verses.text_english: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔር ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጠረ።

verses.text_english: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ባዶ ነበረች፥ አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ጨለማም በጥልቁ ላይ ነበረ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በውኃ ላይ ሰፍፎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ብርሃን ይሁን ኣለ፤ ብርሃንም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God saw the light, that good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ እግዚብሔርም ብርሃንንና ጨለማን ለየ።

verses.text_english: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ብርሃኑን ቀን ብሎ ጠራው፥ ጨለማውንም ሌሊት አለው። ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ አንድ ቀን።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። በውኆች መካከል ጠፈር ይሁን፥ በውኃና በውኃ መካከልም ይክፈል አለ።

verses.text_english: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which under the firmament from the waters which above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ጠፈርን አደረገ፥ ከጠፈር በታችና ከጠፈር በላይ ያሉትንም ውኆች ለየ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጠፈርን ሰማይ ብሎ ጠራው። ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ ሁለተኛ ቀን።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry appear: and it was so.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ከሰማይ በታች ያለው ውኃ በአንድ ስፍራ ይሰብሰብ፥ የብሱም ይገለጥ አለ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God called the dry Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that good.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የብሱን ምድር ብሎ ጠራው፤ የውኃ መከማቻውንም ባሕር አለው፤ እግዚእብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ምድር ዘርን የሚሰጥ ሣርንና ቡቃያን በምድርም ላይ እንደ ወገኑ ዘሩ ያለበትን ፍሬን የሚያፈራ ዛፍን ታብቅል አለ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the earth brought forth grass, herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed in itself, after his kind: and God saw that good.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ዘርን የሚሰጥ ሣርንና ቡቃያን እንደ ወገኑ ዘሩም ያለበትን ፍሬን የሚያፈራ ዛፍን እንደ ወገኑ አበቀለች። እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.text_english: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
verses.text_amharic: ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ ሦስተኛ ቀን።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ቀንና ሌሊትን ይለዩ ዘንድ ብርሃናት በሰማይ ጠፈር ይሁኑ፤ ለምልክቶች ለዘመኖች ለዕለታት ለዓመታትም ይሁኑ፤

verses.text_english: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ያበሩ ዘንድ በሰማይ ጠፈር ብርሃናት ይሁኑ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: the stars also.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሁለት ታላላቆች ብርሃናትን አደረገ፤ ትልቁ ብርሃን በቀን እንዲሠለጥን፥ ትንሹም ብርሃን በሌሊት እንዲሰለጥን፤ ከዋክብትንም ደግሞ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ላይ ያበሩ ዘንድ በሰማይ ጠፈር አኖራቸው፤

verses.text_english: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that good.
verses.text_amharic: በቀንም በሌሊትም እንዲሠለጥኑ፥ ብርሃንንና ጨለማንም እንዲለዩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.text_english: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
verses.text_amharic: ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ አራተኛ ቀን።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ውኃ ሕያው ነፍስ ያላቸውን ተንቀሳቃሾች ታስገኝ፥ ወፎችም ከምድር በላይ ከሰማይ ጠፈር በታች ይብረሩ።

verses.text_english: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that good.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ታላላቆች አንበሪዎችን፥ ውኃይቱ እንደ ወገኑ ያስገኘቻቸውንም ተንቀሳቃሾቹን ሕያዋን ፍጥረታት ሁሉ፥ እንደ ወገኑ የሚበሩትንም ወፎች ሁሉ ፈጠረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.text_english: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ብሎ ባረካቸው። ብዙ ተባዙም የባሕርንም ውኃ ሙሉአት፤ ወፎችም በምድር ላይ ይብዙ።

verses.text_english: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
verses.text_amharic: ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ አምስተኛ ቀን።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ምድር ሕያዋን ፍጥረታትን እንደ ወገኑ፥ እንስሳትንና ተንቀሳቃሾችን የምድር አራዊትንም እንደ ወገኑ፥ ታውጣ፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that good.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የምድር አራዊትን እንደ ወገኑ አደረገ፥ እንስሳውንም እንደ ወገኑ፥ የመሬት ተንቀሳቃሾችንም እንደ ወገኑ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያ መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.text_english: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ሰውን በመልካችን እንደ ምሳሌአችን እንፍጠር፤ የባሕር ዓሦችንና የሰማይ ወፎችን፥ እንስሳትንና ምድርን ሁሉ፥ በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱትንም ሁሉ ይግዙ።

verses.text_english: So God created man in his image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በመልኩ ፈጠረ፤ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጠረው፤ ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ባረካቸው፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። ብዙ፥ ተባዙ፥ ምድርንም ሙሉአት፥ ግዙአትም፤ የባሕርን ዓሦችና የሰማይን ወፎች በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱትንም ሁሉ ግዙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እነሆ መብል ይሆናችሁ ዘንድ በምድር ፊት ሁሉ ላይ ዘሩ በእርሱ ያለውን ሐመልማል ሁሉ፥ የዛፍን ፍሬ የሚያፈራውንና ዘር ያለውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰጠኋችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein life, every green herb for meat: and it was so.
verses.text_amharic: ለምድርም አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ለሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ፥ ሕያው ነፍስ ላላቸው ለምድር ተንቀሳቃሾችም ሁሉ የሚበቅለው ሐመልማል ሁሉ መብል ይሁንላቸው፤ እንዲሁም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ፥ እነሆም እጅግ መልካም ነበረ። ማታም ሆነ ጥዋትም ሆነ፥ ስድስተኛ ቀን።

verses.text_english: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይና ምድር ሠራዊታቸውም ሁሉ ተፈጸሙ።

verses.text_english: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የሠራውን ሥራ በሰባተኛው ቀን ፈጸመ፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ዐረፈ።

verses.text_english: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰባተኛውን ቀን ባረከው ቀደሰውም፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያደርገው ከፈጠረው ሥራ ሁሉ በእርሱ ዐርፎአልና።

verses.text_english: These the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ሰማይንና ምድርን ባደረገ አምላክ ሰማይንና ምድርን ቀን፥ በተፈጠሩ ጊዜ የሰማይና የምድር ልደት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and not a man to till the ground.
verses.text_amharic: የሜዳ ቁጥቋጦ ሁሉ በምድር ላይ ገና አልነበረም፤ የሜዳውም ቡቃያ ሁሉ ገና አልበቀለም ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ምድር ላይ አላዘነበም ነበርና፥ ምድርንም የሚሠራባት ሰው አልነበረም፤

verses.text_english: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጉም ከምድር ትወጣ ነበር፥ የምድርንም ፊት ሁሉ ታጠጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God formed man the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሰውን ከምድር አፈር አበጀው፤ በአፍንጫውም የሕይወት እስትንፋስን እፍ አለበት፤ ሰውም ሕያው ነፍስ ያለው ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም በምሥራቅ በዔድን ገነትን ተከለ የፈጠረውንም ሰው ከዚያው አኖረው።

verses.text_english: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ለማየት ደስ የሚያሰኘውን፥ ለመብላትም መልካም የሆነውን ዛፍ ሁሉ ከምድር አበቀለ፤ በገነትም መካከል የሕይወትን ዛፍ፥ መልካምንና ክፉን የሚያስታውቀውንም ዛፍ አበቀለ።

verses.text_english: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዝም ገነትን ያጠጣ ዘንድ ከዔድን ይወጣ ነበር፤ ከዚያም ለአራት ክፍል ይከፈል ነበር።

verses.text_english: The name of the first Pison: that it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where gold;
verses.text_amharic: የአንደኛው ወንዝ ስም ፊሶን ነው፤ እርሱም ወርቅ የሚገኝበትን የኤውላጥ ምድርን ይከብባል፤ የዚያም ምድር ወርቅ ጥሩ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And the gold of that land good: there bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ሉልና የከበረ ድንጋይ ይገኛል።

verses.text_english: And the name of the second river Gihon: the same it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለተኛውም ወንዝ ስም ግዮን ነው፤ እርሱም የኢትዮጵያን ምድር ሁሉ ይከብባል።

verses.text_english: And the name of the third river Hiddekel: that it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river Euphrates.
verses.text_amharic: የሦስተኛውም ወንዝ ስም ጤግሮስ ነው፤ እርሱም በአሦር ምሥራቅ የሚሄድ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛውም ወንዝ ኤፍራጥስ ነው። እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሰውን ወስዶ ያበጃትም ይጠብቃትም ዘንድ በዔድን ገነት አኖረው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሰውን እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። ከገነት ዛፍ ሁሉ ትበላለህ፤

verses.text_english: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መልካምንና ክፉን ከሚያስታውቀው ዛፍ አትብላ፤ ከእርሱ በበላህ ቀን ሞትን ትሞታለህና።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God said, not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም አለ። ሰው ብቻውን ይሆን ዘንድ መልካም አይደለም፤ የሚመቸውን ረዳት እንፍጠርለት።

verses.text_english: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that the name thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም የምድር አራዊትንና የሰማይ ወፎችን ሁሉ ከመሬት አደረገ፤ በምን ስም እንደሚጠራቸውም ያይ ዘንድ ወደ አዳም አመጣቸው፤ አዳምም ሕያው ነፍስ ላለው ሁሉ በስሙ እንደ ጠራው ስሙ ያው ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም ለእንስሳት ሁሉ፥ ለሰማይ ወፎችም ሁሉ፥ ለምድር አራዊትም ሁሉ ስም አወጣላቸው፤ ነገር ግን ለአዳም እንደ እርሱ ያለ ረዳት አልተገኘለትም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም በአዳም ከባድ እንቅልፍን ጣለበት፥ አንቀላፋም፤ ከጎኑም አንዲት አጥንትን ወስዶ ስፍራውን በሥጋ ዘጋው።

verses.text_english: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ከአዳም የወሰዳትን አጥንት ሴት አድርጎ ሠራት፤ ወደ አዳምም አመጣት።

verses.text_english: And Adam said, This now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም አለ። ይህች አጥንት ከአጥንቴ ናት፥ ሥጋም ከሥጋዬ ናት፤ እርስዋ ከወንድ ተገኝታለችና ሴት ትባል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል፥ በሚስቱም ይጣበቃል፤ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምና ሚስቱ ሁለቱም ዕራቁታቸውን ነበሩ፥ አይተፋፈሩም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
verses.text_amharic: እባብም እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ከፈጠረው ከምድር አውሬ ሁሉ ይልቅ ተንኰለኛ ነበረ። ሴቲቱንም። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከገነት ዛፍ ሁሉ እንዳትበሉ አዝዞአልን? አላት።

verses.text_english: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ለእባቡ አለችው። በገነት ካለው ከዛፍ ፍሬ እንበላለን፤

verses.text_english: But of the fruit of the tree which in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በገነት መካከል ካለው ከዛፉ ፍሬ፥ እግዚአብሔር አለ። እንዳትሞቱ ከእርሱ አትብሉ አትንኩትም።

verses.text_english: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.text_amharic: እባብም ለሴቲቱ አላት። ሞትን አትሞቱም፤

verses.text_english: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርስዋ በበላችሁ ቀን ዓይኖቻችሁ እንዲከፈቱ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም መልካምንና ክፉን የምታውቁ እንድትሆኑ እግዚአብሔር ስለሚያውቅ ነው እንጂ።

verses.text_english: And when the woman saw that the tree good for food, and that it pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ዛፉ ለመብላት ያማረ እንደ ሆነ፥ ለዓይንም እንደሚያስጎመጅ፥ ለጥበብም መልካም እንደ ሆነ አየች፤ ከፍሬውም ወሰደችና በላች፤ ለባልዋም ደግሞ ሰጠችው እርሱም ከእርስዋ ጋር በላ።

verses.text_english: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለቱም ዓይኖች ተከፈቱ፥ እነርሱም ዕራቁታቸውን እንደ ሆኑ አወቁ፤ የበለስንም ቅጠሎች ሰፍተው ለእነርሱ ለራሳቸው ግልድም አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ቀኑ በመሸ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክን ድምፅ ከገነት ውስጥ ሲመላለስ ሰሙ፤ አዳምና ሚስቱም ከእግዚአብሔር ከአምላክ ፊት በገነት ዛፎች መካከል ተሸሸጉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where thou?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም አዳምን ጠርቶ። ወዴት ነህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I naked; and I hid myself.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። በገነት ድምፅህን ሰማሁ፤ ዕራቁቴንም ስለ ሆንሁ ፈራሁ፥ ተሸሸግሁም።

verses.text_english: And he said, Who told thee that thou naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ዕራቁትህን እንደ ሆንህ ማን ነገረህ? ከእርሱ እንዳትበላ ካዘዝሁህ ዛፍ በውኑ በላህን?

verses.text_english: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም አለ። ከእኔ ጋር እንድትሆን የሰጠኸኝ ሴት እርስዋ ከዛፉ ሰጠችኝና በላሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What this thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ሴቲቱን። ይህ ያደረግሽው ምንድር ነው? አላት። ሴቲቱም አለች። እባብ አሳተኝና በላሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም እባቡን አለው። ይህን ስላደረግህ ከእንስሳት ከምድር አራዊትም ሁሉ ተለይተህ አንተ የተረገምህ ትሆናለህ፤ በሆድህም ትሄዳለህ፥ አፈርንም በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ ትበላለህ።

verses.text_english: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተና በሴቲቱ መካከል፥ በዘርህና በዘርዋም መካከል ጠላትነትን አደርጋለሁ፤ እርሱ ራስህን ይቀጠቅጣል፥ አንተም ሰኰናውን ትቀጠቅጣለህ።

verses.text_english: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለሴቲቱም አለ። በፀነስሽ ጊዜ ጭንቅሽን እጅግ አበዛለሁ፤ በጭንቅ ትወልጃለሽ፤ ፈቃድሽም ወደ ባልሽ ይሆናል፥ እርሱም ገዥሽ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat it all the days of thy life;
verses.text_amharic: አዳምንም አለው። የሚስትህን ቃል ሰምተሃልና፥ ከእርሱ እንዳትበላ ካዘዝሁህ ዛፍም በልተሃልና ምድር ከአንተ የተነሣ የተረገመች ትሁን፤ በሕይወት ዘመንህም ሁሉ በድካም ከእርስዋ ትበላለህ፤

verses.text_english: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.text_amharic: እሾህንና አሜከላን ታበቅልብሃለች፤ የምድርንም ቡቃያ ትበላለህ።

verses.text_english: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou , and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ወጣህበት መሬት እስክትመለስ ድረስ በፊትህ ወዝ እንጀራን ትበላለህ፤ አፈር ነህና፥ ወደ አፈርም ትመለሳለህና።

verses.text_english: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም ለሚስቱ ሔዋን ብሎ ስም አወጣ፥ የሕያዋን ሁሉ እናት ናትና።

verses.text_english: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም ለአዳምና ለሚስቱ የቁርበትን ልብስ አደረገላቸው፥ አለበሳቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክም አለ። እነሆ አዳም መልካምንና ክፉን ለማወቅ ከእኛ እንደ አንዱ ሆነ፤ አሁንም እጁን እንዳይዘረጋ፥ ደግሞም ከሕይወት ዛፍ ወስዶ እንዳይበላ፥ ለዘላለምም ሕያው ሆኖ እንዳይኖር፤

verses.text_english: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ከዔድን ገነት አስወጣው፥ የተገኘባትን መሬት ያርስ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምንም አስወጣው፥ ወደ ሕይወት ዛፍ የሚወስደውንም መንገድ ለመጠበቅ ኪሩቤልንና የምትገለባበጥ የነበልባል ሰይፍን በዔድን ገነት ምሥራቅ አስቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም ሚስቱን ሔዋንን አወቀ፤ ፀነሰችም፥ ቃየንንም ወለደች። እርስዋም። ወንድ ልጅ ከእግዚአብሔር አገኘሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ወንድሙን አቤልን ወለደች። አቤልም በግ ጠባቂ ነበረ፤ ቃየንም ምድርን የሚያርስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ቀን በኋላም ቃየን ከምድር ፍሬ ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕትን አቀረበ፤

verses.text_english: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
verses.text_amharic: አቤልም ደግሞ ከበጎቹ በኵራትና ከስቡ አቀረበ። እግዚአብሔርም ወደ አቤልና ወደ መሥዋዕቱ ተመለከተ፤

verses.text_english: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቃየንና ወደ መሥዋዕቱ ግን አልተመለከተም። ቃየንም እጅግ ተናደደ ፊቱም ጠቆረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ቃየንን አለው። ለምን ተናደድህ? ለምንስ ፊትህ ጠቆረ?

verses.text_english: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ብታደርግ ፊትህ የሚበራ አይደለምን? መልካም ባታደርግ ግን ኃጢአት በደጅ ታደባለች፤ ፈቃድዋም ወደ አንተ ነው፥ አንተ ግን በእርስዋ ንገሥባት።

verses.text_english: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.text_amharic: ቃየንም ወንድሙን አቤልን። ና ወደ ሜዳ እንሂድ አለው። በሜዳም ሳሉ ቃየን በወንድሙ በአቤል ላይ ተነሣበት፥ ገደለውም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: I my brother's keeper?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ቃየንን አለው። ወንድምህ አቤል ወዴት ነው? እርሱም አለ። አላውቅም፤ የወንድሜ ጠባቂው እኔ ነኝን?

verses.text_english: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
verses.text_amharic: አለውም። ምን አደረግህ? የወንድምህ የደሙ ድምፅ ከምድር ወደ እኔ ይጮኻል።

verses.text_english: And now thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የወንድምህን ደም ከእጅህ ለመቀበል አፍዋን በከፈተች በምድር ላይ አንተ የተረገምህ ነህ።

verses.text_english: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርንም ባረስህ ጊዜ እንግዲህ ኃይልዋን አትሰጥህም፤ በምድርም ላይ ኰብላይና ተቅበዝባዥ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment greater than I can bear.
verses.text_amharic: ቃየንም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ኃጢአቴ ልሸከማት የማልችላት ታላቅ ናት።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, every one that findeth me shall slay me.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ ዛሬ ከምድር ፊት አሳደድኸኝ፤ ከፊትህም እሰወራለሁ፤ በምድርም ላይ ኰብላይና ተቅበዝባዥ እሆናለሁ፤ የሚያገኘኝም ሁሉ ይገድለኛል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እርሱን አለው። እንግዲህ ቃየንን የገደለ ሁሉ ሰባት እጥፍ ይበቀልበታል። እግዚአብሔርም ቃየንን ያገኘው ሁሉ እንዳይገድለው ምልክት አደረገለት።

verses.text_english: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.text_amharic: ቃየንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ፤ ከዔድንም ወደ ምሥራቅ በኖድ ምድር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.text_amharic: ቃየንም ሚስቱን አወቀ፤ ፀነሰችም፥ ሄኖሕንም ወለደች። ከተማም ሠራ፥ የከተማይቱንም ስም በልጁ ስም ሄኖሕ አላት።

verses.text_english: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖሕም ጋይዳድን ወለደ፤ ጋይዳድም ሜኤልን ወለደ፤ ሜኤልም ማቱሣኤልን ወለደ፤ ማቱሣኤልም ላሜሕን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.text_amharic: ላሜሕም ለራሱ ሁለት ሚስቶችን አገባ፤ የአንዲቱ ስም ዓዳ፥ የሁለተኛይቱ ስም ሴላ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and cattle.
verses.text_amharic: ዓዳም ያባልን ወለደች፤ እርሱም በድንኳን የሚቀመጡት የዘላኖች አባት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his brother's name Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
verses.text_amharic: የወንድሙም ስም ዩባል ነበረ፤ እርሱም በገናንና መለከትን ለሚይዙ አባት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain Naamah.
verses.text_amharic: ሴላም ደግሞ ከናስና ከብረት የሚቀጠቀጥ ዕቃን የሚሠራውን ቱባልቃይንን ወለደች። የቱባልቃይንም እኅት ናዕማ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ላሜሕም ለሚስቶቹ ለዓዳና ለሴላ አላቸው። እናንት የላሜሕ ሚስቶች ቃሌን ስሙ፥ ነገሬንም አድምጡ፤ እኔ ጕልማሳውን ለቍስሌ፥ ብላቴናውንም ለመወጋቴ ገድዬዋለሁና፤

verses.text_english: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.text_amharic: ቃየንን ሰባት እጥፍ ይበቀሉታል፤ ላሜሕን ግን ሰባ ሰባት እጥፍ። ይበቀሉታል

verses.text_english: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
verses.text_amharic: አዳም ደግሞ ሚስቱን አወቀ፤ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች። ስሙንም። ቃየን በገደለው በአቤል ፋንታ እግዚአብሔር ሌላ ዘር ተክቶልኛል ስትል ሴት አለችው።

verses.text_english: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለሴት ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ተወለደለት፤ ስሙንም ሄኖስ አለው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም በእግዚአብሔር ስም መጠራት ተጀመረ። a

verses.text_english: This the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.text_amharic: የአዳም የትውልዱ መጽሐፍ ይህ ነው። እግዚአብሔር አዳምን በፈጠረ ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ አደረገው፤

verses.text_english: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድና ሴት አድርጎ ፈጠራቸው፥ ባረካቸውም። ስማቸውንም በፈጠረበት ቀን አዳም ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም ሁለት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ልጅንም በምሳሌው እንደ መልኩ ወለደ፤ ስሙንም ሴት ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም ሴትን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: አዳምም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
verses.text_amharic: ሴትም ሁለት መቶ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሄኖስንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ሴትም ሄኖስን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ሰባት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ሴትም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖስም መቶ ዘጠና ዓመት ኖረ፥ ቃይናንንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖስም ቃይናንን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖስም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
verses.text_amharic: ቃይናንም መቶ ሰባ ዓመት ኖረ፥ መላልኤልንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ቃይናንም መላልኤልን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ አርባ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ቃይናንም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አሥር ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
verses.text_amharic: መላልኤልም መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ያሬድንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: መላልኤልም ያሬድን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: መላልኤልም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ስምንት መቶ ዘጠና አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
verses.text_amharic: ያሬድም መቶ ስድሳ ሁለት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሄኖክንም ወለደ

verses.text_english: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ያሬድም ሄኖክን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ስምንት መቶ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ያሬድም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ ስድሳ ሁለት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖክም መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ማቱሳላንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖክም አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አደረገ፤ ማቱሳላንም ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሁለት መቶ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖክም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Enoch walked with God: and he not; for God took him.
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖክም አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስላደረገ አልተገኘም፤ እግዚአብሔር ወስዶታልና።

verses.text_english: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
verses.text_amharic: ማቱሳላም መቶ ሰማኒያ ሰባት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ላሜሕንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ማቱሳላም ላሜሕን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው ሰባት መቶ ሰማንያ ሁለት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ማቱሳላም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ ስድሳ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
verses.text_amharic: ላሜሕም መቶ ሰማንያ ሁለት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ልጅንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And he called his name Noah, saying, This shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙንም። እግዚአብሔር በረገማት ምድር ከተግባራችንና ከእጅ ሥራችን ይህ ያሳርፈናል ሲል ኖኅ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.text_amharic: ላሜሕም ኖኅን ከወለደ በኋላ የኖረው አምስት መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ላሜሕ የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሰባት መቶ አርባ ሰባት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም የአምስት መቶ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ ኖኅም ሴምን ካምን ያፌትንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ መብዛት በጀመሩ ጊዜ ሴቶች ልጆች ተወለዱላቸው፤

verses.text_english: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆችም የሰውን ሴቶች ልጆች መልካሞች እንደ ሆኑ አዩ፤ ከመረጡአቸውም ሁሉ ሚስቶችን ለራሳቸው ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። መንፈሴ በሰው ላይ ለዘላለም አይኖርም፥ እርሱ ሥጋ ነውና፤ ዘመኖቹም መቶ ሀያ ዓመት ይሆናሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare to them, the same mighty men which of old, men of renown.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚያ ወራት ኔፊሊም በምድር ላይ ነበሩ፤ ደግሞም ከዚያ በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች የሰውን ሴቶች ልጆች ባገቡ ጊዜ ልጆችን ወለዱላቸው፤ እነርሱም በዱሮ ዘመን ስማቸው የታወቀ ኃያላን ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man great in the earth, and every imagination of the thoughts of his heart only evil continually.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የሰው ክፉት በምድር ላይ እንደ በዛ፥ የልቡ አሳብ ምኞትም ሁልጊዜ ፈጽሞ ክፉ እንደ ሆነ አየ።

verses.text_english: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውን በምድር ላይ በመፍጠሩ ተጸጸተ፥ በልቡም አዘነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። የፈጠርሁትን ሰው ከምድር ላይ አጠፋለሁ፥ ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ እስከ ተንቀሳቃሽም እስከ ሰማይ ወፍም ድረስ፤ ስለ ፈጠርኋቸው ተጸጽቼአለሁና አለ።

verses.text_english: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞገስን አገኘ።

verses.text_english: These the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man perfect in his generations, Noah walked with God.
verses.text_amharic: የኖኅ ትውልድ እንዲህ ነው። ኖኅም በትውልዱ ጻድቅ ፍጹምም ሰው ነበረ፤ ኖኅ አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ሦስት ልጆችን ሴምን ካምን ያፌትንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ተበላሸች፤ ምድርም ግፍን ተሞላች።

verses.text_english: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን አየ፥ እነሆም ተበላሸች፤ ሥጋን የለበሰ ሁሉ በምድር ላይ መንገዱን አበላሽቶ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን አለው። የሥጋ ሁሉ ፍጻሜ በፊቴ ደርሶአል፤ ከእነርሱ የተነሣ ምድር በግፍ ተሞልታለችና፤ እኔም እነሆ ከምድር ጋር አጠፋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.text_amharic: ከጎፈር እንጨት መርከብን ለአንተ ሥራ፤ በመርከቢቱም ጉርጆችን አድርግ፥ በውስጥም በውጭም በቅጥራን ለቅልቃት።

verses.text_english: And this which thou shalt make it : The length of the ark three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋንም እንዲህ ታደርጋታለህ፤ የመርከቢቱ ርዝመት ሦስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ወርድዋ አምሳ ክንድ፥ ከፍታዋ ሠላሳ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; lower, second, and third shalt thou make it.
verses.text_amharic: ለመርከቢቱም መስኮትን ታደርጋለህ፤ ከቁመትዋም ክንድ ሙሉ ትተህ ጨርሳት፤ የመርከቢቱንም በር በጎንዋ አድርግ፤ ታችኛውንም ሁለተኛውንም ሦስተኛውንም ደርብ ታደርግላታለህ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein the breath of life, from under heaven; every thing that in the earth shall die.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እነሆ ከሰማይ በታች የሕይወት ነፍስ ያለውን ሥጋ ሁሉ ለማጥፋት በምድር ላይ የጥፋት ውኃን አመጣለሁ፤ በምድር ያለው ሁሉ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኔንም ከአንተ ጋር አቆማለሁ፤ ወደ መርከብም አንተ ልጆችህንና ሚስትህን የልጆችህንም ሚስቶች ይዘህ ትገባለህ።

verses.text_english: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ ጋር በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ ሥጋ ካለው ከሕያው ሁሉ ሁለት ሁለት እያደረግህ ወደ መርከብ ታገባለህ፤ ተባትና እንስት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every shall come unto thee, to keep alive.
verses.text_amharic: ከወፍ እንደ ወገኑ፥ ከእንስሳም እንደ ወገኑ፥ ከምድር ተንቀሳቃሽም ሁሉ እንደ ወገኑ በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ ሁለት ሁለት እየሆኑ ወደ አንተ ይግቡ።

verses.text_english: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚበላውም መብል ሁሉ ለአንተ ውሰድ፥ ወደ አንተም ትሰበስባለህ፤ እርሱም ለአንተም ለእነርሱም መብል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ። a

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን አለው። አንተ ቤተሰቦችህን ሁሉ ይዘህ ወደ መርከብ ግባ፤ በዚህ ትውልድ በፊቴ ጻድቅ ሆነህ አይቼሃለሁና።

verses.text_english: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that not clean by two, the male and his female.
Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከንጹሕ እንስሳ ሁሉ ሰባት ሰባት ተባትና እንስት፥ ንጹሕ ካልሆነ እንስሳም ሁለት ሁለት ተባትና እንስት፥ ከሰማይ ወፍ ደግሞ ሰባት ሰባት ተባትና እንስት እያደረግህ በምድር ላይ ለዘር ይቀር ዘንድ ለአንተ ትወስዳለህ።

verses.text_english: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰባት ቀን በኋላ አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በምድር ላይ ዝናብ አዘንባለሁና፤ የፈጠርሁትንም ፍጥረት ሁሉ ከምድር ላይ አጠፉለሁና።

verses.text_english: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Noah six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም የጥፋት ውኃ በምድር ላይ በሆነ ጊዜ የስድስት መቶ ዓመት ዕድሜ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ስለ ጥፋት ውኃ ልጆቹንና ሚስቱን የልጆቹንም ሚስቶች ይዞ ወደ መርከብ ገባ።

verses.text_english: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
verses.text_amharic: ከንጹሕ እንስሳ ንጹሕም ካልሆነው እንስሳ፥ ከወፎችና በምድር ላይ ከሚንቀሳቀሰውም ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ኖኅን እንዳዘዘው፥ ሁለት ሁለት ተባትና እንስት እየሆኑ ወደ ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰባት ቀንም በኋላ የጥፋት ውኃ በምድር ላይ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.text_amharic: በኖኅ ዕድሜ በስድስተኛው መቶ ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ዕለት፥ በዚያው ቀን የታላቁ ቀላይ ምንጮች ሁሉ ተነደሉ፥ የሰማይም መስኮቶች ተከፈቱ፤

verses.text_english: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናቡም አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በምድር ላይ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያውም ቀን ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ ገባ፥ የኖኅ ልጆችም ሴም ካም ያፌትና የኖኅ ሚስት ሦስቱም የልጆቹ ሚስቶች ከርሱ ጋር ገቡ።

verses.text_english: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ፥ አራዊትም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ እንስሳትም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾችም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ ወፎችም ሁሉ በየወገናቸው፥ የሚበሩ ወፎችም ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein the breath of life.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋ ያላቸው ሕያዋን ሁሉ ሁለት ሁለት እየሆኑ ወደ ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋ ካለው ሁሉ የገቡትም ተባትና እንስት እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ገቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በስተ ኋላው ዘጋበት።

verses.text_english: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የጥፋትም ውኃ በምድር ላይ አርባ ቀን ነበረ፤ ውኃውም በዛ መርከቢቱንም አነሣ፥ ከምድርም ወደ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለች።

verses.text_english: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም አሸነፈ፥ በምድር ላይም እጅግ በዛ፤ መርከቢቱም በውኃ ላይ ሄደች።

verses.text_english: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም በምድር ላይ እጅግ በጣም አሸነፈ፤ ከሰማይም በታች ያሉ ታላላቆች ተራሮች ሁሉ ተሸፈኑ።

verses.text_english: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃው ወደ ላይ አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ተራሮችም ተሸፈኑ።

verses.text_english: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ሥጋ ያለው የሚንቀሳቀሰው ሁሉ፥ ወፉም፥ እንስሳውም፥ አራዊቱም፥ በምድር ላይ የሚርመሰመሰው ተንቀሳቃሹም ሁሉ፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ጠፋ።

verses.text_english: All in whose nostrils the breath of life, of all that in the dry , died.
verses.text_amharic: በየብስ የነበረው በአፍንጫው የሕይወት ነፍስ እስትንፋስ ያለው ሁሉ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained , and they that with him in the ark.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ የነበረውም ሁሉ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ፥ እስከሚርመሰመሰውም ሁሉ ድረስ፥ እስከ ሰማይ ወፍ ድረስ ተደመሰሰ፤ ከምድርም ተደመሰሱ። ኖኅም አብረውት በመርከብ ከነበሩት ጋር ብቻውን ቀረ።

verses.text_english: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም መቶ አምሳ ቀን በምድር ላይ አሸነፈ።

verses.text_english: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን፥ በመርከብም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበረውን አራዊቱን ሁሉ፥ እንስሳውንም ሁሉ አሰበ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ላይ ነፋስን አሳለፈ፥ ውኃውም ጎደለ፤

verses.text_english: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
verses.text_amharic: የቀላዩም ምንጮች የሰማይም መስኮቶች ተደፈኑ፥ ዝናብም ከሰማይ ተከለከለ፤

verses.text_english: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም ከምድር ላይ እያደር እያደር ቀለለ፥ ከመቶ አምሳ ቀንም በኋላ ውኃው ጎደለ።

verses.text_english: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.text_amharic: መርከቢቱም በሰባተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ቀን በአራራት ተራሮች ላይ ተቀመጠች።

verses.text_english: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth , on the first of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም እስከ አሥረኛው ወር ድረስ ይጎድል ነበር፤ በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን የተራሮቹ ራሶች ተገለጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.text_amharic: ከአርባ ቀንም በኋላ ኖኅ የሠራውን የመርከቢቱን መስኮት ከፈተ፥

verses.text_english: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ቁራንም ሰደደው፤ እርሱም ወጣ፤ ውኃው ከምድር ላይ እስኪደርቅ ድረስ ወዲያና ወዲህ ይበር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verses.text_amharic: ርግብንም ውኃው ከምድር ፊት ቀልሎ እንደ ሆነ እንድታይ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ሰደዳት።

verses.text_english: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ርግብ እግርዋን የምታሳርፍበት ስፍራ አላገኘችም፥ ወደ እርሱም ወደ መርከብ ተመለሰች፥ ውኃ በምድር ላይ ሁሉ ስለ ነበረ፤ እጁን ዘረጋና ተቀበላት፥ ወደ እርሱም ወደ መርከብ ውስጥ አገባት።

verses.text_english: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ እስከ ሰባት ቀን ቆየ፤ ርግብንም እንደ ገና ከመርከብ ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ርግብም በማታ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፤ በአፍዋም እነሆ የለመለመ የወይራ ቅጠል ይዛ ነበር። ኖኅም ከምድር ላይ ውኃ እንደ ቀለለ አወቀ።

verses.text_english: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ እስከ ሰባት ቀን ቆየ፤ ርግብንም ሰደዳት ዳግመኛም ወደ እርሱ አልተመለሰችም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first , the first of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.text_amharic: በኖኅ ዕድሜ በስድስት መቶ አንድ ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ውኃው ከምድር ላይ ደረቀ፤ ኖኅም የመርከቢቱን ክዳን አነሣ፥ እነሆም፥ ውኃው ከምድር ፊት እንደ ደረቀ አየ።

verses.text_english: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ወር ከወሩም በሀያ ሰባተኛው ቀን ምድር ደረቀች።

verses.text_english: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለኖኅ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ሚስትህንና ልጆችህን የልጆችህንም ሚስቶች ይዘህ ከመርከብ ውጣ።

verses.text_english: Bring forth with thee every living thing that with thee, of all flesh, of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ ጋር ያሉትን አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ሥጋ ያላቸውን ሁሉ፥ ወፎችንና እንስሶችን ሁሉ፥ በምድር ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱትንም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር አውጣቸው፤ በምድር ላይ ይርመስመሱ፥ ይዋለዱ፥ በምድርም ላይ ይብዙ።

verses.text_english: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ልጆቹንና ሚስቱን የልጆቹንም ሚስቶች ይዞ ወጣ፤

verses.text_english: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
verses.text_amharic: አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ፥ ወፎችም ሁሉ፥ በምድር ላይ የሚርመሰምሰው ሁሉ በየዘመዳቸው ከመርከብ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያውን ሠራ፥ ከንጹሕም እንስሳ ሁሉ ከንጹሐን ወፎችም ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ በመሠውያውም ላይ መሥዋዕትን አቀረበ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም መልካሙን መዓዛ አሸተተ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በልቡ አለ። ምድርን ዳግመኛ ስለ ሰው አልረግምም፥ የሰው ልብ አሳብ ከታናሽነቱ ጀምሮ ክፉ ነውና፤ ደግሞም ከዚህ ቀድሞ እንዳደረግሁት ሕያዋንን ሁሉ እንደ ገና አልመታም።

verses.text_english: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ዘመን ሁሉ መዝራትና ማጨድ፥ ብርድና ሙቀት፥ በጋና ክረምት፥ ቀንና ሌሊት አያቋርጡም። a

verses.text_english: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅንና ልጆቹን ባረካቸው እንዲህም አላቸው። ብዙ ተባዙ፥ ምድርንም ሙሉአት።

verses.text_english: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.text_amharic: አስፈሪነታችሁና አስደንጋጭነታችሁ በምድር አራዊት፥ በሰማይም ወፎች፥ በምድር ላይ በሚንቀሳቀሱትም፥ በባሕር ዓሦችም ሁሉ ላይ ይሁን፤ እነርሱም በእጃችሁ ተሰጥተዋል።

verses.text_english: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወት ያለው ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ መብል ይሁናችሁ፤ ሁሉን እንደ ለመለመ ቡቃያ ሰጠኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: But flesh with the life thereof, the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ነፍሱ ደሙ ያለችበትን ሥጋ አትብሉ፤

verses.text_english: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሳችሁ ያለችበትን ደማችሁን በእርግጥ እሻዋለሁ፤ ከአራዊት ሁሉ እጅ እሻዋለሁ፤ ከሰውም እጅ፥ ከሰው ወንድም እጅ፥ የሰውን ነፍስ እሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውን ደም የሚያፈስስ ሁሉ ደሙ ይፈስሳል፤ ሰውን በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ፈጥሮታልና።

verses.text_english: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ብዙ፥ ተባዙ፤ በምድር ላይ ተዋለዱ፥ እርቡባትም።

verses.text_english: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለኖኅና ለልጆቹ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እነሆ ቃል ኪዳኔን ከእናንተና በኋላ ከሚመጣው ከዘራችሁ ጋር አቆማለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And with every living creature that with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ጋር ላሉትም ሕያው ነፍስ ላላቸው ሁሉ፥ ከእናንተ ጋር ከመርከብ ለወጡት ለወፎች፥ ለእንስሳትም ለምድር አራዊትም ሁሉ፥ ለማንኛውም ለምድር አራዊት ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኔንም ለእናንተ አቆማለሁ፤ ሥጋ ያለውም ሁሉ ዳግመኛ በጥፋት ውኃ አይጠፋም፤ ምድርንም ለማጥፋት ዳግመኛ የጥፋት ውኃ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: And God said, This the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል፥ ከእናንተም ጋር ባለው በሕያው ነፍስ ሁሉ መካከል፥ ለዘላለም የማደርገው የቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይህ ነው፤

verses.text_english: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስቴን በደመና አድርጌአለሁ፥ የቃል ኪዳኑም ምልክት በእኔና በምድር መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ደመናን በጋረድሁ ጊዜ ቀስቲቱ በደመናው ትታያለች፤

verses.text_english: And I will remember my covenant, which between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል፥ ሕያው ነፍስ ባለውም ሥጋ ሁሉ መካከል ያለውን ቃል ኪዳኔን አስባለሁ፤ ሥጋ ያለውንም ሁሉ ያጠፋ ዘንድ ዳግመኛ የጥፋት ውኃ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስቲቱም በደመና ትሆናለች፤ በእኔና በምድር ላይ በሚኖር ሥጋ ባለው በሕያው ነፍስ ሁሉ መካከል ያለውን የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ለማሰብ አያታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And God said unto Noah, This the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኖኅን። በእኔና በምድር ላይ በሚኖር ሥጋ ባለው ሁሉ መካከል ያቆምሁት የቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይህ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham the father of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: ከመርከብ የወጡት የኖኅ ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ሴም፥ ካም፥ ያፌት፤ ካምም የከነዓን አባት ነው።

verses.text_english: These the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.text_amharic: የኖኅ ልጆች እነዚህ ሦስቱ ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ምድር ሁሉ ተሞላች።

verses.text_english: And Noah began an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ገበሬ መሆን ጀመረ፥ ወይንም ተከለ።

verses.text_english: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.text_amharic: ከወይን ጠጁም ጠጣና ሰከረ፤ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ ዕራቁቱን ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.text_amharic: የከነዓን አባት ካምም የአባቱን ዕራቁትነት አየ፥ ወደ ውጭም ወጥቶ ለሁለቱ ወንድሞቹ ነገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: ሴምና ያፌትም ሸማ ወስደው በጫንቃቸው ላይ አደረጉ፥ የኋሊትም ሄደው የአባታቸውን ዕራቁትነት አለበሱ፤ ፊታቸውም ወደ ኋላ ነበረ፥ የአባታቸውንም ዕራቁትነት አላዩም።

verses.text_english: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ከወይን ጠጁ ስካር ነቃ፥ ታናሹ ልጁ ያደረገበትንም አወቀ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Cursed Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። ከነዓን ርጉም ይሁን፤ ለወንድሞቹም የባሪያዎች ባሪያ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And he said, Blessed the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። የሴም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ፥ ከነዓንም ለእነርሱ ባሪያ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያፌትን ያስፋ፥ በሴምም ድንኳን ይደር፤ ከነዓንም ለእነርሱ ባሪያ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም ከጥፋት ውኃ በኋላ ሦስት መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅም የኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ዘጠኝ መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ሆነ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: Now these the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.text_amharic: የኖኅ ልጆች የሴም የካም የያፌት ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤ ከጥፋት ውኃም በኋላ ልጆች ተወለዱላቸው።

verses.text_english: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.text_amharic: የያፌት ልጆች ጋሜር፥ ማጎግ፥ ማዴ፥ ያዋን፥ ይልሳ፥ ቶቤል፥ ሞሳሕ፥ ቴራስ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.text_amharic: የጋሜርም ልጆች አስከናዝ፥ ሪፋት፥ ቴርጋማ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.text_amharic: የያዋንም ልጆች ኤሊሳ፥ ተርሴስ፥ ኪቲም፥ ሮድኢ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም የአሕዛብ ደሴቶች ሁሉ በየምድራቸው በየቋንቋቸው በየነገዳቸው በየሕዝባቸው ተከፋፈሉ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: የካምም ልጆች ኩሽ፥ ምጽራይም፥ ፉጥ፥ ከነዓን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.text_amharic: የኩሽም ልጆች ሳባ፥ ኤውላጥ፥ ሰብታ፥ ራዕማ፥ ሰበቃታ ናቸው። የራዕማ ልጆችም ሳባ፥ ድዳን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሽም ናምሩድን ወለደ፤ እርሱም በምድር ላይ ኃያል መሆንን ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኃያል አዳኝ ነበረ፤ ስለዚህም። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኃያል አዳኝ እንደ ናምሩድ ተባለ።

verses.text_english: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.text_amharic: የግዛቱም መጀመሪያ በሰናዖር አገር ባቢሎን፥ ኦሬክ፥ አርካድ፥ ካልኔ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.text_amharic: አሦርም ከዚያች አገር ወጣ፤ ነነዌን፥ የረሆቦትን ከተማ፥ ካለህን፥

verses.text_english: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same a great city.
verses.text_amharic: በነነዌና በካለህ መካከልም ሬሴንን ሠራ፤ እርስዋም ታላቂቱ ከተማ ናት።

verses.text_english: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.text_amharic: ምጽራይምም ሉዲምን፥ ዐናሚምን፥ ላህቢምን፥ ነፍታሌምን፥ ፈትሩሲምን፥

verses.text_english: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች የወጡባቸውን ከስሉሂምን፥ ቀፍቶሪምንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.text_amharic: ከነዓንም የበኵር ልጁን ሲዶንን፥ ኬጢያውያንንም፥

verses.text_english: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.text_amharic: ኢያቡሳውያንንም፥ አሞራውያንንም፥

verses.text_english: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.text_amharic: ጌርጌሳውያንንም፥ ኤዊያውያንንም፥

verses.text_english: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.text_amharic: ዐሩኬዎንንም፥ ሲኒንም፥ አራዴዎንንም፥ ሰማሪዎንንም፥ አማቲንም ወለደ። ከዚህም በኋላ የከነዓናውያን ነገድ ተበተኑ።

verses.text_english: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.text_amharic: የከነዓናውያንም ወሰን ከሲዶን አንሥቶ ወደ ጌራራ በኩል ሲል እስከ ጋዛ ድረስ ነው፤ ወደ ሰዶምና ወደ ገሞራ፥ ወደ አዳማና ወደ ሰቦይም በኩልም ሲል እስከ ላሣ ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, in their nations.
verses.text_amharic: የካም ልጆች በየነገዳቸውና በየቋንቋቸው፥ በየምድራችውና በየሕዝባቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were born.
verses.text_amharic: ለሴምም ደግሞ ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ እርሱም የያፌት ታላቅ ወንድምና የዔቦር ልጆች ሁሉ አባት የሆነ ነው።

verses.text_english: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.text_amharic: የሴምም ልጆች ኤላም፥ አሦር፥ አርፋክስድ፥ ሉድ፥ አራም ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.text_amharic: የአራምም ልጆች ዑፅ፥ ሁል፥ ጌቴር፥ ሞሶሕ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.text_amharic: አርፋክስድም ቃይንምን ወለደ፤ ቃይንምም ሳላን፥ ሳላም ዔቦርን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name Joktan.
verses.text_amharic: ለዔቦርም ሁለት ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ የአንደኛው ስሙ ፋሌቅ ነው፥ ምድር በዘመኑ ተከፍላለችና፤ የወንድሙም ስም ዮቅጣን ነው።

verses.text_english: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.text_amharic: ዮቅጣንም ኤልሞዳድን፥ ሣሌፍንም፥ ሐስረሞትንም፥

verses.text_english: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.text_amharic: ያራሕንም፥ ሀዶራምንም፥ አውዛልንም፥

verses.text_english: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.text_amharic: ደቅላንም፥ ዖባልንም፥ አቢማኤልንም፥

verses.text_english: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these the sons of Joktan.
verses.text_amharic: ሳባንም፥ ኦፊርንም፥ ኤውላጥንም፥ ዩባብንም ወለደ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የዮቅጣን ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.text_amharic: ስፍራቸውም ከማሴ አንሥቶ ወደ ስፋር ሲል እስከ ምሥራቅ ተራራ ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.text_amharic: የሴም ልጆች በየነገዳቸውና በየቋንቋቸው፥ በየምድራቸውና በየሕዝባቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: These the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.text_amharic: የኖኅ የልጆቹ ነገዶች እንደ ትውልዳቸው በየሕዝባቸው እነዚህ ናቸው። አሕዛብም ከጥፋት ውኃ በኋላ በምድር ላይ ከእነዚህ ተከፋፈሉ። a

verses.text_english: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ሁሉ በአንድ ቋንቋና በአንድ ንግግር ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሥራቅም ተነሥተው በሄዱ ጊዜ በሰናዖር ምድር አንድ ሜዳ አገኙ፤ በዚያም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ኑ፥ ጡብ እንሥራ፥ በእሳትም እንተኵሰው ተባባሉ። ጡቡም እንደ ድንጋይ ሆነላቸው፤ የምድርም ዝፋት እንደ ጭቃ ሆነችላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም። ኑ ለእኛ ከተማና ራሱ ወደ ሰማይ የሚደርስ ግንብ እንሥራ፤ በምድር ላይ ሳንበተንም ስማችንን እናስጠራው አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የአዳም ልጆች የሠሩትን ከተማና ግንብ ለማየት ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, Behold, the people one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እነሆ፥ እነርሱ አንድ ወገን ናቸው፥ ለሁሉም አንድ ቋንቋ አላቸው፤ ይህንም ለማድረግ ጀመሩ፤ አሁንም ያሰቡትን ሁሉ ለመሥራት አይከለከሉም።

verses.text_english: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ፥ እንውረድ፤ አንዱ የአንዱን ነገር እንዳይሰማው ቋንቋቸውን በዚያ እንደባልቀው።

verses.text_english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከዚያ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ በተናቸው፤ ከተማይቱንም መሥራት ተዉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ስምዋ ባቢሎን ተባለ፥ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ የምድርን ቋንቋ ሁሉ ደባልቋልና፤ ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር በምድር ሁሉ ላይ እነርሱን በትኖአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: These the generations of Shem: Shem an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.text_amharic: የሴም ትውልድ ይህ ነው። ሴም የመቶ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፥ አርፋክስድንም ከጥፋት ውኃ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ዓመት ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ሴምም አርፋክስድን ከወለደ በኋላ አምስት መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.text_amharic: አርፋክስድም መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ቃይንምንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: አርፋክስድም ቃይንምን ከወለደ በኋላ አራት መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም። ቃይንምም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሳላንም ወለደ፤ ቃይንምም ሳላን ከወለደ በኋላ ሶስት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.text_amharic: ሳላም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ዔቦርንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ሳላም ዔቦርን ከወለደ በኋላ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.text_amharic: ዔቦርም መቶ ሠላሳ አራት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ፋሌቅንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ዔቦርም ፋሌቅን ከወለደ በኋላ አራት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.text_amharic: ፋሌቅም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ራግውንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ራግውንም ከወለደ በኋላ ፋሌቅ ሁለት መቶ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.text_amharic: ራግውም መቶ ሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ሴሮሕንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ራግውም ሴሮሕን ከወለደ በኋላ ሁለት መቶ ሰባት ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.text_amharic: ሴሮሕም መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ናኮርንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ናኮርንም ከወለደ በኋላ ሴሮሕ ሁለት መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.text_amharic: ናኮርም መቶ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ታራንም ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ታራንም ከወለደ በኋላ ናኮር መቶ ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም ወለደ፤ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.text_amharic: ታራም መቶ ዓመት ኖረ፥ አብራምንና ናኮርን ሐራንንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: Now these the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.text_amharic: የታራም ትውልድ እነሆ ይህ ነው። ታራ አብራምንና ናኮርን ሐራንንም ወለደ፤ ሐራንም ሎጥን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.text_amharic: ሐራንም በተወለደበት አገር በከለዳውያን ዑር በአባቱ በታራ ፊት ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምና ናኮርም ሚስቶችን አገቡ፤ የአብራም ሚስት ስምዋ ሦራ ነው፤ የናኮር ሚስት የሐራን ልጅ ሚልካ ናት፤ ሐራንም የሚልካና የዮስካ አባት ነው።

verses.text_english: But Sarai was barren; she no child.
verses.text_amharic: ሦራም መካን ነበረች፤ ልጅ አልነበራትም።

verses.text_english: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.text_amharic: ታራም ልጁን አብራምንና የልጅ ልጁን የሐራንን ልጅ ሎጥን የልጁንም የአብራምን ሚስት ምራቱን ሦራን ወሰደ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ይሄዱ ዘንድ ከከለዳውያን ዑር ወጡ፤ ወደ ካራንም መጡ፥ ከዚያም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.text_amharic: የታራም ዕድሜ ሁለት መቶ አምስት ዓመት ሆነ፤ ታራም በካራን ሞተ።

verses.text_english: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አብራምን አለው። ከአገርህ ከዘመዶችህም ከአባትህም ቤት ተለይተህ እኔ ወደማሳይህ ምድር ውጣ።

verses.text_english: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅ ሕዝብም አደርግሃለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም አከብረዋለሁ፤ ለበረከትም ሁን፤

verses.text_english: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
verses.text_amharic: የሚባርኩህንም እባርካለሁ፥ የሚረግሙህንም እረግማለሁ፤ የምድር ነገዶችም ሁሉ በአንተ ይባረካሉ።

verses.text_english: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ነገረው ሄደ፤ ሎጥም ከእርሱ ጋር ሄደ፤ አብራምም ከካራን በወጣ ጊዜ የሰባ አምስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ሚስቱን ሦራንና የወንድሙን ልጅ ሎጥን፥ ያገኙትን ከብት ሁሉና በካራን ያገኙአቸውን ሰዎች ይዞ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ለመሄድ ወጣ፤ ወደ ከነዓንም ምድር ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite then in the land.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም እስከ ሴኬም ስፍራ እስከ ሞሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ድረስ በምድር አለፈ፤ የከነዓን ሰዎችም በዚያን ጊዜ በምድሩ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለአብራም ተገለጠለትና። ይህችን ምድር ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ አለው። እርሱም ለተገለጠለት ለእግዚአብሔር በዚያ ስፍራ መሠውያን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በቤቴል ምሥራቅ ወዳለው ተራራ ወጣ፥ በዚያም ቤቴልን ወደ ምዕራብ ጋይን ወደ ምሥራቅ አድርጎ ድንኳኑን ተከለ፤ በዚያም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ከዚያ ተነሣ፥ እየተጓዘም ወደ አዜብ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine grievous in the land.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ራብ ሆነ፤ አብራምም በዚያ በእንግድነት ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ወደ ግብፅ ወረደ፥ በምድር ራብ ጸንቶ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou a fair woman to look upon:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ግብፅም ለመግባት በቀረበ ጊዜ ሚስቱን ሦራን እንዲህ አላት። አንቺ መልከ መልካም ሴት እንደ ሆንሽ እነሆ እኔ አውቃለሁ

verses.text_english: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅ ሰዎች ያዩሽ እንደ ሆነ። ሚስቱ ናት ይላሉ እኔንም ይገድሉኛል፥ አንቺንም በሕይወት ይተዉሻል።

verses.text_english: Say, I pray thee, thou my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በአንቺ ምክንያት መልካም ይሆንልኝ ዘንድ፥ ስለ አንቺም ነፍሴ ትድን ዘንድ። እኅቱ ነኝ በዪ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she very fair.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ወደ ግብፅ በገባ ጊዜ የግብፅ ሰዎች ሴቲቱን እጅግ ውብ እንደ ሆነች አዩ፤

verses.text_english: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም አለቆች አዩአት፥ በፈርዖንም ፊት አመሰገኑአት፤ ሴቲቱንም ወደ ፈርዖን ቤት ወሰዱአት።

verses.text_english: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.text_amharic: ለአብራምም ስለ እርስዋ መልካም አደረገለት፤ ለእርሱ በጎችም በሬዎችም አህዮችም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም ግመሎችም ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በአብራም ሚስት በሦራ ምክንያት ፈርዖንንና የቤቱን ሰዎች በታላቅ መቅሠፍት መታ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What this thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she thy wife?
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም አብራምን ጠርቶ አለው። ይህ ያደረግህብኝ ምንድር ነው? እርስዋ ሚስትህ እንደ ሆነች ለምን አልገለጥህልኝም?

verses.text_english: Why saidst thou, She my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take , and go thy way.
verses.text_amharic: ለምንስ። እኅቴ ናት አልህ? እኔ ሚስት ላደርጋት ወስጄአት ነበር። አሁንም ሚስትህ እነኋት፤ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh commanded men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሰዎቹን ስለ እርሱ አዘዘ፥ እርሱንም ሚስቱንም ከብቱንም ሁሉ ሸኙአቸው። a

verses.text_english: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ከግብፅ ወጣ፤ እርሱና ሚስቱ ለእርሱ የነበረውም ሁሉ ሎጥም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ አዜብ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Abram very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም በከብት በብርና በወርቅ እጅግ በለጠገ።

verses.text_english: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
verses.text_amharic: ከአዜብ ባደረገው በጕዞውም ወደ ቤቴል በኩል ሄደ፤ ያም ስፍራ አስቀድሞ በቤቴልና በጋይ መካከል ድንኳን ተክሎበት የነበረው ነው፤

verses.text_english: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ስፍራ አስቀድሞ መሠውያ የሠራበት ነው፤ በዚያም አብራም የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.text_amharic: ከአብራም ጋር የሄደው ሎጥ ደግሞ የላምና የበግ መንጋ ድንኳንም ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድነትም ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ምድር አልበቃቸውም የነበራቸው እጅግ ነበረና በአንድነት ሊቀመጡ አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
verses.text_amharic: የአብራምንና የሎጥን መንጎች በሚጠብቁት መካከልም ጠብ ሆነ በዚያም ዘመን ከነዓናውያንና ፌርዛውያን በዚያች ምድር ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we brethren.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ሎጥን አለው። እኛ ወንድማማች ነንና በእኔና በአንተ በእረኞቼና በእረኞችህ መካከል ጠብ እንዳይሆን እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ በፊትህ አይደለችምን? ከእኔ ትለይ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ፤ አንተ ግራውን ብትወስድ እኔ ወደ ቀኝ እሄዳለሁ፤ አንተም ቀኙን ብትወስድ እኔ ወደ ግራ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
verses.text_amharic: ሎጥም ዓይኑን አነሣ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ያለውንም አገር ሁሉ ውኃ የሞላበት መሆኑን አየ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሰዶምንና ገሞራን ከማጥፋቱ አስቀድሞ እስከ ዞዓር ድረስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ገነት በግብፅ ምድር አምሳል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.text_amharic: ሎጥም በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ያለውን አገር ሁሉ መረጠ፤ ሎጥም ወደ ምሥራቅ ተጓዘ፤ አንዱም ከሌላው እርስ በርሳቸው ተለያዩ።

verses.text_english: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched tent toward Sodom.
verses.text_amharic: አብራም በከነዓን ምድር ተቀመጠ ሎጥም በአገሩ ሜዳ ባሉት ከተሞች ተቀመጠ፥ እስከ ሰዶምም ድረስ ድንኳኑን አዘዋወረ።

verses.text_english: But the men of Sodom wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
verses.text_amharic: የሰዶም ሰዎች ግን ክፉዎችና በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እጅግ ኃጢአተኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
verses.text_amharic: ሎጥ ከተለየው በኋላም እግዚአብሔር አብራምን አለው። ዓይንህን አንሣና አንተ ካለህበት ስፍራ ወደ ሰሜንና ወደ ደቡብ ወደ ምሥራቅና ወደ ምዕራብ እይ፤

verses.text_english: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የምታያትን ምድር ሁሉ ለአንተና ለዘርህ ለዘላለም እሰጣለሁና።

verses.text_english: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህንም እንደ ምድር አሸዋ አደርጋለሁ፤ የምድርን አሸዋን ይቈጥር ዘንድ የሚችል ሰው ቢኖር ዘርህ ደግሞ ይቈጠራል።

verses.text_english: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሣ በምድር በርዝመትዋም በስፋትዋም ሂድ እርስዋን ለአንተ እሰጣለሁና።

verses.text_english: Then Abram removed tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ድንኳኑን ነቀለ መጥቶም በኬብሮን ባለው በመምሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ተቀመጠ፤ በዚያም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
verses.text_amharic: በሰናዖር ንጉሥ በአምራፌል፥ በእላሳር ንጉሥ በአርዮክ፥ በኤላም ንጉሥ በኮሎዶጎምር፥ በአሕዛብ ንጉሥ በቲድዓል ዘመን እንዲህ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰዶም ንጉሥ ከባላ፥ ከገሞራ ንጉሥ ከብርሳ፥ ከአዳማ ንጉሥ ከሰነአብ፥ ከሰቦይም ንጉሥ ከሰሜበር፥ ዞዓር ከተባለች ከቤላ ንጉሥም ጋር ሰልፍ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ በሲዲም ሸለቆ ተሰብስበው ተባበሩ፤ ይኸውም የጨው ባሕር ነው።

verses.text_english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ለኮሎዶጎምር ተገዝተው ነበር፥ በአሥራ ሦስተኛውም ዓመት ዐመፁ።

verses.text_english: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.text_amharic: በአሥራ አራተኛውም ዓመት ኮሎዶጎምርና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ነገሥታት መጡ፤ ራፋይምን በአስጣሮት ቃርናይም፥ ዙዚምንም በሃም፥ ኤሚምንም በሴዊ ቂርያታይም መቱ፤

verses.text_english: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which by the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: የሖር ሰዎችንም በሴይር ተራራቸው በበረሀ አጠገብ እስካለች እስከ ኤል ፋራን ድረስ መቱ።

verses.text_english: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰውም ቃዴስ ወደ ተባለች ወደ ዓይንሚስፓጥ መጡ፤ የአማሌቅን አገር ሁሉና ደግሞ በሐሴሶን ታማር የነበረውን አሞራውያንን መቱ።

verses.text_english: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.text_amharic: የሰዶም ንጉሥና የገሞራ ንጉሥ፥ የአዳማ ንጉሥና የሰቦይም ንጉሥ፥ ዞዓር የተባለች የቤላ ንጉሥም ወጡ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ በሲዲም ሸለቆ በእነርሱ ላይ ለሰልፍ ወጡ፤

verses.text_english: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
verses.text_amharic: የኤላምን ንጉሥ ኮሎዶጎምርን፥ የአሕዛብን ንጉሥ ቲድዓልን፥ የሰናዖርን ንጉሥ አምራፌልን፥ የእላሳርን ንጉሥ አርዮክን ለመውጋት አምስቱ ነገሥታት በእነዚህ በአራቱ ላይ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the vale of Siddim slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.text_amharic: በሲዲም ሸለቆ ግን የዝፍት ጕድጓዶች ነበሩበት። የሰዶም ንጉሥ የገሞራ ንጉሥም ሸሹና ወደዚያ ወደቁ፤ የቀሩትም ወደ ተራራ ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.text_amharic: የሰዶምንና የገሞራን ከብት ሁሉ መብላቸውንም ሁሉ ወስደው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.text_amharic: በሰዶም ይኖር የነበረውን የአብራምን የወንድም ልጅ ሎጥን ደግሞ ከብቱንም ወስደው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these confederate with Abram.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ የሸሸ ሰውም መጣ፥ ለዕብራዊው ለአብራምም ነገረው፤ እርሱም የኤስኮል ወንድምና የአውናን ወንድም በሆነ በአሞራዊ መምሬ የአድባር ዛፍ ይኖር ነበር፤ እነዚያም ከአብራም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ገብተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained , born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued unto Dan.
verses.text_amharic: አብራምም ወንድሙ እንደ ተማረከ በሰማ ጊዜ በቤቱ የተወለዱትን ሦስት መቶ አሥራ ስምንት ብላቴኖቹን አሰለፈ፥ ፍለጋቸውንም ተከትሎ እስከ ዳን ድረስ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴኖቹንም ከፍሎ በሌሊት እርሱ ከባሪያዎቹ ጋር ወረደባቸው፥ መታቸውም፥ በደማስቆ ግራ እስካለችውም እስከ ሖባ ድረስ አሳደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.text_amharic: ከብቱንም ሁሉ አስመለሰ፥ ደግሞም ወንድሙን ሎጥንና ከብቶቹን ሴቶችንና ሕዝቡን ደግሞ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which the king's dale.
verses.text_amharic: ኮሎዶጎምርንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ነገሥታት ወግቶ ከተመለሰ በኋላም የሰዶም ንጉሥ የንጉሥ ሸለቆ በሆነ በሴዊ ሸለቆ ሊቀበለው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he the priest of the most high God.
verses.text_amharic: የሳሌም ንጉሥ መልከ ጼዴቅም እንጀራንና የወይን ጠጅን አወጣ፤ እርሱም የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ካህን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.text_amharic: ባረከውም። አብራም ሰማይንና ምድርን ለሚገዛ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔር የተባረከ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
