verses.text_english: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም። በመጀመሪያ ብኵርናህን ሽጥልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Esau said, Behold, I at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም። እነሆ፥ እኔ ልሞት ነኝ፤ ይህች ብኵርና ለምኔ ናት? አለ ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም። እስኪ በመጀመሪያ ማልልኝ አለው። ማለለትም፤ ብኵርናውንም ለያዕቆብ ሸጠ።

verses.text_english: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised birthright.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ለዔሳው እንጀራና የምስር ወጥ ሰጠው፤ በላ፥ ጠጣ፥ ተነሥቶም ሄደ፤ እንዲሁም ዔሳው ብኵርናውን አቃለላት።

verses.text_english: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ቀድሞ በአብርሃም ዘመን ከሆነው ራብ በላይ ራብ ሆነ፤ ይስሐቅም ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ንጉሥ ወደ አቢሜሌክ ወደ ጌራራ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ተገለጠለት፥ እንዲህም አለው። ወደ ግብፅ አትውረድ፥ እኔ በምልህ ምድር ተቀመጥ እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
verses.text_amharic: በዚህች ምድር ተቀመጥ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም እሆናለሁ፥ እባርክሃለሁም፤ እነዚህን ምድሮች ሁሉ ለአንተም ለዘርህም እሰጣለሁና፥ ለአባትህ ለአብርሃም የማልሁለትንም መሐላ አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህንም እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አበዛለሁ፥ እነዚህንም ምድሮች ሁሉ ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ፤ የምድርም አህዛብ ሁሉ በዘርህ ይባረካሉ፤

verses.text_english: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም ቃሌን ሰምቶአልና፥ ፍርዴን ትእዛዜን ሥርዓቴን ሕጌንም ጠብቆአልና።

verses.text_english: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም በጌራራ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And the men of the place asked of his wife; and he said, She my sister: for he feared to say, my wife; lest, , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she fair to look upon.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያም ስፍራ ሰዎች ስለ ሚስቱ ጠየቁት፤ እርሱም። እኅቴ ናት አለ፤ የዚህ ስፍራ ስዎች ለርብቃ ሲሉ እንዳይገድሉኝ ብሎ ሚስቴ ናት ማለትን ፈርቶአልና፤ እርስዋ ውብ ነበረችና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ብዙ ቀን ከተቀመጠ በኋላ የፍልስጥኤም ንጉሥ አቢሜሌክ በመስኮት ሆኖ ጎበኘ፥ ይስሐቅም ሚስቱን ርብቃን ሲዳራት አየ።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she thy wife: and how saidst thou, She my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
verses.text_amharic: አቢሜሌክም ይስሐቅን ጠራ፥ እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ ሚስትህ ናት፤ እንዴትስ እርስዋን። እኅቴ ናት አልህ? ይስሐቅም። በእርስዋ ምክንያት እንዳልሞት ብዬ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech said, What this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
verses.text_amharic: አቢሜሌክም አለ። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ከሕዝብ አንዱ ከሚስትህ ጋር ሊተኛ ጥቂት በቀረው ነበር፥ ኃጢአትንም ልታመጣብን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech charged all people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: አቢሜሌክም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ይህን ሰው ሚስቱንም የሚነካ ሞትን ይሙት ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም በዚያች ምድር ዘርን ዘራ፥ በዚያች ዓመትም መቶ እጥፍ አገኘ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ባረከው።

verses.text_english: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
verses.text_amharic: ባለ ጠጋ ሰውም ሆነ፥ እጅግ እስኪበልጥ ድረስም እየጨመረ ይበዛ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
verses.text_amharic: የበግና የላም ከብትም ሎሌዎችም እጅግ በዙለት፤ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ቀኑበት።

verses.text_english: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
verses.text_amharic: በአባቱ በአብርሃም ዘመን የአባቱ ሎሌዎች የማሱአቸውን ጕድጓዶች ሁሉ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ደፈኑአቸው አፈርንም ሞሉባቸው።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
verses.text_amharic: አቢሜሌክም ይስሐቅን። ከእኛ ተለይተህ ሂድ፥ ከእኛ ይልቅ እጅግ በርትተሃልና አለው።

verses.text_english: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ከዚያ ሄደ፥ በጌራራም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም በአባቱ በአብርሃም ዘመን ቈፍረዋቸው የነበሩትን የውኃ ጕድጓዶች ደግሞ አስቈፈረ፤ አብርሃም ከሞተ በኋላ የፍልስጥኤም ሰዎች ደፍነዋቸው ነበሩና፤ አባቱም ይጠራቸው በነበረው ስም ጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
verses.text_amharic: የይስሐቅ ሎሌዎችም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ቈፈሩ፥ በዚያም የሚመነጭ የውኃ ጕድጓድ አገኙ።

verses.text_english: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
verses.text_amharic: የጌራራ አገር እረኞች ከይስሐቅ እረኞች ጋር። ውኃው የእኛ ነው ሲሉ ተከራከሩ፤ የዚያችንም ጕድጓድ ስም ኤሴቅ ብሎ ጠራት፥ ለእርስዋ ሲሉ ተጣልተዋልና።

verses.text_english: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ ጕድጓድም ማሱ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ደግሞ ተጣሉ፤ ስምዋንም ስጥና ብሎ ጠራት ።

verses.text_english: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም እልፍ ብሎ ሌላ ጕድጓድ አስቈፈረ፥ ስለ እርስዋም አልተጣሉም፤ ስምዋንም ርኆቦት ብሎ ጠራት እንዲህ ሲል። አሁን እግዚአብሔር አሰፋልን፥ በምድርም እንበዛለን።

verses.text_english: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም መሠዊያን ሠራ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራ፥ በዚያም ድንኳን ተከለ፤ የይስሐቅም ሎሌዎች በዚያ ጕድጓድ ማሱ።

verses.text_english: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
verses.text_amharic: አቢሜሌክና የሙሽራው ወዳጅ አኮዘት የሠራዊቱም አለቃ ፊኮል ከጌራራ ወደ እርሱ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም። ለምን ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? እናንተ ጠልታችሁኛል፥ ከእናንተም ለይታችሁ አሳድዳችሁኛል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.text_english: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou now the blessed of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ማልደውም ተነሡ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ተማማሉ፤ ይስሐቅም አሰናበታቸው፥ ከእርሱም ወጥተው በደኅና ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የይስሐቅ ሎሌዎች መጡ፥ ስለቈፈሩአትም ጕድጓድ። ውኃ አገኘን ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዋንም ሳቤህ ብሎ ጠራት፤ ስለዚህም የከተማይቱ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቤርሳቤህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም አርባ ዓመት ሲሆነው የኬጢያዊ የብኤሪን ልጅ ዮዲትን፥ የኬጢያዊ የኤሎንን ልጅ ቤሴሞትንም ሚስቶች አድርጎ አገባ፤

verses.text_english: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city Beersheba unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም የይስሐቅንና የርብቃን ልብ ያሳዝኑ ነበር። a

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, I.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅ ሸምግሎ ዓይኖቹ ከማየት በፈዘዙ ጊዜ ታላቁን ልጁን ዔሳውን ጠርቶ። ልጄ ሆይ አለው፤ እርሱም። እነሆ አለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለው። እነሆ እኔ አረጀሁ፥ የምሞትበትን ቀን አላውቅም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ማደኛህን የፍላጻህን አፎትና ቀስትህን ውሰድ፥ ወደ ምድረ በዳም ውጣ፥ አደንም አድንልኝ፤

verses.text_english: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
verses.text_amharic: ሳልሞትም ነፍሴ እንድትባርክህ የጣፈጠ መብል እኔ እንደምወደው አዘጋጅተህ እበላ ዘንድ አምጣልኝ።

verses.text_english: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt venison, to bring .
verses.text_amharic: ርብቃም ይስሐቅ ለልጁ ለዔሳው ሲነግር ትሰማ ነበር። ዔሳውም አደን አድኖ ሊያመጣ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ርብቃም ልጅዋን ያዕቆብን እንዲህ አለችው። እነሆ፥ አባትህ ለወንድምህ ለዔሳው።

verses.text_english: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
verses.text_amharic: አደን አድነህ አምጣልኝ፥ ሳልሞትም በልቼ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንድባርክህ የጣፈጠ መብል አድርግልኝ ብሎ ሲነግረው ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ በማዝዝህ ነገር ስማኝ፤

verses.text_english: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መንጋ ሄደህ ሁለት መልካካም ጠቦቶች አምጣልኝ፤ እነርሱንም ጣፋጭ መብል ለአባትህ እንደሚወደው አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባትህም፥ ሳይሞት እንዲባርክህ፥ ይበላ ዘንድ ታገባለታለህ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother a hairy man, and I a smooth man:
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ርብቃን እናቱን አላት። እነሆ ዔሳው ወንድሜ ጠጕራም ሰው ነው፥ እኔ ግን ለስላሳ ነኝ፤

verses.text_english: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባት አባቴ ቢዳስሰኝ በፊቱ እንደሚዘብት እሆናለሁ፤ መርገምንም በላዬ አመጣለሁ፥ በረከትን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: And his mother said unto him, Upon me thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me .
verses.text_amharic: እናቱም አለችው። ልጄ ሆይ፥ መርገምህ በእኔ ላይ ይሁን፤ ቃሌን ብቻ ስማኝ፤ ሂድና አምጣልኝ።

verses.text_english: And he went, and fetched, and brought to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዶም አመጣ፥ ለእናቱም ሰጣት፤ እናቱም የጣፈጠውን መብል አባቱ እንደሚወደው አደረገች።

verses.text_english: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
verses.text_amharic: ርብቃም ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቤት የነበረችውን የታላቁን ልጅዋን የዔሳውን መልካሙን ልብስ አመጣች፥ ታናሹን ልጅዋን ያዕቆብንም አለበሰችው፤

verses.text_english: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verses.text_amharic: የጠቦቶችንም ለምድ በእጆቹና በለስላሳው አንገቱ ላይ አደረገች፤

verses.text_english: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራችውን ጣፋጭ መብልና እንጀራውን ለልጅዋ ለያዕቆብ በእጁ ሰጠችው።

verses.text_english: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here I; who thou, my son?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባቱም ገብቶ። አባቴ ሆይ አለው እርሱም። እነሆኝ፤ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ማን ነህ? አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said unto his father, I Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም አባቱን አለው። የበኵር ልጅህ እኔ ዔሳው ነኝ፤ እንዳዘዝኽኝ አደረግሁ፤ ነፍስህ ትባርከኝ ዘንድ ቀና በልና ተቀመጥ፥ ካደንሁትም ብላ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac said unto his son, How that thou hast found so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought to me.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ልጁን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እንዴት ፈጥነህ አገኘኸው? አለው። እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ወደ እኔ ስለ አቀረበው ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou my very son Esau or not.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ልጄ ዔሳው እንደ ሆንህ ወይም እንዳልሆንህ እዳስስህ ዘንድ ቅረበኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice Jacob's voice, but the hands the hands of Esau.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ወደ አባቱ ወደ ይስሐቅ ቀረበ፤ ዳሰሰውም፥ እንዲህም። ይህ ድምፅ የያዕቆብም ድምፅ ነው፥ እጆች ግን የዔሳው እጆች ናቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አላወቀውም ነበር፤ እጆቹ እንደ ወንድሙ እንደ ዔሳው እጆች ጠጕራም ነበሩና፤ ስለዚህም ባረከው።

verses.text_english: And he said, thou my very son Esau? And he said, I .
verses.text_amharic: አለውም። አንተ ልጄ ዔሳው ነህን? እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Bring near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከልጄ አደን እንድበላና ነፍሴ እንድትባርክህ አቅርብልኝ አለ። አቀረበለትም፥ በላም፤ የወይን ጠጅ አመጣለት፥ እርሱም ጠጣ።

verses.text_english: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ ይስሐቅም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ወደ እኔ ቅረብ ሳመኝም አለው።

verses.text_english: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም ቀረበ፥ ሳመውም፤ የልብሱንም ሽታ አሸተተ፥ ባረከውም፥ እንዲህም አለ። የልጄ ሽታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ባረከው እርሻ ሽታ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከሰማይ ጠል ከምድርም ስብ የእህልንም የወይንንም ብዛት ይስጥህ፤

verses.text_english: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed every one that curseth thee, and blessed he that blesseth thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ይገዙልህ ሕዝብም ይስገዱልህ፤ ለወንድሞችህ ጌታ ሁን፥ የእናትህም ልጆች ይስገዱልህ፤ የሚረግምህ እርሱ ርጉም ይሁን የሚባርክህም ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ባርኮ ከፈጸመ በኋላ፥ ያዕቆብም ከአባቱ ከይስሐቅ ፊት ከወጣ በኋላ፥ ወዲያው በዚያው ጊዜ ዔሳው ከአደኑ መጥቶ ገባ።

verses.text_english: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ደግሞ ጣፋጭ መብል አዘጋጀ፥ ለአባቱም አገባ፤ አባቱንም። አባቴ ይነሣ፥ ነፍስህም ትባርከኝ ዘንድ ከልጁ አደን ይብላ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who thou? And he said, I thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ ይስሐቅም። አንተ ማን ነህ? አለው፤ እርሱም። እኔ የበኵር ልጅህ ዔሳው ነኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where he that hath taken venison, and brought me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, he shall be blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም እጅግ ደነገጠ እንዲህም አለ። ያደነውን አደን ወደ እኔ ያመጣ ማን ነው? አንተ ሳትመጣም ከሁሉ በላሁ ባረክሁትም፤ እርሱም የተባረከ ሆኖ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, me also, O my father.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም የአባቱን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ታላቅ እጅግም መራራ ጩኸት ጮኸ፥ አባቱንም። አባቴ ሆይ፥ እኔንም ደግሞ ባርከኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ወንድምህ በተንኮል ገብቶ በረከትህን ወሰደብህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። በእውነት ስሙ ያዕቆብ ተባለ፥ ሁለት ጊዜ አሰናክሎኛልና፤ ብኵርናዬን ወሰደ፥ አሁንም እነሆ በረከቴን ወሰደ። ደግሞም። ለእኔ በረከትን አላስቀረህልኝምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም መለሰ ዔሳውንም አለው። እነሆ፥ ጌታህ አደረግሁት፥ ወንድሞቹንም ሁሉ ለእርሱ ተገዦች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰጠሁት፥ በእህልም በወይንም አበረታሁት፤ ለአንተ ግን፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግ?

verses.text_english: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም አባቱን አለው። አባቴ ሆይ፥ በረከትህ አንዲት ብቻ ናትን? አባቴ ሆይ፥ እኔንም ደግሞ ባርከኝ። ዔሳውም ቃሉን አንሥቶ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ ይስሐቅም መለሰ አለውም። እነሆ፥ መኖሪያህ ከምድር ስብ ከላይ ከሚገኝ ከሰማይም ጠል ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
verses.text_amharic: በሰይፍህም ትኖራለህ፥ ለወንድምህም ትገዛለህ፤ ነገር ግን በተቃወምኸው ጊዜ ቀንበሩን ከአንገትህ ትጥላለህ።

verses.text_english: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም አባቱ ስለ ባረከው በያዕቆብ ቂም ያዘበት፤ ዔሳውም በልቡ አለ። ለአባቴ የልቅሶ ቀን ቀርቦአል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወንድሜን ያዕቆብን እገድለዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, to kill thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለርብቃም ይህ የታላቁ ልጅዋ የዔሳው ቃል ደረሰላት፤ ታናሹን ልጅዋን ያዕቆብንም አስጠርታ አስመጣችው፥ አለችውም። እነሆ፥ ወንድምህ ዔሳው ሊገድልህ ይፈቅዳል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ልጄ ሆይ ቃሌን ስማ፤ ተነሣና ወደ ካራን ምድር ወደ ወንድሜ ወደ ላባ ሂድ፤

verses.text_english: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ዘንድ ጥቂት ቀን ተቀመጥ፥ የወንድምህ ቍጣ እስኪበርድ ድረስ፤

verses.text_english: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
verses.text_amharic: የወንድምህ ቍጣ ከአንተ እስኪመለስ ድረስ፥ ያደረግህበትንም እስኪረሳው ድረስ፤ ከዚያም ልኬ አስመጣሃለሁ፤ በአንድ ቀን ሁለታችሁን ለምን አጣለሁ?

verses.text_english: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
verses.text_amharic: ርብቃም ይስሐቅን አለችው። ከኬጢ ሴቶች ልጆች የተነሣ ሕይወቴን ጠላሁት፤ ያዕቆብ ከዚህ አገር ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን የሚያገባ ከሆነ በሕይወት መኖር ለምኔ ነው?

verses.text_english: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ጠራው፥ ባረከውም፥ እንዲህ ብሎም አዘዘው። ከከነዓናውያን ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን አታግባ፤

verses.text_english: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሣና ወደ እናትህ አባት ወደ ባቱኤል ቤት ወደ ሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል ሂድ፤ ከዚያም ከእናትህ ወንድም ከላባ ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን አግባ።

verses.text_english: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክም ለብዙ ሕዝብ ጉባኤ እንድትሆን ይባርክህ፥ ያፍራህ፥ ያብዛህ፤

verses.text_english: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: ስደተኛ ሆነህ የተቀመጥህባትን እግዚአብሔርም ለአብርሃም የሰጣትን ምድር ትወርስ ዘንድ የአብርሃምን በርከት ለአንተ ይስጥህ፥ ለዘርህም እንዲሁ እንደ አንተ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ሰደደው፥ እርሱም የያዕቆብና የዔሳው እናት የርብቃ ወንድም የሚሆን የሶርያዊ ባቱኤል ልጅ ላባ ወዳለበት ወደ ሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል ሄደ።

verses.text_english: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም ይስሐቅ ያዕቆብን እንደ ባረከው ባየ ጊዜ፥ ከዚያም ሚስትን ያገባ ዘንድ ወደ ሁለት ወንዞች መካካል እንደ ሰደደው፥ በባረከውም ጊዜ። ከከነዓን ሴቶች ልጆች ሚስትን አታግባ ብሎ እንዳዘዘው፥

verses.text_english: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም የአባቱንና የእናቱን ቃል ሰምቶ ወደ ሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል እንደሄደ፥

verses.text_english: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
verses.text_amharic: የከነዓናውያንም ሴቶች ልጆች በአባቱ በይስሐቅ ፊት የተጠሉ እንደሆኑ ዔሳው ባየ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳው ወደ እስማኤል ሄደ፥ ማዕሌትንም በፊት ካሉት ሚስቶቹ ጋር ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ አገባ፤ እርስዋም የአብርሃም ልጅ የሆነ የእስማኤል ልጅና የነባዮት እኅት ናት።

verses.text_english: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ከቤርሳቤህ ወጥቶ ወደ ካራን ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንድ ስፍራም ደረሰ፥ ፀሐይም ጠልቃ ነበርና ከዚያ አደረ፤ በዚያም ስፍራ ድንጋይ አነሣ፥ ከራሱም በታች ተንተርሶ በዚያ ስፍራ ተኛ።

verses.text_english: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verses.text_amharic: ሕልምም አለመ፤ እነሆም መሰላል በምድር ላይ ተተክሎ፥ ራሱም ወደ ሰማይ ደርሶ፥ እነሆም የእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ይወጡበት ይወርዱበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር በላይ ቆሞበት ነበር፥ እንዲህም አለ። የአባትህ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ይህችን አንተ የተኛህባትን ምድር ለአንተም ለዘርህም እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህም እንደ ምድር አሸዋ ይሆናል፤ እስከ ምዕራብና እስከ ምሥራቅ እስከ ሰሜንና እስከ ደቡብ ትስፋፋለህ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በአንተ በዘርህም ይባረካሉ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I with thee, and will keep thee in all whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done which I have spoken to thee of.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፥ በምትሄድባትም መንገድ ሁሉ እጠብቅሃለሁ፥ ወደዚችም ምድር እመልስሃለሁ፤ የነገርሁህን ሁሉ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ አልተውህምና።

verses.text_english: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew not.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ከእንቅልፉ ተነሥቶ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ስፍራ ነው፤ እኔ አላወቅሁም ነበር አለ።

verses.text_english: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful this place! this none other but the house of God, and this the gate of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ፈራ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ይህ ስፍራ እንዴት ያስፈራ፤ ይህ ስፍራ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ነው እንጂ ሌላ አይደለም፤ ይህም የሰማይ ደጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put his pillows, and set it up a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ ተንተርሶት የነበረውንም ድንጋይ ወስዶ ሐውልት አድርጎ አቆመው፥ በላዩም ዘይትን አፈሰሰበት።

verses.text_english: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city Luz at the first.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ያንን ስፍራ ቤቴል ብሎ ጠራው፤ አስቀድሞ ግን የዚያች ከተማ ስም ሎዛ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም እንዲህ ብሎ ስእለት ተሳለ። እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ጋር ቢሆን፥ በምሄድባትም በዚች መንገድ ቢጠብቀኝ፥ የምበላውንም እንጀራ የምለብሰውንም ልብስ ቢሰጠኝ፥

verses.text_english: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባቴ ቤትም በጤና ብመለስ፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ይሆንልኛል፤

verses.text_english: And this stone, which I have set a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለሐውልት የተከልሁት ይህም ድንጋይ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሆናል፤ ከሰጠኸኝም ሁሉ ለአንተ ከአሥር እጅ አንዱን እሰጥሃለሁ። a

verses.text_english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ተነሥቶ ወደ ምሥራቅ ሰዎች አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone upon the well's mouth.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳውም እነሆ ጕድጓድን አየ፥ በዚያም ሦስት የበጎች መንጎች በላዩ ተመስገው ነበር፤ ከዚያ ጕድጓድ በጎቹን ያጠጡ ነበርና፤ በጕድጓዱም አፍ የነበረው ድንጋይ ትልቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
verses.text_amharic: መንጎችም ሁሉ ከዚያ በተከማቹ ጊዜ ድንጋዩን ከጕድጓዱ አፍ ገለል አድርገው በጎቹን ያጠጡ ነበር፤ ድንጋዩንም ወደ ስፍራው መልሰው በጕድጓዱ አፍ እንደ ገና ይገጥሙት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence ye? And they said, Of Haran we.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እናንት የወዴት ናችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እኛ የካራን ነን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know .
verses.text_amharic: የናኮርን ልጅ ላባን ታውቁታላችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እናውቀዋለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, he well? And they said, well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ። ደኅና ነውን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አዎን ደኅና ነው፤ አሁንም ልጁ ራሔል ከበጎች ጋር መጣች አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Lo, yet high day, neither time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go feed .
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ቀኑ ገና ቀትር ነው፥ ከብቶቹ የሚከማቹበት ሰዓቱም ገና አልደረሰም፤ አሁንም በጎቹን አጠጡና ሄዳችሁ አሰማሩአቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሉ። መንጎች ሁሉ እስኪከማቹና ድንጋዩን ከጕድጓዱ አፍ እስኪገለብጡት ድረስ አንችልም፤ ከዚያም በኋላ በጎቹን እናጠጣለን።

verses.text_english: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ከእነርሱ ጋር ሲነጋገር እነሆ የላባ ልጅ ራሔል ከአባትዋ በጎች ጋር ደረሰች፤ እርስዋ የአባትዋን በጎች ትጠብቅ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም የእናቱን ወንድም የላባን ልጅ ራሔልንና የእጎቱን የላባን በጎች ባየ ጊዜ፥ ቀረበ ከጕድጓዱም አፍ ድንጋዩን ገለበጠ፥ የአጎቱን የላባን በጎችንም አጠጣ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ራሔልን ሳማት፥ ቃሉንም ከፍ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob told Rachel that he her father's brother, and that he Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም የአባትዋ ዘመድና የርብቃ ልጅ መሆኑን ለራሔል አስታወቃት፤ እርስዋም ሮጣ ሄዳ ለአባትዋ ይህን ነገር ነገረችው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም የእኅቱን ልጅ የያዕቆብን ወሬ በሰማ ጊዜ ሊቀበለው ሮጠ፥ አቅፎም ሳመው፥ ወደ ቤቱም አገባው። ነገሩንም ሁሉ ለላባ ነገረው ።

verses.text_english: And Laban said to him, Surely thou my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም። በእውነት አንተ አጥንቴ ሥጋዬም ነህ አለው። አንድ ወር የሚያህልም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what thy wages ?
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ያዕቆብን። ወንድሜ ስለሆንህ በከንቱ ታገለግለኛለህን? ምንዳህ ምንድር ነው? ንገረኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder Leah, and the name of the younger Rachel.
verses.text_amharic: ለላባም ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ የታላቂቱ ስም ልያ የታናሺቱ ስም ራሔል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Leah tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም ዓይነ ልም ነበረች፤ ራሔል ግን መልከ መልካም ነበረች ፊትዋም ውብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ራሔልን ወደደ፤ እንዲህም አለ። ስለ ታናሺቱ ልጅህ ስለ ራሔል ሰባት ዓመት እገዛልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Laban said, better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም። ለሌላ ሰው ከምሰጣት ይልቅ ለአንተ ብሰጣት ይሻላል፤ ከእኔ ጋር ተቀመጥ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him a few days, for the love he had to her.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ስለ ራሔል ሰባት ዓመት ተገዛ፤ እርስዋንም ይወድዳት ስለነበረ በእርሱ ዘንድ እንደ ጥቂት ቀን ሆነለት።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ላባን። ወደ እርስዋ እገባ ዘንድ ሚስቴን ስጠኝ፥ ቀኔ ተፈጽሞአልና አለው።

verses.text_english: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም የዚያን ስፍራ ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ሰርግም አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ልጁን ልያን ወስዶ ለያዕቆብ አገባለት፤ ያዕቆብም ወደ እርስዋ ገባ።

verses.text_english: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid an handmaid.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ለልጁ ለልያ ባሪያይቱን ዘለፋን ባርያ ትሆናት ዘንድ ሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it Leah: and he said to Laban, What this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ እነሆ ልያ ሆና ተገኘች፤ ላባንም። ምነው እንደዚህ አደረግህብኝ? ያገለገልሁህ ስለ ራሔል አልነበረምን? ለምን አታለልኸኝ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም እንዲህ አለ። በአገራችን ታላቂቱ ሳለች፥ ታናሺቱን እንሰጥ ዘንድ ወግ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችንም ሳምንት ፈጽም፤ ሌላ ሰባት ዓመት ደግሞ እኔን ስለምታገለግለኝ አገልግሎት እርስዋን ደግሞ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም እንዲህ አደረገ፥ ይህችንም ሳምንት ፈጸመ፤ ልጁን ራሔልንም ለእርሱ ሚስት ትሆን ዘንድ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ለልጁ ለራሔል ባርያይቱን ባላን ባርያ ትሆናት ዘንድ ሰጣት ።

verses.text_english: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ወደ ራሔል ደግሞ ገባ። ራሔልንም ከልያ ይልቅ ወደዳት፤ ሌላ ሰባት ዓመትም ተገዛለት።

verses.text_english: And when the LORD saw that Leah hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel barren.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ልያ የተጠላች መሆንዋን ባየ ጊዜ ማኅፀንዋን ከፈተላት፤ ራሔል ግን መካን ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ሮቤል ብላ ጠራችው፤ እግዚአብሔር መከራዬን አይቶአልና፥ እንግዲህም ወዲህ ባሌ ይወድደኛል ብላለችና።

verses.text_english: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I hated, he hath therefore given me this also: and she called his name Simeon.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ እኔ እንደ ተጠላሁ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰማ ይህን ደገመኝ አለች፤ ስሙንም ስምዖን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ አሁንም ባሌ ወደ እኔ ይጠጋል፥ ሦስት ወንዶች ልጆችን ወልጄለታለሁና አለች፤ ስለዚህም ስሙን ሌዊ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ፀነስች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ በዚህም ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ አለች፤ ስለዚህም ስሙን ይሁዳ ብላ ጠራችው። መውለድንም አቆመች።

verses.text_english: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልም ለያዕቆብ ልጆችን እንዳልወለደች ባየች ጊዜ በእኅትዋ ቀናችባት፤ ያቆብንም። ልጅ ስጠኝ፤ ይህስ ካልሆነ እሞታለሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ራሔልን ተቆጥቶ። በውኑ እኔ የሆድን ፍሬ በነሣሽ በእግዚአብሔር ቦታ ነኝን? አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ባሪያዬ ባላ እነሆ አለች፤ ድረስባት፤ በእኔም ጭን ላይ ትውለድ፥ የእርስዋም ልጆች ለእኔ ደግሞ ይሁኑልኝ አለች።

verses.text_english: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዋን ባላንም ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ለእርሱ ሰጠችው፤ ያዕቆብም ደረሰባት።

verses.text_english: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.text_amharic: ባላም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልም። እግዚአብሔር ፈረደልኝ፥ ቃሌንም ደግሞ ሰማ፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ሰጠኝ አለች፤ ስለዚህ ስሙን ዳን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.text_amharic: የራሔልም ባሪያ ባላ ደግማ ፀነሰች፥ ለያዕቆብም ሁለተኛ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልም። ብርቱ ትግልን ከእኅቴ ጋር ታገልሁ፥ አሸነፍሁም አለች፤ ስሙንም ንፍታሌም ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም መውለድን እንዳቆመች ባየች ጊዜ ባሪያዋን ዘለፋን ወሰደች፥ ሚስት ትሆነውም ዘንድ ለያዕቆብ ሰጠችው።

verses.text_english: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
verses.text_amharic: የልያ ባሪያ ዘለፋም ወንድ ልጅን ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም። ጉድ አለች፤ ስሙንም ጋድ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.text_amharic: የልያ ባሪያ ዘለፋም ዳግመኛ ለያዕቆብ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም። ደስታ ሆነልኝ፤ ሴቶች ያመሰግኑኛልና አለች፤ ስሙንም አሴር ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤል ስንዴ በሚታጨድበት ወራት ወጣ፥ በእርሻም እንኮይ አገኘ፥ ለእናቱ ለልያም አመጣላት። ራሔልም ልያን። የልጅሽን እንኮይ ስጪኝ አለቻት።

verses.text_english: And she said unto her, a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ባሌን መውሰድሽ በውኑ ጥቂት ነገር ነውን? አሁን ደግሞ የልጄን እንኮይ ልትወስጂ ትፈልጊያለሽን? አለቻት። ራሔልም። እንኪያስ ስለ ልጅሽ እንኮይ በዚህች ሌሊት ከአንቺ ጋር ይተኛ አለች።

verses.text_english: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ሲመሽ ከዱር ገባ፥ ልያም ልትቀበለው ወጣች እንዲህም አለችው። ወደ እኔ ትገባለህ፤ በልጄ እንኮይ በእርግጥ ተከራይቼሃለሁና። በዚያችም ሌሊት ከእርስዋ ጋር ተኛ።

verses.text_english: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የልያን ጸሎት ሰማ፥ ፀነሰችም፥ አምስተኛ ወንድ ልጅንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም። ባሪያዬን ለባሌ ስለ ሰጠሁ እግዚአብሔር ዋጋዬን ሰጠኝ አለች፤ ስሙንም ይሳኮር ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም ደግማ ፀነሰች፥ ስድስተኛ ወንድ ልጅንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And Leah said, God hath endued me a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.text_amharic: ልያም። እግዚአብሔር መልካም ስጦታን ሰጠኝ፤ እንግዲህስ ባሌ ከእኔ ጋር ይኖራል፥ ስድስት ልጆችን ወልጄለታለሁና አለች፤ ስሙንም ዛብሎን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ሴት ልጅን ወለደች፥ ስምዋንም ዲና አለቻት።

verses.text_english: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ራሔልን አሰበ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ተለመናት፥ ማኅፀንዋንም ከፈተላት፤

verses.text_english: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.text_amharic: ፀነሰችም፥ ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደችና። እግዚአብሔር ስድቤን አስወገደ አለች፤

verses.text_english: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙንም። እግዚአብሔር ሁለተኛ ወንድ ልጅን ይጨምርልኝ ስትል ዮሴፍ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልም ዮሴፍን ከወለደች በኋላ ያዕቆብ ላባን እንዲህ አለው። ወደ ስፍራዬ ወደ አገሬም እመለስ ዘንድ አሰናብተኝ።

verses.text_english: Give my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እነርሱ የተገዛሁላቸውን ሚስቶቼንና ልጆቼን ስጠኝና ልሂድ፤ የተገዛሁልህን መገዛት ታውቃለህና።

verses.text_english: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም። በዓይንህ ፊት ሞገስን የማገኝ ብሆንስ ከዚሁ ተቀመጥ፤ እግዚአብሔር በአንተ ምክንያት እንደ ባረከኝ ተመልክቼአለሁና አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give .
verses.text_amharic: ደመወዝህን ንገረኝ፥ እርሱንም እሰጥሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለው። እንዴት እንዳገለገልሁህ፥ ከብትህንም እንዴት እንደ ጠበቅሁልህ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: For little which thou hadst before I , and it is increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ መምጣት በፊት የነበረህ ጥቂት ነበርና፥ ዛሬም እጅግ በዛ፤ ወደ አንተ በመምጣቴም እግዚአብሔር ባረክህ፤ አሁንም እኔ ደግሞ ለቤቴ የምሠራው መቼ ነው?

verses.text_english: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed keep thy flock:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የምሰጥህ ምንድር ነው? አለ። ያዕቆብም አለው። ምንም አትስጠኝ፤ ይህንም ነገር ብታደርግልኝ እንደ ገና በጎችህን አበላለሁ እጠብቃለሁም።

verses.text_english: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and shall be my hire.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ በመንጎችህ በኩል አልፋለሁ፥ በዚያም ከበጎችህ መካከል ዝንጕርጕርና ነቍጣ ያለበቱን ጥቁሩንም በግ ሁሉ፥ ከፍየሎቹም ነቍጣና ዝንጕርጕር ያለበቱን እለያለሁ፤ እነርሱም ደመወዜ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በፊትህ ያለውን ደመወዜን ለመመልከት በመጣህ ጊዜ ወደ ፊት ጻድቅነቴ ይመሰክርልኛል፤ ከፍየሎች ዝንጕርጕርና ነቍጣ የሌለበት ከበግ ጠቦቶችም ጥቁር ያልሆኑ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ በእኔ ዘንድ ቢገኝ እንደ ተሰረቀ ይቆጠርብኝ።

verses.text_english: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም። እነሆ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave into the hand of his sons.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ከተባቶቹ ፍየሎች ሽመልመሌ መሳይና ነቍጣ ያለባቸውን፥ ከእንስቶቹም ፍየሎች ዝንጕርጕርና ነቍጣ ያለባቸውን፥ ነጭ ያለበትን ማንኛውንም ሁሉ፥ ከበጎቹም መካከል ጥቁሩን በግ ሁሉ ለይቶ ለልጆቹ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱና በያዕቆብ መካከልም የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል አራቃቸው፤ ያዕቆብም የቀሩትን የላባን በጎች ይጠብቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which in the rods.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ልብን ለውዝ ኤርሞን ከሚባሉ እንጨቶች እርጥብ በትርን ወስዶ በበትሮቹ ውስጥ ያለው ነጭ እንዲታይ ነጭ ሽመልመሌ አድርጎ ላጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.text_amharic: የላጣቸውንም በትሮች በጎቹ ውኃ ሊጠጡ በመጡ ጊዜ በውኃ ማጠጫው ገንዳ ውስጥ በበጎቹ ፊት አኖራቸው፤ በጎቹ ውኃ ሊጠጡ በመጡ ጊዜ ይጎመጁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.text_amharic: በጎቹም በትሮቹን አይተው ከመጎምጀታቸው የተነሣ ፀነሱ፤ በጎቹም ሽመልመሌ መሳይና ዝንጕርጕር ነቍጣም ያለበቱን ወለዱ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ጠቦቶቹን ለየ፥ ሽመልመሌ መሳይና ጥቁር ያለባቸውን በጎቹንም ሁሉ በላባ በጎች ፊት ለፊት አኖረ፤ መንጎቹንም ለብቻቸው አቆማቸው፥ ወደ ላባም በጎች አልጨመራቸውም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የበረቱት በጎች በጎመጁ ጊዜ፥ በጎቹ በትሮቹን አይተው በበትሮቹ አምሳል ይፀንሱ ዘንድ ያዕቆብ በትሮቹን በውኃ ማጠጫው ገንዳ ውስጥ ከበጎቹ ፊት አደረገ፤

verses.text_english: But when the cattle were feeble, he put not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
verses.text_amharic: በደከሙ በጎችም ፊት በትሩን አያደርገውም ነበር፤ የደከሙትም ለላባ፥ የበረቱትም ለያዕቆብ ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ሰውም እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ሆነ፤ ብዙም ከብት ሴቶችም ወንዶችም ባሪያዎች ግመሎችም አህዮችም ሆኑለት።

verses.text_english: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that our father's; and of which our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም የላባ ልጆች ያሉትን ነገር። ያዕቆብ ለአባታችን የሆነውን ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ይህንም ሁሉ ክብር ከአባታችን ከብት አገኘ ሲሉ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it not toward him as before.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም የላባን ፊት አየ፥ እነሆም ከእርሱ ጋር እንደ ዱሮው አልሆነም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያዕቆብን። ወደ አባትህ ምድር ወደ ዘመዶችህም ተመለስ፤ ከአንተም ጋር እሆናለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ልኮ ራሔልንና ልያን ወደ በጎቹ ስፍራ ወደ ሜዳ ጠራቸው፥

verses.text_english: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። የአባታችሁ ፊት ከእኔ ጋር እንደ ዱሮ እንዳልሆነ አያለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የአባቴ አምላክ ከእኔ ጋር ነው።

verses.text_english: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባለኝ ጕልበቴ ሁሉ አባታችሁን እንዳገለገልሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችሁ ግን አታለለኝ፥ ደመወዜንም አሥር ጊዜ ለወጠ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ክፉ ያደርግብኝ ዘንድ አልፈቀደለትም።

verses.text_english: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.text_amharic: ደመወዝህ ዝንጕርጕሮች ይሁኑ ቢለኝ በጎቹ ሁሉ ዝንጕርጕሮችን ወለዱ፤ ሽመልመሌ መሳዮቹ ደመወዝህ ይሁኑ ቢለኝ በጎቹ ሁሉ ሽመልመሌ መሳዮችን ወለዱ።

verses.text_english: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given to me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የአባታችሁን በጎች ሁሉ ነሥቶ ለእኔ ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በጎቹ በጎመጁ ጊዜ ዓይኔን አንሥቼ በሕልም አየሁ፤ እነሆም፥ በበጎችና በፍየሎች ላይ የሚንጠላጠሉት የበጎችና የፍየሎች አውራዎች ሽመልመሌ መሳዮችና ዝንጕርጕሮች ነቁጣ ያለባቸውም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, , Jacob: And I said, Here I.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በሕልም። ያዕቆብ ሆይ አለኝ፤ እኔም። እነሆኝ አልሁት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለኝ። ዓይንህን አቅንተህ እይ፤ በበጎችና በፍየሎች ላይ የሚንጠላጠሉት የበጎችና የፍየሎች አውራዎች ሽመልመሌ መሳዮችና ዝንጕርጕሮች ነቁጣ ያለባቸውም ናቸው፤ ላባ በአንተ ላይ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ አይቼአለሁና።

verses.text_english: I the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.text_amharic: ሐውልት የቀባህበት በዚያም ለእኔ ስእለት የተሳልህበት የቤቴል አምላክ እኔ ነኝ፤ አሁንም ተነሥተህ ከዚህ አገር ውጣ፥ ወደ ተወለድህበትም ምድር ተመለስ።

verses.text_english: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልና ልያም መልሰው እንዲህ አሉት። በአባታችን ቤት ለእኛ ድርሻና ርስት በውኑ ቀርቶልናልን?

verses.text_english: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ በእርሱ ዘንድ እንደ ባዕድ የተቈጠርን አይደለንምን? እርሱ እኛን ሸጦ ዋጋችንን በልቶአልና።

verses.text_english: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን የነሣው ይህ ሁሉ ሀብት ለእኛና ለልጆቻችን ነው፤ አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ያለህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ተነሣ፥ ልጆቹንና ሚስቶቹንም በግመሎች ላይ አስቀመጠ፤

verses.text_english: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: መንጎቹንም ሁሉ፥ የቤቱንም ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ በሁለት ወንዞች መካከል ሳለ ያገኛቸውን ከብቶች ሁሉ ይዞ ወደ አባቱ ወደ ይስሐቅ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that her father's.
verses.text_amharic: ላባ ግን በጎቹን ለመሸለት ሄዶ ነበር፤ ራሔልም የአባትዋን ተራፊም ሰረቀች።

verses.text_english: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም የሶርያውን ሰው ላባን ከድቶ ኮበለለ፥ መኮብለሉንም፥ አልነገረውም።

verses.text_english: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face the mount Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ይዞ ኮበለለ፤ ተነሥቶም ወንዙን ተሻገረ፥ ፊቱንም ወደ ገለዓድ ተራራ አቀና።

verses.text_english: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን የያዕቆብ መኮብለል ለላባ ተነገረው።

verses.text_english: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንድሞቹም ጋር ሆኖ የሰባት ቀን መንገድ ያህል ተከተለው፥ በገለዓድ ተራራም ላይ ደረሰበት።

verses.text_english: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ ሶርያው ሰው ወደ ላባ በሌሊት ሕልም መጥቶ። ያዕቆብን በክፉ ነገር እንዳትናገረው ተጠንቀቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ደረሰበት፤ ያዕቆብም ድንኳኑን በተራራው ተክሎ ነበር፤ ላባም ከወንድሞቹ ጋር በገለዓድ ተራራ ድንኳኑን ተከለ።

verses.text_english: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives with the sword?
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ያዕቆብን አለው። ለምን እንዲህ አደረግህ? ከእኔ ከድተህ ኮበለልህ፥ ልጆቼንም በሰይፍ እንደ ተማረኩ ዓይነት ነዳሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
verses.text_amharic: ስለምን በስውር ሸሸህ? ከእኔም ከድተህ ስለምን ኮበለልህ? በደስታና በዘፈን በከበሮና በበገና እንድሰድድህ ለምን አልነገርኸኝም?

verses.text_english: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in doing.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶቹንና ሴቶቹን ልጆቼን እንድስም ስለ ምን አልፈቀድህልኝም? ይህንም በስንፍና አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ አደርግባችሁ ዘንድ ኃይል ነበረኝ፤ ነገር ግን የአባታችሁ አምላክ ትናንት። ያዕቆብን በክፉ ነገር እንዳትናገረው ተጠንቀቅ ብሎ ነገረኝ።

verses.text_english: And now, thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የአባትህን ቤት ከናፈቅህ ሂድ፤ ነገር ግን አምላኮቼን ለምን ሰረቅህ?

verses.text_english: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም መለሰ ላባንም እንዲህ አለው። ልጆችህን ከእኔ የምትቀማኝ ስለመሰለኝና ስለፈራሁ ይህን አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what thine with me, and take to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኮችህን የምታገኝበት ሰው ግን እርሱ ይሙት፤ የአንተ የሆነውም በእኔ ዘንድ ይገኝ እንደ ሆነ በወንድሞቻችን ፊት ፈልግ፥ ለአንተም ውሰደው አለ። ራሔል እንደ ሰረቀቻቸው ያዕቆብ አያውቅም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ወደ ያዕቆብ ድንኳንና ወደ ልያ ድንኳን ወደ ሁለቱም ባሪያዎች ድንኳን ገባ፥ ነገር ግንአላገኘም። ከልያም ድንኳን ወጥቶ ወደ ራሔል ድንኳን ገባ።

verses.text_english: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found not.
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልም ተራፊምን ወስዳ ከግመል ኮርቻ በታች ሸሸገች፥ በላዩም ተቀመጠችበት። ላባም ድንኳኑን ሁሉ ፈለገ፥ አንዳችም አላገኘም።

verses.text_english: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም አባትዋን። በፊትህ ለመቆም ስላልቻልሁ አትቆጣብኝ፤ በሴቶች የሚደርስ ግዳጅ ደርሶብኛልና አለችው። እርሱም ፈለገ፥ ነገር ግን ተራፊምን አላገኘም።

verses.text_english: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What my trespass? what my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ተቆጣ ላባንም ወቀሰው፤ ያዕቆብም መለሰ ላባንም እንዲህ አለው። የበደልሁህ በደል ምንድር ነው ኃጢአቴስ ምንድር ነው ይህን ያህል ያሳደድኸኝ

verses.text_english: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ዕቃዬን ሁሉ በረበርህ፤ ከቤትህስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ምን አገኘህ እነርሱ በእኛ በሁለታችን መካከል ይፈርዱ ዘንድ በወንድሞቼና በወንድሞችህ ፊት አቅርበው።

verses.text_english: This twenty years I with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ ዓመት ሙሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ፤ በጎችህና ፍየሎችህ አልጨነገፉም፤ የመንጎችህንም ጠቦቶች አልበላሁም፤ አውሬ የሰበረውን አላመጣሁልህም ነበር፤

verses.text_english: That which was torn I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ስለ እርሱ እከፍልህ ነበርሁ፤ በቀንም በሌሊትም የተሰረቀውን ከእጄ ትሻው ነበርህ።

verses.text_english: I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: የቀን ሐሩር የሌሊት ቍር ይበላኝ ነበር፥ እንቅልፍም ከዓይኔ ጠፋ። 4

verses.text_english: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ በአንተ ቤት ሀያ ዓመት ነበርሁ አሥራ አራት ዓመት ስለ ሁለቱ ሴቶች ልጆችህ፥ ስድስት ዓመትም ስለ በጎችህ ተገዛሁልህ፤ ደመወዜንም አሥር ጊዜ ለዋወጥኸው።

verses.text_english: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked yesternight.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቴ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም ፍርሃት ከእኔ ጋር ባይሆንስ ዛሬ ባዶ እጄን በሰደድኸኝ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር መከራዬንና የእጆቼን ድካም አየ፥ ትናንትም ገሠጸህ።

verses.text_english: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, daughters my daughters, and children my children, and cattle my cattle, and all that thou seest mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.text_amharic: ላባም እንዲህ ብሎ ለያቆብ መለሰለት። ሴቶቹ ልጆች ልጆቼ ናቸው፥ ሕፃናቱም ሕፃናቴ ናቸው፥ መንጎቹም መንጎቼ ናቸው፥ የምታየውም ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፤ ዛሬም በእነዚህ በሴቶች ልጆቼና በወለዱአቸው ልጆቻቸው ላይ ምን ላደርግ ይቻላል

verses.text_english: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ና፥ አንተና እኔ ቃል ኪዳን እንጋባ፤ በእኔና በአንተ መካከልም ምስክር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up a pillar.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ድንጋይ ወስዶ ሐውልት አቆመ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ወንድሞቹን። ድንጋይ ሰብስቡ አላቸው፤ እነርሱም ድንጋይ ሰብስበው ከመሩ፤ በድንጋዩም ክምር ላይ በሉ።

verses.text_english: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ይጋር ሠሀዱታ ብሎ ጠራት፤ ያዕቆብም ገለዓድ አላት።

verses.text_english: And Laban said, This heap a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.text_amharic: ላባም። ይህች ክምር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ዛሬ ምስክር ናት አለ። ስለዚህም ስምዋ ገለዓድ ተባለ፤

verses.text_english: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ምጽጳ ተባለ። እኛ በተለያየን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ሆኖ ይጠብቅ ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take wives beside my daughters, no man with us; see, God witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቼን ብትበድላቸው ወይም በላያቸው ሚስቶችን ብታገባባቸው ከእኛ ጋር ያለ ሰው የለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ምስክር ነው።

verses.text_english: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ያዕቆብን አለው። በእኔና በአንተ መካከል እነሆ ይህች ክምር፥ እነሆም ያቆምኋት ሐውልት፤

verses.text_english: This heap witness, and pillar witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ወደ አንተ ይህችን ክምር እንዳላልፍ፥ አንተም ለክፋት ወደ እኔ ይህችን ክምርና ይህችን ሐውልት እንዳታልፋት፥ ይህች ክምር ምስክር ናት፥ ይህችም ሐውልት ምስክር ናት።

verses.text_english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.text_amharic: የአብርሃም አምላክ የናኮርም አምላክ የአባታቸውም አምላክ በእኛ መካከል ይፍረድ። ያዕቆብም በአባቱ በይስሐቅ ፍርሃት ማለ።

verses.text_english: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም በተራራው ላይ መሥዋዕትን ሠዋ፥ ወንድሞቹንም እንጀራ እንዲበሉ ጠራ፤ እነርሱም እንጀራን በሉ፥ በዚያም በተራራ አደሩ።

verses.text_english: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.text_amharic: ላባም ማልዶ ተነሥቶ ወንዶቹንና ሴቶቹን ልጆቹን ሳመ ባረካቸውም፤ ላባም ተመልሶ ወደ ስፍራው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም መንገዱን ሄደ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መላእክትም ተገናኙት።

verses.text_english: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ባያቸው ጊዜ። እነዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ሠራዊት ናቸው አለ፤ የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም መሃናይም ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ወደ ወንድሙ ወደ ዔሳው ወደ ሴይር ምድር ወደ ኤዶም አገር ከፊቱ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤

verses.text_english: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ለጌታዬ ለዔሳው። ባሪያህ ያዕቆብ እንዲህ አለ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። በላባ ዘንድ በስደት ተቀመጥሁ፤ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ቆየሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: ላሞችንም አህዮችንም በጎችን ወንዶች ባሪያዎችንም ሴቶች ባሪያዎችንም አገኘሁ፤ አሁንም በፊትህ ሞገስን አገኝ ዘንድ ለጌታዬ ለማስታወቅ ላክሁ።

verses.text_english: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.text_amharic: መልእክተኞቹም ወደ ያዕቆብ ተመልሰው እንዲህ አሉት። ወደ ወንድምህ ወደ ዔሳው ሄደን ነበር፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ሊቀበልህ ይመጣል፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አራት መቶ ሰዎች አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም እጅግ ፈርቶ ተጨነቀ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉትን ሰዎች መንጎችንም ላሞችንም ግመሎችንም በሁለት ወገን ከፈላቸው፤

verses.text_english: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። ዔሳው መጥቶ አንዱን ወገን የመታ እንደ ሆነ የቀረው ወገን ያመልጣል።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም አለ። የአባቴ የአብርሃም አምላክ ሆይ፥ የአባቴም የይስሐቅ አምላክ ሆይ። ወደ ምድርህ ወደ ተወለድህበትም ስፍራ ተመለስ፥ በጎነትንም አደርግልሃለሁ ያልኸኝ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፤

verses.text_english: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህ ከሠራኸው ከምሕረትህና ከእውነትህም ሁሉ ትንሽ ስንኳ የማይገባኝ ነኝ፤ በትሬን ብቻ ይዤ ይህን ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግሬ ነበርና፥ አሁን ግን የሁለት ክፍል ሠራዊት ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, the mother with the children.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንድሜ ከዔሳው እጅ አድነኝ፤ መጥቶ እንዳያጠፋኝ፥ እናቶችንም ከልጆች ጋር እንዳያጠፋ እኔ እፈራዋለሁና።

verses.text_english: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። በእርግጥ መልካም አደርግልሃለሁ፥ ዘርህንም ከብዛቱ የተነሣ እንደማይቈጠር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ አደርጋለሁ ብለህ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ሌሊት ከዚያው አደረ። ከያዘውም ሁሉ ለወንድሙ ለዔሳው እጅ መንሻን አወጣ፤

verses.text_english: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት መቶ እንስት ፍየሎችንና ሀያ የፍየል አውራዎችን፥ ሁለት መቶ እንስት በጎችንና ሀያ የበግ አውራዎችን፥

verses.text_english: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.text_amharic: ሠላሳ የሚያጠቡ ግመሎችን ከግልገሎቻቸው ጋር፥ አርባ ላም፥ አሥር በሬ፥ ሀያ እንስት አህያ፥ አሥርም የእህያ ግልገሎችን።

verses.text_english: And he delivered into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.text_amharic: መንጎቹን በየወገኑ ከፍሎ በባሪያዎቹ እጅ አደረጋቸው፤ ባሪያዎቹንም። በፊቴ እለፉ መንጋውንና መንጋውንም አራርቁት አለ።

verses.text_english: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose thou? and whither goest thou? and whose these before thee?
verses.text_amharic: የፊተኛውንም እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። ወንድሜ ዔሳው ያገኘህ እንደሆነ። አንተ የማን ነህ? ወዴትስ ትሄዳለህ? በፊትህ ያለው ይህስ የማን ነው? ብሎ የጠየቀህም እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: Then thou shalt say, thy servant Jacob's; it a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he behind us.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አንተ። ለጌታዬ ለዔሳው እጅ መንሻ የሰደደው የባሪያህ የያዕቆብ ነው፤ እርሱም ደግሞ እነሆ ከኋላችን ነው በለው።

verses.text_english: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ሁለተኛውንና ሦስተኛውን ከመንጎችም በኋላ የሚሄዱትን ሁሉ እንዲሁ ብሎ አዘዘ። ዔሳውን ባገኛችሁት ጊዜ ይህንኑ ነገር ንገሩት፤

verses.text_english: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በሉት። እነሆ ባሪያህ ያዕቆብ ከኋላችን ነው። በፊቴ በሚሄደው እጅ መንሻ እታረቀዋለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ምናልባት ይራራልኛል ፊቱንም አያለሁ ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.text_amharic: እጅ መንሻው ከእርሱ ቀድሞ አለፈ፤ እርሱ ግን በዚያች ሌሊት በሰፈር አደረ።

verses.text_english: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች ሌሊትም ተነሣ፥ ሁለቱን ሚስቶቹንና ሁለቱን ባሪያዎቹን አሥራ አንዱንም ልጆቹን ወስዶ የያቦቅን ወንዝ ተሻገረ።

verses.text_english: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
verses.text_amharic: ወሰዳቸውም ወንዙንም አሻገራቸው፥ ከብቱንም ሁሉ አሻገረ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ግን ለብቻው ቀረ፤ አንድ ሰውም እስከ ንጋት ድረስ ይታገለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳላሸነፈውም ባየ ጊዜ የጭኑን ሹልዳ ነካው፤ ያዕቆብም የጭኑ ሹልዳ ሲታገለው ደነዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለው። ሊነጋ አቀላልቶአልና ልቀቀኝ። እርሱም። ካልባረክኸኝ አልለቅቅህም አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, What thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለው። ስምህ ማን ነው? እርሱም። ያዕቆብ ነኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.text_amharic: አለውም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ስምህ እስራኤል ይባል እንጂ ያዕቆብ አይባል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከሰውም ጋር ታግለህ አሸንፈሃልና።

verses.text_english: And Jacob asked , and said, Tell , I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore it thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም። ስምህን ንገረኝ ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም። ስሜን ለምን ትጠይቃለህ? አለው። በዚያም ስፍራ ባረከው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም። እግዚአብሔርን ፊት ለፊት አየሁ፥ ሰውነቴም ድና ቀረች ሲል የዚያን ቦታ ስም Dኒኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.text_amharic: Dኒኤልንም ሲያልፍ ፀሐይ ወጣችበት፥ እርሱም በጭኑ ምክንያት ያነክስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Therefore the children of Israel eat not the sinew which shrank, which upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የእስራኤል ልጆች እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የወርችን ሹልዳ አይበሉም፤ የያዕቆብን ጭን ይዞ የወርችን ሹልዳ አደንዝዞአልና።  q ቍ@ 30፤ ጵኒኤል የሚለውን ቃል የግእዝ መጽሐፍ ራእየ እግዚአብሔር ይለዋል። a

verses.text_english: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ዓይኑን አነሣ፥ እነሆም ዔሳውን ሲመጣ አየው፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አራት መቶ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ልጆቹንም ከፍሎ ወደ ልያና ወደ ራሔል ወደ ሁለቱም ባሪያዎች አደረጋቸው፤

verses.text_english: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎችንና ልጆቻቸውንም በፊት አደረገ፥ ልያንና ልጆችዋንም በኋለኛው ስፍራ፥ ራሔልንና ዮሴፍንም ከሁሉ በኋላ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በፊታቸው አለፈ፤ ወደ ወንድሙም እስኪደርስ ድረስ ወደ ምድር ሰባት ጊዜ ሰገደ።

verses.text_english: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም ሊገናኘው ሮጠ፥ አንገቱንም አቅፎ ሳመው፤ ተላቀሱም።

verses.text_english: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑንም አነሣና ሴቶችንና ልጆችን አየ፥ እንዲህም አለ። እነዚህ ምኖችህ ናቸው? እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ለእኔ ለባሪያህ የሰጠኝ ልጆች ናቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም ከልጆቻቸው ጋር ቀርበው ሰገዱ፤

verses.text_english: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ልያና ልጆችዋ ቀርበው ሰገዱ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ዮሴፍና ራሔል ቀርበው ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: And he said, What thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ያገኘሁት ይህ ሠራዊት ሁሉ ምንህ ነው? አለ። እርሱም። በጌታዬ ፊት ሞገስን አገኝ ዘንድ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም። ለእኔ ብዙ አለኝ፤ ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ የአንተ ለአንተ ይሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም አለ። እንደዚህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ እጅ መንሻዬን ተቀበለኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፊት እንደሚያይ ፊትህን አይቼአለሁና፥ በቸርነትም ተቀብለኸኛልና።

verses.text_english: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took .
verses.text_amharic: ይህችንም ያመጣሁልህን በረከቴን ተቀበል፤ እግዚአብሔር በቸርነት ሰጥቶኛልና፥ ለእኔም ብዙ አለኝና። እስኪቀበለውም ድረስ ዘበዘበው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ተነሣና እንሂድ፥ እኔም በፊትህ እሄዳለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children tender, and the flocks and herds with young with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለው። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ልጆቹ ደካሞች እንደ ሆኑ ታውቃለህ፤ በጎችና ላሞችም ግልገሎቻቸውን ያጠባሉ፤ ሰዎችም አንድ ቀን በችኮላ የነዱአቸው እንደ ሆነ ከብቶቹ ሁሉ ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ ከባሪያው ፊት ቀድሞ ይለፍ፤ እኔም ወደ ሴይር ከጌታዬ ዘንድ እስክደርስ ድረስ ከፊቴ ባሉት በእንስሳቱ እርምጃና በሕፃናቱ እርምጃ መጠን በዝግታ እከተላለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee of the folk that with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም። ከእኔ ጋር ካሉት ሰዎች ከፍዬ ልተውልህን? አለ። እርሱም። ይህ ለምንድር ነው? በጌታዬ ዘንድ ሞገስን ማግኘት ይበቃኛል አለ።

verses.text_english: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም በዚያን ቀን ወደ ሴይር መንገዱን ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ግን ወደ ሱኮት ሄደ፤ በዚያም ለእርሱ ቤትን ሠራ፥ ለከብቶችም ዳሶችን አደረገ፤ ስለዚህም የዚያን ቦታ ስም ሱኮት ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ከሁለት ወንዞች መካከል በተመለሰ ጊዜ በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሴኬም ከተማ በደኅንነት መጣ፤ በከተማይቱም ፊት ሰፈረ።

verses.text_english: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
verses.text_amharic: ድንኳኑን ተክሎበት የነበረውንም የእርሻውን ክፍል ከሴኬም አባት ከኤሞር ልጆች በመቶ በጎች ገዛው።

verses.text_english: And he erected there an altar, and called it Elelohe-Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም መሠውያውን አቆመ፥ ያንም ኤል ኤሎሄ እስራኤል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.text_amharic: ለያዕቆብ የወለደችለት የልያ ልጅ ዲናም የዚያን አገር ሴቶች ልጆችን ለማየት ወጣች።

verses.text_english: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩ አለቃ የኤዊያዊ ሰው የኤሞር ልጅ ሴኬም አያት፤ ወሰዳትም ከእርስዋም ጋር ተኛ፥ አስነወራትም።

verses.text_english: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
verses.text_amharic: ልቡናውም በያዕቆብ ልጅ በዲና ፍቅር ተነደፈ፥ ብላቴናይቱንም ወደዳት፥ ልብዋንም ደስ በሚያሰኛት ነገር ተናገራት።

verses.text_english: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ሴኬምም አባቱን ኤሞርን። ይህችን ብላቴና አጋባኝ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ልጁን ዲናን እንዳስነወራት ሰማ፤ ልጆቹም ከከብቶቻቸው ጋር በምድረ በዳ ነበሩ፤ ያዕቆብም እስኪመጡ ድረስ ዝም አለ።

verses.text_english: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.text_amharic: የሴኬም አባት ኤሞርም ይነግረው ዘንድ ወደ ያዕቆብ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard : and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብም ልጆች ይህንን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ የያዕቆብን ልጅ በመተኛቱ በእስራኤል ላይ ስንፍናን ስላደረገ አዘኑ፥ እጅግም ተቈጡ፤ እንዲህ አይደረግምና።

verses.text_english: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሞርም እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራቸው። ልጄ ሴኬም በልጃችሁ ፍቅር ልቡ ተነድፎአልና ሚስት እንድትሆነው እባካችሁ እርስዋን ስጡት።

verses.text_english: And make ye marriages with us, give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ጋብቾችም ሁኑን፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን ስጡን፥ እናንተም የእኛን ሴቶች ልጆች ውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኛም ጋር ተቀመጡ፥ ምድሪቱም በፊታችሁ ናት፤ ኑሩባት፥ ነግዱም፥ ግዙአትም።

verses.text_english: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.text_amharic: ሴኬምም አባትዋንና ወንድሞችዋን እንዲህ አለ። በፊታችሁ ሞገስን ባገኝ የምትሉኝን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ማጫና እጅ መንሻ አምጣ በሉኝ፥ በነገራችሁኝም መጠን እሰጣለሁ፤ ይህችን ብላቴና ግን አጋቡኝ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብም ልጆች ለሴኬምና ለአባቱ ለኤሞር በተንኰል መለሱ፥ እኅታቸውን ዲናን አርክሶአታልና፤

verses.text_english: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that a reproach unto us:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አሉአቸው። እኅታችንን ላልተገረዘ ሰው ለመስጠት ይህንን ነገር እናደርግ ዘንድ አይቻለንም፤ ይህ ነውር ይሆንብናልና።

verses.text_english: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we , that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እኛ ሆናችሁ ወንዶቻችሁን ሁሉ ብትገርዙ በዚህ ብቻ እሺ እንላችኋለን፤

verses.text_english: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶች ልጆቻችንን እንሰጣችኋለን፥ የእናንተንም ሴቶች ልጆች እንወስዳለን፤ አንድ ሕዝብም ሆነን ከእናንተ ጋር እንኖራለን።

verses.text_english: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.text_amharic: ትገረዙ ዘንድ እኛን ባትሰሙ ግን ልጃችንን ይዘን እንሄዳለን።

verses.text_english: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
verses.text_amharic: ነገራቸውም በኤሞር ልጅ በሴኬምና በኤሞር ዘንድ የተወደደ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he more honourable than all the house of his father.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴናውም ያሉትን ያደርግ ዘንድ አልዘገየም፥ የያዕቆብን ልጅ ወድዶአልና፤ እርሱም በአባቱ ቤት ካሉት ሁሉ የከበረ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሞርና ሴኬም ልጁም ወደ ከተማቸው አደባባይ ገቡ፥ ለከተማቸውም ሰዎች እንዲህ ብለው ነገሩ።

verses.text_english: These men peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሰዎች በእኛ ዘንድ የሰላም ሰዎች ናቸው፤ በምድራችን ይቀመጡ፥ ይነግዱባትም፥ እነሆም ምድሪቱ ሰፊ ናት፤ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን እንውሰድ፥ ለእነርሱም ሴቶች ልጆቻችንን እንስጥ።

verses.text_english: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they circumcised.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንድ ሕዝብ ሆነን ከእኛ ጋር ይቀመጡ ዘንድ በዚህ ነገር ብቻ እሺ ይሉናል፤ እነርሱ እንደ ተገረዙ ወንዶቻችንን ሁሉ ብንገርዝ።

verses.text_english: not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.text_amharic: ከብቶቻቸውም ያላቸውም ሁሉ እንስሶቻቸውም ሁሉ ለእኛ አይደሉምን? በዚህ ነገር ብቻ እሺ ያልናቸው እንደ ሆነ ከእኛ ጋር ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማይቱም አደባባይ የሚወጡ ሁሉ ኤሞርንና ልጁን ሴኬምን እሺ አሉ፤ ከከተማይቱ አደባባይ የሚወጡት ወንዶች ሁሉ ተገረዙ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛም ቀን በሆነ ጊዜ እጅግ ቆስለው ሳሉ፥ የዲና ወንድሞች የያዕቆብ ልጆች ስምዖንና ሌዊ እየራሳቸው ሰይፋቸውን ይዘው ሳይፈሩ ወደ ከተማ ገቡ፥ ወንዱንም ሁሉ ገደሉ፤

verses.text_english: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሞርንና ልጁን ሴኬምንም በሰይፍ ገደሉ፥ እኅታቸውን ዲናንም ከሴኬም ቤት ይዘው ወጡ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብም ልጆች እኅታቸውን ዲናን ሰለ አረከሱአት ወደ ሞቱት ገብተው ከተማይቱን ዘረፉ፤

verses.text_english: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which in the city, and that which in the field,
verses.text_amharic: በጎቻቸውንም ላሞቻቸውንም አህዮቻቸውንም በውጭም በከተማም ያለውን ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that in the house.
verses.text_amharic: ሀብታቸውን ሁሉ ሕፃናቶቻቸውንና ሴቶቻቸውንም ሁሉ ማረኩ፥ በቤት ያለውንም ሁሉ ዘረፉ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ሌዊንና ስሞዖንን እንዲህ አለ። በዚች አገር በሚኖሩ በከነዓናውያንና በፌርዛውያን ሰዎች የተጠላሁ ታደርጉኝ ዘንድ እኔን አስጨነቃችሁኝ፤ እኔ በቍጥር ጥቂት ነኝ፤ እነርሱ በእኔ ላይ ይሰበሰቡና ይመቱኛል፤ እኔም ከወገኔ ጋር እጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። በጋለሞታ እንደሚደረግ በእኅታችን ያደርግባትን? አሉ። a

verses.text_english: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያዕቆብን አለው። ተነሥተህ ወደ ቤቴል ውጣ፥ በዚያም ኑር፤ ከወንድምህ ከዔሳው ፊት በሸሸህ ጊዜ ለተገለጠልህ ለእግዚአብሔርም መሠውያውን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that with him, Put away the strange gods that among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ለቤተ ሰቡና ከእርሱ ጋር ላሉት ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። እንግዶቹን አማልክት ከመካከላችሁ አስወግዱ፥ ንጹሐንም ሁኑ፥ ልብሳችሁንም ለውጡ፤

verses.text_english: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተንም ወደ ቤቴል እንውጣ፤ በዚያም በመከራዬ ጊዜ ለሰማኝ፥ በሄድሁበትም መንገድ ከእኔ ጋር ለነበረው ለእግዚአብሔር መሠውያን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which in their hand, and earrings which in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which by Shechem.
verses.text_amharic: በእጃቸው ያሉትንም እንግዶችን አማልክት ሁሉ በጆሮአቸውም ያሉትን ጕትቾች ለያዕቆብ ሰጡት፤ ያዕቆብም በሴኬም አጠገብ ካለችው የአድባር ዛፍ በታች ቀበራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተውም ሄዱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃት በዙሪያቸው ባሉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ወደቀ፥ የያዕቆብንም ልጆች ለማሳደድ አልተከተሉአቸውም።

verses.text_english: So Jacob came to Luz, which in the land of Canaan, that , Bethel, he and all the people that with him.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም፥ እርሱ ከእርሱ ጋርም የነበሩት ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በከነዓን ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሎዛ መጡ፤ እርስዋም ቤቴል ናት።

verses.text_english: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም መሰውያውን ሠራ፥ የዚያንም ቦታ ስም ኤልቤቴል ብሎ ጠራው፤ እርሱ ከወንድሙ ፊት በሸሸበት ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ ተገልጦለት ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
verses.text_amharic: የርብቃ ሞግዚት ዲቦራም ሞተች፥ በቤቴልም ከአድባር ዛፍ በታች ተቀበረች፤ ስሙም አሎንባኩት ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.text_english: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለያዕቆብ ከሁለት ወንዞች መካከል ከሶርያ ከተመለሰ በኋላ እንደ ገና ተገለጠለት፥ ባረከውም።

verses.text_english: And God said unto him, Thy name Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ስምህ ያዕቆብ ነው፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ስምህ ያዕቆብ ተብሎ አይጠራ፥ ስምህ እስራኤል ይባል እንጂ አለ፤ ስሙንም እስራኤል ብሎ ጠራው።
