verses.text_english: And God said unto him, I God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ሁሉን ቻይ አምላክ እኔ ነኝ፤ ብዛ፥ ተባዛም፤ ሕዝብና የአሕዛብ ማኅበር ከአንተ ይሆናል፥ ነገሥታትም ከጕልበትህ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.text_amharic: ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅም የሰጠኋትን ምድር ለአንተ እሰጣለሁ፥ ከአንተም በኋላ ለዘርህ ምድሪቱን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ከተነጋገረበት ስፍራ ወደ ላይ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር በተነጋገረበት ቦታ የድንጋይ ሐውልት ተከለ፤ የመጠጥ መሥዋዕትንም በእርሱ ላይ አፈሰሰ፥ ዘይትንም አፈሰሰበት።

verses.text_english: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር የተነጋገረበትን ያን ቦታ ቤቴል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤቴልም ተነሡ፤ ወደ ኤፍራታም ሊደርሱ ጥቂት ሲቀራቸው ራሔልን ምጥ ያዛት፥ በምጡም ተጨነቀች።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.text_amharic: ምጡም ባስጨነቃት ጊዜ አዋላጂቱ። አትፍሪ፥ ይኸኛው ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅ ይሆንሻልና አለቻት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ስትሞት ነፍስዋ በምትወጣበት ጊዜ ስሙን ቤንኦኒ ብላ ጠራችው፤ አባቱ ግን ብንያም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which Bethlehem.
verses.text_amharic: ራሔልም ሞተች፥ ወደ ኤፍራታ በምትወስድም መንገድ ተቀበረች፤ እርስዋም ቤተልሔም ናት።

verses.text_english: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም በመቃብርዋ ላይ ሐውልት አቆመ፤ እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ የራሔል የመቃብርዋ ሐውልት ነው።

verses.text_english: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ከዚያ ተነሣ፥ ድንኳኑንም ከጋዴር ግንብ በስተ ወዲያ ተከለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በዚያች አገር በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ሮቤል ሄደ የአባቱንም ቁባት ባላን ተገናኛት፤ እስራኤልም ሰማ። የያዕቆብም ልጆች አሥራ ሁለት ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
verses.text_amharic: የልያ ልጆች፤ የያዕቆብ በኵር ልጅ ሮቤል፥ ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፤

verses.text_english: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
verses.text_amharic: የራሔል ልጆች፤ ዮሴፍ፥ ብንያም፤ የራሔል ባርያ የባላ ልጆችም፤ ዳን፥ ንፍታሌም፤

verses.text_english: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
verses.text_amharic: የልያ ባሪያ የዘለፋ ልጆችም፤ ጋድ፥ አሴር፤ እነዚህ በሁለቱ ወንዞች መካከል በሶርያ የተወለዱለት የያዕቆብ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ወደ አባቱ ወደ ይስሐቅ አብርሃምና ይስሐቅ እንግዶች ሆነው ወደ ተቀመጡባት ወደ መምሬ ወደ ቂርያትአርባቅ እርስዋም ኬብሮን ወደምትባለው መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
verses.text_amharic: የይስሐቅም ዕድሜ መቶ ሰማንያ ዓመት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅም ነፍሱን ሰጠ፥ ሞተም፤ ሸምግሎ ዕድሜንም ጠግቦ ወደ ወገኖቹ ተከማቸ፤ ልጆቹም ዔሳውና ያዕቆብ ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: Now these the generations of Esau, who Edom.
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ትውልድ ይህ ነው፤ እርሱም ኤዶም ነው።

verses.text_english: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳው ከከነዓን ልጆች ሚስቶችን አገባ፤ የኬጢያዊውን የዔሎንን ልጅ ዓዳን፥ የኤዊያዊው የፅብዖን ልጅ ዓና የወለዳትን አህሊባማን፥

verses.text_english: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.text_amharic: የእስማኤልን ልጅ የነባዮትን እኅት ቤሴሞትን።

verses.text_english: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.text_amharic: ዓዳ ለዔሳው ኤልፋዝን ወለደች፤ ቤሴሞትም ራጉኤልን ወለደች፤

verses.text_english: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: አህሊባማም የዑስን፥ የዕላምን፥ ቆሬን ወለደች፤ በከነዓን ምድር የተወለዱለት የዔሳው ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም ሚስቶቹን ወንዶች ልጆቹንና ሴቶች ልጆቹን ቤተሰቡንም ሁሉ ከብቱንም ሁሉ እንስሶቹንም ሁሉ በከነዓንም አገር ያገኘውን ሁሉ ይዞ ከወንድሙ ከያዕቆብ ፊት ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.text_amharic: ከብታቸው ስለ በዛ በአንድነት ይቀመጡ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤ በእንግድነት የተቀመጡባትም ምድር ከከብታቸው ብዛት የተነሣ ልትበቃቸው አልቻለችም።

verses.text_english: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau Edom.
verses.text_amharic: ዔሳውም በሴይር ተራራ ተቀመጠ፤ ዔሳውም ኤዶም ነው።

verses.text_english: And these the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.text_amharic: በሴይር ተራራ የሚኖሩ የኤዶማውያን አባት የዔሳው ትውልድም ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: These the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የዓዳ ልጅ ኤልፋዝ፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጅ ራጉኤል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.text_amharic: የኤልፋዝም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ቴማን፥ ኦማር፥ ስፎ፥ ጎቶም፥ ቄኔዝ።

verses.text_english: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
verses.text_amharic: ቲምናዕም ለዔሳው ልጅ ለኤልፋዝ የጭን ገረድ ነበረች፥ አማሌቅንም ለኤልፋዝ ወለደችለት፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የዓዳ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.text_amharic: የራጉኤልም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ናሖት፥ ዛራ፥ ሣማ፥ ሚዛህ፤ እነዚህም የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.text_amharic: የፅብዖን ልጅ የዓና ልጅ የዔሳው ሚስት የአህሊባማ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለዔሳውም የዑስን፥ የዕላማን፥ ቆሬን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: These dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ልጆች አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለዔሳው የበኵር ለኤልፋዝ ልጆች፤ ቴማን አለቃ፥ ኦማር አለቃ፥ ስፎ አለቃ፥ ቄኔዝ አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, duke Amalek: these the dukes of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these the sons of Adah.
verses.text_amharic: ቆሬ አለቃ፥ ጎቶም አለቃ፥ አማሌቅ አለቃ፤ በኤዶም ምድር የኤልፋዝ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ የዓዳ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these the dukes of Reuel in the land of Edom; these the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ናሖት አለቃ፥ ዛራ አለቃ፥ ሣማ አለቃ፥ ሚዛህ አለቃ፤ በኤዶም ምድር የራጉኤል ልጆች አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህም የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these the dukes of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ሚስት የአህሊባማ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የዑስ አለቃ፥ የዕላማ አለቃ፥ ቆሬ አለቃ፤ የዔሳው ሚስት የዓና ልጅ የአህሊባማ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Esau, who Edom, and these their dukes.
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ልጆችና አለቆቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እርሱም ኤዶም ነው።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች አገር የተቀመጡ የሖሪው የሴይር ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሎጣን፥ ሦባል፥ ፅብዖን፥ ዓና፥ ዲሶን፥ ኤጽር፥ ዲሳን፤

verses.text_english: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በኤዶም ምድር የሖሪው የሴይር ልጆች አለቆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister Timna.
verses.text_amharic: የሎጣን ልጆችም ሖሪ፥ ሄማም ናቸው፤ የሎጣንም እኅት ቲምናዕ ናት።

verses.text_english: And the children of Shobal these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.text_amharic: የሦባል ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ዓልዋን፥ ማኔሐት፥ ዔባል፥ ስፎ፥ አውናም።

verses.text_english: And these the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.text_amharic: የፅብዖን ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ አያ፥ ዓና፤ ይህም ዓና በምድረ በዳ የአባቱን የፅብዖንን አህዮች ሲጠብቅ ፍልውኆችን ያገኘ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the children of Anah these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.text_amharic: የዓና ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And these the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.text_amharic: ዲሶን፥ አህሊባማም የዓና ሴት ልጅ። የዲሶንም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሔምዳን፥ ኤስባን፥ ይትራን፥ ክራን።

verses.text_english: The children of Ezer these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.text_amharic: የኤጽር ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ቢልሐን፥ ዛዕዋን፥ ዓቃን።

verses.text_english: The children of Dishan these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.text_amharic: የዲሳን ልጆችም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ዑፅ፥ አራን።

verses.text_english: These the dukes of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.text_amharic: የሖሪ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሎጣን አለቃ፥ ሦባል አለቃ፥ ፅብዖን አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these the dukes of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.text_amharic: ዓና አለቃ፥ ዲሶን አለቃ፥ ኤጽር አለቃ፥ ዲሳን አለቃ፤ በሴይር ምድር አለቆች የሆኑ የሖሪ አለቆቹ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ንጉሥ ከመኖሩ በፊት በኤዶም አገር የነገሡ ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city Dinhabah.
verses.text_amharic: በኤዶምም የቢዖር ልጅ ባላቅ ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዲንሃባ ናት።

verses.text_english: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የባሶራው የዛራ ልጅ ኢዮባብ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮባብም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የቴማኒው አገር ሑሳም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city Avith.
verses.text_amharic: ሑሳምም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የምድያምን ሰዎች በሞዓብ ሜዳ የመታ የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዓዊት ተባለ።

verses.text_english: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሃዳድም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የመሥሬቃው ሠምላ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth the river reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሠምላም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም በወንዝ አጠገብ ካለችው ከርሆቦት ሳኦል ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም የዓክቦር ልጅ በኣልሐናን ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city Pau; and his wife's name Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.text_amharic: የዓክቦር ልጅ በኣልሐናንም ሞተ፥ በስፍራውም ሃዳር ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ፋዑ ነው፤ ሚስቱም የሜዛሃብ ልጅ መጥሬድ የወለደቻት መሄጣብኤል ትባላለች።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the dukes of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳውም የአለቆቹ ስም በወገናቸው በስፍራቸው በስማቸውም ይህ ነው፤ ቲምናዕ አለቃ፥ ዓልዋ አለቃ፥ የቴት አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.text_amharic: አህሊባማ አለቃ፥ ኤላ አለቃ፥ ፊኖን አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.text_amharic: ቄኔዝ አለቃ፥ ቴማን አለቃ፥ ሚብሳር አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.text_amharic: መግዲኤል አለቃ፥ ዒራም አለቃ፥ እነዚህ በግዛታቸው ምድር በየመኖሪያቸው የኤዶም አለቆች ናቸው። የኤዶማውያን አባት ይህ ዔሳው ነው። a

verses.text_english: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም አባቱ በስደት በኖረበት አገር በከነዓን ምድር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: These the generations of Jacob. Joseph, seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብም ትውልድ ይህ ነው። ዮሴፍ የአሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ልጅ በሆነ ጊዜ ከወንድሞቹ ጋር በጎችን ይጠብቅ ነበር፤ እርሱም ከአባቱ ሚስቶች ከባላና ከዘለፋ ልጆች ጋር ሳለ ብላቴና ነበረ፤ ዮሴፍም የክፋታቸውን ወሬ ወደ አባታቸው አመጣ።

verses.text_english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of colours.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን ከልጆቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ ይወደው ነበር፥ እርሱ በሽምግልናው የወለደው ነበርና፤ በብዙ ኅብር ያጌጠችም ቀሚስ አደረገለት ።

verses.text_english: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹም አባታቸው ከልጆቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ እንዲወደው ባዩ ጊዜ ጠሉት፥ በሰላም ይናገሩትም ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ሕልምን አለመ፥ ለወንድሞቹም ነገራቸው፤ እነርሱም እንደ ገና በብዙ ጠሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አላቸው። እኔ ያለምሁትን ሕልም ስሙ፤

verses.text_english: For, behold, we binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ እኛ በእርሻ መካከል ነዶ ስናስር ነበርና፥ እነሆም፥ የእኔ ነዶ ቀጥ ብላ ቆመች፤ የእናንተም ነዶች በዙሪያ ከብበው እነሆ ለእኔ ነዶ ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹም። በእኛ ላይ ልትነግሥብን ይሆን? ወይስ ልትገዛ ይሆን? አሉት። እንደ ገናም ስለ ሕልሙና ስለ ነገሩ ይልቁን ጠሉት።

verses.text_english: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሌላ ሕልምን አለመ፥ ለወንድሞቹም ነገራቸው፥ እንዲህም አለ። እነሆ ደግሞ ሌላ ሕልምን አለምሁ፤ እነሆ ፀሐይና ጨረቃ አሥራ አንድ ከዋክብትም ሲሰግዱልኝ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And he told to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቱና ለወንድሞቹም ነገራቸው፤ አባቱም ገሠጸው፥ እንዲህም አለው። ይህ ያለምኸው ሕልም ምንድር ነው? በውኑ እኔና እናትህ ወንድሞችህም መጥተን በምድር ላይ እንሰግድልህ ይሆን?

verses.text_english: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹም ቀኑበት አባቱ ግን ነገሩን ይጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹ በሴኬም የአባታቸውን በጎች ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here .
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። ወንድሞችህ በሴኬም በጎችን የሚጠብቁ አይደሉምን? ወደ እነርሱ እልክህ ዘንድ ና አለው። እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለው ።

verses.text_english: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሄደህ ወንድሞችህና በጎቹ ደኅና እንደ ሆኑ እይ፥ ወሬአቸውንም አምጣልኝ አለው። እንዲህም ከኬብሮን ቈላ ሰደደው፥ ወደ ሴኬምም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And a certain man found him, and, behold, wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም በምድረ በዳ ሲቅበዘበዝ ሳለ አንድ ሰው አገኘው፤ ሰውዮውም። ምን ትፈልጋለህ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed .
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ወንድሞቼን እፈልጋለሁ፤ በጎቹን የሚጠብቁበት ወዴት እንደ ሆነ እባክህ ንገረኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮውም። ከዚህ ተነሥተዋል፤ ወደ ዶታይን እንሂድ ሲሉም ሰምቼአቸዋለሁ አለው። ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን ተከታትሎ ሄደ፥ በዶታይንም አገኛቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በሩቅ ሳለ አዩት፥ ወደ እነርሱም ገና ሳይቀርብ ይገድሉት ዘንድ በእርሱ ላይ ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ያ ባለ ሕልም ይኸው መጣ።

verses.text_english: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ኑ፥ እንግደለውና በአንድ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ እንጣለው። ክፉ አውሬም በላው እንላለን፤ ከሕልሞቹም የሚሆነውን እናያለን።

verses.text_english: And Reuben heard , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤልም ይህን ሰማ፥ ከእጃቸውም አዳነው፥ እንዲህም አለ። ሕይወቱን አናጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, cast him into this pit that in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤል። ደም አታፍስሱ፤ በዚህች ምድረ በዳ ባለችው ጕድጓድ ጣሉት፥ ነገር ግን እጃችሁን አትጣሉበት አላቸው። እንዲህም ማለቱ ከእጃቸው ሊያድነውና ወደ አባቱ ሊመልሰው ነው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, coat of colours that on him;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዮሴፍም ወደ ወንድሞቹ በቀረበ ጊዜ የለበሳትን በብዙ ኅብር ያጌጠቺቱን ቀሚሱን ገፈፉት፤

verses.text_english: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit empty, no water in it.
verses.text_amharic: ወስደውም ወደ ጕድጓድ ጣሉት፤ ጕድጓዱም ውኃ የሌለበት ደረቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry down to Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራም ሊበሉ ተቀመጡ፤ ዓይናቸውንም አንሥተው አዩ፥ እነሆም የእስማኤላውያን ነገዶች ወደ ግብፅ ለመውረድ ከገለዓድ መጡ፤ ግመሎቻቸውም ሽቱና በለሳን ከርቤም ተጭነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ወንድሞቹን እንዲህ አላቸው። ወንድማችንን ገድለን ደሙን ብንሸሽግ ጥቅማችን ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he our brother our flesh. And his brethren were content.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ፥ ለእስማኤላውያን እንሽጠው፥ እጃችንን ግን በእርሱ ላይ አንጣል፥ ወንድማችን ሥጋችንም ነውና። ወንድሞቹም የእርሱን ነገር ሰሙት።

verses.text_english: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የምድያም ነጋዶችም አለፉ፤ እነርሱም ዮሴፍን አንሥተው ከጕድጓድ አወጡት፤ ለእስማኤላውያንም ዮሴፍን በሀያ ብር ሸጡት፤ እነርሱም ዮሴፍን ወደ ግብፅ ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤልም ወደ ጕድጓዱ ተመለሰ፥ እነሆም ዮሴፍ በጕድጓድ የለም፤ ልብሱንም ቀደደ።

verses.text_english: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child not; and I, whither shall I go?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ወንድሞቹም ተመልሶ። ብላቴናው የለም፤ እንግዲህ እኔ ወዴት እሄዳለሁ? አለ።

verses.text_english: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍንም ቀሚስ ወሰዱ፥ የፍየል አውራም አርደው ቀሚሱን በደም ነከሩት።

verses.text_english: And they sent the coat of colours, and they brought to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it thy son's coat or no.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ኅብር ያለበትን ቀሚሱንም ላኩ፥ ወደ አባታቸውም አገቡት፥ እንዲህም አሉት። ይህንን አገኘነ፤ ይህ የልጅህ ልብስ እንደ ሆነ ወይም እንዳልሆነ እስኪ እየው።

verses.text_english: And he knew it, and said, my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አውቆ። የልጄ ቀሚስ ነው፤ ክፉ አውሬ በልቶታል፤ ዮሴፍ በእርግጥ ተበጫጭቋል አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ በወገቡም ማቅ ታጥቆ ለልጁ ብዙ ቀን አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶች ልጆቹና ሴቶች ልጆቹም ሁሉ ሊያጽናኑት ተነሡ፤ መጽናናትን እንቢ አለ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ወደ ልጄ ወደ ሙታን ስፍራ እያዘንሁ እወርዳለሁ። አባቱም ስለ እርሱ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, captain of the guard.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያ የምድያም ሰዎች ግን ዮሴፍን በግብፅ ለፈርዖን ጃንደረባ ለዘበኞቹ አለቃ ለጲጥፋራ ሸጡት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name Hirah.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ይሁዳ ከወንድሞቹ ተለይቶ ወረደ፥ ስሙን ኤራስ ወደሚሉት ወደ ዓዶሎማዊውም ሰው ገባ።

verses.text_english: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ይሁዳ የከነዓናዊውን የሴዋን ሴት ልጅ አየ፤ ወሰዳትም፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገባ።

verses.text_english: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.text_amharic: ፀነሰችም ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ ስሙንም ዔር ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች፤ ስሙንም አውናን ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ገና ደግሞ ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ሴሎም ብላ ጠራችው፤ እርሱንም በወለደች ጊዜ ክዚብ በሚባል አገር ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name Tamar.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ለበኵር ልጁ ለዔር ትዕማር የምትባል ሚስት አጋባው።

verses.text_english: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም የበኵር ልጅ ዔር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቀሠፈው።

verses.text_english: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም አውናን። ወደ ወንድምህ ሚስት ግባ፥ አግባትም፥ ለወንድምህም ዘርን አቁምለት አለው።

verses.text_english: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
verses.text_amharic: አውናንም ዘሩ ለእርሱ እንዳይሆን አወቀ፤ ወደ ወንድሙ ሚስት በገባ ጊዜ ለወንድሙ ዘር እንዳይሰጥ ዘሩን በምድር ያፈስስው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሥራው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ክፉ ሆነበት፥ እርሱንም ደግሞ ቀሠፈው።

verses.text_english: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ምራቱን ትዕማርን። ልጄ ሴሎም እስኪያድግ ድረስ በአባትሽ ቤት መበለት ሆነሽ ተቀመጪ አላት፤ እርሱ ደግሞ እንደ ወንድሞቹ እንዳይሞት ብሎአልና። ትዕማርም ሄዳ በአባትዋ ቤት ተቀመጠች።

verses.text_english: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ዘመንም በኋላ የይሁዳ ሚስት የሴዋ ልጅ ሞተች፤ ይሁዳም ተጽናና፥ የበጎቹን ጠጕር ወደሚሸልቱት ሰዎችም ወደ ተምና ወጣ፥ እርሱም ዓዶሎማዊው ወዳጁም ኤራስ።

verses.text_english: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ለትዕማርም። እነሆ አማትሽ ይሁዳ የበጎቹን ጠጕር ይሸልት ዘንድ ወደ ተምና ይወጣል ብለው ነገሩአት።

verses.text_english: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም የመበለትነትዋን ልብስ አወለቀች፥ መጎናጸፊያዋንም ወሰደች፥ ተሸፈነችም፥ ወደ ተምናም በሚወስደው መንገድ ዳር በኤናይም ደጅ ተቀመጠች፤ ሴሎም እንደ አደገ ሚስትም እንዳልሆነችው አይታለችና።

verses.text_english: When Judah saw her, he thought her an harlot; because she had covered her face.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ባያት ጊዜ ጋለሞታን መሰለችው፤ ፊትዋን ተሸፍና ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርስዋም አዘነበለ። እባክሽ ወደ አንቺ ልግባ አላት፤ እርስዋ ምራቱ እንደ ሆነች አላወቀም ነበርና። እርስዋም። ወደኔ ብትገባ ምን ትሰጠኛለህ? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I will send a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give a pledge, till thou send ?
verses.text_amharic: የፍየል ጠቦት ከመንጋዬ እሰድድልሻለሁ አላት። እርስዋም። እስክትሰድድልኝ ድረስ መያዣ ትሰጠኛለህን? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that in thine hand. And he gave her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ምን መያዣ ልስጥሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። ቀለበትህን፥ አምባርህን፥ በእጅህ ያለውን በትር አለች። እርሱም ሰጣትና ከእርስዋ ጋር ደረሰ፥ እርስዋም ፀነሰችለት።

verses.text_english: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ተነሥታ ሄደች፥ መጎናጸፊያዋንም አውልቃ የመበለትነትዋን ልብስ ለበሰች።

verses.text_english: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም መያዣውን ከሴቲቱ እጅ ይቀበል ዘንድ በወዳጁ በዓዶሎማዊው እጅ የፍየሉን ጠቦት ላከላት፤ እርስዋንም አላገኛትም።

verses.text_english: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where the harlot, that openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this .
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የአገሩን ሰዎች። በኤናይም በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጣ የነበረች ጋለሞታ ወዴት ናት? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። እነርሱም። በዚህ ጋለሞታ አልነበረችም አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, there was no harlot in this .
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ይሁዳም ተመልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አላገኘኋትም፤ የአገሩም ሰዎች ደግሞ። ከዚህ ጋለሞታ አልነበረችም አሉኝ።

verses.text_english: And Judah said, Let her take to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም። እኛ መዘበቻ እንዳንሆን ትውሰደው፤ እነሆ የፍየሉን ጠቦት ሰደድሁላት፥ አንተም አላገኘሃትም አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከሦስት ወር በኋላ ለይሁዳ። ምራትህ ትዕማር ሴሰነች፤ ደግሞም በዝሙት እነሆ ፀነሰች ብለው ነገሩት። ይሁዳም። አውጡአትና በእሳት ትቃጠል አለ።

verses.text_english: When she brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ባወጡአት ጊዜ ወደ አማትዋ እንዲህ ብላ ላከች። ለዚህ ለባለ ገንዘብ ነው የፀነስሁት፤ ተመልከት፤ ይህ ቀለበት፥ ይህ አምባር፥ ይህ በትር የማን ነው?

verses.text_english: And Judah acknowledged , and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም አወቀ። ከእኔ ይልቅ እርስዋ እውነተኛ ሆነች፤ ልጄን ሴሎምን አልሰጠኋትምና አለ። ደግሞም አላወቃትም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins in her womb.
verses.text_amharic: በመውለጃዋም ጊዜ እነሆ መንታ ልጆች በሆድዋ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that put out hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
verses.text_amharic: ስትወልድም አንዱ እጁን አወጣ፤ አዋላጂቱም ቀይ ፈትል ወስዳ በእጁ አሰረች። ይህ መጀመሪያ ይወጣል አለች።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? breach upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እጁን በመለሰ ጊዜ እነሆ ወንድሙ ወጣ፤ እርስዋም። ለምን ጥስህ ወጣህ? አለች፤ ስሙንም ፋሬስ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ ቀይ ፈትል በእጁ ያለበት ወንድሙ ወጣ፤ ስሙም ዛራ ተባለ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍ ግን ወደ ግብፅ ወረደ፤ የፈርዖን ጃንደረባ የዘበኞቹም አለቃ የሚሆን የግብፅ ሰው ጲጥፋራ ወደ ግብፅ ካወረዱት ከእስማኤላውያን እጅ ገዛው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከዮሴፍ ጋር ነበረ፥ ሥራውም የተከናወነለት ሰው ሆነ፤ በግብፃዊው ጌታውም ቤት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his master saw that the LORD with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር እንዳለ፥ እርሱ የሚሠራውንም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በእጁ እንዲያከናውንለት አየ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all he had he put into his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በጌታው ፊት ሞገስን አገኘ፥ እርሱንም ያገለግለው ነበር፤ በቤቱም ላይ ሾመው፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ በእጁ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass from the time he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በቤቱ ባለውም ሁሉ ላይ ከሾመው በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የግብፃዊውን ቤት ስለ ዮሴፍ ባረከው፤ የእግዚአብሔር በረከት በውጪም በግቢም ባለው ሁሉ ላይ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was goodly , and well favoured.
verses.text_amharic: ያለውንም ሁሉ ለዮሴፍ አስረከበ፤ ከሚበላውም እንጀራ በቀር ምንም የሚያውቀው አልነበረም። የዮሴፍም ፊቱ መልከ መልካምና ውብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የጌታው ሚስት በዮሴፍ ላይ ዓይንዋን ጣለች። ከእኔም ጋር ተኛ አለችው።

verses.text_english: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንቢ አለ፥ ለጌታውም ሚስት እንዲህ አላት። እነሆ ጌታዬ በቤቱ ያለውን ምንም ምን የሚያውቀው የለም፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ ለእኔ አስረክቦኛል፤

verses.text_english: none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህ ቤት ከእኔ የሚበልጥ ሰው የለም፤ ሚስቱ ስለ ሆንሽ ከአንቺም በቀር ያልሰጠኝ ነገር የለም፤ እንዴት ይህን ትልቅ ክፉ ነገር አደርጋለሁ? በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዴት ኃጢአትን እሠራለሁ?

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, to be with her.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር በየዕለቱ ለዮሴፍ ትነግረው ነበር፤ እርሱም ከእርስዋ ጋር ይተኛ ዘንድ ከእርስዋም ጋር ይሆን ዘንድ አልሰማትም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass about this time, that went into the house to do his business; and none of the men of the house there within.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ ሥራውን እንዲሠራ፤ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፤ በቤትም ውስጥ ከቤት ሰዎች ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ተኛ ስትል ልብሱን ተጠማጥማ ያዘች፤ እርሱም ልብሱን በእጅዋ ትቶላት ሸሸ ወደ ውጭም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ልብሱን ትቶ ወደ ውጭ እንደ ሸሸ ባየች ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
verses.text_amharic: የቤትዋን ሰዎች ወደ እርስዋ ጠርታ እንዲህ ብላ ነገረቻቸው። እዩ፤ ዕብራዊው ሰው በእኛ እንዲሣለቅ አግብቶብናል፤፤ እርሱ ከእኔ ጋር ሊተኛ ወደ እኔ ገባ፥ እኔም ድምፄን ከፍ አድርጌ ጮኽሁ፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
verses.text_amharic: ድምፄንም ከፍ አድርጌ እንደ ጮኽሁ ቢሰማ ልብሱን በእኔ ዘንድ ጥሎ ሸሸ ወደ ውጭም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታው ወደ ቤቱ እስኪገባ ድረስም ልብሱን ከእርስዋ ዘንድ አኖረች።

verses.text_english: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር እንዲህ ብላ ነገረችው። ያገባህልን ዕብራዊው ባሪያ ሊሣለቅብኝ ወደ እኔ ገባ፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ድምፄን ከፍ አድርጌ ስጮኽ ልብሱን በእጄ ተወና ወደ ውጭ ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም። ባሪያህ እንዲህ አደረገኝ ብላ የነገረችውን የሚስቱን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners bound: and he was there in the prison.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍም ጌታ ወሰደው፥ የንጉሡ እስረኞችም ወደሚታሰሩበት ስፍራ ወደ ግዞት ቤት አገባው፤ ከዚያም በግዞት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከዮሴፍ ጋር ነበረ ምሕረትንም አበዛለት፥ በግዞት ቤቱም አለቃ ፊት ሞገስን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer .
verses.text_amharic: የግዞት ቤቱም አለቃ በግዞት ያሉትን እስረኞች ሁሉ በዮሴፍ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ በዚያም የሚደረገው ነገር ሁሉ እርሱ የሚያደርገው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and which he did, the LORD made to prosper.
verses.text_amharic: የግዞት ቤቱም አለቃ በእጁ ያለውን ነገር ከቶ አላሰበም፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረና፤ የሚያደርገውንም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ያቀናለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ ነገር በኋላም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የግብፅ ንጉሥ የጠጅ አሳላፊና የእንጀራ አበዛ ጌታቸውን የግብፅ ንጉሥን በደሉ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh was wroth against two his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም በሁለቱ ሹማምቱ በጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹ አለቃና በእንጀራ አበዛዎቹ አለቃ ላይ ተቆጣ፤

verses.text_english: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph bound.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍ ታስሮ በነበረበትም በግዞት ስፍራ በዘበኞቹ አለቃ ቤት አስጠበቃቸው።

verses.text_english: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ለዮሴፍ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ እርሱም ያገለግላቸው ነበር፤ በግዞት ቤትም አያሌ ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which bound in the prison.
verses.text_amharic: በግዞት ቤት የነበሩት የግብፅ ንጉሥ ጠጅ አሳላፊና እንጀራ አበዛ ሁለቱም በአንዲት ሌሊት እንደ ሕልሙ ትርጓሜ እየራሳቸው ሕልምን አለሙ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they sad.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ማልዶ ወደ እነርሱ ገባ፥ እነሆም አዝነው አያቸው።

verses.text_english: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye sadly to day?
verses.text_amharic: በጌታው ቤት ከእርሱ ጋር በግዞት የነበሩትንም የፈርዖንን ሹማምት እንዲህ ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። እናንተ ዛሬ ስለ ምን አዝናችኋል?

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, not interpretations to God? tell me , I pray you.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሕልምን አልመን የሚተረጕምልን አጣን አሉት። ዮሴፍም አላቸው። ሕልምን የሚተረጕም እግዚአብሔር የሰጠው አይደለምን? እስቲ ንገሩኝ።

verses.text_english: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine before me;
verses.text_amharic: የጠጅ አሳላፊዎች አለቃም ለዮሴፍ ሕልሙን እንዲህ ብሎ ነገረው። በሕልሜ የወይን ዛፍ በፊቴ ሆና አየሁ፥

verses.text_english: And in the vine three branches: and it as though it budded, her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
verses.text_amharic: በዛፊቱም ሦስት አረግ አለባት፤ እርስዋም ቅጠልና አበባ አወጣች፥ ዘለላም አንጠለጠለች፥ የዘለላዋም ፍሬ በሰለ፤

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh's cup in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ጽዋ በእጄ ነበረ፤ ፍሬውንም ወስጄ በፈርዖን ጽዋ ጨመቅሁት፥ ጽዋውንም ለፈርዖን በእጁ ሰጠሁት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto him, This the interpretation of it: The three branches three days:
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አለው። የዚህ ትርጓሜው ይህ ነው፤ ሦስቱ አረግ ሦስት ቀን ነው፤

verses.text_english: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ፈርዖን ራስህን ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ ወደ ቀደመው ሹመትህም ይመልስሃል፤ ጠጅ አሳላፊ በነበርህበት ጊዜ ስታደርግ እንደ ነበረው እንደ ቀድሞው ሥርዓትም የፈርዖንን ጽዋ በእጁ ትሰጣለህ።

verses.text_english: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጎ ነገር በተደረገልህ ጊዜ እኔን አስበኝ፥ ምሕረትንም አድርግልኝ፥ የእኔንም ነገር ለፈርዖን ነግረህ ከዚህ ቤት አውጣኝ፤

verses.text_english: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ከዕብራውያን አገር ሰርቀው አምጥተውኛልና፤ ከዚህም ደግሞ በግዞት ያኖሩኝ ዘንድ ምንም አላደረግሁም።

verses.text_english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also in my dream, and, behold, three white baskets on my head:
verses.text_amharic: የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹ አለቃም ሕልሙን በመልካም እንደ ተረጎመ ባየ ጊዜ ዮሴፍን እንዲህ አለው። እኔም ደግሞ ሕልም አይቼ ነበር፥ እነሆም ሦስት መሶብ ነጭ እንጀራ በራሴ ላይ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And in the uppermost basket of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
verses.text_amharic: በላይኛውም መሶብ ፈርዖን ከሚበላው ከጋጋሪዎች ሥራ ሁሉ ነበረበት፤ ወፎችም በራሴ ላይ ከመሶቡ ይበሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Joseph answered and said, This the interpretation thereof: The three baskets three days:
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። የዚህ ትርጓሜው ይህ ነው፤ ሦስቱ መሶብ ሦስት ቀን ነው፤

verses.text_english: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ፈርዖን ራስህን ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ በእንጨትም ላይ ይሰቅልሃል፤ ወፎችም ሥጋህን ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the third day, Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ፈርዖን የተወለደበት ቀን ነበረ፥ ለሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ግብር አደረገ፤ የጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹን አለቃና የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹን አለቃ በአሽከሮቹ መካከል ከፍ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
verses.text_amharic: የጠጅ አሳለፊዎቹንም አለቃ ወደ ስፍራው መለሰው፥ ጽዋውንም በፈርዖን እጅ ሰጠ፤

verses.text_english: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.text_amharic: የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹንም አለቃ ሰቀለው፥ ዮሴፍ እንደተረጎመላቸው።

verses.text_english: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
verses.text_amharic: የጠጅ አሳላፊዎች አለቃ ግን ዮሴፍን አላሰበውም፥ ረሳው እንጂ። a

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለት ዓመት በኋላም ፈርዖን ሕልምን አየ፥ እነሆም፥ በወንዙ ዳር ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ መልካቸው ያማረ ሥጋቸውም የወፈረ ሰባት ላሞች ከወንዙ ወጡ፥ በውኃውም ዳር በመስኩ ይሰማሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በኋላ እነሆ መልካቸው የከፋ ሥጋቸውም የከሳ ሌሎች ሰባት ላሞች ከወንዝ ወጡ፥ በእነዚያም ላሞች አጠገብ በወንዙ ዳር ይቆሙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.text_amharic: መልካቸው የከፋ ሥጋቸውም የከሳ እነዚያም ላሞች መልካቸው ያማረውን ሥጋቸው የወፈረውን ሰባቱን ላሞች ዋጡአቸው። ፈርዖንም ነቃ።

verses.text_english: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ተኛ ሁለተኛም ሕልምን አየ። እነሆም በአንድ አገዳ ላይ የነበሩ ያማሩና መልካም የሆኑ ሰባት እሸቶች ወጡ፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም ከእነርሱ በኋላ የሰለቱና በምሥራቅ ነፋስ የተመቱ ሰባት እሸቶች ወጡ፤

verses.text_english: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, a dream.
verses.text_amharic: የሰለቱትም እሸቶች ሰባቱን ያማሩና የዳበሩ እሸቶች ዋጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ነቃ፥ እነሆም ሕልም ነበረ። በነጋም ጊዜ ነፍሱ ታወከችበት፤ ወደ ሕልም ተርጓሚዎች ሁሉ ወደ ግብፅ ጠቢባንም ሁሉ ልኮ ወደ እርሱ ጠራቸው፤ ፈርዖንም ሕልሙን ነገራቸው፥ ነገር ግን ከእነርሱ ለፈርዖን የሚተረጕም አልተገኘም።

verses.text_english: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ የጠጅ አሳላፈዎቹ አለቃ እንዲህ ብሎ ለፈርዖን ተናገረ። እኔ ኃጢአቴን ዛሬ አስባለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, me and the chief baker:
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖን በባሪይዎቹ ላይ ተቆጣ፥ እኔንም የእንጀራ አበዛዎቹንም አለቃ በግዞት ስፍራ በዘበኞች አለቃ ቤት አኖረን፤

verses.text_english: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም በአንዲት ሌሊት ሕልምን አለምን፥ እኔና እርሱ፤ እያንዳንዳችን እንደ ሕልማችን ትርጓሜ አለምን።

verses.text_english: And there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ባሪያ የሆነ አንድ ዕብራዊ ጕልማሳ ከእኛ ጋር ነበረ፤ ለእርሱም ነገርነው፥ ሕልማችንንም ተረጐመልን፤ ለእያንዳንዱም እንደ ሕልሙ ተረጐመልን።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እንደ ተረጐመልን እንደዚያው ሆነ፤ እኔ ወደ ሹመቴ ተመለስሁ፥ እርሱም ተሰቀለ።

verses.text_english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved , and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ልኮ ዮሴፍን አስጠራ፥ ከግዞት ቤትም አስቸኰሉት፤ እርሱም ተላጨ፥ ልብሱንም ለወጠ፥ ወደ ፈርዖንም ገባ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። ሕልምን አየሁ፥ የሚተረጕመውም አልተገኘም፤ ሕልምን እንደ ሰማህ፥ እንደ ተረጐምህም ስለ አንተ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ለፈርዖን እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። ይህ በእኔ አይደለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለፈርዖን በደኅንነት ይመልስለታል።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ለዮሴፍ እንዲህ አለው። እነሆ፥ በሕልሜ በወንዝ ዳር ቆሜ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሥጋቸው የወፈረ መልካቸውም ያማረ ሰባት ላሞች ወጡ፥ በመስኩም ይሰማሩ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በኋላ እነሆ የደከሙ መልካቸውም እጅግ የከፋ ሥጋቸውም የከሳ ሌሎች ሰባት ላሞች ወጡ፤ በግብፅም ምድር ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ መልከ ክፉ ከቶ አላየሁም፤

verses.text_english: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.text_amharic: የከሱትና መልከ ክፋዎቹ ላሞች የመጀመሪያዎቹን ወፍራሞቹን ሰባት ላሞች ዋጡአቸው፥

verses.text_english: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.text_amharic: በሆዳቸውም ተዋጡ፤ በሆዳቸውም እንደተዋጡ አልታወቀም፥ መልካቸውም በመጀመሪያ እንደ ነበረው የከፋ ነበረ። ነቃሁም።

verses.text_english: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
verses.text_amharic: በሕልሜም እነሆ የዳበሩና መልካም የሆኑ ሰባት እሸቶች በአንድ አገዳ ሲወጡ አየሁ፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በኋላ እነሆ የደረቁና የሰለቱ በምሥራቅ ነፋስ የተመቱ ሰባት እሸቶች ወጡ፤

verses.text_english: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told unto the magicians; but none that could declare to me.
verses.text_amharic: የሰለቱት እሸቶች ያማሩትን ሰባቱን እሸቶች ዋጡአቸው። ለሕልም ተርጓሚዎችም ሕልሜን ነገርሁ የሚተረጕምልኝም አጣሁ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he about to do.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ፈርዖንን አለው። የፈርዖን ሕልሙ አንድ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያደርገው ያለውን ለፈርዖን ነግሮታል።

verses.text_english: The seven good kine seven years; and the seven good ears seven years: the dream one.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱ መልካካሞች ላሞች ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው፥ ሰባቱም መልካካሞች እሸቶች ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው፤ ሕልሙ አንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በኋላ የወጡት የከሱትና መልከ ክፋዎቹ ሰባት ላሞች ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው፥ የሰለቱትና የምሥራቅ ነፋስ የመታቸው ሰባቱም እሸቶች እነርሱ ራብ የሚሆንባቸው ሰባት ዓመታት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: This the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ለፈርዖን የነገርሁት ነገር ይህ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያደርገው ያለውን ለፈርዖን አሳየው።

verses.text_english: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ጥጋብ የሚሆንባቸው ሰባት ዓመታት ይመጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ከዚህ በኋላ የሰባት ዓመት ራብ ይመጣል፥ በግብፅ አገር የነበረውም ጥጋብ ሁሉ ይረሳል፤ ራብም ምድርን በጣም ያጠፋል፤

verses.text_english: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it very grievous.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላ ከሚሆነው ከዚያ ራብ የተነሣም በምድር የሆነው ጥጋብ አይታወቅም፥ እጅግ ጽኑ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; because the thing established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.text_amharic: ሕልሙም ለፈርዖን ደጋግሞ መታየቱ ነገሩ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የተቈረጠ ስለ ሆነ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ፈጥኖ ያደርገዋል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ፈርዖን ብልህና አዋቂ ሰውን ይፈልግ፥ በግብፅ ምድር ላይም ይሹመው።

verses.text_english: Let Pharaoh do , and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖን በምድር ላይ ሹማምትን ይሹም፤ በሰባቱም የጥጋብ ዓመታት ከሚገኘው ፍሬ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ከአምስት እጅ አንደኛውን ይውሰድ።

verses.text_english: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.text_amharic: የሚመጡትን የመልካሞቹን ዓመታት እህላቸውን ያከማቹ፤ ስንዴውንም ከፈርዖን እጅ በታች ያኑሩ፥ እህሎችም በከተሞች ይጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድር ስለሚሆነው ስለ ሰባቱ ዓመታት ራብ እህሉ ተጠብቆ ይኑር፥ ምድሪቱም በራብ አትጠፋም።

verses.text_english: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩም በፈርዖንና በሎሌዎቹ ፊት መልካም ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find as this , a man in whom the Spirit of God ?
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሎሌዎቹን እንዲህ አላቸው። በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ያለበትን እንደዚህ ያለ ሰው እናገኛለንን?

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, none so discreet and wise as thou :
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። እንደ አንተ ያለ ብልህ አዋቂም ሰው የለም፥ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሁሉ ገልጦልሃልና።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በቤቴ ላይ ተሾም፥ ሕዝቤም ሁሉ ለቃልህ ይታዘዝ፤ እኔ በዙፋኔ ብቻ ከአንተ እበልጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን። በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ሾምሁህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖን ቀለበቱን ከእጁ አወለቀ በዮሴፍ እጅም አደረገው፥ ነጭ የተልባ እግር ልብስንም አለበሰው፥ በአንገቱም የወርቅ ዝርግፍን አደረገለት፤

verses.text_english: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የእርሱም በምትሆን በሁለተኛይቱ ሰረገላ አስቀመጠው፥ አዋጅ ነጋሪም። ስገዱ እያለ በፊት በፊቱ ይጮኽ ነበር፤ እርሱም በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ተሾመ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። እኔ ፈርዖን ነኝ፤ በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ያለ አንተ ማንም እጁንም እግሩንም አያንሣ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም የዮሴፍን ስም ጸፍናት ፐዕናህ ብሎ ጠራው፤ የሄልዮቱ ከተማ ካህን የDoጥፌራ ልጅ የምትሆን አስናትን አጋባው። ዮሴፍም በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በግብፅ ንጉሥ በፈርዖን ፊት በቆመ ጊዜ ዕድሜው ሠላሳ ዓመት ነበረ። ዮሴፍም ከፈርዖን ፊት ወጣ፥ የግብፅ ምድርንም ሁሉ ዞረ።

verses.text_english: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባቱም በጥጋብ ዓመታት የምድሪቱ ፍሬ ክምር ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ያለውን የሰባቱን ዓመት እህል ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ እህልንም በከተሞቹ አደለበ፤ በየከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ያለውን የእርሻውን እህል ሁሉ በዚያው ከተተ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for without number.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ እጅግ ብዙ የሆነ ስንዴን አከማቸ፥ መስፈርን እስኪተው ድረስ፤ ሊሰፈር አልተቻለምና።

verses.text_english: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ለዮሴፍም የሄልዮቱ ከተማ ካህን የDoጥፌራ ልጅ አስናት የወለደችለት ሁለት ልጆች የራብ ዘመን ገና ሳይመጣ ተወለዱለት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, , hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም የበኵር ልጁን ስም ምናሴ ብሎ ጠራው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እግዚአብሔር መከራዬን ሁሉ የአባቴንም ቤት አስረሳኝ፤

verses.text_english: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለተኛውንም ስም ኤፍሬም ብሎ ጠራው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እግዚአብሔር በመከራዬ አገር አፈራኝ።

verses.text_english: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድር የነበረውም የሰባቱ ዓመት ጥጋብ አለፈ፥

verses.text_english: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም እንደ ተናገረ የሰባቱ ዓመት ራብ ጀመረ። በየአገሩም ሁሉ ራብ ሆነ፤ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ግን እህል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅ ምድርም ሁሉ ተራበ፥ ሕዝቡም ስለ እህል ወደ ፈርዖን ጮኸ፤ ፈርዖንም የግብፅ ሰዎችን ሁሉ። ወደ ዮሴፍ ሂዱ፥ እርሱ ያላችሁንም ሁሉ አድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ ራብ ሆነ፤ ዮሴፍም እህል ያለበትን ጎተራ ሁሉ ከፍቶ ለግብፅ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይሸጥ ነበር፤ ራብም በግብፅ ምድር ጸንቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy ; because that the famine was sore in all lands.
verses.text_amharic: አገሮችም ሁሉ እህል ይገዙ ዘንድ ወደ ግብፅ ወደ ዮሴፍ መጡ፤ በምድር ሁሉ ራብ እጅግ ጸንቶ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም በግብፅ እህል እንዳለ ሰማ፥ ያዕቆብም ልጆቹን። ለምን እርስ በርሳችሁ ትተያያላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። እነሆ ስንዴ በግብፅ እንዲገኝ ሰምቼአለሁ፤ ወደዚያ ውረዱ፥ እንድንድንና እንዳንሞትም ከዚያ ሸምቱልን።

verses.text_english: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍም አሥሩ ወንድሞቹ ስንዴን ከግብፅ ይሸምቱ ዘንድ ወረዱ፤

verses.text_english: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍን ወንድም ብንያምን ግን ያዕቆብ ከወንድሞቹ ጋር አልሰደደውም። ምናልባት ክፉ እንዳያገኘው ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለእህል ሸመታ ከመጡቱ ጋር ገቡ፤ በከነዓን አገር ራብ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And Joseph the governor over the land, he that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him their faces to the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በምድር ላይ ገዥ ነበረ፥ እርሱም ለምድር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይሸጥ ነበር፤ የዮሴፍም ወንድሞች በመጡ ጊዜ በምድር ላይ በግምባራቸው ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አይቶ አወቃቸው፤ ተለወጠባቸውም፥ ክፉ ቃልንም ተናገራቸው። እናንተ ከወዴት መጣችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። ከከነዓን ምድር እህል ልንሸምት የመጣን ነን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አወቃቸው፥ እነርሱ ግን አላወቁትም፤

verses.text_english: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ስለ እነርሱ አይቶት የነበረውን ሕልም አሰበ። እንዲህም አላቸው። እናንተ ሰላዮች ናችሁ፤ የምድሩን ዕራቁትነት ልታዩ መጥታችኋል።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሉት። ጌታችን ሆይ አይደለም፤ ባሪያዎችህ ስንዴን ሊገዙ መጥተዋል፤

verses.text_english: We all one man's sons; we true , thy servants are no spies.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ሁላችን የአንድ ሰው ልጆች ነን፤ እኛ እውነተኞች ነን፥ ባሪያዎችህስ ሰላዩች አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አላቸው። አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን የአገሩን ዕራቁትነት ልታዩ መጥታችኋል።

verses.text_english: And they said, Thy servants twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest this day with our father, and one not.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሉ። ባሪያዎችህ አሥራ ሁለት ወንድማማች በከነዓን ምድር የአንድ ሰው ልጆች ነን፤ ታናሹም እነሆ ዛሬ ከአባታችን ጋር ነው፥ አንዱም ጠፍቶአል።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto them, That that I spake unto you, saying, Ye spies:
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አላቸው። እናንተ ሰላዮች ናችሁ ብዬ የተናገርኋችሁ ይህ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ትፈተናላችሁ፤ ታናሽ ወንድማችሁ ካልመጣ በቀር የፈርዖንን ሕይወት ከዚህ አትወጡም።

verses.text_english: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye spies.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትን የምትናገሩ ከሆነ ነገራችሁ ይፈተን ዘንድ ከእናንተ አንዱን ስደዱ፥ ወንድማችሁንም ይዞ ይምጣ እናንተም ታሥራችሁ ተቀመጡ፤ ይህ ካልሆነ የፈርዖንን ሕይወት ሰላዮች ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስት ቀን ያህል በግዞት ቤት ጨመራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; I fear God:
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ዮሴፍ እንዲህ አላቸው። ትድኑ ዘንድ ይህን አድርጉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔርን እፈራለሁና።

verses.text_english: If ye true , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የታመናችሁ ከሆናችሁ ከእናንተ አንዱ ወንድማችሁ በግዞታችሁ ቤት ይታሰር እናንተ ግን ሂዱ፥ እህሉንም ለቤታችሁ ራብ ውሰዱ፤

verses.text_english: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
verses.text_amharic: ታናሹንም ወንድማችሁን ወደ እኔ ይዛችሁ ኑ፤ ነገራችሁም የታመነ ይሆናልና አትሞቱም። እንዲህም አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they said one to another, We verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲህ ተባባሉ። በእውነት ወንድማችንን በድለናል፥ እኛን በማማጠን ነፍሱ ስትጨነቅ አይተን አልሰማነውምና፤ ስለዚህ ይህ መከራ መጣብን።

verses.text_english: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤልም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ብላቴናውን አትበድሉ ብያችሁ አልነበረምን? እኔም አልሰማችሁኝም፤ ስለዚህ እነሆ አሁን ደሙ ይፈላለገናል።

verses.text_english: And they knew not that Joseph understood ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዮሴፍ ነገራቸውን እንደሚሰማባቸው አላወቁም፥ በመካከላቸው አስተርጓሚ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ዘወር ብሎ አለቀሰ፤ ደግሞም ወደ እነርሱ ተመልሶ ተናገራቸው፥ ስምዖንንም ከእነርሱ ለይቶ ወሰዶ በፊታቸው አሰረው።

verses.text_english: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ዓይበታቸውን እህል ይሞሉት ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ የእየራሳቸውንም ብር በእየዓይበታቸው ይመልሱት ዘንድ ደግሞም የመንገድ ስንቅ ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ አዘዘ። እንዲሁም ተደረገላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም እህሉን በአህዮቻቸው ላይ ጫኑ፥ ከዚያም ተነሥተው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it in his sack's mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዱ ባደሩበት ስፍራ ለአህያው ገፈራን ይሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይበቱን ሲፈታ ብሩን አየ፥ እነሆም በዓይበቱ አፍ ላይ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, even in my sack: and their heart failed , and they were afraid, saying one to another, What this God hath done unto us?
verses.text_amharic: ለወንድሞቹም። ብሬ ተመለሰችልኝ፥ እርስዋም በዓይበቴ አፍ እነኋት አላቸው። ልባቸውም ደነገጠ፥ እየተንቀጠቀጡም እርስ በርሳቸው ተባባሉ። እግዚአብሔር ያደረገብን ይህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባታቸውም ወደ ያዕቆብ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር መጡ፥ የደረሰባቸውንም ነገር ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው አወሩ።

verses.text_english: The man, the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩ ጌታ የሆነው ሰው በክፉ ንግግር ተናገረን፥ የምድሪቱም ሰላዮች አስመሰለን።

verses.text_english: And we said unto him, We true ; we are no spies:
verses.text_amharic: እኛም እንዲህ አልነው። እውነተኞች ሰዎች ነን እንጂ ሰላዮች አይደለንም፤

verses.text_english: We twelve brethren, sons of our father; one not, and the youngest this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ የአባታችን ልጆች አሥራ ሁለት ወንድማማች ነን፤ አንዱ ጠፍቶአል፥ ታናሹም በከነዓን ምድር ዛሬ ከአባታችን ጋር አለ።

verses.text_english: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye true ; leave one of your brethren with me, and take the famine of your households, and be gone:
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩም ጌታ ያ ሰው እንዲህ አለን። የታመናችሁ ሰዎች ከሆናችሁ በዚህ አውቃለሁ፤ አንደኛውን ወንድማችሁን ከእኔ ጋር ተዉት፥ ለቤታችሁም ራብ እህልን ወስዳችሁ ሂዱ፤

verses.text_english: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye no spies, but ye true will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ታናሹንም ወንድማችሁን አምጡልኝ፥ እውነተኞች እንጂ ሰላዮች አለመሆናችሁንም በዚህ አውቀዋለሁ፤ ወንድማችሁንም እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም በምድሩ ትነግዳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money in his sack: and when they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዓይበታቸውን በፈቱ ጊዜ እነሆ ከእነርሱ እያንዳንዳቸው ብራቸውን በእየዓይበታቸው ተቋጥሮ አገኙት፤ እነርሱም አባታቸውም የብራቸውን ቍጥራት አይተው ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved : Joseph not, and Simeon not, and ye will take Benjamin : all these things are against me.
verses.text_amharic: አባታቸው ያዕቆብም እንዲህ አላቸው። ልጅ አልባ አስቀራችሁኝ፤ ዮሴፍ የለም፥ ስምዖንም የለም፥ ብንያምንም ትወስዱብኛላችሁ፤ ይህ ሁሉ በእኔ ላይ ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤልም አባቱን አለው። ወደ አንተ መልሼ ያላመጣሁት እንደ ሆነ ሁለቱን ልጆቼን ግደል፤ እርሱን በእጄ ስጠኝ፥ እኔም ወደ አንተ እመልሰዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። ልጄ ከእናንተ ጋር አይወርድም፤ ወንድሙ ሞቶ እርሱ ብቻ ቀርቶአልና፤ በምትሄዱበት መንገድ ምናልባት ክፉ ነገር ቢያገኘው ሽምግልናዬን በኅዘን ወደ መቃብር ታወርዱታላችሁ። a

verses.text_english: And the famine sore in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ፤ራብም በምድር ጸና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅም ያመጡትን እህል በልተው ከፈጸሙ በኋላ አባታቸው። እንደ ገና ሂዱ፤ ጥቂት እህል ሸምቱልን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother with you.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም እንዲህ አለው። ያ ሰው። ወንድማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ካልሆነ ፊቴን አታዩም ብሎ በብርቱ ቃል አስጠነቀቀን።

verses.text_english: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
verses.text_amharic: ወንድማችንን ከእኛ ጋር ብትሰድደው እንወርዳለን፥ እህልም እንሸምትልሃለን፤

verses.text_english: But if thou wilt not send , we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother with you.
verses.text_amharic: ባትሰድደው ግን አንሄድም፤ ያ ሰው። ወንድማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ካልሆነ ፊቴን አታዩም ብሎናልና።

verses.text_english: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye ill with me, to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም አላቸው። ለምን በደላችሁኝ? ለዚያውስ። ሌላ ወንድም አለን ብላችሁ ለምን ነገራችሁት?

verses.text_english: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, your father yet alive? have ye brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሉ። ያ ሰው ስለ እኛና ስለ ወገናችን ፈጽሞ ጠየቀን እንዲህም አለን። አባታችሁ ገና በሕይወት ነው? ወንድምስ አላችሁን? እኛም እንደዚሁ እንደ ጥያቄው መለስንለት፤ በውኑ። ወንድማችሁን አምጡ እንዲለን እናውቅ ነበርነን?

verses.text_english: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, also our little ones.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም አባቱን እስራኤልን አለው። እኛና አንተ ልጆቻችንም ደግሞ እንድንድን እንዳንሞትም ብላቴናውን ከእኔ ጋር ስደደው፥ እኛም ተነሥተን እንሄዳለን።

verses.text_english: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ስለ እርሱ እዋሳለሁ ከእጄ ትሻዋለህ፤ ወደ አንተ ባላመጣው፥ በፊትህም ባላቆመው፥ በዘመናት ሁሉ አንተን የበደልሁ ልሁን።

verses.text_english: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
verses.text_amharic: ባንዘገይስ ኖሮ አሁን ሁለተኛ ጊዜ በተመለስን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And their father Israel said unto them, If so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም አባታቸው እንዲህ አላቸው። ነገሩ እንዲህ ከሆነስ ይህንን አድርጉ፤ ከተመሰገነው ከምድሩ ፍሬ በዓይበታችሁ ይዛችሁ ሂዱ፥ ለዚያም ሰው እጅ መንሻ፥ ጥቂት በለሳን፥ ጥቂት ማር፥ ሽቱ፥ ከርቤ፥ ተምር፥ ለውዝ ውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry again in your hand; peradventure it an oversight:
verses.text_amharic: ብሩን በአጠፌታ አድርጋችሁ በእጃችሁ ውሰዱ፤ በዓይበታችሁ አፍ የተመለሰውንም ብር መልሳችሁ ውሰዱ፤ ምናልባት በስሕተት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.text_amharic: ወንድማችሁንም ውሰዱ፥ ተነሥታችሁም ወደዚያ ሰው ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved , I am bereaved.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክም ሌላውን ወንድማችሁንና ብንያምን ከእናንተ ጋር ይሰድድ ዘንድ በዚያ ሰው ፊት ምሕረትን ይስጣችሁ፤ እኔም ልጆቼን እንዳጣሁ አጣሁ።

verses.text_english: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም በእጃቸው ያችን እጅ መንሻና አጠፌታውን ብር ብንያምንም ወሰዱ፤ ተነሥተውም ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፥ በዮሴፍም ፊት ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring men home, and slay, and make ready; for men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ብንያምን ከእነርሱ ጋር ባየው ጊዜ የቤቱን አዛዥ እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። እነዚያን ሰዎች ወደ ቤት አስገባቸው፥ እርድም እረድ አዘጋጅም፥ እነዚያ ሰዎች በእኩለ ቀን ከእኔ ጋር ይበላሉና።

verses.text_english: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ሰውም ዮሴፍ እንዳለው አደረገ፤ ያ ሰውም ሰዎቹን ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት አስገባ።

verses.text_english: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት ስለ ገቡ ፈሩ፤ እንዲህም አሉ። በዓይበታችን ቀድሞ ስለ ተመለሰው ብር ሊተነኰልብን ሊወድቅብንም፥ እኛንም በባርነት ሊገዛ አህዮቻችንንም ሊወስድ ወደዚህ አስገባን።

verses.text_english: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት አዛዥም ቀረቡ፥ በቤቱም ደጅ ተናገሩት፥

verses.text_english: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አሉት። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ቀድሞ እህልን ልንሸምት ወርደን ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, man's money in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
verses.text_amharic: ወደምናድርበትም ስፍራ በደረስን ጊዜ ዓይበታችንን ከፈትን፥ እነሆም፥ የእያንዳንዱ ሰው ብር በየዓይበቱ አፍ እንደ ሚዛኑ ብራችን ነበረ፤ አሁንም በእጃችን መለስነው።

verses.text_english: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
verses.text_amharic: እህል እንሸምትበት ዘንድ ሌላም ብር በእጃችን አመጣን፤ ብራችንንም በዓይበታችን ማን እንደ ጨመረው አናውቅም።

verses.text_english: And he said, Peace to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አላቸው። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን፥ አትፍሩ፤ አምላካችሁና የአባታችሁ አምላክ በዓይበታችሁ የተሰወረ ገንዘብ ሰጣችሁ፤ ብራችሁስ ደርሶኛል።

verses.text_english: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖንንም አወጣላቸው። ሰውዮውም እነዚያን ስዎች ወደ ዮሴፍ ቤት አስገባቸው፤ ውኃ አመጣላቸው፥ እግራቸውንም ታጠቡ፤ ለአህዮቻቸው አበቅ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በእኩለ ቀን እስኪገባ ድረስ እነርሱ እጅ መንሻቸውን አዘጋጁ፥ ከዚያ እንጀራን እንደሚበሉ ሰምተዋልና።

verses.text_english: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወደ ቤቱ በገባ ጊዜ በእጃቸው ያለውን እጅ መንሻ በቤት ውስጥ አቀረቡለት፥ ወደ ምድርም ወድቀው ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And he asked them of welfare, and said, your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? he yet alive?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ደኅንነታቸውን ጠየቃቸው፥ እንዲህም አለ። የነገራችሁኝ ሽማግሌ አባታችሁ ደኅና ነውን? ገና በሕይወት አለን?

verses.text_english: And they answered, Thy servant our father in good health, he yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሉት። ባሪያህ አባታችን ደኅና ነው፤ ገና በሕይወት አለ። አጐንብሰውም ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ የእናቱን ልጅ ብንያምን አየው፥ እርሱም አለ። የነገራችሁኝ ታናሽ ወንድማችሁ ይህ ነውን? እንዲህም አለው። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought to weep; and he entered into chamber, and wept there.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ቸኮለ፥ አንጀቱ ወንድሙን ናፍቆታልና፤ ሊያለቅስም ወደደ፤ ወደ እልፍኙም ገብቶ ከዚያ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.text_amharic: ፊቱንም ታጥቦ ወጣ፥ ልቡንም አስታግሦ። እንጀራ አቅርቡ አለ።

verses.text_english: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም ለብቻው አቀረቡ፥ ለእነርሱም ለብቻቸው፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ለሚበሉት ለግብፅ ሰዎችም ለብቻቸው፤ የግብፅ ሰዎች ከዕብራውያን ጋር መብላት አይሆንላቸውምና፥ ይህ ለግብፅ ሰዎች እንደ መርከስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱም በኵሩ እንደ ታላቅነቱ ታናሹም እንደ ታናሽነቱ ተቀመጡ፤ ሰዎቹም እርስ በርሳቸው ተደነቁ።

verses.text_english: And he took messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱም ካለው መብል ፈንታቸውን አቀረበላቸው፤ የብንያምም ፈንታ ከሁሉ አምስት እጅ የሚበልጥ ነበረ። እነርሱም ጠጡ ከእርሱም ጋር ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም የቤቱን አዛዥ እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ። ዓይበታቸው የሚያነሣውን ያህል እህል ሙላላቸው፥ የሁሉንም ብር በየዓይበታቸው አፍ ጨምረው፤

verses.text_english: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.text_amharic: በታናሹም ዓይበት አፍ የብሩን ጽዋዬንና የእህሉን ዋጋ ጨምረው። እርሱም ዮሴፍ እንዳለው አደረገ።

verses.text_english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.text_amharic: ነግህ በሆነ ጊዜም ሰዎቹ አህዮቻቸውን ይዘው ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተሰናበቱ።

verses.text_english: when they were gone out of the city, not far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማይቱም ወጥተው ገና ሳይርቁ ዮሴፍ ለቤቱ አዛዥ እንዲህ አለ። ተነሥተህ ሰዎቹን ተከተላቸው፤ በደረስህባቸውም ጊዜ እንዲህ በላቸው። በመልካሙ ፋንታ ስለ ምን ክፉን መለሳችሁ?

verses.text_english: not this in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ የሚጠጣበት ምሥጢርንም የሚያውቅበት ጽዋ አይደለምን? ባደረጋችሁት ነገር በደላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ደርሰባቸው ይህንም ቃል ነገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሉት። ጌታዬ እንደዚህ ያለውን ቃል ለምን ይናገራል? ባሪያዎችህ ይህን ነገር የሚያደርጉ አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዓይበታችን አፍ ያገኘነውን ብር ይዘን ከከነዓን አገር ወደ አንተ ተመልሰናል፤ ከጌታህ ቤት ወርቅ ወይስ ብር እንዴት እንሰርቃለን?

verses.text_english: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሪያዎችህ ጽዋው የተገኘበት እርሱ ይሙት፤ እኛም ደግሞ ለጌታችን ባሪያዎች እንሁን።

verses.text_english: And he said, Now also it according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። አሁንም እንዲሁ እንደ ነገራችሁ ይሁን፤ ጽዋው የተገኘበት እርሱ ለእኔ ባሪያ ይሁነኝ፥ እናንተም ንጹሐን ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.text_amharic: እየራሳቸውም ፈጥነው ዓይበታቸውን ወደ ምድር አወረዱ፥ እየራሳቸውም ዓይበታቸውን ፈቱ።

verses.text_english: And he searched, began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ከታላቁ ጀምሮ እስከ ታናሹ ድረስ በረበራቸው፥ ጽዋውንም በብንያም ዓይበት ውስጥ አገኘው።

verses.text_english: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሳቸውንም ቀደዱ፥ ዓይበታቸውንም በየአህዮቻቸው ጭነው ወደ ከተማይቱ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ወደ ዮሴፍ ገባ፥ እርሱም ገና ከዚያው ነበረ፤ በፊቱም በምድር ላይ ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto them, What deed this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም። ይህ ያደረጋችሁት ነገር ምንድር ነው? እንደ እኔ ያለ ሰው ምሥጢርን እንዲያውቅ አታውቁምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we my lord's servants, both we, and also with whom the cup is found.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም አለ። ለጌታዬ ምን እንመልሳለን? ምንስ እንናገራለን? ወይስ በምን እንነጻለን? እግዚአብሔር የባሪያዎችህን ኃጢአት ገለጠ፤ እነሆ፥ እኛም ጽዋው ከእርሱ ዘንድ የተገኘበቱም ደግሞ ለጌታዬ ባሪያዎቹ ነን።

verses.text_english: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እላቸው። ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ አይሆንልኝም፤ ጽዋው የተገኘበቱ ሰው እርሱ ባሪያ ይሁነኝ፤ እናንተም ወደ አባታችሁ በደኅና ውጡ።

verses.text_english: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou even as Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ወደ እርሱ ቀረበ እንዲህም አለ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እኔ ባርያህ በጌታዬ ጆሮ አንዲት ቃልን እንድናገር እለምናለሁ፤ እኔንም ባሪያህን አትቆጣኝ፤ አንተ እንደ ፈርዖን ነህና።

verses.text_english: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ ባሪያዎቹን። አባት አላችሁን ወይስ ወንድም? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም ለጌታዬ እንዲህ አልነ። ሸማግሌ አባት አለን፥ በሽምግልናው የወለደውም ታናሽ ብላቴና አለ፤ ወንድሙም ሞተ፥ ከእናቱም እርሱ ብቻውን ቀረ፥ አባቱም ይወድደዋል።

verses.text_english: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ለባሪያዎችህ። ወደ እኔ አምጡት፥ እኔም አየዋለሁ አልህ።

verses.text_english: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for he should leave his father, would die.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬንም። ብላቴናው አባቱን መተው አይሆንለትም፤ የተወው እንደ ሆነ አባቱ ይሞታልና አልነው።

verses.text_english: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.text_amharic: ባርያዎችህንም። ታናሽ ወንድማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ካልመጣ ዳግመኛ ፊቴን አታዩም አልኽን።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባርያህ ወደ አባታችን በተመለስን ጊዜም የጌታዬን ቃል ነገርነው።

verses.text_english: And our father said, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችንም። ተመልሳችሁ ጥቂት እህል ሸምቱልን አለ።

verses.text_english: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother with us.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም አልነው። እንሄድ ዘንድ አይሆንልንም፤ ታናሹ ወንድማችን ከእኛ ጋር ይወርድ እንደ ሆነ እኛም እንወርዳለን፤ ታናሹ ወንድማችን ከእኛ ጋር ከሌለ የዚያን ሰው ፊት ማየት አይቻለንምና።

verses.text_english: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two :
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ አባቴም እንዲህ አለን። ሚስቴ ሁለት ወንዶች ልጆችን እንደ ወለደችልኝ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ከእኔ ወጣ። አውሬ በላው አላችሁኝ፥ እስከ ዛሬም አላየሁትም፤

verses.text_english: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ከእኔ ለይታችሁ ደግሞ ብትወስዱት ክፋም ቢያገኘው፥ ሽበቴን በኅዘን ወደ መቃብር ታወርዱታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እኔ ወደ አባቴ ወደ ባሪያህ ብሄድ፥ ብላቴናውም ከእኛ ጋር ከሌለ፥ ነፍሱ በብላቴናው ነፍስ ታስራለችና ብላቴናው ከእኛ ጋር እንደሌለ ባየ ጊዜ ይሞታል፤

verses.text_english: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad not , that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎችህም የባሪያህን የአባታችንን ሽበት በኅዘን ወደ መቃብር ያወርዳሉ።

verses.text_english: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሪያህ በአባቴ ዘንድ ስለ ብላቴናው እንዲህ ብዬ ተውሼአለሁና። እርሱንስ ወደ አንተ ባላመጣው በአባቴ ዘንድ በዘመናት ሁሉ ኃጢአተኛ እሆናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እኔ ባሪያህ በጌታዬ ዘንድ ባሪያ ሆኜ በብላቴናው ፋንታ ልቀመጥ፤ ብላቴናውም ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ይውጣ።

verses.text_english: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.text_amharic: አለዚያም ብላቴናው ከእኔ ጋር ከሌለ ወደ አባቴ እንዴት እወጣለሁ? አባቴን የሚያገኘውን መከራ እንዳላይ። a

verses.text_english: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በእርሱ ዘንድ ቆመው ባሉት ሰዎች ሁሉ ፊት ሊታገሥ አልተቻለውም። ሰዎቹንም ሁሉ ከፊቴ አስወጡልኝ ብሎ ጮኾ ተናገረ፤ ዮሴፍ ለወንድሞቹ ራሱን በገለጠ ጊዜ በእርሱ ዘንድ የቆመ ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
