verses.text_amharic: ቃሉንም ከፍ አድርጎ አለቀሰ፤ የግብፅ ሰዎችም ሰሙ፥ በፈርዖን ቤትም ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ለወንድሞቹ። እኔ ዮሴፍ ነኝ፤ አባቴ እስከ አሁን በሕይወቱ ነውን? አለ። ወንድሞቹም ይመልሱለት ዘንድ አልቻሉም፥ በፊቱ ደንግጠው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን። ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ አለ። ወደ እርሱም ቀረቡ። እንዲህም አላቸው። ወደ ግብፅ የሸጣችሁኝ እኔ ወንድማችሁ ዮሴፍ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ወደዚህ ስለ ሸጣችሁኝ አትዘኑ፥ አትቈርቈሩም፤ እግዚአብሔር ሕይወትን ለማዳን ከእናንተ በፊት ሰድዶኛልና።

verses.text_english: For these two years the famine in the land: and yet five years, in the which neither earing nor harvest.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሁለቱ ዓመት በምድር ላይ ራብ የሆነበት ነውና፤ የማይታረስበትና የማይታጨድበት አምስት ዓመት ገና ቀረ።

verses.text_english: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ላይ ቅሬታን አስቀርላችሁ ዘንድ በታላቅ መድኃኒትም አድናችሁ ዘንድ ከእናንተ በፊት ላከኝ።

verses.text_english: So now not you sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እናንተ ወደዚህ የላካችሁኝ አይደላችሁም፥ እግዚአብሔር ላከኝ እንጂ፤ ለፈርዖንም እንደ አባት አደረገኝ፥ በቤቱም ሁሉ ላይ ጌታ፥ በግብፅ ምድርም ሁሉ ላይ አለቃ አደረገኝ።

verses.text_english: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ፈጥናችሁ ወደ አባቴ ውጡ፥ እንዲህም በሉት። ልጅህ ዮሴፍ የሚለው ነገር ይህ ነው። እግዚአብሔር በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጌታ አደረገኝ፤ ወደ እኔ ና፥ አትዘግይ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.text_amharic: በጌሤምም ምድር ትቀመጣለህ፥ ወደ እኔም ትቀርባለህ፥ አንተና ልጆችህ የልጆችህም ልጆች፥ በጎችህና ላሞችህ ከብትህም ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: And there will I nourish thee; for yet five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም አንተና የቤትህ ሰዎች የአንተ የሆነው ሁሉ እንዳትቸገሩ እመግብሃለሁ የራቡ ዘመን ገና አምስት ዓመት ቀርቶአልና።

verses.text_english: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም ለእናንተ የተናገረቻችሁ የእኔ አፍ እንደ ሆነች የእናንተ ዓይኖች አይተዋል፥ የወንድሜ የብንያምም ዓይኖች አይተዋል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቴም በግብፅ ምድር ያለኝን ክብሬን ሁሉ ያያችሁትንም ሁሉ ንገሩት፤ አባቴንም ወደዚህ ፈጥናችሁ አምጡት።

verses.text_english: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.text_amharic: የወንድሙን የብንያምንም አንገት አቅፎ አለቀሰ፤ ብንያምም በአንገቱ ላይ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ ሳማቸው፥ በእነርሱም ላይ አለቀሰ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወንድሞቹ ከእርሱ ጋር ተጫወቱ።

verses.text_english: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.text_amharic: በፈርዖንም ቤት። የዮሴፍ ወንድሞች መጡ ተብሎ ወሬ ተሰማ፤ በዚያውም ፈርዖንና ሎላልቱ ደስ ተሰኙበት።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን አለው። ለወንድሞችህ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ይህን አድርጉ፤ ከብቶቻችሁን ጭናችሁ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ሂዱ፤

verses.text_english: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችሁንና ቤተሰቦቻችሁን ይዛችሁም ወደ እኔ ኑ፤ እኔም የግብፅን ምድር በረከት ሁሉ እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ የምድሪቱንም ስብ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ወንድሞችህን። እንዲህ አድርጉ በላቸው፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ለሕፃናቶቻችሁ ለሴቶቻችሁም ሰረገሎችን ውሰዱ፥ አባታችሁንም ይዛችሁ ኑ፤

verses.text_english: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt yours.
verses.text_amharic: ለዕቃችሁም ሁሉ አታስቡ፥ የግብፅ በረከት ሁሉ ለእናንተ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆችም እንደዚሁ አደረጉ፤ ዮሴፍም በፈርዖን ትእዛዝ ሰረገሎችንና ለመንገድ ስንቅ ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.text_amharic: ለሁሉም ሁለት ሁለት መለወጫ ልብስ ሰጣቸው፥ ለብንያም ግን ሦስት መቶ ብርና አምስት መለወጫ ልብስ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And to his father he sent after this ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቱም እንደዚሁ ሰደደ፥ የግብፅን በረከት የተሸከሙ አሥር አህዮችን፥ ደግሞም በመንገድ ለአባቱ ስንቅ ስንዴና እንጀራ የተሸከሙ አሥር ሴቶች አህዮችን።

verses.text_english: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አሰናበታቸው፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። በመንገድ እርስ በርሳችሁ አትጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሄዱ፥ ከግብፅ አገርም ወጡ፥ ወደ ከነዓንም ምድር ከአባታቸው ከያዕቆብ ዘንድ ደረሱ።

verses.text_english: And told him, saying, Joseph yet alive, and he governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ብለው ነገሩት። ዮሴፍ ገና በሕይወቱ ነው፥ እርሱም በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ገዥ ሆኖአል። ያዕቆብም ልቡ ደነገጠ፥ አላመናቸውም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዮሴፍ የነገራቸውን ነገር ሁሉ ነገሩት፤ እርሱን ያነሡት ዘንድ ዮሴፍ የሰደዳቸውን ሰረገሎች ባየ ጊዜ የአባታቸው የያዕቆብ የነፍሱ ሕይወት ታደሰች።

verses.text_english: And Israel said, enough; Joseph my son yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም። ልጄ ዮሴፍ ገና በሕይወት ከሆነ ይበቃኛል፤ ሳልሞት እንዳየው እሄዳለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ለእርሱ ያለውን ሁሉ ይዞ ተነሣ፥ ወደ ቤርሳቤህ መጣ፥ መሥዋዕትንም ለአባቱ ለይስሐቅ አምላክ ሠዋ።

verses.text_english: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here I.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሌሊት ራእይ። ያዕቆብ ያዕቆብ ብሎ ለእስራኤል ተናገረው። እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, I God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.text_amharic: አለውም። የአባቶችህ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፤ ወደ ግብፅ መውረድ አትፍራ፥ በዚያ ትልቅ ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁና።

verses.text_english: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ወደ ግብፅ አብሬህ እወርዳለሁ፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ እኔ አወጣሃለሁ፤ ዮሴፍም እጁን በዓይንህ ላይ ያኖራል።

verses.text_english: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ከቤርሳቤህ ተነሣ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያዕቆብን ይወስዱ ዘንድ ፈርዖን በሰደዳቸው ሰረገሎች አባታቸውን ያዕቆብንና ሕፃናቶቻቸውን ሴቶቻቸውንም ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶቻቸውንም በከነዓን አገርም ያገኙትን ከብታቸውን ሁሉ ይዘው ያዕቆብና ዘሩ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ መጡ፤

verses.text_english: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶች ልጆቹንና የልጆቹን ወንዶች ልጆች፥ ሴቶች ልጆቹንና የወንዶች ልጆቹን ሴቶች ልጆች፥ ዘሩንም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ አስገባቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ግብፅም የገቡት የእስራኤል ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፥ ያዕቆብና ልጆቹ፤ የያዕቆብ በኵር ሮቤል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.text_amharic: የሮቤልም ልጆች፤ ሄኖኅ፥ ፈሉሶ፥ አስሮን፥ ከርሚ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.text_amharic: የስሞዖን ልጆች፤ ይሙኤል፥ ያሚን፥ ኦሃድ፥ ያኪን፥ ጾሐር፥ የከነዓናዊት ልጅ ሳኡል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊም ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ልጆች፤ ዔር፥ አውናን፥ ሴሎም፥ ፋሬስ፥ ዛራ፤ ዔርና አውናን በከነዓን ምድር ሞቱ፤ የፋሬስም ልጆች ኤስሮም፥ ሐሙል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.text_amharic: የይሳኮርም ልጆች፤ ቶላ፥ ፉዋ፥ ዮብ፥ ሺምሮን።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.text_amharic: የዛብሎንም ልጆች፤ ሴሬድ፥ ኤሎን፥ ያሕልኤል።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters thirty and three.
verses.text_amharic: ልያ በመስጴጦምያ በሶርያ ለያዕቆብ የወለደቻቸው ልጆችና ሴቲቱ ልጅዋ ዲና እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ወንዶችም ሴቶችም ልጆችዋ ሁሉ ሠላሳ ሦስት ነፍስ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.text_amharic: የጋድም ልጆች ጽፎን፥ ሐጊ፥ ሹኒ፥ ኤስቦን፥ ዔሪ፥ አሮዲ፥ አርኤሊ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.text_amharic: የአሴርም ልጆች፤ ዪምና፥ የሱዋ፥ የሱዊ፥ በሪዓ፥ እኅታቸው ሤራሕ፤ የበሪዓ ልጆችም፤ ሔቤር፥ መልኪኤል።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, sixteen souls.
verses.text_amharic: ላባ ለልጁ ለልያ የሰጣት የዘለፋ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህን አሥራ ስድስቱንም ነፍስ ለያዕቆብ ወለደች።

verses.text_english: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ ሚስት የራሔል ልጆች ዮሴፍና ብንያም ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ለዮሴፍም በግብፅ ምድር ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ተወለዱለት፤ የሄልዮቱ ከተማ ካህን የጶጥፌራ ልጅ አስናት የወለደቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Benjamin Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.text_amharic: የብንያምም ልጆች፤ ቤላ፥ ቤኬር፥ አስቤል፤ የቤላ ልጆችም፤ ጌራ፥ ናዕማን፥ አኪ፥ ሮስ፥ ማንፌን፥ ሑፊም፤ ጌራም አርድን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls fourteen.
verses.text_amharic: ለያዕቆብ የተወለዱለት የራሔልም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሁሉም አሥራ አራት ነፍስ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.text_amharic: የዳንም ልጆች፤ ሑሺም።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.text_amharic: የንፍታሌምም ልጆች፤ ያሕጽኤል፥ ጉኒ፥ ዬጽር፥ ሺሌም።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls seven.
verses.text_amharic: ላባ ለልጁ ለራሔል የሰጣት የባላ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህንም ለያዕቆብ ወለደችለት፤ ሁሉም ሰባት ነፍስ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls threescore and six;
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ የገቡት ሰዎች ሁሉ ከጉልበቱ የወጡት፥ ከልጆቹ ሚስቶች ሌላ፥ ሁላቸው ስድሳ ስድስት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, threescore and ten.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድር የተወለዱለት የዮሴፍም ልጆች ሁለት ናቸው፤ ወደ ግብፅ የገቡት የያዕቆብ ቤተ ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰባ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳንም በጌሤም እንዲቀበለው በፊቱ ወደ ዮሴፍ ላከ፤ ወደ ጌሤም ምድርም ደረሱ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ሰረገላውን አዘጋጀ፥ አባቱንም እስራኤልን ሊገናኘው ወደ ጌሤም ወጣ፤ ባየውም ጊዜ በአንገቱ ላይ ወደቀ፥ አቅፎትም ረጅም ጊዜ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou yet alive.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። አንተ ገና በሕይወት ሳለህ ፊትህን አይቼአለሁና አሁን ልሙት አለው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹንና የአባቱን ቤተ ሰዎች እንዲህ አላቸው። እኔ መጥቼ ለፈርዖን እንዲህ ብዬ እነግረዋለሁ። በከነዓን ምድር የነበሩት ወንድሞቼና የአባቴ ቤተ ሰዎች ወደ እኔ መጥተዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the men shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በግ የሚጠብቁ ሰዎች ናቸው፥ እንስሳ ያረቡ ነበርና፤ በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ያላቸውንም ሁሉ አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What your occupation?
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ቢጠራችሁ። ተግባራችሁስ ምንድር ነው? ቢላችሁ፥

verses.text_english: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd an abomination unto the Egyptians.

Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they in the land of Goshen.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ገባ ለፈርዖንም ነገረው እንዲህ ብሎ። አባቴና ወንድሞቼ በጎቻቸውም ላሞቻቸውም ያላቸውም ሁሉ ከከነዓን ምድር ወጡ፤ እነርሱም እነሆ በጌሤም ምድር ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And he took some of his brethren, five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንድሞቹም አምስት ሰዎችን ወስዶ በፈርዖን ፊት አቆማቸው።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants shepherds, both we, also our fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ወንድሞቹን። ሥራችሁ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱም ፈርዖንን። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ፥ እኛም አባቶቻችንም፥ በግ አርቢዎች ነን አሉት።

verses.text_english: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንንም እንዲህ አሉት። በምድር ልንቀመጥ በእንግድነት መጣን፥ የባርያዎችህ በጎች የሚሰማሩበት ስፍራ የለምና፤ ራብ በከነዓን ምድር እጅግ ጸንቶአልና፤ አሁንም ባሪያዎችህ በጌሤም ምድር እንድንቀመጥ እንለምንሃለን።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዮሴፍን ተናገረው እንዲህ ብሎ። አባትህና ወንድሞችህ መጥተውልሃል፤

verses.text_english: The land of Egypt before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅ ምድር በፊትህ ናት፤ በመልካሙ ምድር አባትህንና ወንድሞችህን አኑራቸው፤ በጌሤም ምድር ይኑሩ፤ ከእነርሱም ውስጥ እውቀት ያላቸውን ሰዎች ታውቅ እንደ ሆነ በእንስሶቼ ላይ አለቆች አድርጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ያዕቆብን አባቱን አስገብቶ በፈርዖን ፊት አቆመው፤ ያዕቆብም ፈርዖንን ባረከው።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old thou?
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ያዕቆብን። የዕድሜህ ዘመን ስንት ዓመት ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ለፈርዖን አለው። የእንግድነቴ ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ነው፤ የሕይወቴ ዘመኖች ጥቂትም ክፉም ሆኑብኝ፥ አባቶቼ በእንግድነት የተቀመጡበትንም ዘመን አያህሉም።

verses.text_english: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ፈርዖንን ባረከው ከፈርዖንም ፊት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አባቱንና ወንድሞቹን አኖረ፥ ፈርዖን እንዳዘዘም በግብፅ ምድር በተሻለችው በራምሴ ምድር ጉልትን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to families.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ለአባቱና ለወንድሞቹ ለአባቱም ቤተ ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ ልጆቻቸው መጠን እህል ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And no bread in all the land; for the famine very sore, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ሁሉ እህል አልነበረም፥ ራብ እጅግ ጸንቶአልና፤ ከራብም የተነሣ የግብፅ ምድርና የከነዓን ምድር ተጎዳ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ከግብፅ ምድርና ከከነዓን ምድር በእህል ሸመት የተገኘውን ብሩን ሁሉ አከማቸ፤ ዮሴፍም ብሩን ወደ ፈርዖን ቤት አስገባው።

verses.text_english: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
verses.text_amharic: ብሩም በግብፅ ምድርና በከነዓን ምድር አለቀ፤ የግብፅ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ወደ ዮሴፍ መጡ እንዲህ ሲሉ። እንጀራ ስጠን፤ ስለ ምን በፊትህ እንሞታለን? ብሩ አልቆብናልና።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም። ከብቶቻችሁን አምጡልኝ፤ ብር ካለቀባችሁ በከብቶቻችሁ ፋንታ እህል እሰጣችኋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
verses.text_amharic: ከብቶቻቸውንም ወደ ዮሴፍ አመጡ፥ ዮሴፍም በፈረሶቻቸው በበጎቻቸውም በላሞቻቸውም በአህዮቻቸውም ፋንታ እህልን ሰጣቸው፤ በዚያች ዓመትም ስለ ከብቶቻቸው ሁሉ ፋንታ እህልን መገባቸው።

verses.text_english: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.text_amharic: ዓመቱም ተፈጸመ፤ በሁለተኛውም ዓመት ወደ እርሱ መጥተው እንዲህ አሉት። እኛ ከጌታችን አንሰውርም፤ ብሩ በፍጹም አለቀ፥ ከብታችንም ከጌታችን ጋር ነው፤ ከሰውነታችንና ከምድራችን በቀር በጌታችን ፊት አንዳች የቀረ የለም፤

verses.text_english: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ በፊትህ ስለ ምን እንሞታለን? ምድራችንስ ስለ ምን ትጠፋለች? እኛንም ምድራችንንም በእህል ግዛን፥ እኛም ለፈርዖን ባሪያዎች እንሁን፥ ምድራችንም ለእርሱ ትሁን፤ እኛ እንድንድን እንዳንሞትም ምድራችንም እንዳትጠፋ ዘር ስጠን።

verses.text_english: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም የግብፅን ምድር ሁሉ ለፈርዖን ገዛ፥ የግብፅ ሰዎች ሁሉ ራብ ስለ ጸናባቸው ርስታቸውን ሸጠዋልና፤ ምድሪቱ ለፈርዖን ሆነች።

verses.text_english: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from end of the borders of Egypt even to the end thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ከግብፅ ዳርቻ አንሥቶ እስከ ሌላው ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ባሪያዎች አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናትን ምድር ብቻ አልገዛም፥ ካህናቱ ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ድርጎ ያገኙ ነበርና፥ ፈርዖንም የሰጣቸውን ድርጎ ይበሉ ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ምድራቸውን አልሸጡም።

verses.text_english: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አለ። እነሆ ዛሬ እናንተንና ምድራችሁን ለፈርዖን ገዝቻችኋለሁ፤ ዘር ውሰዱና ምድሪቱን ዝሩ፤

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.text_amharic: በመከርም ጊዜ ፍሬውን ከአምስት እጅ አንዱን እጅ ለፈርዖን ስጡ፤ አራቱም እጅ ለእናንተ ለራሳችሁ፥ ለእርሻው ዘርና ለእናንተ ምግብ፥ ለቤተ ሰዋችሁና ለሕፃናቶቻችሁም ሲሳይ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አንተ አዳነኸን፤ በጌታችን ፊት ሞገስን አናግኝ፥ ለፈርዖንም ባሪያዎች እንሆናለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, Pharaoh should have the fifth ; except the land of the priests only, became not Pharaoh's.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ለፈርዖን ካልሆነችው ከካህናቱ ምድር በቀር አምስተኛው እጅ ለፈርዖን እንዲሆን በግብፅ ምድር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሕግ አደረጋት።

verses.text_english: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በግብፅ ምድር በጌሤም አገር ተቀመጠ፤ ገዙአትም፥ ረቡ፥ እጅግም በዙ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም በግብፅ ምድር አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ተቀመጠ፤ የያዕቆብም ሙላው የሕይወቱ ዘመን መቶ አርባ ሰባት ዓመት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም የሞቱ ቀን ቀረበ፤ ልጁን ዮሴፍንም ጠርቶ እንዲህ አለው። በፊትህ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ እጅህን ከጭኔ በታች አድርግ፥ በግብፅ ምድርም እንዳትቀብረኝ ምሕረትንና እውነትን አድርግልኝ፤

verses.text_english: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቶቼም ጋር በተኛሁ ጊዜ ከግብፅ ምድር አውጥተህ ትወስደኛለህ፥ በመቃብራቸውም ትቀብረኛለህ። እርሱም። እንደ ቃልህ አደርጋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ማልልኝ አለው። ዮሴፍም ማለለት፤ እስራኤልም በአልጋው ራስ ላይ ሰገደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after these things, that told Joseph, Behold, thy father sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ነገር በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ እነሆ አባትህ ታምሞአል ብለው ለዮሴፍ ነገሩት፤ እርሱም ሁለቱን ልጆቹን ምናሴንና ኤፍሬምን ይዞ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.text_amharic: ለያዕቆብም። እነሆ ልጅህ ዮሴፍ መጥቶልሃል ብለው ነገሩት፤ እስራኤልም ተጠነካከረ፥ በአልጋውም ላይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ዮሴፍን አለው። ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ በከነዓን ምድር በሎዛ ተገለጠልኝ፥ ባረከኝም

verses.text_english: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee an everlasting possession.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለኝ። እነሆ ፍሬያማ አደርግሃለሁ፥ አበዛሃለሁም፥ ለብዙም ሕዝብ ጉባኤ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ይህችንም ምድር ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘላለም ርስት ለዘርህ እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እኔ ወደ አንተ ከመምጣቴ በፊት በግብፅ ምድር የተወለዱልህ ሁለቱ ልጆችህ ለእኔ ይሁኑ፤ ኤፍሬምና ምናሴ ለእኔ እንደ ሮቤልና እንደ ስምዖን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በኋላ የምትወልዳቸው ልጆች ለአንተ ይሁኑ፤ በርስታቸው በወንድሞቻቸው ስም ይጠሩ።

verses.text_english: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same Bethlehem.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከመስጴጦምያ በመጣሁ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ኤፍራታ ለመግባት ጥቂት ቀርቶኝ በመንገድ ሳለሁ፥ ራሔል በከነዓን ምድር ሞተችብኝ፤ በዚያም በኤፍራታ መንገድ ላይ፥ እርስዋም ቤተ ልሔም ናት፥ ቀበርኋት።

verses.text_english: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who these?
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም የዮሴፍን ልጆች አይቶ። እነዚህ እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto his father, They my sons, whom God hath given me in this . And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ለአባቱ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህ የሰጠኝ ልጆቼ ናቸው አለ። እርሱም። እባርካቸው ዘንድ ወደዚህ አቅርብልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ዓይኖች ከሽምግልና የተነሣ ከብደው ነበር፥ ማየትም አይችልም ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም አቀረባቸው፥ ሳማቸውም፥ አቀፋቸውም።

verses.text_english: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። ፊትህን አያለሁ ብዬ አላሰብሁም ነበር፤ እነሆም እግዚአብሔር ዘርህን ደግሞ አሳየኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ከጕልበቱ ፈቀቅ አደረጋቸው፥ ወደ ምድርም በግምባሩ ሰገደ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought near unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ሁለቱን ልጆቹን ወሰደ፥ ኤፍሬምንም በቀኙ በእስራኤል ግራ፥ ምናሴንም በግራው በእስራኤል ቀኝ አደረገው፥ ወደ እርሱም አቀረባቸው።

verses.text_english: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid upon Ephraim's head, who the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh the firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ቀኝ እጁን ዘርግቶ በኤፍሬም ራስ ላይ አኖረው፥ እርሱም ታናሽ ነበረ፥ ግራውንም በምናሴ ራስ ላይ አኖረ፤ እጆቹንም አስተላለፈ፥ ምናሴ በኵር ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ዮሴፍን ባረከ እንዲህም አለ። አባቶቼ አብርሃምና ይስሐቅ በፊቱ የሄዱለት እርሱ እግዚአብሔር፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እኔን የመገበኝ እግዚአብሔር፥

verses.text_english: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ያዳነኝ መልአክ፥ እርሱ እነዚህን ብላቴኖች ይባርክ፤ ስሜም የአባቶቼ የአብርሃምና የይስሐቅም ስም በእነርሱ ይጠራ፤ በምድርም መካከል ይብዙ።

verses.text_english: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አባቱ ቀኝ እጁን በኤፍሬም ራስ ላይ ጭኖ ባየ ጊዜ አሳዘነው፤ የአባቱንም እጅ በምናሴ ራስ ላይ ይጭነው ዘንድ ከኤፍሬም ራስ ላይ አነሣው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አባቱን። አባቴ ሆይ እንዲህ አይደለም፥ በኵሩ ይህ ነውና፤ ቀኝህን በራሱ ላይ አድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: And his father refused, and said, I know , my son, I know : he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም እንቢ አለ እንዲህ ሲል። አወቅሁ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አወቅሁ፤ ይህም ደግሞ ሕዝብ ይሆናል ታላቅም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን ታናሽ ወንድሙ ከእርሱ ይበልጣል፥ ዘሩም የአሕዛብ ሙላት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ብሎ ባረካቸው። በእናንተ እስራኤል እንዲህ ብሎ ይባርካል። እግዚአብሔር እንደ ኤፍሬምና እንደ ምናሴ ያድርግህ። ኤፍሬምንም ከምናሴ ፊት አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ዮሴፍን። እነሆ እኔ እሞታለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእናንተ ጋር ይሆናል፥ ወደ አባቶቻችሁም ምድር ይመልሳችኋል፤

verses.text_english: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከአሞራውያን በሰይፌና በቀስቴ የወሰድሁትን ለአንተ ከወንድሞችህ አንድ እጅ አብልጬ ሰጠሁህ አለው። a

verses.text_english: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ልጆቹን ጠርቶ እንዲህ አለ። በኋለኛው ዘመን የሚያገኛችሁን እንድነግራችሁ ተሰብሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.text_amharic: እናንት የያዕቆብ ልጆች ተሰብሰቡ፥ ስሙም፤ አባታችሁ እስራኤልንም አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: Reuben, thou my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤል፥ አንተ በኵር ልጄና ኃይሌ፥ የጕብዝናዬም መጀመሪያ ነህ፤ የክብር አለቃና የኃይል አለቃ።

verses.text_english: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou : he went up to my couch.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ውኃ የምትዋልል ነህ፤ አለቅነት ለአንተ አይሁን፤ ወደ አባትህ መኝታ ወጥተሃልና፤ አረከስኸውም፤ ወደ አልጋዬም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Simeon and Levi brethren; instruments of cruelty their habitations.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖንና ሌዊ ወንድማማች ናቸው፤ ሰይፎቻቸው የዓመፃ መሣሪያ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
verses.text_amharic: በምክራቸው፥ ነፍሴ፥ አትግባ፤ ከጉባኤአቸውም ጋር፥ ክብሬ፥ አትተባበር፤ በቍጣቸው ሰውን ገድለዋልና፥ በገዛ ፈቃዳቸውም በሬን አስነክሰዋልና።

verses.text_english: Cursed their anger, for fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣቸው ርጉም ይሁን፥ ጽኑ ነበርና፤ ኵርፍታቸውም፥ ብርቱ ነበርና፤ በያዕቆብ እከፋፍላቸዋለሁ፥ በእስራኤልም እበታትናቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Judah, thou whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ፥ ወንድሞችህ አንተን ያመሰግኑሃል፤ እጅህ በጠላቶችህ ደንደስ ላይ ነው፤ የአባትህ ልጆች በፊትህ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Judah a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ የአንበሳ ደቦል ነው፤ ልጄ ሆይ፥ ከአደንህ ወጣህ፤ እንደ አንበሳ አሸመቀ፥ እንደ ሴት አንበሳም አደባ፤ ያስነሣውስ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል?

verses.text_english: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him the gathering of the people .
verses.text_amharic: በትረ መንግሥት ከይሁዳ አይጠፋም፥ የገዥም ዘንግ ከእግሮቹ መካከል፥ ገዥ የሆነው እስኪመጣ ድረስ፤ የአሕዛብ መታዘዝም ለእርሱ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.text_amharic: ውርንጫውን በወይን ግንድ ያስራል፥ የአህያይቱንም ግልገል በወይን አረግ፤ ልብሱን በወይን ያጥባል፥ መጎናጸፊያውንም በወይን ደም።

verses.text_english: His eyes red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑም ከወይን ይቀላል፤ ጥርሱም ከወተት ነጭ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he for an haven of ships; and his border unto Zidon.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሎን በባሕር ዳር ይቀመጣል፤ እርሱም ለመርከቦች ወደብ ይሆናል፤ ዳርቻውም እስከ ሲዶና ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Issachar a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.text_amharic: ይሳኮር አጥንተ ብርቱ አህያ ነው፥ በበጎች ጕረኖም መካከል ያርፋል።

verses.text_english: And he saw that rest good, and the land that pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.text_amharic: ዕረፍትም መልካም መሆንዋን አየ፥ ምድሪቱም የለማች መሆንዋን፤ ትከሻውን ለመሸከም ዝቅ አደረገ፥ በሥራም ገበሬ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዳን በወገኑ ይፈርዳል፥ ከእስራኤል ነገድ እንደ አንዱ።

verses.text_english: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
verses.text_amharic: ዳን በጐዳና ላይ እንደ እባብ ይሆናል፥ በመንገድም እንደ ቀንዳም እባብ፤ ፈረሱን ከሰኮናው ይነክሳል፥ ፈረሰኛም ወደ ኋላው ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ መድኃኒትህን እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.text_amharic: ጋድን ዘማቾች ይዘምቱበታል፤ እርሱ ግን ተከታትሎ ይዘምትባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Out of Asher his bread fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.text_amharic: የአሴር እንጀራው ወፍራም ነው፥ ለነገሥታቱም ደስ የሚያሰኝ መብልን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Naphtali a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
verses.text_amharic: ንፍታሌም የተፈታ ሚዳቋ ነው፤ መልካም ቃልን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Joseph a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a well; branches run over the wall:
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍ ትንሹ የፍሬ ዛፍ ነው፥ በምንጭ አጠገብ የሚያፈራ የፍሬ ዛፍ፤ አረጎቹ በቅጥር ላይ ያድጋሉ።

verses.text_english: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot , and hated him:
verses.text_amharic: ቀስተኞች አስቸገሩት፥ ነደፉትም፥ ተቃወሙትም፤

verses.text_english: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty of Jacob; (from thence the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ቀስቱ እንደ ጸና ቀረ፤ የእጆቹም ክንድ በያዕቆብ አምላክ እጅ በረታ፥ በዚያው በጠባቂው በእስራኤል ዓምድ፥

verses.text_english: by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.text_amharic: በአባትህ አምላክ እርሱም የሚረዳህ፥ ሁሉንም በሚችል አምላክ እርሱም የሚባርክህ፥ በሰማይ በረከት ከላይ በሚገኝ፥ በጥልቅም በረከት ከታች በሚሠራጭ፥ በጡትና በማኅፀን በረከት።

verses.text_english: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: የአባትህ በረከቶች ጽኑዓን ከሆኑ ከተራሮች በረከቶች ይልቅ ኃያላን ናቸው፤ ዘላለማውያን ከሆኑ ከኮረፍቶችም በረከቶች ይልቅ ኃያላን ናቸው፤ እነርሱም በዮሴፍ ራስ ላይ ይሆናሉ፥ በወንድሞቹ መካከል አለቃ በሆነው ራስ አናት ላይ።

verses.text_english: Benjamin shall ravin a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.text_amharic: ብንያም ነጣቂ ተኵላ ነው፤ የበዘበዘውን በጥዋት ይበላል፥ የማረከውንም በማታ ይካፈላል።

verses.text_english: All these the twelve tribes of Israel: and this that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገዶች ናቸው፤ አባታቸው የነገራቸው ይህ ነው፥ ባረካቸውም፤ እያንዳንዳቸውን እንደ በረከታቸው ባረካቸው።

verses.text_english: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ብሎም አዘዛቸው። እኔ ወደ ወገኖቼ እሰበሰባለሁ፤ በኬጢያዊ በኤፍሮን እርሻ ላይ ባለችው ዋሻ ከአባቶቼ ጋር ቅበሩኝ፤

verses.text_english: In the cave that in the field of Machpelah, which before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በከነዓን ምድር በመምሬ ፊት ያለች፥ አብርሃም ለመቃብር ርስት ከኬጢያዊ ከኤፍሮን ከእርሻው ጋር የገዛት፥ ባለ ድርብ ክፍል ዋሻ ናት።

verses.text_english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃምና ሚስቱ ሣራ ከዚያ ተቀበሩ፤ ይስሐቅና ሚስቱ ርብቃ ከዚያ ተቀበሩ፤ ከዚያም እኔ ልያን ቀበርኋት፤

verses.text_english: The purchase of the field and of the cave that therein from the children of Heth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻውና በእርስዋ ላይ ያለችው ዋሻ ከኬጢ ልጆች የተገዙ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ትእዛዙን ለልጆቹ ተናግሮ በፈጸመ ጊዜ እግሮቹን በአልጋው ላይ ሰብስቦ ሞተ፥ ወደ ወገኖቹም ተከማቸ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በአባቱ ፊት ወደቀ፥ በእርሱም ላይ አለቀሰ፥ ሳመውም።

verses.text_english: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ባለመድኃኒቶች አገልጋዮቹ አባቱን በሽቱ ያሹት ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ ባለመድኃኒቶችም እስራኤልን በሽቱ አሹት።

verses.text_english: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
verses.text_amharic: አርባ ቀንም ፈጸሙለት፤ የሽቱ መደረጊያው ወራት እንደዚሁ ይፈጸማልና፤ የግብፅም ሰዎች ሰባ ቀን አለቀሱለት።

verses.text_english: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የልቅሶውም ወራት ባለፈ ጊዜ ዮሴፍ ለፈርዖን ቤተ ሰቦች እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ። እኔ በፊታችሁ ሞገስን አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ ለፈርዖን እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት።

verses.text_english: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.text_amharic: አባቴ አምሎኛል እንዲህ ሲል። እነሆ እኔ እሞታለሁ፤ በቈፈርሁት መቃብር በከነዓን ምድር ከዚያ ቅበረኝ። አሁንም ወጥቼ አባቴን ልቅበርና ልመለስ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። ውጣ፥ አባትህንም እንዳማለህ ቅበረው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አባቱን ሊቀብር ወጣ፤ የፈርዖን ሎላልትም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ወጡ፥ የቤቱ ሽማግሌዎችም የግብፅ ምድር ሽማግሌዎችም ሁሉ፤

verses.text_english: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍም ቤተ ሰቦች ሁሉ ወንድሞቹም የአባቱም ቤተ ሰቦች ወጡ፤ ልጆቻቸውንና በጎቻቸውን ከብቶቻቸውን ብቻ በጌሤም ተዉ።

verses.text_english: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.text_amharic: ሰረገሎችም ፈረሰኞችም ከእርሱ ጋር ወጡ፥ ሠራዊቱም እጅግ ብዙ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.text_amharic: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወዳለችው ወደ አጣድ አውድማ መጡ፥ እጅግ ታላቅ በሆነ በጽኑ ልቅሶም አለቀሱለት፤ ለአባቱም ሰባት ቀን ልቅሶ አደረገለት።

verses.text_english: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which beyond Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች ምድር የሚኖሩ የከነዓን ሰዎችም በአጣድ አውድማ የሆነውን ልቅሶ ባዩ ጊዜ። ይህ ለግብፅ ሰዎች ታላቅ ልቅሶ ነው አሉ፤ ስለዚህም የዚያን ቦታ ስም አቤል ምጽራይም ብለው ጠሩት፤ እርሱም በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ነው።

verses.text_english: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹም እንዳዘዛቸው እንደዚያው አደረጉለት፤

verses.text_english: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹም ወደ ከነዓን ምድር አጓዙት፥ ባለ ሁለት ክፍል በሆነች ዋሻም ቀበሩት፤ እርስዋም በመምሬ ፊት ያለች፥ አብርሃም ለመቃብር ርስት ከኬጢያዊ ከኤፍሮን ከእርሻው ጋር የገዛት ዋሻ ናት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍና ወንድሞቹ አባቱንም ሊቀብሩ ከእርሱ ጋር የወጡት ሰዎች ሁሉ አባቱን ከቀበረ በኋላ ወደ ግብፅ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍም ወንድሞች አባታቸው እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ እንዲህ አሉ። ምናልባት ዮሴፍ ይጠላን ይሆናል፥ ባደረግንበትም ክፋት ሁሉ ብድራት ይመልስብን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዮሴፍም መልእክት ላኩ እንዲህም አሉት። አባትህ ገና ሳይሞት እንዲህ ብሎ አዝዞአል።

verses.text_english: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍን እንዲህ በሉት። እባክህ የወንድሞችህን በደል ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር በል፥ እነርሱ በአንተ ከፍተውብሃልና፤ አሁንም እባክህ የአባትህ አምላክ ባሪያዎች የበደሉህን ይቅር በል።

verses.text_english: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we thy servants.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ይህን ሲሉት አለቀሰ። ወንድሞቹ ደግሞ መጡ በፊቱም ሰግደው። እነሆ እኛ ለአንተ ባሪያዎችህ ነን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for I in the place of God?
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም አላቸው። አትፍሩ፤ እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፋንታ ነኝን?

verses.text_english: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as this day, to save much people alive.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ክፉ ነገርን አሰባችሁብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ እንደ ሆነው ብዙ ሕዝብ እንዲድን ለማድረግ ለመልካም አሰበው።

verses.text_english: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አትፍሩ፤ እኔ እናንተንና ልጆቻችሁን እመግባችኋለሁ። አጽናናቸውም ደስ አሰኛቸውም።

verses.text_english: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በግብፅ ተቀመጠ፥ እርሱና የአባቱም ቤተ ሰብ፤ ዮሴፍም መቶ አሥር ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third : the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም የኤፍሬምን ልጆች እስከ ሦስት ትውልድ አየ፤ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጆችም በዮሴፍ ጭን ላይ ተወለዱ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ወንድሞቹን አለ። እኔ እሞታለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም መጎብኘትን ይጎበኛችኋል፥ ከዚህችም ምድር ያወጣችኋል፤ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ያደርሳችኋል።

verses.text_english: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም የእስራኤልን ልጆች። እግዚአብሔር ሲያስባችሁ አጥንቴን ከዚህ አንሥታችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ውሰዱ ብሎ አማላቸው።

verses.text_english: So Joseph died, an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም በመቶ አሥር ዓመት ዕድሜው ሞተ፤ በሽቱም አሹት፥ በግብፅ ምድር በሣጥን ውስጥ አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: Now these the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብ ጋር ወደ ግብፅ የገቡት የእስራኤል ልጆች ስሞች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሰው ሁሉ ከቤተ ሰቡ ጋር ገባ።

verses.text_english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤል፥

verses.text_english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፥

verses.text_english: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.text_amharic: ብንያም፥ ዳን፥ ንፍታሌም፥ ጋድ፥ አሴር።

verses.text_english: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt .
verses.text_amharic: ከያቆብ ጕልበት የወጡት ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰባ ነፍሶች ነበሩ፤ ዮሴፍም አስቀድሞ በግብፅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ሞተ፥ ወንድሞቹም፥ ያም ትውልድ ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች አፈሩ፥ እጅግም በዙ፥ ተባዙም፥ አጅግም ጸኑ፤ ምድሪቱም በእነርሱ ሞላች።

verses.text_english: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅም ዮሴፍን ያላወቀ አዲስ ንጉሥ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel more and mightier than we:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሕዝቡን። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሕዝብ ከእኛ ይልቅ በዝተዋል በርትተውማል፤

verses.text_english: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and get them up out of the land.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይበዙ፥ ሰልፍም በተነሳብን ጊዜ ጠላቶቻችንን አግዘው እንዳይወጉን ከምድሪቱም እንዳይወጡ፥ ኑ እንጠበብባቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.text_amharic: በብርቱ ሥራም ያስጨንቁአቸው ዘንድ ግብር አስገባሪዎችን ሾመባቸው፤ ለፈርዖንም ፊቶምንና ራምሴን ጽኑ ከተሞች አድርገው ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንዳስጨነቁአቸው መጠን እንዲሁ በዙ፥ እጅግም ጸኑ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተነሣ ተጸይፈዋቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም የእስራኤልን ልጆች በመከራ ገዙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, with rigour.
verses.text_amharic: በጽኑ ሥራ፥ በጭቃ፥ በጡብም በእርሻም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በመከራም በሚያሠሩአቸው ሥራ ሁሉ፥ ሕይወታቸውን ያስመርሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅም ንጉሥ አንዲቱ ሲፓራ ሁለተኛይቱም ፉሐ የሚባሉትን የዕብራውያንን አዋላጆች እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see upon the stools; if it a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it a daughter, then she shall live.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የዕብራውያንን ሴቶች ስታዋልዱ፥ ለመውለድ እንደደረሱ ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ወንድ ቢሆን ግደሉት፤ ሴት ብትሆን ግን በሕይወት ትኑር።

verses.text_english: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
verses.text_amharic: አዋላጆች ግን እግዚአብሔርን ፈሩ፥ የግብፅ ንጉሥም እንዳዘዛቸው አላደረጉም፥ ወንዶቹን ሕፃናትንም አዳኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅም ንጉሥ አዋላጆችን ጠርቶ። ለምን እንዲህ አደረጋችሁ? ወንዶቹን ሕፃናትንስ ለምን አዳናችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women not as the Egyptian women; for they lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
verses.text_amharic: አዋላጆቹም ፈርዖንን። የዕብራውያን ሴቶች እንደ ግብፅ ሴቶች ስላልሆኑ፤ እነርሱ ጠንካሮች ናቸውና አዋላጆች ሳይገቡ ስለሚወልዱ ነው አሉት።

verses.text_english: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለአዋላጆች መልካም አደረገላቸው፤ ሕዝቡም በዛ፥ እጅግም ጸና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አዋላጆች እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈሩ ቤቶችን አደረገላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። የሚወለደውን ወንድ ልጅ ሁሉ ወደ ወንዝ ጣሉት፥ ሴትን ልጅ ሁሉ ግን በሕይወት አድኑአት ብሎ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took a daughter of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዊ ወገንም አንድ ሰው ሄዶ የሌዊን ልጅ አገባ።

verses.text_english: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he goodly , she hid him three months.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ፀነሰች፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፤ መልካምም እንደሆነ ባየች ጊዜ ሦስት ወር ሸሸገችው።

verses.text_english: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid in the flags by the river's brink.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ልትሸሽገው ባልቻለች ጊዜ፥ የደንገል ሣጥን ለእርሱ ወስዳ ዝፍትና ቅጥራን ለቀለቀችው፤ ሕፃኑንም አኖረችበት፥ በወንዝም ዳር ባለ በቄጠማ ውስጥ አስቀመጠችው።

verses.text_english: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
verses.text_amharic: እኅቱም የሚደረግበትን ታውቅ ዘንድ በሩቅ ቆማ ትጎበኘው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ልጅ ልትታጠብ ወደ ወንዝ ወረደች፤ ደንገጥሮችዋም በወንዝ ዳር ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ሣጥኑንም በቄጠማ ውስጥ አየች፥ ደንገጥርዋንም ልካ አስመጣችው።

verses.text_english: And when she had opened , she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This of the Hebrews' children.
verses.text_amharic: በከፈተችውም ጊዜ ሕፃኑን አየች፥ እነሆም ሕፃኑ ያለቅስ ነበር፤ አዘነችለትም። ይህ ከዕብራውያን ልጆች አንድ ነው አለች።

verses.text_english: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
verses.text_amharic: እኅቱም ለፈርዖን ልጅ። ሕፃኑን ታጠባልሽ ዘንድ ሄጄ የምታጠባ ሴት ከዕብራውያን ሴቶች ልጥራልሽን? አለቻት።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ልጅ። ሂጂ አለቻት፤ ብላቴናይቱም ሄዳ የሕፃኑን እናት ጠራች።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ልጅ። ይህን ሕፃን ወስደሽ አጥቢልኝ፥ ዋጋሽንም እሰጥሻለሁ አለቻት። ሴቲቱም ሕፃኑን ወስዳ አጠባችው።

verses.text_english: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ወደ ፈርዖንም ልጅ ዘንድ አመጣችው፥ ለእርስዋም ልጅ ሆነላት። እኔ ከውኃ አውጥቼዋለሁና ስትልም ስሙን ሙሴ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሙሴ ጎበዝ በሆነ ጊዜ ወደ ወንድሞቹ ወጣ፥ የሥራቸውንም መከራ ተመለከተ፤ የግብፅም ሰው የወንድሞቹን የዕብራውያንን ሰው ሲመታ አየ።

verses.text_english: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲህና ወዲያም ተመለከተ፥ ማንንም አላየም፥ ግብፃዊውንም ገደለ፥ በአሸዋም ውስጥ ሸሸገው።

verses.text_english: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ወጣ፥ ሁለቱም የዕብራውያን ሰዎች ሲጣሉ አየ፤ በዳዩንም። ለምን ባልንጀራህን ትመታዋለህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
verses.text_amharic: ያም። በእኛ ላይ አንተን አለቃ ወይስ ዳኛ ማን አደረገህ? ወይስ ግብፃዊውን እንደ ገደልኸው ልትገድለኝ ትሻለህን? አለው። ሙሴም። በእውነት ይህ ነገር ታውቆአል ብሎ ፈራ።

verses.text_english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ይህን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ ሙሴን ሊገድለው ፈለገ። ሙሴ ግን ከፈርዖን ፊት ኰበለለ፥ በምድያምም ምድር ተቀመጠ፤ በውኃም ጕድጓድ አጠገብ ዐረፈ።

verses.text_english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew , and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.
verses.text_amharic: ለምድያምም ካህን ሰባት ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ እነርሱም መጥተው ውኃ ቀዱ፥ የአባታቸውንም በጎች ሊያጠጡ የውኃውን ገንዳ ሞሉ።

verses.text_english: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞችም መጥተው ገፉአቸው፤ ሙሴ ግን ተነሥቶ ረዳቸው፥ በጎቻቸውንም አጠጣላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How ye are come so soon to day?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባታቸው ወደ ራጉኤልም በመጡ ጊዜ። ስለ ምን ዛሬ ፈጥናችሁ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew enough for us, and watered the flock.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አንድ የግብፅ ሰው ከእረኞች እጅ አዳነን፥ ደግሞም ቀዳልን፥ በጎቻችንንም አጠጣ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his daughters, And where he? why it ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹንም። እርሱ ወዴት ነው? ለምንስ ያንን ሰው ተዋችሁት? ጥሩት እንጀራም ይብላ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከዚያ ሰው ጋር ሊቀመጥ ወደደ፤ ልጁንም ሲፓራን ለሙሴ ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And she bare a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች። በሌላ ምድር መጻተኛ ነኝ ሲል ስሙን ጌርሳም ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ከብዙ ቀን በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሞተ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከባርነት የተነሣ አለቀሱ፥ ጮኹም፥ ስለ ባርነታቸውም ጩኸታቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የለቅሶአቸውን ድምፅ ሰማ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ ከያዕቆብም ጋር ያደረገውን ቃል ኪዳን አሰበ።

verses.text_english: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አየ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ያለውን ነገር አወቀ።

verses.text_english: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, to Horeb.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የዮቶርን የአማቱን የምድያምን ካህን በጎች ይጠብቅ ነበር፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ዳርቻም በጎቹን ነዳ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተራራ ወደ ኮሬብ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush not consumed.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእሳት ነበልባል በእሾህ ቍጥቋጦ መካከል ታየው፤ እነሆም ቍጥቋጦው በእሳት ሲነድድ ቍጥቋጦውም ሳይቃጠል አየ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። ልሂድና ቍጥቋጦው ስለ ምን አልተቃጠለም ይህን ታላቅ ራእይ ልይ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here I.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ይመለከት ዘንድ እንደ መጣ ባየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከቍጥቋጦው ውስጥ እርሱን ጠርቶ። ሙሴ፥ ሙሴ ሆይ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest holy ground.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እነሆኝ አለ። ወደዚህ አትቅረብ፤ አንተ የቆምህባት ስፍራ የተቀደሰች መሬት ናትና ጫማህን ከእግርህ አውጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: Moreover he said, I the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። እኔ የአባትህ አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ነኝ አለው። ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ያይ ዘንድ ፈርቶአልና ፊቱን ሸፈነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። በግብፅ ያለውን የሕዝቤን መከራ በእውነት አየሁ፥ ከአስገባሪዎቻቸውም የተነሣ ጩኸታቸውን ሰማሁ፤ ሥቃያቸውንም አውቄአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፃውያንም እጅ አድናቸው ዘንድ፥ ከዚያችም አገር ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስሰው አገር ወደ ሰፊይቱና ወደ መልካሚቱ አገር ወደ ከነዓናውያንም ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ስፍራ አወጣቸው ዘንድ ወረድሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እነሆ የእስራኤል ልጆች ጩኸት ወደ እኔ ወጣ፤ ግብፃውያንም የሚያደርጉባቸውን ግፍ ደግሞ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ና፥ ሕዝቤን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብፅ ታወጣ ዘንድ ወደ ፈርዖን እልክሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto God, Who I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። ወደ ፈርዖን የምሄድ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከግብፅ የማወጣ እኔ ማን ነኝ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በእውነት እኔ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፤ እኔም እንደ ላክሁህ ምልክትህ ይህ ነው፤ ሕዝቡን ከግብፅ ባወጣህ ጊዜ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር ትገዛላችሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto God, Behold, I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What his name? what shall I say unto them?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። እነሆ፥ እኔ ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች በመጣሁ ጊዜ። የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ ወደ እናንተ ላከኝ ባልሁም ጊዜ። ስሙስ ማን ነው? ባሉኝ ጊዜ፥ ምን እላቸዋለሁ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። <<ያለና የሚኖር>>እኔ ነኝ አለው፤ እንዲህ ለእስራኤል ልጆች። <<ያለና የሚኖር>>ወደ እናንተ ላከኝ ትላለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this my name for ever, and this my memorial unto all generations.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ሙሴን አለው። ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ትላለህ። የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወደ እናንተ ላከኝ፤ ይህ ለዘላለሙ ስሜ ነው፥ እስከ ልጅ ልጅ ድረስም መታሰቢያዬ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and that which is done to you in Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ የእስራኤልንም ሽማግሌዎች ሰብስብ። እግዚአብሔር የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ የአብርሃም የይስሐቅም የያዕቆብም አምላክ። መጐብኘትን ጐበኘኋችሁ፥ በግብፅም የሚደረግባችሁን አየሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅም መከራ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ያቡሳውያንም አገር ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ አገር አወጣችኋለሁ አልሁ ብሎ ተገለጠልኝ በላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ቃልህን ይሰማሉ፤ አንተና የእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ወደ ግብፅ ንጉሥ ትገባላችሁ። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተገለጠልን፤ አሁንም ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር እንሠዋ ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ በምድረ በዳ እንሂድ ትሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጽኑ እጅ ካልሆነ በቀር ትሄዱ ዘንድ የግብፅ ንጉሥ እንደማይፈቅድላችሁ እኔ አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እጄን እዘረጋለሁ፥ በማደርግባቸውም ተአምራቴ ሁሉ ግብፅን እመታለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ይለቅቃችኋል።

verses.text_english: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
verses.text_amharic: በግብፃውያንም ፊት ለዚህ ሕዝብ ሞገስን እሰጣለሁ፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሄዳችሁ ጊዜ ባዶ እጃችሁን አትሄዱም፤

verses.text_english: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዲቱ ሴት ከጎረቤትዋ በቤትዋም ካለችው ሴት የብር ዕቃ የወርቅ እቃ ልብስም ትለምናለች፤ በወንዶችና በሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ላይ ታደርጉታላችሁ፤ ግብፃውያንንም ትበዘብዛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም መለሰ። እነሆ አያምኑኝም ቃሌንም አይሰሙም። እግዚአብሔር ከቶ አልተገለጠልህም ይሉኛል አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, What that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ይህች በእጅህ ያለችው ምንድር ናት? አለው። እርሱም። በትር ናት አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መሬት ጣላት አለው፤ እርሱም በመሬት ጣላት፥ እባብም ሆነች፤ ሙሴም ከእርሷ ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአባቶቻቸው አምላክ፥ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተገለጠልህ እንዲያምኑ እጅህን ዘርግተህ ጅራትዋን ያዝ አለው። እጁንም ዘርግቶ ያዛት በእጁም ውስጥ በትር ሆነች።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand leprous as snow.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ። እጅህን ወደ ብብትህ አግባ አለው። እጁንም ወደ ብብቱ አገባት፤ ባወጣትም ጊዜ እነሆ፥ እጁ እንደ በረዶ ለምጽ ሆነች።

verses.text_english: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his flesh.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እጅህን ወደ ብብትህ መልስ አለው። እጁንም ወደ ብብቱ መለሳት፥ ከብብቱም ባወጣት ጊዜ እነሆ ተመልሳ ገላውን መሰለች።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አለው። እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ባያምኑህ የፊተኛይቱንም ምልክት ነገር ባይሰሙ፥ የሁለተኛይቱን ምልክት ነገር ያምናሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour upon the dry : and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry .
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እነዚህን ሁለት ምልክቶች ባያምኑ ቃልህንም ባይሰሙ፥ ከወንዙ ውኃን ውሰድ፥ በደረቁም መሬት ላይ አፍስሰው፤ ከወንዙም የወሰድኸው ውኃ በደረቁ መሬት ላይ ደም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ አፌ ኰልታፋ ምላሴም ጸያፍ የሆነ ሰው ነኝ፤ ትናንት ከትናንት ወዲያ ባሪያህንም ከተናገርኸኝ ጀምሮ አፈ ትብ ሰው አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። የሰውን አፍ የፈጠረ ማን ነው? ዲዳስ ደንቆሮስ የሚያይስ ዕውርስ ያደረገ ማን ነው? እኔ እግዚአብሔር አይደለሁምን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አሁን ሂድ፥ እኔም ከአፍህ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ የምትናገረውንም አስተምርሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand thou wilt send.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በምትልከው ሰው እጅ ትልክ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በሙሴ ላይ ነደደ እንዲህም አለ። ሌዋዊው ወንድምህ አሮን አለ አይደለምን? እርሱ ደህና እንዲናገር አውቃለሁ፤ እነሆም ደግሞ ሊገናኝህ ይመጣል፤ ባየህም ጊዜ በልቡ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ትናገረዋለህ ቃሉንም በአፉ ታደርገዋለህ፤ እኔ ከአፍህና ከአፉ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ የምታደርጉትንም አስተምራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ስለ አንተ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ይናገራል፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እርሱ አፍ ይሆንልሃል አንተም በእግዚአብሔር ፋንታ ትሆንለታለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችንም ተአምራት የምታደርግባትን በትር በእጅህ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሄደ፥ ወደ አማቱ ወደ ዮቶር ተመለሰ። እስከ ዛሬ በሕይወት እንዳሉ አይ ዘንድ ተመልሼ ወደ ግብፅ ወደ ወንድሞቼ ልሂድ አለው። ዮቶርም ሙሴን። በሰላም ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በምድያም። ነፍስህን የሚሹአት ሰዎች ሁሉ ሞተዋልና ተመልሰህ ወደ ግብፅ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሚስቱንና ልጆቹን ወሰደ፥ በአህያ ላይም አስቀመጣቸው፥ ወደ ግብፅም አገር ተመለሰ፤ ሙሴም የእግዚአብሔርን በትር ይዞ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ግብፅ ስትመለስ በእጅህ ያደረግሁትን ተአምራት ሁሉ በፈርዖን ፊት ታደርገው ዘንድ ተመልከት፤ እኔ ግን ልቡን አጸናዋለሁ፥ ሕዝቡንም አይለቅቅም።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel my son, my firstborn:
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንንም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, thy firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል የበኵር ልጄ ነው፤ ይገዛልኝ ዘንድ ልጄን ልቀቅ አልሁህ፤ አንተም ትለቅቀው ዘንድ እንቢ አልህ፤ እነሆ እኔ የበኵር ልጅህን እገድላለሁ ትለዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመንገድ ላይ ባደረበት ስፍራ እግዚአብሔር ተገናኘው፥ ሊገድለውም ፈለገ።

verses.text_english: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband thou to me.
verses.text_amharic: ሲፓራም ሚስቱ ባልጩት ወሰደች፥ የልጅዋንም ሸለፈት ገረዘች፥ ወደ እግሩም ጣለችው። አንተ ለእኔ የደም ሙሽራ ነህ አለች።

verses.text_english: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband , because of the circumcision.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አለ። የዚያን ጊዜ። ስለ ግርዛቱ አንተ የደም ሙሽራ ነህ አለች።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን። ሄደህ በምድረ በዳ ሙሴን ተገናኘው አለው፤ ሄዶም በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ተገናኘው፥ ሳመውም።

verses.text_english: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ ዘንድ የላከውን ቃል ሁሉ ያዘዘውንም ተአምራት ሁሉ ለአሮን ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ሄዱ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ የነገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገረ፥ ተአምራቱንም በሕዝቡ ፊት አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም አመኑ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንደ ጐበኘ ጭንቀታቸውንም እንዳየ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥ አጐነበሱ ሰገዱም።

verses.text_english: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ሙሴና አሮን መጥተው ፈርዖንን እንዲህ አሉት። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በምድረ በዳ በዓል ያደርግልኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said, Who the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። ቃሉን እሰማ ዘንድ እስራኤልንስ እለቅቅ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔርን አላውቅም፥ እስራኤልንም ደግሞ አልለቅቅም አለ።

verses.text_english: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። የዕብራውያን አምላክ ተገናኘን፤ ቸነፈር ወይም ሰይፍ እንዳይጥልብን የሦስት ቀን መንገድ በምድረ በዳ እንድንሄድ፥ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር እንድንሠዋ እንለምንሃለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅ ንጉሥም። አንተ ሙሴ አንተም አሮን፥ ሕዝቡን ለምን ሥራቸውን ታስተዋላችሁ? ወደ ተግባራችሁ ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። እነሆ የምድሩ ሕዝብ አሁን በዝቶአል፥ እናንተም ሥራቸውን ታስፈቱአቸዋላችሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም በዚያን ቀን የሕዝቡን አስገባሪዎች ሹማምቶቹንም እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ወትሮው ለጡብ ሥራ ደግሞ ገለባ ለሕዝቡ አትስጡ፤ ነገር ግን እነርሱ ሄደው ገለባ ይሰብስቡ።

verses.text_english: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish thereof: for they idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go sacrifice to our God.
verses.text_amharic: ቀድሞ ያደርጉት የነበረውን የጡብ ቍጥር በእነርሱ ላይ አድርጉት፤ ምንም ከእርሱ አታጕድሉ፤ ሥራ ሰልችተዋልና ስለዚህ። ለአምላካችን እንድንሰዋ እንሂድ እያሉ ይጮኻሉ።

verses.text_english: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ በሰዎች ላይ ሥራው ይክበድባቸው፤ ከንቱ ቃልም አያስቡ።

verses.text_english: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቡም አስገባሪዎች ሹማምቶቹም ወጡ፥ ሕዝቡንም። ፈርዖን እንዲህ ይላል። ገለባ አልሰጣችሁም።

verses.text_english: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሂዱ፥ ከምታገኙበትም ስፍራ ገለባ ሰብስቡ፤ ከሥራችሁ ግን ምንም አይጐድልም አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ስለ ገለባ እብቅ ሊሰበስቡ በግብፅ ምድር ሁሉ ተበተኑ።

verses.text_english: And the taskmasters hasted , saying, Fulfil your works, daily tasks, as when there was straw.
verses.text_amharic: አስገባሪዎቹም። ገለባ ትቀበሉበት እንደ ነበረ ጊዜ የቀን ሥራችሁን ጨርሱ እያሉ አስቸኰሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም አስገባሪዎች። ቀድሞ ታደርጉ እንደ ነበራችሁ ትናንትናና ዛሬ የተቈጠረውን ጡብ ስለ ምን አትጨርሱም? እያሉ በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ የተሾሙትን አለቆቹን ገረፉ።

verses.text_english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች አለቆችም ወደ ፈርዖን መጡ። ለምን በባሪያዎችህ እንዲህ ታደርጋለህ?

verses.text_english: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants beaten; but the fault in thine own people.
verses.text_amharic: ገለባ አይሰጡንም፥ የጡቡንም ሥራ እንድንሠራ ያዝዙናል፤ እነሆም ባሪያዎችህን ይገርፉናል፤ ግድፈቱ ግን በአንተ ሕዝብ ላይ ነው ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: But he said, Ye idle, idle: therefore ye say, Let us go do sacrifice to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ሰልችታችኋል፥ ሰልችታችኋል፤ ስለዚህም። እንሂድ ለእግዚአብሔርም እንሠዋ ትላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Go therefore now, work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ሂዱ፥ ሥሩ፤ ገለባ አይሰጡአችሁም፥ የጡቡን ቍጥር ግን ታመጣላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the officers of the children of Israel did see they in evil , after it was said, Ye shall not minish from your bricks of your daily task.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች አለቆች። ዕለት ዕለት ከምትሰሩት ከጡቡ ቍጥር ምንም አታጕድሉ ባሉአቸው ጊዜ ነገሩ እንደ ከፋባቸው አዩ።

verses.text_english: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
verses.text_amharic: ከፈርዖንም ዘንድ ሲወጡ ሙሴንና አሮንን በፊታቸው ቆመው ተገናኙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ፊት ሽታችንን አግምታችሁታልና፥ ይገድሉንም ዘንድ ሰይፍን በእጃቸው ሰጥታችኋቸዋልና እግዚአብሔር ይመልከታችሁ ይፍረድባችሁም አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou evil entreated this people? why it thou hast sent me?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሰና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስለ ምን ይህን ሕዝብ አስከፋህ? ስለ ምንስ ላክኸኝ?

verses.text_english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
verses.text_amharic: በስምህ እናገር ዘንድ ወደ ፈርዖን ከገባሁ ወዲህ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ አስከፍቶታልና፤ አንተም ሕዝብህን ከቶ አላዳንኸውም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። በጸናች እጅ ይለቅቃችኋልና፥ በጸናችም እጅ ከምድሩ አስወጥቶ ይሰድዳቸዋልና አሁን በፈርዖን የማደርገውን ታያለህ።

verses.text_english: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ተናገረው አለውም። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤

verses.text_english: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
verses.text_amharic: ለአብርሃምም ለይስሐቅም ለያዕቆብም ሁሉን እንደሚችል አምላክ ተገለጥሁ፤ ነገር ግን ስሜ እግዚአብሔር አልታወቀላቸውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰደዱባትንም ምድር፥ የእንግድነታቸውን የከነዓንን ምድር፥ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳኔን አቆምሁ።

verses.text_english: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ እኔ ግብፃውያን የገዙአቸውን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልቅሶ ሰማሁ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔንም አሰብሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከግብፃውያንም ባርነት አወጣችኋለሁ፥ ከተገዥነታቸውም አድናችኋለሁ፤ በተዘረጋ ክንድ በታላቅ ፍርድም እታደጋችኋለሁ፥

verses.text_english: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔም ሕዝብ እንድትሆኑ እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ አምላክም እሆናችኋለሁ፤ እኔም ከግብፃውያን ባርነት ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንደሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እሰጣት ዘንድ ወደ ማልሁባት ምድር አገባችኋለሁ፤ እርስዋንም ርስት አድርጌ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ይህን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገረ፤ እነርሱ ግን ከሰውነታቸው መጨነቅ ከከባዱም ሥራ የተነሣ ቃሉን አልሰሙትም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.text_amharic: ግባ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከአገሩ ይለቅቅ ዘንድ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ለፈርዖን ንገር።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who of uncircumcised lips?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት። እነሆ የእስራኤል ልጆች አልሰሙኝም፤ እንዴትስ ፈርዖን ይሰማኛል? ይልቁንም እኔ ከንፈረ ቈላፍ ነኝ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን ተናገራቸው፥ የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖንም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብፅ እንዲያወጣቸው ይነግሩት ዘንድ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: These the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these the families of Reuben.
verses.text_amharic: የአባታቸውም ቤት አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው። የእስራኤል የበኵር ልጅ የሮቤል ልጆች፤ ሄኖኅ፥ ፈሉስ፥ አስሮን፥ ከርሚ፤ እነዚህ የሮቤል ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these the families of Simeon.
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖንም ልጆች፤ ይሙኤል፥ ያሚን፥ ኦሃድ፥ ያኪን፥ ዶሐር፥ የከነዓናዊቱም ልጅ ሳኡል፤ እነዚህ የስምዖን ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi an hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም እንደ ወገኖቻቸው የሌዊ ልጆች ስሞች ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ ናቸው። የሌዊም የሕይወት ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ነው።

verses.text_english: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶንም ልጆች እንደ ወገኖቻቸው ሎቤኒ፥ ሰሜኢ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath an hundred thirty and three years.
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓትም ልጆች እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል ናቸው፤ የቀዓትም የሕይወቱ ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these the families of Levi according to their generations.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞሖሊ፥ ሙሲ ናቸው። እነዚህ እንደ ትውልዳቸው የሌዊ ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram an hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.text_amharic: እንበረምም የአጎቱን ልጅ ዮካብድን አገባ፥ አሮንና ሙሴንም ወለደችለት፤ የእንበረምም የሕይወቱ ዘመን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.text_amharic: የይስዓር ልጆች ቆሬ፥ ናፌግ፥ ዝክሪ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
verses.text_amharic: የዑዝኤል ልጆች ሚሳኤል፥ ኤልዳፋን፥ ሥትሪ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም የአሚናዳብን የነአሶንን እኅት ኤልሳቤጥን አገባ፥ እርስዋም ናዳብንና አብዮድን አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these the families of the Korhites.
verses.text_amharic: የቆሬ ልጆች አሴር፥ ሕልቃና፥ አብያሳፍ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ የቆሬ ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጅ አልዓዛር ከፉትኤል ልጆች ሚስት አገባ፥ እርስዋም ፊንሐስን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ እንደ ወገኖቻቸው የሌዋውያን አባቶች አለቆች ናቸው።
