verses.text_english: These that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ አሮንና ሙሴ እግዚአብሔር። ከግብፅ ምድር በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የእስራኤልን ልጆች አውጡ ያላቸው ናቸው።

verses.text_english: These they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these that Moses and Aaron.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብፅ ያወጡ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን ጋር የተነጋገሩ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ ሙሴና አሮን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the day the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በግብፅ አገር ሙሴን በተናገረው ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እኔ የምነግርህን ሁሉ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ለፈርዖን ንገር ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት። እነሆ እኔ ከንፈረ ቈላፍ ነኝ፤ እንዴትስ ፈርዖን ይሰማኛል? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። እይ፥ እኔ ለፈርዖን አምላክ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ወንድምህም አሮን ነቢይ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
verses.text_amharic: ያዘዝሁህን ነገር ሁሉ አንተ ትነግረዋለህ፤ ወንድምህም አሮን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከአገሩ ይለቅቅ ዘንድ ከፈርዖን ጋር ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ በግብፅ ምድርም ድንቄንና ተአምራቴን አበዛለሁ።

verses.text_english: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም አይሰማችሁም፥ እጄንም በግብፅ ላይ አደርጋለሁ፥ ሠራዊቴንም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሕዝቤን በታላቅ ፍርድ ከግብፅ አገር አወጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the Egyptians shall know that I the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም፥ እጄን በግብፅ ላይ በዘረጋሁ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከመካከላቸው ባወጣሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም እንዲህ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And Moses fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንንም በተናገሩት ጊዜ ሙሴ የሰማንያ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፥ አሮንም የሰማንያ ሦስት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast before Pharaoh, it shall become a serpent.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖን። ተአምራትን አሳዩኝ ሲላችሁ፥ አሮንን። በትርህን ወስደህ እባብ እንድትሆን በፈርዖን ፊት ጣላት በለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ ፈርዖን ገቡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዛቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ አሮንም በትሩን በፈርዖንና በባሮቹ ፊት ጣለ፥ እባብም ሆነች።

verses.text_english: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ጠቢባንንና መተተኞችን ጠራ፤ የግብፅም ጠንቋዮች በአስማታቸው እንዲሁ ደግሞ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዳቸውም በትራቸውን ጣሉ፥ እባቦችም ሆኑ፤ የአሮን በትር ግን በትራቸውን ዋጠች።

verses.text_english: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ፥ የፈርዖን ልብ ጸና፥ አልሰማቸውምም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። የፈርዖን ልብ ደነደነ፥ ሕዝቡንም ለመልቀቅ እንቢ አለ።

verses.text_english: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ማልደህ ወደ ፈርዖን ሂድ፤ እነሆ ወደ ውኃ ይወጣል፥ ትገናኘውም ዘንድ አንተ በወንዝ ዳር ትቆማለህ፤ እባብም ሆና የተለወጠችውን በትር በእጅህ ትወስዳለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ትለዋለህ። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር። በምድረ በዳ እንዲያገለግሉኝ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ ብሎ ወደ አንተ ላከኝ፤ እነሆም እስከ ዛሬ አልሰማህም።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that in mine hand upon the waters which in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ በዚህ ታውቃለህ፤ እነሆ እኔ የወንዙን ውኃ በእጄ ባለችው በትር እመታለሁ፥ ውኃውም ተለውጦ ደም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the fish that in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
verses.text_amharic: በወንዙም ያሉት ዓሦች ይሞታሉ፥ ወንዙም ይገማል፤ ግብፃውያንም የወንዙን ውኃ ለመጠጣት ይጠላሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in wood, and in stone.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። አሮንን። በትርህን ውሰድ፥ ደምም እንዲሆኑ በግብፅ ውኆች በወንዞቻቸውም በመስኖቻቸውም በኩሬዎቻቸውም በውኃ ማከማቻዎቻቸውም ሁሉ ላይ እጅህን ዘርጋ በለው፤ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ በእንጨት ዕቃና በድንጋይ ዕቃ ሁሉ ደም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that in the river were turned to blood.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዛቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ በትሩንም አነሣ፥ በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹም ፊት የወንዙን ውኃ መታ፤ የወንዙም ውኃ ሁሉ ተለውጦ ደም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the fish that in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በወንዙም የነበሩ ዓሦች ሞቱ፤ ወንዙም ገማ፥ ግብፃውያንም ከወንዙ ውኃ ይጠጡ ዘንድ አልቻሉም ደሙም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.
verses.text_amharic: የግብፅም ጠንቋዮች በአስማታቸው እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደተናገረ የፈርዖን ልብ ጸና፥ አልሰማቸውምም።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ተመልሶ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፥ ይህንም ደግሞ በልቡ አላኖረውም።

verses.text_english: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም ሁሉ የወንዙን ውኃ ይጠጡ ዘንድ አልቻሉምና በወንዙ አጠገብ ውኃ ሊጠጡ ቆፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ወንዙን ከመታ በኋላ ሰባት ቀን ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ተናገረው። ወደ ፈርዖን ግባ እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ያገለግለኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: And if thou refuse to let go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
verses.text_amharic: ለመልቀቅ እንቢ ብትል ግን እነሆ እኔ አገርህን ሁሉ በጓጕንቸሮች እመታለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
verses.text_amharic: ወንዙም ጓጕንቸሮችን ያፈላል፥ ወጥተውም ወደ ቤትህ፥ ወደ መኝታ ቤትህ፥ ወደ አልጋህም፥ ወደ ባሪያዎችህም ቤት፥ በሕዝብህም ላይ፥ ወደ ምድጆችህም፥ ወደ ቡሃቃዎችህም ይገባሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
verses.text_amharic: ጓጕንቸሮችም በአንተ በሕዝብህም በባሪያዎችም ሁሉ ላይ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። አሮንን። በትርህን ይዘህ በወንዞቹና በመስኖቹ በውኃ ማከማቻዎቹም ላይ እጅህን ዘርጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ላይ ጓጕንቸሮችን አውጣ በለው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም በግብፅ ውኆች ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ ጓጕንቸሮቹም ወጡ፥ የግብፅንም አገር ሸፈኑ።

verses.text_english: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ጠንቋዮችም በአስማታቸው እንዲህ አደረጉ፥ በግብፅም አገር ላይ ጓጕንቸሮችን አወጡ።

verses.text_english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን ጠርቶ። ጓጕንቸሮቹን ከእኔ ከሕዝቤም እንዲያርቅ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩልኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ይሠዋ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን እለቅቃለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, they may remain in the river only?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ፈርዖንን። ጓጕንቸሮቹ ከአንተ ከቤቶችህም እንዲጠፉ፥ በወንዙም ብቻ እንዲቀሩ፥ ለአንተ ለባሪያዎችህም ለሕዝብህም መቼ እንድጸልይ አስታውቀኝ አለው። እርሱም። ነገ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, To morrow. And he said, according to thy word: that thou mayest know that none like unto the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን የሚመስል እንደሌለ ታውቅ ዘንድ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
verses.text_amharic: ጓጕንቸሮቹም ከአንተ ከቤቶችህም ከባርያዎችህም ከሕዝብህም ይሄዳሉ፤ በወንዙም ብቻ ይቀራሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጡ፤ ሙሴም በፈርዖን ላይ ስላመጣቸው ጓጕንቸሮች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴ እንዳለ አደረገ፤ ጓጕንቸሮቹም ከቤት ከወጀድም ከሜዳም ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ክምርም አድርገው ሰበሰቡአቸው፤ ምድርም ገማች።

verses.text_english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ጸጥታ እንደሆነ ባየ ጊዜ ልቡን አደነደነ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደተናገረ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። አሮንን። በትርህን ዘርጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ ቅማል እንዲሆን የምድሩን ትቢያ ምታ በለው።

verses.text_english: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም አደረጉ፤ አሮንም እጁን ዘረጋ፥ በበትሩም የምድሩን ትቢያ መታው፥ በሰውና በእንስሳም ላይ ቅማል ሆነ፤ በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ የምድር ትቢያ ሁሉ ቅማል ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
verses.text_amharic: ጠንቋዮችም በአስማታቸው ያወጡ ዘንድ እንዲሁ አደረጉ፥ ነገር ግን አልቻሉም፤ ቅማሉም በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
verses.text_amharic: ጠንቋዮችም ፈርዖንን። ይህስ የእግዚአብሔር ጣት ነው አሉት፤ የፈርዖን ልብ ግን ጸና፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ማልደህ ተነሣ፥ በፈርዖንም ፊት ቁም፤ እነሆ እርሱ ወደ ውኃ ይወርዳል፤ እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲያገለግለኝ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms , and also the ground whereon they .
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤንም ባትለቅቅ፥ እነሆ በአንተ በባሪያዎችህም በሕዝብህም በቤቶችህም ላይ የዝንብ መንጎች እሰድዳለሁ፤ የግብፃውያን ቤቶች የሚኖሩባትም ምድር ሁሉ በዝንብ መንጎች ይሞላሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I the LORD in the midst of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀን በምድር መካከል እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደሆንሁ ታውቅ ዘንድ፥ በዚያ የዝንብ መንጋ እንዳይሆን ሕዝቤ የሚቀመጥባትን የጌሤምን ምድር እለያለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቤና በሕዝብህ መካከል እለያለሁ፤ ይህም ተአምራት ነገ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm into the house of Pharaoh, and his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ በፈርዖንም ቤት በባሪያዎቹም ቤቶች ውስጥ ብዙ የዝንብ መንጋ መጣ፤ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ ላይ ከዝንቡ መንጋ የተነሣ ምድር ጠፋች።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን ጠርቶ። ሂዱ፥ በአገሩ ውስጥ ለአምላካችሁ ሠዉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላካችን የግብፃውያንን ርኵሰት እንሰዋለንና እንዲህ ይደረግ ዘንድ አይገባም፤ እነሆ እኛ የግብፃውያንን ርኵሰት በፊታቸው ብንሠዋ አይወግሩንምን?

verses.text_english: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.
verses.text_amharic: እኛስ ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላካችን እንሠዋ ዘንድ እንደሚያዝዘን የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ እንሄዳለን አለ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላካችሁ በምድረ በዳ ትሠዉ ዘንድ እለቅቃችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ርቃችሁ አትሂዱ፥ ጸልዩልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እነሆ ከአንተ ዘንድ እወጣለሁ፥ የዝንቡም መንጎች ከፈርዖን ከባሪያዎቹም ከሕዝቡም ነገ እንዲሄዱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጸልያለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዋ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን እንዳይለቅቅ ፈርዖን እንደገና አያታልለን አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጣ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴ እንዳለ አደረገ፤ የዝንቡንም መንጎች ከፈርዖን ከባሪያዎቹም ከህዝቡም አስነሣ፤ አንድ ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም በዚህ ጊዜ ደግሞ ልቡን አደነደነ፥ ሕዝቡንም አልለቀቀም።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ፈርዖን ዘንድ ገብተህ ንገረው። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: For if thou refuse to let go, and wilt hold them still,
verses.text_amharic: ልትለቅቃቸውም እንቢ ብትል ብትይዛቸውም፥

verses.text_english: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: a very grievous murrain.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በሜዳ ውስጥ ባሉት በከብቶችህ፥ በፈረሶችም በአህዮችም በግመሎችም በበሬዎችም በበጎችም ላይ ትሆናለች፤ ብርቱ ቸነፈርም ይወርዳል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all the children's of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤልና በግብፅ ከብቶች መካከል ይለያል፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ከብት አንዳች አይጠፋም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ነገ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ነገር በምድር ላይ ያደርጋል ብሎ ጊዜን ወሰነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያንን ነገር በነጋው አደረገ፥ የግብፅም ከብት ሁሉ ሞተ፤ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከብት ግን አንድ ስንኳ አልሞተም።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ላከ፥ እነሆም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከብት አንድ ስንኳ አልሞተም። የፈርዖን ልብ ግን ደነደነ፥ ሕዝቡንም አልለቀቀም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን። እጃችሁን ሞልታችሁ ከምድጃ አመድ ውሰዱ፥ ሙሴም በፈርዖን ፊት ወደ ሰማይ ይበትነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ትቢያ ይሆናል፥ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ ሻህኝ የሚያመጣ ቍስል ይሆናል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth blains upon man, and upon beast.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድጃውም አመድ ወስደው በፈርዖን ፊት ቆሙ፤ ሙሴም ወደ ሰማይ በተነው፥ በሰውና በእንስሳም ላይ ሻህኝ የሚያወጣ ቍስል ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: ጠንቋዮችም ቍስል ስለ ነበረባቸው በሙሴ ፊት መቆም አልቻሉም፤ ቍስል በጠንቋዮችና በግብፃያን ሁሉ ላይ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፤ እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ እንደተናገረው አልሰማቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ማልደህ ተነሣ፥ በፈርኦንም ፊት ቆመህ በለው። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲያገለግሉኝ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that none like me in all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ሁሉ እንደ እኔ ያለ እንደሌለ ታውቅ ዘንድ በሰውነትህ በባሪያዎችህም በሕዝብህም ላይ መቅሠፍቴን ሁሉ አሁን እልካለሁ።

verses.text_english: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እጄን ዘርግቼ አንተን ሕዝብህንም በቸነፈር በመታሁህ ነበር፥ አንተም ከምድር በጠፋህ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And in very deed for this have I raised thee up, for to shew thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ኃይሌን እገልጥብህ ዘንድ ስሜም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ይነገር ዘንድ ስለዚህ አስነሥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
verses.text_amharic: እንዳትለቅቃቸው ገና በሕዝቤ ላይ ትታበያለህን?

verses.text_english: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ፥ ከተመሰረተች ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ በግብፅ ሆኖ የማያውቅ፥ እጅግ ታላቅ በረዶ አዘንብብሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Send therefore now, gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳ የተገኘ ወደ ቤት ያልገባ ሰውና እንስሳ ሁሉ በረዶ ወርዶበት ይሞታልና አሁን እንግዲህ ላክ፥ ከብቶችህንም በሜዳም ያለህን ሁሉ አስቸኵል።

verses.text_english: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
verses.text_amharic: ከፈርዖንም ባሪያዎች የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የፈራ ባሪያዎቹንና ከብቶቹን ወደ ቤቶቹ አሸሸ፤

verses.text_english: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ያላሰበ ባሪያዎቹንና ከብቶቹን በሜዳ ተወ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በግብፅ አገር በሰው በእንስሳም በእርሻም ቡቃያ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ በረዶ ይሆን ዘንድ እጅህን ወደ ሰማይ ዘርጋ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በትሩን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ነጎድጓድና በረዶ ላከ፥ እሳትም ወደ ምድር ወረደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በግብፅ አገር ላይ በረዶ አዘነበ።

verses.text_english: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.text_amharic: በረዶም ነበረ፥ በበረዶውም መካከል እሳት ይቃጠል ነበር፥ በረዶውም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ሕዝብ ከሆነ ጀምሮ እንደ እርሱ ያልሆነ እጅግ ታላቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
verses.text_amharic: በረዶውም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ በሜዳ ያለውን ሁሉ ሰውንና እንስሳን መታ፤ በረዶውም የእርሻን ቡቃያ ሁሉ መታ፥ የአገሩንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.text_english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel , was there no hail.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ተቀምጠው በነበሩባት በጌሤም አገር ብቻ በረዶ አልወረደም።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD righteous, and I and my people wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ልኮ ሙሴንና አሮንን ጠራ። በዚህ ጊዜ በደልሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው፥ እኔና ሕዝቤም ኃጢያተኞች ነን።

verses.text_english: Intreat the LORD (for enough) that there be no mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክ ነጎድጓድ በረዶውም በዝቶአልና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩ፤ እለቅቃችሁማለሁ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በዚህ አትቀመጡም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD; the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth the LORD'S.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። ከከተማ በወጣሁ ጊዜ እጄን ወደ እግዚአብሔር እዘረጋለሁ፤ ምድሪቱ ለእግዚአብሔር እንደሆነች ታውቅ ዘንድ ነጎድጓዱ ይቀራል፥ በረዶውም ደግሞ አይወርድም።

verses.text_english: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንተና ባሪያዎችህ አምላክን እግዚአብሔርን ገና እንደማትፈሩ አውቃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley in the ear, and the flax bolled.
verses.text_amharic: ገብሱ እሸቶ ተልባውም ኣፍርቶ ነበርና ተልባና ገብሱ ተመታ።

verses.text_english: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they not grown up.
verses.text_amharic: ስንዴውና አጃው ግን ጊዜው ገና ነበርና አልተመታም።

verses.text_english: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ከከተማ ወጣ፥ እጁንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘረጋ፤ ነጎድጓዱም በረዶውም ተቋረጠ፥ ዝናቡም በምድር ላይ አልፈሰሰም።

verses.text_english: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ዝናቡ በረዶውም ነጎድጓዱም እንደ ተቋረጠ ባየ ጊዜ ኃጢያትን ጨመረ፥ እርሱና ባሪያዎቹም ልባቸውን አደነደኑ።

verses.text_english: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ልብ ጸና፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ አፍ እንደተናገር የእስራኤልን ልጆች አልለቀቀም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
verses.text_amharic: [see v2]

verses.text_english: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በግብፃውያን ያደረግሁትን ነገር ያደረግሁባቸውንም ተአምራቴን በልጅህ በልጅ ልጅህም ጆሮች ትነግር ዘንድ፥ ይህችንም ተአምራቴን በመካከላቸው አደረግ ዘንድ የእርሱን የባሪያዎቹንም ልብ አደንድኜአለሁና ወደ ፈርዖን ግባ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንም ወደ ፈርዖን ገቡ፥ አሉትም። የዕብራውያን አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በፊቴ ለመዋረድ እስከ መቼ እንቢ ትላለህ? ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤን ለመልቀቅ እንቢ ብትል ግን፥ እነሆ ነገ በአገርህ አንበጣዎችን አመጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
verses.text_amharic: የምድሩንም ፊት ይሸፍኑታልና ምድሩን ለማየት አይቻልም፤ ከበረዶውም አምልጦ የተረፈላችሁን ትርፍ ይበሉታል፥ ያደገላችሁንም የእርሻውን ዛፍ ሁሉ ይበሉታል፤

verses.text_english: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቶችህም የባሪያዎችህም ሁሉ ቤቶች የግብፃውያንም ሁሉ ቤቶች በእነርሱ ይሞላል፤ አባቶችህ የአባቶችህም አባቶች በምድር ላይ ከተቀመጡበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከዚህ ቀን ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ያላዩት ነው። ተመልሶም ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ባሪያዎች። ይህ ሰው እስከ መቼ ዕንቅፋት ይሆንብናል? አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ሰዎችን ልቀቅ ግብፅስ እንደ ጠፋች ገና አታውቅምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: who they that shall go?
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን መልሶ አስመጣቸው። ሂዱ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ፤ ነገር ግን የሚሄዱት እነማን ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we a feast unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እኛ እንሄዳለን፥ የእግዚአብሔር በዓል ሆኖልናልና ታናናሾቻችንና ሽማግሌዎቻችን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም በጎቻችንና ከብቶቻችንም ከእኛ ጋር ይሄዳሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look ; for evil before you.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። እናንተን ከልጆቻችሁ ጋር ስለቅቅ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ ነገር ግን ክፉ ነገር በፊታችሁ እንደሚሆን ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: Not so: go now ye men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አይይደለም፤ እናንተ ወንዶቹ ሂዱ፥ ይህን ፈልጋችኋልና እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ አላቸው። ከፈርዖንም ፊት አባረሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, all that the hail hath left.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በግብፅ አገር ላይ እንዲወጡ፥ ከበረዶውም የተረፈውን የምድርን ቡቃያ ሁሉ እንዲበሉ፥ ስለ አንበጣዎች በግብፅ አገር ላይ እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all night; when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በግብፅ አገር ላይ በትሩን ዘረጋ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የምሥራቅን ነፋስ ያን ቀን ሁሉ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አመጣ፤ ማለዳም በሆነ ጊዜ የምሥራቁ ነፋስ አንበጣዎቹን አመጣ።

verses.text_english: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous ; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.
verses.text_amharic: አንበጣዎችም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ ላይ ወጡ፥ በግብፅም ዳርቻ ሁሉ ላይ ተቀመጡ፤ እጅግም ብዙ ነበሩ፤ ይህንም የሚያህል አንበጣ በፊት አልነበረም፥ ወደ ፊትም ደግሞ እንደ እርሱ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የምድሩንም ፊት ፈጽመው ሸፈኑት አገሪቱም ጨለመች፤ የአገሪቱን ቡቃያ ሁሉ በረዶውም የተወውን በዛፉ የነበረውን ፍሬ ሁሉ በሉ፤ ለምለም ነገር ዛፍም የምድር ሣርም በግብፅ አገር ሁሉ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን በፍጥነት ጠራ። አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን እናንተንም በደልሁ፤

verses.text_english: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ በዚህ ጊዜ ብቻ ኃጢአቴን ይቅር በሉኝ፥ ይህንም ሞት ብቻ ከእኔ ያነሣልኝ ዘንድ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ለምኑ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከፈርዖን ፊት ወጣ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከምዕራብ ዐውሎ ነፋሱን አስወገደ፥ አንበጣዎችንም ወስዶ በኤርትራ ባሕር ውስጥ ጣላቸው፤ አንድ አንበጣም በግብፅ ዳርቻ ሁሉ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አልለቀቀም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness may be felt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን ወደ ሰማይ ዘርጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ላይ ሰው የሚዳስሰው ፅኑ ጨለማ ይሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እጁን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ፥ በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ ላይ ፅኑ ጨለማ ሦስት ቀን ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ወንድሙን አላየም፥ ሦስት ቀንም ሙሉ ከስፍራው ማንም አልተነሣም፤ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ግን በተቀመጡበት ስፍራ ብርሃን ነበራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሙሴን ጠርቶ። ሂዱ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ፤ ነገር ግን በጎቻችሁንና ከብቶቻችሁን ተዉ፤ ልጆቻችሁ ደግሞ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሂዱ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። አንተ ደግሞ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር የምንሠዋው መሥዋዕትንና የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትን ትሰጠናለህ።

verses.text_english: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ለማገልገል ከእነርሱ እንወስዳለንና ከብቶቻችን ከእኛ ጋር ይሄዳሉ፥ አንድ ሰኮናም አይቀርም፤ አምላካችን የምናገለግለው ምን እንደሆነ ከዚያ እስክንደርስ አናውቅም አለ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ ሊለቅቃቸውም አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። ከእኔ ዘንድ ሂድ፤ ፊቴን ባየህበት ቀን ትሞታለህና ፊቴን እንዳታይ ተጠንቀቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እንደ ተናገርህ ይሁን፤ ፊትህን እንደ ገና አላይም አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በፈርዖንና በግብፅ ላይ ገና አንዲት መቅሰፍት አመጣለሁ፥ ከዚያ ወዲያም ይለቅቃችኋል፤ ሲለቅቃችሁም አባርሮ ይሰድዳችኋል።

verses.text_english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዱ ከወዳጁ ሴቲቱም ከወዳጅዋ የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ ይሹ ዘንድ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ ተናገር አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በግብፃውያን ፊት ለሕዝቡ ሞገስን ሰጠው። ሙሴም በፈርዖን ባሪያዎችና በሕዝቡ ፊት በግብፅ አገር እጅግ የከበረ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አለ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእኩል ሌሊት እኔ በግብፅ መካከል እወጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅም አገር ያለ በኵር ሁሉ፥ በዙፋኑ ከሚቀመጠው ከፈርዖን በኵር ጀምሮ በወፍጮ እግር እስካለችው እስከ ባሪያይቱ በኵር ድረስ፥ የከብቱም በኵር ሁሉ ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅም አገር ሁሉ አስቀድሞ እንደ እርሱ ያልሆነ ኋላም ደግሞ የማይሆን ታላቅ ጩኸት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን በግብፃውያንና በእስራኤል መካከል እንዲለይ እንድታውቁ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ውሻ ምላሱን አያንቀሳቅስባቸውም።

verses.text_english: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ባሪያዎችህ ሁሉ። አንተ ውጣ የሚከተሉህም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይውጡ እያሉ ወደ እኔ ይወርዳሉ፥ ለእኔም ይሰግዳሉ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እወጣለሁ። ሙሴም በጽኑ ቁጣ ከፈርዖን ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ተአምራቴ በግብፅ አገር ብዙ እንዲሆን ፈርዖን አይሰማችሁም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም እነዚህን ተአምራቶች ሁሉ በፈርዖን ፊት አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ከአገሩ አልለቀቀም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በግብፅ አገር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: This month unto you the beginning of months: it the first month of the year to you.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ወር የወሮች መጀመሪያ ይሁናችሁ፤ የዓመቱም መጀመሪያ ወር ይሁናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of fathers, a lamb for an house:
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ተናገሩ፥ በሉአቸውም። በዚህ ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን ሰው ሁሉ ለአባቱ ቤት አንድ ጠቦት፥ ለአንድ ቤትም አንድ ጠቦት ይውሰድ።

verses.text_english: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱ ሰዎች ቍጥርም ለጠቦቱ የማይበቃ ቢሆን እርሱና ለቤቱ የቀረበው ጎረቤቱ እንደ ነፍሶቻቸው ቍጥር አንድ ጠቦት ይውሰድ፤ እያንዳንዱም እንደሚበላው መጠን ከጠቦቱ ይካፈሉ።

verses.text_english: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take out from the sheep, or from the goats:
verses.text_amharic: የእናንተ ጠቦት ነውር የሌለበት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ይሁን፤ ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ውሰድ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ወር እስከ አሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ድረስ ጠብቁት፤ የእስራኤልም ማኅበር ጉባኤ ሁሉ ሲመሽ ይረዱት።

verses.text_english: And they shall take of the blood, and strike on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
verses.text_amharic: ከደሙም ወስደው በሚበሉበት ቤት ሁለቱን መቃንና ጉበኑን ይቅቡት።

verses.text_english: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; with bitter they shall eat it.
verses.text_amharic: በእሳት የተጠበሰውን ሥጋውንና ቂጣውን እንጀራ በዚያች ሌሊት ይብሉ፤ ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ጥሬውን በውኃም የበሰለውን አትብሉ፥ ነገር ግን ከራሱ ከጭኑ ከሆድ ዕቃው ጋር በእሳት የተጠበሰውን ብሉት።

verses.text_english: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም እስከ ጥዋት አንዳች አታስቀሩ፤ እስከ ጥዋትም የቀረውን በእሳት አቃጥሉት።

verses.text_english: And thus shall ye eat it; your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it the LORD'S passover.
verses.text_amharic: ወገቦቻችሁን ታጥቃችሁ፥ ጫማችሁን በእግራችሁ፥ በትራችሁንም በእጃችሁ አድርጋችሁ እንዲህ ብሉት፥ ፈጥናችሁም ትበሉታላችህ፤ እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ነው።

verses.text_english: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በዚያች ሌሊት በግብፅ አገር አልፋለሁ፥ በግብፅም አገር ከሰው እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ በኵርን ሁሉ እገድላለሁ፤ በግብፅም አማልክት ሁሉ ላይ እፈርድባቸዋለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye : and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy , when I smite the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ደሙም ባላችሁበት ቤቶች ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል፤ ደሙንም ባየሁ ጊዜ ከእናንተ አልፋለሁ፤ እኔም የግብፅን አገር በመታሁ ጊዜ መቅሰፍቱ ለጥፋት አይመጣባችሁም።

verses.text_english: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ቀን መታሰቢያ ይሁናችሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም በዓል ታደርጉታላችሁ፤ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ሥርዓት ሆኖ ለዘላለም ታደርጉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ፤ በመጀመሪያም ቀን እርሾውን ከቤታችሁ ታወጣላችሁ፤ ከመጀመሪያውም ቀን አንሥቶ እስከ ሰባተኛው ቀን እርሾ ያለበትን እንጀራ የሚበላ ነፍስ ከእስራኤል ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And in the first day an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ እንዲሁም በሰባተኛውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆንላችኋል። ከሚበላው በቀር በእነርሱም ምንም አትሠሩም፥ ይህንም ብቻ ታደርጉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall observe unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ቀን ሠራዊታችሁን ከግብፅ አገር አውጥቼአለሁና የቂጣውንም በዓል ጠብቁት፤ እንግዲህ ይህን ቀን ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ትጠብቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: In the first , on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ ከወሩም እስከ ሀያ አንድ ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ የቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀን በቤታችሁ እርሾ አይገኝ፤ እርሾ ያለበትንም እንጀራ የሚበላ ነፍስ፥ ከመጻተኛው ጀምሮ እስከ አገር ልጁ ድረስ፥ ከእስራኤል ማኅበር ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
verses.text_amharic: እርሾ ያለበትን ምንም አትብሉ፥ በቤቶቻችሁም ሁሉ ውስጥ ቂጣ እንጀራ ብሉ።

verses.text_english: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎች ጠርቶ አላቸው። በየቤታችሁ ጠቦት ምረጡ፥ ወስዳችሁም ለፋሲካ እረዱት።

verses.text_english: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip in the blood that in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ከሂሶጵ ቅጠልም ጭብጥ ውሰዱ፥ በዕቃ ውስጥ ባለውም ደም ንከሩት፥ በዕቃውም ውስጥ ካለው ደም ሁለቱን መቃኖችና ጉበኑን እርጩ፤ ከእናንተም አንድ ሰው ከቤቱ ደጅ እስኪነጋ ድረስ አይውጣ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግብፃውያንን ይመታ ዘንድ ያልፋልና፤ ደሙንም በጉበኑና በሁለቱ መቃኖች ላይ ባየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በደጁ ላይ ያልፋል፥ አጥፊውም ይመታችሁ ዘንድ ወደ ቤታችሁ እንዲገባ አይተውም።

verses.text_english: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ ለልጆቻችሁም ለዘላለም ሥርዓት አድርጋችሁ ይህችን ነገር ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ ወደ ሚሰጣችሁ አገር በገባችሁ ጊዜ ይህን አምልኮ ጠብቁት።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ልጆቻችሁ። ይህ አምልኮ ለእናንተ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: That ye shall say, It the sacrifice of the LORD'S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
verses.text_amharic: ባሉአችሁ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ። በግብፅ አገር በእስራኤል ልጆች ቤቶች ላይ አልፎ ግብፃዊያንን በመታ ጊዜ፥ ቤቶቻችንን ያዳነ የእግዚአብሔር የማለፉ መሥዋዕት ይህች ናት ትሉአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ተጎነበሰ ሰገደም። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሄዱ፥ እንዲሁም አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እኩል ሌሊት በሆነ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር፥ በዙፋን ከተቀመጠው ከፈርዖን በኵር ጀምሮ በግዞት እስካሉት እስከ ምርኮኞቹ በኵር ድረስ፥ የግብፃውያንን በግብፅ ምድር የተገኘውን በኵር ሁሉ፥ የእንስሳውንም በኵሮች ሁሉ መታ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for not a house where not one dead.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ ግብፃውያንም ሁሉ በሌሊት ተነሡ፤ የሞተ የሌለበት ቤት አልነበረምና በግብፅ ምድር ታላቅ ልቅሶ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ሙሴንና አሮንን በሌሊት ጠርቶ። እናንተ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተነሡ፥ ከሕዝቤ መካከል ውጡ፤ ሂዱም፥ እንዳላችሁም እግዚአብሔርን አገልግሉ፤

verses.text_english: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳላችሁም መንጎቻችሁንና ከብቶቻችሁን ውሰዱ፥ ሂዱም፥ እኔንም ደግሞ ባርኩኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We all dead .
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም ፈጥነው ከምድሩ ይወጡ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ያስቸኵሉአቸው ነበር። ሁላችን እንሞታለን ብለዋልና።

verses.text_english: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሊጡን ሳይቦካ ተሸከሙ፥ ቡሃቃውንም በልብሳቸው ጠቅልለው በትከሻቸው ተሸከሙት።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ አደረጉ፥ ከግብፃውያንም የብርንና የወርቅን ዕቃ ልብስንም ለመኑ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them . And they spoiled the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለሕዝቡ በግብፃውያን ፊት የፈለጉትን እንዲሰጡአቸው ሞገስን ሰጠ። እነርሱም ግብፃውያንን በዘበዙ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot men, beside children.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከራምሴ ተነሥተው ወደ ሱኮት ሄዱ፤ ከሕፃናቱም ሌላ ስድስት መቶ ሺህ ሰው የሚያህል እግረኛ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, very much cattle.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሌላ ብዙ ድብልቅ ሕዝብ መንጎችና ላሞችም እጅግ ብዙም ከብቶች ከእነርሱ ጋር ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, four hundred and thirty years.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አራት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ በዚያ ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከግብፅ ምድር ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች ሌሊት ከግብፅ ምድር ስላወጣቸው ለእግዚአብሔር የተጠበቀች ናት፤ ይህች ሌሊት በእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ዘንድ እስከ ልጅ ልጃቸው ድረስ ለእግዚአብሔር የተጠበቀች ናት።

verses.text_english: It a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን አለ። ይህ የፋሲካ ሕግ ነው፤ ከእርሱ እንግዳ ሰው አይብላ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
verses.text_amharic: በብር የተገዛ ባሪያ ቢኖር ከተገረዘ በኋላ ከእርሱ ይብላ።

verses.text_english: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: መጻተኛና ሞያተኛ ግን ከእርሱ አይብሉ።

verses.text_english: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ ቤትም ይበላ፤ ከሥጋውም አንዳች ከቤት ወደ ሜዳ አታውጡ፤ አጥንትም አትስበሩበት።

verses.text_english: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ያድርጉት።

verses.text_english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዳ ሰውም በመካከላችሁ ቢቀመጥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ፋሲካን ሊያደርግ ቢወድድ፥ አስቀድሞ ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ ይቅረብ ያድርግም፤ እንደ አገር ልጅም ይሆናል፤ ያልተገረዘ ሁሉ ግን ከእርሱ አይብላ።

verses.text_english: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ለአገር ልጅ በእናንተ መካከልም ለሚቀመጡ እንግዶች አንድ ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሠራዊታቸው ጋር ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገርው።

verses.text_english: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, of man and of beast: it mine.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ከሰውም ከእንስሳም ማሕፀንን የሚከፈት በኵር ሁሉ ለእኔ ቀድስልኝ፤ የእኔ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this : there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን አለ። ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ የወጣችሁበትን ይህን ቀን አስቡ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከዚህ ቦታ በብርቱ እጅ አውጥቶአችኋልና፤ ስለዚህ የቦካ እንጀራ አትብሉ።

verses.text_english: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ዛሬ በአቢብ ወር ወጥታችኋል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ ይሰጣት ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ ወደ ማለላቸው፥ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር፥ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ ይህችን አምልኮ በዚህ ወር ታደርጋለህ።

verses.text_english: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day a feast to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፥ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር በዓል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀንም ሙሉ ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፥ በአንተም ዘንድ እርሾ ያለበት እንጀራ አይታይ፥ በድንበርህም ሁሉ እርሾ አይታይ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, because of that the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን። ከግብፅ በወጣሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ስላደረገልኝ ነው ስትል ለልጅህ ትነግረዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD'S law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ አውጥቶሃልና የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በአፍህ ይሆን ዘንድ በእጅህ እንደ ምልክት በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደ መታሰቢያ ይሁንልህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
verses.text_amharic: በዓመት በዓመት በወራቱ ይህችን ሥርዓት ጠብቃት።

verses.text_english: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ ለአባቶችህም እንደ ማለ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፥ እርስዋንም በሰጠህ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males the LORD'S.
verses.text_amharic: ማሕፀንን የሚከፍተውን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ለይ፤ ከሚሆንልህ ከብት ሁሉ ተባት ሆኖ አስቀድሞ የተወለደው ለእግዚአብሔር ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
verses.text_amharic: የአህያውን በኵር በጠቦት ትዋጀዋለህ፥ ባትዋጀውም አንገቱን ትሰብረዋለህ፤ የሰውንም በኵር ሁሉ ከልጆችህ መካከል ትዋጀዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሚመጣው ጊዜ ልጅህ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ እንዲህ ትለዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር በብርቱ እጅ ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣን፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም እንዳይሰድደን ልቡን ባጸና ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው በኵር ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ በኵር ድረስ በግብፅ ምድር ያለውን በኵር ሁሉ ገደለ፤ ስለዚህ ወንድ ሆኖ ማሕፀንን የከፈተውን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እሠዋለሁ፥ ነገር ግን የልጆቼን በኵር ሁሉ እዋጃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በብርቱ እጅ ከግብፅ አውጥቶናልና በእጅህ እንደ ምልክት፥ በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደ ተንጠለጠለ ነገር ይሁንልህ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not the way of the land of the Philistines, although that near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ፈርዖን ሕዝቡን በለቀቀ ጊዜ፥ ምንም ቅርብ ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር በፍልስጥኤማውያን ምድር መንገድ አልመራቸውም፤ እግዚአብሔር። ሕዝቡ ሰልፉን ባየ ጊዜ እንዳይጸጽተው ወደ ግብፅም እንዳይመለስ ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: But God led the people about, the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በዙሪያ መንገድ በኤርትራ ባሕር ባለችው ምድረ በዳ መራቸው። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ተሰልፈው ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም። እግዚአብሔር ሳይጎበኛችሁ አይቀርም፥ አጥንቶቼንም ከዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር ታወጣላችሁ ብሎ የእስራኤልን ልጆች አምሎአቸው ነበርና ሙሴ የእርሱን አጥንቶች ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ከሱኮትም ተጓዙ፥ በምድረ በዳውም ዳር በኤታም ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.text_amharic: በቀንና በሌሊትም ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ መንገድ ሊያሳያቸው ቀን በደመና ዓምድ፥ ሊያበራላቸውም ሌሊት በእሳት ዓምድ እግዚአብሔር በፊታቸው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, before the people.
verses.text_amharic: የደመና ዓምድ በቀን፥ የእሳት ዓምድ በሌሊት ከሕዝቡ ፊት ከቶ ፈቀቅ አላለም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰው በሚግዶልና በባሕር መካከል፥ በበኣልዛፎንም ፊት ለፊት ባለው በፊሀሒሮት ፊት እንዲሰፍሩ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ ከእርሱም አጠገብ በባሕር ዳር ትሰፍራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች። በምድር ይቅበዘበዛሉ፥ ምድረ በዳም ዘጋቻቸው ይላል።

verses.text_english: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I the LORD. And they did so.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ እርሱም ያባርራቸዋል፤ በፈርዖንና በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ላይ ክብር አገኛለሁ፤ ግብፃውያንም እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ። እነርሱም እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም እንደ ኰበለሉ ለግብፅ ንጉሥ ነገሩት፤ የፈርዖንና የባሪያዎቹም ልብ በሕዝቡ ላይ ተለወጠና። እንዳይገዛልን እስራኤልን የለቀቅነው ምን አድርገናል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.text_amharic: ሰረገላውንም አሰናዳ፥ ሕዝቡንም ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፤

verses.text_english: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት መቶ የተመረጡ ሰረገሎችንም፥ የግብፅንም ፈረሶች ሁሉ፥ በእያንዳንዱም ሰረገላ ሁሉ ላይ ሦስተኞችን ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የግብፅን ንጉሥ የፈርዖንን ልብ አጸና፥ እርሱም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሳደደ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከፍ ባለች እጅ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም የፈርዖን ፈረሶች ሰረገሎቹም ፈረሰኞቹም ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ፥ አሳደዱአቸው፤ በባሕሩ ዳር በበኣልዛፎን ፊት ለፊት ባለው በፊሀሒሮት አጠገብ ሰፍረው አገኙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም በቀረበ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ዓይናቸውን አነሡ፥ እነሆም ግብፃውያን በኋላቸው ገሥግስው ነበር፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እጅግ ፈሩ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And they said unto Moses, Because no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንም። በግብፅ መቃብር ስላልኖረ በምድረ በዳ እንሞት ዘንድ አወጣኸንን? ከግብፅ ታወጣን ዘንድ ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ ከምንሞት ብንገዛላቸው ይሻላልና። ተወን፥ ለግብፃውያን እንገዛ ብለን በግብፅ ሳለን ያልንህ ቃል ይህ አይደለምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ለሕዝቡ። አትፍሩ፥ ዛሬ የምታዩአቸውን ግብፃውያንን ለዘላለም አታዩአቸውምና ቁሙ፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የሚያደርጋትን የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን እዩ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋል፥ እናንተም ዝም ትላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ለምን ትጮኽብኛለህ? እንዲጓዙ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገር።

verses.text_english: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry through the midst of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በትርህን አንሣ፥ እጅህንም በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ክፈለውም፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በባሕሩ ውስጥ በየብስ ያልፋሉ።

verses.text_english: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም እኔ የግብፃውያንን ልብ አጸናለሁ፥ በኋላቸውም ይገባሉ፤ በፈርዖንና በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ በሰረገሎቹም በፈረሰኞቹም ላይ ክብር አገኛለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the Egyptians shall know that I the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም በፈርዖንና በሰረገሎቹ በፈረሰኞቹም ላይ ክብር ባገኘሁ ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ሠራዊት ፊት ይሄድ የነበረው የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ፈቀቅ ብሎ በኋላቸው ሄደ፤ የደመናውም ዓምድ ከፊታቸው ፈቀቅ ብሎ በኋላቸው ቆመ፥

verses.text_english: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness , but it gave light by night : so that the one came not near the other all the night.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፃውያን ሰፈርና በእስራኤል ሰፈር መካከልም ገባ፤ በዚያም ደመናና ጨለማ ነበረ፥ በዚህ በኩል ግን ሌሊቱን አበራ፤ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ እርስ በእርሳቸው አልተቃረቡም።

verses.text_english: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry , and the waters were divided.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በባሕሩ ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ጽኑ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ አምጥቶ ባሕሩን አስወገደው፥ ባሕሩንም አደረቀው፥ ውኃውም ተከፈለ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry : and the waters a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በባሕሩ መካከል በየብስ ገቡ፤ ውኃውም በቀኛቸውና በግራቸው እንደ ግድግዳ ሆነላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ግብፃውያንም፥ የፈርዖን ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎች ፈረሰኞቹም ሁሉ፥ እያሳደዱ በኋላቸው ወደ ባሕር መካከል ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እጅህን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘርጋ፥ ውኃውም በግብፃውያን በሰረገሎቻቸውም በፈረሰኞቻቸውም ላይ ይመለስ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እጁን በባሕሩ ላይ ዘረጋ፥ ባሕሩም ማለዳ ወደ መፍሰሱ ተመለሰ፤ ግብፃውያንም ከእርሱ ሸሹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ግብፃውያንን በባሕሩ መካከል ጣላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም ተመልሶ በኋላቸው ወደ ባሕር የገቡትን ሰረገሎችን ፈረሰኞችንም የፈርዖንንም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከደነ፤ ከእነርሱም አንድ ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን በባሕሩ ውስጥ በየብስ ሄዱ፤ ውኆችም በቀኛቸውና በግራቸው እንደ ግድግዳ ሆኑላችው።

verses.text_english: But the children of Israel walked upon dry in the midst of the sea; and the waters a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በዚያን ቀን እስራኤልን እንደዚህ ከግብፃውያን እጅ አዳነ፤ እስራኤልም የግብፃውያንን ሬሳ በባሕር ዳር አዩ።

verses.text_english: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም እግዚአብሔር በግብፃውያን ላይ ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን እጅ አዩ፥ ሕዝቡም እግዚአብሔርን ፈሩ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም በባሪያውም በሙሴ አመኑ።

verses.text_english: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ሙሴና የእስራኤል ልጆች ይህንን መዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘመሩ፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩ። በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ለእግዚአብሔር እዘምራለሁ፤ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን በባሕር ጣለ።

verses.text_english: The LORD my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልበቴ ዝማሬዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥  መድኃኒቴም ሆነልኝ፤  ይህ አምላኬ ነው አመሰግነውማለሁ፥ የአባቴ አምላክ ነው ከፍ ከፍም አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The LORD a man of war: the LORD his name.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ተዋጊ ነው፥ ስሙም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.text_english: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንን ሰረገሎች ሠራዊቱንም በባሕር ጣላቸው፤  የተመረጡት ሦስተኞች በኤርትራ ባሕር ሰጠሙ።

verses.text_english: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
verses.text_amharic: ቀላያትም ከደኑአቸው፤  ወደ ባሕር ጥልቀት እንደ ድንጋይ ሰጠሙ።

verses.text_english: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ቀኝህ በኃይል ከበረ፤  አቤቱ፥ ቀኝህ ጠላቱን አደቀቀ።

verses.text_english: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, consumed them as stubble.
verses.text_amharic: በክብርህም ብዛት የተነሡብህን አጠፋህ፤  ቍጣህን ሰድደህ፥ እንደ ገለባም በላቸው።

verses.text_english: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በአፍንጫህ እስትንፋስ ውኆች ተከመሩ፥  ፈሳሾቹም እንደ ክምር ቆሙ፤  ሞገዱም በባሕር ውስጥ ረጋ።

verses.text_english: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላትም። አሳድጄ እይዛቸዋለሁ፥  ምርኮም እካፈላለሁ፥ ነፍሴም ትጠግባቸዋለች፤ ሰይፌንም እመዝዛለሁ፥ እጄም ታጠፋቸዋለች አለ።

verses.text_english: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስህን አነፈስህ፥ ባሕርም ከደናቸው፤  በኃይለኞች ውኆችም እንደ አረር ሰጠሙ።

verses.text_english: Who like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful praises, doing wonders?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በአማልክት መካከል እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?  በምስጋና የተፈራህ፥ ድንቅንም የምታደርግ፥  በቅድስና የከበረ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኝህን ዘረጋህ፥ ምድርም ዋጠቻቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verses.text_amharic: በቸርነትህ የተቤዠሃቸውን ሕዝብህን መራህ፤  በኃይልህ ወደ ቅዱስ ማደሪያህ አገባሃቸው።

verses.text_english: The people shall hear, be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሰሙ፥ ተንቀጠቀጡም፤  በፍልስጥኤም የሚኖሩትን ምጥ ያዛቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ የኤዶም አለቆች ደነገጡ፤ የሞአብን ኃያላን መንቀጥቀጥ ያዛቸው፤ በከነዓን የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ቀለጡ።

verses.text_english: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, thou hast purchased.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብህ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ የተቤዠኸው ሕዝብ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ፍርሃትና ድንጋጤ ወደቀባቸው፤ በክንድህ ብርታት እንደ ድንጋይ ዝም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, the place, O LORD, thou hast made for thee to dwell in, the Sanctuary, O Lord, thy hands have established.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ታስገባቸዋለህ፥ በርስትህ ተራራም ትተክላቸዋለህ፥ አቤቱ፥ ለማደሪያህ ባደረግኸው ስፍራ፥ አቤቱ፥ እጆችህ ባዘጋጁት መቅደስ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለሙ እስከ ፍጻሜ ይነግሣል።

verses.text_english: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry in the midst of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖን ፈረሶች ከሰረገሎቹ ከፈረሰኞቹም ጋር ወደ ባሕር ገቡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የባሕሩን ውኆች መለሰባቸው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን በባሕሩ መካከል በየብስ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮን እኅት ነቢይቱ ማሪያምም ከበሮ በእጅዋ ወሰደች፤ ሴቶችም ሁሉ በከበሮና በዘፈን በኋላዋ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም እየዘመረች መለሰችላቸው። በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፤ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን በባሕር ጣለ።

verses.text_english: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ከኤርትራ ባሕር አስጓዘ፥ ወደ ሱርም ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ በምድረ በዳም ሦስት ቀን ሄዱ፥ ውኃም አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ማራም በመጡ ጊዜ የማራ ውኃ መራራ ነበረና ሊጠጡ አልቻሉም፤ ስለዚህ የዚያ ስፍራ ስም ማራ ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.text_english: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም። ምን እንጠጣለን? ብለው በሙሴ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.text_english: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንጨትን አሳየው፥ በውኃውም ላይ ጣለው፥ ውኃውም ጣፈጠ። በዚያም ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን አደረገላቸው፥ በዚያም ፈተናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I the LORD that healeth thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አንተ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አጥብቀህ ብትሰማ፥ በፊቱም የሚበጀውን ብታደርግ፥ ትእዛዙንም ብታደምጥ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ በግብፃውያን ላይ ያመጣሁትን በሽታ አላደርስብህም፤ እኔ ፈዋሽህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝና አለ።

verses.text_english: And they came to Elim, where twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወደ ኤሊም መጡ፥ በዚያም አሥራ ሁለት የውኃ ምንጮችና ሰባ የዘንባባ ዛፎች ነበሩባት፤ በዚያም በውኃው አጠገብ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤሊምም ተጓዙ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ከግብፅ አገር ከወጡ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በኤሊምና በሲና መካከል ወዳለችው ወደ ሲን ምድረ በዳ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በምድረ በዳ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። ይህን ጉባኤ ሁሉ በራብ ልትገድሉ እኛን ወደዚች ምድረ በዳ አውጥታችኋል፤ በሥጋው ምንቸት አጠገብ ተቀምጠን እንጀራ ስንበላ ስንጠግብ ሳለን በግብፅ ምድር በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ምነው በሞትን! አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በሕጌ ይሄዱ ወይም አይሄዱ እንደሆነ እኔ እንድፈትናቸው፥ እነሆ ከሰማይ እንጀራን አዘንብላችኋለሁ፤ ሕዝቡም ወጥተው ለዕለት ለዕለት የሚበቃቸውን ይልቀሙ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በስድስተኛው ቀን ያመጡትን ያዘጋጁ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም ከሚለቅሙት ይልቅ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ ምድር እንዳወጣችሁ ማታ ታውቃላችሁ፥

verses.text_english: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what we, that ye murmur against us?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ክብር ጥዋት ታያላችሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ያንጐራጐራችሁትን ሰምቶአልና በእኛም ላይ የምታንጐራጕሩ እኛ ምንድር ነን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, , when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what we? your murmurings not against us, but against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ያንጐራጐራችሁበትን ማንጐራጐራችሁን ሰምቶአልና በመሸ ጊዜ ትበሉ ዘንድ ሥጋን፥ ማልዶም ትጠግቡ ዘንድ እንጀራን እግዚአብሔር ይሰጣችኋል፤ እኛም ምንድር ነን? ማንጐራጐራችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ነው እንጂ በእኛ አይደለም አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን። ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። ማንጐራጐራችሁን ሰምቶአልና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅረቡ በል አለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አሮን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በተናገረ ጊዜ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፊታቸውን አቀኑ፤ እነሆም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በደመናው ታየ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመሸ ጊዜ ድርጭቶች መጡ፥ ሰፈሩንም ከደኑት፤ ማለዳም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ጠል ወድቆ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
verses.text_amharic: የወደቀውም ጠል ባለፈ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ በመሬት ላይ እንደ ደቃቅ ውርጭ ሆኖ ቅርፊት የሚመስል ደቃቅ ነገር በምድረ በዳ ታየ።

verses.text_english: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness a small round thing, small as the hoar frost on the ground.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ባዩት ጊዜ ያ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላወቁምና እርስ በእርሳቸው። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ተባባሉ። ሙሴም። ትበሉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር የሰጣችሁ እንጀራ ነው።

verses.text_english: And when the children of Israel saw , they said one to another, It manna: for they wist not what it . And Moses said unto them, This the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው። እያንዳንዱ የሚበላውን ያህል ይልቀም፤ በድኳኑ ባሉት ነፍሶች ቍጥር ለአንድ ሰው አንድ ጎሞር ውሰዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: This the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, the number of your persons; take ye every man for which in his tents.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ አንዱ አብዝቶ አንዱም አሳንሶ ለቀመ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
verses.text_amharic: በጎሞርም በሰፈሩት ጊዜ እጅግ ለለቀመ አልተረፈውም ጥቂትም ለለቀመ አልጐደለበትም፤ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የሚበላውን ያህል ለቀመ።

verses.text_english: And when they did mete with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። ማንም ከእርሱ አንዳች ለነገ አያስቀር አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሙሴን አልሰሙትም፤ አንዳንድ ሰዎችም ከእርሱ ለነገ አስቀሩ፥ እርሱም ተላ ሸተተም፤ ሙሴም ተቈጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ሁሉ ዕለት ዕለት የሚበላውን ያህል በጥዋት ለቀመ፤ ፀሐይም በተኰሰ ጊዜ ቀለጠ።

verses.text_english: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በስድስተኛው ቀን ሁለት እጥፍ አድርገው እያንዳንዳቸው ሁለት ጎሞር እንጀራ ለቀሙ፤ የማኀበሩም አለቆች ሁሉ መጥተው ለሙሴ ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one : and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ይህ ነው። ነገ ዕረፍት፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የተቀደሰ ሰንበት ነው፤ የምትጋግሩትን ጋግሩ፥ የምትቀቅሉትንም ቀቅሉ፥ የተረፈውን ሁሉ ለነገ እንዲጠበቅ አኑሩት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, This which the LORD hath said, To morrow the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake which ye will bake , and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘ ለነገ አኖሩት፤ አልሸተተም፥ ትልም አልሆነበትም።

verses.text_english: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰንበት ዛሬ ነውና ብሉት፤ ዛሬ በሜዳ አታገኙትም።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ቀን ልቀሙት፤ ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ሰንበት ነው፤ በእርሱ አይገኝም አለ።

verses.text_english: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከሕዝቡ አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሊለቅሙ ወጡ፥ ምንምን አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, there went out of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ትእዛዞቼንና ሕጎቼን ለመጠበቅ እስከ መቼ እንቢ ትላላችሁ?

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሰንበትን እንደ ሰጣችሁ እዩ፤ ስለዚህ በስድስተኛው ቀን የሁለት ቀን እንጀራ ሰጣችሁ፤ ሰው ሁሉ በስፍራው ይቀመጥ፥ በሰባተኛው ቀን ማንም ከስፍራው አይሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በሰባተኛው ቀን ዐረፈ።

verses.text_english: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ወገን ስሙን መና ብለው ጠሩት፤ እርሱም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነጭ ነው፤ ጣዕሙም እንደ ማር ቂጣ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it like wafers with honey.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው። ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣኋችሁ ጊዜ በምድረ በዳ ያበላኋችሁን እንጀራ ያዩ ዘንድ ከእርሱ አንድ ጎሞር ሙሉ ለልጅ ልጆቻችሁ ይጠበቅ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, This the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን። አንድ ማድጋ ወስደህ ጎሞር ሙሉ መና አግባበት፥ ለልጅ ልጃችሁም ይጠበቅ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አኑረው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ ይጠበቅ ዘንድ አሮን በምስክሩ ፊት አኖረው።

verses.text_english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደሚኖሩባት ምድር እስኪመጡ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት መና በሉ፤ ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ድንበር እስኪመጡ ድረስ መና በሉ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: ጎሞርም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል ነው።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and no water for the people to drink.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ ከሲን ምድረ በዳ ሊጓዙ ተነሡ፥ በራፊዲምም ሰፈሩ፤ ሕዝቡም ይጠጡ ዘንድ ውኃ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሙሴን ተጣሉት። የምንጠጣውን ውኃ ስጠን አሉት። ሙሴም። ለምን ትጣሉኛላችሁ? እግዚአብሔርንስ ለምን ትፈታተናላችሁ? አላቸው።
