verses.text_english: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore this thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በዚያ ስፍራ ውኃ ተጠሙ። እኛንና ልጆቻችንን ከብቶቻችንንም በጥማት ልትገድል ለምን ከግብፅ አወጣኸን? ሲሉ በሙሴ ላይ አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.text_english: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። ሊወግሩኝ ቀርበዋልና በዚህ ሕዝብ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በሕዝቡ ፊት እለፍ፥ ከእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤ ወንዙንም የመታህባትን በትር በእጅህ ይዘሃት ሂድ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ እኔ በዚያ በኮሬብ በዓለት ላይ በፊትህ እቆማለሁ፤ ዓለቱንም ትመታለህ፥ ሕዝቡም ይጠጣ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ውኃ ይወጣል አለው። ሙሴም በእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ፊት እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እስራኤልም ልጆች ክርክር። እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ነውን ወይስ አይደለም? ሲሉ እግዚአብሔርን ስለተፈታተኑት የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ማሳህ፥ ደግሞም መሪባ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.text_amharic: አማሌቅም መጥቶ ከእስራኤል ጋር በራፊድም ተዋጋ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ኢያሱን። ጕልማሶችን ምረጥልን፥ ወጥተህም ከአማሌቅ ጋር ተዋጋ፤ እኔ ነገ የእግዚአብሔርን በትር በእጄ ይዤ በኮረብታው ራስ ላይ እቆማለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም ሙሴ እንዳለው አደረገ፥ ከአማሌቅም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ሙሴና አሮንም ሖርም ወደ ኮረብታው ራስ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ እጁን ባነሣ ጊዜ እስራኤል ድል ያደርግ ነበር፤ እጁንም ባወረደ ጊዜ አማሌቅ ድል ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Moses' hands heavy; and they took a stone, and put under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴ እጆች ግን ከብደው ነበር፤ ድንጋይም ወሰዱ፥ በበታቹም አኖሩ፥ እርሱም ተቀመጠበት፤ አሮንና ሖርም አንዱ በዚህ አንዱ በዚያ ሆነው እጆቹን ይደግፉ ነበር፤ ፀሐይም እስክትገባ ድረስ እጆቹ ጠነከሩ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም አማሌቅንና ሕዝቡን በሰይፍ ስለት አሸነፈ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this a memorial in a book, and rehearse in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአማሌቅን ዝክር ከሰማይ በታች ጨርሼ እደመስሳለሁና ይህን ለመታሰቢያ በመጽሐፍ ጻፈው፥ በኢያሱም ጆሮ ተናገር አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ ስሙንም ይህዌህ ንሲ ብሎ ጠራው፤

verses.text_english: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn the LORD war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ላይ ስለጫነ የእግዚአብሔር ሰልፍ በአማሌቅ ላይ ለልጅ ልጅ ይሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
verses.text_amharic: የምድያምም ካህን የሙሴ አማት ዮቶር እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን ከግብፅ እንዳወጣ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የሙሴ አማት ዮቶር መልሶአት የነበረውን የሙሴን ሚስት ሲፓራን ሁለቱንም ልጆቿን ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And her two sons; of which the name of the one Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ የአንደኛው ስም ጌርሳም ነበረ፤ አባቱ። በሌላ አገር ስደተኛ ነበርሁ ብሎአልና፤

verses.text_english: And the name of the other Eliezer; for the God of my father, mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
verses.text_amharic: የሁለተኛውም ስም አልዓዛር ነበረ። የአባቴ አምላክ ረዳኝ፥ ከፈርዖንም ሰይፍ አዳነኝ ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴ አማት ዮቶርም ከልጆቹና ከሚስቱ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ አጠገብ በምድረ በዳ ወደ ሰፈረ ወደ ሙሴ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንም። እኔ አማትህ ዮቶር፥ ሚስትህም፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ሁለቱ ልጆችዋ መጥተንልሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አማቱን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ሰገደም፥ ሳመውም፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም ደኅንነታቸውን ተጠያየቁ፥ ወደ ድንኳኑም ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and the LORD delivered them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር በፈርዖንና በግብፃውያን ላይ ስለ እስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥ በመንገድም ያገኛቸውን ድካም ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዳናቸው ለአማቱ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: ዮቶርም እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ሁሉ፥ ከግብፃውያንም እጅ ስላዳናቸው ደስ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jethro said, Blessed the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.text_amharic: ዮቶርም። ከግብፃውያንና ከፈርዖን እጅ ያዳናችሁ፥ ከግብፃውያንም እጅ ሕዝቡን ያዳነ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.text_english: Now I know that the LORD greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly above them.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢት ባደረጉባቸው ነገር እግዚአብሔር ከአማልክት ሁሉ እንዲበልጥ አሁን አወቅሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴ አማት ዮቶርም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንና ሌላ መሥዋዕትን ለእግዚአብሔር ወሰደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ከሙሴ አማት ጋር እንጀራ ሊበሉ አሮን የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ሙሴ በሕዝቡ ሊፈርድ ተቀመጠ፤ ሕዝቡም በሙሴ ፊት ከጥዋት እስከ ማታ ድረስ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴም አማት በሕዝቡ ያደረገውን ሁሉ ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ በሕዝቡ የምታደርገው ምንድር ነው? ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ከጥዋት ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ በዙሪያህ ቆመው ሳሉ አንተ ብቻህን ስለ ምን ተቀምጠሃል? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አማቱን። ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ወደ እኔ ይመጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make know the statutes of God, and his laws.
verses.text_amharic: ነገርም ቢኖራቸው ወደ እኔ ይመጣሉ፥ በዚህና በዚያ ሰውም መካከል እፈርዳለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥርዓትና ሕግ አስታውቃቸዋለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest not good.
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴም አማት አለው። አንተ የምታደርገው ይህ ነገር መልካም አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that with thee: for this thing too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ነገር ይከብድብሃልና አንተ ከአንተም ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ ትደክማላችሁ፤ አንተ ብቻህን ልታደርገው አትችልም።

verses.text_english: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እመክርሃለሁና ቃሌን ስማ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፤ አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለሕዝቡ ሁን፥ ነገራቸውንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አድርስ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቱንም ሕጉንም አስተምራቸው፥ የሚሄዱበትን መንገድ የሚያደርጉትንም ሥራ ሁሉ አሳያቸው።

verses.text_english: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place over them, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ አዋቂዎችን፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩትን፥ የታመኑ፥ የግፍንም ረብ የሚጠሉትን ሰዎች ምረጥ፤ ከእነርሱም የሺህ አለቆችን፥ የመቶ አለቆችን፥ የአምሳ አለቆችን፥ የአሥርም አለቆችን ሹምላቸው።

verses.text_english: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear with thee.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡ ላይ ሁልጊዜ ይፍረዱ፤ አውራውን ነገር ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ያምጡት፥ ታናሹንም ነገር ሁሉ እነርሱ ይፍረዱ፤ እነርሱም ከአንተ ጋር ሸክሙን ይሸከማሉ፥ ለአንተም ይቀልልልሃል።

verses.text_english: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee , then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብታደርግ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ ቢያዝዝህ፥ መቆም ይቻልሃል፥ ደግሞም ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በሰላም ወደ ስፍራው ይደርሳል።

verses.text_english: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የአማቱን ቃል ሰማ፥ ያለውንም ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ አዋቂዎችን መረጠ፥ በሕዝቡም ላይ የሺህ አለቆች፥ የመቶም አለቆች፥ የአምሳም አለቆች፥ የአሥርም አለቆች አድርጎ ሾማቸው።

verses.text_english: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡም ላይ ሁልጊዜ ፈረዱ፤ የከበደባቸውንም ነገር ወደ ሙሴ አመጡ፥ ታናሹን ነገር ሁሉ ግን እነርሱ ፈረዱ።

verses.text_english: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አማቱን ሰደደው፤ እርሱም ወደ አገሩ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ወር የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በዚያ ቀን ወደ ሲና ምድረ በዳ መጡ።

verses.text_english: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
verses.text_amharic: ከራፊድም ተነሥተው ወደ ሲና ምድረ በዳ መጡ፥ በምድረ በዳም ሰፈሩ፤ በዚያም እስራኤል በተራራው ፊት ሰፈረ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በተራራው ጠርቶ አለው። ለያዕቆብ ቤት እንዲህ በል፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ንገር።

verses.text_english: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፃውያን ያደረግሁትን፥ በንስርም ክንፍ እንደተሸከምኋችሁ፥ ወደ እኔም እንዳመጣኋችሁ አይታችኋል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth mine:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ቃሌን በእውነት ብትሰሙ ኪዳኔንም ብትጠብቁ፥ ምድር ሁሉ የእኔ ናትና ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተመረጠ ርስት ትሆኑልኛላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም የካህናት መንግሥት የተቀደሰም ሕዝብ ትሆኑልኛላችሁ። ለእስራኤል ልጆች የምትነግራቸው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም መጣ፥ የሕዝቡንም ሽማግሌዎች ጠርቶ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በፊታቸው ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡ ሁሉ አንድ አፍ ሆነው። እግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ብለው መለሱ፤ ሙሴም የሕዝቡን ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር አደረሰ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ከአንተ ጋር ስነጋገር ሕዝቡ እንዲሰሙ፥ ደግሞም ለዘላለም እንዲያምኑብህ፥ እነሆ በከባድ ደመና እመጣልሃለሁ አለው። ሙሴም የሕዝቡን ቃል ለእግዚአብሔር ነገረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደ ሕዝቡ ሂድ፥ ዛሬና ነገም ቀድሳቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም ይጠቡ፤

verses.text_english: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛው ቀን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲያዩ እግዚአብሔር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ይወርዳልና ለሦስተኛው ቀን ይዘጋጁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, go up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.text_amharic: ወሰንም ለሕዝቡ በዙሪያው አድርግላቸው። ወደ ተራራው እንዳትወጡ ጫፉንም እንዳትነኩ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ተራራውንም የነካ ፈጽሞ ይሞታል፤

verses.text_english: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.text_amharic: የማንም እጅ አይንካ፤ ነገር ግን የሚነካው ሁሉ ይወገራል፥ ወይም በፍላጻ ይወጋል፤ እንስሳ ወይም ሰው ቢሆን አይድንም በላቸው። ሳያቋርጥ የመለከት ድምፅ ሲነፋ በዚያን ጊዜ ወደ ተራራው ይውጡ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከተራራው ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረደ፥ ሕዝቡንም ቀደሰ፤ ልብሳቸውንም አጠቡ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at wives.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም። ለሦስተኛው ቀን ተዘጋጁ፥ ወደ ሴቶቻችሁ አትቅረቡ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that in the camp trembled.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሦስተኛው ቀን በማለዳ ጊዜ ነጐድጓድና መብረቅ ከባድም ደመና እጅግም የበረታ የቀንደ መለከት ድምጽ በተራራው ላይ ሆነ፤ በሰፈሩም የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.text_english: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ለማገናኘት ከሰፈር አወጣቸው፤ ከተራራውም እግርጌ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእሳት ስለ ወረደበት የሲና ተራራ ሁሉ ይጤስ ነበር፤ ከእርሱም እንደ እቶን ጢስ ያለ ጢስ ይወጣ ነበር፥ ተራራውም ሁሉ እጅግ ይናወጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.text_amharic: የቀንደ መለከቱም ድምፅ እጅግ በበረታና በጸና ጊዜ ሙሴ ተናገረ እግዚአብሔርም በድምፅ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሲና ተራራ ላይ ወደ ተራራው ራስ ወረደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ጠራው፤ ሙሴም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ውረድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ለማየት ዳርቻውን እንዳያልፉ ከእነርሱም ብዙ እንዳይጠፉ ለሕዝቡ አስጠንቅቃቸው፤

verses.text_english: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የሚቀርቡት ካህናት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋቸው ራሳቸውን ይቀድሱ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ። በተራራው ዙሪያ ወሰን አድርግ ቀድሰውም ብለህ አስጠንቅቀኸናልና ሕዝቡ ወደ ተራራ ይወጡ ዘንድ አይችሉም አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ሂድ፥ ውረድ፤ አንተ አሮንም ከአንተ ጋር ትወጣላችሁ፤ ካህናቱና ሕዝቡ ግን እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይወጡ ዘንድ አይተላለፉ አለው።

verses.text_english: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረደ፥ ይህንንም ነገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።  ፕ

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness that in heaven above, or that in the earth beneath, or that in the water under the earth:
verses.text_amharic: በላይ በሰማይ ካለው፥ በታችም በምድር ካለው፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ካለው ነገር የማናቸውንም ምሳሌ፥ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ለአንተ አታድርግ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth of them that hate me;
verses.text_amharic: አትስገድላቸው፥ አታምልካቸውምም፤ በሚጠሉኝ እስከ ሦስተኛና እስከ አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ የአባቶችን ኃጢአት በልጆች ላይ የማመጣ፤

verses.text_english: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚወድዱኝ፥ ትእዛዜንም ለሚጠብቁ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ድረስ ምሕረትን የማደርግ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ቀናተኛ አምላክ ነኝና። ፕ

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክህን ስም በከንቱ አትጥራ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስሙን በከንቱ የሚጠራውን ከበደል አያነጻውምና።

verses.text_english: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.text_amharic: የሰንበትን ቀን ትቀድሰው ዘንድ አስብ።

verses.text_english: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ተግባርህንም ሁሉ አድርግ፤

verses.text_english: But the seventh day the sabbath of the LORD thy God: thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that within thy gates:
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላክህ ሰንበት ነው፤ አንተ፥ ወንድ ልጅህም፥ ሴት ልጅህም፥ ሎሌህም፥ ገረድህም፥ ከብትህም፥ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ያለ እንግዳ በእርሱ ምንም ሥራ አትሥሩ፤

verses.text_english: For six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them , and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በስድስት ቀን ሰማይንና ምድርን፥ ባሕርንም፥ ያለባቸውንም ሁሉ ፈጥሮ በሰባተኛው ቀን ዐርፎአልና፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር የሰንበትን ቀን ባርኮታል ቀድሶታልም።

verses.text_english: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.text_amharic: አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.text_amharic: አትግደል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.text_amharic: አታመንዝር።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.text_amharic: አትስረቅ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: በባልንጀራህ ላይ በሐሰት አትመስክር።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that thy neighbour's.
verses.text_amharic: የባልንጀራህን ቤት አትመኝ፤ የባልንጀራህን ሚስት ሎሌውንም ገረዱንም በሬውንም አህያውንም ከባልንጀራህ ገንዘብ ሁሉ ማናቸውንም አትመኝ።

verses.text_english: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw , they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ነጐድጓዱንና መብረቁን፥ የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ፥ ተራራውንም ሲጤስ አዩ፤ ሕዝቡም ባዩ ጊዜ ተርበደበዱ፥ ርቀውም ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንም። አንተ ተናገረን እኛም እንሰማለን፤ እንዳንሞት ግን እግዚአብሔር አይናገረን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ለሕዝቡ። እግዚአብሔር ሊፈትናችሁ፥ ኃጢያትንም እንዳትሠሩ እርሱን መፍራት በልባችሁ ይሆን ዘንድ መጥቶአልና አትፍሩ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God .
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ርቀው ቆሙ፥ ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር ወዳለበት ወደ ጨለማው ቀረበ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን አለው። ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በል። እኔ ከሰማይ እንደ ተናገርኋችሁ እናንተ አይታችኋል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገቤ ምንም አታድርጉ፤ የብር አማልክት የወርቅም አማልክት ለእናንተ አታድርጉ።

verses.text_english: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.text_amharic: የጭቃ መሠዊያ ሥራልኝ፥ የሚቃጠለውንና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕትህን በጎችህንም በሬዎችህንም ሠዋበት፤ ስሜን በማሳስብበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ወደ አንተ መጥቼ እባርክሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.text_amharic: የድንጋይም መሠዊያ ብታደርግልኝ ብረት በነካው ድንጋይ አትሥራው፤ በመሣሪያ ብትነካው ታረክሰዋለህና።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.text_amharic: ኃፍረተ ሥጋህ በእርሱ እንዳይገለጥ ወደ መሠዊያዬ በደረጃ አትውጣ።

verses.text_english: Now these the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.text_amharic: በፊታቸው የምታደርገው ሥርዓት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ዕብራዊ ባሪያ የገዛህ እንደሆነ ስድስት ዓመት ያገልግልህ፥ በሰባተኛውም በከንቱ አርነት ይውጣ።

verses.text_english: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.text_amharic: ብቻውን መጥቶ እንደሆነ ብቻውን ይውጣ፤ ከሚስቱ ጋር መጥቶ እንደሆነ ሚስቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ትውጣ።

verses.text_english: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታው ሚስት አጋብቶት እንደ ሆነ ወንዶች ወይም ሴቶች ልጆች ብትወልድለት፥ ሚስቱና ልጆችዋ ለጌታው ይሁኑ፥ እርሱም ብቻውን ይውጣ።

verses.text_english: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያውም። ጌታዬን ሚስቴን ልጅቼንም እወድዳለሁ፥ አርነት አልወጣም ብሎ ቢናገር፥ ጌታው ወደ ፈራጆች ይውሰደው፥

verses.text_english: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደጁም ወደ መቃኑ አቅርቦ ጆሮውን በወስፌ ይብሳው፤ ለዘላለምም ባሪያው ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ሴት ልጁን ለባርነት ቢሸጥ ባሪያዎች እንደሚወጡ እርስዋ አትውጣ።

verses.text_english: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዋን ደስ ባታሰኘው በዎጆ ይስደዳት፤ ስለ ናቃት ለሌላ ወገን ሰዎች ይሸጣት ዘንድ አይገባውም።

verses.text_english: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ለልጁም ብድራት፥ ለሴት ልጆች የሚገባውን ያድርግላት።

verses.text_english: If he take him another ; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርስዋ ሌላም ቢያጋባው፥ መኖዋን ልብስዋንም ለምንጣፍዋም ተገቢውን አያጕድልባት።

verses.text_english: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሦስት ነገር ባያደርግላት ያለ ገንዘብ በከንቱ ትውጣ።

verses.text_english: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሰውን ቢመታ ቢሞትም፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.text_amharic: ባይሸምቅበትም፥ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ድንገት በእጁ ቢጥለው፥ የሚሸሽበት ስፍራ እኔ አደርግልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ግን ቢደፍር፥ ባልጀራውን በተንኰል ቢገድለው፥ እንዲሞት ከመሠዊያዬ አውጥተህ ውሰደው።

verses.text_english: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚመታ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን ሰርቆ ቢሸጥ፥ ወይም በእጁ ቢገኝ፥ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚሰድብ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with fist, and he die not, but keepeth bed:
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ሰዎችም ቢጣሉ፥ አንዱም ሌላውን በድንጋይ ወይም በጡጫ ቢመታ፥ ያም ባይሞት ነገር ግን ታምሞ በአልጋው ላይ ቢተኛ፥

verses.text_english: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote be quit: only he shall pay the loss of his time, and shall cause to be thoroughly healed.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቶም በምርኩዝ ወደ ሜዳ ቢወጣ፥ የመታው ንጹሕ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ተግባሩን ስላስፈታው ገንዘብ ይከፍለው ዘንድ፥ ያስፈውሰውም ዘንድ ግዴታ አለበት።

verses.text_english: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ወንድ ባሪያውን ወይም ሴት ባሪያውን በበትር ቢመታ፥ ቢሞትበትም፥ ፈጽሞ ይቀጣ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he his money.
verses.text_amharic: የተመታው ግን አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቀን ቢቈይ ገንዘቡ ነውና አይቀጣ።

verses.text_english: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart , and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges .
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ሰዎች ቢጣሉ፥ ያረገዘችንም ሴት ልጁን እስክትጨነግፍ ቢገፉአት ባትጐዳ ግን፥ የሴቲቱ ባል የጫነበትን ያህል ካሳ ይስጥ፤ ፈራጆቹም እንደ ፈረዱበት ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: And if mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.text_amharic: ጕዳት ግን ቢያገኛት ሕይወት በሕይወት፥

verses.text_english: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.text_amharic: ዓይን በዓይን፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ፥ እጅ በእጅ፥

verses.text_english: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.text_amharic: እግር በእግር፥ መቃጠል በመቃጠል፥ ቍስል በቍስል፥ ግርፋት በግርፋት ይከፈል።

verses.text_english: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም የባሪያውን ወይም የባሪይይቱን ዓይን ቢመታ ቢያጠፋውም፥ ስለ ዓይኑ አርነት ያውጣው።

verses.text_english: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያውን ወይም የባሪያይቱን ጥርስ ቢሰብር፥ ስለ ጥርሱ አርነት ያውጣው።

verses.text_english: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox quit.
verses.text_amharic: በሬም ወንድን ወይም ሴትን እስኪሞቱ ድረስ ቢወጋ፥ በሬው ይወገር፥ ሥጋውም አይበላ፤ የበሬው ባለቤት ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: በሬው ግን አስቀድሞ ተዋጊ ቢሆን፥ ሰዎችም ለባለቤቱ ቢመሰክሩለት ባይጠብቀውም፥ ወንድንም ወይም ሴትን ቢገድል፥ በሬው ይወገር፥ ባለቤቱ ደግሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ግን ካሳ ቢፈልጉ፥ የሕይወቱን ዎጆ የጫኑበትን ያህል ይስጥ።

verses.text_english: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ወንድን ልጅ ቢወጋ ሴትንም ልጅ ቢወጋ፥ ይህንኑ ፍርድ ያድርጉበት።

verses.text_english: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.text_amharic: በሬው ወንድ ባሪያ ወይም ሴት ባሪያ ቢወጋ፥ የበሬው ባለቤት ሠላሳ የብር ሰቅል ለጌታቸው ይስጥ፥ በሬውም ይወገር።

verses.text_english: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ጕድጓድ ቢከፍት፥ ወይም ጕድጓድ ቢቈፍር ባይከድነውም፥ በሬም ወይም አህያ ቢወድቅበት፥

verses.text_english: The owner of the pit shall make good, give money unto the owner of them; and the dead shall be his.
verses.text_amharic: የጕድጓዱ ባለቤት ዋጋቸውን ለባለቤታቸው ይክፈል፤ የሞተውም ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead also they shall divide.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው በሬ የሌላውን በሬ እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢወጋ፥ ደኅናውን በሬ ይሽጡ፥ ዋጋውንም በትክክል ይካፈሉ፤ የሞተውንም ደግሞ በትክክል ይካፈሉ።

verses.text_english: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.text_amharic: በሬውም አስቀድሞ ተዋጊ መሆኑ ቢታወቅ፥ ባለቤቱም ባይጠብቀው፥ በሬውን በበሬው ፈንታ ይስጥ፥ የሞተውም ለእርሱ ይሁነው።

verses.text_english: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በሬ ወይም በግ ቢሰርቅ፥ ቢያርደው ወይም ቢሸጠው፥ በበሬው ፋንታ አምስት በሬዎች፥ በበጉም ፋንታ አራት በጎች ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, no blood for him.
verses.text_amharic: ሌባው ቤት ሲምስ ቢገኝ፥ እርሱም እስኪሞት ቢመታ፥ በመታው ሰው ላይ የደም ዕዳ አይሆንበትም።

verses.text_english: If the sun be risen upon him, blood for him; he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ ግን ከወጣችበት የደም ዕዳ አለበት፤ ሌባው የሰረቀውን ይመልስ፤ የሚከፍለውም ቢያጣ ስለ ሰረቀው ይሸጥ።

verses.text_english: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.text_amharic: የሰረቀው ደኅና ሆኖ በእጁ ቢገኝ፥ በሬም ወይም አህያ ወይም በግ ቢሆን፥ የሰረቀውን ያህል ሁለት እጥፍ ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሰው ወደ እርሻ ወይም ወደ ወይን ስፍራ ከብቱን ቢነዳው፥ የሌላውንም እርሻ ቢያስበላ፥ ከተመረጠ እርሻው ከማለፊያውም ወይኑ ይካስ።

verses.text_english: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed ; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.text_amharic: እሳት ቢነሣ፥ እሾኽንም ቢይዝ፥ ክምሩንም ወይም ያልታጨደውን እህል ወይም እርሻውን ቢያቃጥል፥ እሳቱን ያነደደው ይካስ።

verses.text_english: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በባልንጀራው ዘንድ ብር ወይም ሌላ ነገር እንዲጠብቅለት አደራ ቢያኖር ከቤቱም ቢሰረቅ፥ ሌባው ቢገኝ ስለ አንድ ሁለት ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
verses.text_amharic: ሌባውም ባይገኝ ባለቤቱ ወደ ፈራጆች ይቅረብ፥ እጁንም በባልንጀራው ከብት ላይ እንዳልዘረጋ ይማል።

verses.text_english: For all manner of trespass, for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, for any manner of lost thing, which challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ስለ በሬ ወይም ስለ አህያ ወይም ስለ በግ ወይም ስለ ልብስ ወይም ስለ ሌላ ስለ ጠፋ ነገር ቢካሰሱ፥ አንዱም። ይህ የእኔ ነው ቢል፥ ክርክራቸው ወደ ፈራጆች ይድረስ፤ ፈራጆቹም የፈረዱበት እርሱ ለባልንጀራው በአንድ ሁለት ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing :
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በባልንጀራው ዘንድ አህያ ወይም በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም ሌላ እንስሳ እንዲጠብቅለት አደራ ቢያኖር፥ ማንም ሳያይ ቢሞት ወይም ቢጎዳ ወይም ቢማረክ፥

verses.text_english: shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept , and he shall not make good.
verses.text_amharic: በባልንጀራው ከብት ላይ እጁን እንዳልዘረጋ የእግዚአብሔር መሐላ በሁለታቸው መካከል ይሁን፤ የከብቱም ባለቤት መሐላውን ይቀበል፥ እርሱም ምንም አይክፈል።

verses.text_english: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ዘንድ ቢሰረቅ የጠፋውን ያህል ለባለቤቱ ይመልስ።

verses.text_english: If it be torn in pieces, let him bring it witness, he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.text_amharic: ተቧጭሮም ቢገኝ ለምስክር ያምጣው፤ በመቧጨሩም ምክንያት አይክፈል።

verses.text_english: And if a man borrow of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof not with it, he shall surely make good.
verses.text_amharic: ከባልንጀራው አንዳች ቢዋስ ባለቤቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ሳይኖር ቢጎዳ፥ ወይም ቢሞት፥ ፈጽሞ ይክፈለው።

verses.text_english: if the owner thereof with it, he shall not make good: if it an hired , it came for his hire.
verses.text_amharic: ባለቤቱ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ቢኖር አይክፈል፤ ቢከራየው በክራዩ ይግባ።

verses.text_english: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ያልታጨችውን ድንግል ቢያስታት፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ቢተኛ፥ ማጫዋን ሰጥቶ ሚስት ያድርጋት።

verses.text_english: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.text_amharic: አባትዋም እርስዋን እንዳይሰጠው ፈጽሞ እንቢ ቢል እንደ ደናግል ማጫ ያህል ብር ይክፈላት።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.text_amharic: መተተኛይቱን በሕይወት እንድትኖር አትፍቀድላት።

verses.text_english: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንስሳ ጋር የሚረክስ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: He that sacrificeth unto god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ለአንዳች አምላክ የሚሠዋ ፈጽሞ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር ስደተኞች ነበራችሁና ስደተኛውን አትበድለው፥ ግፍም አታድርግበት።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.text_amharic: መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጎቹን አታስጨንቁአቸው።

verses.text_english: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.text_amharic: ብታስጨንቁአቸውና ወደ እኔ ቢጮኹ እኔ ጩኸታቸውን ፈጽሞ እሰማለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬም ይጸናባችኋል፥ በሰይፍም አስገድላችኋለሁ፤ ሚስቶቻችሁም መበለት፥ ልጆቻችሁም ድሀ አደጎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: If thou lend money to my people poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ ጋር ለተቀመጠው ለወገኔ ለድሀው ገንዘብ ብታበድረው፥ እንደ ባለ አራጣ አትሁን፥ አራጣም አትጫንበት።

verses.text_english: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.text_amharic: የባልንጀራህን ልብስ ለመያዣ ብትወስድ ፀሐይ ሳትገባ መልስለት፤

verses.text_english: For that his covering only, it his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I gracious.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋውን የሚከድንበት እርሱ ብቻ ነውና፤ የሚተኛበትም ሌላ የለውምና፤ ወደ እኔም ቢጮኽ መሐሪ ነኝና እሰማዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.text_amharic: ፈራጆችን አትስደብ፥ የሕዝብህንም አለቃ አትርገመው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not delay the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ነዶህንም የወይንህንም ጭማቂ ለማቅረብ አትዘግይ፤ የልጆችህንም በኵር ትሰጠኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በበሬዎችህና በበጎችህ ታደርገዋለህ፤ ሰባት ቀን ከእናቱ ጋር ይቀመጥ፥ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ለእኔ ትሰጠዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat flesh torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱስ ወገን ትሆኑልኛላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ በምድረ በዳ አውሬ የቧጨረውን ሥጋ ለውሻ ጣሉት እንጂ አትብሉት።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰተኛ ወሬ አትቀበል፤ ሐሰተኛ ምስክርም ትሆን ዘንድ ከኃጢአተኛ ጋር እጅህን አታንሣ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest :
verses.text_amharic: ክፉውን ለማድረግ ብዙ ሰዎችን አትከተል፤ ፍርድንም ለማጥመም ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋር ተስማምተህ አትመስክር።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርድ ነገርም ለድሀው አታድላ።

verses.text_english: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.text_amharic: የጠላትህን በሬ ወይም አህያውን ጠፍቶ ብታገኘው በፍጹም መልስለት።

verses.text_english: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጠላህን ሰው አህያ ከሸክሙ በታች ወድቆ ብታየው አትተወው፥ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር አንሣው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.text_amharic: በሚምዋገትበት ጊዜ የድሀህን ፍርድ አታጥምም።

verses.text_english: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ከሐሰት ነገር ራቅ፤ እኔ ኃጢአተኛውን አላጸድቅምና ንጹሕንና ጻድቅን አትግደል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ማማለጃን አትቀበል፤ ማማለጃ የዓይናማዎችን ሰዎች ዓይን ያሳውራልና፥ የጻድቃንንም ቃል ያጣምማልና።

verses.text_english: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በስደተኛው ግፍ አታድርጉ፤ እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር ስደተኞች ስለ ነበራችሁ የስደተኛ ነፍስ እንዴት እንደ ሆነች አውቃችኋልና።

verses.text_english: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ዓመት ምድርህን ዝራ፥ ፍሬዋንም አግባ፤

verses.text_english: But the seventh thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, with thy oliveyard.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛው ዓመት ግን ተዋት አሳርፋትም፤ የሕዝብህም ድሆች ይበሉታል፤ ያስቀሩትንም የሜዳ እንስሳ ይብላው። እንዲሁም በወይንህና በወይራህ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ቀን ሥራህን ሥራ፤ በሬህና አህያህ ያርፉ ዘንድ ለባሪያህም ልጅ ለመጻተኛውም ዕረፍት ይሆን ዘንድ በሰባተኛው ቀን ዕረፍ።

verses.text_english: And in all that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ያልኋችሁንም ነገር ሁሉ ጠብቁ፤ የሌሎችንም አማልክት ስም አትጥሩ፥ ከአፋችሁም አይሰማ።

verses.text_english: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.text_amharic: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ በዓል ታደርግልኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.text_amharic: የቂጣውን በዓል ጠብቅ፤ በአቢብ ወር ከግብፅ ምድር ወጥታችኋልና በዚህ ወር እንዳዘዝሁህ ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላለህ፤ በፊቴም ባዶ እጃችሁን አትታዩ።

verses.text_english: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሻም የምትዘራትን የፍሬህን በኵራት የመከር በዓል፥ ዓመቱም ሳያልቅ ፍሬህን ከእርሻ ባከማቸህ ጊዜ የመክተቻውን በዓል ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በዓመት ሦስት ጊዜ በአንተ ዘንድ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ በጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታይ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.text_amharic: የመሥዋዕቴን ደም ከቦካ እንጀራ ጋር አትሠዋ፤ የበዓሌም ስብ እስኪነጋ አይደር።

verses.text_english: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.text_amharic: የተመረጠውን የምድርህን ፍሬ በኵራት ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አምጣ። ጠቦትን በእናቱ ወተት አትቀቅል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድ ይጠብቅህ ዘንድ ወዳዘጋጀሁትም ስፍራ ያገባህ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ መልአክን በፊትህ እሰድዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name in him.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱ ተጠንቀቁ፥ ቃሉንም አድምጡ፤ ስሜም በእርሱ ስለ ሆነ ኃጢአት ብትሠሩ ይቅር አይልምና አታስመርሩት።

verses.text_english: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ቃሉን ብትሰማ፥ ያልሁህንም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ጠላቶችህን እጣላቸዋለሁ፥ የሚያስጨንቁህንም አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኬ በፊትህ ይሄዳልና፥ ወደ አሞራውያንም ወደ ኬጢያውያንም ወደ ፌርዛውያንም ወደ ከነዓናውያንም ወደ ኤዊያውያንም ወደ ኢያቡሳውያንም ያገባሃል፤ እኔም አጠፋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.text_amharic: ለአማልክቶቻቸው አትስገድ፥ አታምልካቸውም፤ እንደ ሥራቸውም አትሥራ፤ ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ አፍርሳቸው፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብራቸው።

verses.text_english: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁንም እግዚአብሔርን ታመልኩታላችሁ፥ እርሱም እህልህንና ውኃህን ይባርካል፤ በሽታንም ከመካከልህ አርቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርህም መካን ወይም የምትጨነግፍ አትሆንም፤ የዘመንህን ቍጥር እሞላለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: መፈራቴንም በፊትህ እሰድዳለሁ፥ የምትሄድበትንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ አስደነግጣቸዋለሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ በፊትህ ጀርባቸውን እንዲያዞሩ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.text_amharic: በፊትህም ተርብ እሰድዳለሁ፥ ኤዊያዊውንም ከነዓናዊውንም ኬጢያዊውንም ከፊትህ አባርራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ባድማ እንዳትሆን፥ የምድር አራዊትም እንዳይበዙብህ፥ በአንድ ዓመት ከፊታችሁ አላባርራቸውም።

verses.text_english: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እስክትበዛ ምድርንም እስክትወርስ ድረስ በጥቂት በጥቂት አባርራቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.text_amharic: ድንበርህንም ከኤርትራ ባሕር እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ባሕር፥ ከምድረ በዳም እስከ ወንዙ ድረስ አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድር የሚኖሩትን በእጅህ እጥላለሁና፤ ከፊትህም ታባርራቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱና ከአማልክቶቻቸው ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርግ።

verses.text_english: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አማልክቶቻቸውንም ብታመልክ ወጥመድ ይሆኑብሃልና እኔን እንድትበድል እንዳያደርጉህ በአገርህ አይቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንም። አንተ አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ውጡ፥ በሩቁም ስገዱ፤

verses.text_english: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ብቻውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይቅረብ፥ እነርሱ ግን አይቅረቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ከእርሱ ጋር አይውጡ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም መጣ ለሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃሎች ሁሉ ሥርዓቱንም ሁሉ ነገረ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በአንድ ድምፅ። እግዚአብሔር የተናገራቸውን ቃሎች ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ብለው መለሱ።

verses.text_english: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃሎች ጻፈ፤ ማለዳም ተነሣ፥ ከተራራውም በታች መሠዊያን፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ሐውልቶች ለአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት እንዲያቀርቡ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስለ ደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በሬዎችን እንዲሠዉ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ጐበዛዝት ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took half of the blood, and put in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የደሙን እኵሌታ ወስዶ በቆሬ ውስጥ አደረገው፤ የደሙንም እኵሌታ በመሠዊያው ረጨው።

verses.text_english: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.text_amharic: የቃል ኪዳኑንም መጽሐፍ ወስዶ ለሕዝቡ አነበበላቸው፤ እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እናደርጋለን እንታዘዛለንም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ደሙን ውስዶ በሕዝቡ ላይ ረጨው። በዚህ ቃል ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር ያደረገው የቃል ኪዳኑ ደም እነሆ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወጡ፤

verses.text_english: And they saw the God of Israel: and under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in clearness.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ አዩ፤ ከእግሩም በታች እንደ ሰማይ መልክ የሚያበራ እንደ ብሩህ ሰንፔር ድንጋይ የሚመስል ወለል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም በእስራኤል አዛውንቶች ላይ አልዘረጋም፤ እነርሱም እግዚአብሔርን አዩ፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ወደ እኔ ወደ ተራራው ውጣ፥ በዚያም ሁን፤ እነርሱን ታስተምር ዘንድ እኔ የጻፍሁትን ሕግና ትእዛዝ የድንጋይም ጽላት እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና ሎሌው ኢያሱ ተነሡ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌዎችንም። ወደ እናንተ እስክንመለስ ድረስ በዚህ ቆዩን፤ አሮንና ሖርም እነሆ ከእናንተ ጋር ናቸው፥ ነገረተኛም ቢኖር ወደ እነርሱ ይምጣ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፥ ደመናውም ተራራውን ሸፈነው።

verses.text_english: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ደመናውም ስድስት ቀን ሸፈነው፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ከደመናው ውስጥ ሙሴን ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And the sight of the glory of the LORD like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በተራራው ራስ ላይ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር መታየት እንደሚያቃጥል እሳት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ ደመናው ውስጥ ገባ ወደ ተራራውም ወጣ፤ ሙሴም በተራራው ላይ አርባ ቀን አርባ ሌሊትም ቆየ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.text_amharic: ስጦታ ያመጡልኝ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ በገዛ እጁ ሊሰጠኝ በልቡ ከሚያምረው ሰው ሁሉ መባ ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: And this the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የምትቀበሉት መባ ይህ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' ,
verses.text_amharic: ወርቅ፥ ብር፥ ናስም፥ ሰማያዊና ሐምራዊ ቀይም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩ በፍታም፥

verses.text_english: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.text_amharic: የፍየልም ጠጕር፥ ቀይ የአውራ በግ ቁርበት፥ የአቆስጣ ቁርበት፥ የግራርም እንጨት፥

verses.text_english: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.text_amharic: የመብራትም ዘይት፥ ለቅብዓት ዘይትና ለጣፋጭ ዕጣን ቅመም፥

verses.text_english: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.text_amharic: መረግድም፥ ለኤፉድና ለደረት ኪስ የሚደረግ ፈርጥ።

verses.text_english: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም አድር ዘንድ መቅደስ ይሥሩልኝ።

verses.text_english: According to all that I shew thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make .
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንደማሳይህ ሁሉ፥ እንደ ማደሪያው ምሳሌ እንደ ዕቃውም ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ እንዲሁ ሥሩት።

verses.text_english: And they shall make an ark shittim wood: two cubits and a half the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከግራር እንጨትም ታቦትን ይሥሩ፤ ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ተኩል፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል፥ ቁመቱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጥና በውጭም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለብጠው፤ በእርሱም ላይ በዙሪያው የወርቅ አክሊል አድርግለት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put in the four corners thereof; and two rings in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.text_amharic: አራት የወርቅ ቀለበቶችም አድርግለት፥ እነርሱንም በአራቱ እግሮቹ ላይ አኑር፤ በአንድ ወገን ሁለት ቀለበቶች፥ በሌላው ወገን ሁለት ቀለበቶች ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make staves shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.text_amharic: መሎጊያዎችንም ከግራር እንጨት ሥራ፥ በወርቅም ለብጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.text_amharic: ለታቦቱ መሸከሚያ በታቦቱ ጐን ባሉት ቀለበቶች መሎጊያዎቹን አግባ።

verses.text_english: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.text_amharic: መሎጊያዎቹም በታቦቱ ቀለበቶች ውስጥ ይኑሩ፥ ከቶም አይውጡ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.text_amharic: በታቦቱም ውስጥ እኔ የምሰጥህን ምስክር ታስቀምጣለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make a mercy seat pure gold: two cubits and a half the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥሩ ወርቅም ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ተኩል፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል የሆነ የስርየት መክደኛ ሥራ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make two cherubims gold, beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ኪሩቤል ከተቀጠቀጠ ወርቅ ሥራ፥ በስርየት መክደኛውም ላይ በሁለት ወገን ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከስርየት መክደኛውም ጋር አንዱን ኪሩብ በአንድ ወገን፥ ሁለተኛውንም ኪሩብ በሌላው ወገን አድርገህ በአንድ ላይ ትሠራዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And the cherubims shall stretch forth wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.text_amharic: ኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸውን ወደ ላይ ይዘረጋሉ፥ የስርየት መክደኛውንም በክንፎቻቸው ይሸፍናሉ፥ ፊታቸውም እርስ በርሱ ይተያያል፤ የኪሩቤልም ፊቶቻቸው ወደ ስርየት መክደኛው ይመለከታሉ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.text_amharic: የስርየት መክደኛውንም በታቦቱ ላይ ታደርገዋለህ፤ እኔም የምሰጥህን ምስክር በታቦቱ ውስጥ ታኖረዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which upon the ark of the testimony, of all which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ከአንተ ጋር እገናኛለሁ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ታዝዝ ዘንድ የምሰጥህን ነገር ሁሉ፥ በምስክሩ ታቦት ላይ ባለው በሁለት ኪሩቤል መካከል፥ በስርየት መክደኛውም ላይ ሆኜ እነጋገርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt also make a table shittim wood: two cubits the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ርዝመቱም ሁለት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱ አንድ ክንድ ተኩል የሆነ ገበታ ከግራር እንጨት ሥራ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.text_amharic: በጥሩም ወርቅ ትለብጠዋለህ፤ በዙሪያውም የወርቅ አክሊል አድርግለት፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም አንድ ጋት የሚያህል ክፈፍ አድርግለት፤ የወርቅም አክሊል በክፈፉ ዙሪያ አድርግለት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that on the four feet thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አራትም የወርቅ ቀለበቶች አድርግለት፤ ቀለበቶቹንም አራቱ እግሮቹ ባሉበት በአራቱ ማዕዘኖች አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.text_amharic: ገበታውንም ለመሸከም መሎጊያዎቹ እንዲሰኩባቸው ቀለበቶቹ በክፈፉ አቅራቢያ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the staves shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.text_amharic: ገበታውን ይሸከሙባቸው ዘንድ መሎጊያዎቹን ከግራር እንጨት ሠርተህ በወርቅ ለብጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.text_amharic: ለማፍሰሻም ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወጭቶችዋን ጭልፋዎችዋንም መቅጃዎችዋንም ጽዋዎችዋንም አድርግ፤ እነርሱንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ አድርጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.text_amharic: በገበታም ላይ የገጽ ኅብስት ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make a candlestick pure gold: beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.text_amharic: መቅረዝንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ አድርግ፤ መቅረዙ ከእግሩና ከአገዳው ጋር በተቀጠቀጠ ሥራ ይደረግ፤ ጽዋዎቹም ጕብጕቦቹም አበቦቹም አንድነት በእርሱ ይደረጉበት።

verses.text_english: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.text_amharic: በስተጎኑ ስድስት ቅርንጫፎች ይውጡለት፤ ሦስት የመቅረዙ ቅርንጫፎች በአንድ ወገን፥ ሦስትም የመቅረዙ ቅርንጫፎች በሌላ ወገን ይውጡ።

verses.text_english: Three bowls made like unto almonds, a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.text_amharic: በአንደኛውም ቅርንጫፍ ጕብጕብና አበባ ሦስትም የለውዝ አበባ የሚመስሉትን ጽዋዎች፥ በሁለተኛውም ቅርንጫፍ ጕብጕብና አበባ ሦስትም የለውዝ አበባ የሚመስሉትን ጽዋዎች፤ እንዲሁም ከመቅረዙ ለሚወጡ ለስድስቱ ቅርንጫፎች አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And in the candlestick four bowls made like unto almonds, their knops and their flowers.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅረዙም ጕብጕቦቹንና አበቦቹን አራትም የለውዝ አበባ የሚመስሉትን ጽዋዎች አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.text_amharic: ከመቅረዙ ለሚወጡ ለስድስቱ ቅርንጫፎች ከሁለት ቅርንጫፎች በታች አንድ ሆኖ የተሠራ አንድ ጕብጕብ፥ ከሁለትም ቅርንጫፎች በታች አንድ ሆኖ የተሠራ አንድ ጕብጕብ፥ ደግሞ ከሁለት ቅርንጫፎች በታች አንድ ሆኖ የተሠራ አንድ ጕብጕብ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it one beaten work pure gold.
verses.text_amharic: ጕብጕቦቹና ቅርንጫፎቹ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር አንድ ይሁኑ፤ ሁሉም አንድ ሆኖ ከተቀረጸ ከጥሩ ወርቅ ይደረግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱንም መብራቶች ሥራ፤ በፊቱ ያበሩ ዘንድ መብራቶቹን ያቀጣጥሉአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, pure gold.
verses.text_amharic: መኰስተሪያዎችዋን የኵስታሪ ማድረጊያዎችዋንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.text_amharic: መቅረዙም ዕቃውም ሁሉ ከአንድ መክሊት ጥሩ ወርቅ ይሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And look that thou make after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.text_amharic: በተራራ ላይ እንዳሳየሁህ ምሳሌ እንድትሠራ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle ten curtains fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታ፥ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ የተሠሩ አሥር መጋረጆች ያሉበትን ማደሪያ ሥራ፤ ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ ኪሩቤል በእነርሱ ላይ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: The length of one curtain eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.text_amharic: የእያንዳንዱ መጋረጃ ርዝመት ሀያ ስምንት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አራት ክንድ ይሁን፤ የመጋረጆቹ ሁሉ መጠን ትክክል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and five curtains coupled one to another.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱ መጋረጆች እርስ በርሳቸው የተጋጠሙ ይሁኑ፤ አምስቱም መጋረጆች እንዲሁ እርስ በርሳቸው የተጋጠሙ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚጋጠሙት መጋረጆች በአንደኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ የሰማያዊውን ግምጃ ቀለበቶች አድርግ፤ ደግሞ ከተጋጠሙት ከሌሎች በአንደኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ እንዲሁ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.text_amharic: አምሳ ቀለበቶችን በአንድ መጋረጃ አድርግ፥ አምሳውንም ቀለበቶች በሁለተኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ አድርግ፤ ቀለበቶቹ ሁሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ፊት ለፊት ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: አምሳ የወርቅ መያዣዎች ሥራ፤ ማደሪያውንም አንድ እንዲሆን መጋረጆችን እርስ በርሳቸው በመያዣዎች አጋጥማቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make curtains goats' to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.text_amharic: ከማደሪያውም በላይ ለድንኳን የሚሆኑ መጋረጆች ከፍየል ጠጕር አድርግ፤ አሥራ አንድ መጋረጆች ታደርጋለህ።

verses.text_english: The length of one curtain thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains of one measure.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም መጋረጃ ርዝመቱ ሠላሳ ክንድ፥ እያንዳንዱም መጋረጃ ወርዱ አራት ክንድ ይሁን፤ የአሥራ አንዱም መጋረጆች መጠናቸው ትክክል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱ መጋረጆች አንድ ሆነው ይጋጠሙ፥ ስድስቱም መጋረጆች እርስ በርሳቸው አንድ ሆነው ይጋጠሙ፤ ስድስተኛውም መጋረጃ በድንኳኑ ፊት ይደረብ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.text_amharic: ከተጋጠሙት መጋረጆች በአንደኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ አምሳ ቀለበቶች አድርግ፤ ደግሞ ከተጋጠሙት ከሌሎቹ በአንድኛው መጋረጃ ዘርፍ ላይ እንዲሁ አምሳ ቀለበቶች አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.text_amharic: አምሳም የናስ መያዣዎችን ሥራ፥ መያዣዎችንም ወደ ቀለበቶች አግባቸው፥ ድንኳኑም አንድ እንዲሆን አጋጥመው።

verses.text_english: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ከድንኳኑ መጋረጆች የቀረ ትርፍ ግማሽ መጋረጃ በማደሪያው ጀርባ ይንጠልጠል።

verses.text_english: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያውን እንዲሸፍን ከርዝመቱ በአንድ ወገን አንድ ክንድ፥ በአንድ ወገንም አንድ ክንድ ከድንኳኑ መጋረጆች የቀረው ትርፍ በማደሪያው ውጭ በወዲህና በወዲያ ይንጠልጠል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above badgers' skins.
verses.text_amharic: ለድንኳኑም መደረቢያ ከቀይ አውራ በግ ቁርበት፥ ከዚያም በላይ ሌላ መደረቢያ ከአቆስጣ ቁርበት አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle shittim wood standing up.
verses.text_amharic: ለማደሪያውም የሚቆሙትን ሳንቆች ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Ten cubits the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of one board.
verses.text_amharic: የሳንቃው ሁሉ ርዝመቱ አሥር ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ተኩል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Two tenons in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ አንዱን በአንዱ ላይ የሚያያይዙ ሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ይሁኑለት፤ ለማደሪያው ሳንቆች ሁሉ እንዲሁ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.text_amharic: ለማደሪያውም በደቡብ ወገን ሀያ ሳንቆችን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.text_amharic: ከሀያውም ሳንቆች በታች አርባ የብር እግሮችን አድርግ፤ ከእያንዳንዱ ሳንቃ በታች ለሁለት ማጋጠሚያዎች ሁለት እግሮች ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side twenty boards:
verses.text_amharic: ለማደሪያው ለሁለተኛው ወገን በሰሜን በኩል ሀያ ሳንቆች፥

verses.text_english: And their forty sockets silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም አርባ የብር እግሮች ይሁኑ፤ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ሁለት እግሮች ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.text_amharic: ለማደሪያውም በምዕራቡ ወገን በስተ ኋላ ስድስት ሳንቆችን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.text_amharic: ለማደሪያውም ለሁለቱ ማዕዘን በስተ ኋላ ሁለት ሳንቆችን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.text_amharic: ከታችም እስከ ላይ እስከ አንደኛው ቀለበት ድረስ አንዱ ሳንቃ ድርብ ይሁን፤ እንዲሁም ለሁለቱ ይሁን፤ እነርሱም ለሁለቱ ማዕዘን ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.text_amharic: ስምንት ሳንቆችና አሥራ ስድስት የብር እግሮቻቸው ይሁኑ፤ ከእያንዳንዱም ሳንቃ በታች ሁለት እግሮች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make bars shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.text_amharic: ከግራርም እንጨት በማደሪያው በአንድ ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎች፥

verses.text_english: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.text_amharic: በማደሪያውም በሁለተኛው ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎች፥ በማደሪያውም በስተ ኋላ በምዕራብ ወገን ላሉት ሳንቆች አምስት መወርወሪያዎች አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.text_amharic: መካከለኛውም መወርወሪያ በሳንቆች መካከል ከዳር እስከ ዳር ይለፍ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings gold places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.text_amharic: ሳንቆቹንም በወርቅ ለብጣቸው፤ ቀለበቶቻቸውንም የመወርወሪያ ቤት እንዲሆኑላቸው ከወርቅ ሥራቸው፤ መወርወሪያዎችንም በወርቅ ለብጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያውንም በተራራ እንዳሳየሁህ ምሳሌ አቁም።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make a vail blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.text_amharic: መጋረጃውንም ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም አድርግ፤ ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ ኪሩቤል በእርሱ ላይ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim overlaid with gold: their hooks gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.text_amharic: በወርቅ በተለበጡት ከግራር እንጨትም በተሠሩት በአራቱ ምሰሶች ላይ ስቀለው፤ ኩላቦቻቸውም ከወርቅ፥ አራቱም እግሮቻቸው ከብር የተሠሩ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy and the most holy.
verses.text_amharic: መጋረጃውንም ከመያዣዎቹ በታች ታንጠለጥለዋለህ፥ በመጋረጃውም ውስጥ የምስክርን ታቦት አግባው፤ መጋረጃውም በቅድስቱና በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ መካከል መለያ ይሁናችሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy .
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ውስጥ የስርየት መክደኛውን በምስክሩ ታቦት ላይ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.text_amharic: ገበታውንም በመጋረጃው ውጭ፥ መቅረዙንም በገበታው ፊት ለፊት በማደሪያው በደቡብ ወገን አድርግ፤ ገበታውንም በሰሜን ወገን አድርገው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.text_amharic: ለድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ መጋረጃ አድርግለት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars shittim , and overlay them with gold, their hooks gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.text_amharic: ለመጋረጃውም አምስት ምሰሶች ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ፥ በወርቅም ለብጣቸው፤ ኩላቦቻቸውም ከወርቅ የተሠሩ ይሁኑ፤ አምስትም እግሮች አድርግላቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make an altar shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof three cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ርዝመቱ አምስት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አምስት ክንድ መሠዊያ ከግራር እንጨት አድርግ፤ አራት ማዕዘንም ይሁን፤ ከፍታውም ሦስት ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.text_amharic: በአራቱም ማዕዘን ቀንዶችን ታደርጋለህ፥ ቀንዶቹም ከእርሱ ጋር በአንድ የተሠሩ ይሁኑ፤ በናስም ለብጠው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make brass.
verses.text_amharic: አመድ የሚሆንባቸውን ምንቸቶች፥ መጫሪያዎቹንም፥ ድስቶቹንም፥ ሜንጦቹንም፥ ማንደጃዎቹንም አድርግ፤ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ከናስ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ መረብ ሆኖ የተሠራ የናስ መከታ አድርግለት፤ ለመከታውም አራት የናስ ቀለበት በአራት ማዕዘኑ አድርግለት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: መከታውም እስከ መሠዊያው እኵሌታ ይደርስ ዘንድ በመሰዊያው በሚዞረው በእርከኑ ታች አድርገው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.text_amharic: ለመሠዊያውም ከግራር እንጨት መሎጊያዎችን ሠርተህ በናስ ለብጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.text_amharic: መሎጊያዎቹም በቀለበቶች ውስጥ ይግቡ፤ መሠዊያውንም ስትሸከሙ መሎጊያዎቹ በሁለቱ ወገኖች ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make .
verses.text_amharic: ከሳንቆች ሠርተህ ባዶ አድርገው፤ በተራራው እንዳሳየሁህ ምሳሌ እንዲሁ ያድርጉት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward hangings for the court fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.text_amharic: የማደሪያውንም አደባባይ ሥራ፤ በደቡብ ወገን የጥሩ በፍታ መጋረጆች ይሁኑለት፥ የአንዱም ወገን ርዝመት መቶ ክንድ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets silver.
verses.text_amharic: ከናስ የተሠሩ ሀያ ምሰሶችና ሀያ እግሮች ይሁኑለት፤ የምሰሶቹም ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች የብር ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And likewise for the north side in length hangings of an hundred long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets silver.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በሰሜን ወገን መቶ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸው መጋረጆች፥ ከናስ የተሠሩ ሀያ ምሶሶች ሀያም እግሮች ይሁኑ፤ ለምሰሶችም የብር ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And the breadth of the court on the west side hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራብም ወገን ለአደባባዩ ስፋት አምሳ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸው መጋረጆች፥ አሥርም ምሰሶች፥ አሥርም እግሮች ይሁኑለት።

verses.text_english: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅም ወገን የአደባባዩ ስፋት አምሳ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: The hangings of one side fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ ወገን የመጋረጆቹ ርዝመት አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ይሁን፤ ምሰሶቹም ሦስት፥ እግሮቹም ሦስት ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And on the other side hangings fifteen : their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.text_amharic: በሌላውም ወገን የመጋረጆች ርዝመት አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ይሆናል፤ ምሰሶቹም ሦስት፥ እግሮቹም ሦስት ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And for the gate of the court an hanging of twenty cubits, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.text_amharic: ለአደባባዩም ደጅ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከጥሩ በፍታም በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ ሀያ ክንድ መጋረጃ ይሆናል፤ ምሰሶቹም አራት፥ እግሮቹም አራት ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: All the pillars round about the court filleted with silver; their hooks silver, and their sockets brass.
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባዩም ዙሪያ ላሉት ምሰሶች ሁሉ የብር ዘንጎች፥ የብርም ኩላቦች፥ የናስም እግሮች ይሁኑላቸው።

verses.text_english: The length of the court an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits fine twined linen, and their sockets brass.
verses.text_amharic: የአደባባዩ ርዝመት መቶ ክንድ ስፋቱም አምሳ ክንድ ይሁን፥ የመጋረጃውም ከፍታ አምስት ክንድ ይሁን፤ መጋረጃውም ከጥሩ በፍታ፥ እግሮቹም ከናስ የተሠሩ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, brass.
verses.text_amharic: ለማገልገል ሁሉ የማደሪያው ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ ካስማዎቹም ሁሉ የአደባባዩም ካስማዎች ሁሉ፥ የናስ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም መብራቱን ሁልጊዜ ያበሩት ዘንድ ለመብራት ተወቅጦ የተጠለለ ጥሩ የወይራ ዘይት እንዲያመጡልህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በምስክሩ ታቦት ፊት ባለው መጋረጃ ውጭ አሮንና ልጆቹ ከማታ እስከ ማለዳ ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲበራ ያሰናዱት፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ለልጅ ልጃቸው የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ወንድምህን አሮንን ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለይተህ ካህናት ይሆኑልኝ ዘንድ ወደ አንተ አቅርብ፤ አሮንን የአሮንንም ልጆች፥ ናዳብን አብዮድንም አልዓዛርንም ኢታምርንም፥ አቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሰውንም ልብስ ለክብርና ለጌጥ እንዲሆን ለወንድምህ ለአሮን ሥራለት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt speak unto all wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ካህን ሆኖ እንዲያገለግለኝ አሮን ቅዱስ ይሆን ዘንድ ልብስ እንዲሠሩለት የጥበብ መንፈስ ለሞላሁባቸው በልባቸው ጥበበኞች ለሆኑት ሁሉ ተናገር።

verses.text_english: And these the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሠሩአቸውም ልብሶች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የደረት ኪስ ኤፉድም ቀሚስም ዝንጕርጕር ሸሚዝም መጠምጠሚያም መታጠቂያም፤ እነዚህም ካህናት ይሆኑልኝ ዘንድ ለወንድምህ ለአሮን ለልጆቹም የተቀደሰ ልብስ ያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.text_amharic: ወርቅንም፥ ሰማያዊና ሐምራዊ ቀይም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩ በፍታም ይውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And they shall make the ephod gold, blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፉዱንም በብልሃት የተሠራ በወርቅና በሰማያዊ በሐምራዊም በቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ ያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and it shall be joined together.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱ ወገን አንድ እንዲሆን በሁለቱ ጫንቃ ላይ የሚጋጠም ጨርቅ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.text_amharic: በላዩም መታጠቂያ ሆኖ በብልሃት የተጠለፈው የኤፉድ ቋድ እንደ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድ ይሁን፤ ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊ ከቀይ ግምጃም ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታም የተሠራ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: ሁለትም የመረግድ ድንጋይ ወስደህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስም ስማቸውን ቅረጽባቸው፤

verses.text_english: Six of their names on one stone, and six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አወላለዳቸው ስድስት ስም በአንድ ድንጋይ፥ የቀረውንም ስድስቱን ስም በሌላው ቅረጽ።

verses.text_english: With the work of an engraver in stone, the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
verses.text_amharic: በቅርጽ ሠራተኛ ሥራ እንደ ማኅተም ቅርጽ አድርገህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስም በሁለት ድንጋዮች ቅረጽ በወርቅም ፈርጥ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆችም የመታሰቢያ ድንጋዮች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሁለቱን ዕንቍዎች በኤፉዱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ ታደርጋለህ፤ አሮንም በሁለቱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ ለመታሰቢያ ስማቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make ouches gold;
And two chains pure gold at the ends; wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
verses.text_amharic: ብልህ ሠራተኛም እንደሚሠራ የፍርዱን የደረት ኪስ ሥራው እንደ ኤፉዱም አሠራር ሥራው፤ ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከጥሩ በፍታም ሥራው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.text_amharic: ርዝመቱ ስንዝር ስፋቱም ስንዝር ሆኖ ትክክልና ድርብ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Foursquare it shall be doubled; a span the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በአራት ተራ የሆነ የዕንቍ ፈርጥ አድርግበት፤ በፊተኛው ተራ ሰርድዮን፥ ቶጳዝዮን፥ የሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: row a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: the first row.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ተራ በሉር፥ ሰንፔር፥ አልማዝ፤

verses.text_english: And the second row an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ተራ ያክንት፥ ኬልቄዶን፥ አሜቴስጢኖስ፤

verses.text_english: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ተራ ቢረሌ፥ መረግድ፥ ኢያስጲድ በወርቅ ፈርጥ ይደረጋሉ።

verses.text_english: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
verses.text_amharic: የዕንቈቹም ድንጋዮች እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ስሞች አሥራ ሁለት ይሆናሉ፤ በየስማቸውም ማተሚያ እንደሚቀረጽ ይቀረጹ፤ ስለ አሥራ ሁለቱ ነገዶችም ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.text_amharic: ለደረቱ ኪስም የተጐነጐኑትን ድሪዎች እንደ ገመድ አድርገህ ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሥራቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends wreathen work pure gold.
verses.text_amharic: ለደረቱ ኪስም ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሥራ፥ ሁለቱንም ቀለበቶች በደረቱ ኪስ በሁለቱ ወገን አድርጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.text_amharic: የተጐነጐኑትንም ሁለቱን የወርቅ ድሪዎች በደረቱ ኪስ ወገኖች ወዳሉት ወደ ሁለቱ ቀለበቶች ታገባቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put the two wreathen of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለቱንም ድሪዎች ጫፎች በሁለቱ ፈርጦች ውስጥ አግብተህ በኤፉዱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ በፊታቸው ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And two ends of the two wreathen thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶችም ሥራ፥ እነርሱንም በኤፉዱ ፊት ለፊት ባለው በደረቱ ኪስ በሁለቱ ጫፎች ላይ ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which in the side of the ephod inward.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሥራ፥ በኤፉዱም ፊት ከጫንቃዎች በታች በብልሃት ከተጠለፈ ከኤፉዱ ቋድ በላይ በመያዣው አጠገብ ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And two rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.text_amharic: የደረቱም ኪስ በብልሃት ከተጠለፈ ከኤፉዱ ቋድ በላይ እንዲሆን ከኤፉዱም እንዳይለይ፥ የደረቱን ኪስ ከቀለበቶቹ ወደ ኤፉዱ ቀለበቶች በሰማያዊ ፈትል ያስሩታል።

verses.text_english: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ወደ መቅደስ በገባ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም መታሰቢያ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስሞች በፍርዱ በደረት ኪስ ውስጥ በልቡ ላይ ይሸከም።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy , for a memorial before the LORD continually.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርዱ በደረት ኪስም ውስጥ ኡሪምንና ቱሚምን ታደርጋለህ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት በገባ ጊዜ በአሮን ልብ ላይ ይሆናሉ፤ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ፍርድ በልቡ ላይ ይሸከማል።
