verses.text_amharic: ከናስ የተሠሩ ሀያውን ምሰሶችና ሀያውን እግሮች አደረገ፤ የምሰሶቹንም ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች ከብር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And for the north side an hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets silver.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜኑም ወገን መቶ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸውን መጋረጆች፥ ከናስም የተሠራ ሀያ ምሰሶችንና ሀያ እግሮችን፥ ለምሰሶቹም የብር ኩላቦችንና ዘንጎችን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And for the west side hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets silver.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራብም ወገን አምሳ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸውን መጋረጆች፥ አሥሩንም ምሰሶች፥ አሥሩንም የናስ እግሮች፥ ለምሰሶቹም የብር ኩላቦችንና ዘንጎችን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅም ወገን አምሳ ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸውን መጋረጆች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: The hangings of the one side fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ ወገንም የመጋረጆቹ ርዝመት አሥራ አምስት ክንድ፥ ምሰሶቹም ሦስት፥ እግሮቹም ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በሁለተኛው ወገን በአደባባዩ ደጅ በዚህና በዚያ አሥራ አምስት ክንድ ርዝመት ያላቸው መጋረጆች፥ ሦስትም ምሰሶች፥ ሦስትም እግሮች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All the hangings of the court round about of fine twined linen.
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባዩ ዙሪያ ያሉ መጋረጆች ሁሉ ከተፈተለ ከጥሩ በፍታ ተሠርተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the sockets for the pillars brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters silver; and all the pillars of the court filleted with silver.
verses.text_amharic: የምሰሶቹም እግሮች የናስ፥ የምሰሶቹም ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች የብር ነበሩ፤ የምሰሶችም ጕልላቶች በብር ተለብጠው ነበር፤ በአደባባዩ ላሉ ምሰሶች ሁሉ የብር ዘንጎች ነበሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the hanging for the gate of the court needlework, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits the length, and the height in the breadth five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.text_amharic: የአደባባዩም ደጅ መጋረጃ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ፥ ከጥሩም በፍታ በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ ነበረ፤ ርዝመቱ ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፥ ቁመቱም እንደ አደባባዩ መጋረጆች አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And their pillars four, and their sockets brass four; their hooks silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets silver.
verses.text_amharic: ከናስ የተሠሩ ምሰሶቹም አራት፥ እግሮቹም አራት ነበሩ፤ ኩላቦቹ የብር ነበሩ፤ ጕልላቶቹና ዘንጎቹም በብር ተለብጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, brass.
verses.text_amharic: የማደሪያውም ካስማዎች በዙሪያውም ያለ የአደባባዩ ካስማዎች የናስ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: This is the sum of the tabernacle, of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.text_amharic: በሙሴ ትእዛዝ ለሌዋውያን ማገልገል ሊሆን በካህኑ በአሮን ልጅ በኢታማር እጅ እንደ ተቈጠረው የማደሪያው፥ የምስክሩ ማደሪያ፥ ዕቃ ድምር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ነገድም የሆነ የሆር የልጅ ልጅ፥ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤል እግዚአብሔር ለሙሴ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And with him Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ከዳን ነገድ የሆነ የአሂሳሚክ ልጅ ኤልያብ ነበረ፤ እርሱም የቅርጽ ሠራተኛና ብልህ ሠራተኛ፥ በሰማያዊ በሐምራዊም በቀይም ግምጃ፥ በጥሩም በፍታ የሚሠራ ጠላፊ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy , even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰጠው ወርቅ ሁሉ፥ በመቅደሱ ሥራ ሁሉ የተደረገው ወርቅ፥ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ሀያ ዘጠኝ መክሊት ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.text_amharic: በማኅበሩም ከሚቈጠሩት የተገኘ ብር፥ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን፥ መቶ መክሊትና አንድ ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ከሰባ አምስት ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: A bekah for every man, , half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty .
verses.text_amharic: እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን፥ የሰቅል ግማሽ ከተቈጠረው ከእያንዳንዱ ሰው የተሰጠ ነው፤ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ ስድስት መቶ ሦስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.text_amharic: መቶውም የብር መክሊት የመቅደሱንና የመጋረጃውን እግሮች ለመሥራት ነበረ፤ ከመቶውም መክሊት መቶ እግሮች አደረገ፤ ለአንድ እግርም አንድ መክሊት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.text_amharic: ከሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሰባ አምስት ሰቅል የምሰሶቹን ኩላቦችና ዘንጎች አደረገ፥ የምሰሶቹንም ጕልላቶች ለበጠ።

verses.text_english: And the brass of the offering seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰጠውም ናስ ሰባ መክሊትና ሁለት ሺህ አራት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ደጃፍ እግሮች፥ የናሱንም መሠዊያ፥ ለእርሱም የሆነውን የናሱን መከታ፥ የመሠዊያውንም ዕቃ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባዩ ዙሪያ ያሉትን እግሮች፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ እግሮች፥ የማደሪያውንም ካስማዎች ሁሉ በአደባባዩ ዙሪያም ያሉትን ካስማዎች ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy , and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ በመቅደሱ ለማገልገል ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይ ግምጃም በብልሃት የተሠራ ልብስ፥ ለአሮንም የተቀደሰውን ልብስ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And he made the ephod gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ ኤፉዱን ከወርቅ ከሰማያዊም ከሐምራዊም ከቀይ ግምጃም ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut wires, to work in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, cunning work.
verses.text_amharic: ወርቁንም ቀጥቅጠው እንደ ቅጠል ስስ አድርገው እንደ ፈትል ቈረጡ። ብልህ ሠራተኛም እንደሚሠራ ሰማያዊ ሐምራዊም ቀይም ግምጃ የተፈተለም ጥሩ በፍታ ከእርሱ ጠለፉ።

verses.text_english: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱ ወገን እንዲጋጠም በሁለቱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ የሚጋጠም ልብስ አደረጉት።

verses.text_english: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that upon it, of the same, according to the work thereof; gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በላዩም መታጠቂያ ሆኖ በብልሃት የተጠለፈው የኤፉዱ ቋድ እንደ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድ ነበረ፤ ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊ ከቀይ ግምጃም ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ የተሠራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ በወርቅ ፈርጥ የተያዙ የመረግድ ድንጋዮች ሠርተው እንደ ማኅተም ቅርጽ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስም ቀረጹባቸው።

verses.text_english: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች የመታሰቢያ ድንጋዮች ይሆኑ ዘንድ በኤፉዱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And he made the breastplate cunning work, like the work of the ephod; gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ የደረቱን ኪስ ብልህ ሠራተኛ እንደሚሠራ እንደ ኤፉዱ አሠራር ከወርቅና ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, doubled.
verses.text_amharic: አራት ማዕዘንም ነበረ፤ የደረቱን ኪስም ድርብ አደረጉ፤ ርዝመቱ ስንዝር፥ ወርዱም ስንዝር፥ ድርብም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they set in it four rows of stones: row a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this the first row.
verses.text_amharic: ዕንቍዎቹንም በአራት ተራ አደረጉበት፤ በፊተኛውም ተራ ሰርድዮን፥ ቶጳዝዮን፥ የሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፤

verses.text_english: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ተራ በሉር፥ ሰንፔር፥ አልማዝ፤

verses.text_english: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ተራ ያክንት፥ ኬልቄዶን፥ አሜቴስጢኖስ፤

verses.text_english: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ተራ ቢረሌ፥ መረግድ፥ ኢያስጲድ በወርቅ ፈርጥ ተደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the stones according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.text_amharic: የዕንቍዎችም ድንጋዮች እንደ አሥራ ሁለቱ እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ስሞች ነበሩ፤ በየስማቸውም ማተሚያ እንደሚቀረጽ ተቀረጹ፥ ስለ አሥራ ሁለቱም ነገዶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, wreathen work pure gold.
verses.text_amharic: ለደረቱ ኪስም የተጐነጐኑትን ድሪዎች እንደ ገመድ አድርገው ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And they made two ouches gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለትም የወርቅ ፈርጦች፥ ሁለትም የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሠሩ፤ ሁለቱንም ቀለበቶች በደረቱ ኪስ በሁለቱ ወገን አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም የተጐነጐኑትን የወርቅ ድሪዎች በደረቱ ኪስ ወገኖች ወዳሉት ወደ ሁለቱ ቀለበቶች አገቡ።

verses.text_english: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለቱንም ድሪዎች ጫፎች በሁለቱ ፈርጦች ውስጥ አግብተው በኤፉዱ ጫንቃዎች ላይ በፊታቸው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they made two rings of gold, and put on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሠሩ፥ እነርሱንም በኤፉዱ ፊት ለፊት ባለው በደረቱ ኪስ በሁለት ጫፎቹ ላይ አደረጉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they made two golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሁለት የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ሠሩ፥ በኤፉዱም ፊት፥ ከጫንቃዎች በታች፥ በብልሃት ከተጠለፈ ከኤፉዱ ቋድ በላይ፥ በመያዣው አጠገብ አደረጉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: የደረቱ ኪስ በብልሃት ከተጠለፈው ከኤፉዱ ቋድ በላይ እንዲሆን፥ ከኤፉዱም እንዳይለይ የደረቱን ኪስ ከቀለበቶቹ ጋር ወደ ኤፉዱ ቀለበቶች በሰማያዊ ፈትል አሰሩት።

verses.text_english: And he made the robe of the ephod woven work, all blue.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ የኤፉዱን ቀሚስ ሞላውን በሸማኔ ሥራ ሰማያዊ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.text_amharic: በቀሚሱም መካከል አንገትጌ ነበረ፤ እንዳይቀደድም እንደ ጥሩር የተሠራ ጥልፍ በአንገትጌው ዙሪያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates blue, and purple, and scarlet, twined .
verses.text_amharic: በቀሚሱም ታችኛ ዘርፍ ከሰማያዊ ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ፥ ከተፈተለ በፍታም ሮማኖች አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they made bells pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.text_amharic: ከጥሩ ወርቅም ሻኵራዎችን ሠሩ፥ ሻኵራዎቹንም ከሮማኖች መካከል በቀሚሱ ዘርፍ ዙሪያ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister ; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በቀሚሱ ዘርፍ ዙሪያ ሻኵራንና ሮማንን፥ ሻኵራንና ሮማንን ለማገልገል አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they made coats fine linen woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ እንደ ሸማኔ ሥራ ከጥሩ በፍታ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ሸሚዞችን፥

verses.text_english: And a mitre fine linen, and goodly bonnets fine linen, and linen breeches fine twined linen,
verses.text_amharic: ከጥሩ በፍታም መጠምጠሚያውን፥ ከጥሩ በፍታም መልካሞቹን ቆቦች፥ ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ የእግር ሱሪዎችን፥

verses.text_english: And a girdle fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ከተፈተለም ከጥሩ በፍታ፥ ከሰማያዊም ከሐምራዊም ከቀይም ግምጃ በጥልፍ አሠራር የተሠራ መታጠቂያውን አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they made the plate of the holy crown pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ ከጥሩ ወርቅ የተቀደሰውን የአክሊል ምልክት ሠሩ፤ በእርሱም እንደ ማኅተም ቅርጽ አድርገው። ቅድስና ለእግዚአብሔር የሚል ጻፉበት።

verses.text_english: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በመጠምጠሚያውም ላይ ያንጠለጥሉት ዘንድ ሰማያዊውን ፈትል አሰሩበት።

verses.text_english: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም የመገናኛው ድንኳን የማደሪያው ሥራ ሁሉ ተጨረሰ። እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉ፤ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያውንም፥ ድንኳኑንም፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ወደ ሙሴ አመጡ፤ መያዣዎቹን፥ ሳንቆቹን፥ መወርወሪያዎቹን፥ ምሰሶቹንም፥ እግሮቹንም፤

verses.text_english: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.text_amharic: ከቀይ ከአውራ በግ ቁርበትም የተሠራ መደረቢያ፥ ከአቆስጣ ቁርበትም የተሠራ መደረቢያ፥ የሚሸፍነውንም መጋረጃ፤

verses.text_english: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.text_amharic: የምስክሩንም ታቦት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም፥ የስርየት መክደኛውንም፤

verses.text_english: The table, all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.text_amharic: ገበታውንም፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት፤

verses.text_english: The pure candlestick, the lamps thereof, the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.text_amharic: ጥሩውንም መቅረዝ፥ መብራቶቹንም፥ በተራ የሚሆኑትንም ቀንዲሎች፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የመብራቱንም ዘይት፤

verses.text_english: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.text_amharic: የወርቁንም መሠዊያ፥ የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት፥ ጣፋጩንም ዕጣን፥ የድንኳኑንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፤

verses.text_english: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.text_amharic: የናሱንም መሠዊያ፥ የናሱንም መከታ፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም፥ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንም መቀመጫውንም፤

verses.text_english: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.text_amharic: የአደባባዩንም መጋረጆች፥ ምሰሶቹንም፥ እግሮቹንም፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥ አውታሮቹንም፥ ካስማዎቹንም፥ ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ለማደሪያው ማገልገያ የሚሆኑን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ፤

verses.text_english: The cloths of service to do service in the holy , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስ ውስጥ ለማገልገል በብልሃት የተሠሩትን ልብሶች፥ በክህነትም ያገለግሉበት ዘንድ የተቀደሱትን የካህኑን የአሮንን ልብሶች፥ የልጆቹንም ልብሶች አመጡ።

verses.text_english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ሁሉ እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሥራውን ሁሉ ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሥራውን ሁሉ አየ፥ እነሆም አድርገውት ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አድርገውት ነበር፤ ሙሴም ባረካቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ከመጀመሪያው ወር በፊተኛው ቀን የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ማደሪያ ትተክላለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ውስጥ የምስክሩን ታቦት ታኖራለህ፥ ታቦቱንም በመጋረጃ ትጋርዳለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ገበታውንም አግብተህ በእርሱ ላይ የሚኖረውን ዕቃ ታሰናዳለህ፤ መቅረዙንም አግብተህ ቀንዲሎቹን ትለኵሳለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ለዕጣንም የሚሆነውን የወርቅ መሠዊያ በምስክሩ ታቦት ፊት ታኖራለህ፥ በማደሪያውም ደጃፍ ፊት መጋረጃውን ትጋርዳለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውንም መሠዊያ በመገናኛው ድንኳን በማደሪያው ደጅ ፊት ታኖረዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.text_amharic: የመታጠቢያውን ሰንም በመገናኛው ድንኳንና በመሠዊያው መካከል አኑረህ ውኃ ትጨምርበታለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም አደባባዩን ትተክላለህ፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ ትዘረጋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.text_amharic: የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት ወስደህ ማደሪያውን በእርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ትቀባለህ፥ እርሱንም ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ትቀድሳለህ፤ ቅዱስም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውንም መሠዊያ ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ትቀባዋለህ፥ መሠዊያውንም ትቀድሳለህ፤ መሠዊያውም ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.text_amharic: የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውን ቀብተህ ትቀድሳለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንንና ልጆቹንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አቅርበህ በውኃ ታጥባቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሰውንም ልብስ አሮንን ታለብሰዋለህ፤ በክህነትም ያገለግለኝ ዘንድ ቀብተህ ትቀድሰዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹንም አቅርበህ ሸሚዞችን ታለብሳቸዋለህ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.text_amharic: በክህነትም ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ አባታቸውን እንደ ቀባህ ትቀባቸዋለህ፤ መቀባታቸውም ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም ክህነት ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በፊተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ማደሪያው ተተከለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘው ሙሴ ማደሪያውን ተከለ፥ እግሮቹንም አኖረ፥ ሳንቆቹንም አቆመ፥ መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረገባቸው፥ ምሰሶቹንም አቆመ።

verses.text_english: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ድንኳኑንም በማደሪያው ላይ ዘረጋ፥ የድንኳኑን መደረቢያ በላዩ አደረገበት።

verses.text_english: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ጽላቱን ወስዶ በታቦቱ ውስጥ አኖረው፥ መሎጊያዎቹን በታቦቱ ዘንድ አደረገ፥ የስርየት መክደኛውንም በታቦቱ ላይ አኖረው፤

verses.text_english: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ታቦቱን ወደ ማደሪያው አገባ፥ የሚሸፍነውንም መጋረጃ አድርጎ የምስክሩን ታቦት ሸፈነ።

verses.text_english: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ገበታውን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ፥ ከመጋረጃው ውጭ፥ በማደሪያው በሰሜን በኩል አኖረው፤

verses.text_english: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራውን በላዩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አሰናዳ።

verses.text_english: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው መቅረዙን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ፥ በገበታው ፊት ለፊት፥ በማደሪያው በደቡብ በኩል አኖረ፤

verses.text_english: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንዲሎቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለኰሰ።

verses.text_english: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው የወርቁን መሠዊያ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በመጋረጃው ፊት አኖረ፤

verses.text_english: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: የጣፋጩን ሽቱ ዕጣን ዐጠነበት።

verses.text_english: And he set up the hanging the door of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው በማደሪያው ደጃፍ ፊት መጋረጃውን ዘረጋ።

verses.text_english: And he put the altar of burnt offering the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን መሠዊያ በመገናኛው ድንኳን በማደሪያው ደጅ ፊት አኖረ፥ የሚቃጠለውንና የእህልን መሥዋዕት ሠዋበት።

verses.text_english: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው የመታጠቢያውን ሰን በመገናኛው ድንኳንና በመሠዊያው መካከል አኖረ፥ ለመታጠቢያም ውኃን ጨመረበት።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ሙሴና አሮን ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውንና እግሮቻቸውን ታጠቡ፤

verses.text_english: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን በገቡ ጊዜ፥ ወደ መሠዊያውም በቀረቡ ጊዜ ይታጠቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.text_amharic: በማደሪያውና በመሠዊያውም ዙሪያ አደባባዩን ተከለ፤ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ ዘረጋ። እንዲሁም ሙሴ ሥራውን ፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ከደነ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ማደሪያውን ሞላ።

verses.text_english: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም በላዩ ስለ ነበረ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ማደሪያውን ስለ ሞላ ሙሴ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ይገባ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም ከማደሪያው በተነሣ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች በመንገዳቸው ሁሉ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናው ባይነሣ እስከሚነሣበት ቀን ድረስ አይጓዙም ነበር።

verses.text_english: For the cloud of the LORD upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገዳቸውም ሁሉ በእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ፊት የእግዚአብሔር ደመና በማደሪያው ላይ በቀን ነበረና፥ እሳትም በሌሊት በዚያ ላይ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ሙሴን ጠርቶ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራችው። ከእናንተ ማናቸውም ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር መባ ሲያቀርብ መባችሁን ከእንስሳ ወገን ከላሞች ወይም ከበጎች ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: If his offering a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: መባውም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከላሞች መንጋ ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን ያቀርባል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲሠምር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ፊት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፤ ያስተሰርይለትም ዘንድ የሠመረ ይሆንለታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: በሬውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን ያቀርባሉ፤ ደሙንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ፊት ባለው በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ይገፍፈዋል፥ በየብልቱም ይቈርጠዋል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.text_amharic: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጆች በመሠዊያው ላይ እሳት ያነድዳሉ፥ በእሳቱም ላይ እንጨት ይደረድራሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that on the fire which upon the altar:
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ የተቈረቱትን ብልቶች ራሱንም ስቡንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ይረበርቡታል፤

verses.text_english: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹን ግን በውኃ ያጥባል፤ ካህኑም ሁሉን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And if his offering of the flocks, , of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባኑም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: በመሠዊያውም አጠገብ በሰሜን ወገን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that on the fire which upon the altar:
verses.text_amharic: በየብልቱም ራሱንም ስቡንም ይቈርጠዋል፤ ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ይረበርበዋል፤

verses.text_english: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring all, and burn upon the altar: it a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹን ግን በውኃ ያጥባል። ካህኑም ሁሉን አቅርቦ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚቀርበው ቍርባን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከወፎች ቢሆን፥ ቍርባኑን ከዋኖስ ወይም ከርግብ ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ወደ መሠዊያው ያቀርበዋል፥ ራሱንም ይቈለምመዋል፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ደሙም በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ይንጠፈጠፋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.text_amharic: የሆድ ዕቃውንም ከላባዎች ጋር ለይቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ በምሥራቅ ወገን በአመዱ ስፍራ ይጥለዋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, shall not divide asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that upon the fire: it a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በክንፎቹም ይቀድደዋል፥ ነገር ግን አይከፍለውም። ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.text_english: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ሲያቀርብ ቍርባኑ ከመልካም ዱቄት ይሁን፤ ዘይትም ያፈስስበታል፥ ዕጣንም ይጨምርበታል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አሮንም ልጆች ወደ ካህናቱ ያመጣዋል፤ ከመልካም ዱቄቱና ከዘይቱም አንድ እፍኝ ሙሉና ዕጣኑን ሁሉ ወስዶ ካህኑ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለመታሰቢያ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And the remnant of the meat offering Aaron's and his sons': a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.text_amharic: ከእህሉም ቍርባን የተረፈው ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.text_amharic: በእቶን የተጋገረውን የእህል ቍርባን ስታቀርብ በዘይት የተለወሰ የመልካም ዱቄት የቂጣ እንጐቻ ወይም በዘይት የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if thy oblation a meat offering in a pan, it shall be fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባንህም በምጣድ የተጋገረ የእህል ቍርባን ቢሆን፥ በዘይት የተለወሰ የመልካም ዱቄት ቂጣ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it a meat offering.
verses.text_amharic: ቈርሰህም ዘይት ታፈስስበታለህ፤ የእህል ቍርባን ነው።

verses.text_english: And if thy oblation a meat offering in the fryingpan, it shall be made fine flour with oil.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባንህም በመቀቀያ የበሰለ የእህል ቍርባን ቢሆን፥ ዘይት የገባበት ከመልካም ዱቄት የተደረገ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም የተደረገውን የእህል ቍርባን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታመጣለህ፤ ለካህኑም ይሰጣል፥ እርሱም ወደ መሠዊያው ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn upon the altar: an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን መታሰቢያውን አንሥቶ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And that which is left of the meat offering Aaron's and his sons': a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.text_amharic: ከእህሉም ቍርባን የተረፈው ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
verses.text_amharic: እርሾ ያለበት ነገር ማርም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ይሆን ዘንድ አታቀርቡምና ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ እርሾ አይሁንበት።

verses.text_english: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም የበኵራት ቍርባን አድርጋችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ታቀርባላችሁ፤ እንደ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ግን በመሠዊያው ላይ አይቃጠሉም።

verses.text_english: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.text_amharic: የምታቀርበውን የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ በጨው ታጣፍጠዋለህ፤ የአምላክህንም ቃል ኪዳን ጨው ከእህል ቍርባንህ አታጐድልም፤ በቍርባንህ ሁሉ ላይ ጨው ታቀርባለህ።

verses.text_english: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.text_amharic: ከበኵራትም የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታቀርብ ስለዚህ ቍርባን በእሳት የተጠበሰና የተፈተገ የእህል እሸት ታቀርባለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it a meat offering.
verses.text_amharic: ዘይትም ታፈስስበታለህ፥ ዕጣንም ትጨምርበታለህ፤ የእህል ቍርባን ነው።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, of the beaten corn thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከተፈተገው እህል ከዘይቱም ወስዶ ከዕጣኑ ሁሉ ጋር መታሰቢያውን ያቃጥላል፤ ይህ ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነው።

verses.text_english: And if his oblation a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer of the herd; whether a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባኑም የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ቢሆን፥ ከላሞች መንጋ ተባት ወይም እንስት ቢያቀርብ፥ ነውር የሌለበትን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ለቍርባን በቀረበው ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
verses.text_amharic: ከደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርባል፤ የሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that on them, which by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which upon the wood that on the fire: an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ጋር በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ያቃጥሉታል፤ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርበው ቍርባኑ ከበጎች ተባት ወይም እንስት ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለቍርባኑ ጠቦትን ቢያቀርብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ለቍርባን በቀረበው ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
verses.text_amharic: ከደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርባል፤ ስቡን፥ እስከ ጀርባውም ድረስ የተቈረጠ ላቱን ሁሉ፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that upon them, which by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ በእሳት ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የተደረገ የቍርባን መብል ነው።

verses.text_english: And if his offering a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባኑም ፍየል ቢሆን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም በራሱ ላይ ይጭንበታል፥ በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer thereof his offering, an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርበዋል፤ ሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that upon them, which by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat the LORD'S.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ በእሳት ላይ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የተደረገ መብል ነው። ስቡ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.text_amharic: ስብና ደም እንዳትበሉ በምትኖሩበት ሁሉ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፍ፥

verses.text_english: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀባውም ካህን በሕዝቡ ላይ በደል እንዲቈጠርባቸው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ ስለ ሠራው ስለ ኃጢአቱ ነውር የሌለበት ወይፈን ለእግዚአብሔር ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ወይፈኑንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያመጣዋል፤ እጁንም በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ ይጭነዋል፥ ወይፈኑንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: የተቀባውም ካህን ከወይፈኑ ደም ወስዶ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ያመጣዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ጣቱን በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመቅደሱ መጋረጃ ፊት ደሙን ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለው ጣፋጭ ዕጣን በሚታጠንበት መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ከደሙ ያደርጋል፤ የተረፈውንም የወይፈኑን ደም ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ ባለው ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that upon the inwards,
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት ከሚታረደው ወይፈን ስብን ሁሉ ይወስዳል፤ ሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that upon them, which by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር፥

verses.text_english: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከታረደው ወይፈን እንደ ተወሰደው ይወስዳል። ካህኑም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.text_amharic: የወይፈኑን ቁርበት፥ ሥጋውንም ሁሉ፥ ራሱንም፥ እግሮቹንም፥ ሆድ ዕቃውንም፥

verses.text_english: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርሱንም፥ ወይፈኑን ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አመድ ወደሚፈስስበት ወደ ንጹሕ ስፍራ ይወስደዋል፥ በእንጨትም ላይ በእሳት ያቃጥለዋል፤ አመድ በሚፈስስበት ስፍራ ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the commandments of the LORD which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ቢስቱ፥ ነገሩም ከጉባኤው ፊት ቢሸሸግ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፉ፥

verses.text_english: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ቢበድሉ፥ የሠሩት ኃጢአት ሲታወቅ ጉባኤው ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወይፈንን ያቀርባሉ፤ ወደ መገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት ያመጡታል።

verses.text_english: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የጉባኤውም ሽማግሌዎች እጆቻቸውን በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይጭናሉ፤ ወይፈኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታረዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: የተቀባውም ካህን ከወይፈኑ ደም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ያመጣል፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall dip his finger of the blood, and sprinkle seven times before the LORD, before the vail.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ጣቱን በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመጋረጃው ፊት ለፊት ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall put of the blood upon the horns of the altar which before the LORD, that in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ውስጥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ባለው በዕጣን መሠዊያው ቀንዶች ላይ ከደሙ ያደርጋል፤ ደሙንም ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ ባለው ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ስቡንም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በወይፈኑ ያደርጋል፤ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት በታረደው ወይፈን እንዳደረገ እንዲሁ በዚህ ያደርጋል፤ ካህኑም ስለ እነርሱ ያስተሰርያል፥ እነርሱም ይቅር ይባላሉ።

verses.text_english: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ወይፈኑንም ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ይወስደዋል፥ የፊተኛውንም ወይፈን እንዳቃጠለ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ይህ የማኅበሩ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: When a ruler hath sinned, and done through ignorance any of the commandments of the LORD his God which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.text_amharic: አንድ መኰንንም ኃጢአትን ሲሠሩ፥ ሳያውቅም እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ። አትሥራ ያለውን ትእዛዝ ሲተላለፍ፥ እንዲህም ሲበድል፥

verses.text_english: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.text_amharic: የሠራው ኃጢአት ቢታወቅ፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባት ፍየል ለቍርባኑ ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: በፍየሉም ራስ ላይ እጁን ይጭናል፤ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ እርሱ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ያደርገዋል፤ የተረፈውንም ደም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: ስቡንም ሁሉ እንደ ደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ስብ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ካህኑም ኃጢአቱን ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth any of the commandments of the LORD which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.text_amharic: ከአገሩ ሕዝብም አንድ ሰው ኃጢአትን ሳያውቅ ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥራ ያለውን ትእዛዝ ቢተላለፍ፥ ቢበድልም፥

verses.text_english: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም የሠራው ኃጢአት ቢታወቀው፥ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ነውር የሌለባትን እንስት ፍየል ለቍርባኑ ያመጣል።

verses.text_english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፤ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ የኃጢአትን መስዋዕት ያርዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከደምዋ በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ያደርገዋል፥ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: ስቡም ሁሉ ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ላይ እንደሚወሰድ፥ ስብዋን ሁሉ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ካህኑም ስለ እርሱ ያስተሰርያል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት የበግ ጠቦት ቢያቀርብ፥ ነውር የሌለባትን እንስት ያመጣል።

verses.text_english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያርዳታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ያደርገዋል፥ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: ስቡ ሁሉ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከታረደው ጠቦት ላይ እንደሚወሰድ ስብዋን ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት በተቃጠለው ቍርባን ላይ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and a witness, whether he hath seen or known ; if he do not utter , then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሰው የሚያምለውን ቃል ቢሰማ፥ ምስክር ሆኖም አንድ ነገር አይቶ እንደ ሆነ ወይም አውቆ እንደ ሆነ ባይናገር፥ ኃጢአት መሥራቱ ነውና በደሉን ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳይታወቀው ርኩስ ነገር ቢነካ፥ የረከሰም አውሬ በድን፥ ወይም የረከሰ ከብት በድን፥ ወይም የረከሰ የተንቀሳቀሰ እንስሳ በድን ቢሆን፥ እርሱም ርኩስ ቢሆን ነገሩ በታወቀው ጊዜ በደል ይሆንበታል፤

verses.text_english: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth , then he shall be guilty.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ርኩስነቱን ሳይውቅ ርኩስን ሰው ቢነካ፥ በማናቸውም ርኵሰት ቢረክስ፥ ነገሩ በታወቀው ጊዜ በደል ይሆንበታል።

verses.text_english: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth , then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ክፉን ወይም መልካምን ያደርግ ዘንድ ሳያስብ በከንፈሩ ተናግሮ ቢምል፤ ሳያስብ የማለው ስለ ማናቸውም ነገር ቢሆን፤ በታወቀው ጊዜ ከዚህ ነገር በአንዱ በደለኛ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these , that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that :
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህ ነገሮች በአንዲቱ በደለኛ ሲሆን፥ የሠራውን ኃጢአት ይናዘዛል።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ለእግዚአብሔር የበደል መሥዋዕት ያመጣል፤ እርሱም ከመንጋው የበግ ወይም የፍየል እንስት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ይሆናል፤ ካህኑም ስለ ኃጢአቱ ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.text_english: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ለበደል መሥዋዕት ጠቦትን ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ያልበቃ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች፥ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer which for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide asunder:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ካህኑም ያመጣቸዋል፤ እርሱም አስቀድሞ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን ያቀርባል፥ ራሱንም ከአንገቱ ይቈለምመዋል፥ ነገር ግን አይቈርጠውም።

verses.text_english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአቱም መሥዋዕት ደም በመሠዊያው ግድግዳ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤ የተረፈውም ደም ከመሠዊያው በታች ይንጠፈጠፋል፤ እርሱ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer the second a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሥርዓቱም ሁለተኛውን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያዘጋጀዋል። ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put frankincense thereon: for it a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ያልበቃ እንደ ሆነ፥ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል መልካም ዱቄት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፤ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነውና ዘይት አያፈስስበትም፥ ዕጣንም አይጨምርበትም።

verses.text_english: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, a memorial thereof, and burn on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ካህኑም ያመጣዋል፥ ካህኑም መታሰቢያው ይሆን ዘንድ ከእርሱ እፍኝ ሙሉ ይውሰድ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም በእሳት በተቃጠለው ቍርባን ላይ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ እርሱም የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከእነዚያ በአንዳቸው ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል። የተረፈውም እንደ እህል ቍርባን ለካህኑ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ቢበድል፥ ሳያውቅም ለእግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው በማናቸውም ነገር ኃጢአትን ቢሠራ፥ ለበደል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ከመንጋ ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ያቀርባል፤ እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን በብር ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ለበደል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰ ነገር ላይ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ዕዳ ይከፍላል፥ አምስተኛውንም እጅ ይጨምርበታል፥ ለካህኑም ይሰጠዋል። ካህኑም በበደል መሥዋዕት አውራ በግ ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፍ፥ ባያውቅም፥ ያ ሰው በደለኛ ነው፥ ኃጢአቱንም ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist not, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ከመንጋው ለበደል መሥዋዕት እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጣዋል፤ ካህኑም ሳያውቅ ስለ ሳተው ስሕተት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: It a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ በእውነት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በደለኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ኃጢአትን ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ቢበድል፥ ያኖረበትን አደራ ወይም ብድር ወስዶ ባልንጀራውን ቢክድ፥ ወይም ቢቀማ፥ ወይም በባልንጀራው ላይ ግፍ ቢያደርግ፥

verses.text_english: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
verses.text_amharic: ወይም የጠፋውን ነገር ቢያገኝ፥ ያንንም ሸሽጎ በሐሰት ቢምል፥ ሰው ከሚያደርጋቸው ከእነዚህ ነገሮች ሁሉ በአንዲቱ ቢበድል፥

verses.text_english: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ኃጢአትን ሠርቶ በደለኛ ቢሆን፥ በቅሚያ የወሰደውን ወይም በግፍ የተቀበለውን ወይም የተሰጠውን አደራ ወይም ጠፍቶ ያገኘውን፥

verses.text_english: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም በሐሰት የማለበትን ነገር ይመልስ፤ በሙሉ ይመልስ፥ ከዚያም በላይ አምስተኛውን ክፍል ጨምሮ የበደሉን መሥዋዕት በሚያቀርብበት ቀን ለባለ ገንዘቡ ይስጠው።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ በደል መሥዋዕትም ለእግዚአብሔር ከመንጋው ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን ስለ በደል መሥዋዕት ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣ።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ስለዚያም ስላደረገው በደል ሁሉ ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This the law of the burnt offering: It the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንንና ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። የሚቃጠለው የመሥዋዕቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በመሠዊያው ላይ ባለው እንጨት ላይ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ እስኪጸባ ድረስ ይሆናል፤ እሳቱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ዘወትር ይነድዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የበፍታ ቀሚስና የበፍታ ሱሪ በሥጋው ላይ ይለብሳል፤ በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት እሳቱ ከበላው በኋላ አመዱን አንሥቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሱንም ያወልቃል፥ ሌላም ልብስ ይለብሳል፤ አመዱንም ተሸክሞ ከሰፈሩ ንጹሕ ስፍራ ወደ ሆነ ወደ ውጭ ያወጣዋል።

verses.text_english: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: እሳቱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ዘወትር ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋም፤ ካህኑም ማለዳ ማለዳ እንጨት ያቃጥልበታል፤ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በዚያ ላይ ይረበርባል፤ በዚያም የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ስብ ያቃጥላል።

verses.text_english: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.text_amharic: ዘወትር በመሠዊያው ላይ እሳት ይነድዳል፤ አይጠፋም።

verses.text_english: And this the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉም ቍርባን ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የአሮን ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመሠዊያው ፊት ያቀርቡታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which upon the meat offering, and shall burn upon the altar a sweet savour, the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን መልካሙን ዱቄት ከዘይት ጋር እፍኝ ሙሉ፥ ደግሞም በእህሉ ቍርባን ላይ ያለውን ዕጣን ሁሉ ያነሣል፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለመታሰቢያ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም የተረፈውን አሮንና ልጆቹ ይበሉታል፤ ቂጣ ሆኖ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበላል፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዙሪያ ባለው አደባባይ ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it their portion of my offerings made by fire; it most holy, as the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሾ ቦክቶ አይጋገርም። እርሱን ከእሳቱ ቍርባኔ ለእነርሱ እድል ፈንታ እንዲሆን ሰጠሁ፤ እርሱም እንደ ኃጢአትና እንደ በደል መሥዋዕት ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ከቀረበ ከእሳት ቍርባን ለዘላለም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ እድል ፈንታቸው እንዲሆን ከአሮን ልጆች ወንዶቹ ሁሉ ይበሉታል። የሚነካቸው ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: This the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀቡበት ቀን የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል መልካሙን ዱቄት እኵሌታውን በጥዋት፥ እኵሌታውንም በማታ ለዘወትር የእህል ቍርባን አድርገው ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርቡት የአሮንና የልጆቹ ቍርባን ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: In a pan it shall be made with oil; baken, thou shalt bring it in: the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘይት ጋር በምጣድ ላይ ይደረጋል፤ ሲለወስ ታገባዋለህ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የእህሉን ቍርባን ቈራርሰህ ታቀርበዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.text_amharic: ከልጆቹም በአባቱ ፋንታ የተቀባው ካህን ያቀርበዋል። ለዘላለም ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ፈጽሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የሚያቀርበው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ይቃጠላል፤ ከእርሱም አንዳች አይበላም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it most holy.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንንና ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ የኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታረዳል፤ እርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአት የሚሠዋው ካህን ይበላዋል፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዙሪያ ባለው አደባባይ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበላል።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋውን የሚነካ ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ ማናቸው ልብስ ደም ቢረጭበት የተረጨበትን በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ታጥበዋለህ።

verses.text_english: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቀቀልበትም ሸክላ ይሰበራል፤ በናስም ዕቃ ቢቀቀል ይፈገፈጋል፥ በውኃም ይለቀለቃል።

verses.text_english: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it most holy.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናት ወገን የሆነ ወንድ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ይበላል፤ እርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: And no sin offering, whereof of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile in the holy , shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ለማስተስረያ ይሆን ዘንድ ከደሙ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን የሚገባው የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁሉ አይበላም፤ በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: Likewise this the law of the trespass offering: it most holy.
verses.text_amharic: የበደል መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በሚያርዱበት ስፍራ የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ያርዱታል፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.text_amharic: ስቡንም ሁሉ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that on them, which by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶቹ ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it a trespass offering.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ እርሱ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it most holy.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናት ወገን የሆነ ወንድ ሁሉ ይበላዋል፤ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበሉታል፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: As the sin offering , so the trespass offering: one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have .
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ለሁለቱ አንድ ሕግ ነው፤ በእርሱ የሚያስተሰርይ ካህን ይወስደዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.text_amharic: የማናቸውንም ሰው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ ካህን ያቀረበው የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ቁርበት ለዚያው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.text_amharic: በእቶን የተጋገረው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ፥ በመቀቀያም ወይም በምጣድ የበሰለው ሁሉ ለሚያቀርበው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as another.
verses.text_amharic: በዘይትም የተለወሰው ወይም የደረቀው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአሮን ልጆች ሁሉ ይሆናል፤ ለሁሉም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And this the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.text_amharic: ለምስጋና ቢያቀርበው፥ ከምስጋናው መሥዋዕት ጋር በዘይት የተለወሰ የቂጣ እንጎቻ፥ በዘይትም የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: Besides the cakes, he shall offer his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ለምስጋና የሚሆነውን የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ባቀረበ ጊዜ እርሾ ያለበትን ኅብስት ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation an heave offering unto the LORD, it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ከቍርባኑም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን እንዲሆን ከእነርሱ አንዱን ያነሣል። እርሱም የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ደም ለሚረጨው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ለምስጋና የሚሆነው የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በሚቀርብበት ቀን ይበሉታል፤ ከእርሱ እስከ ነገ ምንም አያድርም።

verses.text_english: But if the sacrifice of his offering a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.text_amharic: የቍርባኑም መሥዋዕት የስእለት ወይም የፈቃድ ቢሆን፥ መሥዋዕቱ በሚቀርብበት ቀን ይብሉት፤ ከእርሱም የቀረውን በነጋው ይብሉት፤

verses.text_english: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ከመሥዋዕቱም ሥጋ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን የሚቆየው በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: And if of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛው ቀን ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ አይሠምርም፤ ላቀረበው ሰው የተጠላ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ቍርባን ሆኖ አይቈጠርለትም፤ ከእርሱም ቢበላ ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ርኩስ ነገር የሚነካውን ሥጋ አይብሉት፤ በእሳት ይቃጠል። ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው ሁሉ ግን ከሥጋው ይብላ።

verses.text_english: But the soul that eateth the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም የረከሰ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከሆነው ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean the uncleanness of man, or unclean beast, or any abominable unclean , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውንም ርኵስ ነገር ቢነካ፥ የሰውን ወይም የረከሰን እንስሳ ወይም ሌላውን የተጠላ ርኩስን ቢነካ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከሆነው ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። የበሬ ወይም የበግ ወይም የፍየል ስብ ከቶ አትብሉ።

verses.text_english: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.text_amharic: የሞተውን ስብ፥ አውሬ የሰበረውንም ስብ ለሌላ ተግባር አድርጉት፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ምንም አትብሉ፤

verses.text_english: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth shall be cut off from his people.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከእንስሳ ስብ የሚበላ ሁሉ፥ ያ የበላ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋልና።

verses.text_english: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: በማደሪያዎቻችሁም ሁሉ የወፍ ወይም የእንስሳ ደም ቢሆን አትብሉ።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever soul that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.text_amharic: ደም የሚበላ ሰው ሁሉ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ለእግዚአብሔር የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ ሰው ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር ከደኅንነቱ መሥዋዕት ያመጣል።

verses.text_english: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእርሱ እጆች ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳቱን ቍርባን ያመጣሉ፤ ፍርምባው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ይወዘውዝ ዘንድ ስቡንና ፍርምባውን ያመጣል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ስቡን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥላል፤ ፍርምባውም ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕታችሁ ቀኝ ወርቹን ለማንሣት ቍርባን እንዲሆን ለካህኑ ትሰጡታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for part.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሮንም ልጆች የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ደሙንና ስቡን ለሚያቀርብ ለእርሱ ቀኝ ወርቹ እድል ፈንታው ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የሚወዘወዘውን ፍርምባና የሚነሣውን ወርች ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕታቸው ወስጄአለሁ፥ ለካህኑ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹም ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታ እንዲሆን ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: This of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በክህነት ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ባቀረባቸው ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነ ከእሳት ቍርባን የአሮንና የልጆቹ እድል ፈንታ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.text_amharic: ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታቸው እንዲሆን በቀባቸው ቀን የእስራኤል ልጆች ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: This the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የእህል ቍርባን፥ የኃጢአትና የበደል መሥዋዕት፥ የቅድስናና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሲና ምድረ በዳ ቍርባናቸውን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ባዘዘ ጊዜ በሲና ተራራ ለሙሴ ያዘዘው ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.text_amharic: አሮንን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹን፥ ልብሱንም፥ የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕትም የሆነውን ወይፈን፥ ሁለቱንም አውራ በጎች፥ የቂጣውንም እንጀራ ሌማት ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩንም ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሰብስባቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the congregation, This the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ማኅበሩን። እግዚአብሔር ይደረግ ዘንድ ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንንና ልጆቹን አቀረበ፥ በውኃም አጠባቸው።

verses.text_english: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound unto him therewith.
verses.text_amharic: ሸሚዝም አለበሰው፥ በመታጠቂያም አስታጠቀው፥ ቀሚስም አለበሰው፥ ኤፉድም ደረበለት፥ በብልሃትም በተጠለፈ ቋድ አስታጠቀውና በእርሱ ላይ አሰረው።

verses.text_english: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.text_amharic: የደረት ኪስ በእርሱ ላይ አደረገ፤ በደረቱ ኪስም ውስጥ ኡሪምንና ቱሚምን አኖረበት።

verses.text_english: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው በራሱ ላይ መጠምጠሚያውን አደረገ፤ በመጠምጠሚያውም ላይ በፊቱ በኩል የተቀደሰውን አክሊል፥ ቅጠል የሚመስለውን የወርቅ ምልክት፥ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that therein, and sanctified them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የቅብዓቱን ዘይት ወሰደ፥ ማደሪያውንና በውስጡ ያለውን ሁሉ ቀብቶ ቀደሳቸው።

verses.text_english: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ ረጨ፤ ይቀድሳቸውም ዘንድ መሠዊያውንና ዕቃውን ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውን ቀባ።

verses.text_english: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.text_amharic: ከቅብዓቱም ዘይት በአሮን ራስ ላይ አፈሰሰ፥ ይቀድሰውም ዘንድ ቀባው።

verses.text_english: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሙሴ የአሮንን ልጆች አቀረበ፥ ቀሚሶችንም አለበሳቸው፥ በመታጠቂያም አስታጠቃቸው፥ ቆብም ደፋባቸው።

verses.text_english: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአትንም መሥዋዕት ወይፈን አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ወይፈን ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.text_english: And he slew ; and Moses took the blood, and put upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.text_amharic: አረደውም፤ ሙሴም ደሙን ወስዶ በጣቱ የመሠዊያውን ቀንዶች ዙሪያ ቀባ፥ መሠዊያውንም አነጻው፤ ደሙንም ከመሠዊያው በታች አፈሰሰው፥ ያስተሰርይለትም ዘንድ ቀደሰው።

verses.text_english: And he took all the fat that upon the inwards, and the caul the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች ስባቸውንም ወሰደ፤ ሙሴም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.text_english: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ወይፈኑን፥ ቁርበቱንም፥ ሥጋውንም፥ ፈርሱንም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም የሚሆን አውራ በግ አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.text_english: And he killed ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.text_amharic: አረደውም፤ ሙሴም ደሙን በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ረጨው።

verses.text_english: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.text_amharic: አውራውንም በግ በየብልቱ ቈረጠ፤ ሙሴም ጭንቅላቱን ብልቶቹንም ስቡንም አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም በውኃ አጠበ፤ ሙሴም አውራውን በግ ሁሉ በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው፤ ይህ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.text_amharic: ለቅድስናም የሚሆነውን ሁለተኛውን አውራ በግ አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.text_english: And he slew ; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.text_amharic: አረደውም፤ ሙሴን ከደሙ ወስዶ የአሮንን የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት አስነካው።

verses.text_english: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንንም ልጆች አቀረበ፤ ሙሴም የቀኝ ጆሮአቸውን ጫፍ፥ የቀን እጃቸውንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግራቸውንም አውራ ጣት ከደሙ አስነካ፤ ሙሴም ደሙን በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ረጨ።

verses.text_english: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that upon the inwards, and the caul the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.text_amharic: ስቡንና ላቱን፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች ስባቸውንም፥ ቀኝ ወርቹንም ወሰደ፤

verses.text_english: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ካለው ከቂጣው እንጀራ ሌማት አንድ የቂጣ እንጐቻ፥ አንድም የዘይት እንጀራ፥ አንድም ስስ ቂጣ ወስዶ በስቡና በቀኝ ወርቹ ላይ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም በአሮንና በልጆቹ እጆች ላይ አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ወዘወዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt on the altar upon the burnt offering: they consecrations for a sweet savour: it an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከእጃቸው ተቀብሎ በመሠዊያው በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ላይ አቃጠለው፤ የጣፋጭ ሽታ መቀደሻ ነበረ። እርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቁርባን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the breast, and waved it a wave offering before the LORD: of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ፍርምባውን ወስዶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ወዘወዘው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ይህ ለቅድስና ከታረደው አውራ በግ የሙሴ እድል ፈንታ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which upon the altar, and sprinkled upon Aaron, upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከቅብዓቱ ዘይትና በመሠዊያው ላይ ካለው ከደሙ ወስዶ በአሮንና በልብሱ ላይ፥ በልጆቹና በልጆቹ ልብስ ላይ ረጨው፤ አሮንንና ልብሱንም፥ ልጆቹንም የልጆቹንም ልብስ ቀደሰ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንንና ልጆቹን አላቸው። ሥጋውን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ቀቅሉ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹ ይበሉታል ብዬ እንዳዘዝሁ በዚያ እርሱንና በሌማቱ ያለውን የቅድስናውን እንጀራ ብሉ።

verses.text_english: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ከሥጋውና ከእንጀራውም የተረፈውን በእሳት ታቃጥሉታላችሁ።
