verses.text_english: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀን ይክናችኋልና የክህነታችሁ ቀን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ሰባት ቀን ከማኅበሩ ድንኳን ደጃፍ አትውጡ።

verses.text_english: As he hath done this day, the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ቀን እንደ ተደረገ ለእናንተ ለማስተስረያ ይደረግ ዘንድ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall ye abide the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ አዝዞኛልና እንዳትሞቱ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሌሊቱንና ቀኑን ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጡ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥርዓት ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንና ልጆቹም እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሙሴ አሮንንና ልጆቹን የእስራኤልንም ሽማግሌዎች ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንንም አለው። ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ከመንጋው እምቦሳውን፥ ስለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አውራውን በግ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ወስደህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርባቸው።

verses.text_english: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ይገለጥላችኋልና ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየልን፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን እምቦሳና ጠቦትን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት በሬንና አውራን በግ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ የእህልን ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሠዉ ዘንድ ውሰዱ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they brought which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ያዘዛቸውን ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አመጡ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ቀርበው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, This the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። ታደርጉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ይገለጥላችኋል አለ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን። ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርበህ የኃጢአትህን መሥዋዕትና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን ሠዋ፥ ለራስህና ለሕዝቡም አስተስርይ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘ የሕዝቡን ቍርባን አቅርብ አስተስርይላቸውም አለው።

verses.text_english: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which for himself.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርቦ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን እምቦሳ አረደ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አቀረቡለት፤ ጣቱንም በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ የመሠዊያውን ቀንዶች አስነካ፥ ደሙንም ከመሠዊያው በታች አፈሰሰው።

verses.text_english: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ከኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ስቡንና ኵላሊቶቹን፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋውንና ቁርበቱንም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አረደ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አመጡለት፥ እርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ረጨው።

verses.text_english: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በየብልቱ፥ ራሱንም አመጡለት፤ እርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.text_english: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም አጠበ፤ በመሠዊያውም በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.text_english: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቡንም ቍርባን አቀረበ፤ ስለ ሕዝቡ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን ፍየል ወስዶ አረደው፥ ስለ ኃጢአትም እንደ ፊተኛው ሠዋው።

verses.text_english: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ እንደ ሥርዓቱም አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉንም ቍርባን አቀረበ፥ ከእርሱም እፍኝ ሙሉ ወስዶ በጥዋት ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ሌላ በመሰዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.text_english: He slew also the bullock and the ram a sacrifice of peace offerings, which for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡ የሆነውን የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በሬውንና አውራውን በግ አረደ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አመጡለት፥

verses.text_english: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth , and the kidneys, and the caul the liver:
verses.text_amharic: በመሠዊያውም ላይ በዙሪያው ረጨው፤ የበሬውንና የአራውንም በግ ስብ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ ኩላሊቶቹንም፥ የጉበቱንም መረብ አመጡለት።

verses.text_english: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.text_amharic: ስቡንም በፍርምባዎቹ ላይ አደረጉ፥ ስቡንም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለ፤

verses.text_english: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አሮን ፍርምባዎቹንና ቀኝ ወርቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቁርባን ወዘወዘው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም እጆቹን ወደ ሕዝቡ ዘረጋ ባረካቸውም፤ የኃጢያቱን የሚቃጠለውንም የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ከሠዋ በኋላ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ገቡ፤ ወጡም፥ ሕዝቡንም ባረኩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.text_amharic: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ስቡንም በላ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እልል አሉ፥ በግምባራቸውም ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች ናዳብና አብዩድ በየራሳቸው ጥናውን ወስደው እሳት አደረጉበት፥ በላዩም ዕጣን አኖሩበት፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እርሱ ያላዘዛቸውን ሌላ እሳት አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጥቶ በላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን። እግዚአብሔር። ወደ እኔ በሚቀርቡ እቀድሳለሁ፥ በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፊት እከብራለሁ ብሎ የተናገረው ይህ ነው አለው፤ አሮንም ዝም አለ

verses.text_english: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የአሮንን አጎት የዑዝኤልን ልጆች ሚሳኤልንና ኤልጻፋንን ጠርቶ። ቅረቡ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁንም ከመቅደሱ ፊት አንሥታችሁ ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ውሰዱአቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ቀርበው አነሡአቸው፥ ሙሴም እንዳለ በቀሚሳቸው ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ወሰዱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን፥ ልጆቹንም አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን። እንዳትሞቱ በማኅበሩም ሁሉ ላይ ቁጣ እንዳይወርድ ራሳችሁን አትንጩ፥ ልብሳችሁንም አትቅደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስላቃጠለው ማቃጠል ግን ወንድሞቻችሁ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ያልቅሱ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር የቅብዓት ዘይት በላያችሁ ነውና እንዳትሞቱ ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አትወጡም አላቸው። እንደ ሙሴ ቃልም አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.text_amharic: እንዳትሞቱ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ስትገቡ አንተና ልጆችህ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክርን ነገር ሁሉ አትጠጡ፤ ይህም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰውና ባልተቀደሰው፥ በርኩሱና በንጹሑም መካከል ትለያላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ ቃል የነገራቸውን ሥርዓት ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ታስተምራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it most holy:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን፥ የተረፉለትንም ልጆቹን አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን አላቸው። ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነው ከእሳት ቁርባን የቀረውን የእህሉን ቁርባን ውሰዱ፥ ቂጣም አድርጋችሁ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ብሉት እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አዞኛል፥

verses.text_english: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነው ከእሳት ቁርባን ለአንተም ለልጆችህም የተሰጠ ሥርዓት ነውና በቅዱስ ስፍራ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for thy due, and thy sons' due, are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕቶች ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ሥርዓት እንዲሆኑ ስለ ተሰጡ፥ የሚወዘወዘውን ፍርምባ፥ የሚነሣውንም ወርች አንተ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም ልጆችህ፥ ሴቶች ልጆችህም በንጹሕ ስፍራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
verses.text_amharic: የሚነሣውን ወርች የሚወዘወዘውንም ፍርምባ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቁርባን እንዲወዘውዙ የእሳት ቁርባን ከሆነው ስብ ጋር ያመጣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ ለአንተ ከአንተ ጋርም ለልጆችህ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron left , saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የኃጢያቱን መሥዋዕት ፍየል እጅግ ፈለገው፥ እነሆም ተቃጥሎ ነበር፤ ሙሴም የቀሩትን የአሮንን ልጆች አልአዛርንና ኢታምርን ተቈጥቶ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it most holy, and hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና፥ የሕዝቡንም ኃጢያት እንድትሸከሙ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እንድታስተሰርዩላቸው ለእናንተ ሰጥቶታልና ስለ ምን የኃጢያትን መሥዋዕት በቅዱሱ ስፍራ አልበላችሁም?

verses.text_english: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy : ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy , as I commanded.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ ደሙን ወደ መቅደሱ ውስጥ አላገባችሁትም፤ እኔ እንዳዘዝሁ በቅዱሱ ስፍራ ውስጥ ትበሉት ዘንድ ይገባችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ሙሴን። እነሆ ዛሬ የኃጢያታቸውን መሥዋዕት፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕታቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ደረሰብኝ፤ ዛሬስ የኃጢያት መሥዋዕት በበላሁ ኖሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም ኖሮአልን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And when Moses heard , he was content.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሰማ በፊቱም መልካም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በሉአቸው። ከምድር እንስሶች ሁሉ የምትበሉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰነጠቀ ሰኮና ያለውንና የሚያመሰኳውን እንስሳ ሁሉ ብሉ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he unclean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከሚያመሰኩት፥ ሰኮናቸው ስንጥቅ ከሆነው ከእነዚህ አትበሉም፤ ግመል ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he unclean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ሽኮኮ ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኰናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he unclean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ጥንቸልም ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he unclean to you.
verses.text_amharic: እርያም ሰኮናው ተሰንጥቋል፥ ነገር ግን ስለማያመሰኳ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they unclean to you.
verses.text_amharic: የእነዚህን ሥጋ አትበሉም፥ በድናቸውንም አትነኩም፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: These shall ye eat of all that in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.text_amharic: በውኃ ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ በውኆች በባሕሮችም በወንዞችም ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ ክንፍና ቅርፊት ያላቸውን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which in the waters, they an abomination unto you:
verses.text_amharic: በውኆቹ ውስጥ ከሚንቀሳቀሱ፥ በውኆች ውስጥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸው ሁሉ፥ በባሕሮችና በወንዞች ውስጥ ክንፍና ቅርፊት የሌላቸው ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተም ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ይሆናሉ፤ ሥጋቸውንም አትበሉም፥ በድናቸውንም ትጸየፋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that an abomination unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ክንፍና ቅርፊትም የሌላቸው በውኃ ውስጥ የሚኖሩት ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.text_amharic: ከወፎችም ወገን የምትጸየፉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ አይበሉም፤ የተጸየፉ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.text_amharic: ንስር፥ ገዲ፥ ዓሣ አውጭ፥ ጭላት፥ ጭልፊት በየወገኑ፥

verses.text_english: Every raven after his kind;
verses.text_amharic: ቁራ ሁሉ በየወገኑ፥

verses.text_english: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.text_amharic: ሰጎን፥ ጠላቋ፥ ዝዪ፥ በቋል በየወገኑ፥

verses.text_english: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
verses.text_amharic: ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራ፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳ በየወገኑ፥ ጅንጁላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።

verses.text_english: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.text_amharic: የሚበርርም፥ በአራት እግሮችም የሚሔድ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፈ ነው።

verses.text_english: All fowls that creep, going upon four, an abomination unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከሚበርሩት፥ አራትም እግሮች ካሉአቸው፥ ከእግሮቻቸውም በላይ በምድር ላይ የሚዘልሉባቸው ጭኖች ካሉአቸው ተንቀሳቃሾች እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ፤ አራቱን ዓይነት አንበጣዎች በየወገናቸው።

verses.text_english: these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሚበርር፥ አራትም እግሮች ያሉት ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፈ ነው።

verses.text_english: But all flying creeping things, which have four feet, an abomination unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም ርኩስ ትሆናላችሁ፤ የእነርሱንም በድን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በድን የሚያነሣ ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever beareth of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ሰኮናም ያለው፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ያልተሰነጠቀ፥ የማያመሰኳም እንሰሳ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፤ እርሱን የሚነካ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: of every beast which divideth the hoof, and not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: በአራት እግሮቹ ከሚሄድ እንስሳ ሁሉ በመዳፎቹ ላይ የሚሄድ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፤ የእርሱን በድን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on four, those unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: በድናቸውንም የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው። እነርሱም በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they unclean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይም ከሚንቀሳቀስ ተንቀሳቅሳሽ እነዚህ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው፤ ሙጭልጭላ፥ አይጥ፥ እንሽላሊት በየወገኑ፥

verses.text_english: These also unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊ፥ አዞ፥ ገበሎ፥ አርጃኖ፥ እስስት።

verses.text_english: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚንቀሳቀሱት ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች የሚሆኑ እነዚህ ናቸው። ከእነርሱም የሞተውን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: These unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የሞተውን የሚነካ በምንም ላይ ቢወድቅ እርሱ ርኩስ ነው፤ የእንጨት ዕቃ ወይም ልብስ ወይም ቁርበት ወይም ከረጢት ቢሆን የሚሠራበት ዕቃ ሁሉ እርሱ በውኃ ውስጥ ይደረግ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And upon whatsoever of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel , wherein work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዳች በውስጡ የወደቀበትን የሸክላውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ስበሩት፥ በውስጡም ያለው ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And every earthen vessel, whereinto of them falleth, whatsoever in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ውስጥ ያለው፥ ውኃም የሚፈስስበት የሚበላ መብል ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ በዚህም ዕቃ ሁሉ ያለው የሚጠጣ መጠጥ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Of all meat which may be eaten, on which water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every vessel shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም በድን የሚወድቅበት ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ እቶን ወይም ምድጃ ቢሆን ይሰባበራል፤ ርኩሶች ናቸው፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And every whereupon of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: they unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ምንጩ፥ ጕድጓዱም፥ የውኃውም ኵሬ ንጹሐን ናቸው፤ በድናቸውን ግን የሚነካ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ከበድናቸውም በሚዘራ ዘር ላይ አንዳች ቢወድቅ እርሱ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it clean.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በዘሩ ላይ ውኃ ቢፈስስበት፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ከበድናቸው አንዳች ቢወድቅበት፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if water be put upon the seed, and of their carcase fall thereon, it unclean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ለመብል ከሚሆኑላችሁ እንስሶች የሞተ ቢኖር፥ በድኑን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ከበድኑም የሚበላ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ በድኑንም የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀስ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ የተጸየፈ ነው፥ አትብሉትም።

verses.text_english: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.text_amharic: በሆዱ የሚሳብ፥ በአራትም እግሮች የሚሳብ፥ ብዙ እግሮችም ያሉት፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ የተጸየፉ ናቸውና አትብሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they an abomination.
verses.text_amharic: በሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ ሰውነታችሁን አታስጸይፉ፤ በእነርሱም እንዳትረክሱ ሰውነታችሁን አታርክሱባቸው።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና፤ ሰውነታችሁን ቀድሱ፥ ቅዱሳንም ሁኑ፥ እኔ ቅዱስ ነኝና፤ በምድርም ላይ በሚሳብ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ሰውነታችሁን አታርክሱ።

verses.text_english: For I the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አምላካችሁ እሆን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እንግዲህ እኔ ቅዱስ ነኝና እናንተ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: For I the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I holy.
verses.text_amharic: የእንስሳና የወፍ፥ በውኃም ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀስ የፍጥረት ሁሉ፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀስ የፍጥረት ሁሉ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: This the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.text_amharic: በርኩስና በንጹሕ መካከል፥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸውም በምትበሉትና በማትበሉት መካከል እንድትለዩ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ሴት ብታረግዝ ወንድ ልጅም ብትወልድ፥ ሰባት ቀን ያህል የረከሰች ናት፤ እንደ ሕመምዋ መርገም ወራት ትረክሳለች።

verses.text_english: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ልጁ ከሥጋው ሸለፈት ይገረዝ።

verses.text_english: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: ከደምዋም እስክትነጻ ሠላሳ ሦስት ቀን ትቀመጥ፤ የመንጻትዋ ቀንም እስኪፈጸም ድረስ የተቀደሰን ነገር አትንካ፥ ወደ መቅደስም አትግባ።

verses.text_english: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ልጅም ብትወልድ እንደ መርገምዋ ወራት ሁለት ሳምንት ያህል የረከሰች ናት፤ ከደምዋም እስክትነጻ ድረስ ስድሳ ስድስት ቀን ትቀመጥ።

verses.text_english: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.text_amharic: የመንጻትዋ ወራትም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ ለወንድ ልጅ ወይም ለሴት ልጅ፥ የአንድ ዓመት ጠቦት ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ የርግብም ግልገል ወይም ዋኖስ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ወደ ካህኑ ታምጣለት።

verses.text_english: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል ያስተሰርይላትማል፤ ከደምዋም ፈሳሽ ትነጻለች። ወንድ ወይም ሴት ለምትወልድ ሴት ሕጉ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቦት ለማምጣት ገንዘብዋ ያልበቃት እንደ ሆነ ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች፥ አንዱን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሌላውንም ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባለች፤ ካህኑም ያስተሰርይላታል፥ እርስዋም ትነጻለች።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ እባጭ ወይም ብጕር ወይም ቋቁቻ ቢታይ፥ በሥጋው ቁርበት እንደ ለምጽ ደዌ ቢመስል፥ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አሮን ወይም ከካህናቱ ልጆቹ ወደ አንዱ ያምጡት።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight deeper than the skin of his flesh, it a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በሥጋው ቁርበት ያለውን ደዌ ያያል፤ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ ደዌውም ወደ ሥጋው ቁርበት ቢጠልቅ፥ እርሱ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ካህኑም አይቶ። ርኩስ ነው ይበለው።

verses.text_english: If the bright spot white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up the plague seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ቋቁቻውም በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ ቢነጣ፥ ከቁርበቱም የጠለቀ ባይመስል፥ ጠጕሩም ባይነጣ፥ ካህኑ የታመመውን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, the plague in his sight be at a stay, the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በዓይኑ ፊት እንደ ነበረ ቢሆን፥ በቁርበቱም ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ደግሞ ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, the plague somewhat dark, the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ በሰባተኛው ቀን ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ቢከስም፥ ደዌውም በቁርበቱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ እከክ ነው፤ ልብሱንም አጥቦ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ መንጻቱ በካህኑ ዘንድ ከታየ በኋላ እከኩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ እንደ ገና ሊታይ ወደ ካህኑ ይቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it a leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ እከኩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.text_english: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.text_amharic: የለምጽ ደዌ በሰው ውስጥ ቢሆን እርሱን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጡለታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall see : and, behold, the rising white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ በቁርበቱ ላይ ነጭ እባጭ ቢሆን፥ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ሥጋውም በእባጩ ውስጥ ቢያዥ፥

verses.text_english: It an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he unclean.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ አሮጌ ለምጽ ነው፥ ካህኑም። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ እርሱ ርኩስ ነውና አይዘጋበትም።

verses.text_english: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.text_amharic: ለምጹም በቁርበቱ ላይ ሰፍቶ ቢወጣ፥ ለምጹም የታመመውን ሰው ቁርበቱን ሁሉ ከራሱ እስከ እግሮቹ ድረስ እንደ ከደነው ለካህኑ ቢመስለው፥ ካህኑ ያያል፤

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce clean the plague: it is all turned white: he clean.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ለምጹ ሥጋውን ሁሉ ቢከድን የታመመውን ሰው። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ ሥጋው ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ተለውጦ ነጭ ሆኖአል፤ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዠው ሥጋ ግን ሲታይበት ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: the raw flesh unclean: it a leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የሚያዠውን ሥጋ አይቶ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የሚያዠው ሥጋ ለምጽ ነውና ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዠውም ሥጋ ተለውጦ ቢነጣ እንደ ገና ወደ ካህኑ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce clean the plague: he clean.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ቢነጣ ካህኑ የታመመውን። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: The flesh also, in which, in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.text_amharic: በሥጋውም ቁርበት ላይ ቍስል ቢሆንና ቢሽር፥

verses.text_english: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.text_amharic: በቍስሉም ስፍራ ነጭ እባጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ቋቁቻ ቢወጣ፥ በካህኑ ዘንድ ይታያል።

verses.text_english: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ወደ ቁርበቱ ውስጥ ጠልቆ ቢታይ፥ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ከቍስሉ ውስጥ ወጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, no white hairs therein, and it not lower than the skin, but somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ቢያየው፥ ነጭም ጠጕር ባይኖርበት፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ውስጥ ባይጠልቅ ነገር ግን ቢከስም፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it a plague.
verses.text_amharic: በቁርበቱም ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ደዌ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if the bright spot stay in his place, spread not, it a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.text_amharic: ቋቁቻው ግን በስፍራው ቢቆም ባይሰፋም፥ የቍስል ጠባሳ ነው፤ ካህኑም። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: Or if there be flesh, in the skin whereof a hot burning, and the quick that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.text_amharic: በሥጋውም ቁርበት የእሳት ትኵሳት ቢኖርበት፥ በተቃጠለውም ስፍራ ነጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ቋቁቻ ቢታይ፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it sight deeper than the skin; it a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it the plague of leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ በቋቁቻው ጠጕሩ ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ውስጥ ቢጠልቅ፥ ለምጽ ነው፤ ከተቃጠለውም ስፍራ ወጥቶአል፤ ካህኑም። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, no white hair in the bright spot, and it no lower than the skin, but somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ቢያየው፥ በቋቁቻውም ነጭ ጠጕር ባይኖር፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ባይጠልቅ ነገር ግን ቢከስም፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it the plague of leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ያየዋል፤ በቁርበቱም ላይ ቢሰፋ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if the bright spot stay in his place, spread not in the skin, but it somewhat dark; it a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it an inflammation of the burning.
verses.text_amharic: ቋቁቻውም በስፍራው ላይ ቢቆም፥ በቁርበቱም ላይ ባይሰፋ ነገር ግን ቢከስም፥ የትኵሳት እባጭ ነው፤ የትኵሳትም ጠባሳ ነውና ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ወንድ ወይም ሴት በራሱ ወይም በአገጩ ደዌ ቢኖርበት፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it in sight deeper than the skin; in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it a dry scall, a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ደዌውን ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ወደ ቁርበቱ ቢጠልቅ፥ በውስጡም ቀጭን ብጫ ጠጕር ቢኖርበት፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ቈረቈር ነው፤ የራስ ወይም የአገጭ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it not in sight deeper than the skin, and no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የቈረቈሩን ደዌ ቢያይ፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ባይጠልቅ፥ ጥቁርም ጠጕር ባይኖርበት፥ ካህኑ የቈረቈር ደዌ ያለበትን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ደዌውን ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ቈረቈሩ ባይሰፋ፥ በውስጡም ብጫ ጠጕር ባይኖር፥ የቈረቈሩም መልክ ወደ ቁርበቱ ባይጠልቅ፥ ይላጫል፥

verses.text_english: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up the scall seven days more:
verses.text_amharic: ቈረቈሩ ግን አይላጭም፤ ካህኑም ቈረቈር ያለበትን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ደግሞ ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, the scall be not spread in the skin, nor in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ቈረቈሩን ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ቈረቈሩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ መልኩም ወደ ቁርበቱ ባይጠልቅ፥ ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ ልብሱን አጥቦ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.text_amharic: ከነጻ በኋላ ግን ቈረቈሩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ ያየዋል፤

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he unclean.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ቈረቈሩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ ካህኑ ብጫውን ጠጕር አይፈልግም፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.text_amharic: ቈረቈሩ ግን በዓይኑ ፊት እንደ ነበረ ቢሆን፥ ጥቁርም ጠጕር ቢበቅልበት፥ ቈረቈሩ ሽሮአል እርሱም ንጹሕ ነው፤ ካህኑም። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, white bright spots;
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ወንድ ወይም ሴት በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ ነጭ ቋቁቻ ቢኖርበት፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, the bright spots in the skin of their flesh darkish white; it a freckled spot groweth in the skin; he clean.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ በሥጋቸው ቁርበት ላይ ያለው ቋቁቻ ፈገግ ቢል አጓጐት ነው፤ ከቁርበቱ ውስጥ ወጥቶአል፤ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he bald; he clean.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውም ጠጕር ከራሱ ቢመለጥ እርሱ ቡሀ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he forehead bald: he clean.
verses.text_amharic: ጠጕሩም ከግምባሩ ቢመለጥ እርሱ ራሰ በራ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.text_amharic: በቡሀነቱ ወይም በራሰ በራነቱ ነጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ደዌ ቢኖርበት፥ እርሱ ከቡሀነቱ ወይም ከራሰ በራነቱ የወጣ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, the rising of the sore white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ የደዌው እብጠት፥ በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ የሆነ ለምጽ መስሎ፥ በቡሀነቱ ወይም በራሰ በራነቱ ነጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: He is a leprous man, he unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague in his head.
verses.text_amharic: ለምጻም ሰው ነው፤ ርኩስ ነው፤ ካህኑ። በእርግጥ ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ደዌው በራሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the leper in whom the plague , his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.text_amharic: የለምጽ ደዌ ያለበት ሰው ልብሱ የተቀደደ ይሁን፥ ራሱም የተገለጠ ይሁን፥ ከንፈሩንም ይሸፍን፤ ርኩስ ርኩስ ነኝ ይበል።

verses.text_english: All the days wherein the plague in him he shall be defiled; he unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp his habitation .
verses.text_amharic: ደዌው ባለበት ዘመን ሁሉ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ እርሱ ርኩስ ነው፤ ብቻውን ይቀመጣል፤ መኖሪያውም ከሰፈር በውጭ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.text_amharic: የለምጽም ደዌ በልብስ ላይ ቢሆን፥ ልብሱም የበግ ጠጕር ወይም በፍታ ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: Whether in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.text_amharic: በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ላይ ቢሆን፥ በፍታ ወይም የበግ ጠጕር ቢሆን፥ አጐዛ ወይም ከአጐዛ የሚደረግ ነገር ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.text_amharic: ደዌው በልብሱ ወይም በአጐዛው ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛው በሚደረገው ነገር አረንጓዴ ወይም ቀይ ቢሆን፥ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ለካህኑ ይታያል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up the plague seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ደዌውን አይቶ ደዌው ያለበትን ነገር ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, in any work that is made of skin; the plague a fretting leprosy; it unclean.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ደዌውን ያያል፤ ደዌውም በልብስ ላይ ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም በአጐዛው ወይም ከአጐዛው በሚደረግ ነገር ቢሰፋ፥ ደዌው እየፋገ የሚሄድ ለምጽ ነው፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሱን ያቃጥል፤ ድሩ ወይም ማጉ የበግ ጠጕር ወይም በፍታ ቢሆን ወይም ከአጐዛው የተደረገ ቢሆን፥ ደዌ ያለበት ሁሉ፥ እየፋገ የሚሄድ ለምጽ ነውና በእሳት ይቃጠል።

verses.text_english: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ቢያይ፥ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛ በተደረገ ነገር ቢሆን በልብሱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall command that they wash wherein the plague , and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ደዌ ያለበቱ ነገር እንዲታጠብ ይዘዝ፤ ሌላም ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it fret inward, it bare within or without.
verses.text_amharic: ደዌውም ከታጠበ በኋላ ካህኑ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው መልኩን ባይለውጥ ባይሰፋም፥ ርኩስ ነው፤ በእሳት አቃጥለው፤ ምልክቱ በውስጥ ወይም በውጭ ቢሆን እየፋገ የሚሄድ ደዌ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ቢያይ፥ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ከታጠበ በኋላ ቢከስም፥ ከልብሱ ወይም ከአጐዛው ወይም ከድሩ ወይም ከማጉ ይቅደደው።

verses.text_english: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it a spreading : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague with fire.
verses.text_amharic: በልብሱም ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛው በተደረገ ነገር ላይ ደግሞ ቢታይ፥ የወጣ ለምጽ ነው፤ ደዌው ያለበትን ነገር አቃጥለው።

verses.text_english: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin , which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ካጠብኸው ልብስ ወይም ከድሩ ወይም ከማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛው ከተደረገው ነገር ላይ ደዌው ቢጠፋ፥ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ይታጠባል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: This the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.text_amharic: በበግ ጠጕር ልብስ ወይም በበፍታ ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛ በተደረገ ነገር ላይ ቢሆን፥ ንጹሕ ወይም ርኩስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ የለምጽ ደዌ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.text_amharic: በመንጻቱ ቀን የለምጻሙ ሕግ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ወደ ካህኑ ይወስዱታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ይወጣል፤ ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ የለምጹ ደዌ ከለምጻሙ ላይ ቢጠፋ፥

verses.text_english: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ስለሚነጻው ሰው ሁለት ንጹሐን ወፎች በሕይወታቸው፥ የዝግባም እንጨት፥ ቀይ ግምጃም፥ ሂሶጵም ያመጣ ዘንድ ያዝዛል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከሁለቱ ወፎች አንዱን በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ በምንጭ ውኃ ላይ ያርድ ዘንድ ይዝዛል።

verses.text_english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird killed over the running water:
verses.text_amharic: ሕያውንም ወፍ ዝግባውንም እንጨት ቀዩንም ግምጃ ሂሶጱንም ወስዶ ከሕያው ወፍ ጋር በምንጭ ውኃ ላይ በታረደው ወፍ ደም ውስጥ ይነክራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
verses.text_amharic: ከለምጹ በሚነጻው ሰው ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል፤ ንጹሕም ነው ይለዋል፥ ሕያውንም ወፍ ወደ ሜዳ ይለቅቀዋል።

verses.text_english: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.text_amharic: የነጻውም ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ጠጕሩንም ሁሉ ይላጫል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል። ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈር ይገባል፥ ነገር ግን ከድንኳኑ በውጭ ሆኖ ሰባት ቀን ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ጠጕሩን ሁሉ ይላጫል፤ ራሱንም፥ ጢሙንም፥ ቅንድቡንም፥ የገላውንም ጠጕር ሁሉ ይላጫል፤ ልብሱንም፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ያጥባል፤ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት ተባት ጠቦት፥ ነውር የሌለባትንም አንዲት የዓመት እንስት ጠቦት፥ ስለ እህልም ቍርባን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ የሆነ በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ አንድ የሎግ መስፈሪያም ዘይት ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest that maketh clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: የሚያነጻውም ካህን እነዚህን ነገሮች የሚነጻውንም ሰው በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያኖራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም አንዱን ጠቦት ወስዶ ስለ በደል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፥ ያንንም የሎግ መስፈሪያ ዘይት፤ ስለ መወዝወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዘዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering the priest's, the trespass offering: it most holy:
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአትን መሥዋዕትና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በሚያርዱበት በተቀደሰው ስፍራ ጠቦቱን ያርደዋል፤ የኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ለካህኑ እንደሚሆን፥ እንዲሁ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከበደል መሥዋዕት ደም ወስዶ የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት ያስነካዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከዘይቱ ከሎግ መስፈሪያው ወስዶ በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ባለው ዘይት ቀኝ ጣቱን ነክሮ ከዘይቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሰባት ጊዜ በጣቱ ይረጫል።

verses.text_english: And of the rest of the oil that in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በእጁ ውስጥ ከቀረው ዘይት የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት የበደል መሥዋዕት ደም ባረፈበት ላይ ያስነካዋል።

verses.text_english: And the remnant of the oil that in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በካህኑም እጅ ውስጥ የቀረውን ዘይት በሚነጻው ሰው ራስ ላይ ያደርግበታል፤ ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል፥ ከርኵሰቱም ለሚነጻው ሰው ያስተሰርይለታል፤ በኋላም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያርዳል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቀርባል፥ ካህኑም ያስተሰርይለታል፤ እርሱም ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And if he poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
verses.text_amharic: ድሀም ቢሆን ይህንም ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ባይበቃው፥ ማስተስረያ ይሆንለት ዘንድ እንዲወዘወዝ አንድ ጠቦት ለበደል መሥዋዕት፥ ከመስፈሪያውም ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ አንድ የሎግ መስፈሪያም ዘይት ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም የርግብ ግልገሎች እንደሚቻለው፥ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ስለ መንጻት ወደ ካህኑ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያመጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ጠቦት የሎግ መስፈሪያውንም ዘይት ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take of the blood of the trespass offering, and put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.text_amharic: የበደሉንም መሥዋዕት ጠቦት ያርዳል፤ ካህኑም ከበደሉ መሥዋዕት ደም ወስዶ የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት ያስነካዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከዘይቱ በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger of the oil that in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ካለው ዘይት በቀኝ ጣቱ ሰባት ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይረጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall put of the oil that in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በእጁ ውስጥ ካለው ዘይት የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት የበደል መሥዋዕት ደም ባረፈበት ላይ ያስነካዋል።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the oil that in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለት ዘንድ በካህኑ እጅ ውስጥ የቀረውን ዘይት በሚነጻው ሰው ራስ ላይ ያደርገዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚቻለው ከዋኖሶች ወይም ከርግብ ግልገሎች አንዱን ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: such as he is able to get, the one a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚቻለው አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውንም ከእህል ቍርባን ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል ካህኑም ለሚነጻው ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.text_english: This the law in whom the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get to his cleansing.
verses.text_amharic: ለመንጻቱ የሚያስፈልገውን ነገር ለማያገኝ የለምጽ ደዌ ላለበት ሰው ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.text_amharic: ወደምሰጣችሁ ርስት ወደ ከነዓን ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔም የለምጽ ደዌ በርስታችሁ ምድር በአንድ ቤት ባደረግሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me as it were a plague in the house:
verses.text_amharic: ባለቤቱ መጥቶ ካህኑን። ደዌ በቤቴ ውስጥ እንዳለ ይመስለኛል ብሎ ይንገረው።

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go to see the plague, that all that in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በቤቱ ውስጥ ያለው ዕቃ ሁሉ እንዳይረክስ፥ እርሱ ደዌውን ለማየት ወደ ቤት ሳይገባ፥ ቤቱን ባዶ እንዲያደርጉት ያዝዛል፤ በኋላም ካህኑ ቤቱን ለማየት ይገባል።

verses.text_english: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, the plague in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight lower than the wall;
verses.text_amharic: ደዌውንም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በግንቡ ላይ በአረንጓዴና በቀይ ቢዥጐረጐር፥ መልኩም ወደ ግንቡ ውስጥ ቢጠልቅ፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ከቤቱ ውስጥ ወደ ቤቱ በር ወጥቶ ሰባት ቀን ቤቱን ይዘጋዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ተመልሶ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በቤቱ ግንብ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ደዌ ያለባቸውን ድንጋዮች እንዲያወጡ፥ ከከተማውም ወደ ውጭ ወደ ረከሰው ስፍራ እንዲጥሉአቸው ያዝዛል።

verses.text_english: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም በውስጡ በዙሪያው ያስፍቀዋል፤ የፋቁትንም የምርጊቱን አፈር ከከተማው ወደ ውጭ ወደ ረከሰ ስፍራ ያፈስሱታል።

verses.text_english: And they shall take other stones, and put in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚያም ድንጋዮች ስፍራ ሌሎች ድንጋዮች ያገባሉ፤ ሌላም ጭቃ ወስደው ቤቱን ይመርጉታል።

verses.text_english: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
verses.text_amharic: ደዌውም ዳግም ቢመለስ፥ ድንጋዮቹም ከወጡ ቤቱም ከተፋቀና ከተመረገ በኋላ በቤቱ ውስጥ ቢሰፋ፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, the plague be spread in the house, it a fretting leprosy in the house: it unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ገብቶ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በቤቱ ውስጥ ቢሰፋ በቤቱ ውስጥ ያለው እየፋገ የሚሄድ ለምጽ ነው፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም፥ ድንጋዮቹንም፥ እንጨቱንም፥ የቤቱንም ምርጊት ሁሉ ያፈርሳል፤ እነርሱንም ከከተማው ወደ ውጭ ወደ ርኩስ ስፍራ ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: በተዘጋበትም ጊዜ ሁሉ ወደ ቤቱ የሚገባ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም የሚተኛ ልብሱን ያጥባል፤ በቤቱም የሚበላ ልብሱን ያጥባል።

verses.text_english: And if the priest shall come in, and look , and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ገብቶ ቢያይ፥ እነሆም፥ ቤቱ ከተመረገ በኋላ ደዌው በቤቱ ውስጥ ባይሰፋ፥ ደዌው ስለ ሻረ ካህኑ ቤቱን። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም ለማንጻት ሁለት ወፎች፥ የዝግባም እንጨት፥ ቀይ ግምጃም፥ ሂሶጵም ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.text_amharic: አንደኛውንም ወፍ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ ከምንጩ ውኃ በላይ ያርዳል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
verses.text_amharic: የዝግባውን እንጨት፥ ሂሶጱንም፥ ቀዩንም ግምጃ፥ ሕያውንም ወፍ ወስዶ በታረደው ወፍ ደምና በምንጩ ውኃ ውስጥ ይነክራቸዋል፥ ቤቱንም ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም በወፉ ደም በምንጩም ውኃ በሕያውም ወፍ በዝግባውም እንጨት በሂሶጱም በቀዩም ግምጃ ያነጻዋል።

verses.text_english: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያውንም ወፍ ከከተማ ወደ ሜዳ ይሰድደዋል፤ ለቤቱም ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: This the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሕግ ነው ለሁሉ ዓይነት ለምጽ ደዌ፥

verses.text_english: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
verses.text_amharic: ለቈረቈርም፥ በልብስና በቤትም ላለ ለምጽ፥

verses.text_english: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
verses.text_amharic: ለእባጭም፥ ለብጕርም፥ ለቋቁቻም፤

verses.text_english: To teach when unclean, and when clean: this the law of leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: በሚረክስና በሚነጻ ጊዜ እንዲያስታውቅ ይህ የለምጽ ሕግ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, his issue he unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩአቸው። ማንም ሰው ከሥጋው ፈሳሽ ነገር ቢወጣ፥ ስለሚፈስሰው ነገር ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it his uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለሚፈስሰው ነገር ርኵስነቱ ይህ ነው፤ ፈሳሹ ነገር ከሥጋው ቢፈስስ ወይም ከመፍሰሱ ቢቆም፥ ርኩስ መሆኑ ነው።

verses.text_english: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው የሚተኛበት መኝታ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ የሚቀመጥበትም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: መኝታውንም የሚነካ ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he that sitteth on thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው በተቀመጠበት ነገር ላይ የሚቀመጥበት ሰው ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበትን የሰውን ሥጋ የሚነካ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው በንጹሕ ሰው ላይ ቢተፋ፥ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው የተቀመጠበት ኮርቻ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ከበታቹም ያለውን ነገር የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ነው፤ እነዚህንም ነገሮች የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው እጁን በውኃ ሳይታጠብ የሚነካው ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው የሚነካውን የሸክላ ዕቃ ይስበሩት፤ የእንጨቱም ዕቃ ሁሉ በውኃ ይታጠብ።

verses.text_english: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው ከፈሳሹ ነገር ሲነጻ ስለ መንጻቱ ሰባት ቀን ይቈጥራል፤ ልብሱንም ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በምንጭ ውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ይዞ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይመጣል፥ ለካህኑም ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall offer them, the one a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም አንደኛውን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል፤ ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ ፈሳሹ ነገር ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.text_english: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: የማንም ሰው ዘር ከእርሱ ቢወጣ፥ ገላውን ሁሉ በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ዘር የነካው ልብስ ሁሉ ቁርበትም ሁሉ በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: The woman also with whom man shall lie seed of copulation, they shall bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዱ በሴቲቱ ቢደርስባት ሁለቱ በውኃ ይታጠባሉ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And if a woman have an issue, her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ፈሳሽ ነገር ቢኖርባት በሥጋዋም ያለው ፈሳሽ ነገር ደም ቢሆን፥ በመርገምዋ ሰባት ቀን ትቀመጣለች፤ የሚነካትም ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: መርገምም ስትሆን የምትተኛበት ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ የምትቀመጥበትም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: መኝታዋንም የሚነካ ሁሉ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: የምትቀመጥበትንም ነገር ሁሉ የሚነካ ሁሉ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if it on bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: በመኝታዋም ላይ ወይም በምትቀመጥበት ነገር ላይ ቢሆን ሲነካው እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ከእርስዋ ጋር ቢተኛ መርገምዋም ቢነካው፥ ሰባት ቀን ርኩስ ነው፤ የሚተኛበትም መኝታ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ሴትም ከመርገም ቀን ሌላ ደምዋ ብዙ ቀን ቢፈስስ፥ ወይም ደምዋ ከመርገምዋ ወራት የሚበልጥ ቢፈስስ፥ በመርገምዋ ወራት እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በፈሳሽዋ ርኵስነት ወራት ትሆናለች፤ ርኩስ ናት።

verses.text_english: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.text_amharic: ደምዋም በሚፈስስበት ወራት ሁሉ የምትተኛበት መኝታ ሁሉ በመርገምዋ ጊዜ እንደ ነበረው መኝታ ያለ ይሆንባታል፤ የምትቀመጥበት ነገር ሁሉ እንደ መርገምዋ ርኵስነት ርኵስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም ነገሮች የሚነካ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ ልብሱንም ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሳሽዋም ብትነጻ ሰባት ቀን ትቈጥራለች ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ይዛ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ታመጣቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall offer the one a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም አንደኛውን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል፤ ካህኑም ስለ ፈሳሽዋ ርኵስነት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይላታል።

verses.text_english: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that among them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በእነርሱ መካከል ያለችውን ማደሪያዬን ባረከሱ ጊዜ፥ በርኵስነታቸው እንዳይሞቱ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከርኵስነታቸው ለያቸው።

verses.text_english: This the law of him that hath an issue, and whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሽ ነገር ላለበት ሰው፥ ይረክስም ዘንድ ዘሩ ለሚወጣበት ሰው፥

verses.text_english: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.text_amharic: በመርገምዋም ለታመመች፥ ፈሳሽም ነገር ላለባቸው ለወንድም ለሴትም፥ የረከሰችንም ሴት ለሚገናኝ ሰው ሕጉ ይኸው ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የቀረቡና የሞቱ ሁለት የአሮን ልጆች ከሞቱ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ተናገረው፤

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy within the vail before the mercy seat, which upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። እኔ በስርየቱ መክደኛ ላይ በደመናው ውስጥ እታያለሁና እንዳይሞት በመጋረጃው ውስጥ በታቦቱ ላይ ወዳለው ወደ ስርየቱ መክደኛ ወደ ተቀደሰው ስፍራ ሁልጊዜ እንዳይገባ ለወንድምህ ለአሮን ንገረው።

verses.text_english: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy : with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ አሮን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወይፈን፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም አውራ በግ ይዞ ወደ ተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይግባ።

verses.text_english: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and put them on.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሰውን የበፍታ ቀሚስ ይልበስ፥ የበፍታውም ሱሪ በገላው ላይ ይሁን፥ የበፍታውንም መታጠቂያ ይታጠቅ፥ የበፍታውንም መጠምጠሚያ ይጠምጥም፤ እነዚህ የተቀደሱ ልብሶች ናቸው፤ ገላውንም በውኃ ታጥቦ ይልበሳቸው።

verses.text_english: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለት አውራ ፍየሎች፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ በግ ይውሰድ።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ለእርሱ ያለውን የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት ወይፈን ያቀርባል፥ ለራሱም ለቤተ ሰቡም ያስተሰርያል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም አውራ ፍየሎች ወስዶ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆማቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም በሁለቱ ፍየሎች ላይ ዕጣ ይጥልባቸዋል፥ አንዱን ዕጣ ለእግዚአብሔር ሌላውንም ዕጣ ለሚለቀቅ።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD'S lot fell, and offer him a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም የእግዚአብሔር ዕጣ የሆነበትን ፍየል ያቀርባል፥ ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት ያደርገዋል።

verses.text_english: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: የመለቀቅም ዕጣ የሆነበትን ፍየል ያስተሰርይበት ዘንድ፥ ለመለቀቅም ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይሰድደው ዘንድ በሕይወቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆመዋል።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which for himself:
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት የሚሠዋውን መሥዋዕት ወይፈኑን ያቀርባል፤ ለራሱም ለቤተ ሰቡም ያስተሰርያል፤ ስለ ኃጢአቱ የእርሱን መሥዋዕት ወይፈኑን ያርዳል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring within the vail:
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ካለው መሠዊያ ላይ የእሳት ፍም አምጥቶ ጥናውን ይሞላል፥ ከተወቀጠውም ከጣፋጭ ዕጣን እጁን ሙሉን ይወስዳል፤ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ ያመጣዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይሞትም የጢሱ ደመና በምስክሩ ላይ ያለውን መክደኛ ይሸፍን ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣኑን በእሳቱ ላይ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.text_amharic: ከወይፈኑም ደም ወስዶ በስርየቱ መክደኛ ላይ ወደ ምሥራቅ በጣቱ ይረጨዋል፤ ከደሙም በመክደኛው ፊት በጣቱ ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል።

verses.text_english: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡም ኃጢአት የሚሠዋውን መሥዋዕት ፍየል ያርዳል፥ ደሙም ወደ መጋረጃው ውስጥ ያመጣዋል፤ በወይፈኑም ደም እንዳደረገ በፍየሉ ደም ያደርጋል፤ በመክደኛውም ላይና በመክደኛውም ፊት ይረጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall make an atonement for the holy , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ርኵስነት ከመተላለፋቸውም ከኃጢአታቸውም የተነሣ ለመቅደሱ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ እንዲሁም በርኩስነታቸው መካከል ከእነርሱ ጋር ለኖረች ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy , until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ለማስተስረይ ወደ መቅደሱ በገባ ጊዜ ለራሱ፥ ለቤተ ሰቡም፥ ለእስራኤል ጉባዔ ሁሉ አስተስርዮ እስኪወጣ ድረስ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ማንም አይኖርም።

verses.text_english: And he shall go out unto the altar that before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ወዳለው ወደ መሠዊያ ወጥቶ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ ከወይፈኑም ደም ከፍየሉም ደም ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ያሉትን ቀንዶች ያስነካል።

verses.text_english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከደሙም በእርሱ ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ በጣቱ ይረጫል፥ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ርኵስነት ያነጻዋል፥ ይቀድሰውማል።

verses.text_english: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy , and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.text_amharic: መቅደሱንም፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ መሠዊያውንም ማስተስረይ ከፈጸመ በኋላ ሕያውን ፍየል ያቀርባል፤

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ሁለቱን እጆቹን በሕያው ፍየል ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በላዩም የእስራኤልን ልጆች በደል ሁሉ መተላለፋቸውንም ሁሉ ኃጢአታቸውንም ሁሉ ይናዝዛል፤ በፍየሉም ራስ ላይ ያሸክመዋል፥ በተዘጋጀው ሰውም እጅ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይሰድደዋል።

verses.text_english: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ፍየሉም ኃጢአታቸውን ሁሉ ወደ በረሀ ይሸከማል፤ ፍየሉንም በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ ይለቅቀዋል።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy , and shall leave them there:
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ይገባል፥ ወደ መቅደሱም በገባ ጊዜ የለበሰውን የበፍታ ልብስ ያወልቃል፥ በዚያም ይተወዋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰውም ስፍራ ገላውን በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ሌላውንም ልብስ ለብሶ ይወጣል፤ የእርሱንም የሚቃጠል መስዋዕት፥ የሕዝቡንም የሚቃጠል መስዋዕት ያቀርባል፥ ለራሱም ለሕዝቡም ያስተሰርያል።

verses.text_english: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢያቱንም መስዋዕት ስብ በመሰዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ለመለቀቅ የሚሆነውን ፍየል የወሰደ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ይገባል።

verses.text_english: And the bullock the sin offering, and the goat the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy , shall carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.text_amharic: ለማስተስረያም እንዲሆን ደማቸው ወደ መቅደስ የገባውን የኃጢአቱን መስዋዕት ወይፈንና የኃጢአቱን መስዋዕት ፍየል ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ያወጡአቸዋል፤ ቁርበታቸውንም፥ ሥጋቸውንም፥ ፈርሳቸውንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ።

verses.text_english: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ያቃጠላቸውም ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈር ይገባል።

verses.text_english: And shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
For on that day shall make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅ ሰንበት ይሆንላችኋል፥ ራሳችሁንም ታዋርዳላችሁ፤ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.text_english: It a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቀባውም፥ በአባቱ ፋንታ ካህን ሊሆን የሚካነው ካህን ያስተስርይ፥ የተቀደሰውንም የበፍታ ልብስ ይልበስ፤

verses.text_english: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, the holy garments:
verses.text_amharic: ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ያስተስርይ፤ ለመገናኛውም ድንኳን ለመሠዊያውም ያስተስርይ፤ ለካህናቱም ለጉባኤውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ያስተስርይ።

verses.text_english: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም አንድ ጊዜ በዓመት ለእስራኤል ልጆች ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ሁሉ ያስተስርይ ዘንድ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁንላችሁ። እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገር። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: What man soever of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth out of the camp,
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ቤት ማናቸውም ሰው በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም ፍየል ቢያርድ፥ በሰፈሩ ውስጥ ወይም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ቢያርደው፥

verses.text_english: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን ያቀርብ ዘንድ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ባያመጣው፥ ደሙ በዚያ ሰው ላይ ይቈጠርበታል፤ ደም አፍስሶአል፤ ያም ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them peace offerings unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ልጆች በሜዳ የሚያርዱትን መሥዋዕታቸውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ያመጡታል፤ ወደ ካህኑም አምጥተው ለእግዚአብሔር ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ይሠዉታል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በመገኛኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ባለው በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ደሙን ይረጨዋል፥ ስቡንም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.text_amharic: መሥዋዕታቸውንም ደግሞ ተከትለው ላመነዘሩባቸው ለሰይጣናት አይሠዉ። ይህ ለእነርሱ ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም እንዲህ በላቸው። ከእስራኤል ቤት በመካከላቸውም ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ሌላ መሥዋዕት ቢያቀርብ፥

verses.text_english: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዋ ዘንድ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ባያመጣው፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ወይም በመካከላቸው ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው ደም ቢበላ፥ ደም በሚበላው በዚያ ሰው ላይ ፊቴን አከብድበታለሁ፥ ያንንም ሰው ከሕዝቡ ለይቼ አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the life of the flesh in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it the blood maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.text_amharic: የሥጋ ሕይወት በደሙ ውስጥ ነውና፤ ደሙም ከሕይወቱ የተነሣ ያስተሰርያልና በመሠዊያው ላይ ለነፍሳችሁ ማስተስረያ ይሆን ዘንድ እኔ ለእናንተ ሰጠሁት።

verses.text_english: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች። ከእናንተ ማንም ደምን አይበላም፥ በመካከላችሁም ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማንም ደምን አይበላም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች በመካከላቸውም ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው የሚበላ እንስሳ ወይም ወፍ እያደነ ቢይዝ፥ ደሙን ያፈስሳል በአፈርም ይከድነዋል።

verses.text_english: For the life of all flesh; the blood of it for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: የሥጋ ሁሉ ሕይወትና ደሙ አንድ ነውና ስለዚህ ለእስራኤል ልጆች። የሥጋ ሁሉ ሕይወት ደሙ ነውና የሥጋውን ሁሉ ደም አትብሉ፤ የሚበላውም ሁሉ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And every soul that eateth that which died , or that which was torn one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.text_amharic: የሞተውን ወይም አውሬ የሰበረውን የሚበላ ሰው ሁሉ፥ የአገር ልጅ ወይም እንግዳ ቢሆን፥ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But if he wash not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሱንና ገላውን ባያጥብ ግን ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተቀመጣችሁባት እንደ ግብፅ ምድር ሥራ አትሥሩ፤ እኔም ወደ እርስዋ እንደማገባችሁ እንደ ከነዓን ምድር ሥራ አትሥሩ፤ በሥርዓታቸውም አትሂዱ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዴን አድርጉ፥ በእርስዋም ትሄዱ ዘንድ ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሠራቸው ሰው በእነርሱ በሕይወት ይኖራልና ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴን ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover nakedness: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ማንም ሰው ኃፍረተ ሥጋውን ይገልጥ ዘንድ ወደ ዘመዱ ሁሉ አይቅረብ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
