verses.text_amharic: የአባትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋና የእናትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ እናትህ ናት፤ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.text_english: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it thy father's nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: የአባትህን ሚስት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአባትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ነው።

verses.text_english: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, born at home, or born abroad, their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.text_amharic: የእኅትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአባትህ ልጅ ወይም የእናትህ ልጅ፥ በቤት ወይም በውጭ የተወለደች ብትሆን፥ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.text_english: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs thine own nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: የወንድ ልጅህን ሴት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ወይም የሴት ልጅህን ሴት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአንተ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ነውና።

verses.text_english: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባትህ የተወለደችውን የአባትህን ሚስት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ እህትህ ናት፤ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.text_amharic: የአባትህን እኅት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአባትህ ዘመድ ናት።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.text_amharic: የእናትህን እኅት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የእናትህ ዘመድ ናት።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she thine aunt.
verses.text_amharic: የአባትህን ወንድም ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፥ ወደ ሚስቱም አትቅረብ፤ የአጎትህ ሚስት ናት።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: የምራትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የልጅህ ሚስት ናት፤ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it thy brother's nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: የወንድምህን ሚስት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የወንድምህ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they her near kinswomen: it wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: የሴትንና የሴት ልጅዋን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የወንድ ልጅዋን ሴት ልጅ ወይም የሴት ልጅዋን ሴት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ትግለጥ ዘንድ አታግባ፤ ዘመዶች ናቸው፤ ዝሙት ነው።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex , to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life .
verses.text_amharic: ሚስትህ በሕይወት ሳለች እኅትዋ ጣውንትዋ እንዳትሆን፥ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ትገልጥ ዘንድ ከእርስዋ ጋር እኅትዋን አታግባ።

verses.text_english: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በመርገምዋ ርኵሰት ሳለች ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ትገልጥ ዘንድ ወደ ሴት አትቅረብ።

verses.text_english: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳትረክስባትም ከባልንጀራህ ሚስት ጋር አትተኛ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘርህም ለሞሎክ በእሳት አሳልፈህ አትስጥ፥ የአምላክህንም ስም አታርክስ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it abomination.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴትም ጋር እንደምትተኛ ከወንድ ጋር አትተኛ፤ ጸያፍ ነገር ነውና።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it confusion.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳትረክስባትም ከእንሰሳ ጋር አትተኛ፤ ሴት ከእርሱ ጋር ትተኛ ዘንድ በእንስሳ ፊት አትቁም፤ የተጠላ ነገር ነውና።

verses.text_english: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ የማሳድዳቸው አሕዛብ ረክሰዋልና በእነዚህ ነገሮች ሁሉ አትርከሱ።

verses.text_english: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ረከሰች፤ ስለዚህ ኃጢአትዋን በእርስዋ ላይ እመልሳለሁ፥ ምድሪቱም የሚኖሩባትን ሰዎች ትተፋለች።

verses.text_english: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit of these abominations; any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴን ጠብቁ፤ እናንተም የአገሩ ልጆች በእናንተም መካከል የሚኖሩት እንግዶች ከዚህ ርኵሰት ምንም አትሥሩ፤

verses.text_english: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩ የአገሩ ልጆች ይህን ርኵሰት ሁሉ ሠርተዋልና፥ ምድሪቱም ረክሳለችና፤

verses.text_english: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that before you.
verses.text_amharic: ባረከሳችኋት ጊዜ ምድሪቱ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበረውን ሕዝብ እንደ ተፋች እናንተን እንዳትተፋችሁ።

verses.text_english: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ ርኵሰት ሁሉ ማናቸውን የሚያደርግ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋልና።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that commit not of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩ ሰዎች የሠሩትን ጸያፍ የሆነውን ወግ ሁሉ እንዳትሠሩ፥ በእርሱም እንዳትረክሱ ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God holy.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲህ ባላቸው። እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ቅዱስ ነኝና እናንተ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ሰው ሁሉ እናቱንና አባቱን ይፍራ፥ ሰንበታቴንም ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጣዖታትም ዘወር አትበሉ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም የአማልክት ምስሎች ለእናንተ አታድርጉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.text_amharic: የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ስትሰዉ እርሱን ደስ እንድታሰኙበት ሠዉት።

verses.text_english: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.text_amharic: በምትሠዉት ቀንና በነጋው ይበላል፤ እስከ ሦስተኛውም ቀን ድረስ ቢተርፍ በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ቢበላ ጸያፍ ነው፥ ደስም አያሰኝም፤

verses.text_english: Therefore that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: የበላውም ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን ነገር አርክሶአልና ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል፤ ያም ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.text_amharic: የምድራችሁንም መከር በሰበሰባችሁ ጊዜ የእርሻችሁን ድንበር ፈጽማችሁ አትጨዱ፥ የመከሩንም ቃርሚያ አትልቀሙ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: የወይንህንም ቃርሚያ አትቃርም፥ የወደቀውንም የወይንህን ፍሬ አትሰብስብ፤ ለድሆችና ለእንግዶች ተወው፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.text_amharic: አትስረቁ፥ አትካዱም፥ ከእናንተም እርስ በርሳችሁ ሐሰት አትነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በስሜም በሐሰት አትማሉ፥ የአምላካችሁንም ስም አታርክሱ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob : the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.text_amharic: በባልንጀራህ ግፍ አታድርግ፥ አትቀማውም። የሞያተኛው ዋጋ እስከ ነገ ድረስ በአንተ ዘንድ አይደርብህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደንቆሮውን አትስደብ፥ በዕውርም ፊት ዕንቅፋት አታድርግ፥ ነገር ግን አምላክህን ፍራ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርድ ዓመፃ አታድርጉ፤ ለድሀ አታድላ፥ ባለ ጠጋውንም አታክብር፤ ነገር ግን ለባልንጀራህ በእውነት ፍረድ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not go up and down a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝብህ መካከል በሸንጋይነት አትዙር፤ በባልንጀራህም ደም ላይ አትቁም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህን በልብህ አትጥላው፤ በባልንጀራህ ምክንያት ኃጢአት እንዳይሆንብህ ገሥጸው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አትበቀልም፥ በሕዝብህም ልጆች ቂም አትያዝ፥ ነገር ግን ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ። እንስሳህ ከሌላ ዓይነት ጋር አይደባለቅ፤ በእርሻህም ሁለት ዓይነት ዘር አትዝራ፤ ከሁለት ዓይነት ነገር የተሠራ ልብስ አትልበስ።

verses.text_english: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሴት ባሪያ ጋር ቢተኛ፥ እርስዋም ለባል የተሰጠች ዋጋዋም ያልተከፈለ አርነት ያልወጣች ብትሆን፥ ቅጣት አለባቸው፤ አርነት አልወጣችምና አይገደሉም።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ይዞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ይመጣል፥ ለበደልም መሥዋዕት አውራ በግ ያመጣል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በበደል መሥዋዕት በግ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ የሠራውም ኃጢአት ይቀርለታል።

verses.text_english: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አገሩም በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ የሚበላ የፍሬ ዛፍ ሁሉ በተከላችሁም ጊዜ፥ ፍሬውን እንዳልተገረዘ ትቈጥሩታላችሁ፤ ሦስት ዓመት እንዳልተገረዘ ይሆንላችኋል፤ አይበላም።

verses.text_english: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD .
verses.text_amharic: የአራተኛውም ዓመት ፍሬ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ቅዱስ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬውም ይበዛላችሁ ዘንድ የአምስተኛውን ዓመት ፍሬ ብሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not eat with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.text_amharic: ከደሙ ጋር ምንም አትብሉ፤ አስማትም አታድርጉ፥ ሞራ ገላጭም አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.text_amharic: የራስ ጠጕራችሁንም ዙሪያውን አትከርክሙት፥ ጢማችሁንም ዙሪያውን አትቍረጡት።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሞተውም ሥጋችሁን አትንጩ፥ ገላችሁንም አትንቀሱት፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱ ከግልሙትና ከርኵሰትም እንዳትሞላ ሴት ልጅህን ታመነዝር ዘንድ አታርክሳት።

verses.text_english: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰንበታቴን ጠብቁ፥ መቅደሴንም አክብሩ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችና ወደ ጠንቋዮች አትሂዱ፤ እንዳትረክሱባቸውም አትፈልጉአቸው፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሽበታሙ ፊት ተነሣ፥ ሽማግሌውንም አክብር፥ አምላክህንም ፍራ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.text_amharic: በአገራችሁ ውስጥ ከእናንተ ጋር እንግዳ ቢቀመጥ ግፍ አታድርጉበት።

verses.text_english: the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር እንግዶች ነበራችሁና ከእናንተ ጋር የሚቀመጥ እንግዳ እንደ አገር ልጅ ይሁንላችሁ፥ እርሱንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርድ፥ በመለካትም፥ በመመዘንም፥ በመስፈርም ዓመፃ አታድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የእውነትም ሚዛን፥ የእውነትም መመዘኛ፥ የእውነትም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ፥ የእውነትም የኢን መስፈሪያ ይሁንላችሁ፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴን ሁሉ ፍርዴንም ሁሉ ጠብቁ አድርጉም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። ከእስራኤል ልጆች ወይም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከሚቀመጡ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው ዘሩን ለሞሎክ ቢሰጥ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ የአገሩ ሕዝብ በድንጋይ ይውገረው።

verses.text_english: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.text_amharic: መቅደሴን ያረክስ ዘንድ፥ የተቀደሰውንም ስሜን ያጐሰቍል ዘንድ ዘሩን ለሞሎክ ሰጥቶአልና እኔ በዚያ ሰው ላይ ፊቴን አከብዳለሁ፥ ከሕዝቡም መካከል ለይቼ አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.text_amharic: ዘሩንም ለሞሎክ ሲሰጥ፥ የአገሩ ሕዝብ ያን ቸል ቢለው ባይገድሉትም፥

verses.text_english: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በዚያ ሰውና በቤተ ሰቡ ላይ ፊቴን አከብዳለሁ፤ እርሱንም፥ ከሞሎክም ጋር ያመነዝሩ ዘንድ የሚከተሉትን ሁሉ ከሕዝባቸው መካከል ለይቼ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችንም በሚከተል፥ በሥራቸውም በሚያመነዝር፥ በዚያ ሰው ላይ ፊቴን አከብዳለሁ፥ ከሕዝቡም መካከል ለይቼ አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና ሰውነታችሁን ቀድሱ፥ ቅዱሳንም ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I the LORD which sanctify you.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ፥ አድርጉትም፤ እኔ የምቀድሳችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው አባቱን ወይም እናቱን ቢሰድብ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፥ አባቱንና እናቱን ሰድቦአልና፤ ደሙ በራሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the man that committeth adultery with man's wife, that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሌላ ሰው ሚስት ወይም ከባልንጀራው ሚስት ጋር ቢያመነዝር አመንዝራውና አመንዝራይቱ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ።

verses.text_english: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከአባቱ ሚስት ጋር ቢተኛ የአባቱን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአል፤ ሁለቱ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከምራቱ ጋር ቢተኛ ሁለቱ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ጸያፍ ነገር አድርገዋል፤ ደማቸውም በላያቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሴት ጋር እንደሚተኛ ከወንድ ጋር ቢተኛ ሁለቱ ጸያፍ ነገር አድርገዋል፤ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው እናቲቱንና ልጂቱን ቢያገባ ርኵሰት ነው፤ በመካከላችሁ ኃጢአት እንዳይሆን እርሱና እነርሱ በእሳት ይቃጠሉ።

verses.text_english: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከእንስሳ ጋር ቢገናኝ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ እንስሳይቱንም ግደሉአት።

verses.text_english: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸይቱም ሴት ወደ እንስሳ ብትቀርብ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ብትገናኝ፥ ሴቲቱንና እንስሳውን ግደል፤ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው የአባቱን ልጅ ወይም የእናቱን ልጅ እኅቱን ቢያገባ፥ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋንም ቢያይ፥ እርስዋም ኃፍረተ ሥጋውን ብታይ፥ ይህ ጸያፍ ነገር ነው፤ በሕዝባቸውም ልጆች ፊት ይገደሉ፤ የእኅቱን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአልና ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከባለ መርገም ሴት ጋር ቢተኛ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋንም ቢገልጥ፥ ፈሳሽዋን ገልጦአልና፥ እርስዋም የደምዋን ፈሳሽ ገልጣለችና ሁለቱ ከሕዝባቸው መካከል ተለይተው ይጥፉ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: የአባትህን ወይም የእናትህን እኅት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ ይህን የሚያደርግ የዘመድን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአል፤ ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.text_english: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ከአጎቱ ሚስት ጋር ቢተኛ፥ የአጎቱን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአል፤ ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ ያለ ልጅ ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም የወንድሙን ሚስት ቢያገባ ርኵሰት ነው፤ የወንድሙን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአል፤ ያለ ልጅ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ትቀመጡባት ዘንድ የማገባችሁ ምድር እንዳትተፋችሁ ሥርዓቴን ሁሉ፥ ፍርዴንም ሁሉ ጠብቁ፥ አድርጉትም።

verses.text_english: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊታችሁ በምጥላቸውም ሕዝብ ወግ አትሂዱ፤ ይህን ሁሉ አድርገዋልና ተጸየፍኋቸው።

verses.text_english: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I the LORD your God, which have separated you from people.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እናንተን። ምድራቸውን ትወርሳላችሁ፤ ትወርሱአትም ዘንድ ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድር እሰጣችኋለሁ አልኋችሁ። እኔ ከአሕዛብ የለየኋችሁ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ንጹሑን እንስሳ ከርኩሱ፥ ንጹሑንም ወፍ ከርኩስ ትለያላችሁ፤ ርኩሶች ናቸው ብዬ በለየኋቸው በእንስሳና በወፍ በምድርም ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ነፍሳችሁን አታርክሱ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD holy, and have severed you from people, that ye should be mine.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነኝና፥ ለእኔም ትሆኑ ዘንድ ከአሕዛብ ለይቻችኋለሁና ቅዱሳን ትሆኑልኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ወይም ሴት መናፍስትን ቢጠሩ ወይም ጠንቋዮች ቢሆኑ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ በድንጋይ ይውገሩአቸው፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ለካህናቱ ለአሮን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው አለው። ማንም ሰው ከሕዝቡ ስለ ሞተው፥

verses.text_english: But for his kin, that is near unto him, , for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
verses.text_amharic: ከሚቀርበው ዘመዱ፥ ከእናቱ፥ ወይም ከአባቱ፥ ወይም ከወንድ ልጁ፥ ወይም ከሴት ልጁ፥ ወይም ከወንድሙ በቀር አይርከስ።

verses.text_english: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም የቀረበችው ያልተጋባች ድንግል እኅቱ በእርስዋ ይርከስ።

verses.text_english: he shall not defile himself, a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቡ አለቃ ራሱን ያጐሰቍል ዘንድ አይርከስ።

verses.text_english: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ራሳቸውን አይላጩ፥ ጢማቸውንም አይላጩ፥ ሥጋቸውንም አይንጩ።

verses.text_english: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላካቸው ቅዱሳን ይሁኑ፥ የአምላካቸውንም ስም አያጐስቍሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን የእሳት ቍርባንና የአምላካቸውን እንጀራ ያቀርባሉና ቅዱሳን ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: They shall not take a wife a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he holy unto his God.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላኩ የተቀደሰ ነውና ጋለሞታን ሴት ወይም የረከሰችውን አያግባ፤ ወይም ከባልዋ የተፈታችውን አያግባ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, holy.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክህን እንጀራ ያቀርባልና ስለዚህ ትቀድሰዋለህ፤ እኔም የምቀድሳችሁ እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነኝና እርሱ ቅዱስ ይሁንልህ።

verses.text_english: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.text_amharic: የካህንም ልጅ ራስዋን በግልሙትና ብታረክስ አባትዋን ታረክሰዋለች፤ በእሳት ትቃጠል።

verses.text_english: And the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
verses.text_amharic: በራሱም ላይ የቅባት ዘይት የፈሰሰበት፥ የክህነትም ልብስ ይለብስ ዘንድ የተቀደሰ ከወንድሞቹ የበለጠው ካህን ራሱን አይግለጥ ልብሱንም አይቅደድ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ በድንም ሁሉ አይግባ፥ በአባቱም ወይም በእናቱ አይርከስ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God upon him: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላኩም ቅባት ዘይት ቅዱስነት በላዩ ነውና ከመቅደስ አይውጣ፥ የአምላኩንም መቅደስ አያርክስ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሚስትን በድንግልናዋ ያግባ።

verses.text_english: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ባልዋ የሞተባትን፥ ወይም የተፋታችውን፥ ወይም ጋለሞታይቱን አያግባ፤ ነገር ግን ከሕዝቡ ድንግሊቱን ያግባ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም የምቀድሰው እግዚአብሔር ነኝና በሕዝቡ መካከል ዘሩን አያጐስቍል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever of thy seed in their generations that hath blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮን እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። ከዘርህ በትውልዳቸው ነውር ያለበት ሰው ሁሉ የአምላኩን እንጀራ ያቀርብ ዘንድ አይቅረብ።

verses.text_english: For whatsoever man that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
verses.text_amharic: ዕውር፥ ወይም አንካሳ፥ ወይም አፍንጫ ደፍጣጣ፥ ወይም፤ ትርፍ አካል ያለው፥

verses.text_english: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
verses.text_amharic: ወይም እግረ ሰባራ፥ ወይም እጀ ሰባራ፥

verses.text_english: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ጐባጣ፥ ወይም ድንክ፥ ወይም ዓይነ መጭማጫ፥ ወይም እከካም፥ ወይም ቋቍቻም፥ ወይም ጃንደረባ፥ ነውረኛ ሁሉ አይቅረብ።

verses.text_english: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህኑ ከአሮን ዘር ነውር ያለበት ሰው የእግዚአብሔርን የእሳት ቍርባን ያቀርብ ዘንድ አይቅረብ፤ ነውረኛ ነው፤ የአምላኩን እንጀራ ያቀርብ ዘንድ አይቅረብ።

verses.text_english: He shall eat the bread of his God, of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.text_amharic: የቅዱሱንና የቅዱስ ቅዱሳኑን የአምላኩን እንጀራ ይብላ፤

verses.text_english: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ነውረኛ ነውና መቅደሶቼን እንዳያረክስ ወደ መጋረጃው አይግባ፥ ወደ መሠዊያውም አይቅረብ፤ የምቀድሳቸው እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And Moses told unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ይህን ለአሮን፥ ለልጆቹም፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ነገረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name which they hallow unto me: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእኔ ከሚቀድሱአቸው ከቅዱሳን ነገሮች ራሳቸውን እንዲለዩ፥ የተቀደሰውንም ስሜን እንዳያረክሱ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ንገራቸው፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Say unto them, Whosoever of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ በላቸው። ማናቸውም ሰው ከዘራችሁ በትውልዳችሁ ርኵሰት እያለበት የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእግዚአብሔር ወደሚቀድሱት ወደ ቅዱስ ነገር ቢቀርብ፥ ያ ሰው ከፊቴ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: What man soever of the seed of Aaron a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing unclean the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.text_amharic: ከአሮን ዘር ለምጽ ወይም ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሁሉ ንጹሕ እስኪሆን ድረስ ከተቀደሰው አይብላ። ከበድንም የተነሣ ርኩስ የሆነውን፥ ወይም ዘሩ ከእርሱ የሚፈስስበትን የሚነካ፥

verses.text_english: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.text_amharic: ወይም የሚያረክሰውን ተንቀሳቃሽ፥ ወይም በሁሉ ዓይነት የረከሰውን ሰው የሚነካ፥

verses.text_english: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን ሁሉ የሚነካ ሰው እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ገላውን በውኃ ካልታጠበ ከተቀደሰው አይብላ።

verses.text_english: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it his food.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይም በገባች ጊዜ ንጹሕ ይሆናል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እንጀራው ነውና ከተቀደሰው ይብላ።

verses.text_english: That which dieth of itself, or is torn , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም እንዳይረክስ፥ የሞተውን አውሬም የሰበረውን አይብላ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.text_amharic: ቢያረክሱአት እንዳይሞቱ ስለ እርስዋም ኃጢአትን እንዳይሸከሙ፥ ሕግን ይጠብቁ፤ የምቀድሳቸው እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: There shall no stranger eat the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat the holy thing.
verses.text_amharic: ልዩ ሰው ከተቀደሰው አይብላ የካህኑም እንግዳ ደመወዘኛውም ከተቀደሰው አይብላ።

verses.text_english: But if the priest buy soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ ግን በገንዘቡ ባሪያ ቢገዛ እርሱ ይብላው፤ በቤቱም የተወለዱት ከእንጀራው ይብሉ።

verses.text_english: If the priest's daughter also be unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.text_amharic: የካህንም ልጅ ከልዩ ሰው ጋር ብትጋባ፥ እርስዋ ከተቀደሰው ቍርባን አትብላ።

verses.text_english: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የካህን ልጅ ግን ባልዋ ቢሞት፥ ወይም ብትፋታ፥ ልጅም ባይኖራት፥ በብላቴንነትዋ እንደ ነበረች ወደ አባትዋ ቤት ብትመለስ፥ ከአባትዋ እንጀራ ትብላ፤ ልዩ ሰው ግን ከእርሱ አይብላ።

verses.text_english: And if a man eat the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ከተቀደሰው ቢበላ አምስተኛ እጅ ጨምሮ የተቀደሰውን ለካህኑ ይስጥ።

verses.text_english: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ከእስራኤል ቤት ወይም ከእናንተ መካከል ከሚቀመጡት እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው ስእለቱን ሁሉ፥ በፈቃዱም የሚያቀርበውን ሁሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርበውን ቍርባን ቢያቀርብ፥

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
verses.text_amharic: ይሠምርላችሁ ዘንድ ከበሬ ወይም ከበግ ወይም ከፍየል ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን አቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አይሠምርላችሁምና ነውር ያለበትን አታቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: whatsoever hath a blemish, shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ስእለቱን ለመፈጸም ወይም በፈቃዱ ለማቅረብ የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት፥ ወይም በሬን ወይም በግን፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ቢያቀርብ፥ ይሠምርለት ዘንድ ፍጹም ይሁን፥ ነውርም አይሁንበት።

verses.text_english: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውር ወይም ሰባራ ወይም ጕንድሽ ወይም የሚመግል ቍስል ያለበት ወይም እከካም ወይም ቋቍቻም ቢሆን፥ እነዚህን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር አታቅርቡ፤ እነዚህም ለእሳት ቍርባን በመሠዊያው ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር አታሳርጉ።

verses.text_english: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሬው ወይም በጉ የተጨመረበት ወይም የጐደለበት ነገር ቢሆን፥ ለፈቃድ መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ ትችላለህ፤ ለስእለት ግን አይሠምርም።

verses.text_english: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰነጋውን ወይም የተቀጠቀጠውን ወይም የተሰበረውን ወይም የተቈረጠውን ለእግዚአብሔር አታቅርቡ፤ በምድራችሁም እነዚህን አትሠዉ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make in your land.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም ከእንግዳ ሰው እጅ ለአምላካችሁ እንጀራ አታቅርቡ፤ ርኵሰትም ነውርም አለባቸውና አይሠምሩላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption in them, blemishes in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም ፍየል ሲወለድ ሰባት ቀን ከእናቱ ጋር ይቀመጥ፤ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ከዚያም በላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን የሠመረ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ላም ወይም በግ ብትሆን እርስዋንና ልጅዋን በአንድ ቀን አትረዱ።

verses.text_english: And cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.text_amharic: የምስጋናንም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ስትሠዉ እንዲሠምርላችሁ ሠዉለት።

verses.text_english: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer at your own will.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያው ቀን ይበላል፤ ከእርሱ እስከ ነገ ምንም አትተዉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛቴን ጠብቁ፥ አድርጉትም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሰውንም ስሜን አታርክሱ፤ እኔ ግን በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል እቀደሳለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I the LORD which hallow you,
verses.text_amharic: የምቀድሳችሁ፥ አምላካችሁም እሆን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim holy convocations, these my feasts.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ብላችሁ የምታውጁአቸው በዓላቶቼ፥ የእግዚአብሔር በዓላት፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work : it the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ይሠራል፤ በሰባተኛው ቀን ግን የዕረፍት ሰንበት ነው፤ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆንበታል፤ ምንም ሥራ አትሠሩም፤ በምትኖሩበት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰንበት ነው።

verses.text_english: These the feasts of the LORD, holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የእግዚአብሔር በዓላት፥ በየዘመናቸው የምታውጁአቸው፥ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: In the fourteenth of the first month at even the LORD'S passover.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ሲመሽ የእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ነው።

verses.text_english: And on the fifteenth day of the same month the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የቂጣ በዓል ነው፤ ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ብሉ።

verses.text_english: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.text_english: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work .
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀንም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አቅርቡ፤ በሰባተኛው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ነው፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደምሰጣችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ መከሩንም ባጨዳችሁ ጊዜ፥ የእናንተን መከር በኵራት ነዶ ወደ ካህኑ አምጡ፤

verses.text_english: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ነዶውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲሠምርላችሁ ይወዝውዘው፤ በማግስቱ ከሰንበት በኋላ ካህኑ ይወዝውዘው።

verses.text_english: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነዶውንም በወዘወዛችሁበት ቀን ነውር የሌለበትን የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦት ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወደ እግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: And the meat offering thereof two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof of wine, the fourth of an hin.
verses.text_amharic: የእህልም ቍርባን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ የሆነ በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለእሳት ቍርባን ይሁን፤ የመጠጡም ቍርባን የወይን ጠጅ የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራውንም፥ የተጠበሰውንም እሸት፥ ለምለሙንም እሸት የአምላካችሁን ቍርባን እስከምታቀርቡበት እስከዚህ ቀን ድረስ አትብሉ። ይህ በምትቀመጡበት አገር ሁሉ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.text_english: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.text_amharic: የወዘወዛችሁትን ነዶ ከምታመጡበት ቀን በኋላ ከሰንበት ማግስት ፍጹም ሰባት ጊዜ ሰባት ቀን ቍጠሩ፤

verses.text_english: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ሰባተኛ ሰንበት ማግስት ድረስ አምሳ ቀን ቍጠሩ፤ አዲሱንም የእህል ቍርባን ወደ እግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; the firstfruits unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከየማደሪያችሁ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ ከሆነ መልካም ዱቄት የተሠራ ሁለት የመወዝወዝ እንጀራ ታመጣላችሁ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ለበኵራት ቍርባን እንዲሆን በእርሾ ይጋገራል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንጀራውም ጋር ነውር የሌለባቸውን የአንድ ዓመት ሰባት ጠቦቶች፥ አንድ ወይፈንም፥ ሁለትም አውራ በጎች ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ይሁኑ፤ ከእህልም ቍርባን፥ ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ጋር ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: አንድም አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሁለትም የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦቶች ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት አቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከበኵራቱ እንጀራ ከሁለቱም ጠቦቶች ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ይወዘውዛቸዋል፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ፈንታ ነው፤ ለካህኑ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ ታውጃላችሁ፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አታድርጉበት፤ በምትቀመጡበት አገር ሁሉ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.text_english: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: የምድራችሁንም መከር በሰበሰባችሁ ጊዜ የእርሻችሁን ድንበር ፈጽማችሁ አትጨዱ፥ የመከሩንም ቃርሚያ አትልቀሙ፤ ለድሆችና ለእንግዶች ተዉት፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። በሰባተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ዕረፍት፥ በመለከት ድምፅ መታሰቢያ፥ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall do no servile work : but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አታድርጉበት፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የእሳት ቍርባንን አቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Also on the tenth of this seventh month a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ በሰባተኛው ወር አሥረኛው ቀን የማስተስረያ ቀን ነው፤ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ ሰውነታችሁን አስጨንቋት፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የእሳት ቍርባንን አቅርቡ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላካችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ማስተስረያ ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ የማስተስረያ ቀን ነውና በዚያ ቀን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩ።

verses.text_english: For whatsoever soul that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የማይዋረድ ሰው ሁሉ ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever soul that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሥራ የሚሠራውን ሰው ሁሉ ከሕዝቡ መካከል አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall do no manner of work: a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራ ሁሉ አታድርጉበት፤ በምትቀመጡበት አገር ሁሉ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.text_english: It unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: የዕረፍት ሰንበት ይሁንላችሁ፥ ሰውነታችሁንም አዋርዱ፤ በወሩ በዘጠነኛው ቀን በማታ ጊዜ፥ ከማታ ጀምራችሁ እስከ ማታ ድረስ፥ ሰንበታችሁን አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month the feast of tabernacles seven days unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። በዚህ በሰባተኛው ወር ከአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ ሰባት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የዳስ በዓል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: On the first day an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work .
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁን፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አታድርጉበት።

verses.text_english: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it a solemn assembly; ye shall do no servile work .
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባንን አቅርቡ፤ በስምንተኛውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚቃጠለውን ቍርባን አቅርቡ፤ ዋና ጉባኤ ነው፤ የተግባር ሥራ ሁሉ አታድርጉበት።

verses.text_english: These the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን፥ መሥዋዕቱንም፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን፥ በየቀኑ የእሳት ቍርባን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታቀርቡባቸው ዘንድ የተቀደሱ ጉባኤዎች እንዲሆኑ የምታውጁአቸው የእግዚአብሔር በዓላት እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ከእግዚአብሔር ሰንበታት ሌላ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከምትሰጡት ከስጦታችሁ ሌላ፥ ከስእለታችሁም ሁሉ ሌላ፥ በፈቃዳችሁም ከምታቀርቡአቸው ሁሉ ሌላ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day a sabbath, and on the eighth day a sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰባተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን የምድሩን ፍሬ ካከማቻችሁ በኋላ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን በዓል ሰባት ቀን ጠብቁ፤ በመጀመሪያው ቀን ዕረፍት ይሁን፥ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ዕረፍት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ቀን የመልካም ዛፍ ፍሬ፥ የሰሌን ቅርንጫፍ፥ የለመለመውን ዛፍ ቅርንጫፍ፥ የወንዝም አኻያ ዛፍ ውሰዱ፤ በአምላካችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሰባት ቀን ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንንም በዓል በየዓመቱ ሰባት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር አድርጉ፤ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው፤ በሰባተኛው ወር ትጠብቁታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የእግዚአብሔርን በዓላት ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.text_amharic: መብራቱን ሁልጊዜ እንድታበራበት ለመብራት ጥሩ ተወቅጦ የተጠለለ የወይራ ዘይት ያመጡልህ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.text_amharic: በምስክሩ መጋረጃ ውጭ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ አሮን ከማታ እስከ ማለዳ ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ ያሰናዳው፤ ለዘላለም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ሥርዓት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በጥሩ መቅረዝ ላይ መብራቶቹን ሁልጊዜ ያሰናዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙንም ዱቄት ወስደህ አሥራ ሁለት ኅብስት ጋግር፤ በአንድ ኅብስት ውስጥ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም ስድስት ስድስቱን በሁለት ተርታ አድርገህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በጥሩ ገበታ ላይ አኑራቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ለእሳት ቍርባን በእንጀራው ላይ ለመታሰቢያ ይሆን ዘንድ በሁለቱ ተርታ ላይ ጥሩ ዕጣን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ በሰንበት ቀን ሁሉ በተርታ ያድርገው፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮንና ለልጆቹም ይሁን፤ በእሳት ከተደረገው ከእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን በዘላለም ሥርዓት ለእርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይብሉት።

verses.text_english: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ ግብፃዊ የነበረ የእስራኤላዊት ልጅ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወጣ፤ የእስራኤላዊቱ ልጅና አንድ እስራኤላዊ በሰፈር ውስጥ ተጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name , and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤላዊቱም ልጅ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ሰደበ፥ አቃለለውም፤ ወደ ሙሴም አመጡት። እናቱም ከዳን ነገድ የደብራይ ልጅ ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ሰሎሚት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔርም አፍ ስለ እርሱ ፍርድ እስኪወጣላቸው ድረስ በግዞት አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.text_amharic: ተሳዳቢውን ከስፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አውጣው፤ የሰሙትም ሁሉ እጃቸውን በራሱ ላይ ይጫኑበት፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ይውገረው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ትነግራለህ። ማናቸውም ሰው አምላኩን ቢሰድብ ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name , shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም የሚሰድብ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ይውገሩት፤ መጻተኛ ወይም የአገር ልጅ ቢሆን፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በሰደበ ጊዜ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውንም እስኪሞት ድረስ የሚመታ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሳንም እስኪሞት ድረስ የሚመታ ሕይወት በሕይወት ፋንታ ካሣውን ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ባልንጀራውን ቢጐዳ፥ እርሱ እንዳደረገ እንዲሁ ይደረግበት።

verses.text_english: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him .
verses.text_amharic: ስብራት በስብራት ፋንታ፥ ዓይን በዓይን ፋንታ፥ ጥርስ በጥርስ ፋንታ፥ ሰውን እንደ ጐዳ እንዲሁ ይደረግበት።

verses.text_english: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሳውንም የሚገድል ካሣ ይተካ፤ ሰውንም የሚገድል ይገደል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና ለመጻተኛና ለአገር ልጅ አንድ ዓይነት ሕግ ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገራቸው፤ ተሳዳቢውንም ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥ በድንጋይም ወገሩት። የእስራኤልም ልጆች እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በሲና ተራራ ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። እኔ ወደምሰጣችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ ምድሪቱ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰንበት ታድርግ።

verses.text_english: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ዓመት እርሻህን ዝራ፥ ስድስት ዓመትም ወይንህን ቍረጥ ፍሬዋንም አግባ።

verses.text_english: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛው ዓመት ግን ለምድሪቱ የዕረፍት ሰንበት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ሰንበት፥ ትሁን፤ እርሻህን አትዝራ፥ ወይንህንም አትቍረጥ።

verses.text_english: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.text_amharic: የምድራችሁን የገቦ አትጨደው፥ ያልተቈረጠውንም የወይንህን ፍሬ አታከማች፤ ለምድሪቱ የዕረፍት ሰንበት ዓመት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
verses.text_amharic: የምድርም ሰንበት ለአንተ፥ ለወንድ ባሪያህም፥ ለሴት ባሪያህም፥ ለምንደኛውም፥ ከአንተ ጋር ለሚኖር ለመጻተኛም ምግብ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.text_amharic: ለእንስሶችህም፥ በምድርህም ላሉት አራዊት ፍሬዋ ሁሉ መኖ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ጊዜ ሰባት አድርገህ የዓመታትን ሰንበት ሰባት ቍጠር፤ የሰባት ዓመታትም ሰንበት ዘመን አርባ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ትቈጥራለህ።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ በሰባተኛው ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን በቀንደ መለከት ታውጃለህ፤ በማስተስረያ ቀን በምድራችሁ ሁሉ በቀንደ መለከት ታውጃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.text_amharic: አምሳኛውንም ዓመት ትቀድሳላችሁ፥ በምድሪቱም ለሚኖሩባት ሁሉ ነጻነትን ታውጃላችሁ፤ እርሱ ለእናንተ ኢዮቤልዩ ነው፤ ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ርስቱና ወደ ወገኑ ይመለስ።

verses.text_english: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather in it of thy vine undressed.
verses.text_amharic: ያ አምሳኛው ዓመት ለእናንተ ኢዮቤልዩ ይሆናል፤ በእርሱም አትዝሩ፥ የገቦውንም አትጨዱ፥ የወይኑንም ፍሬ አታከማቹ።

verses.text_english: For it the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮቤልዩ ነውና የተቀደሰ ይሁንላችሁ፤ በሜዳ ላይ የበቀለውን ብሉ።

verses.text_english: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.text_amharic: በዚች በኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ርስቱ ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
verses.text_amharic: ለባልንጀራህም አንዳች ብትሸጥለት፥ ወይም ከባልንጀራህ እጅ ብትገዛ፥ ሰው ባልንጀራውን አያታልል።

verses.text_english: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
verses.text_amharic: ከኢዮቤልዩ በኋላ እንደ ዓመታቱ ቍጥር ከባልንጀራህ ትገዛለህ፤ እርሱም እንደ መከሩ ዓመታት ቍጥር ይሸጥልሃል።

verses.text_english: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for to the number of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ዓመታቱ ብዛት ዋጋውን ታበዛለህ፥ እንደ ዓመታቱም ማነስ ዋጋውን ታሳንሳለህ፤ እንደ መከሩ ቍጥር ይሸጥልሃል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና ሰው ባልንጀራውን አያታልል፥ ነገር ግን አምላክህን ፍራ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴንም አድርጉ፥ ፍርዶቼንም ጠብቁ አድርጉትም፤ በምድሪቱም ውስጥ በጸጥታ ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ፍሬዋን ትሰጣለች፥ እስክትጠግቡም ድረስ ትበላላችሁ፤ በእርስዋም ውስጥ በጸጥታ ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። ካልዘራን፥ እህላችንንም ካላከማቸን በሰባተኛው ዓመት ምን እንበላለን? ብትሉ፥

verses.text_english: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በስድስተኛው ዓመት በረከቴን በላያችሁ አዝዛለሁ፤ ምድሪቱም የሦስት ዓመት ፍሬ ታፈራለች።

verses.text_english: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat the old .
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ዓመት ትዘራላችሁ፥ ከአሮጌውም እህል ትበላላችሁ፤ ፍሬዋ እስኪገባ፥ እስከ ዘጠነኛው ዓመት ድረስ፥ ከአሮጌው እህል ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land mine; for ye strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ለእኔ ናትና፥ እናንተም ከእኔ ጋር እንግዶችና መጻተኞች ናችሁና ምድርን ለዘላለም አትሽጡ።

verses.text_english: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.text_amharic: በርስታችሁም ምድር ሁሉ መቤዠትን ለምድሪቱ አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህም ቢደኸይ ከርስቱም ቢሸጥ፥ ለእርሱ የቀረበ ዘመዱ መጥቶ ወንድሙ የሸጠውን ይቤዠዋል።

verses.text_english: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.text_amharic: የሚቤዠውም ሰው ቢያጣ፥ እርሱም እጁ ቢረጥብ፥ ለመቤዠትም የሚበቃ ቢያገኝ፥

verses.text_english: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.text_amharic: የሽያጩን ዘመን ቈጥሮ የቀረውን ወደ ገዛው ሰው ይመልስ፤ እርሱም ወደ ርስቱ ይመለስ።

verses.text_english: But if he be not able to restore to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሱም ዕዳውን መክፈል ባይችል፥ ሽያጩ በገዛው ሰው እጅ እስከ ኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ድረስ ይቀመጥ፤ በኢዮቤልዩም ዓመት ይውጣ፥ እርሱም ወደ ርስቱ ይመለስ።

verses.text_english: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; a full year may he redeem it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ቅጥር ባለበት ከተማ መኖሪያ ቤትን ቢሸጥ፥ ከተሸጠ በኋላ አንድ ዓመት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ለመቤዠት ይችላል፤ ለአንድ ሙሉ ዓመት መቤዠት ይችላል።

verses.text_english: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ዓመትም እስኪጨረስ ባይቤዠው፥ ቅጥር ባለበት ከተማ የሚሆን ቤት ለገዛው ለልጅ ልጁ ለዘላለም ይጸናለታል፤ በኢዮቤልዩም ከእርሱ አይወጣም።

verses.text_english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥር በሌለበት መንደር ያሉ ቤቶች ግን እንደ እርሻ ይቈጠራሉ፤ ይቤዣሉ፥ በኢዮቤልዩም ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱ ከተማ ያለ የሌዋውያን ቤት ግን ሌዋውያን ለዘላለም መቤዠት ይችላሉ።

verses.text_english: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሌዋውያን ቢገዛ፥ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል የሌዋውያን ከተማ ቤቶች ርስቶቻቸው ናቸውና በርስቱ ከተማ ያለ የተሸጠው ቤት በኢዮቤልዩ ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it their perpetual possession.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማቸውም ዙሪያ ያለችው መሰምርያ የዘላለም ርስታቸው ናትና አትሸጥም።

verses.text_english: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህ ቢደኸይ እጁም በአንተ ዘንድ ቢደክም፥ አጽናው፤ እንደ እንግዳና እንደ መጻተኛም ከአንተ ጋር ይኑር።

verses.text_english: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህ ከአንተ ጋር ይኖር ዘንድ ከእርሱ ምንም ወለድ ወይም ትርፍ አትውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን አምላክህን ፍራ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
verses.text_amharic: ብርህን በወለድ አታበድረው፤ መኖህንም በትርፍ አትስጠው።

verses.text_english: I the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, to be your God.
verses.text_amharic: የከነዓንን ምድር እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ፥ አምላክም እሆናችሁ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And if thy brother by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህም ቢደኸይ ራሱንም ለአንተ ቢሸጥ፥ እንደ ባሪያ አድርገህ አትግዛው።

verses.text_english: as an hired servant, as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምንደኛና እንደ መጻተኛ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ እስከ ኢዮቤልዩም ዓመት ያገልግልህ።

verses.text_english: And shall he depart from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም እርሱ ከልጆቹ ጋር ከአንተ ይውጣ፥ ወደ ወገኖቹም ወደ አባቱም ርስት ይመለስ።

verses.text_english: For they my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋቸው ባሪያዎቼ ናቸውና እንደ ባሪያዎች አይሸጡ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.text_amharic: በጽኑ እጅ አትግዛው፥ ነገር ግን አምላክህን ፍራ።

verses.text_english: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድ ባሪያና ሴት ባሪያ መግዛት ብትፈልግ ግን በዙሪያችሁ ካሉት ከእነርሱ ከአሕዛብ ወንድና ሴት ባሪያዎችን ግዙ።

verses.text_english: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በእናንተ መካከል ከሚቀመጡት መጻተኞች፥ በምድራችሁም ውስጥ ከወለዱአቸው በእናንተ መካከል ከሚቀመጡት ከዘራቸው ውስጥ ባሪያዎችን ግዙ፤ ርስትም ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም በኋላ ልጆቻችሁ ይወርሱአቸው ዘንድ ተዉአቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ባሪያዎችን ለዘላለም ትወስዳላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ወንድሞቻችሁን በጽኑ እጅ አትግዙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
verses.text_amharic: በአንተም ዘንድ የሚኖር መጻተኛ ወይም እንግዳ ሀብታም ቢሆን፥ ወንድምህም በእርሱ አጠገብ ቢደኸይ፥ ራሱንም ለመጻተኛው ወይም ለእንግዳው ወይም ለወገኖቹ ዘር ቢሸጥ፥

verses.text_english: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.text_amharic: ከተሸጠ በኋላ መቤዠት ይችላል፤ ከወንድሞቹ አንዱ ይቤዠው፤

verses.text_english: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም አጎቱ ወይም የአጎቱ ልጅ ይቤዠው፤ ወይም ከወገኑ ለእርሱ የቀረበ ዘመድ ይቤዠው፤ ወይም እርሱ እጁ ቢረጥብ ራሱን ይቤዠው።

verses.text_english: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.text_amharic: ከገዛውም ሰው ጋር ከገዛበት ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ ኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ድረስ ይቍጠር፤ የሽያጩም ብር እንደ ዓመታቱ ቍጥር ይሁን፤ እንደ ምንደኛውም ዘመን ከእርሱ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: If yet many years , according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ዓመታትም ቢቀሩ እንደ እነርሱ ቍጥር ከሽያጩ ብር የመቤዠቱን ዋጋ ይመልስ።

verses.text_english: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ድረስ ጥቂቶች ዓመታት ቢቀሩ ከእርሱ ጋር ይቈጥራል፤ እንደ ዓመታቱም መጠንየመቤዠቱን ዋጋ ይመልስ።

verses.text_english: as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: በየዓመቱ እንደ ምንደኛ ከእርሱ ጋር ይኑር፤ በፊትህ በጽኑ እጅ አይግዛው።

verses.text_english: And if he be not redeemed in these , then he shall go out in the year of jubile, he, and his children with him.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ዘመን ሁሉ ግን ባይቤዥ በኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት እርሱ ከልጆቹ ጋር ይውጣ።

verses.text_english: For unto me the children of Israel servants; they my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእኔ ባሪያዎች ናቸውና፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋቸው ባሪያዎቼ ናቸው፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና ለእናንተ ጣዖት አታድርጉ፥ የተቀረጸም ምስል ወይም ሐውልት አታቁሙ፤ ትሰግዱለትም ዘንድ በምድራችሁ ላይ የተቀረጸ ድንጋይ አታኑሩ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰንበታቴን ጠብቁ፥ መቅደሴንም ፍሩ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.text_amharic: በሥርዓቴ ብትሄዱ፥ ትእዛዛቴንም ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጉትም፥

verses.text_english: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናባችሁን በወቅቱ አዘንባለሁ፥ ምድሪቱም እህልዋን ትሰጣለች፥ የሜዳው ዛፎችም ፍሬአቸውን ይሰጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉም ማበራየት በእናንተ ዘንድ እስከ ወይኑ መቍረጥ ይደርሳል፥ የወይኑም መቍረጥ እስከ እህሉ መዝራት ይደርሳል፤ እስክትጠግቡም ድረስ እንጀራችሁን ትበላላችሁ፥ በምድራችሁም ላይ በጸጥታ ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.text_amharic: በምድራችሁም ላይ ሰላምን እሰጣለሁ፥ ማንም ሳያስፈራችሁ ትተኛላችሁ፤ ክፉዎችንም አራዊት ከምድራችሁ አጠፋለሁ፥ ሰይፍም በምድራችሁ ላይ አያልፍም።

verses.text_english: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቻችሁንም ታሳድዳላችሁ፥ በፊታችሁም በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም አምስቱ መቶውን ያሳድዳሉ፥ መቶውም አሥሩን ሺህ ያሳድዳሉ፤ ጠላቶቻችሁም በፊታችሁ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.text_amharic: ፊቴም ወደ እናንተ ይሆናል፥ እንድታፈሩም አደርጋችኋለሁ፥ አበዛችሁማለሁ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔንም ከእናንተ ጋር አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜ የተቀመጠውንም አሮጌውን እህል ትበላላችሁ፤ ከአዲሱም በፊት አሮጌውን ታወጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያዬንም በእናንተ መካከል አደርጋለሁ፤ ነፍሴም አትጸየፋችሁም።

verses.text_english: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላችሁም እሄዳለሁ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች እዳትሆኑአቸው ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ፤ የባርነታችሁን ቀንበር ሰብሬአለሁ፤ ቀና ብላችሁ እንድትሄዱ አድርጌአችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ባትሰሙኝ፥ እነዚህንም ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.text_english: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, that ye break my covenant:
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴንም ብትንቁ፥ ትእዛዛቴንም ሁሉ እንዳታደርጉ፥ ቃል ኪዳኔንም እንድታፈርሱ ነፍሳችሁ ፍርዴን ብትጸየፍ፥

verses.text_english: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እንዲህ አደርግባችኋለሁ፤ ፍርሃትን፥ ክሳትንም፥ ዓይናችሁንም የሚያፈዝዝ፥ ሰውነታችሁንም የሚያማስን ትኩሳት አወርድባችኋለሁ፤ ዘራችሁንም በከንቱ ትዘራላችሁ፥ ጠላቶቻችሁ ይበሉታልና።

verses.text_english: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.text_amharic: ፊቴንም አከብድባችኋለሁ፥ በጠላቶቻችሁም ፊት ትወድቃላችሁ፤ የሚጠሉአችሁም ይገዙአችኋል፤ ማንም ሳያሳድዳችሁ ትሸሻላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.text_amharic: እስከዚህም ድረስ ባትሰሙኝ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁ በቅጣታችሁ ላይ ሰባት እጥፍ እጨምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.text_amharic: የኃይላችሁንም ትዕቢት እሰብራለሁ፤ ሰማያችሁንም እንደ ብረት፥ ምድራችሁንም እንደ ናስ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልበታችሁም በከንቱ ያልቃል፤ ምድራችሁም እህልዋን አትሰጥም፥ የምድርም ዛፎች ፍሬአቸውን አይሰጡም።

verses.text_english: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.text_amharic: በእንቢተኝነትም ብትሄዱብኝ ባትሰሙኝም፥ እንደ ኃጢአታችሁ መጠን በመቅሠፍት ላይ ሰባት እጥፍ እጨምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your ways shall be desolate.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላችሁም የምድርን አራዊት እሰድዳለሁ፤ ልጆቻችሁንም ይነጥቃሉ፥ እንስሶቻችሁንም ያጠፋሉ፥ እናንተንም ያሳንሳሉ፤ መንገዶቻችሁም በረሃ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.text_amharic: እስከዚህም ድረስ ባትቀጡ፥ በእንቢተኝነትም ብትሄዱ፥

verses.text_english: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ በእንቢተኝነት እሄድባችኋለሁ፤ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁም ሰባት እጥፍ እመታችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: የቃል ኪዳኔንም በቀል ይበቀልባችሁ ዘንድ ሰይፍ አመጣባችኋለሁ፤ ወደ ከተማችሁም ትሰበሰባላችሁ፥ ቸነፈርንም እሰድድባችኋለሁ፤ በጠላትም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.text_amharic: የእህላችሁንም ድጋፍ በሰበርሁ ጊዜ፥ አሥር ሴቶች እንጀራቸውን በአንድ ምጣድ ይጋግራሉ፥ በሚዛንም መዝነው እንጀራችሁን ይመልሱላችኋል፤ በበላችሁም ጊዜ አትጠግቡም።

verses.text_english: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.text_amharic: እስከዚህም ድረስ ባትሰሙኝ፥ በእንቢተኝነትም ብትሄዱብኝ፥

verses.text_english: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ በቍጣ እሄድባችኋለሁ፤ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁም ሰባት እጥፍ እቀጣችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.text_amharic: የወንዶች ልጆቻችሁንም ሥጋ ትበላላችሁ፤ የሴቶች ልጆቻችሁንም ሥጋ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.text_amharic: የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቻችሁንም አፈርሳለሁ፥ የፀሐይ ምስሎቻችሁንም አጠፋለሁ፥ ሬሳችሁንም በጣዖቶቻችሁ ሬሳዎች ላይ እጥላለሁ፤ ነፍሴም ትጸየፋችኋለች።

verses.text_english: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞቻችሁንም ባድማ አደርጋለሁ፥ መቅደሶቻችሁንም አፈርሳለሁ፥ መልካሙንም መዓዛችሁን አላሸትትም።

verses.text_english: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱንም የተፈታች አደርጋለሁ፤ የሚቀመጡባት ጠላቶቻችሁም በእርስዋ የተነሣ ይደነቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተንም ከአሕዛብ መካከል እበትናችኋለሁ፥ ሰይፍንም አስመዝዝባችኋለሁ፤ ምድራችሁም የተፈታች ትሆናለች፥ ከተሞቻችሁም ባድማ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye in your enemies' land; then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በተፈታችበት ዘመን ሁሉ እናንተም በጠላቶቻችሁ ምድር ሳላችሁ፥ ምድሪቱ ሰንበት በማድረግዋ ትደሰታለች፤ በዚያም ጊዜ ምድሪቱ ታርፋለች፥ ሰንበትንም በማድረግዋ ትደሰታለች።

verses.text_english: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ተቀምጣችሁባት በነበረ ጊዜ በሰንበቶቻችሁ አላረፈችም ነበርና በተፈታችበት ዘመን ሁሉ ታርፋለች።

verses.text_english: And upon them that are left of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.text_amharic: በጠላቶቻቸውም ምድሮች ሳሉ ከእናንተ ተለይተው በቀሩት ላይ በልባቸው ድንጋጤን እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፤ በነፋስም የምትንቀሳቀስ የቅጠል ድምፅ ታሸብራቸዋለች፤ ከሰይፍ እንደሚሸሹ ይሸሻሉ፤ ማንም ሳያሳድዳቸው ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሳያሳድዳቸው ከሰይፍ እንዲሸሹ እርስ በርሳቸው ይሰነካከላሉ፤ እናንተም በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት መቆም አትችሉም።

verses.text_english: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብም መካከል ታልቃላችሁ፥ የጠላቶቻችሁም ምድር ትውጣችኋለች።

verses.text_english: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ተለይተው የቀሩት በጠላቶቻቸው ምድር ላይ በኃጢአታቸው ይከሳሉ፤ በአባቶቻቸውም ኃጢአት ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይከሳሉ።

verses.text_english: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.text_amharic: በእኔም ላይ በእንቢተኝነት ስለ ሄዱብኝ የበደሉኝን በደል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም፥ የአባቶቻቸውንም ኃጢአት ይናዘዛሉ።

verses.text_english: And I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ደግሞ በእንቢተኝነት ሄድሁባቸው፤ ወደ ጠላቶቻቸውም ምድር አገባኋቸው፤ ነገር ግን በዚያን ጊዜ ያልተገረዘው ልባቸው ቢዋረድ፥ የኃጢአታቸውንም ቅጣት ቢቀበሉ፥

verses.text_english: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ለያዕቆብ የማልሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አስባለሁ፤ ደግሞ ለይስሐቅና ለአብርሃም የማልሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አስባለሁ፤ ምድሪቱንም አስባለሁ።

verses.text_english: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ከእነርሱ መጥፋት የተነሣ ባዶ ትቀራለች፤ እነርሱም ሳይኖሩ በተፈታችበት ዘመን ሰንበት በማድረግዋ ትደሰታለች፤ ፍርዴንም ስለ ናቁ፥ ነፍሳቸውም ሥርዓቴን ስለ ተጸየፈች የኃጢአታቸውን ቅጣት ይሸከማሉ።

verses.text_english: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I the LORD their God.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው ነኝኛ እነርሱ በጠላቶቻቸው ምድር ሳሉ፥ እስካጠፋቸው ድረስ ከእነርሱም ጋር ያለኝን ቃል ኪዳን እስካፈርስ ድረስ አልጥላቸውም አልጸየፋቸውምም።

verses.text_english: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አምላካቸው እሆን ዘንድ አሕዛብ እያዩ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋቸውን የአባቶቻቸውን ቃል ኪዳን ስለ እነርሱ አስባለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: These the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእርሱና በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል በሲና ተራራ ላይ በሙሴ እጅ ያደረጋቸው ሥርዓቶችና ፍርዶች ሕግጋትም እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons for the LORD by thy estimation.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ማናቸውም ሰው ሰውን ለእግዚአብሔር ሊሰጥ ቢሳል አንተ እንደምትገምተው መጠን ስለ ሰው ዋጋውን ይስጥ።

verses.text_english: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ለወንድ ከሃያ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ ስድሳ ዓመት ድረስ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ግምቱ አምሳ የብር ሰቅል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if it a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.text_amharic: ሴትም ብትሆን ግምትዋ ሠላሳ ሰቅል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.text_amharic: ከአምስት ዓመትም ጀምሮ እስከ ሀያ ዓመት ድረስ ግምቱ ለወንድ ሀያ ሰቅል፥ ለሴትም አሥር ሰቅል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation three shekels of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንድ ወርም እስከ አምስት ዓመት ድረስ ለወንድ ግምቱ አምስት የብር ሰቅል፥ ለሴትም ግምትዋ ሦስት የብር ሰቅል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And if from sixty years old and above; if a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.text_amharic: ከስድሳ ዓመትም ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ወንድ ቢሆን ግምቱ አሥራ አምስት ሰቅል፥ ለሴትም አሥር ሰቅል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.text_amharic: ለግምቱም የሚከፍለውን ቢያጣ ግን በካህኑ ፊት ይቁም፥ ካህኑም የተሳለውን ሰው ይገምተው፤ ካህኑም የተሳለው ሰው እንደሚችል መጠን ይገምተው።

verses.text_english: And if a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም መሥዋዕት አድርጎ የሚያቀርበው እንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ሰው ከእነዚህ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሰጠው ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙን በክፉ፥ ክፉውንም በመልካም አይለውጥ፤ እንስሳንም በእንስሳ ቢለውጥ እርሱና ልዋጩ የተቀደሱ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And if any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.text_amharic: እንስሳው ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት መሆን የማይገባው ርኩስ ቢሆን፥ እንስሳውን በካህኑ ፊት ያኑረው።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, the priest, so shall it be.
verses.text_amharic: መልካምም ቢሆን ክፉም ቢሆን ካህኑ ይገምተው፤ ካህኑም እነሚገምተው መጠን እንዲሁ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.text_amharic: ይቤዠውም ዘንድ ቢወድድ ከግምቱ በላይ አምስተኛ ይጨምር።

verses.text_english: And when a man shall sanctify his house holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ይሆን ዘንድ ቤቱን ቢቀድስ፥ ካህኑ መልካም ወይም ክፉ እንደ ሆነ ይገምተዋል፤ ካህኑም እንደሚገምተው መጠን እንዲሁ ይቆማል።

verses.text_english: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.text_amharic: የቀደሰውም ሰው ቤቱን ይቤዠው ዘንድ ቢወድድ ከግምቱ ገንዘብ በላይ አምስተኛ ይጨምር፤ ቤቱም ለእርሱ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ከርስቱ እርሻ ለእግዚአብሔር ቢቀድስ፥ እንደ መዘራቱ መጠን ይገመት፤ አንድ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ገብስ የሚዘራበት እርሻ አምሳ የብር ሰቅል ይገመታል።
