verses.text_english: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻውንም ከኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ጀምሮ ቢቀድስ፥ እንደ ግምቱ መጠን ይቆማል።

verses.text_english: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻውንም ከኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት በኋላ ቢቀድስ፥ ካህኑ እስከ ኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ድረስ እንደ ቀሩት ዓመታት ገንዘቡን ይቈጥርለታል፤ ከግምቱም ይጐድላል።

verses.text_english: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻውንም የቀደሰ ሰው ይቤዠው ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥ ከግምቱ ገንዘብ በላይ አምስተኛ ይጨምር፤ ለእርሱም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻውንም ባይቤዠው፥ ወይም ለሌላ ሰው ቢሸጥ፥ እንደገና ይቤዠው ዘንድ አይቻለውም።

verses.text_english: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻው ግን በኢዮቤልዩ ሲወጣ እንደ እርም ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ እርሻ ይሆናል፤ ርስቱ ለካህኑ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And if sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which not of the fields of his possession;
verses.text_amharic: ከርስቱ እርሻ ያልሆነውን የገዛውን እርሻ ለእግዚአብሔር ቢቀድስ፥

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ እስከ ኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት ድረስ የግምቱን ዋጋ ይቈጥርለታል፤ በዚያም ቀን ግምቱን እንደ ተቀደሰ ነገር ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, to him to whom the possession of the land .
verses.text_amharic: በኢዮቤልዩ ዓመት እርሻው የምድሪቱ ባለ ርስት ወደ ነበረው ወደ ሸጠው ሰው ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.text_amharic: ግምቱም ሁሉ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ይሆናል፤ ሰቅሉ ሀያ አቦሊ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD'S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether ox, or sheep: it the LORD'S.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ግን የሚቀርበውን የእንስሳ በኵራት ማንም ይቀድሰው ዘንድ አይቻለውም፤ በሬ ቢሆን ወይም በግ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: And if of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.text_amharic: የረከሰም እንስሳ ቢሆን እንደ ግምቱ ይቤዠው፥ በእርሱም የዋጋውን አምስተኛ ይጨምርበታል፤ ባይቤዠውም እንደ ግምቱ ይሸጣል።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing most holy unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም የተለየ እርም የሆነ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ሰው ቢሆን ወይም እንስሳ ወይም የርስቱ እርሻ ቢሆን፥ አይሸጥም፥ አይቤዥም፤ እርም የሆነ ነገር ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.text_english: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; shall surely be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰዎችም እርም የሆነ ሁሉ አይቤዥም፤ ፈጽሞ ይገደላል።

verses.text_english: And all the tithe of the land, of the seed of the land, of the fruit of the tree, the LORD'S: holy unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የምድርም አሥራት፥ ወይም የምድር ዘር ወይም የዛፍ ፍሬ ቢሆን፥ የእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if a man will at all redeem of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም አሥራቱን ሊቤዥ ቢወድድ፥ አምስተኛ ይጨምርበታል።

verses.text_english: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከበሬም ሁሉ ከአሥር አንድ፥ ከእረኛውም በትር በታች ከሚያልፍ በግና ፍየል ሁሉ ከአሥር አንድ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ወይም ክፉ እንዲሆን አይመርምር፥ አይለውጥም፤ ቢለውጠውም እርሱና ልዋጩ የተቀደሱ ይሆናሉ፤ አይቤዠውም።

verses.text_english: These the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሲና ተራራ ላይ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሙሴን ያዘዘው ትእዛዛት እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በሲና ምድረ በዳ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ፥ በሁለተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን፥ ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ዓመት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of names, every male by their polls;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ድምር፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ በየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ወንዱን በየራሱ፥ ውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.text_amharic: ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን፥ ከእስራኤል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡትን ሁሉ፥ አንተና አሮን በየሠራዊቶቻቸው ቍጠሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ከየነገዱም አንድ ሰው የአባቶቹ ቤት አለቃ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the men that shall stand with you: of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ጋር የሚቆሙት ሰዎች ስሞቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከሮቤል የሰዲዮር ልጅ

verses.text_english: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሱር፥ ከስምዖን የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል፥

verses.text_english: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን፥

verses.text_english: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሳኮር የሶገር ልጅ ናትናኤል፥

verses.text_english: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሴር የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል፥

verses.text_english: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.text_amharic: ከጋድ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ፥

verses.text_english: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፍታሌም የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ።

verses.text_english: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.text_amharic: ከማኅበሩ የተመረጡ የእስራኤል አእላፍ ታላላቆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ነገድ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም እነዚህን በስማቸው የተጠሩትን ሰዎች ወሰዱአቸው፤

verses.text_english: These the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ሰበሰቡአቸው፤ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን በየራሱ በየወገኑም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች በየስማቸው ቍጥር ትውልዳቸውን ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by names:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ በሲና ምድረ በዳ ቈጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል በኵር የሮቤል ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ በየራሳቸው፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: ከሮቤል ነገድ የተቈጠሩ አርባ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖን ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የተቈጠሩ፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ በየራሳቸው፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከስምዖን ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ዘጠኝ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከጋድ ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አርባ አምስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ሰባ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.text_amharic: የይሳኮር ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛብሎን ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሰባት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

verses.text_english: Of the children of Joseph, , of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከብንያም ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ሠላሳ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳን ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ስድሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_amharic: ከአሴር ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አርባ አንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፍታሌም ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: These those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ ስድስት መቶ ሦስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያን ግን በየአባቶቻቸው ነገድ ከእነርሱ ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.text_english: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። የሌዊን ነገድ አትቍጠረው፥

verses.text_english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጥራቸውንም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አታድርግ፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በምስክሩ ማደሪያና በዕቃዎች ሁሉ ለእርሱም በሚሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ላይ ሌዋውያንን አቁማቸው። ማደሪያውንና ዕቃዎችን ሁሉ ይሸከሙ፥ ያገልግሉትም፥ በማደሪያውም ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ።

verses.text_english: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያውም ሲነሣ ሌዋውያን ይንቀሉት፤ ማደሪያውም በሰፈረ ጊዜ ሌዋውያን ይትከሉት፤ ሌላ ሰው ግን ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ በየሰፈሩ፥ በየዓላማውም፥ በየጭፍራውም ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይወርድ ሌዋውያን በምስክሩ ማደሪያ ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ፤ ሌዋውያንም የምስክሩን ማደሪያ ይጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴና ለአሮን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች እያንዳንዱ በየዓላማው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ምልክት ይስፈሩ፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን አፋዛዥ ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab captain of the children of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ የሚሰፍሩት እንደ ሠራዊቶቻቸው የይሁዳ ሰፈር ዓላማ ሰዎች ይሆናሉ፤ የይሁዳ ልጆችም አለቃ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ሰባ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And those that do pitch next unto him the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የሚሰፍሩ የይሳኮር ነገድ ይሆናሉ፤ የይሳኮርም ልጆች አለቃ የሶገር ልጅ ናትናኤል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ አራት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የዛብሎን ነገድ ነበረ፤ የዛብሎንም ልጆች አለቃ የኬሎን ልጅ ኤልያብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ ሰባት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው መቶ ሰማንያ ስድስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ። እነዚህም አስቀድመው ይጓዛሉ።

verses.text_english: On the south side the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብ በኩል በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የሮቤል ሰፈር ዓላማ ይሆናል፤ የሮቤልም ልጆች አለቃ የሰዲዮር ልጅ ኤሊሱር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And those which pitch by him the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የሚሰፍሩ የስምዖን ነገድ ናቸው፤ የስምዖንም ልጆች አለቃ የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ ዘጠኝ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የጋድ ነገድ ነበረ፤ የጋድም ልጆች አለቃ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ አምስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.text_amharic: ከሮቤል ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው መቶ አምሳ አንድ ሺህ አራት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ። እነርሱም ቀጥለው ይጓዛሉ።

verses.text_english: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የመገናኛው ድንኳን በሰፈሮቹም መካከል የሌዋውያን ሰፈር ይጓዛል፤ እንደ ሰፈራቸው ሰው ሁሉ በየስፍራው በየዓላማውም ይጓዛሉ።

verses.text_english: On the west side the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራብ በኩል እንደ ሠራዊቶቻቸው የኤፍሬም ሰፈር ዓላማ ይሆናል፤ የኤፍሬም ልጆች አለቃ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ኤሊሳማ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And by him the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የምናሴ ነገድ ይሆናል፤ የምናሴም ልጆች አለቃ የፍዳሱር ልጅ ገማልኤል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የብንያም ነገድ ይሆናል፤ ይብንያምም ልጆች አለቃ የጋዴዮን ልጅ አቢዳን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ሠላሳ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤፍሬም ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው መቶ ስምንት ሺህ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ። እነርሱም ሦስተኛ ሆነው ይጓዛሉ።

verses.text_english: The standard of the camp of Dan on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜን በኩል እንደ ሠራዊቶቻቸው የዳን ሰፈር ዓላማ ይሆናል፤ የዳንም ልጆች አለቃ የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዘር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ስድሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And those that encamp by him the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የሚሰፍሩ የአሴር ነገድ ይሆናሉ፤ የአሴርም ልጆች አለቃ የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ አንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የንፍታሌም ነገድ ይሆናል፤ የንፍታሌምም ልጆች አለቃ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳን ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ መቶ አምሳ ሰባት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ። እነርሱም በየዓላሞቻቸው በመጨረሻ ይጓዛሉ።

verses.text_english: These those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ልጆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የተቈጠሩ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከየሰፈሩ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ ስድስት መቶ ሦስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያን ግን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ በዓላሞቻቸው አጠገብ ሰፈሩ፥ እንዲሁም በየወገኖቻቸው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ተጓዙ።

verses.text_english: These also the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሲና ተራራ ላይ ሙሴን በተናገረበት ቀን የአሮንና የሙሴ ትውልድ ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮን ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፤ በኵሩ ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር።

verses.text_english: These the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀቡ ካህናት በክህነትም ያገለግሉ ዘንድ የቀደሳቸው የአሮን ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.text_amharic: ናዳብና አብዩድ በሲና ምድረ በዳ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ልዩ እሳት ባቀረቡ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞቱ፤ ልጆችም አልነበሩአቸውም። አልዓዛርና ኢታምር በአባታቸው በአሮን ፊት በክህነት ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊን ነገድ አቅርበህ ያገለግሉት ዘንድ በካህኑ በአሮን ፊት አቁማቸው።

verses.text_english: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: የማደሪያውንም ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ፥ እርሱንና ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ለማገልገል የሚያስፈልገውን ነገር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ይጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: የማደሪያውንም ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ፥ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይጠብቁ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ለማገልገል የሚያስፈልገውንም ነገር ይጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንንም ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ትሰጣለህ፤ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ለእርሱ ፈጽመው ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንንና ልጆቹን አቁማቸው፥ ክህነታቸውንም ይጠብቁ፤ ሌላ ሰውም ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ማኅፀን በሚከፍተው በበኵሩ ሁሉ ፋንታ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጄአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Because all the firstborn mine; on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በኵር ሁሉ ለእኔ ነውና ሌዋውያን ለእኔ ይሁኑ፤ በግብፅ ምድር በኵርን ሁሉ በመታሁ ቀን፥ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ በኵርን ሁሉ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳን፥ ለእኔ ለይቼአለሁ፤ ለእኔ ይሁኑ። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በሲና ምድረ በዳ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊን ልጆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች በየወገናቸውም ቍጠር፤ ወንዱን ሁሉ ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን ቍጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዳዘዘው ቈጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊ ልጆች በየስማቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶንም ልጆች ስሞች በየወገናቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሎቤኒ፥ ሰሜኢ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓትም ልጆች በየወገናቸው እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ሞሖሊ፥ ሙሲ። የሌዋውያን ወገኖች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Of Gershon the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these the families of the Gershonites.
verses.text_amharic: ለጌድሶን የሎቤናውያን ወገን የሰሜአውያንም ወገን ነበሩት፤ የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, those that were numbered of them seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩት የወንዶች ሁሉ ቍጥር ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የተቈጠሩት ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች ከማደሪያው በኋላ በምዕራብ ብኩል ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶናውያንም አባቶች ቤት አለቃ የዳኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.text_amharic: ጌድሶናውያንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን የሚጠብቁት ማደሪያው፥ ድንኳኑም፥ መደረቢያውም፥ የመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥

verses.text_english: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በማደሪያውና በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ያለው የአደባባዩ መጋረጆች፥ የአደባባዩም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥ ለማገልገሉም ያሉት ገመዶች ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And of Kohath the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these the families of the Kohathites.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀዓትም የእንበረማውያን ወገን፥ የይስዓራውያንም ወገን፥ የኬብሮናውያንም ወገን፥ የዑዝኤላውያንም ወገን ነበሩ፤ የቀዓታውያን ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶች ሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ስምንት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ፤ መቅደሱንም ይጠብቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓት ልጆች ወገኖች በማደሪያው አጠገብ በደቡብ በኩል ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓታውያንም ወገኖች አባቶች ቤት አለቃ የዑዝኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፈን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And their charge the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ታቦቱንም፥ ገበታውንም፥ መቅረዙንም፥ መሠዊያዎቹንም፥ የሚያገለግሉበትንም የመቅደሱን ዕቃ፥ መጋረጃውንም፥ ማገልገያውንም ሁሉ ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest chief over the chief of the Levites, the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዋውያንም አለቆች አለቃ የካህኑ የአሮን ልጅ አልዓዛር ይሆናል፤ እርሱም መቅደሱን በሚጠብቁት ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Of Merari the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these the families of Merari.
verses.text_amharic: ከሜራሪ የሞሖላውያን ወገን የሙሳያውያንም ወገን ነበሩ፤ የሜራሪ ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, six thousand and two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ወንዶች ሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የተቈጠሩት ስድስት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari Zuriel the son of Abihail: shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪም ወገኖች አባቶች ቤት አለቃ የአቢካኢል ልጅ ሱሪኤል ነበረ፤ በማደሪያው አጠገብ በሰሜን በኩል ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: And the custody and charge of the sons of Merari the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪም ልጆች የሚጠብቁት የማደሪያው ሳንቆች፥ መወርወሪያዎችም፥ ተራዳዎችም፥ እግሮቹም፥ ዕቃውም ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.text_amharic: ማገልገያውም ሁሉ፥ በዙሪያውም የሚቆሙ የአደባባይ ምሰሶች፥ እግሮቹም፥ ካስማዎቹም፥ አውታሮቹም ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: በማደሪያውም ፊት በምሥራቅ በኩል በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት በስተ ፀሐይ መውጫ የሚሰፍሩት ሙሴና አሮን ልጆቹም ይሆናሉ፥ መቅደሱንም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ይጠብቃሉ፤ ልዩም ሰው ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, twenty and two thousand.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ ከሌዋውያን ወንዶች ሁሉ ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ በየወገናቸው የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ወንዱን በኵር ሁሉ ቍጠር፤ ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉትን የስማቸውን ቍጥር ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንንም በእስራኤል ልጆች በኵር ሁሉ ፋንታ፥ የሌዋውያንንም እንስሶች በእስራኤል ልጆች እንስሶች በኵር ሁሉ ፋንታ ለእኔ ለእግዚአብሔር ውሰድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው የእስራኤልን ልጆች በኵር ሁሉ ቈጠረ።

verses.text_english: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ወንዶች በኵሮች ሁሉ የበስማቸው ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሰባ ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንን በእስራኤል ልጆች በኵር ሁሉ ፋንታ፥ የሌዋውያንንም እንስሶች በእንስሶቻቸው ፋንታ ውሰድ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለእኔ ይሁኑ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.text_amharic: በሌዋውያን ላይ ከእስራኤል ልጆች በኵር ስለ ተረፉት ስለ ሁለት መቶ ሰባ ሦስት ቤዛ፥ በየራሱ አምስት ሰቅል ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take : (the shekel twenty gerahs:)
verses.text_amharic: እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ትወስዳለህ፤ ሰቅሉም ሀያ አቦሊ ነው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ተረፉትም የመቤዣውን ገንዘብ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ስጥ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በሌዋውያን ከተቤዡት በላይ ከተረፉት ዘንድ የመቤዣውን ገንዘብ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five , after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ልጆች በኵሮች ገንዘቡን ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል፥ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ ሙሴ የመቤዣውን ገንዘብ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዊ ልጆች መካከል በየወገናቸው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የቀዓትን ልጆች ድምር ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡበትን ሁሉ ትደምራለህ።

verses.text_english: This the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, the most holy things:
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ዘንድ የቀዓት ልጆች ሥራ ይህ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.text_amharic: ከሰፈሩ በተነሡ ጊዜ አሮንና ልጆቹ ገብተው የሚሸፍነውን መጋረጃ ያውርዱ፥ የምስክሩንም ታቦት ይጠቅልሉበት፤

verses.text_english: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በላዩም የአቆስጣውን ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ያድርጉበት፥ ከእርሱም በላይ ሁለንተናው ሰማያዊ የሆነ መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.text_english: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.text_amharic: በገጽ ኅብስት ገበታ ላይ ሰማያዊውን መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፤ በእርሱም ላይ ወጭቶቹን፥ ጭልፋዎቹንም፥ ጽዋዎቹንም፥ ለማፍሰስም መቅጃዎቹን ያድርጉ፤ ሁልጊዜም የሚኖር እንጀራ በእርሱ ላይ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም ላይ ቀይ መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉ፥ በአቆስጣውም ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.text_english: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያዊውንም መጐናጸፊያ ይውሰዱ፥ የሚያበራውንም መቅረዝ፥ ቀንዲሎቹንም፥ መኰስተሪያዎቹንም፥ የኩስታሪ ማድረጊያዎቹንም፥ እርሱንም ለማገልገል የዘይቱን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ይሸፍኑ፤

verses.text_english: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put upon a bar.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንና ዕቃዎቹን ሁሉ በአቆስጣ ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ውስጥ ያድርጉ፥ በመሸከሚያውም ላይ ያድርጉት።

verses.text_english: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.text_amharic: በወርቁም መሠዊያ ላይ ሰማያዊውን መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፥ በአቆስጣም ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.text_english: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put on a bar:
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስም ውስጥ የሚያገልግሉበትን የማገልገያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይውሰዱ፥ በሰማያዊውም መጐናጸፊያ ውስጥ ያስቀምጡት፥ በአቆስጣም ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት፥ በመሸከሚያውም ላይ ያድርጉት።

verses.text_english: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.text_amharic: አመዱንም ከመሠዊያው ላይ ያስወግዱ፥ ሐምራዊውንም መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፤

verses.text_english: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያገለግሉበትን ዕቃውን ሁሉም ማንደጃዎቹን ሜንጦቹንም መጫሪያዎቹንም ድስቶቹንም፥ የመሠዊያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ያስቀምጡበት፤ በእርሱም የአቆስጣን ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይዘርጉ፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.text_english: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear : but they shall not touch holy thing, lest they die. These the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰፈሩም ሲነሡ፥ አሮንና ልጆቹ መቅደሱንና የመቅደሱን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከሸፈኑ በኋላ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ የቀዓት ልጆች ሊሸከሙት ይመጣሉ፤ እንዳይሞቱ ግን ንዋየ ቅድሳቱን አይንኩ። በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ የቀዓት ልጆች ሸክም ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein , in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጅ አልዓዛር በመብራቱ ዘይት በጣፋጩም ዕጣን ላይ፥ ሁልጊዜም በሚቀርበው በእህሉ ቍርባንና በቅባቱ ዘይት ላይ ይሾም፤ ማደሪያውን ሁሉ፥ በእርሱም ውስጥ ያለውን ሁሉ፥ መቅደሱንና ዕቃውን ይጠብቃል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓትን ወገኖች ነገድ ከሌዋውያን መካከል አታጥፉአቸው፤

verses.text_english: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወደ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን በቀረቡ ጊዜ በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ እንጂ እንዳይሞቱ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፤ አሮንና ልጆቹ ይግቡ፥ ለሰውም ሁሉ ሥራውንና ሸክሙን ይዘዙ፤

verses.text_english: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንዳይሞቱ ንዋየ ቅድሳቱን ለድንገት እንኳ ለማየት አይግቡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶንን ልጆች ድምር ደግሞ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች በየወገኖቻቸውም ውሰድ።

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡትን ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ቍጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: This the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች ሥራ በማገልገልና በመሸከም ይህ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.text_amharic: የማደሪያውን መጋረጆች፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ መደረቢያውን፥ በላዩም ያለውን የአቆስጣውን ቁርበት መደረቢያ፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥

verses.text_english: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.text_amharic: በማደሪያውና በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ያለውን የአደባባዩን መጋረጃ፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥ አውታሮቻቸውንም፥ ለማገልገልም የሚሠሩበትን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይሸከሙ፤ በዚህ ያገልግሉ።

verses.text_english: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶናውያን አገልግሎት ሁሉ፥ ሸክማቸውም ሁሉ፥ ሥራቸውም ሁሉ በአሮንና በልጆቹ ትእዛዝ ይሁን፤ የሚደርስባቸውንም ሸክም ሁሉ ትነግሩአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: This the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች አገልግሎት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ ይህ ነው፤ ከካህኑ ከአሮን ልጅ ከኢታምር እጅ በታች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪንም ልጆች በየወገናቸው በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ቍጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡትን ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ቍጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And this the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ ባለው አገልግሎታቸው ሁሉ፥ የማደሪያው ሳንቆች፥ መወርወሪያዎቹም፥ ተራዳዎቹም፥ እግሮቹም፥

verses.text_english: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም የሚቆሙት የአደባባዩ ምሰሶች፥ እግሮቹም፥ ካስማዎቹም፥ አውታሮቹም፥ ዕቃዎቹና ማገልገያዎቹ ሸክማቸው ነው፤ የሚጠብቁትንም የሸክማቸውን ዕቃ ሁሉ በስማቸው ቍጠሩ።

verses.text_english: This the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪ ልጆች ወገኖች አገልግሎት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ ከካህኑ ክአሮን ልጅ ከኢታምር እጅ በታች በየአገልግሎታቸው ሁሉ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም የሕቡም አለቆች የቀዓትን ልጆች በየወገናቸው በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ቈጠሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ወደ አገግሎት የገቡትን ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉትን ቈጠሩአቸው፤

verses.text_english: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸውም ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩት ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለገሉት ሁሉ፥ ከቀዓታውያን ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸውም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች የተቈጠሩት የጌድሶን ልጆች፥

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የገቡት፥ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉት፥

verses.text_english: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸውም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች የተቈጠሩት ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሠላሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለገሉት ሁሉ፥ ከጌድሶን ልጆች ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸውም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ከሜራሪ ልጆች ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ወደ አገልግሎት የገቡት ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉት፥

verses.text_english: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸው የተቈጠሩት ሦስት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ፥ ከሜራሪ ልጆች ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸውና በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ከሌዋውያን የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ፥ ሙሴና አሮን የእስራኤልም አለቆች የቈጠሩአቸው፥

verses.text_english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ሥራውን ለመሥራትና ዕቃውን ለመሸከም የገቡት ሁሉ፥ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉት፥

verses.text_english: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩት ስምንት ሺህ እምስት መቶ ሰማንያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ እያንዳንዳቸው በየአገልግሎታቸውና በየሸክማቸው በሙሴ እጅ ተቈጠሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ በእርሱ ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ለምጻሙን ሁሉ፥ ፈሳሽ ነገርም ያለበትን ሁሉ፥ በሬሳም የረከሰውን ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ እንዲያወጡ እዘዛቸው፤

verses.text_english: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዱንና ሴቱን አውጡ፤ እኔ በመካከሉ የማድርበትን ሰፈራቸውን እንዳያረክሱ ከሰፈሩ አውጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፥ ከሰፈሩ አወጡአቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንደ ተናገረው፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው። ወንድ ወይም ሴት የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይተላለፍ ዘንድ ሰው የሚሠራውን ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ በዚያም ሰው ላይ በደል ቢሆን፥ በሠራው ኃጢአት ይናዘዝ፤

verses.text_english: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth thereof, and give unto against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.text_amharic: የወሰደውንም በሙሉ ይመልስ አምስተኛውንም ይጨምርበት፥ ለበደለውም ሰው ይስጠው።

verses.text_english: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይመልስለት ዘንድ ሰውዮው ዘመድ ባይኖረው፥ ስለ በደል ለእግዚአብሔር የሚመልሰው ነገር ለካህኑ ይሁን፥ ይህም ስለ እርሱ ማስተሰረያ ከሚደረግበት አውራ በግ በላይ ይጨመር።

verses.text_english: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለካህኑ የሚያቀርቡት የተቀደሰ የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሰ የሰው ነገር ሁሉ፥ ሰውም ለካህኑ የሚሰጠው ሁሉ ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው። የማንኛውም ሰው ሚስት ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ ብትል፥ በእርሱም ላይ ብትበድል፥

verses.text_english: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and no witness against her, neither she be taken ;
verses.text_amharic: ከሌላም ሰው ጋር ብትተኛ፥ ከባልዋም ዓይን ቢሸሸግ፥ እርስዋም ተሰውራ ብትረክስ፥ ምስክርም ባይኖርባት፥ በምንዝርም ባትገኝ፥

verses.text_english: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.text_amharic: በባልዋም ላይ የቅንዓት መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፥ እርስዋም ስትረክስ ስለ ሚስቱ ቢቀና፤ ወይም እርስዋ ሳትረክስ የቅንዓት መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፥ ስለ ሚስቱም ቢቀና፤

verses.text_english: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ሰው ሚስቱን ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣት፥ የኢፍ መስፈሪያም አሥረኛ እጅ ገብስ ዱቄት ቍርባን ስለ እርስዋ ያምጣ፤ የቅንዓት ቍርባን ነውና፥ ኃጢአትንም የሚያሳስብ የመታሰቢያ ቍርባን ነውና ዘይት አያፍስስበት፥ ዕጣንም አይጨምርበት።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያቀርባታል በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ያቆማታል፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put into the water:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የተቀደሰ ውኃ በሸክላ ዕቃ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም በማደሪያው ውስጥ ካለው ትቢያ ወስዶ በውኃ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሴቲቱን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆማታል፥ የሴቲቱንም ራስ ይገልጣል፥ በእጅዋም ለመታሰቢያ የሚሆነውን የእህል ቍርባን፥ ለቅንዓት ቍርባን፥ ያኖራል፤ በካህኑም እጅ እርግማንን የሚያመጣው መራራ ውኃ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ያምላታል፥ ሴቲቱንም እንዲህ ይላታል። ሌላ ወንድ አልተኛሽ፥ ባልሽንም አልተውሽ፥ ራስሽንም አላረከስሽ እንደ ሆነ፥ እርግማንን ከሚያመጣ ከዚህ መራራ ውኃ ንጹሕ ሁኚ፤

verses.text_english: But if thou hast gone aside instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ባልሽን ትተሽ ረክሰሽ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከባልሽም ሌላ ከወንድ ጋር ተኝተሽ እንደሆነ፤

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሴቲቱን በመርገም መሐላ ያምላታል፥ ካህኑም ሴቲቱን። እግዚአብሔር ጭንሽን እያሰለሰለ ሆድሽንም እየነፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለመርገምና ለመሐላ በሕዝብሽ መካከል ያድርግሽ፤

verses.text_english: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make belly to swell, and thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.text_amharic: እርግማንንም የሚያመጣ ይህ ውኃ ወደ ሆድሽ ይግባ፥ ሆድሽንም ይንፋው፥ ጭንሽንም ያበስብሰው ይላታል፤ ሴቲቱም። አሜን አሜን ትላለች።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot out with the bitter water:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም እነዚህን መርገሞች በሰሌዳ ይጽፈዋል፥ በመራራውም ውኃ ይደመስሰዋል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, bitter.
verses.text_amharic: እርግማን የሚያመጣውንም መራራ ውኃ ለሴቲቱ ይጠጣታል፤ የእርግማኑም ውኃ በገባባት ጊዜ መራራ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የቅንዓቱን የእህል ቍርባን ከሴቲቱ እጅ ይወስዳል፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዘዋል፥ ወደ መሠዊያውም ያመጣዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, the memorial thereof, and burn upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን አንድ እፍኝ ሙሉ ለመታሰቢያው ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ለሴቲቱ ውኃውን ያጠጣታል።

verses.text_english: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, , if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውን ካጠጣት በኋላ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ረክሳና በባልዋ ላይ አመንዝራ እንደ ሆነች፥ እርግማንን የሚያመጣው ውኃ ገብቶ መራራ ይሆንባታል፥ ሆድዋም ይነፋል፥ ጭንዋም ይሰለስላል፤ ሴቲቱም በሕዝብዋ መካከል ለመርገም ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.text_amharic: ያልረከሰች ያለ ነውርም እንደ ሆነች፥ ንጹሕ ትሆናለች፥ ልጆችንም ታረግዛለች።

verses.text_english: This the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside instead of her husband, and is defiled;
Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮውም ከኃጢአት ንጹሕ ይሆናል፥ ሴቲቱም ኃጢአትዋን ትሸከማለች።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate unto the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው። ሰው ወይም ሴት ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን የተለየ ያደርግ ዘንድ የናዝራዊነት ስእለት ቢሳል፥

verses.text_english: He shall separate from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.text_amharic: ከወይን ጠጅና ከሚያሰክር መጠጥ ራሱን የተለየ ያድርግ፤ ከወይን ወይም ከሌላ ነገር የሚገኘውን ሆምጣጤ አይጠጣ፥ የወይንም ጭማቂ አይጠጣ፤ የወይን እሸት ወይም ዘቢብ አይብላ።

verses.text_english: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ከወይን የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ ከውስጡ ፍሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ገፈፎው ድረስ አይብላ።

verses.text_english: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth unto the LORD, he shall be holy, shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን ለመለየት ስእለት ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ በራሱ ላይ ምላጭ አይደርስም፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየበት ወራት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፥ የራሱንም ጠጕር ያሳድጋል።

verses.text_english: All the days that he separateth unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ወደ ሬሳ አይቅረብ።

verses.text_english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God upon his head.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላኩ ያደረገው እስለት በራሱ ላይ ነውና አባቱ ወይም እናቱ ወይም ወንድሙ ወይም እኅቱ ሲሞቱ ሰውነቱን አያርክስባቸው።

verses.text_english: All the days of his separation he holy unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም በአጠገቡ ድንገት ቢሞት የተለየውንም ራሱን ቢያረክስ፥ እርሱ በሚነጻበት ቀን ራሱን ይላጭ፤ በሰባተኛው ቀን ይላጨው።

verses.text_english: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣ፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፤ በሬሳም የተነሣ ኃጢአት ሠርቶአልና ያስተሰርይለታል፥ በዚያም ቀን ራሱን ይቀድሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን የተለየ ያደረገበትን ወራትም ለእግዚአብሔር ይቀድሳል፥ የአንድ ዓመትም ተባት ጠቦት ለበደል መሥዋዕት ያምጣ፤ ናዝራዊነቱ ግን ረክሶአልና ያለፈው ወራት ሁሉ ከንቱ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And this the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: የመለየቱ ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ የናዝራዊው ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ይቅረብ፤

verses.text_english: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባኑንም ለእግዚአብሔር ያቅርብ፤ ነውር የሌለበት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦት ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ነውርም የሌለባትን የአንድ ዓመት እንስት ጠቦት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ነውርም የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት፥

verses.text_english: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሌማትም ቂጣ እንጀራ፥ በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመልካም ዱቄትም የተሠሩ እንጐቻዎች፥ በዘይትም የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall bring before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርባቸዋል፥ የኃጢአቱንም መሥዋዕት የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ያሳርግለታል።

verses.text_english: And he shall offer the ram a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.text_amharic: አውራውንም በግ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከሌማቱ ቂጣ እንጀራ ጋር ወደ እግዚአብሔር ያቀርባል፤ ካህኑም ደግሞ የእህሉን ቍርባንና የመጠጡን ቍርባን ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put in the fire which under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ናዝራዊውም የተለየውን የራሱን ጠጕር በመገናኛው ድንኳን አጠገብ ይላጫል፥ የመለየቱንም ራስ ጠጕር ወስዶ ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በታች ወዳለው እሳት ይጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put upon the hands of the Nazarite, after his separation is shaven:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የተቀቀለውን የአውራውን በግ ወርች፥ ከሌማቱም አንድ ቂጣ እንጐቻ አንድም ስስ ቂጣ ይወስዳል፥ የተለየውንም የራስ ጠጕር ከተላጨ በኋላ በናዝራዊው እጆች ላይ ያኖራቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the priest shall wave them a wave offering before the LORD: this holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም እነዚህን ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዛቸዋል፤ ይህም ከሚወዘወዘው ፍርምባና ከሚነሣው ወርች ጋር ለካህኑ የተቀደሰ ነው። ከዚያም በኋላ ናዝራዊው ወይን ይጠጣ ዘንድ ይችላል።

verses.text_english: This the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
verses.text_amharic: ስእለቱን የተሳለው የናዝራዊ፥ እጁም ከሚያገኘው ሌላ ስለ ናዝራዊነቱ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የቍርባኑ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ስእለቱን እንደ ተሳለ እንደ ናዝራዊነቱ ሕግ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ንገራቸው። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስትባርኩአቸው እንዲህ በሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ፥ ይጠብቅህም፤

verses.text_english: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፊቱን ያብራልህ፥ ይራራልህም፤

verses.text_english: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፊቱን ወደ አንተ ያንሣ፥ ሰላምንም ይስጥህ።

verses.text_english: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ስሜን በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ያደርጋሉ፤ እኔም እባርካቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ ማደሪያውን ፈጽሞ ከተከለ በኋላ፥ እርሱንና ዕቃውን ሁሉ ከቀባና ከቀደሰ በኋላ፥ መሠዊያውንና ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ከቀባና ከቀደሰ በኋላ፤

verses.text_english: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አለቆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ቍርባናቸውን አቀረቡ፤ እነዚህም ከተቈጠሩት በላይ የተሾሙ የነገዶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: መባቸውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ፥ የተከደኑ ስድስት ሰረገሎች አሥራ ሁለትም በሬዎች፤ በየሁለቱም አለቆች አንድ ሰረገላ አቀረቡ፥ ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ አንድ በሬ በማደሪያው ፊት አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
verses.text_amharic: ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ማገልገል ይሆን ዘንድ ከእነርሱ ተቀብለህ ለሌዋውያን ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ አገልግሎታቸው ስጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሰረገሎችንና በሬዎችን ተቀብሎ ለሌዋውያን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
verses.text_amharic: ለጌድሶን ልጆች እንደ አገልግሎታቸው ሁለት ሰረገሎችንና አራት በሬዎችን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህኑም ከአሮን ልጅ ከኢታምር እጅ በታች ላሉት ለሜራሪ ልጆች እንደ አገልግሎታቸው አራት ሰረገሎችንና ስምንት በሬዎችን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them they should bear upon their shoulders.
verses.text_amharic: ለቀዓት ልጆች ግን መቅደሱን ማገልገል የእነርሱ ነውና፥ በትከሻቸውም ይሸከሙት ነበርና ምንም አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
verses.text_amharic: መሠዊያውም በተቀባ ቀን አለቆቹ መሠዊያውን ለመቀደስ ቍርባንን አቀረቡ፤ አለቆችም መባቸውን በመሠዊያው ፊት አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። አለቆቹ መሠዊያውን ለመቀደስ መባቸውን እያንዳንዱ በቀን በቀኑ ያቅርቡ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ቀን መባውን ያቀረበ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: One spoon of ten of gold, full of incense:
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣንም የተሞላ ሚዛኑ አሥር ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የወርቅ ጭልፋ፤

verses.text_english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ አንድ የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦት፤

verses.text_english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፤

verses.text_english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.text_english: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

verses.text_english: His offering one silver charger, the weight whereof an hundred and thirty , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.text_amharic: መባውም ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት የተሞሉ፥ ሚዛኑ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የብር ወጭት፥ ሚዛኑም ሰባ ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የብር ድስት፤

verses.text_english: One golden spoon of ten , full of incense:
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣንም የተሞላ ሚዛኑ አሥር ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የወርቅ ጭልፋ፤

verses.text_english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥

verses.text_english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.text_amharic: አንድ የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦት፤ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፤

verses.text_english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.text_amharic: ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ሁለት በሬዎች፥ አምስት አውራ በጎች፥ አምስት አውራ ፍየሎች፥ አምስት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበረ፤ የዔናን ልጅ የአኪሬ መባ ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: This the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.text_amharic: መሠዊያው በተቀባ ቀን የእስራኤል አለቆች ለመቀደሻው ያቀረቡት ቍርባን ይህ ነበረ፤ አሥራ ሁለት የብር ወጭቶች፥ አሥራ ሁለት የብር ድስቶች፥ አሥራ ሁለት የወርቅ ጭልፋዎች፤

verses.text_english: Each charger of silver an hundred and thirty , each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels two thousand and four hundred , after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም የብር ወጭት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል፥ እያንዳንዱም ድስት ሰባ ሰቅል ነበረ፤ የዚህም ዕቃ ሁሉ ብር በመቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ሁለት ሺህ አራት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The golden spoons twelve, full of incense, ten apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons an hundred and twenty .
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣንም የተሞሉ አሥራ ሁለቱ የወርቅ ጭልፋዎች፥ እያንዳንዱ በመቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን አሥር አሥር ሰቅል ነበረ፤ የጭልፋዎቹ ወርቅ ሁሉ መቶ ሀያ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: All the oxen for the burnt offering twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ከብት ሁሉ ከእህሉ ቍርባን ጋር አሥራ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ አሥራ ሁለትም አውራ በጎች፥ አሥራ ሁለትም የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦቶች ነበሩ፤ የኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየሎች አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.text_amharic: የደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ከብት ሁሉ ሀያ አራት በሬዎች፥ ስድሳም አውራ በጎች፥ ስድሳም አውራ ፍየሎች፥ ስድሳም የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበሩ። መሠዊያው ከተቀባ በኋላ ለመቀደሻው የቀረበ ቍርባን ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን እርሱን ለመነጋገር በገባ ጊዜ በምስክሩ ታቦት ላይ ካለው ከስርየት መክደኛ በላይ ከኪሩቤልም መካከል ድምፁ ሲናገረው ይሰማ ነበር፤ እርሱም ይናገረው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
verses.text_amharic: መብራቶቹን ስትለኵስ ሰባቱ መብራቶች በመቅረዙ ፊት ያበራሉ ብለህ ለአሮን ንገረው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ በመቅረዙ ፊት መብራቶቹን ለኰሰ።

verses.text_english: And this work of the candlestick beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.text_amharic: መቅረዙም እንዲህ ሆኖ ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ከተቀጠቀጠ ወርቅ ተሠራ፤ እስከ አገዳውና እስከ አበቦቹ ድረስ ከተቀጠቀጠ ሥራ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳሳየው ምሳሌ መቅረዙን እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ሌዋውያንን ወስደህ አንጻቸው።

verses.text_english: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and make themselves clean.
verses.text_amharic: ታነጻቸው ዘንድ እንዲህ ታደርግላቸዋለህ፤ ኃጢአትን የሚያነጻውን ውኃ እርጫቸው፥ በገላቸውም ሁሉ ምላጭ ያሳልፉ፥ ልብሳቸውንም ይጠቡ፥ ይታጠቡም።

verses.text_english: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: ወይፈንን፥ ለእህሉም ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄትን ይውሰዱ፥ ሌላውንም ወይፈን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ውሰድ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት አቅርብ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ሰብስብ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርባቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሌዋውያን ላይ እጃቸውን ይጫኑባቸው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ሌዋውያን እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ስጦታ አድርጎ፥ ሌዋውያንን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያኑም በወይፈኖቹ ራሶች ላይ እጆቻቸውን ይጫኑ፤ ለሌዋውያንም ስለ ማስተስረያ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them an offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንንም በአሮንና በልጆቹ ፊት አቁማቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ስጦታ አድርገህ አቅርባቸው።

verses.text_english: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለይ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለእኔ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them an offering.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ሌዋውያን የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ይገባሉ፤ ታነጻቸውማለህ፥ ስጦታም አድርገህ ታቀርባቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: For they wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ፈጽሞ ለእኔ ተሰጥተዋልና፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች በኵራት ሁሉ፥ ማኅፀን በሚከፍት ሁሉ ፋንታ ለእኔ ወስጄአቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel mine, man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድር ያለውን በኵር ሁሉ በገደልሁበት ቀን የእስራኤልን ልጆች በኵራት ሁሉ፥ ሰው ወይም እንስሳ፥ ለእኔ ቀድሼአቸዋለሁና የእኔ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ልጆች በኵራት ሁሉ ፋንታ ሌዋውያንን ወስጄአለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I have given the Levites a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ መቅደሱ በቀረቡ ጊዜ መቅሠፍት እንዳያገኛቸው፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ያስተሰርዩላቸው ዘንድ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አገልግሎት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ስጦታ አድርጌ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮን የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲሁ በሌዋውያን ላይ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ስለ ሌዋውያን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንም ከኃጢአት ተጣጠቡ፥ ልብሳቸውንም አጠቡ፤ አሮንም ስጦታ አድርጎ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረባቸው፥ አሮንም ያነጻቸው ዘንድ አስተሰረየላቸው።

verses.text_english: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ሌዋውያን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በአሮንና በልጆቹ ፊት አገልግሎታቸውን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ገቡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ስለ ሌዋውያን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረጉላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: This that unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: የሌዋውያን ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ከሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ሥራ ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service , and shall serve no more:
verses.text_amharic: ዕድሜአቸውም አምሳ ዓመት ሲሞላ የአገልግሎታቸውን ሥራ ይተዋሉ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ አይሠሩም፤

verses.text_english: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰጣቸውን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ወንድሞቻቸውን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለግላሉ፤ የድንኳኑን አገልግሎት አይሠሩም። እንዲሁ ስለ ሥራቸው በሌዋውያን ላይ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድር በወጡ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር በሲና ምድረ በዳ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች በጊዜው ፋሲካውን ያድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ በጊዜው አድርጉት፤ እንደ ሥርዓቱ ሁሉ እንደ ፍርዱም ሁሉ አድርጉት።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ፋሲካን ያደርጉ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ በሲና ምድረ በዳ ፋሲካን አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
verses.text_amharic: በሞተ ሰው ሬሳ የረከሱ ሰዎችም ነበሩ፥ ስለዚህም በዚያ ቀን ፋሲካን ያደርጉ ዘንድ አልቻሉም። በዚያም ቀን ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And those men said unto him, We defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ሰዎች። በሞተ ሰው ሬሳ ረክሰናል፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል በጊዜው ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር እንዳናቀርብ ስለ ምን እንከለከላለን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ የሚያዝዘውን እስክሰማ ድረስ ቈዩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ከእናንተ ወይም ከትውልዶቻችሁ ዘንድ ሰው በሬሳ ቢረክስ፥ ወይም ሩቅ መንገድ ቢሄድ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካን ያድርግ።

verses.text_english: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, eat it with unleavened bread and bitter .
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ ያድርጉት፤ ከቂጣ እንጀራና ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይብሉት።

verses.text_english: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም እስከ ነገ ምንም አያስቀሩ፥ ከእርሱም አጥንትን አይስበሩ፤ እንደ ፋሲካ ሥርዓት ሁሉ ያድርጉት።

verses.text_english: But the man that clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው በመንገድም ላይ ያልሆነ ፋሲካን ባያደርግ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ዘንድ ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቍርባን በጊዜው አላቀረበምና ያ ሰው ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.text_english: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላችሁም መጻተኛ ቢኖር፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካን ያደርግ ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥ እንደ ፋሲካ ሥርዓት እንደ ፍርዱም እንዲሁ ያድርግ፤ ለመጻተኛና ለአገር ልጅ አንድ ሥርዓት ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, , the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያውም በተተከለ ቀን ደመናው የምስክሩን ድንኳን ሸፈነው፤ ከማታም ጀምሮ እስከ ጥዋት ድረስ በማደሪያው ላይ እንደ እሳት ይመስል ነበር።

verses.text_english: So it was alway: the cloud covered it , and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ሁልጊዜ ነበረ፤ በቀን ደመና በሌሊትም የእሳት አምሳል ይሸፍነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም ከድንኳኑ ላይ በተነሣ ጊዜ በዚያን ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ይጓዙ ነበር፤ ደመናውም በቆመበት ስፍራ በዚያ የእስራኤል ልጆች ይሰፍሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
