verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ የእስራኤል ልጆች ይጓዙ ነበር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይሰፍሩ ነበር። ደመናው በማደሪያው ላይ በተቀመጠበት ዘመን ሁሉ በሰፈራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም በማደሪያው ላይ ብዙ ቀን በተቀመጠ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይጠብቁ ነበር፥ አይጓዙምም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ደመናው ጥቂት ቀን በማደሪያው ላይ ይሆን ነበር፤ በዚያን ጊዜ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ በሰፈራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንድ ጊዜም ደመናው ከማታ ጀምሮ እስከ ጥዋት ድረስ ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ በጥዋትም ደመናው በተነሣ ጊዜ ይጓዙ ነበር፤ በቀንም በሌሊትም ቢሆን፥ ደመናው በተነሣ ጊዜ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Or two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም ሁለት ቀን ወይም አንድ ወር ወይም አንድ ዓመት ቆይቶ በማደሪያው ላይ ቢቀመጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች በሰፈራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፥ አይጓዙምም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በተነሣ ጊዜ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይሰፍሩ ነበር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይጓዙ ነበር፥ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይጠብቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት የብር መለከቶች አጠፍጥፈህ ለአንተ አድርግ፤ ማኅበሩን ለመጥራት ከሰፈራቸውም ለማስጓዝ ይሁኑልህ።

verses.text_english: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም መለከቶች በተነፉ ጊዜ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ይሰብሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And if they blow with one , then the princes, heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ መለከት ሲነፋ ታላላቆቹ የእስራኤል አእላፍ አለቆች ወደ አንተ ይሰብሰቡ።

verses.text_english: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.text_amharic: መለከትንም ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ ስትነፉ በምሥራቅ በኩል የሰፈሩት ይጓዙ።

verses.text_english: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውንም ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ ስትነፉ በደቡብ በኩል የሰፈሩት ይጓዙ፤ ለማስጓዝ መለከትን ይነፋሉ።

verses.text_english: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም በሚሰበሰብበት ጊዜ ንፉ፥ ነገር ግን ድምፁን ከፍ አታድርጉት።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ መለከቶቹን ይንፉ፤ እነርሱም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.text_amharic: በሚገፋችሁም ጠላት ላይ በምድራችሁ ወደ ሰልፍ ስትወጡ ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ መለከቶቹን ንፉ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም በአምላካችሁ ፊት ትታሰባላችሁ፥ ከጠላቶቻችሁም ትድናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ በደስታችሁ ቀን፥ በበዓላታችሁም ዘመን፥ በወርም መባቻ፥ በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕታችሁና በደኅንነት መሥዋዕታችሁ ላይ መለከቶቹን ንፉ፤ እነርሱም በአምላካችሁ ፊት ለመታሰቢያ ይሆኑላችኋል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the twentieth of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያኛው ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ደመናው ከምስክሩ ማደሪያ ላይ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከሲና ምድረ በዳ በየጕዞአቸው ተጓዙ፤ ደመናውም በፋራን ምድረ በዳ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያም እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ ተጓዙ።

verses.text_english: In the first went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያም የይሁዳ ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.text_amharic: በይሳኮርም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የሶገር ልጅ ናትናኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.text_amharic: በዛብሎንም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የኬሎን ልጅ ኤልያብ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያውም ተነቀለ፤ ማደሪያውንም የተሸከሙ የጌድሶን ልጆችና የሜራሪ ልጆች ተጓዙ።

verses.text_english: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.text_amharic: የሮቤልም ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የሰዲዮር ልጅ ኤሊሱር አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.text_amharic: በስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.text_amharic: በጋድም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.text_amharic: ቀዓታውያንም መቅደሱን ተሸክመው ተጓዙ፤ እነዚህም እስኪመጡ ድረስ እነዚያ ማደሪያውን ተከሉ።

verses.text_english: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬምም ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ኤሊሳማ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.text_amharic: በምናሴም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የፍዳሱር ልጅ ገማልኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.text_amharic: በብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የጋዴዮን ልጅ አቢዳን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰፈሮቹ ሁሉ በኋላ የሆነ የዳን ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዘር አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.text_amharic: በአሴርም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.text_amharic: በንፍታሌምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Thus the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች ጕዞ በየሠራዊታቸው ነበረ፤ እነርሱም ተጓዙ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የሚስቱን አባት የምድያማዊውን የራጉኤልን ልጅ ኦባብን። እግዚአብሔር። ለእናንተ እሰጠዋለሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ እንሄዳለን፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤል መልካምን ነገር ተናግሮአልና አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ና፥ መልካምን እናደርግልሃለን አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አልሄድም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ አገሬና ወደ ዘመዶቼ እሄዳለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እባክህ፥ በምድረ በዳ የምንሰፍርበትን አንተ ታውቃለህና፥ እንደ ዓይኖቻችንም ትሆንልናለህና አትተወን፤

verses.text_english: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኛም ጋር ብትሄድ እግዚአብሔር ከሚያደርግልን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ እኛ ለአንተ እናደርጋለን አለ።

verses.text_english: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔርም ተራራ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል ተጓዙ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም የኪዳኑ ታቦት የሚያድርበትን ስፍራ ይፈልግላቸው ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ቀደማቸው።

verses.text_english: And the cloud of the LORD upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰፈራቸውም በተጓዙ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ደመና ቀን ቀን በላያቸው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ታቦቱ በተጓዘ ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ተነሣ፥ ጠላቶችህም ይበተኑ፥ የሚጠሉህም ከፊትህ ይሽሹ ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ባረፈም ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ወደ እስራኤል እልፍ አእላፋት ተመለስ ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard ; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ክፉ ሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አጕረመረሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት በመካከላቸው ነደደች፥ የሰፈሩንም ዳር በላች።

verses.text_english: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፥ እሳቲቱም ጠፋች።

verses.text_english: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት በመካከላቸው ስለነደደች የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ተቤራ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And the mixt multitude that among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም የነበሩ ልዩ ልዩ ሕዝብ እጅግ ጐመጁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ደግሞ ያለቅሱ ነበር። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ማን ይሰጠናል?

verses.text_english: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ያለ ዋጋ እንበላው የነበረውን ዓሣ፥ ዱባውንም፥ በጢኹንም፥ ኩራቱንም፥ ቀዩንም ሽንኩርት፥ ነጩንም ሽንኩርት እናስባለን፤

verses.text_english: But now our soul dried away: nothing at all, beside this manna, our eyes.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን ሰውነታችን ደረቀች፤ ዓይናችንም ከዚህ መና በቀር ምንም አታይም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the manna as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.text_amharic: መናውም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነበረ፥ መልኩም ሙጫ ይመስል ነበር።

verses.text_english: the people went about, and gathered , and ground in mills, or beat in a mortar, and baked in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም እየዞሩ ይለቅሙ ነበር፥ በወፍጮም ይፈጩት፥ ወይም በሙቀጫ ይወቅጡት፥ በምንቸትም ይቀቅሉት ነበር፥ እንጐቻም ያደርጉት ነበር፤ ጣዕሙም በዘይት እንደ ተለወሰ እንጐቻ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሊትም ጠል በሰፈሩ ላይ በወረደ ጊዜ መናው በላዩ ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሕዝቡ በወገኖቻቸው፥ ሰው ሁሉ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ፥ ሲያለቅሱ ሰማ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ እጅግ ነደደ፤ ሙሴም ተቈጣ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ለምን በባሪያህ ላይ ክፉ አደረግህ? ለምንስ በፊትህ ሞገስ አላገኘሁም? ለምንስ የዚህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሸክም በእኔ ላይ አደረግህ?

verses.text_english: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ማልህላቸው ምድር አደርሳቸው ዘንድ። ሞግዚት የሚጠባውን ልጅ እንድታቀፍ በብብትህ እቀፋቸው የምትለኝ፥ በውኑ ይህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ እኔ ፀነስሁትን? ወለድሁትንስ?

verses.text_english: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቴ ያለቅሳሉና። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ስጠን ይላሉና ለዚህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የምሰጠው ሥጋ ከወዴት እወስዳለሁ?

verses.text_english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because too heavy for me.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ከብዶኛልና ይህን ሁሉ ሕዝብ ልሸከም አልችልም።

verses.text_english: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህስ ከምታደርግብኝ፥ በፊትህ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ በእኔ ላይ የሚሆነውን መከራ እንዳላይ፥ እባክህ፥ ፈጽሞ ግደለኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች፥ በሕዝቡ ላይ ሽማግሌዎችና አለቆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ የምታውቃቸውን፥ ሰባ ሰዎች ሰብስብልኝ፥ ወደ መገናኛውም ድንኳን አምጣቸው፥ በዚያም ከአንተ ጋር አቁማቸው።

verses.text_english: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which upon thee, and will put upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear not thyself alone.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እወርዳለሁ፥ በዚያም እነጋገርሃለሁ፥ በአንተ ካለውም መንፈስ ወስጄ በእነርሱ ላይ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አንተም ብቻ እንዳትሸከም የሕዝቡን ሸክም ከአንተ ጋር ይሸከማሉ።

verses.text_english: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም በላቸው። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ማን ይሰጠናል? በግብፅ ደኅና ነበረልን እያላችሁ ያለቀሳችሁት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ደርሶአልና ለነገ ተቀደሱ፥ ሥጋንም ትበላላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሥጋን ይሰጣችኋል፥ ትበሉማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀን ወይም ሁለት ቀን ወይም አምስት ቀን ወይም አሥር ቀን ወይም ሀያ ቀን አትበሉም፤

verses.text_english: even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በመካከላችሁ ያለውን እግዚአብሔርን ንቃችኋልና፥ በፊቱም። ለምን ከግብፅ ወጣን? ብላችሁ አልቅሳችኋልና በአፍንጫችሁ እስኪወጣ እስኪሰለቻችሁም ድረስ ወር ሙሉ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, The people, among whom I , six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እኔ በመካከላቸው ያለሁ ሕዝብ ስድስት መቶ ሺህ እግረኛ ናቸው፤ አንተም። ወር ሙሉ የሚበሉትን ሥጋ እኔ እሰጣቸዋለሁ አልህ።

verses.text_english: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱን የሚያጠግብ የበሬና የበግ መንጋ ይታረድን? ወይስ የባሕርን ዓሣ ሁሉ ያጠግባቸው ዘንድ ይሰበሰብላቸዋልን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ አጭር ሆነ? አሁን ቃሌ ይፈጸም ወይስ አይፈጸም እንደ ሆነ አንተ ታያለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወጣ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃሎች ለሕዝቡ ነገረ፤ ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችም ሰባውን ሰዎች ሰብስቦ በድንኳኑ ዙሪያ አቆማቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that upon him, and gave unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, , when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በደመናው ወረደ፥ ተናገረውም፥ በእርሱም ላይ ከነበረው መንፈስ ወስዶ በሰባው ሽማግሌዎች ላይ አደረገ፤ መንፈሱም በላያቸው ባደረ ጊዜ ትንቢት ተናገሩ፤ ከዚያ በኋል ግን አልተናገሩም።

verses.text_english: But there remained two men in the camp, the name of the one Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ሁለት ሰዎች በሰፈር ቀርተው ነበር፥ የአንዱም ስም ኤልዳድ የሁለተኛውም ሞዳድ ነበረ፤ መንፈስም ወረደባቸው፤ እነርሱም ከተጻፉት ጋር ነበሩ ወደ ድንኳኑ ግን አልወጡም ነበር፤ በሰፈሩም ውስጥ ሳሉ ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጐበዝ ሰው እየሮጠ መጥቶ። ኤልዳድና ሞዳድ በሰፈር ትንቢት ይናገራሉ ብሎ ለሙሴ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.text_amharic: ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ የሙሴ አገልጋይ የነበረው የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ። ጌታዬ ሙሴ ሆይ፥ ከልክላቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD'S people were prophets, that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ መንፈሱን ቢያወርድ፤ አንተ ስለእኔ ትቀናለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits upon the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፥ ከባሕርም ድርጭቶችን አመጣ፥ የአንድ ቀንም መንገድ ያህል በዚህ፥ የአንድ ቀንም መንገድ ያህል በዚያ በሰፈሩ ላይ በተናቸው፤ በዚያም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ከፍታው ከምድር ወደ ላይ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the people stood up all that day, and all night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሁሉ በሌሊትም ሁሉ በነጋውም ሁሉ ሕዝቡ ተነሥተው ድርጭትን ሰበሰቡ፤ ከሁሉ ጥቂት የሰበሰበ አሥር የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የሚያህል ሰበሰበ፤ በሰፈሩም ዙሪያ ሁሉ አሰጡት።

verses.text_english: And while the flesh yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋውም ገና በጥርሳቸው መካከል ሳለ ሳያኝኩትም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነደደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቡን በታላቅ መቅሠፍት እጅግ መታ።

verses.text_english: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.text_amharic: የጐመጁ ሕዝብ በዚያ ተቀብረዋልና የዚያ ስፍራ ስም የምኞት መቃብር ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.text_english: the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ከምኞት መቃብር ወደ ሐጼሮት ተጓዙ በሐጼሮትም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ኢትዮጵያይቱን አግብቶአልና ባገባት በኢትዮጵያይቱ ምክንያት ማርያምና አሮን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard .
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ ብቻ ተናግሮአልን? በእኛስ ደግሞ የተናገረ አይደለምን? አሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማ።

verses.text_english: (Now the man Moses very meek, above all the men which upon the face of the earth.)
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በምድር ላይ ካሉት ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ ትሑት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ወዲያው ሙሴንና አሮንን ማርያምንም። ሦስታችሁ ወደ መገኛኛው ድንኳን ውጡ ብሎ ተናገረ፤ ሦስቱም ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በደመና ዓምድ ወረደ፥ በድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ቆመ፤ አሮንንና ማርያምን ጠራ፥ ሁለቱም ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ቃሌን ስሙ፤ በመካከላችሁ ነቢይ ቢኖር፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በራእይ እገለጥለታለሁ፥ ወይም በሕልም እናገረዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: My servant Moses not so, who faithful in all mine house.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬ ሙሴ ግን እንዲህ አይደለም፤ እርሱ በቤቴ ሁሉ የታመነ ነው።

verses.text_english: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አፍ ለአፍ በግልጥ እናገረዋለሁ፥ በምሳሌ አይደለም፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልክ ያያል፤ በባሪያዬ በሙሴ ላይ ትናገሩ ዘንድ ስለ ምን አልፈራችሁም? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶባቸው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam leprous, as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, leprous.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውም ከድንኳኑ ተነሣ፤ እነሆም፥ ማርያም ለምጻም ሆነች፥ እንደ አመዳይም ነጭ ሆነች፤ አሮንም ማርያምን ተመለከተ፥ እነሆም፥ ለምጻም ሆና ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ሙሴን። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ስንፍና አድርገናልና፥ በድለንማልና እባክህ፥ ኃጢአት አታድርግብን።

verses.text_english: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናቱ ሆድ በወጣ ጊዜ ግማሽ ሥጋው ተበልቶ እንደ ሞተ እርስዋ አትሁን።

verses.text_english: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እየጮኸ። አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አድናት አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። አባትዋ ምራቁን በፊትዋ ቢተፋባት ስንኳ ሰባት ቀን ታፍር ዘንድ ይገባት ነበር፤ ሰባት ቀን ከሰፈር ውጭ ተዘግታ ትቀመጥ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ትመለስ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in .
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም ከሰፈር ውጭ ሰባት ቀን ተዘግታ ተቀመጠች፤ ማርያምም እስክትመለስ ድረስ ሕዝቡ አልተጓዙም።

verses.text_english: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ሕዝቡ ከሐጼሮት ተጓዙ፥ በፋራንም ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች የምሰጣትን የከንዓንን ምድር ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሰዎችን ላክ፤ ከአባቶች ነገድ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ በመካከላቸው አለቃ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ትልካላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men heads of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ከፋራን ምድረ በዳ ላካቸው፤ እነርሱም ሁሉ የእስራኤል ልጆች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And these their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.text_amharic: ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ከሮቤል ነገድ የዘኩር ልጅ ሰሙኤል፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.text_amharic: ከስምዖን ነገድ የሱሬ ልጅ ሰፈጥ፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ነገድ የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሳኮር ነገድ የዮሴፍ ልጅ ይግአል፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤፍሬም ነገድ የነዌ ልጅ አውሴ፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.text_amharic: ከዮሴፍ ነገድ እርሱም የምናሴ ነገድ የሱሲ ልጅ ጋዲ፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Joseph, , of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳን ነገድ የገማሊ ልጅ ዓሚኤል፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሴር ነገድ የሚካኤል ልጅ ሰቱር፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፍታሌም ነገድ የያቢ ልጅ ናቢ፤

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.text_amharic: ከጋድ ነገድ የማኪ ልጅ ጉዲኤል።

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሙሴ የላካቸው ሰዎች ስም ይህ ነው። ሙሴም የነዌን ልጅ አውሴን ኢያሱ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: These the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የከነዓንን ምድር ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ላካቸው፥ አላቸውም። ከዚህ በደቡብ በኩል ውጡ፥ ወደ ተራሮችም ሂዱ፤

verses.text_english: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱንም እንዴት እንደ ሆነች፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ብርቱዎች ወይም ደካሞች፥

verses.text_english: And see the land, what it ; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they strong or weak, few or many;
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂቶች ወይም ብዙዎች እንደ ሆኑ፥ የሚኖሩባትም ምድር መልካም ወይም ክፉ፥ የሚኖሩባቸውም ከተሞች ሰፈሮች ወይም አምቦች እንደ ሆኑ፥

verses.text_english: And what the land that they dwell in, whether it good or bad; and what cities that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ወፍራም ወይም ስስ ዛፍ ያለባት ወይም የሌለባት እንደ ሆነች እዩ፤ ከምድሪቱ ፍሬ አምጡ፤ አይዞአችሁ። በዚያን ጊዜም ወይኑ አስቀድሞ ፍሬ የሚያፈራበት ወራት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And what the land , whether it fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.text_amharic: ወጡም ምድሪቱንም ከጺን ምድረ በዳ በሐማት ዳር እስካለችው እስከ ረአብ ድረስ ሰለሉ።

verses.text_english: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብም በኩል ውጡ፥ ወደ ኬብሮንም ደረሱ፤ በዚያም የዔናቅ ልጆች አኪመን፥ ሴሲ፥ ተላሚ ነበሩ። ኬብሮንም በግብፅ ካለችው ከጣኔዎስ በፊት ሰባት ዓመት ተሠርታ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, . (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኤሽኮልም ሸለቆ መጡ፥ ከዚያም ከወይኑ አንድ ዘለላ የነበረበትን አረግ ቈረጡ፥ ሁለቱም ሰዎች በመሎጊያ ተሸከሙት፤ ደግሞም ከሮማኑ ከበለሱም አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከዚያ ስለ ቈረጡት ዘለላ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም የኤሽኮል ሸለቆ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.text_english: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱንም ሰልለው ከአርባ ቀን በኋላ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.text_amharic: በፋራን ምድረ በዳና በቃዴስ ወዳሉት ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ሄደው ደረሱ፤ ወሬውንም ለእነርሱና ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው፥ የምድሪቱንም ፍሬ አሳዩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ብለው ነገሩት። ወደ ላክኸን ምድር ደረስን፥ እርስዋም ወተትና ማር ታፈስሳለች፥ ፍሬዋም ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this the fruit of it.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ኃያላን ናቸው። ከተሞቻቸውም የተመሸጉ እጅግም የጸኑ ናቸው፤ ደግሞም በዚያ የዔናቅን ልጆች አየን።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the people strong that dwell in the land, and the cities walled, very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብም ምድር አማሌቅ ተቀምጦአል፤ በተራሮቹም ኬጢያዊና ኢያቡሳዊ አሞራዊም ተቀምጠዋል፤ ከነዓናዊም በባሕር ዳርና በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ተቀምጦአል።

verses.text_english: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ካሌብም ሕዝቡን በሙሴ ፊት ዝም አሰኘና። ማሸነፍ እንችላለንንና እንውጣ፥ እንውረሰው አለ።

verses.text_english: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ጋር የወጡ ሰዎች ግን። በኃይል ከእኛ ይበረታሉና በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ መውጣት አንችልም አሉ።

verses.text_english: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they stronger than we.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሰለሉአትም ምድር ክፉ ወሬ ለእስራኤል ልጆች እያወሩ። እኛ ዞረን የሰለልናት ምድር የሚኖሩባትን ሰዎች የምትበላ ምድር ናት፤ በእርስዋም ዘንድ ያየናቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ ረጃጅም ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it men of a great stature.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ከኔፊሊም ወገን የሆኑትን ኔፊሊም፥ የዔናቅን ልጆች፥ አየን፤ እኛም በዓይናችን ግምት እንደ አንበጣዎች ነበርን፥ ደግሞም እኛ በዓይናቸው ዘንድ እንዲሁ ነበርን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ድምፃቸውን አንሥተው ጮኹ፤ ሕዝቡም በዚያ ሌሊት አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አጕረመረሙ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ። በግብፅ ምድር ሳለን ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ! ወይም በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ!

verses.text_english: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሰይፍ እንሞት ዘንድ ወደዚች ምድር ለምን ያገባናል? ሴቶቻችንና ልጆቻችን ምርኮ ይሆናሉ፤ ወደ ግብፅ መመለስ አይሻለንምን? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ኑ፥ አለቃ ሾመን ወደ ግብፅ እንመለስ ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም በእስራኤል ልጆች ጉባኤ ፊት በግምባራቸው ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን ከሰለሉት ጋር የነበሩት የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱና የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ ልብሳቸውን ቀደዱ፤

verses.text_english: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, an exceeding good land.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። ዞረን የሰለልናት ምድር እጅግ መልካም ናት።

verses.text_english: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርስ ከወደደን ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስሰው ወደዚች ምድር ያገባናል እርስዋንም ይሰጠናል።

verses.text_english: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD with us: fear them not.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አታምፁ፤ እንደ እንጀራ ይሆኑልናልና የምድሪቱን ሰዎች አትፍሩ፤ ጥላቸው ከላያቸው ተገፍፎአል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ አትፍሩአቸው ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ግን በድንጋይ ይወግሩአቸው ዘንድ ተማከሩ። የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ይህ ሕዝብ እስከ መቼ ይንቀኛል? በፊቱስ ባደረግሁት ተአምራት ሁሉ እስከ መቼ አያምንብኝም?

verses.text_english: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.text_amharic: ከርስታቸው አጠፋቸው ዘንድ በቸነፈር እመታቸዋለሁ፤ አንተም ከእነርሱ ለሚበዛና ለሚጠነክር ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear , (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ግብፃውያን ይሰማሉ፤ ይህን ሕዝብ ከመካከላቸው በኃይልህ አውጥተኸዋልና፤

verses.text_english: And they will tell to the inhabitants of this land: they have heard that thou LORD among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and thy cloud standeth over them, and thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚችም ምድር ሰዎች ይናገራሉ። አንተ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል እንደ ሆንህ ሰምተዋል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ ፊት ለፊት ተገልጠሃል፥ ደመናህም በላያቸው ቆሞአል፥ በቀንም በደመና ዓምድ፥ በሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ በፊታቸው ትሄዳለህ።

verses.text_english: Now thou shalt kill this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሕዝብ እንደ አንድ ሰው ብትገድል ዝናህን የሰሙ አሕዛብ።

verses.text_english: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሕዝብ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ያገባቸው ዘንድ አልቻለምና በምድረ በዳ ገደላቸው ብለው ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
The LORD longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth .
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሕዝብ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይቅር እንዳልሃቸው፥ እባክህ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህ ብዛት የዚህን ሕዝብ ኃጢአት ይቅር በል።

verses.text_english: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እንደ ቃልህ ይቅር አልሁ፤

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እኔ ሕያው ነኛ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምድርን ሁሉ ይሞላል።

verses.text_english: But truly I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድርና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግሁትን ተአምራቴንና ክብሬን ያዩ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ አሥር ጊዜ ስለ ተፈታተኑኝ፥

verses.text_english: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.text_amharic: ነገሬንም ስላልሰሙ፥ በእውነት ለአባቶቻቸው የማልሁላቸውን ምድር አያዩም፤ ከእነርሱም የናቀኝ ሰው ሁሉ አያያትም፤

verses.text_english: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬ ካሌብ ግን ሌላ መንፈስ ከእርሱ ጋር ስለ ሆነ ፈጽሞም ስለተከተለኝ እርሱ ወደ ገባባት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሩም ይወርሳታል።

verses.text_english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.text_amharic: አማሌቅና ከነዓናዊውም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀምጦአል፤ በነጋው ተመልሳችሁ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሂዱ።

verses.text_english: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የሚያጕረመርምብኝን ይህን ክፉ ሕዝብ እስከ መቼ እታገሠዋለሁ? በእኔ ላይ የሚያጕረመርሙትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማጕረምረም ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: How long this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ በላቸው። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በጆሮዬ እንደ ተናገራችሁት እንዲሁ በእውነት አደርግባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: Say unto them, I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.text_amharic: በድኖቻችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይወድቃሉ፤ የተቆጠራችሁ ሁሉ፥ እንደቁጥራችሁ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የሆነ ሁሉ፥ እናንተ ያጕረመረማችሁብኝ፥

verses.text_english: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.text_amharic: ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብና ከነዌ ልጅ ከኢያሱ በቀር በእርስዋ አስቀምጣችሁ ዘንድ እጄን ዘርግቼ ወደ ማልሁላችሁ ምድር በእውነት እናንተ አትገቡም።

verses.text_english: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮኛ ይሆናሉ ያላችኋቸውን ልጆቻችሁን እነርሱን አገባቸዋለሁ፥ እናንተም የናቃችኋትን ምድር ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን በድኖቻችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: But you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻችሁም በምድረ በዳ አርባ ዓመት ይቅበዘበዛሉ፥ በድኖቻችሁም በምድረ በዳ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ግልሙትናችሁን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.text_english: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱን በሰላለችሁባት ቀን ቍጥር፥ አርባ ቀን፥ ስለ አንድ ቀንም አንድ ዓመት፥ ኃጢአታችሁን አርባ ዓመት ትሸከማላችሁ፥ ቍጣዬንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር። በእኔ ላይ በተሰበሰበ በዚህ ክፉ ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ እንዲህ አደርጋለሁ ብዬ ተናገርሁ፤ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ያልቃሉ፥ በዚያም ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱንም ሊሰልሉ ሙሴ ልኮአቸው የተመለሱት ሰዎች ክፉ ወሬም ስለ ምድሪቱ እያወሩ በእርሱ ላይ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ እንዲያጕረመርሙ ያደረጉ፥

verses.text_english: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ወሬ ያወሩ እነዚያ ሰዎች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመቅሠፍት ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ምድሪቱን ሊሰልሉ ከሄዱ ሰዎች የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱና የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ በሕይወት ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of the men that went to search the land, lived .
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ይህን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ነገረ፥ ሕዝቡም እጅግ አዘኑ።

verses.text_english: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም ማልደው ተነሡ፥ ወደ ተራራውም ራስ መጥተው። እነሆ፥ መጣን፤ እኛ በድለናልና እግዚአብሔር ወዳለው ስፍራ እንወጣለን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we , and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አለ። የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? አይጠቅማችሁም።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ መካከል አይደለምና በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት እንዳትወድቁ አትውጡ።

verses.text_english: Go not up, for the LORD not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.text_amharic: አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ በፊታችሁ ናቸውና በሰይፍ ትወድቃላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ተመልሳችኋልና እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ሊወጡ ደፈሩ፤ ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦትና ሙሴ ከሰፈሩ አልተነሡም።

verses.text_english: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ተራራ ላይ የተቀመጡ አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ ወረዱ፥ መትተዋቸውም እስከ ሔርማ ድረስ አሳደዱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደምሰጣችሁ ወደ መኖሪያችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.text_amharic: ስእለታችሁን ልትፈጽሙ፥ ወይም በፈቃዳችሁ፥ ወይም በበዓላችሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ከበሬ ወይም ከበግ መንጋ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም መሥዋዕት የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታቀርቡ፥

verses.text_english: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth of an hin of oil.
And the fourth of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርብ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ከሌላ መሥዋዕት ጋር ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.text_english: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third of an hin of oil.
And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third of an hin of wine, a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታዘጋጃለህ፤ የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.text_english: And when thou preparest a bullock a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ወይም ለሌላ መሥዋዕት ወይም ስእለትን ለመፈጸም ወይም ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ወይፈንን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታዘጋጅ፥

verses.text_english: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.text_amharic: ከወይፈኑ ጋር የኢን መስፈሪያ ግማሽ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት ለተደረገ ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ ግማሽ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለ።

verses.text_english: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ለእያንዳንዱ ወይፈን ወይም ለእያንዳንዱ አውራ በግ ወይም ለእያንዳንዱ ተባት የበግ ወይም የፍየል ጠቦት ይደረጋል።

verses.text_english: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳዘጋጃችሁት ቍጥር፥ እንዲሁ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ለእያንዳንዱ ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የአገር ልጅ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ቍርባን በእሳት ባቀረበ ጊዜ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.text_amharic: መጻተኛም ከእናንተ ጋር ቢቀመጥ፥ ወይም በትውልዳችሁ መካከል ማንም ሰው ቢኖር፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ቍርባን በእሳት ቢያቀርብ፥ እናንተ የምታደርጉትን እርሱ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: One ordinance for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth , an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye , so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ በጉባኤው ላላችሁ በእናንተም መካከል ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ አንድ ሥርዓት ይሆናል፥ ለልጅ ልጃችሁም የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤ እናንተ እንደ ሆናችሁ እንዲሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መጻተኛ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተና ከእናንተ ጋር ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ አንድ ሕግና አንድ ፍርድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደማመጣችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምድሪቱን እንጀራ በበላችሁ ጊዜ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough an heave offering: as the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.text_amharic: መጀመሪያ ከምታደርጉት ሊጥ አንድ እንጐቻ ለማንሣት ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ከአውድማም እንደምታነሡት ቍርባን እንዲሁ ታነሣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
verses.text_amharic: መጀመሪያ ከምታደርጉት ሊጥ የማንሣት ቍርባን እስከ ልጅ ልጃችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.text_amharic: ብትስቱም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ ያዘዛቸውን እነዚህን ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.text_english: all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded , and henceforward among your generations;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ካዘዘበት ከፊተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ፊትም እስከ ልጅ ልጃችሁ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.text_english: Then it shall be, if be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩ ሳያውቁ በስሕተት ቢደረግ፥ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከእህሉ ቍርባንና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ጋር እንደ ሕጉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን አንድ ወይፈን፥ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ያቀርባሉ።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ያስተሰርይላቸዋል፥ ስሕተትም ነበረና ይሰረይላቸዋል፤ ስለ ስሕተታቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባናቸውን በእሳት አቅርበዋል፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የኃጢአታቸውን መሥዋዕት አቅርበዋል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people in ignorance.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዘንድ ያለ እውቀት ተደርጎአልና ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመካከላቸውም ለሚኖሩት መጻተኞች ስርየት ይደረግላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰው ሳያውቅ ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንዲት የአንድ ዓመት እንስት ፍየል ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአት ሠርቶ ሳያውቅ፥ ለሳተ ለዚያ ሰው ካህኑ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ይሰረይለትማል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.text_amharic: ትውልዱ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ቢሆን፥ ወይም በመካከላቸው የሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ ቢሆን፥ ሳያውቅ ኃጢአትን ለሚሠራ ሁሉ ሕጉ አንድ ይሆንለታል።

verses.text_english: But the soul that doeth presumptuously, born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text_amharic: የአገር ልጅ ቢሆን ወይም መጻተኛ ቢሆን፥ አንዳች በትዕቢት የሚያደርግ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ሰድቦአል፤ ያም ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity upon him.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስለ ናቀ፥ ትእዛዙንም ስለ ሰበረ፥ ያ ሰው ፈጽሞ ይጥፋ፤ ኃጢአቱ በራሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በምድረ በዳ ሳሉ አንድ ሰው በሰንበት ቀን እንጨት ሲለቅም አገኙ።

verses.text_english: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እንጨትም ሲለቅም ያገኙት ሰዎች ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ወደ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ አመጡት።

verses.text_english: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.text_amharic: ያደርጉበትም ዘንድ የሚገባው አልተገለጠምና በግዞት አስቀመጡት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ሰውየው ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ በድንጋይ ይውገሩት አለው።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እስኪሞት ድረስ በድንጋይ ወገሩት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። እነርሱም ትውልዶቻቸውም በልብሳቸው ጫፍ ዘርፍ ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ በዘርፉም ሁሉ ላይ ሰማያዊ ፈትል ያደርጉ ዘንድ እዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታስቡና ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ እርስዋን በመከተል ያመነዘራችሁባትን የልባችሁንና የዓይኖቻችሁን ፈቃድ እንዳትከተሉ፥

verses.text_english: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዜን ሁሉ ታስቡና ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ ለአምላካችሁም ቅዱሳን ትሆኑ ዘንድ ዘርፉ በልብሳችሁ ላይ እንዲታይ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: I the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ፤ አምላክ እሆናችሁ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took :
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊም ልጅ የቀዓት ልጅ የይስዓር ልጅ ቆሬ ከሮቤልም ልጆች የኤልያብ ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮን የፋሌትም ልጅ ኦን በሙሴ ላይ ተነሡ። ች የኤልያብ ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮን የፋሌትም ልጅ ኦን በሙሴ

verses.text_english: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች ከእነርሱ ጋር ወሰዱ፤ ከጉባኤው የተመረጡ ዝናቸውም የተሰማ የማኅበሩ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, too much upon you, seeing all the congregation holy, every one of them, and the LORD among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ ተሰብስበው። ማኅበሩ ሁሉ እያንዳንዳቸው ቅዱሳን ናቸውና፥ እግዚአብሔርም በመካከላቸው ነውና እናንተ እጅግ አብዝታችኋል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ጉባኤ ላይ ለምን ትታበያላችሁ? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And when Moses heard , he fell upon his face:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በሰማ ጊዜ በግምባሩ ወደቀ፤

verses.text_english: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who his, and holy; and will cause to come near unto him: even whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ለቆሬም ለወገኑም ሁሉ። ነገ እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ የሚሆነውን፥ ቅዱስም የሚሆነውን ያስታውቃል፤ የመረጠውንም ሰው ወደ እርሱ ያቀርበዋል።

verses.text_english: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ አድርጉ፤ ቆሬና ወገንህ ሁሉ፥ ጥናዎቹን ውሰዱ፤

verses.text_english: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be the man whom the LORD doth choose, he holy: too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: ነገም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እሳት አድርጉባቸው፥ ዕጣንም ጨምሩባቸው፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሚመርጠው እርሱ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ እናንተ የሌዊ ልጆች ሆይ እጅግ አብዝታችኋል ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ቆሬን አለው። እናንተ የሌዊ ልጆች፥ ስሙ፤

verses.text_english: a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ ከእስራኤል ማኅበር የለያችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ትሠሩ ዘንድ፥ እንድታገለግሉአቸውም በማኅበሩ ፊት ትቆሙ ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ ያቀረባችሁ አይበቃችሁምን?

verses.text_english: And he hath brought thee near , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ከአንተም ጋር የሌዊን ልጆች ወንድሞችህን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦአል፤ ክህነትንም ደግሞ ትፈልጋላችሁን?

verses.text_english: For which cause thou and all thy company gathered together against the LORD: and what Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም አንተና ወገንህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ተሰብስባችኋል፤ በእርሱም ላይ ታጕረመርሙ ዘንድ አሮን ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የኤልያብን ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮንን እንዲጠሩአቸው ላከ፤ እነርሱም። አንመጣም፤

verses.text_english: a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ ትገድለን ዘንድ ወተትና ማር ከምታፈስሰው ምድር ያወጣኸን አይበቃህምን? ደግመህ በእኛ ላይ ራስህን አለቃ ታደርጋለህን?

verses.text_english: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር አላገባኸንም፥ እርሻና ወይንም አላወረስኸንም፤ የእነዚህንስ ሰዎች ዓይኖቻቸውን ታወጣለህን? አንመጣም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም። ወደ ቍርባናቸው አትመልከት፤ እኔ ከእነርሱ አንድ አህያ ስንኳ አልወሰድሁም፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ ሰው አልበደልሁም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ቆሬን። ነገ አንተ፥ ወገንህም ሁሉ፥ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁኑ፤

verses.text_english: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each his censer.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችሁም ጥናዎቻችሁን ውሰዱ፥ ዕጣንም አድርጉባቸው፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ጥናዎቻችሁን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት አምጡ፥ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ጥናዎች፤ አንተ ደግሞ አሮንም ጥናዎቻችሁን አምጡ አለው።

verses.text_english: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም ጥናውን ወሰደ፥ እሳትም አደረገበት፥ ዕጣንም ጨመረበት፥ ከሙሴና ከአሮንም ጋር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ቆሬም ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእነርሱ ላይ ሰበሰበ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን በቅጽበት አጠፋቸው ዘንድ ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ።

verses.text_english: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በግምባራቸው ወድቀው። አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ የሰው ሁሉ ነፍስ አምላክ፥ አንድ ሰው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ አንተ በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ላይ ትቈጣለህን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.text_amharic: ለማኅበሩ። ከቆሬና ከዳታን ከአቤሮንም ማደሪያ ዙሪያ ፈቀቅ በሉ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ተነሥቶ ወደ ዳታንና ወደ አቤሮን ሄደ፤ የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩንም። እባካችሁ፥ ከእነዚህ ክፉዎች ድንኳን ፈቀቅ በሉ፤ በኃጢአታቸውም ሁሉ እንዳትጠፉ ለእነርሱ የሆነውን ሁሉ አትንኩ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.text_amharic: ከቆሬና ከዳታን ከአቤሮንም ማደሪያ ከዙሪያውም ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ዳታንና አቤሮንም ሴቶቻቸውም ልጆቻቸውም ሕፃናቶቻቸውም ወጥተው በድንኳኖቻቸው ደጃፍ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for not of mine own mind.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አለ። ይህን ሥራ ሁሉ አደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ላከኝ እንጂ ከልቤ እንዳይደለ በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; the LORD hath not sent me.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሰዎች ሰው እንደሚሞት ቢሞቱ፥ ወይም እንደ ሰው ሁሉ ቢቀሠፉ እግዚአብሔር አልላከኝም።

verses.text_english: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን አዲስ ነገር ቢፈጥር፥ ምድርም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን ለእነርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ብትውጣቸው፥ በሕይወታቸውም ወደ ሲኦል ቢወርዱ፥ ያን ጊዜ እነዚህ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ናቁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that under them:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ መናገር በፈጸመ ጊዜ ከበታቻቸው ያለው መሬት ተሰነጠቀ፤

verses.text_english: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that unto Korah, and all goods.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን ቤተ ሰቦቻቸውንም፥ ለቆሬም የነበሩትን ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ዕቃዎቻቸውንም ሁሉ ዋጠቻቸው።

verses.text_english: They, and all that to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ለእነርሱም የነበሩ ሁሉ በሕይወታቸው ወደ ሲኦል ወረዱ፤ ምድሪቱም ተዘጋችባቸው፥ ከጉባኤውም መካከል ጠፉ።

verses.text_english: And all Israel that round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up .
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያቸው የነበሩ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ከጩኸታቸው የተነሣ። ምድሪቱ እንዳትውጠን ብለው በረሩ።

verses.text_english: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.text_amharic: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጥታ ያጥኑ የነበሩትን ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች በላች።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.text_amharic: ለካህኑ ለአሮን ልጅ ለአልዓዛር እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። ተቀድሰዋልና ጥናዎቹን ከተቃጠሉት ዘንድ ውሰድ፥ እሳቱንም ወደ ውጭ ጣለው፤

verses.text_english: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በኃጢአታቸው ሰውነታቸውን ያጠፉትን የእነዚያን ሰዎች ጥናዎች ጠፍጥፈህ ለመሠዊያ መለበጫ አድርጋቸው፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርበዋቸዋልና የተቀደሱ ናቸው፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ምልክት ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad a covering of the altar:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም አልዓዛር የተቃጠሉት ሰዎች ያቀረቡአቸውን የናስ ጥናዎች ወስዶ ጠፍጥፎም ለመሠዊያው መለበጫ አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በቆሬና በወገኑ የደረሰው እንዳይደርስበት፥ ከአሮን ልጆች ያልሆነ ሌላ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣን ያጥን ዘንድ እንዳይቀርብ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እንደ ተናገረው፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። እናንተ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕዝብ ገድላችኋል ብለው በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አጕረመረሙ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ማኅበሩ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አዩ፤ እነሆም፥ ደመናው ሸፈነው፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ፥ እኔም በቅጽበት አጠፋቸዋለሁ። በግምባራቸውም ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም አሮንን። ጥናህን ውሰድ፥ ከመሠዊያውም ላይ እሳት አድርግበት፥ ዕጣንም ጨምርበት፥ ወደ ማኅበሩም ፈጥነህ ውሰደው አስተስርይላቸውም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቍጣ ወጥቶአልና መቅሠፍት ጀምሮአል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ሙሴ እንደ ተናገረው ጥናውን ወስዶ ወደ ጉባኤው መካከል ሮጠ፤ እነሆም፥ መቅሠፍቱ በሕዝቡ መካከል ጀምሮ ነበር፤ ዕጣንም ጨመረ፥ ለሕዝቡም አስተሰረየላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.text_amharic: በሙታንና በሕያዋን መካከል ቆመ፤ መቅሠፍቱም ተከለከለ።

verses.text_english: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.text_amharic: በቆሬም ምክንያት ከሞቱት ሌላ በመቅሠፍቱ የሞቱት አሥራ አራት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንም ወደ ሙሴ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ተመለሰ፤ መቅሠፍቱም ተከለከለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ከእያንዳንዱ ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አንድ አንድ በትር፥ ከአለቆቻቸው ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አሥራ ሁለት በትሮች፥ ውሰድ፤ የእያንዳንዱንም ስም በየበትሩ ላይ ጻፍ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ በትርም ለአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ ይሆናልና በሌዊ በትር ላይ የአሮንን ስም ጻፍ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር በምገናኝበት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በምስክሩ ፊት አኑራቸው።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የመረጥሁት ሰው በትር ታቈጠቁጣለች፤ በእናንተም ላይ የሚያጕረመርሙባችሁን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማጕረምረም ከእኔ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron among their rods.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገራቸው፤ አለቆቻቸው ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት በትሮች፥ እያንዳንዱም አለቃ በየአባቱ ቤት አንድ አንድ በትር፥ ሰጡት፤ የአሮንም በትር በበትሮቻቸው መካከል ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በትሮቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ሙሴ ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ ገባ፤ እነሆም፥ ለሌዊ ቤት የሆነች የአሮን በትር አቈጠቈጠች፥ ለመለመችም፥ አበባም አወጣች፥ የበሰለ ለውዝም አፈራች።

verses.text_english: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በትሮችን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ አወጣቸው፤ እነርሱም አዩ፥ እያንዳንዱም በትሩን ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአሮንን በትር ወደ ምስክሩ ፊት መልስ፤ ማጕረምረማቸው ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲጠፋ እነርሱም እንዳይሞቱ ለሚያምፁብኝ ልጆች ምልክት ሆና ትጠበቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses did : as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሙሴን።እነሆ፥ እንሞታለን፥ እንጠፋለን፥ ሁላችንም እንጠፋለን።

verses.text_english: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
verses.text_amharic: የሚቀርብ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ የሚቀርብ፥ ይሞታል፤ በውኑ ሁላችን እንሞታለንን? ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን አለው። አንተ ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህና የአባቶችህ ቤት የመቅደስን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ፤ አንተም ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ የክህነታችሁን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም የአባትህን የሌዊን ነገድ ወንድሞችህን ከአንተ ጋር አቅርብ፤ ከአንተም ጋር በአንድነት ይሁኑ፥ ያገልግሉህም፤ አንተ ግን ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ በምስክሩ ድንኳን ፊት ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ትእዛዝህን የድንኳኑንም ሁሉ አገግሎት ይጠብቁ፤ ነገር ግን እንዳይሞቱ፥ እናንተም ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዳትሞቱ፥ እነርሱ ወደ መቅደሱ ዕቃና ወደ መሠዊያው አይቅረቡ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ጋር በአንድነት ይሁኑ፥ ለድንኳኑም አገልግሎት ሁሉ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ይጠብቁ፤ ሌላም ሰው ወደ እናንተ አይቅረብ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ገና በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይሆንባቸው እናንተ መቅደሱንና መሠዊያውን ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you given a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም፥ እነሆ፥ ሌዋውያንን ወንድሞቻችሁን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጄአለሁ፤ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ያደርጉ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር የተሰጡ ለእናንተ ስጦታ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ ለመሠዊያው ሥራ የሚሆነውን ሁሉ፥ በመጋረጃውም ውስጥ የሚሆነውን ታደርጉ ዘንድ ክህነታችሁን ጠብቁ፥ አገልግሉም፤ ክህነቱን ለስጦታ አገልግሎት ሰጥቼአችኋለሁ፤ ሌላም ሰው ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ተናገረው እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእኔ የቀደሱትን የማንሣት ቍርባኔን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ ስለ መቀባትህ ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: This shall be thine of the most holy things, from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.text_amharic: በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከተቀደሰው ይህ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ለእኔ የሚያመጡት መባቸው ሁሉ፥ የእህሉ ቍርባናቸው ሁሉ፥ የኃጢአታቸውም መስዋዕት ሁሉ፥ የበደላቸውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ፥ ለአንተ ለልጆችህም የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: In the most holy shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ብላው፤ ወንዶች ሁሉ ይብሉት፤ የተቀደሰ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: And this thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ለአንተ ነው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለስጦታ ያቀረቡትን የማንሣትና የመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።

verses.text_english: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚሰጡት የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ከዘይትና ከወይን ከእህልም የተመረጠውን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat it.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚያመጡት በምድራቸው ያለው ሁሉ የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።

verses.text_english: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ዘንድ እርም የሆነው ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው ወይም ከእንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚያቀርቡት ሥጋ ሁሉ ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን የሰውን በኵራት ፈጽሞ ትቤዠዋለህ፥ ያልነጻውንም እንስሳ በኵራት ትቤዠዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which twenty gerahs.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ የምትቤዠውን እንደ ግምትህ ትቤዠዋለህ፤ ግምቱም እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን አምስት ሰቅል ይሆናል፤ እርሱም ሀያ አቦሊ ነው።

verses.text_english: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የላም በኵራት ወይም የበግ በኵራት ወይም የፍየል በኵራት አትቤዥም፤ የተቀደሱ ናቸው፤ ደማቸውን በመሠዊያው ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፥ ስባቸውንም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለእሳት ቍርባን ታቃጥለዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋቸውም ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ እንደ መወዝወዝ ፍርምባ እንደ ቀኙም ወርች ለአንተ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከተቀደሰው ነገር ሁሉ አንሥተው ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረቡትን ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለዘርህ የጨው ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን አለው። በምድራቸው ርስት በመካከላቸውም ድርሻ አይሆንልህም፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ድርሻህና ርስትህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ለሌዊም ልጆች፥ እነሆ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን አገልግሎት ስለሚያገለግሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሥራት ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ኃጢአትን እንዳይሸከሙ እንዳይሞቱም፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አይቅረቡ።

verses.text_english: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያን ግን የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ይሥሩ፥ እነርሱም ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤ በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ርስት አይወርሱም።

verses.text_english: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን የሚያቀርቡትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሥራት ለሌዋውያን ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአለሁ፤ ስለዚህ። በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ርስት አይወርሱም አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, a tenth of the tithe.
verses.text_amharic: ለሌዋውያን እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ከእስራኤል ልጆች ለእናንተ ርስት አድርጌ የሰጠኋችሁን አሥራት በተቀበላችሁ ጊዜ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን የአሥራት አሥራት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.text_amharic: የማንሣት ቍርባናችሁም እንደ አውድማው እህልና እንደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ፍሬ ይቈጠርላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከምትቀበሉት አሥራት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም የማንሣት ቍርባን ለካህኑ ለአሮን ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.text_amharic: ከምትቀበሉት ስጦታ ሁሉ፥ ከተመረጠው ከተቀደሰውም ድርሻ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ትላቸዋለህ። ከእርሱ የተመረጠውን ባነሣችሁ ጊዜ እንደ አውድማው እህልና እንደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ፍሬ ለሌዋውያን ይቈጠራል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ቤተ ሰቦቻችሁም፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ የማገልገላችሁ ዋጋ ነውና በሁሉ ስፍራ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
verses.text_amharic: የተመረጠውንም ከእርሱ ባነሣችሁ ጊዜ ስለ እርሱ ኃጢአትን አትሸከሙም፤ እንዳትሞቱም የእስራኤል ልጆች የቀደሱትን አታረክሱም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: This the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein no blemish, upon which never came yoke:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው የሕጉ ትእዛዝ ይህ ነው፤ መልካሚቱን፥ ነውርም የሌለባትን፥ ቀንበርም ያልተጫነባትን ቀይ ጊደር ያመጡልህ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and shall slay her before his face:
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋንም ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ትሰጣላችሁ፥ እርስዋንም ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ይወስዳታል፥ አንድ ሰውም በፊቱ ያርዳታል።

verses.text_english: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም አልዓዛር ከደምዋ በጣቱ ይወስዳል፥ ከደምዋም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል።

verses.text_english: And shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.text_amharic: ጊደሪቱም በፊቱ ትቃጠላለች፤ ቁርበትዋም ሥጋዋም ደምዋም ፈርስዋም ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም የዝግባ እንጨት ሂሶጵም ቀይ ግምጃም ወስዶ ጊደሪቱ በምትቃጠልበት እሳት መካከል ይጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ይገባል፤ ካህኑም እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text_amharic: ያቃጠላትም ሰው ልብሱን በውኃ ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And a man clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it a purification for sin.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕም ሰው የጊደሪቱን አመድ ያከማቻል ከሰፈሩም ውጭ በንጹሕ ስፍራ ያኖረዋል፤ ርኵሰትም ለሚያነጻ ውኃ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ይጠበቃል፤ ከኃጢአት ለማንጻት የሚሆን ነው።

verses.text_english: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የጊደሪቱንም አመድ ያከማቸ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእስራኤል ልጆች በመካከላቸውም ለሚኖር መጻተኛ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.text_amharic: የሞተውን ሰው በድን የሚነካ ሰባት ቀን ርኵስ ይሆናል፤
