verses.text_english: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ውኃ በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሁለመናውን ያጠራል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሁለመናውን ባያጠራ ንጹሕ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness yet upon him.
verses.text_amharic: የሞተውን ሰው በድን የነካ ሁለመናውን ባያጠራ የእግዚአብሔርን ማደሪያ ያረክሳል፤ ያ ሰው ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ በእርሱም ላይ የሚያነጻ ውኃ አልተረጨምና ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ርኵሰቱ ገና በእርሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: This the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በድንኳን ውስጥ ቢሞት ሕጉ ይህ ነው፤ ወደ ድንኳኑ የሚገባ ሁሉ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ ያለው ሁሉ ሰባት ቀን ርኵስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, unclean.
verses.text_amharic: መክደኛው ያልታሰረ የተከፈተ ዕቃ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳም በሰይፍ የተገደለውን ወይም የሞተውን በድን ወይም የሰውን አጥንት ወይም መቃብር የሚነካ ሰባት ቀን ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And for an unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአት ለማንጻት እንድትሆን ከተቃጠለችው ጊደር አመድ ለርኩሱ ይወስዱለታል፥ በዕቃውም ውስጥ የምንጭ ውኃ ይቀላቀልበታል።

verses.text_english: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip in the water, and sprinkle upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕም ሰው ሂሶጱን ወስዶ በውኃው ውስጥ ያጠልቀዋል፤ በድንኳኑም፥ በዕቃውም ሁሉ፥ በዚያም ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ፥ አጥንቱንም ወይም የተገደለውን ወይም የሞተውን ወይም መቃብሩን በነካው ላይ ይረጨዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the clean shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሑም በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን በርኩሱ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤ ባሰባተኛውም ቀን ያጠራዋል፤ እርሱም ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ በማታም ጊዜ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ርኩስ ቢሆን ሁለመናውንም ባያጠራ፥ ያ ሰው የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ አርክሶአልና ከጉባኤው መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ በሚያነጻ ውኃ አልተረጨም፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆንላችኋል፤ የሚያነጻውን ውኃ የሚረጭ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፤ የሚያነጻውንም ውኃ የሚነካ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever the unclean toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth shall be unclean until even.
verses.text_amharic: ርኩሱም የሚነካው ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ የሚነካውም ሰው እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Then came the children of Israel, the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመጀመሪያው ወር ወደ ጺን ምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ ሕዝቡም በቃዴስ ተቀመጡ፤ ማርያምም በዚያ ሞተች፥ በዚያም ተቀበረች።

verses.text_english: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.text_amharic: ለማኅበሩም ውኃ አልነበረም፤ በሙሴና በአሮንም ላይ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሙሴን ተጣሉት፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩት። ወንድሞቻችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሞቱ ጊዜ እኛም ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ!

verses.text_english: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ከብቶቻችንም በዚያ እንሞት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ጉባኤ ወደዚህ ምድረ በዳ ለምን አመጣችሁ?

verses.text_english: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither there any water to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚህ ክፉ ስፍራ ታመጡን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ለምን አወጣችሁን? ዘርና በለስ ወይንም ሮማንም የሌለበት ስፍራ ነው፤ የሚጠጣም ውኃ የለበትም።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ከጉባኤው ፊት ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሂደው በግምባራቸው ወደቁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.text_amharic: በትርህን ውሰድ፤ አንተና ወንድምህ አሮን ማኅበሩን ሰብስቡ፥ ድንጋዩም ውኃን እንዲሰጥ እነርሱ ሲያዩ ተናገሩት፤ ከድንጋዩም ውኃ ታወጣላቸዋለህ፤ እንዲሁም ማኅበሩን ከብቶቻቸውንም ታጠጣላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንደ ታዘዘ በትሩን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮንም ጉባኤውን በድንጋዩ ፊት ሰብስበው። እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ እንግዲህ ስሙ፤ በውኑ ከዚህ ድንጋይ ውኃን እናወጣላችኋለን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts .
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እጁን ዘርግቶ ድንጋዩን ሁለት ጊዜ በበትሩ መታው፤ ብዙም ውኃ ወጣ፥ ማኅበሩም ከብቶቻቸውም ጠጡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን። በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ትቀድሱኝ ዘንድ በእኔ አላመናችሁምና ስለዚህ ወደ ሰጠኋቸው ምድር ይህን ጉባኤ ይዛችሁ አትገቡም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: This the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጠብ ያደረጉበት፥ እርሱም ቅዱስ መሆኑን የገለጠበት ይህ የመሪባ ውኃ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከቃዴስ ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ መልእክተኞችን እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ። ወንድምህ እስራኤል እንዲህ ይላል። ያገኘንን መከራ ሁሉ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤

verses.text_english: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፥ በግብፅም እጅግ ዘመን ተቀመጥን ግብፃውያንም እኛንና አባቶቻችንን በደሉ፤

verses.text_english: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጮኽን ጊዜ ድምፃችንን ሰማ፥ መልአክንም ሰድዶ ከግብፅ አወጣን፤ እነሆም፥ በምድርህ ዳርቻ ባለችው ከተማ በቃዴስ ተቀምጠናል።

verses.text_english: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink the water of the wells: we will go by the king's way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.text_amharic: እባክህ፥ በምድርህ ላይ እንለፍ፤ ወደ እርሻም ወደ ወይንም አንገባም፥ ከጕድጓዶችም ውኃን አንጠጣም፤ በንጉሡ ጐዳና እንሄዳለን፥ ዳርቻህንም እስክናልፍ ድረስ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አንልም።

verses.text_english: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስም። በሰይፍ እንዳልገጥምህ በምድሬ ላይ አታልፍም አለው።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without any thing , go through on my feet.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። በጐዳናው እንሄዳለን፥ እኔም ከብቶቼም ከውኃህ ብንጠጣ ዋጋውን እንከፍላለን፥ ሌላም ምንም አናደርግም፤ ብቻ በእግራችን እንለፍ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አታልፍም አለ። ኤዶምያስም በብዙ ሕዝብና በጽኑ እጅ ሊገጥመው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስም እስራኤል በዳርቻው እንዳያልፍ ከለከለ፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤል ከእርሱ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.text_amharic: ከቃዴስም ተጓዙ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ወደ ሖር ተራራ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን በኤዶምያስ ምድር ዳርቻ ባለው በሖር ተራራ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.text_amharic: አሮን ወደ ወገኑ ይከማች፤ በመሪባ ውኃ ዘንድ በቃሌ ላይ ስለ ዐመፃችሁ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር አይገባም።

verses.text_english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.text_amharic: አሮንና ልጁን አልዓዛርን ይዘህ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ላይ አምጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered , and shall die there.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሮንም ልብሱን አውጣ፥ ልጁንም አልዓዛርን አልብሰው፤ አሮንም ወደ ወገኑ ይከማች፥ በዚያም ይሙት።

verses.text_english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ አደረገ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ እያዩ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የአሮንን ልብስ አወጣ፥ ልጁንም አልዓዛርን አለበሰው፤ አሮንም በዚያ በተራራው ራስ ላይ ሞተ፤ ሙሴና አልዓዛርም ከተራራው ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, all the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ አሮን እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ለአሮን ሠላሳ ቀን አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took of them prisoners.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብም በኩል ተቀምጦ የነበረው ከነዓናዊው የዓራድ ንጉሥ በአታሪም መንገድ እስራኤል እንደ መጡ ሰማ፤ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ሰልፍ አደረገ ከእነርሱም ምርኮ ማረከ።

verses.text_english: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ለእግዚአብሔር። እነዚህን አሳልፈህ በእጄ ብትሰጣቸው ከተሞቻቸውን እርም ብዬ አጠፋለሁ ብሎ ስእለት ተሳለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ድምፅ ሰማ፥ ከነዓናውያንንም አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ እነርሱንም ከተሞቻቸውንም እርም ብለው አጠፉ፤ የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም ሔርማ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.text_english: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.text_amharic: ከሖርም ተራራ ከኤዶምያስ ምድር ርቀው ሊዞሩ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ተጓዙ፤ የሕዝቡም ሰውነት ከመንገዱ የተነሣ ደከመ።

verses.text_english: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for no bread, neither water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በእግዚአብሔርና በሙሴ ላይ። በምድረ በዳ እንሞት ዘንድ ከግብፅ ለምን አወጣችሁን? እንጀራ የለም፥ ውኃ የለም፤ ሰውነታችንም ይህን ቀላል እንጀራ ተጸየፈ ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሕዝቡ ላይ እባቦችን ሰደደ፥ ሕዝቡንም ነደፉ፤ ከእስራኤልም ብዙ ሰዎች ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ መጥተው። በእግዚአብሔርና በአንተ ላይ ስለ ተናገርን በድለናል፤ እባቦችን ከእኛ ያርቅልን ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልይልን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ስለ ሕዝቡ ጸለየ። እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እባብን ሠርተህ በዓላማ ላይ ስቀል፤ የተነደፈውም ሁሉ ሲያያት በሕይወት ይኖራል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የናሱን እባብ ሠርቶ በዓላማ ላይ ሰቀለ፤ እባብም የነደፈችው ሰው ሁሉ የናሱን እባብ ባየ ጊዜ ዳነ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተጓዙ፥ በኦቦትም ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.text_amharic: ከኦቦትም ተጕዘው በሞዓብ ፊት ለፊት ባለችው ምድረ በዳ፥ በፀሐይ መውጫ በኩል፥ በዒዬዓባሪም ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ተጕዘው በዘሬድ ሸለቆ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ተጕዘው ከአሞራውያን ዳርቻ በሚወጣው ምድረ በዳ ውስጥ በአሮኖን ማዶ ሰፈሩ፤ አሮኖን በሞዓብና በአሞራውያን መካከል ያለ የሞዓብ ዳርቻ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር የጦርነት መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ተባለ።  ዋሄብ በሱፋ፥  የአርኖንም ሸለቆች፥

verses.text_english: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዔር ማደሪያ የሚወርድ  በሞዓብም ዳርቻ የሚጠጋ  የሸለቆች ፈሳሽ።

verses.text_english: And from thence to Beer: that the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ብኤር ተጓዙ፤ ይኸውም እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን። ሕዝቡን ሰብስብ ውኃንም እሰጣቸዋለሁ ብሎ የተናገረለት ጕድጓድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ እስራኤል ይህን መዝሙር ዘመረ።  አንተ ምንጭ ሆይ፥ ፍለቅ፤ እናንተ ዘምሩለት፤

verses.text_english: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness to Mattanah:
verses.text_amharic: በበትረ መንግሥት በበትራቸውም  የሕዝብ አዛውንቶች ያጐደጐዱት፥  አለቆችም የቈፈሩት ጕድጓድ።

verses.text_english: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.text_amharic: ከምድረ በዳም ወደ መቴና ተጓዙ፤ ከመቴናም ወደ ነሃሊኤል፥ ከነሃሊኤልም ወደ ባሞት፥

verses.text_english: And from Bamoth the valley, that in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሞትም ምድረ በዳውን ከላይ ወደሚመለከተው ወደ ፈስጋ ተራራ ራስ በሞዓብ በረሀ ወዳለው ሸለቆ ተጓዙ።

verses.text_english: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink the waters of the well: we will go along by the king's way, until we be past thy borders.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዎንም እስራኤል በምድሩ ላይ ያልፍ ዘንድ እንቢ አለ፤ ሴዎንም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ እስራኤልንም ለመውጋት ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣ፥ ወደ ያሀጽም መጣ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.text_english: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በሰይፍ መታው፥ ምድሩንም ከአርኖን ጀምሮ እስከ አሞን ልጆች እስከ ያቦቅ ድረስ ወረሰ፤ የአሞንም ልጆች ዳርቻ የጸና ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon strong.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም እነዚህን ከተሞች ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ እስራኤልም በአሞራውያን ከተሞች ሁሉ በሐሴቦንና በመንደሮቹ ሁሉ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሴቦንም የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን ከተማ ነበረ፤ እርሱም የፊተኛውን የሞዓብን ንጉሥ ወግቶ እስከ አርኖን ድረስ ምድሩን ሁሉ ከእጁ ወስዶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For Heshbon the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በምሳሌ እንዲህ ተብሎ ተነገረ።  ወደ ሐሴቦን ኑ፤  የሴዎን ከተማ ይሠራ፥ ይመሥረት፤

verses.text_english: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.text_amharic: እሳት ከሐሴቦን፥ ነበልባልም ከሴዎን ከተማ ወጣ፤  የሞዓብን ዔር፥ የአርኖንን ተራራ አለቆች በላ፤

verses.text_english: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ ወዮልህ!  የከሞስ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ጠፋህ፤  ወንዶች ልጆቹን ለሽሽት፥ ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ለምርኮ፥  ለአሞራውያን ንጉሥ ለሴዎን ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.text_amharic: ገተርናቸው፤ ከሐሴቦን እስከ ዴቦን ድረስ ጠፉ፤  ኖፋም እስኪደርሱ እስከ ሜድባ አፈረስናቸው።

verses.text_english: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which unto Medeba.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም እንደዚህ በአሞራውያን ምድር ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሰላዮችን ወደ ኢያዜር ሰደደ፤ መንደሮችዋንም ወሰዱ፥ በዚያም የነበሩትን አሞራውያን አባረሩ።

verses.text_english: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that there.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰውም በበሳን መንገድ ወጡ፤ የባሳንም ንጉሥ ዐግ ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ ጋር በኤድራይ ይወጋቸው ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እርሱንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ምድሪቱንም አሳልፌ በእጅህ ሰጥቼአለሁና አትፍራው፤ በሐሴቦንም በተቀመጠው በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎን እንዳደረግህ እንዲሁ ታደርግበታለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንና ልጆቹን ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ መቱ ሰውም አልቀረለትም፤ ምድሩንም ወረሱ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan Jericho.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተጓዙ፥ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ባለው በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.text_amharic: የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ እስራኤል በአሞራውያን ላይ ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ።

verses.text_english: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙም ነበረና ሞዓብ ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ፈራ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተነሣ ሞዓብ ደነገጠ።

verses.text_english: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብም የምድያምን ሽማግሌዎች። በሬ የለመለመውን ሣር እንደሚጨርስ ይህ ጭፍራ በዙሪያችን ያለውን ሁሉ ይጨርሳል አላቸው። በዚያን ጊዜም የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, we may smite them, and I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.text_amharic: በወንዙ አጠገብ ባለችው በሕዝቡ ልጆች ምድር በፋቱራ ወደ ተቀመጠው ወደ ቢዖር ልጅ ወደ በለዓም። እነሆ፥ ከግብፅ የወጣ ሕዝብ አለ፤ እነሆም፥ የምድሩን ሁሉ ፊት ሸፈነ፥ በአቅራቢያችንም ተቀምጦአል፤ አሁንም ይህ ሕዝብ ከእኔ ይበልጣልና ልወጋቸውና ከምድሪቱ ላሳድዳቸው እችል እንደ ሆነ፥ እባክህ፥ ና ርገምልኝ፤ አንተ የመረቅኸው ምሩቅ የረገምኸውም ርጉም እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁና ብሎ ይጠሩት ዘንድ መልእክተኞቹን ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.text_amharic: የሞዓብ ሽማግሌዎችና የምድያም ሽማግሌዎችም የምዋርቱን ዋጋ በእጃቸው ይዘው ሄዱ፤ ወደ በለዓምም መጡ፥ የባላቅንም ቃል ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ዛሬ ሌሊት በዚህ እደሩ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደሚነግረኝ እመልስላችኋለሁ አላቸው፤ የሞዓብም አለቆች በበለዓም ዘንድ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men these with thee?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ በለዓም መጥቶ። እነዚህ በአንተ ዘንድ ያሉ ሰዎች እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, ,
Behold, a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በለዓምን። ከእነርሱ ጋር አትሂድ፤ የተባረከ ነውና ሕዝቡን አትረግምም አለው።

verses.text_english: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they blessed.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ሲነጋ ተነሥቶ የባላቅን አለቆች። ከእናንተ ጋር እሄድ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አልፈቀደምና ወደ ምድራችሁ ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.text_amharic: የሞዓብ አለቆች ተነሡ፥ ወደ ባላቅም መጥተው። በለዓም ከእኛ ጋር ይመጣ ዘንድ አልፈቀደም አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም ደግሞ ከፊተኞች የበዙና የከበሩ ሌሎችን አለቆች ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም መልሶ የባላቅን ባሪያዎች። ባላቅ በቤቱ የሞላውን ወርቅና ብር ቢሰጠኝ፥ በትንሹ ወይም በትልቁ ቢሆን የአምላኬን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እተላለፍ ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤

verses.text_english: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ደግሞ የሚነግረኝን አውቅ ዘንድ፥ እባካችሁ፥ ዛሬ ሌሊት ደግሞ በዚህ እደሩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ በለዓም በሌሊት መጥቶ። ሰዎቹ ይጠሩህ ዘንድ መጥተው እንደ ሆነ፥ ተነሣ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሂድ፤ ነገር ግን የምነግርህን ቃል ብቻ ታደርጋለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ሲነጋ ተነሣ፥ አህያይቱንም ጭኖ ከሞዓብ አለቆች ጋር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ስለ ሄደ እግዚአብሔር ተቈጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ሊቋቋመው በመንገድ ላይ ቆመ። እርሱም በአህያይቱ ላይ፥ ሁለቱም ሎሌዎቹ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: አህያይቱም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ በመንገድ ላይ ቆሞ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ይዞ አየች፤ ከመንገዱም ፈቀቅ ብላ ወደ እርሻው ውስጥ ገባች፤ በለዓምም ወደ መንገድ ይመልሳት ዘንድ አህያይቱን መታት።

verses.text_english: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants with him.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከወይኑ ቦታዎች መካከል በወዲያና በወዲህ ወገን ግንብ በነበረበት በጠባብ መንገድ ላይ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.text_amharic: አህያይቱም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ አይታ ወደ ቅጥሩ ተጠጋች፥ የበለዓምንም እግር ከቅጥሩ ጋር አጣበቀች፤ እርሱም ደግሞ መታት።

verses.text_english: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ወደ ፊት ሄደ፥ በቀኝና በግራ መተላለፊያ በሌለበት በጠባብ ስፍራ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.text_amharic: አህያይቱም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ አየች፥ ከበለዓምም በታች ተኛች፤ በለዓምም እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ አህያይቱንም በበትሩ ደበደባት።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የአህያይቱን አፍ ከፈተ፥ በለዓምንም። ሦስት ጊዜ የመታኸኝ ምን አድርጌብህ ነው? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም አህያይቱን። ስላላገጥሽብኝ ነው፤ በእጄስ ሰይፍ ቢኖር አሁን በገደልሁሽ ነበር አላት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.text_amharic: አህያይቱም በለዓምን። ከብዙ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የምትቀመጥብኝ አህያህ አይደለሁምን? በውኑ እንዲህ አደርግ ዘንድ ልማዴ ነበረን? አለችው። እርሱም። እንዲህ አላደረግሽብኝም አላት።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የበለዓምን ዓይኖች ከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ በመንገድ ላይ ቆሞ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ይዞ አየ፤ ሰገደም፥ በግምባሩም ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: And the ass said unto Balaam, not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ። አህያህን ሦስት ጊዜ ለምን መታህ? እነሆ፥ መንገድህ በፊቴ ጠማማ ነውና እቋቋምህ ዘንድ ወጥቼአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.text_amharic: አህያይቱም አይታኝ ከፊቴ ሦስት ጊዜ ፈቀቅ አለች፤ ከፊቴስ ፈቀቅ ባላለች በእውነት አሁን አንተን በገደልሁህ፥ እርስዋንም ባዳንኋት ነበር አለው።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because way is perverse before me:
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ። በድያለሁ፤ አንተ በመንገድ ላይ በፊቴ እንደቆምህብኝ አላወቅሁም፤ እንግዲህም አሁን አትወድድ እንደ ሆነ እመለሳለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በለዓምን። ከሰዎቹ ጋር ሂድ፥ ነገር ግን የምናገርህን ቃል ብቻ ትናገራለህ አለው። በለዓምም ከባላቅ አለቆች ጋር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓም እንደ መጣ በሰማ ጊዜ በአርኖን ዳር ዳርቻ በመጨረሻ ወዳለችው ወደ ሞዓብ ከተማ ሊገናኘው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓምን። በውኑ አንተን ለመጥራት አልላክሁብህምን? ለምንስ ወደ እኔ አልመጣህም? በውኑ አንተን ለማክበር እኔ አልችልምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which in the border of Arnon, which in the utmost coast.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ባላቅን። እነሆ፥ ወደ አንተ መጥቼአለሁ፤ በውኑ አሁን አንዳችን ነገር እናገር ዘንድ እችላለሁን? እግዚአብሔር በአፌ የሚያደርገውን ቃል እርሱን እናገራለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ከባላቅ ጋር ሄደ፥ ወደ ቂርያት ሐጾትም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በሬዎችንና በጎችን አርዶ ወደ በለዓም ከእርሱም ጋር ወዳሉት አለቆች ላከ።

verses.text_english: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም ባላቅ በለዓምን ይዞ ወደ በኣል ኮረብታ መስገጃ አወጣው፤ በዚያም ሆኖ የሕዝቡን ዳርቻ አየ።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ባላቅን። ሰባት መሠዊያ በዚህ ሥራልኝ፥ ሰባትም ወይፈን ሰባትም አውራ በግ በዚህ አዘጋጅልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓም እንደ ተናገረ አደረገ፤ ባላቅና በለዓምም በየመሠዊያው ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረጉ።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ባላቅን። በመሥዋዕትህ ዘንድ ቆይ፥ እኔም እሄዳለሁ፤ ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ሊገናኘኝ ይመጣል፤ እርሱም የሚገልጥልኝን እነግርሃለሁ አለው። ወደ ጉብታም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከበለዓም ጋር ተገናኘ፤ እርሱም። ሰባት መሠዊያዎች አዘጋጀሁ፥ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረግሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ቃልን በበለዓም አፍ አድርጎ። ወደ ባላቅ ተመለስ፥ እንዲህም በል አለው።

verses.text_english: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም ተመለሰ፥ እነሆም፥ እርሱና የሞዓብ አለቆች ሁሉ በመሥዋዕቱ ዘንድ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, , Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  ባላቅ ከአራም አመጣኝ፥  የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ከምሥራቅ ተራሮች፤  ና፥ ያዕቆብን ርገምልኝ፤  ና፥ እስራኤልን ተጣላልኝ ብሎ።

verses.text_english: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, the LORD hath not defied?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያልረገመውን እንዴት እረግማለሁ?

verses.text_english: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: በአምቦች ራስ ላይ ሆኜ አየዋለሁ፥  በኮረብቶችም ላይ ሆኜ እመለከተዋለሁ፤  እነሆ፥ ብቻውን የሚቀመጥ ሕዝብ ነው፥  በአሕዛብም መካከል አይቈጠርም።

verses.text_english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብን ትቢያ ማን ይቈጥራል?  የእስራኤልስ እርቦ ማን ይቈጥራል?  የጻድቃንን ሞት እኔ ልሙት፥  ፍጻሜዬም እንደ እርሱ ፍጻሜ ትሁን።

verses.text_english: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed altogether.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓምን። ያደረግህብኝ ምንድር ነው? ጠላቶቼን ትረግምልኝ ዘንድ ጠራሁህ፤ እነሆም፥ ፈጽመህ ባረክሃቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር በአፌ ያደረገውን እናገር ዘንድ አልጠነቀቅምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም። በዚያ ሆነህ ታያቸው ዘንድ፥ እባክህ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሌላ ቦታ ና ዳርቻቸውንም ብቻ ታያለህ፥ ሁሉን ግን አታይም፤ በዚያም ሆነህ እነርሱን ርገምልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on altar.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጾፊምም ሜዳ ወደ ፈስጋ ተራራ ራስ ላይ ወሰደው፤ ሰባትም መሠዊያዎች ሠራ፥ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈን አንድም አውራ በግ አሳረገ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet yonder.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅንም። እኔ ወደዚያ ለመገናኘት ስሄድ በዚህ በመሥዋዕትህ ዘንድ ቆይ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በለዓምን ተገናኘ፥ ቃልንም በአፉ አድርጎ። ወደ ባላቅ ተመለስ፥ እንዲህም በል አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም መጣ፥ እነሆም፥ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር የሞዓብ አለቆች በመሥዋዕቱ ዘንድ ቆመው ነበር፤ ባላቅም። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  ባላቅ ሆይ፥ ተነሣ፥ ስማ፤  የሴፎር ልጅ ሆይ፥ አድምጠኝ፤

verses.text_english: God not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do ? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰትን ይናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሰው አይደለም፥  ይጸጸትም ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ አይደለም።  እርሱ ያለውን አያደርገውምን?  የተናገረውንስ አይፈጽመውምን?

verses.text_english: Behold, I have received to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ለመባረክ ትእዛዝን ተቀብያለሁ፤  እርሱ ባርኮአል፥ እመልሰውም ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.text_english: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God with him, and the shout of a king among them.
verses.text_amharic: በያዕቆብ ላይ ክፋትን አልተመለከተም፥  በእስራኤልም ጠማምነትን አላየም፤  አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥  የንጉሥም እልልታ በመካከላቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ አውጥቶአቸዋል፤  ጕልበቱ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ነው።

verses.text_english: Surely no enchantment against Jacob, neither any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.text_amharic: በያዕቆብ ላይ አስማት የለም፥  በእስራኤልም ላይ ምዋርት የለም፤  በጊዜው ስለ ያዕቆብና ስለ እስራኤል።  እግዚአብሔር ምን አደረገ! ይባላል።

verses.text_english: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ እንስት አንበሳ ይቆማል፥  እንደ አንበሳም ይነሣል፤  ያደነውን አስኪበላ፥  የገደለውንም ደሙን እስኪጠጣ አይተኛም።

verses.text_english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓምን። ከቶ አትርገማቸው፥ ከቶም አትባርካቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም መልሶ ባላቅን። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ ብዬ አልተናገርሁህምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓምን። ና፥ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ እወስድሃለሁ፤ ምናልባት በዚህ ሆነህ እነርሱን ትረግምልኝ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይወድዳል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም ምድረ በዳውን ከላይ ወደሚመለከተው ወደ ፌጎር ላይ በለዓምን ወሰደው።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ባላቅን። በዚህ ሰባት መሠዊያዎች ሥራልኝ፥ በዚህም ሰባት ወይፈን ሰባትም አውራ በግ አዘጋጅልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on altar.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም በለዓም እንዳለው አደረገ፥ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረገ።

verses.text_english: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ይባርክ ዘንድ እንዲወድድ ባየ ጊዜ፥ አስቀድሞ ያደርግ የነበረውን አስማት ይሻ ዘንድ አልሄደም፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፊቱን አቀና።

verses.text_english: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ዓይኑን አንሥቶ እስራኤል በየነገዱ ተቀምጦ አየ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በላዩ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውን ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  የቢዖር ልጅ በለዓም እንዲህ ይላል፥  ዓይኖቹ የተከፈቱለት ሰው እንዲህ ይላል፤

verses.text_english: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling , but having his eyes open:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የሚሰማ፥  ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክን ራእይ የሚያይ፥  የወደቀው፥ ዓይኖቹም የተከፈቱለት እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ ድንኳኖችህ፥  እስራኤል ሆይ ማደሪያዎችህ ምንኛ ያምራሉ!

verses.text_english: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሸለቆች፥  በወንዝ ዳር እንዳሉ አትክልቶች፥  እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተከለው እሬት  በውኃም ዳር እንዳሉ ዝግባዎች ተዘርግተዋል።

verses.text_english: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: ከማድጋዎቹ ውኃ ይፈስሳል፥  ዘሩም በብዙ ውኆች ይሆናል፥  ንጉሡም ከአጋግ ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፥ መንግሥቱም ይከበራል።

verses.text_english: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce through with his arrows.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከግብፅ አውጥቶታል፤  ጕልበቱ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ነው፤  ጠላቶቹን አሕዛብን ይበላል፥  አጥንቶቻቸውንም ይሰባብራል፥  በፍላጾቹም ይወጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed he that blesseth thee, and cursed he that curseth thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አንበሳ ዐርፎ ተኝቶአል፥  እንደ እንስቲቱም አንበሳ ተጋድሞአል፤  ማን ያስነሣዋል?  የሚመርቅህ ሁሉ የተመረቀ ይሁን፥  የሚረግምህም ሁሉ የተገመ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed these three times.
verses.text_amharic: የባላቅም ቍጣ በበለዓም ላይ ነደደ፤ እጆቹንም አጨበጨበ፤ ባላቅም በለዓምን። ጠላቶቼን ትረግም ዘንድ ጠራሁህ፥ እነሆም፥ ሦስት ጊዜ ፈጽመህ መረቅሃቸው፤ አሁንም እንግዲህ ወደ ስፍራህ ሽሽ፤

verses.text_english: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አከብርህ ዘንድ ወድጄ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን፥ እነሆ፥ ክብርህን ከለከለ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do good or bad of mine own mind; what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ ሕዝቤ እሄዳለሁ፤ ና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ በኋለኛው ዘመን በሕዝብህ ላይ የሚያደርገውን እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  የቢዖር ልጅ በለዓም እንዲህ ይላል፥  ዓይኖቹም የተከፈቱለት ሰው እንዲህ ይላል፤

verses.text_english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የሚሰማ፥  የልዑልንም እውቀት የሚያውቅ፥  ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክን ራእይ የሚያይ፥  የወደቀው፥ ዓይኖቹም የተከፈቱለት እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, saw the vision of the Almighty, falling , but having his eyes open:
verses.text_amharic: አየዋለሁ፥ አሁን ግን አይደለም፤  እመለከተዋለሁ፥ በቅርብ ግን አይደለም፤  ከያዕቆብ ኮከብ ይወጣል፥  ከእስራኤል በትር ይነሣል፥  የሞዓብንም ማዕዘኖች ይመታል፥  የሤትንም ልጆች ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስም ርስቱ ይሆናል፥  ጠላቱ ሴይር ደግሞ ርስቱ ይሆናል፤  እስራኤልም በኃይል ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብም የሚወጣ ገዥ ይሆናል፥  ከከተማውም የቀሩትን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.text_amharic: አማሌቅንም አይቶ ምሳሌውን ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  አማሌቅ የአሕዛብ አለቃ ነበረ፤  ፍጻሜው ግን ወደ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek the first of the nations; but his latter end that he perish for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቄናውያንንም አይቶ ምሳሌውን ይምስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  ማደሪያህ የጸና ነው፥  ጎጆህም በአምባ ላይ ተሠርቶአል፤

verses.text_english: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አሦር እስኪማርክህ ድረስ ቄናዊው ለጥፋት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሲያደርግ  አወይ! ማን በሕይወት ይኖራል?

verses.text_english: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.text_amharic: ከኪቲም ዳርቻ መርከቦች ይመጣሉ፥  አሦርንም ያስጨንቃሉ፥  ዔቦርንም ያስጨንቃሉ፤  እርሱም ደግሞ ወደ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And ships from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በለዓምም ተነሣ፥ ተመልሶም ወደ ስፍራው ሄደ፤ ባላቅም ደግሞ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በሰጢም ተቀመጡ፤ ሕዝቡም ከሞዓብ ልጆች ጋር ያመነዝሩ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ወደ አምላኮቻቸው መሥዋዕት ጠሩ፤ ሕዝቡም በሉ፥ ወደ አምላኮቻቸውም ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ብዔልፌጎርን ተከተለ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የእግዚአብሔር የቍጣው ጽናት ከእስራኤል እንዲመለስ የሕዝቡን አለቆች ሁሉ ወስደህ በፀሐዩ ፊት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ስቀላቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ዳኞች። እናንተ ሁሉ ብዔልፌጎርን የተከተሉትን ሰዎቻችሁን ግደሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who weeping the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች አንዱ መጥቶ በሙሴና በእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ፊት ምድያማዊቱን አንዲቱን ሴት ወደ ወንድሞቹ አመጣት፤ እነርሱም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ያለቅሱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw , he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.text_amharic: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጅ የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ ባየው ጊዜ ከማኅበሩ መካከል ተነሥቶ በእጁ ጦር አነሣ፤

verses.text_english: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ያንንም የእስራኤልን ሰው ተከትሎ ወደ ድንኳኑ ገባ። እስራኤላዊውንም ሰውና ሴቲቱን ሁለቱን ሆዳቸውን ወጋቸው። ከእስራኤልም ልጆች መቅሠፍቱ ተከለከለ።

verses.text_english: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅሠፍትም የሞተው ሀያ አራት ሺህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.text_amharic: የካህኑ የአሮን ልጅ የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ በቅንዓቴ በመካከላቸው ቀንቶአልና ቍጣዬን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መለሰ፤ እኔም የእስራኤልን ልጆች በቅንዓቴ አላጠፋሁም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሰላሜን ቃል ኪዳን እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላኩም ቀንቶአልና፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አስተስርዮአልና ለእርሱ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ክህነት ቃል ኪዳን ይሆንለታል።

verses.text_english: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, that was slain with the Midianitish woman, Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድያማዊቱም ጋር የተገደለው የእስራኤላዊው ሰው ስም ዘንበሪ ነበረ፤ የአባቱ ቤት አለቃ የስምዖናውያን የሆነ የሰሉ ልጅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he head over a people, of a chief house in Midian.
verses.text_amharic: የተገደለችውም ምድያማዊት ስምዋ ከስቢ ነበረ፤ እርስዋም የሱር ልጅ ነበረች፤ እርሱም በምድያም ዘንድ የአባቱ ቤት ወገን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
verses.text_amharic: በፌጎር በመቅሠፍቱ ቀን ስለተገደለችው ስለ ምድያም አለቃ ልጅ ስለ እኅታቸው ስለ ከስቢ በፌጎር ምክንያት በሸነገሉአችሁ ሽንገላ አስጨንቀዋችኋልና ምድያማውያንን አስጨንቁአቸው ግደሉአቸውም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ መቅሠፍቱ ከሆነ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና የካህኑን የአሮን ልጅ አልዓዛርን።

verses.text_english: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን፥ በእስራኤል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጣውን ሁሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት ቍጠሩ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan Jericho, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛር በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ።

verses.text_english: , from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ከግብፅም ምድር የወጡትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዳዘዛቸው፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን ሕዝቡን ቍጠሩ ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል በኵር ሮቤል፤ የሮቤል ልጆች፤ ከሄኖኅ የሄኖኀውያን ወገን፥ ከፈሉስ የፈሉሳውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.text_amharic: ከአስሮን የአስሮናውያን ወገን፥ ከከርሚ የከርማውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የሮቤላውያን ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ ሦስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.text_amharic: የፈሉስም ልጆች፤ ኤልያብ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This Dathan and Abiram, famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: የኤልያብም ልጆች፤ ነሙኤል፥ ዳታን፥ አቤሮን፤ እነዚህ ዳታንና አቤሮን ከማኅበሩ የተመረጡ ነበሩ፤ ከቆሬ ወገን ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ባመፁ ጊዜ ሙሴንና አሮንን ተጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ወገን በሞተ ጊዜ ምድሪቱ አፍዋን ከፍታ ከቆሬ ጋር ዋጠቻቸው፤ በዚያም ጊዜ እሳቲቱ ሁለት መቶ አምሳውን ሰዎች አቃጠለቻቸው፤ እነርሱም ለምልክት ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
verses.text_amharic: የቆሬ ልጆች ግን አልሞቱም።

verses.text_english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖን ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከነሙኤል የነሙኤላውያን ወገን፥ ከያሚን የያሚናውያን ወገን፥ ከያኪን የያኪናውያን ወገን፥ ከዛራ የዛራውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳኡል የሳኡላውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የስምዖናውያን ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
verses.text_amharic: የጋድ ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከጽፎን የጽፎናውያን ወገን፥ ከሐጊ የሐጋውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
verses.text_amharic: ከሹኒ የሹናውያን ወገን፥ ከኤስናን የኤስናናውያን ወገን፥ ከዔሪ የዔራውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሮድ የአሮዳውያን ወገን፥ ከአርኤሊ የአርኤላውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የጋድ ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Judah Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ልጆች ዔርና አውናን፤ ዔርና አውናንም በከነዓን ምድር ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከሴሎም የሴሎማውያን ወገን፥ ከፋሬስ የፋሬሳውያን ወገን፥ ከዛራ የዛራውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.text_amharic: የፋሬስም ልጆች፤ ከኤስሮም የኤስሮማውያን ወገን፥ ከሐሙል የሐሙላውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የይሁዳ ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ሰባ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: the sons of Issachar after their families: Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
verses.text_amharic: የይሳኮር ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከቶላ የቶላውያን ወገን፥ ከፉዋ የፉዋውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
verses.text_amharic: ከያሱብ የያሱባውያን ወገን፥ ከሺምሮን የሺምሮናውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የይሳኮር ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ስድሳ አራት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.text_amharic: የዛብሎን ወገኖች በየወገናቸው፤ ከሴሬድ የሴሬዳውያን ወገን፥ ከኤሎን የኤሎናውያን ወገን፥ ከያሕልኤል የያሕልኤላውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የዛብሎናውያን ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ስድሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Joseph after their families Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍ ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ምናሴና ኤፍሬም።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead the family of the Gileadites.
verses.text_amharic: የምናሴ ልጆች፤ ከማኪር የማኪራውያን ወገን፤ ማኪርም ገለዓድን ወለደ፤ ከገለዓድ የገልዓዳውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Gilead: Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
verses.text_amharic: የገለዓድ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከኢዔዝር የኢዔዝራውያን ወገን፥ ከኬሌግ የኬሌጋውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: And Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
verses.text_amharic: ከአሥሪኤል የአሥሪኤላውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: And Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴኬም የሴኬማውያን ወገን፥ ከሸሚዳ የሸሚዳውያን ወገን፥ ከኦፌር የኦፌራውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.text_amharic: የኦፌርም ልጅ ሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ የሰለጰዓድም የሴቶች ልጆቹ ስም ማህለህ፥ ኑዓ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ቲርጻ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: These the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የምናሴ ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸው የኤፍሬም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከሱቱላ የሱቱላውያን ወገን፥ ከቤኬር የቤኬራውያን ወገን፥ ከታሐን የታሐናውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: And these the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የሱቱላ ልጆች ናቸው፤ ከዔዴን የዔዴናውያን ወገን። ከዔዴን የዔዴናውያና ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ። በየወገናቸው የዮሴፍ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
verses.text_amharic: የብንያም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከቤላ የቤላውያን ወገን፥ ከአስቤል የአስቤላውያን ወገን፥ ከአኪራን የአኪራናውያን ወገን፥ ከሶፋን የሶፋናውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.text_amharic: ከሑፋም የሑፋማውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: , the family of the Ardites: of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.text_amharic: የቤላም ልጆች፤ አርድና ናዕማን፤ ከአርድ የአርዳውያን ወገን፥ ከናዕማን የናዕማናውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸው የብንያም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ አምስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These the families of Dan after their families.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸው የዳን ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከሰምዔ የሰምዔያውያን ወገን፤ በየወገናቸው የዳን ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: የሰምዔያውያን ወገኖች ሁሉ ከእነርሱ እንደ ተቈጠሩ ስድሳ አራት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.text_amharic: የአሴር ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከዪምና የዪምናውያን ወገን፥ ከየሱዋ የየሱዋውያን ወገን፥ ከበሪዓ የበሪዓውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.text_amharic: ከበሪዓ ልጆች፤ ከሔቤር የሔቤራውያን ወገን፥ ከመልኪኤል የመልኪኤላውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: And the name of the daughter of Asher Sarah.
verses.text_amharic: የአሴርም የሴት ልጁ ስም ሤራሕ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: These the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የአሴር ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
verses.text_amharic: የንፍታሌም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከያሕጽኤል የያሕጽኤላውያን ወገን፥ ከጉኒ የጉናውያን ወገን፥

verses.text_english: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.text_amharic: ከዬጽር የዬጽራውያን ወገን፥ ከሺሌም የሺሌማውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.text_amharic: በየወገናቸው የንፍታሌም ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ልጆች የተቈጠሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ስድስት መቶ አንድ ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነዚህ በየስማቸው ቍጥር ምድሪቱ ርስት ሆና ትከፈላለች።

verses.text_english: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.text_amharic: ለብዙዎቹ እንደ ብዛታቸው፥ ለጥቂቶቹም እንደ ጥቂትነታቸው መጠን ርስትን ትሰጣቸዋለህ። ለሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን ርስታቸው ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ምድሪቱ በዕጣ ትከፈላለች፤ እንደ አባቶቻቸው ነገድ ስም ይወርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.text_amharic: በብዙዎችና በጥቂቶች መካከል ርስታቸው በዕጣ ትከፈላለች።

verses.text_english: And these they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያንም በየወገናቸው የተቈጠሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከጌድሶን የጌድሶናውያን ወገን፥ ከቀዓት የቀዓታውያን ወገን፥ ከሜራሪ የሜራራውያን ወገን።

verses.text_english: These the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የሌዊ ወገኖች ናቸው፤ የሊብናውያን ወገን፥ የኬብሮናውያን ወገን፥ የሞሖላውያን ወገን፥ የሙሳውያን ወገን፥ የቆሬያውያን ወገን። ቀዓትም እንበረምን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the name of Amram's wife Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.text_amharic: የእንበረም ሚስት ስም ዮካብድ ነበረ። እርስዋ በግብፅ ከሌዊ የተወለደች የሌዊ ልጅ ነበረች፤ ለእንበረምም አሮንንና ሙሴን እኅታቸውንም ማርያምን ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮንም ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር ተወለዱለት።

verses.text_english: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሌላ እሳት ባቀረቡ ጊዜ ናዳብና አብዩድ ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንድ ወርም ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉ ወንዶች ሁሉ ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ሦስት ሺህ ነበሩ። ከእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ርስት አልተሰጣቸውምና ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.text_english: These they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan Jericho.
verses.text_amharic: በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት ሲቈጥሩ፥ ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛር የቈጠሩአቸው የእስራኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሙሴና ካህኑ አሮን በሲና ምድረ በዳ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በቈጠሩአቸው ጊዜ ከነበሩት ከእነዚያ መካከል አንድም ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እነርሱ። በእውነት በምድረ በዳ ይሞታሉ ብሎ ተናግሮአልና። ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብ ከነዌም ልጅ ከኢያሱ በቀር ከእነርሱ አንድ ሰው ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.text_amharic: ከዮሴፍ ልጅ ከምናሴ ወገኖች፥ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጅ የኦፌር ልጅ የሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች ቀረቡ፤ የእነዚህም ሴቶች ልጆች ስም ማህለህ፥ ኑዓ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ቲርጻ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በሙሴና በካህኑ በአልዓዛር በአለቆቹም በማኅበሩም ሁሉ ፊት ቆመው።

verses.text_english: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችን በምድረ በዳ ሞተ፤ በራሱ ኃጢአት ሞተ እንጂ ከቆሬ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ላይ በተሰበሰቡ ወገን መካከል አልነበረም፤ ወንዶችም ልጆች አልነበሩትም።

verses.text_english: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድ ልጅስ ባይኖረው የአባታችን ስም ከወገኑ መካከል ለምን ይጠፋል? በአባታችን ወንድሞች መካከል ርስትን ስጠን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ነገራቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረበ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.text_amharic: የሰለጰዓድ ልጆች እውነት ተናግረዋል፤ በአባታቸው ወንድሞች መካከል የርስት ድርሻ ስጣቸው፤ የአባታቸውን ርስት ለእነርሱ አሳልፈህ ስጥ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ሰው ቢሞት ወንድ ልጅም ባይኖረው፥ ርስቱ ለሴት ልጁ ይለፍ፤

verses.text_english: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ልጅም ባትኖረው ርስቱን ለወንድሞቹ ስጡ፤

verses.text_english: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞችም ባይኖሩት ርስቱን ለአባቱ ወንድሞች ስጡ፤

verses.text_english: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቱም ወንድሞች ባይኖሩት ከወገኑ ለቀረበ ዘመድ ርስቱን ስጡ እርሱም ይውረሰው፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደዚህ ወደ ዓባሪም ተራራ ውጣ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች የሰጠኋትን ምድር እይ፤

verses.text_english: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.text_amharic: ባየሃትም ጊዜ ወንድምህ አሮን እንደ ተከማቸ አንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወገንህ ትከማቻለህ።

verses.text_english: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በጺን ምድረ በዳ በማኅበሩ ጠብ በቃሌ ላይ ዐምፃችኋልና፥ በእነርሱም ፊት በውኃው ዘንድ አልቀደሳችሁኝምና። ይህም በጺን ምድረ በዳ በቃዴስ ያለው የመሪባ ውኃ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። መንፈስ ያለበትን ሰው የነዌን ልጅ ኢያሱን ወስደህ እጅህን በላዩ ጫንበት፤

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.text_amharic: በካህኑ በአልዓዛርና በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ፊት አቁመው፥ እነርሱም እያዩ እዘዘው።

verses.text_english: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲታዘዙት ከክብርህ አኑርበት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt put of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.text_amharic: በካህኑም በአልዓዛር ፊት ይቁም፤ እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በኡሪም ፍርድ ይጠይቅለት፤ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በቃሉ ይውጡ፥ በቃሉም ይግቡ።

verses.text_english: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ኢያሱንም ወስዶ በካህኑ በአልዓዛርና በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ፊት አቆመው፤

verses.text_english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ እንደ ተናገረ፥ እጁን በላዩ ጫነበት፥ አዘዘውም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። መብሌን፥ ለእኔ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የተደረገውን ቍርባኔን፥ መባዬን በየጊዜው ታቀርቡልኝ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say unto them, This the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, a continual burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በላቸው። በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት ቍርባን ይህ ነው፤ ለዘወትር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ዕለት ዕለት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.text_amharic: አንዱን ጠቦት በማለዳ፥ ሌላውንም ጠቦት በማታ አቅርብ፤

verses.text_english: And a tenth of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.text_amharic: ለእህልም ቍርባን የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ተወቅጦ በተጠለለ ዘይት የተለወሰ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ታቀርባለህ።

verses.text_english: a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የቀረበ በሲና ተራራ የተሠራ ለዘወትር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the drink offering thereof the fourth of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD a drink offering.
verses.text_amharic: የመጠጡ ቍርባን ለአንድ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛው እጅ ነው፤ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ለእግዚአብሔር ለመጠጥ ቍርባን መጠጥ ታፈስሳለህ።

verses.text_english: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer , a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውንም ጠቦት በማታ ጊዜ ታቀርባለህ፤ የእህሉን ቍርባንና የመጠጡን ቍርባን በማለዳ እንዳቀረብህ በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ታቀርበዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበትም ቀን ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥ ለእህልም ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.text_amharic: በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ሌላ፥ ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ፥ በየሰንበቱ ሁሉ የምታቀርቡት የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.text_amharic: በወሩም መባቻ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ሁለት ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ነውርም የሌለባቸውን ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.text_english: And three tenth deals of flour a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዱም ወይፈን ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለአውራው በግም ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥

verses.text_english: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil a meat offering unto one lamb; a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዱም ጠቦት ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth of an hin unto a lamb: this the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.text_amharic: የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውም ለአንድ ወይፈን የኢን ግማሽ፥ ለአውራው በግም የኢን ሢሶ፥ ለአንዱም ጠቦት የኢን አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ይሆናል፤ ይህ ለዓመቱ የወር መባቻ ሁሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.text_english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ሌላ ይቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And in the fourteenth day of the first month the passover of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ነው።

verses.text_english: And in the fifteenth day of this month the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በዓል ይሆናል ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: In the first day an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work :
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆናል፤ በእርሱም የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.text_english: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.text_amharic: በእሳትም የተደረገውን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፤ ነውር የሌለባቸው ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And their meat offering flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.text_amharic: የእህል ቍርባናቸውንም በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለአንድ ወይፈን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአውራውም በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.text_english: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባቱም ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And one goat a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.text_amharic: ማስተስረያ የሚሆንላችሁን አንድ አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which for a continual burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ማልዶ ከሚቀርበው በዘወትር ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሌላ እነዚህን ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የሚደረገውን የቍርባኑን መብል ሰባት ቀን በየዕለቱ እንዲሁ ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ሌላ ይቀርባል።

verses.text_english: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.text_english: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks , ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ በበኵራት ቀን ከሰባቱ ሱባዔ በዓላችሁ አዲሱን የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ባቀረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆንላችኋል፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.text_english: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.text_english: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
verses.text_amharic: ለእህል ቍርባናቸው በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለእያንዳንዱ ወይፈን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.text_english: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባቱም ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
verses.text_amharic: ማስተስረያ የሚሆንላችሁን አንድ አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall offer beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.text_amharic: በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ሌላ እነርሱንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ነውርም የሌለባቸው ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ወር ከወሩ በመጀመሪያ ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት፤ መለከቶች የሚነፉበት ቀን ነው።

verses.text_english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.text_english: And their meat offering flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, two tenth deals for a ram,
verses.text_amharic: ለእህል ቍርባናቸው በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለወይፈኑ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአውራው በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.text_english: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባቱ ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And one kid of the goats a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
verses.text_amharic: ማስተስረያም የሚሆንላችሁን አንድ አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በወሩ መባቻ ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን፥ በዘወትርም ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን፥ ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ፥ እንደ ሕጋቸው ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And ye shall have on the tenth of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work :
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ከሰባተኛው ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ ሰውነታችሁን አስጨንቁት፤ ከሥራ ሁሉ ምንም አታድርጉ።

verses.text_english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ነውር የሌለባቸው ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And their meat offering flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, two tenth deals to one ram,
verses.text_amharic: ለእህል ቍርባናቸውም በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለወይፈኑ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአውራው በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.text_english: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባቱ ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ፥

verses.text_english: One kid of the goats a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል አቅርቡ። ከሚያስተሰርየው ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ በዘወትርም ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን፥ ከመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውም ሌላ አቅርቡት።

verses.text_english: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
verses.text_amharic: ከሰባተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት፥ ሰባት ቀንም ለእግዚአብሔር በዓል አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አሥራ ሦስት ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች አቅርቡ፤ ነውር የሌለባቸውም ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And their meat offering flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
verses.text_amharic: ለእህል ቍርባናቸውም በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለአሥራ ሦስት ወይፈኖች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለሁለቱ አውራ በጎች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.text_english: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
verses.text_amharic: ለአሥራ አራቱ ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ፥

verses.text_english: And one kid of the goats a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And on the second day twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ቀን አሥራ ሁለት ወይፈኖችን፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎችን፥ ነውር የሌለባቸው አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶችን፥

verses.text_english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the manner:
verses.text_amharic: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.text_english: And one kid of the goats a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየልን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባናቸው ሌላ የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን አሥራ አንድ ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.text_english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the manner:
verses.text_amharic: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.text_english: And one goat a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
