verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰን በባሳን መንገድ ወጣን፥ የባሳን ንጉሥ ዐግም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በኤድራይ ሊዋጉን ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። እርሱንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ምድሩንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼአለሁና አትፍራው፤ በሐሴቦን ይኖር በነበረው በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎን ላይ እንዳደረግህ በእርሱም ታደርግበታለህ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ በእጃችን አሳልፎ ሰጠን፤ እኛም መታነው፤ አንድ ሰው እንኳ አምልጦ አልቀረለትም።

verses.text_english: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ከተሞቹን ሁሉ ወሰድን፤ አንድም ያልወሰድነው የለም፤ በባሳን ያለውን የዐግን መንግሥት፥ የአርጎብን አገር ሁሉ፥ ስድሳ ከተሞችን ወሰድን።

verses.text_english: All these cities fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.text_amharic: በቅጥር ካልተመሸጉት ከእጅግ ብዙ ከተሞች ሌላ፥ እነዚህ ከተሞች ሁሉ ቁመቱ ረጅም በሆነ ቅጥር በመዝጊያና በመወርወሪያም የተመሸጉ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.text_amharic: በሐሴቦንም ንጉሥ በሴዎን እንዳደረግን ፈጽሞ አጠፋናቸው፤ ከተሞቹን ሁሉ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ከሕፃናቶችም ጋር አጠፋናቸው።

verses.text_english: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.text_amharic: ከብቶቹን ሁሉ የከተሞቹንም ምርኮ ለእኛ በዘበዝን።

verses.text_english: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን ከአርኖን ሸለቆ ጀምሮ እስከ አርሞንዔም ተራራ ድረስ ምድሪቱን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከነበሩ ከሁለቱ ከአሞራውያን ነገሥታት እጅ ወሰድን፤

verses.text_english: ( Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.text_amharic: ሲዶናውያን አርሞንዔምን ሢርዮን ብለው ይጠሩታል፥ አሞራውያንም ሳኔር ብለው ይጠሩታል።

verses.text_english: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳውም ያሉትን ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ገለዓድንም ሁሉ፥ በባሳንም ያሉትን የዐግን መንግሥት ከተሞች እስከ ሰልካና እስከ ኤድራይ ድረስ ባሳንን ሁሉ ወሰድን።

verses.text_english: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead a bedstead of iron; it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.text_amharic: ከራፋይም ወገን የባሳን ንጉሥ ዐግ ብቻውን ቀርቶ ነበር፤ እነሆ፥ አልጋው የብረት አልጋ ነበረ፤ እርሱ በአሞን ልጆች አገር በነበረባት አለ፤ ርዝመቱ ዘጠኝ ክንድ ወርዱም አራት ክንድ በሰው ክንድ ልክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And this land, we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችንም ምድር በዚያን ዘመን ወረስን፤ በአርኖንም ሸለቆ አጠገብ ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ የገለዓድን ተራራማ አገር እኩሌታ ከተሞቹንም ለሮቤልና ለጋድ ነገድ ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.text_amharic: ከገለዓድም የቀረውን የዐግንም መንግሥት ባሳንን ሁሉ፥ የአርጎብንም ምድር ሁሉ ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ ሰጠሁ፤ ያችም ባሳን ሁሉ የራፋይም አገር ተብላ ተቈጠረች።

verses.text_english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: የምናሴ ልጅ ኢያዕር እስከ ጌሹራውያንና እስከ ማዕካታውያን ዳርቻ ድረስ የአርጎብን ምድር ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ይህችንም የባሳንን ምድር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በስሙ የኢያዕር መንደሮች ብሎ ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.text_amharic: ለማኪርም ገልዓድን ሰጠሁት።

verses.text_english: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.text_amharic: ለሮቤል ነገድና ለጋድም ነገድ ከገለዓድ ጀምሮ እስከ አርኖን ሸለቆ ድረስ የሸለቆውን እኩሌታ ዳርቻውንም፥ እስከ አሞን ልጆች ዳርቻ እስከ ያቦቅ ወንዝ ድረስ፥

verses.text_english: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
verses.text_amharic: ከኪኔሬት እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር እርሱም የጨው ባሕር ድረስ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ወደ ምሥራቅ ያለውን ዓረባ ዮርዳኖስንም ዳሩንም ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all meet for the war.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን እንዲህ ብዬ አዘዝኋችሁ። አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ይህችን ምድር ርስት አድርጎ ሰጥቶአችኋል፤ መሣሪያችሁን ይዛችሁ እናንተ አርበኞች ሁሉ በወንድሞቻችሁ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ትሻገራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, ( I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እጅግ ከብቶች እንዳሉአችሁ አውቃለሁና ሴቶቻችሁና ልጆቻችሁ ከብቶቻችሁም በሰጠኋችሁ ከተሞች ይቀመጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም እግዚአብሔር እናንተን እንዳሳረፈ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁን እስኪያሳርፍ ድረስ እነርሱም ደግሞ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጣቸውን ምድር እስኪወርሱ ድረስ ነው፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እናንተ ሁሉ ወደ ሰጠኋችሁ ርስት ትመለሳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ኢያሱን። አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በሁለቱ ነገሥት ያደረገውን ሁሉ ዓይኖችህ አይተዋል፤ እንዲሁ በምታልፍባቸው መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ስለ እናንተ ይዋጋልና አትፍራቸውም ብዬ አዘዝሁት።

verses.text_english: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን እኔ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብዬ ለመንሁ።

verses.text_english: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ታላቅነትህን የጸናችውንም እጅህን ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ማሳየት ጀምረሃል፤ በሰማይና በምድርም እንደ ሥራህ እንደ ኃይልህም ይሠራ ዘንድ የሚችል አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ልሻገር በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ያለችውን መልካሚቱን ምድር ያንም መልካሙን ተራራማውን አገር ሊባኖስንም ልይ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን በእናንተ ምክንያት ተቈጣኝ አልሰማኝምም፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። ይበቃሃል፤ በዚህ ነገር ደግመህ አትናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ዮርዳኖስን አትሻገርምና ወደ ፈስጋ ራስ ውጣ፤ ዓይንህንም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ ሰሜንም ወደ ደቡብም ወደ ምሥራቅም አንሥተህ በዓይንህ ተመልከት።

verses.text_english: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱ በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት ይሻገራልና፥ አንተም የምታያትን ምድር እርሱ ያወርሳቸዋልና ኢያሱን እዘዘው፥ አደፋፍረውም፥ አጽናውም።

verses.text_english: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
verses.text_amharic: በቤተፌጎርም ፊት ለፊት በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀመጥን።

verses.text_english: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do , that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንድታደርጉአቸው በሕይወትም እንድትኖሩ፥ የአባቶቻችሁም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣችሁ ምድር ገብታችሁ እንድትወርሱ፥ የማስተምራችሁን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ያዘዝኋችሁን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ትጠብቃላችሁ እንጂ ባዘዝኋችሁ ቃል ላይ አትጨምሩም፥ ከእርሱም አታጎድሉም።

verses.text_english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.text_amharic: ብዔልፌጎርን የተከተሉትን ሰዎች ሁሉ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከመካከላችሁ እንዳጠፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር በብዔልፌጎር ያደረገውን ዓይኖቻችሁ አይተዋል።

verses.text_english: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God alive every one of you this day.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን የተከተላችሁ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሁላችሁ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እናንተ ገብታችሁ በምትወርሱአት ምድር ውስጥ እንዲህ ታደርጉ ዘንድ አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘኝ ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን አስተማርኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: Keep therefore and do ; for this your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation a wise and understanding people.
verses.text_amharic: ጠብቁአት አድርጉአትም፤ ይህችን ሥርዓት ሁሉ ሰምተው። በእውነት ይህ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ጠቢብና አስተዋይ ሕዝብ ነው በሚሉ በአሕዛብ ፊት ጥበባችሁና ማስተዋላችሁ ይህ ነውና፤

verses.text_english: For what nation great, who God nigh unto them, as the LORD our God in all we call upon him ?
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በምንጠራው ጊዜ ሁሉ እንደሚቀርበን፥ አምላኩ ወደ እርሱ የቀረበው ታላቅ ሕዝብ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: And what nation great, that hath statutes and judgments righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.text_amharic: በዓይናችሁ ፊት ዛሬ እንደማኖራት እንደዚህች ሕግ ሁሉ ጽድቅ የሆነች ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ያለው ታላቅ ሕዝብ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and they may teach their children.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ቀርባችሁ ከተራራው በታች ቆማችሁ ነበር፤ እስከ ሰማይም መካከል ድረስ አሳት በተራራው ላይ ይነድድ ነበር፤ ጨለማና ደመና ድቅድቅ ጨለማም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ ተናገራችሁ፤ የቃልን ድምፅ ሰማችሁ፥ መልክ ግን አላያችሁም፤ ድምፅን ብቻ ሰማችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only a voice.
verses.text_amharic: ታደርጉትም ዘንድ ያዘዛችሁን ቃል ኪዳን አሥሩን ቃላት ነገራችሁ፤ በሁለቱም በድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ ጻፋቸው።

verses.text_english: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.text_amharic: ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ተሻግራችሁ በምትገቡባት ምድር የምታደርጉአትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ አስተምራችሁ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር በዚያን ጊዜ አዘዘኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ በተናገራችሁ ጊዜ መልክ ከቶ አላያችሁምና እጅግ ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.text_english: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.text_amharic: እንዳትረክሱ፥ የተቀረጸውን ምስል የማናቸውንም ነገር ምሳሌ፥ በወንድ ወይም በሴት መልክ የተሠራውን፥

verses.text_english: Lest ye corrupt , and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ያለውን የእንስሳን ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ በሰማይም በታች የሚበርረውን የወፍን ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥

verses.text_english: The likeness of any beast that on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ላይ የሚሽከረከረውን ሁሉ ምሳሌ፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ውስጥ የሚኖረውን የዓሣን ሁሉ ምሳሌ እንዳታደርጉ፥

verses.text_english: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችህን ወደ ሰማይ አንሥተህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ሁሉ በታች ላሉት አሕዛብ ሁሉ የሰጣቸውን ፀሐይንና ጨረቃን ከዋክብትንና የሰማይን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ባየህ ጊዜ፥ ሰግደህላቸው አምልከሃቸውም እንዳትስት ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተን ግን እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ የርስቱ ሕዝብ ትሆኑለት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ወስዶ ከብረት እቶን ከግብፅ አወጣችሁ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእናንተ ምክንያት ተቈጣኝ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም እንዳልሻገር፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ርስት አድርጎ ወደሚሰጥህ ወደ መልካሚቱ ምድር እንዳልገባ ማለ።

verses.text_english: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee an inheritance:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በዚህች ምድር እሞታለሁ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም አልሻገርም፤ እናንተ ግን ትሻገራላችሁ፥ ያችንም መልካሚቱን ምድር ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር የተማማለውን ቃል ኪዳን እንዳትረሱ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር የከለከለውን በማናቸውም ቅርጽ የተቀረጸውን ምስል እንዳታደርጉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, the likeness of any , which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የሚበላ እሳት ቀናተኛም አምላክ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For the LORD thy God a consuming fire, a jealous God.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችን የልጅ ልጆችንም፥ በወለዳችሁ ጊዜ በምድሪቱም ብዙ ዘመን በተቀመጣችሁ ጊዜ፥ በረከሳችሁም ጊዜ፥ በማናቸውም ቅርጽ የተቀረጸውን ምስል ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ፥ ታስቈጡትም ዘንድ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን ነገር በሠራችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt , and make a graven image, the likeness of any , and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.text_amharic: ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ ከምትገቡባት ምድር ፈጥናችሁ እንድትጠፉ እኔ ዛሬ ሰማይንና ምድርን በእናንተ አስመሰክራለሁ፤ ፈጽሞም ትጠፋላችሁ እንጂ ረጅም ዘመን አትቀመጡባትም።

verses.text_english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በአሕዛብ መካከል ይበትናችኋል፥ እግዚአብሔር በውስጣቸው በሚያኖራችሁ በአሕዛብ መካከልም ጥቂቶች ሆናችሁ ትቀራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የማያዩትን የማይሰሙትንም የማይበሉትንም የማያሸቱትንም፥ በሰው እጅ ከእንጨትና ከድንጋይ የተሠሩትን አማልክት ታመልካላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከዚያ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትሻላችሁ፤ በልብህም ሁሉ በነፍስህም ሁሉ የፈለግኸው እንደ ሆነ ታገኘዋለህ።

verses.text_english: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሁሉ በደረሰብህ ጊዜ፥ ስትጨንቅ፥ በዘመኑ ፍጻሜ ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትመለሳለህ፥ ቃሉንም ትሰማለህ።

verses.text_english: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መሐሪ አምላክ ነውና አይተውህም፥ አያጠፋህምም፥ ለአባቶችህም የማለላቸውን ቃል ኪዳኑን አይረሳም።

verses.text_english: (For the LORD thy God a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሰውን በምድር ላይ ከፈጠረው ጀምሮ፥ ከሰማይ ዳር እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ከቶ እንዲህ ያለ ታላቅ ነገር ወይም እንደ እርሱ ያለ ተሰምቶ እንደሆነ ከአንተ በፊት የነበረውን የቀደመውን ዘመን ጠይቅ።

verses.text_english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been as this great thing , or hath been heard like it?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ከእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ ሲናገር የእግዚአብሔርን ድምፅ እንደ ሰማህ፥ ሌላ ሕዝብ ሰምቶ በሕይወት ይኖራልን?

verses.text_english: Did people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር በዓይናችሁ ፊት በግብፅ ለእናንተ እንደ ሠራው ሁሉ፥ በፈተናና በተአምራት፥ በድንቅና በሰልፍ፥ በጸናች እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ በታላቅም ማስፈራት እግዚአብሔር ከሌላ ሕዝብ መካከል ገብቶ ለእርሱ ሕዝብን ይወስድ ዘንድ ሞክሮ ነበርን?

verses.text_english: Or hath God assayed to go take him a nation from the midst of nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አምላክ እንደ ሆነ ታውቅ ዘንድ ይህ ለአንተ ተገለጠ፤ ከእርሱም ሌላ አምላክ የለም።

verses.text_english: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he God; none else beside him.
verses.text_amharic: ያስተምርህ ዘንድ ከሰማይ ድምፁን አሰማህ፤ በምድርም ላይ ታላቁን እሳት አሳየህ፤ ከእሳትም ውስጥ ቃሉን ሰማህ።

verses.text_english: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሌላም እንደሌለ ዛሬ እወቅ፥ በልብህም ያዝ።

verses.text_english: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou , to bring thee in, to give thee their land an inheritance, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ መልካም ይሆን ዘንድ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም በሚሰጥህ ምድር ዕድሜህ ይረዝም ዘንድ፥ እኔ ዛሬ የማዝዝህን ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዙን ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Know therefore this day, and consider in thine heart, that the LORD he God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: none else.

Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞቹም ለሮቤል ነገድ በምድረ በዳ በደልዳላ ስፍራ ያለ ቦሶር፥ ለጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ያለ ራሞት፥ ለምናሴም ነገድ በባሳን ያለ ጎላን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ያኖራት ሕግ ይህች ናት፤

verses.text_english: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.text_amharic: የእርሱንና የባሳንን ንጉሥ የዐግን ምድር፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩትን የሁለቱን የአሞራውያንን ነገሥታት ምድር፥

verses.text_english: And this the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: በአርኖን ወንዝ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ እስከ ሲዎን ተራራ እስከ አርሞንዔም ድረስ፥

verses.text_english: These the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከፈስጋ ተራራ በታች ያለውን ዓረባ ሁሉ እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር ድረስ ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ሁሉ ጠርቶ አላቸው። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንድትማሩአት በማድረግም እንድትጠብቁአት ዛሬ በጆሮአችሁ የምናገራትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ስሙ።

verses.text_english: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ ከእኛ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, us, who all of us here alive this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ በዚህ በሕይወት ካለነው ከእኛ ከሁላችን ጋር እንጂ ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ይህችን ቃል ኪዳን አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.text_amharic: በተራራው ላይ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ለፊት ተናገራችሁ።

verses.text_english: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እነግራችሁ ዘንድ በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔርና በእናንተ መካከል ቆሜ ነበር፤ እናንተ በእሳቱ ምክንያት ፈርታችኋልና፥ ወደ ተራራውም አልወጣችሁምና። እርሱም አለ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not make thee graven image, any likeness that in heaven above, or that in the earth beneath, or that in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.text_amharic: በላይ በሰማይ ካለው፥ በታችም በምድር ካለው፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ካለው ነገር የማናቸውንም ምሳሌ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ለአንተ አታድርግ፤

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth of them that hate me,
And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላክህን ስም በከንቱ አትጥራ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስሙን በከንቱ የሚጠራውን ከበደል አያነጻውምና።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እንዳዘዘህ የሰንበትን ቀን ትቀድሰው ዘንድ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ቀን ሥራ ተግባርህንም ሁሉ አድርግ፥

verses.text_english: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛው ቀን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ሰንበት ነው፤ አንተ እንደምታርፍ ሎሌህና ገረድህ ያርፉ ዘንድ፥ አንተ ወንድ ልጅህም ሴት ልጅህም ሎሌህም ገረድህም በሬህም አህያህም ከብትህም ሁሉ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ያለ እንግዳ በእርሱ ምንም ሥራ አትሥሩ።

verses.text_english: But the seventh day the sabbath of the LORD thy God: thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በግብፅ ባሪያ እንደ ነበርህ አስብ፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በጸናች እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ ከዚያ አወጣህ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ የሰንበትን ቀን ትጠብቅ ዘንድ አዘዘህ።

verses.text_english: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እንዳዘዘህ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ በሚሰጥህ ምድር ላይ ዕድሜህ እንዲረዝም፥ መልካምም እንዲሆንልህ።

verses.text_english: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.text_amharic: አትግደል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.text_amharic: አታመንዝር።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.text_amharic: አትስረቅ።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.text_amharic: በባልንጀራህ ላይ በሐሰት አትመስክር።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: የባልጀራህን ሚስት አትመኝ፤ የባልንጀራህንም ቤት እርሻውንም ሎሌውንም ገረዱንም በሬውንም አህያውንም፥ ከባልንጀራህ ገንዘብ ሁሉ ማናቸውንም አትመኝ።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any that thy neighbour's.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በተራራው ላይ በእሳትና በደመናው በጨለማውም ውስጥ ሆኖ በታላቅ ድምፅ እነዚህን ቃሎች ለጉባኤአችሁ ሁሉ ተናገረ፤ ምንም ምን አልጨመረም። በሁለቱም የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ላይ ጻፋቸው፥ ለእኔም ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ተራራው በእሳት ሲነድድ ከጨለማው ውስጥ ድምፁን በሰማችሁ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ፥ የነገዶቻችሁ አለቆች ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም፥ ወደ እኔ ቀረባችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.text_amharic: አላችሁም። እነሆ፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ክብሩንና ታላቅነቱን አሳይቶናል፥ ከእሳቱም ውስጥ ድምፁን ሰምተናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከሰው ጋር ሲነጋገር ሰውዮውም በሕይወት ሲኖር ዛሬ አይተናል።

verses.text_english: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ይህች ታላቂቱ እሳት ታቃጥለናለችና ለምን እንሞታለን? እኛ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ድምፅ ደግሞ ብንሰማ እንሞታለን።

verses.text_english: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.text_amharic: ከሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ እኛ እንደ ሰማን በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ ሲናገር የሕያው አምላክን ድምፅ ሰምቶ በሕይወቱ የኖረ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: For who all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we , and lived?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ቅረብ፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር የሚለውን ሁሉ ስማ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ለአንተ የሚናገረውን ሁሉ ለእኛ ንገረን፤ እኛም ሰምተን እናደርገዋለን።

verses.text_english: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear , and do .
verses.text_amharic: በተናገራችሁኝም ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር የእናንተን ቃል ጽምፅ ሰማ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ። ይህ ሕዝብ የተናገሩህን ቃል ድምፅ ሰምቼአለሁ፤ የተናገሩህ ሁሉ መልካም ነገር ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም ለዘላለምም ለልጆቻቸው መልካም ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ፥ እንዲፈሩኝ ሁልጊዜም ትእዛዜን ሁሉ እንዲጠብቁ እንዲህ ያለ ልብ ምነው በሆነላቸው!

verses.text_english: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.text_amharic: ሄደህ። ወደ ድንኳናችሁ ተመለሱ በላቸው።

verses.text_english: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን በዚህ በእኔ ዘንድ ቁም፥ ርስት አድርጌ በምሰጣቸውም ምድር ላይ ያደርጉአት ዘንድ የምታስተምራቸውን ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ፍርዴንም ሁሉ እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንዳዘዛችሁ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ፤ ከእርሱም ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም ፈቀቅ አትበሉ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ፥ መልካምም እንዲሆንላችሁ፥ በምትወርሱአትም ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ እንዲረዝም፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ባዘዛችሁ መንገድ ሁሉ ሂዱ።

verses.text_english: Now these the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ልጅህም የልጅ ልጅህም በዕድሜአችሁ

verses.text_english: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ልትወርሱአት በምትገቡባት ምድር ታደርጉአት ዘንድ፥ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ፈርተህ እኔ ለአንተ ያዘዝሁትን ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዙን ሁሉ ትጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ ዕድሜህም ይረዝም ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንዳስተምራችሁ ያዘዛት ትእዛዝና ሥርዓት ፍርድም ይህች ናት።

verses.text_english: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do ; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ፥ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ መልካምም እንዲሆንልህ፥ የአባቶችህም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ ወተትና ማር በምታፈስሰው ምድር እጅግ እንድትበዛ፥ ታደርጋት ዘንድ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God one LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አንድ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ በፍጹምም ኃይልህ ውደድ።

verses.text_english: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ዛሬ አንተን የማዝዘውን ይህን ቃል በልብህ ያዝ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.text_amharic: ለልጆችህም አስተምረው፥ በቤትህም ስትቀመጥ፥ በመንገድም ስትሄድ፥ ስትተኛም፥ ስትነሣም ተጫወተው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: በእጅህም ምልክት አድርገህ እሰረው፤ በዓይኖችህም መካከል እንደክታብ ይሁንልህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.text_amharic: በቤትህም መቃኖች በደጃፍህም በሮች ላይ ጻፈው።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ለአንተ ሊሰጣት ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፤ ያልሠራሃቸውንም ታላቅና መልካም ከተሞች፥

verses.text_english: And houses full of all good , which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.text_amharic: ያልሞላሃቸውንም ሀብትን የሞሉ ቤቶች፥ ያልማስሃቸውንም የተማሱ ጕድጓዶች፥ ያልተከልሃቸውንም ወይንና ወይራ በሰጠህ ጊዜ፥ በበላህና በጠገብህም ጊዜ፤

verses.text_english: beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳትረሳ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፤ እርሱንም አምልክ፤ በስሙም ማል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which round about you;
(For the LORD thy God a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በማሳህ እንደ ፈተናችሁት አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አትፈታተኑት።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted in Massah.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ ያዘዘውን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ምስክሩንም ሥርዓቱንም አጥብቃችሁ ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
And thou shalt do right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
verses.text_amharic: በኋለኛው ዘመንም ልጅህ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ያዘዛችሁ ምስክርና ሥርዓት ፍርድስ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ በጠየቀህ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ልጅህን በለው። በግብፅ የፈርዖን ባሪያዎች ነበርን፤ እግዚአብሔርም በጽኑ እጅ ከግብፅ አወጣን፤

verses.text_english: when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከግብፅና በፈርዖን በቤቱም ሁሉ ላይ እኛ እያየን ታላቅና ክፉ ምልክት ተአምራትም አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቶቻችን ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር አግብቶ እርስዋን ይሰጠን ዘንድ ከዚያ አወጣን።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ዛሬም በሕይወት እንዲያኖረን፥ ሁልጊዜም መልካም እንዲሆንልን፥ አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንፈራ ዘንድ፥ ይህችንም ሥርዓት ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አዘዘን።

verses.text_english: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዳዘዘን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እናደርጋት ዘንድ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብንጠብቅ ለእኛ ጽድቅ ይሆንልናል።

verses.text_english: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ልትወርሳት ወደምትገባባት ምድር ባመጣህ ጊዜ፥ ከፊትህም ብዙ አሕዛብን፥ ከአንተ የበለጡትን የበረቱትንም ሰባቱን አሕዛብ፥ ኬጢያዊውን ጌርጌሳዊውንም አሞራዊውንም ከነዓናዊውንም ፌርዛዊውንም ኤዊያዊውንም ኢያቡሳዊውንም ባወጣ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም በእጅህ አሳልፎ በሰጣቸው በመታሃቸውም ጊዜ፥ ፈጽመህ አጥፋቸው፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርግ፥ አትማራቸውም፤

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር አትጋባ፤ ሴት ልጅህን ለወንድ ልጁ አትስጥ፥ ሴት ልጁንም ለወንድ ልጅህ አትውሰድ።

verses.text_english: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይከተለኝ ሌሎችንም አማልክት እንዲያመልክ ልጅህን ያስታልና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ ይነድድባችኋል፥ ፈጥኖም ያጠፋችኋል።

verses.text_english: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንዲህ አድርጉባቸው፤ መሠዊያቸውን አፍርሱ፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብሩ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቻቸውንም ቍረጡ፥ የተቀረጸውን ምስላቸውንም በእሳት አቃጥሉ።

verses.text_english: For thou an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that upon the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር አንተ ቅዱስ ሕዝብ ነህና፤ በምድር ፊት ከሚኖሩ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይልቅ ለእርሱ ለራሱ ሕዝብ ትሆንለት ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መረጠህ።

verses.text_english: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye the fewest of all people:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የወደዳችሁና የመረጣችሁ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ በቍጥር ስለ በዛችሁ አይደለም፤ እናንተ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ነበራችሁና፤

verses.text_english: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ስለ ወደዳችሁ ለአባቶቻችሁም የማለላቸውን መሐላ ስለ ጠበቀ፥ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በጽኑ እጅ አወጣችሁ፥ ከባርነትም ቤት ከግብፅ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን እጅ አዳናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.text_amharic: አንተም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ለሚወድዱትም ትእዛዙንም ለሚጠብቁ ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምሕረቱን እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ድረስ የሚጠብቅ የታመነ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ እወቅ፤

verses.text_english: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጠሉትን ለማጥፋት በፊታቸው ብድራት ይመልስባቸዋል፤ ለሚጠላው አይዘገይም፥ ነገር ግን በፊቱ ብድራት ይመልስበታል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ታደርጋት ዘንድ እኔ ዛሬ ለአንተ የማዝዛትን ትእዛዝና ሥርዓት ፍርድንም ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ይህችን ፍርድ ሰምተህ ብትጠብቃት ብታደርጋትም፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶችህ የማለውን ቃል ኪዳንና ምሕረት ለአንተ ይጠብቅልሃል፤

verses.text_english: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.text_amharic: ይወድድህማል፥ ይባርክህማል፥ ያበዛህማል፤ ይሰጥህም ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ በማለላቸው ምድር የሆድህን ፍሬ የመሬትህንም ፍሬ፥ እህልህን ወይንህንም ዘይትህንም፥ የከብትህንም ብዛት የበግህንም መንጋ ይባርክልሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ ይልቅ የተባረክህ ትሆናለህ፤ በሰውህና በከብትህም ዘንድ ወንድ ቢሆን ወይም ሴት ብትሆን መካን አይሆንብህም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all that hate thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሕማምን ሁሉ ከአንተ ያርቃል፤ የምታውቀውንም ክፉውን የግብፅ በሽታ ሁሉ በአንተ ላይ አያደርስብህም፥ በጠላቶችህም ሁሉ ላይ ያመጣባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that a snare unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በእጅህ አሳልፎ የሚጥላቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ታጠፋቸዋለህ፤ ዓይንህም አታዝንላቸውም፤ ያም ወጥመድ ይሆንብሃልና አማልክቶቻቸውን አታምልካቸው።

verses.text_english: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.text_amharic: በልብህም። እነዚህ አሕዛብ ከእኔ ይልቅ ይበዛሉና አወጣቸው ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ? ብትል፥ አትፍራቸው፤

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በፈርዖንና በግብፅ ሁሉ ያደረገውን፥

verses.text_english: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር፥ ዓይንህ እያየች፥ ታላቅን መቅሠፍት ምልክትንም ተአምራትንም የጸናችውን እጅ የተዘረጋውንም ክንድ አድርጎ እንዳወጣህ፥ አስብ፤ እንዲሁ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር አንተ በምትፈራቸው በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የቀሩት ከፊትህም የተሸሸጉት እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ተርብ ይሰድድባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God among you, a mighty God and terrible.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር፥ ታላቅና የሚያስፈራ አምላክ፥ በመካከልህ ነውና ከእነርሱ የተነሣ አትደንግጥ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አሕዛብ በጥቂት በጥቂቱ ከፊትህ ያወጣቸዋል፤ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት እንዳይበዙብህ አንድ ጊዜ ታጠፋቸው ዘንድ አይገባህም።

verses.text_english: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ግን እነርሱን በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸዋል፥ እስኪጠፉም ድረስ በታላቅ ድንጋጤ ያስደነግጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሥታቶቻቸውንም በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸዋል፥ ስማቸውንም ከሰማይ በታች ታጠፋለህ፤ እስክታጠፋቸው ድረስ ማንም በፊትህ ይቆም ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold on them, nor take unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it an abomination to the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀረጸውንም የአምላኮቻቸውን ምስል በእሳት ታቃጥላለህ፤ የተሠራባቸውን ብርና ወርቅ አትመኝ፤ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ርኩስ ነውና እንዳትጠመድበት ከእርሱ ምንም አትውሰድ።

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it a cursed thing.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እርሱም ርጉም እንዳትሆን ርኩስን ነገር ወደ ቤትህ አታግባ፤ ርጉም ነውና ተጸየፈው፥ ጥላውም።

verses.text_english: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ፥ እንድትበዙም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶቻችሁ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ገብታችሁ እንድትወርሱአት፥ ዛሬ ለአንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, to prove thee, to know what in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይፈትንህ ዘንድ፥ በልብህም ያለውን ትእዛዙን ትጠብቅ ወይም አትጠብቅ እንደሆነ ያውቅ ዘንድ፥ ሊያስጨንቅህ በእነዚህ በአርባ ዓመታት በምድረ በዳ የመራህን መንገድ ሁሉ አስብ።

verses.text_english: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ በሚወጣ ነገር ሁሉ በሕይወት እንዲኖር እንጂ ሰው በእንጀራ ብቻ በሕይወት እንዳይኖር ያስታውቅህ ዘንድ አስጨነቀህ፥ አስራበህም፥ አንተም ያላወቅኸውን አባቶችህም ያላወቁትን መና አበላህ።

verses.text_english: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ አርባ ዓመታት የለበስኸው ልብስ አላረጀም፥ እግርህም አላበጠም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ልጁን እንደሚገሥፅ እንዲሁም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር አንተን እንዲገሥጽ በልብህ አስተውል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገዱም እንድትሄድ እርሱንም እንድትፈራ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መልካም ምድር፥ ከሸለቆና ከኮረብታ የሚመነጩ የውኃ ጅረቶችና ፈሳሾች ምንጮችም ወዳሉባት ምድር፥

verses.text_english: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.text_amharic: ስንዴ ገብስም ወይንም በለስም ሮማንም ወይራም ማርም ወደ ሞሉባት ምድር፥

verses.text_english: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any in it; a land whose stones iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.text_amharic: ሳይጎድልህ እንጀራን ወደምትበላባት አንዳችም ወደማታጣባት ምድር፥ ድንጋይዋ ብረት ወደ ሆነ፥ ከተራራዋም መዳብ ወደሚማስባት ምድር ያገባሃል።

verses.text_english: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.text_amharic: ትበላማለህ፥ ትጠግብማለህ፥ ስለሰጠህም ስለመልካሚቱ ምድር አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትባርካለህ።

verses.text_english: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ እኔ አንተን የማዝዘውን ትእዛዙንና ፍርዱን ሥርዓቱንም ባለመጠበቅ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳትረሳ ተጠንቀቅ፤

verses.text_english: Lest thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt ;
verses.text_amharic: ከበላህና ከጠገብህ በኋላ፥ መልካምም ቤት ሠርተህ ከተቀመጥህበት በኋላ፥

verses.text_english: And thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.text_amharic: የላምና የበግ መንጋ ከበዛልህ በኋላ፥ ብርህና ወርቅህም ያለህም ሁሉ ከበዛልህ በኋላ፥ ልብህ እንዳይጓደድ፤

verses.text_english: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅም ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣህን፥

verses.text_english: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.text_amharic: እባብና ጊንጥ ጥማትም ባለባት፥ ውኃም በሌለባት፥ በታላቂቱና በምታስፈራው ምድረ በዳ የመራህን፥ ከጭንጫ ድንጋይም ውኃን ያወጣልህን፥

verses.text_english: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.text_amharic: በመጨረሻም ዘመን መልካም ያደርግልህ ዘንድ ሊፈትንህ ሊያዋርድህም አባቶችህ ያላወቁትን መና በምድረ በዳ ያበላህን አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳትረሳ፤

verses.text_english: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.text_amharic: በልብህም። ጉልበቴ የእጄም ብርታት ይህን ሀብት አመጣልኝ እንዳትል።

verses.text_english: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ለአባቶችህ የማለውን ቃል ኪዳን ያጸና ዘንድ፥ ሀብት ለማከማቸት እርሱ ጉልበት ሰጥቶሃልና አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን አስብ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህንም እግዚአብሔርን ብትረሳ፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት ብትከተል ብታመልካቸውም ብትሰግድላቸውም፥ ፈጽሞ እንድትጠፉ እኔ ዛሬውኑ እመሰክርባችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስላልሰማችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከፊታችሁ እንደሚያጠፋቸው እንደ አሕዛብ እንዲሁ እናንተ ትጠፋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O Israel: Thou to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ከአንተ የበለጡትንና የበረቱትን አሕዛብ፥ እስከ ሰማይም ድረስ የተመሸጉትን ታላላቆች ከተሞች ለመውረስ ትገቡ ዘንድ ዛሬ ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገረዋለህ።

verses.text_english: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and thou hast heard , Who can stand before the children of Anak!
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የምታውቃቸው ስለ እነርሱም። በዔናቅ ልጆች ፊት መቆም ማን ይችላል? ሲባል የሰማኸው ታላቁና ረጅሙ ሕዝብ የዔናቅ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God he which goeth over before thee; a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር እንደሚበላ እሳት ሆኖ በፊትህ እንዲያልፍ ዛሬ እወቅ፤ እርሱ ያጠፋቸዋል፥ በፊትህም ያዋርዳቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ነገረህ አንተ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ፥ ፈጥነህም ታጠፋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ ካወጣቸው በኋላ። ስለ ጽድቄ እወርሳት ዘንድ ወደዚች ምድር እግዚአብሔር አገባኝ ስትል በልብህ አትናገር፤ እነዚህን አሕዛብ ስለ ኃጢአታቸው እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ ያወጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸውን ትወርሳት ዘንድ የምትገባው ስለ ጽድቅህና ስለ ልብህ ቅንነት አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከፊትህ በሚያጠፋቸው በእነዚያ አሕዛብ ኃጢአት ምክንያትና ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም የማለላቸውን ቃል ይፈጽም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou a stiffnecked people.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አንተ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ነህና አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይህችን መልካም ምድር ርስት አድርጎ የሰጠህ ስለ ጽድቅህ እንዳይደለ እወቅ።

verses.text_english: Remember, forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በምድረ በዳ እንዳስቈጣኸው፤ ከግብፅ አገር ከወጣህበት ቀን ጀምሮ ወደዚህ ስፍራ እስከ መጣችሁ ድረስ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ እንዳመፃችሁ አስብ፥ አትርሳ።

verses.text_english: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
verses.text_amharic: በኮሬብ ደግሞ እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሊያጠፋችሁ ተቈጣባችሁ።

verses.text_english: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
verses.text_amharic: የድንጋዩን ጽላቶች፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር የተማማለባቸውን የቃል ኪዳን ጽላቶች፥ እቀበል ዘንድ ወደ ተራራ በወጣሁ ጊዜ፥ በተራራው አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ተቀምጬ ነበር፤ እንጀራ አልበላሁም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣሁም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእግዚአብሔር ጣት የተጻፋትን ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ሰጠኝ፤ ስብሰባ ተደርጎ በነበረበትም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በተራራው ላይ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ የነገራችሁ ቃል ሁሉ ተጽፎባቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, the tables of the covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ከአርባ ቀንና ከአርባ ሌሊትም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሁለቱን የድንጋይ ጽላቶች፥ የቃል ኪዳኑን ጽላቶች፥ ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ተነሥተህ ከዚህ ፈጥነህ ውረድ፤ ከግብፅ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህ ረክሰዋል፤ ፈጥነው ካዘዝኋቸው መንገድ ፈቀቅ ብለዋል፥ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልም ለራሳቸው አድርገዋል አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it a stiffnecked people:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ይህ ሕዝብ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ እንደሆነ አይቼአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.text_amharic: አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ ስማቸውንም ከሰማይ በታች እደመስስ ዘንድ ተወኝ፤ አንተንም ከእነርሱ ለሚበረታና ለሚበዛ ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant in my two hands.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ተመልሼ ከተራራው ወረድሁ፥ ተራራውም በእሳት ይነድድ ነበር፤ ሁለቱም የቃል ኪዳን ጽላቶች በሁለቱ እጆቼ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
verses.text_amharic: ተመለከትሁም፤ እነሆ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን በድላችሁ ነበር፥ ለእናንተም ቀልጦ የተሠራ የጥጃ ምስል ሠርታችሁ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር ካዘዛችሁ መንገድ ፈጥናችሁ ፈቀቅ ብላችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ጽላቶች ያዝሁ፥ ከሁለቱም እጆቼ ጣልኋቸው፥ እናንተም ስታዩ ሰበርኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ሊያጠፋው እጅግ ተቈጣው፤ ስለ አሮንም ደግሞ በዚያን ጊዜ ጸለይሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.text_amharic: ያደረጋችሁትንም ኃጢአት ጥጃውን ወሰድሁ፥ በእሳትም አቃጠልሁት፥ አደቀቅሁትም፥ እንደ ትቢያም እስኪሆን ድረስ ፈጨሁት፤ ትቢያውንም ከተራራ በሚወርድ ወንዝ ጣልሁት።

verses.text_english: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, ground very small, until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.text_amharic: በተቤራም በማሳህም በምኞት መቃብርም እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣችሁት።

verses.text_english: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ውጡ የሰጠኋችሁንም ምድር ውረሱ ብሎ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በላካችሁ ጊዜ፥ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ዐመፃችሁ፥ በእርሱም አላመናችሁም፥ ድምፁንም አልሰማችሁም።

verses.text_english: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተን ካወቅሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ በእግዚአብሔር ዓመፀኞች ነበራችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። አጠፋችኋለሁ ብሎ ስለ ተናገረ በወደቅሁበት ዘመን አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down ; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እንዲህ ብዬ ጸለይሁ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ በታላቅነትህ የተቤዠኸውን፥ በጠነከረችውም እጅ ከግብፅ ያወጣኸውን ሕዝብህንና ርስትህን አታጥፋ።

verses.text_english: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎችህን አብርሃምንና ይስሐቅን ያዕቆብንም አስብ፤ የዚህን ሕዝብ ደንዳንነት ክፋቱንም ኃጢአቱንም አትመልከት፤

verses.text_english: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
verses.text_amharic: ከእርስዋ እኛን ያወጣህባት ምድር ሰዎች። እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ወደ ሰጣቸው ምድር ያገባቸው ዘንድ አልቻለምና፥ ጠልቶአቸውማልና ስለዚህ በምድረ በዳ ሊገድላቸው አወጣቸው እንዳይሉ።

verses.text_english: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በታላቅ ኃይልህ በተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህና ርስትህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር። እንደ ፊተኞች ያሉትን ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ጠርበህ ወደ እኔ ወደ ተራራው ውጣ፥ ለአንተም የእንጨት ታቦት ሥራ፤

verses.text_english: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.text_amharic: በሰበርሃቸውም በፊተኞቹ ጽላቶች የነበሩትን ቃሎች በእነዚህ ጽላቶች እጽፋለሁ፥ በታቦቱም ውስጥ ታደርጋቸዋለህ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I made an ark shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ከግራርም እንጨት ታቦትን ሠራሁ፥ እንደ ፊተኞችም ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶች ጠረብሁ፤ ሁለቱንም ጽላቶች በእጄ ይዤ ወደ ተራራው ወጣሁ።

verses.text_english: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ስብሰባ ተደርጎ በነበረበትም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በተራራው ላይ በእሳት ውስጥ ሆኖ የተናገራችሁን አሠርቱን ቃላት ቀድሞ ተጽፈው እንደ ነበረ በጽላቶቹ ላይ ጻፈ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እነርሱን ለእኔ ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሼም ከተራራው ወረድሁ፥ ጽላቶችንም በሠራሁት ታቦት ውስጥ አደረግኋቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘኝ በዚያ ኖሩ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከብኤሮት ብኔያዕቃን ወደ ሞሴራ ተጓዙ፤ በዚያም አሮን ሞተ በዚያም ተቀበረ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ አልዓዛር ካህን ሆነ።

verses.text_english: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ጉድጎዳ ተጓዙ፤ ከጉድጎዳም ወደ ውኃ ፈሳሾች ምድር ወደ ዮጥባታ ተጓዙ።

verses.text_english: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ይሸከም ዘንድ፥ እርሱንም ለማገልገል በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይቆም ዘንድ፥ በስሙም ይባርክ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የሌዊን ነገድ ለየ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ለሌዊ ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ክፍልና ርስት የለውም፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረው እግዚአብሔር ርስቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, the LORD would not destroy thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እንደ ፊተኛው ጊዜ አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት በተራራው ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በዚህ ጊዜ ደግሞ ሰማኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሊያጠፋህ አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ተነሥተህ በሕዝቡ ፊት ተጓዝ፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ልሰጣቸው ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ይግቡ ይውረሱአትም አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ሰማየ ሰማያትም፥ ምድርም በእርስዋም ያለው ሁሉ የአምላክህ የእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens the LORD'S thy God, the earth , with all that therein .
verses.text_amharic: ብቻ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አባቶችህ ደስ ብሎታል፥ እነርሱንም ወድዶአል፤ ከእነርሱም በኋላ እናንተን ዘራቸውን እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል መረጠ።

verses.text_english: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, you above all people, as this day.
Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.text_amharic: ለድሃ አደጉና ለመበለቲቱ ይፈርዳል፥ መብልና ልብስም ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስደተኛውን ይወድዳል።

verses.text_english: For the LORD your God God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በግብፅ አገር ስደተኞች ነበራችሁና ስለዚህ ስደተኛውን ውደዱ።

verses.text_english: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፥ እርሱንም አምልክ፤ ከእርሱም ተጣበቅ፥ በስሙም ማል።

verses.text_english: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችህ ያዩትን እነዚህን ታላላቆች የሚያስፈሩትንም ነገሮች ያደረገልህ እርሱ ክብርህ ነው፥ እርሱም አምላክህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶችህ ሰባ ነፍስ ሆነው ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፤ አሁንም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ብዛትህን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ውደድ፥ ሕጉንም ሥርዓቱንም ፍርዱንም ትእዛዙንም ሁልጊዜ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: And know ye this day: for not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ተግሣጽ፥ ታላቅነቱንም፥ የጸናችም እጁን፥ የተዘረጋውንም ክንዱን፥

verses.text_english: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅም መካከል በንጉሡ በፈርዖንና በአገሩ ሁሉ ላይ ያደረጋትን ተአምራቱንና ሥራውን፥

verses.text_english: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
verses.text_amharic: በተከተሉአችሁም ጊዜ በኤርትራ ባሕር ውኃ እንዳሰጠማቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንዳጠፋቸው፥ በግብፅ ጭፍራ በፈረሶቻቸውም በሰረገሎቻቸውም ያደረገውን፥

verses.text_english: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚህ ስፍራ እስክትመጡ ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ያደረገላችሁን፥

verses.text_english: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ሁሉ መካከል ምድር አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱንና ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ድንኳኖቻቸውንም ለእነርሱም የነበራቸውን ሁሉ በዋጠቻቸው በሮቤል ልጅ በኤልያብ ልጆች በዳታንና በአቤሮን ያደረገውን ላላወቁትና ላላዩት ልጆቻችሁ አልነግራቸውምና እናንተ ዛሬ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ያደረጋትን ታላቂቱን ሥራ ሁሉ ዓይኖቻችሁ አይተዋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
And that ye may prolong days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንድትጠነክሩ፥ ትወርሱአትም ዘንድ ወደምትሻገሩባት ምድር እንድትገቡ እንድትወርሱአትም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለእነርሱና ለዘራቸው ይሰጣት ዘንድ በማለላቸው ወተትና ማርም በምታፈስሰው ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ እንዲረዝም፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
verses.text_amharic: ትወርሳት ዘንድ የምትገባባት ምድር፥ በአትክልት ስፍራ እንደሚዘሩ ዘርህን እንደዘራህባት፥ በእግርህም እንዳጠጣሃት፥ እንደ ወጣህባት እንደ ግብፅ ምድር አይደለችም።

verses.text_english: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, a land of hills and valleys, drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ተሻግራችሁ የምትገቡባት ምድር ኮረብታና ሸለቆ ያለባት አገር ናት፤ በሰማይ ዝናብ ውኃ ትረካለች።

verses.text_english: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የሚጐበኛት አገር ናት፤ ከዓመቱ መጀመሪያ እስከ ዓመቱ መጨረሻ ድረስ የአምላክህ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ሁልጊዜ በእርስዋ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ በፍጹምም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ታመልኩት ዘንድ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዜን ፈጽማችሁ ብትሰሙ፥

verses.text_english: That I will give the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
verses.text_amharic: እህልህን ወይንህንም ዘይትህንም ትሰበስብ ዘንድ በየጊዜው የበልጉን ዝናብና የክረምቱን ዝናብ ለምድራችሁ አወርዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳ ለእንስሶችህ ሣርን እሰጣለሁ፥ ትበላማለህ፥ ትጠግብማለህ።

verses.text_english: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.text_amharic: ልባችሁ እንዳይስት፥ ፈቀቅ እንዳትሉ፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት እንዳታመልኩ፥ እንዳትሰግዱላቸውም፥

verses.text_english: And the LORD'S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ እንዳይነድድባችሁ፥ ዝናብም እንዳይዘንብ ምድሪቱም ፍሬዋን እንዳትሰጥ ሰማይን እንዳይዘጋባችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከሚሰጣችሁ ከመልካሚቱ ምድር ፈጥናችሁ እንዳትጠፉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እነዚህን ቃሎች በልባችሁና በነፍሳችሁ አኑሩ፤ እነርሱንም ለምልክት በእጃችሁ ላይ እሰሩአቸው፥ በዓይኖቻችሁም መካከል እንደክታብ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻችሁንም አስተምሩአቸው፥ በቤትህም ስትቀመጥ፥ በመንገድም ስትሄድ፥ ስትተኛም ስትነሣም አጫውቱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድዱ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ሁሉ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ትጣበቁ ዘንድ፥ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጉአትም፥

verses.text_english: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ ያወጣል፥ ከእናንተም የሚበልጡትን የሚበረቱትንም አሕዛብ ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: የእግራችሁ ጫማ የምትረግጣት ስፍራ ሁሉ ለእናንተ ትሆናለች፤ ከምድረ በዳም ከሊባኖስም ከታላቁም ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ባሕር ድረስ ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተም ፊት ማንም መቆም አይችልም፤ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ እንደ ተናገራችሁ፥ ማስፈራታችሁን ማስደንገጣችሁንም በምትረግጡአት ምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያኖራል።

verses.text_english: There shall no man be able to stand before you: the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ ዛሬ በፊታችሁ በረከትንና መርገምን አኖራለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
verses.text_amharic: በረከትም፥ እኔ ዛሬ ለእናንተ የማዝዘውን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ብትሰሙ፤

verses.text_english: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
verses.text_amharic: መርገምም፥ የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ባትሰሙ፥ ዛሬም ካዘዝኋችሁ መንገድ ፈቀቅ ብትሉ፥ ሌሎችንም የማታውቋቸውን አማልክት ብትከተሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ አንተን ወደምትሄድባት ምድር ባገባህ ጊዜ፥ በረከቱን በገሪዛን ተራራ መርገሙንም በጌባል ተራራ ታኖራለህ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፥ ከፀሐይ መግቢያ ካለችው መንገድ በኋላ፥ በዓረባ በተቀመጡት በከነዓናውያን ምድር፥ በጌልገላ ፊት ለፊት በሞሬ የአድባር ዛፍ አጠገብ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጣችሁን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገራላችሁ፥ ትወርሱአታላችሁም፥ ትቀመጡባታላችሁም።

verses.text_english: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ዛሬ በፊታችሁ የማኖራትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሁሉ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: These the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ በምትኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለመውረስ በሰጣችሁ አገር፥ የምትጠብቁአትና የምታደርጉአት ሥርዓትና ፍርድ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምትወርሱአቸው አሕዛብ አማልክቶቻቸውን ያመለኩባቸውን በረጅም ተራሮች በኮረብቶችም ላይ ከለምለምም ዛፍ በታች ያለውን ስፍራ ሁሉ ፈጽማችሁ አጥፉአቸው፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
verses.text_amharic: መሠዊያቸውንም አፍርሱ፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ሰባብሩ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቻቸውንም በእሳት አቃጥሉ፥ የአማልክቶቻቸውንም የተቀረጹ ምስሎች አንከታክቱ፤ ከዚያም ስፍራ ስማቸውን አጥፉ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላካችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አትሥሩ።

verses.text_english: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከነገዶቻችሁ ሁሉ ስሙን በዚያ ያኖር ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ትመጣላችሁ፥ ማደሪያውንም ትሻላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚያም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን፥ ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁንም፥ አሥራታችሁንም፥ በእጃችሁም ያነሣችሁትን ቍርባን፥ ስእለታችሁንም፥ በፈቃዳችሁ የምታቀርቡትን፥ የላማችሁንና የበጋችሁንም በኵራት ውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ብሉ፥ እጃችሁንም በምትዘረጉበት፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በባረከህ ነገር ሁሉ፥ እናንተና ቤተሰባችሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall not do after all that we do here this day, every man whatsoever right in his own eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ በፊቱ መልካም መስሎ የታየውን፥ እኛ በዚህ ዛሬ የምናደርገውን ሁሉ አታደርጉም፤

verses.text_english: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣችሁ ዕረፍትና ርስት እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አልገባችሁምና።

verses.text_english: But ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
verses.text_amharic: ዮርዳኖስን ግን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ፥ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር በሚያወርሳችሁ ምድር በተቀመጣችሁ ጊዜ፥ ያለ ፍርሃትም እንድትኖሩ ከከበቡአችሁ ጠላቶች ሁሉ ዕረፍት በሰጣችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ስሙ ይጠራበት ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ፥ እኔ የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን፥ ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁንም፥ አሥራታችሁንም፥ በእጃችሁ ያነሣችሁትንም ቍርባን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ተስላችሁ የመረጣችሁትን ስእለታችሁን ሁሉ ውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም፥ ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም፥ ባሪያዎቻችሁም፥ ገረዶቻችሁም፥ ከእናንተ ጋር ክፍልና ርስት ስለሌለው በደጆቻችሁ ውስጥ የተቀመጠው ሌዋዊም በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን በሚታይህ ስፍራ ሁሉ እንዳታቀርብ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ከነገዶችህ ከአንዱ ዘንድ በመረጠው ስፍራ በዚያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን አቅርብ፥ በዚያም የማዝዝህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰጠህ በረከት፥ ሰውነትህ እንደ ፈቀደ፥ በደጆችህ ሁሉ ውስጥ አርደህ ብላ፤ ንጹሕ ሰው ንጹሕም ያልሆነ ሰው እንደ ሚዳቋና እንደ ዋላ ያለውን ይብላው።

verses.text_english: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.text_amharic: ደሙን ግን እንደ ውኃ በምድር ላይ አፍስሰው እንጂ አትብላው።

verses.text_english: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
verses.text_amharic: የእህልህን የወይን ጠጅህን የዘይትህንም አሥራት፥ የላምህንና የበግህንም በኩራት፥ የተሳልኸውንም ስእለት ሁሉ፥ በፈቃድህም ያቀረብኸውን፥ በእጅህም ያነሣኸውን ቍርባን በደጆችህ ውስጥ መብላት አትችልም።

verses.text_english: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንተ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህም፥ ባሪያዎችህና ገረዶችህም፥ በአገርህም ደጅ ያለው ሌዋዊ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በመረጠው ስፍራ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ብሉት፤ እጅህንም በምትዘረጋበት ነገር ሁሉ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይበልህ።

verses.text_english: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርህ ላይ በምትኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሌዋዊውን ቸል እንዳትል ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ነገረህ አገርህን ባሰፋ ጊዜ፥ ሰውነትህም ሥጋ መብላት ስለ ወደደች። ሥጋ ልብላ ስትል፥ እንደ ሰውነትህ ፈቃድ ሥጋን ብላ።

verses.text_english: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በዚያ ስሙን ያኖር ዘንድ የመረጠው ስፍራ ከአንተ ሩቅ ቢሆንም፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሰጠህ ከላምና ከበግ መንጋህ እንዳዘዝሁህ እረድ፥ እንደ ሰውነትህም ፈቃድ ሁሉ በአገርህ ደጅ ውስጥ ብላው።

verses.text_english: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat them alike.
verses.text_amharic: ሚዳቋና ዋላ እንደሚበሉ እንዲሁ ብላው፤ ንጹሕ ሰው ንጹሕም ያልሆነ ይብላው።

verses.text_english: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ደሙ ነፍሱ ነውና፥ ነፍሱንም ከሥጋው ጋር መብላት አይገባህምና ደሙን እንዳትበላ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ እንደ ውኃ አፍስሰው እንጂ አትብላው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም የሆነውን ነገር ስታደርግ ለአንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ መልካም እንዲሆንላችሁ፥ አትብላው።

verses.text_english: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የተቀደሰውን ነገርህን ስእለትህንም ይዘህ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መረጠው ስፍራ ሂድ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕትህን፥ ሥጋውንና ደሙን፥ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ አቅርብ፤ የመሥዋዕትህም ደም በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ይፍሰስ፥ ሥጋውንም ብላው።

verses.text_english: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና ቅን የሆነውን ነገር ስታደርግ ለአንተ ከአንተም በኋላ ለልጆችህ ለዘላለም መልካም ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ እኔ የማዝዝህን እነዚህን ቃሎች ሁሉ ሰምተህ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳቸው ዘንድ የምትሄድባቸውን አሕዛብን በፊትህ ባጠፋ ጊዜ፥ አንተም በወረስሃቸው ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
verses.text_amharic: በምድራቸውም በተቀመጥህ ጊዜ፥ ከፊትህ ከጠፉ በኋላ እነርሱን ለመከተል እንዳትጠመድ። እነዚህስ አሕዛብ አማልክቶቻቸውን ያመለኩት እንዴት ነው? እንዲሁ ደግሞ እኔ አደርጋለሁ ብለህ ስለ አማልክቶቻቸው እንዳትጠይቅ ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የሚጠላውን ርኵሰት ሁሉ እነርሱ ለአማልክቶቻቸው አድርገዋልና፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ደግሞ ለአማልክቶቻቸው በእሳት ያቃጥሉአቸዋልና አንተ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ አታድርግ።

verses.text_english: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የማዝዝህን ነገር ሁሉ ታደርገው ዘንድ ጠብቅ፤ ምንም በእርሱ ላይ አትጨምር፥ ከእርሱም ምንም አታጕድል።

verses.text_english: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
verses.text_amharic: በመካከልህም ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ቢነሣ፥ ምልክትም ተአምራትም ቢሰጥህ፥

verses.text_english: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ነገረህም ምልክቱ ተአምራቱም ቢፈጸም፥ እርሱም። ሄደን የማታውቃቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እንከተል እናምልካቸውም ቢልህ፥

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልባችሁ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ትወድዱት እንደ ሆነ ያውቅ ዘንድ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ሊፈትናችሁ ነውና የዚያን ነቢይ ቃል ወይም ያን ሕልም አላሚ አትስማ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁን አግዚአብሔርን ተከተሉ፥ እርሱንም ፍሩ፥ ትእዛዙንም ጠብቁ፥ ቃሉንም ስሙ፥ እርሱንም አምልኩ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ተጣበቁ።

verses.text_english: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ትሄድባት ዘንድ ካዘዘህ መንገድ ሊያወጣህ፥ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣችሁ ከባርነትም ቤት ካዳናችሁ ከአምላካችሁ ከእግዚአብሔር ሊያስታችሁ ተናግሮአልና ያ ነቢይ ወይም ያ ሕልም አላሚ ይገደል፤ እንዲሁም ክፉውን ነገር ከመካከልህ አርቅ።

verses.text_english: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
, of the gods of the people which round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the end of the earth even unto the end of the earth;
verses.text_amharic: የእናትህ ልጅ ወንድምህ ወይም ወንድ ልጅህ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ ወይም በብብትህ ያለች ሚስትህ ወይም እንደ ነፍስህ ያለ ወዳጅህ በስውር። ና፥ ሄደን ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ወደ አንተ የቀረቡት ከአንተም የራቁት አንተን ከብበውህ ያሉ አሕዛብ ከሚያመልኩአቸው አማልክት፥ አንተም አባቶችህም የማታውቋቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እናምልክ ብሎ ቢያስትህ፥ እሺ አትበለው፥
