verses.text_amharic: የአባቶችህ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠህ፥ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጥህ ምድር ትገባ ዘንድ በተሻገርህ ጊዜ፥ የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ጻፍባቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
verses.text_amharic: ዮርዳኖስንም በተሻገርህ ጊዜ፥ ዛሬ እንዳዘዝሁህ፥ እነዚህን ድንጋዮች በጌባል ተራራ አቁም፥ በኖራም ምረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up iron upon them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሥራ፤ መሠዊያውም ብረት ካልነካው ድንጋይ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:
verses.text_amharic: ካልተጠረበም ድንጋይ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ ሥራ፤ ለአምላክም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን አቅርብበት፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: የደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ሠዋበት፥ በዚያም ብላ፤ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይበልህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
verses.text_amharic: የዚህንም ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ የተገለጠ አድርገህ በድንጋዮቹ ላይ ጻፍ።

verses.text_english: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና ሌዋውያን ካህናት ለእስራኤል ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩ። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ዝም ብላችሁ አድምጡ፤ ዛሬ የአምላክህ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሆነሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላክህም ለእግዚአብሔር ቃል ታዘዝ፥ ዛሬም የማዝዝህን ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በዚያን ቀን እንዲህ ብሎ ሕዝቡን አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.text_amharic: ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ ሕዝቡን ይባርኩ ዘንድ እነዚህ፥ ስምዖንና ሌዊ ይሁዳና ይሳኮር ዮሴፍና ብንያም፥ በገሪዛን ተራራ ላይ ይቁሙ።

verses.text_english: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.text_amharic: ይረግሙም ዘንድ እነዚህ፥ ሮቤልና ጋድ አሴርና ዛብሎን ዳንና ንፍታሌም፥ በጌባል ተራራ ላይ ይቁሙ።

verses.text_english: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንም ከፍ ባለች ድምፅ ለእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed the man that maketh graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth in secret . And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የተጠላ የሠራተኛ እጅ ሥራን የተቀረጸ ወይም ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልን የሚያደርግ፥ በስውርም የሚያቆመው ሰው ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መልሰው አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚያቃልል ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: የባልንጀራውን የድንበር ምልክት የሚገፋ ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውሩን ከመንገድ ፈቀቅ የሚያደርግ ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: በመጻተኛ በድሀ አደጉም በመበለቲቱም ላይ ፍርድን የሚያጣምም ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቱ ሚስት ጋር የሚተኛ የአባቱን ልብስ ገልጦአልና ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ከማናቸይቱም እንስሳ ጋር የሚተኛ ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቱ ወይም ከእናቱ ልጅ ከእኅቱ ጋር የሚተኛ ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ከአማቱ ጋር የሚተኛ ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀራውን በስውር የሚመታ ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: የንጹሑን ሰው ነፍስ ለመግደል ጉቦ የሚቀበል ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that confirmeth not the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text_amharic: የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ያደርግ ዘንድ የማያጸና ርጉም ይሁን፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ብትሰማ፥ ዛሬም ያዘዝሁህን ትእዛዙን ሁሉ ብታደርግ ብትጠብቅም አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርግሃል።

verses.text_english: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክህንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ብትሰማ እነዚህ በረከቶች ሁሉ ይመጡልሃል፤ ያገኙህማል።

verses.text_english: Blessed thou in the city, and blessed thou in the field.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በከተማ ቡሩክ ትሆናለህ፥ በእርሻም ቡሩክ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.text_amharic: የሆድህ ፍሬ፥ የምድርህም ፍሬ፥ የከብትህም ፍሬ፥ የላምህም ርቢ፥ የበግህም ርቢ ቡሩክ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Blessed thy basket and thy store.
verses.text_amharic: እንቅብህና ቡሃቃህ ቡሩክ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Blessed thou when thou comest in, and blessed thou when thou goest out.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በመግባትህ ቡሩክ ትሆናለህ፥ በመውጣትህም ቡሩክ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በላይህ የሚቆሙትን ጠላቶችህን በፊትህ የተመቱ ያደርጋቸዋል፤ በአንድ መንገድ ይመጡብሃል፥ በሰባትም መንገድ ከፊትህ ይሸሻሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በረከቱ በአንተ ላይ በጐተራህ በእጅህም ሥራ ሁሉ እንዲወርድ ያዝዛል፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በሚሰጥህም ምድር ይባርክሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ብትጠብቅ፥ በመንገዱም ብትሄድ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ማለልህ ለእርሱ የተቀደሰ ሕዝብ አድርጎ ያቆምሃል።

verses.text_english: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.text_amharic: የምድር አሕዛብም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ስም በአንተ ላይ እንደ ተጠራ አይተው ይፈሩሃል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እርስዋን ይሰጥህ ዘንድ ለአባቶችህ በማለላቸው በምድርህ ላይ፥ በሆድህ ፍሬ፥ በከብትህ ፍሬ፥ በእርሻህም ፍሬ፥ እግዚአብሔር በጎነቱን በላይህ ያበዛል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለምድርህ በወራቱ ዝናብ ይሰጥ ዘንድ፥ የእጅህንም ሥራ ሁሉ ይባርክ ዘንድ መልካሙን መዝገብ ሰማዩን ይከፍትልሃል፤ ለብዙ አሕዝብም ታበድራለህ፥ አንተ ግን ከማንም አትበደርም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do :
And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, the right hand, or the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ባትሰማ፥ ዛሬም ያዘዝሁህን ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዙን ሁሉ ባትጠብቅ ባታደርግም፥ እነዚህ መርገሞች ሁሉ ይመጡብሃል ያገኙህማል።

verses.text_english: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.text_amharic: በከተማ ርጉም ትሆናለህ፥ በእርሻም ርጉም ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: Cursed thou in the city, and cursed thou in the field.
verses.text_amharic: እንቅብህና ቡሃቃህ ርጉም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Cursed thy basket and thy store.
verses.text_amharic: የሆድህ ፍሬ፥ የምድርህም ፍሬ፥ የላምህም ርቢ፥ የበግህም ርቢ ርጉም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Cursed the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በመግባትህ ርጉም ትሆናለህ፥ በመውጣትህም ርጉም ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: Cursed thou when thou comest in, and cursed thou when thou goest out.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ስለ ተውኸኝ፥ ስለ ሥራህ ክፋት፥ እስክትጠፋ ፈጥነህም እስክታልቅ ድረስ በምትሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር መርገምን፥ ሽሽትን፥ ተግሣጽን ይሰድድብሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ትወርሳት ዘንድ ከምትገባባት ምድር እስኪያጠፋህ ድረስ ቸነፈርን ያጣብቅብሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በክሳት፥ በንዳድም፥ በጥብሳትም፥ በትኲሳትም፥ በድርቅም፥ በዋግም፥ በአረማሞም ይመታሃል፤ እስክትጠፋም ድረስ ያሳድዱሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.text_amharic: በራስህም ላይ ሰማይ ናስ ይሆንብሃል፥ ከእግርህም በታች ምድሪቱ ብረት ትሆንብሃለች።

verses.text_english: And thy heaven that over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee iron.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የምድርህን ዝናብ ትቢያና አፈር ያደርጋል፤ እስክትጠፋ ድረስ ከሰማይ ይወርድብሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከጠላቶችህ ፊት የተመታህ ያደርግሃል፤ በአንድ መንገድ ትወጣባቸዋለህ፥ በሰባት መንገድ ከእነርሱ ትሸሻለህ፤ ለምድርም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ድንጋጤ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ሬሳህ ለሰማይ ወፎች ሁሉ ለምድርም አራዊት መብል ይሆናል፥ የሚያስፈራቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray away.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፈውስ በሌለው በግብፅ ቍስል በእባጭም በቋቁቻም በችፌም ይመታሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በዕብደት፥ በዕውርነት፥ በድንጋጤም ይመታሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.text_amharic: በቀትርም ጊዜ ዕውር በጨለማ እንደሚርመሰመስ ትርመሰመሳለህ፥ መንገድህም የቀና አይሆንም፤ በዘመንህም ሁሉ የተጨነቅህ የተዘረፍህም ትሆናለህ፥ የሚያድንህም የለም።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save .
verses.text_amharic: ሚስት ታጫለህ፥ ሌላም ሰው ከእርስዋ ጋር ይተኛል፤ ቤት ትሠራለህ፥ አትቀመጥበትም፤ ወይን ትተክላለህ፥ ከእርሱም አትበላም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በሬህ በፊትህ ይታረዳል፥ ከእርሱም አትበላም፤ አህያህ ከእጅህ በግድ ይወሰዳል፥ ወደ አንተም አይመለስም፤ በግህ ለጠላቶችህ ትሰጣለች፥ የሚያድንህም አታገኝም።

verses.text_english: Thine ox slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue .
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህ ለሌላ ሕዝብ ይሰጣሉ፥ ዓይኖችህም ያያሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ስለ እነርሱ ሲባክኑ ያልቃሉ፤ በእጅህም ኃይል ምንም አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: Thy sons and thy daughters given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail for them all the day long: and no might in thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: የምድርህን ፍሬ ድካምህንም ሁሉ የማታውቀው ሕዝብ ይበላዋል፤ አንተም ሁልጊዜ የተጨነቅህ የተገፋህም ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችህም ከሚያዩት የተነሣ ዕብድ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፈውስ በሌለው በክፉ ቍስል ጕልበትህንና ጭንህን ከእግርህ ጫማ እስከ አናትህ ድረስ ይመታሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አንተን በአንተም ላይ የምታነግሠውን ንጉሥ አንተና አባቶችህ ወዳላወቃችኋቸው ሕዝብ ይወስድሃል፤ በዚያም ሌሎችን የእንጨትና የድንጋይ አማልክት ታመልካለህ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሚያገባህ በአሕዛብ መካከል ሁሉ ድንጋጤ ምሳሌም ተረትም ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ዘር ወደ እርሻ ታወጣለህ፤ አንበጣም ይበላዋልና ጥቂት ትሰበስባለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.text_amharic: ወይን ትተክላለህ ታበጀውማለህ፤ ትልም ይበላዋልና ከእርሱ ምንም አትሰበስብም፥ የወይን ጠጁንም አትጠጣም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress , but shalt neither drink the wine, nor gather ; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.text_amharic: የወይራ ዛፍ በአገርህ ሁሉ ይሆንልሃል፤ ወይራህም ይረግፋልና ዘይቱን አትቀባም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint with the oil; for thine olive shall cast .
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች ይወለዱልሃል፤ በምርኮም ይሄዳሉና ለአንተ አይሆኑልህም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፍህን ሁሉ የምድርህንም ፍሬ ኩብኩባ ይወርሰዋል።

verses.text_english: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ መካከል ያለ መጻተኛ በአንተ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፥ አንተም ዝቅ ዝቅ ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: The stranger that within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ያበድርሃል፥ አንተ ግን አታበድረውም፤ እርሱ ራስ ይሆናል፥ አንተም ጅራት ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክህንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስላልሰማህ፥ ያዘዘህንም ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን ስላልጠበቅህ፥ እስክትጠፋ ድረስ እነዚህ መርገሞች ሁሉ ይወርዱብሃል፥ ያሳድዱህማል፥ ያገኙሁማል።

verses.text_english: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.text_amharic: በአንተም በልጅ ልጅህም ላይ ለዘላለም ለምልክትና ለድንቅ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን አብዝቶ ስለ ሰጠህ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍሥሐና በሐሤት አላመለክህምና

verses.text_english: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all ;
verses.text_amharic: በራብና በጥማት በዕራቁትነትም ሁሉንም በማጣት እግዚአብሔር ለሚልክብህ ለጠላቶችህ ትገዛለህ፤ እስኪያጠፋህም ድረስ በአንገትህ ላይ የብረት ቀንበር ይጭናል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all : and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.text_amharic: እስክትጠፋ ድረስ የከብትህን ፍሬ የምድርህንም ፍሬ ይበላሉ፤ እስኪያጠፉህም ድረስ እህልን የወይንም ጠጅ ዘይትንም የላምህንና የበግህን ርቢ አይተዉልህም።

verses.text_english: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.text_amharic: በአገርህ ሁሉ ያሉ፥ ትታመንባቸው የነበሩ፥ የረዘሙ የጸኑም ቅጥሮች እስኪፈርሱ ድረስ፥ በከተሞችህ ደጆች ሁሉ ከብበው ያስጭንቁሃል፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በሰጠህ ምድር ሁሉ በደጆች ሁሉ ከብበው ያስጨንቁሃል።

verses.text_english: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which shall not leave thee corn, wine, or oil, the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶችህም ከብበው ባስጨነቁህና መከራ ባሳዩህ ጊዜ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጥህን የሆድህን ፍሬ የወንዶችና የሴቶች ልጆችህን ሥጋ ትበላለህ።

verses.text_english: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ዘንድ የተለሳለሰና በቅምጥልነት ሁልጊዜ ይኖር የነበረ ሰው በወንድሙ፥ አቅፋውም በምትተኛ በሚስቱ፥ በቀሩትም ልጆች ይቀናል፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.text_amharic: በደጆችህ ሁሉ ውስጥ ጠላቶችህ ከብበው ባስጨነቁህና መከራ ባሳዩህ ጊዜ ሌላ ነገር የቀረው የለምና ከሚበላው ከልጆቹ ሥጋ ለአንዱ አይሰጥም።

verses.text_english: the man tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ዘንድ ያለችው የተለሳለሰችና በቅምጥልነት ሁልጊዜ ትኖር የነበረችው፥ ከልስላሴና ከቅምጥልነት የተነሣ የእግር ጫማዋን በምድር ላይ ያላደረገችው ሴት፥ አቅፋ በተኛችው ባልዋ፥

verses.text_english: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.text_amharic: በወንድና በሴት ልጅዋም፥ በእግርዋ መካከል በሚወጣው በእንግዴ ልጅ፥ በምትወልዳቸውም ልጆች ትቀናለች፤ በደጆችህም ውስጥ ጠላቶችህ ከብበው ባስጨነቁህና መከራ ባሳዩህ ጊዜ ሁሉን ስላጣች በስውር ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፉትን የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ታደርግ ዘንድ ባትጠብቅ፥ ይህንንም <<አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር>> የተባለውን የተመሰገነውንና የተፈራውን ስም ባትፈራ፥

verses.text_english: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መቅሠፍትህን፥ የዘርህንም መቅሠፍት፥ ብዙ ዘመንም የሚኖረውን ታላቅ መቅሠፍት፥ ብዙ ዘመን የሚኖረውንም ክፉ ደዌ ያደርግብሃል።

verses.text_english: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.text_amharic: የፈራኸውንም የግብፅ ደዌ ሁሉ እንደ ገና ያመጣብሃል፥ ይጣበቅብህማል።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ይህ ሕግ ባለበት መጽሐፍ ውስጥ ያልተጻፈውን ደዌ ሁሉ መቅሠፍትም ሁሉ እስክትጠፋ ድረስ እግዚአብሔር ያመጣብሃል።

verses.text_english: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማችሁምና ከብዛታችሁ የተነሣ እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት የነበረው ቍጥራችሁ ጥቂት ሆኖ ይቀራል።

verses.text_english: Also every sickness, and every plague, which not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በጎ ያደርግላችሁ ዘንድ ያበዛችሁም ዘንድ ደስ ይለው እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ሲያጠፋችሁ ሲያፈርሳችሁም ደስ ይለዋል፤ ትወርሱአትም ዘንድ ከምትገቡባት ምድር ትነቀላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከምድር ዳር እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ ወዳሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይበትንሃል፤ በዚያም አንተና አባቶችህ ያላወቃችኋቸውን ሌሎችን አማልክት፥ እንጨትንና ድንጋይን፥ ታመልካለህ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚያም አሕዛብ መካከል ዕረፍት አታገኝም፥ ለእግርህም ጫማ ማረፊያ አይሆንም፤ በዚያም እግዚአብሔር ተንቀጥቃጭ ልብ፥ ፈዛዛ ዓይን፥ ደካማም ነፍስ ያመጣብሃል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, wood and stone.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስህም ታመነታለች፤ ሌሊትና ቀንም ትፈራለህ፥ በሕይወትህም አትታመንም፤

verses.text_english: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ስለ ፈራህበት ስለ ልብህ ፍርሃት፥ በዓይንህም ስለምታየው አስተያየት፥ ማለዳ። መቼ ይመሻል? ትላለህ፤ ማታም። መቼ ይነጋል? ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ተመልሰህ አታያትም ባልሁህ መንገድም እግዚአብሔር በመርከብ ወደ ግብፅ ይመልስሃል፤ በዚያም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎች ትሆኑአቸው ዘንድ ለጠላቶቻችሁ ራሳችሁን ትሸጣላችሁ፤ የሚገዛችሁም አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: These the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ ካደረገው ቃል ኪዳን ሌላ በሞዓብ ምድር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር ያደርገው ዘንድ ሙሴን ያዘዘው የቃል ኪዳኑ ቃሎች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሁሉ ጠርቶ አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር በፊታችሁ በግብፅ ምድር በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ በምድሩም ሁሉ ያደረገውን ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቻችሁ ያዩአቸውን ታላላቆች ፈተናዎች፥ ታላላቆች ተአምራትና ድንቆች፥ አይታችኋል፤

verses.text_english: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን አስተዋይ ልብ፥ የሚያዩ ዓይኖች፥ የሚሰሙም ጆሮች እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አልሰጣችሁም።

verses.text_english: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.text_amharic: አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ መራኋችሁ፤ ልብሳችሁም አላረጀባችሁም፥ ጫማችሁም በእግራችሁ ላይ አላረጀም።

verses.text_english: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ እንጀራ አልበላችሁም፥ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክረውን መጠጥ አልጠጣችሁም።

verses.text_english: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚህም ስፍራ በመጣችሁ ጊዜ የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ሴዎን የባሳንም ንጉስ ዐግ ሊወጉን ወጡብን፥ እኛም መታናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸውንም ወስደን ለሮቤልና ለጋድ ለምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ ርስት አድርገን ሰጠናቸው።

verses.text_english: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በምታደርጉት ሁሉ ትከናወኑ ዘንድ የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃሎች ጠብቁ አድርጉም።

verses.text_english: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, all the men of Israel,
Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ይህን ቃል ኪዳንና ይህን መሐላ የማደርገው ከእናንተ ጋር ብቻ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዛሬ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከእኛ ጋር በዚህ ከሚቆም ሰው ጋር፥ ዛሬም ከእኛ ጋር በዚህ ከሌለ ሰው ጋር ነው እንጂ፤

verses.text_english: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እኛ በግብፅ ምድር እንደ ተቀመጥን በመካከላቸውም ባለፋችሁባቸው አሕዛብ መካከል እንዳለፍን አውቃችኋልና፥

verses.text_english: But with that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with that not here with us this day:
verses.text_amharic: ርኩስነታቸውንም በእነርሱም ዘንድ የነበሩትን የእንጨትና የድንጋይ የብርና የወርቅም ጣዖቶቻቸውን አይታችኋልና፥

verses.text_english: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.text_amharic: ሄዶ የእነዚያን አሕዛብ አማልክት ያመልክ ዘንድ ከአምላኩ ከእግዚአብሔር ልቡን ዛሬ የሚያስት ወንድ ወይም ሴት ወይም ወገን ወይም ነገድ አይኑርባችሁ፤ ሐሞትና እሬትም የሚያበቅል ሥር አይሁንባችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which among them:)
verses.text_amharic: የዚህንም እርግማን ቃሎች የሰማ ሰው። ምንም እንኳ በልቤ ደንዳንነት ብሄድ፥ ለጥማቴም ስካር ብጨምር፥ ሰላም ይሆንልኛል ብሎ ሰውነቱን በልቡ የሚባርክ ቢኖር፥

verses.text_english: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ቅንዓቱም በዚያ ሰው ላይ ይጤሳል እንጂ እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ አያደርግለትም፤ በዚህም መጽሐፍ የተጻፈው እርግማን ሁሉ በላዩ ይኖራል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ስሙን ከሰማይ በታች ይደመስሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በዚህ ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው እንደ ቃል ኪዳኑ እርግማን ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ ለጥፋት ይለየዋል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የሚነሣ ትውልድ ከእናንተም በኋላ የሚሆኑ ልጆቻችሁ ከሩቅ አገርም የሚመጣ እንግዳ፥ የዚህን አገር መቅሠፍት፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእርስዋ ያደረገውን ሥቃይዋን፥

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም በሁለንተናዋ ዲንና ጨው መቃጠልም እንደ ሆነባት፥ እንዳትዘራም እንዳታበቅልም፥ ማናቸውም ሣርና ልምላሜም እንዳይወጣባት፥ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣውና በመዓቱ እንደ ገለባበጣቸው እንደ ሰዶምና ገሞራ እንደ አዳማና እንደ ሲባዮ እንደ ሆነች ባዩ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህች ምድር ስለ ምን እንደዚህ አደረገ? ይህስ የቍጣው ታላቅ መቅሠፍት ምንድር ነው? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: the whole land thereof brimstone, and salt, burning, it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም እንዲህ ይላሉ። የአባቶቻቸው አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣቸው ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ጋር ያደረገውን ቃል ኪዳን ስለተዉ፥

verses.text_english: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what the heat of this great anger?
verses.text_amharic: ሄደውም የማያውቋቸውንና ያልታዘዙትን ሌሎችን አማልክት ስላመለኩና ስለ ሰገዱላቸው፥

verses.text_english: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን መርገም ሁሉ ያወርድባት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በዚህች ምድር ነደደ፤

verses.text_english: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and he had not given unto them:
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬም እንዳሉ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣና በመቅሠፍት በታላቅም መዓት ከምድራቸው ነቀላቸው፥ ወደ ሌላም ምድር ጣላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.text_amharic: ምሥጢሩ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የተገለጠው ግን የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ እናደርግ ዘንድ ለእኛ ለዘላለምም ለልጆቻችን ነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እኔ በፊትህ ያኖርሁት ይህ ነገር ሁሉ፥ በረከቱና መርገሙ፥ በወረደብህ ጊዜ፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር በሚበትንህ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ሆነህ በልብህ ባሰብኸው ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አምላክህም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሰህ እኔ ዛሬ እንደማዝዝህ ሁሉ አንተና ልጆችህ በፍጹም ልብና በፍጹም ነፍስ ለቃሉ በታዘዝህ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ምርኮህን ይመልሳል ይራራልህማል፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር አንተን ከበተነበት ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል መልሶ ይሰበስብሃል።

verses.text_english: If of thine be driven out unto the outmost of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችህም እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ ድረስ ፈልሰው እንደ ሆነ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከዚያ ይሰበስብሃል፥ ከዚያም ያመጣሃል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶችህም ወደ ወረሱአት ምድር አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ያጋባሃል፥ ትወርሳትማለህ፤ መልካምም ያደርግልሃል፥ ከአባቶችህም ይልቅ ያበዛሃል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወትም እንድትኖር፥ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ እንድትወድድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ልብህን የዘርህንም ልብ ይገርዛል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ይህችን መርገም ሁሉ በጠላቶችህና በሚጠሉህ በሚያሳድዱህም ላይ ያመጣታል።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ተመልሰህ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ትሰማለህ፥ ዛሬም እኔ የማዝዝህን ትእዛዙን ሁሉ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ዛሬ የማዝዝህ ይህች ትእዛዝ ከባድ አይደለችም፥ ከአንተም የራቀች አይደለችም።

verses.text_english: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it not hidden from thee, neither it far off.
verses.text_amharic: ሰምተን እናደርጋት ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ወደ ሰማይ ወጥቶ እርስዋን የሚያመጣልን ማን ነው? እንዳትል በሰማይ አይደለችም።

verses.text_english: It not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.text_amharic: ሰምተን እናደርጋት ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ባሕሩን ተሻግሮ እርስዋን የሚያመጣልን ማን ነው? እንዳትል ከባሕሩ ማዶ አይደለችም።

verses.text_english: Neither it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ታደርገው ዘንድ ቃሉ በአፍህና በልብህ ውስጥ ለአንተ እጅግ ቅርብ ነው።

verses.text_english: But the word very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልከት፤ ዛሬ በፊትህ ሕይወትንና መልካምነትን፥ ሞትንና ክፋትን አኑሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወትም እንድትኖር እንድትባዛም፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ልትወርሳት በምትገባባት ምድር እንዲባርክህ፥ አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድድ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ትሄድ ዘንድ ትእዛዙንና ሥርዓቱን ፍርዱንም ትጠብቅ ዘንድ ዛሬ እኔ አዝዝሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: ልብህ ግን ቢስት አንተም ባትሰማ፥ ብትታለልም፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት ብትሰግድ ብታመልካቸውም፥

verses.text_english: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.text_amharic: ፈጽማችሁ እንድትጠፉ እኔ ዛሬ እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግረህ ትወርሳት ዘንድ በምትገባባት ምድር ዘመናችሁን አታስረዝሙም።

verses.text_english: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, ye shall not prolong days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: በፊታችሁ ሕይወትንና ሞትን በረከትንና መርገምን እንዳስቀመጥሁ እኔ ዛሬ ሰማይንና ምድርን በአንተ ላይ አስመሰክራለሁ፤ እንግዲህ አንተና ዘርህ በሕይወት ትኖሩ ዘንድ ሕይወትን ምረጥ፤

verses.text_english: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለአባቶችህ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም እንዲሰጣቸው በማለላቸው በምድሪቱ ትቀመጥ ዘንድ፥ እርሱ ሕይወትህ የዘመንህም ርዝመት ነውና አምላክህን እግዚአብሔርን ትወድደው ትጠባበቀውም ቃሉንም ትሰማ ዘንድ ምረጥ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ሄዶ ይህንን ቃል ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ነገረ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, I an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: አላቸውም። እኔ ዛሬ መቶ ሀያ ዓመት ሆኖኛል፤ ከዚህ በኋላ እወጣና እገባ ዘንድ አልችልም፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ይህን ዮርዳኖስን አትሻገርም ብሎኛል።

verses.text_english: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ በፊትህ ያልፋል፤ እርሱ እነዚህን አሕዛብ ከፊትህ ያጠፋቸዋል ትወርሳቸውማለህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ ኢያሱ በፊትህ ይሻገራል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ባጠፋቸው በአሞራውያን ነገሥታት በሴዎንና በዐግ በምድራቸውም እንዳደረገ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በፊታችሁ አሳልፎ ይጥላቸዋል፥ እንዳዘዝኋችሁም ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታደርጉባቸዋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጽኑ፥ አይዞአችሁ፥ አትፍሩ፥ ከፊታቸውም አትደንግጡ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ከአንተ ጋር ይሄዳል፤ አይጥልህም፥ አይተውህም።

verses.text_english: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ኢያሱን ጠርቶ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት። አንተ ከዚህ ሕዝብ ጋር እግዚአብሔር ለአባቶቻቸው እንዲሰጥ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ትገባለህና፥ እርስዋንም ለእነርሱ ታወርሳለህና ጽና፥ አይዞህ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD, he that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.text_amharic: በፊትህም የሚሄድ እርሱ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፥ አይጥልህም፥ አይተውህም፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ይህችን ሕግ ጻፈ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ይሸከሙ ለነበሩት ለሌዊ ልጆች ለካህናቱ ለእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው። በሰባተኛው ዓመት መጨረሻ፥ በዕዳ ምሕረት ዘመን፥ በዳስ በዓል፥

verses.text_english: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሁሉ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታይ ዘንድ እርሱ በመረጠው ስፍራ ሲከማች፥ ይህን ሕግ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት በጆሮው አንብበው።

verses.text_english: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.text_amharic: ይሰሙና ይማሩ ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁንም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈሩ ዘንድ፥ የዚህንም ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ጠብቀው ያደርጉ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ሕፃናቶችንም በአገራችሁ ደጅ ያለውንም መጻተኛ ሰብስብ።

verses.text_english: And their children, which have not known , may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: የሕግ ቃላት የማያውቁ ልጆቻቸውም ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ ልትወርሱአት በምትሄዱባት ምድር በምትኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ ይስሙ፥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርንም መፍራት ይማሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የምትሞትበት ቀን፥ እነሆ፥ ቀረበ፤ ኢያሱን ጠርተህ እርሱን አዝዘው ዘንድ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ከእርሱ ጋር ቁም አለው። ሙሴና ኢያሱም ሄደው በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በድንኳኑ ውስጥ በደመና ዓምድ ተገለጠ፤ የደመናውም ዓምድ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ላይ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። እነሆ፥ ከአባቶችህ ጋር ትተኛለህ፤ ይህም ሕዝብ ይነሣል፥ ይቀመጥባትም ዘንድ በሚሄድባት ምድር መካከል ያሉትን ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከትሎ ያመነዝራል፥ እኔንም ይተወኛል፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን ያፈርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God not among us?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ቍጣዬ ይነድድባቸዋል፥ እተዋቸውማለሁ፥ ፊቴንም እሰውርባቸዋለሁ፥ ለአሕዛብ መብል ይሆናሉ፤ በዚያም ቀን። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር በእኛ መካከል የለምና ይህ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አገኘን እስኪሉ ድረስ ብዙ ክፉ ነገርና ጭንቀት ይደርስባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከትለዋልና ስላደረጉት ክፋት ሁሉ እኔ በዚያ ቀን ፈጽሜ ፊቴን እሰውራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ይህችን መዝሙር ለእናንተ ጻፉ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አስተምሩአቸው፤ ይህችም መዝሙር በእስራኤል ላይ ምስክር ትሆንልኝ ዘንድ በአፋቸው አድርጓት።

verses.text_english: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ማልሁላቸው፥ ወተትና ማር ወደ ምታፈስሰው ምድር ካገባኋቸው በኋላ፥ ከበሉም ከጠገቡም ከደነደኑም በኋላ፥ ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከትለው ያመልካሉ፥ እኔንም ይንቃሉ፥ ቃል ኪዳኔንም ያፈርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ገና ሳላገባቸው የሚያስቡትን አሳብ አውቃለሁና፥ ከልጆቻቸውም አፍ አትረሳምና ብዙ ክፉ ነገርና ጭንቀት በደረሰባቸው ጊዜ ይህች መዝሙር ምስክር ሆና በፊታቸው ትመሰክራለች።

verses.text_english: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በዚያ ቀን ይህችን መዝሙር ጻፈ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አስተማራት።

verses.text_english: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.text_amharic: የነዌንም ልጅ ኢያሱን። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ታገባለህና ጽና፥ አይዞህ፤ እኔም ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ ብሎ አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች በመጽሐፍ ከጻፈ ከፈጸመም በኋላ፥

verses.text_english: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት የሚሸከሙትን ሌዋውያንን እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን የሕግ መጽሐፍ ውሰዱ፥ በዚያም በእናንተ ላይ ምስክር እንዲሆን በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት አጠገብ አኑሩት።

verses.text_english: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ዓመፃችሁንና የአንገታችሁን ድንዳኔ አውቃለሁና፤ እኔም ዛሬ ከእናንተ ጋር ገና በሕይወት ሳለሁ እናንተ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዐምፃችኋል፤ ይልቁንስ ከሞትሁ በኋላ እንዴት ይሆናል?

verses.text_english: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ቃል በጆሮአቸው እናገር ዘንድ፥ ሰማይንና ምድርንም አስመሰክርባቸው ዘንድ የነገዶቻችሁን ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ አለቆቻችሁንም ሰብስቡልኝ፤

verses.text_english: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.text_amharic: ከሞትሁ በኋላ ፈጽማችሁ እንድትረክሱ፥ ካዘዝኋችሁም መንገድ ፈቀቅ እንድትሉ አውቃለሁና። በእጃችሁም ሥራ ታስቈጡት ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ስላደረጋችሁ በኋለኛው ዘመን ክፉ ነገር ያገኛችኋል።

verses.text_english: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ ጆሮ የዚህች መዝሙር ቃሎች እስኪፈጸሙ ድረስ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፥ እኔም እናገራለሁ፤  ምድርም የአፌን ቃሎች ትስማ።

verses.text_english: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.text_amharic: ትምህርቴ እንደ ዝናብ ትፈስሳለች፥  ነገሬ እንደ ጠል ትንጠባጠባለች፤  በልምላሜ ላይ እንደ ጤዛ፥  በሣርም ላይ እንደ ካፊያ።

verses.text_english: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም እጠራለሁና፤  ለአምላካችን ታላቅነትን ስጡ።

verses.text_english: the Rock, his work perfect: for all his ways judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right he.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አምላክ ነው፤ ሥራውም ፍጹም ነው፤  መንገዱም ሁሉ የቀና ነው፤  የታመነ አምላክ፥ ክፋትም የሌለበት፥  እርሱ እውነተኛና ቅን ነው።

verses.text_english: They have corrupted themselves, their spot not of his children: a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ረከሱ፤ ልጆቹም አይደሉም፤  ነውርም አለባቸው፤ ጠማማና ገልበጥባጣ ትውልድ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? not he thy father hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.text_amharic: ደንቆሮ ብልሃተኛም ያልሆንህ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥  ለእግዚአብሔር ይህንን ትመልሳለህ?  የገዛህ አባትህ አይደለምን?  የፈጠረህና ያጸናህ እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.text_amharic: የዱሮውን ዘመን አስብ፥  የብዙ ትውልድንም ዓመታት አስተውል፤  አባትህን ጠይቅ፥ ያስታውቅህማል፤  ሽማግሌዎችህን ጠይቅ፥ ይነግሩህማል።

verses.text_english: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ልዑል ለአሕዛብ ርስታቸውን ባወረሰ ጊዜ፥  የአዳምን ልጆች በለየ ጊዜ፥  እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ቍጥር  የአሕዛብን ድንበር አቆመ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD'S portion his people; Jacob the lot of his inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር እድል ፈንታ ሕዝቡ ነው፤  ያዕቆብም የርስቱ ገምድ ነው።

verses.text_english: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ በጥማት፥  የነፋስ ጩኸትም በሞላበት ውድማ አገኘው፤  ከበበው ተጠነቀቀለትም፤  እንደ ዓይን ብሌን ጠበቀው።

verses.text_english: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.text_amharic: ንስር ጫጩቶቹን እንደሚያወጣ፥  በእነርሱም ላይ እንደሚሰፍፍ፥  ክንፎቹን ዘርግቶ ወሰዳቸው፥  በክንፎቹም አዘላቸው።

verses.text_english: the LORD alone did lead him, and no strange god with him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን መራው፤  ከእርሱም ጋር ሌላ አምላክ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ከፍታ ላይ አወጣው፤  የእርሻውን ፍሬ በላ፤  ከዓለትም ድንጋይ በሚገኝ ማር፥  ከጭንጫውም ድንጋይ በሚገኝ ዘይት አጠባው፤

verses.text_english: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.text_amharic: የላሙንም ቅቤ፥ የመንጋውም ወተት፥  ከጠቦት ስብ ጋር፥  የባሳንንም አውራ በግ፥ ፍየሉንም፥  ከስንዴ እሸት ጋር በላህ፤  ከወይኑም ደም ያለውን ጠጅ ጠጣህ።

verses.text_english: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered ; then he forsook God made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ይሹሩን ወፈረ፥ ረገጠ፤  ወፈረ፥ ደነደነ፥ ሰባ፤  የፈጠረውንም እግዚአብሔርን ተወ፤  የመድኃኒቱንም አምላክ ናቀ።

verses.text_english: They provoked him to jealousy with strange , with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሎች አማልክት አስቀኑት፥  በርኵሰታቸውም አስቈጡት።

verses.text_english: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ላልሆኑ አጋንንት፥  ለማያውቋቸውም አማልክት፥  በቅርብ ጊዜ ለተነሡ ለአዲሶች  አባቶቻቸውም ላልፈሩአቸው አማልክት ሠዉ።

verses.text_english: Of the Rock begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.text_amharic: የወለደህን አምላክ ተውህ፥  ያሳደገህን እግዚአብሔርን ረሳህ።

verses.text_english: And when the LORD saw , he abhorred , because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችም ስላስቈጡት  እግዚአብሔር አይቶ ጣላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end : for they a very froward generation, children in whom no faith.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። ፊቴን እሰውርባቸዋለሁ፤  ፍጻሜያቸው ምን እንደ ሆነ አያለሁ፤  ጠማማ ትውልድ፥  ያልታመኑም ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They have moved me to jealousy with not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ባልሆነው አስቀኑኝ፤ 3 ቍ.15፤ በዕብራይስጥ ይሹሩን የሚለውን ግዕዙ ያዕቆብ ይለዋል።  በምናምንቴዎቻቸውም አስቈጡኝ፤  እኔም ሕዝብ ባልሆነው አስቀናቸዋለሁ፤  በማያስተውል ሕዝብ አስቈጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: እሳት ከቍጣዬ ትነድዳለችና፥  እስከ ሲኦል ድረስ ታቃጥላለች፥  ምድርንም ከፍሬዋ ጋር ትበላለች፥  የተራሮችን መሠረት ታነድዳለች።

verses.text_english: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.text_amharic: መከራን እጨምርባቸዋለሁ፤  በፍላጾቼም እወጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.text_amharic: በራብ በንዳድ ይጠፋሉ፤  በንዳድና በመራራ ጥፋት ያልቃሉ፤  የአራዊትን ጥርስ፥  የምድርንም እባብ መርዝ እሰድድባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling with the man of gray hairs.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሳውን ከድንግል፥ ሕፃኑንም ከሽማግሌ ጋር፥  በሜዳ ሰይፍ፥ በቤትም ውስጥ ድንጋጤ ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.text_amharic: እበትናቸዋለሁ አልሁ፤  ከሰዎችም መካከል መታሰቢያቸውን አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, lest they should say, Our hand high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጠላቶቻቸው እንዳይታበዩ።  እጃችን ከፍ ከፍ አለች እንጂ  እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሁሉ አላደረገም  እንዳይሉ፥  ስለ ጠላቱ ቍጣ ፈራሁ።

verses.text_english: For they a nation void of counsel, neither understanding in them.
verses.text_amharic: ምክር ያጡ ሕዝብ ናቸው፥  ማስተዋልም የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: O that they were wise, they understood this, they would consider their latter end!
verses.text_amharic: አእምሮ ቢኖራቸው፥  ይህንን ያስተውሉ ነበር፥  ፍጻሜያቸውንም ያስቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አምላካቸው ካልሸጣቸው፥  እግዚአብሔርም አሳልፎ ካልሰጣቸው፥  አንድ ሰው እንዴት ሺህን ያሳድድ ነበር?  ሁለቱሳ እንዴት አሥሩን ሺህ ያሸሹ ነበር?

verses.text_english: For their rock not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves judges.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን እንደ አማልክቶቻቸው አይደለም፤  ጠላቶቻችንም ሰነፎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For their vine of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes grapes of gall, their clusters bitter:
verses.text_amharic: ወይናቸው ከሰዶም ወይን፥  ከገሞራም እርሻ ነው፤  ፍሬያቸው ሐሞት ነው፤  ዘለላውም መራራ ነው።

verses.text_english: Their wine the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.text_amharic: የወይን ጠጃቸው የእባብ መርዝ፥  የእፉኝትም ሥራይ ነው።

verses.text_english: not this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ በእኔ ዘንድ ተጠብቆ የለምን?  በመዝገቤስ የታተመ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: To me vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in time: for the day of their calamity at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.text_amharic: የጥፋታቸው ቀን ቀርቦአልና፥  የሚመጣባቸውም ነገር ይፈጥናልና  እግራቸው ሲሰናከል  በቀልና ፍርድ የእኔ ነው።

verses.text_english: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that power is gone, and none shut up, or left.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይላቸውም እንደ ደከመ፥  የተዘጋ የተለቀቀም እንደሌለ ባየ ጊዜ  እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳል፥  ስለ ባሪያዎቹም ያዝናል።

verses.text_english: And he shall say, Where their gods, rock in whom they trusted,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ይላል። አማልክቶቻቸው የት ናቸው?  ይታመኑባቸው የነበሩት አማልክት?

verses.text_english: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, be your protection.
verses.text_amharic: የመሥዋዕታቸውን ስብ የበሉ፥  የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውንም የወይን ጠጅ የጠጡ?  እነርሱ ይነሡ፥ ይርዱአችሁም፥  መጠጊያም ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.text_english: See now that I, I, he, and no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እኔ ብቻዬን እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ፥  ከእኔም በቀር አምላክ እንደሌለ እዩ፤  እኔ እገድላለሁ፥ አድንማለሁ፤  እኔ እመታለሁ፥ እፈውስማለሁ፤  ከእጄም የሚያድን የለም።

verses.text_english: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እጄን ወደ ሰማይ እዘረጋለሁና፥  እንዲህም እላለሁ። ለዘላለም እኔ ሕያው ነኝና

verses.text_english: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.text_amharic: የሚንቦገቦግ ሰይፌን እስለዋለሁ፥  እጄም ፍርድን ትይዛለች፥  ጠላቶቼንም እበቀላለሁ፥  ለሚጠሉኝም ፍዳቸውን እከፍላለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: ከተወጉት ከተማረኩትም ደም፥  ፍላጾቼን በደም አሰክራለሁ፤  ከጠላት አለቆችም ራስ  ሰይፌ ሥጋ ይበላል።

verses.text_english: Rejoice, O ye nations, his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, to his people.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎቹን ደም ይበቀላልና፥  ጠላቶቹንም ይበቀላቸዋልና፥  ምድሪቱንና ሕዝቡን ይክሳልና  እናንተ አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ የዚህችን መዝሙር ቃሎች ሁሉ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ተናግሮ ፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው። የዚህን ሕግ ቃሎች ሁሉ ይጠብቁና ያደርጉ ዘንድ ልጆቻችሁን እንድታዝዙበት ዛሬ የምመሰክርላችሁን ቃል ሁሉ በልባችሁ አኑሩት።

verses.text_english: For it not a vain thing for you; because it your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ነገር ሕይወታችሁ ነው እንጂ ለእናንተ ከንቱ አይደለምና፤ በዚህም ነገር ትወርሱአት ዘንድ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ በምትገቡባት ምድር ረጅም ዘመን ትቀመጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, mount Nebo, which in the land of Moab, that over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚህ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ምድር በዓባሪም ተራራ ውስጥ ወዳለው ወደ ናባው ተራራ ውጣ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ርስት አድርጌ የምሰጣቸውን የከነዓንን ምድር እይ፤

verses.text_english: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህም አሮን በሖር ተራራ እንደ ሞተ ወደ ወገኖቹም እንደ ተከማቸ፥ በወጣህበት ተራራ ሙት፥ ወደ ወገኖችህም ተከማች፤

verses.text_english: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል በጺን ምድረ በዳ በቃዴስ ባለው በመሪባ ውኃ ስለ በደላችሁኝ፥ በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ስላልቀደሳችሁኝ፥

verses.text_english: Yet thou shalt see the land before ; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱን ፊት ለፊት ታያለህ እንጂ ወደዚያች እኔ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደምሰጣቸው ምድር አትገባም።

verses.text_english: And this the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሙሴ ሳይሞት የእስራኤልን ልጆች የባረከባት በረከት ይህች ናት።

verses.text_english: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand a fiery law for them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ።  እግዚአብሔር ከሲና መጣ፥  በሴይርም ተገለጠ፤  ከፋራን ተራራ አበራላቸው፥  ከአእላፋትም ቅዱሳኑ መጣ፤  በስተ ቀኙም የእሳት ሕግ ነበረላቸው።

verses.text_english: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; shall receive of thy words.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ወደዳቸው፤  ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ በእጅህ ናቸው፤  በእግሮችህም አጠገብ ተቀመጡ፤  ቃሎችህን ይቀበላሉ።

verses.text_english: Moses commanded us a law, the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ ለያዕቆብ ጉባኤ ርስት የሆነውን  ሕግ አዘዘን።

verses.text_english: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቡ አለቆች ከእስራኤል ነገዶች  ሁሉ ጋር በተከማቹ ጊዜ፥  ንጉሥ በይሹሩን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let his men be few.
verses.text_amharic: ሮቤል በህይወት ይኑር፥ አይሙት፤  ሰዎቹም በቍጥር ብዙ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And this of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help from his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ በረከት ይህ ነው፤ እንዲህም አለ።  አቤቱ፥ የይሁዳን ድምፅ ስማ፥  ወደ ወገኖቹም አግባው፤  እጆቹ ይጠንክሩለት፤  በጠላቶቹ ላይ ረዳት ትሆነዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And of Levi he said, thy Thummim and thy Urim with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሌዊም እንዲህ አለ፥  ቱሚምህና ኡሪምህ ለቅዱስህ ሰው ነው፥  በማሳህ ለፈተንኸው፥  በመሪባ ውኃም ለተከራከርኸው፤

verses.text_english: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አባቱና ስለ እናቱ። አላየሁም ላለ፥  ወንድሞቹንም ላላስተዋለ፥  ልጆቹንም ላላወቀ፤  ቃልህን አደረጉ፥  ቃል ኪዳንህንም ጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድህን ለያዕቆብ፥  ሕግህንም ለእስራኤል ያስተምራሉ፤  በፊትህ ዕጣንን፥  በመሠዊያህም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ይሠዋሉ።

verses.text_english: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሀብቱን ባርክ፥  የእጁንም ሥራ ተቀበል፤  የሚነሣበትን ወገብ ውጋው፥  የሚጠሉትም አይነሡ።

verses.text_english: of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ብንያምም እንዲህ አለ።  በእግዚአብሔር የተወደደ በእርሱ  ዘንድ ተማምኖ ይኖራል፤  ቀኑን ሁሉ ይጋርደዋል፥  በትከሻውም መካከል ያድራል።

verses.text_english: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዮሴፍም እንዲህ አለ፥  ምድሩ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የተባረከ ይሁን፤  በሰማያት ገናንነት በጠል፥  በታችኛውም ቀላይ፥

verses.text_english: And for the precious fruits by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
verses.text_amharic: በፀሐዩ ፍሬያት ገናንነት፥  በጨረቃውም መውጣት ገናንነት

verses.text_english: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.text_amharic: በቀደሙትም ተራሮች ከፍተኛነት፥  በዘላለሙም ኮረብቶች ገናንነት፥

verses.text_english: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him separated from his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: በምድሪቱም ገናንነትና ሞላዋ፥  በቍጥቋጦው ውስጥ ከነበረው በረከት  በዮሴፍ ራስ ላይ፥ ከወንድሞቹም በተለየው ራስ አናት ላይ ይውረድ።

verses.text_english: His glory the firstling of his bullock, and his horns the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: ለላሞች በኵር ግርማ ይሆናል፤  ቀንዶቹ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ናቸው፤  በእነርሱ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ያሉትን  አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይወጋል፤  የኤፍሬም እልፍ አእላፋት፥  የምናሴም አእላፋት እነርሱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዛብሎንም እንዲህ አለ። ዛብሎን ሆይ፥ በመውጣትህ፥  ይሳኮር ሆይ፥ በድንኳንህ ውስጥ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck the abundance of the seas, and treasures hid in the sand.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰወረውን የአሸዋውን መዝገብ፥  የባሕሩንም ባለጠግነት ይጠባሉና  አሕዛብን ወደ ተራራው ይጠራሉ፤  በዚያ የጽድቅ መሥዋዕት ይሠዋሉ።

verses.text_english: And of Gad he said, Blessed he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጋድም እንዲህ አለ።  ጋድን ሰፊ ያደረገ ቡሩክ ይሁን፤  እንደ አንበሳይቱ ዐርፎአል፤  ክንድንና ራስን ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.text_english: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, a portion of the lawgiver, seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ የአለቃ እድል ፈንታ ቀርቶአልና  የመጀመሪያውን ክፍል ለራሱ መረጠ፤  ወደ ሕዝብ አለቆችም መጣ፤  የእግዚአብሔርንም ጽድቅ፥  ፍርዱንም ከእስራኤል ጋር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And of Dan he said, Dan a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዳንም እንዲህ አለ።  ዳን የአንበሳ ደቦል ነው፤  ከባሳን ዘልሎ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ንፍታሌምም እንዲህ አለ።  ንፍታሌም በሞገስ ጠግቦአል፥  የእግዚአብሔርንም በረከት ተሞልቶአል፤  ባሕሩንና ደቡቡን ይወርሳል።

verses.text_english: And of Asher he said, Asher blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አሴርም እንዲህ አለ።  አሴር በልጆች የተባረከ ይሁን፤  በወንድሞቹ የተወደደ ይሁን፤ እግሩንም በዘይት ውስጥ ያጥልቅ።

verses.text_english: Thy shoes iron and brass; and as thy days, thy strength .
verses.text_amharic: ጫማህ ብረትና ናስ ይሆናል፤  እንደ ዕድሜህ እንዲሁ ኃይልህ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: none like unto the God of Jeshurun, rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.text_amharic: ይሹሩን ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ለረድኤትህ፥  በደመናትም ላይ በታላቅነት እንደሚሄድ  እንደ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: The eternal God refuge, and underneath the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy .
verses.text_amharic: መኖሪያህ የዘላለም አምላክ ነው፥  የዘላለምም ክንዶች ከአንተ በታች ናቸው፤  ጠላትህን ከፊትህ አውጥቶ።  አጥፋው ይላል።

verses.text_english: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ተማምኖ፥  የያዕቆብም ምንጭ ብቻውን፥  እህልና የወይን ጠጅ ባለባት ምድር ይኖራል፤  ሰማያቱም ጠልን ያንጠባጥባሉ።

verses.text_english: Happy thou, O Israel: who like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ምስጉን ነህ፤  በእግዚአብሔር የዳነ ሕዝብ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው?  እርሱ የረድኤትህ ጋሻ፥  የከፍተኛነትህም ሰይፍ ነው።  ጠላቶችህም ይገዙልሃል፤  አንተም ከፍታቸውን ትረግጣለህ።

verses.text_english: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም ከሞዓብ ሜዳ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ወደ ናባው ተራራ ወደ ፈስጋ ራስ ወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እስከዳን ድረስ ያለውን የገለዓድን ምድር፥

verses.text_english: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
verses.text_amharic: የንፍታሌምንም ምድር ሁሉ፥ የኤፍሬምንና የምናሴንም ምድር፥ እስከ ምዕራብም ባሕር ድረስ ያለውን የይሁዳን ምድር ሁሉ፥ ደቡብንም፥

verses.text_english: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ዞዓር ድረስ ያለውንም የዘንባባ ዛፎች ያሉባትን ከተማ የኢያሪኮን ሸለቆ ሜዳ አሳየው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, This the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ለዘርህ እሰጣታለሁ ብዬ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም የማልሁላቸው ምድር ይህች ናት፤ በዓይንህ እንድታያት አደረግሁህ፥ ነገር ግን ወደዚያች አትሻገርም አለው።

verses.text_english: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያም ሙሴ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል በዚያ በሞዓብ ምድር ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: በቤተ ፌጎርም ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ምድር በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀበረ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ መቃብሩን ማንም አላወቀም።

verses.text_english: And Moses an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሀያ ዓመት ነበረ፤ ዓይኑ አልፈዘዘም፥ ጕልበቱም አልደነገዘም።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሠላሳ ቀን ለሙሴ አለቀሱለት፤ ለሙሴም ያለቀሱለት የልቅሶው ወራት ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እጆቹን ስለ ጫነበት የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ የጥበብን መንፈስ ተሞላ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ታዘዙለት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ፊት ለፊት እንዳወቀው እንደ ሙሴ ያለ ነቢይ ከዚያ ወዲህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አልተነሣም፤

verses.text_english: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.text_amharic: በግብፅ ምድር በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ በምድሪቱም ሁሉ ላይ ምልክትንና ድንቅን ያደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ላከው ያለ፥

verses.text_english: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት በጸናች እጅ ሁሉና በታላቅ ማስደንገጥ ሁሉ እንዳደረገው እንደ ሙሴ ያለ አልተነሣም።

verses.text_english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ከሞተ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የሙሴን አገልጋይ የነዌን ልጅ ኢያሱን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, to the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬ ሙሴ ሞቶአል፤ አሁንም አንተና ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተነሥታችሁ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደምሰጣቸው ምድር ይህን ዮርዳኖስ ተሻገሩ።

verses.text_english: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ለሙሴ እንደ ነገርሁት የእግራችሁ ጫማ የሚረግጠውን ቦታ ሁሉ ለእናንተ ሰጥቼአለሁ።

verses.text_english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድረ በዳው ከዚህም ከሊባኖስ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ወንዝ እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ድረስ የኬጥያውያን ምድር ሁሉ እስከ ፀሐይ መግቢያ እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወትህ ዕድሜ ሁሉ ማንም አይቋቋምህም፤ ከሙሴ ጋር እንደ ሆንሁ እንዲሁ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፤ አልጥልህም፥ አልተውህም።

verses.text_english: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቶቻቸው። እሰጣችኋለሁ ብዬ የማልሁላቸውን ምድር ለዚህ ሕዝብ ታወርሳለህና ጽና፥ አይዞህ።

verses.text_english: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it the right hand or the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጽና፥ እጅግ በርታ፤ ባሪያዬ ሙሴ ያዘዘህን ሕግ ሁሉ ጠብቅ፥ አድርገውም፤ በምትሄድበትም ሁሉ እንዲከናወንልህ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አትበል።

verses.text_english: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
verses.text_amharic: የዚህ ሕግ መጽሐፍ ከአፍህ አይለይ፥ ነገር ግን የተጻፈበትን ሁሉ ትጠብቅና ታደርግ ዘንድ በቀንም በሌሊትም አስበው፤ የዚያን ጊዜም መንገድህ ይቀናልሃል ይከናወንልሃልም።

verses.text_english: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.text_amharic: በምትሄድበት ሁሉ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና ጽና፥ አይዞህ፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥ ብዬ አላዘዝሁህምን?

verses.text_english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም የሮቤልን ልጆች የጋድንም ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኩሌታ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ባርያ ሙሴ እንዲህ ብሎ ያዘዛችሁን ቃል አስቡ። አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ያሳርፋችኋል፥ ይህችንም ምድር ይሰጣችኋል።

verses.text_english: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቶቻችሁና ልጆቻችሁ ከብቶቻችሁም ሙሴ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሰጣችሁ ምድር ይቀመጡ፤ ነገር ግን እናንተ፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሁሉ፥ ተሰልፋችሁ በወንድሞቻችሁ ፊት ተሻገሩ፥ እርዱአቸውም፥

verses.text_english: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እናንተን እንዳሳረፋችሁ ወንድሞቻችሁን እስኪያሳርፍ ድረስ፥ እነርሱም ደግሞ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የሚሰጣቸውን ምድር እስኪወርሱ ድረስ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ በፀሐይ መውጫ ወደ ሰጣችሁ ወደ ርስታችሁ ምድር ትመለሳላችሁ ትወርሱአትማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD'S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ለኢያሱ እንዲህ ብለው መለሱለት። ያዘዝኸንን ነገር ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ወደምትልከንም ስፍራ እንሄዳለን።

verses.text_english: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
verses.text_amharic: በሁሉም ለሙሴ እንደ ታዘዝን እንዲሁ ለአንተ ደግሞ እንታዘዛለን፤ ብቻ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ከሙሴ ጋር እንደ ነበረ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በትእዛዝህ የሚያምፅ ሁሉ የምታዝዘውንም ቃል ሁሉ የማይሰማ፥ እርሱ ይገደል፤ ብቻ ጽና፥ አይዞህ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
verses.text_amharic: የነዌም ልጅ ኢያሱ። ሄዳችሁ ምድሪቱንና ኢያሪኮን እዩ ብሎ ከሰጢም ሁለት ሰላዮች በስውር ላከ። ሄዱም፤ ረዓብም ወደሚሉአት ጋለሞታ ቤት ገቡ፥ በዚያም አደሩ።

verses.text_english: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
verses.text_amharic: የኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ። እነሆ፥ ሰዎች ከእስራኤል ልጆች አገሩን ሊሰልሉ ወደዚህ በሌሊት ገቡ ሲባል ወሬ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
verses.text_amharic: የኢያሪኮም ንጉሥ። አገሩን ሁሉ ሊሰልሉ መጥተዋልና ወደ አንቺ የመጡትን ወደ ቤትሽም የገቡትን ሰዎች አውጪ ብሎ ወደ ረዓብ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they :
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ሁለቱን ሰዎች ወስዳ ሸሸገቻቸው፤ እርስዋም። አዎን፥ ሰዎቹ ወደ እኔ መጡ፥ ከወዴት እንደ ሆኑ ግን አላወቅሁም፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
verses.text_amharic: በሩም ሲዘጋ ሲጨልምም ሰዎቹ ወጡ፤ ወዴት እንደ ሄዱ አላውቅም፤ ፈጥናችሁ አሳድዱአቸው፥ ታገኙአቸውማላችሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ግን ወደ ሰገነቱ አውጥታቸው ነበር፤ በዚያም በረበረበችው በተልባ እግር ውስጥ ሸሽጋቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መሻገሪያ በሚወስደው መንገድ አሳደዱአቸው፤ እሳዳጆችም ከወጡ በኋላ በሩ ተቈለፈ።

verses.text_english: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሳይተኙ ሴቲቱ ወደ እነርሱ ወደ ሰገነቱ ወጣች።

verses.text_english: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹንም እንዲህ አለቻቸው። እግዚአብሔር ምድሪቱን እንደ ሰጣችሁ፥ እናንተንም መፍራት በላያችን እንደ ወደቀ፥ በምድሪቱም የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ እንደ ቀለጡ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድር በወጣችሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር የኤርትራን ባሕር በፊታችሁ እንዳደረቀ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ በነበሩት እናንተም ፈጽማችሁ ባጠፋችኋቸው በሁለቱ በአሞራውያን ነገሥታት፥ በሴዎንና በዐግ ያደረጋችሁትን ሰምተናል።

verses.text_english: And as soon as we had heard , our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር ሰምተን ልባችን ቀለጠ፤ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር እርሱ አምላክ ነውና ከእናንተ የተንሣ ከዚያ ወዲያ ለማንም ነፍስ አልቀረለትም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እባካችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ማሉልኝ፥ በእውነትም ምልክት ስጡኝ፥ እኔ ለእናንተ ቸርነት እንደ ሠራሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ለአባቴ ቤት ቸርነት እንድትሠሩ፥

verses.text_english: And ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
verses.text_amharic: አባቴንና እናቴንም ወንድሞቼንና እኅቶቼንም ያላቸውንም ሁሉ እንድታድኑ፥ ሰውነታችንንም ከሞት እንድታድኑ።

verses.text_english: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም። ይህን ነገራችንን ባትገልጪ ነፍሳችን በነፍሳችሁ ፋንታ ለሞት ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ምድሪቱን በሰጠን ጊዜ ከአንቺ ጋር ቸርነትንና እውነትን እናደርጋለን አሉአት።

verses.text_english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
verses.text_amharic: ቤትዋም በከተማ ቅጥር የተጠጋ ነበረና፥ እርስዋም በቅጥሩ ላይ ተቀምጣ ነበርና ከመስኮቱ በገመድ አወረደቻቸው።

verses.text_english: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አሳዳጆቹ እንዳያገኙአችሁ ወደ ተራራው ሂዱ፤ አሳዳጆቹም እስኪመለሱ ድረስ በዚያ ሦስት ቀን ተሰውራችሁ ተቀመጡ፤ ኋላም መንገዳችሁን ትሄዳላችሁ አለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: And the men said unto her, We blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም አሉአት። እኛ ከዚህ ካማልሽን መሐላ ንጹሐን እንሆናለን።

verses.text_english: Behold, we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኛ ወደ አገሩ በገባን ጊዜ ይህን ቀይ ፈትል እኛን ባወረድሽበት መስኮት በኩል እሰሪው፤ አባትሽንም እናትሽንም ወንድሞችሽንም የአባትሽንም ቤተ ሰብ ሁሉ ወደ አንቺ ወደ ቤትሽ ሰብስቢ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood upon his head, and we guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood on our head, if hand be upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤትሽም ደጅ ወደ ሜዳ የሚወጣ ደሙ በራሱ ላይ ይሆናል፥ እኛም ንጹሐን እንሆናለን፤ ነገር ግን ከአንቺ ጋር በቤቱ ውስጥ ያለውን አንድ እጅ ቢነካው ደሙ በእኛ ራስ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንን ነገራችንን ግን ብትገልጪ ከዚህ ካማልሽን መሐላ ንጹሐን እንሆናለን።

verses.text_english: And she said, According unto your words, so it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። እንደ ቃላችሁ ይሁን አለች፤ ሰደደቻቸውም እነርሱም ሄዱ፤ ቀዩንም ፈትል በመስኮቱ በኩል አንጠለጠለችው።

verses.text_english: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought throughout all the way, but found not.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሄደው ወደ ተራራው ደረሱ፥ አሳዳጆቹም እስኪመለሱ ድረስ ሦስት ቀን በዚያ ተቀመጡ፤ አሳዳጆቹም በመንገዱ ሁሉ ፈልገው አላገኙአቸውም።

verses.text_english: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all that befell them:
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም ሰዎች ተመለሱ፥ ከተራራውም ወርደው ተሻገሩ፥ ወደ ነዌም ልጅ ወደ ኢያሱ መጡ፤ የደረሰባቸውንም ሁሉ አወሩለት።

verses.text_english: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱንም። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር አገሩን ሁሉ በእጃችን አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአል፤ በአገሩም ውስጥ ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ በፊታችን ይቀልጣሉ አሉት። a

verses.text_english: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ እርሱና የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ከሰጢም ተነሥተው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጡ፤ ሳይሻገሩም በዚያ አደሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ አለቆች በሰፈሩ መካከል አለፉ።

verses.text_english: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡን። የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦትና ሌዋውያን ካህናት ተሸክመውት ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ከሰፈራችሁ ተነስታችሁ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed way heretofore.
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተና በታቦቱ መካከል ያለው ርቀት በስፍር ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ ያህል ይሁን፤ በዚህ መንገድ በፊት አልሄዳችሁበትምና የምትሄዱበትን መንገድ እንድታውቁ ወደ ታቦቱ አትቅረቡ ብለው አዘዙ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን። ነገ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ ድንቅ ነገር ያደርጋልና ተቀደሱ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
