verses.text_english: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.text_amharic: አዶኒቤዜቅንም በቤዜቅ አገኙትና ተዋጉት፤ ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንንም መቱአቸው።

verses.text_english: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.text_amharic: አዶኒቤዜቅም ሸሸ፤ አሳድደውም ያዙት፥ የእጁንና የእግሩንም አውራ ጣት ቈረጡ።

verses.text_english: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.text_amharic: አዶኒቤዜቅም። የእጃቸውና የእግራቸው አውራ ጣት የተቈረጡ ሰባ ነገሥታት ከገበታዬ በታች ፍርፋሪ ይለቅሙ ነበር፤ እኔ እንዳደረግሁ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ መለሰልኝ አለ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም አመጡት፥ በዚያም ሞተ።

verses.text_english: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ልጆች ኢየሩሳሌምን ተዋግተው ያዙአት፥ በሰይፍ ስለትም መቱአት፥ ከተማይቱንም በእሳት አቃጠሉአት።

verses.text_english: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የይሁዳ ልጆች በተራራማው አገርና በደቡቡ በኩል በቈላውም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያንን ሊወጉ ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም በኬብሮን የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያንን ሊወጋ ሄደ። የኬብሮንም ስም አስቀድሞ ቂርያትአርባቅ ነበረ። ሴሲንና አኪመንን ተላሚንም ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before Kirjathsepher:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም የዳቤርን ሰዎች ሊወጋ ሄደ፤ አስቀድሞም የዳቤር ስም ቅርያትሤፍር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ካሌብም። ቅርያትሤፍርን ለሚመታና ለሚይዝ ልጄን ዓክሳን አጋባዋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.text_amharic: የካሌብም ትንሽ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ያዛት፤ ልጁንም ዓክሳን አጋባው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when she came , that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ወደ እርሱ በመጣች ጊዜ ከአባትዋ እርሻ እንዲለምን መከረችው። እርስዋም ከአህያዋ ወረደች፤ ካሌብም። ምን ፈለግሽ? አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። በረከትን ስጠኝ፤ በደቡብ በኩል ያለውን ምድር ሰጥተኸኛልና የውኃ ምንጭ ደግሞ ስጠኝ አለችው። ካሌብም ላይኛውንና ታችኛውን ምንጭ ሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
verses.text_amharic: የቄናዊው የሙሴ አማት ልጆችም ከይሁዳ ልጆች ጋር ዘንባባ ካለባት ከተማ ተነሥተው ከዓራድ በደቡብ በኩል ወዳለው ወደ ይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ ሄደውም ከሕዝቡ ጋር ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ከወንድሙ ከስምዖን ጋር ሄደ፥ በጽፋት የተቀመጡትንም ከነዓናውያንን መቱ፥ ፈጽመውም አጠፉአት። የከተማይቱንም ስም ሔርማ ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.text_english: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ጋዛንና ዳርቻዋን፥ አስቀሎናንና ዳርቻዋን፥ አቃሮንንና ዳርቻዋን ያዘ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከይሁዳ ጋር ነበረ፤ ይሁዳም ተራራማውን አገር ወረሰ፤ በሸለቆው የሚኖሩት ግን የብረት ሰረገሎች ነበሩአቸውና ሊያወጣቸው አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንደ ተናገረ ለካሌብ ኬብሮንን ሰጡት፤ ከዚያም ሦስቱን የዔናቅ ልጆች አወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ኢያቡሳውያንን የብንያም ልጆች አላወጡአቸውም፤ ኢያቡሳውያንም ከብንያም ልጆች ጋር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.text_english: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD with them.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍም ወገን ደግሞ በቤቴል ላይ ወጡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before Luz.)
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍም ወገን ቤቴልን የሚሰልሉ ላኩ። አስቀድሞም የከተማይቱ ስም ሎዛ ይባል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
verses.text_amharic: ጠባቂዎቹም አንድ ሰው ከከተማ ሲወጣ አይተው። የከተማይቱን መግቢያ አሳየን፥ እኛም ቸርነት እናደርግልሃለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱንም መግቢያ አሳያቸው፥ ከተማይቱንም በሰይፍ ስለት መቱ፤ ያንን ሰውና ወገኖቹን ግን ለቀቁአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which the name thereof unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውየውም ወደ ኬጢያውያን ምድር ሄደ፥ በዚያም ከተማን ሠራ፥ ስምዋንም ሎዛ ብሎ ጠራት። እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ስምዋ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Neither did Manasseh drive out Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.text_amharic: ምናሴም የቤትሳንንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የታዕናክንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የዶርንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የይብለዓምንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የመጊዶንና የመንደሮችዋን ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በዚያ አገር በመቀመጥ ጸኑ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በበረቱ ጊዜ ከነዓናውያንን አስገበሩአቸው፥ ፈጽመውም አላወጡአቸውም።

verses.text_english: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬምም በጌዝር የተቀመጡትን ከነዓናውያንን አላወጣቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በመካከላቸው በጌዝር ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሎንም የቂድሮንንና የነህሎልን ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በመካከላቸው ተቀመጡ፥ ግብርም የሚገብሩለት ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
verses.text_amharic: አሴርም የዓኮንና የሲዶንን የአሕላብንም የአክዚብንም የሒልባንም የአፌቅንም የረአብንም ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ምድር የተቀመጡትን ከነዓናውያን አላወጡአቸውምና በመካከላቸው የአሴር ልጆች ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ንፍታሌምም የቤትሳሚስንና የቤትዓናትን ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም፥ በምድሩም በተቀመጡት በከነዓናውያን መካከል ተቀመጡ፤ ነገር ግን የቤትሳሚስና የቤትዓናት ሰዎች ግብር የሚገብሩለት ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
verses.text_amharic: አሞራውያንም የዳንን ልጆች ወደ ተራራማው አገር እንዲያፈገፍጉ አስገደዱአቸው፥ ወደ ሸለቆውም እንዳይወርዱ ከለከሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
verses.text_amharic: አሞራውያን በሔሬስ ተራራና በኤሎን በሸዓልቢምም በመቀመጥ ጸኑ፤ ነገር ግን የዮሴፍ ቤት እጅ ከበደች፥ አስገበረቻቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the coast of the Amorites from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞራውያንም ድንበር ከአቅረቢም ዐቀበት ከጭንጫው ጀምሮ እስከ ላይ ድረስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከጌልገላ ወደ ቦኪም ወጥቶ እንዲህ አለ። እኔ ከግብፅ አውጥቻችኋለሁ፥ ለአባቶቻችሁም ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር አግብቻችኋለሁ፤ እኔም። ከእናንተ ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም አላፈርስም፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም መሠዊያቸውን አፍርሱ እንጂ በዚህች ምድር ከሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርጉ አልሁ። እናንተ ግን ቃሌን አልሰማችሁም፤

verses.text_english: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንስ ለምን አደረጋችሁ? ስለዚህም። ከፊታችሁ አላወጣቸውም፥ ነገር ግን ያስጨንቋችኋል፥ አማልክቶቻቸውም ወጥመድ ይሆኑባችኋል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ይህን ቃል ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በተናገረ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ድምፃቸውን አንሥተው አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም ቦኪም ብለው ጠሩት፤ በዚያም ለእግዚአብሔር ሠዉ።

verses.text_english: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን ባሰናበተ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ምድሪቱን ሊወርሱ ወደ እየርስታቸው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱም በነበረበት ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ለእስራኤልም ያደረገውን ታላቁን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ሁሉ ባዩት፥ ከኢያሱ በኋላ በነበሩ ሽማግሌዎች ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔርን አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, an hundred and ten years old.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ ዕድሜው መቶ አሥር ዓመት ሲሆነው ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
verses.text_amharic: በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር በገዓስ ተራራ በሰሜን ባለችው በርስቱ ዳርቻ በተምናሔሬስ ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ትውልድ ሁሉ ደግሞ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ተከማቹ፤ ከእነዚያም በኋላ እግዚአብሔርን ለእስራኤልም ያደረገውን ሥራ ያላወቀ ሌላ ትውልድ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ የሆነ ነገር አደረጉ፥ በኣሊምንም አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድርም ያወጣቸውን የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ተዉ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ካሉት ከአሕዛብ አማልክት ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከተሉ፥ ሰገዱላቸውም፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አስቈጡ።

verses.text_english: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም ትተው በኣልንና አስታሮትን አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ ወደ ማረኩአቸውም ማራኪዎች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ በዙሪያቸውም ባሉት በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ ጠላቶቻቸውንም ከዚያ ወዲያ ሊቋቋሙ አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ እንደማለ፥ ወደ ወጡበት ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ትከፋባቸው ነበረች፤ እጅግም ተጨነቁ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም መሳፍንትን አስነሣላቸው፥ ከሚማርኩአቸውም እጅ አዳኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; they did not so.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎች አማልክትን ተከትለው አመነዘሩ ሰገዱላቸውም እንጂ መሳፍንቶቻቸውን አልሰሙም፤ አባቶቻቸውም ይሄዱበት ከነበረ መንገድ ፈጥነው ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ አባቶቻቸው ለእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ እንደ ታዘዙ እንዲሁ አላደረጉም።

verses.text_english: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም መሳፍንትን ባስነሣላቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከመስፍኑ ጋር ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስለሚጋፉአቸውና ስለሚያስጨንቋቸው በጩኸታቸው ያዝን ነበርና በመስፍኑ ዘመን ሁሉ ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, they returned, and corrupted more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.text_amharic: መስፍኑ ግን ከሞተ በኋላ ይመለሱ ነበር፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት በመከተላቸው እነርሱንም በማምለካቸውና ለእነርሱ በመስገዳቸው አባቶቻቸው አድርገውት ከነበረው የከፋ ያደርጉ ነበር፤ የእልከኝነታቸውን መንገድና ሥራቸውን አልተዉም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ይህ ሕዝብ ለአባቶቻቸው ያዘዝሁትን ቃል ኪዳን ስለ ተላለፉ፥ ድምፄንም ስላልሰሙ አባቶቻቸውም እንደ ጠበቁ፥

verses.text_english: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep , or not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚህን አሕዛብ አስቀረ፥ ፈጥኖም አላወጣቸውም፥ በኢያሱም እጅ አሳልፎ አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: Now these the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.text_amharic: ከከነዓናውያንም ጋር መዋጋት ያላወቁትን እስራኤልን በእነርሱ፤

verses.text_english: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
verses.text_amharic: ይፈትናቸው ዘንድ፥ በፊትም ሰልፍን ያልለመዱ የእስራኤል ልጆች ትውልድ መዋጋትን ያውቁና ይማሩ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያስቀራቸው አሕዛብ እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: , five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያን መኳንንት፥ ከነዓናውያንም ሁሉ፥ ሲዶናውያንም፥ ከበኣልአርሞንዔም ተራራ ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ ድረስ በሊባኖስ ተራራ የሚኖሩትም ኤዊያውያን።

verses.text_english: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ለአባቶቻቸው ያዘዘውን ትእዛዝ መስማታቸው እንዲታወቅ እስራኤል ይፈተኑባቸው ዘንድ እነዚህ ቀሩ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከነዓናውያን በኬጢያውያንም በአሞራውያንም በፌርዛውያንም በኤዊያውያንም በኢያቡሳውያንም መካከል ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ልጆቻቸውንም አገቡአቸው፥ እነርሱም ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለወንዶች ልጆቻቸው ሰጡ፥ አማልክቶቻቸውንም አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን ነገር አደረጉ፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ረስተው በኣሊምንና አስታሮትን አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ በመስጴጦምያ ንጉሥ በኵሰርሰቴም እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለኵሰርሰቴም ስምንት ዓመት ተገዙለት።

verses.text_english: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚያድናቸውን አዳኝ የካሌብን የታናሽ ወንድሙን የቄኔዝን ልጅ ጎቶንያልን አስነሣላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በእርሱ ላይ መጣ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ይፈርድ ነበር፤ ለሰልፍ ወጣ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የመስጴጦምያን ንጉሥ ኵሰርሰቴምን በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እጁም በኵሰርሰቴም ላይ አሸነፈች።

verses.text_english: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም አርባ ዓመት ዐረፈች፤ የቄኔዝም ልጅ ጎቶንያል ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ስለ ሠሩ እግዚአብሔር የሞዓብን ንጉሥ ዔግሎምን በእስራኤል ላይ አበረታባቸው።

verses.text_english: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንን ልጆችና አማሌቅን ወደ እርሱ ሰበሰበ፤ ሄዶም እስራኤልን መታ፥ ዘንባባም ያለባትን ከተማ ያዙአት።

verses.text_english: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለሞዓብ ንጉሥ ለዔግሎም አሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ተገዙለት።

verses.text_english: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ብንያማዊውን የጌራን ልጅ ናዖድን ግራኙን ሰው አዳኝ አስነሣላቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእርሱ እጅ ወደ ሞዓብ ንጉሥ ወደ ዔግሎም ግብር ላኩ።

verses.text_english: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድም ሁለት አፍ ያለው ርዝመቱ አንድ ክንድ የሆነ ሰይፍ አበጀ፥ ከልብሱም በታች በቀኝ ጭኑ በኩል አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon a very fat man.
verses.text_amharic: ለሞዓብም ንጉሥ ለዔግሎም ግብሩን አቀረበ፤ ዔግሎምም እጅግ ወፍራም ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
verses.text_amharic: ግብሩንም ማቅረብ በጨረሰ ጊዜ፥ ግብር የተሸከሙትን ሰዎች ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: But he himself turned again from the quarries that by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድ ግን በጌልገላ ከነበሩት ትክል ድንጋዮች ዘንድ ተመልሶ። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ የምሥጢር ነገር አለኝ አለ፤ ንጉሡም። ዝም በል አለ፤ በዙሪያውም የቆሙት ሁሉ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of seat.
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድም ወደ እርሱ ቀረበ፤ እርሱም በሰገነት ቤት ለብቻው ተቀምጦ ነበር። ናዖድም። የእግዚአብሔር መልእክት ለአንተ አለኝ አለ። ከዙፋኑም ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድም ግራ እጁን ዘርግቶ ከቀኝ ጭኑ ሰይፉን ወሰደ፥ ሆዱንም ወጋው፤

verses.text_english: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
verses.text_amharic: የሰይፉም እጀታው ደግሞ ከስለቱ በኋላ ገባ፤ ስቡም ስለቱን ከደነው፥ ሰይፉንም ከሆዱ መልሶ አላወጣውም፤ በኋላውም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድም ወደ ደርቡ ወጣ፥ የሰገነቱንም ደጅ ዘግቶ ቈለፈው።

verses.text_english: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድም ከሄደ በኋላ ባሪያዎቹ መጡ፤ የሰገነቱም ደጅ ተቈልፎ ባዩ ጊዜ። ምናልባት በሰገነቱ ውስጥ ወገቡን ይሞክር ይሆናል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened : and, behold, their lord fallen down dead on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እስኪያፍሩም ድረስ እጅግ ዘገዩ፤ የሰገነቱንም ደጅ እንዳልከፈተ ባዩ ጊዜ መክፈቻውን ወስደው ከፈቱ፥ እነሆም፥ ጌታቸው በምድር ወድቆ ሞቶም አገኙት።

verses.text_english: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
verses.text_amharic: በዘገዩበትም ጊዜያት ናዖድ ሸሸ፥ ትክል ድንጋዮቹንም አለፈ፥ ወደ ቤይሮታም አመለጠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
verses.text_amharic: በመጣም ጊዜ በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ቀንደ መለከት ነፋ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከእርሱ ጋር ከተራራማው አገር ወረዱ፥ እርሱም በፊታቸው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቻችሁን ሞዓባውያንን በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና ተከተሉኝ አላቸው። ተከትለውትም ወረዱ፥ ወደ ሞዓብም የሚያሻግረውን የዮርዳኖስን መሻገርያ ያዙ፥ ማንንም አላሳለፉም።

verses.text_english: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜም ከሞዓብ አሥር ሺህ የሚያህሉትን፥ ጕልማሶችና ጽኑዓን ሁሉ፥ መቱ፤ አንድ እንኳ አላመለጠም።

verses.text_english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሞዓብ ከእስራኤል እጅ በታች ተዋረደ፤ ምድሪቱም ሰማንያ ዓመት ዐረፈች።

verses.text_english: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የዓናት ልጅ ሰሜጋር ተነሣ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ስድስት መቶ ሰው በበሬ መውጊያ ገደለ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ እስራኤልን አዳነ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
verses.text_amharic: ናዖድም ከሞተ በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በአሶር በነገሠው በከነዓን ንጉሥ በኢያቢስ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ የሠራዊቱም አለቃ በአሕዛብ አሪሶት የተቀመጠው ሲሣራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ ዘጠኝ መቶ የብረት ሰረገሎች ነበሩትና፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ሀያ ዓመት ያህል እጅግ ያስጨንቃቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜም ነቢይቱ የለፊዶት ሚስት ዲቦራ በእስራኤል ላይ ትፈርድ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር በራማና በቤቴል መካከል ካለው የዲቦራ ዛፍ ከሚባለው ከዘንባባው በታች ተቀምጣ ነበር፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እርስዋ ለፍርድ ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, , Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.text_amharic: ልካም ከቃዴስ ንፍታሌም የአቢኒኤምን ልጅ ባርቅን ጠርታ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር። ሄደህ ወደ ታቦር ተራራ ውጣ፥ ከአንተም ጋር ከንፍታሌምና ከዛብሎን ልጆች አሥር ሺህ ሰዎች ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም የኢያቢስን ሠራዊት አለቃ ሲሣራን ሰረገሎቹንም ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ወደ ቂሶን ወንዝ እስባለሁ፥ በእጅህም አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ ብሎ አላዘዘህምን? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, I will not go.
verses.text_amharic: ባርቅም። አንቺ ከእኔ ጋር ብትሄጂ እኔ እሄዳለሁ፤ አንቺ ግን ከእኔ ጋር ባትሄጂ እኔ አልሄድም አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.text_amharic: እርሷም። በእውነት ከአንተ ጋር እሄዳለሁ፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሲሣራን በሴት እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣልና በዚህ በምትሄድበት መንገድ ለአንተ ክብር አይሆንም አለችው። ዲቦራም ተነሥታ ከባርቅ ጋር ወደ ቃዴስ ሄደች።

verses.text_english: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.text_amharic: ባርቅም ዛብሎንንና ንፍታሌምን ወደ ቃዴስ ጠራቸው፥ አሥር ሺህም ሰዎች ተከትለውት ወጡ፤ ዲቦራም ከእርሱ ጋር ወጣች።

verses.text_english: Now Heber the Kenite, of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which by Kedesh.
verses.text_amharic: ቄናዊውም ሔቤር ከሙሴ አማት ከኦባብ ልጆች ከቄናውያን ተለይቶ ድንኳኑን በቃዴስ አጠገብ በጻዕናይም እስከ ነበረው እስከ ትልቁ ዛፍ ድረስ ተከለ።

verses.text_english: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.text_amharic: የአቢኒኤምም ልጅ ባርቅ ወደ ታቦር ተራራ እንደ ወጣ ለሲሣራ ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሣራም ሰረገሎቹን ሁሉ፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ የብረት ሰረገሎች፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ከአሪሶት ወደ ቂሶን ወንዝ ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.text_english: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.text_amharic: ዲቦራም ባርቅን። እግዚአብሔር ሲሣራን በእጅህ አሳልፎ የሚሰጥበት ቀን ዛሬ ነውና ተነሣ፤ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በፊትህ ወጥቶአል አለችው። ባርቅም አሥር ሺህ ሰዎች ተከትለውት ከታቦር ተራራ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all chariots, and all host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሲሣራን ሰረገሎቹንም ሁሉ ሠራዊቱንም ሁሉ ከባርቅ ፊት በሰይፍ ስለት አስደነገጣቸው፤ ሲሣራም ከሰረገላው ወርዶ በእግሩ ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; there was not a man left.
verses.text_amharic: ባርቅም ሰረገሎችንና ሠራዊቱን እስከ አሪሶት ድረስ አባረረ፤ የሲሣራም ሠራዊት ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት ወደቀ፤ አንድ እንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.text_amharic: በአሶር ንጉሥም በኢያቢስና በቄናዊው በሔቤር ቤት መካከል ሰላም ነበረና ሲሣራ በእግሩ ሸሽቶ ወደ ቄናዊው ወደ ሔቤር ሚስት ወደ ኢያዔል ድንኳን ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያዔልም ሲሣራን ለመገናኘት ወጥታ። ግባ፥ ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወደ እኔ ግባ፤ አትፍራ አለችው። ወደ እርስዋም ወደ ድንኳንዋ ገባ፥ በመጐናጸፊያዋም ሸፈነችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጠምቶኛልና እባክሽ የምጠጣው ጥቂት ውኃ ስጭኝ አላት፤ እርስዋም የወተቱን አቁማዳ ፈትታ አጠጣችው፥ ሸፈነችውም።

verses.text_english: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ቁሚ፤ ሰውም መጥቶ። በዚህ ሰው አለን? ብሎ ቢጠይቅሽ አንቺ። የለም ትዪዋለሽ አላት።

verses.text_english: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.text_amharic: የሔቤርም ሚስት ኢያዔል የድንኳን ካስማ ወሰደች፥ በእጅዋም መዶሻ ያዘች፥ ቀስ ብላም ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች፤ በጆሮግንዱ ካስማውን ቸነከረች፤ እርሱም ደክሞ እንቀላፍቶ ነበርና ካስማው ወደ መሬት ጠለቀ፥ እርሱም ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her , behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail in his temples.
So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የከነዓንን ንጉሥ ኢያቢስንም እስኪያጠፉ ድረስ በከነዓን ንጉሥ በኢያቢስ ላይ የእስራኤል ልጆች እጅ እየበረታች ሄደች።

verses.text_english: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ዲቦራና የአቢኒኤም ልጅ ባርቅ እንዲህ ብለው ተቀኙ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ውስጥ መሪዎች ስለ መሩ፥  ሕዝቡም ነፍሳቸውን በፈቃዳቸው ስለ ሰጡ፥  እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing to the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሥታት ሆይ፥ ስሙ፤  መኳንንት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤  እኔ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ፥  ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከሴይር በወጣህ ጊዜ፥  ከኤዶምያስም ሜዳ በተራመድህ ጊዜ፥  ምድሪቱ ተናወጠች፥ ሰማያቱም አንጠበጠቡ፤  ደመናትም ደግሞ ውኃን አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.text_english: The mountains melted from before the LORD, that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት የተነሣ ቀለጡ፥  ያም ሲና ከእስራኤል አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት የተነሣ።

verses.text_english: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
verses.text_amharic: በዓናት ልጅ በሰሜጋር ዘመን፥  በኢያዔል ዘመን መንገዶች ተቋረጡ፤  መንገደኞች በስርጥ መንገድ ይሄዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ፥ ዲቦራ፥ እስክትነሽ ድረስ፥  ለእስራኤልም እናት ሆነሽ እስክትነሽ ድረስ፥  ኃያላን በእስራኤል ዘንድ አነሱ፥ አለቁም።

verses.text_english: They chose new gods; then war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.text_amharic: አዲሶች አማልክትን መረጡ፤  በዚያ ጊዜ ሰልፍ በበሮች ሆነ፤  በአርባ ሺህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ጦርና ጋሻ አልታየም።

verses.text_english: My heart toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ወደ እስራኤል አለቆች ነው፥  በሕዝቡ መካከል ነፍሳቸውን በፈቃዳቸው ወደ ሰጡት፤  እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
verses.text_amharic: በነጫጭ አህዮች ላይ የምትጫኑ፥  በወላንሳ ላይ የምትቀመጡ፥  በመንገድም የምትሄዱ፥ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, the righteous acts of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
verses.text_amharic: በማጠጫው መካከል ካሉት ከቀስተኞች ጩኸት ርቀው፥  በዚያ የእግዚአብሔርን ጽድቅ፥  በእስራኤል ላይ የግዛቱን ጽድቅ ይጫወታሉ፤  ከዚያም በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ወደ በሮች ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
verses.text_amharic: ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ዲቦራ ሆይ፤  ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ቅኔውን ተቀኚ፤  ባርቅ ሆይ፥ ተነሣ፤  የአቢኒኤም ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምርኮህን ማርክ።

verses.text_english: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜ የቀሩት ወደ ኃያላኑና ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረዱ፤  እግዚአብሔርም ስለ እኔ በኃያላን ላይ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: Out of Ephraim a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
verses.text_amharic: በአማሌቅ ዘንድ ሥር የነበራቸው እነርሱ ከኤፍሬም፥  ብንያም ሆይ፥ በሕዝብህ መካከል ከአንተ በኋላ ወረዱ፤  አለቆች ከማኪር፥ የንጉሥንም ዘንግ የሚይዙ ከዛብሎን ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And the princes of Issachar with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben great thoughts of heart.
verses.text_amharic: የይሳኮርም አለቆች ከዲቦራ ጋር ነበሩ፤  ይሳኮርም እንደ ባርቅ ነበረ፤  ከእግሩ በኋላ ወደ ሸለቆው ቸኰሉ፤  በሮቤል ፈሳሾች አጠገብ ብዙ የልብ ማመንታት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben great searchings of heart.
verses.text_amharic: መንጎች ሲያፍዋጩ ለመስማት  በበጎች ጕረኖ መካከል ለምን ተቀመጥህ?  በሮቤል ፈሳሾች አጠገብ ታላቅ የልብ ምርምር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓድ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ተቀመጠ፤  ዳንም ለምን በመርከብ ውስጥ ቀረ?  አሴርም በባሕሩ ዳር ተቀመጠ፥  በወንዞቹም ዳርቻ ዐረፈ።

verses.text_english: Zebulun and Naphtali a people jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሎን ነፍሱን ወደ ሞት ያሳለፈ ሕዝብ ነው፥  ንፍታሌምም በአገሩ ኮረብታ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: The kings came fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሥታት መጡ፥ ተዋጉም፤  በዚያ ጊዜ በመጊዶ ውኆች አጠገብ በታዕናክ  የከነዓን ነገሥታት ተዋጉ፤  የብር ዘረፋም አልወሰዱም።

verses.text_english: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.text_amharic: ከዋክብት ከሰማይ ተዋጉ፤  በአካሄዳቸውም ከሲሣራ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.text_english: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
verses.text_amharic: ከዱሮ ጀምሮ የታወቀ ያ የቂሶን ወንዝ፥  የቂሶን ወንዝ ጠርጎ ወሰዳቸው።  ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ በኃይል እርገጪ።

verses.text_english: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃያላን ግልቢያ ብርታት የተነሣ  የፈረሶች ጥፍሮች ተቀጠቀጡ።

verses.text_english: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ። ሜሮዝን እርገሙ፤  እግዚአብሔርን በኃያላን መካከል ለመርዳት፥  እግዚአብሔርን ለመርዳት አልመጡምና  የተቀመጡባትን ሰዎች ፈጽማችሁ እርገሙ አለ።

verses.text_english: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.text_amharic: የቄናዊው የሔቤር ሚስት ኢያዔል  ከሴቶች ይልቅ የተባረከች ትሁን፤  በድንኳን ውስጥ ከሚኖሩ ሴቶች ይልቅ የተባረከች ትሁን።

verses.text_english: He asked water, she gave milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃ ለመነ፥ ወተትም ሰጠችው፤  በተከበረ ዳካ እርጎ አቀረበችለት።

verses.text_english: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
verses.text_amharic: እጅዋን ወደ ካስማ፥  ቀኝ እጅዋንም ወደ ሠራተኛ መዶሻ አደረገች፤  በመዶሻውም ሲሣራን መታች፥ ራሱንም ቸነከረች፤  ጆሮግንዱንም በሳች፥ ጎዳችውም።

verses.text_english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.text_amharic: በእግሮችዋ አጠገብ ተደፋ፥ ወደቀ፥ ተኛ፤  በእግሮችዋ አጠገብ ተደፋ፥ ወደቀ፤  በተደፋበት ስፍራ በዚያ ወድቆ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.text_amharic: ከመስኮት ሆና ተመለከተች፤  የሲሣራ እናት በሰቅሰቅ ዘልቃ።  ስለ ምን ለመምጣት ሰረገላው ዘገየ?  ስለ ምንስ የሰረገላው መንኰራኵር ቈየ? ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.text_amharic: ብልሃተኞች ሴቶችዋ መለሱላት፤  እርስዋ ደግሞ ለራስዋ እንዲህ ብላ መለሰች።

verses.text_english: Have they not sped? have they divided the prey; to every man a damsel two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, for the necks of the spoil?
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮ አግኝተው የለምን? ተካፍለውስ የለምን?  ለእያንዳንዱ ሰው ምርኮ አንዲት ወይም ሁለት ቈነጃጅት፤  ለሲሣራ ምርኮ ልዩ ልዩ ያለው ልብስ፥  በአንገትጌ ላይ በሁለት እጥፍ የተጠለፈ ዝንጕርጕር ልብስ።

verses.text_english: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but them that love him as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጠላቶችህ ሁሉ እንዲሁ ይጥፉ፤  ወዳጆችህ ግን ፀሐይ በኃይሉ በወጣ ጊዜ እንደሚሆን፥ እንዲሁ ይሁኑ። ምድሪቱም አርባ ዓመት ያህል ዐረፈች።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድያም እጅ ሰባት ዓመት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
verses.text_amharic: የምድያምም እጅ በእስራኤል ላይ ጠነከረች፤ ከምድያምም የተነሣ የእስራኤል ልጆች በተራራ ላይ ጕድጓድና ዋሻ ምሽግም አበጁ።

verses.text_english: And it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ዘር በዘሩ ጊዜ ምድያማውያን አማሌቃውያንም በምሥራቅም የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ይመጡባቸው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም ላይ ይሰፍሩ ነበር፥ እስከ ጋዛም ድረስ የምድሩን ቡቃያ ያጠፉ ነበር፥ ምግብንም ለእስራኤል አይተዉም ነበር፤ በግ ወይም በሬ ወይም አህያ ቢሆን አይተዉም።

verses.text_english: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶቻቸውንና ድንኳኖቻቸውን ይዘው በብዛት እንደ አንበጣ ሆነው ይመጡ ነበር፤ ለእነርሱና ለግመሎቻቸውም ቍጥር አልነበራቸውም፤ ምድሪቱንም ያጠፉ ዘንድ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድያምም የተነሣ እስራኤል እጅግ ተጠቁ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች በምድያም ምክንያት ወደ እግዚአብሔር በጮኹ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ነቢይ ላከ፥ እርሱም አለ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣኋችሁ፥ ከባርነትም ቤት አስለቀቅኋችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፃውያንም እጅ፥ ከሚጋፉአችሁም ሁሉ እጅ አዳንኋችሁ፥ ከፊታችሁም አሳደድኋቸው፥ አገራቸውንም ሰጠኋችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I said unto you, I the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተንም። እኔ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ በምድራቸው የተቀመጣችሁባቸውን የአሞራያውያንን አማልክት አትፍሩ አልኋችሁ። እናንተ ግን ድምፄን አልሰማችሁም።

verses.text_english: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which in Ophrah, that unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide from the Midianites.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ መጥቶ በዖፍራ ባለችው ለአቢዔዝራዊው ለኢዮአስ በነበረችው በአድባሩ ዛፍ በታች ተቀመጠ፤ ልጁም ጌዴዎን ከምድያማውያን ለመሸሸግ በወይን መጥመቂያው ውስጥ ስንዴ ይወቃ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ለእርሱ ተገልጦ። አንተ ጽኑዕ ኃያል ሰው፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ከሆነ ይህ ነገር ሁሉ ለምን ደረሰብን? አባቶቻችንስ። እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ አውጥቶናል ብለው ይነግሩን የነበረ ተአምራቱ ወዴት አለ? ወዴት አለ? አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔር ትቶናል፥ በምድያማውያንም እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶናል አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ እርሱ ዘወር ብሎ። በዚህ በጕልበትህ ሂድ፥ እስራኤልንም ከምድያም እጅ አድን፤ እነሆ፥ ልኬሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family poor in Manasseh, and I the least in my father's house.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እስራኤልን በምን አድናለሁ? ወገኔ ከምናሴ ነገድ ከሁሉ ይልቅ የተጠቃ ነው፤ እኔም በአባቴ ቤት የሁሉ ታናሽ ነኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። በእርግጥ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ ምድያምንም እንደ አንድ ሰው አድርገህ ትመታለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስ ካገኘሁ፥ የምትናገረኝም አንተ እንደ ሆንህ ምልክት አሳየኝ፤

verses.text_english: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንተም እስክመለስ ድረስ፥ ቍርባኔንም አምጥቼ እስካቀርብልህ ድረስ፥ እባክህ፥ ከዚህ አትላወስ አለው። እርሱም። እስክትመለስ ድረስ እቆያለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought out unto him under the oak, and presented .
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎን ገባ የፍየሉንም ጠቦት የኢፍ መስፈሪያም ዱቄት የቂጣ እንጎቻ አዘጋጀ፤ ሥጋውን በሌማት አኖረ፥ መረቁንም በምንቸት ውስጥ አደረገ፥ ሁሉንም ይዞ በአድባሩ ዛፍ በታች አቀረበለት።

verses.text_english: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ። ሥጋውንና የቂጣውን እንጎቻ ወስደህ በዚህ ድንጋይ ላይ አኑር፥ መረቁንም አፍስስ አለው። እንዲሁም አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእጁ ያለውን የበትሩን ጫፍ ዘርግቶ ሥጋውንና የቂጣውን እንጎቻ አስነካ፤ እሳትም ከድንጋዩ ውስጥ ወጥቶ ሥጋውንና የቂጣውን እንጎቻ በላ። የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከዓይኑ ተሰወረ።

verses.text_english: And when Gideon perceived that he an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ ጌዴዎንም። አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወዮልኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ ፊት ለፊት አይቻለሁና አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Peace unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፤ አትፍራ፤ አትሞትም አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም በዚያ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ ስሙንም። እግዚአብሔር ሰላም ብሎ ጠራው። እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ለአቢዔዝራውያን በምትሆነው በዖፍራ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that by it:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ሌሊት። የአባትህን በሬ፥ ሰባት ዓመት የሆነውን ሁለተኛውን በሬ፥ ውሰድ፥ የአባትህ የሆነውንም የበኣል መሠዊያ አፍርስ፥ በእርሱም ዙሪያ ያለውን የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ቍረጥ፤

verses.text_english: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ኮረብታ አናት ላይ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ አሳምረህ ሥራ ሁለተኛውንም በሬ ውሰድ፥ በዚያም በቈረጥኸው በማምለኪያ ዐፀዱ እንጨት ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቅርብ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do by day, that he did by night.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም ከባሪያዎቹ አሥር ሰዎችን ወስዶ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለው አደረገ፤ የአባቱን ቤተ ሰቦች የከተማውንም ሰዎች ስለ ፈራ ይህን በቀን ለማድረግ አልቻለም፥ ነገር ግን በሌሊት አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar built.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማውም ሰዎች ማልደው ተነሡ፥ እነሆም፥ የበኣል መሠዊያ ፈርሶ፥ በዙሪያው ያለውም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ተቈርጦ፥ በተሠራውም መሠዊያ ላይ ሁለተኛው በሬ ተሠውቶ አገኙት።

verses.text_english: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ይህን ነገር ያደረገ ማን ነው? ተባባሉ። በጠየቁና በመረመሩም ጊዜ። ይህን ነገር ያደረገ የኢዮአስ ልጅ ጌዴዎን ነው አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that by it.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማውም ሰዎች ኢዮአስን። የበኣልን መሠዊያ አፍርሶአልና፥ በዙሪያውም ያለውን የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ቈርጦአልና እንዲሞት ልጅህን አውጣ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst morning: if he a god, let him plead for himself, because hath cast down his altar.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአስም እርሱን የተቃወሙትን ሁሉ። ለበኣል ትምዋገቱለታላችሁን? ወይስ እርሱን ታድናላችሁን? የሚምዋገትለት ሁሉ እስከ ነገ ይሙት፤ እርሱ አምላክ ከሆነ መሠዊያውን ካፈረሰው ጋር ለራሱ ይምዋገት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በዚያ ቀን። መሠዊያውን አፍርሶአልና በኣል ከእርሱ ጋር ይምዋገት ብሎ ጌዴዎንን። ይሩበኣል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: ምድያማውያንም አማሌቃውያንም ሁሉ የምሥራቅም ሰዎች አንድ ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻገሩ፥ በኢይዝራኤልም ሸለቆ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በጌዴዎን ገባበት፥ እርሱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ነፋ፤ የአቢዔዝርም ሰዎች ተጠርተው በኋላው ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ ሁሉ መልክተኞችን ሰደደ እነርሱም ደግሞ ተጠርተው በኋላው ተከተሉት፤ መልክተኞችንም ወደ አሴርና ወደ ዛብሎን ወደ ንፍታሌምም ሰደደ፥ እነርሱም ሊገናኙአቸው ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም እግዚአብሔርን። እንደ ተናገርህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በእኔ እጅ ታድን እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; if the dew be on the fleece only, and dry upon all the earth , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በአውድማው ላይ የተባዘተ የበግ ጠጕር አኖራለሁ፤ በጠጕሩ ብቻ ላይ ጠል ቢሆን በምድሩም ሁሉ ደረቅ ቢሆን፥ እንደ ተናገርህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በእኔ እጅ እንድታድናቸው አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ሆነ፤ በነጋውም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ ጠጕሩንም ጨመቀው፥ ከጠጕሩም የተጨመቀው ጠል ቆሬ ሙሉ ውኃ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም እግዚአብሔርን። እኔ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ስናገር አትቈጣኝ፤ እኔ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ በጠጕሩ፥ እባክህ፥ ልፈትን፤ አሁንም በጠጕሩ ብቻ ላይ ደረቅ ይሁን፥ በምድሩም ሁሉ ላይ ጠል ይሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ሌሊት እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ በጠጕሩ ብቻ ላይ ደረቅ ነበረ፥ በምድሩም ሁሉ ላይ ጠል ነበረ። a

verses.text_english: Then Jerubbaal, who Gideon, and all the people that with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎን የተባለውም ይሩበኣል ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ማልደው ተነሡ፥ በሐሮድ ምንጭ አጠገብም ሰፈሩ፤ የምድያምም ሰፈር ከእነርሱ ወደ ሰሜን በኩል በሞሬ ኮረብታ አጠገብ በሸለቆው ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that with thee too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። ከአንተ ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ በዝቶአል፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤል። እጄ አዳነኝ ብሎ እንዳይታበይብኝ እኔ ምድያምን በእጃቸው አሳልፌ አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እንግዲህ። የፈራ የደነገጠም ከገለዓድ ተራራ ተነሥቶ ይመለስ ብለህ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ አውጅ አለው። ከሕዝቡም ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ተመለሱ፥ አሥርም ሺህ ቀሩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people yet many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። ሕዝቡ ገና ብዙ ነው፤ ወደ ውኃ አውርዳቸው፥ በዚያም እፈትናቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም። ይህ ከአንተ ጋር ይሂድ የምለው እርሱ ከአንተ ጋር ይሄዳል፤ እኔም። ይህ ከአንተ ጋር አይሂድ የምለው እርሱ አይሄድም አለው።

verses.text_english: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ወደ ውኃ አወረደ። እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። ውሻ እንደሚጠጣ ውኃ በምላሱ የሚጠጣውን ሁሉ፥ እርሱን ለብቻው አድርገው፤ እንዲሁም ሊጠጣ በጕልበቱ የሚንበረከከውን ሁሉ ለብቻው አድርገው አለው።

verses.text_english: And the number of them that lapped, their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verses.text_amharic: በእጃቸውም ውኃ ወደ አፋቸው አድርገው የጠጡት ቍጥር ሦስት መቶ ነበረ፤ የቀሩት ሕዝብ ግን ውኃ ሊጠጡ በጕልበታቸው ተንበረከኩ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the people go every man unto his place.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። በእጃቸው ውኃ በጠጡት በሦስት መቶ ሰዎች አድናችኋለሁ፥ ምድያማውያንንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ የቀሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ግን ወደ ስፍራቸው ይመለሱ አለው።

verses.text_english: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቡንም ስንቅና ቀንደ መለከት በእጃቸው ወሰዱ፤ የቀሩትንም የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ ድንኳናቸው ሰደዳቸው፥ ሦስቱን መቶ ሰዎች ግን በእርሱ ዘንድ ጠበቃቸው፤ የምድያምም ሰፈር ከእርሱ በታች በሸለቆው ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር። በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻቸዋለሁና ተነሥተህ ወደ ሰፈር ውረድ።

verses.text_english: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ለመውረድ ብትፈራ አንተ ከሎሌህ ከፉራ ጋር ወደ ሰፈሩ ውረድ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that in the host.
verses.text_amharic: የሚናገሩትንም ትሰማለህ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ትወርድ ዘንድ እጅህ ትበረታለች አለው። እርሱና ሎሌው ፉራ በሰፈሩ ዳርቻ ወደ ነበሩት ሰልፈኞች ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
verses.text_amharic: ብዛታቸውም እንደ አንበጣ የሆነ ምድያማውያንና አማሌቃውያን የምሥራቅም ሰዎች ሁሉ በሸለቆው ውስጥ ሰፍረው ነበር፤ የግመሎቻቸውም ብዛት ቍጥር እንደ ሌለው በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when Gideon was come, behold, a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም በደረሰ ጊዜ አንድ ሰው ሕልምን ለባልንጀራው ሲያጫውት። እነሆ፥ ሕልም አለምሁ፤ እነሆም፥ አንዲት የገብስ እንጎቻ ወደ ምድያም ሰፈር ተንከባልላ ወረደች፥ ወደ ድንኳኑም ደርሳ እስኪወድቅ ድረስ መታችው፥ ገለበጠችውም፥ ድንኳኑም ተጋደመ ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his fellow answered and said, This nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀራውም መልሶ። ይህ ነገር ከእስራኤል ሰው ከኢዮአስ ልጅ ከጌዴዎን ሰይፍ በቀር ሌላ አይደለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ምድያምንና ሠራዊቱን ሁሉ በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአል አለው።

verses.text_english: And it was , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም ሕልሙንና ትርጓሜውን በሰማ ጊዜ ሰገደ፤ ወደ እስራኤልም ሰፈር ተመልሶ። እግዚአብሔር የምድያምን ሠራዊት በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና ተነሡ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he divided the three hundred men three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስቱንም መቶ ሰዎች በሦስት ወገን ከፈላቸው፥ በሁሉም እጅ ቀንደ መለከትና ባዶ ማሰሮ፥ በማሰሮውም ውስጥ ችቦ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be , as I do, so shall ye do.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እኔን ተመልከቱ፥ እንዲሁም አድርጉ፤ እነሆም፥ ወደ ሰፈሩ ዳርቻ በደረስሁ ጊዜ እኔ እንደማደርግ እንዲሁ እናንተ አድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, of the LORD, and of Gideon.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከእኔም ጋር ያሉት ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከት ስንነፋ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከታችሁን ንፉ። ለእግዚአብሔርና ለጌዴዎን በሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So Gideon, and the hundred men that with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that in their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት መቶ ሰዎች በመካከለኛው ትጋት ትጋቱም በተጀመረ ጊዜ ወደ ሰፈሩ ዳርቻ መጡ፤ ቀንደ መለከቶችንም ነፉ፥ በእጃቸውም የነበሩትን ማሰሮች ሰባበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow : and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስቱም ወገኖች ቀንደ መለከቶችን ነፉ፥ ማሰሮችንም ሰበሩ፥ በግራ እጃቸውም ችቦችን፥ በቀኝ እጃቸውም ቀንደ መለከቶችን ይዘው እየነፉ። የእግዚአብሔርና የጌዴዎን ሰይፍ ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በየቦታው በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ቆመ፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ሮጠ፥ ጮኸ፥ ሸሸም።

verses.text_english: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስቱንም መቶ ቀንደ መለከቶች ነፉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የሰውን ሁሉ ሰይፍ በባልንጀራውና በሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ላይ አደረገ፤ ሠራዊቱም በጽሬራ በኩል እስከ ቤትሺጣ ድረስ በጠባት አጠገብ እስካለው እስከ አቤልምሖላ ዳርቻ ድረስ ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከንፍታሌምና ከአሴር ከምናሴም ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ምድያምን አሳደዱ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም። ምድያምን ለመገናኘት ውረዱ፥ እስከ ቤትባራም ድረስ ያለውን ውኃ፥ ዮርዳኖስን፥ ያዙባቸው ብሎ መልክተኞችን በኤፍሬም ወዳለው ተራራማ አገር ሁሉ ሰደደ። የኤፍሬም ሰዎችም ሁሉ ተሰብስበው እስከ ቤትባራ ድረስ ውኃውን፥ ዮርዳኖስን፥ ያዙ።

verses.text_english: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: የምድያምን ሁለቱን መኳንንት ሔሬብንና ዜብን ያዙ፤ ሔሬብንም በሔሬብ ዓለት አጠገብ ገደሉት፥ ዜብንም በዜብ መጥመቂያ ላይ ገደሉት፤ ምድያምንም አሳደዱ፥ የሔሬብንና የዜብንም ራስ ይዘው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ጌዴዎን መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬም ሰዎች። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ምድያምን ለመዋጋት በወጣህ ጊዜ ለምን አልጠራኸንም? አሉት። ጽኑ ጥልም ተጣሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እኔ ካደረግሁት እናንተ ያደረጋችሁት አይበልጥምን? የኤፍሬም ወይን ቃርሚያ ከአቢዔዝር ወይን መከር አይሻልምን?

verses.text_english: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የምድያምን መኳንንት ሔሬብንና ዜብን በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋል፤ እናንተ ያደረጋችሁትን የሚመስል እኔ ምን ማድረግ እችል ኖሮአል? አላቸው። ይህን በተናገረ ጊዜ ቍጣቸው በረደ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon came to Jordan, passed over, he, and the three hundred men that with him, faint, yet pursuing .
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም ከሦስቱ መቶ ሰዎች ጋር ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ደርሶ ተሻገረ፤ ምንም እንኳ ቢደክሙ ያሳድዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
verses.text_amharic: የሱኮትንም ሰዎች። የምድያምን ነገሥታት ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን ሳሳድድ፥ ደክመዋልና እኔን ለተከተሉ ሕዝብ እንጀራ፥ እባካችሁ፥ ስጡ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the princes of Succoth said, the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
verses.text_amharic: የሱኮትም አለቆች። እኛ ለሠራዊትህ እንጀራ እንድንሰጥ የዛብሄልና የስልማና እጅ አሁን በእጅህ ነውን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም። እግዚአብሔር ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን በእጄ አሳልፎ ሲሰጠኝ እኔ በምድረ በዳ እሾህና በኵርንችት ሥጋችሁን እገርፋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered .
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ጵኒኤል ወጣ፥ ለጵኒኤልም ሰዎች እንዲሁ አላቸው፤ የጵንኤልም ሰዎች የሱኮት ሰዎች እንደ መለሱ መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የጵኒኤልን ሰዎች ደግሞ። በደኅና በተመለስሁ ጊዜ ይህን ግንብ አፈርሰዋለሁ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሄልና ስልማናም ከሠራዊቶቻቸው ጋር በቀርቀር ነበሩ፤ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ መቶ ሀያ ሺህ ሰዎች ወድቀው ነበርና ከምሥራቅ ሰዎች ሠራዊት ሁሉ የቀሩ አሥራ አምስት ሺህ ያህል ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም የድንኳን ተቀማጮች ባሉበት መንገድ በኖባህና በዮግብሃ በምሥራቅ በኩል ወጣ፤ ሠራዊቱም ተዘልሎ ነበርና ሠራዊቱን መታ።

verses.text_english: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሄልና ስልማናም ሸሹ፤ እርሱም አሳደዳቸው፥ ሁለቱንም የምድያም ነገሥታት ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን ያዘ፥ ሠራዊቱንም ሁሉ አስደነገጠ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun ,
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮአስ ልጅም ጌዴዎን ከሔሬስ ዳገት ከሰልፍ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, threescore and seventeen men.
verses.text_amharic: ከሱኮትም ሰዎች አንድ ብላቴና ይዞ ጠየቀው፤ እርሱም የሱኮትን አለቆችና ሽማግሌዎች ሰባ ሳባት ሰዎች ጻፈለት።

verses.text_english: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men weary?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሱኮትም ሰዎች መጥቶ። ለደከሙት ሰዎችህ እንጀራ እንሰጥ ዘንድ የዛብሄልና የስልማና እጅ አሁን በእጅህ ነውን? ብላችሁ የተላገዳችሁብኝ፥ ዛብሄልና ስልማና እነሆ፥ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱንም ሽማግሌዎች ያዘ፥ የምድረ በዳንም እሾህና ኵርንችት ወስዶ የሱኮትን ሰዎች ገረፋቸው።

verses.text_english: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
verses.text_amharic: የጵኒኤልንም ግንብ አፈረሰ፥ የከተማይቱንም ሰዎች ገደላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou , so they; each one resembled the children of a king.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን። በታቦር የገደላችኋቸው ሰዎች እንዴት ያሉ ነበሩ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እንደ አንተ ያሉ ነበሩ፥ አንተንም ይመስሉ ነበር፤ መልካቸውም እንደ ንጉሥ ልጆች መልክ ነበረ ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: And he said, They my brethren, the sons of my mother: the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የእናቴ ልጆች ወንድሞቼ ነበሩ፤ አድናችኋቸው ቢሆን ኖሮ፥ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እኔ አልገድላችሁም ነበር አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he yet a youth.
verses.text_amharic: በኵሩንም ዬቴርን። ተነሥተህ ግደላቸው አለው፤ ብላቴናው ግን ገና ብላቴና ነበረና ስለ ፈራ ሰይፉን አልመዘዘም።

verses.text_english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that on their camels' necks.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሄልና ስልማናም። የሰው ኃይሉ እንደ ሰውነቱ ነውና አንተ ተነሥተህ ውደቅብን አሉት። ጌዴዎንም ተነሥቶ ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን ገደለ፥ በግመሎቻቸውም አንገት የነበሩትን ሥሉሴዎች ማረከ።

verses.text_english: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ጌዴዎንን። ከምድያም እጅ አድነኸናልና አንተ ልጅህም የልጅ ልጅህም ደግሞ ግዙን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም። እኔ አልገዛችሁም፥ ልጄም አይገዛችሁም፤ እግዚአብሔር ይገዛችኋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they Ishmaelites.)
verses.text_amharic: እስማኤላውያንም ስለ ነበሩ የወርቅ ጕትቻ ነበራቸውና ጌዴዎን። ሁላችሁ ከምርኮአችሁ ጕትቻችሁን እንድትሰጡኝ እለምናችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they answered, We will willingly give . And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ፈቅደን እንሰጥሃለን ብለው መለሱለት። መጎናጸፊያም አነጠፉ፥ ሰውም ሁሉ የምርኮውን ጕትቻ በዚያ ላይ ጣለ።

verses.text_english: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that about their camels' necks.
verses.text_amharic: የለመነውም የወርቅ ጕትቻ ሚዛኑ፥ ከአምባሩ፥ ከድሪውም፥ የምድያምም ነገሥታት ከለበሱት ከቀዩ ቀሚስ፥ በግመሎቻቸውም አንገት ከነበሩት ሥሉሴዎች ሌላ፥ ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሰቅለ ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
verses.text_amharic: ጌዴዎንም ኤፉድ አድርጎ አሠራው፥ በከተማውም በዖፍራ አኖረው፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ተከትሎት አመነዘረበት፤ ለጌዴዎንና ለቤቱም ወጥመድ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.text_amharic: ምድያምም በእስራኤል ልጆች ተዋረደ፥ ራሳቸውንም ዳግመኛ አላነሡም፤ በጌዴዎንም ዕድሜ ምድሪቱ አርባ ዓመት ዐረፈች።

verses.text_english: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮአስም ልጅ ይሩበኣል ሄዶ በቤቱ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
verses.text_amharic: ለጌዴዎንም ብዙ ሚስቶች ነበሩትና ከወገቡ የወጡ ሰባ ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And his concubine that in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
verses.text_amharic: በሴኬምም የነበረችው ቁባቱ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደችለት፥ ስሙንም አቤሜሌክ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮአስም ልጅ ጌዴዎን በመልካም ሽምግልና ሞተ፥ በአቢዔዝራውያንም ከተማ በዖፍራ በነበረችው በአባቱ በኢዮአስ መቃብር ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ጌዴዎን ከሞተ በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተመለሱ፥ በኣሊምንም ተከትለው አመነዘሩ፤ በኣልብሪትንም አምላካቸው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በዙሪያቸው ከነበሩት ከጠላቶቻቸው ሁሉ እጅ ያዳናቸውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን አላሰቡትም፤

verses.text_english: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, , Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ለእስራኤል በጎ ነገርን ሁሉ እንዳደረገ መጠን፥ እነርሱ ለጌዴዎን ለይሩበኣል ቤት ወረታ አላደረጉም።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የይሩበኣል ልጅ አቤሜሌክም ወደ ሴኬም ወደ እናቱ ወንድሞች ሄደ፥ ለእነርሱም ለእናቱ አባት ቤተ ሰቦችም ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I your bone and your flesh.
verses.text_amharic: በሴኬም ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ። ሰባ የሆኑት የይሩበኣል ልጆች ሁሉ ቢገዙአችሁ ወይስ አንድ ሰው ቢገዛችሁ ምን ይሻላችኋል? ብላችሁ ንገሩአቸው ብዬ እለምናችኋለሁ፤ ደግሞ እኔ የአጥንታችሁ ፍላጭ የሥጋችሁ ቍራጭ እንደ ሆንሁ አስቡ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He our brother.
verses.text_amharic: የእናቱም ወንድሞች ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ በሴኬም ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ ተናገሩ፤ እነርሱም። እርሱ ወንድማችን ነው ብለው አቤሜሌክን ለመከተል ልባቸውን አዘነበሉት።

verses.text_english: And they gave him threescore and ten of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ከበኣልብሪትም ቤት ሰባ ብር ሰጡት፤ በዚያም አቤሜሌክ ምናምንቴዎችንና ወሮበሎችን ቀጠረበት፥ እነርሱም ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባቱም ቤት ወደ ዖፍራ ሄደ፤ ሰባ የሆኑትን የይሩበኣልን ልጆች ወንድሞቹን በአንድ ድንጋይ ላይ አረዳቸው፤ ትንሹ የይሩበኣል ልጅ ኢዮአታም ግን ተሸሽጎ ነበርና ተረፈ።

verses.text_english: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that in Shechem.
verses.text_amharic: የሴኬምም ሰዎች ሁሉ ቤትሚሎም ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ሄደውም በሴኬም በዓምዱ አጠገብ ባለው በአድባሩ ዛፍ በታች አቤሜሌክን አነገሡ።

verses.text_english: And when they told to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር ለኢዮአታም በነገሩት ጊዜ፥ ሄዶ በገሪዛን ተራራ ራስ ላይ ቆመ፥ ድምፁንም አንሥቶ ጮኸ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። የሴኬም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰማችሁ ስሙኝ።

verses.text_english: The trees went forth to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጊዜ ዛፎች በላያቸው ንጉሥ ሊያነግሡ ጌዱ፤ ወይራውንም። በእኛ ላይ ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.text_english: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.text_amharic: ወይራው ግን። እግዚአብሔርና ሰዎች በእኔ የሚከበሩበትን ቅባቴን ትቼ በዛፎች ላይ እንድሰፍፍ ልሂድ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, reign over us.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፎችም በለሱን። መጥተህ በላያችን ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.text_english: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.text_amharic: በለሱ ግን። ጣፋጭነቴንና መልካሙን ፍሬዬን ትቼ በዛፎች ላይ እንድሰፍፍ ልሂድ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, reign over us.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፎችም ውይኑን። መጥተህ በላያችን ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.text_amharic: ወይኑም። እግዚአብሔርንና ሰውን ደስ የሚያሰኘውን የወይን ጠጄን ትቼ በዛፎች ላይ እንድሰፍፍ ልሂድ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, reign over us.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፎችም ሁሉ እሾህን። መጥተህ በላያችን ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, come put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: እሾሁም ዛፎችን። በእውነት እኔን በእናንተ ላይ ታነግሡኝ እንደ ሆነ ኑ ከጥላዬ በታች ተጠጉ። እንዲሁም ባይሆን እሳት ከእሾህ ይውጣ፥ የሊባኖስንም ዝግባ ያቃጥል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ አቤሜሌክን በማንገሣችሁ እውነትንና ቅንነትን አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ ለይሩበኣልም ለቤቱም በጎ አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እንዳደረገውም መጠን ለእርሱ የተገባውን አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.text_amharic: አባቴ ስለ እናንተ ተጋድሎ ነበርና፥ ከምድያምም እጅ ሊያድናችሁ ነፍሱን ለሞት አሳልፎ ሰጥቶ ነበርና፥

verses.text_english: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he your brother;)
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ዛሬ በአባቴ ቤት ተነሥታችኋልና፥ ሰባ የሆኑትን ልጆቹንም በአንድ ድንጋይ ላይ አርዳችኋልና፥ ወንድማችሁም ስለ ሆነ የባሪያይቱን ልጅ አቤሜሌክን በሴኬም ሰዎች ላይ አንግሣችኋልና፥

verses.text_english: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ለይሩበኣልና ለቤቱ እውነትንና ቅንነትን ዛሬ አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ በአቤሜሌክ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ በእናንተ ደስ ይበለው፤

verses.text_english: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ባይሆን ግን ከአቤሜሌክ እሳት ይውጣ፥ የሴኬምንም ሰዎች ቤትሚሎንም ይብላ፤ ከሴኬምም ሰዎች ከቤትሚሎም እሳት ይውጣ፥ አቤሜሌክንም ይብላ።

verses.text_english: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአታምም ሸሽቶ አመለጠ፥ ወንድሙንም አቤሜሌክን ፈርቶ ወደ ብኤር ሄደ፥ በዚያም ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም በእስራኤል ላይ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአቤሜሌክና በሴኬም ሰዎች መካከል ክፉን መንፈስ ሰደደ፤ የሴኬምም ሰዎች በአቤሜሌክ ላይ ተንኰል አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: That the cruelty to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው፥ በሰባ የይሩበኣል ልጆቹ ላይ የተደረገው ዓመፅ እንዲመጣ፥ ደማቸውም በገደላቸው በወንድማቸው በአቤሜሌክ ላይ፥ ወንድሞቹንም እንዲገድል እጆቹን ባጸኑአቸው በሴኬም ሰዎች ላይ እንዲሆን ነው።

verses.text_english: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.text_amharic: የሴኬምም ሰዎች በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ድብቅ ጦር አደረጉ፥ መንገድ ተላላፊዎችንም ሁሉ ይዘርፉ ነበር፤ አቤሜሌክም ይህን ወሬ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.text_amharic: የአቤድም ልጅ ገዓል ከወንድሞቹ ጋር መጥቶ ወደ ሴኬም ገባ፤ የሴኬምም ሰዎች ታመኑበት።

verses.text_english: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode , and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሻውም ወጡ ወይናቸውንም ለቀሙ፥ ጠመቁትም፥ የደስታም በዓል አደረጉ፤ ወደ አምላካቸውም ቤት ገቡ፥ በሉም ጠጡም፥ አቤሜሌክንም ሰደቡ።

verses.text_english: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who Abimelech, and who Shechem, that we should serve him? not the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.text_amharic: የአቤድም ልጅ ገዓል። የምንገዛለት አቤሜሌክ ማን ነው? ሴኬምስ ምንድርነው? እርሱ የይሩብኣል ልጅ አይደለምን? ዜቡልም የእርሱ ሹም አይደለምን? ለሴኬም አባት ለኤሞር ሰዎች ተገዙ፤

verses.text_english: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምንስ ለዚህ እንገዛለን? ይህ ሕዝብ ከእጄ በታች ቢሆን ኖሮ አቤሜሌክን አሳድደው ነበር አለ። አቤሜሌክንም። ሠራዊትህን አብዝተህ ና፥ ውጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱ ገዥ ዜቡልም የአቤድን ልጅ የገዓልን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣ።

verses.text_english: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ብሎ ወደ አቤሜሌክ በተንኰል መልክተኞች ላከ። እነሆ፥ የአቤድ ልጅ ገዓልና ወንድሞቹ ወደ ሴኬም መጥተዋል፥ በአንተም ላይ ከተማይቱን አሸፍተዋል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አንተና ከአንተ ጋር ያሉት ሕዝብ በሌሊት ተነሡ፥ በሜዳም ሸምቁ፤

verses.text_english: And it shall be, in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, he and the people that with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.text_amharic: ነገም ፀሐይ በወጣች ጊዜ ማልደህ ተነሣ፥ በከተማይቱም ላይ ውደቅባት፤ እነሆም፥ እርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉት ሕዝብ በአንተ ላይ በወጡ ጊዜ እጅህ እንዳገኘች አድርግበት።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክና ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በሌሊት ተነሡ፥ በሴኬምም አቅራቢያ በአራት ወገን ሸመቁበት።

verses.text_english: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that with him, from lying in wait.
verses.text_amharic: የአቤድም ልጅ ገዓል ወጥቶ በከተማይቱ በር አደባባይ ቆመ፤ አቤሜሌክና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉት ሕዝብ ከሸመቁበት ስፍራ ተነሱ።

verses.text_english: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as men.
verses.text_amharic: ገዓልም ሕዝቡን ባየ ጊዜ ዜቡልን። እነሆ፥ ከተራሮች ራስ ሕዝብ ይወርዳል አለው። ዜቡልም። ሰዎች የሚመስለውን የተራሮችን ጥላ ታያለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.text_amharic: ገዓልም ደግሞ። እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ በምድር መካከል ይወርዳል፤ አንድም ወገን በምዖንኒም በአድባሩ ዛፍ መንገድ ይመጣል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Then said Zebul unto him, Where now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who Abimelech, that we should serve him? not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.text_amharic: ዜቡልም። እንገዛለት ዘንድ አቤሜሌክ ማን ነው? ያልህበት አፍህ አሁን የት አለ? ይህ የናቅኸው ሕዝብ አይደለምን? አሁንም ወጥተህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተዋጋ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.text_amharic: ገዓልም በሴኬም ሰዎች ፊት ወጣ፥ ከአቤሜሌክም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown wounded, unto the entering of the gate.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም አሳደደው፤ በፊቱም ሸሸ፥ እስከ በሩም አደባባይ ድረስ ብዙዎች ተጐድተው ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም በአሩማ ተቀመጠ፤ ዜቡልም ገዓልንና ወንድሞቹን በሴኬም እንዳይኖሩ አሳደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም ሕዝቡ ወደ እርሻ ወጡ፤ አቤሜሌክም ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ወስዶ በሦስት ወገን ከፈላቸው፥ በሜዳም ሸመቀ፤ ተመለከተም፥ እነሆም፥ ሕዝቡ ከከተማ ወጡ፥ ተነሣባቸውም መታቸውም።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech, and the company that with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two companies ran upon all that in the fields, and slew them.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት ወገኖች ተጣደፉ በከተማይቱም በር አደባባይ ቆሙ፤ ሁለቱም ወገኖች በእርሻው ውስጥ በነበሩት ሁሉ ላይ ሮጡባቸው፥ መቱአቸውም።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም በዚያ ቀን ሁሉ ከከተማይቱ ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ከተማይቱንም ይዞ በእርሷ የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ገደለ፤ ከተማይቱንም አፈረሰ፥ ጨውም ዘራባት።

verses.text_english: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard , they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.text_amharic: በሴኬምም ግንብ ውስጥ የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ወደ ኤልብሪት ቤት ወደ ምሽጉ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም በሴኬም ግንብ ውስጥ ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ አንድ ሆነው እንደ ተሰበሰቡ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid on his shoulder, and said unto the people that with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, do as I .
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉትም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ሰልሞን ተራራ ወጡ፤ አቤሜሌክም በእጁ መጥረቢያ ወስዶ የዛፉን ቅርንጫፍ ቈረጠ፥ አንሥቶም በጫንቃው ላይ አደረገው፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት ሕዝብ። እኔ ሳደርግ ያያችሁትን፥ እናንተም ፈጥናችሁ እኔ እንዳደረግሁ አድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እንዲሁ እያንዳንዳቸው የዛፉን ቅርንጫፎች ቈረጡ፥ አቤሜሌክንም ተከትለው በምሽጉ ዙሪያ አኖሩአቸው፥ ምሽጉንም በላያቸው አቃጠሉት፤ የሴኬምም ግንብ ሰዎች ሁሉ ደግሞ አንድ ሺህ የሚያህሉ ወንድና ሴት ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም ወደ ቴቤስ መጣ፥ ቴቤስንም ከብቦ ያዛት።
