verses.text_english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማይቱም ውስጥ ብርቱ ግንብ ነበረ፥ የከተማይቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ወንዱና ሴቱ ሁሉ፥ ወደዚያ ሸሹ፤ ደጁንም በኋላቸው ዘጉ፥ ወደ ግንቡም ሰገነት ላይ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም ወደ ግንቡ ቀርቦ ይዋጋ ነበር፥ በእሳትም ሊያቃጥለው ወደ ግንቡ ደጅ ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.text_amharic: አንዲትም ሴት በአቤሜሌክ ራስ ላይ የወፍጮ መጅ ጣለችበት፥ አናቱንም ሰበረችው።

verses.text_english: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ፈጥኖ ጋሻ ዣግሬውን ጠርቶ። እኔን። ሴት ገደለችው እንዳይሉ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ግደለኝ አለው፤ ጕልማሳውም ወጋው፥ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች አቤሜሌክ እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ሰባ ወንድሞቹን በመግደል አቤሜሌክ በአባቱ ላይ ያደረገውን ክፋት እግዚአብሔር መለሰበት።

verses.text_english: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የሴኬምን ሰዎች ክፋት ሁሉ በራሳቸው ላይ መለሰባቸው፤ የይሩበኣልም ልጅ የኢዮአታም እርግማን ደረሰባቸው።

verses.text_english: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: ከአቤሜሌክም በኋላ ከይሳኮር ነገድ የሆነ የዱዲ ልጅ የፎሖ ልጅ ቶላ እስራኤልን ለማዳን ተነሣ፤ በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር ባለችው በሳምር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ላይ ሀያ ሦስት ዓመት ፈረደ፤ ሞተም፥ በሳምርም ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ ገለዓዳዊው ኢያዕር ተነሣ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.text_english: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which in the land of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: በሠላሳ የአህያ ግልገሎች ይቀመጡ የነበሩ ሠላሳ ልጆችም ነበሩት፤ ለእነርሱም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የኢያዕር መንደሮች የተባሉ በገለዓድ ምድር ያሉ ሠላሳ ከተሞች ነበሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያዕርም ሞተ፥ በቃሞንም ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ በኣሊምንና አስታሮትን የሶርያንም አማልክት፥ የሲዶናንም አማልክት፥ የሞዓብንም አማልክት፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች አማልክት፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንንም አማልክት አመለኩ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ተዉ፥ አላመለኩትምም።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ በፍልስጥኤማውያንና በአሞን ልጆች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which in Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዓመት የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሥቃይ አበዙባቸው፤ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በአሞራውያን አገር በገለዓድ ውስጥ ያሉትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሁሉ አሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ተጋፉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ከይሁዳ ከብንያምና ከኤፍሬም ቤት ጋር ደግሞ ሊዋጋ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገሩ፤ እስራኤልም እጅግ ተጨነቁ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። አምላካችንን ትተን በኣሊምን አምልከናልና አንተን በድለናል ብለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, not from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አላቸው። ግብፃውያን፥ አሞራውያንም፥ የአሞንም ልጆች፥

verses.text_english: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም፥ ሲዶናውያንም፥ አማሌቃውያንም፥ ማዖናውያንም አላስጨነቋችሁምን? ወደ እኔም ጮኻችሁ፥ እኔም ከእጃቸው አዳንኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ተዋችሁኝ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አመለካችሁ፤ ስለዚህም ደግሞ አላድናችሁም።

verses.text_english: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዳችሁም የመረጣችኋቸውን አማልክት ጥሩ፤ እነርሱም በመከራችሁ ጊዜ ያድኑአችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን። እኛ ኃጢአትን ሠርተናል፤ አንተ ደስ የሚያሰኝህን አድርግብን ዛሬ ግን፥ እባክህ፥ አድነን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችንም አማልክት ከመካከላቸው አስወገዱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመለኩ፤ ነፍሱም ስለ እስራኤል ጕስቍልና አዘነች።

verses.text_english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ተሰብስበው በገለዓድ ሰፈሩ። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተሰብስበው በምጽጳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And the people princes of Gilead said one to another, What man that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም፥ የገለዓድ አለቆች፥ እርስ በእርሳቸው። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር መዋጋት የሚጀምር ማን ነው? እርሱ በገለዓድ ሰዎች ሁሉ ላይ አለቃ ይሆናል አሉ። a

verses.text_english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓዳዊውም ዮፍታሔ ጽኑዕ ኃያል ሰው የጋለሞታ ሴትም ልጅ ነበረ። ገለዓድም ዮፍታሔን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou the son of a strange woman.
verses.text_amharic: የገለዓድም ሚስት ወንዶች ልጆችን ወለደችለት፤ ልጆችዋም ባደጉ ጊዜ ዮፍታሔን። የልዩ ሴት ልጅ ነህና በአባታችን ቤት አትወርስም ብለው አሳደዱት።

verses.text_english: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም ከወንድሞቹ ፊት ሸሽቶ በጦብ ምድር ተቀመጠ፤ ምናምንቴዎችም ሰዎች ተሰብስበው ዮፍታሔን ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወራት በኋላ የአሞን ልጆች ከእስራኤል ጋር ይዋጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ከእስራኤል ጋር በተዋጉ ጊዜ የገለዓድ ሽማግሌዎች ዮፍታሔን ከጦብ ምድር ለማምጣት ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔንም። ና፥ ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር እንድንዋጋ አለቃችን ሁን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም የገለዓድን ሽማግሌዎች። የጠላችሁኝ ከአባቴም ቤት ያሳደዳችሁኝ እናንተ አይደላችሁምን? አሁን በተጨነቃችሁ ጊዜ ለምን ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: የገለዓድም ሽማግሌዎች ዮፍታሔን። ከእኛ ጋር እንድትወጣ፥ ከአሞንም ልጆች ጋር እንድትዋጋ፥ ስለዚህ አሁን ወደ አንተ ተመልሰን መጣን፤ በገለዓድም ሰዎች ሁሉ ላይ አለቃችን ትሆናለህ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም የገለዓድን ሽማግሌዎች። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለመዋጋት ወደ አገሬ ብትመልሱኝ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጄ አሳልፎ ቢሰጣቸው፥ እኔ አለቃችሁ እሆናለሁን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
verses.text_amharic: የገለዓድም ሽማግሌዎች ዮፍታሔን። እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ምስክር ይሁን፤ በእርግጥ እንደ ቃልህ እናደርጋለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም ከገለዓድ ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ሄደ፥ ሕዝቡም በላያቸው ራስና አለቃ አደረጉት፤ ዮፍታሔም ቃሉን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በምጽጳ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም ወደ አሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ። አገሬን ለመውጋት ወደ እኔ የምትመጣ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ምን አለህ? ብሎ መልክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those again peaceably.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ የዮፍታሔን መልክተኞች። እስራኤል ከግብፅ በወጣ ጊዜ ከአርኖን ጀምሮ እስከ ያቦቅና እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ ምድሬን ስለ ወሰደ ነው፤ አሁንም በሰላም መልሱልኝ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም ወደ አሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ መልክተኞችን እንደ ገና ላከ፥

verses.text_english: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለው። ዮፍታሔ እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤል የሞዓብን ምድር የአሞንንም ልጆች ምድር አልወሰደም፤

verses.text_english: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከግብፅ በወጣ ጊዜ፥ እስራኤልም በምድረ በዳ በኩል ወደ ኤርትራ ባሕር በሄደ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቃዴስም በደረሰ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not : and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ። በምድርህ እንዳልፍ፥ እባክህ፥ ፍቀድልኝ ብሎ መልክተኞችን ላከ፤ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ አልሰማም። እንዲሁም ወደ ሞዓብ ንጉሥ ላከ፥ እርሱም አልፈቀደም።

verses.text_english: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon the border of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በቃዴስ ተቀመጠ። በምድረ በዳም በኩል ሄዱ፥ የኤዶምያስንና የሞዓብንም ምድር ዞሩ፤ ከሞዓብ ምድርም በምሥራቅ በኩል መጡ በአርኖንም ማዶ ሰፈሩ፤ አርኖንም የሞዓብ ድንበር ነበረና የሞዓብን ድንበር አላለፉም።

verses.text_english: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ወደ አሞራዊው ወደ ሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ወደ ሴዎን መልክተኞችን ላከ፤ እስራኤልም። በምድርህ በኩል ወደ ስፍራችን፥ እባክህ፥ አሳልፈን አለው።

verses.text_english: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዎንም እስራኤል በድንበሩ እንዲያልፍ አላመነውም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሴዎን ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ በያሀጽም ሰፈረ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሴዎንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠ፥ መቱአቸውም፤ እስራኤልም በዚያ ምድር ተቀምጠው የነበሩትን የአሞራውያንን ምድር ሁሉ ወረሰ።

verses.text_english: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ከአርኖንም እስከ ያቦቅ ድረስ ከምድረ በዳውም እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ የአሞራውያንን ምድር ሁሉ ወረሱ።

verses.text_english: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ከእስራኤል ፊት አሞራውያንን አስወገደ፤ አንተም ምድሩን ትወርሳለህን?

verses.text_english: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ ካሞሽ የሚሰጥህን አትወርስምን? እኛም አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ከፊታችን ያስወጣቸውን የእነርሱን ምድር እንወርሳለን።

verses.text_english: And now thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ከሞዓብ ንጉሥ ከሴፎር ልጅ ከባላቅ አንተ ትሻላለህን? በውኑ እርሱ እስራኤልን ከቶ ተጣላውን? ወይስ ተዋጋውን?

verses.text_english: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover within that time?
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም በሐሴቦንና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በአሮዔርና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በአርኖንም አቅራቢያ ባሉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ሦስት መቶ ዓመት ተቀምጦ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ ዘመን ስለ ምን አልወሰዳችኋቸውም ነበር?

verses.text_english: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አልበደልሁህም፥ አንተ ግን ከእኔ ጋር እየተዋጋህ በድለኸኛል፤ ፈራጁ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ልጆችና በአሞን ልጆች መካከል ዛሬ ይፍረድ።

verses.text_english: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዮፍታሔ የላከበትን ቃል የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ አልሰማም።

verses.text_english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በዮፍታሔ ላይ መጣ፤ እርሱም ገለዓድንና ምናሴን አለፈ፥ በገለዓድም ያለውን ምጽጳን አለፈ፥ ከምጽጳም ወደ አሞን ልጆች አለፈ።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም። በእውነት የአሞንን ልጆች በእጄ አሳልፈህ ብትሰጠኝ፥

verses.text_english: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD'S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሞን ልጆች ዘንድ በደኅና በተመለስሁ ጊዜ፥ ሊገናኘኝ ከቤቴ ደጅ የሚወጣው ማንኛውም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሆናል፤ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አቀርበዋለሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ተሳለ።

verses.text_english: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም ሊዋጋቸው ወደ አሞን ልጆች አለፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሮዔርም እስከ ሚኒትና እስከ አቤልክራሚም ድረስ ሀያ ከተሞችን በታላቅ አገዳደል መታቸው። የአሞንም ልጆች በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ተዋረዱ።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሄም ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ምጽጳ መጣ፥ እነሆም ልጁ ከበሮ ይዛ እየዘፈነች ልትገናኘው ወጣች፤ ለእርሱም አንዲት ብቻ ነበረች፤ ከእርስዋም በቀር ወንድ ወይም ሴት ሌላ ልጅ አልነበረውም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋንም ባየ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ። አወይ ልጄ ሆይ! ወደ እግዚአብሔር አፌን ከፍቻለሁና፥ ከዚያውም እመለስ ዘንድ አልችልምና በጣም አዋረድሽኝ አስጨነቅሽኝም አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said unto him, My father, thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, of the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አባቴ ሆይ፥ አፍህን ለእግዚአብሔር ከከፈትህ፥ እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶችህ በአሞን ልጆች ላይ ተበቅሎልሃልና በአፍህ እንደ ተናገርህ አድርግብኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
verses.text_amharic: አባትዋንም። ይህ ነገር ይደረግልኝ፤ ከዚህ ሄጄ በተራሮች ላይ እንድወጣና እንድወርድ፥ ከባልንጀሮቼም ጋር ለድንግልናዬ እንዳለቅስ ሁለት ወር አሰናብተኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Go. And he sent her away two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሂጂ አለ። ሁለት ወርም አሰናበታት፤ ከባልንጀሮችዋም ጋር ሄደች፥ በተራሮችም ላይ ለድንግልናዋ አለቀሰች።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
verses.text_amharic: ሁለትም ወር ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ወደ አባትዋ ተመለሰች፥ እንደ ተሳለውም ስእለት አደረገባት፤ እርስዋም ወንድ አላወቀችም ነበር።

verses.text_english: the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሴቶች ልጆች በዓመት በዓመቱ እየሄዱ የገለዓዳዊውን የዮፍታሔን ልጅ በዓመት አራት ቀን ሙሾ እንዲያወጡ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ልማድ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬም ሰዎች ተሰበሰቡ፥ ወደ ጻፎንም ተሻግረው ዮፍታሔን። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለመዋጋት ስታልፍ ከአንተ ጋር እንድንሄድ ስለ ምን አልጠራኸንም? ቤትህን በአንተ ላይ በእሳት እናቃጥለዋለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለእኔና ለሕዝቤ ጽኑ ጠብ ነበረን፤ በጠራኋችሁም ጊዜ ከእጃቸው አላዳናችሁኝም።

verses.text_english: And when I saw that ye delivered not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
verses.text_amharic: እንዳላዳናችሁኝም ባየሁ ጊዜ ነፍሴን በእጄ አድርጌ በአሞን ልጆች ላይ አለፍሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ ለምንስ ዛሬ ልትወጉኝ ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, among the Manassites.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም የገለዓድን ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ከኤፍሬምም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ኤፍሬምም። ገለዓዳውያን ሆይ፥ እናንተ በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ መካከል የተቀመጣችሁት ከኤፍሬም ሸሽታችሁ ነው ስላሉ የገለዓድ ሰዎች ኤፍሬምን መቱ።

verses.text_english: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was , that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓዳውያንም ኤፍሬም የሚያልፍበትን የዮርዳኖስን መሻገሪያ ያዙባቸው፤ የሸሸም የኤፍሬም ሰው። ልለፍ ባለ ጊዜ፥ የገለዓድ ሰዎች። አንተ ኤፍሬማዊ ነህን? አሉት፤ እርሱም። አይደለሁም ቢል፥

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ። አሁን ሺቦሌት በል አሉት፤ እርሱም አጥርቶ መናገር አልቻለምና። ሲቦሌት አለ፤ ይዘውም በዮርዳኖስ መሻገሪያ አረዱት፤ በዚያም ጊዜ ከኤፍሬም አርባ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎች ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ዮፍታሔም በእስራኤል ላይ ስድስት ዓመት ፈረደ። ገለዓዳዊውም ዮፍታሔ ሞተ፥ ከገለዓድም ከተሞች በአንዲቱ ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቤተ ልሔሙ ኢብጻን በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጅ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
verses.text_amharic: ሠላሳም ወንዶች ልጆችና ሠላሳ ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ሠላሳ ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ወደ ውጭ አገር ዳረ፤ ለወንዶች ልጆቹም ከውጭ አገር ሴቶች ልጆችን አመጣ። በእስራኤልም ላይ ሰባት ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.text_english: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.text_amharic: ኢብጻንም ሞተ፥ በቤተ ልሔምም ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ ዛብሎናዊው ኤሎም በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጅ ሆነ፤ እርሱም በእስራኤል ላይ አሥር ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.text_english: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
verses.text_amharic: ዛብሎናዊውም ኤሎም ሞተ፥ በዛብሎንም ምድር ባለችው በኤሎም ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የጲርዓቶናዊው የሂሌል ልጅ ዓብዶን በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጅ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
verses.text_amharic: አርባም ልጆች ሠላሳም የልጅ ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በሰባም አህያ ግልገሎች ላይ ይቀመጡ ነበር። በእስራኤልም ላይ ስምንት ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.text_english: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
verses.text_amharic: የጲርዓቶናዊውም የሂሌል ልጅ ዓብዶን ሞተ፥ በተራራማውም በአማሌቃውያን ምድር በኤፍሬም ባለችው በጲርዓቶን ተቀበረ። a

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ አርባ ዓመት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name Manoah; and his wife barren, and bare not.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳን ወገን የሆነ ማኑሄ የሚባል አንድ የጾርዓ ሰው ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም መካን ነበረች፥ ልጅም አልወለደችም።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ለሴቲቱ ተገልጦ እንዲህ አላት። እነሆ፥ አንቺ መካን ነሽ፥ ልጅም አልወለድሽም፤ ነገር ግን ትፀንሻለሽ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean :
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ተጠንቀቂ፤ የወይን ጠጅን የሚያሰክርም ነገር አትጠጪ፥ ርኩስም ነገር አትብዪ።

verses.text_english: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ትፀንሻለሽ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ፤ ልጁም ከእናቱ ማኅፀን ጀምሮ ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየ ናዝራዊ ይሆናልና በራሱ ላይ ምላጭ አይድረስበት፤ እርሱም እስራኤልን ከፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ ማዳን ይጀምራል።

verses.text_english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he , neither told he me his name:
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ወደ ባልዋ መጥታ። አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ እኔ መጣ፥ መልኩም እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ እጅግ የሚያስደነግጥ ነበረ፤ ከወዴትም እንደ መጣ አልጠየቅሁትም፥ እርሱም ስሙን አልነገረኝም።

verses.text_english: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean : for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እነሆ፥ ትፀንሻለሽ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ፤ ልጁም ከእናቱ ማኅፀን ጀምሮ እስኪሞት ድረስ ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየ ናዝራዊ ይሆናልና አሁን የወይን ጠጅ የሚያሰክርም ነገር አትጠጪ፥ ርኩስም ነገር አትብዪ አለኝ ብላ ተናገረች።

verses.text_english: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የላክኸው የእግዚአብሔር ሰው፥ እባክህ፥ እንደ ገና ወደ እኛ ይምጣ፤ ለሚወለደውም ልጅ ምን እንድናደርግ ያስገንዝበን ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለመነ።

verses.text_english: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband not with her.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የማኑሄን ድምፅ ሰማ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ እንደ ገና ለሴቲቱ በእርሻ ውስጥ ተቀምጣ ሳለች ተገለጠላት፤ ባልዋ ማኑሄ ግን ከእርስዋ ጋር አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the day.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ፈጥና ሮጠች ለባልዋም። እነሆ፥ በቀደም ዕለት ወደ እኔ የመጣው ሰው ደግሞ ተገለጠልኝ ብላ ነገረችው።

verses.text_english: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I .
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም ተነሥቶ ሚስቱን ተከተለ፥ ወደ ሰውዮውም መጥቶ። ከዚህች ሴት ጋር የተነጋገርህ አንተ ነህን? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and shall we do unto him?
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም። ቃልህ በደረሰ ጊዜ የልጁ ሥርዓት ምንድር ነው? የምናደርግለትስ ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ማኑሄን። ሴቲቱ ከነገርኋፅት ሁሉ ትጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: She may not eat of any that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean : all that I commanded her let her observe.
verses.text_amharic: ከወይንም ከሚወጣው ሁሉ አትብላ፥ የወይን ጠጅንም የሚያሰክርንም ነገር አትጠጣ፥ ርኩስም ነገር ሁሉ አትብላ፤ ያዘዝኋትን ሁሉ ትጠብቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ። የፍየል ጠቦት እስክናዘጋጅልህ ድረስ፥ እባክህ፥ ቆይ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he an angel of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ማኑሄን። አንተ የግድ ብትለኝ መብልህን አልበላም፤ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ማዘጋጀት ብትወድድ ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርበው አለው። ማኑሄም የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ መሆኑን አላወቀም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ። ነገርህ በደረሰ ጊዜ እንድናከብርህ ስምህ ማን ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it secret?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ። ስሜ ድንቅ ነውና ለምን ትጠይቃለህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered upon a rock unto the LORD: and did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም የፍየሉን ጠቦትና የእህሉን ቍርባን ወስዶ በድንጋይ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር አቀረበው። መልአኩም ተአምራት አደረገ፥ ማኑሄና ሚስቱም ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on , and fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ነበልባሉም ከመሠዊያው ላይ ወደ ሰማይ በወጣ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በመሠዊያው ነበልባል ውስጥ ዐረገ፤ ማኑሄና ሚስቱም ተመለከቱ፥ በምድርም በግምባራቸው ተደፉ።

verses.text_english: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he an angel of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ዳግመኛ ላማኑሄና ለሚስቱ አልተገለጠም፤ ያን ጊዜም ማኑሄ የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ መሆኑን አወቀ።

verses.text_english: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
verses.text_amharic: ማኑሄም ሚስቱን። እግዚአብሔርን አይተናልና ሞት እንሞታለን አላት።

verses.text_english: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these , nor would as at this time have told us as these.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቱም። እግዚአብሔርስ ሊገድለን ቢወድድ ኖሮ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን ከእጃችን ባልተቀበለን፥ ይህንም ነገር ሁሉ ባላሳየን፥ እንዲህ ያለ ነገርም በዚህ ጊዜ ባላስታወቀን ነበር አለችው።

verses.text_english: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ሶምሶን ብላ ጠራችው፤ ልጁም አደገ እግዚአብሔርም ባረከው።

verses.text_english: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በጾርዓና በኤሽታኦል መካከል ባለው በዳን ሰፈር ውስጥ ሊያነቃቃው ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም ወደ ተምና ወረደ፥ በተምናም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ልጆች አንዲት ሴት አየ።

verses.text_english: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥቶም ለአባቱና ለእናቱ። በተምና ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ልጆች አንዲት ሴት አይቻለሁ፤ አሁንም እርስዋን አጋቡኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then his father and his mother said unto him, never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱና እናቱም። ካልተገረዙት ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ሚስት ለማግባት ትሄድ ዘንድ ከወንድሞችህ ሴቶች ልጆች ከሕዝቤም ሁሉ መካከል ሴት የለምን? አሉት። ሶምሶንም አባቱን። ለዓይኔ እጅግ ደስ አሰኝታኛለችና እርስዋን አጋባኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: But his father and his mother knew not that it of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በፍልስጥኤማውያን ላይ ምክንያት ይፈልግ ነበርና ነገሩ ከእርሱ ሆነ፤ አባቱና እናቱ ግን አላወቁም። በዚያን ጊዜም ፍልስጥኤማውያን በእስራኤል ላይ ገዦች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም አባቱና እናቱም ወደ ተምና ወረዱ፥ በተምናም ወዳለው ወደ ወይኑ ስፍራ መጡ፤ እነሆም፥ የአንበሳ ደቦል እያገሣ ወደ እርሱ ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በእርሱ ላይ በኃይል ወረደ፤ ጠቦትን እንደሚቆራርጥ በእጁ ምንም ሳይኖር ቈራረጠው፤ ያደረገውንም ለአባቱና ለእናቱ አልነገረም።

verses.text_english: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
verses.text_amharic: ወርዶም ከሴቲቱ ጋር ተነጋገረ፤ እጅግም ደስ አሰኘችው።

verses.text_english: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂትም ቀን በኋላ ሊያገባት ተመለሰ፥ የአንበሳውንም ሬሳ ያይ ዘንድ ከመንገድ ፈቀቅ አለ፤ እነሆም፥ በአንበሳው ሬሳ ውስጥ ንብ ሰፍሮበት ነበር፥ ማርም ነበረበት።

verses.text_english: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
verses.text_amharic: በእጁም ወስዶ መንገድ ለመንገድ እየበላ ሄደ፤ ወደ አባቱና ወደ እናቱ መጣ፥ ማሩንም ሰጣቸው፥ እነርሱም በሉ፤ ማሩንም ከአንበሳው ሬሳ ውስጥ እንደ ወሰደ አልነገራቸውም።

verses.text_english: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ወደ ሴቲቱ ወረደ፤ ጎበዞችም እንዲህ ያደርጉ ነበርና ሶምሶን በዚያ በዓል አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
verses.text_amharic: ባዩትም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሌሎች ሠላሳ ሰዎች ሰጡት።

verses.text_english: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። እንቆቅልሽ ልስጣችሁ፤ በሰባቱም በበዓሉ ቀኖች ውስጥ ፈትታችሁ ብትነግሩኝ፥ ሠላሳ የበፍታ ቀሚስና ሠላሳ ልውጥ ልብስ እሰጣችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: But if ye cannot declare me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.
verses.text_amharic: መፍታትም ባትችሉ ሠላሳ የበፍታ ቀሚስና ሠላሳ ልውጥ ልብስ ትሰጡኛላችሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም። እንድንሰማው እንቆቅልሽህን ንገረን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከበላተኛው ውስጥ መብል ወጣ፥ ከብርቱም ውስጥ ጥፍጥ ወጣ አላቸው። ሦስት ቀንም እንቈቅልሹን መተርጎም አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? not ?
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ቀን የሶምሶንን ሚስት። እንቈቅልሹን እንዲነግረን ባልሽን ሸንግዪው፥ አለዚያም እንቺንና የአባትሽን ቤት በእሳት እናቃጥላለን፤ ወደዚህ ጠራችሁን ልትገፉን ነውን? አሉአት።

verses.text_english: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told my father nor my mother, and shall I tell thee?
verses.text_amharic: የሶምሶንም ሚስት በፊቱ እያለቀሰች። በእውነት ጠልተኸኛል፥ ከቶም አትወድደኝም፤ ለሕዝቤ ልጆች እንቈቅልሽ ሰጥተሃቸዋልና ትርጓሜውንም አልነገርኸኝም አለችው። እርሱም። እነሆ፥ ለአባቴና ለእናቴ አልነገርኋቸውም፥ ለአንቺ እነግርሻለሁን? አላት።

verses.text_english: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱንም የበዓል ቀን በፊቱ አለቀሰች፤ እርስዋም ነዝንዛዋለችና በሰባተኛው ቀን ነገራት። ትርጓሜውንም ለሕዝብዋ ልጆች ነገረች።

verses.text_english: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What sweeter than honey? and what stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ፀሐይ ሳትገባ የከተማይቱ ሰዎች። ከማር የሚጣፍጥ ምንድር ነው? ከአንበሳስ የሚበረታ ማን ነው? አሉት። እርሱም። በጥጃዬ ባላረሳችሁ የእንቈቅልሼን ትርጓሜ ባላወቃችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በላዩ በኃይል ወረደ፤ ወደ አስቀሎናም ወረደ፥ ከዚያም ሠላሳ ሰዎችን ገደለ፥ ልብሳቸውንም ወስዶ እንቈቅልሹን ለፈቱት ሰዎች ሰጠ። ቍጣውም ነደደ፥ ወደ አባቱም ቤት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: But Samson's wife was to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
verses.text_amharic: የሶምሶን ሚስት ግን ከተባበሩት ከሚዜዎቹ ለአንደኛው ሆነች። a

verses.text_english: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ በስንዴ መከር ጊዜ ሶምሶን የፍየል ጠቦት ይዞ ሚስቱን ሊጠይቅ ሄደና። ወደ ጫጉላ ቤት ወደ ሚስቴ ልግባ አለ፤ አባትዋ ግን እንዳይገባ ከለከለው።

verses.text_english: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
verses.text_amharic: አባትዋም። ፈጽመህ የጠላሃት መስሎኝ ለሚዜህ አጋባኋፅት፤ ታናሽ እኅትዋ ከርስዋ ይልቅ የተዋበች አይደለችምን? እባክህ፥ በእርስዋ ፋንታ አግባት አለው።

verses.text_english: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በፍልስጥኤማውያን ላይ ክፉ ባደርግ እኔ ንጹሕ ነኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም ሄዶ ሦስት መቶ ቀበሮች ያዘ፤ ችቦም ወስዶ ሁለት ሁለቱንም ቀበሮዎች በጅራታቸው አሰረ፥ በሁለቱም ጅራቶች ማካከል አንድ ችቦ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards olives.
verses.text_amharic: ችቦውንም አንድዶ በቆመው በፍልስጥኤማውያን እህል መካከል ሰደዳቸው፤ ነዶውንም የቆመውንም እህል ወይኑንም ወይራውንም አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም። ይህን ያደረገው ማን ነው? አሉ። እነርሱም። ሚስቱን ወስዶ ለሚዜው አጋብቶበታልና የተምናዊው አማች ሶምሶን ነው አሉ። ፍልስጥኤማያንም ወጥተው ሴቲቱንና አባትዋን በእሳት አቃጠሉ።

verses.text_english: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። እናንተ እንዲሁ ብታደርጉ እኔ እበቀላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ዐርፋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ጭን ጭናቸውን ብሎ በታላቅ አገዳደል መታቸው፤ ወርዶም በኤጣም ዓለት ባለው ዋሻ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ወጡ፥ በይሁዳም ሰፈሩ፥ በሌሒ ላይም ተበታትነው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ሰዎች። በእኛ ላይ የወጣችሁት ለምንድር ነው? አሉ። እነርሱም። ሶምሶንን ልናስር፥ እንዳደረገብንም ልናደርግበት መጥተናል አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines rulers over us? what this thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳም ሰዎች ሦስት ሺህ የሚያህሉ በኤጣም ዓለት ወዳለው ዋሻ ወርደው ሶምሶንን። ገዦቻችን ፍልስጥኤማውያን እንደ ሆኑ አታውቅምን? ያደረግህብን ይህ ምንድር ነው? አሉት። እርሱም። እንዳደረጉብኝ እንዲሁ አደረግሁባቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አስረን በፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ አሳልፈን ልንሰጥህ መጥተናል አሉት። ሶምሶንም። እናንተ እንዳትገድሉኝ ማሉልኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አስረን በእጃቸው አሳልፈን እንሰጥሃለን እንጂ አንገድልህም ብለው ተናገሩት። በሁለትም አዲስ ገመድ አስረው ከዓለቱ ውስጥ አወጡት።

verses.text_english: when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሌሒ በመጣ ጊዜም ፍልስጥኤማውያን እልል እያሉ ተገናኙት። የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በኃይል ወረደበት፤ ክንዱም የታሰረበት ገመድ በእሳት እንደ ተበላ እንደ ተልባ እግር ፈትል ሆነ፥ ማሰሪያዎቹም ከእጁ ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
verses.text_amharic: አዲስም የአህያ መንጋጋ አገኘ፥ እጁንም ዘርግቶ ወሰደው፥ በእርሱም አንድ ሺህ ሰው ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። በአህያ መንጋጋ ክምር በክምር ላይ አድርጌአቸዋለሁ፤ በአህያ መንጋጋ አንድ ሺህ ሰው ገድያለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
verses.text_amharic: መናገሩንም በፈጸመ ጊዜ መንጋጋውን ከእጁ ጣለ፤ የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም ራማትሌሒ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እጅግ ተጠምቶ ነበርና። አንተ ይህችን ታላቅ ማዳን በባሪያህ እጅ ሰጥተሃል፤ አሁንም በጥም እሞታለሁ፥ ባልተገረዙትም እጅ እወድቃለሁ ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: But God clave an hollow place that in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which in Lehi unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሌሒ ያለውን አዘቅት ሰነጠቀ፥ ከእርሱም ውኃ ወጣ፤ እርሱም ጠጣ፥ ነፍሱም ተመለሰች፥ ተጠናከረም። ስለዚህም የዚያን ቦታ ስም ዓይንሀቆሬ ብሎ ጠራው፤ ይህም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በሌሒ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
verses.text_amharic: በፍልስጥኤማውያንም ዘመን በእስራኤል ላይ ሀያ ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.text_english: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም ወደ ጋዛ ሄደ፥ በዚያም ጋለሞታ ሴት አይቶ ወደ እርስዋ ገባ።

verses.text_english: the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.
verses.text_amharic: የጋዛ ሰዎችም ሶምሶን ወደ ከተማ ውስጥ እንደ ገባ ሰሙ፥ ከበቡትም፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ በከተማይቱ በር ሸመቁበት። ማለዳ እንገድለዋለን ብለውም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ በዝምታ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that before Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም እስከ እኩለ ሌሊት ተኛ፤ እኩለ ሌሊትም በሆነ ጊዜ ተነሥቶ የከተማይቱን በር መዝጊያ ያዘ፥ ከሁለቱ መቃኖችና ከመወርወሪያውም ጋር ነቀለው፥ በትከሻውም ላይ አደረገ፥ በኬብሮንም ፊት ወዳለው ተራራ ራስ ላይ ተሸክሞት ወጣ በዚያም ጣለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name Delilah.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ በሶሬቅ ሸለቆ የነበረች ደሊላ የተባለች አንዲት ሴትን ወደደ።

verses.text_english: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength , and by what we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred of silver.
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤማውያንም መኳንንት ወደ እርስዋ ወጥተው። እርሱን ሸንግለሽ በእርሱ ያለ ታላቅ ኃይል በምን እንደ ሆነ፥ እኛስ እርሱን ለማዋረድ እናስረው ዘንድ የምናሸንፈው በምን እንደ ሆነ እወቂ፤ እኛም እያንዳንዳችን ሺህ አንድ መቶ ብር ሺህ አንድ መቶ ብር እንሰጥሻለን አሉአት።

verses.text_english: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength , and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
verses.text_amharic: ደሊላም ሶምሶንን። ታላቅ ኃይልህ በምን እንደ ሆነ፥ እንድትዋረድስ የምትታሰርበት ምን እንደ ሆነ፥ እባክህ፥ ንገረኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። በሰባት ባልደረቀ በእርጥብ ጠፍር ቢያስሩኝ፥ እደክማለሁ እንደ ሌላም ሰው እሆናለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤማውያንም መኳንንት ሰባት ያልደረቀ እርጥብ ጠፍር አመጡላት፥ በእርሱም አሰረችው።

verses.text_english: Now men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
verses.text_amharic: በጓዳዋም ውስጥ ሰዎች ተደብቀው ነበር። እርስዋም። ሶምሶን ሆይ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን መጡብህ አለችው። እርሱም የተልባ እግር ፈትል እሳት በሸተተው ጊዜ እንዲበጠስ ጠፍሩን በጣጠሰው፤ ኃይሉም በምን እንደ ሆነ አልታወቀም።

verses.text_english: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.
verses.text_amharic: ደሊላም ሶምሶንን። እነሆ፥ አታለልኸኝ፥ የነገርኸኝም ሀሰት ነው፤ አሁንም የምትታሰርበት ምን እንደ ሆነ፥ እባክህ፥ ንገረኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሥራ ባልተሠራበት በአዲስ ገመድ ቢያስሩኝ፥ እደክማለሁ፥ እንደ ሌላም ሰው እሆናለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines upon thee, Samson. And liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.
verses.text_amharic: ደሊላም አዲስ ገመድ ወስዳ በእርሱ አሰረችው፤ በጓዳዋም የተደበቁ ሰዎች ተቀምጠው ነበር። እርስዋም። ሶምሶን ሆይ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን መጡብህ አለችው። ገመዱንም ከክንዱ እንደ ፈትል በጣጠሰው።

verses.text_english: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.
verses.text_amharic: ደሊላም ሶምሶንን። እስከ አሁን ድረስ አታለልኸኝ፥ የነገርኸኝም ሐሰት ነው፤ የምትታሰርበት ምን እንደ ሆነ ንገረኝ አለችው። እርሱም። የራሴን ጠጕር ሰባቱን ጕንጕን ከድር ጋር ብትጐነጕኚው፥ በችካልም ብትቸክዪው፥ እደክማለሁ፥ እንደ ሌላም ሰው እሆናለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: And she fastened with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም በተኛ ጊዜ ደሊላ የራሱን ጠጕር ሰባቱን ጕንጕን ከድሩ ጋር ጐነጐነችው፥ በችካልም ቸከለችውና። ሶምሶን ሆይ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን መጡብህ አለችው። ከእንቅልፉም ነቃ፥ ችካሉንም ከነቆንዳላው ድሩንም ነቀለ።

verses.text_english: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength .
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አንተ። እወድድሻለሁ እንዴት ትለኛለህ፥ ልብህ ከእኔ ጋር አይደለም? ስታታልለኝ ይህ ሦስተኛ ጊዜህ ነው፥ ታላቅ ኃይልህም በምን እንደ ሆነ አልነገርኸኝም አለችው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, that his soul was vexed unto death;
verses.text_amharic: ዕለት ዕለትም በቃልዋ ነዘነዘችው አስቸገረችውም፥ ነፍሱም እስከ ሞት ድረስ ተጨነቀች።

verses.text_english: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any man.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከእናቴ ማኅፀን ጀምሬ ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየሁ ነኝና በራሴ ላይ ምላጭ አልደረሰም፤ የራሴንም ጠጕር ብላጭ ኃይሌ ከእኔ ይሄዳል፥ እደክማለሁም፥ እንደ ሌላም ሰው እሆናለሁ ብሎ የልቡን ሁሉ ገለጠላት።

verses.text_english: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.
verses.text_amharic: ደሊላም የልቡን ሁሉ እንደ ገለጠላት ባየች ጊዜ። የልቡን ሁሉ ገልጦልኛልና ይህን ጊዜ ደግሞ ኑ ብላ ላከችና የፍልስጥኤማውያንን መኳንንት ጠራች። የፍልስጥኤማውያን መኳንንትም ብሩን በእጃቸው ይዘው ወደ እርስዋ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በጕልበትዋ ላይ አስተኛችው፤ አንድ ሰውም ጠራች፥ እርሱም ሰባቱን የራሱን ጕንጕን ላጨው። ልታዋርደውም ጀመረች፥ ኃይሉም ከእርሱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And she said, The Philistines upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ሶምሶን ሆይ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን መጡብህ አለችው። ከእንቅልፉም ነቅቶ። እወጣለሁ እንደ ወትሮውም ጊዜ አደርጋለሁ አለ። ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ እንደ ተለየው አላወቀም።

verses.text_english: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ይዘው ዓይኖቹን አወጡት፤ ወደ ጋዛም አምጥተው በናስ ሰንሰለት አሰሩት፤ በግዞትም ሆኖ እህል ይፈጭ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
verses.text_amharic: የራሱም ጠጕር ከላጩት በኋላ ያድግ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤምም መኳንንት። አምላካችን ጠላታችንን ሶምሶንን በእጃችን አሳልፎ ሰጠን እያሉ ለአምላካቸው ለዳጎን ታላቅ መሥዋዕት ይሠዉ ዘንድ ደስም ይላቸው ዘንድ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ባዩት ጊዜ። ምድራችንን ያጠፋውን፥ ከእኛም ብዙ ሰው የገደለውን ጠላታችንን አምላካችን በእጃችን አሳልፎ ሰጠን እያሉ አምላካቸውን አመሰገኑ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸውንም ደስ ባለው ጊዜ። በፊታችን እንዲጫወት ሶምሶንን ጥሩት አሉ። ሶምሶንንም ከግዞት ቤት ጠሩት፥ በፊታቸውም ተጫወተ፤ ተዘባበቱበትም፥ በምሰሶና በምሰሶም መካከል አቆሙት።

verses.text_english: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም እጁን የያዘውን ብላቴና። ቤቱን የደገፉትን ምሰሶች እጠጋባቸው ዘንድ፥ እባክህ፥ አስይዘኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines there; and upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
verses.text_amharic: በቤትም ውስጥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ሞልተውበት ነበር፥ የፍልስጥኤምም መኳንንት ሁሉ በዚያ ነበሩ፤ በቤቱም ሰገነት ላይ ሶምሶን ሲጫወት የሚያዩ ሦስት ሺህ የሚያህሉ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። ስለ ሁለቱ ዓይኖቼ ፍልስጥኤማውያንን አሁን እንድበቀል፥ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ሆይ፥ እባክህ፥ አስበኝ፤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ፥ እባክህ፥ አበርታኝ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም ቤቱ ተደግፎባቸው የነበሩትን ሁለቱን መካከለኞች ምሰሶች ያዘ፤ አንዱን በቀኝ እጁ አንዱንም በግራ እጁ ይዞ ተጠጋባቸው።

verses.text_english: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than which he slew in his life.
verses.text_amharic: ሶምሶንም። ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ልሙት አለ፤ ተጎንብሶም ምሰሶቹን በሙሉ ኅይሉ ገፋ፥ ቤቱም በውስጡ በነበሩት በመኳንንቱም በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ላይ ወደቀ፤ በሞቱም የገደላቸው ሙታን በሕይወት ሳለ ከገደላቸው በዙ።

verses.text_english: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹም የአባቱ ቤተ ሰቦችም ሁሉ ወረዱ፥ ይዘውም አመጡት፤ በጾርዓና በኤሽታኦል መካከል ባለው በአባቱ በማኑሄ መቃብር ቀበሩት። እርሱም በእስራኤል ላይ ሀያ ዓመት ፈረደ። a

verses.text_english: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name Micah.
verses.text_amharic: በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር ሚካ የተባለ አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed of the LORD, my son.
verses.text_amharic: እናቱንም። ከአንቺ ዘንድ የተወሰደው፥ የረገምሽበትም፥ በጆሮዬም የተናገርሽበት አንድ ሺህ አንድ መቶ ብር፥ እነሆ፥ በእኔ ዘንድ አለ፤ እኔም ወስጄዋለሁ አላት። እናቱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And when he had restored the eleven hundred of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱን ሺህ አንዱን መቶ ብርም መለሰላት፤ እናቱም። ይህን ብር የተቀረጸ ምስልና ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስል አድርጌ ከእጄ ስለ ልጄ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀድሰዋለሁ፤ አሁንም ለአንተ እመልሰዋለሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናቱም ገንዘቡን በመለሰላት ጊዜ እናቱ ሁለቱን መቶ ብር ወስዳ ለአንጥረኛ ሰጠችው፥ እርሱም የተቀረጸ ምስልና ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስል አደረገው። ያም በሚካ ቤት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮውም ሚካ የአምላክ ቤት ነበረው፤ ኤፉድና ተራፊም አደረገ፥ ከልጆቹም አንዱን ቀደሰው፥ ካህንም ሆነለት።

verses.text_english: In those days no king in Israel, every man did right in his own eyes.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን በእስራኤል ዘንድ ንጉሥ አልነበረም፤ ሰውም ሁሉ በፊቱ መልካም መስሎ የታየውን ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who a Levite, and he sojourned there.
verses.text_amharic: በቤተ ልሔም ይሁዳም ከይሁዳ ወገን የሆነ አንድ ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ እርሱም ሌዋዊ ነበረ፥ በዚያም ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሰው የሚቀመጥበትን ስፍራ ለመሻት ከከተማው ከቤተ ልሔም ይሁዳ ወጣ፤ ሲሔድም ወደ ተራራማው ወደ ኤፍሬም አገር ወደ ሚካ ቤት መጣ።

verses.text_english: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find .
verses.text_amharic: ሚካም። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። እርሱም። ከቤተ ልሔም ይሁዳ የሆንሁ ሌዋዊ ነኝ፤ የምቀመጥበትንም ስፍራ ለመሻት እሄዳለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.
verses.text_amharic: ሚካም። ከእኔ ዘንድ ተቀመጥ፥ አባትና ካህንም ሁነኝ፤ እኔም ልብሶችንና ምግብህን፥ በእየዓመቱም አሥር ብር እሰጥሃለሁ አለው። ሌዋዊውም ገባ።

verses.text_english: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋዊውም ከሰውዮው ጋር መቀመጥን ፈቀደ፤ ጕልማሳውም ከልጆቹ እንደ አንዱ ሆነለት።

verses.text_english: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
verses.text_amharic: ሚካም ሌዋዊውን ቀደሰ፥ ጕልማሳውም ካህኑ ሆነለት፥ በሚካም ቤት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to priest.
verses.text_amharic: ሚካም። ሌዋዊ ካህን ስለ ሆነልኝ እግዚአብሔር መልካም እንዲሠራልኝ አሁን አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: In those days no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን በእስራኤል ዘንድ ንጉሥ አልነበረም። እስከዚያም ቀን ድረስ ለዳን ነገድ በእስራኤል ነገዶች መካከል ርስት አልደረሳቸውም ነበርና በዚያ ዘመን የሚቀመጡባት ርስት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.
verses.text_amharic: የዳንም ልጆች ከወገናቸው አምስት ጽኑዓን ሰዎች ምድሪቱን እንዲሰልሉና እንዲመረምሩ። ሂዱ ምድሪቱንም ሰልሉ ብለው ከጾርዓና ከኤሽታኦል ሰደዱ። እነዚያም ወደ ተራራማው ወደ ኤፍሬም አገር ወደ ሚካ ቤት መጥተው በዚያ አደሩ።

verses.text_english: When they by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this ? and what hast thou here?
verses.text_amharic: በሚካ ቤት አጠገብም በነበሩ ጊዜ የሌዋዊውን የጕልማሳውን ድምፅ አወቁ፤ ወደ እርሱም ቀርበው። ወደዚህ ማን አመጣህ? በዚህስ የምታደርገው ምንድር ነው? በዚህስ ምን አለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሚካ እንዲህ እንዲህ አደረገልኝ፥ ቀጠረኝም፥ እኔም ካህን ሆንሁለት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። የምንሄድበት መንገድ የቀና መሆኑን እናውቅ ዘንድ፥ እባክህ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቅልን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD your way wherein ye go.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የምትሄዱበት መንገድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ነውና በደኅና ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and no magistrate in the land, that might put to shame in thing; and they far from the Zidonians, and had no business with man.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱም ሰዎች ሄዱ ወደ ሌሳም መጡ፥ በውስጡም የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ተዘልለው አዩአቸው፥ አንደ ሲዶናውያንም ልማድ ጸጥ ብለው ተዘልለው ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ የሚያስቸግራቸውም የሚገዛቸውም አልነበረም፥ ከሲዶናውያንም ርቀው ከሰውም ሁሉ ተለይተው ለብቻቸው ይኖሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What ye?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ወንድሞቻቸውም ወደ ጾርዓና ወደ ኤሽታኦል ተመለሱ፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም። ምን ወሬ ይዛችኋል? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it very good: and ye still? be not slothful to go, to enter to possess the land.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ምድሪቱን እግጅ መልካም እንደ ሆነች አይተናልና ተነሡ፥ በእነርሱ ላይ እንውጣ፤ እናንተ ዝም ትላላችሁን? ትሄዱ ዘንድ ምድሪቱንም ለመውረስ ትገቡ ዘንድ ቸል አትበሉ።

verses.text_english: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where no want of any thing that in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በሄዳችሁ ጊዜ ተዘልለው ወደ ተቀመጡ ሕዝብ ትደርሳላችሁ፥ ምድሪቱም ሰፊ ናት፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ካለው ነገር ሁሉ አንዳች የማይጎድልበትን ስፍራ በእጃችሁ ሰጥቶአል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳን ወገንም የጦር ዕቃ የታጠቁ ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ከዚያ ከጾርዓና ከኤሽታኦል ተነሥተው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, behind Kirjathjearim.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥተውም በይሁዳ ባለችው በቂርያትይዓሪም ሰፈሩ፤ ስለዚህም የዚያ ስፍራ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የዳን ሰፈር ተብሎ ተጠራ፤ እነሆም፥ ከቂርያትይዓሪም በስተ ኋላ ነው።

verses.text_english: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ተራራማው ወደ ኤፍሬም አገር አለፉ፤ ወደ ሚካም ቤት መጡ።

verses.text_english: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.
verses.text_amharic: የሌሳን ምድር ሊሰልሉ ሄደው የነበሩት አምስቱ ሰዎችም ወንድሞቻቸውን። በእነዚህ ቤቶች ውስጥ ኤፉድና ተራፊም፥ የተቀረጸ ምስልና ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልም እንዳሉ ታውቃላችሁን? አሁንም የምታደርጉትን ምከሩ ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
verses.text_amharic: ከመንገዱም ፈቀቅ ብለው ጕልማሳው ሌዋዊ ወደ ነበረበት ወደ ሚካ ቤት መጡ፥ ደኅንነቱንም ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
verses.text_amharic: የጦር ዕቃ የታጠቁት፥ ከዳን ልጆችም የሆኑት ስድስቱ መቶ ሰዎች በደጃፉ አጠገብ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, came in thither, took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱንም ሊሰልሉ ሄደው የነበሩት አምስቱ ሰዎች ወጥተው ወደዚያ ገቡ፤ የተቀረጸውን ምስል ኤፉዱንም ተራፊሙንም ቀልጦ የተሠራውን ምስልም ወሰዱ፤ ካህኑም የጦር ዕቃ ከታጠቁት ከስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ጋር በደጃፉ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And these went into Micah's house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ወደ ሚካ ቤት ገብተው የተቀረጸውን ምስል ኤፉዱንም ተራፊሙንም ቀልጦ የተሠራውን ምስልም በወሰዱ ጊዜ፥ ካህኑ። ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ዝም በል፥ እጅህንም በአፍህ ላይ ጫን፥ ከእኛም ጋር መጥተህ አባትና ካህን ሁንልን፤ ለአንድ ሰው ቤት ካህን መሆን ወይስ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ለነገድና ለወገን ካህን መሆን ማናቸው ይሻልሃል? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም በልቡ ደስ አለው፥ ኤፉዱንም ተራፊሙንም የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ወሰደ፥ በሕዝቡም መካከል ሄደ።

verses.text_english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዞረው ሄዱ፥ ሕፃናቶችንና ከብቶችን ዕቃዎችንም በፊታቸው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚካም ቤት በራቁ ጊዜ የሚካ ጐረቤቶች ተሰበሰቡ፥ የዳንም ልጆች ተከትለው ደረሱባቸው።

verses.text_english: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዳንም ልጆች ጮኹ፥ የዳንም ልጆች ፊታቸውን መልሰው ሚካን። የምትጮኸው ምን ሆነህ ነው? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what this ye say unto me, What aileth thee?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሠራኋቸውን አማልክቴን ካህኑንም ይዛችሁ ሄዳችኋል፤ ሌላ ምን አለኝ? እናንተስ። ምን ሆነሃል እንዴት ትሉኛላችሁ? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.
verses.text_amharic: የዳንም ልጆች። የተቈጡ ሰዎች እንዳይወድቁብህ ነፍስህም የቤተ ሰቦችህም ነፍስ እንዳይጠፋብህ፥ ድምፅህን በእኛ መካከል አታሰማ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
verses.text_amharic: የዳንም ልጆች መንገዳቸውን ሄዱ፤ ሚካም ከእርሱ እንደ በረቱ ባየ ጊዜ ተመልሶ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And they took which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሚካ የሠራውን ጣዖትና ለእርሱ የነበረውን ካህን ይዘው ወደ ሌሳ፥ ጸጥ ብሎ ተዘልሎም ወደ ተቀመጠው ሕዝብ፥ መጡ፤ በሰይፍም ስለት መቱአቸው፥ ከተማይቱንም በእሳት አቃጠሉአት።

verses.text_english: And no deliverer, because it far from Zidon, and they had no business with man; and it was in the valley that by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱ ከሲዶና ራቅ ያለች ነበረችና፥ እነርሱም ከሌሎች ሰዎች ተለይተው ብቻቸውን ይኖሩ ነበርና የሚታደግ አልነበራቸውም። ሌሳም በቤትሮዖብ አጠገብ ባለች ሸለቆ ውስጥ ነበረች። ከተማይቱንም ሠርተው ተቀመጡባት።

verses.text_english: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city Laish at the first.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱንም ከእስራኤል በተወለደው በአባታቸው በዳን ስም ዳን ብለው ጠሩአት፤ የከተማይቱም ስም አስቀድሞ ሌሳ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
verses.text_amharic: የዳንም ልጆች የተቀረጸውን ምስል ለራሳቸው አቆሙ፤ የሙሴም ልጅ የጌርሳም ልጅ ዮናታን፥ እርሱና ልጆቹ የአገሩ ሰዎች እስከሚማረኩበት ቀን ድረስ የዳን ነገድ ካህናት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they set them up Micah's graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
verses.text_amharic: ሚካም ያደረገውን የተቀረጸ ምስል የእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሴሎ ባለበት ዘመን ሁሉ አቆሙ። a

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in those days, when no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን በእስራኤል ዘንድ ንጉሥ በሌለበት ጊዜ በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ማዶ የተቀመጠ ሌዋዊ ነበረ፤ ከቤተ ልሔምም ይሁዳ ቁባት አገባ።

verses.text_english: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.
verses.text_amharic: ቁባቱም አመነዘረችበት፥ ትታውም ወደ አባትዋ ቤት ወደ ቤተ ልሔም ይሁዳ ሄደች፤ በዚያም አራት ወር ተቀመጠች።

verses.text_english: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father's house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.
verses.text_amharic: ባልዋም ተነሣ፥ ከእርስዋም ዕርቅ ሽቶ ወደ ቤቱ ሊመልሳት ፍለጋዋን ተከትሎ ሄደ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድ አሽከር ሁለትም አህዮች ነበሩ። እርስዋም ወደ አባትዋ ቤት አገባችው፤ አባትዋም ባየው ጊዜ ደስ ብሎት ተገናኘው።

verses.text_english: And his father in law, the damsel's father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.
verses.text_amharic: የብላቴናይቱም አባት አማቱ የግድ አለ፥ በቤቱም ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጠ፤ በሉም፥ ጠጡም፥ በዚያም አደሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel's father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ቀን ማልደው ተነሡ፥ እርሱም ለመሄድ ተነሣ፤ የብላቴናይቱም አባት አማቹን። ሰውነትህን በቍራሽ እንጀራ አበርታ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ትሄዳለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel's father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀመጡም በአንድ ላይም በሉ ጠጡም፤ የብላቴናይቱም አባት ሰውዮውን። ዛሬ ደግሞ ከዚህ ለማደር፥ እባክህ፥ ፍቀድ፥ ልብህንም ደስ ይበለው አለው።

verses.text_english: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮውም ሊሄድ ተነሣ፤ አማቱ ግን የግድ አለው፥ ዳግመኛም በዚያ አደረ።

verses.text_english: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel's father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.
verses.text_amharic: በአምስተኛውም ቀን ለመሄድ ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ የብላቴናይቱም አባት። እባክህ፥ ሰውነትህን አበርታ፥ ቀኑም እስኪዋገድ ድረስ ቆይ አለው። ሁለቱም በሉ።

verses.text_english: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel's father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮውም ከቁባቱና ከአሽከሩ ጋር ለመሄድ በተነሣ ጊዜ የብላቴናይቱ አባት አማቱ። እነሆ፥ ቀኑ ተዋግዶአል፤ በዚህ እደሩ፤ እነሆ፥ ቀኑ ለማለፍ ተዋግዶአል፤ ልባችሁ ደስ እንዲለው በዚህ እደሩ፤ ነገም ወደ ቤታችሁ እንድትደርሱ ማልዳችሁ መንገዳችሁን ትሄዳላችሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which Jerusalem; and with him two asses saddled, his concubine also with him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮው ግን በዚያ ሌሊት ለማደር አልፈቀደም፥ ተነሥቶም ሄደ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ወደ ተባለች ወደ ኢያቡስ ፊት ለፊት ደረሰ። ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት የተጫኑ አህዮች ነበሩ፥ ቁባቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረች።

verses.text_english: when they by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢያቡስም በደረሱ ጊዜ መሸባቸው፥ አሽከሩም ጌታውን። ና፥ ወደዚህ ወደ ኢያቡሳውያን ከተማ፥ እባክህ፥ እናቅና፥ በእርስዋም እንደር አለው።

verses.text_english: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም። ከእስራኤል ወገን ወዳልሆነች ወደ እንግዳ ከተማ አንገባም፤ እኛ ወደ ጊብዓ እንለፍ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
verses.text_amharic: አሽከሩንም። ና፥ ከእነዚህ ስፍራ ወደ አንዱ እንቅረብ፤ በጊብዓ ወይም በራማ እንደር አለው።

verses.text_english: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them by Gibeah, which to Benjamin.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዳቸውንም ይዘው ሄዱ፤ የብንያምም ነገድ በምትሆነው በጊብዓ አጠገብ ሳሉ ፀሐይ ገባችባቸው።

verses.text_english: And they turned aside thither, to go in to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for no man that took them into his house to lodging.
verses.text_amharic: በጊብዓም ገብተው ያድሩ ዘንድ ወደዚያ አቀኑ። በገባም ጊዜ ሊያሳድራቸው ማንም በቤቱ አልተቀበላቸውምና በከተማው አደባባይ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place Benjamites.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሽማግሌ ከእርሻው ሥራ ወደ ማታ መጣ፤ ይህም ሰው ከተራራማው ከኤፍሬም አገር ነበረ በጊብዓም በእንግድነት ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ የዚያ አገር ሰዎች ግን ብንያማውያን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ መንገደኛውን በከተማው አደባባይ አየ፤ ሽማግሌውም። ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? ከወዴትስ መጣህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, We passing from Bethlehemjudah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence I: and I went to Bethlehemjudah, but I going to the house of the LORD; and there no man that receiveth me to house.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እኛ ከቤተ ልሔም ይሁዳ ወደ ተራራማው ወደ ኤፍሬም አገር ማዶ እናልፋለን፤ እኔ ከዚያ ነኝ፥ ወደ ቤተ ልሔምም ይሁዳ ሄጄ ነበር፥ አሁንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እሄዳለሁ፤ በቤቱም የሚያሳድረኝ አጣሁ፤

verses.text_english: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man with thy servants: no want of any thing.
verses.text_amharic: ለአህዮቻችን ገለባና ገፈራ አለን፤ ለእኔና ለገረድህ ከባሪያዎችህም ጋር ላለው አሽከር እንጀራና የወይን ጠጅ አለን፤ አንዳችም አላጣንም አለው።

verses.text_english: And the old man said, Peace with thee; howsoever all thy wants upon me; only lodge not in the street.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌውም። ሰላም ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ የምትሻውንም ሁሉ እኔ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ በአደባባይ ግን አትደር አለው።

verses.text_english: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቱም አስገባው፥ ለአህዮቹም ገፈራ ጣለላቸው፤ እግራቸውንም ታጠቡ፥ በሉም ጠጡም።

verses.text_english: as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውነታቸውንም ደስ ባሰኙ ጊዜ ወስላቶች የሆኑ የከተማው ሰዎች ቤቱን ከበቡ በሩንም ይደበድቡ ነበር፤ ባለቤቱንም ሽማግሌውን። ወደ ቤትህ የገባውን ሰው እንድንደርስበት አውጣልን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, , I pray you, do not wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.
verses.text_amharic: ባለቤቱም ሽማግሌው ወደ እነርሱ ወጥቶ። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ይህን ክፉ ነገር፥ እባካችሁ፥ አታድርጉ፤ ይህ ሰው ወደ ቤቴ ገብቶአልና እንደዚህ ያለ ኃጢአት አትሥሩ።

verses.text_english: Behold, my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.
verses.text_amharic: ድንግል ልጄና የእርሱም ቁባት፥ እነሆ፥ አሉ፥ አሁንም አወጣቸዋለሁ፤ አዋርዱአቸው እንደ ወደዳችሁም አድርጉባቸው፤ ነገር ግን በዚህ ሰው ላይ እንደዚህ ያለ ኃጢአት አታድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹ ግን ነገሩን አልሰሙም፤ ሰውዮውም ቁባቱን ይዞ አወጣላቸው፤ ደረሱባትም፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ እስኪነጋ ድረስ አመነዘሩባት፤ ጎህ በቀደደም ጊዜ ለቀቁአት።

verses.text_english: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man's house where her lord , till it was light.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ማለዳ መጣች፥ ጌታዋም ባለበት በሰውዮው ቤት ደጅ ወድቃ እስኪነጋ ድረስ በዚያ ቀረች።

verses.text_english: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down the door of the house, and her hands upon the threshold.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዋም ማለዳ ተነሣ የቤቱንም ደጅ ከፈተ፥ መንገዱንም ለመሄድ ወጣ፤ እነሆም ቁባቲቱ ሴት በቤቱ ደጃፍ ወድቃ፥ እጅዋም በመድረክ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ተነሺ፥ እንሂድ አላት፤ እርስዋ ግን ሞታ ነበርና አልመለሰችም፤ በዚያን ጊዜ በአህያው ላይ ጫናት፥ ተነሥቶም ወደ ስፍራው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቱም በመጣ ጊዜ ካራ አነሣ፥ ቁባቱንም ይዞ ከአጥንቶችዋ መለያያ ላይ ለአሥራ ሁለት ቈራርጦ ወደ እስራኤል አገር ሁሉ ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak .
verses.text_amharic: ያየም ሁሉ። የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ከቶ አልተደረገም፥ አልታየምም፤ አስቡት፥ በዚህም ተመካከሩ፥ ተነጋገሩም ይባባል ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ወጡ፥ ማኅበሩም ከዳን እስከ ቤርሳቤህ ድረስ፥ ከገለዓድም አገር ሰዎች ጋር፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ምጽጳ እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And the chief of all the people, of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ሁሉ የሆኑ የሕዝብ ሁሉ አለቆች ሰይፍ በሚመዝዙ በቍጥርም አራት መቶ ሺህ እግረኞች በሆኑ በእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ጉባኤ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell , how was this wickedness?
verses.text_amharic: የብንያምም ልጆች የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ምጽጳ እንደ ወጡ ሰሙ። የእስራኤልም ልጆች። ይህ ክፉ ነገር እንደምን እንደ ተደረገ ንገሩን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
verses.text_amharic: የተገደለችውም ሴት ባል ሌዋዊው እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው። እኔና ቁባቴ በዚያ ለማደር ወደ ብንያም አገር ወደ ጊብዓ መጣን።

verses.text_english: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
verses.text_amharic: የጊብዓም ሰዎች ተነሡብኝ፥ ቤቱንም በሌሊት በእኛ ላይ ከበቡት፤ ሊገድሉኝም ወደዱ፥ በቁባቴም አጥብቀው አመነዘሩባት፥ እርስዋም ሞተች።

verses.text_english: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ቁባቴን ይዤ ቈራረኋጥጥኋት በእስራኤልም ዘንድ እንደዚህ ያለ ኃጢአትና ስንፍና ስለ ተሠራ ወደ እስራኤል ርስት አገር ሁሉ ሰደድሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, ye all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ ሁላችሁ፥ ምክራችሁንና እዝናታችሁን በዚህ ስጡ።

verses.text_english: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any go to his tent, neither will we any turn into his house.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እንደ አንድ ሰው ተነሥተው አሉ። ከእኛ ዘንድ ማንም ወደ ድንኳኑ አይሄድም፥ ወደ ቤቱም አይመለስም።

verses.text_english: But now this the thing which we will do to Gibeah; by lot against it;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጊብዓ ላይ የምናደርገው ነገር ይህ ነው፤ በዕጣ እንወጣባታለን።

verses.text_english: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ብንያም ጊብዓ በመጡ ጊዜ እርስዋ በእስራኤል ላይ እንዳደረገችው እንደ ስንፍናዋ እንዲያደርጉ፥ ለሕዝብ ስንቅ የሚይዙ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ከመቶው አሥር ሰው ከሺሁም መቶ ሰው ከአሥሩም ሺህ አንድ ሺህ ሰው እንወስዳለን።

verses.text_english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው በከተማይቱ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness this that is done among you?

Now therefore deliver the men, the children of Belial, which in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:
But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
Among all this people seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair , and not miss.
And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these men of war.

And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah first.
And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.
And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

(And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)
And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God there in those days,

And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.
And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
And the children of Benjamin said, They smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.
And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baaltamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, out of the meadows of Gibeah.
And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil near them.
And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.
And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.
