verses.text_english: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም። እነሆ፥ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ከምድር እንዳጠፋ ሳኦል ያደረገውን ታውቃለህ፤ ስለ ምን እኔን ለማስገደል ወጥመድ ለነፍሴ ታደርጋለህ? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying, the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በዚህ ነገር ቅጣት አያገኝሽም ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ማለላት።

verses.text_english: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም። ማንን ላስነሣልህ? አለች፤ እርሱም። ሳሙኤልን አስነሽልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou Saul.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ሳሙኤልን ባየች ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸች፤ ሴቲቱም ሳኦልን። አንተ ሳኦል ስትሆን ለምን አታለልኸኝ? ብላ ተናገረችው።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። አትፍሪ፤ ያየሽው ምንድር ነው? አላት። ሴቲቱም ሳኦልን። አማልክት ከምድር ሲወጡ አየሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, What form he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it Samuel, and he stooped with face to the ground, and bowed himself.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። መልኩ ምን ዓይነት ነው? አላት። እርስዋም። ሽማግሌ ሰው ወጣ፤ መጐናጸፊያም ተጐናጽፎአል አለች። ሳኦልም ሳሙኤል እንደ ሆነ አወቀ፥ በፊቱም ተጐነበሰ፥ በምድርም ላይ እጅ ነሣ።

verses.text_english: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.
verses.text_amharic: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን። ለምን አወክኸኝ? ለምንስ አስነሣኸኝ? አለው። ሳኦልም መልሶ። ፍልስጥኤማውያን ይወጉኛልና እጅግ ተጨንቄአለሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእኔ ርቆአል፤ በነቢያት ወይም በሕልም አልመለሰልኝም፤ ስለዚህም የማደርገውን ታስታውቀኝ ዘንድ ጠራሁህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?
verses.text_amharic: ሳሙኤልም አለ። እግዚአብሔር ከራቀህ ጠላትም ከሆነህ ለምን ትጠይቀኛለህ?

verses.text_english: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, to David:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በቃሌ እንደ ተናገረ አድርጎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥትህን ከእጅህ ነጥቆ ለጎረቤትህ ለዳዊት ሰጥቶታል።

verses.text_english: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማህምና፥ በአማሌቅም ላይ ታላቅ የሆነ ቍጣውን አላደረግህምና ስለዚህ ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ነገር አድርጎብሃል።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow thou and thy sons with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤልን ከአንተ ጋር በፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፤ ነገም አንተና ልጆችህ ከእኔ ጋር ትሆናላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ጭፍራ ደግሞ በፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልም በዚያን ጊዜ በቁመቱ ሙሉ በምድር ላይ ወደቀ፥ ከሳሙኤልም ቃል የተነሣ እጅግ ፈራ። በዚያም ቀን ሁሉ በዚያም ሌሊት ሁሉ እንጀራ አልበላምና ኃይል አልቀረለትም።

verses.text_english: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ወደ ሳኦል መጣች፥ እጅግም ደንግጦ እንደ ነበረ አይታ። እነሆ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ቃልህን ሰማሁ፥ ነፍሴንም በእጄ ጣልሁ፥ የነገርኸኝንም ቃል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ አንተ ደግሞ የባሪያህን ቃል እንድትሰማ እለምንሃለሁ፥ በፊትህም ቍራሽ እንጀራ ላኑርልህ፤ በመንገድም ስትሄድ ትበረታ ዘንድ ብላ አለችው።

verses.text_english: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። አልበላም ብሎ እንቢ አለ፤ ነገር ግን ባሪያዎቹና ሴቲቱ አስገደዱት፥ ቃላቸውንም ሰማ፤ ከምድርም ተነሥቶ በአልጋ ላይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded , and did bake unleavened bread thereof:
verses.text_amharic: ለሴቲቱም ማለፊያ እንቦሳ ነበራት፤ ፈጥና አረደችው፤ ዱቄቱንም ወስዳ ለወሰችው፥ ቂጣም እንጀራ አድርጋ ጋገረችው።

verses.text_english: And she brought before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
verses.text_amharic: በሳኦልና በባሪያዎቹም ፊት አቀረበችው፤ በልተውም ተነሡ፥ በዚያም ሌሊት ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which in Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍሮቻቸውን ሁሉ ወደ አፌቅ ሰበሰቡ፤ እስራኤላውያንም በኢይዝራኤል ባለው ውኃ ምንጭ አጠገብ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤማውያንም አለቆች በመቶ በመቶ በሺህ በሺህ እየሆኑ ያልፉ ነበር፤ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ከአንኩስ ጋር በኋለኛው ጭፍራ በኩል ያልፉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What these Hebrews ? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto this day?
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤማውያንም አለቆች። እነዚህ ዕብራውያን በዚህ ምን ያደርጋሉ? አሉ፤ አንኩስም የፍልስጥኤማውያንን አለቆች። ይህ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የሳኦል ባሪያ ዳዊት አይደለምን? እርሱም በእነዚህ ቀኖች በእነዚህ ዓመታት ከእኔ ጋር ነበረ፥ ወደ እኔም ከተጠጋበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ምንም አላገኘሁበትም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? not with the heads of these men?
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤማውያን አለቆች ግን ተቆጥተው። ይህ ሰው ባስቀመጥኸው ስፍራ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ይመለስ፤ በሰልፉ ውስጥ ጠላት እንዳይሆነን ከእኛ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ አይውረድ፤ ከጌታው ጋር በምን ይታረቃል? የእነዚህን ሰዎች ራስ በመቍረጥ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ሴቶች። ሳኦል ሺህ ገደለ፥ ዳዊት እልፍ ገደለ ብለው በዘፈን የዘመሩለት ይህ ዳዊት አይደለምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.
verses.text_amharic: አንኩስም ዳዊትን ጠርቶ። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አንተ ቅን ነህ፥ ከእኔም ጋር በጭፍራው በኩል መውጣትህና መግባትህ በፊቴ መልካም ነው፤ ወደ እኔም ከመጣህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አንዳች ክፋት አላገኘሁብህም፤ ነገር ግን በአለቆች ዘንድ አልተወደድህም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ተመልሰህ በደኅና ሂድ፥ በፍልስጥኤማውያንም አለቆች ዓይን ክፋት አታድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም አንኩስን። ምን አድርጌአለሁ? ሄጄስ ከጌታዬ ከንጉሡ ጠላቶች ጋር እንዳልዋጋ፥ በፊትህ ከተቀመጥሁ ጀምሬ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በእኔ በባሪያህ ምን አግኝተህብኛል? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
verses.text_amharic: አንኩስም መልሶ ዳዊትን። እንደ አምላክ መልእክተኛ በዓይኔ ፊት መልካም እንደ ሆንህ አውቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የፍልስጥኤማውያን አለቆች። ከእኛ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ አይወጣም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አንተ ከአንተም ጋር የመጡ የጌታህ ባሪያዎች ማልዳችሁ ተነሡ፤ ሲነጋም ተነሥታችሁ ሂዱ አለው።

verses.text_english: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ማልደው ይሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም አገር ይመለሱ ዘንድ ተነሡ። ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ጺቅላግ በመጡ ጊዜ፥ አማሌቃውያን በደቡብ አገርና በጺቅላግ ላይ ዘምተው ነበር፥ ጺቅላግንም መትተው በእሳት አቃጥለዋት ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And had taken the women captives, that therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried away, and went on their way.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶቹንና በውስጥዋም የነበሩትን ሁሉ ከታናሽ እስከ ታላቅ ድረስ ማርከው ነበር፤ ሁሉንም ወስደው መንገዳቸውን ሄዱ እንጂ አንድስ እንኳ አልገደሉም ነበር።

verses.text_english: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወደ ከተማ በመጡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በእሳት ተቃጥላ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም ተማርከው አገኙ።

verses.text_english: Then David and the people that with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊት ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው ለማልቀስ ኃይል እስኪያጡ ድረስ አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ሁለቱ ሚስቶቹ ኢይዝራኤላዊቱ አኪናሆምና የቀርሜሎሳዊው የናባል ሚስት የነበረችው አቢግያ ተማርከው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ወንዶችና ስለ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸው የሕዝቡ ሁሉ ልብ ተቈጥቶ ነበርና ሕዝቡ ሊወግሩት ስለ ተናገሩ ዳዊት እጅግ ተጨነቀ፤ ዳዊት ግን በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ልቡን አበረታ።

verses.text_english: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የአቢሜሌክን ልጅ ካህኑን አብያታርን። ኤፉዱን አቅርብልኝ አለው፤ አብያታርም ኤፉዱን ለዳዊት አቀረበለት።

verses.text_english: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake , and without fail recover .
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። የእነዚህን ሠራዊት ፍለጋ ልከተልን? አገኛቸዋለሁን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እርሱም። ታገኛቸዋለህና፥ ፈጽመህም ምርኮውን ትመልሳለህና ፍለጋቸውን ተከተል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: So David went, he and the six hundred men that with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ሄዱ፥ እስከ ቦሦር ወንዝ ድረስም መጡ፤ ከእነርሱም የቀሩት በዚያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት አራት መቶ ሰዎች አሳደዱ፤ ሁለቱ መቶ ሰዎች ግን የቦሦር ወንዝን መሻገር ደክመዋልና በኋላ ቀሩ።

verses.text_english: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
verses.text_amharic: በበረሀውም ውስጥ አንድ ግብጻዊ አግኝተው ወደ ዳዊት ይዘውት መጡ፤ እንጀራም ሰጡትና በላ፥ ውኃም አጠጡት፤

verses.text_english: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk water, three days and three nights.
verses.text_amharic: ከበለሱም ጥፍጥፍ ቁራጭና ሁለት የወይን ዘለላ ሰጡት፤ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት እንጀራ አልበላም ውኃም አልጠጣም ነበርና በበላ ጊዜ ነፍሱ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች።

verses.text_english: And David said unto him, To whom thou? and whence thou? And he said, I a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። አንተ የማን ነህ? ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ የአማሌቃዊ ባሪያ ግብጻዊ ብላቴና ነኝ፤ ከሦስት ቀንም በፊት ታምሜ ነበርና ጌታዬ ጥሎኝ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: We made an invasion the south of the Cherethites, and upon which to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም በከሊታውያን ደቡብ፥ በይሁዳም ምድር፥ በካሌብም ደቡብ ላይ ዘመትን፤ ጺቅላግንም በእሳት አቃጠልናት አለ።

verses.text_english: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ወደ እነዚያ ሠራዊት ዘንድ ልትመራኝ ትወድዳለህን? አለው፤ እርሱም። እንዳትገድለኝ፥ ለጌታዬም እጅ አሳልፈህ እንዳትሰጠኝ በአምላክ ማልልኝ እንጂ ወደ እነዚያ ሠራዊት እመራሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when he had brought him down, behold, spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ታችም እንዲወርድ ባደረገው ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንና ከይሁዳ ምድር ከወሰዱት ከብዙ ምርኮ ሁሉ የተነሣ በልተው ጠጥተውም የበዓልም ቀን አድርገው በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ተበትነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከማታ ጀምሮ እስከ ማግሥቱ ማታ ድረስ መታቸው፤ ከእነርሱም በግመል ተቀምጠው ከሸሹ ከአራት መቶ ጕልማሶች በቀር አንድ ያመለጠ የለም።

verses.text_english: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም አማሌቃውያን የወሰዱትን ሁሉ አስጣላቸው፥ ሁለቱንም ሚስቶቹን አዳነ።

verses.text_english: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆች፥ ከወሰዱትም ምርኮ ሁሉ፥ ታላቅም ሆነ ታናሽም ሆነ፥ ምንም የጐደለባቸው የለም፤ ዳዊትም ሁሉን አስጣለ።

verses.text_english: And David took all the flocks and the herds, they drave before those cattle, and said, This David's spoil.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የበጉንና የላሙን መንጋ ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ ከራሱም ከብት ፊት እየነዳ። ይህ የዳዊት ምርኮ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ደክመው ዳዊትን ይከተሉት ዘንድ ወዳልቻሉ፥ በቦሦር ወንዝ ወዳስቀራቸው ወደ ሁለቱ መቶ ሰዎች መጣ፤ እነርሱም ዳዊትን ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ሊቀበሉ ወጡ፤ ዳዊትም ወደ ሕዝቡ በቀረበ ጊዜ ደኅንነታቸውን ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: Then answered all the wicked men and of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead away, and depart.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳዊትም ጋር ከሄዱ ሰዎች ክፉዎቹና ምናምንቴዎቹ ሁሉ። እነዚህ ከእኛ ጋር አልመጡምና እየራሳቸው ሚስቶቻቸውንና ልጆቻቸውን ይዘው ይሂዱ እንጂ ካስጣልነው ምርኮ ምንም አንሰጣቸውም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ የጠበቀን በእኛም ላይ የመጣውን ጭፍራ በእጃችን አሳልፎ የሰጠን እግዚአብሔር በሰጠን ነገር እንዲህ አታድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part that goeth down to the battle, so his part that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንስ ነገ ማን ይሰማችኋል? ነገር ግን የተዋጉትና ዕቃውን የጠበቁት እድል ፈንታ እኩል ይሆናል፥ አንድነት ይካፈላሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it was from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይህን ለእስራኤል ሥርዓትና ፍርድ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ ጺቅላግ በመጣ ጊዜ ለዘመዶቹ ለይሁዳ ሽማግሌዎች። እነሆ ከእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶች ምርኮ በረከትን ተቀበሉ ብሎ ከምርኮው ሰደደላቸው።

verses.text_english: To which in Bethel, and to which in south Ramoth, and to which in Jattir,
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴል ለነበሩ፥ በራሞት በደቡብ ለነበሩ

verses.text_english: And to which in Aroer, and to which in Siphmoth, and to which in Eshtemoa,
verses.text_amharic: በየቲር ለነበሩ፥ በአሮዔር ለነበሩ፥ በሢፍሞት ለነበሩ፥ በኤሽትሞዓ ለነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And to which in Rachal, and to which in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to which in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.text_amharic: በቀርሜሎስ ለነበሩ፥ በይረሕምኤላውያንና በቄናውያን ከተሞችም ለነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And to which in Hormah, and to which in Chorashan, and to which in Athach,
verses.text_amharic: በሔርማ ለነበሩ፥ በቦራሣን ለነበሩ፥ በዓታክ ለነበሩ፥ በኬብሮን ለነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And to which in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም በተመላለሱበት ስፍራ ለነበሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ላከ።

verses.text_english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ፥ ተወግተውም በጊልቦዓ ተራራ ላይ ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, Saul's sons.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በእግር በእግራቸው ተከትለው አባረሩአቸው፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም የሳኦልን ልጆች ዮናታንንና አሚናዳብን ሜልኪሳንም ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
verses.text_amharic: ሰልፍም በሳኦል ላይ ጠነከረ፥ ቀስተኞችም አገኙት፤ እርሱም ከቀስተኞቹ የተነሣ እጅግ ተጨነቀ።

verses.text_english: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። እነዚህ ቈላፋን መጥተው እንዳይወጉኝና እንዳይሳለቁብኝ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ውጋኝ አለው። ጋሻ ጃግሬው ግን እጅግ ፈርቶ ነበርና እንቢ አለ። ሳኦልም ሰይፉን ወስዶ በላዩ ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሳኦል እንደ ሞተ ባየ ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በሰይፉ ላይ ወደቀ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሞተ።

verses.text_english: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሳኦል ሦስቱም ልጆቹ ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሰዎቹም ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And when the men of Israel that on the other side of the valley, and that on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.text_amharic: በሸለቆውም ማዶና በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩ እስራኤላውያን የእስራኤል ሰዎች እንደ ሸሹ፥ ሳኦልና ልጆቹም እንደ ሞቱ ባዩ ጊዜ ከተሞቹን ለቅቀው ሸሹ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው ተቀመጡባቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱም ፍልስጥኤማውያን የሞቱትን ለመግፈፍ በመጡ ጊዜ ሳኦልና ሦስቱ ልጆቹ በጊልቦዓ ተራራ ላይ ወድቀው አገኙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish the house of their idols, and among the people.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልንም ራስ ቈረጠው የጦር ዕቃውን ገፍፈው ለጣዖታቱ መቅደስ ለሕዝቡም የምስራች ይሰጥ ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን አገር ሁሉ ሰደዱ።

verses.text_english: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.
verses.text_amharic: የጦር ዕቃውንም በአስታሮት መቅደስ ውስጥ አኖሩት፤ ሬሳውንም በቤትሳን ቅጥር ላይ አንጠለጠሉት።

verses.text_english: And when the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም በሳኦል ላይ ያደረጉትን የኢያቢስ ገለዓድ ሰዎች በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
verses.text_amharic: ጀግኖች ሰዎች ሁሉ ተነሥተው ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ሄዱ፥ የሳኦልንም ሬሳ የልጆቹንም ሬሳ ከቤትሳን ቅጥር ላይ አወረዱ፤ ወደ ኢያቢስም መጡ፥ በዚያም አቃጠሉት።

verses.text_english: And they took their bones, and buried under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.text_amharic: አጥንታቸውንም ወሰዱ በኢያቢስም ባለው በአጣጡ ዛፍ በታች ቀበሩት፥ ሰባት ቀንም ጾሙ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፥ ሳኦል ከሞተ በኋላ ዳዊት አማሌቃውያንን ከመግደል ተመልሶ በጺቅላግ ሁለት ቀን ያህል ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን፥ እነሆ፥ ከሳኦል ሰፈር አንድ ሰው ልብሱን ቀድዶ በራሱም ላይ ትቢያ ነስንሶ መጣ፤ ወደ ዳዊትም በመጣ ጊዜ በግምባሩ ተደፍቶ እጅ ነሣ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው እርሱም። ከእስራኤል ሰፈር ኰብልዬ መጣሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ነገሩ እንደ ምን ሆነ? እስኪ ንገረኝ አለው። እርሱም መልሶ። ሕዝቡ ከሰልፉ ሸሽቶአል፥ ከሕዝቡ ብዙው ወደቁ ሞቱም፤ ሳኦልና ልጁም ዮናታን ደግሞ ሞተዋል አለ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወሬኛውን ጕልማሳ። ሳኦልና ልጁ ዮናታን እንደ ሞቱ በምን ታውቃለህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
verses.text_amharic: ወሬኛውም ጕልማሳ አለ። በድንገት ወደ ጊልቦዓ ተራራ መጣሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሳኦል ጦሩን ተመርኵዞ ቆሞ ነበር፤ ሰረገሎችና ፈረሰኞችም ተከትለው ደረሱበት።

verses.text_english: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here I.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኋላውም ዘወር አለና እኔን አይቶ ጠራኝ፤ እኔም። እነሆኝ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Who thou? And I answered him, I an Amalekite.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አንተ ማን ነህ? አለኝ፤ እኔም። አማሌቃዊ ነኝ ብዬ መለስሁለት።

verses.text_english: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life yet whole in me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሰውነቴ ዝሎአልና፥ ደግሞ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ነፍሴ ገና ፈጽማ ሕያው ናትና በላዬ ቆመህ ግደለኝ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that upon his head, and the bracelet that on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከወደቀ በኋላ አለ መዳኑን አይቼ በላዩ ቆሜ ገደልሁት፤ በራሱም ላይ የነበረውን ዘውድ በክንዱም የነበረውን ቢተዋ ወሰድሁ፥ ወደዚህም ወደ ጌታዬ አመጣሁት።

verses.text_english: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that with him:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ልብሳቸውን ይዘው ቀደዱ።

verses.text_english: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: በሰይፍም ወድቀዋልና ለሳኦልና ለልጁ ለዮናታን ለእግዚአብሔርም ሕዝብ ለእስራኤልም ወገን እንባ እያፈሰሱ አለቀሱ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ጾሙ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence thou? And he answered, I the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወሬኛውን ጕልማሳ። አንተ ከወዴት ነህ? አለው፤ እርሱም። እኔ የመጻተኛው የአማሌቃዊው ልጅ ነኝ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD'S anointed?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን ለመግደል እጅህን ስትዘረጋ ለምን አልፈራህም? አለው።

verses.text_english: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከጕልማሶቹ አንዱን ጠርቶ። ወደ እርሱ ቅረብና ውደቅበት አለው። እርሱም መታው፥ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And David said unto him, Thy blood upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD'S anointed.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን እኔ ገድያለሁ ብሎ አፍህ በላይህ መስክሮአልና ደምህ በራስህ ላይ ይሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ስለ ሳኦልና ሰለ ልጁ ስለ ዮናታን ይህን የኀዘን ቅኔ ተቀኘ፥

verses.text_english: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the bow: behold, written in the book of Jasher.)
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳንም ልጆች ያስተምሩ ዘንድ አዘዘ። እነሆ፥ ይህ በያሻር መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ክብር በኮረብቶች ላይ ተወግቶ ሞተ፤ ኃያላን እንዴት ወደቁ!

verses.text_english: Tell not in Gath, publish not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
verses.text_amharic: የፍልስጥኤማውያን ቈነጃጅት ደስ እንዳይላቸው፥ የቈላፋንም ቈነጃጅት እልል እንዳይሉ፥ በጌት ውስጥ አታውሩ፤ በአስቀሎናም አደባባይ የምስራች አትበሉ።

verses.text_english: Ye mountains of Gilboa, no dew, neither rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, not anointed with oil.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የጊልቦዓ ተራሮች ሆይ፥ የሳኦል ጋሻ በዘይት እንዳልተቀባ፥ የኃያላን ጋሻ በዚያ ወድቆአልና ዝናብና ጠል አይውረድባችሁ፥ ቍርባንንም የሚያበቅል እርሻ አይሁንባችሁ።

verses.text_english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
verses.text_amharic: ከሞቱት ደምና ከኃያላን ስብ የዮናታን ቀስት አልተመለሰችም፥ የሳኦልም ሰይፍ በከንቱ አልተመለሰም።

verses.text_english: Saul and Jonathan lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልና ዮናታን የተዋደዱና የተስማሙ ነበሩ፤ በሕይወታቸውና በሞታቸው አልተለያዩም፤ ከንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ነበሩ፤ ከአንበሳም ይልቅ ብርቱዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ ቀይ ሐርና ጥሩ ግምጃ ያለብሳችሁ ለነበረ፥ በወርቀዘቦም ላስጌጣችሁ ለሳኦል አልቅሱለት።

verses.text_english: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, slain in thine high places.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያላንም በሰልፍ ውስጥ እንዴት ወደቁ! ዮናታንም በኮረብቶችህ ላይ ወድቆአል።

verses.text_english: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሜ ዮናታን ሆይ፥ እኔ ስለ አንተ እጨነቃለሁ፤ በእኔ ዘንድ ውድህ እጅግ የተለየ ነበረ፤ ከሴት ፍቅር ይልቅ ፍቅርህ ለእኔ ግሩም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
verses.text_amharic: ኃያላን እንዴት ወደቁ! የሰልፍም ዕቃ እንዴት ጠፋ!

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ዳዊት። ከይሁዳ ከተሞች ወደ አንዲቱ ልውጣን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ። እግዚአብሔርም። ውጣ አለው። ዳዊትም። ወዴት ልውጣ? አለ። እርሱም። ወደ ኬብሮን ውጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከሁለቱ ሚስቶቹ ከኢይዝራኤላዊቱ ከአኪናሆምና የቀርሜሎሳዊው የናባል ሚስት ከነበረችው ከአቢግያ ጋር ወደዚያ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And his men that with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ሰዎችና ቤተ ሰባቸውን ሁሉ አመጣ፤ በኬብሮንም ከተሞች ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, the men of Jabeshgilead that buried Saul.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ሰዎች መጥተው በይሁዳ ቤት ይነግሥ ዘንድ ዳዊትን በዚያ ቀቡት። ሳኦልን የቀበሩት የኢያቢስ ገለዓድ ሰዎች ናቸው ብለው ለዳዊት ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, unto Saul, and have buried him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ ኢያቢስ ገለዓድ ሰዎች መልእክተኞችን ልኮ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ ለጌታችሁ ለሳኦል ይህን ቸርነት አድርጋችኋልና፥ ቀብራችሁትማልና በእግዚአብሔር የተባረካችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ቸርነትንና እውነትን ያድርግላችሁ፤ ይህንም ነገር አድርጋችኋልና እኔ ደግሞ ይህን ቸርነት እመልስላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ጌታችሁ ሳኦል ሞቶአልና እጃችሁ ትጽና፥ እናንተም ጨክኑ፤ ዳግም የይሁዳ ቤት በእነርሱ ላይ ንጉሥ እሆን ዘንድ ቀብተውኛል።

verses.text_english: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ጭፍራ አለቃ የኔር ልጅ አበኔር የሳኦልን ልጅ ኢያቡስቴን ወስዶ ወደመሃናይም አሻገረው፤

verses.text_english: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በገለዓድና በአሹራውያን በኢይዝራኤልም በኤፍሬምም በብንያምም በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ላይ አነገሠው።

verses.text_english: Ishbosheth Saul's son forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦል ልጅ ኢያቡስቴም በእስራኤል ላይ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአርባ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ ሁለት ዓመትም ነገሠ፤ ነገር ግን የይሁዳ ቤት ዳዊትን ተከተለ።

verses.text_english: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በይሁዳ ቤት ነግሦ በኬብሮን የተቀመጠበት ዘመን ሰባት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.text_amharic: የኔር ልጅ አበኔርና የሳኦል ልጅ የኢያቡስቴ ባሪያዎች ከመሃናይም ወደ ገባዖን ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብና የዳዊት ባሪያዎች ወጥተው በገባዖን ውኃ መቆሚያ አጠገብ ተገናኙአቸው፤ በውኃውም መቆሚያ በአንዱ ወገን እነዚህ፥ በሌላውም ወገን እነዚያ ሆነው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ኢዮአብን። ጕልማሶች ይነሡ፥ በፊታችንም ይቈራቈሱ አለው፤ ኢዮአብም። ይነሡ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
verses.text_amharic: ለብንያም ወገንና ለሳኦል ልጅ ለኢያቡስቴ አስራ ሁለት፥ ከዳዊትም ባሪያዎች አሥራ ሁለት ተቈጥረው ተነሡ።

verses.text_english: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which in Gibeon.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ የወደረኛውን ራስ ያዘ፥ ሰይፉንም በወደረኛው ጎን ሻጠ፥ ተያይዘውም ወደቁ። የዚያም ስፍራ ስም የስለታም ሰይፍ እርሻ ተብሎ ተጠራ፥ እርሱም በገባዖን ነው።

verses.text_english: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ጽኑ ሰልፍ ሆነ፤ በዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ፊት አበኔርና የእስራኤል ሰዎች ተሸነፉ።

verses.text_english: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel light of foot as a wild roe.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሦስቱ የጽሩያ ልጆች ኢዮአብና አቢሳ አሣሄልም ነበሩ፤ አሣሄልም እንደ ዱር ሚዳቋ በሩጫ ፈጣን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
verses.text_amharic: አሣሄልም የአበኔርን ፍለጋ ተከታተለ፥ አበኔርንም ከማሳደድ ቀኝና ግራ አላለም።

verses.text_english: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, thou Asahel? And he answered, I .
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ዘወር ብሎ ተመለከተና። አንተ አሣሄል ነህን? አለ። እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም። ወደ ቀኝ ወይም ወደ ግራ ፈቀቅ በል፤ አንድ ጕልማሳ ያዝ፥ መሣርያውንም ውሰድ አለው። አሣሄል ግን እርሱን ከማሳደድ ፈቀቅ ይል ዘንድ እንቢ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም አሣሄልን። ከምድር ጋር እንዳላጣብቅህ እኔን ከማሳደድ ፈቀቅ በል፤ ወደ ወንድምህ ወደ ኢዮአብ ፊቴን አቅኝቼ አይ ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻለኛል? አለው።

verses.text_english: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth , that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ ይል ዘንድ እንቢ አለ፤ አበኔርም በጦሩ ጫፍ ሆዱን ወጋው፥ ጦሩም በኋላው ወጣ፥ በዚያም ስፍራ ወድቆ ሞተ። አሣሄልም ወድቆ በሞተበቱ ስፍራ የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይቆም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብና አቢሳም አበኔርን አሳደዱ፤ በገባዖንም ምድረ በዳ መንገድ በጋይ ፊት ለፊት እስካለው እስከ አማ ኮረብታ ድረስ በወጡ ጊዜ ፀሐይ ጠለቀች።

verses.text_english: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
verses.text_amharic: የብንያምም ልጆች ወደ አበኔር ተሰበሰቡ፥ በአንድነትም ሆኑ፥ በኮረብታም ራስ ላይ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ወደ ኢዮአብ ጮኸ። ሰይፍ በውኑ እስከ ዘላለም ያጠፋልን? ፍጻሜውሳ መራራ እንደ ሆነ አታውቅምን? ሕዝቡ ወንድሞቻቸውን ከማሳደድ ይመለሱ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን የማትናገር እስከ መቼ ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Joab said, God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ባትናገር ኖሮ ሕዝቡ በጥዋት ወጥተው በሄዱ ነበር፥ ወንድሞቻቸውንም ማሳደድ በተዉ ነበር አለ።

verses.text_english: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ቀንደ መለከት ነፋ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ቆመ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ እስራኤልን አላሳደደም፥ ሰልፍም አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርና ሰዎቹም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ዓረባ እያለፉ ሄዱ፤ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻገሩ፥ ቢትሮንንም ሁሉ ካለፉ በኋላ ወደ መሃናይም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም አበኔርን ከማሳደድ ተመለሰ፤ ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ከዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ከአሣሄል ሌላ አሥራ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ጐደሉ።

verses.text_english: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, three hundred and threescore men died.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ከብንያምና ከአበኔር ሰዎች ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ ያህል ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
verses.text_amharic: አሣሄልንም አንሥተው በቤተ ልሔም በአባቱ መቃብር ቀበሩት፤ ኢዮአብና ሰዎቹም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ሄዱ፥ በኬብሮንም አነጉ።

verses.text_english: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
verses.text_amharic: በሳኦል ቤትና በዳዊት ቤት መካከል ብዙ ዘመን ጦርነት ሆነ፤ የዳዊት ቤት እየበረታ፥ የሳኦል ቤት ግን እየደከመ የሚሄድ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.text_amharic: ለዳዊትም ወንድ ልጆች በኬብሮን ተወለዱለት፤ በኵሩም ከኢይዝራኤላዊቱ ከአኪናሆም የተወለደው አምኖን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም የቀርሜሎሳዊው የናባል ሚስት ከነበረች ከአቢግያ የተወለደው ዶሎሕያ ነበረ። ሦስተኛውም ከጌሹር ንጉሥ ከተልማይ ልጅ ከመዓካ የተወለደው አቤሴሎም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛውም የአጊት ልጅ አዶንያስ፥ አምስተኛውም የአቢጣል ልጅ ሰፋጥያስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛውም የዳዊት ልጅ ሚስት የዔግላ ልጅ ይትረኃም ነበረ። እነዚህም ለዳዊት በኬብሮን ተወለዱለት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
verses.text_amharic: በሳኦል ቤትና በዳዊት ቤት መካከል ጦርነት ሆኖ ሳለ አበኔር በሳኦል ቤት ይበረታ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Saul had a concubine, whose name Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
verses.text_amharic: ለሳኦልም የኢዮሄል ልጅ ሪጽፋ የተባለች ቁባት ነበረችው፤ ኢያቡስቴም አበኔርን። ወደ አባቴ ቁባት ለምን ገባህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም በኢያቡስቴ ቃል እጅግ ተቈጥቶ እንዲህ አለ። እኔ ለአባትህ ለሳኦል ቤት ለወንድሞቹም ለዘመዶቹም ቸርነት አድርጌአለሁ፥ አንተንም ለዳዊት እጅ አሳልፌ አልሰጠሁም፤ አንተም ዛሬ ከዚህች ሴት ጋር ስለ ሠራሁት ኃጢአት ትከስሰኛለህ፤ በውኑ እኔ የውሻ ራስ ነኝን?

verses.text_english: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያቡስቴም አበኔርን ይፈራው ነበርና አንዳች ይመልስለት ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ለዳዊት። ምድሪቱ ለማን ናት? ከእኔ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርግ፥ እጄም ከአንተ ጋር ትሆናለች፥ እስራኤልንም ሁሉ ወደ አንተ እመልሰዋለሁ ብለው ይነግሩት ዘንድ መልእክተኞች ሰደደለት።

verses.text_english: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose the land? saying , Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ይሁን፥ ከአንተ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንድ ነገር ከአንተ እሻለሁ፤ ፊቴን ለማየት በመጣህ ጊዜ፥ የሳኦልን ልጅ ሜልኮልን ካላመጣህልኝ ፊቴን አታይም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ ሳኦል ልጅ ወደ ኢያቡስቴ። በመቶ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ሸለፈት ያጨኋትን ሚስቴን ሜልኮልን ስጠኝ ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያቡስቴም ልኮ ከሌሳ ልጅ ከባልዋ ከፈልጢኤል ወሰዳት።

verses.text_english: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from husband, from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
verses.text_amharic: ባልዋም እያለቀሰ ከእርስዋ ጋር ሄደ፥ እስከ ብራቂም ድረስ ተከተላት። አበኔርም። ሂድ፥ ተመለስ አለው፤ እርሱም ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ለእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች። አስቀድሞ ዳዊት በእናንተ ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ ፈልጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past king over you:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ዳዊት። በባሪያዬ በዳዊት እጅ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን ከፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅና ከጠላቶቻቸው ሁሉ እጅ አድናለሁ ብሎ ተናግሮአልና እንግዲህ አሁን አድርጉ ብሎ ነገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Now then do : for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ደግሞ በብንያም ወገን ጆሮ ተናገረ፤ አበኔርም ደግሞ በእስራኤልና በብንያም ቤት ሁሉ መልካም የነበረውን ለዳዊት ሊነግረው ወደ ኬብሮን ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ከሀያ ሰዎች ጋር ወደ ዳዊት ወደ ኬብሮን መጣ። ዳዊትም ለአበኔርና ከእርሱ ጋር ለነበሩት ሰዎች ግብዣ አደረገላቸው።

verses.text_english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that with him a feast.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ዳዊትን። ተነሥቼ ልሂድ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም ቃል ኪዳን እንዲያደርጉ፥ ነፍስህም እንደ ወደደች ሁሉን እንድትገዛ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ለጌታዬ ለንጉሥ ልሰብስብ አለው። ዳዊትም አበኔርን አሰናበተው፥ በደኅናም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም የዳዊት ባሪያዎችና ኢዮአብ ከዘመቻ ታላቅ ምርኮ ይዘው መጡ። አበኔር ግን ዳዊት አሰናብቶት በደኅና ሄዶ ነበር እንጂ በኬብሮን አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረ ጭፍራ ሁሉ በመጡ ጊዜ። የኔር ልጅ አበኔር ወደ ንጉሥ መጣ፥ አሰናበተውም በደኅናውም ሄደ ብለው ሰዎች ለኢዮአብ ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: When Joab and all the host that with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ወደ ንጉሥ ገብቶ። ምን አደረግህ? እነሆ፥ አበኔር መጥቶልህ ነበር፤ በደኅና እንዲሄድ ስለ ምን አሰናበትኸው?

verses.text_english: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why it thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
verses.text_amharic: የኔር ልጅ አበኔር ያታልልህ ዘንድ፥ መውጫህንና መግቢያህንም ያውቅ ዘንድ፥ የምታደርገውንም ነገር ሁሉ ያስተውል ዘንድ እንደ መጣ አታውቅምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ከዳዊት በወጣ ጊዜ መልእክተኞችን ከአበኔር በኋላ ላከ፥ ከሴይርም ጕድጓድም መለሱት። ዳዊት ግን ይህን አላወቀም።

verses.text_english: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew not.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርም ወደ ኬብሮን በተመለሰ ጊዜ ኢዮአብ በበር ውስጥ በቈይታ ይናገረው ዘንድ ወደ አጠገቡ ወሰደው፤ በዚያም ለወንድሙ ለአሣሄል ደም ተበቅሎ ሆዱን መታው፥ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth , that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላም ዳዊት ይህ ነገር እንደ ተደረገ በሰማ ጊዜ። ከኔር ልጅ ከአበኔር ደም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ለዘላለም እኔ ንጹሕ ነኝ፥ መንግሥቴም ንጹሕ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And afterward when David heard , he said, I and my kingdom guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
verses.text_amharic: በኢዮአብ ራስ ላይና በአባቱ ቤት ሁሉ ላይ ይምጣበት፤ በኢዮአብም ቤት ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ወይም ለምጻም ወይም አንካሳ ወይም በሰይፍ የሚወድቅ ወይም እንጀራ የሌለው ሰው አይታጣ አለ።

verses.text_english: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብና ወንድሙ አቢሳም በሰልፍ በገባዖን ወንድማቸው አሣሄልን ገድሎ ነበርና አበኔርን ገደሉት።

verses.text_english: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ኢዮአብንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ሁሉ። ልብሳችሁን ቅደዱ፥ ማቅም ልበሱ፥ በአበኔርም ፊት አልቅሱ አላቸው። ንጉሡም ዳዊት ከቃሬዛው በኋላ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David followed the bier.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔርንም በኬብሮን ቀበሩት፤ ንጉሡም ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ በአበኔር መቃብር አጠገብ አለቀሰ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አለቀሱ። ንጉሡም ለአበኔር።

verses.text_english: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
verses.text_amharic: አበኔር ሰነፍ እንደሚሞት ይምታልን?

verses.text_english: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
verses.text_amharic: እጅህ አልታሰረም፥ እግርህም በሰንሰለት አልተያዘም፤ ሰው በዓመፀኞች ፊት እንደሚወድቅ አንተ እንዲሁ ወደቅህ ብሎ የልቅሶ ቅኔ ተቀኘለት። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዋይታ አብዝተው አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: Thy hands not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ገና ሳይመሽ ዳዊትን እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ ሊጋብዙት መጡ፤ ዳዊት ግን። ፀሐይ ሳትጠልቅ እንጀራ ወይም ሌላ ነገር ብቀምስ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያድርግብኝ፥ ይህንም ይጨምርብኝ ብሎ፤ ማለ።

verses.text_english: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ይህን ተመለከቱ፥ ደስ አሰኛቸውም፤ በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፊት ንጉሥ ያደረገው ሁሉ ደስ አሰኛቸው።

verses.text_english: And all the people took notice , and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እስራኤልም ሁሉ የኔር ልጅ የአበኔር ሞት ከንጉሡ ዘንድ እንዳልሆነ አወቁ።

verses.text_english: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ባሪያዎቹን። ዛሬ በእስራኤል ዘንድ መኰንንና ታላቅ ሰው እንደ ወደቀ አታውቁምን?

verses.text_english: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ዛሬ ምንም ለመንገሥ የተቀባሁ ብሆን ደካማ ነኝ፤ እነዚህም ሰዎች የጽሩያ ልጆች በርትተውብኛል፤ እግዚአብሔር ክፋት በሠራ ላይ እንደ ክፋቱ ይመልስበት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ልጅ ኢያቡስቴ አበኔር በኬብሮን እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ እጁ ደከመች፥ እስራኤላውያንም ሁሉ ደነገጡ።

verses.text_english: And Saul's son had two men captains of bands: the name of the one Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:
verses.text_amharic: ለሳኦልም ልጅ ለኢያቡስቴ የጭፍራ አለቆች የሆኑ ሁለት ሰዎች ነበሩት፤ የአንዱም ስም በዓና፥ የሁለተኛውም ስም ሬካብ ነበረ፥ ከብንያምም ልጆች የብኤሮታዊው የሬሞን ልጆች ነበሩ፤ ብኤሮትም ለብንያም ተቈጥራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
verses.text_amharic: ብኤሮታውያንም ወደ ጌቴም ሸሽተው ነበር፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በዚያ ተጠግተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son lame of feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name Mephibosheth.
verses.text_amharic: ለሳኦልም ልጅ ለዮናታን አንድ ሽባ የሆነ ልጅ ነበረው። የሳኦልና የዮናታን ወሬ ከኢይዝራኤል በመጣ ጊዜ የአምስት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ ሞግዚቱም አዝላው ሸሸች፤ ፈጥናም ስትሸሽ ወድቆ ሽባ ሆነ። ስሙም ሜምፊቦስቴ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
verses.text_amharic: የብኤሮታዊውም የሬሞን ልጆች ሬካብና በዓና ቀኑ ሲሞቅ ወደ ኢያቡስቴ ቤት መጡ፤ እርሱም በቀትር ጊዜ በምንጣፍ ላይ ተኝቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they came thither into the midst of the house, they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
verses.text_amharic: በረኛይቱም ስንዴ ታበጥር ነበር፥ አንቀላፍታም ተኝታ ነበር፤ ሬካብና ወንድሙ በዓናም በቀስታ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም በገቡ ጊዜ እርሱ በእልፍኙ በምንጣፉ ላይ ተኝቶ ሳለ መቱት፥ ገደሉትም፤ ራሱንም ቈርጠው ወሰዱት፥ በዓረባም መንገድ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
verses.text_amharic: የኢያቡስቴንም ራስ ይዘው ወደ ዳዊት ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም። ነፍስህን ይሻ የነበረው የጠላትህ የሳኦል ልጅ የኢያቡስቴ ራስ እነሆ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዛሬ ከሳኦልና ከዘሩ ለጌታችን ለንጉሥ ተበቀለለት አሉት።

verses.text_english: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ለብኤሮታዊው ለሬሞት ልጆች ለሬካብና ለወንድሙ ለበዓና እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው። ነፍሴን ከመከራ ሁሉ ያዳነ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን!

verses.text_english: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ወሬ የያዘ መስሎት። እነሆ፥ ሳኦል ሞተ ብሎ የነገረኝን የምስራቹ ዋጋ እንዲሆን ይዤ በጺቅላግ ገደልሁት።

verses.text_english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንስ በቤቱ ውስጥ በምንጣፉ ላይ ንጹሑን ሰው የገደላችሁትን እናንተን ኃጢአተኞችንማ እንዴት ነዋ? ደሙን ከእጃችሁ አልሻውምን? ከምድርም አላጠፋችሁምን?

verses.text_english: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ጕልማሶቹን አዘዘ፥ ገደሉአቸውም፤ እጃቸውንና እግራቸውን ቈርጠው በኬብሮን በውኃ መቆሚያ አጠገብ አንጠለጠሉአቸው። የኢያቡስቴንም ራስ ወስደው በአበኔር መቃብር በኬብሮን ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ነገድ ሁሉ ወደ ኬብሮን ወደ ዳዊት መጥተው። እነሆ፥ እኛ የአጥንትህ ፍላጭ የሥጋህ ቍራጭ ነን።

verses.text_english: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞ ሳኦል በእኛ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሳለ እስራኤልን የምታወጣና የምታገባ አንተ ነበርህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። አንተ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን ትጠብቃለህ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ አለቃ ትሆናለህ ብሎህ ነበር አሉት።

verses.text_english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ንጉሡ ዳዊትም በኬብሮን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር አደረገ፤ በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ ዳዊትን ቀቡት።

verses.text_english: David thirty years old when he began to reign, he reigned forty years.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ አርባ ዓመትም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በኬብሮን በይሁዳ ላይ ሰባት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ነገሠ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም በእስራኤል ሁሉና በይሁዳ ላይ ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡና ሰዎቹም በአገሩ ውስጥ ከተቀመጡት ከኢያቡሳውያን ጋር ለመዋጋት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዱ፤ እነርሱም። ዳዊት ወደዚህ ሊገባ አይችልም ብለው አስበው ነበርና ዳዊትን። ዕውሮችንና አንካሶችን ካላወጣህ በቀር ወደዚህ አትገባም አሉት።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same the city of David.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዳዊት አምባይቱን ጽዮንን ያዘ፥ እርስዋም የዳዊት ከተማ ናት።

verses.text_english: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, hated of David's soul, . Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ዳዊት። ኢያቡሳውያንን የሚመታ በውኃ መሄጃው ይውጣ፤ የዳዊትም ነፍስ የምትጠላቸውን ዕውሮችንና አንካሶችን ያውጣ አለ። ስለዚህም በምሳሌ። ዕውርና አንካሳ ወደ ቤት አይግቡ ተባለ።

verses.text_english: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በአምባይቱ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ፥ የዳዊትም ከተማ ብሎ ጠራት። ዳዊትም ዙሪያዋን ከሚሎ ጀምሮ ወደ ውስጥ ቀጠራት።

verses.text_english: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እየበረታ ሄደ፤ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
verses.text_amharic: የጢሮስም ንጉሥ ኪራም ወደ ዳዊት መልእክተኞችን የዝግባ እንጨትንም አናጢዎችንም ጠራቢዎችንም ላከ፤ ለዳዊትም ቤት ሠሩለት።

verses.text_english: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ አድርጎ እንዳጸናው፥ ስለ ሕዝቡ ስለ እስራኤልም መንግሥቱን ከፍ እንዳደረገ አወቀ።

verses.text_english: And David took more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከኬብሮን ከመጣ በኋላ ሌሎቹን ቁባቶቹንና ሚስቶቹን ከኢየሩሳሌም ወሰደ፤ ለዳዊትም ደግሞ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች ተወለዱለት።

verses.text_english: And these the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም የተወለዱለት ስማቸው ይህ ነው፤ ሳሙስ፥

verses.text_english: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.text_amharic: ሶባብ፥ ናታን፥ ሰሎሞን፥ ኢያቤሐር፥ ኤሊሱዔ፥

verses.text_english: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.text_amharic: ናፌቅ፥ ያፍያ፥ ኤሊሳማ፥ ኤሊዳሄ፥ ኤሊፋላት።

verses.text_english: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard , and went down to the hold.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ዳዊት በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ሆኖ እንደ ተቀባ ሰሙ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሁሉ ዳዊትን ሊፈልጉ ወጡ፤ ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ምሽጉ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው በራፋይም ሸለቆ ተበትነው ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ልውጣን? በእጄስ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣቸዋለህን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ። እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊትን። ፍልስጥኤማውያንን በእርግጥ በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁና ውጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ በኣልፐራሲም መጣ፥ በዚያም መታቸውና። ውኃ እንዲያፈርስ እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቼን በፊቴ አፈረሳቸው አለ። ስለዚህም የዚያን ስፍራ ስም በኣልፐራሲም ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
verses.text_amharic: ጣዖቶቻቸውንም በዚያ ተዉ፥ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወሰዱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ደግሞ መጡ፥ በራፋይምም ሸለቆ ተበትነው ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እርሱም። በኋላቸው ዞረህ በሾላው ዛፍ ፊት ለፊት ግጠማቸው እንጂ አትውጣ።

verses.text_english: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: በሾላውም ዛፍ ራስ ውስጥ የሽውሽውታ ድምፅ ስትሰማ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ ለመምታት በፊትህ ወጥቶ ይሆናልና በዚያን ጊዜ ቸኵል አለው።

verses.text_english: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ከገባዖንም እስከ ጌዝር ድረስ ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ።

verses.text_english: Again, David gathered together all chosen of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ዳግም ከእስራኤል የተመረጡትን ሠላሳ ሺህ ያህል ሰው ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: And David arose, and went with all the people that with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth the cherubims.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ በይሁዳ ካለች ከበኣል ተነሥተው በኪሩቤል ላይ በተቀመጠ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የተጠራውን የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ከዚያ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት በአዲስ ሰረገላ ላይ ጫኑ፥ በኮረብታውም ላይ ከነበረው ከአሚናዳብ ቤት አመጡት፤ የአሚናዳብ ልጆችም ዖዛ እና አሒዮ አዲሱን ሰረገላ ይነዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.text_amharic: በኮረብታውም ላይ ከነበረው ከአሚናዳብ ቤት የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ባመጡ ጊዜ አሒዮ በታቦቱ ፊት ይሄድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና የእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ በቅኔና በበገና በመሰንቆም በከበሮም በነጋሪትና በጸናጽል በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሙሉ ኃይላቸው ይጫወቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook .
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ናኮንም አውድማ በደረሱ ጊዜ በሬዎቹ ይፋንኑ ነበርና ዖዛ እጁን ዘርግቶ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ያዘ።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for error; and there he died by the ark of God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በዖዛ ላይ ነደደ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ድፍረቱ በዚያው ቀሠፈው፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት አጠገብ በዚያው ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ዖዛን ስለ ሰበረው ዳዊት አዘነ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የዚያ ስፍራ ስም የዖዛ ስብራት ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.text_english: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን ፈራና። የእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ወደ እኔ እንዴት ይመጣል? አለ።

verses.text_english: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ወደ እርሱ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ ያመጣው ዘንድ አልወደደም፤ ዳዊትም በጌት ሰው በአቢዳራ ቤት አገባው።

verses.text_english: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obededom, and all his household.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት በጌት ሰው በአቢዳራ ቤት ሦስት ወር ያህል ተቀመጠ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አቢዳራንና ቤቱን ሁሉ ባረከ።

verses.text_english: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obededom, and all that unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር የአቢዳራን ቤትና የነበረውን ሁሉ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ታቦት እንደ ባረከ ሰማ። ዳዊትም ሄዶ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ከአቢዳራ ቤት ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ በደስታ አመጣው።

verses.text_english: And it was , that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት የተሸከሙ ስድስት እርምጃ በሄዱ ጊዜ አንድ በሬና አንድ ፍሪዳ ሠዋ።

verses.text_english: And David danced before the LORD with all might; and David girded with a linen ephod.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በሙሉ ኃይሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይዘፍን ነበር፤ ዳዊትም የበፍታ ኤፉድ ለብሶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና የእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ ሆ እያሉ ቀንደ መለከትም እየነፉ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ በገባ ጊዜ የሳኦል ልጅ ሜልኮል በመስኮት ሆና ተመለከተች፥ ንጉሡም ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሲዘልልና ሲዘፍን አየች፤ በልብዋም ናቀችው።

verses.text_english: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት አገቡ፥ ዳዊትም በተከለለት ድንኳን ውስጥ በስፍራው አኖሩት፤ ዳዊትም የሚቃጠልና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕትን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አሳረገ።

verses.text_english: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የሚቃጠልና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ማሳረግ ከፈጸመ በኋላ ሕዝቡን በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ስም መረቀ።

verses.text_english: And he dealt among all the people, among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece , and a flagon . So all the people departed every one to his house.
verses.text_amharic: ለሕዝቡም ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ወገን ለወንዱም ለሴቱም ለእያንዳንዱ አንዳንድ እንጀራ አንዳንድም የሥጋ ቍራጭ አንዳንድም የዘቢብ ጥፍጥፍ አከፋፈለ። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ቤተ ሰቡን ሊመርቅ ተመለሰ። የሳኦልም ልጅ ሜልኮል ዳዊትን ለመቀበል ወጣችና። ምናምንቴዎች እርቃናቸውን እንደሚገልጡ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ በባሪያዎቹ ቈነጃጅት ፊት እርቃኑን በመግለጡ ምንኛ የተከበረ ነው! አለችው።

verses.text_english: And David said unto Michal, before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሜልኮልን። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘፍኛለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ እሆን ዘንድ ከአባትሽና ከቤቱ ሁሉ ይልቅ የመረጠኝ እግዚአብሔር የተባረከ ይሁን ስለዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እጫወታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከሆንሁት ይልቅ የተናቅሁ እሆናለሁ፥ በዓይንሽም እዋረዳለሁ፤ ነገር ግን በተናገርሽው ቈነጃጅት ዘንድ እከብራለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ልጅ ሜልኮል እስከ ሞተችበት ቀን ድረስ ልጅ አልወለደችም።፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ንጉሡ በቤቱ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርም በዙሪያው ካሉት ጠላቶቹ ሁሉ ባሳረፈው ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ነቢዩን ናታንን። እኔ ከዝግባ በተሠራ ቤት ተቀምጬአለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ግን በመጋረጆች ውስጥ እንደ ተቀመጠ እይ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that in thine heart; for the LORD with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ናታንም ንጉሡን። እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና ሂድ፥ በልብህም ያለውን ሁሉ አድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሌሊት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ናታን መጣ እንዲህም አለው።

verses.text_english: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
Whereas I have not dwelt in house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ፥ ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በድንኳንና በማደሪያ እሄድ ነበር እንጂ በቤት አልተቀመጥሁምና አንተ የምኖርበትን ቤት አትሠራልኝም።

verses.text_english: In all wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ጋር ባለፍሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ። ስለ ምን ቤትን ከዝግባ እንጨት አልሠራችሁልኝም? ብዬ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን ይጠብቅ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ላዘዝሁት ለአንዱ በውኑ ተናግሬአለሁን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ዳዊትን ባሪያዬን እንዲህ በለው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ መንጋውን ስትከተል በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆን ዘንድ ከበግ ጥበቃ ወሰድሁህ፤

verses.text_english: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great that in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በሄድህበትም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ከፊትህ አጠፋሁ፤ በምድርም ላይ እንዳሉ እንደ ታላላቆቹ ስም ታላቅ ስም አደርግልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
And as since the time that I commanded judges over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.
verses.text_amharic: ዕድሜህም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ከአባቶችህም ጋር ባንቀላፋህ ጊዜ፥ ከወገብህ የሚወጣውን ዘርህን ከአንተ በኋላ አስነሣለሁ፥ መንግሥቱንም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል፤ የመንግሥቱንም ዙፋን ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁ፥ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል፤ ክፉ ነገርም ቢያደርግ፥ ሰው በሚቀጣበት በትርና በሰው ልጆች መቀጫ እገሥጸዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
verses.text_amharic: ከፊቴም ከጣልሁት ከሳኦል እንዳራቅሁ ምሕረቴን ከእርሱ አላርቅም።

verses.text_english: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቤትህና መንግሥትህም በፊቴ ለዘላለም ይጠነክራል፥ ዙፋንህም ለዘላለም ይጸናል።

verses.text_english: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ቃል ሁሉ እንደዚህም ራእይ ሁሉ ናታን ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.text_english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ዳዊትም ገባ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ተቀምጦ እንዲህ አለ። ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እስከዚህ ያደረስኸኝ እኔ ማን ነኝ?

verses.text_english: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who I, O Lord GOD? and what my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.text_amharic: ቤቴስ ምንድር ነው? ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ይህ በፊትህ ጥቂት ነበረ፤ ስለ ባሪያህም ቤት ደግሞ ለሩቅ ዘመን ተናገርህ፤ ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ይህ የሰው ሕግ ነው።

verses.text_english: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አንተ ባሪያህን ታውቃለህና ዳዊትስ ይናገርህ ዘንድ የሚጨምረው ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህም ታስታውቀው ዘንድ ስለ ቃልህ ምክንያትና እንደ ልብህ አሳብ ይህን ታላቅ ነገር ሁሉ አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know .
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ የለምና፥ በጆሮአችንም እንደ ሰማን ሁሉ ከአንተ በቀር አምላክ የለምና አንተ ታላቅ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for none like thee, neither God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱ ለራሱ እንዲሆን ሕዝብን ይቤዥ ዘንድ ለእርሱ ለራሱም ስም ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ በአሕዛብና በአምላኮቻቸውም ፊት ከግብጽ በተቤዠው ሕዝብ ፊት ተአምራትንና ድንቅን ያደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሄደለት እንደ ሕዝብህ እንደ እስራኤል ያለ በምድር ላይ ምን ሕዝብ አለ?

verses.text_english: And what one nation in the earth like thy people, like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, the nations and their gods?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህንም እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ሕዝብ አድርገህ አጽንተኸዋል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ አምላክ ሆነሃቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ አሁንም ለባሪያህና ለቤቱ የተናገርኸውን ለዘላለም አጽናው፥ እንደ ተናገርህም አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤል አምላክ ነው ይባል ዘንድ ስምህ ለዘላለም ታላቅ ይሁን፤ የባሪያህም የዳዊት ቤት በፊትህ የጸና ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ። እኔ ቤት እሠራልሃለሁ ብለህ ለባሪያህ ገልጠሃልና ስለዚህ ባሪያህ ይህችን ጸሎት ወደ አንተ ይጸልይ ዘንድ በልቡ ደፈረ።

verses.text_english: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አሁንም አንተ አምላክ ነህ፥ ቃልህም እውነት ነው፥ ይህንም መልካም ነገር ለባሪያህ ተናግረሃል።

verses.text_english: And now, O Lord GOD, thou that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አንተ ተናግረሃልና አሁን እንግዲህ ለዘላለም በፊትህ ይሆን ዘንድ የባሪያህን ቤት፥ እባክህ፥ ባርክ፤ በበረከትህም የባሪያህ ቤት ለዘላለም ይባረክ።

verses.text_english: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ፥ አዋረዳቸውም፤ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ ሜቴግ አማ የተባለችውን ከተማ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And the Moabites became David's servants, brought gifts.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብን መታ፥ ሞዓባውያንንም በምድር ጥሎ በገመድ ሰፈራቸው፤ በሁለትም ገመድ ለሞት፥ በአንድም ገመድ ሙሉ ለሕይወት ሰፈራቸው፤ ሞዓባውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፥ ግብርም አመጡለት።

verses.text_english: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ደግሞ በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ የነበረውን ግዛት መልሶ ለመያዝ በሄደ ጊዜ የረአብን ልጅ የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን መታ።

verses.text_english: And David took from him a thousand , and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot , but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ፈረሰኞች፥ ሀያ ሺህም እግረኞች ያዘ፤ ዳዊትም የሰረገለኛውን ፈረስ ሁሉ ቋንጃ ቈረጠ፤ ለመቶ ሰረገላ ብቻ አስቀረ።

verses.text_english: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: ከደማስቆም ሶርያውያን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ በመጡ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከሶርያውያን ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎች ገደለ።

verses.text_english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በደማስቆ ሶርያ ጭፍሮች አኖረ፥ ሶርያውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፥ ግብርም አመጡለት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊት በሄደበት ሁሉ ድልን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ለአድርአዛር ባሪያዎች የነበሩትን የወርቅ ጋሾች ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ይዞአቸው መጣ።

verses.text_english: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ከአድርአዛር ከተሞች ከቤጣሕና ከቤሮታይ እጅግ ብዙ ናስ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.text_amharic: የሐማትም ንጉሥ ቶዑ ዳዊት የአድርአዛርን ጭፍራ ሁሉ እንደ መታ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.text_amharic: ቶዑም ከአድርአዛር ጋር ሁልጊዜ ይዋጋ ነበርና ዳዊት አድርአዛርን ድል ስለ መታ ቶዑ ልጁን አዶራምን ደኅንነቱን ይጠይቅ ዘንድ፥ ይመርቀውም ዘንድ ወደ ንጉሥ ዳዊት ላከው፤ እርሱም የብርና የወርቅ የናስም ዕቃ ይዞ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በተመለሰ ጊዜ ከኤዶምያስ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ሰዎች በጨው ሸለቆ ውስጥ በመምታቱ ስሙ ተጠራ።

verses.text_english: And David gat a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, eighteen thousand .
verses.text_amharic: በኤዶምያስ ሁሉ ጭፍሮች አኖረ፥ ኤዶማውያንም ሁሉ ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊት በሚሄድበት ሁሉ ድልን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ፤ ዳዊትም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አደረገላቸው።

verses.text_english: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብም የሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ፤ የአሒሉድም ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud recorder;
verses.text_amharic: የአኪጦብም ልጅ ሳዶቅ፥ የአቢሜሌክም ልጅ አብያታር ካህናት ነበሩ፤ ሠራያም ጸሐፊ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, the priests; and Seraiah the scribe;
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ በከሊታውያንና በፈሊታውያን ላይ ነበረ፤ የዳዊትም ልጆች አማካሪዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ስለ ዮናታን ቸርነት አደርግለት ዘንድ ከሳኦል ቤት አንድ ሰው ቀርቶአልን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And of the house of Saul a servant whose name Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant .
verses.text_amharic: ከሳኦልም ቤት ሲባ የሚባል አንድ ባሪያ ነበረ፥ ወደ ዳዊትም ጠሩት፤ ንጉሡም። አንተ ሲባ ነህን? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king said, there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, lame on feet.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት አደርግለት ዘንድ ከሳኦል ቤት አንድ ሰው አልቀረምን? አለ። ሲባም ንጉሡን። እግሩ ሽባ የሆነ አንድ የዮናታን ልጅ አለ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto him, Where he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ወዴት ነው? አለው፤ ሲባም ንጉሡን። እነሆ፥ እርሱ በሎዶባር በዓሚኤል ልጅ በማኪር ቤት አለ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ልኮ ከሎዶባር ከዓሚኤል ልጅ ከማኪር ቤት አስመጣው።

verses.text_english: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ልጅ የዮናታን ልጅ ሜምፊቦስቴ ወደ ዳዊት መጣ፥ በግምባሩም ወድቆ እጅ ነሣ፤ ዳዊትም። ሜምፊቦስቴ ሆይ፥ አለ፤ እርሱም። እነሆኝ ባሪያህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ስለ አባትህ ስለ ዮናታን ቸርነት ፈጽሜ አደርግልሃለሁና አትፍራ፤ የአባትህንም የሳኦልን ምድር ሁሉ እመልስልሃለሁ፥ አንተም ሁልጊዜ ከገበታዬ እንጀራ ትበላለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he bowed himself, and said, What thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I ?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሞተ ውሻ ወደምመስል ወደ እኔ የተመለከትህ እኔ ባሪያህ ምንድር ነኝ? ብሎ እጅ ነሣ።

verses.text_english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የሳኦልን ባሪያ ሲባን ጠርቶ። ለሳኦልና ለቤቱ ሁሉ የነበረውን ሁሉ ለጌታህ ልጅ ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in , that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.text_amharic: አንተና ልጆችህ ሎሌዎችህም ምድሩን እረሱለት፤ ለጌታህም ልጅ እንጀራ ይሆነው ዘንድ ፍሬውን አግባ፤ የጌታህ ልጅ ሜምፊቦስቴ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከገበታዬ ይበላል አለው። ለሲባም አሥራ አምስት ልጆችና ሀያ ባሪያዎች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, , he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.
verses.text_amharic: ሲባም ንጉሡን። ጌታዬ ንጉሡ ባሪያውን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ ባሪያህ ያደርጋል አለው። ሜምፊቦስቴም ከንጉሡ ልጆች እንደ አንዱ ከዳዊት ገበታ ይበላ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba servants unto Mephibosheth.
verses.text_amharic: ለሜምፊቦስቴም ሚካ የተባለ ታናሽ ልጅ ነበረው። በሲባም ቤት ያሉ ሁሉ ለሜምፊቦስቴ ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
verses.text_amharic: ሜምፊቦስቴም ከንጉሥ ገበታ ሁልጊዜ እየበላ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ሁለት እግሩም ሽባ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ ሞተ፥ ልጁም ሐኖን በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። አባቱ ወረታ እንዳደረገልኝ እኔ ለናዖስ ልጅ ለሐኖን ቸርነት አደርጋለሁ አለ። ዳዊትም አባቱ ስለ ሞተ ሊያጽናናው ባሪያዎቹን ላከ፤ የዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ወደ አሞን ልጆች አገር መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች አለቆች ጌታቸውን ሐኖንን። ዳዊት አባትህን አክብሮ ሊያጽናናህ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ አንተ የላከ ይመስልሃልን? ዳዊትስ ከተማይቱን ለመመርመርና ለመሰለል ለማጥፋትም ባሪያዎቹን የላከ አይደለምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, to their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.text_amharic: ሐኖንም የዳዊትን ባሪያዎች ወስዶ የጢማቸውን ገሚስ ላጨ፥ ልብሳቸውንም እስከ ወገባቸው ድረስ ከሁለት ቀድዶ ሰደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: When they told unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and return.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ያን በሰማ ጊዜ ሰዎቹ እጅግ አፍረው ነበሩና ተቀባዮች ላከ። ንጉሡም። ጢማችሁ እስኪያድግ ድረስ በኢያሪኮ ተቀመጡ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ተመለሱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.
