verses.text_amharic: የአሞን ልጆች በዳዊት ዘንድ እንደተጠሉ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ የአሞን ልጆች ልከው ከሶርያውያን ከቤትሮዖብና ከሱባ ሀያ ሺህ እግረኞች፥ ከመዓካ ንጉሥም አንድ ሺህ ሰዎች፥ ከጦብም አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎች ቀጠሩ።

verses.text_english: And when David heard of , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮአብንና የኃያላኑን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, by themselves in the field.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ወጥተው በበሩ መግቢያ ፊት ለፊት ተሰለፉ፤ የሱባና የረአብ ሶርያውያን፥ የጦብና የመዓካም ሰዎች ለብቻቸው በሰፊ ሜዳ ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice of Israel, and put in array against the Syrians:
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም በፊትና በኋላ ሰልፍ እንደ ከበበው ባየ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ምርጥ ምርጦቹን ሁሉ መረጠ፥ በሶርያውያንም ፊት ለሰልፍ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውንም ሕዝብ በወንድሙ በአቢሳ እጅ አድርጎ በአሞን ልጆች ፊት ለሰልፍ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያውያን ቢበረቱብኝ ትረዳኛለህ፤ የአሞን ልጆች ቢበረቱብህ እኔ መጥቼ እረዳሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.
verses.text_amharic: አይዞህ፤ ስለ ሕዝባችንና ስለ አምላካችንም ከተሞች እንበርታ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደስ ያሰኘውን ያድርግ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረው ሕዝብ ከሶርያውያን ጋር ሊዋጉ ቀረቡ፥ እነርሱም ከፊቱ ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ሶርያውያን እንደ ሸሹ ባዩ ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከአቢሳ ፊት ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ገቡ፤ ኢዮአብም ከአሞን ልጆች ዘንድ ተመልሶ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያውያንም በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ በአንድነት ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer before them.
verses.text_amharic: አድርአዛርም ልኮ በወንዝ ማዶ የነበሩትን ሶርያውያን፥ አመጣ፤ ወደ ኤላምም መጡ፥ የአድርአዛርም ሠራዊት አለቃ ሶባክ በፊታቸው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻግሮ ወደኤላም መጣ፤ ሶርያውያንም በዳዊት ፊት ተሰልፈው ከእርሱ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.text_english: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያውያንም ከእስራኤል ፊት ሸሹ፤ ዳዊትም ከሶርያውያን ሰባት መቶ ሰረገለኞች አርባ ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ገደለ፤ የሠራዊቱንም አለቃ ሶባክን መታ፥ እርሱም በዚያ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And when all the kings servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.text_amharic: ለአድርአዛርም የሚገብሩ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ጋር ታረቁ፥ ገበሩላቸውም። ሶርያውያንም ከዚያ ወዲያ የአሞንን ልጆች ይረዱ ዘንድ ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth , that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዓመቱ መለወጫ ነገሥታት ወደ ሰልፍ በሚወጡበት ጊዜ፥ ዳዊት ኢዮአብን ከእርሱም ጋር ባሪያዎቹን እስራኤልንም ሁሉ ሰደደ። የአሞንም ልጆች አገር አጠፉ፥ ረባትንም ከበቡ፤ ዳዊት ግን በኢየሩሳሌም ቀርቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman very beautiful to look upon.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ወደ ማታ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከምንጣፉ ተነሣ፥ በንጉሥም ቤት በሰገነት ላይ ተመላለሰ፤ በሰገነቱ ሳለ አንዲት ሴት ስትታጠብ አየ፤ ሴቲቱም መልከ መልካም ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And said, not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ልኮ ስለ ሴቲቱ ጠየቀ፤ አንድ ሰውም። ይህች የኤልያብ ልጅ የኬጢያዊው የኦርዮ ሚስት ቤርሳቤህ አይደለችምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም መልእክተኞች ልኮ አስመጣት፤ ወደ እርሱም ገባች፥ ከርኵሰትዋም ነጽታ ነበርና ከእርስዋ ጋር ተኛ፤ ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።

verses.text_english: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I with child.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም አረገዘች፥ ወደ ዳዊትም። አርግዤአለሁ ብላ ላከችበት።

verses.text_english: And David sent to Joab, , Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ ኢዮአብ። ኬጢያዊውን ኦርዮን ስደድልኝ ብሎ ላከ። ኢዮአብም ኦርዮን ወደ ዳዊት ሰደደው።

verses.text_english: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርዮም ወደ እርሱ በመጣ ጊዜ ዳዊት የኢዮአብንና የሕዝቡን ደኅንነት፥ ሰልፉም እንዴት እንደ ሆነ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess from the king.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ኦርዮን። ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ፥ እግርህንም ታጠብ አለው። ኦርዮም ከንጉሡ ቤት ሲወጣ ማለፊያ የንጉሥ መብል ተከትሎት ሄደ።

verses.text_english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርዮ ግን ከጌታው ባሪያዎች ሁሉ ጋር በንጉሥ ቤት ደጅ ተኛ፥ ወደ ቤቱም አልወረደም።

verses.text_english: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from journey? why didst thou not go down unto thine house?
verses.text_amharic: ኦርዮ ወደ ቤቱ አልሄደም ብለው ለዳዊት ነገሩት፤ ዳዊትም ኦርዮን። አንተ ከመንገድ የመጣህ አይደለምን? ስለ ምን ወደ ቤትህ አልወረድህም? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? thou livest, and thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርዮም ዳዊትን። ታቦቱና እስራኤል ይሁዳም በጎጆ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ጌታዬ ኢዮአብና የጌታዬም ባሪያዎች በሰፊ ሜዳ ሰፍረዋል፤ እኔ ልበላና ልጠጣ ወይስ ከሚስቴ ጋር ልተኛ ወደ ቤቴ እሄዳለሁን? በሕይወትህና በሕያው ነፍስህ እምላለሁ! ይህን ነገር አላደርገውም አለው።

verses.text_english: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ኦርዮን። ዛሬ ደግሞ በዚህ ተቀመጥ፥ ነገም አሰናብትሃለሁ አለው። ኦርዮም በዚያ ቀንና በነጋው በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ጠራው፥ በፊቱም በላና ጠጣ፥ አሰከረውም፤ ነገር ግን በመሸ ጊዜ ወጥቶ ከጌታው ባሪያዎች ጋር በምንጣፉ ላይ ተኛ፥ ወደ ቤቱም አልወረደም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent by the hand of Uriah.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ ዳዊት ለኢዮአብ ደብዳቤ ጻፈ፥ በኦርዮም እጅ ላከው።

verses.text_english: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
verses.text_amharic: በደብዳቤውም። ኦርዮን ጽኑ ሰልፍ ባለበት በፊተኛው ስፍራ አቁሙት፥ ተመትቶም ይሞት ዘንድ ከኋላው ሽሹ ብሎ ጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men .
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ከተማይቱን በከበበ ጊዜ ጀግኖች እንዳሉበት በሚያውቀው ስፍራ ኦርዮን አቆመው።

verses.text_english: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱም ሰዎች ወጥተው ከኢዮአብ ጋር ተዋጉ፤ ከዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ከሕዝቡ አንዳንዱ ወደቁ፤ ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮም ደግሞ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ልኮ በሰልፍ የሆነውን ሁሉ ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
verses.text_amharic: ለመልእክተኛውም እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዘው። የሰልፉን ነገር ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ነግረህ በፈጸምህ ጊዜ።

verses.text_english: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.text_amharic: ስትዋጉ ወደ ከተማይቱ ለምን ቀረባችሁ? ከቅጥሩ በላይ ፍላጻ እንዲወረወር አታውቁምን?

verses.text_english: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.text_amharic: የሩቤሼትን ልጅ አቤሜሌክን ማን ገደለው? ከቅጥር ላይ የወፍጮ መጅ ጥላ በቴቤስ ላይ የገደለችው አንዲት ሴት አይደለችምን? ስለ ምን ወደ ቅጥሩ እንደዚህ ቀርባችሁ? ብሎ ንጉሡ ሲቈጣ ብታይ፥ አንተ። ባሪያህ ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮ ደግሞ ሞተ በለው።

verses.text_english: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
verses.text_amharic: መልእክተኛውም ተነሥቶ ሄደ፥ ኢዮአብም ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.text_amharic: መልእክተኛውም ዳዊትን። ሰዎቹ በረቱብን፥ ወደ ሜዳም ወጡብን፤ እኛም ወደቅንባቸው፥ እስከ ከተማይቱም በር ድረስ ተከተልናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጻ የሚወረውሩም በቅጥሩ ላይ ሆነው በባሪያዎችህ ላይ ወረወሩ፤ ከንጉሡም ባሪያዎች አንዳንድ ሞቱ፥ ባሪያህም ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮ ደግሞ ሞተ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም መልእክተኛውን። ሰይፍ አንድ ጊዜ ይህን አንድ ጊዜም ያን ያጠፋልና ይህ ነገር በዓይንህ አይክፋ፤ ከተማይቱን የሚወጉትን አበርታ፥ አፍርሳትም ብለህ ለኢዮአብ ንገረው፤ አንተም አጽናው አለው።

verses.text_english: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.text_amharic: የኦርዮም ሚስት ባልዋ ኦርዮ እንደሞተ በሰማች ጊዜ ለባልዋ አለቀሰች።

verses.text_english: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የልቅሶዋም ወራት ሲፈጸም ዳዊት ልኮ ወደ ቤቱ አስመጣት፥ ሚስትም ሆነችው፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደችለት፤ ነገር ግን ዳዊት ያደረገው ነገር ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ናታንን ወደ ዳዊት ላከ፥ ወደ እርሱም መጥቶ አለው። በአንድ ከተማ አንዱ ባለጠጋ አንዱም ድሀ የሆኑ ሁለት ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The rich had exceeding many flocks and herds:
verses.text_amharic: ባለጠጋውም እጅግ ብዙ በግና ላም ነበረው።

verses.text_english: But the poor had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ለድሀው ግን ከገዛት አንዲት ታናሽ በግ በቀር አንዳች አልነበረውም፤ አሳደጋትም፥ ከልጆቹም ጋር በእርሱ ዘንድ አደገች፤ እንጀራውንም ትበላ፥ ከዋንጫውም ትጠጣ፥ በብብቱም ትተኛ ነበር፥ እንደ ልጁም ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባለጠጋውም እንግዳ በመጣ ጊዜ ከበጉና ከላሙ ወስዶ ለዚያ ወደ እርሱ ለመጣው እንግዳ ያዘጋጅለት ዘንድ ሳሳ፤ የዚያንም የድሀውን ሰው በግ ወስዶ ለዚያ ለመጣው ሰው አዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this shall surely die:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በዚያ ሰው ላይ እጅግ ተቈጥቶ ናታንን። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ይህን ያደረገ ሰው የሞት ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን አድርጎአልና፥ አላዘነምና ስለ አንዲቱ በግ አራት ይመልስ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Nathan said to David, Thou the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;
verses.text_amharic: ናታንም ዳዊትን አለው። ያ ሰው አንተ ነህ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ልትሆን ቀባሁህ፥ ከሳኦልም እጅ አዳንሁህ፤

verses.text_english: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታህንም ቤት ሰጠሁህ፥ የጌታህንም ሚስቶች በብብትህ ጣልሁልህ፤ የእስራኤልንና የይሁዳን ቤት ሰጠሁህ፤ ይህም አንሶ ቢሆን ኖሮ ከዚህ የበለጠ እጨምርልህ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ በፊቱ ክፉ ትሠራ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ነገር ለምን አቃለልህ? ኬጢያዊውን ኦርዮን በሰይፍ መትተሃል፥ ሚስቱንም ለአንተ ሚስት ትሆን ዘንድ ወስደሃል፤ እርሱንም በአሞን ልጆች ሰይፍ ገድለሃል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም አቃልለኸኛልና፥ የኬጢያዊውንም የኦርዮን ሚስት ለአንተ ሚስት ትሆን ዘንድ ወስደሃልና ለዘላለም ከቤትህ ሰይፍ አይርቅም።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከቤትህ ክፉ ነገር አስነሣብሃለሁ፤ ሚስቶችህንም በዓይንህ ፊት እወስዳለሁ፥ ለዘመድህም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ በዚህችም ፀሐይ ዓይን ፊት ከሚስቶችህ ጋር ይተኛል።

verses.text_english: For thou didst secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ይህን በስውር አድርገኸዋል፤ እኔ ግን ይህን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊትና በፀሐይ ፊት አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ናታንን። እግዚአብሔርን በድያለሁ አለው። ናታንም ዳዊትን። እግዚአብሔር ደግሞ ኃጢአትህን አርቆልሃል፤ አትሞትም።

verses.text_english: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also born unto thee shall surely die.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በዚህ ነገር ለእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶች ታላቅ የስድብ ምክንያት አድርገሃልና ስለዚህ ደግሞ የተወለደልህ ልጅ ፈጽሞ ይሞታል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
verses.text_amharic: ናታንም ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ። እግዚአብሔርም የኦርዮ ሚስት ለዳዊት የወለደችውን ሕፃን ቀሠፈ፥ እጅግም ታምሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ስለ ሕፃኑ እግዚአብሔርን ለመነ፤ ዳዊትም ጾመ፥ ገብቶም በመሬት ላይ ተኛ።

verses.text_english: And the elders of his house arose, to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱም ሽማግሌዎች ተነሥተው ከምድር ያነሡት ዘንድ በአጠገቡ ቆሙ፤ እርሱ ግን እንቢ አለ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር እንጀራ አልበላም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ሕፃኑ ሞተ። የዳዊትም ባሪያዎች። ሕፃኑ በሕይወት ሳለ ብንነግረው አልሰማንም፤ ይልቁንስ ሕፃኑ እንደ ሞተ ብንነግረው እንዴት ይሆን? በነፍሱ ክፉ ያደርጋል ብለው ሕፃኑ እንደ ሞተ ይነግሩት ዘንድ ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ባሪያዎቹ በሹክሹክታ ሲነጋገሩ ባየ ጊዜ ዳዊት ሕፃኑ እንደ ሞተ አወቀ፤ ዳዊትም ባሪያዎቹን። ሕፃኑ ሞቶአል? አላቸው። እነርሱም። ሞቶአል አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed , and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከምድር ተነሥቶ ታጠበ፥ ተቀባም፥ ልብሱንም ለወጠ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገብቶ ሰገደ። ወደ ቤቱም መጣ። እንጀራ አምጡልኝ አለ፤ በፊቱም አቀረቡለት፥ በላም።

verses.text_english: Then said his servants unto him, What thing this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹም። ይህ ያደረግኸው ነገር ምንድር ነው? በሕይወት ሳለ ስለ ሕፃኑ ጾምህና አለቀስህ፤ ከሞተ በኋላ ግን ተነሥተህ እንጀራ በላህ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሕፃኑ ሕያው ሳለ። እግዚአብሔር ይምረኝ፥ ሕፃኑም በሕይወት ይኖር እንደ ሆነ ማን ያውቃል? ብዬ ጾምሁ አለቅሰሁም።

verses.text_english: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን ሞቶአል፤ የምጾመው ስለ ምንድር ነው? በውኑ እንግዲህ እመልሰው ዘንድ ይቻለኛልን? እኔ ወደ እርሱ እሄዳለሁ እንጂ እርሱ ወደ እኔ አይመለስም አለ።

verses.text_english: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሚስቱን ቤርሳቤህን አጽናናት፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገባ፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ተኛ፤ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ሰሎሞን ብሎ ጠራው። እግዚአብሔርም ወደደው፤

verses.text_english: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በነቢዩ በናታን እጅ ልኮ ስሙን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ይዲድያ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም የአሞንን ልጆች ከተማ ረባትን ወጋ፥ የውኃውንም ከተማ ያዘ።

verses.text_english: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ወደ ዳዊት። ረባትን ወግቻለሁ፥ የውኃውንም ከተማ ይዤአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከተማይቱን እንዳልይዝ፥ በስሜም እንዳትጠራ፥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ ሰብስብ፥ ከተማይቱንም ከብበህ ያዝ ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.text_english: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ወደ ረባት ሄደ፥ ወግቶም ያዛት።

verses.text_english: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሣቸውንም ዘውድ ከራሱ ላይ ወሰደ። ክብደቱም አንድ መክሊት ወርቅ ያህል ነበር፥ ክቡር ዕንቍም ነበረበት፤ ዳዊትም በራሱ ላይ አደረገው። ከከተማይቱም እጅግ ብዙ ምርኮ አወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he brought forth the people that therein, and put under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጥዋም የነበሩትን ሕዝብ አውጥቶ በመጋዝና በብረት መቈፈሪያና በብረት መጥረቢያ እንዲሠሩ አደረጋቸው፤ የሸክላ ጡብም እንዲያቃጥሉ አደረጋቸው፤ በአሞን ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ እንዲህ አደረገ። ዳዊትም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ለዳዊት ልጅ ለአቤሴሎም አንዲት የተዋበች እኅት ነበረችው፥ ስምዋም ትዕማር ነበረ፤ የዳዊትም ልጅ አምኖን ወደዳት።

verses.text_english: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.
verses.text_amharic: አምኖንም ከእኅቱ ከትዕማር የተነሣ እጅግ ስለ ተከዘ ታመመ፤ ድንግልም ነበረችና አንዳች ያደርጋት ዘንድ በዓይኑ ፊት ጭንቅ ሆኖበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Amnon had a friend, whose name Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab a very subtil man.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምኖንም የዳዊት ወንድም የሳምዓ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ የሚባል ወዳጅ ነበረው፤ ኢዮናዳብም እጅግ ብልህ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Why thou, the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የንጉሥ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለ ምን ቀን በቀን እንዲህ ከሳህ? አትነግረኝምን? አለው። አምኖንም። የወንድሜን የአቤሴሎምን እኅት ትዕማርን እወድዳታለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see , and eat at her hand.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮናዳብም። ታምሜአለሁ ብለህ በአልጋህ ላይ ተኛ፤ አባትህም ሊያይህ በመጣ ጊዜ። እኅቴ ትዕማር እንድትመጣና እኔ የምበላውን እንጀራ እንድትሰጠኝ፥ መብሉንም እኔ እያየሁ እንድታዘጋጅልኝ፥ ከእጅዋም እንድበላው እለምንሃለሁ በል አለው።

verses.text_english: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም አምኖን። ታምሜአለሁ ብሎ ተኛ፤ ንጉሡም ሊያየው በመጣ ጊዜ አምኖን ንጉሡን። እኅቴ ትዕማር እንድትመጣና እኔ እያየሁ ሁለት እንጎቻ እንድታደርግልኝ፥ ከእጅዋም እንድበላ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። መብልን ታዘጋጂለት ዘንድ ወደ ወንድምሽ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሂጂ ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ወደ ትዕማር ቤት ላከ።

verses.text_english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded , and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕማርም ወደ ወንድምዋ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሄደች፥ ተኝቶም ነበር፤ ዱቄትም ወስዳ ለወሰች፥ እያየም እንጎቻ አደረገች፥ ጋገረችም።

verses.text_english: And she took a pan, and poured out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
verses.text_amharic: ምጣዱንም ወስዳ በፊቱ ገለበጠች እርሱ ግን ይበላ ዘንድ እንቢ አለ። አምኖንም። ሰውን ሁሉ ከእኔ ዘንድ አስወጡ አለ፤ ሰውም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
verses.text_amharic: አምኖንም ትዕማርን። ከእጅሽ እበላ ዘንድ መብሉን ወደ እልፍኙ አግቢው አላት፤ ትዕማርም የሠራችውን እንጎቻ ወስዳ ወንድምዋ አምኖን ወዳለበት እልፍኝ አገባችው።

verses.text_english: And when she had brought unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.
verses.text_amharic: መብሉንም ባቀረበች ጊዜ ያዛትና። እኅቴ ሆይ፥ ነዪ ከእኔም ጋር ተኚ አላት።

verses.text_english: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ መልሳ። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ አይሆንም፤ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር በእስራኤል ዘንድ አይገባምና አታሳፍረኝ፤ ይህንም ነውረኛ ሥራ አታድርግ።

verses.text_english: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ነውሬን ወዴት ልሸከም? አንተም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከምናምንቴዎች እንደ አንዱ ትሆናለህ፤ እንግዲህስ ለንጉሡ ንገረው፥ እኔንም አይነሣህም አለችው።

verses.text_english: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልዋን ግን አልሰማም፤ ከእርስዋም ይልቅ ብርቱ ነበረና በግድ አስነወራት፥ ከእርስዋም ጋር ተኛ።

verses.text_english: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ አምኖን ፈጽሞ ጠላት፤ አስቀድሞም ከወደዳት ውድ ይልቅ በኋላ የጠላት ጥል በለጠ። አምኖንም። ተነሥተሽ ሂጂ አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said unto him, no cause: this evil in sending me away greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አይሆንም፤ ቀድሞ ከሠራኸው ክፋት ይልቅ አኔን በማውጣትህ የበለጠ ክፋት ትሠራለህ አለችው፤ እርሱ ግን አልሰማትም።

verses.text_english: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this out from me, and bolt the door after her.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያገለግለውንም ብላቴና ጠርቶ። ይህችን ሴት ከፊቴ አስወጥተህ በሩን ዝጋባት አለው።

verses.text_english: And a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ኅብር ያለውንም ልብስ ለብሳ ነበር፥ እንዲህ ያለውን ልብስ የንጉሡ ልጆች ደናግሉ ይለብሱ ነበርና፤ አገልጋዩም አስወጥቶ በሩን ዘጋባት።

verses.text_english: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕማርም በራስዋ ላይ አመድ ነስንሳ፥ ብዙ ኅብርም ያለውን ልብስዋን ተርትራ፥ እጅዋንም በራስዋ ላይ ጭና እየጮኸች ሄደች።

verses.text_english: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምዋም አቤሴሎም። ወንድምሽ አምኖን ከአንቺ ጋር ነበረን? እኅቴ ሆይ፥ አሁን ግን ዝም በዪ፤ ወንድምሽ ነው፤ ይህን ነገር በልብሽ አትያዢው አላት። ትዕማርም በወንድምዋ በአቤሴሎም ቤት ብቻዋን ተቀመጠች።

verses.text_english: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣ፤ ነገር ግን የበኵር ልጁ ነበረና ስለ ወደደው የልጁን የአምኖን ነፍስ አላሳዘነም።

verses.text_english: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም እኅቱን ትዕማርን ስላሳፈራት አምኖንን ጠልቶታልና አቤሴሎም አምኖንን ክፉም ሆነ መልካምም አልተናገረውም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለት ዓመትም በኋላ አቤሴሎም በኤፍሬም አቅራቢያ ባለችው በቤላሶር በጎቹን አሸለተ፤ አቤሴሎምም የንጉሡን ልጆች ሁሉ ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም ወደ ንጉሡ መጥቶ። እነሆ፥ ባሪያህ በጎቹን ያሸልታል፤ ንጉሡና ሎሌዎቹ ከባሪያህ ጋር ይሂዱ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አቤሴሎምን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እንከብድብሃለንና ሁላችን እንመጣ ዘንድ አይሆንም አለው። የግድም አለው፥ እርሱ ግን መረቀው እንጂ ለመሄድ እንቢ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም። አንተ እንቢ ካልህ ወንድሜ አምኖን ከእኛ ጋር እንዲሄድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ። ንጉሡም። ከአንተ ጋር ለምን ይሄዳል? አለው።

verses.text_english: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም የግድ አለው፥ አምኖንንና የንጉሡንም ልጆች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም እንደ ንጉሥ ግብዣ ያለ ግብዣ አደረገ፤ አቤሴሎምም አገልጋዮቹን። አምኖን የወይን ጠጅ ጠጥቶ ልቡን ደስ ባለው ጊዜ እዩ። አምኖንን ግደሉ ባልኋችሁም ጊዜ ግደሉት፥ አትፍሩም፤ ያዘዝኋችሁም እኔ ነኝና በርቱ ጽኑም ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
verses.text_amharic: የአቤሴሎም አገልጋዮች አቤሴሎም እንዳዘዛቸው በአምኖን ላይ አደረጉበት። የንጉሡም ልጆች ሁሉ ተነሥተው በየበቅሎቻቸው ተቀምጠው ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.
verses.text_amharic: ገናም በመንገድ ሲሄዱ ለዳዊት። አቤሴሎም የንጉሡን ልጆች ሁሉ ገድሎአል፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አልቀረም የሚል ወሬ መጣለት።

verses.text_english: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ተነሥቶ ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ በምድር ላይም ወደቀ፤ ባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ ልብሳቸውን ቀድደው በአጠገቡ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ወንድም የሳምዓ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ። ጌታዬ ጕልማሶቹ የንጉሡ ልጆች ሁሉ እንደ ሞቱ አያስብ፤ እኅቱን ትዕማርን በግድ ካስነወራት ጀምሮ በአቤሴሎም ዘንድ የተቈረጠ ነገር ነበረና የሞተ አምኖን ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የሞተ አምኖን ብቻ ነው እንጂ የንጉሥ ልጆች ሁሉ ሞቱ ብሎ ጌታዬ ንጉሡ ይህን ነገር በልቡ አያኑር አለው።

verses.text_english: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም ኰበለለ። ጕበኛውም ጕልማሳ ዓይኑን ከፍ አደረገ፥ እነሆም፥ ብዙ ሰዎች በኋላው በተራራው አጠገብ በመንገድ ሲመጡ አየ።

verses.text_english: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮናዳብም ንጉሡን። እነሆ፥ የንጉሡ ልጆች መጥተዋል፤ ባሪያህ እንዳለው እንዲሁ ሆኖአል አለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
verses.text_amharic: ተናግሮም በጨረሰ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ወዲያው የንጉሥ ልጆች ገቡ፥ ድምፃቸውንም ከፍ አድርገው አለቀሱ፤ ደግሞ ንጉሡና ባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ እጅግ ታላቅ ልቅሶ አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And mourned for his son every day.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎም ግን ኰብልሎ ወደ ጌሹር ንጉሥ ወደ ዓሚሁድ ልጅ ወደ ተልማይ ሄደ። ዳዊትም ሁልጊዜ ለልጁ ያለቅስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎም ኰብልሎ ወደ ጌሹር ሄደ፥ በዚያም ሦስት ዓመት ያህል ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ስለ አምኖን ሞት ተጽናንቶ ወደ አቤሴሎም ይሄድ ዘንድ እጅግ ናፈቀ።

verses.text_english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart toward Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ የንጉሡ ልብ ወደ አቤሴሎም እንዳዘነበለ አወቀ።

verses.text_english: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ወደ ቴቁሔ ልኮ ከዚያ ብልሃተኛ ሴት አስመጣና። አልቅሺ፥ የኀዘንም ልብስ ልበሺ፥ ዘይትም አትቀቢ፥ ስለ ሞተ ሰውም ብዙ ዘመን እንደምታለቅሺ ሁኚ፤

verses.text_english: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ንጉሡም ገብተሽ እንዲህ ያለውን ቃል ንገሪው አላት፤ ኢዮአብም ቃሉን በእርስዋ አፍ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም የቴቁሔይቱ ሴት ወደ ንጉሥ ገብታ በግምባርዋ በምድር ላይ ወደቀች፥ እጅ ነሥታም። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ አለች።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ምን ሆነሻል? አላት። እርስዋም መልሳ አለች። በእውነት እኔ ባሌ የሞተብኝ ባልቴት ሴት ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔም ለባሪያህ ሁለት ወንዶች ልጆች ነበሩኝ፥ በሜዳም ተጣሉ፤ የሚገላግላቸውም አልነበረም፥ አንዱም ሌላውን መትቶ ገደለው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband name nor remainder upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ዘመዶች ሁሉ በባሪያህ ላይ ተነሥተው። ስለ ገደለው ስለ ወንድሙ ነፍስ እንገድለው ዘንድ ወንድሙን የገደለውን አውጪ አሉኝ፤ እንዲሁም ደግሞ ወራሹን የቀረውን መብራቴን ያጠፋሉ፥ የባሌን ስምና ዘርም ከምድር ላይ አያስቀሩም።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴቲቱን። ወደ ቤትሽ ሂጂ፥ እኔም ስለ አንቺ አዝዛለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne guiltless.
verses.text_amharic: የቴቁሔይቱም ሴት ንጉሡን። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ኃጢአቱ በእኔና በአባቴ ቤት ላይ ይሁን፤ ንጉሡና ዙፋኑ ንጹሕ ይሁን አለችው።

verses.text_english: And the king said, Whosoever saith unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። የሚናገርሽን አምጪልኝ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ አይነካሽም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ደም ተበቃዮችም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳያጠፉ ልጄንም እንዳይገድሉ፥ ንጉሡ አምላኩን እግዚአብሔርን ያስብ አለች። እርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ከልጅሽ አንድ ጠጕር በምድር ላይ አይወድቅም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም። እኔ ባሪያህ ለጌታዬ ለንጉሥ አንድ ቃል ልናገር አለች፤ እርሱም። ተናገሪ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም አለች። በእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ላይ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ስለ ምን አሰብህ? ንጉሡ ይህን ነገር ተናግሮአልና ያሳደደውን ስላላስመለሰ በደለኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: For we must needs die, and as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችን እንሞታለን፥ በምድርም ላይ እንደ ፈሰሰና እንደማይመለስ ውኃ ነን፤ እግዚአብሔርም የነፍስን ጥፋት አይወድድም፥ ነገር ግን የተጣለ ሰው ፈጽሞ እንዳይጠፋ በምክሩ ያስባል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ሕዝቡ ስለሚያስፈራኝ ይህን ነገር ለጌታዬ ለንጉሥ እነግረው ዘንድ መጥቻለሁ፤ እኔም ባሪያህ። ምናልባት የእኔን የባሪያውን ልመና ንጉሡ ያደርግልኝ እንደሆነ ለንጉሡ ልናገር፤

verses.text_english: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋንና ልጅዋን ከእግዚአብሔር ርስት ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ከሚሻ ሰው እጅ ያድን ዘንድ ንጉሡ ባሪያውን ይሰማል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ባሪያህ። መልካሙንና ክፉውን ነገር ለመስማት ንጉሡ ጌታዬ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ ነውና የጌታዬ የንጉሡ ቃል ያጽናናኛል፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ለሴቲቱ መልሶ። የምጠይቅሽን ነገር አትሰውሪኝ አላት። ሴቲቱም። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ይናገር አለች።

verses.text_english: And the king said, the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። በዚህ ሁሉ የኢዮአብ እጅ ከአንቺ ጋር ነውን? አላት። ሴቲቱም መልሳ። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በሕያው ነፍስህ እምላለሁ! ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ከተናገረው ነገር ሁሉ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም ሊል የሚችል የለም፤ ባሪያህ ኢዮአብ አዝዞኛል፥ ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ በባሪያህ አፍ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all that in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ ኢዮአብ የዚህ ነገር መልክ እንዲለወጥ አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ጠቢብ እንደ ሆነ፥ አንተም ጌታዬ በምድር ላይ ያለውን ነገር ሁሉ ታውቅ ዘንድ ጠቢብ ነህ አለች።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኢዮአብን። እነሆ፥ ይህን ነገር አድርጌአለሁ፤ እንግዲህ ሂድና ብላቴናውን አቤሴሎምን መልሰው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም በምድር ላይ በግምባሩ ወድቆ እጅ ነሣ፥ ንጉሡንም ባረከ፤ ኢዮአብም። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ የባሪያህን ነገር አድርገሃልና በዓይንህ ፊት ሞገስ እንዳገኘ ባሪያህ ዛሬ አወቀ አለ።

verses.text_english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ተነሥቶ ወደ ጌሹር ሄደ፥ አቤሴሎምንም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይዞ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ወደ ቤቱ ይሂድ እንጂ ፊቴን እንዳያይ አለ፤ አቤሴሎምም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ፥ የንጉሡንም ፊት አላየም።

verses.text_english: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ዘንድ እንደ አቤሴሎም በውበቱ የተመሰገነ ሰው አልነበረም፤ ከእግሩ እስከ ራሱ ድረስ ነውር አልነበረበትም።

verses.text_english: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled : because was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.
verses.text_amharic: ጠጕሩም ይከብደው ነበርና በዓመት አንድ ጊዜ ይቈርጠው ነበር፤ ሲቈረጥም የራሱ ጠጕር በንጉሥ ሚዛን ሁለት መቶ ሰቅል ያህል ይመዘን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
verses.text_amharic: ለአቤሴሎምም ሦስት ወንዶች ልጆችና አንዲት ሴት ልጅ ተወለዱለት፤ የሴቲቱም ልጅ ስም ትዕማር ነበረ፥ እርስዋም የተዋበች ሴት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም በኢየሩሳሌም ሁለት ዓመት ሙሉ የንጉሡን ፊት ሳያይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም ወደ ንጉሡ ይልከው ዘንድ ወደ ኢዮአብ ላከ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሊመጣ አልወደደም፤ ሁለተኛም ላከበት፥ ሊመጣ ግን አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹንም። በእርሻዬ አጠገብ ያለውን የኢዮአብን እርሻ እዩ፥ በዚያም ገብስ አለው፤ ሂዳችሁ በእሳት አቃጥሉት አላቸው። የአቤሴሎምም ባሪያዎች እርሻውን አቃጠሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ተነሥቶ ወደ አቤሴሎም ወደ ቤቱ መጣና። ባሪያዎችህ እርሻዬን ስለምን አቃጠሉት? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? good for me there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be iniquity in me, let him kill me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም ኢዮአብን መልሶ። ከጌሹር ለምን መጣሁ? በዚያም ተቀምጩ ብሆን ይሻለኝ ነበር ብለህ እንድትነግረው ወደ ንጉሡ እልክህ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ ጠራሁህ፤ አሁንም የንጉሡን ፊት ልይ፥ ኃጢአት ቢሆንብኝ ይግደለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ወደ ንጉሥ መጥቶ ነገረው፤ አቤሴሎምንም ጠራው፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ገብቶ በንጉሥ ፊት ወደ ምድር በግምባሩ ተደፋ፤ ንጉሡም አቤሴሎምን ሳመው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ አቤሴሎም ሰረገላና ፈረሶች፥ በፊቱም የሚሮጡ አምሳ ሰዎች አዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city thou? And he said, Thy servant of one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም በማለዳ ተነሥቶ በበሩ አደበባይ ይቆም ነበር፤ አቤሴሎምም ከንጉሥ ለማስፈረድ ጉዳይ የነበረውን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ እየጠራ። አንተ ከወዴት ከተማ ነህ? ብሎ ይጠይቅ ነበር። እርሱም። እኔ ባሪያህ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ከአንዲቱ ነኝ ብሎ ይመልስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters good and right; but no man of the king to hear thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም። ነገርህ እውነትና ቅን ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከንጉሥ ታዝዞ የሚሰማህ የለም ይለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም። ነገርና ክርክር ያለው ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣ ዘንድ ቅንም ፍርድ እፈርድለት ዘንድ በአገር ላይ ፈራጅ አድርጎ ማን በሾመኝ? ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it was , that when any man came nigh to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም እጅ ሊነሣው ወደ እርሱ በቀረበ ጊዜ እጁን ዘርግቶ ይይዝና ይስመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም አቤሴሎም ከንጉሥ ፍርድ ሊሰማ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ በሚመጣ ሁሉ ያደርግ ነበር፤ አቤሴሎምም የእስራኤልን ሰዎች ልብ ሰረቀ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD, in Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከአራት ዓመት በኋላ አቤሴሎም ንጉሡን። ለእግዚአብሔር የተሳልሁትን ስእለት ለመስጠት ወደ ኬብሮን፥ እባክህ፥ ልሂድ።

verses.text_english: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሪያህ በሶርያ ጌሹር ሳለሁ። እግዚአብሔር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቢመልሰኝ ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት አቀርባለሁ ብዬ ስእለት ተስዬ ነበር አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። በደኅና ሂድ አለው፤ ተነሥቶም ወደ ኬብሮን ሄደ።

verses.text_english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም በእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ። የቀንደ መለከት ድምፅ በሰማችሁ ጊዜ። አቤሴሎም በኬብሮን ነገሠ በሉ የሚሉ ጕበኞች ላከ።

verses.text_english: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
verses.text_amharic: የተጠሩትም ሁለት መቶ ሰዎች ከአቤሴሎም ጋር በየዋህነት ከኢየሩሳሌም ሄዱ፤ የሚሆነውንም ነገር ከቶ አያውቁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም የዳዊት መካር የነበረውን የጊሎ ሰው አኪጦፌልን ከከተማው ከጊሎ መሥዋዕት በሚያቀርብበት ጊዜ አስጠራው። ሴራውም ጽኑ ሆነ፤ ከአቤሴሎምም ጋር ያለ ሕዝብ እየበዛ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: ለዳዊትም። የእስራኤል ሰዎች ልብ ከአቤሴሎም ጋር ሆኖአል የሚል ወሬኛ መጣለት።

verses.text_english: And David said unto all his servants that with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም ያሉትን ባሪያዎቹን ሁሉ። ተነሡ፥ እንሽሽ ያለዚያ ከአቤሴሎም እጅ የሚድን ከእኛ የለምና፤ መጥቶም እንዳይዘን፥ ክፉም እንዳያመጣብን ከተማይቱንም በሰይፍ ስለት እንዳይመታ ፈጥናችሁ እንሂድ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡም ባሪያዎች ንጉሡን። እነሆ፥ ጌታችን ንጉሡ የመረጠውን ሁሉ እኛ ባሪያዎችህ እሺ ብለን እናደርጋለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, concubines, to keep the house.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከእርሱም በኋላ ቤተ ሰቡ ሁሉ ወጡ፤ ንጉሡም አሥሩን ሴቶች ቁባቶቹን ቤቱን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ተወ።

verses.text_english: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከእርሱም በኋላ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ወጡ፥ በቤትሜርሐቅም ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ በፊቱ አለፉ፤ ከሊታውያንና ፈሊታውያንም ሁሉ፥ ከእርሱም በኋላ ከጌት የመጡት ስድስት መቶው ጌትያውን ሁሉ በንጉሡ ፊት አለፉ።

verses.text_english: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou a stranger, and also an exile.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የጌት ሰው ኢታይን። ከእኛ ጋር ለምን መጣህ? አንተ ከስፍራህ የመጣህ እንግዳና ስደተኛ ነህና ተመለስ፥ ከንጉሡም ጋር ተቀመጥ።

verses.text_english: Whereas thou camest yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth with thee.
verses.text_amharic: የመጣኸው ትናንት ነው፤ ዛሬ ከእኛ ጋር ላዙርህን? እኔ ወደምሄድበት እሄዳለሁ፤ አንተ ግን ተመለስ፥ ወንድሞችህንም ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ምሕረቱንና እውነቱን ያድርግልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Ittai answered the king, and said, the LORD liveth, and my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.
verses.text_amharic: ኢታይም ለንጉሡ መልሶ። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በጌታዬም በንጉሡ ሕይወት እምላለሁ! በእውነት ጌታዬ ባለበት ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ በሞትም ቢሆን በሕይወትም፥ በዚያ ደግሞ እኔ ባሪያህ እሆናለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ኢታይን። ሂድ ተሻገር አለው፤ የጌት ሰው ኢታይና ሰዎቹም ሁሉ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሕፃናት ሁሉ ተሻገሩ።

verses.text_english: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: በአገርም የነበሩት ሁሉ በታላቅ ድምፅ አለቀሱ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተሻገሩ፥ ንጉሡም ደግሞ የቄድሮንን ፈፋ ተሻገረ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ምድረ በዳ መንገድ ተሻገሩ።

verses.text_english: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ደግሞ ሳዶቅ ከእርሱም ጋር ሌዋውያን ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ተሸክመው መጡ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት አስቀመጡ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከከተማይቱ ፈጽሞ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ አብያታር ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and shew me it, and his habitation:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሳዶቅን። የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ወደ ከተማ መልስ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆንሁ፥ መልሶ እርሱንና ማደሪያውን ያሳየኛል፤

verses.text_english: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። አልወድድህም ቢለኝ፥ እነሆኝ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ያድርግብኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ካህኑን ሳዶቅን። እነሆ፥ አንተና ልጅህ አኪማአስ የአብያታርም ልጅ ዮናታን ሁለቱ ልጆቻችሁ በደኅና ወደ ከተማ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም፥ እነሆ፥ ከእናንተ ዘንድ ወሬ እስኪመጣልኝ ድረስ በምድረ በዳው መሻገርያ እቆያለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.
verses.text_amharic: ሳዶቅም አብያታርም የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መለሱት፥ በዚያም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And David went up by the ascent of Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ተከናንቦ ያለ ጫማ እያለቀሰ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ዐቀበት ወጣ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተከናንበው እያለቀሱ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And told David, saying, Ahithophel among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
verses.text_amharic: አኪጦፌል ከአቤሴሎም ጋር በሴራ አንድ ነው ብለው ለዳዊት ነገሩት፤ ዳዊትም። አቤቱ፥ የአኪጦፌልን ምክር ስንፍና አድርገህ እንድትለውጥ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that David was come to the top , where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ለእግዚአብሔር ወደ ሰገደበት ወደ ተራራው ራስ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ አርካዊው ኩሲ ልብሱን ቀድዶ በራሱም ላይ ትቢያ ነስንሶ ሊገናኘው መጣ።

verses.text_english: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም አለው። ከእኔ ጋር ብትመጣ ትከብደኛለህ፤

verses.text_english: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; I thy father's servant hitherto, so I now also thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ከተማ ግን ተመልሰህ ለአቤሴሎም። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ባሪያ እሆንሃለሁ፤ አስቀድሞ ለአባትህ ባሪያ እንደ ነበርሁ እንዲሁ አሁን ለአንተ ባሪያ እሆንሃለሁ ብትለው የአኪጦፌልን ምክር ከንቱ ታደርግልኛለህ።

verses.text_english: And not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱ ሳዶቅና አብያታርም በዚያ ከአንተ ጋር አይደሉምን? ከንጉሡ ቤትም የምትሰማውን ነገር ሁሉ ለካህናቱ ለሳዶቅና ለአብያታር ንገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold, there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's , and Jonathan Abiathar's ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የሳዶቅ ልጅ አኪማአስና የአብያታር ልጅ ዮናታን ልጆቻቸው በዚያ ከእነርሱ ጋር አሉ፤ የምትሰሙትን ሁሉ በእነርሱ እጅ ላኩልኝ።

verses.text_english: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ወዳጅ ኩሲ ወደ ከተማ መጣ፤ አቤሴሎምም ደግሞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ገባ።

verses.text_english: And when David was a little past the top , behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከተራራው ራስ ጥቂት ፈቀቅ ባለ ጊዜ የሜምፊቦስቴ ባሪያ ሲባ ሁለት መቶ እንጀራ፥ አንድ መቶም ዘለላ ዘቢብ፥ አንድ መቶም በለስ፥ አንድ አቁማዳም ወይን ጠጅ የተጫኑ ሁለት አህዮች እየነዳ ተገናኘው።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሲባን። ይህ ምንድር ነው? አለው። ሲባም። አህዮቹ የንጉሥ ቤተ ሰቦች ይቀመጡባቸው ዘንድ፥ እንጀራውና በለሱ ብላቴኖቹ ይበሉት ዘንድ፥ የወይን ጠጁም በበረሀ የሚደክሙት ይጠጡት ዘንድ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king said, And where thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። የጌታህ ልጅ ወዴት ነው? አለ። ሲባም ንጉሡን። እነሆ። የእስራኤል ቤት ዛሬ የአባቴን መንግሥት ይመልስልኛል ብሎ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀምጦአል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine all that unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሲባን። እነሆ፥ ለሜምፊቦስቴ የነበረው ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሁን አለው። ሲባም። እጅ እነሣለሁ፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በፊትህ ሞገስ ላግኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ዳዊትም ወደ ብራቂም መጣ፤ እነሆም፥ ሳሚ የሚባል የጌራ ልጅ ከሳኦል ቤተ ዘመድ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ከዚያ ወጣ፥ እየሄደም ይረግመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men on his right hand and on his left.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዳዊትና ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ዳዊት ባሪያዎችም ድንጋይ ይወረውር ነበር፤ በንጉሡም ቀኝና ግራ ሕዝቡ ሁሉና ኃያላኑ ሁሉ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:
verses.text_amharic: ሳሚም ሲረግም። ሂድ፥ አንተ የደም ሰው፥ ምናምንቴ፥ ሂድ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou in thy mischief, because thou a bloody man.
verses.text_amharic: በፋንታው ነግሠሃልና እግዚአብሔር የሳኦልን ቤት ደም ሁሉ መለሰብህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥትን ለልጅህ ለአቤሴሎም እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶታል፤ እነሆም፥ አንተ የደም ሰው ነህና በመከራ ተይዘሃል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያም ልጅ አቢሳ ንጉሡን። ይህ የሞተ ውሻ ጌታዬን ንጉሡን ስለምን ይረግማል? ልሂድና ራሱን ልቍረጠው አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። እናንተ የጽሩም ልጆች፥ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? እግዚአብሔር። ዳዊትን ስደበው ብሎ አዝዞታልና ይርገመኝ፤ ለምንስ እንዲህ ታደርጋለህ? የሚለው ማን ነው? አለ።

verses.text_english: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now Benjamite ? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም አቢሳንና ባሪያዎቹን ሁሉ። እነሆ ከወገቤ የወጣው ልጄ ነፍሴን ይሻል፤ ይልቁንስ ይህ የብንያም ልጅ እንዴት ነዋ? እግዚአብሔር አዝዞታልና ተዉት፥ ይርገመኝ።

verses.text_english: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባት በዚህ ቀን መከራዬን አይቶ ስለ እርግማኑ መልካም ይመልስልኛል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም በመንገድ ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ሳሚም በተራራው አጠገብ በእርሱ ትይዩ እየሄደ ይራገም፤ ድንጋይም ይወረውር፥ ትቢያም ይበትን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the king, and all the people that with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደክመው ነበር፥ በዚያም ዐረፉ።

verses.text_english: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች አኪጦፌልም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ወዳጅ አርካዊው ኩሲ ወደ አቤሴሎም በመጣ ጊዜ ኩሲ። ሺህ ዓመት ያንግሥህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Absalom said to Hushai, this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም ኩሲን። ስለ ወዳጅህ ያደረግኸው ቸርነት ይህ ነውን? ከወዳጅህ ጋር ያልሄድህ ስለምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሲም አቤሴሎምን። እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከዚህም ሕዝብ ከእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ ለተመረጠው ለእርሱ እሆናለሁ ከእርሱም ጋር እቀመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And again, whom should I serve? not in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
verses.text_amharic: ዳግምም የማገለግል ለማን ነው? በንጉሥ ልጅ ፊት አይደለምን? በአባትህ ፊት እንዳገለገልሁ እንዲሁ በአንተ ፊት እሆናለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም አኪጦፌልን። ምከሩ ምን እናድርግ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that with thee be strong.
verses.text_amharic: አኪጦፌልም አቤሴሎምን። ቤት ሊጠብቁ ወደ ተዋቸው ወደ አባትህ ቁባቶች ግባ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ አባትህን እንዳሳፈርኸው ይሰማሉ፤ ከአንተም ጋር ያሉት ሁሉ እጃቸው ይበረታል አለው።

verses.text_english: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለአቤሴሎምም በሰገነት ላይ ድንኳን ተከሉለት፤ አቤሴሎምም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት ወደ አባቱ ቁባቶች ገባ።

verses.text_english: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት የመከራት የአኪጦፌል ምክር የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ መጠየቅ ነበረች፤ የአኪጦፌልም ምክር ሁሉ ከዳዊትና ከአቤሴሎም ጋር እንዲህ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:
verses.text_amharic: አኪጦፌልም አቤሴሎምን። አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎች ልምረጥና  1 አኪጦፌልም በዚህች ሌሊት ተነሥቼ ዳዊትን ላሳድድ።

verses.text_english: And I will come upon him while he weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
verses.text_amharic: ደክሞና እጁ ዝሎ ሳለ እወድቅበታለህ፥ አስፈራውማለሁ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይሸሻል፥ ንጉሡንም ብቻውን እመታዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest as if all returned: all the people shall be in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሽራ ወደ ባልዋ እንደምትመለስ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ወደ አንተ እመልሰዋለሁ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ደኅና ይሆናል፤ የምትፈልገው አንድ ሰው ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩም አቤሴሎምንና የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ደስ አሰኘ።

verses.text_english: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም። አርካዊውን ኩሲን ጥሩ፥ ደግሞም እርሱ የሚለውን እንስማ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do his saying? if not; speak thou.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሱም ወደ አቤሴሎም በመጣ ጊዜ አቤሴሎም። አኪጦፌል ያለው ይህ ነው፤ ነገሩን እናደርገው ዘንድ ይገባልን? ባይሆን ግን አንተ ንገረን ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given not good at this time.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሲም አቤሴሎምን። አኪጦፌል በዚህ ጊዜ የመከራት ምክር መልካም አይደለችም አለው።

verses.text_english: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they mighty men, and they chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሲ ደግሞ አለ። ግልገሎችዋ በዱር በተነጠቁ ጊዜ ድብ መራራ እንደ ሆነች በልባቸው መራሮች እጅግም ኃያላን መሆናቸውን አባትህንና ሰዎቹን ታውቃለህ፤ አባትህ አርበኛ ነው፥ ከሕዝብም ጋር አያድርም።

verses.text_english: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ምናልባት በአንድ ጕድጓድ ወይም በማናቸውም ስፍራ ተሸሽጎ ይሆናል፤ በመጀመሪያም ከእነርሱ አያሌዎች ቢወድቁ፥ የሚሰማው ሁሉ። አቤሴሎምን የተከተለው ሕዝብ ተመታ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And he also valiant, whose heart as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father a mighty man, and which with him valiant men.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ሁሉ አባትህ ኃያል እንደ ሆነ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት ሰዎች ጽኑዓን እንደ ሆኑ ያውቃልና ጽኑዕ ልቡም እንደ አንበሳ ልብ የሆነው ፈጽሞ ይቀልጣል።

verses.text_english: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የምመክርህ ይህ ነው፤ ከዳን እስከ ቤርሳቤህ ያለ እስራኤል ሁሉ በብዛቱ እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ሆኖ ወደ አንተ ይሰብሰብ፥ አንተም በመካከላቸው ወደ ሰልፍ ውጣ።

verses.text_english: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that with him there shall not be left so much as one.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም ወደምናገኝበት ወደ አንድ ስፍራ እንደርስበታለን፥ ጠልም በምድር ላይ እንደሚወድቅ እንወርድበታለን፤ እርሱና ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ አንድ ስንኳ አናስቀርም።

verses.text_english: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ከተማም ቢገባ እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደዚያች ከተማ ገመድ ይወስዳል፥ እኛም አንድ ድንጋይ እንኳ እስከማይገኝባት ድረስ ወደ ወንዙ ውስጥ እንስባታለን።

verses.text_english: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምና የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ። የአርካዊው የኩሲ ምክር ከአኪጦፌል ምክር ይሻላል አሉ። እግዚአብሔርም በአቤሴሎም ላይ ክፉ ያመጣ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር መልካሚቱን የአኪጦፌልን ምክር እንዲበትን አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሲም ለካህናቱ ለሳዶቅና ለአብያታር። አኪጦፌል ለአቤሴሎምና ለእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች እንዲህና እንዲህ መክሮአል፤ እኔ ግን እንዲህና እንዲህ መክሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that with him.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ንጉሡና ከእርሱ ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ እንዳይዋጡ፥ ፈጥናችሁ። ሳትዘገይ ተሻገር እንጂ በዚህች ሌሊት በምድረ በዳ መሻገሪያ አትደር ብላችሁ ለዳዊት ንገሩት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.
verses.text_amharic: ዮናታንና አኪማአስ ተገልጠው ወደ ከተማ ይገቡ ዘንድ አልቻሉም ነበርና በዓይንሮጌል ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ አንዲትም ባሪያ ሄዳ ትነግራቸው ነበር፤ እነርሱም ሄደው ለንጉሡ ለዳዊት ይነግሩት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ብላቴናም አይቶ ለአቤሴሎም ነገረው፤ እነርሱ ግን ፈጥነው ሄዱ፤ ወደ ብራቂምም ወደ አንድ ሰው ቤት መጡ፤ በግቢውም ውስጥ ጕድጓድ ነበረ፥ ወደዚያም ውስጥ ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም በጕድጓድ አፍ ላይ ዳውጃ ዘረጋችበት፥ የተከካ እህልም በላዩ አሰጣችበት፤ ነገሩም እንዲህ ተሰወረ።

verses.text_english: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find , they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የአቤሴሎም ባሪያዎች ወደ ሴቲቱ ወደ ቤት መጥተው። አኪማአስና ዮናታን የት አሉ? አሉ፤ ሴቲቱም። ፈፋውን ተሻግረው ሄዱ አለቻቸው። እነርሱም ፈልገው ባላገኟቸው ጊዜ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.
verses.text_amharic: ከሄዱም በኋላ እነርሱ ከጕድጓድ ወጥተው ሄዱ፥ ለንጉሡም ለዳዊት ነገሩት፥ ዳዊትንም። አኪጦፌል በእናንተ ላይ እንዲህ መክሮአልና ተነሡ፥ ፈጥናችሁም ውኃውን ተሻገሩ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then David arose, and all the people that with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሁሉ ተነሥተው ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገሩ፤ እስኪነጋም ድረስ ዮርዳኖስን ሳይሻገር አንድ ሰው እንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.
verses.text_amharic: አኪጦፌልም ምክሩን እንዳልተከተሉ ባየ ጊዜ አህያውን ጫነ፥ ተነሥቶም ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ከተማው ሄደ፤ ቤቱንም አደራጅቶ በገዛ እጁ ታንቆ ሞተ፥ በአባቱም መቃብር ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ መሃናይም መጣ፤ አቤሴሎምም ከእርሱም ጋር የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገሩ።

verses.text_english: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa a man's son, whose name Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም በጭፍራው ላይ በኢዮአብ ስፍራ አሜሳይን ሾመ፤ አሜሳይም የይስማኤላዊ ሰው የዬቴር ልጅ ነበረ፤ እርሱም የኢዮአብን እናት የጽሩያን እኅት የናዖስን ልጅ አቢግያን አግብቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልና አቤሴሎምም በገለዓድ ምድር ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ መሃናይም በመጣ ጊዜ በአሞን ልጆች አገር በረባት የነበረ የናዖስ ልጅ ኡኤስቢ፥ የሎዶባርም ሰው የዓሚኤል ልጅ ማኪር፥ የሮግሊምም ሰው ገለዓዳዊ ቤርዜሊ፥

verses.text_english: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched , and beans, and lentiles, and parched ,
And David numbered the people that with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ቈጠረ፥ ሻለቆችንና የመቶ አለቆችንም ሾመላቸው።

verses.text_english: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሕዝቡን ከኢዮአብ እጅ በታች ሲሶውን፥ ከኢዮአብም ወንድም ከጽሩያ ልጅ ከአቢሳ እጅ በታች ሲሶውን፥ ከጌት ሰውም ከኢታይ እጅ በታች ሲሶውን ሰደደ። ንጉሡም ሕዝቡን። እኔ ደግሞ ከእናንተ ጋር እወጣለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now worth ten thousand of us: therefore now better that thou succour us out of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡ ግን። አትወጣም፤ ብንሸሽ ስለ እኛ አያስቡም፤ ከእኛም እኩሌታው ቢሞት ስለ እኛ አያስቡም፤ አንተ ግን ለብቻህ ከእኛ ከአስሩ ሺህ ይልቅ ትበልጣለህ፤ አሁንም በከተማ ተቀምጠህ ብትረዳን ይሻላል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። መልካም የሚመስላችሁን አደርጋለሁ አላቸው። ንጉሡም በበሩ አጠገብ ቆመ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መቶ በመቶ ሺህ በሺህ እየሆኑ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, gently for my sake with the young man, with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም እዮአብንና አቢሳን ኢታይንም። ለብላቴናው ለአቤሴሎም ስለ እኔ ራሩለት ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ንጉሡም ስለአቤሴሎም አለቆቹን ሁሉ ሲያዝዝ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በእስራኤል ላይ ወደ ሜዳ ወጣ፤ ሰልፉም በኤፍሬም ሁሉ ውስጥ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የእስራኤል ሕዝብ በዳዊት ባሪያዎች ፊት ተመቱ፥ በዚያም ቀን ታላቅ ውጊያ በዚያ ሆነ፥ ሃያ ሺህ ሰውም ሞተ።

verses.text_english: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ሰልፉ በአገሩ ሁሉ ፊት ላይ ተበተነ፤ በዚያም ቀን ሰይፍ ከዋጠው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይልቅ ዱር ብዙ ዋጠ።

verses.text_english: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that under him went away.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎም ከዳዊት ባሪያዎች ጋር በድንገት ተገናኘ፤ አቤሴሎምም በበቅሎ ተቀምጦ ነበር፥ በቅሎውም ብዙ ቅርንጫፍ ባለው በታላቅ ዛፍ በታች ገባ፥ ራሱም በዛፉ ተያዘ፤ በሰማይና በምድር መካከል ተንጠለጠለ፥ ተቀምጦበትም የነበረ በቅሎ አለፈ።

verses.text_english: And a certain man saw , and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰውም አይቶ። እነሆ፥ አቤሴሎም በትልቅ ዛፍ ላይ ተንጠልጥሎ አየሁ ብሎ ለኢዮአብ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten of silver, and a girdle.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ለነገረው ሰው። እነሆ፥ ካየኸው ለምን ወደ ምድር አልመታኸውም? አስር ብርና አንድ ድግ እሰጥህ ነበር አለው።

verses.text_english: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand of silver in mine hand, would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none the young man Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዮውም ኢዮአብን። እኛ ስንሰማ ንጉሡ አንተንና አቢሳን ኢታይንም። ብላቴናውን አቤሴሎምን ማንም እንዳይነካው ተጠንቀቁ ብሎ አዝዞአልና ሺህ ብር በእጄ ላይ ብትመዝን እጄን በንጉሡ ልጅ ላይ ባልዘረጋሁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against .
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ቅሉ በነብሱ ላይ ብወነጅል ኖሮ ይህ ከንጉሥ ባልተሰወረም፥ አንተም በተነሳህብኝ ነበር አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he yet alive in the midst of the oak.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም። እኔ ከአንተ ጋር እንዲህ እዘገይ ዘንድ አልችልም ብሎ ሦስት ጦሮች በእጁ ወሰደ፥ አቤሴሎምም ገና በዛፍ ላይ ተንጠልጥሎ ሕያው ሳለ በልቡ ላይ ተከላቸው።

verses.text_english: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
verses.text_amharic: አስሩም የኢዮአብ ጋሻ ጃግሬዎች ከበቡት፥ አቤሴሎምንም መትተው ገደሉት።

verses.text_english: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ሕዝቡን ከልክሎ ነበርና ቀንደ መለከት ነፋ፥ ሕዝቡም እስራኤልን ከማሳደድ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምንም ወስደው በዱር ባለ በታላቅ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ ጣሉት፥ እጅግም ታላቅ የሆነ የድንጋይ ክምር ከመሩበት፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሴሎምም ሕያው ሳለ። ለስሜ መታሰቢያ የሚሆን ልጅ የለኝም ብሎ ሃውልት ወስዶ በንጉሥ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ለራሱ አቁሞ ነበር፤ ሃውልቱንም በስሙ ጠርቶት ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የአቤሴሎም መታሰቢያ ተብሎ ይጠራል።

verses.text_english: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: የሳዶቅ ልጅ አኪማኣስ ግን። እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቹን እንደተበቀለለት ሮጬ ለንጉሥ የምሥራች ልንገር አለ።

verses.text_english: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም። በሌላ ቀን እንጂ ዛሬ ወሬ አትናገርም፤ የንጉሥ ልጅ ሞቶአልና ዛሬ ወሬ አትናገርም አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ኵሲን። ሂድ ያየኸውንም ለንጉሡ ንገር አለው። ኵሲም ለኢዮአብ እጅ ነስቶ ሮጠ።

verses.text_english: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?
verses.text_amharic: ዳግመኛም የሳዶቅ ልጅ አኪማአስ ኢዮአብን። የሆነ ሆኖ ኵሲን ተከትዬ፥ እባክህ፥ ልሩጥ አለው። ኢዮአብም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ መልካም ወሬ የምትወስድ አይደለህምና ትሮጥ ዘንድ ለምን ትወድዳለህ? አለ።

verses.text_english: But howsoever, , let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እኔ ብሮጥ ምን ይገድዳል? አለ። እርሱም። ሩጥ አለው። አኪማአስም በሜዳው መንደር በኩል ሮጠ፥ ኵሲንም ቀደመው።

verses.text_english: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በሁለት በር መካከል ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ዘበኛውም በቅጥሩ ላይ ወዳለው ወደ በሩ ሰገነት ወጣ፥ ዓይኑንም አቅንቶ ብቻውን የሚሮጥ ሰው አየ።

verses.text_english: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he alone, tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
verses.text_amharic: ዘበኛውም ለንጉሡ ሊነግረው ጮኸ። ንጉሡም። ብቻውን እንደሆነ በአፉ ወሬ ይኖራል አለ።

verses.text_english: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ፈጥኖ ቀረበ። ዘበኛውም ሌላ ሰው ሲሮጥ አየ፤ ዘበኛውም ለደጅ ጠባቂው ጮኾ። እነሆ፥ ብቻውን የሚሮጥ ሌላ ሰው አየሁ አለ። ንጉሡም። እርሱ ደግሞ ወሬ ይዞ ይሆናል አለ።

verses.text_english: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
verses.text_amharic: ዘበኛውም። የፊተኛው ሩጫ እንደ ሳዶቅ ልጅ እንደ አኪማአስ ሩጫ ይመስላል አለ፤ ንጉሡም። እርሱ መልካም ሰው ነው፥ መልካምም ወሬ ያመጣል አለ።

verses.text_english: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.
verses.text_amharic: አኪማአስም ጮኾ ንጉሡን። ሁሉ ደህና ሆኖአል አለው። በንጉሡም ፊት በምድር ላይ በግምባሩ ተደፍቶ። በንጉሡ በጌታዬ ላይ እጃቸውን ያነሱትን ሰዎች አሳልፎ የሰጠ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what .
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ብላቴናው አቤሴሎም ደህና ነውን? አለ። አኪማአስም። ኢዮአብ እኔን ባሪያህንና የንጉሡን ባሪያ በላከ ጊዜ ትልቅ ሽብር አይቻለሁ፥ ምን እንደሆነ ግን አላወቅሁም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the king said , Turn aside, stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ፈቀቅ ብለህ ቁም አለ፤ እርሱም ፈቀቅ ብሎ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ኵሲ መጣ፤ ኵሲም። እግዚአብሔር በላይህ የተነሡትን ሁሉ ዛሬ እንደተበቀለልህ ለጌታዬ ለንጉሡ ወሬ አምጥቻለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do hurt, be as young man .
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኵሲን። ብላቴናው አቤሴሎም ደህና ነውን? አለው። ኵሲም። የጌታዬ የንጉሡ ጠላቶች፥ በክፉም የተነሡብህ ሁሉ እንደዚያ ብላቴና ይሁኑ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም እጅግ አዘነ፥ በበሩም ላይ ወዳለችው ቤት ወጥቶ አለቀሰ፤ ሲሄድም። ልጄ አቤሴሎም ሆይ፥ ልጄ፥ ልጄ አቤሴሎም ሆይ፥ በአንተ ፋንታ ሞቼ ኖሮ ቢሆን፥ ልጄ አቤሴሎም፥ ልጄ ሆይ ይል ነበር። ች

verses.text_english: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ንጉሡ ስለ አቤሴሎም እንዳለቀሰና ዋይ ዋይ እንዳለ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And the victory that day was into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን። ንጉሡ ስለ ልጁ አዘነ ሲባል ሕዝቡ ሰምቶአልና የዚያ ቀን ድል በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ዘንድ ወደ ኀዘን ተለወጠ።

verses.text_english: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ከሰልፍ የሸሸ ሕዝብ አፍሮ ወደ ኋላው እንዲል በዚያ ቀን ወደ ከተማ ተሰርቆ ገባ።

verses.text_english: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ፊቱን ሸፈነ፥ ንጉሡም በታላቅ ድምፅ። ልጄ አቤሴሎም ሆይ፥ ልጄ አቤሴሎም፥ ልጄ ሆይ እያለ ይጮኽ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ቤት ገብቶ እንዲህ አለ። ዛሬ ነፍስህንና የወንዶችና የሴቶች ልጆችህን ነፍስ የሚስቶችህንና የቁባቶችህን ነፍስ ያዳኑትን የባሪያዎችህን ሁሉ ፊት ዛሬ አሳፍረሃል፤

verses.text_english: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የሚጠሉህን ትወድዳለህ፥ የሚወድዱህንም ትጠላለህ። መሳፍንትህንና ባሪያዎችህን እንዳታስብ ዛሬ ገልጠሃል፤ ዛሬ ሁላችን ሞተን ቢሆን ኖር አቤሴሎምም ድኖ ቢሆን ኖሮ ደስ ያሰኘህ እንደ ነበረ ዛሬ አያለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ተነሥተህ ውጣ፥ ለባሪያዎችህም የሚያጽናናቸውን ነገር ተናገራቸው፤ ያልወጣህ እንደ ሆነ ግን አንድ ሰው ከአንተ ጋር በዚህች ሌሊት እንዳይቀር በእግዚአብሔር እምላለሁ፤ ይህም ከብላቴናነትህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ካገኘህ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ይልቅ ታላቅ መከራ ይሆንብሃል።

verses.text_english: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ተነሥቶ በበሩ ተቀመጠ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ንጉሡ በበሩ እንደ ተቀመጠ ሰማ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት መጣ። እስራኤልም እያንዳንዱ ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሽቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ውስጥ። ንጉሡ ከጠላቶቻችን እጅ ታድጎናል፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ አድኖናል፤ አሁንም ስለ አቤሴሎም ከአገር ሸሽቶአል።

verses.text_english: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?
verses.text_amharic: በላያችን እንዲሆን የቀባነው አቤሴሎም በሰልፍ ሞቶአል፤ አሁንም እንግዲህ ንጉሡን ለመመለስ ስለምን ዝም ትላላችሁ? እያለ እርስ በርሱ ይከራከር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, to his house.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ለካህናቱ ለሳዶቅና ለአብያታር ልኮ እንዲህ አላቸው። ለይሁዳ ሽማግሌዎች እንዲህ ብላችሁ ተናገሩአቸው። የእስራኤል ሁሉ ነገር ወደ ንጉሡ ደርሶአልና ንጉሡን ወደ ቤቱ ከመመለስ ስለ ምን ዘገያችሁ?

verses.text_english: Ye my brethren, ye my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ወንድሞቼ፥ የአጥንቴ ፍላጭና የሥጋዬ ቍራጭ ናችሁ፤ እናንተ ንጉሡን ከመመለስ ስለ ምን ዘገያችሁ?

verses.text_english: And say ye to Amasa, thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሜሳይም። አንተ የአጥንቴ ፍላጭና የሥጋዬ ቍራጭ አይደለህምን? በዘመንህም ሁሉ በኢዮአብ ፋንታ በፊቴ የሠራዊት አለቃ ሳትሆን ብትቀር እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያድርግብኝ ይህንም ይጨምርብኝ በሉት።

verses.text_english: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man; so that they sent unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳንም ሰዎች ሁሉ ልብ እንደ አንድ ሰው ልብ አድርጎ አዘነበለ፤ ወደ ንጉሡም ልከው። አንተ ከባሪያዎችህ ሁሉ ጋር ተመለስ አሉት።

verses.text_english: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ተመልሶ እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ መጣ። የይሁዳ ሰዎች ንጉሡን ሊቀበሉ ንጉሡንም ዮርዳኖስን ሊያሻግሩ ወደ ጌልገላ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
