verses.text_amharic: ከብራቂምም አገር የነበረው ብንያማዊው የጌራ ልጅ ሳሚ ከይሁዳ ሰዎች ጋር ዳዊትን ሊቀበል ፈጥኖ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ብንያማውያን የሆኑ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ፥ የሳኦልም ቤት ባሪያ ሲባ ከእርሱም ጋር አሥራ አምስቱ ልጆችና ሀያው ባሪያዎች ነበሩ፤ በንጉሡም ፊት ፈጥነው ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገሩ።

verses.text_english: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
verses.text_amharic: ታንኳውም የንጉሥን ቤተ ሰብ ያሻግር ዘንድ ንጉሡም ደስ ያሰኘውን ያደርግ ዘንድ ይሸጋገር ነበር። ንጉሡም ዮርዳኖስን ከተሻገረ በኋላ የጌራ ልጅ ሳሚ በፊቱ ተደፋ።

verses.text_english: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ኃጢአቴን አትቍጠርብኝ፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሡ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም በወጣህ ቀን ባሪያህ የበደልሁህን አታስብብኝ፥ ንጉሡም በልቡ አያኑረው።

verses.text_english: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ በደለኛ እንደ ሆንሁ አውቄአለሁና እነሆ፥ ከዮሴፍ ቤት ሁሉ አስቀድሜ ዛሬ መጣሁ፥ ጌታዬንም ንጉሡን ልቀበል ወረድሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያ ልጅ አቢሳ ግን። ሳሚ እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን ሰድቦአልና ሞት የተገባው አይደለምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I this day king over Israel?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። እናንተ የጽሩያ ልጆች፥ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ዛሬ ስለ ምን ጠላቶች ትሆኑብኛላችሁ? ዛሬስ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ሰው ሊሞት ይገባልን? ዛሬስ በእስራኤል ላይ እንደ ነገሥሁ አላወቅሁምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሳሚን። አትሞትም አለው። ንጉሡም ማለለት።

verses.text_english: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came in peace.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ልጅ ሜምፊቦስቴ ንጉሡን ሊቀበል ወረደ፤ ንጉሡም ከሄደ ጀምሮ በደኅና እስከ ተመለሰበት ቀን ድረስ እግሩን አልጠገነም፥ ጢሙንም አልቈረጠም፥ ልብሱንም አላጠበም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሊቀበለው ከኢየሩሳሌም በመጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡ። ሜምፊቦስቴ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ስለ ምን አልወጣህም? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant lame.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ አለ። ጌታዬን፥ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ባሪያዬ አታለለኝ፤ እኔ ባሪያህ አንካሳ ነኝና። ከንጉሥ ጋር እሄድ ዘንድ የምቀመጥበትን አህያ ልጫን አልሁት።

verses.text_english: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king as an angel of God: do therefore good in thine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እኔን ባሪያህን ለጌታዬ ለንጉሡ አማ፤ አንተ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ግን እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ ነህ፤ ደስም ያሰኘህን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: For all my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
verses.text_amharic: የአባቴ ቤት ሁሉ በጌታዬ በንጉሡ ዘንድ ሞት የሚገባቸው ነበሩ፤ አንተ ግን እኔን ባሪያህን በገበታህ በሚበሉ መካከል አስቀመጥኸኝ፤ ለንጉሥ ደግሞ ለመናገር ምን መብት አለኝ?

verses.text_english: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ነገርህን ለምን ታበዛለህ? አንተና ሲባ እርሻውን ትካፈሉ ዘንድ ብያለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
verses.text_amharic: ሜምፊቦስቴም ንጉሡን። ጌታዬ ንጉሡ በደኅና ወደ ቤቱ ከተመለሰ እርሱ ሁሉን ይውሰደው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓዳዊውም ቤርዜሊ ከሮግሊም ወረደ፤ ሊሸኘውም ከንጉሡ ጋር ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገረ።

verses.text_english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he a very great man.
verses.text_amharic: ቤርዜሊም እጅግ ያረጀ የሰማንያ ዓመት ሽማግሌ ነበረ፤ እጅግም ትልቅ ሰው ነበረና ንጉሡ በመሃናይም ሳለ ይቀልበው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ቤርዜሊን። በኢየሩሳሌም እቀልብህ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር እለፍ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
verses.text_amharic: ቤርዜሊም ንጉሡን አለው። ከንጉሡ ጋር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እወጣ ዘንድ ከሕይወቴ ዘመን ምን ያህል ቀረኝ?

verses.text_english: I this day fourscore years old: can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ የሰማንያ ዓመት ሽማግሌ ነኝ፤ መልካሙንና ክፉውን መለየት እችላለሁን? እኔ ባሪያህ የምበላውንና የምጠጣውን ጣዕሙን መለየት እችላለሁን? የወንዱንና የሴቲቱን ዘፈን ድምፅ መስማት እችላለሁን? እኔ ባሪያህ በጌታዬ በንጉሡ ላይ ለምን እከብድብሃለሁ?

verses.text_english: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሪያህ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግሬ ከንጉሡ ጋር ጥቂት ልሄድ ነበር፤ ንጉሡ እንዲህ ያለ ወረታ ለምን ይመልስልኛል?

verses.text_english: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሪያህ ተመልሼ በከተማዬ በአባቴና በእናቴ መቃብር አጠገብ፥ እባክህ፥ ልሙት። ነገር ግን ባሪያህን ከመዓምን እይ፤ እርሱ ከጌታዬ ከንጉሡ ጋር ይለፍ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኝህንም ለእርሱ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, will I do for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ከመዓም ከእኔ ጋር ይለፍ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኝህንም አደርግለታለሁ፤ አንተም ከእኔ የምትሻውን ሁሉ አደርግልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገረ፥ ንጉሡም ተሻገረ፤ ንጉሡም ቤርዜሊን ሳመው፥ መረቀውም፤ ወደ ስፍራውም ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ወደ ጌልገላ ተሻገረ፥ ከመዓምም ከእርሱ ጋር ሄደ፤ የይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደግሞም የእስራኤል ሕዝብ እኩሌታ ንጉሡን አሻገረው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሥ መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም። ወንድሞቻችን የይሁዳ ሰዎች ለምን ሰረቁህ? ንጉሡንም ቤተ ሰቡንም ከእርሱም ጋር የዳዊትን ሰዎች ሁሉ ዮርዳኖስን አሻገሩ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's ? or hath he given us any gift?
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ሰዎች መልሰው። ንጉሡ ለእኛ ቅርባችን ነው፤ ስለ ምን በዚህ ነገር ትቈጣላችሁ? በውኑ ከንጉሡ አንዳች በልተናልን? ወይስ እርሱ በረከት ሰጥቶናልን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ለይሁዳ ሰዎች መልሰው። በንጉሡ ዘንድ ለእኛ አሥር ክፍል አለን፥ በዳዊትም ዘንድ ደግሞ ከእናንተ ይልቅ መብት አለን፤ ስለ ምን ናቃችሁን? ስለ ምንስ ንጉሣችንን ለመመለስ ቀድሞ ምክር አልጠየቃችሁንም? አሉ። የይሁዳም ሰዎች ቃል ከእስራኤል ሰዎች ቃል ይልቅ ጠነከረ።

verses.text_english: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ አንድ ብንያማዊ የቢክሪ ልጅ ስሙ ሳቤዔ የሚባል ምናምንቴ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም። ከዳዊት ዘንድ እድል ፈንታ የለንም፥ ከእሴይም ልጅ ዘንድ ርስት የለንም፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እያንዳንድህ ወደ ድንኳንህ ተመለስ ብሎ ቀንደ መለከት ነፋ።

verses.text_english: So every man of Israel went up from after David, followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ ከዳዊት ተለይተው የቢክሪን ልጅ ሳቤዔን ተከተሉ፤ የይሁዳ ሰዎች ግን ከዮርዳኖስ ጀምረው ኢየሩሳሌም እስኪደርሱ ንጉሣቸውን ተከተሉ።

verses.text_english: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ቤቱ መጣ፤ ንጉሡም ቤቱን ሊጠብቁ የተዋቸውን አሥሩን ቁባቶች ወስዶ ለጠባቂ ሰጣቸው፥ ቀለብም ሰጣቸው፥ ነገር ግን ወደ እነርሱ አልገባም፤ በቤት ተዘግተው እስኪሞቱም ድረስ ባልቴቶች ሆነው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አሜሳይን። የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ በሦስት ቀን ውስጥ ጥራልኝ፥ አንተም አብረህ በዚህ ሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: So Amasa went to assemble Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
verses.text_amharic: አሜሳይም የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ ይጠራ ዘንድ ሄደ፤ ነገር ግን እርሱ የተቀጠረውን ቀን አሳልፎ ዘገየ።

verses.text_english: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም አቢሳን። አሁን ከአቤሴሎም ይልቅ የሚጎዳን የቢክሪ ልጅ ሳቤዔ ነው፤ እርሱ የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች አግኝቶ ከዓይናችን እንዳያመልጥ፥ አንተ የጌታህን ባሪያዎች ወስደህ አሳድደው አለው።

verses.text_english: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.text_amharic: አቢሳንም ተከትለው የኢዮአብ ሰዎች ከሊታውያንም ፈሊታውያንም ኃያላንም ሁሉ ሄዱ፤ የቢክሪንም ልጅ ሳቤዔን ለማሳደድ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ።

verses.text_english: When they at the great stone which in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
verses.text_amharic: በገባዖንም ወዳለው ወደ ታላቁ ድንጋይ በደረሱ ጊዜ አሜሳይ ሊገናኛቸው መጣ፤ ኢዮአብም የሰልፍ ልብስ ለብሶ ነበር፥ በላዩም መታጠቂያ ነበረ፥ በወገቡም ላይ ሰገባ ያለው ሰይፍ ታጥቆ ነበር፤ እርሱም ሲራመድ ሰይፉ ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: And Joab said to Amasa, thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም አሜሳይን። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ ደኅና ነህን? አለው ኢዮአብም አሜሳይን የሚስም መስሎ በቀን እጁ ጢሙን ያዘው።

verses.text_english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth , and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.text_amharic: አሜሳይ ግን በኢዮአብ እጅ ከነበረው ሰይፍ አልተጠነቀቀም ነበር፤ ኢዮአብም ሆዱን ወጋው፥ አንጀቱንም በምድር ላይ ዘረገፈው፤ ሁለተኛም አልወጋውም፥ ሞተም። ኢዮአብና ወንድሙ አቢሳ የቢክሪን ልጅ ሳቤዔን አሳደዱ።

verses.text_english: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that for David, after Joab.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢዮአብም ብላቴኖች አንዱ በአሜሳይ ሬሳ አጠገብ ቆሞ። ለኢዮአብ ወዳጅ የሚሆን ለዳዊትም የሆነ ሁሉ ኢዮአብን ይከተል ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
verses.text_amharic: አሜሳይም በመንገድ መካከል ወድቆ በደሙ ላይ ይንከባለል ነበር፤ ያም ሰው ወደ እርሱ የሚመጣ ሁሉ ሲቆም አይቶአልና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እንደ ቆመ ባየ ጊዜ አሜሳይን ከመንገድ ላይ ወደ እርሻ ውስጥ ፈቀቅ አደረገው፥ በልብስም ከደነው።

verses.text_english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.text_amharic: ከመንገድ ራቅ ባለ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የቢክሪን ልጅ ሳቤዔን ለማሳደድ ኢዮአብን ተከትሎ ያልፍ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ወደ አቤል፥ ወደ ቤትመዓካ፥ ወደ ቤሪም ሁሉ አለፈ፤ ሰዎችም ደግሞ ተሰብስበው ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
verses.text_amharic: በቤትመዓካ ባለ በአቤልም መጥተው ከበቡት፥ በከተማይቱም ላይ እስከ ቅጥርዋ ድረስ የአፈርን ድልድል ደለደሉ፤ ቅጥሩንም ያፈርሱ ዘንድ ከኢዮአብ ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይደባደቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማይቱም አንዲት ብልሃተኛ ሴት። ስሙ፥ ስሙ፤ ኢዮአብንም። እነግርህ ዘንድ ወደዚህ ቅረብ በሉት ስትል ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, thou Joab? And he answered, I . Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርስዋም ቀረበ፤ ሴቲቱም። ኢዮአብ አንተ ነህን? አለች። እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ ብሎ መለሰላት። እርስዋም። የባሪያህን ቃል ስማ አለችው። እርሱም። እሰማለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask at Abel: and so they ended .
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ቀድሞ። የሚጠይቅ በአቤል ዘንድ ይጠይቅ ይባል ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ነገሩ ይፈጸም ነበር።

verses.text_english: I peaceable faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ዘንድ ሰላምንና እውነትን ከሚወድዱ እኔ ነኝ፤ አንተ በእስራኤል ያለችውን ከተማና እናት ለማፍረስ ትሻለህ፤ ስለ ምንስ የእግዚአብሔርን ርስት ትውጣለህ? ብላ ተናገረች።

verses.text_english: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም መልሶ። ይህ መዋጥና ማጥፋት ከእኔ ይራቅ፤

verses.text_english: The matter not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ከተራራማው ከኤፍሬም አገር የሚሆን የቢክሪ ልጅ ሳቤዔ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ግን በንጉሡ በዳዊት ላይ እጁን አነሣ፤ እርሱን ብቻውን ስጡኝ፥ እኔም ከከተማይቱ እርቃለሁ አላት። ሴቲቱም ኢዮአብን። እነሆ፥ ራሱ ከቅጥር ላይ ይጣልልሃል አለችው።

verses.text_english: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም በብልሃትዋ ወደ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሄደች፤ እነርሱም የቢክሪን ልጅ የሳቤዔን ራስ ቈርጠው ወደ ኢዮአብ ጣሉት። እርሱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ነፋ፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ከከተማይቱ ርቆ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ድንኳኑ ሄደ። ኢዮአብም ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: Now Joab over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም በእስራኤል ሠራዊት ሁሉ ላይ አለቃ ነበረ፤ የዩዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ በከሊታውያንና በፈሊታውያን ላይ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Adoram over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud recorder:
verses.text_amharic: አዶኒራምም ግብር አስገባሪ ነበረ፤ የአሒሉድም ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Sheva scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar the priests:
verses.text_amharic: ሱሳም ጸሐፊ ነበረ፤ ሳዶቅና አብያታርም ካህናት ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
verses.text_amharic: የኢያዕር ሰውም ዒራስ ለዳዊት አማካሪ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, for Saul, and for bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
verses.text_amharic: በዳዊትም ዘመን ሦስት ዓመት ያህል ቀጥሎ ራብ ሆነ፤ ዳዊትም የእግዚአብሔርን ፊት ጠየቀ። እግዚአብሔርም። የገባዖንን ሰዎች ስለ ገደለ በሳኦልና በቤቱ ላይ ደም አለበት አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የገባዖንን ሰዎች ጠራ፤ የገባዖን ሰዎችም ከአሞራውያን የተረፉ ነበሩ እንጂ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ወገን አልነበሩም፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ምለውላቸው ነበር፤ ሳኦል ግን ለእስራኤል ልጆችና ለይሁዳ ስለ ቀና ሊገድላቸው ወድዶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የገባዖንን ሰዎች። የእግዚአብሔርን ርስት ትባርኩ ዘንድ ምን ላድርግላችሁ? ማስተስረያውስ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, will I do for you.
verses.text_amharic: የገባዖን ሰዎችም። በእኛና በሳኦል ወይም በእኛና በቤቱ መካከል ያለው የብርና የወርቅ ነገር አይደለም፤ ከእስራኤልም ወገን እኛ የምንገድለው የለም አሉት። እርሱም። የምትናገሩትን አደርግላችኋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም። እኛን ካጠፋ፥ በእስራኤልም ዳርቻ ሁሉ እንዳንቀመጥ መፍረሳችንን

verses.text_english: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give .
verses.text_amharic: ካሰበው ሰው ልጆች ሰባት ሰዎች አሳልፈህ ስጠንና ከእግዚአብሔር በተመረጠው በሳኦል አገር በጊብዓ ለእግዚአብሔር እንሰቅላቸዋለን አሉት። ንጉሡም። እሰጣችኋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD'S oath that between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በሳኦል ልጅ በዮናታንና በዳዊት መካከል ስለ ነበረው ስለ እግዚአብሔር መሐላ የሳኦልን ልጅ የዮናታንን ልጅ ሜምፊቦስቴን አዳነ።

verses.text_english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ለሳኦል የወለደቻቸውን የኢዮሄል ልጅ የሪጽፋን ሁለቱን ልጆች ሄርሞንንና ሜምፊቦስቴን ለመሓላታዊውም ለቤርዜሊ ልጅ ለኤስድሪኤል የወለደቻቸውን የሳኦልን ልጅ የሜሮብን አምስቱን ልጆች ወሰደ፥

verses.text_english: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first , in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.text_amharic: ለገባዖንም ሰዎች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት በተራራው ላይ ሰቀሉአቸው፥ ሰባቱም በአንድነት ወደቁ፤ እህል በሚታጨድበት ወራት በገብሱ መከር መጀመሪያ ተገደሉ።

verses.text_english: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮሄልም ልጅ ሪጽፋ ማቅ ወስዳ ከመከር ወራት ጀምሮ ዝናብ ከሰማይ እስኪዘንብ ድረስ በድንጋይ ላይ ዘረጋችው፤ በቀንም ወፎች በሌሊትም አራዊት ያርፉባቸው ዘንድ አልተወችም።

verses.text_english: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ቁባት የኢዮሄል ልጅ ሪጽፋ ያደረገችውን ለዳዊት ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሄደ፥ ሳኦልንም በጊልቦዓ በገደሉ ጊዜ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ከሰቀሉአቸው ስፍራ ከቤትሳን አደባባይ ከሰረቁት ከኢያቢስ ገለዓድ ሰዎች የሳኦልንና የልጁን የዮናታንን አጥንት ወሰደ፤

verses.text_english: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም የሳኦልንና የልጁን የዮናታንን አጥንት ይዞ መጣ፤ የተሰቀሉትንም ሰዎች አጥንት ሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልንና የልጁን የዮናታንን አጥንት በብንያም አገር በጼላ በአባቱ በቂስ መቃብር ቀበሩት፤ ንጉሡም ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ። ከዚያም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አገሩ የተለመነውን ሰማ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
verses.text_amharic: በፍልስጥኤማውያንና በእስራኤልም መካከል ደግሞ ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር ባሪያዎቹ ወረዱ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጋር ተዋጉ፤ ዳዊትም ደከመ።

verses.text_english: And Ishbibenob, which of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear three hundred of brass in weight, he being girded with a new , thought to have slain David.
verses.text_amharic: ከራፋይም ወገን የነበረው ይሽቢብኖብ ዳዊትን ይገድል ዘንድ አሰበ፤ የጦሩም ሚዛን ክብደት ሦስት መቶ ሰቅል ናስ ነበረ፥ አዲስም የጦር መሣሪያ ታጥቆ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያም ልጅ አቢሳ አዳነው፥ ፍልስጥኤማዊውንም መትቶ ገደለው። ያንጊዜም የዳዊት ሰዎች። አንተ የእስራኤልን መብራት እንዳታጠፋ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከእኛ ጋር ለሰልፍ አትወጣም ብለው ማሉለት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which of the sons of the giant.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ እንደ ገና በጎብ ላይ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሰልፍ ሆነ፥ ኩሳታዊውም ሴቦካይ ከራፋይም ወገን የነበረውን ሳፍን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear like a weaver's beam.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በጎብ ላይ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ የቤተ ልሔማዊውም የየዓሬኦርጊም ልጅ ኤልያናን የጦሩ የቦ እንደ ሸማኔ መጠቅለያ የነበረውን የጌት ሰው ጎልያድን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በጌት ላይ ሰልፍ ሆነ፤ በዚያም በእጁና በእግሩ ስድስት ስድስት ሁላሁሉ ሀያ አራት ጣቶች የነበሩት አንድ ረጅም ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱ ደግሞ ከራፋይም የተወለደ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልንም በተገዳደረ ጊዜ የዳዊት ወንድም የሣማ ልጅ ዮናታን ገደለው።

verses.text_english: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም አራቱ በጌት ውስጥ ከራፋይም የተወለዱ ነበሩ፤ በዳዊትም እጅ በባሪያዎቹም እጅ ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር ከሳኦል እጅና ከጠላቶቹ እጅ ሁሉ ባዳነው ቀን የዚህን ቅኔ ቃል ለእግዚአብሔር ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And he said, The LORD my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። እግዚአብሔር ዓለቴ አምባዬ መድኃኒቴ ነው፤

verses.text_english: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጠባቂዬ ነው፥ በእርሱም እታመናለሁ፤ ጋሻዬና የረድኤቴ ቀንድ፥ መጠጊያዬና መሸሸጊያዬ፥ መድኃኒቴ ሆይ፥ ከግፍ ሥራ ታድነኛለህ።

verses.text_english: I will call on the LORD, worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ምስጋና የሚገባውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠራለሁ፤ ከጠላቶቼም እድናለሁ።

verses.text_english: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.text_amharic: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፤ የዓመፅ ፈሳሽም አስፈራኝ፤

verses.text_english: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.text_amharic: የሲኦል ጣር ከበበኝ፤ የሞት ወጥመድ ደረሰብኝ።

verses.text_english: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry into his ears.
verses.text_amharic: በጨነቀኝ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፥ ወደ አምላኬም ጮኽሁ፤ ከመቅደሱም ቃሌን ሰማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም በፊቱ ወደ ጆሮው ገባ።

verses.text_english: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ተንቀጠቀጠች፥ ተናወጠችም፥ የሰማዮችም መሠረቶች ተነቃነቁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶአልና ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.text_english: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.text_amharic: ከቍጣው ጢስ ወጣ፥ ከአፉም የሚበላ እሳት ነደደ፤ ፍምም ከእርሱ በራ።

verses.text_english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness under his feet.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማዮችን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረገ፥ ወረደም፤ ጨለማም ከእግሩ በታች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.text_amharic: በኪሩብም ላይ ተቀምጦ በረረ፤ በነፋስም ክንፍ ሆኖ ታየ፤

verses.text_english: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.text_amharic: መሰወርያውን ጨለማ፥ በዙሪያውም የነበረውን ድንኳን፥ በደመና ውስጥ የነበረ የጨለማ ውኃ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱም ካለው ብርሃን የተነሣ ፍም ተቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከሰማያት አንጐደጐደ፥ ልዑልም ቃሉን ሰጠ፤

verses.text_english: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጻውን ላከ፥ በተናቸውም መብረቆችን ላከ፥ አወካቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘለፋ፥ ከመዓቱም መንፈስ እስትንፋስ የተነሣ፥ የባሕር ፈሳሾች ታዩ፥ የዓለም መሠረቶችም ተገለጡ።

verses.text_english: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.text_amharic: ከላይ ሰደደ፥ ወሰደኝም፤ ከብዙ ውኆችም አወጣኝ።

verses.text_english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.text_amharic: ከብርቱዎች ጠላቶቼ፥ ከሚጠሉኝም አዳነኝ፤ በርትተውብኝ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራዬ ቀን ደረሱብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ደገፋዬ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰፊ ስፍራም አወጣኝ፤ ወድዶኛልና አዳነኝ።

verses.text_english: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጽድቄ ይከፍለኛል፤ እንደ እጄ ንጽሕና ይመልስልኛል፤

verses.text_english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ጠብቄአለሁና፥ በአምላኬም አላመፅሁምና።

verses.text_english: For all his judgments before me: and his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዱ ሁሉ በፊቴ ነበረና፤ ከሥርዓቱም አልራቅሁምና።

verses.text_english: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ዘንድ ቅን ነበርሁ፥ ከኃጢአቴም ተጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ጽድቄ፥ እንደ እጄም ንጽሕና በዓይኖቹ ፊት መለሰልኝ።

verses.text_english: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
verses.text_amharic: ከቸር ሰው ጋር ቸር ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከቅን ሰው ጋር ቅን ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤

verses.text_english: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.text_amharic: ከንጹሕ ጋር ንጹሕ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከጠማማም ጋር ጠማማ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ።

verses.text_english: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes upon the haughty, thou mayest bring down.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የተጠቃውን ሕዝብ ታድናለህና፤ የትዕቢተኞችን ዓይን ግን ታዋርዳለህ።

verses.text_english: For thou my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ መብራቴ ነህና፤ እግዚአብሔርም ጨለማዬን ያበራል።

verses.text_english: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ኃይል በጭፍራ ላይ እሮጣለሁና፤ በአምላኬም ቅጥሩን እዘልላለሁና።

verses.text_english: God, his way perfect; the word of the LORD tried: he a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክ መንገድ ፍጹም ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የነጠረ ነው፤ በእርሱ ለሚታመኑት ሁሉ ጋሻ ነው።

verses.text_english: For who God, save the LORD? and who a rock, save our God?
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው? ከአምላካችንስ በቀር አምባ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: God my strength power: and he maketh my way perfect.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይልን የሚያስታጥቀኝ፥ መንገዴንም የሚያቃና፥

verses.text_english: He maketh my feet like hinds' : and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቼን እንደ ብሆር እግሮች የሚያበረታ፥ በኮረብቶችም የሚያቆመኝ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቼን ሰልፍ ያስተምራል፤ በክንዴም የናስ ቀስት እገትራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.text_amharic: የማዳንህንም ጋሻ ሰጠኸኝ፤ ተግሣጽህም አሳደገኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.text_amharic: አረማመዴን በበታቼ አሰፋህ፥ እግሮቼም አልተንሸራተቱም።

verses.text_english: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼን አሳድዳቸዋለሁ፥ አጠፋቸውማለሁ፤ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ አልመለስም።

verses.text_english: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.text_amharic: አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ መቆምም አይችሉም፥ ከእግሬም በታች ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰልፍም ኃይልን ታስታጥቀኛለህ፤ በላዬ የቆሙትን በበታቼ ታስገዛቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.text_amharic: የጠላቶቼን ጀርባ ሰጠኸኝ፥ የሚጠሉኝንም አጠፋሃቸው።

verses.text_english: They looked, but none to save; unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.text_amharic: ጮኹ፥ የሚረዳቸውም አልነበረም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ አልሰማቸውምም።

verses.text_english: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, did spread them abroad.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምድር ትቢያ ፈጨኋቸው፤ እንደ አደባባይም ጭቃ ረገጥኋቸው፥ ደቀደቅኋቸውም።

verses.text_english: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me head of the heathen: a people I knew not shall serve me.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብ ክርክር ታድነኛለህ፤ የአሕዛብም ራስ አድርገህ ትሾመኛለህ፤ የማላውቀው ሕዝብም ይገዛልኛል።

verses.text_english: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.text_amharic: የባዕድ ልጆች ደለሉኝ፤ በጆሮ ሰምተው ተገዙልኝ።

verses.text_english: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.text_amharic: የባዕድ ልጆች እየጠፉ ይሄዳሉ፤ ከተዘጉ ስፍሮች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD liveth; and blessed my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ነው፥ ጠባቂዬም ቡሩክ ነው፤ የመድኃኒቴ ጠባቂ አምላኬ ከፍ ከፍ ይበል፤

verses.text_english: It God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
verses.text_amharic: በቀሌን የሚመልስልኝ አምላክ፥ አሕዛብን በበታቼ የሚያስገዛ፥

verses.text_english: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠላቶቼ የሚያወጣኝ እርሱ ነው፤ በእኔም ላይ ከቆሙ ከፍ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ፤ ከግፈኛ ሰው ታድነኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡን መድኃኒት ታላቅ ያደርጋል፤ ቸርነቱንም ለቀባው፥ ለዳዊትና ለዘሩ፥ ለዘላለም ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Now these the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም የመጨረሻ ቃሉ ይህ ነው። ከፍ ከፍ የተደረገው፥ በያዕቆብም አምላክ የተቀባው፥ በእስራኤል ዘንድ መልካም ባለ ቅኔ የሆነ፥ የእሴይ ልጅ የዳዊት ንግግር፤

verses.text_english: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word in my tongue.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእኔ ተናገረ፤ ቃሉም በአንደበቴ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men just, ruling in the fear of God.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ ተናገረኝ፤ የእስራኤል ጠባቂ እንዲህ አለ። በሰው ላይ በጽድቅ የሚሠለጥን፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃት የሚነግሥ፥

verses.text_english: And as the light of the morning, the sun riseth, a morning without clouds; the tender grass out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እንደ ማለዳ ብርሃን እንደ ፀሐይ አወጣጥ፥ በጥዋትም ያለ ደመና እንደሚደምቅ፥ ከዝናብ በኋላ ከምድር እንደሚበቅል ልምላሜ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Although my house not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all , and sure: for all my salvation, and all desire, although he make not to grow.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ቤቴ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንዲሁ አይደለምን? ከእኔም ጋር በሁሉ ነገር ቅንና ጽኑ የሆነውን የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን አድርጎአል፤ መድኃኒቴንና ፈቃዴን ሁሉ ያበቅላል።

verses.text_english: But of Belial all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፀኞች ሁሉ ግን ሰው በእጁ እንደማይዘው፥ እንደ ተጣለ እሾህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: But the man shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the place.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው ይነካው ዘንድ ቢወደድ፥ በእጁ ብረትና የጦሩን የቦ ይይዛል፤ በሥራቸውም በእሳት ፈጽሞ ይቃጠላሉ።

verses.text_english: These the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same Adino the Eznite: against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊት ኃያላን ስም ይህ ነው። የአለቆች አለቃ የሆነ ከነዓናዊው ኢያቡስቴ ነበረ፤ እርሱም ጦሩን አንሥቶ ስምንት መቶ ያህል በአንድ ጊዜ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And after him Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የአሆሃዊው የዱዲ ልጅ ኤልያናን ነበረ፤ ለሰልፍ የተሰበሰቡትን ፍልስጥኤማውያንን በተገዳደሩ ጊዜ ከዳዊት ጋር ከሦስቱ ኃያላን አንዱ እርሱ ነበረ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ተነሥቶ እጁ እስኪደክምና ከሰይፉ ጋር እስኪጣበቅ ድረስ ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ፤ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ መድኃኒት አደረገ፤ ሕዝቡም ከእርሱ በኋላ ምርኮ ለመግፈፍ ብቻ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And after him Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የአሮዳዊው የአጌ ልጅ ሣማ ነበረ። ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ምስር በሞላበት እርሻ በአንድነት ሆነው ተከማችተው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን በእርሻው መካከል ቆሞ ጠበቀ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ገደለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ታላቅ መድኃኒትአደረገ።

verses.text_english: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠላሳውም አለቆች ሦስቱ ወርደው በመከር ጊዜ ወደ ዳዊት ወደ ዓዶላም ዋሻ መጡ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በራፋይም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines then Bethlehem.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜም ዳዊት በምሽጉ ውስጥ ነበረ፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በዚያ ጊዜ በቤተ ልሔም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which by the gate!
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። በበሩ አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውኃ ማን ባጠጣኝ? ብሎ ተመኘ።

verses.text_english: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that by the gate, and took , and brought to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስቱም ኃያላን የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሠራዊት ቀድደው ሄዱ፥ በበሩም አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውኃ ቀዱ፥ ይዘውም ለዳዊት አመጡለት፤ እርሱ ግን ሊጠጣ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አፍስሶ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ ከእኔ ይራቅ፤ በነፍሳቸው ደፍረው የሄዱ ሰዎች ደም አይደለምን? ብሎ ይጠጣ ዘንድ አልወደደም። ሦስቱ ኃያላን ያደረጉት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, slew , and had the name among three.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያም ልጅ የኢዮአብ ወንድም አቢሳ የሠላሳው አለቃ ነበረ። እርሱም ጦሩን በሦስቱ መቶ ላይ አንሥቶ ገደላቸው፤ ስሙም እንደ ሦስቱ ተጠርቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the three.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ በሠላሳው መካከል የከበረ አልነበረምን? ስለዚህ አለቃቸው ሆኖ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም።

verses.text_english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
verses.text_amharic: በቀብጽኤል የነበረው ታላቅ ሥራ ያደረገው የጽኑዕ ሰው የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ የሞዓባዊውን የቀብስኤልን ሁለት ልጆች ገደለ፤ በአመዳዩም ወራት ወርዶ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ አንበሳ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.text_amharic: ረጅሙንም ግብጻዊ ሰው ገደለ፤ ግብጻዊው በእጁ ጦር ነበረው፤ በናያስ ግን በትር ይዞ ወደ እርሱ ወረደ፥ ከግብጻዊውም እጅ ጦሩን ነቅሎ በገዛ ጦሩ ገደለው።

verses.text_english: These did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ያደረገው ይህ ነው፤ ስሙም እንደ ሦስቱ ኃያላን ተጠርቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the three. And David set him over his guard.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠላሳውም ይልቅ የከበረ ነበረ፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም። ዳዊትም በክብር ዘበኞቹ ላይ ሾመው።

verses.text_english: Asahel the brother of Joab one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮአብም ወንድም አሣሄል በሠላሳው መካከል ነበረ፥ የቤተ ልሔም ሰው የዱዲ

verses.text_english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
verses.text_amharic: ልጅ ኤልያናን፥ አሮዳዊው ሣማ፥ ሒሮዳዊው ኤሊቃ፥

verses.text_english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
verses.text_amharic: ፈልጣዊው ሴሌስ፥ የቴቁሐዊው

verses.text_english: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
verses.text_amharic: የዒስካ ልጅ ዒራስ፥ ዓናቶታዊው

verses.text_english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
verses.text_amharic: አቢዔዜር፥ ኩሳታዊው ምቡናይ፥ አሆሃዊው

verses.text_english: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
verses.text_amharic: ጸልሞን፥ ነጦፋዊው ኖኤሬ፥ የነጦፋዊው የበዓና ልጅ ሔሌብ፥ ከብንያም ወገን

verses.text_english: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
verses.text_amharic: ከጊብዓ የሪባይ ልጅ ኢታይ፥ ጲርዓቶናዊው በናያስ፥ የገዓስ ወንዝ ሰው

verses.text_english: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
verses.text_amharic: ሂዳይ፥ ዓረባዊው አቢዓልቦን፥ በርሑማዊው

verses.text_english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
verses.text_amharic: ዓዝሞት፥ ሸዓልቦናዊው ኤሊያሕባ፥

verses.text_english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
verses.text_amharic: የአሳን ልጆች፥ ዮናታን፥ አሮዳዊው ሣማ

verses.text_english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
verses.text_amharic: የአሮዳዊው የአራር ልጅ አምናን፥ የማዕካታዊው ልጅ የአሐስባይ ልጅ ኤሌፋላት፥ የጊሎናዊው የአኪጦፌል ልጅ ኤልያብ፥

verses.text_english: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
verses.text_amharic: ቀርሜሎሳዊው ሐጽሮ፥ አርባዊው ፈዓራይ፥

verses.text_english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
verses.text_amharic: የሱባ ሰው የናታን ልጅ ይግዓል፥ ጋዳዊው

verses.text_english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.text_amharic: ባኒ፥ የጽሩያ ልጅ የኢዮአብ ጋሻ ጃግሬዎች አሞናዊው ጼሌቅ፥ ብኤሮታዊው

verses.text_english: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
verses.text_amharic: ነሃራይ፥ ይትራዊው ዒራስ፥ ይትራዊው

verses.text_english: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሬብ፥ ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮ፤ ሁሉ በሁሉ ሠላሳ ሰባት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ ዳዊትንም። ሂድ፥ እስራኤልንና ይሁዳን ቍጠር ብሎ በላያቸው አስነሣው።

verses.text_english: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኢዮአብንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን የሠራዊት አለቆች። የሕዝቡን ድምር አውቅ ዘንድ ከዳን ጀምሮ እስከ ቤርሳቤህ ድረስ ተመላለሱ፥ ሕዝቡንም ቍጠሩአቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see : but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ንጉሡን። የጌታዬ የንጉሡ ዓይን እያየ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ ካለው ሕዝብ መጠን በላይ መቶ እጥፍ ይጨምርበት፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሡ ግን ይህን ነገር ለምን ይወድዳል? አለው።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የንጉሡ ቃል በኢዮአብና በሠራዊቱ አለቆች ላይ አሸነፈ። ኢዮአብና የሠራዊቱ አለቆችም የእስራኤልን ሕዝብ ይቈጥሩ ዘንድ ከንጉሥ ዘንድ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
verses.text_amharic: ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻገሩ፤ በጋድ ሸለቆ መካከል ባለችው በኢያዜር ከተማ ቀኝ በኩል በአሮዔር ላይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ገለዓድም ወደ ተባሶን አዳሰይ አገር መጡ፤ ወደ ዳንየዓንም ደረሱ፥ ወደ ሲዶናም ዞሩ፥

verses.text_english: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, to Beersheba.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጢሮስም ምሽግ ወደ ኤዊያውያንና ወደ ከነዓናውያንም ከተሞች ሁሉ መጡ፤ በይሁዳም ደቡብ በኩል በቤርሳቤህ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.text_amharic: በአገሪቱም ሁሉ ላይ ተመላልሰው ከዘጠኝ ወርና ከሀያ ቀን በኋላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah five hundred thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም የሕዝቡን ቁጥር ድምር ለንጉሡ ሰጠ፤ በእስራኤልም ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ስምንት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ የይሁዳም ሰዎች አምስት መቶ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ከቈጠረ በኋላ ዳዊትን ልቡ መታው፤ ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን። ባደረግሁት ነገር እጅግ በድያለሁ፤ አሁን ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ታላቅ ስንፍና አድርጌአለሁና የባሪያህን ኃጢአት ታርቅ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ማልዶ በተነሣ ጊዜ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ዳዊት ባለ ራእይ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ጋድ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three ; choose thee one of them, that I may unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ ለዳዊት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሦስት ነገሮች በፊትህ አኖራለሁ፤ አደርግብህ ዘንድ ከእነርሱ አንዱን ምረጥ ብለህ ንገረው አለው።

verses.text_english: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ጋድም ወደ ዳዊት መጥቶ። የሦስት ዓመት ራብ በአገርህ ላይ ይምጣብህን? ወይስ ጠላቶችህ እያሳደዱህ ሦስት ወር ከእነርሱ ትሸሽን? ወይስ የሦስት ቀን ቸነፈር በአገርህ ላይ ይሁን? አሁንም ለላከኝ ምን መልስ እንደምሰጥ አስብና መርምር ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ጋድን። እጅግ ተጨንቄአለሁ፤ ምሕረቱ ብዙ ነውና በእግዚአብሔር እጅ እንውደቅ፤ በሰው እጅ ግን አልውደቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ቸነፈሩን መረጠ፤ የስንዴም መከር ወራት በሆነ ጊዜ ቸነፈሩ በሕዝቡ መካከል ጀመረ፤ ከሕዝቡም ሰባ ሺህ ሰው ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ኢየሩሳሌምን ያጠፋት ዘንድ እጁን በዘረጋ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ክፉው ነገር አዘነ፥ ሕዝቡንም የሚያጠፋውን መልአክ። እንግዲህ በቃህ፤ እጅህን መልስ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሕዝቡን የሚመታውን መልእክ ባየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን። እነሆ፥ እኔ በድያለሁ ጠማማም ሥራ እኔ አድርጌአለሁ፤ እነዚህ በጎች ግን እነርሱ ምን አደረጉ? እጅህ በእኔና በአባቴ ቤት ላይ እንድትሆን እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ጋድ ወደ ዳዊት መጥቶ። ውጣ፥ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሥራ አለው።

verses.text_english: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው እንደ ጋድ ነገር ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርናም ሲመለከት ንጉሡና ባሪያዎቹ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጡ አየ፤ ኦርናም ወጥቶ በንጉሡ ፊት በምድር ላይ በግምባሩ ተደፋ።

verses.text_english: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርናም። ጌታዬን ንጉሡን ወደ ባሪያው ያመጣው ምክንያት ምንድር ነው? አለ። ዳዊትም። መቅሠፍቱ ከሕዝቡ ላይ ይከለከል ዘንድ አውድማውን ከአንተ ገዝቼ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ልሠራ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what good unto him: behold, oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and instruments of the oxen for wood.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርናም ዳዊትን። ጌታዬ ንጉሡ እንደ ወደደ ወስዶ ያቅርብ፤ እነሆ፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሬዎች፥ ለሚቃጠልም እንጨት የአውድማ ዕቃና የበሬ ቀንበር አለ።

verses.text_english: All these did Araunah, a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ይህን ሁሉ ኦርና ለንጉሡ ይሰጣል አለው፤ ኦርናም ንጉሡን። አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይቀበልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኦርናን። እንዲህ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን በዋጋ ከአንተ እገዛለሁ፤ ለአምላኬም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያለ ዋጋ አላቀርብም አለው። ዳዊትም አውድማውንና በሬዎቹን በአምሳ ሰቅል ብር ገዛ።

verses.text_english: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዳዊት ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ የሚቃጠልና የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት አቀረበ። እግዚአብሔርም ስለ አገሪቱ የተለመነውን ሰማ፥ መቅሠፍቱም ከእስራኤል ተከለከለ።

verses.text_english: Now king David was old stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ዳዊትም ሸመገለ ዕድሜውም በዛ፤ ልብስም ደረቡለት፥ ነገር ግን አይሞቀውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹም። ለጌታችን ለንጉሡ ድንግል ትፈለጋለች፤ በንጉሡም ፊት ቆማ ታገልግለው፥ በጌታችንም በንጉሡ ብብት ተኝታ ታሙቀው አሉት።

verses.text_english: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም አገር ሁሉ የተዋበች ቈንጆ ፈለጉ፤ ሱነማይቱን አቢሳንም አገኙ፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ይዘዋት መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the damsel very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.text_amharic: ቈንጆይቱም እጅግ ውብ ነበረች፤ ንጉሡንም ትረዳውና ታገለግለው ነበር፥ ንጉሡ ግን አያውቃትም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.text_amharic: የአጊትም ልጅ አዶንያስ። ንጉሥ እሆናለሁ ብሎ ተነሣ፤ ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን በፊቱም የሚሮጡ አምሳ ሰዎች አዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also very goodly ; and bare him after Absalom.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ከቶ በሕይወቱ ሳለ። እንዲህ ለምን ታደርጋለህ? ብሎ አልተቈጣውም ነበር፤ እርሱ ደግሞ እጅግ ያማረ ሰው ነበረ፤ ከአቤሴሎምም በኋላ ተወልዶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped .
verses.text_amharic: ሴራውም ከጽሩያ ልጅ ከኢዮአብና ከካህኑ ከአብያታር ጋር ነበረ፥ እነርሱም አዶንያስን ተከትለው ይረዱት ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ካህኑ ሳዶቅና የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ነቢዩም ናታን ሳሚም ሬሲም የዳዊትም ኃያላን ከአዶንያስ ጋር አልነበሩም።

verses.text_english: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
verses.text_amharic: አዶንያስም በጎችንና በሬዎችን ፍሪዳዎችንም በዓይንሮጌል አጠገብ ባለችው በዞሔሌት ድንጋይ ዘንድ ሠዋ፤ የንጉሡንም ልጆች ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ፥ የንጉሡንም ባሪያዎች፥ የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ ጠራ።

verses.text_english: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ነቢዩን ናታንን፥ በናያስንም፥ ኃያላኑንም፥ ወንድሙንም ሰሎሞንን አልጠራም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth not?
verses.text_amharic: ናታንም የሰሎሞንን እናት ቤርሳቤህን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራት። ጌታችን ዳዊት ሳያውቅ የአጊት ልጅ አዶንያስ እንደ ነገሠ አልሰማሽምን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ነዪ፥ የልጅሽን የሰሎሞንን ነፍስና የአንቺን ነፍስ እንድታድኝ እመክርሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.text_amharic: ሄደሽ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ዳዊት ግቢና። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ለእኔ ለባሪያህ። ልጅሽ ሰሎሞን ከእኔ በኋላ ይነግሣል፥ በዙፋኔም ይቀመጣል ብለህ አልማልህልኝምን? ስለ ምንስ አዶንያስ ይነግሣል? በዪው።

verses.text_english: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አንቺ በዚያ ለንጉሥ ስትነግሪ እኔ ከአንቺ በኋላ እገባለሁ፥ ቃልሽንም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.text_amharic: ቤርሳቤህም ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ እልፍኝ ገባች፤ ንጉሡም እጅግ ሸምግሎ ነበር፥ ሱነማይቱም አቢሳ ታገለግለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
verses.text_amharic: ቤርሳቤህም አጐንብሳ ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሣች፤ ንጉሡም። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? አለ።

verses.text_english: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም አለችው። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ አንተ ለባሪያህ። ልጅሽ ሰሎሞን ከእኔ በኋላ ይነግሣል፥ በዙፋኔም ይቀመጣል ብለህ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ምለህልኛል፤

verses.text_english: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest not:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ አዶንያስ መንገሡ ነው፤ አንተም ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ይህን አታውቅም፤

verses.text_english: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ብዙ በሬዎችንና ፍሪዳዎችን በጎችንም ሠውቶአል፥ የንጉሡንም ልጆች ሁሉ፥ ካህኑንም አብያታርን፥ የሠራዊቱንም አለቃ ኢዮአብን ጠርቶአል፤ ባሪያህን ሰሎሞንን ግን አልጠራውም።

verses.text_english: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በኋላ በጌታዬ በንጉሥ ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጠውን ትነግራቸው ዘንድ የእስራኤል ሁሉ ዓይን ይመለከትሃል።

verses.text_english: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ባይሆን፥ ጌታዬ ከአባቶችህ ጋር ባንቀላፋህ ጊዜ እኔና ልጄ ሰሎሞን እንደ ኃጢአተኞች እንቈጠራለን።

verses.text_english: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ለንጉሡ ስትናገር ነቢዩ ናታን ገባ።

verses.text_english: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡም። እነሆ፥ ነቢዩ ናታን መጥቶአል ብለው ነገሩት፤ እርሱም ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት በገባ ጊዜ በግምባሩ በምድር ላይ ተደፍቶ ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሣ።

verses.text_english: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.text_amharic: ናታንም አለ። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አንተ። ከእኔ በኋላ አዶንያስ ይነግሣል፥ በዙፋኔም ላይ ይቀመጣል ብለሃልን?

verses.text_english: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ዛሬ ወርዶ ብዙ በሬዎችንና ፍሪዳዎችን በጎችንም ሠውቶአል፥ የንጉሡንም ልጆች ሁሉ፥ የሠራዊትንም አለቃ ኢዮአብን፥ ካህኑንም አብያታርን ጠርቶአል፤ እነሆም፥ በፊቱ እየበሉና እየጠጡ። አዶንያስ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: But me, me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እኔን ባሪያህን፥ ካህኑንም ሳዶቅን፥ የዮዳሄንም ልጅ በናያስን፥ ባሪያህንም ሰሎሞንን አልጠራም።

verses.text_english: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ይህ ነገር ከጌታዬ ከንጉሡ የተደረገ ነውን? ለባሪያህም ከአንተ በኋላ በጌታዬ በንጉሡ ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጠውን አልነገርህምን?

verses.text_english: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት። ቤርሳቤህን ጥሩልኝ ብሎ መለሰ። ወደ ንጉሡም ገባች፥ በንጉሡም ፊት ቆመች።

verses.text_english: And the king sware, and said, the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ነፍሴን ከመከራ ሁሉ ያዳነኝ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን!

verses.text_english: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት። ልጅሽ ሰሎሞን ከእኔ በኋላ ይነግሣል፥ በእኔም ፋንታ በዙፋኔ ላይ ይቀመጣል ብዬ በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር እንደ ማልሁልሽ፥ እንዲሁ ዛሬ በእውነት አደርጋለሁ ብሎ ማለ።

verses.text_english: Then Bathsheba bowed with face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቤርሳቤህም በግምባርዋ በምድር ላይ ተደፍታ ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሣችና። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ዳዊት ለዘላለም በሕይወት ይኑር አለች።

verses.text_english: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት። ካህኑን ሳዶቅንና ነቢዩን ናታንን የዮዳሄንም ልጅ በናያስን ጥሩልኝ አለ። ወደ ንጉሡም ፊት ገቡ።

verses.text_english: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አላቸው። የጌታችሁን ባሪያዎች ይዛችሁ ሂዱ፥ ልጄንም ሰሎሞንን በበቅሎዬ ላይ አስቀምጡት፥ ወደ ግዮንም አውርዱት፤

verses.text_english: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ካህኑ ሳዶቅና ነቢዩ ናታን በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ አድርገው ይቅቡት፤ ቀንደ መለከትም ነፍታችሁ። ሰሎሞን ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ በሉ።

verses.text_english: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላውም ተከትላችሁ ውጡ፤ እርሱም መጥቶ በዙፋኔ ላይ ይቀመጥ፥ በእኔም ፋንታ ይንገሥ፤ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳም ላይ አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so .
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ መልሶ ለንጉሡ አለ፥ ያበጅ ያድርግ፤ የጌታዬም የንጉሥ አምላክ ይህን ይናገር።

verses.text_english: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከጌታዬ ከንጉሥ ጋር እንደ ነበረ እንዲሁ ከሰሎሞን ጋር ይሁን፥ ዙፋኑንም ከጌታዬ ከንጉሡ ዳዊት ዙፋን የበለጠ ያድርግ።

verses.text_english: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሳዶቅና ነቢዩ ናታን የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ ከሊታውያንና ፈሊታውያንም ወረዱ፥ ሰሎሞንንም በንጉሡ በዳዊት በቅሎ ላይ አስቀምጠው ወደ ግዮን አመጡት።

verses.text_english: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሳዶቅ ከድንኳኑ የቅብዓቱን ቀንድ ወስዶ ሰሎሞንን ቀባ፤ ቀንደ መለከትም ነፉ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ሰሎሞን ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እርሱን ተከትለው ወጡ፥ ሕዝቡም ዘፈን ይዘፍኑ ነበር፥ በታላቅም ደስታ ደስ አላቸው፤ ከጩኸታቸውም የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች።

verses.text_english: And Adonijah and all the guests that with him heard as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.text_amharic: አዶንያስና እርሱም የጠራቸው ሁሉ መብሉና መጠጡ ተፈጽሞ ሳለ ሰሙ፤ ኢዮአብም የቀንደ መለከት ጽምፅ በሰማ ጊዜ። ይህ በከተማ ውስጥ ያለ የሽብር ድምፅ ምንድር ነው? አለ።

verses.text_english: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ይህን ሲናገር የካህኑ የአብያታር ልጅ ዮናታን መጣ፤ አዶንያስም። አንተ መልካም ሰው ነህና፥ መልካም ታወራልናለህና ግባ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.text_amharic: ዮናታንም ለአዶንያስ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። በእውነት ጌታችን ንጉሥ ዳዊት ሰሎሞንን አነገሠው።

verses.text_english: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከእርሱ ጋር ካሁኑን ሳዶቅንና ነቢዩን ናታንን የዮዳሄንም ልጅ በናያስን ከሊታውያንንና ፈሊታውያንንም ሰደደ፥ በንጉሡም በቅሎ ላይ አስቀመጡት።

verses.text_english: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This the noise that ye have heard.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሳዶቅና ነቢዩ ናታን በግዮን ንጉሥ አድርገው ቀቡት፤ ከዚያም ደስ ብሎአቸው ወጡ፥ ከተማይቱም አስተጋባች፤ የሰማችሁትም ድምፅ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሰሎሞን በመንግሥቱ ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦአል።

verses.text_english: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡም ባሪያዎች ገብተው። እግዚአብሔር የሰሎሞንን ስም ከስምህ ዙፋኑንም ከዙፋንህ የበለጠ ያድርግ ብለው ጌታችንን ንጉሡን ዳዊትን ባረኩ፤ ንጉሡም በአልጋው ላይ ሆኖ ሰገደ።

verses.text_english: And also thus said the king, Blessed the LORD God of Israel, which hath given to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing .
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ደግሞ። ዓይኔ እያየ ዛሬ በዙፋኔ ላይ የሚቀመጠውን የሰጠኝ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን አለ።

verses.text_english: And all the guests that with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.text_amharic: አዶንያስም የጠራቸው ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ ተነሥተውም እያንዳንዳቸው በየመንገዳቸው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: አዶንያስም ሰሎሞንን ፈራ፥ ተነሥቶም ሄደ፥ የመሠዊያውንም ቀንድ ያዘ።

verses.text_english: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰሎሞንም። እነሆ፥ አዶንያስ ንጉሡን ሰሎሞንን ፈርቶ። ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ባሪያውን በሰይፍ እንዳይገድለኝ ዛሬ ይማልልኝ ብሎ የመሠዊያውን ቀንድ ይዞአል አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም። እርሱ አካሄዱን ያሳመረ እንደ ሆነ ከእርሱ አንዲት ጠጕር እንኳ በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም፤ ነገር ግን ክፋት የተገኘበት እንደ ሆነ ይሞታል አለ።

verses.text_english: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ላከ፥ ከመሠዊያውም አወረዱት፤ መጥቶም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እጅ ነሣ፥ ሰሎሞንም። ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የሚሞትበት ቀን ቀረበ፤ ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የምድሩን ሁሉ መንገድ እሄዳለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
verses.text_amharic: በርታ ሰውም ሁን፤ የምታደርገውንና የምትሄድበትን ሁሉ ታከናውን ዘንድ፥ በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዛቱን ፍርዱንና ምስክሩንም ትጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ትሄድ ዘንድ፥ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እኔ። ልጆችህ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ፥ በፊቴም በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው በእውነት ቢሄዱ ከእስራኤል ዙፋን ሰው አይቈረጥብህም ብሎ የተናገረውን ቃል ያጸና ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that about his loins, and in his shoes that on his feet.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ደግሞ የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብ፥ ሁለቱን የእስራኤልን ጭፍራ አለቆች የኔር ልጅ አበኔርን የዬቴሩንም ልጅ አሜሳይን ገድሎ፥ በእኔ ላይ ያደረገውን ታውቃለህ፤ የሰልፉንም ደም በሰላም አፈሰሰ፥ በወገቡም ባለው ድግና በእግሩ ባለው ጫማ ንጹሕ ደም አኖረ።

verses.text_english: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም እንደ ጥበብህ አድርግ፥ ሽበቱንም በሰላም ወደ መቃብር አታውርደው።

verses.text_english: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንድምህ ከአቤሴሎም ፊት በሸሸሁ ጊዜ ቀርበውኛልና ለገለዓዳዊው ለቤርዜሊ ልጆች መልካም ቸርነት አድርግላቸው፥ በማዕድህም ከሚበሉት መካከል ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ወደ መሃናይም በሄድሁ ጊዜ ብርቱ እርግማን የረገመኝ የብራቂም አገር ሰው የብንያማዊው የጌራ ልጅ ሳሚ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንተ ዘንድ ነው፤ እርሱ ግን ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገርሁ ጊዜ ሊቀበለኝ ወረደ፥ እኔም። በሰይፍ አልገድልህም ብዬ በእግዚአብሔር ምዬለታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ጥበበኛ ሰው ነህና ያለ ቅጣት አትተወው፤ የምታደርግበትንም አንተ ታውቃለህ፥ ሽበቱንም ከደም ጋር ወደ መቃብር አውርድ።

verses.text_english: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And the days that David reigned over Israel forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ላይ የነገሠው ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ። በኬብሮን ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በአባቱ በዳዊት ዙፋን ተቀመጠ፤ መንግሥቱም እጅግ ጸና።

verses.text_english: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.text_amharic: የአጊት ልጅ አዶንያስም ወደ ሰሎሞን እናት ወደ ቤርሳቤህ መጣ፤ እርስዋም። ወደ እኔ መምጣትህ በሰላም ነውን? አለች፤

verses.text_english: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በሰላም ነው አለ። ደግሞም። ከአንቺ ጋር ጉዳይ አለኝ አለ፤ እርስዋም። ተናገር አለች።

verses.text_english: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። መንግሥቱ ለእኔ እንደ ነበረ፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ንጉሥ እሆን ዘንድ ፊታቸውን ወደ እኔ አድርገው እንደ ነበረ አንቺ ታውቂያለሽ፤ ነገር ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆኖለታልና መንግሥቱ ከእኔ አልፎ ለወንድሜ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አንዲት ልመና እለምንሻለሁ፤ አታሳፍሪኝ አለ። እርስዋም። ተናገር አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አያሳፍርሽምና ሱነማይቱን አቢሳን ይድርልኝ ዘንድ ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እንድትነግሪው እለምንሻለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.text_amharic: ቤርሳቤህም። መልካም ነው፥ ስለ አንተ ለንጉሡ እነግረዋለሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.text_amharic: ቤርሳቤህም የአዶንያስን ነገር ትነግረው ዘንድ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን ገባች፤ ንጉሡም ሊቀበላት ተነሣ ሳማትም፥ በዙፋኑም ተቀመጠ፤ ለንጉሡም እናት ወንበር አስመጣላት፥ በቀኙም ተቀመጠች።

verses.text_english: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; , say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አንዲት ታናሽ ልመና እለምንሃለሁ፤ አታሳፍረኝ አለች። ንጉሡም። እናቴ ሆይ፥ አላሳፍርሽምና ለምኝ አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ሱነማይቱ አቢሳ ለወንድምህ ለአዶንያስ ትዳርለት አለች።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ለእናቱ መልሶ። ሱነማይቱን አቢሳን ለአዶንያስ ለምን ትለምኝለታለሽ? ታላቅ ወንድሜ ነውና መንግሥትን ደግሞ ለምኚለት፤ ካህኑም አብያታርና የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ናቸው አላት።

verses.text_english: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን። አዶንያስ ይህን ቃል በሕይወቱ ላይ አለመናገሩ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያድርግብኝ፥ ይህንም ይጨምርብኝ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ያጸናኝ፥ በአባቴም በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ያስቀመጠኝ፥ እንደ ተናገረውም ቤትን የሠራልኝ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዛሬ አዶንያስ ፈጽሞ ይገደላል ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ማለ።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን ላከ፤ እርሱም ወደቀበት፥ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ካህኑን አብያታርን። አንተ ዛሬ የሞት ሰው ነበርህ፤ ነገር ግን የአምላክን የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት በአባቴ በዳዊት ፊት ስለ ተሸከምህ፥ አባቴም የተቀበለውን መከራ ሁሉ አንተ ስለ ተቀበልህ አልገድልህምና በዓናቶት ወዳለው ወደ እርሻህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.text_amharic: በሴሎም በዔሊ ቤት ላይ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ሰሎሞን አብያታርን ከእግዚአብሔር ክህነት አወጣው።

verses.text_english: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ለኢዮአብም ወሬ ደረሰለት፤ ኢዮአብም አቤሴሎምን አልተከተለም ነበር እንጂ አዶንያስን ተከትሎ ነበር። ኢዮአብም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድንኳን ሸሽቶ የመሠዊያውን ቀንድ ያዘ።

verses.text_english: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ኢዮአብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድንኳን ሸሽቶ መሠዊያውን እንደ ያዘ ሰማ፤ ሰሎሞንም የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን፥ ሂድ ውደቅበት ብሎ አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.text_amharic: በናያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድንኳን መጥቶ። ንጉሡ። ውጣ ይልሃል አለው፤ እርሱም። በዚህ እሞታለሁ እንጂ አልወጣም አለ። በናያስም። ኢዮአብ የተናገረው ቃል የመለሰልኝም እንዲህ ነው ብሎ ወደ ንጉሡ ወሬ አመጣ።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አለው። እንደ ነገረህ አድርግ፤ ኢዮአብም በከንቱ ያፈሰሰውን ደም ከእኔና ከአባቴ ቤት ታርቅ ዘንድ ገድለህ ቅበረው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing , Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: አባቴ ዳዊት ሳያውቅ ከእርሱ የሚሻሉትን ሁለቱን ጻድቃን ሰዎች፥ የእስራኤልን ሠራዊት አለቃ የኔርን ልጅ አበኔርን፥ የይሁዳንም ሠራዊት አለቃ የዬቴርን ልጅ አሜሳይን፥ በሰይፍ ገድሎአልና እግዚአብሔር ደሙን በራሱ ላይ ይመልሰው።

verses.text_english: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደማቸውም በኢዮአብ ራስና በዘሩ ራስ ላይ ለዘላለም ይመለስ፤ ለዳዊት ግን ለዘሩና ለቤቱ ለዙፋኑም የእግዚአብሔር ሰላም ለዘላለም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ ወጥቶ ወደቀበት ገደለውም፤ በምድረ በዳም ባለው በቤቱ ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በእርሱ ፋንታ የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን የሠራዊቱ አለቃ አደረገ፤ በአብያታርም ፋንታ ካህኑን ሳዶቅን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ልኮ ሳሚን አስጠራውና። በኢየሩሳሌም ቤት ሠርተህ ተቀመጥ፥ ወዲህና ወዲያም አትውጣ።

verses.text_english: For it shall be, on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.text_amharic: በወጣህበትም ቀን፥ የቄድሮንንም ፈፋ በተሻገርህበት ቀን ፈጽመህ እንድትሞት እወቅ፤ ደምህ በራስህ ላይ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.text_amharic: ሳሚም ንጉሡን። ነገሩ መልካም ነው፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ እንደ ተናገረ ባሪያህ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል አለው፤ ሳሚም በኢየሩሳሌም ብዙ ቀን ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants in Gath.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት ዓመትም በኋላ ከሳሚ ባሪያዎች ሁለቱ ወደ ጌት ንጉሥ ወደ መዓካ ልጅ ወደ አንኩስ ኰበለሉ፤ ሳሚንም። እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎችህ በጌት ናቸው ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.text_amharic: ሳሚም ተነሣ፥ አህያውንም ጭኖ ባሪያዎቹን ይሻ ዘንድ ወደ ጌት ወደ አንኩስ ዘንድ ሄደ፤ ሳሚም ሄዶ ባሪያዎቹን ከጌት አመጣ።

verses.text_english: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ሳሚ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ጌት ሄዶ እንደ ተመለሰ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word I have heard good.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ልኮ ሳሚን አስጠራና። ወዲህና ወዲያ ለመሄድ በወጣህ ቀን ፈጽመህ እንድትሞት እወቅ ብዬ በእግዚአብሔር አላስማልሁህምን? ወይስ አላስመሰከርሁብህምን? አንተም። ቃሉ መልካም ነው፥ ሰምቻለሁ አልኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን መሐላ እኔስ ያዘዝሁህን ትእዛዝ ስለ ምን አልጠበቅህም? አለው።

verses.text_english: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ሳሚን። አንተ በአባቴ በዳዊት ላይ የሠራኸውን ልብህም ያሰበውን ክፋት ሁሉ ታውቃለህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ክፋትህን በራስህ ላይ ይመልሳል።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ግን የተባረከ ይሆናል፥ የዳዊትም ዙፋን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም ይጸናል አለው።

verses.text_english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን አዘዘው፥ ወጥቶም ወደቀበት፥ ሞተም። መንግሥትም በሰሎሞን እጅ ጸና። a

verses.text_english: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ለግብጽ ንጉሥ ለፈርዖን አማች ሆነ፤ የፈርዖንን ልጅ አገባ፥ ቤቱንና የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ያለውን ቅጥር ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አመጣት።

verses.text_english: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
verses.text_amharic: እስከዚያም ቀን ድረስ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም መቅደስ አልተሠራም ነበርና ሕዝቡ በኮረብታ ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔርን ይወድድ ነበር፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ሥርዓት ይሄድ ነበር፤ ብቻ በኮረብታ መስገጃ ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.text_amharic: ገባዖን ዋና የኮረብታ መስገጃ ነበረችና ንጉሡ ይሠዋ ዘንድ ወደዚያ ሄደ፤ ሰሎሞንም በዚያ መሠዊያ ላይ አንድ ሺህ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።

verses.text_english: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በገባዖን ለሰሎሞን በሌሊት በሕልም ተገለጠለት፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ምን እንድሰጥህ ለምን አለ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም አለ። እርሱ በፊትህ በእውነትና በጽድቅ በልብም ቅንነት ከአንተ ጋር እንደ ሄደ፥ ከባሪያህ ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር ታላቅ ቸርነት አድርገሃል፤ ዛሬ እንደ ሆነም በዙፋኑ ላይ የሚቀመጥ ልጅ ሰጥተህ ታላቁን ቸርነትህን አቆይተህለታል።

verses.text_english: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I a little child: I know not to go out or come in.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ባሪያህን በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ አንግሠኸኛል፤ እኔም መውጫንና መግቢያን የማላውቅ ታናሽ ብላቴና ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And thy servant in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህም ያለው አንተ በመረጥኸው ሕዝብህ ስለ ብዛቱም ይቈጠርና ይመጠን ዘንድ በማይቻል በታላቅ ሕዝብ መካከል ነው።

verses.text_english: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በሕዝብህ ላይ መፍረድ ይችል ዘንድ፥ መልካሙንና ክፉውንም ይለይ ዘንድ ለባሪያህ አስተዋይ ልቡና ስጠው፤ አለዚያማ በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብህ ላይ ይፈድ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል?

verses.text_english: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ይህን ነገር ስለ ለመነ፥ ነገሩ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኘው።

verses.text_english: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ፍርድን ትለይ ዘንድ ለራስህ ማስተዋልን ለመንህ እንጂ ለራስህ ብዙ ዘመናትን ባለጠግነትንም የጠላቶችህንም ነፍስ ሳትለምን ይህን ነገር ለምነሃልና እነሆ፥

verses.text_english: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንደ ቃል አድርጌልሃለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ማንም የሚመስልህ ከአንተ በፊት እንደሌለ ከአንተም በኋላ እንዳይነሣ አድርጌ ጥበበኛና አስተዋይ ልቡና ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
