verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከነገሥታት የሚመስልህ ማንም እንዳይኖር ያልለመንኸውን ባለጠግነትና ክብር ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.text_amharic: አባትህም ዳዊት እንደ ሄደ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ትእዛዜን ትጠብቅ ዘንድ በመንገዴ የሄድህ እንደ ሆነ፥ ዕድሜህን አረዝመዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ነቃ፥ እነሆም፥ ሕልም ነበረ፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ቆመ፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አሳረገ፥ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ ለባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ ግብዣ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Then came there two women, harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ሁለት ጋለሞቶች ሴቶች ወደ ንጉሡ መጥተው በፊቱ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.text_amharic: አንደኛይቱም ሴት አለች። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እኔና ይህች ሴት በአንድ ቤት እንኖራለን፤ እኔም ከእርስዋ ጋር በቤት ሳለሁ ወለድሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we together; no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከወለድሁ ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ይህች ሴት ደግሞ ወለደች፤ እኛ በቤት ውስጥ አብረን ነበርን፥ ከሁለታችንም በቀር ማንም በቤት ውስጥ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በላዩ ስለ ተኛችበት የዚህች ሴት ልጅ በሌሊት ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በእኩለ ሌሊት ተነሥታ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ተኝቼ ሳለሁ፥ ልጄን ከአጠገቤ ወሰደች፥ በብብትዋም አደረገችው፥ የሞተውንም ልጅዋን በእኔ ብብት አደረገች።

verses.text_english: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄንም አጠባ ዘንድ በማለዳ ብነሣ፥ እነሆ፥ ሞቶ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ብርሃን በሆነ ጊዜ ተመለከትሁት፥ እነሆም፥ የወለድሁት ልጄ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living my son, and the dead thy son. And this said, No; but the dead thy son, and the living my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛይቱም ሴት። ደኅነኛው የኔ ልጅ ነው፥ የሞተውም የአንቺ ልጅ ነው እንጂ አንቺ እንደምትዪው አይደለም አለች። ይህችም። የሞተው የአንቺ ልጅ ነው፥ ደኅነኛውም የእኔ ልጅ ነው አለች፤ እንዲሁም በንጉሡ ፊት ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said the king, The one saith, This my son that liveth, and thy son the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son the dead, and my son the living.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ንጉሡ። ይህች። ደኅነኛው የእኔ ልጅ ነው፥ የሞተውም የአንቺ ልጅ ነው ትላለች፤ ያችኛይቱም። አይደለም፥ የሞተው የአንቺ ልጅ ነው ደኅነኛውም የእኔ ልጅ ነው ትላለች አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ሰይፍ አምጡልኝ አለ፤ ሰይፍም ይዘው ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ደኅነኛውን ሕፃን ለሁለት ከፍላችሁ ለአንዲቱ አንዱን ክፍል፥ ለሁለተኛይቱም ሁለተኛውን ክፍል ስጡ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then spake the woman whose the living child unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, divide .
verses.text_amharic: ደኅነኛውም የነበራት ሴት አንጀትዋ ስለ ልጅዋ ናፍቆአልና። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ደኀነኛውን ለእርስዋ ስጣት እንጂ አትግደል ብላ ለንጉሡ ተናገረች። ያችኛይቱ ግን። ይከፈል እንጂ ለእኔም ለአንቺም አይሁን አለች።

verses.text_english: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she the mother thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም መልሶ። ይህችኛይቱ እናቱ ናትና ደኅነኛውን ሕፃን ለእርስዋ ስጡአት እንጂ አትግደሉት አለ።

verses.text_english: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God in him, to do judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የፈረደውን ፍርድ እስራኤል ሁሉ ሰሙ፤ ፍርድን ለማድረግ የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ እንደ ነበረበት አይተዋልና ንጉሡን ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነግሦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And these the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.text_amharic: የነበሩትም አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የሳዶቅ ልጅ ካህኑ ዓዛርያስ፥

verses.text_english: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሐፊዎቹም የሴባ ልጆች ኤልያፍና አኪያ፥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሒሉድ ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥

verses.text_english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar the priests:
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ የሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ፤ ሳዶቅና አብያታርም ካህናት ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And Azariah the son of Nathan over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan principal officer, the king's friend:
verses.text_amharic: የናታንም ልጅ ዓዛርያስ የሹሞች አለቃ ነበረ፤ የናታንም ልጅ ዛቡድ የንጉሡ አማካሪና ወዳጅ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahishar over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda over the tribute.
verses.text_amharic: አሒሳርም የቤት አዛዥ፥ የዓብዳም ልጅ አዶኒራም አስገባሪ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡና ለቤተ ሰቡም ቀለብ የሚሰጡ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አሥራ ሁለት ሹሞች ለሰሎሞን ነበሩት። ከዓመቱ ውስጥ አንዱን ወር እያንዳንዳቸው ይቀልቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And these their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
verses.text_amharic: ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ በተራራማው አገር በኤፍሬም የሑር ልጅ፤

verses.text_english: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
verses.text_amharic: በማቃጽና በሸዓልቢም በቤትሳሚስና በኤሎንቤትሐናን የዴቀር ልጅ፤

verses.text_english: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
verses.text_amharic: በአሩቦት የሔሴድ ልጅ፥ ለእርሱም ሰኰትና የኦፌር አገር ሁሉ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.text_amharic: በዶር አገር ዳርቻ ሁሉ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ፥ እርሱም የሰሎሞንን ልጅ ጣፈትን አግብቶ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Baana the son of Ahilud; Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, unto beyond Jokneam:
verses.text_amharic: ከቤትሳን ጀምሮ እስከ አቤልምሖላና እስከ ዮቅምዓም ማዶ ድረስ በታዕናክና በመጊዶ በጸርታንም አጠገብ በኢይዝራኤል በታች ባለው በቤትሳን ሁሉ የአሒሉድ ልጅ በዓና ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which in Gilead; to him the region of Argob, which in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
verses.text_amharic: በሬማት ዘገለዓድ የጌበር ልጅ ነበረ፥ ለእርሱም በገለዓድ ያሉት የምናሴ ልጅ የኢያዕር መንደሮች ነበሩ፤ ለእርሱም ደግሞ በባሳን በአርጎብ ዳርቻ ያሉት ቅጥርና የናስ መወረወሪያዎች የነበረባቸው ስድሳ ታላላቅ ከተሞች ነበሩበት፤

verses.text_english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo Mahanaim:
verses.text_amharic: በመሃናይም የዒዶ ልጅ አሒናዳብ፤

verses.text_english: Ahimaaz in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.text_amharic: በንፍታሌም አኪማአስ ነበረ፥ እርሱም የሰሎሞንን ልጅ ባስማትን አግብቶ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Baanah the son of Hushai in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.text_amharic: በአሴርና በበዓሎት የኩሲ ልጅ በዓና፤

verses.text_english: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.text_amharic: በይሳኮር የፋሩዋ ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ፤

verses.text_english: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.text_amharic: በብንያም የኤላ ልጅ ሳሚ፤

verses.text_english: Geber the son of Uri in the country of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and the only officer which in the land.
verses.text_amharic: በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎንና በባሳን ንጉሥ በዐግ አገር፥ በገለዓድ አገር፥ የኡሪ ልጅ ጌበር ነበረ፤ በዚያችም ምድር ላይ እርሱ ብቻውን ሹም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Judah and Israel many, as the sand which by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳና እስራኤልም እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ብዛት ብዙ ነበሩ፤ በልተውም ጠጥተውም ደስ ብሎአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ከወንዙ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ዳርቻ እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ድረስ በመንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ነግሦ ነበር፤ ግብርም ያመጡለት ነበር፥ በዕድሜውም ሙሉ ለሰሎሞን ይገዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.text_amharic: ለሰሎሞንም ለቀን ለቀኑ ቀለብ የሚሆን ሠላሳ ኮር መልካም ዱቄትና ስድሳ ኮር መናኛ ድቄት፥

verses.text_english: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.text_amharic: ከዋላና ከሚዳቋ ከበረሀ ፍየልና ከሰቡ ወፎች በቀር አሥር ፍሪዳዎች ሀያም የተሰማሩ በሬዎች አንድ መቶም በጎች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: For he had dominion over all on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንዙ ወዲህ ባሉት ነገሥታት ሁሉ ከወንዙም ወዲህ ባለው አገር ሁሉ ላይ ከቲፍሳ ጀምሮ እስከ ጋዛ ድረስ ነግሦ ነበር፤ በዙሪያውም ባለው በሁሉ ወገን ሰላም ሆኖለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሎሞንም ዘመን ሁሉ ይሁዳና እስራኤል ከዳን ጀምሮ እስከ ቤርሳቤህ ድረስ እያንዳንዱ ከወይኑና ከበለሱ በታች ተዘልሎ ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰሎሞንም በአርባ ሺህ ጋጥ የሚገቡ የሰረገላ ፈረሶች አሥራ ሁለትም ሺህ ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ሹሞች እያንዳንዱ በየወሩ ንጉሡን ሰሎሞንንና ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን ማዕድ የሚቀርቡትን ሁሉ ይቀልቡ ነበር፤ ምንም አያጎድሉም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where were, every man according to his charge.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም እንደ ደንቡ ለፈረሶቹና ለሰጋር በቅሎች ገብስና ጭድ ወደ ስፍራቸው ያመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that on the sea shore.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለሰሎሞን እጅግ ብዙ ጥበብና ማስተዋል በባሕርም ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ የልብ ስፋት ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሎሞንም ጥበብ በምሥራቅ ካሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ጥበብና ከግብጽ ጥበብ ሁሉ በለጠ።

verses.text_english: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰውም ሁሉ ይልቅ ከኢይዝራኤላዊው ከኤታንና ከማሖል ልጆች ከሄማንና ከከልቀድ ከደራልም ይልቅ ጥበበኛ ነበረ። በዙሪያውም ባሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ዝናው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሦስት ሺህ ምሳሌዎች ተናገረ፤ መኃልዩም ሺህ አምስት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዛፍም ከሊባኖስ ዝግባ ጀምሮ በቅጥር ግንብ ላይ እስከሚበቅለው እስከ ሂሶጵ ድረስ ይናገር ነበር፤ ደግሞም ስለ አውሬዎችና ስለ ወፎች ሰለተንቀሳቃሾችና ስለ ዓሣዎች ይናገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ፥ ጥበቡንም ሰምተው ከነበሩ ከምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ለመስማት ሰዎች ይመጡ ነበር። a

verses.text_english: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.text_amharic: የጢሮስ ንጉሥ ኪራም ለዳዊት በዘመኑ ሁሉ ወዳጅ ስለ ነበረ፥ ሰሎሞን በአባቱ ፋንታ ንጉሥ ለመሆን እንደ ተቀባ ሰምቶ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ሰሎሞን ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ወደ ኪራም እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ።

verses.text_english: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከእግሩ በታች እስኪጥልለት ድረስ በዙሪያው ስለ ነበረ ሰልፍ አባቴ ዳዊት የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት እንዳልቻለ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር በዙሪያዬ ካሉት ዕረፍት ሰጥቶኛል፤ ጠላትም ክፉም ነገር የለብኝም።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር ለአባቴ ለዳዊት። በአንተ ፋንታ በዙፋንህ ላይ የማስቀምጠው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል ብሎ እንደ ነገረው፥ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት እሠራ ዘንድ አስባለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከወገኔ እንደ ሲዶናውያን እንጨት መቈረጥ የሚያውቅ እንደሌለ ታውቃለህና የዝግባ ዛፍ ከሊባኖስ ይቈርጡልኝ ዘንድ ባሪያዎችህን እዘዝ፤ ባሪያዎቼም ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሁኑ፤ የባሪያዎችህንም ዋጋ እንደ ተናገርኸው ሁሉ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም የሰሎሞንን ቃል ሰምቶ እጅግ ደስ አለውና። በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብ ላይ ጥበበኛ ልጅ ለዳዊት የሰጠ እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ ይመስገን አለ።

verses.text_english: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም። የላክህብኝን ሁሉ ሰማሁ፤ ስለ ዝግባውና ስለ ጥዱ እንጨት ፈቃድህን ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: My servants shall bring down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive : and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቼ ከሊባኖስ ወደ ባሕር ይጐትቱታል፤ እኔም በታንኳ አድርጌ በባሕር ላይ እያንሳፈፍሁ አንተ እስከ ወሰንኸው ስፍራ ድረስ አደርስልሃለሁ፥ በዚያም እፈታዋለሁ፥ አንተም ከዚያ ታስወስደዋለህ፤ አንተም ፈቃዴን ታደርጋለህ፤ ለቤቴም ቀለብ የሚሆነውን ትሰጠኛለህ ብሎ ወደ ሰሎሞን ላከ።

verses.text_english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees all his desire.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ኪራም የዝግባውንና የጥዱን እንጨት እንደሚሻው ያህል ሁሉ ለሰሎሞን ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ለኪራም ስለ ቤቱ ቀለብ ሀያ ሺ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ ሀያ ኮርም ጥሩ ዘይት ይሰጠው ነበር፤ ሰሎሞንም ለኪራም በየዓመቱ ይህን ይሰጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ነገረው ለሰሎሞን ጥበብን ሰጠው፤ በኪራምና በሰሎሞንም መካከል ሰላም ነበረ፤ ሁለቱም ቃል ኪዳን ተጋቡ።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ገባሮቹን መርጦ አወጣ፤ የገባሮቹም ቍጥር ሠላሳ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, two months at home: and Adoniram over the levy.
verses.text_amharic: በየወሩም እያከታተለ ወደ ሊባኖስ አሥር አሥር ሺህ ይሰድድ ነበር፤ አንድ ወርም በሊባኖስ ሁለት ወርም በቤታቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር። አዶኒራምም አስገባሪ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ሰባ ሺህ ተሸካሚዎች፥ ሰማንያ ሺህም በተራራው ላይ የሚጠርቡ ጠራቢዎች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም በሠራተኛው ሕዝብ ላይ ከተሾሙት ከሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ሌላ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ታላላቅ ምርጥ ምርጥ ድንጋዮችን ይቈፍሩና ይጠርቡ ዘንድ ለቤቱም መሠረት ይረበርቡት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew , and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሎሞንና የኪራምም አናጢዎች ጌባላውያንም ወቀሩአቸው፥ ቤቱንም ለመሥራት እንጨቱንና ድንጋዮቹን አዘጋጁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ከወጡ አራት መቶ ሰማንያ ዓመት በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ሰሎሞን በእስራኤል ላይ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ ዚፍ በሚባለው በሁለተኛው ወር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty , and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር የሠራው ቤት ርዝመቱ ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሠላሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; ten cubits the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደሱም ፊት ወለል ነበረ፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ መቅደሱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ከቤቱ ወደፊት አሥር ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.text_amharic: ለቤቱም በዓይነ ርግብ የተዘጉ መስኮቶች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, the walls of the house round about, of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም ግንብ ዙሪያ፥ በመቅደሱና በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ግንብ ዙሪያ፥ ደርብ ሠራ፥ በዙሪያውም ጓዳዎች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: The nethermost chamber five cubits broad, and the middle six cubits broad, and the third seven cubits broad: for without of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
verses.text_amharic: የታችኛውም ደርብ ወርዱ አምስት ክንድ፥ የመካከለኛው ደርብ ወርዱ ስድስት ክንድ፥ የሦስተኛውም ደርብ ወርዱ ሰባት ክንድ ነበረ። ሰረገሎቹ በቤቱ ግንብ ውስጥ እንዳይገቡ ከቤቱ ግንብ ውጭ ዓረፍቶች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱም በተሠራ ጊዜ ፈጽመው በተወቀሩ ድንጋዮች ተሠራ፤ በተሠራም ጊዜ መራጃና መጥረቢያ የብረትም ዕቃ ሁሉ በቤቱ ውስጥ አልተሰማም።

verses.text_english: The door for the middle chamber in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle , and out of the middle into the third.
verses.text_amharic: የታችኛውም ደርብ ጓዳዎች በር በቤቱ ቀኝ አጠገብ ነበረ። ከዚያም ወደ መካከለኛው ደርብ፥ ከመካከለኛውም ወደ ሦስተኛው ደርብ በመውጫ ያስወጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም ሠርቶ ፈጸመው፤ በዝግባው ሰረገሎችና ሳንቃዎች ከደነው።

verses.text_english: And he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house timber of cedar.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም ሁሉ ዙሪያ ቁመታቸው አምስት አምስት ክንድ የሆነ ደርቦች ሠራ፤ ከቤቱም ጋር በዝግባ እንጨት አጋጠማቸው።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ሰሎሞን መጣ እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.text_english: this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ስለምትሠራው ቤት በሥርዓቴ ብትሄድ፥ ፍርዴንም ብታደርግ፥ ትመላለስበትም ዘንድ ትእዛዜን ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ ለአባትህ ለዳዊት የነገርሁትን ቃል ከአንተ ጋር አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል እኖራለሁ፥ ሕዝቤንም እስራኤልን አልጥልም።

verses.text_english: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ቤቱን ሠራው፥ ፈጸመውም።

verses.text_english: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: he covered on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱንም ግንብ ውስጡን በዝግባ ሳንቃ ለበጠ፤ ከቤቱም መሠረት ጀምሮ እስከ ጣራው ድረስ ውስጡን በእንጨት ለበጠው፤ ደግሞም የቤቱን ወለል በጥድ እንጨት ከደነው።

verses.text_english: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built for it within, for the oracle, for the most holy .
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱ ውስጥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ይሆን ዘንድ ኋለኛውን ሀያውን ክንድ በዝግባ እንጨት ጋረደው።

verses.text_english: And the house, that , the temple before it, was forty cubits .
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ፊት ያለውም መቅደስ ርዝመቱ አርባ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the cedar of the house within carved with knops and open flowers: all cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱንም ውስጥ በተጐበጐበና በፈነዳ አበባ በተቀረጸ ዝግባ ለበጠው፤ ሁሉም ዝግባ ነበረ፤ ድንጋዩም አልታየም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ያኖር ዘንድ በቤቱ ውስጥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑን አበጀ።

verses.text_english: And the oracle in the forepart twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and covered the altar cedar.
verses.text_amharic: የቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ርዝመት ሀያ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ በጥሩ ወርቅም ለበጠው።

verses.text_english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት ከዝግባ የተሠራ መሠዊያ አደረገ፤ በጥሩ ወርቅም ለበጠው።

verses.text_english: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም ሁሉ ፈጽሞ በወርቅ ለበጠው፤ በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት የነበረውን መሠዊያ ሁሉ በወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.text_english: And within the oracle he made two cherubims olive tree, ten cubits high.
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ውስጥ ቁመታቸው አሥር ክንድ የሆነ ከወይራ እንጨት ሁለት ኪሩቤል ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And five cubits the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other ten cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የኪሩብም አንደኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ፥ የኪሩብም ሁለተኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤ ከአንደኛው ክንፍ ጫፍ ጀምሮ እስክ ሁለተኛው ክንፍ ጫፍ ድረስ አሥር ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the other cherub ten cubits: both the cherubims of one measure and one size.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ አሥር ክንድ ነበረ፤ ሁለቱም ኪሩቤል አንድ ልክና አንድ መልክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The height of the one cherub ten cubits, and so of the other cherub.
verses.text_amharic: የአንዱ ኪሩብ ቁመት አሥር ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ እንዲሁ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.text_amharic: ኪሩቤልንም በውስጠኛው ቤት አኖራቸው፤ የኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸው ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ የአንዱም ኪሩብ ክንፍ አንደኛውን ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፥ የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ሁለተኛውን ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፤ የሁለቱም ክንፎች በቤቱ መካከል እርስ በርሳቸው ይነካኩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.text_amharic: ኪሩቤልንም በወርቅ ለበጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም ግንብ ሁሉ ዙሪያ በውስጥና በውጭ የኪሩቤልና የዘንባባ ዛፍ የፈነዳም አበባ ምስል ቀረጸ።

verses.text_english: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱንም ወለል በውስጥና በውጭ በወርቅ ለበጠ።

verses.text_english: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors olive tree: the lintel side posts a fifth part .
verses.text_amharic: ለቅዱስተ ቅዱሳኑም መግቢያ ከወይራ እንጨት ደጆች ሠራ፤ መድረኩንና መቃኖቹን ደፉንም አምስት ማዕዘን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: The two doors also olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ደጆች ከወይራ እንጨት ሠራ፤ የኪሩቤልንና የዘንባባ ዛፍ የፈነዳም አበባ ምስል ቀረጸባቸው፥ በወርቅም ለበጣቸው፤ ኪሩቤልናና የዘንባባውን ዛፍ በወርቅ ለበጣቸው።

verses.text_english: So also made he for the door of the temple posts olive tree, a fourth part .
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ለመቅደሱ መግቢያ ከወይራ እንጨት አራት ማዕዘን መቃን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the two doors fir tree: the two leaves of the one door folding, and the two leaves of the other door folding.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱንም ደጆች ከጥድ እንጨት ሠራ፤ አንዱ ደጅ በማጠፊያ ከተያያዘ ከሁለት ሳንቃ ተደረገ፥ ሁለተኛውም ደጅ በማጠፊያ ከተያያዘ ከሁለት ሳንቃ ተደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he carved cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.text_amharic: የኪሩቤልንና የዘንባባ ዛፍ የፈነዳም አበባ ምስል ቀረጸባቸው፤ በተቀረጸውም ሥራ ላይ በወርቅ ለበጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.text_amharic: የውስጠኛውንም አደባባይ ቅጥር ሦስቱን ተራ በተጠረበ ድንጋይ፥ አንዱንም ተራ በዝግባ ሳንቃ ሠራው።

verses.text_english: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛው ዓመት ዚፍ በሚባል ወር የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተመሠረተ።

verses.text_english: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.text_amharic: በአሥራ አንደኛውም ዓመት ቡል በሚባል በስምንተኛው ወር ቤቱ እንደ ክፍሎቹና እንደ ሥርዓቱ ሁሉ ተጨረሰ። በሰባትም ዓመት ውስጥ ሠራው። a

verses.text_english: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የራሱን ቤት በአሥራ ሦስት ዓመት ሠራ፥ የቤቱንም ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።

verses.text_english: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.text_amharic: የሊባኖስ ዱር ቤት የሚባል ቤትን ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱንም መቶ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱንም አምሳ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱንም ሠላሳ ክንድ አደረገ፤ የዝግባም እንጨት በሦስት ተራ በተሠሩ አዕማድ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር፤ በአዕማዱም ላይ የዝግባ እንጨት አግዳሚ ሰረገሎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And covered with cedar above upon the beams, that on forty five pillars, fifteen a row.
verses.text_amharic: በአዕማዱም ላይ በነበሩ አግዳሚዎች ቤቱ በዝግባ ሳንቃ ተሸፍኖ ነበር፤ አዕማዱም በአንዱ ተራ አሥራ አምስት፥ በአንዱ ተራ አሥራ አምስት እየሆኑ አርባ አምስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And windows three rows, and light against light three ranks.
verses.text_amharic: መስኮቶቹም በሦስት ተራ ነበሩ፥ መስኮቶቹም ፊት ለፊት ይተያዩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the doors and posts square, with the windows: and light against light three ranks.
verses.text_amharic: ደጆቹና መስኮቶቹም ሁሉ አራት ማዕዘን ነበሩ፤ መስኮቶቹም በሦስት ተራ ሆነው ፊት ለፊት ይተያዩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch before them: and the pillars and the thick beam before them.
verses.text_amharic: አዕማዱም ያሉበቱን ቤት ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱም አምሳ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱም ሠላሳ ክንድ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ፊት ደግሞ አዕማድና መድረክ ያሉበት ወለል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, the porch of judgment: and covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም የሚፈርድበት ዙፋን ያለበትን የፍርድ ቤት አደረገ። ከወለሉም አንሥቶ እስከ ጣራው ድረስ በዝግባ እንጨት ተሸፍኖ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his house where he dwelt another court within the porch, was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken , like unto this porch.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍርድ ሰቀላ ወደ ውስጥ፥ በሌላውም አደባባይ ውስጥ የነበረውን መኖሪያ ቤት እንዲሁ ሠራ። እንደዚሁም ያለ ቤት ሰሎሞን ላገባት ለፈርዖን ልጅ ቤት ሠራ።

verses.text_english: All these costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and on the outside toward the great court.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሁሉ ከመሠረቱ ጀምሮ እስከ ጕልላቱ ድረስ በጥሩ በተጠረበና በውስጥና በውጭ በልክ በተከረከመ ድንጋይ ተሠርተው ነበር፤ በውጭውም እስከ ታላቁ አደባባይ ድረስ እንዲሁ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the foundation costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.text_amharic: መሠረቱም አሥር ወይም ስምንት ክንድ በሆነ በጥሩና በታላቅ ድንጋይ ተሠርቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And above costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.text_amharic: በላዩም ልክ ሆኖ የተከረከመ ጥሩ ድንጋይና የዝግባ ሳንቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the great court round about with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቁም አደባባይ ዙሪያ የነበረው ቅጥር እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ ቅጥርና እንደ ቤቱ ወለል ሦስቱ ተራ በተጠረበ ድንጋይ አንዱም ተራ በዝግባ ሳንቃ ተሠርቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ልኮ ኪራምን ከጢሮስ አስመጣ።

verses.text_english: He a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ከንፍታሌም ወገን የነበረች የባል አልባ ሴት ልጅ ነበረ፥ አባቱም የጢሮስ ሰው ናስ ሠራተኛ ነበረ፤ የናስንም ሥራ ሁሉ ይሠራ ዘንድ በጥበብና በማስተዋል በብልሃትም ተሞልቶ ነበር። ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ሰሎሞን መጥቶ ሥራውን ሁሉ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱን የናስ አዕማድ አደረገ፤ የአንዱም ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የዙሪያውም መጠን አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፤ የዓምዱም ውፍረት አንድ ጋት ነበረ፥ ውስጠ ክፍትም ነበረ። ሁለተኛውም ዓምድ እንዲሁ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he made two chapiters molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter five cubits:
verses.text_amharic: በሁለቱም አዕማድ ራስ ላይ እንዲቀመጡ ከፈሰሰ ናስ ሁለት ጕልላት ሠራ፤ የአንዱም ጕልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ፥ የሁለተኛውም ጕልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.text_amharic: በአዕማዱም ራስ ላይ የነበሩትን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ ሁለት እንደ መርበብ ሥራ አደረገ፤ አንዱም መርበብ ለአንዱ ጕልላት ሁለተኛውም መርበብ ለሁለተኛው ጕልላት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.text_amharic: ሮማኖችንም ሠራ፤ በአንድ ጕልላት ዙሪያ በተራ ሁለት መቶ ሮማኖች ነበሩ፥ በአንድም መርበብ ላይ ሁለት ተራ ነበረ፤ እንዲሁም ለሁለተኛው ጕልላት አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the chapiters that upon the top of the pillars of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በወለሉም አዕማድ በነበሩት ጕልላቶች ላይ የሱፍ አበባ የሚመስል ሥራ አራት ክንድ አድርጎ ቀረጸ።

verses.text_english: And the chapiters upon the two pillars also above, over against the belly which by the network: and the pomegranates two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለቱም አዕማድ በነበሩት ጕልላቶች ላይ በመርበቡ ሥራ አጠገብ ሮማኖቹን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.text_amharic: አዕማዱንም በመቅደሱ ወለል አጠገብ አቆማቸው፤ የቀኙንም ዓምድ አቁሞ ያቁም ብሎ ጠራው፤ የግራውንም ዓምድ አቁሞ በለዝ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And upon the top of the pillars lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.text_amharic: በአዕማዱም ራስ ላይ የሱፍ አበባ የሚመስል ሥራ ነበረ፤ እንዲሁም የአዕማዱ ሥራ ተጨረሰ።

verses.text_english: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: round all about, and his height five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሰሰም ናስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር አሥር ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ፥ በዙሪያውም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ ክብ ኵሬ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And under the brim of it round about knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.text_amharic: ከከንፈሩም በታች ለአንድ ክንድ አሥር ለአንድ ክንድም አሥር ጉብጉቦች አዞረበት፤ እርሱም በቀለጠ ጊዜ ጉብጉቦቹ በሁለት ተራ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ቀልጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea above upon them, and all their hinder parts inward.
verses.text_amharic: ኵሬውም በአሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ምስል ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ሦስቱ ወደ ሰሜን፥ ሦስቱም ወደ ምዕራብ፥ ሦስቱም ወደ ደቡብ፥ ሦስቱም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከቱ ነበር። ኵሬውም በላያቸው ነበረ፥ የሁሉም ጀርባቸው በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.text_amharic: ውፍረቱም አንድ ጋት ነበረ፤ ከንፈሩም እንደ ጽዋ ከንፈር ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ እንደ ሱፍ አበባዎች ሆኖ ተከርክሞ ነበር። ሁለት ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ይይዝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.text_amharic: አሥርም የናስ መቀመጫዎች ሠራ፤ የአንዱም መቀመጫ ርዝመት አራት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አራት ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሦስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the work of the bases on this : they had borders, and the borders between the ledges:
verses.text_amharic: የመቀመጫውም ሥራ እንዲህ ነበረ፤ በክፈፎችም መካከል ያለው ሰንበር ይመስል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And on the borders that between the ledges lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen certain additions made of thin work.
verses.text_amharic: በክፈፎቹም መካከል በነበሩ ሰንበሮች ላይ አንበሳዎችና በሬዎች ኪሩቤልም ነበሩ፤ እንዲሁም በክፈፎቹ ላይ ነበረ፤ ከአንበሳዎቹና ከበሬዎቹ በታች ሻኵራ የሚመስል ተንጠልጥሎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.text_amharic: በየመቀመጫዎቹም ሁሉ አራት የናስ መንኰራኵሮች ነበሩባቸ፤ መንኰራኵሮቹም የሚዞሩበትን የናስ ወስከምት ሠራ፤ ከመታጠቢያውም ሰን በታች በአራቱ ማዕዘን በኩል አራት በምስል የፈሰሱ እግሮች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above a cubit: but the mouth thereof round the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.text_amharic: በክፈፉም ውስጥ የነበረ አንገት አንድ ክንድ ነበረ፤ አንገቱም ድቡልቡል ነበረ፥ ቁመቱም ክንድ ተኩል ነበረ። በአንገቱም ላይ ቅርጽ ነበረበት፤ ክፈፉ ግን አራት ማዕዘን ነበረ እንጂ ድቡልቡል አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And under the borders four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels to the base: and the height of a wheel a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.text_amharic: አራቱም መንኰራኵሮች ከሰንበሮቹ በታች ነበሩ፤ የመንኰራኵሮቹም ወስከምት በመቀመጫው ውስጥ ነበረ፤ የመንኰራኵሩም ቁመት ክንድ ተኩል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the work of the wheels like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, all molten.
verses.text_amharic: የመንኰራኵሮቹም ሥራ እንደ ሰረገላ መንኰራኵር ነበረ፥ ወስከምቶቹና የመንኰራኵሮቹ ክፈፍ ቅትርቶቹም ወስከምቱም የሚገባበት ቧምቧ ሁሉ በምስል የፈሰሰ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And four undersetters to the four corners of one base: the undersetters of the very base itself.
verses.text_amharic: በእያንዳንዱም መቀመጫ በአራቱ ማዕዘን በኩል አራት ደገፋዎች ነበሩ፤ ደገፋዎቹም ከመቀመጫው ጋር ተገጥመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in the top of the base a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof of the same.
verses.text_amharic: በመቀመጫውም ላይ ስንዝር የሚሆን ድቡልቡል ነገር ነበረ፤ በመቀመጫውም ላይ የነበሩ መያዣዎችና ሰንበሮች ከእርሱ ጋር ይጋጠሙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
verses.text_amharic: በመያዣውና በሰንበሮቹ ላይ ኪሩቤልንና አንበሳዎችን የዘንባባውንም ዛፍ እንደ መጠናችው ቀረጸ፥ በዙሪያውም ሻኵራ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: After this he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, one size.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ አሥሩን መቀመጫዎች ሠራ፤ ሁሉም በምስልና በመጠን በንድፍም ትክክሎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: every laver was four cubits: upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.text_amharic: አሥሩንም የናስ መታጠቢያ ሰን ሠራ፤ አንዱ መታጠቢያ ሰን አርባ የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ያነሣ ነበር፤ እያንዳንዱም መታጠቢያ ሰን አራት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በአሥሩም መቀመጫዎች ላይ በእያንዳንዱ አንድ አንድ መታጠቢያ ሰን ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱንም መቀመጫዎች በቤቱ ቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በቤቱ ግራ አኖራቸው፤ ኵሬውንም በቤቱ ቀኝ በአዜብ በኩል አኖረው።

verses.text_english: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም ምንችቶችንና መጫሪያዎችን ድስቶችንም ሠራ፤ ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።

verses.text_english: The two pillars, and the bowls of the chapiters that on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which upon the top of the pillars;
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም አዕማድ፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ኩብ የሚመስሉትን ጕልላቶች፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች የሚሸፍኑትን ሁለቱን መርበቦች፥

verses.text_english: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that upon the pillars;
verses.text_amharic: በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ ለእያንዳንዱ መርበብ በሁለት በሁለት ተራ አድርጎ ለሁለቱ መርበቦች አራት መቶ ሮማኖች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
verses.text_amharic: አሥሩንም መቀመጫዎች፥ በመቀመጫዎችም ላይ የሚቀመጡትን አሥሩን መታጠቢያ ሰን፥

verses.text_english: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.text_amharic: አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከኵሬውም በታች የሚሆኑትን አሥራ ሁለቱን በሬዎች፥

verses.text_english: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, bright brass.
verses.text_amharic: ምንቸቶቹንም፥ መጫሪያዎቹንም፥ ድስቶቹንም አደረገ። ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራው ይህ ዕቃ ሁሉ የጋለ ናስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
verses.text_amharic: በዮርዳኖስ ሜዳ በሱኮትና በጸርታን መካከል ባለው በወፍራሙ መሬት ውስጥ አስፈሰሰው።

verses.text_english: And Solomon left all the vessels , because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ዕቃውን ሁሉ ሳያስመዝን አኖረ፤ የናሱም ሚዛን ከብዛቱ የተነሣ አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon made all the vessels that unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread ,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አሠራ፤ የወርቁን መሠዊያ፥ የገጹም ኅብስት የነበረበትን የወርቅ ገበታ፥

verses.text_english: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right , and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs gold,
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ፊት አምስቱ በቀኝ አምስቱም በግራ የሚቀመጡትን ከጥሩ ወርቅ የተሠሩትንም መቅረዞች፥ የወርቁንም አበባዎችና ቀንዲሎች መኰስተሪያዎችም፥

verses.text_english: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers pure gold; and the hinges gold, for the doors of the inner house, the most holy for the doors of the house, , of the temple.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥሩ ወርቅም የተሠሩትን ጽዋዎችና ጕጠቶች፥ ድስቶቹንና ጭልፋዎቹንም፥ ማንደጃዎቹንም፥ ለውስጠኛውም ቤት ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ደጆች ለቤተ መቅደሱም ደጆች የሚሆኑትን የወርቅ ማጠፊያዎች አሠራ።

verses.text_english: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ያሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ተፈጸመ። አባቱም ዳዊት የቀደሰውን፥ ብርና ወርቅ ዕቃም፥ ሰሎሞን አገባ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ውስጥ በነበሩ ግምጃ ቤቶች አኖረው።

verses.text_english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ከዳዊት ከተማ ከጽዮን ያወጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎችና የነገድ አለቆችን ሁሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶች መሳፍንት፥ ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ወዳለበት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.text_english: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which the seventh month.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ኤታኒም በሚባል በሰባተኛው ወር በበዓሉ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን ተከማቹ።

verses.text_english: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ፤ ካህናቱም ታቦቱን አነሡ።

verses.text_english: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ የነበረውን የተቀደሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አመጡ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰበሰቡ የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር በታቦቱ ፊት ሆነው፥ ከብዛታቸው የተነሣ የማይቈጠሩትንና የማይመጠኑትን በጎችና በሬዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy under the wings of the cherubims.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በቤቱ በቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ውስጥ ከኪሩቤል ክንፍ በታች ወደ ነበረው ወደ ስፍራው አመጡት።

verses.text_english: For the cherubims spread forth two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.text_amharic: ኪሩቤልም በታቦቱ ስፍራ ላይ ክንፎቻቸውን ዘርግተው ነበር፤ ኪሩቤልም ታቦቱንና መሎጊያዎቹን በስተ ላይ በኩል ሸፍነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: መሎጊያዎቹም ረጃጅሞች ነበሩ፤ በቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ፊት ከመቅደሱ ውስጥ ጫፎቻቸው ይታዩ ነበር፤ በውጭ ያለ ግን አያያቸውም ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በዚያ አሉ።

verses.text_english: nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በታቦቱም ውስጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ባደረገ ጊዜ፥ ሙሴ በኮሬብ ካስቀመጣቸው ከሁለቱ የድንጋይ ጽላቶች በቀር ምንም አልነበረበትም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy , that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም ከመቅደሱ በመጡ ጊዜ ደመናው የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞላው።

verses.text_english: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶ ነበርና ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ ለማገልገል ይቆሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም። እግዚአብሔር። በጨለማው ውስጥ እኖራለሁ ብሎአል፤

verses.text_english: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ለዘላለም የምትኖርበት ማደሪያ ቤት በእውነት ሠራሁልህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ፊቱን ዘወር አድርጎ የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ መረቀ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said, Blessed the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled , saying,

Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አባቴም ዳዊት ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አባቴን ዳዊትን። ለስሜ ቤት ትሠራ ዘንድ በልብህ አስበሃልና ይህን በልብህ ማሰብህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከወገብህ የሚወጣው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል እንጂ ቤት የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም አለው።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረውን ቃል አጸና፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠ በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ ተነሣሁ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ሠራሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽም ምድር ባወጣቸው ጊዜ ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ያደረገው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ላለበት ታቦት ስፍራ በዚያ አደረግሁለት።

verses.text_english: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ እያዩ ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ቆሞ እጆቹን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ፥ በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አንተን የሚመስል አምላክ የለም፤ በፍጹም ልባቸው በፊትህ ለሚሄዱ ባሪያዎችህ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥

verses.text_english: And he said, LORD God of Israel, no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸውን ተስፋ የጠበቅህ፤ በአፍህ ተናገርህ፥ እንደ ዛሬው ቀንም በእጅህ ፈጸምኸው።

verses.text_english: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled with thine hand, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ። አንተ በፊቴ እንደ ሄድህ ልጆችህ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ፥ በእስራኤል ዙፋን የሚቀመጥ ሰው በፊቴ አታጣም ብለህ ተስፋ የሰጠኸውን ለአባቴ ለዳዊት ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የተናገርኸው ቃል፥ እባክህ፥ ይጽና።

verses.text_english: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ጋር በምድር ላይ ይኖራልን? እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ከሰማያትም በላይ ያለው ሰማይ ይይዝህ ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ይልቁንስ እኔ የሠራሁት ቤት እንዴት ያንስ!

verses.text_english: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያህ ጸሎትና ልመና ተመልከት፥ ዛሬም ባሪያህ በፊትህ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎትና ጥሪውን ስማ፤

verses.text_english: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ። በዚያ ስሜ ይሆናል ወዳልኸው ስፍራ ወደዚህ ቤት ዓይኖችህ ሌሊትና ቀን የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህና ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልዩትን ልመና ስማ፤ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ ሰምተህም ይቅር በል።

verses.text_english: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ባልንጀራውን ቢበድል፥ በላዩም መሐላ ቢጫን፥ እርሱም መጥቶ በዚህ ቤት በመሠዊያህ ፊት ቢምል፥

verses.text_english: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይ ስማ አድርግም፤ በባሪያዎችህም ላይ ዳኛ ሁን፤ በበደለኛውም ላይ ፍረድ፥ መንገዱንም በራሱ ላይ መልስበት፤ ንጹሑን አጽድቀው፥ እንደ ጽድቁም ክፈለው።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህ እስራኤል አንተን ስለ በደሉ በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት ድል በተመቱ ጊዜ፥ ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ በዚህም ቤት ቢጸልዩና ቢለምኑህ፥

verses.text_english: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የሕዝብህንም የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፥ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠሃት ምድር መልሳቸው።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ስለ በደሉ ሰማይ በተዘጋ ጊዜ ዝናብም ባልዘነበ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚህ ስፍራ ቢጸልዩ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ ባስጨነቅሃቸውም ጊዜ ከኃጢአታቸው ቢመለሱ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፤

verses.text_english: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
verses.text_amharic: የሚሄዱበትንም መልካም መንገድ በማሳየት የባሪያዎችህንና የሕዝብህን የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፤ ለሕዝብህም ርስት አድርገህ ለሰጠሃት ምድር ዝናብ ስጥ።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ራብ፥ ወይም ቸነፈር፥ ወይም ዋግ፥ ወይም አረማሞ፥ ወይም አንበጣ፥ ወይም ኩብኩባ ቢሆን፥ የሕዝብህም ጠላት የአገሩን ቀበሌዎች ከብቦ ቢያስጨንቃቸው፥ መቅሠፍትና ደዌ ሁሉ ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness ;
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም ሰው የልቡን ሕመም አውቆ ጸሎትና ልመና ቢጸልይ፥ እጆቹንም ወደዚህ ቤት ቢዘረጋ፥

verses.text_english: What prayer and supplication soever be by any man, by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Moreover concerning a stranger, that not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህም ጠላቶቻቸውን ለመውጋት አንተ በምትልካቸው መንገድ ቢወጡ፥ አንተም ወደ መረጥሃት ከተማ እኔም ለስምህ ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ለእግዚአብሔር ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.text_english: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው።

verses.text_english: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
verses.text_amharic: የማይበድልም ሰው የለምና አንተን ቢበድሉ፥ ተቈጥተህም ለጠላቶቻቸው አሳልፈህ ብትሰጣቸው ሩቅ ወይም ቅርብ ወደ ሆነ ወደ ጠላቶች አገር ቢማረኩም፥

verses.text_english: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and the house that I have built for thy name:
verses.text_amharic: በተማረኩበትም አገር ሆነው በልባቸው ንስሐ ቢገቡ፥ በማራኪዎቹም አገር ሳሉ ተመልሰው። ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፥ በድለንማል፥ ክፉንም አድርገናል ብለው ቢለምኑህ፥

verses.text_english: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.text_amharic: በማረኩአቸው በጠላቶቻቸው አገር ሳሉ በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠሃት ወደ ምድራቸው ወደ መረጥሃትም ከተማ ለስምህም ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.text_english: If they sin against thee, (for no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፥

verses.text_english: if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው፥ አንተንም የበደሉህን ሕዝብህን፥ በአንተም ላይ ያደረጉትን በደላቸውን ሁሉ ይቅር በል፤ ይራሩላቸውም ዘንድ በማረኩአቸው ፊት ምሕረት ስጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ ምድር ከብረት እቶን ውስጥ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህና ርስትህ ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
verses.text_amharic: በጠሩህ ጊዜ ሁሉ ትሰማቸው ዘንድ ለባሪያህና ለሕዝብህ ለእስራኤል ልመና ዓይኖችህ የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አባቶቻችንን ከግብጽ ባወጣህ ጊዜ በባሪያህ በሙሴ እጅ እንደ ተናገርህ ርስት ይሆኑህ ዘንድ ከምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለይተሃቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: For they thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ይህችን ጸሎትና ልመና ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጸልዮ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጕልበቱ ተንበርክኮ እጁንም ወደ ሰማይ ዘርግቶ ነበርና ከእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቆሞም የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ በታላቅ ድምፅ ሲመርቅ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.text_english: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተናገረው ተስፋ ሁሉ ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ዕረፍትን የሰጠ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን፤ በባሪያው በሙሴ ከሰጠው ከመልካም ተስፋ ሁሉ አንድ ቃል አልወደቀም።

verses.text_english: And it was , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ከአባቶቻችን ጋር እንደ ነበረ ከእኛ ጋር ይሁን፤ አይተወን፥ አይጣለንም፤

verses.text_english: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በመንገዱም ሁሉ እንሄድ ዘንድ፥ ለአባቶቻችንም ያዘዛትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ትእዛዙንም እንጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ ልባችንን ወደ እርሱ ያዘነብል ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያውና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል በየዕለቱ ፍርድን ያደርግ ዘንድ ይህች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የለመንኋት ቃል በቀንና በሌሊት ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር የቀረበች ትሁን፤

verses.text_english: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
verses.text_amharic: የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከእርሱም በቀር ሌላ እንደሌለ ያውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ዛሬው ቀን በሥርዓቱ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንም ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ልባችሁ ፍጹም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መሥዋዕት ሠዉ።

verses.text_english: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD God, none else.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዋ ዘንድ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ በሬዎችና መቶ ሀያ ሺህ በጎች አቀረበ። ንጉሡና የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቀደሱ።

verses.text_english: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለው የናሱ መሠዊያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቁርባን የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ስብ ይይዝ ዘንድ ታናሽ ስለ ነበረ፥ በዚያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ስብ አሳርጎአልና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የአደባባዩ መካከል ንጉሡ በዚያ ቀን ቀደሰ።

verses.text_english: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ ያለው ታላቅ ጉባኤ፥ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሰባት ቀን በዓሉን አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሕዝቡን አሰናበተ፤ እነርሱም ንጉሡን መረቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለባሪያው ለዳዊትና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ሁሉ በልባቸው ተደስተው ሐሤትም አድርገው ወደ ስፍራቸው ሄዱ። a

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት፥ የንጉሡን ቤትና ሰሎሞን የወደደውን የልቡን አሳብ ሁሉ ሠርቶ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በገባዖን ለሰሎሞን እንደ ተገለጠለት ዳግመኛ ተገለጠለት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። በፊቴ የጸለይኸውን ጸሎትህንና ልመናህን ሰምቻለሁ፤ ለዘላለምም ስሜ በዚያ ያድር ዘንድ ይህን የሠራኸውን ቤት ቀድሻለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼና ልቤም በዘመኑ ሁሉ በዚያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም አባትህ በየዋህ ልብና በቅንነት እንደ ሄደ አንተ ደግሞ በፊቴ ብትሄድ፥ ያዘዝሁህንም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዓቴንም ፍርዴንም ብትጠብቅ፥

verses.text_english: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ። ከእስራኤል ዙፋን ከዘርህ ሰው አታጣም ብዬ ለአባትህ ለዳዊት እንደ ተናገርሁ፥ የመንግሥትህን ዙፋን በእስራኤል ላይ ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተና ልጆቻችሁ ግን እኔን ከመከትል ብትመለሱ፥ የሰጠኋችሁንም ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ባትጠብቁ፥ ሄዳችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት ብታመልኩ፥ ብትሰግዱላቸውም፥

verses.text_english: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልን ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር አጠፋቸዋለሁ፤ ለስሜም የቀደስሁትን ይህን ቤት ከፊቴ እጥለዋለሁ፤ እስራኤልም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ምሳሌና ተረት ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And at this house, is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ የነበረውም ይህ ቤት ባድማ ይሆናል፤ በዚያም የሚያልፍ ሁሉ እያፍዋጨ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህ አገርና በዚህ ቤት ስለምን እንዲህ አደረገ? ብሎ ይደነቃል።

verses.text_english: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
verses.text_amharic: መልሰውም። ከግብጽ ምድር አባቶቻቸውን ያወጣውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ሌሎችንም አማልክት ስለ ተከተሉ፥ ስለ ሰገዱላቸውም፥ ስለ አመለኩአቸውም፥ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣባቸው ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king's house,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት ሁለቱን ቤቶች የሠራበት ሀያ ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: ( Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን በገሊላ ምድር ያሉትን ሀያ ከተሞች ለኪራም ሰጠው። የጢሮስም ንጉሥ ኪራም የሚሻውን ያህል የዝግባና የጥድ እንጨት የሚሻውንም ያህል ወርቅ ሁሉ ለሰሎሞን ሰጥቶት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም ሰሎሞን የሰጠውን ከተሞች ያይ ዘንድ ከጢሮስ ወጣ፤ ደስም አላሰኙትም።

verses.text_english: And he said, What cities these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ የሰጠኸኝ እነዚህ ከተሞች ምንድር ናቸው? አለ። እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የከቡል አገር ተብለው ተጠሩ።

verses.text_english: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም መቶ ሀያ መክሊት ወርቅ ለንጉሡ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And this the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የራሱን ቤት፥ ሚሎንም፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር፥ ሐጾርንም፥ መጊዶንም፥ ጌዝርንም ይሠራ ዘንድ ገባሮችን መልምሎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽም ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ወጥቶ ጌዝርን ይዞ ነበር፥ በእሳትም አቃጥሎ ነበር፥ በከተማም የኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ገድሎ ነበር፤ ለልጁም ለሰሎምን ሚስት ትሎት አድርጎ ሰጥቶአት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ጌዝርን፥ የታችኛውንም ቤት

verses.text_english: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.text_amharic: ሖሮን፥ ባዕላትንም፥ በምድረ በዳም አገር ያለችውን ተድሞርን፥

verses.text_english: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰሎሞንም የነበሩትን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የሰረገላውንም ከተሞች፥ የፈረሰኞችንም ከተሞች፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሊባኖስም በመንግሥቱም ምድር ሁሉ ሰሎሞን ይሠራ ዘንድ የወደደውን ሁሉ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: all the people left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which not of the children of Israel,
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ዘንድ ያልነበሩትን ከአሞራውያንና ከኬጢያውያን፥ ከፌርዛውያን፥ ከኤዊያውያንና ከኢያቡሳውያን የቀሩትን፥

verses.text_english: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያጠፉአቸው ዘንድ ያልቻሉትን፥ በኋላቸው የቀሩትን ልጆቻቸውን፥ ሰሎሞን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ገባሮች አድርጎ መለመላቸው።

verses.text_english: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ማንንም ባሪያ አላደረገም፤ እነርሱ ግን ሰልፈኞች፥ ሎሌዎችም፥ መሳፍንትም፥ አለቆችም፥ የሰረገሎችና የፈረሶች ባልደራሶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the chief of the officers that over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በሚሠራው ሥራ ላይ ሠራተኛውን ሕዝብ የሚያዝዙ አለቆች አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ልጅ ከዳዊት ከተማ ሰሎሞን ወደ ሠራላት ወደ ቤትዋ ወጣች በዚያን ጊዜም ሚሎን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that before the LORD. So he finished the house.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በየዓመቱ ሦስት ጊዜ የሚቃጠለውንና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር በሠራው መሠዊያ ላይ ያሳርግ ነበር፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ ዕጣን ያሳርግ ነበር፤ ቤቱንም ጨረሰ።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በኤዶምያስ ምድር በኤርትራ ባሕር ዳር በኤሎት አጠገብ ባለችው በዔጽዮንጋብር መርከቦችን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም በእነዚያ መርከቦች ከሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ጋር የባሕሩን ነገር የሚያውቁ መርከበኞች ባሪያዎቹን ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought to king Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኦፊርም መጡ፥ ከዚያም አራት መቶ ሀያ መክሊተ ወርቅ ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ሰሎሞን ይዘው መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.text_amharic: የሳባም ንግሥት በእግዚአብሔር ስም የወጣለትን የሰሎሞንን ዝና በሰማች ጊዜ በእንቆቅልሽ ትፈትነው ዘንድ መጣች።

verses.text_english: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.text_amharic: በግመሎችም ላይ ሽቱና እጅግ ብዙ ወርቅ የከበረም ዕንቍ አስጭና ከታላቅ ጓዝ ጋር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ገባች፤ ወደ ሰሎሞንም በመጣች ጊዜ በልብዋ ያለውን ሁሉ አጫወተችው።

verses.text_english: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የጠየቀችውን ሁሉ ፈታላት፤ ሊፈታላት ያልቻለውና ከንጉሡ የተሰወረ ነገር አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.text_amharic: የሳባም ንግሥት የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ሁሉ፥ ሠርቶትም የነበረውን ቤት፥

verses.text_english: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.text_amharic: የማዕዱንም መብል፥ የብላቴኖቹንም አቀማመጥ፥ የሎሌዎቹንም አሠራር አለባበሳቸውንም፥ ጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹንም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የሚያሳርገውን መሥዋዕት ባየች ጊዜ ነፍስ አልቀረላትም።

verses.text_english: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም አለችው። ስለ ነገርህና ስለ ጥበብህ በአገሬ ሳለሁ የሰማሁት ዝና እውነት ነው።

verses.text_english: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen : and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም መጥቼ በዓይኔ እስካይ ድረስ የነገሩኝን አላመንሁም ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ እኩሌታውን አልነገሩኝም ነበር፤ ጥበብህና ሥራህ ከሰማሁት ዝና ይበልጣል።

verses.text_english: Happy thy men, happy these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, that hear thy wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: በፊትህ ሁልጊዜ የሚቆሙ ጥበብህንም የሚሰሙ ሰዎችህና እነዚህ ባሪያዎችህ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን የወደደ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ያስቀመጠህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የተባረከ ይሁን፤ እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ወድዶታልና ስለዚህ ጽድቅና ፍርድ ታደርግ ዘንድ ንጉሥ አድርጎ አስነሣህ።

verses.text_english: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡም መቶ ሀያ መክሊት ወርቅ እጅግም ብዙ ሽቱ የከበረም ዕንቍ ሰጠችው፤ የሳባ ንግሥት ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እንደ ሰጠችው ያለ የሽቱ ብዛት ከዚያ ወዲያ አልመጣም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
verses.text_amharic: ከኦፊርም ወርቅ ያመጡ የኪራም መርከቦች እጅግ ብዙ የሰንደል እንጨትና የከበረ ዕንቍ ከኦፊር አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከሰንደሉ እንጨት ለእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ለንጉሡ ቤት መከታ፥ ለመዘምራኑም መሰንቆና በገና አደረገ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እንደዚያ ያለ የሰንደል እንጨት ከቶ አልመጣም አልታየምም።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን፥ በገዛ እጁ ከሰጣት ሌላ፥ የወደደችውን ሁሉ ከእርሱም የለመነችውን ሁሉ ለሳባ ንግሥት ሰጣት፤ እርስዋም ተመልሳ ከባሪያዎችዋ ጋር ወደ ምድርዋ ሄደች።

verses.text_english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
Beside of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ሁለት መቶ አላበሽ አግሬ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ ውስጥ የገባው ወርቅ ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And king Solomon made two hundred targets beaten gold: six hundred of gold went to one target.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥፍጥፍም ወርቅ ሦስት መቶ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም ጋሻ የገባው ወርቅ ሦስት ምናን ነበረ፤ ንጉሡም የሊባኖስ ዱር በተባለው ቤት ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And three hundred shields beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ከዝሆን ጥርስ ታላቅ ዙፋን አሠራ፥ በጥሩም ወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.text_english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዙፋንም የሚያስሄዱ ስድስት እርከኖች ነበሩ፤ በስተ ኋላውም ያለው የዙፋኑ ራስ ክብ ነበረ፤ በዚህና በዚያ በመቀመጫው አጠገብ ሁለት የክንድ መደገፊያዎች ነበሩበት፥ በመደገፊያዎቹም አጠገብ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne round behind: and stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
verses.text_amharic: በስድስቱም እርከኖች ላይ በዚህና በዚያ አሥራ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር፤ በመንግሥታት ሁሉ እንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አልተሠራም።

verses.text_english: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የሚጠጣበት ዕቃ ሁሉ ወርቅ ነበረ፥ የሊባኖስ ዱር የተባለውም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ ጥሩ ወርቅ እንጂ ብር አልነበረም። በሰሎሞን ዘመን ብር ከቶ አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon pure gold; none silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡም ከኪራም መርከቦች ጋር የተርሴስ መርከቦች ነበሩት፤ በሦስት በሦስት ዓመትም አንድ ጊዜ የተርሴስ መርከቦች ወርቅና ብር፥ የዝሆንም ጥርስ፥ ዝንጀሮና ዝንጕርጕር ወፍ ይዘው ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በባለጠግነትና በጥበብ ከምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ በልጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በልቡ ያኖረለትን ጥበቡን ይሰማ ዘንድ የሰሎሞንን ፊት ይመኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም እያንዳንዱ በዓመቱ በዓመቱ ገጸ በረከቱን፥ የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ፥ ልብስና የጦር መሣሪያ፥ ሽቱም፥ ፈረሶችና በቅሎች እየያዘ ይመጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን ሰበሰበ፤ አንድ ሺህ አራት መቶ ሰረገሎች፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፥ በሰረገሎችም ከተሞች ከንጉሡም ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ብሩን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he as the sycomore trees that in the vale, for abundance.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ፈረሶችን ከግብጽና ከቀዌ አገር አስመጣ፤ የንጉሡም ነገዴዎች በገንዘብ እየገዙ ከቀዌ ያመጡአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ሰረገላ በስድስት መቶ፥ አንዱም ፈረስ በመቶ አምሳ ብር ከግብጽ ይወጣ ነበር። እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያንና ለሶርያ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእጃቸው ያወጡላቸው ነበር። a

verses.text_english: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, Hittites;
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከፈርዖን ልጅ ሌላ፥ በሞዓባውያንና በአሞናውያን በኤዶማውያን በሲዶናውያንና በኬጢያውያን ሴቶች፥ በብዙ እንግዶች ሴቶች ፍቅር ተነደፈ።

verses.text_english: Of the nations which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች። አምላኮቻቸውን ትከተሉ ዘንድ ልባችሁን በእውነት ያዘነብላሉና ወደ እነርሱ አትግቡ፥ እነርሱም ወደ እናንተ አይግቡ ካላቸው ከአሕዛብ፥ ከእነዚህ ጋር ሰሎሞን በፍቅር ተጣበቀ።

verses.text_english: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም ወይዛዝር የሆኑ ሰባት መቶ ሚስቶች ሦስት መቶም ቁባቶች ነበሩት፤ ሚስቶቹም ልቡን አዘነበሉት።

verses.text_english: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ሲሸመግል ሚስቶቹ ሌሎችን አማልክት ይከተል ዘንድ ልቡን አዘነበሉት፤ የአባቱ የዳዊት ልብ ከአምላኩ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፍጹም እንደ ነበረ የሰሎሞን ልቡ እንዲሁ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የሲዶናውያንን አምላክ አስታሮትን፥ የአሞናውያንንም ርኵሰት ሚልኮምን፥ ተከተለ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as David his father.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገርን አደረገ፥ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን በመከተል ፍጹም አልሆነም።

verses.text_english: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን ለሞዓብ ርኵሰት ለካሞሽ፥ ለአሞንም ልጆች ርኵሰት ለሞሎክ በኢየሩሳሌም ፊት ለፊት ባለው ተራራ ላይ መስገጃ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.text_amharic: ለአማልክቶቻቸው ዕጣን ለሚያጥኑ መሥዋዕትም ለሚሠዉ ለእንግዶች ሚስቶቹ ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን አለው። ይህን ሠርተሃልና፥ ያዘዝሁህንም ቃል ኪዳኔንና ሥርዓቴን አልጠበቅህምና መንግሥትህን ከአንተ ቀዳድጄ ለባሪያህ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከልጅህ እጅ እቀድደዋለሁ እንጂ ስለ አባትህ ስለ ዳዊት ይህን በዘመንህ አላደርግም።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ዳዊትና ስለ መረጥኋት ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ለልጅህ አንድ ነገድ እሰጣለሁ እንጂ መንግሥቱን ሁሉ አልቀድድም።

verses.text_english: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከኤዶምያስ ነገሥታት ዘር የኤዶምያስን ሰው ሃዳድን ጠላት አድርጎ በሰሎሞን ላይ አስነሣው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he of the king's seed in Edom.
For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.text_amharic: ሃዳድ ገና ብላቴና ሳለ ሃዳድና ከእርሱ ጋር ጥቂቶቹ ከኤዶምያስ ሰዎች የሆኑ የአባቱ ባሪያዎች ወደ ግብጽ ኰብልለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.text_amharic: ከምድያምም ተነሥተው ወደ ፋራን መጡ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ከፋራን ሰዎች ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ግብጽም መጡ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ንጉሥ ወደ ፈርዖን ዘንድ ገቡ፤ እርሱም ቤት ሰጥቶ ቀለብ ዳረገው፥ ምድርም ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad yet a little child.
verses.text_amharic: የሚስቱንም የእቴጌይቱን የቴቄምናስን እኅት እስኪያጋባው ድረስ ሃዳድ በፈርዖን ፊት እጅግ ባለምዋል ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.text_amharic: የቴቄምናስ እኅት ጌንባትን ወለደችለት፥ ቴቄምናስም በፈርዖን ቤት አሳደገችው፤ ጌንባትም በፈርዖን ቤት በፈርዖን ልጆች መካከል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.text_amharic: ሃዳድም በግብጽ ሳለ ዳዊት ከአባቶቹ ጋር እንዳንቀላፋ፥ የሠራዊቱም አለቃ ኢዮአብ እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ሃዳድ ፈርዖንን። ወደ አገሬ እሄድ ዘንድ አሰናብተኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም። እነሆ፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ ወደ አገርህ መሄድ የፈለግህ ምን አጥተህ ነው? አለው። እርሱም። አንዳች አላጣሁም፤ ነገር ግን ልሂድ ብሎ መለሰ። ሃዳድም ወደ አገሩ ተመለሰ፥ ሃዳድም ያደረገው ክፉ ነገር ይህ ነው፤ እስራኤልን አስጨነቀ፥ በኤዶምያስም ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ከጌታው ከሱባ ንጉሥ ከአድርአዛር የኰበለለውን የኤልያዳን ልጅ ሬዞንን ጠላት አድርጎ አስነሣበት።

verses.text_english: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የሱባን ሰዎች በገደለ ጊዜ ሬዞን ሰዎችን ሰብስቦ የጭፍራ አለቃ ሆነ፤ ወደ ደማስቆም ሄዱ፥ በዚያም ተቀመጡ፤ በደማስቆም ላይ አነገሡት።

verses.text_english: And God stirred him up adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.text_amharic: ሃዳድም ካደረገው ክፋት ሌላ በሰሎሞን ዘመን ሁሉ የእስራኤል ጠላት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them : and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳሪራ አገር የሆነ የሰሎሞን ባሪያ የኤፍሬማዊው የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በንጉሡ ላይ ዐመፀ፤ እናቱም ጽሩዓ የተባለች ባልቴት ሴት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad : and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም ያመፀበት ምክንያት ይህ ነው፤ ሰሎሞን ሚሎን ሠራ፥ የአባቱንም የዳዊትን ከተማ ሰባራውን ጠገነ።

verses.text_english: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up hand against the king.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምም ጽኑዕ ኃያል ሰው ነበረ፤ ሰሎሞንም ጕልማሳው በሥራ የተመሰገነ መሆኑን ባየ ጊዜ በዮሴፍ ነገድ ሥራ ሁሉ ላይ ሾመው።
