verses.text_english: And this the cause that he lifted up hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢዮርብዓም ከኢየሩሳሌም በወጣ ጊዜ ሴሎናዊው ነቢዩ አኪያ በመንገድ ላይ ተገናኘው፤ አኪያም አዲስ ልብስ ለብሶ ነበር ሁለቱም በሜዳው ለብቻቸው ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the man Jeroboam a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: አኪያም የለበሰውን አዲስ ልብስ ይዞ ከአሥራ ሁለት ቈራረጠው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two alone in the field:
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምንም አለው። አሥር ቍራጭ ውሰድ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ከሰሎሞን እጅ መንግሥቱን እቀድዳለሁ፥ አሥሩንም ነገዶች እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahijah caught the new garment that on him, and rent it twelve pieces:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ዳዊት ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ስለ መረጥኋት ከተማ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ግን አንድ ነገድ ይቀርለታል፤

verses.text_english: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
verses.text_amharic: ጥለውኛልና፥ ለሲዶናውያንም አምላክ ለአስታሮት፥ ለሞዓብም አምላክ ለካሞሽ፥ ለአሞንም ልጆች አምላክ ለሚልኮም ሰግደዋልና፥ አባቱም ዳዊት እንዳደረገ በፊቴ ቅን ነገር ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴንም ይጠብቁ ዘንድ በመንገዴ አልሄዱምና።

verses.text_english: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥቱንም ሁሉ ከእጁ አልወስድም፤ ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ስለ ጠበቀው ስለ መረጥሁት ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ዳዊት ግን በዕድሜው ሁሉ አለቃ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do right in mine eyes, and my statutes and my judgments, as David his father.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥቱንም ከልጁ እጅ እወስዳለሁ፥ ለአንተም አሥሩን ነገድ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.text_amharic: ስሜንም ባኖርሁባት በዚያች በመረጥኋት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት በፊቴ ሁልጊዜ መብራት ይሆንለት ዘንድ ለልጁ አንድ ነገድ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, ten tribes.
verses.text_amharic: አንተንም እወስድሃለሁ፥ ነፍስህም በወደደችው ሁሉ ላይ ትነግሣለች፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬም ዳዊት እንዳደረገ፥ ያዘዝሁህን ሁሉ ብትሰማ፥ በመንገዴም ብትሄድ፥ በፊቴም የቀናውን ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ትእዛዜን ብትጠብቅ፥ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ ለዳዊትም እንደ ሠራሁለት ጽኑ ቤት እሠራልሃለሁ፥ እስራኤልንም ለአንተ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የዳዊትን ዘር አስጨንቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን በዘመን ሁሉ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ኢዮርብዓምን ሊገድለው ወደደ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም ተነሥቶ ወደ ግብጽ ኰበለለ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ንጉሥ ወደ ሺሻቅ መጣ፥ ሰሎሞንም እስኪሞት ድረስ በግብጽ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የሰሎሞን ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ጥበቡም፥ እነሆ፥ በሰሎሞን ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በኢየሩሳሌም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ የነገሠበት ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሮብዓም በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሁሉ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ወደ ሴኬም መጥተው ነበርና ሮብዓም ወደ ሴኬም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard , (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ፥ እርሱም ከንጉሡ ከሰሎሞን ፊት ኰብልሎ በግብጽ ተቀምጦ ነበርና፥ በግብጽም ሳለ ልከው ጠርተውት ነበርና

verses.text_english: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምና የእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ መጥተው ለሮብዓም።

verses.text_english: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
verses.text_amharic: አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብን ነበር፤ አሁንም አንተ ጽኑውን የአባትህን አገዛዝ፥ በላያችንም የጫነውን የከበደውን ቀንበር አቃልልልን፤ እኛም እንገዛልሃለን ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Depart yet three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ አላቸው። ሕዝቡም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ እመልስለት ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ አባቱ ሰሎሞን በሕይወቱ ሳለ በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.text_english: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ አሁን ባሪያ ብትሆን ብትገዛላቸውም፥ መልሰህም በገርነት ብትናገራቸው፥ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ባሪያዎች ይሆኑልሃል ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, which stood before him:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ሽማግሌዎች የመከሩትን ምክር ትቶ ከእርሱ ጋር ካደጉትና በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ብላቴኖች ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አባትህ የጫኑብንን ቀንበር አቃልልልን ለሚሉኝ ሕዝብ እመልስላቸው ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ያደጉት ብላቴኖች። አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብናል፥ አንተ ግን አቃልልልን ለሚሉህ ሕዝብ። ታናሺቱ ጣቴ ከአባቴ ወገብ ትወፍራለች።

verses.text_english: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አባቴ ከባድ ቀንበር ጭኖባችኋል፥ እኔ ግን በቀንበራችሁ ላይ እጨምራለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችኋል፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ በላቸው ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ ብሎ እንደ ተናገረ ኢዮርብዓምና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ሮብዓም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሽማግሌዎች የመከሩትን ምክር ትቶ ለሕዝቡ ጽኑ ምላሽ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ብላቴኖችም ምክር። አባቴ ቀንበር አክብዶባችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በቀንበራችሁ ላይ እጨምራለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሴሎናዊው በአኪያ አድርጎ ለናባጥ ልጅ ለኢዮርብዓም የተናገረውን ነገር እንዲያጸና ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተመድቦ ነበርና ንጉሡ ሕዝቡን አልሰማም።

verses.text_english: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ንጉሡ እንዳልሰማቸው ባዩ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ለንጉሡ። በዳዊት ዘንድ ምን ክፍል አለን? በእሴይም ልጅ ዘንድ ርስት የለንም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ወደ ድንኳኖቻችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ዳዊት ሆይ፥ አሁን ቤትህን ተመልከት ብለው መለሱለት። እስራኤልም ወደ ድንኳኖቻቸው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: But the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ከተሞች በተቀመጡት በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ግን ሮብዓም ነገሠባቸው።

verses.text_english: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም አስገባሪውን አዶኒራምን ሰደደ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በድንጋይ ደበደቡት፥ ሞተም። ንጉሡም ሮብዓም ፈጥኖ ወደ ሰረገላው ወጣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከዳዊት ቤት ሸፈተ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ኢዮርብዓም እንደ ተመለሰ በሰሙ ጊዜ ልከው ወደ ሸንጎአቸው ጠሩት፥ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ላይ አነገሡት። ከብቻው ከይሁዳ ነገድ በቀረ የዳዊትን ቤት የተከተለ አንድ ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: ሮብዓምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፥ የእስራኤልንም ቤት ወግተው መንግሥቱን ወደ ሰሎሞን ልጅ ወደ ሮብዓም ይመልሱ ዘንድ ከይሁዳ ቤት ሁሉና ከብንያም ነገድ የተመረጡትን አንድ መቶ ሰማንያ ሺህ ሰልፈኞች ሰዎች ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ሳማያ።

verses.text_english: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓምና ለይሁዳ ለብንያምም ቤት ሁሉ ለቀረውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ነገር ከእኔ ዘንድ ነውና አትውጡ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ወንድሞቻችሁን አትውጉ፤ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ ብለህ ንገራቸው ሲል መጣ። የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ሰሙ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል ተመልሰው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ሴኬምን ሠርቶ በዚያ ተቀመጠ፤ ደግሞም ከዚያ ወጥቶ ጵኒኤልን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምም በልቡ። አሁን መንግሥቱ ወደ ዳዊት ቤት ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት መሥዋዕትን ያቀርብ ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቢወጣ፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ወደ ጌታቸው ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ ሮብዓም ይመለሳል፥ እኔንም ይገድሉኛል አለ።

verses.text_english: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ተማከረ፥ ሁለትም የወርቅ ጥጆች አድርጎ። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ትወጡ ዘንድ ይበዛባችኋል፤ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጡህን አማልክቶችህን እይ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱን በቤቴል፥ ሁለተኛውንም በዳን አኖረ።

verses.text_english: And this thing became a sin: for the people went before the one, unto Dan.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንዱ ጥጃ ይሰግድ ዘንድ ሕዝቡ እስከ ዳን ድረስ ይሄድ ነበርና ይህ ኃጢአት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: በኮረብቶቹም ላይ መስገጃዎች ሠራ፥ ከሌዊ ልጆች ካይደሉ ከሕዝብ ሁሉ ካህናትን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛው ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛውም ቀን በይሁዳ እንደሚደረግ በዓል ያለ በዓል አደረገ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ ሠዋ፤ ለሠራቸውም ጥጆች ይሠዋ ዘንድ እንዲሁ በቤቴል አደረገ፤ ለኮረብታ መስገጃዎችም የመረጣቸውን ካህናት በቤቴል አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በልቡ ባሰበው ቀን በቤቴል በሠራው መሠዊያ ላይ ሠዋ፤ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች በዓል አደረገላቸው፤ በመሠዊያውም ሠዋ፥ ዕጣንም ዐጠነ። a

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከይሁዳ ወደ ቤቴል መጣ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም ዕጣን እያጠነ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: በመሠዊያውም ላይ። መሠዊያ ሆይ፥ መሠዊያ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ስሙ ኢዮስያስ የሚባል ልጅ ለዳዊት ቤት ይወለዳል፤ ዕጣንም የሚያጥኑብህን የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹን ካህናት ይሠዋብሃል፥ የሰዎቹንም አጥንት ያቃጥልብሃል ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that upon it shall be poured out.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ምልክት ይህ ነው፤ እነሆ፥ መሠዊያው ይሰነጠቃል፥ በላዩም ያለው አመድ ይፈስሳል ብሎ ምልክት ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ የጮኸውን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ኢዮርብዓም እጁን ከመሠዊያው አንሥቶ። ያዙት አለ። በእርሱም ላይ የዘረጋት እጅ ደረቀች፥ ወደ እርሱም ይመልሳት ዘንድ አልተቻለውም።

verses.text_english: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ሰጠው ምልክት መሠዊያው ተሰነጠቀ፥ አመዱም ከመሠዊያው ፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as before.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። አሁን የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ፊት ለምን፥ እጄም ወደ እኔ ትመለስ ዘንድ ስለ እኔ ጸልይ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ለመነ፥ የንጉሡም እጅ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፥ እንደ ቀድሞም ሆነች።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ቤቴ ና እንጀራም ብላ፥ በረከትም እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ንጉሡን። የቤትህን እኩሌታ እንኳ ብትሰጠኝ ከአንተ ጋር አልገባም፥ በዚህም ስፍራ እንጀራ አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም፤

verses.text_english: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ውኃም አትጠጣ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ አትመለስ በሚል በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ታዝዤአለሁና አለው።

verses.text_english: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.text_amharic: በሌላም መንገድ ሄደ፥ ወደ ቤቴልም በመጣበት መንገድ አልተመለሰም።

verses.text_english: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴልም አንድ ሽማግሌ ነቢይ ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ ልጆቹም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው በዚያ ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በቤቴል ያደረገውን ሥራ ሁሉ ነገሩት ደግሞም ለንጉሡ የተናገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ለአባታቸው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
verses.text_amharic: አባታቸውም። በማናቸው መንገድ ሄደ? አላቸው። ልጆቹም ከይሁዳ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ሰው የሄደበትን መንገድ አመለከቱት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹንም። አህያውን ጫኑልኝ አላቸው፤ አህያውንም በጫኑለት ጊዜ ተቀመጠበት።

verses.text_english: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I .
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔርም ሰው በኋላ ሄደ፤ በአድባርም ዛፍ በታች ተቀምጦ አገኘውና። ከይሁዳ የመጣህ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው አንተ ነህን? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ቤቴ ና፥ እንጀራም ብላ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከአንተ ጋር እመለስና እገባ ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤ በዚህም ስፍራ ከአንተ ጋር እንጀራ አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም፤

verses.text_english: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ውኃም አትጠጣ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ አትመለስ በሚል በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ተብሎልኛልና አለ።

verses.text_english: He said unto him, I a prophet also as thou ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. he lied unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እኔ ደግሞ እንደ አንተ ነቢይ ነኝ፤ መልአክም። እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ ውኃም ይጠጣ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ወደ ቤትህ መልሰው ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ተናገረኝ አለው። ዋሽቶም ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ተመለሰ፥ በቤቱም እንጀራ በላ፥ ውኃም ጠጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.text_amharic: በማዕድም ተቀምጠው ሳሉ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ መለሰው ነቢይ መጣ፤

verses.text_english: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳም ወደ መጣው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእግዚአብሔር አፍ ላይ ዐምፀሃልና፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘህን ትእዛዝ አልጠበቅህምና፥

verses.text_english: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰህም። እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ውኃም አትጠጣ ባለህ ስፍራ እንጀራ በልተሃልና፥ ውኃም ጠጥተሃልና ሬሳህ ወደ አባቶችህ መቃብር አይደርስም ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, , for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራም ከበላ፥ ውኃም ከጠጣ በኋላ አህያውን ጫነለት።

verses.text_english: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሶም በሄደ ጊዜ በመንገዱ ላይ አንበሳ አግኝቶ ገደለው፤ ሬሳውም በመንገድ ላይ ተጋድሞ ነበር፥ አህያውም በእርሱ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር፤ አንበሳውም ደግሞ በሬሳው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ መንገድ አላፊ ሰዎች ሬሳው በመንገዱ ወድቆ አንበሳውም በሬሳው አጠገብ ቆሞ አዩ መጥተውም ሽማግሌው ነቢይ ተቀምጦባት በነበረው ከተማ አወሩ።

verses.text_english: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard , he said, It the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ከመንገድ የመለሰው ነቢይ ያን በሰማ ጊዜ። በእግዚአብሔር አፍ ላይ ያመፀ ያ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረው ቃል፥ እግዚአብሔር ለአንበሳ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶታል፤ ሰብሮም ገድሎታል አለ።

verses.text_english: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled .
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹንም። አህያ ጫኑልኝ አላቸው፤ እነርሱም ጫኑለት።

verses.text_english: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.text_amharic: ሄደም፥ ሬሳውም በመንገድ ወድቆ፥ በሬሳውም አጠገብ አህያውና አንበሳው ቆመው፥ አንበሳው ሬሳውን ሳይበላው፥ አህያውንም ሳይሰብረው አገኘ።

verses.text_english: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው ሬሳ አነሣ፥ በአህያውም ላይ ጭኖ መለሰው፤ ያለቅስለትና ይቀብረው ዘንድ ወደ ገዛ ከተማው ይዞት መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, , Alas, my brother!
verses.text_amharic: ሬሳውንም በገዛ መቃብሩ አኖረው፤ ዋይ ዋይ ወንድሜ ሆይ እያሉ አለቀሱለት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.text_amharic: ከቀበረውም በኋላ ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። በሞትሁ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በተቀበረበት መቃብር ቅበሩኝ፤ አጥንቶቼንም በአጥንቶቹ አጠገብ አኑሩ፤

verses.text_english: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ፥ በሰማርያም ከተሞች ውስጥ ባሉ በኮረብታዎቹ መስገጃዎች ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል የጮኸው ነገር በእውነት ይደርሳልና።

verses.text_english: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became of the priests of the high places.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮርብዓም ከክፉ መንገድ አልተመለሰም፥ ነገር ግን ለኮረብታዎቹ መስገጃዎች አብልጦ ከሕዝብ ሁሉ ካህናትን አደረገ፤ የሚወድደውንም ሁሉ ይቀድስ ነበር፥ እርሱም ለኮርብታዎቹ መስገጃዎች ካህን ይሆን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut off, and to destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እስኪፈርስም ከምድርም እስኪጠፋ ድረስ ይህ ነገር ለኢዮርብዓም ቤት ኃጢአት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት የኢዮርብዓም ልጅ አብያ ታመመ።

verses.text_english: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there Ahijah the prophet, which told me that king over this people.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምም ሚስቱን። ተነሺ፥ የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት እንደ ሆንሽ እንዳትታወቂ ልብስሽን ለውጪና ወደ ሴሎ ሂጂ፤ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ እንድነግሥ የነገረኝ ነቢዩ አኪያ በዚያ አለ።

verses.text_english: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
verses.text_amharic: በእጅሽም አሥር እንጀራና እንጎቻዎች አንድም ምንቸት ማር ይዘሽ ወደ እርሱ ሂጂ፤ በልጁም የሚሆነውን ይነግርሻል አላት።

verses.text_english: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት እንዲሁ አደረገች፥ ተነሥታም ወደ ሴሎ ሄደች፤ ወደ አኪያም ቤት መጣች። አኪያም ስለ መሸምገሉ ዓይኖቹ ፈዝዘው ነበርና፤ ማየት አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself another .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አኪያን። እነሆ፥ ስለ ታመመው ልጅዋ ትጠይቅህ ዘንድ የኢዮርብዓም ሚስት ትመጣለች፤ ሌላ ሴትም መስላ ተሰውራለችና በገባች ጊዜ እንዲህና እንዲህ በላት አለው።

verses.text_english: And it was , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself another? for I sent to thee heavy .
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በደጅ ስትገባ አኪያ የእግርዋን ኮቴ ሰማ፥ እንዲህም አለ። የኢዮርብዓም ሚስት ሆይ፥ ግቢ፤ ስለ ምንስ ሌላ ሴት መሰልሽ? እኔም ብርቱ ወሬ ይዤ ተልኬልሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
verses.text_amharic: ሂጂ፥ ለኢዮርብዓምም እንዲህ በዪው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከሕዝብ መካከል ለይቼ ከፍ አድርጌህ ነበር፥ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ አድርጌህ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do only right in mine eyes;
verses.text_amharic: ከዳዊትም ቤት መንግሥቱን ቀድጄ ሰጥቼህ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልቡ እንደ ተከተለኝ፥ በፊቴም ቅን ነገር ብቻ እንዳደረገ፥ ትእዛዜንም እንደ ጠበቀ እንደ ባሪያዬ እንደ ዳዊት አልሆንህም።

verses.text_english: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተም አስቀድመው ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ ክፉ ሠራህ፤ ታስቈጣኝም ዘንድ ሄደህ ሌሎችን አማልክትና ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎች አደረግህ፥ ወደ ኋላህም ጣልኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት ላይ መከራ አመጣለሁ፥ ከኢዮርብአምም በእስራኤል ዘንድ የታሰረውንና የተለቀቀውን ወንድ ሁሉ እቈርጣለሁ፤ ሰውም ፋንድያን እስኪጠፋ ድረስ እንደሚጠርግ እኔ የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ፈጽሜ እጠርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: ከኢዮርብዓምም ወገን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳውም የሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል፤ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ተነሥተሽ ወደ ቤትሽ ሂጂ፤ እግርሽም ወደ ከተማ በገባ ጊዜ ልጁ ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ያለቅሱለታል፥ ይቀብሩትማል፤ በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት በዚህ ልጅ መልካም ነገር ተገኝቶበታልና ከኢዮርብዓም እርሱ ብቻ ይቀበራል።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ያስነሣል፤ እርሱም በዚያ ዘመን የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜም ሸምበቆ በውኃ ውስጥ እንደሚንቀሳቀስ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ እስራኤልን ይመታል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያስቈጡ ዘንድ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ተክለዋልና ለአባቶቻቸው ከሰጣቸው ከዚች ከመልካሚቱ ምድር እስራኤልን ይነቅላል፥ በወንዙም ማዶ ይበትናቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ በደለውና እስራኤልንም ስላሳተበት ስለ ኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት እስራኤልን ይጥላል።

verses.text_english: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት ተነሥታ ሄደች፥ ወደ ቴርሳ መጣች፤ ወደ ቤቱም መድረክ በገባች ጊዜ ልጁ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.text_amharic: በባሪያውም በነቢዩ በአኪያ እንደ ተነገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እስራኤል ሁሉ ቀበሩት አለቀሱለትም።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የኢዮርብዓም ነገር፥ እንዴት እንደ ተዋጋ፥ እንዴትም እንደ ነገሠ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: And the days which Jeroboam reigned two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮርብዓምም የነገሠበት ዘመን ሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ነበረ፤ ከአባቶቹም ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ ልጁም ናዳብ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሎሞንም ልጅ ሮብዓም በይሁዳ ነገሠ፤ ሮብዓምም ንጉሥ በሆነ ጊዜ የአርባ አንድ ዓመት ጉልማሳ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስሙን ያኖርባት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ በመረጣት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም ናዕማ ነበረ፤ እርስዋም አሞናዊት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሠራ፤ አባቶቻቸውም ከሠሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ አብዝተው በሠሩት ኃጢአት አስቈጡት።

verses.text_english: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ደግሞ ከፍ ባለው ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፥ ቅጠሉ ከለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች መስገጃዎችንና ሐውልቶችን የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንም ለራሳቸው ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And there were also sodomites in the land: they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ውስጥ ሰዶማውያን ነበሩ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ፊት እግዚአብሔር ያሳደዳቸውን የአሕዛብን ርኵሰት ሁሉ ያደርጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
verses.text_amharic: ሮብዓምም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብጽ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት መዛግብትንና የንጉሥ ቤት መዛግብትን ወሰደ፤ ሁሉንም ወሰደ፤ ሰሎሞንም የሠራውን የወርቁን ጋሻ ሁሉ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በፋንታው የናስ ጋሾችን ሠራ፥ የንጉሥንም ቤት ደጅ በሚጠብቁ በዘበኞች አለቆች እጅ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And it was , when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዘወትር ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ሲገባ ዘበኞች ይሸከሙአቸው ነበር፤ መልሰውም በዘበኞች ቤት ውስጥ ያኖሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የሮብዓም ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all days.
verses.text_amharic: በዘመኑም ሁሉ በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከል ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሮብዓምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ። ልጁም አብያም በፋንታው ነገሠ። a

verses.text_english: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በነገሠ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት አብያም በይሁዳ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም መዓካ የተባለች የአቤሴሎም ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ አስቀድሞ ባደረገው በአባቱ ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄደ፤ ልቡም እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት ልብ ከአምላኩ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፍጹም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless for David's sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ልጁን ከእርሱ በኋላ ያስነሣ ዘንድ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ያጸና ዘንድ አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ዳዊት በኢየሩሳሌም መብራት ሰጠው፤

verses.text_english: Because David did right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊት በዘመኑ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አድርጎ ነበርና፥ ካዘዘውም ነገር ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አላለም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.text_amharic: በኢዮርብዓምና በሮብዓም ልጅ በአብያም መካከል በዘመኑ ሁሉ ጠብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የአብያም ነገር፥ ያደርገውም ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? በአብያምና በኢዮርብዓምም መካከል ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: አብያምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት። ልጁም አሳ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም በሀያኛውም ዓመት አሳ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም መዓካ የተባለች የአቤሴሎም ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Asa did right in the eyes of the LORD, as David his father.
verses.text_amharic: አሳ እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.text_amharic: ከአገሩም ሰዶማውያንን አስወገደ፥ አባቶቹም ያደረጉትን ጣዖታትን ሁሉ አራቀ።

verses.text_english: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt by the brook Kidron.
verses.text_amharic: በማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ጣዖት ስለሠራች እናቱን መዓካን እቴጌ እንዳትሆን ሻራት፤ ጣዖትዋንም ሰበረው፥ በቄድሮንም ፈፋ አጠገብ አቃጠለው።

verses.text_english: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አላራቀም፤ የአሳ ልብ ግን በዘመኑ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፍጹም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ የቀደሰውንና እርሱም የቀደሰውን ወርቅና ብር ዕቃውንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አገባው።

verses.text_english: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.text_amharic: በአሳና በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በባኦስ መካከል በዘመናቸው ሁሉ ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባኦስ በይሁዳ ላይ ወጣ፤ ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሳ ዘንድ ማንም እንዳይወጣ ወደ እርሱም ማንም እንዳይገባ አድርጎ ራማን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.text_amharic: አሳም በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በንጉሥ ቤት መዛግብት የቀረውን ብርና ወርቅ ሁሉ ወስዶ በባሪያዎቹ እጅ ሰጣቸው፤ ንጉሡም አሳ በደማስቆ ለተቀመጠው ለአዚን ልጅ ለጠብሪሞን ልጅ ለሶርያ ንጉሥ ለወልደ አዴር።

verses.text_english: a league between me and thee, between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔና በአንተ መካከል በአባቴና በአባትህም መካከል ቃል ኪዳን ጸንቶአል፤ እነሆ፥ ብርና ወርቅ ገጸ በረከት ሰድጄልሃለሁ፤ እርሱ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲርቅ ሄደህ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከባኦስ ጋር ያለህን ቃል ኪዳን አፍርስ ብሎ ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.text_amharic: ወልደ አዴርም ለንጉሡ ለአሳ እሺ አለው፤ የሠራዊቱንም አለቆች በእስራኤል ከተሞች ላይ ሰድዶ ዒዮንንና ዳንን፥ አቤልቤት መዓካንና ኪኔሬትን ሁሉ የንፍታሌምንም አገር ሁሉ መታ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard , that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.text_amharic: ባኦስም ያን በሰማ ጊዜ ራማን መሥራት ትቶ በቴርሳ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አሳ በይሁዳ ሁሉ ላይ አዋጅ ነገረ፤ ማንም ነጻ አልነበረም፤ ባኦስም የሠራበትን የራማን ድንጋይና እንጨት ወሰዱ፥ ንጉሡም አሳ የብንያምን ጌባንና ምጽጳን ሠራበት።

verses.text_english: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የአሳ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ጭከናውም ሁሉ፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ የሠራቸውም ከተሞች፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? ነገር ግን በሸመገለ ጊዜ እግሮቹ ታመሙ።

verses.text_english: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: አሳም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ። ልጁም ኢዮሣፍጥ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሁለተኛው ዓመት የኢዮርብዓም ልጅ ናዳብ በእስራኤል ላይ ነገሠ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በአባቱም መንገድ እስራኤልንም ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሳኮርም ቤት የሆነ የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ ተማማለበት፤ ናዳብና እስራኤልም ሁሉ ገባቶንን ከብበው ነበርና ባኦስ በፍልስጥኤም አገር ባለው በገባቶን ገደለው።

verses.text_english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት ባኦስ ናዳብን ገደለው፥ በፋንታውም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he reigned, he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ በቴርሳ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሀያ አራት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በኢዮርብዓምም መንገድ እስራኤልንም ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በባኦስ ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ወደ አናኒ ልጅ ወደ ኢዩ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከመሬት አስነሥቼ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ አንተ ግን በኢዮርብዓም መንገድ ሄደሃል፥ በኃጢአታቸውም ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን አስተሃቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም፥ እነሆ፥ ባኦስንና ቤቱን ፈጽሜ እጠርጋለሁ፤ ቤትህንም እንደ ናባጥ ልጅ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.text_amharic: ከባኦስም ወገን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የሚሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳውም የሚሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የባኦስ ነገር፥ ሥራውና ጭከናውም፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ባኦስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በቴርሳም ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኤላ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
verses.text_amharic: በእጁም ሥራ ያስቈጣው ዘንድ፥ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስላደረገው ክፋት ሁሉ እርሱንም ስለ ገደለው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በባኦስና በቤቱ ላይ ወደ አናኒ ልጅ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኢዩ መጣ።

verses.text_english: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሀያ ስድስተኛው ዓመት የባኦስ ልጅ ኤላ በእስራኤል ላይ በቴርሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And his servant Zimri, captain of half chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of house in Tirzah.
verses.text_amharic: የእኩሌቶቹም ሰረገሎች አለቃ ዘምሪ ተማማለበት፤ ኤላም በቴርሳ ነበረ፥ በቴርሳም በነበረው በቤት አሽከሮች አለቃ በኦሳ ቤት ይሰክር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሀያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት ዘምሪ ገብቶ መታው ገደለውም፥ በፋንታውም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥም በሆነ ጊዜ፥ በዙፋኑም በተቀመጠ ጊዜ፥ የባኦስን ቤት ሁሉ መታ፤ ከዘመዶችና ከወዳጆች ሁሉ አንድ ወንድ እንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የኤላ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሳ በሀያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት ዘምሪ በቴርሳ ሰባት ቀን ነገሠ። ሕዝቡም በፍልስጥኤም አገር የነበረው ገባቶንን ከብበው ነበር።

verses.text_english: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people encamped against Gibbethon, which to the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱንም ከብበው የነበሩ ሕዝብ ዘምሪ እንደ ዐመፀ፥ ንጉሡንም እንደ ገደለ ሰሙ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በዚያ ቀን በሰፈሩ ውስጥ የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ዘንበሪን አነገሡ።

verses.text_english: And the people encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ዘንበሪም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ከገባቶን ወጥተው ቴርሳን ከበቡ።

verses.text_english: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.text_amharic: ዘምሪም ከተማይቱ እንደ ተያዘች ባየ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ግንብ ውስጥ ገባ፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት በራሱ ላይ በእሳት አቃጠለ፤

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,
verses.text_amharic: ስላደረገውም ኃጢአት፥ እስራኤልንም ስላሳተበት ኃጢአት፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አድርጎአልና፥ በኢዮርብዓምም መንገድ ሄዶአልና ሞተ።

verses.text_english: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የዘምሪ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ዐመፅ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ በሁለት ተከፈለ፤ የሕዝቡም እኩሌታ የጎናትን ልጅ ታምኒን ያነግሡት ዘንድ ተከተለው፤ እኩሌታውም ዘንበሪን ተከተለ።

verses.text_english: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.text_amharic: ዘንበሪንም የተከተለ ሕዝብ የጎናትን ልጅ ታምኒን በተከተለ ሕዝብ ላይ በረታ፤ ታምኒም ሞተ፥ ዘንበሪም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሳ በሠላሳ አንደኛው ዓመት ዘንበሪ በእስራኤል ላይ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ። በቴርሳም ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳምርም በሁለት መክሊት ብር የሰማርያን ተራራ ገዛ፤ በተራራውም ላይ ሠራ፥ የሠራውንም ከተማ በተራራው ባለቤት በሳምር ስም ሰማርያ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ዘንበሪም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ ከእርሱም አስቀድሞ ከነበሩት ይልቅ እጅግ ከፋ።

verses.text_english: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that before him.
verses.text_amharic: በናባጥም ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም መንገድ ሁሉ በምናምንቴም ነገራቸው የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ያስቈጡት ዘንድ እስራኤልን ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.text_english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም ዘንበሪ ያደረገው ነገር፥ የሠራውም ጭከና፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: ዘንበሪም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በሰማርያም ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም አክዓብ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሠላሳ ስምንተኛው ዓመት የዘንበሪ ልጅ አክዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ ነገሠ፤ የዘንበሪም ልጅ አክዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማሪያ ሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.text_amharic: የዘንበሪም ልጅ አክዓብ ከእርሱ በፊት ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that before him.
verses.text_amharic: በናባጥም ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት መሄድ ታናሽ ነገር መሰለው፥ የሲዶናውያንንም ንጉሥ የኤትበኣልን ልጅ ኤልዛቤልን አገባ፥ ሄዶም በኣልን አመለከ ሰገደለትም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማርያም በሠራው በበኣል ቤት ውስጥ ለበኣል መሠዊያ አቆመ።

verses.text_english: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ተከለ፤ አክዓብም ከእርሱ በፊት ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያስቈጣውን ነገር አበዛ።

verses.text_english: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ዘመን የቤቴል ሰው አኪኤል ኢያሪኮን ሠራ፤ በነዌም ልጅ በኢያሱ እጅ እንደ ተነገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል፥ በበኵር ልጅ በአቢሮን መሠረትዋን አደረገ፥ በታናሹ ልጁም በሠጉብ በሮችዋን አቆመ። a

verses.text_english: And Elijah the Tishbite, of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.text_amharic: በገለዓድ ቴስቢ የነበረው ቴስብያዊው ኤልያስ አክዓብን። በፊቱ የቆምሁት የእስራኤል አምላክ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ከአፌ ቃል በቀር በእነዚህ ዓመታት ጠልና ዝናብ አይሆንም አለው።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ለእርሱ መጣለት።

verses.text_english: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that before Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ ተነሥተህ ወደ ምሥራቅ ሂድ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ትይዩ ባለው በኮራት ፈፋ ውስጥ ተሸሸግ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንዙም ትጠጣለህ፥ ቍራዎችም በዚያ ይመግቡህ ዘንድ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.text_english: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that before Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ሄደም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃልም አደረገ። ሄዶም በዮርዳኖስ ትይዩ ባለው በኮራት ፈፋ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.text_amharic: ቍራዎቹም በየጥዋትና በየማታው እንጀራና ሥጋ ያመጡለት ነበር፤ ከወንዙም ይጠጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ በምድር ላይ ዝናብ አልነበረምና ወንዙ ደረቀ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተህም በሲዶና አጠገብ ወዳለችው ወደ ሰራፕታ ሂድ፥ በዚያም ተቀመጥ፤

verses.text_english: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ትመግብህ ዘንድ አንዲት ባልቴት አዝዣለሁ የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣለት።

verses.text_english: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቶም ወደ ሰራፕታ ሄደ፤ ወደ ከተማይቱም በር በደረሰ ጊዜ አንዲት ባልቴት በዚያ እንጨት ትለቅም ነበር፤ እርሱም ጠርቶ። የምጠጣው ጥቂት ውኃ በጽዋ ታመጭልኝ ዘንድ እለምንሻለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: And as she was going to fetch , he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃም ልታመጣለት በሄደች ጊዜ ወደ እርስዋ ጠርቶ፥ ቁራሽ እንጀራ በእጅሽ ይዘሽ ትመጭ ዘንድ እለምንሻለሁ አላት።

verses.text_english: And she said, the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አምላክህ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በማድጋ ካለው ከእፍኝ ዱቄት፥ በማሰሮም ካለው ከጥቂት ዘይት በቀር እንጀራ የለኝም፤ እነሆም፥ ገብቼ ለእኔና ለልጄ እጋግረው ዘንድ በልተነውም እንሞት ዘንድ ጥቂት እንጨት እሰበስባለሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም አላት። አትፍሪ፤ ይልቅስ ሄደሽ እንዳልሺው አድርጊ፤ አስቀድመሽ ግን ከዱቄቱ ለእኔ ታናሽ እንጎቻ አድርገሽ አምጭልኝ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ለአንቺና ለልጅሽ አድርጊ፤

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በምድር ላይ እግዚአብሔር ዝናብ እስከሚሰጥበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ዱቄቱ ከማድጋ አይጨረስም፥ ዘይቱም ከማሰሮው አይጎድልም።

verses.text_english: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat days.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ሄዳ እንደ ኤልያሳ ቃል አደረገች፤ እርስዋና እርሱ ቤትዋም ብዙ ቀን በሉ።

verses.text_english: the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.text_amharic: በኤልያስም እጅ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ዱቄቱ ከማድጋው አልተጨረሰም፥ ዘይቱም ከማሰሮው አልጎደለም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የባለቤቲቱ ልጅ ታመመ፤ ትንፋሹም እስኪታጣ ድረስ ደዌው እጅግ ከባድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ኤልያስን። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ኃጢአቴንስ ታሳስብ ዘንድ፥ ልጄንስ ትገድል ዘንድ ወደ እኔ መጥተሃልን? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። ልጅሽን ስጪኝ አላት። ከብብትዋም ወስዶ ተቀምጦበት ወደ ነበረው ሰገነት አወጣው በአልጋውም ላይ አጋደመው።

verses.text_english: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም። አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ልጅዋን በመግደልህ ይህችን ትቀልበኝ የነበረቺቱን ባልቴት እንዲህ ደግሞ አስጨነቅኻትን? ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
verses.text_amharic: በብላቴናውም ላይ ሦስት ጊዜ ተዘረጋበት፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም። አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ የዚህ ብላቴና ነፍስ ወደ እርሱ ትመለስ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የኤልያስን ቃል ሰማ፤ የብላቴናው ነፍስ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፥ እርሱም ዳነ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ብላቴናውን ይዞ ከሰገነቱ ወደ ቤት አወረደው፥ ኤልያስም። እነሆ፥ ልጅሽ በሕይወት ይኖራል ብሎ ለእናቱ ሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou a man of God, that the word of the LORD in thy mouth truth.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ኤልያስን። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንህ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በአፍህ እውነት እንደ ሆነ አሁን አወቅሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ በሦስተኛው ዓመት። ሂድ፥ ለአክዓብ ተገለጥ፥ በምድር ላይም ዝናብ እሰጣለሁ የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤልያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ለአክዓብ ይገለጥ ዘንድ ሄደ፤ በሰማርያም ራብ ጸንቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Ahab called Obadiah, which the governor of house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም የቤቱን አዛዥ አብድዩን ጠራ፤ አብድዩ እግዚአብሔርን እጅግ ይፈራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For it was , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዛቤልም የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢያት ባስገደለች ጊዜ እርሱ መቶውን ነቢያት ወስዶ አምሳ አምሳውን በዋሻ ውስጥ ሸሽጎ እንጀራና ውኃ ይመግባቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም አብድዩን። በአገሩ መካከል ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ ሁሉና ወደ ወንዝ ሁሉ ሂድ፤ እንስሶችም ሁሉ እንዳይጠፉ ፈረሶችንና በቅሎችን የምናድንበት ሣር ምናልባት እናገኛለን አለው።

verses.text_english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም የሚመለሱበትን አገር ተካፈሉ፤ አክዓብም ለብቻው በአንድ መንገድ አብድዩም ለብቻው በሌላ መንገድ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, thou that my lord Elijah?
verses.text_amharic: አብድዩም በመንገድ ሲሄድ፥ እነሆ፥ ኤልያስ ተገናኘው፤ አብድዩም አወቀው፥ በግምባሩም ተደፍቶ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ኤልያስ አንተ ነህን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And he answered him, I : go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah .
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። እኔ ነኝ ሄደህ ለጌታህ። ኤልያስ ተገኝቶአል በል አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.text_amharic: አብድዩም አለ። እኔን ባሪያህን እንዲገድል በአክዓብ እጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጠኝ ዘንድ ምን ኃጢአት አድርጌአለሁ?

verses.text_english: the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, not ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ጌታዬ ይፈልግህ ዘንድ ያልላከበት ሕዝብ ወይም መንግሥት የለም፤ ሁሉም። በዚህ የለም ባሉ ጊዜ አንተን እንዳላገኙ መንግሥቱንና ሕዝቡን አምሎአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah .
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ። ሂድ፥ ኤልያስ ተገኘ ብለህ ለጌታህ ንገር ትለኛለህ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከአንተ ጥቂት ራቅ ስል የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አንሥቶ ወደማላውቀው ስፍራ ይወስድሃል፤ እኔም ገብቼ ለአክዓብ ስናገር፥ ባያገኝህ ይገድለኛል፤ እኔም ባሪያህ ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሬ እግዚአብሔርን እፈራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD'S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዛቤል የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢያት ባስገደለች ጊዜ፥ መቶውን የእግዚአብሔር ነቢያት ወስጄ፥ አምሳ አምሳውንም በዋሻ ውስጥ ሸሽጌ፥ እንጀራና ውኃ የመገብኋቸው፥ ይህ ያደርግሁት ነገር በውኑ ለጌታዬ አልታወቀህምን?

verses.text_english: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah : and he shall slay me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም። ሄደህ ኤልያስ ተገኘ ብለህ ለጌታህ ንገር ትላለህ፤ እርሱም ይገድለኛል።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said, the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። በፊቱ የቆምሁት የሠራዊት ጌታ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እኔ ዛሬ ለእርሱ እገለጣለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.text_amharic: አብድዩም አክዓብን ሊገናኘው ሄደ፥ ነገረውም፤ አክዓብም ኤልያስን ሊገናኘው መጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, thou he that troubleth Israel?
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ኤልያስን ባየው ጊዜ። እስራኤልን የምትገለባብጥ አንተ ነህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። እስራኤልን የምትገለባብጡ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ትታችሁ በኣሊምን የተከተላችሁ፥ አንተና የአባትህ ቤት ናችሁ እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore send, gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ልከህ እስራኤልን ሁሉ፥ በኤልዛቤልም ማዕድ የሚበሉትን አራት መቶ አምሳ የበኣልን ነቢያት፥ አራት መቶም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድን ነቢያት ወደ እኔ ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሰብስብ አለ።

verses.text_english: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ልኮ ነቢያቱን ሁሉ ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD God, follow him: but if Baal, follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ወደ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቀርቦ። እስከ መቼ ድረስ በሁለት አሳብ ታነክሳላችሁ? እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ቢሆን እርሱን ተከተሉ፤ በኣል ግን አምላክ ቢሆን እርሱን ተከተሉ አለ። ሕዝቡም አንዲት ቃል አልመለሱለትም።

verses.text_english: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets four hundred and fifty men.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ሕዝቡን አለ። ከእግዚአብሔር ነቢያት እኔ ብቻ ቀርቻለሁ፤ የበኣል ነቢያት ግን አራት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay on wood, and put no fire : and I will dress the other bullock, and lay on wood, and put no fire :
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ወይፈኖች ይሰጡን፤ እነርሱም አንድ ወይፈን ይምረጡ፥ እየብልቱም ይቍረጡት፥ በእንጨትም ላይ ያኑሩት፥ በበታቹም እሳት አይጨምሩ፤ እኔም ሁለተኛውን ወይፈን አዘጋጃለሁ፥ በእንጨቱም ላይ አኖረዋለሁ፥ በበታቹም እሳት አልጨምርም።

verses.text_english: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም የአምላካችሁን ስም ጥሩ፥ እኔም የእግዚአብሔርን ስም እጠራለሁ፤ ሰምቶም በእሳት የሚመልስ አምላክ፥ እርሱ አምላክ ይሁን። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ይህ ነገር መልካም ነው ብለው መለሱ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress first; for ye many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire .
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም የበኣልን ነቢያት። እናንተ ብዙዎች ናችሁና አስቀድማችሁ አንድ ወይፈን ምረጡና አዘጋጁ፤ የአምላካችሁንም ስም ጥሩ፥ በበታችሁም እሳት አትጨምሩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.text_amharic: ወይፈኑንም ወስደው አዘጋጁ፥ ከጠዋትም እስከ ቀትር ድረስ። በኣል ሆይ፥ ስማን እያሉ የበኣልን ስም ጠሩ። ድምፅም አልነበረም፥ የሚመልስም አልነበረም፤ በሠሩትም መሠዊያ ዙሪያ እያነከሱ ያሸበሽቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
verses.text_amharic: በቀትርም ጊዜ ኤልያስ። አምላክ ነውና በታላቅ ቃል ጩኹ፤ ምናልባት አሳብ ይዞታል፥ ወይም ፈቀቅ ብሎአል፥ ወይም ወደ መንገድ ሄዶአል፥ ወይም ተኝቶ እንደ ሆነ መቀስቀስ ያስፈልገዋል እያለ አላገጠባቸው።

verses.text_english: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅም ቃል ይጮኹ፥ እንደ ልማዳቸውም ደማቸው እስኪፈስስ ድረስ ገላቸውን በካራና በቀጭኔ ይብዋጭሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the of the offering of the sacrifice, that neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.text_amharic: ቀትርም ካለፈ በኋላ መሥዋዕተ ሠርክ እስኪደርስ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር፤ ድምፅም አልነበረም፥ የሚመልስና የሚያደምጥም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD broken down.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ አላቸው። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ። ፈርሶ የነበረውንም የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ አበጀ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። ስምህ እስራኤል ይሆናል የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ደረሰለት እንደ ያዕቆብ ልጆች ነገድ ቍጥር አሥራ ሁለቱን ድንጋዮች ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.text_amharic: ከድንጋዮችም ለእግዚአብሔር ስም መሠዊያ ሠራ፤ በመሠዊያውም ዙሪያ ሁለት መስፈሪያ እህል የሚያዝ ጕድጓድ ቈፈረ።

verses.text_english: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.text_amharic: እንጨቱንም በተርታ አደረገ፥ ወይፈኑንም በብልት በብልቱ ቈረጠ፥ በእንጨቱም ላይ አኖረና።

verses.text_english: And he said, Do the second time. And they did the second time. And he said, Do the third time. And they did the third time.
verses.text_amharic: አራት ጋን ውኃ ሙሉ በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና በእንጨቱ ላይ አፍስሱ አሉ። ደግሞም። ድገሙ አለ፤ እነርሱም ደገሙ። እርሱም። ሦስተኛ አድርጉ አለ፤ ሦስተኛም አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውም በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ፈሰሰ፤ ደግሞም ጕድጓዱን በውኃ ሞላው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the offering of the sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou God in Israel, and I thy servant, and I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.text_amharic: መሥዋዕተ ሠርክ በሚቀርብበት ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤልያስ ቀርቦ። አቤቱ፥ የአብርሃምና የይስሐቅ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ በእስራኤል ላይ አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ፥ እኔም ባሪያህ እንደ ሆንሁ፥ ይህንም ሁሉ በቃልህ እንዳደረግሁ ዛሬ ይገለጥ።

verses.text_english: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou the LORD God, and thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ፥ አቤቱ፥ አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ፥ ልባቸውንም ደግሞ እንደ መለስህ ይህ ሕዝብ ያውቅ ዘንድ ስማኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስማኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that in the trench.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት ወደቀች፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕቱንም እንጨቱንም ድንጋዮቹንም አፈሩንም በላች፥ በጕድጓዱም ውስጥ ያለውን ውኃ ላሰች።

verses.text_english: And when all the people saw , they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he the God; the LORD, he the God.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ያንን ባዩ ጊዜ በግምባራቸው ተደፍተው። እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ ነው አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። ከበኣል ነቢያት አንድ ሰው እንዳያመልጥ ያዙ አላቸው። ያዙአቸውም፤ ኤልያስም ወደ ቂሶን ወንዝ ወስዶ በዚያ አሳረዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም አክዓብን። የዝናቡ ውሽንፍር እጅግ ነውና ተነሥተህ ውጣ፥ ብላም ጠጣም አለው።

verses.text_english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ሊበላና ሊጠጣ ወጣ፤ ኤልያስም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ አናት ወጣ፤ ፊቱንም በጕልበቱ መካከል አድርጎ በግምባሩ ተደፋ።

verses.text_english: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴናውንም። ወጥተህ ወደ ባሕሩ ተመልከት አለው። ወጥቶም ተመልክቶም። ምንም የለም አለ። እርሱም። ሰባት ጊዜ ተመላለስ አለው። ብላቴናውም ሰባት ጊዜ ተመላለሰ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare , and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ጊዜ። እነሆ፥ የሰው እጅ የምታህል ታናሽ ደመና ከባሕር ወጥች አለ። እርሱም። ወጥተህ አክዓብን። ዝናብ እንዳይከለክልህ ሰረገላን ጭነህ ውረድ በለው አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂትም ጊዜ በኋላ ሰማዩ ከደመናውና ከነፋሱ የተነሣ ጨለመ፥ ብዙም ዝናብ ሆነ፤ አክዓብም በሰረገላው ተቀምጦ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በኤልያስ ላይ ነበረች፤ ወገቡንም አሸንፍጦ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል እስኪገባ ድረስ በአክዓብ ፊት ይሮጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ኤልያስ ይህን ሁሉ እንዳደረገ፥ ነቢያትንም ሁሉ በሰይፍ እንደ ገደለ ለኤልዛቤል ነገራት።

verses.text_english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do , and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዛቤልም። ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ ነፍስህን ከእነዚህ እንደ አንዲቱ ነፍስ ባላደርጋት፥ አማልክት ይህን ያድርጉብኝ ይህንም ይጨምሩብኝ ብላ ወደ ኤልያስ መልእክተኛ ላከች።

verses.text_english: And when he saw , he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which to Judah, and left his servant there.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ፈርቶ ተነሣ፥ ነፍሱንም ሊያድን ሄደ፥ በይሁዳም ወዳለው ወደ ቤርሳቤህ መጥቶ ብላቴናውን በዚያ ተወ።

verses.text_english: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I not better than my fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አንድ ቀን የሚያህል መንገድ በምድረ በዳ ሄደ፤ መጥቶም ከክትክታ ዛፍ በታች ተቀመጠና። ይበቃኛል፤ አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ እኔ ከአባቶቼ አልበልጥምና ነፍሴን ውሰድ ብሎ እንዲሞት ለመነ።

verses.text_english: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise eat.
verses.text_amharic: በክትክታውም ዛፍ በታች ተጋደመ እንቅልፍም አንቀላፋ፤ እነሆም፥ መልአክ ዳሰሰውና። ተነሥተህ ብላ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he looked, and, behold, a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verses.text_amharic: ሲመለከትም፥ እነሆ፥ በራሱ አጠገብ የተጋገረ እንጎቻና በማሰሮ ውኃ አገኘ። በላም ጠጣም፥ ተመልሶም ተኛ።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise eat; because the journey too great for thee.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ደግሞ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ መጥቶ ዳሰሰውና። የምትሄድበት መንገድ ሩቅ ነውና ተነሥተህ ብላ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቶም በላ ጠጣም፤ በዚያም ምግብ ኃይል እስከ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ እስከ ኮሬብ ድረስ አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.text_amharic: እዚያም ወዳለ ዋሻ መጣ፥ በዚያም አደረ፤ እነሆም። ኤልያስ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምን ታደርጋለህ? የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ለሠራዊት አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ቀንቻለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ቃል ኪዳንህን ትተዋልና፥ መሠዊያዎችህንም አፍርሰዋልና፥ ነቢያትህንም በሰይፍ ገድለዋልና፤ እኔም ብቻዬን ቀርቻለሁ፤ ነፍሴንም ሊወስዱአት ይሻሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD; the LORD not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; the LORD not in the earthquake:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ውጣ፥ በተራራውም ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቁም አለ። እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር አለፈ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ትልቅና ብርቱ ነፋስ ተራሮቹን ሰነጠቀ ዓለቶቹንም ሰባበረ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በነፋሱ ውስጥ አልነበረም። ከነፋሱም በኋላ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በምድር መናወጥ ውስጥ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And after the earthquake a fire; the LORD not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድር መናወጥ በኋላ እሳት ሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በእሳቱ ውስጥ አልነበረም። ከእሳቱም በኋላ ትንሽ የዝምታ ድምፅ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And it was , when Elijah heard , that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ያን በሰማ ጊዜ ፊቱን በመጐናጸፊያው ሸፈነ፥ ወጥቶም በዋሻው ደጃፍ ቆመ። እነሆ። ኤልያስ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምን ታደርጋለህ? የሚል ድምፅ ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ለሠራዊት አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ቀንቻለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ቃል ኪዳንህን ትተዋልና፥ መሠዊያዎችህንም አፍርሰዋልና፥ ነቢያትህንም በሰይፍ ገድለዋልና፤ እኔም ብቻዬን ቀርቻለሁ፤ ነፍሴንም ሊወስዱአት ይሻሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael king over Syria:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ሂድ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ በምድረ በዳ ወደ ደማስቆ ተመለስ፤ ከዚያም በደረስህ ጊዜ በሶርያ ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ አዛሄልን ቅባው፤

verses.text_english: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint prophet in thy room.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ የናሜሲን ልጅ ኢዩን ቅባው፤ በፋንታህም ነቢይ ይሆን ዘንድ የአቤልምሖላን ሰው የሣፋጥን ልጅ ኤልሳዕን ቅባው ከአዛሄልም ሰይፍ ያመለጠውን ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዩ ይገድለዋል፤ ከኢዩም ሰይፍ ያመለጠውን ሁሉ ኤልሳዕ ይገድለዋል።

verses.text_english: Yet I have left seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከእስራኤል ጕልበታቸውን ለበኣል ያላንበረከኩትን ሁሉ፥ በአፋቸውም ያልሳሙትን ሁሉ፥ ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ለእኔ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.text_english: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who plowing twelve yoke before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ሄደ፥ የሣፋጥንም ልጅ ኤልሳዕን በአሥራ ሁለት ጥማድ በሬዎች ሲያርስ፥ እርሱም ከአሥራ ሁለተኛው ጋር ሆኖ አገኘው። ኤልያስም ወደ እርሱ አልፎ መጐናጸፊያውን ጣለበት።

verses.text_english: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
verses.text_amharic: በሬዎቹንም ተወ፥ ከኤልያስም በኋላ ሮጦ። አባቴንና እናቴን እስማቸው ዘንድ፥ እባክህ፥ ተወኝ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ እከተልሃለሁ አለው። እርሱም። ሂድና ተመለስ፤ ምን አድርጌልሃለሁ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ዘንድ ተመልሶ ሁለቱን በሬዎች ወስዶ አረዳቸው፥ ሥጋቸውንም በበሬዎቹ ዕቃ ቀቀለው፥ ለሕዝቡም ሰጣቸው፥ በሉም፤ እርሱም ተነሥቶ ኤልያስን ተከትሎ ሄደ፥ ያገለግለውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ጭፍራውን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ሠላሳ ሁለት ነገሥት ነበሩ፥ ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎችም ነበሩ፤ ወጥቶም ሰማርያን ከበበ፥ ወጋትም።

verses.text_english: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ ወደ አክዓብ።

verses.text_english: Thy silver and thy gold mine; thy wives also and thy children, the goodliest, mine.
verses.text_amharic: ወልደ አዴር እንዲህ ይላል። ብርህና ወርቅህ ለእኔ ነው፤ ሴቶችህና መልካካሞቹም ልጆችህ ለእኔ ናቸው ብሎ ወደ ከተማይቱ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I thine, and all that I have.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ መልሶ። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አንተ እንዳልህ ነው፤ እኔ ለእኔም የሆነው ሁሉ የአንተ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም መልእክተኞች ተመልሰው። ወልደ አዴር እንዲህ ይላል። ቀድሞ ብርህንና ወርቅህን ሴቶችህንና ልጆችህንም ትሰጠኛለህ ብዬ ልኬብህ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put in their hand, and take away.
verses.text_amharic: ነገም በዚህ ጊዜ ባሪያዎቼን እልክብሃለሁ፥ ቤትህንም የባሪያዎችህንም ቤቶች ይበረብራሉ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኛቸውንም ሁሉ በእጃቸው አድርገው ይወስዳሉ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የአገሩን ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ጠርቶ። ተመልከቱ፥ ይህም ሰው ክፉ እንዲሻ እዩ፤ ስለ ሴቶቼ ስለ ልጆቼ ስለ ብሬና ወርቄም ላከብኝ፥ እንቢም አላልሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not , nor consent.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌዎችም ሁሉ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። አትስማው፥ እሺም አትበለው አሉት።

verses.text_english: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
verses.text_amharic: ለወልደ አዴርም መልእክተኞች። ለጌታዬ ለንጉሥ። ለእኔ ለባሪያህ በመጀመሪያ የላክህብኝ ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ፤ ይህን ግን አደርገው ዘንድ አይቻለኝም በሉት አላቸው። መልእክተኞችም ተመልሰው ይህን አወሩለት።

verses.text_english: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ወልደ አዴርም። ለሚከተለኝ ሕዝብ የሰማርያ ትቢያ ጭብጥ ጭብጥ ይበቃው እንደ ሆነ፥ አማልክት ይህን ያድርጉብኝ ይህን ይጨምሩብኝ ብሎ ላከበት።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell , Let not him that girdeth on boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ መልሶ። በቃ፤ ለሰልፍ የሚታጠቅ ጋሻ ጦሩን እንደሚያወልቅ አይመካ አለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when heard this message, as he drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set . And they set against the city.
verses.text_amharic: ወልደ አዴርም ያን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ይጠጣ ነበር፤ ባሪያዎቹንም። ተሰለፉ አላቸው፤ እነርሱም በከተማይቱ ትይዪ ተሰለፉ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ነቢይ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ አክዓብ ቀርቦ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህን ብዙ ጭፍራ ሁሉ ታያለህን? እነሆ፥ ዛሬ በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም። በማን? አለ፤ እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአውራጆቹ አለቆች ጕልማሶች አለ፤ እርሱም። ሰልፉን ማን ይጀምራል? አለ፤ እርሱም። አንተ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, all the children of Israel, seven thousand.
verses.text_amharic: የአውራጆቹንም አለቆች ጕልማሶች ቈጠረ፥ ሁለት መቶም ሠላሳ ሁለት ነበሩ፤ ከእነርሱም በኋላ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሁሉ፥ ቈጠረ፥ ሰባትም ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
verses.text_amharic: ቀትርም በሆነ ጊዜ ወጡ፤ ወልደ አዴር ረዳቶቹም ሠላሳ ሁለቱ ነገሥታት እየጠጡ በድንኳን ውስጥ ይሰክሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: የአውራጆቹም አለቆች ጕልማሶች አስቀድመው ወጡ፤ ወልደ አዴርም መልእክተኞችን ላከ፥ እነርሱም። ሰዎች ከሰማርያ ወጥተዋል ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ለዕርቅ ወይም ለሰልፍ መጥተው እንደ ሆነ በሕይወታቸው ያዙአቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም የአውራጆች አለቆች ጕልማሶች ከከተማይቱ ወጡ፥ ሠራዊትም ተከተላቸው።
