verses.text_english: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በእያንዳንዱ በፊቱ የነበረውን ሰው ገደለ፥ ሶርያውያንም ሸሹ፤ እስራኤልም አሳደዱአቸው፥ የሶርያም ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር በፈረሱ አመለጠ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ንጉሥም ወጥቶ ፈረሶቹንና ሰረገሎቹን ያዘ፥ ሶርያውያንንም በታላቅ ውጊት ገደላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ቀርቦ። የሶርያ ንጉሥ በሚመጣው ዓመት ይመጣብሃልና ሂድ፥ በርታ፥ የምታደርገውንም ተመልከትና እወቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች እንዲህ አሉት። አምላካቸው የተራሮች አምላክ ነው፤ ስለዚህ በርትተውብን ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በሜዳ ላይ ከእነርሱ ጋር ብንዋጋ በእርግጥ እንበረታባቸዋለን።

verses.text_english: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም አድርግ፤ ከጭፍሮችህ ነገሥታቱን አርቅ፥ በፋንታቸውም አለቆችን ሹም።

verses.text_english: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ቀድሞ እንደ ጠፋብህ ሠራዊት፥ ፈረሱን በፈረስ ፋንታ፥ ሰረገላውንም በሰረገላ ፋንታ፥ ሠራዊትን ቍጠር፤ በሜዳም ላይ ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዋጋለን፥ በእርግጥም እንበረታባቸዋለን። ምክራቸውንም ሰማ፥ እንዲሁም አደረገ። ፕ

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በሚመጣውም ዓመት ወልደ አዴር ሶርያውያንን አሰለፈ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ይዋጋ ዘንድ ወደ አፌቅ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተሰለፉ፥ ሊገጥሙአቸውም ወጡ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንደ ሁለት ትናንሾች የፍየል መንጋዎች ሆነው በፊታቸው ሰፈሩ፤ ሶርያውያን ግን ምድሩን ሞልተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD God of the hills, but he not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ቀርቦ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሶርያውያን። እግዚአብሔር የተራሮች አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሸለቆ አምላክ አይደለም ብለዋልና ይህን ታላቅ ጭፍራ ሁሉ በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም በእነዚያ ትይዩ ሰባት ቀን ያህል ሰፈሩ፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ተጋጠሙ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከሶርያውያን በአንድ ቀን መቶ ሺህ እግረኛ ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም ወደ አፌቅ ወደ ከተማይቱ ውስጥ ሸሹ፤ ቅጥሩም በቀሩት በሀያ ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ላይ ወደቀ። ወልደ አዴርም ሸሽቶ ወደ ከተማይቱ ወደ እልፍኙ ውስጥ ገባ።

verses.text_english: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹም። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት ነገሥታት መሐሪዎች እንደ ሆኑ ሰምተናል፤ በወገባችን ማቅ እንታጠቅ፥ በራሳችንም ገመድ እንጠምጥም፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ እንውጣ፤ ምናልባት ነፍስህን ይምራታል አሉት።

verses.text_english: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, he yet alive? he my brother.
verses.text_amharic: ወገባቸውንም በማቅ ታጠቁ፥ በራሳቸውም ገመድ ጠመጠሙ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ መጥተው። ባሪያህ ወልደ አዴር። ነፍሴን ትምራት ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎአል አሉት። እርሱም። ገና በሕይወቱ አለን? ወንድሜ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: Now the men did diligently observe whether from him, and did hastily catch : and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም የደግ ምልክት አደረጉትና ቃሉን ከአፉ ተቀብለው። ወንድምህ ወልደ አዴር አለ አሉት። እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ አምጡት አለ። ወልደ አዴርም ወደ እርሱ ወጣ፥ በሰረገላውም ላይ አስቀመጠው።

verses.text_english: And said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then , I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
verses.text_amharic: ወልደ አዴርም። አባቴ ከአባትህ የወሰዳቸውን ከተሞች እመልስልሃለሁ፤ አባቴ በሰማርያ እንዳደረገ አንተ በደማስቆ ገበያ ታደርጋለህ አለው። አክዓብም። እኔም በዚህ ቃል ኪዳን እሰድድሃለሁ አለ። ከእርሱም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርጎ ሰደደው።

verses.text_english: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
verses.text_amharic: ከነቢያትም ወገን አንድ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ባልንጀራውን። ምታኝ አለው። ሰውዮውም ይመታው ዘንድ እንቢ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማህምና እነሆ፥ ከእኔ በራቅህ ጊዜ አንበሳ ይገድልሃል አለው። ከእርሱም በራቀ ጊዜ አንበሳ አግኝቶ ገደለው።

verses.text_english: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded .
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሌላ ሰው አግኝቶ። ምታኝ አለው። ሰውዮውም መታው፥ በመምታቱም አቈሰለው።

verses.text_english: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ሄዶ በመንገድ አጠገብ ንጉሡን ቆየው፤ ዓይኖቹንም በቀጸላው ሸፍኖ ተሸሸገ።

verses.text_english: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ባለፈ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ጮኸ። ባሪያህ ወደ ሰልፍ መካከል ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ አንድ ሰው ፈቀቅ ብሎ ወደ እኔ አንድ ሰው አመጣና። ይህን ሰው ጠብቅ፥ ቢኰበልልም ነፍስህ በነፍሱ ፋንታ ትሆናለች፥ ወይም አንድ መክሊት ብር ትከፍላለህ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So thy judgment ; thyself hast decided .
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህም ወዲህና ወዲያ ሲመለከት ጠፋ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ፍርድህ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ አንተ ፈርድኸዋል አለው።

verses.text_english: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጥኖም ቀጸላውን ከዓይኑ አነሣ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ከነቢያት ወገን እንደ ሆነ አወቀው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ እርም ያልሁትን ሰው ከእጅህ አውጥተሃልና ነፍስህ በነፍሱ ፋንታ ሕዝብህም በሕዝቡ ፋንታ ይሆናሉ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ እየተቈጣና እየተናደደ ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ፥ ወደ ሰማርያም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ለኢይዝራኤላዊውም ለናቡቴ በሰማርያ ንጉሥ በአክዓብ ቤት አጠገብ የወይን ቦታ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; , if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ናቡቴን። በቤቴ አቅራቢያ ነውና የአትክልት ቦታ አደርገው ዘንድ የወይን ቦታህን ስጠኝ፤ ስለ እርሱም ከእርሱ የተሻለ የወይን ቦታ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ ወይም ብትወድድ ግምቱን ገንዘብ እሰጥሃለሁ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ናቡቴም አክዓብን። የአባቶቼን ርስት እሰጥህ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያርቅልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
verses.text_amharic: ኢይዝራኤላዊውም ናቡቴ። የአባቶቼን ርስት አልሰጥህም ብሎ ስለ ተናገረው አክዓብ ተቈጥቶና ተናድዶ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ። በአልጋውም ላይ ተጋድሞ ፊቱን ተሸፋፈነ፥ እንጀራም አልበላም።

verses.text_english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቱም ኤልዛቤል ወደ እርሱ መጥታ። ልብህ የሚያዝን እንጀራስ የማትበላ ስለምንድር ነው? አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ኢይዝራኤላዊውን ናቡቴን። የወይንህን ቦታ በገንዘብ ስጠኝ፤ ወይም ብትወድድ በፋንታው ሌላ የወይን ቦታ እሰጥሃለሁ ብዬ ተናገርሁት፤ እርሱ ግን። የወይን ቦታዬን አልሰጥህም ብሎ ስለ መለሰልኝ ነው አላት።

verses.text_english: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቱም ኤልዛቤል። አንተ አሁን የእስራኤልን መንግሥት ትገዛለህን? ተነሣ እንጀራም ብላ፥ ልብህም ደስ ይበላት፤ የኢይዝራኤላዊውን የናቡቴን የወይን ቦታ እሰጥሃለሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
verses.text_amharic: በአክዓብም ስም ደብዳቤ ጻፈች፥ በማኅተሙም አተመችው፤ በከተማው ወደ ነበሩትና ከናቡቴም ጋር ወደ ተቀመጡት ሽማግሌዎችና ከበርቴዎች ደብዳቤውን ላከች።

verses.text_english: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
verses.text_amharic: በደብዳቤውም። ስለ ጾም አዋጅ ንገሩ፥ ናቡቴንም በሕዝቡ ፊት አስቀምጡት፤

verses.text_english: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለትም ምናምንቴ ሰዎች በፊቱ አስቀምጡና። እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሡን ሰድቦአል ብለው ይመስክሩበት፤ አውጥታችሁም እስኪሞት ድረስ ውገሩት ብላ ጻፈች።

verses.text_english: And the men of his city, the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, as it written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማውም የተቀመጡት የከተማው ሰዎችና ሽማግሌዎች ከበርቴዎችም ኤልዛቤል እንዳዘዘቻቸውና ወደ እነርሱ በተላከው ደብዳቤ እንደ ተጻፈ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
verses.text_amharic: የጾም አዋጅ ነገሩ፥ ናቡቴንም በሕዝቡ ፊት አስቀመጡት።

verses.text_english: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም ምናምንቴ ሰዎች ገብተው በፊቱ ተቀመጡ፤ ምናምንቴዎቹ ሰዎችም በሕዝቡ ፊት። ናቡቴ እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሡን ሰድቦአል ብለው በናቡቴ ላይ መሰከሩ። የዚያን ጊዜም ከከተማ አውጥተው እስኪሞት ድረስ ወገሩት።

verses.text_english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኤልዛቤልም። ናቡቴ ተወግሮ ሞተ ብለው ላኩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዛቤልም ናቡቴ ተወግሮ እንደ ሞተ በሰማች ጊዜ ኤልዛቤል አክዓብን። ናቡቴ ሞቶአል እንጂ በሕይወት አይደለምና በገንዘብ ይሰጥህ ዘንድ እንቢ ያለውን የኢይዝራኤላዊውን የናቡቴን የወይን ቦታ ተነሥተህ ውረስ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ናቡቴ እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ ይወርሰው ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤላዊው ወደ ናቡቴ ወይን ቦታ ሊወርድ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ቴስብያዊው ወደ ኤልያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which in Samaria: behold, in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተህ በሰማርያ የሚኖረውን የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ አክዓብን ትገናኝ ዘንድ ውረድ፤ እነሆ፥ ይወርሰው ዘንድ በወረደበት በናቡቴ የወይን ቦታ ውስጥ አለ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ገድለህ ወረስኸውን? ብለህ ንገረው። ደግሞም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ውሾች የናቡቴን ደም በላሱበት ስፍራ የአንተን ደም ደግሞ ውሾች ይልሱታል ብለህ ንገረው።

verses.text_english: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found : because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ኤልያስን። ጠላቴ ሆይ፥ አገኘኸኝን? አለው። እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። አግኝቼሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ለማድረግ ራስህን ሽጠሃልና።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር አመጣብሃለሁ፥ ፈጽሞም እጠርግሃለሁ፥ ከአክዓብም በእስራኤል ዘንድ የታሰረውንና የተለቀቀውን ወንድ ሁሉ አጠፋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked to anger, and made Israel to sin.
verses.text_amharic: በሥራህም አስቈጥተኸኛልና፥ እስራኤልንም አስተሃልና ቤትህን እንደ ናባጥ ልጅ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት እንደ አኪያም ልጅ እንደ ባኦስ ቤት አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኤልዛቤል። በኢይዝራኤል ቅጥር አጠገብ ኤልዛቤልን ውሾች ይበሉአታል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.text_amharic: ከአክዓብም ወገን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳውም የሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፋት ለመሥራት ራሱን እንደ ሸጠ፥ ሚስቱም ኤልዛቤል እንደ ነዳችው፥ እንደ አክዓብ ያለ ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ያጠፋቸው አሞራውያን እንደ ሠሩት ሁሉ፥ ጣዖታትን በመከተል እጅግ ርኩስ ነገር ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ይህን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ ገላውን ማቅ አለበሰ፥ ጾመም፥ በማቅ ላይም ተኛ፥ ቅስስ ብሎም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። አክዓብ በፊቴ እንደ ተዋረደ አየህን? በፊቴ የተዋረደ ስለ ሆነ በልጁ ዘመን በቤቱ ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣለሁ እንጂ በእርሱ ዘመን ክፉ ነገር አላመጣም የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ቴስብያዊው ወደ ኤልያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያና እስራኤልም ሳይዋጉ ሦስት ዓመት ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead ours, and we still, take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባሪያዎቹን። ሬማት ዘገለዓድ የእኛ እንደ ሆነች፥ እኛም ከሶርያ ንጉሥ እጅ ሳንወስዳት ዝም እንዳልን ታውቃላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I as thou , my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥንም። በሬማት ዘገለዓድ እንዋጋ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር ትመጣለህን? አለው። ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። እኔ እንደ አንተ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ፥ ፈረሶቼም እንደ ፈረሶችህ ናቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አስቀድመህ ትጠይቅ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver into the hand of the king.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ነቢያቶቹን አራት መቶ የሚያህሉትን ሰዎች ሰብስቦ። ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ ልሂድን? ወይስ ልቅር? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ውጣ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat said, not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን። እንጠይቀው ዘንድ ሌላ የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ በዚህ አይገኝምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት የይምላ ልጅ ሚክያስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው አለ፤ ነገር ግን ክፉ እንጂ መልካም ትንቢት አይናገርልኝምና እጠላዋለሁ አለው። ኢዮሣፍጥም። ንጉሥ እንዲህ አይበል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten Micaiah the son of Imlah.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አንዱን ጃንደረባ ጠርቶ። የይምላን ልጅ ሚክያስን ፈጥነህ አምጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ልብሰ መንግሥት ለብሰው በሰማርያ በር መግቢያ አጠገብ በአደባባይ በዙፋኖቻቸው ላይ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ነቢያቶቹም ሁሉ በፊታቸው ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
verses.text_amharic: የክንዓና ልጅ ሴዴቅያስም የብረት ቀንዶች ሠርቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በእነዚህ ሶርያውያንን ትወጋለህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver into the king's hand.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢያትም ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ሂድና ተከናወን እያሉ እንዲህ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak good.
verses.text_amharic: ሚክያስንም ሊጠራ የሄደ መልእክተኛ። እነሆ፥ ነቢያት ሁሉ በአንድ አፍ ሆነው ለንጉሡ መልካምን ይናገራሉ፤ ቃልህም እንደ ቃላቸው እንዲሆን መልካም እንድትናገር እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Micaiah said, the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
verses.text_amharic: ሚክያስም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እግዚአብሔር የሚነግረኝን እርሱን እናገራለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver into the hand of the king.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ንጉሡም በመጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡ። ሚክያስ ሆይ፥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ እንሂድን? ወይስ እንቅር? አለው፤ እርሱም። ውጣና ተከናወን፤ እግዚአብሔርም በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but true in the name of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ከእውነት በቀር በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንዳትነግረኝ ስንት ጊዜ አምልሃለሁ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሁሉ ጠባቂ እንደሌላቸው በጎች በተራሮች ላይ ተበትነው አየሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ለእነዚህ ጌታ የላቸውም እያንዳንዱም በሰላም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ አለ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ክፉ እንጂ መልካም እንደማይናገርልኝ አላልሁህምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.text_amharic: ሚክያስም አለ። እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር በዙፋኑ ተቀምጦ፥ የሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ በቀኙና በግራው ቆመው አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ወጥቶ በሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይወድቅ ዘንድ አክዓብን የሚያሳስት ማን ነው? አለ። አንዱም እንዲህ ያለ ነገር፥ ሌላውም እንዲያ የለ ነገር ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስም ወጣ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቆሞ። እኔ አሳስተዋለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade , and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። በምን? አለው፤ እርሱም። ወጥቼ በነቢያቶቹ ሁሉ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስ እሆናለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። ማሳሳትስ ታሳስተዋለህ፥ ይሆንልሃልም፤ ውጣ፥ እንዲሁም አድርግ አለ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በነቢያትህ ሁሉ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስ አድርጎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በላይህ ክፉ ተናግሮብሃል።

verses.text_english: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
verses.text_amharic: የክንዓናም ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ ቀረበ፥ ሚክያስንም ጕንጩን በጥፊ መታውና። አንተን ሊናገር የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በምን መንገድ ከእኔ አለፈ? አለ።

verses.text_english: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.text_amharic: ሚክያስም። እነሆ፥ በዚያ ቀን ልትሸሸግ ወደ እልፍኝህ በሄድህ ጊዜ ታያለህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ሚክያስን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ሹም ወደ አሞን ወደ ንጉሡም ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ መልሳችሁ። ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.text_amharic: በደኅና እስክመለስ ድረስ ይህን ሰው በግዞት አኑሩት፥ የመከራም እንጀራ መግቡት፥ የመከራም ውኃ አጠጡት በሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.text_amharic: ሚክያስም። በደኅና ብትመለስ እግዚአብሔር በእኔ የተናገረ አይደለም አለ። ደግሞም። አሕዛብ ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ልብሴን ለውጬ ወደ ሰልፍ እገባለሁ፤ አንተ ግን ልብስህን ልበስ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ልብሱን ለውጦ ወደ ሰልፍ ገባ።

verses.text_english: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ሠላሳ ሁለቱን የሰረገሎች አለቆች። ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ በቀር፥ ታናሽ ቢሆን ወይም ታላቅ ከማናቸውም ጋር አትግጠሙ ብሎ አዝዞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.text_amharic: የሰረገሎች አለቆችም ኢዮሣፍጥን ባዩ ጊዜ። በእውነት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነው አሉ፤ ይገጥሙትም ዘንድ ከበቡት፤ ኢዮሣፍጥም ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰረገሎች አለቆችም የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እንዳልሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ እርሱን ከማሳደድ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And a man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰውም ቀስቱን ድንገት ገትሮ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ በጥሩሩ ልብስ መጋጠሚያ በኩል ወጋው፤ ሰረገለኛውንም። መልሰህ ንዳ፥ ተወግቻለሁና ከሰልፍ ውስጥ አውጣኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሰልፍ በረታ፤ ንጉሡም በሶርያውያን ፊት በሰረገላው ላይ ተደግፎ ነበር፥ ማታም ሞተ፤ የቍስሉም ደም በሰረገላው ውስጥ ፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.text_amharic: በሠራዊቱም መካከል ፀሐይ ስትገባ። ንጉሡ ሞቶአልና እያንዳንዱ ወደ ከተማው፥ እያንዳንዱም ወደ አገሩ ይሂድ የሚል ጩኸት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰማርያም መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም በሰማርያ ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: And washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
verses.text_amharic: አመንዝሮች በታጠቡባት በሰማርያ ኵሬ ሰረገላውን አጠቡት፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው ቃል ውሾች ደሙን ላሱት።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የአክዓብ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ከዝሆን ጥርስም የሠራው ቤት፥ የሠራቸውም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት የአሳ ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Jehoshaphat thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ጎበዝ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ። እናቱም ዓዙባ የተባለች የሺልሒ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing right in the eyes of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: በአባቱም በአሳ መንገድ ሁሉ ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አላለም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አላራቀም፤ ሕዝቡ ገና በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away; the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ጋር ታረቀ።  vፕ

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የኢዮሣፍጥ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ጭከና፥ እንዴትም እንደ ተወጋ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቱ ከአሳ ዘመን የተረፉትን ሰዶማውያን ከምድር አጠፋ።

verses.text_english: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.text_amharic: በኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ አልነበረም፤ ሹሙም እንደ ንጉሥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: then no king in Edom: a deputy king.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም ወደ ኦፊር ሄደው ወርቅ ያመጡ ዘንድ የተርሴስን መርከቦች ሠራ፤ ነገር ግን መርከቦቹ በዔጽዮንጋብር ተሰበሩ እንጂ አልሄዱም።

verses.text_english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.
verses.text_amharic: የአክዓብም ልጅ አካዝያስ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር በመርከብ ይሂዱ አለው፤ ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ ኢዮራም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የአክዓብ ልጅ አካዝያስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በአባቱና በእናቱም መንገድ፥ እስራኤልንም ባሳተው በናባጥ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም መንገድ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
verses.text_amharic: በኣልንም አመለከ ሰገደለትም፤ አባቱም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣ።

verses.text_english: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ከሞተ በኋላ ሞዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.text_english: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝያስም በሰማርያ በሰገነቱ ላይ ሳለ ከዓይነ ርግቡ ወድቆ ታመመ፤ እርሱም። ሂዱ ከዚህም ደዌ እድን እንደ ሆነ የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ጠይቁ ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.text_english: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, not because not a God in Israel, ye go to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ቴስብያዊውን ኤልያስን። ተነሣ፥ የሰማርያን ንጉሥ መልእክተኞች ለመገናኘት ውጣና። የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቁ ዘንድ የምትሄዱት በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም በላቸው አለው። ኤልያስም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
verses.text_amharic: መልእክተኞችም ወደ አካዝያስ ተመለሱ፥ እርሱም። ለምን ተመለሳችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, not because not a God in Israel, thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አንድ ሰው ሊገናኘን መጣና። ሂዱ፥ ወደ ላካችሁም ንጉሥ ተመልሳችሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቅ ዘንድ የላከህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን? ስለዚህ ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም በሉት አለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What manner of man which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሊገናኛችሁ የወጣው፥ ይህንስ ቃል የነገራችሁ ሰው መልኩ ምን ይመስላል? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they answered him, an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It Elijah the Tishbite.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሰውዮው ጠጕራም ነው፥ በወገቡም ጠፍር ታጥቆ ነበር አሉት። እርሱም። ቴስብያዊው ኤልያስ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የአምሳ አለቃውን ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ሰደደ፥ ወደ እርሱም ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ በተራራ ራስ ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር። እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ንጉሡ። ውረድ ይልሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም መልሶ የአምሳ አለቃውን። እኔስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ እሳት ከሰማይ ትውረድ፥ አንተንም፥ አምሳውንም ሰዎችህን ትብላ አለው። እሳትም ከሰማይ ወርዳ እርሱንና አምሳውን ሰዎቹን በላች።

verses.text_english: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሌላ የአምሳ አለቃ ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ላከበት፤ እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ንጉሡ። ፈጥነህ ውረድ ይላል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። እኔስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ እሳት ከሰማይ ትውረድ፥ አንተንም አምሳውንም ሰዎችህን ትብላ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዳ እርሱንና አምሳውን ሰዎቹን በላች።

verses.text_english: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሦስተኛ የአምሳ አለቃ ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ሰደደ፤ ሦስተኛውም የአምሳ አለቃ ወጥቶ በኤልያስ ፊት በጕልበቱ ተንበረከከና። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ነፍሴና የእነዚህ የአምሳው ባሪያዎችህ ነፍስ በፊትህ የከበረች ትሁን።

verses.text_english: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዳ የፊተኞቹን ሁለቱን የአምሳ አለቆችና አምሳ አምሳውን ሰዎቻቸውን በላች፤ አሁን ግን ነፍሴ በፊትህ የከበረች ትሁን ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ኤልያስን። ከእርሱ ጋር ውረድ፥ አትፍራውም አለው። ተነሥቶም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ንጉሡ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, not because no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቅ ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን ልከሃልና ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም አለው።

verses.text_english: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ሞተ። ልጅም አልነበረውምና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ በኢዮራም በሁለተኛው ዓመት ወንድሙ ኢዮራም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: አካዝያስ ያደረገው የቀረው ነገር በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እግዚአብሔር ኤልያስን በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ ሊያወጣው በወደደ ጊዜ ኤልያስ ከኤልሳዕ ጋር ከጌልገላ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said the LORD liveth, and thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም ኤልሳዕን። እግዚአብሔር ወደ ቤቴል ልኮኛልና በዚህ ቆይ አለው። ኤልሳዕም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ፥ አልለይህም አለ። ወደ ቤቴልም ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of the prophets that at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know ; hold ye your peace.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴልም የነበሩ የነቢያት ልጆች ወደ ኤልሳዕ ወጥተው። እግዚአብሔር ጌታህን ከራስህ ላይ ዛሬ እንዲወስደው አውቀሃልን? አሉት። እርሱም። አዎን፥ አውቄአለሁ፤ ዝም በሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, the LORD liveth, and thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። ኤልሳዕ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ኢያሪኮ ልኮኛልና እባክህ፥ በዚህ ቆይ አለው። እርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ፥ አልለይህም አለ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of the prophets that at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know ; hold ye your peace.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢያሪኮም መጡ። በኢያሪኮም የነበሩ የነቢያት ልጆች ወደ ኤልሳዕ ቀርበው። እግዚአብሔር ጌታህን ከራስህ ላይ ዛሬ እንዲወስደው አውቀሃልን? አሉት። እርሱም። አዎን አውቄአለሁ፤ ዝም በሉ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, the LORD liveth, and thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም። እግዚአብሔር ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ልኮኛልና እባክህ፥ በዚህ ቆይ አለው። እርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ፥ አልለይህም አለ። ሁለቱም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ከነቢያትም ልጆች አምሳ ሰዎች ሄዱ፥ በፊታቸውም ርቀው ቆሙ፤ እነዚህም ሁለቱ በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም መጐናጸፊያውን ወስዶ ጠቀለለው፥ ውኃውንም መታ፥ ወዲህና ወዲያም ተከፈለ፤ ሁለቱም በደረቅ ተሻገሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሻገሩም በኋላ ኤልያስ ኤልሳዕን። ከአንተ ሳልወሰድ አደርግልህ ዘንድ የምትሻውን ለምን አለው፤ ኤልሳዕም። መንፈስህ በእኔ ላይ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሆን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: , if thou see me taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be .
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አስቸጋሪ ነገር ለምነሃል፤ ነገር ግን ከአንተ ዘንድ በተወሰድሁ ጊዜ ብታየኝ ይሆንልሃል፤ አለዚያ ግን አይሆንልህም አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄዱም። እያዘገሙም ሲጫወቱ፥ እነሆ፥ የእሳት ሰረገላና የእሳት ፈረሶች በመካከላቸው ገብተው ከፈሉአቸው፤ ኤልያስም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Elisha saw , and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም አይቶ። አባቴ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ሰረገላና ፈረሰኞች፥ ብሎ ጮኸ። ከዚያም ወዲያ አላየውም፤ ልብሱንም ይዞ ከሁለት ተረተረው።

verses.text_english: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
verses.text_amharic: ከኤልያስም የወደቀውን መጐናጸፊያ አነሣ፥ ተመልሶም በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤልያስም የወደቀውን መጎናጸፊያ ወስዶ ውኃውን መታና። የኤልያስ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወዴት ነው? አለ፤ ውኃውንም በመታ ጊዜ ወዲህና ወዲያ ተከፈለ፤ ኤልሳዕም ተሻገረ።

verses.text_english: And when the sons of the prophets which to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢያሪኮም መጥተው በአንጻሩ የነበሩት የነቢያት ልጆች ባዩት ጊዜ። የኤልያስ መንፈስ በኤልሳዕ ላይ ዐርፎአል አሉ። ሊገናኙትም መጥተው በፊቱ ወደ ምድር ተደፉ።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር አምሳ ኃያላን ሰዎች አሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አንሥቶ ወደ አንድ ተራራ ወይም ወደ አንድ ሸለቆ ጥሎት እንደ ሆነ፥ ሄደው ጌታህን ይፈልጉት ዘንድ እንለምንሃለን አሉት። እርሱም። አትስደዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
verses.text_amharic: እስኪያፍርም ድረስ ግድ ባሉት ጊዜ። ስደዱ አለ፤ አምሳም ሰዎች ሰደዱ፤ ሦስት ቀንም ፈልገው አላገኙትም።

verses.text_english: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water naught, and the ground barren.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አዲስ ማሰሮ አምጡልኝ፥ ጨውም ጨምሩበት አለ፤ ያንንም አመጡለት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought to him.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃው ወዳለበቱም ምንጭ ወጥቶ ጨው ጣለበትና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህን ውኃ ፈውሼዋለሁ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ሞትና ጭንገፋ አይሆንበትም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren .
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም እንደ ተናገረው ነገር ውኃው እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተፈውሶአል።

verses.text_english: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ቤቴል ወጣ፤ በመንገድም ሲወጣ ብላቴኖች ከከተማይቱ ወጥተው። አንተ መላጣ፥ ውጣ፤ አንተ መላጣ፥ ውጣ ብለው አፌዙበት።

verses.text_english: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
verses.text_amharic: ዘወርም ብሎ አያቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም ረገማቸው፤ ከዱርም ሁለት ድቦች ወጥተው ከብላቴኖች አርባ ሁለቱን ሰባበሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሄደ፥ ከዚያም ወደ ሰማርያ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት የአክዓብ ልጅ ኢዮራም በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን አባቱ ያሠራውን የበኣልን ሐውልት አርቆአልና እንደ አባቱና እንደ እናቱ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እስራኤልን ባሳታቸው በናባጥ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት ተያዘ፤ ከእርሱም አልራቀም።

verses.text_english: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
verses.text_amharic: የሞዓብም ንጉሥ ሞሳ ባለ በጎች ነበረ፤ ለእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የመቶ ሺህ ጠቦትና የመቶ ሺህ አውራ በጎች ጠጕር ይገብርለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አክዓብም ከሞተ በኋላ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.text_english: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ንጉሡ ኢዮራም ከሰማርያ ወጥቶ እስራኤልን ሁሉ አሰለፈ።

verses.text_english: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I as thou , my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ይሁዳም ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዮሣፍጥ። የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ዐምፆብኛልና ከእኔ ጋር በሞዓብ ላይ ለሰልፍ ትሄዳለህን? ብሎ ላከ። እርሱም። እወጣለሁ፤ እኔ እንደ አንተ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ፥ ፈረሶቼም እንደ ፈረሶችህ ናቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። በምን መንገድ እንሄዳለን? አለ፤ እርሱም። በኤዶምያስ ምድረ በዳ መንገድ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ሄዱ፤ የሰባትም ቀን መንገድ ዞሩ፤ ለሠራዊቱና ለተከተሉአቸውም እንስሶች ውኃ አልተገኘም።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ወዮ! እግዚአብሔር በሞዓብ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ እነዚህን ሦስቱን ነገሥታት ጠርቶአልና ወዮ አለ።

verses.text_english: But Jehoshaphat said, not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም። በእርሱ እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ በዚህ አይገኝምን? አለ። ከእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች አንዱ። በኤልያስ እጅ ላይ ውኃ ያፈስስ የነበረው የሣፋጥ ልጅ ኤልሳዕ እዚህ አለ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በእርሱ ዘንድ ይገኛል አለ። የእስራኤል ንጉሥና ኢዮሣፍጥ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ወደ እርሱ ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ወደ አባትህና ወደ እናትህ ነቢያት ሂድ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። አይደለም፥ በሞዓብ እጅ ይጥላቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን ሦስት ነገሥታት ጠርቶአል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Elisha said, the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም። በፊቱ የቆምሁት የሠራዊት ጌታ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን ያላፈርሁ ብሆን ኖሮ አንተን ባልተመለከትሁና ባላየሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ባለ በገና አምጡልኝ አለ። ባለ በገናውም በደረደረ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ መጣችበት፤

verses.text_english: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ሸለቆ ሁሉ ጕድጓድ ቆፈሩ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ነፋስ አታዩም፥ ዝናብም አታዩም፥ ይህ ሸለቆ ግን ውኃ ይሞላል፤ እናንተም ከብቶቻችሁም እንስሶቻችሁም ትጠጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And this is a light thing in the sight of the LORD: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ቀላል ነገር ነው፤ ደግሞም ሞዓባውያንን በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
verses.text_amharic: የተመሸጉትንና ያማሩትን ከተሞች ሁሉ ትመታላችሁ፥ የሚያፈሩትንም ዛፎች ሁሉ ትቈርጣላችሁ፥ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ሁሉ ትደፍናላችሁ፥ መልካሞችንም እርሻዎች ሁሉ በድንጋይ ታበላሻላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም የቍርባን ጊዜ ሲደርስ፥ እነሆ፥ ውኃ በኤዶምያስ መንገድ መጣ፥ ምድሪቱም ውኃ ሞላች።

verses.text_english: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓባውያንም ሁሉ ነገሥታት ሊወጉአቸው እንደ መጡ በሰሙ ጊዜ በወገባቸው ሰይፍ የሚታጠቁ ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ወጥተውም በአገሩ ድንበር ላይ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side red as blood:
verses.text_amharic: ማልደውም ተነሡ፤ ፀሐይም በውኃው ላይ አንጸባረቀ፥ ሞዓባውያንም በፊታቸው ውኃው እንደ ደም ቀልቶ አዩና። ይህ ደም ነው፤

verses.text_english: And they said, This blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
verses.text_amharic: በእርግጥ ነገሥታት እርስ በርሳቸው ተዋጉ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ተጋደሉ፤ ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ወደ ምርኮህ ሂድ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in country.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እስራኤል ሰፈር በመጡ ጊዜ እስራኤላውያን ተነሥተው ሞዓባውያንን መቱ፥ እነርሱም ከፊታቸው ሸሹ፤ ሞዓባውያንንም እየመቱ ወደ አገሩ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about , and smote it.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞችንም አፈረሱ፤ በመልካሞቹም እርሻዎች ሁሉ ላይ እስኪሞሉ ድረስ እያንዳንዱ ሰው አንድ አንድ ድንጋይ ይጥል ነበር፤ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ሁሉ ደፈኑ፥ የሚያፈሩትንም ዛፎች ሁሉ ቈረጡ፤ የቂርሐራሴትን ድንጋዮች ብቻ አስቀሩ፤ ባለ ወንጭፎች ግን ከብበው መቱአት።

verses.text_english: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
verses.text_amharic: የሞዓብም ንጉሥ ሰልፍ እንደ በረታበት ባየ ጊዜ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰባት መቶ ሰዎች ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ያልፉ ዘንድ ሞከሩ፤ አልቻሉምም።

verses.text_english: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to land.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ በእርሱ ፋንታ ንጉሥ የሚሆነውን የበኵር ልጁን ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በቅጥሩ ላይ አቀረበው። በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ታላቅ ቍጣ ሆነ፤ ከዚያም ርቀው ወደ ምድራቸው ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
verses.text_amharic: ከነቢያትም ወገን ሚስቶች አንዲት ሴት። ባሌ ባሪያህ ሞቶአል፤ ባሪያህም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈራ እንደ ነበረ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ ባለ ዕዳ ልጆቼን ባሪያዎች አድርጎ ሊወስዳቸው መጥቶአል ብላ ወደ ኤልሳዕ ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም። አደርግልሽ ዘንድ ምን ትሻለሽ? በቤትሽ ያለውን ንገሪኝ አላት። እርስዋም። ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ከዘይት ማሰሮ በቀር በቤቴ አንዳች የለኝም አለች።

verses.text_english: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሄደሽ ከጐረቤቶችሽ ሁሉ ከሜዳ ባዶ ማድጋዎችን ተዋሺ፤ አታሳንሻቸውም አላት።

verses.text_english: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
verses.text_amharic: ገብተሽም ከአንቺና ከልጆችሽ በኋላ በሩን ዝጊ፥ ወደ እነዚህም ማድጋዎች ሁሉ ዘይቱን ገልብጪ፤ የሞላውንም ፈቀቅ አድርጊ አለ።

verses.text_english: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought to her; and she poured out.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ከእርሱ ሄዳ በሩን ከእርስዋና ከልጆችዋ በኋላ ዘጋች፤ እነርሱም ማድጋዎቹን ወደ እርስዋ ያመጡ ነበር፥ እርስዋም ትገለብጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.text_amharic: ማድጋዎቹም በሞሉ ጊዜ ልጅዋን። ደግሞም ማድጋ አምጣልኝ አለችው፤ እርሱም። ሌላ ማድጋ የለም አላት፤ ዘይቱም ቆመ።

verses.text_english: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verses.text_amharic: መጥታም ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው ነገረችው፤ እርሱም። ሄደሽ ዘይቱን ሽጪ ለባለ ዕዳውም ክፈዪ፤ አንቺና ልጆችሽም ከተረፈው ተመገቡ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And it was, as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ኤልሳዕ ወደ ሱነም አለፈ፥ በዚያም ታላቅ ሴት ነበረች፤ እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ የግድ አለችው፤ በዚያም ባለፈ ቍጥር እንጀራ ሊበላ ወደዚያ ይገባ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
verses.text_amharic: ለባልዋም። ይህ በእኛ ዘንድ ሁልጊዜ የሚያልፈው ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.text_amharic: ትንሽ ቤት በሰገነቱ ላይ እንሥራ፤ በዚያም አልጋ ጠረጴዛ ወንበርና መቅረዝ እናኑርለት፤ ወደ እኛም ሲመጣ ወደዚያ ይገባል አለችው።

verses.text_english: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀንም ወደዚያ በመጣ ጊዜ ወደ ቤቱ ገብቶ በዚያ ዐረፈ።

verses.text_english: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.text_amharic: ሎሌውንም ግያዝን። ይህችን ሱነማዊት ጥራ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
verses.text_amharic: በጠራትም ጊዜ በፊቱ ቆመች። እርሱም። እነሆ፥ ይህን ሁሉ አሳብ አሰብሽልኝ፤ አሁንስ ምን ላድርግልሽ? ለንጉሥ ወይስ ለሠራዊት አለቃ ልንገርልሽን? በላት አለው፤ እርስዋም። እኔ በወገኔ መካከል ተቀምጫለሁ ብላ መለሰች።

verses.text_english: And he said, What then to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እንግዲህ ምን እናድርግላት? አለ። ግያዝም። ልጅ የላትም፤ ባልዋም ሸምግሎአል ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጥራት አለ። በጠራትም ጊዜ በደጃፉ ቆመች።

verses.text_english: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በሚመጣው ዓመት በዚህ ወራት ወንድ ልጅ ትታቀፊአለሽ አለ፤ እርስዋም። አይደለም ጌታዬ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ባሪያህን እንዳትዋሻት እለምንሃለሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ፀነሰች፥ በዚያም ወራት በአዲሱ ዓመት ኤልሳዕ እንዳላት ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ አንድ ቀንም እህል አጫጆች ወዳሉበት ወደ አባቱ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱንም። ራሴን ራሴን አለው፤ እርሱም ሎሌውን። ተሸክመህ ወደ እናቱ ውሰደው አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and died.
verses.text_amharic: አንሥቶም ወደ እናቱ ወሰደው፤ በጕልበትዋም ላይ እስከ ቀትር ድረስ ተቀመጠ፥ ሞተም።

verses.text_english: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut upon him, and went out.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥታም በእግዚአብሔር ሰው አልጋ ላይ አጋደመችው፥ በሩንም ዘግታበት ወጣች።

verses.text_english: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
verses.text_amharic: ባልዋንም ጠርታ። ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው በፍጥነት ደርሼ እመለስ ዘንድ አንድ ሎሌና አንድ አህያ ላክልኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, well.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። መባቻ ወይም ሰንበት ያይደለ ዛሬ ለምን ትሄጂበታለሽ? አለ። እርስዋም። ደኅና ነው አለች።

verses.text_english: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not riding for me, except I bid thee.
verses.text_amharic: አህያውንም አስጭና ሎሌዋን። ንዳ፥ ሂድ፤ እኔ ሳላዝዝህ አታዘግየኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, that Shunammite:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ሄደች፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ሰው ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ መጣች። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ከሩቅ ባያት ጊዜ ሎሌውን ግያዝን፥ እነኋት ሱነማዊቲቱ መጣች፤

verses.text_english: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, well with thee? well with thy husband? well with the child? And she answered, well.
verses.text_amharic: ትቀበላትም ዘንድ ሩጥና። በደኅናሽ ነውን? ባልሽ ደኅና ነውን? ልጅሽስ ደኅና ነውን? በላት አለው። እርስዋም። ደኅና ነው አለች።

verses.text_english: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid from me, and hath not told me.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ተራራው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው በመጣች ጊዜ እግሮቹን ጨበጠች፤ ግያዝም ሊያርቃት ቀረበ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ነፍስዋ አዝናለችና ተዋት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያንን ከእኔ ሰውሮታል አልነገረኝምም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። በውኑ ከጌታዬ ልጅን ለመንሁን? እኔም አታታልለኝ አላልሁህምን? አለች።

verses.text_english: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.text_amharic: ግያዝንም። ወገብህን ታጠቅ፥ በትሬንም በእጅህ ይዘህ ሂድ፤ ሰውም ብታገኝ ሰላም አትበል፥ እርሱም ሰላም ቢልህ አትመልስለት፤ በትሬንም በሕፃኑ ፊት ላይ አኑር አለው።

verses.text_english: And the mother of the child said, the LORD liveth, and thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.text_amharic: የሕፃኑም እናት። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ! አልተውህም አለች፤ ተነሥቶም ተከተላት።

verses.text_english: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.text_amharic: ግያዝም ቀደማቸው፥ በትሩንም በሕፃኑ ፊት ላይ አኖረው፤ ነገር ግን ድምፅ ወይም መስማት አልነበረም፤ እርሱንም ሊገናኘው ተመልሶ። ሕፃኑ አልነቃም ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, laid upon his bed.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም ወደ ቤት በገባ ጊዜ እነሆ፥ ሕፃኑ ሞቶ በአልጋው ላይ ተጋድሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ገብቶም በሩን ከሁለቱ በኋላ ዘጋ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.text_amharic: መጥቶም በሕፃኑ ላይ ተኛ፤ አፉንም በአፉ፥ ዓይኑንም በዓይኑ፥ እጁንም በእጁ ላይ አድርጎ ተጋደመበት፤ የሕፃኑም ገላ ሞቀ።

verses.text_english: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሶም በቤቱ ውስጥ አንድ ጊዜ ወዲህና ወዲያ ተመላለሰ፤ ደግሞም ወጥቶ ሰባት ጊዜ በሕፃኑ ላይ ተጋደመ፤ ሕፃኑም ዓይኖቹን ከፈተ።

verses.text_english: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
verses.text_amharic: ግያዝንም ጠርቶ። ይህችን ሱነማዊት ጥራ አለው። ጠራትም፥ ወደ እርሱም በገባች ጊዜ። ልጅሽን አንሥተሽ ውሰጂ አላት።

verses.text_english: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
verses.text_amharic: ገብታም በእግሩ አጠገብ ወደቀች በምድርም ላይ ተደፋች፤ ልጅዋንም አንሥታ ወጣች።

verses.text_english: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም ዳግመኛ ወደ ጌልገላ መጣ፥ በምድርም ላይ ራብ ነበረ፤ የነቢያትም ልጆች በፊቱ ተቀምጠው ነበር፥ ሎሌውንም። ታላቁን ምንቸት ጣድ፥ ለነቢያት ልጆችም ወጥ ሥራ አለው።

verses.text_english: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred into the pot of pottage: for they knew not.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ቅጠላቅጠል ያመጣ ዘንድ ወደ ሜዳ ወጣ፥ የምድረበዳውንም ሐረግ አገኘ ከዚያም የበረሀ ቅል ሰበሰበ፥ ልብሱንም ሞልቶ ተመለሰ፥ መትሮም በወጡ ምንቸት ውስጥ ጨመረው፤ ምን እንደ ሆነ ግን አላወቁም።

verses.text_english: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O man of God, death in the pot. And they could not eat .
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም ይበሉ ዘንድ ቀዱ፤ ወጡንም በቀመሱ ጊዜ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ በምንቸቱ ውስጥ ሞት አለ ብለው ጮኹ፤ ይበሉም ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ዱቄት አምጡልኝ አለ፤ በምንቸቱም ውስጥ ጥሎ። ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ቅዱ አለ። በምንቸቱም ውስጥ ክፉ ነገር አልተገኘም።

verses.text_english: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰውም ከበኣልሻሊሻ የበኵራቱን እንጀራ፥ ሀያ የገብስ እንጀራ፥ የእህልም እሸት በአቁማዳ ይዞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው መጣ፤ እርሱም። ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ስጣቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave .
verses.text_amharic: ሎሌውም። ይህን እንዴት አድርጌ ለመቶ ሰው እሰጣለሁ? አለ። እርሱም። ይበላሉ ያተርፋሉም ብሎ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ስጣቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: So he set before them, and they did eat, and left , according to the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በፊታቸው አኖረው፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል በሉ፥ አተረፉም።

verses.text_english: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, a leper.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያ ንጉሥ ሠራዊት አለቃ ንዕማንም እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ እጅ ለሶርያ ደኅንነትን ስለ ሰጠ በጌታው ዘንድ ታላቅ ክቡር ሰው ነበረ፤ ደግሞም ጽኑዕ ኃያል ነበረ፥ ነገር ግን ለምጻም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.
verses.text_amharic: ከሶርያውያንም አገር አደጋ ጣዮች ወጥተው ነበር፥ ከእስራኤልም ምድር ታናሽ ብላቴና ሴት ማርከው ነበር፤ የንዕማንንም ሚስት ታገለግል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord with the prophet that in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: እመቤትዋንም። ጌታዬ በሰማርያ ካለው ከነቢዩ ፊት ቢደርስ ኖሮ ከለምጹ በፈወሰው ነበር አለቻት።

verses.text_english: And went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that of the land of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ንዕማንም ገብቶ ለጌታው። ከእስራኤል አገር የሆነች አንዲት ብላቴና እንዲህና እንዲህ ብላለች ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ንዕማንን። ሂድ፥ ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ደብዳቤ እልካለሁ አለው። እርሱም ሄደ፥ አሥርም መክሊት ብር፥ ስድስት ሺህም ወርቅ፥ አሥርም መለውጫ ልብስ በእጁ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ይህች ደብዳቤ ወደ አንተ ስትደርስ ባሪያዬን ንዕማንን ከለምጹ ትፈውሰው ዘንድ እንደ ሰደድሁልህ እወቅ የሚል ደብዳቤ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ደብዳቤውን ባነበበ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ። ሰውን ከለምጹ እፈውስ ዘንድ ይህ ሰው ወደ እኔ መስደዱ እኔ በውኑ ለመግደልና ለማዳን የምችል አምላክ ሆኜ ነውን? ተመልከቱ፥ የጠብ ምክንያትም እንደሚፈልግብኝ እዩ አለ።

verses.text_english: And it was , when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ኤልሳዕ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ልብሱን እንደ ቀደደ በሰማ ጊዜ። ልብስህን ለምን ቀደድህ? ወደ እኔ ይምጣ፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ነቢይ እንዳለ ያውቃል ብሎ ወደ ንጉሡ ላከ።

verses.text_english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.text_amharic: ንዕማንም በፈረሱና በሰረገላው መጣ፥ በኤልሳዕም ቤት ደጃፍ ውጭ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም። ሂድ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ሰባት ጊዜ ታጠብ፤ ሥጋህም ይፈወሳል፥ አንተም ንጹሕ ትሆናለህ ብሎ ወደ እርሱ መልእክተኛ ላከ።

verses.text_english: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.text_amharic: ንዕማን ግን ተቈጥቶ ሄደ፥ እንዲህም አለ። እነሆ፥ ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ፥ ቆሞም የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም የሚጠራ፥ የለምጹንም ስፍራ በእጁ ዳስሶ የሚፈውሰኝ መስሎኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.text_amharic: የደማስቆ ወንዞች አባናና ፋርፋ ከእስራኤል ውኆች ሁሉ አይሻሉምን? በእነርሱስ ውስጥ መታጠብና መንጻት አይቻለኝም ኖሮአልን? ዘወርም ብሎ ተቈጥቶ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, the prophet had bid thee great thing, wouldest thou not have done ? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹም ቀርበው። አባት ሆይ፥ ነቢዩ ታላቅ ነገርስ እንኳ ቢነግርህ ኖሮ ባደረግኸው ነበር፤ ይልቁንስ። ታጠብና ንጹሕ ሁን ቢልህ እንዴት ነዋ! ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.text_amharic: ወረደም፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው እንደ ተናገረው በዮርዳኖስ ሰባት ጊዜ ብቅ ጥልቅ አለ፤ ሥጋውም እንደ ገና እንደ ትንሽ ብላቴና ሥጋ ሆኖ ተመለሰ፥ ንጹሕም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ከጭፍራው ሁሉ ጋር ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ተመለሰ፥ ወጥቶም በፊቱ ቆመና። እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ በቀር በምድር ሁሉ አምላክ እንደሌለ አወቅሁ፤ አሁንም ከባሪያህ በረከት ትቀበል ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: But he said, the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take ; but he refused.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በፊቱ የቆምሁት ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አልቀበልም አለ። ይቀበለውም ዘንድ ግድ አለው፤ እርሱ ግን እንቢ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንዕማንም። እኔ ባሪያህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ለሌሎች አማልክት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ሌላ መሥዋዕት አላቀርብምና ሁለት የበቅሎ ጭነት አፈር እንድወስድ እሺ ትለኝ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለእኔ ለባሪያህ በዚህ ነገር ብቻ ይቅር ይበለኝ፤ ጌታዬ በዚያ ይሰግድ ዘንድ እጄን ተደግፎ ወደ ሬሞን ቤት በገባ ጊዜ፥ እኔም በሬሞን ቤት በሰገድሁ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ነገር ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ይቅር ይበለኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በደኅና ሂድ አለው። አንድ አግድመትም ያህል ከእርሱ ራቀ።

verses.text_english: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ሎሌ ግያዝ። ጌታዬ ሶርያዊውን ይህን ንዕማንን ማረው፥ ካመጣለትም ነገር ምንም አልተቀበለም፤ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በስተ ኋለው እሮጣለሁ፥ ከእርሱም አንዳች እወስዳለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, all well?
verses.text_amharic: ግያዝም ንዕማንን ተከተለው፤ ንዕማንም ወደ እርሱ ሲሮጥ ባየው ጊዜ ሊገናኘው ከሰረገላው ወርዶ። ሁሉ ደኅና ነውን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, All well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ደኅና ነው። አሁን ከነቢያት ወገን የሆኑት ሁለት ጕልማሶች ከተራራማው ከኤፍሬም አገር ወደ እኔ መጥተዋል፤ አንድ መክሊት ብርና ሁለት መለወጫ ልብስ ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ጌታዬ ላከኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid upon two of his servants; and they bare before him.
verses.text_amharic: ንዕማንም። ሁለት መክሊት ትወስድ ዘንድ ይፈቀድልህ አለ፤ ግድ አለውም፤ ሁለቱንም መክሊት ብር በሁለት ከረጢት ውስጥ አሰረና ከሁለት መለወጫ ልብስ ጋር ለሁለት ሎሌዎቹ አስያዘ፤ እነርሱም ተሸክመው በፊቱ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And when he came to the tower, he took from their hand, and bestowed in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኮረብታውም በመጣ ጊዜ ከእጃቸው ወስዶ በቤቱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው፤ ሰዎቹንም አሰናበተ፥ እነርሱም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence , Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ገብቶ በጌታው ፊት ቆመ፤ ኤልሳዕም። ግያዝ ሆይ፥ ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ ባሪያህ ወዴትም አልሄድሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ያ ሰው ከሰረገላው ወርዶ ሊቀበልህ በተመለሰ ጊዜ ልቤ ከአንተ ጋር አልሄደምን? ብሩንና ልብሱን፥ የወይራውንና የወይኑን ቦታ፥ በጎችንና በሬዎችን፥ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ባሪያዎች ትቀበል ዘንድ ይህ ጊዜው ነውን?

verses.text_english: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as snow.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህስ የንዕማን ለምጽ በአንተ ላይ፥ ለዘላለምም በዘርህ ላይ ይጣበቃል አለው። እንደ በረዶም ለምጻም ሆኖ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
verses.text_amharic: የነቢያትም ልጆች ኤልሳዕን። እነሆ፥ በፊትህ የምንቀመጥበት ስፍራ ጠብቦናል።

verses.text_english: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዮርዳኖስም እንሂድ፥ ከእኛም እያንዳንዱ ከዚያ ምሰሶ ያምጣ፥ የምንቀመጥበትንም ስፍራ በዚያ እንሥራ አሉት፤ እርሱም። ሂዱ አለ።

verses.text_english: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዱ። አንተ ደግሞ ከእኛ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ለመሄድ ፍቀድ አለ። እርሱም። እሄዳለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር ሄደ፤ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም በደረሱ ጊዜ እንጨት ቆረጡ።

verses.text_english: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዱ ምሰሶውን ሲቆርጥ የምሳሩ ብረት ወደ ውኃው ውስጥ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወየው! ወየው! የተዋስሁት ነበረ ብሎ ጮኽ።

verses.text_english: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast in thither; and the iron did swim.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። የወደቀው ወዴት ነው? አለ ስፍራውንም አሳየው፤ እንጨትም ቆርጦ በዚያ ጣለው፥ ብረቱም ተንሳፈፈ።

verses.text_english: Therefore said he, Take up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ውሰደው አለ፤ እጁንም ዘርግቶ ወሰደው።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place my camp.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ከእስራኤል ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር፤ ከባሪያዎቹም ጋር ተማክሮ። በዚህ ተደብቀን እንሰፍራለን አለ።

verses.text_english: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ሶርያውያን በዚያ ተደብቀዋልና በዚያ ስፍራ እንዳታልፍ ተጠንቀቅ ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ነገረው ስፍራ ሰደደ፤ አንድ ጊዜም ሳይሆን፥ ሁለት ጊዜም ሳይሆን በዚያ ራሱን አዳነ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us for the king of Israel?
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ልብ ስለዚህ እጅግ ታወከ፤ ባሪያዎቹንም ጠርቶ። ከእኛ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ጋር የተወዳጀ እንዳለ አትነግሩኝምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሪያዎቹም አንዱ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እንዲህ እኮ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን በእልፍኝህ ውስጥ ሆነህ የምትናገረውን በእስራኤል ዘንድ ያለ ነቢይ ኤልሳዕ ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ይነግረዋል አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Go and spy where he , that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, in Dothan.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ልኬ አስይዘው ዘንድ ሄዳችሁ ወዴት እንደ ሆነ እዩ አለ። እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ በዶታይን አለ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚያም ፈረሶችንና ሰረገሎችን እጅግም ጭፍራ ሰደደ፤ በሌሊትም መጥተው ከተማይቱን ከበቡ።

verses.text_english: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሎሌ ማለዳ ተነሥቶ በወጣ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ጭፍራና ፈረሶች ሰረገሎችም ነበሩ። ሎሌውም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! ምን እናደርጋለን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered, Fear not: for they that with us more than they that with them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከእኛ ጋር ያሉት ከእነርሱ ጋር ካሉት ይበልጣሉና አትፍራ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም። አቤቱ፥ ያይ ዘንድ ዓይኖቹን፥ እባክህ፥ ግለጥ ብሎ ጸለየ። እግዚአብሔርም የብላቴናውን ዓይኖች ገለጠ፥ አየም፤ እነሆም፥ በኤልሳዕ ዙሪያ ያሉት የእሳት ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎች ተራራውን ሞልተውት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም በወረዱ ጊዜ ኤልሳዕ። ይህን ሕዝብ ዕውር ታደርገው ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ። ኤልሳዕም እንደ ተናገረው ቃል ዕውር አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And Elisha said unto them, This not the way, neither this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕም። መንገዱ በዚህ አይደለም፥ ከተማይቱም ይህች አይደለችም፤ የምትሹትን ሰው አሳያችሁ ዘንድ ተከተሉኝ አላቸው፤ ወደ ሰማርያም መራቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these , that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, in the midst of Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰማርያም በገቡ ጊዜ ኤልሳዕ። አቤቱ፥ ያዩ ዘንድ የእነዚህን ሰዎች ዓይኖች ግለጥ አለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዓይኖቻቸውን ገለጠ፥ እነርሱም አዩ። እነሆም፥ በሰማርያ መካከል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite ? shall I smite ?
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባያቸው ጊዜ አልሳዕን። አባቴ ሆይ፥ ልግደላቸውን? ልግደላቸውን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite : wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አትግደላቸው፤ በሰይፍህና በቀስትህ የማረክኸውን ትገድል ዘንድ ይገባሃልን? እንጀራና ውኃ በፊታቸው አኑርላቸው፥ በልተውና ጠጥተውም ወደ ጌታቸው ይሂዱ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙም መብል አዘጋጀላቸው፤ በበሉና በጠጡ ጊዜም አሰናበታቸው፥ እነርሱም ወደ ጌታቸው ሄዱ። ከዚያም በኋላ የሶርያ አደጋ ጣዮች ወደ እስራኤል አገር አልመጡም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የሶርያ ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ሠራዊቱን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ወጥቶም ሰማርያን ከበባት።

verses.text_english: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was for fourscore of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five of silver.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማርያም ታላቅ ራብ ሆኖ ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ የአህያ ራስ በአምሳ ብር፥ የርግብም ኩስ የጎሞር ስምንተኛ የሚሆን በአምስት ብር እስኪሸጥ ድረስ ከበቡአት።

verses.text_english: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በቅጥር ላይ በተመላለሰ ጊዜ አንዲት ሴት ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እርዳኝ ብላ ወደ እርሱ ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ያልረዳሽን እኔ እንዴት እረዳሻለሁ? ከአውድማው ወይስ ከመጥመቂያው ነውን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ምን ሆነሻል? አላት፤ እርስዋም። ይህች ሴት። ዛሬ እንድንበላው ልጅሽን አምጪ፤ ነገም ልጄን እንበላለን አለችኝ።

verses.text_english: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄንም ቀቅለን በላነው፤ በማግሥቱም። እንድንበላው ልጅሽን አምጪ አልኋት፤ ልጅዋንም ሸሸገችው ብላ መለሰችለት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, sackcloth within upon his flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የሴቲቱን ቃል ሰምቶ ልብሱን ቀደደ፤ በቅጥርም ይመላለስ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም በስተ ውስጥ በሥጋው ላይ ለብሶት የነበረውን ማቅ አዩ።

verses.text_english: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። የሣፋጥ ልጅ የኤልሳዕ ራስ ዛሬ በላዩ ያደረ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያድርግብኝ፥ ይህንም ይጨምርብኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: not the sound of his master's feet behind him?
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳዕ ግን በቤቱ ተቀምጦ ነበር፥ ሽማግሌዎችም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ንጉሡ ሰው ላካ፤ መልእክተኛውም ገና ሳይደርስ ለሽማግሌዎች። ይህ የነፍሰ ገዳይ ልጅ ራሴን ይቈርጥ ዘንድ እንደ ላከ እዩ፤ መልእከተኛውም በመጣ ጊዜ ደጁን ዘግታችሁ ከልክሉት፤ የጌታው የእግሩ ኮቴ በኋላው ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil of the LORD; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?
verses.text_amharic: ሲናገራቸውም መልእክተኛው ወደ እርሱ ደረሰ፤ እርሱም። እነሆ፥ ይህ ክፉ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ገና እጠብቅ ዘንድ ምንድር ነኝ? አለ።
