verses.text_english: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የዙፋኑን መሠረት ሠራ፤ ስለ አሦርም ንጉሥ በውጭ ያለውን የንጉሡን መንገድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አዞረው።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም አካዝ ያደረገው ነገር በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሕዝቅያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአካዝ በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ዓመት የኤላ ልጅ ሆሴዕ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ንጉሥ ሆነ፤ ዘጠኝ ዓመትም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ አስቀድሞ እንደ ነበሩት እንደ እስራኤል ነገሥታት አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ስልምናሶር በእርሱ ላይ ወጣ፤ ሆሴዕም ተገዛለት፥ ግብርም አመጣለት።

verses.text_english: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ በሆሴዕ ላይ ዓመፅ አገኘ፤ መልእክተኞችን ወደ ግብጽ ንጉሥ ወደ ሴጎር ልኮ ነበርና፤ እንደ ልማዱም በየዓመቱ ለአሦር ንጉሥ ግብር አልሰጠምና፤ ስለዚህ የአሦር ንጉሥ ይዞ በወህኒ ቤት አሰረው።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ወጣ፥ ወደ ሰማርያም ወጥቶ ሦስት ዓመት ከበባት።

verses.text_english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.text_amharic: በሆሴዕ በዘጠኝኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰማርያን ወሰደ፥ እስራኤልንም ወደ አሦር አፈለሰ፥ በአላሔና በአቦር በጎዛንም ወንዝ በሜዶንም ከተሞች አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: For it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከግብጽ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን እጅ፥ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣቸውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን በድለው ነበርና፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አምልከው ነበርና፥

verses.text_english: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ባሳደዳቸው በአሕዛብ ሥርዓት፥ የእስራኤልም ነገሥታት ባደረጓት ሥርዓት ሄደው ነበርና እንደዚህ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel did secretly things that not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በአምላካቸው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ቅን ያልሆነን ንገር በስውር አደረጉ፤ በከተሞቻቸውም ሁሉ ከዘበኞች ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ተመሸገች ከተማ ድረስ በከፍታዎቹ ላይ መስገጃዎችን ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.text_amharic: በረጃጅሙ ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ ታች ሐውልቶችንና የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችን ተከሉ፤

verses.text_english: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው ያወጣቸው አሕዛብ እንዳደረጉት፥ በኮረብቶቹ መስገጃዎች ሁሉ ላይ ያጥኑ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያስቈጡ ዘንድ ክፉ ነገር አደረጉ፤

verses.text_english: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የከለከላቸውን ጣዖቶች አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ለአባቶቻችሁም እንዳዘዝሁት፥ ባባሪያዎቼ በነቢያት የላክሁላችሁን ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ሕጌንም ሁሉ ጠብቁ ብሎ በነቢዩ ሁሉና በባለ ራእዩ አፍ ሁሉ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ መሰከረ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳላመኑ እንደ አባቶቻቸው አንገት አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ እንጂ አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that round about them, whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቱንም ከአባቶቻቸውም ጋር ያደረገውን ቃል ኪዳን፥ ያጸናላቸውንም ምስክሩን ናቁ፤ ከንቱ ነገርንም ተከተሉ፥ ምናምንቴዎችም ሆኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ እነርሱ እንዳይሠሩ ያዘዛቸውን በዙሪያቸው ያሉትን አሕዛብን ተከተሉ።

verses.text_english: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካቸውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ተዉ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም የሁለቱን እንቦሶች ምስሎች አደረጉ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድንም ተከሉ፥ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ሰገዱ፥ በኣልንም አመለኩ።

verses.text_english: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት አሳለፉአቸው፥ ምዋርተኞችና አስማተኞችም ሆኑ፥ ያስቈጡትም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር ለማድረግ ራሳቸውን ሸጡ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ ከፊቱም ጣላቸው፤ ከይሁዳም ነገድ ብቻ በቀር ማንም አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ደግሞ እስራኤል ባደረጋት ሥርዓት ሄደ እንጂ የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ አልጠበቀም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ዘር ሁሉ ጠላ፥ አስጨነቃቸውም፥ ከፊቱም እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ በበዝባዦች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልንም ከዳዊት ቤት ለየ፤ የናባጥንም ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምን አነገሡ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል እስራኤልን መለሰ፥ ታላቅም ኃጢአት አሠራቸው።

verses.text_english: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢዮርብዓም ባደረገው ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄዱ፤

verses.text_english: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያቱ ሁሉ አፍ እንደ ተናገረው እስራኤልን ከፊቱ እስኪያወጣ ድረስ ከእርስዋ አልራቁም። እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከምድሩ ወደ አሦር ፈለሰ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Assyria brought from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከባቢሎንና ከኩታ ከአዋና ከሐማት ከሴፈርዋይም ሰዎችን አመጣ፥ በእስራኤልም ልጆች ፋንታ በሰማርያ ከተሞች አኖራቸው፤ ሰማርያንም ወረሱአት፤ በከተሞችዋም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew of them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም መቀመጥ በጀመሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አይፈሩትም ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም አንበሶች ሰደደባቸው፥ ይገድሉአቸውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ለአሦር ንጉሥ። ያፈለስኻቸው፥ በሰማርያም ከተሞች ያኖርኻቸው የአገሩን አምላክ ወግ አላወቁም፤ የአገሩን አምላክ ወግ አላወቁምና አንበሶችን ሰድዶባቸዋል፥ እነሆም፥ ገደሉአቸው ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ። ከዚያ ካመጣችኋቸው ካህናት አንዱን ውሰዱ፤ ሄዶም በዚያ ይቀመጥ፥ የአገሩንም አምላክ ወግ ያስተምራቸው ብሎ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማርያም ካፈለሱአቸው ካህናት አንዱ መጥቶ በቤቴል ተቀመጠ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም እንዴት እንዲፈሩት ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
verses.text_amharic: በየሕዝባቸውም አምላካቸውን አደረጉ፥ ሰምራውያንም በሠሩት በኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሚኖሩበት ከተሞቻቸው አኖሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ሰዎች ሱኮትበኖትን ሠሩ፤ የኩታም ሰዎች ኤርጌልን ሠሩ፤

verses.text_english: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.text_amharic: የሐማትም ሰዎች አሲማትን ሠሩ፤ አዋውያንም ኤልባዝርንና ተርታቅን ሠሩ፤ የሴፈርዋይም ሰዎችም ለሴፈርዋይም አማልክት ለአድራሜሌክና ለአነሜሌክ ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈሩ ነበር፥ ከመካከላቸውም ለኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ካህናት አደረጉ፥ በኮረብታውም መስገጃዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም ሲፈሩ ከመካከላቸው እንደ ፈለሱት እንደ አሕዛብ ልማድ አምላካቸውን ያመልኩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እንደ ቀደመው ልማድ ያደርጋሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አይፈሩም፥ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤል ብሎ የጠራውን የያዕቆብን ልጆች እንዳዘዛቸው ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሕግና ትእዛዝም አያደርጉም።

verses.text_english: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፥ እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ሌሎችን አማልክት አትፍሩ፥ አትስገዱላቸው፥ አታምልኩአቸው፥ አትሠዉላቸው፤

verses.text_english: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በታላቅ ኃይል በተዘረጋችም ክንድ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣችሁን እግዚአብሔር እርሱን ፍሩ፥ ለእርሱም ስገዱ፥ ለእርሱም ሠዉ፤

verses.text_english: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
verses.text_amharic: የጻፈላችሁንም ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ሕግና ትእዛዝም ለዘላለም ታደርጉ ዘንድ ጠብቁ፤ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አትፍሩ።

verses.text_english: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን አትርሱ፤ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አትፍሩ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩ፤ እርሱም ከጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ እጅ ያድናችኋል።

verses.text_english: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንደ ቀደመው ልማዳቸው አደረጉ እንጂ አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም አሕዛብ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ደግሞም የተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውን ያመልኩ ነበር፤ ልጆቻቸውም የልጅ ልጆቻቸውም አባቶቻቸው እንዳደረጉ እንዲሁ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኤላ ልጅ በሆሴዕ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የአካዝ ልጅ ሕዝቅያስ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
verses.text_amharic: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የዘካርያስ ልጅ አቡ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አባቱ ዳዊት እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገርን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
verses.text_amharic: በኮረብታም ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አስወገደ፥ ሐውልቶችንም ቀለጣጠመ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እስከዚህ ዘመን ድረስ ያጥኑለት ነበርና ሙሴ የሠራውን የናሱን እባብ ሰባበረ፤ ስሙንም ነሑሽታን ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor that were before him.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ታመነ፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ከእርሱም በፊት ከነበሩት ከይሁዳ ነገሥታት ሁሉ እርሱን የሚመስል አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: For he clave to the LORD, departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔርም ጋር ተጣበቀ፥ እርሱንም ከመከተል አልራቀም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ ያዘዘውን ትእዛዛቱን ጠበቀ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD was with him; he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥ የሚሄድበትም መንገድ ተከናወነለት፤ በአሦርም ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ አልገበረለትም።

verses.text_english: He smote the Philistines, unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም እስከ ጋዛና እስከ ዳርቻዋ ድረስ፥ ከዘበኞች ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ምሽጉ ከተማ ድረስ መታ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡ በሕዝቅያስ በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኤላ ልጅ በሆሴዕ በሰባተኛው ዓመት፥ የአሦር ንጉሥ ስልምናሶር ወደ ሰማርያ ወጣ፥ ከበባትም።

verses.text_english: And at the end of three years they took it: in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት ዓመት በኋላም ወሰዳት፤ በሕዝቅያስ በስድስተኛው ዓመት፥ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በሆሴዕ በዘጠኝኛው ዓመት፥ ሰማርያ ተያዘች።

verses.text_english: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
verses.text_amharic: የአሦር ንጉሥ እስራኤልን ወደ አሦር አፈለሰ፥ በአላሔና በአቦር በጎዛንም ወንዝ በሜዶንም ከተሞች አኖራቸው፤

verses.text_english: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear , nor do .
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙምና፥ ቃል ኪዳኑንም አፍርሰዋልና፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አልሰሙምና፥ አላደረጉምና።

verses.text_english: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም በሕዝቅያስ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ ተመሸጉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ወጣ፥ ወሰዳቸውም።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ። በድያለሁ፥ ከእኔ ተመለስ፤ የምትጭንብኝን ሁሉ እሸከማለሁ ብሎ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ወደ ለኪሶ ላከ። የአሦርም ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ላይ ሦስት መቶ መክሊት ብርና ሠላሳ መክሊት ወርቅ ጫነበት።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah gave all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤት መዛግብት የተገኘውን ብር ሁሉ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the doors of the temple of the LORD, and the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ሕዝቅያስ ከእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ደጆችና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ከለበጣቸው መቃኖች ወርቁን ቈረጠ፥ ለአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ተርታንንና ራፌስን ራፋስቂስንም ከብዙ ሠራዊት ጋር ከለኪሶ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላከ። ወጥተውም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ፤ በመጡም ጊዜ በአጣቢው እርሻ መንገድ ባለችው በላይኛይቱ ኩሬ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም ጠሩ፤ የቤቱም አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊውም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ወደ እነርሱ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence this wherein thou trustest?
verses.text_amharic: ራፋስቂስም አላቸው። ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ታላቁ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ የምትታመንበት መተማመኛ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Thou sayest, (but vain words,) counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.text_amharic: የከንፈር ቃል ለሰልፍ ምክርና ኃይል እንደሚሆን ትናገራለህ፤ አሁንም በእኔ ላይ ያመፅኸው በማን ተማምነህ ነው?

verses.text_english: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዚህ በተቀጠቀጠ በሸምበቆ በትር በግብጽ ትታመናለህ፤ ሰው ቢመረኰዘው ተሰብሮ በእጁ ይገባል ያቈስለውማል፤ የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ለሚታመኑበት ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር እንታመናለን ብትሉኝ፥ ሕዝቅያስ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን። በኢየሩሳሌም ባለው በዚህ መሠዊያ ፊት ሰገዱ ብሎ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹንና መሠዊያውቹን ያስፈረሰ ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ከጌታዬ ከአሦር ንጉሥ ጋር ተወራረድ፥ የሚቀመጡባቸውንም ሰዎች ማግኘት ቢቻልህ እኔ ሁለት ሺህ ፈረሶች እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሰረገሎችና ስለ ፈረሰኞች በግብጽ ስትታመን፥ ከጌታዬ ባሪያዎች የሚያንሰውን የአንዱ አለቃ ፊት ትቃወም ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻልሃል?

verses.text_english: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን በውኑ ያለ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይህን ስፍራ አጠፋ ዘንድ ወጥቻለሁን? እግዚአብሔር። ወደዚች አገር ወጥተህ አጥፋት አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand : and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that on the wall.
verses.text_amharic: የኬልቅያስም ልጅ ኤልያቄም ሳምናስም ዮአስም ራፋስቂስን። እኛ እንሰማለንና እባክህ፥ በሶርያ ቋንቋ ለባሪያዎችህ ተናገር፤ በቅጥርም ላይ ባለው ሕዝብ ጆሮ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ አትናገረን አሉት።

verses.text_english: But Rabshakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? not to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.text_amharic: ራፋስቂስ ግን። ጌታዬ ይህን ቃል እናገር ዘንድ ወደ አንተና ወደ ጌታህ ልኮኛልን? ከእናንተ ጋር ኵሳቸውን ይበሉ ዘንድ ሽንታቸውንም ይጠጡ ዘንድ በቅጥር ላይ ወደ ተቀመጡት ሰዎች አይደለምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
verses.text_amharic: ራፋስቂስም ቆሞ በታላቅ ድምፅ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኽ። የታላቁን የአሦር ንጉሥ ቃል ስሙ፤ ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
verses.text_amharic: ከእጄ ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አይችልምና ሕዝቅያስ አያታልላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር በእርግጥ ያድነናል፥ ይህችም ከተማ በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር እንድትታመኑ አያድርጋችሁ።

verses.text_english: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make with me by a present, and come out to me, and eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስንም አትስሙ፤ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ከእኔ ጋር ታረቁ ወደ እኔም ውጡ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከወይናችሁና ከበለሳችሁ ብሉ ከጕድጓዳችሁም ውኃ ጠጡ፤

verses.text_english: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም መጥቼ ምድራችሁን ወደምትመስለው ምድር፥ እህልና የወይን ጠጅ፥ እንጀራና ወይን፥ ወይራና ማር ወዳለባት ምድር እስካፈልሳችሁ ድረስ በሕይወት እንድትኖሩ እንዳትሞቱም ነው። ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር ያድነናል ብሎ ቢያታልላችሁ አትስሙት።

verses.text_english: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የአሕዛብ አማልክት አገሮቻቸውን ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አድነዋቸዋልን?

verses.text_english: Where the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
verses.text_amharic: የሐማትና የአርፋድ አማልክት ወዴት አሉ? የሴፈርዋይምና የሄና የዒዋም አማልክት ወዴት አሉ?

verses.text_english: Who they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
verses.text_amharic: ሰማርያን ከእጄ አድነዋታልን? እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ከእጄ ያድን ዘንድ ከአገሮቹ አማልክት ሁሉ አገሩን ከእጄ ያዳነ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ዝም አሉ፥ አንዳችም አልመለሱለትም፤ ንጉሡ እንዳይመልሱለት አዝዞ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱ አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ልብሳቸውን ቀድደው ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጡ፥ የራፋስቂስንም ቃል ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard , that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስ ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ ማቅም ለበሰ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገባ።

verses.text_english: And he sent Eliakim, which over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱንም አዛዥ ኤልያቄምን ጸሐፊውንም ሳምናስን የካህናቱንም ሽማግሌዎች ማቅ ለብሰው ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ አሞጽ ልጅ ወደ ኢሳይያስ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ላካቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and not strength to bring forth.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ቀን የመከራና የተግሣጽ የዘለፋም ቀን ነው፤ ልጆች የሚወለዱበት ጊዜ ደርሶአል፥ ለመውለድም ኃይል የለም።

verses.text_english: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up prayer for the remnant that are left.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባት በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ ጌታው የአሦር ንጉሥ የላከውን የራፋስቂስን ቃል ሁሉ አምላካህ እግዚአብሔር ይሰማ እንደ ሆነ፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ሰማው ቃል ይገሥጸው እንደ ሆነ፥ ስለዚህ ለቀረው ቅሬታ ጸልይ አሉት።

verses.text_english: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ የንጉሡ የሕዝቅያስ ባሪያዎች ወደ ኢሳይያስ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም። ለጌታችሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦር ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች ስለ ሰደቡኝ፥ ስለ ሰማኸው ቃል አትፍራ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በላዩ መንፈስን እሰድዳለሁ፥ ወሬንም ይሰማል፥ ወደ ምድሩም ይመለሳል፤ በምድሩም በሰይፍ እንዲወድቅ አደርገዋለሁ በሉት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከለኪሶ እንደ ራቀ ሰምቶ ነበርና ራፋስቂስ ተመልሶ በልብና ሲዋጋ አገኘው።

verses.text_english: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የኢትዮጵያ ንጉሥ ቲርሐቅ ሊወጋህ መጥቶአል የሚል ወሬ በሰማ ጊዜ ደግሞ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፥ እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.text_english: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ኢየሩሳሌም በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ የምትታመንበት አምላክህ አያታልልህ።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የአሦር ነገሥታት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያደረጉትን፥ እንዴትስ እንዳጠፋአቸው ሰምተሃል፤ አንተስ ትድናለህን?

verses.text_english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which in Thelasar?
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቼ ያጠፉአቸውን፥ ጎዛንን፥ ካራንን፥ ራፊስን፥ በተላሳር የነበሩትንም የዔድንን ልጆች፥ የአሕዛብ አማልክት አዳኑአቸውን?

verses.text_english: Where the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?
verses.text_amharic: የሐማት ንጉሥ፥ የአርፋድ ንጉሥ፥ የሴፈርዋይም ከተማ ንጉሥ፥ የሄናና የዒዋ ንጉሥ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ደብዳቤውን ከመልእክተኞች እጅ ተቀብሎ አነበበው፤ ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘረጋው።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest the cherubims, thou art the God, thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ። በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብቻህን የምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ አምላክ ነህ፤ ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጥረሃል።

verses.text_english: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን አዘንብልና ስማ፤ አቤቱ፥ ዓይንህን ክፈትና እይ፤ በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ የላከውን የሰናክሬምን ቃል ስማ።

verses.text_english: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በእውነት የአሦር ነገሥታት አሕዛብንና ምድራቸውን አፍርሰዋል፥

verses.text_english: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.text_amharic: አማልክቶቻቸውንም በእሳት ላይ ጥለዋል፤ የእንጨትና የድንጋይ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ነበሩ እንጂ አማልክት አልነበሩምና፤ ስለዚህ አጥፍተዋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou the LORD God, thou only.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህም አምላካችን አቤቱ፥ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አንተ ብቻ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ ያውቁ ዘንድ ከእጁ እንድታድነን እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞጽም ልጅ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ብሎ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ላካ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ አሦር ንጉሥ ስለ ሰናክሬም ወደ እኔ የለመንኽውን ሰምቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: This the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ ላይ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው። ድንግሊቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ቀላል አድርጋሃለች፥ በንቀትም ስቃብሃለች፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ በላይህ ራስዋን ነቅንቃብሃለች።

verses.text_english: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? against the Holy of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የተገዳደርኸው፥ የሰደብኸውስ ማን ነው? ቃልህንስ ከፍ ከፍ ያደረግኸው ዓይንህንም ወደ ላይ ያነሣኸው በማን ላይ ነው? በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, the forest of his Carmel.
verses.text_amharic: አንተስ። በሰረገላዬ ብዛት ወደ ተራሮች ከፍታ፥ ወደ ሊባኖስ ጥግ ላይ ወጥቻለሁ፤ ረጃጅሞቹንም ዝግባዎች የተመረጡትንም ጥዶች እቈርጣለሁ፥ ወደ አገሩም ዳርቻና ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ዱር እገባለሁ።

verses.text_english: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
verses.text_amharic: ቈፈርሁም፥ እንግዳውንም ውኃ ጠጣሁ፤ የተገደበውንም ውኃ ሁሉ በእግሬ ጫማ አደርቃለሁ ብለህ በመልእክተኞችህ እጅ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ተገዳደርህ።

verses.text_english: Hast thou not heard long ago I have done it, of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities ruinous heaps.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ጥንቱን እንደ ሠራሁት፥ ቀድሞውንም እንዳደረግሁት አልሰማህምን? አሁንም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች የፍርስራሽ ክምር እስኪሆኑ ድረስ እንድታፈርስ አደረግሁህ።

verses.text_english: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were the grass of the field, and the green herb, the grass on the housetops, and blasted before it be grown up.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የሚኖሩባቸው ሰዎች እጃቸው ዝሎአል፥ ደንግጠውም ታውከዋል፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሣር፥ እንደ ለምለምም ቡቃያ፥ በሰገነትም ላይ እንዳለ ሣር፥ ሳይሸት ዋግ እንደ መታውም እህል ሆነዋል።

verses.text_english: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን መቀመጫህንና መውጫህንም መግቢያህንም፥ በእኔም ላይ የተቈጠኸውን ቍጣ አውቄአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣህና ትዕቢትህ ወደ ጆሮዬ ደርሶአልና ስለዚህ ስናጋዬን በአፍንጫህ፥ ልጓሜንም በከንፈርህ አደርጋለሁ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ እመልስሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And this a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ምልክት ይሆንሃል፤ በዚህ ዓመት የገቦውን፥ በሁለተኛውም ዓመት ከገቦው የበቀለውን ትበላላችሁ፤ በሦስተኛውም ዓመት ትዘራላችሁ፥ ታጭዱማላችሁ፥ ወይንንም ትተክላላችሁ፥ ፍሬውንም ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
verses.text_amharic: ያመለጠው የይሁዳ ቤት ቅሬታ ሥሩን ወደ ታች ይሰድዳል፥ ወደ ላይም ያፈራል።

verses.text_english: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD shall do this.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢየሩሳሌም ቅሬታ ከጽዮንም ተራራ ያመለጡት ይወጣሉና፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት ይህን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ስለ አሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ወደዚች ከተማ አይመጣም፥ ፍላጻንም አይወረውርባትም፥ በጋሻም አይመጣባትም፥ የአፈርንም ድልድል አይደለድልባትም።

verses.text_english: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በመጣበት መንገድ በዚያው ይመለሳል፥ ወደዚህችም ከተማ አይመጣም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እኔም፥ ስለ ባሪያዬም ስለ ዳዊት ይህችን ከተማ አድናት ዘንድ እጋርዳታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they all dead corpses.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ሌሊት የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ወጣ፥ ከአሦራውያንም ሰፈር መቶ ሰማንያ አምስት ሺህ ገደለ፤ ማለዳም በተነሡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁሉ በድኖች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ተነሥቶ ሄደ፥ ተመልሶም በነነዌ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላኩም በናሳራክ ቤት ሲሰግድ ልጆቹ አደራሜሌክና ሳራሳር በሰይፍ ገደሉት፤ ወደ አራራትም አገር ኰበለሉ። ልጁም አስራዶን በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት ሕዝቅያስ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ታመመ። ነቢዩም የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትሞታለህ እንጂ በሕይወት አትኖርምና ቤትህን አስተካክል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ፊቱንም ወደ ግድግዳው መልሶ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ በእውነትና በፍጹም ልብ እንደ ሄድሁ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኝህንም እንዳደረግሁ ታስብ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ። ሕዝቅያስም እጅግ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም ወደ መካከለኛው ከተማ አደባባይ ሳይደርስ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ሲል መጣለት።

verses.text_english: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰህ የሕዝቤን አለቃ ሕዝቅያስን እንዲህ በለው። የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፥ እንባህንም አይቻለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ እፈውስሃለሁ፤ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ትወጣለህ።

verses.text_english: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.text_amharic: በዕድሜህም ላይ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት እጨምራለሁ፤ አንተንና ይህችን ከተማ ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ እታደጋለሁ፤ ስለ እኔም ስለ ባሪያዬም ስለ ዳዊት ይህችን ከተማ እጋርዳታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid on the boil, and he recovered.
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይስም፥ የበለስ ጥፍጥፍ አምጡልኝ አለ፤ አምጥተውም በእባጩ ላይ አደርጉለት፥ እርሱም ተፈወሰ።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲፈውሰኝ፥ እኔስ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንድወጣ ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም፥ እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ነገር እንዲፈጽመው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክቱ ይህ ይሆንልሃል፤ ጥላው አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ፊት ይሄድ ዘንድ ወይም አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ ይመለስ ዘንድ ትወድዳለህን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም፥ ጥላው አሥር ደረጃ ቢጨምር ቀላል ነገር ነው፤ እንዲህ አይሁን፤ ነገር ግን ጥላው አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ ይመለስ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ኢሳይያስ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ፤ ጥላውንም በአካዝ የጥላ ስፍራ ሰዓት ላይ በወረደበት መንገድ አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ መለሰው።

verses.text_english: At that time Berodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የባልዳን ልጅ መሮዳክ ባልዳን ሕዝቅያስ እንደ ታመመ ሰምቶ ነበርና ደብዳቤና እጅ መንሻ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ደስ አለው፥ ግምጃ ቤቱንም ሁሉ፥ ብሩንና ወርቁንም፥ ቅመሙንና የከበረውንም ዘይት፥ መሣሪያም ያለበትን ቤት በቤተ መዛግብቱም የተገኘውን ሁሉ አሳያቸው በቤቱና በግዛቱ ሁሉ ካለው ሕዝቅያስ ያላሳያቸው የለም።

verses.text_english: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, from Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ኢሳያሳ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጥቶ። እነዚህ ሰዎች ምን አሉ? ከወዴትስ መጡልህ? አለው። ሕዝቅያስም። ከሩቅ አገር ከባቢሎን መጡ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በቤትህ ያዩት ምንድር ነው? አለው፤ ሕዝቅያስም። በቤቴ ያለውን ሁሉ አይተዋል፤ በቤተ መዛግብቴ ካለው ያላሳየኋቸው የለም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም ሕዝቅያስን። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, that all that in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በቤትህ ያለው ሁሉ፥ አባቶችህም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያከማቹት ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን የሚፈልስበት ወራት ይመጣል፤ ምንም አይቀርም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተም ከሚወጡት ከምትወልዳቸው ልጆችህ ማርከው ይወስዳሉ፤ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቤት ውስጥ ጃንደረቦች ይሆናሉ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, not , if peace and truth be in my days?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን። የተናገርኸው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መልካም ነው አለው። ደግሞም። በዘመኔ ሰላምና እውነት የሆነ እንደ ሆነ መልካም አይደለምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የሕዝቅያስ ነገር፥ ጭከናውም ሁሉ፥ ኵሬውንና መስኖውንም እንደ ሠራ፥ ውኃውንም ወደ ከተማይቱ እንዳመጣ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ምናሴ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Manasseh twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Hephzibah.
verses.text_amharic: ምናሴም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ የእናቱ ስም ሐፍሴባ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳወጣቸው እንደ አሕዛብ ርኵሰት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ሕዝቅያስ ያፈረሳቸውን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች መልሶ ሠራ፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አክዓብ እንዳደረገው ለበኣል መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድንም ተከለ፥ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ሰገደ አመለካቸውም።

verses.text_english: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ስሜን በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራለሁ ባለው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት መሠዊያዎችን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በሁለቱ ወለሎች ላይ ለሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ መሠዊያዎችን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke to anger.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁንም በእሳት አሳለፈ፥ ሞራ ገላጭም ሆነ፥ አስማትም አደረገ፥ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችንም ሰበሰበ፤ ያስቈጣውም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እጅግ ክፉ ነገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለዳዊትና ለልጁ ለሰሎሞን። በዚህ ቤት ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ሁሉ በመረጥኋት በኢየሩሳሌም ስሜን ለዘላለም አኖራለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
verses.text_amharic: ያዘዝኋቸውንም ሁሉ፥ ባሪያዬም ሙሴ ያዘዛቸውን ሕግ ሁሉ ቢያደርጉ ቢጠብቁም ለአባቶቻቸው ከሰጠኋት ምድር የእስራኤልን እግር እንደ ገና አላቅበዘብዝም ባለው ቤት የሠራውን የማምለኪያ ዐፀድን የተቀረጸውን ምስል አቆመ።

verses.text_english: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አልሰሙም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ካጠፋቸው ከአሕዛብ ይልቅ ክፉ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ምናሴ አሳታቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያት እጅ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ምናሴ ይህን ርኵሰት አድርጎአልና፥ ከፊቱም የነበሩ አሞራውያን ከሠሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ ክፉ ሥራ ሠርቶአልና፥ ይሁዳንም ደግሞ በጣዖታቱ አስቶአልና

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I bringing evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የሚሰማውን ሁሉ ሁለቱ ጆሮቹ ጭው የሚያደርግ ክፉ ነገርን በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ላይ አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as wipeth a dish, wiping , and turning upside down.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማርያንም ገመድ የአክዓብንም ቤት ቱንቢ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ እዘረጋለሁ ሰውም ወጭቱን እንዲወለውል ኢየሩሳሌምን ወልውዬ እገለብጣታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
verses.text_amharic: የርስቴንም ቅሬታ እጥላለሁ፥ በጠላቶቻቸውም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ለጠላቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ምርኮና ብዝበዛ ይሆናሉ፤

verses.text_english: Because they have done evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻቸው ከግብጽ ከወጡ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በፊቴ ክፉ ሠርተዋልና፥ አስቈጥተውኝማልና።

verses.text_english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ምናሴ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ይሠራ ዘንድ ይሁዳን ካሳተበት ኃጢአት ሌላ ከዳር እስከ ዳር ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪሞላት ድረስ እጅግ ብዙ ንጹሕ ደም አፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የምናሴም የቀረው ነገርና የሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ፥ ያደረገውም ኃጢአት፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ምናሴም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በቤቱም አጠገብ ባለው በዖዛ አትክልት ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም አሞጽ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Amon twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.text_amharic: አሞጽም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የዮጥባ ሰው የሐሩስ ልጅ ሜሶላም ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ምናሴ እንዳደረገ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም በሄደበት መንገድ ሁሉ ሄደ፥ አባቱም ያመለካቸውን ጣዖታት አመለከ ሰገደላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቹንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ተወ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም መንገድ አልሄደም።

verses.text_english: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞጽም ባሪያዎች አሴሩበት ንጉሡንም በቤቱ ውስጥ ገደሉት፥

verses.text_english: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩ ሕዝብ ግን በንጉሡ በአሞጽ ላይ ያሴሩበትን ሁሉ ገደሉ፤ የአገሩም ሕዝብ ልጁን ኢዮስያስን በእርሱ ፋንታ አነገሡት።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የአሞጽም የቀረው ነገርና የሠራው ሥራ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በዖዛም አትክልት ባለው በመቃብሩ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኢዮስያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Josiah eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የስምንት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ከባሱሮት የሆነ የአዳያ ልጅ ይዲዳ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገርን አደረገ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት መንገድ ሁሉ ሄደ፥ ቀኝም ግራም አላለም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም በኢዮስያስ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት በስምንተኛው ወር ንጉሡ ጸሐፊውን የሜሶላምን ልጅ የኤዜልያስን ልጅ ሳፋንን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ላከው፥ እንዲህም አለው።

verses.text_english: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደሱ በረኞች ከሕዝቡ የሰበሰቡትን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የገባውን ገንዘብ ይደምር ዘንድ ወደ ካህናቱ አለቃ ወደ ኬልቅያስ ሂድ።

verses.text_english: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላሉት ሠራተኞች አለቆች ይስጡት፤ እነርሱም የተናደውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለሚጠግኑት ሠራተኞች፥

verses.text_english: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
verses.text_amharic: ለአናጢዎችና ለጠራቢዎች፥ ለድንጋይም ወቃሪዎች፥ መቅደሱንም ለመጠገን እንጨትንና የተወቀረውን ድንጋይ ለሚገዙ ይክፈሉት።

verses.text_english: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እነርሱ የታመኑ ነበሩና በእጃቸው ስለ ተሰጠ አይቈጣጠሩአቸውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ኬልቅያስ ጸሐፊውን ሳፋንን፥ የሕጉን መጽሐፍ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አግኝቻለሁ አለው፤ ኬልቅያስም መጽሐፉን ለሳፋን ሰጠው፥ እርሱም አነበበው።

verses.text_english: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሐፊውም ሳፋን ወደ ንጉሡ መጣ፥ ለንጉሡም። በመቅደሱ የተገኘውን ገንዘብ ባሪያዎችህ አፈሰሱት፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ሠራተኞች ላይ ለተሾሙት አለቆች ሰጡት ብሎ አወራለት።

verses.text_english: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሐፊውም ሳፋን ለንጉሡ። ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ መጽሐፍ ሰጥቶኛል ብሎ ነገረው። ሳፋንም በንጉሡ ፊት አነበበው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የሕጉን መጽሐፍ ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ።

verses.text_english: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ካህኑን ኬልቅያስን፥ የሳፋንንም ልጅ አኪቃምን፥ የሚክያስንም ልጅ ዓክቦርን፥ ጸሐፊውንም ሳፋንን፥ የንጉሡንም ብላቴና ዓሳያን።

verses.text_english: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን በእርስዋ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ ይሠሩ ዘንድ የዚህችን መጽሐፍ ቃል ስላልሰሙ በላያችን የነደደ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ እጅግ ነውና ሄዳችሁ ስለ እኔና ስለ ሕዝቡ ስለ ይሁዳም ሁሉ የዚህችን የተገኘችውን መጽሐፍ ቃል እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቁ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ካህኑ ኬልቅያስና አኪቃም ዓክቦርም ሳፋንና ዓሳያም ወደ ልብስ ጠባቂው ወደ ሐስራ ልጅ ወደ ቲቁዋ ልጅ ወደ ሴሌም ሚስት ወደ ነቢያቱ ወደ ሕልዳና ሄዱ፤ እርስዋም በኢየሩሳሌም በሁለተኛው ክፍል ተቀምጣ ነበር፤ ከእርስዋም ጋር ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም አለቻቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ እኔ ለላካችሁ ሰው እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ እንዳነበበው እንደ መጽሐፉ ቃል ሁሉ በዚህ ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.text_amharic: በእጃቸው ሥራ ሁሉ ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ትተውኛልና፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት ዐጥነዋልና ቍጣዬ በዚህ ስፍራ ላይ ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋምም።

verses.text_english: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, the words which thou hast heard;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ለላካችሁ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ግን እንዲህ በሉት። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ሰማኸው ቃል፥ ልብህ ገር ሆኖአልና፥

verses.text_english: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard , saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ለድንቅና ለመርገም እንዲሆኑ በዚህ ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ የተናገርሁትን ሰምተህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ተዋርደሃልና፥ ልብስህን ቀድደሃልና፥ በፊቴም አልቅሰሃልና እኔ ደግሞ ሰምቼሃለሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ደግሞ ወደ አባቶችህ እሰበስብሃለሁ፥ በሰላምም ወደ መቃብርህ ትሰበሰባለህ፤ በዚህም ስፍራ ላይ የማመጣውን ክፉ ነገር ዓይኖችህ አያዩም። ይህንም ለንጉሡ አወሩለት።

verses.text_english: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ላከ፤ የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምንም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጣ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱና ነቢያቱም፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከታናሾቹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቆቹ ድረስ ወጡ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የተገኘውን የቃል ኪዳኑን መጽሐፍ ቃል ሁሉ በጆሮአቸው አነበበ።

verses.text_english: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all heart and all soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በዓምደ ወርቁ አጠገብ ቆሞ እግዚአብሔርን ተከትሎ ይሄድ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንና ምስክሩንም ሥርዓቱንም በፍጹም ልቡና በፍጹም ነፍሱ ይጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ በዚሁም መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን የቃል ኪዳን ቃል ያጸና ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ቃል ኪዳን ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የካህናቱን አለቃ ኬልቅያስን በሁለተኛውም መዓርግ ያሉትን ካህናትን በረኞቹንም ለባኣልና ለማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ የተሠሩትን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ያወጡ ዘንድ አዘዛቸው፤ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ውጭ በቄድሮን ሜዳ አቃጠላቸው፥ አመዱንም ወደ ቤቴል ወሰደው።

verses.text_english: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ነገሥታትም በይሁዳ ከተሞች በነበሩት በኮረብታው መገጃዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ መስገጃዎች ያጥኑ ዘንድ ያኖሩአቸውን የጣዖቱን ካህናት፥ ለበኣልና ለፀሐይ ለጨረቃና ለከዋክብት ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ያጥኑ የነበሩትንም አስወገደ።

verses.text_english: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
verses.text_amharic: የማምለኪያ ዐፀድንም ጣዖት ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ውጭ ወደ ቄድሮን ፈፋ አወጣው፤ በቄድሮንም ፈፋ አጠገብ አቃጠለው፥ አድቅቆም ትቢያ አደረገው፥ ትቢያውንም በሕዝብ መቃብር ላይ ጣለው።

verses.text_english: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶቹም ለማምለኪያ ዐፀድ መጋረጃ ይፈትሉባቸው የነበሩትን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ያሉትን የሰዶማውያንን ቤቶች አፈረሰ።

verses.text_english: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱንም ሁሉ ከይሁዳ ከተሞች አወጣቸው፤ ከጌባም ጀምሮ እስከ ቤርሳቤህ ድረስ ካህናት ያጥኑበት የነበረውን የኮረብታ መስገጃ ሁሉ ርኩስ አደረገው። በከተማይቱም በር በግራ በኩል በነበረው በከተማይቱ ሹም በኢያሱ በር መግቢያ አጠገብ የነበሩትን የበሮቹን መስገጃዎች አፈረሰ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.text_amharic: የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ካህናት ግን በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ አይመጡም ነበር፤ ብቻ በወንድሞቻቸው መካከል ቂጣ እንጀራ ይበሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he defiled Topheth, which in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሰው ወንድ ልጁን ወይም ሴት ልጁን ለሞሎክ በእሳት እንዳያሳልፍ በሄኖም ልጆች ሸለቆ የነበረውን ቶፌትን ርኩስ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ነገሥታት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት መግቢያ አጠገብ በከተማው አቅራቢያ በነበረው በጃንደረባው በናታንሜሌክ መኖሪያ አጠገብ ለፀሐይ የሰጡትን ፈረሶች አስወገደ፤ የፀሐይንም ሰረገሎች በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And the altars that on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ነገሥታት ያሠሩትን በአካዝ ቤት ሰገነት ላይ የነበሩትን መሠዊያዎች፥ ምናሴም ያሠራውን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሁለቱ ወለሎች ላይ የነበሩትን መሠዊያዎች ንጉሡ አስፈረሳቸው፥ አደቀቃቸውም፥ ትቢያቸውንም በቄድሮን ፈፋ ጣለ።

verses.text_english: And the high places that before Jerusalem, which on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ፊት ለፊት በርኵሰት ተራራ ቀኝ የነበሩትን፥ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን ለሲዶናውያን ርኵሰት ለአስታሮት ለሞዓብም ርኵሰት ለካሞሽ ለአሞንም ልጆች ርኵሰት ለሚልኮም ያሠራቸውን መስገጃዎች ንጉሡ ርኩስ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
verses.text_amharic: ሐውልቶቹንም ሁሉ አደቀቀ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፥ በስፍራቸውም የሙታንን አጥንት ሞላበት።

verses.text_english: Moreover the altar that at Bethel, the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, stamped small to powder, and burned the grove.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በቤቴል የነበረውን መሠዊያ፥ እስራኤልንም ያሳተ የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም ያሠራውን የኮረብታውን መስገጃ፥ ይህን መሠዊያና መስገጃ አፈረሰ፤ ድንጋዮቹንም ሰባበረ፥ አድቅቆም ትቢያ አደረገው፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዱንም አቃጠለው።

verses.text_english: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮስያስም ዘወር ብሎ በተራራው የነበሩትን መቃብሮች አየ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም በበዓል ጊዜ በመሠዊያ አጠገብ ሲቆም እነዚህን ነገሮች የተነባ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል፥ ልኮ ከመቃብሮቹ አጥንቶቹን አስወጣ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ አቃጠላቸው አረከሰውም። ዘወርም ብሎ ወደ ተናገረው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው መቃብር ዓይኖቹን አቅንቶ።

verses.text_english: Then he said, What title that that I see? And the men of the city told him, the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.
verses.text_amharic: ያ የማየው የመታሰቢያ ምልክት ምንድር ነው? አለ። የዚያችም ከተማ ሰዎች። ከይሁዳ ወጥቶ በቤቴል መሠዊያ ላይ ይህን ያደረግኸውን ነገር የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ሰው መቃብር ነው ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ተዉት፥ ማንም አጥንቱን አያንቀሳቅሰው አለ፤ እነርሱም ከሰማርያ ከወጣው ከነቢዩ አጥንት ጋር አጥንቱን ተዉ።

verses.text_english: And all the houses also of the high places that in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማሪያም ከተሞች የነበሩትን፥ እግዚአብሔርን ያስቈጡት ዘንድ የእስራኤል ነገሥታት የሠሩትን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ኢዮስያስ አስወገዳቸው፥ በቤቴልም እንዳደረገው ነገር ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገባቸው።

verses.text_english: And he slew all the priests of the high places that there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የነበሩትን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ካህናት ሁሉ በመሠዊያዎቹ ላይ ገደላቸው፥ የሰዎቹንም አጥንት በመሠዊያዎቹ ላይ አቃጠለ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as written in the book of this covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። በዚህ በቃል ኪዳን መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው ለአምላካችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ አድርጉ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም ያለ ፋሲካ በእስራኤል ላይ ይፈርዱ ከነበሩ ከመሳፍንት ዘመን ጀምሮ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ዘመን ሁሉ አልተፈሰከም።

verses.text_english: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ይህ ፋሲካ በኢየሩሳሌም ለእግዚአብሔር ተፈሰከ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ባገኘው መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን የሕጉን ቃል ያጸና ዘንድ፥ መናፍስት ጠሪዎቹንና ጠንቋዮቹን ተራፊምንና ጣዖታትንም በይሁዳ አገርና በኢየሩሳሌም የተገኘውን ርኵሰት ሁሉ ኢዮስያስ አስወገደ።

verses.text_english: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there like him.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሙሴም ሕግ ሁሉ በፍጹም ልቡ በፍጹምም ነፍሱ በፍጹምም ኃይሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የተመለሰ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ንጉሥ ከእርሱ አስቀድሞ አልነበረም፤ እንደ እርሱም ያለ ንጉሥ ከእርሱ በኋላ አልተነሣም።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ምናሴ ስላስቈጣው ነገር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በይሁዳ ላይ ከነደደው ከታላቁ ቍጣው ትኵሳት አልተመለሰም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። እስራኤልን እንዳራቅሁት ይሁዳን ከፊቴ አርቀዋላሁ፤ ይህችንም የመረጥኋትን ከተማ ኢየሩሳሌምንና። ስሜ በዚያ ይሆናል ያልሁትን ቤት እጥላለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የኢዮስያስ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: In his days Pharaohnechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ዘመን የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ ከአሦር ንጉሥ ጋር ሊጋጠም ወደ ኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ወጣ፤ ንጉሡም ኢዮስያስ ከእርሱ ጋር ሊጋጠም ወጣ፤ ፈርዖንም በተገናኘው ጊዜ በመጊዶ ገደለው።

verses.text_english: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.
verses.text_amharic: ከሞተም በኋላ ባሪያዎቹ በሰረገላው አድርገው ከመጊዶ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመጡት፥ በመቃብሩም ቀበሩት። የአገሩም ሰዎች የኢዮስያስን ልጅ ኢዮአክስን ወሰዱት፥ ቀብተውም በአባቱ ፋንታ አነገሡት።

verses.text_english: Jehoahaz twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአክስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ሦስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ወር ነገሠ። እናቱም አሚጣል ትባል ነበር፥ እርስዋም የልብና ሰው የኤርምያስ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቹም እንዳደረጉ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Pharaohnechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም እንዳይነግሥ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ በሐማት ምድር ባለችው በሪብላ አሰረው፤ በምድሩም ላይ መቶ መክሊት ብርና አንድ መክሊት ወርቅ ፈሰሴ ጣለበት።

verses.text_english: And Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖን ኒካዑም የኢዮስያስን ልጅ ኤልያቄምን በአባቱ በኢዮስያስ ፋንታ አነገሠ፥ ስሙንም ኢዮአቄም ብሎ ለወጠው። ኢዮአክስንም ወስዶ ወደ ግብጽ አፈለሰው፤ በዚያም ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give unto Pharaohnechoh.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአቄምም ብሩንና ወርቁን ለፈርዖን ሰጠው፤ እንደ ፈርዖንም ትእዛዝ ገንዘብ ይሰጥ ዘንድ ምድሩን አስገበረ፤ ለፈርዖን ኒካዑም ይሰጥ ዘንድ ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ እንደ ግምጋሜው ብርና ወርቅ አስከፈለ።

verses.text_english: Jehoiakim twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአቄምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ዘቢዳ ትባል ነበር፤ እርስዋም የሩማ ሰው የፈዳያ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቹም እንዳደረጉ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ዘመን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነዖር ወጣ፥ ኢዮአቄምም ሦስት ዓመት ተገዛለት፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ዘወር አለና ዐመፀበት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servants the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የከለዳውያንንና የሶርያውያንን የሞዓባውያንንም የአሞንንም ልጆች አደጋ ጣዮች ሰደደበት፤ በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያት እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ያጠፉት ዘንድ በይሁዳ ላይ ሰደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came upon Judah, to remove out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
verses.text_amharic: ምናሴ ስላደረገው ኃጢአት ሁሉ ስላፈሰሰውም ንጹሕ ደም፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በንጹሕ ደም ስለሞላ ከፊቱ ያስወግዳቸው ዘንድ ይህ ነገር በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ በይሁዳ ላይ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይራራ ዘንድ አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የኢዮአቄም ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአቄምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ዮአኪን፤ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ለግብጽ ንጉሥ የነበረውን ሁሉ ከግብጽ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ድረስ ወስዶ ነበርና የግብጽ ንጉሥ ከዚያ ወዲያ ከአገሩ አልወጣም።

verses.text_english: Jehoiachin eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዮአኪን መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ወር ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ኔስታ ትባል ነበር፤ እርስዋም የኢየሩሳሌም ሰው የኤልናታን ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የናቡከደነዖር ባሪያዎች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ፥ ከተማይቱም ተከበበች።

verses.text_english: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹም በከበቡአት ጊዜ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናብከደነዖር ወደ ከተማይቱ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ዮአኮንና እናቱ፥ ባርያዎቹም፥ አለቆቹም፥ ጃንደረቦቹም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወጡ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በነገሠ በስምንተኛው ዓመት ያዘው።

verses.text_english: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት መዛግብትን ሁሉ የንጉሡም ቤት መዛግብትን ከዚያ አወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ የሠራውን የወርቁን ዕቃ ሁሉ ሰባበረ።

verses.text_english: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌምንም ሁሉ፥ አለቆቹንም ሁሉ፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላኑንም ሁሉ፥ ጠራቢዎቹንም ሁሉ፥ ብረት ሠራተኞቹን ሁሉ አሥር ሺህ ምርኮኞች አፈለሰ፤ ከድሆች ከአገሩ ሕዝብ በቀር ማንም አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ዮአኮንንም ወደ ባቢሎን አፈለሰ፤ የንጉሡንም እናት፥ የንጉሡንም ሚስቶች፥ ጃንደረቦቹንም፥ የአገሩንም ታላላቆች ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ማረከ።

verses.text_english: And all the men of might, seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all strong apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ብርቱዎቹንና ሰልፍ የሚችሉትን ሁሉ፥ ኃያላኑን ሁሉ ሰባት ሺህ ያህል፥ ጠራቢዎችና ብረት ሠራተኞችም አንድ ሺህ፥ ወደ ባቢሎን ማረከ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የዮአኪንን አጎት ማታንያን በእርሱ ፋንታ አነገሠ፥ ስሙንም ሴዴቅያስ ብሎ ለወጠው።

verses.text_english: Zedekiah twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዴቅያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም አሚጣል የተባለች የልብና ሰው የኤርምያስ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአቄምም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊቱ አውጥቶ እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ ይህ ነገር በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ላይ ሆኖአልና፤ ሴዴቅያስም በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዴቅያስም በነገሠ በዘጠኝኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥተው ከበቡአት፤ በዙሪያዋም ዕርድ ሠሩባት።

verses.text_english: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም እስከ ንጉሡ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ድረስ ተከብባ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And on the ninth of the month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ወር በዘጠኝኛው ቀን በከተማይቱ ራብ ጸንቶ ነበርና ለአገሩ ሰዎች እንጀራ ታጣ።

verses.text_english: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees against the city round about:) and went the way toward the plain.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም ተሰበረች፥ ሰልፈኞችም ሁሉ በሁለት ቅጥር መካከል ባለው በር ወደ ንጉሡ አትክልት በሚወስደው መንገድ በሌሊት ሸሹ፤ ከለዳውያንም በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ነበሩ፤ በዓረባም መንገድ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
verses.text_amharic: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ንጉሡን ተከታተሉ፥ በኢያሪኮም ሜዳ ያዙት፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ተለይተው ተበትነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም ይዘው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለበት ወደ ሪብላ አመጡት፤ ፍርድም ፈረዱበት።

verses.text_english: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የሴዴቅያስንም ልጆች በፊቱ ገደሉአቸው፤ የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይኖች አወጡ፥ በሰንሰለትም አሰሩት፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And in the fifth month, on the seventh of the month, which the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በአሥራ ዘጠኝኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሰባተኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ባሪያ የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great house burnt he with fire.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ ታላላቆቹን ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And all the army of the Chaldees, that the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጋር የነበረው የከለዳውያን ሠራዊት ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ዙሪያዋን አፈረሱ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the people left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፥ ሸሽተውም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ የተጠጉትን፥ የቀሩትንም ሕዝብ አፈለሰ።

verses.text_english: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land vinedressers and husbandmen.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ከአገሩ ድሆች ወይን ተካዮችና አራሾች እንዲሆኑ አስቀረ።

verses.text_english: And the pillars of brass that in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ከለዳውያንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ የነበሩትን የናስ ዓምዶች፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የነበሩትን መቀመጫዎችና የናስ ኵሬ ሰባበሩ፥ ናሱንም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.text_amharic: ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎቹንም መኰስተሪያዎቹንና ጭልፋዎቹንም የሚያገለግሉበትንም የናስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And the firepans, and the bowls, such things as of gold, gold, and of silver, silver, the captain of the guard took away.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ማንደጃዎቹንና መቀመጨዎቹን፥ የወርቁን ዕቃ ሁሉ በወርቅ፥ የብሩንም በብር አድርጎ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራቸውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች አንዱንም ኵሬ መቀመጫዎቹንም ወሰደ፤ ለእነዚህ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ናስ ሚዛን አልነበረውም።

verses.text_english: The height of the one pillar eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
verses.text_amharic: የአንዱም ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የናስም ጕልላት ነበረበት፤ የጕልላቱም ርዝመት ሦስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በጕልላቱም ላይ በዙሪያው የናስ መርበብና ሮማኖች ነበሩ፤ እንዲሁም ደግሞ በሁለተኛው ዓምድ ላይ መርበብ ነበረበት።

verses.text_english: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ታላቁን ካህን ሠራያን ሁለተኛውንም ካህን ሶፎንያስን ሦስቱንም በረኞች ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land found in the city:
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማይቱም በሰልፈኞች ላይ ተሾመው ከነበሩት አንዱን ጃንደረባ፥ በከተማይቱም የተገኙትን በንጉሡ ፊት የሚቆሙትን አምስቱን ሰዎች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ የሚያሰልፍ የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊ፥ በከተማይቱም ከተገኙት ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወስዶ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለበት ወደ ሪብላ አመጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ መታቸው፥ በሐማትም ምድር ባለችው በሪብላ ገደላቸው። እንዲሁ ይሁዳ ከአገሩ ተማረከ።

verses.text_english: And the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በይሁዳ ምድር በቀረው ሕዝብ ላይ የሳፋንን ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን አለቃ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.text_amharic: የጭፍሮቹም አለቆች ሁሉ፥ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል፥ የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ የነጦፋዊውም የተንሑሜት ልጅ ሠራያ፥ የማዕካታዊውም ልጅ ያእዛንያ፥ ሰዎቻቸውም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ጎዶልያስን እንደ ሾመ በሰሙ ጊዜ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ወደ ምጽጳ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
verses.text_amharic: ጎዶልያስም። ከከለዳውያን ሎሌዎች የተነሣ አትፍሩ፥ በአገሩ ተቀመጡ፥ ለባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ተገዙ፥ መልካምም ይሆንላችኋል ብሎ ለእነርሱና ለሰዎቻቸው ማለላቸው።

verses.text_english: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛው ወር ግን የመንግሥት ዘር የነበረ የኤሊሳማ ልጅ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ከእርሱም ጋር አሥር ሰዎች መጥተው ጎዶልያስንና ከእርሱ ጋር በምጽጳ የነበሩትን አይሁድንና ከለዳውያንን እስኪሞቱ ድረስ መቱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
verses.text_amharic: ከለዳውያንንም ፈርተው ነበርና ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የጭፍሮቹም አለቆች ተነሥተው ወደ ግብጽ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
