verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማከረ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ ሰባተኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴቅ በነገሠ በአንደኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪንን ከወህኒ አወጣው፤

verses.text_english: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that with him in Babylon;
verses.text_amharic: በፍቅርም ተናገረው፥ ዙፋኑንም ከእርሱ ጋር በባቢሎን ከነበሩት ነገሥታት ዙፋን በላይ አደረገለት።

verses.text_english: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
verses.text_amharic: በወህኒም ውስጥ ለብሶት የነበረውን ልብስ ለወጠለት፤ ዮአኪንም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ በፊቱ ሁልጊዜ እንጀራ ይበላ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his allowance a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ የዘወትር ቀለብ ዕለት ዕለት ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
verses.text_amharic: አዳም፥

verses.text_english: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
verses.text_amharic: ሴት፥ ሄኖስ፥ ቃይናን፥ መላልኤል፥

verses.text_english: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.text_amharic: ያሬድ፥ ሄኖክ፥ ማቱሳላ፥ ላሜሕ፥

verses.text_english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅ፥ ሴም፥ ካም፥ ያፌት።

verses.text_english: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.text_amharic: የያፌት ልጆች፤ ጋሜር፥ ማጎግ፥ ማዴ፥

verses.text_english: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.text_amharic: ያዋን፥ ቶቤል፥ ሞሳሕ፥ ቴራስ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.text_amharic: የጋሜርም ልጆች፤ አስከናዝ፥ ሪፋት፥ ቴርጋማ። የያዋንም ልጆች፤ ኤሊሳ፥ ተርሴስ፥ ኪቲም፥ ሮድኢ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.text_amharic: የካምም ልጆች፤ ኩሽ፥ ምጽራይም፥ ፉጥ፥ ከነዓን።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.text_amharic: የኩሽም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ኤውላጥ፥ ሰብታ፥ ራዕማ፥ ሰብቃታ። የራዕማም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ድዳን።

verses.text_english: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ኩሽም ናምሩድን ወለደ፤ እርሱም በምድር ኃያል መሆንን ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.text_amharic: ምጽራይምም ሉዲምን፥ ዐናሚምን፥ ላህቢምን፥

verses.text_english: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍተሂምን፥ ፈትሩሲምን፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን የወጡበትን ከስሉሂምን፥ ከፍቶሪምን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.text_amharic: ከነዓንም የበኵር ልጁን ሲዶንን፥

verses.text_english: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.text_amharic: ኬጢን፥ ኢያቡሳዊውን፥ አሞራዊውን፥

verses.text_english: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.text_amharic: ጌርጌሳዊውን፥ ኤዊያዊውን፥ ዐርካዊውን፥

verses.text_english: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.text_amharic: ሲኒያዊውን፥ አራዴዎንን፥ ሰማሪዎንን፥ አማቲን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.text_amharic: የሴምም ልጆች፤ ኤላም፥ አሦር፥ አርፋክስድ፥ ሉድ፥ አራም፥ ዑፅ፥ ሁል፥ ጌቴር፥ ሞሳሕ።

verses.text_english: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.text_amharic: አርፋክስድም ቃይንምን ወለደ፤ ቃይንምም ሳላን ወለደ፤ ሳላም ዔቦርን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name Joktan.
verses.text_amharic: ለዔቦርም ሁለት ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ በዘመኑ ምድር ተከፍላለችና የአንደኛው ስም ፋሌቅ ተባለ፤ የወንድሙም ስም ዮቅጣን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.text_amharic: ዮቅጣንም አልሞዳድን፥

verses.text_english: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.text_amharic: ሣሌፍን፥ ሐስረሞትን፥ ያራሕን፥ ሀዶራምን፥

verses.text_english: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.text_amharic: አውዛልን፥ ደቅላን፥ ዖባልን፥ አቢማኤልን፥

verses.text_english: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these the sons of Joktan.
verses.text_amharic: ሳባን፥ ኦፊርን፥ ኤውላጥን፥ ዮባብን ወለደ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የዮቅጣን ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.text_amharic: የአብርሃምም ልጆች፤ ይስሐቅ፥ እስማኤል።

verses.text_english: Abram; the same Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: ትውልዳቸውም እንደዚህ ነው። የእስማኤል በኵር ልጅ ነባዮት፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ቄዳር፥ ነብዳኤል፥ መብሳም፥

verses.text_english: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.text_amharic: ማስማዕ፥ ዱማ፥ ማሣ፥ ኩዳን፥ ቴማን፥

verses.text_english: These their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.text_amharic: ኢጡር፥ ናፌስ፥ ቄድማ፤ እነዚህ የእስማኤል ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.text_amharic: የአብርሃምም ገረድ የኬጡራ ልጆች፤ ዘምራን፥ ዮቅሳን፥ ሜዳን፥ ምድያም፥ የስቦቅ፥ ስዌሕ። የዮቅሳንም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ድዳን።

verses.text_english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.text_amharic: የምድያምም ልጆች፤ ጌፌር፥ ዔፌር፥ ሄኖኅ፥ አቢዳዕ፥ ኤልዳዓ። እነዚህ ሁሉ የኬጡራ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃምም ይስሐቅን ወለደ። የይስሐቅም ልጆች ዔሳውና እስራኤል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these the sons of Keturah.
verses.text_amharic: የዔሳው ልጆች፤ ኤልፋዝ፥ ራጉኤል፥ የዑስ፥ የዕላም፥ ቆሬ።

verses.text_english: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የኤልፋዝ ልጆች፤ ቴማን፥ ኦማር፥ ስፎ፥ ጎቶም፥ ቄኔዝ፥ ቲምናዕ፥ አማሌቅ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.text_amharic: የራጉኤል ልጆች፤ ናሖት፥ ዛራ፥ ሣማ፥ ሚዛህ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.text_amharic: የሴይርም ልጆች፤ ሎጣን፥ ሦባል፥ ጽብዖን፥ ዓና፥ ዲሶን፥ ኤጽር፥ ዲሳን።

verses.text_english: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.text_amharic: የሎጣንም ልጆች፤ ሖሪ፥ ሔማም፤ ቲሞናዕ የሎጣን እኅት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.text_amharic: የሦባል ልጆች፤ ዓልዋን፥ ማኔሐት፥ ዔባል፥ ስፎ፥ አውናም። የጽብዖንም ልጆች፤ አያ፥ ዓና።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna Lotan's sister.
verses.text_amharic: የዓና ልጅ፤ ዲሶን። የዲሶንም ልጆች፤ ሔምዳን፥ ኤስባን፥ ይትራን፥ ክራን።

verses.text_english: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.text_amharic: የኤጽር ልጆች፤ ቢልሐን፥ ዛዕዋን፥ ዓቃን። የዲሳን ልጆች፤ ዑፅ፥ አራን።

verses.text_english: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ልጆች ላይ ገና ንጉሥ ሳይነግሥ በኤዶምያስ ምድር የነገሡ ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው። የቢዖር ልጅ ባላቅ፤ የከተማይቱም ስም ዲንሃባ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.text_amharic: ባላቅም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የባሶራ ሰው የዛራ ልጅ ኢዮባብ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Now these the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city Dinhabah.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮባብም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የቴማን አገር ሰው ሑሳም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሑሳምም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ምድያምን የመታው የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማይቱም ስም ዓዊት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሃዳድም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የመሥሬቃ ሰው ሠምላ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city Avith.
verses.text_amharic: ሠምላም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ በወንዙ አጠገብ ያለችው የረሆቦት ሰው ሳኡል ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኡልም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የዓክቦር ልጅ በኣልሐናን ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በኣልሐናንም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማይቱም ስም ፋዑ ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም የሜዛሃብ ልጅ የመጥሬድ ልጅ መሄጣብኤል ነበረች፤ ሃዳድም ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶምያስም አለቆች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ቲምናዕ አለቃ፥ ዓልዋ አለቃ፥ የቴት አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city Pai; and his wife's name Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.text_amharic: አህሊባማ አለቃ፥ ኤላ አለቃ፥ ፊኖን አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.text_amharic: ቄኔዝ አለቃ፥ ቴማን አለቃ፥ ሚብሳር አለቃ፥

verses.text_english: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.text_amharic: መግዲኤል አለቃ፥ ዒራም አለቃ፤ እነዚህ የኤዶምያስ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሮቤል፥ ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፥

verses.text_english: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.text_amharic: ዳን፥ ዮሴፍ፥ ብንያም፥ ንፍታሌም፥ ጋድ፥ አሴር።

verses.text_english: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ልጆች፤ ዔር፥ አውናን፥ ሴሎም፤ እነዚህ ሦስቱ ከከነዓናዊቱ ከሴዋ ልጅ ተወለዱለት። የይሁዳም የበኵር ልጅ ዔር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነበረ፤ ገደለውም።

verses.text_english: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah five.
verses.text_amharic: ምራቱም ትዕማር ፋሬስንና ዛራን ወለደችለት፤ የይሁዳም ልጆች ሁሉ አምስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.text_amharic: የፋሬስ ልጆች፤ ኤስሮም፥ ሐሙል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.text_amharic: የዛራም ልጆች፤ ዘምሪ፥ ኤታን፥ ሄማን፥

verses.text_english: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.text_amharic: ከልኮል፥ ዳራ፤ ሁሉም አምስት ነበሩ። የከርሚም ልጅ እስራኤልን ያስጨነቀ፥ እርሙንም ሰርቆ የበደለ አካን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.text_amharic: የኤታንም ልጅ አዛርያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.text_amharic: ለኤስሮም የተወለዱለት ልጆች፤ ይረሕምኤል፥ አራም፥ ካልብ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.text_amharic: አራምም አሚናዳብን ወለደ፤ አሚናዳብም የይሁዳን ልጆች አለቃ ነአሶንን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.text_amharic: ነአሶንም ሰልሞንን ወለደ፤ ሰልሞንም ቦዔዝን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.text_amharic: ቦዔዝም ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቤድም እሴይን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.text_amharic: እሴይም የበኵር ልጁን ኤልያብን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አሚናዳብን፥ ሦስተኛውንም ሣማን፥

verses.text_english: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛውንም ናትናኤልን፥

verses.text_english: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛውንም ራዳይን፥ ስድስተኛውንም አሳምን፥ ሰባተኛውንም ዳዊትን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: Whose sisters Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.text_amharic: እኅቶቻቸውም ጽሩያና አቢግያ ነበሩ። የጽሩያም ልጆች አቢሳ፥ ኢዮአብ፥ አሣሄል ሦስቱ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.text_amharic: አቢግያም አሜሳይን ወለደች፤ የአሜሳይም አባት እስማኤላዊው ዬቴር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat of Azubah wife, and of Jerioth: her sons these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.text_amharic: የኤስሮምም ልጅ ካሌብ ከሚስቱ ከዓዙባ ከይሪዖትም ልጆች ወለደ፤ ልጆቹዋም ያሳር፥ ሶባብ፥ አርዶን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.text_amharic: ዓዙባም ሞተች፥ ካሌብም ኤፍራታን አገባ፤ እርስዋም ሆርን ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.text_amharic: ሆርም ኡሪን ወለደ፥ ኡሪም ባስልኤልን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ኤስሮም ስድሳ ዓመት በሆነው ጊዜ ወዳገባት ወደ ገለዓድ አባት ወደ ማኪር ልጅ ገባ፤ ሠጉብንም ወለደችለት። ሠጉብም ኢያዕርን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም በገለዓድ ምድር ሀያ ሦስት ከተሞች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, threescore cities. All these the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ጌሹርና አራምም የኢያዕርን ከተሞች ከቄናትና ከመንደሮችዋ ጋር ስድሳውን ከተሞች ወሰዱባቸው። እነዚህ ሁሉ የገለዓድ አባት የማኪር ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.text_amharic: ኤስሮምም በካሌብ ኤፍራታ ከሞተ በኋላ የኤስሮም ሚስት አቢያ የቴቁሔን አባት አሽሑርን ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
verses.text_amharic: የኤስሮምም የበኵር ልጁ የይረሕምኤል ልጆች በኵሩ ራም፥ ቡናህ፥ ኦሬን፥ ኦጼም፥ አኪያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name Atarah; she the mother of Onam.
verses.text_amharic: ለይረሕምኤልም ዓጣራ የተባለች ሌላ ሚስት ነበረችው፤ እርስዋም የኦናም እናት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.text_amharic: የይረሕምኤል የበኵሩ የራም ልጆች መዓስ፥ ያሚን፥ ዔቄር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.text_amharic: የኦናምም ልጆች ሸማይና ያዳ ነበሩ። የሸማይ ልጆች ናዳብና አቢሱር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the name of the wife of Abishur Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.text_amharic: የአቢሱርም ሚስት አቢካኢል ነበረች፤ አሕባንንና ሞሊድን ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.text_amharic: የናዳብም ልጆች ሴሊድና አፋይም ነበሩ፤ ሴሌድም ያለ ልጆች ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.text_amharic: የአፋይምም ልጅ ይሽዒ፥ የይሽዒም ልጅ ሶሳን፥ የሶሳንም ልጅ አሕላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.text_amharic: የሸማይም ወንድም የያዳ ልጆች ዬቴርና ዮናታን ነበሩ፤ ዬቴርም ያለ ልጆች ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.text_amharic: የዮናታንም ልጆች ፌሌትና ዛዛ ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ የይረሕምኤል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name Jarha.
verses.text_amharic: ለሶሳንም ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ ለሶሳንም ኢዮሄል የተባለ ግብጻዊ አገልጋይ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.text_amharic: ሶሳንም ለአገልጋዩ ለኢዮሄል ልጁን አጋባት፥ እርስዋም ዓታይን ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.text_amharic: ዓታይም ናታንን ወለደ፤ ናታንም ዛባድን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.text_amharic: ዛባድም ኤፍላልን ወለደ፤ ኤፍላልም ዖቤድን ወለደ፤ ዖቤድም ኢዩን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዩም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.text_amharic: ዓዛርያስም ኬሌስን ወለደ፤ ኬሌስም ኤልዓሣን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዓሣም ሲስማይን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.text_amharic: ሲስማይም ሰሎምን ወለደ፤ ሰሎምም የቃምያን ወለደ፤ የቃምያም ኤሊሳማን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel , Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.text_amharic: የይረሕምኤልም ወንድም የካሌብ ልጆች በኵሩ የዚፍ አባት ሞሳ፥ የኬብሮንም አባት የመሪሳ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.text_amharic: የኬብሮንም ልጆች ቆሬ፥ ተፉዋ፥ ሬቄም፥ ሽማዕ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማዕም የዮርቅዓምን አባት ረሐምን ወለደ፤ ሬቄምም ሸማይን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the son of Shammai Maon: and Maon the father of Bethzur.
verses.text_amharic: የሸማይም ልጅ ማዖን ነበረ፤ ማዖንም የቤት ጹር አባት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.text_amharic: የካሌብም ቁባት ዔፋ ሐራንን፥ ሞዳን፥ ጋዜዝን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.text_amharic: ሐራንም ጋዜዝን ወለደ። የያህዳይም ልጆች ሬጌም፥ ኢዮታም፥ ጌሻን፥ ፋሌጥ፥ ሔፋ፥ ሸዓፍ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.text_amharic: የካሌብም ቁባት ማዕካ ሸቤርንና ቲርሐናን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb Achsah.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም የመድማናን አባት ሸዓፍንና የመክቢናንና የጊብዓን አባት ሱሳን ወለደች፤ የካሌብም ሴት ልጅ ዓክሳ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
verses.text_amharic: የካሌብ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የኤፍራታ የበኵሩ የሆር ልጅ የቂርያትይዓሪም አባት ሦባል፥

verses.text_english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
verses.text_amharic: የቤተ ልሔም አባት ሰልሞን፥ የቤት ጋዴር አባት ሐሬፍ።

verses.text_english: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, half of the Manahethites.
verses.text_amharic: ለቂርያትይዓሪምም አባት ለሦባል ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ሀሮኤ የመናሕታውያን እኵሌታ።

verses.text_english: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.text_amharic: የቂርያትይዓሪምም ወገኖች፤ ይትራውያን፥ ፉታውያን፥ ሹማታውያን፥ ሚሽራውያን፤ ከእነዚህም ጾርዓውያንና ኤሽታኦላውያን ወጡ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.text_amharic: የሰልሞንም ልጆች ቤተ ልሔም፥ ነጦፋውያን፥ ዓጣሮትቤትዮአብ፥ የመናሕታውያን እኵሌታ፥ ጾርዓውያን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, Suchathites. These the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.text_amharic: በያቤጽም የተቀመጡ የጸሐፊዎች ወገኖች፤ ቲርዓውያን፥ ሺምዓታውያን፥ ሡካታውያን ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ ከሬካብ ቤት አባት ከሐማት የወጡ ቄናውያን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.text_amharic: በኬብሮንም ለዳዊት የተወለዱለት ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው። በኵሩ አምኖን ከኢይዝራኤላዊቱ ከአኪናሆም፥ ሁለተኛውም ዳንኤል ከቀርሜሎሳዊቱ ከአቢግያ፥

verses.text_english: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛው አቤሴሎም ከጌሹር ንጉሥ ከተልማይ ልጅ ከመዓካ፥ አራተኛው አዶንያስ ከአጊት፥

verses.text_english: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛው ሰፋጥያስ ከአቢጣል፥ ስድስተኛው ይትረኃም ከሚስቱ ከዔግላ።

verses.text_english: six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስቱ በኬብሮን ተወለዱለት፤ በዚያም ሰባት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ነገሠ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም ተወለዱለት፤ ከዓሚኤል ልጅ ከቤርሳቤህ፥ ሳሙስ፥ ሶባብ፥ ናታን፥

verses.text_english: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞን፥ አራት፤ ኢያቤሐር፥ ኤሊሱዔ፥

verses.text_english: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊፋላት፥ ኖጋ፥ ናፌቅ፥ ያፍያ፥

verses.text_english: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሳማ፥ ኤሊዳሄ፥ ኤሊፋላት፥ ዘጠኝ።

verses.text_english: all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከቁባቶች ልጆች በቀር የዳዊት ልጆች ነበሩ፤ ትዕማርም እኅታቸው ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Solomon's son Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.text_amharic: የሰሎሞንም ልጅ ሮብዓም ነበረ፤ ልጁ አቢያ፥

verses.text_english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ አሳ፥ ልጁ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ ልጁ ኢዮራም፥ ልጁ አካዝያስ፥ ልጁ ኢዮአስ፥

verses.text_english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ አሜስያስ፥ ልጁ ዓዛርያስ፥ ልጁ ኢዮአታም፥

verses.text_english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ አካዝ፥ ልጁ ሕዝቅያስ፥ ልጁ ምናሴ፥

verses.text_english: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ አሞጽ፥ ልጁ ኢዮስያስ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Josiah , the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮስያስም ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ዮሐናን፥ ሁለተኛውም ኢዮአቄም፥ ሦስተኛውም ሴዴቅያስ፥ አራተኛውም ሰሎም።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮአቄምም ልጆች፤ ልጁ ኢኮንያን፥ ልጁ ሴዴቅያስ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.text_amharic: የምርኮኛውም የኢኮንያን ልጆች ሰላትያል፥ መልኪራም፥

verses.text_english: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.text_amharic: ፈዳያ፥ ሼናጻር፥ ይቃምያ፥ ሆሻማ፥ ነዳብያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Pedaiah , Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.text_amharic: የፈዳያ ልጆች ዘሩባቤልና ሰሜኢ ነበሩ፤ የዘሩባቤልም ልጆች፤ ሜሱላም፥ ሐናንያ፥ እኅታቸውም ሰሎሚት።

verses.text_english: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሹባ፥ ኦሄል፥ በራክያ፥ ሐሳድያ፥ ዮሻብሒሴድ አምስት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.text_amharic: የሐናንያም ልጆች ፈላጥያና የሻያ ነበሩ። የረፋያ ልጆች፥ የአርናን ልጆች፥ የአብድዩ ልጆች፥ የሴኬንያ ልጆች።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.text_amharic: የሴኬንያም ልጅ ሸማያ ነበረ። የሸማያም ልጆች ሐጡስ፥ ይግኣል፥ ባርያሕ፥ ነዓርያ፥ ሻፋጥ ስድስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.text_amharic: የነዓርያም ልጆች ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ሕዝቅያስ፥ ዓዝሪቃም ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Elioenai , Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.text_amharic: የኤልዮዔናይም ልጆች ሆዳይዋ፥ ኤልያሴብ፥ ፌልያ፥ ዓቁብ፥ ዮሐናን፥ ደላያ፥ ዓናኒ ሰባት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ልጆች ፋሬስ፥ ኤስሮም፥ ከርሚ፥ ሆር፥ ሦባል ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These the families of the Zorathites.
verses.text_amharic: የሦባልም ልጅ ራያ ኢኤትን ወለደ፤ ኢኤትም አሑማይንና ላሃድን ወለደ። እነዚህ የጾርዓውያን ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister Hazelelponi:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም የኤጣም አባት ልጆች ናቸው፤ ኢይዝራኤል፥ ይሽማ፥ ይድባሽ፥ እኅታቸውም ሃጽሌልፎኒ።

verses.text_english: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.text_amharic: የጌዶርም አባት ፋኑኤል፥ የሑሻም አባት ኤጽር፤ እነዚህ የቤተ ልሔም አባት የኤፍራታ የበኵሩ የሆር ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.text_amharic: ለቴቁሔም አባት ለአሽሑር ሔላና ነዕራ የተባሉ ሁለት ሚስቶች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These the sons of Naarah.
verses.text_amharic: ነዕራም አሑዛምን፥ ኦፌርን፥ ቴምኒን፥ አሐሽታሪን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ የነዕራ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Helah , Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.text_amharic: የሔላም ልጆች ዴሬት፥ ይጽሐር፥ ኤትናን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.text_amharic: ቆጽ ዓኑብን፥ ጾቤባን፥ የሃሩምንም ልጅ የአሐርሔልን ወገኖች ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: ያቤጽም ከወንድሞቹ ይልቅ የተከበረ ነበረ፤ እናቱም። በጣር ወልጄዋለሁና ብላ ስሙን። ያቤጽ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.text_english: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.text_amharic: ያቤጽም። እባክህ፥ መባረክን ባርከኝ፥ አገሬንም አስፋው፤ እጅህም ከእኔ ጋር ትሁን፤ እንዳያሳዝነኝም ከክፋት ጠብቀኝ ብሎ የእስራኤልን አምላክ ጠራ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የለመነውን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which the father of Eshton.
verses.text_amharic: የሹሐም ወንድም ክሉብ የኤሽቶንን አባት ምሒርን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These the men of Rechah.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሽቶንም ቤትራ ፋንና ፋሴሐን የዒርናሐሽንም አባት ተሒናን ወለደ፤ እነዚህ የሬካ ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.text_amharic: የቄኔዝም ልጆች ጎቶንያልና ሠራያ ነበሩ። የጎቶንያልም ልጅ ሐታት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.text_amharic: መዖኖታይ ዖፍራን ወለደ። ሠራያም የጌሃራሽምን አባት ኢዮአብን ወለደ፤ እነርሱም ጠራቢዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.text_amharic: የዮፎኒም ልጅ የካሌብ ልጆች ዒሩ፥ ኤላ፥ ነዓም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.text_amharic: የኤላም ልጅ ቄኔዝ ነበረ። የይሃሌልኤል ልጆች ዚፍ፥ ዚፋ፥ ቲርያ፥ አሣርኤል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ezra , Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.text_amharic: የዕዝራም ልጆች ዬቴር፥ ሜሬድ፥ ዔፌር፥ ያሎን ነበሩ፤ ዬቴርም ማርያምን፥ ሸማይን፥ የኤሽትምዓን አባት ይሽባን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁዳዊቱም ሚስቱ የጌዶርን አባት ዬሬድን፥ የሦኮንም አባት ሔቤርን፥ የዛኖዋንም አባት ይቁቲኤልን ወለደች። እነዚህም ሜሬድ ያገባት የፈርዖን ልጅ የቢትያ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.text_amharic: የሆዲያ ሚስት የነሐም እኅት ልጆች የገርሚው የቅዒላ አባትና ማዕካታዊው ኤሽትሞዓ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Shimon , Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi , Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
verses.text_amharic: የሺሞንም ልጆች አምኖን፥ ሪና፥ ቤንሐናን፥ ቲሎን ነበሩ። የይሽዒም ልጆች ዞሔትና ቢንዞሔት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah , Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ልጅ የሴሎም ልጆች የሌካ አባት ዔር፥ የመሪሳ አባት ለዓዳ፥ ከአሽቤዓ ቤት የሚሆኑ ጥሩ በፍታ የሚሠሩ ወገኖች፥

verses.text_english: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And ancient things.
verses.text_amharic: ዮቂም፥ የኮዜባ ሰዎች፥ ኢዮአስ፥ ሞዓብን የገዛ ሣራፍ፥ ያሹቢሌሔም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ዝና ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ ነበረ። እነዚህ በነጣዒምና በጋዴራ የሚቀመጡ ሸክላ ሠራተኞች ነበሩ። በዚያ በንጉሡ ዘንድ ስለ ሥራው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The sons of Simeon , Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul:
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖንም ልጆች፤ ነሙኤል፥ ያሚን፥ ያሪን፥ ዛራ፥ ሳኡል፤

verses.text_english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ሰሎም፥ ልጁ መብሳም፥ ልጁ ማስማዕ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.text_amharic: የማስማዕም ልጆች፤ ልጁ ሃሙኤል፥ ልጁ ዘኩር፥ ልጁ ሰሜኢ።

verses.text_english: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰሜኢም አሥራ ስድስት ወንዶችና ስድስት ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ለወንድሞቹ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አልነበሩአቸውም፥ ወገናቸውም ሁሉ እንደ ይሁዳ ልጆች አልተባዙም።

verses.text_english: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
verses.text_amharic: በቤርሳቤህም፥ በሞላዳ፥

verses.text_english: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.text_amharic: በሐጸርሹዓል፥ በቢልሃ፥ በዔጼም፥

verses.text_english: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.text_amharic: በቶላድ፥ በቤቱኤል፥ በሔርማ፥ በጺቅላግ፥

verses.text_english: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.text_amharic: በቤትማርካቦት፥ በሐጸርሱሲም፥ በቤትቢሪ፥ በሸዓራይም ይቀመጡ ነበር። እስከ ዳዊትም መንግሥት ድረስ ከተሞቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And their villages , Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.text_amharic: መንደሮቻቸውም ኤጣም፥ ዓይን፥ ሬሞን፥ ቶኬን፥ ዓሻን፥ አምስቱ ከተሞች፤

verses.text_english: And all their villages that round about the same cities, unto Baal. These their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ በኣልም ድረስ በእነዚህ ከተሞች ዙሪያ የነበሩ መንደሮቻቸው ሁሉ ነበሩ። መቀመጫቸውና የትውልዳቸው መዝገቦች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.text_amharic: ምሾባብ፥ የምሌክ፥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ ኢዮስያ፥

verses.text_english: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮኤል፥ የዮሺብያ ልጅ፥ የሠራያ ልጅ የዓሢኤል ልጅ ኢዩ፥

verses.text_english: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ያዕቆባ፥ የሾሐያ፥ ዓሣያ፥ ዓዲዔል፥ ዩሲምኤል፥ በናያስ፥

verses.text_english: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.text_amharic: የሺፊ ልጅ ዚዛ፥ የአሎን ልጅ የይዳያ ልጅ የሺምሪ ልጅ የሸማያ ልጅ፤

verses.text_english: These mentioned by names princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በስማቸው የተጠሩ በወገኖቻቸው ላይ አለቆች ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች በዝተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.text_amharic: ለመንጎቻቸው መሰምርያ ይሹ ዘንድ ወደ ጌዶር መግቢያ እስከ ሸለቆው ምሥራቅ ድረስ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.text_amharic: የለመለመችም እጅግም ያማረች መሰምርያ አገኙ፤ ምድሪቱም ሰፊና ጸጥተኛ ሰላም ያላትም ነበረች፤ በቀድሞም ጊዜ በዚያ ተቀምጠው የነበሩ ከካም ወገን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because pasture there for their flocks.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም በስማቸው የተጻፉ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን መጥተው ድንኳኖቻቸውንና በዚያ የተገኙትን ምዑናውያንን መቱ፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ፈጽመው አጠፉአቸው፤ በዚያም ለመንጎቻቸው መሰምርያ ነበረና በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And of them, of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖንም ልጆች አምስት መቶ ሰዎች ወደ ሴይር ተራራ ሄዱ፤ አለቆቻቸውም የይሽዒ ልጆች፥ ፈላጥያ፥ ነዓርያ፥ ረፋያ፥ ዑዝኤል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ያመለጡትንም የአማሌቃውያንን ቅሬታ መቱ፥ በዚያም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.text_english: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም በኵር የሮቤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው። እርሱ የበኵር ልጅ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን የአባቱን ምንጣፍ ስላረከሰ ብኵርናው ለእስራኤል ልጅ ለዮሴፍ ልጆች ተሰጠ፤ ትውልዱ ግን ከብኵርና ጋር አልተቈጠረም።

verses.text_english: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him the chief ruler; but the birthright Joseph's:)
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም በወንድሞቹ መካከል በረታ፥ አለቃም ከእርሱ ሆነ፤ ብኵርናው ግን ለዮሴፍ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The sons, , of Reuben the firstborn of Israel , Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል በኵር የሮቤል ልጆች፤ ሄኖኅ፥ ፈሉሶ፥ አስሮን፥ ከርሚ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮኤል ልጆች፤ ልጁ ሸማያ፥

verses.text_english: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ጎግ፥ ልጁ ሰሜኢ፥ ልጁ ሚካ፥

verses.text_english: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away : he prince of the Reubenites.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ራያ፥ ልጁ ቢኤል፥ የአሦር ንጉሥ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር የማረከው ልጁ ብኤራ፤ እርሱ የሮቤል ነገድ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹ በየወገናቸው የትውልዶቻቸው መዝገብ በተቈጠረ ጊዜ፤ አንደኛው ኢዮኤል፥

verses.text_english: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
verses.text_amharic: ዘካርያስ፥ እስከ ናባውና እስከ በኣልሜዎን ድረስ በአሮዔር የተቀመጠው የኢዮኤል ልጅ የሽማዕ ልጅ የዖዛዝ ልጅ ቤላ፤

verses.text_english: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: በገለዓድ ምድር እንስሶቻቸው በዝተው ነበርና በምሥራቅ በኩል ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ምድረ በዳው መግቢያ ድረስ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: በሳኦልም ዘመን ከአጋራውያን ጋር ተዋጉ፥ እነርሱም በእጃቸው ተመትተው ወደቁ፤ በገለዓድ ምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው አገር ሁሉ በድንኳኖቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
verses.text_amharic: የጋድም ልጆች በባሳን ምድር እስከ ሰልካ ድረስ በአፋዛዣቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.text_amharic: አንደኛው ኢዮኤል፥ ሁለተኛው ሳፋም፥ ያናይ፥ ሳፋጥ በበሳን ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And their brethren of the house of their fathers , Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ወንድሞች ሚካኤል፥ ሜሱላም፥ ሳባ፥ ዮራይ፥ ያካን፥ ዙኤ፥ ኦቤድ ሰባት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም የቡዝ ልጅ የዬዳይ ልጅ የኢዬሳይ ልጅ የሚካኤል ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጅ የኢዳይ ልጅ የዑሪ ልጅ የአቢካኢል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቃ የጉኒ ልጅ የአብዲኤል ልጅ ወንድም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
verses.text_amharic: በገለዓድም ምድር በባሳን በመንደሮቹም በሳሮንም መሰምርያዎች ሁሉ እስከ ዳርቻቸው ድረስ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ በትውልዶቻቸው በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮአታም ዘመንና በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
verses.text_amharic: የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ፥ ጽኑዓን፥ ጋሻና ሰይፍ የሚይዙ፥ ቀስተኞችም፥ ሰልፍ የሚያውቁ ሰልፈኞችም፥ አርባ አራት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.text_amharic: ከአጋራውያንና ከኢጡር ከናፌስና ከናዳብ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.text_english: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.text_amharic: በሚዋጉበትም ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸዋልና፥ በእርሱም ታምነዋልና ተለመናቸው፤ በላያቸውም ረዳት ሆናቸው፥ አጋራውያንና ከእነርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም ሁሉ በእጃቸው ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ከከብቶቻቸውም አምሳ ሺህ ግመሎች፥ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሺህም በጎች፥ ሁለት ሺህም አህዮች፥ ከሰዎችም መቶ ሺህ ማረኩ።

verses.text_english: For there fell down many slain, because the war of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.text_amharic: ሰልፉ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረና ብዙ ሰዎች ተገድለው ወደቁ፤ እስከ ምርኮም ዘመን ድረስ በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.text_amharic: የምናሴ የነገድ እኵሌታ ልጆች በምድሪቱ ተቀመጡ። ከባሳንም ጀምሮ እስከ በኣልአርሞንዔምና እስከ ሳኔር እስከ አርሞንዔም ተራራ ድረስ በዙ።

verses.text_english: And these the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, heads of the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ዔፌር፥ ይሽዒ፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ዓዝርኤል፥ ኤርምያ፥ ሆዳይዋ፥ ኢየድኤል፤ እነርሱ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን የታወቁ ሰዎች የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ በደሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው ባጠፋቸው በምድሩ አሕዛብ አማልክት አመነዘሩ።

verses.text_english: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የአሦርን ንጉሥ የፎሐን መንፈስ፥ የአሦርንም ንጉሥ የቴልጌልቴልፌልሶርን መንፈስ አስነሣ፤ የሮቤልንና የጋድን ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኵሌታ አፈለሰ፥ እስከ ዛሬም ወዳሉበት ወደ አላሔና ወደ ኦቦር፥ ወደ ሃራና ወደ ጎዛን ወንዝ አመጣቸው።

verses.text_english: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓትም ልጆች፤ እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል።

verses.text_english: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: የእንበረምም ልጆች፤ አሮን፥ ሙሴ፥ ማርያም። የአሮን ልጆች፤ ናዳብ፥ አብዮድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር።

verses.text_english: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.text_amharic: አልዓዛር ፊንሐስን ወለደ፤ ፊንሐስ አቢሱን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.text_amharic: አቢሱም ቡቂን ወለደ፤ ቡቂም ኦዚን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.text_amharic: ኦዚም ዘራእያን ወለደ፤ ዘራእያም መራዮትን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.text_amharic: መራዮት አማርያን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.text_amharic: አማርያም አኪጦብን ወለደ፤ አኪጦብም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም አኪማአስን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.text_amharic: አኪማአስም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.text_amharic: ዓዛርያስም ዮሐናንን ወለደ፤ ዮሐናንም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤ እርሱም ሰሎሞን በኢየሩሳሌም በሠራው ቤት ካህን ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.text_amharic: ዓዛርያስም አማርያን ወለደ፤ አማርያም አኪጦብን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.text_amharic: አኪጦብም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም ሰሎምን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎምም ኬልቅያስን ወለደ፤ ኬልቅያስም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.text_amharic: ዓዛርያስም ሠራያን ወለደ፤ ሠራያም ኢዮሴዴቅን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Jehozadak went , when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን በናቡከደነፆር እጅ ባስማረከ ጊዜ ኢዮሴዴቅ ተማርኮ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.text_english: And these the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.text_amharic: የጌድሶንም ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፤ ሎቤኒ ሰሜኢ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Kohath , Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓትም ልጆች፤ እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ሞሖሊም፥ ሙሲ። የሌዋውያን ወገኖች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.text_amharic: ከጌድሶን፤ ልጁ ሎቤኒ፥ ልጁ ኢኤት፥ ልጁ ዛማት፥

verses.text_english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ዮአክ፥ ልጁ አዶ፥ ልጁ ዛራ፥ ልጁ ያትራይ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.text_amharic: የቀዓት ልጆች፤ ልጁ አሚናዳብ፥

verses.text_english: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ቆሬ፥ ልጁ አሴር፥ ልጁ ሕልቃና፥

verses.text_english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ አቢሳፍ፥ ልጁ አሴር፥ ልጁ ኢኢት፥ ልጁ ኡሩኤል፥ ልጁ ዖዝያ፥ ልጁ ሳውል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.text_amharic: የሕልቃናም ልጆች፤ አማሢ፥ አኪሞት።

verses.text_english: Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.text_amharic: የሕልቃናም ልጆች፤ ልጁ ሱፊ፥

verses.text_english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ናሐት፥ ልጁ ኤልያብ፥ ልጁ ይሮሐም፥ ልጁ ሕልቃና።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.text_amharic: የሳሙኤልም ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ኢዮኤል፥ ሁለተኛውም አብያ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ሞሖሊ፥ ልጁ ሎቤኒ፥ ልጁ ሰሜኢ፥

verses.text_english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ዖዛ፥ ልጁ ሳምዓ፥ ልጁ ሐግያ፥ ልጁ ዓሣያ።

verses.text_english: And these whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ታቦቱ ዐርፎ ከተቀመጠ በኋላ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያቆማቸው የመዘምራን አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት በኢየሩሳሌም እስኪሠራ ድረስ በመገናኛ ድንኳን ማደሪያ ፊት እያዜሙ ያገለግሉ ነበር፤ በየተራቸውም ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And these they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.text_amharic: አገልጋዮቹና ልጆቹ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከቀዓት ልጆች ዘማሪው ኤማን ነበረ፤ እርሱም የኢዮኤል ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.text_amharic: የሳሙኤል ልጅ፥ የሕልቃና ልጅ፥ የይሮሐም ልጅ፥ የኤሊኤል ልጅ፥ የቶዋ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.text_amharic: የሱፍ ልጅ፥ የሕልቃና ልጅ፥ የመሐት ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.text_amharic: የአማሢ ልጅ፥ የሕልቃና ልጅ፥ የኢዮኤል ልጅ፥ የዓዛርያስ ልጅ፥ የሶፎንያስ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.text_amharic: የታሐት ልጅ፥ የአሴር ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የአብያሳፍ ልጅ፥ የቆሬ ልጅ፥ የይስዓር ልጅ፥ የቀዓት ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥ የእስራኤል ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.text_amharic: በቀኙም የቆመ ወንድሙ አሳፍ ነበረ፤ አሳፍም የበራክያ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.text_amharic: የሳምዓ ልጅ፥ የሚካኤል ልጅ፥ የበዓሤያ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.text_amharic: የመልክያ ልጅ፥ የኤትኒ ልጅ፥ የዛራ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.text_amharic: የዓዳያ ልጅ፥ የኤታን ልጅ፥ የዛማት ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሜኢ ልጅ፥ የኢኤት ልጅ፥ የጌድሶን ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And their brethren the sons of Merari on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.text_amharic: በግራቸውም በኩል ወንድሞቻቸው የሜራሪ ልጆች ነበሩ፤ ኤታን የቂሳ ልጅ፥ የአብዲ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.text_amharic: የማሎክ ልጅ፥ የሐሸብያ ልጅ፥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.text_amharic: የኬልቅያስ ልጅ፥ የአማሲ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: የባኒ ልጅ፥ የሴሜር ልጅ፥ የሞሖሊ ልጅ፥ የሙሲ ልጅ፥ የሜራሪ ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ።

verses.text_english: Their brethren also the Levites appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻቸውም ሌዋውያን ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ሁሉ ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.text_amharic: አሮንና ልጆቹ ግን የእግዚአሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ሥራ ሁሉ ስለ እስራኤልም ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ ይሠዉ ነበር፥ በዕጣኑም መሠዊያ ላይ ያጥኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And these the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ልጁ አልዓዛር፥

verses.text_english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ፊንሐስ፥ ልጁ አቢሱ፥ ልጁ ቡቂ፥

verses.text_english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ኦዚ፥ ልጁ ዘራእያ፥ ልጁ መራዮት፥

verses.text_english: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ አማርያ፥ ልጁ አኪጦብ፥ ልጁ ሳዶቅ፥ ልጁ አኪማአስ።

verses.text_english: Now these their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያዎቻቸውም በየሰፈራቸው በየዳርቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለአሮን ልጆች ለቀዓት ወገኖች አንደኛው ዕጣ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱ በይሁዳ አገር ያለችውን ኬብሮንን፥ በእርስዋም ዙሪያ የነበረውን መሰምርያ ሰጡ፤

verses.text_english: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱን እርሻ ግን መንደሮችዋንም ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, , Hebron, of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ለአሮንም ልጆች የመማፀኛውን ከተሞች፥ ኬብሮንን፥ ልብናንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ደግሞ የቲርን፥

verses.text_english: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሽትሞዓንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ሖሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዳቤርንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.text_english: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ዓሳንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቤትሳሚስንና መሰምርያዋን፤

verses.text_english: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families thirteen cities.
verses.text_amharic: ከብንያምም ነገድ ጌባንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጋሌማትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዓናቶትንና መሰምርያዋን ሰጡ። ከተሞቻተው ሁሉ በየወገናቸው አሥራ ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And unto the sons of Kohath, left of the family of that tribe, out of the half tribe, the half of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.text_amharic: ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ከነገዱ ወገን ከምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ አሥር ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.text_amharic: ለጌድሶንም ልጆች በየወገናቸው ከይሳኮር ነገድ፥ ከአሴርም ነገድ፥ ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ፥ በባሳንም ካለው ከምናሴ ነገድ፥ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: Unto the sons of Merari by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.text_amharic: ለሜራሪ ልጆች በየወገናቸው ከሮቤል ነገድ፥ ከጋድም ነገድ፥ ከዛብሎንም ነገድ፥ አሥራ ሁለት ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites cities with their suburbs.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለሌዋውያን ከተሞችን ከመሰምርያዎቻቸው ጋር ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by names.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ፥ ከስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ፥ ከብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ፥ እነዚህን በስማቸው የተጠሩትን ከተሞች በዕጣ ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀዓትም ልጆች ወገኖች ለአንዳንዶቹ ከኤፍሬም ነገድ ከተሞች ድርሻ ነበራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they gave unto them, the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ያሉትን የመማፀኛውን ከተሞች ሴኬምንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ደግሞም ጌዝርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዮቅምዓምንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.text_english: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ቤትሖሮንንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.text_english: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ኤሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጋትሪሞንንና መሰምርያዋን ሰጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.text_amharic: ከምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ ዓኔርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቢልዓምንና መሰምርያዋን ከቀዓት ልጆች ወገን ለቀሩት ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: Unto the sons of Gershom out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ለጌድሶን ልጆች ከምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ ወገን በባሳን ያለችው ጎላንና መሰምርያዋ፥ አስታሮትና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.text_english: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ከይሳኮርም ነገድ ቃዴስና መሰምርያዋ፥ ዳብራትና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.text_english: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ራሞትና መሰምርያዋ፥ ዓኔምና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.text_english: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ከአሴርም ነገድ መዓሳልና መሰምርያዋ፥ ዓብዶንና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.text_english: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ሑቆቅና መሰምርያዋ፥ ረአብና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.text_english: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ በገሊላ ያለችው ቃዴስና መሰምርያዋ፥ ሐሞንና መሰምርያዋ፥ ቂርያታይምና መሰምርያዋ ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: Unto the rest of the children of Merari out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያን ለቀሩት ለሜራሪ ልጆች ከዛብሎን ነገድ ሬሞንና መሰምርያዋ፥ ታቦርና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.text_english: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ከሮቤልም ነገድ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምሥራቅ በኩል በምድረ በዳ ያለችው ቦሶርና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.text_english: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.text_amharic: ያሳና መሰምርያዋ፥ ቅዴሞትና መሰምርያዋ፥ ሜፍዓትና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.text_english: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.text_amharic: ከጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ያለችው ሬማትና መሰምርያዋ፥ መሃናይምና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.text_english: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሴቦንና መሰምርያዋ፥ ኢያዜርና መሰምርያዋ ተሰጡ።

verses.text_english: Now the sons of Issachar , Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.text_amharic: የይሳኮርም ልጆች፥ ቶላ፥ ፉዋ፥ ያሱብ ሺምሮን፥ አራት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, , of Tola: valiant men of might in their generations; whose number in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: የቶላም ልጆች፥ ኦዚ፥ ራፋያ፥ ይሪኤል፥ የሕማይ፥ ይብሣም፥ ሽሙኤል፥ የአባታቸው የቶላ ቤት አለቆች፥ በትውልዳቸው ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ በዳዊት ዘመን ቍጥራቸው ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.text_amharic: የኦዚም ልጆች ይዝረሕያ፤ የይዝረሕያም ልጆች ሚካኤል፥ አብድዩ፥ ኢዮኤል፥ ይሺያ አምስት ናቸው፤ ሁሉም አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand : for they had many wives and sons.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር በየትውልዳቸው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ለሰልፍ የተዘጋጁ የሠራዊት ጭፍሮች ነበሩ፤ ብዙም ሴቶችና ልጆች ነበሩአቸውና ሠላሳ ስድስት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻቸውም በይሳኮር ወገኖች ሁሉ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች በትውልዳቸው ሁሉ የተቈጠሩ ሰማኒያ ሰባት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.text_amharic: የብንያም ልጆች ቤላ፥ ቤኬር፥ ይዲኤል ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.text_amharic: የቤላም ልጆች፥ ኤሴቦን፥ ኦዚ፥ ዑዝኤል፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ ዒሪ፥ አምስት ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ በትውልድ የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሠላሳ አራት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these the sons of Becher.
verses.text_amharic: የቤኬርም ልጆች፤ ዝሚራ፥ ኢዮአስ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ዖምሪ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ አብያ፥ ዓናቶት፥ ዓሌሜት፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የቤኬር ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: በየትውልዳቸው መዝገብ የተቈጠሩ፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ሀያ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.text_amharic: የይዲኤልም ልጅ ቢልሐን ነበረ፤ የቢልሐንም ልጆች የዑስ፥ ብንያም፥ ኤሁድ፥ ክንዓና፥ ዜታን፥ ተርሴስ፥ አኪሳአር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, seventeen thousand and two hundred , fit to go out for war battle.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ የይዲኤል ልጆች ነበሩ፤ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጭፍራ እየሆኑ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች አሥራ ሰባት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሳፊን፥ ሑፊም የዒር ልጆች፥ ሑሺም የአሔር ልጆችም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.text_amharic: የንፍታሌም ልጆች፥ ያሕጽኤል፥ ጉኒ፥ ዬጽር፥ ሺሌም፥ የባላ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: ( his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.text_amharic: የምናሴ ልጆች ሶርያይቱ ቁባቱ የወለደችለት እሥርኤልና የገለዓድ አባት ማኪር ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Machir took to wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name Maachah;) and the name of the second Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ማኪርም ከሑፊምና ከሳፊን ወገን ሚስት አገባ፤ የእኅትዋም ስም መዓካ ነበረ፤ የሁለተኛውም ስም ሰለጰአድ ነበረ፤ ለሰለጰዓድም ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother Sheresh; and his sons Ulam and Rakem.
verses.text_amharic: የማኪርም ሚስት መዓካ ልጅ ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ፋሬስ ብላ ጠራችው፤ የወንድሙም ስም ሱሮስ ነበረ፤ ልጆቹም ኡላም፥ ራቄም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: የኡላምም ልጅ ባዳን ነበረ፤ እነዚህ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.text_amharic: እኅቱ መለኬት ኢሱድን፥ አቢዔዝርን፥ መሕላን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.text_amharic: የሸሚዳም ልጆች አሒያን፥ ሴኬም፥ ሊቅሒ፥ አኒዓም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬም ልጆች፤ ሹቱላ፥ ልጁ ባሬድ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ኤልዓዳ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ዛባድ፥ ልጁ ሽቱላ፥

verses.text_english: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath born in land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩም ተወላጆች የጌት ሰዎች ከብቶቻቸውን ሊወስዱ ወርደው ነበርና የገደሉአቸው ልጆቹ ኤድርና ኤልዓድ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.text_amharic: አባታቸውም ኤፍሬም ብዙ ቀን አለቀሰ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሊያጽናኑት መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሚስቱም ገባ፥ አረገዘችም፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፤ በቤቱም መከራ ሆኖአልና ስሙ በሪዓ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: (And his daughter Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ልጁም ታችኛውንና ላይኛውን ቤትሖሮንንና ኡዜንሼራን የሠራች ሲአራ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Rephah his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶች ልጆቹም ፋፌ፥ ሬሴፍ፥ ልጁ ቴላ፥

verses.text_english: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ታሐን፥ ልጁ ለአዳን፥ ልጁ ዓሚሁድ፥ ልጁ ኤሊሳማ፥

verses.text_english: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁ ነዌ፥ ልጁ ኢያሱ።

verses.text_english: And their possessions and habitations , Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
verses.text_amharic: ግዛታቸውና ማደሪያቸው ቤቴልና መንደሮችዋ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ነዓራን፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ጌዝርና መንደሮችዋ፥ ደግሞ ሴኬምና መንደሮችዋ እስከ ጋዛና እስከ መንደሮችዋ ድረስ፥

verses.text_english: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በምናሴም ልጆች ዳርቻ ቤትሳንና መንደሮችዋ፥ ታዕናክና መንደሮችዋ፥ መጊዶና መንደሮችዋ፥ ዶርና መንደሮችዋ ነበሩ፤ በእነዚህ የእስራኤል ልጅ የዮሴፍ ልጆች ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.text_amharic: የአሴር ልጆች ዪምና፥ የሱዋ፥ የሱዊ፥ በሪዓ፥ እኅታቸውም ሤራሕ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who the father of Birzavith.
verses.text_amharic: የበሪዓም ልጆች፤ ሔቤር፥ የቢርዛዊት አባት የነበረው መልኪኤል።

verses.text_english: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.text_amharic: ሔቤርም ያፍሌጥን፥ ሳሜንር፥ ኮታምን፥ እኅታቸውንም ሶላን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These the children of Japhlet.
verses.text_amharic: የያፍሌጥም ልጆች ፋሴክ፥ ቢምሃል፥ ዓሲት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ የያፍሌጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.text_amharic: የሳሜርም ልጆች አኪ፥ ሮኦጋ፥ ይሑባ፥ አራም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.text_amharic: የወንድሙም የኤላም ልጆች ጾፋ፥ ይምና፥ ሰሌስ፥ ዓማል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.text_amharic: የጾፋም ልጆች ሱዋ፥ ሐርኔፍር፥

verses.text_english: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.text_amharic: ሦጋል፥ ቤሪ፥ ይምራ፥ ቤጼር፥ ሆድ፥ ሳማ፥ ሰሊሳ፥ ይትራን፥ ብኤራ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.text_amharic: የዬቴር ልጆች ዮሮኒ፥ ፊስጳ፥ አራ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.text_amharic: የዑላ ልጆች ኤራ፥ ሐኒኤል፥ ሪጽያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All these the children of Asher, heads of father's house, choice mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war to battle twenty and six thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ የአሴር ልጆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ የተመረጡ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች፥ የመኳንንቱ አለቆች ነበሩ። በትውልዳቸውም በሰልፍ ለመዋጋት የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ስድስት ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.text_amharic: ብንያምም በኵሩን ቤላን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አስቤልን፥

verses.text_english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛውንም አሐራን፥ አራተኛውንም ኖሐን፥ አምስተኛውንም ራፋን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.text_amharic: ለቤላም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አዳር፥

verses.text_english: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.text_amharic: ጌራ፥ አቢሁድ፥ አቢሱ፥ ናዕማን፥ አሖዋ፥ ጌራ፥ ሰፉፋም፥ ሑራም።

verses.text_english: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
And these the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም የኤሁድ ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ በጌባ የሚቀመጡ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መናሐትም ተማረኩ፤ ናዕማን፥ አኪያ፥ ጌራ፥ እነርሱም ተማረኩ። ዖዛንና አሒሑድን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Shaharaim begat in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara his wives.
verses.text_amharic: ሸሐራይምም ሚስቶቹን ሑሺምንና በዕራን ከሰደደ በኋላ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.text_amharic: ከሚስቱ ከሖዴሽ ዮባብን፥

verses.text_english: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ዲብያን፥ ማሴን፥ ማልካምን፥ ይዑጽን፥ ሻክያን፥ ሚርማን ወለደ። እነዚህም ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.text_amharic: ከሑሺምም አቢጡብንና ኤልፍዓልን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.text_amharic: የኤልፍዓልም ልጆች፤ ዔቤር፥ ሚሻም፥ ኦኖንና ሎድን መንደሮቻቸውንም የሠራ ሻሚድ፤

verses.text_english: Beriah also, and Shema, who heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.text_amharic: በሪዓ፥ ሽማዕ የጌትን ሰዎች ያሳደዱ የኤሎን ሰዎች የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.text_amharic: አሒዮ፥ ሻሻቅ፥ ይሬምት፥

verses.text_english: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.text_amharic: ዝባድያ፥ ሜሱላም፥

verses.text_english: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቂ፥ ሔቤር፥ ይሽምራይ፥ ይዝሊያ፥ ዮባብ፥ የኤልፍዓል ልጆች፤

verses.text_english: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.text_amharic: ያቂም፥ ዝክሪ፥ ዘብዲ፥

verses.text_english: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.text_amharic: ይሽጳን፥

verses.text_english: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.text_amharic: ዔቤር፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ዓብዶን፥ ዝክሪ፥

verses.text_english: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.text_amharic: ሸምሽራይ፥

verses.text_english: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.text_amharic: ሸሃሪያ፥ ጎቶልያ፥ ያሬሽያ፥ ኤልያስ፥ ዝክሪ፥ የይሮሐም ልጆች።

verses.text_english: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በትውልዶቻቸው አለቆች ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.text_amharic: የሚስቱ ስም መዓካ የነበረው የገባዖን አባት ይዒኤል፥

verses.text_english: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.text_amharic: የበኵር ልጁ ዓብዶን፥

verses.text_english: These heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief . These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ናዳብ፥ ጌዶር፥ አሒዮ፥ ዛኩር በገባዖን ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name Maachah:
verses.text_amharic: ሚቅሎት ሳምአን ወለደ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.text_amharic: ኔር ቂስን ወለደ፤ ቂስም ሳኦልን ወለደ፤ ሳኦልም ዮናታንን፥ ሚልኪሳን፥ አሚናዳብን፥ አስባኣልን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.text_amharic: የዮናታንም ልጅ መሪበኣል ነበረ፤ መሪበኣልም ሚካን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.text_amharic: የሚካም ልጆች ፒቶን፥ ሜሌክ፥ ታሬዓ፥ አካዝ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም ይሆዓዳን ወለደ፤ ይሆዓዳም ዓሌሜትን፥ ዓዝሞትን፥ ዘምሪን ወለደ፤ ዘምሪም ሞጻን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the son of Jonathan Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.text_amharic: ሞጻም ቢንዓን ወለደ፤ ልጁም ረፋያ ነበረ፥ ልጁ ኤልዓሣ፥ ልጁ ኤሴል፤

verses.text_english: And the sons of Micah , Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.text_amharic: ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሽዓርያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.text_amharic: የወንድሙም የአሴል ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ኡላም፥ ሁለተኛውም ኢያስ፥ ሦስተኛውም ኤሊፋላት።

verses.text_english: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.text_amharic: የኡላም ልጆች ጽኑዓን ኃያላንና ቀስተኞች ነበሩ፤ ለእነርሱም መቶ አምሳ የሚያህሉ ብዙ ልጆችና የልጅ ልጆች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የብንያም ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በየትውልዳቸው ተቈጠሩ፤ እነሆም፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል። ይሁዳም ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ወደ ባቢሎን ተማረኩ።

verses.text_english: Now the first inhabitants that in their possessions in their cities , the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.text_amharic: በአውራጃዎቻቸውና በከተሞቻቸው መጀመሪያ የተቀመጡ እስራኤልና ካህናት ሌዋውያንም ናታኒምም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ልጆችና ከብንያም ልጆች ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴ ልጆች በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ልጅ ከፋሬስ ልጆች የባኒ ልጅ የአምሪ ልጅ የፆምሪ ልጅ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ዑታይ ደግሞ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴሎናዊያንም በኵሩ ዓሣያና ልጆቹ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛራም ልጆች ይዑኤልና ወንድሞቻቸው፥ ስድስት መቶ ዘጠና።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.text_amharic: ከብንያምም ልጆች የሐስኑአ ልጅ የሆዳይዋ ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ ሰሉ፤

verses.text_english: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.text_amharic: የይሮሐም ልጅ ብኔያ፤ የሚክሪ ልጅ የኦዚ ልጅ ኤላ፤ የዪብኒያ ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጅ የሰፋጥያስ ልጅ ሜሱላም፤

verses.text_english: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: በየትውልዳቸውም ወንድሞቻቸው ዘጠኝ መቶ ሃምሳ ስድስት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናቱም ዮዳሄ፥ ዮአሪብ፥ ያኪን፤

verses.text_english: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አለቃ የአኪጦብ ልጅ የመራዮት ልጅ የሳዶቅ ልጅ ሜሱላም ልጅ የኬልቂያስ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ፤

verses.text_english: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.text_amharic: የመልኪያ ልጅ የጳስኮር ልጅ የይሮሐም ልጅ ዓዳያ፤ የኢሜር ልጅ የምሺላሚት ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ የየሕዜራ ልጅ የዓዲኤል ልጅ መዕሣይ፤

verses.text_english: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች ወንድሞቻቸው ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ማገልገል ሥራ እጅግ ብልሃተኞች ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያንም የሜራሪ ልጆች የአሳብያ ልጅ የዓዝሪቃም ልጅ የአሱብ ልጅ ሸማያ፤

verses.text_english: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.text_amharic: በቅበቃር፥ ኤሬስ፥ ጋላል፥ የኣሳፍ ልጅ የዝክሪ ልጅ የሚካ ልጅ መታንያ፤

verses.text_english: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶታም ልጅ የጋላል ልጅ የሰሙስ ልጅ አብድያ፤ በነጦፋውያንም መንደሮች የተቀመጠው የሕልቃና ልጅ የአሳ ልጅ በራክያ።

verses.text_english: And the porters , Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum the chief;
verses.text_amharic: በረኞችም ሰሎም፥ ዓቁብ፥ ጤልሞን፥ አሒማን፥ ወንድሞቻቸውም ነበሩ፤ ሰሎምም አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Who hitherto in the king's gate eastward: they porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በንጉሥ በር በምሥራቅ በኩል ነበሩ፤ ለሌዊ ልጆች ሰፈር በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, over the host of the LORD, keepers of the entry.
verses.text_amharic: የቆሬም ልጅ የአብያሳፍ ልጅ የቆሬ ልጅ ሰሎም ከአባቱም ቤት የነበሩ ወንድሞቹ ቆሬያውያን በማገልገል ሥራ ላይ ነበሩ፥ የድንኳኑንም መድረክ ይጠብቁ ነበር። አባቶቻቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰፈር መግቢያ ጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, the LORD with him.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞም የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ አለቃቸው ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: የሜሱላም ልጅ ዘካርያስ የመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ በረኛ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: All these chosen to be porters in the gates two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.text_amharic: የመድረኩ በረኞች ይሆኑ ዘንድ የተመረጡ እነዚህ ሁሉ ሁለት መቶ አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ። ዳዊትና ነቢዩ ሳሙኤል በሥራቸው ያቆሙአቸው እነዚህ በመንደሮቻቸው በየትውልዳቸው ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: So they and their children the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, , the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱና ልጆቻቸውም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በድንኳኑ ደጆች ላይ ዘበኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.text_amharic: በአራቱ ማዕዘኖች፥ በምሥራቅ፥ በምዕራብ፥ በሰሜን፥ በደቡብ፥ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And their brethren, in their villages, to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻቸውም በመንደሮቻቸው ሆነው፥ በየሰባትም ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር ሊሆኑ ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ይገቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያንም የነበሩ አራቱ የበረኞች አለቆች ዘወትር በሥራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ባሉ ጓዳዎችና ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge upon them, and the opening thereof every morning to them.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት የሚጠብቁ፥ ጥዋት ጥዋትም ደጆቹን የሚከፍቱ እነርሱ ነበሩና በዚያ ያድሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.text_amharic: ዕቃውም በቍጥር ይገባና ይወጣ ነበርና ከእነዚህ አንዳንዱ በማገልገያው ዕቃ ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: of them also appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ በመቅደሱ ዕቃ ሁሉ በመልካሙም ዱቄት፥ በወይን ጠጁ፥ በዘይቱም፥ በዕጣኑም፥ በሽቱውም ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናቱም ልጆች አንዳንዶቹ የሽቱውን ቅባት ያጣፍጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Mattithiah, of the Levites, who the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.text_amharic: የቆሬያዊውም የሰሎም በኵር ሌዋዊው ማቲትያ በምጣድ በሚጋገረው ነገር ላይ ሹም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, over the shewbread, to prepare every sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: በየሰንበቱም ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ ከወንድሞቻቸው ከቀዓታውያን አንዳንዱ በገጹ ኅብስት ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And these the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, in the chambers free: for they were employed in work day and night.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያኑም ወገን የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች የነበሩ መዘምራን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሥራቸውም ሌሊትና ቀን ነበረና ያለሌላ ሥራ በየጓዳቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: These chief fathers of the Levites chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ከሌዋውያን የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች በየትውልዳቸው አለቆች ነበሩ። እነዚህም በኢየሩሳሌም ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name Maachah:
verses.text_amharic: የሚስቱ ስም መዓካ የነበረው የገባዖን አባት ይዒኤል፥

verses.text_english: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.text_amharic: የበኵር ልጁም ዓብዶን፥

verses.text_english: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.text_amharic: ዱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ኔር፥ ናዳብ፥ ጌዶር፥ አሒዮ፥ ዛኩር፥ ሚቅሎት፥ በገባኦን ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ሚቅሎትም ሳምአን ወለደ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.text_amharic: ኔርም ቂስን ወለደ፤ ቂስም ሳኦልን ወለደ፤ ሳኦልም ዮናታንን፥ ሚልኪሳን፥ አሚናዳብን፥ አስበኣልን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the son of Jonathan Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
verses.text_amharic: የዮናታንም ልጅ መሪበኣል ነበረ፤ መሪበኣልም ሚካን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Micah , Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, .
verses.text_amharic: የሚካም ልጆች ፒቶን፥ ሜሌክ፥ ታሬዓ፥ አካዝ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም የዕራን ወለደ፤ የዕራም ዓሌሜትን፥ ዓዝሞትን፥ ዘምሪን ወለደ፤ ዘምሪም ሞጻን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.text_amharic: ሞጻም ቢንዓን ወለደ፥ ልጁም ረፋያ ነበረ፥ ልጁ ኤልዓሣ፥ ልጁ ኤሴል፤

verses.text_english: And Azel had six sons, whose names these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these the sons of Azel.
verses.text_amharic: ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሸዓሪያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ፥ ተወግተውም በጊልቦአ ተራራ ላይ ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በእግር በእግራቸው ተከትለው አባረሩአቸው፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም የሳኦልን ልጆች ዮናታንንና አሚናዳብን ሜልኪሳንም ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.text_amharic: ሰልፍም በሳኦል ላይ ጠነከረ፥ ቀስተኞችም አገኙት፤ ከቀስተኞችም የተነሣ ተጨነቀ።

verses.text_english: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። እነዚህ ቈላፋን መጥተው እንዳይዘብቱብኝ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ውጋኝ አለው። ጋሻ ጃግሬው ግን እጅግ ፈርቶ ነበርና እንቢ አለ። ሳኦልም ሰይፉን ወስዶ በላዩ ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሳኦል እንደ ሞተ ባየ ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በሰይፉ ላይ ወድቆ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.text_amharic: ሳኦልና ሦስቱ ልጆቹ የቤቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And when all the men of Israel that in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.text_amharic: በሸለቆውም የነበሩት የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ ሸሹ፥ ሳኦልና ልጆቹም እንደ ሞቱ ባዩ ጊዜ ከተሞቻቸውን ለቅቀው ሸሹ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው ተቀመጡባቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም ፍልስጥኤማውያን የሞቱትን ለመግፈፍ በመጡ ጊዜ ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በጊልቦአ ተራራ ላይ ወድቀው አገኙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.text_amharic: ገፈፉትም፥ ራሱንና መሣሪያውንም አንሥተው ለጣኦቶቻቸውና ለሕዝቡ የምሥራች ይወስዱ ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን አገር ዙሪያ ሰደዱ።

verses.text_english: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.text_amharic: መሣሪያውንም በአምላኮቻቸው ቤት ውስጥ አኖሩ፤ ራሱንም በዳጎን ቤት ውስጥ ቸነከሩት።

verses.text_english: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.text_amharic: የኢያቢስ ገለዓድም ሰዎች ሁሉ ፍልስጥኤማውያን በሳኦል ላይ ያደረጉትን ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.text_amharic: ጽኑአን ሰዎች ሁሉ ተነሥተው የሳኦልን ሬሳ የልጆቹንም ሬሳ ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ኢያቢስም አመጡአቸው፤ በኢያቢስም ካለው ከትልቁ ዛፍ በታች አጥንቶቻቸውን ቀበሩ፥ ሰባት ቀንም ጾሙ።

verses.text_english: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking of a familiar spirit, to enquire ;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ሳኦል በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ስላደረገው ኃጢአት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ስላልጠበቀ ሞተ። ደግሞም መናፍስት ጠሪ

verses.text_english: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጠየቀ እግዚአብሔርንም ስላልጠየቀ፥ ስለዚህ ገደለው፥ መንግሥቱንም ወደ እሴይ ልጅ ወደ ዳዊት አሳለፈው።

verses.text_english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በኬብሮን ወደ ዳዊት ተሰብስበው። እነሆ፥ እኛ የአጥንትህ ፍላጭ የሥጋህ ቍራጭ ነን፤

verses.text_english: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞ ሳኦል ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሳለ እስራኤልን የምታወጣና የምታገባ አንተ ነበርህ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም። ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን አንተ ትጠብቃለህ፤ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆናለህ 5ብሎህ ነበር አሉት።

verses.text_english: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ዳዊትም በኬብሮን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር አደረገ፤ በሳሙኤልም እጅ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ ዳዊትን ቀቡት።
