verses.text_english: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which Jebus; where the Jebusites , the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እስራኤልም ሁሉ ኢያቡስ ወደምትባል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዱ፤ በአገሩም የተቀመጡ ኢያቡሳውያን በዚያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which the city of David.
verses.text_amharic: በኢያቡስም የተቀመጡ ዳዊትን። ወደዚህ አትገባም አሉት፤ ዳዊት ግን አምባይቱን ጽዮንን ያዘ፤ እርሷም የዳዊት ከተማ ናት።

verses.text_english: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ኢያቡሳውያንን አስቀድሞ የሚመታ ሰው አለቃና መኰንን ይሆናል አለ። የጽሩያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ አስቀድሞ ወጣ፥ አለቃም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በአምባይቱ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ፤ ስለዚህም የዳዊት ከተማ ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.text_english: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚሎም ጀምሮ በዙሪያው ከተማ ሠራ፤ ኢዮአብም የቀረውን ከተማ አበጀ።

verses.text_english: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበርና እየበረታ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: These also the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለዳዊትም የነበሩት የኃያላን አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ስለ እስራኤል እንደ ተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ያነግሡት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር በመንግሥቱ ላይ አጸኑት።

verses.text_english: And this the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain at one time.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ኃያላን ቍጥር ይህ ነበረ፤ የሠላሳው አለቃ የአክሞናዊው ልጅ ያሾብአም ነበረ፤ እርሱ ጦሩን አንሥቶ ሦስት መቶ ሰው በአንድ ጊዜ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And after him Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who of the three mighties.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ በሦስቱ ኃያላን መካከል የነበረ የአሆሃሂው የዱዲ ልጅ አልዓዛር ነበር።

verses.text_english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከዳዊት ጋር በፈስደሚም ነበረ፥ በዚያም ገብስ በሞላበት እርሻ ውስጥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ለሰልፍ ተሰብስበው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: And they set themselves in the midst of parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved by a great deliverance.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሻውም መካከል ቆመው ጠበቁት፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ገደሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ማዳን አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠላሳውም አለቆች ሦስቱ ወርደው ዳዊት ወዳለበት ወደ ዓለቱ ወደ ዓዶላም ዋሻ መጡ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በራፋይም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison then at Bethlehem.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ዳዊት በምሽጉ ውስጥ ነበረ፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በቤተ ልሔም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that at the gate!
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። በበሩ አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውሃ ማን ይሰጠኛል? ብሎ ተመኘ።

verses.text_english: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that by the gate, and took , and brought to David: but David would not drink it, but poured it out to the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሦስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሠራዊት ቀድደው ሄዱ፥ በበሩም አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውሃ ቀዱ፤ ይዘውም ለዳዊት አመጡለት። እርሱ ግን ሊጠጣ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አፍስሶ።

verses.text_english: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ አምላኬ ይከልክለኝ፤ በነፍሳቸው የደፈሩትም እነዚህ ሰዎች ደም እጠጣለሁን? በነፍሳቸው አምጥተውታል አለ። ስለዚህም ይጠጣ ዘንድ አልወደደም። ሦስቱም ኃያላን ያደረጉት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew , and had a name among the three.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮአብም ወንድም አቢሳ የሦስቱ አለቃ ነበረ፤ ጦሩንም በሦስት መቶ ላይ አንሥቶ ገደላቸው፥ በሦስቱም መካከል ስሙ የተጠራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the three.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ተራ በሆኑት በሦስቱ መካከል የከበረ ነበረ፥ አለቃቸውም ሆነ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ፊተኞቹ ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም።

verses.text_english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.text_amharic: በቀብስኤልም የነበረው፥ ታላቅ ሥራ ያደረገው የጽኑዕ ሰው የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ የሞዓባዊን የአሪኤል ሁለቱን ልጆች ገደለ፤ በአመዳይም ወራት ወርዶ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ አንበሳ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.text_amharic: ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ የነበረውን ረጅሙን ግብጻዊውን ሰው ገደለ፤ በግብጻዊውም እጅ የሸማኔ መጠቅለያ የመሰለ ጦር ነበረ፤ እርሱ ግን በትር ይዞ ወደ እርሱ ወረደ፥ ከግብጻዊውም እጅ ጦሩን ነቅሎ በገዛ ጦሩ ገደለው።

verses.text_english: These did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ያደረገው ይህ ነው፤ ስሙም በሦስቱ ኃያላን መካከል የተጠራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከሠላሳው ይልቅ የከበረ ነበረ፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ፊተኞቹ ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም። ዳዊትም በዘበኞቹ ላይ ሾመው።

verses.text_english: Also the valiant men of the armies , Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በጭፍሮች ዘንድ የነበሩት ኃያላን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የኢዮአብ ወንድም አሣሄል፥ የቤተ ልሔሙ ሰው የዱዲ ልጅ ኤልያናን፥

verses.text_english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.text_amharic: ሃሮራዊው ሳሞት፥ ፈሎናዊው ሴሌስ፥

verses.text_english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.text_amharic: የቴቁሔ ሰው የዒስካ ልጅ ዒራስ፥

verses.text_english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.text_amharic: ዓናቶታዊው አቢዔዜር፥ ኩሳታዊው ሴቤካይ፥

verses.text_english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.text_amharic: አሆሃዊው ዔላይ፥ ነጦፋዊው ኖኤሬ፥ የነጦፋዊው የበዓና ልጅ ሔሌድ፥

verses.text_english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.text_amharic: ከብንያም ወገን ከግብዓ የሪባይ ልጅ ኤታይ፥

verses.text_english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.text_amharic: ጲርዓቶናዊው በናያስ፥ የገዓስ ወንዝ ሰው ኡሪ፥

verses.text_english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.text_amharic: ዓረባዊው አቢኤል፥ ባሕሩማዊው ዓዝሞት፥

verses.text_english: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.text_amharic: ሰዓልቦናዊው ኤሊያሕባ፥ የጊዞናዊው የአሳን ልጆች፥ የሃራራዊው የሻጌ ልጅ ዮናታን፥

verses.text_english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.text_amharic: የአሮዳዊው የአራር ልጅ አምናን፥

verses.text_english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.text_amharic: የኡር ልጅ ኤሊፋል፥ ሚኬራታዊው ኦፌር፥

verses.text_english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.text_amharic: ፍሎናዊው አኪያ፥ ቀርሜሎሳዊው ሐጽሮ፥ የኤዝባይ ልጅ ነዕራይ፥

verses.text_english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.text_amharic: የናታንም ወንድም ኢዮኤል፥ የሐግሪ ልጅ ሚብሐር፥

verses.text_english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.text_amharic: አሞናዊው ጼሌቅ፥ የጽሩያ ልጅ የኢዮአብ ጋሻ ጃግሬ ቤሮታዊው ነሃራይ፥

verses.text_english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.text_amharic: ይትራዊው ዒራስ፥ ይትራዊው ጋሬብ፥

verses.text_english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.text_amharic: ኬጢያዊው ኦርዮ፥ የአሕላይ ልጅ ዛባድ፥

verses.text_english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.text_amharic: የሮቤላዊው የሺዛ ልጅ ዓዲና፥ እርሱ የሮቤላውያን አለቃ ነበረ፥

verses.text_english: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ሠላሳ ሰዎች ነበሩ፥ የማዕካ ልጅ ሐናን፥ ሚትናዊው ኢዮሣፍጥ፥

verses.text_english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.text_amharic: አስታሮታዊው ዖዝያ፥ የአሮኤራዊው የኮታም ልጆች ሻማና ይዒኤል፥

verses.text_english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.text_amharic: የሽምሪ ልጅ ይድኤል፥ ወንድሙም ይድኤል፥ ወንድሙም ቲዳዊው ዮሐ፥

verses.text_english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.text_amharic: መሐዋዊው ኤሊኤል፥ ይሪባይ፥ ዮሻዊያ፥ የኤልናዓም ልጆች፥ ሞዓባዊው ይትማ፥

verses.text_english: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልኤል፥ ዖቤድ፥ ምጾባዊው የዕሢኤል።

verses.text_english: Now these they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
verses.text_amharic: በጺቅላግም ከቂስ ልጅ ከሳኦል በተሸሸገ ጊዜ ወደ ዳዊት የመጡ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሰልፍም ባገዙት ኃያላን መካከል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in stones and arrows out of a bow, of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስተኞችም ነበሩ፥ በቀኝና በግራም እጃቸው ድንጋይ ሊወነጭፉ ፍላጻም ሊወረውሩ ይችሉ ነበር፤ ከብንያም ወገን የሳኦል ወንድሞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The chief Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
verses.text_amharic: አለቃቸው አሒዔዝር ነበረ፥ ከእርሱም በኋላ ኢዮአስ፥ የጊብዓዊው የሸማዓ ልጆች፤ ይዝኤል፥ ፋሌጥ፥ የዓዝሞት ልጆች፤ በራኪያ፥ ዓናቶታዊው ኢዩ፥

verses.text_english: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
verses.text_amharic: ገባዖናዊው ሰማያስ፥ እርሱ በሠላሳው መካከልና በሠላሳው ላይ ኃያል ሰው ነበረ፤ ኤርምያስ፥ የሕዚኤል፥ ዮሐናን፥

verses.text_english: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.text_amharic: ገድሮታዊው ዮዛባት፥ ኤሉዛይ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ በዓልያ፥ ሰማራያ፥ ሀሩፋዊው ሰፋጥያስ፥

verses.text_english: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.text_amharic: ቆርያውያን ሕልቃና፥ ይሺያ፥ አዛርኤል፥ ዮዛር፥ ያሾቢአም፤

verses.text_english: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.text_amharic: የጌዶር ሰው የይሮሃም ልጆች የኤላ፥ ዝባድያ

verses.text_english: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, men of war for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces the faces of lions, and as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከምድረ በዳ ውስጥ ባለችው በአንባይቱ ሳለ ከጋድ ወገን የሆኑ እነዚህ ጋሻና ጦር የሚይዙ፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን፥ ሰልፈኞች፥ ወደ እርሱ ተጠጉ፤ ፊታቸውም እንደ አንበሳ ፊት ነበረ፥ በተራራም ላይ እንደሚዘልል ሚዳቋ ፈጣኖች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.text_amharic: አለቃው ዔጼር፥ ሁለተኛው አብድዩ፥

verses.text_english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛው ኤልያብ፥ አራተኛው መስመና፥

verses.text_english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛው ኤርምያስ፥ ስድስተኛው አታይ፥

verses.text_english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛው ኤሊኤል፥ ስምንተኛው ዮሐናን፥

verses.text_english: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.text_amharic: ዘጠነኛው ኤልዛባድ፥ አሥረኛው ኤርምያስ፥ አሥራ አንደኛው መክበናይ።

verses.text_english: These of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የጋድ ልጆች የጭፍራ አለቆች ነበሩ፤ ከእነርሱም ታናሹ ከመቶ፥ ታላቁ ከሺህ ይመዛዘኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: These they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all of the valleys, toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ወር ዮርዳኖስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር ሞልቶ በነበረ ጊዜ የተሻገሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሸለቆውም ውስጥ በምሥራቅና በምዕራብ በኩል የተቀመጡትን ሁሉ አባረሩ።

verses.text_english: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደነበረባት ወደ አምባይቱ ከብንያምና ከይሁዳ ወገን ሰዎች መጡ።

verses.text_english: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if to betray me to mine enemies, seeing no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look , and rebuke .
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሊገናኛቸው ወጥቶ። ትረዱኝ ዘንድ በሠላም ወደ እኔ መጥታችሁ እንደ ሆነ ልቤ ከእናንተ ጋር አንድ ይሆናል፤ ለጠላቶቼ አሳልፋችሁ ልትሰጡኝ መጥታችሁ እንደሆነ ግን፥ በእጄ ዓመፅ የለብኝምና የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ይመልከተው፥ ይፍረደውም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, chief of the captains, , Thine , David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace unto thee, and peace to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስም በሠላሳው አለቃ በአማሳይ ላይ መጣ፥ እርሱም። ዳዊት ሆይ፥ እኛ የአንተ ነን፤ የእሴል ልጅ ሆይ፥ እኛ ከአንተ ጋር ነን፤ አምላክህ ይረዳሃልና ሰላም ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፥ ለሚረዱህም ሰላም ይሁን አለ። ዳዊትም ተቀበላቸው፥ የጭፍራም አለቆች አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And there fell of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to our heads.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሳኦልን ሊወጋ በመጣ ጊዜ ከምናሴ ወገን ሰዎች ወደ ዳዊት ከዱ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያን አለቆች ግን። በራሳችን ላይ ጕዳት አድርጎ ወደ ጌታው ወደ ሳኦል ይመለሳል ሲሉ ተማክረው ሰድደውታልና እነርሱ አልረዷቸውም።

verses.text_english: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that of Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጺቅላግም ሲሄድ ከምናሴ ወገን የምናሴ ሻለቆች የነበሩ ዓድና፥ ዮዛባት፥ ይዲኤል፥ ሚካኤል፥ ዮዛባት፥ ኤሊሁ፥ ጺልታይ ወደ እርሱ ከዱ።

verses.text_english: And they helped David against the band : for they all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ጽኑዓን ኃያላንና በሠራዊቱ ላይ አለቆች ነበሩና በአደጋ ጣዮቹ ላይ ዳዊትን አገዙት።

verses.text_english: For at time day by day there came to David to help him, until a great host, like the host of God.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ሠራዊት ታላቅ ሠራዊት እስኪሆን ድረስ ዳዊትን ለመርዳት ዕለት ዕለት ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And these the numbers of the bands ready armed to the war, came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል የሳኦልን መንግሥት ወደ እርሱ ይመልሱ ዘንድ በኬብሮን ሳለ ወደ ዳዊት የመጡት የሠራዊቱ አለቆች ቍጥር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሻና ጦር ተሸክመው ለሰልፍ የተዘጋጁ የይሁዳ ልጆች ስድስት ሺህ ስምንት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰልፍ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች የነበሩ የስምዖን ልጆች ሰባት ሺህ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊ ልጆች አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoiada the leader of the Aaronites, and with him three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ቤት አለቃ ዮዳሄ ነበረ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሦስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ጽኑዕ ኃያል ጕልማሳ ሳዶቅ ነበረ፥ ከአባቱም ቤት ሃያ ሁለት አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
verses.text_amharic: የሳኦልም ወንድሞች ከሆኑ ከብንያም ወንድሞች የሚበልጠው ክፍል እስከዚያ ዘመን ድረስ የሳኦልን ቤት ይከተል ነበርና ከእነርሱ ዘንድ የመጡ ሦስት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ጽኑዓን ኃያላን የሆኑ በአባቶቻቸውም ቤት የታወቁ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ሀያ ሺህ ስምንት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.text_amharic: በየስማቸውም የተጻፉ ዳዊትን ያነግሡት ዘንድ የመጡ የምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the children of Issachar, that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them two hundred; and all their brethren at their commandment.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም የሚገባውን ያደርግ ዘንድ ዘመኑን የሚያውቁ ጥበበኞች ሰዎች የይሳኮር ልጆች አለቆች ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም ሁሉ ይታዘዙአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: not of double heart.
verses.text_amharic: በጭፍራውም ውስጥ የወጡ ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ፥ የማያመነቱ፥ መሣሪያም ሁሉ የያዙ የዛብሎን ሰዎች አምሳ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.text_amharic: የንፍታሌምም አለቆች አንድ ሺህ ነበሩ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ጋሻና ጦር የሚይዙ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ የዳን ሰዎች ሃያ ስምንት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.text_amharic: በጭፍራውም ውስጥ የሚወጡ፥ ለሰልፍም የተዘጋጁ የአሴር ሰዎች አርባ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.text_amharic: በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ካሉ ከሮቤልና ከጋድ ሰዎች ከምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ መሣሪያን ሁሉ ይዘው የመጡ መቶ ሀያ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel of one heart to make David king.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ ዳዊትን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ያነግሡት ዘንድ አርበኞችና ሰልፈኞች እየሆኑ በፍጹም ልባቸው ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ደግሞም ከእስራኤል የቀሩት ሁሉ ዳዊትን ያነግሡት ዘንድ አንድ ልብ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻቸውም አዘጋጅተውላቸው ነበርና እየበሉና እየጠጡ በዚያ ከዳዊት ጋር ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Moreover they that were nigh them, unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for joy in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ደስታ ሆኖአልና እስከ ይሳኮርና እስከ ዛብሎን እስከ ንፍታሌምም ድረስ ለእርሱ አቅራቢያ የነበሩ በአህያና በግመል በበቅሎና በበሬ ላይ እንጀራና ዱቄት የበለስ ጥፍጥፍና የዘቢበ ዘለላ የወይንም ጠጅ ዘይትም በሬዎችንና በጎችንም በብዙ አድርገው ያመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, with every leader.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ከአለቆቹም ሁሉ ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If good unto you, and of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, left in all the land of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites in their cities suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ። መልካም መስሎ የታያችሁ እንደሆነ፥ ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔርም ወጥቶ እንደ ሆነ፥ በእስራኤል አገር ሁሉ ለቀሩት ወንድሞቻችን በከተሞቻቸውና በመሰምሪያዎቻቸውም ለሚቀመጡ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን ወደ እኛ ይሰበሰቡ ዘንድ እንላክ፤

verses.text_english: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.text_amharic: በሳኦልም ዘመን አልፈለግነውምና የአምላካችንን ታቦት ወደ እኛ እንመልስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩም በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ዓይን ዘንድ ቅን ነበረና ጉባኤው ሁሉ። እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን አሉ።

verses.text_english: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት ከቂርያትይዓሪም ያመጡ ዘንድ ዳዊት እስራኤልን ሁሉ ከግብጽ ወንዝ ከሺሖር ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ ድረስ ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, , to Kirjathjearim, which to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth the cherubims, whose name is called .
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እስራኤልም ሁሉ በኪሩቤል ላይ የተቀመጠውን ስሙም በእርሱ የተጠራውን የአምላክን የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ከዚያ ያወጡ ዘንድ በይሁዳ ወዳለችው ቂርያትይዓሪም ወደ ተባለች ወደ በኣላ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት በአዲስ ሰረገላ ላይ ጫኑት፥ ከአሚናዳብም ቤት አመጡት፤ ዖዛና አሒዮም ሠረገላውን ይነዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David and all Israel played before God with all might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና እስራኤል ሁሉ በቅኔና በበገና በመሰንቆና በከበሮ በጸናጽልና በመለከት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሙሉ ኃይላቸው ይጫወቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኪዶንም አውድማ በደረሱ ጊዜ በሬዎቹ ይፋንኑ ነበርና ታቦቱን ሊይዝ ዖዛ እጁን ዘረጋ።

verses.text_english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በዖዛ ላይ ነደደ፥ እጁንም ወደ ታቦቱ ስለ ዘረጋ ቀሠፈው፤ በዚያም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ዖዛን ስለ ቀሠፈው ዳዊት አዘነ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም የዖዛ ስብራት ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.text_english: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God to me?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ዳዊት። የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ወደ እኔ እንዴት አመጣለሁ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ፈራ።

verses.text_english: So David brought not the ark to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ታቦቱን ወደ ጌት ሰው ወደ አቢዳራ ቤት አሳለፈው እንጂ ወደ እርሱ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አላመጣውም።

verses.text_english: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት በአቢዳራ ቤተሰብ ዘንድ በቤቱ ውስጥ ሦስት ወር ተቀመጠ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የአቢዳራን ቤትና ያለውን ሁሉ ባረከ።

verses.text_english: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.text_amharic: የጢሮስም ንጉሥ ኪራም ቤት ይሠሩለት ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን የዝግባ እንጨትንም ጠራቢዎችንም አናጢዎችንም ወደ ዳዊት ላከ።

verses.text_english: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡም ስለ እስራኤል መንግሥቱ ከፍ ብሎአልና እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ አድርጎ እንዳጸናው ዳዊት አወቀ።

verses.text_english: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በኢየሩሳሌም ሚስቶችን ጨምሮ ሌሎችን ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.text_english: Now these the names of children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም የወለዳቸው የልጆቹ ስም ይህ ነው፤ ሳሙስ፥

verses.text_english: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.text_amharic: ሶባብ፥ ናታን፥ ሰሎሞን፥ ኢያቤሐር፥ ኤሊሱዔ፥

verses.text_english: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊፋላት፥ ኖጋ፥ ናፌቅ፥ ያፍያ፥

verses.text_english: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሳማ፥ ኤሊዳሄ፥ ኤሊፋላት።

verses.text_english: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard , and went out against them.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ዳዊት በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆኖ እንደተቀባ ሰሙ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሁሉ ዳዊትን ሊፈልጉ ወጡ፤ ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ ሊጋጠማቸው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው በራፋይም ሸለቆ አደጋ ጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ልውጣን? በእጄስ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣቸዋለህን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ። እግዚአብሔርም። በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁና ውጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ በአልፐራሲም ወጡ፥ በዚያም ዳዊት መታቸው። ዳዊትም። ውኃ እንዲያፈርስ እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቼን በእጄ አፈረሳቸው አለ። ስለዚህም የዚያን ስፍራ ስም በአልፐራሲም ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.text_english: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.text_amharic: አማልክቶቻቸውንም በዚያ ተዉ፤ ዳዊትም አዘዘ፥ በእሳትም አቃጠሏቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ደግሞ በሸለቆው አደጋ ጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እንደ ገና እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ከእነርሱ ዞረህ በሾላው ዛፍ ፊት ለፊት ግጠማቸው እንጂ ወደ እነርሱ አትውጣ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: በሾላውም ዛፍ እራስ ውስጥ የሽውሽውታ ድምፅ ስትሰማ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ ሊመታ እግዚአብሔር በፊትህ ይወጣልና በዚያን ጊዜ ወደ ሰልፍ ውጣ አለው።

verses.text_english: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ከገባዖንም ጀምሮ እስከ ጌዝር ድረስ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ መቱት።

verses.text_english: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ዝና በየአገሩ ሁሉ ወጣ፤ መፈራቱንም እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ዘንድ አደረገው።

verses.text_english: And made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በከተማው ላይ ለራሱ ቤቶችን ሠራ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት ስፍራ አዘጋጀ፥ ድንኳንም ተከለለት።

verses.text_english: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ዳዊት። የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ይሸከሙ ዘንድ፥ ለዘላለሙም ያገለግሉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከመረጣቸው ከሌዋውያን በቀር ማንም የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ይሸከም ዘንድ አይገባውም አለ።

verses.text_english: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወዳዘጋጀለት ስፍራ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ያመጣ ዘንድ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የአሮንን ልጆችና ሌዋውያንን ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.text_amharic: ከቀዓት ልጆች፤ አለቃው ኡርኤል፥ ወንድሞቹም መቶ ሀያ፤

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.text_amharic: ከሜራሪ ልጆች፤ አለቃው ዓሣያ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሁለት መቶ ሀያ፤

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.text_amharic: ከጌድሶን ልጆች፤ አለቃው ኢዮኤል፥ ወንድሞቹም መቶ ሠላሳ፤

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.text_amharic: ከኤሊጻፋን ልጆች፤ አለቃው ሸማያ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሁለት መቶ፤

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.text_amharic: ከኬብሮን ልጆች፤ አለቃው ኤሊኤል፥ ወንድሞቹም ሰማንያ፤

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ከዑዝኤል ልጆች፤ አለቃው አሚናዳብ፥ ወንድሞቹም መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።

verses.text_english: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ካህናቱን ሳዶቅንና አቢያታርን፥ ሌዋውያንንም ኡርኤልን፥ ዓሣያን፥ ኢዮኤልን፥ ሸማያን፥ ኤሊኤልን፥ አሚናዳብንም ጠርቶ።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Ye the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto I have prepared for it.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የሌዋውያን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ናችሁ፤ ወዳዘጋጀሁለት ስፍራ የእስራኤልን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ታመጡ ዘንድ እናንተና ወንድሞቻችሁ ተቀደሱ።

verses.text_english: For because ye not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.text_amharic: ቀድሞም አልተሸከማችሁምና፥ እንደ ሥርዓቱም አልፈለግነውምና አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ስብራት አደረገ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት ያመጡ ዘንድ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ ተቀደሱ።

verses.text_english: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል የሌዋውያን ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት በትከሻቸው ላይ በመሎጊያዎቹ ተሸከሙ።

verses.text_english: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በዜማ ዕቃ በመሰንቆና በበገና በጸናጽልም እንዲያዜሙ፥ ድምፃቸውንም በደስታ ከፍ እንዲያደርጉ መዘምራኑን ወንድሞቻቸውን ይሾሙ ዘንድ ለሌዋውያን ኣለቆች ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያኑም የኢዮኤልን ልጅ ኤማንን፥ ከወንድሞቹም የበራክያን ልጅ አሳፍን፥ ከወንድሞቻቸውም ከሜራሪ ልጆች የቂሳን ልጅ ኤታንን፥

verses.text_english: And with them their brethren of the second , Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር በሁለተኛው ተራ የሆኑትን ወንድሞቻቸውን ዘካርያስን፥ ቤንን፥ ያዝኤልን፥ ሰሚራሞትን፥ ይሒኤልን፥ ዑኒን፥ ኤልያብን፥ በናያስን፥ መዕሤያን፥ መቲትያን፥ ኤሊፍሌሁን፥ ሚቅንያን፥ በረኞችንም ዖቤድኤዶምንና ይዒኤልን አቆሙ።

verses.text_english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.text_amharic: መዘምራንም ኤማንና አሳፍ ኤታንም በናስ ጸናጽል ከፍ አድርገው ያሰሙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.text_amharic: ዘካርያስ፥ ዓዝዔል፥ ሰሚራሞት፥ ይሒኤል፥ ዑኒ፥ ኤልያብ፥ መዕሤያ፥ በናያስ በመሰንቆ ምሥጢር ነገር ያዜሙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.text_amharic: መቲትያ፥ ኤልፍሌሁ፥ ሚቅኒያ፥ ዖቤድኤዶም፥ ይዒኤል፥ ዓዛዝያ ስምንት አውታር ባለው በገና ይዘምሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, for song: he instructed about the song, because he skilful.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዋውያኑም አለቃ ክናንያ በዜማ ላይ ተሹሞ ነበር። ብልሃተኛ ነበረና ዜማ ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Berechiah and Elkanah doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.text_amharic: በራክያና ሕልቃናም ለታቦቱ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም ሰበንያ፥ ኢዮሳፍጥ፥ ናትናኤል፥ ዓማሣይ፥ ዘካርያስ፥ በናያስ፥ አልዓዛር በእግዚአብሔር ታቦይ ፊት መለከት ይነፉ ነበር። ዖቤድኤዶምና ይሒያም ለታቦቱ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም፥ የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች፥ የሻለቆችም የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦት ከአቢዳራ ቤት በደስታ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት የተሸከሙትን ሌዋውያንን እግዚአብሔር በረዳቸው ጊዜ ሰባት በሬዎችና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ሰዉ።

verses.text_english: And David clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም፥ ታቦቱንም የተሸከሙ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ፥ መዘምራኑም፥ የመዘምራኑም አለቃ ከናንያ የጥሩ በፍታ ቀሚስ ለብሰው ነበር፤ ዳዊትም የበፍታ ኤፉድ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ እስራኤል ሁሉ ሆ እያሉ ቀንደ መለከትና እምቢልታ እየነፉ፥ ጸናጽልና መሰንቆም በገናም እየመቱ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳን ታቦት አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ በደረሰ ጊዜ የሳኦል ልጅ ሜልኮል በመስኮት ሆና ተመለከተች፤ ንጉሡም ዳዊት ሲዘፍንና ሲጫወት አይታ በልቧ ናቀችው።

verses.text_english: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት ይዘው ገቡ፥ ዳዊትም በተከለለት ድንኳን ውስጥ አኖሩት፤ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕትም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ በፈጸመ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ሕዝቡን ባረከ።

verses.text_english: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon .
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ለወንዱም ለሴቱም ለእያንዳንዱ አንዳንድ እንጀራ፤ አንዳንድም ቍራጭ ሥጋ፥ አንዳንድም የዘቢብ ጥፍጥፍ አካፈለ።

verses.text_english: And he appointed of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ታቦት ፊት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይወድሱት ዘንድ፥ ያመሰግኑትና ያከብሩትም ዘንድ ከሌዋውያን ወገን አቆመ።

verses.text_english: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.text_amharic: አለቃው አሳፍ ነበረ፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ዘካርያስ፥ ይዒኤል፥ ሰሚራሞት፥ ይሒኤል፥ መቲትያ፥ ኤልያብ፥ በናያስ፥ ዖቤድኤዶም፥ ይዒኤል በመሰንቆና በበገና አሳፍም በጸናጽል ይዘምሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም በናያስና የሕዚኤል በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ሁልጊዜ መለከት ይነፉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then on that day David delivered first to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ዳዊት በአሳፍና በወንድሞቹ እጅ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመሰግኑ ትእዛዝን ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ስሙን ጥሩ፤ ለአሕዛብ ሥራውን አውሩ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀኙለት፥ ዘምሩለት፤ ተአምራቱንም ሁሉ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በቅዱስ ስሙ ተጓደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ልብ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.text_english: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉት፥ ትጸናላችሁም፤ ሁልጊዜ ፊቱን ፈልጉ።

verses.text_english: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው

verses.text_english: He the LORD our God; his judgments in all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዱ በምድር ሁሉ ነው። ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም፥ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ያዘዘውን ቃሉን አሰበ፥

verses.text_english: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.text_amharic: ለአብርሃም ያደረገውን፥ ለይስሐቅም የማለውን፤

verses.text_english: which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.text_amharic: ለያዕቆብ ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ለእስራኤልም የዘላለም ኪዳን እንዲሆን አጸና፤

verses.text_english: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, to Israel an everlasting covenant,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። ለአንተ የከነዓንን ምድር የርስታችሁን ገመድ እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው እነርሱ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ሰዎች፥ እጅግ ጥቂቶችና ስደተኞች ሲሆኑ ነው።

verses.text_english: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ፥ ከመንግሥትም ወደ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለፉ።

verses.text_english: And they went from nation to nation, and from kingdom to another people;
He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ዕለት ዕለት ማዳኑን አውሩ።

verses.text_english: , Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.text_amharic: ክብሩን ለአሕዛብ፥ ተአምራቱንም ለወገኖች ሁሉ ንገሩ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ፥ ምስጋናውም ብዙ ነውና፤ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ የተፈራ ነው።

verses.text_english: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ ጣዖታት ናቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: For great the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also to be feared above all gods.
verses.text_amharic: ክብርና ግርማ በፊቱ፥ ኃይልና ደስታ በስፍራው ውስጥ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For all the gods of the people idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ወገኖች ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ ክብርንና ኃይልን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ።

verses.text_english: Glory and honour in his presence; strength and gladness in his place.
verses.text_amharic: ለስሙ የሚገባ ክብርን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤ ቍርባንን ይዛችሁ በፊቱ ግቡ፤ በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ።

verses.text_english: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ በፊቱ ትነዋወጥ፤ ዓለሙም እንዳይናወጥ ጸንቶአል።

verses.text_english: Give unto the LORD the glory unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት ደስ ይበላቸው፥ ምድርም ሐሴትን ታድርግ፤ በአሕዛብም መካከል። እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ በሉ።

verses.text_english: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.text_amharic: ባሕርና ሞላዋ ትናወጥ፤ በረሀ በእርሷም ያሉ ሁሉ ሐሤትን ያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና፥ የዱር ዛፎች በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that therein.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር ነውና፥ ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የመዳናችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ አድነን፤ ቅዱስ ስምህን እናመሰግን ዘንድ፥ በምስጋናህም እንመካ ዘንድ፥ ከአሕዛብ ሰብስበህ ታደገን በሉ።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the LORD; for good; for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አሜን ይበሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, glory in thy praise.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በየቀኑ እንደሚገባቸው በታቦቱ ፊት ዘወትር ያገለግሉ ዘንድ አሳፍንና ወንድሞቹን፥ ዖቤድኤዶምንም፥ ስድሳ ስምንቱንም ወንድሞቻቸውን በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ተዋቸው።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶታምም ልጅ ዖቤድኤዶምና ሖሳ በረኞች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ተዋቸው።

verses.text_english: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሳዶቅንና ካህናቱን ወንድሞቹን በገባዖን በኮረብታው መስገጃ ባለው በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት አቆማቸው፥

verses.text_english: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah porters:
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ባዘዘው በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ ሁሉ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ሁል ጊዜ ጥዋትና ማታ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that at Gibeon,
verses.text_amharic: ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ ኤማንንና ኤዶታምን፥ በስማቸውም የተጻፉትን ተመርጠው የቀሩትን ከእነርሱ ጋር አቆመ።

verses.text_english: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር ካህናቱ ከፍ አድርገው ለማሰማት መለከትና ጸናጽል ለእግዚአብሔርም መዝሙራት የዜማ ዕቃ ይዘው ነበር፤ የኤዶታምም ልጆች በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy for ever;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ፤ ዳዊትም ቤቱን ይባርክ ዘንድ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD under curtains.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊት በቤቱ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ ዳዊት ነቢዩን ናታንን። እነሆ፥ እኔ ከዝግባ በተሠራ ቤት ተቀምጫለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በመጋረጃዎች ውስጥ ተቀምጦአል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that in thine heart; for God with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ናታንም ዳዊትን። እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና በልብህ ያለውን ሁሉ አድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሌሊት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ናታን መጣ እንዲህም አለው።

verses.text_english: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from tabernacle .
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ፥ ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤልን ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከድንኳን ወደ ድንኳን፥ ከማደሪያም ወደ ማደሪያ እሄድ ነበር እንጂ በቤት ውስጥ አልኖርሁምና የምኖርበትን ቤት አትሠራልኝም።

verses.text_english: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር ባለፍሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ። ስለ ምን ቤትን ከዝግባ እንጨት አልሠራችሁልኝም? ብዬ ሕዝቤን ይጠብቅ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ፈራጆች ላዘዝሁት ለአንዱ በውኑ ተናግሬአለሁን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን እንዲህ በለው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ መንጋውን ስትከተል በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆን ዘንድ ከበግ ጥበቃ ወሰድሁህ።

verses.text_english: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በሄድህበትም ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ነበርሁ፥ ጠላቶችህንም ሁሉ ከፊትህ አጠፋሁ፤ በምድርም ላይ እንዳሉ እንደታላላቆች ስም ለአንተ ስም አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
And since the time that I commanded judges over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባቶችህም ትሄድ ዘንድ ዕድሜህ በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ከልጆችህ የሚሆነውን ዘርህን ከአንተ በኋላ አስነሣለሁ፤ መንግሥቱንም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ቤት ይሠራልኛል፤ ዙፋኑንም ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁ፥ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል፤ ከአንተ አስቀድሞ ከነበረው እንዳራቅሁ፥ ምሕረቴን ከእርሱ አላርቅም።

verses.text_english: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took from that was before thee:
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴና በመንግሥቴም ለዘላለም አቆመዋለሁ፤ ዙፋኑም ለዘላለም ይጸናል።

verses.text_english: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ነገር ሁሉ እንደዚህም ራእይ ሁሉ ናታን ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.text_english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ገባ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ተቀምጦ እንዲህ አለ። አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እስከዚህ ያደረስኸኝ እኔ ማን ነኝ? ቤቴስ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who I, O LORD God, and what mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ ይህ በፊትህ ጥቂት ነበረ፤ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ስለ ባሪያህ ቤት ደግሞ ለሩቅ ዘመን ተናገርህ፤ እንደ አንድ ባለ ማዕርግ ሰው ተመለከትኸኝ።

verses.text_english: And this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ባሪያህን ታውቀዋለህና ለባሪያህ ስለ ተደረገ ክብር ዳዊት ጨምሮ የሚለው ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: What can David more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ይህን ታላቅ ነገር ሁሉ ታስታውቀው ዘንድ ስለ ባሪያህ እንደ ልብህም ይህን ታአምራት ሁሉ አድርገሃል።

verses.text_english: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all great things.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንዳንተ ያለ የለም፥ በጆሮአችንም እንደሰማን ሁሉ ከአንተ በቀር አምላክ የለም።

verses.text_english: O LORD, none like thee, neither God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ እግዚአብሔር ከግብጽ ካወጣኸው ከሕዝብህ ፊት አሕዛብን በማሳደድ በታላቅና በሚያስፈራ ነገር ለአንተ ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ፥ ለአንተም ሕዝብ ትቤዥ ዘንድ እንደሄድህለት እንዳንተ ሕዝብ እንደ እስራኤል ያለ በምድር ላይ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለን?

verses.text_english: And what one nation in the earth like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህንም እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ሕዝብህ አደረግኸው፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ አምላክ ሆነኸዋል።

verses.text_english: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ ስለ ባሪያህና ስለ ቤቱ የተናገርኸው ለዘላለም የጸና ይሁን፤ እንደተናገርህም አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ነው፥ በእውነት የእስራኤል አምላክ ነው ይባል ዘንድ ስምህ ለዘላለም ጽኑና ታላቅ ይሁን፤ የባሪያህም የዳዊት ቤት በፊትህ ጸንቶአል።

verses.text_english: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts the God of Israel, a God to Israel: and the house of David thy servant established before thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ቤት እንድሠራለት ለባሪያህ ገልጠሃልና ስለዚህ ባሪያህ ወዳንተ ይጸልይ ዘንድ በልቡ ደፈረ።

verses.text_english: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found to pray before thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አምላክ ነህ፥ ይህንም መልካም ነገር ለባሪያህ ተናግረሃል።

verses.text_english: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በፊትህ ለዘላለም ይኖር ዘንድ የባሪያህን ቤት እንድትባርክ ፈቅደሃል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ ባርከኸዋል፥ ለዘላለምም ቡሩክ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ፥ አዋረዳቸውም፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ ጌትንና መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, brought gifts.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብን መታ፤ ሞዓባውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፤ ግብርም አመጡለት።

verses.text_english: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ የነበረውን ግዛት ለመያዝ በሄደ ጊዜ የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን እስከ ሃማት ድረስ መታ።

verses.text_english: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot , but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ አንድ ሺህ ሰረገሎች፥ ሰባት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች፥ ሀያ ሺህም እግረኞች ወሰደ፤ ዳዊት ለመቶ ሰረገሎች የሚሆኑትን ብቻ አስቀርቶ የሰረገሎቹን ፈረሶች ቋንጃ ቆረጠ።

verses.text_english: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: ከደማስቆም ሶርያውያን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ በመጡ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከሶርያውያን ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎችን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: Then David put in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በደማስቆ ሶርያ ጭፍሮች አኖረ፤ ሶርያውያንም ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ፥ ግብርም አመጡለት። እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊት በሄደበት ሁሉ ድል ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ለአድርአዛር ባሪያዎች የነበሩትን የወርቅ ጋሻዎች ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ይዞአቸው መጣ።

verses.text_english: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.text_amharic: ከአድርአዛርም ከተሞች ከጢብሐትና ከኩን ዳዊት እጅግ ብዙ ናስ ወሰደ፤ ከዚህም ሰሎሞን የናሱን ኵሬና ዓምዶች የናሱንም ዕቃ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.text_amharic: የሐማትም ንጉሥ ቶዑ ዳዊት የሱባን ንጉሥ የአድርአዛርን ጭፍራ ሁሉ እንደ መታ ሰማ።

verses.text_english: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.text_amharic: ቶዑም ከአድርአዛር ጋር ሁል ጊዜ ይዋጋ ነበርና ዳዊት አድርአዛርን ወግቶ ስለመታው ደኅንነቱን ይጠይቅ ዘንድ ይመርቀውም ዘንድ ልጁን አዶራምን ወደ ዳዊት ላከው፤ እርሱም የወርቅና የብር የናስም ዕቃ ይዞ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ ከኤዶምና ከሞዓብ ከአሞንም ልጆች ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከአማሌቅም ከማረከው ብርና ወርቅ ጋር እነዚህን ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ቀደሰ።

verses.text_english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ የጽሩያ ልጅ አቢሳ ከኤዶማውያን በጨው ሸለቆ ውስጥ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ሰዎች ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text_amharic: በኤዶምያስም ጭፍሮች አኖረ፥ ኤዶማውያንም ሁሉ ለዳዊት ገባሮች ሆኑ። እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊት በሄደበት ሁሉ ድል ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ፤ ለሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፍርድንና ጽድቅም አደረገላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብም የሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ፤ የአሒሉድም ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.text_amharic: የአኪጦብም ልጅ ሳዶቅ፥ የአቤሜሌክም ልጅ አብያታር ካህናት ነበሩ፤ ሱሳ ጸሐፊ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David chief about the king.
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ በከሊታውያንና በፈሊታውያን ላይ ነበረ፤ የዳዊትም ልጆች በንጉሡ አጠገብ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ ናዖስ ሞተ፥ ልጁም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። አባቱ ስላደረገልኝ ወረታ እኔ ለናዖስ ልጅ ለሐኖን ቸርነት አደርጋለሁ አለ። ዳዊትም አባቱ ስለ ሞተ ልያጽናናው መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤ የዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ሊያጽናኑት ወደ ሐኖን ወደ አሞን ልጆች ምድር መጡ።

verses.text_english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.text_amharic: የአሞን ልጆች አለቆች ግን ሐኖንን። ዳዊት አባትህን አክብሮ የሚያጽናኑህን ወደ አንተ የላከ ይመስልሃልን? ባሪያዎቹስ አገሪቱን ለመመርመር፥ ለማጥፋት፥ ለመሰለልም ወደ አንተ የመጡ አይደሉምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.text_amharic: ሐኖንም የዳዊትን ባሪያዎች ወስዶ አስላጫቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም እስከ ወገባቸው ድረስ ከሁለት ቀድዶ ሰደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: Then there went , and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and return.
verses.text_amharic: ወሬኞችም ሄደው በሰዎቹ ላይ የተደረገውን ለዳዊት አስታወቁት። ሰዎቹም በብዙ አፍረዋልና ተቀባዮች ላከ፤ ንጉሡም። ጢማችሁ እስኪያድግ ድረስ በኢያሪኮ ተቀመጡ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ተመለሱ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች በዳዊት ዘንድ እንደ ተጠሉ ባዩ ጊዜ ሐኖንና የአሞን ልጆች ከመስጴጦምያ፥ ከአራምመዓካ፥ ከሱባ ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን ይቀጥሩ ዘንድ አንድ ሺህ መክሊት ብር ላኩ።

verses.text_english: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.text_amharic: ሠላሳ ሁለትም ሺህ ሰረገሎች የመዓካንም ንጉሥ ሕዝቡንም ቀጠሩ፤ መጥተውም በሜድባ ፊት ለፊት ሰፈሩ። የአሞንም ልጆች ከየከተሞቻቸው ተሰብስበው ወደ ሰልፍ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when David heard , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ይህ በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮአብንና የኃያላኑን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come by themselves in the field.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ወጥተው በከተማይቱ በር አጠገብ ተሰለፉ፤ የመጡትም ነገሥታት ለብቻቸው በሜዳው ላይ በሩ።

verses.text_english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put in array against the Syrians.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም በፊትና በኋላ ሰልፍ እንደ ከበበው ባየ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ምርጥ ምርጦችን ሁሉ ለይቶ በሶርያውያን ላይ አሰለፋቸው።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውንም ሕዝብ ለወንድሙ ለአቢሳ ሰጠው፥ በአሞንም ልጆች ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.text_english: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሶርያውያን ቢበረቱብኝ እርዳኝ፤ የአሞንም ልጆች ቢበረቱብህ እረዳሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do good in his sight.
verses.text_amharic: አይዞህ፥ ስለ ሕዝባችንና ስለ አምላካችንም ከተሞች እንበርታ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደስ ያሰኘውን ያድርግ አለ።

verses.text_english: So Joab and the people that with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረው ሕዝብ ለሰልፍ ወደ ሶርያውያን ፊት ቀረቡ፥ እነርሱም ከፊቱ ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ሶርያውያን እንደ ሸሹ ባዩ ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሙ ከአቢሳ ፊት ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ገቡ። ኢዮአብም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer before them.
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያውያንም በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ መልእክተኞች ልከው በወንዝ ማዶ የነበሩትን ሶርያውያን አስመጡ፤ የአድርአዛርም ሠራዊት አለቃ ሾፋክ በፊታቸው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻግሮ መጣባቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ዳዊትም በሶርያውያን ላይ በተሰለፈ ጊዜ እነርሱ ከእርሱ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.text_english: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያውያንም ከእስራኤል ፊት ሸሹ፤ ዳዊትም ከሶርያውያን ሰባት ሺህ ሰረገለኞች፥ አርባ ሺህም እግረኞች ገደለ፥ የሠራዊቱንም አለቃ ሾፋክን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.text_amharic: የአድርአዛርም ባሪያዎች በእስራኤል ፊት እንደ ተሸነፉ ባዩ ጊዜ ከዳዊት ጋር ታረቁ፥ ገበሩለትም፤ ሶርያውያንም ከዚያ ወዲያ የአሞንን ልጆች ይረዱ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out , Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዓመት መለወጫ ነገሥታት ወደ ሰልፍ በሚወጡበት ጊዜ ኢዮአብ ሠራዊቱን አወጣ፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች አገር አጠፋ፤ መጥቶም ረባትን ከበበ። ዳዊትም በኢየሩሳሌም ቈይቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም ረባትን መትቶ አፈረሳት። ዳዊትም የንጉሣቸውን ዘውድ ከራሱ ላይ ወሰደ፥ ክብደቱም አንድ መክሊት ወርቅ ያህል ነበረ፥ ክቡርም ዕንቍ ነበረበት፥ በዳዊትም ራስ ላይ አስቀመጡት፤ ከከተማይቱም እጅግ ብዙ ምርኮ አወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he brought out the people that in it, and cut with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጥዋም የነበረውን ሕዝብ አውጥቶ በመጋዝና በብረት መቈፈሪያ በመጥረቢያም እንዲሠሩ አደረጋቸው። እንዲሁም ዳዊት በአሞን ልጆች ከተሞች ሁሉ አደረገ። ዳዊትም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ በጌዝር ላይ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሰልፍ ሆነ፤ ኩሳታዊውም ሴቦካይ ከራፋይም ወገን የነበረውን ሲፋይን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff like a weaver's beam.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ የያዒርም ልጅ ኤልያናን የጦሩ የቦ እንደ ሸማኔ መጠቅለያ የነበረውን የጌት ሰው የጎልያድን ወንድም ለሕሚን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of stature, whose fingers and toes four and twenty, six , and six : and he also was the son of the giant.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ በጌት ላይ ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ ከዚያም በእጁና በእግሩ ስድስት ስድስት ሁላሁሉ ሀያ አራት ጣቶች ያሉት አንድ ረጅም ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ከራፋይም የተወለደ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልንም በተገዳደረ ጊዜ የዳዊት ወንድም የሳምዓ ልጅ ዮናታን ገደለው።

verses.text_english: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም በጌት ውስጥ ከራፋይም የተወለዱ ነበሩ፤ በዳዊትም እጅ በባሪያዎቹም እጅ ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም በእስራኤል ላይ ተነሣ፥ እስራኤልንም ይቈጥር ዘንድ ዳዊትን አንቀሳቀሰው።

verses.text_english: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know .
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ኢዮአብንና የሕዝቡን አለቆች። ሂዱ፥ ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዳን ድረስ እስራኤልን ቍጠሩ፥ ድምራቸውንም አውቅ ዘንድ አስታውቁኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they : but, my lord the king, they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በአሁኑ ላይ መቶ እጥፍ ይጨምር፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሁሉ የጌታዬ ባሪያዎች አይደሉምን? ይህን ነገር ጌታዬ ለምን ይሻል? በእስራኤል ላይ በደል ስለ ምን ያመጣል?

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የንጉሡ ቃል በኢዮአብ ላይ አሸነፈ፤ ኢዮአብም ወጥቶ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ተዘዋወረ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአብም የቈጠራቸውን የሕዝቡን ድምር ለዳዊት ሰጠ፤ ከእስራኤልም ሁሉ አንድ ሚሊዮን ከመቶ ሺህ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰዎችን አገኘ፤ ከይሁዳም አራት መቶ ሰባ ሺህ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰዎችን አገኘ።

verses.text_english: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡ ትእዛዝ ግን በኢዮአብ ዘንድ የተጠላ ነበርና ሌዊና ብንያም ከእነርሱ ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.text_english: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ነገር የተነሣ እግዚአብሔር ተቈጣ፥ እስራኤልንም ቀሠፈ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን። ይህን በማድረግ እጅግ በድያለሁ፤ አሁን ግን ታላቅ ስንፍና አድርጌአለሁና የባሪያህን ኃጢአት ታስወግድ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለዳዊት ባለ ራእይ ለጋድ።

verses.text_english: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three : choose thee one of them, that I may do unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ፥ ለዳዊት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሦስቱን ነገሮች በፊትህ አኖራለሁ፤ አደርግብህ ዘንድ ከእነርሱ አንዱን ምረጥ ብለህ ንገረው ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
verses.text_amharic: ጋድም ወደ ዳዊት መጥቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የምትወድደውን ምረጥ፤

verses.text_english: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh ; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: የሦስት ዓመት ራብ፥ ወይም ሦስት ወር የጠላቶችህ ሰይፍ እንዲያገኝህ ከጠላቶችህ መሰደድን፥ ወይም ሦስት ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ ቸነፈርም በምድር ላይ መሆንን፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእስራኤል ምድር ሁሉ ማጥፋትን ምረጥ፤ አሁንም ለላከኝ ምን እንድመልስ ተመልከት አለው።

verses.text_english: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ጋድን። እጅግ ተጨንቄአለሁ፤ ምሕረቱ ብዙ ነውና በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ልውደቅ፤ በሰው እጅ ግን አልውደቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ቸነፈርን ሰደደ፤ ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሺህ ሰዎች ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋት ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መልአክን ሰደደ፤ ሊያጠፋትም በቀረበ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር አይቶ ስለ ክፉው ነገር ተጸጸተ፥ የሚያጠፋውንም መልአክ። በቃህ፤ አሁን እጅህን መልስ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ዓይኖቹን አነሣ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በምድርና በሰማይ መካከል ቆሞ፥ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ሆኖ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተዘርግቶ አየ። ዳዊትም ሽማግሌዎችም ማቅ ለብሰው በግምባራቸው ተደፉ።

verses.text_english: And David said unto God, not I commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እግዚአብሔርን። ሕዝቡ ይቈጠር ዘንድ ያዘዝሁ እኔ አይደለሁምን? የበደልሁና ክፉ የሠራሁ እኔ ነኝ፤ እነዚህ በጎች ግን ምን አድርገዋል? አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እጅህ በእኔና በአባቴ ቤት ላይ ትሁን፥ ነገር ግን ይቀሠፍ ዘንድ በሕዝብህ ላይ አትሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ዳዊት ወጥቶ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ይሠራ ዘንድ ለዳዊት እንዲነግረው ጋድን አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንደ ተናገረው እንደ ጋድ ነገር ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርናም ዘወር ብሎ መልአኩን አየ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ አራቱ ልጆቹ ተሸሸጉ፤ ኦርናም ስንዴ ያበራይ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with face to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ወደ ኦርና በመጣ ጊዜ ኦርና ተመልክቶ ዳዊትን አየ፤ ከአውድማውም ወጥቶ ዳዊትን እጅ ሊነሣ በምድር ላይ ተደፋ።

verses.text_english: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ኦርናን። በላዩ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ እሠራ ዘንድ ይህን የአውድማ ስፍራ ስጠኝ፤ በሙሉ ዋጋ ስጠኝ፤ መቅሠፍቱን ከሕዝቡ ይከለከላል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Ornan said unto David, Take to thee, and let my lord the king do good in his eyes: lo, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.text_amharic: ኦርናም ዳዊትን። ለአንተ ውሰደው፥ ጌታዬ ንጉሡም ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ያድርግ፤ እነሆ፥ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሬዎቹን፥ ለእንጨትም የአውድማውን ዕቃ፥ ከእህልም ቍርባን ስንዴውን እሰጥሃለሁ፤ ሁሉን እሰጣለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take which thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ኦርናን። አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ለአንተ ያለውን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጥቼ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በከንቱ አላቀርብምና በሙሉ ዋጋ እገዛዋለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ስለ ስፍራው ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ወርቅ በሚዛን ለኦርና ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በዚያ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ጠራ፤ ከሰማይም ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ በእሳት መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም መልአኩን አዘዘው፥ ሰይፉንም በአፎቱ ከተተው።

verses.text_english: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ እንደ መለሰለት ዳዊት ባየ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ መሥዋዕት ሠዋ።

verses.text_english: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም በምድረ በዳ የሠራት የእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያና ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነው መሠዊያ በዚያን ጊዜ በገባዖን ባለው በኮረብታው መስገጃ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊት ግን የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ ሰይፍ ስለ ፈራ እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ወደዚያ ይሄድ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: Then David said, This the house of the LORD God, and this the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ነው፥ ይህም ለእስራኤል ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነው መሠዊያ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ምድር የነበሩትን መጻተኞች ይሰበስቡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ለመሥራት የሚወቀሩትን ድንጋዮች ይወቅሩ ዘንድ ጠራቢዎችን አኖረ።

verses.text_english: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ለበሮቹ ሳንቃ ለሚሆኑ ለምስማርና ለመጠረቂያ ብዙ ብረት፥ ከብዛቱም የተነሣ የማይመዘን ናስ አዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.text_amharic: ሲዶናውያውንና የጢሮስ ሰዎች ብዙ የዝግባ እንጨት ወደ ዳዊት ያመጡ ነበርና ቍጥር ያሌላቸውን የዝግባ እንጨቶች አዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: And David said, Solomon my son young and tender, and the house to be builded for the LORD exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። ልጄ ሰሎሞን ታናሽና ለጋ ብላቴና ነው፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚሠራው ቤት እጅግ ማለፊያና በአገሩ ሁሉ ስሙና ክብሩ እንዲጠራ ይሆን ዘንድ ይገባል፤ ስለዚህ አዘጋጅለታለሁ አለ። ዳዊትም ሳይሞት አስቀድሞ ብዙ አዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን ጠርቶ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ አለ። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እኔ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት እሠራ ዘንድ በልቤ አስቤ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እኔ መጣ። እጅግ ደም አፍስሰሃል፥ ታላቅም ሰልፍ አድርገሃል፤ በፊቴ በምድር ላይ ብዙ ደም አፍስሰሃልና ለስሜ ቤት አትሠራም።

verses.text_english: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የዕረፍት ሰው የሚሆን ልጅ ይወለድልሃል፤ በዙሪያው ካሉ ከጠላቶቹ ሁሉ አሳርፈዋለሁ፤ ስሙ ሰሎሞን ይባላልና፥ በዘመኑም ሰላምንና ጸጥታን ለእስራኤል እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል፥ ልጅም ይሆነኛል፥ እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁ፤ የመንግሥቱንም ዙፋን በእስራኤል ላይ ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ ስለ አንተም እንደ ተናገረው ያከናውንልህ፥ የአምላክህንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ።

verses.text_english: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
verses.text_amharic: ብቻ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ትጠብቅ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ጥበብንና ማስተዋልን ይስጥህ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ያሠልጥንህ።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤል ሙሴን ያዘዘውን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ታደርግ ዘንድ ብትጠነቀቅ በዚያን ጊዜ ይከናወንልሃል፤ አይዞህ፥ በርታ፤ አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥም።

verses.text_english: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ በድህነቴ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት መቶ ሺህ መክሊት ወርቅና አንድ ሚሊዮን መክሊት ብር፥ ሚዛንም የሌላቸው ብዙ ናስና ብረት አዘጋጀሁ፤ ደግሞም እንጨትና ድንጋዮች አዘጋጀሁ፥ አንተም ከዚያ በላይ ጨምር።

verses.text_english: Moreover workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተም ዘንድ ብዙ ሠራተኞች፥ ድንጋይና እንጨት ወቃሪዎችና ጠራቢዎች፥ ሥራውንም ሁሉ ለማድረግ ጠቢባን ሰዎች ሁሉ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, no number. Arise , and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሠሩበት ወርቅና ብር ናስና ብረት ቍጥር የለውም፤ ተነሥተህ ሥራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, ,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ደግሞ ልጁን ሰሎሞንን ያግዙ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን አለቆች ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: not the LORD your God with you? and hath he given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር አይደለምን? በምድርም የሚቀመጡትን በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና፥ ምድርም በእግዚአብሔርና በሕዝቡ ፊት ተገዝታለችና በዙሪያችሁ ሁሉ ዕረፍትን ሰጥቶአችኋል።

verses.text_english: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ትፈልጉ ዘንድ ልባችሁንና ነፍሳችሁን ስጡ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስም ወደሚሠራው ቤት የእግዚአብሔርን የቃል ኪዳኑን ታቦትና የእግዚአብሔርን ንዋየ ቅድሳት ታመጡ ዘንድ ተነሥታችሁ የአምላክን የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ ሥሩ።

verses.text_english: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በሸመገለ ጊዜ፥ ዕድሜንም በጠገበ ጊዜ ልጁን ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ላይ አነገሠው።

verses.text_english: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልንም አለቆች ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱንም፥ ሌዋውያኑንም ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንም ከሠላሳ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ወደ ላይ ተቈጠሩ፤ ቍጥራቸው በእያንዳንዱ ነፍስ ወከፍ ሠላሳ ስምንት ሺህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Of which, twenty and four thousand to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand officers and judges:
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም ውስጥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ የሚያሠሩት ሀያ አራት ሺህ ነበሩ፤ ስድስቱ ሺህም አለቆችና ፈራጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Moreover four thousand porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, , to praise .
verses.text_amharic: አራቱ ሺህም በረኞች ነበሩ፤ አራቱ ሺህም ለምስጋና በተሠሩት በዜማ ዕቃዎች እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, , Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም እንደ ሌዊ ልጆች እንደ ጌድሶንና እንደ ቀዓት እነደ ሜራሪም በየሰሞናቸው ከፈላቸው።

verses.text_english: Of the Gershonites , Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.text_amharic: ከጌድሶናውያን ለአዳንና ሰሜኢ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Laadan; the chief Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.text_amharic: የለአዳን ልጆች አለቃው ይሒኤል፥ ዜቶም፥ ኢዮኤል ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሜኢ ልጆች ሰሎሚት፥ ሐዝኤል፥ ሐራን ሦስት ነበሩ። እነዚህ የለአዳን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Shimei , Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four the sons of Shimei.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሜኢ ልጆች ኢኢት፥ ዚዛ፥ የዑስ፥ በሪዓ ነበሩ። እነዚህ አራቱ የሰሜኢ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to father's house.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃው ኢኢት ነበረ፤ ሁለተኛው ዚዛ ነበረ፤ የዑስና በሪዓ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አልነበሩአቸውም፤ ስለዚህ እንደ አንድ አባት ቤት ሆነው ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.text_amharic: የቀአት ልጆች እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል አራት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የእንበረም ልጆች አሮንና ሙሴ ነበሩ፤ አሮንም ከሁሉ በላይ የተቀደሰ ይሆን ዘንድ ተለየ፥ እርሱና ልጆቹ፥ ለዘላለም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያጥንና ያገለግል ዘንድ፥ በስሙም ለዘላለም ይባርክ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Now Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው የሙሴ ልጆች በሌዊ ነገድ ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Moses , Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴ ልጆች ጌርሳምና አልዓዛር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel the chief.
verses.text_amharic: የጌርሳም ልጆች አለቃ ሱባኤል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Eliezer , Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.text_amharic: የአልዓዛርም ልጆች አለቃ ረዓብያ ነበረ፤ አልዓዛርም ሌሎች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ የረዓብያ ልጆች እጅግ ብዙ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.text_amharic: የይስዓር ልጆች አለቃው ሰሎሚት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.text_amharic: የኬብሮን ልጆች አለቃው ይሪያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው የሕዚኤል፥ አራተኛው ይቅምዓም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.
verses.text_amharic: የዑዝኤል ልጆች አለቃው ሚካ፥ ሁለተኛው ይሺያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞሖሊና ሙሲ ነበሩ። የሞሖሊ ልጆች አልዓዛርና ቂስ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.text_amharic: አልዓዛርም ሴቶች ልጆች ብቻ እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች ሳይወልድ ሞተ፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም የቂስ ልጆች አገቡአቸው።

verses.text_english: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.text_amharic: የሙሲ ልጆች ሞሖሊ፥ ዔደር፥ ኢያሪሙት ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አገልግሎት በሠሩ ከሀያ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ወደ ላይ በነበሩ በእያንዳንዳቸው በስማቸው በተቆጠሩት ላይ የአባቶች ቤት አለቆች የሆኑት በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት የሌዊ ልጆች እነዚህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ዕረፍት ሰጥቶአል፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለዘላለም የቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: And also unto the Levites; they shall no carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ማደሪያውንና የማገልገያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አይሸከሙም አለ።

verses.text_english: For by the last words of David the Levites numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.text_amharic: በመጨረሻውም በዳዊት ትእዛዝ ከሀያ ዓመት ዕድሜ ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት የሌዊ ልጆች ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: Because their office to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.text_amharic: ሥራቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት በየአደባባዩና በየጓዳው ውስጥ ለማገልገል፥ ቅዱሱንም ዕቃ ሁሉ ለማንጻት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት አገልግሎት ለመሥራት ከአሮን ልጆች እጅ በታች ነበረ።
