verses.text_english: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ገጸ ኅብስት፥ ስስ ቂጣም ቢሆን፥ በምጣድም ቢጋገር፥ ቢለወስም፥ ለእህል ቍርባን በሆነው በመልካሙ ዱቄት በመስፈሪያና በልክ ሁሉ ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
verses.text_amharic: ሥራቸውም በየጥዋቱና በየማታው ቆመው እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገንና ለማክበር፥

verses.text_english: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: በየሰንበታቱም በየመባቻዎቹም በየበዓላቱም እንደ ሥርዓቱ ቍጥር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘወትር ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ሁሉ ለማቅረብ፥

verses.text_english: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ሥርዓት የመቅደሱንም ሥርዓት የወንድሞቻቸውንም የአሮንን ልጆች ሥርዓት ለመጠበቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Now the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮንም ልጆች ሰሞን ይህ ነው። የአሮን ልጆች ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.text_amharic: ናዳብና አብዩድ ግን ልጆች ሳይወልዱ ከአባታቸው በፊት ሞቱ፤ አልዓዛርና ኢታምርም ካህናት ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ከአልዓዛር ልጆች ከሳዶቅ ጋር፥ ከኢታምርም ልጆች ከአቢሜሌክ ጋር ሆኖ እንደ አገልግሎታቸው ሥርዓት ከፍሎ መደባቸው።

verses.text_english: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar sixteen chief men of the house of fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የአልዓዛርም ልጆች አለቆች ከኢታምርም ልጆች አለቆች በልጠው ተገኙ፤ እንዲህም ተመደቡ፤ ከአልዓዛር ልጆች እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አሥራ ስድስት፥ ከኢታምርም ልጆች እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ስምንት አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: ከአልዓዛርና ከኢታምርም ልጆች መካከል የመቅደሱና የእግዚአብሔር አለቆች ነበሩና እነዚህና እነዚያ እንዲህ በዕጣ ተመደቡ።

verses.text_english: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and taken for Ithamar.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያንም ወገን የነበረው የናትናኤል ልጅ ጸሐፊው ሸማያ በንጉሡና በአለቆቹ ፊት፥ በካህኑ በሳዶቅና በአብያታርም ልጅ በአቢሜሌክ ፊት፥ በካህናቱና በሌዋውያኑ አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ፊት ጻፋቸው፤ አንዱንም የአባት ቤት ለአልዓዛር፥ አንዱንም ለኢታምር ጻፈ።

verses.text_english: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.text_amharic: መጀመሪያውም ዕጣ ለዮአሪብ ወጣ፥ ሁለተኛው ለዮዳኤ፥

verses.text_english: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛው ለካሪም፥

verses.text_english: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛው ለሥዖሪም፥ አምስተኛው ለመልክያ፥

verses.text_english: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛው ለሚያሚን፥ ሰባተኛው ለአቆስ፥

verses.text_english: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.text_amharic: ስምንተኛው ለአብያ፥ ዘጠኝኛው ለኢያሱ፥

verses.text_english: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.text_amharic: አሥረኛው ለሴኬንያ፥ አሥራ አንደኛው ለኤልያሴብ፥ አሥራ ሁለተኛው ለያቂም፥

verses.text_english: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሦስተኛው ለኦፓ፥ አሥራ አራተኛው ለየሼብአብ፥

verses.text_english: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ አምስተኛው ለቢልጋ፥ አሥራ ስድስተኛው ለኢሜር፥

verses.text_english: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሰባተኛው ለኤዚር፥ አሥራ ስምንተኛው ለሃፊጼጽ፥

verses.text_english: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ዘጠኝኛው ለፈታያ፥

verses.text_english: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.text_amharic: ሀያኛው ለኤዜቄል፥ ሀያ አንደኛው ለያኪን፥ ሀያ ሁለተኛው ለጋሙል፥

verses.text_english: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ ሦስተኛው ለድላያ፥ ሀያ አራተኛው ለመዓዝያ።

verses.text_english: These the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ፥ አባታቸው አሮን እንደ ሰጣቸው ሥርዓት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚገቡበት የአገልግሎታቸው ሥርዓት ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the sons of Levi : Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀሩትም የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ከእንበረም ልጆች ሱባኤል፤ ከሱባኤል ልጆች ዬሕድያ፤

verses.text_english: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first Isshiah.
Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.text_amharic: ከኬብሮንም ልጆች አለቃው ይሪያ፥ ሁለተኛው አማርያ፥ ሦስተኛው የሕዚኤል፥ አራተኛው ይቀምዓም፤

verses.text_english: And the sons ; Jeriah , Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.text_amharic: የዑዝኤል ልጅ ሚካ፤

verses.text_english: the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.text_amharic: የሚካ ልጅ ሻሚር፤ የሚካ ወንድም ይሺያ፤

verses.text_english: The brother of Michah Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሺያ ልጆች ዘካርያስ፤ የሜራሪ ልጆች ሞሖሊ፥ ሙሲ፤ ከያዝያ ልጅ በኖ፤

verses.text_english: The sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.text_amharic: የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ከያዝያ በኖ፥ ሾሃም፥ ዘኩር፥ ዔብሪ፤

verses.text_english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.text_amharic: ከሞሖሊ አልዓዛር፥ እርሱም ልጆች አልነበሩት፤

verses.text_english: Of Mahli Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.text_amharic: ከቂስ፤ የቂስ ልጅ ይረሕምኤል፤ የሙሲም ልጆች፤ ሞሖሊ፥ ዔዳር፥ ኢያሪሙት።

verses.text_english: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish Jerahmeel.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የሌዋውያን ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ደግሞ በንጉሡ በዳዊትና በሳዶቅ በአቢሜሌክም በሌዋውያንና በካህናት አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ፊት፥ ታላቁም እንደ ታናሹ፥ እንደ ወንድሞቻቸው እንደ አሮን ልጆች ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትና የሠራዊቱ አለቆችም ከአሳፍና ከኤማን ከኤዶታም ልጆች በመሰንቆና በበገና በጸናጽልም ትንቢት የሚናገሩትን ሰዎች ለማገልገል ለዩ፤ በአገልግሎታቸውም ሥራ የሠሩ ሰዎች ቍጥር ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሳፍ ልጆች፤ ዘኩር፥ ዮሴፍ፥ ነታንያ፥ አሸርኤላ፤ እነዚህ የአሳፍ ልጆች በንጉሡ ትእዛዝ ትንቢት ከተናገረው ከአሳፍ እጅ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤዶታም የኤዶታም ልጆች፤ ጎዶልያስ፥ ጽሪ፥ የሻያ፥ ሰሜኢ፥ ሐሸብያ፥ መቲትያ፥ እነዚህ ስድስቱ ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋናና ክብር በመሰንቆ ትንቢት ከተናገረው ከአባታቸው ከኤዶታም እጅ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth:
verses.text_amharic: ከኤማን የኤማን ልጆች፤ ቡቅያ፥ መታንያ፥ ዓዛርዔል፥ ሱባኤ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ ሐናንያ፥ ሐናኒ፥ ኤልያታ፥ ጊዶልቲ፥ ሮማንቲዔዘር፥ ዮሽብቃሻ፥ መሎቲ፥ ሆቲር፥ መሐዝዮት፤

verses.text_english: All these the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከቱን ከፍ ያደርጉ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል የንጉሡ ባለ ራእይ የሆነው የኤማን ልጆች ነበሩ። እግዚአብሔርም ለኤማን አሥራ አራት ወንዶች ልጆችንና ሦስት ሴቶች ልጆችን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: All these under the hands of their father for song the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በጸናጽልና በበገና በመሰንቆም ይዘምሩ ዘንድ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ከአባታቸው እጅ በታች ነበሩ፤ አሳፍም ኤዶታምም ኤማንም ከንጉሡ ትእዛዝ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.text_amharic: የብልሃተኞቹም ቍጥር እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገን ከሚያውቁ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር ሁለት መቶ ሰማንያ ስምንት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they cast lots, ward against , as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ተካክለው፥ ታናሹ እንደ ታላቁ፥ አስተማሪውም እንደ ተማሪው፥ ለሰሞናቸው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons twelve:
verses.text_amharic: የፊተኛው ዕጣ ከአሳፍ ወገን ለነበረው ለዮሴፍ ወጣ፤ ሁለተኛው ለጎዶልያስ ወጣ፤ እርሱ ወንድሞቹም ልጆቹም አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: The third to Zaccur, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛው ለዘኩር ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The fourth to Izri, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛው ለይጽሪ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The fifth to Nethaniah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛው ለነታንያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The sixth to Bukkiah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛው ለቡቅያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The seventh to Jesharelah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛው ለይሽርኤል ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The eighth to Jeshaiah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ስምንተኛው ለየሻያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The ninth to Mattaniah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ዘጠኝኛው ለመታንያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The tenth to Shimei, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥረኛው ለሰሜኢ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The eleventh to Azareel, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ አንደኛው ለዓዛርኤል ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The twelfth to Hashabiah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለተኛው ለሐሸብያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The thirteenth to Shubael, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሦስተኛው ለሱባኤል ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ አራተኛው ለመቲትያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ አምስተኛው ለኢያሪሙት ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The sixteenth to Hananiah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ስድስተኛው ለሐናንያ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሰባተኛው ለዮሽብቃሻ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The eighteenth to Hanani, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ስምንተኛው ለሐናኒ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The nineteenth to Mallothi, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ዘጠኝኛው ለመሎቲ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The twentieth to Eliathah, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ሀያኛው ለኤልያታ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The one and twentieth to Hothir, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ አንደኛው ለሆቲር ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ ሁለተኛው ለጊዶልቲ ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ ሦስተኛው ለመሐዚዮት ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.text_english: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, , his sons, and his brethren, twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ አራተኛው ለሮማንቲዔዘር ለልጆቹም ለወንድሞቹም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.text_amharic: በረኞችም እንደዚህ ተመደቡ፤ ከቆሬያውያን ከአሳፍ ልጆች የቆሬ ልጅ ሜሱላም።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Meshelemiah , Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.text_amharic: ሜሱላም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በኵሩ ዘካርያስ፥ ሁለተኛው ይዲኤል፥ ሦስተኛው ዮዛባት፥

verses.text_english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛው የትኒኤል፥ አምስተኛው ኤላም፥ ስድስተኛው ይሆሐናን፥ ሰባተኛው ኤሊሆዔናይ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the sons of Obededom , Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ባርኮታልና ዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በኵሩ ሸማያ፥ ሁለተኛው ዮዛባት፥ ሦስተኛው ኢዮአስ፥ አራተኛው ሣካር፥ አምስተኛው ናትናኤል፥

verses.text_english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛው ዓሚኤል፥ ሰባተኛው ይሳኮር፥ ስምንተኛው ፒላቲ።

verses.text_english: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they mighty men of valour.
verses.text_amharic: ለልጁም ለሸማያ ደግሞ ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ ጽኑዓንም ኃያላን ነበሩና በአባታቸው ቤት ሠለጠኑ።

verses.text_english: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.text_amharic: ለሸማያ ልጆች ዖትኒ፥ ራፋኤል፥ ዖቤድ፥ ወንድሞቹም ኃያላን የነበሩ ኤልዛባድ፥ ኤልሁ፥ ሰማክያ።

verses.text_english: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, threescore and two of Obededom.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ የዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም ልጆቻቸውም ወንድሞቻቸውም ለማገልገል ኃያላን የነበሩ የዖቤድኤዶም ልጆች ስድሳ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
verses.text_amharic: ለሜሱላም ኃያላን የነበሩ አሥራ ስምንት ልጆችና ወንድሞች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
verses.text_amharic: ከሜራሪም ልጆች ለነበረው ለሖሳ ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አለቃውም ሽምሪ ነበረ፤ በኵር አልነበረም፥ አባቱ ግን አለቃ አደረገው፤

verses.text_english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah thirteen.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም ኬልቅያስ፥ ሦስተኛው ጥበልያ፥ አራተኛው ዘካርያስ ነበረ፤ የሖሳ ልጆችና ወንድሞች ሁሉ አሥራ ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Among these the divisions of the porters, among the chief men, wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ወንድሞቻቸው ሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ የበረኞች የአለቆች ሰሞነኞች እነዚህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
verses.text_amharic: በበሩም ሁሉ ያገለግሉ ዘንድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ታናሹና ታላቁ ተካክለው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅም በኩል ዕጣ ለሰሌምያ ወደቀ። ለልጁም ብልህ መካር ለሆነው ለዘካርያስ ዕጣ ጣሉ፤ ዕጣውም በሰሜን በኩል ወጣ።

verses.text_english: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
verses.text_amharic: ለዖቤድኤዶም በደቡብ በኩል፥ ለልጆቹም ለዕቃ ቤቱ ዕጣ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰፊንና ለሖሳ በምዕራብ በኩል፥ በዐቀበቱም መንገድ ባለው በሸሌኬት በር በኩል ጥበቃ ከጥበቃ ላይ ዕጣ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Eastward six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two two.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅ በኩል ስድስት ሌዋውያን ነበሩ፤ በሰሜን በኩል ለየዕለቱ አራት፥ በደቡብ በኩል ለየዕለቱ አራት፥ ለዕቃ ቤቱም ሁለት ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, two at Parbar.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራብ በኩል በፈርባር መንገድ ላይ አራት፥ በፈርባርም አጠገብ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
verses.text_amharic: ከቆሬና ከሜራሪ ልጆች የነበሩ የበረኞች ሰሞን ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And of the Levites, Ahijah over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያን አኪያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብትና በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, of Laadan the Gershonite, Jehieli.
verses.text_amharic: የለአዳን ልጆች፤ ለለአዳን የሆኑ የጌድሶናውያን ልጆች፥ ለጌድሶናዊ ለለአዳን የሆኑ የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ይሒኤሊ፤

verses.text_english: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የይሒኤሊ ልጆች፤ በእግዚአሔር ቤት በሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የነበሩ ዜቶም፥ ወንድሙም ኢዩኤል።

verses.text_english: Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, the Uzzielites:
verses.text_amharic: ከእንበረማውያን፥ ከይስዓራውያን፥ ከኬብሮናውያን፥ ከዑዝኤላውያን፤

verses.text_english: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, ruler of the treasures.
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴ ልጅ የጌርሳም ልጅ ሱባኤል በቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹም፤ ከአልዓዛር ልጁ ረዓብያ፥ ልጁም የሻያ፥ ልጁም ኢዮራም፥ ልጁም ዝክሪ፥ ልጁም ሰሎሚት መጡ።

verses.text_english: Which Shelomith and his brethren over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሰሎሚትና ወንድሞቹ ንጉሡ ዳዊትና የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች የሠራዊቱም አለቆች፥ በቀደሱት በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ቤተ መዛግብት ሁሉ ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሰልፍም ከተገኘው ምርኮ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለማበጀት ቀደሱ።

verses.text_english: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; whosoever had dedicated under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ባለ ራእዩም ሳሙኤል፥ የቂስም ልጅ ሳኦል፥ የኔርም ልጅ አበኔር፥ የጽሩያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ የቀደሱት ንዋየ ቅድሳት ሁሉ ከሰሎሚትና ከወንድሞቹ እጅ በታች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.text_amharic: ከይስዓራውያን ከናንያና ልጆቹ ሹማምትና ፈራጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ በውጭው ሥራ በእስራኤል ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
verses.text_amharic: ከኬብሮናውያን ሐሸብያና ወንድሞቹ፥ ጽኑዓን የነበሩት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሰዎች፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ሁሉ ለንጉሡም አገልግሎት በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምዕራብ በኩል ባለው በእስራኤል ላይ ተሾመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Among the Hebronites Jerijah the chief, among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ከኬብሮናውያንም እንደ አባቶች ቤቶች ትውልዶች የኬብሮናውያን አለቃ ይርያ ነበረ። ዳዊት በነገሠ በአርባኛው ዓመት ይፈልጉአቸው ነበር፤ በእነርሱም መካከል በገለዓድ ኢያዜር ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ተገኙ፤

verses.text_english: And his brethren, men of valour, two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹም ጽኑዓን የነበሩት የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ። ንጉሡም ዳዊት ለእግዚአብሔር ጉዳይ ሁሉና ለንጉሡ ጉዳይ በሮቤላውያንና በጋዳውያን በምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ ላይ ሹሞች አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: Now the children of Israel after their number, , the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችና የሺህ አለቆች የመቶ አለቆችም በክፍሎች ነገር ሁሉ ንጉሡን ያገለገሉትም ሹማምት እንደ ቍጥራቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ። እነዚህም ክፍሎች እያንዳንዳቸው ሀያ አራት ሺህ ሆነው በዓመት ወራት ሁሉ በየወሩ ይገቡና ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Over the first course for the first month Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለመጀመሪያው ወር በአንደኛው ክፍል ላይ የዘብድኤል ልጅ ያሾብዓም ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Of the children of Perez the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከፋሬስ ልጆች ነበረ፤ ለመጀመሪያው ወር በጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ ላይ ተሾሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And over the course of the second month Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ወር ክፍል ላይ አሆሃዊው ዱዲ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The third captain of the host for the third month Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለሦስተኛው ወር ሦስተኛው የጭፍራ አለቃ የካህኑ የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: This Benaiah, mighty the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course Ammizabad his son.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ በናያስ በሠላሳው መካከል ኃያል ሆኖ በሠላሳው ላይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ልጁ ዓሚዛባድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The fourth for the fourth month Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለአራተኛው ወር አራተኛው አለቃ የኢዮአብ ወንድም አሣሄል፥ ከእርሱም በኋላ ልጁ ዝባድያ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The fifth captain for the fifth month Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምስተኛው ወር አምስተኛው አለቃ ይዝራዊው ሸምሁት ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The sixth for the sixth month Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለስድስተኛው ወር ስድስተኛው አለቃ የቴቁሐዊው የዒስካ ልጅ ዒራስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The seventh for the seventh month Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባተኛው ወር ሰባተኛው አለቃ ከኤፍሬም ልጆች የሆነ ፍሎናዊው ሴሌስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The eighth for the eighth month Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለስምንተኛው ወር ስምንተኛው አለቃ ከዛራውያን የነበረው ኩሳታዊው ሲቦካይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The ninth for the ninth month Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘጠኝኛው ወር ዘጠኝኛው አለቃ ከብንያማውያን የነበረው ዓናቶታዊው አቢዔዜር ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The tenth for the tenth month Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሥረኛው ወር አሥረኛው አለቃ ከዛራውያን የነበረው ነጦፋዊው ኖኤሬ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The eleventh for the eleventh month Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሥራ አንደኛው ወር አሥራ አንደኛው አለቃ ከኤፍሬም ልጆች የነበረው ጲርዓቶናዊው በናያስ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The twelfth for the twelfth month Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course twenty and four thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር አሥራ ሁለተኛው አለቃ ከጎቶንያል ወገን የነበረው ነጦፋዊው ሔልዳይ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ክፍል ሀያ አራት ሺህ ጭፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ነገዶች ላይ እነዚህ ነበሩ በሮቤላውያን ላይ የዝክሪ ልጅ አልዓዛር አለቃ ነበረ፤ በስምዖናውያን የመዓካ ልጅ ሰፋጥያስ፤

verses.text_english: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.text_amharic: በሌዊ ላይ የቀሙኤል ልጅ ሐሸቢያ፤

verses.text_english: Of Judah, Elihu, of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.text_amharic: በአሮን ላይ ሳዶቅ፤ በይሁዳ ላይ ከዳዊት ወንድሞች ኤሊሁ፤ በይሳኮር ላይ የሚካኤል ልጅ ዖምሪ፤

verses.text_english: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.text_amharic: በዛብሎን ላይ የአብድዩ ልጅ ይሽማያ፤ በንፍታሌም ላይ የዓዝሪኤል ልጅ ኢያሪሙት፤

verses.text_english: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.text_amharic: በኤፍሬም ልጆች ላይ የዓዛዝያ ልጅ ሆሴዕ፤ በምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ ላይ የፈዳያ ልጅ ኢዩኤል፤

verses.text_english: Of the half of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.text_amharic: በገለዓድ ባለው በምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ ላይ የዘካርያስ ልጅ አዶ፤ በብንያም ላይ የአበኔር ልጅ የዕሢኤል፤

verses.text_english: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዳን ላይ የይሮሐም ልጅ ዓዛርኤል፤ እነዚህ የእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን እስራኤልን እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት ያበዛ ዘንድ ተናግሮ ነበርና ዳዊት ከሀያ ዓመት በታች የነበሩትን አልቈጠረም።

verses.text_english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.text_amharic: የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብ መቍጠር ጀመረ፥ ነገር ግን አልፈጸመም፤ ስለዚህም በእስራኤል ላይ ቍጣ ሆነ፥ ቍጥራቸውም በንጉሡ በዳዊት መዝገብ አልተጻፈም።

verses.text_english: And over the king's treasures Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የዓዲኤል ልጅ ዓዝሞት ሹም ነበረ፤ በሜዳውም በከተሞችም በመንደሮችም በግንቦችም ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ የዖዝያ ልጅ ዮናታን ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.text_amharic: መሬቱን የሚያበጃጁትና እርሻውን በሚያርሱት ላይ የክሉብ ልጅ ዔዝሪ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And over the vineyards Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.text_amharic: በወይንም ቦታዎች ላይ ራማታዊው ሰሜኢ ሹም ነበረ፤ ለወይንም ጠጅ ዕቃ ቤት በሚሆነው በወይኑ ሰብል ላይ ሸፋማዊው ዘብዲ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that in the low plains Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil Joash:
verses.text_amharic: በቈላውም ውስጥ ባሉት በወይራውና በሾላው ዛፎች ላይ ጌድራዊው በአልሐናን ሹም ነበረ፤ በዘይቱም ቤቶች ላይ ኢዮአስ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And over the herds that fed in Sharon Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds in the valleys Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.text_amharic: በሳሮንም በሚሰማሩ ከብቶች ላይ ሳሮናዊው ሰጥራይ ሹም ነበረ፤ በሸለቆቹም ውስጥ በነበሩት ከብቶች ላይ የዓድላይ ልጅ ሻፍጥ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: Over the camels also Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.text_amharic: በግመሎችም ላይ እስማኤላዊው ኡቢያስ ሹም ነበረ፤ በአህዮቹም ላይ ሜሮኖታዊው ይሕድያ ሹም ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And over the flocks Jaziz the Hagerite. All these the rulers of the substance which king David's.
verses.text_amharic: በመንጎቹም ላይ አጋራዊው ያዚዝ ሹም ነበረ። እነዚህ ሁሉ በንጉሡ በዳዊት ሀብት ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni with the king's sons:
verses.text_amharic: አስተዋይና ጸሐፊ የነበረው የዳዊት አጎት ዮናታን አማካሪ ነበረ፤ የሐክሞኒም ልጅ ይሒኤል ከንጉሡ ልጆች ጋር ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Ahithophel the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite the king's companion:
verses.text_amharic: አኪጦፌልም የንጉሡ አማካሪ ነበረ፤ አርካዊውም ኩሲ የንጉሡ ወዳጅ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And after Ahithophel Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army Joab.
verses.text_amharic: ከአኪጦፌልም ቀጥሎ የበናያስ ልጅ ዮዳሄና አብያታር ነበሩ፤ ኢዮአብም የንጉሡ ሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም የእስራኤልን አለቆች ሁሉ፥ የነገዶቹንም አለቆች፥ ንጉሡንም በክፍል የሚያገለግሉትን የጭፍሮች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆቹንም፥ የመቶ አለቆችንም፥ በንጉሥና በልጆች ሀብትና ግዛት ላይ የተሾሙትን፥ ጃንደረቦችንም፥ ጽኑዓን ኃይላኑንም ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: , I in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት በእግሩ ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። ወንድሞቼና ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ለቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦትና ለአምላካችን እግር ማረፊያ የዕረፍት ቤት ለመሥራት እኔ በልቤ አስቤአለሁ፤ ለሥራም የሚያስፈልገውን አዘጋጅቻለሁ፤

verses.text_english: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን። የሰልፍ ሰው ነህና፥ ደምም አፍስሰሃልና ለስሜ ቤት አትሠራም ብሎኛል።

verses.text_english: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make king over all Israel:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ የዘላለም ንጉሥ እሆን ዘንድ ከአባቴ ቤት ሁሉ መርጦኛል፤ ይሁዳም አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ መርጦታል፤ ከይሁዳም ቤት የአባቴን ቤት መርጦአል፤ ከአባቴም ልጆች መካከል በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ያነግሠኝ ዘንድ ሊመርጠኝ ወደደ።

verses.text_english: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ብዙ ልጆች ሰጥቶኛልና ከልጆቼ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ በእስራኤል ላይ ይነግሥ ዘንድ ልጄን ሰሎሞንን መርጦታል።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him my son, and I will be his father.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ልጅ ይሆነኝ ዘንድ መርጬዋለሁና፥ እኔም አባት እሆነዋለሁና ልጅህ ሰሎሞን ቤቴንና አደባባዮቼን ይሠራል።

verses.text_english: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዜንና ፈርዴንም በማድረግ እንደ ዛሬው ቢጸና መንግሥቱን ለዘላለም አጸናዋለሁ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ እስራኤል ሁሉ እያዩ፥ አምላካችንም እየሰማ፥ ይህችን መልካሚቱን ምድር ትወርሱ ዘንድ፥ ለልጆቻችሁም ለዘላለም ታወርሱአት ዘንድ የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ጠብቁ፥ ፈልጉም።

verses.text_english: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም፥ ልጄ ሰሎሞን ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ልብን ሁሉ ይመረምራልና፥ የነፍስንም አሳብ ሁሉ ያውቃልና፥ የአባትህን አምላክ እወቅ፤ በፍጹም ልብና በነፍስህ ፈቃድም አምልከው፤ ብትፈልገው ታገኘዋለህ፤ ብትተወው ግን ለዘላለም ይጥልሃል።

verses.text_english: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do .
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለመቅደስ የሚሆን ቤትን ትሠራ ዘንድ መርጦሃልና ጠንክረህ ፈጽመው።

verses.text_english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ለመቅደሱ ወለል፥ ለቤቱም፥ ለቤተ መዛግብቱም፥ ለደርቡና ለውስጡም ጓዳዎች፥ ለስርየቱም መክደኛ መቀመጫ ምሳሌውን ለልጁ ለሰሎሞን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባዮችና በዙርያው ለሚሆኑ ጓዳዎች፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት፥ ለንዋየ ቅድሳቱም ለሚሆኑ ቤተ መዛግብት በመንፈሱ ላሰበው ሁሉ ምሳሌን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
of gold by weight for of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
verses.text_amharic: ለወርቁም መቅረዞችና ለቀንዲሎችም ወርቁን በየመቅረዙና በየቀንዲሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤ ለብሩን መቅረዞች እንደ መቅረዙ ሁሉ ሥራ ሁሉ ብሩን በየመቅረዙና በየቀንዲሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤

verses.text_english: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, for the candlestick, and for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
verses.text_amharic: ለገጹ ኅብስት ገበታዎች ወርቁን በሚዛን ለገበታዎቹ ሁሉ፥ ብሩንም ለብሩ ገበታዎች ሰጠው፤

verses.text_english: And by weight gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver:
verses.text_amharic: ለሜንጦቹና ለድስቶቹ ለመቅጃዎቹም ጥሩውን ወርቅ፥ ለወርቁም ጽዋዎች ወርቁን በየጽዋው ሁሉ በሚዛን፥ ለብሩም ጽዋዎች ብሩን በየጽዋው ሁሉ በሚዛን ሰጠው፤

verses.text_english: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons by weight for every bason; and by weight for every bason of silver:
verses.text_amharic: ለዕጣኑም መሠዊዋ ጥሩውን ወርቅ በሚዛን፥ ክንፎቻቸውንም ዘርግተው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት የሸፈኑትን የኪሩቤልን የወርቅ ሰረገላ ምሳሌ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out , and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም። የሥራውን ሁሉ ምሳሌ አውቅ ዘንድ ይህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ተጽፎ መጣልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: All , the LORD made me understand in writing by hand upon me, all the works of this pattern.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ልጁን ሰሎሞንን። ጠንክር፥ አይዞህ፥ አድርገውም፤ አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ከአንተ ጋር ነውና አትፍራ፥ አትደንግጥም፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት የሚሆነው ሥራ ሁሉ እስኪፈጸም ድረስ እርሱ አይተውህም፥ አይጥልህምም።

verses.text_english: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do : fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, my God, with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ሁሉ የሚሆኑ የካህናትና የሌዋውያን ክፍሎች በዚህ አሉ፤ ለሁሉም ዓይነት አገልግሎትና ሥር በብልሃትና በነፍሱ ፈቃድ የሚሠራ ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፤ አለቆችና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፈጽመው ይታዘዙሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, young and tender, and the work great: for the palace not for man, but for the LORD God.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳዊት ለጉባኤው ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን የመረጠው ልጄ ሰሎሞን ገና ብላቴና ለጋ ነው፤ ሕንፃው ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ለአምላክ ነው እንጂ ለሰው አይደለምና ሥራው ታላቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for of gold, and the silver for of silver, and the brass for of brass, the iron for of iron, and wood for of wood; onyx stones, and to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እንደ ጕልበቴ ሁሉ ለአምላኬ ቤት ለወርቁ ዕቃ ወርቁን፥ ለብሩም ዕቃ ብሩን፥ ለናሱም ዕቃ ናሱን፥ ለብረቱም ዕቃ ብረቱን፥ ለእንጨቱም ዕቃ እንጨቱን፥ ደግሞም መረግድንና በፈርጥ የሚገባ ድንጋይን፥ የሚለጠፍ ድንጋይን፥ ልዩ ልዩ መልክ ያለውንም ድንጋይ፥ የከበረውንም ድንጋይ ከየዓይነቱ፥ ብዙም እብነ በረድ አዘጋጅቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በላይ ደግሞ የአምላኬን ቤት ስለወደድሁ፥ ለመቅደሱ ካዘጋጀሁት ሁሉ ሌላ የግል ገንዘቤ የሚሆን ወርቅና ብር አለኝና ለአምላኬ ቤት ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses :
verses.text_amharic: የቤቶቹ ግንብ ይለበጡበት ዘንድ ከኦፊር ወርቅ ሦስት ሺህ መክሊት ወርቅ፥ ሰባት ሺህም መክሊት ጥሩ ብር፥

verses.text_english: The gold for of gold, and the silver for of silver, and for all manner of work by the hands of artificers. And who is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: በሠራተኞች እጅ ለሚሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ለወርቁ ዕቃ ወርቁን፥ ለብሩም ዕቃ ብሩን ሰጥቻለሁ። ዛሬ በፈቃዱ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቀድስ ማነው?

verses.text_english: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶችም ቤቶች አለቆች፥ የእስራኤልም ነገዶች አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችም፥ የመቶ አለቆችም፥ በንጉሡም ሥራ ላይ የተሾሙት በፈቃዳቸው አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት አምስት ሺህ መክሊት ወርቅና አሥር ሺህ ዳሪክ፥ አሥር ሺህም መክሊት ብር፥ አሥራ ስምንት ሺህም መክሊት ናስ፥ መቶ ሺህም መክሊት ብረት ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And they with whom stones were found gave to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.text_amharic: ዕንቍም ያለው ሰው ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ለሆነው ቤተ መዛግብት በጌድሶናዊው በይሒኤል እጅ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ፈቅደው ሰጥተዋልና፥ በፍጹም ልባቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃዳቸው አቅርበዋልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ንጉሡም ዳዊት ደግሞ ታላቅ ደስታ ደስ አለው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በጉባኤው ሁሉ ፊት እግዚአብሔርን ባረከ፤ ዳዊትም አለ። አቤቱ፥ የአባታችን የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ተባረክ።

verses.text_english: Thine, O LORD, the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all in the heaven and in the earth ; thine the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በሰማይና በምድር ያለው ሁሉ የአንተ ነውና ታላቅነትና ኃይል፥ ክብርም፥ ድልና ግርማ ለአንተ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ መንግሥት የአንተ ነው፥ አንተም በሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያልህ ራስ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Both riches and honour of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand power and might; and in thine hand to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.text_amharic: ባለጠግነትና ክብር ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው፥ አንተም ሁሉን ትገዛለህ፤ ኃይልና ብርታት በእጅህ ነው፤ ታላቅ ለማድረግ፥ ለሁሉም ኃይልን ለመስጠት በእጅህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እንግዲህ፥ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ እንገዛልሃለን፥ ለክቡር ስምህም ምስጋና እናቀርባለን።

verses.text_english: But who I, and what my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና፥ ከእጅህም የተቀበልነውን ሰጥተንሃልና ይህን ያህል ችለን ልናቀርብልህ እኔ ማን ነኝ? ሕዝቤስ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: For we strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers: our days on the earth as a shadow, and none abiding.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችንም ሁሉ እንደነበሩ እኛ በፊትህ ስደተኞችና መጻተኞች ነን፤ ዘመናችንም በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ናት፥ አትጸናም።

verses.text_english: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name of thine hand, and all thine own.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ለቅዱስ ስምህ ቤት እንሠራ ዘንድ ይህ ያዘጋጀነው ባለጠግነት ሁሉ ከእጅህ የመጣ ነው፥ ሁሉም የአንተ ነው።

verses.text_english: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ልብን እንድትመረምር፥ ቅንነትንም እንድትወድድ አውቃለሁ፤ እኔም በልቤ ቅንነትና በፈቃዴ ይህን ሁሉ አቅርቤአለሁ፤ አሁንም በዚህ ያለው ሕዝብህ በፈቃዱ እንዳቀረበልህ በደስታ አይቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የአባቶቻችን የአብርሃምና የይስሐቅ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ሆይ፥ ይህን አሳብ በሕዝብህ ልብ ለዘላለም ጠብቅ፥ ልባቸውንም ወደ አንተ አቅና።

verses.text_english: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all , and to build the palace, the which I have made provision.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝህንም ምስክርህንም ሥርዓትህንም ይጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ ይህንም ነገር ሁሉ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ያዘጋጀሁለትንም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ለልጄ ለሰሎሞን ፍጹም ልብ ስጠው።

verses.text_english: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ጉባኤውን ሁሉ። አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ አላቸው። ጉባኤውም ሁሉ የአባታቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ባረኩ፥ ራሳቸውንም አዘንብለው ለእግዚአብሔርና ለንጉሡ ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር አቀረቡ፤ አንድ ሺህ ወይፈን፥ አንድ ሺህም አውራ በጎች፥ አንድ ሺህም የበግ ጠቦቶች፥ የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውንም፥ ስለ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ብዙ መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed unto the LORD the chief governor, and Zadok priest.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በታላቅ ደስታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሉ ጠጡም። የዳዊትንም ልጅ ሰሎሞንን ሁለተኛ ጊዜ አነገሡት፤ እርሱንም አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር ቀቡት፥ ሳዶቅንም ካህን ይሆን ዘንድ ቀቡት።

verses.text_english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በአባቱ በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ተከናወነለትም፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ታዘዙለት።

verses.text_english: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹም ሁሉ፥ ኃያላኑም፥ ደግሞም የንጉሡ የዳዊት ልጆች ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እጅ ሰጡት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ፊት እጅግ አገነነው፤ ከእርሱ በፊትም ለነበሩት ለእስራኤል ነገሥታት ያልሆነውን የመንግሥት ክብር ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእሴይም ልጅ ዳዊት በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And the time that he reigned over Israel forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤልም ላይ የነገሠበት ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ፤ ሰባት ዓመት በኬብሮን ነገሠ፥ ሠላሳ ሦስትም ዓመት በኢየሩሳሌም ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ዕድሜም፥ ባለጠግነትም፥ ክብርም ጠግቦ በመልካም ሽምግልና ሞተ፤ ልጁም ሰሎሞን በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡም የዳዊት የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በባለ ራእዩ በሳሙኤል ታሪክ፥ በነቢዩም በናታን ታሪክ፥ በባለ ራእዩም በጋድ ታሪክ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚሁም የመንግሥቱ ነገርና ኃይሉ ሁሉ በእርሱም በእስራኤልም በአገሮችም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ያለፉት ዘመናት ተጽፈዋል።

verses.text_english: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊት ልጅ ሰሎሞን በመንግሥቱ በረታ፤ አምላኩም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥ እጅግም አገነነው።

verses.text_english: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ለእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ለሻለቆች፥ ለመቶ አለቆችም፥ ለፈራጆችም፥ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ዘንድ ለነበሩ መሳፍንት ሁሉ፥ ለአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ከእርሱም ጋር ጉባኤው ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ የሠራው የእግዚአብሔር መገናኛ ድንኳን በዚያ ነበረና በገባዖን ወዳለው የኮረብታ መስገጃ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ግን ዳዊት በኢየሩሳሌም ድንኳን ተክሎለት ነበርና ዳዊት ከቂርያትይዓሪም ወዳዘጋጀለት ስፍራ አምጥቶት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.text_amharic: የሆርም ልጅ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤል የሠራው የናስ መሠዊያ በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት ነበረ፤ ሰሎሞንም ጉባኤውም ይህን ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመገናኛው ድንኳን አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ ናሱ መሠዊያ ወጣ፥ በዚያም አንድ ሺህ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።

verses.text_english: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር። ምን እንድሰጥህ ለምነኝ ሲል ለሰሎሞን ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር ታላቅ ምሕረት አድርገሃል፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ አንግሠኸኛል።

verses.text_english: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ቍጥሩ እንደ ምድር ትቢያ በሆነው በብዙ ሕዝብ ላይ አንግሠኸኛልና ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸው ተስፋ ይጽና።

verses.text_english: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, great?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት እወጣና እገባ ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ስጠኝ፤ ይህን በሚያህል በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብ ላይ ይፈርድ ዘንድ የሚችል የለምና።

verses.text_english: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን። ይህ በልብህ ነበረና፥ ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንና የጠላቶችህን ነፍስ ረጅምም ዕድሜን አልለመንህምና፥ ነገር ግን ባነገሥሁህ በሕዝቤ ላይ ለመፍረድ ትችል ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ለራስህ ለምነሃልና ጥበብንና እውቀትን ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Wisdom and knowledge granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ በፊትም ከነበሩት ከአንተም በኋላ ከሚነሡት ነገሥታት አንድ ስንኳ የሚመስልህ እንዳይኖር ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንም እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Solomon came to the high place that at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በገባዖን ካለው ከኮረብታው መስገጃ ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ሰረገሎቹንና ፈረሰኞችን ሰበሰበ፥ አንድ ሺህም አራት መቶ ሰረገሎች፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፤ በሰረገሎች ከተሞችና ከእርሱ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that in the vale for abundance.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ብሩንና ወርቁን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ፈረሶችን ከግብጽና ከቀዌ አስመጣ፤ የንጉሡም ነጋዴዎች በገንዘብ እየገዙ ከቀዌ ያመጡአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ሰረገላ በስድስት መቶ፥ አንዱም ፈረስ በመቶ አምሳ ሰቅል ብር ከግብጽ ይወጣ ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያንና ለሶሪያ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእጃቸው ያመጡላቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት፥ ለመንግሥቱም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የሚሸከሙትን ሰባ ሺህ፥ ከተራሮችም የሚጠርቡትን ሰማኒያ ሺህ፥ በእነርሱም ላይ የተሾሙትን ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ቈጠረ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, .
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም እንዲህ ሲል ወደ ጢሮስ ንጉሥ ወደ ኪራም ላከ። ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር እንዳደረግህ፥ የሚቀመጥበትንም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የዝግባ እንጨት እንደ ሰደድህለት፥ እንዲሁ ለእኔ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate to him, to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This for ever to Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ለእስራኤል ለዘላለም እንደ ታዘዘው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የጣፋጩን ሽቱ ለማጠን፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት ለማኖር፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በጥዋትና በማታ በሰንበታቱም በመባቻዎቹም በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር በዓላት ለማቅረብ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት እሠራና እቀድስ ዘንድ አሰብሁ።

verses.text_english: And the house which I build great: for great our God above all gods.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ታላቅ ነውና የምሠራው ቤት ታላቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሰማይና ከሰማያት በላይ ያለ ሰማይ ይይዘው ዘንድ አይችልምና ለእርሱ ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል? በፊቱ ዕጣን ከማጠን በቀር ቤት እሠራለት ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነኝ?

verses.text_english: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አባቴ ዳዊት ካዘጋጃቸው በእኔ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ካሉት ብልሃተኞች ጋር የሚሆን፥ ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ናሱንና ብረቱን፥ ሐምራዊውንና ቀዩን ሰማያዊውንም ግምጃ የሚሠራ፥ ቅርጽንም የሚያውቅ ብልሃተኛ ሰው ላክልኝ።

verses.text_english: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants with thy servants,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ባሪያዎችህ ከሊባኖስ እንጨት መቍረጥ እንዲያውቁ እኔ አውቃለሁና ከሊባኖስ የዝግባና የጥድ የሰንደልም እንጨት ስደድልኝ።

verses.text_english: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build wonderful great.
verses.text_amharic: የምሠራውም ቤት እጅግ ታላቅና ድንቅ ይሆናልና ብዙ እንጨት ያዘጋጁልኝ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ እንጨቱን ለሚቈርጡ ለባሪያዎችህ ሀያ ሺህ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የተበጠረ ስንዴ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ገብስ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የወይን ጠጅ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ዘይት እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.text_amharic: የጢሮስ ንጉሥም ኪራም። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ወድዶአልና በላያቸው አነገሠህ ብሎ ለሰሎሞን መልእክት ላከ።

verses.text_english: Huram said moreover, Blessed the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም ደግሞ አለ። ሰማይንና ምድርን የፈጠረ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለመንግሥቱም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ጥበበኛና ብልሃተኛ አስተዋይም ልጅ ለንጉሡ ለዳዊት የሰጠ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከብልሃተኞችህ ጋር ከጌታዬም ከአባትህ ከዳዊት ብልሃተኞች ጋር ይሆን ዘንድ ኪራምአቢ የሚባል ብልሃተኛና አስተዋይ ሰው ሰድጄልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
verses.text_amharic: እናቱ ከዳን ልጆች ናት፥ አባቱም የጢሮስ ሰው ነው፤ ወርቁንና ብሩንም፥ ናሱንና ብረቱን፥ ድንጋይንና እንጨቱን፥ ሐምራዊውንና ሰማያዊውን ቀዩንም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩውንም በፍታ ይሠራ ዘንድ፥ ቅርጽም ሌላም ነገር ሁሉ ያደርግ ዘንድ ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ጌታዬ የተናገረውን ስንዴውንና ገብሱን ዘይቱንና የወይን ጠጁን ወደ ባሪያዎቹ ይስደድ፤

verses.text_english: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም ከሊባኖስ የምትሻውን ያህል እንጨት እንቈርጣለን፥ በታንኳም አድርገን በባሕር ላይ ወደ አንተ ወደ ኢዮጴ እንሰድዳለን፤ አንተም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ታስወስደዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በእስራኤል ምድር የነበሩትን መጻተኞች ሁሉ አባቱ ዳዊት እንደ ቈጠራቸው ቈጠረ፤ መቶ አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ተገኙ።

verses.text_english: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የሚሸከሙትን ሰባ ሺህ፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የሚጠርቡትን ሰማንያ ሺህ፥ በሕዝቡም ሥራ ላይ የተሾሙትን ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔር ለአባቱ ለዳዊት በተገለጠበት በሞሪያ ተራራ ዳዊት ባዘጋጀው ስፍራ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ በኢየሩሳሌም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: And he began to build in the second of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.text_amharic: በነገሠም በአራተኛው ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር መሥራት ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: Now these Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የጣለው መሠረት ይህ ነው፤ ርዝመቱም በዱሮው ስፍር ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the porch that in the front , the length according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም ፊት የነበረው ወለል ርዝመቱ እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም መቶ ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውስጡንም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.text_english: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቁንም ቤት በጥድ እንጨት ከደነው፥ በጥሩም ወርቅ ለበጠው፤ የዘንባባና የሰንሰለት አምሳል ቀረጸበት።

verses.text_english: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold gold of Parvaim.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም በዕንቍ አስጌጠው፤ ወርቁንም የፈርዋይም ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱንም ሰረገሎቹንም መድረኮቹንም ግንቦቹንም ደጆቹንም በወርቅ ለበጠ፤ በግንቦቹም ላይ ኪሩቤልን ቀረጸ።

verses.text_english: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, to six hundred talents.
verses.text_amharic: ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑንም ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ስድስት መቶ መክሊት በሚያህል በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.text_english: And the weight of the nails fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.text_amharic: የምስማሮቹም ሚዛን አምሳ ሰቅል ወርቅ ነበረ። የደርቡንም ጓዳዎች በወርቅ ለበጠ።

verses.text_english: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ውስጥ ከእንጨት ሥራ ሁለቱ ኪሩቤልን ሠራ፥ በወርቅም ለበጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the wings of the cherubims twenty cubits long: one wing five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.text_amharic: የኪሩቤልም ክንፎች ሀያ ክንድ ሙሉ ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ የአንዱ ኪሩብ ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የቤቱንም ግንብ ይነካ ነበረ፤ ሁለተኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሁለተኛውንም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ይነካ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And wing of the other cherub five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing five cubits , joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የቤቱንም ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፤ ሁለተኛውም ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሌላውንም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ይነካ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces inward.
verses.text_amharic: የእነዚህም ኪሩቤል ክንፎች ሀያ ክንድ ሙሉ ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ በእግራቸውም ቆመው ነበር፥ ፊቶቻቸውም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he made the vail blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማያዊውም ከሐምራዊውም ከቀዩም ሐር ከጥሩም በፍታ መጋረጃውን ሠራ፥ ኪሩቤልንም ጠለፈበት።

verses.text_english: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that on the top of each of them five cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም ፊት ቁመታቸው ሠላሳ አምስት ክንድ የነበረውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች ሠራ፥ በእያንዳንዳቸውም ላይ የነበረው ጕልላት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he made chains, in the oracle, and put on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put on the chains.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ድሪ ያሉ ሰንሰለቶችንም ሠርቶ በአዕማዱ ራስ ላይ አደረጋቸው፤ መቶም ሮማኖች ሠርቶ በሰንሰለቱ ላይ አደረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.text_amharic: አዕማዶቹንም አንደኛውን በቀኝ፥ ሁለተኛውን በግራ በመቅደሱ ፊት አቆማቸው፤ በቀኝም የነበረውን ስም ያቁም በግራም የነበረውን ስም በለዝ ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ርዝመቱ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አሥር ክንድ የነበረውን የናሱን መሠዊያ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሰሰም ናስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር አሥር ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ፥ በዙሪያውም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ ክብ ኵሬ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And under it the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen cast, when it was cast.
verses.text_amharic: በበታቹም ለአንድ ክንድ አሥር፥ ለአንድም ክንድ አሥር፥ ጕብጕቦች አዞረበት፤ ኵሬውም በቀለጠ ጊዜ ጕብጕቦቹ በሁለት ተራ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ቀልጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea above upon them, and all their hinder parts inward.
verses.text_amharic: በአሥራ ሁለትም በሬዎች ምስል ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ሦስቱ ወደ ሰሜን ሦስቱም ወደ ምዕራብ ሦስቱም ወደ ደቡብ ሦስቱም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ ኵሬውም በላያቸው ነበር፥ የሁሉም ጀርባቸው በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the thickness of it an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.text_amharic: ውፍረቱም አንድ ጋት ያህል ነበረ፤ ከንፈሩም አንደ ጽዋ ከንፈር፥ እንደ ሱፍ አበባ ሆኖ ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ሦስት ሺህም የባዶስ መሥፈሪያ ይይዝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea for the priests to wash in.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አሥር የመታጠቢያ ሰኖች ሠራ፥ ለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት የሚቀርበው ነገር ሁሉ ይታጠብባቸው ዘንድ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ አኖራቸው፤ ኵሬው ግን ካህናት ይታጠቡበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.text_amharic: አሥሩንም መቅረዞች እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ከወርቅ ሠርቶ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: He made also ten tables, and placed in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.text_amharic: አሥሩንም ገበታዎች ሠርቶ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው። አንድ መቶም የወርቅ ድስቶች ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም የካህናቱን አደባባይ፥ ታላቁንም አደባባይ፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጆች ሠራ፥ ደጆቻቸውንም በናስ ለበጠ።

verses.text_english: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.text_amharic: ኵሬውንም በቤቱ ቀኝ በአዜብ በኩል አኖረው።

verses.text_english: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.text_amharic: ኪራምም ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎቹን ድስቶቹንም ሠራ። ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።

verses.text_english: , the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which on the top of the pillars;
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱን አዕማድ፥ ጽዋዎቹንም፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለት ጕልላቶች፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን የጕልላቶች ሁለቱን ጽዋዎች የሚሸፍኑትን ሁለቱን መርበቦች ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which upon the pillars.
verses.text_amharic: በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ፥ ለእያንዳንዱ መርበብ ሁለት ሁለት ተራ ሮማኖች፥ ለሁለቱ መርበቦች አራት መቶ ሮማኖች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.text_amharic: መቀመጫዎቹንና በመቀመጫዎቹ ላይ የሚቀመጡትን የመታጠቢያ ሰኖች፥

verses.text_english: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ በበታቹም የሚሆኑትን አሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ሠራ።

verses.text_english: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
verses.text_amharic: ምንቸቶቹንም መጫሪያዎቹንም ሜንጦዎቹንም ዕቃቸውንም ሁሉ ኪራም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ከለስላሳ ናስ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በዮርዳኖስ ሜዳ በሱኮትና በጽሬዳ መካከል ባለው በወፍራሙ መሬት ውስጥ አስፈሰሰው።

verses.text_english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም እነዚህን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ እጅግ አብዝቶ ሠራ፤ የናሱም ሚዛን አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Solomon made all the vessels that the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread ;
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን ዕቃ ሁሉ የወርቁንም መሠዊያ፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት የነበረባቸውን ገበታዎች፥

verses.text_english: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ያበሩ ዘንድ መቅረዞችንና ቀንዲሎቻቸውን ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, gold, that perfect gold;
verses.text_amharic: አበባዎቹንና ቀንዲሎቹን መኮስተሪያዎቹንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy , and the doors of the house of the temple, gold.
verses.text_amharic: ጕጦቹንም ድስቶቹንም ጭልፋዎቹንም ማንደጃዎቹንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ። የውስጠኛውም ቤት የቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ደጆች የቤተ መቅደሱም ደጆች የወርቅ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ሰሎሞን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ተጨረሰ። አባቱም ዳዊት የቀደሰውን የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ ሁሉ ሰሎሞን አምጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በነበረው ግምጃ ቤት አኖረው።

verses.text_english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which Zion.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ከዳዊት ከተማ ከጽዮን ያወጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎችና የነገድ አለቆች ሁሉ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አባቶች ቤቶች መሳፍንት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which in the seventh month.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ በሰባተኛው ወር በበዓሉ ጊዜ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ተከማቹ።

verses.text_english: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ፥ ሌዋውያንም ታቦቱን አነሡ።

verses.text_english: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that in the tabernacle, these did the priests the Levites bring up.
verses.text_amharic: ታቦቱንም የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን በድኳኑም ውስጥ የነበረውን የተቀደሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አመጡ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ አመጡ።

verses.text_english: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰበሰቡ የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ በታቦቱ ፊት ሆነው ከብዛት የተነሣ የማይቈጠሩትንና የማይመጠኑትን በጎችና በሬዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ወደ ቤቱ አምጥተው በቅድስት ቅዱሳን ውስጥ ከኪሩቤል ክንፍ በታች በነበረው በስፍራው አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: For the cherubims spread forth wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.text_amharic: ኪሩቤልም በታቦቱ ስፍራ ላይ ክንፎቻቸውን ዘርግተው ነበር፥ ኪሩቤልም ታቦቱንና መሎጊያዎቹን በስተ ላዩ በኩል ይሸፍኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: መሎጊያዎቹም ረጃጅሞች ነበሩና በቅዱስተ ቅዱሳን ፊት ከመቅደሱ ውስጥ ጫፎቻቸው ይታዩ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ከውጪ አይታዩም ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እዚያ አሉ።

verses.text_english: nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put at Horeb, when the LORD made with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በታቦቱም ውስጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ባደረገ ጊዜ ሙሴ በኮሬብ ካስቀመጣቸው ከሁለቱ ጽላቶች በቀር ምንም አልነበረበትም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy : (for all the priests present were sanctified, did not wait by course:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የነበሩት ካህናት ሁሉ ተቀድሰው ነበር፥ በሰሞናቸውም አልተከፈሉም ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Also the Levites the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
verses.text_amharic: መዘምራንም የነበሩት ሌዋውያን ሁሉ፥ አሳፍና ኤማን ኤዶታምም ልጆቻቸውም ወንድሞቻቸውም፥ ጥሩ በፍታ ለብሰው ጸናጽልና በገና መሰንቆም እየመቱ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ በመሥራቅ በኩል ቆመው ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር መቶ ሀያ ካህናት መለከት ይነፉ ነበር። ካህናቱም ከመቅደሱ በወጡ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, , For good; for his mercy for ever: that the house was filled with a cloud, the house of the LORD;
verses.text_amharic: መለከቱንም የሚነፉ መዘምራኑም በአንድነት ሆነው እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ። እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ እያሉ በአንድ ቃል ድምፃቸውን ወደ ላይ ከፍ አድገው በመለከትና በጸናጽል በዜማም ዕቃ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ባመሰገኑ ጊዜ፥ ደመናው የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞላው።

verses.text_english: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበርና ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ መቆምና ማገልገል አልተቻላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም። እግዚአብሔር። በጨለማ ውስጥ እኖራለሁ ብሎአል፤

verses.text_english: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ለዘላለም ትኖርበት ዘንድ ማደሪያ ቤትን ሠራሁልህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ፊቱን ዘወር አድርጎ የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ መረቀ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said, Blessed the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። ለአባቴ ለዳዊት በአፉ የተናገረ በእጁም የፈጸመ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ፤

verses.text_english: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሕዝቤን ከግብጽ ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ ስሜ የሚጠራበት ቤት በዚያ ይሠራልኝ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ማንኛውንም ከተማ አልመረጥሁም፤ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ማንንም አልመረጥሁም፤

verses.text_english: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ስሜ በዚያ እንዲጠራባት ኢየሩሳሌምን መርጫለሁ፥ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ እንዲሆን ዳዊትን መርጫለሁ ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አባቴም ዳዊት ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ በልቡ አስቦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አባቴን ዳዊትን። ለስሜ ቤት ትሠራ ዘንድ በልብህ አስበሃልና ይህን በልብህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከወገብህ የሚወጣው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤትን ይሠራል እንጂ ቤት የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም አለው።

verses.text_english: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረውን ቃል ፈጸመ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠ በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ ተነሣሁ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ሠራሁ።

verses.text_english: And in it have I put the ark, wherein the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ጋር ያደረገው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ያለበትን ታቦት በዚያው ውስጥ አኖርሁ።

verses.text_english: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ወይም በምድር አንተን የሚመስል አምላክ የለም፤ በፍጹም ልባቸው በፊትህ ለሚሄዱ ባሪያዎችህ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥

verses.text_english: And said, O LORD God of Israel, no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸውን ተስፋ የጠበቀህ፤ በአፍህ ተናገርህ፥ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው በእጅህ ፈጸምኸው።

verses.text_english: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled with thine hand, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ። አንተ በፊቴ እንደ ሄድህ ልጆችህ በሕጌ ይሄዱ ዘንድ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ በእስራኤል ዙፋን የሚቀመጥ ሰው በፊቴ አታጣም ብለህ ተስፋ የሰጠኸውን ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለባሪያህ ለዳዊት የተናገረኸው ቃል ይጽና።

verses.text_english: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ጋር በምድር ላይ ይኖራልን? እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ከሰማያትም በላይ ያለ ሰማይ ይይዝህ ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ይልቁንስ እኔ የሠራሁት ቤት እንዴት ያንስ ይሆን?

verses.text_english: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያህ ጸሎትና ልመና ተመልከት፥ ባሪያህም በፊትህ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎትና ጥሪውን ስማ።

verses.text_english: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ። በዚያ ስሜ ይሆናል ወዳልኸው ስፍራ፥ ወደዚህ ቤት ዓይኖችህ ቀንና ሌሊት የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህና ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልዩትን ልመና ስማ፤ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ ሰምተህም ይቅር በል።

verses.text_english: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ባልንጀራውን ቢበድል፥ በላዩም መሐላ ቢጫን፥ እርሱም መጥቶ በዚህ ቤት በመሠዊያህ ፊት ቢምል፥

verses.text_english: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይ ስማ፥ አድርግም፥ በባሪያዎችህም ላይ ዳኛ ሁን፥ በበደለኛውም ላይ ፍረድ፥ መንገዱንም በራሱ ላይ መልስበት፤ ንጹሑንም አጽድቀው፥ እንደ ጽድቁም ክፈለው።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህም እስራኤል አንተን ስለ በደሉ በጠላት ፊት ድል ተመትተው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ በዚህም ቤት በፊትህ ቢጸልዩና ቢለምኑህ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፥

verses.text_english: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝብህንም የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፤ ለእነርሱም ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጥሃት ምድር መልሳቸው።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ስለ በደሉ ሰማያት በተዘጉ ጊዜ ዝናብም ባልዘነበ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚህ ስፍራ ቢጸልዩ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ ባስጨነቅሃቸውም ጊዜ ከኃጢአታቸው ቢመለሱ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፥

verses.text_english: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎችህንና የሕዝብህን የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፥ የሚሄዱበትንም መልካም መንገድ አሳያቸው፤ ለሕዝብህም ርስት አድርገህ ለሰጠሃት ምድር ዝናብን ስጥ።

verses.text_english: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ራብ ወይም ቸነፈር ወይም ዋግ ወይም አረማሞ ወይም አንበጣ ወይም ኩብኩባ ቢሆን፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም የአገሩን ከተሞች ከብበው ቢያስጨንቁአቸው፥ ማናቸውም መቅሠፍትና ደዌ ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness :
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሰው ወይም ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ማናቸውም ሰው ሕመሙንና ኀዘኑን አውቆ ጸሎትና ልመና ቢያደርግ እጆቹንም ወደዚህ ቤት ቢዘረጋ፥

verses.text_english: what prayer what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብህም ከእስራኤል ያልሆነ እንግዳ ስለ ታላቁ ስምህ ስለ ብርቱውም እጅህ ስለ ተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ከሩቅ አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ መጥቶም ወደዚህ ቤት በጸለየ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደ ተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህም ጠላቶቻቸውን ለመውጋት አንተ በምትልካቸው መንገድ ቢወጡ፥ አንተም ወደ መረጥሃት ወደዚህች ከተማ እኔም ለስምህ ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ለአንተ ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.text_english: Then hear thou from the heavens, from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው።

verses.text_english: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
verses.text_amharic: የማይበድል ሰው የለምና አንተን ቢበድሉ፥ ተቈጥተህም ለጠላት አሳልፈህ ብትሰጣቸው፥ ሩቅም ወይም ቅርብ ወደ ሆነ አገር ቢማርኩአቸው፥

verses.text_english: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.text_amharic: በተማረኩበትም አገር ሆነው በልባቸው ንስሐ ቢገቡ፥ በምርኮአቸውም አገር ሳሉ ተመልሰው። ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፥ በድለንማል፥ ክፉም አድርገናል ብለው ቢለምኑህ፥

verses.text_english: If they sin against thee, (for no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.text_amharic: በተማረኩበትም በምርኮአቸው አገር ሳሉ በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠሃት ወደ ምድራቸው ወደ መረጥሃትም ከተማ ለስምህም ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.text_english: Yet they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
