verses.text_english: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝቡም ጋር ተማክሮ በሠራዊቱ ፊት የሚሄዱትን። ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚሉትንም፥ ጌጠኛ ልብስም ለብሰው የሚያመሰግኑትን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚዘምሩትን መዘምራን አቆመ።

verses.text_english: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
verses.text_amharic: ዝማሬውንና ምስጋናውንም በጀመሩ ጊዜ ይሁዳን ሊወጉ በመጡት በአሞንና በሞዓብ ልጆች በሴይርም ተራራ ሰዎች ላይ እግዚአብሔር ድብቅ ጦርን አመጣባቸው፤ እነርሱም ተመቱ።

verses.text_english: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy : and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንና የሞዓብ ልጆችም በሴይር ተራራ በሚኖሩት ላይ ፈጽመው ይገድሉአቸው ዘንድ ያጠፉአቸውም ዘንድ ተነሥተውባቸው ነበር፤ በሴይርም የሚኖሩትን ካጠፉ በኋላ እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራውን ለማጥፋት ተረዳዳ።

verses.text_english: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ወደ ምድረ በዳ ግንብ በመጡ ጊዜ ሕዝቡን አዩ፤ እነሆም፥ በምድሩ ሁሉ ሬሳ ሞልቶ ነበር፥ ያመለጠም ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥና ሕዝቡም ምርኮ ይወስዱ ዘንድ መጡ ብዙ ከብትና ልዩ ልዩ ዕቃም፥ ልብስም፥ እጅግም ያማረ ዕቃ አገኙ፥ በዘበዙትም፥ ሁሉንም ይሸከሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤ ከምርኮውም ብዛት የተነሣ እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ይበዘብዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ቀን በበረከት ሸለቆ ውስጥ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በዚያም እግዚአብሔርን ባረኩ፤ ስለዚህም ያ ስፍራ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የበረከት ሸለቆ ተባለ።

verses.text_english: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች፥ በፊታቸውም ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶቻቸው ላይ ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና በደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በበገናም በመሰንቆም በመለከትም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ጠላቶች እንደ ወጋ በሰሙ ጊዜ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
verses.text_amharic: የኢዮሣፍጥም መንግሥት ጸጥ አለች፥ አምላኩም በዙሪያው ካሉ አሳረፈው።

verses.text_english: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ፤ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜም የሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የሺልሒ ልጅ ዓዙባ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በአባቱም በአሳ መንገድ ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አላለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና ልባቸውን ወደ አባቶቻቸው አምላክ አላዘጋጁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው የኢዮሣፍጥ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ውስጥ በሚገኘው በአናኒ ልጅ በኢዩ ታሪክ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ሥራው እጅግ ክፉ ከሆነ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከአካዝያስ ጋር ተባበረ።

verses.text_english: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ተርሴስም የሚሄዱትን መርከቦች ያሠሩ ዘንድ አንድ ሆኑ፤ መርከቦቹንም በዔጽዮንጋብር አሠሩ።

verses.text_english: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.text_amharic: የመሪሳም ሰው የዶዳያ ልጅ አልዓዛር። ከአካዝያስ ጋር ተባብረሃልና እግዚአብሔር ሥራህን አፍርሶታል ብሎ በኢዮሣፍጥ ላይ ትንቢት ተናገረ። መርከቦቹም ተሰበሩ፥ ወደ ተርሴስም ይሄዱ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኢዮራም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ዓዛርያስ፥ ይሒኤል፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ዔዛርያስ፥ ሚካኤል፥ ሰፋጥያስ የሚባሉ ወንድሞች ነበሩት፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he the firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: አባታቸውም ብዙ ስጦታ፥ ብርና ወርቅ፥ የከበረም ዕቃ፥ በይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ሰጣቸው፤ መንግሥቱን ግን በኵር ልጁ ስለ ሆነ ለኢዮራም ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and also of the princes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮራምም በአባቱ መንግሥት ላይ ተነሥቶ በጸና ጊዜ ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ ሌሎችንም የእስራኤልን መሳፍንት በሰይፍ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: Jehoram thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮራምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የአክአብንም ልጅ አግብቶ ነበርና የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከዳዊት ጋር ስላደረገው ቃል ኪዳን፥ ለእርሱና ለልጆቹም በዘመናት ሁሉ መብራት ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስለ ሰጠው ተስፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር የዳዊትን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ዘመን ኤዶምያስ በይሁዳ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ ለራሱም ንጉሥ አነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮራምም ከአለቆቹና ከሰረገሎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ተሻገረ፤ በሌሊትም ተነሥቶ እርሱንና የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች ከብበው የነበሩትን የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች መታ።

verses.text_english: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስ ግን በይሁዳ ላይ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዐመፀ፥ በዚያንም ዘመን ልብና ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ የአባቶቹን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትቶ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah .
verses.text_amharic: ዳግምም በይሁዳ ተራሮች ላይ መስገጃዎችን ሠራ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የተቀመጡትን እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረጋቸው፥ ይሁዳንም አሳተው።

verses.text_english: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.text_amharic: ከነቢዩም ከኤልያስ እንዲህ የሚል ጽሕፈት መጣባት። የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአባትህ በኢዮሣፍጥ መንገድ በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ መንገድ አልሄድህምና፥

verses.text_english: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, better than thyself:
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ግን ሄደሃልና፥ የአክዓብም ቤት እንዳደረገ ይሁዳንና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን እንዲያመነዝሩ አድርገሃልና፥ ከአንተም የሚሻሉትን የአባትህን ቤት ወንድሞችህን ገድለሃልና፥

verses.text_english: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝብህንና ልጆችህን ሚስቶችህንም ያለህንም ሁሉ በታላቅ መቅሠፍት ይቀሥፋል።

verses.text_english: And thou great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ከደዌው ጽናት የተነሣ አንጀትህ በየዕለቱ እስኪወጣ ድረስ በክፉ የአንጀት ደዌ ትታመማለህ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that near the Ethiopians:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የፍልስጥኤማውያንና በኢትዮጵያውያን አጠገብ የሚኖሩትን የዓረባውያንን መንፈስ በኢዮራም ላይ አስነሣ።

verses.text_english: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ይሁዳም ወጡ፥ አፈረሱአትም፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ ወንዶች ልጆቹንም ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ማረኩ፤ ከታናሹም ልጅ ከአካዝያስ በቀር ልጅ አልቀረለትም።

verses.text_english: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር በማይፈወስ ደዌ አንጀቱን ቀሰፈው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀንም ወደ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከሁለት ዓመት በኋላ ከደዌው ጽናት የተነሣ አንጀቱ ወጣ፥ በክፉም ደዌ ሞተ። ሕዝቡም ለአባቶቹ ያደርገው እንደ ነበር ለእርሱ የመቃብር ወግ አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.text_amharic: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ ማንም ሳያዝንለት ሄደ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ እንጂ በነገሥታት መቃብር አልቀበሩትም።

verses.text_english: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩትም ታናሹን ልጁን አካዝያስን በእርሱ ፋንታ አነገሡት። የመጣባቸው የዓረብና የአሊማዞን የሽፍቶች ጭፍራ የእርሱን ታላቆች ገድለዋቸው ነበርና። የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Forty and two years old Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ ዕድሜው አርባ ሁለት ዓመት ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ጎቶሊያ የተባለች የዘንበሪ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
verses.text_amharic: እናቱም ክፉ ለማድረግ ትመክረው ነበርና እርሱ ደግሞ በአክዓብ ቤት መንገድ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ከሞተ በኋላ የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ መካሪዎች ነበሩትና።

verses.text_english: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
verses.text_amharic: በምክራቸውም ሄደ፥ ከእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ከአክዓብ ልጅ ከኢዮራም ጋር የሶርያን ንጉሥ አዛሄልን በሬማት ዘገለአድ ሊዋጋ ሄደ፤ ሶርያውያንም ኢዮራንም አቈሰሉት።

verses.text_english: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.text_amharic: ከሶርያም ንጉሥ ከአዛሄል ጋር በተዋጋ ጊዜ ሶርያውያን በሬማት ያቈሰሉትን ቍስል ይታከም ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ተመለሰ፤ ታምሞም ነበርና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ የአክዓብን ልጅ ኢዮራምን ያይ ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝያስም ወደ ኢዮራም በመምጣቱ ይጠፋ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበረ፤ በመጣም ጊዜ ከኢዮራም ጋር እግዚአብሔር የአክዓብን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ ወደ ቀባው ወደ ናሜሲ ልጅ ወደ ኢዩ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዩም በአክዓብ ቤት ላይ ፍርድን ሲፈጽም የይሁዳን መሳፍንትና አካዝያስን ያገለግሉ የነበሩትን የአካዝያስን ወንድሞች ልጆች አግኝቶ ገደላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝያስንም ፈለገው፥ በሰማርያ ተሸሽጎ ሳለ አገኙት፤ ወደ ኢዩም አምጥተው ገደሉትና። በፍጹም ልብ እግዚአብሔርን የፈለገው የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ ነው ብለው ቀበሩት። ከአካዝያስም ቤት ማንም መንግሥትን ይይዝ ዘንድ የሚችል አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የአካዝያስም እናት ጎቶሊያ ልጅዋ እንደ ሞተ ባየች ጊዜ ተነሥታ የይሁዳን ቤተ መንግሥት ዘር ሁሉ አጠፋች።

verses.text_english: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡ ልጅ ዮሳቤት ግን ከተገደሉት ከንጉሡ ልጆች መካከል የአካዝያስን ልጅ ኢዮአስን ሰርቃ ወሰደች፤ እርሱንና ሞግዚቱን በእልፍኝ ውስጥ አኖረቻቸው፤ ጎቶሊያ እንዳታስገድለው የንጉሡ የኢዮራም ልጅ የአካዛያስ እኅት የካህኑ የዮዳሄ ሚስት ዮሳቤት እንዲሁ ሸሸገችው።

verses.text_english: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም ዘንድ ተሸሽጎ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስድስት ዓመት ያህል ተቀመጠ፤ ጎቶልያም በምድር ላይ ነገሠች።

verses.text_english: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ዓመት ዮዳሄ በረታ፥ የመቶ አለቆቹንም፥ የይሮሐምን ልጅ ዓዛርያስን፥ የይሆሐናንንም ልጅ ይስማኤልን፥ የዖቤድንም ልጅ ዓዛርያስን፥ የዓዳያንም ልጅ መዕሤያን፥ የዝክሪንም ልጅ ኤሊሳፋጥን ወስዶ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳንም ዞሩ፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ሌዋውያንንና የእስራኤልን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ሰብስበው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ከንጉሥ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ። ዮዳሄም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ዳዊት ልጆች እንደተናገረ የንጉሡ ልጅ ይነግሣል።

verses.text_english: This the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, porters of the doors;
verses.text_amharic: የምታደርጉት ይህ ነው፤ በሰንበት ቀን ከምትገቡት ከእናንተ ከካህናትና ከሌዋዊውያን ከሦስት አንድ እጅ በመግቢያ በሮች በረኞች ሁኑ፤

verses.text_english: And a third part at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people in the courts of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት አንድ እጅም በንጉሥ ቤት ሁኑ፤ አንድ እጅም በመካከለኛው በር ሁኑ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: But let none come into the house of the LORD, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ግን ከካህናትና ከአገልጋዮቹ ሌዋውያን በቀር ማንም አይግባ፤ እነርሱ ቅዱሳን ናቸውና ይግቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ይጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንም የጦር መሣሪያቸውን በእጃቸው ይዘው ንጉሡን በዙሪያው ይክበቡት፤ ወደ ቤቱም የሚገባ ይገደል ንጉሡም ሲገባና ሲወጣ ከእርሱ ጋር ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንና ይሁዳም ሁሉ ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ፤ ካህኑም ዮዳሄ ሰሞነኞቹን አላሰናበተም ነበርና እያንዳንዱ በሰንበት ቀን ይገቡ የነበሩትን በሰንበትም ቀን ይወጡ የነበሩትን ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that king David's, which in the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን የንጉሡን የዳዊትን ጋሻና ጦር አላባሽ አግሬውንም ጋሻ ለመቶ አለቆች ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የጦር መሣሪያውን በእጁ እየያዘ በንጉሡ ዙሪያ ከቤቱ ቀኝ እስከ ቤቱ ግራ ድረስ በመሠዊያውና በቤቱ አጠገብ እንዲቆም አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡንም ልጅ አውጥተው ዘውዱን ጫኑበት፥ ምስክሩንም ሰጡት፥ አነገሡትም፤ ዮዳሄና ልጆቹም። ንጉሡ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ እያሉ ቀቡት።

verses.text_english: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ጎቶሊያም የሚሮጡትንና ንጉሡን የሚያመሰግኑትን የሕዝቡን ድምፅ በሰማች ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መጣች።

verses.text_english: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ንጉሡ በመግቢያው በዓምዱ አጠገብ ሆኖ ከንጉሡ ጋር አለቆችና መለከተኞች ቆመው አየች። የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው መለከቱን ይነፉ ነበር፤ መዘምራንም በዜማ ዕቃ እያዜሙ የምስጋና መዝሙር ይዘምሩ ነበር። ጎቶሊያም ልብስዋን ቀድዳ። ዓመፅ ነው፥ ዓመፅ ነው ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በጭፍራው ላይ የተሾሙትን የመቶ አለቆች። ወደ ሰልፉ መካከል አውጡአት፤ የሚከተላትም በሰይፍ ይገደል ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ካህኑም። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ አትግደሉአት አለ።

verses.text_english: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.
verses.text_amharic: ገለልም ብለው አሳለፉአት፤ እርስዋም ወደ ፈረሱ በር መግቢያ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ሄደች፥ በዚያም ገደሉአት።

verses.text_english: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD'S people.
verses.text_amharic: ዮዳሄም በእርሱና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ በንጉሡም መካከል የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ በኣል ቤት ሄደው አፈረሱት፥ መሠዊያዎቹንና ምስሎቹንም አደቀቁ፥ የበኣልንም ካህን ማታንን በመሠዊያው ፊት ገደሉት።

verses.text_english: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, by David.
verses.text_amharic: ዮዳሄም በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈው፥ እንደ ዳዊትም ትእዛዝ፥ በደስታና በመዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የከፈላቸውን ካህናትና ሌዋውያን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ላይ ሾመ።

verses.text_english: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none unclean in any thing should enter in.
verses.text_amharic: በማናቸውም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ የሆነ ሰው እንዳይገባ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር በረኞችን አኖረ።

verses.text_english: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቆችንም፥ ከበርቴዎቹንም፥ የሕዝቡንም አለቆች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ ንጉሡንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አወረደ፤ በላይኛውም በር በኩል ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም በመንግሥቱ ዙፋን ላይ አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ አላቸው፥ ከተማይቱም ጸጥ አለች፤ ጎቶሊያንም በሰይፍ ገደሉአት። ች

verses.text_english: Joash seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ሳብያ የተባለች የቤርሳቤህ ሴት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And Joash did right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.text_amharic: በካህኑም በዮዳሄ ዘመን ሁሉ ኢዮአስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ዮዳሄም ሁለት ሚስቶች አጋባው፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after this, Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮአስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይጠግን ዘንድ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened not.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንንም ሰብስቦ። ወደ ይሁዳ ከተሞች ውጡ፥ የአምላካችሁንም ቤት በየዓመቱ ለማደስ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ገንዘብን ሰብስቡ፤ ነገሩንም ፈጥናችሁ አድርጉ አላቸው። ሌዋውያን ግን ቸል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አለቃውን ዮዳሄን ጠርቶ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ስለ ምስክሩ ድንኳን የእስራኤል ጉባኤ እንዲያዋጣ ያዘዘውን ግብር ከይሁዳና ከኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ሌዋውያንን አላተጋሃቸውም? አለው።

verses.text_english: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.
verses.text_amharic: ጎቶሊያ ከሐዲት ነበረችና ልጆችዋም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አፍርሰዋልና፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ተቀድሶ የነበረውን ሁሉ ለበኣሊም ሰጥተዋልና።

verses.text_english: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አዘዘ፥ ሣጥንም ሠርተው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር አጠገብ በስተ ውጭ አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection Moses the servant of God upon Israel in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ በእስራኤል ላይ ያዘዘውን ግብር ለእግዚአብሔር ያመጡ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም አዋጅ ነገሩ።

verses.text_english: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው አቀረቡት፥ እስኪሞላም ድረስ በሣጥኑ ውስጥ ጣሉት።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.text_amharic: ሣጥኑም በሌዋውያን እጅ ወደ ንጉሡ ሹማምት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ ብዙ ገንዘብም እንዳለበት ባየ ጊዜ፥ የንጉሡ ጸሐፊና የዋነኛው ካህን ሹም እየመጡ ብሩን ከሣጥን ያወጡ ነበር፥ ሣጥኑንም ደግሞ ወደ ስፍራው ይመልሱት ነበር። እንዲሁም በየቀኑ ያደርጉ ነበር፥ ብዙም ገንዘብ አከማቹ።

verses.text_english: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡና ዮዳሄም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰጡአቸው፤ እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የሚጠግኑትን ጠራቢዎችንና አናጢዎችን፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት የሚያድሱትን የብረትና የናስ ሠራተኞችን ይገዙበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራተኞችም ሠሩ፥ የፈረሰውም በእጃቸው ተጠገነ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት እንደ ቀድሞው ሥራ መለሱ፥ አጽንተውም አቆሙት።

verses.text_english: And when they had finished , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD, vessels to minister, and to offer , and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.text_amharic: በጨረሱም ጊዜ የተረፈውን ገንዘብ በንጉሡና በዮዳሄ ፊት አመጡ፤ እነርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ፥ ለአገልግሎትና ለቍርባን ዕቃ፥ ለጭልፋዎችም፥ ለወርቅና ለብርም ዕቃ አደረጉት። በዮዳሄም ዘመን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሁልጊዜ ያቀርቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old when he died.
verses.text_amharic: ዮዳሄም ሸመገለ፥ ዕድሜም ጠግቦ ሞተ፤ በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ጋር፥ ከእግዚአብሔርና ከቤቱም ጋር ቸርነትን ሠርቶአልና በዳዊት ከተማ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ዮዳሄም ከሞተ በኋላ የይሁዳ አለቆች ገብተው ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሡ፤ ንጉሡም እሺ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንና ጣዖታትን አመለኩ፤ በዚህ በደላቸውም ምክንያት በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ቍጣ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመልሱአቸው ዘንድ ነቢያትን ይሰድድላቸው ነበር፤ መሰከሩባቸውም፥ እነርሱ ግን አላደመጡም።

verses.text_english: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ላይ መጣ፤ እርሱም በሕዝቡ ፊት ቆመና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? መልካምም አይሆንላችሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ተዋችሁ እርሱ ትቶአችኋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ተማማሉበትም በንጉሡም ትእዛዝ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ውስጥ በድንጋይ ወገሩት።

verses.text_english: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon , and require .
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ንጉሡ ኢዮአስ ዮዳሄ ያደረገለትን ቸርነት አላሰበም፥ ልጁንም ዘካርያስን አስገደለው፤ እርሱም ሲሞት። እግዚአብሔር ይየው፥ ይፈልገውም አለ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of the year, the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመቱም ካለፈ በኋላ የሶርያውያን ሠራዊት መጡበት፤ ወደ ይሁዳና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጥተው ከሕዝቡ መካከል የሕዝቡን አለቆች ሁሉ አጠፉ፥ ምርኮአቸውንም ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ደማስቆ ላኩ።

verses.text_english: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያውያንም ሠራዊት ቍጥር ጥቂት ሆኖ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅን ሠራዊት አሳልፎ በእጃቸው ሰጣቸው፤ ይህም የሆነው የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ስለ ነበረ ነው። እነርሱም በኢዮአስ ላይ ፍርድ ፈረዱበት።

verses.text_english: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ዘንድ አልፈው ከሄዱ በኋላ እጅግ ታምሞ ነበር፤ የገዛ ባሪያዎቹም ስለ ካህኑ ስለ ዮዳሄ ልጅ ተበቅለው ተማማሉበት፥ በአልጋውም ላይ ገደሉት፥ ሞተም፤ በዳዊት ከተማ እንጂ በነገሥታት መቃብር አልቀበሩትም።

verses.text_english: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
verses.text_amharic: የተማማሉበትም የአሞናዊቱ የሰምዓት ልጅ ዛባድ፥ የሞዓባዊቱም የሰማሪት ልጅ ዮዛባት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now his sons, and the greatness of the burdens upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: የልጆቹና በእርሱ ላይ የተደረገው ነገር የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ማደሱ፥ እነሆ፥ በነገሥታቱ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል። ልጁም አሜስያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Amaziah twenty and five years old he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱ ዮዓዳን የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፥ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልብ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥትም በጸናለት ጊዜ አባቱን የገደሉትን ባሪያዎች ገደለ።

verses.text_english: But he slew not their children, but as written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.text_amharic: በሙሴም ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ ኃጢያቱ ይሙት እንጂ አባቶች በልጆች ፋንታ አይሙቱ፥ ልጆችም በአባቶች ፋንታ አይሙቱ ብሎ እንዳዘዘ የነፍሰ ገዳዮችን ልጆች አልገደለም።

verses.text_english: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም ይሁዳን ሰበሰበ፥ በእየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ከሺህ አለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች እጅ በታች አቆማቸው፤ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀመሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉትን ይሁዳንና ብንያምን ሁሉ ቈጠረ፥ ለሰልፍም የሚወጡ፥ ጋሻና ጦርም የሚይዙ ሦስት መቶ ሺህ የተመረጡ ሰዎች አገኘ።

verses.text_english: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከእስራኤል ዘንድ መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን በመቶ መክሊት ብር ቀጠረ።

verses.text_english: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD not with Israel, all the children of Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ግን ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤልና ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ጋር አይደለምና የእስራኤል ጭፍራ ከአንተ ጋር አይውጣ።

verses.text_english: But if thou wilt go, do , be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
verses.text_amharic: ብትሄድ ግን፥ በእነርሱም ማሸነፍን ብታስብ፥ የመርዳትና የመጣል ኃይል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነውና እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶችህ ፊት ይጥልሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። ለእስራኤል ጭፍራ የሰጠሁት መቶ መክሊት ምን ይሁን? አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ከዚህ አብልጦ ይሰጥህ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይችላል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Then Amaziah separated them, , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም ከኤፍሬም የመጡት ጭፍሮች ወደ ስፍራቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ለይቶ አሰናበታቸው፤ ስለዚህም ቍጣቸው በይሁዳ ላይ ጸና፥ ወደ አገራቸውም በጽኑ ቍጣ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም በረታ፥ ሕዝቡንም አውጥቶ ወደ ጨው ሸለቆ ሄደ፥ ከሴይርም ልጆች አሥር ሺህ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And ten thousand alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ልጆች ደግሞ አሥር ሺህ ሰዎችን በሕይወታቸው ማረኩ፥ ወደ ዓለቱም ራስ ላይ አመጡአቸው፤ ከዓለቱም ራስ ላይ ጣሉአቸው፥ ሁሉም ተፈጠፈጡ።

verses.text_english: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ እንዳይሄዱ ያሰናበታቸው ጭፍሮች ከሰማርያ ጀምረው እስከ ቤትሖሮን ድረስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ከእነርሱም ሦስት ሺህ ገደሉ፥ ብዙ ምርኮም ማረኩ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች ከገደለ በኋላ የሴይርን ልጆች አማልክት አመጣ፥ የእርሱም አማልክት ይሆኑ ዘንድ አቆማቸው፥ ይሰግድላቸውም ያጥንላቸውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በአሜስያስ ላይ ነደደና። ሕዝባቸውን ከአንተ እጅ ያላዳኑትን የአሕዛብን አማልክት ስለ ምን ፈለግሃቸው? የሚል ነቢይ ሰደደበት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሲናገር ንጉሡ። በውኑ አንተ የንጉሡ አማካሪ ልትሆን ሾመነሃልን? ተው፤ ቅጣትን ስለ ምን ትሻለህ? አለው። ነቢዩም። ይህን አድርገሃልና፥ ምክሬንም አልሰማህምና እግዚአብሔር ሊያጠፋህ እንዳሰበ አወቅሁ ብሎ ተወ።

verses.text_english: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ አሜስያስ ምክር አደረገና። ና፥ እርስ በርሳችን ፊት ለፊት እንተያይ ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዩ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ ላከ።

verses.text_english: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that in Lebanon sent to the cedar that in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮስያስ። የሊባኖስ ኵርንችት። ልጅህን ለልጄ ሚስት አድርገህ ስጠው ብሎ ወድ ሊባኖስ ዝግባ ላከ፤ የሊባኖስም አውሬ አልፎ ኵርንችቱን ረገጠ።

verses.text_english: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to hurt, that thou shouldest fall, thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። እነሆ፥ ኤዶምያስን መትቻለሁ ብለህ ኰርተሃል፤ በቤትህ ተቀመጥ፤ አንተ ከይሁዳ ጋር ትወድቅ ዘንድ ስለ ምን መከራ ትሻላህ? ብሎ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሜስያስ ላከ።

verses.text_english: But Amaziah would not hear; for it of God, that he might deliver them into the hand , because they sought after the gods of Edom.
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶምያስንም አማልክት ስለ ፈለጉ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበረና አሜስያስ አልሰማም።

verses.text_english: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Bethshemesh, which to Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ ወጣ፤ እርሱና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሜስያስም በይሁዳ ባለች በቤትሳሚስ ላይ እርስ በርሳቸው ተያዩ።

verses.text_english: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም በእስራኤል ፊት ተመታ፥ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የአካዝያስን ልጅ የኢዮአስን ልጅ አሜስያስን በቤትሳሚስ ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመጣው፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር ከኤፍሬም በር ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ አራት መቶ ክንድ አፈረሰ።

verses.text_english: And all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: ወርቁንና ብሩን ሁሉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ከዖቤድኤዶም ጋር የነበሩትን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ፥ የንጉሡን ቤት መዛግብት፥ በመያዣ የተያዙትንም ወስዶ ወደ ሰማርያ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ የኢዮአስ ልጅ አሜስያስ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ከኢዮአስ ሞት በኋላ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የፊተኛውና የኋላኛው የአሜስያስ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በይሁዳና በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
verses.text_amharic: አሜስያስም እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ከራቀ በኋላ በኢየሩሳሌም የዓመፅ መሐላ አደረጉበት፥ ወደ ለኪሶም ኰበለለ፤ በስተ ኋላውም ወደ ለኪሶ ላኩ፥ በዚያም ገደሉት።

verses.text_english: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በፈረስም ጭነው አመጡት፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የአሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ የነበረውን ዖዝያንን ወስደው በአባቱ በአሜስያስ ፋንታ አነገሡት።

verses.text_english: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከአባቶቹ ጋር ከአንቀላፋ በኋላ ዖዝያን ኤላትን ሠራ፥ ወደ ይሁዳም መለሳት።

verses.text_english: Sixteen years old Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዖዝያንም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ይኮልያ የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም አሜስያስ እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም መፍራት ባስተማረ በዘካርያስ ዘመን እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ልብ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም በፈለገ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ነገሩን አከናወነለት።

verses.text_english: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥቶም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ተዋጋ፥ የጌትንና የየብናን የአዞጦንንም ቅጥር አፈረሰ፤ በአዛጦንና በፍልስጥኤማውያንም አገር ከተሞችን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በፍልስጥኤማውያንና በጉርበኣል በሚኖሩ ዓረባውያን በምዑናውያንም ላይ ረዳው።

verses.text_english: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened exceedingly.
verses.text_amharic: አሞናውያንም ለዖዝያን ገበሩ፤ እጅግም በርትቶ ነበርና ዝናው እስከ ግብጽ መግቢያ ድረስ ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning , and fortified them.
verses.text_amharic: ዖዝያንም በኢየሩሳሌም በማዕዘኑ በርና በሸለቆው በር ቅጥሩም በዞረበት ማዕዘን አጠገብ ግንቦችን ሠርቶ መሸጋቸው።

verses.text_english: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen , and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙም እንስሶች ነበሩበትና በምድረ በዳና በቈላው በደጋውም ግንብ ሠራ፥ ብዙ ጕድጓድም ማሰ፤ ደግሞም እርሻ ይወድድ ነበርና በተራራማውና በፍሬያማው ስፍራ አራሾችና አትክልተኞች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, of the king's captains.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ለዖዝያን በሠራዊት ውስጥ ሰልፈኞች ነበሩት፤ በንጉሡ አለቃ በሐናንያ ትእዛዝ በአለቃው በመዕሤያና በጸሐፊው በይዒኤል እጅ እንደ ተቈጠሩ ወደ ሰልፍ በየቍጥራቸው ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour two thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች የጽኑዓን ኃያላኑ ቍጥር ሁሉ ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And under their hand an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም በጠላቱ ላይ ያግዝ ዘንድ፥ በታላቅ ኃይል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጣ፥ ከእጃቸው በታች የነበረ ሠራዊት ሦስት መቶ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings stones.
verses.text_amharic: ዖዝያንም ለጭፍራው ሁሉ ጋሻና ጦር፥ ራስ ቍርና ጥሩር፥ ቀስትና የሚወነጭፉትን ድንጋይ አዘጋጀላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም በብልሃተኞች እጅ የተሠሩትን፥ በግንብና በቅጥር ላይ የሚኖሩትን፥ ፍላጻና መርግ የሚወረወርባቸውን መሣሪያዎች አደረገ፤ እስኪበረታም ድረስ እግዚአብሔር በድንቅ ረድቶታልና ዝናው እስከ ሩቅ ድረስ ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በበረታ ጊዜ ለጥፋት ልቡ ታበየ፥ አምላኩንም እግዚአብሔርን በደለ፤ ወደ መቅደስ ገብቶ በዕጣን መሠዊያ ላይ ዐጠነ።

verses.text_english: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD, valiant men:
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ዓዛርያስ ከእርሱም ጋር ጽኑዓን የነበሩ ሰማንያ የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ተከትለው ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither for thine honour from the LORD God.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም ዖዝያንን እየተቃወሙ። ዖዝያን ሆይ፥ ዕጣን ማጠን የተቀደሱት የአሮን ልጆች የካህናቱ ሹመት ነው እንጂ ለእግዚአብሔር ታጥን ዘንድ ለአንተ አይገባህም፤ በድለሃልና ከመቅደሱ ውጣ፤ ከአምላክህም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ክብር አይሆንልህም አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Uzziah was wroth, and a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.
verses.text_amharic: ዖዝያንም ተቈጣ፤ የሚያጥንበትም ጥና በእጁ ነበረ፤ ካህናቱንም በተቈጣ ጊዜ በካህናቱ ፊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በዕጣኑ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ሳለ በግምባሩ ላይ ለምጽ ታየ።

verses.text_english: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቁም ካህን ዓዛርያስ ካህናቱም ሁሉ ተመለከቱት፥ እነሆም፥ በግምባሩ ላይ ለምጽ ነበረ፤ ፈጥነውም አባርረሩት፥ እርሱም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ቀሥፎት ነበርና ይወጣ ዘንድ ቸኰለ።

verses.text_english: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዖዝያን እስኪሞት ድረስ ለምጻም ነበረ፤ ለምጻምም ሆኖ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተቈርጦአልና በተለየ ቤት ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በንጉሡ ቤት ላይ ሆኖ በምድሩ ሕዝብ ላይ ይፈርድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውንም የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን የዖዝያንን ነገር ነቢዩ የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ጽፎታል።

verses.text_english: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which to the kings; for they said, He a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ዖዝያንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ ለምጻም ነው ብለውም ከአባቶቹ ጋር በነገሥታቱ መቃብር እርሻ ውስጥ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Jotham twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአታምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የሳዶቅ ልጅ ኢየሩሳ ትባል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he did right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ዖዝያን እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅደስ አልገባም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና ይበድል ነበር።

verses.text_english: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የላይኛውን በር ሠራ፥ በዖፌልም ቅጥር ላይ እጅግ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
verses.text_amharic: በተራራማውም በይሁዳ አገር ላይ ከተሞችን ሠራ፥ በዱር ስፍራዎችም አምባዎችንና ግንቦችን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ ጋር ተዋጋ አሸነፋቸውም። በዚያም ዓመት የአሞን ልጆች መቶ መክሊት ብር፥ አሥር ሺህም የቆሬስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ፥ አሥር ሺህም የቆሬስ መሥፈሪያ ገብስ ሰጡት። እንዲሁም ደግሞ የአሞን ልጆች በሁለተኛውና በሦስተኛው ዓመት ሰጡት።

verses.text_english: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአታምም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መንገዱን አቅንቶአልና በረታ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም የኢዮአታም ነገር፥ ሰልፉም ሁሉ፥ ሥራውም፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአታምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አካዝ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Ahaz twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:
verses.text_amharic: አካዝ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፥ ደግሞም ለበኣሊም ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎችን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ዐጠነ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳሳደዳቸው እንደ አሕዛብም ክፉ ልማድ ልጆቹን በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.text_amharic: በኮረብታው መስገጃዎችና በተራሮች ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር በሶርያ ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ ሶርያውያንም መቱት፥ ከእርሱም ብዙ ምርኮኞች ወስደው ወደ ደማስቆ አመጡ። ደግሞም በእስራኤል ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እርሱም በታላቅ አመታት መታው።

verses.text_english: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ነበርና የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ በአንድ ቀን ከይሁዳ መቶ ሀያ ሺህ ገደለ፤ ሁሉም ጽኑዓን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah next to the king.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤፍሬምም ወገን የነበረው ኃያል ሰው ዝክሪ የንጉሡን ልጅ መዕሤያንና የቤቱን አዛዥ ዓዝሪቃምን፥ ለንጉሡም በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ የሆነውን ሕልቃናን ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከወንድሞቻቸው ሁለት መቶ ሺህ ሴቶችን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ማረኩ፥ እጅግም ምርኮ ከእነርሱ ወስደው ወደ ሰማርያ አገቡ።

verses.text_english: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage reacheth up unto heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዖዴድ የተባለ የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ ነበረ፤ ወደ ሰማርያም የሚመጣውን ጭፍራ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይሁዳን ስለ ተቈጣ በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ እናንተም ወደ ሰማይ በሚደርስ ቍጣ ገደላችኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌም ልጆች ባሪያዎች ሆነው ይገዙላችሁ ዘንድ ታስባላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን የበደላችሁት በደል በእናንተ ዘንድ የለምን?

verses.text_english: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD upon you.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ስሙኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በላያችሁ ነድዶአልና ከወንድሞቻችሁ የወሰዳችኋቸውን ምርኮኞች መልሱ።

verses.text_english: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከኤፍሬም ልጆች አለቆች የዮሐናን ልጅ ዓዛርያስ፥ የምሺሌሞትም ልጅ በራክያ፥ የሰሎምም ልጅ ይሒዝቅያ፥ የሐድላይም ልጅ ዓሜሳይ ከሰልፍ በተመለሱት ላይ ተቃወሙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD , ye intend to add to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and fierce wrath against Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በእኛ ላይ በደል ታመጡብናላችሁና፥ ኃጢያታችንንና በደላችንን ታበዙብናላችሁና የተማረኩትን ወደዚህ አታግቡ፤ በደላችን ታላቅ ነውና፥ የመቅሰፍቱም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነውና አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሰልፈኞቹም ምርኮኞቹንና ምርኮውን በአለቆችና በጉባኤ ሁሉ ፊት ተዉ።

verses.text_english: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: በስማቸውም የተጻፉ ሰዎች ተነሥተው ምርኮኞቹን ወሰዱ፥ በመካከላቸውም ራቁታቸውን ለነበሩት ሁሉ ከምርኮው አለበሱአቸው፥ አጎናጸፉአቸውም፥ ጫማም በእግራቸው አደረጉላቸው፥ መገቡአቸውም፥ አጠጡአቸውም፥ ቀቡአቸውም፤ ደካሞቹንም ሁሉ በአህዮች ላይ አስቀመጡአቸው፥ ዘንባባም ወዳለበት ከተማ ወደ ኢያሪኮ ወደ ወንድሞቻቸው አመጡአቸው፤ ወደ ሰማርያም ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ንጉሡ አካዝ እርዳታ ፈልጎ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ላከ፤

verses.text_english: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶምያስ ሰዎች ዳግመኛ መጥተው፥ ይሁዳንም መትተው ብዙ ምርኮኛ ወስደው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ፍልስጥኤማውያን በቈላውና በደቡብ በኩል ባሉት በይሁዳ ከተሞች አደጋ ጥለው ነበር፤ ቤትሳሚስንና ኤሎንን፥ ግዴሮትንም፥ ሦኮንና መንደሮችዋን፥ ተምናንና መንደሮችዋን፥ ጊምዞንና መንደሮችዋን ወስደው በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ አካዝ እግዚአብሔርን ክዷልና፥ ከእርሱም እጅግ ርቆአልና እግዚአብሔር ስለ እርሱ ይሁዳን አዋረደው።

verses.text_english: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር መጥቶ አስጨነቀው እንጂ አልረዳውም።

verses.text_english: For Ahaz took away a portion of the house of the LORD, and of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ከንጉሡና ከአለቆቹም ቤት እኵሌታውን ገፈፈ፥ ለአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰጠ፤ ነገር ግን አንዳች አልተጠቀመበትም።

verses.text_english: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this king Ahaz.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ንጉሥ አካዝ በተጨነቀ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን መበደል አበዛ።

verses.text_english: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለመቱትም ለደማስቆ አማልክት። የሶርያን ነገሥታት አማልክት ረድተዋቸዋልና እኔን ይረዱ ዘንድ እሠዋላቸዋለሁ ብሎ ሠዋላቸው። ነገር ግን ለእርሱና ለእስራኤል ሁሉ እንቅፋት ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ወስዶ ሰባበራቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ደጅ ቈለፈ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ማዕዘን ሁሉ መሠዊያ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ለሌሎች አማልክት ያጥን ዘንድ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎች አሠራ፤ የአባቶቹንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣ።

verses.text_english: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውም ነገርና ሥራው ሁሉ፥ የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው፥ እነሆ፥ በይሁዳና በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በከተማይቱም በኢየሩሳሌም ቀበሩት፤ ነገር ግን ወደ እስራኤል ነገሥታት መቃብር አላገቡትም፤ ልጁም ሕዝቅያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: Hezekiah began to reign five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ በነበረ ጊዜ መንገሥ ጀመረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የዘካርያስ ልጅ አቡ ትባል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he did right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ዳዊት እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.
verses.text_amharic: በነገሠም በመጀመሪያው ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ደጆች ከፈተ፥ አደሳቸውም።

verses.text_english: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑንም አስመጣ፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው አደባባይም ሰበሰባቸው፥

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy .
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ሌዋውያን ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ተቀደሱ፥ የአባቶቻችሁንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቀድሱ፤ ርኩሱን ነገር ሁሉ ከመቅደሱ አስወግዱ።

verses.text_english: For our fathers have trespassed, and done evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned backs.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን ተላልፈዋል፥ በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አድርገዋል፤ እርሱንም ትተዋል፥ ፊታቸውንም ከእግዚአብሔር መኖሪያ መልሰዋል፥

verses.text_english: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy unto the God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርስዋም ጀርባቸውን አዙረዋል፤ ደግሞም የወለሉን ደጆች ቈልፈዋል፥ መብራቶቹንም አጥፍተዋል፥ በመቅደሱም ውስጥ ለእስራኤል አምላክ አላጠኑም፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አላቀረቡም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ሆነ፥ በዓይናችሁም እንደምታዩ ለድንጋጤና ለመደነቂያ ለመዘበቻም አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives in captivity for this.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ስለዚህ አባቶቻችን በሰይፍ ወደቁ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም ሚስቶቻችንም ተማረኩ።

verses.text_english: Now in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የቍጣው ጽናት ከእኛ እንዲመለስ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደርግ ዘንድ በልቤ አስቤአለሁ።

verses.text_english: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ በፊቱ ትቆሙና ታገለግሉት ዘንድ፥ አገልጋዮቹም ትሆኑ ዘንድ፥ ታጥኑለትም ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር መርጦአችኋልና ቸል አትበሉ።

verses.text_english: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያኑም፥ ከቀዓት ልጆች የአማሢ ልጅ መሐትና የዓዛርያስ ልጅ ኢዮኤል፥ ከሜራሪም ልጆች የአብዲ ልጅ ቂስና የይሃሌልኤል ልጅ ዓዛርያስ፥ ከጌድሶንም ልጆች የዛማት ልጅ ዩአክና የዩአክ ልጅ ዔድን፥

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻቸውንም ሰብስበው ተቀደሱ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደመጣው እንደ ንጉሡ ትእዛዝ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ያነጹ ዘንድ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም ያነጹት ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ውስጡ ገቡ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም መቅደስ ያገኙትን ርኩስ ነገር ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ አወጡት። ሌዋውያንም ወስደው ወደ ሜዳ ወደ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ጣሉት።

verses.text_english: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse , and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took , to carry out abroad into the brook Kidron.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ይቀደሱ ጀመር፥ በዚያውም ወር በስምንተኛው ቀን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወለል ደረሱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት በስምንት ቀን ቀደሱ፥ በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ ስድስተኛው ቀን ፈጸሙ።

verses.text_english: Now they began on the first of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውስጡም ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ገብተው። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሁሉ፥ ለሚቃጠል መስዋዕት የሚሆነውን መሠዊያና ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት ገበታና ዕቃውን ሁሉ አንጽተናል፤

verses.text_english: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አካዝ ነግሦ ሳለ በመተላለፍ ያረከሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አዘጋጅተናል ቀድሰናልም፤ እነሆም፥ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ሆነዋል አሉት።

verses.text_english: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they before the altar of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስ ማልዶ ተነሣ የከተማይቱንም አለቆች ሰበሰበ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ መንግሥቱና ስለ መቅደሱም ስለ ይሁዳም ሰባት ወይፈኖች፥ ሰባትም አውራ በጎች፥ ሰባትም የበግ ጠቦቶች፥ ሰባትም አውራ ፍየሎች ለኃጢያት መሥዋዕት አመጡ። የአሮንንም ልጆች ካህናቱን። በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ አሳረጉአቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer on the altar of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ወይፈኖቹንም አረዱ፥ ካህናቱም ደሙን ተቀብለው በመሠዊያው ላይ ረጩት፤ አውራ በጎቹንም አረዱ፥ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ ረጩት፤ ጠቦቶቹንም አረዱ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ ረጩት።

verses.text_english: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢያትም መሥዋዕት የሚሆኑትን አውራ ፍየሎች በንጉሡና በጉባኤው ፊት አቀረቡ፥ እጃቸውንም ጫኑባቸው፥ ካህናቱም አረዱአቸው፤

verses.text_english: And they brought forth the he goats the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የኃጢያት መሥዋዕት ለእስራኤል ሁሉ እንዲደረግ አዝዞ ነበርና ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ማስተስረያ ያደርጉ ዘንድ የኃጢያቱን መሥዋዕት ደም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ትእዛዝ እግዚአብሔር በነቢያቱ እጅ አዝዞአልና እንደ ዳዊትና እንደ ንጉሡ ባለ ራእይ እንደ ጋድ፥ እንደ ነቢዩም እንደ ናታን ትእዛዝ፥ ጸናጽልና በገና መሰንቆም አስይዞ ሌዋውያንን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አቆመ።

verses.text_english: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንም የዳዊትን የዜማ ዕቃ ይዘው፥ ካህናቱም መለከቱን ይዘው ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በመሠዊያው ላይ ያሳርጉ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ የሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ማረግ በተጀመረ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር መዝሙር ደግሞ ተጀመረ፥ መለከቱም ተነፋ፥ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የዳዊት ዜማ ዕቃ ተመታ።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began with the trumpets, and with the instruments by David king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም ሁሉ ሰገዱ፥ መዘምራኑም ዘመሩ፥ መለከተኞችም ነፉ፤ የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ይህ ሁሉ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: all until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.text_amharic: ማቅረቡንም በፈጸሙ ጊዜ ንጉሡና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩ ሁሉ አጐነበሱ ሰገዱም።

verses.text_english: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስና አለቆቹ ሌዋውያንን በዳዊትና በባለ ራእዩ በአሳፍ ቃል እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ አዘዙ። በደስታም አመሰገኑ፥ አጐነበሱም ሰገዱም።

verses.text_english: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም። አሁን ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀድሳችኋል፤ ቅረቡ፥ መሥዋዕቱንና የምስጋናውን መሥዋዕት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አምጡ ብሎ ተናገረ። ጉባኤውም መሥዋዕቱንና የምስጋናውን መስዋዕት አመጡ፤ ልባቸውም የፈቀደ ሁሉ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አመጡ።

verses.text_english: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም ያመጡት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ቍጥር ሰባ ወይፈን፥ መቶም አውራ በጎች፥ ሁለት መቶም የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበረ፤ ይህ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, two hundred lambs: all these for a burnt offering to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሱትም ቍጥር ስድስት መቶ በሬዎች ሦስት ሺህም በጎች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the consecrated things six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ካህናቱ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለመግፈፍ ጥቂቶች ነበሩ፤ ስለዚህም ሌዋውያን በቅን ልብ ከካህናት ይልቅ ይቀደሱ ነበርና ሥራው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ካህናቱም እስኪቀደሱ ድረስ ወንድሞቻቸው ሌዋውያን ያግዙአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት የደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ስብ፥ ከሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ ጋር የሚቀርበው የመጠጥ ቍርባን፥ ብዙ ነበረ። እንዲሁም የእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ተዘጋጀ።

verses.text_english: And also the burnt offerings in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ስላዘጋጀው ነገር ደስ አላቸው። ይህም ነገር በድንገት ተደረገ።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ያደርጉ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲመጡ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ እስራኤልና ወደ ይሁዳ ሁሉ ላከ፥ ደግሞም ወደ ኤፍሬምና ወደ ምናሴ ደብዳቤ ጻፈ።

verses.text_english: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም በሚበቃ ቍጥር ስላልተቀደሱ፥ ሕዝቡም ገና በኢየሩሳሌም ስላልተሰበሰቡ በጊዜው ያደርጉት ዘንድ አልቻሉምና ንጉሡና አለቆቹ የኢየሩሳሌምም ጉባኤ ሁሉ በሁለተኛው ወር ፋሲካውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተመካክረው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩም ለንጉሡና ለጉባኤው ሁሉ ዓይን መልካም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done of a long as it was written.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተጻፈም በብዙ ቍጥር አላደረጉም ነበርና የእስራኤልን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ፋሲካ በኢየሩሳሌም ያደርጉ ዘንድ እንዲመጡ ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዳን ድረስ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ አዋጅ እንዲነገር ወሰኑ።

verses.text_english: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ንጉሡም ትእዛዝ መልክተኞቹ እንዲህ የሚለውን የንጉሡንና የአለቆቹን ደብዳቤ ይዘው ወደ እስራኤልና ወደ ይሁዳ ሁሉ ሄዱ። የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአሦር ነገሥታት እጅ ወዳመለጠ ቅሬታችሁ እንዲመለስ ወደ አብርሃምና ወደ ይስሐቅ ወደ እስራኤልም አምላክ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም እንደምታዩ የተፈቱ እስኪያደርጋቸው ድረስ የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን እንደ በደሉ እንደ አባቶቻችሁና እንደ ወንድሞቻችሁ አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችሁም እንደ ነበሩ አንገተ ደንዳና አትሁኑ፤ እጃችሁንም ለእግዚአብሔር ስጡ፥ ለዘላለም ወደ ተቀደሰው ወደ መቅደሱም ግቡ፥ ጽኑ ቍጣውም ከእናንተ እንዲመለስ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አምልኩ።

verses.text_english: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God gracious and merciful, and will not turn away face from you, if ye return unto him.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር ቸርና መሐሪ ነውና፥ ወደ እርሱም ብትመለሱ ፊቱን ከእናንተ አያዞርምና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ብትመለሱ ወንድሞቻችሁና ልጆቻችሁ በማረኩአቸው ፊት ምሕረትን ያገኛሉ፥ ደግሞም ወደዚህች ምድር ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
verses.text_amharic: መልእክተኞቹም ከከተማ ወደ ከተማ በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ አገር እስከ ዛብሎን ሄዱ፤ እነዚያ ግን በንቀት ሳቁባቸው፥ አፌዙባቸውም።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከአሴርና ከምናሴ ከዛብሎንም አያሌ ሰዎች ሰውነታቸውን አዋረዱ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጡ።

verses.text_english: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አንድ ልብ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቃል የሆነውን የንጉሡንና የአለቆቹን ትእዛዝ ያደርጉ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በይሁዳ ላይ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ወር የቂጣውን በዓል ያደርግ ዘንድ እጅግ ታላቅ ጉባኤ የሆነ ሕዝብ በኢየሩሳሌም ተከማቸ።

verses.text_english: And they arose and took away the altars that in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast into the brook Kidron.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተውም በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩትን መሠዊያዎችና ለጣዖታት የሚያጥኑበትን ዕቃ ሁሉ አስወገዱ፥ በቄድሮንም ወንዝ ጣሉት።

verses.text_english: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ፋሲካውን አረዱ፤ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም አፈሩ፥ ተቀደሱም፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, of the hand of the Levites.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ሰው እንደ ሙሴ ሕግ በሥርዓታቸው ቆሙ፤ ካህናቱም ከሌዋውያን እጅ የተቀበሉትን ደም ይረጩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one not clean, to sanctify unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በጉባኤውም ያልተቀደሱ እጅግ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ስለዚህም ሌዋውያን ለእግዚአብሔር ይቀድሱአቸው ዘንድ ንጹሐን ላልሆኑት ሁሉ ፋሲካውን ያርዱላቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: For a multitude of the people, many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ትእዛዙም ሳይሆን ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴ ከይሳኮርና ከዛብሎንም ወገን እጅግ ሰዎች ሳይነጹ ፋሲካውን በሉ።

verses.text_english: prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though not according to the purification of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም። ምንም እንደ መቅደሱ ማንጻት ባይነጻ የአባቶቹን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ለመፈለግ ልቡን የሚያቀናውን ሁሉ ቸሩ እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ይበለው ብሎ ስለ እነርሱ ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቅያስን ሰማው፥ ሕዝቡንም ፈወሰ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, with loud instruments unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ተገኝተው የነበሩ የእስራኤል ልጆች የቂጣውን በዓል በታላቅ ደስታ ሰባት ቀን አደረጉ፤ ሌዋውያኑና ካህናቱም በዜማ ዕቃ ለእግዚአብሔር እየዘመሩ ዕለት ዕለት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር አገልግሎት አስተዋዮች የነበሩትን ሌዋውያንን ሁሉ ያጽናና ነበር። የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት እያቀረቡ፥ የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እያመሰገኑ ሰባት ቀን በዓል አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept seven days with gladness.

For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ጉባኤ ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ፥ ከእስራኤልም የመጡ ጉባኤ ሁሉ፥ ከእስራኤልም አገር የመጡትና በይሁዳ የኖሩት እንግዶች ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ታላቅ ደስታ ሆነ፤ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከዳዊት ልጅ ከሰሎሞን ዘመን ጀምሮ እንደዚህ ያለ በዓል በኢየሩሳሌም አልተደረገም ነበር።

verses.text_english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel not the like in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም ተነሥተው ሕዝቡን ባረኩ፤ ድምፃቸውም ተሰማ፥ ጸሎታቸውም ወደ ቅዱስ መኖሪያው ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ።

verses.text_english: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሁሉ በተፈጸመ ጊዜ በዚያ የተገኙ እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደ ይሁዳ ከተሞች ወጥተው ሁሉን ፈጽመው እስካጠፉአቸው ድረስ ሐውልቶቹን ሰባበሩ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጡ፥ በይሁዳና በብንያምም ሁሉ ደግሞም በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ የነበሩትን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎችና መሠዊያዎች አፈረሱ። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ወደ ርስታቸውና ወደ ከተሞቻቸው ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም የካህናትንና የሌዋውያንን ሰሞን በየክፍላቸውና በየአገልግሎታቸው አቆመ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ በሮች የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ፥ ያገለግሉም ዘንድ፥ ያመሰግኑም ያከብሩም ዘንድ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን አቆመ።

verses.text_english: also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, , for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as written in the law of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ በጥዋትና በማታ፥ በሰንበታቱም፥ በመባቻዎቹም፥ በበዓላትም ለሚቀርበው ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ንጉሡ ከገንዘቡ የሚከፍለውን ወሰነ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለአገልግሎት እንዲጸኑ ለካህናቱና ለሌዋውያን ክፍላቸውን ይሰጡ ዘንድ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ሕዝብ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all brought they in abundantly.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር እንዳዘዘ የእስራኤል ልጆች የእህሉንና የወይኑን ጠጅ የዘይቱንና የማሩንም፥ የእርሻውንም ፍሬ ሁሉ በኵራት ሰጡ፤ የሁሉንም አሥራት አብዝተው አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid by heaps.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ከተሞች የሚኖሩ የእስራኤልና የይሁዳ ልጆች የበሬውንና የበጉን አሥራት፥ ለአምላካቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን አሥራት አመጡ፥ ከምረውም አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished in the seventh month.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛው ወር መከመር ጀመሩ፤ በሰባተኛውም ወር ጨረሱ።

verses.text_english: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስና አለቆቹም መጥተው ክምሩን ባዩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርና ሕዝቡን እስራኤልን ባረኩ።

verses.text_english: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ስለ ክምሩ ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left this great store.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳዶቅም ወገን የሆነ ዋነኛው ካህን ዓዛሪያስ። ሕዝቡ ቍርባኑን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ማቅረብ ከጀመረ ወዲህ በልተናል፥ ጠግበናልም፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ባርኮአልና ብዙ ተርፎአል፤ የተረፈውም ይህ ክምር ትልቅ ነው ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared ,
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ጐተራ ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ እነርሱም አዘጋጁ።

verses.text_english: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite ruler, and Shimei his brother the next.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባኑና አሥራቱን የተቀደሱትንም በእምነት ወደዚያ አገቡት። ሌዋዊውም ኮናንያ ተሾመባቸው፥ ወንድሙም ሰሜኢ በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም በሕዝቅያስና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አለቃ በዓዛርያስ ትእዛዝ ይሒዒል፥ ዓዛዝያ፥ ናሖት፥ አሣሄል፥ ይሬሞት፥ ዮዛባት፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ሰማኪያ፥ መሐት፥ በናያስ፥ ከኮናንያና ከወንድሙ ከሰሜኢ እጅ በታች ተቈጣጣሪዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዋዊውም የይምና ልጅ የምሥራቁ ደጅ በረኛ ቆሬ የእግዚአብሔርን መባና የተቀደሱትን ነገሮች እንዲያካፍል ሕዝቡ ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃድ ባቀረቡት ላይ ተሾመ።

verses.text_english: And next him Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
verses.text_amharic: በካህናቱም ከተሞች ለታላላቆችና ለታናናሾች ወንድሞቻቸው በየሰሞናቸው ክፍላቸውን በእምነት ይሰጡ ዘንድ ዔድን፥ ሚንያሚን፥ ኢያሱ፥ ሸማያ፥ አማርያ፥ ሴኬንያ ከእጁ በታች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
