verses.text_english: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም ለሰማይ አምላክ ጣፋጭ ሽቱ የሆነውን መሥዋዕት ያቀረቡ ዘንድ ለንጉሡና ለልጆቹም ዕድሜ ይጸልዩ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ትእዛዝ የሚለውጥ ሁሉ፥ ምሰሶው ከቤቱ ተነቅሎ እርሱ ይሰቀልበት፤ ቤቱም የጉድፍ መጣያ ይደረግ ብዬ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter to destroy this house of God which at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙንም በዚያ ያኖረው አምላክ ይህን ይለውጡ ዘንድ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ያፈርሱት ዘንድ እጃቸውን የሚዘረጉትን ነገሥታትና አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያጥፋ። እኔ ዳርዮስ ይህን አዝዣለሁ፤ በትጋት ይፈጸም።

verses.text_english: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ዳርዮስ እንደ ላከው ቃል፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በወንዝ ማዶ ያለ ገዥ ተንትናይ ደግሞ ሰተርቡዝናይ ተባባሪዎቻቸውም እንዲሁ ተግተው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished , according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.text_amharic: የአይሁድም ሽማግሌዎች በነቢዩ በሐጌና በአዶ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ትንቢት ሠሩ ተከናወነላቸውም። እንደ እስራኤልም አምላክ ትእዛዝ፥ እንደ ፋርስም ነገሥታት እንደ ቂሮስና እንደ ዳርዮስ እንደ አርጤክስስም ትእዛዝ ሠርተው ፈጸሙ።

verses.text_english: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ቤት በንጉሡ በዳርዮስ መንግሥት በስድስተኛው ዓመት አዳር በሚባል ወር በሦስተኛው ቀን ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች፥ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን የቀሩትም ምርኮኞች፥ የዚህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቅዳሴ በደስታ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ቅዳሴ መቶ ወይፈኖችና ሁለት መቶ አውራ በጎች አራት መቶም ጠቦቶች አቀረቡ ፤ ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት እንደ እስራኤል ነገዶች ቍጥር ለእስራኤል ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት አውራ ፍየሎች አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: በሙሴም መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈው በኢየሩሳሌም ባለው በእግዚአብሔር አገልግሎት ላይ ካህናቱን በየማዕርጋቸው ሌዋውያኑም በየክፍላቸው አቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth of the first month.
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮኞቹም በመጀመሪያው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ፋሲካውን አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም አንድ ሆነው ነጽተው ነበር፤ ሁሉም ንጹሐን ነበሩ፤ ለምርኮኞቹም ሁሉ፥ ለወንድሞቻቸውም ለካህናቱ፥ ለራሳቸውም ፋሲካውን አረዱ።

verses.text_english: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
verses.text_amharic: ከምርኮም ተመልሰው የመጡት የእስራኤል ልጆች፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ ራሳቸውን ከምድር አሕዛብ ርኵሰት ለይተው ወደ እነርሱ መጥተው የነበሩት ሁሉ በሉ፤

verses.text_english: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለመሥራት እጃቸውን ያጸና ዘንድ የአሦርን ንጉሥ ልብ ወደ እነርሱ መልሶአልና የቂጣውን በዓል ሰባት ቀን በደስታ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ነገር በኋላ በፋርስ ንጉሥ በአርጤክስስ መንግሥት ዕዝራ የሠራያ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.text_amharic: የዓዛርያስ ልጅ፥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ፥ የሰሎም ልጅ፥ የሳዶቅ ልጅ፥ የአኪጦብ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.text_amharic: የአማርያ ልጅ፥ የዓዛርያስ ልጅ፥ የመራዮት ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.text_amharic: የዘራእያ ልጅ፥ የኦዚ ልጅ፥ የቡቂ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
verses.text_amharic: የአቢሱ ልጅ፥ የፊንሐስ ልጅ፥ የአልዓዛር ልጅ፥ የታላቁ ካህን የአሮን ልጅ፥ ይህ ዕዝራ ከባቢሎን ወጣ፤

verses.text_english: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በሰጠው በሙሴ ሕግ ፈጣን ጸሐፊ ነበረ፤ የአምላኩም የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረችና ንጉሡ የሻውን ሁሉ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And there went up of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ከካህናቱም ከሌዋውያኑም ከመዘምራኑም ከበረኞቹም ከናታኒምም በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ በሰባተኛው ዓመት አያሌዎች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which in the seventh year of the king.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም በሰባተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: For upon the first of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአንደኛው ቀን ከባቢሎን ሊወጣ ጀመረ፥ መልካሚቱም የአምላኩ እጅ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረችና በአምስተኛ ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ዕዝራም የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ይፈልግና ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ለእስራኤልም ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን ያስተምር ዘንድ ልቡን አዘጋጅቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now this the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ቃልና ለእስራኤል የሆነውን ሥርዓት ይጽፍ ለነበረው ለጸሐፊው ለካህኑ ለዕዝራ የሰጠው የደብዳቤው ግልባጭ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect , and at such a time.
verses.text_amharic: ከንጉሠ ነገሥት ከአርጤክስስ ለሰማይ አምላክ ሕግ ጸሐፊ ለካህኑ ለዕዝራ፥ ሙሉ ሰላም ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
verses.text_amharic: በመንግሥቴ ውስጥ ካሉ ከእስራኤል ሕዝብ ከካህናቱና ከሌዋውያኑም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄድ ዘንድ የሚወድድ ሁሉ ከአንተ ጋር እንዲሄድ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which in thine hand;
verses.text_amharic: በእጅህ እንዳለችው እንደ አምላክህ ሕግ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን ትጐበኝ ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation in Jerusalem,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንና አማካሪዎቹም መኖሪያው በኢየሩሳሌም ለሆነው ለእስራኤል አምላክ በፈቃዳቸው ያቀረቡትን ብርና ወርቅ፥

verses.text_english: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which in Jerusalem:
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎንም አውራጃ ሁሉ የምታገኘውን ብርና ወርቅ ሁሉ፥ ሕዝቡና ካህናቱም በኢየሩሳሌም ላለው ለአምላካቸው ቤት በፈቃዳቸው የሚያቀርቡትን ትወስድ ዘንድ በንጉሡና በሰባቱ አማካሪዎች ተልከሃልና፤

verses.text_english: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በዚህ ገንዘብ ወደፈኖችንና አውራ በጎችን ጠቦቶችንም የእህላቸውንና የመጠጣቸውን ቍርባን ተግተህ ግዛ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ባለው በአምላካችሁ ቤት መሠዊያ ላይ አቅርባቸው።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀረውም ብርና ወርቅ አንተና ወንድሞችህ ለማድረግ ደስ የሚያሰኛችሁን ነገር እንደ አምላካችሁ ፈቃድ አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አምላክህም ቤት አገልግሎት የተሰጠህን ዕቃ በኢየሩሳሌም አምላክ ፊት አሳልፈህ ስጥ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow out of the king's treasure house.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በላይ ለማውጣት የሚያስፈልግህን ለአምላክህ ቤት የሚያሻውን ነገር ከንጉሡ ቤተ መዛግብት አውጣ።

verses.text_english: And I, I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ንጉሡ አርጤክስስ በወንዝ ማዶ ላሉት በጅሮንዶች ሁሉ ይህን ትእዛዝ ሰጥቻለሁ። የሰማይ አምላክ ሕግ ጸሐፊ ካህኑ ዕዝራ ከእናንተ የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ አዘጋጁለት፤

verses.text_english: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing .
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መቶ መክሊት ብርም ቢሆን፥ እስከ መቶ የቆሬስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ፥ እስከ መቶም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የወይን ጠጅ፥ እስከ መቶም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ዘይት ቢሆን፥ ጨውም ያለ ልክ ቢሆን ስጡ።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡና በልጆቹ መንግሥት ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይሆን፥ የሰማይ አምላክ ያዘዘው ሁሉ ለሰማይ አምላክ ቤት በሙሉ ይደረግ።

verses.text_english: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በካህናቱና በሌዋውያን በመዘምራኑም በበረኞቹም በናታኒምም በዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሚሠሩ አገልጋዮች ላይ ግብርና ቀረጥ መጥንም እንዳይጣል ብለን እናስታውቃችኋለን።

verses.text_english: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know not.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ዕዝራ፥ በእጅህ እንዳለው እንደ አምላክህ ጥበብ መጠን በወንዝ ማዶ ባሉ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የአምላክህን ሕግ በሚያውቁ ሁሉ ላይ ይፈርዱ ዘንድ ዳኞችንና ፈራጆች አስነሣ፤ የማያውቁትንም አስተምሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክህንም ሕግ፥ የንጉሡንም ሕግ በማያደርግ ሁሉ ላይ ሞት ወይም ስደት ወይም ገንዘብን መወረስ ወይም ግዞት በፍጥነት ይፈረድበት።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which in Jerusalem:
These now the chief of their fathers, and the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ መንግሥት ከእኔ ጋር ከባቢሎን የወጡ የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው ትውልዳቸውም ይህ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊንሐስ ልጆች ጌርሶን፥ ከኢታምር ልጆች ዳንኤል፥ ከዳዊት ልጆች ሐጡስ፥ ከሴኬንያ ልጆች፥

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ከፋሮስ ልጆቾ ዘካርያስ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር መቶ አምሳ ወንዶች በትውልድ ተቈጠሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
verses.text_amharic: ከፋሐት ሞዓብ ልጆች የዘራእያ ልጅ ኤሊሆዔናይ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴኬንያ ልጆች የየሕዚኤል ልጅ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሦስት መቶ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓዲን ልጆች የዮናታን ልጅ ዔቤድ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አምሳ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤላም ልጆች የጎቶልያ ልጅ የሻያ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሰባ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
verses.text_amharic: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች የሚካኤል ልጅ ዝባድያ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሰማንያ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢዮአብ ልጆች የይሒኤል ልጅ አብድዩ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ አሥራ ስምንት ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰሎሚት ልጆች የዮሲፍያ ልጅ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር መቶ ስድሳ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤባይ ልጆች የቤባይ ልጅ ዘካርያስ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሀያ ስምንት ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓዝጋድ ልጆች የሃቃጣን ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር መቶ አሥር ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
verses.text_amharic: ከኋለኞቹ ከአዶኒቃም ልጆች ስማቸው ይህ ነው፤ ኤሊፋላት፥ ይዑኤል፥ ሸማያ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ስድሳ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.text_amharic: ከበጉዋይ ልጆች ዑታይና ዘቡድ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሰባ ወንዶች።

verses.text_english: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አኅዋም ወደሚፈስስ ወንዝ ሰበሰብኋቸው፥ በዚያም ሦስት ቀን ሰፈርን፤ ሕዝቡንና ካህናቱን ስቈጥራቸው በዚያ ከሌዊ ልጆች ማንንም አላገኘሁም።

verses.text_english: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አለቆቹም ወደ አልዓዛር፥ ወደ አርኤል፥ ወደ ሸማያ፥ ወደ ኤልናታን፥ ወደ ያሪብ፥ ወደ ኤልናታን፥ ወደ ናታን፥ ወደ ዘካርያስ፥ ወደ ሜሱላም፥ ደግሞም ወደ አዋቂዎቹ ወደ ዮያሪብና ወደ ኤልናታን ላክሁ።

verses.text_english: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.text_amharic: በካሲፍያ ስፍራ ወደ ነበረው ወደ አለቃው ወደ አዶ ላክኋቸው፤ ለአምላካችን ቤት አገልጋዮችን ያመጡልን ዘንድ በካሲፍያ ስፍራ ለሚኖሩት ለአዶና ለወንድሞቹ ለናታኒም የሚነግሩአቸውን በአፋቸው አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.text_amharic: በላያችንም መልካም በሆነው በአምላካችን እጅ ከእስራኤል ልጅ ከሌዊ ልጅ ከሞሖሊ ልጆች ወገን የነበረውን አስተዋይ ሰው ሰራብያን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አሥራ ስምንቱን ልጆቹንና ወንድሞቹን አመጡልን።

verses.text_english: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሐሸብያን ከእርሱም ጋር ከሜራሪ ልጆች ወገን የነበረውን የሻያንና ሀያውን ወንድሞቹንና ልጆቻቸውን።

verses.text_english: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋውያንንም እንዲያገለግሉ ዳዊትና አለቆቹ ከሰጡአቸው ናታኒም ውስጥ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ናታኒም አመጡ፤ እነዚህም ሁሉ በስም በስማቸው ተጠሩ።

verses.text_english: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላካችን ፊት ራሳችንን እናዋርድ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱም የቀናውን መንገድ ለእኛና ለልጆቻችን ለንብረታችንም ሁሉ እንለምን ዘንድ በዚያ በአኅዋ ወንዝ አጠገብ ጾም አወጅሁ።

verses.text_english: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath against all them that forsake him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም። የአምላካችን እጅ በሚሹት ሁሉ ላይ ለመልካም ነው፤ ኃይሉና ቍጣው ግን እርሱን በሚተዉ ሁሉ ላይ ነው ብለን ተናግረን ነበርና በመንገድ ካለው ጠላት ያድኑን ዘንድ ጭፍራና ፈረሰኞች ከንጉሡ እለምን ዘንድ አፍሬ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ነገር ጾምን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመንን፤ እርሱም ተለመነን።

verses.text_english: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናቱም አለቆች አሥራ ሁለት ሰዎችን፥ ሰራብያንና ሐሸቢያን ከእነርሱም ጋር አሥር ወንድሞቻቸውን ለየሁ፤

verses.text_english: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel present, had offered:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡና አማካሪዎቹ አለቆቹም በዚያም የተገኙት እስራኤል ሁሉ ያቀረቡትን ለአምላካችን ቤት የቀረበውን ብሩንና ወርቁን ዕቃውንም መዝኜ ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, of gold an hundred talents;
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት መቶ አምሳ መክሊት ብር፥ አንድ መቶም መክሊት የብር ዕቃዎች፥ አንድ መቶም መክሊት ወርቅ፥

verses.text_english: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
verses.text_amharic: ሀያም ባለሺህ ዳሪክ የወርቅ ጽዋዎች፥ ሁለትም እንደ ወርቅ የከበሩ ከጥሩ ከሚያንጸባርቅ ናስ የተሠሩ ዕቃዎች መዝኜ በእጃቸው ሰጠሁ።

verses.text_english: And I said unto them, Ye holy unto the LORD; the vessels holy also; and the silver and the gold a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። እናንተ ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀድሳችኋል፥ ዕቃዎቹም ቅዱስ ናቸው፤ ብሩና ወርቁም ለአባቶቻችን አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃድ የቀረበ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Watch ye, and keep , until ye weigh before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በካህናትና በሌዋውያን አለቆች በእስራኤልም አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ፊት በኢየሩሳሌም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ጓዳዎች ውስጥ እስክትመዝኑ ድረስ ተግታችሁ ጠብቁ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ አምላካችን ቤት ይወስዱት ዘንድ ብሩንና ወርቁን ዕቃዎቹንም በሚዛን ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ቀን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንሄድ ዘንድ ከአኅዋ ወንዝ ተነሣን የአምላካችንም እጅ በላያችን ነበረ፥ በመንገድም ከጠላትና ከሚሸምቅ ሰው እጅ አዳነን።

verses.text_english: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደረስን፥ በዚያም ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጥን።

verses.text_english: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ቀን ብሩና ወርቁ ዕቃዎቹም በአምላካችን ቤት በካህኑ በኦርዮ ልጅ በሜሪሞት እጅ ተመዘኑ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የፊንሐስ ልጅ አልዓዛር ነበረ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሌዋውያን የኢያሱ ልጅ ዮዛባትና የቢንዊ ልጅ ኖዓድያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: By number by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በቍጥርና በሚዛን ተመዘነ፤ ሚዛኑም ሁሉ በዚያን ጊዜ ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats a sin offering: all a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከምርኮም የወጡት ምርኮኞች ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ስለ እስራኤል ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ ዘጠና ስድስትም አውራ በጎች፥ ሰባ ሰባትም ጠቦቶች፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አሥራ ሁለት አውራ ፍየሎች አቀረቡ። ይህ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡንም ትእዛዝ በወንዙ ማዶ ላሉት ለንጉሡ ሹማምቶችና ገዦች ሰጡ፤ እነርሱም ሕዝቡንና የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አገዙ።

verses.text_english: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, according to their abominations, of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ከተፈጸመ በኋላ አለቆቹ ወደ እኔ ቀርበው። የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ካህናቱም ሌዋውያኑም እንደ ከነዓናውያን እንደ ኬጢያውያን እንደ ፌርዛውያን እንደ ኢያቡሳውያን እንደ አሞናውያን እንደ ሞዓባውያን እንደ ግብጻውያንና እንደ አሞራውያን ርኵሰት ያደርጋሉ እንጂ ከምድር አሕዛብ አልተለዩም፤

verses.text_english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሳቸውና ለልጆቻቸውም ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ወስደዋል፥ የተቀደሰውንም ዘር ከምድር አሕዛብ ጋር ደባልቀዋል፤ አስቀድሞም አለቆቹና ሹማምቶቹ በዚህ መተላለፍ መጀመሪያ ሆነዋል አሉኝ።

verses.text_english: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር በሰማሁ ጊዜ ልብሴንና መጐናጸፊያዬን ቀደድሁ፥ የራሴንና የጢሜንም ጠጉር ነጨሁ፥ ደንግጬም ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.text_english: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምርኮኞቹም መተላለፍ የእስራኤልን አምላክ ቃል የሚፈሩ ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ተሰበሰቡ፤ እኔም እስከ ሠርክ መሥዋዕት ድረስ ደንግጬ ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.text_english: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God,
verses.text_amharic: በሠርክም መሥዋዕት ጊዜ ልብሴና መጐናጸፊያዬ እንደ ተቀደደ ሆኖ ከመዋረዴ ተነሣሁ፤ በጕልበቴም ተንበርክኬ ወደ አምላኬ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጄን ዘረጋሁ።

verses.text_english: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አልሁ። አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ኃጢአታችን በራሳችን ላይ በዝቶአልና፥ በደላችንም ወደ ሰማይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፊቴን ወደ አንተ አነሣ ዘንድ አፍራለሁ፥ እፈራማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Since the days of our fathers we in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as this day.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቶቻችን ዘመን ጀምረን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እጅግ በድለናል፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው ስለ ኃጢአታችን እኛና ንጉሦቻችን ካህናቶቻችንም ለሰይፍና ለምርኮ ለብዝበዛና ለእፍረት በምድር ነገሥታት እጅ ተጣልን።

verses.text_english: And now for a little space grace hath been from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ቅሬታ ይተውልን ዘንድ፥ በተቀደሰውም ስፍራው ችንካርን ይሰጠን ዘንድ፥ አምላካችንም ዓይናችንን ያበራ ዘንድ፥ በባርነትም ሳለን ጥቂት የሕይወት መታደስን ይሰጠን ዘንድ ለጥቂት ጊዜ ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔር ሞገስ ተሰጥቶናል።

verses.text_english: For we bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች ነንና፥ አምላካችን ግን በባርነታችን አልተወንም፤ የሕይወት መታደስን ይሰጠን ዘንድ፥ የአምላካችንንም ቤት እንሠራ ዘንድ፥ የተፈታውንም እንጠግን ዘንድ፥ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌምም ቅጥር ይደረግልን ዘንድ በፋርስ ነገሥታት ፊት ምሕረቱን ሰጠን።

verses.text_english: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ክፉ ሥራችንና ስለ ታላቁ በደላችን ካገኘን ነገር ሁሉ በኋላ፥ አንተ አምላካችን እንደ ኃጢአታችን ብዛት አልቀሠፍኸንም ነገር ግን ቅሬታን ሰጠኸን።

verses.text_english: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave for an inheritance to your children for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ተመልሰን ትእዛዝህን እናፈርስ ዘንድ፥ ርኩስ ሥራን ከሚሠሩ ከእነዚህም አሕዛብ ጋር እንገባ ዘንድ ይገባናልን? አንተስ ቅሬታ የሌለንና የማናመልጥ እስክንሆን ድረስ እንድታጠፋን አትቈጣንም?

verses.text_english: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities , and hast given us deliverance as this;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው እኛ አምልጠን ቀርተናል፤ እነሆ በፊትህ በበደላችን አለን፤ ስለዚህ በፊትህ ሊቆም የሚችል የለም።

verses.text_english: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
verses.text_amharic: ዕዝራም እያለቀሰና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት እየወደቀ በጸለየና በተናዘዘ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ የወንድና የሴት የሕፃናትም እጅግ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰበ፤ ሕዝቡም እጅግ አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤላም ልጆች ወገን የነበረም የይሒኤል ልጅ ሴኬንያ ዕዝራን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። አምላካችንን በድለናል፤ የምድርን አሕዛብ እንግዶች ሴቶችን አግብተናል፤ አሁን ግን ስለዚህ ነገር ገና ለእስራኤል ተስፋ አለ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እንደ ጌታዬና የአምላካችንን ትእዛዝ እንደሚፈሩት ምክር፥ ሴቶችን ሁሉ ከእነርሱም የተወለዱትን እንሰድድ ዘንድ ከአምላካችን ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እናድርግ፤ እንደ ሕጉም ይደረግ።

verses.text_english: Arise; for matter unto thee: we also with thee: be of good courage, and do .
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ነገር ለአንተ ይገባልና፥ እኛም ከአንተ ጋር ነንና ተነሣ፥ አይዞህ፥ አድርገው።

verses.text_english: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
verses.text_amharic: ዕዝራም ተነሣ፤ አለቆቹንና ካህናቱን ሌዋውያኑንም እስራኤልንም ሁሉ እንደዚህ ቃል ያደርጉ ዘንድ አማለ፤ እነርሱም ማሉ።

verses.text_english: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
verses.text_amharic: ዕዝራም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት ተነሥቶ ወደ ኤልያሴብ ልጅ ወደ ዮሐናን ጓዳ ገባ፤ ስለ ምርኮኞቹም ኃጢአት ያለቅስ ነበርና ገብቶ እንጀራ አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም።

verses.text_english: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮኞቹም ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲሰበሰቡ፥ እንደ አለቆቹና እንደ ሽማግሌዎችም ምክር በሦስት ቀን ውስጥ ያልመጣ ሁሉ ንብረቱ ሁሉ እንዲወረስ፥ እርሱም ከምርኮው ጉባኤ እንዲለይ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አዋጅ ነገሩ።

verses.text_english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of matter, and for the great rain.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስት ቀንም ሳያልፍ በዘጠኝኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያኛው ቀን የይሁዳና የብንያም ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ስለዚህ ነገርና ስለ ታላቁ ዝናብ እየተንቀጠቀጡ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት ባለው አደባባይ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ዕዝራ ተነሥቶ። ተላልፋችኋል፤ የእስራኤልን በደል ታበዙ ዘንድ እንግዶችን ሴቶች አግብታችኋል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ለአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ተናዘዙ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኘውንም አድርጉ፤ ከምድርም አሕዛብና ከእንግዶች ሴቶች ተለዩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም ሁሉ በታላቅ ድምፅ መልሰው እንዲህ አሉ። እንደ ተናገርኸን እናደርግ ዘንድ ይገባናል።

verses.text_english: But the people many, and a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሕዝቡ ቍጥር ብዙ ነው፥ ጊዜውም የትልቅ ዝናብ ጊዜ ነው፥ በሜዳም ልንቆም አንችልም፤ በዚህም ነገር እጅግ በድለናልና ይህ ሥራ የአንድ ወይም የሁለት ቀን ሥራ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቻችንም በጉባኤው ሁሉ ፋንታ ይቁሙ፤ ስለዚህም ነገር የአምላካችን ጽኑ ቍጣ ከእኛ ይመለስ ዘንድ እንግዶቹን ሴቶች ያገቡት በከተሞቻችን ያሉት ሁሉ በተቀጠረው ጊዜ ይምጡ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር የከተማ ሁሉ ሽማግሌዎችና ፈራጆች ይምጡ።

verses.text_english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this : and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የአሣሄል ልጅ ዮናታንና የቴቁዋ ልጅ የሕዝያ ይህን ነገር ተቃወሙ፤ ሜሱላምና ሌዋዊውም ሳባታይ ረዱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮኞቹም እንዲህ አደረጉ፤ ካህኑ ዕዝራም የአባቶችም ቤቶች አለቆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ተለዩ፥ ሁሉም በየስማቸው ተጻፉ፤ በአሥረኛውም ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ነገሩን ይመረምሩ ዘንድ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መጀመሪያው ወር እስከ መጀመሪያው ቀን ድረስ ሠረተው እንግዶቹን ሴቶች ያገቡትን ሰዎች ሁሉ መርምረው ጨረሱ።

verses.text_english: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: , of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናቱም ወገን ልጆች እንግዶቹን ሴቶች ያገቡ ሰዎች ተገኙ፤ ከኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ ከኢያሱ ልጆችና ከወንድሞቹ፥ መዕሤያ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ያሪብ፥ ጎዶልያስ።

verses.text_english: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and guilty, a ram of the flock for their trespass.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቶቻቸውን ይፈቱ ዘንድ እጃቸውን ሰጡ፤ ስለ በደላቸውም ከመንጋው አንድ አውራ በግ ለበደል መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢሜር ልጆችም፤ አናኒና ዝባድያ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.text_amharic: ከካሪም ልጆችም መዕሤያ፥ ኤልያስ፥ ሸማያ፥ ይሒኤል፥ ዖዝያ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.text_amharic: ከፋስኩር ልጆችም፤ ኤልዮዔናይ፥ መዕሤያ፥ ይስማኤል፥ ናትናኤል፥ ዮዛባት፥ ኤልዓሣ።

verses.text_english: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዋውያንም፤ ዮዛባት፥ ሰሜኢ፥ ቆሊጣስ የሚባል ቆልያ፥ ፈታያ፥ ይሁዳ፥ አልዓዛር።

verses.text_english: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.text_amharic: ከመዘምራንም፤ ኤልያሴብ፤ ከበረኞችም፤ ሰሎም፥ ጤሌም፥ ኡሪ።

verses.text_english: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ከፋሮስ ልጆች፤ ራምያ፥ ይዝያ፥ መልክያ፥ ሚያሚን፥ አልዓዛር፥ መልክያ፥ በናያስ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤላም ልጆችም፤ ሙታንያ፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ይሒኤል፥ አብዲ፥ ይሬሞት፥ ኤልያ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛቱዕ ልጆችም፤ ዔሊዮዔናይ፥ ኢልያሴብ፥ ሙታንያ፥ ይሬሞት፥ ዛባድ፥ ዓዚዛ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤባይ ልጆችም፤ ይሆሐናን፥ ሐናንያ፥ ዘባይ፥ አጥላይ።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.text_amharic: ከባኒ ልጆችም፤ ሜሱላም፥ መሉክ፥ ዓዳያ፥ ያሱብ፥ ሸዓል፥ ራሞት።

verses.text_english: And of the sons of Pahathmoab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሐት ሞዓብ ልጆችም፤ ዓድና፥ ክላል፥ በናያስ፥ መዕሤያ፥ ሙታንያ፥ ባስልኤል፥ ቢንዊ፥ ምናሴ።

verses.text_english: And the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.text_amharic: ከካሪም ልጆችም፤ አልዓዛር፥ ይሺያ፥ መልክያ፥

verses.text_english: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.
verses.text_amharic: ሸማያ፥ ስምዖን፥ ብንያም፥ መሉክ፥ ሰማራያ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
verses.text_amharic: ከሐሱም ልጆችም፤ መትናይ፥ መተታ፥ ዛባድ፥ ኤሊፋላት፥ ይሬማይ፥ ምናሴ፥ ሰሜኢ።

verses.text_english: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.text_amharic: ከባኒ ልጆችም፤ መዕዳይ፥ ዓምራም፥

verses.text_english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
verses.text_amharic: ኡኤል፥ በናያስ፥ ቤድያ፥ ኬልቅያ

verses.text_english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
verses.text_amharic: መትናይ፥ የዕሡ፥ ባኒ፥ ቢንዊ፥ ሰሜኢ፥

verses.text_english: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.text_amharic: ሴሴይ፥ ሸራይ፥ ኤዝርኤል፥ ሰሌምያ፥ ሰማራያ፥ ሰሎም፥ አማርያ፥ ዮሴፍ።

verses.text_english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ እንግዶቹን ሚስቶች አግብተው ነበር፤ ከእነዚህም ሚስቶች አያሌዎቹ ልጆችን ወልደው ነበር።

verses.text_english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
verses.text_amharic: የሐካልያ ልጅ የነህምያ ቃል። በሀያኛው ዓመት በካሴሉ ወር እንዲህ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በሱሳ ግንብ ሳለሁ፥ ከወንድሞቼ አንዱ አናኒ ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎች ሰዎች ከይሁዳ መጡ፤ እኔም የዳኑትን ከምርኮ የተረፉትን የአይሁድን ነገር የኢየሩሳሌምንም ነገር ጠየቅኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። በዚያ ስፍራ ያሉት ከምርኮ የተረፉት ቅሬታዎች በታላቅ መከራና ስድብ አሉ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምም ቅጥር ፈርሶአል፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል አሉኝ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ቃል በሰማሁ ጊዜ ተቀምጬ አለቀስሁ፥ አያሌ ቀንም አዝን ነበር፤ በሰማይም አምላክ ፊት እጾምና እጸልይ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አልሁ። አቤቱ የሰማይ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለሚወድዱህና ትእዛዝህን ለሚያደርጉ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥ ታላቅና የተፈራህ አምላክ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሪያህ ዛሬ በፊትህ ስለ ባሪያዎችህ ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች ሌሊትና ቀን የምጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ ጆሮህ ያድምጥ፥ ዓይኖችህም ይከፈቱ፤ በአንተ ላይም ያደረግነውን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ኃጢአት እናዘዝልሃለሁ፤ እኔና የአባቴም ቤት በድለናል።

verses.text_english: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም በአንተ ላይ እጅግ ክፉ ሠርተናል፤ ለባሪያህም ለሙሴ ያዘዝኸውን ትእዛዝና ሥርዓት ሕግም አልጠበቅንም።

verses.text_english: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

But ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ብትተላለፉ በአሕዛብ መካከል እበትናችኋለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ ብትመለሱ ግን ትእዛዜንም ብትጠብቁ ብታደርጓትም፥ ከእናንተ ሰዎች እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ ድረስ ምንም ቢበተኑ ከዚያ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ስሜም ይኖርበት ዘንድ ወደ መረጥሁት ስፍራ አመጣቸዋለሁ ብለህ ለባሪያህ ለሙሴ ያዘዝኸውን ቃል እባክህ አስብ።

verses.text_english: Now these thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም በታላቅ ኃይልህና በብርቱ እጅህ የተቤዠሃቸው ባሪያዎችህና ሕዝብህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጆሮህ የባሪያህን ጸሎት፥ ስምህንም ይፈሩ ዘንድ የሚወድዱትን፥ የባሪያዎችህን ጸሎት ያድምጥ፤ ዛሬም ለባሪያህ አከናውንለት፥ በዚህም ሰው ፊት ምሕረትን ስጠው። እኔም ለንጉሡ ጠጅ አሳላፊው ነበርሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, wine before him: and I took up the wine, and gave unto the king. Now I had not been sad in his presence.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ በሀያኛው ዓመት በኒሳን ወር የወይን ጠጅ በፊቱ በነበረ ጊዜ ጠጁን አንሥቼ ለንጉሡ ሰጠሁት። ቀድሞ ግን በፊቱ ያለ ኃዘን እኖር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why thy countenance sad, seeing thou not sick? this nothing but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ሳትታመም ፊትህ ለምን አዘነ? ይህ የልብ ኅዘን ነው እንጂ ሌላ ነገር አይደለም አለኝ። እጅግም ብዙ አድርጌ ፈራሁ።

verses.text_english: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም። ንጉሡ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ፤ የአባቶቼ መቃብር ያለባት ከተማ ተፈትታለችና፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት ተቃጥለዋልና ፊቴ ስለ ምን አይዘን? አልሁት።

verses.text_english: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም። ምን ትለምነኛለህ? አለኝ። እኔም ወደ ሰማይ አምላክ ጸለይሁ።

verses.text_english: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም። ንጉሡን ደስ ቢያሰኝህ፥ ባሪያህም በፊትህ ሞገስ ቢያገኝ፥ እሠራው ዘንድ ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ አባቶቼ መቃብር ከተማ ስደደኝ አልሁት።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.text_amharic: ንግሥቲቱም በአጠገቡ ተቀምጣ ሳለች ንጉሡ። መንገድህ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ይሆናል? መቼስ ትመለሳለህ? አለኝ። ንጉሡም ይሰድደኝ ዘንድ ደስ አለው፤ እኔም ዘመኑን ቀጠርሁለት።

verses.text_english: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም። ንጉሡ ደስ ቢለው፥ እስከ ይሁዳ አገር እንዲያደርሱኝ በወንዝ ማዶ ላሉት ገዦች ደብዳቤ ይሰጠኝ፤

verses.text_english: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም አጠገብ ላለው ለግንብ በሮች፥ ለከተማውም ቅጥር፥ ለምገባበትም ቤት እንጨት እንዲሰጠኝ ለንጉሡ ዱር ጠባቂ ለአሳፍ ደብዳቤ ይሰጠኝ አልሁት። ንጉሡም በእኔ ላይ መልካም እንደ ሆነችው እንደ አምላኬ እጅ ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
verses.text_amharic: በወንዙም ማዶ ወዳሉት አለቆች መጥቼ የንጉሡን ደብዳቤ ሰጠኋቸው ንጉሡም ከእኔ ጋር የሠራዊቱን አለቆችና ፈረሰኞች ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሖሮናዊውም ሰንባላጥና ባሪያው አሞናዊ ጦብያ ለእስራኤል ልጆች መልካምን ነገር የሚሻ ሰው እንደ መጣ በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ተበሳጩ።

verses.text_english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ደረስሁ፥ በዚያም ሦስት ቀን ያህል ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.text_english: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊትም ተነሣሁ፥ ከእኔም ጋር አያሌ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለኢየሩሳሌም አደርገው ዘንድ በልቤ ያኖረውን ለማንም አላስታወቅሁም፤ ተቀምጬበት ከነበረው እንስሳ በቀር ከእኔ ጋር ምንም እንስሳ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
verses.text_amharic: በሸለቆውም በር ወጣሁ፥ ወደ ዘንዶውም ምንጭና ወደ ጕድፍ መጣያው በር ሄድሁ፤ የፈረሰውንም የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር፥ በእሳትም የተቃጠሉትን በሮችዋን ተመለከትሁ።

verses.text_english: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but no place for the beast under me to pass.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምንጩም በርና ወደ ንጉሡ መዋኛ አለፍሁ፤ ተቀምጬበትም የነበረው እንስሳ የሚያልፍበት ስፍራ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and returned.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊትም በፈፋው በኩል ወጥቼ ቅጥሩን ተመለከትሁ፤ ዘወርም ብዬ በሸለቆው በር ገባሁ፥ እንዲሁም ተመለስሁ።

verses.text_english: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
verses.text_amharic: ሹማምቱ ግን ወዴት እንደ ሄድሁ፥ ምን እንዳደረግሁም አላወቁም ነበር፤ ለአይሁድና ለካህናቱ፥ ለታላላቆችና ለሹማምቱም፥ ሥራም ይሠሩ ለነበሩት ለሌሎች ገና አልተናገርሁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we in, how Jerusalem waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። እኛ ያለንበትን ጕስቍልና ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ፈረሰች፥ በሮችዋም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠሉ ታያላችሁ፤ አሁንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ መሳለቂያ እንዳንሆን ኑና የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር እንሥራ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for good .
verses.text_amharic: የአምላኬም እጅ በእኔ ላይ መልካም እንደሆነች፥ ንጉሡም የነገረኝን ቃል ነገርኋቸው። እነርሱም። እንነሣና እንሥራ አሉ። እጃቸውንም ለበጎ ሥራ አበረቱ።

verses.text_english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard , they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
verses.text_amharic: ሖሮናዊውም ሰንባላጥ፥ ባሪያውም አሞናዊው ጦብያ፥ ዓረባዊውም ጌሳም በሰሙ ጊዜ በንቀት ሳቁብን፥ ቀላል አድርገውንም። ይህ የምታደርጉት ነገር ምንድር ነው? በውኑ በንጉሡ ላይ ትሸፍቱ ዘንድ ትወድዳላችሁን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም መልሼ። የሰማይ አምላክ ያከናውንልናል፥ እኛም ባሪያዎቹ ተነሥተን እንሠራለን፤ እናንተ ግን በኢየሩሳሌም እድል ፈንታና መብት መታሰቢያም የላችሁም አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቁም ካህን ኤልያሴብ ወንድሞቹም ካህናት ተነሥተው የበግ በር ሠሩ፤ ቀደሱትም፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፤ እስከ ሃሜአ ግንብና እስከ ሐናንኤል ግንብ ድረስ ቀደሱት።

verses.text_english: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገቡ የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች ሠሩ፤ በአጠገባቸውም የአምሪ ልጅ ዘኩር ሠራ።

verses.text_english: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የሃስናአ ልጆችም የዓሣ በር ሠሩ፤ ሰረገሎቹን አኖሩ፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም የአቆስ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት አደሰ። በአጠገባቸውም የሜሴዜቤል ልጅ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አደሰ። በአጠገባቸውም የበዓና ልጅ ሳዶቅ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም ቴቁሐውያን አደሱ፤ ታላላቆቻቸው ግን ለጌታቸው ሥራ አንገታቸውን አላዋረዱም።

verses.text_english: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የፋሴሐ ልጅ ዮዳሄና የበሶድያ ልጅ ሜሱላም አሮጌውን በር አደሱ፤ ሰረገሎቹን አኖሩ፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም ገባዖናዊው መልጥያና ሜሮኖታዊው ያዶን፥ የወንዙም ማዶ አለቃ ግዛት የሆኑ የገባዖንና የምጽጳ ሰዎች አደሱ።

verses.text_english: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም ወርቅ አንጥረኛው የሐርሃያ ልጅ ዑዝኤል አደሰ። በአጠገቡም ከሽቱ ቀማሚዎች የነበረ ሐናንያ አደሰ፤ እስከ ሰፊው ቅጥር ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌምን ጠገኑ።

verses.text_english: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም የኢየሩሳሌም ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ የሆር ልጅ ረፋያ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም የኤርማፍ ልጅ ይዳያ በቤቱ አንጻር ያለውን አደሰ። በአጠገቡም የአሰበንያ ልጅ ሐጡስ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
verses.text_amharic: የካሪም ልጅ መልክያ፥ የፈሐት ሞዓብ ልጅም አሱብ ሌላውን ክፍልና የእቶኑን ግንብ አደሱ።

verses.text_english: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም የኢየሩሳሌም ግዛት እኵሌታና የመንደሮችዋ አለቃ የአሎኤስ ልጅ ሰሎም አደሰ።

verses.text_english: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
verses.text_amharic: ሐኖንና የዛኖዋ ሰዎችም የሸለቆውን በር አደሱ፤ ሠሩት፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆሙ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረጉ፤ ደግሞም እስከ ጕድፍ መጣያው በር ድረስ አንድ ሺህ ክንድ የሚሆን ቅጥር ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Bethhaccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የቤትሐካሪምም ግዛት አለቃ የሬካብ ልጅ መልክያ የጕድፍ መጣያውን በር አደሰ፤ ሠራው፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆመ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረገ።

verses.text_english: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.text_amharic: የምጽጳም ግዛት አለቃ የኮልሖዜ ልጅ ሰሎም የምንጩን በር አደሰ፤ ሠራው፥ ከደነውም፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም አቆመ፥ ቍልፎቹንና መወርወሪያዎቹንም አደረገ፤ ከዳዊትም ከተማ እስከሚወርደው ደረጃ ድረስ በንጉሡ አትክልት አጠገብ ያለውን የሼላን መዋኛ ቅጥር ሠራ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, unto over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቤትጹር ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ የዓዝቡቅ ልጅ ነህምያ በዳዊት መቃብር አንጻር እስካለው ስፍራ፥ እስከ ተሠራውም መዋኛ፥ እስከ ኃያላኑም ቤት ድረስ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ ሌዋውያንና የባኒ ልጅ ሬሁም አደሱ። በአጠገባቸውም የቅዒላ ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ ሐሸብያ ስለ ግዛቱ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቅዒላ ግዛት እኵሌታ አለቃ የኤንሐዳድ ልጅ በዋይ ወንድሞቹም አደሱ።

verses.text_english: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning .
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገቡም የምጽጳ አለቃ የኢያሱ ልጅ ኤጽር በማዕዘኑ አጠገብ በጦር መሣሪያ ቤት አንጻር ሌላውን ክፍል አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የዘባይ ልጅ ባሮክ ከማዕዘኑ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ካህን እስከ ኤልያሴብ ቤት መግቢያ ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል ተግቶ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የአቆስ ልጅ የኦርዮ ልጅ ሜሪሞት ከኤልያሴብ ቤት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ኤልያሴብ ቤት መጨረሻ ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል አደሰ።

verses.text_english: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቈላው ሰዎች ካህናቱ አደሱ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም በኋላ ብንያምና አሱብ በቤታቸው አንጻር ያለውን አደሱ። ከእነርሱም በኋላ የሐናንያ ልጅ የመዕሤያ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ በቤቱ አጠገብ ያለውን አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning , even unto the corner.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ የኤንሐደድ ልጅ ቢንዊ ከዓዛርያስ ቤት ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል አደሰ።

verses.text_english: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning , and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
verses.text_amharic: የኡዛይ ልጅ ፋላል በማዕዘኑ አንጻር ያለውንና በዘበኞች አደባባይ አጠገብ ከላይኛው የንጉሡ ቤት ወጥቶ የቆመውን ግንብ ሠራ። ከእርሱም በኋላ የፋሮስ ልጅ ፈዳያ ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.
verses.text_amharic: ናታኒምም በዖፌል በውኃው በር አንጻር በምሥራቅ በኩል ወጥቶ በቆመው ግንብ አጠገብ እስካለው ስፍራ ድረስ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ ቴቁሐውያን ወጥቶ በቆመው በታላቁ ግንብ አንጻር ያለውን እስከ ዖፌል ቅጥር ድረስ ሌላውን ክፍል አደሱ።

verses.text_english: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈረሱ በር በላይ ካህናቱ እያንዳንዳቸው በየቤታቸው አንጻር አደሱ።

verses.text_english: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ በኋላ የኢሜር ልጅ ሳዶቅ በቤቱ አንጻር አደሰ። ከእርሱም በኋላ የምሥራቁን በር ጠባቂ የሴኬንያ ልጅ ሸማያ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ በኋላ የሰሌምያ ልጅ ሐናንያና የሴሌፍ ስድስተኛው ልጁ ሐኖን ሌላውን ክፍል አደሱ። ከዚያም በኋላ የበራክያ ልጅ ሜሱላም በጓዳው አንጻር ያለውን አደሰ።

verses.text_english: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም በኋላ ከወርቅ አንጥረኞቹ የነበረ መልክያ እስከ ናታኒምና እስከ ነጋዴዎቹ ቤት ድረስ በሐሚፍቃድ በር አንጻር ያለውን እስከ ማዕዘኑ መውጫ ድረስ አደሰ።

verses.text_english: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
verses.text_amharic: ከማዕዘኑም መውጫ ጀምረው እስከ በጉ በር ድረስ ወርቅ አንጥረኞችና ነጋዴዎች አደሱ።

verses.text_english: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: ሰንባላጥም ቅጥሩን እንደ ሠራን በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ ተበሳጨም፥ በአይሁድም አላገጠ።

verses.text_english: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
verses.text_amharic: በወንድሞቹና በሰማርያ ሠራዊትም ፊት። እነዚህ ደካሞች አይሁድ የሚሠሩት ምንድር ነው? ይተዉላቸዋልን? ይሠዋሉን? በአንድ ቀንስ ይጨርሳሉን? የተቃጠለውንስ ድንጋይ ከፍርስራሹ መልሰው ያድኑታልን? ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
verses.text_amharic: አሞናዊውም ጦብያ በአጠገቡ ቆሞ። በድንጋይ በሚሠሩት ቅጥራቸው ላይ ቀበሮ ቢመጣበት ያፈርሰዋል አለ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ተንቀናልና ስማ፤ ስድባቸውን በራሳቸው ላይ መልስባቸው፤ በምርኮ አገር ለብዝበዛ አሳልፈህ ስጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked to anger before the builders.
verses.text_amharic: በደላቸውንም አትክደን፥ ኃጢአታቸውም ከፊትህ አይደምሰስ፤ በሠራተኞች ፊት አስቆጥተውሃልና።

verses.text_english: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥሩንም ሠራን፤ ቅጥሩም ሁሉ እስከ እኵሌታው ድረስ ተጋጠመ፤ የሕዝቡም ልብ ለሥራው ጨከነ።

verses.text_english: But it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
verses.text_amharic: ሰንባላጥና ጦብያም ዓረባውያንም አሞናውያንም አሽዶዳውያንም የኢየሩሳሌም ቅጥር እየታደሰ እንደ ሄደ፥ የፈረሰውም ሊጠገን እንደ ተጀመረ በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጡ።

verses.text_english: And conspired all of them together to come to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
verses.text_amharic: መጥተውም ኢየሩሳሌምን ይወጉና ያሸብሩ ዘንድ ሁሉም በአንድነት ተማማሉ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አምላካችንም ጸለይን፥ ከእነርሱም የተነሣ በአንጻራቸው ተጠባባቂዎች በሌሊትና በቀን አደረግን።

verses.text_english: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም። የተሸካሚዎች ኃይል ደከመ፥ ፍርስራሹም ብዙ ነው፤ ቅጥሩንም እንሠራ ዘንድ አንችልም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቻችንም። ወደ መካከላቸው እስክንመጣና እስክንገድላቸው ድረስ ሥራቸውንም እስክናስተጓጕል ድረስ አያውቁምና አያዩም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us .
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገባቸውም የተቀመጡት አይሁድ መጥተው። ከስፍራው ሁሉ ይመጡብናል ብለው አሥር ጊዜ ነገሩን።

verses.text_english: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.text_amharic: ከቅጥሩም በስተ ኋላ በኩል ባለው በታችኛው ስፍራ ሰይፋቸውን ጦራቸውንም ቀስታቸውንም አስይዤ ሕዝቡን በየወገናቸው አቆምኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verses.text_amharic: አይቼም ተነሣሁ፥ ታላላቆቹንና ሹማምቱንም የቀሩትንም ሕዝብ። አትፍሩአቸው፤ ታላቁንና የተፈራውን ጌታ አስቡ፥ ስለ ወንድሞቻችሁም ስለ ወንዶችና ስለ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ስለ ሚስቶቻችሁም ስለ ቤቶቻችሁም ተዋጉ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቻችንም ይህ ነገር እንደ ደረሰልን፥ እግዚአብሔርም ምክራቸውን ከንቱ እንዳደረገው ሰሙ፤ እኛም ሁላችን ወደ ቅጥሩ እያንዳንዳችን ወደ ሥራችን ተመለስን።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass from that time forth, the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers behind all the house of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ቀን ጀምሮ እኵሌቶቹ ብላቴኖቼ ሥራ ይሠሩ ነበር፥ እኵሌቶቹም ጋሻና ጦር ቀስትና ጥሩርም ይዘው ነበር፤ አለቆቹም ከይሁዳ ቤት ሁሉ በኋላ ይቆሙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other held a weapon.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥሩንም የሚሠሩትና ተሸካሚዎቹ በአንድ እጃቸው ይሠሩ ነበር፥ በአንድ እጃቸውም የጦር መሣሪያቸውን ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and builded. And he that sounded the trumpet by me.
verses.text_amharic: አናጢዎቹም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ሰይፉን በወገቡ ታጥቆ ይሠራ ነበር፤ ቀንደ መለከትም የሚነፋ በአጠገቤ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
verses.text_amharic: ታላላቆቹንና ሹማምቱን የቀሩትንም ሕዝብ። ሥራው ታላቅና ሰፊ ነው፥ እኛም በቅጥሩ ላይ ተበታትነናል፥ አንዱም ከሁለተኛው ርቆአል፤

verses.text_english: In what place ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
verses.text_amharic: የቀንደ መለከቱን ድምፅ ወደምትሰሙበት ስፍራ ወደዚያ ወደ እኛ ተሰብሰቡ፤ አምላካችን ስለ እኛ ይዋጋል አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራውንም ሠራን ከማለዳ ወገግታም ጀምሮ ከዋክብት እስኪወጡ ድረስ እኵሌቶቹ ጦር ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በዚያ ጊዜ ሕዝቡን። ሁላችሁ ከብላቴኖቻችሁ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ እደሩ፤ በሌሊትም ጠባቂዎች ሁኑልን፥ በቀንም ሥሩ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, every one put them off for washing.
verses.text_amharic: እኔና ወንድሞቼም ብላቴኖቼም በኋላዬም የነበሩት ጠባቂዎች ልብሳችንን አናወልቅም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: በወንድሞቻቸውም በአይሁድ ላይ ትልቅ የሕዝቡና የሚስቶቻቸው ጩኸት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, many: therefore we take up corn , that we may eat, and live.
verses.text_amharic: አያሌዎቹም። ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችን ብዙዎች ናቸው፤ በልተንም በሕይወት እንድንኖር እህልን እንሸምት ይሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
verses.text_amharic: አያሌዎቹም። ከራብ የተነሣ እህልን እንሸምት ዘንድ እርሻችንና ወይናችንን ቤታችንንም አስይዘናል ይሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, our lands and vineyards.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎቹም። ለንጉሡ ግብር እርሻችንንና ወይናችንን አስይዘን ገንዘብ ተበድረናል፤

verses.text_english: Yet now our flesh as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and of our daughters are brought unto bondage : neither in our power ; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ሥጋችን እንደ ወንድሞቻችን ሥጋ፥ ልጆቻችንም እንደ ልጆቻቸው ናቸው፤ እነሆም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችን ባሪያዎች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰጥተናል፥ ከሴቶችም ልጆቻችን ባሪያዎች ሆነው የሚኖሩ አሉ፤ ታላላቆችም እርሻችንና ወይናችንን ይዘዋልና ልናድናቸው አንችልም ይሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ጩኸታቸውንና ይህን ቃል በሰማሁ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣሁ።

verses.text_english: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
verses.text_amharic: በልቤም አሰብሁ፥ ታላላቆቹንና ሹማምቱንም። ሁላችሁ እያንዳንዳችሁ ወለድ ትወስዳላችሁ ብዬ ተጣላኋቸው፤ ትልቅም ጉባኤ ሰበሰብሁባቸው።

verses.text_english: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing .
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ለአሕዛብ የተሸጡትን ወንድሞቻችንን አይሁድን በፈቃዳችን ተቤዠን፤ እናንተስ ወንድሞቻችሁን ትሸጣላችሁን? እነርሱስ ለእኛ የተሸጡ ይሆናሉን? አልኋቸው። እነርሱም ዝም አሉ፥ መልስም አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: Also I said, It not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አልሁ። የምታደርጉት ነገር መልካም አይደለም፤ ጠላቶቻችን አሕዛብ እንዳይሰድቡን አምላካችንን በመፍራት ትሄዱ ዘንድ አይገባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: I likewise, my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ደግሞ ወንድሞቼም ብላቴኖቼም ገንዘብና እህል ለእነርሱ አበድረናል፤ እባካችሁ፥ ይህን ወለድ እንተውላቸው።

verses.text_english: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻቸውንና ወይናቸውን ወይራቸውንና ቤታቸውንም ከእነርሱም የወሰዳችሁትን ገንዘቡንና እህሉን፥ ወይን ጠጁንና ዘይቱን ከመቶ እጅ አንድ እጅ እባካችሁ ዛሬ መልሱላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said they, We will restore , and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እንመልስላቸዋለን፥ ከእነርሱም ምንም አንሻም፤ እንደ ተናገርህ እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን አሉ። ካህናቱንም ጠርቼ እንደዚህ ነገር ያደርጉ ዘንድ አማልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ልብሴን አራገፍሁና። ይህን ነገር የማያደርገውን ሰው ከቤቱና ከሥራው እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ያራግፈው፤ እንዲሁም የተራገፈና ባዶ ይሁን አልሁ። ጉባኤውም ሁሉ። አሜን አሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመሰገኑ፤ ሕዝቡም እንደዚህ ነገር አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, , twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በይሁዳ ምድር ላይ አለቃ እሆን ዘንድ ካዘዘኝ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ከንጉሡ ከአርጤክስስ ከሀያኛው ዓመት እስከ ሠላሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት ድረስ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ያህል እኔና ወንድሞቼ ለአለቃ የሚገባውን ስንቅ አልበላንም።

verses.text_english: But the former governors that before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ አስቀድመው የነበሩት አለቆች ግን በሕዝቡ ላይ አክብደው ነበር፤ ስለ እንጀራውና ስለ ወይኑ አርባ ሰቅል ብር ይወስዱ ነበር፤ ሎሌዎቻቸውም ደግሞ በሕዝቡ ላይ ይሠለጥኑ ነበር፤ እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈራሁ እንዲህ አላደረግሁም።

verses.text_english: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants gathered thither unto the work.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አጥብቄ የቅጥሩን ሥራ ሠራሁ፥ እርሻም አልገዛንም፤ ብላቴኖቼም ሁሉ ወደዚያው ወደ ሥራው ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Moreover at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that about us.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በዙሪያችን ካሉት አሕዛብ ወደ እኛ ከመጡት ሌላ ከአይሁድና ከሹማምቱ መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች በገበታዬ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now which was prepared daily one ox six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
verses.text_amharic: ከወፎችም በቀር ለአንድ ቀን አንድ በሬና ስድስት የሰቡ በጎች፥ በአሥር በአሥር ቀንም ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት ወይን ጠጅ ይዘጋጅልኝ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አገዛዝ በሕዝቡ ላይ ከብዶ ነበርና ለአለቃ የሚገባውን ስንቅ አልሻም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Think upon me, my God, for good, to all that I have done for this people.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ ለበጎነት አስብልኝ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ቅጥሩን እንደ ሠራሁ፥ ከፍራሹም አንዳች እንዳልቀረበት ሰንባላጥና ጦብያ ዓረባዊውም ጌሳም የቀሩትም ጠላቶቻችን ሰሙ፤ ነገር ግን እስከዚያ ጊዜ ድረስ በበሮቹ ውስጥ ሳንቃዎቹን አላቆምሁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.text_amharic: ሰንባላጥና ጌሳም። መጥተህ በኦኖ ቈላ ውስጥ ባሉት መንደሮች እንገናኝ ብለው ላኩብኝ፤ ነገር ግን ክፉ ያደርጉብኝ ዘንድ ያስቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ትልቅ ሥራ እሠራለሁ፥ እወርድም ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤ ሥራውን ትቼ ወደ እናንተ በመውረዴ ስለ ምን ሥራው ይታጐላል? ብዬ መልእክተኞችን ላክሁባቸው።

verses.text_english: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ቃል አራት ጊዜ ላኩብኝ፤ እኔም እንደ ፊተኛው ቃል መለስሁላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
verses.text_amharic: ሰንባላጥም እንደ ፊተኛው ጊዜ ብላቴናውን አምስተኛ ጊዜ ላከብኝ፤

verses.text_english: Wherein written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.
verses.text_amharic: በእጁም ውስጥ። አንተና አይሁድ ዓመፅ እንድታስቡ፥ ስለዚህም ቅጥሩን እንድትሠራ፥ ንጉሣቸውም ትሆን ዘንድ እንድትወድድ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። ንጉሥ በይሁዳ አለ ብለው ስለ አንተ በኢየሩሳሌም ይናገሩ ዘንድ ነቢያትን አቁመሃል፤ አሁንም ለንጉሡ ይህን ቃል ያወሩለታል፤ እንግዲህ መጥተህ በአንድነት እንማከር የሚል ክፍት ደብዳቤ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። አንተ ከልብህ ፈጥረኸዋል እንጂ እንደ ተናገርኸው ነገር ምንም የለም ብዬ ላክሁበት።

verses.text_english: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, , strengthen my hands.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሁሉ ሥራው እንዳይፈጸም። እጃቸው ይደክማል ብለው ያስፈራሩን ዘንድ ወደዱ፤ አሁንም፥ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እጄን አበርታ።

verses.text_english: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ወደ መሔጣብኤል ልጅ ወደ ድላያ ልጅ ወደ ሸማያ ቤት ገባሁ፤ እርሱም ተዘግቶ ነበርና። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በመቅደሱ ውስጥ እንገናኝ የመቅደሱንም ደጆች እንዝጋ፤ እነርሱ መጥተው ይገድሉሃልና፥ በሌሊትም ይገድሉህ ዘንድ ይመጣሉና አለ።

verses.text_english: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who , that, as I , would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። እንደ እኔ ያለ ሰው የሸሸና፥ ነፍሱንስ ያድን ዘንድ ወደ መቅደስ የገባ ማን ነው? እኔስ አልገባም አልሁት።

verses.text_english: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ልኮት እንዳልነበረ፥ በእኔ ላይ ግን ትንቢት እንደ ተናገረ፥ እነሆ፥ አወቅሁ፤ ጦብያና ሰንባላጥም ገዝተውት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Therefore he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and they might have for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ነገር አደርግና እበድል ዘንድ፥ በእኔም ላይ ክፋት እንዲናገሩና እንዲያላግጡ ያስፈራራኝ ዘንድ ተገዝቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ሥራቸው ጦብያንና ሰንባላጥን ያስፈራሩኝም ዘንድ የወደዱትን ነቢይቱን ኖዓድያን የቀሩትንም ነቢያት አስብ።

verses.text_english: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth of Elul, in fifty and two days.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥሩም በኤሉል ወር በሀያ አምስተኛው ቀን በአምሳ ሁለት ቀን ውስጥ ተጨረሰ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard , and all the heathen that about us saw , they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቻችንም ሁሉ ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ በዙሪያችን የነበሩ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ በራሳቸውም አሳብ እጅግ ተዋረዱ፥ ይህም ሥራ በእግዚአብሔር እንደ ተደረገ አወቁ።

verses.text_english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and of Tobiah came unto them.
For many in Judah sworn unto him, because he the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በፊቴ ስለ እርሱ መልካም ይናገሩ ነበር፥ ቃሌንም ያወሩለት ነበር፤ ጦብያም ሊያስፈራራኝ ደብዳቤዎችን ይልክ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ቅጥሩ ከተሠራ በኋላ፥ ሳንቃዎቹንም ካቆምሁ በኋላ፥ በረኞቹና መዘምራኑ ሌዋውያኑም ከተሾሙ በኋላ፥

verses.text_english: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሜን አናኒንና የግንቡን አለቃ ሐናንያን በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ሾምኋቸው፤ እርሱም እውነተኛ ከሌሎቹም ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar : and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one over against his house.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ፀሐይ እስኪሞቅ ድረስ የኢየሩሳሌም በሮች አይከፈቱ፤ እነርሱም ቆመው ሳሉ ደጆቹን ይዝጉ፥ ይቈልፉም፤ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ሰዎች አንዳንዱን በየተራው አንዳንዱንም በየቤቱ አንጻር ጠባቆችን አስቀምጡ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Now the city large and great: but the people few therein, and the houses not builded.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም ሰፊና ታላቅ ነበረች፤ በውስጥዋ የነበሩ ሕዝብ ግን ጥቂቶች ነበሩ፥ ቤቶቹም አልተሠሩም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬም ታላቆቹንና ሹማምቱን ሕዝቡንም ሰብስቤ እቈጥራቸው ዘንድ በልቤ አደረገ፤ አስቀድመው የመጡትን ሰዎች የትውልድ መጽሐፋቸውን አገኘሁ፥ በእርሱም እንደዚህ ተጽፎ አገኘሁ።

verses.text_english: These the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ከማረካቸው ምርኮኞች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምና ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ እየከተማቸው የተመለሱት የአገር ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, , of the men of the people of Israel ;
verses.text_amharic: ከዘሩባቤል፥ ከኢያሱ፥ ከነህምያ፥ ከአዛርያስ፥ ከረዓምያ፥ ከነሐማኒ፥ ከመርዶክዮስ፥ ከበላሳን፥ ከሚስጴሬት፥ ከበጉዋይ፥ ከነሑም፥ ከበዓና ጋር መጡ።

verses.text_english: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ሕዝብ ሰዎች ቍጥር ይህ ነው፤ የፋሮስ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።

verses.text_english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.text_amharic: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።

verses.text_english: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.text_amharic: የኤራ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ሁለት።

verses.text_english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred eighteen.

verses.text_english: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
verses.text_amharic: የዛቱዕ ልጆች፥ ስምንት መቶ አርባ አምስት።

verses.text_english: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

verses.text_english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
verses.text_amharic: የቤባይ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።

verses.text_english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

verses.text_amharic: የበጉዋይ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ ስድሳ ሰባት።

verses.text_english: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

verses.text_amharic: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ የሐጢል ልጆች፥ የፈከራት ልጆች፥ የሐፂቦይም ልጆች፥ የአሞን ልጆች።

verses.text_english: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, three hundred ninety and two.
verses.text_amharic: ናታኒም ሁሉና የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And these they which went up from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከቴልሜላ፥ ከቴላሬሳ፥ ከክሩብ፥ ከአዳን፥ ከኢሜር የወጡ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ነገር ግን የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶችና ዘራቸውን ወይም ከእስራኤል ወገን መሆናቸውን ያስታውቁ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤

verses.text_english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.text_amharic: የዳላያ ልጆች፥ የጦብያ ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አርባ ሁለት።

verses.text_english: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናቱም የኤብያ ልጆች፥ የአቆስ ልጆች፥ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ልጆች ሚስት ያገባ በስሙም የተጠራ የቤርዜሊ ልጆች።

verses.text_english: These sought their register those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በትውልድ መጽሐፍ ትውልዳቸውን ፈለጉ፥ ነገር ግን አልተገኘም፤ ከክህነትም ተከለከሉ።

verses.text_english: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.text_amharic: ሐቴርሰታም። በኡሪምና በቱሚም የሚፈርድ ካህን እስኪነሣ ደረስ ከተቀደሰው ነገር አትበሉም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: The whole congregation together forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.text_amharic: ፈረሶቻቸውም ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ስድስት፥ በቅሎቻቸውም ሁለት መቶ አርባ አምስት፥

verses.text_english: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
verses.text_amharic: ግመሎቻቸውም አራት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት፥ አህዮቻቸውም ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችም አያሌዎቹ ሰዎች ስለ ሥራው ስጦታ ሰጡ። ሐቴርሰታም አንድ ሺህ የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ አምሳም ድስቶች፥ አምስት መቶ ሠላሳም የካህናት ልብስ በቤተ መዛግብት ውስጥ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችም አያሌዎቹ በሥራው ቤተ መዛግብት ውስጥ ሀያ ሺህ የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶም ምናን ብር ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: And of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም ሕዝብ የሰጡት ሀያ ሺህ የወርቅ ዳሪክና ሁለት ሺህ ምናን ብር፥ ስድሳ ሰባትም የካህናት ልብስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And which the rest of the people gave twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም፥ በረኞቹና መዘምራኑም ከሕዝቡም አያሌዎቹ፥ ናታኒምም፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛውም ወር በደረሰ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች በከተሞቻቸው ነበሩ። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በውኃው በር ፊት ወዳለው አደባባይ እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለእስራኤል ያዘዘውን የሙሴን ሕግ መጽሐፍ ያመጣ ዘንድ ጸሐፊውን ዕዝራን ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ዕዝራ በሰባተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ሕጉን በማኅበሩ በወንዶችና በሴቶች አስተውለውም በሚሰሙት ሁሉ ፊት አመጣው።

verses.text_english: And he read therein before the street that before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people unto the book of the law.
verses.text_amharic: በውኃውም በር ፊት ባለው አደባባይ ላይ ቆሞ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች የሚያስተውሉም ሲሰሙ፥ ከማለዳ ጀምሮ እስከ ቀትር ድረስ አነበበው፤ የሕዝቡም ሁሉ ጆሮ የሕጉን መጽሐፍ ለመስማት ያደምጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, Meshullam.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሐፊውም ዕዝራ ስለዚህ ነገር በተሠራ በእንጨት መረባርብ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር፤ በአጠገቡ መቲትያ፥ ሽማዕ፥ ዓናያ፥ ኦርዮ፥ ኬልቅያስ፥ መዕሤያ በቀኙ በኩል፥ ፈዳያ፥ ሚሳኤል፥ መልክያ፥ ሐሱም፥ ሐሽበዳና፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ሜሱላም በግራው በኩል ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
verses.text_amharic: ዕዝራም በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ብሎ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እያዩ መጽሐፉን ገለጠ፤ በገለጠውም ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with faces to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ዕዝራም ታላቁን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ባረከ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እጃቸውን እየዘረጉ። አሜን፥ አሜን ብለው መለሱ። ራሳቸውንም አዘነበሉ፥ በግምባራቸውም ተደፍተው ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people in their place.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ኢያሱና ባኒ፥ ሰራብያ፥ ያሚን፥ ዓቁብ፥ ሳባታይ፥ ሆዲያ፥ መዕሤያ፥ ቆሊጣስ፥ ዓዛርያስ፥ ዮዛባት፥ ሐናን፥ ፌልያ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ሕጉን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ያስተምሩ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም በየስፍራቸው ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused to understand the reading.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ሕግ መጽሐፍ አነበቡ፤ ዕዝራም እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ ያስተምርና ያስታውቅ ነበር፥ ሕዝቡም የሚነበበውን ያስተውሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Nehemiah, which the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.text_amharic: ሐቴርሰታ ነህምያም ጸሐፊውም ካህኑ ዕዝራ ሕዝቡንም የሚያስተምሩ ሌዋውያን ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ዛሬ ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ቀን ነው፤ አታልቅሱ እንባም አታፍስሱ አሉአቸው፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የሕጉን ቃል በሰሙ ጊዜ ያለቅሱ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for day holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
