Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከቤቱ አታክልት ወደ ወይን ጠጁ ግብዣ ስፍራ ተመለሰ፤ ሐማም አስቴር ባለችበት አልጋ ላይ ወድቆ ነበር። ንጉሡም። ደግሞ በቤቴ በእኔ ፊት ንግሥቲቱን ይጋፋታልን? አለ። ይህም ቃል ከንጉሡ አፍ በወጣ ጊዜ የሐማን ፊት ሸፈኑት።

verses.text_english: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም ፊት ካሉት ጃንደረቦች አንዱ ሐርቦና። እነሆ ሐማ ለንጉሡ በጎ ለተናገረው ለመርዶክዮስ ያሠራው ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ የሆነው ግንድ በሐማ ቤት ተተክሎአል አለ። ንጉሡም። በእርሱ ላይ ስቀሉት አለ።

verses.text_english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
verses.text_amharic: ሐማንም ለመርዶክዮስ ባዘጋጀው ግንድ ላይ ሰቀሉት፤ በዚያም ጊዜ የንጉሡ ቍጣ በረደ።

verses.text_english: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he unto her.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ንጉሡ አርጤክስስ የአይሁድን ጠላት የሐማን ቤት ለንግሥቲቱ ለአስቴር ሰጠ። አስቴርም ለእርስዋ ምን እንደ ሆነ ነግራው ነበርና መርዶክዮስ ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት ገባ።

verses.text_english: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ከሐማ ያወለቀውን ቀለበቱን አወጣ፥ ለመርዶክዮስም ሰጠው። አስቴርም በሐማ ቤት ላይ መርዶክዮስን ሾመች።

verses.text_english: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: አስቴርም እንደ ገና በንጉሡ ፊት ተናገረች፤ በእግሩም ላይ ወድቃ እያለቀሰች የአጋጋዊውን የሐማን ክፋትና በአይሁድ ላይ የተተነኰለውን ተንኰል ይሽር ዘንድ ለመነችው።

verses.text_english: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የወርቁን ዘንግ ለአስቴር ዘረጋላት፤ አስቴርም ተነሥታ በንጉሡ ፊት ቆመችና።

verses.text_english: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing right before the king, and I pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which in all the king's provinces:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡን ደስ ቢያሰኘው፥ በፊቱም ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደሆነ፥ ይህም ነገር በፊቱ ቅን ቢሆን፥ እኔም በእርሱ ዘንድ ተወድጄ እንደ ሆነ፥ አጋጋዊው የሐመዳቱ ልጅ ሐማ በንጉሡ አገር ሁሉ ያሉትን አይሁድ ለማጥፋት የጻፈው ተንኰል ይገለበጥ ዘንድ ይጻፍ።

verses.text_english: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በሕዝቤ ላይ የሚወርደውን ክፉ ነገር አይ ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ? ወይስ የዘመዶቼን ጥፋት አይ ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ? አለች።

verses.text_english: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ ንግሥቲቱን አስቴርንና አይሁዳዊውን መርዶክዮስን። እነሆ የሐማን ቤት ለአስቴር ሰጥቻለሁ፥ እርሱም እጆቹን በአይሁድ ላይ ስለ ዘረጋ በግንድ ላይ ተሰቀለ።

verses.text_english: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡ ስም የተጻፈና በንጉሡ ቀለበት የታተመ አይገለበጥምና እናንተ ደግሞ ደስ የሚያሰኛችሁን በንጉሡ ስም ስለ አይሁድ ጻፉ፥ በንጉሡም ቀለበት አትሙ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that , the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ኒሳን በተባለው በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ ሦስተኛው ቀን የንጉሡ ጸሐፊዎች ተጠሩ፤ መርዶክዮስም ስለ አይሁድ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ከህንድ ጀምሮ እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ድረስ በመቶ ሀያ ሰባቱ አገሮች ላሉ ሹማምትና አለቆች አዛውንትም ለእያንዳንዱም አገር እንደ ጽሕፈቱ ለእያንዳንዱም ሕዝብ እንደ ቋንቋው ለአይሁድም እንደ ጽሕፈታቸውና እንደ ቋንቋቸው ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, riders on mules, camels, young dromedaries:
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም በአርጤክስስ ስም አስጻፈው፥ በንጉሡም ቀለበት አሳተመው፤ ደብዳቤውንም በንጉሡ ፈረስ ቤት በተወለዱት፥ ለንጉሡም አገልግሎት በተለዩ በፈጣን ፈረሶች በተቀመጡ መልእክተኞች እጅ ሰደደው።

verses.text_english: Wherein the king granted the Jews which in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, little ones and women, and the spoil of them for a prey,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ደብዳቤ በከተሞቹ ሁሉ የሚኖሩት አይሁድ እንዲሰበሰቡ፥ ለሕይወታቸውም እንዲቆሙ፥ በጥል የሚነሡባቸውን የሕዝቡንና የአገሩን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከሕፃናቶቻቸውና ከሴቶቻቸው ጋር እንዲያጠፉና እንዲገድሉ እንዲደመስሱም፥ ምርኮአቸውንም እንዲዘርፉ ንጉሡ ፈቀደላቸው።

verses.text_english: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, , upon the thirteenth of the twelfth month, which the month Adar.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም አዳር በሚባለው በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ቀን በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ አገሮች ሁሉ በአንድ ቀን እንዲሆን ነው።

verses.text_english: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ጠላቶቻቸውን እንዲበቀሉ በዚያ ቀን ይዘጋጁ ዘንድ የደብዳቤው ቅጅ በየአገሩ ላሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ታወጀ።

verses.text_english: the posts that rode upon mules camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡ አገልግሎት በተለዩ በፈጣን ፈረሶች የተቀመጡት መልእክተኞች በንጉሡ ትእዛዝ ተርበትብተውና ቸኵለው ወጡ፤ አዋጁም በሱሳ ግንብ ተነገረ።

verses.text_english: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
verses.text_amharic: መርዶክዮስም በሰማያዊና በነጭ ሐር የተሠራውን የንጉሡን የክብር ልብስ ለብሶ ታላቅም የወርቅ አክሊል ደፍቶ ከጥሩ በፍታና ከሐምራዊ ግምጃ የተሠራ መጐናጸፊያ ተጐናጽፎ ከንጉሡ ፊት ወጣ፤ የሱሳም ከተማ ደስ አላት፥ እልልም አለች።

verses.text_english: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
verses.text_amharic: ለአይሁድም ብርሃንና ደስታ ተድላና ክብርም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡም ትእዛዝና አዋጅ በደረሰበት አገርና ከተማ ሁሉ ለአይሁድ ደስታና ተድላ፥ የግብዣም ቀን መልካምም ቀን ሆነ። አይሁድንም መፍራት ስለ ወደቀባቸው ከምድር አሕዛብ ብዙ ሰዎች አይሁድ ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Now in the twelfth month, that , the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)
verses.text_amharic: አዳር በሚባለውም በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ቀን፥ የንጉሡ ትእዛዝና አዋጅ ሊፈጸምበት በነበረው ቀን፥ የአይሁድ ጠላቶች ሊሠለጥኑባቸው በነበረው ቀን፥ አይሁድ በጠላቶቻቸው ላይ እንዲሠለጥኑ ነገሩ ተገለበጠ።

verses.text_english: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ክፋታቸውን በሚሹት ሰዎች ላይ እጃቸውን ይዘረጉ ዘንድ በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ አገሮች ሁሉ በነበሩ ከተሞቻቸው ውስጥ ተሰበሰቡ፤ እነርሱንም መፍራት በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ወድቆ ነበርና እነርሱን የሚቃወም ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
verses.text_amharic: መርዶክዮስን መፍራት በላያቸው ስለ ወደቀ በየአገሩ የነበሩ አዛውንትና ሹማምቶች አለቆችም፥ የንጉሡንም ሥራ የሚሠሩቱ ሁሉ አይሁድን አገዙ።

verses.text_english: For Mordecai great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ሰው መርዶክዮስ ከፍ ከፍ እያለ ስለ ሄደ በንጉሡ ቤት ታላቅ ሆኖ ነበርና፥ የመርዶክዮስም ዝና በየአገሩ ሁሉ ተሰምቶ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ጠላቶቻቸውን ሁሉ በሰይፍ እየመቱ ገደሉአቸው፥ አጠፉአቸውም፤ በሚጠሉአቸውም ላይ እንደ ወደዱ አደረጉባቸው።

verses.text_english: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም በሱሳ ግንብ አምስት መቶ ያህል ሰዎች ገደሉ አጠፉም።

verses.text_english: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,
And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,
verses.text_amharic: ፈርሰኔስ፥ ደልፎን፥ ፋስጋ፥ ፋረዳታ፥

verses.text_english: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,
verses.text_amharic: በርያ፥ ሰርባካ፥ መርመሲማ፥ ሩፋዮስ፥ አርሳዮስ፥ ዛቡታዮስ የሚባሉትን፥

verses.text_english: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
verses.text_amharic: የሐመዳቱን ልጅ የአይሁድን ጠላት አሥሩን የሐማን ልጆች ገደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ብዝበዛው እጃቸውን አልዘረጉም።

verses.text_english: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በሱሳ ግንብ የተገደሉት ሰዎች ቍጥር ወደ ንጉሡ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what thy request further? and it shall be done.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ንግሥቲቱን አስቴርን። አይሁድ በሱሳ ግንብ አምስት መቶ ሰዎችንና አሥሩን የሐማ ልጆች ገደሉ አጠፉአቸውም፤ በቀሩትስ በንጉሡ አገሮች እንዴት አድርገው ይሆን! አሁንስ ልመናሽ ምንድር ነው? ይሰጥሻል፤ ሌላስ የምትሺው ምንድር ነው? ይደረጋል አላት።

verses.text_english: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
verses.text_amharic: አስቴርም። ንጉሡን ደስ ቢያሰኘው በሱሳ የሚኖሩ አይሁድ ዛሬ እንደ ተደረገው ትእዛዝ ነገ ደግሞ ያድርጉ፤ አሥሩም የሐማ ልጆች በግንድ ላይ ይሰቀሉ አለች።

verses.text_english: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ይህ ይደረግ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ አዋጅም በሱሳ ተነገረ፤ አሥሩንም የሐማን ልጆች ሰቀሉ።

verses.text_english: For the Jews that in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
verses.text_amharic: በሱሳም የነበሩ አይሁድ አዳር በሚባለው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ደግሞ ተሰብስበው በሱሳ ሦስት መቶ ያህል ሰዎች ገደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ብዝበዛው እጃቸውን አልዘረጉም።

verses.text_english: But the other Jews that in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም በንጉሡ አገር ያሉ አይሁድ ተሰብስበው ለሕይወታቸው ቆሙ፥ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ዐረፉ፤ ከሚጠሉአቸውም ሰባ አምስት ሺህ ገደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ብዝበዛው እጃቸውን አልዘረጉም።

verses.text_english: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
verses.text_amharic: አዳር በሚባለው ወር በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ቀን ይህ ተደረገ፤ በአሥራ አራተኛውም ቀን ዐረፉ፥ የግብዣና የደስታም ቀን አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: But the Jews that at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
verses.text_amharic: በሱሳ የነበሩት አይሁድ ግን በአሥራ ሦስተኛውና በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ተሰበሰቡ፤ በአሥራ አምስተኛውም ቀን ዐረፉ፥ የመጠጥና የደስታም ቀን አደረጉት።

verses.text_english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በመንደሮችና ባልተመሸጉ ከተሞች የሚኖሩ አይሁድ አዳር በሚባለው ወር አሥራ አራተኛውን ቀን የደስታና የመጠጥ የመልካምም ቀን፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ስጦታ የሚሰጣጡበት ቀን ያደርጉታል።

verses.text_english: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, nigh and far,
verses.text_amharic: መርዶክዮስም ይህን ነገር ጻፈ፥ በንጉሡም በአርጤክስስ አገሮች ሁሉ በቅርብና በሩቅ ወዳሉት አይሁድ ሁሉ ደብዳቤዎችን ላከ።

verses.text_english: To stablish among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,
verses.text_amharic: በየዓመቱም አዳር በሚባለው ወር አሥራ አራተኛውና አሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን፥

verses.text_english: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ከጠላቶቻቸው ዕረፍትን ያገኙበት ቀን፥ ወሩም ከኀዘን ወደ ደስታ ከልቅሶም ወደ መልካም ቀን የተለወጠበት ወር ሆኖ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ፥ የግብዣና የደስታም ቀን፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ስጦታ የሚሰጣጡበትና ለድሆች ስጦታ የሚሰጡበት ቀን ያደርጉት ዘንድ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ለመሥራት የጀመሩትን፥ መርዶክዮስም የጻፈላቸውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተቀበሉት፤

verses.text_english: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that , the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
verses.text_amharic: አጋጋዊው የሐመዳቱ ልጅ የአይሁድ ሁሉ ጠላት ሐማ አይሁድን ያጠፋ ዘንድ ተተንኵሎ ነበር፤ ሊደመስሳቸውና ሊያጠፋቸውም ፉር የሚባል ዕጣ ጥሎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
verses.text_amharic: አስቴርም ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት በገባች ጊዜ በአይሁድ ላይ የተተነኰለው ክፉ ተንኰል በራሱ ላይ እንዲመለስ፥ እርሱና ልጆቹም በግንድ ላይ እንዲሰቀሉ በደብዳቤው አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እነዚህ ቀኖች እንደ ፉር ስም ፉሪም ተባሉ። በዚህም ደብዳቤ ስለ ተጻፈው ቃል ሁሉ፥ ስላዩትና ስላገኙአቸውም ነገር ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their time every year;

And these days remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.
verses.text_amharic: የአቢካኢልም ልጅ ንግሥቲቱ አስቴርና አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስ ይህችን ስለ ፉሪም የምትናገረውን ሁለተኛይቱን ደብዳቤ በሥልጣናቸው ሁሉ ያጸኑአት ዘንድ ጻፉ።

verses.text_english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
verses.text_amharic: ደብዳቤዎቹንም በአርጤክስስ መንግሥት በመቶ ሀያ ሰባቱ አገሮች ወዳሉ አይሁድ ሁሉ በሰላምና በእውነት ቃል ላኩ።

verses.text_english: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, words of peace and truth,
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም የፉሪም ቀኖች፥ አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስና ንግሥቲቱ አስቴር እንዳዘዙ፥ ለራሳቸውና ለዘራቸውም የጾማቸውንና የልቅሶአቸውን ነገር ለማክበር እንደ ተቀበሉ፥ በየጊዜያቸው ያጸኑ ዘንድ ጻፉ።

verses.text_english: To confirm these days of Purim in their times , according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
verses.text_amharic: የአስቴርም ትእዛዝ ይህን የፉሪምን ነገር አጸና፤ በመጽሐፍም ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and the isles of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ በምድርና በባሕር ደሴቶች ላይ ግብር ጣለ።

verses.text_english: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
verses.text_amharic: የኃይሉና የብርታቱም ሥራ ሁሉ ንጉሡም እስከ ምን ድረስ እንዳከበረው የመርዶክዮስ ክብር ታላቅነት፥ በሜዶንና በፋርስ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: For Mordecai the Jew next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁዳዊውም መርዶክዮስ ለንጉሡ ለአርጤክስስ በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ ነበረ፤ በአይሁድም ዘንድ የከበረ፥ በብዙ ወንድሞችም ዘንድ የተወደደ፥ ለሕዝቡም መልካምን የፈለገ፥ ለዘሩም ሁሉ በደኅና የተናገረ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
verses.text_amharic: ዖፅ በሚባል አገር ስሙ ኢዮብ የተባለ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ ያም ሰው ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባትም ወንዶች ሦስትም ሴቶች ልጆች ተወልደውለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
verses.text_amharic: ሀብቱም ሰባት ሺህ በጎች፥ ሦስት ሺህም ግመሎች፥ አምስት መቶም ጥማድ በሬ፥ አምስት መቶም እንስት አህዮች ነበረ፥ እጅግ ብዙም ባሪያዎች ነበሩት፤ ያም ሰው በምሥራቅ ካሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ታላቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And his sons went and feasted houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶች ልጆቹም ሄደው በየተራ በያንዳንዳቸው ቤት ግብዣ ያደርጉ ነበር፤ ሦስቱ እኅቶቻቸውም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይበሉና ይጠጡ ዘንድ እነርሱ ልከው ይጠሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it was so, when the days of feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
verses.text_amharic: የግብዣውም ቀኖች ባለፉ ጊዜ ኢዮብ። ምናልባት ልጆቼ በድለው፥ እግዚአብሔርንም በልባቸው ሰድበው ይሆናል ብሎ ይልክና ይቀድሳቸው ነበር፤ ኢዮብም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ እንደ ቍጥራቸውም ሁሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ። እንዲሁ ኢዮብ ሁልጊዜ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.
verses.text_amharic: ከዕለታት አንድ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአምላክ ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፥ ሰይጣንም ደግሞ በመካከላቸው መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። ሰይጣንም። ምድርን ሁሉ ዞርሁአት፥ በእርስዋም ተመላለስሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። በውኑ ባሪያዬን ኢዮብን ተመለከትኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው የለም አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። በውኑ ኢዮብ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ በከንቱ ነውን?

verses.text_english: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንና ቤቱን በዙሪያውም ያሉትን ሁሉ አላጠርህለትምን? የእጁን ሥራ ባርከህለታል፥ ከብቱም በምድር ላይ በዝቶአል።

verses.text_english: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እጅህን ዘርግተህ ያለውን ሁሉ ዳብስ፤ በእውነት በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። እነሆ ለእርሱ ያለው ሁሉ በእጅህ ነው፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ላይ እጅህን አትዘርጋ አለው። ሰይጣንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የኢዮብ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች በታላቅ ወንድማቸው ቤት ይበሉና የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
verses.text_amharic: መልክተኛም ወደ ኢዮብ መጥቶ። በሬዎች እርሻ ያርሱ፥ በአጠገባቸውም አህዮች ይሰማሩ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And the Sabeans fell , and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.text_amharic: የሳባም ሰዎች አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ወሰዱአቸውም፥ ብላቴኖቹንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: While he yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። የእግዚአብሔር እሳት ከሰማይ ወደቀች፥ በጎቹንም አቃጠለች፥ ጠባቂዎችንም በላች፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: While he yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። ከለዳውያን በሦስት ረድፍ ተከፍለው በግመሎች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ወሰዱአቸውም፥ ብላቴኖቹንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: While he yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህ በታላቅ ወንድማቸው ቤት ይበሉና የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ከምድረ በዳ መጥቶ የቤቱን አራቱን ማዕዘን መታው፥ በብላቴኖቹም ላይ ወደቀ፥ ሞቱም፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም ተነሣ መጐናጸፊያውንም ቀደደ፥ ራሱንም ተላጨ፥ በምድርም ላይ ተደፍቶ ሰገደ፤

verses.text_english: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። ራቁቴን ከእናቴ ማኅፀን ወጥቻለሁ፥ ራቁቴንም ወደዚያ እመለሳለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሰጠ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ነሣ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ስም የተባረከ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ሁሉ ኢዮብ አልበደለም፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስንፍናን አልሰጠም።

verses.text_english: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከዕለታት አንድ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአምላክ ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፥ ሰይጣን ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም በመካከላቸው መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። ሰይጣንም። በምድር ላይ ዞርሁ፥ በእርስዋም ተመላለስሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። በውኑ ባሪያዬን ኢዮብን ተመለከትኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው የለም፤ በከንቱም አጠፋው ዘንድ አንተ በእርሱ ላይ ምንም ብታንቀሳቅሰኝ፥ እስከ አሁን ፍጹምነቱን ይዞአል።

verses.text_english: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም መልሶ እግዚአብሔርን። ቁርበት ስለ ቁርበት ነው፤ ሰው ያለውን ሁሉ ስለ ሕይወቱ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አሁን እጅህን ዘርግተህ አጥንቱንና ሥጋውን ዳብስ፤ በእውነት በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he in thine hand; but save his life.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔም ሰይጣንን። ሕይወቱን ተወው እንጂ እነሆ፥ እርሱ በእጅህ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ፥ ኢዮብንም ከእግሩ ጫማ ጀምሮ እስከ አናቱ ድረስ በክፉ ቍስል መታው።

verses.text_english: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋውንም ይፍቅበት ዘንድ ገል ወሰደ፥ በአመድም ላይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቱም። እስከ አሁን ፍጹምነትህን ይዘሃልን? እግዚአብሔርን ስደብና ሙት አለችው።  (የሚቀጥለው ከግሪክ የተጨመረ ነው)  ዳግመኛ እግዚአብሔርን ጥቂት ወራት ደጅ እጠናዋለሁ፤ ዳግመኛም መከራውን እታገሠዋለሁ፥ የቀድሞ ኑሮዬንም ተስፋ አደርገዋለሁ ትላለህን? አለችው። እንደዚህሳ እንዳትል ከዚህ ዓለም እነሆ ስም አጠራርህ ጠፋ፤ ሴቶች ልጆቼና ወንዶች ልጆቼም ሞቱ እኔስ ዘጠኝ ወር ሳረግዝ ሳምጥ ስወልድ ሳይረቡኝ ሳይጠቅሙኝ በከንቱ ደከምሁ አለች። አንተም በመግል ተውጠህ በትል ተከብበህ ትኖራለህ፤ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ስትዛብር ታድራለህ። እኔ ግን እየዞርሁ እቀላውጣለሁ። ከአንዱ አገር ወደ አንዱ አገር ከአንዱ ቤት ወደ አንዱ ቤት እሄዳለሁ፤ ከድካሜ በእኔ ላይ ካለ ከችግሬም አርፍ ዘንድ ከጧት ጀምሮ ፀሐይ እስኪገባ ድረስ እጠብቃለሁ፤ አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔርን የማይገባ ቃል ተናግረኸው ሙት አለች።

verses.text_english: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን አንቺ ከሰነፎች ሴቶች እንደ አንዲቱ ተናገርሽ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ መልካሙን ተቀበልን፥ ክፉ ነገርንስ አንቀበልምን? አላት። በዚህ ሁሉ ኢዮብ በከንፈሩ አልበደለም።

verses.text_english: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስቱም የኢዮብ ወዳጆች ይህን የደረሰበትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ሰምተው ከየአገራቸው መጡ፤ እነርሱም ቴማናዊው ኤልፋዝ፥ ሹሐዊው በልዳዶስ፥ ነዕማታዊው ሶፋር ነበሩ። እነርሱም ሊያዝኑለትና ሊያጽናኑት በአንድነት ወደ እርሱ ለመምጣት ተስማሙ።

verses.text_english: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ከሩቅም ሆነው ዓይናቸውን ባነሡ ጊዜ አላወቁትም፤ ድምፃቸውንም አሰምተው አለቀሱ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም መጐናጸፊያቸውን ቀደዱ፥ ወደ ላይም ወደ ራሳቸው ላይ ትቢያ ነሰነሱ።

verses.text_english: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that grief was very great.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀንና ሰባት ሌሊትም ከእርሱ ጋር በምድር ላይ ተቀመጡ፤ ሕመሙም እጅግ እንደ በዛ አይተዋልና ከእነርሱ አንድ ቃል የሚናገረው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ኢዮብ አፉን ከፍቶ የተወለደበትን ቀን ረገመ።

verses.text_english: And Job spake, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.text_english: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.text_amharic: ያ የተወለድሁበት ቀን ይጥፋ፥  ያም። ወንድ ልጅ ተፀነሰ የተባለበት ሌሊት።

verses.text_english: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ቀን ጨለማ ይሁን፤  እግዚአብሔር ከላይ አይመልከተው፥  ብርሃንም አይብራበት።

verses.text_english: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.text_amharic: ጨለማና የሞት ጥላ የራሳቸው ገንዘብ ያድርጉት፤  ዳመናም ይረፍበት፤  የቀን ጨለማ ሁሉ ያስፈራው።

verses.text_english: As that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ሌሊት ጨለማ ይያዘው፤  በዓመቱ ቀኖች መካከል ደስ አይበለው፤  በወሮች ውስጥ ገብቶ አይቈጠር።

verses.text_english: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ያ ሌሊት መካን ይሁን፤  እልልታ አይግባበት።

verses.text_english: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዋታንን ለማንቀሳቀስ የተዘጋጁ  ቀኑን የሚረግሙ ይርገሙት።

verses.text_english: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.text_amharic: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች ይጨልሙ፤  ብርሃንን ቢጠባበቅ አያግኘው፥  የንጋትንም ቅንድብ አይይ፤

verses.text_english: Because it shut not up the doors of my womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: የእናቴን ማኅፀን ደጅ አልዘጋምና፥  መከራንም ከዓይኔ አልሰወረምና።

verses.text_english: Why died I not from the womb? did I give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.text_amharic: በማኅፀን ሳለሁ ስለ ምን አልሞትሁም?  ከሆድስ በወጣሁ ጊዜ ፈጥኜ ስለ ምን አልጠፋሁም?

verses.text_english: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.text_amharic: ጕልበቶች ስለ ምን ተቀበሉኝ?  ጡትስ ስለ ምን ጠባሁ?

verses.text_english: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ተኝቼ ዝም ባልሁ ነበር፤  አንቀላፍቼ ባረፍሁ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
verses.text_amharic: የፈረሰውን ለራሳቸው ከሚሠሩት  ከምድር ነገሥታትና መካሮች ጋር፥

verses.text_english: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ቤታቸውን ብር ከሞሉ  ወርቅም ካላቸው መኳንንት ጋር፥

verses.text_english: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants never saw light.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም እንደ ተቀበረ ጭንጋፍ፥  ብርሃንም እንዳላዩ ሕፃናት በሆንሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: There the wicked cease troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉዎች በዚያ መናደዳቸውን ይተዋሉ፤  በዚያም ደካሞች ያርፋሉ።

verses.text_english: the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ግዞተኞች በአንድነት ተዘልለው ተቀምጠዋል፤  የአስጨናቂውን ድምፅ አይሰሙም።

verses.text_english: The small and great are there; and the servant free from his master.
verses.text_amharic: ታናሽና ታላቅ በዚያ አሉ፤  ባሪያም ከጌታው ነጻ ወጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter soul;
verses.text_amharic: በመከራ ላሉት ብርሃን፥  ነፍሳቸው መራራ ለሆነችባቸው፥

verses.text_english: Which long for death, but it not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.text_amharic: የተሰወረ ሀብትን ከሚቈፍሩ ይልቅ  ሞትን ለሚጠብቁ ለማያገኙትም፥

verses.text_english: Which rejoice exceedingly, are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.text_amharic: መቃብርን ባገኙ ጊዜ  በእልልታ ደስ ለሚላቸው፥ ሐሤትንም ለሚያደርጉ  ሕይወት ስለ ምን ተሰጠ?

verses.text_english: to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
verses.text_amharic: መንገዱ ለተሰወረበት ሰው፥  እግዚአብሔርም በአጥር ላጠረው  ብርሃን ስለ ምን ተሰጠ?

verses.text_english: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንጀራዬ በፊት ልቅሶዬ መጥቶአልና፥  ጩኸቴም እንደ ውኃ ፈስሶአል።

verses.text_english: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.text_amharic: የፈራሁት ነገር መጥቶብኛልና፥  የደነገጥሁበትም ደርሶብኛል።

verses.text_english: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.text_amharic: ተዘልዬ አልተቀመጥሁም፥ አልተማመንሁም፥ አላረፍሁም፤  ነገር ግን መከራ መጣብኝ።

verses.text_english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰው ከአንተ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ ቢሞክር ትቀየማለህን?  ቃልንስ ከመናገር ሊቀር የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አንተ ብዙዎችን ታስተምር ነበር፥  የደከሙትንም እጆች ታበረታ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህ የሚሰናከለውን ያስነሣ ነበር፥  አንተም የሚብረከረከውን ጕልበት ታጸና ነበር።

verses.text_english: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በአንተ ላይ መጥቶአል፥ አንተም ደከምህ፤  ደርሶብሃል፥ አንተም ተቸገርህ።

verses.text_english: not thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.text_amharic: አምላክህን መፍራትህ መጽናናትህ፥  የቅንነትህም መንገድ ተስፋህ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Remember, I pray thee, who perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.text_amharic: እባክህ አስብ፥ ንጹሕ ሆኖ የጠፋ ማን ነው?  ከልበ ቅንስ የተደመሰሰ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንዳየሁ፥ ኃጢአትን የሚያርሱ፥  መከራንም የሚዘሩ ይህንኑ ያጭዳሉ።

verses.text_english: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ይጠፋሉ፥  በቍጣውም መንፈስ ያልቃሉ።

verses.text_english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.text_amharic: የአንበሳ ጩኸት፥ የጩዋኺ አንበሳ ድምፅ፥  የአንበሳ ደቦል ጥርስ ተሰባበረ።

verses.text_english: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.text_amharic: አሮጌ አንበሳ አደን በማጣት ይሞታል፥  የአንበሳይቱም ግልገሎች ይበተናሉ።

verses.text_english: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔም በምሥጢር ቃል መጣልኝ፥  ጆሮዬም ሹክሹክታውን ሰማች።

verses.text_english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊት ሕልም አሳብ ሲነሣ፥  የከበደም እንቅልፍ በሰው ላይ ሲወድቅ፥

verses.text_english: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.text_amharic: አጥንቴን ሁሉ ያናወጡ  ድንጋጤና መንቀጥቀጥ ወደቁብኝ።

verses.text_english: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስም በፊቴ አለፈ፤  የሥጋዬ ጠጕር ቆመ።

verses.text_english: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image before mine eyes, silence, and I heard a voice, ,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ቆመ፥ መልኩን ግን ለመለየት አልቻልሁም፥  ምሳሌም በዓይኔ ፊት ነበረ፤  የዝምታ ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ሊሆን፥  ወይስ ሰው በፈጣሪው ፊት ሊነጻ ይችላልን?

verses.text_english: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በባሪያዎቹ አይታመንም፤  መላእክቱንም ስንፍና ይከስሳቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: How much less them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation in the dust, are crushed before the moth?
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንስ በጭቃ ቤት የሚኖሩ፥  መሠረታቸው በትቢያ ውስጥ የሆነ፥  ከብል በፊት የሚጨፈለቁ እንዴት ይሆኑ?

verses.text_english: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding .
verses.text_amharic: በጥዋትና በማታ መካከል ይሰባበራሉ፤  ማንም ሳያስብ ለዘላለም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: Doth not their excellency in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ገመዳቸው የተነቀለ አይደለምን?  አለጥበብም ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ጥራ፤ የሚመልስልህ አለን?  ከቅዱሳንስ ወደማናቸው ትዞራለህ?

verses.text_english: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፉን ሰው ቍጣ ይገድለዋል፥  ሰነፉንም ቅንዓት ያጠፋዋል።

verses.text_english: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ ሰው ሥር ሰድዶ አየሁት፥  ድንገትም መኖሪያውን ረገምሁ።

verses.text_english: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither any to deliver .
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹም ከደኅንነት ርቀዋል፥  በበርም ውስጥ ተረግጠዋል፥  የሚታደጋቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.text_amharic: የሰበሰበውንም ራብተኛ ይበላዋል፥  ከእሾህም ውስጥ እንኳ ያወጣዋል፤  የተጠማ ሀብታቸውን ዋጠ።

verses.text_english: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.text_amharic: ችግር ከትቢያ አይመጣም፥  መከራም ከመሬት አይበቅልም፤

verses.text_english: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞራ ግልገሎች ግን ወደ ላይ እየበረሩ ከፍ እንዲሉ፥  ሰው እንዲሁ ለመከራ ተወልዶአል።

verses.text_english: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን እለምን ነበር፥  ነገሬንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አቀርብ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.text_amharic: የማይመረመረውን ታላቅ ነገርና  የማይቈጠረውን ተአምራት ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ዝናብን ይሰጣል፥  በእርሻም ላይ ውኃ ይልካል።

verses.text_english: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.text_amharic: የተዋረዱትን ወደ ላይ ያወጣል፥  ኀዘንተኞችንም ለደኅንነት ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform enterprise.
verses.text_amharic: እጃቸውም ምክራቸውን እንዳይፈጽም  የተንኰለኞችን አሳብ ከንቱ ያደርገዋል።

verses.text_english: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢባንን በተንኰላቸው ይይዛቸዋል፤  የጠማሞችንም ምክር ይዘረዝራል።

verses.text_english: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.text_amharic: በቀን ጨለማን ያገኛሉ፥  በቀትርም ጊዜ በሌሊት እንዳሉ ይርመሰመሳሉ።

verses.text_english: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀውንም ከአፋቸው ሰይፍ  ከኃያሉም እጅ ያድነዋል።

verses.text_english: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ለምስኪኑም ተስፋ አለው፤  ክፋት ግን አፍዋን ትዘጋለች።

verses.text_english: Behold, happy the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር የሚገሥጸው ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤  ስለዚህ ሁሉን የሚችለውን የአምላክን ተግሣጽ አትናቅ።

verses.text_english: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ይሰብራል፥ ይጠግንማል፤  ያቈስላል፥ እጆቹም ይፈውሳሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.text_amharic: በስድስት ክፉ ነገር ውስጥ ያድንሃል፥  በሰባትም ውስጥ ክፋት አትነካህም።

verses.text_english: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.text_amharic: በራብ ጊዜ ከሞት፥  በሰልፍም ከሰይፍ እጅ ያድንሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.text_amharic: ከምላስ ጅራፍ ትሰወራለህ፤  ጥፋትም ሲመጣ አትፈራም።

verses.text_english: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በጥፋትና በራብ ላይ ትስቃለህ፤  ከምድረ በዳ አራዊትም አትፈራም፤

verses.text_english: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳንህ ከምድረ በዳ ድንጋይ ጋር ይሆናልና፤  የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ከአንተ ጋር ይስማማሉና።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.text_amharic: ድንኳንህም በሰላም እንዲሆን ታውቃለህ፤  በረትህን ትጐበኛለህ አንዳችም አይጐድልብህም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt know also that thy seed great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህም ታላቅ እንዲሆን፥  ትውልድህም እንደ ምድር ሣር እንዲሆን ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt come to grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.text_amharic: በወራቱ የእህሉ ነዶ ወደ አውድማ እንዲገባ፥  በረጅም ዕድሜ ወደ መቃብር ትገባለህ።

verses.text_english: Lo this, we have searched it, so it ; hear it, and know thou for thy good.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ይህችን መረመርን፥ የሰማነውም ይህ ነው፤  አንተ ግን አንዳች ሠርተህ እንደ ሆነ ለራስህ እወቀው።

verses.text_english: But Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
verses.text_amharic: ትካዜዬ ምነው በተመዘነ ኖሮ!  መከራዬም ሁሉ ምነው በሚዛን ላይ በተደረገ ኖሮ!

verses.text_english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሕር አሸዋ ይልቅ ይከብድ ነበርና፤  ስለዚህ ቃሌ ደፋር ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: For the arrows of the Almighty within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክ ፍላጻ በሥጋዬ ውስጥ ነው፥  መርዙንም ነፍሴ ትጠጣለች፤  የእግዚአብሔር ድንጋጤ በላዬ ተሰልፎአል።

verses.text_english: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የሜዳ አህያ ሣር ሳለው ይጮኻልን?  ወይስ በሬ ገለባ ሳለው ይጮኻልን?

verses.text_english: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there taste in the white of an egg?
verses.text_amharic: የማይጣፍጥስ ነገር ያለ ጨው ይበላልን?  ወይስ የእንቁላል ውኃ ይጥማልን?

verses.text_english: The things my soul refused to touch as my sorrowful meat.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውነቴ ትነካው ዘንድ እንቢ አለችው፤  እንደሚያስጸይፍ መብል ሆነብኝ።

verses.text_english: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant the thing that I long for!
verses.text_amharic: ልመናዬ ምነው በደረሰልኝ!  እግዚአብሔርም ምኞቴን ምነው በሰጠኝ!

verses.text_english: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያደቀኝ ዘንድ  እጁንም ለቅቆ ያጠፋኝ ዘንድ ወድዶ ቢሆን ኖሮ!

verses.text_english: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.text_amharic: መጽናናት በሆነልኝ ነበር፤  በማይራራ ሕመም ሐሤት ባደረግሁ ነበር፥  የቅዱሱን ቃል አልካድሁምና።

verses.text_english: What my strength, that I should hope? and what mine end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.text_amharic: እጠብቅ ዘንድ ጕልበቴ ምንድር ነው?  እታገሥም ዘንድ ፍጻሜዬ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: my strength the strength of stones? or my flesh of brass?
verses.text_amharic: ጕልበቴ የድንጋይ ጕልበት ነውን?  ሥጋዬስ እንደ ናስ ነውን?

verses.text_english: not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ረድኤት በእኔ እንደሌለ  ጥበብም ሁሉ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ተባረረ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: To him that is afflicted pity from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችለውን የአምላክን መፍራት  ለሚተው፥ ለመዛል ለቀረበው ስንኳ  ወዳጁ ቸርነትን ሊያሳይ ይገባል።

verses.text_english: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the stream of brooks they pass away;
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ እንደ ፈፋ፥  እንደሚያልፍ ፈፋ ሐሰተኞች ሆኑብኝ።

verses.text_english: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, wherein the snow is hid:
verses.text_amharic: ከበረዶ የተነሣ ደፈረሱ፥  አመዳይም ተሰወረባቸው፤

verses.text_english: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ በተኰሰች ጊዜ ይደርቃሉ፤  በሙቀትም ጊዜ ከስፍራቸው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
verses.text_amharic: በየዳርቻቸውም የሚሄዱ ነጋዴዎች ፈቀቅ ይላሉ፤  ወደ በረሃ ወጥተው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.text_amharic: የቴማን ነጋዴዎች ተመለከቱ፥  የሳባ መንገደኞችም ተጠባበቁአቸው።

verses.text_english: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋ አድርገዋቸው ነበርና አፈሩ፤  ወደዚያ ደረሱ፥ እፍረትም ያዛቸው።

verses.text_english: For now ye are nothing; ye see casting down, and are afraid.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እናንተ እንደዚሁ ሆናችኋል፤  መከራዬን አይታችሁ ፈራችሁ።

verses.text_english: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ። አንዳች ነገር አምጡልኝ፤  ወይስ። ከብልጥግናችሁ ስጦታ አቅርቡልኝ፤

verses.text_english: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ። ከጠላቴ እጅ አስጥሉኝ፤  ወይስ። ከአስጨናቂው እጅ አድኑኝ አልኋችሁን?

verses.text_english: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.text_amharic: አስተምሩኝ፥ እኔም ዝም እላለሁ፤  የተሳሳትሁትንም ንገሩኝ።

verses.text_english: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
verses.text_amharic: የቅንነት ቃል እንዴት ኃይለኛ ነው!  የእናንተ ሙግት ግን ምን ይገሥጻል?

verses.text_english: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, as wind?
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋ የሌለው ሰው ንግግር እንደ ነፋስ ነውና  ቃሌን ትገሥጹ ዘንድ ታስባላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig for your friend.
verses.text_amharic: በድሀ አደጉ ላይ ዕጣ ትጣጣላላችሁ፤  ለወዳጆቻችሁም ጕድጓድ ትቈፍራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for evident unto you if I lie.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እባካችሁ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፤  በፊታችሁም ሐሰት አልናገርም።

verses.text_english: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness in it.
verses.text_amharic: እባካችሁ፥ ተመለሱ፤ በደል አይሁን፤  ጽድቄ በዚህ ነገር ነውና አንድ ጊዜ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ በአንደበቴ በደል ይገኛልን?  አፌስ ተንኰልን ይለይ ዘንድ አይችልምን?

verses.text_english: not an appointed time to man upon earth? his days also like the days of an hireling?
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ የሰው ሕይወት ብርቱ ሰልፍ አይደለምን?  ወራቱም እንደ ምንደኛ ወራት አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for his work:
verses.text_amharic: አገልጋይ ጥላ እንደሚመኝ፥  ምንደኛም ደመወዙን እንደሚጠብቅ፥

verses.text_english: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ዕጣዬ የከንቱ ወራት ሆነብኝ፥  የድካምም ሌሊት ተወሰነችልኝ።

verses.text_english: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.text_amharic: በተኛሁ ጊዜ። መቼ እነሣለሁ? እላለሁ።  ሌሊቱ ግን ይረዝማል፥  እስኪነጋ ድረስም እገለባበጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋዬ ትልና ጓል ለብሶአል፤  ቁርበቴ ያፈከፍካል እንደ ገናም ይመግላል።

verses.text_english: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኔ ከሸማኔ መወርወርያ ይልቅ ይቸኵላል፥  ያለ ተስፋም ያልቃል።

verses.text_english: O remember that my life wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወቴ እስትንፋስ እንደ ሆነ አስብ፤  ዓይኔ መልካም ነገርን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያይም።

verses.text_english: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no : thine eyes upon me, and I not.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያየኝ ሰው ዓይን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያየኝም፤  ዓይንህ በእኔ ላይ ይሆናል፥ እኔም አልገኝም።

verses.text_english: the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no .
verses.text_amharic: ደመና ተበትኖ እንደሚጠፋ፥  እንዲሁ ወደ ሲኦል የሚወርድ ዳግመኛ አይወጣም።

verses.text_english: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቱ ዳግመኛ አይመለስም፥  ስፍራውም ዳግመኛ አያውቀውም።

verses.text_english: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም አፌን አልከለክልም፤  በመንፈሴ ጭንቀትን እናገራለሁ፤  በነፍሴ ምሬት በኀዘን አንጐራጕራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
verses.text_amharic: ጠባቂ ታስነሣብኝ ዘንድ፥  እኔ ባሕር ወይስ አንበሪ ነኝን?

verses.text_english: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። አልጋዬ ያጽናናኛል፥  መኝታዬም የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን ያቀልልኛል ባልሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በሕልም ታስፈራራኛለህ፥  በራእይም ታስደነግጠኛለህ፤

verses.text_english: So that my soul chooseth strangling, death rather than my life.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴም ከአጥንቴ ይልቅ  መታነቅንና ሞትን መረጠች።

verses.text_english: I loathe ; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወቴን ናቅኋት፤ ለዘላለም ልኖር አልወድድም።  የሕይወቴ ዘመን እስትንፋስ ነውና ተወኝ።

verses.text_english: What man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ምንድር ነው ታከብረው ዘንድ፥  ልብህንስ ትጥልበት ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: And thou shouldest visit him every morning, try him every moment?
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳ ማለዳስ ትጐበኘው ዘንድ፥  ሁልጊዜስ ትፈታተነው ዘንድ?

verses.text_english: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.text_amharic: የማትተወኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?  ምራቄንስ እስክውጥ ድረስ የማትለቅቀኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.text_english: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን የምትጠብቅ ሆይ፥ በድዬስ እንደ ሆነ ምን ላድርግልህ?  ስለ ምን እኔን ለአንተ ዓላማ አደረግኸኝ?  ስለ ምን እኔ ሸክም ሆንሁብህ?

verses.text_english: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I not .
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን መተላለፌን ይቅር አትልም?  ኃጢአቴንስ ስለ ምን አታስወግድልኝም?  አሁን በምድር ውስጥ እተኛለሁ፤  ማለዳ ትፈልገኛለህ፥ አታገኘኝም።

verses.text_english: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: How long wilt thou speak these ? and the words of thy mouth a strong wind?
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መቼ ይህን ትናገራለህ?  የአፍህስ ቃል እስከ መቼ እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሆናል?

verses.text_english: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን ያጣምማልን?  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ ጽድቅን ያጣምማልን?

verses.text_english: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችህ በድለውት እንደ ሆነ፥  እርሱ በበደላቸው እጅ ጥሎአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ብትገሠግሥ፥  ሁሉንም የሚችለውን አምላክ ብትለምን፥

verses.text_english: If thou pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕና ቅን ብትሆን፥  በእውነት አሁን ስለ አንተ ይነቃል፥  የጽድቅህንም መኖሪያ ያከናውንልሃል።

verses.text_english: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.text_amharic: ጅማሬህ ታናሽ ቢሆንም እንኳ  ፍጻሜህ እጅግ ይበዛል።

verses.text_english: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
(For we yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth a shadow:)
verses.text_amharic: ዘመናችን በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ነውና  እኛ የትናንት ብቻ ነን፤ ምንም አናውቅም፤  ስለዚህ የቀደመውን ትውልድ ጠይቅ፥  አባቶቻቸውም ለመረመሩት ነገር ትጋ፤

verses.text_english: Shall not they teach thee, tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ የሚያስተምሩህና የሚነግሩህ፥  ቃልንም ከልባቸው የሚያወጡ አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ደንገል ረግረግ በሌለበት መሬት ይበቅላልን?  ወይስ ቄጠማ ውኃ በሌለበት ቦታ ይለመልማልን?

verses.text_english: Whilst it yet in his greenness, not cut down, it withereth before any herb.
verses.text_amharic: ገና ሲለመልም ሳይቈረጥም፥  ከአትክልት ሁሉ በፊት ይደርቃል።

verses.text_english: So the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የሚረሱ ሁሉ ፍጻሜአቸው እንዲሁ ነው፤  የዝንጉም ሰው ተስፋ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust a spider's web.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋው ይቈረጣል፥  እምነቱም እንደ ሸረሪት ቤት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱን ይደግፈዋል፥ አይቆምለትም፤  ይይዘውማል፥ አይጸናለትም።

verses.text_english: He green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይም ሳይተኵስ ይለመልማል፥  ጫፉም በአታክልቱ ቦታ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: His roots are wrapped about the heap, seeth the place of stones.
verses.text_amharic: በድንጋይ ክምር ላይ ሥሩ ይጠመጠማል፤  የድንጋዮቹን ቦታ ይመለከታል።

verses.text_english: If he destroy him from his place, then shall deny him, , I have not seen thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከቦታው ቢጠፋ።  አላየሁህም ብሎ ይክደዋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, this the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የመንገዱ ደስታ እንዲህ ነው፤  ሌሎችም ከመሬት ይበቅላሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect , neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ፍጹሙን ሰው አይጥለውም፥  የኃጢአተኞችንም እጅ አያበረታም።

verses.text_english: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.text_amharic: አፍህን እንደ ገና ሳቅ ይሞላል፥  ከንፈሮችህንም እልልታ ይሞላል።

verses.text_english: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጠሉህ እፍረት ይለብሳሉ፤  የኃጢአተኞችም ድንኳን አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: I know so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት እንዲህ እንደ ሆነ አወቅሁ፤  ሰውስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ መሆን እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.text_english: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከር ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥  ከሺህ ነገር አንዱን መመለስ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened against him, and hath prospered?
verses.text_amharic: ልቡ ጠቢብ፥ ኃይሉም ታላቅ ነው፤  ደፍሮትስ በደኅና የሄደ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮችን ይነቅላል፤ አያውቁትም፤  በቍጣውም ይገለብጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን ከስፍራው ያናውጣታል፥  ምሰሶችዋም ይንቀጠቀጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይን ያዝዛታል፥ አትወጣምም፤  ከዋክብትንም ያትማል።

verses.text_english: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትን ብቻውን ይዘረጋል፥  በባሕሩም ማዕበል ላይ ይረግጣል።

verses.text_english: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.text_amharic: ድብ የሚባለውን ኮከብና ኦሪዮን የሚባለውን ኮከብ፥ ሰባቱንም ከዋክብት፥  በደቡብም በኩል ያሉትን የከዋክብት ማደርያዎች ሠርቶአል።

verses.text_english: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.text_amharic: የማይመረመረውን ታላላቅ ነገር፥  የማይቈጠረውንም ተአምራት ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ቢመጣብኝ አላየውም፤  ቢያልፍብኝም አላውቀውም።

verses.text_english: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ፈጥኖ ቢነጥቅ የሚከለክለው ማን ነው?  እርሱንስ። ምን ታደርጋለህ? የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቍጣውን አይመልስም፤  ከእርሱ በታች ረዓብን የሚረዱ ይዋረዳሉ።

verses.text_english: How much less shall I answer him, choose out my words with him?
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንስ እመልስለት ዘንድ፥  ቃሌንስ በፊቱ እመርጥ ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነኝ?

verses.text_english: Whom, though I were righteous, would I not answer, I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ብሆን ኖሮ አልመልስለትም ነበር፤  ወደ ፈራጄም እለምን ነበር።

verses.text_english: If I had called, and he had answered me; would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.text_amharic: ብጠራው እርሱም ቢመልስልኝ ኖሮ፥  ቃሌን እንደ ሰማ አላምንም ነበር።

verses.text_english: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.text_amharic: በዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሰብረኛል፥  ቍስሌንም ያለ ምክንያት ያበዛል።

verses.text_english: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.text_amharic: እተነፍስ ዘንድ አይተወኝም፥  ነገር ግን መራራን ነገር አጥግቦኛል።

verses.text_english: If of strength, lo, strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time ?
verses.text_amharic: የኃይል ነገር ቢሆን እርሱ ኃያል ነው፤  የፍርድ ነገር ቢሆን። ጊዜን ወሳኙ ማን ነው? ይላል።

verses.text_english: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: , I perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ብሆን አፌ ይወቅሰኛል፤  ፍጹምም ብሆን ጠማማ ያደርገኛል።

verses.text_english: I perfect, would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.text_amharic: ፍጹም ነኝ ራሴንም አልመለከትም፤  ሕይወቴንም እንቃታለሁ።

verses.text_english: This one , therefore I said , He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሁሉ አንድ ነው፤ ስለዚህ።  ፍጹማንንና ክፉዎችን ያጠፋል እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.text_amharic: መቅሠፍቱ ፈጥኖ ቢገድል፥  በንጹሐን ፈተና ይሳለቃል።

verses.text_english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, who he?
verses.text_amharic: ምድር በኃጥአን እጅ ተሰጥታለች፤  የፈራጆችዋን ፊት ሸፍኖአል፤  እርሱ ካልሆነ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኔ ከሚሮጥ ሰው ይልቅ ይፈጥናል፤  ይሸሻል፥ መልካምንም አያይም።

verses.text_english: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle hasteth to the prey.
verses.text_amharic: የደንገል ታንኳ እንደሚፈጥን፥  ንስርም ወደ ንጥቂያው እንደሚበርር ያልፋል።

verses.text_english: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort :
verses.text_amharic: እኔ። የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን እረሳለሁ፤  ፊቴን መልሼ እጽናናለሁ ብል፥

verses.text_english: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕ እንደማታደርገኝ እኔ አውቃለሁና  ከመከራዬ ሁሉ እፈራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.text_amharic: በደለኛ እንደሚሆን ሰው እሆናለሁ፤  ስለ ምንስ በከንቱ እደክማለሁ?

verses.text_english: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.text_amharic: በአመዳይ ውስጥ ብታጠብ፥  እጆቼንም እጅግ ባነጻ፥

verses.text_english: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.text_amharic: በአዘቅት ውስጥ ታሰጥመኛለህ፥  ልብሴም ይጸየፈኛል።

verses.text_english: For not a man, as I I should answer him, we should come together in judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እንድመልስለት አብረን ወደ ፍርድ እንገባ ዘንድ፥  እርሱ እንደ እኔ ሰው አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.text_amharic: እጁን በሁለታችን ላይ የሚያኖር ዳኛ  በመካከላችን ምነው በተገኘ!

verses.text_english: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.text_amharic: በትሩን ከእኔ ላይ ያርቅ፥  ግርማውም አያስፈራኝ፤

verses.text_english: would I speak, and not fear him; but not so with me.
verses.text_amharic: እናገርም ነበር፥ አልፈራውምም ነበር፤  በራሴ እንዲህ አይደለሁምና።

verses.text_english: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሕይወቴን ሰለቸቻት፤  የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን እለቀዋለሁ፤  በነፍሴም ምሬት እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ እለዋለሁ።  አትፍረድብኝ፤ የምትከራከረኝ ለምን እንደ ሆነ ንገረኝ።

verses.text_english: good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.text_amharic: ልታስጨንቅና የእጅህን ሥራ ልትንቅ  የኃጥአንንስ ምክር ልታበራ  በአንተ ዘንድ መልካም ነውን?

verses.text_english: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የሥጋ ዓይን አለህን?  ወይስ ሰው እንደሚያይ ታያለህን?

verses.text_english: thy days as the days of man? thy years as man's days,
That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ክፋቴን ትፈላለግ ዘንድ፥  ኃጢአቴንም ትመረምር ዘንድ፥  ዘመንህ እንደ ሰው ዘመን ነውን?  ወይስ ዓመታትህ እንደ ሰው ዓመታት ናቸውን?

verses.text_english: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and none that can deliver out of thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በላይ በደለኛ እንዳልሆንሁ፥  ከእጅህም የሚያድን እንደሌለ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.text_amharic: እጅህ ለወሰችኝ ሠራችኝም፤  ከዚያም በኋላ ዞረህ ታጠፋኝ ዘንድ ፈለግህ።

verses.text_english: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጭቃ አድርገህ እንደ ለወስኸኝ አስብ፤  ወደ ትቢያም ትመልሰኛለህን?

verses.text_english: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እንደ ወተት አላፈሰስኸኝምን?  እንደ እርጎስ አላረጋኸኝምን?

verses.text_english: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.text_amharic: ቁርበትና ሥጋ አለበስኸኝ፥  በአጥንትና በጅማትም አጠንከርኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወትና ቸርነት አደረግህልኝ፤  መጐብኘትህም መንፈሴን ጠበቀች።

verses.text_english: And these hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this with thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም ነገሮች በልብህ ውስጥ ሰወርህ።  ይህ ሁሉ በአሳብህ እንዳለ አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአት ብሠራ አንተ ትመለከተኛለህ፤  ከኃጢአቴም ንጹሕ አታደርገኝም።

verses.text_english: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and I be righteous, will I not lift up my head. full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
verses.text_amharic: በደለኛ ብሆን ወዮልኝ፤  ጻድቅም ብሆን ራሴን አላነሣም፤  ጕስቍልናን ተሞልቻለሁ፥  መከራዬንም ተመልክቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.text_amharic: ራሴም ከፍ ከፍ ቢል እንደ አንበሳ ታድነኛለህ፤  ተመልሰህም ድንቅ ነገር ታድርግብኛለህ

verses.text_english: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war against me.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክሮችህን ታድስብኛለህ፤  ቍጣህንም ታበዛብኛለህ፤  ጭፍራ በጭፍራ ላይ ትጨምርብኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን ከማኅፀን አወጣኸኝ?  ዓይን ሳያየኝ ምነው በሞትሁ።

verses.text_english: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳልነበረ በሆንሁ፤  ከማኅፀንም ወደ መቃብር በወሰዱኝ።

verses.text_english: not my days few? cease let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.text_amharic: የሕይወቴ ዘመን ጥቂት አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Before I go I shall not return, to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.text_amharic: ወደማልመለስበት ስፍራ፥  ወደ ጨለማና ወደ ሞት ጥላ ምድር፥

verses.text_english: A land of darkness, as darkness of the shadow of death, without any order, and the light as darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጨለማም ወደ ጨለመች፥  ሥርዓትም ወደሌለባት ወደ ሞት ጥላ፥  ብርሃንዋም እንደ ጨለማ ወደ ሆነ ምድር ሳልሄድ፥  ጥቂት እጽናና ዘንድ ተወኝ፥ ልቀቀኝም።

verses.text_english: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ነዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለስ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ለቃል ብዛት መልስ መስጠት አይገባምን?  ወይስ ተናጋሪ ሰው እንደ ጻድቅ ይቈጠራልን?

verses.text_english: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.text_amharic: ትምክህትህስ ሰዎችን ዝም ያሰኛቸዋልን?  ብትሳለቅስ የሚያሳፍርህ የለምን?

verses.text_english: For thou hast said, My doctrine pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ። ትምህርቴ የተጣራ ነው፥  በዓይንህም ፊት ንጹሕ ነኝ ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
verses.text_amharic: ምነው እግዚአብሔር ቢናገርህ!  በአንተም ላይ ከንፈሩን ቢከፍት!

verses.text_english: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee than thine iniquity .
verses.text_amharic: የጥበቡን ምሥጢር ቢገልጥልህ!  ማስተዋሉ ብዙ ነውና።  እግዚአብሔር ለበደልህ ከሚገባው አሳንሶ እንደሚያስከፍልህ እወቅ።

verses.text_english: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ጥልቅ ነገር ልትመረምር ትችላለህን?  ወይስ ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ፈጽመህ ልትመረምር ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይ ይልቅ ከፍ ይላል፤ ምን ልታደርግ ትችላለህ?  ከሲኦልም ይልቅ ይጠልቃል፤ ምን ልታውቅ ትችላለህ?

verses.text_english: The measure thereof longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ርዝመቱ ከምድር ይልቅ ይረዝማል፥  ከባሕርም ይልቅ ይሰፋል።

verses.text_english: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ቢያልፍ፥ ቢዘጋም፥ ጉባኤንም ቢሰበስብ፥  የሚከለክለው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider ?
verses.text_amharic: ምናምንቴዎችን ሰዎች ያውቃልና፥  በደልንም ሲያይ ዝም ብሎ አይመለከትም።

verses.text_english: For vain man would be wise, though man be born a wild ass's colt.
verses.text_amharic: የሜዳ አህያ ግልገል ሰው ሆኖ ቢወለድ፥  ያን ጊዜ ከንቱ ሰው ጥበብን ያገኛል።

verses.text_english: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
If iniquity in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በእውነት ፊትህን ያለ ነውር ታነሣለህ፤  ትበረታለህ፥ አትፈራምም።

verses.text_english: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.text_amharic: መከራህንም ትረሳለህ፤  እንዳለፈ ውኃ ታስበዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Because thou shalt forget misery, remember as waters pass away:
verses.text_amharic: ከቅትር ይልቅ ሕይወትህ ይበራል፤  ጨለማም ቢሆን እንደ ጥዋት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋም ስላለህ ተዘልለህ ትቀመጣለህ፤  በዙሪያህ ትመለከታለህ፥ በደኅንነትም ታርፋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.text_amharic: ትተኛለህ፥ የሚያስፈራህም የለም፤  ብዙ ሰዎችም ልመና ያቀርቡልሃል።

verses.text_english: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: የክፉዎች ዓይን ግን ትጨልማለች፤  የሚሸሹበትንም ያጣሉ፥  ተስፋቸውም ነፍሳቸውን ማውጣት ነው።

verses.text_english: And Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: No doubt but ye the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.text_amharic: በእርግጥ እናንተ ዓይነተኞች ሰዎች ናቸሁ፤  ጥበብም ከእናንተ ጋር ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: But I have understanding as well as you; I not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ ማስተዋል አለኝ፤  ከእናንተም የማንስ አይደለሁም፤  እንደዚህ ያለውን ነገር የማያውቅ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: I am one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright laughed to scorn.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የጠራሁ እርሱም የመለሰልኝ እኔ  ለባልንጀራው መሳለቂያ እንደሚሆን ሰው ሆኛለሁ፤  ጻድቅና ፍጹም ሰው መሳለቂያ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: He that is ready to slip with feet a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.text_amharic: ተዘልሎ በሚቀመጥ ሰው አሳብ መከራ ይናቃል፤  ነገር ግን እግሩን ሊያድጠው ተዘጋጅቶአል።

verses.text_english: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth .
verses.text_amharic: የቀማኞች ድንኳን በደኅንነት ይኖራል፥  እግዚአብሔርንም የሚያስቈጡ ተዘልለው ተቀምጠዋል፤  እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን በእጃቸው አምጥቶላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን እንስሶችን ጠይቅ፥ ያስተምሩህማል፤  የሰማይንም ወፎች ጠይቅ፥ ይነግሩህማል።

verses.text_english: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ለምድር ተናገር፥ እርስዋም ታስተምርሃለች፤  የባሕርም ዓሣዎች ይነግሩሃል።

verses.text_english: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ይህን እንዳደረገ  ከእነዚህ ሁሉ የማያውቅ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: In whose hand the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.text_amharic: የሕያዋን ሁሉ ነፍስ  የሰውም ሁሉ መንፈስ በእጁ ናት።

verses.text_english: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.text_amharic: ምላስ መብልን እንደሚቀምስ፥  ጆሮ ቃልን የሚለይ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: With the ancient wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.text_amharic: በሽምግልና ጊዜ ጥበብ፥  በዘመንስ ርዝመት ማስተዋል ይገኛል።

verses.text_english: With him wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጥበብና ኃይል አለ፤  ለእርሱ ምክርና ማስተዋል አለው።

verses.text_english: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ይፈርሳል፥ የፈረሰውም ተመልሶ አይሠራም፤  በሰውም ቢዘጋበት የሚከፍትለት የለም።

verses.text_english: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ውኆቹን ይከለክላል፥ እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ፤  እንደ ገና ይሰድዳቸዋል፥ ምድሪቱንም ይገለብጣሉ።

verses.text_english: With him strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver his.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይልና ጥበብ በእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸው፤  የሚስተውና የሚያስተው ለእርሱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.text_amharic: መካሮችንም እንደ ዘረፋ ይወስዳቸዋል፥  ፈራጆችንም ያሳብዳል።

verses.text_english: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.text_amharic: የነገሥታትንም እስራት ይፈታል፥  ወገባቸውንም በመታጠቂያ ያስራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናትን እንደ ዘረፋ ይወስዳቸዋል፥  ኃያላንንም ይገለብጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.text_amharic: ከታመኑ ሰዎችም ቋንቋን ያርቃል፥  የሽማግሌዎችንም ማስተዋል ይወስድባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: በአለቆች ላይ ንቀትን ያፈስሳል፥  የብርቱዎችንም መታጠቂያ ያላላል።

verses.text_english: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.text_amharic: ጥልቅ ነገር ከጨለማ ይገልጣል፥  የሞትንም ጥላ ወደ ብርሃን ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them .
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ እነርሱንም ያጠፋል፤  አሕዛብንም ያሰፋል፥ እነርሱንም ያፈልሳቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness no way.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድር አሕዛብ አለቆች ዘንድ ማስተዋልን ይወስዳል፥  መንገድም በሌለበት በረሃ ያቅበዘብዛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like drunken .
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንም ሳይኖር በጨለማ ይርመሰመሳሉ፤  እንደ ሰካራም ይቅበዘበዛሉ።

verses.text_english: Lo, mine eye hath seen all , mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ይህን ሁሉ ዓይኔ አየች፤  ጆሮዬም ሰምታ አስተዋለችው።

verses.text_english: What ye know, do I know also: I not inferior unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምታውቁትን እኔ ደግሞ አውቃለሁ፤  ከእናንተ የማንስ አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሁሉን ለሚችል አምላክ መናገር እፈልጋለሁ፥  ከእግዚአብሔርም ጋር ለመዋቀስ እሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: But ye forgers of lies, ye all physicians of no value.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን በሐሰት ለባጮች ናችሁ፤  ሁላችሁ የማትጠቅሙ ባለ መድኃኒቶች ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ምነው ዝም ብላችሁ ብትኖሩ!  ይህ ጥበብ በሆነላችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ክርክሬን ስሙ፥  የከንፈሬንም ሙግት አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሐሰትን ትናገራላችሁን?  ስለ እርሱም ሽንገላን ታወራላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
verses.text_amharic: ለፊቱስ ታደላላችሁን?  ስለ እግዚአብሔርስ ትከራከራላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye mock him?
verses.text_amharic: ቢመረምራችሁስ መልካም ይሆንልችኋልን?  ወይስ በሰው እንደምትሳለቁ ትሳለቁበታላችሁን?

verses.text_english: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.text_amharic: በስውር ለሰው ፊት ብታደሉ  ዘለፋ ይዘልፋችኋል።

verses.text_english: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.text_amharic: ክብሩስ አያስፈራችሁምን?  ግርማውስ አይወድቅባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: Your remembrances like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.text_amharic: ምስሌዎቻችሁ የአመድ ምሳሌዎች ናቸው፤  ምሽጎቻችሁ የጭቃ ምሽጎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what .
verses.text_amharic: ዝም በሉ፥ እናገርም ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤  የሆነው ነገር ይምጣብኝ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋዬን በጥርሴ እይዛለሁ፥  ሕይወቴንም በእጄ አኖራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ቢገድለኝ ስንኳ እርሱን በትዕግሥት እጠባበቃለሁ፤  ነገር ግን መንገዴን በፊቱ አጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: He also my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.text_amharic: ዝንጉ ሰው በፊቱ አይገባምና  እርሱ መድኃኒት ይሆንልኛል።

verses.text_english: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሬን ተግታችሁ ስሙ፥  ምስክርነቴንም በጆሮአችሁ አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: Behold now, I have ordered cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅቻለሁ።  እንደምጸድቅም አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Who he will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔስ ጋር የሚፋረድ ማን ነው?  አሁን እኔ ዝም ብል እሞታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Only do not two unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሁለት ነገር አታድርግብኝ፤  የዚያን ጊዜ ከፊትህ አልሰወርም፤

verses.text_english: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እጅህን ከእኔ አርቅ፤  ግርማህም አታስደንግጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ጥራኝ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ።  ወይም እኔ ልናገር፥ አንተም መልስልኝ።

verses.text_english: How many mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.text_amharic: ያለብኝስ በደልና ኃጢአት ምን ያህል ነው?  መተላለፌንና ኃጢአቴን አስታውቀኝ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.text_amharic: ፊትህን ከእኔ የሰወርህ፥  እንደ ጠላትህም የቈጠርኸኝ ስለ ምን ነው?

verses.text_english: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.text_amharic: የረገፈውን ቅጠል ታስጨንቃለህን?  ወይስ የደረቀውን ዕብቅ ታሳድዳለህን?

verses.text_english: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.text_amharic: የመረረ ነገር ጽፈህብኛልና፤  የሕፃንነቴንም ኃጢአት ታወርሰኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.text_amharic: እግሬንም በእግር ግንድ አግብተሃል፥  መንገዴንም ሁሉ መርምረሃል፤  የእግሬን ፍለጋ ወስነሃል።

verses.text_english: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንደሚጠፋ በስባሳ ነገር፥  ብልም እንደሚበላው ልብስ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Man born of a woman of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴት የተወለደ ሰው  የሕይወቱ ዘመን ጥቂት ቀን ነው፥ መከራም ይሞላዋል።

verses.text_english: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አበባ ይወጣል፥ ይረግፋልም፤  እንደ ጥላም ይሸሻል፥ እርሱም አይጸናም።

verses.text_english: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህስ ባለ ሰው ላይ ዓይኖችህን ትከፍታለህን?  ከአንተስ ጋር እኔን ወደ ፍርድ ታገባለህን?

verses.text_english: Who can bring a clean out of an unclean? not one.
verses.text_amharic: ከርኩስ ነገር ንጹሕን ሊያወጣ ማን ይችላል?  አንድ እንኳ የሚችል የለም።

verses.text_english: Seeing his days determined, the number of his months with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ዕድሜ የተወሰነ ነው፥  የወሩም ቍጥር በአንተ ዘንድ ነው፥  እርሱም ሊተላለፈው የማይችለውን ዳርቻ አደረግህለት።

verses.text_english: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምንደኛ ዕድሜው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ  ያርፍ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ጥቂት ዘወር በል።

verses.text_english: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፍ ቢቈረጥ ደግሞ ያቈጠቍጥ ዘንድ፥  ቅርንጫፉም እንዳያልቅ ተስፋ አለው።

verses.text_english: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.text_amharic: ሥሩም በምድር ውስጥ ቢያረጅ፥  ግንዱም በመሬት ውስጥ ቢሞት፥

verses.text_english: through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.text_amharic: ከውኃ ሽታ የተነሣ ያቈጠቍጣል፤  እንደ አትክልት ቅርንጫፍ ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where he?
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ግን ይሞትና ይጋደማል፤  ሰውም ነፍሱን ይሰጣል፥ እርሱስ ወዴት አለ?

verses.text_english: the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.text_amharic: ውኃ ከባሕር ውስጥ ያልቃል፤  ወንዙም ያንሳል ይደርቅማል።

verses.text_english: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ተኝቶ አይነሣም፤  ሰማይ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ አይነቃም፥  ከእንቅልፉም አይነሣም።

verses.text_english: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.text_amharic: በሲኦል ውስጥ ምነው በሰወርኸኝ ኖሮ!  ቍጣህ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ በሸሸግኸኝ ኖሮ!  ቀጠሮም አድርገህ ምነው ባሰብኸኝ ኖሮ!

verses.text_english: If a man die, shall he live ? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ሰው ከሞተ ተመልሶ ሕያው ይሆናልን?  መለወጤ እስኪመጣ ድረስ፥  የሰልፌን ዘመን ሁሉ በትዕግሥት በተጠባበቅሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.text_amharic: በጠራኸኝና በመለስሁልህ ነበር፤  የእጅህንም ሥራ በተመኘኸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን እርምጃዬን ቈጥረኸዋል፤  ኃጢአቴንም ትጠባበቃለህ።

verses.text_english: My transgression sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: መተላልፌ በከረጢት ውስጥ ታትሞአል፥  ኃጢአቴንም ለብጠህበታል።

verses.text_english: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.text_amharic: ተራራ ሲወድቅ ይጠፋል፥  ዓለቱም ከስፍራው ይፈልሳል፤

verses.text_english: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.text_amharic: ውኆች ድንጋዮቹን ይፍቃሉ፤  ፈሳሾቹም የምድሩን አፈር ይወስዳሉ፤  እንዲሁ የሰውን ተስፋ ታጠፋዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም ታሸንፈዋለህ፥ እርሱም ያልፋል፤  ፊቱን ትለውጣለህ፥ እርሱንም ትሰድደዋለህ።

verses.text_english: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth not of them.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹ ቢከብሩ አያውቅም፤  ቢዋረዱም አያይም።

verses.text_english: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የገዛ ሥጋው ሕመም ብቻ ይሰማዋል፥  ለራሱም ብቻ ያለቅሳል። ች

verses.text_english: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ጠቢብ ሰው እንደ ንፋስ በሆነ እውቀት ይመልሳልን?  በሆዱስ የምሥራቅን ነፋስ ይሞላልን?

verses.text_english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.text_amharic: ከማይረባ ነገር፥  ወይስ ከማይጠቅም ንግግር ጋር ይዋቀሳልን?

verses.text_english: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ታፈርሳለህ፤  በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አምልኮን ታስቀራለህ።

verses.text_english: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.text_amharic: በደልህ አፍህን ያስተምረዋል፥  የተንኰለኞችንም አንደበት ትመርጣለህ።

verses.text_english: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.text_amharic: የሚፈርድብህ አፍህ ነው እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።  ከንፈሮችህም ይመሰክሩብሃል።

verses.text_english: thou the first man was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ መጀመሪያ የተወለድህ ሰው አንተ ነህን?  ወይስ ከተራሮች በፊት ተፀነስህን?

verses.text_english: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንስ ምሥጢር ሰምተሃልን?  ወይስ ጥበብን ለብቻህ አድርገሃልን?

verses.text_english: What knowest thou, that we know not? understandest thou, which not in us?
verses.text_amharic: እኛ የማናውቀውን አንተ የምታወቀው ምንድር ነው?  ከእኛ ዘንድስ የሌለው የምታስተውለው ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: With us both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.text_amharic: በዕድሜ ከአባትህ የሚበልጡ  ሽበትም ያላቸው ሽማግሌዎችም ከእኛ ጋር አሉ።

verses.text_english: the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር ማጽናናት፥  በየውሃትም የተነገረህ ቃል ጥቂት ነውን?

verses.text_english: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.text_amharic: ልብህስ ለምን ይወስድሃል?  ዓይኖችህስ ለምን ይገለምጣሉ?
