verses.text_english: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest words go out of thy mouth?
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ መንፈስህን እስከ ማንሣት ደርሰህ፤  ይህንም ቃል ከአፍህ እስከ ማውጣት ደርሰህ።

verses.text_english: What man, that he should be clean? and born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕ ይሆን ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው?  ጻድቅስ ይሆን ዘንድ ከሴት የተወለደ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በቅዱሳኑ ስንኳ አይታመንም፤  ሰማያትም በፊቱ ንጹሐን አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: How much more abominable and filthy man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንስ አስጸያፊና የረከሰ፥  ኃጢአትንም እንደ ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሰው ምንኛ ያንስ?

verses.text_english: I will shew thee, hear me; and that I have seen I will declare;
Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid :
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም እንግዳ ያልገባባቸው ጠቢባን።  ከአባቶቻቸው ተቀብለው የተናገሩትን ያልሸሸጉትንም፥  እገልጥልሃለሁ፥ ስማኝ፤ ያየሁትንም እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ሰው ዕድሜውን ሙሉ፥  ከግፈኛ በተመደቡለት በዓመታት ሁሉ በሕመም ይጣጣራል።

verses.text_english: The wicked man travaileth with pain all days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስደነግጥ ድምፅ በጆሮው ነው፤  በደኅንነቱም ሳለ ቀማኛ ይመጣበታል።

verses.text_english: A dreadful sound in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ከጨለማ ተመልሶ እንዲወጣ አያምንም፥  ሰይፍም ይሸምቅበታል።

verses.text_english: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ተቅበዝብዞም። ወዴት አለ? እያለ እንጀራ ይለምናል፤  የጨለማ ቀን እንደ ቀረበበት ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: He wandereth abroad for bread, , Where ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.text_amharic: መከራና ጭንቀት ያስፈራሩታል፤  ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ንጉሥ ያሸንፉታል፤

verses.text_english: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.text_amharic: እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዘርግቶአልና፥  ሁሉንም በሚችል አምላክ ላይ ደፍሮአልና፥

verses.text_english: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: በደንዳና አንገቱና በወፍራሙ በጋሻው  ጕብጕብ እየሠገገ ይመጣበታልና፥

verses.text_english: He runneth upon him, on neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.text_amharic: በስብም ፊቱን ከድኖአልና፥  ስቡንም በወገቡ ላይ አድርጓልና፥

verses.text_english: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on flanks.
verses.text_amharic: በተፈቱም ከተሞች ውስጥ፥  ሰውም በሌለባቸው፥  ክምር ለመሆን በተመደቡ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተቀምጦአልና

verses.text_english: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.text_amharic: ባለጠጋ አይሆንም፥ ሀብቱም አይጸናም፤  ጥላውንም በምድር ላይ አይጥልም፤

verses.text_english: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከጨለማ አይወጣም፤  ነበልባሉም ቅርንጫፎቹን ያደርቃቸዋል፥  አበባዎቹም ይረግፋሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.text_amharic: ዋጋው ከንቱ ነገር ይሆናልና  ራሱን እያሳተ በከንቱ ነገር አይታመን።

verses.text_english: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኑ ሳይደርስ ጊዜው ይፈጸማል፥  ቅርንጫፉም አይለመልምም።

verses.text_english: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ወይን ያልበሰለውን ዘለላ ያረግፋል፤  እንደ ወይራ አበባውን ይጥላል።

verses.text_english: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.text_amharic: የዝንጉዎች ጉባኤ ሁሉ ለጥፋት ይሆናል፥  የጉቦ ተቀባዮችንም ድንኳን እሳት ትበላለች።

verses.text_english: For the congregation of hypocrites desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.text_amharic: ጉዳትን ይፀንሳሉ፥ በደልንም ይወልዳሉ፥  ሆዳቸውም ተንኰልን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.text_english: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters ye all.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ያለ ዓይነት ነገር እጅግ ሰማሁ፤  እናንተ ሁላችሁ የምታደክሙ አጽናኞች ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ከንቱ ቃል ይፈጸማልን?  ወይስ ትመልስ ዘንድ ያነሣሣህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: I also could speak as ye : if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ እናገር ዘንድ ይቻለኝ ነበር፤  ነፍሳችሁ በነፍሴ ፋንታ ቢሆን ኖሮ፥  እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ቃል ማሳካት፥  ራሴንም በእናንተ ላይ መነቅነቅ በተቻለኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage .
verses.text_amharic: በአፌም ነገር ባበረታኋችሁ ነበር፤  የከንፈሬን ማጽናናት ባልከለከልሁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ብናገር ሕማሜ አይቀነስም፤  ዝምም ብል ከእኔ አይወገድም።

verses.text_english: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን አድክሞኛል፤  ወገኔንም ሁሉ አፍርሰሃል።

verses.text_english: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, is a witness : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.text_amharic: መጨማተሬ ይመሰክርብኛል፤  ክሳቴም ተነሥቶብኛል፤  በፊቴም ይመሰክርብኛል።

verses.text_english: He teareth in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣው ቀደደኝ፥ እርሱም ጠላኝ፤  ጥርሶቹንም አፋጨብኝ፤  ጠላቴ ዓይኑን አፈጠጠብኝ፤

verses.text_english: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አፋቸውን ከፈቱብኝ፤  እያላገጡ ጕንጬን ጠፈጠፉኝ፤  በአንድነትም ተሰበሰቡብኝ።

verses.text_english: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለጠማማ ሰው አሳልፎ ሰጠኝ፥  በክፉዎችም እጅ ጣለኝ።

verses.text_english: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.text_amharic: ተዘልዬ ተቀምጬ ነበር፥ እርሱም ሰበረኝ፤  አንገቴንም ይዞ ቀጠቀጠኝ፤  እንደ ዓላማ አድርጎ አቆመኝ።

verses.text_english: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስተኞቹ ከበቡኝ፤  ኵላሊቴንም ቈራረጠ፥ እርሱም አልራራም፤  ሐሞቴን በምድር ላይ አፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.text_amharic: በቍስል ላይ ቍስል ጨመረብኝ፤  እንደ ኃያል እየሠገገ ይሮጥብኛል።

verses.text_english: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.text_amharic: በቁርበቴ ላይ ማቅ ሰፋሁ፥  ቀንዴንም በመሬት ላይ አኖርሁ።

verses.text_english: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids the shadow of death;
verses.text_amharic: ፊቴ ከልቅሶ የተነሣ ቀላ፤  የሞት ጥላ በዓይኖቼ ቆብ ላይ አለ፤

verses.text_english: Not for injustice in mine hands: also my prayer pure.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእጄ ዓመፅ የለም፤  ጸሎቴም ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.text_english: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሆይ፥ ደሜን አትክደኚ፥  ለጩኸቴም ማረፊያ አይሁን።

verses.text_english: Also now, behold, my witness in heaven, and my record on high.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ምስክሬ በሰማይ አለ፥  የሚመሰክርልኝም በአርያም ነው።

verses.text_english: My friends scorn me: mine eye poureth out unto God.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎቴ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይድረስ፥  ዓይኔም በፊቱ እንባ ታፍስስ።

verses.text_english: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man for his neighbour!
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንደሚምዋገት፥  ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመምዋገት ምነው በቻለ!

verses.text_english: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way I shall not return.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂቶች ዓመታት ካለፉ በኋላ  እኔ ወደማልመለስበት መንገድ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves for me.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈሴ ደከመ፥ ዘመኔ አለቀ፥  መቃብርም ተዘጋጅቶልኛል።

verses.text_english: not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.text_amharic: አላጋጮች በእኔ ዘንድ አሉ፥  ዓይኔም በማስቈጣታቸው አደረች።

verses.text_english: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who he will strike hands with me?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አንተ መያዣ ሆነህ ተዋሰኝ፤  ከእኔ ጋር አጋና የሚመታ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt .
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸውም እንዳያስተውል ከልክለኸዋል፤  ስለዚህ ከፍ ከፍ አታደርጋቸውም።

verses.text_english: He that speaketh flattery to friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.text_amharic: ለብዝበዛ ባልንጀሮቹን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ ሰው፥  የልጆቹ ዓይን ይጨልማል።

verses.text_english: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.text_amharic: ለሕዝብም ምሳሌ አደረገኝ፤  በፊቱ ላይ ጺቅ እንደሚሉበት ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members as a shadow.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔም ከኀዘን የተነሣ ፈዘዘች፥  ብልቶቼም ሁሉ እንደ ጥላ ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Upright shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.text_amharic: ቅኖች ሰዎች በዚህ ነገር ይደነቃሉ፥  ንጹሕም በዝንጉው ላይ ይበሳጫል።

verses.text_english: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ግን መንገዱን ያጠነክራል፥  እጁም ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው ኃይልን እየጨመረ ይሄዳል።

verses.text_english: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find wise among you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እናንተ ሁሉ ተመልሳችሁ ወደ እኔ ኑ፤  በእናንተም ዘንድ ብልሃተኛ አላገኝም።

verses.text_english: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, the thoughts of my heart.
verses.text_amharic: ዕድሜዬ አለፈች፤  አሳቤና የልቤ መሣርያ ተቈረጠ።

verses.text_english: They change the night into day: the light short because of darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሊቱን ወደ ቀን ይለውጣሉ፤  ብርሃኑም ወደ ጨለማ የቀረበ ይመስላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: If I wait, the grave mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋ ባደርግ ሲኦል ቤቴ ናት፤  ምንጣፌንም በጨለማ ዘርግቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: I have said to corruption, Thou my father: to the worm, my mother, and my sister.
verses.text_amharic: መበስበስን። አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤  ትልንም። አንቺ እናቴ እኅቴም ነሽ ብያለሁ።

verses.text_english: And where now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ተስፋዬ ወዴት ነው?  ተስፋዬንስ የሚያይ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when rest together in the dust.
verses.text_amharic: አብረን በመሬት ውስጥ ስናርፍ፥  ወደ ሲኦል ይወርዳል።

verses.text_english: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: How long ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መቼ ቃልን ታጠምዳለህ?  አስተውል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ እንናገራለን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, reputed vile in your sight?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምንስ እንደ እንስሶች ተቈጠርን?  ስለ ምንስ በዓይንህ ፊት ረከስን?

verses.text_english: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣ ወርሶሃል፤ አንተስ የሞትህ እንደ ሆነ፥  ምድር ስለ አንተ ባድማ ትሆናለችን?  ወይስ ዓለት ከስፍራው ይነቀላልን?

verses.text_english: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአተኛ መብራት ይጠፋል፥  የእሳቱም ነበልባል ብልጭ አይልም።

verses.text_english: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃን በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ይጨልማል፥  መብራቱም በላዩ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.text_amharic: የኃይሉም እርምጃ ትጠብባለች፥  ምክሩም ትጥለዋለች።

verses.text_english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.text_amharic: እግሩ በወጥመድ ትያዛለች፥  በመረብም ላይ ይሄዳል።

verses.text_english: The gin shall take by the heel, the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.text_amharic: አሽክላ ሰኰናውን ይይዛል፥  ወስፈንጠርም ይበረታበታል።

verses.text_english: The snare laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ የሸምቀቆ ገመድ፥  በመንገዱም ላይ ወጥመድ ለእርሱ ተሰውራለች።

verses.text_english: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋጤ በዙሪያው ታስፈራዋለች፥  በስተ ኋላውም ሆና ታባርራቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction ready at his side.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይሉ በራብ ትደክማለች፥  መቅሠፍትም እስኪሰናከል ተዘጋጅቶለታል።

verses.text_english: It shall devour the strength of his skin: the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውነቱ ብልቶች ይጠፋሉ፤  የሞትም በኵር ልጅ ብልቶቹን ይበላል።

verses.text_english: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚታመንበት ድንኳን ይነቀላል፤  ወደ ድንጋጤም ንጉሥ ያስቸኵሉታል።

verses.text_english: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.text_amharic: በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ለእርሱ የማይሆነው ይኖራል፤  በመኖሪያውም ላይ ዲን ይበተናል።

verses.text_english: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: ሥሩ ከበታቹ ይደርቃል፥  ጫፉም ከበላይ ይረግፋል።

verses.text_english: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.text_amharic: መታሰቢያው ከምድር ላይ ይጠፋል፥  በሜዳም ስም አይቀርለትም።

verses.text_english: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ከብርሃን ወደ ጨለማ ያፈልሱታል፥  ከዓለምም ያሳድዱታል።

verses.text_english: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርም ትውልድም በሕዝቡ መካከል አይሆንለትም፤  በመኖሪያውም ውስጥ የሚቀመጥ ሰው አይቀርለትም።

verses.text_english: They that come after shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.text_amharic: የፊተኞች ሰዎች እንደ ደነገጡ፥  እንዲሁ የኋለኞች ሰዎች ስለ ዘመኑ ይደነቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Surely such the dwellings of the wicked, and this the place knoweth not God.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት የኃጢአተኞች ቤት እንዲሁ ናት፥  እግዚአብሔርንም የማያውቅ ሰው ስፍራ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን የምትነዘንዙ፥  በቃልስ የምታደቅቁኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.text_english: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸው ስትሰድቡኝ አሥር ጊዜ ነው፤  ስታሻክሩኝም አላፈራችሁም።

verses.text_english: And be it indeed I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነትም የሳትሁ እንደ ሆነ፥  ስሕተቴ ከእኔ ጋር ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: If indeed ye will magnify against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.text_amharic: በእውነትም ብትጓደዱብኝ፥  መዋረዴን በእኔ ላይ ብትከራከሩ፥

verses.text_english: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጠኝ፥  በመረቡም እንደ ከበበኝ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but no judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ስለ ተደረገብኝ ግፍ ብጮኽ ማንም አይመልስልኝም፤  አሰምቼም ብጠራ ፍርድ የለኝም።

verses.text_english: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳላልፍ መንገዴን ዘግቶታል፥  በጎዳናዬም ጨለማ አኑሮበታል።

verses.text_english: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown my head.
verses.text_amharic: ክብሬን ገፈፈኝ፥  ዘውዴንም ከራሴ ላይ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህና በዚያም አፈረሰኝ፥ እኔም ሄድሁ፤  ተስፋዬንም እንደ ዛፍ ነቀለው፤

verses.text_english: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣውንም አነደደብኝ፥  እንደ ጠላቱም ቈጠረኝ።

verses.text_english: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱ አብረው መጡ፥  መንገዳቸውንም በላዬ አዘጋጁ፥  በድንኳኔም ዙሪያ ሰፈሩ።

verses.text_english: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼን ከእኔ ዘንድ አራቀ፥  የሚያውቁኝም አጥብቀው ተለዩኝ።

verses.text_english: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመዶቼ ተቋረጡ፥  ወዳጆቼም ረሱኝ።

verses.text_english: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.text_amharic: ቤተ ሰቦቼና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ እንደ መጻተኛ ቈጠሩኝ፤  በዓይናቸውም እንደ እንግዳ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: I called my servant, and he gave no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬን ብጠራ፥ በአፌም ባቈላምጥ አይመልስልኝም።

verses.text_english: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's of mine own body.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቴ እስትንፋሴን ጠላች፥  የእናቴም ማኅፀን ልጆች ልመናዬን ጠሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃናቶች እንኳ አጠቁኝ፤  ብነሣም በእኔ ላይ ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.text_amharic: አማካሪዎቼ ሁሉ ተጸየፉኝ፤  እኔ የምወድዳቸው በላዬ ተገለበጡ።

verses.text_english: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.text_amharic: አጥንቴ ከቁርበቴና ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቀ፤  ድድ ብቻ ቀርቶልኝ አመለጥሁ።

verses.text_english: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ማሩኝ፤  የእግዚአብሔር እጅ መትታኛለችና ማሩኝ።

verses.text_english: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን እናንተ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ታሳድዱኛላችሁ?  ከሥጋዬስ ስለ ምን አትጠግቡም?

verses.text_english: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.text_amharic: ምነው አሁን ቃሌ ቢጻፍ!  ምነው በመጽሐፍ ውስጥ ቢታተም!

verses.text_english: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.text_amharic: ምነው በብረት ብርና በእርሳስ  በዓለቱ ላይ ለዘላለም ቢቀረጽ!

verses.text_english: For I know my redeemer liveth, and he shall stand at the latter upon the earth:
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ግን የሚቤዠኝ ሕያው እንደ ሆነ፥  በመጨረሻም ዘመን በምድር ላይ እንዲቆም፥

verses.text_english: And after my skin destroy this , yet in my flesh shall I see God:
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ቁርበቴም ከጠፋ በኋላ፥  በዚያን ጊዜ ከሥጋዬ ተለይቼ እግዚአብሔርን እንዳይ አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; my reins be consumed within me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ራሴ አየዋለሁ፥  ዓይኖቼም ይመለከቱታል፥  ከእኔም ሌላ አይደለም።  ልቤ በመናፈቅ ዝሎአል።

verses.text_english: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት። እንዴት እናሳድደዋለን?  የነገሩ ሥር በእርሱ ዘንድ ተገኝቶአል ብትሉ፥

verses.text_english: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath the punishments of the sword, that ye may know a judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድ እንዳለ ታውቁ ዘንድ  ቍጣ የሰይፍን ቅጣት ያመጣልና  ከሰይፍ ፍሩ።

verses.text_english: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ናዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for I make haste.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በውስጤ ስላለው ችኰላ አሳቤ ትመልስልኛለች።

verses.text_english: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያሳፍረኝንም ተግሣጽ ሰምቻለሁ፥  የማስተዋሌም መንፈስ ይመልስልኛል።

verses.text_english: Knowest thou this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በምድር ላይ ከተቀመጠ፥ ከዱሮ ዘመን ጀምሮ፥

verses.text_english: That the triumphing of the wicked short, and the joy of the hypocrite for a moment?
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአተኛ ፉከራ አጭር መሆኑን  የዝንጉዎችም ደስታ ቅጽበት መሆኑን አታውቁምን?

verses.text_english: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.text_amharic: ከፍታው ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጣ፥  ራሱም እስከ ደመና ቢደርስ፥

verses.text_english: he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where he?
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ፋንድያ ለዘላለም ይጠፋል፤  ያዩትም። ወዴት ነው? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሕልም ይበርራል፥ እርሱም አይገኝም፤  እንደ ሌሊትም ራእይ ይሰደዳል።

verses.text_english: The eye also saw him shall no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.text_amharic: ያየችውም ዓይን ዳግመኛ አታየውም፤  ስፍራውም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለከተውም።

verses.text_english: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹ ድሆቹን ያቈላምጣሉ፤  እጁ ሀብቱን ይመልሳል።

verses.text_english: His bones are full of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.text_amharic: አጥንቶቹ ብላቴንነቱን ሞልተዋል፤  ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር በመሬት ውስጥ ይተኛል።

verses.text_english: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, he hide it under his tongue;
verses.text_amharic: ክፋት በአፉ ውስጥ ቢጣፍጥ፥  ከምላሱም በታች ቢሰውረው፥

verses.text_english: he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.text_amharic: ቢጠብቀውም ባይተወውም፥  በጕሮሮውም ቢይዘው፥

verses.text_english: his meat in his bowels is turned, the gall of asps within him.
verses.text_amharic: መብሉ በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ይገላበጣል፤  እንደ እፉኝትም ሐሞት በውስጡ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.text_amharic: የዋጠውን ሀብት ይተፋዋል፤  እግዚአብሔርም ከሆዱ ውስጥ ያወጣዋል።

verses.text_english: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
verses.text_amharic: የእፉኝትን መርዝ ይጠባል፤  የእባብም ምላስ ይገድለዋል።

verses.text_english: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.text_amharic: የማሩንና የቅቤውን ፈሳሽ  ወንዞቹንም አይመለከትም።

verses.text_english: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow down: according to substance the restitution , and he shall not rejoice .
verses.text_amharic: የድካሙን ፍሬ ሳይውጠው ይመልሰዋል፤  እንደ ንግዱም ትርፍ አይደሰትም።

verses.text_english: Because he hath oppressed hath forsaken the poor; he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.text_amharic: ድሀውን አስጨንቆአል፥ ትቶታልም፤  ያልሠራውንም ቤት በዝብዞአል።

verses.text_english: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.text_amharic: ሆዱ ዕረፍትን አላወቀምና  የወደደው ነገር አላዳነውም።

verses.text_english: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከበላ በኋላ ምንም አልተረፈም፤  ስለዚህ በረከቱ አይከናወንለትም።

verses.text_english: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.text_amharic: በጠገበ ጊዜ ይጨነቃል፤  የችግረኞችም ሁሉ እጅ ታገኘዋለች።

verses.text_english: he is about to fill his belly, shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain upon him while he is eating.
verses.text_amharic: ሆዱን ሳያጠግብ  እግዚአብሔር የቍጣውን ትኵሳት ይሰድድበታል፥  ሲበላም ያዘንብበታል።

verses.text_english: He shall flee from the iron weapon, the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.text_amharic: ከብረት መሣርያም ይሸሻል፥  የናስም ቀስት ይወጋዋል።

verses.text_english: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors upon him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ይመዝዘዋል፥ ከሥጋውም ይወጣል፤  ከሐሞቱም ብልጭ ብሎ ይሠርጻል፤  ፍርሃትም ይወድቅበታል።

verses.text_english: All darkness hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ጨለማ ሁሉ ስለ ከበረው ዕቃ ተዘጋጅቶአል፤  በሰው አፍ እፍ የማትባል እሳት ትበላዋለች፤  በድንኳኑ ውስጥ የቀረው ይጨነቅባታል።

verses.text_english: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይ ኃጢአቱን ይገልጥበታል፥  ምድርም ትነሣበታለች።

verses.text_english: The increase of his house shall depart, shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱም ባለጠግነት ይሄዳል፤  በቍጣው ቀን እንደ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ያልፋል።

verses.text_english: This the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የበደለኛ ሰው እድል ፈንታ፥  ከእግዚአብሔርም የተመደበ ርስቱ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: But Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙ፥ ቃሌን ስሙ፤  ይህም መጽናናታችሁ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.text_amharic: እናገር ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤  ከተናገርሁም በኋላ ተሳለቁ።

verses.text_english: As for me, my complaint to man? and if , why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የኀዘን እንጉርጕሮዬ ለሰው እናገራለሁን?  አለመታገሥ ስለ ምን አይገባኝም?

verses.text_english: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay hand upon mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፥ ተደነቁም፤  እጃችሁንም በአፋችሁ ላይ አኑሩ።

verses.text_english: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሰብሁ ቍጥር እጨነቃለሁ፥  ፃዕርም ሥጋዬን ይይዛል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን ኃጢአተኞች በሕይወት ይኖራሉ?  ስለ ምንስ ያረጃሉ? በባለጠግነትስ ስለ ምን ይበረታሉ?

verses.text_english: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ዘራቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር ጸንቶ ይኖራል፥  ልጆቻቸውም በዓይናቸው ፊት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Their houses safe from fear, neither the rod of God upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ቤታቸው ከፍርሃት ወጥቶ የታመነ ነው፥  የእግዚአብሔርም በትር የለባቸውም።

verses.text_english: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.text_amharic: ኮርማቸው ይወልዳል፥ ዘሩንም አይጥለውም፤  ላማቸውም ትወልዳለች፥ አትጨነግፍም።

verses.text_english: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃናቶቻቸውን እንደ መንጋ ያወጣሉ፥  ልጆቻቸውም ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.text_english: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.text_amharic: ከበሮና መሰንቆ ወስደው ይዘምራሉ፥  በእምቢልታ ድምፅ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.text_amharic: ዕድሜያቸውንም በተድላ ይፈጽማሉ፤  ድንገትም ወደ ሲኦል ይወርዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም። ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤  መንገድህን እናውቅ ዘንድ አንወድድም።

verses.text_english: What the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.text_amharic: እናመልከውስ ዘንድ ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ማን ነው?  ወይስ ወደ እርሱ ብንጸልይ ምን ይጠቅመናል? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Lo, their good not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሀብታቸው በእጃቸው ውስጥ አይደለምን?  የኃጥአን ምክር ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቀች ናት።

verses.text_english: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and cometh their destruction upon them! distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጥአን መብራት የጠፋው፥  መቅሠፍትም የመጣባቸው፥  እግዚአብሔርም በቍጣው መከራ የከፈላቸው፥

verses.text_english: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.text_amharic: በነፋስ ፊት እንደ ገለባ፥  ዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደሚወስደው ትቢያ የሆኑ ስንት ጊዜ ነው?

verses.text_english: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know .
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። እግዚአብሔር በደላቸውን ለልጆቻቸው ይጠብቃል ብላችኋል።  እነርሱ ያውቁ ዘንድ ፍዳን ለራሳቸው ይክፈል።

verses.text_english: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቻቸው ጥፋታቸውን ይዩ፥  ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ቍጣ ይጠጡ።

verses.text_english: For what pleasure he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.text_amharic: የወራታቸውስ ቍጥር ቢቈረጥ፥  ከእነርሱ በኋላ የቤታቸው ደስታ ምን ይሆናቸዋል?

verses.text_english: Shall teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ከፍ ባሉትስ ላይ ለሚፈርድ ለእግዚአብሔር  በውኑ ሰው እውቀትን ያስተምራልን?

verses.text_english: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰው በሰላም ተዘልሎ ሲቀመጥ  በሙሉ ኃይሉ ሳለ ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.text_amharic: በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ስብ ሞልቶአል፥  የአጥንቶቹም ቅልጥም ረጥቦአል።

verses.text_english: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም ሰው መልካምን ነገር ከቶ ሳይቀምስ  በተመረረች ነፍስ ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.text_amharic: በአፈር ውስጥ በአንድ ላይ ይተኛሉ፥  ትልም ይከድናቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አሳባችሁን፥  የመከራችሁብኝንም ክፉ ምክር አውቄዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For ye say, Where the house of the prince? and where the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። የከበርቴው ቤት የት ነው?  ኃጢአተኛውም ያደረበት ድንኳን የት ነው? ብላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.text_amharic: መንገድ አላፊዎችን አልጠየቃችሁምን?  ምልክታቸውን አታውቁምን?

verses.text_english: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛው በመቅሠፍት ቀን እንደ ተጠበቀ፥  በቍጣው ቀን እንደሚድን።

verses.text_english: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him he hath done?
verses.text_amharic: መንገዱን በፊቱ የሚናገር ማን ነው?  የሠራውንስ የሚመልስበት ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱን ግን ወደ መቃብር ይሸከሙታል፥  ሰዎቹም በመቃብሩ ላይ ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.text_english: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as innumerable before him.
verses.text_amharic: የሸለቆው ጓል ይጣፍጥለታል፤  በኋላውም ሰው ሁሉ ይሳባል፥  በፊቱም ቍጥር የሌለው ጉባኤ አለ።

verses.text_english: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
verses.text_amharic: የምትመልሱልኝ ውስልትና ነውና  በከንቱ እንዴት ታጽናኑኛላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ይጠቅመዋልን?  በእውነት ጥበበኛ ሰው ራሱን ይጠቅማል።

verses.text_english: any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or gain , that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ መሆንህስ ሁሉን የሚችለውን አምላክ ደስ ያሰኘዋልን?  መንገድህን ማቅናትህስ ይጠቅመዋልን?

verses.text_english: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንስ ስለ ፈራህ ይዘልፍሃልን?  ወደ ፍርድስ ከአንተ ጋር ይገባልን?

verses.text_english: not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.text_amharic: ክፋትህስ የበዛ አይደለምን?  ለኃጢአትህም ፍጻሜ የላትም።

verses.text_english: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.text_amharic: የወንድሞችህን መያዣ በከንቱ ወስደሃል፥  የእርዘኞቹንም ልብስ ዘርፈሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.text_amharic: ለደካማ ውኃ አላጠጣህም፥  ለራብተኛም እንጀራን ከልክለሃል።

verses.text_english: But the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.text_amharic: በክንድ የበረታ ምድርን ገዛ፤  ከበርቴውም ሰው ተቀመጠባት።

verses.text_english: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.text_amharic: መበለቲቱን አንዳች አልባ ሰድደሃታል፤  የድሀ አደጎችም ክንድ ተሰብሮአል።

verses.text_english: Therefore snares round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አሽክላ ከብቦሃል፥  ድንገተኛ ፍርሃትም አናውጦሃል።

verses.text_english: Or darkness, thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳታይ ብርሃን ጨለማ ሆነችብህ፥  የውኆችም ብዛት አሰጠመህ።

verses.text_english: not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሰማያት ከፍ ከፍ አይልምን?  ከዋክብትም እንዴት ከፍ ከፍ እንዳሉ ተመልከት።

verses.text_english: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። እግዚአብሔር ምን ያውቃል?  በድቅድቅ ጨለማ ውስጥ ሆኖ ሊፈርድ ይችላልን?

verses.text_english: Thick clouds a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳያይ የጠቈረ ደመና ጋርዶታል፤  በሰማይ ክበብ ላይ ይራመዳል ብለሃል።

verses.text_english: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ኃጢአተኞች ሰዎች የረገጡአትን  የዱሮይቱን መንገድ ትጠብቃለህን?

verses.text_english: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.text_amharic: ጊዜያቸው ሳይደርስ ተነጠቁ፤  መሠረታቸውም እንደ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም። ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ ምን ሊያደርግልን ይችላል? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Yet he filled their houses with good : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ቤታቸውን በመልካም ነገር ሞላ፤  የኃጥአን ምክር ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቀች ናት።

verses.text_english: The righteous see , and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን ያዩታል፥ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤  ንጹሐንም በንቀት ይስቁባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ሀብታቸው ጠፋ፥  የቀረውንም እሳት በላች።

verses.text_english: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከእርሱ ጋር ተስማማ፥ ሰላምም ይኑርህ፤  በዚያም በጎነት ታገኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.text_amharic: ከአፉም ሕጉን ተቀበል፥  በልብህም ቃሉን አኑር፤

verses.text_english: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን ወደሚችል አምላክ ብትመለስ፥ ብትዋረድም፥  ኃጢአትንም ከድንኳንህ ብታርቅ፥

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.text_amharic: የወርቅን ዕቃ በአፈር ውስጥ፥  የኦፊርንም ወርቅ በጅረት ድንጋይ መካከል ብትጥል፥

verses.text_english: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ወርቅና የሚብለጨለጭ ብር ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ደስ ይልሃል፥  ፊትህንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታነሣለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም ትጸልያለህ፥ እርሱም ይሰማሃል፤  ስእለትህንም ትሰጣለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.text_amharic: ነገርንም ትመክራለህ፥ እርሱም ይሳካልሃል፤  ብርሃንም በመንገድህ ላይ ይበራል።

verses.text_english: When are cast down, then thou shalt say, lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.text_amharic: ቢያዋርዱህ አንተ ከፍ ከፍ ትላለህ፤  ትሑቱንም ሰው ያድነዋል።

verses.text_english: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሑን ሰው ያድነዋል፤  በእጅህም ንጽሕና ትድናለህ።

verses.text_english: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Even to day my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬም ደግሞ የኅዘን እንጕርጕሮዬ ገና መራራ ነው፤  እጁ በልቅሶ ጩኸቴ ላይ ከብዳለች።

verses.text_english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! I might come to his seat!
verses.text_amharic: እርሱን ወዴት እንዳገኘው ምነው ባወቅሁ!  ወደ ተቀመጠበትስ ስፍራ ምነው በደረስሁ!

verses.text_english: I would order cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅ ነበር፥  አፌንም በማስረጃ እሞላው ነበር።

verses.text_english: I would know the words he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.text_amharic: የሚመልስልኝም ቃል ምን እንደ ሆነ አውቅ ነበር፥  የሚለኝንም አስተውል ነበር።

verses.text_english: Will he plead against me with great power? No; but he would put in me.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይሉ ብዛት ከእኔ ጋር ይምዋገት ነበርን?  እንኳን! ያደምጠኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.text_amharic: ቅን ሰው ከእርሱ ጋር በዚያ ይከራከር ነበር፤  እኔም ከፈራጄ ለዘላለም እድን ነበር።

verses.text_english: Behold, I go forward, but he not ; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ወደ ፊት እሄዳለሁ፥ እርሱም የለም፤  ወደ ኋላም እሄዳለሁ፥ እኔም አላስተውለውም፤

verses.text_english: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold : he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see :
verses.text_amharic: ወደሚሠራበት ወደ ግራ ብሄድ አልመለከተውም፤  በቀኜም ይሰወራል፥ አላየውምም፤

verses.text_english: But he knoweth the way that I take: he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.text_amharic: የምሄድበትን መንገድ ያውቃል፤  ከፈተነኝም በኋላ እንደ ወርቅ እወጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.text_amharic: እግሬ ወደ እርምጃው ተጣብቆአል፤  መንገዱንም ጠብቄአለሁ፥ ፈቀቅም አላልሁም።

verses.text_english: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary .
verses.text_amharic: ከከንፈሩ ትእዛዝ አልተመለስሁም፤  የአፉን ቃል በልቤ ሰውሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: But he in one , and who can turn him? and his soul desireth, even he doeth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ብቻውን ነው፤ እርሱንስ የሚመስለው ማን ነው?  ነፍሱም የወደደችውን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: For he performeth appointed for me: and many such with him.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ላይ የተወሰነውን ይፈጽማል፤  እንደዚህም ያለ ብዙ ነገር በእርሱ ዘንድ አለ።

verses.text_english: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በፊቱ ደነገጥሁ፤  ባሰብሁም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ፈራሁ።

verses.text_english: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ልቤን አባብቶታልና፥  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ አስደንግጦኛል።

verses.text_english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.text_amharic: ከጨለማው የተነሣ፥  ድቅድቁም ጨለማ ፊቴን ከመክደኑ የተነሣ አልደነገጥሁም።

verses.text_english: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ ዘመናት አልተሰወረምና  እርሱን የሚያውቁ ለምን ወራቱን አያዩም?

verses.text_english: remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed .
verses.text_amharic: የድንበሩን ምልክት የሚያፈርሱ አሉ፤  መንጋዎቹን በዝብዘው ያሰማራሉ።

verses.text_english: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
verses.text_amharic: የድሀ አድጎቹን አህያ ይነዳሉ፤  የመበለቲቱን በሬ ስለ መያዣ ይወስዳሉ።

verses.text_english: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.text_amharic: ድሆቹን ከመንገዱ ያወጣሉ፤  የምድርም ችግረኞች ሁሉ ይሸሸጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness food for them for children.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በምድረ በዳ እንዳሉ እንደ ሜዳ አህዮች፥  መብልን ፈልገው ወደ ሥራቸው ይወጣሉ፤  ምድረ በዳውም ለልጆቻቸው መብልን ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: They reap his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያ በእርሻ ውስጥ እህላቸውን ያጭዳሉ፤  የበደለኛውንም ወይን ይቃርማሉ።

verses.text_english: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that no covering in the cold.
verses.text_amharic: ራቁታቸውን ያለ ልብስ ያድራሉ፥  በብርድ ጊዜ መጐናጸፊያ የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.text_amharic: ከተራሮች በሚወርድ ዝናብ ይረጥባሉ፤  መጠጊያም አጥተው ቋጥኙን ያቅፋሉ።

verses.text_english: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀ አደጉን ልጅ ከጡቱ የሚነጥሉ አሉ  ከችግረኛውም መያዣ ይወስዳሉ።

verses.text_english: They cause to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf the hungry;
verses.text_amharic: ያለ ልብስ ራቁታቸውን ይሄዳሉ፤  ተርበውም ነዶዎችን ይሸከማሉ፤

verses.text_english: make oil within their walls, tread winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ ሰዎች አጥር ውስጥ ዘይት ያደርጋሉ፤  ወይንም ይጠምቃሉ፥ ነገር ግን ይጠማሉ።

verses.text_english: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly .
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማውና ከገዛ ቤቶቻቸው ይባረራሉ፤  የልጆችም ነፍስ ለእርዳታ ትጮኻለች፤  እግዚአብሔር ግን ስንፍናቸውን አይመለከትም።

verses.text_english: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በብርሃን ላይ የሚያምፁ ናቸው፤  መንገዱን አያውቁም፥ በጎዳናውም አይጸኑም።

verses.text_english: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ሳይነጋ ማልዶ ይነሣል፤  ችግረኞችንና ድሆችን ይገድላል፤  በሌሊትም እንደ ሌባ ነው።

verses.text_english: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth face.
verses.text_amharic: የአመንዝራም ዓይን ድግዝግዝታን ይጠብቃል።  የማንም ዓይን አያየኝም ይላል፥  ፊቱንም ይሸፍናል።

verses.text_english: In the dark they dig through houses, they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቶቹን በጨለማ ይነድላሉ፤  በቀን ይሸሸጋሉ፤  ብርሃንም አያውቁም።

verses.text_english: For the morning to them even as the shadow of death: if know the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.text_amharic: የጥዋት ብርሃን ለእነርሱ ሁሉ እንደ ሞት ጥላ ነው፤  የሞትን ጥላ ድንጋጤ ያውቃሉና።

verses.text_english: He swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ በውኃ ፊት ላይ በርረው ያልፋሉ፤  እድል ፈንታቸውም በምድር ላይ የተረገመች ናት፤  ወደ ወይኑ ቦታ መንገድ አይዞሩም።

verses.text_english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: the grave have sinned.
verses.text_amharic: ድርቅና ሙቀት የአመዳዩን ውኃ ያጠፋሉ፤  እንዲሁ ሲኦል በደለኞችን ታጠፋለች።

verses.text_english: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.text_amharic: ማኅፀን ትረሳዋለች፤  ትልም በደስታ ይጠባዋል፤  ዳግመኛም አይታሰብም፤  ክፋትም እንደ ዛፍ ይሰበራል።

verses.text_english: He evil entreateth the barren beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.text_amharic: የማትወልደውን መካኒቱን ይበድላታል፤  ለመበለቲቱም በጎነት አያደርግም።

verses.text_english: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no is sure of life.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በኃይሉ ኃያላንን ይስባል፤  እርሱም በተነሣ ጊዜ ሰው በሕይወቱ አይታመንም።

verses.text_english: it be given him in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes upon their ways.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በደኅና አኑሮአቸዋል፥  በዚያም ይታመናሉ፤  ዓይኖቹ ግን በመንገዳቸው ላይ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all , and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂት ጊዜ ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ፤  ይሄዳሉ፥ ይጠወልጋሉም፤  እንደ ሌሎች ሁሉ ይከማቻሉ፤  እንደ እሸትም ራስ ይቈረጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And if not now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህስ ባይሆን ሐሰተኛ የሚያደርገኝ፥  ነገሬንስ እንደ ምናምን የሚያደርገው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Dominion and fear with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.text_amharic: ገዢነትና መፈራት በእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸው፤  በከፍታውም ሰላም አድራጊ ነው።

verses.text_english: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ለሠራዊቶቹ ቍጥር አላቸውን?  ብርሃኑስ የማይወጣው በማን ላይ ነው?

verses.text_english: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean born of a woman?
verses.text_amharic: ሰውስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ይሆን ዘንድ፥  ከሴትስ የተወለደ ንጹሕ ይሆን ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.text_english: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጨረቃ እንኳ ብሩህ አይደለም፥  ከዋክብትም በፊቱ ንጹሐን አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: How much less man, a worm? and the son of man, a worm?
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንስ ብስብስ የሆነ ሰው፥  ትልም የሆነ የሰው ልጅ ምንኛ ያንስ!

verses.text_english: But Job answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: How hast thou helped without power? savest thou the arm no strength?
verses.text_amharic: ኃይል የሌለውን ምንኛ ረዳኸው!  ብርታት የሌለውን ክንድ ምንኛ አዳንኸው!

verses.text_english: How hast thou counselled no wisdom? and hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብስ የሌለውን ምንኛ መከርኸው!  ብዙ እውቀትንስ ምንኛ ገለጥህለት!

verses.text_english: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.text_amharic: ይህንስ ቃል በማን እርዳታ ተናገርህ?  የማንስ መንፈስ ከአንተ ዘንድ ወጣ?

verses.text_english: Dead are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ሙታን ሰዎች ከውኆች በታች፥  በውኆችም ውስጥ ከሚኖሩ በታች ይንቀጠቀጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Hell naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.text_amharic: ሲኦል በፊቱ ራቁትዋን ናት፥  ለጥፋትም መጋረጃ የለውም።

verses.text_english: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሜንን በባዶ ስፍራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥  ምድሪቱንም በታችዋ አንዳች አልባ ያንጠለጥላል።

verses.text_english: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.text_amharic: ውኆችን በደመናዎቹ ውስጥ ያስራል፥  ደመናይቱም ከታች አልተቀደደችም።

verses.text_english: He holdeth back the face of his throne, spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.text_amharic: የዙፋኑን ፊት ይከድናል፥  ደመናውንም ይዘረጋበታል።

verses.text_english: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንና ጨለማ እስከሚለያዩበት ዳርቻ ድረስ፥  በውኆች ፊት ላይ ድንበርን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይ አዕማድ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥  ከተግሣጹም የተነሣ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.text_english: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይሉ ባሕርን ጸጥ ያደርጋል፥  በማስተዋሉም ረዓብን ይመታል።

verses.text_english: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈሱ ሰማያት ውበትን አገኙ፥  እጁም በራሪይቱን እባብ ወጋች።

verses.text_english: Lo, these parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ይህ የመንገዱ ዳርቻ ብቻ ነው፤  ይህም የሰማነው ነገር ምንኛ ጥቂት ነው!  የኃይሉንስ ነጐድጓድ ያስተውል ዘንድ ማን ይችላል?

verses.text_english: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም ምሳሌውን ይመስል ዘንድ ደገመ፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: God liveth, hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, hath vexed my soul;
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዴን ያስወገደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን!  ነፍሴንም መራራ ያደረገ ሁሉን የሚችል ሕያው አምላክን!

verses.text_english: All the while my breath in me, and the spirit of God in my nostrils;
verses.text_amharic: እስትንፋሴ በእኔ ውስጥ፥  የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በአፍንጫዬ ውስጥ ገና ሳለ፥

verses.text_english: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፈሬ ኃጢአትን አትናገርም፥  አንደበቴም ሽንገላን አያወጣም።

verses.text_english: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተን ማጽደቅ ከእኔ ዘንድ ይራቅ፤  እስክሞት ድረስ ፍጹምነቴን ከእኔ አላርቅም።

verses.text_english: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach so long as I live.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቄን እይዛለሁ እርሱንም አልተውም፤  ከቀኖቼም ሁሉ ስለ አንዱ ልቤ አይዘልፈኝም።

verses.text_english: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቴ እንደ በደለኛ፥  በእኔ ላይም የሚነሣ እንደ ኃጢአተኛ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: For what the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ባጠፋውና ነፍሱን በለየ ጊዜ፥  የዝንጉ ሰው ተስፋው ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ መከራ በመጣበት ጊዜ፥  እግዚአብሔር ጩኸቱን ይሰማልን?

verses.text_english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንስ በሚችል አምላክ ደስ ይለዋልን?  እግዚአብሔርንስ ሁልጊዜ ይጠራልን?

verses.text_english: I will teach you by the hand of God: which with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ስለ እግዚአብሔር እጅ አስተምራችኋለሁ፤  ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ ያለውን አልሸሽግም።

verses.text_english: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen ; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሁላችሁ አይታችኋል፤  ስለ ምን ከንቱ ሆናችሁ?

verses.text_english: This the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የበደለኛ እድል ፈንታ፥  ግፈኛም ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ የሚቀበላት ርስት ናት፤

verses.text_english: If his children be multiplied, for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹ ቢበዙ ለሰይፍ ይሆናሉ፤  ዘሩም እንጀራን አይጠግብም።

verses.text_english: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም የቀሩት በቸነፈር ይቀበራሉ፤  መበለቶቻቸውም አያለቅሱም።

verses.text_english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ብርን እንደ አፈር ቢከምር፥  ልብስንም እንደ ጭቃ ቢያዘጋጅ፥

verses.text_english: He may prepare , but the just shall put on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ያዘጋጀው ይሆናል፥ ነገር ግን ጻድቅ ይለብሰዋል፤  ብሩንም ንጹሐን ይከፋፈሉታል።

verses.text_english: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth the keeper maketh.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሠራው ቤት እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ይሠራል፥  ጠባቂም እንደሚሠራው ጎጆ ነው።

verses.text_english: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he not.
verses.text_amharic: ባለጠጋ ሆኖ ይተኛል፥ ዳግመኛም አይተኛም፤  ዓይኑን ይከፍታል፥ እርሱም የለም።

verses.text_english: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋጤ እንደ ጐርፍ ታገኘዋለች፤  በሌሊትም ዐውሎ ነፋስ ትነጥቀዋለች።

verses.text_english: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.text_amharic: የምሥራቅ ነፋስ ያነሣዋል፥ እርሱም ይሄዳል፤  ከቦታውም ይጠርገዋል።

verses.text_english: For shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ይጥልበታል፥ አይራራለትም፤  ከእጁ ፈጥኖ መሸሽ ይወድዳል።

verses.text_english: shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በእጁ ያጨበጭብበታል፤  ከስፍራውም በፉጨት ያስወጡታል።

verses.text_english: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold they fine .
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ብር የሚወጣበት፥  ወርቅም የሚነጠርበት ስፍራ አለ።

verses.text_english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass molten the stone.
verses.text_amharic: ብረት ከመሬት ውስጥ ይወሰዳል፤  መዳብም ከድንጋይ ይቀለጣል።

verses.text_english: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ለጨለማ ፍጻሜን ያደርጋል፤  የጨለማውንና የሞት ጥላን ድንጋይ እስከ ወሰኑ ድረስ ይፈላልጋል።

verses.text_english: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ከሚኖርበት ርቀው መውረጃ ይቈፍራሉ፤  ከሰውም እግር ተረሱ፥  ከሰዎችም ርቀው እየተንጠለጠሉ ይወዛወዛሉ።

verses.text_english: the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራ ከምድር ውስጥ ይወጣል፤  በእሳትም እንደሚሆን ታችኛው ይገለበጣል።

verses.text_english: The stones of it the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋይዋ የሰንፔር ስፍራ ነው፥  የወርቅም ድቃቂ አለው።

verses.text_english: a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
verses.text_amharic: መንገድዋን ጭልፊት አያውቀውም፥  የአሞራም ዓይን አላየውም።

verses.text_english: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.text_amharic: የትዕቢት ልጆች አልረገጡአትም፥  ደቦል አንበሳ አላለፈባትም።

verses.text_english: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ወደ ቡላድ ድንጋይ እጁን ይዘረጋል፥  ተራራውንም ከመሠረቱ ይገለብጣል።

verses.text_english: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.text_amharic: ከድንጋይ ውስጥ መንዶልዶያ ይወቅራል፤  ዓይኑም ዕንቍን ሁሉ ታያለች።

verses.text_english: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሹም እንዳይንጠባጠብ ይገድባል፤  የተሰወረውንም ነገር ወደ ብርሃን ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: But where shall wisdom be found? and where the place of understanding?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጥበብ የምትገኘው ወዴት ነው?  የማስተዋልስ ስፍራ ወዴት ነው?

verses.text_english: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው መንገድዋን አያውቅም፤  በሕያዋን ምድር አትገኝም።

verses.text_english: The depth saith, It not in me: and the sea saith, not with me.
verses.text_amharic: ቀላይ። በእኔ ውስጥ የለችም ይላል፤  ባሕርም። በእኔ ዘንድ የለችም ይላል።

verses.text_english: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed the price thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በምዝምዝ ወርቅ አትገኝም፥  ብርም ስለ ዋጋዋ አይመዘንም።

verses.text_english: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.text_amharic: በኦፊር ወርቅ፥  በከበረም መረግድና በሰንፔር አትገመትም።

verses.text_english: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it jewels of fine gold.
verses.text_amharic: ወርቅና ብርጭቆ አይወዳደሩአትም፥  በጥሩ ወርቅም ዕቃ አትለወጥም።

verses.text_english: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom above rubies.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዛጐልና ስለ አልማዝ አይነገርም።  የጥበብ ዋጋ ከቀይ ዕንቍ ይልቅ ይበልጣል።

verses.text_english: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.text_amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ቶጳዝዮን አይተካከላትም፥  በጥሩም ወርቅ አትገመትም።

verses.text_english: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where the place of understanding?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያሳ ጥበብ ከወዴት ትመጣለች?  የማስተዋልስ ስፍራ ወዴት ነው?

verses.text_english: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕያዋን ሁሉ ዓይን ተሰውራለች፥  ከሰማይ ወፎች ተሸሽጋለች።

verses.text_english: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.text_amharic: ጥፋትና ሞት። ወሬዋን በጆሮቻችን ሰማን ብለዋል።

verses.text_english: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መንገድዋን ያስተውላል፥  እርሱም ስፍራዋን ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የምድርን ዳርቻ ይመለከታል፥  ከሰማይም በታች ያለውን ሁሉ ያያል።

verses.text_english: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.text_amharic: ለነፋስ ሚዛንን ባደረገለት ጊዜ፥  ውኆችንም በስፍር በሰፈረ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.text_amharic: ለዝናብም ሥርዓትን፥  ለነጐድጓድ መብረቅም መንገድን ባደረገ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አያት፥ ገለጣትም፤  አዘጋጃትም፥ ደግሞም መረመራት።

verses.text_english: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that wisdom; and to depart from evil understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውንም። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ጥበብ ነው፤  ከኃጢአትም መራቅ ማስተዋል ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም ምሳሌውን ይመስል ዘንድ ደገመ፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Oh that I were as months past, as the days God preserved me;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቀኝ እንደ ነበረው ጊዜ፥  እንደ ፊተኛው ወራት ምነው በሆንሁ!

verses.text_english: When his candle shined upon my head, by his light I walked darkness;
verses.text_amharic: በራሴ ላይ መብራቱ በበራ ጊዜ፥  እኔም ጨለማውን አልፌ በብርሃኑ በሄድሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God upon my tabernacle;
verses.text_amharic: በሙሉ ሰውነቴ እንደ ነበርሁ ጊዜ፥  እግዚአብሔር ድንኳኔን በጋረደ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: When the Almighty yet with me, my children about me;
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ከእኔ ጋር ገና ሳለ፥  ልጆቼም በዙሪያዬ ሳሉ፥

verses.text_english: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
verses.text_amharic: መንገዴ በቅቤ ይታጠብ በነበረ ጊዜ፥  ድንጋዩ የዘይት ፈሳሽ ያፈስስልኝ በነበረ ጊዜ።

verses.text_english: When I went out to the gate through the city, I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ከተማይቱ በር በወጣሁ ጊዜ፥  በአደባባዩም ወንበሬን ባኖርሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, stood up.
verses.text_amharic: ጐበዛዝት እኔን አይተው ተሸሸጉ፥  ሽማግሌዎችም ተነሥተው ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: The princes refrained talking, and laid hand on their mouth.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹ ከመናገር ዝም አሉ፥  እጃቸውንም በአፋቸው ላይ ጫኑ።

verses.text_english: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.text_amharic: የታላላቆቹም ድምፅ አረመመ፤  ምላሳቸውም በትናጋቸው ተጣጋ።

verses.text_english: When the ear heard , then it blessed me; and when the eye saw , it gave witness to me:
verses.text_amharic: የሰማችኝ ጆሮ አሞገሰችኝ፥  ያየችኝም ዓይን መሰከረችልኝ፤

verses.text_english: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and none to help him.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጮኸውን ችግረኛ፥  ድሀ አደጉንና ረጂ የሌለውን አድኜ ነበርሁና።

verses.text_english: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
verses.text_amharic: ለጥፋት የቀረበው በረከት በላዬ መጣ፤  የባልቴቲቱንም ልብ እልል አሰኘሁ።

verses.text_english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment as a robe and a diadem.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን ለበስሁ እርስዋም ለበሰችኝ፤  ፍርዴም እንደ መጐናጸፊያና እንደ ኵፋር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet I to the lame.
verses.text_amharic: ለዕውር ዓይን፥  ለአንካሳ እግር ነበርሁ።

verses.text_english: I a father to the poor: and the cause I knew not I searched out.
verses.text_amharic: ለድሀው አባት ነበርሁ፤  የማላውቀውንም ሰው ሙግት መረመርሁ።

verses.text_english: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአተኛውን መንጋጋ ሰበርሁ፥  የነጠቀውንም ከጥርሱ ውስጥ አስጣልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply days as the sand.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አልሁ። በልጆቼ መካከል እሞታለሁ፥  ዕድሜዬንም እንደ አሸዋ አበዛለሁ፤

verses.text_english: My root spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
verses.text_amharic: ሥሬ በውኃ ላይ ተዘርግቶአል፥  ጠልም በቅርንጫፌ ላይ ያድራል፤

verses.text_english: My glory fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
verses.text_amharic: ክብሬ በእኔ ዘንድ ታድሶአል፥  ቀስቴም በእጄ ውስጥ ለምልሞአል።

verses.text_english: Unto me gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች እኔን ሰምተው በትዕግሥት ተጠባበቁ፥  ምክሬንም ለማዳመጥ ዝም አሉ።

verses.text_english: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ከቃሌ በኋላ አንዳች አልመለሱም፤  ንግግሬም በእርሱ ላይ ተንጠባጠበ።

verses.text_english: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide for the latter rain.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናብን እንደሚጠብቁ በትዕግሥት ጠበቁኝ፤  የጥቢን ዝናብ እንደሚሹ አፋቸውን ከፈቱ።

verses.text_english: I laughed on them, they believed not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ባልታመኑ ጊዜ ሳቅሁላቸው፤  የፊቴንም ብርሃን አላወረዱም።

verses.text_english: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one comforteth the mourners.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዳቸውን መረጥሁ፤  እንደ አለቃ ሆኜ ተቀመጥሁ፤  ንጉሥ በሠራዊቱ መካከል እንደሚኖር፥  ኅዘነተኞችን እንደሚያጽናና ኖርሁ።

verses.text_english: But now younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በዕድሜ ከእኔ የሚያንሱ፥  አባቶቻቸውን ከመንጋዬ ውሾች ጋር ለማኖር የናቅኋቸው፥  በእኔ ላይ ተሳለቁብኝ።

verses.text_english: Yea, whereto the strength of their hands me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሉ ሰው መሆናቸው ጠፍቶባቸው ነበርና  የእጃቸው ብርታት ለእኔ ምን ይጠቅማል?

verses.text_english: For want and famine solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
verses.text_amharic: በራብና በቀጠና የመነመኑ ናቸው፤  የመፍረስና የመፈታት ጨለማ ወዳለበት  ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይሸሻሉ።

verses.text_english: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots their meat.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጥቋጦ አጠገብ ያለውን  ጨው ጨው የሚለውን አትክልት ይለቅማሉ፤  የክትክታ ሥር ደግሞ መብላቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: They were driven forth from among , (they cried after them as a thief;)
verses.text_amharic: ከሰዎች ተለይተው ተሰደዱ፤  በሌባ ላይ እንደሚጮኽ ይጮኹባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, caves of the earth, and the rocks.
verses.text_amharic: በሸለቆ ፈረፈርና በምድር ጕድጓድ  በድንጋይም ዋሻ ውስጥ ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጥቋጦ መካከል ይጮኻሉ፤  ከሳማ በታች ተሰብስበዋል።

verses.text_english: children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የሰነፎችና የነውረኞች ልጆች ናቸው፤  ከምድርም በግርፋት የተባረሩ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እኔ መዝፈኛና መተረቻ ሆንኋቸው።

verses.text_english: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
verses.text_amharic: ተጸየፉኝ፥ ከእኔም ራቁ፤  አክታቸውንም በፊቴ መትፋትን አልተዉም።

verses.text_english: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.text_amharic: የቀስቴን አውታር አላልቶብኛል፥ አዋርዶኝማል፤  እነርሱም በፊቴ ልጓማቸውን ፈትተዋል።

verses.text_english: Upon right rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.text_amharic: በቀኜ በኩል ዱርዬዎች ተነሥተዋል፥  እግሬንም ይገለብጣሉ፤  የጥፋታቸውን መንገድ በእኔ ላይ ይጐድባሉ።

verses.text_english: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.text_amharic: ጐዳናዬን ያበላሻሉ፤  ረዳት የሌላቸው ሰዎች መከራዬን ያበዛሉ።

verses.text_english: They came as a wide breaking in : in the desolation they rolled themselves .
verses.text_amharic: በሰፊ ፍራሽ እንደሚመጡ ይመጡብኛል፤  በባድማ ውስጥ ይንከባለሉብኛል።

verses.text_english: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋጤ በላዬ ተመለሰችብኝ፥  ክብሬንም እንደ ነፋስ ያሳድዱአታል፤  ደኅንነቴም እንደ ደመና አልፋለች።

verses.text_english: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ነፍሴ በውስጤ ፈሰሰች፤  የመከራም ዘመን ያዘችኝ።

verses.text_english: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊት አጥንቴ በደዌ ተነደለች፥  ጅማቶቼም አያርፉም።

verses.text_english: By the great force is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.text_amharic: ከታላቁ ደዌ ኃይል የተነሣ ልብሴ ተበላሸች፤  እንደ ቀሚስ ክሳድ አነቀችኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ በጭቃ ውስጥ ጣለኝ፥  አፈርና አመድም መሰልሁ።

verses.text_english: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me .
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፥ አልመለስህልኝም፤  ተነሣሁ፥ አልተመለከትኸኝም።

verses.text_english: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰህ ጨካኝ ሆንህብኝ፤  በእጅህም ብረታት አስጨነቅኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride , and dissolvest my substance.
verses.text_amharic: በነፋስ አነሣኸኝ፥ በላዩም አስቀመጥኸኝ፤  በዐውሎ ነፋስ አቀለጥኸኝ።

verses.text_english: For I know thou wilt bring me death, and the house appointed for all living.
verses.text_amharic: ለሞት ሕያዋንም ሁሉ ለሚሰበሰቡበት ቤት አሳልፈህ እንደምትሰጠኝ አውቄአለሁና።

verses.text_english: Howbeit he will not stretch out hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሰው በወደቀ ጊዜ እጁን አይዘረጋምን?  በጥፋቱስ ጊዜ አይጮኽምን?

verses.text_english: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was my soul grieved for the poor?
verses.text_amharic: ጭንቅ ቀን ላገኘው ሰው አላለቀስሁምን?  ለችግረኛስ ነፍሴ አላዘነችምን?

verses.text_english: When I looked for good, then evil came : and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጎነትን በተጠባበቅሁ ጊዜ ክፉ ነገር መጣችብኝ፤  ብርሃንን በትዕግሥት ጠበቅሁ፥ ጨለማም መጣ።

verses.text_english: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.text_amharic: አንጀቴ ፈላች፥ አላረፈችም፤  የመከራም ዘመን መጣችብኝ።

verses.text_english: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, I cried in the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ ፀሐይ በትካዜ ሄድሁ፤  በጉባኤም መካከል ቆሜ ጮኽሁ።

verses.text_english: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
verses.text_amharic: ለቀበሮ ወንድም፥  ለሰጐንም ባልንጀራ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.text_amharic: ቁርበቴ ጠቈረ፥ ከእኔም ተለይቶ እርግፍግፍ አለ፤  አጥንቴም ከትኵሳት የተነሣ ተቃጠለች።

verses.text_english: My harp also is to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መሰንቆዬ ለኀዘን፥  እምቢልታዬም ለሚያለቅሱ ቃል ሆነ።

verses.text_english: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.text_amharic: ከዓይኔ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ገባሁ፤  እንግዲህስ ቈንጆይቱን እንዴት እመለከታለሁ?

verses.text_english: For what portion of God from above? and inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር እድል ፈንታ ከላይ፥  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ ርስት ከአርያም ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: not destruction to the wicked? and a strange to the workers of iniquity?
verses.text_amharic: መዓትስ ለኃጢአተኛ፥  መለየትስ ለሚበድሉ አይደለምችን?

verses.text_english: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.text_amharic: መንገዴን አያይምን?  እርምጃዬንስ ሁሉ አይቈጥርምን?

verses.text_english: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነተኛ ሚዛን ልመዘን፥  እግዚአብሔርም ቅንነቴን ይወቅ።  በሐሰት ሄጄ እንደ ሆነ  እግሬም ለሽንገላ ቸኵላ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.text_amharic: እርምጃዬ ከመንገድ ፈቀቅ ብሎ፥  ልቤም ዓይኔን ተከትሎ፥  ነውርም ከእጄ ጋር ተጣብቆ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ልዝራ፥ ሌላ ሰውም ይብላው፤  የሚበቅለውም ሁሉ ይነቀል።

verses.text_english: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ወደ ሌላይቱ ሴት ጐምጅቶ እንደ ሆነ፥  በባልንጀራዬም ደጅ አድብቼ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቴ ለሌላ ሰው ትፍጭ፥  ሌሎችም በእርስዋ ላይ ይጐንበሱ።

verses.text_english: For this an heinous crime; yea, it an iniquity the judges.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ክፉ አበሳ፥  ፈራጆችም የሚቀጡበት በደል ነውና፤

verses.text_english: For it a fire consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ እስከ ጥፋት ድረስ የሚበላ እሳት፥  ቡቃያዬንም ሁሉ የሚነቅል ነውና።

verses.text_english: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.text_amharic: ወንድ ባሪያዬ ወይም ሴት ባሪያዬ ከእኔ ጋር በተምዋገቱ ጊዜ፥  ሙግታቸውን ንቄ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በተነሣ ጊዜ ምን አደርጋለሁ?  በጐበኘኝ ጊዜ ምን እመልስለታለሁ?

verses.text_english: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.text_amharic: እኔን በማኅፀን የፈጠረ እርሱንስ የፈጠረው አይደለምን?  በማኅፀንስ ውስጥ የሠራን አንድ አይደለንምን?

verses.text_english: If I have withheld the poor from desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.text_amharic: ድሀውን ከልመናው ከልክዬ፥  የመበለቲቱን ዓይን አጨልሜ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራዬን ለብቻዬ በልቼ እንደ ሆነ፥  ድሀ አደጉም ደግሞ ከእርሱ ሳይበላ ቀርቶ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)
verses.text_amharic: እርሱን ግን ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሬ እንደ አባቱ ከእኔ ጋር አሳድጌው ነበር፥  እርስዋንም ከእናቴ ማኅፀን ጀምሬ መራኋት፤

verses.text_english: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.text_amharic: ራቁቱን የሆነው ሰው ሲጠፋ፥  ወይም ድሀ ያለ ልብስ ሲሆን አይቼ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: If his loins have not blessed me, and he were warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.text_amharic: ጐንና ጐኑ ያልባረከችኝ፥  በበጎቼም ጠጕር ያልሞቀ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.text_amharic: በበሩ ረዳት ስላየሁ፥  በድሀ አደጉ ላይ እጄን አንሥቼ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.text_amharic: ትከሻዬ ከመሠረትዋ ትውደቅ፥  ክንዴም ከመገናኛዋ ትሰበር።

verses.text_english: For destruction God a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መዓት አስደንግጦኛልና፤  በክብሩም ፊት ምንም ለማድረግ አልቻልሁም።

verses.text_english: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, my confidence;
verses.text_amharic: ወርቅን ተስፋ አድርጌ፥  ጥሩውንም ወርቅ። በአንተ እታመናለሁ ብዬ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: If I rejoiced because my wealth great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
verses.text_amharic: ሀብቴ ስለ በዛ፥  እጄም ብዙ ስላገኘች ደስ ብሎኝ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking brightness;
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ ሲበራ  ጨረቃ በክብር ስትሄድ አይቼ፥

verses.text_english: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ በስውር ተታልሎ፥  አፌም እጄን ስሞ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: This also an iniquity the judge: for I should have denied the God above.
verses.text_amharic: ልዑል እግዚአብሔርን በካድሁ ነበርና  ይህ ደግሞ ፈራጆች የሚቀጡበት በደል በሆነ ነበር።

verses.text_english: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.text_amharic: በሚጠላኝ መጥፋት ደስ ብሎኝ  ክፉ ነገርም ባገኘው ጊዜ ሐሤት አድርጌ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በመርገም ነፍሱን በመሻት  አንደበቴን ኃጢአት ይሠራ ዘንድ አልሰጠሁም፤

verses.text_english: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.text_amharic: በድንኳኔ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች።  በከብቱ ሥጋ ያልጠገበ ማን ይገኛል? ብለው እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: The stranger did not lodge in the street: I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.text_amharic: መጻተኛው ግን በሜዳ አያድርም ነበር፥  ደጄንም ለመንገደኛ እከፍት ነበር፤

verses.text_english: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
verses.text_amharic: በደሌንም በብብቴ በመሸሸግ  ኃጢአቴን እንደ ሰው ሰውሬ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, went not out of the door?
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብ ብዛት ፈርቼ፥  የዘመዶቼም ንቀት አስደንግጦኝ፥  ዝም ብዬ ከደጅ ያልወጣሁ እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire the Almighty would answer me, and mine adversary had written a book.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዳምጠኝ ምነው በኖረልኝ!  እነሆ የእጄ ምልክት  ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ይመልስልኝ፤  ከባላጋራዬ የተጻፈው የክስ ጽሑፍ ምነው በተገኘልኝ!

verses.text_english: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, bind it a crown to me.
verses.text_amharic: በትከሻዬ ላይ እሸከመው፥  አክሊልም አድርጌ በራሴ አስረው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.text_amharic: የእርምጃዬን ቍጥር አስታውቀው፥  እንደ አለቃም ሆኜ አቀርብለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.text_amharic: እርሻዬ በእኔ ላይ ጮኻ እንደ ሆነ፥  ትልሞችዋም በአንድ ላይ አልቅሰው እንደ ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬዋን ያለ ዋጋ በልቼ፥  የባለቤቶችንም ነፍስ አሳዝኜ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.text_amharic: በስንዴ ፋንታ አሜከላ፥  በገብስም ፋንታ ኵርንችት ይውጣብኝ። የኢዮብ ቃል ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he righteous in his own eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም ራሱን ጻድቅ አድርጎ ነበርና እነዚያ ሦስቱ ሰዎች መመለስን ተዉ።

verses.text_english: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.text_amharic: ከራም ወገን የሆነ የቡዛዊው የባርክኤል ልጅ የኤሊሁ ቍጣ ነደደ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ ራሱን ጻድቅ አድርጎ ነበርና ኢዮብን ተቈጣው።

verses.text_english: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and had condemned Job.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በኢዮብ ፈረዱበት እንጂ የሚገባ መልስ ስላላገኙ በሦስቱ ባልንጀሮቹ ላይ ተቈጣ።

verses.text_english: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they elder than he.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሁ ግን ከእርሱ ይልቅ ሽማግሌዎች ነበሩና ከኢዮብ ጋር መናገርን ጠብቆ ነበር።

verses.text_english: When Elihu saw that no answer in the mouth of three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሁም በነዚህ በሦስቱ ሰዎች አፍ መልስ እንደሌለ ባየ ጊዜ ቍጣው ነደደ።

verses.text_english: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I young, and ye very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.text_amharic: የቡዛዊውም የባርክኤል ልጅ ኤሊሁ ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ።  እኔ በዕድሜ ታናሽ ነኝ፥ እናንተ ግን ሽማግሌዎች ናችሁ፤  ስለዚህም ሰጋሁ፤ እውቀቴን እገልጥላችሁ ዘንድ ፈራሁ።

verses.text_english: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም አልሁ። ዓመታት በተናገሩ ነበር፥  የዓመታትም ብዛት ጥበብን ባስተማረች ነበር።

verses.text_english: But a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በሰው ውስጥ መንፈስ አለ፥  ሁሉንም የሚችል የአምላክ እስትንፋስ ማስተዋልን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Great men are not wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.text_amharic: በዕድሜ ያረጁ ጠቢባን አይደሉም፥  ሽማግሌዎችም ፍርድን አያስተውሉም።

verses.text_english: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም። ስሙኝ፤  እኔ ደግሞ እውቀቴን እገልጥላችኋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ቃላችሁን በትዕግሥት ጠበቅሁ፤  የምትናገሩትን ነገር እስክትመረምሩ ድረስ፤  ብልሃታችሁን አዳመጥሁ።

verses.text_english: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, none of you that convinced Job, that answered his words:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ልብ አደረግሁ፤  እነሆም፥ በእናንተ መካከል ኢዮብን ያስረዳ፥  ወይም ለቃሉ የመለሰ የለም።

verses.text_english: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። ጥበብን አግኝተናል፤  እግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ ሰው አያሸንፈውም እንዳትሉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: Now he hath not directed words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ቃሉን በእኔ ላይ አልተናገረም፤  እኔም በንግግራችሁ አልመልስለትም።

verses.text_english: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ደነገጡ፥ ዳግመኛም አልመለሱም፤  የሚናገሩትንም አጡ።

verses.text_english: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, answered no more;)
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ አልተናገሩምና፥  ቆመው ዳግመኛ አልመለሱምና እኔ በትዕግሥት እጠብቃለሁን?

verses.text_english: , I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ ፈንታዬን እመልሳለሁ፥  እውቀቴንም እገልጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ቃል ተሞልቻለሁና፥  በውስጤም ያለ መንፈስ አስገድዶኛልና።

verses.text_english: Behold, my belly as wine hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.text_amharic: በተሐ ጠጅ እንደ ተሞላና ሊቀደድ እንደ ቀረበ አቁማዳ፥  ሊፈነዳ እንደማይችል እንደ ወይን ጠጅ  አቁማዳ፥ እነሆ፥ አንጀቴ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂት እንድተነፍስ እናገራለሁ፤  ከንፈሬን ገልጬ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ፊት ግን አላደላም፤  ሰውንም አላቈላምጥም።

verses.text_english: For I know not to give flattering titles; my maker would soon take me away.
verses.text_amharic: በማቈላመጥ እናገር ዘንድ አላውቅምና፤  ያለዚያስ ፈጣሪዬ ፈጥኖ ከሕይወቴ ይለየኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን እንድትሰማ፥  ቃሌንም ሁሉ እንድታደምጥ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አፌን ከፍቻለሁ፥  አንደበቴም በትናጋዬ ተናግሮአል።

verses.text_english: My words the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌ የልቤን ቅንነት ያወጣል፤  ከንፈሮቼም የሚያውቁትን በቅንነት ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ፈጠረኝ፥  ሁሉንም የሚችል የአምላክ እስትንፋስ ሕይወት ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: If thou canst answer me, set in order before me, stand up.
verses.text_amharic: ይቻልህ እንደ ሆነ መልስልኝ፤  ቃልህንም አዘጋጅተህ በፊቴ ቁም።

verses.text_english: Behold, I according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እኔ እንደ አንተ ነኝ፤  እኔ ደግሞ ከጭቃ የተፈጠርሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ግርማዬ አታስፈራህም  እጄም አትከብድብህም።

verses.text_english: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of words, ,
verses.text_amharic: በጆሮዬ ተናግረሃል፥  የቃልህንም ድምፅ ሰምቻለሁ፥ እንዲህም ብለሃል።

verses.text_english: I am clean without transgression, I innocent; neither iniquity in me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ያለ መተላለፍ ንጹሕ ነኝ፤  ያለ ነውር ነኝ፥ ኃጢአትም የለብኝም፤

verses.text_english: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ምክንያት አግኝቶብኛል፥  እንደ ጠላቱም ቈጥሮኛል፤

verses.text_english: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
verses.text_amharic: እግሬን በግንድ አጣበቀ፥  መንገዴንም ሁሉ ተመለከተ።

verses.text_english: Behold, this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አንተ በዚህ ጻድቅ አይደለህም፤  እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ይበልጣል ብዬ እመልስልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ። ለቃሌ ሁሉ አይመልስልኝም ብለህ፥  ስለ ምን ከእርሱ ጋር ትከራከራለህ?

verses.text_english: For God speaketh once, yea twice, perceiveth it not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአንድ መንገድ በሌላም ይናገራል፤  ሰው ግን አያስተውለውም።

verses.text_english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
verses.text_amharic: በሕልም፥ በሌሊት ራእይ፥  አፍላ እንቅልፍ በሰዎች ላይ ሲወድቅ፥  በአልጋ ላይ ተኝተው ሳሉ፥

verses.text_english: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የሰዎችን ጆሮ ይከፍታል፥  በተግሣጹም ያስደነግጣቸዋል፥

verses.text_english: That he may withdraw man purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን ከክፉ ሥራው ይመልሰው ዘንድ  ከሰውም ትዕቢትን ይሰውር ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ከጕድጓድ፥  በሰይፍም እንዳይጠፋ ሕይወቱን ይጠብቃል።

verses.text_english: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong :
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ በአልጋ ላይ በደዌ ይገሥጸዋል፥  አጥንቱንም ሁሉ ያደነዝዛል።

verses.text_english: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወቱም እንጀራን፥  ነፍሱም ጣፋጭ መብልን ትጠላለች።

verses.text_english: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones were not seen stick out.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋው እስከማይታይ ድረስ ይሰለስላል፤  ተሸፍኖ የነበረውም አጥንት ይገለጣል።

verses.text_english: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱ ወደ ጕድጓዱ፥  ሕይወቱም ወደሚገድሉአት ቀርባለች።

verses.text_english: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
verses.text_amharic: የቀናውን መንገድ ለሰው ያስታውቀው ዘንድ፥  ከሺህ አንድ ሆኖ የሚተረጕም መልአክ ቢገኝለት፥

verses.text_english: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
verses.text_amharic: እየራራለት።  ቤዛ አግኝቻለሁና  ወደ ጕድጓድ እንዳይወርድ አድነው ቢለው፥

verses.text_english: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋው እንደ ሕፃን ሥጋ ይለመልማል፤  ወደ ጕብዝናውም ዘመን ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጸልያል፥  እርሱም ሞገስን ይሰጠዋል  ፊቱንም በደስታ ያሳየዋል፤  ለሰውም ጽድቁን ይመልስለታል።

verses.text_english: He looketh upon men, and say, I have sinned, and perverted right, and it profited me not;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በሰው ፊት እየዘመረ።  እኔ በድያለሁ፥ ቅኑንም አጣምሜአለሁ፤  የሚገባኝንም ብድራት አልተቀበልሁም፤

verses.text_english: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ወደ ጕድጓድ እንዳትወርድ አድኖአታል፥  ሕይወቴም ብርሃንን ታያለች ይላል።

verses.text_english: Lo, all these worketh God oftentimes with man,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሁሉ  ሁለት ጊዜና ሦስት ጊዜ ከሰው ጋር ያደርጋል፤

verses.text_english: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ነፍሱን ከጕድጓድ ይመልስ ዘንድ፥  በሕያዋንም ብርሃን ያበራ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ፥ እኔንም ስማ፤  ዝም በል፥ እኔም እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ቢኖርህ መልስልኝ፤  ትጸድቅ ዘንድ እወድዳለሁና ተናገር።

verses.text_english: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ያለዚያም እኔን ስማ፤  ዝም በል፥ እኔም ጥበብን አስተምርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሁም ደግሞ መለሰ፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Hear my words, O ye wise ; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
