verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ጥበበኞች፥ ቃሌን ስሙ፤  እናንተም አዋቂዎች፥ ወደ እኔ አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
verses.text_amharic: ትናጋ መብልን እንደሚቀምስ፥  ጆሮ ቃልን ትለያለችና።

verses.text_english: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what good.
verses.text_amharic: ቅን የሆነውን ነገር እንምረጥ፤  መልካሙንም ነገር በመካከላችን እንወቅ።

verses.text_english: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብ። እኔ ጻድቅ ነኝ፥  እግዚአብሔር ግን ፍርዴን አስወገደ፤

verses.text_english: Should I lie against my right? my wound incurable without transgression.
verses.text_amharic: ምንም እውነተኛ ብሆን እንደ ውሸተኛ ተቈጠርሁ፤  ምንም ባልበድል ቍስሌ የማይፈወስ ነው ብሎአል።

verses.text_english: What man like Job, drinketh up scorning like water?
Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም። በእግዚአብሔር መደሰት  ለሰው ምንም አይጠቅምም ብሎአልና  ከበደለኞች ጋር የሚተባበር፥  ክፉ ከሚያደርጉስ ጋር የሚሄድ፥  መሳለቅን እንደ ውኃ የሚጠጣት  እንደ ኢዮብ ያለ ሰው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, wickedness; and the Almighty, iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እናንተ አእምሮ ያላችሁ ሰዎች፥ ስሙኝ፤  ክፋትን ያደርግ ዘንድ ከእግዚአብሔር፥  በደልንም ይሠራ ዘንድ ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ይራቅ።

verses.text_english: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to ways.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ሥራውን ይመልስለታል፥  ሰውም እንደ መንገዱ ያገኝ ዘንድ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ክፉ አይሠራም፥  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ ፍርድን ጠማማ አያደርግም።

verses.text_english: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን አደራ የሰጠው ማን ነው?  ዓለምንስ ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ ያኖረ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: If he set his heart upon man, he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ልቡን ወደ ራሱ ቢመልስ፥  መንፈሱንና እስትንፋሱን ወደ ራሱ ቢሰበስብ፥

verses.text_english: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ በአንድነት ይጠፋል፥  ሰውም ወደ አፈር ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: If now understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.text_amharic: አስተዋይ ብትሆን ይህን ስማ፤  የንግግሬንም ቃል አድመጥ።

verses.text_english: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ጽድቅን የሚጠላ ይሠለጥናልን?  ጻድቅና ኃያል የሆነውስ በደለኛ ታደርገዋለህን?

verses.text_english: to say to a king, wicked? to princes, ungodly?
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሰው ንጉሡን። በደለኛ ነህ፥  መኳንንቱንም። ክፉዎች ናችሁ ይላልን?

verses.text_english: that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all the work of his hands.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ሁሉ የእጁ ሥራ ናቸውና  በአለቆች ፊት አያደላም፥  ባለጠጋውንም ሰው ከድሀው ይበልጥ አይመለከትም።

verses.text_english: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ በመንፈቀ ሌሊት በድንገት ይሞታሉ፤  ሕዝቡ ተንቀጥቅጦ ያልፋል፥  ኃያላንም ያለ እጅ ይነጠቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For his eyes upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቹ በሰው መንገድ ላይ ናቸው፥  እርምጃውንም ሁሉ ያያል።

verses.text_english: no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአትን የሚሠሩ ይሰወሩበት ዘንድ  ጨለማ ወይም የሞት ጥላ የለም።

verses.text_english: For he will not lay upon man more ; that he should enter into judgment with God.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመፈራረድ እንዲመጣ  ጊዜ አይወሰንለትም።

verses.text_english: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
verses.text_amharic: ታላላቆችን ያለ ምርመራ ይሰባብራል፥  በእነርሱም ፋንታ ሌሎችን ያቆማል።

verses.text_english: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራቸውን ያውቃል፤  እንዲደቅቁም በሌሊት ይገለባብጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች እያዩ እንደ ክፉዎች ይመታቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝብ ወይም በሰው ዘንድ ቢሆን፥  እርሱ ቢያሳርፍ የሚፈርድ ማን ነው?  ፊቱንስ ቢሰውር የሚያየው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth face, who then can behold him? whether against a nation, or against a man only:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ዝንጉ ሰው እንዳይነግሥ፥  ሕዝቡም የሚያጠምድ እንዳይኖር ነው።

verses.text_english: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን። እኔ ሳልበድል ቅጣት ተቀበልሁ፤

verses.text_english: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne , I will not offend :
verses.text_amharic: የማላየውን ነገር አንተ አስተምረኝ፤  ኃጢአትንም ሠርቼ እንደ ሆነ፥  ደግሜ አልሠራም የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ አንተ ጥለኸዋልና  ፍዳው አንተ እንደምትወድደው ይሆናልን?  አንተ ትመርጣለህ እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም፤  ስለዚህ የምታውቀውን ተናገር።

verses.text_english: according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰሙኝ ጥበበኞች ሁሉ፥  አስተዋዮችም እንዲህ ይሉኛል።

verses.text_english: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብ ያለ እውቀት ተናግሮአል፥  ቃሉም በአእምሮ አይደለችም።

verses.text_english: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words without wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብ እስከ ፍጻሜ ድረስ ምነው በተፈተነ ኖሮ!  እርሱ እንደ ክፉዎች መልሶአልና፤

verses.text_english: My desire Job may be tried unto the end because of answers for wicked men.
verses.text_amharic: በኃጢአቱም ላይ ዓመፅን ጨምሮአልና፥  በእኛም መካከል በእጁ ያጨበጭባልና፥  ቃልንም በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ያበዛልና።

verses.text_english: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሁም ደግሞ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Thinkest thou this to be right, thou saidst, My righteousness more than God's?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ጽድቅ እንደ ሆነ ታስባለህን?  ወይስ። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እኔ ጻድቅ ነኝ ትላለህን?

verses.text_english: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? , What profit shall I have, from my sin?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ። ምን ጥቅም አለህ?  ኃጢአት ሠርቼ ከማገኘው ይልቅ ኃጢአት ባልሠራ ኖሮ ምን እጠቀማለሁ? ብለህ ጠይቀሃልና።

verses.text_english: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ለአንተና ከአንተ ጋር ላሉ ለባልንጀሮችህ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds are higher than thou.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችህን ወደ ሰማይ አቅንተህ እይ፤  ከአንተም ከፍ ከፍ ያሉትን ደመናት ተመልከት።

verses.text_english: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአት ብትሠራ ምን ትጐዳዋለህ?  መተላለፍህስ ቢበዛ ምን ታደርገዋለህ?

verses.text_english: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅስ ብትሆን ምን ትሰጠዋለህ?  ወይስ ከእጅህ ምንን ይቀበላል?

verses.text_english: Thy wickedness a man as thou ; and thy righteousness the son of man.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አንተ ያለውን ሰው ክፋትህ ይጐዳዋል፤  ለሰውም ልጅ ጽድቅህ ይጠቅመዋል።

verses.text_english: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.text_amharic: ከግፍ ብዛት የተነሣ ሰዎች ይጮኻሉ፤  ከኃያላንም ክንድ የተነሣ ለእርዳታ ይጠራሉ።

verses.text_english: But none saith, Where God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ስለ ክፉ ሰዎች ትዕቢት ይጮኻሉ፥  እርሱ ግን አይመልስላቸውም።

verses.text_english: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ከንቱ ነገርን አይሰማም፥  ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክም አይመለከተውም፤

verses.text_english: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንም። አላየውም፤  ነገሩ በእርሱ ፊት ነው፥ እኔም አጠብቀዋለሁ ስትል።

verses.text_english: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, judgment before him; therefore trust thou in him.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በቍጣው አልጐበኘምና።  በኃጢአት እጅግ አያስብም ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: But now, because not , he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth not in great extremity:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኢዮብ አፉን በከንቱ ይከፍታል፥  ያለ እውቀትም ቃሉን ያበዛል።

verses.text_english: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኤሊሁም ደግሞ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that yet to speak on God's behalf.
verses.text_amharic: ገና ስለ እግዚአብሔር የሚነገር አለኝና  ጥቂት ቆየኝ፥ እኔም አስታውቅሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.text_amharic: እውቀቴን ከሩቅ አመጣለሁ፥  ፈጣሪዬንም። ጻድቅ ነው እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: For truly my words not false: he that is perfect in knowledge with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌ በእውነት ያለ ሐሰት ነው፤  በእውቀትም ፍጹም የሆነ ከአንተ ጋር አለ።

verses.text_english: Behold, God mighty, and despiseth not mighty in strength wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ኃያል ነው፥ ማንንም አይንቅም፤  እርሱም በማስተዋል ብርታት ኃያል ነው።

verses.text_english: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ የበደለኞችን ሕይወት አያድንም፤  ለችግረኞች ግን ፍርዱን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑን ከጻድቃን ላይ አያርቅም፤  ለዘላለምም ከነገሥታት ጋር በዙፋን ላይ ያስቀምጣቸዋል፥  እነርሱም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: And if bound in fetters, be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.text_amharic: በሰንሰለት ቢታሰሩ፥  ወይም በችግር ገመድ ቢጠመዱ፥

verses.text_english: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራቸውንና መተላለፋቸውን  በትዕቢትም እንዳደረጉ ይናገራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮአቸውን ለተግሣጽ ይከፍተዋል፥  ከኃጢአትም ይመለሱ ዘንድ ያዝዛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: If they obey and serve , they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.text_amharic: ቢሰሙ ቢያገለግሉትም፥  ዕድሜአቸውን በልማት፥  ዘመናቸውንም በተድላ ይፈጽማሉ።

verses.text_english: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: ባይሰሙ ግን በሰይፍ ይጠፋሉ፥  ያለ እውቀትም ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.text_amharic: ዝንጉዎች ግን ቍጣን ያዘጋጃሉ፤  እርሱም ባሰራቸው ጊዜ አይጮኹም።

verses.text_english: They die in youth, and their life among the unclean.
verses.text_amharic: በሕፃንነታቸው ሳሉ ይሞታሉ፥  ሕይወታቸውም በሰዶማውያን መካከል ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.text_amharic: የተቸገረውን በችግሩ ያድነዋል፤  በመከራም ጆሮአቸውን ይገልጣል።

verses.text_english: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait a broad place, where no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table full of fatness.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም አንተን ከመከራ  ችግር ወደሌለበት ወደ ሰፊ ስፍራ በወሰደህ ነበር፥  በማዕድህ ላይ የተዘጋጀውም ስብ በሞላበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold .
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን በበደለኞች ፍርድ የተሞላህ ነህ፤  ስለዚህ ፍርድና ብይን ይይዝሃል።

verses.text_english: Because wrath, lest he take thee away with stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣ ለስድብ አያታልልህ፤  የማማለጃም ብዛት ፈቀቅ አያድርግህ።

verses.text_english: Will he esteem thy riches? , not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.text_amharic: ባለጠግነትህ የኃይልህም ብርታት ሁሉ  ያለ ችግር እንድትሆን ሊረዳህ ይችላልን?

verses.text_english: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.text_amharic: ወገኖች ከስፍራቸው የሚወጡበትን ሌሊት አትመኝ።

verses.text_english: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.text_amharic: ከመከራ ይልቅ ይህን መርጠሃልና  ኃጢአትን እንዳትመለከት ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በኃይሉ ከፍ ያለውን ነገር ያደርጋል፤  እንደ እርሱስ ያለ አስተማሪ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.text_amharic: መንገዱን ማን አዘዘለት?  ወይስ። ኃጢአትን ሠርተሃል የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች የዘመሩትን ሥራውን ታከብር ዘንድ አስብ።

verses.text_english: Every man may see it; man may behold afar off.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ሁሉ ተመልክተውታል፤  ሰውም ከሩቅ ያየዋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, God great, and we know not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው፥ እኛም አናውቀውም።  የዘመኑም ቍጥር አይመረመርም።

verses.text_english: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.text_amharic: የውኃውን ነጠብጣብ ወደ ላይ ይስባል፥  ዝናብም ከጉም ይንጠባጠባል፤

verses.text_english: Which the clouds do drop distil upon man abundantly.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናት ያዘንባሉ፥  በሰዎችም ላይ በብዙ ያንጠባጥባሉ።

verses.text_english: Also can understand the spreadings of the clouds, the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.text_amharic: የደመናውንም መዘርጋት፥  የማደሪያውንም ነጐድጓድ የሚያስተውል ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዙሪያው ብርሃኑን ይዘረጋል፤  የባሕሩንም ጥልቀት ይከድናል።

verses.text_english: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ በአሕዛብ ላይ ይፈርዳል፤  ብዙም ምግብ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it by that cometh betwixt.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቹን በብርሃን ይሰውራል፥  በጠላቱም ላይ ይወጣ ዘንድ ያዝዘዋል፤

verses.text_english: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.text_amharic: የነጐድጓድ ድምፅ ስለ እርሱ ይናገራል፤  እንስሶችም ደግሞ ስለሚመጣው ውሽንፍር ይጮኻሉ።

verses.text_english: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ልቤ ተንቀጠቀጠ፥  ከስፍራውም ተንቀሳቀሰ።

verses.text_english: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound goeth out of his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: የድምፁን መትመም ስሙ፥  ከአፉም የሚወጣውን ጕርምርምታ አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱን ወደ ሰማያት ሁሉ ታች፥  ብርሃኑንም ወደ ምድር ዳርቻ ይሰድዳል።

verses.text_english: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ኋላው ድምፅ ይጮኻል፤  በግርማውም ድምፅ ያንጐደጕዳል፤  ድምፁም በተሰማ ጊዜ  መብረቁን አይከለክልም።

verses.text_english: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በድምፁ ድንቅኛ ያንጐደጕዳል፤  እኛም የማናስተውለውን ታላቅ ነገር ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: For he saith to the snow, Be thou the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.text_amharic: በረዶውንና ውሽንፍሩን ብርቱንም ዝናብ።  በምድር ላይ ውደቁ ይላል።

verses.text_english: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ ሥራውን ያውቅ ዘንድ  የሰውን ሁሉ እጅ ያትማል።

verses.text_english: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.text_amharic: አውሬዎቹም ወደ ጫካው ይገባሉ፥  በዋሾቻቸውም ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሰወረ ማደሪያውም ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥  ከሰሜንም ብርድ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ውርጭ ተሰጥቶአል፤  የውኆችም ስፋት ይጠብባል።

verses.text_english: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
verses.text_amharic: የውኃውንም ሙላት በደመና ላይ ይጭናል፤  የብርሃኑንም ደመና ይበታትናል፤

verses.text_english: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
verses.text_amharic: ለተግሣጽ ወይም ለምድሩ ወይም ለምሕረት ቢሆን፥  ሰው በሚኖርበት ዓለም ላይ  ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ያደርግ ዘንድ  ፈቃዱ ወደ መራችው ይዞራል።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስማ፤  ቁም፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ተአምራት አስብ።

verses.text_english: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር እንዴት እንደሚያዝዛቸው፥  የደመናውንም ብርሃን እንዴት እንደሚያበራ አውቀሃልን?

verses.text_english: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ የደመናውን ሚዛን፥  ወይስ በእውቀት ፍጹም የሆነውን ተአምራት አውቀሃልን?

verses.text_english: How thy garments warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south ?
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብ ነፋስ ምድር ጸጥ ባለች ጊዜ፥  ልብስህ የሞቀች አንተ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, strong, as a molten looking glass?
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ቀለጠ መስተዋት  ብርቱ የሆኑትን ሰማያት ከእርሱ ጋር ልትዘረጋ ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: Teach us what we shall say unto him; we cannot order by reason of darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ከጨለማ የተነሣ በሥርዓት መናገር አንችልምና  የምንለውን አስታውቀን።

verses.text_english: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም በእርሱ ላይ ቢናገር ፈጽሞ ይዋጣልና  እኔ እናገር ዘንድ ብወድድ ሰው ይነግረዋልን?

verses.text_english: And now see not the bright light which in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ነፋስ አልፎ ካጠራቸው በኋላ፥  ሰው በሰማያት የሚበራውን ብርሃን ሊመለከት አይችልም።

verses.text_english: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God terrible majesty.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰሜን ወርቅ የሚመስል ጌጠኛ ብርሃን ይወጣል፤  በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሚያስፈራ ግርማ አለ።

verses.text_english: the Almighty, we cannot find him out: excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክን እናገኝ ዘንድ አንችልም፤  በኃይል ታላቅ ነው፤  በፍርድና በጽድቅም አያስጨንቅም።

verses.text_english: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any wise of heart.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሰዎች ይፈሩታል፤  በልባቸውም ጠቢባን የሆኑትን ሁሉ አይመለከትም።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ውስጥ ሆኖ ለኢዮብ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Who this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.text_amharic: ያለ እውቀት በሚነገር ቃል  ምክርን የሚያጨልም ይህ ማነው?

verses.text_english: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደ ሰው ወገብህን ታጠቅ፤  እጠይቅሃለሁ፥ አንተም ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን በመሠረትሁ ጊዜ አንተ ወዴት ነበርህ?  ታስተውል እንደ ሆንህ ተናገር።

verses.text_english: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.text_amharic: ብታውቅስ መሠፈሪያዋን የወሰነ፥  በላይዋስ የመለኪያ ገመድ የዘረጋ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.text_amharic: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች በአንድነት ሲዘምሩ፥  የእግዚአብሔርም ልጆች ሁሉ እልል ሲሉ፥  መሠረቶችዋ በምን ላይ ተተክለው ነበር?  የማዕዘንዋንስ ድንጋይ ያቆመ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Or shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, it had issued out of the womb?
verses.text_amharic: ከማኅፀን እንደሚወጣ በወጣ ጊዜ  ባሕርን በመዝጊያዎች የዘጋ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውን ለልብሱ፥  ጨለማንም ለመጠቅለያው አደረግሁ፤

verses.text_english: And brake up for it my decreed , and set bars and doors,
verses.text_amharic: ድንበሩን በዙሪያው አድርጌ፥  መወርወሪያዎቹንና መዝጊያዎቹን አኑሬ።

verses.text_english: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.text_amharic: እስከዚህ ድረስ ድረሺ፥ አትለፊ፤  በዚህም ለትዕቢተኛው ማዕበልሽ ገደብ ይሁን አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; caused the dayspring to know his place;
That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.text_amharic: ጭቃ ከማኅተም በታች እንደሚለወጥ እንዲሁ እርስዋ ትለወጣለች፤  ነገርም ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ተቀልሞአል።

verses.text_english: It is turned as clay the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.text_amharic: ከበደለኞች ብርሃናቸው ተከልክሎአል፥  ከፍ ያለውም ክንድ ተሰብሮአል።

verses.text_english: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባሕር ምንጭስ ውስጥ ገብተሃልን?  በቀላዩስ መሠረት ውስጥ ተመላልሰሃልን?

verses.text_english: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.text_amharic: የሞት በሮች ተገልጠውልሃልን?  የሞትንስ ጥላ ደጆች አይተሃልን?

verses.text_english: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.text_amharic: ምድርንስ በስፋትዋ አስተውለሃታልን?  ሁሉን አውቀህ እንደ ሆነ ተናገር።

verses.text_english: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
Where the way light dwelleth? and darkness, where the place thereof,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ተወልደህ ነበርና፥  የዕድሜህም ቍጥር ብዙ ነውና፤  በእውነት አንተ ሳታውቅ አትቀርም።

verses.text_english: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths the house thereof?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ወደ በረዶው ቤተ መዛግብት ገብተሃልን?  የበረዶውንስ ቅንጣት ቤተ መዛግብት አይተሃልን?

verses.text_english: Knowest thou , because thou wast then born? or the number of thy days great?
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም ለመከራ ጊዜ ለሰልፍና ለጦርነት ቀን የጠበቅሁት ነው።

verses.text_english: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንስ በምን መንገድ ይከፈላል?  የምሥራቅስ ነፋስ በምድር ላይ እንዴት ይበተናል?

verses.text_english: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
By what way is the light parted, scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.text_amharic: ሣሩንም እንዲያበቅል፥  ማንም በሌለባት ምድር ላይ፥  ሰውም በሌለባት ምድረ በዳ ላይ ዝናብን ያዘንብ ዘንድ፥  ለፈሳሹ ውኃ መንዶልዶያውን፥  ወይስ ለሚያንጐደጕድ መብረቅ መንገድን ያበጀ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ለዝናብ አባት አለውን?  ወይስ የጠልን ነጠብጣብ የወለደ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: To cause it to rain on the earth, no man the wilderness, wherein no man;
verses.text_amharic: በረዶስ ከማን ማኅፀን ወጣ?  የሰማዩንስ አመዳይ ማን ወለደው?

verses.text_english: To satisfy the desolate and waste ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.text_amharic: ውኆች እንደ ድንጋይ ጠነከሩ፥  የቀላዩም ፊት ረግቶአል።

verses.text_english: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የሰባቱን ከዋክብት ዘለላ ታስር ዘንድ፥  ወይስ ኦሪዮን የሚባለውን ኮከብ ትፈታ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ማዛሮት የሚባሉትን ከዋክብት በጊዜያቸው ታወጣ ዘንድ፥  ወይስ ድብ የሚባለውን ኮከብ ከልጆቹ ጋር ትመራ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: The waters are hid as a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይን ሥርዓት ታውቃለህን?  በምድርስ ለይ እንዲሠለጥን ልታደርግ ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.text_amharic: የውኆች ብዛት ይሸፍንህ ዘንድ  ቃልህን ወደ ደመናት ታነሣ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.text_amharic: መብረቆች ሄደው። እነሆ፥ እዚህ አለን ይሉህ ዘንድ  ልትልካቸው ትችላለህን?

verses.text_english: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.text_amharic: በውስጡስ ጥበብን ያኖረ፥  ለሰውስ ልብ ማስተዋልን የሰጠ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we ?
Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥  የሚበሉትም አጥተው ሲቅበዘበዙ፥  ለቍራ መብልን የሚሰጠው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.text_amharic: የበረሃ ፍየል የምትወልድበትን ጊዜ ታውቃለህን?  ዋላይቱስ የምታምጥበትን ጊዜ ትመለከታለህን?

verses.text_english: Canst thou number the months they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ የምትፈጽመውንስ ወራት ትቈጥራለህን?  የምትወልድበትንስ ጊዜ ታውቃለህን?

verses.text_english: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
verses.text_amharic: ይንበረከካሉ፥ ልጆቻቸውንም ይወልዳሉ፥  ከምጣቸውም ያርፋሉ።

verses.text_english: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸው ይጠነክራሉ፥  በሜዳም ያድጋሉ፤  ይወጣሉ፥ ወደ እነርሱም አይመለሱም።

verses.text_english: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.text_amharic: የሜዳውስ አህያ አርነት ማን አወጣው?  የበረሃውንስ አህያ ከእስራቱ ማን ፈታው?

verses.text_english: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
verses.text_amharic: በረሃውን ለእርሱ ቤት አድርጌ ሰጠሁት፤  መኖሪያውም በጨው ምድር ነው።

verses.text_english: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማ ውካታ ይዘብታል፤  የነጂውን ጩኸት አይሰማም።

verses.text_english: The range of the mountains his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.text_amharic: ተራራውን እንደ መሰምርያው ይመለከተዋል፥  ለምለሙንም ሁሉ ይፈልጋል።

verses.text_english: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
verses.text_amharic: ጐሽ ያገለግልህ ዘንድ ይታዘዛልን?  ወይስ በግርግምህ አጠገብ ያድራልን?

verses.text_english: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.text_amharic: ጐሽ ይተልምልህ ዘንድ ትጠምደዋለህን?  ወይስ ከአንተ በኋላ በእርሻ ላይ ይጐለጕላልን?

verses.text_english: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
verses.text_amharic: ጕልበቱስ ብርቱ ስለ ሆነ ትታመነዋለህን?  ተግባርህንስ ለእርሱ ትተዋለህን?

verses.text_english: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather thy barn?
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህንስ ይመልስልህ ዘንድ፥  በአውድማህስ ያከማችልህ ዘንድ ትታመነዋለህን?

verses.text_english: the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
verses.text_amharic: የሰጐን ክንፍ በደስታ ይንቀሳቀሳል፤  ነገር ግን ክንፉና ላባው ጭምተኛ ነውን?

verses.text_english: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
verses.text_amharic: እንቍላልዋን በመሬት ላይ ትተዋለች፥  በአፈርም ውስጥ ታሞቀዋለች፤

verses.text_english: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.text_amharic: እግር ይሰብረው ዘንድ፥  የምድረ በዳም አውሬ ይረግጠው ዘንድ ትረሳለች።

verses.text_english: She is hardened against her young ones, as though not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
verses.text_amharic: የእርስዋ እንዳልሆኑ በልጆችዋ ትጨክናለች።  በከንቱም ብትሠራ አትፈራም፤

verses.text_english: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጥበብን ከእርስዋ ከልክሎአልና፥  ማስተዋልንም አልሰጣትምና።

verses.text_english: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ስትል  በፈረስና በፈረሰኛው ትሳለቃለች።

verses.text_english: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.text_amharic: ለፈረስ ጕልበቱን ሰጥተኸዋልን?  አንገቱንስ ጋማ አልብሰኸዋልን?

verses.text_english: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils terrible.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አንበጣስ አፈናጠርኸውን?  የማንኰራፋቱ ክብር የሚያስፈራ ነው።

verses.text_english: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
verses.text_amharic: በኮቴው በሸለቆው ውስጥ ይጐደፍራል፥  በጉልበቱም ደስ ይለዋል፤  ሰይፍም የታጠቁትን ለመገናኘት ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርሃት ላይ ይስቃል፥  እርሱም አይደነግጥም፤  ከሰይፍም ፊት አይመለስም።

verses.text_english: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ላይ የፍላጻ ኮረጆና ብልጭልጭ የሚል ጦር  ሰላጢንም ያንኳኳሉ።

verses.text_english: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that the sound of the trumpet.
verses.text_amharic: በጭካኔና በቍጣ መሬትን ይውጣል፤  የመለከትም ድምፅ ቢሰማ አይቆምም።

verses.text_english: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.text_amharic: የመለከትም ድምፅ ሲሰማ። እሰይ! ይላል፤  ከሩቅ ሆኖ ሰልፍንና የአለቆቹን ጩኸት፥  የሠራዊቱንም ውካታ ያሸታል።

verses.text_english: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ከጥበብህ የተነሣ ጭልፊት ያንዣብባልን?  ወይስ ክንፎቹን ወደ ደቡብ ይዘረጋልን?

verses.text_english: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
verses.text_amharic: በአፍህ ትእዛዝ ንስር ከፍ ከፍ ይላልን?  ቤቱንስ በአርያም ላይ ያደርጋልን?

verses.text_english: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.text_amharic: በገደል ላይ ይኖራል፤  በገደሉ ገመገምና በጥጉ ያድራል።

verses.text_english: From thence she seeketh the prey, her eyes behold afar off.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሆኖ የሚነጥቀውን ይጐበኛል፤  ዓይኑም በሩቅ ትመለከታለች።

verses.text_english: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain , there she.
verses.text_amharic: ጫጩቶቹም ደም ይጠጣሉ፤  በድን ባለባትም ስፍራ እርሱ በዚያ አለ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም መለሰ ኢዮብንም እንዲህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct ? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የሚከራከር ሰው ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ጋር ይከራከራልን?  ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር የሚዋቀስ እርሱ ይመልስለት።

verses.text_english: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እግዚአብሔርንም እንዲህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ ወራዳ ሰው ነኝ፤ የምመልስልህ ምንድር ነው?  እጄን በአፌ ላይ እጭናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጊዜ ተናገርሁ፥ አልመልስምም፤  ሁለተኛ ጊዜም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልናገርም።

verses.text_english: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ውስጥ ሆኖ ለኢዮብ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደ ወንድ ወገብህን ታጠቅ፤  እጠይቅሃለሁ፥ አንተም ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ፍርዴን ታፈርሳለህን?  አንተስ ጻድቅ ትሆን ዘንድ በእኔ ትፈርዳለህን?

verses.text_english: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔር ክንድ ያለ ክንድ አለህን?  ወይስ እንደ እርሱ ባለ ድምፅ ታንጐደጕዳለህን?

verses.text_english: Deck thyself now majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅነትና በልዕልና ተላበስ፤  በክብርና በግርማም ተጐናጸፍ።

verses.text_english: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one proud, and abase him.
verses.text_amharic: የቍጣህን ፈሳሽ አፍስስ፤  ትዕቢተኛውንም ሁሉ ተመልክተህ አዋርደው።

verses.text_english: Look on every one proud, bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኛውንም ሁሉ ተመልከት፥ ዝቅ ዝቅም አድርገው፤  በደለኞችንም ወዲያውኑ እርገጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Hide them in the dust together; bind their faces in secret.
verses.text_amharic: በአፈር ውስጥ በአንድነት ሰውራቸው፤  በተሸሸገም ስፍራ ፊታቸውን ሸፍን።

verses.text_english: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ቀኝ እጅህ ታድንህ ዘንድ እንድትችል  እኔ ደግሞ እመሰክርልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ ጋር የሠራሁትን ጉማሬ፥ እስኪ፥ ተመልከት፤  እንደ በሬ ሣር ይበላል።

verses.text_english: Lo now, his strength in his loins, and his force in the navel of his belly.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ብርታቱ በወገቡ ውስጥ ነው፤  ኃይሉም በሆዱ ጅማት ውስጥ ነው።

verses.text_english: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.text_amharic: ጅራቱን እንደ ጥድ ዛፍ ያወዛውዛል፤  የወርቹ ጅማት የተጐነጐነ ነው።

verses.text_english: His bones strong pieces of brass; his bones like bars of iron.
verses.text_amharic: አጥንቱ እንደ ናስ አገዳ ነው፤  አካላቱ እንደ ብረት ዘንጎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: He the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach .
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ፍጥረት አውራ ነው፤  ሠሪውም ሰይፉን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.text_amharic: የሜዳ እንስሶች ሁሉ የሚጫወቱበት ተራራ  ምግብን ያበቅልለታል።

verses.text_english: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.text_amharic: ጥላ ካለው ዛፍ በታች፥  በደንገልና በረግረግ ውስጥ ይተኛል።

verses.text_english: The shady trees cover him their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.text_amharic: ጥላ ያለው ዛፍ በጥላው ይሰውረዋል፤  የወንዝ አኻያ ዛፎች ይከብቡታል።

verses.text_english: Behold, he drinketh up a river, hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ወንዙ ቢጐርፍ አይደነግጥም፤  ዮርዳኖስም እስከ አፉ ድረስ ቢፈስስ እርሱ ይተማመናል።

verses.text_english: He taketh it with his eyes: nose pierceth through snares.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቹ እያዩ ይያዛልን?  አፍንጫውስ በወጥመድ ይበሳልን?

verses.text_english: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord thou lettest down?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ተስፋው ከንቱ ነው፤  ያየው ሁሉ ስንኳ በፊቱ ይዋረዳል።

verses.text_english: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.text_amharic: ያንቀሳቅሰውም ዘንድ የሚደፍር የለም፤  እንግዲህ በፊቴ መቆም የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft unto thee?
verses.text_amharic: እመልስለትስ ዘንድ መጀመሪያ የሰጠኝ ማን ነው?  ከሰማይ ሁሉ በታች ያለው ገንዘቤ ነው።

verses.text_english: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አካላቱና ስለ ብርቱ ኃይሉ፥  ስለ መልካም ሰውነቱ ዝም አልልም።

verses.text_english: Wilt thou play with him as a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.text_amharic: የውጪ ልብሱን ማን ይገፋል?  በጥንድ መንጋጋውስ ውስጥ ማን ይገባል?

verses.text_english: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.text_amharic: የፊቱንስ ደጆች የሚከፍት ማን ነው?  በጥርሶቹ ዙሪያ ግርማ አለ።

verses.text_english: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.text_amharic: ቅርፊቶቹ ጠንካራ ስለ ሆኑ እርሱ ትዕቢተኛ ነው፤  በጠባብ ማተሚያ እንደ ታተሙ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸው የተቀራረቡ ናቸውና  ነፋስ በመካከላቸው መግባት አይችልም።

verses.text_english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸው የተገጣጠሙ ናቸው፤  እስከማይለያዩም ድረስ ተያይዘዋል።

verses.text_english: None fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.text_amharic: እንጥሽታው ብልጭታ ያወጣል፥  ዓይኖቹም እንደ ወገግታ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.text_amharic: ከአፉ ፋናዎች ይወጣሉ፥  የእሳትም ፍንጣሪ ይረጫል።

verses.text_english: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ፈላ ድስትና እንደሚቃጠል ሸምበቆ  ከአንፍንጫው ጢስ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: Who can discover the face of his garment? who can come with his double bridle?
verses.text_amharic: እስትንፋሱ ከሰልን ታቃጥላለች፥  ነበልባልም ከአፉ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth terrible round about.
verses.text_amharic: በአንገቱ ኃይል ታድራለች፤  ግርማ በፊቱ ይዘፍናል።

verses.text_english: scales pride, shut up together a close seal.
verses.text_amharic: የሥጋውም ቅርፊት የተጣበቀ ነው፤  እስከማይንቀሳቀሱም ድረስ በእርሱ ላይ ጸንተዋል።

verses.text_english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.text_amharic: ልቡ እንደ ድንጋይ የደነደነ ነው፤  እንደ ወፍጮ ድንጋይ የጸና ነው።

verses.text_english: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.text_amharic: በተነሣ ጊዜ ኃያላን ይፈራሉ፤  ከድንጋጤም የተነሣ ያብዳሉ።

verses.text_english: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍና ጦር፥ ፍላጻና መውጊያም ቢያገኙት አያሸንፉትም።

verses.text_english: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, sparks of fire leap out.
verses.text_amharic: ብረትን እንደ ገለባ፥  ናስንም እንደ ነቀዘ እንጨት ይቈጥራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጻ ሊያባርረው አይችልም፤  የወንጭፍም ድንጋዮች እንደ ገለባ ይሆኑለታል።

verses.text_english: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: በሎታውን እንደ ገለባ ይቈጥረዋል፤  ሰላጢኑም ሲሰበቅ ይስቃል።

verses.text_english: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.text_amharic: ታቹ እንደ ስለታም ገል ነው፤  እንደ መዳመጫም በጭቃ ላይ ያልፋል።

verses.text_english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ቀላዩን እንደ ድስት ያፈላዋል፤  ባሕሩንም እንደ ሽቱ ምንቸት ያደርገዋል።

verses.text_english: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether .
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ኋላው ብሩህ መንገድን ያበራል፤  ቀላዩም ሽበት ይመስላል።

verses.text_english: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ ፍርሃት የተፈጠረ፥  እንደ እርሱ ያለ በምድር ላይ የለም።

verses.text_english: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ያለውን ሁሉ ይመለከታል፤  በትዕቢተኞችም ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.text_english: He esteemeth iron as straw, brass as rotten wood.
The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
Sharp stones under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
He maketh a path to shine after him; would think the deep hoary.
Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
He beholdeth all high : he a king over all the children of pride.
Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም መለሰ እግዚአብሔርንም እንዲህ አለው።

verses.text_english: I know that thou canst do every , and no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን ታደርግ ዘንድ ቻይ እንደ ሆንህ፥  አሳብህም ይከለከል ዘንድ ከቶ እንደማይቻል አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Who he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ እውቀት ምክርን የሚሰውር ማን ነው?  ስለዚህ እኔ የማላስተውለውን፥  የማላውቀውንም ድንቅ ነገር ተናግሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.text_amharic: እባክህ፥ ስማኝ እኔም ልናገር፤  እጠይቅህማለሁ፥ አንተም ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
verses.text_amharic: መስማትንስ በጆሮ በመስማት ሰምቼ ነበር፤  አሁን ግን ዓይኔ አየችህ፤

verses.text_english: Wherefore I abhor , and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ራሴን እንቃለሁ፤  በአፈርና በአመድ ላይ ተቀምጬ እጸጸታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it was , that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me right, as my servant Job .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ቃል ለኢዮብ ከተናገረ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ቴማናዊውን ኤልፋዝን። እንደ ባሪያዬ እንደ ኢዮብ ቅንን ነገር ስለ እኔ አልተናገራችሁምና ቍጣዬ በአንተና በሁለቱ ባልንጀሮችህ ላይ ነድዶአል።

verses.text_english: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you folly, in that ye have not spoken of me right, like my servant Job.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ሰባት ወይፈኖችና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ይዛችሁ ወደ ባሪያዬ ወደ ኢዮብ ዘንድ ሂዱ፥ የሚቃጠልንም መሥዋዕት ስለ ራሳችሁ አሳርጉ፤ ባሪያዬም ኢዮብ ስለ እናንተ ይጸልያል፥ እኔም እንደ ስንፍናችሁ እንዳላደርግባችሁ ፊቱን እቀበላለሁ፤ እንደ ባሪያዬ እንደ ኢዮብ ቅን ነገር ስለ እኔ አልተናገራችሁምና።

verses.text_english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.
verses.text_amharic: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ ናዕማታዊውም ሶፋር ሄደው እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ እግዚአብሔርም የኢዮብን ፊት ተቀበለ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም ስለ ወዳጆቹ በጸለየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርም ምርኮውን መለሰለት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቀድሞ በነበረው ፋንታ ሁለት እጥፍ አድርጎ ለኢዮብ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹና እኅቶቹ ቀድሞም ያውቁት የነበሩት ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ በቤቱም ከእርሱ ጋር እንጀራ በሉ፤ ስለ እርሱም አዘኑለት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ካመጣበት ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አጽናኑት፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም ብርና የወርቅ ቀለበት ሰጡት።

verses.text_english: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከፊተኛው ይልቅ የኋለኛውን ለኢዮብ ባረከ፤ አሥራ አራት ሺህም በጎች፥ ስድስት ሺህም ግመሎች፥ አንድ ሺህም ጥማድ በሬዎች፥ አንድ ሺህም እንስት አህዮች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሰባት ወንዶችና ሦስት ሴቶች ልጆች ሆኑለት።

verses.text_english: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.
verses.text_amharic: የመጀመሪያይቱንም ስም ይሚማ፥ የሁለተኛይቱንም ስም ቃስያ፥ የሦስተኛይቱንም ስም አማልቶያስ ቂራስ ብሎ ሰየማቸው።

verses.text_english: And in all the land were no women found fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ኢዮብ ሴቶች ልጆችም ያሉ የተዋቡ ሴቶች በአገሩ ሁሉ አልተገኙም፤ አባታቸውም ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር ርስት ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, four generations.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮብ መቶ አርባ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ልጆቹንና የልጅ ልጆቹንም እስከ አራት ተውልድ ድረስ አየ።

verses.text_english: So Job died, old and full of days.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮብም ሸምግሎ ዕድሜም ጠግቦ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.text_amharic: ምስጉን ነው በክፉዎች ምክር ያልሄደ፥ በኃጢአተኞችም መንገድ ያልቆመ፥ በዋዘኞችም ወንበር ያልተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: But his delight in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ደስ ይለዋል፥ ሕጉንም በቀንና በሌሊት ያስባል።

verses.text_english: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በውኃ ፈሳሾች ዳር እንደ ተተከለች፥ ፍሬዋን በየጊዜዋ እንደምትሰጥ፥ ቅጠልዋም እንደማይረግፍ ዛፍ ይሆናል፤ የሚሠራውም ሁሉ ይከናወንለታል።

verses.text_english: The ungodly not so: but like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉዎች እንዲህ አይደሉም፥ ነገር ግን ነፋስ ጠርጎ እንደሚወስደው ትቢያ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ክፉዎች በፍርድ፥ ኃጢአተኞችም በጻድቃን ማኅበር አይቆሙም።

verses.text_english: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የጻድቃንን መንገድ ያውቃልና፥ የክፉዎች መንገድ ግን ትጠፋለች።

verses.text_english: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ለምን ያጕረመርማሉ? ወገኖችስ ለምን ከንቱን ይናገራሉ?

verses.text_english: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, ,
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ነገሥታት ተነሡ፥ አለቆችም በእግዚአብሔርና በመሢሑ ላይ እንዲህ ሲሉ ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.text_amharic: ማሰርያቸውን እንበጥስ፥ ገመዳቸውንም ከእኛ እንጣል።

verses.text_english: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይ የሚኖር እርሱ ይሥቃል፥ ጌታም ይሣለቅባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በቍጣው ይናገራቸዋል፥ በመዓቱም ያውካቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ንጉሤን ሾምሁ በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ በጽዮን ላይ።

verses.text_english: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዙን እናገራለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር አለኝ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወለድሁህ።

verses.text_english: Ask of me, and I shall give the heathen thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth thy possession.
verses.text_amharic: ለምነኝ፥ አሕዛብን ለርስትህ የምድርንም ዳርቻ ለግዛትህ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.text_amharic: በብረት በትር ትጠብቃቸዋለህ፥ እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ዕቃዎች ትቀጠቅጣቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እናንት ነገሥታት፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤ እናንት የምድር ፈራጆችም፥ ተገሠጹ።

verses.text_english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር በፍርሃት ተገዙ፥ በረዓድም ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed all they that put their trust in him.
verses.text_amharic: ተግሣጹን ተቀበሉ ጌታ እንዳይቈጣ እናንተም በመንገድ እንዳትጠፉ፥ ቍጣው ፈጥና ትነድዳለችና። በእርሱ የታመኑ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.] LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many they that rise up against me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሚያስጨንቁኝ ምንኛ በዙ! በኔ ላይ የሚቆሙት ብዙ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Many which say of my soul, no help for him in God. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች ነፍሴን። አምላክሽ አያድንሽም አልዋት።

verses.text_english: But thou, O LORD, a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥ ክብሬንና ራሴንም ከፍ ከፍ የምታደርገው አንተ ነህ።

verses.text_english: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጮሃለሁ ከተቀደሰ ተራራውም ይሰማኛል።

verses.text_english: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ተኛሁ አንቀላፋሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደግፎኛልና ነቃሁ።

verses.text_english: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set against me round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚከብቡኝ ከአእላፍ ሕዝብ አልፈራም።

verses.text_english: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥ፥ አቤቱ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ፤ አንተ የጠላቶቼን መንጋጋ መትተሃልና፥ የክፉዎችንም ጥርስ ሰብረሃልና።

verses.text_english: Salvation unto the LORD: thy blessing upon thy people. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ማዳን የእግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በረከትህም በሕዝብህ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.] Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቄ አምላክ በጠራሁት ጊዜ መለሰልኝ፥ በጭንቀቴም አሰፋህልኝ፤ ማረኝ፥ ጸሎቴንም ስማ።

verses.text_english: O ye sons of men, how long my glory into shame? will ye love vanity, seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እናንት የሰው ልጆች፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ልባችሁን ታከብዳላችሁ?

verses.text_english: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በጻድቁ እንደ ተገለጠ እወቁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ወደ እርሱ በተጣራሁ ጊዜ ይሰማኛል።

verses.text_english: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ተቈጡ፥ ነገር ግን ኃጢአትን አታድርጉ፤ በመኝታችሁ ሳላችሁ በልባችሁ አስቡ፤ ዝም በሉ።

verses.text_english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቅን መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ታመኑ።

verses.text_english: many that say, Who will shew us good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.text_amharic: በጎውን ማን ያሳየናል? የሚሉ ብዙ ናቸው። አቤቱ፥ የፊትህ ብርሃን በላያችን ታወቀ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time their corn and their wine increased.
verses.text_amharic: በልቤ ደስታን ጨመርህ፤ ከስንዴ ፍሬና ከወይን ከዘይትም ይልቅ በዛ።

verses.text_english: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.text_amharic: በሰላም እተኛለሁ አንቀላፋለሁም፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብቻህን በእምነት አሳድረኸኛልና።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.] Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ቃሌን አድምጥ፥ ጩኸቴንም አስተውል፤

verses.text_english: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.text_amharic: የልመናዬን ቃል አድምጥ፥ ንጉሤና አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ እጸልያለሁና።

verses.text_english: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct unto thee, and will look up.
verses.text_amharic: በማለዳ ድምፄን ትሰማለህ፥ በማለዳ በፊትህ እቆማለሁ፥ እጠብቃለሁም።

verses.text_english: For thou not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በደልን የማትወድድ አምላክ ነህና፤ ክፉ ከአንተ ጋር አያድርም።

verses.text_english: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ የሚመኩ በዓይኖችህ ፊት አይኖሩም፤ ክፉ አድራጊዎችን ሁሉ ጠላህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰትን የሚናገሩትን ታጠፋቸዋለህ፤ ደም አፍሳሹንና ሸንጋዩን ሰው እግዚአብሔር ይጸየፋል።

verses.text_english: But as for me, I will come thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በምሕረትህ ብዛት ወደ ቤትህ እገባለሁ፤ አንተን በመፍራት ወደ ቅድስናህ መቅደስ እሰግዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ጠላቶቼ በጽድቅህ ምራኝ፤ መንገዴን በፊትህ አቅና።

verses.text_english: For no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part very wickedness; their throat an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.text_amharic: በአፋቸው እውነት የለምና፥ ልባቸውም ከንቱ ነው፤ ጕሮሮአቸው የተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፤ በምላሳቸው ይሸነግላሉ።

verses.text_english: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍረድባቸው፥ በምክራቸውም ይውደቁ፤ ስለ ክፋታቸውም ብዛት አሳድዳቸው፥ እነርሱ ዐምፀውብሃልና።

verses.text_english: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ የሚታመኑት ሁሉ ግን ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ለዘላለሙ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ እነርሱንም ትጠብቃለህ፤ ስምህንም የሚወድዱ ሁሉ በአንተ ይመካሉ።

verses.text_english: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as a shield.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ጻድቁን ትባርከዋለህና፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ጋሻ በሞገስ ከለልኸን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.] O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥ በመዓትህም አትገሥጸኝ።

verses.text_english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.text_amharic: ድውይ ነኝና አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ፤ አጥንቶቼ ታውከዋልና ፈውሰኝ።

verses.text_english: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴም እጅግ ታወከች፤ አንተም አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?

verses.text_english: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ ነፍሴንም አድናት፥ ስለ ቸርነትህም አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: For in death no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.text_amharic: በሞት የሚያስብህ የለምና፥ በሲኦልም የሚያመሰግንህ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.text_amharic: በጭንቀቴ ደክሜያለሁ፤ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አልጋዬን አጥባለሁ፥ በዕንባዬም መኝታዬን አርሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔ ከቍጡ ዕንባ የተነሣ ታወከች፤ ከጠላቶቼ ሁሉ የተነሣ አረጀሁ።

verses.text_english: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃን የምታደርጉ ሁሉ፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥ እግዚአብሔር የልቅሶዬን ቃል ሰምቶአልና።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ልመናዬን ሰማኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ጸሎቴን ተቀበለ።

verses.text_english: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return be ashamed suddenly.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይፈሩ እጅግም ይጐስቍሉ፤ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ፥ በፍጥነትም ይፈሩ።

verses.text_english: [Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.] O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ በአንተ ታመንሁ፤ ከሚያሳድዱኝ ሁሉ አድነኝና አውጣኝ፥

verses.text_english: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending in pieces, while none to deliver.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን እንደ አንበሳ ነጥቀው እንዳይሰብሩዋት፥ የሚያድንና የሚታደግ ሳይኖር።

verses.text_english: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እንዲህስ ካደረግሁ፥ ዓመፃም በእጄ ቢኖር፥

verses.text_english: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ላደረጉብኝም ክፉን መልሼላቸው ብሆን፥ ጠላቴንም በከንቱ ገፍቼው ብሆን፥

verses.text_english: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take ; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላት ነፍሴን ያሳድዳት ያግኛትም፥ ሕይወቴንም በምድር ላይ ይርገጣት፥ ክብሬንም በትቢያ ላይ ያዋርዳት።

verses.text_english: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me the judgment thou hast commanded.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በመዓትህ ተነሥ፥ በጠላቶቼ ላይ በቍጣ ተነሣባቸው፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ባዘዝኸው ትእዛዝ ንቃ።

verses.text_english: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብም ጉባኤ ይከብብሃል፥ በእነርሱም ላይ ወደ ከፍታ ተመለስ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity in me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ይፈርዳል፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ጽድቄ ፍረድልኝ፥ እንደ የዋህነቴም ይሁንልኝ።

verses.text_english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጥኣን ክፋት ይጥፋ፥ ጻድቁን ግን አቅና፤ እግዚአብሔር ልቡናንና ኵላሊትን ይመረምራል።

verses.text_english: My defence of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የጽድቅ ጋሻዬ ነው ልበ ቅኖችን የሚያድናቸው።

verses.text_english: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry every day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የእውነት ዳኛ ነው፥ ኃይለኛም ታጋሽም ነው፥ ሁልጊዜም አይቈጣም።

verses.text_english: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.text_amharic: ባትመለሱ ግን ሰይፉን ይስላል፥ ቀስቱን ገተረ አዘጋጀም፤

verses.text_english: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.text_amharic: የሞት መሣርያንም አዘጋጀበት፥ ፍላጻዎቹንም የሚቃጠሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዓመፃ ተጨነቀ ጉዳትን ፀነሰ ኃጢአትንም ወለደ።

verses.text_english: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch he made.
verses.text_amharic: ጕድጓድን ማሰ ቈፈረም። ባደረገውም ጕድጓድ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.text_amharic: ጉዳቱ በራሱ ይመለሳል፥ ዓመፃውም በአናቱ ላይ ትወርዳለች።

verses.text_english: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ጽድቁ መጠን አመሰግናለሁ፥ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔርም ስም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.] O LORD our Lord, how excellent thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ ጌታችን፥ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ተመሰገነ፥ ምስጋናህ በሰማዮች ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡ ልጆች አፍ ምስጋናን አዘጋጀህ ስለ ጠላትህ፥ ጠላትንና ቂመኛን ለማጥፋት።

verses.text_english: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.text_amharic: የጣቶችህን ሥራ ሰማዮችን ባየሁ ጊዜ፥ ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን አንተ የሠራሃቸውን፥

verses.text_english: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.text_amharic: ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ትጐበኘውም ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.text_amharic: ከመላእክት እጅግ ጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ በክብርና በምስጋና ዘውድ ከለልኸው።

verses.text_english: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all under his feet:
verses.text_amharic: በእጆችህም ሥራ ሁሉ ላይ ሾምኸው፤ ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት፥

verses.text_english: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.text_amharic: በጎችንም ላሞችንም ሁሉ ደግሞም የምድረ በዳውን እንስሶች፥

verses.text_english: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይንም ወፎች የባሕርንም ዓሦች፥ በባሕር መንገድ የሚሄደውንም ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: O LORD our Lord, how excellent thy name in all the earth!
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ ጌታችን፥ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ተመሰገነ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.] I will praise , O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሐሤትንም አደርጋለሁ፤ ልዑል ሆይ፥ ለስምህ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ ወደ ኋላ በተመለሱ ጊዜ፥ ይሰናከላሉ ከፊትህም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዴንና በቀሌን አድርገህልኛልና፤ ጽድቅን እየፈረድህ በዙፋንህ ላይ ተቀመጥህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብን ገሠጽህ፥ ዝንጉዎችንም አጠፋህ፥ ስማቸውንም ለዘላለም ደመሰስህ።

verses.text_english: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶች በጦር ለዘላለም ጠፉ፥ ከተሞቻቸውንም አፈረስህ፥ ዝክራቸውም በአንድነት ጠፋ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል፥ ዙፋኑንም ለመፍረድ አዘጋጀ፤

verses.text_english: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ዓለምን በጽድቅ ይፈርዳታል፥ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይዳኛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ለድሆች መጠጊያ ሆናቸው፥ እርሱም በመከራቸው ጊዜ ረዳታቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህን የሚያውቁ ሁሉ በአንተ ይታመናሉ፥ አቤቱ፥ የሚሹህን አትተዋቸውምና።

verses.text_english: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን ለሚኖር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል አደራረጉን ንገሩ፤

verses.text_english: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.text_amharic: ደማቸውን የሚመራመር እርሱ አስቦአልና፥ የድሆችንም ጩኸት አልረሳምና።

verses.text_english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እዘንልኝ፥ ጠላቶቼም የሚያመጡብኝን መከራ እይ፥ ከሞት ደጆች ከፍ ከፍ የምታደርገኝ፤

verses.text_english: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ምስጋናውን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ፤ በጽዮን ልጅ በደጆችዋ በማዳንህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.text_english: The heathen are sunk down in the pit they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ በሠሩት ጕድጓድ ወደቁ፥ በዚያችም በሸሸጓት ወጥመድ እግራቸው ተጠመደች።

verses.text_english: The LORD is known the judgment he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን በማድረግ የታወቀ ነው፤ ኃጢአተኛው በእጆቹ ሥራ ተጠመደ።

verses.text_english: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች ወደ ሲኦል ይመለሳሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚረሱ አሕዛብም ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall perish for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀ ለዘላለም አይረሳምና፥ የችግረኞችም ተስፋቸው ለዘላለም አይጠፋም።

verses.text_english: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፤ ሰውም አይበርታ፥ አሕዛብም በፊትህ ይፈረድባቸው።

verses.text_english: Put them in fear, O LORD: the nations may know themselves men. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍርሃትን በላያቸው ጫንባቸው፤ አሕዛብ ሰዎች እንደ ሆኑ ይወቁ።

verses.text_english: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? hidest thou in times of trouble?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ለምን ርቀህ ቆምህ? በመከራም ጊዜ ለምን ትሰወራለህ?

verses.text_english: The wicked in pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.text_amharic: በኃጢአተኛ ትዕቢት ድሀ ይናደዳል፤ ባሰቡት ተንኰላቸው ተጠመዱ።

verses.text_english: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, the LORD abhorreth.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ በነፍሱ ፈቃድ ይወደሳልና፥ ዓመፀኛም ይባርካል።

verses.text_english: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek : God not in all his thoughts.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ እግዚአብሔርን አበሳጨው፥ እንደ ቍጣውም ብዛት አይመራመረውም በእርሱ ፊት እግዚአብሔር የለም።

verses.text_english: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments far above out of his sight: all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዱ ሁሉ የረከሰ ነው፥ ፍርድህም በፊቱ የፈረሰ ነው፥ ጠላቶችንም ሁሉ ይገዛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for never in adversity.
verses.text_amharic: በልቡ ይላል። ለልጅ ልጅ አልታወክም ክፉም አያገኘኝም።

verses.text_english: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue mischief and vanity.
verses.text_amharic: አፉ መርገምንና ሽንገላን ተንኰልን የተመላ ነው፤ ከምላሱ በታች ጉዳትና መከራ ነው።

verses.text_english: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.text_amharic: በመንደሮች መሸመቅያ ይቀመጣል ንጹሓንን በስውር ይገድል ዘንድ፤ ዓይኖቹም ወደ ድኃ ይመለከታሉ።

verses.text_english: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አንበሳ በችፍግ ዱር በስውር ይሸምቃል፤ ድሀውን ለመንጠቅ ያደባል፤ ድሀውን ይነጥቀዋል በአሽክላውም ይስበዋል።

verses.text_english: He croucheth, humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀ ይዋረዳል፥ ይጐብጣል፤ በኃያላኑም እጅግ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see .
verses.text_amharic: በልቡም ይላል። እግዚአብሔር ረስቶኛል፤ ፈጽሞም እንዳያይ ፊቱን ሰወረ።

verses.text_english: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ እጅህም ከፍ ከፍ ትበል፤ ድሆችን አትርሳ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require .
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ ስለ ምን እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣው? በልቡ። አይመራመረኝም ይላልና።

verses.text_english: Thou hast seen ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.text_amharic: አየኸው፥ አንተ ክፋትንና ቍጣን ትመለከታለህና በእጅህ ፍዳውን ለመስጠት፤ ድሀ ራሱን ለአንተ ይተዋል፥ ለድሀ አደግም ረዳቱ አንተ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil : seek out his wickedness thou find none.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአተኛንና የክፉን ክንድ ስበር፥ የኃጢአቱንም ብድራት ክፈል ሌላ እስከማይገኝ ድረስ።

verses.text_english: The LORD King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይነግሣል፤ አሕዛብ ከምድሩ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የድሆችን ምኞት ሰማ፥ ጆሮውም የልባቸውን አሳብ አደመጠች፥

verses.text_english: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዱ ለድሀ አደግና ለችግረኛ ይደረግ ዘንድ፥ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ አፋቸውን ከፍ ከፍ ማድረግ እንዳይደግሙ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, of David.] In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee a bird to your mountain?
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፤ ነፍሴን። እንደ ወፍ ወደ ተራሮች ተቅበዝበዢ እንዴት ትሉአታላችሁ?

verses.text_english: For, lo, the wicked bend bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች እነሆ ቀስታቸውን ገትረዋልና፥ ፍላጻቸውንም በአውታር አዘጋጅተዋልና፥ ልበ ቅኖችን በስውር ይነድፉ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የሠራኸውን እነሆ እነርሱ አፍርሰዋልና፤ ጻድቅ ግን ምን አደረገ?

verses.text_english: The LORD in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው መቅደሱ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር፥ ዙፋኑ በሰማይ ነው፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ ድሃ ይመለከታሉ፥ ቅንድቦቹም የሰው ልጆችን ይመረምራሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅንና ኅጥእን ይመረምራል፤ ዓመፃን የወደዳት ግን ነፍሱን ጠልቶአል።

verses.text_english: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: the portion of their cup.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥመድ በኅጥኣን ላይ ያዘንባል እሳትና ዲን ዐውሎ ነፋስም የጽዋቸው እድል ፈንታ ነው።

verses.text_english: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነውና፥ ጽድቅንም ይወድዳል፤ ቅንነት ግን ፊቱን ታየዋለች።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.] Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አድነኝ፤ ደግ ሰው አልቆአልና፥ ከሰው ልጆችም መተማመን ጐድሎአልና።

verses.text_english: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: flattering lips with a double heart do they speak.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸው ከንቱ ነገርን ይናገራሉ፤ በሽንገላ ከንፈር ሁለት ልብ ሆነው ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.text_amharic: የሽንገላን ከንፈሮች ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋቸዋል፥ ታላቅ ነገርን የምትናገረውን ምላስ፤

verses.text_english: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips our own: who lord over us?
verses.text_amharic: ምላሳችንን እናበረታለን፤ ከንፈራችን የእኛ ነው፥ ጌታችን ማን ነው? የሚሉትን።

verses.text_english: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set in safety puffeth at him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ድሆች መከራ፥ ስለ ችግረኞች ጩኸት እግዚአብሔር። አሁን እነሣለሁ ይላል፤ መድኃኒትን አደርጋለሁ፥ በላዩም እገልጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: The words of the LORD pure words: silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ እንደ ተፈተነ ሰባት ጊዜ እንደ ተጣራ ብር። የእግዚአብሔር ቃላት የነጹ ቃላት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጠብቀን፥ ከዚህችም ትውልድ ለዘላለም ታደገን።

verses.text_english: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ልጆች ዘንድ ምናምንቴ ከፍ ከፍ ባለ ጊዜ ክፉዎች በዙሪያው ሁሉ ይመላለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ፈጽመህ ትረሳኛለህ? እስከ መቼስ ፊትህን ከእኔ ትሰውራለህ?

verses.text_english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መቼ በነፍሴ እመካከራለሁ? ትካዜስ እስከ መቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሆናል? እስከ መቼ ጠላቴ በላዬ ይጓደዳል?

verses.text_english: Consider hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the death;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እየኝ ስማኝም፤ ጠላቴ። አሸነፍሁት እንዳይል፥

verses.text_english: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስጨንቁኝም እኔ ብናወጥ ደስ እንዳይላቸው፥ ለሞትም እንዳልተኛ ዓይኖቼን አብራ።

verses.text_english: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በቸርነትህ ታመንሁ፥ ልቤም በመድኃኒትህ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.text_amharic: የረዳኝን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፥ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔር ስምም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, of David.] The fool hath said in his heart, no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, none that doeth good.
verses.text_amharic: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.text_english: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, seek God.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስተውል እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ እንዳለ ያይ ዘንድ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ የሰው ልጆችን ተመለከተ።

verses.text_english: They are all gone aside, they are together become filthy: none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ዐመፁ በአንድነትም ረከሱ በጎ ነገርን የሚሠራ የለም፤ አንድም ስንኳ የለም።

verses.text_english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጕሮሮአቸው የተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ በምላሳቸው ሸነገሉ፤

verses.text_english: There were they in great fear: for God in the generation of the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ከከንፈራቸው በታች የእባብ መርዝ አለ፤ አፋቸው መርገምንና መራራን ተሞልቶአል፤

verses.text_english: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD his refuge.
verses.text_amharic: ደምን ለማፍሰስ እግራቸው ፈጣን ነው፤ ጥፋትና ጕስቍልና በመንገዳቸው አለ፥ የሰላምን መንገድ አላወቁአትምና፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በዓይናቸው ፊት የለም።

verses.text_english: Oh that the salvation of Israel out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, Israel shall be glad.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤን እንደ እንጀራ የሚበሉ ኃጢአት የሚሠሩ ሁሉ በውኑ አያውቁምን? እግዚአብሔርንም አይጠሩትም።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በድንኳንህ ውስጥ ማን ያድራል? በተቀደሰውም ተራራህ ማን ይኖራል?

verses.text_english: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.text_amharic: በቅንነት የሚሄድ፥ ጽድቅንም የሚያደርግ፥ በልቡም እውነትን የሚናገር።

verses.text_english: backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: በአንደበቱ የማይሸነግል፥ በባልንጀራው ላይ ክፋትን የማያደርግ፥ ዘመዶቹንም የማይሰድብ።

verses.text_english: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. sweareth to hurt, and changeth not.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ በፊቱ የተናቀ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈሩትን የሚያከብር፥ ለባልንጀራው የሚምል የማይከዳም።

verses.text_english: putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these shall never be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ገንዘቡን በአራጣ የማያበድር፥ በንጹሑ ላይ መማለጃን የማይቀበል። እንዲህ የሚያደርግ ለዘላለም አይታወክም።

verses.text_english: [Michtam of David.] Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና ጠብቀኝ።

verses.text_english: , thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou my Lord: my goodness not to thee;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ ጌታዬ ነህ አልሁ፤ ከአንተ በቀር በጎነት የለኝም።

verses.text_english: to the saints that in the earth, and the excellent, in whom all my delight.
verses.text_amharic: ፈቃድህ ሁሉ በምድር ባሉት ቅዱሳንና ክቡራን ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied hasten another : their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሌላ ለሚፋጠኑት መከራቸው ይበዛል፤ የቍርባናቸውን ደም እኔ አላፈስሰውም፥ ስማቸውንም በከንፈሬ አልጠራም።

verses.text_english: The LORD the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የርስቴ እድል ፈንታና ጽዋዬ ነው፥ ዕጣዬንም የምታጠና አንተ ነህ።

verses.text_english: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant ; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.text_amharic: ገመድ ባማረ ስፍራ ወደቀችልኝ፥ ርስቴም ተዋበችልኝ።

verses.text_english: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.text_amharic: የመከረኝን እግዚአብሔርን እባርካለሁ፤ ደግሞም በሌሊት ኵላሊቶቼ ይገሥጹኛል።

verses.text_english: I have set the LORD always before me: because at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን በፊቴ አየዋለሁ፤ በቀኜ ነውና አልታወክም።

verses.text_english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ልቤን ደስ አለው ምላሴም ሐሴት አደረገች፤ ሥጋዬም ደግሞ በተስፋ ታድራለች፤

verses.text_english: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን በሲኦል አትተዋትምና፥ ቅዱስህንም መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትተወውም።

verses.text_english: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence fulness of joy; at thy right hand pleasures for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: የሕይወትን መንገድ አሳየኸኝ፤ ከፊትህ ጋር ደስታን አጠገብኸኝ፥ በቀኝህም የዘላለም ፍሥሐ አለ።

verses.text_english: [A Prayer of David.] Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, not out of feigned lips.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጽድቄን ስማ ጩኸቴንም አድምጥ፤ በተንኰለኛም ከንፈር ያልሆነውን ጸሎቴን አድምጥ።

verses.text_english: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዴ ከፊትህ ይውጣ፥ ዓይኖችህም በቅንነት ይዩ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited in the night; thou hast tried me, shalt find nothing; I am purposed my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤን ፈተንኸው በሌሊትም ጐበኘኸኝ፤ ፈተንኸኝ፥ ምንም አላገኘህብኝም።

verses.text_english: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept the paths of the destroyer.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውን ሥራ አፌ እንዳይናገር ፈቃዴ ነው፤ ስለ ከንፈሮችህ ቃል ጭንቅ የሆኑ መንገዶችን ጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Hold up my goings in thy paths, my footsteps slip not.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮች እንዳይናወጡ አረማመዴን በመንገድህ አጽና።

verses.text_english: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, my speech.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሰምተኸኛልና ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ቃሌንም ስማ።

verses.text_english: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust from those that rise up .
verses.text_amharic: የሚያምኑህን ከሚቃወሙ በቀኝህ የምታድናቸው፥ ቸርነትህን ድንቅ አድርገህ ግለጠው።

verses.text_english: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ዓይን ብሌን ጠብቀኝ፥ በክንፎችህ ጥላ ሰውረኝ፥

verses.text_english: From the wicked that oppress me, my deadly enemies, compass me about.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚያስጨንቁኝ ከኃጢአተኞች፥ ነፍሴንም ከሚከብቡአት ከጠላቶቼ።

verses.text_english: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.text_amharic: አንጀታቸውን በስብ ቋጠሩ፥ በአፋቸውም ትንቢትን ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እርምጃችንን ከበቡ፤ ዓይናቸውን ወደ ምድር ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Like as a lion is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ንጥቂያን እንደሚናፍቅ አንበሳ ተሸጕጦም እንደሚኖር እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል ነው።

verses.text_english: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, thy sword:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፤ ቀድመህ ወደ ታች ጣለው፤ ነፍሴን ከኃጢአተኛ በሰይፍህ አድናት።

verses.text_english: From men thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, their portion in life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid : they are full of children, and leave the rest of their to their babes.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከሰዎች፥ እድል ፈንታቸው በሕይወታቸው ከሆነች ከዚህ ዓለም ሰዎች በእጅህ አድነኝ፤ ከሰወርኸው መዝገብህ ሆዳቸውን አጠገብህ፤ ልጆቻቸው ብዙ ናቸው የተረፋቸውንም ለሕፃናቶቻቸው ያተርፋሉ።

verses.text_english: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በጽድቅ ፊትህን አያለሁ፤ ክብርህን ሳይ እጠግባለሁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, of David, the servant of the LORD, who spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said,] I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ ጕልበቴ ሆይ፥ እወድድሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The LORD my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ዓለቴ፥ አምባዬ፥ መድኃኒቴ፥ አምላኬ፥ በእርሱም የምተማመንበት ረዳቴ፥ መታመኛዬና የደኅንነቴ ቀንድ መጠጊያዬም ነው።

verses.text_english: I will call upon the LORD, to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ምስጋና የሚገባውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠራለሁ፥ ከጠላቶቼም እድናለሁ።

verses.text_english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.text_amharic: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥ የዓመፅ ፈሳሽም አስፈራኝ፤

verses.text_english: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.text_amharic: የሲኦል ጣር ከበበኝ፤ የሞት ወጥመድም ደረሰብኝ።

verses.text_english: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, into his ears.
verses.text_amharic: በጨነቀኝ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፥ ወደ አምላኬም ጮኽሁ፤ ከመቅደሱም ቃሌን ሰማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም በፊቱ ወደ ጆሮው ገባ።

verses.text_english: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ተንቀጠቀጠች ተናወጠችም፥ የተራሮችም መሠረቶች ተነቃነቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶአልና ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.text_english: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.text_amharic: ከቍጣው ጢስ ወጣ፥ ከፊቱም የሚበላ እሳት ነደደ፤ ፍምም ከእርሱ በራ።

verses.text_english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness under his feet.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማዮችን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረገ ወረደም፥ ጨለማ ከእግሩ በታች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.text_amharic: በኪሩቤልም ላይ ተቀምጦ በረረ፥ በነፋስም ክንፍ በረረ።

verses.text_english: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him dark waters thick clouds of the skies.
verses.text_amharic: መሰወሪያውን ጨለማ አደረገ፤ በዙሪያውም ድንኳኑ፤ በደመናት ውስጥ የጨለማ ውኃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱ ካለው ብርሃን የተነሣ ደመናትና በረዶ የእሳት ፍምም አለፉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail and coals of fire.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከሰማያት አንጐደጐደ፥ ልዑልም ቃሉን ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጻውን ላከ በተናቸውም፤ መብረቆችን አበዛ አወካቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከዘለፋህ ከመዓትህም መንፈስ እስትንፋስ የተነሣ፥ የውኆች ምንጮች ታዩ፥ የዓለም መሠረቶችም ተገለጡ።

verses.text_english: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.text_amharic: ከላይ ሰደደ ወሰደኝም፥ ከብዙ ውኆችም አወጣኝ።

verses.text_english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.text_amharic: ከብርቱዎች ጠላቶቼ ከሚጠሉኝም አዳነኝ፥ በርትተውብኝ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራዬ ቀን ደረሱብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ደገፋዬ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰፊ ስፍራም አወጣኝ፤ ወድዶኛልና አዳነኝ።

verses.text_english: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጽድቄ ይከፍለኛል፤ እንደ እጄ ንጽሕና ይመልስልኛል።
