verses.text_english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ጠብቄአለሁና፥ በአምላኬም አላመፅሁም።

verses.text_english: For all his judgments before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዱ ሁሉ በፊቴ ነበረና፥ ሥርዓቱንም ከፊቴ አላራቅሁም።

verses.text_english: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ዘንድ ቅን ነበርሁ፥ ከኃጢአቴም ተጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ጽድቄ እንደ እጄም ንጽሕና በዓይኖቹ ፊት መለሰልኝ።

verses.text_english: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.text_amharic: ከቸር ሰው ጋር ቸር ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከቅን ሰው ጋር ቅን ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤

verses.text_english: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.text_amharic: ከንጹሕ ጋር ንጹሕ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከጠማማም ጋር ጠማማ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ።

verses.text_english: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የተጠቃውን ሕዝብ ታድናለህና፥ የትዕቢተኞችን ዓይን ግን ታዋርዳለህ።

verses.text_english: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ መብራቴን ታበራለህና፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ጨለማዬን ያበራል።

verses.text_english: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ከጥፋት እድናለሁና በአምላኬም ቅጥሩን እዘልላለሁ።

verses.text_english: God, his way perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላኬ መንገድ ፍጹም ነው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የነጠረ ነው፥ በእርሱ ለሚታመኑት ሁሉ ጋሻ ነው።

verses.text_english: For who God save the LORD? or who a rock save our God?
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው? ከአምላካችን በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይልን የሚያስታጥቀኝ መንገዴንም የሚያቃና፥

verses.text_english: He maketh my feet like hinds' , and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቼን እንደ ብሖር እግሮች የሚያረታ በኮረብቶችም የሚያቆመኝ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቼን ሰልፍ ያስተምራል፥ በክንዴም የናስ ቀስት እገትራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.text_amharic: ለደኅንነቴም መታመኛን ሰጠኸኝ፥ ቀኝህም ትረዳኛለች፥ ትምህርትህም ለዘላለም ታጠናኛለች፥ ተግሣጽህም ታስተምረኛለች።

verses.text_english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.text_amharic: አረማመዴን በበታቼ አሰፋህ፥ እግሮቼም አልተንሸራተቱም።

verses.text_english: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼን አሳድዳቸዋለሁ እይዛቸዋለሁም፥ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ አልመለስም።

verses.text_english: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.text_amharic: አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ መቆምም አይችሉም፥ ከእግሬም በታች ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰልፍም ኃይልን ታስታጥቀኛለህ፤ በበላዬ የቆሙትን ሁሉ በበታቼ ታስገዛቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.text_amharic: የጠላቶቼን ጀርባ ሰጠኸኝ፥ የሚጠሉኝንም አጠፋሃቸው።

verses.text_english: They cried, but none to save unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.text_amharic: ጮኹ የሚረዳቸውም አልነበረም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ትቢያ በነፋስ ፊት እፈጫቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ አደባባይም ጭቃ እረግጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people I have not known shall serve me.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብ ክርክር ታድነኛለህ፥ የአሕዛብም ራስ አድርገህ ትሾመኛለህ፥ የማላውቀው ሕዝብም ይገዛልኛል።

verses.text_english: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.text_amharic: በጆሮ ሰምተው ተገዙልኝ፤ የባዕድ ልጆች ደለሉኝ።

verses.text_english: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.text_amharic: የባዕድ ልጆች አረጁ፥ በመንገዳቸውም ተሰናከሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD liveth; and blessed my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ነው፥ አምላኬም ቡሩክ ነው፥ የመድኃኒቴም አምላክ ከፍ ከፍ ይበል።

verses.text_english: God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.text_amharic: በቀሌን የሚመልስልኝ አምላክ አሕዛብን በበታቼ ያስገዛልኛል።

verses.text_english: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠላቶቼ የሚታደገኝ እርሱ ነው፤ በእኔም ላይ ከቆሙ ከፍ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ፥ ከግፈኛ ሰው ታድነኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡን መድኃኒት ታላቅ ያደርጋል፥ ቸርነቱንም ለቀባው ለዳዊትና ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ የሰማይም ጠፈር የእጁን ሥራ ያወራል።

verses.text_english: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: ቀን ለቀን ነገርን ታወጣለች፥ ሌሊትም ለሌሊት እውቀትን ትናገራለች።

verses.text_english: no speech nor language, their voice is not heard.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር የለም መናገርም የለም፥ ድምፃቸውም አይሰማም።

verses.text_english: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.text_amharic: ድምፃቸው ወደ ምድር ሁሉ፥ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Which as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም ውስጥ የፀሐይን ድንኳን አደረገ፥ እርሱም እንደ ሙሽራ ከእልፍኙ ይወጣል፤ እንደ አርበኛ በመንገዱ ለመሮጥ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: His going forth from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አወጣጡ ከሰማያት ዳርቻ ነው፥ ዙረቱም እስከ ዳርቻቸው ነው፤ ከትኩሳቱም የሚሰወር የለም።

verses.text_english: The law of the LORD perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD sure, making wise the simple.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ፍጹም ነው፤ ነፍስን ይመልሳል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ምስክር የታመነ ነው፤ ሕፃናትን ጠቢባን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: The statutes of the LORD right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሥርዓት ቅን ነው፥ ልብንም ደስ ያሰኛል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ብሩህ ነው፥ ዓይንንም ያበራል።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD true righteous altogether.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ እውነትና ቅንነት በአንድነት ነው።

verses.text_english: More to be desired than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.text_amharic: ከወርቅና ከክቡር ዕንቍ ይልቅ ይወደዳል፤ ከማርና ከማር ወለላም ይጣፍጣል።

verses.text_english: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: in keeping of them great reward.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ ደግሞ ይጠብቀዋል፤ በመጠበቁም እጅግ ይጠቀማል።

verses.text_english: Who can understand errors? cleanse thou me from secret .
verses.text_amharic: ስሕተትን ማን ያስተውላታል? ከተሰወረ ኃጢአት አንጻኝ።

verses.text_english: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous ; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.text_amharic: የድፍረት ኃጢአት እንዳይገዛኝ ባሪያህን ጠብቅ፤ የዚያን ጊዜ ፍጹም እሆናለሁ፥ ከታላቁም ኃጢአት እነጻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ረድኤቴ መድኃኒቴም፥ የአፌ ቃልና የልቤ አሳብ በፊትህ ያማረ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.text_amharic: በመከራ ቀን እግዚአብሔር ይስማህ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ስም ያቁምህ።

verses.text_english: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.text_amharic: ከመቅደሱ ረድኤትን ይላክልህ፥ ከጽዮንም ያጥናህ።

verses.text_english: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባንህን ሁሉ ያስብልህ፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትህን ያለምልምልህ።

verses.text_english: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ልብህ ይስጥህ ፈቃድህንም ሁሉ ይፈጽምልህ።

verses.text_english: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.text_amharic: በማዳንህ ደስ ይለናል፤ በአምላካችን ስም ከፍ ከፍ እንላለን፤ ልመናህን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ይፈጽምልህ።

verses.text_english: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን እንዳዳነው ዛሬ አወቅሁ፤ ከሰማይ መቅደሱ ይመልስለታል፤ በቀኙ ብርታት ማዳን።

verses.text_english: Some in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያ በሰረገላ እነዚያም በፈረስ ይታመናሉ፤ እኛ ግን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ከፍ ከፍ እንላለን።

verses.text_english: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ተሰነካክለው ወደቁ፤ እኛ ግን ተነሣን፥ ጸንተንም ቆምን።

verses.text_english: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ንጉሥን አድነው፥ በጠራንህም ቀን ስማን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ንጉሥ ደስ ይለዋል፤ በማዳንህ እጅግ ሐሤትን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የልቡን ፈቃድ ሰጠኽው፥ የከንፈሩንም ልመና አልከለከልኸውም።

verses.text_english: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.text_amharic: በበጎ በረከት ደርሰህለታልና፤ ከክቡር ዕንቍ የሆነ ዘውድን በራሱ ላይ አኖርህ።

verses.text_english: He asked life of thee, thou gavest him, length of days for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወትን ለመነህ ሰጠኸውም፥ ለረጅም ዘመን ለዘላለሙ።

verses.text_english: His glory great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.text_amharic: በማዳንህ ክብሩ ታላቅ ነው፤ ክብርንና ምስጋናን ጨመርህለት።

verses.text_english: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.text_amharic: የዘላለም በረከትን ሰጥተኸዋልና። በፊትህም ደስታ ደስ ታሰኘዋለህ።

verses.text_english: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ተማምኖአልና፥ በልዑልም ምሕረት አይናወጥም።

verses.text_english: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.text_amharic: እጅህ ጠላቶችህን ሁሉ ታግኛቸው፥ ቀኝህም የሚጠሉህን ሁሉ ታግኛቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.text_amharic: በተቈጣህም ጊዜ እንደ እሳት እቶን አድርጋቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው ያጠፋቸዋል፥ እሳትም ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬአቸውን ከምድር ዘራቸውንም ከሰው ልጆች ታጠፋለህ።

verses.text_english: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, they are not able .
verses.text_amharic: ክፋትን በአንተ ላይ ዘርግተዋልና፥ የማይቻላቸውንም ምክር አሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, thou shalt make ready upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኋላቸው ትመልሳቸዋለህ፤ ፍላጻን በፊታቸው ላይ ታዘጋጃለህ።

verses.text_english: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ጽናትህንም እናመሰግናለን እንዘምርማለን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.] My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? far from helping me, the words of my roaring?
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ለምን ተውኸኝ? እኔን ከማዳንና ከጩኸቴ ቃል ሩቅ ነህ።

verses.text_english: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ፥ በቀን ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፥ አልመለስህልኝም፤ በሌሊትም እንኳ ዕረፍት የለኝም።

verses.text_english: But thou holy, that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል የተመሰገንህ አንተ ግን በቅድስና ትኖራለህ።

verses.text_english: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን አንተን ተማመኑ፥ ተማመኑ አንተም አዳንሃቸው።

verses.text_english: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንተ ጮኹ አመለጡም፥ አንተንም ተማመኑ አላፈሩም።

verses.text_english: But I a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ትል ነኝ ሰውም አይደለሁም፤ የሰው ማላገጫ በሕዝብም ዘንድ የተናቅሁ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, ,
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዩኝ ሁሉ ይላገዱብኛል፤ ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ በከንፈሮቻቸው እንዲህ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: He trusted on the LORD he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ተማመነ፥ እርሱንም ያድነው፤ ቢወድደውስ ያድነው።

verses.text_english: But thou he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope upon my mother's breasts.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ከሆድ አውጥተኸኛልና፥ በእናቴ ጡት ሳለሁም በአንተ ታመንሁ።

verses.text_english: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou my God from my mother's belly.
verses.text_amharic: ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ላይ ተጣልሁ፤ ከእናቴ ሆድ ጀምረህ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Be not far from me; for trouble near; for none to help.
verses.text_amharic: ጭንቀት ቀርባለችና የሚረዳኝም የለምና ከእኔ አትራቅ።

verses.text_english: Many bulls have compassed me: strong of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ በሬዎች ከበቡኝ፥ የሰቡትም ፍሪዳዎች ያዙኝ፤

verses.text_english: They gaped upon me their mouths, a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ነጣቂና እንደሚጮኽ አንበሳ በላዬ አፋቸውን ከፈቱ።

verses.text_english: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ውኃ ፈሰስሁ፤ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ ተለያዩ፤ ልቤ እንደ ሰም ሆነ፥ በአንጀቴም መካከል ቀለጠ።

verses.text_english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይሌ እንደ ገል ደረቀ፥ በጕሮሮዬም ምላሴ ተጣጋ፥ ወደ ሞትም አሸዋ አወረድኸኝ።

verses.text_english: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ውሾች ከብበውኛልና፤ የክፋተኞች ጉባኤም ያዘኝ፤ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን ቸነከሩኝ።

verses.text_english: I may tell all my bones: they look stare upon me.
verses.text_amharic: አጥንቶቼ ሁሉ ተቈጠሩ፤ እነርሱም አዩኝ ተመለከቱኝም።

verses.text_english: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሶቼን ለራሳቸው ተከፋፈሉ፥ በቀሚሴም ላይ ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.text_english: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤ አንተ ጕልበቴ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.text_english: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ከሰይፍ አድናት፥ ብቻነቴንም ከውሾች እጅ።

verses.text_english: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንበሳ አፍ አድነኝ፥ ብቻነቴንም አንድ ቀንድ ካላቸው።

verses.text_english: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ፥ በጉባኤም መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ፥ አመስግኑት፤ የያዕቆብ ዘር ሁላችሁ፥ አክብሩት፥ የእስራኤልም ዘር ሁላችሁ፥ ፍሩት።

verses.text_english: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.text_amharic: የችግረኛን ችግር አልናቀምና፥ ቸልም አላለምና፤ ፊቱንም ከእኔ አልሰወረምና፥ ነገር ግን ወደ እርሱ በጮኽሁ ጊዜ ሰማኝ።

verses.text_english: My praise of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ጉባኤ ምስጋናዬ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው። እርሱን በሚፈሩት ፊት ስእለቴን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ችግረኞች ይበላሉ፥ ይጠግቡማል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚሹት ያመሰግኑታል፤ ልባቸውም ለዘላለም ሕያው ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ ያስቡ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለሱ፤ የአሕዛብ ነገዶች ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.text_english: For the kingdom the LORD'S: and he the governor among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥት ለእግዚአብሔር ነውና፥ እርሱም አሕዛብን ይገዛል።

verses.text_english: All fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ደንዳኖች ሁሉ ይበላሉ ይሰግዳሉም፤ ወደ መሬት የሚወርዱት ሁሉ በፊቱ ይንበረከካሉ፤ ነፍሴም ስለ እርሱ በሕይወት ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሬ ይገዛለታል፤ የምትመጣው ትውልድ ለእግዚአብሔር ትነግረዋለች፤

verses.text_english: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done .
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቁንም ለሚወለደው ሕዝብ፥ እግዚአብሔር ያደረገውን ጽድቁን፥ ይነግራሉ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እረኛዬ ነው፥ የሚያሳጣኝም የለም።

verses.text_english: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.text_amharic: በለመለመ መስክ ያሳድረኛል፤ በዕረፍት ውኃ ዘንድ ይመራኛል።

verses.text_english: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን መለሳት፥ ስለ ስሙም በጽድቅ መንገድ መራኝ።

verses.text_english: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.text_amharic: በሞት ጥላ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ነህና ክፉን አልፈራም፤ በትርህና ምርኵዝህ እነርሱ ያጸናኑኛል።

verses.text_english: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቴ ገበታን አዘጋጀህልኝ በጠላቶቼ ፊት ለፊት ራሴን በዘይት ቀባህ፥ ጽዋዬም የተረፈ ነው።

verses.text_english: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቸርነትህና ምሕረትህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ ይከተሉኛል፥ በእግዚአሔርም ቤት ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] The earth the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያ ሰንበት የዳዊት መዝሙር።  1 ምድርና ሞላዋ ለእግዚአብሔር ናት፥ ዓለምም በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ በባሕሮች መሥርቶአታልና፥ በፈሳሾችም አጽንቶአታልና።

verses.text_english: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ ማን ይወጣል? በቅድስናውስ ስፍራ ማን ይቆማል?

verses.text_english: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቹ የነጹ፥ ልቡም ንጹሕ የሆነ፥ ነፍሱን ለከንቱ ያላነሣ፥ ለባልንጀራውም በሽንገላ ያልማለ።

verses.text_english: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በረከትን ከመድኃኒቱ አምላክም ምሕረትን ይቀበላል።

verses.text_english: This the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች ትውልድ እርሱን የምትፈልግ ናት፥ የያዕቆብን አምላክ ፊት የምትፈልግ።

verses.text_english: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text_amharic: እናንት መኳንንቶች፥ በሮችን ክፈቱ፥ የዘላለም ደጆችም ይከፈቱ፥ የክብርም ንጉሥ ይግባ።

verses.text_english: Who this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ ብርቱና ኃያል፥ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በሰልፍ ኃያል።

verses.text_english: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ መኳንንቶች፥ በሮችን ክፈቱ፥ የዘላለም ደጆችም ይከፈቱ፥ የክብርም ንጉሥ ይግባ።

verses.text_english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he the King of glory. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? የጭፍሮች አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ የክብር ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ነፍሴን አነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ አልፈር፥ ጠላቶቼ በእኔ አይሣቁብኝ።

verses.text_english: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ተስፋ የሚያደርጉ አያፍሩም፤ በከንቱ የሚገበዙ ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን አመልክተኝ፥ ፍለጋህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ ነህና በእውነትህ ምራኝ፥ አስተምረኝም፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ አንተን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they ever of old.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህንና ቸርነትህን አስብ፥ ከጥንት ጀምሮ ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የልጅነቴን ኃጢአትና መተላለፍ አታስብብኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ስለ ቸርነትህ ብዛት እንደ ምሕረትህ አስበኝ።

verses.text_english: Good and upright the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቸር ቅንም ነው፤ ስለዚህ ኃጢአተኞችን በመንገድ ይመራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.text_amharic: ገሮችን በፍርድ ይመራል፥ ለገሮችም መንገድን ያስተምራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: All the paths of the LORD mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ሁሉ ቸርነትና እውነት ነው። ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምስክሩን ለሚጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it great.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአቴ እጅግ ነውና ስለ ስምህ ይቅር በለኝ።

verses.text_english: What man he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way he shall choose.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ማን ነው? በሚመርጠው መንገድ ያስተምረዋል።

verses.text_english: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱ በመልካም ታድራለች፥ ዘሩም ምድርን ይወርሳል።

verses.text_english: The secret of the LORD with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሚፈሩት ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ቃል ኪዳኑንም ያስታውቃቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Mine eyes ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እግሮቼን ከወጥመድ ያወጣቸዋልና ዓይኖቼ ሁልጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I desolate and afflicted.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ብቻዬንና ችግረኛ ነኝና ፊትህን ወደ እኔ አድርግ ማረኝም።

verses.text_english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.text_amharic: የልቤ ችግር ብዙ ነው፤ ከጭንቀቴ አውጣኝ።

verses.text_english: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.text_amharic: ድካሜንና መከራዬን እይ፥ ኃጢአቴንም ሁሉ ይቅር በለኝ።

verses.text_english: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ እንደ በዙ እይ፥ የግፍም ጥል ጠልተውኛል።

verses.text_english: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ጠብቅና አድነኝ፤ አንተን ታምኛለሁና አልፈር።

verses.text_english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁና የውሃትና ቅንነት ይጠብቁኝ።

verses.text_english: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እስራኤልን ከመከራው ሁሉ አድነው።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; I shall not slide.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እኔ በየውሃቴ ሄጃለሁና ፍረድልኝ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አምኛለሁና አልናወጥም።

verses.text_english: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍተነኝ መርምረኝም፤ ኵላሊቴንና ልቤን ፍተን።

verses.text_english: For thy lovingkindness before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህ በዓይኔ ፊት ነውና፥ በእውነትህም ተመላለስሁ።

verses.text_english: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ ሸንጎ አልተቀመጥሁም፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር አልገባሁም።

verses.text_english: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: የክፉዎችን ማኅበር ጠላሁ፥ ከዝንጉዎችም ጋር አልቀመጥም።

verses.text_english: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እጆቼን በንጽሕና አጥባለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ መሠዊያህን እዞራለሁ፥

verses.text_english: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: የምስጋናን ድምፅ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግር ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የቤትህን ስፍራ የክብርህንም ማደሪያ ቦታ ወደድሁ።

verses.text_english: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ነፍሴን፥ ከደም ሰዎችም ጋር ሕይወቴን አታጥፋ።

verses.text_english: In whose hands mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.text_amharic: በእጃቸው ተንኰል አለባቸው፥ ቀኛቸውም መማለጃ ተሞልታለች።

verses.text_english: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በየውሃቴ ሄጃለሁ፤ አድነኝ ማረኝም።

verses.text_english: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቼ በቅንነት ቆመዋልና፤ አቤቱ፥ በማኅበር አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] The LORD my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ብርሃኔና መድኃኒቴ ነው፤ የሚያስፈራኝ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር የሕይወቴ መታመኛዋ ነው፤ የሚያስደነግጠኝ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: When the wicked, mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉዎች፥ አስጨናቂዎቼ ጠላቶቼም፥ ሥጋዬን ይበሉ ዘንድ በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ እነርሱ ተሰናከሉና ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this I confident.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊትም ቢሰፍርብኝ ልቤ አይፈራም፤ ሰልፍም ቢነሣብኝ በዚህ እተማመናለሁ።

verses.text_english: One have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አንዲት ነገር ለመንሁት እርስዋንም እሻለሁ፤ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እኖር ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኘውንም አይ ዘንድ፥ መቅደሱንም እመለከት ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራዬ ቀን በድንኳኑ ሰውሮኛልና፥ በድንኳኑም መሸሸጊያ ሸሽጎኛልና፥ በዓለት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አድርጎኛልና።

verses.text_english: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አሁን በዙሪያ ባሉ በጠላቶቼ ላይ ራሴን ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ፤ በድንኳኑም የእልልታ መሥዋዕትን ሠዋሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ እዘምርለትማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O LORD, I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ የጮኽሁትን ቃሌን ስማኝ። ማረኝና አድምጠኝ።

verses.text_english: , Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ፊቴን እሹት ባልህ ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ፊትህን እሻለሁ ልቤ አንተን አለ።

verses.text_english: Hide not thy face from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ፊትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር፥ ተቈጥተህ ከባሪያህ ፈቀቅ አትበል፤ ረዳት ሁነኝ፥ አትጣለኝም፥ የመድኃኒቴም አምላክ ሆይ፥ አትተውኝ።

verses.text_english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
verses.text_amharic: አባቴና እናቴ ትተውኛልና፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ተቀበለኝ።

verses.text_english: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን አስተምረኝ፥ ስለ ጠላቶቼም በቀና መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.text_amharic: የሐሰት ምስክሮችና ዓመፀኞች ተነሥተውብኛልና ለጠላቶቼ ፈቃድ አትስጠኝ።

verses.text_english: , unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት በሕያዋን ምድር አይ ዘንድ አምናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ፤ በርታ፥ ልብህም ይጽና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፤ ዝም ብትለኝ ወደ ጓድጓድ እንደሚወርዱት እንዳልመስል፥ አንተ አምላኬ፥ ዝም አትበለኝ።

verses.text_english: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደስህ ማደሪያ እጄን ባነሣሁ ጊዜ፥ ወደ አንተ የጮኽሁትን የልመናዬን ቃል ስማ።

verses.text_english: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief in their hearts.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጥኣንና ከክፉ አድራጊዎች ጋር ነፍሴን አትውሰዳት፤ ክፋትም በልባቸው እያለ ከባልንጀራቸው ጋር ሰላም ከሚናገሩት ጋር አትጣለኝ።

verses.text_english: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሥራቸው እንደ አካሄዳቸውም ክፉት ስጣቸው፤ እንደ እጃቸውም ሥራ ስጣቸው፤ ፍዳቸውን ወደ ራሳቸው መልስ።

verses.text_english: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሥራ ወደ እጆቹም አደራረግ አላሰቡምና ያፈርሳቸዋል እንጂ አይሠራቸውም።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.text_amharic: የልመናዬን ቃል ሰምቶኛልና እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.text_english: The LORD my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌና ጋሻዬ ነው፤ ልቤ በእርሱ ታመነ እኔም ተረዳሁ፤ ሥጋዬም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ፈቅጄም አመሰግነዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The LORD their strength, and he the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ለቀባውም የመድኃኒቱ መታመኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህን አድን፥ ርስትህንም ባርክ፤ ጠብቃቸው፥ ለዘላለሙም ከፍ ከፍ አድርጋቸው።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላክ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ። ክብርንና ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ።

verses.text_english: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.text_amharic: የስሙን ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ።

verses.text_english: The voice of the LORD upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD upon many waters.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በውኆች ላይ፥ የክብር አምላክ አንጐደጐደ፥ እግዚአብሔር በብዙ ውኆች ላይ።

verses.text_english: The voice of the LORD powerful; the voice of the LORD full of majesty.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በኃይል ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በታላቅ ክብር ነው።

verses.text_english: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብር ድምፅ ዝግባን ይሰብራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሊባኖስን ዝግባ ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.text_english: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጥጃ ሊባኖስን፥ አንድ ቀን እንዳለው አውሬ ልጅ ስርዮንን ያዘልላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ የእሳቱን ነበልባል ይቈርጣል።

verses.text_english: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ምድረ በዳውን ያናውጣል፥ እግዚአብሔር የቃዴስን ምድረ በዳ ያናውጣል።

verses.text_english: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of glory.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ዋላዎችን ያጠነክራቸዋል፥ ጫካዎቹንም ይገልጣል፤ ሁሉም በመቅደሱ። ምስጋና ይላል።

verses.text_english: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የጥፋት ውኃን ሰብስቦአል፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ንጉሥ ሆኖ ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይልን ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በሰላም ይባርካል።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm Song the dedication of the house of David.] I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተቀብለኸኛልና፥ ጠላቶቼንም ደስ አላሰኘህብኝምና ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ ምሕረትም አደረግህልኝ።

verses.text_english: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ከሲኦል አወጣሃት፥ ወደ ጕድጓድም እንዳልወርድ አዳንኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱሳን ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥ ለቅድስናውም መታሰቢያ አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: For his anger a moment; in his favour life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy in the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣው ለጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሞገሱ ግን ለሕይወት ዘመን፤ ልቅሶ ማታ ይመጣል፥ ጥዋት ግን ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በደስታዬ። ለዘላለም አልታወክም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, I was troubled.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በፈቃድህ ለሕይወቴ ኃይልን ሰጠሃት፤ ፊትህን መለስህ፥ እኔም ደነገጥሁ።

verses.text_english: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፥ ወደ አምላኬም ለመንሁ።

verses.text_english: What profit in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጥፋት ብወርድ በደሜ ምን ጥቅም አለ? አፈር ያመሰግንሃልን? እውነትህንም ይናገራልን?

verses.text_english: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሰማ ማረኝም፤ እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ሆነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.text_amharic: ክብሬ ትዘምርልህ ዘንድ ዝምም እንዳትል ልቅሶዬን ለደስታ ለወጥህልኝ፥ ማቄን ቀድደህ ደስታንም አስታጠቅኸኝ።

verses.text_english: To the end that glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ለዘላለም አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘላለም አልፈር፤ በጽድቅህም አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ፈጥነህም አድነኝ፤ ታድነኝ ዘንድ መታመኛ አምላክና የመጠጊያ ቤት ሁነኝ።

verses.text_english: For thou my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.text_amharic: አምባዬና መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና ስለ ስምህ መንገዴን አቅና ምራኝም።

verses.text_english: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou my strength.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ መታመኛዬ ነህና ከደበቁብኝ ወጥመድ አውጣኝ።

verses.text_english: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
verses.text_amharic: በእጅህ ነፍሴን እሰጣለሁ፤ የእውነት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ተቤዥተኸኛል።

verses.text_english: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከንቱ ምናምንቴነትን የጠበቁትን ጠላህ፤ እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ።

verses.text_english: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.text_amharic: መከራዬን አይተሃልና፥ ነፍሴንም ከጭንቀት አድነሃታልና በምሕረትህ ደስ ይለኛል ሐሤትም አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.text_amharic: በጠላቴ እጅ አልዘጋኸኝም፥ በሰፊም ስፍራ እግሮቼን አቆምህ።

verses.text_english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, , my soul and my belly.
verses.text_amharic: ተቸግሬአለሁና አቤቱ ምራኝ፤ ዓይኔም ከኃዘን የተነሣ ተፈጀች፥ ነፍሴም ሆዴም።

verses.text_english: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወቴ በኅዘን አልቃለችና፥ ዓመታቴም በልቅሶ ጩኸት፤ ኃይሌ በችግር ደከመ፥ አጥንቶቼም ተነዋወጡ።

verses.text_english: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.text_amharic: በጠላቶቼ ዘንድ ተነወርኹ፥ ይልቁንም በጎረቤቶቼ ዘንድ፥ ለሚያውቁኝም ፍርሃት ሆንሁ፤ በሜዳ ያዩኝም ከእኔ ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሞተ ሰው ከልብ ተረሳሁ፥ እንደ ተበላሸ ዕቃም ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: For I have heard the slander of many: fear on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.text_amharic: የብዙ ሰዎችን ስድብ ሰምቻለሁና፤ በዙሪያው ፍርሃት ነበረ፤ በላዬ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ነፍሴን ለመንጠቅ ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou my God.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን በአንተ ታመንሁ፤ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: My times in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.text_amharic: ርስቴ በእጅህ ነው፤ ከጠላቶቼ እጅና ከሚያሳድዱኝ አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.text_amharic: ፊትህን በባሪያህ ላይ አብራ፥ ስለ ምሕረትህም አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, let them be silent in the grave.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ጠርቻለሁና አልፈር፤ ክፉዎች ይፈሩ በሲኦልም ዝም ይበሉ።

verses.text_english: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: በድፍረትና በትዕቢት በመናቅም በጻድቅ ላይ የሚናገሩ የሽንገላ ከንፈሮች ድዳ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: how great thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ለሚያምኑ በሰው ልጆች ፊት ያዘጋጀሃት ለሚፈሩህም የሰወርሃት፥ ቸርነትህ እንደ ምን በዛች!

verses.text_english: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.text_amharic: በፊትህ መጋረጃ ከሰው ክርክር ትጋርዳቸዋለህ፥ በድንኳንህም ከአንደበት ክርክር ትሸፍናቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.text_amharic: በተከበበ ከተማ የሚያስደንቅ ምሕረቱን በእኔ የገለጠ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.text_english: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ ከዓይንህ ፊት ተጣልሁ፥ በድንጋጤ አልሁ፤ አንተ ግን ወደ አንተ በጮኽሁ ጊዜ የልመናዬን ቃል ሰማኸኝ።

verses.text_english: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችሁ ቅዱሳኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ውደዱት፤ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኞችን ይፈልጋል፥ ትዕቢተኞችንም ፈጽሞ ይበቀላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር የምታምኑ ሁላችሁ፥ በርቱ ልባችሁም ይጥና።

verses.text_english: [ of David, Maschil.] Blessed transgression forgiven, sin covered.
verses.text_amharic: መተላለፉ የቀረችለት ኃጢአቱም የተከደነችለት ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit no guile.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በደልን የማይቈጥርበት በመንፈሱም ሽንገላ የሌለበት ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ከመጮኼ የተነሣ ዝም ባልሁ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼ ተበላሹ፤

verses.text_english: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በቀንና በሌሊት እጅህ ከብዳብኛለችና፥ እርጥበቴም ለበጋ ትኵሳት ተለወጠ።

verses.text_english: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአቴን ለአንተ አስታወቅሁ፥ በደሌንም አልሸፈንሁም፤ ለእግዚአብሔር መተላለፌን እነግራለሁ አልሁ፤ አንተም የልቤን ኃጢአት ተውህልኝ።

verses.text_english: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ቅዱስ ሁሉ በምቹ ጊዜ ወደ አንተ ይለምናል፤ ብዙ የጥፋት ውኃም ወደ እርሱ አይቀርብም።

verses.text_english: Thou my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ለእኔ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፥ ከጣርም ትጠብቀኛለህ፤ ከከበቡኝ ታድነኝ ዘንድ ደስታዬ ነህ።

verses.text_english: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.text_amharic: አስተምርሃለሁ በምትሄድበትም መንገድ እመራሃለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼን በአንተ ላይ አጠናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Be ye not as the horse, as the mule, have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንተ እንዳይቀርቡ በልባብና በልጓም ጉንጫቸውን እንደሚለጕሙአቸው፥ ልብ እንደሌላቸው እንደ ፈረስና እንደ በቅሎ አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Many sorrows to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.text_amharic: በኃጢአተኛ ብዙ መቅሠፍት አለበት፤ በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመነውን ግን ምሕረት ይከብበዋል።

verses.text_english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all upright in heart.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ ሐሤትም አድርጉ፤  ልባችሁም የቀና ሁላችሁ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: praise is comely for the upright.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ለቅኖች ምስጋና ይገባል።

verses.text_english: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery an instrument of ten strings.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በመሰንቆ አመስግኑት፥ አሥር አውታርም ባለው በበገና ዘምሩለት።

verses.text_english: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.text_amharic: አዲስ ቅኔም ተቀኙለት፥ በእልልታም መልካም ዝማሬ ዘምሩ፤

verses.text_english: For the word of the LORD right; and all his works in truth.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ቅን ነውና ሥራውም ሁሉ በእምነት ነውና።

verses.text_english: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅንና ፍርድን ይወድዳል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት ምድርን ሞላች።

verses.text_english: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሰማዮች ጸኑ፥ ሠራዊታቸውም ሁሉ በአፉ እስትንፋስ፤

verses.text_english: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.text_amharic: የባሕርን ውኃ እንደ ረዋት የሚሰበስበው፥ ቀላዮችንም በመዝገቦች የሚያኖራቸው።

verses.text_english: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ትፍራው፥ በዓለም የሚኖሩ ሁሉም ከእርሱ የተነሣ ይደንግጡ።

verses.text_english: For he spake, and it was ; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ተናግሮአልና፥ ሆኑም፤ እርሱ አዘዘ፥ ጸኑም።

verses.text_english: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የአሕዛብን ምክር ያጠፋል፥ የአሕዛብንም አሳብ ይመልሳል።

verses.text_english: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ምክር ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል። የልቡም አሳብ ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Blessed the nation whose God the LORD; the people he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ የሚሆንለት ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው፥ እርሱ ለርስቱ የመረጠው ሕዝብ።

verses.text_english: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ተመለከተ፥ የሰውንም ልጆች ሁሉ አየ።

verses.text_english: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከማደሪያው ቦታ ሆኖ በምድር ወደሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተመለከተ፥

verses.text_english: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ብቻውን ልባቸውን የሠራ ሥራቸውንም ሁሉ የሚያስተውል።

verses.text_english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ በሠራዊቱ ብዛት አይድንም ኃያልም በኃይሉ ብዛት አያመልጥም።

verses.text_english: An horse a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver by his great strength.
verses.text_amharic: ፈረስም ከንቱ ነው፥ አያድንም፤ በኃይሉም ብዛት አያመልጥም።

verses.text_english: Behold, the eye of the LORD upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ወደሚፈሩት ናቸው፥ በምሕረቱም ወደሚታመኑ፥

verses.text_english: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሳቸውን ከሞት ያድን ዘንድ፥ በራብም ጊዜ ይመግባቸው ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he our help and our shield.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሳችን እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ ታደርገዋለች፥ ረዳታችንና መጠጊያችን እርሱ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.text_amharic: ልባችን በእርሱ ደስ ይለዋልና፥ በቅዱስ ስሙም ታምነናልና።

verses.text_english: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በላያችን ትሁን፥ በአንተ እንደ ታመንን።

verses.text_english: [ of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.] I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise continually in my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ እባርከዋለሁ፥ ምስጋናውንም ዘወትር በአፌ ነው።

verses.text_english: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear , and be glad.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ትከብራለች፥ ገሮችም ሰምተው ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ከእኔ ጋር ታላቅ አድርጉት፥ በአንድነትም ስሙን ከፍ ከፍ እናድርግ።

verses.text_english: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት መለሰልኝም፥ ከመከራዬም ሁሉ አዳነኝ።

verses.text_english: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱ ቅረቡ ያበራላችሁማል፥ ፊታችሁም አያፍርም።

verses.text_english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard , and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ችግረኛ ጮኸ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማው፥ ከመከራውም ሁሉ አዳነው።

verses.text_english: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በሚፈሩት ሰዎች ዙሪያ ይሰፍራል፥ ያድናቸውማል።

verses.text_english: O taste and see that the LORD good: blessed the man trusteth in him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቸር እንደ ሆነ ቅመሱ እዩም፤ በእርሱ የሚታመን ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for no want to them that fear him.
verses.text_amharic: የሚፈሩት አንዳችን አያጡምና ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩት።

verses.text_english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good .
verses.text_amharic: ባለጠጎች ደኸዩ፥ ተራቡም፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልጉትን ግን ከመልካም ነገር ሁሉ አይጐድሉም።

verses.text_english: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቼ ኑ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት አስተምራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: What man desireth life, loveth days, that he may see good?
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወትን የሚፈቅድ ሰው ማን ነው? በጎንም ዘመን ለማየት የሚወድድ?

verses.text_english: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.text_amharic: አንደበትህን ከክፉ ከልክል፥ ከንፈሮችህም ሽንገላን እንዳይናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ሽሽ መልካምንም አድርግ፤ ሰላምን እሻ ተከተላትም።

verses.text_english: The eyes of the LORD upon the righteous, and his ears unto their cry.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ወደ ጻድቃን ጆሮቹም ወደ ጩኸታቸው ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: The face of the LORD against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.text_amharic: መታሰቢያቸውን ከምድር ያጠፋ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉን በሚያደርጉ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን ጮኹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማቸው ከመከራቸውም ሁሉ አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: The LORD nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ልባቸው ለተሰበረ ቅርብ ነው፥ መንፈሳቸው የተሰበረውንም ያድናቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Many the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን መከራቸው ብዙ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከሁሉ ያድናቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አጥንቶቻቸውን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አይሰበርም።

verses.text_english: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞችን ክፋት ይገድላቸዋል ጻድቃንንም የሚጠሉ ይጸጸታሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎቹን ነፍስ እግዚአብሔር ይቤዣል፥ በእርሱም የሚያምኑ ሁሉ አይጸጸቱም።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Plead , O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.text_english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.text_amharic: ጥሩርና ጋሻ ያዝ፥ እኔንም ለመርዳት ተነሥ።

verses.text_english: Draw out also the spear, and stop against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I thy salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍህን ምዘዝ የሚያሳድዱኝንም መንገዳቸውን ዝጋ፤ ነፍሴን። መድኃኒትሽ እኔ ነኝ በላት።

verses.text_english: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን የሚሹ ሁሉ ይፈሩ ይጐስቈሉም፤ ክፉትን በእኔ ላይ የሚያስቡ ይፈሩ ወደ ኋላቸውም ይበሉ።

verses.text_english: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase .
verses.text_amharic: በነፋስ ፊት እንዳለ ትቢያ ይሁኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልአክ ያስጨንቃቸው።

verses.text_english: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዳቸው ዳጥና ጨለማ ይሁን፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ያሳድዳቸው።

verses.text_english: For without cause have they hid for me their net a pit, without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ወጥመዳቸውን ሸሽገውብኛልና፥ ነፍሴን በከንቱ አበሳጭተዋልና።

verses.text_english: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.text_amharic: ያላወቁት ወጥመድ ይምጣባቸው፥ የሸሸጉትም ወጥመድ ይያዛቸው፤ በዚህ ወጥመድ ውስጥ ይውደቁ።

verses.text_english: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይላታል፥ በማዳኑም ሐሴት ታደርጋለች።

verses.text_english: All my bones shall say, LORD, who like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.text_amharic: አጥንቶቼ ሁሉ እንዲህ ይሉሃል። አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው? ችግረኛን ከሚቀማው እጅ፥ ችግረኛንና ድሀውንም ከሚነጥቀው እጅ ታድነዋለህ።

verses.text_english: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge that I knew not.
verses.text_amharic: የክፋት ምስክሮች ተነሡብኝ፥ የማላውቀውንም በእኔ ላይ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: They rewarded me evil for good the spoiling of my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ በጎ ክፋትን መለሱልኝ፥ ነፍሴንም ልጆችን አሳጡአት።

verses.text_english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ እነርሱ በታመሙ ጊዜ ማቅ ለበስሁ፥ ነፍሴንም በጾም አደከምኋት፤ ጸሎቴም ወደ ብብቴ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: I behaved myself as though my friend brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth mother.
verses.text_amharic: ለወዳጄና ለወንድሜ እንደማደርግ አደረግሁ፤ ለእናቱም እንደሚያለቅስ ራሴን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: , the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew not; they did tear , and ceased not:
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ ደስም አላቸው፤ ግፈኞች በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ እኔም አላውቅሁም፤ ቀደዱኝ አልተውኝምም።

verses.text_english: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.text_amharic: ፈተኑኝ በሣቅም ዘበቱብኝ፥ ጥርሳቸውንም በእኔ ላይ አንቀጫቅጩ።

verses.text_english: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ታይልኛለህ? ነፍሴን ከክፉ ሥራቸው ብችነቴንም ከአንበሶች አድናት።

verses.text_english: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በታላቁ ጉባኤ ውስጥ እገዛልሃለሁ፥ በብዙ ሕዝብ መካከልም አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.text_amharic: በግፍ የሚጠሉኝ በላዬ ደስ አይበላቸው፥ በከንቱ የሚጣሉኝም በዓይናቸው አይጣቀሱብኝ።

verses.text_english: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against quiet in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔስ ሰላምን ይናገሩኛልና፥ በቍጣም ሽንገላን ይመክራሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen .
verses.text_amharic: አፋቸውንም በእኔ ላይ አላቀቁ፤ እሰይ እሰይ፥ ዓይናችን አየው ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አየኸው፤ ዝም አትበል፤ አቤቱ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ።

verses.text_english: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ጌታዬም፥ ወደ ፍርዴ ተነሥ፥ አቤቱ፥ ፍርዴን አድምጥ።

verses.text_english: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እንደ ጽድቅህ ፍረድልኝ፥ በላዬም ደስ አይበላቸው።

verses.text_english: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.text_amharic: በልባቸው። እሰይ እሰይ፥ ነፍሳችንን ደስ አላት አይበሉ፤ ደግሞም። ዋጥነው አይበሉ።

verses.text_english: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify against me.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራዬ ደስ የሚላቸው ይፈሩ፥ በአንድነትም ይጐስቍሉ፤ በእኔ ላይ የሚታበዩ እፍረትንና ጕስቍልናን ይልበሱ።

verses.text_english: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቄን የሚወድዱአት ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሴትንም ያድርጉ፤ የባሪያውን ሰላም የሚወድድ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ይሁን ዘወትር ይበሉ።

verses.text_english: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness of thy praise all the day long.
verses.text_amharic: ምላሴ ጽድቅህን ሁልጊዜም ምስጋናህን ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, of David the servant of the LORD.] The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ በራሱ የሚያስት ነገርን ይናገራል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃት በዓይኖቹ ፊት የለም።

verses.text_english: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.text_amharic: በአንደበቱ ሸንግሎአልና፤ ኃጢአቱ ባገኘችው ጊዜ ይጠላታል።

verses.text_english: The words of his mouth iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, to do good.
verses.text_amharic: የአፉ ቃል ግፍና ሽንገላ ነው፤ ማስተዋልን በጎ ማድረግንም ተወ።

verses.text_english: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.text_amharic: በመኝታው ጠማማነትን አሰበ፤ መልካም ባልሆነች መንገድ ቆሞአል፤ ክፋትን አይንቃትም።

verses.text_english: Thy mercy, O LORD, in the heavens; thy faithfulness unto the clouds.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ነው፥ እውነትህም ወደ ደመናት ትደርሳለች።

verses.text_english: Thy righteousness like the great mountains; thy judgments a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅህም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ተራሮች፥ ፍርድህም እጅግ ጥልቅ ናት፤ አቤቱ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳን ታድናለህ።

verses.text_english: How excellent thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን እንዴት አበዛህ! የሰው ልጆች በክንፎችህ ጥላ ይታመናሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤትህ ጠል ይጠጣሉ፥ ከተድላም ፈሳሽ ታጠጣቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: For with thee the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.text_amharic: የሕይወት ምንጭ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና፤ በብርሃንህ ብርሃንን እናያለን።

verses.text_english: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህን በሚያውቁህ ላይ፥ ጽድቅህንም ልባቸው በቀና ላይ ዘርጋ።

verses.text_english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.text_amharic: የትዕቢት እግር አይምጣብኝ፥ የኃጢአተኞችም እጅ አያውከኝ።

verses.text_english: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃን የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ከዚያ ወደቁ፤ ወድቀዋል፥ መቆምም አይችሉም።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በክፉዎች ላይ አትቅና፥ ዓመፃንም በሚያደርጉ ላይ አትቅና፤

verses.text_english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሣር ፈጥነው ይደርቃሉና፥ እንደ ለመለመ ቅጠልም ይረግፋሉና።

verses.text_english: Trust in the LORD, and do good; shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፥ መልካምንም አድርግ፥ በምድርም ተቀመጥ፥ ታምነህም ተሰማራ።

verses.text_english: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበልህ፥ የልብህንም መሻት ይሰጥሃል።

verses.text_english: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring to pass.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድህን ለእግዚአብሔር አደራ ስጥ፥ በእርሱም ታመን፥ እርሱም ያደርግልሃል።

verses.text_english: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅህን እንደ ብርሃን። ፍርድህንም እንደ ቀትር ያመጣል።

verses.text_english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዛ ተስፋም አድርገው። መንገድም በቀናችለትና ጥመትን በሚያደርግ ሰው አትቅና።

verses.text_english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.text_amharic: ከቁጣ ራቅ መዓትንም ተው፤ እንዳትበድል አትቅና።

verses.text_english: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ አድራጊዎች ይጠፋሉና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ የሚያደርጉ ግን እነርሱ ምድርን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: For yet a little while, and the wicked not : yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it not .
verses.text_amharic: ገና ጥቂት፥ ኃጢአተኛም አይኖርም፤ ትፈልገዋለህ ቦታውንም አታገኝም።

verses.text_english: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.text_amharic: ገሮች ግን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በብዙም ሰላም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለካከተዋል፥ ጥርሱንም በእርሱ ላይ ያንገጫግጫል።

verses.text_english: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይሥቅበታል፥ ቀኑ እንደሚደርስ አይቶአልና።

verses.text_english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች ሰይፋቸውን መዘዙ፥ ቀስታቸውንም ገተሩ ድሀውንና ችግረኛውን ይጥሉ ዘንድ ልበ ቅኖችንም ይወጉ ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፋቸው ወደ ልባቸው ይግባ፥ ቀስታቸውም ይሰበር።

verses.text_english: A little that a righteous man hath better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ለጻድቅ ያለው ጥቂት ከብዙ ከኃጢአተኞች ሀብት ይበልጣል።

verses.text_english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጥአን ክንድ ትሰበራለችና፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ጻድቃንን ይደግፋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የንጹሓንን መንገድ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል፥ ርስታቸውም ለዘላለም ነው፤

verses.text_english: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.text_amharic: በክፉ ዘመንም አያፍሩም በራብ ዘመንም ይጠግባሉ።

verses.text_english: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.text_amharic: ኅጥአን ግን ይጠፋሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶች በከበሩና ከፍ ከፍ ባሉ ጊዜ እንደ ጢስ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ ይበደራል አይከፍልምም፤ ጻድቅ ግን ይራራል ይሰጣልም።

verses.text_english: For blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱን የሚባርኩት ምድርን ይወርሳሉና፤ የሚረግሙት ግን ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው አካሄድ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይጸናል፥ መንገዱንም ይወድዳል።

verses.text_english: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ቢወድቅም ለድንጋፄ አይጣልም፥ እግዚአብሔር እጁን ይዞ ይደግፈዋልና።

verses.text_english: I have been young, and am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.text_amharic: ጐለመስሁ አረጀሁም፤ ጻድቅ ሲጣል፥ ዘሩም እህል ሲለምን አላየሁም።

verses.text_english: ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ይራራል ያበድርማል፥ ዘሩም በበረከት ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ሽሽ፥ መልካምንም አድርግ፤ ለዘላለምም ትኖራለህ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፍርዱን ይወድዳልና፥ ቅዱሳኑንም አይጥላቸውምና፤ ለዘላለምም ይጠብቃቸዋል ለንጹሓንም ይበቀልላቸዋል፤ የኅጥኣን ዘር ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በእርስዋም ለዘላለም ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ አፍ ጥበብን ያስተምራል፥ አንደበቱም ፍርድን ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: The law of his God in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላኩ ሕግ በልቡ ውስጥ ነው፥ በእርምጃውም አይሰናከልም።

verses.text_english: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለከተዋል፥ ሊገድለውም ይወድዳል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን በእጁ አይተወውም፥ በተፋረደውም ጊዜ አያሸንፈውም።

verses.text_english: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ደጅ ጥና፥ መንገዱንም ጠብቅ፥ ምድርንም ትወርስ ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርግሃል፤ ኃጢአተኞችም ሲጠፉ ታያለህ።

verses.text_english: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጥአን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ለምልሞ አየሁት።

verses.text_english: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.text_amharic: ብመለስ ግን አጣሁት፤ ፈለግሁት ቦታውንም አላገኘሁም።

verses.text_english: Mark the perfect , and behold the upright: for the end of man peace.
verses.text_amharic: ቅንነትን ጠብቅ፥ ጽድቅንም እይ፤ ለሰላም ሰው ቅሬታ አለውና።

verses.text_english: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: በደለኞች በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ። የኃጢአተኞች ቅሬታ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: But the salvation of the righteous of the LORD: their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን መድኃኒታቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፤ በመከራቸውም ጊዜ መጠጊያቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይረዳቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋልም፥ ከኃጢአተኞችም እጅ ያወጣቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋል፥ በእርሱ ታምነዋልና።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.] O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥ በመዓትህም አትገሥጸኝ።

verses.text_english: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጾችህ ወግተውኛልና፥ እጅህንም አክብደህብኛልና።

verses.text_english: no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.text_amharic: ከቍጣህ የተነሣ ለሥጋዬ ጤና የለውም፤ ከኃጢአቴም የተነሣ ለአጥንቶቼ ሰላም የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአቴ በራሴ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ እንደ ከባድ ሸክምም በላዬ ከብዶአልና።

verses.text_english: My wounds stink are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.text_amharic: ከስንፍናዬ የተነሣ ቍስሌ ሸተተ በሰበሰም፤

verses.text_english: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ጐሰቈልሁ ተዋረድሁም፥ ሁልጊዜም በትካዜ እመላለሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: For my loins are filled with a loathsome : and no soundness in my flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ስድብን ተሞልታለችና፥ ለሥጋዬም ጤና የላትምና።

verses.text_english: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.text_amharic: ታመምሁ፤ እጅግም ተቸገርሁ፥ ከልቤ ውዝዋዜም የተነሣ ጮኽሁ።

verses.text_english: Lord, all my desire before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፈቃዴ ሁሉ በፊትህ ነው፥ ጭንቀቴም ከአንተ አይሰወርም።

verses.text_english: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ደነገጠብኝ፥ ኃይሌም ተወችኝ፥ የዓይኖቼም ብርሃን ፈዘዘ።

verses.text_english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጆቼም ባልንጀሮቼም ከቍስሌ ገለል ብለው ቆሙ፥ ዘመዶቼም ርቀው ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: They also that seek after my life lay snares : and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴንም የሚሹአት በረቱብኝ፥ መከራዬንም የሚፈልጉ ከንቱን ተናገሩ፥ ሁልጊዜም በሽንገላ ይመክራሉ።

verses.text_english: But I, as a deaf , heard not; and as a dumb man openeth not his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እንደማይሰማ ደንቆሮ አፉንም እንደማይከፍት ዲዳ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth no reproofs.
verses.text_amharic: እንደማይሰማ ሰው በአፉም ተግሣጽ እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ አንተ ትሰማኛለህ።

verses.text_english: For I said, , lest they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify against me.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ በእኔ ላይ ደስ እንዳይላቸው ብያለሁና፥ እግሮቼም ቢሰናከሉ ራሳቸውን በእኔ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: For I ready to halt, and my sorrow continually before me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ ወደ ማንከስ ቀርቤአለሁና፥ ቍስሌም ሁልጊዜም በፊቴ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.text_amharic: በደሌን እናገራለሁና፥ ስለ ኃጢአቴም እተክዛለሁ።

verses.text_english: But mine enemies lively, they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ ሕያዋን ናቸው ይበረቱብኝማል፥ በጠማማነትም የሚጠሉኝ በዙ።

verses.text_english: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow good .
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን ስለ ተከተልሁ፥ በበጎ ፋንታ ክፉን የሚመልሱልኝ ይጠሉኛል።

verses.text_english: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አትጣለኝ፤ አምላኬ፥ ከኔ አትራቅ።

verses.text_english: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ መድኃኒቴ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.] I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.text_amharic: በአንደበቴ እንዳልስት መንገዴን እጠብቃለሁ፤ ኃጢአተኛ በፊቴ በተቃወመኝ ጊዜ በአፌ ላይ ጠባቂ አኖራለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.text_amharic: ከዝምታ የተነሣ እንደ ዲዳ ሆንሁ፥ ለበጎ እንኳ ዝም አልሁ፥ ቍስሌም ታደሰብኝ።

verses.text_english: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: spake I with my tongue,
verses.text_amharic: ልቤም በውስጤ ሞቀብኝ፤ ከማሰቤም የተነሣ እሳት ነደደ፥ በአንደበቴም ተናገርሁ።

verses.text_english: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it I may know how frail I .
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍጻሜዬን አስታውቀኝ፥ የዘመኔ ቍጥሮች ምን ያህል እንደ ሆኑ፥ እኔ ምን ያህል ወደ ኋላ እንደምቀር አውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou hast made my days an handbreadth; and mine age as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ዘመኖቼን አስረጀሃቸው፤ አካሌም በፊትህ እንደ ኢምንት ነው። ሕያው የሆነ ሰው ሁሉ በእውነት ከንቱ ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up , and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ ይታወካል እንጂ በእውነት ሰው እንደ ጣላ ይመላለሳል፤ ያከማቻል የሚሰበስብለትንም አያውቅም።

verses.text_english: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope in thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ ተስፋዬ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር አይደለምን? ትዕግሥቴም ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአቴ ሁሉ አድነኝ፥ ለሰነፎችም ስድብ አታድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst .
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ሠርተኸኛልና ዝም አልሁ አፌንም አልከፈትሁም።

verses.text_english: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: መቅሠፍትህን ከእኔ አርቅ፥ ከእጅህ ብርታት የተነሣ አልቄአለሁና።

verses.text_english: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man vanity. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በተግሣጽህ ስለ ኃጢአቱ ሰውን ዘለፍኸው፥ ነፍሱም እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ታልቃለች፤ በእውነት ሰው ሁሉ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I a stranger with thee, a sojourner, as all my fathers .
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፥ ጩኸቴንም አድምጥ፥ ልቅሶዬንም ቸል አትበለኝ፤ እኔ በምድር ላይ መጻተኛ ነኝና፥ እንደ አባቶችም እንግዳ ነኝና።

verses.text_english: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.text_amharic: ወደማልመለስበት ሳልሄድ ዐርፍ ዘንድ ተወኝ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.text_amharic: ቆይቼ እግዚአብሔር ደጅ ጠናሁት፥ እርሱም ዘንበል አለልኝ ጩኽቴንም ሰማኝ።

verses.text_english: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, established my goings.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥፋት ጕድጓድ ከረግረግም ጭቃ አወጣኝ፥ እግሮቼንም በድንጋይ ላይ አቆማቸው፥ አረማመዴንም አጸና።

verses.text_english: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, praise unto our God: many shall see , and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አዲስ ዝማሬን ለአምላካችን ምስጋና በአፌ ጨመረ፤ ብዙዎች ያያሉ ይፈሩማል፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ይታመናሉ።

verses.text_english: Blessed that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የታመነ ወደ ትዕቢተኛና ወደ ሐሰተኛ ያልተመለከተ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: Many, O LORD my God, thy wonderful works thou hast done, and thy thoughts to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: I would declare and speak , they are more than can be numbered.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ያደረግኸው ተአምራት ብዙ ነው፥ አሳብህንም ምንም የሚመስለው የለም፤ ባወራም ብናገርም ከቍጥር ሁሉ በዛ።

verses.text_english: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.text_amharic: መሥዋዕትንና ቍርባንን አልወደድህም፤ ሥጋን አዘጋጀህልኝ፤ የሚቃጠለውንና ስለ ኃጢአት የሚቀርበውን መሥዋዕት አልሻህም።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book written of me,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አልሁ። እነሆ፥ መጣሁ፤ ስለ እኔ በመጽሐፍ ራስ ተጽፎአል፤

verses.text_english: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law within my heart.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ ወደድሁ፥ ሕግህም በልቤ ውስጥ ነው።

verses.text_english: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ጉባኤ ጽድቅን አወራሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ከንፈሮቼን አልከለክልም፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጽድቄን ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትህንም በልቤ ውስጥ አልሰወርሁም፥ ማዳንህንም ተናገርሁ፤ ምሕረትህንና እውነትህን ከታላቅ ጉባኤ አልሰወርሁም።

verses.text_english: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ምሕረትህን ከእኔ አታርቅ፤ ቸርነትህና እውነትህ ዘወትር ይጠብቁኝ።

verses.text_english: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጥር የሌላት ክፋት አግኝታኛለችና፤ ኃጢአቶቼ ያዙኝ፥ ማየትም ተስኖኛል ከራሴ ጠጕር ይልቅ በዙ፥ ልቤም ተወኝ።

verses.text_english: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ታድነኝ ዘንድ ፍቀድ፤ አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.text_english: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ለማጥፋት የሚወድዱ ይፈሩ፥ በአንድነትም ይጐስቍሉ፤ በእኔ ላይ ክፋትን ሊያደርጉ የሚወድዱ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ ይጐስቍሉም።

verses.text_english: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.text_amharic: እሰይ እሰይ የሚሉኝ እፍረታቸውን ወዲያው ይከፈሉ።

verses.text_english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሚፈልጉህ ሁሉ በአንተ ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሤትም ያድርጉ፤ ሁልጊዜ ማዳንህን የሚወድዱ ዘወትር። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ይሁን ይበሉ።

verses.text_english: But I poor and needy; the Lord thinketh upon me: thou my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝ፥ ጌታ ግን ያስብልኛል፤ አንተ ረዳቴና መድኃኒቴ ነህ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አትዘግይ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Blessed he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ለችግረኛና ለምስኪን የሚያስብ ምስጉን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር በክፉ ቀን ያድነዋል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቀዋል፥ ሕያውም ያደርገዋል፥ በምድር ላይም ያስመሰግነዋል፥ በጠላቶቹም እጅ አያሳልፈውም።

verses.text_english: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በደዌው አልጋ ሳለ ይረዳዋል፤ መኝታውን ሁሉ በበሽታው ጊዜ ያነጥፍለታል።

verses.text_english: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ። አቤቱ ማረኝ፤ አንተን በድያለሁና ነፍሴን ፈውሳት አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼም በላዬ ክፋትን ይናገራሉ። መቼም ይሞታል ስሙስ መቼ ይሻራል? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: And if he come to see , he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; he goeth abroad, he telleth .
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ለማየት ቢገባ ከንቱን ይናገራል፤ ልቡ ኃጢአትን ሰበሰበለት፤ ወደ ሜዳ ይወጣል ይናገራልም።

verses.text_english: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.text_amharic: በላዬ በመተባበር ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይሾካሾኩብኛል፥ በእኔ ላይም ክፋትን ያስባሉ።

verses.text_english: An evil disease, , cleaveth fast unto him: and that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ነገር መጣበት፤ ተኝቶአል ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይነሣም ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up heel against me.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ የሰላሜ ሰው የታመንሁበት እንጀራዬን የበላ በእኔ ላይ ተረከዙን አነሣ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ እመልስላቸውም ዘንድ አስነሣኝ።

verses.text_english: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቴ እልል አይልብኝምና ስለዚህ እንደ ወደድኸኝ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ግን ስለ ቅንነቴ ተቀበልኸኝ፥ በፊትህም ለዘላለም አጸናኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአሔር ይባረክ። አሜን አሜን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.] As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
verses.text_amharic: ዋላ ወደ ውኃ ምንጭ እንደሚናፍቅ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንዲሁ ነፍሴ ወደ አንተ ትናፍቃለች።

verses.text_english: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ወደ ሕያው አምላክ ተጠማች፤ መቼ እደርሳለሁ? የአምላክንስ ፊት መቼ አያለሁ?

verses.text_english: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where thy God?
verses.text_amharic: ዘወትር። አምላክህ ወዴት ነው? ሲሉኝ እንባዬ በቀንና በሌሊት ምግብ ሆነኝ።

verses.text_english: When I remember these , I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሳስብ ነፍሴ በእኔ ውስጥ ፈሰሰች፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ምስጋና መኖሪያ ስፍራ እገባለሁና፤ በዓል የሚያደርጉ ሰዎች የደስታና ምስጋና ቃል አሰሙ።

verses.text_english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him the help of his countenance.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ? የፊቴን መድኃኒት አምላኬን አመሰግነው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኚ።

verses.text_english: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ነፍሴ በእኔ ውስጥ ታወከች፤ ስለዚህ በዮርዳኖስ ምድር በአርሞንኤምም በታናሹ ተራራ አስብሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.text_amharic: በፍዋፍዋቴህ ድምፅ ቀላይ ቀላይን ትጠራታለች፤ ማዕበልህና ሞገድህ ሁሉ በላዬ አለፈ።

verses.text_english: the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song with me, my prayer unto the God of my life.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቀን ቸርነቱን ያዝዛል፥ በሌሊትም ዝማሬው በእኔ ዘንድ ይሆናል፤ የእኔ ስእለት ለሕይወቴ አምላክ ነው።

verses.text_english: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ መጠጊያዬ ነህ፤ ለምን ረሳኸኝ? ጠላቶቼ ሲያስጨንቁኝ ለምን አዝኜ እመላለሳለሁ? እለዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where thy God?
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ ሁልጊዜ። አምላክህ ወዴት ነው? ባሉኝ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼን እየቀለጣጠሙ ሰደቡኝ።

verses.text_english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ? የፊቴን መድኃኒት አምላኬን አመሰግነው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኚ።

verses.text_english: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍረድልኝ፥ ከጽድቅ ከራቁ ሕዝብም ክርክሬን ተከራከር፤ ከሸንጋይና ከግፈኛ ሰው አድነኝ።
