verses.text_english: For thou the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ አምላኬ ኃይሌም፥ ለምን ትተውኛለህ? ጠላቶቼ ሲያስጨንቁኝ ለምን አዝኜ እመላለሳለሁ?

verses.text_english: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንህንና እውነትህን ላክ፤ እነርሱ ይምሩኝ፥ ወደ ቅድስናህ ተራራና ወደ ማደሪያህ ይውሰዱኝ።

verses.text_english: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ፥ ጕልማስነቴንም ደስ ወዳሰኛት ወደ አምላኬ እገባለሁ፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ በበገና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, the health of my countenance, and my God.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ለምን ታዝኛለሽ? ለምንስ ታውኪኛለሽ? የፊቴን መድኃኒት አምላኬን አመሰግነው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኚ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.] We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በጆሮአችን ሰማን፥ አባቶቻችንም በዘመናቸው በቀድሞ ዘመን የሠራኸውን ሥራ ነገሩን።

verses.text_english: thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.text_amharic: እጅህ አሕዛብን አጠፋች፥ እነርሱንም ተከልህ፤ አሕዛብን ሣቀይኻቸው አሳደድኻቸውም።

verses.text_english: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በሰይፋቸው ምድርን አልወረሱም ክንዳቸውም አላዳናቸው፤ ቀኝህና ክንድህ የፊትህም ብርሃን ነው እንጂ ወድደሃቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬና ንጉሤ አንተ ነህ፤ ለያዕቆብ መድኃኒትንህ እዘዝ።

verses.text_english: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ጠላቶቻችንን እንወጋቸዋለን፥ በስምህም በላያችን የቆሙትን እናዋርዳቸዋለን።

verses.text_english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.text_amharic: በቀስቴ የምታመን አይደለሁምና፥ ሰይፌም አያድነኝምና፤

verses.text_english: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ከጠላቶቻችን አዳንኸን፥ የሚጠሉንንም አሳፈርሃቸው።

verses.text_english: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር እንከብራለን፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም እናመሰግናለን።

verses.text_english: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን ጠላኸን አሳፈርኸንም፥ ከሠራዊታችንም ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.text_english: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠላቶቻችንም ፊት ወደ ኋላችን መለስኸን፥ የሚጠሉንም ተነጣጠቁን።

verses.text_english: Thou hast given us like sheep for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ በጎች ሊበሉን ሰጠኸን፥ ወደ አሕዛብም በተንኸን።

verses.text_english: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase by their price.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህን ያለ ዋጋ ሰጠህ፥ በመለወጣቸውም ትርፍ የለም።

verses.text_english: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.text_amharic: ለጎረቤቶቻችን ስድብ፥ በዙሪያችንም ላሉ መሣቂያና መዘበቻ አደረግኸን።

verses.text_english: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ምሳሌ፥ በሕዝብም ዘንድ የራስ መንቀሳቀሻ አደረግኸን።

verses.text_english: My confusion continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.text_amharic: ጕስቍልናዬ ሁልጊዜም በፊቴ ነው፥ የፊቴም እፍረት ሸፈነኝ።

verses.text_english: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚሳደብና ከሚላገድ ቃል የተነሣ፥ ከጠላትና ከቂመኛ ፊት የተነሣ ነው።

verses.text_english: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሁሉ በእኛ ላይ ደረሰ፥ አልረሳንህም፥ ኪዳንህንም አልወነጀልንም።

verses.text_english: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.text_amharic: ልባችን ወደ ኋላው አልተመለሰም፥ ፍለጋችንም ከመንገድህ ፈቀቅ አላለም፤

verses.text_english: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.text_amharic: በክፉ ስፍራ አዋርደኸናልና፥ በሞት ጥላም ሰውረኸናልና።

verses.text_english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችንን ስም ረስተንስ ቢሆን፥ እጃችንንም ወደ ሌላ አምላክ አንሥተንስ ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይህንን አይመረምርም ነበርን? እርሱ ልብ የሰወረውን ያውቃልና።

verses.text_english: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አንተ ሁልጊዜም ተገድለናል፥ እንደሚታረዱም በጎች ሆነናል።

verses.text_english: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast not off for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ንቃ፤ ለምንስ ትተኛለህ? ተነሥ፥ ለዘወትርም አትጣለን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.text_amharic: ለምንስ ፊትህን ትሰውራለህ? መከራችንንና ችግራችንንስ ለምን ትረሳለህ?

verses.text_english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሳችን በመሬት ላይ ተጐሳቍላለችና፥ ሆዳችንም ወደ ምድር ተጣብቃለችና።

verses.text_english: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥና እርዳን፥ ስለ ስምህም ተቤዠን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.] My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue the pen of a ready writer.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ መልካም ነገርን አፈለቀ፥ እኔ ሥራዬን ለንጉሥ እነግራለሁ፤ አንደበቴ እንደ ፈጣን ጸሓፊ ብርዕ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ውበትህ ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ ያምራል፤ ሞገስ በከንፈሮችህ ፈሰሰ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ባረከህ።

verses.text_english: Gird thy sword upon thigh, O mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያል ሆይ፥ በቍንጅናህና በውበትህ ሰይፍህን በወገብህ ታጠቅ።

verses.text_english: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ቅንነትና ስለ የዋህነት ስለ ጽድቅም አቅና ተከናወን ንገሥም፤ ቀኝህም በክብር ይመራሃል።

verses.text_english: Thine arrows sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; the people fall under thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያል ሆይ፥ ፍላጻዎችህ የተሳሉ ናቸው፥ እነርሱም በንጉሥ ጠላቶች ልብ ውስጥ ይገባሉ፥ አሕዛብም በበታችህ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Thy throne, O God, for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom a right sceptre.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ዙፋንህ ለዘላለም ነው፤ የመንግሥትህ በትር የቅንነት በትር ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን ወደድህ ዓመፃንም ጠላህ፤ ስለዚህ ከባልንጀሮችህ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ የደስታ ዘይትን ቀባህ።

verses.text_english: All thy garments of myrrh, and aloes, cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.text_amharic: በልብሶችህ ሁሉ ከርቤና ሽቱ ዝባድም አሉ፤ ከዝሆን ጥርሶች አዳራሽ ደስ ያሰኙሃል።

verses.text_english: Kings' daughters among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሦች ሴት ልጆች ለክብርህ ናቸው፤ በወርቅ ልብስ ተጐናጽፋና ተሸፋፍና ንግሥቲቱ በቀኝህ ትቆማለች።

verses.text_english: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስሚ እዪ ጆሮሽንም አዘንብዪ፤ ወገንሽን ያባትሽንም ቤት እርሺ፤

verses.text_english: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he thy Lord; and worship thou him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ ውበትሽን ወድዶአልና፥ እርሱ ጌታሽ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And the daughter of Tyre with a gift; the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.text_amharic: የጢሮስ ሴቶች ልጆች እጅ መንሻን ይዘው ይሰግዱለታል። የምድር ባለጠጎች አሕዛብ በፊትህ ይማለላሉ።

verses.text_english: The king's daughter all glorious within: her clothing of wrought gold.
verses.text_amharic: ለሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ልጅ ሁሉ ክብርዋ ነው፤ ልብስዋ የወርቅ መጐናጸፊያ ነው።

verses.text_english: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላዋ ደናግሉን ለንጉሥ ይወስዳሉ፥ ባልንጀሮችዋንም ወደ አንተ ያቀርባሉ፤

verses.text_english: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
verses.text_amharic: በደስታና በሐሴት ይወስዱአቸዋል፥ ወደ ንጉሥ እልፍኝም ያስገቡአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በአባቶችሽ ፋንታ ልጆች ተወለዱልሽ፥ በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ ገዥዎች አድርገሽ ትሾሚያቸዋለሽ።

verses.text_english: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለልጅ ልጅ ሁሉ ስምሽን ያሳስባሉ፤ ስለዚህ ለዓለምና ለዘላለም አሕዛብ ይገዙልሃል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.] God our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን መጠጊያችንና ኃይላችን፥ ባገኘን በታላቅ መከራም ረዳታችን ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምድር ብትነዋወጥ፥ ተራሮችም ወደ ባሕር ልብ ቢወሰዱ አንፈራም።

verses.text_english: the waters thereof roar be troubled, the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ውኆቻቸው ጮኹ ተናወጡም፥ ተራሮችም ከኃይሉ የተነሣ ተናወጡ።

verses.text_english: a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.text_amharic: የወንዝ ፈሳሾች የእግዚአብሔርን ከተማ ደስ ያሰኛሉ፤ ልዑል ማደሪያውን ቀደሰ።

verses.text_english: God in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, right early.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአሔር በመካከልዋ ነው አትናወጥም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ፈጥኖ ይረዳታል።

verses.text_english: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ተናወጡ መንግሥታትም ተመለሱ፤ እርሱ ቃሉን ሰጠ፥ ምድርም ተንቀጠቀጠች።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts with us; the God of Jacob our refuge. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ መጠጊያችን ነው።

verses.text_english: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ፥ በምድር ያደረገውንም ተኣምራት እንድታዩ ኑ።

verses.text_english: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ጦርነት ይሽራል። ቀስትን ይሰብራል፥ ጦርንም ይቈርጣል በእሳትም ጋሻን ያቃጥላል።

verses.text_english: Be still, and know that I God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ዕረፉ፥ እኔም አምላክ እንደ ሆንሁ እወቁ፤ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ፥ በምድርም ላይ ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts with us; the God of Jacob our refuge. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ መጠጊያችን ነው።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ እጆቻችሁን አጨብጭቡ፥ በደስታ ቃልም ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD most high terrible; a great King over all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ልዑል ግሩምም ነውና፥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይም ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነውና።

verses.text_english: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብን ከእኛ በታች፥ ወገኖችንም ከእግራችን በታች አስገዛልን።

verses.text_english: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ለርስቱ እኛን መረጠን፥ የወደደውን የያዕቆብን ውበት።

verses.text_english: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ በእልልታ፥ እግዚአብሔር በመለከት ድምፅ ዐረገ።

verses.text_english: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.text_amharic: ዘምሩ፥ ለአምላካችን ዘምሩ፤ ዘምሩ፥ ለንጉሣችን ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: For God the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ሁሉ ንጉሥ ነውና፤ በማስተዋል ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ላይ ነገሠ፤ እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ዙፋን ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: The princes of the people are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ኃይለኞች ለእግዚአብሔር ናቸውና የአሕዛብ አለቆች ወደ አብርሃም አምላክ ተሰበሰቡ፤ እርሱንም ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉት።

verses.text_english: [A Song Psalm for the sons of Korah.] Great the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, the mountain of his holiness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ትልቅ ነው፤ በአምላካችን ከተማ በተቀደሰ ተራራ ምስጋናው ብዙ ነው።

verses.text_english: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, mount Zion, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜን ወገን በመልካም ስፍራ የቆመ የምድር ሁሉ ደስታ የጽዮን ተራራ ነው፤ እርሱም የትልቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ነው።

verses.text_english: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአዳራሾችዋ መጠጊያ ሆኖ ይታወቃል።

verses.text_english: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ነገሥታት ተከማችተው በአንድነት መጥተዋል።

verses.text_english: They saw so they marvelled; they were troubled, hasted away.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱስ አይተው ተደነቁ፥ ደነገጡ፥ ታወኩ።

verses.text_english: Fear took hold upon them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.text_amharic: መንቀጥቀጥ እንደ ወላድ ምጥ በዚያ ያዛቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይለኛ ነፋስ የተርሴስን መርከቦች ትሰብራለህ።

verses.text_english: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሰማን እንዲሁ አየን በሠራዊት ጌታ ከተማ፥ በአምላካችን ከተማ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያጸናታል።

verses.text_english: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሕዝብህ መካከል ምሕረትህን ተቀበልን።

verses.text_english: According to thy name, O God, so thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንደ ስምህ እንዲሁም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ምስጋናህ ነው፤ ቀኝህ ጽድቅን የተሞላች ናት።

verses.text_english: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ፍርድህ የጽዮን ተራራ ደስ ይበለው፥ የአይሁድም ሴት ልጆች ሐሤት ያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዮንን ክበቡአት፥ በዙሪያዋም ተመላለሱ፥ ግንቦችዋንም ቍጠሩ፤

verses.text_english: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell to the generation following.
verses.text_amharic: በብርታትዋ ልባችሁን አኑሩ፤ አዳራሽዋን አስቡ፤ ለሚመጣው ትውልድ ትነግሩ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: For this God our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide unto death.
verses.text_amharic: ለዓለምና ለዘላለም ይህ አምላካችን ነው፥ እርሱም ለዘላለም ይመራናል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] Hear this, all people; give ear, all inhabitants of the world:
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ በዓለም የምትኖሩትም ሁላችሁ፥ አድምጡ፤

verses.text_english: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.text_amharic: ዝቅተኞችና ከፍተኞች፥ ባለጠጎችና ድሆች በአንድነት።

verses.text_english: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart of understanding.
verses.text_amharic: አፌ ጥበብን ይናገራል፥ የልቤም አሳብ ማስተዋልን።

verses.text_english: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮዬን ወደ ምሳሌ አዘነብላለሁ፥ በበገናም ምሥጢሬን እገልጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአት ተረከዜን በከበበኝ ጊዜ በክፉ ቀን ለምን እፈራለሁ?

verses.text_english: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.text_amharic: በኃይላቸው የሚታመኑ፥ በባለጠግነታቸውም ብዛት የሚመኩ፤

verses.text_english: None can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.text_amharic: ወንድም ወንድሙን አያድንም፥ ሰውም አያድንም፤ ቤዛውን ለእግዚአብሔር አይሰጥም፥

verses.text_english: (For the redemption of their soul precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
That he should still live for ever, not see corruption.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም እንዲኖር፥ ጥፋትንም እንዳያይ፤ የነፍሳቸው ለውጥ ከብሮአልና፥ ለዘላለምም ቀርቶአልና።

verses.text_english: For he seeth wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.text_amharic: ብልሃተኞች እንዲሞቱ፥ ሰነፎችችና ደንቆሮች በአንድነት እንዲጠፉ፥ ገንዘባቸውንም ለሌሎች እንዲተዉ አይቶአል።

verses.text_english: Their inward thought their houses for ever, their dwelling places to all generations; they call lands after their own names.
verses.text_amharic: በልባቸውም ቤታቸው ለዘላለም የሚኖር፥ ማደሪያቸውም ለልጆች ልጅ የሚሆን ይመስላቸዋል፤ በየአገራቸውም ስማቸው ይጠራል።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless man in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts perish.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ግን ክቡር ሆኖ ሳለ አያውቅም፤ እንደሚጠፉ እንስሶች መሰለ።

verses.text_english: This their way their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች መንገዳቸው መሰናክላቸው ናት፥ ከእነርሱም በኋላ የሚመጡ በአፋቸው እሺ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ በጎች ወደ ሲኦል የሚሄዱ ናቸው፥ እረኛቸውም ሞት ነው፤ ቅኖችንም በማለዳ ይገዙአቸዋል፥ ውበታቸውም ከመኖሪያቸው ተለይታ በሲኦል ታረጃለች።

verses.text_english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ይቀበለኛልና ነፍሴን ከሲኦል እጅ ይቤዣታል።

verses.text_english: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ባለጠግነት የቤቱም ክብር በበዛ ጊዜ አትፍራ፥

verses.text_english: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.text_amharic: በሞተ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ምንም አይወስድምና፥ ክብሩም ከእርሱ በኋላ አይወርድምና።

verses.text_english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወቱ ሳለ ነፍሱን ባርኮአልና ለሰውነቱ መልካም ብታደርግለት ያመሰግንሃል።

verses.text_english: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.text_amharic: ሆኖም ወደ አባቶቹ ትውልድ ይወርዳል፤ ለዘላለም ብርሃንን አያይም።

verses.text_english: Man in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts perish.
verses.text_amharic: አእምሮ የሌለው ክቡር ሰው እንደሚጠፋ እንስሶች መሰለ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of Asaph.] The mighty God, the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የአማልክት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተናገረ፥ ከፀሓይም መውጫ ጀምሮ እስከ መግቢያዋ ድረስ ምድርን ጠራት።

verses.text_english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
verses.text_amharic: ከክብሩ ውበት ከጽዮን እግዚአብሔር ግልጥ ሆኖ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን ይመጣል ዝምም አይልም፤ እሳት በፊት ይቃጠላል፥ በዙሪያውም ብዙ ዐውሎ አለ።

verses.text_english: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.text_amharic: በላይ ያለውን ሰማይን ምድርንም በሕዝቡ ለመፍረድ ይጠራል፤

verses.text_english: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ጋር ለመሥዋዕት ኪዳን የቆሙትን ቅዱሳኑን ሰብስቡለት።

verses.text_english: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God judge himself. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት ጽድቁን ይናገራሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር ፈራጅ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I God, thy God.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ፥ ስማኝ፥ ልንገርህ፤ እስራኤልም፥ ስማኝ፥ ልመስክርብህ፤ አምላክስ እኔ አምላክህ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, continually before me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ቍርባንህ የምዘልፍህ አይደለሁም፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትህ ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ነው።

verses.text_english: I will take no bullock out of thy house, he goats out of thy folds.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤትህ ፍሪዳን ከመንጋህም አውራ ፍየልን አልወስድም፤

verses.text_english: For every beast of the forest mine, the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.text_amharic: የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሁሉ በሺህ ተራራዎች ያሉ እንስሶችም የእኔ ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field mine.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይን አዕዋፍ ሁሉ አውቃለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳ አራዊትም በእኔ ዘንድ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ብራብም ለአንተ አልነግርህም፥ ዓለምና ሞላው የእኔ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.text_amharic: የፍሪዳውን ሥጋ እበላለሁን? የፍየሉንስ ደም እጠጣለሁን?

verses.text_english: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት ሠዋ፥ ለልዑልም ስእለትህን ስጥ፤

verses.text_english: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራ ቀን ጥራኝ፥ አድንህማለሁ አንተም ታከብረኛለህ።

verses.text_english: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛውን ግን እግዚአብሔር አለው። ለምን አንተ ሕጌን ትናገራለህ? ኪዳኔንም በአፍህ ለምን ትወስዳለህ?

verses.text_english: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተስ ተግሣጼን ጠላህ፥ ቃሎቼንም ወደ ኋላህ ጣልህ።

verses.text_english: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.text_amharic: ሌባውን ባየህ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ትሮጥ ነበር እድል ፈንታህንም ከአመንዝሮች ጋር አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.text_amharic: አፍህ ክፋትን አበዛ፥ አንደበትህም ሽንገላን ተበተበ።

verses.text_english: Thou sittest speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀምጠህ ወንድምህን አማኸው፥ ለእናትህም ልጅ ዕንቅፋት አኖርህ።

verses.text_english: These hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether as thyself: I will reprove thee, and set in order before thine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን አድርገህ ዝም አልሁህ፤ እኔ እንደ አንተ እሆን ዘንድ ጠረጠርህ፤ እዘልፍሃለሁ በፊትህም እቆማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear in pieces, and none to deliver.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የምትረሱ እናንተ፥ ይህን አስተውሉ፤ አለዚያ ግን ይነጥቃል የሚያድንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth conversation will I shew the salvation of God.
verses.text_amharic: ምስጋና የሚሠዋ ያከብረኛል፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ለእርሱ የማሳይበት መንገድ ከዚያ አለ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.] Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቸርነትህ መጠን ማረኝ፤ እንደ ምሕረትህም ብዛት መተላለፌን ደምስስ።

verses.text_english: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.text_amharic: ከበደሌ ፈጽሞ እጠበኝ፥ ከኃጢአቴም አንጻኝ፤

verses.text_english: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin ever before me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ መተላለፌን አውቃለሁና፥ ኃጢአቴም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, be clear when thou judgest.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ብቻ በደልሁ፥ በፊትህም ክፋትን አደረግሁ፥ በነገርህም ትጸድቅ ዘንድ በፍርድህም ንጹሕ ትሆን ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዓመፃ ተፀነስሁ፥ እናቴም በኃጢአት ወለደችኝ።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እውነትን ወደድህ፤ የማይታይ ስውር ጥበብን አስታወቅኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.text_amharic: በሂሶጵ እርጨኝ፥ እነጻማለሁ፤ እጠበኝ፥ ከበረዶም ይልቅ ነጭ እሆናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Make me to hear joy and gladness; the bones thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሤትንና ደስታን አሰማኝ፥ የሰበርሃቸውም አጥንቶቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአቴ ፊትህን መልስ፥ በደሌንም ሁሉ ደምስስልኝ።

verses.text_english: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ንጹሕ ልብን ፍጠርልኝ፥ የቀናውንም መንፈስ በውስጤ አድስ።

verses.text_english: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊትህ አትጣለኝ፥ ቅዱስ መንፈስህንም ከእኔ ላይ አትውሰድብኝ።

verses.text_english: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me free spirit.
verses.text_amharic: የማዳንህን ደስታ ስጠኝ፥ በእሽታ መንፈስም ደግፈኝ።

verses.text_english: will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለሕግ ተላላፎች መንገድህን አስተምራለሁ፥ ኃጢአተኞችም ወደ አንተ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ከደም አድነኝ፥ አንደበቴም በአንተ ጽድቅ ትደሰታለች።

verses.text_english: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከንፈሮቼን ክፈት፥ አፌም ምስጋናህን ያወራል።

verses.text_english: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give : thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: መሥዋዕትን ብትወድድስ በሰጠሁህ ነበር፤ የሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ደስ አያሰኝህም።

verses.text_english: The sacrifices of God a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት የተሰበረ መንፈስ ነው፥ የተሰበርውንና የተዋረደውን ልብ እግዚአብሔር አይንቅም።

verses.text_english: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በውዴታህ ጽዮንን አሰማምራት፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጽሮች ሥራ።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቁን መሥዋዕት መባውንም የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በወደድህ ጊዜ፥ ያን ጊዜ በመሠዊያህ ላይ ፍሪዳዎችን ይሠዋሉ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.] Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God continually.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያል ሆይ፥ በክፋት ለምን ትጓደዳለህ? ሁልጊዜስ በመተላለፍ?

verses.text_english: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.text_amharic: አንደበትህ ኃጢአትን ያስባል፤ እንደ ተሳለ ምላጭ ሽንገላን አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: Thou lovest evil more than good; lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ከመልካም ይልቅ ክፋትን፥ ጽድቅንም ከመናገር ይልቅ ዓመፃን ወደድህ።

verses.text_english: Thou lovest all devouring words, O deceitful tongue.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያጠፉ ቃልን ሁሉ፥ የሽንገላ ምላስን ወደድህ።

verses.text_english: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያፈርስሃል፤ ከቤትህም ይነቅልሃል ያፈልስሃልም፥ ሥርህንም ከሕያዋን ምድር።

verses.text_english: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን አይተው ይፈራሉ፤ በእርሱም ይሥቃሉ እንዲህም ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Lo, the man made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ረዳቱ ያላደረገ፥ በባለጠግነቱም ብዛት የታመነ፥ በከንቱ ነገርም የበረታ ያ ሰው እነሆ።

verses.text_english: But I like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ለመለመ እንደ ወይራ ዛፍ ነኝ፤ ለዓለምና ለዘላለም በእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት ታመንሁ።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done : and I will wait on thy name; for good before thy saints.
verses.text_amharic: አድርገህልኛልና ለዘላለም አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በቅዱሳንህም ዘንድ መልካም ነውና ስምህን ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, of David.] The fool hath said in his heart, no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: none that doeth good.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ በልቡ። አምላክ የለም ይላል። ረከሱ በበደላቸውም ጐሰቈሉ፤ በጎ ነገርን የሚያደርጋት የለም።

verses.text_english: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were that did understand, that did seek God.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስተውል እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ እንዳለ ያይ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ የሰው ልጆችን ተመለከተ።

verses.text_english: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ በደሉ፥ አብረውም ረከሱ፤ አንድ ስንኳ በጎን ነገር የሚያደርጋት የለም።

verses.text_english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤን እንጀራ እንደሚበላ የሚበሉ ግፍ አድራጊዎች ሁሉ አያውቁምን? እግዚአብሔርንም አይጠሩትም።

verses.text_english: There were they in great fear, no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth thee: thou hast put to shame, because God hath despised them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የግብዞችን አጥንቶች በትኖአልና። በዚያ የሚያስፈራ ሳይኖር እጅግ ፈሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ንቆአቸዋልና አሳፈርሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Oh that the salvation of Israel out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, Israel shall be glad.
verses.text_amharic: መድኃኒትን ከጽዮን ለእስራኤል ማን በሰጠ! እግዚአብሔር የሕዝቡን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፥ ያዕቆብ ደስ ይለዋል እስራኤልም ሐሤት ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?] Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በስምህ አድነኝ፥ በኃይልህም ፍረድልኝ።

verses.text_english: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ የአፌንም ቃል አድምጥ፤

verses.text_english: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዶች ቁመውብኛልና፥ ኃያላንም ነፍሴን ሽተዋታልና። እግዚአብሔርን በፊታቸው አላደረጉትም።

verses.text_english: Behold, God mine helper: the Lord with them that uphold my soul.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፥ ጌታዬም ለነፍሴ ደጋፊዋ ነው።

verses.text_english: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.text_amharic: ክፋትን ወደ ጠላቶቼ ይመልሳታል፤ በእውነትህም አጥፋቸው።

verses.text_english: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for good.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈቃዴ እሠዋልሃለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ መልካም ነውና ስምህን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen upon mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ከመከራ ሁሉ አድኖኛልና፥ ዓይኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አይታለችና።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, of David.] Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጥ፥ ልመናዬንም ቸል አትበል።

verses.text_english: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.text_amharic: ተመልከተኝ ስማኝም። በኀዘኔ ተቅበዘበዝሁ ተናወጥሁም፤

verses.text_english: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠላት ድምፅ ከዓመፀኛም ግፍ የተነሣ፤ ዓመፃን በላዬ ጥለውብኛልና፥ በቁጣም ጠልተውኛልና።

verses.text_english: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ በላዬ ተናወጠብኝ፥ የሞት ድንጋጤም ወደቀብኝ።

verses.text_english: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርሃትና እንቅጥቅጥ መጡብኝ፥ ጨለማም ሸፈነኝ።

verses.text_english: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.text_amharic: በርሬ ዐርፍ ዘንድ እንደ ርግብ ክንፍን ማን በሰጠኝ!

verses.text_english: Lo, would I wander far off, remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ኰብልዬ በራቅሁ በምድረ በዳም በተቀመጥሁ፤

verses.text_english: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm tempest.
verses.text_amharic: ከዐውሎና ከብርቱ ንፋስ ሸሽቼ በፈጠንሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Destroy, O Lord, divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ግፍንና ጠብን በከተማ ውስጥ አይቼአለሁና አስጥማቸው እንደበታቸውንም ቍረጥ።

verses.text_english: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow in the midst of it.
verses.text_amharic: በቀንና በሌሊት በቅጥርዋ ይከብቡአታል፤ ዓመፃና ድካም ኃጢአትም በመካከልዋ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Wickedness in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.text_amharic: ተንኰልና ሽንገላ ከአደባባይዋ አይርቁም።

verses.text_english: For not an enemy reproached me; then I could have borne : neither he that hated me did magnify against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.text_amharic: ጠላትስ ቢሰድበኝ፥ በታገሥሁ ነበር፤ የሚጠላኝም ራሱን በላዬ ከፍ ከፍ ቢያደርግ፥ ከእርሱ በተሸሸግሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ እኩያዬ ሰው፥ ባልንጀራዬና የልቤ ወዳጅ፤

verses.text_english: We took sweet counsel together, walked unto the house of God in company.
verses.text_amharic: መብልን ከእኔ ጋር በአንድነት ያጣፈጥህ፤ በአንድ ልብ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተራመድን።

verses.text_english: Let death seize upon them, let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness in their dwellings, among them.
verses.text_amharic: ሞት ይምጣባቸው፤ በሕይወት ሳሉ ወደ ሲኦል ይውረዱ፤ ክፋት በማደሪያቸውና በመካከላቸው ነውና።

verses.text_english: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማኝ።

verses.text_english: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.text_amharic: በማታና በጥዋት በቀትርም እናገራለሁ እጮኽማለሁ፥ ቃሌንም ይሰማኛል።

verses.text_english: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle against me: for there were many with me.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ላይ ብዙ ነበሩና ከሚቃረቡኝ ነፍሴን በሰላም አድናት።

verses.text_english: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
verses.text_amharic: ቤዛ የላቸውምና፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አልፈሩትምና ከጥንት ጀምሮ የነበረ እግዚአብሔር ሰምቶ ያጐሰቍላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ጋር ሰላም በነበሩት ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ ኪዳኑንም አረከሱ።

verses.text_english: of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet they drawn swords.
verses.text_amharic: አፉ ከቅቤ ይልቅ ለዘበ፥ በልቡ ግን ሰልፍ ነበረ፤ ቃሎቹም ከዘይት ይልቅ ለሰለሱ፥ እነርሱ ግን እንደ ተመዘዘ ሰይፍ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ትካዜህን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጣል፥ እርሱም ይደግፍሃል፤ ለጻድቁም ለዘላለም ሁከትን አይሰጠውም።

verses.text_english: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ወደ ሞት ጕድጓድ ታወርዳቸዋለህ፤ የደም ሰዎችና ሸንጋዮች ዘመናቸው ግማሽ አይሞላም፤ እኔ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ እታመንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath.] Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሰው ረግጦኛልና ማረኝ፤ ሁልጊዜም በሰልፍ አስጨንቆኛል።

verses.text_english: Mine enemies would daily swallow up: for many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.text_amharic: የሚዋጉኝ በዝተዋልና ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ጠላቶቼ ረገጡኝ።

verses.text_english: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ፈራሁ በአንተም ታመንሁ።

verses.text_english: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቃሉን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፥ አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?

verses.text_english: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts against me for evil.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ቃሎቼን ያጸይፉብኛል፤ በእኔ ላይም የሚመክሩት ሁሉ ለክፉ ነው።

verses.text_english: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ይሸምቁብኛል ይሸሽጉኝማል፥ እነርሱም ተረከዜን ይመለካከታሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ነፍሴን ይሸምቁባታል።

verses.text_english: Shall they escape by iniquity? in anger cast down the people, O God.
verses.text_amharic: በምንም ምን አታድናቸውም፤ አሕዛብን በቍጣ ትጥላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: not in thy book?
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ሕይወቴን ነገርሁህ፤ እንባዬን እንደ ትእዛዝህ በፊተህ አኖርህ።

verses.text_english: When I cry , then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God for me.
verses.text_amharic: በጠራሁህ ጊዜ ጠላቶቼ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሳሉ፤ አንተ አምላኬ እንደ ሆንህ እነሆ፥ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: In God will I praise word: in the LORD will I praise word.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቃሉን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቃሉን አከብራለሁ።

verses.text_english: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፥ አልፈራም ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?

verses.text_english: Thy vows upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የምስጋና ስእለት የምሰጥህ ከእኔ ዘንድ ነው፤

verses.text_english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: not my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ እግሮቼን ከመውደቅ አድነሃልና፥ በሕያዋን ብርሃን እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኘው ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.] Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until calamities be overpast.
verses.text_amharic: ማረኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ፥ ነፍሴ አንተን ታምናለችና፤ ጉዳት እስክታልፍ ድረስ በክንፎችህ ጥላ እታመናለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth for me.
verses.text_amharic: ወደሚረዳኝ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ልዑል እግዚአብሔር እጮኻለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall send from heaven, and save me the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይ ልኮ አዳነኝ፥ ለረገጡኝም ውርደትን ሰጣቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ቸርነቱንና እውነቱን ላከ።

verses.text_english: My soul among lions: I lie them that are set on fire, the sons of men, whose teeth spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ከአንበሶች መካከል አዳናት። ደንግጬ ተኛሁ፤ የሰው ልጆች ጥርሳቸው ጦርና ፍላጻ፥ አንደበታቸው የተሳለ ሾተል ነው።

verses.text_english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; thy glory above all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.text_english: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen . Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግሮቼ ወጥመድን አዘጋጁ፥ ነፍሴንም አጐበጡአት፤ ጕድጓድ በፊቴ ቈፈሩ፥ በእርሱም ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ጨካኝ ነው፥ አቤቱ፥ ልቤ ጨካኝ ነው፤ እቀኛለሁ፥ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I will awake early.
verses.text_amharic: ክብሬ ይነሣ፥ በገናና መሰንቆም ይነሡ፤ እኔም ማልጄ እነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በወገኖችም ዘንድ እዘምርልሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For thy mercy great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህ እስከ ሰማይ ድረስ ከፍ ብላለችና፥ እውነትህም እስከ ደመናት ድረስ።

verses.text_english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: thy glory above all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David.] Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ጽድቅን ብትናገሩስ፥ የሰው ልጆች ሆይ፥ በቅን ትፈርዳላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በልባችሁ በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ትሠራላችሁና፥ እጆቻችሁም ግፍን ይታታሉና።

verses.text_english: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.text_amharic: ኅጥኣን ከማኅፀን ጀምረው ተለዩ፤ ከሆድም ጀምረው ሳቱ፥ ሐሰትንም ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Their poison like the poison of a serpent: like the deaf adder stoppeth her ear;
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣቸው እንደ እባብ መርዝ ነው፥ እንደ ምድር አውሬም ጆሮዋ የተደፈነ ነው፥

verses.text_english: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.text_amharic: አዋቂ ሲደግምባት የአስማተኛውን ቃል እንደማትሰማ።

verses.text_english: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጥርሳቸውን በአፋቸው ውስጥ ይሰብራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የአንበሶቹን መንጋጋቸውን ያደቅቃል።

verses.text_english: Let them melt away as waters run continually: he bendeth his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚፈስስ ውኃ ይቀልጣሉ፤ እስኪያደክማቸው ድረስ ፍላጾቹን ይገትራል።

verses.text_english: As a snail melteth, let pass away: the untimely birth of a woman, they may not see the sun.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚቀልጥ ሰም ያልቃሉ፤ እሳት ወደቀች፥ ፀሐይንም አላዩአትም።

verses.text_english: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in wrath.
verses.text_amharic: እሾኻችሁ ሳይታወቅ በትር ሆነ፤ ሕያዋን ሳላችሁ በመዓቱ ይነጥቃችኋል።

verses.text_english: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ በቀልን ባየ ጊዜ ደስ ይለዋል፤ በኃጢአተኛው ደምም እጁን ይታጠባል።

verses.text_english: So that a man shall say, Verily a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም። በእውነት ለጻድቅ ፍሬ አለው፤ በእውነት በምድር ላይ የሚፈርድ አምላክ አለ ይላል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.] Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ፤ በላዬም ከቆሙት አስጥለኝ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.text_amharic: ከግፍ አድራጊዎች ታደገኝ፥ ከደም ሰዎችም አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not my transgression, nor my sin, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ነፍሴን ሸምቀውባታልና፥ ብርቱዎችም በላዬ ተሰበሰቡ። አቤቱ፥ በበደሌም አይደለም፥ በኃጢአቴም አይደለም።

verses.text_english: They run and prepare themselves without fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ በደል ሮጥሁ ተዘጋጀሁም፤ ተነሥ፥ ተቀበለኝ፥ እይም።

verses.text_english: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም አቤቱ፥ የኃያላን አምላክ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ፥ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ትጐበኛቸው ዘንድ ተነሥ፤ ዓመፅ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ አትማራቸው።

verses.text_english: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.text_amharic: ማታ ይመለሱ እንደ ውሾችም ይራቡ፥ በከተማም ይዙሩ።

verses.text_english: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords in their lips: for who, , doth hear?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በአፋቸው አሰምተው ይናገራሉ፤ ሰይፍም በከንፈሮቻቸው አለ፤ ማን ይሰማል? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ ትሥቅባቸዋለህ፥ አሕዛብንም ሁሉ ትንቃቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: his strength will I wait upon thee: for God my defence.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያዬ ነውና ኃይሌን ወደ አንተ አስጠጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see upon mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላኬ ቸርነቱ ይገናኘኛል አምላኬ በጠላቶቼ ላይ ያሳየኛል።

verses.text_english: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህን እንዳይረሱ አትግደላቸው፤ አቤቱ ጋሻዬ፥ በኃይልህ በትናቸው አውርዳቸውም።

verses.text_english: the sin of their mouth the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying they speak.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አፋቸው ኃጢአት ስለ ከንፈራቸውም ቃል፥ መርገምንና ሐሰትን ስለሚናገሩ፥ በትዕቢታቸው ይጠመዱ።

verses.text_english: Consume in wrath, consume , that they not : and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣ አጥፋቸው፥ እንዳይኖሩም አጥፋቸው፤ የያዕቆብም አምላክ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ እንዲገዛ ይወቁ።

verses.text_english: And at evening let them return; let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.text_amharic: ማታ ይመለሱ እንደ ውሾችም ይራቡ፥ በከተማም ይዙሩ።

verses.text_english: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም መብል ለመፈለግ ይበተኑ፤ ያልጠገቡ እንደ ሆነም ያንጐረጕራሉ።

verses.text_english: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ለኃይልህ እቀኛለሁ፤ በምሕረትህም ማልዶ ደስ ይለኛል፤ በመከራዬ ቀን መጠጊያዬና አምባዬ ሆነኸኛልና።

verses.text_english: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God my defence, the God of my mercy.
verses.text_amharic: ረዳቴ ሆይ፥ ለአንተ ለአምላኬ እዘምራለሁ፤ አንተ፥ አምላኬ፥ መጠጊያዬ ምሕረቴም ነህና።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.] O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጣልኸን አፈረስኸንም፤ ተቈጣኸን ይቅርም አልኸን።

verses.text_english: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን አናወጥሃት አወክሃትም፤ ተናውጣለችና ቍስልዋን ፈውስ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.text_amharic: ለሕዝብህ ጭንቅን አሳየሃቸው፥ አስደንጋጩንም ወይን አጠጣኸን።

verses.text_english: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀስት ፊት ያመልጡ ዘንድ፥ ለሚፈሩህ ምልክትን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.text_english: That thy beloved may be delivered; save thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጆችህ እንዲድኑ በቀኝህ አድን፥ አድምጠኝም።

verses.text_english: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ተናገረ፤ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሴኬምንም እካፈላለሁ፥ የሱኮትንም ሸለቆ እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Gilead mine, and Manasseh mine; Ephraim also the strength of mine head; Judah my lawgiver;
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓድ የእኔ ነው፥ ምናሴም የእኔ ነው፤ ኤፍሬም የራሴ መጠጊያ ነው። ይሁዳ ንጉሤ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Moab my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ መታጠቢያዬ ነው፥ በኤዶምያስ ላይ ጫማዬን እዘረጋለሁ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ይገዙልኛል።

verses.text_english: Who will bring me the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጽኑ ከተማ ማን ይወስደኛል? ማንስ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ይመራኛል?

verses.text_english: not thou, O God, hadst cast us off? and , O God, didst not go out with our armies?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የጣልኸን አንተ አይደለህምን? አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከሠራዊታችን ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.text_english: Give us help from trouble: for vain the help of man.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራችን ረድኤትን ስጠን የሰውም ማዳን ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he shall tread down our enemies.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይልን እናደርጋለን እርሱ የሚያስጨንቁንን ያዋርዳቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Neginah, of David.] Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልመናዬን ስማ፥ ጸሎቴንም አድምጥ።

verses.text_english: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock is higher than I.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ተስፋ በቈረጠ ጊዜ ከምድር ዳርቻ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፤ በድንጋይ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግኸኝ።

verses.text_english: For thou hast been a shelter for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: ጽኑ ግንብ በጠላት ፊት ተስፋዬም ሆነኸኛልና መራኸኝ።

verses.text_english: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በድንኳንህ ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ፤ በክንፎችህም ጥላ እጋረዳለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስእለቴን ሰምተሃልና፤ ስምህንም ለሚፈሩ ርስትህን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: his years as many generations.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሥ ከቀን በላይ ቀን ትጨምራለህ፥ ዓመታቱም ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, may preserve him.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ ምሕረትንና እውነትን አዘጋጅለት።

verses.text_english: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ለስምህ ለዘላለም እዘምራለሁ ስእለቴን ሁልጊዜ እፈጽም ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.] Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ለእግዚአብሔር የምትገዛ አይደለችምን? መድኃኒቴ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናትና።

verses.text_english: He only my rock and my salvation; my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አምላኬ መድኃኒቴም ነውና፤ እርሱ መጠጊያዬ ነው፥ እጅግም አልታወክም።

verses.text_english: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall a tottering fence.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መቼ በሰው ላይ ትቆማላችሁ? እናንተ ሁላችሁ እንዳዘነበለ ግድግዳ እንደ ፈረሰም ቅጥር ትገድላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: They only consult to cast down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ክብሬን ይሽሩ ዘንድ መከሩ፥ ሐሰትንም ይወድዳሉ፤ በአፋቸው ይባርካሉ፥ በልባቸውም ይረግማሉ።

verses.text_english: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation from him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ አንቺ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዢ፥ ተስፋዬ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናትና።

verses.text_english: He only my rock and my salvation: my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አምላኬ መድኃኒቴም ነውና፤ እርሱ መጠጊያዬ ነው፤ አልታወክም።

verses.text_english: In God my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, my refuge, in God.
verses.text_amharic: መድኃኒቴና ክብሬ በእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የረድኤቴ አምላክ ተስፋዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: Trust in him at all times; people, pour out your heart before him: God a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝብ ማኅበር ሁላችሁ፥ በእርሱ ታመኑ፥ ልባችሁንም በፊቱ አፍስሱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ረዳታችን ነው።

verses.text_english: Surely men of low degree vanity, men of high degree a lie: to be laid in the balance, they altogether than vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሰው ልጆች ከንቱ ናቸው፥ የሰው ልጆችም ሐሰተኞች ናቸው፤ በሚዛንም ይበድላሉ፥ እነርሱስ በፍጹም ከንቱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart .
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃን ተስፋ አታድርጉ፥ ቅሚያንም አትተማመኑት፤ ባለጠግነት ቢበዛ ልባችሁ አይኵራ።

verses.text_english: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power unto God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አንድ ጊዜ ተናገረ፥ እኔም ይህን ብቻ ሰማሁ፤ ኃይል የእግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.text_english: Also unto thee, O Lord, mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትም ያንተ ነው፤ አንተ ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ሥራው ፍዳውን ትሰጣለህና።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.] O God, thou my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ወደ አንተ እገሠግሣለሁ፤ ነፍሴ አንተን ተጠማች፥ ሥጋዬ አንተን እንዴት ናፈቀች እንጨትና ውኃ በሌለበት በምድረ በዳ።

verses.text_english: To see thy power and thy glory, so I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይልህንና ክብርህን አይ ዘንድ እንዲሁ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ተመለከትሁህ።

verses.text_english: Because thy lovingkindness better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህ ከሕይወት ይሻላልና ከንፈሮቼ ያመሰግኑሃል።

verses.text_english: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በአንተም ስም እጆቼን አነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: My soul shall be satisfied as marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise with joyful lips:
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ በቅቤና በስብ እንደሚጠግቡ ትጠግባለች፥ ከንፈሮቼም ስምህን በደስታ ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.text_english: When I remember thee upon my bed, meditate on thee in the watches.
verses.text_amharic: በመኝታዬም አስብሃለሁ፥ በማለዳም እናገርልሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: ረዳቴ ሆነኸኛልና፥ በክንፎችህም ጥላ ደስ ይለኛልና።

verses.text_english: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ በኋላህ ተከታተለች፥ እኔንም ቀኝህ ተቀበለችኝ።

verses.text_english: But those seek my soul, to destroy , shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ነፍሴን ለከንቱ ፈለጓት፤ ወደ ምድር ጥልቅ ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰይፍ እጅ አልፈው ይሰጣሉ፥ የቀበሮም እድል ፈንታ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል፤ በእርሱ የሚምል ሁሉ ይከብራል፥ ሐሰትን የሚናገር አፍ ይዘጋልና።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ በለመንሁ ጊዜ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ ከጠላትም ፍርሃት ነፍሴን አድን።

verses.text_english: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉዎች ሸንጎ ከዓመፀኞችም ብዛት ሰውረኝ።

verses.text_english: Who whet their tongue like a sword, bend their arrows, bitter words:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሰይፍ ምላሳቸውን አሰሉ፤ መራራ ነገርን ለማድረግ፥

verses.text_english: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕንም በስውር ለመንደፍ ቀስትን ገተሩ፤ ድንገት ይነድፉታል አይፈሩምም።

verses.text_english: They encourage themselves an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱ ለራሳቸው ክፉ ነገርን አጸኑ፤ ወጥመድን ይሰውሩ ዘንድ ተማከሩ፤ ማንስ ያየናል? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward of every one , and the heart, deep.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃን ፈልጓት፥ ሲፈትኑም አለቁ፤ የሰው የውስጥ አሳቡና ልቡ የጠለቀ ነው፥

verses.text_english: But God shall shoot at them an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከፍ ከፍ ይላል። የድንገትም ፍላጻ፤ ያቈስላቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.text_amharic: አንደበታቸው ያሰናክላቸዋል፥ የሚያዩአቸውም ሁሉ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ ተናገሩ፥ ሥራውንም አስተዋሉ።

verses.text_english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል፥ በእርሱም ይታመናል፤ ልባቸውም የቀና ሁሉ እልል ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm Song of David.] Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በጽዮን ለአንተ ምስጋና ይገባል፥ ለአንተም ጸሎት ይቀርባል።

verses.text_english: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋ ሁሉ ጸሎትን ወደምትሰማ ወደ አንተ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Iniquities prevail against me: our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.text_amharic: የዓመፃ ነገር በረታብን፤ ኃጢአታችንንስ አንተ ይቅር ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: Blessed thou choosest, and causest to approach he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, of thy holy temple.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የመረጥኸው በአደባባዮችህም ለማደር የተቀበልኸው ምስጉን ነው፤ ከቤትህ በረከት እንጠግባለን።

verses.text_english: terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off the sea:
verses.text_amharic: ቤተ መቅደስህ ቅዱስ ነው በጽድቅም ድንቅ ነው። በምድር ዳርቻ ሁሉና በሩቅ ባሕር ውስጥ ላሉ ተስፋቸው የሆንህ፥ አምላካችንና መድኃኒታችን ሆይ፥ ስማን።

verses.text_english: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; girded with power:
verses.text_amharic: በጉልበትህ ተራሮችን አጸናሃቸው፥ በኃይልም ታጥቀሃል።

verses.text_english: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.text_amharic: የባሕሩን ጥልቀት የሞገድንም ጩኸት ታናውጣለህ።

verses.text_english: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: ከተአምራትህ የተነሣ አሕዛብ ይደነግጣሉ፥ በምድር ዳርቻም የሚኖሩ ይፈራሉ፤ የጥዋትንና የማታን መውጫ ደስ ታሰኛቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን ጐበኘሃት አጠጣሃትም፥ ብልጥግናዋንም እጅግ አበዛህ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንዝ ውኃን የተመላ ነው፤ ምግባቸውን አዘጋጀህ እንዲሁ ታሰናዳለህና።

verses.text_english: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ትልምዋን ታረካለህ፥ ቦይዋንም ታስተካክላለህ፤ በነጠብጣብ ታለሰልሳታለህ፥ ቡቃያዋንም ትባርካለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.text_amharic: በቸርነትህ ዓመትን ታቀዳጃለህ፥ ምድረ በዳውም ስብን ይጠግባል።

verses.text_english: They drop the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.text_amharic: የምድረ በዳ ተራሮች ይረካሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም በደስታ ይታጠቃሉ።

verses.text_english: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.text_amharic: ማሰማርያዎች መንጎችን ለበሱ፥ ሸለቆችም በእህል ተሸፈኑ፤ በደስታ ይጮኻሉ ይዘምራሉም።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Song Psalm.] Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥

verses.text_english: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.text_amharic: ለስሙም ዘምሩ፥ ለምስጋናውም ክብርን ስጡ።

verses.text_english: Say unto God, How terrible thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ በሉት። ሥራህ ግሩም ነው፤ ኃይልህ ብዙ ሲሆን ጠላቶች ዋሹብህ።

verses.text_english: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing thy name. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ያሉ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሰግዳሉ፥ ለአንተም ይዘምራሉ፥ ለስምህም ይዘምራሉ።

verses.text_english: Come and see the works of God: terrible doing toward the children of men.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እዩ፤ ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ በምክር ግሩም ነው።

verses.text_english: He turned the sea into dry : they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.text_amharic: ባሕርን የብስ አደረጋት፥ ወንዙንም በእግር ተሻገሩ፤ በዚያ በእርሱ ደስ ይለናል።

verses.text_english: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይሉ ለዘላለም ይገዛል፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ አሕዛብ ይመለከታሉ፤ ዓመፀኞች ራሳቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ አምላካችንን ባርኩ፥ የምስጋናውንም ድምፅ አሰሙ።

verses.text_english: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን በሕይወት ያኖራታል፥ እግሮቼንም ለመናወጥ አልሰጠም።

verses.text_english: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፈትነኸናልና፥ ብርንም እንደሚያነጥሩት አንጥረኸናልና።

verses.text_english: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ወጥመድ አገባኸን፥ በጀርባችንም መከራን አኖርህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy .
verses.text_amharic: በራሳችን ላይ ሰውን አስረገጥኸን፤ በእሳትና በውኃ መካከል አለፍን፥ ወደ ዕረፍትም አወጣኸን።

verses.text_english: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ከዕጣንና ከወጠጤዎች ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ፍሪዳን አቀርባለሁ፤ ላሞችንና ፍየሎችን እሠዋልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሁሉ፥ ኑ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ለነፍሴ ያደረገላትን ልንገራችሁ።

verses.text_english: Come hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.text_amharic: በአፌ ወደ እርሱ ጮኽሁ፥ በአንደበቴም አመሰገንሁት።

verses.text_english: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.text_amharic: በልቤስ በደልን አይቼ ብሆን ጌታ አይሰማኝም ነበር።

verses.text_english: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear :
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ሰማኝ፤ የልመናዬን ድምፅ አደመጠ።

verses.text_english: verily God hath heard ; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎቴን ያልከለከለኝ ምሕረቱንም ከእኔ ያላራቀ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm Song.] God be merciful unto us, and bless us; cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይማረን ይባርከንም፥ ፊቱንም በላያችን ያብራ፤

verses.text_english: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ማዳንህን፥ መንገድህንም በምድር እናውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ያመስግኑህ፥ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመስግኑህ።

verses.text_english: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሕዛብ በቅን ትፈርድላቸዋለህና፥ አሕዛብንም በምድር ላይ ትመራለህና አሕዛብ ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሤትም ያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ያመስግኑህ፥ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመስግኑህ።

verses.text_english: shall the earth yield her increase; God, our own God, shall bless us.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ፍሬዋን ሰጠች፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችንም ይባርከናል።

verses.text_english: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይባርከናል፥ የምድርም ዳርቻ ሁሉ ይፈሩታል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm Song of David.] Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይነሣ፥ ጠላቶቹም ይበተኑ፥ የሚጠሉትም ከፊቱ ይሽሹ።

verses.text_english: As smoke is driven away, drive away: as wax melteth before the fire, let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.text_amharic: ጢስ እንደሚበንን እንዲሁ ይብነኑ፤ ሰም በእሳት ፊት እንደሚቀልጥ፥ እንዲሁ ኅጥኣን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይጥፉ።

verses.text_english: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃንም ደስ ይበላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሐሤት ያድርጉ፥ በደስታም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.text_english: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ ለስሙም ዘምሩ፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ለወጣም መንገድ አድርጉ፤ ስሙ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በፊቱም ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ በፊቱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.text_english: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, God in his holy habitation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱስ ቦታው ለድሀ አደጎች አባት፥ ለባልቴቶችም ዳኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ብቸኞችን በቤት ያሳድራቸዋል፥ እስረኞችንም በኃይሉ ያወጣቸዋል፤ ዓመፀኞች ግን በምድረ በዳ ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብም ፊት በወጣህ ጊዜ፥ በምድረ በዳም ባለፍህ ጊዜ፥ ምድር ተናወጠች፥

verses.text_english: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: Sinai itself at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከሲና አምላክ ፊት፥ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ፊት ሰማያትም አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.text_english: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሞገስን ዝናብ ለርስትህ አዘነብህ፥ በደከመም ጊዜ አንተ አጸናኸው።

verses.text_english: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶችህ በውስጡ አደሩ፤ አቤቱ፥ በቸርነትህ ለድሆች አዘጋጀህ።

verses.text_english: The Lord gave the word: great the company of those that published .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቃሉን ሰጠ፤ የሚያወሩት ብዙ ሠራዊት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ነገሥታት ፈጥነው ይሸሻሉ፤ በቤትም የምትኖር ምርኮን ተካፈለች።

verses.text_english: Though ye have lien among the pots, the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.text_amharic: በርስቶች መካከል ብታድሩ፥ ከብር እንደ ተሠሩ እንደ ርግብ ክንፎች፥ በቅጠልያ ወርቅም እንደ ተለበጡ ላባዎችዋ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was as snow in Salmon.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያዊ ንጉሥ በላይዋ ባዘዘ ጊዜ፥ በሰልሞን ላይ በረዶ ዘነበ።

verses.text_english: The hill of God the hill of Bashan; an high hill the hill of Bashan.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ተራራ የለመለመ ተራራ ነው፤ የጸና ተራራና የለመለመ ተራራ ነው።

verses.text_english: Why leap ye, ye high hills? the hill God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የጸኑ ተራራዎች ለምን ይነሣሉ? እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተራራ ያድርበት ዘንድ ወደደው፤ በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያድርበታል።

verses.text_english: The chariots of God twenty thousand, thousands of angels: the Lord among them, Sinai, in the holy .
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሰረገላዎች የብዙ ብዙ ሺህ ናቸው፤ ጌታ በመቅደሱ በሲና በመካከላቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell .
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ላይ ዓረግህ፥ ምርኮን ማረክህ፥ ስጦታንም ለሰዎች ሰጠህ፥ ደግሞም ለዓመፀኞች በዚያ ያድሩ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the Lord, daily loadeth us the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ቡሩክ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር በየዕለቱ ቡሩክ ነው፤ የመድኃኒታችን አምላክ ይረዳናል።

verses.text_english: our God the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord the issues from death.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንስ የደኅንነት አምላክ ነው፤ ከሞት መውጣትም ከእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር የጠላቶቹን ራስ፥ በኃጢአት የሚሄድንም የጠጕሩን አናት ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.text_english: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring again from the depths of the sea:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። ከባሳን አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከባሕርም ጥልቅ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥

verses.text_english: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of enemies, the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮችህ በደም ይረገጡ ዘንድ፥ የውሾችህ ምላስ በጠላቶች ላይ ይሆን ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: They have seen thy goings, O God; the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላኬ የንጉሥ መንገድ በመቅደሱ፥ አቤቱ፥ መንገድህ ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: The singers went before, the players on instruments after; among the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆች ቀደሙ፥ መዘምራንም ተከተሉ፤ ከበሮን በሚመቱ በቈነጃጅት መካከል።

verses.text_english: Bless ye God in the congregations, the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በጉባኤ፥ ጌታችንንም በእስራኤል ምንጭ አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: There little Benjamin their ruler, the princes of Judah their council, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.text_amharic: ወጣቱ ብንያም በጕልበቱ በዚያ አለ፥ ገዦቻቸው የይሁዳ አለቆች የዛብሎን አለቆችና የንፍታሌምም አለቆች።

verses.text_english: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ኃይልህን እዘዝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ይህንም ለእኛ የሠራኸውን አጽናው።

verses.text_english: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም ስላለው መቅደስህ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ለአንተ ያመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people delight in war.
verses.text_amharic: በሸምበቆ ውስጥ ያሉትን አራዊት፥ በአሕዛብ ውስጥ ያሉትን የበሬዎችንና የወይፈኖችን ጉባኤ ገሥጽ፥ እንደ ብር የተፈተኑት አሕዛብ እንዳይዘጉ፤ ሰልፍን የሚወድዱትን አሕዛብን በትናቸው።

verses.text_english: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.text_amharic: መኳንንት ከግብጽ ይመጣሉ፤ ኢትዮጵያ እጆችዋን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትዘረጋለች።

verses.text_english: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ነገሥታት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ፥ ለጌታም ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, a mighty voice.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ሰማየ ሰማያት ለወጣ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፤ የኃይል ቃል የሆነ ቃሉን፥ እነሆ፥ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency over Israel, and his strength in the clouds.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ስጡ፤ ግርማው በእስራኤል ላይ፥ ኃይሉም በደመናት ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: O God, terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel he that giveth strength and power unto people. Blessed God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱሳኑ ላይ ድንቅ ነው፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እርሱ ኃይልን ብርታትንም ለሕዝቡ ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይመስገን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, of David.] Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto soul.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ውኃ እስከ ነፍሴ ደርሶብኛልና አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: I sink in deep mire, where no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.text_amharic: በጥልቅ ረግረግ ጠለቅሁ መቋሚያም የለኝም። ወደ ጥልቅ ባሕር ገባሁ ማዕበልም አሰጠመኝ።

verses.text_english: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.text_amharic: በጩኸት ደከምሁ ጕሮሮዬም ሰለለ፤ አምላኬን ስጠብቅ ዓይኖቼ ፈዘዙ።

verses.text_english: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored which I took not away.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ የሚጠሉኝ ከራሴ ጠጕር በዙ፤ በዓመፅ ያሚያሳድዱኝ ጠላቶቼ በረቱ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ ያልቀማሁትን መለስሁ።

verses.text_english: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስንፍናዬን ታውቃለህ፥ ኃጢአቴም ከአንተ አልተሰወረም።

verses.text_english: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ ተስፋ የሚያደርጉህ በእኔ አይፈሩ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ የሚሹህ በእኔ አይነወሩ።

verses.text_english: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አንተ ስድብን ታግሻለሁና፥ እፍረትም ፊቴን ሸፍናለችና።

verses.text_english: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.text_amharic: ለወንድሞቼ እንደ ሌላ፥ ለእናቴ ልጆችም እንደ እንግዳ ሆንሁባቸው፥

verses.text_english: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.text_amharic: የቤትህ ቅንዓት በልታኛለችና፥ የሚሰድቡህም ስድብ በላዬ ወድቆአልና።

verses.text_english: When I wept, my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን በጾም አስመረርሁአት፥ ለስድብም ሆነብኝ።

verses.text_english: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.text_amharic: ማቅ ለበስሁ ምሳሌም ሆንሁላቸው።

verses.text_english: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I the song of the drunkards.
verses.text_amharic: በደጅ የሚቀመጡ በእኔ ይጫወታሉ፤ ወይን የሚጠጡ እኔን ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.text_english: But as for me, my prayer unto thee, O LORD, an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በመልካሙ ጊዜ ጸሎቴ ወደ አንተ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ በምሕረትህ ብዛት በማዳንህም እውነት አድምጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይውጠኝ ከረግረግ አውጣኝ፤ ከሚጠሉኝና ከጥልቅ ውኃ አስጥለኝ።

verses.text_english: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.text_amharic: የውኃው ማዕበል አያስጥመኝ፥ ጥልቁም አይዋጠኝ፥ ጕድጓድም አፉን በእኔ ላይ አይዝጋ።

verses.text_english: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ መልካም ናትና ስማኝ። እንደ ርኅራኄህም ብዛት ወደ እኔ ተመልከት፤

verses.text_english: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሪያህም ፊትህን አትሰውር፤ ተጨንቄአለሁና ፈጥነህ አድምጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Draw nigh unto my soul, redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ተመልክተህ ተቤዣት፤ ስለ ጠላቶቼም አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries all before thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ስድቤን እፍረቴንም ነውሬንም ታውቃለህ፤ የሚያስጨንቁኝ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked to take pity, but none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ስድብንና ኃሣርን ታገሠች፤ አስተዛዛኝም ተመኘሁ አላገኘሁም። የሚያጽናናኝም አጣሁ።

verses.text_english: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ለመብሌ ሐሞት ሰጡኝ፥ ለጥማቴም ሆምጣጤ አጠጡኝ።

verses.text_english: Let their table become a snare before them: and for welfare, a trap.
verses.text_amharic: ማዕዳቸው በፊታቸው ለወጥመድ ለፍዳ ለዕንቅፋት ትሁንባቸው፤

verses.text_english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ይጨልሙ፥ ጀርባቸውም ዘወትር ይጕበጥ።

verses.text_english: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.text_amharic: መዓትህን በላያቸው አፍስስ፥ የቍጣህ መቅሠፍትም ያግኛቸው።

verses.text_english: Let their habitation be desolate; let none dwell in their tents.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያቸው በረሃ ትሁን፥ በድንኳኖቻቸውም የሚቀመጥ አይገኝ፤

verses.text_english: For they persecute whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የቀሠፍኸውን እነርሱ አሳድደዋልና፥ በቍስሌም ላይ ጥዝጣዜ ጨመሩብኝ።

verses.text_english: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: በኃጢአታቸው ላይ ኃጢአትን ጨምርባቸው፥ በጽድቅህም አይግቡ።

verses.text_english: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕያዋን መጽሐፍ ይደምሰሱ፥ ከጻድቃንም ጋር አይጻፉ።

verses.text_english: But I poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ችግረኛና ቍስለኛ ነኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ የፊትህ መድኃኒት ይቀበለኝ።

verses.text_english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በዝማሬ አመሰግናለሁ፥ በምስጋናም ከፍ ከፍ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: also shall please the LORD better than an ox bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንድና ጥፍር ካበቀለ ከእምቦሳ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.text_english: The humble shall see be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.text_amharic: ችግረኞች ያያሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉ ሕያዋንም ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ችግረኞችን ሰምቶአልና፥ እስረኞቹንም አልናቀምና።

verses.text_english: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይና ምድር ባሕርም በእርስዋም የሚንቀሳቀስ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል።

verses.text_english: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ያድናታልና፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ይሠራልና፤ በዚያም ይቀመጣሉ ይወርሱአትማል።

verses.text_english: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎቹ ዘር ይኖሩባታል። ስሙንም የሚወድዱ በዚያ ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, of David, to bring to remembrance.] , O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለማዳን ተመልከት፤ አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.text_english: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን የሚሹአት ይፈሩ ይጐስቍሉም፥ ክፉንም የሚመክሩብኝ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ ይፈሩም።

verses.text_english: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.text_amharic: እንኳ እንኳ የሚሉኝ አፍረው ወዲያው ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሹህ ሁሉ በአንተ ሐሤት ያድርጉ ደስ ይበላቸው፤ ማዳንህን የሚወድዱ ሁልጊዜ። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው ይበሉ።

verses.text_english: But I poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ እርዳኝ፤ ረዳቴ ታዳጊዬም አንተ ነህ፤ አቤቱ፥ አትዘግይ።

verses.text_english: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘላለም አልፈር።

verses.text_english: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅህ አስጥለኝ ታደገኝም፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል አድነኝም።

verses.text_english: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou my rock and my fortress.
verses.text_amharic: በጠንካራ ቦታ ታድነኝ ዘንድ አምላክና መሸሸጊያ ሁነኝ፤ ኃይሌ መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና።

verses.text_english: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ፥ ከኃጢአተኛ እጅ፥ ከዓመፀኛና ከግፈኛም እጅ አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: For thou my hope, O Lord GOD: my trust from my youth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፥ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ መታመኛዬ ነህና።

verses.text_english: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise continually of thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ተደገፍሁ፥ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ አንተ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፤ ሁልጊዜም ዝማሬዬ ለአንተ ነው።

verses.text_english: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou my strong refuge.
verses.text_amharic: ለብዙዎች መደነቂያ ሆንሁ፤ አንተ ግን ብርቱ መጠጊያዬ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Let my mouth be filled thy praise thy honour all the day.
verses.text_amharic: አፌን ምስጋና ምላ ሁልጊዜ ክብርህንና ግርማህን እዘምር ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.text_amharic: በእርጅናዬ ዘመን አትጣለኝ፥ ጕልበቴም ባለቀ ጊዜ አትተወኝ።

verses.text_english: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቹ በላዬ ተናግረዋልና፤ ነፍሴንም የሚሹአት በአንድነት ተማክረዋልና፥ እንዲህም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for none to deliver .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ትቶታል፤ የሚያድነው የለምና ተከትላችሁ ያዙት።

verses.text_english: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.text_english: Let them be confounded consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን የሚቃወሙአት ይፈሩ ይጥፉም፥ ጕዳቴንም የሚፈልጉ እፍረትንና ኃሣርን ይልበሱ።

verses.text_english: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ፥ በምስጋናህም ሁሉ ላይ እጨምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers .
verses.text_amharic: ሥራን አላውቅምና አፌ ጽድቅህን ሁልጊዜም ማዳንህን ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, of thine only.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል እገባለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ ጽድቅህን ብቻ አስባለሁ።

verses.text_english: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ አስተማርኸኝ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ተአምራትህን እነግራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto generation, thy power to every one is to come.
verses.text_amharic: እስካረጅም እስክሸመግልም ድረስ፥ ለሚመጣ ትውልድም ሁሉ ክንድህን ኃይልህንም ጽድቅህንም እስክነግር ድረስ፥ አቤቱ፥ አትተወኝ።

verses.text_english: Thy righteousness also, O God, very high, who hast done great things: O God, who like unto thee!
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እስከ አርያም ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አደረግህ፤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አሳይተኸኛልና፥ ተመለስህ ሕያውም አደረግኸኝ፤ ከምድር ጥልቅም እንደ ገና አወጣኸኝ።
