verses.text_english: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅህንም አብዛው፥ ተመልሰህም ደስ አሰኘኝ፥ ከጥልቅም እንደ ገና አወጣኸኝ።

verses.text_english: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በበገና ስለ እውነትህ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አምላክ ሆይ፥ በመሰንቆ እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.text_amharic: ዝማሬን ባቀርብሁልህ ጊዜ ከንፈሮቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ አንተ ያዳንሃትም ነፍሴ።

verses.text_english: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ጕዳቴን የሚሹ ባፈሩና በተነወሩ ጊዜ አንደበቴ ደግሞ ሁልጊዜ ጽድቅህን ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: [ for Solomon.] Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህን ለንጉሥ ስጥ፥ ጽድቅህንም ለንጉሥ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህን በጽድቅ፥ ችግረኞችህንም በፍርድ ይዳኝ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮችና ኰረብቶች ለሕዝብህ ሰላምን ይቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.text_amharic: ለችግረኞች ሕዝብ በጽድቅ ትፈርዳለህ የድሆችንም ልጆች ታድናለህ፤ ክፉውንም ታዋርደዋለህ።

verses.text_english: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ በሚኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ፥ በጨረቃም ፊት ለፊት ለልጅ ልጅ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers water the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ዝናብ በታጨደ መስክ ላይ፥ በምድርም ላይ እንደሚንጠባጠብ ጠብታ ይወርዳል።

verses.text_english: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.text_amharic: በዘመኑም ጽድቅ ያብባል፥ ጨረቃም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ ሰላም ብዙ ነው።

verses.text_english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሕር እስከ ባሕር ድረስ፥ ከወንዝም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ይገዛል።

verses.text_english: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱም ኢትዮጵያ ይሰግዳሉ፥ ጠላቶቹም አፈር ይልሳሉ።

verses.text_english: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.text_amharic: የተርሴስና የደሴቶች ነገሥታት ስጦታን ያመጣሉ፤ የዓረብና የሳባ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ያቀርባሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሥታት ሁሉ ይሰግዱለታል። አሕዛብም ሁሉ ይገዙለታል።

verses.text_english: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and that hath no helper.
verses.text_amharic: ችግረኛውን ከቀማኛው እጅ፥ ረዳት የሌለውንም ምስኪን ያድነዋልና።

verses.text_english: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.text_amharic: ለችግረኛና ለምስኪን ይራራል፥ የችግረኞችንም ነፍስ ያድናል።

verses.text_english: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.text_amharic: ከግፍና ከጭንቀት ነፍሳቸውን ያድናል፤ ስማቸው በፊቱ ክቡር ነው።

verses.text_english: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; daily shall he be praised.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ይኖራል ከዓረብም ወርቅ ይሰጡታል፤ ሁልጊዜም ወደ እርሱ ይጸልያሉ፥ ዘወትርም ይባርኩታል።

verses.text_english: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ውስጥ በተራሮች ላይ መጠጊያ ይሆናል፤ ፍሬውም ከሊባኖስ ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ እንደ ምድር ሣር በከተማ ይበቅላል።

verses.text_english: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙ ለዘላለም ቡሩክ ይሆናል፥ ከፀሐይም አስቀድሞ ስሙ ይኖራል፤ የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ በእርሱ ይባረካሉም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.text_amharic: ብቻውን ተአምራትን የሚያደርግ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.text_english: And blessed his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.text_amharic: የምስጋናው ስም ለዓለምና ለዘላለም ይባረክ፤ ምስጋናውም ምድርን ሁሉ ይምላ። ይሁን፤ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.text_amharic: የእሴይ ልጅ የዳዊት መዝሙር ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of Asaph.] Truly God good to Israel, to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው ለቀና ለእስራኤል እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ቸር ነው።

verses.text_english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እግሮቼ ሊሰናከሉ፥ አረማመዴም ሊወድቅ ትንሽ ቀረ።

verses.text_english: For I was envious at the foolish, I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአተኞችን ሰላም አይቼ በዓመፀኞች ቀንቼ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: For no bands in their death: but their strength firm.
verses.text_amharic: ለሞታቸው መጣጣር የለውምና፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠንካራ ነውና።

verses.text_english: They not in trouble men; neither are they plagued like men.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሰው በድካም አልሆኑም፥ ከሰው ጋርም አልተገረፉም።

verses.text_english: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them a garment.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ትዕቢት ያዛቸው፤ ኃጢአትንና በደልን ተጐናጸፉአት።

verses.text_english: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይናቸው ስብ ስለ ሆነ ወጣ፤ ልባቸውም ከምኞታቸው ይልቅ አገኘ።

verses.text_english: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.text_amharic: አስበው ክፉ ነገርን ተናገሩ። ከፍ ከፍ ብለውም በዓመፃ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አፋቸውን በሰማይ አኖሩ፥ አንደበታቸውም በምድር ውስጥ ተመላለሰ።

verses.text_english: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full are wrung out to them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሕዝቤ ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ፤ ፍጹም ጊዜም በላያቸው ይገኛል፤

verses.text_english: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ያውቃል? በልዑልስ ዘንድ በውኑ እውቀት አለ? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, these the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase riches.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ ኃጢአተኞች ይደሰታሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ባለጠግነታቸውን ያበዛሉ።

verses.text_english: Verily I have cleansed my heart vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አልሁ። በውኑ ልቤን በከንቱ አጸደቅሁ፥ እጆቼንም በንጽሕና በከንቱ አጠብሁ።

verses.text_english: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜም የተገረፍሁ ሆንሁ፥ መሰደቤም በማለዳ ነው።

verses.text_english: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend the generation of thy children.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ብዬ ብናገር ኖሮ፥ እነሆ፥ የልጆችህን ትውልድ በበደልሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: When I thought to know this, it too painful for me;
verses.text_amharic: አውቅም ዘንድ አሰብሁ፥ ይህ ግን በፊቴ ችግር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; understood I their end.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅደስ እስክገባ ድረስ፥ ፍጻሜአቸውንም እስካስተውል ድረስ።

verses.text_english: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.text_amharic: በድጥ ስፍራ አስቀመጥኻቸው፥ ወደ ጥፋትም ጣልኻቸው።

verses.text_english: How are they into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.text_amharic: እንዴት ለጥፋት ሆኑ! በድንገት አለቁ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ጠፉ።

verses.text_english: As a dream when awaketh; , O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕልም እንደሚነቃ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስትነቃ ምልክታቸውን ታስነውራለህ።

verses.text_english: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ነድዶአልና፥ ኵላሊቴም ቀልጦአልና፤

verses.text_english: So foolish I, and ignorant: I was a beast before thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የተናቅሁ ነኝ አላውቅሁምም፥ በአንተ ዘንድም እንደ እንስሳ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless I continually with thee: thou hast holden by my right hand.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ዘወትር ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፥ ቀኝ እጄንም ያዝኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me glory.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ምክር መራኸኝ፤ ከክብር ጋር ተቀበልኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Whom have I in heaven ? and none upon earth I desire beside thee.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይ ያለኝ ምንድር ነው? በምድርስ ውስጥ ከአንተ ዘንድ ምን እሻለሁ?

verses.text_english: My flesh and my heart faileth: God the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የልቤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልቤና ሥጋዬ አለቀ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታዬ ነው።

verses.text_english: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከአንተ የሚርቁ ይጠፋሉና ከአንተ ርቀው የሚያመነዝሩትንም ሁሉ አጠፋኻቸው።

verses.text_english: But good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔ ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅረብ ይሻለኛል፤ መታመኛዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው በጽዮን ልጅ በሮች ምስጋናህን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: [Maschil of Asaph.] O God, why hast thou cast off for ever? doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ምን ለዘወትር ጣልኸኝ? በማሰማርያህ በጎች ላይስ ቍጣህን ስለ ምን ተቈጣህ?

verses.text_english: Remember thy congregation, thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድመህ የፈጠርሃትን ማኅበርህን፥ የተቤዤሃትንም የርስትህን በትር፥ በእርስዋ ያደርህባትን የጽዮንን ተራራ አስብ።

verses.text_english: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; all the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላት በቅዱሳንህ ላይ እንደ ከፋ መጠን፥ ሁልጊዜም በትዕቢታቸው ላይ እጅህን አንሣ።

verses.text_english: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns signs.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶችህ በበዓል መካከል ተመኩ፤ የማያውቁትንም ምልክት ምልክታቸው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ላይኛው መግቢያ ውስጥ በዱር እንዳሉም እንጨቶች፥ በመጥረቢያ በሮችዋን ሰበሩ።

verses.text_english: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ በመጥረቢያና በመዶሻ ሰበሩአት።

verses.text_english: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: መቅደስህን በእሳት አቃጠሉ፤ የስምህንም ማደሪያ በምድር ውስጥ አረከሱ።

verses.text_english: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሆነው በልባቸው በየሕዝባቸው። ኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን በዓሎች ከምድር እንሻር አሉ።

verses.text_english: We see not our signs: no more any prophet: neither among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.text_amharic: ምልክታችንን አናይም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ነቢይ የለም፤ እስከ መቼ እንዲኖር የሚያውቅ በኛ ዘንድ የለም።

verses.text_english: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጠላት እስከ መቼ ይሳደባል? ስምህን ጠላት ሁልጊዜ ያቃልላልን?

verses.text_english: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck out of thy bosom.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኝህንም በብብትህ መካከል፥ እጅህንም ፈጽመህ ለምን ትመልሳለህ?

verses.text_english: For God my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን ከዓለም አስቀድሞ ንጉሥ ነው፥ በምድርም መካከል መድኃኒትን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ባሕርን በኃይልህ አጸናሃት፤ አንተ የእባቦችን ራስ በውኃ ውስጥ ሰበርህ።

verses.text_english: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, gavest him meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የዘንዶውን ራሶች ቀጠቀጥህ፤ ለኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ምግባቸውን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ምንጮቹንና ፈሳሾቹን ሰነጠቅህ፤ አንተ ሁልጊዜ የሚፈስሱትን ወንዞች አደረቅህ።

verses.text_english: The day thine, the night also thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኑ የአንተ ነው ሌሊቱም የአንተ ነው፤ አንተ ፀሓዩንና ጨረቃውን አዘጋጀህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የምድርን ዳርቻ ሁሉ ሠራህ፤ በጋንም ክረምትንም አንተ አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: Remember this, the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ፍጥረትህን አስብ። ጠላት እግዚአብሔርን ተላገደ፥ ሰነፍ ሕዝብም ስሙን አስቈጣ።

verses.text_english: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude : forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የምትገዛልህን ነፍስ ለአራዊት አትስጣት፤ የችግረኞችህን ነፍስ ለዘወትር አትርሳ።

verses.text_english: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኪዳንህ ተመልከት፥ የምድር የጨለማ ስፍራዎች በኅጥኣን ቤቶች ተሞልተዋልና።

verses.text_english: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ችግረኛ አፍሮ አይመለስ፤ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.text_english: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ በቀልህንም ተበቀል፤ ሰነፎች ሁልጊዜም የተላገዱህን አስብ።

verses.text_english: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎችህን ቃል አትርሳ፤ የጠላቶችህ ኵራት ሁልጊዜ ወደ አንተ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm Song of Asaph.] Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, do we give thanks: for thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እናመሰግንሃለን እናመሰግንሃለን ስምህንም እንጠራለን፤ ተኣምራትህን ሁሉ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.text_amharic: ጊዜውን ስቀበል እኔ በቅን እፈርዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርና በእርስዋ ውስጥ የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ቀለጡ፥ እኔም ምሰሶችዋን አጠናሁ።

verses.text_english: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፀኞችን። አትበድሉ አልኋቸው፥ ኃጢአተኞችንም። ቀንዳችሁን አታንሡ፤

verses.text_english: Lift not up your horn on high: speak a stiff neck.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንዳችሁን እስከ ላይ አታንሡ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ዓመፅን አትናገሩ።

verses.text_english: For promotion neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.text_amharic: ክብር ከምሥራቅ ወይም ከምዕራብ ወይም ከምድረ በዳ የለምና፤

verses.text_english: But God the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፈራጅ ነውና ይህን ያዋርዳል ይህንም ያከብራል።

verses.text_english: For in the hand of the LORD a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring out, drink .
verses.text_amharic: ጽዋ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ነውና፤ ያልተቀላቀለ የወይን ጠጅ ሞላበት፤ ከዚህ ወደዚያ አገላበጠው፥ ነገር ግን አተላው አልፈሰሰም፤ የምድር ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ ይጠጡታል።

verses.text_english: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ለዘላለም ደስ ይለኛል፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ ዝማሬን አቀርባለሁ።

verses.text_english: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: የኅጥኣንን ቀንዶች ሁሉ እሰብራለሁ፤ የጻድቃን ቀንዶች ግን ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm Song of Asaph.] In Judah God known: his name great in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በይሁዳ ታወቀ፥ ስሙም በእስራኤል ታላቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ስፍራው በሳሌም፥ ማደሪያውም በጽዮን ነው።

verses.text_english: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የቀስትን ኃይል፥ ጋሻን ሰይፍን ሰልፍንም ሰበረ፤ በዚያም ቀንዶችን ሰበረ።

verses.text_english: Thou more glorious excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በዘላለም ተራሮች ሆነህ በድንቅ ታበራለህ።

verses.text_english: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ልበ ሰነፎች ሁሉ ደነገጡ፥ እንቅልፋቸውንም አንቀላፉ፤ ባለጠጎች ሁሉ በእነርሱ እጅ ምንም አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከተግሣጽህ የተነሣ ፈረሰኞች ሁሉ አንቀላፉ።

verses.text_english: Thou, thou, to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ አንተ ግሩም ነህ፤ ቍጣህን ማን ይቃወማል?

verses.text_english: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድን ከሰማይ አሰማህ፤ ምድር ፈራች ዝምም አለች፥

verses.text_english: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ልበ የዋሃን ያድን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ለፍርድ በተነሣ ጊዜ።

verses.text_english: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በፈቃዱ ያመሰግንሃልና፥ ከሕሊናቸው ትርፍም በዓልህን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለትን ክፈሉ፤ በዙሪያው ያሉ ሁሉ እጅ መንሻን ለሚያስፈራው ያገባሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የመኳንንትን ነፍስ ያወጣል፤ በምድርም ነገሥታት ዘንድ ያስፈራል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.] I cried unto God with my voice, unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.text_amharic: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ ቃሌም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ እርሱም አደመጠኝ።

verses.text_english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራዬ ቀን እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት፤ እጆቼ በሌሊት በፊቱ ናቸው፥ አላረፍሁምም፥ ነፍሴም መጽናናትን አልቻለችም።

verses.text_english: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አሰብሁት ደስ አለኝም፤ ተናገርሁ፥ ነፍሴም ፈዘዘች።

verses.text_english: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቼ እንዲተጉ ያዝሃቸው፤ ደነገጥሁ አልተናገርሁም።

verses.text_english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.text_amharic: የዱሮውን ዘመን አሰብሁ፤ የዘላለሙን ዓመታት አሰብሁ፤ አጠናጠንሁም

verses.text_english: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊት ከልቤ ጋር ተጫወትሁ፥ ነፍሴንም አነቃቃኋት።

verses.text_english: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይጥላልን? እንግዲህስ ቸርነቱን አይጨምርምን?

verses.text_english: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth promise fail for evermore?
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለምስ ምሕረቱ ለልጅ ልጅ ተቈረጠችን? የተናገረውስ ቃል አልቆአልን?

verses.text_english: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርስ ሞገሱን ረሳን? በቍጣውስ ምሕረቱን ዘጋውን?

verses.text_english: And I said, This my infirmity: the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ድካሜ ነው አልሁ፥ የልዑል ቀኝ እንደ ተለወጠ።

verses.text_english: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ አስታወስሁ፤ የቀደመውን ተአምራትህን አስታወሳለሁና፤

verses.text_english: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.text_amharic: በምግባርህም ሁሉ እናገራለሁ፥ በሥራህም እጫወታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thy way, O God, in the sanctuary: who great a God as God?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ነው፤ እንደ አምላካችን ያለ ታላቅ አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Thou the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.text_amharic: ተኣምራትን የምታደርግ አምላክ አንተ ነህ። ለሕዝብህ ኃይልን አስታወቅሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast with arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብንና የዮሴፍን ልጆች፥ ሕዝብህን በክንድህ አዳንሃቸው።

verses.text_english: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ውኆች አዩህ፥ ውኆችም አይተውህ ፈሩ፤ ጥልቆች ተነዋወጡ፥ ውኆችም ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.text_amharic: ደመኖች ድምፅን ሰጡ፥ ፍላጾችህም ወጡ።

verses.text_english: The voice of thy thunder in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.text_amharic: የነጐድጓድህ ድምፅ በዐውሎ ነበረ፤ መብረቆች ለዓለም አበሩ፤ ምድር ተናወጠች ተንቀጠቀጠችም።

verses.text_english: Thy way in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድህ በባህር ውስጥ ነው፥ ፍለጋህም በብዙ ውኆች ነው፥ አረማመድህም አልታወቀም።

verses.text_english: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.text_amharic: በሙሴና በአሮን እጅ ሕዝብህን እንደ በጎች መራሃቸው።

verses.text_english: [Maschil of Asaph.] Give ear, O my people, my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ሕጌን አድምጡ፤ ጆሮአችሁንም ወደ አፌ ቃል አዘንብሉ።

verses.text_english: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.text_amharic: አፌን በምሳሌ እከፍታለሁ፤ ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ፥ ያለውንም ተምሳሊት እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማነውንና ያውቅነውን፥ አባቶቻችንም የነገሩንን፥ ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ከልጆቻቸው አልሰወሩም።

verses.text_english: We will not hide from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋናና ኃይሉን ያደረገውንም ተኣምራት ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.text_amharic: ለልጆቻቸው ያስታውቅ ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን ያዘዘውን ምስክር በያዕቆብ አቆመ፥ በእስራኤልም ሕግን ሠራ፤

verses.text_english: That the generation to come might know the children should be born; should arise and declare to their children:
verses.text_amharic: የሚመጣ፥ ትውልድ የሚወለዱም ልጆች ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ ተነሥተው ለልጆቻቸው ይነግራሉ፤

verses.text_english: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋቸውን በእግዚአብሔር እንዲያደርጉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እንዳይረሱ፥ ትእዛዙንም እንዲጠብቁ፤

verses.text_english: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አባቶቻቸው እንዳይሆኑ ጠማማና የምታስመርር ትውልድ፥ ልብዋን ያላቀናች ትውልድ፥ ነፍስዋ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያልታመነች።

verses.text_english: The children of Ephraim, armed, carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬም ልጆች ለሰልፍ ታጥቀው ቀስትንም ገትረው በሰልፍ ቀን ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ኪዳን አልጠበቁም፥ በሕጉም ለመመላለስ እንቢ አሉ፤

verses.text_english: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ሥራውንና ያሳያቸውን ተኣምራቱን ረሱ፥

verses.text_english: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, the field of Zoan.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽ አገርና በጣኔዎስ በረሃ በአባቶቻቸው ፊት የሠራውን ተኣምራት።

verses.text_english: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.text_amharic: ባሕርን ከፍሎ አሳለፋቸው፤ ውኆችን እንደ ክምር አቆመ።

verses.text_english: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.text_amharic: ቀን በደመና መራቸው፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ በእሳት ብርሃን።

verses.text_english: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave drink as the great depths.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለቱን በምድረ በዳ ሰነጠቀ፤ ከጥልቅ እንደሚገኝ ያህል በብዙ አጠጣቸው።

verses.text_english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃን ከጭንጫ አወጣ፥ ውኃንም እንደ ወንዞች አፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይበድሉት ዘንድ እንደ ገና ደገሙ፥ ልዑልንም በምድረ በዳ አስቈጡት።

verses.text_english: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.text_amharic: ለነፍሳቸው መብልን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን በልባቸው ፈተኑት።

verses.text_english: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ ብለው አሙት። እግዚአብሔር በምድረ በዳ ማዕድን ያሰናዳ ዘንድ ይችላልን?

verses.text_english: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.text_amharic: ዓለቱን መታ፤ ውኆችም ወጡ፥ ወንዞችም ጐረፉ፤ እንጀራን መስጠትስ ይችላልን? ለሕዝቡስ ማዕድን ያዘጋጃልን?

verses.text_english: Therefore the LORD heard , and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ በያዕቆብም ላይ እሳት ነደደ፥ መዓትም በእስራኤል ላይ መጣ፤

verses.text_english: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር አላመኑምና፥ በመድኃኒቱም አልተማመኑምና።

verses.text_english: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.text_amharic: ደመናውንም ከላይ አዘዘ፥ የሰማይንም ደጆች ከፈተ፤

verses.text_english: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ይበሉም ዘንድ መናን አዘነበላቸው፥ የሰማይንም እንጀራ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.text_amharic: የመላክትንም እንጀራ ሰው በላ ስንቅንም እስኪተርፋቸው ላከላቸው።

verses.text_english: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይ የምሥራቅን ነፋስ አስነሣ፥ በኃይሉም የደቡብን ነፋስ አመጣ፤

verses.text_english: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋን እንደ አፈር፥ የሚበርሩትንም ወፎች እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ አዘነበላቸው፤

verses.text_english: And he let fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.text_amharic: በሰፈራቸው መካከል፥ በድንኳናቸውም ዙሪያ ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.text_amharic: በሉ እጅግም ጠገቡ፤ ምኞታቸውንም ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat yet in their mouths,
verses.text_amharic: ከወደዱትም አላሳጣቸውም፤ መብላቸውም ገና በአፋቸው ሳለ፥

verses.text_english: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በላያቸው መጣ፥ ከእነርሱም ከፍ ያሉትን ገደለ፥ የእስራኤልንም ምርጦች አሰናከለ።

verses.text_english: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር እንደ ገና በደሉ፥ ተኣምራቱንም አላመኑም፤

verses.text_english: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኖቻቸውም በከንቱ አለቁ፥ ዓመቶቻቸውም በችኰላ።

verses.text_english: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.text_amharic: በገደላቸውም ጊዜ ወዲያው ፈለጉት፤ ተመለሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ገሠገሡ፤

verses.text_english: And they remembered that God their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.text_amharic: ረዳታቸውም እግዚአብሔር፥ መድኃኒታቸውም ልዑል አምላክ እንደ ሆነ አሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መሓሪ ነው፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አላቸው፥ አላጠፋቸውምም፤ ቍጣውንም መመለስ አበዛ፥ መዓቱንም ሁሉ አላቃጠለም።

verses.text_english: But he, full of compassion, forgave iniquity, and destroyed not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥቶ የማይመለስ መንፈስ፥ ሥጋም እንደ ሆኑ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: For he remembered that they flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ ምን ያህል አስቈጡት፥ በበረሃም አሳዘኑት።

verses.text_english: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, grieve him in the desert!
verses.text_amharic: ተመለሱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ፈተኑት፥ የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ አሳዘኑት።

verses.text_english: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም እጁን አላሰቡም፥ ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ያዳነበትን ቀን፥

verses.text_english: They remembered not his hand, the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽ ያደረገውን ተኣምራቱን፥ በጣኔዎስም በረሃ ያደረገውን ድንቁን።

verses.text_english: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.text_amharic: ወንዞቻቸውንም ወደ ደም ለወጠ፥ ምንጮቻቸውን ደግሞ እንዳይጠጡ።

verses.text_english: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.text_amharic: ዝንቦችንም በላያቸው ሰደደባቸው፥ በሉአቸውም፤ በጓጉንቸርም አጠፋቸው።

verses.text_english: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬያቸውን ለኩብኩባ፥ ሥራቸውንም ለአንበጣ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.text_amharic: ወይናቸውን በበረዶ፥ በለሳቸውንም በአመዳይ አጠፋ።

verses.text_english: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶቻቸውን ለበረዶ፥ ሀብታቸውንም ለእሳት ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.text_amharic: የመዓቱን መቅሠፍት በላያቸው ሰደደ፤ መቅሠፍትን መዓትንም መከራንም በክፉዎች መላእክት ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels .
verses.text_amharic: ለቍጣው መንገድን ጠረገ፤ ነፍሳቸውንም ከሞት አላዳናትም፥ እንስሶቻቸውንም በሞት ውስጥ ዘጋ፤

verses.text_english: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.text_amharic: በኵሮቻቸውን ሁሉ በግብጽ፥ የድካማቸውንም መጀመሪያ በካም ድንኳኖች ገደለ።

verses.text_english: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡን ግን እንደ በጎች አሰማራቸው፥ እንደ መንጋም በምድረ በዳ መራቸው።

verses.text_english: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.text_amharic: በተስፋም መራቸው አልፈሩምም፥ ጠላቶቻቸውንም ባሕር ደፈናቸው።

verses.text_english: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደሱም ተራራ አገባቸው፥ ቀኙ ወደ ፈጠረችው ወደዚህች ተራራ፤

verses.text_english: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, this mountain, his right hand had purchased.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊታቸውም አሕዛብን አባረረ፥ ርስቱንም በገመድ አካፈላቸው፥ የእስራኤልንም ወገኖች በቤታቸው አኖረ።

verses.text_english: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ልዑል እግዚአብሔርን ፈተኑት አስቈጡትም፥ ምስክሩንም አልጠበቁም፤

verses.text_english: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.text_amharic: ተመለሱም እንደ አባቶቻቸውም ከዱ፤ እንደ ጠማማ ቀስትም ተገለበጡ፤

verses.text_english: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.text_amharic: በኰረብታ መስገጃዎቻቸውም አስቈጡት፥ በተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውም አስቀኑት።

verses.text_english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፥ እስራኤልንም እጅግ ናቀ፤

verses.text_english: When God heard , he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.text_amharic: የሴሎምን ማደሪያ ተዋት በሰዎች መካከል ያደረገባትን ድንኳኑን፤

verses.text_english: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he placed among men;
verses.text_amharic: ኃይላቸውን ለምርኮ፥ ሽልማቱንም በጠላት እጅ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም በጦር ውስጥ ዘጋቸው፥ ርስቱንም ቸል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሶቻቸውን እሳት በላቸው፥ ቈነጃጅቶቻቸውም አላዘኑም፤

verses.text_english: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቶቻቸውም በሰይፍ ወደቁ፥ ባልቴቶቻቸውም አላለቀሱላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእንቅልፍ እንደሚነቃ ተነሣ፥ የወይን ስካር እንደ ተወው እንደ ኃያልም ሰው፤

verses.text_english: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቹንም በኋላቸው መታ፤ የዘላለምን ኀሣር ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴፍንም ድንኳን ተዋት፥ የኤፍሬምንም ወገን አልመረጠውም፤

verses.text_english: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳን ወገን ግን መረጠ፥ የወደደውን የጽዮንን ተራራ።

verses.text_english: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.text_amharic: መቅደሱን እንደ አርያም ሠራ፥ ለዘላለምም በምድር ውስጥ መሠረታት።

verses.text_english: And he built his sanctuary like high , like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትንም ባሪያውን መረጠው፥ ከበጎቹም መንጋ ውስጥ ወሰደው፤

verses.text_english: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
[A Psalm of Asaph.] O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ወደ ርስትህ ገቡ፤ የቅድስናህንም መቅደስ አረከሱ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም እንደ መደብ አደረጉአት።

verses.text_english: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎችህንም በድኖች ለሰማይ ወፎች መብል አደረጉ፥ የጻድቃንህንም ሥራ ለምድር አራዊት፤

verses.text_english: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and none to bury .
verses.text_amharic: ደማቸውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ውኃ አፈሰሱ፥ የሚቀብራቸውም አጡ።

verses.text_english: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.text_amharic: ለጎረቤቶቻችንም ስድብ ሆንን፥ በዙሪያችንም ላሉ ሣቅና ዘበት።

verses.text_english: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘላለም ትቈጣለህ? ቅንዓትህም እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል?

verses.text_english: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህን በማይጠሩ መንግሥታት ላይ በማያውቁህም አሕዛብ ላይ መዓትህን አፍስስ፤

verses.text_english: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥ ስፍራውንም ባድማ አድርገዋልና።

verses.text_english: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.text_amharic: የቀደመውን በደላችንን አታስብብን፥ ምሕረትህ በቶሎ ታግኘን፥ እጅግ ተቸግረናልና።

verses.text_english: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንና መድኃኒታችን ሆይ፥ እርዳን፤ ስለ ስምህ ክብር፥ አቤቱ፥ ታደገን፥ ስለ ስምህም ኃጢአታችንን አስተሰርይልን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight the revenging of the blood of thy servants shed.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ፥ አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? እንዳይሉ፥ የፈሰሰውን የባሪያዎችህን ደም በቀል በዓይኖቻችን ፊት አሕዛብ ያወቁ፤

verses.text_english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.text_amharic: የእስረኞች ጩኸት ወደ ፊትህ ይግባ፤ እንደ ክንድህም ታላቅነት ሊገደሉ የተፈረደባቸውን አድን።

verses.text_english: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የተዘባበቱብህን መዘባበታቸውን ለጎረቤቶቻችን ሰባት እጥፍ በብብታቸው ክፈላቸው።

verses.text_english: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ሕዝብህ ግን፥ የማሰማርያህም በጎች፥ ለዘላለም እናመሰግንሃለን፤ ለልጅ ልጅም ምስጋናህን እንናገራለን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.] Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍን እንደ መንጋ የምትመራ፥ የእስራኤል ጠባቂ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ፥ ተገለጥ።

verses.text_english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come save us.
verses.text_amharic: በኤፍሬምና በብንያም በምናሴም፤ ኃይልህን አንሣ እኛንም ለማዳን ና።

verses.text_english: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.text_english: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ በባሪያህ ጸሎት ላይ እስከ መቼ ትቈጣለህ?

verses.text_english: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.text_amharic: የእንባ እንጀራን ትመግበናለህ፥ እንባም በስፍር ታጠጣናለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ለጎረቤቶቻችን ክርክር አደረግኸን፥ ጠላቶቻችንም በላያችን ተሣለቁብን።

verses.text_english: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.text_english: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽ የወይን ግንድ አመጣህ፤ አሕዛብን አባረርህ እርስዋንም ተከልህ።

verses.text_english: Thou preparedst before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.text_amharic: በፊትዋም ስፍራን አዘጋጀህ፥ ሥሮችዋንም ተከልህ ምድርንም ሞላች።

verses.text_english: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof the goodly cedars.
verses.text_amharic: ጥላዋ ተራሮችን ከደነ፥ ጫፎችዋም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ዝግባ ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.text_amharic: ቅርንጫፎችዋንም እስከ ባሕር፥ ቡቃያዋንም እስከ ወንዙ ዘረጋች።

verses.text_english: Why hast thou broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.text_amharic: አጥርዋን ለምን አፈረስህ? መንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ ይቀጥፋታል።

verses.text_english: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.text_amharic: የዱር እርያ አረከሳት፥ የአገር አውሬም ተሰማራባት።

verses.text_english: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ተመለስ፤ ከሰማይ ተመልከት፥ እይም፥ ይህችንም የወይን ግንድ ጐብኝ።

verses.text_english: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ልጅ ለአንተ ያጸናኸውን ቀኝህ የተከላትን አንሣ።

verses.text_english: burned with fire, cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.text_amharic: በእሳት ተቃጥላለች ተነቅላማለች፤ ከፊትህ ተግሣጽም የተነሣ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንተ ባጸናኸው በሰው ልጅ ላይ፥ በቀኝህ ሰው ላይ እጅህ ትሁን።

verses.text_english: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተም አንራቅ፤ አድነን ስምህንም እንጠራለን።

verses.text_english: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, of Asaph.] Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: በረድኤታችን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ እልል በሉ።

verses.text_english: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.text_amharic: ዝማሬውን አንሡ ከበሮንም ስጡ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን በገና ከመሰንቆ ጋር፤

verses.text_english: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.text_amharic: በመባቻ ቀን በከፍተኛው በዓላችን ቀን መለከትን ንፉ፤

verses.text_english: For this a statute for Israel, a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ሥርዓቱ ነውና፥ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ፍርድ።

verses.text_english: This he ordained in Joseph a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: I heard a language I understood not.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽ በወጣ ጊዜ ለዮሴፍ ምስክር አቆመው። ያላወቅሁትን ቋንቋ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.text_amharic: ጫንቃውን ከሸክም፥ እጆቹንም በቅርጫት ከመገዛት አራቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራህ ጊዜ ጠራኸኝ አዳንሁህም፥ በተሰወረ ዐውሎም መለስሁልህ፥ በክርክር ውኃ ዘንድም ፈተንሁህ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ስማኝ እነግርሃለሁም፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እመሰክርልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.text_amharic: አንተስ ብትሰማኝ ሌላ አምላክ አይሆንልህም፥ ለሌላ አምላክም አትሰግድም።

verses.text_english: I the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣሁህ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ነኝና፤ አፍህን አስፋ እሞላዋለሁም።

verses.text_english: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ግን ቃሌን አልሰሙኝም፥ እስራኤልም አላዳመጠኝም።

verses.text_english: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: they walked in their own counsels.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ልባቸው ሥራ ተውኋቸው፥ በልባቸውም አሳብ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤስ ሰምቶኝ ቢሆን፥ እስራኤልም በመንገዴ ሄደው ቢሆን፤

verses.text_english: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቻቸውን ፈጥኜ ባዋረድኋቸው ነበር፥ በሚያስጨንቋቸውም ላይ እጄን በጣልሁ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶችም በተገዙለት ነበር፥ ዘመናቸውም ለዘላለም በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከስንዴም ስብ ባበላቸው ነበር፥ ከዓለቱም ማር ባጠገባቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of Asaph.] God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአማልክት ማኅበር ቆመ፥ በአማልክትም መካከል ይፈርዳል።

verses.text_english: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መቼ ሐሰትን ትፈርዳላችሁ? እስከ መቼ ለኃጢአተኞች ፊት ታደላላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.text_amharic: ለድሆችና ለድሀ አደጎች ፍረዱ፤ ለችግረኛውና ለምስኪኑ ጽድቅ አድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: Deliver the poor and needy: rid out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ብቸኛውንና ችግረኛውን አድኑ፤ ከኃጢአተኞችም እጅ አስጥሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.text_amharic: አያውቁም፥ አያስተውሉም፤ በጨለማ ውስጥ ይመላለሳሉ፤ የምድር መሠረቶች ሁሉ ተናወጡ።

verses.text_english: I have said, Ye gods; and all of you children of the most High.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን። አማልክት ናችሁ፥ ሁላችሁም የልዑል ልጆች ናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንደ ሰው ትሞታላችሁ፥ ከአለቆችም እንደ አንዱ ትወድቃላችሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፥ በምድር ላይ ፍርድ፥ አንተ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ትወርሳለህና።

verses.text_english: [A Song Psalm of Asaph.] Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው? አቤቱ፥ ዝም አትበል፥ ቸልም አትበል።

verses.text_english: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጠላቶችህ ጮኽዋልና፥ የሚጠሉህም ራሳቸውን አንሥተዋልና።

verses.text_english: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህን በምክር ሸነገሉአቸው፥ በቅዱሳንህም ላይ ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ ከሕዝብ እናጥፋቸው፥ ደግሞም የእስራኤል ስም አይታሰብ አሉ።

verses.text_english: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሆነው በአንተ ላይ ተማከሩ፤ በአንተ ላይ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ፤

verses.text_english: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶማውያን ድንኳኖች እስማኤላውያንም፥ ሞዓብም አጋራውያንም፥

verses.text_english: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.text_amharic: ጌባል አሞንም አማሌቅም፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከጢሮስ ሰዎች ጋር፤

verses.text_english: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: አሦርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተባበረ፥ ለሎጥ ልጆችም ረዳት ሆኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: Do unto them as the Midianites; as Sisera, as Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምድያምና እንደ ሲሣራ፥ በቂሶንም ወንዝ እንደ ኢያቢስ አድርግባቸው።

verses.text_english: perished at Endor: they became dung for the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይንዶር ጠፉ፥ እንደ ምድርም ጕድፍ ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቻቸውን እንደ ሔሬብና እንደ ዜብ፥ ታላላቆቻቸውንም እንደ ዛብሄልና እንደ ስልማና አድርጋቸው።

verses.text_english: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ እንወርሳለን የሚሉትን።

verses.text_english: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እንደ ትቢያ በነፋስ ፊትም እንደ ገለባ አድርጋቸው።

verses.text_english: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.text_amharic: እሳት ዱርን እንደሚያቃጥል፥ ነበልባልም ተራሮች እንደሚያነድድ፥

verses.text_english: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ በቍጣህ አሳድዳቸው፥ በመቅሠፍትህም አስደንግጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ፊታቸውን እፍረት ሙላው፥ አቤቱ፥ ስምህንም ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.text_amharic: ይፈሩ ለዘላለሙም ይታወኩ፤ ይጐስቍሉ ይጥፉም።

verses.text_english: That may know that thou, whose name alone JEHOVAH, the most high over all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ፥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይም አንተ ብቻ ልዑል እንደ ሆንህ ይወቁ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] How amiable thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ ማደሪያዎችህ እንደምን የተወደዱ ናቸው!

verses.text_english: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ የእግዚአብሔርን አደባባዮች ትወድዳለች ትናፍቅማለች፤ ልቤም ሥጋዬም በሕያው አምላክ ደስ ተሰኘ።

verses.text_english: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.text_amharic: ወፍ ለእርስዋ ቤትን አገኘች፥ ዋኖስም ጫጩቶችዋን የምታኖርበት ቤት አገኘች፤ የሠራዊት አምላክ ንጉሤም አምላኬም ሆይ፥ እርሱ መሠዊያህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Blessed they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በቤትህ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው፤ ለዓለምና ለዘላለምም ያመሰግኑሃል።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man whose strength in thee; in whose heart the ways .
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እርዳታው ከአንተ ዘንድ የሆነለት፥ በልቡም የላይኛውን መንገድ የሚያስብ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.text_amharic: በልቅሶ ሸለቆ ውስጥ በወሰነው ስፍራ የሕግ መምህር በረከትን ይሰጣልና።

verses.text_english: They go from strength to strength, in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃይል ወደ ኃይል ይሄዳሉ፤ የአማልክት አምላክ በጽዮን ይታያል።

verses.text_english: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ።

verses.text_english: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መታመናችንን እይልን፥ ወደ ቀባኸውም ፊት ተመልከት።

verses.text_english: For a day in thy courts better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: ከአእላፍ ይልቅ በአደባባዮችህ አንዲት ቀን ትሻላለች፤ በኃጥኣን ድንኳኖች ከመቀመጥ ይልቅ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እጣል ዘንድ መረጥሁ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD God a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ምሕረትንና እውነትን ስለ ወደደ፥ ሞገስንና ክብርን ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር በቅንነት የሚሄዱትን ከመልካም ነገር አያሳጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: O LORD of hosts, blessed the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ በአንተ የታመነ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ለምድርህ ሞገስን አደረግህ፥ የያዕቆብንም ምርኮ መለስህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝብህን ኃጢአት አስቀረህ፥ አበሳቸውንም ሁሉ ከደንህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.text_amharic: መዓትህንም ሁሉ አስወገድህ፤ ከቍጣህ መቅሠፍት ተመለስህ።

verses.text_english: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.text_amharic: የመድኃኒታችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ መልሰን፥ ቍጣህንም ከእኛ መልስ።

verses.text_english: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ለዘላለም ትቈጣናለህን? ቍጣህንስ ለልጅ ልጅ ታስረዝማለህን?

verses.text_english: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ትመለሳለህ ታድነንማለህ፤ ሕዝቡም በአንተ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን አሳየን፥ አቤቱ፥ መድኃኒትህንም ስጠን።

verses.text_english: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ የሚናገረውን እሰማለሁ፤ ሰላምን ለሕዝቡና ለቅዱሳኑ ልባቸውንም ወደ እርሱ ለሚመልሱ ይናገራልና።

verses.text_english: Surely his salvation nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ክብር በምድራችን ያድር ዘንድ ማዳኑ ለሚፈሩት ቅርብ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed .
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትና እውነት ተገናኙ፤ ጽድቅና ሰላም ተስማሙ።

verses.text_english: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት ከምድር በቀለች፥ ጽድቅም ከሰማይ ተመለከተች።

verses.text_english: Yea, the LORD shall give good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በጎ ነገርን ይሰጣል፥ ምድራችንም ፍሬዋን ትሰጣለች።

verses.text_english: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set in the way of his steps.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅ በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ ፍለጋውንም በመንገድ ውስጥ ያኖራል።

verses.text_english: [A Prayer of David.] Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I poor and needy.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል አድምጠኝም፥ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝና።

verses.text_english: Preserve my soul; for I holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱስ ነኝና ነፍሴን ጠብቅ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተን የታመነውን ባሪያህን አድነው።

verses.text_english: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ቀኑን ሁሉ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁና ማረኝ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያህን ነፍስ ደስ አሰኛት፥ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁና።

verses.text_english: For thou, Lord, good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነህና፥ ምሕረትህም ለሚጠሩህ ሁሉ ብዙ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጥ፥ የልመናዬንም ድምፅ ስማ።

verses.text_english: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.text_amharic: ትመልስልኛለህና በመከራዬ ቀን ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Among the gods none like unto thee, O Lord; neither like unto thy works.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከአማልክት የሚመስልህ የለም፥ እንደ ሥራህም ያለ የለም።

verses.text_english: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ያደረግሃቸው አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይመጣሉ፥ አቤቱ፥ በፊትህም ይሰግዳሉ፥ ስምህንም ያከብራሉ፤

verses.text_english: For thou great, and doest wondrous things: thou God alone.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ድንቅ የምታደርግ አንተ ታላቅ ነህና፥ አንተም ብቻህን ታላቅ አምላክ ነህና።

verses.text_english: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን ምራኝ፥ በእውነትህም እሄዳለሁ፤ ስምህን ለመፍራት ልቤ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም ስምህን አከብራለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For great thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህ በእኔ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥ ነፍሴንም ከታችኛይቱ ሲኦል አድነሃታልና።

verses.text_english: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ዓመፀኞች በእኔ ላይ ተነሥተዋል፥ የክፉዎችንም ማኅበር ነፍሴን ፈለጉአት፤ በፊታቸውም አላደረጉህም።

verses.text_english: But thou, O Lord, a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ግን መሓሪና ርኅሩኅ አምላክ ነህ፤ መዓትህ የራቀ ምሕረትህም እውነትህም የበዛ፤

verses.text_english: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኔ ተመልከት ማረኝም፤ ለባሪያህ ኃይልህን ስጥ፥ የሴት ባሪያህንም ልጅ አድን።

verses.text_english: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see , and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.text_amharic: ምልክትንም ለመልካም ከእኔ ጋር አድርግ፤ የሚጠሉኝ ይዩ ይፈሩም፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ረድተኸኛልና፥ አጽንተኸኛልምና።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm Song for the sons of Korah.] His foundation in the holy mountains.
verses.text_amharic: መሠረቶቹ በተቀደሱ ተራሮች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብ ድንኳኖች ይልቅ፥ እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ደጆች ይወድዳቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ከተማ ሆይ፥ በአንቺ የተከበረ ነገር ይባላል።

verses.text_english: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this was born there.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያውቁኝን ረዓብንና ባቢሎንን አስባቸዋለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ጢሮስም የኢትዮጵያም ሕዝብ፥ እነዚህ በዚያ ተወለዱ።

verses.text_english: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው እናታችን ጽዮን ይላል፥ በውስጥዋም ሰው ተወለደ፤ እርሱ ራሱም ልዑል መሠረታት።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, this was born there. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ፥ በውስጥዋም ለተወለዱት አለቆችዋ በመጽሐፍ ይነግራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: As well the singers as the players on instruments : all my springs in thee.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ደስ እንደሚላቸው ይነግራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: [A Song Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.] O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day night before thee:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ፥ በቀንና በሌሊት በፊትህ ጮኽሁ፤

verses.text_english: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትግባ፥ ጆሮህንም ወደ ጩኸቴ አዘንብል፤

verses.text_english: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ መከራን ጠግባለችና፥ ሕይወቴም ወደ ሲኦል ቀርባለችና።

verses.text_english: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man no strength:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጓድጓድ ከሚወርዱ ጋር ተቈጠርሁ፥ ረዳትም እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም እንደማታስባቸው፥ እንደ ተገደሉና በመቃብር ውስጥ እንደ ተጣሉ፥ በሙታን ውስጥ እንዳሉ የተጣልሁ ሆንሁ፤ እነርሱም ከእጅህ ተለዩ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.text_amharic: በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ውስጥ፥ በታችኛው ጕድጓድ አስቀመጥኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ላይ ቍጣህ ጸና፥ መቅሠፍትህን ሁሉ በእኔ ላይ አመጣህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያውቁኝን ከእኔ አራቅህ፤ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ርኵስ አደረግኸኝ፤ ያዙኝ፥ መውጫም የለኝም።

verses.text_english: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቼም በመከራ ፈዘዙ፤ አቤቱ፥ ሁልጊዜ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፥ እጆቼንም ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፥

verses.text_english: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise praise thee? Selah.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ለሙታን ተኣምራት ታደርጋለህን? የሞቱትስ ተነሥተው ያመሰግኑሃልን?

verses.text_english: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.text_amharic: በመቃብርስ ውስጥ ቸርነትህን፥ እውነትህንስ በጥፋት ስፍራ ይናገራሉን?

verses.text_english: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.text_amharic: ተአምራትህ በጨለማ፥ ጽድቅህንም በመርሳት ምድር ትታወቃለችን?

verses.text_english: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ በጥዋት ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትደርሳለች።

verses.text_english: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ለምን ትጥላለህ? ፊትህንስ ከእኔ ለምን ትሰውራለህ?

verses.text_english: I afflicted and ready to die from youth up: I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከታናሽነቴ ችግረኛ ለሞትም የቀረብሁ ነኝ፤ ከፍ ከፍ ካልሁ በኋላ ግን ተዋረድሁ ተናቅሁም።

verses.text_english: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.text_amharic: መቅሠፍትህ በላዬ አለፈ፥ ግርማህም አስደነገጠኝ።

verses.text_english: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ እንደ ውኃ ከበቡኝ፥ በአንድነትም ያዙኝ።

verses.text_english: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄንና ባልንጀራዬን ዘመዶቼንም ከመከራ የተነሣ ከእኔ አራቅህ።

verses.text_english: [Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.] I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን ለዘላለም እዘምራለሁ፥ እውነትህንም በአፌ ለልጅ ልጅ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ብለሃልና። ምሕረት ለዘላለም ይመሠረታል፥ እውነትህም በሰማይ ይጸናል።

verses.text_english: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.text_amharic: ከመረጥሁት ጋር ቃል ኪዳኔን አደረግሁ፥ ለባሪያዬም ለዳዊት ማልሁ።

verses.text_english: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህን ለዘላለም አዘጋጃለሁ፥ ዙፋንህንም ለልጅ ልጅ እመሠርታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሰማያት ተኣምራትህን እውነትህንም ደግሞ በቅዱሳን ማኅበር ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.text_english: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በሰማይ የሚተካከለው ማን ነው? ከአማልክትስ ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን ማን ይመስለዋል?

verses.text_english: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all about him.
verses.text_amharic: በቅዱሳን ምክር እግዚአብሔር ክቡር ነው፤ በዙሪያው ባሉት ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅና ግሩም ነው።

verses.text_english: O LORD God of hosts, who a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው? አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብርቱ ነህ፥ እውነትህም ይከብብሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.text_amharic: የባሕርን ኃይል አንተ ትገዛለህ፥ የሞገዱንም መናወጥ አንተ ዝም ታሰኘዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ረዓብን እንደ ተገደለ አዋረድኸው፥ በኃይልህም ክንድ ጠላቶችህን በተንሃቸው።

verses.text_english: The heavens thine, the earth also thine: the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት የአንተ ናቸው፥ ምድርም የአንተ ናት፤ ዓለምንና ሞላውም አንተ መሠረትህ።

verses.text_english: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሜንና ደቡብን አንተ ፈጠርህ፤ ታቦርና አርሞንዔም በስምህ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, high is thy right hand.
verses.text_amharic: ክንድህ ከኃይልህ ጋር ነው፤ እጅህ በረታች ቀኝህም ከፍ ከፍ አለች።

verses.text_english: Justice and judgment the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.text_amharic: የዙፋንህ መሠረት ጽድቅና ፍርድ ነው፤ ምሕረትና እውነት በፊትህ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.text_amharic: እልልታ የሚያውቅ ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ ብርሃን ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: በስምህ ቀኑን ሁሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ በጽድቅህም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ፤

verses.text_english: For thou the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: የኃይላቸው ትምክሕት አንተ ነህና፥ በሞገስህም ቀንዳችን ከፍ ከፍ ይላልና።

verses.text_english: For the LORD our defence; and the Holy One of Israel our king.
verses.text_amharic: ረድኤታችን ከእግዚአብሔር ከንጉሣችንም ከእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon mighty; I have exalted chosen out of the people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜ ለልጆችህ በራእይ ተናገርህ እንዲህም አልህ። ረድኤቴን በኃይል ላይ አኖርሁ፤ ከሕዝቤ የተመረጠውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን አገኘሁት፥ ቅዱስ ዘይትም ቀባሁት።

verses.text_english: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.text_amharic: እጄም ትረዳዋለች፥ ክንዴም ታጸናዋለች።

verses.text_english: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላት በእርሱ ላይ አይጠቀምም፥ የዓመፃ ልጅም መከራ አይጨምርበትም።

verses.text_english: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ አጠፋለሁ፥ የሚጠሉትንም አዋርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: But my faithfulness and my mercy with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: እውነቴና ምሕረቴም ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥ በስሜም ቀንዱ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.text_amharic: እጁን በባሕር ላይ ቀኙንም በወንዞች ላይ አኖራለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall cry unto me, Thou my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ። አባቴ አንተ ነህ፥ አምላኬ የመድኃኒቴም መጠጊያ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Also I will make him firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ደግሞ በኵሬ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ከምድር ነገሥታትም ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለምም ምሕረቴን ለእርሱ እጠብቃለሁ፥ ኪዳኔም በእርሱ ዘንድ የታመነ ነው።

verses.text_english: His seed also will I make for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሩንም ለዓለምና ለዘላለም፥ ዙፋኑንም እንደ ሰማይ ዘመን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹ ግን ሕጌን ቢተዉ፥ በፍርዴም ባይሄዱ፤

verses.text_english: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴንም ቢያረክሱ፥ ትእዛዜንም ባይጠብቁ፤

verses.text_english: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአታቸውን በበትር፥ በደላቸውንም በመቅሠፍት እጐበኛታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረቴን ግን ከእርሱ አላርቅም፥ በእውነቴም አልበድልም፤

verses.text_english: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.text_amharic: ኪዳኔንም አላረክስም፥ ከከንፈሬም የወጣውን አልለውጥም።

verses.text_english: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትን እንዳልዋሸው አንድ ጊዜ በቅዱስነቴ ማልሁ።

verses.text_english: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሩ ለዘላለም፥ ዙፋኑም በፊቴ እንደ ፀሐይ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም እንደ ጨረቃ ይጸናል፤ ምስክርነቱ በሰማይ የታመን ነው።

verses.text_english: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ናቅኸው ጣልኸውም፥ የቀባኸውንም ጣልኸው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያህንም ኪዳን አፈረስህ፥ መቅደሱንም በምድር አረከስህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥሩን ሁሉ ጣልህ፥ አምባዎቹንም አጠፋህ።

verses.text_english: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ ተናጠቀው፥ ለጎረቤቶቹም ስድብ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: የጠላቶቹንም ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ፥ ጠላቶቹንም ሁሉ ደስ አሰኘህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.text_amharic: የሰይፉንም ረድኤት መለስህ፥ በሰልፍም ውስጥ አልደገፍኸውም።

verses.text_english: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ከንጽሕናውም ሻርኸው፥ ዙፋኑንም በምድር ጣልህ።

verses.text_english: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: የዙፋኑንም ዘመን አሳነስህ፥ በእፍረትም ሸፈንኸው።

verses.text_english: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘላለም ፊትህን ትመልሳለህ? እስከ መቼስ ቍጣህ እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል?

verses.text_english: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.text_amharic: ችሎታዬ ምን እንደ ሆነ አስብ፤ በውኑ የሰውን ልጅ ሁሉ ለከንቱ ፈጠርኸውን?

verses.text_english: What man liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው ሆኖ የሚኖር፥ ሞትንስ የማያይ ማን ነው? ነፍሱንስ ከሲኦል እጅ የሚያድን ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Lord, where thy former lovingkindnesses, thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.text_amharic: ለዳዊት በእውነት የማልህ፥ አቤቱ፥ የቀድሞ ምሕረትህ ወዴት ነው?

verses.text_english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; I do bear in my bosom all the mighty people;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የባሪያዎችህን ስድብ፥ በብብቴ ብዙ አሕዛብን የተቀበልሁትን፥

verses.text_english: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጠላቶችህን የሰደቡትን የቀባኸውን ዘመን የሰደቡትን አስብ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይባረክ። ይሁን ይሁን።

verses.text_english: [A Prayer of Moses the man of God.] Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ለትውልድ ሁሉ መጠጊያ ሆንህልን።

verses.text_english: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou God.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች ሳይወለዱ፥ ምድርም ዓለምም ሳይሠሩ፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ አንተ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን ወደ ኅሳር አትመልስም፤ የሰው ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ ትላለህ፤

verses.text_english: For a thousand years in thy sight as yesterday when it is past, and a watch in the night.
verses.text_amharic: ሺህ ዓመት በፊትህ እንዳለፈች እንደ ትናንት ቀን፥ እንደ ሌሊትም ትጋት ነውና።

verses.text_english: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are a sleep: in the morning like grass groweth up.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኖች የተናቁ ይሆናሉ፥ በማለዳም እንደ ሣር ያልፋል።

verses.text_english: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.text_amharic: ማልዶ ያብባል ያልፋልም፥ በሠርክም ጠውልጎና ደርቆ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ በቍጣህ አልቀናልና፥ በመዓትህም ደንግጠናልና።

verses.text_english: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret in the light of thy countenance.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰወረውን ኃጢአታችንን በፊትህ ብርሃን፥ በደላችንንም በፊትህ አስቀመጥህ።

verses.text_english: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale .
verses.text_amharic: ዘመናችን ሁሉ አልፎአልና፥ እኛም በመዓትህ አልቀናልና፤ ዘመኖቻችንም እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: The days of our years threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength fourscore years, yet their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.text_amharic: የዘመኖቻችንም ዕድሜ ሰባ ዓመት፥ ቢበረታም ሰማንያ ዓመት ነው፤ ቢበዛ ግን ድካምና መከራ ነው፤ ከእኛ ቶሎ ያልፋልና፥ እኛም እንገሠጻለንና።

verses.text_english: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, thy wrath.
verses.text_amharic: የቍጣህን ጽናት ማን ያውቃል? ከቍጣህ ግርማ የተነሣ አለቁ።

verses.text_english: So teach to number our days, that we may apply hearts unto wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: በልብ ጥበብን እንድንማር፥ ቀኝህን እንዲህ አስታውቀን።

verses.text_english: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ፥ እስከ መቼስ ነው? ስለ ባሪያዎችህም ተምዋገት።

verses.text_english: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.text_amharic: በማለዳ ምሕረትህን እንጠግባለን፤ በዘመናችን ሁሉ ደስ ይለናል ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን።

verses.text_english: Make us glad according to the days thou hast afflicted us, the years we have seen evil.
verses.text_amharic: መከራ ባሳየኸን ዘመን ፈንታ፥ ክፉም ባየንባቸው ዘመኖች ፋንታ ደስ ይለናል።

verses.text_english: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎችህንና ሥራህን እይ፥ ልጆቻቸውንም ምራ።

verses.text_english: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችን የእግዚአብሔር ብርሃን በላያችን ይሁን። የእጆቻችንንም ሥራ በላያችን አቅና።

verses.text_english: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: በልዑል መጠጊያ የሚኖር ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ጥላ ውስጥ ያድራል።

verses.text_english: I will say of the LORD, my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ መታመኛዬ ነህ እለዋለሁ፤ አምላኬና መሸሸጊያዬ ነው፥ በእርሱም እታመናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, from the noisome pestilence.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከአዳኝ ወጥመድ ከሚያስደነግጥም ነገር ያድንሃልና።

verses.text_english: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shield and buckler.
verses.text_amharic: በላባዎቹ ይጋርድሃል፥ በክንፎቹም በታች ትተማመናለህ፤ እውነት እንደ ጋሻ ይከብብሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; for the arrow flieth by day;
verses.text_amharic: ከሌሊት ግርማ፥ በቀን ከሚበርር ፍላጻ፥

verses.text_english: for the pestilence walketh in darkness; for the destruction wasteth at noonday.
verses.text_amharic: በጨለማ ከሚሄድ ክፉ ነገር፥ ከአደጋና ከቀትር ጋኔን አትፈራም።

verses.text_english: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገብህ ሺህ በቀኝህም አሥር ሺህ ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አንተ ግን አይቀርብም።

verses.text_english: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይኖችህ ብቻ ትመለከታለህ፥ የኃጥኣንንም ብድራት ታያለህ።

verses.text_english: Because thou hast made the LORD, my refuge, the most High, thy habitation;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፤ ልዑልን መጠጊያህ አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ነገር ወደ አንተ አይቀርብም፥ መቅሠፍትም ወደ ቤትህ አይገባም።

verses.text_english: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድህ ሁሉ ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝዛቸዋልና፤

verses.text_english: They shall bear thee up in hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.text_amharic: እግርህም በድንጋይ እንዳትሰናከል በእጆቻቸው ያነሡሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.text_amharic: በተኵላና በእባብ ላይ ትጫማለህ፤ አንበሳውንና ዘንዶውን ትረግጣለህ።

verses.text_english: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ተማምኖአልና አስጥለዋለሁ፤ ስሜንም አውቆአልና እጋርደዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.text_amharic: ይጠራኛል እመልስለትማለሁ፥ በመከራውም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋራ እሆናለሁ፤ አድነዋለሁ አከብረውማለሁ።

verses.text_english: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ረጅምን ዕድሜ አጠግበዋለሁ፥ ማዳኔንም አሳየዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm Song for the sabbath day.] good to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ማመስገን መልካም ነው፥ ልዑል ሆይ፥ ለስምህም ዝማሬ ማቅረብ፤

verses.text_english: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.text_amharic: በማለዳ ምሕረትን፥ በሌሊትም እውነትህን ማውራት

verses.text_english: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.text_amharic: አሥር አውታር ባለው በበገና፥ ከምስጋና ጋርም በመሰንቆ።

verses.text_english: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በሥራህ ደስ አሰኝተኸኛልና፤ በእጅህም ሥራ ደስ ይለኛልና።

verses.text_english: O LORD, how great are thy works! thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ትልቅ ነው፥ አሳብህም እጅግ ጥልቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ ሰው አያውቅም። ልብ የሌለውም ይህን አያስተውለውም።

verses.text_english: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች እንደ ሣር ሲበቅሉ ዓመፃ የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ሲለመልሙ፥ ለዘላለም ዓለም እንዲጠፋ ነው።

verses.text_english: But thou, LORD, high for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ግን ለዘላለም ልዑል ነህ፤

verses.text_english: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ጠላቶችህ ይጠፋሉና፥ ዓመፃንም የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ይበተናሉና።

verses.text_english: But my horn shalt thou exalt like an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንዴ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ ሽምግልናዬም በዘይት ይለመልማል።

verses.text_english: Mine eye also shall see on mine enemies, mine ears shall hear of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አየች፥ ጆሮዬም በእኔ ላይ በቆሙ በክፉዎች ላይ ሰማች።

verses.text_english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘንባባ ያፈራል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል።

verses.text_english: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ተተክለዋል፥ በአምላካችንም አደባባይ ውስጥ ይበቅላሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ በለመለመ ሽምግልና ያፈራሉ ደስተኞችም ሆነው ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: To shew that the LORD upright: my rock, and no unrighteousness in him.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ ይነግራሉ፥ በእርሱም ዘንድ ዓመፃ የለም።

verses.text_english: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ ክብርንም ለበሰ፤ እግዚአብሔር ኃይልን ለበሰ፥ ታጠቀም፤ ዓለምን እንዳትናወጥ አጸናት።

verses.text_english: Thy throne established of old: thou from everlasting.
verses.text_amharic: ዙፋንህ ከጥንት ጀምሮ የተዘጋጀ ነው፥ አንተም ከዘላለም ነህ።

verses.text_english: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወንዞች ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ፥ ወንዞች ቃሎቻቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD on high mightier than the noise of many waters, the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ውኆች ድምፅ ከባሕርም ታላቅ ሞገድ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔር በከፍታው ድንቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርህ እጅግ የታመነ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ እስከ ረጅም ዘመን ድረስ ለቤትህ ቅድስና ይገባል።

verses.text_english: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የበቀል አምላክ ነው። የበቀል አምላክ ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ፈራጅ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ለትዕቢተኞች ፍዳቸውን ክፈላቸው።

verses.text_english: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአተኞች እስከ መቼ? ኃጢአተኞች እስከ መቼ ይጓደዳሉ?

verses.text_english: shall they utter speak hard things? all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.text_amharic: ይከራከራሉ፥ ዓመፃንም ይናገራሉ፤ ዓመፃንም የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብን አዋረዱ፥ ርስትህንም አስቸገሩ።

verses.text_english: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.text_amharic: ባልቴቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን ገደሉ፥ ስደተኛውንም ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አያይም፥ የያዕቆብ አምላክ አያስተውልም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝብ ደንቆሮች ሆይ፥ አስተውሉ፤ ሰነፎችማ መቼ ይጠበባሉ?

verses.text_english: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮን የተከለው አይሰማምን? ዓይንን የሠራው አያይምን?

verses.text_english: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, ?
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብንስ የሚገሥጸው፥ ለሰውም እውቀት የሚያስተምረው እርሱ አይዘልፍምን?

verses.text_english: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they vanity.
verses.text_amharic: የሰዎች አሳብ ከንቱ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥልምና፥ ርስቱንም አይተውምና

verses.text_english: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድ ወደ ጽድቅ እስኪመልስ ድረስ ልበ ቅኖችም ሁሉ ይከተሉአታል።

verses.text_english: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.text_amharic: በክፉዎች ላይ ለእኔ የሚቆም ማን ነው? ዓመፃንስ በሚያደርጉ ላይ ለእኔ የሚከራከር ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የረዳኝ ባይሆን ነፍሴ ለጥቂት ጊዜ በሲኦል ባደረች ነበር።

verses.text_english: Unless the LORD my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቼ ተሰናከሉ ባልሁ ጊዜ፥ አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ረዳኝ።

verses.text_english: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ለልቤ እንደ መከራዋ ብዛት ማጽናናትህ ነፍሴን ደስ አሰኛት።

verses.text_english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.text_amharic: በሕግ ላይ ዓመፅን የሚሠራ የዓመፅ ዙፋን ከአንተ ጋር አንድ ይሆናልን?

verses.text_english: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅን ነፍስ ያደቡባታል፥ በንጹሕ ደምም ይፈርዳሉ።

verses.text_english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
