verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያ ሆነኝ፥ አምላኬ የተስፋዬም ረዳት ነው።

verses.text_english: But the LORD is my defence; and my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ በደላቸውም እንደ ክፋታቸውም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላቸዋል፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበለን፤ ለአምላክ ለመድኃኒታችን እልል እንበል።

verses.text_english: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.text_amharic: በምስጋና ወደ ፊቱ እንድረስ፥ በዝማሬም ለእርሱ እልል እንበል፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ አምላክ ነውና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነውና።

verses.text_english: In his hand the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills his also.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥላቸውም፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎችም በእጁ ውስጥ ናቸው፥ የተራሮች ከፍታዎች የእርሱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: The sea his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry .
verses.text_amharic: ባሕር የእርሱ ናት እርሱም አደረጋት፥ የብስንም እጆቹ ሠሩአት።

verses.text_english: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ፥ እንስገድ ለእርሱም እንገዛ፤ በእርሱ ባደረገን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንበርከክ፤

verses.text_english: For he our God; and we the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አምላካችን ነውና፥ እኛ የማሰማርያው ሕዝብ የእጁም በጎች ነንና።

verses.text_english: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, as the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ እንደ ተፈታተኑት እንዳስቈጡት ጊዜ፥ ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ ልባችሁን አታጽኑ።

verses.text_english: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.text_amharic: የተፈታተኑኝ አባቶቻችሁ ፈተኑኝ ሥራዬንም አዩ።

verses.text_english: Forty years long was I grieved with generation, and said, It a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.text_amharic: ያችን ትውልድ አርባ ዓመት ተቈጥቻት ነበር። ሁልጊዜ ልባቸው ይስታል፥ እነርሱም መንገዴን አላወቁም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዕረፍቴም እንዳይገቡ በቁጣዬ ማልሁ።

verses.text_english: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ ምስጋናን አመስግኑ፤ ምድር ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ ስሙንም ባርኩ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም ማዳኑን አውሩ።

verses.text_english: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.text_amharic: ክብሩን ለአሕዛብ ተኣምራቱንም ለወገኖች ሁሉ ንገሩ፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD great, and greatly to be praised: he to be feared above all gods.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ምስጋናውም ብዙ ነውና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ የተፈራ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For all the gods of the nations idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ አጋንንት ናቸውና፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።

verses.text_english: Honour and majesty before him: strength and beauty in his sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ምስጋናና ውበት በፊቱ፥ ቅዱስነትና ግርማ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ወገኖች፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ ክብርና ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤

verses.text_english: Give unto the LORD the glory his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.text_amharic: ለስሙ የሚገባ ክብርን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤ ቍርባን ያዙ ወደ አደባባዮችም ግቡ።

verses.text_english: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ፤ ምድር ሁሉ በፊቱ ትነዋወጥ።

verses.text_english: Say among the heathen the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ መካከል። እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ በሉ። እንዳይናወጥም ዓለሙን እርሱ አጸናው፥ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.text_english: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት ደስ ይበላቸው፥ ምድርም ሐሤትን ታድርግ፤ ባሕርና ሞላዋ ይናወጡ፤

verses.text_english: Let the field be joyful, and all that therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.text_amharic: በረሃ በእርስዋም ያሉ ሁሉ ሐሤትን ያድርጉ፤ የዱር ዛፎች ሁሉ በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይላቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.text_amharic: ይመጣልና፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና፤ እርሱም ዓለምን በጽድቅ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.text_english: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፤ ምድር ሐሤትን ታድርግ፥ ብዙ ደሴቶችም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.text_english: Clouds and darkness round about him: righteousness and judgment the habitation of his throne.
verses.text_amharic: ደመና ጭጋግም በዙሪያው ናቸው፤ ጽድቅና ፍርድ የዙፋኑ መሠረት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.text_amharic: እሳት በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ ጠላቶቹንም በዙሪያው ያቃጥላል።

verses.text_english: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.text_amharic: መብረቆቹ ለዓለም አበሩ፤ ምድር አየችና ተናወጠች።

verses.text_english: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮችም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት፥ ከምድር ሁሉ ጌታ ፊት እንደ ሰም ቀለጡ።

verses.text_english: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት የእርሱን ጽድቅ አወሩ፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ክብሩን አዩ።

verses.text_english: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all gods.
verses.text_amharic: ለተቀረጸ ምስል የሚሰግዱ ሁሉ፥ በጣዖቶቻቸውም የሚመኩ ይፈሩ፤ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ ስገዱለት።

verses.text_english: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ፍርድህ ጽዮን ሰምታ ደስ አላት፥ የይሁዳም ሴት ልጆች ደስ አላቸው፤

verses.text_english: For thou, LORD, high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ በምድር ላይ ሁሉ ልዑል ነህና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ እጅግ ከፍ ከፍ ብለሃልና።

verses.text_english: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የምትወዱ፥ ክፋትን ጥሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር የቅዱሳኑን ነፍሶች ይጠብቃል፥ ከኃጥኣንም እጅ ያድናቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃን ለጻድቃን፥ ደስታም ለልበ ቅኖች ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለቅድስናውም መታሰቢያ አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm.] O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ ምስጋናን አመስግኑ፥ እግዚአብሔር ተኣምራትን አድርጎአልና፤ ቀኙ የተቀደሰም ክንዱ ለእርሱ ማዳን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ማዳኑን አስታወቀ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት ጽድቁን ገለጠ።

verses.text_english: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.text_amharic: ለያዕቆብ ምሕረቱን ለእስራኤልም ቤት እውነቱን አሰበ፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ የአምላካችንን ማዳን አዩ።

verses.text_english: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፤ አመስግኑ፥ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ዘምሩም።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር በመሰንቆ፥ በመሰንቆና በዝማሬ ድምፅ ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
verses.text_amharic: በዋሽንትና በመለከት ድምፅ በንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እልል በሉ።

verses.text_english: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: ባሕርና ሞላዋ፥ ዓለምም በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ይናወጡ።

verses.text_english: Let the floods clap hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.text_amharic: ወንዞችም በአንድነት በእጅ ያጨብጭቡ፤ ተራሮች ደስ ይበላቸው፥ በምድር ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና።

verses.text_english: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.text_amharic: ለዓለምም በጽድቅ ለአሕዛብም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.text_english: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ አሕዛብ ይደንግጡ፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ምድር ትናወጥ።

verses.text_english: The LORD great in Zion; and he high above all the people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ታላቅ ነው፤ እርሱም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለ።

verses.text_english: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; it holy.
verses.text_amharic: ግሩምና ቅዱስ ነውና ሁሉ ታላቅ ስምህን ያመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሥ ክብር ፍርድን ይወድዳል፤ አንተ ቅንነትን አጸናህ፥ ለያዕቆብ ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አንተ አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; he holy.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉት፥ ቅዱስ ነውና ወደ እግሩ መረገጫ ስገዱ።

verses.text_english: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴና አሮን በካህናቱ ዘንድ፥ ሳሙኤልም ስሙን በሚጠሩት ዘንድ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔርን ጠሩት፥ እርሱም መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance he gave them.
verses.text_amharic: በደመና ዓምድም ተናገራቸው፤ ምስክሩንና የሰጣቸውን ትእዛዝ ጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላክችን ሆይ፥ አንተ ሰማሃቸው፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ማርሃቸው፥ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ግን ተበቀልሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God holy.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉት፥ በቅዱስ ተራራውም ስገዱ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of praise.] Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥

verses.text_english: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.text_amharic: በደስታም ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፥ በሐሤትም ወደ ፊቱ ግቡ።

verses.text_english: Know ye that the LORD he God: he hath made us, and not we ourselves; his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ እወቁ፤ እርሱ ሠራን እኛም አይደለንም፤ እኛስ ሕዝቡ የማሰማርያውም በጎች ነን።

verses.text_english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, bless his name.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደጆቹ በመገዛት፥ ወደ አደባባዮቹም በምስጋና ግቡ፤ አመስግኑት፥ ስሙንም ባርኩ፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD good; his mercy everlasting; and his truth to all generations.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቸር፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም፥ እውነቱም ለልጅ ልጅ ነውና።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትንና ፍርድን እቀኝልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.text_amharic: እዘምራለሁ፥ ንጹሕ መንገዱንም አስተውላለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ መቼ ትመጣለህ? በቤቴ መካከል በልቤ ቅንነት እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; shall not cleave to me.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይኔ ፊት ክፉን ነገር አላኖርሁም፤ ሕግ ተላላፊዎችን ጠላሁ።

verses.text_english: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked .
verses.text_amharic: ጠማማ ልብም አልተጠጋኝም፤ ክፉ ከእኔ በራቀ ጊዜ አላወቅሁም።

verses.text_english: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀራውን በቀስታ የሚያማን እርሱን አሳደድሁ፤ በዓይኑ ትዕቢተኛ የሆነውና ልቡ የሚሳሳው ከእኔ ጋር አይተባበርም።

verses.text_english: Mine eyes upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ይኖሩ ዘንድ፤ ዓይኖቼ በምድር ምእመናን ላይ ናቸው፤ በቀና መንገድ የሚሄድ እርሱ ያገለግለኛል።

verses.text_english: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢትን የሚያደርግ በቤቴ መካከል አይኖርም፤ ዓመፅን የሚናገር በዓይኔ ፊት አይቀናም።

verses.text_english: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ከተማ አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ የምድርን ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በማለዳ እገድላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: [A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.] Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም ወደ አንተ ይድረስ።

verses.text_english: Hide not thy face from me in the day I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day I call answer me speedily.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራዬ ቀን ፊትህን ከኔ አትመልስ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፤ በጠራሁህ ቀን ፈጥነህ ስማኝ።

verses.text_english: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኔ እንደ ጢስ አልቃለችና፥ አጥንቶቼም እንደ መቃጠያ ተቃጥለዋልና።

verses.text_english: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.text_amharic: እህል መብላት ተረስቶኛልና ተቀሠፍሁ ልቤም እንደ ሣር ደረቀ።

verses.text_english: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.text_amharic: ከጩኸቴ ድምፅ የተነሣ አጥንቶቼ ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቁ።

verses.text_english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምድረ በዳ እርኩም መሰልሁ፤ በፈረሰ ቤት እንዳለ እንደ ጕጕት ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.text_amharic: ተጋሁ፥ በሰገነትም እንደሚኖር ብቸኛ ድንቢጥ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሰድቡኛል፥ የሚያሳድዱኝም ተማማሉብኝ።

verses.text_english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.text_amharic: አመድን እንደ እህል ቅሜአለሁና፥ መጠጤንም ከእንባዬ ጋር ቀላቅያለሁና፥

verses.text_english: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.text_amharic: ከቍጣህና ከመዓትህም የተነሣ፤ አንሥተኸኛልና፥ ጥለኸኝማልና።

verses.text_english: My days like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኖቼ እንደ ጥላ አዘንብለዋል፤ እኔም እንደ ሣር ደርቄአለሁ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ለዘላለም ትኖራለህ፥ መታሰቢያህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt arise, have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ተነሥ ጽዮንንም ይቅር በላት፥ የምሕረትዋ ጊዜ ነውና፥ ዘመንዋም ደርሶአልና፤

verses.text_english: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎችህም ድንጋዮችዋን ወድደዋልና፥ ለመሬትዋም አዝነዋልና።

verses.text_english: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ስምህን፥ ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርህን ይፈራሉ፤

verses.text_english: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ይሠራታልና፥ በክብሩም ይገለጣልና።

verses.text_english: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ችግረኞች ጸሎት ተመለከተ፥ ልመናቸውንም አልናቀም።

verses.text_english: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ይጻፍ፥ የሚፈጠርም ሕዝብ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል ይላል፤

verses.text_english: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከመቅደሱ ከፍታ ሆኖ ተመልክቶአልና፥ ከሰማይ ሆኖ ምድርን አይቶአልና፤

verses.text_english: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.text_amharic: የእስረኞችን ጩኸት ይሰማ ዘንድ፥ ሊገድሉ የተፈረደባቸውን ያድን ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በጽዮን ምስጋናውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ይናገሩ ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ መንግሥታትም ለእግዚአብሔር ይገዙ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይሉ ጎዳና መለሰለት። የዘመኔን አነስተኛነት ንገረኝ።

verses.text_english: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years throughout all generations.
verses.text_amharic: በዘመኔ እኵሌታ አትውሰደኝ፤ ዓመቶችህ ለልጅ ልጅ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens the work of thy hands.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ከጥንት ምድርን መሠረትህ፥ ሰማያትም የእጅህ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ይጠፋሉ፥ አንተ ግን ትኖራለህ፤ ሁላቸው እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ፥ እንደ መጐናጸፊያም ትለውጣቸዋለህ፥ ይለወጡማል፤

verses.text_english: But thou the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ያው አንተ ነህ፥ ዓመቶችህም ከቶ አያልቁም።

verses.text_english: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዎችህም ልጆች ይኖራሉ፥ ዘራቸውም ለዘላለም ትጸናለች።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, his holy name.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ፥ የተቀደሰ ስሙን።

verses.text_english: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ ምስጋናውንም ሁሉ አትርሺ፤

verses.text_english: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአትሽን ሁሉ ይቅር የሚል፥ ደዌሽንም ሁሉ የሚፈውስ፥

verses.text_english: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወትሽን ከጥፋት የሚያድናት፥ በምሕረቱና በቸርነቱ የሚከልልሽ፥

verses.text_english: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.text_amharic: ምኞትሽን ከበረከቱ የሚያጠግባት፥ ጕልማስነትሽን እንደ ንስር ያድሳል።

verses.text_english: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ አድራጊ ነው፤ ለተበደሉ ሁሉ ይፈርዳል።

verses.text_english: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለሙሴ መንገዱን አስታወቀ፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆችም አደራረጉን።

verses.text_english: The LORD merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው፥ ከቍጣ የራቀ ምሕረቱም የበዛ።

verses.text_english: He will not always chide: neither will he keep for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜም አይቀሥፍም፥ ለዘላለምም አይቈጣም።

verses.text_english: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ኃጢአታችን አላደረገብንም፥ እንደ በደላችንም አልከፈለንም።

verses.text_english: For as the heaven is high above the earth, great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይ ከምድር ከፍ እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ምሕረቱን በሚፈሩት ላይ አጠነከረ።

verses.text_english: As far as the east is from the west, far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.text_amharic: ምሥራቅ ከምዕራብ እንደሚርቅ፥ እንዲሁ ኃጢአታችንን ከእኛ አራቀ።

verses.text_english: Like as a father pitieth children, the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
verses.text_amharic: አባት ለልጆቹ እንደሚራራ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ለሚፈሩት ይራራል፤

verses.text_english: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we dust.
verses.text_amharic: ፍጥረታችንን እርሱ ያውቃልና፤ አቤቱ፥ እኛ አፈር እንደ ሆንን አስብ።

verses.text_english: man, his days as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውስ ዘመኑ እንደ ሣር ነው፤ እንደ ዱር አበባ እንዲሁ ያብባል፤

verses.text_english: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስ በነፈሰበት ጊዜ ያልፋልና፥ ስፍራውንም ደግሞ አያውቀውምና።

verses.text_english: But the mercy of the LORD from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት ግን ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በሚፈሩት ላይ፥ ጽድቁም በልጅ ልጆች ላይ ነው፤

verses.text_english: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኑን በሚጠብቁ፥ ትእዛዙንም ያደርጉአት ዘንድ በሚያስቡ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ዙፋኑን በሰማይ አዘጋጀ፥ መንግሥቱም ሁሉን ትገዛለች።

verses.text_english: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ፥ ብርቱዎችና ኃያላን፥ የቃሉንም ድምፅ የምትሰሙ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

verses.text_english: Bless ye the LORD, all his hosts; ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ ፈቃዱን የምታደርጉ አገልጋዮቹ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

verses.text_english: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ፍጥረቶቹ ሁሉ በግዛቱ ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ።

verses.text_english: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተ እጅግ ታላቅ ነህ፤ ክብርንና ግርማን ለበስህ።

verses.text_english: Who coverest with light as a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንን እንደ ልብስ ለበስህ፤ ሰማይንም እንደ መጋረጃ ዘረጋህ፤

verses.text_english: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.text_amharic: እልፍኙን በውኃ የሚሠራ፥ ሰረገላውን ደመና የሚያደርግ፥ በነፋስ ክንፍም የሚሄድ፥

verses.text_english: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.text_amharic: መላእክቱን መንፈስ የሚያደርግ፥ አገልጋዮቹንም የእሳት ነበልባል።

verses.text_english: laid the foundations of the earth, it should not be removed for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም እንዳትናወጥ ምድርን በመሠረትዋ ላይ መሠረታት።

verses.text_english: Thou coveredst it with the deep as a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: በጥልቅ እንደ ልብስ ከደንሃት፥ በተራሮችም ላይ ውኆች ይቆማሉ።

verses.text_english: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘለፋህም ይሸሻሉ፥ ከነጐድጓድህም ድምፅ ይደነግጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ተራሮች ይወጣሉ፥ ወደ ቈላዎች ወዳዘጋጀህላቸው ስፍራ ይወርዳሉ፤

verses.text_english: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳያልፉትም ድንበር አደረግህላቸው ምድርን ይከድኑ ዘንድ እንዳይመለሱ።

verses.text_english: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, run among the hills.
verses.text_amharic: ምንጮችን ወደ ቈላዎች ይልካል፤ በተራሮች መካከል ውኆች ያልፋሉ፤

verses.text_english: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.text_amharic: የዱር አራዊትን ሁሉ ያጠጣሉ፥ የበረሃ አህያዎችም ጥማታቸውን ይረካሉ።

verses.text_english: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, sing among the branches.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይም ወፎች በእነርሱ ዘንድ ያድራሉ፥ በድንጋዩ ስንጥቅ መካከልም ይጮኻሉ።

verses.text_english: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮችን ከላይ የሚያጠጣቸው፤ ከሥራህ ፍሬ ምድር ትጠግባለች።

verses.text_english: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራን ከምድር ያወጣ ዘንድ ለምለሙን ለሰው ልጆች ጥቅም፥ ሣርንም ለእንስሳ ያበቅላል።

verses.text_english: And wine maketh glad the heart of man, oil to make face to shine, and bread strengtheneth man's heart.
verses.text_amharic: ወይን የሰውን ልብ ደስ ያሰኛል፥ ዘይትም ፊትን ያበራል፥ እህልም የሰውን ጕልበት ያጠነክራል።

verses.text_english: The trees of the LORD are full ; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ዛፎች እርሱም የተከላቸው የሊባኖስ ዝግባዎች ይጠግባሉ።

verses.text_english: Where the birds make their nests: the stork, the fir trees her house.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወፎች ይዋለዳሉ፥ የሽመላ ቤትም የእነርሱ ጎረቤት ነው።

verses.text_english: The high hills a refuge for the wild goats; the rocks for the conies.
verses.text_amharic: ረጃጅም ተራራዎች ለዋላዎች፥ ድንጋዮችም ለእሽኮኮች መሸሻ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.text_amharic: ጨረቃን ለጊዜዎች አደረገ፤ ፀሐይም መግቢያውን ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep .
verses.text_amharic: ጨለማ ታደርጋለህ ሌሊትም ይሆናል፤ በእርሱም የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ ይወጡበታል።

verses.text_english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.text_amharic: የአንበሳ ግልገሎች ለመንጠቅ ይጮኻሉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ምግባቸውን ይሻሉ።

verses.text_english: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ ስትወጣ ይሰበሰባሉ በየዋሻቸውም ይተኛሉ።

verses.text_english: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ወደ ተግባሩ፥ እስኪመሽም ድረስ ወደ ሥራው ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤ ሁሉን በጥበብ አደረግህ፥ ምድርም ከፍጥረትህ ተሞላች።

verses.text_english: this great and wide sea, wherein things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች ባሕር ታላቅና ሰፊ ናት፤ በዚያ ስፍራ ቍጥር የሌለው ተንቀሳቃሽ፥ ታላላቆችና ታናናሾች እንስሶች አሉ።

verses.text_english: There go the ships: that leviathan, thou hast made to play therein.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜ መርከቦች ይሄዳሉ፥ በዚያም ላይ የፈጠርኸው ዘንዶ ይጫወትበታል።

verses.text_english: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give their meat in due season.
verses.text_amharic: ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እነዚህ ሁሉ አንተን ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.text_amharic: በሰጠሃቸውም ጊዜ ይሰበስባሉ፤ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ፥ ከመልካም ነገርም ይጠግባሉ።

verses.text_english: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.text_amharic: ፊትህን ስትሰውር ይደነግጣሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውን ታወጣለህ ይሞታሉም፥ ወደ አፈራቸውም ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስህን ትልካለህ ይፈጠራሉም፥ የምድርንም ፊት ታድሳለህ።

verses.text_english: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ለዘላለም ይሁን፤ እግዚአብሔር በሥራው ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን ያያል እንድትንቀጠቀጥም ያደርጋል፤ ተራሮችን ይዳስሳል ይጤሳሉም።

verses.text_english: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወቴ ሳለሁ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ፥ ለአምላኬም በምኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌ ለእርሱ ይጣፍጠው፥ እኔም በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.text_english: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ኅጥኣን ከምድር ይጥፉ፤ ዓመፀኞች እንግዲህ አይገኙ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ ስሙንም ጥሩ፥ ለአሕዛብም ሥራውን አውሩ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀኙለት፥ ዘምሩለት፥ ተአምራቱንም ሁሉ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በቅዱስ ስሙ ተጓደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ልብ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.text_english: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉት ትጸናላችሁም፤ ሁልጊዜ ፊቱን ፈልጉ።

verses.text_english: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎቹ የአብርሃም ዘር፥ ለእርሱም የተመረጣችሁ የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፥ የሠራትን ድንቅ አስቡ፥ ተአምራቱን የአፉንም ፍርድ።

verses.text_english: He the LORD our God: his judgments in all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው፤ ፍርዱ በምድር ሁሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም፥ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ያዘዘውን ቃሉን አሰበ፥

verses.text_english: Which he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.text_amharic: ለአብርሃም ያደረገውን፥ ለይስሐቅም የማለውን፤

verses.text_english: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, to Israel an everlasting covenant:
verses.text_amharic: ለያዕቆብ ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ለእስራኤልም የዘላለም ኪዳን እንዲሆን አጸና።

verses.text_english: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። ለአንተ የከነዓንን ምድር የርስታችሁን ገመድ እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: When they were a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው እነርሱ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ሰዎች፥ እጅግ ጥቂቶችና ስደተኞች ሲሆኑ ነው።

verses.text_english: When they went from one nation to another, from kingdom to another people;
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ፥ ከመንግሥታትም ወደ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለፉ።

verses.text_english: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ራብን ጠራ፥ የእህልን ኃይል ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.text_amharic: በፊታቸው ሰውን ላከ፤ ዮሴፍ ለባርነት ተሸጠ።

verses.text_english: He sent a man before them, Joseph, was sold for a servant:
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቹም በእግር ብረት ደከሙ፥ እርሱም በብረት ውስጥ ገባ።

verses.text_english: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉ እስኪመጣለት ድረስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ፈተነው።

verses.text_english: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ ላከ ፈታውም፥ የአሕዛብም አለቃ አስፈታው።

verses.text_english: The king sent and loosed him; the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱ ጌታ፥ የጥሪቱ ሁሉ ገዢ አደረገው፥

verses.text_english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹን እንደ ፈቃዱ ይገሥጽ ዘንድ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹንም ጥበበኞች ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልም ወደ ግብጽ ገባ፥ ያዕቆብም በካም አገር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም እጅግ አበዛ፥ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ይልቅ አበረታቸው።

verses.text_english: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡን ይጠሉ ዘንድ በባሪያዎቹም ላይ ይተነኰሉ ዘንድ ልባቸውን ለወጠ።

verses.text_english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያውን ሙሴን የመረጠውንም አሮንን ላከ።

verses.text_english: He sent Moses his servant; Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.text_amharic: የተኣምራቱን ነገር በላያቸው ድንቁንም በካም አገር አደረገ።

verses.text_english: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.text_amharic: ጨለማን ላከ ጨለመባቸውም፤ በቃሉም ዐመፁ።

verses.text_english: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃቸውን ወደ ደም ለወጠ፥ ዓሦቻቸውንም ገደለ።

verses.text_english: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸው የንጉሦቻቸውም ቤቶች በጓጕንቸር ሞሉ።

verses.text_english: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.text_amharic: ተናገረ፥ የውሻ ዝንብ ትንኝም በዳርቻቸው መጡ።

verses.text_english: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, lice in all their coasts.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናባቸውን በረዶ አደረገው፥ እሳትም በምድራቸው ተቃጠለች።

verses.text_english: He gave them hail for rain, flaming fire in their land.
verses.text_amharic: ወይናቸውንና በለሳቸውን መታ፥ የአገራቸውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.text_english: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.text_amharic: ተናገረ፥ አንበጣም ስፍር ቍጥር የሌለውም ኩብኩባ መጣ፥

verses.text_english: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.text_amharic: የአገራቸውንም ለምለም ሁሉ በላ፥ የምድራቸውንም ፍሬ በላ።

verses.text_english: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.text_amharic: የአገራቸውንም በኵር ሁሉ፥ የጕልበታቸውን መጀመሪያ ሁሉ መታ።

verses.text_english: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.text_amharic: ከወርቅና ከብርም ጋር አወጣቸው፥ በወገናቸውም ውስጥ ደዌ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and not one feeble among their tribes.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርተዋቸው ነበርና ግብጽ በመውጣታቸው ደስ አላት።

verses.text_english: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናን ለመሸፈኛ ዘረጋባቸው፥ እሳትንም በሌሊት ያበራላቸው ዘንድ ዘረጋ።

verses.text_english: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.text_amharic: ለመኑ፥ ድርጭትንም አመጣላቸው፥ የሰማይንም እንጀራ አጠገባቸው።

verses.text_english: asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለቱን ሰነጠቀ፥ ውኃውም ፈሰሰ፤ ወንዞች በበረሃ ሄዱ፤

verses.text_english: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places a river.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያው ለአብርሃም የነገረውን ቅዱስ ቃሉን አስቦአልና።

verses.text_english: For he remembered his holy promise, Abraham his servant.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም በደስታ የተመረጡትንም በእልልታ አወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he brought forth his people with joy, his chosen with gladness:
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብንም አገሮች ሰጣቸው፥ የወገኖችንም ድካም ወረሱ፥

verses.text_english: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.text_amharic: ሕጉን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ይፈልጉ ዘንድ። ሃሌ ሉያ

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for good: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ፤ ቸር ነውና፥ ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? can shew forth all his praise?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል ሥራ ማን ይናገራል? ምስጋናውንስ ሁሉ ማን ያሰማል?

verses.text_english: Blessed they that keep judgment, he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድን የሚጠብቁ፥ ጽድቅንም ሁልጊዜ የሚያደርጉ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብህ ሞገስ አስበን፥ በመድኃኒትህም ጐብኘን፤

verses.text_english: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: የመረጥሃቸውን በጎነት እናይ ዘንድ፥ በሕዝብህም ደስታ ደስ ይለን ዘንድ፥ ከርስትህም ጋር እንጓደድ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ኃጢአትን ሠራን፥ ዐመፅንም፥ በደልንም።

verses.text_english: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked at the sea, at the Red sea.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን በግብጽ ሳሉ ተኣምራትህን አላስተዋሉም፥ የምሕረትህንም ብዛት አላሰቡም፤ በኤርትራ ባሕር ባለፉ ጊዜ ዐመፁብህ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይሉን ግን ለማስታወቅ። ስለ ስሙ አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: የኤርትራንም ባሕር ገሠጸ እርሱም ደረቀ፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ በጥልቅ መራቸው።

verses.text_english: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚጠሉአቸውም እጅ አዳናቸው፥ ከጠላትም እጅ ተቤዣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.text_amharic: ያሳደዱአቸውንም ውኃ ደፈናቸው፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አልቀረም።

verses.text_english: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በቃሉ አመኑ፥ ምስጋናውንም ዘመሩ።

verses.text_english: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.text_amharic: ፈጥነውም ሥራውን ረሱ፥ በምክሩም አልታገሡም።

verses.text_english: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳም ምኞትን ተመኙ፥ በበረሃም እግዚአብሔርን ተፈታተኑት።

verses.text_english: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.text_amharic: የለመኑትንም ሰጣቸው፤ ለነፍሳቸው ግን ክሳትን ላከ።

verses.text_english: They envied Moses also in the camp, Aaron the saint of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንም እግዚአብሔር የቀደሰውንም አሮንን በሰፈር ተመቀኙአቸው።

verses.text_english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ተከፈተች ዳታንንም ዋጠችው፥ የአቤሮንንም ወገን ደፈነች፤

verses.text_english: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: በማኅበራቸውም እሳት ነደደች፥ ነበልባልም ኅጥኣንን አቃጠላቸው።

verses.text_english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.text_amharic: በኮሬብም ጥጃን ሠሩ፥ ቀልጦ ለተሠራ ምስልም ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.text_amharic: ሣርም በሚበላ በበሬ ምሳሌ ክብራቸውን ለወጡ።

verses.text_english: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
Wondrous works in the land of Ham, terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳያጠፋቸው ቍጣውን ይመልስ ዘንድ የተመረጠው ሙሴ በመቅሠፍት ጊዜ በፊቱ ባይቆም ኖሮ፥ ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy .
verses.text_amharic: የተወደደችውን ምድር ናቁ፥ በቃሉም አልታመኑም፥

verses.text_english: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.text_amharic: በድንኳኖቻቸውም ውስጥ አንጐራጐሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: But murmured in their tents, hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.text_amharic: በብዔል ፌጎርም ተባበሩበት፥ የሙታንንም መሥዋዕት በሉ።

verses.text_english: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.text_amharic: በሥራቸውም አስመረሩት፥ ቸነፈርም በላያቸው በዛ።

verses.text_english: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ፊንሐስም ተነሥቶ ፈረደባቸው፥ ቸነፈሩም ተወ፤

verses.text_english: Thus they provoked to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ያም እስከ ዘላለም ለልጅ ልጅ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።

verses.text_english: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and the plague was stayed.
And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳላቸው አሕዛብን አላጠፉም፤

verses.text_english: They angered also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብም ጋር ተደባለቁ፥ ሥራቸውንም ተማሩ።

verses.text_english: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.text_amharic: ለጣዖቶቻቸውም ተገዙ፥ ወጥመድም ሆኑባቸው።

verses.text_english: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶች ልጆቻቸውንና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለአጋንንት ሠው፤

verses.text_english: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.text_amharic: የወንዶች ልጆቻቸውንና የሴቶች ልጆቻቸን ደም፥ ለከነዓን ጣዖቶች የሠውአቸውን ንጹሕ ደም አፈሰሱ፥ ምድርም በደም ረከሰች።

verses.text_english: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በሥራቸው ረከሱ፥ በማድረጋቸውም አመነዘሩ።

verses.text_english: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነደደ፥ ርስቱንም ተጸየፈ።

verses.text_english: And shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አሕዛብም እጅ አሳለፋቸው፥ የሚጠሉአቸውም ገዙአቸው።

verses.text_english: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቻቸውም ግፍ አደረጉባቸው፥ ከእጃቸውም በታች ተዋረዱ።

verses.text_english: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜ አዳናቸው፤ ነገር ግን በምክራቸው አስመረሩት፥ በኃጢአታቸውም ተዋረዱ።

verses.text_english: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ጩኸታቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ ጭንቃቸውን ተመለከተ፤

verses.text_english: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም ኪዳኑን አሰበ፥ እንደ ምሕረቱም ብዛት ተጸጸተ።

verses.text_english: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በማረኩአቸውም ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አድነን፤ ቅዱስ ስምህን እናመሰግን ዘንድ፥ በምስጋናህም እንመካ ዘንድ፥ ከአሕዛብ መካከል ሰብስበን።

verses.text_english: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ ሕዝብም ሁሉ አሜን ይበል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the LORD, for good: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤

verses.text_english: Let the redeemed of the LORD say , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያዳናቸው፥ ከጠላቶች እጅ ያዳናቸው ይናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ፥ ከሰሜንና ከባሕር፥ ከየአገሩ ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.text_english: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃ በሌለበት ምድረ በዳ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ የሚኖሩበትንም ከተማ መንገድ አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.text_amharic: ተራቡ ተጠሙም፥ ነፍሳቸውም በውስጣቸው አለቀች።

verses.text_english: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.text_amharic: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.text_amharic: ወደሚኖሩበት ከተማ ይሄዱ ዘንድ የቀና መንገድን መራቸው።

verses.text_english: Oh that would praise the LORD his goodness, and his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ፤

verses.text_english: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.text_amharic: የተራበችን ነፍስ አጥግቦአልና፥ የተራቈተችንም ነፍስ በበረከት ሞልቶአልና።

verses.text_english: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, bound in affliction and iron;
verses.text_amharic: በጨለማ በሞትም ጥላ የተቀመጡ፥ በችግር በብረትም የታሰሩ፤

verses.text_english: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስለ ዐመፁ፥ የልዑልንም ምክር ስለ ናቁ፥

verses.text_english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and none to help.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው በድካም ተዋረደ፤ ታመሙ የሚረዳቸውም አጡ።

verses.text_english: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.text_amharic: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ በመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.text_amharic: ከጨለማና ከሞት ጥላ አወጣቸው፥ እስራታቸውንም ሰበረ።

verses.text_english: Oh that would praise the LORD his goodness, and his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ፤

verses.text_english: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.text_amharic: የናሱን ደዶች ሰብሮአልና፥ የብረቱንም መወርወሪያ ቈርጦአልና።

verses.text_english: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዓመፃቸው ሰነፉ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ተቸገሩ።

verses.text_english: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውነታቸው መብልን ሁሉ ተጸየፈች፥ ወደ ሞትም ደጆች ቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.text_amharic: በተጨነቁ ጊዜም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered from their destructions.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን ላከ ፈወሳቸውም፥ ከጥፋታቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: Oh that would praise the LORD his goodness, and his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ፤

verses.text_english: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.text_amharic: የምስጋና መሥዋዕትንም ይሠውለት፥ በእልልታም ሥራውን ይንገሩ።

verses.text_english: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.text_amharic: በመርከቦች ወደ ባሕር የሚወርዱ፥ በታላቅ ውኃ ሥራቸውን የሚሠሩ፥

verses.text_english: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ፥ በጥልቅም ያለችውን ድንቁን አዩ።

verses.text_english: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ተናገረ፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ተነሣ፥ ሞገድም ከፍ ከፍ አለ።

verses.text_english: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰማይ ይወጣሉ ወደ ጥልቅም ይወርዳሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በመከራ ቀለጠች።

verses.text_english: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.
verses.text_amharic: ደነገጡ እንደ ስካርም ተንገደገዱ፥ ጥበባቸውም ሁሉ ተዋጠች።

verses.text_english: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.text_amharic: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.text_english: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.text_amharic: ዐውሎንም ጸጥ አደረገ፥ ሞገዱም ዝም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.text_amharic: ዝም ብሎአልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ወደ ፈለጉትም ወደብ መራቸው።

verses.text_english: Oh that would praise the LORD his goodness, and his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተአምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ ጉባኤ ከፍ ከፍ ያድርጉት፥ በሽማግሌዎችም ሸንጎ ያመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.text_amharic: ወንዞችን ምድረ በዳ፥ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ደረቅ አደረጋቸው፤

verses.text_english: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: ከተቀመጡባት ክፋት የተነሣ ፍሬያማዋን ምድር ጨው አደረጋት።

verses.text_english: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.text_amharic: ምድረ በዳን ለውኃ መቆሚያ፥ ደረቁንም ምድር የውኃ ምንጮች አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ራብተኞችን አስቀመጠ፥ የሚኖርባትንም ከተማ ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.text_amharic: እርሻዎችንም ዘሩ ወይኖችንም ተከሉ፥ የእህልንም ሰብል አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.text_amharic: ባረካቸውም እጅግም በዙ፤ እንስሶቻቸውንም አላሳነሰባቸውም።

verses.text_english: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ በችግር በክፋት በጭንቀት ተዋረዱ እያነሱም ሄዱ፤

verses.text_english: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, no way.
verses.text_amharic: በአለቶችም ላይ ኅሣርን፥ አፈሰሰ፥ መንገድም በሌለበት በምድረ በዳ አሳታቸው።

verses.text_english: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh families like a flock.
verses.text_amharic: ችግረኛንም ከችግሩ ረዳው፤ እንደ በጎች መንጋ ወገን አደረገው።

verses.text_english: The righteous shall see , and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ቅኖች ያያሉ፥ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤ ኃጢአትም ሁሉ አፍዋን ትዘጋለች።

verses.text_english: Whoso wise, and will observe these , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበበኛ የሆነና ይህን የሚጠብቅ ማን ነው? እርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን ምሕረት ያስተውላል።

verses.text_english: [A Song Psalm of David.] O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ጽኑ ነው፥ አቤቱ፥ ልቤ ጽኑ ነው፤ እቀኛለሁ በክብሬም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Awake, psaltery and harp: I will awake early.
verses.text_amharic: በገና ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ መሰንቆም፤ እኔም ማልጄ እነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በወገኖችም መካከል እዘምርልሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For thy mercy great above the heavens: and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥ እውነትህም እስከ ደመናት ድረስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፥ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.text_english: That thy beloved may be delivered: save thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጆችህ ይድኑ ዘንድ፤ በቀኝህ አድን አድምጠኝም።

verses.text_english: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ተናገረ። ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሴኬምንም እካፈላለሁ፥ የሱኮትንም ሸለቆ እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Gilead mine; Manasseh mine; Ephraim also the strength of mine head; Judah my lawgiver;
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓድ የእኔ ነው ምናሴም የእኔ ነው፤ ኤፍሬም የራሴ መጠጊያ ነው። ይሁዳ ንጉሤ ነው።

verses.text_english: Moab my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ መታጠቢያዬ ነው፥ በኤዶምያስ ላይም ጫማዬን እዘረጋለሁ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ይገዙልኛል።

verses.text_english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጽኑ ከተማ ማን ይወስደኛል? ማንስ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ይመራኛል?

verses.text_english: not , O God, hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የጣልኸኝ አንተ አይደለህምን? አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከሠራዊታችን ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.text_english: Give us help from trouble: for vain the help of man.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራችን ረድኤትን ስጠን፤ የሰውም ማዳን ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he shall tread down our enemies.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይልን እናደርጋለን፤ እርሱም የሚያስጨንቁንን ያዋርዳቸዋል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.text_amharic: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ምሥጋናዬን ዝም አትበል፥

verses.text_english: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአተኛ አፍና የተንኰለኛ አፍ በላዬ ተላቅቀውብኛልና፤ በሽንገላ አንደበትም በላዬ ተናገሩ፤

verses.text_english: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.text_amharic: በጥል ቃል ከበቡኝ፥ በከንቱም ተሰለፉብኝ።

verses.text_english: For my love they are my adversaries: but I prayer.
verses.text_amharic: በወደድኋቸው ፋንታ አጣሉኝ፥ እኔ ግን እጸልያለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.text_amharic: በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉን በወደድኋቸውም ፋንታ ጠላትነትን መለሱልኝ።

verses.text_english: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.text_amharic: በላዩ ኃጢአተኛን ሹም፤ ሰይጣንም በቀኙ ይቁም።

verses.text_english: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.text_amharic: በተምዋገተም ጊዜ ተረትቶ ይውጣ፤ ጸሎቱም ኃጢአት ትሁንበት።

verses.text_english: Let his days be few; let another take his office.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኖቹም ጥቂት ይሁኑ፤ ሹመቱንም ሌላ ይውሰድ።

verses.text_english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹም ድሀ አደግ ይሁኑ፥ ሚስቱም መበለት ትሁን።

verses.text_english: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek also out of their desolate places.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹም ተናውጠው ይቅበዝበዙ ይለምኑም፥ ከስፍራቸውም ይባረሩ።

verses.text_english: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.text_amharic: ባለዕዳም ያለውን ሁሉ ይበርብረው፥ እንግዶችም ድካሙን ሁሉ ይበዝብዙት።

verses.text_english: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያግዘውንም አያግኝ። ለድሀ አደግ ልጆቹም የሚራራ አይኑር።

verses.text_english: Let his posterity be cut off; in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹ ይጥፉ፤ በአንድ ትውልድ ስሙ ይደምሰስ።

verses.text_english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቹ ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትታሰብ፤ የእናቱም ኃጢአት አትደምሰስ።

verses.text_english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ ይኑሩ፤ መታሰቢያቸው ከምድር ይጥፋ።

verses.text_english: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትን ያደርግ ዘንድ አላሰበምና ችግረኛንና ምስኪንን ልቡ የተሰበረውንም ሰው ይገድል ዘንድ አሳደደ።

verses.text_english: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.text_amharic: መርገምን ወደደ ወደ እርሱም መጣች፤ በረከትንም አልመረጠም ከእርሱም ራቀች።

verses.text_english: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.text_amharic: መርገምን እንደ ልብስ ለበሳት፥ እንደ ውኃም ወደ አንጀቱ፥ እንደ ቅባትም ወደ አጥንቱ ገባች።

verses.text_english: Let it be unto him as the garment covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚለብሰው ልብስ። ሁልጊዜም እንደሚታጠቀው ትጥቅ ይሁነው።

verses.text_english: this the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሥራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚያጣሉኝ በነፍሴም ላይ ክፉን በሚናገሩ ነው።

verses.text_english: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy good, deliver thou me.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን አቤቱ ጌታዬ፥ ስለ ስምህ ምሕረትህን በእኔ ላይ አድርግ፤ ምሕረትህ መልካም ናትና አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: For I poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ችግረኛ ምስኪንም ነኝና፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.text_english: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳለፈ ጥላ አለቅሁ፥ እንደ አንበጣም እረገፍሁ።

verses.text_english: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልበቶቼ በጾም ደከሙ፤ ሥጋዬም ቅቤ በማጣት ከሳ።

verses.text_english: I became also a reproach unto them: they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በእነርሱ ዘንድ ለነውር ሆንሁ፤ ባዩኝ ጊዜ ራሳቸውን ነቀነቁ።

verses.text_english: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እርዳኝ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህም አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: That they may know that this thy hand; thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እጅህ ይህች እንደ ሆነች፥ አንተም ይህችን እንዳደረግህ ይወቁ።

verses.text_english: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ይራገማሉ አንተ ግን ባርክ፤ በእኔ ላይ የሚነሡ ይፈሩ፥ ባሪያህ ግን ደስ ይበለው።

verses.text_english: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያጣሉኝ እፍረትን ይልበሱ፤ እፍረታቸውን እንደ መጐናጸፊያ ይልበሱአት።

verses.text_english: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በአፌ እጅግ አመሰግነዋለሁ። በብዙዎችም መካከል አከብረዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save from those that condemn his soul.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ከሚያሳድዱአት ያድን ዘንድ በድሀ ቀኝ ቆሞአልና።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን ለእግርህ መቀመጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የኃይልን በትር ከጽዮን ይልክልሃል፤ በጠላቶችህም መካከል ግዛ።

verses.text_english: Thy people willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ ጋር ቀድሞ በኃይልህ ቀን፥ በቅዱሳን ብርሃን፥ ከአጥቢያ ኮከብ አስቀድሞ ከሆድ ወለድሁህ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት አንተ ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ፥ እግዚአብሔር ማለ አይጸጸትም።

verses.text_english: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቀኝህ ነገሥታትን በቍጣው ቀን ይቀጠቅጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ መካከል ይፈርዳል፥ ሬሳዎችንም ያበዛል፤ በሰፊ ምድር ላይ ራሶችን ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.text_english: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድ ከፈሳሽ ውኃ ይጠጣል፤ ስለዚህ ራስ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and the congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። አቤቱ፥ በቅኖች ሸንጎ በጉባኤም በፍጹም ልቤ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The works of the LORD great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ታላቅ ናት፥ ደስ በሚሰኙባት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተፈለገች ናት።

verses.text_english: His work honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራው ምስጋናና ግርማ ነው፤ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD gracious and full of compassion.
verses.text_amharic: ለተአምራቱ መታሰቢያን አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው።

verses.text_english: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚፈሩት ምግብን ሰጣቸው፤ ኪዳኑንም ለዘላለም ያስባል።

verses.text_english: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብን ርስት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ የሥራውን ብርታት አሳየ።

verses.text_english: The works of his hands verity and judgment; all his commandments sure.
verses.text_amharic: የእጆቹ ሥራ እውነትና ፍርድ ነው፤ ትእዛዙም ሁሉ የታመነ ነው፥

verses.text_english: They stand fast for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለምም የጸና ነው፥ በእውነትና በቅንም የተሠራ ነው።

verses.text_english: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend his name.
verses.text_amharic: መድኃኒትንም ለሕዝቡ ሰደደ፥ ኪዳኑንም ለዘላለም አዘዘ፤ ስሙ የተቀደሰና የተፈራ ነው።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do : his praise endureth for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፥ ለሚያደርጓትም ሁሉ ደኅና ማስተዋል አላቸው፤ ምስጋናውም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed the man feareth the LORD, delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥ ትእዛዙንም እጅግ የሚወድድ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሩ በምድር ላይ ኃያል ይሆናል፤ የቅኖች ትውልድ ትባረካለች።

verses.text_english: Wealth and riches in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ክብርና ባለጠግነት በቤቱ ነው፥ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ለቅኖች ብርሃን በጨለማ ወጣ፤ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ጻድቅም ነው።

verses.text_english: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር ሰው ይራራል ያበድራልም፥ በፍርድም ነገሩን ይፈጽማል።

verses.text_english: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም አይናወጥም፤ የጻድቅ መታሰቢያ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ነገር አይፈራም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ለመታመን ልቡ የጸና ነው።

verses.text_english: His heart established, he shall not be afraid, until he see upon his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: በጠላቶቹ ላይ እስኪያይ ድረስ ልቡ ጽኑ ነው፥ አይፈራም።

verses.text_english: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.text_amharic: በተነ ለችግረኞችም ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ዓለም ይኖራል፤ ቀንዱ በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: The wicked shall see , and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛም አይቶ ይቈጣል፥ ጥርሱንም ያፋጫል፥ ይቀልጣልም፤ የኃጢአተኞችም ምኞት ትጠፋለች።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ አመስግኑት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name to be praised.
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ መውጫ ጀምሮ እስከ መግቢያው ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ይመስገን።

verses.text_english: The LORD high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍተኛ ነው፥ ክብሩም ከሰማያት በላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: Who like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አምላካችን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ማን ነው? በላይ የሚኖር፤

verses.text_english: Who humbleth to behold in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይና በምድር የተዋረዱትን የሚያይ፤

verses.text_english: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
That he may set with princes, with the princes of his people.
verses.text_amharic: ከአለቆች ጋር ከሕዝቡም አለቆች ጋር ያኖረው ዘንድ ችግረኛን ከመሬት የሚያነሣ፥ ምስኪኑንም ከፋንድያ ከፍ ከፍ የሚያደርግ፤

verses.text_english: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: መካኒቱን በቤት የሚያኖራት፥ ደስ የተሰኘችም የልጆች እናት የሚያደርጋት። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ከግብጽ፥ የያዕቆብም ቤት ከእንግዳ ሕዝብ በወጣ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Judah was his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ መቅደሱ፥ እስራኤልም ግዛቱ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: The sea saw , and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.text_amharic: ባሕር አየች ሸሸችም፥ ዮርዳኖስም ወደ ኋላው ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች እንደ ኮርማዎች፥ ኮረብቶችም እንደ ጠቦቶች ዘለሉ።

verses.text_english: What thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, thou wast driven back?
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ባሕር የሸሸሽ፥ አንቺም ዮርዳኖስ ወደ ኋላሽ የተመለስሽ፥ምን ሆናችኋል?

verses.text_english: Ye mountains, ye skipped like rams; ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ተራሮች፥ እንደ ኮርማዎች፥ ኮረብቶችስ፥ እንደ ጠቦቶች ለምን ዘለላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብ አምላክ ፊት፥ ከጌታ ፊት ምድር ተናወጠች፤

verses.text_english: Which turned the rock a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋዩን ወደ ውኃ መቆሚያ፥ ጭንጫውንም ወደ ውኃ ምንጭ ከለወጠ።

verses.text_english: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, for thy truth's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኛ አይደለም፥ አቤቱ፥ ለእኛ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ለስምህ ስለ ምሕረትህ ስለ እውነትህም ምስጋናን ስጥ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where now their God?
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ። አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? አይበሉ።

verses.text_english: But our God in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንስ በላይ በሰማይ ነው፤ በሰማይም በምድርም የፈቀደውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Their idols silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ጣዖታቶች የወርቅና የብር፥ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.text_amharic: አፍ አላቸው አይናገሩምም፤ ዓይን አላቸው አያዩምም፤

verses.text_english: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮ አላቸው አይሰሙምም፤ አፍንጫ አላቸው አያሸትቱምም፤

verses.text_english: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.text_amharic: እጅ አላቸው አይዳሰሱምም፤ እግር አላቸው አይሄዱምም፤ በጕሮሮአቸውም አይናገሩም።

verses.text_english: They that make them are like unto them; every one that trusteth in them.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሠሩአቸውም የሚያምኑባቸውም ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he their help and their shield.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ፤ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he their help and their shield.
verses.text_amharic: የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he their help and their shield.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ፤ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless ; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አሰበን ይባርከንማል፤ የእስራኤልን ቤት ይባረካል፥ የአሮንንም ቤት ይባረካል።

verses.text_english: He will bless them that fear the LORD, small and great.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩትን፥ ትንንሾችንና ትልልቆችን ይባርካል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በላያችሁ፥ በላያችሁና በልጆቻችሁ ላይ ይጨምር።

verses.text_english: Ye blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሰማይንና ምድርን ለሠራ ለእግዚአብሔር የተባረካችሁ ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: The heaven, the heavens, the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማያት ሰማይ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርን ግን ለሰው ልጆች ሰጣት።

verses.text_english: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሙታን የሚያመሰግኑህ አይደሉም ወደ ሲኦልም የሚወርዱ ሁሉ፤

verses.text_english: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ሕያዋን ግን ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እግዚአብሔርን እንባርካለን። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice my supplications.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የልመናዬን ድምፅ ሰምቶአልና ወደድሁት።

verses.text_english: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon as long as I live.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮውን ወደ እኔ አዘንብሎአልና በዘመኔ ሁሉ እጠራዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥ የሲኦልም ሕማም አገኘኝ፤ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አገኘሁ።

verses.text_english: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራሁ። አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን አድናት።

verses.text_english: Gracious the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God merciful.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ጻድቅ ነው፥ አምላካችንም ይቅር ባይ ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሕፃናትን ይጠብቃል፤ ተቸገርሁ እርሱም አዳነኝ።

verses.text_english: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትሽ ተመለሺ፥ እግዚአብሔር መልካም አድርጎልሻልና፤

verses.text_english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, my feet from falling.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ ዓይኔንም ከእንባ፥ እግሬንም ከመሰናከል አድኖአልና።

verses.text_english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.text_amharic: በሕያዋን አገር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.text_amharic: አመንሁ ስለዚህም ተናገርሁ፤ እኔም እጅግ ተቸገርሁ።

verses.text_english: I said in my haste, All men liars.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከድንጋጤዬ የተነሣ። ሰው ሁሉ ሐሰተኛ ነው አልሁ።

verses.text_english: What shall I render unto the LORD all his benefits toward me?
verses.text_amharic: ስላደረገልኝ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ምንን እመልሳለሁ?

verses.text_english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የመድኃኒትን ጽዋ እቀበላለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እጠራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እፈጽማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Precious in the sight of the LORD the death of his saints.
verses.text_amharic: የቅዱሳኑ ሞት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የከበረ ነው።

verses.text_english: O LORD, truly I thy servant; I thy servant, the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥ የሴት ባሪያህም ልጅ ነኝ፤ ሰንሰለቴን ሰበርህ።

verses.text_english: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንተ የምስጋና መሥዋዕትን እሠዋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እጠራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እፈጽማለሁ፥

verses.text_english: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ በመካከልሽም። ሃሌሉያ

verses.text_english: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፥ ወገኖችም ሁሉ ያመስግኑት፤

verses.text_english: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረቱ በእኛ ላይ ጸንታለችና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እውነት ለዘላለም ትኖራለች። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the LORD; for good: because his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ናትና።

verses.text_english: Let Israel now say, that his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች የእስራኤል ቤት አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.text_english: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች የአሮን ቤት አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.text_english: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩ ሁሉ አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.text_english: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, in a large place.
verses.text_amharic: በተጨነቅሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፤ ሰማኝ አሰፋልኝም።

verses.text_english: The LORD on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ነው፥ አልፈራም ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?

verses.text_english: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see upon them that hate me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ነው፥ እኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አያለሁ።

verses.text_english: better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ከመታመን ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር መታመን ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
verses.text_amharic: በገዦች ተስፋ ከማድረግ ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ማድረግ ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁሉ ከበቡኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው፤

verses.text_english: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: መክበቡንስ ከበቡኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው፤

verses.text_english: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: ንብ ማርን እንዲከብብ ከበቡኝ፥ እሳትም በእሾህ ውስጥ እንዲነድድ ነደዱ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
verses.text_amharic: ገፋኸኝ፥ ለመውደቅም ተንገዳገድሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አገዘኝ።

verses.text_english: The LORD my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይሌም ዝማሬዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ እርሱም መድኃኒት ሆነልኝ።

verses.text_english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.text_amharic: የእልልታና የመድኃኒት ድምፅ በጻድቃን ድንኳን ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ኃይልን አደረገች።

verses.text_english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገችኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ኃይልን አደረገች።

verses.text_english: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አልሞትም በሕይወት እኖራለሁ እንጂ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.text_amharic: መገሠጽስ እግዚአብሔር ገሠጸኝ፤ ለሞት ግን አልሰጠኝም።

verses.text_english: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, I will praise the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቅን ደጆች ክፈቱልኝ፤ ወደ እነርሱ ገብቼ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.text_english: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች የእግዚአብሔር ደጅ ናት፤ ወደ እርስዋ ጻድቃን ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ሰምተኸኛልና፥ መድኃኒትም ሆነኸኛልና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The stone the builders refused is become the head of the corner.
verses.text_amharic: ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ፥ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: This is the LORD'S doing; it marvellous in our eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆነች፥ ለዓይናችንም ድንቅ ናት።

verses.text_english: This the day the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የሠራት ቀን ይህች ናት፤ ሐሤትን እናድርግ፥ በእርስዋም ደስ ይበለን።

verses.text_english: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አድን፤ አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አቅና።

verses.text_english: Blessed he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚመጣ ቡሩክ ነው፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት መረቅናችሁ።

verses.text_english: God the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, unto the horns of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነው፥ ለእኛም በራልን፤ እስከ መሠዊያው ቀንዶች ድረስ የበዓሉን መሥዋዕት በገመድ እሰሩት።

verses.text_english: Thou my God, and I will praise thee: my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ አምላኬ ነህ አመሰግንህማለሁ። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ሰምተኸኛልና፥ መድኃኒትም ሆነኸኛልና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the LORD; for good: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ናትና።

verses.text_english: ALEPH. Blessed the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገዳቸው ንጹሐን የሆኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ የሚሄዱ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Blessed they that keep his testimonies, seek him with the whole heart.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክሩን የሚፈልጉ፥ በፍጹም ልብ የሚሹት ምስጉኖች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፅንም አያደርጉም፥ በመንገዶቹም ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast commanded to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትህን እጅግ እንጠብቅ ዘንድ አንተ አዘዝህ።

verses.text_english: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓትህን ለመጠበቅ፤ መንገዶቼ ይቀኑ ዘንድ እወድድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝህን ሁሉ ስመለከት በዚያን ጊዜ አላፍርም።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የጽድቅህን ፍርድ ስማር በቅን ልብ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓትህን እጠብቃለሁ፤ በፍጹም አትጣለኝ።  ቤት

verses.text_english: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሳ መንገዱን በምን ያነጻል? ቃልህን በመጠበቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: በፍጹም ልቤ ፈለግሁህ፥ ከትእዛዝህ አታርቀኝ።

verses.text_english: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ እንዳልበድል፥ ቃልህን በልቤ ሰወርሁ።

verses.text_english: Blessed thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቡሩክ ነህ፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.text_amharic: የአፍህን ፍርድ ሁሉ በከንፈሬ ነገርሁ።

verses.text_english: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as in all riches.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ብልጥግና ሁሉ በምስክርህ መንገድ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝህን አሰላስላለሁ፥ መንገድህንም እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.text_amharic: በትእዛዝህ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ቃልህንም አልረሳም።  ጋሜል

verses.text_english: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህ መልካም አድርግ ሕያው እንድሆን፥ ቃልህንም እንድጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቼን ክፈት፥ ከሕግህም ተኣምራትህን አያለሁ።

verses.text_english: I a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በምድር እንግዳ ነኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር።

verses.text_english: My soul breaketh for the longing unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ ፍርድህን እጅግ ናፈቀች።

verses.text_english: Thou hast rebuked the proud cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: ከትእዛዛትህ የሳቱትን ትዕቢተኞችንና ርጉማንን ዘለፍህ።

verses.text_english: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርህን ፈልጌአለሁና። ስድብንና ነውርን ከእኔ አርቅ።

verses.text_english: Princes also did sit speak against me: thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆች ደግሞ ተቀምጠው እኔን አሙኝ፤ ባሪያህ ግን ሕግህን ያሰላስል ነበር።

verses.text_english: Thy testimonies also my delight my counsellors.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርህም ተድላዬ ነው፥ ሥርዓትህም መካሪዬ ነው።  ዳሌጥ

verses.text_english: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ወደ ምድር ተጠጋች፤ እንደ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድህን ነገርሁ ሰማኸኝም፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: የሥርዓትህን መንገድ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ተኣምራትህንም አሰላስላለሁ።

verses.text_english: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ከኀዘን የተነሣ ነፍሴ አንቀላፋች፤ በቃልህ አጠንክረኝ።

verses.text_english: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.text_amharic: የዓመፅን መንገድ ከእኔ አርቅ፥ በሕግህም ማረኝ፤

verses.text_english: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid .
verses.text_amharic: የእውነትህን መንገድ መረጥሁ፥ ፍርድህንም አልረሳሁም።

verses.text_english: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምስክርህን ተጠጋሁ፤ አታሳፍረኝ።

verses.text_english: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤን ባሰፋኸው ጊዜ፥ በትእዛዝህ መንገድ ሮጥሁ።  ሄ

verses.text_english: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it the end.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሥርዓትህን መንገድ አስተምረኝ፥ ሁልጊዜም እፈልገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with whole heart.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ሕግህንም እፈልጋለሁ፤ በፍጹም ልቤም እጠብቀዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋን ወድጃለሁና የትእዛዝህን መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.text_english: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤን ወደ ምስክርህ አዘንብል፥ ወደ ስስትም አይሁን።

verses.text_english: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.text_amharic: ከንቱ ነገርን እንዳያዩ ዓይኖቼን መልስ፤ በመንገድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who to thy fear.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲፈራህ ባሪያህን በቃልህ አጽና።

verses.text_english: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments good.
