verses.text_amharic: ፍርድህ መልካም ናትና የተጠራጠርሁትን ስድብ ከእኔ አርቅ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ትእዛዝህን ናፈቅሁ፤ በጽድቅህ ሕያው አድርገኝ  ዋው

verses.text_english: VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ፥ ምሕረትህና መድኃኒትህ ይምጡልኝ።

verses.text_english: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.text_amharic: በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና ለሚሰድቡኝ በነገር እመልስላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርድህም ታምኛለሁና የእውነትን ቃል ከአፌ ፈጽመህ አታርቅ።

verses.text_english: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም ዓለም ሁልጊዜ ሕግህን እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና አስፍቼ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: በነገሥታት ፊት ምስክርህን እናገራለሁ፥ አላፍርምም፤

verses.text_english: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግም በወደድኋቸው በትእዛዛትህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.text_english: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቼንም ወደ ወደድኋቸው ወደ ትእዛዛትህ አነሣለሁ፤ ሥርዓትህንም አሰላስላሁ።  ዛይ

verses.text_english: ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህ ተስፋ ያስደረግኸውን ቃልህን አስብ።

verses.text_english: This my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህ ሕያው አድርጎኛልና ይህች በመከራዬ ደስ አሰኘችኝ።

verses.text_english: The proud have had me greatly in derision: have I not declined from thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኞች እጅግ ዐመፁ፤ እኔ ግን ከሕግህ አልራቅሁም።

verses.text_english: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንት የነበረውን ፍርድህን አሰብሁ፥ አቤቱ፥ ተጽናናሁም።

verses.text_english: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህን ከተዉ ከኃጢአተኞች የተነሣ ኅዘን ያዘኝ።

verses.text_english: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.text_amharic: በእንግድነቴ አገር ሥርዓትህ መዝሙር ሆነችኝ።

verses.text_english: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በሌሊት ስምህን አሰብሁ፥ ሕግህንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና፤ ይህች ሆነችልኝ።  ሔት

verses.text_english: CHETH. my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ክፍሌ ነው፤ ሕግህን እጠብቃለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: I intreated thy favour with whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: በፍጹም ልቤ ወደ ፊትህ ተማለልሁ፤ እንደ ቃልህ ማረኝ።

verses.text_english: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ መንገዶችህ አሰብሁ፥ እግሬንም ወደ ምስክሮችህ መለስሁ።

verses.text_english: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝህን ለመጠበቅ ጨከንሁ አልዘገየሁምም።

verses.text_english: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጥኣን ገመዶች ተተበተቡብኝ፤ ሕግህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.text_english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርድ፥ በእኩለ ሌሊት አመሰግንህ ዘንድ እነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: I a companion of all that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ለሚፈሩህ ሁሉ፥ ትእዛዝህንም ለሚጠብቁ ባልንጀራ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በምድር ሁሉ ሞላች፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።  ጤት

verses.text_english: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ ለባሪያህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: በትእዛዛትህ ታምኛለሁና መልካም ምክርና እውቀትን አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሳልጨነቅ ሳትሁ፤ አሁን ግን ቃልህን ጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቸር ነህ፥ በቸርነትህም ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: The proud have forged a lie against me: I will keep thy precepts with whole heart.
verses.text_amharic: የትዕቢተኞች ዓመፅ በላዬ በዛ፤ እኔ ግን በፍጹም ልቤ ትእዛዛትህን እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Their heart is as fat as grease; I delight in thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው እንደ ወተት ረጋ፤ እኔ ግን በሕግህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.text_english: good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓትህን እማር ዘንድ ያስጨነቅኸኝ መልካም ሆነልኝ።

verses.text_english: The law of thy mouth better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.text_amharic: ከአእላፋት ወርቅና ብር ይልቅ የአፍህ ሕግ ይሻለኛል።  ዮድ

verses.text_english: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: እጆችህ ሠሩኝ አበጃጁኝም፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ትእዛዛትህንም እማራለሁ።

verses.text_english: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.text_amharic: በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና የሚፈሩህ እኔን አይተው ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments right, and thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህ ጽድቅ እንደ ሆነች፥ በእውነትህም እንዳስቸገርኸኝ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትህ ለመጽናናቴ ትሁነኝ፥ እንደ ቃልህም ለባሪያህ ይሁነው።

verses.text_english: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law my delight.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህ ተድላዬ ናትና ቸርነትህ ትምጣልኝ፥ በሕይወትም ልኑር።

verses.text_english: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኞች በዓመፅ ጠምመውብኛልና ይፈሩ፤ እኔ ግን በትእዛዝህ እጫወታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: የሚፈሩህና ምስክሮችህን የሚያውቁ ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳላፍር ልቤ በሥርዓትህ የቀና ይሁን።  ካፍ

verses.text_english: CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: I hope in thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ መድኃኒትህን ናፈቀች፤ በቃልህም ታመንሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.text_amharic: መቼ ታጽናናኛለህ እያልሁ ዓይኖቼ ስለ ቃልህ ፈዘዙ።

verses.text_english: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: በጢስ እንዳለ አቁማዳ ሆኛለሁና፤ ሥርዓትህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.text_english: How many the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያህ ዘመኖች ስንት ናቸው? በሚያሳድዱኝስ ላይ መቼ ትፈርድልኛለህ?

verses.text_english: The proud have digged pits for me, which not after thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች ጨዋታን ነገሩኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ሕግህ ግን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: All thy commandments faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ እውነት ናቸው፤ በዓመፅ አሳድደውኛል፤ እርዳኝ።

verses.text_english: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድር ሊያጠፉኝ ጥቂት ቀርቶአቸው ነበር፤ እኔ ግን ትእዛዛትህን አልተውሁም።

verses.text_english: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምሕረትህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ የአፍህንም ምስክር እጠብቃለሁ።  ላሜድ

verses.text_english: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ቃልህ በሰማይ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Thy faithfulness unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትህ ለልጅ ልጅ ናት፤ ምድርን መሠረትሃት እርስዋም ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all thy servants.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ባሪያዎችህ ናቸውና ቀኑ በትእዛዝህ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Unless thy law my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህ ተድላዬ ባይሆን፥ ቀድሞ በጐስቍልናዬ በጠፋሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ሕያው አድርገኸኛልና ፍርድህን ለዘላለም አልረሳም።

verses.text_english: I thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የአንተ ነኝ፤ ፍርድህን ፈልጌአልሁና አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ጠበቁኝ፤ ምስክርህን ግን መረመርሁ።

verses.text_english: I have seen an end of all perfection: thy commandment exceeding broad.
verses.text_amharic: የሥራህን ሁሉ ፍጻሜ አየሁ፤ ትእዛዝህ ግን እጅግ ሰፊ ነው።  ሜም

verses.text_english: MEM. O how love I thy law! it my meditation all the day.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሕግህን እንደ ምን እጅግ ወደድሁ! ቀኑን ሁሉ እርሱ ትዝታዬ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they ever with me.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም ለእኔ ነውና ትእዛዝህ ከጠላቶቼ ይልቅ አስተዋይ አደረገኝ።

verses.text_english: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies my meditation.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርህ ትዝታዬ ነውና ካስተማሩኝ ሁሉ ይልቅ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.text_english: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝህን ፈልጌአለሁና ከሽማግሌዎች ይልቅ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.text_english: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህን እጠብቅ ዘንድ ከክፉ መንገድ ሁሉ እግሬን ከለከልሁ።

verses.text_english: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.text_amharic: አስተምረኸኛልና ከፍርድህ አልራቅሁም።

verses.text_english: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! than honey to my mouth!
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህ ለጕሮሮዬ ጣፋጭ ነው፤ ከማርና ከወለላ ይልቅ ለአፌ ጣፈጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.text_amharic: ከትእዛዝህ የተነሣ አስተዋልሁ፤ ስለዚህ የሐሰትን መንገድ ጠላሁ።  ኖን

verses.text_english: NUN. Thy word a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህ ለእግሬ መብራት፥ ለመንገዴ ብርሃን ነው።

verses.text_english: I have sworn, and I will perform , that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቅህን ፍርድ እጠብቅ ዘንድ ማልሁ፥ አጸናሁም።

verses.text_english: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ተቸገርሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከአፌ የሚወጣውን ቃል ውደድ፥ ፍርድህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: My soul continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ በእጅህ ውስጥ ናት፤ ሕግህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.text_english: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች ወጥመድን ዘረጉብኝ፤ ከትእዛዝህ ግን አልሳትሁም።

verses.text_english: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.text_amharic: የልቤ ደስታ ነውና ምስክርህን ለዘላለም ወረስሁ።

verses.text_english: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, the end.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም ለፍጻሜውም ትእዛዝህን አደርግ ዘንድ ልቤን አዘነበልሁ።  ሳምኬት

verses.text_english: SAMECH. I hate thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፀኞችን ጠላሁ፥ ሕግህን ግን ወደድሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ረዳቴና መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥ በቃልህም ተማመንሁ።

verses.text_english: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ኃጢአተኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥ የአምላኬንም ትእዛዝ ልፈልግ።

verses.text_english: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ቃልህ ደግፈኝ፥ ሕያውም እሆናለሁ። ከተስፋዬም አልፈር።

verses.text_english: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.text_amharic: እርዳኝ እድናለሁም፥ ሁልጊዜም ሥርዓትህን እመረምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit falsehood.
verses.text_amharic: ምኞታቸው ዓመፃ ነውና ከሥርዓትህ የሚርቁትን ሁሉ አጐሳቈልሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: የምድርን ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ እንደ ርኵሰት አጠፋሃቸው፤ ስለዚህ ምስክርህን ወደድሁ።

verses.text_english: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋዬ አንተን ከመፍራት የተነሣ ደንገጠ፤ ከፍርድህ የተነሣ ፈርቻለሁ።  ዔ

verses.text_english: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ሠራሁ፤ ለሚያስጨንቁኝ አሳልፈህ አትስጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህን በመልካም ጠብቀው፤ ትዕቢተኞችም አይጋፉኝ።

verses.text_english: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቼ ለማዳንህ፥ ለጽድቅህም ቃል ፈዘዙ።

verses.text_english: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያህ እንደ ምሕረትህ አድርግ፥ ሥርዓትህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: I thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ምስክርህንም አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: time for , LORD, to work: they have made void thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር የሥራ ጊዜ ነው፥ ሕግህንም ሻሩት።

verses.text_english: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከወርቅና ከዕንቍ ይልቅ ትእዛዝህን ወደድሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore I esteem all precepts all right; I hate every false way.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ሁሉ አቀናሁ፥ የዓመፅንም መንገድ ሁሉ ጠላሁ።  ፌ

verses.text_english: PE. Thy testimonies wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክሮችህ ድንቆች ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ነፍሴ ፈለገቻቸው።

verses.text_english: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.text_amharic: የቃልህ ፍቺ ያበራል፥ ሕፃናትንም አስተዋዮች ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: አፌን ከፈትሁ፥ አለከለክሁም፤ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ናፍቄአለሁና።

verses.text_english: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህን ለሚወድዱ እንድምታደርገው ፍርድ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመልከተ ማረኝም።

verses.text_english: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.text_amharic: አካሄድን እንደ ቃልህ አቅና፤ ኃጢአትም ሁሉ አይግዛኝ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው ግፍ አድነኝ፤ ትእዛዝህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: በባሪያህ ላይ ፊትህን አብራ፥ ሥርዓትህንም አሰተምረኝ።

verses.text_english: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህን አልጠበቅሁምና የውኃ ፈሳሽ ከዓይኖቼ ፈሰሰ።  ጻዴ

verses.text_english: TZADDI. Righteous thou, O LORD, and upright thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፥ ፍርድህም ቅን ነው።

verses.text_english: Thy testimonies thou hast commanded righteous and very faithful.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርህን በጽድቅ አዘዝህ፥ እጅግም ቅን ነው።

verses.text_english: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቼ ቃልህን ረስተዋልና የቤትህ ቅንዓት አቀለጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Thy word very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህ እጅግ የነጠረ ነው፥ ባሪያህም ወደደው።

verses.text_english: I small and despised: do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ታናሽና የተናቅሁ ነኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.text_english: Thy righteousness an everlasting righteousness, and thy law the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅህ የዘላለም ጽድቅ ነው፥ ቃልህም እውነት ነው።

verses.text_english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: thy commandments my delights.
verses.text_amharic: መከራና ችግር አገኙኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህ ግን ተድላዬ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: The righteousness of thy testimonies everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርህ ለዘላለም ጽድቅ ነው፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ በሕይወትም አኑረኝ።  ቆፍ

verses.text_english: KOPH. I cried with whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: በፍጹም ልቤ ጮኽሁ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስማኝ፤ ሥርዓትህን እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ አድነኝ፥ ምስክርህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳ ጮኽሁ፤ ቃልህንም ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine eyes prevent the watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህን አስብ ዘንድ ዓይኖቼ ለመማለድ ቀደሙ።

verses.text_english: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቸርነትህ ድምፄን ስማ፤ እንደ ፍርድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.text_amharic: በዓመፃ የሚያሳድዱኝ ቀረቡ፥ ከሕግህም ራቁ።

verses.text_english: Thou near, O LORD; and all thy commandments truth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቅርብ ነህ፥ መንገዶችህም ሁሉ ቅኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘላለም እንደ መሠረትኸው ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ ከምስክርህ የተነሣ አወቅሁ።  ሬስ

verses.text_english: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህን አልረሳሁምና ችግሬን ተመልከት አድነኝም።

verses.text_english: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርዴን ፍረድ አድነኝም፤ ስለ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: Salvation far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: መድኃኒት ከኅጥኣን ሩቅ ነው፥ ሥርዓትህን አልፈለጉምና።

verses.text_english: Great thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ቸርነትህ እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤ እንደ ፍርድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: Many my persecutors and mine enemies; do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.text_amharic: ያሳደዱኝና ያስጨነቁኝ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤ ከምስክር ግን ፈቀቅ አላልሁም።

verses.text_english: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህን አልጠበቁምና ሰነፎችን አይቼ አዘንሁ።

verses.text_english: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝህን እንደ ወደድሁ ተመልከት፤ አቤቱ፥ በምሕረትህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: Thy word true the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የቃልህ መጀመሪያ እውነት ነው፥ የጽድቅህንም ፍርድ ሁሉ ለዘላለም ነው።  ሳን

verses.text_english: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ገዢዎች በከንቱ አሳደዱኝ፤ ከቃልህ የተነሣ ግን ልቤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.text_english: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ምርኮ እንዳገኘ በቃልህ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: I hate and abhor lying: thy law do I love.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃን ጠላሁ ተጸየፍሁም፤ ሕግን ግን ወደድሁ።

verses.text_english: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርድ ሰባት ጊዜ በቀን አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግህን ለሚወድዱ ብዙ ሰላም ነው፥ ዕንቅፋትም የለባቸውም።

verses.text_english: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ተስፋ አደርግሁ፥ ትእዛዛትህንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ምስክርህን ጠበቀች እጅግም ወደደችው።

verses.text_english: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways before thee.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዶቼ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናቸውና ትእዛዝህንና ምስክርህን ጠበቅሁ።  ታው

verses.text_english: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትቅረብ፤ እንደ ቃልህም አስተዋይ አድርገኝ።

verses.text_english: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ልመናዬ ወደ ፊትህ ትድረስ፤ እንደ ቃልህ አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኸኛልና ከንፈሮቼ ምስጋናን አወጡ።

verses.text_english: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ ጽድቅ ናቸውና አንደበቴ ቃልህን ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትህን መርጫለሁና እጅህ የሚያድነኝ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law my delight.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ናፈቅሁ፤ ሕግህም ተድላዬ ነው።

verses.text_english: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ትኑርልኝ ታመሰግንህማለች፥ ፍርድህም ይርዳኝ።

verses.text_english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጠፉ በግ ተቅበዘበዝሁ፤ ትእዛዛትህን አልረሳሁምና ባሪያህን ፈልገው።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
verses.text_amharic: በተጨነቅሁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ ሰማኝም።

verses.text_english: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓመፀኛ ከንፈር ከሸንጋይም አንደበት፥ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን አድናት።

verses.text_english: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሽንገላ አንደበት ምንም ይሰጡሃል? ምንስ ይጨምሩልሃል?

verses.text_english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ በረሃ እንጨት ፍም የኃያላን ፍላጾች የተሳሉ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.text_amharic: መኖሪያዬ የራቀ እኔ ወዮልኝ፤ በቄዳር ድንኳኖች አደርሁ።

verses.text_english: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.text_amharic: ሰላምን ከሚጠሉ ጋር ነፍሴ ብዙ ጊዜ ኖረች።

verses.text_english: I peace: but when I speak, they for war.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሰላማዊ ነኝ፤ በተናገኋቸው ጊዜ ግን በከንቱ ተሰለፉብኝ።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቼ ወደ ተራሮች አነሣሁ፤ ረዳቴ ከወዴት ይምጣ?

verses.text_english: My help from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.text_amharic: ረዳቴ ሰማይና ምድርን ከሠራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.text_amharic: እግርህን ለመናወጥ አይሰጠውም፤ የሚጠብቅህም አይተኛም።

verses.text_english: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ አይተኛም አያንቀላፋምም።

verses.text_english: The LORD thy keeper: the LORD thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቅሃል፥ እግዚአብሔርም በቀኝ እጅህ በኩል ይጋርድሃል።

verses.text_english: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ በቀን አያቃጥልህም ጨረቃም በሌሊት።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከክፉ ሁሉ ይጠብቅሃል፥ ነፍስህንም ይጠብቃታል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እግዚአብሔር መውጣትህና መግባትህን ይጠብቃል።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees of David.] I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንሄድ ባሉኝ ጊዜ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግሮቻችን በአደባባይሽ ቆሙ።

verses.text_english: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌምስ እርስ በርስዋ እንደ ተገጠገጠች ከተማ ተሠርታለች።

verses.text_english: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑ ዘንድ፥ ለእስራኤል ምስክር ሊሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ነገዶች ወደዚያ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.text_amharic: ዙፋኖች በዚያ ለፍርድ ተቀምጠዋልና፥ የዳዊት ቤት ዙፋኖች።

verses.text_english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰላምን ለምኑ፤ አንተንም ለሚወድዱ ልማት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Peace be within thy walls, prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይልህ ሰላም፥ በጌጠኛ ቤትህም ልማት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace within thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ወንድሞቼ ስለ ባልንጀሮቼም፥ በውስጥሽ ሰላም ይሁን አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አምላካችን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ላንቺ መልካምነትሽን ፈለግሁ።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: 1 በሰማይ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ዓይኖቼን ወደ አንተ አነሣሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, as the eyes of servants unto the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የባሪያዎች ዓይኖች ወደ ጌታቸው እጅ እንደ ሆኑ፥ የባሪያይቱም ዓይን ወደ እመቤትዋ እጅ እንደ ሆነ፥ እንዲሁ እስኪምረን ድረስ ዓይናችን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.text_amharic: ማረን፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን፤ ንቀትን እጅግ ጠግበናልና፤

verses.text_english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
verses.text_amharic: የባለጠጎች ስድብና የትዕቢተኞችን ንቀት ነፍሳችን እጅግ ጠገበች።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees of David.] If the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ባይሆን እስራኤል እንዲህ ይበል።

verses.text_english: If the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ባይሆን ሰዎች በእኛ ላይ በተነሡ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣቸውን በላያችን በነደደ ጊዜ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሕያዋን ሳለን በዋጡን ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ውኃ ባሰጠመን ነበር፥ በነፍሳችንም ላይ ፈሳሽ ባለፈ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የጐርፍ ውኃ በነፍሳችን ላይ ባለፈ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Blessed the LORD, who hath not given us a prey to their teeth.
verses.text_amharic: ለጥርሳቸው ንክሻ ያላደረገን እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.text_english: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሳችን እንደ ወፍ ከአዳኞች ወጥመድ አመለጠች። ወጥመድ ተሰበረ እኛም አመለጥን።

verses.text_english: Our help in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.text_amharic: ረድኤታችን ሰማይንና ምድርን በሠራ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ነው።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] They that trust in the LORD as mount Zion, cannot be removed, abideth for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር የታመኑ እንደማይታወክ ለዘላለም እንደሚኖር እንደ ጽዮን ተራራ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: As the mountains round about Jerusalem, so the LORD round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ሆኑ፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ለዘላለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ዙሪያ ነው።

verses.text_english: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን እጃቸውን ወደ ክፋት እንዳይዘረጉ የኃጥኣን በትር በጻድቃን ዕጣ ላይ አይኖርም።

verses.text_english: Do good, O LORD, unto good, and upright in their hearts.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ለቸሮች ልባቸውም ለቀና መልካምን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: peace upon Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጠማማነት የሚመለሱትን ግን ዓመፃን ከሚሠሩት ጋር እግዚአብሔር ይወስዳቸዋል። ሰላም በእስራኤል ላይ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፥ እጅግ ደስተኞች ሆንን።

verses.text_english: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አፋችን ደስታን፥ አንደበታችንም ሐሴትን ሞላ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገላቸው ተባለ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath done great things for us; we are glad.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገልን፥ ደስም አለን።

verses.text_english: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በደቡብ እንዳሉ ፈሳሾች ምርኮአችንን መልስ።

verses.text_english: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.text_amharic: በልቅሶ የሚዘሩ በደስታ ይለቅማሉ።

verses.text_english: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves .
verses.text_amharic: በሄዱ ጊዜ፥ ዘራቸውን ተሸክመው እያለቀሱ ተሰማሩ፤ በተመለሱ ጊዜ ግን ነዶአቸውን ተሸክመው ደስ እያላቸው ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees for Solomon.] Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh in vain.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቤትን ካልሠራ፥ ሠራተኞች በከንቱ ይደክማሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከተማን ካልጠበቀ፥ ጠባቂ በከንቱ ይተጋል።

verses.text_english: vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.text_amharic: በማለዳ መገሥገሣችሁም ከንቱ ነው። ለወዳጆቹ እንቅልፍን በሰጠ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ የመከራን እንጀራ የምትበሉ፥ ከተቀመጣችሁበት ተነሡ።

verses.text_english: Lo, children an heritage of the LORD: the fruit of the womb reward.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ልጆች የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ናቸው፥ የሆድም ፍሬ የእርሱ ዋጋ ነው።

verses.text_english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man; so children of the youth.
verses.text_amharic: በኃያል እጅ እንዳሉ ፍላጾች፥ የጐልማስነት ልጆች እንዲሁ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Happy the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ምኞቱን የሚፈጽም ብፁዕ ሰው ነው፤ ጠላቶቻቸውን በአደባባይ በተናገሩ ጊዜ እርሱ አያፍርም።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] Blessed every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩት ሁሉ፥ በመንገዶቹም የሚሄዱ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy thou , and well with thee.
verses.text_amharic: የድካምህንም ፍሬ ትመገባለህ፤ ምስጉን ነህ መልካምም ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: Thy wife as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስትህ በቤትህ እልፍኝ ውስጥ እንደሚያፈራ ወይን ናት፤ ልጆችህ በማዕድህ ዙሪያ እንደ ወይራ ቡቃያ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው እንዲህ ይባረካል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን ይባርክህ፤ በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን መልካምነትዋን ታያለህ።

verses.text_english: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, peace upon Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የልጆችህንም ልጆች ታያለህ። በእስራኤል ላይ ሰላም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል። ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ ተሰለፉብኝ ይበል፤

verses.text_english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.text_amharic: ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ ተሰለፉብኝ፤ ነገር ግን አላሸነፉኝም።

verses.text_english: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች በጀርባዬ ላይ መቱኝ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም አስረዘሙአት።

verses.text_english: The LORD righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው፤ የኃጢአተኞችን አንገታቸውን ቈረጠ።

verses.text_english: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዮንን የሚጠሉ ሁሉ ይፈሩ፥ ወደ ኋላቸውም ይመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Let them be as the grass the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.text_amharic: በሰገነት ላይ እንደ በቀለ ሣር፥ ሳይነቀል እንደሚደርቅ፥

verses.text_english: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚያጭደው እጁን፥ ነዶዎቹን ለሚሰበስብ እቅፉን እንደማይሞላ ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገዱም የሚያልፉ። የእግዚአብሔር በረከት በእናንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንመርቃችኋለን አይሉም።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ከጥልቅ ጠራሁህ።

verses.text_english: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ድምፄን ስማ፤ ጆሮህ የልመናዬን ቃል የሚያደምጥ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአትንስ ብትጠባበቅ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማን ይቆማል?

verses.text_english: But forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.text_amharic: ይቅርታ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና።

verses.text_english: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ተስፋ አደረግሁህ፤ ነፍሴ በሕግህ ታገሠች።

verses.text_english: My soul for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: they that watch for the morning.
verses.text_amharic: ከማለዳው ሰዓት ጀምሮ እስከ ሌሊት ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ታመነች።

verses.text_english: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD mercy, and with him plenteous redemption.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምሕረት፥ በእርሱም ዘንድ ብዙ ማዳን ነውና እስራኤል በእግዚአብሔር ይታመን።

verses.text_english: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እስራኤልን ከኃጢአቱ ሁሉ ያድነዋል።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees of David.] LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ልቤ አይታበይብኝ፥ ዓይኖቼም ከፍ ከፍ አይበሉብኝ፤ ከትልልቆች ጋር፥ ከእኔም ይበልጥ ከሚከበሩ ጋር አልሄድሁም።

verses.text_english: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul even as a weaned child.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን አሳረፍኋት፥ የእናቱንም ጡት እንዳስተውት ዝም አሰኘኋት፤ ነፍሴ የእናቱን ጡት እንዳስተውት በእኔ ውስጥ ናት።

verses.text_english: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እስራኤል በእግዚአብሔር ይታመን።

verses.text_english: A Song of degrees. LORD, remember David, all his afflictions:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ዳዊትን ገርነቱንም ሁሉ አስብ፤

verses.text_english: How he sware unto the LORD, vowed unto the mighty of Jacob;
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር እንደ ማለ፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ እንደ ተሳለ።

verses.text_english: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ወደ ቤቴ ድንኳን አልገባም፥ ወደ ምንጣፌም አልጋ አልወጣም፥

verses.text_english: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.text_amharic: ለዓይኖቼም መኝታ ለሽፋሽፍቶቼም እንቅልፍ፥ ለጕንጮቼም ዕረፍትን አልሰጥም፥

verses.text_english: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ስፍራ፥ ለያዕቆብ አምላክ ማደሪያ እስካገኝ ድረስ ብሎ።

verses.text_english: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በኤፍራታ ሰማነው፥ በዱር ውስጥም አገኘነው።

verses.text_english: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ማደሪያዎቹ እንገባለን፤ እግሮቹ በሚቆሙበት ስፍራ እንሰግዳለን።

verses.text_english: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሥ፥ አንተና የመቅደስህ ታቦት።

verses.text_english: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቶችህ ጽድቅን ይልበሱ፥ ቅዱሳንህም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.text_english: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዳዊት ስለ ባሪያህ የቀባኸውን ሰው ፊት አትመልስ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath sworn truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዳዊት በእውነት ማለ አይጸጸትምም፥ እንዲህ ብሎ። ከሆድህ ፍሬ በዙፋንህ ላይ አስቀምጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችህ ኪዳኔን፥ ይህንም የማስተምራቸውን ምስክሬን ቢጠብቁ፥ ልጆቻቸው ደግሞ በዙፋንህ ላይ ለዘላለም ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired for his habitation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን መርጦአታልና፥ ማደሪያውም ትሆነው ዘንድ ወድዶአታልና፥ እንዲህ ብሎ።

verses.text_english: This my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች ለዘላለም ማረፊያዬ ናት፤ መርጫታለሁና በዚህች አድራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.text_amharic: አሮጊቶችዋን እጅግ እባርካለሁ፥ ድሆችዋንም እንጀራ አጠግባለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቶችዋንም ደኅንነትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥ ቅዱሳኖችዋም እጅግ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ለዳዊት ቀንድን አበቅላለሁ፥ ለቀባሁትም ሰው መብራትን አዘጋጃለሁ።

verses.text_english: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶችንም እፍረትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፤ በእርሱ ግን ቅድስናዬ ያብባል።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees of David.] Behold, how good and how pleasant for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች በኅብረት ቢቀመጡ፥ እነሆ፥ መልካም ነው፥ እነሆም፥ ያማረ ነው።

verses.text_english: like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.text_amharic: ከራስ እስከ ጢም እንደሚፈስስ፥ እስከ አሮን ጢም፥ በልብሱ መደረቢያ እንደሚወርድ ሽቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: As the dew of Hermon, that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, life for evermore.
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን ተራሮች እንደሚወርድ እንደ አርሞንዔም ጠል ነው፤ በዚያ እግዚአብሔር በረከቱን ሕይወትንም እስከ ዘላለም አዝዞአልና።

verses.text_english: [A Song of degrees.] Behold, bless ye the LORD, all servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ፥ በአምላካችን ቤት አደባባዬች የምትቆሙ እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሁላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Lift up your hands the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊት በቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ እጆቻችሁን አንሡ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ባርኩ።

verses.text_english: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይንና ምድርን የሠራ እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን ይባርክህ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise , O ye servants of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስም አመስግኑ፤ እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ አመስግኑት፥

verses.text_english: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ፥ በአምላካችን ቤት አደባባይ የምትቆሙ።

verses.text_english: Praise the LORD; for the LORD good: sing praises unto his name; for pleasant.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ለስሙ ዘምሩ፥ መልካም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, Israel for his peculiar treasure.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ለራሱ፥ እስራኤልንም ለመዝገቡ መርጦታልና፤

verses.text_english: For I know that the LORD great, and our Lord above all gods.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ፥ ጌታችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ እንዲበልጥ አውቄአለሁና።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይና በምድር በባሕርና በጥልቆች ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር የወደደውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድር ዳር ደመናትን ያወጣል፤ በዝናብ ጊዜ መብረቅን አደረገ፤ ነፋሳትንም ከመዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽን በኵር ልጆች ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ መታ።

verses.text_english: sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.text_amharic: ግብጽ ሆይ፥ በመካከልሽ በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ ተኣምራትንና ድንቅን ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ አሕዛብን መታ፥ ብርቱዎችንም ነገሥታት ገደለ።

verses.text_english: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.text_amharic: የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ የባሳንንም ንጉሥ ዐግን፥ የከነዓንን መንግሥታት ሁሉ ገደለ፤

verses.text_english: And gave their land an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸውንም ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ለሕዝቡ ርስት ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Thy name, O LORD, for ever; thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስምህ ለዘላለም ነው፥ ዝክርህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳልና፥ ባሪያዎቹንም ይረዳልና።

verses.text_english: The idols of the heathen silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ጣዖታት የብርና የወርቅ፥ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.text_amharic: አፍ አላቸው፥ አይናገሩምም፤ ዓይን አላቸው፥ አያዩምም፤

verses.text_english: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there breath in their mouths.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮ አላቸው፥ አይሰሙምም፤ እስትንፋስም በአፋቸው የለም።

verses.text_english: They that make them are like unto them: every one that trusteth in them.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሠሩአቸው ሁሉ የሚታመኑባቸውም ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት። የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት፤

verses.text_english: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊ ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት።

verses.text_english: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚያድር እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን የተባረከ ነው። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the LORD; for good: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የአማልክትን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.text_english: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የጌቶችን ጌታ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ብቻውን ታላቅ ተኣምራትን ያደረገ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትን በብልሃት የሠራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን በውኃ ላይ ያጸና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him that made great lights: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ብቻውን ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን የሠራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ለፀሐይ ቀንን ያስገዛው፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለጨረቃና ለከዋክብትም ሌሊትን ያስገዛቸው፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ከበኵራቸው ጋር ግብጽን የመታ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልንም ከመካከላቸው ያወጣ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በጸናች እጅ በተዘረጋችም ክንድ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: የኤርትራን ባሕር በየክፍሉ የከፈለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልን በመካከሉ ያሳለፈ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንንና ሠራዊቱን በኤርትራ ባሕር የጣለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ የመራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ታላላቅ ነገሥታትን የመታ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And slew famous kings: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ብርቱዎችንም ነገሥታት የገደለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸውን ርስት አድርጎ የሰጠ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለባሪያው ለእስራኤል ርስት፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.text_english: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እኛን በመዋረዳችን አስቦናልና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠላቶቻችንም እጅ አድኖናልና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.text_english: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ለሥጋ ሁሉ ምግብን የሚሰጥ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.text_english: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.text_english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎን ወንዞች አጠገብ በዚያ ተቀመጥን፤ ጽዮንንም ባሰብናት ጊዜ አለቀስን።

verses.text_english: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በአኻያ ዛፎችዋ ላይ መሰንቆቻችንን ሰቀልን።

verses.text_english: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us mirth, , Sing us of the songs of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: የማረኩን በዚያ የዝማሬን ቃል ፈለጉብን፥ የወሰዱንም። የጽዮንን ዝማሬ ዘምሩልን አሉን።

verses.text_english: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ዝማሬ በባዕድ ምድር እንዴት እንዘምራለን?

verses.text_english: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget .
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ብረሳሽ፥ ቀኜ ትርሳኝ።

verses.text_english: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.text_amharic: ባላስብሽ፥ ምላሴ በጕሮሮዬ ይጣበቅ፤ ከደስታዬ ሁሉ በላይ ኢየሩሳሌምን ባልወድድ።

verses.text_english: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase , rase to the foundation thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ቀን የኤዶምን ልጆች አስብ። እስከ መሠረትዋ ድረስ አፍርሱ አፍርሱ ያሉአትን።

verses.text_english: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy , that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ወራዳ የባቢሎን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለ ተበቀልሽን የሚበቀልሽ የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.text_english: Happy , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃናቶችሽን ይዞ በዓለት ላይ የሚፈጠፍጣቸው የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በፍጹም ልቤ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ የአፌን ነገር ሰምተኸኛልና፤ በመላእክት ፊት እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ እሰግዳለሁ፤ ስለ ምሕረትህና ስለ እውነትህ ስምህንም አመሰግናለሁ፥ በሁሉ ላይ ቅዱስ ስምህን ከፍ ከፍ አድርገሃልና።

verses.text_english: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, strengthenedst me strength in my soul.
verses.text_amharic: በጠራሁህ ቀን በፍጥነት አድምጠኝ፤ ነፍሴን በኃይልህ በብዙ አጸናሃት።

verses.text_english: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ የአፍህን ቃል ሁሉ ሰምተዋልና።

verses.text_english: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great the glory of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም መንገድ ይዘምራሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ታላቅ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Though the LORD high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከፍ ያለ ነውና፥ ወደ ችግረኞችም ይመለከታልና፤ ትዕቢተኞችንም ከሩቅ ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.text_amharic: በመከራ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ፥ አንተ ሕያው ታደርገኛለህ፤ በጠላቶቼ ቍጣ ላይ እጆቼን ትዘረጋለህ፥ ቀኝህም ታድነኛለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD will perfect concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ብድራትን ይመልስልኛል፤ አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ለዘላለም ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ የእጅህን ሥራ ቸል አትበል።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known .
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መረመርኸኝ፥ አወቅኸኝም።

verses.text_english: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ መቀመጤንና መነሣቴን አወቅህ፤ አሳቤን ሁሉ ከሩቅ አስተዋልህ።

verses.text_english: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted all my ways.
verses.text_amharic: ፍለጋዬንና ዕረፍቴን አንተ መረመርህ፤ መንገዶቼን ሁሉ ቀድመህ አወቅህ፥

verses.text_english: For not a word in my tongue, , lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.text_amharic: የዓመፃ ቃል በአንደበቴ እንደሌለ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ እነሆ የቀድሞውንና የኋላውን አወቅህ፤ አንተ ፈጠርኸኝ፥ እጅህንም በላዬ አደረግህ።

verses.text_english: knowledge too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot unto it.
verses.text_amharic: እውቀትህ ከእኔ ይልቅ ተደነቀች፤ በረታች፥ ወደ እርስዋም ለመድረስ አልችልም።

verses.text_english: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.text_amharic: ከመንፈስህ ወዴት እሄዳለሁ? ከፊትህስ ወዴት እሸሻለሁ?

verses.text_english: If I ascend up into heaven, thou there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou .
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰማይ ብወጣ፥ አንተ በዚያ አለህ። ወደ ሲኦልም ብወርድ፥ በዚያ አለህ።

verses.text_english: I take the wings of the morning, dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ንስር የንጋትን ክንፍ ብወስድ፥ እስከ ባሕር መጨረሻም ብበርር፥

verses.text_english: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ እጅህ ትመራኛለች፥ ቀኝህም ትይዘኛለች።

verses.text_english: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ጨለማ ትሸፍነኛለች ብል፥ ሌሊት በዙሪያዬ ብርሃን ትሆናለች፤

verses.text_english: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light both alike .
verses.text_amharic: ጨለማ በአንተ ዘንድ አይጨልምምና፥ ሌሊትም እንደ ቀን ታበራለችና፤ እንደ ጨለማዋ እንዲሁ ብርሃንዋ ነው።

verses.text_english: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኵላሊቴን ፈጥረሃልና፥ በእናቴም ሆድ ሰውረኸኛል።

verses.text_english: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully wonderfully made: marvellous thy works; and my soul knoweth right well.
verses.text_amharic: ግሩምና ድንቅ ሆኜ ተፈጥሬአለሁና አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ሥራህ ድንቅ ነው፥ ነፍሴም እጅግ ታውቀዋለች።

verses.text_english: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በስውር በተሠራሁ ጊዜ፥ አካሌም በምድር ታች በተሠራ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼ ከአንተ አልተሰወሩም።

verses.text_english: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all were written, in continuance were fashioned, when none of them.
verses.text_amharic: ያልተሠራ አካሌን ዓይኖችህ አዩኝ፤ የተፈጠሩ ቀኖቼ ሁሉ አንድ ስንኳ ሳይኖር በመጽሐፍህ ተጻፉ።

verses.text_english: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አሳቦችህ በእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ምን እጅግ የተከበሩ ናቸው! ቍጥራቸውም እንደ ምን በዛ!

verses.text_english: I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ብቈጥራቸው ከአሸዋ ይልቅ ይበዛሉ፤ ተነሣሁም፥ እኔም ገና ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኃጢአተኞችን የምትገድል ከሆንህስ፥ የደም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ከእኔ ፈቀቅ በሉ።

verses.text_english: For they speak against thee wickedly, thine enemies take in vain.
verses.text_amharic: በክፋት ይናገሩብሃልና፤ ጠላቶችህም በከንቱ ያምፁብሃል።

verses.text_english: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሚጠሉህን እኔ የጠላሁ አይደለሁምን? ስለ ጠላቶችህም አልተሰቀቅሁምን?

verses.text_english: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ፍጹም ጥል ጠላኋቸው፥ ጠላቶችም ሆኑኝ።

verses.text_english: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ መርምረኝ ልቤንም እወቅ፤ ፍተነኝ መንገዴንም እወቅ፤

verses.text_english: And see if wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.text_amharic: በደልንም በእኔ ውስጥ ብታገኝ እይ፤ የዘላለምንም መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.text_english: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.text_amharic: ለመዘምራን አለቃ የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.text_english: Which imagine mischiefs in heart; continually are they gathered together war.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከክፉ ሰው አድነኝ፥ በልባቸውም ክፉ ካሰቡ ከዓመፀኞች ሰዎች ጠብቀኝ፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ ለሰልፍ ይከማቻሉ።

verses.text_english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison under their lips. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ምላሳቸውን እንደ እባብ ሳሉ፤ ከከንፈራቸው በታች የእፉኝት መርዝ ነው።

verses.text_english: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች እጅ ጠብቀኝ፥ እርምጃዬንም ሊያሰናክሉ ከመከሩ ከዓመፀኞች አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኞች ወጥመድን ሰወሩብኝ፥ ለእግሮቼም የወጥመድ ገመድን ዘረጉ፤ በመንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አኖሩ።

verses.text_english: I said unto the LORD, Thou my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ የልመናዬን ቃል፥ አቤቱ፥ አድምጥ አልሁት።

verses.text_english: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጌታዬ፥ የመድኃኒቴ ጕልበት፥ በሰልፍ ቀን ራሴን ሸፈንህ።

verses.text_english: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከምኞቴ የተነሣ ለኃጢአተኞች አትስጠኝ፤ በላዬ ተማከሩ፤ እንዳይጓደዱ አትተወኝ።

verses.text_english: the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.text_amharic: የሚከብቡኝን ራስ የከንፈራቸው ክፋት ይክደናቸው።

verses.text_english: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.text_amharic: የእሳት ፍም በላያቸው ይውደቅ፤ እንዳይነሡም ወደ እሳትና ወደ ማዕበል ይጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow .
verses.text_amharic: ተናጋሪ ሰው በምድር ውስጥ አይጸናም፤ ዓመፀኛን ሰው ክፋት ለጥፋት ይፈልገዋል።

verses.text_english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, the right of the poor.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለድሀ ዳኝነትን ለችግረኛም ፍርድን እንዲያደርግ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃንም በእውነት ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ፤ ቀኖችም በፊትህ ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ ስማኝ፤ ወደ አንተ ስጮኽም የልመናዬን ቃል አድምጥ።

verses.text_english: Let my prayer be set forth before thee incense; the lifting up of my hands the evening sacrifice.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎቴን በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን ተቀበልልኝ፥ እጅ መንሣቴም እንደ ሠርክ መሥዋዕት ትሁን።

verses.text_english: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ለአፌ ጠባቂ አኑር፥ የከንፈሮቼንም መዝጊያ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Incline not my heart to evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤን ወደ ክፉ ነገር አትመልሰው፥ ዓመፃን ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ጋር ለኃጢአት ምክንያት እንዳልሰጥ፤ ከምርጦቻቸውም ጋር አልተባበር።

verses.text_english: Let the righteous smite me; a kindness: and let him reprove me; an excellent oil, shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also in their calamities.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ በምሕረት ይገሥጸኝ፥ ይዝለፈኝም፥ የኃጢአተኛ ዘይት ግን ራሴን አይቅባ፤ ጸሎቴ ገና በክፋታቸው ላይ ነውና።

verses.text_english: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያላኖቻቸው በዓለት አጠገብ ተጣሉ፤ ጣፋጭ ናትና ቃሌን ይሰማሉ።

verses.text_english: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ እንደ ተሰነጠቀ እንደ መሬት ጓል፥ እንዲሁ አጥንቶቻችን በሲኦል ተበተኑ።

verses.text_english: But mine eyes unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ ጌታ፥ ዓይኖቼ ወደ አንተ ናቸውና፤ በአንተ ታመንሁ፥ ነፍሴን አታውጣት።

verses.text_english: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰወሩብኝ ወጥመድ፥ ዓመፅንም ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ዕንቅፋት ጠብቀኝ።

verses.text_english: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ብቻዬን እስካልፍ ድረስ ኃጢአተኞች በወጥመዳቸው ይውደቁ።

verses.text_english: [Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.] I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.text_amharic: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፤ በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለመንሁ።

verses.text_english: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ልመናዬን በፊቱ አፈስሳለሁ፤ መከራዬንም በፊቴ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ በውስጤ ባለቀች ጊዜ መንገዴን አወቅሁ፤ በምሄድባት በዚያች መንገድ ወጥመድን ሰወሩብኝ።

verses.text_english: I looked on right hand, and beheld, but no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቀኝ ተመለከትሁ አየሁም፥ የሚያውቀኝም አጣሁ፤ መሸሸጊያም የለኝም፥ ስለ ነፍሴም የሚመራመር የለም።

verses.text_english: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou my refuge my portion in the land of the living.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ። አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህ፥ በሕያዋንም ምድር አንተ እድል ፈንታዬ ነህ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ተቸግሬአለሁና ወደ ልመናዬ አድምጥ፤ በርትተውብኛልና ከሚያሳድዱኝ አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስምህን አመሰግን ዘንድ፤ ነፍሴን ከወህኒ አውጣት፤ ዋጋዬን እስክትሰጠኝ ድረስ ጻድቃን እኔን ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.text_english: [A Psalm of David.] Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, in thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ በእውነትህ ልመናዬን አድምጥ፥ በጽድቅህም መልስልኝ።

verses.text_english: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው ሁሉ በፊትህ ጻድቅ አይደለምና ከባሪያህ ጋር ወደ ፍርድ አትግባ።

verses.text_english: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላትህ ነፍሴን አሳድዶአታል፥ ሕይወቴንም በምድር ውስጥ አጐስቍሎአታል፤ ቀድሞ እንደ ሞተ ሰው በጨለማ አኑሮኛል።

verses.text_english: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ በውስጤ አለቀችብኝ፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.text_english: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.text_amharic: የቀድሞውን ዘመን አሰብሁ፥ ሥራህንም ሁሉ አሰላሰልሁ፤ የእጅህንም ሥራ ተመለከትሁ።

verses.text_english: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቼን ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፤ ነፍሴም እንደ ምድረ በዳ አንተን ተጠማች።

verses.text_english: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፈጥነህ ስማኝ፤ ነፍሴ አልቃለች፤ ፊትህን ከኔ አትመልስ፥ ወደ ጕድጓድም እንደሚወርዱ አልሁን።

verses.text_english: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተን ታምኛለሁና በማለዳ ምሕረትህን አሰማኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አንሥቻለሁና የምሄድበትን መንገድ አስታውቀኝ።

verses.text_english: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ተማፅኛለሁና ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ።

verses.text_english: Teach me to do thy will; for thou my God: thy spirit good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ አምላኬ ነህና ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ አስተምረኝ፤ ቅዱስ መንፈስህም በጽድቅ ምድር ይምራኝ።

verses.text_english: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ በጽድቅህም ነፍሴን ከመከራዋ አውጣት።

verses.text_english: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I thy servant.
verses.text_amharic: በምሕረትህ ጠላቶቼን ደምስሳቸው፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝና ነፍሴን የሚያስጨንቁአትን ሁሉ አጥፋቸው።

verses.text_english: [ of David.] Blessed the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, my fingers to fight:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ይባረክ፥ ለእጆቼ ሰልፍን፥ ለጣቶቼም ዘመቻን የሚያስተምር፤

verses.text_english: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.text_amharic: መሓሪዬና መሸሸጊያዬ፥ መጠጊያዬና መድኃኒቴ፤ ረዳቴና መታመኛዬም፤ ሕዝቤንም ከእኔ በታች የሚያስገዛልኝ።

verses.text_english: LORD, what man, that thou takest knowledge of him! the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እርሱን ታውቀው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ታስብለት ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Man is like to vanity: his days as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ከንቱን ነገር ይመስላል፤ ዘመኑ እንደ ጥላ ያልፋል።

verses.text_english: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሰማዮችህን ዝቅ ዝቅ አድርጋቸው ውረድም፤ ተራሮችን ዳስሳቸው ይጢሱም።

verses.text_english: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: መብረቆችህን ብልጭ አድርጋቸው በትናቸውም፤ ፍላጾችህን ላካቸው አስደንግጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand a right hand of falsehood.
verses.text_amharic: እጅህን ከአርያም ላክ አድነኝም ከብዙ ውኆች፥ አፋቸውም ምናምንን ከሚናገር፥ ቀኛቸው የሐሰት ቀኝ ከሆነ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆች እጅ አስጥለኝ።

verses.text_english: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አዲስ ቅኔ እቀኛልሃለሁ፤ አሥር አውታር ባለው በገና እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.text_amharic: ለነገሥታት መድኃኒትን የሚሰጥ፥ ባሪያውን ዳዊትን ከክፉ ሰይፍ የሚያድነው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand a right hand of falsehood:
verses.text_amharic: አድነኝ፥ አፋቸውም ምናምንን ከሚናገር፥ ቀኛቸውም የሐሰት ቀኝ ከሆነ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆች እጅ አስጥለኝ።

verses.text_english: That our sons as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner stones, polished the similitude of a palace:
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸው በጕልማስነታቸው እንደ አዲስ አትክልት የሆኑ፥ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም እንደ እልፍኝ ያማሩና ያጌጡ፤

verses.text_english: our garners full, affording all manner of store: our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.text_amharic: ዕቃ ቤቶቻቸውም የተሞሉ በየዓይነቱ ዕቃ የሚሰጡ፥ በጎቻቸውም ብዙ የሚወልዱ፥ በማሰማርያቸውም የሚበዙ፥

verses.text_english: our oxen strong to labour; no breaking in, nor going out; that no complaining in our streets.
verses.text_amharic: ላሞቻቸውም የሚሰቡ፤ ቅጥራቸውም መፍረሻና መውጫ የሌለው፥ በአደባባዮቻቸውም ዋይታ የሌለ፤

verses.text_english: Happy people, that is in such a case: , happy people, whose God the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ የሚሆን ሕዝብ የተመሰገነ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ የሆነ ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: [David's of praise.] I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ ንጉሤ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም ዓለምም እባርካለሁ።

verses.text_english: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: በየቀኑ ሁሉ እባርክሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም ዓለምም አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Great the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness unsearchable.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው እጅግም የተመሰገነ ነው፤ ለታላቅነቱም ፍጻሜ የለውም።

verses.text_english: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.text_amharic: ትውልደ ትውልድ ሥራህን ያመሰግናሉ፥ ኃይልህንም ያወራሉ።

verses.text_english: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.text_amharic: የቅድስናህን ግርማ ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ ተኣምራትህንም ይነጋገራሉ።

verses.text_english: And shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.text_amharic: የግርማህንም ኃይል ይናገራሉ፥ ታላቅነትህንም ይነጋገራሉ፥ ብርታትህንም ይነጋገራሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: የቸርነትህን ብዛት መታሰብ ያወጣሉ፥ በጽድቅህም ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ርኅሩኅና መሓሪ ነው፥ ከቍጣ የራቀ፥ ምሕረቱም ብዙ ነው፤

verses.text_english: The LORD good to all: and his tender mercies over all his works.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሚታገሡት ቸር ነው። ምሕረቱም በሥራው ሁሉ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፥ ቅዱሳንህም ይባርኩሃል።

verses.text_english: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.text_amharic: የመንግሥትህን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ ኃይልህንም ይነጋገራሉ፥

verses.text_english: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ልጆች ኃይልህን የመንግሥትህንም ግርማ ክብር ያስታውቁ ዘንድ

verses.text_english: Thy kingdom an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion throughout all generations.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥትህ የዘላለም መንግሥት ናት፥ ግዛትህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all bowed down.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በቃሎቹ የታመነ ነው፥ በሥራውም ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር የተፍገመገሙትን ሁሉ ይደግፋቸዋል፥ የወደቁትንም ያነሣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.text_amharic: የሁሉ ዓይን አንተን ተስፋ ያደርጋል፤ አንተም ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ፥ ሕይወት ላለውም ሁሉ መልካምን ታጠግባለህ።

verses.text_english: The LORD righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በመንገዱ ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው በሥራውም ሁሉ ቸር ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ፥ በእውነት ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ ቅርብ ነው።

verses.text_english: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚፈሩት ምኞታቸውን ያደርጋል፥ ልመናቸውንም ይሰማል ያድናቸዋልም።

verses.text_english: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የሚወድዱትን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፤ ኃጢአተኞችንም ሁሉ ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: አፌ የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና ይናገራል፤ ሥጋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ዓለም የተቀደሰውን ስሙን ይባርክ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኚ።

verses.text_english: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወቴ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በምኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ ለአምላኬ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Put not your trust in princes, in the son of man, in whom no help.
verses.text_amharic: ማዳን በማይችሉ በሰው ልጆችና በአለቆች አትታመኑ።

verses.text_english: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱ ትወጣለች ወደ መሬቱም ይመለሳል፤ ያን ጊዜ ምክሩ ሁሉ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Happy that the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope in the LORD his God:
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ አምላክ ረዳቱ የሆነ ተስፋውም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር የሆነ ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤

verses.text_english: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein : which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሰማይንና ምድርን ባሕርንም፥ በእነርሱ ያለውንም ሁሉ የፈጠረ፤ እውነትን ለዘላለም የሚጠብቅ፤

verses.text_english: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
verses.text_amharic: ለተበደሉት የሚፈርድ፥ ለተራቡ ምግብን የሚሰጥ ነው። እግዚአብሔር የታሰሩትን ይፈታል፤

verses.text_english: The LORD openeth the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የወደቁትን ያነሣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ዕውሮችን ጥበበኞች ያደርጋቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ጻድቃንን ይወድዳል፤

verses.text_english: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስደተኞችን ይጠብቃል፤ ድሀ አደጎችንና ባልቴቶችን ይቀበላል፤ የኃጢአተኞችንም መንገድ ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall reign for ever, thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይነግሣል፤ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ አምላክሽ ለልጅ ልጅ ነው። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD: for good to sing praises unto our God; for pleasant; praise is comely.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ መዝሙር መልካም ነውና። ለአምላካችን ምስጋና ያማረ ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይሠራል፥ ከእስራኤልም የተበተኑትን ይሰበስባል።

verses.text_english: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸውን የቈሰሉትን ይፈውሳል፥ ሕማማቸውንም ይጠግናል።

verses.text_english: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by names.
verses.text_amharic: የከዋክብትንም ብዛት ይቈጥራል፥ ሁሉንም በየስማቸው ይጠራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Great our Lord, and of great power: his understanding infinite.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታችን ታላቅ ነው፥ ኃይሉም ታላቅ ነው፥ ለጥበቡም ቍጥር የለውም።

verses.text_english: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የዋሃንን ያነሣል፥ ኃጢአተኞችን ግን እስከ ምድር ድረስ ያዋርዳል።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር በምስጋና ዘምሩ፥ ለአምላካችንም በመሰንቆ ዘምሩ፤

verses.text_english: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማዩን በደመናት ይሸፍናል ለምድርም ዝናብን ያዘጋጃል፤ ሣርን በተራሮች ላይ ያበቅላል፤ ለምለሙንም ለሰው ልጆች ጥቅም።

verses.text_english: He giveth to the beast his food, to the young ravens which cry.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚጠሩት ለቍራዎች ጫጩቶች ለእንስሶችም ምግባቸውን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.text_amharic: የፈረስን ኃይል አይወድድም፥ በሰውም ጭን አይደሰትም።

verses.text_english: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሚፈሩት፥ በምሕረቱም በሚታመኑት ይደሰታል።

verses.text_english: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኚ፥

verses.text_english: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዮንም ሆይ፥ ለአምላክሽ እልል በዪ፤ የደጆችሽን መወርወሪያ አጽንቶአልና፥ ልጆችንም በውስጥሽ ባርኮአልና።

verses.text_english: He maketh peace thy borders, filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.text_amharic: በወሰንሽም ሰላምን አደረገ፥ የስንዴንም ስብ አጠገበሽ።

verses.text_english: He sendeth forth his commandment earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩን ወደ ምድር ይሰድዳል፥ ቃሉም እጅግ ፈጥኖ ይሮጣል።

verses.text_english: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.text_amharic: አመዳዩን እንደ ባዘቶ ይሰጣል፤ ጉሙን እንደ አመድ ይበትነዋል፤

verses.text_english: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.text_amharic: በረዶውን እንደ ፍርፋሪ ያወርዳል፤ በበረዶውስ ፊት ማን ይቆማል?

verses.text_english: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, the waters flow.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን ልኮ ያቀልጠዋል፤ ነፋሱን ያነፍሳል፥ ውኆችንም ያፈስሳል።

verses.text_english: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን ለያዕቆብ፥ ሥርዓቱንና ፍርዱን ለእስራኤል ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለሌሎች አሕዛብ ሁሉ እንዲህ አላደረገም፥ ፍርዱንም አልገለጠላቸውም። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን ከሰማያት አመስግኑት፤ በአርያም አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.text_amharic: መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት፤ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፥ አመስግኑት፤ ከዋክብትና ብርሃን ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that above the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማየ ሰማያት፥ አመስግኑት የሰማያት በላይም ውኃ።

verses.text_english: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ብሎአልና፥ ሆኑም፤ እርሱም አዝዞአልና፥ ተፈጠሩም፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም ዓለም አቆማቸው፤ ትእዛዝን ሰጠ፥ አያልፉምም።

verses.text_english: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.text_amharic: እባቦች ጥልቆችም ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ከምድር አመስግኑት፤

verses.text_english: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.text_amharic: እሳትና በረዶ አመዳይና ውርጭ፥ ቃሉን የሚያደርግ ዐውሎ ነፋስም፤

verses.text_english: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች ኰረብቶችም ሁሉ፥ የሚያፈራም ዛፍ ዝግባም ሁሉ፤

verses.text_english: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.text_amharic: አራዊትም እንስሳትም ሁሉ፥ ተንቀሳቃሾችም የሚበርሩ ወፎችም፤

verses.text_english: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ነገሥታት አሕዛብም ሁሉ፥ አለቆች የምድርም ፈራጆች ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሶችና ቈነጃጅቶች፥ ሽማግሌዎችና ልጆች፤

verses.text_english: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory above the earth and heaven.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑ፤ ስሙ ብቻውን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ ምስጋናውም በሰማይና በምድር ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቡንም ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ የቅዱሳኑንም ሁሉ ምስጋና ወደ እርሱ ለቀረበ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሕዝብ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። ለእግዚአብሔር አዲሱን ቅኔ ተቀኙለት፤ ምስጋናው በቅዱሳኑ ጉባኤ ነው።

verses.text_english: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል በፈጣሪው ደስ ይበለው፥ የጽዮንም ልጆች በንጉሣቸው ሐሤትን ያድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙን በዘፈን ያመስግኑ፥ በከበሮና በመሰንቆም ይዘምሩለት።

verses.text_english: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ተደስቶአልና፥ የዋሃንንም በማዳኑ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋልና።

verses.text_english: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱሳን በክብር ይመካሉ፤ በምንጣፋቸውም ላይ ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: the high of God in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና በጕሮሮአቸው ነው፤ ሁለት አፍ ያለውም ሰይፍ በእጃቸው ነው፥

verses.text_english: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, punishments upon the people;
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ ላይ በቀልን በሰዎችም መካከል ቅጣትን ያደርጉ ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሦቻቸውን በሰንሰለት፥ አለቆቻቸውንም በእግር ብረት ያስሩ ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የተጻፈውን ፍርድ ያደርጉባቸው ዘንድ። ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይህች ክብር ናት። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን በመቅደሱ አመስግኑት፤ በኃይሉ ጠፈር አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.text_amharic: በችሎቱ አመስግኑት፤ በታላቅነቱ ብዛት አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.text_amharic: በመለከት ድምፅ አመስግኑት፤ በበገናና በመሰንቆ አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.text_amharic: በከበሮና በዘፈን አመስግኑት፤ በአውታርና በእምቢልታ አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.text_amharic: ድምፁ መልካም በሆነ ጸናጽል አመስግኑት፤ እልልታ ባለው ጸናጽል አመስግኑት።

verses.text_english: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እስትንፋስ ያለው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግን። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.text_english: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የዳዊት ልጅ የሰሎሞን ምሳሌዎች፤

verses.text_english: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብንና ተግሣጽን ለማወቅ፥ የእውቀትንም ቃል ለማስተዋል፥

verses.text_english: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.text_amharic: የጥበብን ትምህርት ጽድቅንና ፍርድን ቅንነትንም ለመቀበል፥

verses.text_english: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.text_amharic: ብልሃትን ለአላዋቂዎች ይሰጥ ዘንድ ለጐበዛዝትም እውቀትንና ጥንቃቄን፥

verses.text_english: A wise will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢብ እነዚህን ከመስማት ጥበብን ይጨምራል፥ አስተዋይም መልካም ምክርን ገንዘቡ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌንና ትርጓሜን የጠቢባንና ቃልና የተሸሸገውን ነገር ለማስተዋል።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD the beginning of knowledge: fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.text_amharic: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፤ ሰነፎች ግን ጥበብንና ተግሣጽን ይንቃሉ።

verses.text_english: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ የአባትህን ምክር ስማ፥ የእናንትህንም ሕግ አትተው፤

verses.text_english: For they an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.text_amharic: ለራስህ የሞገስ ዘውድ ለአንገትህም ድሪ ይሆንልሃልና።

verses.text_english: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ኃጢአተኞች ቢያባብሉህ እሺ አትበል።

verses.text_english: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.text_amharic: ደምን ለማፍሰስ ለእኛ ጋር ና እናድባ፥ ለንጹሕም ያለ ምክንያት ወጥመድን እንሸምቅበት ቢሉ፤

verses.text_english: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወታቸው ሳሉ እንደ ሲኦል ሆነን እንዋጣቸው፥ በሙሉም ወደ ጕድጓድ እንደሚወድቁ ይሁኑ፤

verses.text_english: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙን ሀብት ሁሉ እናገኛለን፥ ከምርኮውም ቤታችንን እንሞላለን፤

verses.text_english: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣህን ከእኛ ጋር ጣል፤ ለሁላችንም አንድ ከረጢት ይሁን ቢሉ፤

verses.text_english: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር በመንገድ አትሂድ፥ ከጎዳናቸውም እግርህን ፈቀቅ አድርግ፤
