verses.text_english: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቻቸው ወደ ክፋት ይሮጣሉና፥ ደም ለማፍሰስም ይፈጥናሉና።

verses.text_english: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.text_amharic: መርበብ በወፎች ዓይን ፊት በከንቱ ትተከላለችና።

verses.text_english: And they lay wait for their blood; they lurk privily for their lives.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በደማቸው ላይ ያደባሉ፥ በነፍሳቸውም ላይ ይሸምቃሉ።

verses.text_english: So the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ይህ መንገድ ትርፍን ለማግኘት የሚሳሳ ሁሉ ነው። የባለቤቱን ነፍስ ይነጥቃል።

verses.text_english: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ በጎዳና ትጮኻለች፤ በአደባባይ ድምፅዋን ከፍ ታደርጋለች፤

verses.text_english: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, ,
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባይ ትጣራለች፤ በከተማይቱ መግቢያ በር ቃልን ትናገራለች።

verses.text_english: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ አላዋቂዎች፥ እስከ መቼ አላዋቂነት ትወድዳላችሁ? ፌዘኞችም ፌዝን ይፈቅዳሉ? ሰነፎችም እውቀትን ይጠላሉ?

verses.text_english: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዘለፋዬ ተመለሱ፤ እነሆ፥ መንፈሴን አፈስስላችኋለሁ፤ ቃሌን አስተምራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.text_amharic: በጠራሁ ጊዜ እምቢ ስላላችሁ፥ እጄን በዘረጋሁ ጊዜ ማንም ስላላስተዋለ፥

verses.text_english: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.text_amharic: ምክሬን ሁሉ ግን ቸል ስላላችሁ፥ ዘለፋዬንም ስላልፈቀዳችሁ፤

verses.text_english: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ስለዚህ በጥፋታችሁ እስቃለሁ፤ ጥፋታችሁም በመጣ ጊዜ አላግጥባችvሁ።

verses.text_english: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋጤ እንደ ጐርፍ በደረሰባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ጥፋታችሁም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ ጭንቅና መከራ በወረደባችሁ ጊዜ።

verses.text_english: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ ይጠሩኛል፥ እኔ ግን አልመልስም፤ ተግተው ይሹኛል፥ ነገር ግን አያገኙኝም።

verses.text_english: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እውቀትን ጠልተዋልና፥ እግዚአብሔርንም መፍራት አልመረጡምና፤

verses.text_english: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.text_amharic: ምክሬን አልፈቀዱምና፥ ዘለፋዬንም ሁሉ ንቀዋልና፤

verses.text_english: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የመንገዳቸውን ፍሬ ይበላሉ፥ ከራሳቸው ምክር ይጠግባሉ።

verses.text_english: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: አላዋቂዎችን ከጥበብ መራቅ ይገድላቸዋልና፥ ሰነፎችንም ቸልተኛ መሆን ያጠፋቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማኝ ግን በእርጋታ ይቀመጣል፥ ከመከራም ሥጋት ያርፋል።

verses.text_english: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ቃሌን ብትቀበል፥ ትእዛዜንም በአንተ ዘንድ ሸሽገህ ብትይዛት፥

verses.text_english: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮህ ጥበብን እንዲያደምጥ ታደርጋለህ፥ ልብህንም ወደ ማስተዋል ታዘነብላለህ።

verses.text_english: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.text_amharic: ረቂቅ እውቀትን ብትጠራት፥ ለማስተዋልም ድምፅህን ብታነሣ፥

verses.text_english: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as hid treasures;
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋንም እንደ ብር ብትፈላልጋት፥ እርስዋንም እንደ ተቀበረ ገንዘብ ብትሻት፤

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ታውቃለህ፥ የአምላክንም እውቀት ታገኛለህ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth knowledge and understanding.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጥበብን ይሰጣልና፤ ከአፉም እውቀትና ማስተዋል ይወጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ለቅኖች ደኅንነትን ያከማቻል፤ ያለ ነውር ለሚሄዱትም ጋሻ ነው፤

verses.text_english: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.text_amharic: የፍርድን ጎዳና ይጠብቃል፤ የቅዱሳኑንም መንገድ ያጸናል።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; , every good path.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ ጽድቅንና ፍርድን ቅንነትንና መልካም መንገድን ሁሉ ታስተውላለህ።

verses.text_english: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ ወደ ልብህ ትገባለችና፥ እውቀትም ነፍስህን ደስ ታሰኛለችና፤

verses.text_english: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.text_amharic: ጥንቃቄ ይጠብቅሃል፥ ማስተዋልም ይጋርድሃል፥

verses.text_english: To deliver thee from the way of the evil , from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ መንገድ አንተን ለማዳን፥ ጠማማ ነገርን ከሚናገሩም ሰዎች፤

verses.text_english: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በጨለማ መንገድ ይሄዱ ዘንድ የቀናውን ጎዳና የሚተው፥

verses.text_english: Who rejoice to do evil, delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ በመሥራት ደስ የሚላቸው በጠማማነትም ደስታን የሚያደርጉ፥

verses.text_english: Whose ways crooked, and froward in their paths:
verses.text_amharic: መንገዳቸውን የሚጠመዝዙ አካሄዳቸውንም የሚያጣምሙ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: To deliver thee from the strange woman, from the stranger flattereth with her words;
verses.text_amharic: ከጋለሞታ ሴት አንተን ለመታደግ፥ ቃልዋን ከምታለዝብ ከሌላዪቱም ሴት፤

verses.text_english: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.text_amharic: የሕፃንነት ወዳጅዋን የምትተው የአምላክዋንም ቃል ኪዳን የምትረሳ፤

verses.text_english: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ቤትዋ ወደ ሞት ያዘነበለ ነው፥ አካሄድዋም ወደ ሙታን ጥላ።

verses.text_english: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርስዋ የሚገቡ ሁሉ አይመለሱም፥ የሕይወትንም ጎዳና አያገኙም፤

verses.text_english: That thou mayest walk in the way of good , and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በደጋግ ሰዎች መንገድ እንድትሄድ የጻድቃንንም ጎዳና እንድትጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.text_amharic: ቅኖች በምድር ላይ ይቀመጣሉና፥ ፍጹማንም በእርስዋ ይኖራሉና፤

verses.text_english: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጥኣን ግን ከምድር ይጠፋሉ፥ ዓመፀኞችም ከእርስዋ ይነጠቃሉ።

verses.text_english: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ሕጌን አትርሳ፥ ልብህም ትእዛዛቴን ይጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ዘመናትና ረጅም ዕድሜ ሰላምም ይጨምሩልሃልና።

verses.text_english: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትና እውነት ከአንተ አይራቁ፤ በአንገትህ እሰራቸው፤ በልብህ ጽላት ጻፋቸው።

verses.text_english: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊትም ሞገስንና መልካም ዝናን ታገኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.text_amharic: በፍጹም ልብህ በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፥ በራስህም ማስተዋል አትደገፍ፤

verses.text_english: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድህ ሁሉ እርሱን እወቅ፥ እርሱም ጎዳናህን ያቀናልሃል።

verses.text_english: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.text_amharic: በራስህ አስተያየት ጠቢብ አትሁን፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፥ ከክፋትም ራቅ፤

verses.text_english: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ለሥጋህ ፈውስ ይሆንልሃል፥ ለአጥንትህም ጠገን።

verses.text_english: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ከሀብትህ አክብር፥ ከፍሬህም ሁሉ በኵራት፤

verses.text_english: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.text_amharic: ጐተራህም እህልን ይሞላል፥ መጥመቂያህም በወይን ጠጅ ሞልታ ትትረፈረፋለች።

verses.text_english: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ተግሣጽ አትናቅ፥ በገሠጸህም ጊዜ አትመረር።

verses.text_english: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son he delighteth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የወደደውን ይገሥጻልና፥ አባት የሚወድደውን ልጁን እንደሚገሥጽ።

verses.text_english: Happy the man findeth wisdom, and the man getteth understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብን የሚያገኝ ሰው ምስጉን ነው፥ ማስተዋልንም ገንዘቡ የሚያደርግ፤

verses.text_english: For the merchandise of it better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.text_amharic: በወርቅና በብር ከመነገድ ይልቅ በእርስዋ መነገድ ይሻላልና።

verses.text_english: She more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀይ ዕንቍም ትከብራለች፥ የተከበረም ነገር ሁሉ አይተካከላትም።

verses.text_english: Length of days in her right hand; in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.text_amharic: በቀኝዋ ረጅም ዘመን ነው፥ በግራዋም ባለጠግነትና ክብር።

verses.text_english: Her ways ways of pleasantness, and all her paths peace.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድዋ የደስታ መንገድ ነው፥ ጎዳናዋም ሁሉ ሰላም ነው።

verses.text_english: She a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy that retaineth her.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ለሚይዙአት የሕይወት ዛፍ ናት፥ የተመረኰዘባትም ሁሉ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በጥበብ ምድርን መሠረተ፥ በማስተዋልም ሰማያትን አጸና።

verses.text_english: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.text_amharic: በእውቀቱ ቀላያት ተቀደዱ፥ ደመናትም ጠልን ያንጠባጥባሉ።

verses.text_english: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ከዓይኖችህ አይራቁ፤ መልካም ጥበብንና ጥንቃቄን ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.text_amharic: ለነፍስህም ሕይወት ይሆናሉ፥ ለአንገትህም ሞገስ።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ መንገድህን ተማምነህ ትሄዳለህ፥ እግርህም አይሰነካከልም።

verses.text_english: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.text_amharic: በተኛህ ጊዜ አትፈራም፤ ትተኛለህ፥ እንቅልፍህም የጣፈጠ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገት ከሚያስፈራ ነገር፥ ከሚመጣውም ከኃጥኣን ጥፋት አትፈራም፤

verses.text_english: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መታመኛህ ይሆናልና፥ እግርህም እንዳይጠመድ ይጠብቅሃልና።

verses.text_english: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do .
verses.text_amharic: ለተቸገረው ሰው በጎ ነገርን ማድረግ አትከልክል፥ ልታደርግለት የሚቻልህ ሲሆን።

verses.text_english: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጅህን። ሂድና ተመለስ፤ ነገ እሰጥሃለሁ አትበለው። በጎ ነገርን ማድረግ ሲቻልህ።

verses.text_english: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.text_amharic: በወዳጅህ ላይ ክፉ አትሥራ፥ እርሱ ተማምኖ ከአንተ ጋር ተቀምጦ ሳለ።

verses.text_english: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው ጋር በከንቱ አትጣላ፥ እርሱ ክፉ ካልሠራብህ።

verses.text_english: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.text_amharic: በግፈኛ ሰው አትቅና፥ መንገዱንም ሁሉ አትምረጥ።

verses.text_english: For the froward abomination to the LORD: but his secret with the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ጠማማ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርኩስ ነውና፤ ወዳጅነቱ ግን ከቅኖች ጋር ነው።

verses.text_english: The curse of the LORD in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መርገም በኃጥእ ቤት ነው፥ የጻድቃን ቤት ግን ይባረካል።

verses.text_english: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.text_amharic: በፌዘኞች እርሱ ያፌዛል፥ ለትሑታን ግን ሞገስን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢባን ክብርን ይወርሳሉ፤ የሰነፎች ከፍታቸው ግን መዋረድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ልጆች፥ የአባትን ተግሣጽ ስሙ፥ ማስተዋልንም ታውቁ ዘንድ አድምጡ፤

verses.text_english: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ትምህርትን እሰጣችኋለሁና፤ ሕጌን አትተዉ።

verses.text_english: For I was my father's son, tender and only in the sight of my mother.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አባቴን የምሰማ ልጅ ነበርሁና፥ በእናቴም ዘንድ እወደድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.text_amharic: ያስተምረኝም ነበር እንዲህም ይለኝ ነበር። ልብህ ቃሌን ይቀበል፤ ትእዛዜን ጠብቅ በሕይወትም ትኖራለህ።

verses.text_english: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብን አግኝ፤ ማስተዋልን አግኝ፤ አትርሳም፥ ከአፌም ቃል ፈቀቅ አትበል።

verses.text_english: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.text_amharic: አትተዋት፥ ትደግፍህማለች፤ ውደዳት፥ ትጠብቅህማለች።

verses.text_english: Wisdom the principal thing; get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ ዓይነተኛ ነገር ናትና ጥበብን አግኝ፤ ከሀብትህም ሁሉ ማስተዋልን አትርፍ።

verses.text_english: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ከፍ አድርጋት፥ እርስዋም ከፍ ከፍ ታደርግሃለች፤ ብታቅፋትም ታከብርሃለች።

verses.text_english: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለራስህ የሞገስ አክሊልን ትሰጥሃለች፥ የተዋበ ዘውድንም ታበረክትሃለች።

verses.text_english: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስማ፥ ንግግሬንም ተቀበል፤ የሕይወትህም ዘመን ትበዛልሃለች።

verses.text_english: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.text_amharic: የጥበብን መንገድ አስተማርሁህ፤ በቀናች ጎዳና መራሁህ።

verses.text_english: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.text_amharic: በሄድህ ጊዜ እርምጃህ አይጠብብም፤ በሮጥህም ጊዜ አትሰናከልም።

verses.text_english: Take fast hold of instruction; let not go: keep her; for she thy life.
verses.text_amharic: ተግሣጽን ያዝ፥ አትተውም፤ ጠብቀው፥ እርሱ ሕይወትህ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil .
verses.text_amharic: በኃጥኣን መንገድ አትግባ፥ በክፉ ሰዎችም ጎዳና አትሂድ።

verses.text_english: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርስዋ ራቅ፥ አትሂድባትም፤ ፈቀቅ በል ተዋትም።

verses.text_english: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause to fall.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ካላደረጉ አይተኙምና፥ ካላሰናከሉም እንቅልፋቸው ይወገዳልና።

verses.text_english: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጢአትን እንጀራ ይበላሉና፥ የግፍንም ወይን ጠጅ ይጠጣሉና።

verses.text_english: But the path of the just as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን መንገድ ግን እንደ ንጋት ብርሃን ነው፥ ሙሉ ቀን እስኪሆንም ድረስ እየተጨመረ ይበራል።

verses.text_english: The way of the wicked as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጥኣን መንገድ እንደ ጨለማ ነው፥ እንዴት እንደሚሰናከሉም አያውቁም።

verses.text_english: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን አድምጥ ወደ ቃሌም ጆሮህን አዘንብል።

verses.text_english: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓይንህ አታርቃት፥ በልብህም ውስጥ ጠብቃት።

verses.text_english: For they life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚያገኙአት ሕይወት፥ ለሥጋቸውም ሁሉ ፈውስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it the issues of life.
verses.text_amharic: አጥብቀህ ልብህን ጠብቅ፥ የሕይወት መውጫ ከእርሱ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.text_amharic: የአፍህን ጠማማነት ከአንተ አውጣ፥ ሐሰተኞቹን ከንፈሮችም ከአንተ አርቅ።

verses.text_english: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችህ አቅንተው ይዩ፥ ሽፋሽፍቶችህም በቀጥታ ይመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.text_amharic: የእግርህን መንገድ አቅና፥ አካሄድህም ሁሉ ይጽና።

verses.text_english: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አትበል፤ እግርህንም ከክፉ መልስ።

verses.text_english: My son, attend unto my wisdom, bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ወደ ጥበቤ አድምጥ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ ትምህርቴ መልስ፥

verses.text_english: That thou mayest regard discretion, and thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: ጥንቃቄን ትጠብቅ ዘንድ ከንፈሮችህም እውቀትን እንዲጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: For the lips of a strange woman drop an honeycomb, and her mouth smoother than oil:
verses.text_amharic: ከጋለሞታ ሴት ከንፈር ማር ይንጠባጠባልና፥ አፍዋም ከቅቤ የለሰለሰ ነውና፤

verses.text_english: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
verses.text_amharic: ፍጻሜዋ ግን እንደ እሬት የመረረ ነው፥ ሁለት አፍ እንዳለው ሰይፍም የተሳለ ነው።

verses.text_english: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮችዋ ወደ ሞት ይወርዳሉ፥ አረማመድዋም ወደ ሲኦል ነው፤

verses.text_english: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, thou canst not know .
verses.text_amharic: የቀና የሕይወትን መንገድ አታገኝም፤ በአካሄድዋ የተቅበዘበዘች ናት፥ የሚታወቅም አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፥ ከአፌም ቃል አትራቁ።

verses.text_english: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.text_amharic: መንገድህን ከእርስዋ አርቅ፥ ወደ ቤትዋም ደጅ አትቅረብ፥

verses.text_english: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.text_amharic: ክብርህ ለሌላ እንዳትሰጥ፥ ዕድሜህም ለጨካኝ፤

verses.text_english: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours in the house of a stranger;
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎች ከሀብትህ እንዳይጠግቡ፥ ድካምህም በባዕድ ሰው ቤት እንዳይሆን።

verses.text_english: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.text_amharic: በመጨረሻም ሥጋህና ሰውነትህ በጠፋ ጊዜ ታለቅሳለህ፥

verses.text_english: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.text_amharic: ትላለህም። እንዴት ትምህርትን ጠላሁ፥ ልቤም ዘለፋን ናቀ!

verses.text_english: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.text_amharic: የአስተማሪዎቼንም ቃል አልሰማሁም፥ ጆሮቼንም ወደ አስተማሪዎቼ አላዘነበልሁም።

verses.text_english: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.text_amharic: በማኅበርና በጉባኤ መካከል ወደ ክፉ ሁሉ ለመድረስ ጥቂት ቀረኝ።

verses.text_english: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.text_amharic: ከጕድጓድህ ውኃ፥ ከምንጭህም የሚፈልቀውን ውኃ ጠጣ።

verses.text_english: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.text_amharic: ምንጮችህ ወደ ሜዳ፥ ወንዞችህ ወደ አደባባይ፥ ይፈስሳሉን?

verses.text_english: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንተ ብቻ ይሁኑ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ላሉ እንግዶችም አይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.text_amharic: ምንጭህ ቡሩክ ይሁን፤ ከጕብዝናህም ሚስት ጋር ደስ ይበልህ።

verses.text_english: the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተወደደች ዋላ እንደ ተዋበችም ሚዳቋ፥ ጡትዋ ሁልጊዜ ታርካህ፥ በፍቅርዋም ሁልጊዜ ጥገብ።

verses.text_english: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስለ ምን ጋለሞታ ሴት ትወድዳለህ? የሌላይቱንስ ብብት ለምን ታቅፋለህ?

verses.text_english: For the ways of man before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው መንገድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ነውና፥ አካሄዱንም ሁሉ እርሱ ይመለከታልና።

verses.text_english: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጥኣንን ኃጢአቱ ታጠምደዋለች፥ በኃጢአቱም ገመድ ይታሰራል።

verses.text_english: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.text_amharic: አልተቀጣምና እርሱ ይሞታል፤ በስንፍናውም ብዛት ይስታል።

verses.text_english: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለጎረቤትህ ዋስ ብትሆን፥ ስለ ሌላ ሰው እጅህን አጋና ብትመታ፥

verses.text_english: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.text_amharic: በአፍህ ቃል ተጠመድህ፤ በአፍህ ቃል ተያዝህ።

verses.text_english: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ይህን አድርግ ራስህንም አድን፥ በጎረቤትህ እጅ ወድቀሃልና፤ ፈጥነህ ሂድ፥ ጎረቤትህንም ነዝንዘው።

verses.text_english: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.text_amharic: ለዓይንህ እንቅልፍን ለሽፋሽፍቶችህም እንጕልቻን አትስጥ፥

verses.text_english: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand , and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሚዳቋ ከአዳኝ እጅ፥ እንደ ወፍም ከአጥማጅ እጅ ትድን ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ታካች፥ ወደ ገብረ ጕንዳን ሂድ፥ መንገድዋንም ተመልክተህ ጠቢብ ሁን።

verses.text_english: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.text_amharic: አለቃና አዛዥ ገዢም ሳይኖራት

verses.text_english: Provideth her meat in the summer, gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.text_amharic: መብልዋን በበጋ ታሰናዳለች፥ መኖዋንም በመከር ትሰበስባለች።

verses.text_english: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ታካች፥ እስከ መቼ ትተኛለህ? ከእንቅልፍህስ መቼ ትነሣለህ?

verses.text_english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂት ትተኛለህ፥ ጥቂት ታንቀላፋለህ፥ ትተኛም ዘንድ ጥቂት እጅህን ታጥፋለህ፤

verses.text_english: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ድህነትህ እንደ ወንበዴ፥ ችጋርህም ሰይፍ እንደ ታጠቀ ሰው ይመጣብሃል።

verses.text_english: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ምናምንቴ ሰው የበደለኛም ልጅ በጠማማ አፍ ይሄዳል፤

verses.text_english: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.text_amharic: በዓይኑ ይጠቅሳል፥ በእግሩ ይናገራል፥ በጣቱ ያስተምራል፤

verses.text_english: Frowardness in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.text_amharic: ጠማማነት በልቡ አለ፥ ሁልጊዜም ክፋትን ያስባል፤ ጠብንም ይዘራል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጥፋቱ ድንገት ይደርስበታል፤ ድንገት ይደቅቃል፥ ፈውስም ከቶ የለውም።

verses.text_english: These six doth the LORD hate: yea, seven an abomination unto him:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የሚጠላቸው ስድስት ነገሮች ናቸው፥ ሰባትንም ነፍሱ አጥብቃ ትጸየፈዋለች፤

verses.text_english: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኛ ዓይን፥ ሐሰተኛ ምላስ፥ ንጹሕን ደም የምታፈስስ እጅ፥

verses.text_english: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ አሳብን የሚያበቅል ልብ፥ ወደ ክፉ የምትሮጥ እግር፥

verses.text_english: A false witness speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.text_amharic: በሐሰት የሚናገር ሐሰተኛ ምስክር በወንድማማች መካከልም ጠብን የሚዘራ።

verses.text_english: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ የአባትህን ትእዛዝ ጠብቅ፥ የእናትህንም ሕግ አትተው፤

verses.text_english: Bind them continually upon thine heart, tie them about thy neck.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜም በልብህ አኑረው፥ በአንገትህም እሰረው።

verses.text_english: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስትሄድም ይመራሃል፤ ስትተኛ ይጠብቅሃል፤ ስትነሣ ያነጋግርሃል።

verses.text_english: For the commandment a lamp; and the law light; and reproofs of instruction the way of life:
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝ መብራት፥ ሕግም ብርሃን ነውና፥ የተግሣጽም ዘለፋ የሕይወት መንገድ ነውና፥

verses.text_english: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ሴት ትጠብቅህ ዘንድ፥ ከሌላይቱም ሴት ምላስ ጥፍጥነት።

verses.text_english: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.text_amharic: ውበትዋን በልብህ አትመኘው፤ ሽፋሽፍትዋም አያጥምድህ።

verses.text_english: For by means of a whorish woman to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.text_amharic: የጋለሞታ ዋጋ እስከ አንዲት እንጀራ ነው፤ አመንዝራም ሴት የሰውን ሕይወት ታጠምዳለች።

verses.text_english: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.text_amharic: በጉያው እሳትን የሚታቀፍ፥ ልብሶቹስ የማይቃጠሉ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.text_amharic: በፍም ላይ የሚሄድ እግሮቹስ የማይቃጠሉ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰው ሚስት የሚገባም እንዲሁ ነው፤ የሚነካትም ሁሉ ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም።

verses.text_english: do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.text_amharic: ሌባ በተራበ ጊዜ ነፍሱን ሊያጠግብ ቢሰርቅ ሰዎች አይንቁትም፤

verses.text_english: But he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.text_amharic: ቢያዝም ሰባት እጥፍ ይከፍላል፥ በቤቱም ያለውን ሁሉ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴት ጋር የሚያመነዝር ግን አእምሮው የጐደለ ነው፤ እንዲሁም የሚያደርግ ነፍሱን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.text_amharic: ቍስልንና ውርደትን ያገኛል፥ ስድቡም አይደመሰስም።

verses.text_english: For jealousy the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.text_amharic: ቅንዓት ለሰው የቍጣ ትኵሳት ነውና፥ በበቀል ቀን አይራራለትምና።

verses.text_english: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ምንም ካሣ አይቀበልም፥ ስጦታም ብታበዛለት አይታረቅም።

verses.text_english: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ቃሌን ጠብቅ ትእዛዜንም በአንተ ዘንድ ሸሽግ።

verses.text_english: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዜን ጠብቅ በሕይወትም ትኖራለህ፤ ሕጌንም እንደ ዓይንህ ብሌን ጠብቅ፤

verses.text_english: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.text_amharic: በጣቶችህ እሰራቸው፤ በልብህ ጽላት ጻፋቸው።

verses.text_english: Say unto wisdom, Thou my sister; and call understanding kinswoman:
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብን። አንቺ እኅቴ ነሽ በላት፥ ማስተማውልንም። ወዳጄ ብለህ ጥራት፥

verses.text_english: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger flattereth with her words.
verses.text_amharic: ከጋለሞታ ሴት ትጠብቅህ ዘንድ ቃልዋን ካለዘበች ከሌላይቱ ሴት።

verses.text_english: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴ መስኮት ሆኜ ወደ አደባባይ ተመለከትሁ፤

verses.text_english: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.text_amharic: ከአላዋቂዎች መካከል አስተዋልሁ፤ ከጐበዛዝትም መካከል ብላቴናውን አእምሮ ጐድሎት አየሁ፥

verses.text_english: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባይ ሲሄድ በቤትዋም አቅራቢያ ሲያልፍ፤ የቤትዋን መንገድ ይዞ ወደ እርስዋ አቀና፥

verses.text_english: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.text_amharic: ማታ ሲመሽ፥ ውድቅትም ሲሆን፥ በሌሊትም በጽኑ ጨለማ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there met him a woman the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሴት ተገናኘችው የጋለሞታ ልብስ የለበሰች፥ ነፍሳትን ለማጥመድ የተዘጋጀች።

verses.text_english: (She loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.text_amharic: ሁከተኛና አባያ ናት፥ እግሮችዋም በቤትዋ አይቀመጡም፤

verses.text_english: Now without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጊዜ በጎዳና፥ አንድ ጊዜ በአደባባይ፥ በማዕዘኑም ሁሉ ታደባለች።

verses.text_english: So she caught him, and kissed him, with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.text_amharic: ያዘችውም ሳመችውም፤ ፊትዋም ያለ እፍረት ሆኖ እንዲህ አለችው።

verses.text_english: peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.text_amharic: መሥዋዕትንና የደኅንነት ቍርባንን ማቅረብ ነበረብኝ፤ ዛሬ ስእለቴን ፈጸምሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እንድገናኝህ፥ ፊትህንም በትጋት ለመሻት ወጥቻለሁ፥ አግኝቼሃለሁም።

verses.text_english: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved , with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በአልጋዬ ላይ ማለፊያ ሰርፍ ዘርግቼበታለሁ፥ የግብጽንም ሽመልመሌ ለሀፍ።

verses.text_english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.text_amharic: በመኝታዬ ከርቤንና ዓልሙን ቀረፋም ረጭቼበታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.text_amharic: ና፥ እስኪነጋ ድረስ በፍቅር እንርካ፥ በተወደደ መተቃቀፍም ደስ ይበለን።

verses.text_english: For the goodman not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.text_amharic: ባለቤቴ በቤቱ የለምና፥ ወደ ሩቅ መንገድ ሄዶአልና፤

verses.text_english: He hath taken a bag of money with him, will come home at the day appointed.
verses.text_amharic: በእጁም የብር ከረጢት ወስዶአል፤ ሙሉ ጨረቃ በሆነች ጊዜ ወደ ቤቱ ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.text_amharic: በብዙ ጨዋታዋ እንዲስት ታደርገዋለች፤ በከንፈርዋ ልዝብነት ትጐትተዋለች።

verses.text_english: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እንዲህ ስቶ ይከተላታል፥ በሬ ለመታረድ እንዲነዳ፥ ውሻም ወደ እስራት እንዲሄድ፥

verses.text_english: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it for his life.
verses.text_amharic: ወፍ ወደ ወጥመድ እንደሚቸኩል፥ ለነፍሱ ጥፋት እንደሚሆን ሳያውቅ፥ ፍላጻ ጕበቱን እስኪሰነጥቀው ድረስ።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ አሁን እንግዲህ ስሙኝ ወደ አፌም ቃል አድምጡኝ።

verses.text_english: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.text_amharic: ልብህ ወደ መንገድዋ አያዘንብል በጎዳናዋ አትሳት።

verses.text_english: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong have been slain by her.
verses.text_amharic: ወግታ የጣለቻቸው ብዙ ናቸውና፤ እርስዋም የገደለቻቸው እጅግ ብዙ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Her house the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.text_amharic: ቤትዋ የሲኦል መንገድ ነው፤ ወደ ሞት ማጀት የሚወርድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ጥበብ አትጮኽምን? ማስተዋልስ ድምፅዋን አትሰጥምን?

verses.text_english: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.text_amharic: በኮረብታ ላይ በመንገድ አጠገብ በጎዳና መካከል ትቆማለች።

verses.text_english: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.text_amharic: በበሩ አጠገብ በከተማይቱም መግቢያ፥ በደጁ መግቢያ ትጮኻለች።

verses.text_english: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice to the sons of man.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሰዎች፥ እናንተን እጠራለሁ፥ ድምፄም ወደ ሰዎች ልጆች ነው።

verses.text_english: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ አላዋቂዎች፥ ብልሃትን አስተውሉ፤ እናንተም ሰነፎች ጥበብን በልባችሁ ያዙ።

verses.text_english: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips right things.
verses.text_amharic: የከበረች ነገርን እናገራለሁና ስሙ፤ ከንፈሮቼም ቅን ነገርን ለመናገር ይከፈታሉ።

verses.text_english: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness an abomination to my lips.
verses.text_amharic: አፌ እውነትን ይናገራልና፥ ከንፈሮቼም ክፋትን ይጸየፋሉ።

verses.text_english: All the words of my mouth in righteousness; nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.text_amharic: የአፌ ቃላት ሁሉ ጽድቅ ናቸው፤ ጠማማ ዘወርዋራም አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: They all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ በሚያስተውሉ ዘንድ የቀኑ ናቸው፥ እውቀትንም ካገኙአት ሰዎች ጋር የተስማሙ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.text_amharic: ተግሣጼን እንጂ ብርን አትቀበሉ፥ ከምዝምዝ ወርቅም ይልቅ እውቀትን ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: For wisdom better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ ከቀይ ዕንቍ ትበልጣለችና የከበረ ነገር ሁሉ አይተካከላትም።

verses.text_english: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ጥበብ በብልሃት ተቀምጫለሁ፥ እውቀትንም ጥንቃቄንም አግኝቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ክፋትን ይጠላል፤ ትዕቢትንና እብሪትን ክፉንም መንገድ ጠማማውንም አፍ እጠላለሁ።

verses.text_english: Counsel mine, and sound wisdom: I understanding; I have strength.
verses.text_amharic: ምክርና መልካም ጥበብ የእኔ ነው፤ ማስተዋል እኔ ነኝ፥ ብርታትም አለኝ።

verses.text_english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሥታት በእኔ ይነግሣሉ፥ ሹማምቶችም የቀናውን ነገር ይደነግጋሉ።

verses.text_english: By me princes rule, and nobles, all the judges of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆች በእኔ ያዝዛሉ፥ ክቡራንና የምድር ፈራጆችም ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የሚወድዱኝን እወድዳለሁ፥ ተግተው የሚሹኝም ያገኙኛል።

verses.text_english: Riches and honour with me; , durable riches and righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ብልጥግናና ክብር በእኔ ዘንድ ነው፥ ብዙ ሀብትና ጽድቅም።

verses.text_english: My fruit better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬዬም ከምዝምዝ ወርቅ ይሻላል፥ ቡቃያዬም ከተመረጠች ብር።

verses.text_english: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በጽድቅ መንገድ እሄዳለሁ፥ በፍርድም ጎዳና መካከል፥

verses.text_english: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚወድዱኝ ርስት አወርሳቸው ዘንድ ቤተ መዛግብታቸውንም እሞላ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የመንገዱ መጀመሪያ አደረገኝ፥ በቀድሞ ሥራው መጀመሪያ።

verses.text_english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንቱ ከዘላለም ጀምሮ ተሾምሁ፤ ምድር ከመፈጠርዋ አስቀድሞ።

verses.text_english: When no depths, I was brought forth; when no fountains abounding with water.
verses.text_amharic: ቀላያት ገና ሳይኖሩ እኔ ተወለድሁ፥ የውኃ ምንጮች ገና ሳይፈልቁ።

verses.text_english: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች ገና ሳይመሠረቱ፥ ከኮረብቶች በፊት እኔ ተወለድሁ፥

verses.text_english: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱንና ሜዳውን ገና ሳይፈጥር፤ የመጀመሪያውን የዓለም አፈር።

verses.text_english: When he prepared the heavens, I there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.text_amharic: ሰማዮችን በዘረጋ ጊዜ አብሬ ነበርሁ፥ በቀላያት ፊት ክበብን በደነገገ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.text_amharic: ደመናትን በላይ ባዘጋጀ ጊዜ፥ የቀላይን ምንጮች ባጸና ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.text_amharic: ለባሕርም ዳርቻን በወሰነ ጊዜ ውኃ ከትእዛዙ እንዳያልፍ፥ የምድርን መሠረት በመሠረተ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then I was by him, one brought up : and I was daily delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ እኔ በእርሱ ዘንድ ዋና ሠራተኛ ነበርሁ፤ ዕለት ዕለት ደስ አሰኘው ነበርሁ፥ በፊቱም ሁልጊዜ ደስ ይለኝ ነበርሁ፥

verses.text_english: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights with the sons of men.
verses.text_amharic: ደስታዬም በምድሩ ተድላዬም በሰው ልጆች ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed keep my ways.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ መንገዴንም የሚጠብቁ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.text_amharic: ትምህርቴን ስሙ፥ ጠቢባንም ሁኑ፥ ቸል አትበሉትም።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማኝ ሰው ምስጉን ነው ዕለት ዕለት በቤቴ መግቢያ የሚተጋ፥ የደጄንም መድረክ የሚጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ያገኘ ሕይወትን ያገኛልና። ከእግዚአብሔርም ሞገስን ያገኛልና።

verses.text_english: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ያጣ ግን ራሱን ይጐዳል፤ የሚጠሉኝ ሁሉ ሞትን ይወድዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ ቤትዋን ሠራች፥ ሰባቱንም ምሰሶችዋን አቆመች።

verses.text_english: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሪዳዋን አረደች፥ የወይን ጠጅዋን ደባለቀች፥ ማዕድዋን አዘጋጀች።

verses.text_english: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎችዋን ልካ በከተማይቱ ከፍተኛ ስፍራ ላይ ጠራች።

verses.text_english: Whoso simple, let him turn in hither: him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.text_amharic: አላዋቂ የሆነ ወደዚህ ፈቀቅ ይበል፤ አእምሮ የጐደላቸውንም እንዲህ አለች።

verses.text_english: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine I have mingled.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ፥ እንጀራዬን ብሉ፥ የደባለቅሁትንም የወይን ጠጅ ጠጡ።

verses.text_english: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.text_amharic: አላዋቂነትን ትታችሁ በሕይወት ኑሩ፥ በማስተዋልም መንገድ ሂዱ።

verses.text_english: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked himself a blot.
verses.text_amharic: ፌዘኛን የሚገሥጽ ለራሱ ስድብን ይቀበላል፥ ኅጥአንም የሚዘልፍ ነውርን ያገኛል።

verses.text_english: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.text_amharic: ፌዘኛን አትገሥጽ እንዳይጠላህ፤ ጠቢብን ገሥጽ ይወድድህማል።

verses.text_english: Give to a wise , and he will be yet wiser: teach a just , and he will increase in learning.
verses.text_amharic: ለጠቢብ ሰው ትምህርትን ስጠው፥ ጥበብንም ያበዛል፤ ጽድቅንም አስተምረው፥ እውቀትንም ያበዛል።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy understanding.
verses.text_amharic: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፤ ቅዱሱንም ማወቅ ማስተዋል ነው።

verses.text_english: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመንህ በእኔ ይበዛልና፥ የሕይወትህም ዕድሜ ይጨመርልሃልና።

verses.text_english: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear .
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢብ ብትሆን ለራስህ ጠቢብ ትሆናለህ፥ ፌዘኛም ብትሆን ፌዘኛነትህን ለብቻህ ትሸከማለህ።  ፍን [የሚቀጥለው ከግሪክ የተጨመረ ነው።] ልጄ ለራስህ አዋቂ ብትሆን ለባልንጀራህም አዋቂ ትሆናለህ፤ ለራስህ ክፉ ብትሆን ግን ክፋትህን ትማራለህ። ሐሰትን የሚያዘጋጅ ሰው ነፋሳትን እንደሚያዘጋጅ ሰው ነው፤ የሚበርር ወፍንም እንደሚከተል ይመስላል። የወይኑ ቦታ መንገዱን ተወ፤ የሚሠማራባትን መንገድ ዘነጋ፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይሄዳል ለጥም ወደ ተሠራች አገር ይሄዳል፤ የማያፈራ የማይጠቅም ገንዘብንም በእጁ ይሰበስባል።

verses.text_english: A foolish woman clamorous: simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ ሴት ሁከተኛ ናት፤ አሳብ የላትም፥ አንዳችም አታውቅም።

verses.text_english: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.text_amharic: በቤትዋ ደጅ በከተማይቱ ከፍተኛ ስፍራ በወንበር ላይ ትቀመጣለች፥

verses.text_english: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድ የሚያልፉትን አካሄዳቸውንም ያቀኑትን ለመጥራት።

verses.text_english: Whoso simple, let him turn in hither: and him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.text_amharic: አላዋቂ የሆነ ወደዚህ ፈቀቅ ይበል፤ አእምሮ የጐደለውንም እንዲህ አለች።

verses.text_english: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread in secret is pleasant.
verses.text_amharic: የስርቆት ውኃ ይጣፍጣል፥ የተሸሸገም እንጀራ ደስ ያሰኛል።

verses.text_english: But he knoweth not that the dead there; her guests in the depths of hell.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እርሱ ሙታን ከዚያ እንዳሉ፥ እድምተኞችዋም በሲኦል ጥልቀት እንዳሉ አያውቅም።

verses.text_english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son the heaviness of his mother.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሎሞን ምሳሌዎች። ጠቢብ ልጅ አባቱን ደስ ያሰኛል፤ ሰነፍ ልጅ ግን ለእናቱ ኀዘን ነው።

verses.text_english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.text_amharic: በኃጢአት የተገኘ መዝገብ ጥቅም የለውም፤ ጽድቅ ግን ከሞት ያድናል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የጻድቁን ነፍስ አያስርብም፤ የኅጥኣንን ምኞት ግን ይገለብጣል።

verses.text_english: He becometh poor that dealeth a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.text_amharic: የታካች እጅ ችግረኛ ታደርጋለች፤ የትጉ እጅ ግን ባለጠጋ ታደርጋለች።

verses.text_english: He that gathereth in summer a wise son: he that sleepeth in harvest a son that causeth shame.
verses.text_amharic: በበጋ የሚያከማች ልጅ አስተዋይ ነው፤ በመከር የሚተኛ ግን እርሱ ራሱን ያስነውራል።

verses.text_english: Blessings upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: በረከት በጻድቅ ራስ ላይ ነው፤ የኅጥኣንን አፍ ግን ግፍ ይከድነዋል።

verses.text_english: The memory of the just blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ መታሰቢያ ለበረከት ነው፤ የኅጥኣን ስም ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.text_amharic: በልቡ ጠቢብ የሆነ ትእዛዝን ይቀበላል፤ በከንፈሩ የሚሰንፍ ግን ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ ነውር የሚሄድ ተማምኖ ይሄዳል፤ መንገዱን የሚያጣምም ግን ይታወቃል።

verses.text_english: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይኑ የሚጠቅስ መከራን ያመጣል፤ ደፍሮ የሚገሥጽ ግን ሰላምን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: The mouth of a righteous a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ አፍ የሕይወት ምንጭ ናት፤ የኃጥኣንን አፍ ግን ግፍ ይከድነዋል።

verses.text_english: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.text_amharic: ጥል ክርክርን ታስነሣለች፤ ፍቅር ግን ኃጢአትን ሁሉ ትከድናለች።

verses.text_english: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.text_amharic: በብልሃተኛ ከንፈር ጥበብ ትገኛለች፤ በትር ግን አእምሮ ለጐደለው ሰው ጀርባ ነው።

verses.text_english: Wise lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish near destruction.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢባን እውቀትን ይሸሽጋሉ፤ የሰነፍ አፍ ግን ለጥፋት ይቀርባል።

verses.text_english: The rich man's wealth his strong city: the destruction of the poor their poverty.
verses.text_amharic: የባለጠጋ ሀብት ለእርሱ የጸናች ከተማ ናት፤ የድሆች ጥፋት ድህነታቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: The labour of the righteous to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ ደመወዝ ለሕይወት ነው፤ የኃጥእ ፍሬ ግን ለኃጢአት ነው።

verses.text_english: He the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
verses.text_amharic: ተግሣጽን የሚጠብቅ በሕይወት መንገድ ይሄዳል፤ ዘለፋን የሚተው ግን ይስታል።

verses.text_english: He that hideth hatred lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, a fool.
verses.text_amharic: ጥልን የሚከድን ሐሰተኛ ከንፈር አለው፤ ሐሜትንም የሚገልጥ ሰነፍ ነው።

verses.text_english: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips wise.
verses.text_amharic: በቃል ብዛት ውስጥ ኃጢአት ሳይኖር አይቀርም፤ ከንፈሩን የሚገታ ግን አስተዋይ ነው።

verses.text_english: The tongue of the just choice silver: the heart of the wicked little worth.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ ምላስ የተፈተነ ብር ነው፤ የኅጥኣን ልብ ግን ምናምን ነው።

verses.text_english: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ ከንፈሮች ብዙ ሰዎችን ይመግባሉ፤ ሰነፎች ግን ከልባቸው ጕድለት የተነሣ ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር በረከት ባለጠጋ ታደርጋለች፥ ኀዘንንም ከእርስዋ ጋር አይጨምርም።

verses.text_english: as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ነገር ማድረግ ለሰነፍ ሰው ጨዋታ ነው፤ እንዲሁም ጥበብ ለአስተዋይ ነው።

verses.text_english: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.text_amharic: የኀጥእ ሰው ፍርሃት በላዩ ይመጣበታል፥ ለጻድቃንም ምኞታቸው ትሰጣቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: As the whirlwind passeth, so the wicked no : but the righteous an everlasting foundation.
verses.text_amharic: ዐውሎ ነፋስ ሲያልፍ ኃጥእ አይገኝም፤ ጻድቅ ግን የዘላለም መሠረት ነው።

verses.text_english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.text_amharic: ሆምጣጤ ጥርስን፥ ጢስም ዓይንን እንደሚጐዳ፥ እንዲሁም ታካች ለላኩት።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ዘመንን ታረዝማለች፤ የኀጥኣን ዕድሜ ግን ታጥራለች።

verses.text_english: The hope of the righteous gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን አለኝታ ደስታ ነው፤ የኀጥኣን ተስፋ ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The way of the LORD strength to the upright: but destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ያለ ነውር ለሚሄድ አምባ ነው፥ ጥፋት ግን ክፋትን ለሚያደርጉ።

verses.text_english: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን ለዘላለም አይናወጡም፤ ኅጥኣን ግን በምድር ላይ አይቀመጡም።

verses.text_english: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ አፍ ጥበብን ይናገራል፤ ጠማማ ምላስ ግን ትቈረጣለች።

verses.text_english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked frowardness.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ ከንፈሮች ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነገርን ያውቃሉ፤ የኀጥኣን አፍ ግን ጠማማ ነው።

verses.text_english: A false balance abomination to the LORD: but a just weight his delight.
verses.text_amharic: አባይ ሚዛን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አስጸያፊ ነው፤ እውነተኛ ሚዛን ግን ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.text_english: pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢት ከመጣች ውርደት ትመጣለች፤ በትሑታን ዘንድ ግን ጥበብ ትገኛለች።

verses.text_english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: ቅኖች ቅንነታቸው ትመራቸዋለች፤ ወስላቶችን ግን ጠማማነታቸው ታጠፋቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣ ቀን ሀብት አትረባም፤ ጽድቅ ግን ከሞት ታድናለች።

verses.text_english: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: የፍጹም ሰው ጽድቁ መንገዱን ያቀናለታል፤ ኃጥእ ግን በኃጢአቱ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in naughtiness.
verses.text_amharic: ቅኖችን ጽድቃቸው ይታደጋቸዋል፤ ወስላቶች ግን በምኞታቸው ይጠመዳሉ።

verses.text_english: When a wicked man dieth, expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust perisheth.
verses.text_amharic: ኀጥእ በሞተ ጊዜ ተስፋው ይቈረጣል፥ የኃያል አለኝታም ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ከጭንቀት ይድናል፥ ኀጥእም በእርሱ ፋንታ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: An hypocrite with mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.text_amharic: ዝንጉ ሰው በአፉ ባልንጀራውን ያጠፋል፤ ጻድቃን ግን በእውቀት ይድናሉ።

verses.text_english: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, shouting.
verses.text_amharic: በጻድቃን ልማት ከተማ ደስ ይላታል፥ በኀጥኣንም ጥፋት እልል ትላለች።

verses.text_english: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: በቅኖች በረከት ከተማ ከፍ ከፍ ትላለች፤ በኀጥኣን አፍ ግን ትገለበጣለች።

verses.text_english: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጁን የሚንቅ እርሱ አእምሮ የጐደለው ነው፤ አስተዋይ ግን ዝም ይላል።

verses.text_english: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.text_amharic: ለሐሜት የሚሄድ ምሥጢሩን ይገልጣል፤ በመንፈስ የታመነ ግን ነገሩን ይሰውራል።

verses.text_english: Where no counsel , the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors safety.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ምክር ከሌለ ዘንድ ሕዝብ ይወድቃል፤ በመካሮች ብዛት ግን ደኅንነት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart : and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.text_amharic: ለማያውቅ የሚዋስ ክፉ መከራን ይቀበላል፤ ዋስነትን የሚጠላ ግን ይድናል።

verses.text_english: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong retain riches.
verses.text_amharic: ሞገስ ያላት ሴት ክብርን ታገኛለች፥ ሀኬተኖችም ሀብትን ያገኛሉ።

verses.text_english: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ቸር ሰው ለራሱ መልካም ያደርጋል፤ ጨካኝ ግን ሥጋውን ይጐዳል።

verses.text_english: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness a sure reward.
verses.text_amharic: የኀጥእ ሰው ሞያ ሐሰተኛ ነው፤ ጽድቅን የሚዘራ ግን የታመነ ዋጋ አለው።

verses.text_english: As righteousness to life: so he that pursueth evil to his own death.
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅ የሚጸና በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ ክፋትን የሚከተል ግን ለሞቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: They that are of a froward heart abomination to the LORD: but upright in way his delight.
verses.text_amharic: ልበ ጠማሞች በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊዎች ናቸው፤ በመንገዳቸው ፍጹማን የሆኑ ግን የተወደዱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: hand in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ሰው እጅ በእጅ ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም፤ የጻድቃን ዘር ግን ይድናል።

verses.text_english: a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.text_amharic: የወርቅ ቀለበት በእርያ አፍንጫ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከጥበብ የተለየች ቆንጆ ሴትም እንዲሁ ናት።

verses.text_english: The desire of the righteous only good: the expectation of the wicked wrath.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን ምኞት በጎ ብቻ ነው፤ የኀጥኣን ተስፋ ግን መቅሠፍት ነው።

verses.text_english: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and that withholdeth more than is meet, but to poverty.
verses.text_amharic: ያለውን የሚበትን ሰው አለ፥ ይጨመርለታልም፤ ያለ ቅጥ የሚነፍግ ሰውም አለ፥ ይደኸያልም።

verses.text_english: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.text_amharic: የምትባረክ ነፍስ ትጠግባለች፥ የረካም እርሱ ደግሞ ይረካል።

verses.text_english: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing upon the head of him that selleth .
verses.text_amharic: እህልን የሚያስቀር ሰው በሕዝብ ዘንድ ይረገማል፤ በረከት ግን በሚሸጠው ራስ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.text_amharic: መልካምን ተግቶ የሚሻ ደስታን ይፈልጋል፤ ክፉን በሚፈልግ ግን ክፉ ይመጣበታል።

verses.text_english: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.text_amharic: በባለጠግነቱ የሚተማመን ሰው ይወድቃል ጻድቃን ግን እንደ ቅጠል ይለመልማሉ።

verses.text_english: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool servant to the wise of heart.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱን የሚያውክ ሰው ነፋስን ይወርሳል፥ ሰነፍም ለጠቢብ ተገዥ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The fruit of the righteous a tree of life; and he that winneth souls wise.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ ፍሬ የሕይወት ዛፍ ናት፥ ነፍሶችንም የሚሰበስብ እርሱ ጠቢብ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጻድቅ በምድር ላይ ፍዳውን የሚቀበል ከሆነ፥ ይልቁንስ ኀጥእና ዓመፀኛ እንዴት ይሆናሉ!

verses.text_english: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof brutish.
verses.text_amharic: ተግሣጽን የሚወድድ እውቀትን ይወድዳል፤ ዘለፋን የሚጠላ ግን ደንቆሮ ነው።

verses.text_english: A good obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.text_amharic: ደኅና ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሞገስን ያገኛል፤ ተንኰለኛውን ሰው ግን ይቀሥፈዋል።

verses.text_english: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን ዓመፃ አያጸናውም፤ የጻድቃን ሥር ግን አይንቀሳቀስም።

verses.text_english: A virtuous woman a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed as rottenness in his bones.
verses.text_amharic: ልባም ሴት ለባልዋ ዘውድ ናት፤ አሳፋሪ ሴት ግን በአጥንቱ ውስጥ እንደ ቅንቅን ናት።

verses.text_english: The thoughts of the righteous right: the counsels of the wicked deceit.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን አሳብ ቅን ነው፤ የኃጥኣን ምክር ግን ተንኰል ነው።

verses.text_english: The words of the wicked to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.text_amharic: የኃጥኣን ቃል ደምን ለማፍሰስ ትሸምቃለች፤ የቅኖች አፍ ግን ይታደጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The wicked are overthrown, and not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.text_amharic: ኀጥኣን ይገለበጣሉ፥ ደግሞም አይገኙም፤ የጻድቃን ቤት ግን ጸንቶ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በጥበቡ ይመሰገናል፤ ልቡ ጠማማ የሆነ ሰው ግን ይናቃል።

verses.text_english: despised, and hath a servant, better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሱ ባሪያ ሆኖ የተጠቃ ሰው እንጀራ ጐድሎት ራሱን ካከበረው ሰው ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: A righteous regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked cruel.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ሰው ለእንስሳው ነፍስ ይራራል፤ የኀጥኣን ምሕረት ግን ጨካኝ ነው።

verses.text_english: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain void of understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሩን የሚሠራ ሰው እንጀራ ይጠግባል፤ ለከንቱ ነገር የሚሮጥ ግን አእምሮ የጐደለው ነው።

verses.text_english: The wicked desireth the net of evil : but the root of the righteous yieldeth .
verses.text_amharic: የኅጥኣን ፈቃድ የክፉዎች ወጥመድ ናት፤ የጻድቃን ሥር ግን ፍሬን ያፈራል።

verses.text_english: The wicked is snared by the transgression of lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ሰው በከንፈሩ ኃጢአት ይጠመዳል፤ ጻድቅ ግን ከመከራ ያመልጣል።

verses.text_english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ነፍስ ከአፉ ፍሬ መልካም ነገርን ትጠግባለች፥ ሰውም እንደ እጁ ሥራ ዋጋውን ይቀበላል።

verses.text_english: The way of a fool right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel wise.
verses.text_amharic: የሰነፍ መንገድ በዓይኑ የቀናች ናት፤ ጠቢብ ግን ምክርን ይሰማል።

verses.text_english: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent covereth shame.
verses.text_amharic: የሰነፍ ቍጣ ቶሎ ይታወቃል፤ ብልህ ሰው ግን ነውርን ይሰውራል።

verses.text_english: speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.text_amharic: እውነተኛን ነገር የሚናገር ቅን ነገርን ያወራል፤ የሐሰት ምስክር ግን ተንኰልን ያወራል።

verses.text_english: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise health.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚዋጋ ሰይፍ የሚለፈልፍ ሰው አለ፤ የጠቢባን ምላስ ግን ጤና ነው።

verses.text_english: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue but for a moment.
verses.text_amharic: የእውነት ከንፈር ለዘላለም ትቆማለች፤ ውሸተኛ ምላስ ግን ለቅጽበት ነው።

verses.text_english: Deceit in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace joy.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉን በሚያስቡ ልብ ውስጥ ተንኰል አለ፤ በሰላም ለሚመክሩ ግን ደስታ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅን መከራ አያገኘውም፤ ኀጥኣን ግን ክፋትን የተሞሉ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Lying lips abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly his delight.
verses.text_amharic: ውሸተኛ ከንፈር በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አሰጸያፊ ነው፤ እውነትን የሚያደርጉ ግን በእርሱ ዘንድ የተወደዱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.text_amharic: ብልህ ሰው እውቀትን ይሸሽጋል፤ የሰነፎች ልብ ግን ስንፍናን ያወራል።

verses.text_english: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.text_amharic: የትጉ እጅ ትገዛለች፤ የታካች እጅ ግን ትገብራለች።

verses.text_english: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን የልቡ ኀዘን ያዋርደዋል፤ መልካም ቃል ግን ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.text_english: The righteous more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ለባልንጀራው መንገዱን ያሳያል፤ የኀጥኣን መንገድ ግን ታስታቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: The slothful roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man precious.
verses.text_amharic: ታካች ሰው አደን ምንም አያድንም፤ ለሰው የከበረ ሀብት ትጋት ነው።

verses.text_english: In the way of righteousness life; and the pathway no death.
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅ መንገድ ላይ ሕይወት አለ በጎዳናዋም ሞት የለም።

verses.text_english: A wise son his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.text_amharic: ባለ አእምሮ ልጅ የአባቱን ተግሣጽ ይሰማል። ፌዘኛ ግን ተግሣጽን አይሰማም።

verses.text_english: A man shall eat good by the fruit of mouth: but the soul of the transgressors violence.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ከአፉ ፍሬ መልካምን ይበላል፤ የዓመፀኞች ነፍስ ግን ግፍን ትሻለች።

verses.text_english: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.text_amharic: አፉን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃል፤ ከንፈሩን የሚያሞጠሙጥ ግን ጥፋትን ያገኘዋል።

verses.text_english: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.text_amharic: የታካች ሰው ነፍስ ትመኛለች፤ አንዳችም አታገኝም፤ የትጉ ነፍስ ግን ትጠግባለች።

verses.text_english: A righteous hateth lying: but a wicked is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ሐሰትን ይጠላል፤ ኀጥእ ግን ያሳፍራል ያስነውራልም።

verses.text_english: Righteousness keepeth upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገዱ ያለ ነውር የሚሄደውን ጽድቅ ይጠብቀዋል፤ ኃጢአት ግን ኃጢአተኛውን ይጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: There is that maketh himself rich, yet nothing: that maketh himself poor, yet great riches.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን ባለጠጋ የሚያስመስል ሰው አለ፥ ነገር ግን አንዳች የለውም፤ ራሱን ድሀ የሚያስመስል አለ፥ ነገር ግን እጅግ ባለጠግነት አለው።

verses.text_english: The ransom of a man's life his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ነፍስ ቤዛው ሀብቱ ነው፤ ድሀ ግን ተግሣጽን አይሰማም።

verses.text_english: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ለጻድቃን ብርሃን ነው፤ የኀጥኣን መብራት ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: በትዕቢት ጠብ ብቻ ይሆናል፤ ጥበብ ግን ምክርን በሚቀበሉ ዘንድ ናት።

verses.text_english: Wealth by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.text_amharic: በችኰላ የምትከማች ሀብት ትጐድላለች፤ ጥቂት በጥቂት የተከማቸች ግን ትበዛለች።

verses.text_english: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but the desire cometh, a tree of life.
verses.text_amharic: የምትዘገይ ተስፋ ልብን ታሳዝናለች፤ የተገኘች ፈቃድ ግን የሕይወት ዛፍ ናት።

verses.text_english: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝን የሚያቃልል በትእዛዝ ተይዞ ይጠፋል፤ ትእዛዝን የሚፈራ ግን በደኅንነት ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: The law of the wise a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ከሞት ወጥመድ ያመልጥ ዘንድ የጠቢብ ሰው ትምህርት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው።

verses.text_english: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors hard.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም እውቀት ሞገስን ይሰጣል፤ የወስላቶች መንገድ ግን ሸካራ ናት።

verses.text_english: Every prudent dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open folly.
verses.text_amharic: ብልህ ሁሉ በእውቀት ይሠራል፤ ሰነፍ ግን ስንፍናውን ይገልጣል።

verses.text_english: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador health.
verses.text_amharic: መጥፎ መልእክተኛ በክፉ ላይ ይወድቃል፤ የታመነ መልእክተኛ ግን ፈውስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Poverty and shame him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.text_amharic: ድህነትና ነውር ተግሣጽን ቸል ለሚሉ ነው፤ ዘለፋን የሚሰማ ግን ይከብራል።

verses.text_english: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.text_amharic: የተፈጸመች ፈቃድ ሰውነትን ደስ ታሰኛለች፤ ሰነፎች ግን ከክፉ መራቅን ይጸየፋሉ።

verses.text_english: He that walketh with wise shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠቢባን ጋር የሚሄዱ ጠቢብ ይሆናል፤ የሰነፎች ባልንጀራ ግን ክፉ መከራን ይቀበላል።

verses.text_english: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ነገር ኃጢአተኞችን ያሳድዳቸዋል፤ ጻድቃን ግን መልካሙን ዋጋ ይቀበላሉ።

verses.text_english: A good leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner laid up for the just.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ሰው ለልጅ ልጆቹ ያወርሳል፤ የኃጢአተኛ ብልጥግና ግን ለጻድቅ ትጠበቃለች።

verses.text_english: Much food the tillage of the poor: but there is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.text_amharic: በድሆች እርሻ ላይ ብዙ ሲሳይ አለ፤ ከፍርድ መጕደል የተነሣ ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.text_amharic: በበትር ከመምታት የሚራራ ሰው ልጁን ይጠላል፤ ልጁን የሚወድድ ግን ተግቶ ይገሥጻዋል።

verses.text_english: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ሰውነቱ እስክትጠግብ ድረስ ይበላል፤ የኀጥኣን ሆድ ግን ይራባል።

verses.text_english: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.text_amharic: ብልሃተኛ ሴት ቤትዋን ትሠራለች፤ ሰነፍ ሴት ግን በእጅዋ ታፈርሰዋለች።

verses.text_english: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.text_amharic: በቅን የሚሄድ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ይፈራል፤ መንገዱን የሚያጣምም ግን ይንቀዋል።

verses.text_english: In the mouth of the foolish a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.text_amharic: በሰነፍ አፍ የትዕቢት በትር አለ፤ የጠቢባን ከንፈር ግን ትጠብቃቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: Where no oxen , the crib clean: but much increase by the strength of the ox.
verses.text_amharic: በሬ በሌለበት ስፍራ እህል አይገኝም፤ ብዙ ሲሳይ ግን በበሬዎች ኃይል ነው።

verses.text_english: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.text_amharic: የታመነ ምስክር አይዋሽም፤ የሐሰት ምስክር ግን በሐሰት ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and not: but knowledge easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.text_amharic: ፌዘኛ ሰው ጥበብን ይፈልጋል አያገኛትም፤ ለአስተዋይ ግን እውቀትን ማግኘት አያስቸግረውም።

verses.text_english: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not the lips of knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰነፍ ሰው ፊት ራቅ፥ በእርሱ ዘንድ የእውቀትን ከንፈር አታገኝምና።

verses.text_english: The wisdom of the prudent to understand his way: but the folly of fools deceit.
verses.text_amharic: የብልህ ሰው ጥበብ መንገዱን ያስተውል ዘንድ ነው፤ የሰነፎች ስንፍና ግን ሽንገላ ነው።

verses.text_english: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous favour.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፉ በኃጢአት ያፌዛል፤ በቅኖች መካከል ግን ቸርነት አለች።

verses.text_english: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.text_amharic: የራሱን ኀዘን ልብ ያውቃል፤ ከደስታውም ጋር ሌላ ሰው አይገናኝም።

verses.text_english: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.text_amharic: የኅጥኣን ቤት ይፈርሳል፤ የቅኖች ማደሪያ ግን ያብባል።

verses.text_english: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof the ways of death.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ቅን የምትመስል መንገድ አለች ፍጻሜዋ ግን የሞት መንገድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth heaviness.
verses.text_amharic: በሳቅ ደግሞ ልብ ያዝናል፥ የደስታም ፍጻሜ ልቅሶ ነው።

verses.text_english: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man from himself.
verses.text_amharic: ልቡን ከጽድቅ የሚመልስ ሰው ከመንገዱ ፍሬ ይጠግባል፥ ጻድቅም ሰው ደግሞ በራሱ።

verses.text_english: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent looketh well to his going.
verses.text_amharic: የዋህ ቃልን ሁሉ ያምናል፤ ብልህ ግን አካሄዱን ይመለከታል።

verses.text_english: A wise feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢብ ሰው ይፈራል ከክፉም ይሸሻል፤ ሰነፍ ግን ራሱን ታምኖ ይኰራል።

verses.text_english: soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጡ ሰው በስንፍና ይሠራል፤ አስተዋይ ግን ይታገሣል።

verses.text_english: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: አላዋቂዎች ሰዎች ስንፍናን ይወርሳሉ፤ ብልሆች ግን እውቀትን እንደ ዘውድ ይጭናሉ።

verses.text_english: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞች በደጎች ፊት ይጐነበሳሉ፥ ኀጥኣንም በጻድቃን በር።

verses.text_english: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich many friends.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀ በባልንጀራው ዘንድ የተጠላ ነው የባለጠጋ ወዳጆች ግን ብዙዎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy he.
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀራውን የሚንቅ ይበድላል ለድሀ ግን የሚራራ ምስጉ ነው።

verses.text_english: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth to them that devise good.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ የሚያደርጉ ይስታሉ፤ ምሕረትና እውነት ግን መልካምን ለሚያደርጉ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips only to penury.
verses.text_amharic: በድካም ሁሉ ልምላሜ ይገኛል፤ ብዙ ነገር በሚናገር ከንፈር ግን ድህነት ብቻ አለ።

verses.text_english: The crown of the wise their riches: the foolishness of fools folly.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢባን ዘውድ ባለጠግነታቸው ነው፤ የሰነፎች ስንፍና ግን ስንፍና ነው።

verses.text_english: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful speaketh lies.
verses.text_amharic: እውነተኛ ምስክር ነፍሶችን ያድናል፤ በሐሰት የሚናገር ግን ሸንጋይ ነው።

verses.text_english: In the fear of the LORD strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ለሚፈራ ጠንካራ መታመን አለው፥ ለልጆቹም መጠጊያ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ከሞት ወጥመድ ያመልጥ ዘድን እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው።

verses.text_english: In the multitude of people the king's honour: but in the want of people the destruction of the prince.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሥ ክብር በሕዝብ ብዛት ነው፤ በሰው ጥቂትነት ግን የገዥ ጥፋት አለ።

verses.text_english: slow to wrath of great understanding: but hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.text_amharic: ለትግሥተኛ ሰው ብዙ ማስተዋል አለው፤ ቍጡ ግን ስንፍናውን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: A sound heart the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.text_amharic: ትሑት ልብ የሥጋ ሕይወት ነው፤ ቅንዓት ግን አጥንትን ያነቅዛል።

verses.text_english: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀን የሚያስጨንቅ ፈጣሪውን ይሰድባል፤ ለድሀ ምሕረትን የሚያደርግ ግን ያከብረዋል።

verses.text_english: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.text_amharic: ኀጥእ በክፋቱ ይደፋል፤ ጻድቅ ግን በእውነቱ ይታመናል።

verses.text_english: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.text_amharic: በአዋቂ ልብ ጥበብ ትቀመጣለች፤ በሰነፎች ውስጥ ግን አትታወቅም።

verses.text_english: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin a reproach to any people.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅ ሕዝብን ከፍ ከፍ ታደርጋለች፤ ኃጢአት ግን ሕዝብን ታስነውራለች።

verses.text_english: The king's favour toward a wise servant: but his wrath is him that causeth shame.
verses.text_amharic: አስተዋይ አገልጋይ በንጉሥ ዘንድ ይወደዳል፤ በሚያሳፍር ላይ ግን ቍጣው ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.text_amharic: የለዘበች መልስ ቍጣን ትመልሳለች ሸካራ ቃል ግን ቍጣን ታስነሣለች።

verses.text_english: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢባን ምላስ እውቀትን ያሳምራል፤ የሰነፎች አፍ ግን ስንፍናን ያፈልቃል።

verses.text_english: The eyes of the LORD in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች በስፍራ ሁሉ ናቸው፤ ክፉዎችንና ደጎችን ይመለከታሉ።

verses.text_english: A wholesome tongue a tree of life: but perverseness therein a breach in the spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ፈዋሽ ምላስ የሕይወት ዛፍ ነው፤ የጠማማ ምላስ ግን ነፍስን ይሰብራል።

verses.text_english: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ የአባቱን ተግሣጽ ይንቃል፤ ዘለፋን የሚቀበል ግን አእምሮው የበዛ ነው።

verses.text_english: In the house of the righteous much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.text_amharic: በጻድቅ ሰው ቤት ብዙ ኃይል አለ፤ የኃጥእ ሰው መዝገብ ግን ሁከት ነው።

verses.text_english: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish not so.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢባን ከንፈር እውቀትን ትዘራለች፤ የሰነፎች ልብ ግን እንዲህ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: The sacrifice of the wicked an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright his delight.
verses.text_amharic: የኅጥኣን መሥዋዕት በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፤ የቅኖች ጸሎት ግን በእርሱ ዘንድ የተወደደ ነው።

verses.text_english: The way of the wicked an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: የኅጥኣን መንገድ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፤ እርሱ ግን ጽድቅን የሚከተል ይወድዳል።

verses.text_english: Correction grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ መቅሠፍት መንገድን በተወ ሰው ላይ ይመጣል፥ ዘለፋንም የሚጠላ ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: Hell and destruction before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.text_amharic: ሲኦልና ጥፋት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የታወቁ ናቸው፤ ይልቁንም የሰዎች ልብ የታወቀ ነው።

verses.text_english: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.text_amharic: ፌዘኛ ሰው የሚዘልፈውን አይወድድም፥ ወደ ጠቢባንም አይሄድም።

verses.text_english: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.text_amharic: ደስ ያለው ልብ ፊትን ያበራል፤ በልብ ኀዘን ግን ነፍስ ትሰበራለች።

verses.text_english: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.text_amharic: የአዋቂ ልብ እውቀትን ይፈልጋል፤ የሰነፎች አፍ ግን በስንፍና ይሰማራል።

verses.text_english: All the days of the afflicted evil: but he that is of a merry heart a continual feast.
verses.text_amharic: ልቡ የሚያዝን ሰው ዘመኑ ሁሉ የከፋች ናት፤ የልብ ደስታ ግን ሁልጊዜ እንደ ግብዣ ነው።

verses.text_english: Better little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ከመፍራት ጋር ያለ ጥቂት ነገር ሁከት ካለበት ከብዙ መዝገብ ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: Better a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.text_amharic: የጐመን ወጥ በፍቅር መብላት የሰባ ፍሪዳን ጥል ባለበት ዘንድ ከመብላት ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጡ ሰው ጠብን ያነሣሣል፤ ትዕግሥተኛ ሰው ግን ጸጥ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.text_english: The way of the slothful as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous made plain.
verses.text_amharic: የታካች መንገድ እንደ እሾህ አጥር ናት፤ የጻድቃን መንገድ ግን የተደላደለች ናት።

verses.text_english: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢብ ልጅ አባቱን ደስ ያሰኛል፤ ሰነፍ ልጅ ግን እናቱን ይንቃል።

verses.text_english: Folly joy to destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.text_amharic: ልብ ለሌለው ሰው ስንፍና ደስታ ናት፤ አስተዋይ ግን አካሄዱን ያቀናል።

verses.text_english: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.text_amharic: ምክር ከሌለች ዘንድ የታሰበው ሳይሳካ ይቀራል፤ መካሮች በበዙበት ዘንድ ግን ይጸናል።

verses.text_english: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word in due season, how good !
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በአፉ መልስ ደስ ይለዋል፤ ቃልም በጊዜው ምንኛ መልካም ነው!

verses.text_english: The way of life above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.text_amharic: በታች ካለው ከሲኦል ያመልጥ ዘንድ የሕይወት መንገድ አስተዋዩን ሰው ወደ ላይ ይወስደዋል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የትዕቢተኞች ቤት ይነቅላል፤ የባልቴትን ዳርቻ ግን ያጸናል።

verses.text_english: The thoughts of the wicked an abomination to the LORD: but of the pure pleasant words.
verses.text_amharic: የበደለኛ አሳብ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ናት፤ ያማረ ቃል ግን ጥሩ ነው።

verses.text_english: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ትርፍ ለማግኘት የሚሳሳ ሰው የራሱን ቤት ያውካል፤ መማለጃን የሚጠላ ግን በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቅ ልብ መልሱን ያስባል የኅጥኣን አፍ ግን ክፋትን ያፈልቃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከኅጥኣን ይርቃል፤ የጻድቃንን ጸሎት ግን ይሰማል።

verses.text_english: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.text_amharic: የዓይን ብርሃን ልብን ደስ ያሰኛል፥ መልካም ወሬም አጥንትን ያለመልማል።

verses.text_english: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.text_amharic: የሕይወትን ተግሣጽ የሚሰማ ጆሮ በጠቢባን መካከል ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ተግሣጽን ቸል የሚል የራሱን ነፍስ ይንቃል፤ ዘለፋን የሚሰማ ግን አእምሮ ያገኛል።

verses.text_english: The fear of the LORD the instruction of wisdom; and before honour humility.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የጥበብ ትምህርት ነው፤ ትሕትናም ክብረትን ትቀድማለች።

verses.text_english: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የልብ መዘጋጀት ከሰው ነው፤ የምላስ መልስ ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: All the ways of a man clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው መንገድ ሁሉ በዓይኖቹ ፊት ንጹሕ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን መንፈስን ይመዝናል።

verses.text_english: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራህን ለእግዚአብሔር አደራ ስጥ፥ አሳብህም ትጸናለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath made all for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ለእርሱ ለራሱ ፈጠረ፥ ኀጥእን ደግሞ ለክፉ ቀን።

verses.text_english: Every one proud in heart an abomination to the LORD: hand in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.text_amharic: በልቡ የታበየ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፥ እጅ በእጅም ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም።

verses.text_english: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD depart from evil.
verses.text_amharic: በምሕረትና በእውነት ኃጢአት ትሰረያለች፥ እግዚአብሔርንም በመፍራት ሰው ከክፋት ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው አካሄድ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘው እንደ ሆነ፤ በእርሱና በጠላቶቹ መካከል ስንኳ ሰላምን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Better a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅ የሚገኝ ጥቂት ነገር በዓመፅ ከሚገኝ ከብዙ ትርፍ ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልብ መንገዱ ያዘጋጃል፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አካሄዱን ያቀናለታል።

verses.text_english: A divine sentence in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ብይን በንጉሥ አፍ ነው፥ አፉም በፍርድ አይስትም።

verses.text_english: A just weight and balance the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag his work.
verses.text_amharic: እውነተኛ ሚዛንና መመዘኛ የእግዚአብሔር ናቸው፤ የከረጢት መመዘኛዎች ሁሉ የእርሱ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ግፍን መሥራት በንጉሥ ዘንድ ጸያፍ ነገር ነው፥ ዙፋን በጽድቅ ይጸናልና።

verses.text_english: Righteous lips the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቅ ከንፈር የነገሥታት ደስታ ናት፥ በቅን የሚናገር እርሱንም ይወድዱታል።

verses.text_english: The wrath of a king messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሥ ቍጣ እንደ ሞት መልእክተኛ ነው፤ ጠቢብ ሰው ግን ያቈላምጠዋል።

verses.text_english: In the light of the king's countenance life; and his favour as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሥ ፊት ብርሃን ዘንድ ሕይወት አለ፥ መልካም ፈቃዱም እንደ በልግ ዝናብ ደመና ነው።

verses.text_english: How much better to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብን ማግኘት ምንኛ ከወርቅ ይሻላል! ማስተዋልንም ማግኘት ከብር ይልቅ የሚመረጥ ነው።

verses.text_english: The highway of the upright to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.text_amharic: የቅኖች መንገድ ከክፋት መራቅ ነው፤ መንገዱን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃታል።

verses.text_english: Pride before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢት ጥፋትን፥ ኵሩ መንፈስም ውድቀትን ይቀድማል።

verses.text_english: Better of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.text_amharic: ከዕቡያን ጋር ምርኮ ከመካፈል ከትሑታን ጋር በተዋረደ መንፈስ መሆን ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy he.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልን የሚያዳምጥ መልካም ነገርን ያገኛል፤ በእግዚአብሔር የታመነ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.text_amharic: ልቡ ጠቢብ የሆነ አስተዋይ ይባላል፥ በከንፈሩም ጣፋጭ የሆነ ትምህርትን ያበዛል።

verses.text_english: Understanding a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools folly.
verses.text_amharic: ገንዘብ ላደረገው ሰው እውቀት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው፤ ስንፍና ግን የሰነፎች ቅጣት ነው።

verses.text_english: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢብ ልብ አፉን ያስተምራል፥ ለከንፈሩም ትምህርትን ይጨምራል።

verses.text_english: Pleasant words an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.text_amharic: ያማረ ቃል የማር ወለላ ነው፤ ለነፍስ ጣፋጭ ለአጥንትም ጤና ነው።

verses.text_english: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof the ways of death.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ቅን የምትመስል መንገድ አለች፤ ፍጻሜዋ ግን የሞት መንገድ ነው።

verses.text_english: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራተኛ ራብ ለእርሱ ይሠራል፥ አፉ ይጐተጕተዋልና።

verses.text_english: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips as a burning fire.
verses.text_amharic: ምናምንቴ ሰው ክፋትን ይምሳል፥ በከንፈሩም የሚቃጠል እሳት አለ።

verses.text_english: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.text_amharic: ጠማማ ሰው ጥልን ይዘራል፤ ጆሮ ጠቢ ሰው የተማመኑትን ወዳጆች ይለያያል።

verses.text_english: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way not good.
verses.text_amharic: ግፈኛ ሰው ወዳጁን ያባብላል፥ መልካምም ወዳይደለ መንገድ ይመራዋል።

verses.text_english: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑን የሚዘጋ ጠማማ አሳብን ያስባል፤ ከንፈሩን የሚነክስ ክፋትን ይፈጽማል።

verses.text_english: The hoary head a crown of glory, it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: የሸበተ ጠጕር የክብር ዘውድ ነው፥ እርሱም በጽድቅ መንገድ ይገኛል።

verses.text_english: slow to anger better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕግሥተኛ ሰው ከኃያል ሰው ይሻላል፥ በመንፈሱም ላይ የሚገዛ ከተማ ከሚወስዱ ይበልጣል።

verses.text_english: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣ በጕያ ይጣላል፤ መደብዋ ሁሉ ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Better a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices strife.
verses.text_amharic: ጥል ባለበት ዘንድ እርድ ከሞላበት ቤት በጸጥታ ደረቅ ቍራሽ ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.text_amharic: አስተዋይ ባሪያ ነውረኛውን ልጅ ይገዛል፥ በወንድማማች መካከልም ርስትን ይካፈላል።

verses.text_english: The fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.text_amharic: ማቅለጫ ለብር፥ ከውር ለወርቅ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ይፈትናል።

verses.text_english: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ሰው የበደለኛን ከንፈር ይሰማል፤ ሐሰተኛም ወደ ተንኰለኛ ምላስ ያደምጣል።

verses.text_english: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.text_amharic: በድሀ የሚያላግጥ ፈጣሪውን ይሰድባል፤ በጥፋትም ደስ የሚለው ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም።

verses.text_english: Children's children the crown of old men; and the glory of children their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: የሽማግሌዎች አክሊል የልጅ ልጆች ናቸው፤ የልጆችም ክብር አባቶቻቸው ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰነፍ የኵራት አነጋገር አይገባውም፤ ይልቁንም ሐሰተኛ ከንፈር ለመኰንን አይገባውም።

verses.text_english: A gift a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.text_amharic: ገንዘብ ባደረገው ፊት መማለጃ እንደ ተዋበ ዕንቍ ነው፥ ወደ ዞረበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ ሥራውን ያቀናል።

verses.text_english: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth friends.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአትን የሚከድን ሰው ፍቅርን ይሻል፤ ነገርን የሚደጋግም ግን የተማመኑትን ወዳጆቹን ይለያያል።

verses.text_english: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.text_amharic: መቶ ግርፋት በሰነፍ ጠልቆ ከሚገባ ይልቅ ተግሣጽ በአስተዋይ ሰው ጠልቆ ወደ ልቡ ይገባል።

verses.text_english: An evil seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ሰው ዓመፃን ብቻ ይሻል፤ ስለዚህ ጨካኝ መልአክ ይላክበታል።

verses.text_english: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍን በስንፍናው ከመገናኘት ልጆችዋ የተነጠቁባትን ድብ መገናኘት ይሻላል።
