verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ባሪያዎች ገዛሁ፥ የቤት ውልድ ባሪያዎችም ነበሩኝ፤ ከእኔ አስቀድመው በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ ብዙ ከብቶችና መንጋዎች ነበሩኝ።

verses.text_english: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
verses.text_amharic: ብርንና ወርቅን የከበረውንም የነገሥታትና የአውራጆችን መዝገብ ሰበሰብሁ፤ አዝማሪዎችንና አርሆዎችን የሰዎች ልጆችንም ተድላ እጅግ የበዙ ሴቶችንም አከማቸሁ።

verses.text_english: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅም ሆንሁ፥ ከእኔም አስቀድመው በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ ከበርሁ፤ ደግምም ጥበቤ ከእኔ ጋር ጸንታ ቀረች።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቼንም ከፈለጉት ሁሉ አልከለከልኋቸውም፤ ልቤም በድካሜ ሁሉ ደስ ይለው ነበርና ልቤን ከደስታ ሁሉ አላራቅሁትም ከድካሜም ሁሉ ይህ እድል ፈንታዬ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all vanity and vexation of spirit, and no profit under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: እጄ የሠራቻችን ሥራዬን ሁሉ የደከምሁበትንም ድካሜን ሁሉ ተመለከትሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ሁሉ ከንቱ ነፋስንም እንደ መከተል ነበር፥ ከፀሐይ በታችም ትርፍ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what the man that cometh after the king? that which hath been already done.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ጥበብን ዕብደትንና ስንፍናን አይ ዘንድ ተመለከትሁ፤ በፊት ከተደረገው በቀር፥ ከንጉሥ በኋላ የሚመጣው ሰው ምን ያደርጋል?

verses.text_english: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ብርሃን ከጨለማ እንደሚበልጥ እንዲሁ ጥበብ ከስንፍና እንዲበልጥ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: The wise man's eyes in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢብ ዓይኖች በራሱ ላይ ናቸው፥ ሰነፍ ግን በጨለማ ይሄዳል፤ ደግሞ ለሁለቱ መጨረሻቸው አንድ እንደ ሆነ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በልቤ። ለሰነፍ የሚደርሰው ለእኔም ይደርሳል፤ ለምን እጅግ ጠቢብ ሆንሁ? አልሁ። የዚያን ጊዜም በልቤ። ይህ ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው አልሁ።

verses.text_english: For no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise ? as the fool.
verses.text_amharic: በሚመጣው ዘመን ነገር ሁሉ የተረሳ ይሆናልና ለዘላለም የሚሆን የጠቢብና የሰነፍ መታሰቢያ አይገኝም። አዬ ጉድ! ጠቢብ ከሰነፍ ጋር እንዴት ይሞታል!

verses.text_english: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun grievous unto me: for all vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይም በታች የተሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ከብዶብኛልና ሕይወትን ጠላሁ፤ ሁሉም ከንቱ ነፋስንም እንደ መከተል ነው።

verses.text_english: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ በኋላ ለሚመጣው ሰው እተወዋለሁና ከፀሐይ በታች የደከምሁበትን ሁሉ ጠላሁት።

verses.text_english: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢብ ወይም ሰነፍ እንዲሆን የሚያውቅ ሰው ማን ነው? ከፀሐይ በታች በደከምሁበትና ጠቢብ በሆንሁበት በድካሜ ሁሉ ላይ ጌታ ይሆንበታል፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ተመልሼ ልቤን ከፀሐይ በታች በደከምሁበት ድካም ሁሉ ተስፋ አስቈረጥሁት።

verses.text_english: For there is a man whose labour in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it his portion. This also vanity and a great evil.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በጥበብና በእውቀት በብልሃትም ከደከመ በኋላ ለሌላ ላልደከመበት ሰው ያወርሰዋልና፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ትልቅም መከራ ነው።

verses.text_english: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ በታች በደከመበት ድካም ሁሉና በልቡ አሳብ የሰው ጥቅም ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For all his days sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኑ ሁሉ ኀዘን፥ ጥረትም ትካዜ ነው፤ ልቡም በሌሊት አይተኛም፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: nothing better for a man, that he should eat and drink, and he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it from the hand of God.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ከሚበላና ከሚጠጣ በድካሙም ደስ ከሚለው በቀር የሚሻለው ነገር የለም፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ እንደ ተሰጠ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: For who can eat, or who else can hasten , more than I?
verses.text_amharic: ያለ እርሱ ፈቃድ የበላ ደስ ብሎትም ተድላን የቀመሰ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: For giveth to a man that good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to good before God. This also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ደስ ለሚያሰኘው ሰው ጥበብንና እውቀትን ደስታንም ይሰጠዋል፤ ለኃጢአተኛ ግን እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ለሚያሰኘው ሰው ይሰጥ ዘንድ እንዲሰበስብና እንዲያከማች ጥረትን ይሰጠዋል። ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነፋስንም እንደ መከተል ነው።

verses.text_english: To every a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.text_amharic: ለሁሉ ዘመን አለው፥ ከሰማይ በታችም ለሆነ ነገር ሁሉ ጊዜ አለው።

verses.text_english: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up planted;
verses.text_amharic: ለመወለድ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመሞትም ጊዜ አለው፤ ለመትከል ጊዜ አለው፥ የተተከለውንም ለመንቀል ጊዜ አለው፤

verses.text_english: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.text_amharic: ለመግደል ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመፈወስም ጊዜ አለው፤ ለማፍረስ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመሥራትም ጊዜ አለው፤

verses.text_english: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.text_amharic: ለማልቀስ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመሳቅም ጊዜ አለው፤ ዋይ ለማለት ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመዝፈንም ጊዜ አለው፤

verses.text_english: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋይን ለመጣል ጊዜ አለው፥ ድንጋይንም ለመሰብሰብ ጊዜ አለው፤ ለመተቃቀፍ ጊዜ አለው፥ ከመተቃቀፍም ለመራቅ ጊዜ አለው፤

verses.text_english: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.text_amharic: ለመፈለግ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለማጥፋትም ጊዜ አለው፤ ለመጠበቅ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመጣልም ጊዜ አለው፤

verses.text_english: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.text_amharic: ለመቅደድ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመስፋትም ጊዜ አለው፤ ዝም ለማለት ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመናገርም ጊዜ አለው፤

verses.text_english: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
verses.text_amharic: ለመውደድ ጊዜ አለው፥ ለመጥላትም ጊዜ አለው፤ ለጦርነት ጊዜ አለው፥ ለሰላምም ጊዜ አለው።

verses.text_english: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
verses.text_amharic: ለሠራተኛ የድካሙ ትርፍ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ልጆች ይደክሙበት ዘንድ የሰጣቸውን ጥረት አይቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: He hath made every beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verses.text_amharic: ነገርን ሁሉ በጊዜው ውብ አድርጎ ሠራው፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከጥንት ጀምሮ እስከ ፍጻሜ ድረስ የሠራውን ሥራ ሰው መርምሮ እንዳያገኝ ዘላለምነትን በልቡ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: I know that no good in them, but for to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ደስ ከሚለውና በሕይወቱ ሳለ መልካምን ነገር ከሚያደርግ በቀር መልካም ነገር እንደሌለ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it the gift of God.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሰው ሁሉ ይበላና ይጠጣ ዘንድ በድካሙም ሁሉ ደስ ይለው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ነው።

verses.text_english: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth , that should fear before him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያደረገው ሁሉ ለዘላለም እንዲኖር አወቅሁ፤ ሊጨመርበት ወይም ከእርሱ ሊጐድል አይቻልም፤ እግዚአብሔርም በፊቱ ይፈሩ ዘንድ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ያለው በፊት ነበረ፥ የሚሆነውም በፊት ሆኖ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያለፈውን መልሶ ይሻዋል።

verses.text_english: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, wickedness there; and the place of righteousness, iniquity there.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከፀሐይ በታች በፍርድ ስፍራ ኃጢአት፥ በጽድቅም ስፍራ ኃጢአት እንዳለ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በልቤ። በዚያ ለነገር ሁሉና ለሥራ ሁሉ ጊዜ አለውና በጻድቅና በኃጢአተኛ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ይፈርዳል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በልቤ ስለ ሰው ልጆች። እንደ እንስሳ መሆናቸውን እንዲያዩ እግዚአብሔር ይፈትናቸዋል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all vanity.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጆችና የእንስሳ እድል ፈንታ አንድ ነው፤ ድርሻቸውም ትክክል ነው፤ አንዱ እንደሚሞት ሌላውም እንዲሁ ይሞታል፤ የሁሉም እስትንፋስ አንድ ነው፤ ሁሉም ከንቱ ነውና ሰው ከእንስሳ ብልጫ የለውም።

verses.text_english: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ወደ አንድ ቦታ ይሄዳል፤ ሁሉ ከአፈር ነው ሁሉም ወደ አፈር ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጆች ነፍስ ወደ ላይ እንደምትወጣ የእንስሳም ነፍስ ወደ ታች ወደ ምድር እንደምትወርድ የሚያውቅ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Wherefore I perceive that nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
verses.text_amharic: ያም እድል ፈንታው ነውና ሰው በሥራው ደስ ከሚለው በቀር ሌላ መልካም ነገር እንደሌለው አየሁ፤ ከእርሱ በኋላስ የሚሆነውን ያይ ዘንድ የሚያመጣው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors power; but they had no comforter.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ተመለስሁ፥ ከፀሐይ በታችም የሚደረገውን ግፍ ሁሉ አየሁ፤ እነሆም፥ የተገፉት ሰዎች እንባ ነበረ፤ የሚያጽናናቸውም አልነበረም፤ በሚገፉአቸውም እጅ ኃይል ነበረ፥ እነርሱን ግን የሚያጽናናቸው አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እስከ ዛሬ በሕይወት ካሉት ይልቅ በቀድሞ ዘመን የሞቱትን አመሰገንሁ፤

verses.text_english: Yea, better than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም ከሁለቱ ይልቅ ገና ያልተወለደው ከፀሐይም በታች የሚደረገውን ግፍ ያላየው ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም የሰውን ድካምና የብልሃት ሥራውን ሁሉ ተመለከትሁ፥ በባልንጀራውም ዘንድ ቅንዓት እንዲያስነሣ አየሁ፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነፋስንም እንደ መከተል ነው።

verses.text_english: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ እጆቹን ኮርትሞ ይቀመጣል፤ የገዛ ሥጋውንም ይበላል።

verses.text_english: Better an handful quietness, than both the hands full travail and vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: በድካምና ነፋስን በመከተል ከሁለት እጅ ሙሉ ይልቅ አንድ እጅ ሙሉ በዕረፍት ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ተመለስሁ፥ ከፀሐይ በታችም ከንቱን ነገር አየሁ።

verses.text_english: There is one , and not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither , For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This also vanity, yea, it a sore travail.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰው ብቻውን አለ፥ ሁለተኛም የለውም ልጅም ሆነ ወንድም የለውም፤ ለድካሙ ግን መጨረሻ የለውም፥ ዓይኖቹም ከባለጠግነት አይጠግቡም። ለማን እደክማለሁ፥ ሰውነቴንስ መልካሙን ነገር ለምን እነፍጋታለሁ? ይላል። ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነገር ክፉም ጥረት ነው።

verses.text_english: Two better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
verses.text_amharic: ድካማቸው መልካም ዋጋ አለውና አንድ ብቻ ከመሆን ሁለት መሆን ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him alone when he falleth; for not another to help him up.
verses.text_amharic: ቢወድቁ አንዱ ሁለተኛውን ያነሣዋልና፤ አንዱ ብቻውን ሆኖ በወደቀ ጊዜ ግን የሚያነሣው ሁለተኛ የለውምና ወዮለት።

verses.text_english: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm ?
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም በአንድነት ቢተኙ ይሞቃቸዋል፤ አንድ ብቻውን ግን እንዴት ይሞቀዋል?

verses.text_english: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም አንዱን ቢያሸንፍ ሁለቱ በፊቱ ይቆማሉ፤ በሦስትም የተገመደ ገመድ ፈጥኖ አይበጠስም።

verses.text_english: Better a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀና ጠቢብ ብላቴና ተግሣጽን መቀበል ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከማያውቅ ከሰነፍ ሽማግሌ ንጉሥ ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also born in his kingdom becometh poor.
verses.text_amharic: ምንም በመንግሥቱ አገር ደግሞ ችግረኛ ሆኖ ቢወለድ፥ ከግዞቱ ቤት ወደ መንግሥት ወጥቶአልና።

verses.text_english: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ በታች የሚሄዱትን ሕያዋን ሁሉ በእርሱ ፋንታ ከሚነሣው ከሌላው ጎበዝ ጋር ሆነው አየሁ።

verses.text_english: no end of all the people, of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ በፊት የተገዙለት ሕዝብ ሁሉ አይቈጠሩም፤ በኋላ የሚመጡት ግን በእርሱ ደስ አይላቸውም። ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነፋስንም እንደ መከተል ነው።

verses.text_english: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በገባህ ጊዜ እግርህን ጠብቅ፤ ለመስማት መቅረብ ከሰነፎች መሥዋዕት ይበልጣልና፤ እነርሱም ክፉ እንዲያደርጉ አያውቁምና።

verses.text_english: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter thing before God: for God in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሰማይ፥ አንተም በምድር ነህና በአፍህ አትፍጠን፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቃልን ይናገር ዘንድ ልብህ አይቸኵል፤ ስለዚህም ቃልህ ጥቂት ትሁን።

verses.text_english: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice by multitude of words.
verses.text_amharic: ሕልም በሥራ ብዛት ይታያል፤ እንዲሁም የሰነፍ ድምፅ በቃሉ ብዛት ይሰማል።

verses.text_english: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፎች ደስ አያሰኙትምና ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት በተሳልህ ጊዜ ትፈጽመው ዘንድ አትዘግይ፤ የተሳልኸውን ፈጽመው።

verses.text_english: Better that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
verses.text_amharic: ተስለህ የማትፈጽም ብትሆን ባትሳል ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋህን በኃጢአት እንዳያስተው ለአፍህ አርነት አትስጥ፥ በመልአክም ፊት። ስሕተት ነበረ አትበል፤ እግዚአብሔር በቃልህ ይቈጣ ዘንድ የእጅህንም ሥራ ያጠፋ ዘንድ ስለምን ትሻለህ?

verses.text_english: For in the multitude of dreams and many words also vanities: but fear thou God.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕልም ባለበት ዘንድ፥ እንዲሁም ደግሞ ብዙ ቃል ባለበት ስፍራ በዚያ ብዙ ከንቱ ነገር አለ፤ አንተ ግን እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ።

verses.text_english: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for higher than the highest regardeth; and higher than they.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ካለው በላይ ከፍ ያለ ይመለከታልና፥ ከእነርሱም በላይ ደግሞ ሌሎች ከፍ ይላሉና በአገሩ ድሆች ሲገፉ፥ ፍርድና ጽድቅም ሲነጠቅ ባየህ ጊዜ በዚህ ነገር አታድንቅ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king is served by the field.
verses.text_amharic: በጠቅላላው ግን የአገሩ ጥቅም እርሻን የሚወድድ ንጉሥ ቢኖር ነው።

verses.text_english: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ብርን የሚወድድ ሰው ብርን አይጠግብም፤ ባለጠግነትንም የሚወድድ ትርፉን አይጠግብም፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good to the owners thereof, saving the beholding with their eyes?
verses.text_amharic: ሀብት ሲበዛ የሚበሉት ይበዛሉ፤ ሀብቱን በዓይኑ ብቻ ከማየት በቀር ለባለቤቱ ምን ይጠቅመዋል?

verses.text_english: The sleep of a labouring man sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ወይም ጥቂት ቢበላ የሠራተኛ እንቅልፍ ጣፋጭ ነው የባለጠጋ ጥጋብ ግን እንቅልፍን ይከለክለዋል።

verses.text_english: There is a sore evil I have seen under the sun, , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ በታች የሚያሳዝን ክፉ ነገር አየሁ፤ ለመከራው በባለቤቱ ዘንድ የተቈጠበች ባለጠግነት ናት።

verses.text_english: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and nothing in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ያችም ባለጠግነት በክፉ ነገር ትጠፋለች፤ ልጅንም ቢወልድ በእጁ ምንም የለውም።

verses.text_english: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናቱ ሆድ ራቁቱን እንደ ወጣ እንዲሁ እንደ መጣው ይመለሳል፤ ከጥረቱም በእጁ ሊወስድ የሚችለውን ምንም አያገኝም።

verses.text_english: And this also a sore evil, in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ደግሞ የሚያሳዝን ክፉ ነገር ነው፤ እንደ መጣ እንዲሁ ይሄዳል፤ ድካሙም ለነፋስ ከሆነ ጥቅሙ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኑን ሁሉ በጨለማ በኀዘን በብስጭት በደዌና በቍጣ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold which I have seen: good and comely to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it his portion.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ ያየሁት መልካምና የተዋበ ነገር ሰው እግዚአብሔር በሰጠው በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ ይበላና ይጠጣ ዘንድ፥ ከፀሐይ በታችም በሚደክምበት ድካም ሁሉ ደስ ይለው ዘንድ ነው፤ ይህ እድል ፈንታው ነውና።

verses.text_english: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this the gift of God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ሁሉ ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን መስጠቱ፥ ከእርስዋም ይበላና እድል ፈንታውን ይወስድ ዘንድ በድካሙም ደስ ይለው ዘንድ ማሠልጠኑ፤ ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ነው።

verses.text_english: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth in the joy of his heart.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በልቡ ደስታን ስለ ሰጠው እርሱ የሕይወቱን ዘመን እጅግ አያስብም።

verses.text_english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it common among men:
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ በታች ያየሁት ክፉ ነገር አለ፥ እርሱም በሰው ላይ እጅግ የከበደ ነው።

verses.text_english: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this vanity, and it an evil disease.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ሀብትንና ጥሪትን ክብርንም ሰጠው፥ ከወደደውም ሁሉ ለነፍሱ አልጐደለውም፤ ነገር ግን ሌላ ሰው ይበላዋል እንጂ ከእርሱ ይበላ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አላሠለጠነውም፤ ይህም ከንቱና ክፉ ደዌ ነው።

verses.text_english: If a man beget an hundred , and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also he have no burial; I say, an untimely birth better than he.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው መቶ ልጆች ቢወልድ እጅግ ዘመንም በሕይወት ቢኖር ዕድሜውም እጅግ ዓመት ቢሆን፥ ነፍሱም መልካምን ባትጠግብ መቃብርንም ባያገኝ፥ እኔ ስለ እርሱ። ከእርሱ ይልቅ ጭንጋፍ ይሻላል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ መጥቶአል በጨለማ ይሄዳል ስሙም በጨለማ ይሸፈናል፤

verses.text_english: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known : this hath more rest than the other.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ፀሐይን አላየውም አላወቀውምም፤ ለዚህም ከዚያ ይልቅ ዕረፍት አለው።

verses.text_english: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice , yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
verses.text_amharic: ሺህ ዓመት ሁለት ጊዜ በሕይወት ቢኖር መልካምንም ባያይ፥ ሁሉ ወደ አንድ ስፍራ የሚሄድ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: All the labour of man for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ድካም ሁሉ ለአፉ ነው፥ ነፍሱ ግን አትጠግብም።

verses.text_english: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
verses.text_amharic: ከሰነፍ ይልቅ ለጥበበኛ ጥቅም ምንድር ነው? በሕያዋን ፊትስ መሄድ ለሚያውቅ ለድሀ ጥቅሙ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Better the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this also vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይን ማየት በነፍስ ከመቅበዝበዝ ይሻላል፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነፋስንም እንደ መከተል ነው።

verses.text_english: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
verses.text_amharic: የሆነው ስሙ አስቀድሞ ተጠራ፥ ሰውም እንደ ሆነ ታወቀ፤ ከእርሱ ከሚበረታው ጋር ይፋረድ ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what man the better?
verses.text_amharic: ከንቱን የሚያበዛ ብዙ ነገር አለና ለሰው ጥቅሙ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For who knoweth what good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በከንቱ ወራቱ ቍጥርና እንደ ጥላ በሚያሳልፈው ዘመኑ በሕይወቱ ሳለ ለሰው የሚሻለውን የሚያውቅ ማነው? ወይስ ለሰው ከፀሐይ በታች ከእርሱ በኋላ የሚሆነውን ማን ይነግረዋል?

verses.text_english: A good name better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
verses.text_amharic: ከመልካም ሽቱ መልካም ስም፥ ከመወለድ ቀንም የሞት ቀን ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that the end of all men; and the living will lay to his heart.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ግብዣ ቤት ከመሄድ ወደ ልቅሶ ቤት መሄድ ይሻላል፤ እርሱ የሰው ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ነውና፥ ሕያውም የሆነ በልቡ ያኖረዋልና።

verses.text_english: Sorrow better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳቅ ኀዘን ይሻላል፥ ከፊት ኀዘን የተነሣ ልብ ደስ ይሰኛልና።

verses.text_english: The heart of the wise in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools in the house of mirth.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢባን ልብ በልቅሶ ቤት ነው፤ የሰነፎች ልብ ግን በደስታ ቤት ነው።

verses.text_english: better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው የሰነፎችን ዜማ ከሚሰማ ይልቅ የጠቢባንን ተግሣጽ መስማት ይሻለዋል።

verses.text_english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so the laughter of the fool: this also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ከድስት በታች እንደሚቃጠል እሾህ ድምፅ የሰነፍ ሳቅ እንዲሁ ነው፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
verses.text_amharic: ግፍ ጠቢቡን ያሳብደዋል፤ ጉቦም ልቡን ያጠፋዋል።

verses.text_english: Better the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: the patient in spirit better than the proud in spirit.
verses.text_amharic: የነገር ፍጻሜ ከመጀመሪያው ይሻላል፤ ታጋሽም ከትዕቢተኛ ይሻላል።

verses.text_english: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
verses.text_amharic: በነፍስህ ለቍጣ ችኩል አትሁን ቍጣ በሰነፍ ብብት ያርፋልና።

verses.text_english: Say not thou, What is that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ ዘመን ይልቅ ያለፈው ዘመን ለምን ተሻለ? ብለህ አትናገር፤ የዚህን ነገር በጥበብ አትጠይቅምና።

verses.text_english: Wisdom good with an inheritance: and profit to them that see the sun.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ ከርስት ጋር መልካም ነው፤ ፀሐይንም ለሚያዩ ሰዎች ትርፍን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: For wisdom a defence, money a defence: but the excellency of knowledge wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
verses.text_amharic: የጥበብ ጥላ እንደ ገንዘብ ጥላ ናትና፤ የእውቀትም ብልጫዋ ጥበብ ገንዘብ ላደረጋት ሕይወትን እንድትሰጥ ነው።

verses.text_english: Consider the work of God: for who can make straight, which he hath made crooked?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ተመልከት፤ እርሱ ጠማማ ያደረገውን ማን ሊያቀናው ይችላል?

verses.text_english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
verses.text_amharic: በመልካም ቀን ደስ ይበልህ፤ በክፉም ቀን ተመልከት፤ ሰው ከእርሱ በኋላ መርምሮ ምንም እንዳያገኝ እግዚአብሔር ይህንም ያንም እንደዚያ ሠርቶአል።

verses.text_english: All have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked that prolongeth in his wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ በጽድቁ ሲጠፋ ኀጥእም በክፋቱ እጅግ ዘመን ሲኖር፥ ይህን ሁሉ ከንቱ በሆነ ዘመኔ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ጻድቅ አትሁን፥ እጅግ ጠቢብም አትሁን፥ እንዳትጠፋ።

verses.text_english: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ክፉ አትሁን፥ እልከኛም አትሁን፥ ጊዜህ ሳይደርስ እንዳትሞት።

verses.text_english: good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ከሁሉ ይወጣልና ይህን ብትይዝ ከዚያም ደግሞ እጅህን ባታርቅ መልካም ነው።

verses.text_english: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty which are in the city.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማ ከሚኖሩ ከአሥር ገዢዎች ይልቅ ጥበብ ጠቢብን ታበረታለች።

verses.text_english: For not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ መልካምን የሚሠራ ኃጢአትንም የማያደርግ ጻድቅ አይገኝምና።

verses.text_english: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያህ ሲረግምህ እንዳትሰማ በሚጫወቱበት ቃል ሁሉ ልብህን አትጣል፤

verses.text_english: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ደግሞ ሌሎችን እንደ ረገምህ ልብህ ያውቃልና።

verses.text_english: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it far from me.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሁሉ በጥበብ ፈተንሁ፤ ጠቢብ እሆናለሁ አልሁ፥ እርስዋ ግን ከእኔ ራቀች።

verses.text_english: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
verses.text_amharic: የሆነው ራቀ እጅግም ጠለቀ፤ መርምሮ የሚያገኘውስ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason , and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness madness:
verses.text_amharic: አውቅና እመረምር ዘንድ፥ ጥበብንና የነገሩን ሁሉ መደምደሚያ እፈልግ ዘንድ፥ ኃጢአትም ስንፍና፥ ስንፍናም እብደት እንደ ሆነች አውቅ ዘንድ እኔ በልቤ ዞርሁ።

verses.text_english: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart snares and nets, her hands bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከሞት ይልቅ የመረረ ነገር መርምሬ አገኘሁ፤ እርስዋም ልብዋ ወጥመድና መርበብ የሆነ፥ እጆችዋም እግር ብረት የሆኑ ሴት ናት፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም የሆነ ከእርስዋ ያመልጣል፥ ኃጢአተኛ ግን ይጠመድባታል።

verses.text_english: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, one by one, to find out the account:
verses.text_amharic: አንዱን በአንዱ ላይ ጨምሬ ወደ ነገሩ ሁሉ መደምደሚያ እደርስ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ ይህን ነገር አገኘሁ ይላል ሰባኪው፤

verses.text_english: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ትሻታለች፥ ነገር ግን አላገኘሁም፤ ከሺህ ወንዶች አንድ አገኘሁ፥ ከእነዚያ ሁሉ መካከል ግን አንዲት ሴት አላገኘሁም።

verses.text_english: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሰዎችን ቅኖች አድርጎ እንደ ሠራቸው፥ እነሆ፥ ይህን ብቻ አገኘሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን ብዙ ብልሃትን ፈለጉ።

verses.text_english: Who as the wise ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጠቢብ የሆነ ሰው ማን ነው? ነገርንስ መተርጐም የሚያውቅ ማን ነው? የሰው ጥበብ ፊቱን ታበራለች፥ የፊቱንም ድፍረት ትለውጣለች።

verses.text_english: I to keep the king's commandment, and in regard of the oath of God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ። በእግዚአብሔር መሐላ ምክንያት የንጉሥን ትእዛዝ ጠብቅ እልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
verses.text_amharic: የወደደውን ሁሉ ያደርጋልና ከፊቱ ትወገድ ዘንድ አትቸኵል፥ ክፉንም በማድረግ አትጽና።

verses.text_english: Where the word of a king power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሥ ቃል ኃይለኛ ነውና፤ ይህንስ ለምን ታደርጋለህ? ማን ይለዋል?

verses.text_english: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝን የሚጠብቅ ክፉን ነገር አያውቅም፤ የጠቢብም ልብ ጊዜንና ፍርድን ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man great upon him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው መከራ በእርሱ ላይ እጅግ ስለ ሆነ ለነገር ሁሉ ጊዜና ፍርድ አለውና።

verses.text_english: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
verses.text_amharic: የሚሆነውንም አያውቅም፤ እንዴትስ እንደሚሆን የሚነግረው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither power in the day of death: and no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስን ለማስቀረት በመንፈስ ላይ ሥልጣን ያለው ሰው የለም፤ በሞቱም ቀን ሥልጣን የለውም፤ በሰልፍም ስንብቻ የለም፥ ኃጢአትም ሠሪውን አያድነውም።

verses.text_english: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሁሉ አየሁ፥ ከፀሐይም በታች ወደ ተደረገው ሥራ ሁሉ ልቤን ሰጠሁ፤ ሰው ሰውን ለመጕዳት ገዢ የሚሆንበት ጊዜ አለ።

verses.text_english: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ኀጥኣን ተቀብረው አየሁ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትም ገቡ፤ ነገር ግን ቅን አድራጊዎች ከቅድስት ስፍራ ወጡ፥ በከተማይቱም ውስጥ ተረሱ፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.text_amharic: በክፉ ሥራ ላይ ፈጥኖ ፍርድ አይፈረድምና ስለዚህ በሰው ልጆች ውስጥ ልባቸው ክፉን ለመሥራት ጠነከረ።

verses.text_english: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ መቶ ጊዜ ክፉን ቢሠራ ዘመኑም ረጅም ቢሆን፥ እግዚአብሔርን ለሚፈሩት በፊቱም ለሚፈሩት ደኅንነት እንዲሆን አውቃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong days, as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
verses.text_amharic: ለኀጥእ ግን ደኅንነት የለውም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት አይፈራምና ዘመኑ እንደ ጥላ አትረዝምም።

verses.text_english: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also vanity.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር የሚደረግ ከንቱ ነገር አለ፤ በኀጥኣን የሚደረገው ሥራ የሚደርስባቸው ጻድቃን አሉ፥ ለጻድቃንም የሚደረገው ሥራ የሚደርስላቸው ኀጥኣን አሉ፤ ይህም ደግሞ ከንቱ ነው አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚበላውና ከሚጠጣው ደስም ከሚለው በቀር ለሰው ከፀሐይ በታች ሌላ መልካም ነገር የለውምና እኔ ደስታን አመሰገንሁ፤ ከፀሐይም በታች ከድካሙ እግዚአብሔር በሰጠው በሕይወቱ ዘመን ይህ ደስታው ከእርሱ ጋር ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብን አውቅ ዘንድ በምድር የሚሆነውንም ድካም አይ ዘንድ ልቤን ሰጠሁ፥ በቀንና በሌሊት እንቅልፍን በዓይኑ የማያይ አለና፤

verses.text_english: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek out, yet he shall not find ; yea further; though a wise think to know , yet shall he not be able to find .
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይም በታች የተደረገውን ሥራ መርምሮ ያገኝ ዘንድ ለሰው እንዳይቻለው የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ሁሉ አየሁ። ሰውም ሊፈልግ እጅግ ቢደክም መርምሮ አያገኘውም፤ ደግሞ ጠቢብ ሰው። ይህን አወቅሁ ቢል እርሱ ያኘው ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred all before them.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃንና ጠቢባን ሥራዎቻቸውም በእግዚአብሔር እጅ እንደ ሆኑ፥ ይህን ሁሉ እመረምር ዘንድ በልቤ አኖርሁ፤ ፍቅር ወይም ጥል ቢሆን ሰው አያውቅም ሁሉ ወደ ፊታቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: All alike to all: one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as the good, so the sinner; he that sweareth, as that feareth an oath.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቁና የበደለኛው፥ የመልካሙና የክፉው፥ የንጹሑና የርኩሱ፥ መሥዋዕትን የሚሠዋውና የማይሠዋው፥ የሰው ሁሉ ድርሻው አንድ ነው፤ እንደ መልካሙ ሰው እንዲሁ ኃጢአተኛው፥ እንደ መሐለኛው ሰው እንዲሁ መሐላን የሚፈራው ነው።

verses.text_english: This an evil among all that are done under the sun, that one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness in their heart while they live, and after that to the dead.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ድርሻ ሁሉን እንዲያገኝ ከፀሐይ በታች በተደረገው ሁሉ ይህ ነገር ክፉ ነው፤ ደግሞም የሰው ልጆች ልብ ክፋትን ትሞላለች፥ በሕይወታቸውም ሳሉ እብደት በልባቸው ነው፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሙታን ይወርዳሉ።

verses.text_english: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
verses.text_amharic: ያልሞተ ውሻ ከሞተ አንበሳ ይሻላልና ሰው ከሕያዋን ሁሉ ጋር በአንድነት ቢኖር ተስፋ አለው።

verses.text_english: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያዋን እንዲሞቱ ያውቃሉና፤ ሙታን ግን አንዳች አያውቁም፤ መታሰቢያቸውም ተረስቶአልና ከዚያ በኋላ ዋጋ የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any that is done under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: ፍቅራቸውና ጥላቸው ቅንዓታቸውም በአንድነት ጠፍቶአል፥ ከፀሐይ በታችም በሚሠራው ነገር ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሥራህን ተቀብሎታልና ሂድ፥ እንጀራህን በደስታ ብላ፥ የወይን ጠጅህንም በተድላ ጠጣ።

verses.text_english: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ልብስህ ነጭ ይሁን፤ ቅባትም ከራስህ ላይ አይታጣ።

verses.text_english: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that thy portion in life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወትህ፥ አንተም ከፀሐይ በታች በምትደክምበት ድካም ይህ እድል ፈንታህ ነውና ከንቱ በሆነ በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ከፀሐይ በታች በሰጠህ፥ በከንቱ ዘመንህ ሁሉ፥ ከምትወድዳት ሚስትህ ጋር ደስ ይበልህ።

verses.text_english: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do with thy might; for no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በምትሄድበት በሲኦል ሥራና አሳብ እውቀትና ጥበብ አይገኙምና እጅህ ለማድረግ የምታገኘውን ሁሉ እንደ ኃይልህ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ተመለስሁ፥ ከፀሐይ በታችም ሩጫ ለፈጣኖች፥ ሰልፍም ለኃያላን፥ እንጀራም ለጠቢባን፥ ባለጠግነትም ለአስተዋዮች፥ ሞገስም ለአዋቂዎች እንዳልሆነ አየሁ፤ ጊዜና እድል ግን ሁሉን ይገናኛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ጊዜውን አያውቅም፤ በክፉ መረብ እንደ ተጠመዱ ዓሣዎች፥ በወጥመድም እንደ ተያዙ ወፎች፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ልጆች በክፉ ጊዜ በድንገት ሲወድቅባቸው ይጠመዳሉ።

verses.text_english: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it great unto me:
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ በታችም ይህን ጥበብ አየሁ፥ እርስዋም በእኔ ዘንድ ታላቅ መሰለችኝ።

verses.text_english: a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
verses.text_amharic: ታናሽ ከተማ ነበረች፥ ጥቂቶች ሰዎችም ነበሩባት፤ ታላቅ ንጉሥም መጣባት ከበባትም፥ ታላቅ ግንብም ሠራባት።

verses.text_english: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቢብ ድሀ ሰውም ተገኘባት፥ ያችንም ከተማ በጥበቡ አዳናት፤ ያን ድሀ ሰው ግን ማንም አላሰበውም።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Wisdom better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom despised, and his words are not heard.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ከኃይል ይልቅ ጥበብ ትበልጣለች፤ የድሀው ጥበብ ግን ተናቀች ቃሉም አልተሰማችም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: The words of wise heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
verses.text_amharic: በሰነፎች መካከል ከሚጮኽ ከገዢው ጩኸት ይልቅ የጠቢባን ቃል በጸጥታ ትሰማለች።

verses.text_english: Wisdom better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
verses.text_amharic: ከጦር መሣሪያዎች ይልቅ ጥበብ ትሻላለች፤ አንድ ኃጢአተኛ ግን ብዙ መልካምን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom honour.
verses.text_amharic: የሞቱ ዝንቦች የተቀመመውን የዘይት ሽቱ ያገሙታል፤ እንዲሁም ትንሽ ስንፍና ጥበብንና ክብርን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: A wise man's heart at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢብ ልብ በስተ ቀኙ ነው፥ የሰነፍ ልብ ግን በስተ ግራው ነው።

verses.text_english: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth , and he saith to every one he a fool.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሰነፍ በመንገድ ሲመላለስ እርሱ ልብ ይጐድለዋል፥ የሚያስበውም ሁሉ ስንፍና ነው።

verses.text_english: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕግሥት ታላቁን ኃጢአት ጸጥ ያደርጋልና የገዢ ቍጣ የተነሣብህ እንደ ሆነ ስፍራህን አትልቀቅ።

verses.text_english: There is an evil I have seen under the sun, as an error proceedeth from the ruler:
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ በታች ያየሁት ክፉ ነገር አለ፥ እርሱም ከገዢ የሚወጣ ስሕተት ነው፤

verses.text_english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ በታላቅ ማዕርግ ተሾመ፥ ባለጠጎች ግን በተዋረደ ስፍራ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች በፈረስ ላይ ሲቀመጡ መሳፍንትም እንደ ባሪያዎች በምድር ላይ ሲሄዱ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
verses.text_amharic: ጕድጓድን የሚምስ ይወድቅበታል፥ ቅጥርንም የሚያፈርስን እባብ ትነድፈዋለች።

verses.text_english: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋይን የሚፈነቅል ይታመምበታል፥ እንጨትንም የሚፈልጥ ይጐዳበታል።

verses.text_english: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom profitable to direct.
verses.text_amharic: ብረት ቢደነዝዝ ሰውም ባይስለው ኃይልን ሊያበዛ ይገባዋል፤ ጥበብ ግን ሥራውን ለማከናወን ትጠቅመዋለች።

verses.text_english: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
verses.text_amharic: ደጋሚ ሳይደግምባት እባብ ብትነድፍ ለደጋሚው ትርፍ የለውም።

verses.text_english: The words of a wise man's mouth gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢብ ሰው የአፉ ቃል ሞገስ ናት፤ የሰነፍ ከንፈሮች ግን ራሱን ይውጡታል።

verses.text_english: The beginning of the words of his mouth foolishness: and the end of his talk mischievous madness.
verses.text_amharic: የአፉ ቃል መጀመሪያ ስንፍና ነው፥ የንግግሩ ፍጻሜም ክፉ እብደት ነው።

verses.text_english: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ ቃሉን ያበዛል፤ ሰው ግን የሚሆነውን አያውቅም፤ ከእርሱስ በኋላ የሚሆነውን ማን ይነግረዋል?

verses.text_english: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
verses.text_amharic: የሰነፍ ሥራ ያደክመዋል ወደ ከተማ መሄድ አያውቅምና።

verses.text_english: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥሽ ሕፃን የሆነ፥ መኳንንቶችሽም ማልደው የሚበሉ፥ አንቺ አገር ሆይ፥ ወዮልሽ!

verses.text_english: Blessed thou, O land, when thy king the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥሽ የከበረ ልጅ የሆነ፥ ለብርታት እንጂ ለስካር ያይደለ በጊዜ የሚበሉ መኳንንት ያሉሽ፥ አንቺ አገር ሆይ፥ የተመሰገንሽ ነሽ።

verses.text_english: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.
verses.text_amharic: ተግባር በመፍታት ጣራው ይዘብጣል፥ በእጅም መታከት ቤት ያፈስሳል።

verses.text_english: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all .
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራን ለሳቅ የወይን ጠጅንም ለሕይወት ደስታ ያደርጉታል፥ ሁሉም ለገንዘብ ይገዛል።

verses.text_english: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይ ወፍ ቃሉን ይወስደዋልና፥ ባለ ክንፎችም ነገሩን ይናገራሉና በልብህ አሳብ እንኳ ቢሆን ንጉሥን አትስደብ፥ በመኝታ ቤትህም ባለጠጋን አትስደብ።

verses.text_english: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራህን በውኃ ፊት ላይ ጣለው፥ ከብዙ ቀን በኋላ ታገኛዋለህና።

verses.text_english: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባት ደግሞም ለስምንት እድል ፈንታን ክፈል፥ በምድር ላይ የሚሆነውን ክፉ ነገር ምን እንደሆነ አታውቅምና።

verses.text_english: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናት ዝናብ በሞሉ ጊዜ በምድር ላይ ያፈስሱታል፤ ዛፍም ወደ ደቡብ ወይም ወደ ሰሜን ቢወድቅ፥ ዛፉ በወደቀበት ስፍራ በዚያ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስን የሚጠባበቅ አይዘራም፥ ደመናንም የሚመለከት አያጭድም።

verses.text_english: As thou knowest not what the way of the spirit, how the bones in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
verses.text_amharic: የነፋስ መንገድ እንዴት እንደ ሆነች አጥንትም በእርጉዝ ሆድ እንዴት እንድትዋደድ እንደማታውቅ፥ እንዲሁም ሁሉን የሚሠራውን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ አታውቅም።

verses.text_english: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both alike good.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ይህ ወይም ያ ማናቸው እንዲበቅል ወይም ሁለቱ መልካም እንዲሆኑ አታውቅምና በማለዳ ዘርህን ዝራ፥ በማታም እጅህን አትተው።

verses.text_english: Truly the light sweet, and a pleasant for the eyes to behold the sun:
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃን ጣፋጭ ነው ፀሐይንም ማየት ለዓይን መልካም ነው።

verses.text_english: But if a man live many years, rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ብዙ ዘመን በሕይወት ቢኖር በሁሉም ደስ ይበለው፤ ሆኖም የጨለማውን ዘመን ያስብ፥ ብዙ ቀን ይሆናልና። የሚመጣው ነገር ሁሉ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these God will bring thee into judgment.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ጐበዝ፥ በጕብዝናህ ደስ ይበልህ፥ በጕብዝናህም ወራት ልብህን ደስ ይበለው፥ በልብህም መንገድ ዓይኖችህም በሚያዩት ሂድ፤ ዳሩ ግን ስለዚህ ነገር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ፍርድ እንዲያመጣህ እወቅ።

verses.text_english: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃንነትና ጕብዝና ከንቱዎች ናቸውና ከልብህ ኀዘንን አርቅ፥ ከሰውነትህም ክፉን ነገር አስወግድ።

verses.text_english: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
verses.text_amharic: የጭንቀት ቀን ሳይመጣ በጕብዝናህ ወራት ፈጣሪህን አስብ፤ ደስ አያሰኙም የምትላቸውም ዓመታት ሳይደርሱ፤

verses.text_english: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይና ብርሃን ጨረቃና ከዋክብትም ሳይጨልሙ፥ ደመናትም ከዝናብ በኋላ ሳይመለሱ፤

verses.text_english: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
verses.text_amharic: ቤት ጠባቆች በሚንቀጠቀጡበት፥ ኃያላን ሰዎችም በሚጎብጡበት፥ ጥቂቶች ሆነዋልና ፈጭታዎች ሥራ በሚፈቱበት፥ በመስኮትም ሆነው የሚመለከቱ በሚጨልሙበት፥ በአደባባይም ደጆቹ በሚዘጉበት ቀን፤

verses.text_english: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
verses.text_amharic: የወፍጮ ድምፅ ሲላሽ፥ ከወፍ ድምፅ የተነሣ ሰው ሲነሣ፥ ዜማም የሚጮኹ ሴቶች ልጆች ሁሉ ዝግ ሲሉ፤

verses.text_english: Also they shall be afraid of high, and fears in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ያለውን ደግሞ ሲፈሩ፥ ድንጋጤም በመንገድ ላይ ሲሆን፤ ለውዝም ሲያብብ፥ አንበጣም እንደ ሸክም ሲከብድ፥ ፈቃድም ሲጠፋ፤ ሰው ወደ ዘላለም ቤት ሲሄድ፥ አልቃሾችም በአደባባይ ሲዞሩ፤

verses.text_english: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
verses.text_amharic: የብር ድሪ ሳይበጠስ፥ የወርቅም ኵስኵስት ሳይሰበር፥ ማድጋውም በምንጭ አጠገብ ሳይከሰከስ፥ መንኰራኵሩም በጕድጓድ ላይ ሳይሰበር፥

verses.text_english: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
verses.text_amharic: አፈርም ወደ ነበረበት ምድር ሳይመለስ፥ ነፍስም ወደ ሰጠው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሳይመለስ ፈጣሪህን አስብ።

verses.text_english: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all vanity.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባኪው። ከንቱ፥ ከንቱ፤ ሁሉ ከንቱ ነው ይላል።

verses.text_english: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, set in order many proverbs.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባኪውም ጠቢብ ስለ ሆነ ለሕዝቡ እውቀትን አስተማረ፤ እርሱም ብዙ ምሳሌዎችን መረመረና ፈላለገ አስማማም።

verses.text_english: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and written upright, words of truth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባኪው ያማረውን በቅንም የተጻፈውን እውነተኛውን ቃል መርምሮ ለማግኘት ፈለገ።

verses.text_english: The words of the wise as goads, and as nails fastened the masters of assemblies, are given from one shepherd.
verses.text_amharic: የጠቢባን ቃል እንደ በሬ መውጊያ ነው፥ የተሰበሰቡትም ከአንድ እረኛ የተሰጡት ቃላት እንደ ተቸነከሩ ችንካሮች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books no end; and much study a weariness of the flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሁሉ በላይ፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ ተግሣጽን ስማ፤ ብዙ መጻሕፍትን ማድረግ ፍጻሜ የለውም፥ እጅግም ምርምር ሰውነትን ያደክማል።

verses.text_english: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this the whole of man.
verses.text_amharic: የነገሩን ሁሉ ፍጻሜ እንስማ፤ ይህ የሰው ሁለንተናው ነውና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፍራ፥ ትእዛዙንም ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether good, or whether evil.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሥራን ሁሉ የተሰወረውንም ነገር ሁሉ፥ መልካምም ቢሆን ክፉም ቢሆን፥ ወደ ፍርድ ያመጣዋልና።

verses.text_english: The song of songs, which Solomon's.
verses.text_amharic: ከመዝሙር ሁሉ የሚበልጥ የሰሎሞን መዝሙር።

verses.text_english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love better than wine.
verses.text_amharic: በአፉ መሳም ይሳመኝ፥ ፍቅርህ ከወይን ጠጅ ይልቅ መልካም ነውና።

verses.text_english: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
verses.text_amharic: ዘይትህ መልካም መዓዛ አለው፤ ስምህ እንደሚፈስስ ዘይት ነው፤ ስለዚህ ደናግል ወደዱህ።

verses.text_english: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሳበኝ፥ ከአንተም በኋላ እንሮጣለን፤ ንጉሡ ወደ ቤቱ አገባኝ በአንተ ደስ ይለናል፥ ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን፤ ከወይን ጠጅ ይልቅ ፍቅርህን እናስባለን፤ በቅንነት ይወድዱሃል።

verses.text_english: I black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እኔ ጥቁር ነኝ፤ ነገር ግን ውብ ነኝ፥ እንደ ቄዳር ድንኳኖች እንደ ሰሎሞንም መጋረጃዎች።

verses.text_english: Look not upon me, because I black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; mine own vineyard have I not kept.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ መልኬን አክስሎታልና፤ ጥቁር ስለ ሆንሁ አትዩኝ፤ የእናቴ ልጆች ተጣሉኝ፥ የወይን ቦታዎችንም ጠባቂ አደረጉኝ፤ ነገር ግን የእኔን ወይን ቦታ አልጠበቅሁም።

verses.text_english: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ የወደደችህ አንተ ንገረኝ፤ ወዴት ታሰማራለህ? በቅትርስ ጊዜ ወዴት ትመስጋለህ? ስለ ምንስ ከባልንጀሮችህ መንጎች በኋላ እቅበዘበዛለሁ?

verses.text_english: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በሴቶች ዘንድ የተዋብሽ ሆይ፥ ያላወቅሽ እንደ ሆነ የመንጎችን ፍለጋ ተከትለሽ ውጪ፥ የፍየል ግልገሎችሽንም በእረኞች ድንኳኖች አጠገብ አሰማሪ።

verses.text_english: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ በፈርዖን ሰረገሎች እንዳለ ፈረስ መሰልሁሽ።

verses.text_english: Thy cheeks are comely with rows , thy neck with chains .
verses.text_amharic: የጕንጭሽ ውበት በከበረ ሉል፥ አንገትሽም በዕንቍ ድሪ ያማረ ነው።

verses.text_english: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ባለ ብር ጕብጕብ የሆነ የወርቅ ጠልሰም እናደርግልሻለን።

verses.text_english: While the king at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ በማዕዱ ሳለ፥ የእኔ ናርዶስ መዓዛውን ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: A bundle of myrrh my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ለእኔ በጡቶቼ መካከል እንደሚያርፍ እንደ ተቋጠረ ከርቤ ነው።

verses.text_english: My beloved unto me a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ለእኔ በዓይንጋዲ ወይን ቦታ እንዳለ እንደ አበባ እቅፍ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou fair, my love; behold, thou fair; thou doves' eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ውብ ነሽ፤ እነሆ፥ አንቺ ውብ ነሽ፤ ዓይኖችሽም እንደ ርግቦች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed green.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ ውብ ነህ፥ መልከ መልካምም ነህ፤ አልጋችንም ለምለም ነው።

verses.text_english: The beams of our house cedar, our rafters of fir.
verses.text_amharic: የቤታችን ሰረገላ የዝግባ ዛፍ ነው፥ የጣሪያችንም ማዋቀሪያ የጥድ ዛፍ ነው።

verses.text_english: I the rose of Sharon, the lily of the valleys.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የሳሮን ጽጌ ረዳ የቈላም አበባ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: As the lily among thorns, so my love among the daughters.
verses.text_amharic: በእሾህ መካከል እንዳለ የሱፍ አበባ፥ እንዲሁ ወዳጄ በቈነጃጅት መካከል ናት።

verses.text_english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit sweet to my taste.
verses.text_amharic: በዱር እንዳለ እንኮይ፥ እንዲሁ ውዴ በልጆች መካከል ነው። ከጥላው በታች እጅግ ወድጄ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ፍሬውም በጕሮሮዬ ጣፋጭ ነው።

verses.text_english: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me love.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ወይን ጠጁም ቤት አገባኝ፥ በእኔ ላይ ያለው ዓላማውም ፍቅር ነው።

verses.text_english: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I sick of love.
verses.text_amharic: በዘቢብም አጽናኑኝ፥ በእንኮይ አበረታቱኝ፥ በፍቅሩ ተነድፌ ታምሜያለሁና።

verses.text_english: His left hand under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
verses.text_amharic: ግራው ከራሴ በታች ናት፥ ቀኙም ታቅፈኛለች።

verses.text_english: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake love, till he please.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እርሱ እስኪፈልግ ድረስ፥ ፍቅርን እንዳታስነሱትና እንዳታነሣሡት በሚዳቋ በምድረ በዳም ዋላ አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የውዴ ቃል! በተራሮች ላይ ሲዘልል፥ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ሲወረወር ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ሚዳቋን ወይም የዋላን እምቦሳ ይመስላል፤ እነሆ፥ በመስኮቶች ሲጐበኝ፥ በዓይነ ርግብም ሲመለከት፥ እርሱ ከቅጥራችን በኋላ ቆሞአል።

verses.text_english: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፤ ውበቴ ሆይ፥ ነዪ።

verses.text_english: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over gone;
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ክረምት አለፈ፥ ዝናቡም አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verses.text_amharic: አበቦች በምድር ላይ ተገለጡ፥ የዜማም ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ የቊርዬውም ቃል በምድራችን ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines the tender grape give a smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.text_amharic: በለሱ ጐመራ፥ ወይኖችም አበቡ መዓዛቸውንም ሰጡ፤ ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፤ ውበቴ ሆይ፥ ነዪ።

verses.text_english: O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the secret of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet thy voice, and thy countenance comely.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለት ንቃቃትና በገደል መሸሸጊያ ያለሽ ርግብ ሆይ፥ ቃልሽ መልካም ፊትሽም ያማረ ነውና መልክሽን አሳዪኝ፥ ድምፅሽንም አሰሚኝ።

verses.text_english: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines tender grapes.
verses.text_amharic: ወይናችን አብቦአልና የወይናችንን ቦታ የሚያጠፉትን ቀበሮች፥ ጥቃቅኑን ቀበሮች አጥምዳችሁ ያዙልን።

verses.text_english: My beloved mine, and I his: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ የእኔ ነው፥ እኔም የእርሱ ነኝ፤ በሱፍ አበባዎች መካከልም መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.text_english: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ሆይ፥ ቀኑ እስኪነፍስ፥ ጥላውም እስኪሸሽ ድረስ ተመለስ፤ በቅመም ተራራ ላይ ሚዳቋውን ወይም የዋላውን እምቦሳ ምሰል።

verses.text_english: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሊት በምንጣፌ ላይ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን ፈለግሁት፤ ፈለግሁት አላገኘሁትም።

verses.text_english: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.text_amharic: እነሣለሁ በከተማይቱም እዞራለሁ፥ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን በጎዳናና በአደባባይ እፈልጋለሁ፤ ፈለግሁት አላገኘሁትም።

verses.text_english: The watchmen that go about the city found me: , Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱን የሚዞሩት ጠባቂዎች አገኙኝ፤ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን አያችሁትን? አልኋቸውም።

verses.text_english: but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጥቂት እልፍ ብዬ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን አገኘሁት፥ ያዝሁትም ወደ እናቴም ቤት ወደ ወላጅ እናቴም እልፍኝ እስካገባው ድረስ አልተውሁትም።

verses.text_english: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake love, till he please.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እርሱ እስኪፈልግ ድረስ፥ ፍቅርን እንዳታስነሡትና እንዳታነሣሡት በሚዳቋ በምድረ በዳም ዋላ አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Who this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
verses.text_amharic: መዓዛም እንደ ከርቤና እንደ ዕጣን የሆነችው፥ ከልዩ ከነጋዴ ቅመም ሁሉ የሆነችው፥ ይህች ከምድረ በዳ እንደ ጢስ ምስሶ የወጣችው ማን ናት?

verses.text_english: Behold his bed, which Solomon's; threescore valiant men about it, of the valiant of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የሰሎሞን አልጋ ናት፤ ከእስራኤል ኃያላን ስድሳ ኃያላን በዙሪያው ናቸው።

verses.text_english: They all hold swords, expert in war: every man his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ሰይፍ የያዙ ሰልፈኞች ናቸው፤ በሌሊት ከሚወድቀው ፍርሃት የተነሣ ሰው ሁሉ ሰይፉ በወገቡ አለ።

verses.text_english: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን መሸከሚያን ከሊባኖስ እንጨት ለራሱ አሠራ።

verses.text_english: He made the pillars thereof silver, the bottom thereof gold, the covering of it purple, the midst thereof being paved love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ምሰሶቹን የብር፥ መደገፊያውንም የወርቅ፥ መቀመጫውንም ሐምራዊ ግምጃ አደረገ፤ ውስጡ በኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ፍቅር የተለበጠ ነው።

verses.text_english: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የጽዮን ቈነጃጅት፥ ውጡ፤ እናቱ በሠርጉ ቀንና በልቡ ደስታ ቀን ያደረገችለትን አክሊል ደፍቶ ንጉሥ ሰሎሞንን እዩ።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou fair, my love; behold, thou fair; thou doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ውብ ነሽ፤ እነሆ፥ አንቺ ውብ ነሽ፤ በዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛሽ ውስጥ ዓይኖችሽ እንደ ርግቦች ናቸው፤ ጠጕርሽ በገለዓድ ተራራ እንደሚወርድ እንደ ፍየል መንጋ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thy teeth like a flock shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none barren among them.
verses.text_amharic: ጥርሶችሽ ታጥበው እንደ ተሸለቱ ሁሉም መንታ እንደ ወለዱ ከእነርሱም መካን እንደሌለባቸው መንጎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Thy lips like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech comely: thy temples like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፈሮችሽ እንደ ቀይ ሐር ፈትል ናቸው፥ አፍሽም ያማረ ነው፤ በዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛሽ ውስጥ ጕንጭና ጕንጭሽ እንደ ተከፈለ ሮማን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Thy neck like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: አንገትሽ ለሰልፍ ዕቃ መስቀያ እንደ ተሠራው እንደ ዳዊት ግንብ ነው፤ ሺህ ጋሻ የኃያላንም መሣሪያ ሁሉ ተንጠልጥሎበታል።

verses.text_english: Thy two breasts like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱ ጡቶችሽ መንታ እንደ ተወለዱ፥ በሱፍ አበባ መካከል እንደሚሰማሩ እንደ ሚዳቋ ግልገሎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኑ እስኪነፍስ ጥላውም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ወደ ከርቤው ተራራ ወደ ዕጣኑም ኮረብታ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou all fair, my love; no spot in thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ሁለንተናሽ ውብ ነው፥ ነውርም የለብሽም።

verses.text_english: Come with me from Lebanon, spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ከሊባኖስ ከእኔ ጋር ነዪ፤ ከሊባኖስ ከእኔ ጋር ነዪ፤ ከአማና ራስ ከሳኔርና ከኤርሞን ራስ፥ ከአንበሶች መኖሪያ ከነብሮችም ተራራ ተመልከች።

verses.text_english: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
verses.text_amharic: እኅቴ ሙሽራ ሆይ፥ ልቤን በደስታ አሳበድሽው፤ አንድ ጊዜ በዓይኖችሽ፥ ከአንገትሽ ድሪ በአንዱ ልቤን በደስታ አሳበድሽው።

verses.text_english: How fair is thy love, my sister, spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
verses.text_amharic: እኅቴ ሙሽራ ሆይ፥ ፍቅርሽ እንዴት መልካም ነው! ፍቅርሽ ከወይን ጠጅ ይልቅ እንዴት ይሻላል! የዘይትሽም መዓዛ ከሽቱ ሁሉ!

verses.text_english: Thy lips, O spouse, drop the honeycomb: honey and milk under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ከከንፈሮችሽ ማር ይንጠበጠባል፤ ከምላስሽ በታች ማርና ወተት አለ፥ የልብስሽም መዓዛ እንደ ሊባኖስ ሽታ ነው።

verses.text_english: A garden inclosed my sister, spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
verses.text_amharic: እኅቴ ሙሽራ የተቈለፈ ገነት፥ የተዘጋ ምንጭ የታተመም ፈሳሽ ናት።

verses.text_english: Thy plants an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
verses.text_amharic: ቡቃያሽ ሮማንና የተመረጠ ፍሬ፥ ቆዕ ከናርዶስ ጋር ያለበት ገነት ነው፥

verses.text_english: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
verses.text_amharic: ናርዶስ ከቀጋ ጋር፥ የሽቱ ሣርና ቀረፋ፥ ከልዩ ልዩ ዕጣን ጋር፥ ከርቤና እሬት ከክቡር ሽቱ ሁሉ ጋር።

verses.text_english: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የገነት ምንጭ፥ የሕይወት ውኃ ጕድጓድ፥ ከሊባኖስም የሚፈስስ ወንዝ ነሽ።

verses.text_english: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሜን ነፋስ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ የደቡብም ነፋስ ና፤ በገነቴ ላይ ንፈስ፥ ሽቱውም ይፍሰስ፤ ውዴ ወደ ገነቱ ይግባ፥ መልካሙንም ፍሬ ይብላ።

verses.text_english: I am come into my garden, my sister, spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
verses.text_amharic: እኅቴ ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ገነቴ ገባሁ፥ ከርቤዬን ከሽቱዬ ጋር ለቀምሁ፥ እንጀራዬን ከማሬ ጋር በላሁ፥ የወይን ጠጄን ከወተቴ ጋር ጠጣሁ። ባልንጀሮቼ ሆይ፥ ብሉ፤ ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ጠጪ፤ እስክትረኪ ድረስ ጠጪ።

verses.text_english: I sleep, but my heart waketh: the voice of my beloved that knocketh, , Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, my locks with the drops of the night.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ተኝቻለሁ፥ ልቤ ግን ነቅቶአል፤ የውዴ ቃል ነው፥ እርሱም ደጁን ይመታል፤ እኅቴ፥ ወዳጄ፥ ርግቤ፥ መደምደሚያዬ ሆይ፥ በራሴ ጠል፥ በቈንዳላዬም የሌሊት ነጠብጣብ ሞልቶበታልና ክፈችልኝ።

verses.text_english: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
verses.text_amharic: ቀሚሴን አወለቅሁ፤ እንዴት እለብሰዋለሁ? እግሬን ታጠብሁ፤ እንዴት አሳድፈዋለሁ?

verses.text_english: My beloved put in his hand by the hole , and my bowels were moved for him.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ እጁን በቀዳዳ ሰደደ፥ አንጀቴም ስለ እርሱ ታወከ።

verses.text_english: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped myrrh, and my fingers sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
verses.text_amharic: ለውዴ እከፍትለት ዘንድ ተነሣሁ፤ እጆቼ በደጅ መወርወሪያ ላይ ከርቤን አፈሰሱ፥ ጣቶቼ ፈሳሹን ከርቤ አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.text_english: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
verses.text_amharic: ለውዴ ከፈትሁለት፥ ውዴ ግን ፈቀቅ ብሎ አልፎ ነበር። ነፍሴ ከቃሉ የተነሣ ደነገጠች፤ ፈለግሁት፥ አላገኘሁትም፤ ጠራሁት፥ አልመለሰልኝም።

verses.text_english: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱን የሚዞሩት ጠባቂዎች አገኙኝ፤ መቱኝ፥ አቈሰሉኝም፤ ቅጥር ጠባቂዎችም የዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛዬን ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I sick of love.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ አምላችኋለሁ፤ ውዴን ያገኛችሁት እንደ ሆነ፥ እኔ ከፍቅር የተነሣ መታመሜን ንገሩት።

verses.text_english: What thy beloved more than beloved, O thou fairest among women? what thy beloved more than beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በሴቶች ዘንድ የተዋብሽ ሆይ፥ ከሌላ ወዳጅ ይልቅ ውድሽ ማን ነው? ይህን የሚያህል አምለሽናልና ከሌላ ወዳጅ ይልቅ ውድሽ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: My beloved white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ነጭና ቀይ ነው፥ ከእልፍ የተመረጠ ነው።

verses.text_english: His head the most fine gold, his locks bushy, black as a raven.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱ ምዝምዝ ወርቅ ነው፤ ቈንዳላው የተዝረፈረፈ ነው፥ እንደ ቁራ ጥቁረትም ጥቁር ነው።

verses.text_english: His eyes as of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, fitly set.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቹ በሙሉ ፈሳሽ አጠገብ እንዳሉ በወተት እንደ ታጠቡ በፈሳሽ ውኃ አጠገብ እንደ ተቀመጡ እንደ ርግቦች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: His cheeks as a bed of spices, sweet flowers: his lips lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
verses.text_amharic: ጕንጩና ጕንጩ የሽቱ መደብ እርከን እንዳለበት እንደ ሽቱ አትክልት ናቸው፤ ከንፈሮቹ እንደ አበቦች ናቸው፥ የሚፈስስ ከርቤንም ያንጠበጥባሉ።

verses.text_english: His hands gold rings set with the beryl: his belly bright ivory overlaid sapphires.
verses.text_amharic: እጆቹ የቢረሌ ፈርጥ እንዳለበት እንደ ወርቅ ቀለበት ናቸው፤ አካሉ ብልሃተኛ እንደ ሠራው በሰንፔር እንዳጌጠ እንደ ዝሆን ጥርስ ነው።

verses.text_english: His legs pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቹ በምዝምዝ ወርቅ እንደ ተመሠረቱ እንደ ዕብነ በረድ ምሰሶች ናቸው፤ መልኩ እንደ ሊባኖስና እንደ ዝግባ ዛፍ መልካም ነው።

verses.text_english: His mouth most sweet: yea, he altogether lovely. This my beloved, and this my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አፉ እጅግ ጣፋጭ ነው፥ እርሱም ፈጽሞ ያማረ ነው፤ እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ ውዴ ይህ ነው፥ ባልንጀራዬም ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በሴቶች ዘንድ የተዋብሽ ሆይ፥ ከአንቺ ጋር እንፈልገው ዘንድ ውድሽ ወዴት ሄደ? ውድሽስ ወዴት ፈቀቅ አለ?

verses.text_english: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ በገነቱ መንጋውን ያሰማራ ዘንድ አበባውንም ይሰበስብ ዘንድ ወደ ሽቱ መደብ ወደ ገነቱ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: I my beloved's, and my beloved mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የወዴ ነኝ ውዴም የእኔ ነው፤ በሱፉ አበባ መካከል መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.text_english: Thou beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as with banners.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እንደ ቴርሳ ውብ ነሽ፥ እንደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ያማርሽ ነሽ፤ ዓላማ ይዞ እንደ ተሰለፈ ሠራዊት ታስፈሪያለሽ።

verses.text_english: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: አውከውኛልና ዓይኖችሽን ከፊቴ መልሺ፤ ጠጕርሽ ከገለዓድ እንደ ወረደ እንደ ፍየል መንጋ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thy teeth as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and not one barren among them.
verses.text_amharic: ጥርሶችሽ ታጥበው እንደ ወጡ ሁሉ መንታ እንደ ወለዱ ከእነርሱም መካን እንደሌለባቸው መንጎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: As a piece of a pomegranate thy temples within thy locks.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛሽ ውስጥ ጕንጭና ጕንጭሽ እንደ ተከፈለ ሮማን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.text_amharic: ስድሳ ንግሥታት ሰማንያም ቍባቶች ቍጥር የሌላቸውም ቈነጃጅት አሉ።

verses.text_english: My dove, my undefiled is one; she the one of her mother, she the choice of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; , the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
verses.text_amharic: ርግቤ መደምደሚያዬም አንዲት ናት፤ ለእናትዋ አንዲት ናት ለወለደቻትም የተመረጠች ናት። ቈነጃጅትም አይተው አሞገሱአት፥ ንግሥታትና ቍባቶችም አመሰገኑአት።

verses.text_english: Who she looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, terrible as with banners?
verses.text_amharic: ይህች እንደ ማለዳ ብርሃን የምትጐበኝ፥ እንደ ጨረቃ የተዋበች እንደ ፀሐይም የጠራች፥ ዓላማ ይዞ እንደ ተሰለፈ ሠራዊት የምታስፈራ ማን ናት?

verses.text_english: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, to see whether the vine flourished, the pomegranates budded.
verses.text_amharic: የወንዙን ዳር ልምላሜ አይ ዘንድ፥ ወይኑ አብቦ ሮማኑም አፍርቶ እንደ ሆነ እመለከት ዘንድ ወደ ገውዝ ገነት ወረድሁ።

verses.text_english: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me the chariots of Amminadib.
verses.text_amharic: ሳላውቅ ነፍሴ በከበረው ሰረገላ ላይ አስቀመጠችኝ።

verses.text_english: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ሱላማጢስ ሆይ፥ ተመለሽ፥ ተመለሽ፤ እናይሽ ዘንድ ተመለሽ፥ ተመለሽ። በሱላማጢስ ምን ታያላችሁ? እርስዋ እንደ መሃናይም ዘፈን ናት።

verses.text_english: Thy navel a round goblet, wanteth not liquor: thy belly an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የመኰንን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እግሮችሽ በጫማ ውስጥ እንዴት ውቦች ናቸው! ዳሌዎችሽስ በአንጥረኛ እጅ እንደ ተሠሩ እንደ ዕንቍዎች ይመስላሉ።

verses.text_english: Thy two breasts like two young roes twins.
verses.text_amharic: እንብርትሽ የወይን ጠጅ እንደማይጐድልበት እንደ ተነጠጠ ጽዋ ነው፤ ሆድሽ እንደ ስንዴ ክምር፥ በአበባም እንደ ታጠረ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thy neck as a tower of ivory; thine eyes the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱ ጡቶችሽ እንደ ሁለቱ መንታ እንደ ሚዳቋ ግለገሎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Thine head upon thee like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king held in the galleries.
verses.text_amharic: አንገትሽ እንደ ዝሆን ጥርስ ግንብ ነው፤ ዓይኖችሽ በሐሴቦን ውስጥ በባትረቢ በር አጠገብ እንደ ውኃ ኵሬዎች ናቸው፤ አፍንጫሽ ወደ ደማስቆ አፋዛዥ እንደሚመለከት እንደ ሊባኖስ ግንብ ነው።

verses.text_english: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
verses.text_amharic: ራስሽ እንደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ በላይሽ ነው፤ የራስሽም ጠጕር እንደ ሐምራዊ ሐር ነው፤ ንጉሡ በሹርባው ታስሮአል።

verses.text_english: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters .
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እንዴት የተዋብሽ ነሽ! እንዴትስ ደስ ታሰኛለሽ!

verses.text_english: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ቁመትሽ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ይመስላል፥ ጡቶችሽም የወይን ዘለላ ይመስላሉ።

verses.text_english: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዘንባባው ዛፍ እወጣለሁ ጫፎችዋንም እይዛለሁ አልሁ፤ ጡቶችሽ እንደ ወይን ዘለላ የአፍንጫሽም ሽቱ እንደ እንኮይ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: I my beloved's, and his desire toward me.
verses.text_amharic: ጕሮሮሽ ለወዳጄ እየጣፈጠ እንደሚገባ፥ የተኙትን ከንፈሮች ይናገሩ ዘንድ እንደሚያደርግ፥ እንደ ማለፊያ የወይን ጠጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የውዴ ነኝ፥ የእርሱም ምኞት ወደ እኔ ነው።

verses.text_english: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, the tender grape appear, the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ሆይ፥ ና፥ ወደ መስክ እንውጣ በመንደሮችም እንደር።

verses.text_english: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates all manner of pleasant , new and old, I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ወይኑ ቦታ ማልደን እንሂድ፤ ወይኑ አብቦ አበባውም ፍሬ አንዠርግጎ ሮማኑም አፍርቶ እንደ ሆነ እንይ፤ በዚያ ውዴን እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: O that thou as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የእናቴን ጡት እንደ ጠባ እንደ ወንድሜ ምነው በሆንህ! በሜዳ ባገኘሁህ ጊዜ በሳምሁህ፥ ማንም ባልናቀኝም ነበር።

verses.text_english: I would lead thee, bring thee into my mother's house, would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.text_amharic: መርቼ ወደ እናቴ ቤት ባገባሁህ፥ በዚያም አንተ ባስተማርከኝ፤ እኔም ከመልካሙ ወይን ጠጅ ከሮማኔም ውኃ ባጠጣሁህ ነበር።

verses.text_english: His left hand under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
verses.text_amharic: ግራው ከራሴ በታች በሆነች ቀኙም ባቀፈችኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake love, until he please.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እርሱ እስኪፈልግ ድረስ ፍቅርን እንዳታስነሡት እንዳታነሣሡትም አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Who this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth bare thee.
verses.text_amharic: በውድዋ ላይ ተደግፋ ከምድረ በዳ የምትወጣ ይህች ማን ናት? ከእንኮይ በታች አስነሣሁህ፤ በዚያ እናትህ ወለደችህ፥ በዚያም ወላጅ እናትህ አማጠችህ።

verses.text_english: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love strong as death; jealousy cruel as the grave: the coals thereof coals of fire, most vehement flame.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ማኅተም በልብህ፥ እንደ ማኅተም በክንድህ አኑረኝ፤ ፍቅር እንደ ሞት የበረታች ናትና፥ ቅንዓትም እንደ ሲኦል የጨከነች ናትና። ፍንጣሪዋ እንደ እሳት ፍንጣሪ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ነበልባል ነው።

verses.text_english: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ውኃ ፍቅርን ያጠፋት ዘንድ አይችልም፥ ፈሳሾችም አያሰጥሙአትም፤ ሰው የቤቱን ሀብት ሁሉ ስለ ፍቅር ቢሰጥ ፈጽሞ ይንቁታል።

verses.text_english: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ጡት የሌላት ታናሽ እኅት አለችን፤ ስለ እርስዋ በሚናገሩባት ቀን ለእኅታችን ምን እናድርግላት?

verses.text_english: If she a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ቅጥር ብትሆን የብር ግንብ በላይዋ እንሠራለን፤ ደጅም ብትሆን በዝግባ ሳንቃ እንከብባታለን።

verses.text_english: I a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ቅጥር ነኝ ጡቶቼም እንደ ግንብ ናቸው፤ በዚያን ጊዜ በፊቱ ሰላምን እንደምታገኝ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰሎሞን በብኤላሞን የወይን ቦታ ነበረው፤ የወይኑን ቦታ ለጠባቂዎች አከራየው፤ ሰው ሁሉ ለፍሬው ሺህ ብር ያመጣለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: My vineyard, which mine, before me: thou, O Solomon, a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔ ያለኝ የወይን ቦታ በፊቴ ነው፤ ሰሎሞን ሆይ፥ ሺሁ ለአንተ፥ ሁለት መቶውም ፍሬውን ለሚጠብቁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear .
verses.text_amharic: በገነቱ የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ ባልንጀሮች የአንቺን ቃል ያደምጣሉ፤ ቃልሽን አሰሚኝ።

verses.text_english: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
verses.text_amharic: ውዴ ሆይ፥ ፍጠን፤ በቅመም ተራራ ላይ ሚዳቋን ወይም የዋላን እምቦሳ ምሰል።

verses.text_english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያንና በኢዮአታም በአካዝና በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ስለ ይሁዳና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው የአሞጽ ልጅ የኢሳይያስ ራእይ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና ሰማያት ስሙ፥ ምድርም አድምጪ፤ ልጆችን ወለድሁ አሳደግሁም፥ እነርሱም አመጹብኝ።

verses.text_english: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.text_amharic: በሬ የገዢውን አህያም የጌታውን ጋጣ አወቀ፤ እስራኤል ግን አላወቀም፥ ሕዝቤም አላስተዋለም።

verses.text_english: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛ ወገንና በደል የተሞላበት ሕዝብ፥ የክፉዎች ዘር፥ ርኵሰትን የምታደርጉ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ወዮላችሁ! እግዚአብሔርን ትተዋል የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ አቃልለዋል ወደ ኋላቸውም እየሄዱ ተለይተዋል።

verses.text_english: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞስ ዓመፃ እየጨመራችሁ ለምን ገና ትቀሰፋላችሁ? ራስ ሁሉ ለሕመም ልብም ሁሉ ለድካም ሆኗል።

verses.text_english: From the sole of the foot even unto the head no soundness in it; wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግር ጫማ አንስቶ እስከ ራስ ድረስ ጤና የለውም፤ ቍስልና እበጥ የሚመግልም ነው፤ አልፈረጠም፥ አልተጠገነም፥ በዘይትም አልለዘበም።

verses.text_english: Your country desolate, your cities burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራችሁ ባድማ ናት፤ ከተሞቻችሁ በእሳት ተቃጠሉ፤ እርሻችሁንም በፊታችሁ ሌሎች ይበሉታል፤ ባዕድ እንዳፈረሳት ምድር ባድማ ሆነች።

verses.text_english: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.text_amharic: የጽዮንም ሴት ልጅ በወይን ቦታ እንዳለ ዳስ፥ በዱባ አትክልትም እንዳለ ጎጆ፥ እንደተከበበችም ከተማ ሆና ቀረች።

verses.text_english: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ዘርን ባያስቀርልን ኖሮ፥ እንደ ሰዶም በሆንነ እንደ ገሞራም በመሰልነ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የሰዶም አለቆች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እናንተ የገሞራ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ የአምላካችንን ሕግ አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: To what purpose the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.text_amharic: የመሥዋዕታችሁ ብዛት ለእኔ ምን ይጠቅመኛል? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የሚቃጠለውን የአውራ በግ መሥዋዕትንና የፍሪዳን ስብ ጠግቤያለሁ፤ የበሬና የበግ ጠቦት የአውራ ፍየልም ደም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

verses.text_english: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ፊት ልትታዩ ብትመጡ ይህን የመቅደሴን አደባባይ መርገጣችሁን ከእጃችሁ የሚሻ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.text_amharic: ምናምንቴውን ቍርባን ጨምራችሁ አታምጡ፤ ዕጣን በእኔ ዘንድ አጸያፊ ነው፤ መባቻችሁንና ሰንበታችሁን በጉባኤ መሰብሰባችሁን አልወድድም፤ በደልንም የተቀደሰውንም ጉባኤ አልታገሥም።

verses.text_english: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear .
verses.text_amharic: መባቻችሁንና በዓላቶቻችሁን ነፍሴ ጠልታለች፤ ሸክም ሆነውብኛል፥ ልታገሣቸውም ደክሜያለሁ።

verses.text_english: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.text_amharic: እጃችሁንም ወደ እኔ ብትዘረጉ ዓይኔን ከእናንተ እሰውራለሁ፥ ልመናንም ብታበዙ አልሰማችሁም፤ እጆቻችሁ ደም ተሞልተዋል።

verses.text_english: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.text_amharic: ታጠቡ ሰውነታችሁንም አንጹ፤ የሥራችሁን ክፋት ከዓይኔ ፊት አስወግዱ፤ ክፉ ማድረግን ተዉ፥

verses.text_english: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም መሥራትን ተማሩ፥ ፍርድን ፈልጉ፥ የተገፋውን አድኑ፥ ለድሀ አደጉ ፍረዱለት ስለ መበለቲቱም ተምዋገቱ።

verses.text_english: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.text_amharic: ኑና እንዋቀስ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ኃጢአታችሁ እንደ አለላ ብትሆን እንደ አመዳይ ትነጻለች፤ እንደ ደምም ብትቀላ እንደ ባዘቶ ትጠራለች።

verses.text_english: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.text_amharic: እሺ ብትሉ ለእኔም ብትታዘዙ፥ የምድርን በረከት ትበላላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: እምቢ ብትሉ ግን ብታምፁም፥ ሰይፍ ይበላችኋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ይህን ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድ ሞልቶባት የነበረው የታመነችይቱ ከተማ እንዴት ጋለሞታ ሆነች! ጽድቅ አድሮባት ነበር፥ አሁን ግን ገዳዮች አሉባት።

verses.text_english: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
verses.text_amharic: ብርሽ ወደ ዝገት ተለወጠ፤ የወይን ጠጅሽ ከውሃ ጋር ተደባለቀ።

verses.text_english: Thy princes rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆችሽ አመጸኞችና የሌቦች ባልንጀሮች ሆኑ፤ ሁሉ ጉቦ ይወድዳሉ፥ ዋጋም ለማግኘት ይሮጣሉ፤ ለድሀ አደጉ አይፈርዱም፥ የመበለቲቱም ሙግት ወደ እነርሱ አይደርስም።

verses.text_english: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ኃያል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በጠላቶቼ ላይ ቍጣዬን እፈጽማለሁ፥ የሚቋቋሙኝንም እበቀላለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
verses.text_amharic: እጄንም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ዝገትሽንም በጣም አነጻለሁ፥ ቆርቆሮሽንም ሁሉ አወጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.text_amharic: ፈራጆችሽንም እንደ ቀድሞ አማካሪዎችሽንም እንደ መጀመሪያው ጊዜ መልሼ አስነሣለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ የጽድቅ ከተማ የታመነችም ከተማ ተብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ።

verses.text_english: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዮን በፍርድ ከእርሷም የሚመለሱ በጽድቅ ይድናሉ።

verses.text_english: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
verses.text_amharic: በደለኞችና ኃጢአተኞች ግን በአንድነት ይሰበራሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚተዉ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.text_amharic: በወደዳችኋት የአድባር ዛፍ ታፍራላችሁና፥ ስለ መረጣችኋትም አትክልት እፍረት ይይዛችኋልና፤

verses.text_english: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጠልዋ እንደ ረገፈ ዛፍ፥ ውሃም እንደሌለባት አትክልት ትሆናላችሁና።

verses.text_english: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench .
verses.text_amharic: ኃይለኛውም እንደ ተልባ ጭረት፥ ሥራውም እንደ ጠለሸት ይሆናል፤ አብረውም ይቃጠላሉ እነርሱንም የሚያጠፋ የለም።

verses.text_english: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ስለ ይሁዳና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው ቃል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in the last days, the mountain of the LORD'S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.text_amharic: በዘመኑም ፍጻሜ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተራራ በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ጸንቶ ይቆማል፥ ከኮረብቶችም በላይ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይሰበሰባሉ።
