verses.text_english: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግ ከጽዮን የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ከኢየሩሳሌም ይወጣልና ብዙዎች አሕዛብ ሄደው። ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ፥ ወደ ያዕቆብ አምላክ ቤት እንውጣ፤ እርሱም መንገዱን ያስተምረናል፥ በጎዳናውም እንሄዳለን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብም መካከል ይፈርዳል፥ በብዙ አሕዛብም ላይ ይበይናል፤ ሰይፋቸውንም ማረሻ ጦራቸውንም ማጭድ ለማድረግ ይቀጠቅጣሉ፤ ሕዝብም በሕዝብ ላይ ሰይፍ አያነሣም፥ ሰልፍም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይማሩም።

verses.text_english: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የያዕቆብ ቤት ሆይ፥ ኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ብርሃን እንሂድ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብህን የያዕቆብን ቤት ትተሃልና፤ ይኸውም የምሥራቅን ሰዎች አመል ስለ ተሞሉ፥ እንደ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ምዋርተኞች ስለ ሆኑ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆችም ጋር ስለ ተባበሩ ነው።

verses.text_english: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither end of their chariots:
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸው በብርና በወርቅ ተሞልታለች፥ ለመዛግብቶቻቸውም ፍጻሜ የለውም፤ ምድራቸውም ደግሞ በፈረሶች ተሞልታለች፥ ለሠረገሎቻቸውም ፍጻሜ የለውም።

verses.text_english: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸው ደግሞ በጣዖታት ተሞልታለች፤ ጣቶቻቸውም ላደረጉት ለእጃቸው ሥራ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.text_english: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.text_amharic: ታናሹም ሰው ዝቅ ብሎአል፥ ጨዋውም ተዋርዶአል፤ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አትበላቸው።

verses.text_english: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ማስደንገጥና ከግርማው ክብር የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻ ግባ፥ በመሬትም ውስጥ ተሸሸግ።

verses.text_english: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ያለችውም የሰው ዓይን ትዋረዳለች፥ የሰዎችም ኵራት ትወድቃለች፥ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ብቻውን ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: For the day of the LORD of hosts upon every proud and lofty, and upon every lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን በትዕቢተኛውና በኵራተኛው ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ባለውም ላይ ይሆናል፥ እርሱም ይዋረዳል፤

verses.text_english: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በረጅሙ ከፍ ባለው በሊባኖስ ዝግባ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በባሳንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ላይ፥

verses.text_english: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills lifted up,
verses.text_amharic: በረጅሙም ተራራ ሁሉ ላይ፥ ከፍ ባለውም ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፥

verses.text_english: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.text_amharic: በረጅሙም ግንብ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በተመሸገውም ቅጥር ሁሉ ላይ፥

verses.text_english: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.text_amharic: በተርሴስም መርከብ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በሚያማምሩ ጣዖታትም ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ሁሉ ይዋረዳል፥ የሰውም ኵራት ይወድቃል፥ በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.text_amharic: ጣዖቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ፈጽመው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን ያናውጥ ዘንድ በተነሣ ጊዜ ሰዎች ከማስደንገጡና ከግርማው ክብሩ የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻና ወደ ምድር ንቃቃት ውስጥ ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀን ሰው ይሰግድላቸው ዘንድ ያበጁአቸውን የብሩንና የወርቁን ጣዖቶቹን ለፍልፈልና ለሌሊት ወፍ ይጥላል።

verses.text_english: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ምድርን ያናውጥ ዘንድ በተነሣ ጊዜ ከማስደንገጡና ከግርማው ክብር የተነሣ ወደ ድንጋይ ዋሻና ወደ ተሰነጠቁ ዓለቶች ውስጥ ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: Cease ye from man, whose breath in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.text_amharic: እስትንፋሱ በአፍንጫው ውስጥ ያለበትን ሰው ተዉት፤ እርሱ ስለ ምን ይቈጠራል?

verses.text_english: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከኢየሩሳሌምና ከይሁዳ ድጋፍንና ብርታትን፥ የእንጀራን ድጋፍ ሁሉ የውኃውንም ድጋፍ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
verses.text_amharic: ኃያሉንም፥ ተዋጊውንም፥ ፈራጁንም፥ ነቢዩንም፥ ምዋርተኛውንም፥

verses.text_english: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌውንም፥ የአምሳ አለቃውንም፥ ከበርቴውንም፥ አማካሪውንም፥ ብልሁንም ሠራተኛ፥ አስማት አዋቂውንም ይነቅላል።

verses.text_english: And I will give children their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቻቸው እንዲሆኑ ብላቴኖችን አስነሣባቸዋለሁ፥ ሕፃናቶችም ይገዙአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም፥ ሰው በሰው ላይ ሰውም በባልንጀራው ላይ፥ ይገፋፋል፤ ብላቴናውም በሽማግሌው ላይ የተጠቃውም በከበርቴው ላይ ይኰራል።

verses.text_english: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, , Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and this ruin under thy hand:
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም በአባቱ ቤት ውስጥ ወንድሙን ይዞ። አንተ ልብስ አለህ አለቃም ሁንልን ይህችም ባድማ ከእጅህ በታች ትሁን ሲለው፥

verses.text_english: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ። እኔ በቤቴ ውስጥ እንጀራ ወይም ልብስ የለኝምና ባለ መድኃኒት አልሆንም፤ በሕዝቡም ላይ አለቃ አታደርጉኝም ይላል።

verses.text_english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.text_amharic: የክብሩን ዓይን ያስቈጡ ዘንድ ምላሳቸውና ሥራቸው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ነውና ኢየሩሳሌም ተፈታች ይሁዳም ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
verses.text_amharic: የፊታቸውም እፍረት ይመሰክርባቸዋል፤ እንደ ሰዶምም ኃጢአታቸውን ያወራሉ፥ አይሠውሩአትም። በራሳቸው ላይ ክፉ ነገርን ሠርተዋልና ለነፍሳቸው ወዮ!

verses.text_english: Say ye to the righteous, that well : for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.text_amharic: የሥራቸውን ፍሬ ይበላሉና ጻድቁን። መልካም ይሆንልሃል በሉት።

verses.text_english: Woe unto the wicked! ill : for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እጁ ሥራ ፍዳው ይደረግበታልና ለበደለኛ ወዮ! ክፉም ደርሶበታል።

verses.text_english: my people, children their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤንስ አስገባሪዎቻቸው ይገፉአቸዋል፥ አስጨናቂዎችም ይሠለጥኑባቸዋል። ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ የመሩአችሁ ያስቱአችኋል የምትሄዱበትንም መንገድ ያጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለፍርድ ተነሥቶአል በሕዝቡም ላይ ሊፈርድ ቆሞአል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor in your houses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችና ከአለቆቻቸው ጋር ይፋረዳል፤ የወይኑን ቦታ የጨረሳችሁ እናንተ ናችሁ፤ ከድሆች የበዘበዛችሁት በቤታችሁ አለ፤

verses.text_english: What mean ye ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤንም ለምን ታደቅቁአቸዋላችሁ? የድሆችንስ ፊት ለምን ትፈጫላችሁ? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። የጽዮን ቈነጃጅት ኰርተዋልና፥ አንገታቸውንም እያሰገጉ በዓይናቸውም እያጣቀሱ፥ ፈንጠርም እያሉ፥ በእግራቸውም እያቃጨሉ ይሄዳሉና

verses.text_english: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ የጽዮንን ቈነጃጅት አናት በቡሀነት ይመታል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ኀፍረተ ሥጋቸውን ይገልጣል።

verses.text_english: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of tinkling ornaments , and cauls, and round tires like the moon,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ጌታ የእግር አልቦውን ክብር፥ መርበብንም፥ ጨረቃ የሚመስለውንም ጌጥ፥ የጆሮ እንጥልጥሉንም፥

verses.text_english: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
verses.text_amharic: አንባሩንም፥ መሸፈኛውንም፥ ቀጸላውንም፥

verses.text_english: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
verses.text_amharic: ሰንሰለቱንም፥ መቀነቱንም፥ የሽቱውንም ዕቃ፥

verses.text_english: The rings, and nose jewels,
verses.text_amharic: አሸንክታቡንም፥ የእጅና የአፍንጫ ቀለበቱንም፥

verses.text_english: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
verses.text_amharic: የዓመት በዓልንም ልብስ፥ መጐናጸፊያውንም፥ ልግምበገላውንም፥ ከረጢቱንም፥

verses.text_english: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
verses.text_amharic: መስተዋቱንም፥ ከጥሩ በፍታ የተሰራውንም ልብስ፥ ራስ ማሰሪያውንም፥ ዓይነ ርግቡንም ያስወግዳል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; burning instead of beauty.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ በሽቱ ፋንታ ግማት፥ በመታጠቂያውም ፋንታ ገመድ፥ ጠጕርንም በመንቀስ ፋንታ ቡሀነት፥ በመጐናጸፊያ ፋንታ ማቅ፥ በውበትም ፋንታ ጠባሳ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሶችሽ በሰይፍ፥ ኃያላንሽም በውጊያ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she desolate shall sit upon the ground.
verses.text_amharic: በሮችዋ ያዝናሉ ያለቅሱማል፤ እርስዋም ብቻዋን በምድር ላይ ትቀመጣለች።

verses.text_english: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሰባት ሴቶች። የገዛ እንጀራችንን እንበላለን የገዛ ልብሳችንንም እንለብሳለን፤ ስምህ ብቻ በእኛ ላይ ይጠራ፥ መሰደባችንንም አርቅ ብለው አንዱን ወንድ ይይዙታል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጥቋጥ ለጌጥና ለክብር ይሆናል፥ ከእስራኤልም ወገን ላመለጡ ሰዎች የምድሪቱን ፍሬ ለትምክሕትና ለውበት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, left in Zion, and remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም የጽዮንን ቈነጃጅት እድፍ ባጠበ ጊዜ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ደም በፍርድ መንፈስና በሚያቃጥል መንፈስ ከመካከልዋ ባነጻ ጊዜ፥ በጽዮን የቀረ በኢየሩሳሌምም የተረፈ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ለሕይወት የተጻፈ ሁሉ፥ ቅዱስ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory a defence.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ባለ ማደሪያ ሁሉ በጉባኤአቸውም ላይ በቀን ዳመናንና ጢስን በሌሊትም የሚቃጠለውን የእሳት ብርሃን ይፈጥራል፤ በክብርም ሁሉ ላይ መጋረጃ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.text_amharic: በቀን ከሙቀት ለጥላ፥ ከዐውሎ ነፋስና ከዝናብም ለመጠጊያና ለመሸሸጊያ ጎጆ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ስለ ወዳጄና ስለ ወይን ቦታው ለወዳጄ ቅኔ እቀኛለሁ። ለወዳጄ በፍሬያማው ኮረብታ ላይ የወይን ቦታ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያው ቈፈረ፥ ድንጋዮችንም ለቅሞ አወጣ፥ ምርጥ የሆነውንም አረግ ተከለበት፥ በመካከሉም ግንብ ሠራ፥ ደግሞም የመጥመቂያ ጕድጓድ ማሰበት፤ ወይንንም ያፈራ ዘንድ ተማመነ፥ ዳሩ ግን ሆምጣጣ ፍሬ አፈራ።

verses.text_english: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እናንተ በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ በእኔና በወይኑ ቦታዬ መካከል እስኪ ፍረዱ።

verses.text_english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.text_amharic: ለወይኔ ያላደረግሁለት፥ ከዚህ ሌላ አደርግለት ዘንድ የሚገባኝ ምንድር ነው? ወይንን ያፈራል ብዬ ስትማመን ስለ ምን ሆምጣጣ ፍሬ አፈራ?

verses.text_english: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በወይኔ ላይ የማደርገውን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ አጥሩን እነቅላለሁ፥ ለማሰማርያም ይሆናል፤ ቅጥሩንም አፈርሳለሁ፥ ለመራገጫም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ባድማ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አይቈረጥም፥ አይኰተኰትም፤ ኵርንችትና እሾህ ይበቅልበታል፤ ዝናብንም እንዳያዘንቡበት ዳመናዎችን አዝዛለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ወይን ቦታ እርሱ የእስራኤል ቤት ነው፥ የደስታውም አትክልት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ናቸው፤ ፍርድን ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር፥ እነሆም ደም ማፍሰስ ሆነ፤ ጽድቅንም ይተማመን ነበር፥ እነሆም፥ ጩኸት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto them that join house to house, lay field to field, till no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.text_amharic: ስፍራ እስከማይቀር ድረስ እናንተም በምድር ላይ ብቻችሁን እስክትቀመጡ ድረስ፥ ቤትን ከቤት ጋር ለሚያያይዙ እርሻንም ከእርሻ ጋር ለሚያቀራርቡ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: In mine ears the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በጆሮዬ እንዲህ አለ። በእውነት ብዙ ታላቅና መልካም ቤት ባድማ ይሆናል፥ የሚቀመጥበትም አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.text_amharic: ከወይኑ ቦታ አሥር ጥማድ በሬ ካረሰው አንድ የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ብቻ ይወጣል፤ አንድ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ዘር አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ብቻ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, wine inflame them!
verses.text_amharic: ስካርን ለመከተል በጥዋት ለሚማልዱ፥ የወይን ጠጅም እስኪያቃጥላቸው እስከ ሌሊት ድረስ ለሚዘገዩ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.text_amharic: መሰንቆና በገና ከበሮና እምቢልታም የወይን ጠጅም በግብዣቸው አለ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ግን አልተመለከቱም፥ እጁም ያደረገችውን አላስተዋሉም።

verses.text_english: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because no knowledge: and their honourable men famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሕዝቤ ወደ ምርኮ ሄዱ፥ ጌታን አላወቁትምና፤ ከበርቴዎቻቸውም ተራቡ፥ ሕዝባቸውም ተጠሙ።

verses.text_english: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.text_amharic: ሲኦልም ሆድዋን አስፍታለች፥ አፍዋንም ያለ ልክ ከፍታለች፤ ከበርቴዎቻቸውና አዛውንቶቻቸው ባለጠጎቻቸውም ደስተኞቻቸውም ወደ እርስዋ ይወርዳሉ።

verses.text_english: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ይጐሰቍላል፥ ሰውም ይዋረዳል፥ የትዕቢተኞችም ዓይን ትዋረዳለች፤

verses.text_english: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ግን በፍርድ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአል፥ ቅዱሱም አምላክ በጽድቅ ተቀድሶአል።

verses.text_english: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.text_amharic: የበግ ጠቦቶች በማሰማርያቸው ውስጥ ይሰማራሉ፥ እንግዶችም የሰቡትን ባድማ ይበላሉ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.text_amharic: በደልን በምናምንቴ ገመድ፥ ኃጢአትንም በሰረገላ ማሰሪያ ወደ ራሳቸው ለሚስቡ። እናይ ዘንድ ይቸኵል፥

verses.text_english: That say, Let him make speed, hasten his work, that we may see : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know !
verses.text_amharic: ሥራውንም ያፋጥን፤ እናውቃትም ዘንድ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ምክር ትቅረብ፥ ትምጣ ለሚሉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.text_amharic: ክፉውን መልካም መልካሙን ክፉ ለሚሉ፥ ጨለማውን ብርሃን ብርሃኑንም ጨለማ ለሚያደርጉ፥ ጣፋጩን መራራ መራራውንም ጣፋጭ ለሚያደርጉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Woe unto wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.text_amharic: በዓይናቸው ጥበበኞች በነፍሳቸውም አስተዋዮች ለሆኑ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Woe unto mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.text_amharic: የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጣት ኃያላን የሚያሰክረውንም ለማደባለቅ ጨካኞች ለሆኑ፤

verses.text_english: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.text_amharic: በደለኛውን ስለ ጉቦ ጻድቅ ለሚያደርጉ፥ የጻድቁንም ጽድቅ ለሚያስወግዱበት ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእሳት ወላፈን ቃርሚያን እንደሚበላ፥ እብቅም በነበልባል ውስጥ እንደሚጠፋ፥ እንዲሁ የእነርሱ ሥር የበሰበሰ ይሆናል ቡቃያቸውም እንደ ትቢያ ይበንናል፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ጥለዋልና፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ የተናገረውን ቃል አቃልለዋልና።

verses.text_english: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand stretched out still.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነድዶአል እጁንም በላያቸው ዘርግቶ መትቶአቸዋል፤ ተራሮችም ተንቀጠቀጡ፥ ሬሳቸውም በአደባባይ መካከል እንደ ጕድፍ ሆኖአል። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.text_amharic: ለአሕዛብም በሩቅ ምልክትን ያቆማል፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ በፉጨት ይጠራቸዋል፤ እነሆም፥ እየተጣደፉ ፈጥነው ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.text_amharic: ደካማና ስንኵል የለባቸውም፥ የሚያንቀላፋና የሚተኛም የለም፤ የወገባቸውም መቀነት አይፈታም፥ የጫማቸውም ማዘቢያ አይበጠስም።

verses.text_english: Whose arrows sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጾቻቸው ተስለዋል፥ ቀስቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ተለጥጠዋል፤ የፈረሶቻቸውም ኮቴ እንደ ቡላድ የሰረገሎቻቸውም መንኰራኵር እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይቈጠራል።

verses.text_english: Their roaring like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry away safe, and none shall deliver .
verses.text_amharic: ጩኸታቸው እንደ አንበሳ ነው፥ እንደ አንበሳ ደቦሎችም ያገሣሉ፤ ንጥቂያንም ይዘው ያገሣሉ፥ ይወስዱትማል፥ የሚያድንም የለም።

verses.text_english: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if look unto the land, behold darkness sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንደ ባሕር መትመም ይተምሙባቸዋል፤ ወደ ምድርም ቢመለከቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ጨለማና መከራ አለ፤ ብርሃንም በደመናዎችዋ ውስጥ ጨልሞአል።

verses.text_english: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ዖዝያን በሞተበት ዓመት እግዚአብሔርን በረጅምና ከፍ ባለ ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ አየሁት፥ የልብሱም ዘርፍ መቅደሱን ሞልቶት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.text_amharic: ሱራፌልም ከእርሱ በላይ ቆመው ነበር፥ ለእያንዳንዱም ስድስት ክንፍ ነበረው፤ በሁለት ክንፍ ፊቱን ይሸፍን ነበር፥ በሁለቱም ክንፍ እግሮቹን ይሸፍን ነበር፥ በሁለቱም ክንፍ ይበር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, the LORD of hosts: the whole earth full of his glory.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ለአንዱ። ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ምድር ሁሉ ከክብሩ ተሞልታለች እያለ ይጮኽ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.text_amharic: የመድረኩም መሠረት ከጭዋኺው ድምፅ የተነሣ ተናወጠ፥ ቤቱንም ጢስ ሞላበት።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Woe me! for I am undone; because I a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ከንፈሮቼ የረከሱብኝ ሰው በመሆኔ፥ ከንፈሮቻቸውም በረከሱባቸው ሕዝብ መካከል በመቀመጤ ዓይኖቼ የሠራዊትን ጌታ ንጉሡን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ አዩ ጠፍቻለሁና ወዮልኝ! አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.text_amharic: ከሱራፌልም አንዱ እየበረረ ወደ እኔ መጣ፥ በእጁም ከመሠዊያው በጕጠት የወሰደው ፍም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he laid upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
verses.text_amharic: አፌንም ዳሰሰበትና። እነሆ፥ ይህ ከንፈሮችህን ነክቶአል፤ በደልህም ከአንተ ተወገደ፥ ኃጢአትህም ተሰረየልህ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here I; send me.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታንም ድምፅ። ማንን እልካለሁ? ማንስ ይሄድልናል? ሲል ሰማሁ። እኔም። እነሆኝ፥ እኔን ላከኝ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሂድ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ። መስማትን ትሰማላችሁ አታስተውሉምም፤ ማየትንም ታያላችሁ አትመለከቱምም በላቸው።

verses.text_english: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ፥ በጆሮአቸውም እንዳይሰሙ፥ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ፥ ተመልሰውም እንዳይፈወሱ፥ የዚህን ሕዝብ ልብ አደንድን፥ ጆሮአቸውንም አደንቍር፥ ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍን አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው? አልሁ። እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ከተሞች የሚኖርባቸውን አጥተው እስኪፈርሱ ድረስ፥ ቤቶችም ሰው አልቦ እስኪሆኑ ምድርም ፈጽሞ ባድማ ሆና እስክትቀር ድረስ፥

verses.text_english: And the LORD have removed men far away, and a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰዎችን እስኪያርቅ፥ በምድርም መካከል ውድማው መሬት እስኪበዛ ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: But yet in it a tenth, and shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance in them, when they cast the holy seed the substance thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋም ዘንድ አሥረኛ እጅ ቀርቶ እንደ ሆነ እርሱ ደግሞ ይቃጠላል፤ በተቈረጡ ጊዜ ጉቶቻቸው እንደ ቀሩ እንደ ግራርና እንደ ኮምበል ዛፍ ሆኖ፥ ጉቶው የተቀደሰ ዘር ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዖዝያን ልጅ በኢዮአታም ልጅ በአካዝ ዘመን የሶርያ ንጉሥ ረአሶን የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ ኢየሩሳሌምን ሊወጉ ወጡ፥ ሊያሸንፉአትም አልቻሉም።

verses.text_english: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.text_amharic: ለዳዊትም ቤት። ሶርያ ከኤፍሬም ጋር ተባብረዋል የሚል ወሬ ተነገረ፤ የእርሱም ልብ የሕዝቡም ልብ የዱር ዛፍ በነፋስ እንድትናወጥ ተናወጠ።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shearjashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኢሳይያስን አለው። አንተና ልጅህ ያሱብ አካዝን ትገናኙት ዘንድ በልብስ አጣቢው እርሻ መንገድ ወዳለው ወደ ላይኛው የኵሬ መስኖ ጫፍ ውጡ፤

verses.text_english: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በለው። ተጠበቅ፥ ዝምም በል፤ ስለ እነዚህ ስለሚጤሱ ስለ ሁለት የእንጨት ጠለሸቶች፥ ስለ ሶርያና ስለ ረአሶን ስለ ሮሜልዩም ልጅ ቍጣ አትፍራ፥ ልብህም አይድከም።

verses.text_english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, the son of Tabeal:
verses.text_amharic: ሶርያና ኤፍሬም የሮሜልዩም ልጅ። ወደ ይሁዳ እንውጣ እናስጨንቀውም፥ እንስበረውም፥ የጣብኤልንም ልጅ እናንግሥበት ብለው ክፋት ስለ መከሩብህ፤

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ምክር አይጸናምና አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: For the head of Syria Damascus, and the head of Damascus Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.text_amharic: የሶርያ ራስ ደማስቆ ነው፥ የደማስቆም ራስ ረአሶን ነው፤ በስድሳ አምስት ዓመት ውስጥ ኤፍሬም ይሰባበራልና ሕዝብ አይሆንም፤

verses.text_english: And the head of Ephraim Samaria, and the head of Samaria Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬምም ራስ ሰማርያ ነው፥ የሰማርያም ራስ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ነው። ባታምኑ አትጸኑም።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ አካዝን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥልቁ ወይም ከከፍታው ቢሆን ከአምላክህ ከእግዚአብሔር ምልክትን ለምን።

verses.text_english: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም። አልለምንም፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አልፈታተንም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። እናንተ የዳዊት ቤት ሆይ፥ ስሙ፤ በውኑ ሰውን ማድከማችሁ ቀላል ነውን? አምላኬን ደግሞ የምታደክሙ፤

verses.text_english: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ ራሱ ምልክት ይሰጣችኋል፤ እነሆ፥ ድንግል ትፀንሳለች፥ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልዳለች፥ ስሙንም አማኑኤል ብላ ትጠራዋለች።

verses.text_english: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉን ለመጥላት መልካሙንም ለመምረጥ ሲያውቅ ቅቤና ማር ይበላል።

verses.text_english: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃኑ ክፉን ለመጥላት መልካሙን ለመምረጥ ሳያውቅ የፈራሃቸው የሁለቱ ነገሥታት አገር ባድማ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ኤፍሬም ከይሁዳ ከተለየበት ቀን ጀምሮ ያልመጣውን ዘመን በአንተና በሕዝብህ በአባትህም ቤት ላይ ያመጣል፤ እርሱም የአሦር ንጉሥ መምጣት ነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the LORD shall hiss for the fly that in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that in the land of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር በግብጽ ወንዝ ዳርቻ ያለውን ዝምብ በአሦርም አገር ያለውን ንብ በፉጨት ይጠራል።

verses.text_english: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.text_amharic: ይመጡማል፥ እነርሱም ሁሉ በበረሃ ሸለቆ በድንጋይም ዋሻ ውስጥ በእሾህ ቍጥቋጦ ሁሉ ላይ በማሰማርያውም ሁሉ ላይ ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, , by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ከወንዙ ማዶ በተከራየው ምላጭ በአሦር ንጉሥ የራሱንና የእግሩን ጠጕር ይላጨዋል፤ ምላጩም ጢሙን ደግሞ ይበላል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ሰው አንዲት ጊደርን ሁለት በጎችንም ያሳድጋል፤

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚሰጡት ወተት ብዛት የተነሣ ቅቤ ይበላል፤ በአገሪቱም መካከል የቀረ ሁሉ ቅቤና ማር ይበላል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall be for briers and thorns.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ሺህ ብር የተገመተ ሺህ የወይን ግንድ በነበረበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ለኵርንችትና ለእሾህ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: With arrows and with bows shall come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.text_amharic: ኵርንችትና እሾህ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ነውና በፍላጻና በቀስት ወደዚያ ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: And all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.text_amharic: በመቈፈርያም ወደ ተቈፈሩ ኮረብቶች ሁሉ ከኵርንችትና እሾህ ፍርሃት የተነሣ ወደዚያ አትሄድም፤ ነገር ግን የበሬ ማሰማርያና የበግ መራገጫ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ታላቅ ሰሌዳ ወስደህ። ምርኮ ፈጠነ፥ ብዝበዛ ቸኰለ ብለህ በሰው ፊደል ጻፍበት።

verses.text_english: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.text_amharic: የታመኑትን ሰዎች ካህኑን ኦርዮንና የበራክዩን ልጅ ዘካርያስን ምስክሮች አድርግልኝ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ነቢይቱም ቀረብሁ፤ እርስዋም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች።

verses.text_english: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ሕፃኑ አባቱንና እናቱን መጥራት ሳያውቅ የደማስቆን ሀብትና የሰማርያን ምርኮ በአሦር ንጉሥ ፊት ይወስዳልና ስሙን። ምርኮ ፈጠነ፥ ብዝበዛ ቸኰለ ብለህ ጥራው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ተናገረኝ እንዲህም አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ በቀስታ የሚሄደውን የሰሊሆምን ውኃ ጠልቶአልና፥ ረአሶንንና የሮሜልዩንም ልጅ ወዶአልና ስለዚህ፥

verses.text_english: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ብርቱና ብዙ የሆነውን የወንዝ ውኃ፥ የአሦርን ንጉሥና ክብሩን ሁሉ፥ ያመጣባቸዋል፤ መስኖውንም ሁሉ ሞልቶ ይወጣል፥ በዳሩም ሁሉ ላይ ይፈስሳል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.text_amharic: እየጐረፈም ወደ ይሁዳ ይገባል፤ እያጥለቀለቀም ያልፋል፥ እስከ አንገትም ይደርሳል፤ አማኑኤል ሆይ፥ የክንፉ መዘርጋት የአገርህን ስፋት ትሞላለች።

verses.text_english: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ እወቁና ደንግጡ፤ እናንተም ምድራችሁ የራቀ ሁሉ፥ አድምጡ፤ ታጠቁም፥ ደንግጡ፤ ታጠቁ፤ ደንግጡ።

verses.text_english: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God with us.
verses.text_amharic: ተመካከሩ፥ ምክራችሁም ይፈታል፤ ቃሉን ተናገሩ፥ ቃሉም አይጸናም፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ነውና።

verses.text_english: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በጽኑ እጅ እንዲህ ተናገረኝ፥ በዚህም ሕዝብ መንገድ አንዳልሄድ አስጠነቀቀኝ፥ እንዲህም አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ። ዱለት ነው በሚሉት ሁሉ። ዱለት ነው አትበሉ፤ መፈራታቸውንም አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡ።

verses.text_english: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and him your fear, and him your dread.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን ቀድሱት፤ የሚያስፈራችሁና የሚያስደነግጣችሁም እርሱ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ለመቅደስ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን ለሁለቱ ለእስራኤል ቤቶች ለዕንቅፋት ድንጋይና ለማሰናከያ ዓለት፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ለወጥመድና ለአሽክላ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙዎችም በእርሱ ይሰናከላሉ፥ ይወድቁማል፥ ይሰበሩማል፥ ይጠመዱማል፥ ይያዙማል።

verses.text_english: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክሩን እሰር፤ በደቀ መዛሙርቶቼም መካከል ሕጉን አትም።

verses.text_english: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብም ቤት ፊቱን የመለሰውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠብቃለሁ፥ እተማመንበትማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔና እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝ ልጆች ለእስራኤል በጽዮን ተራራ ከሚኖረው ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክትና ተአምራት ነን።

verses.text_english: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። የሚጮኹትንና ድምፃቸውን ዝቅ አድርገው የሚናገሩትን መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ጠይቁ ባሉአችሁ ጊዜ፥ ሕዝቡ ከአምላኩ መጠየቅ አይገባውምን? ወይስ ለሕያዋን ሲሉ ሙታንን ይጠይቃሉን?

verses.text_english: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, because no light in them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሕግና ወደ ምስክር ሂዱ! እንዲህም ያለውን ቃል ባይናገሩ ንጋት አይበራላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ተጨንቀውና ተርበው ያልፋሉ፤ በተራቡም ጊዜ ተቈጥተው ንጉሣቸውንና አምላካቸውን ይረግማሉ፥ ወደ ላይም ይመለከታሉ፤

verses.text_english: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and driven to darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምድርም ይመለከታሉ፥ እነሆም፥ መከራና ጨለማ የሚያስጨንቅም ጭጋግ አለ፤ ወደ ድቅድቅም ጨለማ ይሰደዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the dimness not such as in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ተጨንቃ ለነበረች ጨለማ አይሆንም። በመጀመሪያው ዘመን የዛብሎንንና የንፍታሌምን ምድር አቃለለ፤ በኋለኛው ዘመን ግን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በባሕር መንገድ ያለውን የአሕዛብን ገሊላ ያከብራል።

verses.text_english: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.text_amharic: በጨለማ የሄደ ሕዝብ ብርሃን አየ፤ በሞት ጥላ አገርም ለኖሩ ብርሃን ወጣላቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast multiplied the nation, not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, as rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብን አብዝተሃል፥ ደስታንም ጨምረህላቸዋል፤ በመከር ደስ እንደሚላቸው፥ ሰዎችም ምርኮን ሲካፈሉ ደስ እንደሚላቸው በፊትህ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
verses.text_amharic: በምድያም ጊዜ እንደ ሆነ የሸክሙን ቀንበር የጫንቃውንም በትር የአስጨናቂውንም ዘንግ ሰብረሃል።

verses.text_english: For every battle of the warrior with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but shall be with burning fuel of fire.
verses.text_amharic: የሚረግጡ የሰልፈኞች ጫማ ሁሉ፥ በደምም የተለወሰ ልብስ ለቃጠሎ ይሆናል፥ እንደ እሳት ማቃጠያም ሆኖ ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃን ተወልዶልናልና፥ ወንድ ልጅም ተሰጥቶናልና፤ አለቅነትም በጫንቃው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ስሙም ድንቅ መካር፥ ኃያል አምላክ፥ የዘላለም አባት፥ የሰላም አለቃ ተብሎ ይጠራል።

verses.text_english: Of the increase of government and peace no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ በፍርድና በጽድቅ ያጸናውና ይደግፈው ዘንድ በዳዊት ዙፋንና በመንግሥቱ ላይ አለቅነቱ ይበዛል፥ ለሰላሙም ፍፃሜ የለውም። የእግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት ይህን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ በያዕቆብ ላይ ቃልን ሰደደ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: And all the people shall know, Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change cedars.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ተቋቋሚ ያስነሣበታል፥

verses.text_english: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቹን ሶርያውያንንም ከምሥራቅ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ከምዕራብ ያንቀሳቅስበታል፤ እስራኤልንም በተከፈተ አፍ ይበሉታል። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand stretched out still.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡ ግን ወደ ቀሠፋቸው አልተመለሱም፥ የሠራዊትንም ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈለጉም።

verses.text_english: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ራስና ጅራትን፥ የሰሌኑን ቅርንጫፍና እንግጫውን በአንድ ቀን ከእስራኤል ይቆርጣል።

verses.text_english: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌውና ከበርቴው እርሱ ራስ ነው፤ በሐሰትም የሚያስተምር ነቢይ እርሱ ጅራት ነው።

verses.text_english: The ancient and honourable, he the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he the tail.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሕዝብ የሚመሩ ያስቱአቸዋል፤ ተመሪዎቹም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: For the leaders of this people cause to err; and led of them destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ ዝንጉና ክፉ ሠሪ ነውና፥ አፍም ሁሉ ስንፍናን ይናገራልና ስለዚህ ጌታ በጕልማሶቻቸው ደስ አይለውም፥ ለድሀ አደጎቻቸውና ለመበለቶቻቸውም አይራራም። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand stretched out still.
verses.text_amharic: ክፋት እንደ እሳት ይቃጠላል፤ ኵርንችቱንና እሾሁን ይበላል፤ ጭፍቅ የሆነውንም ዱር ያቃጥላል፥ ጢሱም ተትጐልጕሎ እንደ ዓምድ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up the lifting up of smoke.
verses.text_amharic: በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ምድር ተቃጥላለች፤ ሕዝቡም እሳት እንደሚበላው እንጨት ሆኖአል፤ ሰውም ለወንድሙ አይራራም።

verses.text_english: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በቀኙ በኩል ይነቅላል ይራብማል፤ በግራም በኩል ይበላል አይጠግብምም፤ እያንዳንዱም የክንዱን ሥጋ ይበላል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.text_amharic: ምናሴ ኤፍሬምን ኤፍሬምም ምናሴን ይበላል፤ እነርሱ በአንድነት የይሁዳ ጠላቶች ይሆናሉ። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness they have prescribed;
verses.text_amharic: [see v2]

verses.text_english: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and they may rob the fatherless!
verses.text_amharic: መበለቶችም ቅሚያቸው እንዲሆኑ፥ ድሀ አደጎችንም ብዝበዛቸው እንዲያደርጉ፥ የድሀውን ፍርድ ያጣምሙ ዘንድ፥ የችግረኛውንም ሕዝቤን ፍርድ ያጐድሉ ዘንድ የግፍን ትእዛዛት ለሚያዝዙ፥ ክፉንም ጽሕፈት ለሚጽፉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
verses.text_amharic: በተጎበኛችሁበት ቀን፥ መከራም ከሩቅ በሚመጣበት ዘመን ምን ታደርጉ ይሆን? ለረድኤትስ ወደ ማን ትሸሻላችሁ? ክብራችሁንስ ወዴት ትተዉታላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand stretched out still.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስረኞች በታች ይጐነበሳሉ፥ ከተገደሉትም በታች ይወድቃሉ። በዚህም ሁሉ እንኳ ቍጣው አልተመለሰችም፥ ነገር ግን እጁ ገና ተዘርግታ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
verses.text_amharic: ለቍጣዬ በትር ለሆነ፥ የመዓቴም ጨንገር በእጁ ላለ ለአሦር ወዮለት!

verses.text_english: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም በዝንጉ ሕዝብ ላይ እልካለሁ፥ ምርኮውንና ብዝበዛውንም ይወስድ ዘንድ እንደ አደባባይም ጭቃ የተረገጡ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ በምቈጣቸው ሰዎች ላይ አዝዘዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እንዲሁ አያስብም፥ በልቡም እንዲህ አይመስለውም፤ ነገር ግን ማጥፋት፥ ጥቂት ያይደሉትንም አሕዛብን መቍረጥ በልቡ አለ።

verses.text_english: For he saith, not my princes altogether kings?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ይላል። መሳፍንቴ ሁሉ ነገሥታት አይደሉምን? ካልኖ እንደ ከርከሚሽ አይደለችምን?

verses.text_english: not Calno as Carchemish? not Hamath as Arpad? not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.text_amharic: ሐማትስ እንደ አርፋድ አይደለችምን? ሰማርያስ እንደ ደማስቆ አይደለችምን?

verses.text_english: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.text_amharic: የተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸው ከኢየሩሳሌምና ከሰማርያ ምስሎች የበለጡትን የጣዖቶችን መንግሥታት እጄ እንዳገኘች፥

verses.text_english: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.text_amharic: በሰማርያና በጣዖቶችዋም እንዳደረግሁ፥ እንዲሁስ በኢየሩሳሌምና በጣዖቶችዋ አላደርግምን?

verses.text_english: Wherefore it shall come to pass, when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ጌታ ሥራውን ሁሉ በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ በፈጸመ ጊዜ የአሦርን ንጉሥ የኩሩ ልብ ፍሬን የዓይኑንም ከፍታ ትምክሕት ይጐበኛል።

verses.text_english: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done , and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant :
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እንዲህ ብሎአልና። አስተዋይ ነኝና በእጄ ኃይልና በጥበቤ አደረግሁት፤ የአሕዛብን ድንበሮች አራቅሁ፥ ሀብታቸውንም ዘረፍሁ፥ እንደ ጀግናም ሆኜ በምድር የተቀመጡትን አዋረድሁ፤

verses.text_english: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
verses.text_amharic: እጄም የአሕዛብን ኃይል እንደ ወፍ ቤት አገኘች፤ የተተወም እንቍላል እንደሚሰበሰብ እንዲሁ እኔ ምድርን ሁሉ ሰበሰብሁ፤ ክንፉን የሚያራግብ አፉንም የሚከፍት የሚጮኽም የለም።

verses.text_english: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake against them that lift it up, as if the staff should lift up no wood.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ መጥረቢያ በሚቈርጥበት ሰው ላይ ይመካልን? ወይስ መጋዝ በሚስበው ላይ ይጓደዳልን? ይህስ፥ በትር የሚያነሣውን እንደ መነቅነቅ ዘንግም እንጨት ያይደለውን እንደ ማንሣት ያህል ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በወፍራሞች ላይ ክሳትን ይልካል፤ ከክብሩም በታች ቃጠሎው እንደ እሳት መቃጠል ይነድዳል።

verses.text_english: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ብርሃን እንደ እሳት ቅዱስም እንደ ነበልባል ይሆናል፤ እሾሁንና ኵርንችቱን በአንድ ቀን ያቃጥላል ይበላውማል።

verses.text_english: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
verses.text_amharic: ከነፍስም እስከ ሥጋ ድረስ የዱሩንና የሚያፈራውን እርሻ ክብር ይበላል፤ ይህም የታመመ ሰው እንደሚሰለስል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

And it shall come to pass in that day, the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብም ቅሬታ ወደ ኃያል አምላክ ይምለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: The remnant shall return, the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ የሕዝብህ ቍጥር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ቢሆን ቅሬታው ይመለሳል። ጽድቅ የተትረፈረፈበትም ጥፋት ተወስኖአል።

verses.text_english: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ያለቀ የተቈረጠ ነገርን በምድር ሁሉ መካከል ይፈጽማል።

verses.text_english: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በጽዮን የምትኖር ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ አሦር በበትር ቢመታህ፥ ግብጽም እንዳደረገ ዘንጉን ቢያነሣብህ አትፍራው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬ እስኪፈጸም መዓቴም እስኪያጠፋቸው ድረስ ጥቂት ጊዜ ቀርቶአልና።

verses.text_english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ምድያምን በሔሬብ ዓለት በኩል እንደ መታው ጅራፍ ያነሣበታል፤ በትሩም በባሕር ላይ ይሆናል፥ በግብጽም እንዳደረገ ያነሣዋል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and his rod upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ሸክሙ ከጫንቃህ ቀንበሩም ከአንገትህ ላይ ይወርዳል፤ ቀንበሩም ከውፍረት የተነሣ ይሰበራል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንጋይ መጥቶአል፤ በመጌዶን በኩል አልፎአል፤ በማክማስ ውስጥ ዕቃውን አኑሮአል፤

verses.text_english: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
verses.text_amharic: በመተላለፊያ አልፎአል፤ በጌባ ማደሪያው ነው፤ ራማ ደንግጣለች፤ የሳኦል ጊብዓ ኰብልላለች።

verses.text_english: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የጋሊም ልጅ ሆይ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅሽ ጩኺ፤ ላይሳ ሆይ፥ አድምጪ፤ ዓናቶት ሆይ፥ መልሽላት።

verses.text_english: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
verses.text_amharic: መደቤና ሸሽታለች፤ በግቤርም የሚኖሩ ቤተ ሰቦቻቸውን አሽሽተዋል።

verses.text_english: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ በኖብ ይቆማል፤ በጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ተራራ በኢየሩሳሌም ኮረብታ ላይ እጁን ያንቀሳቅሳል።

verses.text_english: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ቅርንጫፎቹን በሚያስፈራ ኃይል ይቈርጣል፤ በቁመት የረዘሙትም ይቈረጣሉ፥ ከፍ ያሉትም ይዋረዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
verses.text_amharic: ጭፍቅ የሆነውንም ዱር በብረት ይቈርጣል፥ ሊባኖስም በኃያሉ እጅ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.text_amharic: ከእሴይ ግንድ በትር ይወጣል፥ ከሥሩም ቍጥቋጥ ያፈራል።

verses.text_english: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ፥ የጥበብና የማስተዋል መንፈስ፥ የምክርና የኃይል መንፈስ፥ የእውቀትና እግዚአብሔርን የመፍራት መንፈስ ያርፍበታል።

verses.text_english: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት ደስታውን ያያል። ዓይኑም እንደምታይ አይፈርድም፥ ጆሮውም እንደምትሰማ አይበይንም፤

verses.text_english: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለድሆች በጽድቅ ይፈርዳል፥ ለምድርም የዋሆች በቅንነት ይበይናል፤ በአፉም በትር ምድርን ይመታል፥ በከንፈሩም እስትንፋስ ክፉዎችን ይገድላል።

verses.text_english: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.text_amharic: የወገቡ መታጠቂያ ጽድቅ፥ የጎኑም መቀነት ታማኝነት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.text_amharic: ተኵላ ከበግ ጠቦት ጋር ይቀመጣል፥ ነብርም ከፍየል ጠቦት ጋር ይተኛል፤ ጥጃና የአንበሳ ደቦል ፍሪዳም በአንድነት ያርፋሉ፤ ታናሽም ልጅ ይመራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.text_amharic: ላምና ድብ አብረው ይሰማራሉ፥ ግልገሎቻቸውም በአንድነት ያርፋሉ፤ አንበሳም እንደ በሬ ገለባ ይበላል።

verses.text_english: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጠባውም ሕፃን በእባብ ጕድጓድ ላይ ይጫወታል፥ ጡት የጣለውም ሕፃን በእፉኝት ቤት ላይ እጁን ይጭናል።

verses.text_english: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ሁሉ ላይ አይጐዱም አያጠፉምም፤ ውኃ ባሕርን እንደሚከድን ምድር እግዚአብሔርን በማወቅ ትሞላለችና።

verses.text_english: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ለአሕዛብ ምልክት ሊሆን የቆመውን የእሴይን ሥር አሕዛብ ይፈልጉታል፤ ማረፊያውም የተከበረ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ የቀረውን የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ከአሦርና ከግብጽ፥ ከጳትሮስና ከኢትዮጵያ፥ ከኤላምና ከሰናዖር ከሐማትም፥ ከባሕርም ደሴቶች ይመልስ ዘንድ ጌታ እንደ ገና እጁን ይገልጣል።

verses.text_english: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሕዛብም ምልክትን ያቆማል፥ ከእስራኤልም የተጣሉትን ይሰበስባል፥ ከይሁዳም የተበተኑትን ከአራቱ የምድር ማዕዘኖች ያከማቻል።

verses.text_english: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬምም ምቀኝነት ይርቃል፥ ይሁዳንም የሚያስጨንቁ ይጠፋሉ፤ ኤፍሬምም በይሁዳ አይቀናም፥ ይሁዳም ኤፍሬምን አያስጨንቅም።

verses.text_english: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራብም በኩል በፍልስጥኤማውያን ጫንቃ ላይ እየበረሩ ይወርዳሉ፥ የምሥራቅንም ልጆች በአንድነት ይበዘብዛሉ፤ በኤዶምያስና በሞዓብም ላይ እጃቸውን ይዘረጋሉ፥ የአሞንም ልጆች ለእነርሱ ይታዘዛሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make go over dryshod.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የግብጽን ባሕር ያጠፋል፤ በትኩሱም ነፋስ እጁን በወንዙ ላይ ያነሣል፥ ሰባት ፈሳሾችንም አድርጎ ይመታዋል፥ ሰዎችም በጫማቸው እንዲሻገሩ ያደርጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽም በወጣ ጊዜ ለእስራኤል እንደ ነበረ፥ ለቀረው ለሕዝቡ ቅሬታ ከአሦር ጐዳና ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን። አቤቱ፥ ተቈጥተኸኛልና፥ ቍጣህንም ከእኔ መልሰሃልና፥ አጽናንተኸኛልምና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, God my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH my strength and song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አምላክ መድኃኒቴ ነው፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌና ዝማሬዬ ነውና፥ መድኃኒቴም ሆኖአልና በእርሱ ታምኜ አልፈራም ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውንም ከመድኃኒት ምንጮች በደስታ ትቀዳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ትላላችሁ። እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ስሙንም ጥሩ፤ በአሕዛብ መካከል ሥራውን አስታውቁ፤ ስሙ ከፍ ያለ እንደ ሆነ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this known in all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅ ሥራ ሠርቶአልና ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ፤ ይህንም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ አስታውቁ።

verses.text_english: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በጽዮን የምትኖሪ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ በመካከልሽ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ደስ ይበልሽ እልልም በዪ።

verses.text_english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ያየው ስለ ባቢሎን የተንገረ ሸክም።

verses.text_english: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.text_amharic: ምድረ በዳ በሆነ ተራራ ላይ ምልክትን አቁሙ፥ ድምፅንም ከፍ አድርጉባቸው፤ በአለቆችም ደጆች እንዲገቡ በእጅ ጥቀሱ።

verses.text_english: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬን ይፈጽሙ ዘንድ ቅዱሳኔን አዝዣለሁ፥ እኔ ኃያላኔንና በታላቅነቴ ደስ የሚላቸውን ጠርቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.text_amharic: በተራሮች ላይ እንደ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ድምፅ የሆነ የብዙ ሰው ድምፅ አለ። የከተማቹት የአህዛብ መንግሥታት የውካታ ጫጫታ አለ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሠራዊትን ለሰልፍ አሰልፎአል።

verses.text_english: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርና የቍጣው የጦር ዕቃ ምድርን ሁሉ ያጠፉአት ዘንድ ከሩቅ አገር ከሰማይ ዳርቻ ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቦአልና፥ አልቅሱ፤ ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ እንደሚመጣ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እጅ ሁሉ ትዝላለች፥ የሰውም ሁሉ ልብ ይቀልጣል።

verses.text_english: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces flames.
verses.text_amharic: ይደነግጣሉ፤ ምጥና ሕማም ይይዛቸዋል፥ እንደምትወልድ ሴትም ያምጣሉ፤ አንዱም በሌላው ይደነቃል፥ ፊታቸውም የነበልባል ፊት ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ምድሪቱን ባድማ ሊያደርግ፥ ኃጢአተኞችዋንም ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ሊያጠፋ ጨካኝ ሆኖ በመዓትና በጽኑ ቍጣ ተሞልቶ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይም ከዋክብትና ሠራዊቱ ብርሃናቸውን አይሰጡም፥ ፀሐይም በወጣች ጊዜ ትጨልማለች፥ ጨረቃም በብርሃኑ አያበራም።

verses.text_english: And I will punish the world for evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለሙን ስለ ክፋታቸው ክፉዎቹንም ስለ በደላቸው እቀጣለሁ፤ የትዕቢተኞችንም ኵራት አዋርዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ይልቅ የከበሩ ይሆናሉ፥ ሰውም ከኦፊር ወርቅ ይልቅ የከበረ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር መዓት በጽኑ ቍጣ ቀንም ሰማያትን አነቃንቃለሁ፥ ምድርም ከስፍራዋ ትናወጣለች።

verses.text_english: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተባረረም ሚዳቋ፥ ማንም እንደማይሰበስበው እንደ በግ መንጋ፥ ሰው ሁሉ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል፥ ሁሉም ወደ አገሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.text_english: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined shall fall by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: የተገኘ ሁሉ የተወጋ ይሆናል፥ የተያዘም ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃናቶቻቸውም በፊታቸው ይጨፈጨፋሉ፥ ቤቶቻቸውም ይበዘበዛሉ፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም ይነወራሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ብር የማይሹትን፥ ወርቅም የማያምራቸውን ሜዶናውያንን በላያቸው አስነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጾቻቸውም ጎበዞችን ይጨፈጭፋሉ፥ የማኅፀንንም ፍሬ አይምሩም፥ ዓይኖቻቸውም ለሕፃናት አይራሩም።

verses.text_english: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሰዶምንና ገሞራን ባፈረሰ ጊዜ እንደ ነበረው፥ የመንግሥታት ክብር የከለዳውያንም ትዕቢት ጌጥ ባቢሎን እንዲሁ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም የሚቀመጥባት አይገኝም፥ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ድረስ ሰው አይኖርባትም፤ ዓረባውያንም ድንኳንን በዚያ አይተክሉም፥ እረኞችም መንጎቻቸውን በዚያ አያሳርፉም።

verses.text_english: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ያርፋሉ፥ ጕጕቶችም በቤቶቻቸው ይሞላሉ፤ ሰጎኖችም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፥ በዚያም አጋንንት ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.text_english: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in pleasant palaces: and her time near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.text_amharic: ተኵላዎችም በግንቦቻቸው፥ ቀበሮችም በሚያማምሩ አዳራሾቻቸው ይጮኻሉ፤ ጊዜዋም ለመምጣት ቀርቦአል ቀንዋም አይዘገይም።

verses.text_english: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ያዕቆብን ይምረዋል፥ እስራኤልንም ደግሞ ይመርጠዋል፥ በአገራቸውም ያኖራቸዋል፤ መጻተኛም ከእርሱ ጋር ይተባበራል፥ ከያዕቆብም ቤት ጋር ይጣበቃል።

verses.text_english: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም ይዘው ወደ ስፍራቸው ያመጡአቸዋል፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት በእግዚአብሔር ምድር እንደ ሎሌዎችና እንደ ገረዶች አድርገው ይገዙአቸዋል፤ የማረኩአቸውን ይማርካሉ፥ አስጨናቂዎችንም ይገዛሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከኀዘንህና ከመከራህ ከተገዛህለትም ከጽኑ ባርነት ያሳርፍሃል።

verses.text_english: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ምሳሌ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ታነሣለህ እንዲህም ትላለህ። አስጨናቂ እንዴት ዐረፈ! አስገባሪም እንዴት ጸጥ አለ!

verses.text_english: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers.
He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, none hindereth.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብንም በመዓትና በማያቋርጥ መምታት የመታውን፥ አሕዛብንም ባልተከለከለ መከራ በቍጣው የገዛውን የኀጥኣንን በትር የአለቆችንም ዘንግ እግዚአብሔር ሰብሮአል።

verses.text_english: The whole earth is at rest, is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ሁሉ ዐርፋ በጸጥታ ተቀምጣለች እልልም ብላለች።

verses.text_english: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, the cedars of Lebanon, , Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.text_amharic: ጥድና የሊባኖስ ዝግባ። አንተ ከተዋረድህ ጀምሮ ማንም ይቈርጠን ዘንድ አልወጣብንም ብለው በአንተ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ሲኦል በመምጣትህ ልትገናኝህ በታች ታወከች፤ የሞቱትንም፥ የምድርን ታላላቆች ሁሉ፥ ለአንተ አንቀሳቀሰች፥ የአሕዛብንም ነገሥታት ሁሉ ከዙፋኖቻቸው አስነሣች።

verses.text_english: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ። አንተ ደግሞ እንደ እኛ ደክመሃልን? እኛንስ መስለሃልን? ጌጥህና የበገናህ ድምፅ ወደ ሲኦል ወረደ፤

verses.text_english: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.text_amharic: በበታችህም ብል ተነጥፎአል፥ ትልም መደረቢያህ ሆኖአል ብለው ይመልሱልሃል።

verses.text_english: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የንጋት ልጅ አጥቢያ ኮከብ ሆይ፥ እንዴት ከሰማይ ወደቅህ! አሕዛብንም ያዋረድህ አንተ ሆይ፥ እንዴት እስከ ምድር ድረስ ተቈረጥህ!

verses.text_english: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.text_amharic: አንተን በልብህ። ወደ ሰምይ ዐርጋለሁ፥ ዙፋኔንም ከእግዚአብሔር ከዋክብት በላይ ከፍ ከፍ አደርጋለሁ፥ በሰሜንም ዳርቻ በመሰብሰቢያ ተራራ ላይ እቀመጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳመናዎች ከፍታ በላይ ዐርጋለሁ፥ በልዑልም እመሰላለሁ አልህ።

verses.text_english: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወደ ሲኦል ወደ ጕድጓዱም ጥልቅ ትወርዳለህ።

verses.text_english: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, consider thee, this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዩህ ይመለከቱሃልና። በውኑ ምድርን ያንቀጠቀጠ፥ መንግሥታትንም ያናወጠ፥

verses.text_english: made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.text_amharic: ዓለሙን ሁሉ ባድማ ያደረገ፥ ከተሞችንም ያፈረሰ ምርከኞቹንም ወደ ቤታቸው ያልሰደደ ሰው ይህ ነውን? ብለው ያስተውሉሃል።

verses.text_english: All the kings of the nations, all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በየቤታቸው በክብር አንቀላፍተዋል።

verses.text_english: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን እንደ ተጠላ ቅርንጫፍ ከመቃብርህ ተጥለሃል፤ በሰይፍም የተወጉት፥ ተገድለውም ወደ ጕድጓዱ ድንጋዮች የወረዱት ከድነውሃል፤ እንደ ተረገጠም ሬሳ ሆነሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርህን አጥፍተሃልና፥ ሕዝብህንም ገድለሃልና ከእነርሱ ጋር በመቃብር በአንድነት አትሆንም፤ የክፉዎች ዘር ለዘላለም የተጠራ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይነሡም፥ ምድርንም እንዳይወርሱ፥ የዓለሙንም ፊት በከተሞች እንዳይሞሉ ስለ አባቶቻቸው በደል ለልጆቹ ሞትን አዘጋጁላቸው።

verses.text_english: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱ ላይ እነሣለሁ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ከባቢሎን ስምንና ቅሬታን፥ ዘርንና ትውልድንም እቈርጣለሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: የጃርት መኖርያ የውኃም መቋሚያ አደርጋታለሁ፤ በጥፋትም መጥረጊያ እጠርጋታለሁ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, shall it stand:
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ምሎአል። እንደ ተናገርሁ በእርግጥ ይሆናል፥ እንደ አሰብሁም እንዲሁ ይቆማል።

verses.text_english: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.text_amharic: አሦርን በምድሬ ላይ እሰብረዋለሁ፥ በተራራዬም ላይ እረግጠዋለሁ፤ ቀንበሩም ከእነርሱ ላይ ይነሣል፥ ሸክሙም ከጫንቃቸው ላይ ይወገዳል።

verses.text_english: This the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ሁሉ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ያሰበው አሳብ ይህ ነው፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተዘረጋች እጅ ይህች ናት።

verses.text_english: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul ? and his hand stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይህን አስቦአል፤ የሚያስጥለውስ ማን ነው? እጁም ተዘርግታለች፤ የሚመልሳትስ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ አካዝ በሞተበት ዓመት ይህ ሸክም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit a fiery flying serpent.
verses.text_amharic: ፍልስጥኤም ሆይ፥ ከእባቡ ሥር እፉኝት ይወጣልና፥ ፍሬውም የሚበርርና እሳት የሚመስል እባብ ይሆናልና የመታሽ በትር ስለ ተሰበረ ሁላችሁም ደስ አይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.text_amharic: የድሆችም የበኵር ልጆች ይሰማራሉ፥ ችግረኞችም ተዘልለው ይተኛሉ፤ ሥርህንም በራብ እገድላለሁ፥ ቅሬታህም ይገደላል።

verses.text_english: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none alone in his appointed times.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በር ሆይ፥ ወዮ በል አንቺም ከተማ ሆይ፥ ጩኺ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ሆይ፥ ሁላችሁም ቀልጣችኋል፤ ጢስ ከሰሜን ይመጣል ከጭፍራውም ተለይቶ የሚቀር የለም።

verses.text_english: What shall then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.text_amharic: ለሕዝቡም መልእክተኞች ምን ብሎ መመለስ ይገባል? እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን እንደ መሠረተ፥ የሕዝቡም ችግረኞች በእርስዋ ውስጥ እንደሚጠጉ ነው።

verses.text_english: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, brought to silence;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሞዓብ የተነገረ ሸክም። የሞዓብ ዔር በሌሊት ፈርሶ ጠፋ፤ ቂር የሚባልም የሞዓብ ምሽግ በሌሊት ፈርሶ ጠፋ።

verses.text_english: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads baldness, every beard cut off.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባይት ወደ ዲቦንም ወደ ኮረብታ መስገጃዎችም ለልቅሶ ወጥተዋል፤ ሞዓብ በናባው በሜድባ ላይ ታለቅሳለች፤ ራሳቸው ሁሉ ተነጭቶአል፥ ጢማቸውም ሁሉ ተላጭቶአል።

verses.text_english: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
verses.text_amharic: በየመገዳቸውም በማቅ ታጥቀዋል፤ በየሰገነቶቻቸውና በየአደባባዮቻቸው እንባ እጅግ እያፈሰሱ ሁሉም አልቅሰዋል።

verses.text_english: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሴቦንና ኤልያሊ ጮኹ፤ ድምፃቸው እስከ ያሀጽ ድረስ ይሰማል፤ ስለዚህ የሞዓብ ሰልፈኞች ጮኹ፤ ነፍስዋ በውስጥዋ ተንቀጠቀጠች።

verses.text_english: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ስለ ሞዓብ ጮኸ፤ ከእርስዋም የሚሸሹ ወደ ዞዓር ወደ ዔግላት ሺሊሺያ ኰበለሉ፤ በሉሒት ዓቀበት ላይ እያለቀሱ ይወጣሉ፥ በሖሮናይምም መንገድ የዋይታ ጩኸት ያነሣሉ።

verses.text_english: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
verses.text_amharic: የኔምሬም ውኆች ይደርቃሉ፤ ሣሩም ደርቋል፥ ለጋውም ጠውልጓል፥ ልምላሜውም ሁሉ የለም።

verses.text_english: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የሰበሰቡትን ሀብትና መዝገባቸውን ወደ አኻያ ዛፍ ወንዝ ማዶ ይወስዱታል።

verses.text_english: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
verses.text_amharic: ጩኸት የሞዓብን ዳርቻ ሁሉ ዞረ፤ ልቅሶዋም ወደ ኤግላይምና ወደ ብኤርኢሊም ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.text_amharic: የዲሞንም ውኃ ደም ተሞልታለች፤ በዲሞንም ላይ ሥቃይን እጨምራለሁ፥ ከሞዓባውያንም በሚያመልጡ፥ ከምድርም በሚቀሩ ላይ አንበሳን አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ላይ ለሠለጠነው አለቃ የበግ ጠቦቶችን በምድረ በዳ ካለችው ከሴላ ወደ ጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ተራራ ስደዱ።

verses.text_english: For it shall be, , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚበርር ወፍ እንደ ተበተኑም ጫጩቶች እንዲሁ የሞዓብ ሴቶች ልጆች በአርኖን መሻገሪያዎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.text_amharic: ምክርን ምከሪ፥ ፍርድን አድርጊ፥ በቀትር ጊዜ ጥላሽን እንደ ሌሊት አድርጊ፤ የተሰደዱትን ሸሽጊ፥ የሸሹትን አትግለጪ።

verses.text_english: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.text_amharic: ከሞዓብ የተሰደዱት ከአንቺ ጋር ይቀመጡ፤ ከሚያጠፋቸው ፊት መጋረጃ ሁኛቸው። የሚያስጨንቁ አልቀዋል፥ ጥፋትም ቀርቶአል፤ ይጨቍኑ የነበሩ ከምድር ጠፍተዋል።

verses.text_english: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ዙፋንም በምሕረት ይቀናል፥ በዚያም ላይ በዳዊት ድንኳን ፍርድን የሚሻ ጽድቅንም የሚያፈጥን ፈራጅ በእውነት ይቀመጣል

verses.text_english: We have heard of the pride of Moab; very proud: of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: his lies not so.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሞዓብ ትዕቢት እጅግ ስለ መታበዩ፥ ስለ ኵራቱና ስለ ትዕቢቱ ስለ ቍጣውም ሰምተናል፤ ትምሕክቱ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely stricken.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሞዓብ ስለ ሞዓብ ዋይ ይላል፤ ሁሉም ዋይ ይላል፤ ስለ ቂርሐራሴት መሠራት በጥልቅ ኀዘን ታለቅሳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For the fields of Heshbon languish, the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come unto Jazer, they wandered the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.text_amharic: የሐሴቦን እርሻዎችና የሴባማ ወይን ግንዶች አዝነዋል። የአሕዛብ አለቆች የሰባበሩአቸው ቅርንጫፎች እስከ ኢያዜር ደርሰው ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጥተው ነበር፤ ቍጥቋጦቹም ተዘርግተው ባሕርን ተሻግረው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በኢያዜር ልቅሶ ስለ ሴባማ ወይን ግንድ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ሐሴቦንና ኤልያሊ ሆይ፥ በዛፍሽ ፍሬና በወይንሽ መከር የጦር ጩኸት ወድቆአልና በእንባዬ አረካሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in presses; I have made shouting to cease.
verses.text_amharic: ደስታና ሐሤትም ከፍሬያማው እርሻ ተወስዶአል፥ በወይኑም ቦታዎች ዝማሬና እልልታ የለም፤ በመጥመቂያም ወይን የሚረግጥ የለም፤ የረጋጮቹን እልልታ አጥፍቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ልቤ ስለ ሞዓብ አንጀቴም ስለ ቂርሔሬስ እንደ መሰንቆ ትጮኻለች።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብም መጥቶ በኮረብታ መስገጃ ላይ በደከመና ለጸሎት ወደ መቅደሱ በገባ ጊዜ አያሸንፍም

verses.text_english: This the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሞዓብ ላይ በድሮ ዘመን የተናገረው ነገር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant very small feeble.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔር። በሦስት ዓመት ውስጥ እንደ ምንደኛ ዓመት የሞዓብ ክብርና የሕዝቡ ሁሉ ብዛት ይዋረዳል፥ ቅሬታውም እጅግ ያነሰና የተጠቃ ይሆናል ይላል።

verses.text_english: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ደማስቆ የተነገረ ሸክም። እነሆ፥ ደማስቆ ከተማ ከመሆን ተቋርጣለች፤ ባድማና የፍርስራሽ ክምር ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: The cities of Aroer forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞችዋ ለዘላለም የተፈቱ ይሆናሉ፤ ለመንጋ ማሰማሪያ ሆናሉ፤ መንጎች በዚያ ያርፋሉ የሚያስፈራቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ምሽግም ከኤፍሬም፥ መንግሥትም ከደማስቆ ተወገደች፤ የሶርያም ቅሬታ እንደ እስራኤል ልጆች ክብር ይሆናል ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And in that day it shall come to pass, the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ የያዕቆብ ክብር ይደክማል የሥጋውም ውፍረት ይከሳል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text_amharic: አጫጅ የቆመውን እህል በእጁ ሰብስቦ ዛላውን እንደሚያጭድ ይሆናል፤ በራፋይም ሸለቆ ቃርሚያ እንደሚለቅም እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ወይራ በተመታ ጊዜ ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ፍሬ በራሱ ላይ እንደሚቀር፥ አራት ወይም አምስት በዛፊቱ ጫፍ እንደሚገኝ፥ በእርሱ ዘንድ ቃርሚያ ይቀራል ይላል የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ሰው ወደ ፈጣሪው ይመለከታል፥ ዓይኖቹም ወደ እስራኤል ቅዱስ ያያሉ።

verses.text_english: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
verses.text_amharic: እጁም የሠራችውን መሠዊያ አይመለከትም፤ ጣቶቹም ወደ አበጁአቸው፥ ወደ ማምለኪያ ዐፀዶች ወይም ወደ ፀሐይ ምስሎች፥ አያይም።

verses.text_english: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት የአሞራውያንና የኤውያውያን ከተሞች እንደ ተፈቱ፥ እንዲሁ ከተሞችህ ይፈታሉ፥ ባድማም ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
verses.text_amharic: የደኅንነትህን አምላክ ረስተሃል፥ የረድኤትህንም ጌታ አላሰብህም፤ ስለዚህ ያማረውን ተክል ተክለሃል፥ እንግዳንም ዘር ዘርተሃል።

verses.text_english: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: the harvest a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: በተከልህበት ቀን ታበቅለዋለህ፥ በነጋውም ዘርህን እንዲያብብ ታደርገዋለህ፤ ነገር ግን በኀዘንና በትካዜ ቀን መከሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.text_english: Woe to the multitude of many people, make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ባሕር ሞገድ ድምፅ ለሚተምሙ ለወገኖች ብዛት፥ እንደ ኃይለኛም ውኃ ጩኸት ለሚጮኹ አሕዛብ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ እንደ ብዙ ውኃ ጩኸት ይጮኻሉ፤ እርሱ ግን ይገሥጻቸዋል፥ እነርሱም እየሸሹ ይርቃሉ፥ በተራራም ላይ እንዳለ እብቅ በነፋስ ፊት፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ እንደሚያዞረው ትቢያ ይበተናሉ።

verses.text_english: And behold at eveningtide trouble; before the morning he not. This the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ድንጋጤ አለ፤ ከማለዳም በፊት አይገኙም። የዘረፉን ሰዎች እድል ፈንታ፥ የበዘበዙን ዕጣ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.text_amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ወንዞች ማዶ ላለች፥ ክንፍ ያላቸው መርከቦች ላሉባት፥

verses.text_english: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, , Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
verses.text_amharic: መልእክተኞችን በባሕር ላይ የደንገል መርከቦችንም በውኃ ላይ ለምትልክ ምድር ወዮላት! እናንተ ፈጣኖች መልእክተኞች ሆይ፥ ወደ ረጅምና ወደ ለስላሳ ሕዝብ፥ ከመጀመሪያው አስደንጋጭ ወደ ሆነ ወገን፥ ወደሚሰፍርና ወደሚረግጥ፥ ወንዞችም ምድራቸውን ወደሚከፍሉት ሕዝብ ሂዱ።

verses.text_english: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለም የምትኖሩ ሁሉና በምድር የምትቀመጡ ሆይ፥ ምልክት በተራሮች ላይ በተነሣ ጊዜ እዩ፤ መለከትም በተነፋ ጊዜ ስሙ።

verses.text_english: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር። በፀሐይ ጮራ እንደ ደረቅ ትኩሳት፥ በአጨዳም ወራት እንደ ጠል ደመና ሆኜ በማደሪያዬ በጸጥታ ተቀምጬ እመለከታለሁ ብሎኛልና።

verses.text_english: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away cut down the branches.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከመከር በፊት አበባ በረገፈ ጊዜ የወይንም ፍሬ ጨርቋ ሲይዝ የወይኑን ዘንግ በማጭድ ይቆርጣል፥ ጫፎቹንም ይመለምላል ያስወግድማል።

verses.text_english: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
