verses.text_amharic: በተራራ ላይ ላሉ ነጣቂዎች ወፎች፥ ለምድርም አውሬዎች በአንድነት ይቀራሉ፤ ነጣቂዎችም ወፎች ይባጁባቸዋል፥ የምድርም አውሬዎች ሁሉ ይከርሙባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ዘመን ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር፥ ከረጅምና ከለስላሳ ሕዝብ፥ ከመጀመሪያው አስደንጋጭ ከሆነ ወገን፥ ከሚሰፍርና ከሚረግጥ፥ ወንዞችም ምድራቸውን ከሚከፍሉት ሕዝብ ዘንድ እጅ መንሻ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ወደሚገኝበት ስፍራ ወደ ጽዮን ተራራ ይቀርባል።

verses.text_english: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ግብጽ የተነገረ ሸክም። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በፈጣን ደመና እይበረረ ወደ ግብጽ ይመጣል፤ የግብጽም ጣዖታት በፊቱ ይርዳሉ፥ የግብጽም ልብ በውስጥዋ ይቀልጣል።

verses.text_english: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ግብጻውያንን በግብጻውያን ላይ አስነሣለሁ፤ ወንድምም ወንድሙን፥ ሰውም ባልንጀራውን፥ ከተማም ከተማን፥ መንግሥትም መንግሥትን ይወጋል።

verses.text_english: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽም መንፈስ በውስጥዋ ባዶ ይሆናል፥ ምክራቸውንም አጠፋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ጣዖቶቻቸውን በድግምት የሚጠነቍሉትንም መናፍስት ጠሪዎቻቸውንም ጠንቋዮቻቸውንም ይጠይቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ግብጻውያንንም በጨካኝ ጌታ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ጨካኝ ንጉሥም ይገዛቸዋል ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.text_amharic: ውኆችም ከባሕር ይደርቃሉ፥ ወንዙም ያንሳል ደረቅም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And they shall turn the rivers far away; the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዞቹም ይገማሉ፥ የግብጽም መስኖች ያንሳሉ ይደርቃሉም፤ ደንገልና ቄጤማ ይጠወልጋሉ።

verses.text_english: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no .
verses.text_amharic: በዓባይ ወንዝ ዳር ያለው መስክ በዓባይም ወንዝ አጠገብ የተዘራ እርሻ ሁሉ ይደርቃል፥ ይበተንማል፥ አይገኝምም።

verses.text_english: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.text_amharic: ዓሣ አጥማጆቹ ያዝናሉ፥ በዓባይም ወንዝ መቃጥን የሚጥሉት ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ፥ በውኆችም ላይ መረብ የሚዘረጉት ይዝላሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.text_amharic: የተበጠረውንም የተልባ እግር የሚሠሩ፥ ነጩንም ልብስ የሚሠሩ ሸማኔዎች ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices ponds for fish.
verses.text_amharic: ደገፋዎችዋም ሁሉ ይሰባበራሉ፥ የደመወዘኞችም ነፍስ ትተክዛለች።

verses.text_english: Surely the princes of Zoan fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.text_amharic: የጣኔዎስ አለቆች ፍጹም ሰነፎች ናቸው፤ ፈርዖንን የሚመክሩ ጥበበኞች ምክራቸው ድንቍርና ሆነች። ፈርዖንን። እኛ የጥበበኞች ልጆች የቀደሙም ነገሥታት ልጆች ነን እንዴት ትሉታላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Where they? where thy wise ? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንሳ ጥበበኞችህ የት አሉ? አሁን ይንገሩህ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በግብጽ ላይ ያሰበውን ይወቁ።

verses.text_english: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የጣኔዎስ አለቆች ሰነፎች ሆነዋል፥ የሜምፎስም አለቆች ተሸንግለዋል፤ የነገዶችዋ የማዕዘን ድንጋዮች የሆኑ ግብጽን አሳቱ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken staggereth in his vomit.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የጠማምነትን መንፈስ በውስጥዋ ደባልቆአል፤ ሰካር በትፋቱ እንዲስት እንዲሁ ግብጽን በሥራዋ ሁሉ አሳቱ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall there be work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.text_amharic: ራስ ወይም ጅራት የሰሌን ቅርንጫፍ ወይም እንግጫ ቢሆን ሊሠራ የሚችል ሥራ ለግብጽ አይሆንላትም።

verses.text_english: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ግብጻውያን እንደ ሴቶች ይሆናሉ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ ከሚያንቀሳቅሳት ከእጁ መንቀሳቀስ የተነሣ ይሸበራሉ ይፈሩማል።

verses.text_english: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ምድር ግብጽን የምታስደነግጥ ትሆናለች፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከመከረባት ምክር የተነሣ ወሬዋን የሚሰማ ሁሉ ይፈራል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን በግብጽ ምድር በከነዓን ቋንቋ የሚናገሩ፥ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔርም የሚምሉ አምስት ከተሞች ይሆናሉ፤ ከነዚህም አንዲቱ የጥፋት ከተማ ተብላ ትጠራለች።

verses.text_english: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን በግብጽ ምድር መካከል ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ፥ በዳርቻዋም ለእግዚአብሔር ዓምድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር በግብጽ ምድር ምልክትና ምስክር ይሆናል፤ ከሚያስጨንቁአቸው የተነሣ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻሉና፥ እርሱም መድኃኒትንና ኃያልን ሰድዶ ያድናቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር በግብጽ የታወቀ ይሆናል፥ ግብጽAውያንም እግዚአብሔርን ያውቃሉ፤ በመሥዋዕትና በቍርባን ያመልካሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስእለት ይሳላሉ ይፈጽሙትማል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal : and they shall return to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ግብጽን ይመታታል፤ ይመታታል ይፈውሳታልም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለሳሉ እርሱም ይለመናቸዋል ይፈውሳቸውማል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ከግብጽ ወደ አሦር መንገድ ይሆናል፥ አሦራዊውም ወደ ግብጽ፥ ግብጻዊውም ወደ አሦር ይገባል፤ ግብጻውያንም ከአሦራውያን ጋር ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.text_english: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the land:
In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.text_amharic: የአሦር ንጉሥ ሳርጎን ተርታንን በሰደደ ጊዜ እርሱም ወደ አዛጦን በመጣ ጊዜ አዛጦንም ወግቶ በያዛት ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ዓመት እግዚአብሔር የአሞጽን ልጅ ኢሳይያስን። ሂድ፥ ማቅህን ከወገብህ አውጣ ጫማህንም ከእግርህ አውልቅ ብሎ ተናገረው። እንዲህም አደረገ፥ ራቁቱንም ባዶ እግሩንም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። ባሪያዬ ኢሳይያስ በግብጽና በኢትዮጵያ ላይ ሦስት ዓመት ለምልክትና ለተአምራት ሊሆን ራቁቱንና ባዶ እግሩን እንደ ሄደ፥

verses.text_english: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ የአሦር ንጉሥ የግብጽንና የኢትዮጵያን ምርኮ፥ ጐበዛዝቱንና ሽማግሌዎቹን፥ ራቁታቸውንና ባዶ እግራቸውን አድርጎ ገላቸውንም ገልጦ፥ ለግብጽ ጕስቍልና ይነዳቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከተስፋቸው ከኢትዮጵያ ከትምክሕታቸውም ከግብጽ የተነሣ ይፈራሉ ያፍሩማል፤

verses.text_english: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በዚች ባሕር ዳርቻ የሚቀመጡ። እነሆ፥ ከአሦር ንጉሥ እንድን ዘንድ ለእርዳታ ወደ እነርሱ የሸሸንበት ተስፋችን ይህ ነበረ፤ እኛስ እንዴት እናመልጣለን? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.text_amharic: በባሕር አጠገብ ስላለው ስለ ምድረ በዳ የተነገረ ሸክም። ዐውሎ ነፋስ ከደቡብ እንደሚወጣ፥ እንዲሁ ከሚያስፈራ አገር ከምድረ በዳ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.text_amharic: ከባድ ራእይ ተነገረኝ፤ ወንጀለኛው ይወነጅላል አጥፊውም ያጠፋል። ኤላም ሆይ፥ ውጪ፤ ሜዶን ሆይ፥ ክበቢ፤ ትካዜውን ሁሉ አስቀርቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing ; I was dismayed at the seeing .
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወገቤ ሕመም ተሞላ፤ እንደምትወልድ ሴት ምጥ ያዘኝ፤ ከሕመሜ የተነሣ አልሰማም፥ ከድንጋጤም የተነሣ አላይም።

verses.text_english: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ልቤ ተንበደበደ፥ ድንጋጤ አስፈራኝ፥ ተስፋ ያደረግሁትም ድንግዝግዝታ መንቀጥቀጥ ሆነብኝ።

verses.text_english: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, anoint the shield.
verses.text_amharic: ማዕዱን ያዘጋጃሉ፥ ምንጣፉንም ይዘረጋሉ፥ ይበሉማል፥ ይጠጡማል፤ እናንተ መሳፍንት ሆይ፥ ተነሡ፥ ጋሻውን አዘጋጁ።

verses.text_english: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እንዲህ ብሎኛልና። ሂድ ጉበኛም አቁም፥ የሚያየውንም ይናገር።

verses.text_english: And he saw a chariot a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.text_amharic: በከብት የሚቀመጡትን፥ ሁለት ሁለት እየሆኑ የሚሄዱት ፈረሰኞች፥ በአህዮች የሚቀመጡትንና በግመሎች የሚቀመጡትን ባየ ጊዜ በጽኑ ትጋት አስተውሎ ተግቶም ያድምጥ።

verses.text_english: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.text_amharic: ያየውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ቀኑን ሁሉ ዘወትር በማማ ላይ ቆሜአለሁ፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ በመጠበቂያዬ ላይ ተተክያለሁ፥

verses.text_english: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በፈረሶች የሚቀመጡ፥ ሁለት ሁለት ሁነው የሚሄዱ ፈረሰኞች ይመጣሉ ብሎ ጮኸ፤ እርሱም መልሶ። ባቢሎን ወደቀች ወደቀች፥ የተቀረጹም የአማልክቶችዋ ምስሎች ሁሉ በምድር ላይ ተጥለው ደቀቁ አለ።

verses.text_english: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በአውድማዬ ላይ የተወቃችሁ የአውድማዬ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ከሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የሰማሁትን ነገርኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኤዶምያስ የተነገረ ሸክም። አንዱ ከሴይር። ጕበኛ ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱ ምን ያህል ነው? ጕበኛ ሆይ፥ ሌሊቱ ምን ያህል ነው? ብሎ ጠራኝ።

verses.text_english: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
verses.text_amharic: ጕበኛውም። ይነጋል ድግሞም ይመሻል፤ ትጠይቁ ዘንድ ብትወድዱ ጠይቁ፤ ተመልሳችሁም ኑ አለ።

verses.text_english: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ዓረብ የተነገረ ሸክም። የድዳናውያን ነጋዴዎች ሆይ፥ በዓረብ ዱር ውስጥ ታድራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.text_amharic: በቴማን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ወደ ተጠሙት ሰዎች ውኃ አምጡ እንጀራ ይዛችሁ የሸሹትን ሰዎች ተቀበሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰይፍ፥ ከተመዘዘው ሰይፍ፥ ከተለጠጠውም ቀስት ከጽኑም ሰልፍ ሸሽተዋልና።

verses.text_english: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እንዲህ ብሎኛልና። እንደ ምንደኛ ዓመት በአንድ ዓመት ውስጥ የቄዳር ክብር ሁሉ ይጠፋል፤

verses.text_english: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: ከቀስተኞች ቍጥር የቀሩት፥ የቄዳር ልጆች ኃያላን፥ ያንሳሉ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ራእይ ሸለቆ የተነገረ ሸክም። እናንተ ሁላችሁ ወደ ሰገነት መውጣታቸሁ ምን ሆናችኋል?

verses.text_english: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.text_amharic: ጩኸትና ፍጅት የተሞላብሽ ከተማ፥ ደስታ ያለሽ ከተማ ሆይ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥ የተገደሉት በሰይፍ የተገደሉ አይደሉም፥ በሰልፍም የሞቱ አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, have fled from far.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆችሽ ሁሉ በአንድነት ሸሹ፥ ያለ ቀስትም ተማረኩ፤ ከሩቅ ሸሽተው ከአንቺ ዘንድ የተገኙት ሁሉ በአንድነት ታሰሩ።

verses.text_english: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ። ፊታችሁን ከእኔ ዘንድ አርቁ፤ መራራ ልቅሶ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ጥፋት ታጽናኑኝ ዘንድ አትድከሙ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: For a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የድንጋጤና የመረገጥ የድብልቅልቅም ቀን፥ የቅጥርም መፍረስ ወደ ተራራም መጮኽ በራእይ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.text_amharic: ኤላምም ከሰረገለኞችና ከፈረሰኞች ጋር ሆኖ አፎቱን ተሸከመ፥ ቂርም ጋሻውን ገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.text_amharic: መልካሞቹንም ሸለቆችሽን ሰረገሎች ሞሉባቸው፥ ፈረሰኞችም መቆሚያቸውን በበር ላይ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳንም መጋረጃ ገለጠ፤ በዚያም ቀን በዱር ቤት የነበረውን የጦር ዕቃ ተመለከትህ፥

verses.text_english: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትም ከተማ ፍራሾች እንደ በዙ አይታችኋል፥ የታችኛውንም ኵሬ ውኃ አከማችታችኋል፥

verses.text_english: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.text_amharic: የኢየሩሳሌምን ቤቶች ቈጠራችሁ ቅጥሩንም ለማጥናት ቤቶችን አፈረሳችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.text_amharic: በአሮጌው ኵሬ ላለው ውኃ በሁለቱ ቅጥር መካከል መከማቻ ሠራችሁ፤ ይህን ያደረገውን ግን አልተመለከታችሁም፥ ቀድሞ የሠራውንም አላያችሁም።

verses.text_english: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ልቅሶና ወደ ዋይታ ራስን ወደ መንጨትና ማቅንም ወደ መልበስ ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሐሜትና ደስታ በሬውንና በጉንም ማረድ ሥጋንም መብላት የወይን ጠጅንም መጠጣት ሆነዋል፤ እናንተ። ነገ እንሞታለንና እንብላ እንጠጣ ብላችኋል።

verses.text_english: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ነገር በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ተሰማ። እስክትሞቱ ድረስ ይህ በደል በእውነት አይሰረይላችሁም ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, unto Shebna, which over the house, ,
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በቤቱ ውስጥ ወደ ተሾመው ወደዚህ አዛዥ ወደ ሳምናስ ሂድ እንዲህም በለው።

verses.text_english: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.text_amharic: መቃብር በዚህ ያስወቀርህ ከፍ ባለው ስፍራ መቃብር ያሰራህ በድንጋይም ውስጥ ለራስህ መኖርያ ያሳነጽህ በዚህ ምን አለህ? በዚህስ በአንተ ዘንድ ማን አለ?

verses.text_english: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በኃይል ወርውሮ ይጥልሃል፥ አጠንክሮም ይጨብጥሃል።

verses.text_english: He will surely violently turn and toss thee a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory the shame of thy lord's house.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቅልሎም ያንከባልልሃል ወደ ሰፊይቱም ምድር እንደ ኳስ ይጥልሃል፤ አንተ የጌታህ ቤት እፍረት! በዚያ ትሞታለህ በዚያም የክብርህ ሰረገላዎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.text_amharic: ከአዛዥነት ሥራህ አሳድድሃለሁ፥ ከሹመትህም ትሻራለህ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ባሪያዬን የኬልቅያስን ልጅ ኤልያቄምን እጠራለሁ፥

verses.text_english: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: መጐናጸፊያህንም አለብሰዋለሁ፥ በመታጠቂያህም አስታጥቀዋለሁ፥ ሹመትህንም በእጁ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ለይሁዳም ቤት አባት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊትንም ቤት መክፈቻ በጫንቃው ላይ አኖራለሁ፤ እርሱም ይከፍታል የሚዘጋም የለም እርሱም ይዘጋል የሚከፍትም የለም።

verses.text_english: And I will fasten him a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
verses.text_amharic: በታመነም ስፍራ እንደ ችንካር እተክለዋለሁ፥ ለአባቱም ቤት የክብር ዙፋን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቱንም ቤት ክብር ሁሉ ልጆቹንም የልጅ ልጆቹንም፥ ከጽዋ ዕቃ ጀምሮ እስከ ማድጋ ዕቃ ድረስ፥ ታናናሹን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይሰቅሉበታል።

verses.text_english: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ በታመነው ስፍራ የተከለው ችንካር ይወልቃል ተሰብሮም ይወድቃል፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተሰቀለው ሸክም ይጠፋል እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጢሮስ የተነገረ ሸክም። የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሆይ፥ አልቅሱ፤ ፈርሶአልና ቤት የለም፥ መግባትም የለም፤ ከኪቲም አገር ጀምሮ ተገልጦላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በደሴት የምትኖሩ በባሕርም የምትሻገሩ የሲዶና ነጋዴዎች ንግድ የሞሉባችሁ ሆይ፥ ጸጥ በሉ።

verses.text_english: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.text_amharic: የሺሖር ዘርና የዓባይ ወንዝ መከር በብዙ ውኆች ላይ ገቢዋ ነበረ፤ እርስዋም የአሕዛብ መናገጃ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, bring up virgins.
verses.text_amharic: ሲዶና ሆይ፥ ባሕር፥ የባሕር ምሽግ። አላማጥሁም፥ አልወለድሁም፤ ጐበዛዝትንም አላሳደግሁም፥ ደናግልንም አላሳደግሁም ብሎ ተናግሮአልና እፈሪ።

verses.text_english: As at the report concerning Egypt, shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.text_amharic: ወሬዋ ወደ ግብጽ በደረሰ ጊዜ በጢሮስ ወሬ ምጥ ይይዛቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ተርሴስ ተሻገሩ፤ እናንተ በደሴት የምትኖሩ አልቅሱ።

verses.text_english: this your joyous , whose antiquity of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.text_amharic: በቀድሞ ዘመን ተመሥርታ የነበረችው፥ በዚያም እንደ እንግዳ ሆና ትኖር ዘንድ እግሮችዋ ወደ ሩቅ ያፈለሱአት የደስታችሁ ከተማ ይህች ናትን?

verses.text_english: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning , whose merchants princes, whose traffickers the honourable of the earth?
verses.text_amharic: አክሊል ባስጫነች ከተማ በጢሮስ ላይ ይህን የወሰነ ማን ነው? ነጋዴዎችዋ አለቆች ናቸው፥ በእርስዋም የሚሸጡና የሚለውጡ የምድር ክቡራን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የክብርን ሁሉ ትዕቢት ይሽር ዘንድ የምድርንም ክቡራን ሁሉ ያስንቅ ዘንድ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ወስኖታል።

verses.text_english: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: no more strength.
verses.text_amharic: የተርሴስ ልጅ ሆይ፥ የሚከለክልሽ የለምና እንደ ዓባይ ወንዝ በአገርሽ ላይ ጐርፈሽ እለፊ።

verses.text_english: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant , to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በባሕር ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ መንግሥታትንም አናወጠ፤ ምሽጎችዋንም ያጠፉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ከነዓን አገር አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አንቺ የተበደልሽ የሲዶና ድንግል ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ደስ አይበልሽ፤ ተነሥተሽ ወደ ኪቲም ተሻገሪ፥ በዚያም ደግሞ አታርፊም አለ።

verses.text_english: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; he brought it to ruin.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የከለዳውያን አገር! ይህ ሕዝብ ሆኖ አይገኝም፤ አሦራውያን ለምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሰጥተውታል፤ ግንቦቻቸውን ሠሩ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም አፈረሱ፥ ባድማም አደረጓት።

verses.text_english: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሆይ፥ ምሽጋችሁ ፈርሶአልና ዋይ በሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ጢሮስ እንደ አንድ ንጉሥ ዘመን ሰባ ዓመት ያህል የተረሳች ትሆናለች፤ ከሰባ ዓመት በኋላ ግን ለጢሮስ በጋለሞታ ዘፈን እንደሚሆን እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የተረሳሽ ጋለሞታ ሆይ፥ መሰንቆ ያዢ በከተማ ላይም ዙሪ፤ መታሰቢያም ይሆንልሽ ዘንድ ዜማን አሳምሪ ዘፈንሽንም አብዢ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰባ ዓመትም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ጢሮስን ይጐበኛታል፥ ወደ ዋጋዋም ትምለሳለች፥ ደግሞም በምድር ፊት ላይ ከሆኑ ከዓለም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ጋር ትገለሙታለች።

verses.text_english: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.text_amharic: ንግድዋና ዋጋዋ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ ንግድዋም በልተው ይጠግቡ ዘንድ ማለፊያም ልብስ ይለብሱ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለሚኖሩ ይሆናል እንጂ በዕቃ ቤትና በግምጃ ቤት ውስጥ አይከተትም።

verses.text_english: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ባዶ ያደርጋታል፥ ባድማም ያደርጋታል፥ ይገለብጣትማል፥ በእርስዋም የተቀመጡትን ይበትናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ካህኑ፥ እንደ ባሪያውም እንዲሁ ጌታው፥ እንደ ባሪያይቱም እንዲሁ እመቤትዋ፥ እንደሚገዛም እንዲሁ የሚሸጠው፥ እንደ አበዳሪውም እንዲሁ ተበዳሪው፥ እንደ ዕዳ አስከፋዩም እንዲሁ ዕዳ ከፋዩ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር መፈታትን ትፈታለች፥ ፈጽማም ትበላሻላች፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ቃል ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: The earth mourneth fadeth away, the world languisheth fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም አለቀሰች ረገፈችም፤ ዓለም ደከመች ረገፈችም፤ የምድርም ሕዝብ ታላላቆች ደከሙ።

verses.text_english: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ከሚቀመጡባት በታች ረክሳለች፥ ሕጉን ተላልፈዋልና፥ ሥርዓቱንም ለውጠዋልና፥ የዘላለሙንም ቃል ኪዳን አፍርሰዋልና።

verses.text_english: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መርገም ምድርን ትበላለች በእርስዋም የተቀመጡ ይቀጣሉ፤ ስለዚህ የምድር ሰዎች ይቃጠላሉ ጥቂት ሰዎችም ይቀራሉ።

verses.text_english: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.text_amharic: የወይን ጠጅ አለቀሰች፥ የወይን ንግድ ደከመች፥ ልባቸው ደስ ያለው ሁሉ ተከዙ።

verses.text_english: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.text_amharic: የከበሮው ሐሤት ቀርቶአል፥ የደስተኞች ድምፅ ዝም ብሎአል፥ የመሰንቆ ደስታ ቀርቶአል።

verses.text_english: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.text_amharic: እየዘፈኑም የወይን ጠጅን አይጠጡትም፥ የሚያሰክርም መጠጥ ለሚጠጡት መራራ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.text_amharic: ባድማ የሆነችው ከተማ ፈረሰች፤ ቤት ሁሉ ማንም እንዳይገባበት ተዘጋ።

verses.text_english: a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ወይኑም ጠጅ በአደባባይ ጩኸት ይሆናል፤ ደስታ ሁሉ ጨልሞአል፥ የምድርም ሐሤት ፈርሶአል።

verses.text_english: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም ባድማ ሆናለች፥ በርዋም በጥፋት ተመትቶአል።

verses.text_english: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.text_amharic: የወይራን ዛፍ እንደ መምታት፥ ከወይንም መከር በኋላ ቃርሚያውን እንደ መልቀም፥ እንዲሁ በምድር መካከል በአሕዛብም መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ድምፃቸውን ያነሣሉ፥ እልልም ይላሉ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ክብርም ከባሕር ይጣራሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔርን በምሥራቅ፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም በባሕር ደሴቶች አክብሩ።

verses.text_english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
verses.text_amharic: ለጻድቁ ክብር ይሁን የሚለውን ዝማሬ ከምድር ዳርቻ ሰምተናል። እኔ ግን። ከሳሁ፥ ከሳሁ፥ ወዮልኝ! ወንጀለኞች ወንጅለዋል፤ ወንጀለኞች እጅግ ወንጅለዋል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ፍርሃትና ገደል ወጥመድም በአንተ ላይ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይ መስኮቶች ተከፍተዋልና፥ የምድርም መሠረት ተናውጣለችና ከፍርሃት ድምፅ የሸሸ በገደል ይወድቃል፥ ከገደልም የወጣ በወጥመድ ይያዛል።

verses.text_english: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ተሰባበረች፥ ምድር ፈጽማ ደቀቀች፥ ምድር ተነዋወጠች።

verses.text_english: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር እንደ ሰካር ሰው ትንገዳገዳለች፥ እንደ ዳስም ትወዛወዛለች፤ መተላለፍዋ ይከብድባታል፥ ትወድቅማለች ደግማም አትነሣም።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንደዚህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር በከፍታ ያለውን ሠራዊት በከፍታ ላይ፥ በምድርም ያሉትን ነገሥታት በምድር ላይ ይቀጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And they shall be gathered together, prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.text_amharic: ግዞተኞች በጕድጓድ እንደሚከማቹ በአንድነት ይከማቻሉ፥ በግዞት ቤትም ውስጥ ተዘግተው ይኖራሉ፥ ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ ይጐበኛሉ።

verses.text_english: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ይነግሣልና፥ በሽማግሌዎቹም ፊት ክብር ይሆናልና ጨረቃ ይታወካል ፀሐይም ያፍራል።

verses.text_english: O LORD, thou my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful counsels of old faithfulness truth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ ድንቅን ነገር የዱሮ ምክርን በታማኝነትና በእውነት አድርገሃልና ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ ስምህንም አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.text_english: For thou hast made of a city an heap; a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱን የድንጋይ ክምር፥ የተመሸገችውን ከተማ ውድማ እንድትሆን፥ የኀጥአንንም አዳራሽ ከተማ እንዳትሆን አድርገሃል፤ ከቶ አትሠራም።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኃያላኑ ወገኖች ያከብሩሃል፥ የጨካኞች አሕዛብ ከተማም ትፈራሃለች።

verses.text_english: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones as a storm the wall.
verses.text_amharic: የጨካኞችም ቍጣ እስትንፋስ ቅጥርን እንደሚመታ ዐውሎ ነፋስ በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ለድሀው መጠጊያ፥ ለችግረኛው በጭንቁ ጊዜ መጠጊያ፥ ከውሽንፍር መሸሸጊያ ከሙቀትም ጥላ ሆነሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሙቀት በደረቅ ስፍራ የኀጥአንን ጩኸት ዝም ታሰኛለህ፤ ሙቀትም በደመና ጥላ እንዲበርድ እንዲሁ የጨካኞች ዝማሬ ይዋረዳል።

verses.text_english: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ለሕዝብ ሁሉ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ታላቅ የሰባ ግብዣ፥ ያረጀ የወይን ጠጅ፥ ቅልጥም የሞላባቸው የሰቡ ነገሮች፥ የጥሩና ያረጀ የወይን ጠጅ ግብዣ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ተራራ ላይ በወገኖች ሁሉ ላይ የተጣለውን መጋረጃ፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተዘረጋውን መሸፈኛ ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: ሞትን ለዘላለም ይውጣል፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ከፊት ሁሉ እንባን ያብሳል፥ የሕዝቡን ስድብ ከምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያስወግዳል፤ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን። እነሆ፥ አምላካችን ይህ ነው፤ ተስፋ አድርገነዋል፥ ያድነንማል፤ እግዚአብሔር ይህ ነው፤ ጠብቀነዋል፤ በማዳኑ ደስ ይለናል ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን ይባላል።

verses.text_english: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በዚህ ተራራ ላይ ታርፋለች፥ ጭድም በጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረገጥ እንዲሁ ሞዓብ በስፍራው ይረገጣል።

verses.text_english: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ዋናተኛም ሲዋኝ እጁን እንደሚዘረጋ፥ እንዲሁ በመካከሉ እጁን ይዘረጋል፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ትዕቢቱን ከእጁ ተንኰል ጋር ያዋርዳል።

verses.text_english: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, bring to the ground, to the dust.
verses.text_amharic: የተመሸገውንም ከፍ ከፍ ያለውንም ቅጥርህን ዝቅ ያደርገዋል፥ ያዋርደውማል፥ ወደ መሬትም እስከ አፈር ድረስ ይጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will appoint walls and bulwarks.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ይህ ቅኔ በይሁዳ ምድር ይዘመራል። የጸናች ከተማ አለችን፤ ለቅጥርና ለምሽግ መድኃኒትን ያኖርባታል።

verses.text_english: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትን የሚጠብቅ ጻድቅ ሕዝብ ይገባ ዘንድ በሮችን ክፈቱ።

verses.text_english: Thou wilt keep in perfect peace, mind stayed : because he trusteth in thee.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ታምናለችና በአንተ ለምትደገፍ ነፍስ ፈጽመህ በሰላም ትጠብቃታለህ።

verses.text_english: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH everlasting strength:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም አምባ ነውና ለዘላለም በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ።

verses.text_english: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, to the ground; he bringeth it to the dust.
verses.text_amharic: በከፍታ የሚኖሩትን ሰዎች ዝቅ ያደርጋል፤ ከፍ ያለችውን ከተማ ያዋርዳል፥ እስከ መሬትም ድረስ ያዋርዳታል፥ እስከ አፈርም ድረስ ይጥላታል።

verses.text_english: The foot shall tread it down, the feet of the poor, the steps of the needy.
verses.text_amharic: እግር፥ የድሀ እግርም የችግረኛም አረጋገጥ፥ ትረግጣታለች።

verses.text_english: The way of the just uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.text_amharic: የጻድቃን መንገድ ቅን ናት፤ አንተ ቅን የሆንህ የጻድቃንን መንገድ ታቃናለህ።

verses.text_english: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of soul to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በፍርድህ መንገድ ተስፋ አድርገንሃል፥ ስምህም መታሰቢያህም የነፍሳችን ምኞት ነው።

verses.text_english: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድህን በምድር ባደረግህ ጊዜ በዓለም የሚኖሩት ጽድቅን ይማራሉና ነፍሴ በሌሊት ትናፍቅሃለች፥ መንፈሴም በውስጤ ወደ አንተ ትገሠግሣለች።

verses.text_english: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአተኛ ሞገስ ቢደረግለት ጽድቅን አይማርም፤ በቅኖች ምድር ክፉን ነገር ያደርጋል፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ግርማ አያይም።

verses.text_english: LORD, thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: they shall see, and be ashamed for envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እጅህ ከፍ ከፍ አለች አላዩምም፤ ነገር ግን በሕዝብህ ላይ ያለህን ቅንዓት አይተው ያፍራሉ፤ እሳትም ጠላቶችህን ትበላለች።

verses.text_english: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ሥራችንን ሁሉ ሠርተህልናልና ሰላምን ትሰጠናለህ።

verses.text_english: O LORD our God, lords beside thee have had dominion over us: by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በቀር ሌሎች ጌቶች ገዝተውናል፤ ነገር ግን በአንተ ብቻ ስምህን እናስባለን።

verses.text_english: dead, they shall not live; deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ሞተዋል፥ በሕይወት አይኖሩም፤ ጠፍተዋል፥ አይነሡም፤ ስለዚህ አንተ ጐብኝተሃቸዋል አጥፍተሃቸውማል፥ መታሰቢያቸውንም ሁሉ ምንምን አድርገሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed far all the ends of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብን አበዛህ፥ አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብን አበዛህ፤ አንተም ተከበርህ፥ የአገሪቱንም ዳርቻ ሁሉ አሰፋህ።

verses.text_english: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer thy chastening upon them.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በመከራ ጊዜ ፈለጉህ፥ በገሰጽሃቸውም ጊዜ ልመናቸውን ወደ አንተ አፈሰሱ።

verses.text_english: Like as a woman with child, draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የፀነሰች ሴት ለመውለድ ስትቀርብ እንደምትጨነቅና በምጥ እንደምትጮኽ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንዲሁ በፊትህ ሆነናል።

verses.text_english: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ፀንሰናል ምጥም ይዞናል፥ ነፋስንም እንደምንወልድ ሆነናል፤ በምድርም ደኅንነት አላደረግነም፤ በዓለምም የሚኖሩ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Thy dead shall live, my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ሙታንህ ሕያዋን ይሆናሉ፥ ሬሳዎችም ይነሣሉ። በምድር የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ጠልህ የብርሃን ጠል ነውና፥ ምድርም ሙታንን ታወጣለችና ንቁ ዘምሩም።

verses.text_english: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ና ወደ ቤትህም ግባ፥ ደጅህን በኋላህ ዝጋ ቍጣ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ ጥቂት ጊዜ ተሸሸግ።

verses.text_english: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ በበደላቸው ምክንያት ቍጣውን ያመጣባቸው ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከስፍራው ይወጣል፤ ምድርም ደምዋን ትገልጣለች፥ ሙታኖችዋንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትከድንም።

verses.text_english: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that in the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እግዚአብሔር ፈጣኑን እባብ ሌዋታንን ጠማማውንም እባብ ሌዋታንን በጠንካራ በታላቅም በብርቱም ሰይፍ ይቀጣል፥ በባሕርም ውስጥ ያለውን ዘንዶ ይገድላል።

verses.text_english: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ለተወደደው የወይን ቦታ ተቀኙለት።

verses.text_english: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ጠባቂው ነኝ፤ ሁልጊዜ አጠጣዋለሁ፤ ማንም እንዳይጐዳው በሌሊትና በቀን እጠብቀዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Fury not in me: who would set the briers thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.text_amharic: አልቈጣም፤ እሾህና ኵርንችት በእኔ ላይ ምነው በሰልፍ በነበሩ! በእነርሱ ላይ ተራምጄ በአንድነት ባቃጠልኋቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Or let him take hold of my strength, he may make peace with me; he shall make peace with me.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ጕልበቴን ይያዝ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ሰላም ያድርግ፤ ከእኔ ጋር ሰላም ያድርግ።

verses.text_english: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.text_amharic: በሚመጣው ዘመን ያዕቆብ ሥር ይሰድዳል፥ እስራኤልም ያብባል ይጨበጭብማል፤ በፍሬያቸውም የዓለሙን ፊት ይሞላሉ።

verses.text_english: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የመቱትን እንደ መታ እንዲሁ እርሱን መታውን? ወይስ እነርሱ እንደ ተገደሉበት መገደል እርሱ ተገድሎአልን?

verses.text_english: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
verses.text_amharic: ነዳቸው ሰደዳቸው ቀሠፋቸው፤ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ እንደሚነፍስበት ቀን በጠንካራ ዐውሎ አስወገዳቸው።

verses.text_english: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችና የፀሐይ ምስሎች ዳግመኛ እንዳይነሡ የመሠዊያውን ድንጋይ ሁሉ እንደ ደቀቀ እንደ ኖራ ድንጋይ ባደረገ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የያዕቆብ በደል ይሰረያል፥ ይህም ኀጢአትን የማስወገድ ፍሬ ሁሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: Yet the defenced city desolate, the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የተመሸገችው ከተማ ብቻዋን ሆነች፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሆና የተፈታችና የተተወች መኖሪያ ናት፤ በዚያም ጥጃ ይሰማራል በዚያም ይተኛል ቅርንጫፍዋንም ይበላል።

verses.text_english: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, set them on fire: for it a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.text_amharic: ጫፎችዋ በደረቁ ጊዜ ይሰበራሉ፥ ሴቶችም መጥተው ያቃጥሉአቸዋል፤ የማያስተውል ሕዝብ ነውና ስለዚህ ፈጣሪው አይራራለትም ሠሪውም ምሕረት አያደርግለትም።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከወንዝ ፈሳሽ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ እህሉን ይወቃል፥ እናንተም የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ አንድ በአንድ ትሰበሰባላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ታላቅ መለከት ይነፋል፥ በአሦርም የጠፉ፥ በግብጽ ምድርም የተሰደዱ ይመጣሉ፥ በተቀደሰውም ተራራ በኢየሩሳሌም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty a fading flower, which on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.text_amharic: ለኤፍሬም ሰካሮች ትዕቢት አክሊል፥ በወይን ጠጅ ለተሸነፉ በወፍራም ሸለቆአቸው ራስ ላይ ላለችም ለረገፈች ለክብሩ ጌጥ አበባ ወዮ!

verses.text_english: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, as a tempest of hail a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በጌታ ዘንድ ኃያል ብርቱ የሆነ አለ። እንደ በረዶ ወጨፎ፥ እንደሚያጠፋም ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እንደሚያጥለቀልቅም እንደ ታላቅ ውኃ ፈሳሽ በጠነከረ እጅ ወደ ምድር ይጥላል።

verses.text_english: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬም ሰካሮች ትዕቢት አክሊል በእግር ይረገጣል፤

verses.text_english: And the glorious beauty, which on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, as the hasty fruit before the summer; which he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.text_amharic: በወፍራሙ ሸለቆ ራስ ላይ ያለች የረገፈች የክብሩ ጌጥ አበባ ከመከር በፊት አስቀድማ እንደምትበስል በለስ ትሆናለች፤ ሰው ባያት ጊዜ በእጁ እንዳለች ይበላታል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለቀሩት ሕዝቡ የክብር ዘውድና የጌጥ አክሊል ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርድ ወንበር ላይ ለሚቀመጥም የፍርድ መንፈስ፥ ሰልፉን ወደ በር ለሚመልሱም ኃይል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ደግሞ ከወይን ጠጅ የተነሣ ይስታሉ፥ ከሚያሰክርም መጠጥ የተነሣ ይፋንናሉ፤ ካህኑና ነቢዩ ከሚያሰክር መጠጥ የተነሣ ይስታሉ፥ በወይን ጠጅም ይዋጣሉ፥ ከሚያሰክርም መጠጥ የተነሣ ይፋንናሉ፤ በራእይ ይስታሉ፥ በፍርድም ይሰናከላሉ።

verses.text_english: For all tables are full of vomit filthiness, no place .
verses.text_amharic: ማዕዱ ሁሉ ትፋትንና ርኵሰትን ተሞልቶአታል፤ ንጹሕ ስፍራ እንኳ የለም።

verses.text_english: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? weaned from the milk, drawn from the breasts.
verses.text_amharic: እውቀትን ለማን ያስተምረዋል? ወይስ ወሬ ማስተዋልን ለማን ይሰጣል? ወተትን ለተዉ ወይስ ጡትን ለጣሉ ነውን?

verses.text_english: For precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little:
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ጥቂት በዚህ ጥቂት በዚያ ነው።

verses.text_english: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
verses.text_amharic: በባዕድ አፍ በልዩም ልሳን ለዚህ ሕዝብ ይናገራል፤ እርሱም። ዕረፍት ይህች ናት፥

verses.text_english: To whom he said, This the rest ye may cause the weary to rest; and this the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
verses.text_amharic: የደከመውን አሳርፉ፤ ይህችም ማረፊያ ናት አላቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን መስማትን እንቢ አሉ።

verses.text_english: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሄደው ወደ ኋላ እንዲወድቁ እንዲሰበሩም ተጠምደውም እንዲያዙ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ትእዛዝ በትእዛዝ፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ሥርዓት በሥርዓት፥ ጥቂት በዚህ ጥቂት በዚያ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውን ሕዝብ የምትገዙ ፌዘኞች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። ከሞት ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርገናል፥ ከሲኦልም ጋር ተማምለናል፤ ሐሰትን መሸሸጊያችን አድርገናልና፥ በሐሰትም ተሰውረናልና የሚትረፈረፍ መቅሠፍት ባለፈ ጊዜ አይደርስብንም ስላላችሁ፥

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner , a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በጽዮን ድንጋይን ለመሠረት አስቀምጣለሁ፤ የተፈተነውን፥ የከበረውን፥ መሠረቱ የጸናውን የማዕዘን ድንጋይ፤ የሚያምን አያፍርም።

verses.text_english: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
verses.text_amharic: ለገመድ ፍርድን ለቱንቢም ጽድቅን አደርጋለሁ፤ በረዶውም የሐሰትን መሸሸጊያ ይጠርጋል፥ ውኆችም መሰወሪያውን ያሰጥማሉ።

verses.text_english: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
verses.text_amharic: ከሞትም ጋር ያደረጋችሁት ቃል ኪዳን ይፈርሳል፥ ከሲኦልም ጋር የተማማላችሁት መሐላ አይጸናም፤ የሚትረፈረፍ መቅሠፍት ባለፈ ጊዜ ትረገጡበታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only understand the report.
verses.text_amharic: ባለፈም ጊዜ ይወስዳችኋል፤ ማለዳ ማለዳ ቀንና ሌሊት ያልፋል፤ ወሬውንም ማስተዋል ድንጋጤ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: For the bed is shorter than that can stretch himself : and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself .
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በእርሱ ላይ ተዘርግቶ ቢተኛ አልጋው አጭር ነው፤ ሰውም ሰውነቱን መሸፈን ቢወድድ መጐናጸፊያ ጠባብ ነው።

verses.text_english: For the LORD shall rise up as mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሥራውን ማለት እንግዳ ሥራውን ይሠራ ዘንድ፥ አድራጎቱንም ማለት ያልታወቀውን አድራጎቱን ያደርግ ዘንድ በፐራሲም ተራራ እንደ ነበረ ይነሣል፥ በገባዖንም ሸለቆ እንደ ነበረ ይቈጣል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ የሚጸናውን የጥፋት ትእዛዝ ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሰምቻለሁና እስራት እንዳይጸንባችሁ አታፊዙ።

verses.text_english: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
verses.text_amharic: አድምጡ ድምፄንም ስሙ፤ ልብ አድርጉ ንግግሬንም ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ገበሬ ሊዘራ ሁልጊዜ ያርሳልን? ወይስ ሁልጊዜ እርሻውን ይገለግላልን?

verses.text_english: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
verses.text_amharic: ጓሉንስ ይከሰክሳልን? እርሻውን ባስተካከለ ጊዜ ጥቁሩን አዝሙድ፥ ከሙኑንም፥ ስንዴውንም በተርታ፥ ገብሱንም በስፍራው፥ አጃንም በደረጃው የሚዘራ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, doth teach him.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብልሃት አምላኩ ያስታውቀዋል ያስተምረውማል።

verses.text_english: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቁሩ አዝሙድ በተሳለች መሄጃ አያኬድም፥ የሰረገላም መንኰራኵር በከሙን ላይ አይዞርም፤ ነገር ግን ጥቁሩ አዝሙድ በሽመል ከሙኑም በበትር ይወቃል።

verses.text_english: Bread is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it his horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: የእንጀራ እህል ይደቅቃልን? ለዘላለም አያኬደውም፤ የሰረገላውን መንኰራኵርና ፈረሶቹን ምንም ቢያስኬድበት አያደቅቀውም።

verses.text_english: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, is wonderful in counsel, excellent in working.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ደግሞ ድንቅ ምክር ከሚመክር በግብሩም ማለፊያ ከሆነው ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ወጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊት ለሰፈረባት ከተማ ለአርኤል ወዮላት! ዓመት በዓመት ላይ ጨምሩ፥ በዓላትም ይመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
verses.text_amharic: አርኤልንም አስጨንቃለሁ፥ ልቅሶና ዋይታም ይሆንባታል፤ እንደ አርኤልም ትሆንልኛለች።

verses.text_english: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያሽም እሰፍራለሁ፥ በቅጥርም ከብቤ አስጨንቅሻለሁ፥ አምባም በላይሽ አቆማለሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt be brought down, shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
verses.text_amharic: ትዋረጂማለሽ፥ በመሬትም ላይ ሆነሽ ትናገሪያለሽ፥ ቃልሽም ዝቅ ብሎ ከአፈር ይወጣል፤ ድምፅሽም ከመሬት እንደሚወጣ እንደ መናፍስት ጠሪ ድምፅ ይሆናል፥ ቃልሽም ከአፈር ወጥቶ ይጮኻል።

verses.text_english: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የጠላቶችሽ ብዛት እንደ ደቀቀ ትቢያ፥ የጨካኞችም ብዛት እንደሚያልፍ ገለባ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገትም ፈጥኖ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በነጐድጓድ፥ በምድርም መናወጥ፥ በታላቅም ድምፅ፥ በዐውሎ ነፋስም፥ በወጨፎም፥ በምትበላም በእሳት ነበልባል ይጐበኛታል።

verses.text_english: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.text_amharic: በአርኤልም ላይ የሚዋጉ፥ እርስዋንና ምሽግዋንም የሚወጉ የሚያስጨንቋትም፥ የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ብዛት እንደ ሕልምና እንደ ሌሊት ራእይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: It shall even be as when an hungry dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ተርቦም እንደሚያልም ሰው ይሆናል፤ በሕልሙም፥ እነሆ፥ ይበላል፥ ነገር ግን ይነቃል ሰውነቱም ባዶ ነው፤ ተጠምቶም እንደሚያልም ሰው ይሆናል፤ በሕልሙም፥ እነሆ፥ ይጠጣል፥ ነገር ግን ይነቃል፥ እነሆም፥ ይዝላል ሰውነቱም አምሮት አለው፤ እንዲሁ የጽዮንን ተራራ የሚወጉ የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ብዛት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.text_amharic: ተደነቁ ደንግጡም፤ ተጨፈኑም ዕውሮችም ሁኑ፤ በወይን ጠጅ አይሁን እንጂ ሰከሩ፤ በሚያሰክር መጠጥ አይሁን እንጂ ተንገደገዱ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የእንቅልፍ መንፈስ አፍስሶባችኋል ዓይኖቻችሁን ነቢያትንም ጨፍኖባችኋል ራሶቻችሁን ባለ ራእዮችን ሸፍኖባችኋል።

verses.text_english: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it sealed:
verses.text_amharic: ራእዩም ሁሉ እንደ ታተመ መጽሐፍ ቃል ሆኖባችኋል፤ ማንበብንም ለሚያውቅ። ይህን አንብብ ብለው በሰጡት ጊዜ እርሱ። ታትሞአልና አልችልም ይላቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም መጽሐፉን ማንበብን ለማያውቅ። ይህን አንብብ ብለው በሰጡት ጊዜ እርሱ። ማንበብ አላውቅም ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም። ይህ ሕዝብ በአፉ ወደ እኔ ይቀርባልና፥ በከንፈርቹም ያከብረኛልና፥ ልቡ ግን ከእኔ የራቀ ነውና፥ በሰዎች ሥርዓትና ትምህርት ብቻ ይፈራኛልና

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent shall be hid.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ድንቅ ነገርን በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል፥ ድንቅ ነገርን ተአምራትንም፥ እንደ ገና አደርጋለሁ፤ የጥበበኞችም ጥበብ ትጠፋለች፥ የአስተዋዮችም ማስተዋል ትሰወራለች።

verses.text_english: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
verses.text_amharic: ምክራቸውን ጥልቅ አድርገው ከእግዚአብሔር ለሚሰውሩ፥ ሥራቸውንም በጨለማ ውስጥ አድርገው። ማን ያየናል? ወይስ ማን ያውቀናል? ለሚሉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የእናንተ ጠማምነት ነው፤ እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ጭቃ የምትቈጠሩ አይደላችሁምን? በውኑ ሥራ ሠሪውን። አልሠራኸኝም ይለዋልን? ወይስ የተደረገው አድራጊውን። አታስተውልም ይለዋልን?

verses.text_english: it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.text_amharic: ሊባኖስ እንደ ፍሬያማ እርሻ ሊለወጥ ፍሬያማውም እርሻ እንደ ዱር ሊቈጠር ጥቂት ዘመን የቀረ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ደንቆሮች የመጽሐፍን ቃል ይሰማሉ፥ የዕውሮችም ዓይኖች ከጭጋግና ከጨለማ ተለይተው ያያሉ።

verses.text_english: The meek also shall increase joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የዋሃን ደስታቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ያበዛሉ፥ በሰዎች መካከል ያሉ ችግረኞችም ሐሤትን በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
verses.text_amharic: ጨካኙ ሰው አልቆአልና፥ ፌዘኛውም ጠፍቶአልና፥ ለኃጢአትም የደፈጡ ሁሉ ይቈረጣሉና፤

verses.text_english: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሰውን በነገር በደለኛ የሚያደርጉ፥ በበርም ለሚገሥጸው አሽክላ የሚያኖሩ፥ ጻድቁንም በከንቱ ነገር የሚያስቱ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አብርሃምን የተቤዠ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ያዕቆብ ቤት እንዲህ ይላል። ያዕቆብ አሁን አያፍርም፥ ፊቱም አሁን አይለወጥም።

verses.text_english: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእጄን ሥራ ልጆቹን በመካከሉ ባያቸው ጊዜ ስሜን ይቀድሳሉ፤ የያዕቆብንም ቅዱስ ይቀድሳሉ፥ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ ይፈራሉ።

verses.text_english: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስም የሳቱ ማስተዋልን ያውቃሉ፥ የሚያጕረመርሙም ትምህርትን ይቀበላሉ።

verses.text_english: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
verses.text_amharic: ለዓመፀኞች ልጆች ወዮላቸው! ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከእኔ ዘንድ ያልሆነን ምክር ይመክራሉ፥ ኃጢአትንም በኃጢአት ላይ ይጨምሩ ዘንድ ከመንፈሴ ዘንድ ያልሆነውን ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.text_amharic: ከአፌም ነገርን ሳይጠይቁ በፈርዖን ኃይል ይጸኑ ዘንድ በግብጽም ጥላ ይታመኑ ዘንድ ወደ ግብጽ እንዲወርዱ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt confusion.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የፈርዖን ኃይል እፍረት በግብጽም ጥላ መታመን ስድብ ይሆንባችኋል።

verses.text_english: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆች ምንም በጣኔዎስ ቢሆኑ፥ መልክተኞችም ምንም ወደ ሓኔስ ቢደርሱ፥

verses.text_english: They were all ashamed of a people could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላቸው ይጠቅሙአቸው ዘንድ ስለማይችሉ፥ እፍረትና ስድብ እንጂ ረድኤትና ረብ ስለማይሆኑ ሕዝብ ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people shall not profit .
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብ ስላሉ እንስሶች የተነገረ ሸክም። ተባትና እንስት አንበሳ እፉኝትም ነዘር እባብም በሚወጡባት በመከራና በጭንቀት ምድር በኩል ብልጥግናቸውን በአህዮች ጫንቃ ላይ መዛግብቶቻቸውንም በግመሎች ሻኛ ላይ እየጫኑ ወደማይጠቅሙአቸው ሕዝብ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength to sit still.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽ እርዳታ ከንቱና ምናምን ነው፤ ስለዚህ ስሙን። በቤት የሚቀመጥ ረዓብ ብዬ ጠርቼዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ሂድ፥ ለሚመጣውም ዘመን ለዘላለም እንዲሆን በሰሌዳ ላይ በመጽሐፍም ውስጥ ጻፍላቸው።

verses.text_english: That this a rebellious people, lying children, children will not hear the law of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፀኛ ወገንና የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ለመስማት የማይወድዱ የሐሰት ልጆች ናቸውና፤

verses.text_english: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
verses.text_amharic: ባለ ራእዮችን። አትመልከቱ ይላሉ፥ ነቢያትንም። ጣፋጩንና አታላዩን ነገር እንጂ ቅኑን ነገር አትንገሩን ከመንገድ ፈቀቅ በሉ፥

verses.text_english: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
verses.text_amharic: ከጐዳናውም ዘወር በሉ፥ የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ ከእኛ ዘንድ አስወግዱ ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህችን ቃል አቃልላችኋልና፥ በግፍና በጠማምነት ታምናችኋልና፥ በእርሱም ተደግፋችኋልና

verses.text_english: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ይህ በደል አዘብዝቦ ለመፍረስ እንደ ቀረበ፥ አፈራረሱም ፈጥኖ ድንገት እንደሚመጣ እንደ ረጅም ቅጥር ይሆንባችኋል።

verses.text_english: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water out of the pit.
verses.text_amharic: የሸክለኛ ማድጋ እንደሚሰበር ይሰብረዋል፥ ሳይራራም ያደቅቀዋል፤ ከስባሪውም እሳት ከማንደጃ የሚወስዱበት ወይም ውኃ ከጕድጓድ የሚቀዱበት ገል አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በመመለስና በማረፍ ትድናላችሁ፤ በጸጥታና በመታመን ኃይል ይሆንላችኋል፤ እናንተም እንቢ አላችሁ፥

verses.text_english: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። በፈረስ ላይ ትቀምጠን እንሸሻለን እንጂ እንዲህ አይሆንም አላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም ትሸሻላችሁ፤ ደግሞም። በፈጣን ፈረስ ላይ እንቀመጣለን አላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም የሚያሳድዱአችሁ ፈጣኖች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: One thousand at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንድ ሰው ዛቻ የተነሣ ሺህ ሰዎች ይሸሻሉ፤ እናንተም በተራራ ራስ ላይ እንዳለ ምሰሶ፥ በኮረብታም ላይ እንዳለ ምልክት ሆናችሁ እስክትቀሩ ድረስ፥ ከአምስት ሰዎች ዛቻ የተነሣ ትሸሻላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD a God of judgment: blessed all they that wait for him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የፍርድ አምላክ ነውና ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ይራራላችሁ ዘንድ ይታገሣል፥ ይምራችሁም ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ እርሱን በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ ሁሉ ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ በጽዮን የምትኖሩ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታለቅስም፤ በጩኸትም ድምፅ ይራራልሃል፥ በሰማህም ጊዜ ይመልስልሃል።

verses.text_english: And the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም የጭንቀትን እንጀራና የመከራን ውኃ ቢሰጥህም አስተማሪህ እንግዲህ ከአንተ አይሰወርም፤ ዓይኖችህ ግን አስተማሪህን ያያሉ፥

verses.text_english: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም ፈቀቅ ብትል ጆሮችህ በኋላህ። መንገዱ ይህች ናት በእርስዋም ሂድ የሚለውን ቃል ይሰማሉ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
verses.text_amharic: በብርም የተለበጡትን የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችህን በወርቅም የተለበጡትን ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎችህን ታረክሳለህ፤ እንደ ርኩስም ነገር ትጥላቸዋለህ። ወግዱ ትላቸውማለህ።

verses.text_english: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ለተዘራው ዘርህ ዝናብ ይሰጣል፥ ከምድርም ፍሬ የሚወጣ እንጀራ ወፍራምና ብዙ ይሆናል። በዚያም ቀን ከብቶችህ በሰፊ መስክ ይሰማራሉ፤

verses.text_english: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
verses.text_amharic: መሬትንም የሚያርሱ በሬዎችና አህዮች በመንሽና በወንፊት የነጻውን ጨው ጨው የሚለውን ገፈራ ይበላሉ።

verses.text_english: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅም እልቂት ቀን ግንቦች በወደቁ ጊዜ በረጅሙ ተራራ ሁሉ ከፍ ባለውም ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ወንዞችና የውኃ ፈሳሾች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የሕዝቡን ስብራት በጠገነ ዕለት፥ መቅሰፍቱ የቈሰለውንም በፈወሰ ዕለት፥ የጨረቃ ብርሃን እንደ ፀሐይ ብርሃን፥ የፀሐይም ብርሃን እንደ ሰባት ቀን ብርሃን ሰባት እጥፍ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning his anger, and the burden heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ከሚነድድ ቍጣ ከሚትጐለጐልም ጢስ ጋር ከሩቅ ይመጣል፤ ከንፈሮቹም ቍጣን የሞሉ ናቸው፥ ምላሱም እንደምትበላ እሳት ናት፤

verses.text_english: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing to err.
verses.text_amharic: እስትንፋሱም አሕዛብን በአጥፊ ወንፊት ሊነፋቸው እንደሚያጥለቀልቅ እስከ አንገትም እንደሚደርስ ወንዝ ነው፥ በሕዝብም መንጋጋ የሚያስት ልጓም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Ye shall have a song, as in the night a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዝማሬ በተቀደሰች የዐውደ ዓመት ሌሊት እንደሚሆን ዝማሬ ይሆንላችኋል፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተራራ ወደ እስራኤል አምባ ይመጣ ዘንድ እንቢልታ ይዞ እንደሚሄድ ሰው የልብ ደስታ ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ክቡር ድምፁን ያሰማል፥ የክንዱንም መውረድ በሚነድድ ቍጣውና በምትበላ እሳት ነበልባል በዐውሎ ነፋስም በወጨፎም በበረዶ ጠጠርም ይገልጣል።

verses.text_english: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, smote with a rod.
verses.text_amharic: አሦርም በበትር ከመታው ከእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ የተነሣ ይደነግጣል።

verses.text_english: And every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በላዩ በሚያወርድበት የታዘዘበቱ የበትር ድብደባ ሁሉ በከበሮና በመሰንቆ ይሆናል፤ በጦርነትም ክንዱን አንሥቶ ይዋጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For Tophet ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made deep large: the pile thereof fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀድሞም ጀምሮ የማቃጠያ ስፍራ ተዘጋጅታለች፥ ለንጉሥም ተበጅታለች፤ ጥልቅና ሰፊም አድርጎአታል፤ እሳትና ብዙ ማገዶ ተከምሮአል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እስትንፋስ እንደ ዲን ፈሳሽ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርዳታ ወደ ግብጽ ለሚወርዱ በፈረሶችም ለሚደገፉ፥ ስለ ብዛታቸውም በሰረገሎች፥ እጅግ ብርቱዎችም ስለ ሆኑ በፈረሰኞች ለሚታመኑ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ቅዱስ ለማይመለከቱ እግዚአብሔርንም ለማይፈልጉ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Yet he also wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ደግሞ ጠቢብ ነው፥ ክፉንም ነገር ያመጣል፥ ቃሉንም አይመልስም፥ በክፉም አድራጊዎች ቤት ላይ በደልንም በሚሠሩ ረዳት ላይ ይነሣል።

verses.text_english: Now the Egyptians men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
verses.text_amharic: ግብጻውያን ሰዎች እንጂ አምላክ አይደሉም፥ ፈረሶቻቸውም ሥጋ እንጂ መንፈስ አይደሉም፤ እግዚአብሔርም እጁን በዘረጋ ጊዜ፥ ረጂው ይሰናከላል ተረጂውም ይወድቃል፥ ሁሉም በአንድ ላይ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይለኛልና። አንበሳ ወይም የአንበሳ ደቦል በንጥቂያው ላይ ሲያገሳ፥ ብዙ እረኞች ቢከማቹበት ከቃላቸው እንደማይፈራ ከድምፃቸውም እንደማይዋረድ፥ እንዲሁ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራና በኮረብታዋ ላይ ይዋጋ ዘንድ ይወርዳል።

verses.text_english: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver passing over he will preserve it.
verses.text_amharic: እንደሚበርር ወፍ እንዲሁ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይጋርዳታል፤ ይከልላታል፥ ይታደጋታል፥ አልፎም ያድናታል።

verses.text_english: Turn ye unto whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ አጥብቃችሁ ወደ ዐመፃችሁበት ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you a sin.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እያንዳንዳቸው እጆቻቸው ለኃጢአት የሠሩላቸውን የብሩንና የወርቁን ጣዖቶቻቸውን ይጥላሉ።

verses.text_english: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
verses.text_amharic: አሦርም የሰው ባልሆነ ሰይፍ ይወድቃል፥ የሰውም ያልሆነ ሰይፍ ይበላዋል፤ ከሰይፍም ይሸሻሉ ጐበዛዝቱም ገባሮች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አምባው ከፍርሃት የተነሣ ያልፋል መሳፍንቱም ከዓላማው የተነሣ ይደነግጣሉ፥ ይላል እሳቱ በጽዮን እቶኑም በኢየሩሳሌም የሆነ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ንጉሥ በጽድቅ ይነግሣል፥ መሳፍንትም በፍርድ ይገዛሉ።

verses.text_english: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ከነፋስ እንደ መሸሸጊያ ከዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደ መጠጊያ፥ በጥም ቦታም እንደ ወንዝ ፈሳሽ፥ በበረሃም አገር እንደ ትልቅ ድንጋይ ጥላ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዩትም ሰዎች ዓይኖች አይጨፈኑም፥ የሚሰሙትም ጆሮች ያደምጣሉ።

verses.text_english: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.text_amharic: ጥንቃቄ የሌላቸው ሰዎች ልብ እውቀትን ታስተውላለች፥ የተብታቦችም ምላስ ደኅና አድርጋ ትናገራለች።

verses.text_english: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said bountiful.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሰነፍ ከበርቴ ተብሎ አይጠራም፥ ንፉግም ለጋስ አይባልም።

verses.text_english: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፍ ግን ስንፍናን ይናገራል፥ ልቡም ዝንጉነትን ይፈጽም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ስሕተትን ይናገር ዘንድ የተራበችውንም ሰውነት ባዶ ያደርግ ዘንድ ከተጠማም ሰው መጠጥን ይቈርጥ ዘንድ በደልን ይሠራል።

verses.text_english: The instruments also of the churl evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.text_amharic: የንፉግም ዕቃ ክፉ ናት፤ ችግረኛ ቅን ነገርን በተናገረ ጊዜ እንኳ እርሱ በሐሰት ቃል ድሀውን ያጠፋ ዘንድ ክፉን አሳብ ያስባል።

verses.text_english: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.text_amharic: ከበርቴ ሰው ግን ለመከበር ያስባል፥ በመከበርም ጸንቶ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ዓለመኞች ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ተነሡ ድምፄንም ስሙ፤ እናንተ ተማምናችሁ የምትቀመጡ ሴቶች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ተማምናችሁ የምትቀመጡ ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ወይንን መቍረጥ ይጠፋልና፥ ፍሬም ማከማቸት አይመጣምና ከዓመትና ከጥቂት ቀን በኋላ ትንቀጠቀጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird upon loins.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ዓለመኞች ሴቶች ሆይ፥ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ተማምናችሁም የምትቀመጡ ሆይ፥ ተንቀጥቀጡ፤ ልብሳችሁን አውልቁ፥ ዕራቁታችሁን ሁኑ፥ ወገባችሁንም በማቅ ታጠቁ።

verses.text_english: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ተወደደችውም እርሻ ስለሚያፈራውም ወይን ደረታችሁን ድቁ።

verses.text_english: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy the joyous city:
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቤ ምድር ላይ፥ በደስታ ከተማ ባሉት በደስታ ቤቶች ሁሉ ላይ እሾህና ኵርንችት ይወጣባቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.text_amharic: አዳራሹ ወና ትሆናለችና፥ የብዙ ሰውም ከተማ ትለቀቃለችና፥ አምባውና ግንቡም ለዘላለም ዋሻ፥ የምድረ በዳም አህያ ደስታ፥ የመንጎችም ማሰማርያ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም፥ መንፈስ ከላይ እስኪፈስስልን፥ ምድረ በዳውም ፍሬያማ እርሻ እስኪሆን፥ ፍሬያማውም እርሻ ዱር ተብሎ እስኪቈጠር ድረስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ በኋላ ፍርድ በምድረ በዳ ይኖራል፥ ጽድቅም በፍሬያማው እርሻ ያድራል።

verses.text_english: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቅም ሥራ ሰላም፥ የጽድቅም ፍሬ ለዘላለም ጸጥታና መታመን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤም በሰላም ማደሪያ በታመነም ቤት በጸጥተኛ ማረፊያ ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.text_amharic: በረዶ ግን በዱር ላይ ይወርዳል፥ ከተማም ፈጽማ ትዋረዳለች።

verses.text_english: Blessed ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የበሬና የአህያ እግር እየነዳችሁ በውኃ ሁሉ አጠገብ የምትዘሩ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ሳትጠፋ የምታጠፋ፥ በአንተም ላይ ወንጀል ሳይደረግ ወንጀል የምታደርግ ወዮልህ! ማጥፋትን በተውህ ጊዜ ትጠፋለህ፤ መወንጀልንም በተውህ ጊዜ ይወነጅሉሃል።

verses.text_english: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ማረን፤ አንተን ተማምነናል፤ ጥዋት ጥዋት ክንድ በመከራም ጊዜ ማዳን ሁነን።

verses.text_english: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍጅት ድምፅ ወገኖች ሸሹ፥ በመነሣትህም አሕዛብ ተበተኑ።

verses.text_english: And your spoil shall be gathered the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.text_amharic: አንበጣ እንደሚሰበስብ ምርኮአችሁ ትሰበሰባለች፥ ኩብኩባም እንደሚዘልል ሰዎች ይዘልሉበታል።

verses.text_english: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአርያም ተቀምጦአልና ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ጽዮንን በፍርድና በጽድቅ ሞላት።

verses.text_english: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD his treasure.
verses.text_amharic: የዘመንህም ጸጥታ፥ የመድኃኒት ብዛት፥ ጥበብና እውቀት ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት መዝገቡ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ኃይለኞቻቸው በሜዳ ይጮኻሉ፤ የሰላም መልእክተኞች መራራ ልቅሶ ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.text_english: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዶች ባድማ ሆኑ፥ ተላላፊም ቀረ፤ እርሱም ቃል ኪዳንን አፈረሰ ከተሞችንም ናቀ ሰውንም አልተመለከተም።

verses.text_english: The earth mourneth languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off .
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱ አለቀሰች ከሳችም፤ ሊባኖስ አፈረ ጠወለገም፤ ሳሮን እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሆነ፤ ባሳንና ቀርሜሎስ ቅጠላቸውን አረገፉ።

verses.text_english: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እነሣለሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አሁን እከበራለሁ፤ አሁን ከፍ ከፍ እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, fire, shall devour you.
verses.text_amharic: ገለባን ትፀንሳላችሁ፥ እብቅንም ትወልዳላችሁ፤ እስትንፋሳችሁ የምትበላችሁ እሳት ናት።

verses.text_english: And the people shall be the burnings of lime: thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም እንደ ተቃጠለ ኖራ፥ ተቈርጦም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠለ እሾህ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Hear, ye far off, what I have done; and, ye near, acknowledge my might.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በሩቅ ያላችሁ የሠራሁትን ስሙ፥ እናንተም በቅርብ ያላችሁ ኃይሌን እወቁ።

verses.text_english: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን ያሉ ኃጢአተኞች ፈሩ፤ መንቀጥቀጥ ዝንጉዎቹን ያዘ፤ ከምትበላ እሳት ጋር መኖርን የሚችል ከእኛ ማን አለ? ለዘላለምም ከምትነድድ እሳት ጋር መኖርን የሚችል ከእኛ ማን አለ?

verses.text_english: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅ የሚሄድ ቅን ነገርንም የሚናገር፥ በሽንገላ የሚገኝ ትርፍን የሚንቅ፥ መማለጃን ከመጨበጥ እጁን የሚያራግፍ፥ ደም ማፍሰስን ከመስማት ጆሮቹን የሚያደነቍር፥ ክፋትንም ከማየት ዓይኖቹን የሚጨፍን ነው።

verses.text_english: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters sure.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ከፍ ባለ ስፍራ ይቀመጣል፤ ጠንካራ አምባ መጠጊያው ይሆናል፤ እንጀራም ይሰጠዋል፥ ውኃውም የታመነች ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችህ ንጉሥን በውበቱ ያዩታል፤ እነርሱም በሩቅ ያለች ምድርን ያዩአታል።

verses.text_english: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where the scribe? where the receiver? where he that counted the towers?
verses.text_amharic: ልብህም። ጸሐፊ ወዴት አለ? መዛኝስ ወዴት አለ? ግንቦቹንስ የቈጠረ ወዴት አለ? ብሎ የሚያስፈራ ነገር ያስባል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, not understand.
verses.text_amharic: ጨካኝን ሕዝብ፥ ቋንቋው ለማስተዋል ጥልቅ የሆነውንና አንደበቱ ለማስተዋል ጸያፍ የሆነውን ሕዝብ፥ አታይም።

verses.text_english: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.text_amharic: የበዓላችንን ከተማ ጽዮንን ተመልከት፤ ዓይኖችህ የሰላም ማደሪያ፥ ካስማውም ለዘላለም የማይነቀል አውታሩም ሁሉ የማይበጠስ፥ የማይወገድ ድንኳን የሆነውን ኢየሩሳሌምን ያያሉ።

verses.text_english: But there the glorious LORD unto us a place of broad rivers streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በዚያ የሰፉ ወንዞችና የመስኖች ስፍራ ሆኖ ከእኛ ጋር በግርማ ይሆናል፤ የሚቀዘፉ መርከቦች አይገቡባትም፥ ታላላቆችም መርከቦች አያልፉባትም።

verses.text_english: For the LORD our judge, the LORD our lawgiver, the LORD our king; he will save us.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ፈራጃችን ነው፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕግን ሰጪያችን ነው፥ እግዚአብሔር ንጉሣችን ነው፤ እርሱ ያድነናል።

verses.text_english: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.text_amharic: ገመዶችህ ላልተዋል፥ ደቀላቸውንም አላጸኑም፥ ሸራውንም መዘርጋት አልቻሉም። በዚያም ጊዜ የብዙ ምርኮ ብዝበዛ ተከፈለ፤ አንካሶች እንኳ ብዝበዛውን በዘበዙ።

verses.text_english: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein forgiven iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የሚቀመጥ። ታምሜአለሁ አይልም፥ በእርስዋም ለሚቀመጡ ሰዎች በደላቸው ይቅር ይባልላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ቅረቡ፥ ስሙ፤ እናንተ ወገኖች ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤ ምድርና ሙላዋ፥ ዓለምና ከእርስዋ የሚወጣ ሁሉ ይስሙ።

verses.text_english: For the indignation of the LORD upon all nations, and fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ መዓቱም በሠራዊታቸው ሁሉ ላይ ነው፤ ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው፥ ለመታረድም አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የተገደሉት ይጣላሉ፥ የሬሳቸውም ግማት ይሸታል፥ ተራሮችም ከደማቸው የተነሣ ይርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling from the fig tree.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ይበሰብሳሉ፥ ሰማያትም እንደ መጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ይጠቀለላሉ፥ ከወይንና ከበለስም ቅጠል እንደሚረግፍ ሠራዊታቸው ሁሉ ይረግፋል።

verses.text_english: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፌ በሰማይ ሆና እስክትረካ ድረስ ጠጥታለች፤ እነሆ፥ በኤዶምያስና በረገምሁት ሕዝብ ላይ ለፍርድ ትወርዳለች።
