verses.text_english: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት በባሶራ፥ ታላቅም እርድ በኤዶምያስ ምድር አለውና የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ በደም ተሞልታለች፥ በስብም፥ በበግ ጠቦትና በፍየል ደምም፥ በአውራም በግ ኵላሊት ስብ ወፍራለች።

verses.text_english: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.text_amharic: ጎሽ ከእነርሱ ጋር፥ ወይፈኖችም ከኮርማዎች ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ ምድራቸውም በደም ትረካለች፥ አፈራቸውም በስብ ትወፍራለች።

verses.text_english: For the day of the LORD'S vengeance, the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር የበቀሉ ቀን፥ ስለ ጽዮንም ክርክር የብድራት ዓመት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.text_amharic: የኤዶምያስም ፈሳሾች ዝፍት ሆነው ይለወጣሉ፥ አፈርዋም ዲን ይሆናል፥ መሬትዋም የሚቀጠል ዝፍት ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊትና በቀንም አትጠፋም፥ ጢስዋም ለዘላለም ይወጣል፤ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድም ድረስ ባድማ ሆና ትኖራለች፤ ለዘላለም ዓለም ማንም አያልፍባትም።

verses.text_english: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.text_amharic: ጭልፊትና ጃርት ግን ይወርሱአታል፤ ጕጕትና ቍራም ይኖሩባታል፤ በላይዋም የመፍረስ ገመድና የባዶነት ቱንቢ ይዘረጋባታል።

verses.text_english: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.text_amharic: መሳፍንቶችዋን ወደ መንግሥት ይጠራሉ፥ ነገር ግን ማንም አይገኝባትም፤ አለቆችዋም ሁሉ ምናምኖች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, a court for owls.
verses.text_amharic: በአዳራሾችዋም እሾህ በቅጥሮችዋም ሳማን አሜከላ ይበቅሉባታል፤ የቀበሮም ማደሪያና የሰጐን ስፍራ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.text_amharic: የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ከተኵሎች ጋር ይገናኛሉ፥ አጋንንትም እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠራራሉ፤ ጅንም በዚያ ትኖራለች ለእርስዋም ማረፊያ ታገኛለች።

verses.text_english: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዋሊያ ቤትዋን ትሠራለች እንቍላልም ትጥላለች ትቀፈቅፈውማለች ልጆችዋንም በጥላዋ ትሰበስባለች፤ በዚያም ደግሞ አሞራዎች እያንዳንዳቸው ከባልንጀሮቻቸው ጋር ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.text_english: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር መጽሐፍ ፈልጉ አንብቡም፤ አፌ አዝዞአልና፥ መንፈሱም ሰብስቦአቸዋልና ከእነዚህ አንዲት አትጠፋም፥ ባልንጀራውንም የሚያጣ የለም።

verses.text_english: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ዕጣ ጣለባቸው፥ እጁም በገመድ ከፈለችላቸው፤ ለዘላለም ይገዙአታል፥ ከትውልድም እስከ ትውልድ ድረስ ይቀመጡባታል።

verses.text_english: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.text_amharic: ምድረ በዳውና ደረቁ ምድር ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ በረሀውም ሐሤት ያደርጋል እንደ ጽጌ ረዳም ያብባል።

verses.text_english: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, the excellency of our God.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ያብባል በደስታና በዝማሬ ሐሤትን ያደርጋል፤ የሊባኖስ ክብር፥ የቀርሜሎስና የሳሮን ግርማ ይሰጠዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ክብር የአምላካችንንም ግርማ ያያሉ።

verses.text_english: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.text_amharic: የደከሙትን እጆች አበርቱ፥ የላሉትንም ጕልበቶች አጽኑ።

verses.text_english: Say to them of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come vengeance, God a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪ ልብ ላላቸው። እነሆ፥ አምላካችሁ በበቀል በእግዚአብሔርም ብድራት ይመጣልና፥ መጥቶም ያድናችኋልና በርቱ፥ አትፍሩ በሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም የዕውሮች ዓይን ይገለጣል፤ የደንቆሮችም ጆሮ ይከፈታል።

verses.text_english: Then shall the lame leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አንካሳ እንደ ሚዳቋ ይዘልላል፥ የድዳም ምላስ ይዘምራል፤ በምድረ በዳ ውኃ፥ በበረሀም ፈሳሽ ይፈልቃልና።

verses.text_english: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.text_amharic: ደረቂቱ ምድር ኵሬ፥ የጥማት መሬት የውኃ ምንጭ ትሆናለች፤ ቀበሮ የተኛበት መኖሪያ ልምላሜና ሸምበቆ ደንገልም ይሆንበታል።

verses.text_english: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጐዳናና መንገድ ይሆናል እርሱም የተቀደሰ መንገድ ይባላል፤ ንጹሐንም ያልሆኑ አያልፉበትም፥ ለንጹሐን ግን ይሆናል፤ ተላላፊዎችና ሰነፎች እንኳ አይስቱበትም።

verses.text_english: No lion shall be there, nor ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk :
verses.text_amharic: አንበሳም አይኖርበትም፥ ነጣቂ አውሬም አይወጣበትም፥ ከዚያም አይገኙም፤ የዳኑት ግን በዚያ ይሄዳሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የተቤዣቸው ይመለሳሉ እየዘመሩም ወደ ጽዮን ይመጣሉ፤ የዘላለም ደስታ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ሐሤትንና ደስታን ያገኛሉ፥ ኀዘንና ትካዜም ይሸሻሉ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በንጉሡ በሕዝቅያስ በአሥራ አራተኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ ተመሸጉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ወጥቶ ወሰዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ራፋስቂስን ከብዙ ሠራዊት ጋር ከለኪሶ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላከ፥ እርሱም በአጣቢው እርሻ መንገድ ባለችው በላይኛይቱ ኵሬ መስኖ አጠገብ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱም አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ወደ እርሱ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence this wherein thou trustest?
verses.text_amharic: ራፋስቂስም አላቸው። ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ታላቁ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ የምትታመንበት መተማመኛ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: I say, , (but vain words) counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ። ለሰልፍ የሆነው ምክርህና ኃያልህ ከንቱ ነገር ነው አልሁ፤ አሁንም በእኔ ላይ ያመፅኸው በማን ተማምነህ ነው?

verses.text_english: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዚህ በተቀጠቀጠ በሸምበቆ በትር በግብጽ ትታመናለህ፤ ሰው ቢመረኰዘው ተሰብሮ በእጁ ይገባል ያቈስለውማል የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ለሚታመኑበት ሁሉ አንዲሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር እንታመናለን ብትለኝ፥ ሕዝቅያስ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን። በዚህ መሠዊያ ፊት ስገዱ ብሎ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹንና መሠዊያዎቹን ይስፈረሰ ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ከጌታዬ ከአሦር ንጉሥ ጋር ተወራረድ፥ የሚቀመጡባቸውንም ሰዎች ማግኘት ቢቻልህ እኔ ሁለት ሺህ ፈረሶች እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሰረገሎችና ስለ ፈረሶኞች በግብጽ ስትታመን፥ ከጌታዬ ባሪያዎች የሚያንሰውን የአንዱን አለቃ ፊት ትቃወም ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻልሃል?

verses.text_english: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በውኑ ያለ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይህን አገር አጠፋ ዘንድ ወጥቻለሁን? እግዚአብሔር። ወደዚህ አገር ወጥተህ አጥፋው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand : and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that on the wall.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያቄምና ሳምናስ ዮአስም ራፋስቂስን። እኛ እንሰማለንና እባክህ፥ በሶርያ ቋንቋ ለባሪያዎችህ ተናገር፤ በቅጥርም ላይ ባለው ሕዝብ ጆሮ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ አትናገረን አሉት።

verses.text_english: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? not to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.text_amharic: ራፋስቂስ ግን። ጌታዬ ይህን ቃል እናገር ዘንድ ወደ አንተና ወደ ጌታህ ልኮኛልን? ከእናንተ ጋር ኵሳቸውን ይበሉ ዘንድ ሽንታቸውንም ይጠጡ ዘንድ በቅጥር ላይ ወደ ተቀመጡት ሰዎች አይደለምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: ራፋስቂስም ቆሞ በታላቅ ድምፅ በአይሁድ ቋንቋ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኸ። የታላቁን የአሦርን ንጉሥ ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል። ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አይችልምና ሕዝቅያስ አያታልላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር በእርግጥ ያድነናል ይህችም ከተማ በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር እንድትታመኑ አያድርጋችሁ።

verses.text_english: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make with me a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስንም አትስሙ፤ የአሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ከእኔ ጋር ታረቁ ወደ እኔም ውጡ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከወይናችሁና ከበለሳችሁ ብሉ፥ ከጕድጓዳችሁም ውኃ ጠጡ፤

verses.text_english: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም መጥቼ ምድራችሁን ወደምትመስለው ምድር፥ እህልና የወይን ጠጅ፥ እንጀራና ወይን ወዳለበት ምድር እስካፈልሳችሁ ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም። እግዚአብሔር ያድነናል ብሎ እንዳያታልላችሁ ተጠንቀቁ። በውኑ የአሕዛብ አማልክት አገሮቻቸውን ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አድነዋቸዋልን?

verses.text_english: Where the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.text_amharic: የሐማትና የአርፋድ አማልክት ወዴት አሉ? የሴፈርዋይም አማልክት ወዴት አሉ? ሰማርያን ከእጄ አድነዋታልን?

verses.text_english: Who among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ከእጄ ያድን ዘንድ ከእነዚህ አገሮች አማልክት ሁሉ አገሩን ከእጄ ያዳነ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዝም አሉ፥ አንዳችም አልመለሱለትም፤ ንጉሡ አንዳይመልሱለት አዝዞ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱ አዛዥ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ ኤልያቄም ጸሐፊውም ሳምናስ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሳፍ ልጅ ዮአስ ልብሳቸውን ቀድደው ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጡ፥ የራፋስቂስንም ቃል ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard , that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ንጉሡ ሕዝቅያስ ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ፥ ማቅም ለበሰ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገባ።

verses.text_english: And he sent Eliakim, who over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱንም አዛዥ ኤልያቄምን ጸሐፊውንም ሳምናስን የካህናቱንም ሽማግሌዎች ማቅ ለብሰው ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ አሞጽ ልጅ ወደ ኢሳይያስ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ላካቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and not strength to bring forth.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ቀን የመከራና የተግሣጽ የዘለፋም ቀን ነው፤ ልጆች የሚወለዱበት ጊዜ ደርሶአል ለመውለድም ኃይል የለም።

verses.text_english: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባት በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ ጌታው የአሦር ንጉሥ የላከውን የራፋስቂስን ቃል አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይሰማ እንደ ሆነ፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰማው ቃል ይገሥጸው እንደ ሆነ፥ ስለዚህ ለቀረው ቅሬታ ጸልይ አሉት።

verses.text_english: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ የንጉሡ የሕዝቅያስ ባሪያዎች ወደ ኢሳይያስ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም። ለጌታችሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦር ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች ስለ ሰደቡኝ፥ ስለ ሰማኸው ቃል አትፍራ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በላዩ መንፈስን እሰድዳለሁ፥ ወሬንም ይሰማል፥ ወደ ምድሩም ይመለሳል፤ በምድሩም በሰይፍ እንዲወድቅ አደርጋለሁ በሉት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከለኪሶ እንደ ራቀ ሰምቶ ነበርና ራፋስቂስ ተመልሶ በልብና ሲዋጋ አገኘው።

verses.text_english: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard , he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የኢትዮጵያ ንጉሥ ቲርሐቅ ሊዋጋህ መጥቶአል የሚል ወሬ ሰማ። በሰማም ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፥

verses.text_english: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ሲል። ለይሁዳ ንጉሠ ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት። ኢየሩሳሌም በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ የምትታመንበት አምላክህ አያታልልህ።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የአሦር ነገሥታት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያደረጉትን፥ እንዴትስ እንዳጠፉአቸው ሰምተሃል፤ አንተስ ትድናለህን?

verses.text_english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which in Telassar?
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቼ ያጠፉአቸውን ጎዛንን፥ ካራንን፥ ራፊስን፥ በተላሳር የነበሩትንም የዔድንን ልጆች የአሕዛብ አማልክት አዳኑአቸውን?

verses.text_english: Where the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.text_amharic: የሐማት ንጉሥ፥ የአርፋድ ንጉሥ፥ የሴፈርዋይም ከተማ ንጉሥ፥ የሄናና የዒዋ ንጉሥ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ደብዳቤውን ከመልእክተኞች እጅ ተቀብሎ አነበበው፤ ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘረጋው።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest the cherubims, thou the God, thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ብቻህን የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አምላክ ነህ፤ ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጥረሃል።

verses.text_english: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን አዘንብልና ስማ፤ አቤቱ፥ ዓይንህን ክፈትና እይ፤ በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ የላከውን የሰናክሬም ቃል ስማ።

verses.text_english: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በእውነት የአሦር ነገሥታት ዓለሙን ሁሉ አገሮቻቸውንም አፍርሰዋል፥

verses.text_english: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.text_amharic: አማልክቶቻቸውንም በእሳት ላይ ጥለዋል፤ የእንጨትና የድንጋይ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ነበሩ እንጂ አማልክት አልነበሩምና ስለዚህ አጥፍተዋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou the LORD, thou only.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህም አምላካችን አቤቱ፥ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አንተ ብቻ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንህ ያውቁ ዘንድ ከእጁ አድነን።

verses.text_english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
verses.text_amharic: የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ብሎ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ላከ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ አሦር ንጉሥ ስለ ሰናክሬም ወደ እኔ ለምነሃልና

verses.text_english: This the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እርሱ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው። ድንግሊቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ቀላል አድርጋሃለች፥ በንቀትም ስቃብሃለች፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ ራስዋን ነቅንቃብሃለች።

verses.text_english: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የተገዳደርኸው የሰደብኸውስ ማን ነው? ቃልህንስ ከፍ ከፍ ያደረግህበት ዓይንህንስ ወደ ላይ ያነሣህበት ማን ነው? በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, the forest of his Carmel.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። በሰረገላዬ ብዛት ወደ ተራሮች ከፍታ፥ ወደ ሊባኖስ ጥግ ላይ ወጥቻለሁ፤ ረጃጅሞቹንም ዝግባዎች የተመረጡትንም ጥዶች እቈርጣለሁ፥ ወደ ከፍታውም ዳርቻ ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ዱር እገባለሁ።

verses.text_english: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
verses.text_amharic: ቈፈርሁም ውኃም ጠጣሁ የግብጽንም ወንዞች ሁሉ በእግሬ ጫማ አደርቃለሁ ብለህ በባሪያዎችህ እጅ በጌታ ላይ ተገዳደርህ።

verses.text_english: Hast thou not heard long ago, I have done it; of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities ruinous heaps.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ጥንቱን እንደ ሠራሁት፥ ቀድሞውንም እንዳደረግሁት አልሰማህምን? አሁንም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች የፍርስራሽ ክምር እስኪሆኑ ድረስ እንድታፈርስ አደረግሁህ።

verses.text_english: Therefore their inhabitants of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were the grass of the field, and the green herb, the grass on the housetops, and blasted before it be grown up.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የሚኖሩባቸው ሰዎች እጃቸው ዝሎአል፥ ደንግጠውም ታውከዋል፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሣር፥ እንደ ለመለመም ቡቃያ፥ በሰገነትም ላይ እንዳለ ሣር፥ ሳይሸት ዋግ እንደ መታው እህል ሆነዋል።

verses.text_english: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን መቀመጫህንና መውጫህን መግቢያህንም በእኔም ላይ የተቈጣኸውን ቍጣ አውቄአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣህና ትዕቢትህ ወደጆሮዬ ደርሶአልና ስለዚህ ስናጋዬን በአፍንጫህ ልጓሜንም በከንፈርህ አደርጋለሁ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ እመልስሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And this a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ምልክት ይሆንሃል፤ በዚህ ዓመት የገቦውን፥ በሁለተኛውም ዓመት ከገቦው የበቀለውን ትበላላችሁ፤ በሦስተኛውም ዓመት ትዘራላችሁ ታጭዱማላችሁ፥ ወይንም ትተክላላችሁ ፍሬውንም ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
verses.text_amharic: ያመለጠው የይሁዳ ቤት ቅሬታ ሥሩን ወደ ታች ይሰድዳል፥ ወደ ላይም ያፈራል።

verses.text_english: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢየሩሳሌም ቅሬታ ከጽዮንም ተራራ ያመለጡት ይወጣሉና፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት ይህን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ስለ አሦር ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል። ወደዚች ከተማ አይመጣም፥ ፍላጻንም አይወረውርባትም፥ በጋሻም አይመጣባትም፥ የአፈርንም ድልድል አይደለድልባትም።

verses.text_english: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በመጣበት መንገድ በዚያው ይመለሳል፥ ወደዚችም ከተማ አይመጣም ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እኔም ስለ ባሪያዬም ስለ ዳዊት ይህችን ከተማ አድናት ዘንድ እጋርዳታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they all dead corpses.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ወጣ፥ ከአሦራውያንም ሰፈር መቶ ሰማንያ አምስት ሺህ ገደለ፤ ማለዳም በተነሡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁሉ በድኖች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.text_amharic: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ተነሥቶ ሄደ፥ ተመልሶም በነነዌ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላኩም በናሳራክ ቤት ሲሰግድ ልጆቹ አድራሜሌክና ሳራሳር በሰይፍ ገደሉት፤ ወደ አራራትም አገር ኰበለሉ። ልጁም አስራዶን በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት ሕዝቅያስ ለሞት እስኪደርስ ታመመ። ነቢዩም የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትሞታለህ እንጂ በሕይወት አትኖርምና ቤትህን አስተካክል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ፊቱን ወደ ግድግዳው መልሶ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ በእውነትና በፍጹም ልብ እንደ ሄድሁ ደስ የሚያሰኝህንም እንዳደረግሁ ታስብ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ። ሕዝቅያስም እጅግ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ፥ ሕዝቅያስን እንዲህ በለው። የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፥ እንባህንም አይቻለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ በዕድሜህ ላይ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት አጨምራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
verses.text_amharic: አንተንና ይህችንም ከተማ ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ እታደጋለሁ፥ ይህችንም ከተማ እጋርዳታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And this a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የተገረውን ነገር እንዲፈጽመው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክቱ ይህ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በአካዝ የጥላ ስፍረ ሰዓት ላይ ከፀሐይ ጋር የወረደውን በደረጃዎች ያለውን ጥላ አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ እንዲመለስ አደርጋለሁ። ፀሐይም በጥላ ስፍረ ሰዓት ላይ የወረደበት አሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ታምሞ ከደዌው በተፈወሰ ጊዜ የጻፈው ጽሕፈት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ። በሕይወት ዘመኔ መካከል ወደ ሲኦል በሮች እገባለሁ፤ የቀረው ዘመኔ ጐደለብኝ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: I said, I shall not see the LORD, the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። በሕያዋን ምድር እግዚአብሔርን አላይም፤ በዓለምም ከሚኖሩ ጋር ሰውን እንግዲህ አልመለከትም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያዬ ተነቀለች፥ እንደ እረኛ ድንኳንም ከእኔ ዘንድ ተወገደች፤ ሕይወቴንም እንደ ሸማኔ ጠቀለልሁ፥ እርሱም ከመጠቅለያው ይቈርጠኛል፤ ከማለዳም ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ታጠፋኛለህ።

verses.text_english: I reckoned till morning, , as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.text_amharic: እስኪነጋ ድረስ ቈይቼ ነበር፤ እርሱ እንደ አንበሳ አጥንቴን ሁሉ ሰበረ፤ ከማለዳ ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ታጠፋኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Like a crane a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጨረባና እንደ ሽመላ ተንጫጫሁ፥ እንደ ርግብም አጕረመረምሁ፤ ዓይኖቼ ወደ ላይ ከማየት ደከሙ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተጨንቄአለሁና መከታ ሁነኝ።

verses.text_english: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.text_amharic: ምን እላለሁ? እርሱ ተናግሮኛል፥ እርሱ ራሱም ይህን አድርጎአል፤ በዘመኔ ሁሉ ስለ ነፍሴ ምሬት ቀስ ብዬ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: O Lord, by these live, and in all these the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ነገር ሰዎች በሕይወት ይኖራሉ፥ በዚህም ሁሉ የመንፈሴ ሕይወት ነው፤ አንተም ፈወስኸኝ ወደ ሕይወትም መለስኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ታላቅ ምሬት ለደኅንነቴ ሆነ፤ አንተም ነፍሴን ከጥፋት ጕድጓድ አዳንሃት፥ ኃጢአቴንም ሁሉ ወደ ኋላህ ጣልህ።

verses.text_english: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
verses.text_amharic: ሲኦል አያመሰግንህምና፥ ሞትም አያከብርህምና፤ ወደ ጕድጓዱ የሚወርዱ እውነትህን ተስፋ አያደርጉም።

verses.text_english: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ዛሬ አንደማደርግ ሕያዋን እነርሱ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ አባት ለልጆች እውነትህን ያስታውቃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያድነኛል፤ ስለዚህ በዕድሜያችን ዘመን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ቅኔዎችን አውታር ባለው ዕቃ እንዘምራለን።

verses.text_english: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም። የበለስ ጥፍጥፍ አምጥተው በእባጩ ላይ ይለብጡት፥ እርሱም ይፈወሳል ብሎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Hezekiah also had said, What the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም። ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እወጣ ዘንድ ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የባልዳን ልጅ መሮዳክ ባልዳን ሕዝቅያስ ታምሞ እንደ ተፈወሰ ሰምቶ ነበርና ደብዳቤና እጅ መንሻ ላከለት።

verses.text_english: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ደስ አለው፥ ግምጃ ቤቱንም፥ ብሩንና ወርቁንም፥ ቅመሙንና የከበረውንም ዘይት፥ መሣርያም ያለበትን ቤት ሁሉ፥ በቤተ መዛግብቱም የተገኘውን ሁሉ አሳያቸው፤ በቤቱና በግዛቱ ሁሉ ካለው ሕዝቅያስ ያላሳያቸው የለም።

verses.text_english: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, from Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ኢሳይያስ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መጥቶ። እነዚህ ሰዎች ምን አሉ? ከወዴትስ መጡልህ? አለው። ሕዝቅያስም። ከሩቅ አገር ከባቢሎን መጡልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በቤትህ ያዩት ምንድር ነው? አለው፤ ሕዝቅያስም። በቤቴ ያለውን ሁሉ አይተዋል፤ በቤተ መዛግብቴ ካለው ያላሳየኋቸው የለም አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
verses.text_amharic: ኢሳይያስም ሕዝቅያስን። የሠራዊትን ጌታ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, that all that in thine house, and which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በቤትህ ያለው ሁሉ፥ አባቶችህም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያከማቹት ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን የሚፈልስበት ወራት ይመጣል፤ ምንም አይቀርም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተም ከሚወጡት ከምትወልዳቸው ልጆችህ ማርከው ይወስዳሉ፤ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቤት ውስጥ ጃንደረቦች ይሆናሉ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን። የተናገርኸው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መልካም ነው አለው። ደግሞም። በዘመኔ ሰላምና እውነት ይሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.text_amharic: አጽናኑ፥ ሕዝቤን አጽናኑ ይላል አምላካችሁ።

verses.text_english: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD'S hand double for all her sins.
verses.text_amharic: ለኢየሩሳሌም ልብ ተናገሩ የተቀጠረችበት ወራት እንደ ተፈጸመ፥ ኃጢአትዋም እንደ ተሰረየ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም እጅ ስለ ኃጢአትዋ ሁሉ ሁለት እጥፍ እንደ ተቀበለች ወደ እርስዋ ጩኹ።

verses.text_english: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.text_amharic: የአዋጅ ነጋሪ ቃል። የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ በምድረ በዳ ጥረጉ፥ ለአምላካችንም ጐዳና በበረሀ አስተካከሉ።

verses.text_english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verses.text_amharic: ሸለቆው ሁሉ ከፍ ይላል፥ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይላል፤ ጠማማውም ይቃናል፥ ስርጓጕጡም ሜዳ ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ይገለጣል፥ ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ በአንድነት ያየዋል፥ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ይህን ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh grass, and all the goodliness thereof as the flower of the field:
verses.text_amharic: ጩኽ የሚል ሰው ቃል፤ ምን ብዬ ልጩኽ? አልሁ። ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ሣር ነው፥ ክብሩም ሁሉ እንደ ምድረ በዳ አበባ ነው።

verses.text_english: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people grass.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ይነፍስበታልና ሣሩ ይደርቃል አበባውም ይረግፋል፤ በእውነት ሕዝቡ ሣር ነው።

verses.text_english: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሣሩ ይደርቃል አበባውም ይረግፋል፥ የአምላካችን ቃል ግን ለዘላለም ጸንታ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
verses.text_amharic: የምስራች የምትነግሪ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ከፍ ወዳለው ተራራ ውጪ የምስራች የምትነግሪ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ድምፅሽን በኃይል አንሺ፤ አንሺ፥ አትፍሪ፤ ለይሁዳም ከተሞች። እነሆ፥ አምላካችሁ! ብለሽ ንገሪ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong , and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward with him, and his work before him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ኃያል ይመጣል ክንዱም ስለ እርሱ ይገዛል፤ እነሆ፥ ዋጋው ከእርሱ ጋር ደመወዙም በፊቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry in his bosom, shall gently lead those that are with young.
verses.text_amharic: መንጋውን እንደ እረኛ ያሰማራል፥ ጠቦቶቹን በክንዱ ሰብስቦ በብብቱ ይሸከማል፥ የሚያጠቡትንም በቀስታ ይመራል።

verses.text_english: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.text_amharic: ውኆችን በእፍኙ የሰፈረ፥ ሰማይንም በስንዝር የለካ፥ የምድርንም አፈር በመስፈሪያ ሰብስቦ የያዘ፥ ተራሮችን በሚዛን ኮረብቶችንም በሚዛኖች የመዘነ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or his counsellor hath taught him?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ ያዘዘ፥ ወይስ አማካሪ ሆኖ ያስተማረው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: With whom took he counsel, and instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ከማን ጋር ተመካከረ? ወይስ ማን መከረው? የፍርድንም መንገድ ማን አስተማረው? እውቀትንስ ማን አስተማረው? የማስተዋልንስ መንገድ ማን አሳየው?

verses.text_english: Behold, the nations as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አሕዛብ በገንቦ እንዳለች ጠብታ ናቸው፥ በሚዛንም እንዳለ ትንሽ ትቢያ ተቈጥረዋል፤ እነሆ፥ ደሴቶችን እንደ ቀላል ነገር ያነሣል።

verses.text_english: And Lebanon not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: ሊባኖስ ለማንደጃ እንስሶችዋም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አይበቁም።

verses.text_english: All nations before him as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁሉ በፊቱ እንዳልነበሩ ናቸው፤ ከምናምን እንደሚያንሱ፥ እንደ ከንቱ ነገርም ይቈጥራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔርን በማን ትመስሉታላችሁ? ወይስ በምን ምሳሌ ታስተያዩታላችሁ?

verses.text_english: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀረጸውንስ ምስል ሠራተኛ ሠርቶታል፥ አንጥረኛም በወርቅ ለብጦታል፥ የብሩንም ሰንሰለት አፍስሶለታል።

verses.text_english: He that so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, shall not be moved.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህ መባዕ ገንዘቡ ያልበቃው ድሀ የማይነቅዘውን እንጨት ይመርጣል፤ ምስሉም እንዳይናወጥ ያቆመው ዘንድ ብልህ ሠራተኛን ይፈልጋል።

verses.text_english: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.text_amharic: አላወቃችሁምን? ወይስ አልሰማችሁምን? ከጥንትስ አልተወራላችሁምን? ወይስ ምድር ከተመሠረተች ጀምሮ አላስተዋላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ በምድር ክበብ ላይ ይቀምጣል፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩት እንደ አንበጣ ናቸው፤ ሰማያትን እንደ መጋረጃ የሚዘረጋቸው እንደ ድንኳንም ለመኖርያ የሚዘረጋቸው፥

verses.text_english: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆችንም እንዳልነበሩ፥ የምድርንም ፈራጆች እንደ ከንቱ ነገር የሚያደርጋቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
verses.text_amharic: ገና እንደ ተተከሉና እንደ ተዘሩ፥ በምድርም ሥር ገና እንደ ሰደዱ ወዲያውኑ ነፈሰባቸው፥ እነርሱም ደረቁ፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደ እብቅ ጠረጋቸው።

verses.text_english: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እተካከለው ዘንድ በማን መሰላችሁኝ? ይላል ቅዱሱ።

verses.text_english: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these , that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that strong in power; not one faileth.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይናችሁን ወደ ላይ አንሥታችሁ ተመልከቱ፤ እነዚህን የፈጠረ ማን ነው? ሠራዊታቸውን በቍጥር የሚያወጣ እርሱ ነው፥ ሁሉንም በየስማቸው ይጠራቸዋል፤ በኃይሉ ብዛትና በችሎቱ ብርታት አንድስ እንኳ አይታጣውም።

verses.text_english: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ እስራኤልም ሆይ። መንገዴ ከእግዚአብሔር ተሰውራለች ፍርዴም ከአምላኬ አልፋለች ለምን ትላለህ? ለምንስ እንዲህ ትናገራለህ?

verses.text_english: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? no searching of his understanding.
verses.text_amharic: አላወቅህምን? አልሰማህምን? እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም አምላክ፥ የምድርም ዳርቻ ፈጣሪ ነው፤ አይደክምም፥ አይታክትም፥ ማስተዋሉም አይመረመርም።

verses.text_english: He giveth power to the faint; and to no might he increaseth strength.
verses.text_amharic: ለደካማ ኃይልን ይሰጣል፥ ጕልበት ለሌለውም ብርታትን ይጨምራል።

verses.text_english: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴኖች ይደክማሉ ይታክቱማል፥ ጐበዛዝቱም ፈጽሞ ይወድቃሉ፤

verses.text_english: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ ግን ኃይላቸውን ያድሳሉ፤ እንደ ንስር በክንፍ ይወጣሉ፤ ይሮጣሉ፥ አይታክቱም፤ ይሄዳሉ፥ አይደክሙም።

verses.text_english: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ደሴቶች ሆይ፥ በፊቴ ዝም በሉ፤ አሕዛብም ኃይላቸውን ያድሱ፤ ይቅረቡም በዚያን ጊዜም ይናገሩ፤ ለፍርድ ለአንድነት እንቅረብ።

verses.text_english: Who raised up the righteous from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made rule over kings? he gave as the dust to his sword, as driven stubble to his bow.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሥራቅ አንዱን ያስነሣ በጽድቅም ወደ እግሩ የተጠራው ማን ነው? አሕዛብንም አሳልፎ በፊቱ ሰጠው፥ ነገሥታትንም አስገዛለት፤ ለሰይፉ እንደ ትቢያ ለቀስቱም እንደ ተጠረገ እብቅ አድርጎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: He pursued them, passed safely; by the way he had not gone with his feet.
verses.text_amharic: አሳደዳቸው፥ እግሮቹም አስቀድመው ባልሄዱባት መንገድ በደኅነት አለፈ።

verses.text_english: Who hath wrought and done , calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I he.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን የሠራና ያደረገ፥ ትውልድንም ከጥንት የጠራ ማን ነው? እኔ እግዚአብሔር፥ ፊተኛው በኋላኞችም ዘንድ የምኖር እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: The isles saw , and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
verses.text_amharic: ደሴቶች አይተው ፈሩ፥ የምድርም ዳርቾች ተንቀጠቀጡ፤ ቀረቡም ደረሱም።

verses.text_english: They helped every one his neighbour; and said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራውን ይረዳው ነበር፥ ወንድሙንም። አይዞህ ይለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, he that smootheth the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, it should not be moved.
verses.text_amharic: አናጢውም አንጥረኛውን፥ በመዶሻም የሚያሳሳውን መስፍ መችውን አጽናና፥ ስለ ማጣበቅ ሥራውም። መልካም ነው አለ፤ እንዳይንቀሳቀስም በችንካር አጋጠመው።

verses.text_english: But thou, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዬ እስራኤል፥ የመረጥሁህ ያዕቆብ፥ የወዳጄ የአብርሃም ዘር ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ከምድር ዳርቻ የያዝሁህ ከማዕዘንዋም የጠራሁህና። አንተ ባሪያዬ ነህ፥ መርጬሃለሁ አልጥልህም ያልሁህ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Fear thou not; for I with thee: be not dismayed; for I thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍራ፤ እኔ አምላክህ ነኝና አትደንግጥ፤ አበረታሃለሁ፥ እረዳህማለሁ፥ በጽድቄም ቀኝ ደግፌ እይዝሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ የሚቆጡህ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፥ ይዋረዱማል፤ የሚከራከሩህም እንዳልነበሩ ይሆናሉ፥ ይጠፉማል።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያጣሉህንም ትሻቸዋለህ አታገኛቸውምም፥ የሚዋጉህም እንዳልነበሩና እንደ ምናምን ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር። አትፍራ፥ እረዳሃለሁ ብዬ ቀኝህን እይዛለሁና።

verses.text_english: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ትል ያዕቆብ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ አትፍሩ፤ እረዳሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የሚቤዥህም የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንደ ተሳለች እንደ አዲስ ባለ ጥርስ ማሄጃ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ተራሮችንም ታሄዳለህ ታደቅቃቸውማለህ፥ ኮረብቶችንም እንደ ገለባ ታደርጋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ታበጥራቸዋለህ፥ ነፋስም ይጠርጋቸዋል፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ይበትናቸዋል፤ አንተም በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይልሃል፥ በእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ትመካለህ።

verses.text_english: the poor and needy seek water, and none, their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.text_amharic: ድሆችና ምስኪኖችም ውኃ ይሻሉ አያገኙምም፥ ምላሳቸውም በጥማት ደርቋል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እሰማቸዋለሁ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ እኔ አልተዋቸውም።

verses.text_english: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.text_amharic: በወናዎቹ ኮረብቶች ላይ ወንዞችን፥ በሸለቆችም መካከል ምንጮችን እከፍታለሁ፤ ምድረ በዳውን ለውኃ መቆሚያ፥ የጥማትንም ምድር ለውኃ መፍለቂያ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, the pine, and the box tree together:
That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.text_amharic: ክርክራችሁን አቅርቡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ማስረጃችሁን አምጡ፥ ይላል የያዕቆብ ንጉሥ።

verses.text_english: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong , saith the King of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ያምጡ፥ የሚሆነውንም ይንገሩን፤ ልብም እናደርግ ዘንድ ፍጻሜአቸውንም እናውቅ ዘንድ፥ የቀደሙት ነገሮች ምን እንደ ሆኑ ተናገሩ፥ የሚመጡትንም አሳዩን።

verses.text_english: Let them bring forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they , that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
verses.text_amharic: አማልክትም መሆናችሁን እናውቅ ዘንድ በኋላ የሚመጡትን ተናገሩ፤ እንደነግጥም ዘንድ በአንድነትም እናይ ዘንድ መልካሙን ወይም ክፉውን አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold together.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንዳልነበረ ናችሁ፥ ሥራችሁም ከንቱ ነው፤ የሚመርጣችሁም አስጻያፊ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, ye of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination chooseth you.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱን ከሰሜን አነሣሁ መጥቶአልም፤ አንዱም ከፀሐይ መውጫ ስሜን የሚጠራ ይመጣል፤ በጭቃ ላይ እንደሚመጣ ሰው አፈርም እንደሚረግጥ ሸክለኛ በአለቆች ላይ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: I have raised up from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.text_amharic: እናውቅ ዘንድ ከጥንት የተናገረው። እውነት ነው እንልም ዘንድ ቀድሞ የተናገረው ማን ነው? የሚናገር የለም፥ የሚገልጥም የለም፥ ቃላችሁንም የሚሰማ የለም።

verses.text_english: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, righteous? yea, none that sheweth, yea, none that declareth, yea, none that heareth your words.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያ ለጽዮን። እነኋቸው እላለሁ፤ ለኢየሩሳሌምም የምስራች ነጋሪን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: The first to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
verses.text_amharic: ብመለከት ማንም አልነበረም፤ ብጠይቃቸውም የሚመልስልኝ አማካሪ በመካከላቸው የለም።

verses.text_english: For I beheld, and no man; even among them, and no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እነርሱ ሁሉ ከንቱዎች ናቸው፥ ሥራቸውም ምንምን ናት፤ ቀልጠው የተሠሩት ምስሎቻቸውም ነፋስና ኢምንት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ ደግፌ የያዝሁት ባሪያዬ፤ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ምርጤ፤ በእርሱ ላይ መንፈሴን አድርጌአለሁ፥ እርሱም ለአሕዛብ ፍርድን ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.text_amharic: አይጮኽም ቃሉንም አያነሣም፥ ድምፁንም በሜዳ አያሰማም።

verses.text_english: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀጠቀጠን ሸምበቆ አይሰብርም፥ የሚጤስንም ክር አያጠፋም፤ በእውነት ፍርድን ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ፍርድን እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ይበራል እንጂ አይጠፋም፤ አሕዛብም በስሙ ይታመናሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትን የፈጠረ የዘረጋቸውም፥ ምድርንና በውስጥዋ ያለውን ያጸና፥ በእርስዋ ላይ ለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ እስትንፋስን፥ ለሚሄዱባትም መንፈስን የሚሰጥ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር በጽድቅ ጠርቼሃለሁ፥ እጅህንም እይዛለሁ እጠብቅህማለሁ፥ የዕውሩንም ዓይን ትከፍት ዘንድ የተጋዘውንም ከግዞት ቤት በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን ከወህኒ ቤት ታወጣ ዘንድ ለሕዝብ ቃል ኪዳን ለአሕዛብም ብርሃን አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD: that my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ስሜ ይህ ነው፤ ክብሬን ለሌላ፥ ምስጋናዬንም ለተቀረጹ ምስሎች አልሰጥም።

verses.text_english: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የቀድሞው ነገር ተፈጸመ፥ አዲስ ነገርንም እናገራለሁ፤ አስቀድሞም ሳይበቅል እርሱን አስታውቃችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD a new song, his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባሕር የምትወርዱ በእርስዋም ውስጥ ያላችሁ ሁሉ፥ ደሴቶችና በእነርሱም ላይ የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ መዝሙር፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ ምስጋናውን ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up , the villages Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: ምድረ በዳውና ከተሞቹ የቄዳርም ሰዎች የሚቀመጡባቸው መንደሮች ድምፃቸውን ያንሡ፤ በሴላ የሚኖሩ እልል ይበሉ፥ በተራሮችም ራስ ላይ ሆነው ይጩኹ።

verses.text_english: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ይስጡ፥ ምስጋናውንም በደሴቶች ይናገሩ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ኃያል ይወጣል እንደ ሰልፈኛም ቅንዓትን ያስነሣል፤ ይጮኻል ድምፁንም ያሰማል በጠላቶቹም ላይ ይበረታል።

verses.text_english: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, refrained myself: will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.text_amharic: ከድሮ ዘመን ጀምሮ ዝም ብያለሁ፥ ዝም ብዬም ታግሻለሁ፤ አሁን ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት እጮኻለሁ፤ አጠፋለሁ በአንድነትም እጨርሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮችንና ኮረብቶችን አፈርሳለሁ፥ ቡቃያዎቻቸውንም ሁሉ አደርቃለሁ፤ ወንዞችንም ደሴቶች አደርጋለሁ፥ ኵሬዎችንም አደርቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring the blind by a way they knew not; I will lead them in paths they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውሮችንም በማያውቋት መንገድ አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ በማያውቋትም ጎዳና እመራቸዋለሁ፤ በፊታቸውም ጨለማውን ብርሃን አደርጋለሁ፥ ጠማማውንም አቀናለሁ። ይህን አደርግላቸዋለሁ፥ አልተዋቸውምም።

verses.text_english: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye our gods.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀረጹትም ምስሎች የሚታመኑ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም ምስሎች። አምላኮቻችን ናችሁ የሚሉ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሳሉ ፈጽመውም ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደንቆሮች፥ ስሙ፤ እናንተም ዕውሮች፥ ታዩ ዘንድ ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: Who blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger I sent? who blind as perfect, and blind as the LORD'S servant?
verses.text_amharic: ከባሪያዬ በቀር ዕውር ማን ነው? እንደምልከው መልእክተኛዬስ በቀር ደንቆሮ የሆነ ማን ነው? እንደ ፍጹሙ ወይስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ዕውር የሆነ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ነገርን ታያላችሁ ነገር ግን አትጠባበቁትም፤ ጆሮአችሁም ተከፍተዋል፥ ነገር ግን አትሰሙም።

verses.text_english: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make honourable.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ጽድቁ ሕጉን ታላቅ ያደርግና ያከብር ዘንድ ወደደ።

verses.text_english: But this a people robbed and spoiled; all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ግን የተበዘበዘና የተዘረፈ ሕዝብ ነው፤ ሁላቸው በዋሻ ውስጥ ተጠምደዋል በግዞት ቤትም ተሸሽገዋል፤ ብዝበዛ ሆነዋል የሚያድንም የለም፥ ምርኮም ሆነዋል፥ ማንም። መልሱ አይልም።

verses.text_english: Who among you will give ear to this? will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.text_amharic: ከመካከላችሁ ይህን የሚያደምጥ፥ ለሚመጣውም ጊዜ የሚያደምጥና የሚሰማ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብን ለማረኩ እስራኤልንም ለበዘበዙ ሰዎች የሰጠ ማን ነው? እኛ የበደልነው፥ እነርሱም በመንገዱ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ያልወደዱት ለሕጉም ያልታዘዙለት እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid not to heart.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የቍጣውን መዓትና የሰልፉን ጽናት አፈሰሰበት፤ በዙሪያም አነደደው እርሱ ግን አላወቀም፥ አቃጠለውም እርሱ ግን ልብ አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called by thy name; thou mine.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ የፈጠረህ፥ እስራኤልም ሆይ፥ የሠራህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ተቤዥቼሃለሁና አትፍራ፤ በስምህም ጠርቼሃለሁ፥ አንተ የእኔ ነህ።

verses.text_english: When thou passest through the waters, I with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: በውኃ ውስጥ ባለፍህ ጊዜ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ በወንዞችም ውስጥ ባለፍህ ጊዜ አያሰጥሙህም፤ በእሳትም ውስጥ በሄድህ ጊዜ አትቃጠልም፥ ነበልባሉም አይፈጅህም።

verses.text_english: For I the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መድኃኒትህ ነኝ፤ ግብጽን ለአንተ ቤዛ አድርጌ፥ ኢትዮጵያንና ሳባንም ለአንተ ፋንታ ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይኔ ፊት የከበርህና የተመሰገንህ ነህና፥ እኔም ወድጄሃለሁና ስለዚህ ሰዎችን ለአንተ አሕዛብንም ለነፍስህ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Fear not: for I with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍራ፤ ዘርህንም ከምሥራቅ አመጣዋለሁ፥ ከምዕራብም እሰበስብሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰሜንን። መልሰህ አምጣ፥ ደቡብንም። አትከልክል፤ ወንዶች ልጆቼን ከሩቅ ሴቶች ልጆቼንም ከምድር ዳርቻ፥ በስሜ የተጠራውን ለክብሬም የፈጠርሁትን፥ የሠራሁትንና ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ አምጣ እለዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖች ያሉአቸውን ዕውሮችን ሕዝብ፥ ጆሮችም ያሉአቸውን ደንቆሮቹን አውጣ።

verses.text_english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, truth.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁሉ በአንድነት ይሰብሰቡ ወገኖችም ይከማቹ፤ ከመካከላቸው፤ ይህን የሚናገር፥ የቀድሞውንስ ነገር የሚያሳየን ማን ነው? ይጸድቁ ዘንድ ምስክሮቻቸውን ያምጡ፥ ሰምተውም እውነት ነው ይበሉ።

verses.text_english: Ye my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.text_amharic: ታውቁና ታምኑብኝ ዘንድ እኔም እንደሆንሁ ታስተውሉ ዘንድ፥ እናንተ የመረጥሁትም ባሪያዬ ምስክሮቼ ናችሁ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከእኔ በፊት አምላክ አልተሠራም ከእኔም በኋላ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: I, I, the LORD; and beside me no saviour.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከእኔ ሌላም የሚያድን የለም።

verses.text_english: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when no strange among you: therefore ye my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I God.
verses.text_amharic: ተናግሬአለሁ አድኜማለሁ አሳይቼማለሁ፥ በእናንተም ዘንድ ባዕድ አምላክ አልነበረም፤ ስለዚህ እናንተ ምስክሮቼ ናችሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እኔም አምላክ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Yea, before the day I he; and none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንት ጀምሮ እኔ ነኝ ከእጄም የሚያመልጥ የለም፤ እሠራለሁ፥ የሚከለክልስ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry in the ships.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ የሚቤዣችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ እናንተ ወደ ባቢሎን ሰድጃለሁ፥ ከለዳውያንንም ሁሉ ስደተኞች አድርጌ በሚመኩባቸው መርከቦች አዋርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱሳችሁ፥ የእስራኤል ፈጣሪ፥ ንጉሣችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በባሕር ውስጥ መንገድን በኃይለኛም ውኃ ውስጥ መተላለፊያን ያደርጋል፤

verses.text_english: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሰረገላውንና ፈረሱን ሠራዊቱንና አርበኛውን ያወጣል፤ እነርሱ ግን በአንድነት ተኝተዋል፥ አይነሡም፤ ቀርተዋል፥ እንደ ጥዋፍ ኩስታሪም ጠፍተዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.text_amharic: የፊተኛውን ነገር አታስተውሉ፥ የጥንቱንም ነገር አታስቡ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, rivers in the desert.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አዲስ ነገርን አደርጋለህ፤ እርሱም አሁን ይበቅላል፥ እናንተም አታውቁትምን? በምድረ በዳም መንገድን በበረሀም ወንዞችን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን አልጠራኸኝም፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ ዘንድ ደክመሃል።

verses.text_english: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በጎችህን አላቀረብህልኝም በሌላም መሥዋዕትህ አላከበርኸኝም፤ በእህልም ቍርባን አላስቸገርሁህም በዕጣንም አላደከምሁህም።

verses.text_english: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣንም በገንዘብ አልገዛህልኝም በመሥዋዕትህም ስብ አላጠገብኸኝም፤ ነገር ግን በኃጢአትህ አስቸገርኸኝ፥ በበደልህም አደከምኸኝ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: መተላለፍህን። ስለ እኔ ስል የምደመስስ እኔ ነኝ፤ ኃጢአትህንም አላስብም።

verses.text_english: I, I, he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
verses.text_amharic: አሳስበኝ፥ በአንድነትም ሆነን እንፋረድ፤ እንድትጸድቅ ነገርህን ተናገር።

verses.text_english: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛው አባትህ ኃጢአት ሠርቶአል፥ መምህሮችህም በድለውኛል።

verses.text_english: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የመቅደሱን አለቆች አረከስሁ፥ ያዕቆብንም እርግማን፥ እስራኤልንም ስድብ አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ የመረጥሁህም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.text_amharic: የፈጠረህ ከማኅፀንም የሠራህ የሚረዳህም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ የመረጥሁህም ይሹሩን ሆይ፥ አትፍራ።

verses.text_english: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verses.text_amharic: በተጠማ ላይ ውኃን በደረቅም መሬት ላይ ፈሳሾችን አፈስሳለሁና፤ መንፈሴን በዘርህ ላይ በረከቴንም በልጆችህ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ፥

verses.text_english: And they shall spring up among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
verses.text_amharic: በፈሳሾችም አጠገብ እንደሚበቅሉ እንደ አኻያ ዛፎች በሣር መካከል ይበቅላሉ።

verses.text_english: One shall say, I the LORD'S; and another shall call by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe his hand unto the LORD, and surname by the name of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ። እኔ የእግዚአብሔር ነኝ ይላል፥ ያም በያዕቆብ ስም ይጠራል፤ ይህም። እኔ የእግዚአብሔር ነኝ ብሎ በእጁ ይጽፋል በእስራኤልም የቁልምጫ ስም ይጠራል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I the first, and I the last; and beside me no God.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እግዚአብሔር፥ የሚቤዥም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ፊተኛ ነኝ እኔም ኋለኛ ነኝ፥ ከእኔ ሌላም አምላክ የለም።

verses.text_english: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ይነሣና ይጥራ ይናገርም፤ ከጥንት የፈጠርሁትን ሕዝብ ያዘጋጅልኝ፥ የሚመጣውም ነገር ሳይደርስ ይንገሩኝ።

verses.text_english: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared ? ye even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, no God; I know not .
verses.text_amharic: አትፍሩ አትደንግጡም፤ ከጥንቱ ጀምሬ አልነገርኋችሁምን? ወይስ አላሳየኋችሁምን? እናንተ ምስክሮቼ ናችሁ። ከእኔ ሌላ አምላክ አለን? አምባ የለም፤ ማንንም አላውቅም።

verses.text_english: They that make a graven image all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀረጸውን ምስል የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ከንቱዎች ናቸው፥ የወደዱትም ነገር አይረባቸውም፤ ምስክሮቻቸውም አያዩምና አያውቁም፤ ስለዚህ ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image is profitable for nothing?
verses.text_amharic: አምላክን የሠራ ወይስ ለምንም የማይረባ ምስልን የቀረጸ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; they shall fear, they shall be ashamed together.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ባልንጀሮቹ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፥ ሠራተኞቹም ከሰዎች ወገን ናቸው፤ ሁላቸው ተሰብስበው ይቁሙ፤ ይፈራሉ በአንድነትም ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.text_amharic: ብረት ሠሪ መጥረቢያውን ይሠራል፥ በፍምም ውስጥ ያደርገዋል፥ በመዶሻም መትቶ ቅርጽ ይሰጠዋል፥ በክንዱም ኃይል ይሠራዋል፥ እርሱም ይራባል ይደክምማል፥ ውኃም አይጠጣም ይታክትማል።

verses.text_english: The carpenter stretcheth out rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
verses.text_amharic: ጠራቢውም ገመድ ይዘረጋል በበረቅም ያመለክተዋል በመቅረጫም ይቀርጸዋል በመለኪያም ይለካዋል፤ በቤትም ውስጥ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ በሰው አምሳልና በሰው ውበት ያስመስለዋል።

verses.text_english: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish .
verses.text_amharic: የዝግባን ዛፎች ይቈርጣል፤ የዞጲንና የኮምቦልን ዛፍ ይመርጣል፥ ከዱር ዛፎችም መካከል ይጠነክር ዘንድ ይተወዋል፤ የጥድንም ዛፍ ይተክላል ዝናብም ያበቅለዋል።

verses.text_english: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth , and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth ; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰውም ማገዶ ይሆናል፤ ከእርሱም ወስዶ ይሞቃል፥ አንድዶም እንጀራ ይጋግርበታል፤ ከእርሱም አምላክ አበጅቶ ይሰግድለታል፥ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ሠርቶ በእርሱ ፊት ይንበረከካል።

verses.text_english: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth , and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
verses.text_amharic: ግማሹን በእሳት ያቃጥላል፥ በዚያ በግማሹ ሥጋ ይበላል፥ ሥጋም ይጠብስበትና ይጠግባል፤ ይሞቃልና። እሰይ ሞቅሁ፥ እሳቱን አይቻለሁ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth , and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou my god.
verses.text_amharic: የቀረውንም እንጨት አምላክ አድርጎ ምስል ይቀርጽበታል፤ በፊቱም ተጐንብሶ ይሰግዳል ወደ እርሱም እየጸለየ። አምላኬ ነህና አድነኝ ይላል።

verses.text_english: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.text_amharic: አያውቁም፥ አያስቡም፤ እንዳያዩ ዓይኖቻቸውን፥ እንዳያስተውሉ ልቦቻቸውን ጨፍነዋል።

verses.text_english: And none considereth in his heart, neither knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten : and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.text_amharic: በልቡም ማንም አያስብም። ግማሽዋን በእሳት አቃጥያለሁ፥ በፍምዋም ላይ እንጀራን ጋግሬአለሁ፥ ሥጋም ጠብሼ በልቻለሁ፤ የቀረውንም አስጸያፊ ነገር አደርጋለሁን? ለዛፍስ ግንድ እሰግዳለሁን? እንዲልም እውቀትና ማስተዋል የለውም።

verses.text_english: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, not a lie in my right hand?
verses.text_amharic: አመድ ይበላል፥ የተታለለ ልብ አስቶታል፥ ነፍሱን ለማዳን አይችልም፥ ወይም። በቀኝ እጄ ሐሰት አለ አይልም።

verses.text_english: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou my servant: I have formed thee; thou my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አንተም እስራኤል፥ ባሪያዬ ነህና ይህን አስብ፤ እኔ ሠርቼሃለሁ አንተም ባሪያዬ ነህ፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ ዘንድ ያልተረሳ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verses.text_amharic: መተላለፍህን እንደ ደመና፥ ኃጢአትህንም እንደ ጭጋግ ደምስሼአለሁ፤ ተቤዥቼሃለሁና ወደ እኔ ተመለስ።

verses.text_english: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done : shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር አድርጎታልና ዘምሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ተቤዥቶአልና፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ይከበራልና አንተ የምድር ጥልቅ ሆይ፥ ጩኽ፤ እናንተም ተራሮች አንተም ዱር በአንተም ያለ ዛፍ ሁሉ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I the LORD that maketh all ; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
verses.text_amharic: ከማኅፀን የሠራህ፥ የሚቤዥህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ። ሁሉን የፈጠርሁ፥ ሰማያትን ለብቻዬ የዘረጋሁ ምድርንም ያጸናሁ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፤ ከእኔ ጋር ማን ነበረ?

verses.text_english: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.text_amharic: የሐሰተኞችን ምልክት ከንቱ አደርጋለሁ፥ ምዋርተኞችንም አሳብዳለሁ፥ ጥበበኞቹንም ወደ ኋላ እመልሳለሁ እውቀታቸውንም ስንፍና አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያዬን ቃል አጸናለሁ፥ የመልእክተኞቼንም ምክር እፈጽማለሁ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምን። የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆኛለሽ፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች። ትታነጻላችሁ ፍራሾቻችሁንም አቆማለሁ እላለሁ፤

verses.text_english: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
verses.text_amharic: ቀላዩንም። ደረቅ ሁን፥ ፈሳሾችህንም አደርቃለሁ እላለሁ፤

verses.text_english: That saith of Cyrus, my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
verses.text_amharic: ቂሮስንም። እርሱ እረኛዬ ነው፤ እርሱም ኢየሩሳሌምን ። ትታነጺያለሽ ቤተ መቅደስም ይመሠረታል ብሎ ፈቃዴን ሁሉ ይፈጽማል እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለቀባሁት፥ አሕዛብንም በፊቱ አስገዛ ዘንድ የነገሥታትንም ወገብ እፈታ ዘንድ፥ በሮቹም እንዳይዘጉ መዝጊያዎቹን በፊቱ እከፍት ዘንድ፥ ቀኝ እጁን ለያዝሁት ለቂሮስ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verses.text_amharic: በፊትህ እሄዳለሁ ተራሮችንም ትክክል አደርጋለሁ፥ የናሱንም ደጆች እሰብራለሁ የብረቱንም መወርወሪያዎች እቈርጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call by thy name, the God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በስምህም የምጠራህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቅ ዘንድ በጨለማ የነበረችውን መዝገብ በስውርም የተደበቀችውን ሀብት እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ያዕቆብ፥ ስለ መረጥሁትም ስለ እስራኤል ብዬ በስምህ ጠርቼሃለሁ፤ በቍልምጫ ስምህ ጠራሁህ፥ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም።

verses.text_english: I the LORD, and none else, no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that none beside me. I the LORD, and none else.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ ከእኔም ሌላ ማንም የለም፤ ከእኔም በቀር አምላክ የለም፤ በፀሐይ መውጫና በምዕራብ ያሉ ከእኔ በቀር ማንም ሌላ እንደሌለ ያውቁ ዘንድ አስታጠቅሁህ፥ አንተ ግን አላወቅኸኝም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፥ ከእኔም ሌላ ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these .
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንን ሠራሁ፥ ጨለማውንም ፈጠርሁ፤ ደኅንነትን እሠራለሁ፥ ክፋትንም እፈጥራለሁ፤ እነነዚህን ሁሉ ያደረግሁ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሰማያት ከላይ አንጠባጥቡ ደመናትም ጽድቅን ያዝንቡ፤ ምድርም ትከፈት መድኃኒትንም ታብቅል፥ ጽድቅም በአንድነት ይብቀል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ፈጥሬዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! the potsherd with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
verses.text_amharic: ከሠሪው ጋር ለሚታገል ወዮለት! በምድር ሸክላዎች መካከል ያለ ሸክላ ነው። ጭቃ ሠሪውን። ምን ትሠራለህ? ወይስ ሥራህ። እጅ የለውም ይላልን?

verses.text_english: Woe unto him that saith unto father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
verses.text_amharic: አባትን። ምን ወልደሃል? ወይም ሴትን። ምን አማጥሽ? ለሚል ወዮ!

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ሠሪውም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለሚመጣው ነገር ጠይቁኝ፥ ስለ ልጆቼና ስለ እጄ ሥራም እዘዙኝ።

verses.text_english: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ምድርን ሠርቻለሁ ሰውንም በእርስዋ ላይ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ እኔ በእጄ ሰማያትን ዘርግቼአለሁ፥ ሠራዊታቸውንም ሁሉ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.text_english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በጽድቅ አስነሥቼዋለሁ መንገዱንም ሁሉ አቀናለሁ፤ እርሱ ከተማዬን ይሠራል፥ በዋጋም ወይም በደመወዝ ሳይሆን ምርኮኞቼን ያወጣል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, , Surely God in thee; and none else, no God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። የግብጽ ድካምና የኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ቁመተ ረጅሞችም የሳባ ሰዎች ወደ አንተ ያልፋሉ፤ ለአንተም ይሆናሉ እጆቻቸውም ታስረው ይከተሉሃል፤ በፊትህም ያልፋሉ፥ ለአንተም እየሰገዱ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር በአንተ አለ፥ ከእርሱም ሌላ አምላክ የለም ብለው ይለምኑሃል።

verses.text_english: Verily thou a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ መድኃኒት ሆይ፥ በእውነት አንተ ራስህን የምትሰውር አምላክ ነህ።

verses.text_english: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together makers of idols.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ያፍራሉ ይዋረዱማል፥ ጣዖታትንም የሚሠሩ በአንድነት ወደ ውርደት ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን እስራኤልን በዘላለማዊ መድኃኒት ያድነዋል፥ እናንተም ለዘላለም አታፍሩምና አትዋረዱም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I the LORD; and none else.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትን የፈጠረ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱም ምድርን የሠራና ያደረገ ያጸናትም፥ መኖሪያም ልትሆን እንጂ ለከንቱ እንድትሆን ያልፈጠራት አምላክ፥ እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም።

verses.text_english: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.text_amharic: በስውር ወይም በጨለማ ምድር ስፍራ አልተናገርሁም፤ ለያዕቆብ ዘር። በከንቱ ፈልጉኝ አላልሁም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅን እናገራለሁ ቅንንም አወራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god cannot save.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ከአሕዛብ ወገን ሆናችሁ ያመለጣችሁ፥ ተሰብስባችሁ ኑ በአንድነትም ቅረቡ፤ የተቀረጸውን የምስላቸውን እንጨት የሚሸከሙና ያድን ዘንድ ወደማይችል አምላክ የሚጸልዩ እውቀት የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Tell ye, and bring near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? hath told it from that time? not I the LORD? and no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; none beside me.
verses.text_amharic: ይናገሩ ይቅረቡም በአንድነትም ይማከሩ፤ ከጥንቱ ይህን ያሳየ ከቀድሞስ የተናገረ ማን ነው? ያሳየሁም የተናገርሁም እኔ እግዚአብሔር አይደለሁምን? ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ የለም፤ እኔ ጻድቅ አምላክና መድኃኒት ነኝ፥ ከእኔም በቀር ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I God, and none else.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምድር ዳርቻ ሁሉ፥ እኔ አምላክ ነኝና፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለምና ወደ እኔ ዘወር በሉ ትድኑማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌ ከአፌ በጽድቅ ወጥታለች፥ አትመለስም። ጕልበት ሁሉ ለእኔ ይንበረከካል፥ ምላስም ሁሉ በእኔ ይምላል ብዬ በራሴ ምያለሁ።

verses.text_english: Surely, shall say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: to him shall come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እኔም። በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ብቻ ጽድቅና ኃይል አለ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሰዎች ይመጣሉ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቈጡ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ዘር ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ይጸድቃሉ፥ ይመካሉም ይባላል።

verses.text_english: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages heavy loaden; a burden to the weary .
verses.text_amharic: ቤል ተዋረደ፥ ናባው ተሰባበረ፤ ጣዖቶቻቸው በእንስሳና በከብት ላይ ተጭነዋል፤ ሸክሞቻችሁ ለደካማ እንስሳ ከባድ ጭነት ሆነዋል።

verses.text_english: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.text_amharic: ተጐነበሱ በአንድነትም ተዋረዱ፤ ሸክሙን ለማዳን አልቻሉም፥ ራሳቸው ግን ተማረኩ።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የያዕቆብ ቤት ሆይ፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ ከሆድ ያነሣኋችሁ ከማኅፀንም የተሸከምኋችሁ፥ ስሙኝ።

verses.text_english: And to old age I he; and to hoar hairs will I carry : I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver .
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ሽምግልና ድረስ እኔ ነኝ፥ እስከ ሽበትም ድረስ እሸከማችኋለሁ፤ እኔ ሠርቻለሁ እኔም አነሣለሁ፤ እኔ እሸከማለሁ እኔም አድናለሁ።

verses.text_english: To whom will ye liken me, and make equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.text_amharic: በማን ትመስሉኛላችሁ? ከማንስ ጋር ታስተካክሉኛላችሁ? እንመሳሰል ዘንድ ከማን ጋር ታስተያዩኛላችሁ?

verses.text_english: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.text_amharic: ወርቁን ከኮረጆ የሚያፈስሱ ብሩንም በሚዛን የሚመዝኑ እነርሱ አንጥረኛውን ይቀጥራሉ፥ እርሱም አምላክ አድርጎ ይሠራ ዋል፤ ለዚያም ይጐነበሱለታል ይሰግዱለትማል።

verses.text_english: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.text_amharic: በጫንቃቸው ላይ አንሥተው ይሸከሙታል በስፍራውም ያደርጉታል፥ በዚያም ይቆማል፥ ከስፍራውም ፈቀቅ አይልም፤ ሰውም ወደ እርሱ ቢጮኽ አይሰማውም ከመከራውም አያድነውም።

verses.text_english: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን አስቡና አልቅሱ፤ ተላላፊዎች ሆይ፥ ንስሐ ግቡ፥ ልባችሁንም መልሱ።

verses.text_english: Remember the former things of old: for I God, and none else; God, and none like me,
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አምላክ ነኝና፥ ሌላም የለምና የቀድሞውን የጥንቱን ነገር አስቡ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ እንደ እኔም ያለ ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times that are not done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያ መጨረሻውን፥ ከጥንትም ያልተደረገውን እነግራለሁ፤ ምክሬ ትጸናለች ፈቃዴንም ሁሉ እፈጽማለሁ እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken , I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed , I will also do it.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሥራቅ ነጣቂ ወፍን፥ ከሩቅም አገር ምክሬን የሚያደርገውን ሰው እጠራዋለሁ። ተናግሬአለሁ፤ እፈጽማለሁ፤ አስቤአለሁ አደርግማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that far from righteousness:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ከጽድቅ የራቃችሁ እልከኞች፥ ስሙኝ፤

verses.text_english: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቄን አቀርባለሁ፥ አይርቅም መድኃኒቴም አይዘገይም፤ ከጽዮን ለክብር እንዲሆን መድኃኒትን ለእስራኤል ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ድንግል የባቢሎን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ውረጂ በትቢያም ላይ ተቀመጪ፤ የከለዳውያን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ቅልጣናምና ቅምጥል አትባይምና ያለ ዙፋን በመሬት ላይ ተቀመጪ።

verses.text_english: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
verses.text_amharic: ወፍጮ ወስደሽ ዱቄትን ፍጪ፤ መሸፈኛሽን አውጪ ረጅሙንም ልብስሽን አውልቀሽ ጣዪው፤ ባትሽን ግለጪ፥ ወንዙን ተሻገሪ።

verses.text_english: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet a man.
verses.text_amharic: ኀፍረተ ሥጋሽ ይገለጣል እፍረትሽም ይታያል፤ እኔ እበቀላለሁ፥ ለማንም አልራራም።

verses.text_english: our redeemer, the LORD of hosts his name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ታዳጊያችን፥ ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
verses.text_amharic: የከለዳውያን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ከዚህ በኋላ። የመንግሥታት እመቤት አትባይምና ዝም ብለሽ ተቀመጪ ወደ ጨለማም ውስጥ ግቢ።

verses.text_english: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቤ ላይ ተቈጥቼ ነበር ርስቴንም አረከስሁ በእጅሽም አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው፤ ከእነርሱ ጋር ምሕረት አላደረግሽም፥ በሽማግሌዎቻቸው ላይ ቀንበርሽን እጅግ አክብደሻል።

verses.text_english: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: that thou didst not lay these to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺም። እኔ ለዘላለም እመቤት እሆናለሁ ብለሻል፤ ይህንም በልብሽ አላደረግሽም ፍጻሜውንም አላሰብሽም።

verses.text_english: Therefore hear now this, given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I , and none else beside me; I shall not sit a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም አንቺ ቅምጥል ተዘልለሽ የምትቀመጪ፥ በልብሽም። እኔ ነኝ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም፤ መበለትም ሆኜ አልኖርም የወላድ መካንነትንም አላውቅም የምትዪ ይህን ስሚ፤

verses.text_english: But these two shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በአንድ ቀን እነዚህ ሁለት ነገሮች፥ የወላድ መካንነትና መበለትነት፥ በድንገት ይመጡብሻል፤ ስለ መተቶችሽ ብዛትና ስለ አስማቶችሽ ጽናት ፈጽመው ይመጡብሻል።

verses.text_english: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I , and none else beside me.
verses.text_amharic: በክፋትሽ ታምነሻል፤ የሚያየኝ የለም ብለሻል፤ ጥበብሽና እውቀትሽ አታልለውሻል፥ በልብሽም። እኔ ነኝ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ የለም ብለሻል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, thou shalt not know.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምክንያት ክፉ ነገር ይመጣብሻል፥ በምዋርትሽም እንዴት እንደምታርቂው አታውቂም፤ ጉዳት ይውድቅብሻል ታስወግጅውም ዘንድ አይቻልሽም፤ የማትውቂያትም ጕስቍልና ድንገት ትመጣብሻለች።

verses.text_english: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባትም መጠቀም ትችዪ ወይም ታስደነግጪ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከአስማቶችሽና ከሕፃንነትሽ ጀምረሽ ከደከምሽበት ከመተቶችሽ ብዛት ጋር ቁሚ።

verses.text_english: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from that shall come upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: በምክርሽ ብዛት ደክመሻል፤ አሁንም የሰማይን ከዋክብት የሚቈጥሩ፥ ከዋክብትንም የሚመለከቱ፥ በየመባቻውም የሚመጣውን ነገር የሚናገሩ ተነሥተው ከሚመጣብሽ ነገር ያድኑሽ።
