verses.text_english: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: not a coal to warm at, fire to sit before it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንደ እብቅ ይሆናሉ፥ እሳትም ያቃጥላቸዋል ሰውነታቸውንም ከነበልባል ኃይል አያድኑም፤ እርሱም ሰው እንደሚሞቀው ፍም፥ ወይም በፊቱ ሰው እንደሚቀመጥበት እሳት ያለ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
verses.text_amharic: የደከምሽባቸው ነገሮች እንዲህ ይሆኑብሻል፤ ከሕፃንነትሽ ጀምረው ከአንቺ ጋር ይነግዱ የነበሩ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ ስፍራቸው ይሄዳሉ፥ የሚያድንሽም የለም።

verses.text_english: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በእስራኤል ስም የተጠራችሁ ከይሁዳም ውኆች የወጣችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የምትምሉ፥ በእውነት ሳይሆን በጽድቅም ሳይሆን የእስራኤልን አምላክ የምትጠሩ፥

verses.text_english: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts his name.
verses.text_amharic: በቅድስት ከተማ ስም የተጠራችሁ፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በሚባል በእስራኤል አምላክ የምትደገፉ፥ የያዕቆብ ቤት ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.text_english: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.text_amharic: የቀድሞውን ነገር ከጥንት ተናግሬአለሁ፥ ከአፌም ወጥቶአል አሳይቼውማለሁ፤ ድንገት አድርጌዋለሁ ተፈጽሞማል።

verses.text_english: Because I knew that thou obstinate, and thy neck an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.text_amharic: አንተ እልከኛ፥ አንገትህም የብረት ጅማት፥ ግምባርህም ናስ እንደሆነ አውቄአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I have even from the beginning declared to thee; before it came to pass I shewed thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ አንተ። ጣዖቴ ይህን አድርጎአል፥ የተቀረጸው ምስሌና ቀልጦ የተሠራው ምስሌ ይህን አዘዙኝ እንዳትል፥ አስቀድሜ ነግሬህ ነበር ሳይሆንም አሳይቼህ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare ? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰምተሃል፤ ይህን ሁሉ ተመልከት፤ እናንተም የምትናገሩት አይደላችሁምን? የተሰወሩትን ያላወቅሃቸውንም አዲሶች ነገሮችን ከዚህ ጀምሬ አሳይቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አሁን እንጂ ከጥንት አልተፈጠሩም፤ አንተም ። እነሆ፥ አውቄአቸዋለሁ እንዳትል ከዛሬ በፊት አልሰማሃቸውም።

verses.text_english: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.text_amharic: አልሰማህም፥ አላወቅህም፥ ጆሮህ ከጥንት አልተከፈተችም፤ አንተ ፈጽሞ ወንጀለኛ እንደ ሆንህ ከማኅፀንም ጀምረህ ተላላፊ ተብለህ እንደተጠራህ አውቄአለሁና።

verses.text_english: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ስሜ ቍጣዬን አዘገያለሁ፥ እንዳላጠፋህም ስለ ምስጋናዬ እታገሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አንጥሬሃለሁ ነገር ግን እንደ ብር አይደለም፤ በመከራም እቶን ፈትኜሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: For mine own sake, for mine own sake, will I do : for how should be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እኔ፥ ስለ ራሴ አደርገዋለሁ ስሜ ተነቅፎአልና፤ ክብሬንም ለሌላ አልሰጥም።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I he; I the first, I also the last.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ የጠራሁህም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፤ እኔ ነኝ፤ እኔ ፊተኛው ነኝ እኔም ኋለኛው ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.text_amharic: እጄም ምድርን መሥርታለች ቀኜም ሰማያትን ዘርግታለች፤ በጠራኋቸው ጊዜ በአንድነት ይቆማሉ።

verses.text_english: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these ? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሁሉ፥ በአንድነት ተሰብስባችሁ ስሙ፤ ከእነርሱ ይህን የተናገረ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር የወደደው ፈቃዱን በባቢሎን ላይ ያደርጋል፥ ክንዱም በከለዳውያን ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: I, I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ራሴ ተናግሬአለሁ፤ እኔ ጠርቼዋለሁ፤ አምጥቼዋለሁ፥ መንገዱም ትከናወንለታለች።

verses.text_english: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ ይህንም ስሙ፤ እኔ ከጥንት ጀምሬ በስውር አልተናገርሁም፤ ከሆነበት ዘመን ጀምሮ እኔ በዚያ ነበርሁ፥ አሁንም ጌታ እግዚአብሔርና መንፈሱ ልከውኛል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way thou shouldest go.
verses.text_amharic: ታዳጊህ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ። እኔ የሚረባህን ነገር የማስተምርህ በምትሄድባትም መንገድ የምመራህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዜን ብትሰማ ኖሮ፥ ሰላምህ እንደ ወንዝ ጽድቅህም እንደ ባሕር ሞገድ በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህም እንደ አሸዋ የሆድህም ትውልድ እንደ ምድር ትቢያ በሆነ ነበር፥ ስሙም ከፊቴ ባልጠፋና ባልፈረሰ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎን ውጡ ከከለዳውያንም ኰብልሉ፤ በእልልታ ድምፅ ተናገሩ ይህንም ንገሩ እስከ ምድርም ዳርቻ ድረስ አውሩና። እግዚአብሔር ባሪያውን ያዕቆብን ታድጎታል በሉ።

verses.text_english: And they thirsted not he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ በኩል በመራቸው ጊዜ አልተጠሙም፤ ውኃንም ከዓለቱ ውስጥ አፈለቀላቸው፥ ዓለቱንም ሰነጠቀ ውኃውም ፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ለክፉዎች ሰላም የላቸውም ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
verses.text_amharic: ደሴቶች ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፥ እናንተም በሩቅ ያላችሁ አሕዛብ፥ አድምጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከማኅፀን ጠርቶኛል፥ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ ስሜን አንሥቶአል፤

verses.text_english: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
verses.text_amharic: አፌንም እንደ ተሳለ ሰይፍ አድርጎአል፥ በእጁ ጥላ ሰውሮኛል፤ እንደ ተሳለ ፍላጻም አድርጎኛል፥ በሰገባውም ውስጥ ሽጎኛል።

verses.text_english: And said unto me, Thou my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ባሪያዬ ነህ በአንተም እከበራለሁ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: surely my judgment with the LORD, and my work with my God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን። በከንቱ ደከምሁ፥ ምንም ጥቅም ለሌለውና ለከንቱ ጕልበቴን ፈጀሁ፤ ፍርዴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ፥ ዋጋዬም በአምላኬ ዘንድ ነው አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ከብሬአለሁና፥ አምላኬም ጕልበት ሆኖኛልና ያዕቆብን ወደ እርሱ እንድመልስ እስራኤልንም ወደ እርሱ እንድሰበስብ ባሪያ እሆነው ዘንድ ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ የሠራኝ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የያዕቆብን ነገዶች እንድታስነሣ ከእስራኤልም የዳኑትን እንድትመስል ባሪያዬ ትሆን ዘንድ እጅግ ቀላል ነገር ነውና እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ መድኃኒት ትሆን ዘንድ ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን አድርጌ ሰጥቼሃለሁ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ታዳጊ ቅዱሱም፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ ሰዎች ለሚንቁት ሕዝብም ለሚጠላው ለገዥዎች ባሪያ እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ታማኙ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ስለ መረጠህም ስለ እስራኤል ቅዱስ ነገሥታት አይተው ይነሣሉ፥ መሳፍንትም አይተው ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በተወደደ ጊዜ ሰምቼሃለሁ፥ በመድኃኒትም ቀን ረድቼሃለሁ፤ እጠብቅህማለሁ፥ ምድርንም ታቀና ዘንድ፥ ውድማ የሆኑትንም ርስቶች ታወርስ ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures in all high places.
verses.text_amharic: የተጋዙትንም። ውጡ በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን። ተገለጡ ትል ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጌ ለሕዝቡ ሰጥቼሃለሁ። በመንገድም ላይ ይሰማራሉ፥ ማሰማርያቸውም በወና ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verses.text_amharic: የሚራራላቸውም ይመራቸዋልና፥ በውኃም ምንጮች በኩል ይነዳቸዋልና አይራቡም፥ አይጠሙም፥ ትኩሳት ወይም ፀሐይ አይጐዳቸውም።

verses.text_english: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮቼንም ሁሉ መንገድ አደርጋለሁ፥ ጎዳኖቼም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ ከሩቅ፥ እነሆም፥ እነዚህ ከሰሜንንና ከምዕራብ፥ እነዚህም ከሲኒም አገር ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አጽናንቶአልና፥ ለችግረኞቹም ራርቶአልና ሰማያት ሆይ፥ ዘምሩ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ ተራሮችም ሆይ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.text_english: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዮን ግን። እግዚአብሔር ትቶኛል ጌታም ረስቶኛል አለች።

verses.text_english: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ሴት ከማኅፀንዋ ለተወለደው ልጅ እስከማትራራ ድረስ ሕፃንዋን ትረሳ ዘንድ ትችላለችን? አዎን፥ እርስዋ ትረሳ ይሆናል፥ እኔ ግን አልረሳሽም።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of hands; thy walls continually before me.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ በእጄ መጻፍ ቀርጬሻለሁ፥ ቅጥሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችሽ ይፈጥናሉ፤ ያፈረሱሽና ያወደሙሽ ከአንቺ ዘንድ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, come to thee. I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them , as a bride .
verses.text_amharic: ዓይንሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እነዚህን ሁሉ እንደ ጌጥ ትለብሻቸዋለሽ፥ እንደ ሙሽራም ትጐናጸፊአቸዋለሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.text_amharic: ባድማሽና ውድማሽ ወናም የሆነው ምድርሽ ከሚኖሩብሽ የተሣ ዛሬ ጠባብ ትሆናለችና፥ የዋጡሽም ይርቃሉና።

verses.text_english: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.text_amharic: የወላድ መካን ከሆንሽ በኋላ የተወለዱልሽ ልጆችሽ በጆሮሽ። ስፍራ ጠብቦኛልና እቀመጥ ዘንድ ቦታ አስፊልኝ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where they ?
verses.text_amharic: አንቺም በልብሽ፥ የወላድ መካን ሆኛለሁና፥ እኔም ብቻዬን ተሰድጄአለሁና ተቅበዝበዤ አለሁምና እነዚህን ማን ወለደልኝ? እነዚህንስ ማን አሳደጋቸው? እነሆ፥ ብቻዬን ቀርቼ ነበር፤ እነዚህስ ወዴት ነበሩ? ትያለሽ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon shoulders.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እጄን ወደ አሕዛብ አነሣለሁ፥ ዓለማዬንም ወደ ወገኖች አቆማለሁ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽንም በብብታቸው ያመጡአቸዋል፥ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃቸው ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሥታትም አሳዳጊ አባቶችሽ ይሆናሉ፥ እቴጌዎቻቸውም ሞግዚቶችሽ ይሆናሉ፤ ግምባራቸውንም ወደ ምድር ዝቅ አድርገው ይሰግዱልሻል፥ የእግርሽንም ትቢያ ይልሳሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ፥ እኔንም በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ አያፍሩም።

verses.text_english: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ብዝበዛ ከኃያል እጅ ይወሰዳልን? ወይስ የጨካኙ ምርኮኞች ያመልጣሉን?

verses.text_english: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንዲህ ይላል። በኃያላን የተማረኩ ይወሰዳሉ፥ የጨካኞችም ብዝበዛ ያመልጣል፤ ከአንቺ ጋር የሚጣሉትን እጣላቸዋለሁ፥ ልጆችሽንም አድናለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: አስጨናቂዎችሽንም ሥጋቸውን አስበላቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ ጣፋጭም ወይን ጠጅ ደማቸውን ጠጥተው ይሰክራሉ፤ ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር መድኃኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ፥ የያዕቆብ ኃያል እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Where the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናታችሁን የፈታሁበት የፍችዋ ጽሕፈት የት አለ? ወይስ እናንተን የሸጥሁ ከአበዳሪዎች ለየትኛው ነው? እነሆ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁ ተሽጣችኋል፥ ስለ በደላችሁም እናታችሁ ተፈትታለች።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, when I came, no man? when I called, none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because no water, and dieth for thirst.
verses.text_amharic: በመጣሁስ ጊዜ ሰው ስለ ምን አልነበረም? በጠራሁስ ጊዜ የሚመልስ ስለ ምን አልነበረም? መታደግ እንዳትችል እጄ አጭር ሆናለችን? ወይስ ለማዳን ኃይል የለኝምን? እነሆ፥ በገሠጽሁ ጊዜ ባሕርን አደርቃለሁ፥ ወንዞችንም ምድረ በዳ አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤ ውኃም በማጣት ዓሦቻቸው ይገማሉ በጥማትም ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትን ጥቍረት አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥ መጋረጃቸውንም ማቅ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
verses.text_amharic: የደከመውን በቃል እንዴት እንደምደግፍ አውቅ ዘንድ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተማሩትን ምላስ ሰጥቶኛል ማለዳ ማለዳ ያነቃኛል፥ እንደ ተማሪዎችም ትሰማ ዘንድ ጆሮዬን ያነቃቃል።

verses.text_english: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጆሮዬን ከፍቶአል፥ እኔም ዓመፀኛ አልነበርሁም ወደ ኋላዬም አልተመለስሁም።

verses.text_english: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.text_amharic: ጀርባዬን ለገራፊዎች ጕንጬንም ለጠጕር ነጪዎች ሰጠሁ፥ ፊቴንም ከውርደትና ከትፋት አልመለስሁም።

verses.text_english: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛልና ስለዚህ አልታወክሁም፤ ስለዚህም ፊቴን እንደ ባልጩት ድንጋይ አድርጌዋለሁ፥ እንዳላፍርም አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያጸድቀኝ ቅርብ ነው፤ ከእኔስ ጋር የሚከራከር ማን ነው? በአንድነት እንቁም፤ የሚከራከረኝ ማን ነው? ወደ እኔ ይቅረብ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who he shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፤ ማን ይፈርድብኛል? እነሆ፥ ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ ብልም ይበላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Who among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥ የባሪያውንም ቃል የሚሰማ፥ በጨለማም የሚሄድ፥ ብርሃንም የሌለው፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚታመን፥ በአምላኩም የሚደገፍ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እሳት የምታነድዱ የእሳትንም ወላፈን የምትታጠቁ ሁላችሁ፥ በእሳታችሁ ነበልባል ባነደዳችሁትም ወላፈን ሂዱ፤ ይህ ከእጄ ይሆንባችኋል፤ በኀዘን ትተኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit ye are digged.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ጽድቅን የምትከተሉ እግዚአብሔርንም የምትሹ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ከእርሱ የተቈረጣችሁበትን ድንጋይ ከእርሱም የተቈፈራችሁበትን ጕድጓድ ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አባታችሁ ወደ አብርሃም፥ ወደ ወለደቻችሁም ወደ ሳራ ተመልከቱ፤ አንድ ብቻውን በሆነ ጊዜ ጠራሁት፥ ባረክሁትም አበዛሁትም።

verses.text_english: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ጽዮንን ያጽናናል፤ በእርስዋም ባድማ የሆነውን ሁሉ ያጽናናል፥ ምድረ በዳዋንም እንደ ዔደን በረሀዋንም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ገነት ያደርጋል፤ ደስታና ተድላ ምስጋናና የዝማሬ ድምፅ ይገኝበታል።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ወገኔ ሆይ፥ አድምጠኝ፤ ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፤ ሕግ ከእኔ ይወጣልና ፍርዴም ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: My righteousness near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቄ ፈጥኖ ቀርቦአል፥ ማዳኔም ወጥቶአል፥ ክንዴም በአሕዛብ ላይ ይፈርዳል፤ ደሴቶች እኔን በመተማመን ይጠባበቃሉ፥ በክንዴም ይታመናሉ።

verses.text_english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይናችሁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሡ፥ ወደ ታችም ወደ ምድር ተመልከቱ፤ ሰማያት እንደ ጢስ በንነው ይጠፋሉ፥ ምድርም እንደ ልብስ ታረጃለች፥ የሚኖሩባትም እንዲሁ ይሞታሉ፤ ማዳኔ ግን ለዘላለም ይሆናል፥ ጽድቄም አይፈርስም።

verses.text_english: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን የምታውቁ ሕጌም በልባችሁ ያለ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ የሰውን ተግዳሮት አትፍሩ፥ በስድባቸውም አትደንግጡ።

verses.text_english: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ልብስም ብል ይበላቸዋል፥ እንደ በግ ጠጕርም ትል ይበላቸዋል፤ ጽድቄ ግን ለዘላለም ማዳኔም ለትውልድ ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. thou not it that hath cut Rahab, wounded the dragon?
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ክንድ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ ተነሥ፥ ኃይልንም ልበስ፤ በቀድሞው ወራትና በጥንቱ ዘመን በነበረው ትውልድ እንደ ሆነው ተነሥ። ረዓብን የቈራረጥህ ዘንዶውንም የወጋህ አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.text_english: thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
verses.text_amharic: ባሕሩንና የታላቁን ጥልቅ ውኃ ያደረቅኸው፥ የዳኑትም ይሻገሩ ዘንድ ጠሊቁን ባሕር መንገድ ያደረግህ አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የተቤዣቸው ይመለሳሉ ወደ ጽዮንም ይመጣሉ፤ የዘላለምም ደስታ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ደስታንና ተድላን ያገኛሉ፥ ኀዘንና ልቅሶም ይሸሻል።

verses.text_english: I, I, he that comforteth you: who thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man shall die, and of the son of man shall be made grass;
verses.text_amharic: የማጽናናችሁ እኔ ነኝ፥ እኔ ነኝ፤ የሚሞተውን ሰው እንደ ሣርም የሚጠወልገውን የሰው ልጅ ትፈራ ዘንድ አንተ ማን ነህ?

verses.text_english: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where the fury of the oppressor?
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትንም የዘረጋው ምድርንም የመሠረተውን ፈጣሪህን እግዚአብሔርን ረስተሃል፤ ያጠፋ ዘንድ ባዘጋጀ ጊዜ ከአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የተነሣ ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ፈርተሃል፤ የአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የት አለ?

verses.text_english: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮኛ ፈጥኖ ይፈታል፤ አይሞትም ወደ ጕድጓድም አይወርድም፥ እንጀራም አይጐድልበትም።

verses.text_english: But I the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts his name.
verses.text_amharic: ሞገዱም እንዲተምም ባሕርን የማናውጥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፥ ስሜም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou my people.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያትን እዘረጋ ዘንድ ምድርንም እመሠርት ዘንድ፥ ጽዮንንም። አንቺ ሕዝቤ ነሽ እል ዘንድ ቃሌን በአፍህ አድርጌአለሁ፥ በእጄም ጥላ ጋርጄሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, wrung out.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ የቍጣውን ጽዋ የጠጣሽ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ቁሚ፤ የሚያንገደግድን ዋንጫ ጠጥተሻል ጨልጠሽውማል።

verses.text_english: none to guide her among all the sons she hath brought forth; neither that taketh her by the hand of all the sons she hath brought up.
verses.text_amharic: ከወለደቻቸው ልጆች ሁሉ የሚመራት የለም፥ ካሳደገቻቸውም ልጆች ሁሉ እጅዋን የሚይዝ የለም።

verses.text_english: These two are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁለት ነገሮች ሆነውብሻል፥ ማንስ ያስተዛዝንሻል? መፈታትና ጥፋት ራብና ሰይፍ ናቸው፤ እንዴትስ አድርጌ አጽናናሻለሁ?

verses.text_english: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችሽ ዝለዋል፤ በወጥመድ እንደተያዘ ሚዳቋ በአደባባይ ሁሉ ራስ ላይ ተኝተዋል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣና በአምላክሽ ተግሣጽ ተሞልተዋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ያለ ወይን ጠጅ የሰከርሽ አንቺ ችግረኛ፥ ይህን ስሚ፤

verses.text_english: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ወገኑ የሚምዋገት አምላክሽ ጌታሽ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የሚያንገደግድን ጽዋ የቍጣዬንም ዋንጫ ከእጅሽ ወስጃለሁ፤ ደግመሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትጠጪውም።

verses.text_english: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስሽንም። እንሻገር ዘንድ ዝቅ በዪ በሚሉአት በአስጨናቂዎችሽ እጅ አኖረዋለሁ፤ ጀርባሽንም ለሚሻገሩት እንደ መሬትና እንደ መንገድ አደረግሽላቸው።

verses.text_english: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፥ ተነሺ፥ ኃይልሽን ልበሺ፤ ቅድስቲቱ ከተማ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ያልተገረዘና ርኩስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይገባብሽምና ጌጠኛ ልብስሽን ልበሺ።

verses.text_english: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ትቢያን አራግፊ፤ ተነሺ፥ ተቀመጪ፤ ምርኮኛይቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ የአንገትሽን እስራት ፍቺ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በከንቱ ተሽጣችሁ ነበር፥ ያለ ገንዘብም ትቤዣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወገኔ በዚያ እንግዳ ሆኖ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ ወደ ግብጽ ወረደ፥ አሦርም ያለ ምክንያት በደለው።

verses.text_english: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day blasphemed.
verses.text_amharic: ወገኔ በከንቱ ተወስዶአልና አሁን ከዚህ ምን አለኝ? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የሚገዙአቸው ይጮኻሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ስሜም ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ይሰደባል።

verses.text_english: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore in that day that I he that doth speak: behold, I.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወገኔ ስሜን ያውቃል፥ ስለዚህም የምናገር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ በዚያ ቀን ያውቃሉ፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
verses.text_amharic: የምስራች የሚናገር፥ ሰላምንም የሚያወራ፥ የመልካምንም ወሬ የምስራች የሚናገር፥ መድኃኒትንም የሚያወራ፥ ጽዮንንም። አምላክሽ ነግሦአል የሚል ሰው እግሩ በተራሮች ላይ እጅግ ያማረ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጕበኞችሽ ጮኸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጽዮን በተመለሰ ጊዜ ዓይን በዓይን ይተያያሉና ድምፃቸውን ያነሣሉ፥ በአንድነትም ይዘምራሉ።

verses.text_english: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ፍርስራሾች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አጽናንቶአልና፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ታድጎአልና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ በአንድነትም ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን ክንዱን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ገልጦአል፥ በምድር ዳርቻ የሚኖሩትም ሁሉ የአምላካችንን መድኃኒት ያያሉ።

verses.text_english: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean ; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ዕቃ የምትሸከሙ ሆይ፥ እልፍ በሉ፥ እልፍ በሉ፥ ከዚያ ውጡ፥ ርኩስን ነገር አትንኩ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ፥ ንጽሐን ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel your rereward.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይቀድማችኋልና፥ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ይከተላችኋልና በችኰላ አትወጡም በመኰብለልም አትሄዱም።

verses.text_english: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ባሪያዬ በማስተዋል ያደርጋል፤ ይከብራል ከፍ ከፍም ይላል፥ እጅግ ታላቅም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
verses.text_amharic: ፊቱ ከሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ፥ መልኩም ከሰዎች ልጆች ይልቅ ተጐሳቍሎአልና ብዙ ሰዎች ስለ አንተ እንደ ተደነቁ፥ እንዲሁ ብዙ አሕዛብን ያስደንቃል፤

verses.text_english: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for which had not been told them shall they see; and which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.text_amharic: ያልተነገረላቸውንም ያያሉና፥ ያልሰሙትንም ያስተውላሉና ነገሥታት ስለ እርሱ አፋቸውን ይዘጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
verses.text_amharic: የሰማነውን ነገር ማን አምኖአል? የእግዚአብሔርስ ክንድ ለማን ተገልጦአል?

verses.text_english: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱ እንደ ቡቃያ ከደረቅም መሬት እንደ ሥር አድጎአል። መልክና ውበት የለውም፥ ባየነውም ጊዜ እንወድደው ዘንድ ደም ግባት የለውም።

verses.text_english: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.text_amharic: የተናቀ ከሰውም የተጠላ፥ የሕማም ሰው ደዌንም የሚያውቅ ነው፤ ሰውም ፊቱን እንደሚሰውርበት የተናቀ ነው፥ እኛም አላከበርነውም።

verses.text_english: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ደዌያችንን ተቀበለ ሕመማችንንም ተሸክሞአል፤ እኛ ግን እንደ ተመታ በእግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተቀሠፈ እንደ ተቸገረም ቈጠርነው።

verses.text_english: But he wounded for our transgressions, bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ስለ መተላለፋችን ቈሰለ፥ ስለ በደላችንም ደቀቀ፤ የደኅንነታችንም ተግሣጽ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ፥ በእርሱም ቍስል እኛ ተፈወስን።

verses.text_english: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ሁላችን እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘን ጠፋን፤ ከእኛ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ገዛ መንገዱ አዘነበለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሁላችንን በደል በእርሱ ላይ አኖረ።

verses.text_english: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ተጨነቀ ተሣቀየም አፉንም አልከፈተም፤ ለመታረድ እንደሚነዳ ጠቦት፥ በሸላቶቹም ፊት ዝም እንደሚል በግ፥ እንዲሁ አፉን አልከፈተም።

verses.text_english: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.text_amharic: በማስጨነቅና በፍርድ ተወሰደ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ኃጢአት ተመትቶ ከሕያዋን ምድር እንደ ተወገደ ከትውልዱ ማን አስተዋለ?

verses.text_english: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither deceit in his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉዎችም ጋር መቃብሩን አደረጉ፥ ከባለጠጎችም ጋር በሞቱ ሆኖም ግፍን አላደረገም ነበር፥ በአፉም ተንኮል አልተገንበትም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see seed, he shall prolong days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በደዌ ያደቅቀው ዘንድ ፈከደ፤ ነፍሱን ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ካደረገ በኋላ ዘሩን ያያል፥ ዕድሜውም ይረዝማል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ፈቃድ በእጁ ይከናወናል።

verses.text_english: He shall see of the travail of his soul, shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: ከነፍሱ ድካም ብርሃን ያያል ደስም ይለዋል፤ ጻድቅ ባሪያዬም በእውቀቱ ብዙ ሰዎችን ያጸድቃል፥ ኃጢአታቸውን ይሰከማል።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I divide him with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እርሱ ብዙዎችን ይወርሳል፥ ከኃያላንም ጋር ምርኮን ይከፋፈላል፤ ነፍሱን ለሞት አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር ተቈጥሮአልና፤ እርሱ ግን የብዙ ሰዎችን ኃጢአት ተሸከመ፥ ስለ ዓመፀኞችም ማለደ።

verses.text_english: Sing, O barren, thou didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou didst not travail with child: for more the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ያልወለድሽ መካን ሆይ፥ ዘምሪ፤ አንቺ ያላማጥሽ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፥ ጩኺም፤ ባል ካላት ይልቅ ፈት የሆነቺቱ ልጆች በዝተዋልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verses.text_amharic: የድንኳንሽን ስፍራ አስፊ፥ መጋረጃዎችሽንም ይዘርጉ፤ አትቈጥቢ፤ አውታሮችሽን አስረዝሚ ካስሞችሽንም አጽኚ።

verses.text_english: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.text_amharic: በቀኝና በግራ ትሰፋፊያለሽና፥ ዘርሽም አሕዛብን ይወርሳልና፥ የፈረሱትንም ከተሞች መኖሪያ ያደርጋልና።

verses.text_english: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
verses.text_amharic: አታፍሪምና አትፍሪ፤ አተዋረጂምና አትደንግጪ፤ የሕፃንነትሽንም እፍረት ትረሺዋለሽ፥ የመበለትነትሽንም ስድብ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታስቢም።

verses.text_english: For thy Maker thine husband; the LORD of hosts his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጣሪሽ ባልሽ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ታዲጊሽ ነው፥ እርሱም የምድር ሁሉ አምላክ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተተወችና እንደ ተበሳጨች በልጅነትዋም እንደ ተጣለች ሚስት ጠርቶሻል፥ ይላል አምላክሽ።

verses.text_english: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂት ጊዜ ተውሁሽ፥ በታላቅም ምሕረት እሰበስብሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
verses.text_amharic: በጥቂት ቍጣ ለቅጽበት ዓይን ፊቴን ከአንቺ ሰወርሁ፥ በዘላለምም ቸርነት እምርሻለሁ፥ ይላል ታዳጊሽ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For this the waters of Noah unto me: for I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ለእኔ እንደ ኖኅ ውኃ ነው፤ የኖኅ ውኃ ደግሞ በምድር ላይ እንዳያልፍ እንደ ማልሁ፥ እንዲሁ አንቺን እንዳልቈጣ እንዳልዘልፍሽም ምያለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮች ይፈልሳሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም ይወገዳሉ፤ ቸርነቴ ግን ከአንቺ ዘንድ አይፈልስም የሰላሜም ቃል ኪዳን አይወገድም፥ ይላል መሐሪሽ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የተቸገርሽ በዐውል ነፋስም የተናወጥሽ ያልተጽናናሽም፥ እነሆ፥ ድንጋዮችሽን ሸላልሜ እገነባለሁ፥ በሰንፔርም እመሠርትሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
verses.text_amharic: የግንብሽንም ጕልላት በቀይ ዕንቍ፥ በሮችሽንም በሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፥ ዳርቻሽንም ሁሉ በከበሩ ድንጋዮች እሠራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And all thy children taught of the LORD; and great the peace of thy children.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችሽም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ፥ የልጆችሽም ሰላም ብዙ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅ ትታነጺያለሽ፤ ከግፍ ራቂ፥ አትፈሪምም፥ ድንጋጤም ወደ አንቺ አትቀርብም።

verses.text_english: Behold, they shall surely gather together, not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ነገር ግን ከእኔ ዘንድ አይሆንም፤ በአንቺም ላይ የሚሰበሰቡ ሁሉ ከአንቺ የተነሣ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ፍሙን በወናፍ የሚያናፋ ለሥራውም መሣሪያ የሚያወጣ ብረት ሠሪን እኔ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ የሚያፈርሰውንም እንዲያጠፋ ፈጥሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness of me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ ላይ የተሠራ መሣሪያ ሁሉ አይከናወንም፤ በፍርድም በሚነሣብሽ ምላስ ሁሉ ትፈርጂበታለሽ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ርስት ይህ ነው፥ ጽድቃቸውም ከእኔ ዘንድ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የተጠማችሁ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ውኃ ኑ፥ ገንዘብም የሌላችሁ ኑና ግዙ ብሉም፤ ኑ ያለ ገንዘብም ያለ ዋጋም የወይን ጠጅና ወተት ግዙ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore do ye spend money for not bread? and your labour for satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
verses.text_amharic: ገንዘብን እንጀራ ላይደለ፥ የድካማችሁንም ዋጋ ለማያጠግብ ነገር ለምን ትመዝናላችሁ? አድምጡኝ፥ በረከትንም ብሉ፥ ሰውነታችሁም በጮማ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.text_english: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, the sure mercies of David.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮአችሁን አዘንብሉ ወደ እኔም ቅረቡ፤ ስሙ ሰውነታችሁም በሕይወት ትኖራለች፤ የታመነችይቱን የዳዊትን ምሕረት፥ የዘላለምን ቃል ኪዳን ከእናንተ ጋር አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have given him a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ለአሕዛብ ምስክር፥ ለወገኖችም አለቃና አዛዥ እንዲሆን ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou shalt call a nation thou knowest not, and nations knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የማታውቀውን ሕዝብ ትጠራለህ፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ አክብሮሃልና ስለ አምላክህ ስለ እግዚአብሔር የማያውቁህ ሕዝብ ወደ አንተ ይሮጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በሚገኝበት ጊዜ ፈልጉት፥ ቀርቦም ሳለ ጥሩት፤

verses.text_english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ሰው መንገዱን በደለኛም አሳቡን ይተው፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለስ እርሱም ይምረዋል፥ ይቅርታውም ብዙ ነውና ወደ አምላካችን ይመለስ።

verses.text_english: For my thoughts not your thoughts, neither your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አሳቤ እንደ አሳባችሁ መንገዳችሁም እንደ መንገዴ አይደለምና ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይ ከምድር ከፍ እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ መንገዴ ከመንገዳችሁ አሳቤም ከአሳባችሁ ከፍ ያለ ነው።

verses.text_english: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
verses.text_amharic: ዝናብና በረዶ ከሰማይ እንደሚወርድ፥ ምድርን እንደሚያረካት፥ ታበቅልና ታፈራም ዘንድ እንደሚያደርጋት፥ ዘርንም ለሚዘራ እንጀራንም ለሚበላ እንደሚሰጥ እንጂ ወደ ሰማይ እንደማይመለስ፥

verses.text_english: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper whereto I sent it.
verses.text_amharic: ከአፌ የሚወጣ ቃሌ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ የምሻውን ያደርጋል የላክሁትንም ይፈጽማል እንጂ ወደ እኔ በከንቱ አይመለስም።

verses.text_english: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap hands.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም በደስታ ትወጣላችሁ በሰላምም ትሸኛላችሁ፤ ተራሮችና ኮረብቶች በፊታችሁ እልልታ ያደርጋሉ፥ የሜዳም ዛፎች ሁሉ ያጨበጭባሉ።

verses.text_english: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign shall not be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: በእሾህም ፋንታ ጥድ በኩርንችትም ፋንታ ባርሰነት ይበቅላል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም መታሰቢያን ለዘላለምም የማይጠፋ፥ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ማዳኔ ሊመጣ ጽድቄም ሊገለጥ ቀርቦአልና ፍርድን ጠብቁ ጽድቅንም አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man doeth this, and the son of man layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን የሚያደርግ ሰው ይህንንም የሚይዝ የሰው ልጅ፥ እንዳያረክሰው ሰንበትንም የሚጠብቅ እጁንም ክፋት ከማድረግ የሚጠብቅ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.text_english: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I a dry tree.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የተጠጋ መጻተኛ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ይለየኛል አይበል፤ ጃንደረባም። እነሆ፥ እኔ ደረቅ ዛፍ ነኝ አይበል።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሰንበቴን ስለሚጠብቁ ደስ የሚያሰኘኝንም ነገር ስለሚመርጡ ቃል ኪዳኔንም ስለሚይዙ ጃንደረቦች እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.text_english: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴና በቅጥሬ ውስጥ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆች ይልቅ የሚበልጥ መታሰቢያና ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ የማይጠፋም የዘላለም ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
verses.text_amharic: ያገለግሉት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ይወድዱ ዘንድ ባሪያዎቹም ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚጠጉትንም መጻተኞች፥ እንዳያረክሱት ሰንበትን የሚጠብቁትን ቃል ኪዳኔንም የሚይዙትን ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ተቀደሰ ተራራዬ አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ በጸሎቴም ቤት ደስ አሰኛቸዋለሁ፤ ቤቴ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የሚሆን የጸሎት ቤት ይባላልና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታቸውንና ሌላ መሥዋዕታቸውን በመሠዊያዬ ላይ እቀበላለሁ።

verses.text_english: The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል የተበተኑትን የሚሰበስብ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ዘንድ ሌሎችን እሰበስብለታለሁ ይላል።

verses.text_english: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, , all ye beasts in the forest.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሁሉ፥ እናንተም የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ትበሉ ዘንድ ቅረቡ።

verses.text_english: His watchmen blind: they are all ignorant, they all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.text_amharic: ጕበኞቹ ዕውሮች ናቸው፥ ሁሉ ያለ እውቀት ናቸው፤ ሁሉም ዲዳ የሆኑ ውሾች ናቸው ይጮኹም ዘንድ አይችሉም፤ ሕልምን ያልማሉ፤ ይተኛሉ፤ ማንቀላፋትንም ይወድዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, greedy dogs can never have enough, and they shepherds cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
verses.text_amharic: መብል ወዳጆች ከቶ የማይጠግቡ ውሾች ናቸው፥ እነርሱም ያስተውሉ ዘንድ የማይችሉ እረኞች ናቸው፤ ሁሉ ወደ መንገዳቸው፥ ከፊተኛው እስከ ኋለኛው ድረስ ሁሉ፥ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ ጥቅማቸው ዘወር ብለዋል።

verses.text_english: Come ye, , I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, much more abundant.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ የወይን ጠጅ እንውሰድ፥ በሚያሰክርም መጠጥ እንርካ፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ ነገ ይሆናል፥ ከዛሬም ይልቅ እጅግ ይበልጣል ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth to heart: and merciful men taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil .
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ይሞታል፥ በልቡም ነገሩን የሚያኖር የለም፤ ምሕረተኞችም ይወገዳሉ፥ ጽድቅም ከክፋት ፊት እንደ ተወገደ ማንም አያስተውልም።

verses.text_english: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, walking his uprightness.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰላም ይገባል፤ በቅንነት የሄደ በአልጋው ላይ ያርፋል።

verses.text_english: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የአስማተኛይቱ ልጆች፥ የአመንዝራውና የጋለሞታይቱ ዘር፥ ወደዚህ ቅረቡ።

verses.text_english: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, draw out the tongue? ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.text_amharic: በማን ታላግጣላችሁ? በማንስ ላይ አፋችሁን ታላቅቃላችሁ? ምላሳችሁንስ በማን ላይ ታስረዝማላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በአድባር ዛፎች መካከል በለመለመም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች በፍትወት የምትቃጠሉ፥ እናንተም በሸለቆች ውስጥ በዓለትም ስንጣቂዎች በታች ሕፃናትን የምታርዱ፥ የዓመፅ ልጆችና የሐሰት ዘር አይደላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: Among the smooth of the stream thy portion; they, they thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.text_amharic: በሸለቆው ውስጥ ያሉ የለዘቡ ድንጋዮች እድል ፈንታሽ ናቸው፥ እነርሱም ዕጣሽ ናቸው፤ ለእነርሱም የመጠጥ ቍርባን አፍስሰሻል፥ የእህልንም ቍርባን አቅርበሻል። እንግዲህ በዚህ ነገር አልቈጣምን?

verses.text_english: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍ ባለውም በረዘመውም ተራራ ላይ መኝታሽን አደረግሽ፥ መሥዋዕትንም ትሠዊ ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወጣሽ።

verses.text_english: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest .
verses.text_amharic: ከመዝጊያውና ከመቃኑ በኋላ መታሰቢያሽን አደረግሽ፤ እኔን ትተሽ ለሌላ ተገልጠሻል፥ ወጥተሽ መኝታሽን አስፍተሻል፤ ቃል ኪዳንም ተጋባሻቸው፥ ባየሽበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ መኝታቸውን ወደድሽ።

verses.text_english: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase unto hell.
verses.text_amharic: ዘይትም ይዘሽ ወደ ንጉሡ ሄድሽ፥ ሽቱሽንም አበዛሽ፥ መልእክተኞችሽንም ወደ ሩቅ ላክሽ፥ እስከ ሲኦልም ድረስ ተዋረድሽ።

verses.text_english: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድሽም ብዛት ደከምሽ፥ ነገር ግን። ተስፋ የለም አላልሽም፤ የጕልበትን መታደስ አገኘሽ፥ ስለዚህም አልዛልሽም።

verses.text_english: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰትን የተናገርሺው እኔንም ያላሰብሺው በልብሽም ነገሩን ያላኖርሺው ማንን ሰግተሽ ነው? ማንንስ ፈርተሽ ነው? እኔ ብዙ ጊዜ ዝም አልሁ፥ አንቺም አልፈራሽም።

verses.text_english: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ጽድቅሽን እናገራለሁ፥ ሥራሽም አይረባሽም።

verses.text_english: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take : but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንቺ የሰበሰብሻቸው በጮኽሽ ጊዜ ይታደጉሽ፤ ንፋስ ግን ይወስዳቸዋል ሽውሽውታም ሁሉን ያስወግዳቸዋል። በእኔ የታመነ ግን ምድሪቱን ይገዛል፥ የተቀደሰውንም ተራራዬን ይወርሳል።

verses.text_english: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጥረጉ፥ መንገድን አዘጋጁ፥ ከሕዝቤም መንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አውጡ ይላል።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name Holy; I dwell in the high and holy , with him also of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስሙም ቅዱስ የሆነ፥ ከፍ ያለው ልዑል እንዲህ ይላል። የተዋረዱትን ሰዎች መንፈስ ሕያው አደርግ ዘንድ፥ የተቀጠቀጠውንም ልብ ሕያው አደርግ ዘንድ፥ የተቀጠቀጠና የተዋረደ መንፈስ ካለው ጋር በከፍታና በተቀደሰ ስፍራ እቀመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls I have made.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስም የፈጠርሁትም ነፍስ ከፊቴ እንዳይዝል ለዘላለም አልጣላም፥ ሁልጊዜም አልቈጣም።

verses.text_english: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኃጢአቱ ጥቂት ጊዜ ተቈጥቼ ቀሠፍሁት፥ ፊቴን ሰውሬ ተቈጣሁ፤ እርሱም በልቡ መንገድ እያፈገፈገ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዱን አይቻለሁ እፈውሰውማለሁ፥ እመራውማለሁ፥ ለእርሱና ስለ እርሱም ለሚያለቅሱ መጽናናትን እመልሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to far off, and to near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
verses.text_amharic: የከንፈሮችን ፍሬ እፈጥራለሁ፤ በሩቅም በቅርብም ላለው ሰላም ሰላም ይሁን፥ እፈውሰውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But the wicked like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉዎች ግን እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ባሕር ናቸው፤ ጸጥ ይል ዘንድ አይችልምና፥ ውኆቹም ጭቃና ጕድፍ ያወጣሉና።

verses.text_english: no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ለክፉዎች ሰላም የላቸውም ይላል አምላኬ።

verses.text_english: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.text_amharic: በኃይልህ ጩኽ፥ አትቈጥብ፥ ድምፅህን እንደ መለከት አንሣ፥ ለሕዝቤ መተላለፋቸውን ለያዕቆብ ቤትም ኃጢአታቸውን ንገር።

verses.text_english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዕለት ዕለት ይሹኛል መንገዴንም ያውቁ ዘንድ ይወድዳሉ፤ ጽድቅን እንዳደረጉ የአምላካቸውንም ፍርድ እንዳልተዉ ሕዝብ እውነተኛውን ፍርድ ይለምኑኛል፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመቅረብ ይወድዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore have we fasted, , and thou seest not? have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን ጾምን፥ አንተም አልተመለከትኸንም? ሰውነታችንንስ ስለ ምን አዋረድን፥ አንተም አላወቅህም? ይላሉ። እነሆ፥ በጾማችሁ ቀን ፈቃዳችሁን ታደርጋላችሁ፥ ሠራተኞቻችሁንም ሁሉ ታስጨንቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ለጥልና ለክርክር ትጾማላችሁ በግፍ ጡጫም ትማታላችሁ፤ ድምፃችሁንም ወደ ላይ ታሰሙ ዘንድ ዛሬ እንደምትጾሙት አትጾሙም።

verses.text_english: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes ? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የመረጥሁት ጾም ይህ ነውን? ሰውስ ነፍሱን የሚያዋርደው እንደዚህ ባለ ቀን ነውን? በውኑ ራሱን እንደ እንግጫ ዝቅ ያደርግ ዘንድ ማቅንና አመድንም በበታቹ ያነጥፍ ዘንድ ነውን? በውኑ ይህን ጾም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ የተወደደ ቀን ትለዋለህን?

verses.text_english: not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ የመረጥሁት ጾም ይህ አይደለምን? የበደልን እስራት ትፈቱ ዘንድ፥ የቀንበርንስ ጠፍር ትለቅቁ ዘንድ፥ የተገፉትንስ አርነት ትሰድዱ ዘንድ፥ ቀንበሩንስ ሁሉ ትሰብሩ ዘንድ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራህንስ ለተራበ ትቈርስ ዘንድ፥ ስደተኞቹን ድሆች ወደ ቤትህ ታገባ ዘንድ፥ የተራቈተውንስ ብታይ ታለብሰው ዘንድ፥ ከሥጋ ዘምድህ እንዳትሸሽግ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ ብርሃንህ እንደ ንጋት ይበራል፥ ፈውስህም ፈጥኖ ይበቅላል፥ ጽድቅህም በፊትህ ይሄዳል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በኋላህ ሆኖ ይጠብቅሃል።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I . If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ ትጠራለህ እግዚአብሔርም ይሰማሃል፤ ትጮኻለህ እርሱም። እነሆኝ ይላል። ከመካከልህ ቀንበርን ብታርቅ፥ ጣትህንም መጥቀስ ብትተው፥

verses.text_english: And thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness as the noonday:
verses.text_amharic: ባታንጐራጕርም፥ ነፍስህንም ለተራበ ብታፈስስ፥ የተጨነቀውንም ነፍስ ብታጠግብ፥ ብርሃንህ በጨለማ ይወጣል ጨለማህም እንደ ቀትር ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሁልጊዜ ይመራሃል፤ ነፍስህንም በመልካም ነገር ያጠግባል አጥንትህንም ያጠናል፤ አንተም እንደሚጠጣ ገነት፥ ውኃውም እንደማያቋርጥ ምንጭ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: And of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.text_amharic: ከዱሮ ዘመን የፈረሱት ስፍራዎች ይሠራሉ፥ የብዙ ትውልድም መሠረት ይታነጻል፤ አንተም። ሰባራውን ጠጋኝ፥ የመኖሪያ መንገድን አዳሽ ትባላለህ።

verses.text_english: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking words:
verses.text_amharic: ፈቃድህን በተቀደሰው ቀኔ ከማድረግ እግርህን ከሰንበት ብትመልስ፥ ሰንበትንም ደስታ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የቀደሰውን ክቡር ብትለው፥ የገዛ መንገድህንም ከማድረግ ፈቃድህንም ከማግኘት ከንቱ ነገርንም ከመናገር ተከልክለህ ብታከብረው፥

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይልሃል፥ በምድርም ከፍታዎች ላይ አወጣሃለሁ፥ የአባትህንም የያዕቆብን ርስት አበላሃለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ተናግሮአልና።

verses.text_english: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ከማዳን አላጠረችም፥ ጆሮውም ከመስማት አልደነቈረችም፤

verses.text_english: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በደላችሁ በእናንተና በአምላካችሁ መካከል ለይታለች፥ እንዳይሰማም ኃጢአታችሁ ፊቱን ከእናንተ ሰውሮታል።

verses.text_english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.text_amharic: እጃችሁ በደም ጣታችሁም በበደል ረክሳለች፥ ከንፈራችሁም ሐሰትን ተናግሮአል፥ ምላሳችሁም ኃጢአትን አሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: None calleth for justice, nor pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በጽድቅ የሚጠራ በእውነትም የሚፈርድ የለም፤ በምናምንቴ ነገር ታምነዋል ሐሰትንም ተናግረዋል፤ ጕዳትን ፀንሰዋል በደልንም ወልደዋል፤

verses.text_english: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.text_amharic: የእባብን እንቍላል ቀፈቀፉ፥ የሸረሪትንም ድር አደሩ፤ እንቍላላቸውንም የሚበላ ሰው ይሞታል፥ እንቍላሉም ሲሰበር እፉኝት ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works works of iniquity, and the act of violence in their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ድሮቻቸውም ልብስ አይሆኑላቸውም፥ በሥራቸውም አይሸፈኑም፤ ሥራቸውም የበደል ሥራ ነው፥ የግፍም ሥራ በእጃቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction in their paths.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቻቸው ወደ ክፋት ይሮጣሉ፥ ንጹሑን ደም ለማፍሰስ ይፈጥናሉ፤ አሳባቸው የኃጢአት አሳብ ነው፥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ በመንገዳቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: The way of peace they know not; and no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.text_amharic: የሰላምን መንገድ አያውቁም፥ በአካሄዳቸውም ፍርድ የለም፤ መንገዳቸውን አጣምመዋል፥ የሚሄድባትም ሁሉ ሰላምን አያውቅም።

verses.text_english: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, we walk in darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ፍርድ ከእኛ ዘንድ ርቆአል፥ ጽድቅም አላገኘንም፤ ብርሃንን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር፥ እነሆም፥ ጨለማ ሆነ፤ ጸዳልን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር፥ ነገር ግን በጨለማ ሄድን።

verses.text_english: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; in desolate places as dead .
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ዕውሮች ወደ ቅጥሩ ተርመሰመስን፥ ዓይን እንደሌላቸው ተርመሰመስን፤ በቀትር ጊዜ በድግዝግዝታ እንዳለ ሰው ተሰናከልን፥ እንደ ሙታን በጨለማ ስፍራ ነን።

verses.text_english: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but none; for salvation, it is far off from us.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችን እንደ ድቦች እንጮኻለን፥ እንደ ርግብ እንለቃቀሳለን፤ ፍርድን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር እርሱም የለም፤ መዳንም ከእኛ ዘንድ ርቆአል።

verses.text_english: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions with us; and our iniquities, we know them;
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃችን በአንተ ፊት በዝቶአልና፥ ኃጢአታችን መስክሮብናልና፥ ዓመፃችን ከእኛ ጋር ነውና፥ በደላችንን እናውቃለንና።

verses.text_english: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.text_amharic: ዐምፀናል፥ ሐሰትን ተናግረናል፥ አምላካችንንም ከመከተል ተመልሰናል፤ ግፍንና ዓመፅንም ተናግረናል፥ የኃጢአት ቃልንም ፀንሰን ከልብ አውጥተናል።

verses.text_english: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድም ወደ ኋላ ተመልሶአል፥ ጽድቅም በሩቅ ቆሞአል፤ እውነትም በአደባባይ ላይ ወድቆአልና፥ ቅንነትም ሊገባ አልቻለምና።

verses.text_english: Yea, truth faileth; and he departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw , and it displeased him that no judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትም ታጥቶአል፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው ለብዝበዛ ሆኖአል።  እግዚአብሔርም አየ፥ ፍርድም ስለሌለ ተከፋ።

verses.text_english: And he saw that no man, and wondered that no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም እንደሌለ አየ፥ ወደ እርሱ የሚማልድ እንደሌለ ተረዳ ተደነቀም፤ ስለዚህ የገዛ ክንዱ መድኃኒት አመጣለት፥ ጽድቁም አገዘው።

verses.text_english: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅንም እንደ ጥሩር ለበሰ፥ በራሱም ላይ የማዳንን ራስ ቍር አደረገ፤ የበቀልንም ልብስ ለበሰ፥ በቅንዓትም መጐናጸፊያ ተጐናጸፈ።

verses.text_english: According to deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሥራቸው መጠን እንዲሁ ቍጣን ለባላጋራዎቹ፥ ፍዳንም ለጠላቶቹ ይከፍላል፤ ለደሴቶችም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላል።

verses.text_english: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ነፋስ እንደሚነዳው እንደ ጐርፍ ፈሳሽ ይመጣልና በምዕራብ ያሉት የእግዚአብሔርን ስም፥ በፀሐይ መውጫም ያሉት ክብሩን ይፈራሉ።

verses.text_english: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለጽዮን ታዳጊ ይመጣል፥ በያዕቆብም ዘንድ ከኃጢአት ለሚርቁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: As for me, this my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ጋር ያለው ቃል ኪዳኔ ይህ ነው ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በአንተ ላይ ያለው መንፈሴ በአፍህም ውስጥ ያደረግሁት ቃሌ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ከአፍህ ከዘርህም አፍ ከዘር ዘርህም አፍ አያልፍም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንሽ መጥቶአልና፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ወጥቶልሻልና ተነሺ፥ አብሪ።

verses.text_english: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጨለማ ምድርን ድቅድቅ ጨለማም አሕዛብን ይሸፍናል፤ ነገር ግን በአንቺ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ይወጣል ክብሩም በአንቺ ላይ ይታያል፤

verses.text_english: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም ወደ ብርሃንሽ ነገሥታትም ወደ መውጫሽ ጸዳል ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at side.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖችሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽ ከሩቅ ይመጣሉ፥ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃ ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የባሕሩ በረከት ወደ አንቺ ስለሚመለስ፥ የአሕዛብም ብልጥግና ወደ አንቺ ስለሚመጣ፥ አይተሽ ደስ ይልሻል፥ ልብሽም ይደነቃል ይሰፋማል።

verses.text_english: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የግመሎች ብዛት፥ የምድያምና የጌፌር ግመሎች፥ ይሸፍኑሻል፤ ሁሉ ከሳባ ይመጣሉ፥ ወርቅንና ዕጣንን ያመጣሉ የእግዚአብሔርንም ምስጋና ያወራሉ።

verses.text_english: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.text_amharic: የቄዳር መንጎች ሁሉ ወደ አንቺ ይሰበሰባሉ የነባዮትም አውራ በጎች ያገለግሉሻል፤ እኔን ደስ ሊያሰኙ በመሠዊያዬ ላይ ይወጣሉ፥ የክብሬንም ቤት አከብራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Who these fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.text_amharic: ርግቦች ወደ ቤታቸው እንደሚበርሩ፥ እነዚህ እንደ ደመና የሚበርሩ እነማን ናቸው?

verses.text_english: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አክብሮሻልና ለአምላክሽ ለእግዚአብሔር ስምና ለእስራኤል ቅዱስ ልጆችሽን ከሩቅ ከእነርሱ ጋርም ብራቸውንና ወርቃቸውን ያመጡ ዘንድ ደሴቶች የተርሴስ መርከቦችም አስቀድመው ይጠባበቁኛል።

verses.text_english: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣዬ ቀሥፌ በፍቅሬ ምሬሻለሁና መጻተኞች ቅጥርሽን ይሠራሉ፥ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም ያገለግሉሻል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and their kings brought.
verses.text_amharic: በሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ ይከፈታሉ፤ ሰዎች የአሕዛብን ብልጥግና የተማረኩትንም ነገሥታቶቻቸውን ወደ አንቺ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሌሊትና ቀን አይዘጉም።

verses.text_english: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንቺም የማይገዛ ሕዝብና መንግሥት ይጠፋል፥ እነዚያ አሕዛብም ፈጽመው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደሴንም ስፍራ ያስጌጡ ዘንድ የሊባኖስ ክብር፥ ጥዱና አስታው ባርሰነቱም፥ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥ የእግሬንም ስፍራ አከብራለሁ።

verses.text_english: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የአስጨናቂዎችሽም ልጆች አንገታቸውን ደፍተው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥ የናቁሽም ሁሉ ወደ እግርሽ ጫማ ይሰግዳሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ከተማ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ የሆንሽ ጽዮን ይሉሻል።

verses.text_english: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through , I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰውም ማንም እስከማያልፍብሽ ድረስ የተተውሽና የተጠላሽ ነበርሽ፤ ነገር ግን የዘላለም ትምክሕትና የልጅ ልጅ ደስታ አደርግሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብንም ወተት ትጠጫለሽ የነገሥታትንም ጡት ትጠቢያለሽ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር የያዕቆብ ኃይል፥ መድኃኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ።

verses.text_english: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: በናስ ፋንታ ወርቅን፥ በብረትም ፋንታ ብርን፥ በእንጨትም ፋንታ ናስን፥ በድንጋይም ፋንታ ብረትን አመጣለሁ። አለቆችሽንም ሰላም፥ የበላይ ገዢዎችሽንም ጽድቅ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ በኋላ በምድርሽ ውስጥ ግፍ፥ በዳርቻሽም ውስጥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ አይሰማም፤ ቅጥርሽን መዳን በሮችሽንም ምስጋና ብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ

verses.text_english: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ብርሃንሽ፥ አምላክሽም ክብርሽ ይሆናልና ፀሐይ በቀን ብርሃን አይሆንልሽም፥ የጨረቃም ብርሃን በሌሊት አይበራልሽም።

verses.text_english: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ብርሃንሽ ይሆናልና፥ የልቅሶሽም ወራት ታልቃለችና ፀሐይሽ ከዚያ በኋላ አትጠልቅም ጨረቃሽም አይቋረጥም።

verses.text_english: Thy people also all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብሽም ሁሉ ጻድቃን ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም እከብር ዘንድ የአታክልቴን ቡቃያ፥ የእጄ ሥራ የምትሆን ምድሪቱንም ለዘላለም ይወርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
verses.text_amharic: ታናሹ ለሺህ የሁሉም ታናሹ ለብርቱ ሕዝብ ይሆናል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በዘመኑ ይህን አፋጥነዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The Spirit of the Lord GOD upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to bound;
verses.text_amharic: የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች የምሥራችን እሰብክ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ቀብቶኛልና፤ ልባቸው የተሰበረውን እጠግን ዘንድ፥ ለተማረኩትም ነጻነትን ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን እናገር ዘንድ ልኮኛል።

verses.text_english: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.text_amharic: የተወደደችውን የእግዚአብሔርን ዓመት አምላካችንም የሚበቀልበትን ቀን እናገር ዘንድ፥ የሚያለቅሱትንም ሁሉ አጽናና ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለክብሩ የተከላቸው የጽድቅ ዛፎች እንዲባሉ ለጽዮን አልቃሾች አደርግላቸው ዘንድ፥ በአመድ ፋንታ አክሊልን፥ በልቅሶም ፋንታ የደስታን ዘይት፥ በኀዘንም መንፈስ ፋንታ የምስጋናን መጐናጸፊያ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ልኮኛል።

verses.text_english: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንትም ጀምሮ ባድማ የነበሩትን ይሠራሉ ከቀድሞ የፈረሱትንም ያቆማሉ፤ ባድማ የነበሩትንና ከብዙ ትውልድ በፊት የፈረሱትን ከተሞች እንደ ገና ይሠራሉ።

verses.text_english: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.text_amharic: መጻተኞችም ቆመው በጎቻችሁን ያሰማራሉ፥ ሌሎች ወገኖችም አራሾችና ወይም ጠባቂዎች ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.text_english: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ትባላላችሁ፥ ሰዎቹም የአምላካችን አገልጋዮች ብለው ይጠሩአችኋል፤ የአሕዛብን ሀብት ትበላላችሁ፥ በክብራቸውም ትመካላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For your shame double; and confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በእፍረታችሁ ፋንታ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሆንላችኋል፥ በውርደታችሁም ፋንታ ዕድል ፈንታችሁ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ስለዚህ በምድራቸው ሁሉ እጥፍ ይገዛሉ፥ የዘላለምም ደስታ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን የምወድድ ስርቆትንና በደልን የምጠላ ነኝ፤ ፍዳቸውንም በእውነት እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they the seed the LORD hath blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ዘራቸውም በአሕዛብ መካከል፥ ልጆቻቸውም በወገኖች መካከል የታወቁ ይሆናሉ፤ ያያቸው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር የባረካቸው ዘር እንደ ሆኑ ይገነዘባል።

verses.text_english: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth with her jewels.
verses.text_amharic: አክሊልን እንደ ለበሰ ሙሽራ፥ በጌጥ ሽልማትዋም እንዳጌጠች ሙሽራ፥ የማዳንን ልብስ አልብሶኛልና፥ የጽድቅንም መጐናጸፊያ ደርቦልኛልና በእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ነፍሴም በአምላኬ ሐሤት ታደርጋለች።

verses.text_english: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርም ቡቃያዋን እንደምታወጣ፥ ገነትም ዘሩን እንደሚያበቅል፥ እንዲሁ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅንና ምስጋናን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ያበቅላል።

verses.text_english: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp burneth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጽዮን ዝም አልልም፥ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌምም ጸጥ አልልም፥ ጽድቅዋ እንደ ጸዳል መዳንዋም እንደሚበራ ፋና እስኪወጣ ድረስ።

verses.text_english: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም ጽድቅሽን ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርሽን ያያሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አፍ በሚጠራበት በአዲሱ ስም ትጠሪያለሽ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር እጅ የክብር አክሊል፥ በአምላክሽም እጅ የመንግሥት ዘውድ ትሆኛለሽ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። የተተወች አትባዪም፤ ምድርሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። ውድማ አትባልም፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በአንቺ ደስ ብሎታልና፥ ምድርሽም ባል ታገባለችና አንቺ። ደስታዬ የሚኖርባት ትባያለሽ ምድርሽም። ባል ያገባች ትባላለች።

verses.text_english: For a young man marrieth a virgin, shall thy sons marry thee: and the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሳም ድንግሊቱን እንደሚያገባ፥ እንዲሁ ልጆችሽ ያገቡሻል፤ ሙሽራም በሙሽራይቱ ደስ እንደሚለው፥ እንዲሁ አምላክሽ በአንቺ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ጕበኞችን በቅጥርሽ ላይ አቁሜአለሁ፤ ቀንና ሌሊት ከቶ ዝም አይሉም፤ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የምታሳስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪያጸና በምድርም ላይ ምስጋና እስኪያደርጋት ድረስ አትረፉ ለእርሱም ዕረፍት አትስጡ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በእርግጥ ለጠላቶችሽ መብል ይሆን ዘንድ እህልሽን አልሰጥም፥ መጻተኞችም የደከምሽበትን ወይንሽን አይጠጡም፤

verses.text_english: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሰበሰቡት ይበሉታል እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግናሉ፥ ያከማቹትም በመቅደሴ አደባባይ ላይ ይጠጡታል ብሎ በቀኙና በኃይሉ ክንድ ምሎአል።

verses.text_english: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.text_amharic: እለፉ፥ በበሮች በኩል እለፉ፤ የሕዝቡንም መንገድ ጥረጉ፤ አዘጋጁ፥ ጐዳናውን አዘጋጁ፥ ድንጋዮቹንም አስወግዱ፤ ለአሕዛብም ዓለማ አንሡ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward with him, and his work before him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ዳርቻ አዋጅ እንዲህ ብሎ ነግሮአል። ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ መድኃኒትሽ ይመጣል፤ እነሆ፥ ዋጋው ከእርሱ ጋር ሥራውም በፊቱ አለ በሉአት።

verses.text_english: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር። የተቤዣቸው፥ የተቀደሰ ሕዝብ ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል፤ አንቺም። የተፈለገች ያልተተወችም ከተማ ትባያለሽ።

verses.text_english: Who this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ከኤዶምያስ፥ ልብሱም የቀላ ከባሶራ የሚመጣ፥ አለባበሱ ያማረ፥ በጕልበቱ ጽናት የሚራመድ ማን ነው? በጽድቅ የምናገር ለማዳንም የምበረታ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
verses.text_amharic: ቀሚስህ ስለ ምን ቀላ? ልብስህስ በወይን መጥመቂያ እንደሚረግጥ ሰው ልብስ ስለ ምን መሰለ?

verses.text_english: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
verses.text_amharic: መጥመቂያውን ብቻዬን ረግጫለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም አንድ ሰው ከእኔ ጋር አልነበረም፤ በቍጣዬ ረገጥኋቸው በመዓቴም ቀጠቀጥኋቸው፤ ደማቸውም በልብሴ ላይ ተረጭቶአል፥ ልብሴንም ሁሉ አስድፌአለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the day of vengeance in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.text_amharic: የምበቀልበት ቀን በልቤ ነውና፥ የምቤዥበትም ዓመት ደርሶአልና።

verses.text_english: And I looked, and none to help; and I wondered that none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
verses.text_amharic: ተመለከትሁ፥ የሚረዳም አልተገኘም፤ የሚያግዝም አልነበረምና ተደነቅሁ፤ ስለዚህ የገዛ ክንዴ መድኃኒት አመጣልኝ፥ ቍጣዬም እርሱ አገዘኝ።

verses.text_english: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣዬም አሕዛብን ረገጥሁ በመዓቴም ቀጠቀጥኋቸው፥ ደማቸውንም ወደ ምድር አፈሰስሁት።

verses.text_english: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰጠን ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነትና የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና፥ እንደ ምሕረቱና እንደ ቸርነቱም ብዛት ለእስራኤል ቤት የሰጠውን ትልቅ በጎነት አሳስባለሁ።

verses.text_english: For he said, Surely they my people, children will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በእውነት ሕዝቤ፥ ሐሰትን የማያደርጉ ልጆች፥ ናቸው አለ፤ መድኃኒትም ሆነላቸው።

verses.text_english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.text_amharic: በጭንቃቸው ሁሉ እርሱ ተጨነቀ፥ የፊቱም መልአክ አዳናቸው፤ በፍቅሩና በርኅራኄውም ተቤዣቸው፥ በቀደመውም ዘመን ሁሉ አንሥቶ ተሸከማቸው።

verses.text_english: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, he fought against them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ዐመፁ ቅዱስ መንፈሱንም አስመረሩ፤ ስለዚህ ተመልሶ ጠላት ሆናቸው፥ እርሱም ተዋጋቸው።

verses.text_english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, his people, , Where he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where he that put his holy Spirit within him?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ የቀደመውን ዘመን አሰበ። የበጎቹን እረኛ ከባሕሩ ያወጣው ወዴት ነው ያለ? ቅዱስ መንፈሱንም በመካከላቸው ያኖረ ወዴት ነው ያለ?

verses.text_english: That led by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.text_amharic: የከበረውንም ክንድ በሙሴ ቀኝ ያስሄደ፥ ለራሱም የዘላለምን ስም ያደርግ ዘንድ ውኃውን በፊታቸው የከፈለ፥

verses.text_english: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, they should not stumble?
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳም እንደሚያልፍ ፈረስ፥ በቀላይ ውስጥ ያለ ዕንቅፋት ያሳለፋቸው ወዴት ነው ያለ?

verses.text_english: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሸለቆ እንደሚወርዱ ከብቶች፥ እንዲሁ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ወደ ዕረፍት አመጣቸው፤ እንዲሁም ለራስህ የከበረ ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ ሕዝብን መራህ።

verses.text_english: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይ ተመልከት፥ ከቅዱስነትህና ከክብርህም ማደሪያ ጐብኝ፤ ቅንዓትህና ኃይልህስ ወዴት ነው? ለእኔም የሆነው የልብህ ናፍቆትና ርኅራኄህ ተከለከለ።

verses.text_english: Doubtless thou our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, our father, our redeemer; thy name from everlasting.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም ባያውቀን እስራኤልም ባይገነዘበን አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፥ ስምህም ከዘላለም ታዳጊያችን ነው።

verses.text_english: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከመንገድህ ለምን አሳትኸን? እንዳንፈራህም ልባችንን ለምን አጸናህብን? ስለ ባሪያዎችህ ስለ ርስትህ ነገዶች ተመለስ።

verses.text_english: The people of thy holiness have possessed but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሰው ሕዝብህ መቅደስህን ጥቂት ጊዜ ወረሱት፤ ጠላቶቻችንም ረግጠውታል።

verses.text_english: We are : thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘላለም እንዳልገዛኸን በስምህም እንዳልተጠራን ሆነናል።

verses.text_english: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
verses.text_amharic: ሰማዮችን ቀድደህ ምነው ብትወርድ! ተራሮችም ምነው ቢናወጡ!

verses.text_english: As the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.text_amharic: እሳት ጭራሮውን እንደሚያቃጥል፥ እሳትም ውኃውን እንደሚያፈላ፥ ስምህ ለጠላቶችህ ይገለጥ ዘንድ፥ አሕዛብም በፊትህ ይንቀጠቀጡ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: When thou didst terrible things we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
verses.text_amharic: ያልተጠባበቅነውን የክብርህን ሥራ ባደረግህ ጊዜ፥ ወረድህ ተራሮችም በፊትህ ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.text_english: For since the beginning of the world have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ከጥንት ጀምሮ ለሚጠብቁህ ከምትሠራላቸው ከአንተ በቀር ሌላ አምላክን አልሰሙም በጆሮአቸውም አልተቀበሉም ዓይንም አላየችም።

verses.text_english: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን የሚያደርገውን በመንገዶችህም የሚያስቡህን ትገናኛቸዋለህ። እነሆ፥ እነተ ተቈጣህ እኛም ኃጢአት ሠራን፤ ስለዚህም ተሳሳትን።

verses.text_english: But we are all as an unclean , and all our righteousnesses as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችን እንደ ርኩስ ሰው ሆነናል፥ ጽድቃችንም ሁሉ እንደ መርገም ጨርቅ ነው፤ ሁላችንም እንደ ቅጠል ረግፈናል፥ በደላችንም እንደ ነፋስ ወስዶናል።

verses.text_english: And none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህንም የሚጠራ፥ አንተንም ሊይዝ የሚያስብ የለም፤ ፊትህንም ከእኛ ሰውረሃል፥ በኃጢአታችንም አጥፍተኸናል።

verses.text_english: But now, O LORD, thou our father; we the clay, and thou our potter; and we all the work of thy hand.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ እኛ ጭቃ ነን አንተም ሠሪያችን ነህ፥ እኛም ሁላችን የእጅህ ሥራ ነን።

verses.text_english: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we all thy people.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እጅግ አትቈጣ፥ ለዘላለምም ኃጢአትን አታስብ፤ እነሆ፥ እባክህ፥ ተመልከት፥ እኛ ሁላችን ሕዝብህ ነን።

verses.text_english: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.text_amharic: የተቀደሱ ከተሞችህ ምድረ በዳ ሆነዋል፤ ጽዮን ምድረ በዳ ኢየሩሳሌምም ውድማ ሆናለች።

verses.text_english: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን አንተን ያመሰገኑበት የተቀደሰና የተዋበ ቤታችን በእሳት ተቃጥሎአል፥ ያማረውም ስፍራችን ሁሉ ፈርሶአል።

verses.text_english: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these , O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በውኑ በዚህ ነገር ትታገሣለህን? ዝምስ ትላለህን? አጥብቀህስ ታስጨንቀናለህን?

verses.text_english: I am sought of asked not ; I am found of sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation was not called by my name.
