verses.text_amharic: ላልጠየቁኝ ተገለጥሁ፥ ላልፈለጉኝም ተገኘሁ፤ በስሜም ያልተጠራውን ሕዝብ። እነሆኝ፥ እነሆኝ አልሁት።

verses.text_english: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ባልሆነው መንገድ፥ አሳባቸውን እየተከተሉ፥ ወደሚሄዱ ወደ ዓመፀኛ ሕዝብ ቀኑን ሁሉ እጆቼን ዘረጋሁ።

verses.text_english: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ ዘወትር የሚያስቈጡኝ ናቸው፤ እነርሱ በአትክልት ውስጥ የሚሠዉ በጡብም ላይ የሚያጥኑ፥

verses.text_english: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable their vessels;
verses.text_amharic: በመቃብርም መካከል የሚቀመጡ፥ በስውርም ስፍራ የሚያድሩ፥ የእሪያ ሥጋም የሚበሉ ናቸው። የረከሰው መረቅ በዕቃቸው ውስጥ አለ።

verses.text_english: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ለራስህ ቁም፥ እኔ ከአንተ ይልቅ ቅዱስ ነኝና ወደ እኔ አትቅረብ ይላሉ፤ እነዚህ በአፍንጫዬ ዘንድ ጢስ ቀኑንም ሁሉ የምትነድድ እሳት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold, written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በፊቴ ተጽፎአል። ኃጢአታችሁና የአባቶቻችሁን ኃጢአት በአንድ ላይ ወደ ብብታቸው ፍዳ አድርጌ አመልሳለሁ እንጂ ዝም አልልም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
verses.text_amharic: በተራሮችም ላይ ስላጠኑ፥ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ስለ ሰደቡኝ፥ ስለዚህ አስቀድመው የሠሩትን ሥራቸውን በብብታቸው እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወይን በዘለላው በተገኘች ጊዜ። በረከት በእርስዋ ላይ አለና አታጥፉት እንደሚባለው፥ ሁሉን እንዳላጠፉ ስለባሪያዎቼ እንዲሁ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.text_amharic: ከያዕቆብ ዘርን ከይሁዳም ተራሮቼን የሚወርሰውን አወጣለሁ፤ እኔም የመረጥኋቸው ይወርሱአታል፥ ባሪያዎቼም በዚያ ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.text_amharic: ሳሮንም የበጎች ማሰማርያ፥ የአኮርም ሸለቆ የላሞች መመሰግያ ለፈልጉኝ ሕዝቤ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But ye they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተን ግን እግዚአብሔርን የተዋችሁትን፥ ቅዱሱንም ተራራዬን የረሳችሁትን፥ ጉድ ለተባለ ጣዖትም ማዕድ ያዘጋጃችሁትን፥ እድል ለተባለ ጣዖትም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን የቀዳችሁትን፥

verses.text_english: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose wherein I delighted not.
verses.text_amharic: እድላችሁን ለሰይፍ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ሁላችሁም ለመታረድ ትጐነበሳላችሁ፤ በፊቴም ክፉ ነገርን አደረጋችሁ፥ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጣችሁ እንጂ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሳችሁልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰማችሁኝምና።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ይበላሉ እናንተ ግን ትራባላችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ይጠጣሉ እናንተ ግን ትጠማላችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል እናንተ ግን ታፍራላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ከልባቸው ደስታ የተነሣ ይዘምራሉ፥ እናንተ ግን ከልባችሁ ኀዘን የተነሣ ትጮኻላችሁ፥ መንፈሳችሁም ስለ ተሰበረ ወዮ ትላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
verses.text_amharic: ስማችሁንም ለተመረጡት ሕዝቤ እርግማን አድርጋችሁ ትተዋላችሁ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ይገድላችኋል፥ ባሪያዎቹንም በሌላ ስም ይጠራቸዋል።

verses.text_english: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በምድር ላይ የተባረከ በእውነት አምላክ ይባረካል፥ በምድርም ላይ የማለ በእውነት አምላክ ይምላል፤ የቀድሞው ጭንቀት ተረስቶአልና፥ ከዓይኔም ተሰውሮአልና።

verses.text_english: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር እፈጥራለሁና፤ የቀደሙትም አይታሰቡም፥ ወደ ልብም አይገቡም።

verses.text_english: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በፈጠርሁት ደስ ይበላችሁ ለዘላለምም ሐሤት አድርጉ፤ እነሆ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን ለሐሤት፥ ሕዝብዋንም ለደስታ እፈጥራለሁና።

verses.text_english: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በኢየሩሳሌም ሐሤት አደርጋለሁ በሕዝቤም ደስ ይለኛል፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ የልቅሶ ድምፅና የዋይታ ድምፅ አይሰማባትም።

verses.text_english: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner an hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወዲያ ጥቂት ዘመን ብቻ የሚኖር ሕፃን፥ ወይም ዕድሜውን ያልፈጸመ ሽማግሌ አይገኝም፤ ጕልማሳው የመቶ ዓመት ሆኖት ይሞታልና፥ ኃጢአተኛውም የመቶ ዓመት ሆኖት የተረገመ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: And they shall build houses, and inhabit ; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ ይቀመጡባቸውማል፤ ወይኑንም ይተክላሉ ፍሬውንም ይበላሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ እንዲቀመጥበት አይሠሩም፥ ሌላም እንዲበላው አይተከሉም፤ የሕዝቤ ዕድሜ እንደ ዛፍ ዕድሜ ይሆናልና፥ እኔም የመረጥኋቸው በእጃቸው ሥራ ረጅም ዘመን ደስ ይላቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ከነልጆቻቸው የእግዚአብሔር ቡሩካን ዘር ናቸውና በከንቱ አይደክሙም ለጥፋትም አይወልዱም።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ሳይጠሩ አመልስላቸዋለሁ፥ ገናም ሲናገሩ እሰማለሁ።

verses.text_english: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ተኵላና ጠቦት በአንድነት ይሰማራሉ፥ አንበሳም እንደ በሬ ገለባ ይበላል፥ የእባብም መብል ትቢያ ይሆናል። በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ሁሉ አይጐዱም፥ አያጠፉምም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, The heaven my throne, and the earth my footstool: where the house that ye build unto me? and where the place of my rest?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው፥ ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ የምትሠሩልኝ ቤት ምን ዓይነት ነው? የማርፍበትስ ስፍራ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For all those hath mine hand made, and all those have been, saith the LORD: but to this will I look, to poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን ሁሉ እጄ ሠርታለችና እነዚህ ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን ወደዚህ ወደ ትሑት፥ መንፈሱም ወደ ተሰበረ፥ በቃሌም ወደሚንቀጠቀጥ ሰው እመለከታለሁ።

verses.text_english: He that killeth an ox he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, swine's blood; he that burneth incense, he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
verses.text_amharic: በሬን የሚያርድልኝ ሰውን እንደሚገድል ነው፤ ጠቦትንም የሚሠዋ የውሻውን አንገት እንደሚሰብር ነው፤ የእህልን ቍርባን የሚያቀርብ የእርያን ደም እንደሚያቀርብ ነው፤ ዕጣንን የሚያጥን ጣዖትን እንደሚባርክ ነው። እነዚህ የገዛ መንገዳቸውን መረጡ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በርኵሰታቸው ደስ ይላታል፤

verses.text_english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose in which I delighted not.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ የተሳለቀባቸውን እመርጣለሁ፥ የፈሩትንም ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ፤ በፊቴ ክፉ ነገርን አደረጉ፥ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጡ እንጂ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰሙኝምና።

verses.text_english: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: በቃሉ የምትንቀጠቀጡ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ። የጠሉአችሁ ስለ ስሜም ያባረሩአችሁ ወንድሞቻችሁ። ደስታችሁን እናይ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይክበር ብለዋል፤ ነገር ግን ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: የጩኸት ድምፅ ከከተማ፥ ድምፅም ከመቅደስ፥ በጠላቶቹ ላይ ፍዳን የሚያመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
verses.text_amharic: ሳታምጥ ወለደች፤ ምጥም ሳያገኛት ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.text_english: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
verses.text_amharic: ከቶ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ማን ሰምቶአል? እንዲህስ ያለ ነገር ማን አይቶአል? በውኑ አገር በአንድ ቀን ታምጣለችን? ወይስ በአንድ ጊዜ ሕዝብ ይወለዳልን? ጽዮን እንዳማጠች ወዲያው ልጆችዋን ወልዳለችና።

verses.text_english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut ? saith thy God.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ወደ መውለድ የማደርስ እኔ አላስወልድምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የማስወልድስ ማኅፀንን እኔ እዘጋለሁን? ይላል አምላክሽ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምትወድዱአት ሁሉ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም ጋር ሐሤትን አድርጉ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ እናንተም የምታለቅሱላት ሁሉ፥ ከእርስዋ ጋር በደስታ ሐሤትን አድርጉ፥

verses.text_english: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
verses.text_amharic: ትጠቡ ዘንድ ከማጽናናትዋም ጡት ትጠግቡ ዘንድ፤ እጅግ ጠጥታችሁ በክብርዋ ሙላት ደስ ይላችሁ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon sides, and be dandled upon knees.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ሰላምን እንደ ወንዝ፥ የአሕዛብንም ክብር እንደሚጐርፍ ፈሳሽ እመልስላታለሁ፤ ከዚያም ትጠባላችሁ፥ በጫንቃ ላይ ይሸከሙአችኋል በጕልበትም ላይ እያስቀመጡ ያቀማጥሉአችኋል።

verses.text_english: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እናት ልጅዋን እንደምታጽናና እንዲሁ አጽናናችኋለሁ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ውስጥ ትጽናናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And when ye see , your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and indignation toward his enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ታያላችሁ፥ ልባችሁም ሐሤት ታደርጋለች፥ አጥንታችሁም እንደ ለምለም ሣር ትበቅላለች፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ ለሚፈሩት ትታወቃለች፥ በጠላቶቹም ላይ ይቈጣል።

verses.text_english: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር መዓቱን በቍጣ፥ ዘለፋውንም በእሳት ነበልባል ይመልስ ዘንድ ከእሳት ጋር ይመጣል፥ ሰረገሎቹም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ በእሳትና በሰይፉ ይፈርዳል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ተወግተው የሞቱት ይበዛሉ።

verses.text_english: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸው ያለውን አንዱን ተከትለው ወደ ገነቱ ይገቡ ዘንድ ሰውነታቸውን የሚቀድሱና የሚያነጹ፥ የእሪያንም ሥጋ አስጸያፊ ነገርንም አይጥንም የሚበሉ በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For I their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራቸውንና አሳባቸውን አውቄአለሁና፤ አሕዛብንና ልሳናትን ሁሉ የምሰበስብበት ጊዜ ይደርሳል፥ እነርሱም ይመጣሉ ክብሬንም ያያሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, Tubal, and Javan, the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም ምልክት አደርጋለሁ፥ ከእነርሱም የዳኑትን ዝናዬን ወዳልሰሙ፥ ክብሬንም ወዳላዩ ወደ አሕዛብ ወደ ተርሴስ ወደ ፉጥ ወደ ሉድ ወደ ሞሳሕ ወደ ቶቤል ወደ ያዋን በሩቅ ወዳሉ ደሴቶች እልካቸዋለሁ፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል ክብሬንም ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall bring all your brethren an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ቍርባናቸውን በጥሩ ዕቃ አድርገው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደሚያመጡ፥ እንዲሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን ይሆን ዘንድ ወንድሞቻችሁን ሁሉ፥ በፈረሶችና በሰረገሎች፥ በአልጋዎችና በበቅሎች በጠያር ግመሎችም ላይ አድርገው፥ ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ ወደ ተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡአቸዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will also take of them for priests for Levites, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናትና ሌዋውያን እንዲሆኑ ከእነርሱ እወስዳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የምሠራቸው አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር ከፊቴ ጸንተው እንደሚኖሩ፥ እንዲሁ ዘራችሁና ስማችሁ ጸንተው ይኖራሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ በየመባቻውና በየሰንበቱ ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ በፊቴ ይሰግድ ዘንድ ዘወትር ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥተውም በእኔ ያመፁብኝን ሰዎች ሬሳቸውን ያያሉ፤ ትላቸው አይሞትምና፥ እሳታቸውም አይጠፋምና፤ ለሥጋ ለባሽም ሁሉ አስጸያፊ ነገር ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.text_amharic: በብንያም አገር በዓናቶት ከነበሩ ካህናት የሆነ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ የኤርምያስ ቃል።

verses.text_english: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሞጽ ልጅ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን በመንግሥቱ በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣለት።

verses.text_english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን፥ እስከ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ እስከ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ፍጻሜ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም እስከ ተማረከችበት እስከ አምስተኛው ወር ድረስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.text_amharic: በሆድ ሳልሠራህ አውቄሃለሁ፥ ከማኅፀንም ሳትወጣ ቀድሼሃለሁ፥ ለአሕዛብም ነቢይ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I a child.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ወዮ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ እነሆ፥ ብላቴና ነኝና እናገር ዘንድ አላውቅም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንዲህ አለኝ። ወደምሰድድህ ሁሉ ዘንድ ትሄዳለህና፥ የማዝዝህንም ሁሉ ትናገራለህና። ብላቴና ነኝ አትበል።

verses.text_english: Be not afraid of their faces: for I with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ከፊታቸው አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እጁን ዘርግቶ አፌን ዳሰሰ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። እነሆ፥ ቃሌን በአፍህ ውስጥ አኑሬአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ። ትነቅልና ታፈርስ ዘንድ፥ ታጠፋና ትገለብጥ ዘንድ፥ ትሠራና ትተክል ዘንድ በአሕዛብና በመንግሥታት ላይ ዛሬ አድርጌሃለሁ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ኤርምያስ ሆይ፥ ምን ታያለህ? እያለ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እኔም። የለውዝ በትር አያለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። እፈጽመው ዘንድ በቃሌ እተጋለሁና መልካም አይተሃል አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof toward the north.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛም ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ምን ታያለህ? እያለ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እኔም። የሚፈላ አፍላል አያለሁ፥ ፊቱም ከሰሜን ወገን ነው አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ከሰሜን ወገን ክፉ ነገር በምድሪቱ በተቀመጡ ሁሉ ላይ ይገለጣል።

verses.text_english: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ በሰሜን ያሉትን የመንግሥታትን ወገኖች ሁሉ እጠራለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ይመጣሉ እያንዳንዳቸውም በኢየሩሳሌም በር መግቢያ በዙሪያዋ በቅጥርዋ ሁሉ ላይ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ዙፋናቸውን ያስቀምጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ክፋታቸውም ሁሉ፥ እኔን ስለ ተው ለሌሎችም አማልክት ስላጠኑ ለእጃቸውም ሥራ ስለ ሰገዱ፥ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ወገብህን ታጠቅ፥ ተነሥም፥ ያዘዝሁህም ሁሉ ንገራቸው፤ በፊታቸው እንዳላስፈራህ አትፍራቸው።

verses.text_english: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ በይሁዳም ነገሥታት በአለቆችዋና በካህናትዋ ላይ በምድሪቱም ሕዝብ ላይ እንደ ተመሸገ ከተማ እንደ ብረትም ዓምድ እንደ ናስም ቅጥር ዛሬ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ ጋር ይዋጋሉ፥ ነገር ግን አድንህ ዘንድ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ድል አይነሡህም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ጆሮ ጩኽ፥ እንዲህም በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የብላቴንነትሽን ምሕረት የታጨሽበትንም ፍቅር፥ በምድረ በዳ ዘር ባልተዘራበት ምድር እንደ ተከተልሽኝ አስቤአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Israel holiness unto the LORD, the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነበረ፥ የቡቃያውም በkWraት ነበረ፤ የበሉት እንደ በደለኞች ይቈጠራሉ፥ ክፉም ነገር ያገኛቸዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ ቤት የእስራኤልም ቤት ወገኖች ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁ ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቁ፥ ከንቱነትንም የተከተሉ፥ ከንቱም የሆኑ ምን ክፋት አግኝተውብኝ ነው?

verses.text_english: Neither said they, Where the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣን፥ በምድረ በዳም በባድማ gWdጓድም ባለበት ምድር፥ በውኃ ጥምና በሞት ጥላ ምድር፥ ማንም በማያልፍበትና ማንም በማይቀመጥበት ምድር የመራን እግዚአብሔር ወዴት አለ? አላሉም።

verses.text_english: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬዋንና በረከትዋንም ትበሉ ዘንድ ወደ ፍሬያማ ምድር አገባኋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን በገባችሁ ጊዜ ምድሬን አረከሳችሁ፥ ርስቴንም አጐሳቈላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The priests said not, Where the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after do not profit.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም። እግዚአብሔር ወዴት አለ? አላሉም፥ ባለ ኦሪቶችም አላወቁኝም፤ ገዢዎችም ዐመፁብኝ፥ ነቢያትም በበኣል ትንቢት ተናገሩ፥ የማይረባንም ነገር ተከተሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር እከራከራለሁ፥ ከልጆቻችሁም ልጆች ጋር እከራከራለሁ።

verses.text_english: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኪቲም ደሴቶች እለፉና ተመልከቱ፥ ወደ ቄዳርም ላኩና እጅግ መርምሩ፥ እንደዚህም ያለ ነገር ህኖ እንደ ሆነ እዩ።

verses.text_english: Hath a nation changed gods, which yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for doth not profit.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ አማልክት ያልሆኑትን አማልክቱን የለወጣቸው አንድ ሕዝብ አለን? ነገር ግን ሕዝቤ ክብሩን ለማይረባ ነገር ለወጠ።

verses.text_english: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ በዚህ ተደነቁ፥ እጅግም ደንግጡና ተንጥቀጡ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ሁለቱን ክፉ ነገሮች አድርገዋልና፤ እኔን የሕያውን ውኃ ምንጭ ትተውኛል፥ የተቀደዱትንም gWdጓዶች፥ ውኃውን ይይዙ ዘንድ የማይችሉትን gWdጓዶች፥ ለራሳቸው ቆፍረዋል።

verses.text_english: Israel a servant? he a homeborn ? why is he spoiled?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እስራኤል ባሪያ ነውን? ወይስ የቤት ውላጅ ነውን? ስለምን ብዝበዛ ሆነ?

verses.text_english: The young lions roared upon him, yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: የአንበሳ ደቦሎች በእርሱ ላይ አገሡ፥ ድምፃቸውንም ሰጡ፤ ምድሩንም ባድማ አደረጉ፥ ከተሞቹም ተቃጠሉ የሚቀመጥባቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
verses.text_amharic: የሜምፎስና የጣፍናስ ልጆች አስነወሩሽ አላገጡብሽም።

verses.text_english: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሁሉ የሆነብሽ እኔን ስለ ተውሽ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር አምላክሽ።

verses.text_english: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ የሺሖርን ውኃ ትጠጪ ዘንድ በግብጽ መንገድ ምን ጉዳይ አለሽ? የኤፍራጥስንም ውኃ ትጠጪ ዘንድ በአሦር መንገድ ምን ጉዳይ አለሽ?

verses.text_english: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that an evil and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ክፋትሽ ይገሥጽሻል ክዳትሽም ይዘልፍሻል፤ አምላክሽንም እግዚአብሔርን የተውሽ እኔንም መፍራት የሌለብሽ ክፉና መራራ ነገር እንደ ሆነ እወቂ፥ ተመልከቺ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ቀንበርሽን ሰብሬአለሁ እስራትሽንም ቈርጫለሁ፤ አንቺም። አላገለግልም አልሽ፥ ነገር ግን ከፍ ባለው ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ከለምለምም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ለማመንዘር ተጋደምሽ።

verses.text_english: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የተመረጠች ወይን ፍጹምም እውነተኛ ዘር አድርጌ ተክዬሽ ነበር፤ አንቺ ግን ክፉ የእንግዳ ወይን ግንድ ሆነሽ እንዴት ተለወጥሽብኝ?

verses.text_english: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በእንዶድ ብትታጠቢም፥ ለራስሽም ሳሙና ብታበዢ፥ በእኔ ፊት በኃጢአትሽ ረክሰሻል ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
verses.text_amharic: አንቺስ። አልረከስሁም በአሊምንም አልተከተልሁም እንዴት ትያለሽ? በቈላ ያለውን መንገድሽን ተመልከቺ፥ ያደረግሽውንም እወቂ፤ በመንገድም ላይ እንደ ተለቀቀች እንደ ፈጣን ግመል ሆነሻል፤

verses.text_english: A wild ass used to the wilderness, snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.text_amharic: በምኞትዋ ነፋስን እንደምታሸትት፥ በምድረ በዳ እንደ ለመደች እንደ ሜዳ አህያ ነሽ፤ ከምኞትዋ የሚመልሳት ማን ነው? የሚሹአት ሁሉ አይደክሙም፥ በወራትዋ ያገኙአታል።

verses.text_english: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
verses.text_amharic: እግርሽን ከሸካራ መንገድ gWroሮሽንም ከውኃ ጥም ከልክዪ፤ አንቺ ግን። እጨክናለሁ፥ እንግዶችን ወድጄአለሁና፥ እከተላቸዋለሁም አልሽ።

verses.text_english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
verses.text_amharic: ሌባ በተያዘ ጊዜ እንደሚያፍር እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ቤት፥ እነርሱና ንጉሦቻቸውም አለቆቻቸውም ካህናቶቻቸውም ነቢያቶቻቸውም ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: Saying to a stock, Thou my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned back unto me, and not face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
verses.text_amharic: ግንዱን።አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤ ድንጋዮንም። አንተ ወለድኸኝ ይላሉ፤ ፊታቸውንም ሳይሆን ጀርባቸውን ሰጡኝ፥ በመከራቸው ጊዜ ግን። ተነሥተህ አድነን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: But where thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንተ የሠራሃቸው አማልክትህ ወዴት ናቸው? ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ አማልክትህ እንደ ከተሞችህ KWTር እንዲሁ ናቸውና ይነሡ በመከራህም ጊዜ ያድኑህ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር የምትከራከሩ ለምንድር ነው? ሁላችሁ ዐምፃችሁብኛል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻችሁን በከንቱ ቀሥፌአቸዋለሁ፤ ተግሣጽን አልተቀበሉም፤ ሰይፋችሁ እንደሚሰብር አንበሳ ነቢያቶቻችሁን በልቶአል።

verses.text_english: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
verses.text_amharic: ትውልድ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ተመልከቱ። በውኑ ለእስራኤል ምድረ በዳ ወይስ የጨለመች ምድር ሆንሁባትን? ሕዝቤስ ስለ ምን። እኛ ፈርጥጠናል፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ወደ አንተ አንመለስም ይላል?

verses.text_english: Can a maid forget her ornaments, a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ቆንጆ ጌጥዋን ወይስ ሙሽራ ዝርግፍ ጌጥዋን ትረሳለችን? ሕዝቤ ግን የማይቈጠር ወራት ረስቶኛል።

verses.text_english: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
verses.text_amharic: ፍቅርን ለመሻት መንገድሽን እንዴት ታቀኛለሽ! ስለዚህ ለክፉዎች ሴቶች እንኳ መንገድሽን አስተምረሻል።

verses.text_english: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
verses.text_amharic: በእጆችሽም የንጹሐን ድሆች ደም ተገኝቶአል፤ በእነዚህ ሁሉ ላይ በግልጥ አገኘሁት እንጂ በስውር ፈልጌ አላገኘሁትም።

verses.text_english: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ግን። ንጹሕ ነኝ፤ በእውነት KWTaው ከእኔ ተመልሶአል አልሽ። እነሆ። ኃጢአት አልሠራሁም ብለሻልና በፍርድ እከስስሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድሽን ትለውጪ ዘንድ ለምን እጅግ ትሮጫለሽ? አሦር እንዳሳፈረሽ ግብጽ ያሳፍርሻል።

verses.text_english: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሄር የታመንሽባቸውን ጥሎአልና፥ በእነርሱም አይከናወንልሽምና እጅሽን በራስሽ ላይ አድርገሽ ከዚያ ደግሞ ትወጫለሽ። a

verses.text_english: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ዘንድ። ሰው ሚስቱን ቢፈታ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ ሄዳ ሌላ ወንድ ብታገባ፥ በውኑ ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ትመለሳለችን? ያች ሴት እጅግ የረከሰች አይደለችምን? ይባላል። አንቺ ከብዙ ውሽሞች ጋር አመንዝረሻል፥ ወደ እኔም ትመለሻለሽን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይንሽን አንሥተሽ ወደ ወናዎች ኮረብቶች ተመልከቺ፤ ያልተጋደምሽበት ስፍራ ወዴት አለ? ዓረባዊ በምድረ በዳ እንደሚቀመጥ አንቺ በመንገድ ላይ ተቀምጠሽ ትጠብቂያቸው ነበር፤ በግልሙትናሽና በኃጢአትሽ ምድሪቱን አረከስሽ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ካፊያ ተከለከለ፥ የኋለኛውም ዝናብ ጠፋ፤ የጋለሞታም ሴት ፊት ነበረብሽ፥ ታፍሪም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለሻል።

verses.text_english: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou the guide of my youth?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም። አንተ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የብላቴንነቴ ወዳጅ ነህ ብለሽ አልጮኽሽልኝምን? ለዘላለም ይቈጣልን?

verses.text_english: Will he reserve for ever? will he keep to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ፍጻሜስ ድረስ ይጠብቀዋልን? እነሆ፥ እንዲህ ብለሽ ተናገርሽ፥ እንደ ተቻለሽም መጠን ክፉን ነገር አደረግሽ።

verses.text_english: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በንጉሡ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን እንዲህ አለኝ። ከዳተኛይቱ እስራኤል ያደረገችውን አየህን? ወደ ረዘመው ተራራ ሁሉ ከለመለመ ዛፍም ሁሉ በታች ሄደች በዚያም ጋለሞተች።

verses.text_english: And I said after she had done all these , Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw .
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሁሉ ካደረገች በኋላ። ወደ እኔ ትመለሳለች ብዬ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አልተመለሰችም፤ አታላይ እኅትዋም ይሁዳ አየች።

verses.text_english: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳተኛይቱም እስራኤል ስላመነዘረች ስለዚህ ፈትቻታለሁ የፍችዋንም ወረቀት ሰጥቻታለሁ፤ አታላይ እኅትዋ ይሁዳ ግን እንዳልፈራች እርስዋም ደግሞ ሄዳ እንደ ጋለሞተች አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
verses.text_amharic: በግልሙትናዋም በመቅለልዋም ምድሪቱ ረከሰች፤ እርስዋም ከድንጋይና ከግንድ ጋር አመነዘረች።

verses.text_english: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ሁሉ አታላይቱ ይሁዳ በሐሰት እንጂ በፍጹም ልብዋ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሰችም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ከአታላይቱ ከይሁዳ ይልቅ ከዳተኛይቱ እስራኤል ጸደቀች።

verses.text_english: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I merciful, saith the LORD, I will not keep for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድና ይህን ቃል ወደ ሰሜን ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በል። ከዳተናይቱ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ተመለሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ መሐሪ ነኝና፥ ለዘላለምም አልቈጣምና በእናንተ ላይ ፊቴን አላደርግም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላክሽ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ እንዳመፅሽ፥ መንገድሽንም ከለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ለእንግዶች እንደ ዘረጋሽ፥ ቃሌንም እንዳልሰማሽ ኃጢአትሽን ብቻ እወቂ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
verses.text_amharic: ከዳተኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ እኔ ባላችሁ ነኝና ተመለሱ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንዱንም ከአንዲት ከተማ ሁለቱንም ከአንድ ወገን እወስዳችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ጽዮንም አመጣችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ልቤም በግ ጠባቆችን እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ በእውቀትና በማስተዋልም ይጠብቁአችኋል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit ; neither shall be done any more.
verses.text_amharic: በበዛችሁም ጊዜ በምድርም ላይ በረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያ ዘመን። የእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ብለው ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይጠሩም፤ ልብ አያደርጉትም፥ አያስቡትምም፥ አይሹትምም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም አይደረግም።

verses.text_english: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን ኢየሩሳሌምን የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ብለው ይጠሩአታል፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ወደ እርስዋ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ክፉውን እልከኛ ልባቸውን ተከትለው አይሄዱም።

verses.text_english: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን የይሁዳ ቤት ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ይሄዳል፤ በአንድም ሆነው ከሰሜን ምድር ርስት አድርጌ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን። ከወንዶች ልጆች ጋር እንዴት አደርግሻለሁ? ያማረችውንስ ምድር የከበረችውን የአሕዛብን ሠራዊት ርስት እንዴት እሰጥሻለሁ? ብዬ ነበር። ደግሞ። አባቴ ብለሽ ትጠሪኛለሽ እኔንም ከመከተል አትመለሽም ብዬ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Surely a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ሚስት ባልዋን እንደምታታታልል እንዲሁ አታለላችሁኝ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the LORD their God.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች መንገዳቸውን አጣምመዋልና፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ረስተዋልና በወናዎች ኮረብቶች ላይ የልመናቸውና ልቅሶአቸው ድምፅ ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: Return, ye backsliding children, I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳተኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ፥ ከዳተኛነታችሁንም እፈውሳለሁ። እነሆ፥ አንተ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነህና ወደ አንተ እንመጣለን።

verses.text_english: Truly in vain from the hills, the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God the salvation of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት የኮረብቶችና የተራሮች ፍጅት ከንቱ ናት፤ በእውነት የእስራኤል መዳን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከትንሽነታችን ጀምሮ የአባቶቻችን ድካም፥ በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም፥ እፍረት በልቶባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: ከትንሽነታችን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እኛና አባቶቻችን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና፥ የአምላካችንንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማንምና በእፍረታችን እንጋደም፥ ውርደታችንም ይክደነን።

verses.text_english: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ብትመለስ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመለስ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ርkWsvትህንም ከፊቴ ብታስወግድ፥ ባትናወጥም፥

verses.text_english: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብለህም በእውነትና በቅንነት በጽድቅም ብትምል፥ አሕዛብ በእርሱ ይባረካሉ በእርሱም ይመካሉ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለይሁዳና ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላልና። ጥጋቱን እርሻ እረሱ በእሾህም ላይ አትዝሩ።

verses.text_english: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench , because of the evil of your doings.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም የይሁዳ ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ስለ ሥራችሁ ክፋት KWTaዬ እንደ እሳት እንዳይወጣ የሚያጠፋውም ሳይኖር እንዳያቃጥል፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገረዙ፥ የልባችሁንም ሸለፈት አስወግዱ።

verses.text_english: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ዘንድ ተናገሩ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ አውሩና። በአገሪቱ ላይ መለከት ንፉ በሉ፤ ጮኻችሁም። ሁላችሁ ተሰብሰቡ ወደ ተመሸጉትም ከተሞች እንግባ በሉ።

verses.text_english: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰሜን ክፉ ነገርንና ጽኑ ጥፋትን አመጣለሁና ወደ ጽዮን ዓላማን አንሡ፤ ሽሹ፥ አትዘግዩ።

verses.text_english: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: አንበሳ ከጭፍቅ ዱር ወጥቶአል፥ አሕዛብንም የሚዘርፍ ተነሥቶአል፤ ምድርሽን ባድማ ያደርግ ዘንድ ከስፍራው ወጥቶአል፥ ከተሞችሽም ሰው የሌለባቸው ፍርስራሾች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ KWTa ከእኛ ዘንድ አልተመለሰምና ማቅ ልበሱ፥ አልቅሱም ዋይም በሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የንጉሡና የመኳንንቱ ልብ ይጠፋል፥ ካህናቱም ይደነቃሉ ነቢያቱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ፥ አንተ ሰይፍ እስከ ነፍስ ድረስ በደረሰ ጊዜ። ሰላም ይሆንላችኋል ብለህ ይህን ሕዝብና ኢየሩሳሌምን እጅግ አታለልህ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ጊዜ ለዚህ ሕዝብና ለኢየሩሳሌም። ለማበጠር ወይም ለማጥራት ሳይሆን የሚያቃጥል ነፋስ በምድረ በዳ ካሉ ከወናዎች ኮረብቶች ወደ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ይመጣል፤

verses.text_english: a full wind from those shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እኔ ጽኑ የሆነ ነፋስ ከእነዚህ ይመጣል ይባላል። አሁንም እኔ ደግሞ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንደ ደመና ይወጣል፥ ሰረገሎቹም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ፤ ፈረሶቹም ከንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ናቸው። ጠፍተናልና ወዮልን።

verses.text_english: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ትድኚ ዘንድ ልብሽን ከክፉ ነገር እጠቢ። ክፉ አሳብ የሚኖርብሽ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?

verses.text_english: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: የተናጋሪ ድምፅ ከዳን ዘንድ ይናገራልና፥ ከኤፍሬምም ኮረብቶች መከራን ያወራልና።

verses.text_english: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሕዛብ አሰሙና። እነሆ፥ ጠባቂዎች ከሩቅ አገር ይመጣሉ፤ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ላይ ይጮኻሉ ብላችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አውሩ።

verses.text_english: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ላይ ዓመፀኛ ሆናለችና በዙሪያዋ ከብበው እንደ እርሻ ጠባቂዎች ሆነውባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thy way and thy doings have procured these unto thee; this thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
verses.text_amharic: መንገድሽና ሥራሽ ይህን አድርጎብሻል፤ ይህ ክፋትሽ መራር ነው፥ ወደ ልብሽም ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.text_amharic: አንጀቴ! አንጀቴ! ልቤ በጣም ታምሞአል፥ በውስጤም ልቤ ታውኮብኛል፤ ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ የመለከትን ድምፅና የሰልፍን ውካታ ሰምተሻልና ዝም እል ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.text_english: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, my curtains in a moment.
verses.text_amharic: መከራ በመከራ ላይ ተጠርቶአል፤ ምድርም ሁሉ ተበዝብዛለችና፤ በድንገትም ድንኳኔ በቅጽበት ዓይንም መጋረጃዎቼ ጠፉ።

verses.text_english: How long shall I see the standard, hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.text_amharic: ዓላማውን የምመለከት፥ የመለከቱንስ ድምፅ የምሰማ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.text_english: For my people foolish, they have not known me; they sottish children, and they have none understanding: they wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ሰንፈዋልና አላወቁኝም፤ ሰነፎች ልጆች ናቸው፥ ማስተዋልም የላቸውም፤ ክፉ ነገርን ለማድረግ ብልሃተኞች ናቸው፥ በጎ ነገርን ማድረግ ግን አያውቁም።

verses.text_english: I beheld the earth, and, lo, without form, and void; and the heavens, and they no light.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱን አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ባዶ ነበረች አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ሰማያትንም አየሁ፥ ብርሃንም አልነበረባቸውም።

verses.text_english: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮችን አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ተንቀጠቀጡ፥ ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ተናወጡ።

verses.text_english: I beheld, and, lo, no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሰው አልነበረም፥ የሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ ሸሽተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, by his fierce anger.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ፍሬያማ እርሻ ምድረ በዳ ሆነች፥ ከተሞችም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከጽኑ KWTaው የተነሣ ፈርሰው ነበር።

verses.text_english: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ምድር ሁሉ ባድማ ትሆናለች፥ ነገር ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋትም።

verses.text_english: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken , I have purposed , and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምድር ታለቅሳለች፥ በላይም ሰማይ ይጠKWraል፤ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ አስቤአለሁም፤ አልጸጸትም ከእርሱም አልመለስም።

verses.text_english: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈረሰኞችና ከቀስተኞች ድምፅ የተነሣ ከተማ ሁሉ ሸሽታለች፤ ወደ ችፍግ ዱርም ይገባሉ በቋጥኝ ላይም ይወጣሉ፤ ከተማ ሁሉ ተለቅቃለች የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው የለም።

verses.text_english: And thou spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺም የተበዘበዝሽ ሆይ፥ ምን ታደርጊአለሽ? ቀይ በለበስሽ ጊዜ፥ በወርቅ አንባርም ባጌጥሽ ጊዜ፥ ዓይንሽንም በkWl በተኳልሽ ጊዜ፥ በከንቱ ታጌጫለሽ፤ ውሽሞችሽ አቃለሉሽ፥ ነፍስሽን ይሹአታል።

verses.text_english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, bewaileth herself, spreadeth her hands, , Woe me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.text_amharic: እንደምታምጥ የበkWrዋንም እንደምትወልድ ሴት ድምፅ ሰምቻለሁና፤ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ድምፅ በድካም ይሰልላል፥ እጆችዋንም ትዘረጋለችና። ተገድለው ከሞቱት የተነሣ ነፍሴ ዝላለችና ወዮልኝ! አለች።

verses.text_english: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም መንገድ እየተመላለሳችሁ ሩጡ፥ ተመልከቱም፥ እወቁም፥ በአደባባይዋም ፈልጉ፤ ፍርድን የሚያደርገውን እውነትንም የሚሻውን ሰው ታገኙ እንደሆነ ይቅር እላታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ቢሉ የሚምሉት በሐሰት ነው።

verses.text_english: O LORD, not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ዓይንህ እውነትን የምትመለከት አይደለችምን? አንተ ቀሥፈሃቸዋል ነገር ግን አላዘኑም፥ ቀጥቅጠሃቸውማል ነገር ግን ተግሣጽን እንቢ አሉ፤ ፊታቸውን ከድንጋይ ይልቅ አጠንክረዋል፤ ይመለሱ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore I said, Surely these poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, the judgment of their God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድና የአምላካቸውን ሕግ አላወቁምና እነዚህ በእውነት ድሆችና ሰነፎች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, burst the bonds.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ታላላቆቹ እሄዳለሁ እናገራቸውማለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገንድና የአምላካቸውን ሕግ ያውቃሉና አልሁ። እነዚህ ግን ቀንበሩን በአንድነት ሰብረዋል፥ እስራቱንም ቈርጠዋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, their backslidings are increased.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኃጢአታቸው በዝቶአልና፥ የክዳታቸውም ብዛት ጸንቶአልና ስለዚህ አንበሳ ከዱር ወጥቶ ይሰብራቸዋል፥ የበረሀም ተkWla ያጠፋቸዋል፥ ነብርም በከተሞቻቸው ላይ ይተጋል፥ ከዚያም የሚወጣ ሁሉ ይነጠቃል።

verses.text_english: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ ነገሮች ይቅር የምልሽ እንዴት አድርጌ ነው? ልጆችሽ ትተውኛል አማልክትም ባልሆኑ ምለዋል፤ ካጠገብኋቸውም በኋላ አመነዘሩ በጋለሞቶቹም ቤት ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: They were fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተቀለቡ ፈረሶች ሆኑ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም ከባልንጀሮቻቸው ሚስቶች ኋላ አሽካኩ።

verses.text_english: Shall I not visit for these ? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.text_english: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they not the LORD'S.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቅጥርዋ ወጥታችሁ አፍርሱ፥ ነገር ግን ፈጽማችሁ አታጥፉ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር አይደሉምና ቅርንጫፍዋን ውሰዱ።

verses.text_english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤትና የይሁዳ ቤት በእኔ ላይ እጅግ ወንጅለዋል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: They have belied the LORD, and said, not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እርሱ አይደለም፥ ክፉ ነገርም አይመጣብንም ሰይፍንና ራብንም አናይም፤ ነቢያትም ነፋስ ይሆናሉ፥

verses.text_english: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ የለም፥ እንዲህም ይደረግባቸዋል ብለው እግዚአብሔርን ክደዋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ቃል ተናግራችኋልና እነሆ፥ በአፍህ ውስጥ ቃሌን እሳት ይህንም ሕዝብ እንጨት አደርጋለሁ፥ ትበላቸውማለች።

verses.text_english: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it a mighty nation, it an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሕዝብን ከሩቅ አመጣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ኃያል ጥንታዊ ሕዝብ ነው፥ ቋንቋቸውንም የማታውቀው የሚናገሩትንም የማታስተውለው ሕዝብ ነው።

verses.text_english: Their quiver as an open sepulchre, they all mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: የፍላጻቸውም ሰገባ እንደ ተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ ሁሉም ኃያላን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: መከርህንና እንጀራህን ይበላሉ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህንም ይበሉአቸዋል፤ በጎችህንና ላሞችህንም ይበላሉ፤ ወይንህንና በለስህንም ይበላሉ፤ የምትታመናቸውን የተመሸጉ ከተሞችን በሰይፍ ይደበድባሉ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በዚያ ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ፈጽሜ አላጠፋችሁም።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land not yours.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ስለምን አደረገብን? ብትሉ፥ አንተ። እንደ ተዋችሁኝ በአገራችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት እንዳመለካችሁ፥ እንዲሁ ለእናንተ ባልሆነ አገር ለሌሎች ሰዎች ትገዛላችሁ ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ይህን በያዕቆብ ቤት አውሩ፥ በይሁዳም አሰሙ።

verses.text_english: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሰነፎች ልበ ቢሶች፥ ዓይን እያላችሁ የማታዩ፥ ጆሮም እያላችሁ የማትሰሙ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እኔን አትፈሩምን? ከፊቴስ አትደነግጡምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እንዳያልፍ አሸዋን በዘላለም ትእዛዝ ለባሕር ዳርቻ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ሞገዱም ቢናወጥ አያሸንፍም፥ ቢጮኽም አያልፍበትም።

verses.text_english: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህ ሕዝብ ግን የሸፈተና ያመፀ ልብ አላቸው፤ ዐምፀዋል ሄደውማል።

verses.text_english: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.text_amharic: በልባቸውም። የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን ዝናብ በጊዜው የሚሰጠውን፥ ለመከርም የተመደቡትን ወራት የሚጠብቅልንን አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንፍራ አላሉም።

verses.text_english: Your iniquities have turned away these , and your sins have withholden good from you.
verses.text_amharic: በደላችሁ እነዚህን አስቀርታለች፥ ኃጢአታችሁም መልካምን ነገር ከለከለቻችሁ።

verses.text_english: For among my people are found wicked : they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቤ መካከል ክፉዎች ሰዎች ተገኝተዋል፤ እንደ አጥማጆችም ያደባሉ፥ ወጥመድንም ይዘረጋሉ ሰዎችንም ያጠምዳሉ።

verses.text_english: As a cage is full of birds, so their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.text_amharic: ቀፎ ወፎችን እንደሚሞላ፥ እንዲሁ ቤታቸው ሽንገላን ሞልታለች፤እንዲሁም ከብረዋል ባለ ጠጎችም ሆነዋል።

verses.text_english: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.text_amharic: ወፍረዋል ሰብተውማል፥ ክፋታቸውንም ያለ ልክ አብዝተዋል፤ የድሀ አደጎች ነገር መልካም እንዲሆን አልተምዋገቱላቸውም፥ የችግረኞችንም ፍርድ አልፈረዱላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Shall I not visit for these ? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.text_english: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.text_amharic: የምታስደንቅና የምታስደነግጥ ነገር በምድር ላይ ሆናለች፤

verses.text_english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.text_amharic: ነቢያት በሐሰት ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ካህናትም በእነዚህ እጅ ይገዛሉ፥ ሕዝቤም እንዲህ ያለውን ነገር ይወድዳሉ፤ በፍጻሜውስ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.text_english: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የብንያም ልጆች፥ ክፉ ነገር ታላቅም ጥፋት ከሰሜን ይጐበኛልና ከኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ በቴቁሔ መለከቱን ንፉ፥ በቤትሐካሪም ላይ ምልክት አንሡ።

verses.text_english: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate .
verses.text_amharic: የተዋበችውንና የተሰባቀለችውን የጽዮንን ልጅ አጐሰቍላለሁ።

verses.text_english: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞችና መንጐቻቸው ወደ እርስዋ ይመጣሉ፥ በዙሪያዋም ድንኳኖቻቸውን ይተክሉባታል፥ እያንዳንዱም በስፍራው መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.text_english: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋ ላይ ሰልፍ አዘጋጁ ተነሡ፥ በቀትርም እንውጣ። ቀኑ መሽቶአልና፥ የማታውም ጥላ ረዝሞአልና ወዮልን።

verses.text_english: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሡ በሌሊትም እንውጣ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም እናፍርስ።

verses.text_english: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this the city to be visited; she wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ዛፎችዋን ቍረጡ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ አፈርን ደልድሉ፤ ይህች ከተማ የምትቀሠፍ ናት፤ መካከልዋ ሁሉ ግፍ ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually grief and wounds.
verses.text_amharic: በጕድጓድ ውኃ እንደሚፈልቅ፥ እንዲሁ ክፋትዋ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ይፈልቃል፤ ግፍና ቅሚያ በእርስዋ ዘንድ ይሰማል፥ ደዌና ቍስልም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አለ።

verses.text_english: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ነፍሴ ከአንቺ እንዳትለይ፥ አንቺንም ባድማና ወና እንዳላደርግሽ፥ ተግሣጽን ተቀበዪ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰው ወይኑን እንደሚቃርም፥ እንዲሁ ከእስራኤል የቀሩትን ፈጽሞ ይቃርሙአቸዋል፤ እጅህንም እንደ ለቃሚ ወደ እንቅብ ዘርጋ።

verses.text_english: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.text_amharic: ይሰሙኝስ ዘንድ ለማን እናገራለሁ? ለማንስ አስጠነቅቃለሁ? እነሆ፥ ጆሮአቸው ያልተገረዘች ናት ለመስማትም አይችሉም፤ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ለስድብ ሆኖባቸዋል፥ ደስም አያሰኛቸውም።

verses.text_english: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with full of days.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ተሞልቻለሁ፤ ከመታገሥ ደክሜአለሁ፤ በሜዳ በሕፃናት ላይ በጕልማሶችም ጉባዔ ላይ በአንድነት አፍስሰው፤ ባል ከሚስቱ ጋር ሽማግሌውም ከጎበዙ ጋር ይያያዛልና።

verses.text_english: And their houses shall be turned unto others, fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እጄን በምድር በሚኖሩ ላይ እዘረጋለሁና ቤቶቻቸው እርሻዎቻቸውም ሴቶቻቸውም በአንድነት ለሌሎች ይሆናሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.text_amharic: ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ስስትን ያስባሉና፥ ከነቢዩም ጀምሮ እስከ ካህኑ ድረስ ሁሉ በተንኰል ያደርጋሉና።

verses.text_english: They have healed also the hurt of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when no peace.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቤንም ስብራት በጥቂቱ ይፈውሳሉ፤ ሰላም ሳይሆን። ሰላም ሰላም ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ርኩስን ነገር ስለ ሠሩ አፍረዋልን? ምንም አላፈሩም፥ እፍረትንም አላወቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከሚወድቁ ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ በጐበኘኋቸው ጊዜ ይዋረዳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመንገድ ላይ ቁሙ ተመልከቱም፥ የቀደመችውንም መንገድ ጠይቁ፤ መልካሚቱ መንገድ ወዴት እንደ ሆነች እወቁ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ሂዱ፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን። አንሄድባትም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Also I set watchmen over you, , Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። የመለከቱን ድምፅ አድምጡ ብዬ ጠባቆችን ሾምሁባችሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን። አናደምጥም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what among them.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ስሙ፤ ማኅበር ሆይ፥ እነዚያ የሚያገኛቸውን እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሆይ፥ ስሚ፤ እነሆ፥ ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ሕጌንም ስለ ጣሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ የአሳባቸውን ፍሬ ክፉን ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምንስ ከሳባ ዕጣንን፥ ከሩቅም አገር ቀረፋን ታቀርቡልኛላችሁ? የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን አልቀበለውም ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት ዕንቅፋቶችን አደርጋለሁ፤ አባቶችና ልጆች በአንድነት ይሰናከሉባቸዋል፥ ጎረቤትና ባልንጀራም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን አገር ይመጣል፥ ታላቅ ሕዝብም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣል።

verses.text_english: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው፥ ምሕረትንም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል፥ በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.text_english: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.text_amharic: ወሬውን ሰምተናል፥ እጃችን ደክማለች፤ ምጥ ወላድን ሴት እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞናል።

verses.text_english: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy fear on every side.
verses.text_amharic: የጠላት ሰይፍና ድንጋጤ ከብበዋችኋልና ወደ ሜዳ አትውጡ በምንገድም ላይ አትሂዱ።

verses.text_english: O daughter of my people, gird with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቤ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማቅ ልበሺ በአመድም ውስጥ ተንከባለዪ፤ አጥፊ በላያችን በድንገት ይመጣብናልና ለአንድያ ልጅ እንደሚደረግ ልቅሶ፥ መራራ ልቅሶ አልቅሺ።

verses.text_english: I have set thee a tower a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዳቸውን እንድታውቅና እንድትፈትን በሕዝቤ መካከል ፈታኝ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: They all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: brass and iron; they all corrupters.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ሁሉ እጅግ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው፤ በጠማማነት ይሄዳሉ፤ ናስና ብረት ናቸው፤ ሁሉ ርኵሰትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.text_amharic: ወናፍ አናፋ እርሳሱም በእሳት ቀለጠ፤ አንጥረኛውም መልሶ በከንቱ ያቀልጠዋል፤ ኃጢአተኞች አልተወገዱም።

verses.text_english: Reprobate silver shall call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጥሎአቸዋልና የተጣለ ብር ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Stand in the gate of the LORD'S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር ቁም፥ ይህንም ቃል እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገር። እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ በእነዚህ በሮች የምትገቡ ከይሁዳ ያላችሁ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን አሳምሩ በዚህም ስፍራ አሳድራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, these.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ይህ ነው እያላችሁ በሐሰት ቃል አትታመኑ።

verses.text_english: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.text_amharic: መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን ፈጽማችሁ ብታሳምሩ፥ በሰውና በጎረቤቱ መካከል ቅን ፍርድ ብትፈርዱ፥

verses.text_english: ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.text_amharic: መጻተኛውንና ድሀ አደጉን መበለቲቱንም ባትገፉ፥ በዚህም ስፍራ ንጹሕ ደምን ባታፈስሱ፥ ክፉም ሊሆንባችሁ እንግዶችን አማልክት ባትከተሉ፥

verses.text_english: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ለአባቶቻችሁ በሰጠኋቸው ምድር በዚህ ስፍራ አሳድራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በማትረቡበት በሐሰት ቃል ታምናችኋል።

verses.text_english: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
verses.text_amharic: ትሰርቃላችሁ፥ ትገድላላችሁ፥ ታመነዝራላችሁ፥ በሐሰትም ትምላላችሁ፥ ለበኣልም ታጥናላችሁ፥ የማታውቋቸውንም እንግዶች አማልክት ትከተላላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.text_amharic: መጣችሁም፥ ስሜም በተጠራበት በዚህ ቤት በፊቴ ቆማችሁ። ይህን አስጸያፊ የሆነ ነገርን ሁሉ አላደረግንም አላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen , saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ይህስ ስሜ የተጠራበት ቤት በዓይናችሁ የሌቦች ዋሻ ሆኖአልን? እነሆ፥ እኔ አይቻለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But go ye now unto my place which in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በቀድሞ ዘመን ስሜን ወዳሳደርሁበት በሴሎ ወደ ነበረው ስፍራዬ ሂዱ፥ ከሕዝቤም ከእስራኤል ክፋት የተነሣ ያደረግሁበትን እዩ።

verses.text_english: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ስላደረጋችሁ፥ በማለዳም ተነሥቼ በተናገርኋችሁ ጊዜ ስላልሰማችሁ፥ በጠራኋችሁም ጊዜ ስላልመለሳችሁ፥

verses.text_english: Therefore will I do unto house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በሴሎ እንዳደረግሁ እንዲሁ ስሜ በተጠራበት በምትታመኑበት ቤት ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠኋችሁ ስፍራ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬምንም ዘር ሁሉ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁን ሁሉ እንደ ጣልሁ፥ እንዲሁ ከፊቴ እጥላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህም አልሰማህምና ስለዚህ ሕዝብ አትጸልይ ስለ እነርሱም ልመናና ጸሎት አታድርግ፤ አትማልድላቸው።

verses.text_english: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ውስጥና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ላይ የሚያደርጉትን አታይምን?

verses.text_english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.text_amharic: ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ፥ ለሰማይ ንግሥት እንጐቻ እንዲያደርጉ ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥ ቍርባን እንዲያፈስሱ ልጆች እንጨት ይሰበስባሉ፥ አባቶችም እሳት ያነድዳሉ፥ ሴቶችም ዱቄት ይለውሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: not themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ያስቈጣሉን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለፊታቸውስ እፍረት አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ቍጣዬና መዓቴ በዚህ ስፍራ ላይ፥ በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ፥ በዱር ዛፎችና በምድር ፍሬ ላይ ይፈስሳል፤ ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋምም።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን ጨምሩ፥ ሥጋውንም ብሉ።

verses.text_english: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽ ምድር ባወጣኋችሁ ቀን ስለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ስለ ሌላ መሥዋዕት ለአባቶቻችሁ አልተናገርሁምና፥ አላዘዝኋቸውምም።

verses.text_english: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። ቃሌን ስሙ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ፤ መልካምም ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ ባዘዝኋችሁ መንገድ ሁሉ ሂዱ ብዬ በዚህ ነገር አዘዝኋቸው።

verses.text_english: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በክፉ ልባቸው አሳብና እልከኝነት ሄዱ ወደ ፊትም ሳይሆን ወደ ኋላቸው ሄዱ እንጂ አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።

verses.text_english: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending :
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችሁ ከግብጽ ምድር ከወጡበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፥ በየዕለቱ እየማለድሁ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ልኬባችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ እንጂ አልሰሙኝም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም፤ አባቶቻቸውም ካደረጉት ይልቅ የባሰ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ቃል ሁሉ ትነግራቸዋለህ፥ ነገር ግን አይሰሙህም፤ ትጠራቸውማለህ፥ ነገር ግን አይመልሱልህም።

verses.text_english: But thou shalt say unto them, This a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ያልሰማ፥ ተግሣጽንም ያልተቀበለ ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ እውነት ጠፍቶአል ከአፋቸውም ተቈርጦአል ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Cut off thine hair, , and cast away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የቍጣውን ትውልድ ጥሎአልና፥ ትቶታልምና ጠጕርሽን ቍረጪ፥ ጣዪውም፥ በወናዎች ኮረብቶችም ላይ አሙሺ።

verses.text_english: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ልጆች በፊቴ ክፉን ነገር ሠርተዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ያረክሱትም ዘንድ ስሜ በተጠራበት ቤት ርኵሰታቸውን አኑረዋል።

verses.text_english: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ያላዘዝሁትንና በልቤ ያላሰብሁትን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ያለችውን የቶፌትን መስገጃዎች ሠረተዋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ስፍራ ከማጣት የተነሣ በቶፌት ይቀበራሉና የእርድ ሸለቆ ይባላል እንጂ ቶፌት ወይም የሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray away.
verses.text_amharic: የዚህም ሕዝብ ሬሳ ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናል፥ የሚያስፈራራቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ባድማ ትሆናለችና ከይሁዳ ከተሞችና ከኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የይሁዳን ነገሥታት አጥንትና የመኳንንቶቹን አጥንት፥ የካህናቱን አጥንትና የነቢያቱን አጥንት፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ሰዎች አጥንት ከመቃብራቸው ያወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በወደዱአቸውና ባመለኩአቸው፥ በተከተሉአቸውና በፈለጉአቸው፥ በሰገዱላቸውም በፀሐይና በጨረቃ በሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ፊት ይዘረጉአቸዋል፤ አያከማቹአቸውም አይቀብሩአቸውምም፥ በምድርም ፊት ላይ እንደ ጕድፍ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ባሳደድኋቸው ስፍራ ሁሉ የቀሩ፥ ከዚህች ክፉ ወገን የተረፉ ቅሬታዎች ሁሉ፥ ከሕይወት ይልቅ ሞትን ይመርጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ትላቸዋለሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የወደቁ አይነሡምን? የሳተስ አይመለስምን?

verses.text_english: Why is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ይህ የኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ዘወትር ስለ ምን ወደ ኋላው ይመለሳል? ተንኰልን ይዞአል ሊመለስም እንቢ ብሎአል።

verses.text_english: I hearkened and heard, they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.text_amharic: አደመጥሁ ሰማሁም፤ ቅንን ነገር አልተናገሩም፤ ማናቸውንም። ምን አድርጌአለሁ? ብሎ ከክፋቱ ንስሐ የገባ የለም፤ ወደ ሰልፍም እንደሚሮጥ ፈረስ እያንዳንዱ በየመንገዱ ይሄዳል።

verses.text_english: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሽመላ በሰማይ ጊዜዋን አውቃለች፤ ዋኖስና ጨረባ ዋልያም የመምጣታቸውን ጊዜ ይጠብቃሉ፤ ሕዝቤ ግን የእግዚአብሔርን ፍርድ አላወቁም።

verses.text_english: How do ye say, We wise, and the law of the LORD with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he ; the pen of the scribes in vain.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተስ። ጥበበኞች ነን የእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ ከእኛ ጋር ነው እንዴት ትላላችሁ? እነሆ፥ የጸሐፊ ብርዕ ሐሰተኛ ነው በሐሰትም አድርጎአል።

verses.text_english: The wise are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom in them?
verses.text_amharic: ጥበበኞች አፍረዋል ደንግጠውማል ተማርከውማል፤ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ጥለዋል፤ ምን ዓይነት ጥበብ አላቸው?

verses.text_english: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, their fields to them that shall inherit : for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.text_amharic: ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ስስትን ያስባሉና፥ ከነቢዩም ጀምሮ እስከ ካህኑ ድረስ ሁሉ በተንኰል ያደርጋሉና ስለዚህ ሚስቶቻቸውን ለሌሎች፥ እርሻቸውንም ለሚወርሱባቸው እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when no peace.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቤንም ሴት ልጅ ስብራት በጥቂቱ ይፈውሳሉ፤ ሰላም ሳይሆን። ስለም ሰላም ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አስጸያፊ ነገርን ስለ ሠሩ አፍረዋልን? ምንም አላፈሩም፥ እፍረትንም አላወቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከሚወድቁ ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ በጐበኘኋቸው ጊዜ ይዋረዳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር

verses.text_english: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጽሜ አጠፋችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በወይን ላይ ፍሬ፥ በበለስ ዛፍ ላይ በለስ አይሆንም፥ ቅጠልም ይረግፋል፤ የሚያልፉባቸውንም ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዝም ብለን ለም እንቀመጣለን? እግዚአብሔርን ስለ በደልን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አጥፍቶናልና፥ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጥቶናልና ተሰብስባችሁ ወደ ተመሸጉ ከተሞች እንግባ በዚያም እንጥፋ።

verses.text_english: We looked for peace, but no good for a time of health, and behold trouble!
verses.text_amharic: ሰላምን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ መልካምም አልተገኘም፤ መጠገንን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ እነሆም፥ ድንጋጤ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: የፈረሰኞቹ ድምጽ ከዳን ተሰማ፤ ከአርበኞች ፈረሶች ማሽካካት የተነሣ ምድር ሁሉ ተንቀጠቀጠች፤ መጡም ምድሪቱንና በእርስዋም ያለውን ሁሉ፥ ከተማይቱንና የተቀመጡባትንም በሉ።

verses.text_english: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which not charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አስማት የማይከለክላቸውን እባቦችንና እፉኝቶችን እሰድድባችኋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይነድፉአችኋል።

verses.text_english: I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart faint in me.
verses.text_amharic: ኅዘኔ የማይጽናና ነው፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደክሞአል።

verses.text_english: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: not the LORD in Zion? not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, with strange vanities?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ። እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን የለምን? ወይስ ንጉሥዋ በእርስዋ ዘንድ የለምን? የሚል የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ጩኸት ድምፅ ከሩቅ አገር ተሰማ። በተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውና በባዕድ ከንቱነትስ ያስቈጡኝ ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.text_amharic: መከሩ አልፎአል፥ በጋው ሄዶአል፥ እኛም አልዳንነም።

verses.text_english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ስብራት እኔ ተሰብሬአለሁ ጠKWreማለሁ፤ አድናቆትም ይዞኛል።

verses.text_english: no balm in Gilead; no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verses.text_amharic: በገለዓድ የሚቀባ መድኃኒት የለምን? ወይስ በዚያ ሐኪም የለምን? የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ፈውስ ስለ ምን አልሆነም?

verses.text_english: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.text_amharic: ተወግተው ስለ ሞቱ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ሰዎች ሌሊትና ቀን አለቅስ ዘንድ ራሴ ውኃ፥ ዓይኔም የእንባ ምንጭ በሆነልኝ!

verses.text_english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም አመንዝሮች፥ የአታላዮች ጉባኤ ናቸውና ሕዝቤን እተዋቸው ዘንድ ከእነርሱም እለይ ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ የመንገደኞች ማደሪያን ማን በሰጠኝ?

verses.text_english: And they bend their tongues their bow lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ምላሳቸውን ስለ ሐሰት እንደ ቀስት ገተሩ፤ በምድር በረቱ ነገር ግን ለእውነት አይደለም፤ ከክፋት ወደ ክፋት ይሄዳሉና እኔንም አላወቁምና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምም ሁሉ ያሰናክላልና፥ ባልንጀራም ሁሉ ያማልና እናንተ ሁሉ ከባልንጀሮቻችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፥ በወንድሞቻችሁም አትታመኑ።

verses.text_english: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን ያታልላል በእውነትም አይናገርም፤ ሐሰትን መናገርንም ምላሳቸው ተምሮአል፥ ክፉንም ለማድረግ ይደክማሉ።

verses.text_english: Thine habitation in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ማደሪያህ በሽንገላ መካከል ነው፥ ከሽንገላም የተነሣ እኔን ያውቁኝ ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ አቀልጣቸዋለሁ እፈትናቸውማለሁ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ክፋት ከዚህ ሌላ የማደርገው ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Their tongue an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
verses.text_amharic: ምላሳቸው የተሳለ ፍላጻ ነው፤ ሽንገላን ይናገራሉ ሰው ከባልንጀራው ጋር በሰላም ይናገራል፥ በልቡ ግን ያደባበታል።

verses.text_english: Shall I not visit them for these ? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ስለዚህ ነገር አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.text_english: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through ; neither can hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
verses.text_amharic: ለተራሮች ልቅሶን ለምድረ በዳ ማሰማርያዎችም ዋይታን አነሣለሁ፥ ሰው እንዳያልፍባቸው በእሳት ተቃጥለዋልና። ሰዎችም የከብቱን ድምፅ አይሰሙም፤ ከሰማይ ወፎች ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።

verses.text_english: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌምንም የፍርስራሽ ክምር የቀበሮም ማደሪያ አደርጋታለሁ፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ሰው የማይቀመጥባት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Who the wise man, that may understand this? and to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
verses.text_amharic: ይህን የሚያስተውል ጠቢብ ሰው ማን ነው? ያወራስ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ለማን ተናገረ? ሰው እንዳያልፍባት ምድርስ ስለምን ጠፋች፥ እንደ ምድረ በዳስ ስለ ምን ተቃጠለች?

verses.text_english: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለ። የሰጠኋቸውን ሕጌን ትተዋልና፥ ቃሌንም አልሰሙምና፥

verses.text_english: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
