verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የልባቸውን ምኞትና አባቶቻቸው ያስተማሩአቸውን በኣሊምን ተከትለዋልና

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ እሬትን አበላዋለሁ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጣዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱና አባቶቻቸውም ባላወቁአቸው አሕዛብ መካከል እበትናቸዋለሁ፥ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በስተ ኋላቸው ሰይፍን እሰድድባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning , that they may come:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲመጡ አልቃሾች ሴቶችን ጥሩ፤ እንዲመጡም ወደ ብልሃተኞች ሴቶች ላኩ፤

verses.text_english: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቻችንም እንባ እንዲያፈስሱ የዓይናችንም ሽፋሽፍቶች ውኃን እንዲያፈልቁ ፈጥነው ለእኛ ልቅሶውን ይያዙ።

verses.text_english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast out.
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን። እንዴት ተበዘበዝን! ምድርንም ትተናልና፥ ቤቶቻችንንም አፍርሰዋልና እንዴት አፈርን! የሚል የልቅሶ ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሴቶች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ ጆሮአችሁም የአፉን ቃል ትቀበል፥ ለሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ልቅሶውን፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ለባልንጀሮቻችሁ ዋይታውን አስተምሩ።

verses.text_english: For death is come up into our windows, is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, the young men from the streets.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃናቱን ከመንገድ ጕልማሶቹንም ከአደባባይ ያጠፉ ዘንድ ሞት ወደ መስኮታችን ደርሶአል ወደ አዳራሻችንም ውስጥ ገብቶአል።

verses.text_english: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather .
verses.text_amharic: የሰውም ሬሳ እንደ ጕድፍ በእርሻ ላይ፥ ማንምም እንደማይሰበስበው ከአጫጆች በኋላ እንደሚቀር ቃርሚያ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty glory in his might, let not the rich glory in his riches:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጠቢብ በጥበቡ አይመካ፥ ኃያልም በኃይሉ አይመካ፥ ባለ ጠጋም በብልጥግናው አይመካ፤

verses.text_english: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these I delight, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሚመካው። ምሕረትንና ፍርድን ጽድቅንም በምድር ላይ የማደርግ እኔ እግዚአብሔር መሆኔን በማወቁና በማስተዋሉ በዚህ ይመካ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኙኝ እነዚህ ናቸውና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all circumcised with the uncircumcised;
Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ ላይ የተናገረውን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሕዛብን መንገድ አትማሩ ከሰማይ ምልክትም አትፍሩ፤ አሕዛብ ይፈሩታልና።

verses.text_english: For the customs of the people vain: for cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ልማድ ከንቱ ነውና፤ ዛፍ ከዱር ይቈረጣል፥ በሠራተኛም እንጅ በመጥረቢያ ይሠራል።

verses.text_english: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.text_amharic: በብርና በወርቅ ያስጌጡታል፥ እንዳይናወጥም በችንካርና በመዶሻ ይቸነክሩታል።

verses.text_english: They upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also in them to do good.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተቀረጸ ዓምድ ናቸው እነርሱም አይናገሩም፤ መራመድም አይቻላቸውማን ይሸከሙአቸዋል። ክፉ መሥራትም አይቻላቸውምና፥ ደግምም መልካም ይሠሩ ዘንድ አይችሉምና አትፍሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Forasmuch as none like unto thee, O LORD; thou great, and thy name great in might.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ የለም፤ አንተ ታላቅ ነህ ስምህም በኃይል ታላቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, none like unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በአሕዛብ ጥበበኞች ሁሉ መካከል በመንግሥታቸውም ሁሉ እንደ አንተ ያለ ስለሌለ፥ አንተን መፍራት ይገባልና አንተን የማይፈራ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock a doctrine of vanities.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ ጊዜ ሰንፈዋል፥ ደንቍረውማል፤ ጣዖታት የሚያስተምሩት የእንጨት ነገር ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple their clothing: they all the work of cunning .
verses.text_amharic: የሠራተኛና የአንጥረኛ እጅ ሥራ የሆነ ከተርሴስ ጥፍጥፍ ብር ከአፌዝም ወርቅ ይመጣል፤ ልብሳቸውም ሰማያዊና ቀይ ግምጃ ነው፥ ሁሉም የብልሃተኞች ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: But the LORD the true God, he the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን እውነተኛ አምላክ ነው፤ እርሱም ሕያው አምላክና የዘላለም ንጉሥ ነው፤ ከቍጣው የተነሣ ምድር ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ አሕዛብም መዓቱን አይችሉም።

verses.text_english: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። ሰማይንና ምድርን ያልፈጠሩ እነዚህ አማልክት ከምድር ላይ ከሰማይም በታች ይጠፋሉ ትሉአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: When he uttereth his voice, a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.text_amharic: ድምፁን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናቡም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፋስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: Every man is brutish in knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image falsehood, and no breath in them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።

verses.text_english: They vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The portion of Jacob not like them: for he the former of all ; and Israel the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts his name.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፤ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነውና፤ ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.text_amharic: በምሽግ ውስጥ የተቀመጥሽ ሆይ፥ ዕቃሽን ከመሬት ሰብስቢ፤

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩትን እስኪሰማቸው ድረስ በዚህ ጊዜ እወነጭፋቸዋለሁ፥ አስጨንቃቸውማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ስብራቴ ወዮልኝ! ቍስሌም ክፉ ነው፥ እኔ ግን። በእውነት የመከራ ቍስሌ ነው እርሱንም መሸከም ይገባኛል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they not: none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.text_amharic: ድንኳኔ ተበዘበዘ አውታሬም ሁሉ ተቈረጠ፤ ልጆቼም ከእኔ ወጥተው አይገኙም፤ ድንኳኔንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሚዘረጋ መጋረጃዎችንም የሚያነሣ የለም።

verses.text_english: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞች ሰንፈዋልና፥ እግዚአብሔርን አልጠየቁትምና አልተከናወነላቸውም፥ መንጎቻቸውም ሁሉ ተበትነዋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, a den of dragons.
verses.text_amharic: የወሬን ድምፅ ስሙ፤ እነሆም፥ የይሁዳን ከተሞች ባድማና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ ከሰሜን ምድር ጽኑ ሽብር መጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: O LORD, I know that the way of man not in himself: not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሰው መንገድ ከራሱ እንዳይደለ አውቃለሁ፥ አካሄዱንም ለማቅናት ከሚራመድ ሰው አይደለም።

verses.text_english: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ቅጣኝ፤ ነገር ግን እንዳታዋርደኝ በመጠን ይሁን እንጂ በቍጣ አይሁን።

verses.text_english: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥ ውጠውትማልና፥ አጥፍተውትማልና፥ ማደሪያውንም አፍርሰዋልና በማያውቁህ አሕዛብ ስምህንም በማይጠሩ ወገኖች ላይ መዓትህን አፍስስ።

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.text_amharic: የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ስማ፥ ለይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ተናገር፥

verses.text_english: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

Which I commanded your fathers in the day I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም በላቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከግብጽ አገር ከብረት ምድጃ ባወጣኋቸው ቀን ለአባቶቻችሁ ያዘዝሁትን የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል የማይሰማ ሰው ርጉም ይሁን፤ አልሁም። ቃሌን ስሙ፥ ያዘዝኋችሁንም ሁሉ አድርጉ፤ እንዲሁም እናንተ ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድር እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችሁ የማልሁትን መሐላ አጸና ዘንድ ነው። እኔም። አቤቱ፥ አሜን ብዬ መለስሁለት።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ይህችን ቃል ሁሉ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በል። የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ስሙ አድርጉትም።

verses.text_english: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችሁን ከግብጽ ምድር ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፥ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ እያስጠነቀቅሁ። ቃሌን ስሙ በማለት አስጠንቅቄአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded to do; but they did not.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ሁሉ ግን በክፉ ልባቸው እልከኝነት ሄዱ እንጂ አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም፤ ስለዚህ ያዘዝኋቸውን እነርሱም ያላደረጉትን የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ሁሉ አመጣሁባቸው።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። በይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩ ዘንድ አድማ ተገኝቶአል።

verses.text_english: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌንም ይሰሙ ዘንድ እንቢ ወዳሉ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ኃጢአት ተመለሱ፥ ያመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ እንግዶችን አማልክት ተከተሉ፤ የእስራኤል ቤትና የይሁዳ ቤት ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን አፈረሱ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሊያመልጡት የማይችሉትን ክፉ ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ወደ እኔም ይጮኻሉ፤ እኔም አልሰማቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳም ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ ሄደው ወደሚያጥኑላቸው አማልክት ይጮኻሉ፤ ነገር ግን በመከራቸው ጊዜ ከቶ አያድኑአቸውም።

verses.text_english: For the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to shameful thing, altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ አማልክትህ እንደ ከተሞችህ ቍጥር እንዲሁ ናቸው፤ እንደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መንገዶች ቍጥር ለነውረኛ ነገር መሠዊያ፥ እርሱም ለበኣል ታጥኑበት ዘንድ መሠዊያ፥ አድርጋችኋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ስለዚህ ሕዝብ አትጸልይ፤ ከመከራቸው የተነሣ ወደ እኔ በጮኹ ጊዜ አልሰማቸውምና ስለ እነርሱም ጩኸትና ልመና አታድርግ።

verses.text_english: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጄ በቤቴ ውስጥ ምን አላት? ስእለት ወይም የተቀደሰ ሥጋ ክፋትሽን ከአንቺ ያስወግዳልን? ወይስ በእነዚህ ታመልጫለሽን?

verses.text_english: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስምሽን።በመልካም ፍሬ የተዋበች የለመለመች የወይራ ዛፍ ብሎ ጠራው፤ በጽኑ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ጩኸት እሳትን አነደደባት፥ ቅርንጫፎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።

verses.text_english: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.text_amharic: ለበኣልም በማጠናቸው ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ለራሳቸው ስለ ሠሩአት ስለ እስራኤልና ስለ ይሁዳ ቤት ክፋት የተከለሽ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ክፉን ነገር ተናግሮብሻል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hath given me knowledge , and I know : then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አስታወቀኝ እኔም አወቅሁ፤ ሥራቸውንም ገለጥህልኝ።

verses.text_english: But I like a lamb an ox is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, , Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ለመታረድ እንደሚነዳ እንደ የዋህ በግ ጠቦት ሆንሁ፤ እነርሱም። ዛፉን ከፍሬው ጋር እንቍረጥ፥ ስሙም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳይታሰብ ከሕያዋን ምድር እናጥፋው ብለው ምክርን እንዳሰቡብኝ አላወቅሁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.text_amharic: ኵላሊትንና ልብን የምትፈትን በቅንም የምትፈርድ አቤቱ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክርክሬን ገልጬልሃለሁና በእነርሱ ላይ የሚሆን በቀልህን ለይ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም። በእጃችን እንዳትሞት በእግዚአብሔር ስም ትንቢት አትናገር ብለው ነፍስህን ስለሚሹ ስለ ዓናቶት ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።እነሆ፥ እቀጣቸዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.text_amharic: ጎበዛዝቶቻቸው በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም በራብ ይሞታሉ፤ በምጐበኛቸውም ዓመት በዓናቶት ሰዎች ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁና ማንም ከእነርሱ የሚቀር የለም።

verses.text_english: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, the year of their visitation.
Righteous thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከአንተ ጋር በተምዋገትሁ ጊዜ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፤ ነገር ግን ከአንተ ጋር ስለ ፍርድ ልናገር። የኃጢአተኞች መንገድ ስለምን ይቃናል? በደልንስ ለሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ስለምን ደኅንነት ይሆናል?

verses.text_english: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
verses.text_amharic: ተክለሃቸዋል፤ ሥር ሰድደዋል፤ አድገዋል አፍርተውማል፤ በአፋቸው አንተ ቅርብ ነህ፥ ከልባቸው ግን ሩቅ ነህ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ አውቀኸኛል፤ አይተኸኛል፥ ልቤንም በፊትህ ፈትነሃል፤ እንደ በጎች ለመታረድ ጐትተህ ለያቸው፥ ለመታረድም ቀን አዘጋጃቸው።

verses.text_english: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱ የምታለቅሰው፥ የአገሩ ሣርስ ሁሉ የሚደርቀው እስከ መቸ ነው? የተቀመጡባት ሰዎች። ፍጻሜያችንን አያይም ብለዋልና ስለ ክፋታቸው እንስሶችና ወፎች ጠፍተዋል።

verses.text_english: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and in the land of peace, thou trustedst, , then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.text_amharic: ከእግረኞች ጋር በሮጥህ ጊዜ እነርሱ ቢያደክሙህ፥ ከፈረሶች ጋር መታገል እንዴት ትችላለህ? በሰላምም ምድር ታምነህ ብትቀመጥ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት እንዴት ታደርጋለህ?

verses.text_english: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞችህና የአባትህ ቤት እነርሱ ጭምር አታልለውሃልና፥ በኋላህም ጮኸዋልና፤ በመልካምም ቢናገሩህም አትታመናቸው።

verses.text_english: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቴን ትቼአለሁ ርስቴንም ጥያለሁ፥ ነፍሴም የምትወድዳትን በጠላቶችዋ እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
verses.text_amharic: ርስቴ በዱር እንዳለ አንበሳ ሆናብኛለች፤ ድምፅዋን አንሥታብኛለች፤ ስለዚህ ጠልቻታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Mine heritage unto me a speckled bird, the birds round about against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
verses.text_amharic: ርስቴ እንደ ዝንጕርጕር አሞራ ሆነችብኝን? አሞሮችስ በዙሪያዋና በላይዋ ሆነዋልን? ሂዱ፥ የምድር አራዊትን ሁሉ ሰብስቡ፥ ይበሉም ዘንድ አምጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ እረኞች የወይኑን ቦታዬን አጥፍተዋል፥ እድል ፈንታዬንም ረግጠዋል፤ የአምሮቴን እድል ፈንታ ምድረ በዳ አድርገውታል።

verses.text_english: They have made it desolate, desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth to heart.
verses.text_amharic: ባድማ አድርገውታል፥ ፈርሶም ወደ እኔ ያለቅሳል፤ ምድር ሁሉ ባድማ ሆናለች በልቡም የሚያስባት የለም።

verses.text_english: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the end of the land even to the end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
verses.text_amharic: በወናዎች ኮረብቶች ሁሉ ላይ በዝባዦች መጥተዋል፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ይበላልና፤ ለሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ሰላም የለም።

verses.text_english: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስንዴን ዘሩ እሾህንም አጨዱ፤ ደከሙ፥ ምንም አልረባቸውም፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ከፍሬያችሁ ታፍራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቤ ለእስራኤል ያወረስሁትን ርስት ለሚነኩት ክፉዎች ጐረቤቶች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ከምድራቸው እነቅላቸዋለሁ፥ የይሁዳንም ቤት ከመካከላቸው እነቅለዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
verses.text_amharic: ከነቀልኋቸውም በኋላ መልሼ እምራቸዋለሁ፥ እያንዳንዱንም ወደ ርስቱ እያንዳንዱንም ወደ ምድሩ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
verses.text_amharic: በበኣል ይምሉ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን እንዳስተማሩ በስሜ። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብለው ይምሉ ዘንድ የሕዝቤን መንገድ በትጋት ቢማሩ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በሕዝቤ መካከል ይመሠረታሉ።

verses.text_english: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ባይሰሙኝ ግን ያንን ሕዝብ ፈጽሜ እነቅለዋለሁ አጠፋውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። ሂድ፥ ከተልባ እግር የተሠራችን መታጠቂያ ለአንተ ግዛ፥ ወገብህንም ታጠቅባት፤ በውኃውም ውስጥ አትንከራት።

verses.text_english: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put on my loins.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል መታጠቂያን ገዛሁ ወገቤንም ታጠቅሁባት።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
Take the girdle that thou hast got, which upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛም ጊዜ። የገዛሃትን በወገብህ ያለችውን መታጠቂያ ወስደህ ተነሥ፥ ወደ ኤፍራጥስም ሂድ፥ በዚያም በተሰነጠቀ ዓለት ውስጥ ሸሽጋት የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣልኝ።

verses.text_english: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘኝ ሄድሁ በኤፍራጥስም አጠገብ ሸሸግኋት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር። ተነሥተህ ወደ ኤፍራጥስ ሂድ፥ በዚያም ትሸሽጋት ዘንድ ያዘዝሁህን መታጠቂያ ከዚያ ውስጥ ውሰድ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ወደ ኤፍራጥስ ሄድሁ ቆፈርሁም፥ ከሸሸግሁበትም ስፍራ መታጠቂያይቱን ወሰድሁ። እነሆም፥ መታጠቂያይቱ ተበላሽታ ነበር፥ ለምንም አልረባችም።

verses.text_english: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፤

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲሁ የይሁዳን ትዕቢት ታላቁንም የኢየሩሳሌምን ትዕቢት አበላሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌን ይሰሙ ዘንድ እንቢ የሚሉ፥ በልባቸውም እልከኝነት የሚሄዱ፥ ያመልኩአቸውና ይሰግዱላቸው ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት የሚከተሉ እነዚህ ክፉ ሕዝብ አንዳች እንዳማትረባ እንደዚች መታጠቂያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
verses.text_amharic: መታጠቂያ በሰው ወገብ ላይ እንደምትጣበቅ፥ እንዲሁ ሕዝብና ስም ምስጋናና ክብር ይሆኑልኝ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ቤት ሁሉ የይሁዳንም ቤት ሁሉ ከእኔ ጋር አጣብቄአለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ።የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ማድጋ ሁሉ የወይን ጠጅ ይሞላል ብለህ ትነግራቸዋለህ፤ እነርሱም። ማድጋ ሁሉ የወይን ጠጅ እንዲሞላ በውኑ እኛ አናውቅምን? ይሉሃል።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም እንዲህ ትላቸዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በዚህች ምድር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ፥ በዳዊት ዙፋን የሚቀመጡትን ነገሥታት ካህናቱንም ነቢያቱንም በኢየሩሳሌምም የተቀመጡትን ሁሉ በስካር እሞላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውንም በሰው ላይ፥ አባቶችንና ልጆችን በአንድ ላይ፥ እቀጠቅጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አጠፋቸዋለሁ እንጂ አልራራም፥ አላዝንም፥ አልምርም።

verses.text_english: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙ፥ አድምጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና አትታበዩ።

verses.text_english: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, make gross darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ሳትጨልም እግራችሁም በጨለመችው ተራራ ላይ ሳትሰናከል፥ በተስፋ የምትጠባበቁትን ብርሃን ለሞት ጥላና ለድቅድቅ ጨለማ ሳይለውጠው ለአምላካችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ስጡ።

verses.text_english: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD'S flock is carried away captive.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ባትሰሙ ነፍሴ ስለ ትዕቢታችሁ በስውር ታለቅሳለች፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንጋ ተማርኮአልና ዓይኔ ታነባለች፥ እንባንም ታፈስሳለች።

verses.text_english: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, the crown of your glory.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡና ለንጉሥ እናት ለእቴጌይቱ። የክብራችሁ አክሊል ከራሳችሁ ወርዶአልና ተዋርዳችሁ ተቀመጡ በል።

verses.text_english: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.text_amharic: የደቡብ ከተሞች ተዘግተዋል፥ የሚከፍታቸውም የለም፤ ይሁዳ ሁሉ ተማርኮአል፥ ፈጽሞ ተማርኮአል።

verses.text_english: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where the flock was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
verses.text_amharic: ዓይናችሁን አንሥታችሁ እነዚህን ከሰሜን የሚመጡትን ተመልከቱ፤ ለአንቺ የተሰጠ መንጋ፥ የተዋበ መንጋሽ፥ ወዴት አለ?

verses.text_english: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them captains, as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
verses.text_amharic: ወዳጆችሽ እንዲሆኑ ያስተማርሻቸውን በራስሽ ላይ አለቆች ባደረጋቸው ጊዜ ምን ትያለሽ? እንደ ወላድ ሴት ምጥ አይዝሽምን?

verses.text_english: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, thy heels made bare.
verses.text_amharic: በልብሽም። እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ስለ ምን ደረሰብኝ? ብትዪ፥ ከኃጢአትሽ ብዛት የተነሣ የልብስሽ ዘርፍ ተገልጦአል ተረከዝሽም ተገፍፎአል።

verses.text_english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ኢትዮጵያዊ መልኩን ወይስ ነብር ዝንጕርጕርነትን ይለውጥ ዘንድ ይችላልን? በዚያን ጊዜ ክፋትን የለመዳችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ በጎ ለማድረግ ትችላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እንደሚያልፍ እብቅ በምድረ በዳ ነፋስ እበትናቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: This thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
verses.text_amharic: ረስተሽኛልና፥ በሐሰትም ታምነሻልና ዕጣሽ የለካሁልሽም እድል ፈንታ ይህ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የልብስሽን ዘርፍ በፊትሽ እገልጣለሁ እፍረትሽም ይታያል።

verses.text_english: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when once ?
verses.text_amharic: አስጸያፊ ሥራሽን፥ ምንዝርናሽን፥ ማሽካካትሽን፥ የግልሙትናሽንም መዳራት በኮረብቶች ላይ በሜዳም አይቻለሁ። ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ወዮልሽ! ለመንጻት እንቢ ብለሻል፤ ይህስ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኤርምያስ ስለ ድርቅ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ አለቀሰች፥ ደጆችዋም ባዶ ሆኑ በምድርም ላይ ጨለሙ፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ጩኸት ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአል።

verses.text_english: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
verses.text_amharic: ታላላቆችም ብላቴኖቻቸውን ወደ ውኃ ሰደዱ፤ ወደ ጕድጓድ መጡ ውኃም አላገኙም፥ ዕቃቸውንም ባዶውን ይዘው ተመለሱ፤ አፈሩም ተዋረዱም ራሳቸውንም ተከናነቡ።

verses.text_english: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ አልዘነበምና መሬቱ ስንጥቅጥቅ ስለሆነ አራሾች አፈሩ ራሳቸውንም ተከናነቡ።

verses.text_english: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook , because there was no grass.
verses.text_amharic: ዋላ ደግሞ በምድረ በዳ ወለደች፥ ሣርም የለምና ግልገልዋን ተወች።

verses.text_english: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because no grass.
verses.text_amharic: የሜዳ አህዮችም በወና ኮረብታ ላይ ቆመዋል፥ እንደ ቀበሮም ወደ ነፋስ አለከለኩ፤ ልምላሜም የለምና ዓይኖቻቸው ጠወለጉ።

verses.text_english: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአታችን ብዙ ነውና፥ በአንተም ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና ኃጢአታችን ይመሰክርብናል ነገር ግን ስለ ስምህ ብለህ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man turneth aside to tarry for a night?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የእስራኤል ተስፋ ሆይ በመከራም ጊዜ የምታድነው፥ በምድር እንደ እንግዳ፥ ወደ ማደሪያ ዘወር እንደሚል መንገደኛ ስለ ምን ትሆናለህ?

verses.text_english: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳንቀላፋ ሰው ሰው፥ ያድንም ዘንድ እንደማይችል ኃያል ስለ ምን ትሆናለህ? አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ በመካከላችን ነህ እኛም በስምህ ተጠርተናል፤ አትተወን።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለዚህ ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላል። መቅበዝበዝን ወድደዋል እግራቸውንም አልከለከሉም፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በእነርሱ ደስ አይለውም፥ በደላቸውንም አሁን ያስባል ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for good.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ ስለ መልካም አትጸልይላቸው።

verses.text_english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.text_amharic: በጾሙ ጊዜ ጸሎታቸውን አልሰማም፤ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን ባቀረቡ ጊዜ አልቀበላቸውም፤ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም አጠፋቸዋለሁ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እነሆ፥ ነቢያት። በእውነት ሰላምን በዚህ ስፍራ እሰጣችኋለሁ እንጂ ሰይፍን አታዩም፥ ራብም አያገኛችሁም ይሉአቸዋል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ነቢያቱ ውሸት በስሜ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፤ አላክኋቸውም፥ አላዘዝኋቸውም፥ አልተናገርኋቸውም፤ የውሸቱን ራእይ ምዋርትንም ከንቱንም ነገር የልባቸውንም ሽንገላ ይሰብኩላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በስሜ ትንቢት ስለሚናገሩ ነቢያት። በዚህች አገር ሰይፍና ራብ አይሆንም ስለሚሉ ስላላክኋቸው ነቢያት እንዲህ ይላል። እነዚያ በሰይፍና በራብ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ትንቢት የሚናገሩላቸውም ሰዎች ከራብና ከሰይፍ የተነሣ በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ይበተናሉ፤ ክፋታቸውንም አፈስስባቸዋለሁ እነርሱንና ሚስቶቻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም የሚቀብራቸው አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም ብለህ ትነግራቸዋለህ። የወገኔ ልጅ ድንግሊቱ በታላቅ ስብራትና እጅግ ክፉ በሆነ ቍስል ተሰብራለችና ዓይኖቼ ሌሊትና ቀን ሳያቋርጡ እንባ ያፈሳሉ።

verses.text_english: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሜዳ ብወጣ፥ እነሆ፥ በሰይፍ የሞቱ አሉ፤ ወደ ከተማም ብገባ፥ እነሆ፥ በራብ የከሱ አሉ፤ ነቢዩና ካህኑም ወደማያውቋት አገር ሄደዋልና።

verses.text_english: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and no healing for us? we looked for peace, and no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ይሁዳን ፈጽመህ ጥለኸዋልን? ነፍስህስ ጽዮንን ጠልታታለችን? ስለ ምን መታኸን? ፈውስስ ስለ ምን የለንም? ሰላምን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ መልካምም አልተገኘም፤ ፈውስን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ እነሆም፥ ድንጋጤ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ላይ ኃጢአትን ሠርተናልና ክፋታችንንና የአባቶቻችንን በደል እናውቃለን።

verses.text_english: Do not abhor , for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ስምህ ብለህ አትናቀን፥ የክብርህንም ዙፋን አታስነውር፤ ከእኛ ጋርም ያደረግኸውን ቃል ኪዳንህን አስብ እንጂ አታፍርስ።

verses.text_english: Are there among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these .
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ በአሕዛብ ጣዖታት መካከል ያዘንብ ዘንድ የሚችል ይገኛልን? ወይስ ሰማይ ዝናብ ማፍሰስ ይችላልን? አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ አንተ አይደለህምን? አንተ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ አድርገሃልና ስለዚህ አንተን በተስፋ እንጠባበቃለን።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, my mind not toward this people: cast out of my sight, and let them go forth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደዚህ አለኝ። ሙሴና ሳሙኤል በፊቴ ቢቆሙም፥ ልቤ ወደዚህ ሕዝብ አይዘነብልም፤ ከፊቴ ጣላቸው፤ ይውጡ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as for death, to death; and such as for the sword, to the sword; and such as for the famine, to the famine; and such as for the captivity, to the captivity.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ወዴት እንውጣ ቢሉህ፥ አንተ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለሞት የሆነ ወደ ሞት፥ ለሰይፍም የሆነ ወደ ሰይፍ፥ ለራብም የሆነ ወደ ራብ፥ ለምርኮም የሆነ ወደ ምርኮ ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍን ለመግደል ውሾችንም ለመጐተት የሰማያትንም ወፎች የምድርንም አራዊት ለመብላትና ለማጥፋት፥ አራቱን ዓይነት ጥፋት አዝዝባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for which he did in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ የሕዝቅያስ ልጅ ምናሴ በኢየሩሳሌም ስላደረገው ሁሉ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ መካከል ለመከራ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ የሚራራልሽ ማን ነው? የሚያዝንልሽስ ማን ነው? ወይስ ስለ ደኅንነትሽ ይጠይቅ ዘንድ ፈቀቅ የሚል ማነ ነው?

verses.text_english: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ እኔን ጥለሻል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ወደ ኋላሽም ተመልሰሻል፤ ስለዚህ እጄን በአንቺ ላይ ዘርግቼ አጥፍቼሻለሁ፤ ከይቅርታ ደክሜአለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave of children, I will destroy my people, they return not from their ways.
verses.text_amharic: በአገርም ደጆች ውስጥ በመንሽ አበጥሬአቸዋለሁ፤ የወላድ መካን አድርጌአቸዋለሁ፥ ሕዝቤንም አጥፍቼአለሁ፤ ከመንገዳቸውም አልተመለሱም።

verses.text_english: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
verses.text_amharic: መበለቶቻቸውም ከባሕር አሸዋ ይልቅ በዝተውብኛል፤ በብላቴኖች እናት ላይ በቀትር ጊዜ አጥፊውን አምጥቻለሁ፤ ጣርንና ድንጋጤን በድንገት አምጥቼባታለሁ።

verses.text_english: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት የወለደች ደክማለች፥ ነፍስዋንም አውጥታለች፤ ቀን ገና ሳለ ፀሐይዋ ገብታባታለች፤ አፍራለች ተዋርዳማለች፤ የተረፉትንም በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት ለሰይፍ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; every one of them doth curse me.
verses.text_amharic: እናቴ ሆይ፥ ወዮልኝ! ለምድር ሁሉ የክርክርና የጥል ሰው የሆንሁትን ወለድሽኝ ለማንም አላበደርሁም፥ ማንም ለእኔ አላበደረም፥ ነገር ግን ሁሉ ይረግመኛል።

verses.text_english: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። በእውነት ለደኅንነትህ አጸናሃለሁ፤ በእውነት በመከራና በጭንቅ ጊዜ ጠላትህ እንዲለምንህ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ብረትን፥ የሰሜንን ብረት፥ ናስንም የሚሰብር አለን?

verses.text_english: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
verses.text_amharic: በዳርቻህ ሁሉ ስላለ ኃጢአትህ ሁሉ ባለጠግነትህንና መዝገብህን ለመበዝበዝ በከንቱ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will make to pass with thine enemies into a land thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, shall burn upon you.
verses.text_amharic: የምታቃጥላችሁ እሳት ከቍጣዬ ትነድዳለችና ከጠላቶችህ ጋር ወደማታውቀው ምድር አሳልፍሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ አስበኝ ጐብኘኝም የሚያሳድዱኝንም ተበቀላቸው እንጂ አትታገሣቸው፤ ስለ አንተ ስድብን እንደ ታገሥሁ እወቅ።

verses.text_english: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህ ተገኝቶአል እኔም በልቼዋለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ በስምህ ተጠርቻለሁና ቃልህ ሐሤትና የልብ ደስታ ሆነኝ።

verses.text_english: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
verses.text_amharic: በዋዘኞችና በደስተኞች ጉባኤ አልተቀመጥሁም፤ ቍጣን ሞልተህብኛልና በእጅህ ፊት ለብቻዬ ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.text_english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, waters fail?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን ሕመሜ አዘወተረኝ? ቍስሌስ ስለ ምን የማይፈወስ ሆነ? ስለ ምንስ። አልሽርም አለ? በውኑ እንደ ሐሰተኛ ምንጭ፥ እንዳልታመነች ውኃ ትሆነኛለህን?

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ብትመለስ እመልስሃለሁ በፊቴም ትቆማለህ፤ የከበረውንም ከተዋረደው ብትለይ እንደ አፌ ትሆናለህ፤ እነርሱ ወደ አንተ ይመለሳሉ፥ አንተ ግን ወደ እነርሱ አትመለስም።

verses.text_english: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህም ሕዝብ የተመሸገ የናስ ቅጥር አደርግሃለሁ፤ ይዋጉሃል እኔ ግን ለማዳን ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አያሸንፉህም።

verses.text_english: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ሰዎችም እጅ እታደግሃለሁ፥ ከጨካኞችም ጡጫ እቤዥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ስፍራ ሚስት አታግባ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችም አይሁኑልህ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ስፍራ ስለ ተወለዱ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች፥ ስለወለዱአቸውም ስለ እናቶቻቸው፥ በዚህችም ምድር ስለ ወለዱአቸው ስለ አባቶቻቸው እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.text_english: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በክፉ ሞት ይሞታሉ፤ አይለቀስላቸውም አይቀበሩምም፥ በመሬትም ላይ እንደ ጕድፍ ይሆናሉ፤ በሰይፍና በራብ ይጠፋሉ፥ ሬሳቸውም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, lovingkindness and mercies.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰላሜን፥ ቸርነትና ምሕረትን፥ ከዚህ ሕዝብ አስወግጄአለሁና ልቅሶ ወዳለበት ቤት አትግባ፥ ታለቅስም ታዝንም ዘንድ አትሂድ።

verses.text_english: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
verses.text_amharic: ታላላቆችና ታናናሾች በዚህች ምድር ይሞታሉ፤ አይቀበሩም ሰዎችም አያለቅሱላቸውም ስለ እነርሱም ገላን አይነጩላቸውም ራስንም አይላጩላቸውም፤

verses.text_english: Neither shall tear for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም ስለ ሞቱት ለማጽናናት የእዝን እንጀራ አይቈርሱላቸውም፥ ስለ አባታቸውና ስለ እናታቸውም የመጽናናት ጽዋ አያጠጡአቸውም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ትበላና ትጠጣ ዘንድ ከእነርሱ ጋር ለመቀመጥ ወደ ግብዣ ቤት አትግባ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በዓይናችሁ ፊት በዘመናችሁም የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ ከዚህ ስፍራ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what our iniquity? or what our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህም ሕዝብ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በተናገርህ ጊዜ። ይህን ሁሉ ታላቅ የሆነ ክፉ ነገርን ስለ ምን እግዚአብሔር ተናገረብን? በደላችንስ ምንድር ነው? በአምላካችንስ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ የሠራነው ኃጢአታችን ምንድር ነው? ቢሉህ፥

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
verses.text_amharic: አንተ እንዲህ ትላቸዋለህ። አባቶቻችሁ እኔን ስለ ተው ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት ተከተሉ አመለኩአቸውም ሰገዱላቸውም፥ እነርሱም ትተውኛል፥ ሕጌንም አልጠበቁም

verses.text_english: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ከአባቶቻችሁ ይልቅ ክፉ አድርጋችኋል፤ እነሆም፥ ሁላችሁ እንደ ክፉ ልባችሁ እልከኝነት ሄዳችኋል እኔንም አልሰማችሁም።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከዚህች ምድር እናንተና አባቶቻችሁ ወዳላወቃችኋት ምድር እጥላችኋለሁ፤ ምሕረትንም አላደርግላችሁምና በዚያ ሌሎችን አማልክት ቀንና ሌሊት ታመልካላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን።የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሰሜን ምድር ካሳደዳቸውም ምድር ሁሉ ያወጣ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ይባላል፤ እኔም ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠኋት ወደ ምድራቸው እመልሳቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ብዙ ዓሣ አጥማጆችን እሰድዳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እነርሱም ያጠምዱአቸዋል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ብዙ አዳኞችን እሰድዳለሁ፥ እነርሱም ከየተራራውና ከየኮረብታው ሁሉ ከየድንጋዩም ስንጣቂ ውስጥ ያድኑአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For mine eyes upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔ በመንገዳቸው ሁሉ ላይ ነው፤ ከፊቴም አልተሰወሩም፥ ኃጢአታቸውም ከዓይኔ አልተሸሸገም።

verses.text_english: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሬንም በተጠሉ በጣዖቶቻቸው ሬሳዎች አርክሰዋልና፥ ርስቴንም አስጸያፊ በሆኑ ነገሮች ሞልተዋልና አስቀድሜ የበደላቸውንና የኃጢአታቸውን ዕዳ ሁለት እጥፍ እከፍላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and wherein no profit.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ኃይሌ፥ አምባዬ፥ በመከራም ቀን መጠጊያዬ ሆይ፥ ከምድር ዳርቻ አሕዛብ ወደ አንተ መጥተው። በእውነት አባቶቻችን ውሸትንና ከንቱን ነገር የማይረባቸውንም ወርሰዋል ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they no gods?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ሰው አማልክት ያልሆኑትን ለራሱ አማልክትን አድርጎ ይሠራልን?

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name The LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አስታውቃቸዋለሁ፥ በዚህች ጊዜ እጄንና ኃይሌን አስታውቃቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ስሜ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: The sin of Judah written with a pen of iron, with the point of a diamond: graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ኃጢአት በብረት ብርዕና በተሾለ ዕብነ አልማዝ ተጽፎአል፤ በልባቸው ጽላትና በመሠዊያቸው ቀንዶች ተቀርጾአል።

verses.text_english: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸውም ከለመለሙ ዛፎች በታችና በረዘሙት ኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉትን መሠዊያቸውንና የማምለኪያ ዐፀዳቸውን ያስባሉ።

verses.text_english: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance all thy treasures to the spoil, thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳ ያለው ተራራዬ ሆይ፥ ባለጠግነትህንና መዝገብህን ሁሉ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችህም ስለ ኃጢአት በድንበሮችህ ሁሉ ለመበዝበዝ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, shall burn for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የሰጠሁህን ርስት ትለቅቃለህ ለዘላለምም በማታውቃትም ምድር ለጠላቶቻችሁ ባሪያ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ለዘላለም የሚነድደውን እሳት በቍጣዬ አንድዳችኋልና።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በሰው የሚታመን ሥጋ ለባሹንም ክንዱ የሚያደርግ ልቡም ከእግዚአብሔር የሚመለስ ሰው ርጉም ነው።

verses.text_english: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ቍጥቋጦ ይሆናል፥ መልካምም በመጣ ጊዜ አያይም፤ ሰውም በሌለበት፥ ጨው ባለበት ምድር በምድረ በዳ በደርቅ ስፍራ ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር የታመነ እምነቱም እግዚአብሔር የሆነ ሰው ቡሩክ ነው።

verses.text_english: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.text_amharic: በውኃ አጠገብ እንደ ተተከለ፥ በወንዝም ዳር ሥሩን እንደሚዘረጋ ሙቀትም ሲመጣ እንደማይፈራ ቅጠሉም እንደሚለመልም፥ በድርቅ ዓመትም እንደማይሠጋ ፍሬውንም እንደማያቋርጥ ዛፍ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The heart deceitful above all , and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልብ ከሁሉ ይልቅ ተንኰለኛ እጅግም ክፉ ነው፤ ማንስ ያውቀዋል?

verses.text_english: I the LORD search the heart, try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ሁሉ እንደ መንገዱ፥ እንደ ሥራው ፍሬ እሰጥ ዘንድ ልብን እመረምራለሁ ኵላሊትንም እፈትናለሁ።

verses.text_english: the partridge sitteth , and hatcheth not; he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verses.text_amharic: ያልወለደችውን እንደምታቅፍ ቆቅ፥ እንዲሁ በቅን ሳይሆን ባለጠግነትን የሚሰበስብ ሰው ነው፤ በእኩሌታ ዘመኑ ይተወዋል፥ በፍጻሜውም ሰነፍ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: A glorious high throne from the beginning the place of our sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደሳችን ስፍራ ከጥንት ጀምሮ ክፍ ያለ የክብር ዙፋን ነው።

verses.text_english: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የእስራኤል ተስፋ ሆይ፥ የሚተዉህ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፤ ከአንተም የሚለዩ የሕይወትን ውኃ ምንጭ እግዚአብሔርን ትተዋልና በምድር ላይ ይጻፋሉ።

verses.text_english: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou my praise.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፈውሰኝ እኔም እፈወሳለሁ፤ አድነኝ እኔም እድናለሁ፤ አንተ ምስጋናዬ ነህና።

verses.text_english: Behold, they say unto me, Where the word of the LORD? let it come now.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወዴት አለች? አሁን ትምጣ ይሉኛል።

verses.text_english: As for me, I have not hastened from a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was before thee.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አንተን ተከትዬ እረኛ ከመሆን አልቸኰልሁም፥ የመከራንም ቀን አልወደድሁም፤ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ ከከንፈሬ የወጣው በፊትህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Be not a terror unto me: thou my hope in the day of evil.
verses.text_amharic: ለማስፈራራት አትሁንብኝ፤ በመከራ ቀን አንተ መጠጊያዬ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.text_amharic: አሳዳጆቼ ይፈሩ፥ እኔ ግን አልፈር፤ እነርሱ ይደንግጡ፥ እኔ ግን አልደንግጥ፤ ክፉንም ቀን አምጣባቸው፥ በሁለት እጥፍ ጥፋት አጥፋቸው።

verses.text_english: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። ሂድ፥ የይሁዳም ነገሥታት በሚገቡበትና በሚወጡበት በሕዝቡ ልጆች በር በኢየሩሳሌምም በሮች ሁሉ ቁም፤

verses.text_english: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በላቸው። በእነዚህ በሮች የምትገቡ፥ እናንተ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት፥ ይሁዳም ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፥ በሰንበትም ቀን ሸክም አትሸከሙ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሮች አታግቡ፥

verses.text_english: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ከቤቶቻችሁም በሰንበት ቀን ሸክምን አታውጡ፥ ሥራንም ሁሉ አትሥሩበት፤ አባቶቻችሁንም እንዳዘዝሁ የሰንበትን ቀን ቀድሱ።

verses.text_english: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውን አላዘነበሉም፥ እንዳይሰሙና እንዳይገሠጹም አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ፈጽሞ ብትሰሙ፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በሰንበትም ቀን በዚህች ከተማ በሮች ሸክም ባታገቡ፥ የሰንበትንም ቀን ብትቀድሱ ሥራንም ሁሉ ባትሠሩበት፥

verses.text_english: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.text_amharic: በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጡ ነገሥታትና መሳፍንት በሰረገሎችና በፈረሶች ላይ እየተቀመጡ በዚህች ከተማ በሮች ይገባሉ፤ እነርሱና መሳፍንቶቻቸው የይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚቀመጡ ይገባሉ፥ ይህችም ከተማ ለዘላለም የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕትን የእህሉንም ቍርባን ዕጣኑንም የምስጋናውንም መሥዋዕት ይዘው ከይሁዳ ከተሞች ከኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ከብንያምም አገር ከቈላውም ከደጋውም ከደቡብም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሰንበትን ቀን እንድትቀድሱ፥ በሰንበትም ቀን ሸክምን ተሸክማችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች እንዳትገቡ የነገርኋችሁን ባትሰሙኝ፥ በበሮችዋ ላይ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች፥ አትጠፋም።

verses.text_english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል፥

verses.text_english: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለው። ተነሥተህ ወደ ሸክላ ሠሪው ቤት ውረድ፥ በዚያም ቃሌን አሰማሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሸክላ ሠሪው ቤትም ወረድሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሥራውን በመንኰራኵር ላይ ይሠራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make .
verses.text_amharic: ከጭቃም ይሠራው የነበረ ዕቃ በሸክላ ሠሪው እጅ ተበላሸ፥ ሸክላ ሠሪውም እንደ ወደደ መልሶ ሌላ ዕቃ አድርጎ ሠራው።

verses.text_english: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay in the potter's hand, so ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ይህ ሸክላ ሠሪ እንደሚሠራ በውኑ እኔ በእናንተ ዘንድ መሥራት አይቻለኝምን? እነሆ፥ ጭቃው በሸክላ ሠሪ እጅ እንዳለ፥ እንዲሁ እናንተ በእኔ እንጅ አላችሁ።

verses.text_english: instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy ;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝብ ስለ መንግሥትም እነቅል አፈርስም አጠፋም ዘንድ በተናገርሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ስለ እርሱ የተናገርሁበት ሕዝብ ከክፋቱ ቢመለስ፥ እኔ አደርግበት ዘንድ ካሰብሁት ክፉ ነገር እጸጸታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant ;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡም ስለ መንግሥትም እሠራውና እተክለው ዘንድ በተናገርሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቴ ክፉን ነገር ቢያደርግ ቃሌንም ባይሰማ፥ እኔ አደርግለት ዘንድ ስለ ተናገርሁት መልካም ነገር እጸጸታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚቀመጡ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር እፈጥርባችኋለሁ፥ አሳብንም አስብባችኋለሁ፤ አሁንም ሁላችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፥ መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁንም አቅኑ ብለህ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን። እንጨክናለን፤ አሳባችንን ተከትለን እንሄዳለን ሁላችንም እንደ ክፉው ልባችን እልከኝነት እናደርጋለን አሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአሕዛብ መካከል። እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ማን ሰምቶአል? ብላችሁ ጠይቁ። የእስራኤል ድንግል በጣም የሚያስደነግጠውን ነገር አድርጋለች።

verses.text_english: Will leave the snow of Lebanon from the rock of the field? shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የሊባኖስ በረዶ የምድረ በዳውን ድንጋይ ይተዋልን? ወይስ ከሩቅ የምትመጣው ቀዝቃዛይቱ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ትደርቃለችን?

verses.text_english: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways the ancient paths, to walk in paths, a way not cast up;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ግን ረስተውኛል ለከንቱ ነገርም ዐጥነዋል፤ ከመንገዱም ተሰናክለዋል ከቀድሞውም ጐዳና ርቀው ወዳልተሠራው ወደ ጠማማው መንገድ ፈቀቅ ብለዋል።

verses.text_english: To make their land desolate, a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸውን ለመደነቂያና ለዘላለም ማፍዋጫ አድርገዋል፤ የሚያልፍባት ሁሉ ይደነቃል፥ ራሱንም ያነቃንቃል።

verses.text_english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.text_amharic: በጠላት ፊት እንደ ምሥራቅ ነፋስ እበትናቸዋለሁ፥ በጥፋታቸውም ቀን ጀርባዬን እንጂ ፊቴን አላሳያቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሕግ ከካህን፥ ምክርም ከጠቢብ፥ ቃልም ከነቢይ አይጠፋምና ኑ፥ በኤርምያስ ላይ አሳብን እናስብ። ኑ፥ በምላስ እንምታው፥ ቃሉንም ሁሉ አናድምጥ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አድምጠኝ፥ የክርክሬንም ቃል ስማ።

verses.text_english: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, to turn away thy wrath from them.
verses.text_amharic: ለነፍሴ ጕድጓድ ቈፍረዋልና በውኑ በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉ ይመለሳልን? ስለ እነርሱ በመልካም እናገር ዘንድ ቍጣህንም ከእነርሱ እመልስ ዘንድ በፊትህ እንደ ቆምሁ አስብ።

verses.text_english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and widows; and let their men be put to death; their young men slain by the sword in battle.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ልጆቻቸውን ለራብ ስጥ፥ ለሰይፍም እጅ አሳልፈህ ስጣቸው፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም የወላድ መካንና መበለቶች ይሁኑ፥ ወንዶቻቸውም በሞት ይጥፉ፥ ጕልማሶቻቸውም በሰልፍ ጊዜ በሰይፍ ይመቱ።

verses.text_english: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.text_amharic: ሊይዙኝ ጕድጓድ ቆፍረዋልና፥ ለእግሮቼም ወጥመድ ሸሽገዋልና ድንገት በላያቸው ጭፍራ ባመጣህ ጊዜ ከቤታቸው ጩኸት ይሰማ።

verses.text_english: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay : forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal with them in the time of thine anger.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ይገድሉኝ ዘንድ በላዬ የመከሩትን ምክር ሁሉ ታውቃለህ፤ በደላቸውን ይቅር አትበል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ከፊትህ አትደምስስ፤ በፊትህም ይውደቁ፥ በቍጣህ ጊዜ እንዲሁ አድርግባቸው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ሂድ፥ ከሸክላ ሠሪ ገምቦ ግዛ፥ ከሕዝቡም ሽማግሌዎችና ከካህናት ሽማግሌዎች ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
verses.text_amharic: በካርሲት በር መግቢያ አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ ሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ሂድ፥ በዚያም የምነግርህን ቃል ተናገር፥

verses.text_english: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በል። የይሁዳ ነገሥታትና በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሰማውን ሰው ጆሮ ጭው የሚያደርግ ክፉ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ስፍራ አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.text_amharic: ትተውኛልና፥ ይህንም ስፍራ እንግዳ አድርገውታልና፥ እነርሱና አባቶቻቸውም ለማያውቋቸው ለሌሎች አማልክት ዐጥነዋልና የይሁዳም ነገሥታት ይህን ስፍራ በንጹህ ደም ሞልተዋልና፥

verses.text_english: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake , neither came into my mind:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ያላዘዝሁትን ያልተናገርሁትንም ወደ ልቤም ያልገባውን፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አድርገው ለበኣል ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ የበኣልን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ሠርተዋልና ስለዚህ፥

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ይህ ስፍራ የእርድ ሸለቆ ይባላል እንጂ ቶፌት ወይም የሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ስፍራ የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ምክር አፈርሳለሁ፥ በጠላቶቻቸውም ፊት በሰይፍና ነፍሳቸውን በሚሹት እጅ እጥላቸዋለሁ፥ ሬሳቸውንም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል አድርጌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችንም ከተማ ለመደነቂያና ለማፍዋጫ አደርጋታለሁ፤ የሚያልፍባትም ሁሉ ስለ ተደረገባት መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ይደነቃል ከንፈሩንም ይመጥጣል።

verses.text_english: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
verses.text_amharic: የወንዶችና የሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ሥጋ አበላቸዋለሁ፥ ሁሉም ጠላቶቻቸውንና ነፍሳቸውን የሚሹት በሚያስጨንቋቸው ጭንቀትና መከበብ የባልንጀሮቻቸውን ሥጋ ይበላሉ።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.text_amharic: ገምቦውንም ከአንተ ጋር በሚሄዱ ሰዎች ፊት ትሰብራለህ፥

verses.text_english: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury in Tophet, till no place to bury.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ትላቸዋለህ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሸክላ ሠሪው ዕቃ እንደሚሰባበር ደግሞም ይጠገን ዘንድ እንደማይቻል፥ እንዲሁ ይህን ሕዝብና ይህችን ከተማ እሰብራለሁ፤ የሚቀብሩበትም ስፍራ ሌላ የለምና በቶፌት ይቀበራሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and make this city as Tophet:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ በዚህ ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ አደርጋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ይህችንም ከተማ እንደ ቶፌት አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
verses.text_amharic: የረከሱትም የኢየሩሳሌም ቤቶችና የይሁዳ ነገሥታት ቤቶች፥ እነዚያ በሰገነታቸው ላይ ለሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ ያጠኑባቸው ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥን ቍርባን ያፈሰሱባቸው ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ እንደ ቶፌት ስፍራ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD'S house; and said to all the people,
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም እግዚአብሔር ትንቢት ሊናገር ወደዚያ ልኮት ከነበረው ስፍራ ከቶፌት መጣ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አደባባይ ቆሞ ለሕዝብ ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቃሌን እንዳይሰሙ አንገታቸውን አደንድነዋልና እነሆ፥ በዚህች ከተማና በመንደሮችዋ ሁሉ ላይ የተናገርሁባትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የተሾመው አለቃ የካህኑ የኢሜር ልጅ ጳስኮር ኤርምያስ በዚህ ነገር ትንቢት ሲናገር ሰማ።

verses.text_english: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that in the high gate of Benjamin, which by the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጳስኮርም ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን መታው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በነበረው በላይኛው በብንያም በር ባለው በእግር ግንድ ውስጥ አኖረው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋውም ጳስኮር ኤርምያስን ከግንድ ውስጥ አወጣው። ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አለው። እግዚአብሔር ስምህን። ማጎርሚሳቢብ እንጂ ጳስኮር ብሎ አይጠራህም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ለራስህና ለወዳጆችህ ሁሉ ፍርሃት አደርግሃለሁ፤ እነርሱም በጠላቶቻቸው ሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ ዓይኖችህም ያያሉ፤ ይሁዳንም ሁሉ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እርሱም ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሳቸዋል በሰይፍም ይገድላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የዚህችንም ከተማ ባለጠግነት ሁሉ ጥሪትዋንም ሁሉ ክብርዋንም ሁሉ የይሁዳንም ነገሥታት መዝገብ ሁሉ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እነርሱም ይበዘብዙአቸዋል ይዘውም ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሱአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም፥ ጳስኮር ሆይ፥ በቤትህም የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ተማርካችሁ ትሄዳላችሁ፤ አንተም በሐሰትም ትንቢት የተናገርህላቸው ወዳጆችህ ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን ትገባላችሁ፥ በዚያም ትሞታላችሁ፥ በዚያም ትቀበራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አታለልኸኝ እኔም ተታለልሁ፥ ከእኔም በረታህ አሸነፍህም፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ መሳቂያ ሆኛለሁ፥ ሁሉም ያላግጡብኛል።

verses.text_english: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
verses.text_amharic: በተናገርሁ ቍጥር እጮኻለሁ፤ ግፍና ጥፋት ብዬ እጮኻለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ቀኑን ሁሉ ስድብና ዋዛ ሆኖብኛልና።

verses.text_english: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not .
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። የእግዚአብሔርን ስም አላነሣም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም በስሙ አልናገርም ብል፥ በአጥንቶቼ ውስጥ እንደ ገባ እንደሚነድድ እሳት ያለ በልቤ ሆነብኝ፤ ደከምሁ፥ መሸከምም አልቻልሁም።

verses.text_english: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, , and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, , Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.text_amharic: የብዙ ሰዎችን ስድብ ሰምቻለሁ፥ ማስፈራራትም ከብቦኛል። መውደቄን የሚጠብቁ የሰላሜ ሰዎች ሁሉ። ምናልባት ይታለል እንደ ሆነ፥ እናሸንፈውም እንደ ሆነ፥ እርሱንም እንበቀል እንደ ሆነ፥ ክሰሱት እኛም እንከስሰዋለን ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: But the LORD with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንደ ኃያልና እንደ ጨካኝ ከእኔ ጋር ነው፤ ስለዚህ አሳዳጆቼ ይሰናከላሉ አያሸንፉም፤ አይከናወንላቸውምና በጽኑ እፍረት ያፍራሉ፥ ለዘላለምም በማይረሳ ጕስቍልና ይጐሰቍላሉ።

verses.text_english: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጻድቅን የምትመረምር ኵላሊትንና ልብን የምትመለከት የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክርክሬን ገልጬልሃለሁና በቀልህን በላያቸው ለይ።

verses.text_english: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ እግዚአብሔርንም አመስግኑ፤ የችግረኛውን ነፍስ ከክፉ አድራጊዎች እጅ አድኖአልና።

verses.text_english: Cursed the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.text_amharic: የተወለድሁባት ቀን የተረገመች ትሁን፤ እናቴ እኔን የወለደችባት ቀን የተባረከች አትሁን።

verses.text_english: Cursed the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድ ልጅ ተወልዶልሃል ብሎ ለአባቴ የምሥራች ነግሮ ደስ ያሰኘው ሰው የተረገመ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
verses.text_amharic: ያም ሰው እግዚአብሔር ሳይጸጸት እንደ ገለበጣቸው ከተሞች ይሁን፥ በማለዳም ልቅሶን በቀትርም ጩኸትን ይስማ፤

verses.text_english: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb always great .
verses.text_amharic: እናቴ መቃብር ትሆነኝ ዘንድ ማኅፀንዋም ዘወትር ይዞኝ ያቆይ ዘንድ በማኅፀን ውስጥ አልገደለኝምና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.text_amharic: ድካምንና ጣርን አይ ዘንድ ዘመኔም በእፍረት ታልቅ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ከማኅፀን ወጣሁ?

verses.text_english: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ይወጋናልና ስለ እኛ፥ እባክህ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቅ፤ ከእኛም ይመለስ ዘንድ ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር እንደ ተአምራቱ ሁሉ ያደርግ ይሆናል ብሎ የመልክያን ልጅ ጳስኮርንና ካህኑን የመዕሤያን ልጅ ሶፎንያስ ወደ ኤርምያስ በላከ ጊዜ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ሴዴቅያስን እንዲህ በሉት።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ በቅጥርም ውጭ የከበቡአችሁን ከለዳውያንን የምትወጉበትን በእጃችሁ ያለውን ዕቃ ጦራችሁን እመልሰዋለሁ፥ እነዚያንም ወደዚህች ከተማ ውስጥ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በተዘረጋች እጅና በብርቱ ክንድ፥ በቍጣና በመዓት በታላቅም መቅሠፍት እወጋችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህችም ከተማ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ሰዎችንና እንስሶችን እመታለሁ፥ በጽኑም ቸነፈር ይሞታሉ።

verses.text_english: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስን ከቸነፈርና ከሰይፍ ከራብም በዚህች ከተማ የቀሩትንም ባሪዎቹንና ሕዝቡን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ በጠላቶቻቸውና ነፍሳቸውንም በሚሹት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ እርሱም በሰይፍ ስለት ይመታቸዋል፤ አያዝንላቸውም፥ አይራራላቸውም፥ አይምራቸውም።

verses.text_english: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህም ሕዝብ እንዲህ በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በፊታችሁ የሕይወትን መንገድና የሞትን መንገድ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.text_english: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህች ከተማ ውስጥ የሚዘገይ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ይሞታል፤ ወጥቶ ወደ ከበቡአችሁ ወደ ከለዳውያን የሚገባ ግን በሕይወት ይኖራል፥ ነፍሱም ምርኮ ትሆንለታለች።

verses.text_english: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፋ ፊቴን በዚህች ከተማ ላይ አድርጌአለሁና፤ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ትሰጣለች፥ እርሱም በእሳት ያቃጥላታል።

verses.text_english: And touching the house of the king of Judah, , Hear ye the word of the LORD;
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench , because of the evil of your doings.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊት ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ሥራችሁ ክፋት ቍጣዬ እንደ እሳት እንዳይወጣና ማንም ሳያጠፋው እንዳይነድድ፥ በማለዳ ፍርድን አድርጉ የተበዘበዘውንም ከአስጨናቂው እጅ አድኑ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በሸለቆው ውስጥ በሜዳ ላይም ባለው አምባ የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ እኔ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፤ እናንተም። በእኛ ላይ የሚወርድ ወይም ወደ መኖሪያችን የሚገባ ማን ነው? የምትሉ ሆይ፥ እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ነኝ፤

verses.text_english: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሥራችሁም ፍሬ እቀጣችኋለሁ፤ በዱርዋም ውስጥ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፥ በዙሪያዋም ያለውን ሁሉ ይበላል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት ውረድ በዚያም ይህን ቃል ተናገር፥

verses.text_english: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በል። በዳዊት ዙፋን የምትቀመጥ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አንተና ባሪያዎችህ በእነዚህም በሮች የሚገባ ሕዝብህ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አድርጉ የተበዘበዘውንም ከአስጨናቂው እጅ አድኑ፤ መጻተኛውንና ድሀ አደጉን መበለቲቱንም አትበድሉ፥ አታምፁባቸውም፥ በዚህም ስፍራ ንጹሕ ደምን አታፍስሱ።

verses.text_english: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንንም ነገር ብታደርጉ፥ በዳዊት ዙፋን የሚቀመጡ ነገሥታት፥ በሰረገሎችና በፈረሶች ላይ ተቀምጠው፥ በዚህ ቤት በሮች ይገባሉ፤ እርሱም ባሪያዎቹም ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥ ይህ ቤት ወና እንዲሆን በራሴ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD unto the king's house of Judah; Thou Gilead unto me, the head of Lebanon: surely I will make thee a wilderness, cities are not inhabited.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት እንዲህ ይላልና። አንተ በእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ገለዓድና እንደ ሊባኖስ ራስ ነህ፥ ነገር ግን በእርግጥ ምድረ በዳ ማንም የማይቀመጥባቸውም ከተሞች አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast into the fire.
verses.text_amharic: መሣሪያም የሚይዙትን አጥፊዎች በአንተ ላይ አዘጋጃለሁ፥ የተመረጡትንም የዝግባ ዛፎችህን ይቈርጣሉ፥ በእሳትም ውስጥ ይጥሉአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ አሕዛብም በዚህች ከተማ አጠገብ ያልፋሉ፥ ሁሉም ባልንጀሮቻቸውን። እግዚአብሔር በዚህች ታላቅ ከተማ ለምን እንዲህ አደርገ? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ትተው ለሌሎች አማልክት ስለ ሰገዱ ስላመለኩአቸውም ነዋ ብለው ይመልሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለስምና፥ የተወለደባትንም አገር አያይምና ለሚወጣ እጅግ አልቅሱ እንጂ ለሞተ አታልቅሱ አትዘኑለትም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
verses.text_amharic: በአባቱ በኢዮስያስ ፋንታ ስለ ነገሠው ከዚህም ስፍራ ስለ ወጣው ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ስለ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ ስለ ሰሎም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.text_english: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህም ወደዚህ አይመለስም፥ በተማረከባት አገር ይሞታል እንጂ፤ ይህችንም አገር ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያይም።

verses.text_english: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱን በግፍ ሰገነቱንም በዓመፅ ለሚሠራ፥ ባልንጀራውንም እንዲያው በከንቱ ለሚያሠራ፥ ዋጋውንም ለማይሰጠው፤

verses.text_english: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሴ ሰፊ ቤት ትልቅም ሰገነት እሠራለሁ ለሚል፥ መስኮትንም ለሚያወጣ፥ በዝግባም ሥራ ለሚያሳጌጥ፥ በቀይ ቀለምም ለሚቀባው ወዮለት!

verses.text_english: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, then well with him?
verses.text_amharic: በዝግባ እንጨት ስለምትወዳደር በውኑ ትነግሣለህን? በውኑ አባትህ አይበላምና አይጠጣም ነበርን? ፍርድንና ጽድቅንስ አያደርግም ነበርን? በዚያም ጊዜ መልካም ሆኖለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then well not this to know me? saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የድሀውንና የችግረኛውን ፍርድ ይፈርድ ነበር፥ በዚያም ጊዜ መልካም ሆኖ ነበር። ይህ እኔን ማወቅ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But thine eyes and thine heart not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do .
verses.text_amharic: ዓይንህና ልብህ ግን ለስስት ንጹሕ ደምንም ለማፍሰስ ዓመፅንና ግፍንም ለመሥራት ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, , Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, , Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ስለ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ ስለ ኢዮአቄም እንዲህ ይላል። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እያሉ አያለቅሱለትም፥ ወይም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እያሉ አያለቅሱለትም።
