verses.text_english: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አህያም እንደሚቀበር ይቀበራል፥ ከኢየሩሳሌምም በር ወደ ውጭ ተጐትቶ ይጣላል።

verses.text_english: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: ውሽሞችሽ ሁሉ ጠፍተዋልና ወደ ሊባኖስ ወጥተሽ ጩኺ፤ በባሳን ላይ ድምፅሽን አንሺ፤ በዓባሪምም ውስጥ ሆነሽ ጩኺ።

verses.text_english: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; thou saidst, I will not hear. This thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
verses.text_amharic: በደኅንነትሽ ጊዜ ተናገርሁሽ፤ አንቺም። አልሰማም አልሽ። ከሕፃንነትሽ ጀምሮ ቃሌን አለመስማትሽ መንገድሽ ነው።

verses.text_english: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: በግ ጠባቂዎችሽን ሁሉ ነፋስ ይጠብቃቸዋል፥ ውሽሞችሽም ተማርከው ይሄዳሉ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ስለ ክፋትሽ ሁሉ ታፍሪያለሽ ትጐሳቈይማለሽ።

verses.text_english: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በሊባኖስ የምትቀመጪ፥ በዝግባ ዛፍም ውስጥ ጎጆሽን የምትሠሪ ሆይ፥ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ሕማም በያዘሽ ጊዜ እንዴት ታጓሪያለሽ!

verses.text_english: I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄም ልጅ ኢኮንያን የቀኝ እጄ ማኅተም ቢሆን ኖሮ እንኳ፥ ከዚያ እነቅልህ ነበር፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስህንም ለሚሹት ለምትፈራቸውም እጅ፥ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር ለከለዳውያንም እጅ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.text_amharic: አንተንም የወለደችህንም እናትህን ወዳልተወለዳችሁባት ወደ ሌላ አገር እጥላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያም ትሞታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.text_amharic: ይመለሱባትም ዘንድ ነፍሳቸው ወደምትመኛት ወደዚያች ምድር አይመለሱም።

verses.text_english: this man Coniah a despised broken idol? a vessel wherein no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ይህ ሰው ኢኮንያን የተናቀና የተሰበረ የሸክላ ዕቃ ነውን? ወይስ እርሱ ለአንዳች የማይረባ የሸክላ ዕቃ ነውን? እርሱና ዘሩስ በማያውቋት ምድር ስለ ምን ተጥለው ወደቁ?

verses.text_english: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሆይ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሚ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከዚህ ሰው ዘር የሚከናወን በዳዊትም ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመት በይሁዳም የሚነግሥ እንግዲህ አይገኝምና። መካን በዘመኑም የማይከናወንለት ሰው ብላችሁ ጻፉ።

verses.text_english: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የማሰማርያዬን በጎች ለሚያጠፉና ለሚበትኑ እረኞች ወዮላቸው! ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቤን ስለሚጠብቁ እረኞች እንዲህ ይላል። በጎቼን በትናችኋል አባርራችኋቸውማል አልጐበኛችኋቸውምም፤ እነሆ፥ የሥራችሁን ክፋት እጐበኝባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.text_amharic: የመንጋዬም ቅሬታ ካባረርኋቸው ምድር ሁሉ ወደ በረታቸው ሰብሰቤ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ያፈራሉ ይበዙማል።

verses.text_english: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጠብቋቸውን እረኞች አስነሣላቸዋለሁ፥ ዳግመኛም አይፈሩምና አይደነግጡም፥ ከእነሱም አንድ አይጐድልም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ለዳዊት ጻድቅ ቍጥቋጥ የማስነሣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱም እንደ ንጉሥ ይነግሣል፥ ይከናወንለታልም፥ በምድርም ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
verses.text_amharic: በዘመኑም ይሁዳ ይድናል እስራኤልም ተዘልሎ ይቀመጣል፥ የሚጠራበትም ስም። እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችን ተብሎ ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። የእስራኤልን ቤት ዘር ከሰሜን አገርና ካሰደድኋቸውም አገር ሁሉ ያወጣና የመራ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ይባላል፤ በምድራቸውም ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ነቢያት፤ ልቤ በውስጤ ተሰብሮአል አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ ታውከዋል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር የተነሣ ከቅዱስ ቃሉም የተነሣ የወይን ጠጅ እንዳሸነፈው እንደ ሰካራም ሰው ሆኛለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force not right.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ከአመንዝሮች ተሞልታለችና፥ ከመርገምም የተነሣ ምድር አልቅሳለች፤ የምድረ በዳ ማሰማርያ ደርቆአል፤ አካሄዳቸው ክፉ ነው፥ ብርታታቸውም ቅን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩና ካህኑም ረክሰዋልና፥ በቤቴም ውስጥ ክፋታቸውን አግኝቻለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መንገዳቸው በጨለማ እንዳለች እንደ ድጥ ስፍራ ትሆንባቸዋለች፥ እነርሱም ፍግምግም ብለው ይወድቁባታል፤ እኔም በምጐበኛቸው ዓመት ክፉ ነገርን አመጣባቸዋለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማርያ ነቢያት ላይ ስንፍናን አይቻለሁ፤ በበኣል ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር፥ ሕዝቤንም እስራኤል ያስቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ነቢያት ላይ የሚያስደነግጥን ነገር አይቻለሁ፤ ያመነዝራሉ በሐሰትም ይሄዳሉ፤ ማንም ከክፋቱ እንዳይመለስ የክፉ አድራጊዎችን እጅ ያበረታሉ፤ ሁሉም እንደ ሰዶም የሚኖሩባትም እንደ ገሞራ ሆኑብኝ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም ነቢያት ዘንድ ርኵሰት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ወጥቶአልና እሬትን አበላቸዋለሁ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትንቢት የሚናገሩላችሁን የነቢያትን ቃል አትሰሙ፤ ከንቱነትን ያስተምሩአችኋል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ ሳይሆን ከገዛ ልባቸው የወጣውን ራእይ ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚንቁኝ ሁልጊዜ። እግዚአብሔር። ሰላም ይሆንላችኋል ብሎአል ይላሉ፤ በልቡም እልከኝነት ለሚሄድ ሁሉ። ክፉ ነገር አያገኛችሁም ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard ?
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን ያይና ይሰማ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ምክር የቆመ ማን ነውና? ቃሉንስ ያደመጠ የሰማስ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እርሱም ቍጣው፥ የሚያገለባብጥ ዐውሎ ነፍስ ወጥቶአል፤ የዓመፀኞችን ራስ ይገለባብጣል።

verses.text_english: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ የልቡን አሳብ ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ አይመለስም፤ በኋለኛው ዘመን ፈጽማችሁ ታስተውሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሳልልካቸው እነዚህ ነቢያት ሮጡ፤ እኔም ሳልነግራቸው ትንቢትን ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.text_amharic: በምክሬ ግን ቢቆሙ ኖሮ፥ ለሕዝቤ ቃሌን ባሰሙ ነበር፥ ከክፉም መንገዳቸው ከሥራቸውም ክፋት በመለሱአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የቅርብ አምላክ ነኝ እንጂ የሩቅ አምላክ አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በስውር ቢሸሸግ፥ እኔ አላየውምን? ሰማይንና ምድርንስ የሞላሁ እኔ አይደለሁምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.text_amharic: አለምሁ አለምሁ እያሉ በስሜ ሐሰትን የሚናገሩትን የነቢያትን ነገር ሰምቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: How long shall be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.text_amharic: ትንቢትን በሐሰት በሚናገሩ፥ የልባቸውንም ሽንገላ በሚናገሩ በነቢያት ልብ ይህ የሚሆነው እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.text_english: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻቸው ስለ በኣል ስሜን እንደ ረሱ፥ እያንዳንዱ ለባልንጀራው በሚናገራት ሕልማቸው ሕዝቤ ስሜን ለማስረሳት ያስባሉ።

verses.text_english: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያልም ነቢይ ሕልምን ይናገር፤ ቃሌም ያለበት ቃሌን በእውነት ይናገር። ገለባ ከስንዴ ጋር ምን አለው?

verses.text_english: not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ ቃሌ እንደ እሳት፥ ድንጋዩንም እንደሚያደቅቅ መዶሻ አይደለችምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እያንዳንዱ ከባልንጀራው ዘንድ ቃሌን በሚሰርቁ ነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, I against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከምላሳቸው ትንቢትን አውጥተው። እርሱ ይላል በሚሉ ነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, I against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሐሰትን በሚያልሙ በሚናገሩም በሐሰታቸውና በድፍረታቸውም ሕዝቤን በሚያስቱ በነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እኔም አልላክኋቸውም አላዘዝኋቸውምም ለእነዚህም ሕዝብ በማናቸውም አይረቡአቸውም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ ወይም ነቢይ ወይም ካህን። የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ቢጠይቅህ፥ አንተ። ሸክሙ እናንተ ናችሁ፥ እጥላችሁማለህ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም የሚለውን ነቢይንና ካህንን ሕዝቡንም ያን ሰውና ቤቱን እቀጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም አንዱ ለባልንጀራው፥ አንዱም አንዱ ለወንድሙ እንዲህ ይበል። እግዚአብሔር የመለሰው ምንድር ነው? እግዚአብሔርስ ምን ነገር ተናገረ?

verses.text_english: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ሁሉ ቃል ሸክም ይሆንበታልና የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ይሆንበታልና የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብላችሁ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትጥሩ፤ የሠራዊትን ጌታ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን የሕያውን አምላክ ቃል ለውጣችኋልና።

verses.text_english: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.text_amharic: ለነቢዩ። እግዚአብሔር ምን መለሰልህ? እግዚአብሔርስ የተናገረው ምንድር ነው? ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብትሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ። የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም አትበሉ ብዬ ልኬባችኋለሁና፥ እናንተም ይህን ቃል።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, out of my presence:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብላችኋልና ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ፈጽሜ እረሳችኋለሁ እናንተንም ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም የሰጠኋትን ከተማ ከፊቴ እጥላለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.text_amharic: የዘላለምንም ስድብ ከቶም ተረስቶ የማይጠፋውን የዘላለምን እፍረት አመጣባችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንን የይሁዳንም አለቆች ጠራቢዎችንና ብረት ሠራተኞችን ከኢየሩሳሌም ማርኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ካፈለሳቸው በኋላ፥ እግዚአብሔር አሳየኝ፥ እነሆም፥ በእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ፊት ሁለት ቅርጫት በለስ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: One basket very good figs, like the figs first ripe: and the other basket very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.text_amharic: በአንደኛይቱ ቅርጫት አስቀድሞ እንደ ደረሰ በለስ የሚመስል እጅግ መልካም በለስ ነበረባት፤ በሁለተኛይቱ ቅርጫት ከክፋቱ የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ የማይቻል እጅግ ክፉ በለስ ነበረባት።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ኤርምያስ ሆይ፥ የምታየው ምንድር ነው? አለኝ። እኔም። በለስን አያለሁ፤ እጅግ መልካም የሆነ መልካም በለስ፥ ከክፋቱም የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ የማይቻል እጅግ ክፉ የሆነ ክፉ በለስ ነው አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for good.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንደዚህ እንደ መልካሙ በለስ፥ እንዲሁ ከዚህ ስፍራ ወደ ከለዳውያን ምድር የሰደድሁትን የይሁዳን ምርኮ ለበጐነት እመለከተዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull down; and I will plant them, and not pluck up.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔንም ለበጐነት በእነርሱ ላይ አደርጋለሁ ወደዚህችም ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እሠራቸዋለሁ እንጂ አላፈርሳቸውም፤ እተክላቸዋለሁ እንጂ አልነቅላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ የሚያውቅ ልብ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ በፍጹምም ልባቸው ወደ እኔ ይመለሳሉና ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ከክፋቱ የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ እንደማይቻል እንደ ክፉው በለስ፥ እንዲሁ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስን አለቆቹንም በዚህችም አገር የሚቀሩትን የኢየሩሳሌም ቅሬታ በግብጽም አገር የሚቀመጡትን እጥላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for hurt, a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.text_amharic: በማሳድዳቸውም ስፍራ ሁሉ ለስድብና ለምሳሌ ለማላገጫና ለእርግማን ይሆኑ ዘንድ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ለመበተን አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱና ለአባቶቻቸውም ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በመካከላቸው ሰይፍንና ራብን ቸነፈርንም እሰድዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በመጀመሪያው ዓመት፥ ስለ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ቃል ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና በኢየሩሳሌም ለተቀመጡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.text_english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሞጽ ልጅ ከኢዮስያስ ከአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ባሉት በእነዚህ በሀያ ሦስቱ ዓመታት፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ መጣ፥ እኔም ማልጄ ተነሥቼ ተናገርኋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አልሰማችሁም።

verses.text_english: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending ; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ማልዶ ተነሥቶ ባሪያዎቹን ነቢያትን ወደ እናንተ ላከ፤ እናንተም አላደመጣችሁም ጆሮአችሁንም አላዘነበላችሁም።

verses.text_english: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሁላችሁ እናንተ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁና ከሥራችሁ ክፋት ተመለሱ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከዘላለም ወደ ዘላለም ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁ በሰጣችሁ ምድር ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ታመልኩአቸውም ትሰግዱላቸውም ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አትከተሉ፥ ክፉም እንዳላደርግባችሁ በእጃችሁ ሥራ አታስቈጡኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ ጕዳት እንዲሆን በእጃችሁ ሥራ ታስቈጡኝ ዘንድ አልሰማችሁኝም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቃሌን አልሰማችሁምና እነሆ፥

verses.text_english: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.text_amharic: ልኬ የሰሜንን ወገኖች ሁሉ ባሪያዬንም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናብከደነዖርን እወስዳለሁ፥ በዚህችም ምድር በሚቀመጡባትም ሰዎች በዙሪያዋም ባሉ በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ ፈጽሜም አጠፋቸዋለሁ፥ ለመደነቂያና ለማፍዋጫም ለዘላለምም ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ፥ የወፍጮንም ድምፅ የመብራትንም ብርሃን አስቀራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And this whole land shall be a desolation, an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችም ምድር ሁሉ ባድማና መደነቂያ ትሆናለች፤ እነዚህም አሕዛብ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሰባ ዓመት ይገዛሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባው ዓመትም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥና ያንን ሕዝብ ስለ ኃጢአታቸው እቀጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የከለዳውያንንም ምድር ለዘላለም ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋም ላይ የተናገርሁትን ቃሌን ሁሉ፥ ማለት ኤርምያስ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ትንቢት የተናገረውን በዚህች መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ፥ በዚያች ምድር አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ አሕዛብና ታላላቆች ነገሥታት እነርሱን ያስገዙአቸዋል፤ እኔም እንደ አደራረጋቸውና እንደ እጃቸው ሥራ እከፍላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። የዚህን ቍጣ የወይን ጠጅ ጽዋ ከእጄ ውሰድ አንተንም የምሰድድባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ አጠጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሰድድባቸውም ሰይፍ የተነሣ ይጠጣሉ ይወላገዱማል ያብዳሉም።

verses.text_english: Then took I the cup at the LORD'S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔርም እጅ ጽዋውን ወሰድሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እኔን የሰደደባቸውን አሕዛብ ሁሉ አጠጣኋቸው።

verses.text_english: , Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as this day;
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ እንደ ሆነው ሁሉ ባድማና መደነቂያ ማፍዋጫም እርግማንም አደርጋቸው ዘንድ ኢየሩሳሌምንና የይሁዳን ከተሞች ነገሥታትዋንም አለቆችዋንም አጠጣኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽንም ንጉሥ ፈርዖንን ባሪያዎቹንም አለቆቹንም ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.text_amharic: የተደባለቀውንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ የዖፅ ምድር ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የፍልስጥኤም ምድር ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ አስቀሎናንም ጋዛንም አቃሮንንም የአዞጦንንም ቅሬታ፥

verses.text_english: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስንም፥ ሞዓብንም፥ የአሞንም ልጆች፥

verses.text_english: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which beyond the sea,
verses.text_amharic: የጤሮስን ነገሥታትም ሁሉ፥ የሲዶናን ነገሥታት ሁሉ፥ በባህር ማዶ ያለች የደሴት ነገሥታትንም፥

verses.text_english: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all in the utmost corners,
verses.text_amharic: ድዳንንም፥ ቴማንንም፥ ቡዝንም፥ ጠጕራቸውንም የሚቈርጡትን ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.text_amharic: የዓረብ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ በምድረ በዳ የሚቀመጡ የድብልቅ ሕዝብ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.text_amharic: የዘምሪ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የኤላም ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.text_amharic: የሜዶን ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የቀረቡና የራቁ፥ አንዱ ከሌላው ጋር ያሉ የሰሜን ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ በምድር ፊት ላይ ያሉ የዓለም መንግሥታትንም ሁሉ አጠጣኋቸው፤ የሼሻክም ንጉሥ ከእነርሱ በኋላ ይጠጣል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመካከላችሁ ከምሰድደው ሰይፍ የተነሣ ጠጡ፥ ስከሩም፥ አስታውኩም ውደቁም፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አትነሡም በላቸው።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.text_amharic: ይጠጡም ዘንድ ጽዋውን ከእጅህ ለመቀበል እንቢ ቢሉ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፈጽማችሁ ትጠጣላችሁ በላቸው።

verses.text_english: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ስሜ የተጠራባትን ከተማ አስጨንቃት ዘንድ እጀምራለሁ፤ በውኑ እናንተ ያልተቀጣችሁ ትሆናላችሁን? በምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ሰይፍን እጠራለሁና ያለ ቅጣት አትቀሩም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread , against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ትንቢት ትናገርባቸዋለህ፥ እንዲህም ትላቸዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር በላይ ሆኖ ይጮኻል፥ በቅዱስ ማደሪያውም ሆኖ ድምፁን ያሰማል፤ በበረቱ ላይ እጅግ ይጮኻል፥ ወይንም እንደሚጠምቁ በምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ይጮኻል።

verses.text_english: A noise shall come to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከአሕዛብ ጋር ክርክር አለውና ድምፅ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ይደርሳል፤ ከሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ጋር ይፋረዳል፥ ኃቲአተኞችንም ለሰይፍ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ ይወጣል፥ ጽኑም ዐውሎ ነፍስ ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣል።

verses.text_english: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from end of the earth even unto the end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ግዳዩች ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ይሆናሉ፤ አይለቀስላቸውም፤ በምድር ላይ እንደ gWdፍ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አይከማቹም አይቀበሩምም።

verses.text_english: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves , ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.text_amharic: ትታረዱና ትበተኑ ዘንድ ቀናችሁ ደርሶአልና፥ እንደ ተወደደም የሸክላ ዕቃ ትወድቃላችሁና እናንተ እረኞች፥ አልቅሱ ጩኹም፤ እናንተ የመንጋ አውራዎች፥ በአመድ ውስጥ ተንከባለሉ።

verses.text_english: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.text_amharic: ሽሽትም ከእረኞች ማምለጥም ከመንጋ አውራዎች ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, : for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ማሰማርያቸውን አጥፍቶአልና የእረኞች ጩኸት ድምፅ የመንጋ አውራዎችም ልቅሶ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ KWTa የተነሣ የሰላም በረት ፈርሶአል።

verses.text_english: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አንበሳ መደቡን ለቅቆአል፤ ከአስጨናቂውም ሰይፍና ከጽኑ ቍጣው የተነሣ ምድራቸው ባድማ ሆናለችና።

verses.text_english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD'S house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD'S house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ቁም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ውስጥ ይሰግዱ ዘንድ ለሚመጡት ለይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ትነግራቸው ዘንድ ያዘዝሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገራቸው፤ አንዲትም ቃል አትgWdል።

verses.text_english: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባት ይሰሙ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ይመለሱ ይሆናል፤ እኔም ስለ ሥራቸው ክፋት ያሰብሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር እተዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በላቸው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በፊታችሁ በሰጠኋት ሕጌ ትሄዱ ዘንድ ባትሰሙኝ፥

verses.text_english: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending , but ye have not hearkened;
verses.text_amharic: ያልሰማችሁትን በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ወደ እናንተ የላክኋቸውን የባሪያዎቼን የነቢያትን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥

verses.text_english: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ቤት እንደ ሴሎ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ይህችንም ከተማ ለምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ እርግማን አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.text_english: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም ነቢያቱም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ኤርምያስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይህን ቃል ሲናገር ሰሙ።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ነገር ሁሉ በፈጸመ ጊዜ ካህናትና ነቢያት ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ሞትን ትሞታለህ።

verses.text_english: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ስም። ይህ ቤት እንደ ሴሎ ይሆናል፥ ይህችም ከተማ ባድማና ወና ትሆናለች ብለህ ስለ ምን ትንቢት ተናገርህ? ብለው ያዙት። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በኤርምያስ ላይ ተሰብስበው ነበር።

verses.text_english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD'S .
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም አለቆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከንጉሥ ቤት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጡ፥ በአዲሱም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ደጅ መግቢያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱና ነቢያቱም ለአለቆቹና ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ። በጆሮአችሁ እንደ ሰማችሁ በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ትንቢት ተናግአልና ይህ ሰው ሞት የሚገባው ነው ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ለአለቆችና ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ። በሰማችሁት ቃል ሁሉ በዚህች ቤትና በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ትንቢት እናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ልኮኛል።

verses.text_english: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን አሳምሩ፥ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረባችሁን ክፉ ነገር ይተዋል።

verses.text_english: As for me, behold, I in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን፥ እነሆ፥ በእጃችሁ ነኝ፤ በዓይናችሁ መልካምና ቅን የመሰለውን አድርጉብኝ።

verses.text_english: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በጆሮአችሁ እናገር ዘንድ በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ወደ እናንተ ልኮኛልና ብትገድሉኝ ንጹሕ ደምን በራሳችሁና በዚህች ከተማ በሚኖሩባትም ላይ እንድታመጡ በእርግጥ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ለካህናትና ለነቢያት። ይህ ሰው በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ተናግሮናልና ሞት አይገባውም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከአገሩ ሽማግሌዎችም ሰዎች ተነሥተው ለሕዝቡ ጉባኤ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.text_amharic: ሞሬታዊው ሚክያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ነቢይ ነበረ፤ ለይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጽዮን እንደ እርሻ ትታረሳለች፥ ኢየሩሳሌም የፍርስራሽ ክምር ትሆናለች፥ የቤቱም ተራራ እንደ ዱር ከፍታ ይሆናል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ገደሉትን? በውኑ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈሩምን? ወደ እግዚአብሔርስ አልተማለሉምን? እግዚአብሔርስ የተናገረባቸውን ክፉ ነገር አይተውምን? እኛም በነፍሳችን ላይ ታላቅ ክፋት እናደርጋለን።

verses.text_english: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በእግዚአብሔር ስም ትንቢት የተናገረ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም የቂርያትይዓሪም ሰው የሸማያ ልጅ ኦርዮ ይባል ነበር፤ በዚህችም ከተማ በዚህችም ምድር ላይ እንደ ኤርምያስ ቃል ሁሉ ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኢዮአቄም ኃያላኑም ሁሉ አለቆቹም ሁሉ ቃሉን በሰሙ ጊዜ ንጉሡ ሊገድለው ፈለገ፤ ኦርዮም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ፈርቶ ሸሸ ወደ ግብጽም ገባ።

verses.text_english: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, , Elnathan the son of Achbor, and men with him into Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኢዮአቄም የዓክቦርን ልጅ ኤልናታንን ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎችን ሰዎች ወደ ግብጽ ላካቸው፤

verses.text_english: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽም ኦርዮን አውጥተው ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኢዮአቄም ይዘውት መጡ፤ እርሱም በሰይፍ ገደለው ሬሳውንም ክቡራን ባልሆኑ ሰዎች መቃብር ጣለው።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በሕዝቡ እጅ እንዳይሰጥና እንዳይገድሉት የሳፋን ልጅ የአኪቃም እጅ ከኤርምያስ ጋር ነበረች።

verses.text_english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። እስራትና ቀንበር ሥራ በአንገትህም ላይ አድርግ፤

verses.text_english: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥም ወደ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በመጡት መልእክተኞች እጅ ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ ወደ ሞዓብም ንጉሥ ወደ አሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ ወደ ጢሮስም ንጉሥ ወደ ሲዶናም ንጉሥ ላካቸው።

verses.text_english: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
verses.text_amharic: ለጌቶቻቸውም እንዲነግሩ እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለጌቶቻችሁ እንዲህ በሉ።

verses.text_english: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱን በምድርም ፊት ላይ ያሉትን ሰዎችንና እንስሶችን በታላቅ ኃይሌና በተዘረጋችው ክንዴ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ ለዓይኔም መልካም ለሆነው እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እነዚህን ምድሮች ሁሉ ለባሪያዬ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ፤ ይገዙለትም ዘንድ የምድረ በዳ አራዊትን ደግሞ ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.text_amharic: የገዛ ራሱም ምድር ጊዜ እስኪመጣ ድረስ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለእርሱና ለልጅ ለልጅ ልጁም ይገዛሉ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙ አሕዛብና ታላላቆች ነገሥታት እርሱን ያስገዙታል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ለባቢሎን ንጉሥም ለናቡከደነፆር የማይገዛውን፥ ከባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የማያደርገውን ሕዝብና መንግሥት፥ ያን ሕዝብ በእጁ እስካጠፋው ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም እቀጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን ነቢያቶቻችሁንና ምዋርተኞቻችሁን፥ ሕልም አላሚዎቻችሁንና ቃላተኞቻችሁን መተተኞቻችሁንም አትስሙ፤

verses.text_english: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድራቸሁ እንዲያርቁአችሁ፥ እኔም እንዳሳድዳችሁ እናንተም እንድትጠፉ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገሩላችኋልና።

verses.text_english: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የሚያደርገውንና የሚገዛለትን ሕዝብ በአገሩ ላይ እተወዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ያርሱአታል ይቀመጡባትማል።

verses.text_english: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.text_amharic: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስም በዚህ ቃል ተናገርሁ። ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገታችሁን ዝቅ አድርጉ ለእርሱና ለሕዝቡም ተገዙላቸው በሕይወትም ኑሩ።

verses.text_english: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.text_amharic: ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይገዛ ዘንድ እንቢ ስላለ ሕዝብ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ፥ አንተና ሕዝብህ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለምን ትሞታላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰተኛን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያትን ቃል አትስሙ።

verses.text_english: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አልላክኋቸውምና፤ ነገር ግን እኔ እንዳሳድዳችሁ፥ እናንተና ትንቢት የሚናገሩላችሁ ነቢያትም እንድትጠፉ በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገራሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD'S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ለካህናትም ለዚህም ሕዝብ እንዲህ ብዬ ተናገርሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሐሰተኛውን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ በቅርብ ጊዜ ከባቢሎን ይመለሳል የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያቶቻችሁን ቃል አትስሙ።

verses.text_english: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አትስሙ፤ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ተገዙ በሕይወትም ኑሩ። ይህችስ ከተማ ስለ ምን ባድማ ትሆናለች?

verses.text_english: But if they prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ ቢገኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም የቀረችው ዕቃ ወደ ባቢሎን እንዳትሄድ ወደ ሠራዊት ጌታ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይማለሉ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ስለ ቀረችው ዕቃ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain the house of the LORD, and the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባቢሎን ትወሰዳለች እስከምጐበኛትም ቀን ድረስ በዚያ ትኖራለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አወጣታለሁ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዓመት በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ በአራተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ነቢዩ የገባዖን ሰው የዓዙር ልጅ ሐናንያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በካህናትና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ይናገራል። የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር ሰብሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD'S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ከዚህች ስፍራ ወደ ባቢሎን የወሰዳትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባቢሎንም የሄዱትን የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ ሁሉ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር እሰብራለሁና።

verses.text_english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም በካህናቱና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በቆሙት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ለነቢዩ ለሐናንያ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD'S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ እንዲህ አለ። አሜን፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያድርግ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ምርኮውንም ሁሉ ከባቢሎን ወደዚህ ስፍራ በመመለስ እግዚአብሔር የተናገርኸውን ትንቢት ይፈጽም።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጆሮህና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ጆሮ የምናገረውን ይህን ቃል ስማ፤

verses.text_english: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንት ከእኔና ከአንተ በፊት የነበሩ ነቢያት በብዙ አገርና በታላላቅ መንግሥታት ላይ ስለ ሰልፍና ስለ ክፉ ነገር ስለ ቸነፈርም ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሰላም የተናገረ ነቢይ፥ የነቢዩ ቃል በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት የሰደደው ነቢይ እንደ ሆነ ይታወቃል።

verses.text_english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ወስዶ ሰበረው።

verses.text_english: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.text_amharic: ሐናንያም በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲሁ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ የናቡከደነፆርን ቀንበር ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ አንገት እሰብራለሁ አለ። ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ከሰበረ በኋላ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ፥ ለሐናንያ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ የእንጨትን ቀንበር ሰብረሃል፥ እኔ ግን በእርሱ ፋንታ የብረትን ቀንበር እሠራለሁ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር ይገዙለት ዘንድ የብረትን ቀንበር በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ አንገት ላይ አድርጌአለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይገዙለታል፥ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ደግሞ ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ ነቢዩን ሐናንያን። ሐናንያ ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ይህ ሕዝብ በሐሰት እንዲታመን አድርገሃል እንጂ እግዚአብሔር አልላከህም።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከምድር ላይ እሰድድሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዓመፅን ተናግረሃልና በዚህ ዓመት ትሞታለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ በዚያው ዓመት በሰባተኛው ወር ሞተ።

verses.text_english: Now these the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ወደ ተረፉት የምርኮ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ወደ ካህናቱም፥ ወደ ነቢያቱም፥ ናቡከደነፆር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ማርኮ ወዳፈለሰውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌም የላከው የደብዳቤው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው ንጉሡ ኢኮንያን እናቱም እቴጌይቱ ጃንደረቦቹም የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌምም አለቆች ጠራቢዎችና ብረት ሠራተኞችም ከኢየሩሳሌም ከወው በኋላ ነው።

verses.text_english: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ባቢሎን በላካቸው በሳፋን ልጅ በኤልዓሣና በኬልቅያስ ልጅ በገማርያ እጅ ደብዳቤውን እንዲህ ሲል ላከው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ላስማረክኋቸው ምርኮኞች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Build ye houses, and dwell ; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.text_amharic: ቤት ሠርታችሁ ተቀመጡ፥ አታክልትም ተክላችሁ ፍሬዋን ብሉ፤

verses.text_english: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.text_amharic: ተጋቡ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ውለዱ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁንም አጋቡ፥ እነርሱም ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆች ይውለዱ፤ ከዚያም ተባዙ ጥቂቶችም አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋ ሰላም ሰላም ይሆንላችኋልና ወደ እርስዋ ላስማርክኋችሁ ከተማ ሰላምን ፈልጉ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በመካከላችሁ ያሉት ነቢያቶቻችሁና ምዋርተኞቻችሁ አያታልሉአችሁ፥ እናንተም የምታልሙትን ሕልም አትስሙ።

verses.text_english: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገሩላችኋልና፤ እኔም አልላክኋቸውም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰባው ዓመት በባቢሎን በተፈጸመ ጊዜ እጐበኛችኋለሁ፥ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳችሁ ዘንድ መልካሚቱን ቃሌን እፈጽምላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ የማስባትን አሳብ እኔ አውቃለሁ፤ ፍጻሜና ተስፋ እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሰላም አሳብ ነው እንጂ የክፉ ነገር አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ትጠሩኛለችሁ፥ ሄዳችሁም ወደ እኔ ትጸልያላችሁ፥ እኔም እሰማችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall seek me, and find , when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ትሹኛላችሁ፥ በፍጹም ልባችሁም ከሻችሁኝ ታገኙኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ዘንድ እገኛለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ምርኮአችሁንም እመልሳለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ ዘንድ እናንተንም ካሳደድሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እናንተንም ለምርኮ ወዳፈለስሁበት ስፍራ እመልሳችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ነቢያትን አስነሥቶልናል ብላችኋልና፤

verses.text_english: that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በዳዊት ዙፋን ስለ ተቀመጠ ንጉሥ ከእናንተም ጋር ስላልተማረኩት ወንድሞቻችሁ፥ በዚህች ከተማ ስለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሰይፍንና ራብን ቸነፈርንም እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፥ ከክፋቱም የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ እንደማይቻል እንደ ክፉ በለስ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.text_amharic: በሰይፍም በራብም በቸነፈርም አሳዳድዳቸዋለሁ፥ ባሳደድሁባቸውም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ዘንድ ለጥላቻና ለመደነቂያ ለማፍዋጫም ለመሰደቢያም እንዲሆኑ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ዘንድ ለመበተን አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending ; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ወደ እነርሱ ሰድጃለሁና፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን የሰደድኋችሁ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ስለሚናገሩላችሁ ስለ ቆላያ ልጅ ስለ አክዓብና ስለ መዕሤያ ልጅ ስለ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ በዓይኖቻችሁም ፊት ይገድላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የተነሣ በባቢሎን ያሉ የይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእሳት እንደ ጠበሳቸው እንደ ሴዴቅያስና እንደ አክዓብ እግዚአብሔር ያድርግህ የምትባል እርግማንን ያነሣሉ፤ እኔም አውቃለሁ ምስክርም ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and a witness, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ዘንድ ስንፍና አድርገዋልና፥ ከባልንጀሮቻቸውም ሚስቶች ጋር አመንዝረዋልና፥ ያላዘዝኋቸውንም ቃል በስሜ በሐሰት ተናግረዋልና።

verses.text_english: shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ለኔሔላማዊው ለሸማያ እንዲህ በል።

verses.text_english: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ካህኑም ወደ መዕሤያ ልጅ ወደ ሶፎንያስ፥ ወደ ካህናቱም ሁሉ ደብዳቤዎችን በስምህ እንዲህ ስትል ልከሃል።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.text_amharic: እያበደ ትንቢት የሚናገርን ሰው ሁሉ በእግር ግንድና በዛንጅር ታኖረው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አለቃ እንድትሆን እግዚአብሔር በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ፋንታ ካህን አድርጎሃል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ ትንቢት ተናጋሪውን የዓናቶቱን ሰው ኤርምያስን ስለ ምን አትዘልፈውም?

verses.text_english: For therefore he sent unto us Babylon, saying, This long: build ye houses, and dwell ; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ። ምርኮው የረዘመው ነውና ቤት ሠርታችሁ ተቀመጡ፥ አታክልትንም ተክላችሁ ፍሬዋን ብሉ ብሎ ወደ እኛ ወደ ባቢሎን ልኮአልና።

verses.text_english: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ሶፎንያስ ይህን ደብዳቤ በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ ጆሮ አነበበው።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኔሔላማዊው ስለ ሸማያ እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ወደ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ላክ። እኔ ሳልልከው ሸማያ ትንቢት ተናግሮላችኋልና፥ በሐሰትም እንድትታመኑ አድርጎአችኋልና፤

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ኔሔላማዊውን ሸማያንና ዘሩን እቀጣለሁ፤ እኔም የማደርግላችሁን መልካሙን ነገር የሚያይ ሰው በመካከላችሁ አይኖርላችሁም

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የነገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ በመጽሐፍ ጻፍ።

verses.text_english: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የሕዝቤን የእስራኤልንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ የምመልስባት ዘመን ይመጣልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ እነርሱም ይገዙአታል።

verses.text_english: And these the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤልና ስለ ይሁዳ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። የሚያስፈራ ድምፅ ሰምተናል፤ የፍርሃት ነው እንጂ የሰላም አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.text_amharic: ጠይቁ፥ ወንድ ይወልድ እንደ ሆነ ተመልከቱ፤ ስለ ምን ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ወላድ እጁን በወገቡ ላይ አድርጎ ፊቱም ሁሉ ወደ ጥቁረት ተለውጦ አየሁ?

verses.text_english: Alas! for that day great, so that none like it: it even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.text_amharic: ወዮ! ያ ቀን ታላቅ ነውና፥ እርሱንም የሚመስል የለምና፤ ያ የያዕቆብ መከራ ዘመን ነው፥ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ይድናል።

verses.text_english: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ቀንበርን ከአንገትህ እሰብራለሁ፥ እስራትህንም እበጥሳለሁ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ለሌላ አትገዛም፤

verses.text_english: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላካቸው ለእግዚአብሔርም ለማስነሣላቸው ለንጉሣቸው ለዳዊትም ይገዛሉ እንጂ ሌሎች አሕዛብ እንደ ገና አይገዙአቸውም።

verses.text_english: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አንተን ከሩቅ ዘርህንም ከምርኮ አገር አድናለሁና ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ ያዕቆብም ይመለሳል ያርፍማል ተዘልሎም ይቀመጣል፤ ማንም አያስፈራውም።

verses.text_english: For I with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.text_amharic: አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንተንም የበተንሁባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁ፥ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም፤ በመጠን እቀጣሃለሁ፥ ያለ ቅጣትም ከቶ አልተውህም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise incurable, thy wound grievous.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስብራትህ የማይፈወስ ቍስልህም ክፉ ነው።

verses.text_english: none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.text_amharic: ትጠገን ዘንድ ክርክርህን የሚፈርድልህ የለም፥ ቍስልህንም የሚፈውስ መድኃኒት የለህም።

verses.text_english: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; thy sins were increased.
verses.text_amharic: ውሽሞችህ ሁሉ ረስተውሃል አይፈልጉህምም፤ በደልህ ታላቅ ስለሆነ ኃጢአትህም ስለ በዛ፥ በጠላት ማቍሰልና በጨካኝ ቅጣት አቍስዬሃለሁና።

verses.text_english: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሕመምህ የማይፈወስ ሆኖአልና ስለ ስብራትህ ለምን ትጮኻለህ? በደልህ ታላቅ ስለሆነ ኃጢአትህም ስለ በዛ፥ ይህን አድርጌብሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የሚውጡህ ሁሉ ይዋጣሉ፥ ጠላቶችህም ሁላቸው ይማረካሉ፤ የዘረፉህም ይዘረፋሉ፥ የበዘበዙህንም ሁሉ ለመበዝበዝ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, , This Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ጤናህን እመልስልሃለሁ ቍስልህንም እፈውሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ማንም የማይሻት፥ የተጣለች ጽዮን ብለው ጠርተውሻልና።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የያዕቆብን ድንኳን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ለማደሪያውም እራራለሁ፤ ከተማይቱም በጉብታዋ ላይ ትሠራለች፥ አዳራሹም እንደ ዱሮው የሰው መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ዘንድ የምስጋናና የዘፋኞች ድምፅ ይወጣል፤ እኔም አበዛቸዋለሁ አያንሱምም፥ እኔም አከብራቸዋለሁ ታናሽም አይሆኑም።

verses.text_english: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸውም እንደ ቀድሞ ይሆናሉ፥ ማኅበራቸውም በፊቴ ጸንቶ ይኖራል፤ የሚያስጨንቋቸውንም ሁሉ እቀጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃቸው ከእነርሱ ውስጥ ይሆናል፥ ገዥአቸውም ከመካከላቸው ይወጣል፤ እኔ አቀርበዋለሁ እርሱም ይቀርባል፤ ይህስ ባይሆን ወደ እኔ ለመቅረብ የሚደፍር ማን ነው? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እርሱም ቍጣው፥ የሚያገለባብጥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ወጥቶአል፤ የዓመፀኞችንም ራስ ይገለባብጣል።

verses.text_english: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done , and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ የልቡን አሳብ ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ አይመለስም በኋለኛው ዘመን ታስተውሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ለእስራኤል ወገኖች ሁሉ አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, The people left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤል ማረፊያ ሊሻ በሄደ ጊዜ ከሰይፍ የተረፈው ሕዝብ በምድረ በዳ ሞገስ አገኘ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, , Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከሩቅ ተገለጠልኝ እንዲህም አለኝ። በዘላለም ፍቅር ወድጄሻለሁ፤ ስለዚህ በቸርነት ሳብሁሽ።

verses.text_english: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ድንግል ሆይ፥ እንደ ገና እሠራሻለሁ አንቺም ትሠሪያለሽ፤ እንደ ገናም ከበሮሽን አንሥተሽ ከዘፋኞች ጋር ወደ ዘፈን ትወጫለሽ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat as common things.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ገናም በሰማርያ ተራሮች ላይ የወይን ቦታዎችን ትተክሊአለሽ፤ አትክልተኞች ይተክላሉ በፍሬውም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For there shall be a day, the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: በኤፍሬምም ተራሮች ላይ ያሉ ጠባቆች። ተነሡ፥ ወደ ጽዮን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንውጣ ብለው የሚጮኹበት ቀን ይመጣልና።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ስለ ያዕቆብ ደስ ይበላችሁ ስለ አሕዛብም አለቆች እልል በሉ፤ አውሩ፥ አመስግኑ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ አድኖአል በሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን አገር አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ በመካከላቸውም ዕውሩና አንካሳው ያረገዘችና የወለደችም በአንድነት፤ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ሆነው ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim my firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: በልቅሶ ወጡ እኔም በማጽናናት አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በወንዝ ዳር በቅን መንገድ አስኬዳቸዋለሁ፥ በእርሱም አይሰናከሉም፤ እኔ ለእስራኤል አባት ነኝና፥ ኤፍሬምም በኵሬ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd his flock.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ በሩቅም ላሉ ደሴቶች አውሩና። እስራኤልን የበተነ እርሱ ይሰበስበዋል፥ እረኛም መንጋውን እንደሚጠብቅ ይጠብቀዋል በሉ።

verses.text_english: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of stronger than he.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ተቤዥቶታል፥ ከበረቱበትም እጅ አድኖታል።

verses.text_english: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.text_amharic: ይመጣሉ በጽዮንም ተራራ እልል ይላሉ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጎነት፥ ወደ እህልና ወደ ወይን ጠጅ ወደ ዘይትም፥ ወደ በጎችና ወደ ላሞች ይሰበሰባሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውም እንደ ረካች ገነት ትሆናለች፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አያዝኑም።

verses.text_english: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ድንግሊቱ በዘፈን ደስ ይላታል፥ ጐበዛዝቱና ሽማግሌዎቹም በአንድ ላይ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ልቅሶአቸውንም ወደ ደስታ እመልሳለሁ፥ አጽናናቸውማለሁ፥ ከኅዘናቸውም ደስ አሰኛቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናቱንም ነፍስ በብዛት አረካታለሁ ሕዝቤም በጎነቴን ይጠግባል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they not.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የዋይታና የመራራ ልቅሶ ድምፅ በራማ ተሰማ፤ ራሔል ስለ ልጆችዋ አለቀሰች፤ የሉምና ስለ ልጆችዋ መጽናናትን እንቢ አለች።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ድምፅሽን ከልቅሶ ዓይንሽንም ከእንባ ከልክዪ፤ ለሥራሽ ዋጋ ይሆናልና፥ ከጠላትም ምድር ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.text_amharic: ለፍጻሜሽም ተስፋ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ልጆችሽም ወደ ዳርቻቸው ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself ; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed : turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou the LORD my God.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም። ቀጣኸኝ እኔም እንዳልተገራ ወይፈን ተቀጣሁ፤ አንተ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ነህና መልሰኝ እኔም እመለሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.text_amharic: ከተመለስሁ በኋላ ተጸጸትሁ፥ ከተገሠጽሁም በኋላ ጭኔን ጸፋሁ፤ የብላቴንነቴንም ስድብ ተሸክሜአለሁና አፈርሁ፥ ተዋረድሁም ብሎ ሲያለቅስ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: Ephraim my dear son? a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ኤፍሬም ለእኔ የከበረ ልጅ ነውን? ወይስ የተወደደ ሕፃን ነውን? በእርሱ ላይ በተናገርሁ ቍጥር አስበዋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ አንጀቴ ታወከችለት ርኅራኄም እራራለታለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, the way thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.text_amharic: ለራስሽ የመንገድ ምልክት አድርጊ፥ መንገድንም የሚመሩ ዓምዶችን ትከዪ፥ ልብሽንም ወደ ሄድሽበት መንገድ ወደ ጥርጊያው አቅኚ፤ አንቺ የእስራኤል ድንግል ሆይ፥ ተመለሺ፥ ወደ እነዚህም ወደ ከተሞችሽ ተመለሺ።

verses.text_english: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ከዳተኛ ልጅ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ትቅበዘበዣለሽ? እግዚአብሔር በምድር ላይ አዲስ ነገር ፈጥሮአልና ሴት ወንድን ትከብባለች።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, mountain of holiness.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠርዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ምርኮአቸውን በመለስሁ ጊዜ በይሁዳ አገር በከተሞችዋ። የጽድቅ ማደሪያ ሆይ፥ የቅድስና ተራራ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ የሚልን ነገር እንደ ገና ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they go forth with flocks.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በአገሩ ሁሉ ከገበሬዎችና መንጋን ይዘው ከሚዞሩ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ይገኛሉ።

verses.text_english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.text_amharic: የደከመችውን ነፍስ አርክቻለሁና፥ ያዘነችውንም ነፍስ ሁሉ አጥግቤአለሁና።

verses.text_english: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ነቃሁ ተመለከትሁም፥ እንቅልፌም ጣፋጭ ሆነልኝ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልን ቤትና የይሁዳን ቤት በሰው ዘርና በእንስሳ ዘር የምዘራበት ዘመን፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ አፈርሳቸውና ክፉ አድርግባቸው ዘንድ እንደ ተጋሁባቸው፥ እንዲሁ እሠራቸውና እተክላቸው ዘንድ እተጋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ዘመን ሰው ዳግመኛ እንዲህ አይልም። አባቶች ጨርቋ የወይን ፍሬ በሉ፥ የልጆችም ጥርሶች ጠረሱ፤

verses.text_english: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ በደሉ ይሞታል፤ መራራውን የወይን ፍሬ የሚበላ ሁሉ ጥርሶቹ ይጠርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ቃል ኪዳን የምገባበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽ አገር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝሁበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንደ ገባሁት ያለ ቃል ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልጸኑምና፥ እኔም ቸል አልኋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But this the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚያ ወራት በኋላ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር የምገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነውና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ሕጌን በልቡናቸው አኖራለሁ፥ በልባቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፤ እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.text_english: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱ ሰው ባልንጀራውን፥ እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን። እግዚአብሔርን እወቅ ብሎ አያስተምርም፤ ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ያውቁኛልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። በደላቸውን እምራቸዋለሁና፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አላስብምና።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts his name:
verses.text_amharic: ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ የሚባል፥ ፀሐይን በቀን የጨረቃንና የከዋክብትን ሥርዓት በሌሊት ብርሃን አድርጎ የሚሰጥ፥ እንዲተምሙም የባሕርን ሞገዶች የሚያናውጥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕግ ከፊቴ ቢወገድ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ደግሞ የእስራኤል ዘር በፊቴ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ለዘላለም ይቀራል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰማይ በላይ ቢከነዳ፥ የምድርም መሠረት በታች ቢመረመር፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ስላደረጉት ነገር ሁሉ የእስራኤልን ዘር ሁሉ እጥላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.text_amharic: ከሐናንኤል ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ ከተማ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሠራበት ዘመን፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.text_amharic: የተለካበትም ገመድ ወደ ጋሬብ ኮረብታ በቀጥታ ወደ ፊት ይሄዳል፥ ወደ ጎዓም ይዞራል።

verses.text_english: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የሬሳም ሸለቆ ሁሉ የአመድም እርሻ ሁሉ እስከ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ድረስ በምሥራቅ በኩል እስካለው እስከ ፈረሰ በር ማዕዘን ድረስ ለእግዚአብሄር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ለዘላለም አይነቀልም አይፈርስምም።

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ በአሥረኛው ዓመት፥ በናቡክደነፆር በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which in the king of Judah's house.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምን ከብቦ ነበር፤ ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በነበረው በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ብሎ አስጠብቆት ነበርና። ስለ ምን እንዲህ ብለህ ትንቢት ትናገራለህ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ እርሱም ይይዛታል፤

verses.text_english: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በእውነት በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል፥ አፍ ለአፍም ይናገረዋል፥ ዓይኑም ዓይኑን ያያል እንጂ ከከለዳውያን እጅ አያመልጥም፤

verses.text_english: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሴዴቅያስን ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሰዋል፥ እኔም እስክጐበኘው ድረስ በዚያ ይኖራል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከከላዳውያን ጋር ብትዋጉ ምንም አትረቡም።

verses.text_english: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አለ። የእግዚአብሄር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that in Anathoth: for the right of redemption thine to buy .
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የአጐትህ የሰሎም ልጅ አናምኤል ወደ አንተ መጥቶ። ትገዛው ዘንድ መቤዠቱ የአንተ ነውና በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን ግዛ ይልሃል።

verses.text_english: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that in Anathoth, which in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance thine, and the redemption thine; buy for thyself. Then I knew that this the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል የአጐቴ ልጅ አናምኤል እኔ ወዳለሁበት ወደ ግዞቱ ቤት አደባባይ መጥቶ። በብንያም አገር በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን፥ እባክህ፥ ግዛ፤ ርስቱ የአንተ ነውና፥ መቤዠቱም የአንተ ነውና፤ ለአንተ ግዛው አለኝ። ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ሆነ አወቅሁ።

verses.text_english: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.text_amharic: በዓናቶትም ያለውን እርሻ ከአጐቴ ልጅ ከአናምኤል ገዛሁ፥ አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብርም መዘንሁለት።

verses.text_english: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed , and took witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances.
verses.text_amharic: በውሉም ወረቀት ላይ ፈረምሁ አተምሁትም፥ ምስክሮችንም ጠርቼ ብሩን በሚዛን መዘንሁለት።

verses.text_english: So I took the evidence of the purchase, that which was sealed to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.text_amharic: የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን የውል ወረቀት ወሰድሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.text_amharic: የአጐቴም ልጅ አናምኤል፥ የውሉንም ወረቀት የፈረሙ ምስክሮች፥ በግዞትም ቤት አደባባይ የተቀመጡ አይሁድ ሁሉ እያዩ የውሉን ወረቀት ለመሕሤያ ልጅ ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ ሰጠሁት።

verses.text_english: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በፊታቸውም እንዲህ ብዬ ባሮክን አዘዝሁት።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ብዙ ቀን ይጠበቁ ዘንድ የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን ይህን የውል ወረከት ወስደህ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ አኑራቸው።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰዎች በዚህች ምድር ቤትንና እርሻን የወይን ቦታንም እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።

verses.text_english: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክም የውሉን ወረቀት ከሰጠሁት በኋላ፥ እንዲህ ብዬ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለይሁ።

verses.text_english: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ ሰማይንና ምድርን በታላቅ ኃይልህና በተዘረጋች ክንድህ ፈጥረሃል፥ ከአንተም የሚያቅት ነገር የለም።

verses.text_english: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, his name,
verses.text_amharic: ለብዙ ሺህ ምሕረት ታደርጋለህ፥ የአባቶችንም በደል ከእነርሱ በኋላ በልጆቻቸው ብብት ትመልሳለህ፤ ስምህ ታላቅና ኃያል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.text_amharic: በምክር ታላቅ በሥራም ብርቱ ነህ፤ ለሁሉም እንደ መንገዱና እንደ ሥራው ፍሬ ትሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይኖችህ በአዳም ልጆች መንገድ ሁሉ ተገልጠዋል።
