verses.text_english: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, unto this day, and in Israel, and among men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ምልክትንና ድንቅን ነገር በግብጽ ምድር ደግሞም በእስራኤልና በሌሎች ሰዎች መካከል አድርገሃል፥ እንደ ዛሬም ለአንተ ስም አድርገሃል።

verses.text_english: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.text_amharic: በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር፥ በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በታላቅም ግርማ ሕዝብህን እስራኤልን ከግብጽ ምድር አወጣህ።

verses.text_english: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.text_amharic: ትሰጣቸውም ዘንድ ለአባቶቻቸው የማልህላቸውን ምድር፥ ወተትና ማርንም የምታፈስሰውን ምድር፥ ሰጠሃቸው፤

verses.text_english: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ገብተው ወረሱአት፤ ነገር ግን ቃልህን አልሰሙም በሕግህም አልሄዱም፥ ያደረርም ዘንድ ካዘዝሃቸው ሁሉ ምንም አላደረጉም፤ ስለዚህ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣህባቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest .
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ የአፈር ድልድል፥ ሊይዙአትም እስከ ከተማይቱ ድረስ ቀርበዋል፤ ከሰይፍና ከራብ ከቸነፈርም የተነሣ ከተማይቱ ለሚዋጉአት ለከለዳውያን እጅ ተሰጥታለች፥ የተናገርኸውም ሆኖአል፤ እነሆም፥ አንተ ታየዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ። እርሻውን በብር ግዛ ምስክሮችንም ጥራ አልኸኝ፤ ከተማይቱ ግን ለከለዳውያን እጅ ተሰጥታለች።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ የሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እኔን የሚያቅተኝ ነገር አለን? ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ ለከለዳውያን እጅና ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እርሱም ይይዛታል።

verses.text_english: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችን ከተማ የሚወጉ ከለዳውያን መጥተው በእሳት ያነድዱአታል፥ ያስቈጡኝም ዘንድ በሰገነታቸው ላይ ለበኣል ካጠኑባቸው፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥን KWrባን ካፈሰሱባቸው ቤቶች ጋር ያቃጥሉአታል።

verses.text_english: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች ከታናሽነታቸው ጀምሮ በፊቴ ክፉ ነገርን ብቻ አድርገዋልና፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እኔን በእጃቸው ሥራ ከማስቈጣት በቀር ሌላ ሥራ አላደረጉምና።

verses.text_english: For this city hath been to me a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.text_amharic: ከፊቴ አስወግዳት ዘንድ ይህች ከተማ ከሠሩአት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቍጣዬንና መዓቴን ለማነሣሣት ሆናለችና፤

verses.text_english: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም እኔን ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ፥ እነርሱና ነገሥታቶቻቸው አለቆቻቸውም ካህናቶቻቸውም ነቢያቶቻቸውም የይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚንኖሩ፥ ስላደረጉት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆችና ስለ ይሁዳ ልጆች ክፋት ሁሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.text_amharic: ፊታቸውንም ሳይሆን ጀርባቸውን ወደ እኔ መለሱ፤ እኔም በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ሳሰተምራቸው ተግሣጽን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.text_amharic: ያረክሱትም ዘንድ ስሜ በተጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ ርkWsvታቸውን አኖሩ።

verses.text_english: And they built the high places of Baal, which in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳን ወደ ኃጢአት እንዲያገቡት፥ ይህንን ርkWsvት ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ እኔ ያላዘዝሁትንና በልቤ ያላሰብሁትን ነገር፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለሞሎክ በእሳት ያሳልፉ ዘንድ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ያሉትን የበኣልን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ሠሩ።

verses.text_english: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንግዲህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር አንተ ስለ እርስዋ። በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ተሰጥታለች ስለምትላት ከተማ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ በታላቅም መቅሠፍቴ እነርሱን ካሳደድሁባት አገር ሁሉ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ ተዘልለውም እንዲኖሩ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም ከእነርሱም በኋላ ለልጆቻቸው መልካም ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ ለዘላለም እንዲፈሩኝ አንድ ልብና አንድ መንገድ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም ከማደርገው በጎነት አልመለስም ስል፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር የዘላለምን ቃል ኪዳን እገባለሁ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ ፈቀቅ እንዳይሉ መፈራቴን በልባቸው ውስጥ አኖራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም መልካምን በማድረግ ደስ ይለኛል በእውነትም በፍጹም ልቤና በፍጹም ነፍሴ በዚህች ምድር እተክላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ይህን እጅግ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ እንዳመጣሁ፥ እንዲሁ የተናገርሁላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ አመጣላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንሰሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት፥ ለከለዳውያንም እጅ ተሰጥታለች በምትሉአት ምድር እርሻን ይገዛሉ።

verses.text_english: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ምርኮኞቻቸውንም እመልሳለሁና በብንያም አገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች በደጋውም ባሉ ከተሞች በቈላውም ባሉ ከተሞች በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ ሰዎች እርሻውን በብር ይገዛሉ በውሉም ወረቀት ፈርመው ያትማሉ ምስክሮችንም ይጠራሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስ ገና በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ሳለ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሲል መጣለት።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD his name;
verses.text_amharic: ስሙ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ፥ ያደረገው እግዚአብሔር፥ ያጸናውም ዘንድ የሠራው እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኔ ጩኽ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ፤ አንተም የማታውቀውን ታላቅና ኃይለኛ ነገርን አሳይሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሄር ለአፈር ድልድልና ለምሽግ ስለ ፈረሱ ስለዚህች ከተማ ቤቶች፥ ስለ ይሁዳም ነገሥታት ቤቶች እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.text_english: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
verses.text_amharic: ከለዳውያን ለመዋጋት መጥተዋል፤ ነገር ግን በKWTaዬና በመዓቴ በገደልኋቸው ሰዎች ሬሳዎች ሊሞሉአቸው ነው፥ ስለ ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ፊቴን ከዚህች ከተማ ሰውሬአለሁና።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ፈውስንና መድኃኒትን አመጣላታለሁ፥ እፈውሳቸውማለሁ፤ የሰላምንና የእውነትን ብዛት እገልጥላቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳን ምርኮና የእስራኤልንም ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ቀድሞም እንደ ነበሩ አድርጌ እሠራቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔንም ከበደሉበት ኃጢአት ሁሉ አነጻቸዋለሁ እኔንም የበደሉኝን ያመፀብኝንም ኃጢአታቸውን ሁሉ ይቅር እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችም ከተማ እኔ የምሠራላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ በሚሰሙ እኔም ስላመጣሁላቸው በጎነትና ሰላም ሁሉ በሚፈሩና በሚደነግጡ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ለደስታ ስም ለምስጋናም ለክብርም ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say desolate without man and without beast, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲ ይላል። እናንተ። ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት በምትሉአት በዚህች ስፍራ፥ የሚቀመጥባቸው በሌላ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባድማ በሆኑ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ፥

verses.text_english: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD good; for his mercy for ever: of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሐሤት ድምፅና የደስታ ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራ ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራ ድምፅ። እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና የሠራዊትን ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚሉ ድምፅ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት የሚያመጡት ድምፅ እንደ ገና ይሰማል። የምድርን ምርኮ ቀድሞ እንደ ነበረ አድርጌ እመልሳለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing flocks to lie down.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ባድማ ሆኖ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባለው በዚህ ስፍራ በከተሞችም ሁሉ መንጎቻቸውን የሚያሳርፉት የእረኞች መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth , saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በደጋው ላይ ባሉ ከተሞች በቈላውም ባሉ ከተሞች በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ በብንያምም አገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች መንጎቹ በተቈጣጣሪው እጅ እንደ ገና ያልፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ስለ እስራኤል ቤትና ስለ ይሁዳ ቤት የተናገርሁትን መልካም ቃል የምፈጽምበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን በዚያም ጊዜ ለዳዊት የጽድቅን ቍጥቋጥ አበቅልለታለሁ፤ እርሱም ፍርድንና ጽድቅን በምድር ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን ይሁዳ ይድናል ኢየሩሳሌምም ተዘልላ ትቀመጣለች፤ የምትጠራበትም ስም። እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችን ተብሎ ነው።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በእስራኤል ቤት ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጥ ሰው ከዳዊት ዘንድ አይታጣም፤

verses.text_english: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ የእህሉንም ቍርባን የሚያቃጥል ሁልጊዜም የሚሠዋ ሰው ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ዘንድ በእኔ ፊት አይታጣም።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቀንና ሌሊት በወራቱ እንዳይሆን የቀን ቃል ኪዳኔንና የሌሊት ቃል ኪዳኔን ማፍረስ ብትችሉ፥

verses.text_english: may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑ ላይ የሚነግሥ ልጅ እንዳይሆንለት ከባሪዬ ከዳዊት ጋር፥ ከአገልጋዮቼም ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ጋር ያለው ቃል ኪዳኔ ደግሞ ይፈርሳል።

verses.text_english: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይን ሠራዊት መቍጠር የባሕርንም አሸዋ መስፈር እንደማይቻል፥ እንዲሁ የባሪያዬን የዳዊትን ዘርና የሚያገለግሉኝን ሌዋውያንን አበዛለሁ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ። እግዚአብሔር የመረጣቸውን ሁለቱን ወገን ጥሎአቸዋል ያለውን ነገር አትመለከትምን? እንዲሁ በፊታቸው ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ሕዝቤን አቃልለዋል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant not with day and night, I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የቀንና የሌሊት ቃል ኪዳኔን የሰማይንና የምድርንም ሥርዓት ያላጸናሁ እንደሆነ፥

verses.text_english: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, that I will not take of his seed rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ደግሞ በአብርሃምና በይስሐቅ በያዕቆብም ዘር ላይ ገዦች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ከዘሩ እንዳልወስድ፥ የያዕቆብንና የባሪያዬን የዳዊትን ዘር እጥላለሁ፤ ምርኮአቸውን እመልሳለሁና፥ እምራቸውማለሁና።

verses.text_english: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ከእጁም ግዛት በታች ያሉ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ኢየሩሳሌምንና ከተሞችዋን ሁሉ ይወጉ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሂድ ለይሁዳም ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ ተናገር እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ በእሳትም ያቃጥላታል፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በእርግጥ ትያዛለህ በእጅም አልፈህ ትሰጣለህ እንጂ ከእጁ አታመልጥም፤ ዓይንህም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ዓይን ታያለች፥ እርሱም ከአንተ ጋር አፍ ለአፍ ይናገራል፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም ትገባለህ።

verses.text_english: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አንተ እንዲህ ይላል። በሰይፍ አትሞትም፥ በሰላም ትሞታለህ እንጂ፤

verses.text_english: thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn for thee; and they will lament thee, , Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተ በፊት እንደ ነበሩ እንደ ዱሮ ነገሥታት እንደ አባቶችህ መቃጠል፥ እንዲሁ ያቃጥሉሃልና። ወየው! ጌታ ሆይ እያሉ ያለቅሱልሃል፤ እኔ ቃልን ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምንና የቀሩትን የይሁዳን ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ከተመሸጉት ከይሁዳ ከተሞች የተረፉትን ለኪሶንና ዓዜቃን በወጋ ጊዜ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ነገረው።

verses.text_english: the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, , of a Jew his brother.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ ዕብራዊ የሆነውን ወንድ ባሪያውንና ዕብራዊት የሆነች ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ፥ አይሁዳዊ ወንድሙንም ማንም እንዳይገዛ፥ ስለ አርነታቸው አዋጅ እንዲነገር ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ካደረገ በኋላ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let go.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ ወንድ ባሪያውንና ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ማንም እንዳይገዛቸው ወደ ቃል ኪዳኑ የገቡ አለቆች ሁሉና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሰሙ አርነትም አወጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ ተመልሰው አርነት ያወጡአቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻቸውን አስመለሱ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም አድርገው ገዙአቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁን ከባርነት ቤት ከግብጽ አገር ባወጣኋቸው ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዲህ ብዬ ቃል ኪዳን አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ የተሸጠላችሁን ስድስትም ዓመት የተገዛላችሁን ዕብራዊ ወንድማችሁን እያንዳንዳችሁ አርነት ታወጡታላችሁ፥ እያንዳንዱም ያወጣዋል፤ አባቶቻችሁ ግን አልሰሙኝም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።

verses.text_english: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ዛሬ ተመልሳችሁ ሰው ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን አርነት ለማውጣት አዋጅ በመንገር ለዓይኔ ደስ የሚያሰኝን ነገር አድርጋችሁ ነበር፥ በስሜም በሚጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ተመልሳችሁ ስሜን አስነቀፋችሁ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፈቃዳቸው እንዲሄዱ አርነት ያወጣችኋቸውን ወንድና ሴት ባሪያዎቻችሁን አስመለሳችሁ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም እንዲሆኑላችሁ ገዛችኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰው ሁሉ ለወንድሙና ለባልንጀራው የአርነት አዋጅ ለመንገር እኔን አልሰማችሁም፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ለሰይፍና ለቸነፈር ለራብም የአርነት አዋጅ እናገርባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በምድርም መንግሥታት ሁሉ መካከል እንድትበተኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኔንም የተላለፉትን ሰዎች፥ እንቦሳውንም ቈርጠው በቍራጩ መካከል ባለፉ ጊዜ በፊቴ ያደረጉትን የቃል ኪዳንን ቃል ያልፈጸሙትን፥

verses.text_english: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳን አለቆችና የኢየሩሳሌምን አለቆች ጃንደረቦችን ካህናትንም በእንቦሳም ቍራጭ መካከል ያለፉትን የአገሩን ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ነፍሳቸውንም ለሚሹአት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ሬሳቸውም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳንም ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስንና አለቆቹን ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ነፍሳቸውንም ለሚሹአት እጅ ከእናንተም ለተመለሱት ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አዝዛለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ወደዚህችም ከተማ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እርስዋንም ይወጋሉ ይይዙአትማል በእሳትም ያቃጥሉአታል፤ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ሰው የሌለበት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉስ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሬካባውያን ቤት ሄደህ ተናገራቸው፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ከጓዳዎቹ ወደ አንዲቱ አግባቸው የወይን ጠጅም አጠጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
verses.text_amharic: የከባስንን ልጅ የኤርምያስን ልጅ ያእዛንያን ወንድሞቹንም ልጆቹንም ሁሉ የሬካባውያንን ወገን ሁሉ ወሰድኋቸው፤

verses.text_english: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which by the chamber of the princes, which above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት በበረኛው በሰሎም ልጅ በመዕሤያ ጓዳ በላይ ባለው በአለቆች ጓዳ አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ጌዴልያ ልጅ ወደ ሐናን ልጆች ጓዳ አገባኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
verses.text_amharic: በሬካባውያንም ልጆች ፊት የወይን ጠጅ የሞላባቸውን ማድጋዎችንና ጽዋዎችን አኑሬ። የወይኑን ጠጅ ጠጡ አልኋቸው።

verses.text_english: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, , nor your sons for ever:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን እንዲህ አሉ። የወይኑን ጠጅ አንጠጣም፥ አባታችን የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ እንዲህ ብሎ አዝዞናልና። እናንተና ልጆቻችሁ ለዘላለም የወይን ጠጅ አትጠጡ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye strangers.
verses.text_amharic: በምትኖሩባት ምድር ላይ ብዙ ዘመን እንድትኖሩ፥ በዕድሜአችሁ ሙሉ በድንኳን ውስጥ ተቀመጡ እንጂ ቤትን አትሥሩ፥ ዘርንም አትዝሩ፥ ወይንም አትትከሉ፥ አንዳችም አይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
verses.text_amharic: እኛም የአባታችንን የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብን ቃል ባዘዘን ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዘናል፤ እኛም ሚስቶቻችንም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም ዕድሜአችንን ሙሉ የወይን ጠጅ አልጠጣንም፤

verses.text_english: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
verses.text_amharic: የምንቀመጥበትንም ቤት አልሠራንም፤ የወይን ቦታና እርሻ ዘርም የለንም፤

verses.text_english: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.text_amharic: በድንኳንም ውስጥ ተቀምጠናል፥ ታዝዘናል፥ አባታችንም ኢዮናዳብ ያዘዘንን ሁሉ አድርገናል።

verses.text_english: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደዚህች ምድር በመጣ ጊዜ። ኑ ከከለዳውያን ሠራዊትና ከሶርያ ሠራዊት ፊት የተነሣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንሂድ አልን፤ እንዲሁም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጥን።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሂድና ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚቀመጡ ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ቃሌን ትሰሙ ዘንድ ተግሣጽን አትቀበሉምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
verses.text_amharic: የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ ልጆቹ የወይን ጠጅ እንዳይጠጡ ያዘዛቸው ቃል ተፈጸመ፤ ለአባታቸውም ትእዛዝ ታዝዘዋልና እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አይጠጡም፤ እኔም በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ተናግሬአችኋለሁ፤ ተናገርሁ፥ ሆኖም አልሰማችሁኝም።

verses.text_english: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending , saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። እያንዳንዳችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፥ ሥራችሁንም አሳምሩ፥ ታመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አትከተሉ፥ ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠሁት ምድር ትቀመጣላችሁ እያልሁ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ልኬባችሁ ነበር፤ እናንተ ግን ጆሬአችሁን አላዘነበላችሁም እኔንም አልሰማችሁኝም።

verses.text_english: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
verses.text_amharic: የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብ ልጆች አባታቸው ያዘዛቸውን ትእዛዝ ፈጽመዋልና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ ግን አልሰማኝምና፤

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በተናገርኋቸው ጊዜ አልሰሙምና፥ በጠራኋቸውም ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና የተናገርሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በይሁዳ ላይ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ ላይ አመጣባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ሬካባውያንን እንዲህ አላቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለአባታችሁ ለኢዮናዳብ ትእዛዝ ታዝዛችኋልና፥ ትእዛዙንም ሁሉ ጠብቃችኋልና፥ ያዘዛችሁንም ፈጽማችኋልና፤

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በፊቴ የሚቆም ሰው ከሬካብ ልጅ ከኢዮናዳብ ወገን ለዘላለም አይታጣም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ የመጽሐፍ ክርታስ ውሰድ፥ ለአንተም ከተናገርሁበት ቀን ከኢዮስያስ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ላይ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተናገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ጻፍበት።

verses.text_english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
verses.text_amharic: ምናልባት የይሁዳ ቤት። እኔ አደርግባቸዋለሁ ያልሁትንና ያሰብሁትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ይሰሙ ይሆናል፥ ከክፋ መንገዳቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ እኔም በደላቸውንና ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር እል ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም የኔርያን ልጀ ባሮክን ጠራ፥ ባሮክም እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ የተናገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ከኤርምያስ አፍ በመጽሐፉ ክርታስ ጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ባሮክን እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው። እኔ ተግዤአለሁ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እገባ ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.text_english: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD'S house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ሂድ፥ ከአፌም የጻፍኸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በጾም ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሕዝቡ ጆር በክርታሱ አንብብ፤ ደግሞም ከከተሞቻቸው በሚወጡ በይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ አንብበው።

verses.text_english: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ የተናገረው ቍጣውና መዓቱ ታላቅ ነውና ምናልባት ጸሎታቸው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትወድቅ ይሆናል፥ ሁሉም ከክፉ መንገዱ ይመለስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD'S house.
verses.text_amharic: የኔርያም ልጅ ባሮክ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በመጽሐፉ አነበበ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአምስተኛው ዓመት በዘጠነኛው ወር በኢየሩሳሌም የተቀመጡ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከይሁዳም ከተሞች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም የመጡ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመጾም አዋጅ ነገሩ።

verses.text_english: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD'S house, in the ears of all the people.
verses.text_amharic: ባሮክም የኤርምያስን ቃል በእግዚአብሄር ቤት በላይኛው አደባባይ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በአዲሱ በር መግቢያ ባለው በጸሐፊው በሳፋን ልጅ በገማርያ ጓዳ በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ጆሮ በመጽሐፉ አነበበ።

verses.text_english: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: የሳፋንም ልጅ የገማርያ ልጅ ሚክያስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሁሉ ከመጽሐፉ በሰማ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ወደ ጸሐፊው ጓዳ ወረደ፤ እነሆም፥ አለቆች ሁሉ፥ ጸሐፊው ኤሊሳማ፥ የሸማያ ልጅ ድላያ፥ የዓክቦር ልጅ ኤልናታን፥ የሳፋን ልጅ ገማርያ፥ የሐናንያ ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ አለቆቹም ሁሉ በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ሚክያስም ባሮክ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ በመጽሐፉ ባነበበ ጊዜ የሰማውን ቃል ሁሉ ነገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹም ሁሉ። በሕዝቡ ጆሮ ያነበብኸውን ክርታስ በእጅህ ይዘህ ና የሚል መልእክት በኵሲ ልጅ በሰሌምያ ልጅ በናታንያ ልጅ በይሁዲ እጅ ወደ ባሮክ ላኩ። የኔርያም ልጅ ባሮክ ክርታሱን በእጁ ይዞ ወደ እነርሱ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read in their ears.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እስኪ ተቀመጥ፥ በጆሮአችንም አንብብ አሉት። ባሮክም በጆሮአቸው አነበበው።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉንም ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ ፈርተው እርስ በእርሳቸው ተመካከሩ፥ ባሮክንም። ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በእርግጥ ለንጉሡ እንናገራለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
verses.text_amharic: ባሮክንም። ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ከአፉ እንዴት እንደ ጻፍኸው ንገረን ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote with ink in the book.
verses.text_amharic: ባሮክም። ይህን ቃል ከአፉ ይነግረኝ ነበር፥ እኔም በመጽሐፉ ላይ በቀለም እጽፍ ነበር ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹም ባሮክን። አንተና ኤርምያስ ሂዱ፥ ተሸሸጉ፥ ወዴትም እንደ ሆናችሁ ማንም አይወቅ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ አደባባይ ገቡ፥ ክርታሱንም በጸሐፊው በኤሊሳማ ጓዳ አኑረውት ነበር፤ ቃሉንም ሁሉ በንጉሡ ጆሮ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe's chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ክርታሱን ያመጣ ዘንድ ይሁዲን ላከ፥ እርሱም ከጸሐፊው ከኤሊሳማ ጓዳ ወሰደው፤ ይሁዲም በንጉሡና በንጉሡ አጠገብ በቆሙት አለቆች ሁሉ ጆሮ አነበበው።

verses.text_english: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and on the hearth burning before him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በዘጠነኛው ወር በክረምት ቤት ተቀምጦ ነበር፥ በፊቱም በምድጃ ውስጥ እሳት ይነድድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast into the fire that on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that on the hearth.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዲም ሦስት ወይም አራት ዓምድ ያህል ባነበበ ቍጥር፥ ንጉሡ በካራ ቀደደው፤ ክርታሱም በምድጃ ውስጥ ባለው እሳት ፈጽሞ እስኪቃጠል ድረስ በምድጃ ውስጥ ወዳለው እሳት ጣለው።

verses.text_english: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ የሰሙ ባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ አልፈሩም ልብሳቸውንም አልቀደዱም።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ኤልናታንና ድላያ ገማርያም ክርታሱን እንዳያቃጥል ንጉሡን ለመኑት፥ እርሱ ግን አልሰማቸውም።

verses.text_english: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ጸሐፊውን ባሮክንና ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን ይይዙ ዘንድ የንጉሡን ልጅ ይረሕምኤልንና የዓዝርኤልን ልጅ ሠራያን የዓብድኤልንም ልጅ ሰሌምያን አዘዘ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ሰወራቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ክርስታሱንና ባሮክ ከኤርምያስ አፍ የጻፈውን ቃል ካቃጠለ በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
verses.text_amharic: ዳግመኛም ሌላ ክርታስ ውሰድ፥ የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄም ባቃጠለው ክርታስ ላይ የነበረውን የቀድሞውን ቃል ሁሉ ጻፍበት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳንም ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄምን እንዲህ በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእርግጥ ይመጣል ይህችንም አገር ያፈርሳታል ከሰውና ከእንስሳም ባዶ ያደርጋታል ብለህ ለምን ጻፍህበት? ብለህ ይህን ክርታስ አቃጥለሃል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ስለ ኢዮአቄም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ተቀማጭ አይኖርለትም፥ ሬሳውም በቀን ለትኩሳት በሌሊትም ለውርጭ ይጣላል።

verses.text_english: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም እርሱንና ዘሩን ባሪያዎቹንም እቀጣለሁ፤ እነርሱም አልሰሙምና የተናገርሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በእነርሱ ላይና በኢየሩሳሌም በሚቀመጡ በይሁዳም ሰዎች ላይ አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በይሁዳ ያነገሠው የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ በኢዮአቄም ልጅ በኢኮንያን ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.text_english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሆነ ባሪያዎቹ የአገሩም ሕዝብ በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ እጅ የተናገረውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ። ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እኛ ጸልይ ብሎ የሰሌምያን ልጅ ዮካልንና ካህኑን የመዕሤያን ልጅ ሶፎንያስን ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ ላከ።

verses.text_english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም በግዞት ቤት ገና አላገቡትም ነበርና ኤርምያስ በሕዝቡ መካከል ይወጣና ይገባ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: የፈርዖንም ሠራዊት ከግብጽ ወጣ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ከብበዋት የነበሩ ከለዳውያን ይህን ወሬ በሰሙ ጊዜ ከኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh's army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከእኔ ትጠይቁ ዘንድ የላካችሁን የይሁዳን ንጉሥ እንዲህ በሉት። እነሆ፥ ሊረዳችሁ የወጣው የፈርዖን ሠራዊት ወደ አገሩ ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ከለዳውያንም ተመልሰው ይህችን ከተማ ይዋጉአታል ይይዙአትማል በእሳትም ያቃጥሉአታል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አይሄዱምና። ከለዳውያን በእርግጥ ከእኛ ዘንድ ይሄዳሉ ብላችሁ ራሳችሁን አታታልሉ።

verses.text_english: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained wounded men among them, should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም የሚዋጉትን የከለዳውያንን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ብትመቱት ኖሮ፥ ከእነርሱም የተወጉት ብቻ ቢቀሩ ኖሮ፥ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ በድንኳኑ ተነሥቶ ይህችን ከተማ በእሳት ባቃጠሉአት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,
verses.text_amharic: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ከፈርዖን ሠራዊት ፊት የተነሣ ከኢየሩሳሌም በተመለሰ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስ በሕዝቡ መካከል የርስቱን እድል ፈንታ ከዚያ ይቀበል ዘንድ ወደ ብንያም አገር ሊሄድ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward there, whose name Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: በብንያምም በር በነበረ ጊዜ የሐናንያ ልጅ የሰሌምያ ልጅ የሪያ የተባለ የዘበኞች አለቃ በዚያ ነበረ፤ እርሱም። ወደ ከለዳውያን መኰብለልህ ነው ብሎ ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን ያዘው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jeremiah, false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም። ሐሰት ነው፤ ወደ ከለዳውያን መኰብለሌ አይደለም አለ፤ እርሱ ግን አልሰማውም፥ የሪያም ኤርምያስን ይዞ ወደ አለቆች አመጣው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆችም ተቈጥተው ኤርምያስን መቱት፥ የጸሐፊውንም የዮናታንን ቤት የግዞት ቤት አድርገውት ነበርና በዚያ አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ወደ ጕድጓድ ቤት ወደ ጓዳዎቹ ገባ፤ ኤርምያስም በዚያ ብዙ ቀን ከተቀመጠ በኋላ፥

verses.text_english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ ልኮ አስመጣው፥ ንጉሡም በቤቱ። በውኑ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሆነ ቃል አለን? ብሎ በቈይታ ጠየቀው። ኤርምያስም። አዎን አለ። ደግሞም። በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አልፈህ ትሰጣለህ አለ።

verses.text_english: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ደግሞ ንጉሡን ሴዴቅያስን እንዲህ አለው። በግዞት ቤት የጣላችሁኝ አንተን ወይስ ባሪያዎችህን ወይስ ሕዝብህን ምን በድያችሁ ነው?

verses.text_english: Where now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእናንተና በዚህች አገር አይመጣባችሁም ብለው ትንቢት ይናገሩላችሁ የነበሩ ነቢያቶቻችሁ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.text_english: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እንድትሰማኝ አሁን እለምንሃለሁ፤ እባክህ፥ ልመናዬ ወደ አንተ ይድረስ፤ በዚያ እንዳልሞት ወደ ጸሐፊው ወደ ዮናታን ቤት አትመልሰኝ።

verses.text_english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ አዘዘ፥ ኤርምያስንም በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ አኖሩት፥ እንጀራም ሁሉ ከከተማ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ ዕለት ዕለት አንድ አንድ እንጀራ ከጋጋሪዎች መንገድ ይሰጡት ነበር። እንዲሁም ኤርምያስ በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ የተናገረውን ቃል የማታን ልጅ ስፋጥያስ፥ የጳስኮርም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ፥ የሰሌምያም ልጅ ዮካል፥ የመልክያም ልጅ ጳስኮር ሰሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ብሎአልና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህች ከተማ የሚቀመጥ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ይሞታል፤ ወደ ከለዳውያን ግን የሚወጣ በሕይወት ይኖራል፥ ነፍሱም እንደ ምርኮ ትሆንለታለች፥ በሕይወትም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which shall take it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ይህች ከተማ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት እጅ በእርግጥ ትሰጣለች፥ እርሱም ይይዛታል።

verses.text_english: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹም ንጉሡን። ይህን የመሰለውን ቃል ሲነግራቸው በዚህች ከተማ የቀሩትን የሰልፈኞቹን እጅ የሕዝቡንም ሁሉ እጅ ያደክማልና ይህ ሰው እንዲገደል እንለምንሃለን፤ ይህ ሰው ክፋትን እንጂ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ሰላምን አይመኝለትምና አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he in your hand: for the king not can do thing against you.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ። ንጉሡ በእናንተ ላይ ምንም ሊያደርግ አይችልምና እነሆ፥ በእጃችሁ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስንም ወሰዱት በግዞት ቤቱም አደባባይ ወደ ነበረው ወደ ንጉሡ ልጅ ወደ መልክያ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ ጣሉት፤ ኤርምያስንም በገመድ አወረዱት። በጕድጓድም ውስጥ ጭቃ እንጂ ውኃ አልነበረበትም፤ ኤርምያስም ወደ ጭቃው ውስጥ ገባ።

verses.text_english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም ቤት የነበረው ጃንደረባ ኢትዮጵያዊው አቤሜሌክ ኤርምያስን በጕድጓዱ ውስጥ እንዳኖሩት ሰማ። ንጉሡም በብንያም በር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king's house, and spake to the king, saying,
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም ከንጉሡ ቤት ወጥቶ ንጉሡን እንዲህ አለው።

verses.text_english: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for no more bread in the city.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ሰዎች ነቢዮን ኤርምያስን በጕድጓድ ውስጥ በመጣላቸው በእርሱ ላይ በማድረጋቸው ሁሉ ክፉ አድርገዋል፤ በከተማይቱም ውስጥ እንጀራ ስለሌለ በዚያ በራብ ይሞታል።

verses.text_english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ኢትዮጵያዊውን አቤሜሌክም። ከአንተ ጋር ሠላሳ ሰዎች ከዚህ ውሰድ፥ ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ ሳይሞት ከጕድጓድ አውጣው ብሎ አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
verses.text_amharic: አቤሜሌክም ከእርሱ ጋር ሰዎችን ይዞ ሄደ፥ ከቤተ መዛግብቱም በታች ወደ ነበረው ወደ ንጉሥ ቤት ገባ፥ ከዚያም አሮጌ ጨርቅና እላቂ ልብስ ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኤርምያስም ወደ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ በገመድ አወረደው።

verses.text_english: And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
verses.text_amharic: ኢትዮጵያዊውም አቤሜሌክ ኤርምያስን። ይህን አሮጌ ጨርቅና እላቂውን ልብስ በብብትህ ከገመዱ በታች አድርግ አለው፤ ኤርምያስም እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስንም በገመዱ ጐተቱት ከጕድጓድም አወጡት፥ ኤርምያስም በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that in the house of the LORD: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ ልኮ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ነበረው ወደ ሦስተኛው መግቢያ ወደ እርሱ ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን አስመጣው፤ ንጉሡም ኤርምያስን። አንዲት ነገር እጠይቅሃለሁ፤ ምንም አትሸሽገኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ሴዴቅያስን። ብነግርህ በውኑ አትገድለኝምን? ብመክርህም አትሰማኝም አለው።

verses.text_english: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ። ይህችን ነፍስ የፈጠረልን ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አልገድልህም፥ ነፍስህንም ለሚሹ ለእነዚህ ሰዎች እጅ አሳልፌ አልሰጥህም ብሎ በቈይታ ለኤርምያስ ማለ።

verses.text_english: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon's princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ሴዴቅያስን። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ አለቆች ብትወጣ፥ ነፍስህ በሕይወት ትኖራለች ይህችም ከተማ በእሳት አትቃጠልም፤ አንተም ቤትህም በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ አለቆች ባትወጣ ግን፥ ይህች ከተማ በከለዳውያን እጅ ትሰጣለች፥ በእሳትም ያቃጥሉአታል አንተም ከእጃቸው አታመልጥም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ ኤርምያስን። ወደ ከለዳውያን በኰበለሉት በአይሁድ እጅ አሳልፈው ይሰጡኛል እነርሱም ያፌዙብኛል ብዬ እፈራለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver . Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the LORD, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አለው። አሳልፈው አይሰጡህም። እኔ የምነግርህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እባክህ፥ ስማ፤ ይቀናሃል ነፍስህም በሕይወት ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: But if thou refuse to go forth, this the word that the LORD hath shewed me:
verses.text_amharic: ትወጣ ዘንድ እንቢ ብትል ግን፥ እግዚአብሔር ያሳየኝ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah's house brought forth to the king of Babylon's princes, and those shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire, they are turned away back.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት የቀሩትን ሴቶች ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ አለቆች ያወጣሉ፤ እነዚያም ሴቶች። ባለምዋሎችህ አታልለውሃል አሸንፈውህማል፤ እግሮችህ ግን አሁን በጭቃ ውስጥ ከገቡ እነርሱ ከአንተ ወደ ኋላ ተመልሰዋል ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቶችህንና ልጆችህንም ሁሉ ወደ ከለዳውያን ያወጣሉ፤ አንተም በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ትያዛለህ እንጂ ከእጃቸው አታመልጥም፤ ይህችም ከተማ በእሳት ትቃጠላለች።

verses.text_english: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዴቅያስም ኤርምያስን እንዲህ አለው። ይህም ቃል ማንም አይወቅ፥ አንተም አትሞትም።

verses.text_english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹ ግን እኔ ከአንተ ጋር እንደ ተነጋገርሁ ቢሰሙ፥ ወደ አንተም መጥተው። ለንጉሡ ያልኸውን ንገረን አትሸሽገንም፥ እኛም አንገድልህም፤ ደግሞ ንጉሡ ያለህን ንገረን ቢሉህ፥ አንተ።

verses.text_english: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ እሞት ዘንድ ወደ ዮናታን ቤት አትመልሰኝ ብዬ በንጉሡ ፊት ለመንሁ በላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆቹም ሁሉ ወደ ኤርምያስ መጥተው ጠየቁ፥ ንጉሡም እንዳዘዘው እንደዚህ ቃል ሁሉ ነገራቸው። ነገሩም አልተሰማምና ከእርሱ ጋር መነጋገርን ተው።

verses.text_english: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was when Jerusalem was taken.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም እስከ ተያዘችበት ቀን ድረስ በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌምም በተያዘች ጊዜ፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥተው ከበቡአት፤

verses.text_english: in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth of the month, the city was broken up.
verses.text_amharic: በሴዴቅያስም በአሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት በአራተኛው ወር ከወሩም በዘጠነኛው ቀን ከተማይቱ ተሰበረች።

verses.text_english: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, Nergalsharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim, Rabsaris, Nergalsharezer, Rabmag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ አለቆች ሁሉ፥ ኤርጌል ሳራስር፥ ሳምጋርናቦ፥ ሠርሰኪም፥ ራፌስ፥ ኤርጌል ሳራስር፥ ራብማግ፥ ከቀሩት ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ አለቆች ሁሉ ጋር ገብተው በመካከለኛው በር ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ሰልፈኞቹም ሁሉ ባዩአቸው ጊዜ ኰበለሉ፥ በሌሊትም በንጉሡ አትክልት መንገድ በሁለቱ ቅጥር መካከል ከነበረው ደጅ ከከተማይቱ ወጡ፤ በዓረባም መንገድ ወጡ።

verses.text_english: But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.text_amharic: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ተከታተላቸው፥ ሴዴቅያስንም በኢያሪኮ ሜዳ አገኙት፤ ይዘውም በሐማት ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሪብላ ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ናቡከደነፆር አመጡት እርሱም ፍርድን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የሴዴቅያስን ልጆች በዓይኑ ፊት በሪብላ ገደላቸው፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የይሁዳን ከበርቴዎች ሁሉ ገደለ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah's eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይን አወጣ፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም ይወስደው ዘንድ በሰንሰለት አሰረው።

verses.text_english: And the Chaldeans burned the king's house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ከለዳውያንም የንጉሡንና የሕዝቡን ቤቶች በእሳት አቃጠሉ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር አፈረሱ።

verses.text_english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን በከተማይቱ የቀሩትን ሕዝብ ወደ እርሱም የኰበለሉትን ሰዎች የቀረውንም የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ወደ ባቢሎን ማረካቸው።

verses.text_english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳች ከሌላቸው ከሕዝቡ ድሆች ግን የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን በይሁዳ አገር ተዋቸው፥ የወይኑን ቦታና እርሻውን በዚያን ጊዜ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, saying,
Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ላከ፥ ናቡሽዝባንም ራፋስቂስም ኤርጌል ሳራስርም ራብማግም የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ዋና ዋና አለቆች ሁሉ ላኩ፤

verses.text_english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rabsaris, and Nergalsharezer, Rabmag, and all the king of Babylon's princes;
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስንም ከግዞት ቤት አደባባይ አወጡት፥ ወደ ቤቱም ይወስደው ዘንድ ለሳፋን ልጅ ለአኪቃም ልጅ ለጎዶልያስ ሰጡት፤ እንዲህም በሕዝብ መካከል ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.
verses.text_amharic: በግዞትም ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ሳለ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሂድ ለኢትዮጵያዊውም ለአቤሜሌክ እንዲህ በለው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ለበጎነት ሳይሆን ለክፋት ቃሌን በዚህች ከተማ ላይ አመጣለሁ፤ በዚያም ቀን በፊትህ ይፈጸማል።

verses.text_english: Go and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be in that day before thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን አድንሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በምትፈራቸው ሰዎች እጅ አልሰጥህም።

verses.text_english: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጽሜ አድንሃለሁ ነፍስህም እንደ ምርኮ ትሆንልሃለች እንጂ በሰይፍ አትወድቅም፥ በእኔ ታምነሃልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባቢሎን በተማረኩት በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ምርኮኞች መካከል የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን በሰንሰለት አስሮ በወሰደው ጊዜ ከራማ ከለቀቀው በኋላ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ኤርምያስን ወሰደው እንዲህም አለው። አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ክፉ ነገር በዚህ ስፍራ ላይ ተናገረ፤

verses.text_english: Now the LORD hath brought , and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም አመጣው እንደ ተናገረውም አደረገ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርታችኋልና፥ ቃሉንም አልሰማችሁምና ይህ ነገር ሆነባችሁ።

verses.text_english: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ በእጅህ ካለችው ሰንሰለት ዛሬ ፈታሁህ። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት መልካም መስሎ ቢታይህ፥ ና፥ እኔም በመልካም አይሃለሁ፤ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን መምጣት መልካም መስሎ ባይታይህ ግን፥ ተቀመጥ፤ እነሆ፥ አገሪቱ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናት፤ ትሄድ ዘንድ መልካም መስሎ ወደሚታይህ ደስ ወደሚያሰኝህም ስፍራ ሂድ።

verses.text_english: Now while he was not yet gone back, , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሳይመለስ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ ወደ ሾመው ወደ ሳፋን ልጅ ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ተመለስ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር በሕዝቡ መካከል ተቀመጥ፤ ወይም ትሄድ ዘንድ ደስ ወደሚያሰኝህ ስፍራ ሂድ አለው። የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ስንቅና ስጦታ ሰጥቶ አሰናበተው።

verses.text_english: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ወዳለበት ወደ ምጽጳ ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር በአገሩ ውስጥ በቀሩት ሕዝብ መካከል ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: Now when all the captains of the forces which in the fields, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;
verses.text_amharic: በየሜዳውም የነበሩት የጭፍራ አለቆችና ሰዎቻቸው ሁሉ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በምድር ላይ እንደ ሾመ፥ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆችንም፥ ወደ ባቢሎን ያልተማረኩትን የምድርን ድሆች፥ እንዳስጠበቀ በሰሙ ጊዜ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል፥

verses.text_english: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናንና ዮናታን፥ የተንሑሜትም ልጅ ሠራያ፥ የነጦፋዊውም የዮፌ ልጆች የማዕካታዊውም ልጅ ያእዛንያ ከሰዎቻቸው ጋር ወደ ጎዶልያስ ወደ ምጽጳ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
verses.text_amharic: የሳፋንም ልጅ የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ለእነርሱና ለሰዎቻቸው እንዲህ ብሎ ማለ። ለከለዳውያን ትገዙ ዘንድ አትፍሩ፤ በምድር ተቀመጡ ለባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ተገዙ፥ መልካምም ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.text_english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ እኛ በሚመጡት ከለዳውያን ፊት እቆም ዘንድ በምጽጳ እኖራለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ወይንንና የበጋ ፍሬ ዘይትንም አከማቹ፥ በየዕቃችሁም ውስጥ ክተቱ፥ በያዛችኋቸውም ከተሞቻችሁ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: Likewise when all the Jews that in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;
verses.text_amharic: በሞዓብም በአሞንም ልጆች መካከል በኤዶምያስም በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ የነበሩ አይሁድ ሁሉ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ የይሁዳን ቅሬታ እንዳስቀረ፥ የሳፋንንም ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በላያቸው እንደ ሾመው በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ሁሉ ከተሰደዱበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ተመለሱ፥ ወደ ይሁዳም አገር ጎዶልያስ ወዳለበት ወደ ምጽጳ መጡ፥ ወይንና የበጋንም ፍሬ እጅግ ብዙ አከማቹ።

verses.text_english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን በየሜዳውም የነበሩ የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ወደ ምጽጳ መጥተው።

verses.text_english: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ በኣሊስ ይገድልህ ዘንድ የናታንያን ልጅ እስማኤልን እንደ ሰደደ ታውቃለህን? አሉት። የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ግን አላመናቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know : wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን። እባክህ፥ ልሂድ፤ ማንም ሳያውቅ የናታንያን ልጅ እስማኤልን ልግደለው፤ ወደ አንተ የተሰበሰቡ አይሁድ ሁሉ እንዲበተኑ የይሁዳም ቅሬታ እንዲጠፋ ነፍስህን ስለ ምን ይገድላል? ብሎ በምጽጳ በቆይታ ለጎዶልያስ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.
verses.text_amharic: የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ግን የቃሬያን ልጅ ዮሐናንን። በእስማኤል ላይ ሐሰት ተናግረሃልና ይህን ነገር አታድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ወር ከመንግሥት ወገንና ከንጉሡ ዋና ዋና አለቆች አንዱ የኤሊሳማ ልጅ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ከአሥር ሰዎች ጋር ወደ ምጽጳ ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ መጣ፤ በዚያም በምጽጳ በአንድ ላይ እንጀራ በሉ።

verses.text_english: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
verses.text_amharic: የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት አሥሩ ሰዎች ተነሥተው የሳፋንን ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በሰይፍ መቱ፥ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በአገሩ ላይ የሾመውን ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, the men of war.
verses.text_amharic: እስማኤልም ከጎዶልያስ ጋር በምጽጳ የነበሩትን አይሁድ ሁሉ፥ በዚያም የተገኙትን የከለዳውያንን ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ገደላቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew ,
verses.text_amharic: ጎዶልያስን ከገደለ በኋላ ማንም ሳያውቅ በሁለተኛው ቀን፥

verses.text_english: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring to the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጢማቸውን ላጭተው ልብሳቸውንም ቀድደው ገላቸውንም ነጭተው፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ የእህል ቍርባንና ዕጣን በእጃቸው እየያዙ፥ ሰማንያ ሰዎች ከሴኬምና ከሴሎ ከሰማርያም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
verses.text_amharic: የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል ከምጽጳ ወጥቶ እያለቀሰ ሊገናኛቸው ሄደ፤ በተገናኛቸውም ጊዜ። ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ኑ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And it was , when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that with him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ከተማም መካከል በመጡ ጊዜ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሰዎች ገደሉአቸው፥ በgWdጓድም መካከል ጣሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም እስማኤልን። በሜዳ የተሸሸገ ስንዴና ገብስ ዘይትና ማርም አለንና አትግደለን የሚሉት አሥር ሰዎች ተገኙ። እርሱም ተዋቸው፥ ከወንድሞቻቸውም ጋር አልገደላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with slain.
verses.text_amharic: እስማኤልም ከጎዶልያስ ጋር የገደላቸውን የሰዎች ሬሳ ሁሉ የጣለበት ጕድጓድ ንጉሡ አሳ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ ባኦስን ስለ ፈራ የሠራው gWdጓድ ነበረ፤ የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል የገደላቸውን ሞላበት።

verses.text_english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that in Mizpah, the king's daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
verses.text_amharic: እስማኤልም በምጽጳ የነበረውን የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ የንጉሡን ሴቶች ልጆች የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ለአኪቃም ልጅ ለጎዶልያስ የሰጠውን በምጽጳ የቀሩትን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ማረካቸው፤ የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል ማርኮ ወደ አሞን ልጆች ይሄድ ዘንድ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ያደረገውን ክፋት ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that in Gibeon.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹን ሁሉ ይዘው ከናታንያ ልጅ ከእስማኤል ጋር ሊዋጉ ሄዱ፥ በገባዖንም ባለው በታላቁ ውኃ አጠገብ አገኙት።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, when all the people which with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that with him, then they were glad.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስማኤልም ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ የቃሬያን ልጅ ዮሐናንን ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩትን የጭፍራ አለቆችን ሁሉ ባዩ ጊዜ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
verses.text_amharic: እስማኤልም ከምጽጳ የማረካቸው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ዘወር ብለው ተመለሱ፥ ወደ ቃሬያም ልጅ ወደ ዮሐናን ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
verses.text_amharic: የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ግን ከስምንት ሰዎች ጋር ከዮሐናን አመለጠ ወደ አሞንም ልጆች ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በምጽጳ ከገደለው በኋላ ከናታንያ ልጅ ከእስማኤል ያስመለሱአቸውን የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ ከገባዖን ያስመለሱአቸውን ሰልፈኞች፥ ሴቶችንም፥ ልጆችንም፥ ጃንደረቦችንም፥ ወሰዱ፤

verses.text_english: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተውም ወደ ግብጽ ይሄዱ ዘንድ በቤተልሔም አጠገብ ባለው በጌሮት ከመዓም ተቀመጡ፤

verses.text_english: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
verses.text_amharic: እስማኤል የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በአገሩ ላይ የሾመውን የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን ስለ ገደለው ከለዳውያንን ፈርተዋልና።

verses.text_english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
verses.text_amharic: የጭፍራ አለቆችም ሁሉ የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን የሆሻያም ልጅ ያእዛንያ ሕዝብም ሁሉ ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ቀረቡ፥

verses.text_english: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the LORD thy God, for all this remnant; (for we are left a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)
That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
verses.text_amharic: ነብዩንም ኤርምያስን። ዓይኖችህ እንዳዩን ከብዙ ጥቂት ቀርተናልና ልመናችን፥ እባክህ፥ በፊትህ ትድረስ፤ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር የምንሄድበትን መንገድና የምናደርገውን ነገር ያሳየን ዘንድ ስለ እኛ፥ ስለዚህ ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልይ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard ; behold, I will pray unto the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass, whatsoever thing the LORD shall answer you, I will declare unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ። ሰምቻችኋለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ እንደ ቃላችሁ ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጸልያለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚመልስላችሁን ሁሉ እነግራችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተም ምንም አልሸሽግም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send thee to us.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስንም። አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር በአንተ እጅ ወደ እኛ የላከውን ነገር ሁሉ ባናደርግ፥ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን እውነተኛና ታማኝ ምስክር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Whether good, or whether evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በመስማታችን መልካም እንዲሆንልን፥ መልካም ወይም ክፉ ቢሆን፥ አንተን ወደ እርሱ የምንልክህ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንሰማለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሥር ቀን በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያንም ልጅ ዮሐናንን ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩትን የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ጠራ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎታችሁን በፊቱ አቀርብ ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ የላካችሁኝ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull down, and I will plant you, and not pluck up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ስላደረግሁባችሁ ክፉ ነገር ተጸጽቻለሁና በዚህች ምድር ብትቀመጡ እሠራችኋለሁ እንጂ አላፈርሳችሁም፥ እተክላችኋለሁ እንጂ አልነቅላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD: for I with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ከምትፈሩት ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትፍሩ፤ አድናችሁ ዘንድ ከእጁም አስጥላችሁ ዘንድ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍሩ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ እንዲምራችሁ ወደ አገራችሁም እንዲመልሳችሁ እኔ እምራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን። በዚህች ምድር አንቀመጥም ብትሉ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥

verses.text_english: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። አይደለም፤ ሰልፍ ወደማናይባት የመለከትም ድምፅ ወደማንሰማባት ወደማንራብባትም ወደ ግብጽ ምድር እንሄዳለን በዚያም እንቀመጣለን ብትሉ፥

verses.text_english: And now therefore hear the word of the LORD, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የይሁዳ ቅሬታ ሆይ፥ አሁን እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ ግብጽ ትገቡ ዘንድ በዚያም ትቀመጡ ዘንድ ፊታችሁን ብታቀኑ፥

verses.text_english: Then it shall come to pass, the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.
verses.text_amharic: የምትፈሩት ሰይፍ በዚያ በግብጽ ምድር ያገኛችኋል፥ ስለ እርሱም የምትደነግጡበት ራብ በዚያ በግብጽ ይደርስባቸኋል፥ በዚያም ትሞታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ግብጽም ይገቡ ዘንድ በዚያም ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ፊታቸውን በሚያቀኑ ሰዎች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይሆንባቸዋል፤ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ይሞታሉ፤ እኔም ከማመጣባቸው ክፉ ነገር ማንም አይቀርም፥ ማንም አያመልጥም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። KWTaዬና መዓቴ በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩ ላይ እንደ ፈሰሰ፥ እንዲሁ ወደ ግብጽ በገባችሁ ጊዜ መዓቴ ይፈስስባችኋል፤ እናንተም ለጥላቻና ለመደነቂያ ለመረገሚያና ለመሰደቢያ ትሆናላችሁ፥ ይህንም ስፍራ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታዩትም።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የይሁዳ ቅሬታ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር። ወደ ግብጽ አትግቡ ብሎ ተናግሮባችኋልና ዛሬ እንዳስጠነቀቅኋችሁ በእርግጥ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us unto the LORD our God; and according unto all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do .
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። ስለ እኛ ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልይ፥ አምላካችንም እግዚአብሔር የሚናገርህን ሁሉ ንገረን እኛም እናደርገዋለን ብላችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ አምላካችሁ ልካችሁኝ ነበርና ራሳችሁን አታልላችኋል።

verses.text_english: And I have this day declared to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any for the which he hath sent me unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ዛሬ ነግሬአችኋለሁ፥ ወደ እናንተም በላከኝ ነገር ሁሉ የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማችሁም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go to sojourn.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ሄዳችሁ እንድትቀመጡ በወደዳችሁበት ስፍራ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም እንድትሞቱ በእርግጥ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, all these words,
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ለእነርሱ አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር የላከውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ኤርምያስ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ መናገርን በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
verses.text_amharic: የሆሻያ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን ትዕቢተኞችም ሰዎች ሁሉ ኤርምያስን። ሐሰት ተናግረሃል፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር። በዚያ ትቀመጡ ዘንድ ወደ ግብጽ አትግቡ ብሎ አልላከህም፤

verses.text_english: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከለዳውያን እንዲገድሉን ወደ ባቢሎንም እንዲማርኩን በእጃቸው አሳልፈህ ትሰጠን ዘንድ የኔርያ ልጅ ባሮክ በላያችን ላይ አነሣሥቶሃል አሉት።

verses.text_english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን የጭፍራ አለቆችም ሁሉ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በይሁዳ ምድር ይቀመጡ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;
verses.text_amharic: የቃሬያም ልጅ ዮሐናን የጭፍራ አለቆችም ሁሉ በይሁዳ ምድር ለመቀመጥ ከተሰደዱባቸው ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተመለሱትን የይሁዳን ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆችንም የንጉሡንም ሴቶች ልጆች፥ የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከሳፋን ልጅ ከአኪቃም ልጅ ከጎዶልያስ ጋር የተዋቸውን ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ነቢዩንም ኤርምያስን የኔርያንም ልጅ ባሮክን ወሰዱ፤

verses.text_english: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they to Tahpanhes.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል አልሰሙምና ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ገቡ፥ እስከ ጣፍናስ ድረስ መጡ።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በጣፍናስም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;
verses.text_amharic: ታላላቆችን ድንጋዮች በእጅህ ውሰድ፥ የይሁዳም ሰዎች እያዩ በጣፍናስ ባለው በፈርዖን ቤት ደጅ መግቢያ ሸሽጋቸው፤

verses.text_english: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በላቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ልኬ ባሪያዬን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር አመጣለሁ፥ ዙፋኑንም እኔ በሸሸግኋቸው በእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ላይ አኖራለሁ፤ እርሱም ማለፊያውን ድንኳኑን በላያቸው ይዘረጋል።

verses.text_english: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, such for death to death; and such for captivity to captivity; and such for the sword to the sword.
verses.text_amharic: መጥቶም የግብጽን ምድር ይመታል፥ ለሞትም የሚሆነውን ለሞት፥ ለምርኮም የሚሆነውን ለምርኮ፥ ለሰይፍም የሚሆነውን ለሰይፍ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።
