verses.text_english: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽም አማልክት ቤቶች እሳትን ያነድዳል ያቃጥላቸውማል ይማርካቸውማል፤ እረኛም ደበሎውን እንደሚደርብ እንዲሁ የግብጽን አገር ይደርባል፤ ከዚያም በሰላም ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: He shall break also the images of Bethshemesh, that in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽም ምድር ያለውን የሄልዮቱን ከተማ ሐውልቶች ይሰብራል፥ የግብጽንም አማልክት ቤቶች በእሳት ያቃጥላል።

verses.text_english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽ ምድር በሚግዶልና በጣፍናስ በሜምፎስም በጳትሮስም አገር ስለ ተቀመጡ አይሁድ ሁሉ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ያመጣሁትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አይታችኋል፤ እነሆ፥ ዛሬ ባድማ ሆነዋል፥ የሚቀመጥባቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods, whom they knew not, they, ye, nor your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሆነው ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ስላደረጉት ክፋት፥ ለማያውቁአቸውም ለሌሎች አማልክት ያጥኑ ዘንድ ያመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ ስለሄዱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending , saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
verses.text_amharic: በማለዳም ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ሰደድሁባችሁና። እንደዚህ እንደ ጠላሁት ያለ ርኩስ ነገር አታድርጉ አልኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አልሰሙም ከክፋታቸውም ተመልሰው ለሌሎች አማልክት እንዳያጥኑ ጆሮአቸውን አላዘነበሉም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted desolate, as at this day.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መዓቴና ቍጣዬ ፈሰሱ፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ነደዱ፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው ፈረሱ ባድማም ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Therefore now thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሄር እንዲህ ይላል። ከይሁዳ ወገን ቅሬታ እንዳይቀርላችሁ፥ ወንድንና ሴትን፥ ብላቴናንና ሕፃንን ከመካከላችሁ ታጠፉ ዘንድ ይህን ታላቅ ክፋት በራሳችሁ ላይ ለምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.text_english: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
verses.text_amharic: ሰውነታችሁንም ታጠፉ ዘንድ በምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል መረገሚያና መሰደቢያ ትሆኑ ዘንድ፥ ለመቀመጥ በገባችሁባት በግብጽ ምድር ለሌሎች አማልክት በማጠናችሁ በእጃችሁ ሥራ ለምን ታስቈጡኛላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ በይሁዳ ምድርና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ያደረጉትን የአባቶቻችሁን ክፋት፥ የይሁዳንም ነገሥታት ክፋት፥ የሚስቶቻቸውንም ክፋት፥ የእናንተንም ክፋት፥ የሚስቶቻችሁንም ክፋት ረስታችሁታልን?

verses.text_english: They are not humbled unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አልተዋረዱም አልፈሩምም፥ በእናንተና በአባቶቻችሁም ፊት ባኖርሁት ሕጌና ሥርዓቴ አልሄዱም።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይሁዳን ሁሉ አጠፋ ዘንድ ፊቴን ለክፋት በላያችሁ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, fall in the land of Egypt; they shall be consumed by the sword by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ግብጽም ይገቡ ዘንድ በዚያም ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ፊታቸውን ያቀኑትን የይሁዳን ቅሬታ እወስዳለሁ፥ ሁሉም ይጠፋሉ፥ በግብጽም ምድር ይወድቃሉ፤ በሰይፍና በራብ ይጠፋሉ፤ ከታናሹም ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ ይሞታሉ፤ ለጥላቻና ለመደነቂያ ለመረገሚያና ለመሰደቢያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌምንም እንደ ቀጣሁ፥ እንዲሁ በግብጽ ምድር የሚኖሩትን በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም እቀጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ለመቀመጥ ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ከሄዱ፥ ወደ ይሁዳ አገር ተመልሰው በዚያ ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ከሚወድዱ ከይሁዳ ቅሬታ ወገን የሚያመልጥና የሚቀር ወደዚያም የሚመለስ የለም፤ ከሚያመልጥም በቀር ማንም አይመለስም።

verses.text_english: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቶቻቸውም ለሌሎች አማልክት ማጠናቸውን ያወቁ ሰዎች ሁሉ በዚያም የቆሙ ሴቶች ሁሉ፥ በግብጽ ምድር በጳትሮስ የተቀመጡ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ሆነው ለኤርምያስ መለሱለት እንዲህም አሉ።

verses.text_english: the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የነገርኸንን ቃል አንሰማህም።

verses.text_english: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እኛና አባቶቻችን ነገሥታቶቻችንም አለቆቻችንም በይሁዳ ከተሞች በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ እናደርገው እንደ ነበረ፥ ለሰማይ ንግሥት እናጥን ዘንድ የመጠጥንም KWrባን እናፈስስላት ዘንድ ከአፋችን የወጣውን ቃል ሁሉ በእርግጥ እናደርጋለን፤ በዚያን ጊዜም እንጀራ እንጠግብ ነበር፥ መልካምም ይሆንልን ክፉም አናይም ነበር።

verses.text_english: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰማይ ንግሥት ማጠንን ለእርስዋም የመጠጥን ቍርባን ማፍሰስን ከተውን ወዲህ ግን፥ እኛ በሁሉ ነገር ተቸግረናል፥ በሰይፍና በራብ አልቀናል።

verses.text_english: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
verses.text_amharic: እኛስ ለሰማይ ንግሥት ባጠንንላት የመጠጥንም ቍርባን ባፈሰስንላት ጊዜ፥ በውኑ ያለ ባሎቻችን ምስልዋን ለማበጀት እንጐቻ አድርገንላት ኖሮአልን? የመጠጥንም ቍርባን አፍስሰንላት ኖሮአልን?

verses.text_english: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him answer, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ይህን ቃል ለመለሱለት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ለወንዶቹና ለሴቶቹ ለሕዝቡም ሁሉ፥ መለሰላቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it into his mind?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተና አባቶቻችሁ ነገሥታቶቻችሁም አለቆቻችሁም የምድርም ሕዝብ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ያጠናችሁትን ዕጣን እግዚአብሔር ያሰበው በልቡም ያኖረው አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሥራችሁን ክፋትና ያደረጋችሁትን ርኵሰት ይታገሥ ዘንድ አልቻለም፤ ስለዚህ ምድራችሁ ባድማ መደነቂያም መረገሚያም ሆናለች ዛሬም እንደ ሆነ የሚኖርባት የለም።

verses.text_english: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
verses.text_amharic: ስላጠናችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ስለ በደላችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ስላልሰማችሁ፥ በሕጉና በሥርዓቱም በምስክሩም ስላልሄዳችሁ፥ ስለዚህ ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ይህች ክፉ ነገር አግኝታችኋለች።

verses.text_english: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that in the land of Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ለሴቶቹም ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። በግብጽ ምድር የምትኖሩ ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተና ሚስቶቻችሁ በአፋችሁ። ለሰማይ ንግሥት እናጥን ዘንድ የመጠጥንም ቍርባን እናፈስስላት ዘንድ የተሳልነውን ስእለታችንን በእርግጥ እንፈጽማለን አላችሁ በእጃችሁም አደረጋችሁት፤ እንግዲህ ስእለታችሁን አጽኑ ስእለታችሁንም ፈጽሙ።

verses.text_english: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በግብጽ ምድር የምትኖሩ ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ በግብጽ ምድር ሁሉ በሚኖር በይሁዳ ሰው ሁሉ አፍ ስሜ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ተብሎ እንዳይጠራ፥ እነሆ፥ በታላቅ ስሜ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፋት እተጋባቸዋለሁ፤ በግብጽም ምድር ያሉት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ ያልቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰይፍም የሚያመልጡ ጥቂት ሰዎች ሆነው ከግብጽ ምድር ወደ ይሁዳ ምድር ይመለሳሉ፤ ሊቀመጡም ወደ ግብጽ ምድር የገቡት የይሁዳ ቅሬታ ሁሉ ከእኔ ወይም ከእነርሱ የማናችን ቃል እንዲጸና ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And this a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
verses.text_amharic: ቃሌም በላያችሁ ለክፋት እንዲጸና ታውቁ ዘንድ በዚህች ስፍራ እንድቀጣችሁ ምልክታችሁ ይህ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaohhophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስን ጠላቱ ለሆነው ነፍሱንም ለፈለገው ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እንደ ሰጠሁት፥ እንዲሁ፥ እነሆ፥ የግብጹን ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ሖፍራን ለጠላቶቹ ነፍሱንም ለሚፈልጉ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት የኔርያ ልጅ ባሮክ እነዚህን ቃሎች ከኤርምያስ አፍ በመጽሐፍ በጻፋቸው ጊዜ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;
verses.text_amharic: ባሮክ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይልሃል።

verses.text_english: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ። እግዚአብሔር በሕመሜ ላይ ኀዘንን ጨምሮብኛልና ወዮልኝ! በልቅሶዬ ጩኸት ደክሜአለሁ፥ ዕረፍትንም አላገኘሁም ብለሃል።

verses.text_english: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የሠራሁትን አፈርሳለሁ፥ የተከልሁትንም እነቅላለሁ፤ ይኸውም በምድር ሁሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.
verses.text_amharic: ለራስህ ታላቅን ነገር ትፈልጋለህን? በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ፥ እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገርን አመጣለሁና አትፈልገው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን በሄድህበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ነፍስህን እንደ ምርኮ አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አሕዛብ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaohnecho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ግብጽ፤ በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ በከርከሚሽ ስለ ነበረው፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ስለ መታው ስለ ግብጽ ንጉሥ ስለ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ ሠራዊት።

verses.text_english: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሻ ጦር አዘጋጁ ወደ ሰልፍም ቅረቡ።

verses.text_english: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with helmets; furbish the spears, put on the brigandines.
verses.text_amharic: ፈረሰኞች ሆይ፥ ፈረሶችን ለgWmuና ውጡ፥ ራስ ቍርንም ደፍታችሁ ቁሙ፤ ጦርንም ሰንግሉ ጥሩርንም ልበሱ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: fear round about, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርተው ወደ ኋላ ሲመለሱ፥ ኃያላኖቻቸውም ሲደበደቡ ወደ ኋላቸውም ሳይመለከቱ ፈጥነው ሲሸሹ ለምን አየሁ? በዚህና በዚያ ድንጋጤ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጣኑ አያመልጥም ኃያሉም አይድንም፤ በሰሜን በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ በኩል ተሰናክለው ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: Who this cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ እንደ ግብጽ ወንዝ የሚነሣ፥ ውኃውም እንደ ወንዝ የሚናወጥ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ግብጽ እንደ ግብጽ ወንዝ ይነሳል ውኃውም እንደ ወንዙ ይናወጣል፤ እርሱም።እነሣለሁ ምድርንም ሁሉ እከድናለሁ፤ ከተሞችንና የሚኖሩባቸውን አጠፋለሁ ብሎአል።

verses.text_english: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle bend the bow.
verses.text_amharic: ፈረሶች ሆይ፥ ውጡ፤ ሰረገሎችም ሆይ፥ ንጐዱ፤ ጋሻም የሚያነግቡ የኢትዮጵያና የፋጥ ኃያላን፥ ቀስትንም ይዘው የሚስቡ የሉድ ኃያላን ይውጡ።

verses.text_english: For this the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ቀን ጠላቶቹን የሚበቀልበት የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር የበቀል ቀን ነው፤ ሰይፍ በልቶ ይጠግባል በደማቸውም ይሰክራል፥ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር በሰሜን ምድር በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ መሥዋዕት አለውና።

verses.text_english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; thou shalt not be cured.
verses.text_amharic: ድንግሊቱ የግብጽ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ወደ ገለዓድ ውጪ የሚቀባንም መድኃኒት ውሰጂ፤ መድኃኒትን ያበዛሽው በከንቱ ነው፤ መዳን የለሽም።

verses.text_english: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, they are fallen both together.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያሉ በኃያሉ ላይ ተሰናክሎ ሁለቱ በአንድነት ወድቀዋልና አሕዛብ gWsKWlናሽን ሰምተዋል፥ ልቅሶሽም ምድርን ሞልቶአታል።

verses.text_english: The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come smite the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር እንዲመጣና የግብጽን ምድር እንዲመታ እግዚአብሔር ለነቢዩ ለኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽ ተናገሩ፥ በሚግዶልም አሰሙ፥ በሜምፎስና በጣፍናስ አሰሙ፤ ሰይፍ በዙሪያህ ያለውን በልቶአልና። ተነሥ ተዘጋጅም በሉ።

verses.text_english: Why are thy valiant swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይለኞችህ ስለ ምን ተወገዱ? እግዚአብሔር ስላደከማቸው አልቆሙም።

verses.text_english: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
verses.text_amharic: ብዛታቸውም ተሰናከለ፥ ሰውም አንዱ በአንዱ ላይ ወደቀ፤ እነርሱም። ተነሡ፥ ከሚያስጨንቅ ሰይፍ ፊት ወደ ወገናችን ወደ ተወለድንባት ምድር እንመለስ አሉ።

verses.text_english: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የግብሥ ንጉሥ ፈርዖንን። ሰዓቱን የሚያሳልፍ gWrvኛ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.text_english: I live, saith the King, whose name the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, shall he come.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በተራሮች መካከል እንዳለ እንደ ታቦር፥ በባሕርም አጠገብ እንዳለ እንደ ቀርሜሎስ፥ እንዲሁ በእውነት ይመጣል፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተባለው ንጉሥ።

verses.text_english: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በግብጽ የምትቀመጪ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ሜምፎስ ባድማ ትሆናለችና፥ ትቃጠልማለችና፥ የሚቀመጥባትም አይገኝምና ለምርኮ የሚሆን ዕቃ አዘጋጂ።

verses.text_english: Egypt a very fair heifer, destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
verses.text_amharic: ግብጽ የተዋበች ጊደር ናት፤ ጥፋት ግን ይመጣል፥ ከሰሜን በኩል ይመጣባታል።

verses.text_english: Also her hired men in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, the time of their visitation.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋም ያሉ የተቀጠሩ ሠራተኞች እንደ ሰቡ ወይፈኖች ናቸው፤ የጥፋታቸው ቀንና የመጐብኘታቸው ጊዜ መጥቶባቸዋልና ተመለሱ፥ በአንድነትም ሸሹ፥ አልቆሙምም።

verses.text_english: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠራዊትም ጋር ይሄዳሉና ድምፅ እንደ እባብ ይተምማል፤ እንደ እንጨት ቈራጮችም በምሳር ይመጡባታል።

verses.text_english: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and innumerable.
verses.text_amharic: ይቈጠሩ ዘንድ የማይቻሉትን የዱርዋን ዛፎች ይቈርጣሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከአንበጣ ይልቅ በዝተዋልና ቍጥርም የላቸውምና።

verses.text_english: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽ ልጅ ታፍራለች፤ በሰሜን ሕዝብ እጅ አልፋ ትሰጣለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and them that trust in him:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የኖእ አሞንን፥ ፈርዖንንም፥ ግብጽንም፥ አማልክቶችዋንና ነገሥታቶችዋንም፥ ፈርዖንና በእርሱም የሚታመኑትን እቀጣለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሳቸውንም በሚፈልጉ ሰዎች እጅ፥ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በናቡክደነፆር እጅ፥ በባሪያዎቹም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ አንደ ቀድሞው ዘመን የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆናለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንተ ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ እነሆ፥ አንተን ከሩቅ ዘርህንም ከተማረከባት ምድር አድናለሁ፤ ያዕቆብም ተመልሶ ያርፋል ተዘልሎም ይቀመጣል፥ ማንም አያስፈራውምም።

verses.text_english: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንተንም ያሰደድሁባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁና፥ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም፤ በመጠን እቀጣሃለሁ፥ ያለ ቅጣትም አልተውህም።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርዖንም ጋዛን ሳይመታ ስለ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ውኃ ከሰሜን ይነሣል የሚያጥለቀልቅም ፈሳሽ ይሆናል፤ በአገሪቱና በመላዋ ሁሉ፥ በከተማይቱና በሚኖሩባት ላይ ይጐርፋል፤ ሰዎቹም ይጮኻሉ፥ በምድርም የሚሮሩ ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.text_english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong , at the rushing of his chariots, the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to children for feebleness of hands;
verses.text_amharic: ከኃይለኞች ፈረሶች ከኮቴያቸው መጠብጠብ ድምፅ፥ ከሰረገሎቹም መሸከርከር፥ ከመንኰራኵሮቹም መትመም የተነሣ አባቶች በእጃቸው ድካም ምክንያት ፊታቸውን መልሰው ወደ ልጆቻቸው አይመለከቱም።

verses.text_english: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሚሆነው ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሁሉ ያጠፋ ዘንድ የቀሩትንም ረዳቶች ሁሉ ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ይቈርጥ ዘንድ ስለሚመጣው ቀን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ፍልስጥኤማውያንና የከፍቶርን ደሴት ቅሬታ ያጠፋልና።

verses.text_english: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.text_amharic: ቡሀነት በጋዛ ላይ መጥቶአል፤ አስቀሎና ጠፋች፤ የዔናቅ ቅሬታዎች ሆይ! እስከ መቼ ድረስ ገላችሁን ትነጫላችሁ?

verses.text_english: O thou sword of the LORD, how long ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ ሆይ፥ ዝም የማትለው እስከ መቼ ነው? ወደ ሰገባህ ግባ ጸጥ ብለህም ዕረፍ።

verses.text_english: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር በአስቀሎናና በባሕር ዳር ላይ ትእዛዝ ሰጥቶአልና፥ በዚያም አዘጋጅቶታልና እንዴት ዝም ትላለህ?

verses.text_english: Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሞዓብ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ናባው ጠፍታለችና ወዮላት! ቂርያታይም አፍራለች ተይዛማለች፤ ሚሥጋብ አፍራለች ደንግጣማለች።

verses.text_english: no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሞዓብ ትምክሕት የለም፤ በሐሴቦን ላይ። ኑ ሕዝብ እንዳትሆን እናጥፋት ብለው ክፉ ነገር አስበውባታል። መድሜን ሆይ፥ አንቺ ደግሞ ትጠፊአለሽ ሰይፍም ያሳድድሻል።

verses.text_english: A voice of crying from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
verses.text_amharic: መፍረስና ታላቅ ጥፋት የሚል የጩኸት ቃል ከሖሮናይም ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ ጠፍታለች፥ ልጆችዋም ጩኸትን አሰምተዋል።

verses.text_english: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.text_amharic: በሉሒት ዓቀበት ልቅሶ እያለቀሱ ይወጣሉና፥ በሖሮናይምም ቍልቍለት የጥፋትንና የመባባትን ጩኸት ሰምተዋል።

verses.text_english: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ሸሽታችሁ ራሳችሁን አድኑ፤ በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ KWTቋጦ ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity his priests and his princes together.
verses.text_amharic: በሥራሽና በመዝገብሽ ታምነሻልና አንቺ ደግሞ ትያዢያለሽ፤ ካሞሽም ከካህናቱና ከአለቆቹ ጋር በአንድነት ይማረካል።

verses.text_english: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ፥ አጥፊ ወደ ከተማ ሁሉ ይመጣል አንዲትም ከተማ አትድንም፤ ሸለቆውም ይጠፋል ሜዳውም ይበላሻል።

verses.text_english: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: በርራ እንድትወጣ ለሞዓብ ክንፍ ስጡአት፤ ከተሞችዋም ባድማና ወና ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Cursed he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ በቸልታ የሚያደግ ርጉም ይሁን፥ ሰይፉንም ከደም የሚከለክል ርጉም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ ከታናሽነቱ ጀምሮ ቅምጥል ነበረ፥ በአምቡላውም ላይ ዐርፎአል፥ ከዕቃውም ወደ ዕቃ አልተገላበጠም፥ ወደ ምርኮም አልሄደም፤ ስለዚህ ቃናው በእርሱ ውስጥ ቀርቶአል፥ መዓዛውም አልተለወጠም።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሚያገላብጡትን የምልክበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እነርሱም ያገላብጡታል፤ ጋኖቹንም ባዶ ያደርጋሉ፥ መስቴዎቹንም ይሰብራሉ።

verses.text_english: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ቤት ይታመንባት ከነበረው ከቤቴል እንዳፈረ፥ እንዲሁ ሞዓብ ከካሞሽ ያፍራል።

verses.text_english: How say ye, We mighty and strong men for the war?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። እኛ ኃያላን በሰልፍም ጽኑዓን ነን እንዴት ትላላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Moab is spoiled, and gone up her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ ፈርሶአል፥ ከተሞቹም ጠፍተዋል፥ የተመረጡትም ጕልማሶች ወደ መታረድ ወርደዋል፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ ንጉሥ።

verses.text_english: The calamity of Moab near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.text_amharic: የሞዓብ ጥፋት ሊመጣ ቀርቦአል መከራውም እጅግ ይፈጥናል።

verses.text_english: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያው ያላችሁ ሁሉ ስሙንም የምታውቁ ሁሉ። ብርቱው በትር፥ የከበረው ሽመል፥ እንዴት ተሰበረ! ብላችሁ አልቅሱለት።

verses.text_english: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, he shall destroy thy strong holds.
verses.text_amharic: በዲቦን የምትኖሪ ሆይ፥ ሞዓብን የሚያጠፋ ወጥቶብሻልና፥ አምባሽንም ሰብሮአልና ከክብርሽ ውረጂ በጥማትም ተቀመጪ።

verses.text_english: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, say, What is done?
verses.text_amharic: በአሮዔር የምትኖሪ ሆይ፥ በመንገድ አጠገብ ቆመሽ ተመልከቺ፤ የሸሸውንና ያመለጠችውን። ምን ሆኖአል? ብለሽ ጠይቂ።

verses.text_english: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብም ፈርሶአልና አፈረ፤ አልቅሱ ጩኹም፤ ሞዓብ እንደ ተዘረፈ በአርኖን አጠገብ አውሩ።

verses.text_english: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳ ላይ፥ በሖሎን፥ በያሳ፥ በሜፍዓት ላይ፥

verses.text_english: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,
verses.text_amharic: በዲቦን፥ በናባው፥ በቤት ዲብላታይም ላይ፥

verses.text_english: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmeon,
verses.text_amharic: በቂርያታይም፥ በቤትጋሙል፥

verses.text_english: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.text_amharic: በቤትምዖን ላይ፥ በቂርዮት፥ በባሶራ፥ በሞዓብም ምድር ከተሞች ሁሉ ቅርብና ሩቅ በሆኑ ላይ ፍርድ መጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የሞዓብ ቀንድ ተቈረጠ ክንዱም ተሰበረ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርቶአልና አስክሩት፤ ሞዓብም በጥፋቱ ላይ ይንከባለላል፥ ደግሞም መሳቂያ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ለአንተ መሳቂያ አልሆነምን? ወይስ በሌቦች መካከል ተገኝቶአልን? ስለ እርሱ በተናገርህ ጊዜ ራስህን ትነቀንቃለህ።

verses.text_english: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በሞዓብ የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ከተሞችን ትታችሁ በዓለት ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፥ በገደል አፋፍም ቤትዋን እንደምትሠራ እንደ ርግብ ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ እንደ ታበየ ስለ ሞዓብ ትዕቢት ስለ ትምክህቱም ስለ kWraቱም ስለ መጓደዱም ስለ ልቡም ትዕቢት ሰምተናል።

verses.text_english: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but not so; his lies shall not so effect .
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣው ምንም እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ፉከራው ምንም አልሠራም።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ለሞዓብ አለቅሳለሁ ለሞዓብም ሁሉ እጮኻለሁ፤ ለቂርሔሬስ ሰዎች አለቅሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የሴባማ ወይን ሆይ፥ ከኢያዜር ልቅሶ ይልቅ ለአንቺ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ቅርንጫፎችሽ ባሕርን ተሻግረዋል፥ ወደ ኢያዜርም ባሕር ደርሰዋል፤ አጥፊው በሰብልሽና በወይንሽ ላይ መጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; shouting no shouting.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሤትና ደስታ ከፍሬያማው እርሻና ከሞዓብ ምድር ጠፍተዋል፤ ጠጁን ከመጥመቂያው አጥፍቻለሁ፤ ጠማቂውም በእልልታ አይጠምቅም፥ እልልታቸውም እልልታ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: From the cry of Heshbon unto Elealeh, unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar unto Horonaim, an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ከሐሴቦን ጩኸት እስከ ኤልያሊና እስከ ያሀጽ ድረስ ድምፃቸውን ሰጥተዋል፤ ከዞዓር እስከ ሖሮናይምና እስከ ዔግላት ሺሊሺያ ድረስ ይደርሳል፤ የኔምሬም ውኃ ደግሞ ይደርቃል።

verses.text_english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
verses.text_amharic: በኮረብታው መስገጃ ላይ የሚሠዋውን ለአማልክቱም የሚያጥነውን ከሞዓብ አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches he hath gotten are perished.
verses.text_amharic: ያተረፈው ትርፉ ጠፍቶበታልና፤ ስለዚህ ልቤ ለሞዓብ እንደ እንቢልታ ይጮኻል፥ ልቤም ለቂርሔሬስ ሰዎች እንደ እንቢልታ ይጮኻል።

verses.text_english: For every head bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.text_amharic: ራስ ሁሉ መላጣ ጢምም ሁሉ የተላጨ ነውና፤ በእጅም ሁሉ ላይ ክትፋት በወገብም ላይ ማቅ አለና።

verses.text_english: lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein no pleasure, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብን እንደማይወደድ ዕቃ ሰብሬአለሁና በሞዓብ ሰገነት ሁሉ ላይ በአደባባዩም ላይ በሁሉም ቦታ ልቅሶ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: They shall howl, , How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
verses.text_amharic: እንዴት ተገለበጠ! በእፍረትም የተነሣ ሞዓብ ጀርባውን እንዴት መለሰ! ብላችሁ አልቅሱ። ሞዓብም በዙሪያው ላሉት ሁሉ መሳቂያና ድንጋጤ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ እንደ ንስር ይበርራል ክንፉንም በሞዓብ ላይ ይዘረጋል።

verses.text_english: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞቹ ተይዘዋል፥ አምባዎቹም ተወስደዋል፥ በዚያም ቀን የሞዓብ ኃያላን ልብ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ልብ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Moab shall be destroyed from a people, because he hath magnified against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብም በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርቶአልና ሕዝብ ከመሆን ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሞዓብ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ፍርሃትና gWdጓድ ወጥመድም በአንተ ላይ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሞዓብ ላይ የመጐብኘትን ዓመት አመጣበታለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በፍርሃት የሸሸ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ ይወድቃል፥ ከgWdጓድም የወጣ በወጥመድ ይያዛል።

verses.text_english: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.text_amharic: የሸሹ ደክመው ከሐሴቦን ጥላ በታች ቆመዋል፤ እሳት ከሐሴቦን ነበልባልም ከሴዎን ወጥቶአል የሞዓብንም ማዕዘን የሤትንም ልጆች አናት በልቶአል።

verses.text_english: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
verses.text_amharic: ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ ወዮልህ! የካሞሽ ወገን ጠፍቶአል፤ ወንዶች ልጆችህ ተማርከዋልና፥ ሴቶች ልጆችህም ወደ ምርኮ ሄደዋልና።

verses.text_english: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far the judgment of Moab.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የሞዓብን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። የሞዓብ ፍርድ እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አሞን ልጆች፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለእስራኤል ልጆች የሉትምን? ወይስ ወራሽ የለውምን? ስለ ምን ሚልኮም ጋድን ወረሰ? ሕዝቡስ በከተሞቹ ላይ ስለ ምን ተቀመጠ?

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በአሞን ልጆች ከተማ በረባት ላይ የሰልፍ ውካታን የማሰማበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የፍርስራሽ ክምርም ትሆናለች፥ ሴቶች ልጆችዋም በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፥ እስራኤልም የወረሱትን ይወርሳል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሴቦን ሆይ፥ ጋይ ፈርሳለችና አልቅሺላት እናንተም የረባት ሴቶች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ሚልኮም ካህናቱና አለቆቹም በአንድነት ይማረካሉና ጩኹ፥ ማቅም ታጠቁ፥ አልቅሱም፥ በቅጥሮችም መካከል ተርዋርዋጡ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, , Who shall come unto me?
verses.text_amharic: ማን ይመጣብኛል ብለሽ በመዝገብሽ የታመንሽ አንቺ ከዳተኛ ልጅ ሆይ፥ በሸለቆችሽ፥ ውኃ በሚያረካቸው ሸለቆችሽ፥ ስለ ምን ትመኪያለሽ?

verses.text_english: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በዙሪያሽ ካሉት ሁሉ ዘንድ ፍርሃትን አመጣብሻለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፊታችሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ ትሰደዳላችሁ፥ የሚሸሹትንም የሚሰበስብ የለም።

verses.text_english: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ የአሞንን ልጆች ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኤዶምያስ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውኑ በቴማን ጥበብ የለምን? ከብልሃተኞችስ ምክር ጠፍቶአልን?

verses.text_english: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time I will visit him.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበባቸውስ አልቆአልን? እናንተ በድዳን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የዔሳውን ጥፋት፥ የምጐበኝበትን ጊዜ፥ አመጣበታለሁና ሽሹ፥ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፥ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.text_amharic: ወይን ለቃሚዎች ቢመጡብህ፥ ቃርሚያውን አይተውልህምን? ሌቦችስ በሌሊት ቢመጡ፥ የሚያጠፉት እስኪበቃቸው ድረስ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he not.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ዔሳውን ዐራቈትሁት፥ የተሸሸጉትንም ስፍራዎች ገለጥሁ፥ ይሸሸግም ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ዘሩም ወንድሞቹም ጎረቤቶቹም ጠፍተዋል እርሱም የለም።

verses.text_english: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀ አደጎችህን ተው፥ እኔም በሕይወት አኖራቸዋለሁ፤ መበለቶችህም በእኔ ይታመኑ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and thou he shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ጽዋውን ያልተገባቸው ሰዎች ጠጥተውታል፤ አንተም ሳትቀጣ ትቀራለህን? በእርግጥ ትጠጣለህ እንጂ ያለ ቅጣት አትቀርም።

verses.text_english: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.text_amharic: ባሶራ መደነቂያና መሰደቢያ መረገሚያም እንድትሆን በራሴ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከተሞችዋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ባድማ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, , Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወሬ ሰምቻለሁ በአሕዛብም መካከል። ተሰብሰቡ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ኑ ለሰልፍም ተነሡ የሚል መልእክተኛ ተልኮአል።

verses.text_english: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, despised among men.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ የተጠቃህ፥ በሰዎችም ዘንድ የተናቅህ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለት ንቃቃት ውስጥ የምትቀመጥ፥ የተራራውን ከፍታ የምትይዝ ሆይ፥ ድፍረትህና የልብህ ኵራት አታልለውሃል። ቤትህን ምንም እንደ ንስር ከፍ ብታደርግ፥ ከዚያ አወርድሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስም መደነቂያ ትሆናለች፥ የሚያልፍባትም ሁሉ ይደነቃል፥ ስለ መጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጭባታል።

verses.text_english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዶምና ገሞራ በእነርሱም አጠገብ የነበሩት ከተሞች እንደ ተገለበጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ በዚያ ሰው አይቀመጥም የሰው ልጅም አይኖርባትም።

verses.text_english: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who a chosen I may appoint over her? for who like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በኤዶምያስ ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በቴማንም በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትንንሾች ይጐተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.text_amharic: ከመውደቃቸው ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ የጩኸታቸውም ድምፅ በኤርትራ ባሕር ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንደ ንስር ወጥቶ ይበራል ክንፉንም በባሶራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ በዚያም ቀን የኤዶምያስ ኃያላን ልብ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ልብ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ደማስቆ፤ ክፉ ወሬ ሰምተዋልና ሐማትና አርፋድ አፈሩ ቀለጡም፤ በባሕርም ላይ ኅዘን አለ፥ ታርፍም ዘንድ አትችልም።

verses.text_english: Damascus is waxed feeble, turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on : anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.text_amharic: ደማስቆ ደከመች ትሸሽም ዘንድ ዘወር አለች እንቅጥቅጥም ያዛት፥ እንደ ወላድም ሴት ጣርና ምጥ ያዛት።

verses.text_english: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.text_amharic: የተመሰገነችው ከተማ፥ የደስታዬ ከተማ፥ ሳትለቀቅ እንዴት ቀረች?

verses.text_english: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.text_amharic: በደማስቆም ቅጥር ላይ እሳት አነድዳለሁ የወልደ አዴርንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።

verses.text_english: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ስለ መታ ስለ ቄዳርና ስለ አሶር መንግሥታት፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ተነሡ ወደ ቄዳርም ውጡ፥ የምሥራቅንም ልጆች አጥፉ።

verses.text_english: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear on every side.
verses.text_amharic: ድንኳናቸውንና መንጋቸውን ይወስዳሉ፤ መጋረጆቻቸውንና ዕቃቸውን ሁሉ ግመሎቻቸውንም ለራሳቸው ይወስዳሉ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋትን ጥሩባቸው።

verses.text_english: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በአሶር የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ተማክሮባችኋልና፥ አሳብም አስቦባችኋልና ሽሹ ወደ ሩቅም ሂዱ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, dwell alone.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሡ፥ ዕርፊት ወዳለበት ተዘልሎም ወደ ተቀመጠው፥ ደጅና መወርወሪያ ወደሌለው ብቻውንም ወደ ተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ውጡ።

verses.text_english: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ግመሎቻቸው ይበዘበዛሉ የእንስሶቻቸውም ብዛት ይማረካል፤ ጠgWraቸውንም በዙሪያ የሚላጩትን ሰዎች ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከዳርቻቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋት አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor son of man dwell in it.
verses.text_amharic: አሶርም የቀበሮ መኖሪያና የዘላለም ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ በዚያም ሰው አይኖርም፥ የሰው ልጅም አይቀመጥባትም።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ስለ ኤላም ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ዋና የኃይላቸው መሣሪያ የሆነውን የኤላምን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.text_amharic: ከአራቱም ከሰማይ ማዕዘናት አራቱን ነፋሳት በኤላም ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ወደ እነዚያም ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከኤላም የተሰደዱ ሰዎች የማይደርሱበት ሕዝብ አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.text_amharic: በጠላቶቻቸውና ነፍሳቸውን በሚሹአት ፊት ኤላምን አስደነግጣለሁ፤ ክፉ ነገርን እርሱም ጽኑ ቍጣዬን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በኋላቸው ሰይፍ እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዙፋኔንም በኤላም አኖራለሁ ከዚያም ንጉሡንና አለቆቹን አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የኤላምን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ከለዳውያን ምድር ስለ ባቢሎን በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ መካከል ተናገሩ አውሩም፥ ዓላማውንም አንሡ፤ አውሩ፥ አትደብቁ። ባቢሎን ተወሰደች፥ ቤል አፈረ፥ ሜሮዳክ ደነገጠ፤ ምስሎችዋ አፈሩ፥ ጣዖታትዋ ደነገጡ በሉ።

verses.text_english: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ወጥቶባታል ምድርዋንም ባድማ ያደርጋል፥ የሚቀመጥባትም አይገኝም፤ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።

verses.text_english: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት በዚያም ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ሆነው ይመጣሉ፥ እያለቀሱም መንገዳቸውን ይሄዳሉ፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, , Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant shall not be forgotten.
verses.text_amharic: ፊታቸውንም ወደዚያ አቅንተው። ኑ፥ ከቶ በማይረሳ በዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተጠጉ ብለው ስለ ጽዮን መንገድ ይጠይቃሉ።

verses.text_english: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ የጠፉ በጎች ሆነዋል፤ እረኞቻቸው አሳቱአቸው፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የተቅበዘበዙ አደረጉአቸው፤ ከተራራ ወደ ኮረብታ አለፉ፥ በረታቸውንም ረሱ።

verses.text_english: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ያገኙአቸው ሁሉ በሉአቸው፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም። በጽድቅ ማደሪያ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ፥ በአባቶቻቸው ተስፋ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠሩ እኛ አልበደልንም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎን መካከል ሽሹ፥ ከከለዳውያንም ድር ውጡ፥ በመንጎችም ፊት እንደ አውራ ፍየሎች ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን ምድር የታላላቅ አሕዛብን ጉባኤ አስነሣለሁ በባቢሎንም ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በእርስዋም ላይ ይሰለፋሉ፥ ከዚያም ትወሰዳለች፤ ፍላጾቻቸውም ባዶውን እንደማይመለስ እንደ ብልህ ጀግና ፍላጻ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የከላውዴዎንም ምድር ትበዘበዛለች፥ የሚበዘብዙአትም ሁሉ ይጠግባሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.text_amharic: ርስቴን የምትበዘብዙ እናንተ ሆይ፥ ደስ ብሎአችኋልና፥ ሐሤትንም አድርጋችኋልና፥ በመስክ ላይም እንዳለች ጊደር ሆናችሁ ተቀናጥታችኋልና፥ እንደ ብርቱዎችም ፈረሶች አሽካክታችኋልና፥

verses.text_english: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.text_amharic: እናታችሁ እጅግ ታፍራለች፥ የወለደቻችሁም ትጐሰቍላለች፤ እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል ኋለኛይቱ ትሆናለች፤ ምድረ በዳና ደረቅ ምድር በረሀም ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ የተነሣ ባድማ ትሆናለች እንጂ ሰው አይቀመጥባትም፤ በባቢሎንም በኩል የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይደነቃል በመጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጫል።

verses.text_english: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ቀስትን የምትገትሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በባቢሎን ላይ በዙሪያዋ ተሰለፉ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርታለችና ወርውሩባት ፍላጾችንም አትንፈጉ።

verses.text_english: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ነውና በዙሪያዋ ጩኹባት፤ እጅዋን ሰጠች፤ ግንቦችዋ ወደቁ ቅጥሮችዋም ፈረሱ፤ እርስዋን ተበቀሉ እንደ ሠራችውም ሥሩባት።

verses.text_english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሪውንና በመከር ጊዜ ማጭድ የሚይዘውን ከባቢሎን አጥፉ፤ ከሚያስጨንቅ ሰይፍ ፊት እያንዳንዱ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል እያንዳንዱም ወደ አገሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.text_english: Israel a scattered sheep; the lions have driven away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል የባዘነ በግ ነው፤ አንበሶች አሳደዱት፤ መጀመሪያ የአሦር ንጉሥ በላው፥ በመጨረሻም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር አጥንቱን ቈረጠመው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦርን ንጉሥ እንደ ቀጣሁ እንዲሁ፥ እነሆ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥና ምድሩን እቀጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልንም ወደ ማሰማርያው እመልሳለሁ፥ በቀርሜሎስና በባሳንም ላይ ይሰማራል፥ ሰውነቱም በኤፍሬም ተራራና በገለዓድ ላይ ትጠግባለች።

verses.text_english: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን ያስቀረኋቸውን ይቅር እላቸዋለሁና በዚያን ወራት በዚያም ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል በደል የይሁዳም ኃጢአት ይፈለጋል ምንም አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: Go up against the land of Merathaim, against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.text_amharic: በምራታይም ምድር ላይ በፋቁድም በሚኖሩት ላይ ውጣ፤ ግደላቸው ፈጽመህም አጥፋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: A sound of battle in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.text_amharic: የሰልፍና የታላቅ ጥፋት ውካታ በምድር ላይ አለ።

verses.text_english: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
verses.text_amharic: የምድር ሁሉ መዶሻ እንዴት ደቀቀ እንዴትስ ተሰበረ! ባቢሎንስ በአሕዛብ መካከል እንዴት ባድማ ሆነች!

verses.text_english: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎን ሆይ፥ አጥምጄብሻለሁ አንቺም ሳታውቂ ተይዘሻል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስለ ተዋጋሽ ተገኝተሻል ተይዘሽማል።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በከለዳውያን ምድር ይሠራ ዘንድ ሥራ አለውና እግዚአብሔር ዕቃ ቤቱን ከፍቶ የቍጣውን ዕቃ ጦር አውጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.text_amharic: ከየበኩሉ በእርስዋ ላይ ውጡ፥ ጎተራዎችዋንም ክፈቱ፤ እንደ ክምርም አድርጓት ፈጽማችሁም አጥፉአት፥ አንዳችም አታስቀሩላት።

verses.text_english: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.text_amharic: ወይፈኖችዋን ሁሉ እረዱ፥ ወደ መታረድም ይውረዱ፤ ቀናቸው፥ የመጐብኘታቸው ጊዜ፥ ደርሶአልና ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን በቀል የመቅደሱንም በቀል በጽዮን ይነግሩ ዘንድ ሸሽተው ከባቢሎን አገር ያመለጡት ሰዎች ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስትን የሚገትሩትን ቀስተኞችን ሁሉ በባቢሎን ላይ ጥሩአቸው፤ በዙሪያዋ ስፈሩባት አንድም አያምልጥ፤ በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርታለችና እንደ ሥራዋ መጠን መልሱላት፥ እንዳደረገችም ሁሉ አድርጉባት።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞችዋ ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, I against thee, most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time I will visit thee.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኛው ሆይ፥ የመጐብኘትህ ጊዜ፥ ቀንህ ደርሶአልና እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕቢተኛው ተሰናክሎ ይወድቃል የሚያነሣውም የለም፤ በከተሞቹም ውስጥ እሳት አነድዳለሁ፥ በዙሪያውም ያለውን ሁሉ ትበላለች።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ተገፍተዋል፥ የማረኳቸውም ሁሉ በኃይል ይይዙአቸዋል፥ ይለቅቁአቸውም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል።

verses.text_english: Their Redeemer strong; the LORD of hosts his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ተቤዢአቸው ብርቱ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርንም ያሳርፍ ዘንድ በባቢሎንም የሚኖሩትን ያውክ ዘንድ ሙግታቸውን ፈጽም ይምዋገታል።

verses.text_english: A sword upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise .
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍ በከለዳውያንና በባቢሎን በሚኖሩ ላይ፥ በአለቆችዋና በጥበበኞችዋ ላይ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: A sword upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍ በሚጓደዱት ላይ አለ ሰነፎችም ይሆናሉ፥ ሰይፍም በኃያላኖችዋ ላይ አለ እነርሱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.text_english: A sword upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍ በፈረሶቻቸውና በሰረገሎቻቸው ላይ በመካከልዋም ባሉት በልዩ በልዩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ላይ አለ፥ እነርሱም እንደ ሴቶች ይሆናሉ፤ ሰይፍም በመዝገብዋ ላይ አለ ለብዝበዛም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: A drought upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it the land of graven images, and they are mad upon idols.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ምድር ናት፥ እነርሱም በጣዖታት ይመካሉና ድርቅ በውኆችዋ ላይ ይሆናል እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell , and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ከተኵላዎች ጋር ይቀመጡባታል፥ ሰጐኖችም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ሰውም ከዚያ ወዲያ ለዘላለም አይቀመጥባትም፥ እስከ ልጅ ልጅም ድረስ የሚኖርባት የለም።

verses.text_english: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour thereof, saith the LORD; shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዶምንና ገሞራን በአጠገባቸውም የነበሩትን ከተምች እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጣቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ ሰው በዚያ አይቀመጥም የሰውም ልጅ አይኖርባትም።

verses.text_english: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ይመጣል ታላቅ ሕዝብና ብዙ ነገሥታትም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው ምሕረትም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የባቢሎን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.text_english: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወሬአቸውን ሰምቶአል፥ እጁም ደክማለች፥ ጭንቀትም ይዞታል፥ ምጥ ወላድ ሴትን እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞታል።

verses.text_english: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who a chosen I may appoint over her? for who like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make habitation desolate with them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በከለዳውያንም ምድር ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትናንሾች ይጎተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎን መያዝ ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ ጩኸትም በአሕዛብ መካከል ዘንድ ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ላይና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ አጥፊውን ነፋስ አስነሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚያዘሩትን ሰዎች እሰድዳለሁ እነርሱም ያዘሩአታል፥ ምድርዋንም ባዶ ያደርጋሉ፤ በመከራም ቀን በዙሪያዋ ይከብቡአታል።

verses.text_english: Against bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.text_amharic: በወርዋሪው ላይ በጥሩርም በሚነሣው ላይ ቀስተኛው ቀስቱን ይገትር፤ ለጐበዛዝትዋ አትዘኑ ሠራዊትዋንም ሁሉ አጥፉ።

verses.text_english: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.
verses.text_amharic: በከለዳውያንም ምድር ተገድለው፥ በሜዳዋም ላይ ተወግተው ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For Israel not forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ምድራቸው በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በተሠራው በደል ምንም እንኳ የተሞላች ብትሆን፥ እስራኤልም ሆነ ይሁዳ በአምላኩ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አልተጣለም።

verses.text_english: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this the time of the LORD'S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎን ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ነፍሳችሁን አድኑ፤ በበደልዋ አትጥፉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ጊዜ ነውና፥ እርሱም ብድራትዋን ይከፍላታልና።

verses.text_english: Babylon a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎን በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ውስጥ ምድርን ሁሉ ያሰከረች የወርቅ ጽዋ ነበረች፥ አሕዛብም ከጠጅዋ ጠጥተዋል፤ ስለዚህ አሕዛብ አብደዋል።

verses.text_english: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎን በድንገት ወድቃ ጠፍታለች፤ አልቅሱላት፥ ትፈወስም እንደ ሆነ ለKWsልዋ መድኃኒት ውሰዱላት።

verses.text_english: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up to the skies.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎንን ፈወስናት፥ እርስዋ ግን አልተፈወሰችም፤ ፍርድዋ እስከ ሰማይ ደርሶአልና፥ እስከ ደመናም ድረስ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ትታችኋት እያንዳንዳችን ወደ አገራችን እንሂድ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችንን አውጥቶአል፤ ኑ፥ በጽዮን የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንናገር።

verses.text_english: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device against Babylon, to destroy it; because it the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.text_amharic: ፍላጾችን ሳሉ ጋሻዎችንም አዘጋጁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋት ዘንድ አሳቡ በባቢሎን ላይ ነውና የሜዶንን ነገሥታት መንፈስ አስነሥቶአል፤ የእግዚብሔር በቀል የመቅደሱ በቀል ነውና።

verses.text_english: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎን ቅጥር ዓላማውን አንሡበት፥ ጥበቃን አጽኑ፥ ተመልካቾችን አቁሙ፥ ድብቅ ጦር አዘጋጁ። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን በሚኖሩት ላይ የተናገረውን አስቦአልና፥ አድርጎአልምና።

verses.text_english: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, the measure of thy covetousness.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ በብዙ ውኃ አጠገብ የተቀመጥሽ፥ በመዝገብም የበለጠግሽ ሆይ፥ እንደ ስስትሽ መጠን ፍጻሜሽ ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, , Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ሲል በራሱ ምሎአል። በእውነት ሰዎችን እንደ አንበጣ እሞላብሻለሁ፥ እነርሱም ጩኸት ያነሡብሻል።

verses.text_english: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.text_amharic: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ፥ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: When he uttereth voice, a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.text_amharic: ድምጹን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይታወካሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናብም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፍስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: Every man is brutish by knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image falsehood, and no breath in them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።

verses.text_english: They vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.text_english: The portion of Jacob not like them; for he the former of all things: and the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts his name.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፥ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou my battle axe weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ መዶሻዬና የጦር መሣሪያዬ ነሽ፤ በአንቺ አሕዛብን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን እሰባብራለሁ፤

verses.text_english: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺም ሰረገላውንና በላዩ የሚቀመጠውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ወንድንና ሴትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ሽማግሌውንና ብላቴናውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ጐልማሳውንና ቆንጆይቱን እሰባብራለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺም እረኛውንና መንጋውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አራሹንና ጥማጁን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አለቆችንና ሹማምቶችን አሰባብራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን በዓይናችሁ ፊት ስለሠሩት ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በባቢሎንና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ፍዳቸውን እከፍላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, I against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ምድርን ሁሉ የምታጠፋ አጥፊ ተራራ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እጄንም እዘረጋብሃለሁ፥ ከድንጋዮችም ላይ አንከባልልሃለሁ፥ የተቃጠለም ተራራ አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንተም ለማዕዘንና ለመሠረት የሚሆን ድንጋይ አይወስዱም፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ ትሆናለህ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ዓላማን አንሡ በአሕዛብም መካከል መለከት ንፉ፥ አሕዛብንም አዘጋጁባት፤ የአራራትንና የሚኒን የአስከናዝንም መንግሥታት ሰብስቡባት አለቃንም በላይዋ አቁሙ፤ እንደ ጠgWraም ኩብኩባ ፈረሶችን በላይዋ አውጡ።

verses.text_english: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብን የሚዶንንም ነገሥታት አለቆችንም ሹማምቶችንም ሁሉ የግዛታቸውንም ምድር ሁሉ አዘጋጁባት።

verses.text_english: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት የባቢሎንን ምድር ባድማ ያደርጋት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አሳብ በባቢሎን ላይ ጸንቶአልና ምድር ተናወጣለች ታመመችም።

verses.text_english: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ኃያላን መዋጋትን ትተዋል በአምባዎቻቸውም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠፍቶአል እንደ ሴቶችም ሆነዋል፤ ማደሪያዎችዋም ነድደዋል መወርወሪያዎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።

verses.text_english: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at end,
And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አውድማ እንደ ተረገጠ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የባቢሎን ልጅ ናት፤ ጥቂት ቈይታ የመከር ጊዜ ይደርስባታል።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon like a threshingfloor, time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በላኝ፥ ከፋፈለኝም፥ እንደ ባዶ ዕቃም አደረገኝ፥ እንደ ዘንዶም ዋጠኝ፥ ከሚጣፍጠውም ምግቤ ሆዱን ሞላ፥ እኔንም ጣለኝ።

verses.text_english: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን የምትቀመጥ። በእኔና በሥጋዬ የተደረገ ግፍ በባቢሎን ላይ ይሁን ትላለች፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም። ደሜ በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ ይሁን ትላለች።

verses.text_english: The violence done to me and to my flesh upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እምዋገትልሻለሁ በቀልሽንም እበቀልልሻለሁ፤ ባሕርዋንም ድርቅ አደርገዋለሁ ምንጭዋንም አደርቀዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎንም የድንጋይ KWlልና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ መደነቂያም ማፍዋጫም ትሆናለች፥ የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድነትም እንደ አንበሶች ያገሣሉ፥ እንደ አንበሳም ደቦሎች ያጕረመርማሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
verses.text_amharic: በሞቃቸው ጊዜ ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው እንዳይነቁ የመጠጥ ግብዣ አደርግላቸዋለሁ አሰክራቸውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጠቦቶችና እንደ አውራ በጎች እንደ አውራ ፍየሎችም ወደ መታረድ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.text_amharic: ሼሻክ እንዴት ተያዘች! የምድርም ሁሉ ምስጋና እንዴት ተወሰደች! ባቢሎንም በአሕዛብ መካከል መደነቂያ እንዴት ሆነች!

verses.text_english: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.text_amharic: ባሕር በባቢሎን ላይ ወጣ በሞገዱም ብዛት ተከደነች።

verses.text_english: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞችዋ ባድማና ደረቅ ምድር ምድረ በዳም፥ ሰውም የማይቀመጥበት የሰውም ልጅ የማያልፍበት ምድር ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth son of man pass thereby.
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎንም ውስጥ ቤልን እቀጣለሁ የዋጠውንም ከአፉ አስተፋዋለሁ፤ አሕዛብም ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ እርሱ አይሰበሰቡም፥ የባቢሎንም ቅጥር ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ራሳችሁን አድኑ።

verses.text_english: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ከሚሰማ ወሬ የተነሣ አትፍሩ ልባችሁም የዛለ አይሁን፤ በአንድ ዓመት ወሬ ይመጣል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በሌላው ዓመት ወሬ፥ በምድርም ላይ ግፍ ይመጣል፥ አለቃም በአለቃ ላይ ይነሣል።

verses.text_english: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come year, and after that in year a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን የባቢሎን ምስሎች የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ምድርዋም ሁሉ ታፍራለች፤ ተወግተውም የሞቱት ሁሉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.text_amharic: አጥፊዎች ከሰሜን ይመጡባታልና ሰማይና ምድር በእነርሱም ያለው ሁሉ ስለ ባቢሎን እልል ይላሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎንም ከእስራኤል ተወግተው የሞቱት እንዲወድቁ እንዳደረገች፥ እንዲሁ በባቢሎን ከምድሩ ሁሉ ተወግተው የሞቱት ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: As Babylon the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰይፍ ያመለጣችሁ ሆይ፥ ሂዱ፥ አትቁሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከሩቅ አስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በልባችሁ አስቡ።

verses.text_english: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.text_amharic: ስድብን ስለ ሰማን አፍረናል፤ ባዕዳን ሰዎችም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ገብተዋልና ነውር ፊታችንን ከድኖታል።

verses.text_english: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD'S house.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችዋ የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር በምድርዋም ላይ ሁሉ የተወጉት ያንቋርራሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.text_amharic: ባቢሎን ምንም ወደ ሰማይ ብትወጣ፥ የኃይልዋንም ከፍታ ብታጸና፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ አጥፊዎች ይመጡባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎን ጩኸት፥ ከከለዳውያንም ምድር የታላቅ ጥፋት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: A sound of a cry from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ባቢሎንን አጥፍቶአታልና፥ ከእርስዋም ታላቁን ድምፅ ዝም አሰኝቶአልና፤ ሞገዳቸውም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምማል፥ የድምፃቸውም ጩኸት ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.text_amharic: አጥፊው በባቢሎን ላይ መጥቶባታልና፥ ኃያላኖችዋ ተያዙ፥ ቀስታቸውም ተሰባበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ፍዳን የሚከፍል አምላክ ነውና፥ ፍዳንም በእርግጥ ይከፍላል።

verses.text_english: Because the spoiler is come upon her, upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.text_amharic: መሳፍንቶችዋንና ጥበበኞችዋንም፥ አለቆችዋንና ሹማምቶችዋን ኃያላኖችዋንም አሰክራለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው አይነቁም፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተባለው ንጉሥ።

verses.text_english: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise , her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰፊው የባቢሎን ቅጥር ፈጽሞ ይፈርሳል ረጃጅሞችም በሮችዋ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፤ የወገኖችም ድካም ከንቱ ትሆናለች፥ የአሕዛብም ሥራ ለእሳት ትሆናለች፤ እነርሱም ይደክማሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.text_amharic: የመሕሤያ ልጅ የኔርያ ልጅ ሠራያ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን በሄደ ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘው ቃል ይህ ነው። ሠራያም የቤት አዛዥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And Seraiah a quiet prince.
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚመጣውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ስለ ባቢሎን የተጻፈውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ኤርምያስ በመጽሐፍ ላይ ጻፈው።

verses.text_english: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርምያስም ሠራያን እንዲህ አለው። ወደ ባቢሎን በገባህ ጊዜ እይ ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ አንብብና።

verses.text_english: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ እንድትሆን ታጠፋት ዘንድ በዚህች ስፍራ ላይ ተናግረሃል በል።

verses.text_english: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም መጽሐፍ ማንበብ ከፈጸምህ በኋላ፥ ድንጋይን እሰርበት በኤፍራጥስም ውስጥ ጣለው፤

verses.text_english: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.text_amharic: አንተም። እኔ ከማመጣባት ክፉ ነገር የተነሣ እንዲሁ ባቢሎን ትሰጥማለች አትነሣምም በል። የኤርምያስ ቃል እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Zedekiah one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዴቅያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም አሚጣል የተባለች የሊብና ሰው የኤርምያስ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮአቄምም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊቱም አውጥቶ እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ላይ ሆኖአልና፤ ሴዴቅያስም በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth of the month, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
verses.text_amharic: ሴዴቅያስም በነገሠ በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጥተው ከበቡአት በዙሪያዋም ዕርድ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም እስከ ንጉሡ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ድረስ ተከብባ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in the fourth month, in the ninth of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.text_amharic: በአራተኛውም ወር በዘጠነኛው ቀን በከተማይቱ ራብ ጸንቶ ነበር፥ ለአገሩም ሰዎች እንጀራ ታጣ።

verses.text_english: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም ተሰበረች፥ ሰልፈኞችም ሁሉ ሸሹ፥ በሁለቱም ቅጥር መካከል ባለው በር ወደ ንጉሡ አትክልት በሚወስደው መንገድ በሌሊት ከከተማይቱ ወጡ። ከለዳውያንም በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ነበሩ፤ በዓረባም መንገድ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.text_amharic: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ንጉሡን ተከታተሉት፥ በኢያሪኮም ሜዳ ሴዴቅያስን ያዙ፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተበትነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡንም ይዘው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለባት በሐማት ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሪብላ አመጡት፤ እርሱም ፍርድን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የሴዴቅያስን ልጆች በፊቱ ገደላቸው፥ የይሁዳንም አለቆች ሁሉ ደግሞ በሪብላ ገደላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.text_amharic: የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይኖች አወጣ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሰንሰለት አሰረው ወደ ባቢሎንም ወሰደው፥ እስኪሞትም ድረስ በግዞት ቤት አኖረው።

verses.text_english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth of the month, which the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
verses.text_amharic: በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በአሥራ ዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረናው ከን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ፊት የቆመው የዘበኞቹ አለካ ናቡዘረዳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.text_english: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great , burned he with fire:
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ ታላላቆችን ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጋር የነበረው የከለዳውያን ሠራዊት ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ሁሉ ዙሪያዋን አፈረሱ።

verses.text_english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
