verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን የሕዝቡን ድኆች፥ በከተማም ውስጥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፥ ሸሽተውም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ የተጠጉትን፥ የሕዝቡንም ቅሬታ አፈለሰ።

verses.text_english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአገሩ ድኆች ወይን ተካዮችና አራሾች እንዲሆኑ አስቀረ።

verses.text_english: Also the pillars of brass that in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.text_amharic: ከለዳውያንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበሩትን የናስ ዓምዶች በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የነበሩትን መቀመጫዎችና የናሱን ኵሬ ሰባበሩ፥ ናሱንም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.text_amharic: ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎችንም መኰስተሪያዎችንና ድስቶችን ጭልፋዎችንም የሚያገለግሉበትንም የናስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; which of gold gold, and which of silver silver, took the captain of the guard away.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጽዋዎቹንና ማንደጃዎቹን ድስቶቹንና ምንቸቶችን መቅረዞችንና ጭልፋዎቹን መንቀሎችንም፥ የወርቁን ዕቃ በወርቅ፥ የብሩንም ዕቃ በብር አድርጎ፥ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያሠራቸውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች፥ አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከመቀመጫዎቹም በታች የነበሩትን አሥራ ሁለቱን የናስ በሬዎች ወሰደ፤ ለእነዚህ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ናስ ሚዛን አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And the pillars, the height of one pillar eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof four fingers: hollow.
verses.text_amharic: ዓምዶቹም፥ የአንዱ ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የዙሪያውም መጠን አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውፍረቱም አራት ጣት ያህል ነበረ፥ ባዶም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And a chapiter of brass upon it; and the height of one chapiter five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates like unto these.
verses.text_amharic: የናሱም ጕልላት በላዩ ነበረ፤ የአንዱም ጉልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በጕልላቱም ላይ በዙሪያው ሁሉ ከናስ የተሠሩ መረበብና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት፤ በሁለተኛውም ዓምድ ደግሞ እንደዚህ ያለ ነገርና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት።

verses.text_english: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; all the pomegranates upon the network an hundred round about.
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ውጭም ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ። በመረበቡም ዙሪያ የነበሩ ሮማኖች ሁሉ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ታላቁን ካህን ሠራያን ሁለተኛውንም ካህን ሶፎንያስን ሦስቱንም በረኞች ወሰደ፤

verses.text_english: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማይቱም በሰልፈኞች ላይ ተሾመው ከነበሩት አንዱን ጀንደረባ፥ በከተማይቱም ከሚገኙት በንጉሡ ፊት ከሚቆሙት ሰባቱን ሰዎች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ የሚያሰልፈውን የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊ፥ በከተማይቱም ከተገኙት ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወስዶ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለበት ወደ ሪብላ አመጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ መታቸው፥ በሐማትም ምድር ባለችው በሪብላ ገደላቸው። እንዲሁ ይሁዳ ከአገሩ ተማረከ።

verses.text_english: This the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
verses.text_amharic: ናቡከደነፆር የማረከው ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ በሰባተኛው ዓመት ሦስት ሺህ ሀያ ሦስት አይሁድ፤

verses.text_english: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
verses.text_amharic: ናቡከደነፆርም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ስምንት መቶ ሠላሳ ሁለት ነፍስ ከኢየሩሳሌም ማርኮአል፤

verses.text_english: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons four thousand and six hundred.
verses.text_amharic: በናቡከደነፆር በሀያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአይሁድ ሰባት መቶ አርባ አምስት ነፍስ ማርኮአል፤ ሰዎች ሁሉ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ አምስተኛው ቀን፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴክ በነገሠ በአንደኛው ዓመት የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የዮአኪንን ራስ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ ከወህኒም አወጣው፤

verses.text_english: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that with him in Babylon,
verses.text_amharic: በመልካምም ተናገረው፥ ዙፋኑንም ከእርሱ ጋር በባቢሎን ከነበሩት ነገሥታት ዙፋን በላይ አደረገለት።

verses.text_english: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
verses.text_amharic: በወህኒም ውስጥ ለብሶት የነበረውን ልብስ ለወጠለት፥ ዮአኪንም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ በፊቴ ሁልጊዜ እንጀራ ይበላ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ እስኪሞት ድረስ የዘወትር ቀለብ ዕለት ዕለት ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: How doth the city sit solitary, full of people! is she become as a widow! she great among the nations, princess among the provinces, is she become tributary!
verses.text_amharic: አሌፍ። ሕዝብ ሞልቶባት የነበረች ከተማ ብቻዋን እንዴት ተቀመጠች! በአሕዛብ መካከል ታላቅ የነበረች እንደ መበለት ሆናለች፤ በአውራጆች መካከል ልዕልት የነበረች ተገዢ ሆናለች።

verses.text_english: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort : all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
verses.text_amharic: ቤት። በሌሊት እጅግ ታላቅሳለች፥ እንባዋም በጕንጭዋ ላይ አለ፤ ከውሽሞችዋ ሁሉ የሚያጽናናት የለም፤ ወዳጆችዋ ሁሉ ወነጀሉአት ጠላቶችም ሆኑአት።

verses.text_english: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሜል። ይሁዳ ስለ መጨነቅና ስለ ባርነት ብዛት ተማረከች፤ በአሕዛብ መካከል ተቀመጠች ዕረፍትም አላገኘችም፤ የሚያስጨንቁአት ሁሉ ተጨንቃ አገኙአት።

verses.text_english: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she in bitterness.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሌጥ። ወደ ዓመት በዓልም የሚመጣ የለምና የጽዮን መንገዶች አለቀሱ፤ በሮችዋ ሁሉ ፈርሰዋል ካህናቶችዋም እየጮኹ ያለቅሳሉ፤ ደናግሎችዋም ተጨነቁ እርስዋም በምሬት አለች።

verses.text_english: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
verses.text_amharic: ሄ። ስለ ኃጢአትዋ ብዛት እግዚአብሔር አስጨንቆአታልና አስጨናቂዎችዋ ራስ ሆኑ ጠላቶችዋም ተከናወነላቸው፤ ሕፃናቶችዋ በአስጨናቂዎች ፊት ተማርከዋል።

verses.text_english: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
verses.text_amharic: ዋው። ከጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ውበትዋ ሁሉ ወጥቶአል፤ አለቆችዋ ማሰማርያ እንደማያገኙ ዋላዎች ሆኑ፤ ከሚያባርሩአቸው ፊት ተዳክመው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, did mock at her sabbaths.
verses.text_amharic: ዛይ። ኢየሩሳሌም በጭንቀትዋና በመከራዋ ወራት ከጥንት ጀምሮ የነበረላትን የከበረን ነገር ሁሉ አሰበች፤ ሕዝብዋ በአስጨናቂዎች እጅ በወደቀ ጊዜ የሚረዳትም በሌላት ጊዜ፥ አስጨናቂዎች አዩአት በመፍረስዋም ሳቁ።

verses.text_english: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
verses.text_amharic: ሔት። ኢየሩሳሌም እጅግ ኃጢአት ሠርታለች፤ ስለዚህ ረክሳለች፤ ያከብሩአት የነበሩ ሁሉ ኀፍረተ ሥጋዋን አይተዋታልና አቃለሉአት፤ እርስዋም እየጮኸች ታለቅሳለች ወደ ኋላም ዘወር አለች።

verses.text_english: Her filthiness in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified .
verses.text_amharic: ጤት። አደፍዋ በልብስዋ ዘርፍ ነበረ፤ ፍጻሜዋን አላሰበችም፤ ስለዚህ በድንቅ ተዋርዳለች፥ የሚያጽናናትም የለም፤ አቤቱ፥ ጠላት ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና መከራዬን ተመልከት።

verses.text_english: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command they should not enter into thy congregation.
verses.text_amharic: ዮድ። አስጨናቂው በከበረ ነገርዋ ሁሉ ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤ ወደ ጉባኤህ እንዳይገቡ ያዘዝሃቸው አሕዛብ ወደ መቅደስዋ ሲገቡ አይታለችና።

verses.text_english: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
verses.text_amharic: ካፍ። ሕዝብዋ ሁሉ እየጮኹ ያለቅሳሉ እንጀራም ይፈልጋሉ፤ ሰውነታቸውን ለማበርታት የከበረ ሀብታቸውን ስለ መብል ሰጥተዋል፤ አቤቱ፥ ተጐሳቍያለሁና እይ፥ ተመልከትም።

verses.text_english: nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.text_amharic: ላሜድ። እናንተ መንገድ አላፊዎች ሁሉ፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ ምንም የለምን? እግዚአብሔር በጽኑ ቍጣው ቀን እኔን እንዳስጨነቀበት በእኔ ላይ እንደ ተደረገው እንደ እኔ መከራ የሚመስል መከራ እንዳለ ተመልከቱ፥ እዩ።

verses.text_english: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate faint all the day.
verses.text_amharic: ሜም። ከላይ እሳትን ወደ አጥንቴ ሰደደ በረታችበትም፤ ለእግሬ ወጥመድ ዘረጋ ወደ ኋላም መለሰኝ፥ አጠፋኝም ቀኑንም ሁሉ አደከመኝ።

verses.text_english: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into hands, I am not able to rise up.
verses.text_amharic: ኖን። የኃጢአቶቼ ቀንበር በእጁ ተይዛለች፤ ታስረው በአንገቴ ላይ ወጥተዋል፤ ጕልበቴን አደከመ። ጌታ በፊታቸው እቆም ዘንድ በማልችላቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, in a winepress.
verses.text_amharic: ሳምኬት። ጌታ ኃያላኖቼን ሁሉ ከውስጤ አስወገዳቸው፤ ጕልማሶቼን ያደቅቅ ዘንድ ጉባኤን ጠራብኝ፤ ጌታ ድንግሊቱን የይሁዳን ልጅ በመጥመቂያ እንደሚረገጥ አድርጎ ረገጣት።

verses.text_english: For these I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
verses.text_amharic: ዔ። የሚያጽናናኝ ነፍሴንም የሚያበረታት ከእኔ ርቆአልና ስለዚህ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ዓይኔ፥ ዓይኔ ውኃ ያፈስሳል። ጠላት በርትቶአልና ልጆቼ ጠፍተዋል።

verses.text_english: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, his adversaries round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
verses.text_amharic: ፌ። ጽዮን እጅዋን ዘረጋች፤ የሚያጽናናት የለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በያዕቆብ ዙሪያ ያሉትን እንዲያስጨንቁት አዘዘ፤ ኢየሩሳሌም በመካከላቸው እንደ ርኩስ ነገር ሆናለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
verses.text_amharic: ጻዴ። በአፉ ነገር ላይ ዓመፅ አድርጌአለሁና እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው። እናንተ አሕዛብ ሁሉ፥ እባካችሁ፥ ስሙ መከራዬንም ተመልከቱ፤ ደናግሎቼና ጐበዛዝቴ ተማርከው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: I called for my lovers, they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
verses.text_amharic: ቆፍ። ውሽሞቼን ጠራሁ እነርሱም አታለሉኝ፤ ካህናቶቼና ሽማግሌዎቼ ሰውነታቸውን ያበረቱ ዘንድ መብል ሲፈልጉ በከተማ ውስጥ ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: Behold, O LORD; for I in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home as death.
verses.text_amharic: ሬስ። አቤቱ፥ ተጨንቄአለሁና፥ አንጀቴም ታውኮብኛልና ተመልከት፤ ዓመፃን ፈጽሞ አድርጌአለሁና ልቤ በውስጤ ተገላበጠብኝ፤ በሜዳ ሰይፍ ልጆቼን አጠፋ በቤትም ሞት አለ።

verses.text_english: They have heard that I sigh: none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done : thou wilt bring the day thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ሳን። እኔ እየጮኽሁ እንደማለቅስ ሰምተዋል፤ የሚያጽናናኝ የለም፤ ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ስለ መከራዬ ሰምተዋል፤ አንተ አድርገኸዋልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ስለ እርሱ የተናገርኸውን ቀን ታመጣለህ እነርሱም እንደ እኔ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs many, and my heart faint.
verses.text_amharic: ታው። ልቅሶዬ እጅግ ነውና፥ ልቤም ደክሞአልና ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ወደ ፊትህ ይድረስ፥ ስለ ኃጢአቴ ሁሉ እንዳደረግህብኝ አድርግባቸው።

verses.text_english: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
verses.text_amharic: አሌፍ። ጌታ በቍጣው የጽዮንን ሴት ልጅ እንደ ምን አደመናት! የእስራኤልን ውበት ከሰማይ ወደ ምድር ጣለ፥ በቍጣውም ቀን የእግሩን መረገጫ አላሰበም።

verses.text_english: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ቤት። ጌታ የያዕቆብን ማደሪያዎች ሁሉ ዋጠ፥ አልራራምም፤ በመዓቱ የይሁዳን ሴት ልጅ አምቦች አፈረሰ፥ ወደ ምድርም አወረዳቸው፤ መንግሥቱንና አለቆችዋን አረከሰ።

verses.text_english: He hath cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, devoureth round about.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሜል። በጽኑ ቍጣው የእስራኤልን ቀንድ ሁሉ ቀጠቀጠ፤ ቀኝ እጁን ከጠላት ፊት ወደ ኋላ መለሰ፥ በዙሪያውም እንደሚባላ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ያዕቆብን አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሌጥ። ቀስቱን እንደ ጠላት ገተረ፥ እንደ አስጨናቂ ቀኝ እጁን አጸና፥ ለዓይንም የሚያምረውን ሁሉ ገደለ፤ በጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ድንኳን መዓቱን እንደ እሳት አፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
verses.text_amharic: ሄ። ጌታ እንደ ጠላት ሆነ፥ እስራኤልን ዋጠ፤ አዳራሾችዋን ሁሉ ዋጠ፥ አምቦችዋን አጠፋ፤ በይሁዳም ሴት ልጅ ኀዘንና ልቅሶ አበዛ።

verses.text_english: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
verses.text_amharic: ዋው። ማደሪያውን እንደ አትክልት ነቀለ፤ የበዓሉን ስፍራ አጠፋ፤ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ዓመት በዓሉንና ሰንበቱን አስረሳ፥ በቍጣውም መዓት ንጉሡንና ካህኑን አቃለለ።

verses.text_english: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
verses.text_amharic: ዛይ። ጌታ መሠዊያውን ጣለ፥ መቅደሱን ጠላ፥ የአዳራሾችዋንም ቅጥር በጠላት እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠ፤ ድምፃቸውን እንደ ዓመት በዓል ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
verses.text_amharic: ሔት። እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ሴት ልጅ ቅጥር ያፈርስ ዘንድ አሰበ፤ የመለኪያውን ገመድ ዘረጋ፥ እጁን ከማጥፋት አልመለሰም፤ ምሽጉና ቅጥሩ እንዲያለቅሱ አደረገ፤ በአንድነት ደከሙ።

verses.text_english: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes among the Gentiles: the law no ; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ጤት። በሮችዋ በመሬት ውስጥ ሰጠሙ፥ መወርወሪያዎችዋን አጠፋ ሰበረም፤ ንጉሥዋና አለቆችዋ ሕግ በሌለባቸው በአሕዛብ መካከል አሉ፤ ነቢያቶቻዋም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ራእይ አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ዮድ። የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ሽማግሌዎች ዝም ብለው በመሬት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ትቢያን በራሳቸው ላይ ነሰነሱ፥ ማቅም ታጠቁ፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ደናግል ራሳቸውን ወደ ምድር አዘነበሉ።

verses.text_english: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ካፍ። ሕፃኑና ጡት የሚጠባው በከተማይቱ ጐዳና ላይ ሲዝሉ፥ ዓይኔ በእንባ ደከመች፥ አንጀቴም ታወከ፤ ስለ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ቅጥቃጤ ጉበቴ በምድር ላይ ተዘረገፈ።

verses.text_english: They say to their mothers, Where corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
verses.text_amharic: ላሜድ። በከተማ ጐዳና እንደ ተወጋ ሰው በዛሉ ጊዜ፥ ነፍሳቸውም በእናቶቻቸው ብብት በወጣች ጊዜ፥ እናቶቻቸውን። እህልና የወይን ጠጅ ወዴት አለ? ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach great like the sea: who can heal thee?
verses.text_amharic: ሜም። የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምን እመሰክርልሻለሁ? በምንስ እመስልሻለሁ? ድንግሊቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ አጽናናሽ ዘንድ በምን አስተካክልሻለሁ? ስብራትሽ እንደ ባሕር ታላቅ ነውና፤ የሚፈውስሽ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
verses.text_amharic: ኖን። ነቢያቶችሽ ከንቱና ሐሰተኛ ራእይ አይተውልሻል፤ ምርኮሽንም ይመልሱ ዘንድ በደልሽን አልገለጡም፤ ከንቱና የማይረባ ነገርንም አይተውልሻል።

verses.text_english: All that pass by clap hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, this the city that call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
verses.text_amharic: ሳምኬት። መንገድ አላፊዎች ሁሉ እጃቸውን ያጨበጭቡብሻልና። በውኑ የውበት ፍጻሜና የምድር ሁሉ ደስታ የሚሉአት ከተማ ይህች ናትን? እያሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ልጅ ላይ ያፍዋጫሉ፥ ራሳቸውንም ያነቃንቃሉ።

verses.text_english: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed up: certainly this the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen .
verses.text_amharic: ዔ። ጠላቶችሽ ሁሉ አፋቸውን አላቀቁብሽ፤ እያፍዋጩና ጥርሳቸውን እያፋጩ። ውጠናታል፤ ነገር ግን ተስፋ ያደረግናት ቀን ይህች ናት፤ አግኝተናታል አይተናትማል ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath done which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
verses.text_amharic: ፌ። እግዚአብሔር ያሰበውን አደረገ፤ በቀድሞ ዘመን ያዘዘውን ቃል ፈጸመ፤ አፈረሰ አልራራምም፤ ጠላትንም ደስ አሰኘብሽ፥ የሚያስጨንቁሽንም ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
verses.text_amharic: ጻዴ። ልባቸው ወደ ጌታ ጮኸ። የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ቅጥር ሆይ፥ እንባሽን እንደ ፈሳሽ ቀንና ሌሊት አፍስሺ፤ ለሰውነትሽ ዕረፍት አትስጪ፤ የዓይንሽ ብሌን አታቋርጥ።

verses.text_english: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
verses.text_amharic: ቆፍ። ተነሺ፥ በሌሊት በመጀመሪያ ክፍል ጩኺ፥ በጌታም ፊት ልብሽን እንደ ውኃ አፍስሺ፤ በጐዳና ሁሉ ራስ ላይ በራብ ስለ ደከሙ ስለ ሕፃናትሽ ነፍስ እጆችሽን ወደ እርሱ አንሺ።

verses.text_english: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
verses.text_amharic: ሬስ። አቤቱ፥ እይ፤ በማን ላይ እንደዚህ እንዳደረግህ ተመልከት። በውኑ ሴቶች ፍሬያቸውን፥ ያቀማጠሉአቸውን ሕፃናት፥ ይበላሉን? በውኑ ካህኑና ነቢዩ በጌታ መቅደስ ውስጥ ይገደላሉን?

verses.text_english: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, not pitied.
verses.text_amharic: ሳን። ብላቴናውና ሽማግሌው በመንገዶች ላይ ተጋደሙ፤ ደናግሎቼና ጐበዛዝቴ በሰይፍ ወድቀዋል፤ በቍጣህ ቀን ገደልሃቸው፤ ሳትራራ አረድሃቸው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD'S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
verses.text_amharic: ታው። እንደ በዓል ቀን የሚያስፈሩኝን ከዙሪያዬ ጠራህ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ቀንም ያመለጠ ወይም የቀረ አልተገኘም፤ ያቀማጠልኋቸውንና ያሳደግኋቸውን ጠላቴ በላቸው።

verses.text_english: I the man hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.text_amharic: አሌፍ። በቍጣው በትር መከራ ያየ ሰው እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath led me, and brought darkness, but not light.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃን ወደ ሌለበት ወደ ጨለማ መርቶ ወሰደኝ።

verses.text_english: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand all the day.
verses.text_amharic: ዘወትር ቀኑን ሁሉ እጁን በላዬ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
verses.text_amharic: ቤት። ሥጋዬንና ቁርበቴን አስረጀ፥ አጥንቴን ሰበረ።

verses.text_english: He hath builded against me, and compassed with gall and travail.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥር ሠራብኝ በሐሞትና በድካምም ከበበኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath set me in dark places, as dead of old.
verses.text_amharic: ቀድሞ ሞተው እንደ ነበሩ በጨለማ አኖረኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሜል። እንዳልወጣ በዙሪያዬ ቅጥር ሠራብኝ፤ ሰንሰለቴን አከበደ።

verses.text_english: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
verses.text_amharic: በጠራሁና በጮኽሁ ጊዜ ጸሎቴን ከለከለ።

verses.text_english: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዴን በተጠረበ ድንጋይ ዘጋ፥ ጐዳናዬንም አጣመመ።

verses.text_english: He unto me a bear lying in wait, a lion in secret places.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሌጥ። እንደሚሸምቅ ድብ እንደ ተሸሸገም አንበሳ ሆነብኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
verses.text_amharic: መንገዴን ለወጠ፥ ገነጣጠለኝም፤ ባድማ አደረገኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.text_amharic: ቀስቱን ገተረ ለፍላጻውም እንደ ጊጤ አደረገኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.text_amharic: ሄ። የሰገባውን ፍላጻዎች በኵላሊቴ ውስጥ ተከለ።

verses.text_english: I was a derision to all my people; their song all the day.
verses.text_amharic: ለወገኔ ሁሉ ማላገጫ ቀኑንም ሁሉ መሳለቂያ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.text_amharic: ምሬት ሞላብኝ በእሬትም አጠገበኝ።

verses.text_english: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
verses.text_amharic: ዋው። ጥርሴን በጭንጫ ሰበረ፥ በአመድም ከደነኝ።

verses.text_english: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ከሰላም አራቅህ፤ በጎ ነገርን ረሳሁ።

verses.text_english: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ኃይሌ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ያለው ተስፋዬ ጠፋ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.text_amharic: ዛይ። መከራዬንና ችግሬን እሬትንና ሐሞትን አስብ።

verses.text_english: My soul hath still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ እያሰበችው በውስጤ ፈዘዘች።

verses.text_english: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችን በልቤ አኖራለሁ፥ ስለዚህ እታገሣለሁ።

verses.text_english: the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.text_amharic: ሔት። ያልጠፋነው ከእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት የተነሣ ነው፤ ርኅራኄው አያልቅምና።

verses.text_english: new every morning: great thy faithfulness.
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳ ማለዳ አዲስ ነው፤ ታማኝነትህ ብዙ ነው።

verses.text_english: The LORD my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ። እግዚአብሔር እድል ፈንታዬ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ተስፋ አደርገዋለሁ አለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD good unto them that wait for him, to the soul seeketh him.
verses.text_amharic: ጤት። እግዚአብሔር በተስፋ ለሚጠብቁት ለምትሻውም ነፍስ መልካም ነው።

verses.text_english: good that should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ዝም ብሎ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ተስፋ ቢያደርግ መልካም ነው።

verses.text_english: good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በታናሽነቱ ቀንበር ቢሸከም መልካም ነው።

verses.text_english: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮድ። እርሱ አሸክሞታልና ዝም ብሎ ለብቻው ይቀመጥ።

verses.text_english: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋ የሆነው እንደ ሆነ አፉን በአፈር ውስጥ ያኑር።

verses.text_english: He giveth cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.text_amharic: ጕንጩን ለሚመታው ይስጥ፥ ስድብንም ይጥገብ።

verses.text_english: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
verses.text_amharic: ካፍ። ጌታ ለዘላለም አይጥልምና፤

verses.text_english: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.text_amharic: ቢያሳዝንም እንደ ምሕረቱ ብዛት ይራራልና፤

verses.text_english: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውን ልጆች ከልቡ አያስጨንቅም፥ አያሳዝንምም።

verses.text_english: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.text_amharic: ላሜድ። በምድር የተጋዙትን ሁሉ ከእግሩ በታች ይረግጣቸው ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
verses.text_amharic: የሰውን ፍርድ በልዑል ፊት ይመልስ ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውን ፍርድ ያጣምም ዘንድ ጌታ እሺ አይልም።

verses.text_english: Who he saith, and it cometh to pass, the Lord commandeth not?
verses.text_amharic: ሜም። ጌታ ያላዘዘውን የሚልና የሚፈጽም ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
verses.text_amharic: ከልዑል አፍ ክፉና መልካም ነገር አይወጣምን?

verses.text_english: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው ሰው የሚያጕረመርም፥ ሰው ስለ ኃጢአቱ ቅጣት የሚያጕረመርም ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ኖን። መንገዳችንን እንመርምርና እንፈትን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም እንመለስ።

verses.text_english: Let us lift up our heart with hands unto God in the heavens.
verses.text_amharic: ልባችንን ከእጃችን ጋር በሰማይ ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር እናንሣ።

verses.text_english: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
verses.text_amharic: በድለናል ዐምፀናልም፥ አንተም ይቅር አላልህም።

verses.text_english: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
verses.text_amharic: ሳምኬት። በቍጣ ከደንኸን አሳደድኸንም፤ ገደልኸን፥ አልራራህም።

verses.text_english: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that prayer should not pass through.
verses.text_amharic: ጸሎት እንዳያልፍ ራስህን በደመና ከደንህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast made us the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብ መካከል ጕድፍና ውዳቂ አደረግኸን።

verses.text_english: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.text_amharic: ዔ። ጠላቶቻችን ሁሉ አፋቸውን ኣላቀቁብን።

verses.text_english: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋጤና ቍጣ፥ ጥፋትና ቅጥቃጤ ሆነብን።

verses.text_english: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ቅጥቃጤ ዓይኔ የውኃ ፈሳሽ አፈሰሰች።

verses.text_english: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ከተማዬ ቈነጃጅት ሁሉ ዓይኔ ነፍሴን አሳዘነች።

verses.text_english: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.text_amharic: ጻዴ። በከንቱ ነገር ጠላቶች የሆኑኝ እንደ ወፍ ማደንን አደኑኝ።

verses.text_english: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወቴን በጕድጓድ አጠፉ፥ በላዬም ድንጋይ ጣሉ።

verses.text_english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.text_amharic: በራሴ ላይ ውኆች ተከነበሉ፤ እኔም። ጠፋሁ ብዬ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Waters flowed over mine head; I said, I am cut off.
verses.text_amharic: ቆፍ። አቤቱ፥ በጠለቀ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ ሆኜ ስምህን ጠራሁ።

verses.text_english: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
verses.text_amharic: ድምፄን ሰማህ፤ ጆሮህን ከልመናዬ አትመልስ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.text_amharic: በጠራሁህ ቀን ቀርበህ። አትፍራ አልህ።

verses.text_english: Thou drewest near in the day I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verses.text_amharic: ሬስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ስለ ነፍሴ ተምዋግተህ ሕይወቴን ተቤዠህ።

verses.text_english: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ጭንቀቴን አይተሃል፥ ፍርዴን ፍረድልኝ።

verses.text_english: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
verses.text_amharic: በቀላቸውን ሁሉና በእኔ ላይ ያለውን አሳባቸውን ሁሉ አየህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast seen all their vengeance all their imaginations against me.
verses.text_amharic: ሳን። አቤቱ፥ ስድባቸውንና በእኔ ላይ ያለውን አሳባቸውን ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, all their imaginations against me;
verses.text_amharic: የተነሡብኝን ሰዎች ከንፈሮች ቀኑንም ሁሉ ያሰቡብኝን አሳባቸውን ሰማህ።

verses.text_english: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.text_amharic: መቀመጣቸውንና መነሣታቸውን ተመልከት፤ እኔ መሳለቂያቸው ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I their musick.
verses.text_amharic: ታው። አቤቱ፥ እንደ እጃቸው ሥራ ፍዳቸውን ትከፍላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
verses.text_amharic: የልብ ዕውርነትንና እርግማንህን ትሰጣቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣ ታሳድዳቸዋለህ ከሰማይም በታች ታጠፋቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: How is the gold become dim! is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
verses.text_amharic: አሌፍ። ወርቁ እንዴት ደበሰ! ጥሩው ወርቅ እንዴት ተለወጠ! የመቅደሱ ድንጋዮች በጐዳና ሁሉ ራስ ተበተኑ።

verses.text_english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.text_amharic: ቤት። ጥሩ ወርቅ የሚመስሉ የከበሩ የጽዮን ልጆች፥ የሸክላ ሠሪ እጅ እንደ ሠራው እንደ ሸክላ ዕቃ እንዴት ተቈጠሩ!

verses.text_english: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ጋሜል። ቀበሮች እንኳ ጡቶታቸውን ገልጠው ግልገሎቻቸውን አጠቡ፤ የወገኔ ልጅ ግን እንደ ምድረ በዳ ሰጐን ጨካኝ ሆነች።

verses.text_english: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, no man breaketh unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሌጥ። ጡት የሚጠባው የሕፃን ምላስ ከጥም የተነሣ ወደ ትናጋው ተጣበቀ፤ ሕፃናት እንጀራ ለመኑ፥ የሚቈርስላቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.text_amharic: ሄ። የጣፈጠ ነገር ይበሉ የነበሩ በመንገድ ጠፉ፤ በቀይ ግምጃ ያድጉ የነበሩ የፍግ ክምር አቀፉ።

verses.text_english: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
verses.text_amharic: ዋው። የማንም እጅ ሳይወድቅባት ድንገት ከተገለበጠች ከሰዶም ኃጢአት ይልቅ የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ኃጢአት በዛች።

verses.text_english: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing of sapphire:
verses.text_amharic: ዛይ። አለቆችዋ ከበረዶ ይልቅ ጥሩ፥ ከወተት ይልቅ ነጭ ነበሩ፤ ገላቸው ከቀይ ዕንቍ ይልቅ ቀይ ነበረ፥ መልካቸውም እንደ ሰንፔር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.text_amharic: ሔት። ፊታቸው ከጥቀርሻ ይልቅ ጠቍሮአል፥ በመንገድም አልታወቁም፤ ቁርበታቸው ወደ አጥንታቸው ተጣብቆአል፤ ደርቆአል፤ እንደ እንጨት ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: slain with the sword are better than slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for the fruits of the field.
verses.text_amharic: ጤት። በሰይፍ የሞቱ በራብ ከሞቱት ይሻላሉ፤ እነዚህ የምድርን ፍሬ አጥተው ተወግተውም ቀጥነዋል።

verses.text_english: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.text_amharic: ዮድ። የርኅሩኆች ሴቶች እጆች ልጆቻችውን ቀቅለዋል፤ የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ በመቀጥቀጥዋ መብል ሆኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ካፍ። እግዚአብሔር መዓቱን ፈጽሞአል፥ ጽኑ ቍጣውን አፍስሶአል፤ እሳትን በጽዮን ውስጥ አቃጠለ፥ መሠረትዋንም በላች።

verses.text_english: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ላሜድ። የምድር ነገሥታት በዓለምም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ አስጨናቂና ጠላት በኢየሩሳሌም በር እንዲገባ አላመኑም።

verses.text_english: For the sins of her prophets, the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
verses.text_amharic: ሜም። የጻድቃንን ደም በውስጥዋ ስላፈሰሱ ስለ ነቢያቶችዋ ኃጢአትና ስለ ካህናቶች በደል ነው።

verses.text_english: They have wandered blind in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
verses.text_amharic: ኖን። ታውረው በመንገድ ላይ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ ልብሳቸው እንዳይዳሰስ በደም ረክሰዋል።

verses.text_english: They cried unto them, Depart ye; unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn .
verses.text_amharic: ሳምኬት። እናንተ ርኩሳን፥ ራቁ፥ ርቃችሁም ሂዱ፥ አትንኩ ብለው ጮኹባቸው። በሸሹና በተቅበዘበዙ ጊዜ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል። በዚህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይኖሩም ተባለ።

verses.text_english: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
verses.text_amharic: ዔ። የእግዚአብሔር ፊት በተናቸው እርሱም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለከታቸውም፤ የካህናቱን ፊት አላፈሩም፥ ሽማግሌዎቹንም አላከበሩም።

verses.text_english: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation could not save .
verses.text_amharic: ፌ። ዓይናችን ወደ ከንቱ ረዳታችን ገና ሲመለከት ጠፍቶአል፤ በመቆየታችን ማዳን የማይቻለውን ሕዝብ ጠብቀናል።

verses.text_english: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.text_amharic: ጻዴ። በአደባባያችን እንዳንሄድ ፍለጋችንን ተከተሉ፤ ፍጻሜያችን ቀርቦአል፥ ዕድሜያችን አልቆአል፥ ፍጻሜያችን ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ቆፍ። አሳዳጆቻችን ከሰማይ ንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ሆኑ፤ በተራሮች ላይ አሳደዱን፥ በምድረ በዳ ሸመቁብን።

verses.text_english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
verses.text_amharic: ሬስ። ስለ እርሱ። በአሕዛብ መካከል በጥላው በሕይወት እንኖራለን ያልነው በእግዚአብሔር የተቀባ፥ የሕይወታችን እስትንፋስ፥ በጕድጓዳቸው ተያዘ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
verses.text_amharic: ሳን። በዖፅ ምድር የምትኖሪ የኤዶምያስ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ ሐሤትም አድርጊ፤ ጽዋው ደግሞ ወደ አንቺ ያልፋል፥ አንቺም ትሰክሪአለሽ ትራቈቻለሽም።

verses.text_english: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
verses.text_amharic: ታው። የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ የበደልሽ ቅጣት ተፈጸመ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያስማርክሽም። የኤዶምያስ ልጅ ሆይ፥ በደልሽን ይቀጣል፤ ኃጢአትሽን ይገልጣል።

verses.text_english: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ የሆነብንን አስብ፤ ተመልከት ስድባችንንም እይ።

verses.text_english: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.text_amharic: ርስታችን ለእንግዶች፥ ቤቶቻችን ለሌሎች ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers as widows.
verses.text_amharic: ድሀ አደጎችና አባት የሌለን ሆነናል፤ እናቶቻችን እንደ መበለቶች ሆነዋል።

verses.text_english: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃችንን በብር ጠጣን እንጨታችንን በዋጋ ገዛን።

verses.text_english: Our necks under persecution: we labour, have no rest.
verses.text_amharic: አሳዳጆቻችን በአንገታችን ላይ ናቸው፤ እኛ ደክመናል ዕረፍትም የለንም።

verses.text_english: We have given the hand the Egyptians, the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.text_amharic: ለግብጻውያንና ለአሦራውያን እንጀራ እንጠግብ ዘንድ እጅ ሰጠን።

verses.text_english: Our fathers have sinned, not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን ኃጢአትን ሠሩ ዛሬም የሉም፤ እኛም በደላቸውን ተሸከምን።

verses.text_english: Servants have ruled over us: none that doth deliver out of their hand.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች ሠልጥነውብናል፤ ከእጃቸው የሚታደገን የለም።

verses.text_english: We gat our bread with our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድረ በዳ ሰይፍ የተነሣ በሕይወታችን እንጀራችንን እናመጣለን።

verses.text_english: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚያቃጥል ከራብ ትኩሳት የተነሣ ቁርበታችን እንደ ምድጃ ጠቈረ።

verses.text_english: They ravished the women in Zion, the maids in the cities of Judah.
verses.text_amharic: በጽዮን ሴቶችን፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ደናግልን አጐሰቈሉ።

verses.text_english: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆች በእጃቸው ተሰቀሉ፤ የሽማግሌዎች ፊት አልታፈረም።

verses.text_english: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.text_amharic: ጕልማሶች ወፍጮን ተሸከሙ፥ ልጆችም ከእንጨት በታች ተሰናከሉ።

verses.text_english: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌዎች ከአደባባይ፥ ጕልማሶች ከበገናቸው ተሻሩ።

verses.text_english: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.text_amharic: የልባችን ደስታ ቀርቶአል፤ ዘፈናችን ወደ ልቅሶ ተለውጦአል።

verses.text_english: The crown is fallen our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.text_amharic: አክሊል ከራሳችን ወድቆአል፤ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና ወዮልን!

verses.text_english: For this our heart is faint; for these our eyes are dim.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ልባችን ታምሞአል፤ ስለዚህም ነገር ዓይናችን ፈዝዞአል፤

verses.text_english: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጽዮን ተራራ፥ ባድማ ሆናለችና፥ ቀበሮችም ተመላልሰውባታልና።

verses.text_english: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ለዘላለም ትኖራለህ፤ ዙፋንህ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, forsake us so long time?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን ለዘላለም ትረሳናለህ? ስለ ምንስ ለረጅም ዘመን ትተወናለህ?

verses.text_english: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ መልሰን እኛም እንመለሳለን፤ ዘመናችንን እንደ ቀድሞ አድስ።

verses.text_english: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ ጥለኸናል፤ እጅግ ተቈጥተኸናል።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth , in the fifth of the month, as I among the captives by the river of Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.text_amharic: በሠላሳኛው ዓመት በአራተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአምስተኛው ቀን በኮቦር ወንዝ በምርኮኞች መካከል ሳለሁ ሰማያት ተከፈቱ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ራእይ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: In the fifth of the month, which the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በአምስተኛው ዓመት

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ከወሩም በአምስተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በከለዳውያን አገር በኮቦር ወንዝ ወደ ቡዝ ልጅ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ ሕዝቅኤል መጣ። የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በዚያ በእኔ ላይ ሆነች፥

verses.text_english: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ከሰሜን በኩል ዐውሎ ነፋስና ታላቅ ደመና የሚበርቅም እሳት መጣ፥ በዙሪያውም ፀዳል ነበረ፥ በመካከልም በእሳቱ ውስጥ እንደሚብለጨለጭ የወርቅ ምስያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Also out of the midst thereof the likeness of four living creatures. And this their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
verses.text_amharic: ከመካከልም የአራት እንስሶች አምሳያ ወጣ። መልካቸውም እንደዚህ ነበረ፥ ሰውም ይመስሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያዳንዱም አራት አራት ፊት፥ ለእያንዳንዱም አራት አራት ክንፍ ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And their feet straight feet; and the sole of their feet like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቻቸውም ቀጥ ያሉ እግሮች ነበሩ፤ የእግራቸውም ኮቴ እንደ ጥጃ እግር ኮቴ ነበረ፤ እንደ ተወለወለ ናስም ይብለጨለጭ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
verses.text_amharic: በክንፎቻቸውም በታች በእያራቱ ጐድናቸው እንደ ሰው እጅ ነበረ፤ ለአራቱም እንደዚህ ያሉ ፊትና ክንፍ ነበሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Their wings joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.text_amharic: ክንፎቻቸው እርስ በእርሱ የተያያዘ ነበረ፤ ሲሄዱም አይገላመጡም ነበር፥ እያንዳንዱም ፊቱን አቅንቶ ይሄድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
verses.text_amharic: የፊታቸው አምሳያ እንደ ሰው ፊት ነበረ፥ ለአራቱም በስተ ቀኛቸው እንደ አንበሳ ፊት፥ በስተ ግራቸውም እንደ ላም ፊት ነበራቸው፥ ለአራቱም ደግሞ የንስር ፊት ነበራቸው።

verses.text_english: Thus their faces: and their wings stretched upward; two of every one joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.text_amharic: ክንፋቸውም በላይ ተዘርግቶ ነበር፥ የእያንዳንዱም ሁለት ሁለት ክንፋቸው የተያያዙ ነበሩ፥ ሁለት ሁለቱም ገላቸውን ይከድኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; they turned not when they went.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም ወደ ፊት ቀጥ ብሎ ይሄድ ነበር፤ መንፈስም ወደሚሄድበት ሁሉ ይሄዱ ነበር፥ ሲሄዱም አይገላመጡም ነበር።

verses.text_english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.text_amharic: በእንስሶቹ መካከል እንደሚነድድ የእሳት ፍም ያለ ምስያ ነበረ፤ በእንስሶች መካከል ወዲህና ወዲያ የሚሄድ እንደ ፋና ያለ ምስያ ነበረ፤ ለእሳቱም ፀዳል ነበረው፥ ከእሳቱም መብረቅ ይወጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶቹም እንደ መብረቅ ምስያ ይሮጡና ይመለሱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶችንም ስመለከት፥ እነሆ፥ በአራቱ እንስሶች አጠገብ በምድር ላይ አንድ አንድ መንኰራኵር አየሁ።

verses.text_english: The appearance of the wheels and their work like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.text_amharic: የመንኰራኵሩም መልክ እንደ ቢረሌ ነበረ፤ አራቱም አንድ አምሳያ ነበሩ፤ ሥራቸውም በመንኰራኵር ውስጥ እንዳለ መንኰራኵር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: When they went, they went upon their four sides: they turned not when they went.
verses.text_amharic: በእያራቱ ጐድናቸው ይሄዱ ነበር፤ ሲሄዱም አይገላመጡም ነበር።

verses.text_english: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings full of eyes round about them four.
verses.text_amharic: ቁመታቸውም የረዘመና የሚያስፈራ ነበረ፤ የአራቱም ክበብ ዙሪያው በዓይን ተሞልቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶቹም በሄዱ ጊዜ መንኰራኵሮቹ በአጠገባቸው ሄዱ። እንስሶቹም ከምድር ከፍ ከፍ ባሉ ጊዜ መንኰራኵሮቹ ከፍ ከፍ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature in the wheels.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈሱ ወደሚሄድበት ሁሉ እነርሱ ሄዱ፤ የእንስሶች መንፈስ በመንኰራኵሮቹ ውስጥ ነበረና መንኰራኵሮቹ በእነርሱ አጠገብ ከፍ ከፍ አሉ።

verses.text_english: When those went, went; and when those stood, stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature in the wheels.
verses.text_amharic: የእንስሶች መንፈስ በመንኰራኵሮቹ ውስጥ ነበረና እነዚያ ሲሄዱ እነዚህ ይሄዱ ነበር፤ እነዚያም ሲቆሙ እነዚህ ይቆሙ ነበር፤ እነዚያም ከምድር ከፍ ከፍ ሲሉ መንኰራኵሮቹ በአጠገባቸው ከፍ ከፍ ይሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንስሶች ራስ በላይ የሚያስፈራ በረዶ የሚመስል የጠፈር አምሳያ በራሳቸው ላይ ተዘርግቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And under the firmament their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠፈሩም በታች ክንፎቻቸው እርስ በርሳቸው ተቃንተው ነበር፤ ለእያንዳንዱም ገላውን የሚከድኑ ሁለት ሁለት ክንፎች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄዱም የክንፎቻቸው ድምፅ እንደ ብዙ ውኃ ድምፅ፥ እንደ ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክም ድምፅ፥ እንደ ታላቅም ሠራዊት ድምፅ ሆኖ ሰማሁ፤ ሲቆሙም ክንፎቻቸውን ዝቅ ያደርጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was a voice from the firmament that over their heads, when they stood, had let down their wings.
verses.text_amharic: በራሳቸውም ላይ ካለው ጠፈር በላይ ድምፅ ተሰማ፤ ሲቆሙም ክንፎቻቸውን ዝቅ ያደርጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And above the firmament that over their heads the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
verses.text_amharic: በራሳቸውም በላይ ካለው ጠፈር በላይ የሰንፔር ድንጋይ የሚመስል የዙፋን አምሳያ ነበረ፤ በዙፋኑም አምሳያ ላይ እንደ ሰው መልክ አምሳያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከወገቡም አምሳያ ወደ ላይ የሚብለጨለጭ የወርቅ ምስያ አየሁ፤ ከወገቡም አምሳያ ወደ ታች እንደ እሳት ምስያ አየሁ፤ በዙሪያውም ፀዳል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so the appearance of the brightness round about. This the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw , I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.text_amharic: በዝናብ ቀን በደመና ውስጥ እንደ ቀስተ ደመና አምሳያ፥ እንዲሁ በዙሪያው ያለ ፀዳል አምሳያ ነበረ። የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምሳሌ መልክ ይህ ነበረ። ባየሁም ጊዜ በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ፥ የሚናገርንም ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በእግርህ ቁም እኔም እናገርሃለሁ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.text_amharic: በተናገረኝም ጊዜ መንፈስ ገባብኝ በእግሬም አቆመኝ፥ የሚናገረኝንም ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, unto this very day.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በእኔ ላይ ወደ ዐመፁ ወደ ዓመፀኞች ሰዎች ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች እልክሃለሁ። እነርሱና አባቶቻቸው እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዐመፁብኝ።

verses.text_english: For impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ፊታቸው የተጨማተረ ልባቸውም የደነደነ ልጆች ናቸው። እኔ ወደ እነርሱ እልክሃለሁ፤ አንተም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል በላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና ቢሰሙ ወይም ባይሰሙ ነቢይ በመካከላቸው እንዳለ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they a rebellious house.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ኵርንችትና እሾህ ከአንተ ጋር ቢኖሩም፥ አንተም በጊንጦች መካከል ብትቀመጥም፥ አትፍራቸው፥ ቃላቸውንም አትፍራ፤ አንተ ቃላቸውን አትፍራ፥ ከፊታቸውም የተነሣ አትደንግጥ፤ እነርሱ ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they most rebellious.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና ቢሰሙ ወይም ባይሰሙ ቃሌን ትነግራቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የምነግርህን ስማ፤ እንደዚያ እንደ ዓመፀኛው ቤት ዓመፀኛ አትሁን፤ አፍህን ክፈት የምሰጥህንም ብላ።

verses.text_english: And when I looked, behold, an hand sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book therein;
verses.text_amharic: ባየሁም ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ እጅ ወደ እኔ ተዘርግታ ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ የመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ነበረባት።

verses.text_english: And he spread it before me; and it written within and without: and written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
verses.text_amharic: በፊቴም ዘረጋው፥ በውስጥና በውጭም ተጽፎበት ነበር፤ ልቅሶና ኀዘን ዋይታም ተጽፎበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ያገኘኸውን ብላ፤ ይህን መጽሐፍ ብላ፥ ሄደህም ለእስራኤል ቤት ተናገር አለኝ።

verses.text_english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
verses.text_amharic: አፌንም ከፈትሁ መጽሐፉንም አጐረሰኝ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ አፍህ ይብላ፥ በምሰጥህም በዚህ መጽሐፍ ሆድህን ሙላ አለኝ። እኔም በላሁት፥ በአፌም ውስጥ እንደ ማር ጣፈጠ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ተነሥተህ ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ሂድ፥ ቃሌንም ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: For thou not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, to the house of Israel;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እስራኤል ቤት እንጂ ንግግራቸው ወደ ጠለቀው ቋንቋቸውም ወደማይታወቅ ሕዝብ አልተላክህምና፤

verses.text_english: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ንግግራቸው ወደ ጠለቀው ቋንቋቸውም ወደማይታወቅ ቃላቸውንም ታውቅ ዘንድ ወደማይቻልህ ሕዝብ አልላክሁህም። ወደ እነዚያስ ልኬህ ቢሆን ኖሮ በሰሙህ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel impudent and hardhearted.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ የጠነከረ ግምባርና የደነደነ ልብ አላቸውና፥ እኔንም መስማት እንቢ ብለዋልና የእስራኤል ቤት አንተን አይሰሙም።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ፊትህን በፊታቸው ግምባርህንም በግምባራቸው አጠንክሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they a rebellious house.
verses.text_amharic: ከቡላድ ድንጋይ ይልቅ እንዳለ አልማዝ ግምባርህን አጠንክሬአለሁ፤ እነርሱ ዓመፀኛ ቤት ቢሆኑ አትፍራቸው፤ ከፊታቸውም የተነሣ አትደንግጥ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የነገርሁህን ቃሌን ሁሉ በልብህ ተቀበል በጆሮህም ስማ።

verses.text_english: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥተህም ወደ ተማረኩ ወደ ወገንህ ልጆች ሂድ፤ እነርሱም ቢሰሙ ወይም ባይሰሙ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ንገራቸው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, , Blessed the glory of the LORD from his place.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስም አነሣኝ፥ በኋላዬም። የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ከቦታው ይባረክ የሚል የጽኑ ንውጥውጥታ ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
verses.text_amharic: የአራቱም እንስሳ ክንፎች እርስ በርሳቸው ሲማቱ፥ በአጠገባቸውም የመንኰራኵሮችን ድምፅ፥ የጽኑውንም ንውጥውጥታ ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስ አንሥቶ አስወገደኝ፥ እኔም በምሬትና በመንፈሴ ሙቀት ሄድሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በላዬ በርትታ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.text_amharic: በቴልአቢብም ወዳሉ በኮቦርም ወንዝ አጠገብ ወደ ተቀመጡ ምርኮኞች መጣሁ፥ በተቀመጡበትም ቦታ ተቀመጥሁ፤ በዚያም ሰባት ቀን በድንጋጤ በመካከላቸው ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከሰባቱም ቀን በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለእስራኤል ቤት ጠባቂ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ ስለዚህ የአፌን ቃል ስማ ከእኔም ዘንድ አስጠንቅቃቸው።

verses.text_english: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ኃጢአተኛውን። በእርግጥ ትሞታለህ ባልሁት ጊዜ፥ አንተም ባታስጠነቅቀው ነፍሱም እንድትድን ከክፉ መንገዱ ይመለስ ዘንድ ለኃጢአተኛው አስጠንቅቀህ ባትነግረው፥ ያ ኃጢአተኛ በኃጢአት ይሞታል፤ ደሙን ግን ከእጅህ እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንተ ኃጢአተኛውን ብታስጠነቅቅ እርሱም ከኃጢአቱና ከክፉ መንገዱ ባይመለስ፥ በኃጢአቱ ይሞታል፥ አንተ ግን ነፍስህን አድነሃል።

verses.text_english: Again, When a righteous doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ጻድቁ ከጽድቁ ተመልሶ ኃጢአት በሠራ ጊዜ እኔ በፊቱም ዕንቅፋትን ሳደርግ፥ እርሱ ይሞታል፤ አንተም አላስጠነቀቅኸውምና በኃጢአቱ ይሞታል ያደረጋትም ጽድቅ ነገር አትታሰብለትም፤ ደሙን ግን ከእጅህ እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous , that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ኃጢአት እንዳይሠራ ጻድቁን ብታስጠነቅቅ እርሱም ኃጢአት ባይሠራ፥ ተጠንቅቆአልና በእርግጥ በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ አንተም ነፍስህን አድነሃል።

verses.text_english: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በእኔ ላይ ነበረች፥ እርሱም። ተነሥተህ ወደ ቈላው ሂድ በዚያም እናገርሃለሁ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ተነሥቼ ወደ ቈላው ሄድሁ፤ እነሆም፥ በኮቦር ወንዝ እንዳየሁት ክብር ያለ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በዚያ ቆሞ ነበር፥ በግምባሬም ተደፋሁ።

verses.text_english: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስም ገባብኝ በእግሬም አቆመኝ፥ ተናገረኝም እንዲህም አለኝ። ሂድ፥ ገብተህ ቤትህን ዝጋ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
verses.text_amharic: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ገመድ ያደርጉብሃል ያስሩህማል፥ አንተም በመካከላቸው አትወጣም፤

verses.text_english: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they a rebellious house.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ምላስህን ከትናጋህ ጋር አጣብቃታለሁ አንተም ዲዳ ትሆናለህ፥ እነርሱም ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና የሚዘልፍ ሰው አትሆንባቸውም።

verses.text_english: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they a rebellious house.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በተናገርሁህ ጊዜ አፍህን እከፍታለሁ፥ እነርሱም ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና አንተ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሚሰማ ይስማ፥ የማይሰማም አይስማ ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, Jerusalem:
verses.text_amharic: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጡብን ወስደህ በፊትህ አኑራት የኢየሩሳሌምንም ከተማ ስዕል ሳልባት ክበባት፥

verses.text_english: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set rams against it round about.
verses.text_amharic: ምሽግም ሥራባት፥ አፈርም ደልድልባት፥ ሰፈርም አቁምባት፥ በዙሪያዋም የሚያፈርስ ግንድ አድርግባት።

verses.text_english: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የብረት ምጣድም ወስደህ በአንተና በከተማይቱ መካከል ለብረት ቅጥር አድርገው፥ ፊትህንም ወደ እርስዋ አቅና፥ የተከበበችም ትሆናለች አንተም ትከብባታለህ። ይህም ለእስራኤል ቤት ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በግራ ጐድንህ ተኛ የእስራኤልንም ቤት ኃጢአት አኑርባት፤ በምትተኛበትም ቀን ቍጥር ኃጢአታቸውን ትሸከማለህ።

verses.text_english: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም የኃጢአታቸውን ዓመታት ለአንተ የቀን ቍጥር እንዲሆንልህ ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ቀን ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ የእስራኤልንም ቤት ኃጢአት ትሸከማለህ።

verses.text_english: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም በፈጸምህ ጊዜ በቀኝ ጐድንህ ትተኛለህ፥ የይሁዳንም ቤት ኃጢአት ትሸከማለህ፤ አንድን ዓመት አንድ ቀን አድርጌ አርባ ቀን ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
verses.text_amharic: ክንድህን ዕራቁቱን አድርገህ ፊትህን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ክቡ ታቀናለህ፥ ትንቢትም ትናገርባታለህ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ገመድ አደርግብሃለሁ፥ የምትከበብበትንም ወራት እስክትፈጽም ድረስ ከጐድን ጐድንህ አትገላበጥም።

verses.text_english: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ስንዴንና ገብስን ባቄላንና ምስርን ጤፍንና አጃን ወደ አንተ ውሰድ፥ በአንድ ዕቃም ውስጥ አድርገህ እንጀራ ጋግር፤ በጐድንህ እንደ ተኛህበት ቀን ቍጥር ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ቀን ትበላዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thy meat which thou shalt eat by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
verses.text_amharic: የምትበላውም በሚዛን በየቀኑ ሀያ ሀያ ሰቅል ይሁን፥ በየጊዜው ትበላዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃውንም በልክ የኢን መስፈሪያ ከስድስት እጅ አንድን እጅ ትጠጣለህ፥ በየጊዜው ትጠጣዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt eat it barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ገብስ እንጐቻም አድርገህ ትበላዋለህ፥ ከሰውም በሚወጣ ፋንድያ በፊታቸው ትጋግረዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች እነርሱን በምበትንባቸው በአሕዛብ መካከል ርኩስ እንጀራቸውን ይበላሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እነሆ፥ ሰውነቴ አልረከሰችም፤ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ጥንብና አውሬ የሰበረውን ከቶ አልበላሁም፥ ርኩስም ሥጋ በአፌ ውስጥ አልገባም አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እነሆ፥ በሰው ፋንድያ ፋንታ ኩበት ሰጥቼሃለሁ በእርሱም እንጀራህን ትጋግራለህ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን እንጀራ በትር እሰብራለሁ፥ እየፈሩም እንጀራን በሚዛን ይበላሉ፥ እየደነገጡም ውኃን በልክ ይጠጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም እንጀራንና ውኃን እንዲያጡ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም እንዲደነቁ፥ በኃጢአታቸውም እንዲሰለስሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the .
verses.text_amharic: አንተም፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የተሳለን ጐራዴ ውሰድ፥ እንደ ጢም መላጫ ወደ አንተ ትወስደዋለህ፥ ራስህንና ጢምህንም ትላጭበታለህ፤ ሚዛንንም ውሰድ ጠጕሩንም ትከፋፍላለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.text_amharic: የመከበብም ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ በከተማይቱ መካከል ሢሶውን በእሳት ታቃጥላለህ፤ ሢሶውንም ወስደህ ዙሪያውን በጐራዴ ትመታለህ፥ ሢሶውንም ወደ ነፋስ ትበትናለህ እኔም በኋላቸው ጐራዴ እመዝዛለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በጥቂቱ ውሰድ በመጐናጸፊያህም ጫፍ ቋጥራቸው።

verses.text_english: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ደግሞ ወስደህ በእሳት ውስጥ ትጥላለህ በእሳትም ታቃጥላቸዋለህ፤ ከዚያም በእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ላይ እሳት ትወጣለች።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries round about her.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህች ኢየሩሳሌም ናት፤ በአሕዛብም መካከል አድርጌአታለሁ፥ አገሮችም በዙሪያዋ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ከአሕዛብ ይልቅ ፍርዴን በኃጢአት ለወጠች በዙሪያዋም ካሉ አገሮች ሁሉ ይልቅ ትእዛዜን ተላለፈች፤ ፍርዴን ጥለዋልና፥ በትእዛዜም አልሄዱምና።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that round about you, have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that round about you;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዙሪያችሁ ላሉት አሕዛብ ሰበብ ሆናችኋልና፥ በትእዛዜም አልሄዳችሁምና፥ ፍርዴንም አልጠበቃችሁምና፥ በዙሪያችሁም እንዳሉ እንደ አሕዛብ ፍርድ እንኳ አላደረጋችሁምና

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እኔ ራሴ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፥ አሕዛብም እያዩ ፍርድን በመካከልሽ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ርኵሰትሽም ሁሉ ያልሠራሁትን እርሱንም የሚመስል ደግሞ የማልሠራውን ነገር እሠራብሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በመካከልሽ አባቶች ልጆቻቸውን ይበላሉ ልጆችም አባቶቻቸውን ይበላሉ፤ ፍርድንም አደርግብሻለሁ ከአንቺም የቀረውን ሁሉ ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish ; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በእድፍሽና በርኵሰትሽ መቅደሴን ስላረከስሽ፥ ስለዚህ በእውነት እኔ አሳንስሻለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ዓይኔም አይራራም እኔም አላዝንም።

verses.text_english: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንቺም ሢሶው በቸነፈር ይሞታል፥ በመካከልሽም በራብ ያልቃል፤ ሢሶውም በዙሪያሽ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል፤ ሢሶውንም ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናለሁ በኋላቸውም ሰይፍ እመዝዛለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬም ይፈጸማል መዓቴንም እጨርሳለሁ እጽናናማለሁ፥ መዓቴንም በፈጸምሁባቸው ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በቅንዓቴ እንደ ተናገርሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያሽም ባሉ በአሕዛብ መካከል በሚያልፉም ሁሉ ፊት ባድማና መሰደቢያ አደርግሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken .
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣና በመዓት፥ በመዓትም ዘለፋ ፍርድን ባደረግሁብሽ ጊዜ በዙሪያሽ ላሉ አሕዛብ መሰደቢያና መተረቻ፥ ተግሣጽና መደነቂያ ይሆናል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተናግሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for destruction, which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
verses.text_amharic: ለማጥፋትም የሆነውን፥ አጠፋችሁም ዘንድ የምሰድደውን የራብ ፍላጻ በላያችሁ በሰደድሁ ጊዜ፥ ራብን እጨምርባችኋለሁ፥ የእንጀራችሁንም በትር እሰብራለሁ።

verses.text_english: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken .
verses.text_amharic: ራብንና ክፉዎችን አራዊት እሰድድባችኋለሁ፥ ልጆቻችሁንም ያጠፋሉ፤ ቸነፈርና ደምም በአንቺ ዘንድ ያልፋሉ፤ ሰይፍንም አመጣብሻለሁ። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተናግሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ እስራኤል ተራሮች አቅና ትንቢትም ተናገርባቸው።

verses.text_english: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በል። የእስራኤል ተራሮች ሆይ፥ የጌታን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለተራሮችና ለኮረብቶች ለምንጮችና ለሸለቆች እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ ሰይፍን አመጣባችኋለሁ የኮረብታው መስገጃዎቻችሁንም አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
verses.text_amharic: መሠዊያዎቻችሁም ይፈርሳሉ፥ የፀሐይም ምስሎቻችሁ ይሰበራሉ፤ ተወግተውም የሞቱትን ሰዎቻችሁን በጣዖቶቻችሁ ፊት እጥላለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ሬሳዎች በጣዖቶቻቸው ፊት አኖራለሁ፥ አጥንቶቻችሁንም በመሠዊያዎቻችሁ ዙሪያ እበትናለሁ።

verses.text_english: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
verses.text_amharic: በምትኖሩበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ ከተሞቹ ይፈርሳሉ፥ የኮረብታው መስገጃዎችም ሁሉ ውድማ ይሆናሉ፥ መሠዊያዎቻችሁም ይፈርሳሉ ባድማም ይሆናሉ፥ ጣዖቶቻችሁም ይሰበራሉ ያልቃሉም፥ የፀሐይም ምስሎቻችሁ ይቈረጣሉ፥ ሥራችሁም ይሻራል።

verses.text_english: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ተወግተውም የሞቱት በመካከላችሁ ይወድቃሉ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በአገሮች በተበተናችሁ ጊዜ ከሰይፍ ያመለጡትን ቅሬታ በአሕዛብ መካከል አስቀርላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም የዳኑት ከእኔ በራቀው በአመንዝራ ልባቸውና ጣዖቶቻቸውን በተከተሉ በአመንዝራ ዓይኖቻቸው የተሰበርሁትን እኔን ወደ እነርሱ በተማረኩት አሕዛብ መካከል ሆነው ያስቡኛል፤ በርኵሰታቸውም ሁሉ ስላደረጉት ክፋት ራሳቸውን ይጸየፋሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall know that I the LORD, I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ ይህን ክፉ ነገር አደርግባቸው ዘንድ መናገሬ በከንቱ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእጅህ አጨብጭብ በእግርህም አሸብሽብ እንዲህም በል። በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ይወድቃሉና ስለ እስራኤል ቤት ስለ አስጸያፊ ሥራዎቻቸው ሁሉ ወዮ!

verses.text_english: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
verses.text_amharic: በሩቅ ያለው በቸነፈር ይሞታል፥ በቅርብም ያለው በሰይፍ ይወድቃል፥ የቀረውና የዳነውም በራብ ይሞታል፤ እንዲሁ መዓቴን እፈጽምባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then shall ye know that I the LORD, when their slain shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
verses.text_amharic: ተወግተውም የሞቱ ሰዎቻቸው በጣዖቶቻቸው መካከልና በመሠዊያዎቻቸው ዙሪያ፥ ለጣዖቶቻቸው ጣፋጭ ሽታ ባቀረቡበት ስፍራ፥ ከፍ ባለው ኮረብታ ሁሉ በተራሮችም ራስ ሁሉ ላይ፥ ከለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ቅጠሉም ከበዛ ከአድባር ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች በሆኑ ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እጄንም እዘረጋባቸዋለሁ፥ በሚኖሩበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ ምድሪቱን ከዴብላታ ምድረ በዳ ይልቅ ውድማና በረሃ አደርጋታለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ምድር እንዲህ ይላል። ፍጻሜ፥ በምድሪቱ በአራቱ ማዕዘን ላይ ፍጻሜ ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: Now the end upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ፍጻሜ በአንቺ ላይ ነው፥ ቍጣዬንም እሰድድብሻለሁ፥ እንደ መንገድሽም መጠን እፈርድብሻለሁ፥ ጕስቍልናሽንም ሁሉ አመጣብሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔም አይራራልሽም እኔም አላዝንም፤ መንገድሽንም አመጣብሻለሁ ርኵሰትሽም በመካከልሽ ይሆናል፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ክፉ ነገር፥ አንድ ክፉ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
verses.text_amharic: ፍጻሜ መጥቶአል፥ ፍጻሜ መጥቶአል፥ ነቅቶብሻል፤ እነሆ፥ ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር የምትቀመጥ ሆይ፥ ተራህ ደርሶአል፥ ጊዜ መጥቶአል፥ ቀን ቀርቦአል፤ የሽብር ቀን ነው እንጂ በተራራ ላይ ያለ እልልታ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን በቅርብ መዓቴን አፈስስብሻለሁ፥ ቍጣዬንም እፈጽምብሻለሁ፥ እንደ መንገድሽም መጠን እፈርድብሻለሁ፥ ጕስቍልናሽንም ሁሉ አመጣብሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I the LORD that smiteth.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኔም አይራራም እኔም አላዝንም፤ እንደ መንገድሽም መጠን አመጣብሻለሁ፥ ርኵሰትሽም በመካከልሽ ይሆናል፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር የምቀሥፍ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ ቀኑ፥ እነሆ፥ መጥቶአል፤ ተራህ ወጥቶአል፤ ብትር አብቦአል፥ ትዕቢትም አጅብጅፎአል።

verses.text_english: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them , nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither wailing for them.
verses.text_amharic: ግፍ ወደ ክፋት ብትር ተነስቶአል፤ ከእነርሱና ከብዛታቸው ከሀብታቸውም ምንም አይቀርም፥ የሚያለቅስላቸውም የለም።

verses.text_english: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ጊዜው መጥቶአል፥ ቀኑ ቀርቦአል፤ መዓት በብዙዎች ሁሉ ላይ ነውና የሚገዛ ደስ አይበለው የሚሸጥም አያልቅስ።

verses.text_english: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision touching the whole multitude thereof, shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሸጥ ወደሸጠው ነገር አይመለስም፥ ሰውም በነፍሱ ኃጢአት አይጸናም።

verses.text_english: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.text_amharic: መለከቱን ነፍተዋል ሁሉንም አዘጋጅተዋል፤ ነገር ግን መዓቴ በብዙዎች ሁሉ ላይ ነውና ወደ ሰልፍ የሚሄድ የለም።

verses.text_english: The sword without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that in the field shall die with the sword; and he that in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍ በውጭ ቸነፈርና ራብ በውስጥ አለ፤ በሜዳ ያለው በሰይፍ ይሞታል፥ በከተማም ያለውን ቸነፈርና ራብ ይፈጁታል።

verses.text_english: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የሚሸሹ ይድናሉ በተራራም ላይ ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም በኃጢአታቸው ሁሉን እገድላለሁ።

verses.text_english: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak water.
verses.text_amharic: እጅ ሁሉ ትደክማለች ጕልበትም ሁሉ እንደ ውኃ ትቀልጣለች።

verses.text_english: They shall also gird with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.text_amharic: ማቅም ይለብሳሉ ድንጋጤም ይሸፍናቸዋል፤ በፊትም ሁሉ ላይ እፈረት ይሆናል፥ ራሳቸውንም ሁሉ ይነጩታል።

verses.text_english: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ብራቸውን በጎዳናዎቹ ላይ ይጥላሉ ወርቃቸውም እንደ ጕድፍ ይሆናል፤ በእግዚአብሔር መዓት ቀን ብራቸውና ወርቃቸው ያድናቸው ዘንድ አይችልም። እርሱ የኃጢአታቸው ዕንቅፋት ሆኖአልና ሰውነታቸውን አያጠግቡም ሆዳቸውንም አይሞሉም።

verses.text_english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
verses.text_amharic: የክብሩንም ጌጥ ወደ ትዕቢት ለወጡ፥ የርኵስነታቸውንም ምስሎች አደረጉባት፤ ስለዚህ እኔ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ርኩስ አድርጌአታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
verses.text_amharic: በባዕድም እጅ ለንጥቂያ፥ በምድር ኃጢአተኞችም እጅ ለብዝበዛ አሳልፌ እሰጣታለሁ፤ እነርሱም ያረክሱአታል።

verses.text_english: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret : for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
verses.text_amharic: ፊቴን ከእነርሱ ዘንድ እመልሳለሁ፥ ምሥጢሬንም ያረክሳሉ፤ ወንበዴዎችም ይገቡባታል ያረክሱአትማል።

verses.text_english: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ደም ባመጣው በደል፥ ከተማም በግፍ ተሞልታለችና ሰንሰለት ሥራ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብ ዘንድ ከሁሉ የሚከፉትን አመጣለሁ ቤቶቻቸውንም ይወርሳሉ፤ የኃያላንንም ትዕቢት አጠፋለሁ፥ መቅደሶቻቸውም ይረክሳሉ።

verses.text_english: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and none.
verses.text_amharic: ጥፋት መጥቶአል፤ ሰላምም ይሻሉ እርሱም አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋጤ በድንጋጤ ላይ ይመጣል፥ ወሬም ወሬውን ይከተላል፥ ከነቢዩም ዘንድ ራዕይን ይሻሉ፤ ከካህኑም ዘንድ ትምህርት፥ ከሽማግሌዎችም ዘንድ ምክር ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ያለቅሳል፥ አለቃም ውርደትን ይለብሳል፥ የምድርም ሕዝብ እጅ ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ እንደ መንገዳቸውም መጠን አደርግባቸዋለሁ፥ በፍርዳቸውም መጠን እፈርድባቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth , in the fifth of the month, I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
verses.text_amharic: በስድስተኛውም ዓመት በስድስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአምስተኛው ቀን በቤቴ ተቀምጬ ሳለሁ የይሁዳም ሽማግሌዎች በፊቴ ተቀምጠው ሳሉ፥ በዚያ የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በላዬ ወደቀች።

verses.text_english: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ እንደ እሳት የሚመስል አምሳያ ነበረ፤ ከወገቡም ምሳሌ ወደ ታች እሳት ነበረ፥ ከወገቡም ወደ ላይ እንደ ፀዳል ምሳሌ፥ እንደሚብለጨለጭም የወርቅ ምሳሌ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
verses.text_amharic: እጅ መሳይንም ዘረጋ በራስ ጠጕሬም ያዘኝ፤ መንፈስም በምድርና በሰማይ መካከል አነሣኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ራእይ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ሰሜን ወደሚመለከተው ወደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ በር መግቢያ አመጣኝ፤ በዚያም ቅንዓት የሚያነሣሣ የቅንዓት ጣዖት ተተክሎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በቈላው እንዳየሁት ራእይ የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር በዚያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ዓይንህን ወደ ሰሜን መንገድ አንሣ አለኝ። ዓይኔንም ወደ ሰሜን መንገድ አነሣሁ፤ እነሆም፥ በመሠዊያው በር በሰሜን በኩል በመግቢያው ይህ የቅንዓት ጣዖት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, thou shalt see greater abominations.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የሚያደርጉትን፥ ከመቅደሴ ያርቁኝ ዘንድ የእስራኤል ቤት በዚህ የሚያደርጉትን ታላቁን ርኵሰት ታያለህን? ደግሞም ተመልሰህ ከዚህ የበለጠ ታላቅ ርኵሰት ታያለህ አለኝ።
