verses.text_english: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ዐመፁብኝ ይሰሙኝም ዘንድ አልወደዱም፥ ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ የዓይኑን ርኵሰት አልጣለም የግብጽንም ጣዖታት አልተወም፤ በዚህም ጊዜ። በግብጽ ምድር መካከል ቍጣዬን እፈጽምባቸው ዘንድ መዓቴን አፈስስባቸዋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they , in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በመካከላቸው ባሉ ከግብጽም ምድር አወጣቸው ዘንድ በፊታቸው በተገለጥሁላቸው በአሕዛብ ፊት ስሜ እንዳይረክስ ብዬ ስለ ስሜ ሠራሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽም ምድር አወጣኋቸው ወደ ምድረ በዳም አመጣኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ቢያደርገው ኖሮ በሕይወት የሚኖርበትን ሥርዓቴንም ሰጠኋቸው፥ ፍርዴንም አስታወቅኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I the LORD that sanctify them.
verses.text_amharic: የምቀድሳቸውም እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ በእኔና በእነርሱ መካከል ምልክት ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሰንበታቴን ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል ቤት በምድረ በዳ ዐመፁብኝ፤ ሰው ቢያደርገው ኖሮ በሕይወት የሚኖርበትንም ፍርዴን ጣሱ፥ በትእዛዜም አልሄዱም፥ ሰንበታቴንም ፈጽመው አረከሱ። በዚህም ጊዜ። አጠፋቸው ዘንድ ቍጣዬን በምድረ በዳ አፈስስባቸዋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በፊታቸው ባወጣኋቸው በአሕዛብ ፊት ስሜ እንዳይረክስ ብዬ ስለ ስሜ ሠራሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given , flowing with milk and honey, which the glory of all lands;
verses.text_amharic: ወተትና ማርም ወደምታፈስሰው የምድር ሁሉ ጌጥ ወደምትሆን ወደ ሰጠኋቸው ምድር አላመጣቸውም ብዬ በምድረ በዳ ማልሁባቸው።

verses.text_english: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው ጣዖቶቻቸውን ተከትሎአልና፤ ፍርዴንም ጥሰዋልና፥ በሥርዓቴም አልሄዱምና፥ ሰንበታቴንም አርክሰዋልና።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዓይኔ ራራችላቸው እኔም አላጠፋኋቸውም፥ በምድረ በዳም ፈጽሜ አልፈጀኋቸውም።

verses.text_english: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.text_amharic: ለልጆቻቸውም በምድረ በዳ እንዲህ አልኋቸው። በአባቶቻችሁ ሥርዓት አትሂዱ ወጋቸውንም አትጠብቁ በጣዖቶቻቸውም አትርከሱ።

verses.text_english: I the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ፤ በትእዛዜ ሂዱ ፍርዴንም ጠብቁ አድርጓትም።

verses.text_english: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: ሰንበታቴንም ቀድሱ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል ምልክት ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆች ግን ዐመፁብኝ፥ ሰው ቢያደርገው ኖሮ በሕይወት የሚኖርባትን ፍርዴን ጠብቀው አላደረጓትም በሥርዓቴም አልሄዱም፥ ሰንበታቴንም አረከሱ፤ በዚህም ጊዜ። መዓቴን አፈስስባቸዋለሁ ቍጣዬንም በምድረ በዳ እፈጽምባቸዋለሁ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እጄን መለስሁ፥ በፊታቸውም ባወጣኋቸው በአሕዛብ ፊት ስሜ እንዳይረክስ ብዬ ስለ ስሜ ሠራሁ።

verses.text_english: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ወደ አሕዛብ እበትናቸው ዘንድ፥ በአገሮችም እበትናቸው ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ ማልሁባቸው፤ ፍርዴን አላደረጉምና፤

verses.text_english: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
verses.text_amharic: ሥርዓቴንም ጥሰዋልና፤ ሰንበታቴንም አርክሰዋልና፤ ዓይናቸውም የአባቶቻቸውን ጣዖታቶች ተከትለዋልና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I gave them also statutes not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም መልካም ያልሆነውን ሥርዓት በሕይወት የማይኖሩበትንም ፍርድ ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ እንዲያውቁ አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ ማኅፀን የሚከፍተውን ሁሉ በእሳት ባሳለፉ ጊዜ፥ በመባቸው አረከስኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለእስራኤል ቤት ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህም ደግሞ አባቶቻችሁ ባደረጉት ዓመፅ አስቈጡኝ።

verses.text_english: when I had brought them into the land, the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.text_amharic: እሰጣቸውም ዘንድ ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ባገባኋቸው ጊዜ፥ ከፍ ያለውን ኮረብታ ሁሉ ቅጠልማውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ አዩ፥ በዚያም መሥዋዕታቸውን ሠዉ በዚያም የሚያስቈጣኝን ቍርባናቸውን አቀረቡ በዚያም ደግሞ ጣፋጩን ሽታቸውን አደረጉ በዚያም የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን አፈሰሱ።

verses.text_english: Then I said unto them, What the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። እናንተ ወደ እርሱ የምትሄዱበት ከፍታ ምንድር ነው? አልኋቸው። እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ስሙ ባማ ተብሎ ተጠርቶአል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንደ አባቶቻችሁ ልማድ ትረክሳላችሁን? ርኵሰታቸውንም ተከትላችሁ ታመነዝራላችሁን?

verses.text_english: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.text_amharic: ቍርባናችሁን ባቀረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ልጆቻችሁንም በእሳት ባሳለፋችሁ ጊዜ፥ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በጣዖቶቻችሁ ትረክሳላችሁን የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ከእናንተስ ዘንድ እጠየቃለሁን? እኔ ሕያው ነኛና ከእናንተ ዘንድ አልጠየቅም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተም። እንደ አሕዛብና እንደ ምድር ወገኖች እንሆናለን፥ እንጨትና ድንጋይም እናመልካለን የሚል ከልባችሁ የወጣ አሳብ አይፈጸምላችሁም።

verses.text_english: I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በበረታች እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በፈሰሰችም መዓት እነግሥባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብም ዘንድ አወጣችኋለሁ ከተበተናችሁባትም አገር ሁሉ በበረታች እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በፈሰሰችም መዓት እሰበስባችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አሕዛብም ምድረ በዳ አመጣችኋለሁ በዚያም ፊት ለፊት ከእናንተ ጋር እፋረዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽ ምድረ በዳ ከአባቶቻችሁ ጋር እንደ ተፋረድሁ እንዲሁ ከእናንተ ጋር እፋረዳለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.text_amharic: ከበትርም በታች አሳልፋችኋለሁ ወደ ቃል ኪዳንም እስራት አገባችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ዘንድ ዓመፀኞችንና የበደሉኝን እለያለሁ፤ ከኖሩባትም ምድር አወጣቸዋለሁ፥ ወደ እስራኤል ምድር ግን አይገቡም፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter , if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ሂዱ፥ ከዚህም በኋላ ትሰሙኝ ዘንድ ባትወድዱ ሁላችሁ ጣዖቶቻችሁን አምልኩ። ነገር ግን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በቍርባናችሁና በጣዖቶቻችሁ ቅዱሱን ስሜን አታረክሱም።

verses.text_english: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.text_amharic: በቅዱሱ ተራራዬ፥ ከፍ ባለው በእስራኤል ተራራ ላይ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ሁላቸው በምድሩ ላይ ያመልኩኛል፤ በዚያም እቀበላቸዋለሁ፥ በዚያም ቍርባናችሁን በኵራታችሁንም የቀደሳችሁትንም ነገር ሁሉ እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብም ዘንድ ባወጣኋችሁ ጊዜ ከተበተናችሁባትም አገር ሁሉ በሰበሰብኋችሁ ጊዜ እንደ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት እቀደስባችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall know that I the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቶቻችሁም እሰጣት ዘንድ ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር ወደ እስራኤል አገር ባገባኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የረከሳችሁባትን መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን ሁሉ ታስባላችሁ፤ ስለ ሠራችሁትም ክፋታችሁ ሁሉ ራሳችሁን ትጸየፋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall know that I the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እንደ ክፉ መንገዳችሁና እንደ ርኩስ ሥራችሁ ሳይሆን ስለ ስሜ ስል በሠራሁላችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ ደቡብ አቅና ወደ ደቡብም ተናገር በደቡብም ባለው ዱር ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፤

verses.text_english: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.text_amharic: ለደቡብም ዱር። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በአንተ ውስጥ እሳት አነድዳለሁ፤ በውስጥህም ያለውን የለመለመውንና የደረቀውን ዛፍ ሁሉ ይበላል፤ የሚቃጠል ነበልባል አይጠፋም፤ ከደቡብም ጀምሮ እስከ ሰሜን ድረስ ፊት ሁሉ ይቃጠልበታል።

verses.text_english: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንዳነደድሁት ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ያያል፥ እርሱም አይጠፋም በለው።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እነርሱ ስለ እኔ። ይህ ምሳሌን የሚመስል አይደለምን? ብለዋል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አቅና ወደ መቅደሶችም ተናገር በእስራኤልም ምድር ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር።

verses.text_english: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም ምድር እንዲህ በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ሰይፌንም ከሰገባው እመዝዘዋለሁ፥ ጻድቁንና ክፉውንም ከአንተ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ጻድቁንና ክፉውን ከአንተ ዘንድ ስለማጠፋ፥ ስለዚህ ሰይፌ ከደቡብ ጀምሮ እስከ ሰሜን ድረስ ባለ በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ ከሰገባው ይመዘዛል።

verses.text_english: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ሰይፌን ከሰገባው እንደ መዘዝሁ ያውቃል፥ እርሱም ደግሞ አይመለስም።

verses.text_english: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም፥ አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ አልቅስ፤ ወገብህን በማጕበጥ በፊታቸው ምርር ብለህ አልቅስ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ስለ ምን ታለቅሳለህ? ቢሉህ፥ አንተ እንዲህ በላቸው። ወሬ ስለሚመጣ ነው፤ ልብም ሁሉ ይቀልጣል፥ እጆችም ሁሉ ይዝላሉ፥ ነፍስም ሁሉ ትደክማለች፥ ጉልበትም እንደ ውኃ ይፈስሳል፤ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል ይፈጸምማል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ትንቢት ተናገር፤ ሰይፍ ሰይፍ የተሳለ የተሰነገለም ነው በል።

verses.text_english: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, every tree.
verses.text_amharic: ይገድል ዘንድ ተስሎአል ያብረቀርቅም ዘንድ ተሰንግሎአል፤ እኛስ ደስ ይለናልን? የልጄን በትር እንደ ዛፍ ሁሉ ንቆታል።

verses.text_english: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.text_amharic: በእጁም እንዲያዝ ለመሰንገል ተሰጠ፤ ሰይፍ በገዳይ እጅ እንዲሰጥ ተሳለና ተሰነገለ።

verses.text_english: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thigh.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በሕዝቤ ላይ ነውና፥ በእስራኤል አለቆች ሁሉ ላይ ነውና ጩኽ ዋይም በል፤ እነርሱ ከሕዝቤ ጋር ለሰይፍ ተሰጥተዋል፤ ስለዚህ ጭንህን ጽፋ።

verses.text_english: Because a trial, and what if contemn even the rod? it shall be no , saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ፈተና ደርሶአል፤ የተናቀ በትርስ ደግሞ ባይኖር ምንድር ነው? ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it the sword of the great slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ አንተ የሰው ልጅ፥ ትንቢት ተናገር፥ እጅህን አጨብጭብ፤ የተገደሉ ሰዎች ሰይፍ ሦስት ጊዜ ይደጋግም የሚከብባቸው የተገደለ የታላቅ ሰው ሰይፍ ነው።

verses.text_english: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that heart may faint, and ruins be multiplied: ah! made bright, wrapped up for the slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው እንዲቀልጥ መሰናክላቸውም እንዲበዛ የሚገድለውን ሰይፍ በበሮቻቸው ሁሉ ላይ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ወዮ! ያብረቀርቅ ዘንድ ተሰንግሎአል ይገድልም ዘንድ ተስሎአል።

verses.text_english: Go thee one way or other, on the right hand, on the left, whithersoever thy face set.
verses.text_amharic: ተዘጋጅተህ ፊትህ ወደ ወደደው ወደ ቀኝ ወይም ወደ ግራ ሂድ።

verses.text_english: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said .
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ በእጄ አጨበጭባለሁ መዓቴንም እጨርሳለሁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose at the head of the way to the city.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሰይፍ ይመጣ ዘንድ ሁለት መንገዶችን አድርግ፤ ሁለቱም ከአንዲት ምድር ይውጡ፤ ምልክትም አድርግ፥ በከተማይቱ መንገድ ራስ ላይ አድርገው።

verses.text_english: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍ ወደ አሞን ልጆች አገር ወደ ረባት ወደ ይሁዳም ወደ ተመሸገች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመጣ ዘንድ መንገድን አድርግ።

verses.text_english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ምዋርቱን ያምዋርት ዘንድ በመንታ መንገድ ላይ በሁለቱ መንገዶች ራስ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር፤ ፍላጾችን ወዘወዘ፥ ከተራፊምም ጠየቀ፥ ጉበትም ተመለከተ።

verses.text_english: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint rams against the gates, to cast a mount, to build a fort.
verses.text_amharic: የቅጥሩን ማፍረሻ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ አፍንም በጩኸት ይከፍት ዘንድ፥ በውካታም ድምፅን ከፍ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ የቅጥሩን ማፍረሻ በበሮች ላይ ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ አፈርን ይደለድል ዘንድ፥ ምሽግም ይሠራ ዘንድ የኢየሩሳሌም ዕጣ በቀኝ እጁ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
verses.text_amharic: መሐላውንም በማሉ በዓይናቸው ዘንድ የሐሰት ምዋርት ይመስላል፥ ነገር ግን እነርሱ ይያዙ ዘንድ እርሱ ኃጢአትን ያሳስባል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, , that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ኃጢአታችሁን ስለ አሰባችሁ መተላለፋችሁም ስለ ተገለጠ ኃጢአታችሁም በሥራችሁ ሁሉ ስለ ታየ እናንተም ስለ ታሰባችሁ፥ በእጅ ትያዛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity an end,
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ቀንህ የደረሰብህ፥ የኃጢአትህ ቀጠሮ ጊዜ የደረሰብህ፥ ርኩስ ኃጢአተኛ የእስራኤል አለቃ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this not the same: exalt low, and abase high.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መጠምጠሚያውን አውልቅ፥ ዘውዱንም አርቅ፤ ይህ እንዲህ አይሆንም፤ የተዋረደውን ከፍ አድርግ፥ ከፍ ያለውንም አዋርድ።

verses.text_english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no , until he come whose right it is; and I will give it .
verses.text_amharic: ባድማ፥ ባድማ፥ ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ፤ ፍርድ ያለው እስኪመጣ ድረስ ይህች ደግሞ አትሆንም፥ ለእርሱም እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword drawn: for the slaughter furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity an end.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰገባውም መልሰው። በተፈጠርህበት ስፍራ በተወለድህባትም ምድር እፈርድብሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Shall I cause to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬንም አፈስስብሃለሁ፥ በመዓቴም እሳት አናፋብሃለሁ፥ ማጥፋትንም ለሚያውቁ ለጨካኞች ሰዎች እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.
verses.text_amharic: ለእሳት ማገዶ ትሆናለህ፥ ደምህም በምድር መካከል ይሆናል፥ ደግሞም አትታሰብም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁና።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ትፈርዳለህን? ደም በምታፈስስ ከተማ ላይ ትፈርዳለህን? ርኵሰትዋን ሁሉ አስታውቃት።

verses.text_english: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጊዜሽ እንዲደርስ በመካከልሽ ደምን የምታፈስሺ እንድትረክሺም በራስሽ ላይ ጣዖታትን የምታደርጊ ከተማ ሆይ!

verses.text_english: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.text_amharic: ባፈሰስሽው ደም በድለሻል ባደረግሽውም ጣዖታት ረክሰሻል፤ ቀንሽን አቀረብሽ ዘመንሽንም አሳጠርሽ፤ ስለዚህ ለአሕዛብ መሰደቢያ ለአገሮችም ሁሉ መሳለቂያ አደረግሁሽ።

verses.text_english: near, and far from thee, shall mock thee, infamous much vexed.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ ስምሽ የረከሰ ሽብርም የሞላብሽ ሆይ፥ ወደ አንቺ የቀረቡና ከአንቺ የራቁ ይሳለቁብሻል።

verses.text_english: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል አለቆች እያንዳንዱ እንደ ችሎቱ ደም ያፈስሱ ዘንድ በአንቺ ውስጥ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ ውስጥ አባትንና እናትን አቃለሉ፤ በመካከልሽ በመጻተኛው ላይ በደልን አደረጉ፤ በአንቺ ውስጥ ድሀ አደጉንና መበለቲቱን አስጨነቁ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.text_amharic: ቅድሳቴንም ናቅሽ ሰንበታቴንም አረከስሽ።

verses.text_english: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
verses.text_amharic: ደምን ያፈስሱ ዘንድ ቀማኞች ሰዎች በአንቺ ውስጥ ነበሩ፤ በአንቺ ውስጥ በተራሮች ላይ በሉ፤ በመካከልሽ ሴሰኝነትን አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ ውስጥ የአባቶቻቸውን ኀፍረተ ሥጋ ገለጡ፤ በአንቺም ውስጥ አደፍ ያለባትን አዋረዱ።

verses.text_english: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም በባልንጀራው ሚስት ርኵሰትን አደረገ፥ አባትም የልጁን ሚስት አረከሰ፥ በአንቺም ዘንድ ወንድም የአባቱን ልጅ እኅቱን አሳፈረ።

verses.text_english: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ ውስጥ ደምን ያፈስሱ ዘንድ ጉቦን ተቀበሉ፤ አንቺም አራጣና ትርፍ ወስደሻል፥ ከባልንጀሮችሽም በቅሚያ የስስትን ትርፍ አገኘሽ፥ እኔንም ረሳሽኝ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አንቺ ባደረግሽው ስስት በመካከልሽም በነበረው ደም ላይ እጄን አጨበጨብሁ።

verses.text_english: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken , and will do .
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ እኔ በማደርግብሽ ወራት ልብሽ ይታገሣልን? ወይስ እጅሽ ትጸናለችን? እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ አደርገውማለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አሕዛብም እበትንሻለሁ ወደ አገሮችም እዘራሻለሁ፥ ርኵሰትሽንም ከአንቺ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብም ፊት አንቺ ትረክሻለሽ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂአለሽ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት ለእኔ እንደ አተላ ሆኑብኝ፤ እነርሱ ሁሉ በከውር ውስጥ መዳብና ቈርቈሮ ብረትና እርሳስ ናቸው፤ የብር አተላ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሁላችሁ አተላ ሆናችኋልና ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ እሰበስባችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt ; so will I gather in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave , and melt you.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲያቀልጡት እሳት ያናፉበት ዘንድ ብርንና መዳብን ብረትንና እርሳስን ቈርቈሮንም በከውር እንደሚሰበስቡ፥ እንዲሁ በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፥ በዚያም ውስጥ እጨምራችኋለሁ አቀልጣችሁማለሁ።

verses.text_english: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አሰበስባችሁማለሁ የመዓቴንም እሳት አናፋባችኋለሁ በውስጡም ትቀልጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.text_amharic: ብርም በከውር ውስጥ እንደሚቀልጥ፥ እንዲሁ በውስጡዋ ትቀልጣላችሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር መዓቴን እንዳፈሰስሁባችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, say unto her, Thou the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ። አንቺ ያልነጻሽ በቍጣም ቀን ያልዘነበብሽ ምድር ነሽ በላት።

verses.text_english: a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጥዋ ያሉ ነቢያት እንደሚጮኽና እንደሚናጠቅ አንበሳ አንድ ሆነው ተማማሉ፤ ነፍሶችን በልተዋል፥ ብልጥግናና ሀብትን ወስደዋል፥ በውስጥዋም መበለቶችን አብዝተዋል።

verses.text_english: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቶችዋም ሕጌን በድለዋል ቅድሳቴንም አርክሰዋል፤ ቅዱስ በሆነና ቅዱስ ባልሆነ መካከልም አልለዩም፥ በንጹሕና በርኩስ መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት አላስታወቁም፤ ዓይናቸውንም ከሰንበታቴ ሰወሩ እኔም በመካከላቸው ረከስሁ።

verses.text_english: Her princes in the midst thereof like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጥዋ ያሉ አለቆችዋ የስስትን ትርፍ ለማግኘት ሲሉ ደምን ያፈስሱ ዘንድ ነፍሶችንም ያጠፉ ዘንድ እንደሚናጠቁ ተኵላዎች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered , seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ሳይናገር ነቢያቶችዋ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል እያሉ ከንቱን ራእይ በማየት የሐሰትንም ምዋርት ለእነርሱ በማምዋረት ያለ ገለባ በጭቃ ይመርጓቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.text_amharic: የምድርን ሕዝብ ግፍ አደረጉ ቅሚያም ሠሩ፤ ድሆችንና ችግረኞችን አስጨነቁ፥ መጻተኛውንም በደሉ።

verses.text_english: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥርን የሚጠግንን፥ ምድሪቱንም እንዳላጠፋት በፈረሰበት በኩል በፊቴ የሚቆምላትን ሰው በመካከላቸው ፈለግሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላገኘሁም።

verses.text_english: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ቍጣዬን አፈሰስሁባቸው፥ በመዓቴም እሳት አጠፋኋቸው፤ መንገዳቸውንም በራሳቸው ላይ መለስሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የአንዲት እናት ልጆች የሆኑ ሁለት ሴቶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽም አመነዘሩ፥ በኰረዳነታቸው አመነዘሩ፤ በዚያ ጡቶቻቸው ምዋሸሹ በዚያም የድንግልናቸውን ጡቶች ዳበሱ።

verses.text_english: And the names of them Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus their names; Samaria Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.text_amharic: ስማቸውም የታላቂቱ ኦሖላ የእኅትዋም ኦሖሊባ ነበረ፥ ለእኔም ሆኑ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለዱ። ስማቸውም ኦሖላ ሰማርያ ናት፤ ኦሖሊባ ደግሞ ኢየሩሳሌም ናት።

verses.text_english: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians neighbours,
verses.text_amharic: ኦሖላም ገለሞተችብኝ፥ ውሽሞችዋንም ጎረቤቶችዋን አሦራውያንን በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሰማያዊ ሐር የለበሱ አለቆችና ሹማምቶች፥ መልከ መልካሞች ጐበዛዝት፥ በፈረስ ላይ የሚቀመጡ ፈረሰኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.text_amharic: ግልሙትናዋንም ከተመረጡ ከአሦር ሰዎች ሁሉ ጋር አደረገች፥ በፍቅር በተከተለቻቸውም ጣዖቶቻቸው ሁሉ ረከሰች።

verses.text_english: Neither left she her whoredoms from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽም የነበረውን ግልሙትናዋን አልተወችም፤ በዚያ በኰረዳነትዋ ጊዜ ከእርስዋ ጋር ተኝተው ነበር፥ የድንግልናዋንም ጡቶች ዳብሰው ነበር፥ ግልሙትናቸውንም አፍስሰውባት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በፍቅር በተከተለቻቸው በውሽሞችዋ በአሦራውያን እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጠኋት።

verses.text_english: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ኅፍረተ ሥጋዋን ገለጡ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችዋንም ማርከው ወሰዱ፥ እርስዋንም በሰይፍ ገደሉ፤ ፍርድንም ስላደረጉባት በሴቶች መካከል መተረቻ ሆነች።

verses.text_english: And when her sister Aholibah saw , she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in whoredoms.
verses.text_amharic: እኅትዋም ኦሖሊባ ይህን አየች፤ ሆኖም ከእርስዋ ይልቅ በፍቅር በመከተልዋ ረከሰች፥ ግልሙትናዋም ከእኅትዋ ግልሙትና ይልቅ በዛ።

verses.text_english: She doted upon the Assyrians neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.text_amharic: አለቆችንና ሹማምቶችን ጎረቤቶችዋን ጌጠኛ ልብስ የለበሱትን በፈረሶች ላይ የሚቀመጡትን ፈረሰኞች፥ ሁሉም መልከ መልካሞችን ጐበዛዝት አሦራውያንን በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: Then I saw that she was defiled, they both one way,
verses.text_amharic: የረከሰችም እንደ ሆነች አየሁ፥ ሁለቱም አንድ መንገድ ሄደዋል።

verses.text_english: And she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.text_amharic: ግልሙትናዋንም አበዛች፤ በቀይ ቀለምም የተሳለችውን የከለዳውያንን ስዕል፥ በናስ ላይ የተሳሉትን ሰዎች አየች።

verses.text_english: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.text_amharic: በወገባቸው ዝናር የታጠቁ ራሳቸውንም በቀለማዊ መጠምጠሚያ የጠመጠሙ ነበሩ፤ ሁሉም ከተወለዱባት አገር የሆኑትን የከለዳውያንን ልጆች መስለው መሳፍንትን ይመስሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.text_amharic: ባየቻቸውም ጊዜ በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው፥ ወደ ከላውዴዎን ምድር ወደ እነርሱ መልእክተኞችን ላከች።

verses.text_english: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.text_amharic: የባቢሎንም ሰዎች ወደ እርስዋ ፍቅር ወዳለበት መኝታ መጡ በግልሙትናቸውም አረከሱአት፤ እርስዋም ከእነርሱ ጋር ረከሰች ነፍስዋም ከእነርሱ ተለየች።

verses.text_english: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.text_amharic: ግልሙትናዋንም ገለጠች ኅፍረተ ሥጋዋንም አሳየች፤ ነፍሴም ከእኅትዋ እንደ ተለየች እንዲሁ ነፍሴ ከእርስዋ ተለየች።

verses.text_english: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በግብጽ ምድር የገለሞተችበትን የኰረዳነትዋን ዘመን አስባ ግልሙትናዋን አበዛች።

verses.text_english: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh the flesh of asses, and whose issue the issue of horses.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋቸውም እንደ አህዮች ሥጋ ዘራቸውም እንደ ፈረሶች ዘር የሆነውን እነዚያን ምልምሎች በፍቅር ተከተለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኰረዳነትሽ ምክንያት ግብጻውያን ጡቶችሽን በዳበሱ ጊዜ የኰረዳነትሽን ሴሰኝነት አሰብሽ።

verses.text_english: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ ኦሖሊባ ሆይ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ነፍስሽ ከእነርሱ የተለየች ውሽሞችሽን አስነሣብሻለሁ፥ በዙሪያሽም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም የባቢሎን ሰዎች ከለዳውያንም ሁሉ፥ ፋቁድ፥ ሱሔ፥ ቆዓ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር አሦራውያን ሁሉ፥ መልከ መልካሞች ጐበዛዝት፥ አለቆችና ሹማምቶች ሁሉ፥ መሳፍንቶችና አማካሪዎች ሁሉ፥ በፈረስ ላይ የተቀመጡ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
verses.text_amharic: በመሣሪያና በሰረገላ በመንኰራኵርም በአሕዛብም ጉባኤ ይመጡብሻል፤ ጋሻና አላባሽ ጋሻ ራስ ቍርም ይዘው በዙሪያሽ ይዘጋጁብሻል፤ ፍርድንም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ ፍርዳቸውም ይፈርዱብሻል።

verses.text_english: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.text_amharic: ቅንዓቴንም በአንቺ ላይ አደርጋለሁ በመዓትም ያደርጉብሻል፤ አፍንጫሽንና ጆሮሽንም ከአንቺ ይቈርጣሉ፥ ከአንቺም የቀረ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም ማርከው ይወስዳሉ፥ ከአንቺም የቀረውን እሳት ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
verses.text_amharic: ልብስሽንም ይገፍፉሻል የክብርሽንም ጌጥ ይወስዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.text_amharic: ሴሰኝነትሽንም፥ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣሽውን ግልሙትናሽንም ከአንቺ አስቀራለሁ፤ ዓይንሽንም ወደ እነርሱ አታነሺም ግብጽንም ከዚያ ወዲያ አታስቢም።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand whom thou hatest, into the hand from whom thy mind is alienated:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በጠላሻቸው እጅ፥ ነፍስሽ በተለየቻቸው እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጥሻለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በጥል ያደርጉብሻል፥ የደከምሽበትንም ሁሉ ይወስዳሉ፥ ዕራቁትሽንና ዕርቃንሽን አድርገውም ይተዉሻል፤ የግልሙትናሽም ነውር፥ ሴሰኝነትሽና ግልሙትናሽም ሁሉ ይገለጣል።

verses.text_english: I will do these unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, because thou art polluted with their idols.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሕዛብ ጋር ስላመነዘርሽ በጣዖቶቻቸውም ስለ ረከስሽ ይህን ያደረጉብሻል።

verses.text_english: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
verses.text_amharic: በእኅትሽ መንገድ ሄደሻል፤ ስለዚህ ጽዋዋን በእጅሽ እሰጥሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የጠለቀውንና የሰፋውን ብዙም የሚይዘውን የእኅትሽን ጽዋ ትጠጪአለሽ፤ መሳቂያና መሳለቂያም ትሆኛለሽ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: በእኅትሽ በሰማርያ ጽዋ፥ በድንጋጤና በጥፋት ጽዋ፥ በስካርና በውርደት ትሞልያለሽ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt even drink it and suck out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken , saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ትጠጪዋለሽ ትጨልጪውማለሽ ገሉንም ታኝኪዋለሽ ጡትሽንም ትሸነትሪዋለሽ፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዘንግተሽኛልና፥ ወደ ኋላሽም ጥለሽኛልና አንቺ ደግሞ ሴሰኝነትሽንና ግልሙትናሽን ተሸከሚ።

verses.text_english: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በኦሖላና በኦሖሊባ ትፈርዳለህን? ኃጢአታቸውንም ታስታውቃቸዋለህ?

verses.text_english: That they have committed adultery, and blood in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through , to devour .
verses.text_amharic: አመንዝረዋልና፥ ደምም በእጃቸው አለና፥ ከጣዖቶቻቸውም ጋር አመንዝረዋልና፥ ለእኔም የወለዱአቸውን ልጆቻቸውን መብል እንዲሆኑላቸው በእሳት አሳልፈዋቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ደግሞ አድርገውብኛል፤ በዚያ ቀን መቅደሴን አርክሰዋል ሰንበታቴንም ሽረዋል።

verses.text_english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸውንም ለጣዖቶቻቸው በሠዉ ጊዜ፥ በዚያው ቀን ያረክሱት ዘንድ ወደ መቅደሴ ገቡ፤ እነሆም፥ በቤቴ ውስጥ እንደዚህ አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ መልእክተኛ ወደ ተላከባቸው ከሩቅም ወደሚመጡ ሰዎች ልካችኋል፤ እነሆም መጡ፥ አንቺም ታጠብሽላቸው ዓይኖችሽንም ተኳልሽ ጌጥም አጌጥሽ፤

verses.text_english: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
verses.text_amharic: በክብር አልጋ ላይ ተቀመጥሽ፥ በፊት ለፊትዋም ማዕድ ተዘጋጅታ ነበር፥ ዕጣኔንና ዘይቴንም አኖርሽባት።

verses.text_english: And a voice of a multitude being at ease with her: and with the men of the common sort brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.text_amharic: የደስተኞችም ድምፅ በእርስዋ ዘንድ ነበረ፤ ከብዙም ሰዎች ጉባኤ ጋር ሰካራሞቹ ከምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ በእጃቸው አንበር በራሳቸውም የተዋበ አክሊል አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Then said I unto old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she ?
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በምንዝር ላረጀችው። አሁን ከእርስዋ ጋር ያመነዝራሉ እርስዋም ከእነርሱ ጋር ታመነዝራለች አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጋለሞታም እንደሚገቡ ወደ እርስዋ ገቡ፤ እንዲሁ ይሰስኑ ዘንድ ወደ ኦሖላና ወደ ኦሖሊባ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they adulteresses, and blood in their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶቹ አመንዝሮች ናቸውና፥ በእጃቸውም ደም አለና ጻጽቃን ሰዎች በአመንዝሮቹና በደም አፍሳሾቹ ሴቶች ላይ በሚፈረደው ፍርድ ይፈርዱባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጉባኤን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ለመበተንና ለመበዝበዝም አሳልፌ አሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም በድንጋይ ይወግሩአቸዋል በሰይፋቸውም ይቈርጡአቸዋል፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ይገድላሉ፥ ቤቶቻቸውንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶችም ሁሉ እንደ ሴሰኝነታችሁ እንዳይሠሩ ይማሩ ዘንድ ሴሰኝነትን ከምድር ላይ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ሴሰኝነታችሁንም በላያችሁ ላይ ይመልሳሉ፥ እናንተም የጣዖቶቻችሁን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የዚህን ቀን፥ የዛሬን ቀን ስም ጻፍ፤ በዚህ ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቀረበ።

verses.text_english: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set on, and also pour water into it:
verses.text_amharic: ለዓመፀኛውም ቤት ምሳሌን ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጣድ፥ ምንቸቲቱን ጣድ፥ ውኃም ጨምርባት።

verses.text_english: Gather the pieces thereof into it, every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill with the choice bones.
verses.text_amharic: ቍራጭዋንም፥ መልካሙን ቍራጭ ሁሉ፥ ጭኑንና ወርቹን በእርስዋ ውስጥ ሰብስብ፥ የተመረጡትንም አጥንቶች ሙላባት።

verses.text_english: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
verses.text_amharic: ከመንጋው የተመረጠውን ውሰድ፥ አጥንቶቹም እንዲበስሉ እንጨት በበታችዋ ማግድ፤ አጥንቶቹም በውስጥዋ ይቀቀሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዝገትዋ ላለባት ዝገትዋም ከእርስዋ ላልወጣ ምንቸት፥ ለደም ከተማ ወዮላት! ቍራጭ ቍራጩን አውጣ፤ ዕጣ አልወደቀባትም።

verses.text_english: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
verses.text_amharic: ደምዋ በውስጥዋ አለ። በተራቈተ ድንጋይ ላይ አደረገችው እንጂ በአፈር ይከደን ዘንድ በመሬት ላይ አላፈሰሰችውም፤

verses.text_english: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.text_amharic: መዓቴን አወጣ ዘንድ፥ በቀሌንም እበቀል ዘንድ፥ ደምዋ እንዳይከደን በተራቈተ ድንጋይ ላይ አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለደም ከተማ ወዮላት! እኔ ደግሞ ማገዶዋን ታላቅ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
verses.text_amharic: እንጨቱን አብዛ፤ እሳቱን አንድድ፤ ሥጋውን ቀቅል፤ መረቁን አጣፍጠው፤ አጥንቶቹ ይቃጠሉ።

verses.text_english: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and the filthiness of it may be molten in it, the scum of it may be consumed.
verses.text_amharic: ትሞቅም ዘንድ ናስዋም ትግል ዘንድ ርኵሰትዋም በውስጥዋ ይቀልጥ ዘንድ ዝገትዋም ይጠፋ ዘንድ ባዶዋን በፍም ላይ አድርጋት።

verses.text_english: She hath wearied with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum in the fire.
verses.text_amharic: በከንቱ ደከመች፤ ሆኖም ዝገትዋ በእሳት ስንኳ አልለቀቀም።

verses.text_english: In thy filthiness lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
verses.text_amharic: በርኵሰትሽ ሴሰኝነት አለ፤ አነጻሁሽ አልነጻሽምና መዓቴን በላይሽ እስክጨርስ ድረስ እንግዲህ ከርኵሰትሽ አትነጺም።

verses.text_english: I the LORD have spoken : it shall come to pass, and I will do ; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁ፤ ይመጣል፥ እኔም አደርገዋለሁ፤ አልመለስም፥ አልራራም፥ አልጸጸትም፤ እንደ መንገድሽና እንደ ሥራሽ ይፈርዱብሻል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ የዓይንህን አምሮት በመቅሠፍት እወስድብሃለሁ፤ አንተም ወይ አትበል አታልቅስም እንባህንም አታፍስስ።

verses.text_english: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.text_amharic: በቀስታ ተክዝ፤ ለምዋቾችም አታልቅስ፥ መጠምጠሚያህን በራስህ ላይ አድርግ፥ ጫማህንም በእግርህ አጥልቅ፥ ከንፈሮችህንም አትሸፍን የሰዎችንም እንጀራ አትብላ።

verses.text_english: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በማለዳ ለሕዝቡ ተናገርሁ፥ ወደ ማታም ሚስቴ ሞተች፤ በነጋውም እንደ ታዘዝሁ አደረግሁ።

verses.text_english: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these to us, that thou doest ?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም። ይህ የምታደርገው ነገር ለእኛ ምን እንደ ሆነ አትነግረንምን? አሉኝ።

verses.text_english: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እንዲህ አልኋቸው። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ቤት ተናገር እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የኃይላችሁን ትምክሕት፥ የዓይናችሁን አምሮት፥ የነፍሳችሁን ምኞት መቅደሴን አረክሳለሁ፤ ያስቀራችኋቸውም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እንዳደረግሁ እናንተ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ከንፈራችሁን አትሸፍኑም የሰዎችንም እንጀራ አትበሉም።

verses.text_english: And your tires upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
verses.text_amharic: መጠምጠሚያችሁም በራሳችሁ ጫማችሁም በእግራችሁ ይሆናል፤ ዋይ አትሉም አታለቅሱምም፤ በኃጢአታችሁም ትሰለስላላችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁም ታንጐራጕራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቅኤልም ምልክት ይሆናችኋል፤ እርሱ እንዳደረገ ሁሉ እናንተ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ይህም በመጣ ጊዜ እኔ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Also, thou son of man, not in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ኃይላቸውን፥ የተመኩበትንም ደስታ፥ የዓይናቸውን አምሮት፥ የነፍሳቸውንም ምኞት፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በወሰድሁባቸው ቀን፥

verses.text_english: he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause to hear with ears?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ያመለጠው ይህን ነገር በጆሮህ ያሰማ ዘንድ ወደ አንተ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን አፍህ ላመለጠው ይከፈታል፥ አንተም ትናገራለህ ከዚያ ወዲያም ዲዳ አትሆንም፤ ምልክትም ትሆናቸዋለህ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ አሞን ልጆች አቅንተህ ትንቢት ተናገርባቸው።

verses.text_english: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
verses.text_amharic: ለአሞንም ልጆች እንዲህ በል። የጌታን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መቅደሴ በረከሰ ጊዜ የእስራኤልም ምድር ባድማ በሆነች ጊዜ የይሁዳም ቤት በተማረኩ ጊዜ ስለ እነርሱ እሰይ ብለሃልና

verses.text_english: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ርስት አድርጌ ለምሥራቅ ልጆች አሳልፌ አሰጥሃለሁ፥ እነርሱም በአንተ ውስጥ ይሰፍራሉ፥ ማደሪያዎቻቸውንም በአንተ ዘንድ ይሠራሉ፤ ፍሬህን ይበላሉ ወተትህንም ይጠጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የአሞንን ከተማ ለግመሎች ማሰማርያ፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች ለመንጋ መመሰጊያ አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በእጅህ አጨብጭበሃልና፥ በእግርህም አሸብሽበሃልና፥ በእስራኤልም ምድር ላይ በነፍስህ ንቀት ሁሉ ደስ ብሎሃልና

verses.text_english: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እጄን ዘርግቼብሃለህ፥ ለአሕዛብም አስበዘብዝሃለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም ለይቼ እቈርጥሃለሁ፥ ከአገሮችም አጠፋሃለሁ እፈጅህማለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah like unto all the heathen;
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሞዓብና ሴይር። እነሆ፥ የይሁዳ ቤት እንደ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ነው ብለዋልና

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሞዓብን ጫንቃ ከከተሞቹ፥ በዳርቻው ካሉት የምድሩ ትምክሕት ከሆኑት ከተሞቹ፥ ከቤትየሺሞት፥ ከበኣልሜዎን፥

verses.text_english: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ከቂርያታይም፥ ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለምሥራቅ ልጆች እከፍታለሁ። የአሞን ልጆች በአሕዛብ መካከል ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳይታሰቡ ርስት አድርጌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሞዓብም ላይ ፍርድን አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ኤዶምያስ በይሁዳ ቤት ላይ በቀል አድርጎአልና፥ ቂም ይዞአልና፥ ብድራትንም አስከፍሎአልና

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እጄን በኤዶምያስ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ ከእርስዋም ዘንድ ሰውንና እንስሳን አጠፋለሁ፥ ከቴማንም ጀምሮ ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ፥ እስከ ድዳንም ድረስ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል እጅ ኤዶምያስን እበቀላለሁ፤ እንደ ቍጣዬና እንደ መዓቴም መጠን በኤዶምያስ ያደርጋሉ፤ በቀሌንም ያውቃሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy for the old hatred;
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፍልስጥኤማውያን በቀልን አድርገዋልና፥ በዘወትርም ጠላትነት ያጠፉ ዘንድ በነፍሳቸው ንቀት ተበቅለዋልና

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እጄን በፍልስጥኤማውያን ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፥ ከሊታውያንንም እቈርጣለሁ፥ የባሕሩንም ዳር ቅሬታ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.text_amharic: በመዓት መቅሠፍትም ታላቅ በቀል አደርግባቸዋለሁ፤ በቀሌንም በላያቸው ባደረግሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በአሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ከወሩ በመጀመሪያው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, she is laid waste:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጢሮስ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ። እሰይ፥ የአሕዛብ በር የነበረች ተሰብራለች ወደ እኔም ተመልሳለች፤ እርስዋ ፈርሳለችና እኔ እሞላለሁ ብላለችና

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጢሮስ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፥ ባሕርም ሞገድዋን እንደምታወጣ እንዲሁ ብዙ አሕዛብን አወጣብሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.text_amharic: የጢሮስንም ቅጥሮች ያጠፋሉ ግንቦችዋንም ያፈርሳሉ፤ ትቢያዋንም ከእርስዋ እፍቃለሁ፥ የተራቈተ ድንጋይም አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.text_english: It shall be the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken , saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.text_amharic: በባሕር ውስጥ የመረብ ማስጫ ትሆናለች፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለአሕዛብም ብዝበዛ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: And her daughters which in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳ ያሉትም ሴቶች ልጆችዋ በሰይፍ ይገደላሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን የነገሥታት ንጉሥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን ከፈረሶችና ከሰረገሎች ከፈረሰኞችም ከጉባኤና ከብዙ ሕዝብ ጋር በጢሮስ ላይ አመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
verses.text_amharic: በሜዳ ያሉትን ሴቶች ልጆችሽን በሰይፍ ይገድላቸዋል፥ አምባም ይሠራብሻል አፈርንም ይደለድልብሻል ጋሻም ያነሣብሻል።

verses.text_english: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
verses.text_amharic: ማፍረሻውን በቅጥርሽ ላይ ያደርጋል፥ ግንቦችሽንም በምሳር ያፈርሳል።

verses.text_english: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈረሶቹም ብዛት የተነሣ ትቢያቸው ይከድንሻል፤ ሰዎችም በተናደች ቅጥር ወደ ከተማ እንደሚገቡ እርሱ በበሮችሽ ሲገባ፥ ከፈረሰኞችና ከመንኰራኵሮች ከሰረገሎችም ድምፅ የተነሣ ቅጥርሽ ትናወጣለች።

verses.text_english: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: በፈረሶቹ ኮቴ ጎዳናዎችሽን ሁሉ ይረመርማል፥ ሕዝብሽንም በሰይፍ ይገድላል፥ የብርታትሽም ሐውልት ወደ ምድር ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
verses.text_amharic: ብልጥግናሽንም ይማርካሉ፥ ሸቀጥሽንም ይበዘብዛሉ፤ ቅጥርሽንም ያፈርሳሉ፥ ተድላ የምታደርጊባቸውን ቤቶችሽን ያጠፋሉ፤ ድንጋይሽንና እንጨትሽን መሬትሽንም በባሕር ውስጥ ይጥላሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
verses.text_amharic: የዘፋኞችሽንም ብዛት ዝም አሰኛለሁ፤ የመሰንቆሽም ድምፅ ከዚያ ወዲያ አይሰማም።

verses.text_english: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken , saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: የተራቈተ ድንጋይ አደርግሻለሁ የመረብም ማስጫ ትሆኛለሽ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትሠሪም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጢሮስን እንዲህ ይላታል። የተወጉት ባንቋረሩ ጊዜ፥ በውስጥሽ እልቂት በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ከውድቀትሽ ድምፅ የተነሣ ደሴቶች ይነዋወጡ የለምን?

verses.text_english: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at moment, and be astonished at thee.
verses.text_amharic: የባሕርም አለቆች ሁሉ ከዙፋኖቻቸው ይወርዳሉ፤ መጐናጸፊያቸውን ያወጣሉ ወርቀ ዘቦ ልብሳቸውንም ያወልቃሉ፤ መንቀጥቀጥን ለብሰው በመሬት ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ይንቀጠቀጣሉ በአንቺም ይደነቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror on all that haunt it!
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺም ላይ ሙሾ ያሞሻሉ፥ እንዲህም ይሉሻል። በባሕር የተቀመጥሽ በባሕርም ውስጥ የጸናሽ፥ ከሚቀመጡብሽም ጋር በዙሪያሽ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ያስፈራሽ፥ የከበርሽ ከተማ ሆይ፥ እንዴት ጠፋሽ!

verses.text_english: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን በውድቀትሽ ቀን ደሴቶች ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥ በባሕርም ውስጥ ያለ ደሴቶች ከመጥፋትሽ የተነሣ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰው እንደሌለባቸው ከተሞች ባድማ ከተማ ባደረግሁሽ ጊዜ፥ ቀላዩንም ባወጣሁብሽ ጊዜ ብዙ ውኆችም በከደኑሽ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.text_amharic: የቀድሞ ሕዝብ ወዳሉበት ወደ ጕድጓድ ከሚወርዱት ጋር አወርድሻለሁ፤ የሚኖርብሽም እንዳይገኝ ወደ ጕድጓድ ከሚወርዱ ጋር ቀድሞ በፈረሰችው ስፍራ፥ በታችኛይቱ ምድር አኖርሻለሁ፤ ጌጥሽንም በሕያዋን ምድር አላኖርም።

verses.text_english: I will make thee a terror, and thou no : though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ለድንጋጤ አደርግሻለሁ እንግዲህም አትኖሪም፤ ትፈለጊአለሽ ለዘላለምም አትገኚም፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.text_amharic: አንተ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለ ጢሮስ ሙሾ አድርግ፥

verses.text_english: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I of perfect beauty.
verses.text_amharic: በባሕር መግቢያ የምትኖር በብዙም ደሴቶች ላይ ከሚኖሩ አሕዛብ ጋር ንግድን የምታደርግ ጢሮስንም እንዲህ በላት። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጢሮስ ሆይ፥ አንቺ። በውበት ፍጹም ነኝ ብለሻል።

verses.text_english: Thy borders in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.text_amharic: ዳርቻሽ በባሕር ውስጥ ነው፤ ሠሪዎችሽ ውበትሽን ፈጽመዋል።

verses.text_english: They have made all thy boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሳንቃዎችሽን ሁሉ ከሳኔር ጥድ ሠርተዋል፥ ደቀልንም ይሠሩልሽ ዘንድ ከሊባኖስ ዝግባ ወስደዋል።

verses.text_english: the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches ivory, out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.text_amharic: ከባሳን ኮምቦል መቅዘፊያሽን ሠርተዋል፥ በዝሆን ጥርስ ከታሻበ ከኪቲም ደሴቶች ዛፍ መቀመጫዎችሽን ሠርተዋል።

verses.text_english: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
verses.text_amharic: ዓላማ እንዲሆንልሽ ሸራሽ ከግብጽ በፍታና ከወርቅ ዘቦ ተሠርቶአል፥ መደረቢያሽም ከኤሊሳ ደሴቶች ሰማያዊና ቀይ ሐር ተሠርቶአል።

verses.text_english: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise , O Tyrus, were in thee, were thy pilots.
verses.text_amharic: የሲዶናና የአራድ ሰዎች ቀዛፎችሽ ነበሩ፤ ጢሮስ ሆይ፥ ጥበበኞችሽ በአንቺ ዘንድ ነበሩ የመርከቦችሽም መሪዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The ancients of Gebal and the wise thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
verses.text_amharic: በአንቺ ውስጥ የነበሩ የጌባል ሽማግሌዎችና ጥበበኞችዋ ስብራትሽን ይጠግኑ ነበር፤ ከአንቺም ጋር ይነግዱ ዘንድ የባሕር መርከቦች ሁሉና መርከበኞቻቸው በመካከልሽ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.text_amharic: ፋርስና ሉድ ፉጥም በሠራዊትሽ ሰልፈኞችሽ ነበሩ፤ ጋሻና ራስ ቍርም በአንቺ ውስጥ ያንጠለጥሉ ነበር፤ እነርሱም ውበትሽን ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: The men of Arvad with thine army upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
verses.text_amharic: የአራድ ሰዎችና ሠራዊቶችሽ በቅጥሮችሽ ላይ በዙሪያ ነበሩ፥ ገማዳውያንም በግንቦችሽ ውስጥ ነበሩ፤ ጋሻቸውንም በዙሪያ በቅጥርሽ ላይ አንጠለጠሉ፥ ውበትሽንም ፈጽመዋል።

verses.text_english: Tarshish thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
verses.text_amharic: ከብልጥግናሽ ሁሉ ብዛት የተነሣ ተርሴስ ነጋዴሽ ነበረች፤ በብርና በብረት በቈርቈሮና በእርሳስ ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
verses.text_amharic: ያዋንና ቶቤል ሞሳሕም ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ የሰዎችን ነፍሳትና የናሱን ዕቃ ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.text_amharic: ከቴርጋማ ቤትም የነበሩት ሰዎች በፈረሶችና በፈረሰኞች በበቅሎዎችም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The men of Dedan thy merchants; many isles the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.text_amharic: የድዳን ሰዎች ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ። ብዙ ደሴቶች የእጅሽ ገበያዎች ነበሩ፤ ይለውጡ ዘንድ የዝሆን ጥርስና ዞጲ አመጡልሽ።

verses.text_english: Syria thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.text_amharic: ከሥራሽ ብዛት የተነሣ ሶርያ ነጋዴሽ ነበረች በበሉርና በቀይ ሐር በወርቀ ዘቦም በጥሩ በፍታም በዛጐልም በቀይ ዕንቍም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Judah, and the land of Israel, they thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳና የእስራኤል ምድር ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ የሚኒትን ስንዴ ጣፋጭም እንጐቻ፥ ማር ዘይትም በለሳንም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Damascus thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.text_amharic: ከሥራሽ ብዛትና ከብልጥግናሽ ሁሉ ብዛት የተነሣ ደማስቆ ነጋዴሽ ነበረች፤ በኬልቦን የወይን ጠጅ በነጭም በግ ጠጕር ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
verses.text_amharic: ዌንዳንና ያዋን ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር፤ ከኦሴል የተሠራ ብረትና ብርጕድ ቀረፋም ሸቀጥሽ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Dedan thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.text_amharic: ድዳን በከብት ላይ ለመቀመጥ በመረሻት ነጋዴሽ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these thy merchants.
verses.text_amharic: ዓረብና የቄዳር አለቆች ሁሉ የእጅሽ ነጋዴዎች ነበሩ፤ በጠቦቶችና በአውራ በጎች በፍየሎችም በእነዚህ ከአንቺ ጋር ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.text_amharic: የሳባና የራዕማ ነጋዴዎች እነዚህ ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ በጥሩ ሽቶና በክብር ድንጋይ ሁሉ በወርቅም ስለ አንቺ ሸቀጥ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, Chilmad, thy merchants.
verses.text_amharic: ካራንና ካኔ ዔድንም ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ፤ አሦርና ኪልማድ ነጋዴዎችሽ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: These thy merchants in all sorts , in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ባማረ ልብስ በሰማያዊ ካባ በወርቀ ዘቦም፥ በዝግባ በተሠራች በገመድም በታሰረች በግምጃም በተሞላች ሳጥን በገበያሽ ይነግዱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.text_amharic: የተርሴስ መርከቦች ሸቀጥሽን የሚሸከሙ ነበሩ፤ አንቺም ተሞልተሽ ነበር በባሕርም ውስጥ እጅግ ከበርሽ።

verses.text_english: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
verses.text_amharic: ቀዛፊዎችሽ ወደ ትልቁ ወኃ አመጡሽ፤ የምሥራቅ ነፋስ በባሕር ውስጥ ሰበረሽ።

verses.text_english: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that in thee, and in all thy company which in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.text_amharic: ብልጥግናሽና ሸቀጥሽ ንግድሽም መርከበኞችሽም መርከብ መሪዎችሽም ሰባራሽንም የሚጠግኑ ነጋዴዎችሽም በአንቺም ዘንድ ያሉ ሰልፈኞችሽ ሁሉ በውስጥሽ ካሉት ጉባኤ ሁሉ ጋር በወደቅሽበት ቀን በባሕር ውስጥ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
verses.text_amharic: ከመርከብ መሪዎች ጩኸት ድምፅ የተነሣ በዙሪያሽ ያሉ ሁሉ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.text_amharic: ቀዛፊዎችም ሁሉ መርከበኞችም መርከብ መሪዎችም ሁሉ ከመርከቦቻቸው ይወርዳሉ በመሬትም ላይ ይቆማሉ፤

verses.text_english: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.text_amharic: ድምፃቸውንም በአንቺ ላይ ያሰማሉ፥ ምርር ብለውም ይጮኻሉ፥ በራሳቸውም ላይ ትቢያ ይነሰንሳሉ፥ በአመድም ውስጥ ይንከባለላሉ፤

verses.text_english: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart bitter wailing.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አንቺም የራሳቸውን ጠጕር ይላጫሉ ማቅም ያሸርጣሉ በነፍስ ምሬትም ስለ አንቺ መራራ ልቅሶ ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.text_english: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, , What like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.text_amharic: በትካዜያቸውም ልቅሶ ያነሡልሻል፥ ስለ አንቺም ሙሾ ያሞሻሉ እንዲህም ይላሉ። በባሕር መካከል ጠፍቶ እንደ ቀረ እንደ ጢሮስ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.text_amharic: ሸቀጥሽ ከባሕር በወጣ ጊዜ ብዙ አሕዛብን አጥግበሻል፤ በብልጥግናሽና በንግድሽ ብዛት የምድርን ነገሥታት ባለ ጠጎች አድርገሻል።

verses.text_english: In the time thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በጥልቅ ውኃ ውስጥ በባህር ተሰብረሻል ንግድሽና ጉባኤሽ ሁሉ በመካከልሽ ወድቀዋል።

verses.text_english: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in countenance.
verses.text_amharic: በደሴቶሽ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተደንቀውብሻል፥ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም እጅግ ፈርተዋል ፊታቸውም ተለውጦአል።

verses.text_english: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never any more.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብ ነጋዴዎች አፍዋጩብሽ፤ አንቺ ለድንጋጤ ሆነሻል፥ እስከ ዘላለምም አትገኚም።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart lifted up, and thou hast said, I a God, I sit the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ የጢሮስን ገዥ እንዲህ በለው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ልብህ ኰርቶአል አንተም። እኔ አምላክ ነኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ወንበር በባሕር መካከል ተቀምጫለሁ ብለሃል፤ ነገር ግን ልብህን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ልብ ብታደርግም አንተ ሰው ነህ እንጂ አምላክ አይደለህም።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከዳንኤል ይልቅ ጥበበኛ ነህ፥ ምሥጢርም ሁሉ ከአንተ የተሸሸገ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
verses.text_amharic: በጥበብህና በማስተዋልህ ብልጥግናን ለራስህ አግኝተሃል ወርቅና ብርም በግምጃ ቤትህ ውስጥ ሰብስበሃል።

verses.text_english: By thy great wisdom by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ጥበብህና በንግድህ ብልጥግናህን አብዝተሃል በብልጥግናህም ልብህ ኰርቶአል።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ልብህን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ልብ አድርገሃልና

verses.text_english: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሌላ አገር ሰዎችን፥ የአሕዛብን ጨካኞች፥ አመጣብሃለሁ፤ ሰይፋቸውንም በጥበብህ ውበት ላይ ይመዝዛሉ ክብርህንም ያረክሳሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጕድጓድ ያወርዱሃል፤ ተገድለው እንደ ሞቱ በባሕር ውስጥ ትሞታለህ።

verses.text_english: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I God? but thou a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
verses.text_amharic: በውኑ በገዳይህ ፊት። እኔ አምላክ ነኝ ትላለህን? ነገር ግን በገዳይህ እጅ ሰው ነህ እንጂ አምላክ አይደለህም።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken , saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በእንግዶች እጅ ያልተገረዙትን ሰዎች ሞት ትሞታለህ፤ እኔ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በጢሮስ ንጉሥ ላይ ሙሾ አሞሽተህ እንዲህ በለው። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጥበብን የተሞላህ ውበትህም የተፈጸመ መደምደሚያ አንተ ነህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ገነት በዔድን ነበርህ፤ የከበረ ዕንቍስ ሁሉ፥ ሰርድዮን፥ ቶጳዝዮን፥ አልማዝ፥ ቢረሌ፥ መረግድ፥ ኢያስጲድ፥ ሰንፔር፥ በሉር፥ የሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፥ ወርቅ፥ ልብስህ ነበረ፤ የከበሮህና የእንቢልታህ ሥራ በአንተ ዘንድ ነበረ፤ በተፈጠርህበት ቀን ተዘጋጅተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Thou the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee : thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ልትጋርድ የተቀባህ ኪሩብ ነበርህ በተቀደሰው በእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ላይ አኖርሁህ፤ በእሳት ድንጋዮች መካከል ተመላለስህ።

verses.text_english: Thou perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከተፈጠርህበት ቀን ጀምረህ በደል እስኪገኝብህ ድረስ በመንገድህ ፍጹም ነበርህ።

verses.text_english: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.text_amharic: በንግድህ ብዛት ግፍ በውስጥህ ተሞላ ኃጢአትንም ሠራህ፤ ስለዚህ እንደ ርኩስ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ተራራ ጣልሁህ፤ የምትጋርድ ኪሩብ ሆይ፥ ከእሳት ድንጋዮች መካከል አጠፋሁህ።

verses.text_english: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
verses.text_amharic: በውበትህ ምክንያት ልብህ ኰርቶአል፤ ከክብርህ የተነሣ ጥበብህን አረከስህ፤ በምድር ላይ ጣልሁህ ያዩህም ዘንድ በነገሥታት ፊት ሰጠሁህ።

verses.text_english: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
verses.text_amharic: በበደልህ ብዛት በንግድህም ኃጢአት መቅደስህን አረከስህ፤ ስለዚህ እሳትን ከውስጥህ አውጥቻለሁ እርስዋም በልታሃለች፥ በሚያዩህም ሁሉ ፊት በምድር ላይ አመድ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never thou any more.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብም ውስጥ የሚያውቁህ ሁሉ ይደነቁብሃል፤ አንተም ለድንጋጤ ሆነሃል፥ እስከ ዘላለምም አትገኝም።

verses.text_english: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን ወደ ሲዶና አቅንተህ ትንቢት ተናገርባት፥ እንዲህም በል።

verses.text_english: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሲዶና ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፥ በውስጥሽም እከብራለሁ፤ ፍርድንም ባደረግሁባት ጊዜ በተቀደስሁባትም ጊዜ እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ቸነፈርንም በእርስዋ ላይ፥ ደምንም በጎዳናዋ እሰድዳለሁ፤ ከዙሪያዋ በላይዋ ባለ ሰይፍ የተወጉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor grieving thorn of all round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ ለእስራኤል ቤት የሚወጋ እሾህ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ካሉ ካናቋቸው ሁሉ የሚያቈስል ኵርንችት አይሆንም፤ እኔም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤልን ቤት ከተበተኑባቸው አሕዛብ ዘንድ በሰበሰብሁ ጊዜ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት በተቀደስሁባቸው ጊዜ፥ ለባሪያዬ ለያዕቆብ በሰጠኋት ምድራቸው ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I the LORD their God.
verses.text_amharic: ተዘልለውም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ ወይኑንም ይተክላሉ በዙሪያቸውም ባሉ በሚንቋቸው ሁሉ ላይ ፍርድን ባደረግሁ ጊዜ ተዘልለው ይቀመጣሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: In the tenth year, in the tenth , in the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በአሥረኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ፊትህን በግብጽ ንጉሥ በፈርዖን ላይ አድርግ፥ በእርሱና በግብጽ ሁሉ ላይም ትንቢት ተናገር፥

verses.text_english: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river mine own, and I have made for myself.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በወንዞች መካከል የምትተኛና። ወንዙ የእኔ ነው ለራሴም ሠርቼዋለሁ የምትል ታላቅ አዞ፥ የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
verses.text_amharic: በመንጋጋህ መቃጥን አገባብሃለሁ፥ የወንዞችህንም ዓሦች ወደ ቅርፊትህ አጣብቃለሁ፤ ከወንዞችህም መካከል አወጣሃለሁ፥ የወንዞችህም ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ቅርፊትህ ይጣበቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will leave thee into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
verses.text_amharic: አንተንና የወንዞችህን ዓሦች ሁሉ ወደ ምድረ በዳ እጥላለሁ፥ በምድርም ፊት ላይ ትወድቃለህ እንጂ አትከማችም አትሰበሰብም መብልም አድርጌ ለምድር አራዊትና ለሰማይ ወፎች ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በግብጽም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ቤት የሸንበቆ በትር ሆነዋልና እኔ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.text_amharic: በእጅ በያዙህ ጊዜ ተሰበርህ ጫንቃቸውንም ሁሉ አቈሰልህ፤ በተደገፉብህም ጊዜ ተሰበርህ ወገባቸውንም ሁሉ አንቀጠቀጥህ።

verses.text_english: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሰይፍ አመጣብሃለሁ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳንም ከአንተ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I the LORD: because he hath said, The river mine, and I have made .
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽም ምድር ባድማና ውድማ ትሆናለች፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ አንተ። ወንዙ የእኔ ነው የሠራሁትም እኔ ነኝ ብለሃልና።

verses.text_english: Behold, therefore I against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንተና በወንዞችህ ላይ ነኝ፥ የግብጽንም ምድር ከሚግዶል ጀምሮ እስከ ሴዌኔና እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ዳርቻ ድረስ ውድማና ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.text_english: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው እግር አያልፍባትም የእንስሳም ኮቴ አያልፍባትም፥ እስከ አርባ ዓመትም ድረስ ማንም አይኖርባትም።

verses.text_english: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries desolate, and her cities among the cities laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.text_amharic: ባድማም በሆኑ ምድሮች መካከል የግብጽን ምድር ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ፥ በፈረሱትም ከተሞች መካከል ከተሞችዋ አርባ ዓመደ ፈርሰው ይቀመጣሉ፤ ግብጻውያንንም ወደ አሕዛብ እበትናቸዋለሁ በአገሮችም እዘራቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከአርባ ዓመት በኋላ ግብጻውያንን ከተበተኑባቸው አሕዛብ ዘንድ እሰበስባለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽንም ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ወደ ተወለዱባትም ምድር ወደ ጳትሮስ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ በዚያም የተዋረደች መንግሥት ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌሎች መንግሥታት ሁሉ ይልቅ የተዋረደች ትሆናለች፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ በአሕዛብ ላይ ከፍ አትልም፤ በአሕዛብም ላይ እንዳይገዙ አሳንሳቸዋለሁ።
