verses.text_english: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which as the frame of a city on the south.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ራእይ ወደ እስራኤል ምድር አመጣኝ እጅግም በረዘመ ተራራ ላይ አኖረኝ፥ በዚያም ላይ በደቡብ ወገን እንደ ከተማ ሆኖ የተሠራ ነገር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he brought me thither, and, behold, a man, whose appearance like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚያም አመጣኝ፥ እነሆም፥ መልኩ እንደ ናስ መልክ የመሰለ አንድ ሰው በዚያ ነበረ፥ በእጁም የተልባ እግር ገመድና የመለኪያ ዘንግ ነበረ፤ እርሱም በበሩ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew unto thee thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዬውም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ይህን አሳይህ ዘንድ አንተ ወደዚህ ተመርተሃልና በዓይንህ እይ በጆሮህም ስማ በማሳይህም ሁሉ ላይ ልብህን አድርግ፤ የምታየውንም ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ቤት ንገር አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በቤቱ ውጭ በዙሪያው ቅጥር ነበረ፥ በሰውዬውም እጅ የክንዱ ልክ አንድ ክንድ ከጋት የሆነ ስድስት ክንድ ያለበት የመለኪያ ዘንግ ነበረ፤ የቅጥሩንም ስፋት አንድ ዘንግ ቁመቱንም አንድ ዘንግ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, one reed broad; and the other threshold one reed broad.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደሚመለከተውም በር መጣ በደረጃዎቹም ላይ ወጣ፥ በበሩ በኩል ያለውንም የመድረኩን ወለል ወርዱን አንድ ዘንግ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And little chamber one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within one reed.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኛውም ጓዳ ሁሉ ርዝመቱ አንድ ዘንግ፥ ወርዱም አንድ ዘንግ ነበረ፤ በዘበኛውም ጓዳዎች መካከል አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በበሩም ደጀ ሰላም በስተ ውስጥ በኩል የሚገኝ የበሩ የመድረክ ወለል አንድ ዘንግ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ውስጥም ያለውን የበሩን ደጀ ሰላም አንድ ዘንግ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate inward.
verses.text_amharic: የበሩንም ደጀ ሰላም ስምንት ክንድ፥ የግንቡንም አዕማድ ወርድ ሁለት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የበሩም ደጀ ሰላም በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the little chambers of the gate eastward three on this side, and three on that side; they three of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
verses.text_amharic: የምሥራቁም በር የዘበኛ ጓዳዎች በዚህ በኩል ሦስት በዚያም በኩል ሦስት ነበሩ፥ ለሦስቱም አንድ ልክ ነበረ፤ የግንቡም አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ በኩልና በዚያ በኩል አንድ ልክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የበሩንም መግቢያ ወርድ አሥር ክንድ የበሩንም ርዝመት አሥራ ሦስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: The space also before the little chambers one cubit , and the space one cubit on that side: and the little chambers six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
verses.text_amharic: በዘበኛ ጓዳዎችም ፊት በዚህ በኩል አንድ ክንድ በዚያም በኩል አንድ ክንድ የሆነ ዳርቻ ነበረ፤ የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹም በዚህ በኩል ስድስት ክንድ በዚያም በኩል ስድስት ክንድ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: He measured then the gate from the roof of little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth five and twenty cubits, door against door.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንዱም የዘበኛ ጓዳ ደርብ ጀምሮ እስከ ሌላው ደርብ ድረስ የበሩን ወርድ ሀያ አምስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ መዝጊያውና መዝጊያውም ትይዩ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
verses.text_amharic: ደጀ ሰላሙንም ሀያ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ በበሩም ደጀ ሰላም ዙሪያ አደባባይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate fifty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ከበሩም መግቢያ ፊት ጀምሮ እስከ ውስጠኛው የበሩ ደጀ ሰላም መጨረሻ ድረስ አምሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows round about inward: and upon post palm trees.
verses.text_amharic: በዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹም በበሩ ውስጥ በዙሪያው በነበሩትም በግንቡ አዕማድ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶች ነበሩባቸው፤ ደግሞም በደጀ ሰላሙ ውስጥ በዙሪያው መስኮቶች ነበሩ፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ሁሉ ላይ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾባቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers upon the pavement.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውጭውም አደባባይ አመጣኝ፥ እነሆም፥ በአደባባዩ ዙሪያ የተሠሩ ዕቃ ቤቶችና ወለል ነበሩ፤ በወለሉም ላይ ሠላሳ ዕቃ ቤቶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates the lower pavement.
verses.text_amharic: ወለሉም በበሮች አጠገብ ነበረ ይህም ታችኛው ወለል እንደ በሮቹ ርዝመት መጠን ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
verses.text_amharic: ከታችኛውም በር ፊት ጀምሮ እስከ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ ፊት ድረስ ወርዱን አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰሜንም መራኝ፥ እነሆም፥ በውጭው አደባባይ ያለ ወደ ሰሜን የሚመለከት በር ነበረ፤ ርዝመቱንና ወርዱንም ለካ፥

verses.text_english: And the little chambers thereof three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹም በዚህ በኩል ሦስት በዚያም በኩል ሦስት ነበሩ፤ የግንቡ አዕማድና መዛነቢያዎቹም እንደ ፊተኛው በር ልክ ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof before them.
verses.text_amharic: መስኮቶቹም መዛነቢያዎቹም የዘንባባ ዛፎቹም ወደ ምሥራቅ እንደሚመለከተው በር ልክ ነበሩ። ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ሰባት ደረጃዎች ነበሩ መዛነቢያዎቹም በፊቱ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the gate of the inner court over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በሰሜኑና በምሥራቁ በኩል በሌላው በር አንጻር በር ነበረ፤ ከበርም ወደ በር አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደቡብም መራኝ፥ እነሆም፥ ወደ ደቡብ የሚመለከት በር ነበረ፤ የግንቡን አዕማድና መዛነቢያዎቹንም እንደዚያው መጠን አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱና በመዛነቢያዎቹም ዙሪያ እንደ እነዚያ መስኮቶች የሚመስሉ መስኮቶች ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ሰባት ደረጃዎች ነበሩ፥ መዛነቢያዎቹም በፊቱ ነበሩ፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ አንዱ በዚህ አንዱም በዚያ ወገን ሆኖ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾባቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በደቡብ በኩል በር ነበረ፤ ከበር እስከ በር ድረስ በደቡብ በኩል መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብም በር በኩል ወደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ አገባኝ፤ እንደዚያውም መጠን አድርጎ የደቡብን በር ለካ፤

verses.text_english: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚያውም መጠን አድርጎ የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹንና የግንቡን አዕማድ መዛነቢያዎቹንም ለካ፤ በእርሱና በመዛነቢያዎቹም ዙሪያ መስኮቶች ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the arches round about five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም ደጀ ሰላሞች ነበሩ፤ ርዝመታቸውም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ወርዳቸውም አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the arches thereof toward the utter court; and palm trees upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it eight steps.
verses.text_amharic: መዛነቢያዎቹም ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾ ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ስምንት ደረጃዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
verses.text_amharic: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በምሥራቅ በኩል አገባኝ፥ እንደዚያውም መጠን በሩን ለካ፤

verses.text_english: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚያውም መጠን የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹንና የግንቡን አዕማድ መዛነቢያዎቹንም ለካ፤ በእርሱና በመዛነቢያዎቹም ዙሪያ መስኮቶች ነበሩ፥ ርዝመቱም አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the arches thereof toward the outward court; and palm trees upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it eight steps.
verses.text_amharic: መዛነቢያዎቹም በስተ ውጭ ወዳለው አደባባይ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ በዚህና በዚያ ወገን የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾ ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ስምንት ደረጃዎች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured according to these measures;
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜንም ወዳለው በር አመጣኝ፥ እንደዚያውም መጠን ለካው፤

verses.text_english: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የዘበኛ ጓዳዎቹንና የግንቡን አዕማድ መዛነቢያዎቹንም ለካ፤ በዙሪያውም መስኮቶች ነበሩበት፥ ርዝመቱም አምሳ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the posts thereof toward the utter court; and palm trees upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it eight steps.
verses.text_amharic: የግንቡም አዕማድ ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ በግንቡም አዕማድ ላይ በዚህና በዚያ ወገን የዘንባባ ዛፍ ተቀርጾ ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ ስምንት ደረጃዎች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And the chambers and the entries thereof by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: በበሮቹም በግንብ አዕማድ አጠገብ ዕቃ ቤቱና መዝጊያው ነበሩ፤ በዚያም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያጥቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in the porch of the gate two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የኃጢአቱንና የበደሉንም መሥዋዕት ያርዱባቸው ዘንድ፥ በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም በዚህ ወገን ሁለት ገበታዎች፥ በዚያም ወገን ሁለት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, two tables; and on the other side, which at the porch of the gate, two tables.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜን በኩል ባለው በር በስተ ውጭው፥ በመወጣጫው ደረጃዎች አጠገብ፥ በአንድ ወገን ሁለት ገበታዎች ነበሩ፥ በሌላውም ወገን በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም በኩል ሁለት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Four tables on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew .
verses.text_amharic: በበሩ አጠገብ በዚህ ወገን አራት ገበታዎች በዚያም ወገን አራት ገበታዎች ነበሩ፤ መሥዋዕት የሚያርዱባቸው ገበታዎች ስምንት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the four tables of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
verses.text_amharic: ስለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ርዝመታቸው ክንድ ተኩል ወርዳቸውም ክንድ ተኩል ቁመታቸውም አንድ ክንድ የሆኑ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕቱን የሚያርዱበትን ዕቃ ያኖሩባቸው ዘንድ፥ ከተጠረበ ድንጋይ የተሠሩ አራት ገበታዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And within hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables the flesh of the offering.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም አንድ ጋት የሆነ ክፈፍ ወደ ውስጥ ተቀልብሶ ነበር፤ በገበታዎቹም ላይ የቍርባኑ ሥጋ ነበረባቸው።

verses.text_english: And without the inner gate the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which at the side of the north gate; and their prospect toward the south: one at the side of the east gate the prospect toward the north.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ አገባኝ፥ እነሆም፥ ሁለት ቤቶች ነበሩ፤ አንዱ ወደ ሰሜን በሚመለከት በር አጠገብ ነበረ፥ መግቢያውም ወደ ደቡብ ይመለከት ነበር፤ ሌላውም ወደ ደቡብ በሚመለከተው በር አጠገብ ነበረ፥ መግቢያውም ወደ ሰሜን ይመለከት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect toward the south, for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዬውም። ይህ ወደ ደቡብ የሚመለከት ቤት ለማገልገል ለሚተጉ ካህናት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the chamber whose prospect toward the north for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰሜንም የሚመለከተው ቤት መሠዊያውን ለማገልገል ለሚተጉ ካህናት ነው፤ እነዚህ ከሌዊ ልጆች መካከል ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀርቡ የሳዶቅ ልጆች ናቸው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar before the house.
verses.text_amharic: አደባባዩንም በአራት ማዕዘኑ ርዝመቱን መቶ ክንድ ወርዱንም መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ መሠዊያውም በቤቱ ፊት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቱም ደጀ ሰላም አመጣኝ፥ የደጀ ሰላሙንም የግንብ አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን አምስት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን አምስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የበሩም ወርድ አሥራ አራት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በበሩም በዚህ ወገንና በዚያ ወገን የነበሩት ግንቦች ሦስት ሦስት ክንድ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: The length of the porch twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and by the steps whereby they went up to it: and pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
verses.text_amharic: የደጀ ሰላሙም ርዝመት ሀያ ክንድ ወርዱም አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚያደርሱ አሥር ደረጃዎች ነበሩ፤ አንድ በዚህ ወገን አንድም በዚያ ወገን ሆነው በመቃኖቹ አጠገብ የግንብ አዕማድ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, the breadth of the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደሱም አገባኝ፥ የግንቡንም አዕማድ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን ስድስት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን ስድስት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And the breadth of the door ten cubits; and the sides of the door five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የመግቢያውም ወርድ አሥር ክንድ ነበረ፥ የመግቢያውም መቃኖች በዚህ ወገን አምስት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን አምስት ክንድ ነበሩ፤ ርዝመቱንም አርባ ክንድ ወርዱንም ሀያ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውስጥም ገባ፥ የመግቢያውንም የግንብ አዕማድ ወርድ ሁለት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ፤ የመግቢያውም ወርድ ስድስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የመግቢያውም ግንብ ወርድ በዚህ ወገን ሰባት ክንድ በዚያም ወገን ሰባት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This the most holy .
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደሱም ፊት ርዘመቱን ሀያ ክንድ ወርዱንም ሀያ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካና። ይህ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ነው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደሱንም ግንብ ስድስት ክንድ አድርጎ፥ በመቅደሱም ዙሪያ ሁሉ ያሉትን የጓዳዎቹን ሁሉ ወርድ አራት ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And the side chambers three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.
verses.text_amharic: ጓዳዎቹም አንዱ ከአንዱ በላይ በሦስት ደርብ ነበሩ፥ በእያንዳንዱም ደርብ ሠላሳ ጓዳዎች ነበሩ። በመቅደሱም ግንብ ዙሪያ ደገፋዎች ይሆኑ ዘንድ አረፍቶች ነበሩ፥ በመቅደሱም ግንብ ውስጥ ደገፋዎች አልነበሩም።

verses.text_english: And an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house upward, and so increased the lowest to the highest by the midst.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም ዙሪያ ባለ ግንብ ውስጥ በነበሩት አረፍቶች ምክንያት ላይኞቹ ጓዳዎች ከታችኞቹ ጓዳዎች ይበልጡ ነበር፤ ከታችኛውም ደርብ ወደ መካከለኛው ከመካከለኛውም ደርብ ወደ ላይኛው የሚወጣበት ደረጃ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers a full reed of six great cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ለመቅደሱም ከፍ ያለ ወለል በዙሪያው እንዳለው አየሁ፤ የጓዳዎቹም መሠረት ቁመቱ ሙሉ ዘንግ የሚያህል ስድስት ትልቅ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The thickness of the wall, which for the side chamber without, five cubits: and which left the place of the side chambers that within.
verses.text_amharic: የጓዳዎቹም የውጭው ግንብ ውፍረት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በመቅደሱም ጓዳዎች አጠገብ የቀረ አንድ ባዶ ስፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And between the chambers the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
And the doors of the side chambers toward left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left five cubits round about.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራብም በኩል በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር የነበረ ግቢ ስፋቱ ሰባ ክንድ ነበረ። በግቢውም ዙሪያ የነበረ ግንብ ውፍረቱ አምስት ክንድ ርዝመቱም ዘጠና ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Now the building that before the separate place at the end toward the west seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደሱንም ርዝመት መቶ ክንድ፥ የልዩውን ስፍራና ግቢውን ከግንቡ ጋር አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በምሥራቅ በኩል የነበረውን የመቅደሱንና የልዩውን ስፍራ ወርድ አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኋላውም ባለው በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር የነበረውን የግቢውን ርዝመት በዚህና በዚያም ከነበሩት ከግንቦቹ ጋር አንድ መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
verses.text_amharic: መድረኮቹ፥ መቅደሱና በስተ ውስጥ ያለው ክፍል ደጀ ሰላሙም በእንጨት ተለብጠው ነበር፥ በሦስቱም ዙሪያ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶች ነበሩ። መቅደሱም በመድረኩ አንጻር ከመሬት ጀምሮ እስከ መስኮቶቹ ድረስ በእንጨት ተለብጦ ነበር፤ መስኮቶቹም የዓይነ ርግብ ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows covered;
verses.text_amharic: በደጁም ላይ እስከ ውስጠኛው ክፍል ድረስ፥ በውጭም ግንቡ ሁሉ ውስጡም ውጭውም ተለብጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
verses.text_amharic: ኪሩቤልና የዘንባባው ዛፎች ተቀርጸውበት ነበር፤ የዘንባባውም ዛፍ ከኪሩብና ከኪሩብ መካከል ነበረ፤ ለእያንዳንዱም ኪሩብ ሁለት ፊት ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree between a cherub and a cherub; and cherub had two faces;
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ ወገን ወዳለው የዘንባባ ዛፍ የሰው ፊት ይመለከት ነበር፥ በሌላውም ወገን ወዳለው የዘንባባ ዛፍ የአንበሳ ፊት ይመለከት ነበር፤ በቤቱ ሁሉ ዙሪያ እንደዚህ ተደርጎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: So that the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: made through all the house round about.
verses.text_amharic: ከመሬት አንሥቶ እስከ ደጁ ራስ ድረስ ኪሩቤልና የዘንባባ ዛፎች ተቀርጸው ነበር። የመቅደሱ ግንብ እንደዚህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: From the ground unto above the door cherubims and palm trees made, and the wall of the temple.
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደሱ መቃኖችም አራት ማዕዘን ነበሩ፥ የመቅደሱ ፊትም መልኩ እንደ ሌላው መልክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The posts of the temple squared, the face of the sanctuary; the appearance as the appearance .
verses.text_amharic: መሠዊያውም ቁመቱ ሦስት ክንድ ርዝመቱ ሁለት ክንድ ወርዱም ሁለት ክንድ ሆኖ ከእንጨት ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ማዕዘኖቹም እግሩም አገዳዎቹም ከእንጨት ተሠርተው ነበር፤ እርሱም። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለችው ገበታ ይህች ናት አለኝ።

verses.text_english: The altar of wood three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, of wood: and he said unto me, This the table that before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለመቅደሱና ለተቀደሰው ስፍራ ሁለት መዝጊያዎች ነበሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ መዝጊያም ሁለት ተዘዋዋሪ ሳንቃዎች ነበሩት፤ ለአንዱ መዝጊያ ሁለት ለሌላውም መዝጊያ ሁለት ሳንቃዎች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And the doors had two leaves , two turning leaves; two for the one door, and two leaves for the other .
verses.text_amharic: በግንቡም ላይ በተቀረጹት ዓይነት በእነዚህ በመቅደሱ መዝጊያዎች ላይ ኪሩቤልና የዘንባባ ዛፎች ተቀርጸው ነበር፤ በስተ ውጭም ባለው በደጀ ሰላሙ ፊት የእንጨት መድረክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as made upon the walls; and thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
verses.text_amharic: በደጀ ሰላሙም በሁለቱ ወገን በዚህና በዚያ የዓይነ ርግብ መስኮቶችና የተቀረጹ የዘንባባ ዛፎች ነበሩበት፤ የመቅደሱም ጓዳዎችና የእንጨቱ መድረክ እንዲሁ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that over against the separate place, and which before the building toward the north.
verses.text_amharic: በውጭም አደባባይ በሰሜኑ መንገድ አወጣኝ፥ በልዩውም ስፍራ አንጻርና በሰሜን በኩል ባለው ግቢ ፊት ለፊት ወዳለው ዕቃ ቤት አገባኝ።

verses.text_english: Before the length of an hundred cubits the north door, and the breadth fifty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: መቶ ክንድ በሆነው ርዝመት ፊት በሰሜን በኩል መዝጊያ ነበረ ወርዱም አምሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Over against the twenty which for the inner court, and over against the pavement which for the utter court, gallery against gallery in three .
verses.text_amharic: በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በሀያው ክንድ አንጻር በውጭውም አደባባይ በወለሉ አንጻር በሦስት ደርብ በትይዩ የተሠራ መተላለፊያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And before the chambers a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
verses.text_amharic: በዕቃ ቤቶቹም ፊት በስተ ውስጥ ወርዱ አሥር ክንድ ርዝመቱ መቶ ክንድ የሆነ መንገድ ነበረ፤ መዝጊያዎቻቸውም ወደ ሰሜን ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the upper chambers shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
verses.text_amharic: መተላለፊያውም አሳጥሮአቸዋልና ላይኞቹ ዕቃ ቤቶች ከመካከለኞቹና ከታችኞቹ ይልቅ አጫጭር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: For they in three , but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስትም ደርብ ተሠርተው ነበርና፥ በአደባባዩም እንዳሉት አዕማድ፥ አዕማድ አልነበሩላቸውምና ስለዚህ ላይኞቹ ከመካከለኞቹና ከታችኞቹ ይልቅ ጠባብ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the wall that without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof fifty cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በውጭ በዕቃ ቤቶቹ አጠገብ ያለው፥ ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ የሚመለከተው ቅጥር፥ በዕቃ ቤቶች ትይዩ የሆነ፥ ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: For the length of the chambers that in the utter court fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple an hundred cubits.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደሱ ፊት የነበሩት ዕቃ ቤቶች ርዝመታቸው መቶ ክንድ ሲሆን በውጭው አደባባይ በኩል የነበሩት ዕቃ ቤቶች ርዝመታቸው አምሳ ክንድ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And from under these chambers the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም ዕቃ ቤቶች በታች በስተ ምሥራቅ በኩል፥ ሰው ከውጭው አደባባይ የሚገባበት መግቢያ ነበረ። ይህም በቅጥሩ ራስ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The chambers in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብም በኩል በልዩው ስፍራና በግቢው አንጻር ዕቃ ቤቶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the way before them like the appearance of the chambers which toward the north, as long as they, as broad as they: and all their goings out both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ፊታቸውም የነበረ መንገድ በሰሜን በኩል እንደ ነበረው እንደ ዕቃ ቤቶቹ መንገድ ምስያ ነበረ። ርዝመታቸውም ወርዳቸውም መውጫቸውም ሥርዓታቸውም መዝጊያዎቻቸውም በዚያው ልክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And according to the doors of the chambers that toward the south a door in the head of the way, the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡብም በኩል ካሉት ዕቃ ቤቶች በታች በምሥራቅ በኩል በቅጥሩ ራስ አጠገብ መግቢያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto me, The north chambers the south chambers, which before the separate place, they holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place holy.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለኝ። በልዩ ስፍራ አንጻር በሰሜንና በደቡብ በኩል ያሉ ዕቃ ቤቶች፥ እነርሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀርቡ ካህናት ከሁሉ ይልቅ የተቀደሰውን ምግብ የሚበሉባቸው ቤቶች ናቸው። ስፍራው ቅዱስ ነውና በዚያ የተቀደሰውን ነገር የእህሉን ቍርባን የኃጢአቱንና የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ያኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to which for the people.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም በገቡ ጊዜ ከመቅደሱ በውጭው አደባባይ አይወጡም፤ የሚያገለግሉበትን ልብሳቸውን ግን ቅዱስ ነውና በዚያ ያኖሩታል፥ ሌላም ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ ሕዝብ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect toward the east, and measured it round about.
verses.text_amharic: ውስጠኛውንም ቤት ለክቶ በፈጸመ ጊዜ ወደ ምሥራቅ በሚመለከት በር መንገድ አወጣኝ እርሱንም በዙሪያው ለካው።

verses.text_english: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.text_amharic: የምሥራቁን ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.text_amharic: ዞረም፥ የሰሜኑንም ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
verses.text_amharic: ዞረም፥ የደቡቡንም ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: He turned about to the west side, measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.text_amharic: ዞረም፥ የምዕራቡንም ወገን በመለኪያ ዘንግ አምስት መቶ ክንድ አድርጎ ለካ።

verses.text_english: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
verses.text_amharic: በአራቱ ወገን ለካው። የተቀደሰውንና ያልተቀደሰውን ይለይ ዘንድ ርዝመቱ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ወርዱም አምስት መቶ ክንድ የሆነ ቅጥር በዙሪያው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, the gate that looketh toward the east:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምሥራቅም ወደሚመለከተው በር አመጣኝ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ ክብር ከምሥራቅ መንገድ መጣ፤ ድምፁም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምም ነበር፥ ከክብሩም የተነሣ ምድር ታበራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
verses.text_amharic: ያየሁትም ራእይ ከተማይቱን ለማጥፋት በመጣሁ ጊዜ እንዳየሁት ራእይ ነበረ፤ ራእዩም በኮበር ወንዝ እንዳየሁት ራእይ ነበረ፤ እኔም በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።

verses.text_english: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect toward the east.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ወደ ምሥራቅ በሚመለከት በር ወደ መቅደሱ ገባ።

verses.text_english: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈሱም አነሣኝ ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ አገባኝ፤ እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር መቅደሱን ሞልቶት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And I heard speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደሱም ሆኖ የሚናገረኝን ሰማሁ፥ በአጠገቤም ሰው ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለዘላለም የምቀመጥበት የዙፋኔ ስፍራና የእግሬ ጫማ መረገጫ ይህ ነው። ዳግመኛም የእስራኤል ቤትና ነገሥታቶቻቸው በግልሙትናቸውና በከፍታዎቻቸው ባለው በነገሥታቶቻቸው ሬሳ ቅዱስ ስሜን አያረክሱም፤

verses.text_english: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
verses.text_amharic: መድረካቸውን በመድረኬ አጠገብ፥ መቃናቸውንም በመቃኔ አጠገብ አድርገዋልና። በእኔና በእነርሱም መካከል ግንብ ብቻ ነበረ፤ በሠሩትም ርኵሰት ቅዱስ ስሜን አረከሱ፤ ስለዚህ በቍጣዬ አጠፋኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ግልሙትናቸውንና የነገሥታቶቻቸውን ሬሳ ከእኔ ዘንድ ያርቁ፥ እኔም ለዘላለም በመካከላቸው አድራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም የሰው ልጅ፥ ከኃጢአታቸው የተነሣ ያፍሩ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ወገን ይህን ቤት አሳያቸው አምሳያውንም ይለኩ።

verses.text_english: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
verses.text_amharic: ከሠሩትም ሥራ ሁሉ የተነሣ ቢያፍሩ፥ የቤቱን መልክና ምሳሌውን መውጫውንም መግቢያውንም ሥርዓቱንም ሕጉንም ሁሉ አስታውቃቸው፤ ሥርዓቱንና ሕጉን ሁሉ ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ያደርጉትም ዘንድ በፊታቸው ጻፈው።

verses.text_english: This the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about most holy. Behold, this the law of the house.
verses.text_amharic: የቤቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ በተራራው ራስ ላይ ዳርቻው ሁሉ በዙሪያው ከሁሉ ይልቅ የተቀደስ ይሆናል። እነሆ፥ የቤቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And these the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about a span: and this the higher place of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የመሠዊያውም ልክ በክንድ ይህ ነው፥ ክንዱም ክንድ ተጋት ነው። የመሠረቱም ቁመቱ አንድ ክንድ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ነው፥ አንድ ስንዝርም ክፈፍ ዳር ዳሩን በዙሪያው አለ፤ የመሠዊያው መሠረት እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: And from the bottom the ground to the lower settle two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle to the greater settle four cubits, and the breadth cubit.
verses.text_amharic: በመሬቱም ላይ ካለው መሠረት ጀምሮ እስከ ታችኛው እርከን ድረስ ሁለት ክንድ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ነው፤ ከትንሹም እርከን ጀምሮ እስከ ትልቁ እርከን ድረስ አራት ክንድ ወርዱም አንድ ክንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: So the altar four cubits; and from the altar and upward four horns.
verses.text_amharic: ምድጃውም አራት ክንድ ነው፤ በምድጃውም ላይ አንድ ክንድ ወደ ላይ ከፍ የሚሉ አራት ቀንዶች አሉበት።

verses.text_english: And the altar twelve long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የምድጃውም ርዝመት አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ወርዱም አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነው፥ አራቱም ማዕዘን ትክክል ነው።

verses.text_english: And the settle fourteen long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it half a cubit; and the bottom thereof a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
verses.text_amharic: የእርከኑም ርዝመት አሥራ አራት ክንድ ወርዱም አሥራ አራት ክንድ ነው፥ አራቱም ማዕዘን ትክክል ነው፤ በዙሪያውም ያለው ክፈፍ እኩል ክንድ ነው፥ መሠረቱም በዙሪያው አንድ ክንድ ነው፤ ደረጃዎቹም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከታሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡበት ዘንድ ደሙንም ይረጩበት ዘንድ በሚሠሩበት ቀን የመሠዊያው ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ ለሚቀርቡ ከሳዶቅ ዘር ለሚሆኑ ለሌዋውያኑ ካህናት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ወይፈን ትሰጣቸዋለህ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
verses.text_amharic: ከደሙም ትወስዳለህ፥ በአራቱ ቀንዶቹም በእርከኑም በአራቱ ማዕዘን ላይ በዙሪያውም ባለው ክፈፍ ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፤ እንዲሁ ታነጻዋለህ ታስተሰርይለትማለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ወይፈን ትወስዳለህ፥ በመቅደሱም ውጭ በቤቱ በታዘዘው ስፍራ ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse with the bullock.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባለህ፤ በወይፈኑም እንዳነጹት እንዲሁ መሠዊያውን ያነጹበታል።

verses.text_english: When thou hast made an end of cleansing , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: ማንጻቱንም ከፈጸምህ በኋላ ነውር የሌለበትን ወይፈን ከመንጋውም የወጣውን ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ታቀርባለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ታቀርባቸዋለህ፥ ካህናቱም ጨው ይጨምሩባቸዋል፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አድርገው ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀንም በየዕለቱ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን አውራ ፍየልን ታቀርባለህ፥ ነውርም የሌለባቸውን አንድ ወይፈን ከመንጋውም የወጣውን አንድ አውራ በግ ያቀርባሉ።

verses.text_english: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ቀን ለመሠዊያው ያስተሰርያሉ ያነጹትማል፥ እንዲሁም ይቀድሱታል።

verses.text_english: And when these days are expired, it shall be, upon the eighth day, and forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኖቹንም በፈጸሙ ጊዜ በስምንተኛው ቀን ከዚያም በኋላ ካህናቱ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕታችሁን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያደርጋሉ፤ እኔም እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it shut.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምሥራቅም ወደሚመለከተው በስተ ውጭ ወዳለው ወደ መቅደሱ በር አመጣኝ፤ ተዘግቶም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ይህ በር ተዘግቶ ይኖራል እንጂ አይከፈትም፥ ሰውም አይገባበትም፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ገብቶበታልና ተዘግቶ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃው ግን እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ ይቀመጥበታል፤ በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም መንገድ ይገባል በዚያም መንገድ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜኑም በር መንገድ በቤቱ ፊት አመጣኝ፤ እኔም አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበር፤ እኔም በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ ልብ አድርግ ስለ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ሥርዓትና ሕግ ሁሉ የምናገርህን ሁሉ በዓይንህ ተመልከት በጆሮህም ስማ፤ የቤቱንም መግቢያ የመቅደሱንም መውጫ ሁሉ ልብ አድርግ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
verses.text_amharic: ለዓመፀኛው ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ በል። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: In that ye have brought strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራዬን፥ ስብንና ደምን፥ በምታቀርቡበት ጊዜ በመቅደሴ ውስጥ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ቤቴንም ያረክሱ ዘንድ በልባቸውና በሥጋቸው ያልተገረዙትን እንግዶችን ሰዎች አግብታችኋልና፥ እነርሱም በርኵሰታችሁ ሁሉ ላይ ይጨመሩ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳኔን አፍርሰዋልና ርኵሰታችሁ ሁሉ ይብቃችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደሴ ውስጥ ለራሳችሁ ሥርዓቴን ጠባቂዎች አደረጋችሁ እንጂ የተቀደሰውን ነገሬን ሥርዓት አልጠበቃችሁም።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that among the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ካሉት ሁሉ በልቡና በሥጋው ያልተገረዘ እንግዳ ሁሉ ወደ መቅደሴ አይግባ።

verses.text_english: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቁ፥ እስራኤልም በሳቱ ጊዜ ጣዖታቸውን ተከትለው ከእኔ ዘንድ የሳቱ ሌዋውያን ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.text_english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በመቅደሴ ውስጥ አገልጋዮች ይሆናሉ፥ በቤቱም በሮች በረኞች ይሆናሉ በቤቱም ውስጥ ያገለግላሉ፤ ለሕዝቡም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕቱን ያርዳሉ፥ ያገለግሉአቸውም ዘንድ በፊታቸው ይቆማሉ።

verses.text_english: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: በጣዖቶቻቸውም ፊት አገልግለዋቸው ነበሩና፥ ለእስራኤልም ቤት የኃጢአት ዕንቅፋት ሆነዋልና ስለዚህ እጄን በላያቸው አንሥቻለሁ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይሸከማሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy : but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናትም ይሆኑኝ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ አይቀርቡም፥ ወደ ተቀደሰውም ነገሬና ወደ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ነገር አይቀርቡም፤ እፍረታቸውንና የሠሩትንም ርኵሰታቸውን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.text_english: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለአገልግሎቱ ሁሉና በእርሱ ውስጥ ለሚደረገው ሁሉ የቤቱን ሥርዓት ጠባቂዎች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእስራኤል ልጆች ከእኔ ዘንድ በሳቱ ጊዜ የመቅደሴን ሥርዓት የጠበቁ የሳዶቅ ልጆች ሌዋውያን ካህናት ያገለግሉኝ ዘንድ ወደ እኔ ይቀርባሉ፤ ስቡንና ደሙንም ወደ እኔ ያቀርቡ ዘንድ በፊቴ ይቆማሉ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደሴም ይገባሉ ያገለግሉኝም ዘንድ ወደ ገበታዬ ይቀርባሉ ሥርዓቴንም ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በር በገቡ ጊዜ የተልባ እግር ልብስ ይልበሱ፤ በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በርና በቤቱ ውስጥ ባገለገሉ ጊዜ ከበግ ጠጕር አንዳች ነገር በላያቸው አይሁን።

verses.text_english: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird with any thing that causeth sweat.
verses.text_amharic: በራሳቸው ላይ የተልባ እግር መጠምጠሚያ ይሁን፥ በወገባቸውም ላይ የተልባ እግር ሱሪ ይሁን፤ የሚያወዛም ነገር አይታጠቁ።

verses.text_english: And when they go forth into the utter court, into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውጭውም አደባባይ ወደ ሕዝብ በወጡ ጊዜ ያገለገሉበትን ልብሳቸውን ያውልቁ በተቀደሰውም ዕቃ ቤት ውስጥ ያኑሩት፥ ሕዝቡንም በልብሳቸው እንዳይቀድሱ ሌላውን ልብስ ይልበሱ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
verses.text_amharic: ራሳቸውንም አይላጩ የራሳቸውንም ጠጕር ይከርከሙ እንጂ ጠጕራቸውን አያሳድጉ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናቱም ሁሉ በውስጠኛው አደባባይ ሲገቡ የወይን ጠጅ አይጠጡ።

verses.text_english: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
verses.text_amharic: መበለቲቱንና የተፈታችይቱን አያግቡ፤ ከእስራኤል ቤት ዘር ግን ድንግሊቱን ወይም የካህን ሚስት የነበረችይቱን መበለት ያግቡ።

verses.text_english: And they shall teach my people between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰውና ባልተቀደሰው መካከል ይለዩ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን ያስተምሩ፥ ንጹሕና ንጹሕ ባልሆነው መካከል ይለዩ ዘንድ ያሳዩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
verses.text_amharic: ክርክርም በሆነ ጊዜ ለመፍረድ ይቁሙ፤ እንደ ፍርዴ ይፍረዱ፤ በበዓላቴ ሁሉ ሕጌንና ሥርዓቴን ይጠብቁ፥ ሰንበታቴንም ይቀድሱ።

verses.text_english: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይረክሱም ወደ ሞተ ሰው አይግቡ፤ ነገር ግን ለአባት ወይም ለእናት ወይም ለወንድ ልጅ ወይም ለሴት ልጅ ወይም ለወንድም ወይም ላልተዳረች እኅት ይርከሱ።

verses.text_english: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
verses.text_amharic: ከነጻም በኋላ ሰባት ቀን ይቈጠርለት።

verses.text_english: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስም ውስጥ ያገለግል ዘንድ ወደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ ወደ መቅደሱ በሚገባበት ቀን፥ የኃጢአትን መሥዋዕት ያቅርብ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I their possession.
verses.text_amharic: ርስት ይሆንላቸዋል፤ እኔ ርስታቸው ነኝ፤ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ግዛት አትሰጡአቸው፤ እኔ ግዛታቸው ነኝ።

verses.text_english: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉን ቍርባንና የኃጢአትን መሥዋዕት የበደልንም መሥዋዕት ይበላሉ፤ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ እርም የሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ለእነርሱ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the first of all the firstfruits of all , and every oblation of all, of every of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
verses.text_amharic: የበኵራቱ ሁሉ መጀመሪያ ከየዓይነቱ ከቍርባናችሁም ሁሉ የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ለካህናት ይሆናል፤ በቤታችሁም ውስጥ በረከት ያድር ዘንድ የዱቄታችሁን በኵራት ለካህናቱ ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
verses.text_amharic: የበከተውንና የተሰበረውን፥ ወፍ ወይም እንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ካህናት አይብሉት።

verses.text_english: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length the length of five and twenty thousand , and the breadth ten thousand. This holy in all the borders thereof round about.
verses.text_amharic: ርስትም አድርጋችሁ ምድርን በዕጣ በምታካፍሉበት ጊዜ ከምድር የተቀደሰውን የዕጣ ክፍል መባ አድርጋችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታቀርባላችሁ። ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ወርዱም ሀያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፤ በዳርቻው ሁሉ ዙሪያውን የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred , with five hundred , square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ርዝመቱ አምስት መቶ ወርዱም አምስት መቶ ክንድ አራት ማዕዘን የሆነ ቦታ ለመቅደሱ ይሆናል፤ በዙሪያውም ባዶ ስፍራ የሚሆን አምሳ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary the most holy .
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያው ልክ ደግሞ ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ወርዱም አሥር ሺህ ክንድ የሆነ ስፍራ ትለካለህ፤ በእርሱም ውስጥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን የሆነ መቅደስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The holy of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድርም የተቀደሰ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ለሚቀርቡ ለመቅደሱ አገልጋዮች ለካህናቱ ይሆናል፥ ለቤቶቻቸውም የሚሆን ስፍራ ለመቅደስም የሚሆን የተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
verses.text_amharic: ርዝመቱም ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም አሥር ሺህ የሆነ ዕፍራ ለቤቱ አገልጋዮች ለሌዋውያን ይሆናል፥ ለሚቀመጡባቸውም ከተሞች ለራሳቸውም የርስት ይዞታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy : it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለከተማይቱም ይዞታ በተቀደሰው የዕጣ ክፍል መባ አጠገብ ወርዱ አምስት ሺህ ርዝመቱም ሀያ አምስት ሺህ የሆነውን ስፍራ ታደርጋላችሁ። እርሱም ለእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And a for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy , and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy , and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
verses.text_amharic: ለአለቃውም የሆነ የዕጣ ክፍል በተቀደሰው መባና በከተማይቱ ይዞታ አጠገብ በዚህና በዚያ ይሆናል፤ በተቀደሰው መባና በከተማይቱ ይዞታ ፊት በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ምዕራብ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወደ ምሥራቅ ይሆናል፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ አንድ ነገድ ዕጣ ክፍል ሆኖ ከምድሩ ከምዕራቡ ዳርቻ ጀምሮ እስከ ምሥራቁ ዳርቻ ድረስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ይዞታ ይሆንለታል፥ አለቆቼም ለእስራኤል ቤት ምድሪቱን እንደ ነገዳቸው መጠን ይሰጡአቸዋል እንጂ ሕዝቤን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያስጨንቋቸውም።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤል አለቆች ሆይ፥ ይብቃችሁ፤ ግፍንና ብዝበዛን አስወግዱ፥ ፍርድንና ጽድቅንም አድርጉ፤ ቅሚያችሁን ከሕዝቤ ላይ አርቁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.text_amharic: እውነተኛ ሚዛን እውነተኛም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ እውነተኛውም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
verses.text_amharic: የኢፍና የባዶስ መስፈሪያ አንድ ይሁን፤ የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል፥ የኢፍ መስፈሪያውም የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል ይሁን። መስፈሪያው እንደ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And the shekel twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
verses.text_amharic: ሰቅሉም ሀያ አቦሊ ይሁን፤ ሀያ ሰቅል፥ ሀያ አምስት ሰቅል፥ አሥራ አምስት ሰቅል፥ ምናን ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: This the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
verses.text_amharic: የምታቀርቡት መባ ይህ ነው፤ ከአንድ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ስድስተኛ ክፍል፥ ከአንድም ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ገብስ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ስድስተኛ ክፍል ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, an homer of ten baths; for ten baths an homer:
verses.text_amharic: የዘይቱም ደንብ፥ ከእያንዳንዱ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የባዶስን አሥረኛ ክፍል ትሰጣላችሁ፤ አሥር የባዶስ መስፈሪያ አንድ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ውኃም ካለበት ከእስራኤል ማሰማርያ ከመንጋው ከሁለቱ መቶ አንዱን የበግ ጠቦት ትሰጣላችሁ፤ ይህ ያስተሰርይላችሁ ዘንድ ለእህል ቍርባንና ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ይሆናል፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይህን መባ ለእስራኤል አለቃ ይሰጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be the prince's part burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በየበዓላቱም በየመባቻውም በየሰንበታቱም በእስራኤልም ቤት ዓመት በዓል ሁሉ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የመጠጡንም ቍርባን መስጠት በአለቃው ላይ ይሆናል፤ እርሱ ለእስራኤል ቤት ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first , in the first of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ነውር የሌለበትን ወይፈን ውሰድ መቅደሱንም አንጻ።

verses.text_english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑም ከኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ደም ወስዶ በመቅደሱ መቃኖችና በመሠዊያው እርከን በአራቱ ማዕዘን በውስጠኛውም አደባባይ በበሩ መቃኖች ላይ ይርጨው።

verses.text_english: And so thou shalt do the seventh of the month for every one that erreth, and for simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
verses.text_amharic: ከወሩም በሰባተኛው ቀን እንዲሁ አድርግ፥ ይኸውም ስለ ሳተውና ስላላወቀው ሁሉ ነው። እንዲሁም ስለ ቤቱ አስተስርዩ።

verses.text_english: In the first , in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያ ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን የፋሲካን በዓል ታደርጋላችሁ። እስከ ሰባት ቀንም ድረስ ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን አለቃው ለራሱና ለአገሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ወይፈን ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily a sin offering.
verses.text_amharic: በበዓሉም በሰባቱ ቀኖች የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ያቅርብ፤ ሰባቱን ቀኖች በየዕለቱ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሰባት ወይፈንና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ያቅርብ፤ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት በየዕለቱ አንድ አውራ ፍየል ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንድም ወይፈን አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለአንድም አውራ በግ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለአንድም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ለእህል ቍርባን ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: In the seventh , in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
verses.text_amharic: በሰባተኛውም ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በበዓሉ ሰባት ቀኖች፥ የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የእህሉንም ቍርባን ከዘይቱ ጋር እንዲሁ ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውስጠኛው አደባባይ ወደ ምሥራቅ የሚመለከተው በር ሥራ በሚሠራበት በስድስቱ ቀን ተዘግቶ ይቈይ፤ ነገር ግን በሰንበት ቀንና በመባቻ ቀን ይከፈት።

verses.text_english: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃውም በስተ ውጭ ባለው በር በደጀ ሰላሙ መንገድ ገብቶ በበሩ መቃን አጠገብ ይቁም፥ ካህናቱም የእርሱን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቅርቡ፥ እርሱም በበሩ መድረክ ላይ ይስገድ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ይውጣ፥ በሩ ግን እስከ ማታ ድረስ አይዘጋ።

verses.text_english: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩም ሕዝብ በዚያ በር መግቢያ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሰንበታትና በመባቻ ይስገዱ።

verses.text_english: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃውም በሰንበት ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸው ስድስት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነውርም የሌለበት አንድ አውራ በግ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: And the meat offering an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉም ቍርባን ለአውራ በጉ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ይሁን፥ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባን እንደሚቻል ያህል ይሁን፥ ለአንዱም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And in the day of the new moon a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
verses.text_amharic: በመባቻም ቀን ነውር የሌለበትን አንድ ወይፈን፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውንም ስድስት ጠቦቶችና አንድ አውራ በግ ያቅርብ፤

verses.text_english: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.text_amharic: ለወይፈኑም አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለአውራውም በግ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ለጠቦቶቹም እንደ ተቻለው ያህል፥ ለአንዱም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ለእህሉ ቍርባን ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃውም በሚገባበት ጊዜ በበሩ ደጀ ሰላም መንገድ ይግባ በዚያውም ይውጣ።

verses.text_english: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩ ሕዝብ ግን በየክብረ በዓሉ ቀን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት በመጡ ጊዜ በሰሜን በር በኩል ሊሰግድ የሚገባው በደቡብ በር በኩል ይውጣ፥ በደቡብም በር የሚገባው በሰሜን በር በኩል ይውጣ፤ በፊት ለፊት ይውጣ እንጂ በገባበቱ በር አይመለስ።

verses.text_english: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
verses.text_amharic: በሚገቡበት ጊዜ አለቃው በመካከላቸው ይግባ በሚወጡበትም ጊዜ ይውጣ።

verses.text_english: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.text_amharic: በበዓላትና በክብረ በዓል ቀኖች የእህሉ ቍርባን ለወይፈኑ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ፥ ለአውራ በጉ አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ፥ ለጠቦቶቹም እንደሚቻለው ያህል፥ ለኢፍ መስፈሪያም አንድ የኢን መስፈሪያ ዘይት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth shall shut the gate.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃውም በፈቃዱ የሚያቀርበውን መሥዋዕት፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ ወይም በፈቃዱ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበውን የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት፥ ባቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ምሥራቅ የሚመለከተው በር ይከፈትለት፥ በሰንበትም ቀን እንደሚያደርግ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቅርብ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ይውጣ፥ ከወጣም በኋላ በሩ ይዘጋ።

verses.text_english: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
verses.text_amharic: በየዕለቱም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለበትን የአንድ ዓመት በግ ጠቦት ለእግዚአብሔር ያቅርብ፤ በየማለዳው ያቅርበው።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር የእህልን ቍርባን፥ በኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ ዘይት የተለወሰ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ስድስተኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄትን፥ በየማለዳው ያቅርብ፤ ይህ በዘላለሙ ሥርዓት ለእግዚአብሔር የዘወትር የእህል ቍርባን ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning a continual burnt offering.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ዘወትር ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ጠቦቱንና የእህሉን ቍርባን ዘይቱንም በየማለዳው ያቅርብ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it their possession by inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አለቃው ከልጆቹ ለአንዱ ከርስቱ ስጦታ ቢሰጥ ለልጆቹ ይሁን፤ የርስት ይዞታ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከባሪያዎቹ ለአንዱ ከርስቱ ስጦታ ቢሰጥ እስከ ነጻነት ዓመት ድረሰ ለእርሱ ይሁን፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ለአለቃው ይመለስ፤ ርስቱ ግን ለልጆቹ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
verses.text_amharic: አለቃውም ሕዝቡን ከይዞታቸው ያወጣቸው ዘንድ ከርስታቸው በግድ አይውሰድ፤ ሕዝቤ ሁሉ ከይዞታቸው እንዳይነቀሉ ከገዛ ይዞታው ለልጆች ርስትን ይስጥ።

verses.text_english: After he brought me through the entry, which at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there a place on the two sides westward.
verses.text_amharic: በበሩም አጠገብ ባለው መግቢያ ወደ ሰሜን ወደሚመለከተው ለካህናት ወደሚሆን ወደ ተቀደሰው ዕቃ ቤት አገባኝ፤ እነሆም፥ በኋላው በምዕራብ በኩል አንድ ስፍራ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto me, This the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ካህናቱ ሕዝቡን ለመቀደስ ወደ ውጭው አደባባይ እንዳያወጡ የበደሉን መሥዋዕትና የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት የሚቀቅሉበት፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን የሚጋግሩበት ስፍራ ይህ ነው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court a court.
verses.text_amharic: በውጭው አደባባይ አወጣኝ በአደባባይም ወዳለው ወደ አራቱ ማዕዘን አዞረኝ፤ እነሆም፥ በአደባባዩ ማዕዘን ሁሉ አደባባይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: In the four corners of the court courts joined of forty long and thirty broad: these four corners of one measure.
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባዩ በአራቱ ማዕዘን ርዝመቱ አርባ ክንድ ወርዱም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ የታጠረ አደባባይ ነበረ፤ በማዕዘኑ ላሉ ለእነዚህ ለአራቱ ስፍራዎች አንድ ልክ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And a row round about in them, round about them four, and made with boiling places under the rows round about.
verses.text_amharic: በአራቱም ዙሪያ ሁሉ ግንብ ነበረ፥ በግንቡም ሥር በዙሪያው የመቀቀያ ቦታ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto me, These the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እነዚህ የቤቱ አገልጋዮች የሕዝቡን መሥዋዕት የሚቀቅሉባቸው ስፍራዎች ናቸው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደሱም መዝጊያ መለሰኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ውኃ ከቤቱ መድረክ በታች ወደ ምሥራቅ ይወጣ ነበር፥ የቤቱ ፊት ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከት ነበርና፤ ውኃውም ከቤቱ ከቀኝ ወገን በታች በመሠዊያው በደቡብ በኩል ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሜኑም በር በኩል አወጣኝ፤ በስተ ውጭ ባለው መንገድ፥ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደሚመለከት በስተ ውጭ ወዳለው በር አዞረኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ውኃው በቀኙ ወገን ይፈስስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters to the ankles.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዬውም ገመዱን በእጁ ይዞ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወጣ አንድ ሺህም ክንድ ለካ፥ በውኃውም ውስጥ አሻገረኝ፥ ውኃም እስከ ቍርጭምጭሚት ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters to the loins.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ አንድ ሺህ ለካ በውኃውም ውስጥ አሻገረኝ፥ ውኃውም እስከ ጕልበት ደረሰ። ደግሞም አንድ ሺህ ለካ በውኃውም ውስጥ አሻገረኝ፥ ውኃውም እስከ ወገብ ደረሰ።

verses.text_english: Afterward he measured a thousand; a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ አንድ ሺህ ለካ ልሻገረውም የማልችለው ወንዝ ሆነ፤ ውኃውም ጥልቅ ነበረ፥ የሚዋኝበትም ውኃ ነበረ፤ ሰው ሊሻገረው የማይችለው ወንዝ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen ? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፥ አይተሃልን? አለኝ። አመጣኝም፥ ወደ ወንዙም ዳር መለሰኝ።

verses.text_english: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.text_amharic: በተመለስሁም ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በወንዙ ዳር በዚህና በዚያ እጅግ ብዙ ዛፎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ይህ ውኃ ወደ ምሥራቅ ምድር ይወጣል ወደ ዓረባም ይወርዳል ወደ ባሕሩም ይገባል፤ ወደ ባሕሩም ወደ ረከሰው ውኃ በገባ ጊዜ ውኃው ይፈወሳል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው ነፍስ ያለው ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ወንዙ በመጣበት ስፍራ ሁሉ በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ ይህም ውኃ በዚያ ስለ ደረሰ ዓሣዎች እጅግ ይበዛሉ፤ የባሕሩም ውኃ ይፈወሳል፥ ወንዙም በሚመጣበት ያለው ሁሉ በሕይወት ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto Eneglaim; they shall be a to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.text_amharic: አጥማጆችም በዚያ ይቆማሉ፤ ከዓይንጋዲ ጀምሮ እስከ ዓይንኤግላይም ድረስ መረብ መዘርጊያ ይሆናል፤ ዓሣዎችም እንደ ታላቁ ባሕር ዓሣዎች በየወገናቸው እጅግ ይበዛሉ።

verses.text_english: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.text_amharic: እረግረጉና እቋሪው ውኃ ግን ጨው እንደ ሆነ ይኖራል እንጂ አይፈወስም።

verses.text_english: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
verses.text_amharic: በወንዙም አጠገብ በዳሩ ላይ በዚህና በዚያ ፍሬው የሚበላ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይበቅላል፥ ቅጠሉም አይረግፍም ፍሬውም አይጐድልም፤ ውኃውም ከመቅደስ ይወጣልና በየወሩ ሁሉ የፍሬ በኵር ያገኛል፤ ፍሬውም ለመብል ቅጠሉም ለመድኃኒት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph portions.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ርስት አድርጋችሁ ለአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገዶች ምድሪቱን የምትከፍሉበት ድንበር ይህ ነው። ለዮሴፍ ሁለት እድል ፈንታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቶቻችሁ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ምዬ ነበርና እናንተ እኩል አድርጋችሁ ተካፈሉት ይህችም ምድር ርስት ትሆናችኋለች።

verses.text_english: And this the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.text_amharic: የምድሪቱም ድንበር ይህ ነው። በሰሜኑ ወገን ከታላቁ ባሕር ጀምሮ በሔትሎን መንገድ ወደ ጽዳድ መግቢያ፤

verses.text_english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which by the coast of Hauran.
verses.text_amharic: ሐማት፥ ቤሮታ፥ በደማስቆ ድንበርና በሐማት ድንበር መካከል ያለው ሲብራይም፥ በሐውራን ድንበር አጠገብ ያለው ሐጸርሃቲኮን።

verses.text_english: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And the north side.
verses.text_amharic: ድንበሩ ከባሕሩ በደማስቆ ድንበር ላይ ያለው ሐጸርዔናን ይሆናል፥ በሰሜንም በኩል የሐማት ድንበር አለ። የሰሜኑ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And the east side.
verses.text_amharic: የምሥራቁም ድንበር በሐውራን በደማስቆና በገለዓድ በእስራኤልም ምድር መካከል ዮርዳኖስ ይሆናል። ከሰሜኑ ድንበር ጀምሮ እስከ ምሥራቁ ባሕር እስከ ታማር ድረስ የምሥራቁ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the south side southward, from Tamar to the waters of strife Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And the south side southward.
verses.text_amharic: የደቡቡም ድንበር ከታማር ጀምሮ እስከ ሜርባ ቃዴስ ውኃ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ይሆናል። የደቡቡ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: The west side also the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This the west side.
verses.text_amharic: የምዕራቡም ድንበር ከደቡቡ ድንበር ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ አንጻር ድረስ ታላቁ ባሕር ይሆናል። የምዕራቡ ድንበር ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ይህችን ምድር እንደ እስራኤል ነገዶች መጠን ለእናንተ ትካፈላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተና በእናንተ መካከል ለሚቀመጡ በእናንተም መካከል ልጆችን ለሚወልዱ መጻተኞች ርስት አድርጋችሁ በዕጣ ትካፈሉአታላችሁ፤ እነርሱም በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል እንዳሉ የአገር ልጆች ይሆኑላችኋል፥ በእስራኤልም ነገዶች መካከል ከእናንተ ጋር ርስትን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: መጻተኛውም በማናቸውም ነገድ መካከል ቢቀመጥ በዚያ ርስቱን ትሰጡታላችሁ፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Now these the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east west; a Dan.
verses.text_amharic: የነገዶችም ስም ይህ ነው። በሔትሎን መንገድ አጠገብ ወደ ሐማት መግቢያ በደማስቆም ድንበር ባለው በሐጸርዔናን በሐማትም አጠገብ በሰሜን በኩል ካለው ከሰሜን ድንበር ይጀምራል። ወርዳቸውም ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ይሆናል። ለዳን አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a Asher.
verses.text_amharic: ከዳንም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለአሴር አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a Naphtali.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሴርም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለንፍታሌም አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a Manasseh.
verses.text_amharic: ከንፍታሌም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለምናሴ አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a Ephraim.
verses.text_amharic: ከምናሴም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለኤፍሬም አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a Reuben.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤፍሬምም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለሮቤል አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a Judah.
verses.text_amharic: ከሮቤልም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለይሁዳ አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand breadth, and length as one of the parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለመባ የሆነ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል፤ ወርዱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል ርዝመቱም ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ከዕጣ ክፍሎች እንደ አንዱ ይሆናል፥ መቅደሱም በመካከሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት መባ ርዝመቱ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም ሃያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And for them, for the priests, shall be holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand , and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነዚህም ለካህናቱ የተቀደሰ መባ ይሆናል፤ በሰሜን በኩል ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ወርዱ አሥር ሺህ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ወርዱ አሥር ሺህ፥ በደቡብም በኩል ርዝመቱ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል። የእግዚአብሔርም መቅደስ በመካከሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሳቱ ጊዜ፥ ሌዋውያን እንደ ሳቱ ላልሳቱት ሥርዓቴን ለጠበቁት ከሳዶቅ ልጆች ወገን ለተቀደሱት ካህናት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድርም መባ የተለየ መባ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ ከሁሉም ይልቅ የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ በሌዋውያን ድንበር አጠገብ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And over against the border of the priests the Levites five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.text_amharic: በካህናቱም ድንበር አንጻር ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም አሥር ሺህ የሆነ ዕጣ ለሌዋውያን ይሆናል፤ ርዝመቱ ሁሉ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም ሀያ ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for holy unto the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም የተቀደሰ ነውና ከእርሱ ምንም አይሸጡም አይለውጡምም፥ የምድሩም በኵራት አይፋለስም።

verses.text_english: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በሀያ አምስቱም ሺህ አንጻር አምስት ሺህ ወርድ ያለው የቀረ ስፍራ ለከተማይቱ ለጋራ ጉዳይዋ፥ ለመኖሪያ ለማስማርያም ይሆናል፤ ከተማይቱም በመካከሉ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: And these the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ልክዋም ይህ ነው፤ በሰሜን በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በደቡብም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ለከተማይቱም ማሰማርያ ይኖራታል፤ በሰሜን በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በደቡብም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ክንድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy ; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰው መባ አንጻር የተረፈው ርዝመቱ ወደ ምሥራቅ አሥር ሺህ ወደ ምዕራብም አሥር ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል። በተቀደሰው መባ አንጻር ይሆናል። ፍሬውም ከተማይቱን ለሚያገለግሉ ለመብል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ከተማይቱን የሚያገለግሉ ያርሱታል።

verses.text_english: All the oblation five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.text_amharic: መባው ሁሉ ርዝመቱ ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ወርዱም ሀያ አምስት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፤ የተቀደሰውን መባ ከከተማይቱ ይዞታ ጋር አራት ማዕዘን አድርጋችሁ ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the residue for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house in the midst thereof.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀደሰው መባና በከተማይቱ ይዞታ በዚህና በዚያ ወገን የቀረው ለአለቃው ይሆናል፤ በመባው በሀያ አምስቱ ሺህ ፊት ወደ ምሥራቁ ድንበር፥ በምዕራብም በኩል በሀያ አምስቱ ሺህ ፊት ወደ ምዕራቡ ድንበር፥ እንደ ዕጣ ክፍል ሁሉ መጠን፥ ለአለቃው ይሆናል፤ የተቀደሰውም መባና ቤተ መቅደሱ በመካከሉ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, in the midst which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.text_amharic: የሌዋውያንም ርስት የከተማይቱም ይዞታ ለአለቃው በሆነው መካከል ይሆናል፤ በይሁዳ ድንበርና በብንያም ድንበር መካከል የአለቃ ዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin a .
verses.text_amharic: ለቀሩትም ነገዶች እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለብንያም አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon a .
verses.text_amharic: ከብንያምም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለስምዖን አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a .
verses.text_amharic: ከስምዖንም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለይሳኮር አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a .
verses.text_amharic: ከይሳኮርም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለዛብሎን አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a .
verses.text_amharic: ከዛብሎንም ድንበር ቀጥሎ ከምሥራቅ ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራብ ድረስ ለጋድ አንድ የዕጣ ክፍል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar the waters of strife Kadesh, to the river toward the great sea.
verses.text_amharic: ከጋድም ድንበር ቀጥሎ በደቡብ በኩል ድንበሩ ከታማር ጀምሮ እስከ ሜሪባ ቃዴስ ውኃ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ እስከ ታላቁ ባሕር ድረስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: This the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these their portions, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.text_amharic: ርስት አድርጋችሁ ለእስራኤል ነገዶች በዕጣ የምታካፍሉአት ምድር ይህች ናት፥ የእያንዳንዱም ዕጣ እንደዚህ ነው፥ ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And these the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱም መውጫዎች እነዚህ ናቸው። በሰሜን ወገን ልኩ አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the gates of the city after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱ በሮች እንደ እስራኤል ነገዶች ስም ይሆናሉ፤ በሰሜን በኩል አንዱ የሮቤል በር አንዱም የይሁዳ በር አንዱም የሌዊ በር፥ ሦስት በሮች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቁም ወገን አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ሦስትም በሮች አሉ፤ አንዱ የዮሴፍ በር አንዱም የብንያም በር አንዱም የዳን በር ነው።

verses.text_english: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
verses.text_amharic: በደቡቡም ወገን ልኩ አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ሦስትም በሮች አሉ፤ አንዱ የስምዖን በር አንዱም የይሳኮር በር አንዱም የዛብሎን በር ነው።

verses.text_english: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
verses.text_amharic: በምዕራቡም ወገን ልኩ አራት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ክንድ፥ ሦስትም በሮች አሉ፤ አንዱ የጋድ በር አንዱም የአሴር በር አንዱም የንፍታሌም በር ነው።

verses.text_english: round about eighteen thousand : and the name of the city from day , The LORD there.
verses.text_amharic: ዙሪያዋም አሥራ ስምንት ሺህ ክንድ ይሆናል፥ ከዚያም ቀን ጀምሮ የከተማይቱ ስም። እግዚአብሔር በዚያ አለ ተብሎ ይጠራል።

verses.text_english: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄም በነገሠ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥቶ ከበባት።

verses.text_english: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮአቄምን ከእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ዕቃ ከፍሎ በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እርሱም ወደ ሰናዖር ምድር ወደ አምላኩ ቤት ወሰደው፥ ዕቃውንም ወደ አምላኩ ግምጃ ቤት አገባው።

verses.text_english: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring of the children of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the princes;

Children in whom no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as ability in them to stand in the king's palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ነውር የሌለባቸውንና መልከ መልካሞቹን፥ በጥበብ ሁሉ የሚያስተውሉትን እውቀትም የሞላባቸውን ብልሃተኞችና አስተዋዮች የሆኑትን፥ በንጉሡም ቤት መቆም የሚችሉትን ብላቴኖች ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከነገሥታቱና ከመሳፍንቱ ዘር ያመጣ ዘንድ የከለዳውያንንም ትምህርትና ቋንቋ ያስተምሩአቸው ዘንድ ለጃንደረቦች አለቃ ለአስፋኔዝ ነገረ።

verses.text_english: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king's meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ሦስት ዓመት ያሳድጉአቸው ዘንድ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በንጉሡ ፊት ይቆሙ ዘንድ ከንጉሡ መብል ከሚጠጣውም ጠጅ በየዕለቱ ድርጎአቸውን አዘዘላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም መካከል ከይሁዳ ልጆች ዳንኤልና አናንያ ሚሳኤልና አዛርያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.
verses.text_amharic: የጃንደረቦቹም አለቃ ስም አወጣላቸው፤ ዳንኤልን ብልጣሶር፥ አናንያንም ሲድራቅ፥ ሚሳኤልንም ሚሳቅ፥ አዛርያንም አብደናጎ ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.text_amharic: ዳንኤልም በንጉሡ መብልና በሚጠጣው ጠጅ እንዳይረክስ በልቡ አሰበ፤ እንዳይረክስም የጃንደረቦቹን አለቃ ለመነ።

verses.text_english: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በጃንደረቦቹ አለቃ ፊት ለዳንኤል ሞገስንና ምሕረትን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which of your sort? then shall ye make endanger my head to the king.
verses.text_amharic: የጃንደረቦቹም አለቃ ዳንኤልን። መብሉንና መጠጡን ያዘዘላችሁን ጌታዬን ንጉሡን እፈራለሁ፤ በዕድሜ እንደ እናንተ ካሉ ብላቴኖች ይልቅ ፊታችሁ ከስቶ ያየ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከንጉሡ ዘንድ በራሴ ታስፈርዱብኛላችሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.text_amharic: ዳንኤልም የጃንደርቦቹ አለቃ በዳንኤልና በአናንያ በሚሳኤልና በአዛርያ ላይ የሾመውን ሜልዳርን።

verses.text_english: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
verses.text_amharic: እኛን ባሪያዎችህን አሥር ቀን ያህል ትፈትነን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ፤ የምንበላውንም ጥራጥሬ የምንጠጣውንም ውኃ ይስጡን፤

verses.text_english: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king's meat: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የእኛን ፊትና ከንጉሡ መብል የሚበሉትን የብላቴኖችን ፊት ተመልከት፤ እንዳየኸውም ሁሉ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር የወደድኸውን አድርግ አለው።
