verses.text_english: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት እኔ ዳንኤል ሦስት ሳምንት ሙሉ ሳዝን ነበርሁ።

verses.text_english: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: ማለፊያ እንጀራም አልበላሁም፥ ሥጋና ጠጅም በአፌ አልገባም፥ ሦስቱም ሳምንት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ዘይት አልተቀባሁም።

verses.text_english: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which Hiddekel;
verses.text_amharic: ከመጀመሪያውም ወር በሀያ አራተኛው ቀን ጤግሮስ በተባለው በታላቁ ወንዝ አጠገብ ሳለሁ፥ ዓይኔን አነሣሁ፥

verses.text_english: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በፍታ የለበሰውን ጥሩም የአፌዝን ወርቅ በወገቡ ላይ የታጠቀውን ሰው አየሁ።

verses.text_english: His body also like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.text_amharic: አካሉም እንደ ቢረሌ ይመስል ነበር፥ ፊቱም እንደ መብረቅ ምስያ ነበረ፥ ዓይኖቹም እንደሚንበለበል ፋና፥ ክንዶቹና እግሮቹም እንደ ጋለ ናስ፥ የቃሉም ድምፅ እንደ ብዙ ሕዝብ ድምፅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ዳንኤል ብቻዬን ራእዩን አየሁ፥ ከእኔ ጋር የነበሩ ሰዎች ግን ራእዩን አላዩም፤ ነገር ግን ጽኑ መንቀጥቀጥ ወደቀባቸው፥ ሊሸሸጉም ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ብቻዬን ቀረሁ ይህንም ታላቅ ራእይ አየሁ፤ ኃይልም አልቀረልኝም፥ ደም ግባቴም ወደ ማሸብሸብ ተለወጠብኝ፥ ኃይልም አጣሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
verses.text_amharic: የቃሉንም ድምፅ ሰማሁ፤ የቃሉንም ድምፅ በሰማሁ ጊዜ ደንግጬ በምድር ላይ በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and the palms of my hands.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አንዲት እጅ ዳሰሰችኝ፥ በጕልበቴና በእጄም አቆመችኝ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እጅግ የተወደድህ ሰው ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወደ አንተ ተልኬአለሁና የምነግርህን ቃል አስተውል፥ ቀጥ ብለህም ቁም አለኝ። ይህንም ቃል ባለኝ ጊዜ እየተንቀጠቀጥሁ ቆምሁ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ ልብህ ያስተውል ዘንድ፥ ሰውነትህም በአምላክህ ፊት ይዋረድ ዘንድ ካደረግህበት ከመጀመሪያው ቀን ጀምሮ ቃልህ ተሰምቶአል፤ እኔም ስለ ቃልህ መጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.text_amharic: የፋርስ መንግሥት አለቃ ግን ሀያ አንድ ቀን ተቋቋመኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ከዋነኞቹ አለቆች አንዱ ሚካኤል ሊረዳኝ መጣ፤ እኔም ከፋርስ ነገሥታት ጋር በዚያ ተውሁት።

verses.text_english: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision for days.
verses.text_amharic: ራእዩም ገና ለብዙ ዘመን ነውና በኋለኛው ዘመን ለሕዝብህ የሚሆነውን አስታውቅህ ዘንድ አሁን መጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ቃል በተናገረኝ ጊዜ ፊቴን ወደ ምድር አቀረቀርሁ፥ ዲዳም ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ የሰው ልጅ የሚመስል ከንፈሬን ዳሰሰኝ፤ የዚያን ጊዜም አፌን ከፍቼ ተናገርሁ በፊቴም ቆሞ የነበረውን። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ከራእዩ የተነሣ ሕመሜ መጣብኝ፥ ኃይልም አጣሁ።

verses.text_english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የጌታዬ ባሪያ ከዚህ ከጌታዬ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል? አሁንም ኃይል አጣሁ፥ እስትንፋስም አልቀረልኝም አልሁት።

verses.text_english: Then there came again and touched me like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ሰው የሚመስል ዳሰሰኝ፥ አበረታኝም።

verses.text_english: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እጅግ የተወደድህ ሰው ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፤ በርታ፥ ጽና አለኝ። በተናገረኝም ጊዜ በረታሁና። አበርትተኸኛልና ጌታዬ ይናገር አልሁ።

verses.text_english: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ወደ አንተ የመጣሁት ስለ ምን እንደ ሆነ፥ ታውቃለህን? አሁንም ከፋርስ አለቃ ጋር እዋጋ ዘንድ እመለሳለሁ፤ እኔም ስወጣ፥ እነሆ፤ የግሪክ አለቃ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእውነት ጽሑፍ የተጻፈውን እነግርሃለሁ፤ በዚህም ነገር ከአለቃችሁ ከሚካኤል በቀር ማንም የሚያጸናኝ የለም።

verses.text_english: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በሜዶናዊ በዳርዮስ መጀመሪያ ዓመት አጸናውና አበረታው ዘንድ ቆሜ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እውነትን አሳይሃለሁ። እነሆ፥ ሦስት ነገሥታት ደግሞ በፋርስ ይነሣሉ፤ አራተኛውም ከሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ ባለጠጋ ይሆናል፤ በባለጠግነቱም በበረታ ጊዜ በግሪክ መንግሥት ላይ ሁሉን ያስነሣል።

verses.text_english: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.text_amharic: ኃያልም ንጉሥ ይነሣል፥ በትልቅ አገዛዝም ይገዛል፥ እንደ ፈቃዱም ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በተነሣ ጊዜ መንግሥቱ ይሰበራል፤ እስከ አራቱ የሰማይ ነፋሳት ይከፋፈላል። ለዘሩ ግን አይከፋፈልም፥ እንደ ገዛበትም አገዛዝ አይሆንም፤ መንግሥቱ ይነቀላልና፤ ከእነዚህም ለሌሎች ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: And the king of the south shall be strong, and of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion a great dominion.
verses.text_amharic: የደቡብም ንጉሥ ከአለቆቹም አንዱ ይበረታሉ፤ እርሱም ይበረታበታል ይሠለጥንማል፤ ግዛቱም ታላቅ ግዛት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in times.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘመናትም በኋላ ይጋጠማሉ፤ የደቡብም ንጉሥ ሴት ልጅ ቃል ኪዳን ለማድረግ ወደ ሰሜን ንጉሥ ትመጣለች፤ የክንድዋ ኃይል ግን አይጸናም፥ እርሱና ክንዱም አይጸናም፤ እርስዋና እርስዋን ያመጡ የወለዳትም በዚያም ዘመን ያጸናት አልፈው ይሰጣሉ።

verses.text_english: But out of a branch of her roots shall stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከሥርዋ ቍጥቋጥ አንዱ በስፍራው ይነሣል፤ ወደ ሠራዊቱም ይመጣል፥ ወደ ሰሜንም ንጉሥ አምባ ይገባል፥ በላያቸውም ያደርጋል፥ ያሸንፍማል።

verses.text_english: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue years than the king of the north.
verses.text_amharic: አማልክቶቻቸውንና ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎቻቸውን ከብርና ከወርቅም የተሠሩትን የከበሩትን ዕቃዎች ወደ ግብጽ ይማርካል፤ እስከ ጥቂትም ዓመት ድረስ ከሰሜን ንጉሥ ጋር ሳይዋጋ ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: So the king of the south shall come into kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ወደ ደቡብ ንጉሥ መንግሥት ይገባል፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ገዛ ምድሩ ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, to his fortress.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹም ይዋጋሉ፤ ብዙ ሠራዊትንና ሕዝብን ይሰበስባል፤ እርሱም ይመጣል፥ ይጐርፍማል፥ ያልፍማል፤ ተመልሶም እስከ አምባው ድረስ ይዋጋል።

verses.text_english: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.text_amharic: የደቡብም ንጉሥ ይቈጣል ወጥቶም ከሰሜን ንጉሥ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ ብዙ ሕዝብንም ለሰልፍ ያቆማል፥ ሕዝቡም አልፎ በእጁ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened .
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በተወሰደ ጊዜ ልቡ ይታበያል፤ አእላፋትንም ይጥላል፥ ነገር ግን አያሸንፍም።

verses.text_english: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ይመለሳል፥ ከቀደመውም የበለጠ ብዙ ሕዝብ ለሰልፍ ያቆማል፤ በዘመናትና በዓመታትም ፍጻሜ ከታላቅ ሠራዊትና ከብዙ ሀብት ጋር ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን ብዙ ሰዎች በደቡብ ንጉሥ ላይ ይነሣሉ፤ ከሕዝብህም መካከል የዓመፅ ልጆች ራእዩን ያጸኑ ዘንድ ይነሣሉ፤ ነገር ግን ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither strength to withstand.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ይመጣል፥ አፈርንም ይደለድላል፥ የተመሸገችንም ከተማ ይወስዳል፤ የደቡብም ሠራዊት የተመረጡትም ሕዝቡ አይቆሙም፤ ለመቋቋምም ኃይል የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ላይ የሚመጣው ግን እንደ ፈቃዱ ያደርጋል፥ በፊቱም የሚቆም የለም፤ በመልካሚቱም ምድር ይቆማል፥ በእጁም ውስጥ ጥፋት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand , neither be for him.
verses.text_amharic: ከመንግሥቱም ሁሉ ኃይል ጋር ይመጣ ዘንድ ፊቱን ያቀናል፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድነትን ያደርጋል፤ ያረክሳትም ዘንድ ሴትን ልጅ ይሰጠዋል፤ እርስዋም አትጸናም ለእርሱም አትሆንም።

verses.text_english: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause to turn upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ፊቱን ወደ ደሴቶች ይመልሳል፥ ብዙዎችንም ይወስዳል፤ አንድ አለቃ ግን ስድቡን ይሽራል፥ ስድቡንም በራሱ ላይ ይመልሳል።

verses.text_english: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.text_amharic: ፊቱንም ወደ ገዛ ምድሩ አምባዎች ይመልሳል፤ ተሰናክሎም ይወድቃል፥ አይገኝምም።

verses.text_english: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜም በመንግሥቱ ክብር መካከል አስገባሪውን የሚያሳልፍ በስፍራው ይነሣል፤ ነገር ግን በቍጣው ሳይሆን በሰልፍም ሳይሆን በጥቂት ቀን ይሰበራል።

verses.text_english: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ስፍራ የተጠቃ ሰው ይነሣል የመንግሥቱንም ክብር አይሰጡትም፤ በቀስታ መጥቶ መንግሥቱን በማታለል ይገዛል።

verses.text_english: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጐርፍም ሠራዊት ከፊቱ ይወሰዳል፥ እርሱና የቃል ኪዳኑ አለቃ ይሰበራሉ።

verses.text_english: And after the league with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ከተወዳጀ በኋላ በተንኰል ያደርጋል፤ ከጥቂትም ሕዝብ ጋር ወጥቶ ይበረታል።

verses.text_english: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: , and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
verses.text_amharic: በቀስታ ከአገር ሁሉ ወደ ለመለመችው ክፍል ይገባል፤ አባቶቹና የአባቶቹ አባቶች ያላደረጉትንም ያደርጋል፤ ብዝበዛውንና ምርኮውንም ሀብቱንም በመካከላቸው ይበትናል፤ በምሽጎችም ላይ እስከ ጊዜው ድረስ አሳቡን ይፈጥራል።

verses.text_english: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅም ሠራዊት ሆኖ ኃይሉንና ልቡን በደቡብ ንጉሥ ላይ ያስነሣል፤ የደቡብም ንጉሥ በታላቅና በብዙ ሠራዊት ሆኖ በሰልፍ ይዋጋል፤ ነገር ግን አሳብ በእርሱ ላይ ይፈጥራሉና አይጸናም።

verses.text_english: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
verses.text_amharic: መብሉንም የሚበሉ ሰዎች ይሰብሩታል፤ ሠራዊቱም ይጐርፋል፤ ብዙዎችም ተገድለው ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And both these kings' hearts to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end at the time appointed.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሁለት ነገሥታት ክፋትን ያደርጉ ዘንድ በልባቸው ያስባሉ፥ በአንድ ገበታም ተቀምጠው ሐሰት ይናገራሉ፤ ነገር ግን ፍጻሜው እስከ ተወሰነው ጊዜ ነውና አይከናወንላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart against the holy covenant; and he shall do , and return to his own land.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙም ሀብት ጋር ወደ ምድሩ ይመለሳል፥ ልቡም በተቀደሰ ቃል ኪዳን ላይ ይሆናል፤ ፈቃዱንም ያደርጋል፥ ወደ ገዛ ምድሩም ይመለሳል።

verses.text_english: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
verses.text_amharic: በተወሰነውም ጊዜ ይመለሳል ወደ ደቡብም ይመጣል፤ ነገር ግን ኋለኛው እንደ ፊተኛው አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
verses.text_amharic: የኪቲም መርከቦች ይመጡበታልና ስለዚህ አዝኖ ይመለሳል፥ በቅዱሱም ቃል ኪዳን ላይ ይቈጣል፥ ፈቃዱንም ያደርጋል፤ ተመልሶም ቅዱሱን ቃል ኪዳን የተዉትን ሰዎች ይመለከታል።

verses.text_english: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ሠራዊቶች ይቆማሉ፥ መቅደሱንም ግንቡንም ያረክሳሉ፥ የዘወትሩንም መሥዋዕት ያስቀራሉ፥ የጥፋትንም ርኵሰት ያቆማሉ።

verses.text_english: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do .
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኑን የሚበድሉትንም በማታለል ያስታል፤ ነገር ግን አምላካቸውን የሚያውቁ ሕዝብ ይበረታሉ፥ ያደርጋሉም።

verses.text_english: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, days.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡም መካከል ያሉ ጥበበኞች ብዙ ሰዎችን ያስተምራሉ፤ ነገር ግን በሰይፍና በእሳት ነበልባል በምርኮና በመበዝበዝ ብዙ ዘመን ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
verses.text_amharic: በወደቁም ጊዜ በጥቂት እርዳታ ይረዳሉ፤ ብዙ ሰዎችም በግብዝነት ወደ እነርሱ ተባብረው ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.text_english: And of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make white, to the time of the end: because yet for a time appointed.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ተወሰነውም ዘመን ይሆናልና ከጥበበኞቹ አያሌዎቹ እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ይነጥሩና ይጠሩ ይነጡም ዘንድ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም እንደ ፈቃዱ ያደርጋል፤ ራሱንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ በአማልክት ሁሉ ላይ ራሱን ታላቅ ያደርጋል፥ በአማልክትም አምላክ ላይ በትዕቢት ይናገራል፤ ቍጣም እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ይከናወንለታል፥ የተወሰነው ይደረጋልና።

verses.text_english: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶቹንም አማልክት የሴቶችንም ምኞት አይመለከትም፤ ራሱንም በሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ያደርጋልና አማልክትን ሁሉ አይመለከትም።

verses.text_english: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ ፋንታ ግን የአምባዎቹን አምላክ ያከብራል፤ አባቶቹም ያላወቁትን አምላክ በወርቅና በብር በዕንቍና በከበረ ነገር ያከብረዋል።

verses.text_english: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
verses.text_amharic: በእንግዳም አምላክ እርዳታ በጽኑ አምባ ላይ ያደርጋል፤ ለሚያውቁት ክብር ያበዛላቸዋል፥ በብዙም ላይ ያስገዛቸዋል፥ ምድርንም በዋጋ ይከፍላል።

verses.text_english: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.text_amharic: በፍጻሜ ዘመንም የደቡብ ንጉሥ ከእርሱ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ከሰረገሎችና ከፈረሰኞች ከብዙም መርከቦች ጋር እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይመጣበታል፤ ወደ አገሮችም ይገባል፥ ይጐርፍማል፥ ያልፍማል።

verses.text_english: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መልካሚቱም ምድር ይገባል፥ ብዙ አገሮችም ይወድቃሉ፤ ነገር ግን ኤዶምያስና ሞዓብ ከአሞንም ልጆች የበለጡት ከእጁ ይድናሉ።

verses.text_english: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.text_amharic: እጁን በአገሮች ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ የግብጽም ምድር አታመልጥም።

verses.text_english: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians at his steps.
verses.text_amharic: በወርቅና በብርም መዝገብ ላይ፥ በከበረችም በግብጽ ዕቃ ሁሉ ላይ ይሠለጥናል፤ የልብያና የኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ይከተሉታል።

verses.text_english: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሥራቅና ከሰሜን ግን ወሬ ያውከዋል፤ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ይገድል ዘንድና ፈጽሞ ያጠፋ ዘንድ በታላቅ ቍጣ ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሣዊ ድንኳኑንም በባሕርና በከበረው በቅዱስ ተራራ መካከል ይተክላል፤ ወደ ፍጻሜው ግን ይመጣል፥ ማንም አይረዳውም።

verses.text_english: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ዘመን ስለ ሕዝብህ ልጆች የሚቆመው ታላቁ አለቃ ሚካኤል ይነሣል፤ ሕዝብም ከሆነ ጀምሮ እስከዚያ ዘመን ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ያልሆነ የመከራ ዘመን ይሆናል፤ በዚያም ዘመን በመጽሐፉ ተጽፎ የተገኘው ሕዝብህ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ይድናል።

verses.text_english: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame everlasting contempt.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ትቢያ ውስጥ ካንቀላፉቱ ብዙዎች ይነቃሉ፤ እኵሌቶቹ ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት፥ እኵሌቶቹም ወደ እፍረትና ወደ ዘላለም ጕስቍልና።

verses.text_english: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበበኞቹም እንደ ሰማይ ፀዳል፥ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ወደ ጽድቅ የሚመልሱ እንደ ከዋክብት ለዘላለም ይደምቃሉ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.text_amharic: ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ድረስ ቃሉን ዝጋ፥ መጽሐፉንም አትም፤ ብዙ ሰዎች ይመረምራሉ፥ እውቀትም ይበዛል።

verses.text_english: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ዳንኤል አየሁ፤ እነሆም፥ ሁለት ሌሎች ቆመው ነበር፥ አንዱ በዚህ በወንዙ ዳር፥ ሌላውም በዚያ በወንዙ ዳር።

verses.text_english: And said to the man clothed in linen, which upon the waters of the river, How long the end of these wonders?
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ከወንዙ ውኃ በላይ የነበረውን በፍታም የለበሰውን። የዚህ ድንቅ ፍጻሜ እስከ መቼ ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these shall be finished.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንዙም ውኃ በላይ የነበረው በፍታም የለበሰው ሰው ቀኝና ግራ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሥቶ። ለዘመንና ለዘመናት ለዘመንም እኵሌታ ነው፤ የተቀደሰውም ሕዝብ ኃይል መበተን በተጨረሰ ጊዜ ይህ ሁሉ ይፈጸማል ብሎ ለዘላለም ሕያው ሆኖ በሚኖረው ሲምል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what the end of these ?
verses.text_amharic: ሰማሁም ነገር ግን አላስተዋልሁም፤ የዚያን ጊዜም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ የዚህ ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ምንድር ነው? አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ ቃሉ እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ድረስ የተዘጋና የታተመ ነውና ሂድ፤

verses.text_english: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች ሰውነታቸውን ያጠራሉ ያነጡማል ይነጥሩማል፤ ክፉዎች ግን ክፋትን ያደርጋሉ፤ ክፉዎችም ሁሉ አያስተውሉም፥ ጥበበኞች ግን ያስተውላሉ።

verses.text_english: And from the time the daily shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.text_amharic: የዘወትሩም መሥዋዕት ከቀረ ጀምሮ፥ የጥፋትም ርኵሰት ከቆመ ጀምሮ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ዘጠና ቀን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Blessed he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.text_amharic: የሚታገሥ፥ እስከ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት ቀንም የሚደርስ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.text_english: But go thou thy way till the end : for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን እስከ ፍጻሜው ድረስ ሂድ፤ አንተም ታርፋለህ፥ በቀኑም መጨረሻ በዕጣ ክፍልህ ትቆማለህ።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያንና በኢዮአታም በአካዝና በሕዝቅያስም ዘመን በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን ወደ ብኤሪ ልጅ ወደ ሆሴዕ የመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, from the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መጀመሪያ በሆሴዕ በተናገረ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሆሴዕን። ምድሪቱ ከእግዚአብሔር ርቃ ታላቅ ግልሙትና ታደርጋለችና ሂድ፤ ጋለሞታን ሴትና የግልሙትናን ልጆች ለአንተ ውሰድ አለው።

verses.text_english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሄዶ የዴቤላይምን ልጅ ጎሜርን አገባ፤ እርስዋም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደችለት።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ከጥቂት ዘመን በኋላ የኢይዝራኤልን ደም በኢዩ ቤት ላይ እበቀላለሁና፥ ከእስራኤልም ቤት መንግሥትን እሽራለሁና ስሙን ኢይዝራኤል ብለህ ጥራው፤

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በኢይዝራኤል ሸለቆ ውስጥ የእስራኤልን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And said unto him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ፀነሰች ሴት ልጅንም ወለደች። እግዚአብሔርም። ይቅር እላቸው ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ቤት ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልምርምና ስምዋን ሎሩሃማ ብለህ ጥራት፤

verses.text_english: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የይሁዳን ቤት እምራለሁ፤ በአምላካቸውም በእግዚአብሔር አድናቸዋለሁ እንጂ በቀስት ወይም በሰይፍ ወይም በሰልፍ ወይም በፈረሶች ወይም በፈረሰኞች አላድናቸውም አለው።

verses.text_english: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
verses.text_amharic: ሎሩሃማም ጡት ባስጣለች ጊዜ፥ ደግሞ ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች።

verses.text_english: Then said , Call his name Loammi: for ye not my people, and I will not be your .
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁምና፥ እኔም አምላክ አልሆናችሁምና ስሙን ሎዓሚ ብለህ ጥራው አለው።

verses.text_english: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, in the place where it was said unto them, Ye not my people, it shall be said unto them, the sons of the living God.
Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great the day of Jezreel.
Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ቍጥር እንደማይሰፈርና እንደማይቈጠር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ይሆናል፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁም ተብሎ በተነገረበት በዚያ ስፍራ የሕያው አምላክ ልጆች ይባላሉ።

verses.text_english: Plead with your mother, plead: for she not my wife, neither I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ልጆችና የእስራኤል ልጆች በአንድነት ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ለእነርሱም አንድ አለቃ ይሾማሉ፥ ከምድሪቱም ይወጣሉ፤ የኢይዝራኤል ቀን ታላቅ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻችሁን። ዓሚ፥ እኅቶቻችሁንም። ሩሃማ በሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they the children of whoredoms.
verses.text_amharic: እናታችሁ ሚስቴ አይደለችምና፥ እኔም ባልዋ አይደለሁምና ተምዋገቱ፤ ከእናታችሁ ጋር ተምዋገቱ። ግልሙትናዋን ከፊትዋ፥ ምንዝርናዋንም ከጡቶችዋ መካከል ታስወግድ፤

verses.text_english: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
verses.text_amharic: ዕራቁትዋን እንዳልገፍፋት፥ እንደ ተወለደችበትም ቀን እንዳላደርጋት፥ እንደ ምድረ በዳና እንደ ደረቅ ምድር እንዳላደርጋት፥ በጥማትም እንዳልገድላት፤

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.text_amharic: የግልሙትናዋ ልጆች ናቸውና ልጆችዋን አልምርም።

verses.text_english: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find : then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then better with me than now.
verses.text_amharic: እናታቸው አመንዝራለች፤ የፀነሰቻቸውም። እንጀራዬንና ውኃዬን፥ ጥጤንና የተልባ እግሬን፥ ዘይቴንና መጠጤን ከሚሰጡኝ ከውሽሞቼ በኋላ እሄዳለሁ ብላ አስነወረቻቸው።

verses.text_english: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, they prepared for Baal.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ መንገድሽን በእሾህ እዘጋለሁ፥ መንገድዋንም እንዳታገኝ ቅጥርን እቀጥርባታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax to cover her nakedness.
verses.text_amharic: ውሽሞችዋንም ትከተላለች፥ ነገር ግን አትደርስባቸውም፤ ትፈልጋቸውማለች፥ ነገር ግን አታገኛቸውም፤ እርስዋም። ከዛሬ ይልቅ የዚያን ጊዜ ይሻለኝ ነበርና ተመልሼ ወደ ቀደመው ባሌ እሄዳለሁ ትላለች።

verses.text_english: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም እህልንና ወይንን ጠጅ ዘይትንም የሰጠኋት፥ ለበኣልም የተሠራውን ብርና ወርቅ ያበዛሁላት እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ አላወቀችም።

verses.text_english: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እህሌን በጊዜዋ፥ ወይን ጠጄንም በወረትዋ እወስዳለሁ፥ ዕራቁትነትዋንም እንዳትሸፍን ጥጤንና የተልባ እግሬን እገፍፋታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ውሽሞችዋ እያዩ ነውርዋን እገልጣለሁ፤ ከእጄም ማንም አያድናትም።

verses.text_english: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ደስታዋንም ሁሉ፥ በዓላቶችዋንም፥ መባቻዎችዋንም፥ ሰንበቶችዋንም፥ የተቀደሱትንም ጉባኤዎችን ሁሉ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ውሽሞቼ የሰጡኝ ዋጋዬ ይህ ነው ያለችውን ወይንዋንና በለስዋን አጠፋለሁ፤ ዱርም አደርገዋለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን ረስታ ውሽሞችዋን እየተከተለች፥ በጕትቾችዋና በጌጥዋም እያጌጠች ለበኣሊም ያጠነችበትን ወራት እበቀልባታለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አባብላታለሁ፥ ወደ ምድረ በዳም አመጣታለሁ፥ ለልብዋም እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም የወይን ቦታዋን፥ የተስፋ በርም እንዲሆንላት የአኮርን ሸለቆ እሰጣታለሁ፤ በዚያም ከግብጽ ምድር እንደ ወጣችበት ቀን እንደ ሕፃንነትዋ ወራት ትዘምራለች።

verses.text_english: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ባሌ ብለሽ ትጠሪኛለሽ እንጂ ዳግመኛ በኣሌ ብለሽ አትጠሪኝም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
verses.text_amharic: የበኣሊምን ስም ከአፍዋ አስወግደዋለሁና፥ በስማቸውም እንግዲህ አይታሰቡምና።

verses.text_english: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ከምድር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ከመሬትም ተንቀሳቃሾች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደርግላቸዋለሁ፤ ቀስትንና ሰይፍን ሰልፍንም ከምድሩ እሰብራለሁ፥ ተከልለውም እንዲኖሩ አስተኛቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
verses.text_amharic: ለዘላለምም ለእኔ እንድትሆኚ አጭሻለሁ፤ በጽድቅና በፍርድ በምሕረትና በርኅራኄ አጭሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔም እንድትሆኚ በመታመን አጭሻለሁ፤ አንቺም እግዚአብሔርን ታውቂአለሽ።

verses.text_english: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to not my people, Thou my people; and they shall say, my God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያንም ቀን እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለሰማይ እመልሳለሁ፥ ሰማይም ለምድር ይመልሳል፤

verses.text_english: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሌሎች አማልክት ቢመለሱና የዘቢብ ጥፍጥፍን ቢወድዱ እንኳ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደሚወድዳቸው አንተም ውሽማዋን የምትወድደውን አመንዝራይትን ሴት ውደድ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: So I bought her to me for fifteen of silver, and an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም በአሥራ አምስት ብርና በአንድ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ተኩል ገብስ ገዛኋት።

verses.text_english: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for man: so I also for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ብዙ ወራት ተቀመጪ፥ አታመንዝሪም፥ ለሌላ ሰውም አትሁኚ፤ እኔም እንዲሁ እሆንልሻለሁ አልኋት።

verses.text_english: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and teraphim:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ልጆች ያለ ንጉሥና ያለ አለቃ፥ ያለ መሥዋዕትና ያለ ዓምድ፥ ያለ ኤፉድና ያለ ተራፊም ብዙ ወራት ይቀመጣሉና፤

verses.text_english: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተመልሰው አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሣቸውን ዳዊትን ይፈልጋሉ፤ በኋለኛውም ዘመን ፈርተው ወደ እግዚአብሔርና ወደ በረከቱ ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እውነትና ምሕረት እግዚአብሔርንም ማወቅ በምድር ስለሌለ እግዚአብሔር በምድሩ ላይ ከሚኖሩ ጋር ክርክር አለውና የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.text_english: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.text_amharic: እርግማንና ሐሰት ግዳይና ስርቆት ምንዝርናም ወጥተዋል፤ ደምም ወደ ደም ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱ ታለቅሳለች፥ በእርስዋም የሚቀመጡ ሁሉ ከምድር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር ይደክማሉ፤ የባሕሩም ዓሦች ያልቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people as they that strive with the priest.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሕዝብህ ከካህን ጋር እንደሚከራከሩ ናቸውና ማንም አይከራከር፥ ማንም አይዝለፍ።

verses.text_english: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.text_amharic: በቀንም ትሰናከላለህ፥ ነቢዩም ከአንተ ጋር በሌሊት ይሰናከላል፤ እናትህንም አጠፋታለሁ።

verses.text_english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤ እውቀት ከማጣቱ የተነሣ ጠፍቶአል፤ አንተም እውቀትን ጠልተሃልና እኔ ካህን እንዳትሆነኝ እጠላሃለሁ፤ የአምላክህንም ሕግ ረስተሃልና እኔ ደግሞ ልጆችህን እረሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: will I change their glory into shame.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ብዛታቸው መጠን ኃጢአት ሠሩብኝ፤ እኔም ክብራቸውን ወደ ነውር እለውጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝቤም ኃጢአት መብል ሆኖላቸዋል፥ ልባቸውንም ወደ በደላቸው አድርገዋል።

verses.text_english: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ካህኑ ይሆናል፤ በመንገዳቸውም እበቀላቸዋለሁ፥ ሥራቸውንም እመልስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም መጠበቅ ትተዋልና ሲበሉ አይጠግቡም፥ ሲያመነዝሩም አይበዙም።

verses.text_english: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.text_amharic: ግልሙትናና የወይን ጠጅ ስካርም አእምሮን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
verses.text_amharic: የግልሙትና መንፈስ ሕዝቤን አስቶአቸዋልና፥ እነርሱም ከአምላካቸው ርቀው አመንዝረዋልና በትራቸውን ይጠይቃሉ፥ ዘንጋቸውም ይመልስላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.text_amharic: በተራሮችም ራስ ላይ ይሠዋሉ፤ ጥላውም መልካም ነውና ከኮምበልና ከልብን ከአሆማም ዛፍ በታች በኮረብቶች ላይ ያጥናሉ፤ ስለዚህ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ይገለሙታሉ፥ ሙሽሮቻችሁም ያመነዝራሉ።

verses.text_english: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people doth not understand shall fall.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችም ደግሞ ከጋለሞቶች ጋር ይጫወታሉና፥ ከጋለሞቶችም ጋር ይሠዋሉና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ በገለሞቱ ጊዜ፥ ሙሽሮቻችሁም ባመነዘሩ ጊዜ አልቀጣቸውም፤ የማያስተውልም ሕዝብ ይገለበጣል።

verses.text_english: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ብታመነዝር ይሁዳ አይበድል፤ እናንተም ወደ ጌልገላ አትግቡ፥ ወደ ቤትአዌንም አትውጡ፥ ወይም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብላችሁ አትማሉ።

verses.text_english: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል እንደ እልከኛ ጊደር እንቢ ብሎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርስ በሰፊው ቦታ እንደ ጠቦት ያሰማራዋልን?

verses.text_english: Ephraim joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ከጣዖታት ጋር ተጋጠመ፤ ተወው።

verses.text_english: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers shame do love, Give ye.
verses.text_amharic: ስካርን ፈጽመዋል፥ ግልሙትናንም አብዝተዋል፤ አለቆችዋም ነውርን እጅግ ወደዱ።

verses.text_english: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስ በክንፍዋ አስሮአታል፤ ከመሥዋዕታቸውም የተነሣ ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.text_amharic: ካህናት ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤ የንጉሥ ቤት ሆይ፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤ በምጽጳ ላይ ወጥመድ፥ በታቦርም ላይ የተዘረጋ አሽክላ ሆናችኋልና ፍርድ በእናንተ ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I a rebuker of them all.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፀኞችም እርድ አብዝተዋል፤ እኔ ግን እነዚያን ሁሉ እዘልፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, Israel is defiled.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬምን አውቀዋለሁ፥ እስራኤልም ከእኔ አልተሰወረም፤ ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ ዛሬ አመንዝረሃል፥ እስራኤልም ረክሶአል።

verses.text_english: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አምላካቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ሥራቸውን አላቀኑም፤ የግልሙትና መንፈስ በውስጣቸው አለና፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አላውቁምና።

verses.text_english: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ትዕቢት በፊቱ ይመሰክራል፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤልና ኤፍሬም በኃጢአታቸው ይሰናከላሉ፤ ይሁዳም ደግሞ ከእነሱ ጋር ይሰናከላል።

verses.text_english: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find ; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም ለመሻት በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ነድተው ይሄዳሉ፤ ነገር ግን እርሱ ከእነርሱም ተመልሶአልና አያገኙትም።

verses.text_english: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.text_amharic: ዲቃሎችን ልጆች ወልደዋልና እግዚአብሔርን ወንጅለዋል፤ አሁንም አንድ ወር እነርሱንና ርስታቸውን ይበላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.text_amharic: በጊብዓ መለከትን፥ በራማ እንቢልታን ንፉና። ብንያም ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በኋላ እያላችሁ በቤትአዌን ላይ እሪ በሉ።

verses.text_english: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም በዘለፋ ቀን የፈረሰ ይሆናል። በእስራኤል ነገዶች ዘንድ በእርግጥ የሚሆነውን ነገር ገልጫለሁ።

verses.text_english: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ አለቆች ድምበርን እንደሚነቅሉ ሆነዋል፤ እኔም መዓቴን እንደ ውኃ አፈስስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Ephraim oppressed broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ከትእዛዝ በኋላ መሄድን ወድዶአልና የተገፋና በፍርድ የተጐዳ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: Therefore I unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ለኤፍሬም እንደ ብል፥ ለይሁዳም ቤት እንደ ነቀዝ ሆኜአለሁ።

verses.text_english: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬምም ደዌውን፥ ይሁዳም ቍስሉን ባየ ጊዜ ኤፍሬም ወደ አሦር ሄደ ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ኢያሪም መልእክተኛን ላከ፤ እርሱ ግን ይፈውሳችሁ ዘንድ፥ ከቊስላችሁም ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: For I unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue .
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ለኤፍሬም እንደ አንበሳ፥ ለይሁዳም ቤት እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል እሆናለሁና፤ እኔም ነጥቄ እሄዳለሁ እወስድማለሁ፥ የሚያድንም አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: I will go return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.text_amharic: በደላቸውንም እስኪያውቁ ድረስ፥ ፊቴንም እስኪሹ ድረስ ሄጄ ወደ ስፍራዬ እመለሳለሁ፤ በመከራቸው ጊዜ እጅግ አድርገው ፊቴን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.text_amharic: ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንመለስ፤ እርሱ ሰብሮናልና፥ እርሱም ይፈውሰናል፤ እርሱ መትቶናል፥ እርሱም ይጠግነናል።

verses.text_english: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ያድነናል፤ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ያስነሣናል፥ በፊቱም በሕይወት እንኖራለን።

verses.text_english: Then shall we know, we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter former rain unto the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እንወቅ፤ እናውቀውም ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን እንከተል፤ እንደ ወገግታም ተዘጋጅቶ እናገኘዋለን፤ እንደ ዝናብም ምድርንም እንደሚያጠጣ እንደ መጨረሻ ዝናብ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረታችሁ እንደ ማለዳ ደመና፥ በማለዳም እንደሚያልፍ ጠል ነውና ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግልህ? ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግልህ?

verses.text_english: Therefore have I hewed by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments the light goeth forth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በነቢያት እጅ ቈረጥኋቸው፥ በአፌም ቃል ገደልኋቸው፤ ፍርዴም እንደ ብርሃን ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ከመሥዋዕት ይልቅ ምሕረትን፥ ከሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ እወድዳለሁና።

verses.text_english: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን እንደ አዳም ቃል ኪዳንን ተላልፈዋል፤ በዚያም ላይ ወንጅለውኛል።

verses.text_english: Gilead a city of them that work iniquity, polluted with blood.
verses.text_amharic: ገለዓድ ኃጢአትን የሚሠሩ ሰዎች ከተማ፥ በደምም የተቀባ ነው።

verses.text_english: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰውም እንደሚያደቡ ወንበዴዎች፥ እንዲሁ የካህናት ወገኖች በሴኬም መንገድ ላይ ይገድላሉ፤ ሴሰኝነትንም ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራኤል ቤት የሚያስፈራን ነገር አይቻለሁ፤ በዚያ በኤፍሬም ውስጥ ግልሙትና ተገኘ፥ እስራኤልም ረክሶአል።

verses.text_english: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ የሕዝቤን ምርኮ በምመልስበት ጊዜ ለአንተ ደግሞ መከር ተወስኖልሃል።

verses.text_english: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, the troop of robbers spoileth without.
verses.text_amharic: በሐሰት አድርገዋልና፥ ሌባም ገብቶአልና፥ በውጭም ወንበዴዎች ቀምተዋልና እስራኤልን እፈውስ ዘንድ በወደድሁ ጊዜ የኤፍሬም ኃጢአትና የሰማርያ ክፋት ተገለጠ።

verses.text_english: And they consider not in their hearts I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ክፋታቸውን ሁሉ እንዳሰብሁ በልባቸው አያስቡም አሁንም ሥራቸው ከብባቸዋለች፥ በፊቴም አለች።

verses.text_english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡን በክፋታቸው፥ አለቆቹንም በሐሰታቸው ደስ አሰኝተዋል።

verses.text_english: They all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም አመንዝራዎች ናቸው፤ ጋጋሪ እንደሚያነድድበት እንደ ምድጃ ናቸው፤ ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ እሳትን መቈስቈስና እርሾን መለወስ ይቆያል።

verses.text_english: In the day of our king the princes have made sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሣችን ቀን አለቆች ከወይን ጠጅ ሙቀት የተነሣ ታመሙ፤ እርሱም ከዋዘኞች ጋር እጁን ዘረጋ።

verses.text_english: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.text_amharic: እያደቡ ልባቸውን እንደ ምድጃ አዘጋጅተዋል፤ አበዛቸውም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አንቀላፋ፤ በጠባም ጊዜ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ይነድዳል።

verses.text_english: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም እንደ ምድጃ ግለዋል፥ ፈራጆቻቸውንም በሉ፤ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ወደቁ፤ ከእነርሱም ወደ እኔ የሚጮኽ የለም።

verses.text_english: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ከአሕዛብ ጋር ተደባለቀ፤ ኤፍሬም እንዳልተገላበጠ ቂጣ ነው።

verses.text_english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዶች ጕልበቱን በሉት፥ እርሱም አላወቀም፤ ሽበትም ወጣበት፥ እርሱም አላወቀም።

verses.text_english: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤልም ትዕቢቱ በፊቱ መሰከረ፤ ወደ አምላካቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ግን አልተመለሱም፥ በዚህም ሁሉ አልፈለጉትም።

verses.text_english: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬምም አእምሮ እንደሌላት እንደ ሰነፍ ርግብ ነው፤ ግብጽን ጠሩ፥ ወደ አሦርም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄዱ አሽክላዬን አዘረጋባቸዋለሁ፤ እንደ ሰማይ ወፎች አወርዳቸዋለሁ፤ መከራቸውን ሲሰሙ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ፈቀቅ ብለዋልና ወዮላቸው! በእኔም ላይ ዐመፀዋልና ጥፋት ይምጣባቸው! እኔ ልታደጋቸው ወደድሁ፥ እነርሱ ግን በሐሰት ተናገሩብኝ።

verses.text_english: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, they rebel against me.
verses.text_amharic: በመኝታቸው ላይ ሆነው ያለቅሱ ነበር እንጂ በልባቸው ወደ እኔ አልጮኹም፤ ስለ እህልና ስለ ወይን ጠጅ ይሰበሰቡ ነበር፤ በእኔም ላይ ዐመፁ።

verses.text_english: Though I have bound strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ክንዳቸውን አስተማርሁና አጸናሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን ክፉ ነገርን መከሩብኝ።

verses.text_english: They return, not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ከንቱ ነገር ተመለሱ፤ እንደ ተንኰለኛ ቀስት ሆኑ፤ አለቆቻቸው ከምላሳቸው ቍጣ የተነሣ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፤ ይህ በግብጽ ምድር ውስጥ መሳለቂያ ይሆንባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: the trumpet to thy mouth. as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.text_amharic: መለከትን ወደ አፍህ አቅርብ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔን ተላልፈዋልና፥ በሕጌም ላይ ዐምፀዋልና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ላይ እንደ ንስር ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኛ እስራኤል አወቅንህ ብለው ወደ እኔ ይጮኻሉ።

verses.text_english: Israel hath cast off good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ደግነትን ጥሎአል፤ ጠላትም ያሳድዱታል።

verses.text_english: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሳቸው ነገሥታትን አነገሡ፥ ከእኔም ዘንድ አይደለም፤ አለቆችንም አደረጉ፥ እኔም አላወቅሁም፤ ለጥፋታቸውም ከብራቸውና ከወርቃቸው፤ ጣዖታትን ለራሳቸው አደረጉ።

verses.text_english: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long ere they attain to innocency?
verses.text_amharic: ሰማርያ ሆይ፥ እምቦሳህን፤ ጥሎአል፤ ቍጣዬ በላያቸው ነድዶአል፤ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ንጹሕ ሊሆኑ አይችሉም?

verses.text_english: For from Israel it also: the workman made it; therefore it not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ደግሞ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ነው፤ ሠራተኛ ሠራው፥ እርሱም አምላክ አይደለም፤ የሰማርያም እምቦሳ ይቈራረጣል።

verses.text_english: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስን ዘርተዋል፥ ዐውሎ ነፍስንም ያጭዳሉ፤ አገዳ የለውም፥ ከፍሬውም ዱቄት አይገኝም፤ ቢገኝም እንግዶች ይበሉታል።

verses.text_english: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein no pleasure.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ተውጦአል፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል ዛሬ እንደ ረከሰ ዕቃ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.text_amharic: ለብቻውም እንደሚቀመጥ እንደ ምድረ በዳ አህያ ወደ አሦር ወጥተዋል፤ ኤፍሬምም ወዳጆቹን በእጅ መንሻ ገዛ።

verses.text_english: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለአሕዛብ እጅ መንሻ ቢሰጡ እኔ አሁን እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ከንጉሥና ከአለቆችም ሸክም የተነሣ ይደክማሉ።

verses.text_english: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ኃጢአትን ለመሥራት መሠዊያ አብዝቶአልና መሠዊያ ለኃጢአት ይሆንለታል።

verses.text_english: I have written to him the great things of my law, they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.text_amharic: የሕጌን ብዛት ጽፌለታለሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን እንደ እንግዳ ነገር ቈጥረውታል።

verses.text_english: They sacrifice flesh the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: መሥዋዕቴን ያቀርባሉ፥ ሥጋንም ያርዳሉ፥ ይበላሉም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አይቀበላቸውም፤ በደላቸውንም ያስባል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.text_english: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ፈጣሪውን ረስቶአል፥ መስገጃዎችንም ሠርቶአል፤ ይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች አብዝቶአል፤ እኔ ግን በከተሞች ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ አዳራሾችንም ትበላለች።

verses.text_english: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ከአምላክህ ተለይተህ አመንዝረሃልና እንደ አሕዛብ ደስ አይበልህ፥ ሐሴትንም አታድርግ፤ በእህሉ አውድማ ሁሉ ላይ የግልሙትናን ዋጋ ወድደሃል።

verses.text_english: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.text_amharic: አውድማውና መጥመቂያው አይመግባቸውም፥ ጉሽ ጠጅም ይጐድልባታል።

verses.text_english: They shall not dwell in the LORD'S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean in Assyria.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ምድር ላይ አይቀመጡም፤ ኤፍሬምም ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳል፥ በአሦርም ርኩስን ነገር ይበላሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall not offer wine to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም የወይን ጠጅን ቁርባን አያፈስሱም፥ መሥዋዕታቸውም ደስ አያሰኘውም፤ የኀዘንም እንጀራ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ የሚበላውም ሁሉ ይረክሳል፤ እንጀራቸውም ለሰውነታቸው ይሆናል እንጂ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አይገባም።

verses.text_english: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.text_amharic: በዓመት በዓል ቀንና በእግዚአብሔር በዓል ቀን ምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.text_english: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns in their tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ከጥፋት ሸሽተው ሄዱ፥ ግብጽም ትሰበስባቸዋለች፥ ሜምፎስም ትቀብራቸዋለች፤ ሳማም የብራቸውን ጌጥ ይወርሳል፥ እሾህም በድንኳኖቻቸው ውስጥ ይበቅላል።

verses.text_english: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know : the prophet a fool, the spiritual man mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.text_amharic: የበቀል ወራት መጥቶአል፥ የፍዳም ወራት ደርሶአል፥ እስራኤልም ያውቃል፤ ከኃጢአትህና ከጠላትነትህ ብዛት የተነሣ ነቢዩ ሰንፎአል፥ መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው አብዶአል።

verses.text_english: The watchman of Ephraim with my God: the prophet a snare of a fowler in all his ways, hatred in the house of his God.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ከአምላኬ ጋር ተመልካች ነበረ፤ አሁን ግን ነቢዩ በመንገዱ ሁሉ ላይ የወፍ ወጥመድ ሆነ፥ በአምላኩም ቤት ጠላትነት አለ።

verses.text_english: They have deeply corrupted , as in the days of Gibeah: he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.text_amharic: በጊብዓ ዘመን እንደ ነበረ እጅግ ረከሱ፤ እርሱም በደላቸውን ያስባል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይበቀላል።

verses.text_english: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto shame; and abominations were according as they loved.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤልን በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ወይን ሆኖ አገኘሁት፤ አባቶቻችሁንም ከመጀመሪያዋ ዓመት እንደ በለስ በkWraት ሆነው አየኋቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን ወደ ብዔልፌጎር መጡ፥ ለነውርም ተለዩ፥ እንደ ወደዱትም ርኩስ ሆኑ፥

verses.text_english: Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬምም ክብር እንደ ወፍ በርሮ ይጠፋል፤ መውለድና መፅነስ ማርገዝም አይሆንላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, not a man : yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸውንም ቢያሳድጉ ሰው እንዳይቀርላቸው ልጅ አልባ አደረጋቸዋለሁ፤ ከእነርሱም በራቅሁ ጊዜ ወዮላቸው!

verses.text_english: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንዳየሁ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ለምርኮ ተሰጥተዋል፤ ኤፍሬምም ልጆቹን ወደ ገዳዩች ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ ስጣቸው፤ ምን ትሰጣቸዋለህ? የሚጨነግፍን ማኅፀን የደረቀውንም ጡት ስጣቸው።

verses.text_english: All their wickedness in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes revolters.
verses.text_amharic: ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በጌልገላ አለ፤ በዚያ ጠልቻቸዋለሁ፤ ስለ ሠሩት ክፋት ከቤቴ አሳድዳቸዋለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ አልወድዳቸውም፤ አለቆቻቸው ሁሉ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved of their womb.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ተመታ፥ ሥሩም ደረቀ፥ ፍሬም አያፈራም፤ ደግሞም ቢወልዱ የማኅፀናቸውን ፍሬ እገድላለሁ።

verses.text_english: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.text_amharic: አልሰሙትምና አምላኬ ይጥላቸዋል፤ በአሕዛብም መካከል ተቅበዝባዦች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Israel an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ፍሬው የበዛለት የለመለመ ወይን ነው፤ እንደ ፍሬው ብዛት መሠዊያውን አብዝቶአል፤ እንደ ምድሩም ማማር መጠን ሐውልቶችን እያሳመሩ ሠርተዋል።

verses.text_english: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው ተከፈለ፤ አሁንም በደላቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ እርሱ መሠዊያቸውን ያፈርሳል፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም። ንጉሥ የለንም፥ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈራንምና፤ ንጉሥስ ምን ያደርግልናል? ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.text_amharic: የማይረባውን ቃል ይናገራሉ፤ ቃል ኪዳን በገቡ ጊዜ በሐሰት ይምላሉ፤ ስለዚህ መርዛም ሣር በእርሻ ትልም ላይ እንደሚበቅል መቅሠፍት ይበቅልባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማርያ ሰዎች ስለ ቤትአዌን እምቦሳ ይፈራሉ፤ ክብሩም ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጥቶአልና ሕዝቡ ያለቅሱለታል፥ የጣዖቱ ካህናትም በኀዘን ይንተባተባሉ።

verses.text_english: It shall be also carried unto Assyria a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.text_amharic: ለንጉሡ ለኢያሪም እጅ መንሻ ይሆን ዘንድ ወደ አሦር ይማረካል፤ ኤፍሬምን እፍረት ይይዘዋል፥ እስራኤልም በምክሩ ያፍራል።

verses.text_english: Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማርያ ከንጉሥዋ ጋር በውኃ ላይ እንዳለ አረፋ ጠፍታለች።

verses.text_english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ኃጢአት የሆኑት የአዌን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ይፈርሳሉ፤ እሾህና አሜከላ በመሠዊያዎቻቸው ላይ ይበቅላል፤ ተራሮችንም። ክደኑን፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ውደቁብን ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ከጊብዓ ዘመን ጀምረህ ኃጢአትን ሠርተሃል፤ በዚያ ጸንተዋል፤ በጊብዓ ላይ ሰልፍ አይደርስባቸውምን?

verses.text_english: in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.text_amharic: በፈቀድሁም ጊዜ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ፤ ስለ ሁለቱም ኃጢአታቸው በታሰሩ ጊዜ አሕዛብ ይሰበሰቡባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And Ephraim an heifer taught, loveth to tread out ; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ማበራየት እንደ ለመደች ጊደር ነው፥ እኔ ግን በአንገቱ ውበት እጫንበታለሁ፤ በኤፍሬም ላይ እጠምድበታለሁ፥ ይሁዳም ያርሳል፥ ያዕቆብም አፈሩን ያለሰልሳል።

verses.text_english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መጥቶ ጽድቅን እስኪያዘንብላችሁ ድረስ እርሱን የምትሹበት ዘመን ነውና ለእናንተ በጽድቅ ዝሩ፥ እንደ ምሕረቱም መጠን እጨዱ፥ ጥጋታችሁንም እረሱ።

verses.text_english: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.text_amharic: ክፋትን አርሳችኋል፥ ኃጢአትንም አጭዳችኋል፥ የሐሰትንም ፍሬ በልታችኋል፤ በኃያላንህ ብዛት፥ በመንገድህም ላይ ታምነሃልና።

verses.text_english: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon children.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝብህም መካከል ሽብር ይነሣል፤ እናትም ከልጆችዋ ጋር በተፈጠፈጠች ጊዜ ሰልማን ቤትአርብኤልን በሰልፍ ቀን እንዳፈረሰ፥ አምባዎችህ ሁሉ ይፈርሳሉ።

verses.text_english: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአታችሁም ክፋት የተነሣ ቤቴል እንዲሁ ያደርግባችኋል፤ በነጋ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ፈጽሞ ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: When Israel a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሕፃን በነበረ ጊዜ ወደድሁት፥ ልጄንም ከግብጽ ጠራሁት።

verses.text_english: they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.text_amharic: አብዝቼ ብጠራቸው አጥብቀው ከፊቴ ራቁ፤ ለበኣሊምም ይሠዉ ነበር፥ ለተቀረጹ ምስሎችም ያጥኑ ነበር።

verses.text_english: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ኤፍሬምን ክንዱን ይዤ በእግሩ እንዲሄድ መራሁት፤ እኔም እፈውሳቸው እንደ ነበርሁ አላወቁም።

verses.text_english: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ገመድ በፍቅርም እስራት ሳብኋቸው፤ ለእነርሱም ቀምበርን ከጫንቃቸው ላይ እንደሚያነሣ ሆንሁ፥ ድርቆሽም ጣልሁላቸው።

verses.text_english: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ ዘንድ አልወደዱምና ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ይመለሳሉ፥ አሦርም ንጉሣቸው ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour , because of their own counsels.
verses.text_amharic: ከመከሩትም ምክር የተነሣ ሰይፍ በከተሞቻቸው ላይ ይወድቃል፥ ከበርቴዎችንም ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt .
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቤም ከእኔ ይመለሱ ዘንድ ወደዱ፤ ወደ ላይም ቢጠሩአቸው ማንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ እንዴት እጥልሃለሁ? እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንዴትስ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ? እንዴትስ እንደ አዳማ እጥልሃለሁ? እንዴትስ እንደ ሲባዮ አደርግሃለሁ? ልቤ በውስጤ ተናውጣለች፥ ምሕረቴም ተነሣሥታለች።

verses.text_english: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አምላክ ነኝ እንጂ ሰው አይደለሁምና፥ በመካከልህም ቅዱሱ ነኝና የቁጣዬን መቅሠፍት አላደርግም፥ ኤፍሬምንም አጠፋ ዘንድ አልመለስም፤ በመዓትም አልመጣም።

verses.text_english: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ይከተላሉ፥ እርሱም እንደ አንበሳ ያገሣል፤ ባገሣም ጊዜ ልጆች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ከምዕራብ ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ወፍም ከግብጽ፥ እንደ ርግብም ከአሦር ምድር እየተንቀጠቀጡ ይመጣሉ፤ በቤታቸውም አኖራቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም በሐሰት፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት በተንኰል ከበበኝ፤ ይሁዳም ከታመነው ቅዱሱ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አይጸናም።

verses.text_english: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም ነፋስን ይበላል፥ የምሥራቅንም ነፋስ ይከተላል፤ ሁልጊዜም ሐሰትንና ተንኰልን ያበዛል፤ ከአሦር ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋሉ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ዘይት ይወስዳሉ።

verses.text_english: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ከይሁዳ ጋር ክርክር አለው፥ ያዕቆብንም እንደ መንገዱ ይቀጣል፤ እንደ ሥራውም ይመልስለታል።

verses.text_english: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him Bethel, and there he spake with us;
verses.text_amharic: በማኅፀን ውስጥ ወንድሙን በተረከዙ ያዘው፥ በጕልማስነቱም ጊዜ ከአምላክ ጋር ታገለ፤

verses.text_english: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD his memorial.
verses.text_amharic: ከመልአኩም ጋር ታግሎ አሸነፈ፤ አልቅሶም ለመነው። በቤቴልም አገኘው፥ በዚያም ከእኛ ጋር ተነጋገረ።

verses.text_english: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የመታሰቢያው ስም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: a merchant, the balances of deceit in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወደ አምላክህ ተመለስ፤ ምሕረትንና ፍርድን ጠብቅ፥ ዘወትርም በአምላክህ ታመን።

verses.text_english: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that sin.
verses.text_amharic: ከከነዓን ወገን ነው፤ በእጁ የተንኰል ሚዛን አለ፥ ሽንገላንም ይወድዳል።

verses.text_english: And I the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬምም። ባለ ጠጋ ሆኜአለሁ፥ ሀብትንም አግኝቻለሁ፥ በድካሜም ሁሉ ኃጢአት የሚሆን በደል አይገኝብኝም አለ።

verses.text_english: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከግብጽ ጀምሬ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እንደ ዓመት በዓል ቀን እንደ ገና በድንኳን እንድትኖር አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: iniquity Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.text_amharic: ለነቢያትም ተናግሬአለሁ፥ ራእይንም አብዝቻለሁ፤ በነቢያትም እጅ ምሳሌዎችን አውጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept .
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአት በገለዓድ አለ፤ ፈጽመው ከንቱ ናቸው፤ ወይፈኖች በጌልገላ ይሠዋሉ፥ መሠዊያዎቻቸውም በእርሻ ትልም ላይ የድንጋይ ክምር ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ወደ ሶርያ አገር ሸሸ፥ እስራኤልም ስለ ሚስት አገለገለ፥ ስለ ሚስትም ጠባቂ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Ephraim provoked to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በነቢይ እጅ እስራኤልን ከግብጽ አወጣ፥ በነቢይም እጅ ጠበቀው።

verses.text_english: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.text_amharic: ኤፍሬም በተናገረ ጊዜ ፍርሃት ነበረ፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ታበየ፤ ነገር ግን በኣልን በማምለክ በበደለ ጊዜ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ኃጢአትን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ጨመሩ፤ በብራቸውም ለራሳቸው ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልን፥ እንደ ጥበባቸውም ጣዖታትን ሠርተዋል፤ ሁሉም የሠራተኛ ሥራ ናቸው። ስለ እነርሱም። የሚሠዉ ሰዎች እምቦሳውን ይሳሙ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እንደ ማለዳ ደመና፥ በጥዋትም እንደሚያልፍ ጠል፥ በዐውሎ ነፍስም ከአውድማ እንደሚበተን እብቅ፥ ከመስኮትም እንደሚወጣ ጢስ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Yet I the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for no saviour beside me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ከግብጽ ምድር ጀምሬ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ አታውቅም፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ መድኃኒት የለም።

verses.text_english: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳ፥ እጅግ በደረቀ ምድር አውቄህ ነበር።

verses.text_english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሰማሩ በኋላ ጠገቡ፥ በጠገቡም ጊዜ ልባቸው ታበየ፤ ስለዚህ ረሱኝ።

verses.text_english: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe :
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እኔ እንደ አንበሳ ሆንሁባቸው፥ እንደ ነብርም በመንገድ አጠገብ አደባባቸዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I will meet them as a bear bereaved , and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.text_amharic: ልጅዋ እንደ ተነጠቀባት ድብ እገጥማቸዋለሁ፥ የልባቸውንም ስብ እቀድዳለሁ፤ በዚያም እንደ አንበሳ እበላቸዋለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳም አውሬ ይነጣጠቃቸዋል።

verses.text_english: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me thine help.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ በረዳትህ ላይ በመነሣትህ ጥፋትህ ነው።

verses.text_english: I will be thy king: where that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.text_amharic: በየከተማህ ሁሉ ያድንህ ዘንድ ንጉሥህ ወዴት አለ? ስለ እነርሱም። ንጉሥንና አለቆችን ስጠኝ ብለህ የተናገርኸው መሳፍንቶችህ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.text_english: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took away in my wrath.
verses.text_amharic: በቍጣዬ ንጉሥን ሰጠሁህ፥ በመዓቴም ሻርሁት።

verses.text_english: The iniquity of Ephraim bound up; his sin hid.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬም በደል ታስሮአል፥ ኃጢአቱም ተከማችቶአል።

verses.text_english: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the breaking forth of children.
verses.text_amharic: ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ጭንቅ ይመጣበታል፤ በሚወለድበት ጊዜ በማኅፀን አፍ ቀጥ ብሎ አይወጣምና አእምሮ የሌለው ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ከሲኦል እጅ እታደጋቸዋለሁ፥ ከሞትም እቤዣቸዋለሁ፤ ሞት ሆይ፥ ቸነፈርህ ወዴት አለ? ሲኦል ሆይ፥ ማጥፋትህ ወዴት አለ? ርኅራኄ ከዓይኔ ተሰወረች።

verses.text_english: Though he be fruitful among brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
verses.text_amharic: በወንድሞቹ መካከል ፍሬያማ ቢሆን የምሥራቅ ነፋስ ይመጣል፥ የእግዚአብሔር ነፋስ ከምድረ በዳ ይመጣል፤ ምንጩንም ያደርቃል፥ ፈሳሹንም ያጠፋል፥ የተከበሩ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ያሉበትን መዝገብ ይበዘብዛል።

verses.text_english: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማርያ በአምላክዋ ላይ ዐምፃለችና በደልዋን ትሸከማለች፤ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ ሕፃኖቻቸውም ይፈጠፈጣሉ፥ እርጕዞቻቸውም ይቀደዳሉ።

verses.text_english: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በኃጢአትህ ወድቀሃልና ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለስ።

verses.text_english: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ጋር ቃልን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተመልሳችሁ። ኃጢአትን ሁሉ አስወግድ፥ በቸርነትም ተቀበለን፥ በወይፈንም ፋንታ የከንፈራችንን ፍሬ እንሰጣለን።

verses.text_english: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.text_amharic: አሦር አያድነንም፤ በፈረስ ላይ አንቀመጥም፤ ድሀ አደጉም በአንተ ዘንድ ምሕረትን ያገኛልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ለእጆቻችን ሥራ። አምላኮቻችን ናችሁ አንላቸውም በሉት።

verses.text_english: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተመልሶአልና ዓመፃቸውን እፈውሳለሁ፥ በገዛ ፈቃዴ እወድዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤልም እንደ ጠል እሆነዋለሁ፤ እንደ አበባም ያብባል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስም ሥሩን ይሰድዳል።

verses.text_english: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ቅርንጫፎቹም ይዘረጋሉ፥ ውበቱም እንደ ወይራ፥ ሽታውም እንደ ሊባኖስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥላውም በታች የሚቀመጡ ይመለሳሉ፤ ከእህሉም የተነሣ ይጠግባሉ፤ እንደ ወይንም አረግ ያብባሉ፤ መታሰቢያውም እንደ ሊባኖስ ወይን ጠጅ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Ephraim , What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard , and observed him: I like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ ጣዖት ለኤፍሬም ምንድር ነው? እኔ ሰምቼዋለሁ፥ ወደ እርሱም እመለከታለሁ፤ እኔ እንደ ለመለመ ጥድ ነኝ፤ ፍሬህ በእኔ ዘንድ ይገኛል።

verses.text_english: Who wise, and he shall understand these ? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ነገር የሚያስተውል ጠቢብ፥ የሚያውቃትም አስተዋይ ማን ነው? የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ቅን ነው፥ ጻድቃንም ይሄዱበታል፤ ተላላፊዎች ግን ይወድቁበታል።

verses.text_english: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባቱኤል ልጅ ወደ ኢዩኤል የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ በምድርም የምትኖሩ ሁሉ፥ አድምጡ። ይህ በዘመናችሁ ወይስ በአባቶቻችሁ ዘመን ሆኖ ነበርን?

verses.text_english: Tell ye your children of it, and your children their children, and their children another generation.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ለልጆቻችሁ ንገሩ፤ ልጆቻችሁም ለልጆቻቸው፥ ልጆቻቸውም ለኋለኛው ትውልድ ይንገሩ።

verses.text_english: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሞች የቀረውን አንበጣ በላው፤ ከአንበጣም የቀረውን ደጎብያ በላው፤ ከደጎብያም የቀረውን ኩብኩባ በላው።

verses.text_english: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.text_amharic: በተሃ ወይን ጠጃችሁ ከአፋችሁ ተወግዶአልና እናንተ ሰካራሞች፥ ነቅታችሁ አልቅሱ፤ እናንተም የወይን ጠጅ የምትጠጡ ሁሉ፥ ዋይ በሉ።

verses.text_english: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጥርም የሌለው ብርቱ ሕዝብ በምድሬ ላይ ወጥቶአልና፤ ጥርሳቸው እንደ አንበሳ ጥርስ፥ መንጋጋቸውም እንደ እንስቲቱ አንበሳ መንጋጋ ነው።

verses.text_english: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast away; the branches thereof are made white.
verses.text_amharic: ወይኔን ባዶ ምድር አደረገው፥ በለሴንም ሰበረው፤ ባዶም አደረገው፥ ጣለውም፤ ቅርንጫፎቹም ነጡ።

verses.text_english: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.text_amharic: ለቍንጅናዋ ባል ማቅ ለብሳ እንደምታለቅስ ድንግል አልቅሺ።

verses.text_english: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD'S ministers, mourn.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉ ቍርባንና የመጠጡ ቍርባን ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተወግዶአል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አገልጋዮች ካህናቱ አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.text_amharic: እህሉ ጠፍቶአልና፥ ወይኑም ደርቆአልና፥ ዘይቱም ጐድሎአልና እርሻው ምድረ በዳ ሆኖአል፥ ምድሪቱም አልቅሳለች።

verses.text_english: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.text_amharic: መከሩ ከእርሻቸው ጠፍቶአልና ገበሬዎች ስለ ስንዴውና ስለ ገብሱ አፈሩ፤ የወይን አትክልተኞችም አለቀሱ።

verses.text_english: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.text_amharic: ወይኑ ደርቆአል፥ በለሱም ጠውልጎአል፤ ሮማኑና ተምሩ እንኰዩም የምድርም ዛፎች ሁሉ ደርቀዋል፤ ደስታም ከሰው ልጆች ዘንድ ርቆአል።

verses.text_english: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
verses.text_amharic: የእህሉ ቍርባንና የመጠጡ ቍርባን ከአምላካችሁ ቤት ቀርቶአልና እናንተ ካህናት፥ ማቅ ታጥቃችሁ አልቅሱ፤ እናንተም የመሠዊያ አገልጋዮች፥ ዋይ በሉ፤ እናንተ የአምላኬ አገልጋዮች፥ ኑ፥ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ በማቅ ላይ ተኙ።

verses.text_english: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders all the inhabitants of the land the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: ጾምን ቀድሱ፥ ጉባኤውንም አውጁ፤ ሽምግሌዎችንና በምድር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ሰብስቡ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጩኹ።

verses.text_english: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቦአልና ለቀኑ ወዮ! እርሱም ሁሉን ከሚችል ከአምላክ ዘንድ እንደ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, , joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.text_amharic: ከዓይናችን ፊት ምግብ፥ ከአምላካችንም ቤት ደስታና እልልታ የጠፋ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሩ በምድር ውስጥ በሰበሰ፤ እህሉ ደርቆአልና ጎተራዎቹ ባዶ ናቸው፥ ጎታዎቹም ፈርሰዋል።

verses.text_english: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶች እጅግ ጮኹ፤ የላምም መንጎች ማሰማርያ የላቸውምና ተጠራጠሩ፤ የበግም መንጎች ጠፍተዋል።

verses.text_english: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
verses.text_amharic: አቤቱ፥ እሳት የምድረ በዳውን ማሰማርያ በልቶአልና፥ ነበልባሉም የዱሩን ዛፍ ሁሉ አቃጥሎአልና ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ።

verses.text_english: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሳሹ ውኃ ደርቆአልና፥ እሳቱም የምድረ በዳውን ማሰማርያ በልቶአልና የምድር አራዊት ወደ አንተ አለኸለኩ።

verses.text_english: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for nigh at hand;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን መጥቶአልና፥ እርሱም ቀርቦአልና በጽዮን መለከትን ንፉ፥ በቅዱሱም ተራራዬ ላይ እሪ በሉ፤ በምድርም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ይንቀጥቀጡ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን መጥቶአልና፤

verses.text_english: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, to the years of many generations.
verses.text_amharic: የጨለማና የጭጋግ ቀን፥ የደመናና የድቅድቅ ጨለማ ቀን ነው፤ ታላቅና ብርቱ ሕዝብ በተራሮች ላይ እንደ ወገግታ ተዘርግቶአል፤ ከዘላለምም ጀምሮ እንደ እነርሱ ያለ አልነበረም፥ ከእነርሱም በኋላ እስከ ብዙ ትውልድ ድረስ እንደ እነርሱ ያለ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.text_amharic: እሳት በፊታቸው ትባላለች፥ በኋላቸውም ነበልባል ታቃጥላለች፤ ምድሪቱ በፊታቸው እንደ ዔድን ገነት፥ በኋላቸውም የምድረ በዳ በረሃ ናት፤ ከእነርሱም የሚያመልጥ የለም።

verses.text_english: The appearance of them as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.text_amharic: መልካቸው እንደ ፈረስ መልክ ነው፥ እንደ ፈረሶችም ይሮጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.text_amharic: በተራራ ላይ እንዳሉ ሰረገሎች ድምፅ፥ ገለባውንም እንደሚበላ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ድምፅ፥ ለሰልፍም እንደ ተዘጋጀ እንደ ብርቱ ሕዝብ ያኰበኵባሉ።

verses.text_english: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
verses.text_amharic: ከፊታቸው አሕዛብ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ የሰውም ፊት ሁሉ ይጠቍራል።

verses.text_english: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ኃያላን ይሮጣሉ፥ እንደ ሰልፈኞችም በቅጥሩ ላይ ይወጣሉ፤ እያንዳንዱም በመንገዱ ላይ ይራመዳል፥ ከእርምጃቸውም አያፈገፍጉም።

verses.text_english: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱ ካንዱ ጋር አይጋፉም፥ እያንዳንዱም መንገዱን ይጠበጥባል፤ በሰልፍ መካከል ያልፋሉ፥ እነርሱም አይቈስሉም።

verses.text_english: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማም ያኰበkWbaሉ፥ በቅጥሩም ላይ ይሮጣሉ፤ ወደ ቤቶችም ይወጣሉ፥ እንደ ሌባም በመስኮቶች ይገባሉ።

verses.text_english: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ከፊታቸው ትናወጣለች፥ ሰማያትም ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ ፀሐይና ጨረቃም ይጨልማሉ፥ ከዋክብትም ብርሃናቸውን ይሰውራሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp very great: for strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በሠራዊቱ ፊት ድምፁን ይሰጣል፤ ሰፈሩ እጅግ ብዙ ነውና፥ ቃሉንም የሚያደርግ እርሱ ኃያል ነውና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቀን ታላቅና እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ነውና ማንስ ይችለዋል?

verses.text_english: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በፍጹም ልባችሁ፥ በጾምም፥ በልቅሶና በዋይታ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.text_amharic: ልባችሁን እንጂ ልብሳችሁን አትቅደዱ፤ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር ቸርና መሐሪ፥ KWTaው የዘገየ፥ ምሕረቱም የበዛ፥ ለክፋትም የተጸጸተ ነውና ወደ እርሱ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Who knoweth he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
