verses.text_amharic: ከእኔም ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረውን መልአክ። እነዚህ የኢፍ መስፈሪያውን ወዴት ይወስዱታል? አልሁት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በሰናዖር ምድር ቤት ይሠሩለት ዘንድ ይወስዱታል፤ በተዘጋጀም ጊዜ በዚያ በስፍራው ይኖራል አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains mountains of brass.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሼም ዓይኖቼን አነሣሁ፥ እነሆም፥ አራት ሰረገሎች ከሁለት ተራራ መካከል ሲወጡ አየሁ፤ ተራሮቹም የናስ ተራሮች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: In the first chariot red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.text_amharic: በፊተኛው ሰረገላ መጋላ ፈረሶች፥ በሁለተኛውም ሰረገላ ዱሪ ፈረሶች ነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ሰረገላ አምባላይ ፈረሶች፥ በአራተኛውም ሰረገላ ቅጥልጣል ፈረሶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What these, my lord?
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር ለነበረውም መልአክ መልሼ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁት።

verses.text_english: And the angel answered and said unto me, These the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም መልሶ። እነዚህ በምድር ሁሉ ጌታ ፊት ከቆሙበት ስፍራ የሚወጡ አራቱ የሰማይ ነፋሳት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: The black horses which therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
verses.text_amharic: ዱሪ ፈረሶች ያሉበት ወደ ሰሜን ይወጣል፤ አምባላዮቹም ከእነርሱ በኋላ ይወጣሉ፥ ቅጥልጣሎችም ወደ ደቡብ ይወጣሉ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.text_amharic: መጋላዎቹም ደግሞ ወጡ በምድርም ይመላለሱ ዘንድ ለመሄድ ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ በምድር ላይ ተመላለሱ አለ። እነርሱም በምድር ላይ ተመላለሱ።

verses.text_english: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
verses.text_amharic: ጮኾም። እነሆ፥ ወደ ሰሜን ምድር የሚወጡት እነርሱ መንፈሴን በሰሜን ምድር ላይ አሳርፈዋል ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Take of the captivity, of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎን ከመጡት ምርኮኞች ከሔልዳይና ከጦብያ ከዮዳኤም ውሰድ፤ በዚያም ቀን መጥተህ ወደ ሶፎንያስ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮስያስ ቤት ግባ።

verses.text_english: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
verses.text_amharic: ብርንና ወርቅን ከእነርሱ ውሰድ፥ አክሊሎችንም ሥራ፤ በታላቁም ካህን በኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ በኢያሱ ራስ ላይ ድፋቸው፥

verses.text_english: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም በለው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ስሙ ቍጥቋጥ የሚባል ሰው በስፍራው ይበቅላል፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም መቅደስ ይሠራል።

verses.text_english: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ ይሠራል፥ ክብርንም ይሸከማል፥ በዙፋኑም ላይ ተቀምጦ ይነግሣል፤ በዙፋኑም ላይ ካህን ይሆናል፥ የሰላምም ምክር በሁለቱ መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: አክሊሎችም ለሔሌምና ለጦብያ ለዮዳኤም ለሶፎንያስም ልጅ ለሔን በእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ውስጥ ለመታሰቢያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And they far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.text_amharic: በሩቅም ያሉት መጥተው የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ ይሠራሉ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ወደ እናንተ እንደ ላከኝ ታውቃላችሁ። የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አጥብቃችሁ ብትሰሙ ይህ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth of the ninth month, in Chisleu;
verses.text_amharic: በንጉሡም በዳርዮስ በአራተኛው ዓመት ካሴሉ በሚባል በዘጠነኛው ወር በአራተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,
verses.text_amharic: የቤቴልም ሰዎች ሳራሳርንና ሬጌሜሌክን ሰዎቻቸውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይለምኑ ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: to speak unto the priests which in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
verses.text_amharic: ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ካህናት ለነቢያትም። ባለፉት ዓመታት እንዳደረግሁት በአምስተኛው ወር መለየትና ማልቀስ ይገባኛልን? ብለው ይናገሩ ዘንድ ልኮአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊትም ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh , even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, to me?
verses.text_amharic: ለምድሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ለካህናትም እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። በዚህ በሰባው ዓመት በአምስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ወር በጾማችሁና ባለቀሳችሁ ጊዜ፥ በውኑ ለእኔ ጾም ጾማችሁልኝ?

verses.text_english: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat , and drink ?
verses.text_amharic: በምትበሉበትና በምትጠጡበትስ ጊዜ፥ ለራሳችሁ የምትበሉና የምትጠጡ አይደላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: not the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when inhabited the south and the plain?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌምና በዙሪያዋ ያሉ ከተሞች ገና ሰዎች ባሉባቸው ጊዜ፥ በምቾትም ተቀምጠው ሳሉ፥ ደቡቡና ቈላውም ሰዎች ባሉባቸው ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በቀደሙት ነቢያት እጅ የተናገረውን ቃል መስማት አይገባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ተናግሮአል። እውነተኛውን ፍርድ ፍረዱ፤ ቸርነትንና ምሕረትን ሁላችሁ ለወንድሞቻችሁ አድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.text_amharic: መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን፥ መጻተኛውንና ችግረኛውን አትበድሉ፤ ከእናንተም ማንም በወንድሙ ላይ ክፉውን ነገር በልቡ አያስብ።

verses.text_english: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ደንደሳቸውን አዞሩ እንጂ መስማትን እምቢ አሉ፤ እንዳይሰሙም ጆሮአቸውን አደነቈሩ።

verses.text_english: Yea, they made their hearts an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊትም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በቀደሙት ነቢያት እጅ በመንፈሱ የላከውን ሕጉንና ቃሉን እንዳይሰሙ ልባቸውን እንደ አልማዝ አጠነከሩ፤ ስለዚህ ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ታላቅ ቍጣ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Therefore it is come to pass, as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በጠራሁ ጊዜ እነርሱ እንዳልሰሙኝ፥ እንዲሁ እነርሱ በሚጠሩበት ጊዜ እኔ አልሰማም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.text_english: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
verses.text_amharic: ወደማያውቁአቸውም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በዐውሎ ነፋስ በተንኋቸው። እንዲሁ ከእነርሱ በኋላ ምድሪቱ ባድማ ሆናለች፥ የሚተላለፍባትና የሚመላለስባትም አልነበረም፤ ያማረችውንም ምድር ባድማ አደረጉአት።

verses.text_english: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came , saying,
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊትም ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ጽዮን ታላቅ ቅንዓት ቀንቻለሁ፥ በታላቅም ቍጣ ስለ እርስዋ ቀንቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ ጽዮን ተመልሻለሁ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም መካከል እኖራለሁ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም የእውነት ከተማ ትባላለች፤ የሠራዊትም ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ተራራ የተቀደሰ ተራራ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዳግመኛ ሽማግሌዎችና ባልቴቶች በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ ሰውም ሁሉ ከዕድሜው ብዛት የተነሣ ምርኩዝ በእጁ ይይዛል።

verses.text_english: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱም አደባባዮች በእነዚያ በሚጫወቱ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች ይሞላሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ወራት በዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ዓይን ዘንድ ድንቅ ቢሆን፥ በውኑ በእኔ ዓይን ዘንድ ደግሞ ድንቅ ይሆናልን? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሕዝቤን ከምሥራቅ ምድርና ከምዕራብ ምድር አድነዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: አመጣቸዋለሁም፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ውስጥ ይኖራሉ፤ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል፥ እኔም በእውነትና በጽድቅ አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which in the day the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መቅደሱ ይሠራ ዘንድ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ከተመሠረተበት ቀን ጀምሮ ከነቢያት አፍ ይህን ቃል በዚህ ዘመን የሰማችሁ እናንተ ሆይ፥ እጃችሁን አበርቱ።

verses.text_english: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወራት አስቀድሞ ለሰውና ለእንስሳ ዋጋ አልነበረምና፤ እኔም ሰውን ሁሉ በወንድሙ ላይ አስነሥቼ ነበርና ከአስጨናቂው የተነሣ ለሚገባውና ለሚወጣው ሰላም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: But now I not unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን እንደ ቀደመው ዘመን በዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ላይ አልሆንም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For the seed prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these .
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሰላምን እዘራለሁ፤ ወይኑ ፍሬውን ይሰጣል፥ ምድርም አዝመራዋን ታወጣለች፥ ሰማያትም ጠላቸውን ይሰጣሉ፤ ለዚህም ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ አወርሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, let your hands be strong.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳ ቤትና የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ እርግማን እንደ ነበራችሁ፥ እንዲሁ አድናችኋለሁ፥ በረከትም ትሆናላችሁ፤ አትፍሩ፥ እጃችሁንም አበርቱ።

verses.text_english: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አባቶቻችሁ እጅግ ባስቈጡኝ ጊዜ ክፉ ለማድረግ እንዳሰብሁ፥ እንዳልተጸጸትሁም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥

verses.text_english: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ዳግመኛ ለኢየሩሳሌምና ለይሁዳ ቤት በዚህ ወራት በጎነትን አደርግ ዘንድ አስቤአለሁ፤ አትፍሩ።

verses.text_english: These the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
verses.text_amharic: የምትሠሩት ነገር ይህ ነው፤ እያንዳንዳችሁ ከባልንጀራችሁ ጋር እውነትን ተነጋገሩ፤ በበር አደባባያችሁም የእውነትንና የሰላምን ፍርድ ፍረዱ፤

verses.text_english: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these that I hate, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችሁም በባልንጀራችሁ ላይ ክፉን ነገር በልባችሁ አታስቡ፤ የሐሰትንም መሐላ አትውደዱ፤ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ እጠላለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth , and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአራተኛው ወር ጾም የአምስተኛውም የሰባተኛውም የአሥረኛውም ወር ጾም ለይሁዳ ቤት ደስታና ተድላ የሐሤትም በዓላት ይሆናል፤ ስለዚህም እውነትንና ሰላምን ውደዱ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; yet , that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በብዙ ከተሞች የሚቀመጡ አሕዛብ ገና ይመጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the inhabitants of one shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.
verses.text_amharic: በአንዲትም ከተማ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች። እግዚአብሔርን እንለምን ዘንድ፥ የሠራዊትንም ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን እንፈልግ ዘንድ ኑ እንሂድ፤ እኔም እሄዳለሁ እያሉ ወደ ሌላ ከተማ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ወገኖችና ኃይለኞች አሕዛብ በኢየሩሳሌም የሠራዊትን ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ይለምኑ ዘንድ ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard God with you.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊትም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚያ ዘመን ከአሕዛብ ቋንቋ ሁሉ አሥር ሰዎች የአንዱን አይሁዳዊ ሰው ልብስ ዘርፍ ይዘው። እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር እንዳለ ሰምተናልና ከእናንተ ጋር እንሂድ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, toward the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሸክም በሴድራክ ምድር ላይ ነው፥ በደማስቆም ላይ ያርፋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ወደ ሰውና ወደ እስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ዘንድ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በዳርቻዋ ባለችው በሐማት ላይ፥ እጅግ ጠቢበኞች በሆኑ በጢሮስና በሲዶና ላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.text_amharic: ጢሮስም ምሽግን ለራስዋ ሠርታለች፥ ብሩንም እንደ አፈር ጥሩውንም ወርቅ እንደ መንገድ ጭቃ አከማችታለች።

verses.text_english: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ጌታ ይገፍፋታል፥ በባሕርም ላይ ያለውን ብርታትዋን ይመታል፤ እርስዋም በእሳት ትበላለች።

verses.text_english: Ashkelon shall see , and fear; Gaza also , and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀሎና አይታ ትፈራለች፤ ጋዛ ደግሞ አይታ እጅግ ትታመማለች፤ አቃሮንም እንዲሁ፥ ተስፋዋ ይቈረጣልና፤ ንጉሡም ከጋዛ ይጠፋል፥ በአስቀሎናም የሚቀመጥ አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.text_amharic: የተደባለቀ ወገን በአዛጦን ይቀመጣል፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ትዕቢት አጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.text_amharic: ደሙንም ከአፉ ውስጥ ርኩሱንም ነገር ከጥርሱ መካከል አስወግዳለሁ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ለአምላካችን ቅሬታ ይሆናል፤ በይሁዳም እንደ አለቃ ይሆናል፥ አቃሮንም እንደ ኢያቡሳዊ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ማንም እንዳይሄድና እንዳይመለስ እንደ ጠባቂ ጦር ሆኖ በቤቴ ዙሪያ ሰፈር አደርጋለሁ፤ አሁንም በዓይኔ አይቻለሁና ከዚህ በኋላ አስጨናቂ አያልፍባቸውም።

verses.text_english: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እጅግ ደስ ይበልሽ፤ አንቺ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፤ እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ ጻድቅና አዳኝ ነው፤ ትሑትም ሆኖ በአህያም፥ በአህያይቱ ግልገል በውርጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰረገላውንም ከኤፍሬም ፈረሱንም ከኢየሩሳሌም አጠፋለሁ፤ የሰልፉም ቀስት ይሰበራል፥ ለአሕዛብም ሰላምን ይናገራል፤ ግዛቱም ከባሕር እስከ ባሕር፥ ከወንዙም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድርስ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein no water.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንቺም ደግሞ ስለ ቃል ኪዳንሽ ደም፥ እስሮችሽን ውኃ ከሌለበት ጕድጓድ አውጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare I will render double unto thee;
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በተስፋ የምትኖሩ እስሮች ሆይ፥ ወደ ጽኑ አምባ ተመለሱ፤ ሁለት እጥፍ አድርጌ እንድመልስልሽ ዛሬ እነግርሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳን ለእኔ ገትሬአለሁ፤ ቀስቱን በኤፍሬም ሞልቼአለሁ፤ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ልጆችሽን በግሪክ ልጆች ላይ አስነሣለሁ፥ አንቺንም እንደ ኃያል ሰው ሰይፍ አደርግሻለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ ይገለጣል፥ ፍላጻውም እንደ መብረቅ ይወጣል፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም መለከትን ይነፋል፥ በደቡብም ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሄዳል።

verses.text_english: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, as the corners of the altar.
verses.text_amharic: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቃቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ይበሉአቸዋል፥ የወንጭፉንም ድንጋዮች ይረግጣሉ፤ እንደ ወይን ጠጅም ይጠጡአቸዋል፥ እንደ ጥዋዎችም እንደ መሠዊያም ማዕዘኖች የተሞሉ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሕዝቡ መንጋ ያድናቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ለአክሊል እንደሚሆኑ እንደ ከበሩ ድንጋዮች ይሆናሉ፥ በምድሩም ላይ ይብለጨለጫሉ።

verses.text_english: For how great his goodness, and how great his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
verses.text_amharic: በጎነቱ እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! ውበቱስ እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! እህል ጐበዛዝቱን፥ ጉሽ ጠጅም ቈነጃጅቱን ያለመልማል።

verses.text_english: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.text_amharic: በኋለኛው ዝናብ ጊዜ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ዝናቡን ለምኑ፤ እግዚአብሔር መብረቅ ያደርጋል፤ እርሱም የበልግ ዝናብን ለእያንዳንዱም በሜዳ ውስጥ ሣርን ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because no shepherd.
verses.text_amharic: ተራፊም ከንቱነትን ተናግረዋልና፥ ምዋርተኞችም ውሸትን አይተዋልና፤ ሕልምንም የሚያዩ በሐሰት ተናግረዋል፥ በከንቱም ያጽናናሉ፤ እረኛም የላቸውምና እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘዋል ተጨንቀውማል።

verses.text_english: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.text_amharic: ቍጣዬ በእረኞች ላይ ነድዶአል፥ አውራ ፍየሎችንም እቀጣለሁ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም የይሁዳን ቤት መንጋውን ጐብኝቶአል፥ በሰልፍም ውስጥ እንዳለ እንደ ክብሩ ፈረስ ያደርጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ዘንድ የማዕዘኑ ድንጋይ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ ችንካሩ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ የሰልፉ ቀስት፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ አስገባሪው ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ይመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be as mighty , which tread down in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.text_amharic: በሰልፍም ጊዜ ጠላቶቻቸውን በመንገድ ጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረግጡ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነውና ይዋጋሉ፥ ፈረሰኞችም ያፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I the LORD their God, and will hear them.
verses.text_amharic: ወድጃቸዋለሁና የይሁዳን ቤት አበረታለሁ፥ የዮሴፍንም ቤት አድናለሁ፤ አደላድላቸዋለሁም፤ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር ነኝና፥ እኔም እሰማቸዋለሁና እንዳልጣልኋቸው ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And Ephraim shall be like a mighty , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see , and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: የኤፍሬምም ሰዎች እንደ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፥ ልባቸውም የወይን ጠጅ እንደ ጠጣ ሰው ደስ ይለዋል፤ ልጆቻቸውም አይተው ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ ልባቸውም በእግዚአብሔር ሐሤት ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.text_amharic: ተቤዥቼአቸዋለሁና በፉጨት ጠርቼ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ቀድሞም በዝተው እንደ ነበሩ ይበዛሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
verses.text_amharic: በአሕዛብም መካከል ብዘራቸው እንኳ በሩቅ አገር ሳሉ ያስቡኛል፥ ከልጆቻቸውም ጋር በሕይወት ይኖራሉ፥ ይመለሱማል።

verses.text_english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and shall not be found for them.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብጽም ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ ከአሦርም እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ወደ ገለዓድና ወደ ሊባኖስ ምድር አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ የሚበቃም ቦታ አይገኝላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በጭንቅ ባሕር ያልፋል፥ የባሕርንም ሞገድ ይመታል፥ የወንዙም ጥልቅ ሁሉ ይደርቃል፤ የአሦርም ትዕቢት ይዋረዳል፥ የግብጽም በትረ መንግሥት ይርቃል።

verses.text_english: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በአምላካቸው በእግዚአብሔር አበረታቸዋለሁ፥ በስሙም ይመካሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
verses.text_amharic: ሊባኖስ ሆይ፥ ደጆችህን ክፈት፥ እሳትም ዝግባዎችህን ትብላ።

verses.text_english: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
verses.text_amharic: የጥድ ዛፍ ሆይ፥ ዝግባ ወድቆአልና፥ ከበርቴዎችም ጠፍተዋልና ዋይ በል፤ እናንተም የባሳን ዛፎች ሆይ፥ ጽኑው ጫካ ተቈርጦአልና ዋይ በሉ።

verses.text_english: a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
verses.text_amharic: የእረኞች ክብር ተዋርዶአልና የዋይታቸው ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል፤ የዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ተዋርዶአልና የአንበሶች ግሣት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.text_english: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎአል። ለእርድ የሚሆኑትን በጎች ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed the LORD; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.text_amharic: የገዙአቸው ያርዱአቸዋል፥ ራሳቸውንም እንደ በደለኞች አድርገው አይቈጥሩም፤ የሸጡአቸውም። ባለ ጠጋ ሆነናልና እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን ይላሉ፤ እረኞቻቸውም አይራሩላቸውም።

verses.text_english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver .
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በምድር ላይ ለሚኖሩ አልራራም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እነሆም፥ ሰውን ሁሉ በባልንጀራውና በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ምድሪቱንም ይመታሉ፥ ከእጃቸውም አላድናቸውም።

verses.text_english: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ለእርድ የሚሆኑትን በጎች፥ የመንጋውን ችግረኞች ጠበቅሁ። ሁለት በትሮችንም ወሰድሁ፤ የአንዲቱን ስም ውበት የሁለተኛይቱንም ስም ማሰሪያ ብዬ ጠራሁ፤ መንጋውንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.text_english: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ ወርም ሦስቱን እረኞች አጠፋሁ፤ ነፍሴም ተሰቀቀቻቸው፥ ነፍሳቸውም ደግሞ እኔን ጠላች።

verses.text_english: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። እናንተን አልጠብቅም፤ የሚሞተው ይሙት፥ የሚጠፋውም ይጥፋ፤ የቀረውም እያንዳንዱ የባልንጀራውን ሥጋ ይብላ አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And I took my staff, Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ ጋር የገባሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አፈርስ ዘንድ ውበት የተባለችውን በትሬን ወስጄ ቈረጥሁ።

verses.text_english: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it the word of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ተሰበረች፤ እንዲሁም እኔን የተመለከቱ የመንጋው ችግረኞች የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ነበረ አወቁ።

verses.text_english: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty of silver.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ደስ ብሎአችሁ እንደ ሆነ ዋጋዬን ስጡኝ፤ ያለዚያ ግን ተዉት አልሁ። እነርሱም ለዋጋዬ ሠላሳ ብር መዘኑ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም። የተስማሙበትን የከበረውን ዋጋዬን በግምጃ ቤቱ ውስጥ አኑረው አለኝ። እኔም ሠላሳውን ብር ወስጄ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ባለው በግምጃ ቤቱ ውስጥ አኖርሁት።

verses.text_english: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለውንም ወንድማማችነት እሰብር ዘንድ ማሰሪያ የተባለችውን ሁለተኛይቱን በትሬን ቈረጥሁ።

verses.text_english: And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳግመኛም የሰነፍን እረኛ ዕቃ ውሰድ።

verses.text_english: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በአገሩ ውስጥ እረኛ አስነሣለሁ፤ እርሱም የጠፋውን አያስብም፥ የባዘነውን አይፈልግም፥ የተሰበረውን አይጠግንም፤ የዳነውንም አይቀልብም፥ ነገር ግን የሰባውን ሥጋ ይበላል፥ ሰኰናውንም ይቀለጣጥማል።

verses.text_english: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.text_amharic: መንጋውን ለሚተው ለምናምንቴ እረኛ ወዮለት! ሰይፍ በክንዱና በቀኝ ዓይኑ ላይ ይሆናል፤ ክንዱም አጥብቃ ትደርቃለች፥ ቀኝ ዓይኑም ፈጽሞ ትጨልማለች።

verses.text_english: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እስራኤል የተነገረ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሸክም ይህ ነው። ሰማያትን የዘረጋ፥ ምድርንም የመሠረተ፥ የሰውንም መንፈስ በውስጡ የሠራ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah against Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን በዙሪያዋ ላሉት ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የመንገድገድ ዋንጫ አደርጋታለሁ፤ ደግሞም ኢየሩሳሌም ስትከበብ በይሁዳ ላይ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ኢየሩሳሌምን ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ከባድ ድንጋይ አደርጋታለሁ፤ የሚሸከሙአት ሁሉ እጅግ ይቈስላሉ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በላይዋ ላይ ይከማቻሉ።

verses.text_english: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ፈረስን ሁሉ በድንጋጤ፥ ተቀማጭንም በእብድነት እመታለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼንም በይሁዳ ላይ እከፍታለሁ፥ የአሕዛብንም ፈረሶች ሁሉ በዕውርነት እመታለሁ።

verses.text_english: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም አለቆች በልባቸው። በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ በአምላካቸው በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ብርታት አለ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን የይሁዳን አለቆች በእንጨት መካከል እንዳለ ትንታግ፥ በነዶችም መካከል እንዳለ እንደ ፋና ነበልባል አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤ በቀኝና በግራ በዙሪያ ያሉትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይበላሉ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ ኢየሩሳሌም በስፍራዋ በኢየሩሳሌም ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify against Judah.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም የዳዊት ቤት ክብርና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች ክብር በይሁዳ ክብር ላይ እንዳይታበይ የይሁዳን ድንኳኖች አስቀድሞ ያድናል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩት ይመክትላቸዋል፤ በዚያም ቀን ከእነርሱ መካከል ደካማው እንደ ዳዊት ይሆናል፤ የዳዊትም ቤት በፊታቸው እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ እንደ አምላክ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ የሚመጡትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለማጥፋት እጋደላለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for only , and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for firstborn.
verses.text_amharic: በዳዊትም ቤት ላይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚኖሩት ላይ፥ የሞገስንና የልመናን መንፈስ አፈስሳለሁ፤ ወደ እርሱም ወደ ወጉት ይመለከታሉ፤ ሰውም ለአንድያ ልጁ እንደሚያለቅስ ያለቅሱለታል፥ ሰውም ለበኵር ልጁ እንደሚያዝን በመራራ ኀዘን ያዝኑለታል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን በመጊዶን ሜዳ እንደ ነበረው እንደ ሐዳድሪሞን ልቅሶ ታላቅ ልቅሶ በኢየሩሳሌም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ታለቅሳለች፤ እያንዳንዱ ወገን ለብቻው፥ የዳዊት ቤት ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤ የናታን ቤት ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤

verses.text_english: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
verses.text_amharic: የሌዊ ቤት ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤ የሰሜኢ ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤

verses.text_english: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩት ወገኖች ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.text_english: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ለዳዊት ቤትና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ ከኃጢአትና ከርኵሰት የሚያነጻ ምንጭ ይከፈታል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ የጣዖታትን ስም ከምድር አጠፋለሁ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ አይታሰቡም፤ ደግሞም ሐሰተኞችን ነቢያትና ርኩስ መንፈስን ከምድር ላይ አስወግዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ደግሞ ትንቢት ቢናገር የወለዱት አባቱና እናቱ። አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ሐሰትን ተናግረሃልና በሕይወት አትኖርም ይሉታል፤ ትንቢትንም ሲናገር የወለዱት አባቱና እናቱ ይወጉታል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ነቢያቱ ሁሉ ትንቢትን ሲናገሩ እያንዳንዱ ስለ ራእዩ ያፍራል፤ ያታልሉም ዘንድ የማቅ ልብስ አይለብሱም።

verses.text_english: But he shall say, I no prophet, I an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሮ ባሪያ ሆኜ ነበርሁና ገበሬ ሰው ነኝ እንጂ ነቢይ አይደለሁም ይላል።

verses.text_english: And shall say unto him, What these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, with which I was wounded the house of my friends.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውም። ይህ በእጅህ መካከል ያለ ቍስል ምንድር ነው? ይለዋል። እርሱም። በወዳጆቼ ቤት የቈሰልሁት ቍስል ነው ይላል።

verses.text_english: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይፍ ሆይ፥ ባልንጀራዬ በሆነው ሰው በእረኛዬ ላይ ንቃ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ እረኛውን ምታ፥ በጎቹም ይበተናሉ፤ እጄንም በታናናሾች ላይ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off die; but the third shall be left therein.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ ሁለት ክፍል ተቈርጠው ይሞታሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ሦስተኛውም ክፍል በእርስዋ ውስጥ ይቀራል።

verses.text_english: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It my people: and they shall say, The LORD my God.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛውንም ክፍል ወደ እሳት አገባለሁ፥ ብርም እንደሚነጥር አነጥራቸዋለሁ፥ ወርቅም እንደሚፈተን እፈትናቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ስሜን ይጠራሉ፥ እኔም እሰማቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም። ይህ ሕዝቤ ነው እላለሁ፤ እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ነው ይላል።

verses.text_english: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ይመጣል፥ ብዝበዛሽንም በውስጥሽ ይካፈላሉ።

verses.text_english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብንም ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ለሰልፍ እሰበስባለሁ፤ ከተማይቱም ትያዛለች፥ ቤቶችም ይበዘበዛሉ፥ ሴቶችም ይነወራሉ፤ የከተማይቱም እኵሌታ ለምርኮ ይወጣል፥ የቀረው ሕዝብ ግን ከከተማ አይጠፋም።

verses.text_english: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ይወጣል፥ በሰልፍም ቀን እንደ ተዋጋ ከእነዚያ አሕዛብ ጋር ይዋጋል።

verses.text_english: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን እግሮቹ በኢየሩሳሌም ትይዩ በምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው በደብረ ዘይት ላይ ይቆማሉ፤ ደብረ ዘይትም በመካከል ወደ ምሥራቅና ወደ ምዕራብ ይሰነጠቃል፥ እጅግም ታላቅ ሸለቆ ይሆናል፤ የተራራውም እኵሌታ ወደ ሰሜን፥ እኵሌታውም ወደ ደቡብ ይርቃል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall flee the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, all the saints with thee.
verses.text_amharic: የተራሮችም ሸለቆ እስከ አጸል ይደርሳልና በተራሮች ሸለቆ ትሸሻላችሁ፤ በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በዖዝያን ዘመን ከሆነው ከምድር መናወጥ ፊት እንደ ሸሻችሁ ትሸሻላችሁ፤ አምላኬ እግዚአብሔርም ከቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ ጋር ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, the light shall not be clear, dark:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በረዶና ውርጭ እንጂ ብርሃን አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, at evening time it shall be light.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀንም ይሆናል፥ እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታወቀ ይሆናል፤ ቀንም አይሆንም፥ ሌሊትም አይሆንም፤ ሲመሽም ብርሃን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall be in that day, living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን የሕይወት ውኃ ከኢየሩሳሌም ይወጣል፤ እኵሌታው ወደ ምሥራቁ ባሕር፥ እኵሌታውም ወደ ምዕራቡ ባሕር ይሄዳል፤ ይህ በበጋና በክረምት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ይነግሣል፤ በዚያ ቀን እግዚአብሔር አንድ፥ ስሙም አንድ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.
verses.text_amharic: ምድር ሁሉ ከጌባ ጀምሮ በኢየሩሳሌምም ደቡብ በኩል እስካለችው እስከ ሬሞን ድረስ ተለውጣ እንደ ዓረባ ትሆናለች፤ እርስዋም ከፍ ከፍ ትላለች፥ ከብንያምም በር ጀምሮ እስከ ፊተኛው በር ስፍራ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ፥ ከሐናንኤልም ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ንጉሡ መጥመቂያ ድረስ በስፍራዋ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: And shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም ይኖሩባታል፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ እርግማን አይሆንም፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተዘልላ ትኖራለች።

verses.text_english: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ከኢየሩሳሌም ጋር የተዋጉትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ የሚቀሥፍበት ቸነፈር ይህ ነው፤ በእግራቸው ሲቆሙ ሥጋቸው ይበሰብሳል፥ ዓይኖቻቸውም በዓይነስባቸው ውስጥ ይበሰብሳሉ፥ ምላሳቸውም በአፋቸው ውስጥ ይበሰብሳል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in that day, a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ታላቅ ሽብር በእነርሱ ላይ ይሆናል፤ እያንዳንዱም የባልንጀራውን እጅ ይይዛል፥ እጁም በባልንጀራው እጅ ላይ ይነሣል።

verses.text_english: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ሆኖ ይዋጋል፤ በዙሪያም ያሉት የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ሀብት እጅግ ብዙ ወርቅና ብር ልብስም ይሰበሰባል።

verses.text_english: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
verses.text_amharic: በፈረስና በበቅሎ፥ በግመልና በአህያ፥ በዚያም ሰፈር ባለ እንስሳ ሁሉ ላይ የሆነ ቸነፈር እንደዚያ ያለ ቸነፈር ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ከመጡት ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የቀሩት ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዱ ዘንድ፥ የዳስ በዓልንም ያከብሩ ዘንድ በየዓመቱ ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall be, whoso will not come up of the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
verses.text_amharic: ከምድርም ወገኖች ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዱ ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለማይወጡ ለእነርሱ ዝናብ አይዘንብላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that no ; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽም ወገን ባይወጣ ወደዚያም ባይመጣ፥ እግዚአብሔር የዳስ በዓልን ያከብሩ ዘንድ የማይወጡትን አሕዛብ የሚቀሥፍበት ቸነፈር በእርሱ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text_amharic: የግብጽ ቅጣት፥ የዳስ በዓልንም ያከብሩ ዘንድ የማይወጡት የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ቅጣት እንደዚህ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን በፈረሶች ሻኵራ ላይ። ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ተብሎ ይጻፋል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ያሉ ምንቸቶች በመሠዊያው ፊት እንዳሉ ዳካዎች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ያሉ ምንቸቶችም ሁሉ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሱ ይሆናሉ፤ የሚሠዉትም ሰዎች ሁሉ ይመጣሉ ከእነዚያም ወስደው ይቀቅሉባቸዋል፤ በዚያም ቀን በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ከነዓናዊው ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ አይገኝም።

verses.text_english: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.
verses.text_amharic: በሚልክያስ እጅ ለእስራኤል የሆነ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሸክም ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,
verses.text_amharic: ወድጃችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እናንተ ግን። በምን ወደድኸን? ብላችኋል። ዔሳው የያዕቆብ ወንድም አልነበረምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ያዕቆብንም ወደድሁ፥ ዔሳውንም ጠላሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ተራሮቹንም በረሃ አደረግኋቸው፥ ርስቱንም ለምድረ በዳ ቀበሮች አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.text_english: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ኤዶምያስ። እኛ ፈርሰናል፥ ነገር ግን የፈረሰውን መልሰን እንሠራለን ቢል፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነርሱ ይሠራሉ፥ እኔ ግን አፈርሳለሁ፤ በሰዎችም ዘንድ። የበደል ዳርቻና እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም የተቈጣው ሕዝብ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቻችሁም ያያሉ፥ እናንተም። እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ዳርቻ ወዲያ ታላቅ ይሁን ትላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: A son honoureth father, and a servant his master: if then I a father, where mine honour? and if I a master, where my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ስሜን የምታቃልሉ ካህናት ሆይ፥ ልጅ አባቱን፥ ባሪያም ጌታውን ያከብራል፤ እኔስ አባት ከሆንሁ ክብሬ ወዴት አለ? ጌታስ ከሆንሁ መፈራቴ ወዴት አለ? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። እናንተም። ስምህን ያቃለልን በምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD contemptible.
verses.text_amharic: በመሠዊያዬ ላይ ርኩስ እንጀራ ታቀርባላችሁ። እናንተም። ያረከስንህ በምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል። የእግዚአብሔር ገበታ የተነቀፈ ነው በማለታችሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውር መሥዋዕትንም ስታቀርቡ ይህ ክፉ አይደለምን? አንካሳውንና የታመመውን ስታቀርቡ ይህ ክፉ አይደለምን? ያንን ለአለቃህ አቅርብ፤ በውኑ በአንተ ደስ ይለዋልን? ወይስ ፊትህን ይቀበላልን? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ጸጋን ይሰጠን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን ለምኑ፤ ይህ ከእጃችሁ የተሰጠ ሲሆን ከቶ ፊታችሁን ይቀበላልን? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Who even among you that would shut the doors ? neither do ye kindle on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
verses.text_amharic: በመሠዊያዬ ላይ እሳትን በከንቱ እንዳታቃጥሉ ከእናንተ ዘንድ ደጅ የሚዘጋ ሰው ምነው በተገኘ! በእናንተ ደስ አይለኝም፥ ቍርባንንም ከእጃችሁ አልቀበልም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ከፀሐይ መውጫ ጀምሮ እስከ መግቢያዋ ድረስ ስሜ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ታላቅ ይሆናልና፤ በየስፍራውም ለስሜ ዕጣን ያጥናሉ፥ ንጹሕም ቍርባን ያቀርባሉ፤ ስሜ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ታላቅ ይሆናልና፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD polluted; and the fruit thereof, his meat, contemptible.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን። የእግዚአብሔር ገበታ ርኩስ ነው፤ ፍሬውና መብሉም የተናቀ ነው በማለታችሁ አስነቀፋችሁት።

verses.text_english: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness ! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። እነሆ፥ ይህ ድካም ነው ብላችሁ ጢቅ አላችሁበት፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ በቅሚያ የያዛችሁትንም አንካሳውንም የታመመውንም አቅርባችኋል፤ እንዲሁ ቍርባንን ታመጣላችሁ፤ በውኑ ከእጃችሁ ይህን ልቀበለውን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But cursed the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name dreadful among the heathen.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነኝና፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ ስሜም በአሕዛብ ዘንድ የተፈራ ነውና በመንጋው ውስጥ ተባት እያለው ለጌታ ተስሎ ነውረኛውን የሚሠዋ ሸንጋይ ሰው ርጉም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: And now, O ye priests, this commandment for you.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እናንተ ካህናት ሆይ፥ ይህ ትእዛዝ ለእናንተ ነው።

verses.text_english: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay to heart.
verses.text_amharic: ለስሜ ክብር ትሰጡ ዘንድ ባትሰሙ፥ በልባችሁም ባታደርጉት፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርግማን እሰድድባችኋለሁ፥ በረከታችሁንም እረግማታለሁ፤ አሁንም በልባችሁ አላደረጋችሁትምና እኔ ረግሜአታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, the dung of your solemn feasts; and shall take you away with it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ክንዳችሁን እገሥጻለሁ፥ የመሥዋዕታችሁንም ፋንድያ በፊታችሁ ላይ እበትናለሁ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር በአንድነት ትወሰዳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኔ ከሌዊ ጋር ይሆን ዘንድ ይህን ትእዛዝ እንደ ሰደድሁላችሁ ታውቃላችሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
verses.text_amharic: ቃል ኪዳኔ ከእርሱ ጋር የሕይወትና የሰላም ቃል ኪዳን ነበረ፤ ይፈራ ዘንድም እነርሱን ሰጠሁት፤ እርሱም ፈራኝ፥ ከስሜም የተነሣ ደነገጠ።

verses.text_english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: የእውነት ሕግ በአፉ ውስጥ ነበረች፥ በከንፈሩም ውስጥ በደል አልተገኘበትም፤ ከእኔም ጋር በሰላምና በቅንነት ሄደ፥ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ከኃጢአት መለሰ።

verses.text_english: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he the messenger of the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ካህኑ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር መልእክተኛ ነውና ከንፈሮቹ እውቀትን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ይገባቸዋል፥ ሰዎችም ሕግን ከአፉ ይፈልጉ ዘንድ ይገባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ከመንገዱ ፈቀቅ ብላችኋል፤ በሕግም ብዙ ሰዎችን አሰናክላችኋል፤ የሌዊንም ቃል ኪዳን አስነውራችኋል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መንገዴን እንዳልጠበቃችሁ፥ በሕግም ለሰው ፊት እንዳዳላችሁ መጠን፥ እኔ ደግሞ በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት የተናቃችሁና የተዋረዳችሁ አድርጌአችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
verses.text_amharic: ለሁላችን አንድ አባት ያለን አይደለምን? አንድ አምላክስ የፈጠረን አይደለምን? የአባቶቻችንን ቃል ኪዳን ለማስነቀፍ እኛ እያንዳንዳችን ወንድማችንን ስለ ምን አታለልን?

verses.text_english: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የወደደውን መቅደስ ይሁዳ አርክሶአልና፥ የእንግዳውንም አምላክ ልጅ ሚስት አድርጎ አግብቶአልና ይሁዳ አታልሎአል፥ በእስራኤልና በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ርኵሰት ተሠርቶአል።

verses.text_english: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ከሚያደርግ ሰው፥ እግዚአብሔር የሚጠራውንና የሚመልሰውን ለሠራዊትም ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን የሚያቀርበውን ከያዕቆብ ድንኳን ያጠፋል።

verses.text_english: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth with good will at your hand.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ደግሞ አድርጋችኋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ቍርባኑን ዳግመኛ እንዳይመለከት፥ ከእጃችሁም በደስታ እንዳይቀበለው መሠዊያውን በእንባና በልቅሶ በኀዘንም ትከድናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። ስለ ምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል። ሚስትህ ባልንጀራህና የቃል ኪዳንህ ሚስት ሆና ሳለች እርስዋን አታልለሃታልና እግዚአብሔር በአንተና በልጅነት ሚስትህ መካከል ምስክር ስለ ሆነ ነው።

verses.text_english: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የሕይወትን መንፈስ አንድ አድርጎ ጠብቆልን የለምን? እርሱም የሚፈልገው ምንድር ነው? ዘር አይደለምን? ስለዚህ መንፈሳችሁን ጠብቁ፥ ማንም የልጅነት ሚስቱን አያታልል።

verses.text_english: For the LORD, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for covereth violence with his garment, saith the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.
verses.text_amharic: መፋታትን እጠላለሁ፥ ይላል የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ ልብሱንም በግፍ ሥራ የሚከድነውን ሰው እጠላለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ስለዚህ እንዳታታልሉ መንፈሳችሁን ጠብቁ።

verses.text_english: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied ? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil good in the sight of the LORD, and he delighteth in them; or, Where the God of judgment?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን በቃላችሁ አታክታችኋል። እናንተም። ያታከትነው በምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል። ክፉን የሚያደርግ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መልካም ነው፥ እርሱም በእነርሱ ደስ ይለዋል፤ ወይስ። የፍርድ አምላክ ወዴት አለ? በማለታችሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ መልእክተኛዬን እልካለሁ፥ መንገድንም በፊቴ ያስተካክላል፤ እናንተም የምትፈልጉት ጌታ በድንገት ወደ መቅደሱ ይመጣል፤ የምትወዱትም የቃል ኪዳን መልእክተኛ፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እርሱ እንደ አንጥረኛ እሳትና እንደ አጣቢ ሳሙና ነውና የሚመጣበትን ቀን መታገሥ የሚችል ማን ነው? እርሱስ በተገለጠ ጊዜ የሚቆም ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: And he shall sit a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ብርን እንደሚያነጥርና እንደሚያጠራ ሰው ይቀመጣል፥ የሌዊንም ልጆች ያጠራል፥ እንደ ወርቅና እንደ ብርም ያነጥራቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር በጽድቅ ቍርባንን የሚያቀርቡ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ዱሮው ዘመንና እንደ ቀደሙት ዓመታት በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ቍርባን ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger , and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ለፍርድ ወደ እናንተ እቀርባለሁ፤ በመተተኞችና በአመንዝሮች፥ በሐሰትም በሚምሉ፥ የምንደኛውን ደመወዝ በሚከለክሉ፥ መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን በሚያስጨንቁ፥ የመጻተኛውንም ፍርድ በሚያጣምሙ፥ እኔንም በማይፈሩ ላይ ፈጣን ምስክር እሆንባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: For I the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አልለወጥም፤ እናንተ የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ የጠፋችሁ አይደላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept . Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?
verses.text_amharic: ከአባቶቻችሁ ዘመን ጀምር ከሥርዓቴ ፈቀቅ ብላችኋል፥ እርስዋንም አልጠበቃችሁም። ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፥ እኔም ወደ እናንተ እመለሳለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። እናንተ ግን። የምንመለሰው በምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ይሰርቃልን? እናንተ ግን እኔን ሰርቃችኋል። እናንተም። የሰረቅንህ በምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል። በአሥራትና በበኵራት ነው።

verses.text_english: Ye cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, this whole nation.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ፥ ይህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ እኔን ሰርቃችኋልና በእርግማን ርጉሞች ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that not enough .
verses.text_amharic: በቤቴ ውስጥ መብል እንዲሆን አሥራቱን ሁሉ ወደ ጎተራ አግቡ፤ የሰማይንም መስኮት ባልከፍትላችሁ፥ በረከትንም አትረፍርፌ ባላፈስስላችሁ በዚህ ፈትኑኝ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ ነቀዙን እገሥጻለሁ፥ የምድራችሁንም ፍሬ አያጠፋም፤ በእርሻችሁም ያለው ወይን ፍሬውን አያረግፍም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: የተድላ ምድር ትሆናላችሁና አሕዛብ ሁሉ ብፁዓን ብለው ይጠሩአችኋል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken against thee?
verses.text_amharic: ቃላችሁ በእኔ ላይ ድፍረት ሆኖአል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። እናንተ ግን። በአንተ ላይ ደፍረን የተናገርነው በምንድር ነው? ብላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Ye have said, It vain to serve God: and what profit that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም። እግዚአብሔርን ማገልገል ከንቱ ነው፤ ትእዛዙንስ በመጠበቅ፥ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኀዘንተኞች ሆነን በመሄድ ምን ይረባናል?

verses.text_english: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, tempt God are even delivered.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም የሚታበዩትን ሰዎች ብፁዓን ብለን እንጠራቸዋለን፤ ክፉንም የሚሠሩ ጸንተዋል እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈታተናሉ፥ ያመልጣሉም ብላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard , and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩ እርስ በእርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም አደመጠ፥ ሰማም፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ለሚፈሩ ስሙንም ለሚያስቡ የመታሰቢያ መጽሐፍ በፊቱ ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በምሠራበት ቀን እነርሱ የእኔ ገንዘብ ይሆናሉ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ሰውም የሚያገለግለውን ልጁን እንደሚምር፥ እንዲሁ እምራቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሳችሁም በጻድቁና በኃጢአተኛው መካከል፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሚገዛውና በማይገዛው መካከል ትለያላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንደ ምድጃ እሳት የሚነድድ ቀን ይመጣል፤ ትዕቢተኞችና ኃጢአትን የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ገለባ ይሆናሉ፤ የሚመጣውም ቀን ያቃጥላቸዋል፥ ሥርንና ቅርንጫፍንም አይተውላቸውም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ስሜን ለምትፈሩት ለእናንተ የጽድቅ ፀሐይ ትወጣላችኋለች፥ ፈውስም በክንፎችዋ ውስጥ ይሆናል፤ እናንተም ትወጣላችሁ፥ እንደ ሰባም እምቦሳ ትፈነጫላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do , saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.text_amharic: በምሠራበት ቀን በደለኞች ከእግራችሁ ጫማ በታች አመድ ይሆናሉና እናንተ ትረግጡአቸዋላችሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.text_english: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, the statutes and judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ሥርዓትንና ፍርድን አድርጌ በኮሬብ ያዘዝሁትን የባሪያዬን የሙሴን ሕግ አስቡ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ታላቁና የሚያስፈራው የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ሳይመጣ ነቢዩን ኤልያስን እልክላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
verses.text_amharic: መጥቼም ምድርን በእርግማን እንዳልመታ እርሱ የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆች፥ የልጆችንም ልብ ወደ አባቶች ይመልሳል።

verses.text_english: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊት ልጅ የአብርሃም ልጅ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትውልድ መጽሐፍ።

verses.text_english: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም ይስሐቅን ወለደ፤ ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ወለደ፤ ያዕቆብም ይሁዳንና ወንድሞቹን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳም ከትዕማር ፋሬስንና ዛራን ወለደ፤ ፋሬስም ኤስሮምን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
verses.text_amharic: ኤስሮምም አራምን ወለደ፤ አራምም አሚናዳብን ወለደ፤ አሚናዳብም ነአሶንን ወለደ፤ ነአሶንም ሰልሞንን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.text_amharic: ሰልሞንም ከራኬብ ቦኤዝን ወለደ፤ ቦኤዝም ከሩት ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቤድም እሴይን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her of Urias;
verses.text_amharic: እሴይም ንጉሥ ዳዊትን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
verses.text_amharic: ሰሎሞንም ሮብዓምን ወለደ፤ ሮብዓምም አቢያን ወለደ፤ አቢያም አሣፍን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
verses.text_amharic: አሣፍም ኢዮሣፍጥን ወለደ፤ ኢዮሣፍጥም ኢዮራምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮራምም ዖዝያንን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
verses.text_amharic: ዖዝያንም ኢዮአታምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮአታምም አካዝን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
verses.text_amharic: አካዝም ሕዝቅያስን ወለደ፤ ሕዝቅያስም ምናሴን ወለደ፤ ምናሴም አሞፅን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
verses.text_amharic: አሞፅም ኢዮስያስን ወለደ፤ ኢዮስያስም በባቢሎን ምርኮ ጊዜ ኢኮንያንንና ወንድሞቹን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.text_amharic: ከባቢሎንም ምርኮ በኋላ ኢኮንያን ሰላትያልን ወለደ፤ ሰላትያልም ዘሩባቤልን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.text_amharic: ዘሩባቤልም አብዩድን ወለደ፤ አብዩድም ኤልያቄምን ወለደ፤ ኤልያቄምም አዛርን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.text_amharic: አዛርም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም አኪምን ወለደ፤ አኪምም ኤልዩድን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.text_amharic: ኤልዩድም አልዓዛርን ወለደ፤ አልዓዛርም ማታንን ወለደ፤ ማታንም ያዕቆብን ወለደ፤

verses.text_english: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብም ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን የወለደች የማርያምን እጮኛ ዮሴፍን ወለደ።

verses.text_english: So all the generations from Abraham to David fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ fourteen generations.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ትውልድ ሁሉ ከአብርሃም እስከ ዳዊት አሥራ አራት ትውልድ፥ ከዳዊትም እስከ ባቢሎን ምርኮ አሥራ አራት ትውልድ፥ ከባቢሎንም ምርኮ እስከ ክርስቶስ አሥራ አራት ትውልድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ልደት እንዲህ ነበረ። እናቱ ማርያም ለዮሴፍ በታጨች ጊዜ ሳይገናኙ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ፀንሳ ተገኘች።

verses.text_english: Then Joseph her husband, being a just , and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.text_amharic: እጮኛዋ ዮሴፍም ጻድቅ ሆኖ ሊገልጣት ስላልወደደ በስውር ሊተዋት አሰበ።

verses.text_english: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሲያስብ፥ እነሆ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ታየው፥ እንዲህም አለ። የዳዊት ልጅ ዮሴፍ ሆይ፥ ከእርስዋ የተፀነሰው ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ነውና እጮኛህን ማርያምን ለመውሰድ አትፍራ።

verses.text_english: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.text_amharic: ልጅም ትወልዳለች፤ እርሱ ሕዝቡን ከኃጢአታቸው ያድናቸዋልና ስሙን ኢየሱስ ትለዋለህ።

verses.text_english: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በነቢይ ከጌታ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ድንግል ትፀንሳለች ልጅም ትወልዳለች፥ ስሙንም አማኑኤል ይሉታል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሁሉ ሆኖአል፥ ትርጓሜውም። እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር የሚል ነው።

verses.text_english: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ከእንቅልፉ ነቅቶ የጌታ መልአክ እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ እጮኛውንም ወሰደ፤

verses.text_english: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
verses.text_amharic: የበኩር ልጅዋንም እስክትወልድ ድረስ አላወቃትም፤ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም በንጉሡ በሄሮድስ ዘመን በተወለደ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰብአ ሰገል። የተወለደው የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ወዴት ነው? ኮከቡን በምሥራቅ አይተን ልንሰግድለት መጥተናልና እያሉ ከምሥራቅ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.text_english: When Herod the king had heard , he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡ ሄሮድስም ሰምቶ ደነገጠ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር፤

verses.text_english: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናትንም አለቆች የሕዝቡንም ጻፎች ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ክርስቶስ ወዴት እንዲወለድ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
And thou Bethlehem, the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አንቺ ቤተ ልሔም፥ የይሁዳ ምድር፥ ከይሁዳ ገዢዎች ከቶ አታንሽም፤ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ መስፍን ከአንቺ ይወጣልና ተብሎ በነቢይ እንዲህ ተጽፎአልና በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም ነው አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገልን በስውር ጠርቶ ኮከቡ የታየበትን ዘመን ከእነርሱ በጥንቃቄ ተረዳ፥

verses.text_english: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found , bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤተ ልሔምም እነርሱን ሰድዶ። ሂዱ፥ ስለ ሕፃኑ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ ባገኛችሁትም ጊዜ እኔ ደግሞ መጥቼ እንድሰግድለት ንገሩኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ንጉሡን ሰምተው ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ በምሥራቅ ያዩት ኮከብ ሕፃኑ ባለበት ላይ መጥቶ እስኪቆም ድረስ ይመራቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.text_amharic: ኮከቡንም ባዩ ጊዜ በታላቅ ደስታ እጅግ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም ገብተው ሕፃኑን ከእናቱ ከማርያም ጋር አዩት፥ ወድቀውም ሰገዱለት፥ ሣጥኖቻቸውንም ከፍተው እጅ መንሻ ወርቅና ዕጣን ከርቤም አቀረቡለት።

verses.text_english: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሄሮድስም እንዳይመለሱ በሕልም ተረድተው በሌላ መንገድ ወደ አገራቸው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከሄዱ በኋላ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ለዮሴፍ ታይቶ። ሄሮድስ ሕፃኑን ሊገድለው ይፈልገዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑንና እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ ግብፅ ሽሽ፥ እስክነግርህም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጥ አለው።

verses.text_english: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተሣለቁበት ባየ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣና ልኮ ከሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተረዳው ዘመን በቤተ ልሔምና በአውራጃዋ የነበሩትን፥ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናቸውን ከዚያም የሚያንሱትን ሕፃናት ሁሉ አስገደለ።

verses.text_english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስም ከሞተ በኋላ፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በግብፅ ለዮሴፍ በሕልም ታይቶ።

verses.text_english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.text_amharic: የሕፃኑን ነፍስ የፈለጉት ሞተዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑን እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ እስራኤል አገር ሂድ አለ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ተነሥቶ ሕፃኑንና እናቱን ያዘና ወደ እስራኤል አገር ገባ።

verses.text_english: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: በአባቱም በሄሮድስ ፈንታ አርኬላዎስ በይሁዳ እንደ ነገሠ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚያ መሄድን ፈራ፤ በሕልምም ተረድቶ ወደ ገሊላ አገር ሄደ፤

verses.text_english: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
verses.text_amharic: በነቢያት። ናዝራዊ ይባላል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ፥ ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ከተማ መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.text_english: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት

verses.text_english: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ ብሎ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ እየሰበከ መጣ።

verses.text_english: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.text_amharic: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮህ ሰው ድምፅ የተባለለት ይህ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱም ዮሐንስ የግመል ጠጉር ልብስ ነበረው፥ በወገቡም ጠፍር ይታጠቅ ነበር፤ ምግቡም አንበጣና የበረሀ ማር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሁዳም ሁሉ በዮርዳኖስም ዙሪያ ያለ አገር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጡ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአታቸውንም እየተናዘዙ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ከእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን ብዙዎች ወደ ጥምቀቱ ሲመጡ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?

verses.text_english: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ለንስሐ የሚገባ ፍሬ አድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: በልባችሁም። አብርሃም አባት አለን እንደምትሉ አይምሰላችሁ፤ እላችኋለሁና። ከነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆች ሊያስነሣለት እግዚአብሔር ይችላል።

verses.text_english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ ምሳር በዛፎች ሥር ተቀምጦአል፤ እንግዲህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቈረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.text_english: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and fire:
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ ለንስሐ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ጫማውን እሸከም ዘንድ የማይገባኝ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ግን ከእኔ ይልቅ ይበረታል፤ እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በእሳትም ያጠምቃችኋል፤

verses.text_english: Whose fan in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.text_amharic: መንሹም በእጁ ነው፥ አውድማውንም ፈጽሞ ያጠራል፥ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ይከታል፥ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.text_english: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በዮሐንስ ሊጠመቅ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ ግን። እኔ በአንተ ልጠመቅ ያስፈልገኛል አንተም ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህን? ብሎ ይከለክለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሁንስ ፍቀድልኝ፤ እንዲህ ጽድቅን ሁሉ መፈጸም ይገባናልና አለው። ያን ጊዜ ፈቀደለት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያው ከውኃ ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ ሰማያት ተከፈቱ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ሲወርድ በእርሱ ላይም ሲመጣ አየ፤

verses.text_english: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ድምፅ ከሰማያት መጥቶ። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወዲያ ኢየሱስ ከዲያብሎስ ይፈተን ዘንድ መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወሰደው፥

verses.text_english: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.text_amharic: አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊትም ከጦመ በኋላ ተራበ።

verses.text_english: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.text_amharic: ፈታኝም ቀርቦ። የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ከሆንህ፥ እነዚህ ድንጋዮች እንጀራ እንዲሆኑ በል አለው።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ በሚወጣ ቃል ሁሉ እንጂ በእንጀራ ብቻ አይኖርም ተብሎ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ዲያቢሎስ ወደ ቅድስት ከተማ ወሰደውና እርሱን በመቅደስ ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ።

verses.text_english: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.text_amharic: መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎ ደግሞ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.text_english: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ዲያቢሎስ እጅግ ረጅም ወደ ሆነ ተራራ ወሰደው፥ የዓለምንም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ክብራቸውንም አሳይቶ።

verses.text_english: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.text_amharic: ወድቀህ ብትሰግድልኝ ይህን ሁሉ እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን ለጌታህ ለአምላክህ ስገድ እርሱንም ብቻ አምልክ ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ ዲያቢሎስ ተወው፥ እነሆም፥ መላእክት ቀርበው ያገለግሉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ዮሐንስ አልፎ እንደ ተሰጠ በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ገሊላ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.text_amharic: ናዝሬትንም ትቶ በዛብሎንና በንፍታሌም አገር በባሕር አጠገብ ወደ አለችው ወደ ቅፍርናሆም መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.text_english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.text_amharic: በነቢዩም በኢሳይያስ። የዛብሎን ምድርና የንፍታሌም ምድር፥ የባሕር መንገድ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፥ የአሕዛብ ገሊላ፤ በጨለማ የተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ፥ በሞት አገርና ጥላ ለተቀመጡትም ብርሃን ወጣላቸው

verses.text_english: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ። ከዚያ ዘመን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ እያለ ይሰብክ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.text_amharic: በገሊላ ባሕር አጠገብ ሲመላለስም ሁለት ወንድማማች ጴጥሮስ የሚሉትን ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በኋላዬ ኑና ሰዎችን አጥማጆች እንድትሆኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they straightway left nets, and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም መረባቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም እልፍ ብሎ ሌሎችን ሁለት ወንድማማች የዘብዴዎስን ልጅ ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ከአባታቸው ከዘብዴዎስ ጋር በታንኳ መረባቸውን ሲያበጁ አየ፤ ጠራቸውም።

verses.text_english: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወዲያው ታንኳይቱንና አባታቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በምኩራቦቻቸው እያስተማረ የመንግሥትንም ወንጌል እየሰበከ በሕዝብም ያለውን ደዌና ሕማም ሁሉ እየፈወሰ በገሊላ ሁሉ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናውም ወደ ሶርያ ሁሉ ወጣ፤ በልዩ ልዩ ደዌና ሥቃይም ተይዘው የታመሙትን ሁሉ አጋንንትም ያደሩባቸውን በጨረቃም የሚነሣባቸውን ሽባዎችንም ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፥ ፈወሳቸውም።

verses.text_english: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judaea, and beyond Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: ከገሊላም ከአሥሩ ከተማም ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከይሁዳም ከዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም አይቶ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፤ በተቀመጠም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፤

verses.text_english: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.text_amharic: አፉንም ከፍቶ አስተማራቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስ ድሆች የሆኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።

verses.text_english: Blessed they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያዝኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መፅናናትን ያገኛሉና።

verses.text_english: Blessed the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የዋሆች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ምድርን ይወርሳሉና።

verses.text_english: Blessed they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን የሚራቡና የሚጠሙ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ይጠግባሉና።

verses.text_english: Blessed the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.text_amharic: የሚምሩ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ይማራሉና።

verses.text_english: Blessed the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.text_amharic: ልበ ንጹሖች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ያዩታልና።

verses.text_english: Blessed the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስተራርቁ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይባላሉና።

verses.text_english: Blessed they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጽድቅ የሚሰደዱ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።

verses.text_english: Blessed are ye, when shall revile you, and persecute , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.text_amharic: ሲነቅፉአችሁና ሲያሳድዱአችሁ በእኔም ምክንያት ክፉውን ሁሉ በውሸት ሲናገሩባችሁ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.text_amharic: ዋጋችሁ በሰማያት ታላቅ ነውና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ሐሴትም አድርጉ፤ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩትን ነቢያትን እንዲሁ አሳድደዋቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የምድር ጨው ናችሁ፤ ጨው አልጫ ቢሆን ግን በምን ይጣፍጣል? ወደ ውጭ ተጥሎ በሰው ከመረገጥ በቀር ወደ ፊት ለምንም አይጠቅምም።

verses.text_english: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የዓለም ብርሃን ናችሁ። በተራራ ላይ ያለች ከተማ ልትሰወር አይቻላትም።

verses.text_english: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.text_amharic: መብራትንም አብርተው ከዕንቅብ በታች አይደለም እንጂ በመቅረዙ ላይ ያኖሩታል በቤት ላሉት ሁሉም ያበራል።

verses.text_english: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙን ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ብርሃናችሁ እንዲሁ በሰው ፊት ይብራ።

verses.text_english: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
