verses.text_amharic: እኔ ሕግንና ነቢያትን ለመሻር የመጣሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ ልፈጽም እንጂ ለመሻር አልመጣሁም።

verses.text_english: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰማይና ምድር እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ከሕግ አንዲት የውጣ ወይም አንዲት ነጥብ ከቶ አታልፍም፥ ሁሉ እስኪፈጸም ድረስ።

verses.text_english: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከነዚህ ከሁሉ ካነሱት ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን የሚሽር ለሰውም እንዲሁ የሚያስተምር ማንም ሰው በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ከሁሉ ታናሽ ይባላል፤ የሚያደርግ ግን የሚያስተምርም ማንም ቢሆን እርሱ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ታላቅ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና። ጽድቃችሁ ከጻፎችና ከፈሪሳውያን ጽድቅ ካልበለጠ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም።

verses.text_english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.text_amharic: ለቀደሙት። አትግደል እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል፤ የገደለም ሁሉ ፍርድ ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በወንድሙ ላይ የሚቆጣ ሁሉ ፍርድ ይገባዋል፤ ወንድሙንም ጨርቃም የሚለው ሁሉ የሸንጎ ፍርድ ይገባዋል፤ ደንቆሮ የሚለውም ሁሉ የገሃነመ እሳት ፍርድ ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ መባህን በመሠዊያው ላይ ብታቀርብ፥ በዚያም ወንድምህ አንዳች በአንተ ላይ እንዳለው ብታስብ፥

verses.text_english: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ በመሠዊያው ፊት መባህን ትተህ ሂድ፥ አስቀድመህም ከወንድምህ ጋር ታረቅ፥ በኋላም መጥተህ መባህን አቅርብ።

verses.text_english: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.text_amharic: አብረኸው በመንገድ ሳለህ ከባላጋራህ ጋር ፈጥነህ ተስማማ፤ ባላጋራ ለዳኛ እንዳይሰጥህ ዳኛም ለሎሌው፥ ወደ ወህኒም ትጣላለህ፤

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ የመጨረሻዋን ሳንቲም እስክትከፍል ድረስ ከቶ ከዚያ አትወጣም።

verses.text_english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.text_amharic: አታመንዝር እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ሴት ያየ ሁሉ የተመኛትም ያን ጊዜ በልቡ ከእርስዋ ጋር አመንዝሮአል።

verses.text_english: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኝ ዓይንህም ብታሰናክልህ አውጥተህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሙሉ ሰውነትህ በገሃነም ከሚጣል ይልቅ ከአካላትህ አንድ ቢጠፋ ይሻልሃልና።

verses.text_english: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኝ እጅህም ብታሰናክልህ ቆርጠህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሙሉ ሰውነትህ በገሃነም ከሚጣል ይልቅ ከአካላትህ አንድ ቢጠፋ ይሻላልና።

verses.text_english: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቱን የሚፈታት ሁሉ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ይስጣት ተባለ።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ያለ ዝሙት ምክንያት ሚስቱን የሚፈታ ሁሉ አመንዝራ ያደርጋታል፥ የተፈታችውንም የሚያገባ ሁሉ ያመነዝራል።

verses.text_english: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ለቀደሙት። በውሸት አትማል ነገር ግን መሐላዎችህን ለጌታ ስጥ እንደተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ። ከቶ አትማሉ፤ በሰማይ አይሆንም የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ነውና፤

verses.text_english: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም አይሆንም የእግሩ መረገጫ ናትና፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አይሆንም የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ናትና፤

verses.text_english: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.text_amharic: በራስህም አትማል፥ አንዲቱን ጠጉር ነጭ ወይም ጥቁር ልታደርግ አትችልምና።

verses.text_english: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ቃላችሁ አዎን አዎን ወይም አይደለም አይደለም ይሁን፤ ከነዚህም የወጣ ከክፉው ነው።

verses.text_english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.text_amharic: ዓይን ስለ ዓይን ጥርስም ስለ ጥርስ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ክፉውን አትቃወሙ፤ ዳሩ ግን ቀኝ ጉንጭህን በጥፊ ለሚመታህ ሁሉ ሁለተኛውን ደግሞ አዙርለት፤

verses.text_english: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have cloke also.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲከስህም እጀ ጠባብህንም እንዲወስድ ለሚወድ መጎናጸፊያህን ደግሞ ተውለት፤

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሰው አንድ ምዕራፍ ትሄድ ዘንድ ቢያስገድድህ ሁለተኛውን ከእርሱ ጋር ሂድ።

verses.text_english: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚለምንህ ስጥ፥ ከአንተም ይበደር ዘንድ ከሚወደው ፈቀቅ አትበል።

verses.text_english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀራህን ውደድ ጠላትህንም ጥላ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.text_amharic: የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.text_english: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቻችሁንም ብቻ እጅ ብትነሡ ምን ብልጫ ታደርጋላችሁ? አሕዛብስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.text_english: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more ? do not even the publicans so?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ፍጹም እንደ ሆነ እናንተ ፍጹማን ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰዎች ትታዩ ዘንድ ምጽዋታችሁን በፊታቸው እንዳታደርጉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ያለዚያ በሰማያት ባለው አባታችሁ ዘንድ ዋጋ የላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Therefore when thou doest alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ምጽዋት ስታደርግ፥ ግብዞች በሰው ዘንድ ሊከበሩ በምኩራብ በመንገድም እንደሚያደርጉ በፊትህ መለከት አታስነፋ፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.text_english: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ምጽዋት ስታደርግ ምጽዋትህ በስውር እንዲሆን ቀኝህ የምትሠራውን ግራህ አትወቅ፤ በስውር የሚያይ አባትህም በግልጥ ይከፍልሃል።

verses.text_english: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.text_amharic: ስትጸልዩም እንደ ግብዞች አትሁኑ፤ ለሰው ይታዩ ዘንድ በምኩራብና በመንገድ ማዕዘን ቆመው መጸለይን ይወዳሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.text_english: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ስትጸልይ፥ ወደ እልፍኝህ ግባ መዝጊያህንም ዘግተህ በስውር ላለው አባትህ ጸልይ፤ በስውር የሚያይ አባትህም በግልጥ ይከፍልሃል።

verses.text_english: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም በመናገራቸው ብዛት እንዲሰሙ ይመስላቸዋልና ስትጸልዩ እንደ እነርሱ በከንቱ አትድገሙ።

verses.text_english: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አትምሰሉአቸው፤ ሳትለምኑት አባታችሁ የሚያስፈልጋችሁን ያውቃልና።

verses.text_english: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እናንተስ እንዲህ ጸልዩ። በሰማያት የምትኖር አባታችን ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህ ይቀደስ፤ መንግሥትህ ትምጣ፤ ፈቃድህ በሰማይ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በምድር ትሁን፤

verses.text_english: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.text_amharic: የዕለት እንጀራችንን ዛሬ ስጠን፤

verses.text_english: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም ደግሞ የበደሉንን ይቅር እንደምንል በደላችንን ይቅር በለን፤

verses.text_english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉም አድነን እንጂ ወደ ፈተና አታግባን፤ መንግሥት ያንተ ናትና ኃይልም ክብርም ለዘለዓለሙ፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.text_amharic: ለሰዎች ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ብትሉ፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ እናንተን ደግሞ ይቅር ይላችኋልና፤

verses.text_english: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰዎች ግን ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ባትሉ፥ አባታችሁም ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር አይላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.text_amharic: ስትጦሙም፥ እንደ ግብዞች አትጠውልጉ፤ ለሰዎች እንደ ጦመኛ ሊታዩ ፊታቸውን ያጠፋሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.text_english: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
verses.text_amharic: ብልና ዝገት በሚያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በሚሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በምድር ላይ መዝገብ አትሰብስቡ፤

verses.text_english: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ብልም ዝገትም በማያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በማይሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በሰማይ መዝገብ ሰብስቡ፤

verses.text_english: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.text_amharic: መዝገብህ ባለበት ልብህ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውነት መብራት ዓይን ናት። ዓይንህ እንግዲህ ጤናማ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ ብሩህ ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይንህ ግን ታማሚ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ የጨለመ ይሆናል። እንግዲህ በአንተ ያለው ብርሃን ጨለማ ከሆነ፥ ጨለማውስ እንዴት ይበረታ!

verses.text_english: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great that darkness!
verses.text_amharic: ለሁለት ጌቶች መገዛት የሚቻለው ማንም የለም፤ ወይም አንዱን ይጠላል ሁለተኛውንም ይወዳል፤ ወይም ወደ አንዱ ይጠጋል ሁለተኛውንም ይንቃል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርና ለገንዘብ መገዛት አትችሉም።

verses.text_english: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ በምትበሉትና በምትጠጡት፥ ወይም ስለ ሰውነታችሁ በምትለብሱት አትጨነቁ፤ ነፍስ ከመብል ሰውነትም ከልብስ አይበልጥምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰማይ ወፎች ተመልከቱ፤ አይዘሩም አያጭዱምም በጎተራም አይከቱም፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁም ይመግባቸዋል፤ እናንተ ከእነርሱ እጅግ አትበልጡምን?

verses.text_english: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ተጨንቆ በቁመቱ ላይ አንድ ክንድ መጨመር የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ልብስስ ስለ ምን ትጨነቃላችሁ? የሜዳ አበቦች እንዴት እንዲያድጉ ልብ አድርጋችሁ ተመልከቱ፤

verses.text_english: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.text_amharic: አይደክሙም አይፈትሉምም፤ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰሎሞንስ እንኳ በክብሩ ሁሉ ከነዚህ እንደ አንዱ አልለበሰም።

verses.text_english: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ ያለውን ነገም ወደ እቶን የሚጣለውን የሜዳን ሣር እንዲህ የሚያለብሰው ከሆነ፥ እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ እናንተንማ ይልቁን እንዴት?

verses.text_english: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, not much more you, O ye of little faith?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። ምን እንበላለን? ምንስ እንጠጣለን? ምንስ እንለብሳለን? ብላችሁ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.text_english: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.text_amharic: ይህንስ ሁሉ አሕዛብ ይፈልጋሉ፤ ይህ ሁሉ እንዲያስፈልጋችሁ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ያውቃልና።

verses.text_english: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አስቀድማችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ጽድቁንም ፈልጉ፥ ይህም ሁሉ ይጨመርላችኋል።

verses.text_english: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገ ለራሱ ይጨነቃልና ለነገ አትጨነቁ፤ ለቀኑ ክፋቱ ይበቃዋል።

verses.text_english: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይፈረድባችሁ አትፍረዱ፤

verses.text_english: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.text_amharic: በምትፈርዱበት ፍርድ ይፈረድባችኋልና፥ በምትሰፍሩበትም መስፈሪያ ይሰፈርባችኋል።

verses.text_english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.text_amharic: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለምን ታያለህ፥ በዓይንህ ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?

verses.text_english: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam in thine own eye?
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ወንድምህን። ከዓይንህ ጉድፍ ላውጣ ፍቀድልኝ እንዴትስ ትለዋለህ? እነሆም፥ በዓይንህ ምሰሶ አለ።

verses.text_english: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድመህ ከዓይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ከወንድምህ ዓይን ጉድፉን ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።

verses.text_english: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.text_amharic: በእግራቸው እንዳይረግጡት ተመልሰውም እንዳይነክሱአችሁ፥ የተቀደሰውን ለውሾች አትስጡ፥ ዕንቁዎቻችሁንም በእሪያዎች ፊት አትጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.text_amharic: ለምኑ፥ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ ፈልጉ፥ ታገኙማላችሁ፤ መዝጊያን አንኳኩ፥ ይከፈትላችሁማል።

verses.text_english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.text_amharic: የሚለምነው ሁሉ ይቀበላልና፥ የሚፈልገውም ያገኛል፥ መዝጊያንም ለሚያንኳኳ ይከፈትለታል።

verses.text_english: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ከእናንተ፥ ልጁ እንጀራ ቢለምነው፥ ድንጋይን የሚሰጠው ከእናንተ ማን ሰው ነው?

verses.text_english: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.text_amharic: ዓሣስ ቢለምነው እባብን ይሰጠዋልን?

verses.text_english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.text_amharic: እንኪያስ እናንተ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ስጦታ መስጠትን ካወቃችሁ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ለሚለምኑት እንዴት አብልጦ መልካም ነገርን ይሰጣቸው?

verses.text_english: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሰዎች ሊያደርጉላችሁ የምትወዱትን ሁሉ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፤ ሕግም ነቢያትም ይህ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide the gate, and broad the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.text_amharic: በጠበበው ደጅ ግቡ፤ ወደ ጥፋት የሚወስደው ደጅ ሰፊ፥ መንገዱም ትልቅ ነውና፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚገቡ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: Because strait the gate, and narrow the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሕይወት የሚወስደው ደጅ የጠበበ፥ መንገዱም የቀጠነ ነውና፥ የሚያገኙትም ጥቂቶች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.text_amharic: የበግ ለምድ ለብሰው ከሚመጡባችሁ በውሥጣቸው ግን ነጣቂዎች ተኵላዎች ከሆኑ ከሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.text_amharic: ከፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ። ከእሾህ ወይን ከኩርንችትስ በለስ ይለቀማልን?

verses.text_english: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ መልካም ዛፍ ሁሉ መልካም ፍሬ ያደርጋል፥ ክፉም ዛፍ ክፉ ፍሬ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ዛፍ ክፉ ፍሬ ማፍራት፥ ወይም ክፉ ዛፍ መልካም ፍሬ ማፍራት አይቻለውም።

verses.text_english: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ከፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ እንጂ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ የሚለኝ ሁሉ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚገባ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቀን ብዙዎች። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ በስምህ ትንቢት አልተናገርንምን፥ በስምህስ አጋንንትን አላወጣንምን፥ በስምህስ ብዙ ተአምራትን አላደረግንምን? ይሉኛል።

verses.text_english: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜም። ከቶ አላወቅኋችሁም፤ እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ ብዬ እመሰክርባቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ይህን ቃሌን ሰምቶ የሚያደርገው ሁሉ ቤቱን በዓለት ላይ የሠራ ልባም ሰውን ይመስላል።

verses.text_english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናብም ወረደ ጎርፍም መጣ ነፋስም ነፈሰ ያንም ቤት ገፋው፥ በዓለት ላይም ስለ ተመሠረተ አልወደቀም።

verses.text_english: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ሰው ሁሉ ቤቱን በአሸዋ ላይ የሠራ ሰነፍ ሰውን ይመስላል።

verses.text_english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናብም ወረደ ጎርፍም መጣ ነፋስም ነፈሰ ያንም ቤት መታው፥ ወደቀም፥ አወዳደቁም ታላቅ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን ነገር በጨረሰ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ፤ እንደ ጻፎቻቸው ሳይሆን

verses.text_english: For he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ባለ ሥልጣን ያስተምራቸው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ከተራራም በወረደ ጊዜ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ለምጻም ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብትወድስ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ እያለ ሰገደለት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus put forth hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወዳለሁ፥ ንጻ አለው። ወዲያውም ለምጹ ነጻ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ለማንም እንዳትናገር ተጠንቀቅ፥ ነገር ግን ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ፥ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ሙሴ ያዘዘውን መባ አቅርብ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም በገባ ጊዜ የመቶ አለቃ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴናዬ ሽባ ሆኖ እጅግ እየተሣቀየ በቤት ተኝቶአል ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔ መጥቼ እፈውሰዋለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃውም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በቤቴ ጣራ ከታች ልትገባ አይገባኝም፤ ነገር ግን ቃል ብቻ ተናገር፥ ብላቴናዬም ይፈወሳል።

verses.text_english: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this , Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth .
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ ለሌሎች ተገዥ ነኝና፥ ከእኔም በታች ጭፍራ አለኝ፤ አንዱንም። ሂድ ብለው ይሄዳል፥ ሌላውንም። ና ብለው ይመጣል፥ ባሪያዬንም። ይህን አድርግ ብለው ያደርጋል አለው።

verses.text_english: When Jesus heard , he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ ተደነቀና ለተከተሉት እንዲህ አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእስራኤል እንኳ እንዲህ ያለ ትልቅ እምነት አላገኘሁም።

verses.text_english: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁም፥ ብዙዎች ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ ይመጣሉ ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ ከያዕቆብም ጋር በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ይቀመጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text_amharic: የመንግሥት ልጆች ግን በውጭ ወደ አለው ጨለማ ይጣላሉ፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ለመቶ አለቃ። ሂድና እንዳመንህ ይሁንልህ አለው። ብላቴናውም በዚያች ሰዓት ተፈወሰ።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ ጴጥሮስ ቤት ገብቶ አማቱን በንዳድ ታማ ተኝታ አያት፤

verses.text_english: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እጅዋንም ዳሰሰ፥ ንዳዱም ለቀቃት፤ ተነሥታም አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with word, and healed all that were sick:
That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare sicknesses.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ብዙ ሰዎች ሲከቡት አይቶ ወደ ማዶ እንዲሻገሩ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጻፊም ቀርቦ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ወደምትሄድበት ሁሉ እከተልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ለቀበሮዎች ጉድጓድ ለሰማይም ወፎች መሳፈሪያ አላቸው፥ ለሰው ልጅ ግን ራሱን የሚያስጠጋበት የለውም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay head.
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሌላው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሜ እንድሄድ አባቴን እንድቀብር ፍቀድልኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ተከተለኝ፥ ሙታናቸውንም እንዲቀብሩ ሙታንን ተዋቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ታንኳም ሲገባ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ማዕበሉ ታንኳይቱን እስኪደፍናት ድረስ በባሕር ታላቅ መናወጥ ሆነ፤ እርሱ ግን ተኝቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አድነን፥ ጠፋን እያሉ አስነሡት።

verses.text_english: And his disciples came to , and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ ስለ ምን ትፈራላችሁ? አላቸው፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ተነሥቶ ነፋሱንና ባሕሩን ገሠጸ፥ ታላቅ ጸጥታም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም። ነፋሳትና ባሕርስ ስንኳ የሚታዘዙለት፥ ይህ እንዴት ያለ ሰው ነው? እያሉ ተደነቁ።

verses.text_english: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ማዶም ወደ ጌርጋሴኖን አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ አጋንንት ያደሩባቸው ሁለት ሰዎች ከመቃብር ወጥተው ተገናኙት፤ እነርሱም ሰው በዚያ መንገድ ማለፍ እስኪሳነው ድረስ እጅግ ክፉዎች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ጊዜው ሳይደርስ ልትሣቅየን ወደዚህ መጣህን? እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ርቆ የብዙ እሪያ መንጋ ይሰማራ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.text_amharic: አጋንንቱም። ታወጣንስ እንደሆንህ፥ ወደ እሪያው መንጋ ስደደን ብለው ለመኑት። ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎቹ ሄዱና ገቡ፤ እነሆም፥ የእሪያዎቹ መንጋ ሁሉ ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር እየተጣደፉ ሮጡ በውኃም ውስጥ ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞችም ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ሄደው ነገሩን ሁሉ አጋንንትም በአደሩባቸው የሆነውን አወሩ።

verses.text_english: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከተማው ሁሉ ኢየሱስን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ባዩትም ጊዜ ከአገራቸው እንዲሄድላቸው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.text_amharic: በታንኳም ገብቶ ተሻገረና ወደ ገዛ ከተማው መጣ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በአልጋ የተኛ ሽባ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ። ኢየሱስም እምነታቸውን አይቶ ሽባውን። አንተ ልጅ፥ አይዞህ፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This blasphemeth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከጻፎቹ አንዳንዱ በልባቸው። ይህስ ይሳደባል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አለ። ስለ ምን በልባችሁ ክፉ ታስባላችሁ?

verses.text_english: For whether is easier, to say, sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.text_english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ለሰው ልጅ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሽባውን። ተነሣ፤ አልጋህን ተሸከምና ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቶም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: But when the multitudes saw , they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም አይተው ተደነቁ፥ ለሰውም እንዲህ ያለ ሥልጣን የሰጠ እግዚአብሔርን አከበሩ።

verses.text_english: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ አልፎ በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ የነበረ ማቴዎስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው አየና። ተከተለኝ አለው። ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ እነሆ፥ ብዙ ቀራጮችና ኃጢአተኞች መጥተው ከኢየሱስና ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር አብረው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And when the Pharisees saw , they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም አይተው ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። መምህራችሁ ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር አብሮ ስለ ምን ይበላል? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: But when Jesus heard , he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ባለ ጤናዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም፤

verses.text_english: But go ye and learn what meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሄዳችሁ። ምሕረትን እወዳለሁ መሥዋዕትንም አይደለም ያለው ምን እንደ ሆነ ተማሩ፤ ኃጢአተኞችን ወደ ንስሐ እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁምና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። እኛና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ብዙ ጊዜ የምንጦመው፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ግን የማይጦሙት ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ሚዜዎች ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሊያዝኑ ይችላሉን? ነገር ግን ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ የሚወሰድበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ በዚያ ጊዜም ይጦማሉ።

verses.text_english: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.text_amharic: በአረጀ ልብስ አዲስ እራፊ የሚያኖር የለም፤ መጣፊያው ልብሱን ይቦጭቀዋልና፥ መቀደዱም የባሰ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.text_amharic: በአረጀ አቁማዳ አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ አቁማዳው ይፈነዳል፥ የወይን ጠጁም ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል፤ ነገር ግን አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ በአዲስ አቁማዳ ያኖረዋል፥ ሁለቱም ይጠባበቃሉ።

verses.text_english: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሲነግራቸው፥ አንድ መኰንን መጥቶ። ልጄ አሁን ሞተች፤ ነገር ግን መጥተህ እጅህን ጫንባት፥ በሕይወትም ትኖራለች እያለ ሰገደለት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ተነሥቶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተከተለው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind , and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈስሳት ሴት በኋላው ቀርባ የልብሱን ጫፍ ዳሰሰች፤

verses.text_english: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.text_amharic: በልብዋ። ልብሱን ብቻ የዳሰስሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እድናለሁ ትል ነበረችና።

verses.text_english: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ አያትና። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አይዞሽ፤ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል አላት። ሴቲቱም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምራ ዳነች።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ መኰንኑ ቤት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ እምቢልተኞችንና የሚንጫጫውን ሕዝብ አይቶ።

verses.text_english: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴናይቱ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችምና ፈቀቅ በሉ አላቸው። በጣምም ሳቁበት።

verses.text_english: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡን ግን ከአስወጡ በኋላ ገብቶ እጅዋን ያዛት፥ ብላቴናይቱም ተነሣች።

verses.text_english: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ዝና ወደዚያ አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ ሲያልፍ ሁለት ዕውሮች። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረን ብለው እየጮሁ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም በገባ ጊዜ ዕውሮቹ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥ ኢየሱስም። ይህን ማድረግ እንድችል ታምናላችሁን? አላቸው። አዎን፥ ጌታ ሆይ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ። እንደ እምነታችሁ ይሁንላችሁ ብሎ ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ።

verses.text_english: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See no man know .
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቻቸውም ተከፈቱ።

verses.text_english: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ማንም እንዳያውቅ ተጠንቀቁ ብሎ በብርቱ አዘዛቸው። እነርሱ ግን ወጥተው በዚያ አገር ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ አወሩ።

verses.text_english: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሲወጡ እነሆ፥ ጋኔን ያደረበትን ዲዳ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ።

verses.text_english: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ጋኔኑንም ካወጣው በኋላ ዲዳው ተናገረ። ሕዝቡም። እንዲህ ያለ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከቶ አልታየም እያሉ ተደነቁ።

verses.text_english: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያን ግን። በአጋንንት አለቃ አጋንንትን ያወጣል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በምኩራቦቻቸው እያስተማረ፥ የመንግሥትንም ወንጌል እየሰበከ፥ በሕዝብም ያለውን ደዌና ሕማም ሁሉ እየፈወሰ፥ በከተማዎችና በመንደሮች ሁሉ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕዝብም ባየ ጊዜ፥ እረኛ እንደ ሌላቸው በጎች ተጨንቀው ተጥለውም ነበርና አዘነላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly plenteous, but the labourers few;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። መከሩስ ብዙ ነው፥ ሠራተኞች ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የመከሩን ጌታ ወደ መከሩ ሠራተኞች እንዲልክ ለምኑት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had called unto his twelve disciples, he gave them power unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ፥ እንዲያወጡአቸው በርኩሳን መናፍስት ላይ ደዌንና ሕማምንም ሁሉ እንዲፈውሱ ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.text_amharic: የአሥራ ሁለቱም ሐዋርያት ስም ይህ ነው፤ መጀመሪያው ጴጥሮስ የተባለው ስምዖን ወንድሙ እንድርያስም፥ የዘብዴዎስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ወንድሙ ዮሐንስም፥

verses.text_english: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.text_amharic: ፊልጶስም በርተሎሜዎስም፥ ቶማስም ቀራጩ ማቴዎስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ታዴዎስም የተባለው ልብድዮስ፥

verses.text_english: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.text_amharic: ቀነናዊውም ስምዖን ደግሞም አሳልፎ የሰጠው የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ።

verses.text_english: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን አሥራ ሁለቱን ኢየሱስ ላካቸው፥ አዘዛቸውም፥ እንዲህም አለ። በአሕዛብ መንገድ አትሂዱ፥ ወደ ሳምራውያንም ከተማ አትግቡ፤

verses.text_english: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ይልቅስ የእስራኤል ቤት ወደሚሆኑ ወደ ጠፉት በጎች ሂዱ እንጂ።

verses.text_english: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዳችሁም። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለች ብላችሁ ስበኩ።

verses.text_english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.text_amharic: ድውዮችን ፈውሱ፤ ሙታንን አስነሡ፤ ለምጻሞችን አንጹ፤ አጋንንትን አውጡ፤ በከንቱ ተቀበላችሁ፥ በከንቱ ስጡ።

verses.text_english: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.text_amharic: ወርቅ ወይም ብር ወይም ናስ በመቀነታችሁ፥

verses.text_english: Nor scrip for journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ለመንገድ ከረጢት ወይም ሁለት እጀ ጠባብ ወይም ጫማ ወይም በትር አታግኙ፤ ለሠራተኛ ምግቡ ይገባዋልና።

verses.text_english: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.text_amharic: በምትገቡባትም በማናቸይቱም ከተማ ወይም መንደር፥ በዚያ የሚገባው ማን እንደ ሆነ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ እስክትወጡም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም ስትገቡ ሰላምታ ስጡ፤

verses.text_english: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱም የሚገባው ቢሆን ሰላማችሁ ይድረስለት፤ ባይገባው ግን ሰላማችሁ ይመለስላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.text_amharic: ከማይቀበላችሁም ቃላችሁንም ከማይሰሙ ሁሉ፥ ከዚያ ቤት ወይም ከዚያች ከተማ ስትወጡ የእግራችሁን ትቢያ አራግፉ።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶምና ለገሞራ አገር ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እኔ እንደ በጎች በተኵላዎች መካከል እልካችኋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ እንደ እባብ ልባሞች እንደ ርግብም የዋሆች ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወደ ሸንጎ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ በምኩራቦቻቸውም ይገርፉአችኋልና ከሰዎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱና ለአሕዛብም ምስክር እንዲሆን፥ ስለ እኔ ወደ ገዥዎች ወደ ነገሥታትም ትወሰዳላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.text_amharic: አሳልፈውም ሲሰጡአችሁ፥ የምትናገሩት በዚያች ሰዓት ይሰጣችኋልና እንዴት ወይስ ምን እንድትናገሩ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.text_english: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተ የሚናገር የአባታችሁ መንፈስ ነው እንጂ፥ የምትናገሩ እናንተ አይደላችሁምና።

verses.text_english: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምም ወንድሙን፥ አባትም ልጁን ለሞት አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ልጆችም በወላጆቻቸው ላይ ይነሣሉ ይገድሉአቸውማል።

verses.text_english: And ye shall be hated of all for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ፤ እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.text_english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.text_amharic: በአንዲቱ ከተማም መከራ ቢያሳዩአችሁ ወደ ሌላይቱ ሽሹ፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁና፥ የሰው ልጅ እስኪመጣ ድረስ የእስራኤልን ከተማዎች አትዘልቁም።

verses.text_english: The disciple is not above master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዝሙር ከመምህሩ፥ ባሪያም ከጌታው አይበልጥም።

verses.text_english: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more them of his household?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዝሙር እንደ መምህሩ፥ ባሪያም እንደ ጌታው መሆኑ ይበቃዋል። ባለቤቱን ብዔል ዜቡል ካሉት፥ ቤተሰዎቹንማ እንዴት አብዝተው አይሉአቸው!

verses.text_english: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አትፍሩአቸው፤ የማይገለጥ የተከደነ፥ የማይታወቅም የተሰወረ ምንም የለምና።

verses.text_english: What I tell you in darkness, speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.text_amharic: በጨለማ የምነግራችሁን በብርሃን ተናገሩ፤ በጆሮም የምትሰሙትን በሰገነት ላይ ስበኩ።

verses.text_english: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋንም የሚገድሉትን ነፍስን ግን መግደል የማይቻላቸውን አትፍሩ፤ ይልቅስ ነፍስንም ሥጋንም በገሃነም ሊያጠፋ የሚቻለውን ፍሩ።

verses.text_english: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ድንቢጦች በአምስት ሳንቲም ይሸጡ የለምን? ከእነርሱም አንዲቱ ያለ አባታችሁ ፈቃድ በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።

verses.text_english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.text_amharic: የእናንተስ የራሳችሁ ጠጉር ሁሉ እንኳ ተቈጥሮአል።

verses.text_english: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አትፍሩ ከብዙ ድንቢጦች እናንተ ትበልጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በሰው ፊት ለሚመሰክርልኝ ሁሉ እኔ ደግሞ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ፊት እመሰክርለታለሁ፤

verses.text_english: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ፊትም የሚክደኝን ሁሉ እኔ ደግሞ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ፊት እክደዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ሰላምን ለማምጣት የመጣሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ ሰይፍን እንጂ ሰላምን ለማምጣት አልመጣሁም።

verses.text_english: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን ከአባቱ፥ ሴት ልጅንም ከእናትዋ፥ ምራትንም ከአማትዋ እለያይ ዘንድ መጥቻለሁና፤

verses.text_english: And a man's foes they of his own household.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰውም ቤተ ሰዎቹ ጠላቶች ይሆኑበታል።

verses.text_english: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ይልቅ አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤ ከእኔ ይልቅም ወንድ ልጁን ወይም ሴት ልጁን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤

verses.text_english: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.text_amharic: መስቀሉንም የማይዝ በኋላዬም የማይከተለኝ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም።

verses.text_english: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን የሚያገኝ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም ስለ እኔ የሚያጠፋ ያገኛታል።

verses.text_english: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተን የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፥ እኔንም የሚቀበል የላከኝን ይቀበላል።

verses.text_english: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢይን በነቢይ ስም የሚቀበል የነቢይን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፥ ጻድቅንም በጻድቅ ስም የሚቀበል የጻድቁን ዋጋ ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ ለአንዱ ቀዝቃዛ ጽዋ ውኃ ብቻ በደቀ መዝሙር ስም የሚያጠጣ፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋው አይጠፋበትም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ማዘዝ በፈጸመ ጊዜ በከተሞቻቸው ሊያስተምርና ሊሰብክ ከዚያ አለፈ።

verses.text_english: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም በወህኒ ሳለ የክርስቶስን ሥራ ሰምቶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ላከና።

verses.text_english: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.text_amharic: የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን? ወይስ ሌላ እንጠብቅ? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ለዮሐንስ አውሩለት፤

verses.text_english: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውሮች ያያሉ አንካሶችም ይሄዳሉ፥ ለምጻሞችም ይነጻሉ ደንቆሮችም ይሰማሉ፥ ሙታንም ይነሣሉ

verses.text_english: And blessed is , whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.text_amharic: ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበካል፤ በእኔም የማይሰናከለው ሁሉ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.text_english: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ሲሄዱ ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡ ስለ ዮሐንስ ሊናገር ጀመረ እንዲህም አለ። ምን ልታዩ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣችሁ?

verses.text_english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft are in kings' houses.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስ የሚወዘውዘውን ሸምበቆን? ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሰ ሰውን? እነሆ፥ ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሱ በነገሥታት ቤት አሉ።

verses.text_english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ነቢይን? አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከነቢይም የሚበልጠውን።

verses.text_english: For this is , of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን በፊትህ የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.text_amharic: ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ይህ ነውና። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ አልተነሣም፤ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

verses.text_english: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.text_amharic: ከመጥምቁም ከዮሐንስ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ትገፋለች፥ ግፈኞችም ይናጠቋታል።

verses.text_english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢያት ሁሉና ሕጉ እስከ ዮሐንስ ድረስ ትንቢት ተናገሩ፤

verses.text_english: And if ye will receive , this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.text_amharic: ልትቀበሉትስ ብትወዱ፥ ይመጣ ዘንድ ያለው ኤልያስ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.text_english: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህን ትውልድ በምን እመስለዋለሁ? በገበያ የሚቀመጡትን ልጆች ይመስላሉ፥ እነርሱም ባልንጀሮቻቸውን እየጠሩ።

verses.text_english: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
verses.text_amharic: እንቢልታ ነፋንላችሁ ዘፈንም አልዘፈናችሁም ሙሾ አወጣንላችሁ ዋይ ዋይም አላላችሁም ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ ሳይበላና ሳይጠጣ መጣ፥ እነርሱም። ጋኔን አለበት አሉት።

verses.text_english: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ እየበላና እየጠጣ መጣ፥ እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ በላተኛና የወይን ጠጅ ጠጭ፥ የቀራጮችና የኃጢአተኞች ወዳጅ ይሉታል። ጥበብም በልጆችዋ ጸደቀች።

verses.text_english: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የሚበዙ ተአምራት የተደረገባቸውን ከተማዎች ንስሐ ስላልገቡ ሊነቅፋቸው ጀመረ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.text_amharic: ወዮልሽ ኮራዚ፤ ወዮልሽ ቤተ ሳይዳ፤ በእናንተ የተደረገው ተአምራት በጢሮስና በሲዶና ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ ማቅ ለብሰው አመድም ነስንሰው ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት ንስሐ በገቡ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከእናንተ ይልቅ ለጢሮስና ለሲዶና ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺም ቅፍርናሆም፥ እስከ ሰማይ ከፍ አልሽን? ወደ ሲኦል ትወርጃለሽ፤ በአንቺ የተደረገው ተአምራት በሰዶም ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ እስከ ዛሬ በኖረች ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከአንቺ ይልቅ ለሰዶም አገር ይቀልላታል።

verses.text_english: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። አባት ሆይ፥ የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ፥ ይህን ከጥበበኞችና ከአስተዋዮች ሰውረህ ለሕፃናት ስለ ገለጥህላቸው አመሰግንሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: አዎን፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህ በፊትህ እንዲህ ሆኖአልና።

verses.text_english: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and to whomsoever the Son will reveal .
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ከአባቴ ዘንድ ተሰጥቶኛል፤ ከአብ በቀር ወልድን የሚያውቅ የለም፥ ከወልድም በቀር ወልድም ሊገለጥለት ከሚፈቅድ በቀር አብን የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.text_english: Come unto me, all that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደካሞች ሸክማችሁ የከበደ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እኔ ኑ፥ እኔም አሳርፋችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንበሬን በላያችሁ ተሸከሙ ከእኔም ተማሩ፥ እኔ የዋህ በልቤም ትሑት ነኝና፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: For my yoke easy, and my burden is light.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንበሬ ልዝብ ሸክሜም ቀሊል ነውና።

verses.text_english: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በሰንበት ቀን በእርሻ መካከል አለፈ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ተራቡና እሸት ይቀጥፉ ይበሉም ጀመር።

verses.text_english: But when the Pharisees saw , they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም አይተው። እነሆ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ በሰንበት ማድረግ ያልተፈቀደውን ያደርጋሉ አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ዳዊትና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት በተራቡ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ያደረገውን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ ካህናትም ብቻ እንጂ እርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሊበሉት ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕቱን ኅብስት እንደ በላ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.text_amharic: ካህናትም በሰንበት በመቅደስ ሰንበትን እንዲያረክሱ ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንባቸው በሕጉ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That in this place is greater than the temple.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከመቅደስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.text_english: But if ye had known what meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትን እወዳለሁ መሥዋዕትንም አይደለም ያለው ምን እንደሆነ ብታውቁስ ኃጢአት የሌለባቸውን ባልኰነናችሁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም አልፎ ወደ ምኩራባቸው ገባ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there was a man which had hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበረ፤ ይከሱትም ዘንድ። በሰንበት መፈወስ ተፈቅዶአልን? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift out?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ከእናንተ አንድ በግ ያለው በሰንበት በጉድጓድ ቢወድቅበት፥ ይዞ የማያወጣው ሰው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሰው ከበግ ይልቅ እንደምን አይበልጥም! ስለዚህ በሰንበት መልካም መሥራት ተፈቅዶአል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ሰውየውን። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው። ዘረጋትም፥ እንደ ሁለተኛይቱም ደህና ሆነች።

verses.text_english: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያን ግን ወጥተው እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ተማከሩበት።

verses.text_english: But when Jesus knew , he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አውቆ ከዚያ ፈቀቅ አለ። ብዙ ሰዎችም ተከተሉት፥ ሁሉንም ፈወሳቸው፥ እንዳይገልጡትም አዘዛቸው፤

verses.text_english: And charged them that they should not make him known:
That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ የመረጥሁት ብላቴናዬ፥ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ወዳጄ፤ መንፈሴን በእርሱ ላይ አኖራለሁ፥ ፍርድንም ለአሕዛብ ያወራል።

verses.text_english: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: አይከራከርም አይጮህምም፥ ድምፁንም በአደባባይ የሚሰማ የለም።

verses.text_english: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.text_amharic: ፍርድን ድል ለመንሣት እስኪያወጣ፥ የተቀጠቀጠን ሸምበቆ አይሰብርም የሚጤስን የጥዋፍ ክርም አያጠፋም።

verses.text_english: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም በስሙ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ጋኔን ያደረበትን ዕውር ዲዳም ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ዕውሩም ዲዳውም እስኪያይና እስኪናገር ድረስ ፈወሰው።

verses.text_english: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተገረሙና። እንጃ ይህ ሰው የዳዊት ልጅ ይሆንን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያን ግን ሰምተው። ይህ በብዔል ዜቡል በአጋንንት አለቃ ካልሆነ በቀር አጋንንትን አያወጣም አሉ።

verses.text_english: But when the Pharisees heard , they said, This doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እርስ በርስዋ የምትለያይ መንግሥት ሁላ ትጠፋለች፥ እርስ በርሱ የሚለያይ ከተማም ሁሉ ወይም ቤት አይቆምም።

verses.text_english: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም ሰይጣንን የሚያወጣ ከሆነ፥ እርስ በርሱ ተለያየ፥ እንግዲህ መንግሥቱ እንዴት ትቆማለች?

verses.text_english: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ በብዔል ዜቡል አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ ልጆቻችሁ በማን ያወጡአቸዋል? ስለዚህ እነርሱ ፈራጆች ይሆኑባችኋል።

verses.text_english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ደርሳለች።

verses.text_english: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ሰው አስቀድሞ ኃይለኛውን ሳያስር ወደ ኃይለኛው ቤት ገብቶ እቃውን ሊነጥቀው እንዴት ይችላል? ከዚያም ወዲያ ቤቱን ይበዘብዛል።

verses.text_english: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ያልሆነ ይቃወመኛል፥ ከእኔ ጋርም የማያከማች ይበትናል።

verses.text_english: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ኃጢአትና ስድብ ሁሉ ለሰዎች ይሰረይላቸዋል፥ ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስን ለሰደበ አይሰረይለትም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy the Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ልጅ ላይ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይሰረይለታል፤ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ላይ ግን የሚናገር ሁሉ በዚህ ዓለም ቢሆን ወይም በሚመጣው አይሰረይለትም።

verses.text_english: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the to come.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፍ ከፍሬዋ ትታወቃለችና ዛፍዋን መልካም፥ ፍሬዋንም መልካም አድርጉ፥ ወይም ዛፍዋን ክፉ ፍሬዋንም ክፉ አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by fruit.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ መልካም ለመናገር እንዴት ትችላላችሁ? በልብ ሞልቶ ከተረፈው አፍ ይናገራልና።

verses.text_english: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም ሰው ከልቡ መልካም መዝገብ መልካም ነገርን ያወጣል፥ ክፉ ሰውም ከክፉ መዝገብ ክፉ ነገርን ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰዎች ስለሚናገሩት ስለ ከንቱ ነገር ሁሉ በፍርድ ቀን መልስ ይሰጡበታል፤

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ከቃልህ የተነሣ ትጸድቃለህና ከቃልህም የተነሣ ትኰነናለህ።

verses.text_english: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ከጻፎችና ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዶቹ መለሱና። መምህር ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ምልክት እንድናይ እንወዳለን አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.text_amharic: ዮናስ በዓሣ አንባሪ ሆድ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ልጅ በምድር ልብ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የነነዌ ሰዎች በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥተው ይፈርዱበታል፤ በዮናስ ስብከት ንስሐ ገብተዋልና፥ እነሆም፥ ከዮናስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.text_english: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas here.
verses.text_amharic: ንግሥተ ዓዜብ በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥታ ትፈርድበታለች፤ የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ለመስማት ከምድር ዳር መጥታለችና፥ እነሆም፥ ከሰሎሞን የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.text_english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon here.
verses.text_amharic: ርኩስ መንፈስ ግን ከሰው በወጣ ጊዜ፥ ዕረፍት እየፈለገ ውኃ በሌለበት ቦታ ያልፋል፥ አያገኝምም።

verses.text_english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም። ወደ ወጣሁበት ቤቴ እመለሳለሁ ይላል፤ ቢመጣም ባዶ ሆኖ ተጠርጎና አጊጦ ያገኘዋል።

verses.text_english: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወዲያ ይሄድና ከእርሱ የከፉትን ሰባት ሌሎችን አጋንንት ከእርሱ ጋር ይወስዳል፥ ገብተውም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፤ ለዚያም ሰው ከፊተኛው ይልቅ የኋለኛው ይብስበታል። ለዚህ ክፉ ትውልድ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆንበታል።

verses.text_english: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.text_amharic: ገናም ለሕዝቡ ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ እናቱና ወንድሞቹ ሊነጋገሩት ፈልገው በውጭ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: While he yet talked to the people, behold, mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም። እነሆ፥ እናትህና ወንድሞችህ ሊነጋገሩህ ፈልገው በውጭ ቆመዋል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ለነገረው መልሶ። እናቴ ማን ናት? ወንድሞቼስ እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ዘርግቶ። እነሆ እናቴና ወንድሞቼ፤

verses.text_english: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.text_amharic: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ ወንድሜ እኅቴም እናቴም ነውና አለ።

verses.text_english: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀን ኢየሱስ ከቤት ወጥቶ በባሕር አጠገብ ተቀመጠ፤

verses.text_english: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በታንኳ ገብቶ እስኪቀመጥ ድረስ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በወደቡ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.text_amharic: በምሳሌም ብዙ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ዘሪ ሊዘራ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሲዘራ አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀ፥ ወፎችም መጥተው በሉት።

verses.text_english: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም ብዙ መሬት በሌለበት በጭንጫ ላይ ወደቀ፤ ጥልቅ መሬትም ስላልነበረው ወዲያው በቀለ፥

verses.text_english: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ በወጣ ጊዜ ግን ጠወለገ፥ ሥርም ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.text_english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾህም ወጣና አነቀው።

verses.text_english: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ወደቀ፤ አንዱም መቶ፥ አንዱም ስድሳ፥ አንዱም ሠላሳ ፍሬ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.text_english: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። ስለ ምን በምሳሌ ትነግራቸዋለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ለእናንተ የመንግሥተ ሰማያትን ምሥጢር ማወቅ ተሰጥቶአችኋል፥ ለእነርሱ ግን አልተሰጣቸውም።

verses.text_english: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.text_amharic: ላለው ይሰጠዋልና ይበዛለትማል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.text_english: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እያዩ ስለማያዩ እየሰሙም ስለማይሰሙ ስለማያስተውሉም በምሳሌ እነግራቸዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.text_amharic: መስማት ትሰማላችሁና አታስተውሉም፥ ማየትም ታያላችሁና አትመለከቱም።

verses.text_english: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with eyes, and hear with ears, and should understand with heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ፥ በጆሮአቸውም እንዳይሰሙ፥ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ፥ ተመልሰውም እንዳልፈውሳቸው፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ደንድኖአልና ጆሮአቸውም ደንቁሮአል ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍነዋል የሚል የኢሳይያስ ትንቢት በእነርሱ ይፈጸማል።

verses.text_english: But blessed your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.text_amharic: የእናንተ ግን ዓይኖቻችሁ ስለሚያዩ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለሚሰሙ ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous have desired to see which ye see, and have not seen ; and to hear which ye hear, and have not heard .
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ብዙዎች ነቢያትና ጻድቃን የምታዩትን ሊያዩ ተመኝተው አላዩም፥ የምትሰሙትንም ሊሰሙ ተመኝተው አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እናንተ የዘሪውን ምሳሌ ስሙ።

verses.text_english: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth not, then cometh the wicked , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.text_amharic: የመንግሥትን ቃል ሰምቶ በማያስተውል ሁሉ፥ ክፉው ይመጣል፥ በልቡ የተዘራውንም ይነጥቃል፤ በመንገድ ዳር የተዘራው ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.text_amharic: በጭንጫ ላይ የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን ሰምቶ ወዲያው በደስታ የሚቀበለው ነው፤

verses.text_english: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለጊዜው ነው እንጂ በእርሱ ሥር የለውም፥ በቃሉ ምክንያትም መከራ ወይም ስደት በሆነ ጊዜ ወዲያው ይሰናከላል።

verses.text_english: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.text_amharic: በእሾህ መካከል የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን የሚሰማ ነው፥ የዚህም ዓለም አሳብና የባለጠግነት መታለል ቃሉን ያንቃል፥ የማያፈራም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth ; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.text_amharic: በመልካም መሬት የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን ሰምቶ የሚያስተውል ነው፤ እርሱም ፍሬ ያፈራል አንዱም መቶ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም ሠላሳ ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ ምሳሌ አቀረበላቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት በእርሻው መልካም ዘርን የዘራን ሰው ትመስላለች።

verses.text_english: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹ ሲተኙ ግን ጠላቱ መጣና በስንዴው መካከል እንክርዳድን ዘርቶ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.text_amharic: ስንዴውም በበቀለና በአፈራ ጊዜ እንክርዳዱ ደግሞ ያን ጊዜ ታየ።

verses.text_english: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.text_amharic: የባለቤቱም ባሮች ቀርበው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መልካምን ዘር በእርሻህ ዘርተህ አልነበርህምን? እንክርዳዱንስ ከወዴት አገኘ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጠላት ይህን አደረገ አላቸው። ባሮቹም። እንግዲህ ሄደን ብንለቅመው ትወዳለህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። እንክርዳዱን ስትለቅሙ ስንዴውን ከእርሱ ጋር እንዳትነቅሉት አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.text_amharic: ተዉአቸው፤ እስከ መከር ጊዜ አብረው ይደጉ፤ በመከር ጊዜም አጫጆችን። እንክርዳዱን አስቀድማችሁ ልቀሙ በእሳትም ለማቃጠል በየነዶው እሰሩ፥ ስንዴውን ግን በጎተራዬ ክተቱ እላለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ ምሳሌ አቀረበላቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ሰው ወስዶ በእርሻው የዘራትን የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት ትመስላለች፤

verses.text_english: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ከዘር ሁሉ ታንሳለች፥ በአደገች ጊዜ ግን፥ ከአታክልቶች ትበልጣለች የሰማይም ወፎች መጥተው በቅርንጫፎችዋ እስኪሰፍሩ ድረስ ዛፍ ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ ምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ ሴት ወስዳ በሦስት መስፈሪያ ዱቄት የሸሸገችውን እርሾ ትመስላለች።

verses.text_english: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ ቤት ገባ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። የእርሻውን እንክርዳድ ምሳሌ ተርጕምልን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መልካምን ዘር የዘራው የሰው ልጅ ነው፤ እርሻውም ዓለም ነው፤

verses.text_english: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙም ዘር የመንግሥት ልጆች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked ;
verses.text_amharic: እንክርዳዱም የክፉው ልጆች ናቸው፥ የዘራውም ጠላት ዲያብሎስ ነው፤ መከሩም የዓለም መጨረሻ ነው፥ አጫጆችም መላእክት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንክርዳድ ተለቅሞ በእሳት እንደሚቃጠል፥ በዓለም መጨረሻ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ መላእክቱን ይልካል፥ ከመንግሥቱም እንቅፋትን ሁሉ ዓመፃንም የሚያደርጉትን ይለቅማሉ፥

verses.text_english: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እቶነ እሳትም ይጥሉአቸዋል፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻድቃን በአባታቸው መንግሥት እንደ ፀሐይ ይበራሉ። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.text_english: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት በእርሻ ውስጥ የተሰወረውን መዝገብ ትመስላለች፤ ሰውም አግኝቶ ሰወረው፥ ከደስታውም የተነሣ ሄዶ ያለውን ሁሉ ሸጠና ያን እርሻ ገዛ።

verses.text_english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መልካምን ዕንቁ የሚሻ ነጋዴን ትመስላለች፤

verses.text_english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.text_amharic: ዋጋዋም እጅግ የበዛ አንዲት ዕንቁ በአገኘ ጊዜ ሄዶ ያለውን ሁሉ ሸጠና ገዛት።

verses.text_english: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ወደ ባሕር የተጣለች ከሁሉም ዓይነት የሰበሰበች መረብን ትመስላለች፤

verses.text_english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.text_amharic: በሞላችም ጊዜ ወደ ወደቡ አወጡአት፥ ተቀምጠውም መልካሙን ለቅመው በዕቃዎች ውስጥ አከማቹ ክፉውን ግን ወደ ውጭ ጣሉት።

verses.text_english: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለም መጨረሻ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ መላእክት መጥተው ኃጢአተኞችን ከጻድቃን መካከል ይለዩአቸዋል፥ ወደ እቶነ እሳትም ይጥሉአቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ይህን ሁሉ አስተዋላችሁን? አላቸው አዎን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስለዚህ የመንግሥተ ሰማያት ደቀ መዝሙር የሆነ ጻፊ ሁሉ ከመዝገቡ አዲሱንና አሮጌውን የሚያወጣ ባለቤትን ይመስላል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure new and old.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እነዚህም ምሳሌዎች ከጨረሰ በኋላ ከዚያ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ገዛ አገሩም መጥቶ እስኪገረሙ ድረስ በምኩራባቸው ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤ እንዲህም አሉ። ይህን ጥበብና ተአምራት ይህ ከወዴት አገኘው?

verses.text_english: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this this wisdom, and mighty works?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የጸራቢ ልጅ አይደለምን? እናቱስ ማርያም ትባል የለምን? ወንድሞቹስ ያዕቆብና ዮሳ ስምዖንም ይሁዳም አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.text_amharic: እኅቶቹስ ሁሉ በእኛ ዘንድ ያሉ አይደሉምን? እንኪያስ ይህን ሁሉ ከወዴት አገኘው? ተሰናከሉበትም።

verses.text_english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this all these things?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። ነቢይ ከገዛ አገሩና ከገዛ ቤቱ በቀር ሳይከበር አይቀርም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.text_amharic: በአለማመናቸውም ምክንያት በዚያ ብዙ ተአምራት አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ዘመን የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስ የኢየሱስን ዝና ሰማ፥

verses.text_english: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.text_amharic: ለሎሌዎቹም። ይህ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ነው፤ እርሱ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል፥ ስለዚህም ኃይል በእርሱ ይደረጋል አለ።

verses.text_english: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስ በወንድሙ በፊልጶስ ሚስት በሄሮድያዳ ምክንያት ዮሐንስን አስይዞ አሳስሮት በወህኒ አኑሮት ነበርና፤

verses.text_english: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ። እርስዋ ለአንተ ትሆን ዘንድ አልተፈቀደም ይለው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ሊገድለውም ወዶ ሳለ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ ነቢይ ስለ አዩት ፈራቸው።

verses.text_english: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሄሮድስ የተወለደበት ቀን በሆነ ጊዜ፥ የሄሮድያዳ ልጅ በመካከላቸው ዘፈነች ሄሮድስንም ደስ አሰኘችው፤

verses.text_english: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የምትለምነውን ሁሉ እንዲሰጣት በመሐላ ተስፋ አደረገላት።

verses.text_english: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በእናትዋ ተመክራ። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ በዚህ በወጭት ስጠኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded to be given .
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አዘነ፥ ነገር ግን ስለ መሐላው ከእርሱም ጋር ተቀምጠው ስላሉት ሰዎች እንዲሰጡአት አዘዘ፤

verses.text_english: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.text_amharic: ልኮም የዮሐንስን ራስ በወህኒ አስቆረጠው።

verses.text_english: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought to her mother.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱንም በወጭት አምጥተው ለብላቴናይቱ ሰጡአት፥ ወደ እናትዋም ወሰደችው።

verses.text_english: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው በድኑን ወሰዱና ቀበሩት፥ መጥተውም ለኢየሱስ አወሩለት።

verses.text_english: When Jesus heard , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard , they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ ከዚያ ብቻውን ወደ ምድረ በዳ በታንኳ ፈቀቅ አለ፤ ሕዝቡም ሰምተው ከከተማዎቹ በእግር ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥቶም ብዙ ሕዝብ አየና አዘነላቸው ድውዮቻቸውንም ፈወሰ።

verses.text_english: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ቦታው ምድረ በዳ ነው አሁንም ሰዓቱ አልፎአል፤ ወደ መንደሮች ሄደው ለራሳቸው ምግብ እንዲገዙ ሕዝቡን አሰናብት አሉት።

verses.text_english: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው እንጂ ሊሄዱ አያስፈልግም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ከአምስት እንጀራና ከሁለት ዓሣ በቀር በዚህ የለንም አሉት።

verses.text_english: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እነዚያን ወደዚህ አምጡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በሣር ላይ እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ፥ አምስቱንም እንጀራና ሁለቱን ዓሣ ይዞ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረከ፥ እንጀራውንም ቆርሶ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለሕዝቡ።

verses.text_english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፥ የተረፈውንም ቁርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሙሉ አነሡ።

verses.text_english: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴቶችና ከልጆችም በቀር የበሉት አምስት ሺህ ወንዶች ያህሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡን ሲያሰናብት ሳለ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በታንኳይቱ ገብተው ወደ ማዶ እንዲቀድሙት ግድ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
