verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም አሰናብቶ ይጸልይ ዘንድ ብቻውን ወደ ተራራ ወጣ። በመሸም ጊዜ ብቻውን በዚያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.text_amharic: ታንኳይቱም አሁን በባሕር መካከል ሳለች፥ ነፋስ ከወደ ፊት ነበርና በማዕበል ትጨነቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌሊቱም በአራተኛው ክፍል ኢየሱስ በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ እነርሱ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በባሕር ላይ ሲሄድ ባዩት ጊዜ። ምትሐት ነው ብለው ታወኩ በፍርሃትም ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ ተናገራቸውና። አይዞአችሁ፥ እኔ ነኝ፤ አትፍሩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተስ ከሆንህ በውኃው ላይ ወደ አንተ እንድመጣ እዘዘኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ና አለው። ጴጥሮስም ከታንኳይቱ ወርዶ ወደ ኢየሱስ ሊደርስ በውኃው ላይ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የነፋሱን ኃይል አይቶ ፈራ፥ ሊሰጥምም በጀመረ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And immediately Jesus stretched forth hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ እጁን ዘርግቶ ያዘውና። አንተ እምነት የጎደለህ፥ ስለምን ተጠራጠርህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ታንኳይቱም በወጡ ጊዜ ነፋሱ ተወ።

verses.text_english: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: በታንኳይቱም የነበሩት። በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ ብለው ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.text_amharic: ተሻግረውም ወደ ጌንሴሬጥ ምድር መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.text_amharic: የዚያ ቦታ ሰዎችም ባወቁት ጊዜ በዙርያው ወዳለ አገር ሁሉ ላኩ፥ ሕመምተኞችንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤

verses.text_english: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.text_amharic: የልብሱንም ጫፍ ብቻ ሊዳስሱ ይለምኑት ነበር፤ የዳሰሱትም ሁሉ ዳኑ።

verses.text_english: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረቡና።

verses.text_english: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ስለ ምን የሽማግሎችን ወግ ይተላለፋሉ? እንጀራ ሲበሉ እጃቸውን አይታጠቡምና አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተስ ስለ ወጋችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ስለ ምን ትተላለፋላችሁ?

verses.text_english: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ ደግሞ። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሰደበ ፈጽሞ ይሙት ብሎአልና፤

verses.text_english: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to father or mother, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን። ከእኔ የምትጠቀምበት መባ ነው የሚል ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And honour not his father or his mother, . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን አያከብርም ትላላችሁ፤ ስለ ወጋችሁም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሻራችሁ።

verses.text_english: hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ኢሳይያስ ስለ እናንተ።

verses.text_english: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝብ በከንፈሩ ያከብረኛል፥ ልቡ ግን ከእኔ በጣም የራቀ ነው፤

verses.text_english: But in vain they do worship me, teaching doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውም ሥርዓት የሆነ ትምህርት እያስተማሩ በከንቱ ያመልኩኛል ብሎ በእውነት ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ጠርቶ። ስሙ አስተውሉም፤

verses.text_english: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ወደ አፍ የሚገባ አይደለም፥ ከአፍ የሚወጣው ግን ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ቀርበው። ፈሪሳውያን ይህን ቃል ሰምተው እንደ ተሰናከሉ አወቅህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። የሰማዩ አባቴ ያልተከለው ተክል ሁሉ ይነቀላል።

verses.text_english: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
verses.text_amharic: ተዉአቸው፤ ዕውሮችን የሚመሩ ዕውሮች ናቸው፤ ዕውርም ዕውርን ቢመራው ሁለቱም ወደ ጉድጓድ ይወድቃሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ምሳሌውን ተርጕምልን አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ ደግሞ እስካሁን የማታስተውሉ ናችሁን?

verses.text_english: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አፍ የሚገባ ሁሉ ወደ ሆድ አልፎ ወደ እዳሪ እንዲጣል አትመለከቱምን?

verses.text_english: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.text_amharic: ከአፍ የሚወጣ ግን ከልብ ይወጣል፥ ሰውንም የሚያረክሰው ያ ነው።

verses.text_english: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
verses.text_amharic: ከልብ ክፉ አሳብ፥ መግደል፥ ምንዝርነት፥ ዝሙት፥ መስረቅ፥ በውሸት መመስከር፥ ስድብ ይወጣልና።

verses.text_english: These are which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ይህ ነው እንጂ፥ ባልታጠበ እጅ መብላትስ ሰውን አያረክሰውም።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ ወጥቶ ወደ ጢሮስና ወደ ሲዶና አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከነናዊት ሴት ከዚያ አገር ወጥታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረኝ፤ ልጄን ጋኔን ክፉኛ ይዞአታል ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን አንዳች አልመለሰላትም። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። በኋላችን ትጮኻለችና አሰናብታት እያሉ ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ከእስራኤል ቤት ለጠፉት በጎች በቀር አልተላክሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ግን መጥታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እርዳኝ እያለች ሰገደችለት።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast to dogs.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። የልጆችን እንጀራ ይዞ ለቡችሎች መጣል አይገባም አለ።

verses.text_english: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፤ ቡችሎችም እኮ ከጌቶቻቸው ማዕድ የወደቀውን ፍርፋሪ ይበላሉ አለች።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መልሶ። አንቺ ሴት፥ እምነትሽ ታላቅ ነው፤ እንደወደድሽ ይሁንልሽ አላት። ልጅዋም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ዳነች።

verses.text_english: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ አልፎ ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር አጠገብ መጣ፥ ወደ ተራራም ወጥቶ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕዝብም አንካሶችን፥ ዕውሮችንም፥ ዲዳዎችንም፥ ጉንድሾችንም፥ ሌሎችንም ብዙ ይዘው ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥ በኢየሱስም እግር አጠገብ ጣሉአቸው፤ ፈወሳቸውም፤

verses.text_english: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ሕዝቡ ዲዳዎች ሲናገሩ፥ ጉንድሾችም ሲድኑ፥ አንካሶችም ሲሄዱ፥ ዕውሮችም ሲያዩ አይተው ተደነቁ፤ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ አከበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus called his disciples , and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠርቶ። ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ጋር እስካሁን ሦስት ቀን ውለዋልና የሚበሉት ስለ ሌላቸው አዝንላቸዋለሁ፤ በመንገድም እንዳይዝሉ ጦማቸውን ላሰናብታቸው አልወድም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ይህን ያህል ሕዝብ የሚያጠግብ ይህን ያህል እንጀራ በምድረ በዳ ከወዴት እናገኛለን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። ሰባት፥ ጥቂትም ትንሽ ዓሣ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በምድር ላይ እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ፤

verses.text_english: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake , and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱንም እንጀራ ዓሣውንም ይዞ አመሰገነ ቈርሶም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለሕዝቡ።

verses.text_english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken that was left seven baskets full.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በሉና ጠገቡ፥ የተረፈውንም ቁርስራሽ ሰባት ቅርጫት ሙሉ አነሡ።

verses.text_english: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.text_amharic: የበሉትም ከሴቶችና ከልጆች በቀር አራት ሺህ ወንዶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ካሰናበተ በኋላ ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ መጌዶል አገር መጣ።

verses.text_english: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያንም ቀርበው ሲፈትኑት ከሰማይ ምልክት እንዲያሳያቸው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, fair weather: for the sky is red.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በመሸ ጊዜ። ሰማዩ ቀልቶአልና ብራ ይሆናል ትላላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And in the morning, foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not the signs of the times?
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳም። ሰማዩ ደምኖ ቀልቶአልና ዛሬ ይዘንባል ትላላችሁ። የሰማዩን ፊትማ መለየት ታውቃላችሁ፥ የዘመኑንስ ምልክት መለየት አትችሉምን?

verses.text_english: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም። ትቶአቸውም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ማዶ በመጡ ጊዜ እንጀራ መያዝን ረሱ።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን እርሾ ተጠንቀቁና ተጠበቁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, because we have taken no bread.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እንጀራ ባንይዝ ነው ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ እምነት የጐደላችሁ፥ እንጀራ ስለ ሌላችሁ ስለ ምን እርስ በርሳችሁ ትነጋገራላችሁ? ገና አታስተውሉምን?

verses.text_english: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.text_amharic: ለአምስቱ ሺህ አምስቱ እንጀራ፥ ስንት መሶብም እንዳነሣችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ለአራቱ ሺህ ሰባቱ እንጀራ፥ ስንት ቅርጫትም እንዳነሣችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን እርሾ እንድትጠበቁ ብዬ ስለ እንጀራ እንዳልተናገርኋችሁ እንዴት አታስተውሉምን?

verses.text_english: Then understood they how that he bade not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን ትምህርት እንጂ ከእንጀራ እርሾ እንዲጠበቁ እንዳላላቸው ያን ጊዜ አስተዋሉ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ ፊልጶስ ቂሣርያ አገር በደረሰ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። ሰዎች የሰውን ልጅ ማን እንደ ሆነ ይሉታል? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: And they said, Some John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አንዳንዱ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤርምያስ ወይም ከነቢያት አንዱ ነው ይላሉ አሉት።

verses.text_english: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እናንተስ እኔን ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። አንተ ክርስቶስ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባቴ እንጂ ሥጋና ደም ይህን አልገለጠልህምና ብፁዕ ነህ።

verses.text_english: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እልሃለሁ፥ አንተ ጴጥሮስ ነህ፥ በዚችም ዓለት ላይ ቤተ ክርስቲያኔን እሠራለሁ፥ የገሃነም ደጆችም አይችሉአትም።

verses.text_english: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: የመንግሥተ ሰማያትንም መክፈቻዎች እሰጥሃለሁ፤ በምድር የምታስረው ሁሉ በሰማያት የታሰረ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም የምትፈታው ሁሉ በሰማያት የተፈታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜም እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያን ቀን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄድ ዘንድ ከሽማግሎችና ከካህናት አለቆች ከጻፎችም ብዙ መከራ ይቀበልና ይገደል ዘንድ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣ ዘንድ እንዲገባው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይገልጥላቸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ወደ እርሱ ወስዶ። አይሁንብህ ጌታ ሆይ፤ ይህ ከቶ አይደርስብህም ብሎ ሊገሥጸው ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን። ወደ ኋላዬ ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን፤ የሰውን እንጂ የእግዚአብሔርን አታስብምና ዕንቅፋት ሆነህብኛል አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ አለ። እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.text_english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፤ ስለ እኔ ግን ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ያገኛታል።

verses.text_english: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል? ወይስ ሰው ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?

verses.text_english: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ከመላእክቱ ጋር በአባቱ ክብር ይመጣ ዘንድ አለውና፤ ያን ጊዜም ለሁሉ እንደ ሥራው ያስረክበዋል።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰው ልጅ በመንግሥቱ ሲመጣ እስኪያዩ ድረስ እዚህ ከሚቆሙት ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንድ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.text_amharic: ከስድስት ቀንም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ይዞ ወደ ረጅም ተራራ ብቻቸውን አወጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.text_amharic: በፊታቸውም ተለወጠ፥ ፊቱም እንደ ፀሐይ በራ፥ ልብሱም እንደ ብርሃን ነጭ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሙሴና ኤልያስ ከእርሱ ጋር ሲነጋገሩ ታዩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነው፤ ብትወድስ፥ በዚህ ሦስት ዳስ አንዱን ለአንተ አንዱንም ለሙሴ አንዱንም ለኤልያስ እንሥራ አለ።

verses.text_english: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ ብሩህ ደመና ጋረዳቸው፥ እነሆም፥ ከደመናው። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፤ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And when the disciples heard , they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው በፊታቸው ወደቁ እጅግም ፈርተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ቀርቦ ዳሰሳቸውና። ተነሡ አትፍሩም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይናቸውንም አቅንተው ሲያዩ ከኢየሱስ ብቻ በቀር ማንንም አላዩም።

verses.text_english: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ከተራራውም በወረዱ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። የሰው ልጅ ከሙታን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ያያችሁትን ለማንም አትንገሩ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። እንግዲህ ጻፎች። ኤልያስ አስቀድሞ ሊመጣ ይገባዋል ስለ ምን ይላሉ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ኤልያስማ አስቀድሞ ይመጣል ሁሉንም ያቀናል፤

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ኤልያስ ከዚህ በፊት መጣ፤ የወደዱትንም ሁሉ አደረጉበት እንጂ አላወቁትም፤ እንዲሁም ደግሞ የሰው ልጅ ከእነርሱ መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድ አለው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለ መጥምቁ ስለ ዮሐንስ እንደ ነገራቸው አስተዋሉ።

verses.text_english: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሕዝቡም ሲደርሱ አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበና ተንበርክኮ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ልጄን ማርልኝ፥ በጨረቃ እየተነሣበት ክፉኛ ይሣቀያልና፤

verses.text_english: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜ በእሳት ብዙ ጊዜም በውኃ ይወድቃልና።

verses.text_english: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርትህም አመጣሁት ሊፈውሱትም አቃታቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። የማታምን ጠማማ ትውልድ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ወደዚህ ወደ እኔ አምጡት አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ገሠጸው ጋኔኑም ከእርሱ ወጣ፥ ብላቴናውም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ተፈወሰ።

verses.text_english: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብቻቸውን ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረቡና። እኛ ልናወጣው ያልቻልን ስለ ምን ነው? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ስለ እምነታችሁ ማነስ ነው፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት የሚያህል እምነት ቢኖራችሁ፥ ይህን ተራራ። ከዚህ ወደዚያ እለፍ ብትሉት ያልፋል፤ የሚሳናችሁም ነገር የለም።

verses.text_english: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ዓይነት ግን ከጸሎትና ከጦም በቀር አይወጣም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
verses.text_amharic: በገሊላም ሲመላለሱ ኢየሱስ። የሰው ልጅ በሰዎች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጥ ዘንድ አለው፥ ይገድሉትማል፥

verses.text_english: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው። እጅግም አዘኑ።

verses.text_english: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም በመጡ ጊዜ ግብር የሚቀበሉ ሰዎች ወደ ጴጥሮስ ቀረቡና። መምህራችሁ ሁለቱን ዲናር*ፍ1* አይገብርምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
verses.text_amharic: አዎን ይገብራል አለ። ወደ ቤትም በገባ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ አስቀድሞ። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ምን ይመስልሃል? የምድር ነገሥታት ቀረጥና ግብር ከማን ይቀበላሉ? ከልጆቻቸውን ወይስ ከእንግዶች? አለው።

verses.text_english: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። ከእንግዶች ባለው ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። እንኪያስ ልጆቻቸው ነጻ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንዳናሰናክላቸው፥ ወደ ባሕር ሂድና መቃጥን ጣል፥ መጀመሪያም የሚወጣውን ዓሣ ውሰድና አፉን ስትከፍት እስታቴር*ፍ2* ታገኛለህ፤ ያን ወስደህ ስለ እኔና ስለ አንተ ስጣቸው አለው።  ፍ1 አንድ ዲናር አምሳ የኢት@ ብር ሳንቲም ያህል ነው።  ፍ2 እስታቴር ሁለት ብር ያህል ነው።

verses.text_english: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች ሰዓት ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀርበው። በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ ማን ይሆን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃንም ጠርቶ በመካከላቸው አቆመ

verses.text_english: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልተመለሳችሁ እንደ ሕፃናትም ካልሆናችሁ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም።

verses.text_english: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደዚህ ሕፃን ራሱን የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ፥ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚበልጥ እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም ያለውን አንድ ሕፃን በስሜ የሚቀበል ሁሉ እኔን ይቀበላል፤

verses.text_english: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔም ከሚያምኑ ከነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን የሚያሰናክል ሁሉ፥ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ጥልቅ ባሕር መስጠም ይሻለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
verses.text_amharic: ወዮ ለዓለም ስለ ማሰናከያ፤ ማሰናከያ ሳይመጣ አይቀርምና፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ጠንቅ ማሰናከያ ለሚመጣበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።

verses.text_english: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
verses.text_amharic: እጅህ ወይም እግርህ ብታሰናክልህ፥ ቈርጠህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሁለት እጅ ወይም ሁለት እግር ኖሮህ ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ከምትጣል ይልቅ አንካሳ ወይም ጉንድሽ ሆነህ ወደ ህይወት መግባት ይሻልሀል።

verses.text_english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይንህ ብታሰናክልህ አውጥተህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሁለት ዓይን ኖሮህ ወደ ገሃነመ እሳት ከምትጣል ይልቅ አንዲት ዓይን ኖራህ ወደ ሕይወት መግባት ይሻልሃል።

verses.text_english: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ከነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን እንዳትንቁ ተጠንቀቁ፤ መላእክቶቻቸው በሰማያት ዘወትር በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፊት ያያሉ እላችኋለሁና።

verses.text_english: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ለማዳን መጥቶአልና።

verses.text_english: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
verses.text_amharic: ምን ይመስላችኋል? ለአንድ ሰው መቶ በጎች ቢኖሩት ከእነርሱም አንዱ ቢባዝን፥ ዘጠና ዘጠኙን በተራራ ትቶ ሄዶም የባዘነውን አይፈልግምን?

verses.text_english: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
verses.text_amharic: ቢያገኘውም፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልባዘኑቱ ከዘጠና ዘጠኙ ይልቅ በእርሱ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.text_english: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚሁ ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱ እንዲጠፋ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ፈቃድ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምህም ቢበድልህ፥ ሄደህ አንተና እርሱ ብቻችሁን ሆናችሁ ውቀሰው። ቢሰማህ፥ ወንድምህን ገንዘብ አደረግኸው፤

verses.text_english: But if he will not hear take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
verses.text_amharic: ባይሰማህ ግን፥ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክር አፍ ነገር ሁሉ እንዲጸና፥ ዳግመኛ አንድ ወይም ሁለት ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤

verses.text_english: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱንም ባይሰማ፥ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ንገራት፤ ደግሞም ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ባይሰማት፥ እንደ አረመኔና እንደ ቀራጭ ይሁንልህ።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በምድር የምታስሩት ሁሉ በሰማይ የታሰረ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም የምትፈቱት ሁሉ በሰማይ የተፈታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ ሁለቱ በምድር በማናቸውም በሚለምኑት ነገር ሁሉ ቢስማሙ በሰማያት ካለው ከአባቴ ዘንድ ይደረግላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ወይም ሦስት በስሜ በሚሰበሰቡበት በዚያ በመካከላቸው እሆናለሁና።

verses.text_english: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወንድሜ ቢበድለኝ ስንት ጊዜ ልተውለት? እስከ ሰባት ጊዜን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አለው። እስከ ሰባ ጊዜ ሰባት እንጂ እስከ ሰባት ጊዜ አልልህም።

verses.text_english: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ባሮቹን ሊቈጣጠር የወደደን ንጉሥ ትመስላለች።

verses.text_english: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
verses.text_amharic: መቈጣጠርም በጀመረ ጊዜ፥ እልፍ መክሊት ዕዳ ያለበትን አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ።

verses.text_english: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
verses.text_amharic: የሚከፍለውም ቢያጣ፥ እርሱና ሚስቱ ልጆቹም ያለውም ሁሉ እንዲሸጥና ዕዳው እንዲከፈል ጌታው አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ባሪያው ወድቆ ሰገደለትና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ታገሠኝ፥ ሁሉንም እከፍልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያም ባሪያ ጌታ አዘነለትና ለቀቀው፥ ዕዳውንም ተወለት።

verses.text_english: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ያ ባሪያ ወጥቶ ከባልንጀሮቹ ከባሮቹ መቶ ዲናር ዕዳ ያለበትን አንዱን አገኘና። ዕዳህን ክፈለኝ ብሎ ያዘና አነቀው።

verses.text_english: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ባልንጀራው ባሪያ ወድቆ። ታገሠኝ፥ ሁሉንም እከፍልሃለሁ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አልወደደም፥ ግን ሄዶ ዕዳውን እስኪከፍል ድረስ በወኅኒ አኖረው።

verses.text_english: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀሮቹ የሆኑ ባሮችም ያደረገውን አይተው እጅግ አዘኑ፥ መጥተውም የሆነውን ሁሉ ለጌታቸው ገለጡ።

verses.text_english: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወዲያ ጌታው ጠርቶ። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ ስለ ለመንኸኝ ያን ዕዳ ሁሉ ተውሁልህ፤

verses.text_english: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንደ ማርሁህ ባልንጀራህ የሆነውን ያን ባሪያ ልትምረው ለአንተስ አይገባህምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም ተቈጣና ዕዳውን ሁሉ እስኪከፍለው ድረስ ለሚሣቅዩት አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ ወንድሙን ከልቡ ይቅር ካላለ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ የሰማዩ አባቴ ያደርግባችኋል።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን ነገር ከፈጸመ በኋላ፥ ከገሊላ ሄዶ ወደ ይሁዳ አውራጃ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕዝብም ተከተሉት፥ በዚያም ፈወሳቸው።

verses.text_english: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና ሲፈትኑት። ሰው በሆነው ምክንያት ሁሉ ሚስቱን ሊፈታ ተፈቅዶለታልን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made at the beginning made them male and female,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ፈጣሪ በመጀመሪያ ወንድና ሴት አደረጋቸው፥

verses.text_english: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
verses.text_amharic: አለም። ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል፥ ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል፥ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ የሚለውን ቃል አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አንድ ሥጋ ናቸው እንጂ ወደ ፊት ሁለት አይደሉም። እግዚአብሔር ያጣመረውን እንግዲህ ሰው አይለየው።

verses.text_english: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እንኪያስ ሙሴ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ሰጥተው እንዲፈቱአት ስለ ምን አዘዘ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሙሴስ ስለ ልባችሁ ጥንካሬ ሚስቶቻችሁን ትፈቱ ዘንድ ፈቀደላችሁ፤ ከጥንት ግን እንዲህ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ያለ ዝሙት ምክንያት ሚስቱን ፈትቶ ሌላዪቱን የሚያገባ ሁሉ ያመነዝራል፥ የተፈታችውንም የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። የባልና የሚስት ሥርዓት እንዲህ ከሆነ መጋባት አይጠቅምም አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he said unto them, All cannot receive this saying, save to whom it is given.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ይህ ነገር ለተሰጣቸው ነው እንጂ ለሁሉ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive , let him receive .
verses.text_amharic: በእናት ማኅፀን ጃንደረቦች ሆነው የተወለዱ አሉ፥ ሰውም የሰለባቸው ጃንደረቦች አሉ፥ ስለ መንግሥተ ሰማያትም ራሳቸውን የሰለቡ ጃንደረቦች አሉ። ሊቀበለው የሚችል ይቀበለው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ እጁን እንዲጭንባቸውና እንዲጸልይ ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.text_english: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ። ሕፃናትን ተዉአቸው፥ ወደ እኔም ይመጡ ዘንድ አትከልክሉአቸው፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት እንደነዚህ ላሉ ናትና አለ፤

verses.text_english: And he laid hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ጫነባቸውና ከዚያ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሰው ቀርቦ። መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንዳገኝ ምን መልካም ነገር ላድርግ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none good but one, , God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስለ መልካም ነገር ለምን ትጠይቀኛለህ? መልካም የሆነ አንድ ነው፤ ወደ ሕይወት መግባት ብትወድ ግን ትእዛዛትን ጠብቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የትኞችን? አለው። ኢየሱስም። አትግደል፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥

verses.text_english: Honour thy father and mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.text_amharic: አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፥ ባልንጀራህንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ አለው።

verses.text_english: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.text_amharic: ጐበዙም። ይህንማ ሁሉ ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ፥ ደግሞስ የሚጐድለኝ ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ፍጹም ልትሆን ብትወድ፥ ሂድና ያለህን ሸጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ መዝገብም በሰማያት ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.text_amharic: ጐበዙም ይህን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ብዙ ንብረት ነበረውና እያዘነ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለባለጠጋ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መግባት ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ዳግመኛም እላችኋለሁ፥ ባለጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ቢገባ ይቀላል አለ።

verses.text_english: When his disciples heard , they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው እጅግ ተገረሙና። እንኪያስ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: But Jesus beheld , and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እነርሱን ተመልክቶ። ይህ በሰው ዘንድ አይቻልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ግን ሁሉ ይቻላል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መልሶ። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ፤ እንኪያስ ምን እናገኝ ይሆን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተስ የተከተላችሁኝ፥ በዳግመኛ ልደት የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ ዙፋን በሚቀመጥበት ጊዜ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በአሥራ ሁለት ዙፋን ትቀመጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ስሜም ቤቶችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ ሁሉ መቶ እጥፍ ይቀበላል የዘላለምንም ሕይወት ይወርሳል።

verses.text_english: But many first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ብዙዎቹ ፊተኞች ኋለኞች፥ ኋለኞችም ፊተኞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለወይኑ አትክልት ሠራተኞችን ሊቀጥር ማልዶ የወጣ ባለቤት ሰውን ትመስላለችና።

verses.text_english: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: ሠራተኞችንም በቀን አንድ ዲናር ተስማምቶ ወደ ወይኑ አትክልት ሰደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.text_amharic: በሦስት ሰዓትም ወጥቶ ሥራ የፈቱ ሌሎችን በአደባባይ ቆመው አየ፥

verses.text_english: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያንም። እናንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወይኔ አትክልት ሂዱ የሚገባውንም እሰጣችኋለሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በስድስትና በዘጠኝ ሰዓት ወጥቶ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.text_amharic: በአሥራ አንደኛውም ሰዓት ወጥቶ ሌሎችን ቆመው አገኘና። ሥራ ፈትታችሁ ቀኑን ሁሉ በዚህ ስለ ምን ትቆማላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, shall ye receive.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቀጥረን ስለ አጣን ነው አሉት። እርሱም። እናንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወይኔ አትክልት ሂዱ የሚገባውንም ትቀበላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ አዛዡን። ሠራተኞችን ጥራና ከኋለኞች ጀምረህ እስከ ፊተኞች ድረስ ደመወዝ ስጣቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And when they came that about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.text_amharic: በአሥራ አንደኛው ሰዓትም የገቡ መጥተው እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ዲናር ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኞችም በመጡ ጊዜ አብዝተው የሚቀበሉ መስሎአቸው ነበር፤ እነርሱም ደግሞ እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ዲናር ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: And when they had received , they murmured against the goodman of the house,
Saying, These last have wrought one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ ከእነርሱ ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ አልበደልሁህም በአንድ ዲናር አልተስማማኸኝምን?

verses.text_english: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.text_amharic: ድርሻህን ውሰድና ሂድ፤ እኔ ለዚህ ለኋለኛው እንደ አንተ ልሰጠው እወዳለሁ፤ በገንዘቤ የወደድሁትን አደርግ ዘንድ መብት የለኝምን?

verses.text_english: Take thine , and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ እኔ መልካም ስለ ሆንሁ ዓይንህ ምቀኛ ናትን?

verses.text_english: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ኋለኞች ፊተኞች፥ ፊተኞችም ኋለኞች ይሆናሉ፤ የተጠሩ ብዙዎች፥ የተመረጡ ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሊወጣ ሳለ፥ በመንገድ አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርት ብቻቸውን ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ የሰው ልጅም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለጻፎች ይሰጣል፤ የሞት ፍርድም ይፈርዱበታል፥

verses.text_english: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.text_amharic: ሊዘባበቱበትም ሊገርፉትም ሊሰቅሉትም ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify : and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች እናት ከልጆችዋ ጋር እየሰገደችና አንድ ነገር እየለመነች ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች።

verses.text_english: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping , and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። እነዚህ ሁለቱ ልጆቼ አንዱ በቀኝህ አንዱም በግራህ በመንግሥትህ እንዲቀመጡ እዘዝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። የምትለምኑትን አታውቁም። እኔ ልጠጣው ያለውን ጽዋ ልትጠጡ እኔም የምጠመቀውን ጥምቀት ልትጠመቁ ትችላላችሁን? አለ። እንችላለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጽዋዬንስ ትጠጣላችሁ፤ በቀኝና በግራ መቀመጥ ግን ከአባቴ ዘንድ ለተዘጋጀላቸው ነው እንጂ እኔ የምሰጥ አይደለሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.text_amharic: አሥሩም ሰምተው በሁለቱ ወንድማማች ተቈጡ።

verses.text_english: And when the ten heard , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የአሕዛብ አለቆች እንዲገዙአቸው ታላላቆቹም በላያቸው እንዲሠለጥኑ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But Jesus called them , and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተስ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ማንም ከእናንተ ታላቅ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ አገልጋይ ይሁን፥

verses.text_english: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ማንም ፊተኛ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ ባሪያ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም የሰው ልጅ ሊያገለግል ነፍሱንም ለብዙዎች ቤዛ ሊሰጥ እንጂ እንዲያገለግሉት አልመጣም።

verses.text_english: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢያሪኮም ሲወጡ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሁለት ዕውሮች በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጠው፥ ኢየሱስ እንዲያልፍ በሰሙ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረን ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ዝም እንዲሉ ገሠጹአቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረን እያሉ አብዝተው ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, Son of David.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ጠራቸውና። ምን ላደርግላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ዓይኖቻችን ይከፈቱ ዘንድ አሉት።

verses.text_english: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አዘነላቸውና ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ፥ ወዲያውም አዩና ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ቀርበው ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌ ሲደርሱ፥ ያንጊዜ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ላከ፥

verses.text_english: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose , and bring unto me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ በዚያን ጊዜም የታሰረችን አህያ ውርንጫም ከእርስዋ ጋር ታገኛላችሁ፤ ፈትታችሁ አምጡልኝ።

verses.text_english: And if any say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም አንዳች ቢላችሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልጉታል በሉ፤ ወዲያውም ይሰዳቸዋል።

verses.text_english: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.text_amharic: ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ የዋህ ሆኖ በአህያ ላይና በአህያይቱ ግልገል በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል በሉአት ተብሎ በነቢይ የተነገረው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሄደው ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ፥

verses.text_english: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set thereon.
verses.text_amharic: አህያይቱንና ውርንጫዋንም አመጡለት፥ ልብሳቸውንም በእነርሱ ላይ ጫኑ፥ ተቀመጠባቸውም።

verses.text_english: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed in the way.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝቡም እጅግ ብዙዎች ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ፥ ሌሎችም ከዛፍ ጫፍ ጫፉን እየቈረጡ በመንገድ ላይ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቀድሙትም ሕዝብ የሚከተሉትም። ሆሣዕና ለዳዊት ልጅ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው፤ ሆሣዕና በአርያም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም በገባ ጊዜ መላው ከተማ። ይህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ተናወጠ።

verses.text_english: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም። ይህ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት የመጣ ነቢዩ ኢየሱስ ነው አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ መቅደስ ገባና በመቅደስ የሚሸጡትንና የሚገዙትን ሁሉ አወጣ፥ የገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ገበታዎች የርግብ ሻጮችንም ወንበሮች ገለበጠና።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ትባላለች ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፥ እናንተ ግን የወንበዶች ዋሻ አደረጋችኋት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስም ዕውሮችና አንካሶች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና ፈወሳቸው።

verses.text_english: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ያደረገውን ድንቃ ድንቅ በመቅደስም። ሆሣዕና ለዳዊት ልጅ እያሉ የሚጮኹትን ልጆች ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ተቈጥተው።

verses.text_english: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ የሚሉትን አትሰማምን? አሉት። ኢየሱስም። እሰማለሁ፤ ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡት አፍ ምስጋናን ለራስህ አዘጋጀህ የሚለውን ቃል ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.text_amharic: ትቶአቸውም ከከተማ ወደ ቢታንያ ወጣ በዚያም አደረ።

verses.text_english: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.text_amharic: በማለዳም ወደ ከተማ ሲመለስ ተራበ።

verses.text_english: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድም አጠገብ በለስ አይቶ ወደ እርስዋ መጣ፤ ከቅጠልም ብቻ በቀር ምንም አላገኘባትምና። ለዘላለሙ ፍሬ አይገኝብሽ አላት። በለሲቱም ያንጊዜውን ደረቀች።

verses.text_english: And when the disciples saw , they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን አይተው። በለሲቱ ያንጊዜውን እንዴት ደረቀች? ብለው ተደነቁ።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እምነት ቢኖራችሁ ባትጠራጠሩም፥ በበለሲቱ እንደ ሆነባት ብቻ አታደርጉም፤ ነገር ግን ይህን ተራራ እንኳ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተወርወር ብትሉት ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.text_amharic: አምናችሁም በጸሎት የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ ትቀበላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ ሲያስተምር የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝብ ሽማግሎች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና። በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን ታደርጋለህ? ይህንስ ሥልጣን ማን ሰጠህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፤ እናንተም ያችን ብትነግሩኝ እኔ ደግሞ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን እንዳደርግ እነግራችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.text_amharic: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከወዴት ነበረች? ከሰማይን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። እንኪያስ ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.text_english: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው ግን ብንል፥ ዮሐንስን ሁሉም እንደ ነቢይ ያዩታልና ሕዝቡን እንፈራለን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_amharic: ለኢየሱስም መልሰው። አናውቅም አሉት። እርሱም ደግሞ። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But what think ye? A man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ምን ይመስላችኋል? አንድ ሰው ሁለት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ወደ አንደኛው ቀርቦ። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ ሂድና በወይኔ አትክልት ሥራ አለው።

verses.text_english: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። አልወድም አለ፤ ኋላ ግን ተጸጸተና ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I , sir: and went not.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሁለተኛውም ቀርቦ እንዲሁ አለው እርሱም መልሶ። እሺ ጌታዬ አለ፤ ነገር ግን አልሄደም።

verses.text_english: Whether of them twain did the will of father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለቱ የአባቱን ፈቃድ ያደረገ ማን ነው? ፊተኛው አሉት። ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቀራጮችና ጋለሞቶች ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመግባት ይቀድሙአችኋል።

verses.text_english: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen , repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ በጽድቅ መንገድ መጥቶላችሁ ነበርና፥ አላመናችሁበትም፤ ቀራጮችና ጋለሞቶች ግን አመኑበት፤ እናንተም ይህን አይታችሁ ታምኑበት ዘንድ በኋላ ንስሐ አልገባችሁም።

verses.text_english: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ ምሳሌ ስሙ። የወይን አትክልት የተከለ ባለቤት ሰው ነበረ፤ ቅጥርም ቀጠረለት፥ መጥመቂያም ማሰለት፥ ግንብም ሠራና ለገበሬዎች አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያፈራበትም ጊዜ ሲቀርብ፥ ፍሬውን ሊቀበሉ ባሮቹን ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ።

verses.text_english: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.text_amharic: ገበሬዎቹም ባሮቹን ይዘው አንዱን ደበደቡት አንዱንም ገደሉት ሌላውንም ወገሩት።

verses.text_english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ከፊተኞች የሚበዙ ሌሎች ባሮችን ላከ፥ እንዲሁም አደረጉባቸው።

verses.text_english: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላ ግን። ልጄንስ ያፍሩታል ብሎ ልጁን ላከባቸው።

verses.text_english: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ገበሬዎቹ ግን ልጁን ባዩ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳቸው። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ኑ፥ እንግደለውና ርስቱን እናግኝ ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And they caught him, and cast out of the vineyard, and slew .
verses.text_amharic: ይዘውም ከወይኑ አትክልት አወጡና ገደሉት።

verses.text_english: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ በሚመጣ ጊዜ በእነዚህ ገበሬዎች ምን ያደርግባቸዋል?

verses.text_english: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ክፉዎችን በክፉ ያጠፋቸዋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ፍሬውን በየጊዜው ለሚያስረክቡ ለሌሎች ገበሬዎች ይሰጠዋል አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፤ ይህም ከጌታ ዘንድ ሆነ፥ ለዓይኖቻችንም ድንቅ ነው የሚለውን ከቶ በመጽሐፍ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከእናንተ ትወሰዳለች ፍሬዋንም ለሚያደርግ ሕዝብ ትሰጣለች።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ ድንጋዩ ግን የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ይፈጨዋል።

verses.text_english: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያንም ምሳሌዎቹን ሰምተው ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አስተዋሉ፤

verses.text_english: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ሊይዙትም ሲፈልጉት ሳሉ ሕዝቡ እንደ ነቢይ ስላዩት ፈሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰ ደግሞም በምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለልጁ ሰርግ ያደረገ ንጉሥን ትመስላለች።

verses.text_english: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and fatlings killed, and all things ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.text_amharic: የታደሙትንም ወደ ሰርጉ ይጠሩ ዘንድ ባሮቹን ላከ ሊመጡም አልወደዱም።

verses.text_english: But they made light of , and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ሌሎችን ባሮች ልኮ። የታደሙትን። እነሆ፥ ድግሴን አዘጋጀሁ፥ ኮርማዎቼና የሰቡት ከብቶቼ ታርደዋል፥ ሁሉም ተዘጋጅቶአል፤ ወደ ሰርጉ ኑ በሉአቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated spitefully, and slew .
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ቸል ብለው አንዱ ወደ እርሻው፥ ሌላውም ወደ ንግዱ ሄደ፤

verses.text_english: But when the king heard , he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም ባሮቹን ይዘው አንገላቱአቸው ገደሉአቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም ተቈጣ፥ ጭፍሮቹንም ልኮ እነዚያን ገዳዮች አጠፋ፤ ከተማቸውንም አቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ባሮቹን። ሰርጉስ ተዘጋጅቶአል፥ ነገር ግን የታደሙት የማይገባቸው ሆኑ፤

verses.text_english: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ወደ መንገድ መተላለፊያ ሄዳችሁ ያገኛችሁትን ሁሉ ወደ ሰርጉ ጥሩ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ባሮች ወደ መንገድ ወጥተው ያገኙትን ሁሉ ክፉዎችንም በጎዎችንም ሰበሰቡ፤ የሰርጉንም ቤት ተቀማጮች ሞሉት።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም የተቀመጡትን ለማየት በገባ ጊዜ በዚያ የሰርግ ልብስ ያለበሰ አንድ ሰው አየና። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text_amharic: የሰርግ ልብስ ሳትለብስ እንዴት ወደዚህ ገባህ? አለው እርሱም ዝም አለ።

verses.text_english: For many are called, but few chosen.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ አገልጋዮቹን። እጁንና እግሩን አስራችሁ በውጭ ወዳለው ጨለማ አውጡት፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in talk.
verses.text_amharic: የተጠሩ ብዙዎች፥ የተመረጡ ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any : for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን ሄዱና እንዴት አድርገው በነገር እንዲያጠምዱት ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርታቸውንም ከሄሮድስ ወገን ጋር ላኩበት፥ እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነተኛ እንደ ሆንህ በእውነትም የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ እንድታስተምር እናውቃለን፥ ለማንምም አታደላም፥ የሰውን ፊት አትመለከትምና፤

verses.text_english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, hypocrites?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ምን ይመስልሃል? ንገረን ለቄሣር ግብር መስጠት ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ክፋታቸውን አውቆ። እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ?

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Whose this image and superscription?
verses.text_amharic: የግብሩን ብር አሳዩኝ አለ። እነርሱም ዲናር አመጡለት።

verses.text_english: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ይህች መልክ ጽሕፈቲቱስ የማን ናት? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: When they had heard , they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.text_amharic: የቄሣር ነው አሉት። በዚያን ጊዜ። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሰምተው ተደነቁ፥ ትተውትም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀን። ትንሣኤ ሙታን የለም የሚሉ ሰዱቃውያን ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥

verses.text_english: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ብለው ጠየቁት። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ አንድ ሰው ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሲሞት ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ አለ።

verses.text_english: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ወንድማማች በእኛ ዘንድ ነበሩ፤ ፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ሞተ፥ ዘርም ስለሌለው ሚስቱን ለወንድሙ ተወለት፤

verses.text_english: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ደግሞ ሁለተኛው ሦስተኛውም፥ እስከ ሰባተኛው ድረስ።

verses.text_english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ሞተች።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ አግብተዋታልና በትንሣኤ ቀንስ፥ ከሰባቱ ለማናቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.text_english: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መጻሕፍትንና የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል አታውቁምና ትስታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.text_amharic: በትንሣኤስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መላእክት በሰማይ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አያገቡም አይጋቡምም።

verses.text_english: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
And when the multitude heard , they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ይህን ሰምተው በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.text_english: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም ሰዱቃውያንን ዝም እንዳሰኛቸው በሰሙ ጊዜ አብረው ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Then one of them, a lawyer, asked , tempting him, and saying,
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንድ ሕግ አዋቂ ሊፈትነው።

verses.text_english: Master, which the great commandment in the law?
verses.text_amharic: መምህር ሆይ፥ ከሕግ ማናቸይቱ ትእዛዝ ታላቅ ናት? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለው። ጌታ አምላክህን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹም ነፍስህም በፍጹም አሳብህም ውደድ።

verses.text_english: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቂቱና ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ይህች ናት።

verses.text_english: And the second like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛይቱም ይህችን ትመስላለች፥ እርስዋም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ነፍስህ ውደድ የምትለው ናት።

verses.text_english: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ በሁለቱ ትእዛዛት ሕጉም ሁሉ ነቢያትም ተሰቅለዋል።

verses.text_english: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, of David.
He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.text_amharic: አንድም ቃል ስንኳ ይመልስለት ዘንድ የተቻለው የለም፥ ከዚያ ቀንም ጀምሮ ወደ ፊት ማንም ሊጠይቀው አልደፈረም።

verses.text_english: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡና ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራቸው።

verses.text_english: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
verses.text_amharic: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን በሙሴ ወንበር ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.text_english: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ያዘዙአችሁን ሁሉ አድርጉ ጠብቁትም፥ ነገር ግን እየተናገሩ አያደርጉትምና እንደ ሥራቸው አታድርጉ።

verses.text_english: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay on men's shoulders; but they will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.text_amharic: ከባድና አስቸጋሪ ሸክም ተብትበው በሰው ትከሻ ይጭናሉ፥ እነርሱ ግን በጣታቸው ስንኳ ሊነኩት አይወዱም።

verses.text_english: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.text_amharic: ለሰውም እንዲታዩ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ያደርጋሉ፤ ስለዚህ አሽንክታባቸውን ያሰፋሉ ዘርፉንም ያስረዝማሉ፥

verses.text_english: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.text_amharic: በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥

verses.text_english: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.text_amharic: በገበያም ሰላምታና። መምህር ሆይ መምህር ሆይ ተብለው እንዲጠሩ ይወዳሉ።

verses.text_english: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን። መምህር ተብላችሁ አትጠሩ፤ መምህራችሁ አንድ ስለ ሆነ እናንተም ሁላችሁ ወንድማማች ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: And call no your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችሁ አንዱ እርሱም የሰማዩ ነውና በምድር ላይ ማንንም። አባት ብላችሁ አትጥሩ።

verses.text_english: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቃችሁ አንድ እርሱም ክርስቶስ ነውና። ሊቃውንት ተብላችሁ አትጠሩ።

verses.text_english: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም የሚበልጠው አገልጋያችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳል፥ ራሱንም የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያትን በሰው ፊት ስለምትዘጉ፥ ወዮላችሁ እናንተ አትገቡም የሚገቡትንም እንዳይገቡ ትከለክላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በጸሎት ርዝመት እያመካኛችሁ የመበለቶችን ቤት ስለምትበሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ትቀበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ አንድ ሰው ልታሳምኑ በባሕርና በደረቅ ስለምትዞሩ፥ በሆነም ጊዜ ከእናንተ ይልቅ ሁለት እጥፍ የባሰ የገሃነም ልጅ ስለምታደርጉት፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። ማንም በቤተ መቅደስ የሚምል ምንም የለበትም፤ ማንም በቤተ መቅደስ ወርቅ የሚምል ግን በመሐላው ይያዛል የምትሉ፥ ዕውሮች መሪዎች፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደንቆሮዎችና ዕውሮች፥ ማናቸው ይበልጣል? ወርቁ ነውን? ወይስ ወርቁን የቀደሰው ቤተ መቅደስ?

verses.text_english: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.text_amharic: ደግማችሁም። ማንም በመሠዊያው የሚምል ምንም የለበትም፤ ማንም በላዩ ባለው መባ የሚምል ግን በመሐላው ይያዛል ትላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: fools and blind: for whether greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደንቆሮዎችና ዕውሮች፥ ማናቸው ይበልጣል? መባው ነውን? ወይስ መባውን የሚቀድሰው መሠዊያው?

verses.text_english: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በመሠዊያው የሚምለው በእርሱና በእርሱ ላይ ባለው ሁሉ ይምላል፤

verses.text_english: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.text_amharic: በቤተ መቅደስም የሚምለው በእርሱና በእርሱ በሚኖረው ይምላል፤

verses.text_english: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይም የሚምለው በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋንና በእርሱ ላይ በተቀመጠው ይምላል።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ከአዝሙድና ከእንስላል ከከሙንም አሥራት ስለምታወጡ፥ ፍርድንና ምሕረትን ታማኝነትንም፥ በሕግ ያለውን ዋና ነገር ስለምትተዉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ሌላውን ሳትተዉ ይህን ልታደርጉ ይገባችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ዕውሮች መሪዎች፥ ትንኝን የምታጠሩ ግመልንም የምትውጡ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በውስጡ ቅሚያና ስስት ሞልቶ ሳለ የጽዋውንና የወጭቱን ውጭ ስለምታጠሩ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: blind Pharisee, cleanse first that within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ዕውር ፈሪሳዊ፥ ውጭው ደግሞ ጥሩ እንዲሆን አስቀድመህ የጽዋውንና የወጭቱን ውስጡን አጥራ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በውጭ አምረው የሚታዩ በውስጡ ግን የሙታን አጥንት ርኩሰትም ሁሉ የተሞሉ በኖራ የተለሰኑ መቃብሮችን ስለምትመስሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ በውጭ ለሰው እንደ ጻድቃን ትታያላችሁ፥ በውስጣችሁ ግን ግብዝነትና ዓመፀኝነት ሞልቶባችኋል።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ የነቢያትን መቃብር ስለምትሠሩ የጻድቃንንም መቃብር ስለምታስጌጡና።

verses.text_english: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: በአባቶቻችን ዘመን ኖረን በሆነስ በነቢያት ደም ባልተባበርናቸውም ነበር ስለምትሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ የነቢያት ገዳዮች ልጆች እንደሆናችሁ በራሳችሁ ላይ ትመሰክራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደግሞ የአባቶቻችሁን መስፈሪያ ሙሉ።

verses.text_english: serpents, generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ እባቦች፥ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከገሃነም ፍርድ እንዴት ታመልጣላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and of them ye shall kill and crucify; and of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ነቢያትንና ጥበበኞችን ጻፎችንም ወደ እናንተ እልካለሁ፤ ከእነርሱም ትገድላላችሁ ትሰቅሉማላችሁ፥ ከእነርሱም በምኵራባችሁ ትገርፋላችሁ ከከተማም ወደ ከተማ ታሳድዳላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ከጻድቁ ከአቤል ደም ጀምሮ በቤተ መቅደስና በመሠዊያው መካከል እስከ ገደላችሁት እስከ በራክዩ ልጅ እስከ ዘካርያስ ደም ድረስ በምድር ላይ የፈሰሰው የጻድቅ ደም ሁሉ ይደርስባችሁ ዘንድ።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ በዚህ ትውልድ ላይ ይደርሳል።

verses.text_english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under wings, and ye would not!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ነቢያትን የምትገድል ወደ እርስዋ የተላኩትንም የምትወግር፥ ዶሮ ጫጩቶችዋን ከክንፎችዋ በታች እንደምትሰበስብ ልጆችሽን እሰበስብ ዘንድ ስንት ጊዜ ወደድሁ! አልወደዳችሁምም።

verses.text_english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ቤታችሁ የተፈታ ሆኖ ይቀርላችኋል።

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና፥ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው እስክትሉ ድረስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታዩኝም።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከመቅደስ ወጥቶ ሄደ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም የመቅደሱን ግንቦች ሊያሳዩት ቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። ይህን ሁሉ ታያላችሁን? እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ አይቀርም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በደብረ ዘይት ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ለብቻቸው ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ንገረን፥ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? የመምጣትህና የዓለም መጨረሻ ምልክቱስ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ማንም እንዳያስታችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙዎች። እኔ ክርስቶስ ነኝ እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፤ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ።

verses.text_english: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.text_amharic: ጦርንም የጦርንም ወሬ ትሰሙ ዘንድ አላችሁ፤ ይህ ሊሆን ግድ ነውና ተጠበቁ፥ አትደንግጡ፤ ዳሩ ግን መጨረሻው ገና ነው።

verses.text_english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣልና፥ ራብም ቸነፈርም የምድርም መናወጥ በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: All these the beginning of sorrows.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሁሉ የምጥ ጣር መጀመሪያ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ለመከራ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል ይገድሉአችሁማል፥ ስለ ስሜም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙዎች ይሰናከላሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም አሳልፈው ይሰጣጣሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም ይጣላሉ፤

verses.text_english: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሐሰተኞች ነቢያትም ይነሣሉ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ፤

verses.text_english: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓመፃም ብዛት የተነሣ የብዙ ሰዎች ፍቅር ትቀዘቅዛለች።

verses.text_english: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.text_english: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.text_amharic: ለአሕዛብም ሁሉ ምስክር እንዲሆን ይህ የመንግሥት ወንጌል በዓለም ሁሉ ይሰበካል፥ በዚያን ጊዜም መጨረሻው ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በነቢዩ በዳንኤል የተባለውን የጥፋትን ርኩሰት በተቀደሰችው ስፍራ ቆሞ ስታዩ፥ አንባቢው ያስተውል፥

verses.text_english: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉት ወደ ተራራዎች ይሽሹ፥

verses.text_english: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.text_amharic: በሰገነትም ያለ በቤቱ ያለውን ሊወስድ አይውረድ፥

verses.text_english: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሻም ያለ ልብሱን ይወስድ ዘንድ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.text_english: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ወራት ለርጉዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው።

verses.text_english: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሽሽታችሁ በክረምት ወይም በሰንበት እንዳይሆን ጸልዩ፤

verses.text_english: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ከዓለም መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያልሆነ እንግዲህም ከቶ የማይሆን ታላቅ መከራ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያ ቀኖችስ ባያጥሩ ሥጋ የለበሰ ሁሉ ባልዳነም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እነዚያ ቀኖች ስለ ተመረጡት ሰዎች ያጥራሉ።

verses.text_english: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here Christ, or there; believe not.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ማንም። እነሆ፥ ክርስቶስ ከዚህ አለ ወይም። ከዚያ አለ ቢላችሁ አትመኑ፤

verses.text_english: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰተኞች ክርስቶሶችና ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ይነሣሉና፥ ቢቻላቸውስ የተመረጡትን እንኳ እስኪያስቱ ድረስ ታላላቅ ምልክትና ድንቅ ያሳያሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ አስቀድሜ ነገርኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, in the secret chambers; believe not.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። እነሆ፥ በበረሀ ነው ቢሉአችሁ፥ አትውጡ፤ እነሆ፥ በእልፍኝ ነው ቢሉአችሁ፥ አትመኑ፤

verses.text_english: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.text_amharic: መብረቅ ከምሥራቅ ወጥቶ እስከ ምዕራብ እንደሚታይ፥ የሰው ልጅ መምጣት እንዲሁ ይሆናልና፤

verses.text_english: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: በድን ወዳለበት በዚያ አሞራዎች ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.text_english: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያች ወራትም መከራ በኋላ ወዲያው ፀሐይ ይጨልማል፥ ጨረቃም ብርሃንዋን አትሰጥም፥ ከዋክብትም ከሰማይ ይወድቃሉ፥

verses.text_english: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማያትም ኃይላት ይናወጣሉ። በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ ምልክት በሰማይ ይታያል፥ በዚያን ጊዜም የምድር ወገኖች ሁሉ ዋይ ዋይ ይላሉ፥ የሰው ልጅንም በኃይልና በብዙ ክብር በሰማይ ደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል፤

verses.text_english: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.text_amharic: መላእክቱንም ከታላቅ መለከት ድምፅ ጋር ይልካቸዋል፥ ከሰማያትም ዳርቻ እስከ ዳርቻው ከአራቱ ነፋሳት ለእርሱ የተመረጡትን ይሰበስባሉ።

verses.text_english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer nigh:
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ከበለስ ተማሩ፤ ጫፍዋ ሲለሰልስ ቅጠልዋም ሲያቈጠቍጥ፥ ያን ጊዜ በጋ እንደ ቀረበ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ይህን ሁሉ ስታዩ በደጅ እንደ ቀረበ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።
