verses.text_english: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ፥ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.text_english: But of that day and hour knoweth no , no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚያች ቀንና ስለዚያች ሰዓት ግን ከአባት ብቻ በቀር የሰማይ መላእክትም ቢሆኑ ልጅም ቢሆን የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.text_english: But as the days of Noe , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.text_amharic: የኖኅ ዘመን እንደ ነበረ የሰው ልጅ መምጣት እንዲሁ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች ወራት ከጥፋት ውኃ በፊት፥ ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ እስከገባበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ሲበሉና ሲጠጡ ሲያገቡና ሲጋቡም እንደ ነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.text_amharic: የጥፋት ውኃም መጥቶ ሁሉን እስከ ወሰደ ድረስ እንዳላወቁ፥ የሰው ልጅ መምጣት ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ሁለት ሰዎች በእርሻ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል አንዱም ይቀራል፤

verses.text_english: Two grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ሴቶች በወፍጮ ይፈጫሉ፤ አንዲቱ ትወሰዳለች አንዲቱም ትቀራለች።

verses.text_english: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታችሁ በምን ሰዓት እንዲመጣ አታውቁምና እንግዲህ ንቁ።

verses.text_english: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ግን እወቁ፤ ባለቤት ከሌሊቱ በየትኛው ክፍል ሌባ እንዲመጣ ቢያውቅ ኖሮ፥ በነቃ ቤቱም ሊቈፈር ባልተወም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እናንተ ደግሞ ተዘጋጅታችሁ ኑሩ፥ የሰው ልጅ በማታስቡበት ሰዓት ይመጣልና።

verses.text_english: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.text_amharic: እንኪያስ ምግባቸውን በጊዜው ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ጌታው በቤተ ሰዎች ላይ የሾመው ታማኝና ልባም ባሪያ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Blessed that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታው መጥቶ እንዲህ ሲያደርግ የሚያገኘው ያ ባሪያ ብፁዕ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ባለው ሁሉ ላይ ይሾመዋል።

verses.text_english: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.text_amharic: ያ ክፉ ባሪያ ግን። ጌታዬ እስኪመጣ ይዘገያል ብሎ በልቡ ቢያስብ፥

verses.text_english: And shall begin to smite fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.text_amharic: ባልንጀሮቹን ባሮች ሊመታ ቢጀምር ከሰካሮችም ጋር ቢበላና ቢጠጣ፥

verses.text_english: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for , and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.text_amharic: የዚያ ባሪያ ጌታ ባልጠበቃት ቀን ባላወቃትም ሰዓት ይመጣል፥

verses.text_english: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለትም ይሰነጥቀዋል፥ እድሉንም ከግብዞች ጋር ያደርግበታል፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መብራታቸውን ይዘው ሙሽራውን ሊቀበሉ የወጡ አሥር ቆነጃጅትን ትመስላለች።

verses.text_english: And five of them were wise, and five foolish.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አምስቱ ሰነፎች አምስቱም ልባሞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: They that foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፎቹ መብራታቸውን ይዘው ከእነርሱ ጋር ዘይት አልያዙምና፤

verses.text_english: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.text_amharic: ልባሞቹ ግን ከመብራታቸው ጋር በማሰሮአቸው ዘይት ያዙ።

verses.text_english: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሽራውም በዘገየ ጊዜ ሁሉ እንቅልፍ እንቅልፍ አላቸውና ተኙ።

verses.text_english: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.text_amharic: እኩል ሌሊትም ሲሆን። እነሆ፥ ሙሽራው ይመጣል፥ ትቀበሉት ዘንድ ውጡ የሚል ውካታ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ እነዚያ ቆነጃጅት ሁሉ ተነሡና መብራታቸውን አዘጋጁ።

verses.text_english: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.text_amharic: ሰነፎቹም ልባሞቹን። መብራታችን ሊጠፋብን ነው፤ ከዘይታችሁ ስጡን አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: But the wise answered, saying, ; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: ልባሞቹ ግን መልሰው። ምናልባት ለእኛና ለእናንተ ባይበቃስ፤ ይልቅስ ወደሚሸጡት ሄዳችሁ ለራሳችሁ ግዙ አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.text_amharic: ሊገዙም በሄዱ ጊዜ ሙሽራው መጣ፥ ተዘጋጅተው የነበሩትም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ሰርግ ገቡ፥ ደጁም ተዘጋ።

verses.text_english: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላም ደግሞ የቀሩቱ ቈነጃጅት መጡና። ጌታ ሆይ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክፈትልን አሉ።

verses.text_english: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አላውቃችሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኒቱንና ሰዓቲቱን አታውቁምና እንግዲህ ንቁ።

verses.text_english: For as a man travelling into a far country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሌላ አገር የሚሄድ ሰው ባሮቹን ጠርቶ ያለውን ገንዘብ እንደ ሰጣቸው እንዲሁ ይሆናልና፤

verses.text_english: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ዓቅሙ፥ ለአንዱ አምስት መክሊት ለአንዱ ሁለት ለአንዱም አንድ ሰጠና ወደ ሌላ አገር ወዲያው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made other five talents.
verses.text_amharic: አምስት መክሊትም የተቀበለው ሄዶ ነገደበት ሌላም አምስት አተረፈ፤

verses.text_english: And likewise he that two, he also gained other two.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ሁለት የተቀበለው ሌላ ሁለት አተረፈ።

verses.text_english: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ የተቀበለው ግን ሄዶ ምድርን ቈፈረና የጌታውን ገንዘብ ቀበረ።

verses.text_english: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ዘመንም በኋላ የእነዚያ ባሮች ጌታ መጣና ተቆጣጠራቸው።

verses.text_english: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.text_amharic: አምስት መክሊት የተቀበለውም ቀረበና ሌላ አምስት መክሊት አስረክቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አምስት መክሊት ሰጥተኸኝ ነበር፤ እነሆ፥ ሌላ አምስት መክሊት አተረፍሁበት አለ።

verses.text_english: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ ታማኝም ባሪያ፤ በጥቂቱ ታምነሃል፥ በብዙ እሾምሃለሁ፤ ወደ ጌታህ ደስታ ግባ አለው።

verses.text_english: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት መክሊትም የተቀበለው ደግሞ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ሁለት መክሊት ሰጥተኸኝ ነበር፤ እነሆ፥ ሌላ ሁለት መክሊት አተረፍሁበት አለ።

verses.text_english: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ፥ ታማኝም ባሪያ፤ በጥቂቱ ታምነሃል፥ በብዙ እሾምሃለሁ፥ ወደ ጌታህ ደስታ ግባ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.text_amharic: አንድ መክሊትም የተቀበለው ደግሞ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ካልዘራህባት የምታጭድ ካልበተንህባትም የምትሰበስብ ጨካኝ ሰው መሆንህን አውቃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine.
verses.text_amharic: ፈራሁም ሄጄም መክሊትህን በምድር ቀበርሁት፤ እነሆ፥ መክሊትህ አለህ አለ።

verses.text_english: His lord answered and said unto him, wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አንተ ክፉና ሃኬተኛ ባሪያ፥ ካልዘራሁባት እንዳጭድ ካልበተንሁባትም እንድሰበስብ ታውቃለህን?

verses.text_english: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ገንዘቤን ለለዋጮች አደራ ልትሰጠው በተገባህ ነበር፥ እኔም መጥቼ ያለኝን ከትርፉ ጋር እወስደው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Take therefore the talent from him, and give unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መክሊቱን ውሰዱበት አሥር መክሊትም ላለው ስጡት፤

verses.text_english: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.text_amharic: ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋልና ይበዛለትማል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.text_english: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text_amharic: የማይጠቅመውንም ባሪያ በውጭ ወዳለው ጨለማ አውጡት፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ በሚመጣበት ጊዜ ከእርሱም ጋር ቅዱሳን መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በክብሩ ዙፋን ይቀመጣል፤

verses.text_english: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth sheep from the goats:
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ እረኛም በጎቹን ከፍየሎች እንደሚለይ እርስ በርሳቸው ይለያቸዋል፥

verses.text_english: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.text_amharic: በጎችን በቀኙ ፍየሎችንም በግራው ያቆማቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም በቀኙ ያሉትን እንዲህ ይላቸዋል። እናንተ የአባቴ ቡሩካን፥ ኑ፤ ዓለም ከተፈጠረበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የተዘጋጀላችሁን መንግሥት ውረሱ።

verses.text_english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.text_amharic: ተርቤ አብልታችሁኛልና፥ ተጠምቼ አጠጥታችሁኛልና፥ እንግዳ ሆኜ ተቀብላችሁኛልና፥ ታርዤ አልብሳችሁኛልና፥

verses.text_english: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ታምሜ ጠይቃችሁኛልና፥ ታስሬ ወደ እኔ መጥታችኋልና።

verses.text_english: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed ? or thirsty, and gave drink?
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃንም መልሰው ይሉታል። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተርበህ አይተን መቼ አበላንህስ? ወይስ ተጠምተህ አይተን መቼ አጠጣንህ?

verses.text_english: When saw we thee a stranger, and took in? or naked, and clothed ?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዳ ሆነህስ አይተን መቼ ተቀበልንህ? ወይስ ታርዘህ አይተን መቼ አለበስንህ?

verses.text_english: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ታመህ ወይስ ታስረህ አይተን መቼ ወደ አንተ መጣን?

verses.text_english: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሁሉ ከሚያንሱ ከእነዚህ ወንድሞቼ ለአንዱ እንኳ ስላደረጋችሁት ለእኔ አደረጋችሁት ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በግራው ያሉትን ደግሞ ይላቸዋል። እናንተ ርጉማን፥ ለሰይጣንና ለመላእክቱ ወደ ተዘጋጀ ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ከእኔ ሂዱ።

verses.text_english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.text_amharic: ተርቤ አላበላችሁኝምና፥ ተጠምቼ አላጠጣችሁኝምና፥ እንግዳ ሆኜ አልተቀበላችሁኝምና፥

verses.text_english: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
verses.text_amharic: ታርዤ አላለበሳችሁኝምና፥ ታምሜ ታስሬም አልጠየቃችሁኝምና።

verses.text_english: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ደግሞ ይመልሱና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተርበህ ወይስ ተጠምተህ ወይስ እንግዳ ሆነህ ወይስ ታርዘህ ወይስ ታመህ ወይስ ታስረህ መቼ አይተን አላገለገልንህም? ይሉታል።

verses.text_english: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did not to one of the least of these, ye did not to me.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሁሉ ከሚያንሱ ከእነዚህ ለአንዱ ስላላደረጋችሁት ለእኔ ደግሞ አላደረጋችሁትም ብሎ ይመልስላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ወደ ዘላለም ቅጣት፥ ጻድቃን ግን ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እነዚህን ቃሎች ሁሉ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Ye know that after two days is the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.text_amharic: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ፋሲካ እንዲሆን ታውቃላችሁ፥ የሰው ልጅም ሊሰቀል አልፎ ይሰጣል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የካህናት አለቆች የሕዝብም ሽማግሎች ቀያፋ በሚባለው በሊቀ ካህናቱ ግቢ ተሰበሰቡ፥

verses.text_english: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill .
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም በተንኰል ሊያስይዙት ሊገድሉትም ተማከሩ፤

verses.text_english: But they said, Not on the feast , lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። በሕዝቡ ዘንድ ሁከት እንዳይነሣ በበዓል አይሁን አሉ።

verses.text_english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በቢታንያ በለምጻሙ በስምዖን ቤት ሳለ፥

verses.text_english: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat .
verses.text_amharic: አንዲት ሴት ዋጋው እጅግ የበዛ ሽቱ የሞላው የአልባስጥሮስ ብልቃጥ ይዛ ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች በማዕድም ተቀምጦ ሳለ በራሱ ላይ አፈሰሰችው።

verses.text_english: But when his disciples saw , they had indignation, saying, To what purpose this waste?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን አይተው ተቈጡና። ይህ ጥፋት ለምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ በብዙ ዋጋ ተሽጦ ለድሆች ሊሰጥ ይቻል ነበርና አሉ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus understood , he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። መልካም ሥራ ሠርታልኛለችና ሴቲቱንስ ስለ ምን ታደክሙአታላችሁ?

verses.text_english: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.text_amharic: ድሆች ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ይኖራሉና፥ እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር አልኖርም፤

verses.text_english: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did for my burial.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ይህን ሽቱ በሰውነቴ ላይ አፍስሳ ለመቃብሬ አደረገች።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ወንጌል በዓለም ሁሉ በማናቸውም ስፍራ በሚሰበክበት እርስዋ ያደረገችው ደግሞ ለእርስዋ መታሰቢያ እንዲሆን ይነገራል።

verses.text_english: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ የሚባለው ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ወደ ካህናት አለቆች ሄዶ።

verses.text_english: And said , What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ምን ልትሰጡኝ ትወዳላችሁ እኔም አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ? እነርሱም ሠላሳ ብር መዘኑለት።

verses.text_english: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያችም ሰዓት ጀምሮ አሳልፎ ሊሰጠው ምቹ ጊዜ ይሻ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the first of the unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.text_amharic: በቂጣው በዓል በመጀመሪያ ቀን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀርበው። ፋሲካን ትበላ ዘንድ ወዴት ልናሰናዳልህ ትወዳለህ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ወደ ከተማ ከእገሌ ዘንድ ሄዳችሁ። መምህር። ጊዜዬ ቀርቦአል፤ ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ከአንተ ዘንድ ፋሲካን አደርጋለሁ ይላል በሉት አለ።

verses.text_english: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ ፋሲካንም አሰናዱ።

verses.text_english: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.text_amharic: ሲበሉም። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ አንዱ እኔን አሳልፎ ይሰጣል አለ።

verses.text_english: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.text_amharic: እጅግም አዝነው እያንዳንዱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ እሆንን? ይሉት ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said, He that dippeth hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ከእኔ ጋር እጁን በወጭቱ ያጠለቀ፥ እኔን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅስ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይሄዳል፥ ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት፤ ያ ሰው ባልተወለደ ይሻለው ነበር አለ።

verses.text_english: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.text_amharic: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠው ይሁዳም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ እኔ እሆንን? አለ፤ አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed , and brake , and gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.text_amharic: ሲበሉም ኢየሱስ እንጀራን አንሥቶ ባረከ ቈርሶም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠና። እንካችሁ፥ ብሉ ይህ ሥጋዬ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.text_amharic: ጽዋንም አንሥቶ አመስግኖም ሰጣቸው እንዲህም አለ። ሁላችሁ ከእርሱ ጠጡ፤

verses.text_english: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ብዙዎች ለኃጢአት ይቅርታ የሚፈስ የአዲስ ኪዳን ደሜ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በአባቴ መንግሥት ከእናንተ ጋር ከዚህ ከወይን ፍሬ አዲሱን እስከምጠጣበት እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ከዛሬ ጀምሬ አልጠጣውም።

verses.text_english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.text_amharic: መዝሙርም ከዘመሩ በኋላ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወጡ።

verses.text_english: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። በዚች ሌሊት ሁላችሁ በእኔ ትሰናከላላችሁ፤ እረኛውን እመታለሁ የመንጋውም በጎች ይበተናሉ የሚል ተጽፎአልና፤

verses.text_english: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ከተነሣሁ በኋላ ግን ወደ ገሊላ እቀድማችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all shall be offended because of thee, will I never be offended.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ሁሉም በአንተ ቢሰናከሉ እኔ ከቶ አልሰናከልም አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ በዚች ሌሊት ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ። ከአንተ ጋር መሞት እንኳ የሚያስፈልገኝ ቢሆን፥ ከቶ አልክድህም አለው። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁሉ ደግሞ እንደዚሁ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ከእነርሱ ጋር ጌቴሴማኒ ወደምትባል ስፍራ መጣ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም። ወዲያ ሄጄ ስጸልይ ሳለ በዚህ ተቀመጡ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስንም ሁለቱንም የዘብዴዎስን ልጆች ወስዶ ሊያዝን ሊተክዝም ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou .
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ እስከ ሞት ድረስ እጅግ አዘነች፤ በዚህ ቆዩ ከእኔም ጋር ትጉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂትም ወደ ፊት እልፍ ብሎ በፊቱ ወደቀና ሲጸልይ። አባቴ፥ ቢቻልስ፥ ይህች ጽዋ ከእኔ ትለፍ፤ ነገር ግን አንተ እንደምትወድ ይሁን እንጂ እኔ እንደምወድ አይሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed willing, but the flesh weak.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም መጣ፤ ተኝተውም አገኛቸውና ጴጥሮስን። እንዲሁም ከእኔ ጋር አንዲት ሰዓት እንኳ ልትተጉ አልቻላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ትጉና ጸልዩ፤ መንፈስስ ተዘጋጅታለች ሥጋ ግን ደካማ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ሁለተኛ ሄዶ ጸለየና። አባቴ፥ ይህች ጽዋ ሳልጠጣት ታልፍ ዘንድ የማይቻል እንደ ሆነ፥ ፈቃድህ ትሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም መጥቶ ዓይኖቻቸው በእንቅልፍ ከብደው ነበርና ተኝተው አገኛቸው።

verses.text_english: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ትቶአቸው ሄደ፥ ሦስተኛም ያንኑ ቃል ደግሞ ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥቶ። እንግዲህስ ተኙ ዕረፉም፤ እነሆ፥ ሰዓቲቱ ቀርባለች የሰው ልጅም በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሡ፥ እንሂድ፤ እነሆ፥ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ ቀርቦአል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ገና ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ይሁዳ መጣ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ብዙ ሕዝብ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዘው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሎች ዘንድ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም። የምስመው እርሱ ነው፤ ያዙት ብሎ ምልክት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረበና። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን ብሎ ሳመው።

verses.text_english: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ለምን ነገር መጣህ? አለው። በዚያን ጊዜ ቀረቡ እጃቸውንም በኢየሱስ ላይ ጭነው ያዙት።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ከነበሩት አንዱ እጁን ዘርግቶ ሰይፉን መዘዘና የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መትቶ ጆሮውን ቈረጠው።

verses.text_english: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አለው። ሰይፍ የሚያነሡ ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይጠፋሉና ሰይፍህን ወደ ስፍራው መልስ።

verses.text_english: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ አባቴን እንድለምን እርሱም አሁን ከአሥራ ሁለት ጭፍሮች የሚበዙ መላእክት እንዲሰድልኝ የማይቻል ይመስልሃልን?

verses.text_english: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ከሆነስ። እንደዚህ ሊሆን ይገባል የሚሉ መጻሕፍት እንዴት ይፈጸማሉ?

verses.text_english: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ሰዓት ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡ። ወንበዴን እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ልትይዙኝ ወጣችሁን? በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት እያስተማርሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ስቀመጥ ሳለሁ አልያዛችሁኝም።

verses.text_english: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህ ሁሉ የሆነ የነቢያት መጻሕፍት ይፈጸሙ ዘንድ ነው አለ። በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁሉ ትተውት ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስን የያዙትም ጻፎችና ሽማግሎች ወደ ተከማቹበት ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወደ ቀያፋ ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ ግን እስከ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ግቢ ድረስ ሩቅ ሆኖ ተከተለው፥ የነገሩንም ፍጻሜ ያይ ዘንድ ወደ ውስጥ ገብቶ ከሎሌዎቹ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችና ሽማግሎች ሸንጐውም ሁሉ እንዲገድሉት በኢየሱስ ላይ የሐሰት ምስክር ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ አላገኙም፤

verses.text_english: And said, This said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙም የሐሰት ምስክሮች ምንም ቢቀርቡ አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what these witness against thee?
verses.text_amharic: በኋላም ሁለት ቀርበው። ይህ ሰው። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ መቅደስ አፍርሼ በሦስት ቀን ልሠራው እችላለሁ ብሎአል አሉ።

verses.text_english: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ተነሥቶ። እነዚህ ለሚመሰክሩብህ አንድ ስንኳ አትመልስምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን ዝም አለ። ሊቀ ካህናቱም። አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ክርስቶስ የሆንህ እንደ ሆነ እንድትነግረን በሕያው እግዚአብሔር አምልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። አንተ አልህ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሰው ልጅ በኃይል ቀኝ ሲቀመጥ በሰማይም ደመና ሲመጣ ታያላችሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ልብሱን ቀዶ። ተሳድቦአል እንግዲህ ወዲህ ምስክሮች ስለ ምን ያስፈልገናል? እነሆ፥ ስድቡን አሁን ሰምታችኋል፤ ምን ይመስላችኋል? አለ።

verses.text_english: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote with the palms of their hands,
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሞት ይገባዋል ብለው መለሱ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በፊቱ ተፉበት፤ ጐሰሙትም፥ ሌሎችም በጥፊ መትተው። ክርስቶስ ሆይ፥ በጥፊ የመታህ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ትንቢት ተናገርልን አሉ።

verses.text_english: But he denied before all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ከቤት ውጭ በአጥሩ ግቢ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ አንዲት ገረድም ወደ እርሱ ቀርባ። አንተ ደግሞ ከገሊላው ከኢየሱስ ጋር ነበርህ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And when he was gone out into the porch, another saw him, and said unto them that were there, This was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። የምትዪውን አላውቀውም ብሎ በሁሉ ፊት ካደ።

verses.text_english: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ በሩም ሲወጣ ሌላይቱ አየችውና በዚያ ላሉት። ይህ ደግሞ ከናዝሬቱ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ነበረ አለች።

verses.text_english: And after a while came unto they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.text_amharic: ዳግመኛም ሲምል። ሰውየውን አላውቀውም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.text_english: Then began he to curse and to swear, , I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂትም ቈይተው በዚያ ቆመው የነበሩ ቀርበው ጴጥሮስን። አነጋገርህ ይገልጥሃልና በእውነት አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ወገን ነህ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ። ሰውየውን አላውቀውም ብሎ ሊራገምና ሊምል ጀመረ። ወዲያውም ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: English translation coming soon...
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ ያለው የኢየሱስ ቃል ትዝ አለው፤ ወደ ውጭም ወጥቶ መራራ ልቅሶ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.text_amharic: ሲነጋም የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝቡ ሽማግሎች ሁሉ ሊገድሉት በኢየሱስ ላይ ተማከሩ፤

verses.text_english: And when they had bound him, they led away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.text_amharic: አስረውም ወሰዱት፥ ለገዢው ለጴንጤናዊው ጲላጦስም አሳልፈው ሰጡት።

verses.text_english: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አሳልፎ የሰጠው ይሁዳ እንደ ተፈረደበት አይቶ ተጸጸተ፥ ሠላሳውንም ብር ለካህናት አለቆችና ለሽማግሎች መልሶ።

verses.text_english: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What to us? see thou .
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕ ደም አሳልፌ በመስጠቴ በድያለሁ አለ። እነርሱ ግን። እኛስ ምን አግዶን? አንተው ተጠንቀቅ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.text_amharic: ብሩንም በቤተ መቅደስ ጥሎ ሄደና ታንቆ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም ብሩን አንሥተው። የደም ዋጋ ነውና ወደ መባ ልንጨምረው አልተፈቀደም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
verses.text_amharic: ተማክረውም የሸክላ ሠሪውን መሬት ለእንግዶች መቃብር ገዙበት።

verses.text_english: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ያ መሬት እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የደም መሬት ተባለ።

verses.text_english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ የተባለው። ከእስራኤል ልጆችም አንዳንዶቹ የገመቱትን፥ የተገመተውን ዋጋ ሠላሳ ብር ያዙ፥

verses.text_english: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም እንዳዘዘኝ ስለ ሸክላ ሠሪ መሬት ሰጡት። የሚል ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በገዢው ፊት ቆመ፤ ገዢውም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ አንተ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው፤ ኢየሱስም። አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም ሽማግሎችም ሲከሱት ምንም አልመለሰም።

verses.text_english: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጲላጦስ። ስንት ያህል እንዲመሰክሩብህ አትሰማምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.text_amharic: ገዢውም እጅግ እስኪደነቅ ድረስ አንዲት ቃል ስንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.text_english: Now at feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በዓል ሕዝቡ የወደዱትን አንድ እስረኛ ሊፈታላቸው ለገዢው ልማድ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም በርባን የሚባል በጣም የታወቀ እስረኛ ነበራቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እነርሱ ተሰብስበው ሳሉ ጲላጦስ። በርባንን ወይስ ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን ማንኛውን ልፈታላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው፤

verses.text_english: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.text_amharic: በቅንዓት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡት ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀምጦ ሳለ ሚስቱ። ስለ እርሱ ዛሬ በሕልም እጅግ መከራ ተቀብያለሁና በዚያ ጻድቅ ሰው ምንም አታድርግ ብላ ላከችበት።

verses.text_english: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችና ሽማግሎች ግን በርባንን እንዲለምኑ ኢየሱስን ግን እንዲያጠፉ ሕዝቡን አባበሉ።

verses.text_english: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.text_amharic: ገዢውም መልሶ። ከሁለቱ ማንኛውን ልፈታላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው፤ እነርሱም። በርባንን አሉ።

verses.text_english: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስ። ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን እንግዲህ ምን ላድርገው? አላቸው፤ ሁሉም። ይሰቀል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.text_amharic: ገዢውም። ምን ነው? ያደረገው ክፋት ምንድር ነው? አለ፤ እነርሱ ግን። ይሰቀል እያሉ ጩኸት አበዙ።

verses.text_english: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye .
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ሁከት እንዲጀመር እንጂ አንዳች እንዳይረባ ባየ ጊዜ፥ ውኃ አንሥቶ። እኔ ከዚህ ጻድቅ ሰው ደም ንጹሕ ነኝ፤ እናንተ ተጠንቀቁ ሲል በሕዝቡ ፊት እጁን ታጠበ።

verses.text_english: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood on us, and on our children.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መልሰው። ደሙ በእኛና በልጆቻችን ላይ ይሁን አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered to be crucified.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ በርባንን ፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስን ግን ገርፎ ሊሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የገዢው ወታደሮች ኢየሱስን ወደ ገዢው ግቢ ውስጥ ወሰዱት ጭፍራውንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አከማቹ።

verses.text_english: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሱንም ገፈው ቀይ ልብስ አለበሱት፥

verses.text_english: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.text_amharic: ከእሾህም አክሊል ጎንጉነው በራሱ ላይ፥ በቀኝ እጁም መቃ አኖሩ፥ በፊቱም ተንበርክከው። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን እያሉ ዘበቱበት፤

verses.text_english: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.text_amharic: ተፉበትም መቃውንም ይዘው ራሱን መቱት።

verses.text_english: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify .
verses.text_amharic: ከዘበቱበትም በኋላ ቀዩን ልብስ ገፈፉት፥ ልብሱንም አለበሱት ሊሰቅሉትም ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.text_amharic: ሲወጡም ስምዖን የተባለው የቀሬናን ሰው አገኙ፤ እርሱንም መስቀሉን ይሸከም ዘንድ አስገደዱት።

verses.text_english: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.text_amharic: ትርጓሜው የራስ ቅል ስፍራ ወደሚሆን ጎልጎታ ወደሚባለው ስፍራ በደረሱ ጊዜም፥

verses.text_english: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted , he would not drink.
verses.text_amharic: በሐሞት የተደባለቀ የወይን ጠጅ ሊጠጣ አቀረቡለት፤ ቀምሶም ሊጠጣው አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰቀሉትም በኋላ ልብሱን ዕጣ ጥለው ተካፈሉ፥

verses.text_english: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ተቀምጠው ይጠብቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ኢየሱስ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነው የሚል የክሱን ጽሕፈት ከራሱ በላይ አኖሩ።

verses.text_english: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ሁለት ወንበዶች አንዱ በቀኝ አንዱም በግራ ከእርሱ ጋር ተሰቀሉ።

verses.text_english: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.text_amharic: የሚያልፉትም ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ ይሰድቡት ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.text_amharic: ቤተ መቅደስን የምታፈርስ በሦስት ቀንም የምትሠራው፥ ራስህን አድን፤ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ ከመስቀል ውረድ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking , with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ደግሞ የካህናት አለቆች ከጻፎችና ከሽማግሎች ጋር እየዘበቱበት እንዲህ አሉ።

verses.text_english: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችን አዳነ፥ ራሱን ሊያድን አይችልም፤ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከሆነ፥ አሁን ከመስቀል ይውረድ እኛም እናምንበታለን።

verses.text_english: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ታምኖአል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነኝ ብሎአልና ከወደደውስ አሁን ያድነው።

verses.text_english: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ጋር የተሰቀሉት ወንበዶች ደግሞ ያንኑ እያሉ ይነቅፉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.text_amharic: ከስድስት ሰዓትም ጀምሮ እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ድረስ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጨለማ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.text_amharic: በዘጠኝ ሰዓትም ኢየሱስ። ኤሎሄ ኤሎሄ ላማ ሰበቅታኒ? ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ። ይህም። አምላኬ አምላኬ፥ ስለ ምን ተውኸኝ? ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: Some of them that stood there, when they heard , said, This calleth for Elias.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ከቆሙት ሰዎች ሰምተው። ይህስ ኤልያስን ይጠራል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled with vinegar, and put on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ከእነርሱ አንዱ ሮጠ፤ ሰፍነግም ይዞ ሆምጣጤ ሞላበት፥ በመቃም አድርጎ አጠጣው።

verses.text_english: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎቹ ግን። ተው፥ ኤልያስ መጥቶ ያድነው እንደ ሆነ እንይ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሁለተኛ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ ነፍሱን ተወ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ የቤተ መቅደስ መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ከሁለት ተቀደደ፥ ምድርም ተናወጠች፥ ዓለቶችም ተሰነጠቁ፤

verses.text_english: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.text_amharic: መቃብሮችም ተከፈቱ፥ ተኝተው ከነበሩትም ከቅዱሳን ብዙ ሥጋዎች ተነሡ፤

verses.text_english: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.text_amharic: ከትንሣኤውም በኋላ ከመቃብሮች ወጥተው ወደ ቅድስት ከተማ ገቡና ለብዙዎች ታዩ።

verses.text_english: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃም ከእርሱም ጋር ኢየሱስን የሚጠብቁ መናወጡንና የሆነውን ነገር አይተው። ይህ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበረ ብለው እጅግ ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስን እያገለገሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ብዙ ሴቶች በሩቅ ሆነው ሲመለከቱ በዚያ ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም መግደላዊት ማርያምና የያዕቆብና የዮሳ እናት ማርያም የዘብዴዎስም የልጆቹ እናት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ዮሴፍ የተባለው ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ከአርማትያስ መጣ፥ እርሱም ደግሞ የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም እንዲሰጡት አዘዘ። ዮሴፍም ሥጋውን ይዞ በንጹሕ በፍታ ከፈነው፥

verses.text_english: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓለት በወቀረው በአዲሱ መቃብርም አኖረው፥ በመቃብሩም ደጃፍ ታላቅ ድንጋይ አንከባሎ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: መግደላዊት ማርያምም ሁለተኛይቱም ማርያም በመቃብሩ አንጻር ተቀምጠው በዚያ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱም ከመዘጋጀት በኋላ በሚሆነው ቀን፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን ወደ ጲላጦስ ተሰበሰቡና።

verses.text_english: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ያ አሳች በሕይወቱ ገና ሳለ። ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ እነሣለሁ እንዳለ ትዝ አለን።

verses.text_english: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥተው በሌሊት እንዳይሰርቁት ለሕዝቡም። ከሙታን ተነሣ እንዳይሉ፥ የኋለኛይቱ ስሕተት ከፊተኛይቱ ይልቅ የከፋች ትሆናለችና መቃብሩ እስከ ሦስተኛ ቀን ድረስ እንዲጠበቅ እዘዝ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make as sure as ye can.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። ጠባቆች አሉአችሁ፤ ሄዳችሁ እንዳወቃችሁ አስጠብቁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሄደው ከጠባቆች ጋር ድንጋዩን አትመው መቃብሩን አስጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበትም መጨረሻ መጀመሪያው ቀን ሲነጋ መግደላዊት ማርያምና ሁለተኛይቱ ማርያም መቃብሩን ሊያዩ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ የጌታ መልአክ ከሰማይ ስለ ወረደ ታላቅ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፤ ቀርቦም ድንጋዩን አንከባሎ በላዩ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.text_amharic: መልኩም እንደ መብረቅ ልብሱም እንደ በረዶ ነጭ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead .
verses.text_amharic: ጠባቆቹም እርሱን ከመፍራት የተነሣ ተናወጡ እንደ ሞቱም ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም መልሶ ሴቶቹን አላቸው። እናንተስ አትፍሩ የተሰቀለውን ኢየሱስን እንድትሹ አውቃለሁና፤

verses.text_english: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ተናገረ ተነሥቶአልና በዚህ የለም፤ የተኛበትን ስፍራ ኑና እዩ።

verses.text_english: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጥናችሁም ሂዱና። ከሙታን ተነሣ፥ እነሆም፥ ወደ ገሊላ ይቀድማችኋል በዚያም ታዩታላችሁ ብላችሁ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ንገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ነገርኋችሁ። በፍርሃትና በታላቅ ደስታም ፈጥነው ከመቃብር ሄዱ፥ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሊያወሩ ሮጡ።

verses.text_english: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ኢየሱስ አገኛቸውና። ደስ ይበላችሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም ቀርበው እግሩን ይዘው ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። አትፍሩ፤ ሄዳችሁ ወደ ገሊላ እንዲሄዱ ለወንድሞቼ ተናገሩ፥ በዚያም ያዩኛል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄዱም ሳሉ እነሆ፥ ከጠባቆቹ አንዳንድ ወደ ከተማ መጥተው የሆነውን ሁሉ ለካህናት አለቆች አወሩ።

verses.text_english: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.text_amharic: ከሽማግሎች ጋርም ተሰብስበው ተማከሩና ለጭፍሮች ብዙ ገንዘብ ሰጥተዋቸው።

verses.text_english: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him while we slept.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ተኝተን ሳለን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በሌሊት መጥተው ሰረቁት በሉ።

verses.text_english: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በገዢው ዘንድ የተሰማ እንደ ሆነ፥ እኛ እናስረዳዋለን እናንተም ያለ ሥጋት እንድትሆኑ እናደርጋለን አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ገንዘቡን ተቀብለው እንደ አስተማሩአቸው አደረጉ። ይህም ነገር በአይሁድ ዘንድ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሲወራ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ አንዱ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ኢየሱስ ወዳዘዛቸው ተራራ ወደ ገሊላ ሄዱ፥

verses.text_english: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
verses.text_amharic: ባዩትም ጊዜ ሰገዱለት፤ የተጠራጠሩ ግን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ቀረበና እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። ሥልጣን ሁሉ በሰማይና በምድር ተሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወንጌል መጀመሪያ።

verses.text_english: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ ተብሎ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ እንደ ተጻፈ፥

verses.text_english: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ በምድረ በዳ እያጠመቀ የንስሐንም ጥምቀት ለኃጢአት ስርየት እየሰበከ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.text_amharic: የይሁዳም አገር ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምም ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጡ ነበር፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም እየተናዘዙ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ከእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም የግመል ጠጉር ለብሶ በወገቡ ጠፍር ይታጠቅ አንበጣና የበረሀ ማርም ይበላ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
verses.text_amharic: ተጎንብሼ የጫማውን ጠፍር መፍታት የማይገባኝ ከእኔ የሚበረታ በኋላዬ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በውኃ አጠመቅኋችሁ እርሱ ግን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ያጠምቃችኋል እያለ ይሰብክ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ወራትም ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት መጥቶ ከዮሐንስ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ተጠመቀ።

verses.text_english: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ከውኃው በወጣ ጊዜ ሰማያት ሲቀደዱ መንፈስም እንደ ርግብ ሲወርድበት አየና። የምወድህ ልጄ አንተ ነህ፥

verses.text_english: And there came a voice from heaven, , Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል የሚል ድምፅ ከሰማያት መጣ።

verses.text_english: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ አወጣው።

verses.text_english: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
verses.text_amharic: በምድረ በዳም ከሰይጣን እየተፈተነ አርባ ቀን ሰነበተ ከአራዊትም ጋር ነበረ፥ መላእክቱም አገለገሉት።

verses.text_english: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
verses.text_amharic: በገሊላ ባሕርም አጠገብ ሲያልፍ ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።

verses.text_english: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። በኋላዬ ኑና ሰዎችን አጥማጆች እንድትሆኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም መረባቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ጥቂት እልፍ ብሎ የዘብዴዎስን ልጅ ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ደግሞ በታንኳ ላይ መረባቸውን ሲያበጁ አየ።

verses.text_english: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ጠራቸው አባታቸውንም ዘብዴዎስን ከሞያተኞቹ ጋር በታንኳ ላይ ትተው ተከትለውት ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም ገቡ፤ ወዲያውም በሰንበት ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ አስተማረ።

verses.text_english: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ባለ ሥልጣን ያስተምራቸው ነበር እንጂ እንደ ጻፎች አይደለምና በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.text_english: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም በምኩራባቸው ርኵስ መንፈስ ያለው ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ልታጠፋን መጣህን? ማን እንደ ሆንህ አውቄአለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሱ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Let alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ዝም በል ከእርሱም ውጣ ብሎ ገሠጸው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
verses.text_amharic: ርኵሱም መንፈስ አንፈራገጠውና በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ ከእርሱ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም። ይህ ምንድር ነው? በሥልጣን ርኵሳን መናፍስትን ያዝዛል፤ እነርሱም ይታዘዙለታልና ይህ አዲስ ትምህርት ምንድር ነው? ብለው እስኪጠያየቁ ድረስ አደነቁ።

verses.text_english: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናውም ወዲያው በየስፍራው ወደ ገሊላ ዙሪያ ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ከምኵራብ ወጥቶ ከያዕቆብና ከዮሐንስ ጋር ወደ ስምዖንና ወደ እንድርያስ ቤት ገባ።

verses.text_english: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖንም አማት በንዳድ ታማ ተኝታ ነበር፥ ስለ እርስዋም ወዲያው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
verses.text_amharic: ቀርቦም እጅዋን ይዞ አስነሣት ንዳዱም ወዲያው ለቀቃትና አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይም ገብቶ በመሸ ጊዜ፥ የታመሙትንና አጋንንት ያደረባቸውን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤

verses.text_english: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም ሁላ በደጅ ተሰብስባ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
verses.text_amharic: በልዩ ልዩ ደዌም የታመሙትን ብዙዎችን ፈወሰ፥ ብዙዎችንም አጋንንት አወጣ፥ አጋንንትም ክርስቶስ መሆኑን አውቀው ነበርና ሊናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳም ተነሥቶ ገና ሌሊት ሳለ ወጣ ወደ ምድረ በዳም ሄዶ በዚያ ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም ገሥግሠው ተከተሉት፥

verses.text_english: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
verses.text_amharic: ባገኙትም ጊዜ። ሁሉ ይፈልጉሃል አሉት።

verses.text_english: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All seek for thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። በዚያ ደግሞ ልሰብክ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ በቅርብ ወዳሉ መንደሮች እንሂድ ስለዚህ ወጥቻለሁና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
verses.text_amharic: በምኵራባቸውም እየሰበከ አጋንንትንም እያወጣ ወደ ገሊላ ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
verses.text_amharic: ለምጻምም ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ ተንበረከከና። ብትወድስ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አዘነለት እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወድዳለሁ፤ ንጻ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
verses.text_amharic: በተናገረም ጊዜ ለምጹ ወዲያው ለቀቀውና ነጻ።

verses.text_english: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
verses.text_amharic: በብርቱም ተናግሮ ወዲያው አወጣው፤

verses.text_english: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
verses.text_amharic: ለማንም አንዳች እንዳትናገር ተጠንቀቅ፥ ነገር ግን ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ስለ መንጻትህ ሙሴ ያዘዘውን አቅርብ አለው።

verses.text_english: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ሲወጣ ብዙ ሊሰብክና ነገሩን ሊያወራ ጀመረ፥ ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ ተገልጦ ወደ ከተማ መግባት ወደ ፊት ተሳነው፥ ነገር ግን በውጭ በምድረ በዳ ይኖር ነበር፤ ከየስፍራውም ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And again he entered into Capernaum after days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂት ቀን በኋላ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ደግሞ ገብቶ በቤት እንደ ሆነ ተሰማ።

verses.text_english: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive , no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በደጅ ያለው ስፍራም እስኪጠባቸው ድረስ ብዙ ሰዎች ተሰበሰቡ፤ ቃሉንም ይነግራቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
verses.text_amharic: አራት ሰዎችም የተሸከሙትን ሽባ አመጡለት።

verses.text_english: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡም ብዛት ወደ እርሱ ማቅረብ ቢያቅታቸው እርሱ ያለበትን የቤቱን ጣራ አነሡ፥ ነድለውም ሽባው የተኛበትን አልጋ አወረዱ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እምነታቸውን አይቶ ሽባውን። አንተ ልጅ፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.text_amharic: ከጻፎችም አንዳንዶቹ በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር በልባቸውም። ይህ ሰው ስለ ምን እንደዚህ ያለ ስድብ ይናገራል?

verses.text_english: Why doth this thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
verses.text_amharic: ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ማን ይችላል? ብለው አሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ በልባቸው እንዲህ እንዳሰቡ በመንፈስ አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። በልባችሁ ይህን ስለ ምን ታስባላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.text_amharic: ሽባውን። ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣ አልጋህንም ተሸከምና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.text_english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለሰው ልጅ በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ሊያስተሰርይ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ፤

verses.text_english: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
verses.text_amharic: ሽባውን። አንተን እልሃለሁ፥ ተነሣ፥ አልጋህን ተሸከምና ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቶም ወዲያው አልጋውን ተሸክሞ በሁሉ ፊት ወጣ፥ ስለዚህም ሰዎች ሁሉ ተገረሙና። እንዲህ ያለ ከቶ አላየንም ብለው እግዚአብሔርን አከበሩ።

verses.text_english: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በባሕር አጠገብ ወጣ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡና አስተማራቸው።

verses.text_english: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ሲያልፍም በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የእልፍዮስን ልጅ ሌዊን አየና። ተከተለኝ አለው። ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
verses.text_amharic: በቤቱም በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ ብዙ ቀራጮችና ኃጢአተኞች ከኢየሱስና ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጡ፤ ብዙ ነበሩ ይከተሉትም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
verses.text_amharic: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ሲበላ አይተው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ከቀራ ጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር የሚበላና የሚጠጣ ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus heard , he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ብርቱዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም ኃጢአተኞችን እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.text_amharic: የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርትና ፈሪሳውያን ይጦሙ ነበር። መጥተውም። የዮሐንስና የፈሪሳውያን ደቀ መዛሙርት የሚጦሙት የአንተ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን የማይጦሙት ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሚዜዎች ሊጦሙ ይችላሉን? ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሊጦሙ አይችሉም።

verses.text_english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ የሚወሰድበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ በዚያ ወራትም ይጦማሉ።

verses.text_english: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
verses.text_amharic: በአረጀ ልብስ አዲስ እራፊ የሚጥፍ የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ አዲሱ መጣፊያ አሮጌውን ይቦጭቀዋል፥ መቀደዱም የባሰ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
verses.text_amharic: በአረጀ አቁማዳም አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ የወይን ጠጁ አቁማዳውን ያፈነዳል የወይኑም ጠጅ ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ ግን በአዲስ አቁማዳ ያኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበትም በእርሻ መካከል ሲያልፍ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እየሄዱ እሸት ይቀጥፉ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም። እነሆ፥ በሰንበት ያልተፈቀደውን ስለ ምን ያደርጋሉ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ዳዊት ባስፈለገውና በተራበ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ አብረውት ከነበሩት ጋር ያደረገውን፥ አብያተር ሊቀ ካህናት በነበረ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ፥

verses.text_english: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
verses.text_amharic: ከካህናት በቀር መብላት ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕትን እንጀራ እንደ በላ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት እንደ ሰጣቸው ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ። ሰንበት ስለ ሰው ተፈጥሮአል እንጂ ሰው ስለ ሰንበት አልተፈጠረም፤

verses.text_english: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም የሰው ልጅ ለሰንበት እንኳ ጌታዋ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ወደ ምኵራብ ገባ፥ በዚያም እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
verses.text_amharic: ሊከሱትም፥ በሰንበት ይፈውሰው እንደ ሆነ ይጠባበቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
verses.text_amharic: እጁ የሰለለችውንም ሰው። ተነሥተህ ወደ መካከል ና አለው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበት በጎ ማድረግ ተፈቅዶአልን? ወይስ ክፉ? ነፍስ ማዳን ወይስ መግደል? አላቸው፤ እነርሱም ዝም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ልባቸውም ድንዛዜ አዝኖ ዙሪያውን እየተመለከተ በቍጣ አያቸው፥ ሰውየውንም። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.text_amharic: ዘረጋትም፥ እጁም ዳነች። ፈሪሳውያንም ወጥተው ወዲያው እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ከሄሮድስ ወገን ጋር ተማከሩበት።

verses.text_english: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ባህር ፈቀቅ አለ፤ ከገሊላ የመጡም ብዙ ሰዎች ተከተሉት፤

verses.text_english: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እንዴት ትልቅ ነገርም እንዳደረገው ሰምተው ብዙ ሰዎች ከይሁዳ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከኤዶምያስም ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶም ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ምድርም ወደ እርሱ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም እንዳያጋፉት ታንኳን ያቆዩለት ዘንድ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አዘዛቸው፤

verses.text_english: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎችን አድኖ ነበርና፥ ስለዚህም ሥቃይ ያለባቸው ሁሉ እንዲዳስሱት ይወድቁበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: ርኵሳን መናፍስትም ባዩት ጊዜ በፊቱ ተደፍተው። አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳይገልጡትም በጣም አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth whom he would: and they came unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ተራራም ወጣ፥ ራሱም የወደዳቸውን ወደ እርሱ ጠራ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር እንዲኖሩና ለመስበክ እንዲልካቸው፥

verses.text_english: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
verses.text_amharic: ድውዮችንም ሊፈውሱ አጋንንትንም ሊያወጡ ሥልጣን ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ አሥራ ሁለት አደረገ፤

verses.text_english: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖንንም ጴጥሮስ ብሎ ሰየመው፤

verses.text_english: And James the of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
verses.text_amharic: የዘብዴዎስንም ልጅ ያዕቆብን የያዕቆብንም ወንድም ዮሐንስን ቦአኔርጌስ ብሎ ሰየማቸው፥ የነጎድጓድ ልጆች ማለት ነው፤

verses.text_english: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
verses.text_amharic: እንድርያስንም ፊልጶስንም በርተሎሜውስንም ማቴዎስንም ቶማስንም የእልፍዮስን ልጅ ያዕቆብንም ታዴዎስንም ቀነናዊውንም ስምዖንን፥

verses.text_english: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
verses.text_amharic: አሳልፎ የሰጠውንም የአስቆሮቱን ይሁዳን።

verses.text_english: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም መጡ፤ እንጀራም መብላት ስንኳ እስኪሳናቸው ድረስ እንደ ገና ብዙ ሰዎች ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And when his friends heard , they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመዶቹም ሰምተው። አበደ ብለዋልና ሊይዙት ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢየሩሳሌም የወረዱ ጻፎችም። ብዔል ዜቡል አለበት፤ ደግሞ። በአጋንንት አለቃ አጋንንትን ያወጣል ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And he called them , and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱንም ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ በምሳሌ አላቸው። ሰይጣን ሰይጣንን ሊያወጣው እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.text_english: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥትም እርስ በርስዋ ከተለያየች ያች መንግሥት ልትቆም አትችልም፤

verses.text_english: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.text_amharic: ቤትም እርስ በርሱ ከተለያየ ያ ቤት ሊቆም አይችልም።

verses.text_english: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም ራሱን ተቃውሞ ከተለያየ፥ መጨረሻ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ሊቆም አይችልም።

verses.text_english: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አስቀድሞ ኃይለኛውን ሳያስር ወደ ኃይለኛው ቤት ገብቶ ዕቃውን ሊበዘብዝ የሚችል የለም፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ ቤቱን ይበዘብዛል።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለሰው ልጆች ኃጢአት ሁሉ የሚሳደቡትም ስድብ ሁሉ ይሰረይላቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ላይ የሚሳደብ ሁሉ ግን የዘላለም ኃጢአት ዕዳ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ለዘላለም አይሰረይለትም።

verses.text_english: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ርኵስ መንፈስ አለበት ይሉ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
verses.text_amharic: እናቱና ወንድሞቹም መጡ በውጭም ቆመው ወደ እርሱ ልከው አስጠሩት።

verses.text_english: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎችም በዙሪያው ተቀምጠው ነበሩና። እነሆ፥ እናትህ ወንድሞችህም በውጭ ቆመው ይፈልጉሃል አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
verses.text_amharic: መልሶም። እናቴ ማን ናት? ወንድሞቼስ እነ ማን ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያው ተቀምጠው ወደ ነበሩትም ተመለከተና። እነሆ እናቴ ወንድሞቼም።

verses.text_english: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ ወንድሜ ነው እኅቴም እናቴም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በባሕር ዳር ሊያስተምር ጀመረ። እጅግ ብዙ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ ስለ ተሰበሰቡ እርሱ በታንኳ ገብቶ በባሕር ላይ ተቀመጠ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በባሕር ዳር በምድር ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
verses.text_amharic: በምሳሌም ብዙ ያስተምራቸው ነበር፥ በትምህርቱም አላቸው። ስሙ።

verses.text_english: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ዘሪ ሊዘራ ወጣ። ሲዘራም አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀና ወፎች መጥተው በሉት።

verses.text_english: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም ብዙ መሬት በሌለበት በጭንጫ ላይ ወደቀና ጥልቅ መሬት ስላልነበረው ወዲያው በቀለ፤

verses.text_english: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይም ሲወጣ ጠወለገ፥ ሥርም ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.text_english: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾህም ወጣና አነቀው፥ ፍሬም አልሰጠም።

verses.text_english: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ላይ ወደቀና ወጥቶ አድጎ ፍሬ ሰጠ፥ አንዱም ሠላሳ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም መቶ አፈራ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
verses.text_amharic: ብቻውንም በሆነ ጊዜ፥ በዙሪያው የነበሩት ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ጋር ስለ ምሳሌው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all things are done in parables:
That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and sins should be forgiven them.
verses.text_amharic: አላቸውም። ይህን ምሳሌ አታውቁምን? እንዴትስ ምሳሌዎቹን ሁሉ ታውቃላችሁ?

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
verses.text_amharic: ዘሪው ቃሉን ይዘራል። ቃልም በተዘራበት በመንገድ ዳር የሆኑት እነዚህ ናቸው፥

verses.text_english: The sower soweth the word.
verses.text_amharic: በሰሙት ጊዜም ሰይጣን ወዲያው መጥቶ በልባቸው የተዘራውን ቃል ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በጭንጫ ላይ የተዘሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ቃሉንም ሰምተው ወዲያው በደስታ ይቀበሉታል፥

verses.text_english: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
verses.text_amharic: ለጊዜውም ነው እንጂ በእነርሱ ሥር የላቸውም፥ ኋላም በቃሉ ምክንያት መከራ ወይም ስደት በሆነ ጊዜ ወዲያው ይሰናከላሉ።

verses.text_english: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
verses.text_amharic: በእሾህም የተዘሩት ሌሎች ናቸው፥ ቃሉን የሰሙት እነዚህ ናቸው፥

verses.text_english: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
verses.text_amharic: የዚህም ዓለም አሳብና የባለጠግነት ማታለል የሌላውም ነገር ምኞት ገብተው ቃሉን ያንቃሉ፥ የማያፈራም ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
verses.text_amharic: በመልካምም መሬት የተዘሩት ቃሉን ሰምተው የሚቀበሉት አንዱም ሠላሳ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም መቶ ፍሬ የሚያፈሩት እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive , and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። መብራትን ከዕንቅብ ወይስ ከአልጋ በታች ሊያኖሩት ያመጡታልን? በመቅረዝ ላይ ሊያኖሩት አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲገለጥ ባይሆን የተሰወረ የለምና፤ ወደ ግልጥ እንዲመጣ እንጂ የተሸሸገ የለም።

verses.text_english: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ቢኖር ይስማ።

verses.text_english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: አላቸውም። ምን እንድትሰሙ ተጠበቁ። በምትሰፍሩበት መስፈሪያ ይሰፈርላችኋል ለእናንተም ይጨመርላችኋል።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
verses.text_amharic: ላለው ይሰጠዋልና፤ ከሌለውም ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.text_english: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። በምድር ዘርን እንደሚዘራ ሰው የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደዚህ ናት ሌሊትና ቀን ይተኛልም ይነሣልም፥

verses.text_english: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዴት እንደሚሆን ሳያውቅ ዘሩ ይበቅላል ያድግማል።

verses.text_english: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም አውቃ በመጀመሪያ ቡቃያ ኋላም ዛላ ኋላም በዛላው ፍጹም ሰብል ታፈራለች።

verses.text_english: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬ ግን ሲበስል መከር ደርሶአልና ወዲያው ማጭድ ይልካል።

verses.text_english: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት በምን እናስመስላታለን? ወይስ በምን ምሳሌ እንመስላታለን?

verses.text_english: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት ናት፥ እርስዋም በምድር በተዘራች ጊዜ በምድር ካለ ዘር ሁሉ ታንሳለች፤ በተዘራችም ጊዜ ትወጣለች ከአትክልትም ሁሉ የምትበልጥ ትሆናለች፥

verses.text_english: like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
verses.text_amharic: የሰማይ ወፎችም በጥላዋ ሊሰፍሩ እስኪችሉ ታላላቅ ቅርንጫፎች ታደርጋለች።

verses.text_english: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
verses.text_amharic: መስማትም በሚችሉበት መጠን እነዚህን በሚመስል በብዙ ምሳሌ ቃሉን ይነግራቸው ነበር፤ ያለ ምሳሌ ግን አልነገራቸውም፥

verses.text_english: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear .
verses.text_amharic: ለብቻቸውም ሲሆኑ ነገሩን ሁሉ ለገዛ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይፈታላቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ። ወደ ማዶ እንሻገር አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ትተው በታንኳ እንዲያው ወሰዱት፥ ሌሎች ታንኳዎችም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
verses.text_amharic: ብርቱ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ተነሣና ውኃ በታንኳይቱ እስኪሞላ ድረስ ማዕበሉ በታንኳይቱ ይገባ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በስተኋላዋ ትራስ ተንተርሶ ተኝቶ ነበር፤ አንቅተውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ስንጠፋ አይገድህምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
verses.text_amharic: ነቅቶም ነፋሱን ገሠጸው ባሕሩንም። ዝም በል፥ ፀጥ በል አለው። ነፋሱም ተወ ታላቅ ፀጥታም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ የምትፈሩ ስለ ምን ነው? እንዴትስ እምነት የላችሁም? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
verses.text_amharic: እጅግም ፈሩና። እንግዲህ ነፋስም ባሕርም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው? ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ባሕር ማዶም ወደ ጌርጌሴኖን አገር መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.text_amharic: ከታንኳይቱም በወጣ ጊዜ፥ ርኵስ መንፈስ የያዘው ሰው ከመቃብር ወጥቶ ወዲያው ተገናኘው፤

verses.text_english: Who had dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በመቃብር ይኖር ነበር፥ በሰንሰለትም ስንኳ ማንም ሊያስረው በዚያን ጊዜ አይችልም ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any tame him.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜ በእግር ብረትና በሰንሰለት ይታሰር ነበርና ዳሩ ግን ሰንሰለቱን ይበጣጥስ እግር ብረቱንም ይሰባብር ነበር፥ ሊያሸንፈውም የሚችል አልነበረም፤

verses.text_english: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜም ሌሊትና ቀን በመቃብርና በተራራ ሆኖ ይጮኽ ነበር ሰውነቱንም በድንጋይ ይቧጭር ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም ከሩቅ ባየ ጊዜ ሮጦ ሰገደለት፥

verses.text_english: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ድምፅም እየጮኸ። የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? እንዳታሠቃየኝ በእግዚአብሔር አምልሃለሁ አለ፤

verses.text_english: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, unclean spirit.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ርኵስ መንፈስ፥ ከዚህ ሰው ውጣ ብሎት ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And he asked him, What thy name? And he answered, saying, My name Legion: for we are many.
verses.text_amharic: ስምህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። ብዙዎች ነንና ስሜ ሌጌዎን ነው አለው፥

verses.text_english: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.text_amharic: ከአገርም ውጭ እንዳይሰዳቸው አጥብቆ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በተራራ ጥግ ብዙ የእሪያ መንጋ ይሰማራ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እሪያዎቹ እንድንገባ ስደደን ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ፈቀደላቸው። ርኵሳን መናፍስቱም ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎቹ ገቡ፥ ሁለት ሺህም የሚያህል መንጋ ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር ተጣደፉና በባሕር ሰጠሙ።  ፍ1 ሌጌዎን ማለት ጭፍራ ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: And they that fed the swine fled, and told in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞቹም ሸሽተው በከተማውና በአገሩ አወሩ፤ ነገሩም ምን እንደ ሆነ ለማየት መጡ።

verses.text_english: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
