verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሱስም መጡ፥ አጋንንትም ያደሩበትን ሌጌዎንም የነበረበትን ሰው ተቀምጦ ለብሶም ልቡም ተመልሶ አዩና ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And they that saw told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and concerning the swine.
verses.text_amharic: ያዩት ሰዎችም አጋንንት ላደሩበት ሰው የሆነውንና ስለ እሪያዎቹ ተረኩላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
verses.text_amharic: ከአገራቸውም እንዲሄድላቸው ይለምኑት ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ታንኳይቱም በገባ ጊዜ አጋንንት አድረውበት የነበረው ሰው ከእርሱ ጋር እንዲኖር ለመነው።

verses.text_english: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አልፈቀደለትም፥ ነገር ግን። ወደ ቤትህ በቤተ ሰዎችህ ዘንድ ሄደህ ጌታ እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረገልህ እንዴትስ እንደ ማረህ አውራላቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all did marvel.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዶም ኢየሱስ እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረገለት አሥር ከተማ በሚባል አገር ይሰብክ ጀመር፥ ሁሉም ተደነቁ።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በታንኳይቱ ወደ ማዶ ከተሻገረ በኋላ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በባሕርም አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
verses.text_amharic: ኢያኢሮስ የተባለ ከምኵራብ አለቆች አንዱ መጣ፤ ባየውም ጊዜ በእግሩ ላይ ወደቀና።

verses.text_english: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: , come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
verses.text_amharic: ታናሽቱ ልጄ ልትሞት ቀርባለችና እንድትድንና በሕይወት እንድትኖር መጥተህ እጅህን ጫንባት ብሎ አጥብቆ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ሄደ። ብዙ ሕዝብም ተከተሉት አጋፉትም።

verses.text_english: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
verses.text_amharic: ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመትም ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈሳት ሴት ነበረች፥

verses.text_english: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ባለ መድኃኒቶችም ብዙ ተሠቃየች፤ ገንዘብዋንም ሁሉ ከስራ ባሰባት እንጂ ምንም አልተጠቀመችም፤

verses.text_english: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
verses.text_amharic: የኢየሱስንም ወሬ ሰምታ በስተኋላው በሰዎች መካከል መጥታ ልብሱን ዳሰሰች።

verses.text_english: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
verses.text_amharic: ልብሱን ብቻ የዳሰስሁ እንደ ሆነ እድናለሁ ብላለችና።

verses.text_english: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in body that she was healed of that plague.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም የደምዋ ምንጭ ደረቀ ከሥቃይዋም እንደዳነች በሰውነትዋ አወቀች።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ ከእርሱ ኃይል እንደ ወጣ በገዛ ራሱ አውቆ በሕዝቡ መካከል ዘወር ብሎ። ልብሴን የዳሰሰ ማን ነው? አለ።

verses.text_english: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ሕዝቡ ሲያጋፉህ እያየህ። ማን ዳሰሰኝ ትላለህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ያደረገችውን ለማየት ዘወር ብሎ ይመለከት ነበር።

verses.text_english: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱ ግን የተደረገላትን ስላወቀች፥ እየፈራች እየተንቀጠቀጠችም፥ መጥታ በፊቱ ተደፋች እውነቱንም ሁሉ ነገረችው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ ከሥቃይሽም ተፈወሽ አላት።

verses.text_english: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ከምኵራብ አለቃው ቤት ዘንድ የመጡት። ልጅህ ሞታለች፤ ስለ ምን መምህሩን አሁን ታደክመዋለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን የተናገሩትን ቃል አድምጦ ለምኵራቡ አለቃ። እመን ብቻ እንጂ አትፍራ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
verses.text_amharic: ከጴጥሮስም ከያዕቆብም ከያዕቆብም ወንድም ከዮሐንስ በቀር ማንም እንዲከተለው አልፈቀደም።

verses.text_english: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምኵራቡ አለቃ ቤትም መጥቶ ሰዎች ሲንጫጩና ሲያለቅሱ ዋይታም ሲያበዙ አየ፤

verses.text_english: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.text_amharic: ገብቶም። ስለ ምን ትንጫጫላችሁ ታለቅሳላችሁም? ብላቴናይቱ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
verses.text_amharic: በጣምም ሳቁበት። እርሱ ግን ሁሉን አስወጥቶ የብላቴናይቱን አባትና እናትም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትንም ይዞ ብላቴናይቱ ወዳለችበት ገባ።

verses.text_english: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
verses.text_amharic: የብላቴናይቱንም እጅ ይዞ። ጣሊታ ቁሚ አላት፤ ፍችውም አንቺ ብላቴና ተነሽ እልሻለሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴናይቱም የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረችና ወዲያው ቆማ ተመላለሰች። ወዲያውም ታላቅ መገረም ተገረሙ።

verses.text_english: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ማንም እንዳያውቅ አጥብቆ አዞአቸው። የምትበላውን ስጡአት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወጥቶ ወደ ገዛ አገሩ መጣ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing were astonished, saying, From whence hath this these things? and what wisdom this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.text_amharic: ሰንበትም በሆነ ጊዜ በምኵራብ ያስተምር ጀመር፤ ብዙዎችም ሰምተው ተገረሙና። እነዚህን ነገሮች ይህ ከወዴት አገኛቸው? ለዚህ የተሰጠችው ጥበብ ምንድር ናት? በእጁም የሚደረጉ እንደነዚህ ያሉ ተአምራት ምንድር ናቸው?

verses.text_english: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
verses.text_amharic: ይህስ ጸራቢው የማርያም ልጅ የያቆብም የዮሳም የይሁዳም የስምዖንም ወንድም አይደለምን? እኅቶቹስ በዚህ በእኛ ዘንድ አይደሉምን? አሉ፤ ይሰናከሉበትም ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ነቢይ ከገዛ አገሩና ከገዛ ዘመዶቹ ከገዛ ቤቱም በቀር ሳይከበር አይቀርም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በጥቂቶች ድውዮች ላይ እጁን ጭኖ ከመፈወስ በቀር፥ ተአምር ሊያደርግ ምንም አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አለማመናቸውም ተደነቀ። በመንደሮችም እያስተማረ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he called the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
verses.text_amharic: አስራ ሁለቱንም ወደ እርሱ ጠራ ሁለት ሁለቱንም ይልካቸው ጀመር፥ በርኵሳን መናፍስትም ላይ ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው፥

verses.text_english: And commanded them that they should take nothing for journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in purse:
verses.text_amharic: ለመንገድም ከበትር በቀር እንጀራም ቢሆን ከረጢትም ቢሆን መሐለቅም በመቀነታቸው ቢሆን እንዳይዙ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: But shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
verses.text_amharic: በእግራችሁ ጫማ አድርጉ እንጂ ሁለት እጀ ጠባብ አትልበሱ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
verses.text_amharic: በማናቸውም ስፍራ ወደ ቤት ብትገቡ ከዚያ እስክትወጡ ድረስ በዚያው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.text_amharic: ከማይቀበሉአችሁና ከማይሰሙአችሁ ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ ከዚያ ወጥታችሁ ምስክር ይሆንባቸው ዘንድ ከእግራችሁ በታች ያለውን ትቢያ አራግፉ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶምና ለገሞራ በፍርድ ቀን ይቀልላቸዋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥተውም ንስሐ እንዲገቡ ሰበኩ፥ ብዙ አጋንንትንም አወጡ፥

verses.text_english: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed .
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ድውዮችንም ዘይት እየቀቡ ፈወሱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And king Herod heard ; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙም ተገልጦአልና ንጉሡ ሄሮድስ በሰማ ጊዜ። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል ስለዚህም ኃይል በእርሱ ይደረጋል አለ።

verses.text_english: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችም። ኤልያስ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎችም። ከነቢያት እንደ አንዱ ነቢይ ነው አሉ።

verses.text_english: But when Herod heard , he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስ ግን ሰምቶ። እኔ ራሱን ያስቈረጥሁት ዮሐንስ ይህ ነው እርሱ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል አለ።

verses.text_english: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስ የወንድሙን የፊልጶስን ሚስት ሄሮድያዳን አግብቶ ነበርና በእርስዋ ምክንያት ራሱ ልኮ ዮሐንስን አስይዞ በወኅኒ አሳስሮት ነበር፤

verses.text_english: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ ሄሮድስን። የወንድምህ ሚስት ለአንተ ልትሆን አልተፈቀደም ይለው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድያዳ ግን ተቃውማው ልትገድለው ትፈልግ ነበር አልቻለችም፤

verses.text_english: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስ ዮሐንስ ጻድቅና ቅዱስ ሰው እንደ ሆነ አውቆ ይፈራውና ይጠባበቀው ነበር፤ እርሱንም ሰምቶ በብዙ ነገር ያመነታ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief of Galilee;
verses.text_amharic: በደስታም ይሰማው ነበር። ሄሮድስም በተወለደበት ቀን ለመኳንንቱና ለሻለቆቹ ለገሊላም ሹማምንት ግብር ባደረገ ጊዜ ምቹ ቀን ሆነላትና

verses.text_english: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give thee.
verses.text_amharic: የሄሮድያዳ ልጅ ገብታ ስትዘፍን ሄሮድስንና ከእርሱ ጋር የተቀመጡትን ደስ አሰኘቻቸው። ንጉሡም ብላቴናይቱን። የምትወጂውን ሁሉ ለምኚኝ እሰጥሽማለሁ አላት፤

verses.text_english: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: የመንግሥቴ እኩሌታ ስንኳ ቢሆን የምትለምኚውን ሁሉ እሰጥሻለሁ ብሎ ማለላት።

verses.text_english: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥታም ለእናትዋ። ምን ልለምነው? አለች። እርስዋም። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ አለች።

verses.text_english: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ፈጥና ወደ ንጉሡ ገብታ። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ በወጭት አሁን ልትሰጠኝ እወዳለሁ ብላ ለመነችው።

verses.text_english: And the king was exceeding sorry; for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም እጅግ አዝኖ ስለ መሐላው ከእርሱም ጋር ስለ ተቀመጡት ሊነሣት አልወደደም።

verses.text_english: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ንጉሡ ባለ ወግ ልኮ ራሱን እንዲያመጣ አዘዘው። ሄዶም በወኅኒ ራሱን ቈረጠ፥

verses.text_english: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱንም በወጭት አምጥቶ ለብላቴናይቱ ሰጣት፥ ብላቴናይቱም ለእናትዋ ሰጠች።

verses.text_english: And when his disciples heard , they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው መጡ በድኑንም ወስደው ቀበሩት።

verses.text_english: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
verses.text_amharic: ሐዋርያትም ወደ ኢየሱስ ተሰብስበው ያደረጉትንና ያስተማሩትን ሁሉ ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.text_amharic: እናንት ራሳችሁ ብቻችሁን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ኑና ጥቂት ዕረፉ አላቸው፤ የሚመጡና የሚሄዱ ብዙዎች ነበሩና፥ ለመብላት እንኳ ጊዜ አጡ።

verses.text_english: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
verses.text_amharic: በታንኳውም ብቻቸውን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም ሲሄዱ አዩአቸው ብዙዎችም አወቁአቸውና ከከተሞች ሁሉ በእግር እየሮጡ ወዲያ ቀደሙአቸው ወደ እርሱም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወጥቶ ብዙ ሕዝብ አየና እረኛ እንደሌላቸው በጎች ስለ ነበሩ አዘነላቸው፥ ብዙም ነገር ያስተምራቸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time far passed:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙ ሰዓት ካለፈ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ቦታው ምድረ በዳ ነው አሁንም መሽቶአል፤

verses.text_english: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
verses.text_amharic: የሚበሉት የላቸውምና በዙሪያ ወዳሉ ገጠሮችና መንደሮች ሄደው እንጀራ ለራሳቸው እንዲገዙ አሰናብታቸው አሉት።

verses.text_english: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው አላቸው። ሄደን እንጀራ በሁለት መቶ ዲናር እንግዛላቸውን? እንዲበሉም እንስጣቸውን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? ሂዱና እዩ አላቸው። ባወቁም ጊዜ። አምስት፥ ሁለትም ዓሣ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም በየክፍሉ በለመለመ ሣር ላይ እንዲያስቀምጡአቸው አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.text_amharic: መቶ መቶውና አምሳ አምሳው እየሆኑ በተራ በተራ ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱንም እንጀራ ሁለቱንም ዓሣ ይዞ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረከ፥ እንጀራውንም ቈርሶ እንዲያቀርቡላቸው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥

verses.text_english: And they did all eat, and were filled.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱን ዓሣ ደግሞ ለሁሉ ከፈለ። ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፤

verses.text_english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
verses.text_amharic: ከቍርስራሹም አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ የሞላ አነሡ ከዓሣውም ደግሞ።

verses.text_english: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራውንም የበሉት ወንዶቹ አምስት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡን ሲያሰናብት ሳለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በታንኳ ገብተው ወደ ማዶ ወደ ቤተ ሳይዳ እንዲቀድሙት ግድ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
verses.text_amharic: ካሰናበታቸውም በኋላ ሊጸልይ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ታንኳይቱ በባሕር መካከል ሳለች እርሱ ብቻውን በምድር ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስ ወደ ፊታቸው ነበረና እየቀዘፉ ሲጨነቁ አይቶ፥ ከሌሊቱ በአራተኛው ክፍል በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ እነርሱ መጣ፤ ሊያልፋቸውም ይወድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን በባሕር ላይ ሲሄድ ባዩት ጊዜ ምትሀት መሰላቸውና ጮኹ፥

verses.text_english: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ አይተውታልና፥ ታወኩም። ወዲያውም ተናገራቸውና። አይዞአችሁ፤ እኔ ነኝ፥ አትፍሩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እነርሱም ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገባ፥ ነፋሱም ተወ፤ በራሳቸውም ያለ መጠን እጅግ ተገረሙ፤

verses.text_english: For they considered not of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እንጀራው አላስተዋሉምና፤ ነገር ግን ልባቸው ደንዝዞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
verses.text_amharic: ተሻግረውም ወደ ምድር ወደ ጌንሴሬጥ ደረሱ ታንኳይቱንም አስጠጉ።

verses.text_english: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
verses.text_amharic: ከታንኳይቱም ሲወጡ ወዲያው አውቀውት

verses.text_english: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች አገር ሁሉ ዙሪያ ሮጡና እርሱ እንዳለ ወደ ሰሙበት ስፍራ ሕመምተኞችን በአልጋ ላይ ያመጡ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
verses.text_amharic: በገባበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ መንደርም ከተማም ገጠርም ቢሆን፥ በገበያ ድውዮችን ያኖሩ ነበር፤ የልብሱንም ጫፍ እንኳ ሊዳስሱ ይለምኑት ነበር የዳሰሱትም ሁሉ ዳኑ።

verses.text_english: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንና ከጻፎች ወገን ከኢየሩሳሌም የመጡትም ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም አንዳንድ በርኵስ ማለት ባልታጠበ እጅ እንጀራ ሲበሉ አዩ።

verses.text_english: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንና አይሁድም ሁሉ የሽማግሎችን ወግ ሲጠብቁ እጃቸውን ደኅና አድርገው ሳይታጠቡ አይበሉምና፥

verses.text_english: And from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
verses.text_amharic: ከገበያም ተመልሰው ካልታጠቡ አይበሉም፥ ጽዋንም ማድጋንም የናስ ዕቃንም አልጋንም እንደ ማጠብ ሌላ ነገር ሊጠብቁት የተቀበሉት ብዙ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም ጻፎችም። ደቀ መዛሙርትህ እንደ ሽማግሌዎች ወግ ስለ ምን አይሄዱም? ነገር ግን እጃቸውን ሳይታጠቡ እንጀራ ይበላሉ ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ኢሳይያስ ስለ እናንተ ስለ ግብዞች። ይህ ሕዝብ በከንፈሩ ያከብረኛል ልቡ ግን ከእኔ በጣም የራቀ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውም ሥርዓት የሆነ ትምህርት እያስተማሩ በከንቱ ያመልኩኛል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በእውነት ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ትታችሁ ጽዋን ማድጋንም እንደ ማጠብ የሰውን ወግ ትጠብቃላችሁ፥ ይህንም የመሰለ ብዙ ሌላ ነገር ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ወጋችሁን ትጠብቁ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ እጅግ ንቃችኋል።

verses.text_english: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ ደግሞ። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሰደበ ፈጽሞ ይሙት ብሎአልና።

verses.text_english: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ትላላችሁ። ሰው አባቱን ወይም እናቱን። ከእኔ የምትጠቀምበት ነገር ሁሉ ቍርባን ማለት መባ ነው ቢል፥

verses.text_english: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
verses.text_amharic: ለአባቱና ለእናቱ ምንም እንኳ ሊያደርግ ወደ ፊት አትፈቅዱለትም፤

verses.text_english: And when he had called all the people , he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one , and understand:
verses.text_amharic: ባስተላለፋችሁትም ወግ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ትሽራላችሁ፤ እንደዚሁም ይህን የሚመስል ብዙ ነገር ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሕዝቡን ጠርቶ። ሁላችሁ እኔን ስሙ አስተውሉም።

verses.text_english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው የሚወጡት ሰውን የሚያረክሱ ናቸው እንጂ ከሰው ውጭ የሚገባውስ ሊያረክሰው የሚችል ምንም የለም።

verses.text_english: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ቢኖር ይስማ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, cannot defile him;
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝቡ ዘንድ ወደ ቤት ከገባ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ምሳሌውን ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እናንተ ደግሞ እንደዚህ የማታስተውሉ ናችሁን? ከውጭ ወደ ሰው የሚገባ ሊያረክሰው ምንም እንዳይችል አትመለከቱምን?

verses.text_english: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሆድ ገብቶ ወደ እዳሪ ይወጣል እንጂ ወደ ልብ አይገባምና፤ መብልን ሁሉ እያጠራ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለ። ከሰው የሚወጣው ሰውን የሚያረክስ ያ ነው።

verses.text_english: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
verses.text_amharic: ከውስጥ ከሰው ልብ የሚወጣ ክፉ አሳብ፥

verses.text_english: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
verses.text_amharic: ዝሙት፥ መስረቅ፥ መግደል፥ ምንዝርነት፥ መጐምጀት፥ ክፋት፥ ተንኰል፥ መዳራት፥ ምቀኝነት፥ ስድብ፥ ትዕቢት፥ ስንፍና ናቸውና፤

verses.text_english: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know : but he could not be hid.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ክፉው ሁሉ ከውስጥ ይወጣል ሰውን ያረክሰዋል።

verses.text_english: For a woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ተነሥቶ ወደ ጢሮስና ወደ ሲዶና አገር ሄደ። ወደ ቤትም ገብቶ ማንም እንዳያውቅበት ወደደ ሊሰወርም አልተቻለውም፤

verses.text_english: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያው ግን ታናሺቱ ልጅዋ ርኵስ መንፈስ ያደረባት አንዲት ሴት ስለ እርሱ ሰምታ መጣችና በእግሩ ላይ ተደፋች

verses.text_english: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast unto the dogs.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ግሪክ፥ ትውልድዋም ሲሮፊኒቃዊት ነበረች፤ ከልጅዋ ጋኔን ያወጣላት ዘንድ ለመነችው።

verses.text_english: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። ልጆቹ በፊት ይጠግቡ ዘንድ ተዪ የልጆቹን እንጀራ ይዞ ለቡችሎች መጣል አይገባምናአላት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም መልሳ። አዎን፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ቡችሎች እንኳ ከማዕድ በታች ሆነው የልጆችን ፍርፋሪ ይበላሉ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስለዚህ ቃልሽ ሂጂ ጋኔኑ ከልጅሽ ወጥቶአል አላት።

verses.text_english: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትዋም ሄዳ ጋኔኑ ወጥቶ ልጅዋም በአልጋ ላይ ተኝታ አገኘች።

verses.text_english: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከጢሮስ አገር ወጥቶ በሲዶና አልፎ አሥር ከተማ በሚባል አገር መካከል ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
verses.text_amharic: ደንቆሮና ኰልታፋም የሆነ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፥

verses.text_english: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ይጭንበት ዘንድ ለመኑት። ከሕዝቡም ለይቶ ለብቻው ወሰደው፥ ጣቶቹንም በጆሮቹ አገባ እንትፍም ብሎ መላሱን ዳሰሰ፤

verses.text_english: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰማይም አሻቅቦ አይቶ ቃተተና። ኤፍታህ አለው፥ እርሱም ተከፈት ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published ;
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ጆሮቹ ተከፈቱ የመላሱም እስራት ተፈታ አጥርቶም ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
verses.text_amharic: ለማንም አትንገሩ ብሎ አዘዛቸው እነርሱ ግን ባዘዛቸውም መጠን ይልቅ እጅግ አወሩት።

verses.text_english: English translation coming soon...
verses.text_amharic: ያለ መጠንም ተገረሙና። ሁሉን ደኅና አድርጎአል፤ ደንቆሮችም እንዲሰሙ ዲዳዎችም እንዲናገሩ ያደርጋል አሉ።

verses.text_english: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples , and saith unto them,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ወራት ደግሞ ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበረ የሚበሉትም ስለሌላቸው ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠርቶ።

verses.text_english: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ጋር እስካሁን ሦስት ቀን ውለዋልና የሚበሉት ስለሌላቸው አዝንላቸዋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ከሩቅ መጥተዋልና ጦማቸውን ወደ ቤታቸው ባሰናብታቸው በመንገድ ይዝላሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these with bread here in the wilderness?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። በዚህ በምድረ በዳ እንጀራ ከየት አግኝቶ ሰው እነዚህን ማጥገብ ይችላል? ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው፥ እነርሱም። ሰባት አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before ; and they did set before the people.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም በምድር እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ። ሰባቱንም እንጀራ ይዞ አመሰገነ፥ ቈርሶም እንዲያቀርቡላቸው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ለሕዝቡም አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before .
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂትም ትንሽ ዓሣ ነበራቸው፤ ባረከውም ይህንም ደግሞ እንዲያቀርቡላቸው አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.text_amharic: በሉም ጠገቡም፥ የተረፈውንም ቍርስራሽ ሰባት ቅርጫት አነሡ።

verses.text_english: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.text_amharic: የበሉትም አራት ሺህ ያህል ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
verses.text_amharic: አሰናበታቸውም። ወዲያውም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ ዳልማኑታ አገር መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም ወጡና ሊፈትኑት ከሰማይ ምልክት ከእርሱ ፈልገው ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከሩ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈሱም እጅግ ቃተተና። ይህ ትውልድ ስለ ምን ምልክት ይፈልጋል? እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለዚህ ትውልድ ምልክት አይሰጠውም አለ።

verses.text_english: Now had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
verses.text_amharic: ትቶአቸውም እንደ ገና ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ ማዶ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and the leaven of Herod.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራ መያዝም ረሱ፥ ለእነርሱም ከአንድ እንጀራ በቀር በታንኳይቱ አልነበራቸውም።

verses.text_english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, because we have no bread.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ተጠንቀቁ፤ ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሄሮድስ እርሾ ተጠበቁ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus knew , he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም። እንጀራ ስለሌለን ይሆናል ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እንጀራ ስለሌላችሁ ስለ ምን ትነጋገራላችሁ? ገና አልተመለከታችሁምን? አላስተዋላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ልባችሁስ ደንዝዞአልን? ዓይን ሳላችሁ አታዩምን? ጆሮስ ሳላችሁ አትሰሙምን? ትዝስ አይላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱን እንጀራ ለአምስት ሺህ በቈረስሁ ጊዜ፥ ቍርስራሹ የሞላ ስንት መሶብ አነሣችሁ? እነርሱም። አሥራ ሁለት አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱን እንጀራስ ለአራት ሺህ በቈረስሁ ጊዜ፥ ቍርስራሹ የሞላ ስንት ቅርጫት አነሣችሁ? እነርሱም። ሰባት አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
verses.text_amharic: ገና አላስተዋላችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤተ ሳይዳም መጡ። ዕውርም አመጡለት፥ እንዲዳስሰውም ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውሩንም እጁን ይዞ ከመንደር ውጭ አወጣው፥ በዓይኑም ተፍቶበት እጁንም ጭኖበት። አንዳች ታያለህን ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: After that he put hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
verses.text_amharic: አሻቅቦም። ሰዎች እንደ ዛፍ ሲመላለሱ አያለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell to any in the town.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ደግሞ እጁን በዓይኑ ላይ ጫነበት አጥርቶም አየና ዳነም ከሩቅም ሳይቀር ሁሉን ተመለከተ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቱም ሰደደውና። ወደ መንደሩ አትግባ በመንደሩም ለማንም አንዳች አትናገር አለው።

verses.text_english: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some , Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስና ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በፊልጶስ ቂሣርያ ወዳሉ መንደሮች ወጡ በመንገድም። ሰዎች እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ይላሉ? ብሎ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠየቃቸው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም ከነቢያት አንዱ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተስ እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። ጴጥሮስም። አንተ ክርስቶስ ነህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርሱም ለማንም እንዳይናገሩ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ ብዙ መከራ ሊቀበል፥ ከሽማግሌዎችም ከካህናት አለቆችም ከጻፎችም ሊጣል፥ ሊገደልም ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ሊነሣ እንዲገባው ያስተምራቸው ጀመር፤ ቃሉንም ገልጦ ይናገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ወደ እርሱ ወስዶ ይገሥጸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And when he had called the people with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ዘወር አለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም አይቶ ጴጥሮስን ገሠጸውና። ወደ ኋላዬ ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን፤ የሰውን እንጂ የእግዚአብሔርን ነገር አታስብምና አለው።

verses.text_english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡንም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በኋላዬ ሊመጣ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.text_english: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታልና፥ ስለ እኔና ስለ ወንጌል ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ግን ያድናታል።

verses.text_english: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ዓለምን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል?

verses.text_english: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውስ ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?

verses.text_english: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, of him the Son of Man also will be ashamed when He comes in the glory of His Father with the holy angels." 9And He said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you that there are some standing here who will not taste death till they see the kingdom of God present with power." 2 Now after six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and led them up on a high mountain apart by themselves; and He was transfigured before them. 3 His clothes became shining, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them. 4 And Elijah appeared to them with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus. 5 Then Peter answered and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"-- 6 because he did not know what to say, for they were greatly afraid. 7 And a cloud came and overshadowed them; and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!" 8 Suddenly, when they had looked around, they saw no one anymore, but only Jesus with themselves.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም በዘማዊና በኃጢአተኛ ትውልድ መካከል በእኔና በቃሌ የሚያፍር ሁሉ፥ የሰው ልጅ ደግሞ በአባቱ ክብር ከቅዱሳን መላእክት ጋር በመጣ ጊዜ በእርሱ ያፍርበታል።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚህ ከቆሙት ሰዎች የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በኃይል ስትመጣ እስኪያዩ ድረስ፥ ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንዶች አሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
verses.text_amharic: ከስድስት ቀንም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ዮሐንስንም ይዞ ወደ ረጅም ተራራ ብቻቸውን አወጣቸው። በፊታቸውም ተለወጠ፥ ልብሱም አንጸባረቀ፤

verses.text_english: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
verses.text_amharic: አጣቢም በምድር ላይ እንደዚያ ሊያነጣው እስከማይችል በጣም ነጭ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስና ሙሴም ታዩአቸው፥ ከኢየሱስም ጋር ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ ኢየሱስን። መምህር ሆይ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነውና አንድ ለአንተ አንድም ለሙሴ አንድም ለኤልያስ ሦስት ዳሶች እንሥራ አለው።

verses.text_english: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እጅግ ስለ ፈሩ የሚለውን አያውቅም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.text_amharic: ደመናም መጥቶ ጋረዳቸው፥ ከደመናውም። የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፥ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገትም ዞረው ሲመለከቱ ከእነርሱ ጋር ከኢየሱስ ብቻ በቀር ማንንም አላዩም።

verses.text_english: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ከተራራውም ሲወርዱ የሰው ልጅ ከሙታን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ያዩትን ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉንም ይዘው። ከሙታን መነሣት ምንድር ነው? እያሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ተጠያየቁ።

verses.text_english: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ኤልያስ አስቀድሞ ሊመጣ እንዲገባው ጻፎች ስለ ምን ይላሉ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ኤልያስማ አስቀድሞ ይመጣል ሁሉንም ያቀናናል፤ ስለ ሰው ልጅም እንዴት ተብሎ ተጽፎአል? ብዙ መከራ እንዲቀበል እንዲናቅም።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ኤልያስ ደግሞ መጥቶአል፥ ስለ እርሱም እንደ ተጸፈ የወደዱትን ሁሉ አደረጉበት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he came to disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በመጣ ጊዜ ብዙ ሕዝብ ሲከብቡአቸው ጻፎችም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሲከራከሩ አየ።

verses.text_english: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to saluted him.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ባዩት ጊዜ ደነገጡ፥ ወደ እርሱም ሮጠው እጅ ነሡት።

verses.text_english: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
verses.text_amharic: ጻፎችንም። ስለ ምን ከእነርሱ ጋር ትከራከራላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.text_english: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝቡ አንዱ መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ዲዳ መንፈስ ያደረበትን ልጄን ወደ አንተ አምጥቼአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
verses.text_amharic: በያዘውም ስፍራ ሁሉ ይጥለዋል፤ አረፋም ይደፍቃል፥ ጥርሱንም ያፋጫል ይደርቃልም፤ እንዲያወጡለትም ለደቀ መዛሙርትህ ነገርኋቸው፥ አልቻሉምም አለው።

verses.text_english: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። የማታምን ትውልድ ሆይ፥ እስከመቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ወደ እኔ አምጡት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እርሱም አመጡት። እርሱንም ባየ ጊዜ ያ መንፈስ ወዲያው አንፈራገጠው፤ ወደ ምድርም ወድቆ አረፋ እየደፈቀ ተንፈራፈረ።

verses.text_english: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱንም። ይህ ከያዘው ስንት ዘመን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም። ከሕፃንነቱ ጀምሮ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜም ሊያጠፋው ወደ እሳትም ወደ ውኃም ጣለው፤ ቢቻልህ ግን እዘንልን እርዳንም አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things possible to him that believeth.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ቢቻልህ ትላለህ፤ ለሚያምን ሁሉ ይቻላል አለው።

verses.text_english: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም የብላቴናው አባት ጮኾ። አምናለሁ፤ አለማመኔን እርዳው አለ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሕዝቡ እንደ ገና ሲራወጥ አይቶ ርኵሱን መንፈስ ገሠጸና። አንተ ዲዳ ደንቆሮም መንፈስ፥ እኔ አዝሃለሁ፥ ከእርሱ ውጣ እንግዲህም አትግባበት አለው።

verses.text_english: And cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
verses.text_amharic: ጮኾም እጅግም አንፈራግጦት ወጣ፤ ብዙዎችም። ሞተ እስኪሉ ድረስ እንደ ሙት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን እጁን ይዞ አስነሣው ቆመም።

verses.text_english: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም ከገባ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እኛ ልናወጣው ያልቻልን ስለ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ብቻውን ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ወገን በጸሎትና በጦም ካልሆነ በምንም ሊወጣ አይችልም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know .
For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ነገሩን አላስተዋሉም፥ እንዳይጠይቁትም ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም መጣ። በቤትም ሆኖ። በመንገድ እርስ በርሳችሁ ምን ተነጋገራችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.text_english: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን በመንገድ። ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ ማን ይሆን? ተባብለው ነበርና ዝም አሉ።

verses.text_english: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who the greatest.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀምጦም አሥራ ሁለቱን ጠርቶ። ሰው ፊተኛ ሊሆን ቢወድ ከሁሉ በኋላ የሁሉም አገልጋይ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, shall be last of all, and servant of all.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃንም ይዞ በመካከላቸው አቆመው አቅፎም።

verses.text_english: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ካሉ ሕፃናት አንዱን በስሜ የሚቀበል ሁሉ እኔን ይቀበላል፤ የሚቀበለኝም ሁሉ የላከኝን እንጂ እኔን አይቀበልም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አንድ ሰው በስምህ አጋንንትን ሲያወጣ አየነው፥

verses.text_english: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
verses.text_amharic: ስለማይከተለንም ከለከልነው አለው። ኢየሱስ ግን አለ። በስሜ ተአምር ሠርቶ በቶሎ በእኔ ላይ ክፉ መናገር የሚችል ማንም የለምና አትከልክሉት፤

verses.text_english: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
verses.text_amharic: የማይቃወመን እርሱ ከእኛ ጋር ነውና።

verses.text_english: For he that is not against us is on our part.
verses.text_amharic: የክርስቶስ ስለ ሆናችሁ በስሜ ጽዋ ውኃ የሚያጠጣችሁ ሁሉ፥ ዋጋው እንዳይጠፋበት እውነት እላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔም ከሚያምኑት ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን የሚያሰናክል ሁሉ ትልቅ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ባሕር ቢጣል ይሻለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall offend one of little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ በእሳት ይቀመማልና፥ መሥዋዕትም ሁሉ በጨው ይቀመማል።

verses.text_english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
verses.text_amharic: ጨው መልካም ነው፤ ጨው ግን አልጫ ቢሆን በምን ታጣፍጡታላችሁ? በነፍሳችሁ ጨው ይኑርባችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁም ተስማሙ።

verses.text_english: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ተነሥቶ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ይሁዳ አገር መጣ፥ ደግሞም ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ እንደ ልማዱም ደግሞ ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away wife? tempting him.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም ቀርበው። ሰው ሚስቱን ሊፈታ ተፈቅዶለታልን? ብለው ሊፈትኑት ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። ሙሴ ምን አዘዛችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put away.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሙሴስ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ጽፎ እንዲፈታት ፈቀደ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ስለ ልባችሁ ጥንካሬ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ጻፈላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
verses.text_amharic: ከፍጥረት መጀመሪያ ግን እግዚአብሔር ወንድና ሴት አደረጋቸው፤

verses.text_english: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል፥

verses.text_english: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ፤ ስለዚህ አንድ ሥጋ ናቸው እንጂ ወደ ፊት ሁለት አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ያጣመረውን እንግዲህ ሰው አይለየው።

verses.text_english: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same .
verses.text_amharic: በቤትም ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለዚህ ነገር ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሚስቱን ፈትቶ ሌላ የሚያገባ ሁሉ በእርስዋ ላይ ያመነዝራል፤

verses.text_english: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ባልዋን ፈትታ ሌላ ብታገባ ታመነዝራለች አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and disciples rebuked those that brought .
verses.text_amharic: እንዲዳስሳቸውም ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ያመጡአቸውን ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.text_english: But when Jesus saw , he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን አይቶ ተቈጣና። ሕፃናትን ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉ አትከልክሉአቸው፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he took them up in his arms, put hands upon them, and blessed them.
verses.text_amharic: አቀፋቸውም እጁንም ጭኖ ባረካቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በመንገድ ሲወጣ አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ሮጦ ተንበረከከለትና። ቸር መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘላለም ሕይወትን እወርስ ዘንድ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none good but one, , God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ስለ ምን ቸር ትለኛለህ? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ቸር ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛትን ታውቃለህ፤ አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥ አታታልል፥ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህን ሁሉ ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ተመልክቶ ወደደውና። አንድ ነገር ጐደለህ፤ ሂድ፥ ያለህን ሁሉ ሽጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ፥ መስቀሉንም ተሸክመህ ና፥ ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ነገር ፊቱ ጠቈረ፥ ብዙ ንብረት ነበረውና እያዘነም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ አይቶ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። ገንዘብ ላላቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ይሆናል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም እነዚህን ቃሎች አደነቁ። ኢየሱስም ደግሞ መልሶ። ልጆች ሆይ፥ በገንዘብ ለሚታመኑ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ባለ ጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ቢያልፍ ይቀላል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ያለ መጠን ተገረሙና እርስ በርሳቸው። እንግዲያ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ተመለከታቸውና። ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንጂ በሰው ዘንድ አይቻልም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሁሉ ይቻላልና አለ።

verses.text_english: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ ይለው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ እኔና ስለ ወንጌል ቤትን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ፥

verses.text_english: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን በዚህ ዘመን ከስደት ጋር ቤቶችን ወንድሞችንና እኅቶችንም እናቶችንም ልጆችንም እርሻንም መቶ እጥፍ፥ በሚመጣውም ዓለም የዘላለም ሕይወት የማይቀበል ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: But many first shall be last; and the last first.
verses.text_amharic: ግን ብዙ ፊተኞች ኋለኞች ኋለኞችም ፊተኞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሊወጡ በመንገድ ነበሩ፥ ኢየሱስም ይቀድማቸው ነበርና ተደነቁ፤ የተከተሉትም ይፈሩ ነበር። ደግሞም አሥራ ሁለቱን ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ ይደርስበት ዘንድ ያለውን ይነግራቸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: , Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ የሰው ልጅም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለጻፎች አልፎ ይሰጣል፥ የሞት ፍርድም ይፈርዱበታል፥ ለአሕዛብም አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል፥

verses.text_english: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.text_amharic: ይዘብቱበትማል ይተፉበትማል ይገርፉትማል ይገድሉትማል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
verses.text_amharic: የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። መምህር ሆይ፥ የምንለምንህን ሁሉ እንድታደርግልን እንወዳለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ምን ላደርግላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። በክብርህ ጊዜ አንዳችን በቀኝ አንዳችንም በግራህ መቀመጥን ስጠን አሉት።

verses.text_english: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። የምትለምኑትን አታውቁም። እኔ የምጠጣውን ጽዋ ልትጠጡ፥ እኔ የምጠመቀውንስ ጥምቀት ልትጠመቁ ትችላላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እንችላለን አሉት። ኢየሱስም። እኔ የምጠጣውን ጽዋ ትጠጣላችሁ፥ እኔ የምጠመቀውንም ጥምቀት ትጠመቃላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but for whom it is prepared.
verses.text_amharic: በቀኝና በግራ መቀመጥ ግን ለተዘጋጀላቸው ነው እንጂ የምሰጥ እኔ አይደለሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when the ten heard , they began to be much displeased with James and John.
verses.text_amharic: አሥሩም ሰምተው በያዕቆብና በዮሐንስ ይቈጡ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: But Jesus called them , and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የአሕዛብ አለቆች ተብሎ የምታስቡት እንዲገዙአቸው ታላላቆቻቸውም በላያቸው እንዲሠለጥኑ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተስ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ማንም ከእናንተ ታላቅ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ አገልጋይ ይሁን፥

verses.text_english: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም ማንም ፊተኛ ሊሆን የሚወድ የሁሉ ባሪያ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ የሰው ልጅም ሊያገለግልና ነፍሱን ለብዙዎች ቤዛ ሊሰጥ እንጂ እንዲያገለግሉት አልመጣም።

verses.text_english: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢያሪኮም መጡ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቱና ከብዙ ሕዝብ ጋር ከኢያሪኮ ሲወጣ የጤሜዎስ ልጅ ዕውሩ በርጤሜዎስ እየለመነ በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.text_amharic: የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስም እንደ ሆነ በሰማ ጊዜ። የዳዊት ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ ይጮኽ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙዎችም ዝም እንዲል ገሠጹት፤ እርሱ ግን። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ አብዝቶ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ቆመና። ጥሩት አለ። ዕውሩንም። አይዞህ፥ ተነሣ፥ ይጠራሃል ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.text_english: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እየዘለለ ተነሣና ልብሱን ጥሎ ወደ ኢየሱስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ምን ላደርግልህ ትወዳለህ? አለው። ዕውሩም። መምህር ሆይ፥ አይ ዘንድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሂድ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው። ወዲያውም አየ በመንገድም ተከተለው።

verses.text_english: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ከደብረ ዘይት አጠገብ ወዳሉቱ ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ልኮ።

verses.text_english: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring .
verses.text_amharic: በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወዲያውም ወደ እርስዋ ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፤ ፈትታችሁ አምጡልኝ።

verses.text_english: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም። ስለ ምን እንዲህ ታደርጋላችሁ? ቢላችሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉት፥ ወዲያውም ደግሞ ወደዚህ ይሰደዋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዱም ውርንጫውንም በመንገድ መተላለፊያ በደጅ ውጭ ታስሮ አገኙት፥ ፈቱትም።

verses.text_english: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ከቆሙት አንዳንዶቹ። ውርንጫውን የምትፈቱት ምን ልታደርጉት ነው አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዘ አሉአቸው፤ ተዉአቸውም።

verses.text_english: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ውርንጫውንም ወደ ኢየሱስ አመጡት፥ ልብሳቸውንም በላዩ ጣሉ፥ ተቀመጠበትም።

verses.text_english: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed in the way.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎችም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ፥ ሌሎችም ከዛፍ ቅጠሎችን እየቈረጡ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verses.text_amharic: የሚቀድሙትም የሚከተሉትም። ሆሣዕና፤ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Blessed the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታ ስም የምትመጣ የአባታችን የዳዊት መንግሥት የተባረከች ናት፤ ሆሣዕና በአርያም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ መቅደስ ገባ፤ ዘወር ብሎም ሁሉን ከተመለከተ በኋላ፥ ጊዜው መሽቶ ስለ ነበረ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ጋር ወደ ቢታንያ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱም ከቢታንያ ሲወጡ ተራበ።

verses.text_english: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not .
verses.text_amharic: ቅጠልም ያላት በለስ ከሩቅ አይቶ ምናልባት አንዳች ይገኝባት እንደ ሆነ ብሎ መጣ፥ ነገር ግን የበለስ ወራት አልነበረምና መጥቶ ከቅጠል በቀር ምንም አላገኘባትም።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard .
verses.text_amharic: መልሶም። ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘላለም ማንም ከአንቺ ፍሬ አይብላ አላት። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰሙ።

verses.text_english: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጡ። ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በመቅደስ የሚሸጡትንና የሚገዙትን ያወጣ ጀመር፥ የገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ገበታዎች የርግብ ሻጭዎችንም ወንበሮች ገለበጠ፤

verses.text_english: And would not suffer that any man should carry vessel through the temple.
verses.text_amharic: ዕቃም ተሸክሞ ማንም በመቅደስ ሊያልፍ አልፈቀደም።

verses.text_english: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.text_amharic: አስተማራቸውም። ቤቴ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የጸሎት ቤት ትባላለች ተብሎ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? እናንተ ግን የወንበዶች ዋሻ አደረጋችኋት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the scribes and chief priests heard , and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም ጻፎችም ሰምተው፥ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በትምህርቱ ይገረሙ ስለ ነበር ይፈሩት ነበርና እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ፈለጉ።

verses.text_english: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
verses.text_amharic: ማታ ማታም ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ ይወጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳም ሲያልፉ በለሲቱን ከሥርዋ ደርቃ አዩአት።

verses.text_english: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ትዝ ብሎት። መምህር ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ የረገምሃት በለስ ደርቃለች አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ።

verses.text_english: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ማንም ያለው ነገር እንዲደረግለት ቢያምን በልቡ ሳይጠራጠር፥ ይህን ተራራ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተወርወር ቢል ይሆንለታል።

verses.text_english: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive , and ye shall have .
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ የጸለያችሁትን የለመናችሁትንም ሁሉ እንዳገኛችሁት እመኑ፥ ይሆንላችሁማል።

verses.text_english: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
verses.text_amharic: ለጸሎትም በቆማችሁ ጊዜ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ደግሞ ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር እንዲላችሁ፥ በማንም ላይ አንዳች ቢኖርባችሁ ይቅር በሉት።

verses.text_english: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ይቅር ባትሉ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁም ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር አይላችሁም።

verses.text_english: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ። እርሱም በመቅደስ ሲመላለስ፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ሽማግሌዎችም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው።

verses.text_english: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን ታደርጋለህ? ወይስ እነዚህን ለማድረግ ይህን ሥልጣን ማን ሰጠህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔም አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም መልሱልኝ፥ እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ እነግራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The baptism of John, was from heaven, or of men? answer me.
verses.text_amharic: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከሰማይ ነበረችን ወይስ ከሰው? መልሱልኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ነው ብንል። እንግዲያውስ ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.text_english: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። ከሰው ነው እንበልን? አሉ፤ ሁሉ ዮሐንስን በእውነት እንደ ነቢይ ያዩት ነበርና ሕዝቡን ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_amharic: ለኢየሱስም መልሰው። አናውቅም አሉት ኢየሱስም። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about , and digged the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.text_amharic: በምሳሌም ይነግራቸው ጀመር። አንድ ሰው የወይን አትክልት ተከለ፥ ቅጥርም ቀጠረለት፥ መጥመቂያም ማሰለት፥ ግንብም ሠራና ለገበሬዎች አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: በጊዜውም ከወይን አትክልት ፍሬ ከገበሬዎቹ እንዲቀበል አንድ ባሪያ ወደ ገበሬዎቹ ላከ፤

verses.text_english: And they caught , and beat him, and sent away empty.
verses.text_amharic: ይዘውም ደበደቡት ባዶውንም ሰደዱት።

verses.text_english: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded in the head, and sent away shamefully handled.
verses.text_amharic: ዳግመኛም ሌላውን ባሪያ ወደ እነርሱ ላከ እርሱንም ወግረው ራሱን አቈሰሉት አዋርደውም ሰደዱት።

verses.text_english: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውንም ላከ፤ እርሱንም ገደሉት፥ ከሌሎችም ከብዙዎች አንዳንዱን ደበደቡ አንዳንዱንም ገደሉ።

verses.text_english: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.text_amharic: የሚወደው አንድ ልጅ ገና ነበረው፤ ልጄንስ ያፍሩታል ብሎ እርሱን ከሁሉ በኋላ ወደ እነርሱ ላከ።

verses.text_english: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያ ገበሬዎች ግን እርስ በርሳቸው። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ኑ፥ እንግደለው፥ ርስቱም ለኛ ይሆናል ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And they took him, and killed , and cast out of the vineyard.
verses.text_amharic: ይዘውም ገደሉት፥ ከወይኑም አትክልት ወደ ውጭ ጣሉት።

verses.text_english: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ ምን ያደርጋል? ይመጣል ገበሬዎቹንም ያጠፋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ለሌሎች ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀዋልና ሊይዙት ፈለጉ፥ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ። ትተውትም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.text_amharic: በንግግርም ሊያጠምዱት ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሄሮድስ ወገን የሆኑትን ወደ እርሱ ላኩ።

verses.text_english: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in words.
verses.text_amharic: መጥተውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ የሰውን ፊት ሳትመለከት በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ታስተምራለህና እውነተኛ እንደ ሆንህ ለማንምም እንዳታደላ እናውቃለን፤ ለቄሣር ግብር መስጠት ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? እንስጥን ወይስ አንስጥ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ግብዝነታቸውን አውቆ። ለምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ? አየው ዘንድ አንድ ዲናር አምጡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see .
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም አመጡለት። ይህች መልክ ጽሕፈቲቱስ የማን ናት? አላቸው፤ እነርሱም። የቄሣር ናት አሉት።

verses.text_english: And they brought . And he saith unto them, Whose this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው። በእርሱም ተደነቁ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.text_amharic: ትንሣኤ ሙታን የለም የሚሉ ሰዱቃውያን ወደ እርሱ መጥተው ጠየቁት እንዲህም አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.text_amharic: መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ። የአንድ ሰው ወንድም ሚስቱን ትቶ ልጅ ሳያስቀር ቢሞት፥ ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ ብሎ ጻፈልን።

verses.text_english: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave wife , and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ወንድማማቾች ነበሩ፤ ፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ዘር ሳያስቀር ሞተ፤

verses.text_english: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም አገባት፥ ዘርም ሳይተው ሞተ፤ ሦስተኛውም እንዲሁ፤

verses.text_english: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱም አገቡአት፥ ዘርም አላስቀሩም። ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.text_english: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱ አግብተዋታልና በትንሣኤ ቀን ሲነሡ ከእነርሱ ለማናቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.text_english: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መጻሕፍትንና የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል አታውቁምና ስለዚህ የምትስቱ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.text_amharic: ከሙታንስ ሲነሡ በሰማያት እንዳሉ መላእክት ይሆናሉ እንጂ አያገቡም፥ አይጋቡምም።

verses.text_english: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሙታን ግን እንዲነሡ እግዚአብሔር። እኔ የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ነኝ እንዳለው በሙሴ መጽሐፍ በቍጥቋጦው ዘንድ የተጻፈውን አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.text_english: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.text_amharic: የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም። እንግዲህ እጅግ ትስታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.text_amharic: ከጻፎችም አንዱ ቀርቦ ሲከራከሩ ሰማና መልካም አድርጎ እንደ መለሰላቸው አስተውሎ። ከሁሉ ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ማናቸይቱ ናት? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። ከትእዛዛቱ ሁሉ ፊተኛይቱ። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ጌታ አምላካችን አንድ ጌታ ነው፥

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments , Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.text_amharic: አንተም በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹምም ነፍስህ በፍጹምም አሳብህ በፍጹምም ኃይልህ ጌታ አምላክህን ውደድ የምትል ናት። ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ይህች ናት።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this the first commandment.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛይቱም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ የምትል እርስዋን የምትመስል ይህች ናት። ከእነዚህ የምትበልጥ ሌላ ትእዛዝ የለችም።

verses.text_english: And the second like, this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.text_amharic: ጻፊውም። መልካም ነው፥ መምህር ሆይ፤ አንድ ነው ከእርሱም በቀር ሌላ የለም ብለህ በእውነት ተናገርህ፤

verses.text_english: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.text_amharic: በፍጹም ልብ በፍጹም አእምሮም በፍጹም ነፍስም በፍጹም ኃይልም እርሱን መውደድ፥ ባልንጀራንም እንደ ራስ መውደድ በሙሉ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ከሌላው መሥዋዕት ሁሉ የሚበልጥ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በአእምሮ እንደ መለሰ አይቶ። አንተ ከእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የራቅህ አይደለህም አለው። ከዚህም በኋላ ማንም ሊጠይቀው አልደፈረም።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him .
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ጻፎች ክርስቶስ የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊት ራሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው አለ።

verses.text_english: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም ራሱ ጌታ አለው፤ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል? ብዙ ሕዝብም በደስታ ይሰሙት ነበር።

verses.text_english: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.text_amharic: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ።

verses.text_english: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በመዝገብ አንጻር ተቀምጦ ሕዝቡ በመዝገብ ውስጥ ገንዘብ እንዴት እንዲጥሉ ያይ ነበር፤ ብዙ ባለ ጠጎችም ብዙ ይጥሉ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.text_amharic: አንዲትም ድሀ መበለት መጥታ አንድ ሳንቲም የሚያህሉ ሁለት ናስ ጣለች።

verses.text_english: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም ጠርቶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በመዝገብ ውስጥ ከሚጥሉት ሁሉ ይልቅ ይህች ድሀ መበለት አብልጣ ጣለች፤

verses.text_english: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ጥለዋልና፥ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ሁሉ ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings !
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ከመቅደስ ሲወጣ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ እንዴት ያሉ ድንጋይዎችና እንዴት ያሉ ሕንጻዎች እንደ ሆኑ እይ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እነዚህን ታላላቅ ሕንጻዎች ታያለህን? ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ አይቀርም አለው።

verses.text_english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስም ትይዩ በደብረ ዘይት ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ ጴጥሮስና ያዕቆብ ዮሐንስም እንድርያስም።

verses.text_english: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.text_amharic: ንገረን፥ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? ይህስ ሁሉ ይፈጸም ዘንድ እንዳለው ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ለብቻቸው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any deceive you:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ ይላቸው ጀመር። ማንም እንዳያስታችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am ; and shall deceive many.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙዎች። እኔ ነኝ እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፥ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ።

verses.text_english: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for must needs be; but the end not yet.
verses.text_amharic: ጦርንም የጦርንም ወሬ በሰማችሁ ጊዜ አትደንግጡ፤ ይህ ሊሆን ግድ ነውና፥ ነገር ግን መጨረሻው ገና ነው።

verses.text_english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣልና፤ በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ የምድር መናወጥ ይሆናል፤ ራብ ይሆናል፤ እነዚህ የምጥ ጣር መጀመሪያ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ወደ ሸንጎ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል በምኵራብም ትገረፋላችሁ ምስክርም ይሆንባቸው ዘንድ ስለ እኔ በገዥዎችና በነገሥታት ፊት ትቆማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞም ወንጌል ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበክ ዘንድ ይገባል።

verses.text_english: But when they shall lead , and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ሲጐትቱአችሁና አሳልፈው ሲሰጡአችሁም ምን እንድትናገሩ አስቀድማችሁ አትጨነቁ፥ ዳሩ ግን በዚያች ሰዓት የሚሰጣችሁን ተናገሩ፤ የሚነግረው መንፈስ ቅዱስ ነው እንጂ እናንተ አይደላችሁምና።

verses.text_english: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድምም ወንድሙን አባትም ልጁን ለሞት አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ልጆችም በወላጆቻቸው ላይ ይነሣሉ። ይገድሉአቸውማል፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall be hated of all for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: በሁሉም ዘንድ ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ፤ እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.text_english: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በነቢዩ በዳንኤል የተባለውን የጥፋት ርኵሰት በማይገባው ስፍራ ቆሞ ብታዩ፥ አንባቢው ያስተውል፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉ ወደ ተራሮች ይሽሹ፥

verses.text_english: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter , to take any thing out of his house:
verses.text_amharic: በሰገነትም ያለ ወደ ቤት አይውረድ ከቤቱም አንዳች ይወስድ ዘንድ አይግባ፥

verses.text_english: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሻም ያለ ልብሱን ይወስድ ዘንድ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.text_english: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ወራትም ለርጉዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው።

verses.text_english: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሽሽታችሁ በክረምት እንዳይሆን ጸልዩ፤

verses.text_english: For those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ወራት እግዚአብሔር ከፈጠረው ከፍጥረት መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ያልሆነ ደግሞም የማይሆን የመከራ ዓይነት ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታስ ወራቶቹን ባያሳጥር፥ ሥጋ የለበሰ ሁሉ ባልዳነም፤ ነገር ግን ስለ መረጣቸው ምርጦች ወራቶቹን አሳጠረ።

verses.text_english: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here Christ; or, lo, there; believe not:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ማንም። እነሆ፥ ክርስቶስ ከዚህ አለ፥ ወይም። እነሆ፥ ከዚያ አለ ቢላችሁ አትመኑ፤

verses.text_english: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if possible, even the elect.
verses.text_amharic: ሐሰተኞች ክርስቶሶችና ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ይነሣሉና፥ ቢቻላቸውስ የተመረጡትን እንኳ ያስቱ ዘንድ ምልክትና ድንቅ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.text_english: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ተጠንቀቁ፤ እነሆ፥ አስቀድሜ ሁሉን ነገርኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ወራት ግን ከዚያ መከራ በኋላ ፀሐይ ይጨልማል ጨረቃም ብርሃንዋን አትሰጥም፥

verses.text_english: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.text_amharic: ከዋክብትም ከሰማይ ይወድቃሉ፥ የሰማያትም ኃይላት ይናወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ በብዙ ኃይልና ክብር በደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል።
