verses.text_english: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም መላእክትን ይልካል ከአራቱ ነፋሳትም ከምድር ዳርቻ እስከ ሰማይ ዳርቻ የተመረጡትን ይሰበስባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌውንም ከበለስ ተማሩ፤ ጫፍዋ ሲለሰልስ ቅጠልዋም ሲያቈጠቍጥ፥ ያን ጊዜ በጋ እንደ ቀረበ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, at the doors.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ ይህን ሁሉ መሆኑን ስታዩ ቀርቦ በደጅ እንደ ሆነ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።

verses.text_english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.text_english: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚያች ቀን ወይም ስለዚያች ሰዓት ግን የሰማይ መላእክትም ቢሆኑ ልጅም ቢሆን ከአባት በቀር የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.text_english: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.text_amharic: ጊዜው መቼ እንዲሆን አታውቁምና ተጠንቀቁ፤ ትጉ፤ ጸልዩም።

verses.text_english: as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.text_amharic: ቤቱን ትቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር እንደ ሄደ ሰው ነው፥ ለባሮቹም ሥልጣን ለእያንዳንዱም ሥራውን ሰጥቶ በረኛውን እንዲተጋ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በማታ ቢሆን ወይም በእኩለ ሌሊት ወይም ዶሮ ሲጮኽ ወይም በማለዳ ቢሆን ባለቤቱ መቼ እንዲመጣ አታውቁምና

verses.text_english: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገት መጥቶ ተኝታችሁ እንዳያገኛችሁ ስለዚህ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተም የምነግራችሁ ለሁሉ እላለሁ፤ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: After two days was the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ፋሲካና የቂጣ በዓል ነበረ። የካህናት አለቆችም ጻፎችም እንዴት አድርገው በተንኰል እንደሚይዙትና እንደሚገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But they said, Not on the feast , lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.text_amharic: የሕዝብ ሁከት እንዳይሆን በበዓል አይሁን ይሉ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured on his head.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በቢታንያ በለምጻሙ በስምዖን ቤት በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ አንዲት ሴት ዋጋው እጅግ የከበረ ጥሩ ናርዶስ ሽቱ የመላበት የአልባስጥሮስ ቢልቃጥ ይዛ መጣች፤ ቢልቃጡንም ሰብራ በራሱ ላይ አፈሰሰችው።

verses.text_english: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶችም። ይህ የሽቱ ጥፋት ለምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሽቱ ከሦስት መቶ ዲናር በሚበልጥ ዋጋ ተሽጦ ለድሆች ሊሰጥ ይቻል ነበርና ብለው በራሳቸው ይቈጡ ነበር፤ እርስዋንም ነቀፉአት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን እንዲህ አለ። ተዉአት፤ ስለ ምን ታደክሙአታላችሁ? መልካም ሥራ ሠርታልኛለች።

verses.text_english: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
verses.text_amharic: ድሆች ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ይኖራሉና፥ በማናቸውም በወደዳችሁት ጊዜ መልካም ልታደርጉላቸው ትችላላችሁ፥ እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር አልኖርም።

verses.text_english: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.text_amharic: የተቻላትን አደረገች፤ አስቀድማ ለመቃብሬ ሥጋዬን ቀባችው።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ወንጌል በዓለሙ ሁሉ በሚሰበክበት በማናቸውም ስፍራ፥ እርስዋ ያደረገችው ደግሞ ለእርስዋ መታሰቢያ ሊሆን ይነገራል።

verses.text_english: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሥራ ሁለቱም አንዱ የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ አሳልፎ ሊሰጠው ወደ ካህናት አለቆች ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And when they heard , they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሰሙም ደስ አላቸው ብርም ይሰጡት ዘንድ ተስፋ ሰጡት። በሚመች ጊዜም እንዴት አድርጎ አሳልፎ እንዲሰጠው ይፈልግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
verses.text_amharic: ፋሲካን በሚያርዱበት በቂጣ በዓል መጀመሪያ ቀን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ፋሲካን ትበላ ዘንድ ወዴት ሄደን ልናሰናዳ ትወዳለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሁለት ላከ እንዲህም አላቸው። ወደ ከተማ ሂዱ፥ ማድጋ ውኃ የተሸከመ ሰውም ይገናኛችኋል፤

verses.text_english: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.text_amharic: ተከተሉት፥ የሚገባበትንም የቤቱን ጌታ። መምህሩ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ፋሲካን የምበላበት የእንግዳ ቤት ወዴት ነው? ይላል በሉት።

verses.text_english: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በደርብ ላይ ያለውን የተሰናዳና የተነጠፈ ታላቅ አዳራሽ ያሳያችኋል፤

verses.text_english: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም አሰናዱልን። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወጡ ወደ ከተማም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ፥ ፋሲካንም አሰናዱ።

verses.text_english: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ጋር መጣ።

verses.text_english: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀምጠውም ሲበሉ ኢየሱስ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ አንዱ፥ እርሱም ከእኔ ጋር የሚበላው አሳልፎ ይሰጠኛል አለ።

verses.text_english: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, it I? and another it I?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ያዝኑ፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም። እኔ እሆንን? ይሉት ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto them, one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ወጭቱ እጁን የሚያጠልቀው ነው።

verses.text_english: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅስ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይሄዳል፤ ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት፤ ያ ሰው ባልተወለደ ይሻለው ነበር አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake , and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.text_amharic: ሲበሉም ኢየሱስ እንጀራን አንሥቶ ባረከ ቈርሶም ሰጣቸውና። እንካችሁ፤ ይህ ሥጋዬ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.text_amharic: ጽዋንም አንሥቶ አመስግኖም ሰጣቸው፥ ሁሉም ከእርሱ ጠጡ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ይህ ስለ ብዙዎች የሚፈስ የአዲስ ኪዳን ደሜ ነው።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከወይኑ ፍሬ አዲሱን እስከምጠጣበት እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ደግሞ አልጠጣውም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.text_amharic: መዝሙርም ከዘመሩ በኋላ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። በዚች ሌሊት ሁላችሁ በእኔ ትሰናከላላችሁ፤ እረኛዉን እመታለሁ በጎችም ይበተናሉ የሚል ተጽፎአልና።

verses.text_english: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከተነሣሁ በኋላ ወደ ገሊላ እቀድማችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet not I.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። ሁሉም ቢሰናከሉ እኔ ግን ከቶ አልሰናከልም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ዛሬ በዚች ሌሊት ዶሮ ሁለት ጊዜ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ቃሉን አበርትቶ። ከአንተ ጋር የምሞት እንኳ ቢሆን ከቶ አልክድህም አለ። ሁሉም ደግሞ እንደዚሁ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
verses.text_amharic: ጌቴሴማኒ ወደምትባልም ስፍራ መጡ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም። ስጸልይ ሳለሁ፥ በዚህ ተቀመጡ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ዮሐንስንም ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፤ ሊደነግጥም ሊተክዝም ጀመረና።

verses.text_english: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ እስከ ሞት ድረስ እጅግ አዘነች፤ በዚህ ቈዩ ትጉም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂትም ወደ ፊት እልፍ ብሎ በምድርም ወድቆ፥ ይቻልስ ቢሆን ሰዓቲቱ ከእርሱ እንድታልፍ ጸለየና።

verses.text_english: And he said, Abba, Father, all things possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verses.text_amharic: አባ አባት ሆይ፥ ሁሉ ይቻልሃል፤ ይህችን ጽዋ ከእኔ ውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን አንተ የምትወደው እንጂ እኔ የምወደው አይሁን አለ።

verses.text_english: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
verses.text_amharic: መጣም ተኝተውም አገኛቸው፥ ጴጥሮስንም። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ተኝተሃልን? አንዲት ሰዓት ስንኳ ልትተጋ አልቻልህምን?

verses.text_english: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly ready, but the flesh weak.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ትጉ ጸልዩም፤ መንፈስስ ተዘጋጅታለች፥ ሥጋ ግን ደካማ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሄዶ ያንኑ ቃል ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም መጥቶ ዓይኖቻቸው በእንቅልፍ ከብደው ነበርና ተኝተው አገኛቸው፥ የሚመልሱለትንም አላወቁም።

verses.text_english: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛም መጥቶ። እንግዲህስ ተኙ ዕረፉም፤ ይበቃል፤ ሰዓቲቱ ደረሰች፤ እነሆ፥ የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.text_english: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሡ፥ እንሂድ፤ እነሆ፥ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ ቀርቦአል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ገና ሲናገር ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ይሁዳ መጣ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ብዙ ሰዎች ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዘው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከጻፎች ከሽማግሌዎችም ዘንድ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead away safely.
verses.text_amharic: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም። የምስመው እርሱ ነው፤ ያዙት ተጠንቅቃችሁም ውሰዱት ብሎ ምልክት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: መጥቶም ወዲያው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበና። መምህር ሆይ፥ መምህር ሆይ፥ ብሎ ሳመው፤

verses.text_english: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም እጃቸውን በእርሱ ላይ ጭነው ያዙት።

verses.text_english: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገብ ከቆሙት ግን አንዱ ሰይፉን መዞ የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መታ ጆሮውንም ቈረጠ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves to take me?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ወንበዴ እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ልትይዙኝ መጣችሁን?

verses.text_english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት እያስተማርሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ስኖር አልያዛችሁኝም፤ ነገር ግን መጻሕፍት ይፈጸሙ ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ትተውት ሸሹ።

verses.text_english: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about naked ; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.text_amharic: ዕርቃኑን በነጠላ የሸፈነ አንድ ጎበዝ ይከተለው ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.text_amharic: ጎበዛዝቱም ያዙት፤ እርሱ ግን ነጠላውን ትቶ ዕራቁቱን ሸሸ።

verses.text_english: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወሰዱት፥ የካህናት አለቆችም ሁሉ ሽማግሌዎችም ጻፎችም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም እስከ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ግቢ ውስጥ በሩቁ ተከተለው፥ ከሎሌዎችም ጋር ተቀምጦ እሳት ይሞቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም ሸንጎውም ሁሉ እንዲገድሉት በኢየሱስ ላይ ምስክር ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ አላገኙምም፤

verses.text_english: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙዎች በሐሰት ይመሰክሩበት ነበርና፥ ምስክርነታቸው ግን አልተሰማማም።

verses.text_english: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክርነታቸውም እንዲሁ እንኳ አልተሰማማም።

verses.text_english: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናቱም በመካከላቸው ተነሥቶ። አንዳች አትመልስምን? እነዚህስ በአንተ ላይ የሚመሰክሩብህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ኢየሱስን ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what these witness against thee?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ዝም አለ አንዳችም አልመለሰም። ደግሞ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ጠየቀውና። የቡሩክ ልጅ ክርስቶስ አንተ ነህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔ ነኝ፤ የሰው ልጅም በኃይል ቀኝ ሲቀመጥ በሰማይም ደመና ሲመጣ ታያላችሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ልብሱን ቀደደና። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምስክሮችን ምን ያስፈልገናል?

verses.text_english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
verses.text_amharic: ስድቡን ሰማችሁ፤ ምን ይመስላችኋል? አለ። እነርሱም ሁሉ። ሞት ይገባዋል ብለው ፈረዱበት።

verses.text_english: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶችም ይተፉበት ፊቱንም ሸፍነው ይጐስሙትና። ትንቢት ተናገር ይሉት ጀመር፤ ሎሌዎችም በጥፊ እየመቱ ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም በግቢ ውስጥ ወደ ታች ሳለ ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ገረዶች አንዲቱ መጣች፥

verses.text_english: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም እሳት ሲሞቅ አይታ ተመለከተችውና። አንተ ደግሞ ከናዝሬቱ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ነበርህ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። የምትዪውን አላውቅም አላስተውልምም ብሎ ካደ። ወደ ውጭም ወደ ደጅ ወጣ፤ ዶሮም ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
verses.text_amharic: ገረዲቱም አይታው በዚያ ለቆሙት። ይህም ከእነርሱ ወገን ነው ስትል ሁለተኛ ትነግራቸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is of them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ደግሞ ካደ። ጥቂት ቈይተውም በዚያ የቆሙት ዳግመኛ ጴጥሮስን። የገሊላ ሰው ነህና ከእነርሱ ወገን በእውነት ነህ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth .
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ይህን የምትሉትን ሰው አላውቀውም ብሎ ይረገምና ይምል ጀመር። ወዲያውም ዶሮ ሁለተኛ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: But he began to curse and to swear, , I know not this man of whom ye speak.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስንም ኢየሱስ። ዶሮ ሁለት ጊዜ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ ያለው ቃል ትዝ አለው፤ ነገሩንም አስቦ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried away, and delivered to Pilate.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ማለዳ የካህናት አለቆች ከሽማግሌዎችና ከጻፎች ከሸንጎውም ሁሉ ጋር ከተማከሩ በኋላ፥ ኢየሱስን አሳስረው ወሰዱትና ለጲላጦስ አሳልፈው ሰጡት።

verses.text_english: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest .
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። አንተ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም። አንተ አልህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም ብዙ ያሳጡት ነበር፤ እርሱ ግን ምንም አልመለሰም።

verses.text_english: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ደግሞ። አንዳች አትመልስምን? እነሆ፥ በስንት ነገር ያሳጡሃል ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ በኋላ ጲላጦስ እስኪደነቅ ድረስ ምንም አልመለሰም።

verses.text_english: Now at feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በዓል የለመኑትን አንድ እስረኛ ይፈታላቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was named Barabbas, bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
verses.text_amharic: በዓመፅም ነፍስ ከገደሉት ከዓመፀኞች ጋር የታሰረ በርባን የተባለ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire as he had ever done unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ወጥተው እንደ ልማዱ ያደርግላቸው ዘንድ እየጮኹ ይለምኑት ጀመር።

verses.text_english: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። የአይሁድን ንጉሥ እፈታላችሁ ዘንድ ትወዳላችሁን? ብሎ መለሰላቸው፤

verses.text_english: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆች በቅንዓት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡት ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆች ግን በርባንን በእርሱ ፈንታ ይፈታላቸው ዘንድ ሕዝቡን አወኩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do whom ye call the King of the Jews?
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ዳግመኛ መልሶ። እንግዲህ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ የምትሉትን ምን ላደርገው ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዳግመኛ። ስቀለው እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። ምን ነው? ያደረገው ክፋት ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱ ግን። ስቀለው እያሉ ጩኸት አበዙ።

verses.text_english: And Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged , to be crucified.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም የሕዝቡን ፈቃድ ሊያደርግ ወዶ በርባንን ፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስንም ገርፎ እንዲሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
verses.text_amharic: ወታደሮችም ፕራይቶሪዮን ወደሚባል ግቢ ውስጥ ወሰዱት፥ ጭፍራውንም ሁሉ በአንድነት ጠሩ።

verses.text_english: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his ,
verses.text_amharic: ቀይ ልብስም አለበሱት፥ የእሾህ አክሊልም ጎንጉነው ደፉበት፤

verses.text_english: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.text_amharic: የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን እያሉ እጅ ይነሱት ጀመር፤

verses.text_english: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing knees worshipped him.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱንም በመቃ መቱት ተፉበትም፥ ተንበርክከውም ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
verses.text_amharic: ከተዘባበቱበትም በኋላ ቀዩን ልብስ ገፈፉት፥ ልብሱንም አለበሱት፥ ሊሰቅሉትም ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ መንገድ አላፊም የአሌክስንድሮስና የሩፎስ አባት ስምዖን የተባለ የቀሬና ሰው ከገጠር ሲመጣ መስቀሉን ይሸከም ዘንድ አስገደዱት።

verses.text_english: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
verses.text_amharic: ትርጓሜውም የራስ ቅል ስፍራ ወደሚሆን ጎልጎታ ወደተባለ ስፍራ ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received not.
verses.text_amharic: ከርቤም የተቀላቀለበትን የወይን ጠጅ እንዲጠጣ ሰጡት፤ እርሱ ግን አልተቀበለም።

verses.text_english: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
verses.text_amharic: ሰቀሉትም፥ ልብሱንም ማን ማን እንዲወስድ ዕጣ ተጣጥለው ተካፈሉ።

verses.text_english: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
verses.text_amharic: በሰቀሉትም ጊዜ ሦስት ሰዓት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.text_amharic: የክሱ ጽሕፈትም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ የሚል ተጽፎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት ወንበዶች አንዱን በቀኙ አንዱንም በግራው ሰቀሉ።

verses.text_english: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፍም። ከአመፀኞች ጋር ተቆጠረ ያለው ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest in three days,
verses.text_amharic: የሚያልፉትም ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ ይሰድቡት ነበርና። ዋ፥ ቤተ መቅደስን የምታፈርስ በሦስት ቀንም የምትሠራ፥

verses.text_english: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
verses.text_amharic: ከመስቀል ወርደህ ራስህን አድን አሉ።

verses.text_english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም የካህናት አለቆች ደግሞ ከጻፎች ጋር እርስ በርሳቸው እየተዘባበቱ። ሌሎችን አዳነ፤ ራሱን ሊያድን አይችልም፤

verses.text_english: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
verses.text_amharic: አይተን እናምን ዘንድ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ክርስቶስ አሁን ከመስቀል ይውረድ አሉ። ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰቀሉት ይነቅፉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ሰዓትም በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጨለማ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.text_amharic: በዘጠኝ ሰዓትም ኢየሱስ። ኤሎሄ፥ ኤሎሄ፥ ላማ ሰበቅታኒ? ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ፤ ትርጓሜውም አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ለምን ተውኸኝ? ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: And some of them that stood by, when they heard , said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ከቆሙት ሰዎች ሰምተው። እነሆ፥ ኤልያስን ይጠራል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱም ሮጦ ሆምጣጤ በሰፍነግ ሞላ በመቃም አድርጎ። ተዉ፤ ኤልያስ ሊያወርደው ይመጣ እንደ ሆነ እንይ እያለ አጠጣው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ ነፍሱንም ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.text_amharic: የቤተ መቅደስም መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ከሁለት ተቀደደ።

verses.text_english: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በአንጻሩ የቆመ የመቶ አለቃ እንደዚህ ጮኾ ነፍሱን እንደ ሰጠ ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ ሰው በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበረ አለ።

verses.text_english: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
(Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በመሸ ጊዜ የሰንበት ዋዜማ የሆነ የማዘጋጀት ቀን ስለ ነበረ፥ የከበረ አማካሪ የሆነ የአርማትያስ ዮሴፍ መጣ፥

verses.text_english: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይጠባበቅ ነበር፤ ደፍሮም ወደ ጲላጦስ ገባና የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም አሁኑን እንዴት ሞተ ብሎ ተደነቀ፥ የመቶ አለቃውንም ጠርቶ ከሞተ ቆይቶአልን? ብሎ ጠየቀው፤

verses.text_english: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
verses.text_amharic: ከመቶ አለቃውም ተረድቶ በድኑን ለዮሴፍ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And when he knew of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: በፍታም ገዝቶ አውርዶም በበፍታ ከፈነው ከዓለትም በተወቀረ መቃብር አኖረው፥ በመቃብሩ ደጃፍም ድንጋይ አንከባለለ።

verses.text_english: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: መግደላዊትም ማርያም የዮሳም እናት ማርያም ወዴት እንዳኖሩት ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰንበትም ካለፈ በኋላ መግደላዊት ማርያም የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ሰሎሜም መጥተው ሊቀቡት ሽቱ ገዙ።

verses.text_english: And very early in the morning the first of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳምንቱም በፊተኛው ቀን እጅግ በማለዳ ፀሐይ ከወጣ በኋላ ወደ መቃብር መጡ።

verses.text_english: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ድንጋዩን ከመቃብር ደጃፍ ማን ያንከባልልልናል? ይባባሉ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋዩ እጅግ ትልቅ ነበርና፤ አሻቅበውም አይተው ድንጋዩ ተንከባሎ እንደ ነበር ተመለከቱ።

verses.text_english: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቃብሩም ገብተው ነጭ ልብስ የተጎናጸፈ ጎልማሳ በቀኝ በኩል ተቀምጦ አዩና ደነገጡ።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። አትደንግጡ፤ የተሰቀለውን የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን ትፈልጋላችሁ፤ ተነሥቶአል፥ በዚህ የለም፤ እነሆ እርሱን ያኖሩበት ስፍራ።

verses.text_english: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሄዳችሁ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ለጴጥሮስም። ወደ ገሊላ ይቀድማችኋል፤ እንደ ነገራችሁ በዚያ ታዩታላችሁ ብላችሁ ንገሩአቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any ; for they were afraid.
verses.text_amharic: መንቀጥቀጥና መደንገጥ ይዞአቸው ነበርና ወጥተው ከመቃብር ሸሹ፤ ይፈሩ ነበርና ለማንም አንዳች አልነገሩም። እነርሱም ያዘዛቸውን ሁሉ ለጴጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር ላሉት በአጭሩ ተናገሩ። ከዚህም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ለዘላለም ድኅነት የሆነውን የማይለወጠውን ቅዱስ ወንጌል ከፀሐይ መውጫ እስከ መጥለቂያው ድረስ በእጃቸው ላከው።

verses.text_english: Now when was risen early the first of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳምንቱም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ማልዶ በተነሣ ጊዜ፥ አስቀድሞ ሰባት አጋንንት ላወጣላት ለመግደላዊት ማርያም ታየ።

verses.text_english: she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ሄዳ ከእርሱ ጋር ሆነው ለነበሩት ሲያዝኑና ሲያለቅሱ ሳሉ አወራችላቸው፤

verses.text_english: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሕያው እንደ ሆነ ለእርስዋም እንደ ታያት ሲሰሙ አላመኑም።

verses.text_english: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ከእነርሱ ለሁለቱ ወደ ባላገር ሲሄዱ በመንገድ በሌላ መልክ ተገለጠ፤

verses.text_english: And they went and told unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሄደው ለሌሎቹ አወሩ፤ እነዚያንም ደግሞ አላመኑአቸውም።

verses.text_english: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
verses.text_amharic: ኋላም በማዕድ ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ለአሥራ አንዱ ተገለጠ፥ ተነሥቶም ያዩትን ስላላመኑአቸው አለማመናቸውንና የልባቸውን ጥንካሬ ነቀፈ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ሂዱ ወንጌልንም ለፍጥረት ሁሉ ስበኩ።

verses.text_english: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.text_amharic: ያመነ የተጠመቀም ይድናል፥ ያላመነ ግን ይፈረድበታል።

verses.text_english: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.text_amharic: ያመኑትንም እነዚህ ምልክቶች ይከተሉአቸዋል፤ በስሜ አጋንንትን ያወጣሉ፤ በአዲስ ቋንቋ ይናገራሉ፤ እባቦችን ይይዛሉ፥

verses.text_english: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.text_amharic: የሚገድልም ነገር ቢጠጡ አይጎዳቸውም፤ እጃቸውን በድውዮች ላይ ይጭናሉ እነርሱም ይድናሉ።

verses.text_english: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ኢየሱስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ከተናገረ በኋላ ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ በእግዚአብሔርም ቀኝ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with , and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወጥተው በየስፍራው ሁሉ ሰበኩ፥ ጌታም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሠራ ነበር፥ በሚከተሉትም ምልክቶች ቃሉን ያጸና ነበር።

verses.text_english: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.text_amharic: የከበርህ ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያው በዓይን ያዩትና የቃሉ አገልጋዮች የሆኑት እንዳስተላለፉልን፥

verses.text_english: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name Elisabeth.
verses.text_amharic: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም በጌታ ትእዛዝና ሕግጋት ሁሉ ያለ ነቀፋ እየሄዱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቃን ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were well stricken in years.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳቤጥም መካን ነበረችና ልጅ አልነበራቸውም፤ ሁለቱም በዕድሜያቸው አርጅተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በክፍሉ ተራ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሲያገለግል፥

verses.text_english: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ካህናት ሥርዓት ወደ ጌታ ቤተ መቅደስ ገብቶ ለማጠን ዕጣ ደረሰበት።

verses.text_english: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.text_amharic: በዕጣንም ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በውጭ ቆመው ይጸልዩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታም መልአክ በዕጣኑ መሠዊያ ቀኝ ቆሞ ታየው።

verses.text_english: And when Zacharias saw , he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ዘካርያስም ባየው ጊዜ ደነገጠ፥ ፍርሃትም ወደቀበት።

verses.text_english: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም እንዲህ አለው። ዘካርያስ ሆይ፥ ጸሎትህ ተሰምቶልሃልና አትፍራ ሚስትህ ኤልሳቤጥም ወንድ ልጅ ትወልድልሃለች፥ ስሙንም ዮሐንስ ትለዋለህ።

verses.text_english: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.text_amharic: ደስታና ተድላም ይሆንልሃል፥ በመወለዱም ብዙዎች ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታ ፊት ታላቅ ይሆናልና፥ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክር መጠጥ አይጠጣም፤ ገናም በእናቱ ማኅፀን ሳለ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይሞላበታል፤

verses.text_english: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ብዙዎችን ወደ ጌታ ወደ አምላካቸው ይመልሳል።

verses.text_english: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የተዘጋጁትን ሕዝብ ለጌታ እንዲያሰናዳ፥ የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆች የማይታዘዙትንም ወደ ጻድቃን ጥበብ ይመልስ ዘንድ በኤልያስ መንፈስና ኃይል በፊቱ ይሄዳል።

verses.text_english: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.text_amharic: ዘካርያስም መልአኩን። እኔ ሽማግሌ ነኝ ምስቴም በዕድሜዋ አርጅታለችና ይህን በምን አውቃለሁ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም መልሶ። እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የምቆመው ገብርኤል ነኝ፥ እንድናገርህም ይህችንም የምሥራች እንድሰብክልህ ተልኬ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በጊዜው የሚፈጸመውን ቃሌን ስላላመንህ፥ ይህ ነገር እስከሚሆን ቀን ድረስ ዲዳ ትሆናለህ መናገርም አትችልም አለው።

verses.text_english: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ዘካርያስን ይጠብቁት ነበር፤ በቤተ መቅደስም ውስጥ ስለ ዘገየ ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.text_amharic: በወጣም ጊዜ ሊነግራቸው አልቻለም፥ በቤተ መቅደስም ራእይ እንዳየ አስተዋሉ፤ እርሱም ይጠቅሳቸው ነበር፤ ድዳም ሆኖ ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.text_amharic: የማገልገሉም ወራት ሲፈጸም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on , to take away my reproach among men.
verses.text_amharic: በስድስተኛውም ወር መልአኩ ገብርኤል ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ወደ ገሊላ ከተማ፥

verses.text_english: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.text_amharic: ከዳዊት ወገን ለሆነው ዮሴፍ ለሚባል ሰው ወደ ታጨች ወደ አንዲት ድንግል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተላከ፥ የድንግሊቱም ስም ማርያም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name Mary.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም ወደ እርስዋ ገብቶ። ደስ ይበልሽ፥ ጸጋ የሞላብሽ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ከአንቺ ጋር ነው፤ አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ አላት።

verses.text_english: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, highly favoured, the Lord with thee: blessed thou among women.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ባየችው ጊዜ ከንግግሩ በጣም ደነገጠችና። ይህ እንዴት ያለ ሰላምታ ነው? ብላ አሰበች።

verses.text_english: And when she saw , she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም እንዲህ አላት። ማርያም ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጸጋ አግኝተሻልና አትፍሪ።

verses.text_english: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ትፀንሻለሽ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ፥ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ ትዪዋለሽ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ታላቅ ይሆናል የልዑል ልጅም ይባላል፥ ጌታ አምላክም የአባቱን የዳዊትን ዙፋን ይሰጠዋል፤

verses.text_english: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
verses.text_amharic: በያዕቆብ ቤትም ላይ ለዘለላም ይነግሣል፥ ለመንግሥቱም መጨረሻ የለውም።

verses.text_english: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም መልአኩን። ወንድ ስለማላውቅ ይህ እንዴት ይሆናል? አለችው።

verses.text_english: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም መልሶ እንዲህ አላት። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በአንቺ ላይ ይመጣል፥ የልዑልም ኃይል ይጸልልሻል ስለዚህ ደግሞ ከአንቺ የሚወለደው ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም ዘመድሽ ኤልሳቤጥ፥ እርስዋ ደግሞ በእርጅናዋ ወንድ ልጅ ፀንሳለች፥ ለእርስዋም መካን ትባል ለነበረችው ይህ ስድስተኛ ወር ነው፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር የለምና።

verses.text_english: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም። እነሆኝ የጌታ ባሪያ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁንልኝ አለች። መልአኩም ከእርስዋ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም በዚያ ወራት ተነሥታ ወደ ተራራማው አገር ወደ ይሁዳ ከተማ ፈጥና ወጣች፥

verses.text_english: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዘካርያስም ቤት ገብታ ኤልሳቤጥን ተሳለመቻት።

verses.text_english: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልሳቤጥም የማርያምን ሰላምታ በሰማች ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀንዋ ውስጥ ዘለለ፤ በኤልሳቤጥም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባት፥

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኻ እንዲህ አለች። አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ፥ የማኅፀንሽም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው።

verses.text_english: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed thou among women, and blessed the fruit of thy womb.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታዬ እናት ወደ እኔ ትመጣ ዘንድ እንዴት ይሆንልኛል?

verses.text_english: And whence this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ የሰላምታሽ ድምጽ በጆሮዬ በመጣ ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀኔ በደስታ ዘሎአልና።

verses.text_english: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.text_amharic: ከጌታ፤ የተነገረላት ቃል ይፈጸማልና ያመነች ብፅዕት ናት።

verses.text_english: And blessed she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም እንዲህ አለች።

verses.text_english: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴ ጌታን ታከብረዋለች፥ መንፈሴም በአምላኬ በመድኃኒቴ ሐሴት ታደርጋለች፤

verses.text_english: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
verses.text_amharic: የባሪያይቱን ውርደት ተመልክቶአልና። እነሆም፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ትውልድ ሁሉ ብፅዕት ይሉኛል፤

verses.text_english: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.text_amharic: ብርቱ የሆነ እርሱ በእኔ ታላቅ ሥራ አድርጎአልና፤ ስሙም ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.text_english: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy his name.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረቱም ለሚፈሩት እስከ ትውልድና ትውልድ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: And his mercy on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.text_amharic: በክንዱ ኃይል አድርጎአል፤ ትዕቢተኞችን በልባቸው አሳብ በትኖአል፤

verses.text_english: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.text_amharic: ገዥዎችን ከዙፋናቸው አዋርዶአል፤ ትሑታንንም ከፍ አድርጎአል፤

verses.text_english: He hath put down the mighty from seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.text_amharic: የተራቡትን በበጎ ነገር አጥግቦአል፤ ባለ ጠጎችንም ባዶአቸውን ሰዶአቸዋል።

verses.text_english: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of mercy;
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።

verses.text_english: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.text_amharic: የኤልሳቤጥም የመውለጃዋ ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።

verses.text_english: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.text_amharic: ጎረቤቶችዋም ዘመዶችዋም ጌታ ምሕረቱን እንዳገነነላት ሰምተው ከእርስዋ ጋር ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሕፃኑን ሊገርዙት መጡ፥ በአባቱም ስም ዘካርያስ ሊሉት ወደዱ።

verses.text_english: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.text_amharic: እናቱ ግን መልሳ። አይሆንም፥ ዮሐንስ ይባል እንጂ አለች።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ከወገንሽ ማንም በዚህ ስም የተጠራ የለም አሉአት።

verses.text_english: And his mother answered and said, Not ; but he shall be called John.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱንም ማን ሊባል እንዲወድ ጠቀሱት።

verses.text_english: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.text_amharic: ብራናም ለምኖ። ስሙ ዮሐንስ ነው ብሎ ጻፈ። ሁሉም አደነቁ።

verses.text_english: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.text_amharic: ያንጊዜም አፉ ተከፈተ መላሱም ተፈታ እግዚአብሔርንም እየባረከ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verses.text_amharic: ለጎረቤቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ፍርሃት ሆነ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ነገር በይሁዳ በተራራማው አገር ሁሉ ተወራ፤

verses.text_english: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue , and he spake, and praised God.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሙትም ሁሉ። እንኪያ ይህ ሕፃን ምን ይሆን? እያሉ በልባቸው አኖሩት፤ የጌታ እጅ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረችና።

verses.text_english: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ ዘካርያስም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላበትና ትንቢት ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.text_english: And all they that heard laid up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ጌታ አምላክ ይባረክ፥ ጐብኝቶ ለሕዝቡ ቤዛ አድርጎአልና፤

verses.text_english: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
Blessed the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.text_amharic: ማዳኑም ከወደረኞቻችንና ከሚጠሉን ሁሉ እጅ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.text_english: To perform the mercy to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም የኃጢአታቸው ስርየት የሆነውን የመዳን እውቀት ለሕዝቡ ትሰጣለህ፤

verses.text_english: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ከላይ የመጣ ብርሃን በጐበኘበት በአምላካችን ምሕረትና ርኅራኄ ምክንያት ነው፤

verses.text_english: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃኑም በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ተቀምጠው ላሉት ያበራል እግሮቻችንንም በሰላም መንገድ ያቀናል።

verses.text_english: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃኑም አደገ በመንፈስም ጠነከረ፥ ለእስራኤልም እስከ ታየበት ቀን ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት ዓለሙ ሁሉ እንዲጻፍ ከአውግስጦስ ቄሣር ትእዛዝ ወጣች።

verses.text_english: ( this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.text_amharic: ቄሬኔዎስ በሶርያ አገር ገዥ በነበረ ጊዜ ይህ የመጀመሪያ ጽሕፈት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ ይጻፍ ዘንድ ወደ ከተማው ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍም ደግሞ ከዳዊት ቤትና ወገን ስለ ነበረ ከገሊላ ከናዝሬት ከተማ ተነሥቶ ቤተ ልሔም ወደምትባል ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ ወደ ይሁዳ፥ ፀንሳ ከነበረች ከእጮኛው ከማርያም ጋር ይጻፍ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሳሉ የመውለጃዋ ወራት ደረሰ፥

verses.text_english: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.text_amharic: የበኵር ልጅዋንም ወለደች፥ በመጠቅለያም ጠቀለለችው፤ በእንግዶችም ማደሪያ ስፍራ ስላልነበራቸው በግርግም አስተኛችው።

verses.text_english: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ምድር መንጋቸውን በሌሊት ሲጠብቁ በሜዳ ያደሩ እረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ የጌታ መልአክ ወደ እነርሱ ቀረበ የጌታ ክብርም በዙሪያቸው አበራ፥ ታላቅ ፍርሃትም ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ የሚሆን ታላቅ ደስታ የምሥራች እነግራችኋለሁና አትፍሩ፤

verses.text_english: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ በዳዊት ከተማ መድኃኒት እርሱም ክርስቶስ ጌታ የሆነ ተወልዶላችኋልና።

verses.text_english: And this a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል፤ ሕፃን ተጠቅልሎ በግርግምም ተኝቶ ታገኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.text_amharic: ድንገትም ብዙ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ከመልአኩ ጋር ነበሩ። እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑ።

verses.text_english: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.text_amharic: ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር በአርያም ይሁን ሰላምም በምድር ለሰውም በጎ ፈቃድ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.text_amharic: መላእክትም ከእነርሱ ተለይተው ወደ ሰማይ በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እረኞቹ እርስ በርሳቸው። እንግዲህ እስከ ቤተ ልሔም ድረስ እንሂድ እግዚአብሔርም የገለጠልንን ይህን የሆነውን ነገር እንይ ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጥነውም መጡ ማርያምንና ዮሴፍን ሕፃኑንም በግርግም ተኝቶ አገኙ።

verses.text_english: And when they had seen , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.text_amharic: አይተውም ስለዚህ ሕፃን የተነገረላቸውን ነገር ገለጡ።

verses.text_english: And all they that heard wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሙትን ሁሉ እረኞቹ በነገሩአቸው ነገር አደነቁ፤

verses.text_english: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered in her heart.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያም ግን ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ እያሰበች ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞችም እንደ ተባለላቸው ስለ ሰሙትና ስላዩት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.text_amharic: ሊገርዙት ስምንት ቀን በሞላ ጊዜ፥ በማኅፀን ሳይረገዝ በመልአኩ እንደ ተባለ፥ ስሙ ኢየሱስ ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.text_english: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present to the Lord;
(As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሙሴም ሕግ የመንጻታቸው ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጌታ ሕግ። የእናቱን ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ወንድ ሁሉ ለጌታ የተቀደሰ ይባላል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በጌታ ፊት ሊያቆሙት፥ በጌታም ሕግ። ሁለት ዋሊያ ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ጫጩቶች እንደ ተባለ፥ መሥዋዕት ሊያቀርቡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name Simeon; and the same man just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ስምዖን የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፥ ይህም ሰው የእስራኤልን መጽናናት ይጠባበቅ ነበር፤ ጻድቅና ትጉህም ነበረ፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታም የተቀባውን ሳያይ ሞትን እንዳያይ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተረድቶ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስም ወደ መቅደስ ወጣ፤ ወላጆቹም እንደ ሕጉ ልማድ ያደርጉለት ዘንድ ሕፃኑን ኢየሱስን በአስገቡት ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ደግሞ ተቀብሎ አቀፈው እግዚአብሔርንም እየባረከ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.text_english: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሁን እንደ ቃልህ ባሪያህን በሰላም ታሰናብተዋለህ፤

verses.text_english: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ለአሕዛብ ሁሉን የሚገልጥ ብርሃን ለሕዝብህም ለእስራኤል ክብር ነው።

verses.text_english: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍና እናቱም ስለ እርሱ በተባለው ነገር ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.text_amharic: ከአሴር ወገንም የምትሆን የፋኑኤል ልጅ ሐና የምትባል አንዲት ነቢይት ነበረች፤ እርስዋም ከድንግልናዋ ጀምራ ከባልዋ ጋር ሰባት ዓመት ኖረች፤

verses.text_english: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ሰማኒያ አራት ዓመት ያህል መበለት ሆና በጣም አርጅታ ነበር፤ በጾምና በጸሎትም ሌሊትና ቀን እያገለገለች ከመቅደስ አትለይም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ሰዓት ቀርባ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነች፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤዛ ለሚጠባበቁ ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ትናገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And she a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም እንደ ጌታ ሕግ ከፈጸሙ በኋላ፥ ወደ ገሊላ ወደ ከተማቸው ወደ ናዝሬት ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ጥበብም ሞልቶበት በመንፈስ ጠነከረ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ጸጋ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.text_amharic: ወላጆቹም በያመቱ በፋሲካ በዓል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.text_amharic: የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እንደ በዓሉ ሥርዓት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ፤

verses.text_english: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኖቹንም ከፈጸሙ በኋላ፥ ሲመለሱ ብላቴናው ኢየሱስ በኢየሩሳሌም ቀርቶ ነበር፥ ዮሴፍም እናቱም አላወቁም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.text_amharic: ከመንገደኞች ጋር የነበረ ስለ መሰላቸው የአንድ ቀን መንገድ ሄዱ፥ ከዘመዶቻቸውም ከሚያውቋቸውም ዘንድ ፈለጉት፤

verses.text_english: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not .
verses.text_amharic: ባጡትም ጊዜ እየፈለጉት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ በመምህራን መካከል ተቀምጦ ሲሰማቸውም ሲጠይቃቸውም በመቅደስ አገኙት፤

verses.text_english: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሙትም ሁሉ በማስተዋሉና በመልሱ ተገረሙ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.text_amharic: ባዩትም ጊዜ ተገረሙ፥ እናቱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለምን እንዲህ አደረግህብን? እነሆ፥ አባትህና እኔ እየተጨነቅን ስንፈልግህ ነበርን አለችው።

verses.text_english: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ፈለጋችሁኝ? በአባቴ ቤት እሆን ዘንድ እንዲገባኝ አላወቃችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም የተናገራቸውን ነገር አላስተዋሉም።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፥ ይታዘዝላቸውም ነበር። እናቱም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በጥበብና በቁመት በሞገስም በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት ያድግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.text_amharic: ጢባርዮስ ቄሣርም በነገሠ በአሥራ አምስተኛይቱ ዓመት፥ ጴንጤናዊው ጲላጦስም በይሁዳ ሲገዛ፥ ሄሮድስም በገሊላ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ፥ ወንድሙ ፊልጶስም በኢጡርያስ በጥራኮኒዶስም አገር የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ፥ ሊሳኒዮስም በሳቢላኒስ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሆነው ሳሉ፥

verses.text_english: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: ሐናና ቀያፋም ሊቃነ ካህናት ሳሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ ልጅ ወደ ዮሐንስ በምድረ በዳ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways made smooth;
And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.text_amharic: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከእርሱ ሊጠመቁ ለወጡት ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላቸው ነበር። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?

verses.text_english: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ለንስሐ የሚገባ ፍሬ አድርጉ፤ በልባችሁም። አብርሃም አባት አለን ማለትን አትጀምሩ፤ ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆች ሊያስነሣለት እግዚአብሔር እንዲችል እላችኋለሁና።

verses.text_english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ ምሳር ደግሞ በዛፎች ሥር ተቀምጦአል፤ እንግዲህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.text_english: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም። እንግዲህ ምን እናድርግ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.text_amharic: መልሶም። ሁለት ልብስ ያለው ለሌለው ያካፍል፥ ምግብም ያለው እንዲሁ ያድርግ ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.text_amharic: ቀራጮችም ደግሞ ሊጠመቁ መጥተው። መምህር ሆይ፥ ምን እናድርግ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.text_amharic: ከታዘዘላችሁ አብልጣችሁ አትውሰዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.text_amharic: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ምን እናድርግ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ነበር። እርሱም። በማንም ግፍ አትሥሩ ማንንም በሐሰት አትክሰሱ፥ ደመወዛችሁም ይብቃችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሲጠብቁ ሳሉ ሁሉም በልባቸው ስለ ዮሐንስ። ይህ ክርስቶስ ይሆንን? ብለው ሲያስቡ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: John answered, saying unto all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔስ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የጫማውን ጠፍር መፍታት ከማይገባኝ ከእኔ የሚበረታ ይመጣል፤ እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል፤

verses.text_english: Whose fan in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.text_amharic: መንሹም በእጁ ነው፥ አውድማውንም ፈጽሞ ያጠራል፥ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ይከታል፥ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥለዋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሕዝቡን በብዙ ሌላ ምክር እየመከራቸው ወንጌልን ይሰብክላቸው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.text_amharic: የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስ ግን፥ ስለ ሄሮድያዳ ስለ ወንድሙ ስለ ፊልጶስ ሚስትና ሄሮድስ ስላደረገው ሌላ ክፋት ሁሉ ዮሐንስ ስለ ገሠጸው፥

verses.text_english: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ደግሞ ከሁሉ በላይ ጨምሮ ዮሐንስን በወኅኒ አገባው።

verses.text_english: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከተጠመቁ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ ተጠመቀ። ሲጸልይም ሰማይ ተከፈተ፥

verses.text_english: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስ ቅዱስም በአካል መልክ እንደ ርግብ በእርሱ ላይ ወረደ፤ የምወድህ ልጄ አንተ ነህ፥ በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል የሚል ድምፅም ከሰማይ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was of Heli,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሊያስተምር ሲጀምር ዕድሜው ሠላሳ ዓመት ያህል ሆኖት ነበር እንደመሰላቸው የዮሴፍ ልጅ ሆኖ፥ የኤሊ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Matthat, which was of Levi, which was of Melchi, which was of Janna, which was of Joseph,
verses.text_amharic: የማቲ ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥ የሚልኪ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Mattathias, which was of Amos, which was of Naum, which was of Esli, which was of Nagge,
verses.text_amharic: የዮና ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥ የማታትዩ ልጅ፥ የአሞጽ ልጅ፥ የናሆም ልጅ፥ የኤሲሊም ልጅ

verses.text_english: Which was of Maath, which was of Mattathias, which was of Semei, which was of Joseph, which was of Juda,
verses.text_amharic: የናጌ ልጅ፥ የማአት ልጅ፥ የማታትዩ ልጅ የሴሜይ ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Joanna, which was of Rhesa, which was of Zorobabel, which was of Salathiel, which was of Neri,
verses.text_amharic: የዮዳ ልጅ፥ የዮናን ልጅ፥ የሬስ ልጅ፥ የዘሩባቤል ልጅ፥ የሰላትያል ልጅ፥ የኔሪ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Melchi, which was of Addi, which was of Cosam, which was of Elmodam, which was of Er,
verses.text_amharic: የሚልኪ ልጅ፥ የሐዲ ልጅ፥ የዮሳስ ልጅ፥ የቆሳም ልጅ፥ የኤልሞዳም ልጅ፥ የኤር ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Jose, which was of Eliezer, which was of Jorim, which was of Matthat, which was of Levi,
verses.text_amharic: የዮሴዕ ልጅ፥ የኤልዓዘር ልጅ የዮራም ልጅ፥ የማጣት ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Simeon, which was of Juda, which was of Joseph, which was of Jonan, which was of Eliakim,
verses.text_amharic: የስምዖን ልጅ፥ የይሁዳ ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Melea, which was of Menan, which was of Mattatha, which was of Nathan, which was of David,
verses.text_amharic: የዮናን ልጅ፥ የኤልያቄም ልጅ፥ የሜልያ ልጅ፥ የማይናን ልጅ፥ የማጣት ልጅ፥ የናታን ልጅ

verses.text_english: Which was of Jesse, which was of Obed, which was of Booz, which was of Salmon, which was of Naasson,
verses.text_amharic: የዳዊት ልጅ፥ የእሴይ ልጅ፥ የኢዮቤድ ልጅ፥ የቦዔዝ ልጅ፥ የሰልሞን ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Aminadab, which was of Aram, which was of Esrom, which was of Phares, which was of Juda,
verses.text_amharic: የነአሶን ልጅ፥ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ፥ የአራም ልጅ፥ የአሮኒ ልጅ፥ የኤስሮም ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Jacob, which was of Isaac, which was of Abraham, which was of Thara, which was of Nachor,
verses.text_amharic: የፋሬስ ልጅ፥ የይሁዳ ልጅ፥ የያዕቆብ ልጅ፥ የይስሐቅ ልጅ፥ የአብርሃም ልጅ፥ የታራ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Saruch, which was of Ragau, which was of Phalec, which was of Heber, which was of Sala,
verses.text_amharic: የናኮር ልጅ፥ የሴሮህ ልጅ፥ የራጋው ልጅ፥ የፋሌቅ ልጅ፥ የአቤር ልጅ፥ የሳላ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Cainan, which was of Arphaxad, which was of Sem, which was of Noe, which was of Lamech,
verses.text_amharic: የቃይንም ልጅ፥ የአርፋክስድ ልጅ፥ የሴም ልጅ፥ የኖኅ ልጅ፥ የላሜህ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Mathusala, which was of Enoch, which was of Jared, which was of Maleleel, which was of Cainan,
verses.text_amharic: የማቱሳላ ልጅ፥ የሄኖክ ልጅ፥ የያሬድ ልጅ፥

verses.text_english: Which was of Enos, which was of Seth, which was of Adam, which was of God.
verses.text_amharic: የመላልኤል ልጅ፥ የቃይናን ልጅ፥ የሄኖስ ልጅ፥ የሴት ልጅ፥ የአዳም ልጅ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መንፈስ ቅዱስ መልቶበት ከዮርዳኖስ ተመለሰ፥ በመንፈስም ወደ ምድረ በዳ ተመርቶ፥

verses.text_english: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.text_amharic: አርባ ቀን ከዲያብሎስ ተፈተነ። በነዚያም ቀኖች ምንም አልበላም፥ ከተጨረሱም በኋላ ተራበ።

verses.text_english: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.text_amharic: ዲያብሎስም። የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ከሆንህ፥ ይህን ድንጋይ። እንጀራ ሁን ብለህ እዘዝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁሉ እንጂ በእንጀራ ብቻ አይኖርም ተብሎ ተጽፎአል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.text_amharic: ዲያብሎስም ረጅም ወደ ሆነ ተራራ አውጥቶ የዓለምን መንግሥታት ሁሉ በቅጽበት አሳየው።

verses.text_english: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.text_amharic: ዲያብሎስም። ይህ ሥልጣን ሁሉ ክብራቸውም ለእኔ ተሰጥቶአል ለምወደውም ለማንም እሰጠዋለሁና ለአንተ እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አንተ በእኔ ፊት ብትሰግድ፥ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ለጌታ ለአምላክህ ስገድ እርሱንም ብቻ አምልክ ተብሎ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.text_english: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
And in hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደግሞ ወሰደው፤ በመቅደስም ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ። ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል፥ እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ከዚህ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎአል አለው።

verses.text_english: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.text_amharic: ዲያቢሎስም ፈተናውን ሁሉ ከጨረሰ በኋላ እስከ ጊዜው ከእርሱ ተለየ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በመንፈስ ኃይል ወደ ገሊላ ተመለሰ፤ ስለ እርሱም በዙሪያው ባለችው አገር ሁሉ ዝና ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በምኵራባቸው ያስተምር፥ ሁሉም ያመሰግኑት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.text_amharic: ወዳደገበትም ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፤ እንደ ልማዱም በሰንበት ቀን ወደ ምኵራብ ገባ፥ ሊያነብም ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

The Spirit of the Lord upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: የነቢዩንም የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ሰጡት፥ መጽሐፉንም በተረተረ ጊዜ። የጌታ መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ ቀብቶኛልና፤ ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን ለዕውሮችም ማየትን እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ የተጠቁትንም ነጻ አወጣ ዘንድ የተወደደችውንም የጌታን ዓመት እሰብክ ዘንድ ልኮኛል ተብሎ የተጻፈበትን ስፍራ አገኘ።

verses.text_english: And he closed the book, and he gave again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፉንም ጠቅልሎ ለአገልጋዩ ሰጠውና ተቀመጠ፤ በምኵራብም የነበሩት ሁሉ ትኵር ብለው ይመለከቱት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ዛሬ ይህ መጽሐፍ በጆሮአችሁ ተፈጸመ ይላቸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ይመሰክሩለት ነበር ከአፉም ከሚወጣው ከጸጋው ቃል የተነሣ እየተደነቁ። ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ አይደለምን? ይሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ያለ ጥርጥር ይህን ምሳሌ። ባለ መድኃኒት ሆይ፥ ራስህን ፈውስ፤ በቅፍርናሆም እንዳደረግኸው የሰማነውን ሁሉ በዚህ በገዛ አገርህ ደግሞ አድርግ ትሉኛላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ነቢይ በገዛ አገሩ ከቶ አይወደድም።

verses.text_english: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በኤልያስ ዘመን ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ሰማይ ተዘግቶ ሳለ በምድር ሁሉ ብርቱ ራብ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በእስራኤል ብዙ መበለቶች ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, of Sidon, unto a woman a widow.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስም በሲዶና አገር ወዳለች ወደ ሰራፕታ ወደ አንዲት መበለት እንጂ ከእነርሱ ወደ አንዲቱ አልተላከም።

verses.text_english: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.text_amharic: በነቢዩ በኤልሳዕ ዘመንም በእስራኤል ብዙ ለምጻሞች ነበሩ፥ ከሶርያዊው ከንዕማን በቀር ከእነርሱ አንድ ስንኳ አልነጻም።

verses.text_english: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.text_amharic: በምኵራብም የነበሩ ሁሉ ይህን ሰምተው ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ ተነሥተውም ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥

verses.text_english: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
verses.text_amharic: ይጥሉትም ዘንድ ከተማቸው ተሠርታባት ወደ ነበረች ወደ ተራራው አፋፍ ወሰዱት፤

verses.text_english: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን በመካከላቸው አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ገሊላ ከተማም ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ወረደ። በሰንበትም ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉ በሥልጣን ነበርና በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.text_english: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.text_amharic: በምኵራብም የርኵስ ጋኔን መንፈስ ያደረበት ሰው ነበረ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኾ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Let alone; what have we to do with thee, Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
verses.text_amharic: ተው፥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ልታጠፋን መጣህን? ማን እንደ ሆንህ አውቄሃለሁ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሱ አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ዝም በል ከእርሱም ውጣ ብሎ ገሠጸው። ጋኔኑም በመካከላቸው ጥሎት ሳይጐዳው ከእርሱ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም መደነቅ ያዛቸው፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም። ይህ ቃል ምንድር ነው? በሥልጣንና በኃይል ርኵሳን መናፍስትን ያዝዛልና፥ ይወጡማል ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.text_amharic: ዝናም በዙሪያው ባለች አገር ወደ ስፍራው ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.text_amharic: በምኵራብም ተነሥቶ ወደ ስምዖን ቤት ገባ። የስምዖንም አማት በብርቱ ንዳድ ታማ ነበር ስለ እርስዋም ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገብዋም ቆሞ ንዳዱን ገሠጸውና ለቀቃት፤ ያንጊዜውንም ተነሥታ አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይም በገባ ጊዜ በልዩ ልዩ ደዌ የተያዙ በሽተኞችን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡአቸው፤ እርሱም በእያንዳቸው ላይ እጁን ጭኖ ፈወሳቸው።

verses.text_english: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
verses.text_amharic: አጋንንትም ደግሞ። አንተ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ እያሉ እየጮኹም ከብዙዎች ይወጡ ነበር፤ ገሠጻቸውም ክርስቶስም እንደ ሆነ አውቀውት ነበርና እንዲናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.text_amharic: በጸባም ጊዜ ወጥቶ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄደ፤ ሕዝቡም ይፈልጉት ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም መጡ፥ ከእነርሱም ተለይቶ እንዳይሄድ ሊከለክሉት ወደዱ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ስለዚህ ተልኬአለሁና ለሌሎቹ ከተማዎች ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ወንጌል እሰብክ ዘንድ ይገባኛል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: በገሊላም ምኵራቦች ይሰብክ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እየሰሙ ሲያስጠብቡት ሳሉ፥ እርሱ ራሱ በጌንሳሬጥ ባሕር ዳር ቆሞ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing nets.
verses.text_amharic: በባሕር ዳርም ቆመው የነበሩትን ሁለት ታንኳዎች አየ፤ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ግን ከእነርሱ ውስጥ ወጥተው መረቦቻቸውን ያጥቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.text_amharic: ከታንኳዎቹም የስምዖን ወደ ነበረች ወደ አንዲቱ ገብቶ ከምድር ጥቂት ፈቀቅ እንዲያደርጋት ለመነው፤ በታንኳይቱም ተቀምጦ ሕዝቡን ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.text_amharic: ነገሩንም ከጨረሰ በኋላ፥ ስምዖንን። ወደ ጥልቁ ፈቀቅ በል መረቦቻችሁንም ለማጥመድ ጣሉ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖንም መልሶ። አቤቱ፥ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አድረን ስንደክም ምንም አልያዝንም፤ ነገር ግን በቃልህ መረቦቹን እጥላለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ባደረጉ ጊዜ እጅግ ብዙ ዓሣ ያዙ፤ መረቦቻቸውም ተቀደዱ።

verses.text_english: And they beckoned unto partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.text_amharic: በሌላ ታንኳም የነበሩትን ጓደኞቻቸውን መጥተው እንዲያግዙአቸው ጠቀሱ፤ መጥተውም ሁለቱ ታንኳዎች እስኪሰጥሙ ድረስ ሞሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: When Simon Peter saw , he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ግን ባየ ጊዜ በኢየሱስ ጕልበት ላይ ወድቆ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ ኃጢአተኛ ነኝና ከኔ ተለይ አለው።

verses.text_english: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.text_amharic: ስላጠመዱት ዓሣ እርሱ ከእርሱ ጋርም የነበሩ ሁሉ ተደንቀዋልና፥

verses.text_english: And so also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ደግሞ የስምዖን ባልንጀሮች የነበሩ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ተደነቁ። ኢየሱስም ስምዖንን። አትፍራ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሰውን የምታጠምድ ትሆናለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ታንኳዎችንም ወደ ምድር አድርሰው ሁሉን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማዎችም በአንዲቱ ሳለ፥ እነሆ፥ ለምጽ የሞላበት ሰው ነበረ፤ ኢየሱስንም አይቶ በፊቱ ወደቀና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብትወድስ፥ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And he put forth hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.text_amharic: እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወዳለሁ፥ ንጻ አለው፤ ወዲያውም ለምጹ ለቀቀው።

verses.text_english: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ለማንም እንዳይናገር አዘዘው፥ ነገር ግን። ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ፥ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ስለ መንጻትህ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ መሥዋዕት አቅርብ አለው።

verses.text_english: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.text_amharic: ወሬው ግን አብዝቶ ወጣ፥ ብዙ ሕዝብም ሊሰሙትና ከደዌአቸው ሊፈወሱ ይሰበሰቡ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እርሱ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ይጸልይ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was to heal them.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀንም ያስተምር ነበር፤ ከገሊላና ከይሁዳ መንደሮችም ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌምም መጥተው የነበሩ ፈሪሳውያንና የሕግ መምህራን ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ እርሱም እንዲፈውስ የጌታ ኃይል ሆነለት።

verses.text_english: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought to bring him in, and to lay before him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሽባ በአልጋ ተሸክመው አመጡ፤ አግብተውም በፊቱ ሊያኖሩት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they could not find by what they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡም ብዛት እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያገቡት ሲያቅታቸው፥ ወደ ሰገነቱ ወጡ የጣራውንም ጡብ አሳልፈው በመካከል በኢየሱስ ፊት ከነአልጋው አወረዱት።

verses.text_english: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.text_amharic: እምነታቸውንም አይቶ። አንተ ሰው፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.text_amharic: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም። ይህ የሚሳደብ ማን ነው? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ማን ይችላል? ብለው ያስቡ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አሳባቸውን እያወቀ መልሶ። በልባችሁ ምን ታስባላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.text_english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በምድር ላይ ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ለሰው ልጅ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ ብሎ፥ ሽባውን። አንተን እልሃለሁ፥ ነተሣ፥ አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም በፊታቸው ተነሣ፥ ተኝቶበትም የነበረውን ተሸክሞ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም መገረም ያዛቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመስግነው። ዛሬስ ድንቅ ነገር አየን እያሉ ፍርሃት ሞላባቸው።

verses.text_english: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ወጥቶ ሌዊ የሚባል ቀራጭ በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ ተመለከተና። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም ተወ፤ ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.text_english: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.text_amharic: ሌዊም በቤቱ ታላቅ ግብዣ አደረገለት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጠው የነበሩ ከቀራጮችና ከሌሎች ሰዎች ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበሩ።
