verses.text_english: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንና ጻፎቻቸውም በደቀ መዛሙርቱ ላይ። ስለ ምን ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ትበላላችሁ ትጠጡማላችሁ? ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ባለ ጤናዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም፤

verses.text_english: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞችን ወደ ንስሐ እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለ ምን ብዙ ይጦማሉ ጸሎትስ ስለ ምን ያደርጋሉ፥ ደግሞም የፈሪሳውያን ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለ ምን እንደዚሁ ያደርጋሉ፤ የአንተ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ይበላሉ ይጠጣሉም? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሚዜዎችን ልታስጦሙ ትችላላችሁን?

verses.text_english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወራት ይመጣል፥ ሙሽራውም ከእነርሱ ሲወሰድ ያንጊዜ፥ በዚያ ወራት ይጦማሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ምሳሌ እንዲህ ሲል ነገራቸው። የአዲስ ልብስ እራፊ ባረጀ ልብስ ላይ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን አዲሱን ይቀደዋል ደግሞም አዲስ እራፊ ለአሮጌው አይስማማውም።

verses.text_english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.text_amharic: ባረጀ አቁማዳም አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን አዲሱ የወይን ጠጅ አቁማዳውን ያፈነዳል፥ እርሱም ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል።

verses.text_english: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.text_amharic: አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ ግን በአዲስ አቁማዳ ማኖር ይገባል፥ ሁለቱም ይጠባበቃሉ።

verses.text_english: No man also having drunk old straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.text_amharic: አሮጌ የወይን ጠጅ ሲጠጣ አዲሱን የሚሻ ማንም የለም፤ አሮጌው ይጣፍጣል ይላልና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing in hands.
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበትም በእርሻ መካከል ያልፍ ነበር ደቀ መዛሙርቱም እሸት ይቀጥፉ በእጃቸውም እያሹ ይበሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያን ግን አንዳንዶቹ። በሰንበት ሊያደርግ ያልተፈቀደውን ስለ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ለእነርሱ መልሶ። ዳዊት በተራበ ጊዜ እርሱ አብረውት ከነበሩ ጋር ያደረገውን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ ከካህናት ብቻ በቀር መብላቱ ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕትን እንጀራ ይዞ እንደ በላ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት ደግሞ እንደ ሰጣቸው ይህን አላነበባችሁምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነው አላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.text_amharic: በሌላው ሰንበትም ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ አስተማረ፤ በዚያም ቀኝ እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.text_amharic: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም መክሰሻ ሊያገኙበት በሰንበት ይፈውስ እንደ ሆነ ይጠባበቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እጁ የሰለለችውን ሰው። ተነሣና በመካከል ቁም አለው፤ ተነሥቶም ቆመ።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy ?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እጠይቃችኋለሁ፤ በሰንበት በጎ ማድረግ ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ ክፉ? ነፍስ ማዳንን ወይስ መግደል? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላቸውንም ዙሪያውን አየና ሰውዬውን። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው። እርሱም እንዲህ አደረገ፥ እጁም እንደ ሁለተኛይቱ ዳነች።

verses.text_english: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ በኢየሱስም ምን እንዲያደርጉበት እርስ በርሳቸው ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.text_amharic: በነዚህም ወራት ይጸልይ ዘንድ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጸልይ አደረ።

verses.text_english: And when it was day, he called his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠራ፥ ከእነርሱም አሥራ ሁለት መረጠ ደግሞም ሐዋርያት ብሎ ሰየማቸው፤

verses.text_english: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም፥ ጴጥሮስ ብሎ እንደ ገና የሰየመው ስምዖን፥ ወንድሙም እንድርያስ፥ ያዕቆብም ዮሐንስም፥ ፊልጶስም በርተሎሜዎስም፥

verses.text_english: Matthew and Thomas, James the of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.text_amharic: ማቴዎስም ቶማስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ቀናተኛ የሚባለው ስምዖንም፥

verses.text_english: And Judas of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.text_amharic: የያዕቆብ ይሁዳም፥ አሳልፎ የሰጠውም የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ በተካከለ ስፍራ ቆመ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወገን ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበረ፥ ደግሞም ሊሰሙትና ከደዌአቸው ሊፈወሱ ከይሁዳ ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ባሕር ዳርም የመጡ ብዙ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.text_amharic: ከርኵሳንም መናፍስት ይሠቃዩ የነበሩት ተፈወሱ፤

verses.text_english: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed all.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ኃይል ወጥቶ ሁሉን ይፈውስ ነበርና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሊዳስሱት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ዓይኑን አነሣ እንዲህም አላቸው። እናንተ ድሆች ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የእናንተ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Blessed that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ አሁን የምትራቡ ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ ትጠግባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምታለቅሱ ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ ትስቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you , and shall reproach , and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ስለ ሰው ልጅ ሲጠሉአችሁ ሲለዩአችሁም ሲነቅፉአችሁም ስማችሁንም እንደ ክፉ ሲያወጡ፥ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ዋጋችሁ በሰማይ ታላቅ ነውና በዚያን ቀን ደስ ይበላችሁ ዝለሉም፤ አባቶቻቸው ነቢያትን እንዲህ ያደርጉባቸው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እናንተ ባለ ጠጎች ወዮላችሁ፥ መጽናናታችሁን ተቀብላችኋልና።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ አሁን የጠገባችሁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ትራባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምትስቁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ታዝናላችሁና ታለቅሱማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ሁሉ መልካም ሲናገሩላችሁ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ አባቶቻቸው ለሐሰተኞች ነቢያት እንዲሁ ያደርጉላቸው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለእናንተ ለምትሰሙ እላችኋለሁ፥ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁ መልካም አድርጉ፥

verses.text_english: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.text_amharic: የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ስለሚበድሉአችሁም ጸልዩ።

verses.text_english: And unto him that smiteth thee on the cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not coat also.
verses.text_amharic: ጕንጭህን ለሚመታህ ደግሞ ሁለተኛውን ስጠው፥ መጐናጸፊያህንም ለሚወስድ እጀ ጠባብህን ደግሞ አትከልክለው።

verses.text_english: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask not again.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚለምንህ ሁሉ ስጥ፥ ገንዘብህንም የሚወስድ እንዲመልስ አትጠይቀው።

verses.text_english: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም ሊያደርጉላችሁ እንደምትወዱ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው።

verses.text_english: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.text_amharic: የሚወዱአችሁንማ ብትወዱ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ የሚወዱአቸውን ይወዳሉና።

verses.text_english: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.text_amharic: መልካምም ለሚያደርጉላችሁ መልካም ብታደርጉ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ ያን ያደርጋሉና።

verses.text_english: And if ye lend of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.text_amharic: እንድትወስዱባቸው ተስፋ ለምታደርጉአቸው ብታበድሩ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ በትክክል እንዲቀበሉ ለኃጢአተኞች ያበድራሉ።

verses.text_english: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and the evil.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ መልካም አድርጉ፤ ምንም ተስፋ ሳታደርጉም አበድሩ፥ ዋጋችሁም ታላቅ ይሆናል፥ የልዑልም ልጆች ትሆናላችሁ፥ እርሱ ለማያመሰግኑ ለክፉዎችም ቸር ነውና።

verses.text_english: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችሁ ርኅሩኅ እንደ ሆነ ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.text_amharic: አትፍረዱ አይፈረድባችሁምም፤ አትኰንኑ አትኰነኑምም። ይቅር በሉ ይቅርም ትባላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.text_amharic: ስጡ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ በምትሰፍሩበት መስፈሪያ ተመልሶ ይሰፈርላችኋልና፥ የተጨቈነና የተነቀነቀ የተትረፈረፈም መልካም መስፈሪያ በእቅፋችሁ ይሰጣችኋል።

verses.text_english: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌም አላቸው። ዕውር ዕውርን ሊመራ ይችላልን? ሁለቱ በጕድጓድ አይወድቁምን?

verses.text_english: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዝሙር ከመምህሩ አይበልጥም፤ ፈጽሞ የተማረ ሁሉ ግን እንደ መምህሩ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.text_amharic: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለ ምን ታያለህ፥ በራስህ ዓይን ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?

verses.text_english: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይንህ ያለውን ምሰሶ ራስህ ሳታይ፥ እንዴት ወንድምህን። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ በዓይንህ ያለውን ጉድፍ ላውጣ ፍቀድልኝ ልትል ትችላለህ? አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድመህ ከዓይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ ከዚያም በኋላ በወንድምህ ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።

verses.text_english: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ ፍሬ የሚያደርግ መልካም ዛፍ የለምና፥ እንዲሁም መልካም ፍሬ የሚያደርግ ክፉ ዛፍ የለም።

verses.text_english: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.text_amharic: ዛፍ ሁሉ ከፍሬው ይታወቃልና፤ ከእሾህ በለስ አይለቅሙም፥ ከአጣጥ ቍጥቋጦም ወይን አይቈርጡም።

verses.text_english: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.text_amharic: በልብ ሞልቶ ከተረፈው አፉ ይናገራልና መልካም ሰው ከልብ መልካም መዝገብ መልካሙን ያወጣል፥ ክፉ ሰውም ከልብ ክፉ መዝገብ ክፉውን ያወጣል።

verses.text_english: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ትሉኛላችሁ፥ የምለውንም አታደርጉም?

verses.text_english: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ሁሉ ቃሌንም ሰምቶ የሚያደርገው፥ ማንን እንዲመስል አሳያችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.text_amharic: ቤት ሲሠራ አጥልቆ የቆፈረ በዓለት ላይም የመሠረተ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ጐርፍም በመጣ ጊዜ ወንዙ ያን ቤት ገፋው፥ በዓለት ላይም ስለ ተመሠረተ ሊያናውጠው አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.text_amharic: ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ግን ያለ መሠረት በምድር ላይ ቤቱን የሠራ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ወንዙም ገፋው ወዲያውም ወደቀ የዚያ ቤት አወዳደቅም ታላቅ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን ሁሉ በሕዝብ ጆሮዎች በጨረሰ ጊዜ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ገባ።

verses.text_english: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ የመቶ አለቃም ነበረ፤ የሚወደውም ባሪያው ታሞ ሊሞት ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ የአይሁድን ሽማግሎች ወደ እርሱ ላከና መጥቶ ባሪያውን እንዲያድን ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥተው። ይህን ልታደርግለት ይገባዋል፤

verses.text_english: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝባችንን ይወዳልና ምኵራብም ራሱ ሠርቶልናል ብለው አጽንተው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሄደ። አሁንም ወደ ቤቱ በቀረበ ጊዜ የመቶው አለቃ ወዳጆቹን ወደ እርሱ ላከ፤ አለውም። ጌታ ሆይ በቤቴ ጣራ በታች ልትገባ አይገባኝምና አትድከም፤

verses.text_english: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ወደ አንተ ልመጣ እንዲገባኝ ሰውነቴን አልቈጠርሁትም፤ ነገር ግን ቃል ተናገር፥ ብላቴናዬም ይፈወሳል።

verses.text_english: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth .
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ ከሌሎች በታች የምገዛ ሰው ነኝ፥ ከእኔም በታች ወታደሮች አሉኝ፥ አንዱንም። ሂድ ብለው ይሄዳል፥ ሌላውንም። ና ብለው ይመጣል፥ ባሪያዬንም። ይህን አድርግ ብለው ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ በእርሱ ተደነቀ፥ ዘወርም ብሎ ለተከተሉት ሕዝብ። እላችኋለሁ፥ በእስራኤልስ እንኳ እንዲህ ያለ ትልቅ እምነት አላገኘሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.text_amharic: የተላኩትም ወደ ቤት ተመልሰው ባሪያውን ባለ ጤና ሆኖ አገኙት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም ናይን ወደምትባል ወደ አንዲት ከተማ ሄደ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙ ሕዝብም ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ከተማይቱም በር በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ የሞተ ሰው ተሸክመው አወጡ፤ እርሱም ለእናቱ አንድ ልጅ ነበረ፥ እርስዋም መበለት ነበረች፥ ብዙም የከተማ ሕዝብ ከእርስዋ ጋር አብረው ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም ባያት ጊዜ አዘነላትና። አታልቅሽ አላት።

verses.text_english: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.text_amharic: ቀርቦም ቃሬዛውን ነካ፥ የተሸከሙትም ቆሙ፤ አለውም። አንተ ጐበዝ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.text_amharic: የሞተውም ቀና ብሎ ተቀመጠ ሊናገርም ጀመረ፥ ለእናቱም ሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም ፍርሃት ያዛቸውና። ታላቅ ነቢይ በእኛ መካከል ተነሥቶአል፥ ደግሞ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ጐበኘ እያሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.text_english: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ዝና ስለ እርሱ በይሁዳ ሁሉ በዙሪያውም ባለች አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለዮሐንስ እነዚህን ሁሉ አወሩ።

verses.text_english: And John calling two of his disciples sent to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠብቅ? ብሎ ወደ ኢየሱስ ላከ።

verses.text_english: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ። የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠብቅ? ብሎ ወደ አንተ ላከን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And in that same hour he cured many of infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many blind he gave sight.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያች ሰዓት ከደዌና ከሥቃይ ከክፉዎች መናፍስትም ብዙዎችን ፈወሰ፥ ለብዙ ዕውሮችም ማየትን ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ለዮሐንስ አውሩለት፤ ዕውሮች ያያሉ፥ አንካሶችም ይሄዳሉ፥ ለምጻሞችም ይነጻሉ፥ ደንቆሮዎችም ይሰማሉ፥ ሙታንም ይነሣሉ፥ ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበካል፤

verses.text_english: And blessed is , whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔም የማይሰናከለው ሁሉ ብፁዕ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.text_amharic: የዮሐንስ መልክተኞችም ከሄዱ በኋላ፥ ለሕዝቡ ስለ ዮሐንስ ይናገር ጀመር እንዲህም አለ። ምን ልታዩ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣችሁ? ነፋስ የሚወዘውዘውን ሸምበቆን? ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ?

verses.text_english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.text_amharic: ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሰውን ሰውን? እነሆ፥ ጌጠኛ ልብስ የሚለብሱና በቅምጥልነት የሚኖሩ በነገሥታት ቤት አሉ።

verses.text_english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ነቢይን? አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከነቢይም የሚበልጠውን።

verses.text_english: This is , of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን በፊትህ የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ ማንም የለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

verses.text_english: And all the people that heard , and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.text_amharic: የሰሙትም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ቀራጮች እንኳ ሳይቀሩ በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ተጠምቀው እግዚአብሔርን አጸደቁ፤

verses.text_english: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንና ሕግ አዋቂዎች ግን በእርሱ ስለ አልተጠመቁ የእግዚአብሔርን ምክር ከራሳቸው ጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የዚችን ትውልድ ሰዎች በምን አስመስላቸዋለሁ? ማንንስ ይመስላሉ?

verses.text_english: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.text_amharic: በገበያ የሚቀመጡትን ልጆች ይመስላሉ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም እየተጠራሩ። እንቢልታ ነፋንላችሁ አልዘፈናችሁምም፤ ሙሾ አወጣንላችሁ አላለቀሳችሁምም ይላል።

verses.text_english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.text_amharic: መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ እንጀራ ሳይበላ የወይን ጠጅም ሳይጠጣ መጥቶ ነበርና። ጋኔን አለበት አላችሁት።

verses.text_english: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ እየበላና እየጠጣ መጥቶአልና። እነሆ፥ በላተኛና የወይን ጠጅ ጠጭ፥ የቀራጮችና የኃጢአተኞች ወዳጅ አላችሁት።

verses.text_english: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብም ለልጆችዋ ሁሉ ጸደቀች።

verses.text_english: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያንም አንድ ከእርሱ ጋር ይበላ ዘንድ ለመነው፤ በፈሪሳዊው ቤትም ገብቶ በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም በዚያች ከተማ ኃጢአተኛ የነበረች አንዲት ሴት፤ በፈሪሳዊው ቤት በማዕድ እንደ ተቀመጠ ባወቀች ጊዜ፥ ሽቱ የሞላበት የአልባስጥሮስ ቢልቃጥ አመጣች።

verses.text_english: And stood at his feet behind weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed with the ointment.
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ኋላውም በእግሩ አጠገብ ቆማ እያለቀሰች በእንባዋ እግሩን ታርስ ጀመረች፥ በራስ ጠጕርዋም ታብሰው እግሩንም ትስመው ሽቱም ትቀባው ነበረች።

verses.text_english: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw , he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.text_amharic: የጠራው ፈሪሳዊም አይቶ። ይህስ ነቢይ ቢሆን፥ ይህች የምትዳስሰው ሴት ማን እንደ ሆነች እንዴትስ እንደ ነበረች ባወቀ ነበር፥ ኃጢአተኛ ናትና ብሎ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ የምነግርህ ነገር አለኝ አለው። እርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ተናገር አለ።

verses.text_english: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.text_amharic: ለአንድ አበዳሪ ሁለት ተበዳሪዎች ነበሩት በአንዱ አምስት መቶ ዲናር ነበረበት በሁለተኛውም አምሳ።

verses.text_english: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.text_amharic: የሚከፍሉትም ቢያጡ ለሁለቱም ተወላቸው። እንግዲህ ከእነርሱ አብልጦ የሚወደው ማንኛው ነው?

verses.text_english: Simon answered and said, I suppose that , to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖንም መልሶ። ብዙ የተወለቱ ይመስለኛል አለ። እርሱም። በእውነት ፈረድህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped with the hairs of her head.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሴቲቱም ዘወር ብሎ ስምዖንን እንዲህ አለው። ይህችን ሴት ታያለህን? እኔ ወደ ቤትህ ገባሁ፥ ውኃ ስንኳ ለእግሬ አላቀረብህልኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን በእንባዋ እግሬን አራሰች በጠጕርዋም አበሰች።

verses.text_english: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ አልሳምኸኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን ከገባሁ ጀምራ እግሬን ከመሳም አላቋረጠችም።

verses.text_english: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ራሴን ዘይት አልቀባኸኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን እግሬን ሽቱ ቀባች።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, loveth little.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እልሃለሁ፥ እጅግ ወዳለችና ብዙ ያለው ኃጢአትዋ ተሰርዮላታል፤ ጥቂት ግን የሚሰረይለት ጥቂት ይወዳል።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋንም። ኃጢአትሽ ተሰርዮልሻል አላት።

verses.text_english: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጠው የነበሩት በልባቸው። ኃጢአትን እንኳ የሚያስተሰርይ ይህ ማን ነው? ይሉ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱንም። እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ አላት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve with him,
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ እየሰበከና ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የምሥራች እየተናገረ በየከተማይቱ በየመንደሩም ያልፍ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፥ ከክፉዎች መናፍስትና ከደዌም ተፈውሰው የነበሩ አንዳንድ ሴቶች፤ እነርሱም ሰባት አጋንንት የወጡላት መግደላዊት የምትባል ማርያም፥

verses.text_english: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.text_amharic: የሄሮድስ አዛዥ የኩዛ ሚስት ዮሐናም ሶስናም ብዙዎች ሌሎችም ሆነው በገንዘባቸው ያገለግሉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕዝብም በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ከከተማዎችም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ በመጡ ጊዜ በምሳሌ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.text_amharic: ዘሪ ዘሩን ሊዘራ ወጣ። ሲዘራም አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀ ተረገጠም፥ የሰማይ ወፎችም በሉት።

verses.text_english: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በዓለት ላይ ወደቀ፥ በበቀለም ጊዜ እርጥበት ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.text_english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾሁም አብሮ በቀለና አነቀው።

verses.text_english: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ላይ ወደቀ፤ በበቀለም ጊዜ መቶ እጥፍ አፈራ። ይህን በተናገረ ጊዜ። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ይህ ምሳሌ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ። ለእናንተ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ምሥጢር ማወቅ ተሰጥቶአችኋል፤ ለሌሎች ግን እያዩ እንዳያዩ እየሰሙም እንዳያስተውሉ በምሳሌ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌው ይህ ነው። ዘሩ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።

verses.text_english: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.text_amharic: በመንገድ ዳርም ያሉት የሚሰሙ ናቸው፤ ከዚህ በኋላም ዲያብሎስ ይመጣል አምነውም እንዳይድኑ ቃሉን ከልባቸው ይወስዳል።

verses.text_english: They on the rock , which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለት ላይም ያሉት ሲሰሙ ቃሉን በደስታ የሚቀበሉ ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ለጊዜው ብቻ ያምናሉ እንጂ በፈተና ጊዜ የሚክዱ ሥር የሌላቸው ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.text_amharic: በእሾህ መካከልም የወደቀ እነዚህ የሚሰሙት ናቸው፤ መንገዳቸውንም ሄደው በሕይወት ዘመን በአሳብና በባለ ጠግነት ምቾት ይታነቃሉ፥ ሙሉ ፍሬም አያፈሩም።

verses.text_english: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep , and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.text_amharic: በመልካም መሬት ላይም የወደቀ እነርሱ በመልካምና በበጎ ልብ ቃሉን ሰምተው የሚጠብቁት በመጽናትም ፍሬ የሚያፈሩ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth under a bed; but setteth on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.text_amharic: መብራትንም አብርቶ በዕቃ የሚከድነው ወይም ከአልጋ በታች የሚያኖረው የለም፥ የሚገቡት ሰዎች ብርሃኑን እንዲያዩ በመቅረዝ ላይ ያኖረዋል እንጂ።

verses.text_english: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.text_amharic: የማይገለጥ የተሰወረ የለምና፥ የማይታወቅም ወደ ግልጥም የማይመጣ የተሸሸገ የለም።

verses.text_english: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንዴት እንድትሰሙ ተጠበቁ፤ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋልና፥ ከሌለውም ሁሉ፥ ያው ያለው የሚመስለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.text_english: Then came to him mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.text_amharic: እናቱና ወንድሞቹም ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ ከሕዝቡም ብዛት የተነሣ ሊያገኙት አልተቻላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And it was told him which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.text_amharic: እናትህና ወንድሞችህ ሊያዩህ ወድደው በውጭ ቆመዋል ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። እናቴና ወንድሞቼስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰምተው የሚያደርጉት እነዚህ ናቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.text_amharic: ከዕለታቱም በአንዱ እርሱ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳ ገብቶ። ወደ ባሕር ማዶ እንሻገር አላቸው፤ ተነሡም።

verses.text_english: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled , and were in jeopardy.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄዱም አንቀላፋ። ዓውሎ ነፋስም በባሕር ላይ ወረደ፥ ውኃውም ታንኳይቱን ይሞላ ነበርና ይጨነቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.text_amharic: ቀርበውም። አቤቱ፥ አቤቱ ጠፋን እያሉ አስነሡት። እርሱም ነቅቶ ነፋሱንና የውኃውን ማዕበል ገሠጻቸው፤ ተዉም፥ ጽጥታም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እምነታችሁ የት ነው? አላቸው። ፈርተውም ተደነቁ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም። እንዲህ ነፋሳትንና ውኃን እንኳ የሚያዝ ለእርሱም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: በገሊላም አንጻር ወዳለችው ወደ ጌርጌሴኖን አገር በታንኳ ደረሱ።

verses.text_english: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in house, but in the tombs.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምድርም በወጣ ጊዜ አጋንንት ያደሩበት አንድ ሰው ከከተማ ወጥቶ ተገናኘው፥ ከብዙ ዘመንም ጀምሮ ልብስ ሳይለብስ በመቃብር እንጂ በቤት አይኖርም ነበር።

verses.text_english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም ባየ ጊዜ ጮኾ በፊቱ ተደፋ በታላቅ ድምፅም። የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? እንዳትሣቀየኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.text_amharic: ርኵሱን መንፈስ ከሰውዬው እንዲወጣ ያዘው ነበርና። ብዙ ዘመንም ይዞት ነበርና፥ በሰንሰለትና በእግር ብረትም ታስሮ ይጠበቅ ነበር፤ እስራቱንም ሰብሮ በጋኔኑ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይነዳ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ስምህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም ብዙዎች አጋንንት ገብተውበት ነበርና። ሌጌዎን አለው።

verses.text_english: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጥልቁም ሊሄዱ እንዳያዛቸው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም በተራራው የብዙ እሪያ መንጋ ይሰማሩ ነበር፤ ወደ እነርሱም ሊገቡ እንዲፈቅድላቸው ለመኑት፤ ፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.text_amharic: አጋንንትም ከሰውዬው ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎች ገቡ፥ መንጋውም ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር ተጣደፉና ሰጠሙ።

verses.text_english: When they that fed saw what was done, they fled, and went and told in the city and in the country.
verses.text_amharic: እረኞችም የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ ሸሽተው በከተማውና በአገሩ አወሩት።

verses.text_english: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.text_amharic: የሆነውን ነገር ሊያዩ ወጥተውም ወደ ኢየሱስ መጡ፥ አጋንንትም የወጡለትን ሰው ለብሶ ልቡም ተመልሶ በኢየሱስ እግር አጠገብ ተቀምጦ አገኙትና ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: They also which saw told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.text_amharic: ያዩትም ደግሞ አጋንንት ያደሩበት ሰው እንዴት እንደ ዳነ አወሩላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም በጌርጌሴኖን አገር ያሉት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ታላቅ ፍርሃት ይዞአቸዋልና ከእነርሱ እንዲሄድ ለመኑት በታንኳም ገብቶ ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.text_amharic: አጋንንት የወጡለት ሰውም ከእርሱ ጋር ይኖር ዘንድ ለመነው፤

verses.text_english: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። ወደ ቤትህ ተመለስ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረግልህ ንገር ብሎ አሰናበተው። ኢየሱስም እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር እንዳደረገለት በከተማው ሁሉ እየሰበከ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በተመለሰ ጊዜ ሁሉ ይጠብቁት ነበርና ሕዝቡ ተቀበሉት።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ኢያኢሮስ የሚባል ሰው መጣ፥ እርሱም የምኵራብ አለቃ ነበረ በኢየሱስም እግር ላይ ወድቆ ወደ ቤቱ እንዲገባ ለመነው፤

verses.text_english: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናት አንዲት ሴት ልጅ ነበረችውና፤ እርስዋም ለሞት ቀርባ ነበረች። ሲሄድም ሕዝቡ ያጨናንቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.text_amharic: ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመትም ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈሳት ሴት ነበረች፥ ትዳርዋንም ሁሉ ለባለመድኃኒቶች ከስራ ማንም ሊፈውሳት አልተቻለውም።

verses.text_english: Came behind , and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላውም ቀርባ የልብሱን ጫፍ ዳሰሰች፥ የደምዋም ፈሳሽ በዚያን ጊዜ ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press , and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። የዳሰሰኝ ማን ነው? አለ። ሁሉም በካዱ ጊዜ፥ ጴጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት። አቤቱ፥ ሕዝቡ ያጫንቁሃልና ያጋፉህማል፤ የዳሰሰኝ ማን ነው ትላለህን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። አንድ ሰው ዳስሶኛል፥ ኃይል ከእኔ እንደ ወጣ እኔ አውቃለሁና አለ።

verses.text_english: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም እንዳልተሰወረች ባየች ጊዜ እየተንቀጠቀጠች መጥታ በፊቱ ተደፋች፥ በምን ምክንያትም እንደ ዳሰሰችው ፈጥናም እንደ ተፈወሰች በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት አወራች።

verses.text_english: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ አላት።

verses.text_english: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's , saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር አንድ ሰው ከምኵራብ አለቃው ቤት መጥቶ። ልጅህ ሞታለች፤ እንግዲህ መምህሩን አታድክም አለ።

verses.text_english: But when Jesus heard , he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን ሰምቶ። አትፍራ፤ እመን ብቻ ትድንማለች ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም ሲገባ ከጴጥሮስና ከያዕቆብ ከዮሐንስም ከብላቴናይቱም አባትና እናት በቀር ማንም ከእርሱ ጋር ይገባ ዘንድ አልፈቀደም።

verses.text_english: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም እያለቀሱላት ዋይ ዋይ ይሉ ነበር። እርሱ ግን። አታልቅሱ፤ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችም አለ።

verses.text_english: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሞተችም አውቀው በጣም ሳቁበት።

verses.text_english: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን እጅዋን ይዞ። አንቺ ብላቴና፥ ተነሺ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስዋም ተመለሰች፥ ፈጥናም ቆመች፥ የምትበላውንም እንዲሰጡአት አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.text_amharic: ወላጆችዋም ተገረሙ፤ እርሱ ግን የሆነውን ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለቱንም ሐዋርያት በአንድነት ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ በአጋንንት ሁሉ ላይ ደዌንም ይፈውሱ ዘንድ ኃይልና ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርንም መንግሥት እንዲሰብኩና ድውዮችን እንዲፈውሱ ላካቸው፥

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Take nothing for journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። በትርም ቢሆን፥ ከረጢትም ቢሆን፥ እንጀራም ቢሆን፥ ብርም ቢሆን ለመንገድ ምንም አትያዙ፥ ሁለት እጀ ጠባብም አይሁንላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.text_amharic: በማናቸውም በምትገቡበት ቤት በዚያ ተቀመጡ ከዚያም ውጡ።

verses.text_english: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውም የማይቀበሉአችሁ ቢሆኑ፥ ከዚያ ከተማ ወጥታችሁ ምስክር እንዲሆንባቸው ከእግራችሁ ትቢያ አራግፉ።

verses.text_english: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥተውም ወንጌልን እየሰበኩና በስፍራው ሁሉ እየፈወሱ በየመንደሩ ያልፉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.text_amharic: የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስም የተደረገውን ነገር ሁሉ ሰምቶ፥ አንዳንድ ሰዎች።

verses.text_english: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ ከሙታን ተነሣ፥ ሌሎችም። ኤልያስ ተገለጠ፥ ሌሎችም። ከቀደሙት ነቢያት አንዱ ተነሥቶአል ይሉ ስለ ነበሩ አመነታ።

verses.text_english: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስም። ዮሐንስንስ እኔ ራሱን አስቈረጥሁት፤ ይህ እንዲህ ያለ ነገር የምሰማበት ማን ነው? አለ። ሊያየውም ይሻ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.text_amharic: ሐዋርያትም ተመልሰው ያደረጉትን ሁሉ ነገሩት። ከእርሱ ጋርም ወስዶአቸው ቤተ ሳይዳ ከምትባል ከተማ አጠገብ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ለብቻው ፈቀቅ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the people, when they knew , followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም አውቀው ተከተሉት፤ ተቀብሎአቸውም ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ይነግራቸው ነበር፥ መፈወስ ያስፈለጋቸውንም ፈወሳቸው።

verses.text_english: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.text_amharic: ቀኑም ይመሽ ጀመር፤ አሥራ ሁለቱም ቀርበው። በዚህ በምድረ በዳ ነንና በዙሪያችን ወዳሉ መንደሮችና ገጠሮች ሄደው እንዲያድሩና ምግብ እንዲያገኙ ሕዝቡን አሰናብት አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው አላቸው። እነርሱም። ሄደን ለዚህ ሁሉ ሕዝብ ምግብ ካልገዛን፥ ከአምስት እንጀራና ከሁለት ዓሣ የሚበልጥ የለንም አሉት፤

verses.text_english: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.text_amharic: አምስት ሺህ ሰዎች ያህሉ ነበርና። ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። በየክፍሉ አምሳ አምሳውን አስቀምጡአቸው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አደረጉ ሁሉንም አስቀመጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.text_amharic: አምስቱንም እንጀራና ሁለቱን ዓሣ ይዞ፥ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረካቸው ቆርሶም ለሕዝቡ እንዲያቀርቡ ለደቀ መዛርሙርቱ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፥ ከእነርሱም የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.text_amharic: ለብቻውም ሲጸልይ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩና። ሕዝቡ እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ይላሉ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.text_english: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some , Elias; and others , that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም መልሰው። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም። ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም። ከቀደሙት ነቢያት አንዱ ተነሥቶአል ይላሉ አሉት።

verses.text_english: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተስ እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? አላቸው። ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ከእግዚአብሔር የተቀባህ ነህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he straitly charged them, and commanded to tell no man that thing;
Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.text_amharic: ለሁሉም እንዲህ አላቸው። በኋላዬ ሊመጣ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ዕለት ዕለት ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.text_english: And he said to all, If any will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታልና፤ ስለ እኔ ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ግን እርሱ ያድናታል።

verses.text_english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ አትርፎ ራሱን ቢያጠፋ ወይም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል?

verses.text_english: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.text_amharic: በእኔና በቃሌ የሚያፍር ሁሉ፥ የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ በአባቱና በቅዱሳን መላእክቱ ክብርም ሲመጣ በእርሱ ያፍርበታል።

verses.text_english: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and Father's, and of the holy angels.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚህ ከሚቆሙት ሰዎች የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እስኪያዩ ድረስ ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንድ አሉ።

verses.text_english: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ቃል በኋላ ስምንት ቀን ያህል ቈይቶ ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ያዕቆብንም ይዞ ሊጸልይ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
verses.text_amharic: ሲጸልይም የፊቱ መልክ ተለወጠ፤ ልብሱም ተብለጭልጮ ነጭ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment white glistering.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሁለት ሰዎች እነርሱም ሙሴና ኤልያስ ከእርሱ ጋር ይነጋገሩ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
verses.text_amharic: በክብርም ታይተው በኢየሩሳሌም ሊፈጽም ስላለው ስለ መውጣቱ ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጴጥሮስንና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት እንቅልፍ ከበደባቸው፤ ነቅተው ግን ክብሩንና ከእርሱ ጋር ቆመው የነበሩትን ሁለት ሰዎች አዩ።

verses.text_english: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም ሲለዩ ጴጥሮስ ኢየሱስን። አቤቱ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነውና አንድ ለአንተ አንድም ለሙሴ አንድም ለኤልያስ ሦስት ዳሶች እንሥራ አለው፤ የሚለውንም አያውቅም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሲናገር ደመና መጣና ጋረዳቸው፤ ወደ ደመናውም ሲገቡ ሳሉ ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.text_amharic: ከደመናውም። የመረጥሁት ልጄ ይህ ነው፥ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.text_amharic: ድምፁም ከመጣ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ብቻውን ሆኖ ተገኘ። እነርሱም ዝም አሉ ካዩትም ነገር በዚያ ወራት ምንም ለማንም አላወሩም።

verses.text_english: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም ከተራራ ሲወርዱ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተገናኙት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከሕዝቡ አንድ ሰው እንዲህ እያለ ጮኸ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ለእኔ አንድ ልጅ ነውና ልጄን እንድታይልኝ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ጋኔን ይይዘዋል፥ ድንገትም ይጮኻል አረፋም እያስደፈቀው ያንፈራግጠዋል፥ እየቀጠቀጠም በጭንቅ ይለቀዋል፤

verses.text_english: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርትህንም እንዲያወጡት ለመንሁ፥ አልቻሉምም።

verses.text_english: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እናንተ የማታምን ጠማማ ትውልድ፥ እስከ መቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ልጅህን ወደዚህ አምጣው አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
verses.text_amharic: ሲቀርብም ጋኔኑ ጣለውና አንፈራገጠው፤ ኢየሱስ ግን ርኵሱን መንፈስ ገሥጾ ብላቴናውን ፈወሰው ለአባቱም መለሰው።

verses.text_english: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር ታላቅነት የተነሣ ተገረሙ። ሁሉም ኢየሱስ ባደረገው ሁሉ ሲደነቁ፥

verses.text_english: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። የሰው ልጅ በሰው እጅ ይሰጥ ዘንድ አለውና እናንተ ይህን ቃል በጆሮአችሁ አኑሩ አለ።

verses.text_english: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ይህን ነገር አላስተዋሉም፥ እንዳይገባቸውም ተሰውሮባቸው ነበር፤ ስለዚህ ነገርም እንዳይጠይቁት ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ማን እንዲበልጥ ክርክር ተነሣባቸው።

verses.text_english: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም የልባቸውን አሳብ አውቆ ሕፃንን ያዘ፤ በአጠገቡም አቁሞ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ይህን ሕፃን በስሜ የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፤ የሚቀበለኝም ሁሉ የላከኝን ይቀበላል፤ ከሁላችሁ የሚያንስ እርሱ ታላቅ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም መልሶ። አቤቱ፥ አንድ ሰው በስምህ አጋንንትን ሲያወጣ አየነው፥ ከእኛ ጋርም ስለማይከተል ከለከልነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። የማይቃወማችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና አትከልክሉት አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid not: for he that is not against us is for us.
verses.text_amharic: የሚወጣበትም ወራት በቀረበ ጊዜ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለመሄድ ፊቱን አቀና፥

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.text_amharic: በፊቱም መልክተኞችን ሰደደ። ሄደውም ሊያሰናዱለት ወደ አንድ ወደ ሳምራውያን መንደር ገቡ፤

verses.text_english: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.text_amharic: ፊቱም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደሚሄድ ስለ ነበረ አልተቀበሉትም።

verses.text_english: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስ አይተው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ኤልያስ ደግሞ እንዳደረገ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዶ ያጥፋቸው እንል ዘንድ ትወዳለህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And when his disciples James and John saw , they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ዘወር ብሎ ገሠጻቸውና። ምን ዓይነት መንፈስ እንደ ሆነላችሁ አታውቁም፤

verses.text_english: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ የሰውን ነፍስ ሊያድን እንጂ ሊያጠፋ አልመጣም አለ። ወደ ሌላ መንደርም ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save . And they went to another village.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በመንገድ ሲሄዱ አንድ ሰው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ምትሄድበት ሁሉ እከተልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ለቀበሮዎች ጕድጓድ ለሰማይም ወፎች መሳፈሪያ አላቸው፥ ለሰው ልጅ ግን ራሱን የሚያስጠጋበት የለውም አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay head.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውንም። ተከተለኝ አለው። እርሱ ግን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሜ ልሂድና አባቴን እቀብር ዘንድ ፍቀድልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሙታናቸውን እንዲቀብሩ ሙታንን ተዋቸው፤ አንተስ ሄደህ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ስበክ አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ሌላው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እከተልሃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አስቀድሜ ከቤቴ ሰዎች እንድሰናበት ፍቀድልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። ማንም ዕርፍ በእጁ ይዞ ወደ ኋላ የሚመለከት ለእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የተገባ አይደለም አለው።

verses.text_english: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ጌታ ሌሎቹን ሰብዓ ሾመ፥ ሁለት ሁለትም አድርጎ እርሱ ሊሄድበት ወዳለው ከተማና ስፍራ ሁሉ በፊቱ ላካቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly great, but the labourers few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.text_amharic: አላቸውም። መከሩስ ብዙ ነው፥ ሠራተኞች ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸው፤ እንግዴህ የመከሩን ጌታ ለመከሩ ሠራተኞች እንዲልክ ለምኑት።

verses.text_english: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
verses.text_amharic: ሂዱ፤ እነሆ፥ እንደ በጎች በተኵላዎች መካከል እልካችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
verses.text_amharic: ኮረጆም ከረጢትም ጫማም አትያዙ፤ በመንገድም ለማንም እጅ አትንሡ።

verses.text_english: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace to this house.
verses.text_amharic: ወደምትገቡበት ቤት ሁሉ አስቀድማችሁ። ሰላም ለዚህ ቤት ይሁን በሉ።

verses.text_english: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የሰላም ልጅ ቢኖር፥ ሰላማችሁ ያድርበታል፤ አለዚያም ይመለስላችኋል።

verses.text_english: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቤት ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ካለው እየበላችሁና እየጠጣችሁ ተቀመጡ፤ ለሠራተኛ ደመወዙ ይገባዋልና። ከቤት ወደ ቤት አትተላለፉ።

verses.text_english: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.text_amharic: ወደምትገቡባትም ከተማ ሁሉ ቢቀበሉአችሁ፥ ያቀረቡላችሁን ብሉ፤

verses.text_english: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋም ያሉትን ድውዮችን ፈውሱና። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ቀረበች በሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወደምትገቡባት ከተማ ሁሉ ባይቀበሉአችሁ፥ ወደ አደባባይዋ ወጥታችሁ።

verses.text_english: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማችሁ የተጣበቀብንን ትቢያ እንኳን እናራግፍላችኋለን፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ግን ወደ እናንተ እንደ ቀረበች ይህን እወቁ በሉ።

verses.text_english: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያን ቀን ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶም ይቀልላታል።

verses.text_english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.text_amharic: ወዮልሽ ኮራዚን፥ ወዮልሽ ቤተ ሳይዳ፤ በእናንተ የተደረገው ተአምራት በጢሮስና በሲዶና ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ ማቅ ለብሰው በአመድም ተቀምጠው ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት ንስሐ በገቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በፍርድ ከእናንተ ይልቅ ለጢሮስና ለሲዶና ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺም ቅፍርናሆም፥ እስከ ሰማይ ከፍ አልሽን? ወደ ሲኦል ትወርጃለሽ።

verses.text_english: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: የሚሰማችሁ እኔን ይሰማል፥ እናንተንም የጣለ እኔን ይጥላል፤ እኔንም የጣለ የላከኝን ይጥላል።

verses.text_english: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
verses.text_amharic: ሰብዓውም በደስታ ተመልሰው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አጋንንት ስንኳ በስምህ ተገዝተውልናል አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው ሰይጣንን እንደ መብረቅ ከሰማይ ሲወድቅ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እባቡንና ጊንጡን ትረግጡ ዘንድ፥ በጠላትም ኃይል ሁሉ ላይ ሥልጣን ሰጥቻችኋለሁ፥ የሚጐዳችሁም ምንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መናፍስት ስለ ተገዙላችሁ በዚህ ደስ አይበላችሁ፥ ስማችሁ ግን በሰማያት ሰለ ተጻፈ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ሰዓት ኢየሱስ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ሐሤት አደረገና። የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ አባት ሆይ፥ ይህን ከጥበበኞችና ከአስተዋዮች ሰውረህ ለሕፃናት ስለ ገለጥህላቸው አመሰግናለሁ፤ አዎን አባት ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህ በፊትህ እንዲህ ሆኖአልና።

verses.text_english: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and to whom the Son will reveal .
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ከአባቴ ዘንድ ተሰጥቶኛል፥ ወልድንም ማን እንደ ሆነ ከአብ በቀር የሚያውቅ የለም፥ አብንም ማን እንደ ሆነ ከወልድ በቀር ወልድም ሊገልጥለት ከሚፈቅድ በቀር የሚያውቅ የለም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he turned him unto disciples, and said privately, Blessed the eyes which see the things that ye see:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ዘወር ብሎ ለብቻቸው። የምታዩትን የሚያዩ ዓይኖች ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard .
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና፥ እናንተ የምታዩትን ብዙዎች ነቢያትና ነገሥታት ሊያዩ ወደዱ አላዩምም፥ የምትሰሙትንም ሊሰሙ ወድደው አልሰሙም አለ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሕግ አዋቂ ሊፈትነው ተነሥቶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንድወርስ ምን ላድርግ? አለው።

verses.text_english: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በሕግ የተጻፈው ምንድር ነው? እንዴትስ ታነባለህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ጌታ አምላክህን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹም ነፍስህም በፍጹም ኃይልህም በፍጹም አሳብህም ውደድ፥ ባልንጀራህንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እውነት መለስህ፤ ይህን አድርግ በሕይወትም ትኖራለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ራሱን ሊያጸድቅ ወድዶ ኢየሱስን። ባልንጀራዬስ ማን ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said, A certain went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded , and departed, leaving half dead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። አንድ ሰው ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ኢያሪኮ ወረደ በወንበዴዎችም እጅ ወደቀ፤ እነርሱም ደግሞ ገፈፉት ደበደቡትም በሕይወትና በሞት መካከልም ትተውት ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገትም አንድ ካህን በዚያ መንገድ ወረደ አይቶትም ገለል ብሎ አለፈ።

verses.text_english: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked , and passed by on the other side.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ደግሞ አንድ ሌዋዊ ወደዚያ ስፍራ መጣና አይቶት ገለል ብሎ አለፈ።

verses.text_english: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion ,
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሳምራዊ ግን ሲሄድ ወደ እርሱ መጣ አይቶትም አዘነለት፥

verses.text_english: And went to , and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.text_amharic: ቀርቦም ዘይትና የወይን ጠጅ በቍስሎቹ ላይ አፍስሶ አሰራቸው፥ በራሱ አህያም ላይ አስቀምጦት ወደ እንግዶች ማደርያ ወሰደው ጠበቀውም።

verses.text_english: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱም ሁለት ዲናር አውጥቶ ለባለቤቱ ሰጠና። ጠብቀው፥ ከዚህም በላይ የምትከስረውን ሁሉ እኔ ስመለስ እከፍልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከነዚህ ከሦስቱ በወንበዴዎች እጅ ለወደቀው ባልንጀራ የሆነው ማንኛው ይመስልሃል?

verses.text_english: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ምሕረት ያደረገለት አለ። ኢየሱስም። ሂድ አንተም እንዲሁ አድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄዱም እርሱ ወደ አንዲት መንደር ገባ፤ ማርታ የተባለች አንዲት ሴትም በቤትዋ ተቀበለችው።

verses.text_english: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርስዋም ማርያም የምትባል እኅት ነበረቻት፥ እርስዋም ደግሞ ቃሉን ልትሰማ በኢየሱስ እግር አጠገብ ተቀምጣ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.text_amharic: ማርታ ግን አገልግሎት ስለ በዛባት ባከነች፤ ቀርባም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ እንድሠራ እኅቴ ብቻዬን ስትተወኝ አይገድህምን? እንኪያስ እንድታግዘኝ ንገራት አለችው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ማርታ፥ ማርታ፥ በብዙ ነገር ትጨነቂአለሽ ትታወኪማለሽ፥

verses.text_english: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስፈልገው ግን ጥቂት ወይም አንድ ነገር ነው፤ ማርያምም መልካም ዕድልን መርጣለች ከእርስዋም አይወሰድባትም አላት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በአንድ ስፍራ ይጸልይ ነበር፥ በጨረሰም ጊዜ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን እንዳስተማረ እንጸልይ ዘንድ አስተምረን አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
verses.text_amharic: አላቸውም። ስትጸልዩ እንዲህ በሉ። በሰማያት የምትኖር አባታችን ሆይ፤ ስምህ ይቀደስ፤ መንግሥትህ ትምጣ፤ ፈቃድህ በሰማይ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በምድር ትሁን፤

verses.text_english: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.text_amharic: የዕለት እንጀራችንን ዕለት ዕለት ስጠን፤

verses.text_english: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአታችንንም ይቅር በለን፥ እኛ ደግሞ የበደሉንን ሁሉ ይቅር ብለናልና፤ ከክፉ አድነን እንጂ ወደ ፈተና አታግባን።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ከእናንተ ማናቸውም ወዳጅ ያለው፥ በእኩል ሌሊትስ ወደ እርሱ ሄዶ። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ሦስት እንጀራ አበድረኝ፥

verses.text_english: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ወዳጄ ከመንገድ ወደ እኔ መጥቶ የማቀርብለት የለኝምና ይላልን?

verses.text_english: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ከውስጥ መልሶ። አታድክመኝ፤ አሁን ደጁ ተቈልፎአል ልጆቼም ከእኔ ጋር በአልጋ ላይ አሉ፤ ተነሥቼ ልሰጥህ አልችልም ይላልን?

verses.text_english: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ ወዳጅ ስለ ሆነ ተነሥቶ ባይሰጠው እንኳ፥ ስለ ንዝነዛው ተነስቶ የሚፈልገውን ሁሉ ይሰጠዋል።

verses.text_english: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እላችኋለሁ። ለምኑ፥ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ ፈልጉ፥ ታገኙማላችሁ፤ መዝጊያን አንኳኩ፥ ይከፍትላችሁማል።

verses.text_english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.text_amharic: የሚለምን ሁሉ ይቀበላልና፥ የሚፈልግም ያገኛል፥ መዝጊያውንም ለሚያንኳኳው ይከፈትለታል።

verses.text_english: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.text_amharic: አባት ከሆናችሁ ከእናንተ ከማንኛችሁም ልጁ እንጀራ ቢለምነው፥ እርሱም ድንጋይ ይሰጠዋልን? ዓሣ ደግሞ ቢለምነው በዓሣ ፋንታ እባብ ይሰጠዋልን?

verses.text_english: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ እንቍላል ቢለምነው ጊንጥ ይሰጠዋልን?

verses.text_english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
verses.text_amharic: እንኪያስ እናንተ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ስጦታ መስጠት ካወቃችሁ፥ በሰማይ ያለው አባት ለሚለምኑት እንዴት አብልጦ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ይሰጣቸው?

verses.text_english: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
verses.text_amharic: ዲዳውንም ጋኔን ያወጣ ነበር፤ ጋኔኑም ከወጣ በኋላ ዲዳው ተናገረ ሕዝቡም ተደነቁ፤

verses.text_english: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከእነርሱ አንዳንዱ። በብዔል ዜቡል በአጋንንት አለቃ አጋንንትን ያወጣል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And others, tempting , sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችም ሲፈትኑት ከሰማይ ምልክት ከእርሱ ይፈልጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house against a house falleth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እርስ በርስዋ የምትለያይ መንግሥት ሁሉ ትጠፋለች፤ ቤትም በቤት ላይ ይወድቃል።

verses.text_english: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ አጋንንትን በብዔል ዜቡል እንዳወጣ ትላላችሁና ሰይጣን ደግሞ እርስ በርሱ ከተለያየ መንግሥቱ እንዴት ትቆማለች?

verses.text_english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.text_amharic: እኔስ በብዔል ዜቡል አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ ልጆቻችሁ በማን ያወጡአቸዋል? ስለዚህ እነርሱ ፈራጆች ይሆኑባችኋል።

verses.text_english: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ጣት አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ደርሳለች።

verses.text_english: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
verses.text_amharic: ኃይለኛ ሰው ጋሻና ጦር ይዞ የራሱን ግቢ ቢጠብቅ፥ ያለው ገንዘቡ በሰላም ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱ ይልቅ የሚበረታ መጥቶ ሲያሸንፈው ግን፥ ታምኖበት የነበረውን ጋሻና ጦር ይወስድበታል ምርኮውንም ያካፍላል።

verses.text_english: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ያልሆነ ይቃወመኛል፥ ከእኔ ጋርም የማያከማች ይበትናል።

verses.text_english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
verses.text_amharic: ርኵስ መንፈስ ከሰው በወጣ ጊዜ ዕረፍትን እየፈለገ ውኃ በሌለበት ቦታ ያልፋል፤ ባያገኝም። ወደ ወጣሁበት ቤቴ እመለሳለሁ ይላል፤

verses.text_english: And when he cometh, he findeth swept and garnished.
verses.text_amharic: ሲመጣም ተጠርጎ አጊጦም ያገኘዋል።

verses.text_english: Then goeth he, and taketh seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last of that man is worse than the first.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወዲያ ይሄድና ከእርሱ የከፉትን ሌሎችን ሰባት አጋንንት ከእርሱ ጋር ይይዛል፥ ገብተውም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፤ ለዚያም ሰው ከፊተኛው ይልቅ የኋለኛው ይብስበታል።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሲናገር፥ ከሕዝቡ አንዲት ሴት ድምፅዋን ከፍ አድርጋ። የተሸከመችህ ማኅፀንና የጠባሃቸው ጡቶች ብፁዓን ናቸው አለችው።

verses.text_english: But he said, Yea rather, blessed they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። አዎን፥ ብፁዓንስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰምተው የሚጠብቁት ናቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕዝብም በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ እንዲህ ይል ጀመር። ይህ ትውልድ ክፉ ነው፤ ምልክት ይፈልጋል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም።

verses.text_english: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
verses.text_amharic: ዮናስ ለነነዌ ሰዎች ምልክት እንደ ሆናቸው፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ የሰው ልጅ ለዚህ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon here.
verses.text_amharic: ንግሥተ አዜብ በፍርድ ከዚህ ትውልድ ሰዎች ጋር ተነሥታ ትፈርድባቸዋለች፤ የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ለመስማት ከምድር ዳር መጥታለችና፥ እነሆም፥ ከሰሎሞን የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.text_english: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas here.
verses.text_amharic: የነነዌ ሰዎች በፍርድ ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥተው ይፈርዱበታል፤ በዮናስ ስብከት ንስሐ ገብተዋልና፥ እነሆም፥ ከዮናስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.text_english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
verses.text_amharic: መብራትንም አብርቶ በስውር ወይም በእንቅብ በታች የሚያኖረው የለም፥ የሚገቡ ሰዎች ብርሃኑን እንዲያዩ በመቅረዝ ላይ ያኖረዋል እንጂ።

verses.text_english: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when is evil, thy body also full of darkness.
verses.text_amharic: የሰውነትህ መብራት ዓይንህ ናት። ዓይንህ ጤናማ በሆነች ጊዜ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ ደግሞ ብሩህ ይሆናል። ዓይንህ ታማሚ በሆነች ጊዜ ግን ሰውነትህ ደግሞ የጨለመ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በአንተ ያለው ብርሃን ጨለማ እንዳይሆን ተመልከት።

verses.text_english: If thy whole body therefore full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ የጨለማ ቍራጭ የሌለበት ብሩህ ቢሆን፥ መብራት በደመቀ ብርሃን እንደሚያበራልህ በጭራሽ ብሩህ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንንም ሲናገር አንድ ፈሪሳዊ ከእርሱ ጋር ምሳ ይበላ ዘንድ ለመነው ገብቶም ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And when the Pharisee saw , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሳም በፊት አስቀድሞ እንዳልታጠበ ባየው ጊዜ ፈሪሳዊው ተደነቀ።

verses.text_english: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም እንዲህ አለው። አሁን እናንተ ፈሪሳውያን የጽዋውንና የወጭቱን ውጭ ታጠራላችሁ፥ ውስጣችሁ ግን ቅሚያና ክፋት ሞልቶበታል

verses.text_english: fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
verses.text_amharic: እናንት ደንቆሮዎች፥ የውጭውን የፈጠረ የውስጡን ደግሞ አልፈጠረምን?

verses.text_english: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በውስጥ ያለውን ምጽዋት አድርጋችሁ ስጡ፥ እነሆም፥ ሁሉ ንጹሕ ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.text_english: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እናንተ ፈሪሳውያን፥ ከአዝሙድና ከጤና አዳም ከአትክልትም ሁሉ አሥራት ስለምታወጡ፥ ፍርድንና እግዚአብሔርን መውደድ ስለምትተላለፉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን ሌላውን ሳትተዉ ይህን ልታደርጉት ይገባችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ፈሪሳውያን፥ በምኵራብ የከበሬታ ወንበር በገበያም ሰላምታ ስለምትወዱ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over are not aware .
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ሰዎች ሳያውቁ በላዩ የሚሄዱበት የተሰወረ መቃብር ስለምትመስሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕግ አዋቂዎችም አንዱ መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህን ማለትህ እኛን ደግሞ መስደብህ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Woe unto you also, lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ ደግሞ ሕግ አዋቂዎች፥ አስቸጋሪ ሸክም ለሰዎች ስለምታሸክሙ፥ ራሳችሁም በአንዲት ጣታችሁ ስንኳ ሸክሙን ስለማትነኩት፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችሁ የገደሉአቸውን የነቢያትን መቃብር ስለምትሠሩ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ለአባቶቻችሁ ሥራ ትመሰክራላችሁ ትስማማላችሁም፤ እነርሱ ገድለዋቸዋልና፥ እናንተም መቃብራቸውን ትሠራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and of them they shall slay and persecute:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ እንዲህ አለች። ወደ እነርሱ ነቢያትንና ሐዋርያትን እልካለሁ፥ ከእነርሱም ይገድላሉ ያሳድዱማል፥

verses.text_english: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.text_amharic: ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ የፈሰሰው የነቢያት ሁሉ ደም፥

verses.text_english: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
verses.text_amharic: ከአቤል ደም ጀምሮ በመሠዊያውና በቤተ መቅደስ መካከል እስከ ጠፋው እስከ ዘካርያስ ደም ድረስ፥ ከዚህ ትውልድ እንዲፈለግ አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚህ ትውልድ ይፈለጋል።

verses.text_english: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሕግ አዋቂዎች፥ የእውቀትን መክፈቻ ስለ ወሰዳችሁ፥ ወዮላችሁ ራሳችሁ አልገባችሁም የሚገቡትንም ከለከላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ የሕዝብ አእላፍ እርስ በርሳቸው እስኪረጋገጡ ድረስ ተሰብስበው ሳሉ፥ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ ይል ጀመር። አስቀድማችሁ ከፈሪሳውያን እርሾ ተጠበቁ፥ እርሱም ግብዝነት ነው።

verses.text_english: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የማይገለጥ የተከደነ፥ የማይታወቅም የተሰወረ ምንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በጨለማ የምትናገሩት ሁሉ በብርሃን ይሰማል፥ በእልፍኝም ውስጥ በጆሮ የምትናገሩት በሰገነት ላይ ይሰበካል።

verses.text_english: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተም ለወዳጆቼ እላችኋለሁ፥ ሥጋን የሚገድሉትን በኋላም አንድ ስንኳ የሚበልጥ ሊያደርጉ የማይችሉትን አትፍሩ።

verses.text_english: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን የምትፈሩትን አሳያችኋለሁ፤ ከገደለ በኋላ ወደ ገሃነም ለመጣል ሥልጣን ያለውን ፍሩ። አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ እርሱን ፍሩ።

verses.text_english: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
verses.text_amharic: አምስት ድንቢጦች በአሥር ሳንቲም ይሸጡ የለምን? ከእነርሱም አንዲቱ ስንኳ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አትረሳም።

verses.text_english: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የእናንተ የራሳችሁ ጠጕር ሁሉ እንኳ የተቈጠረ ነው፤ እንግዲያስ አትፍሩ ከብዙ ድንቢጦች ትበልጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
verses.text_amharic: እላችሁማለሁ፥ በሰው ፊት የሚመሰክርልኝ ሁሉ፥ የሰው ልጅ ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት ይመሰክርለታል፤

verses.text_english: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
verses.text_amharic: በሰውም ፊት የሚክደኝ በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት ይካዳል።

verses.text_english: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
verses.text_amharic: በሰው ልጅም ላይ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይሰረይለታል፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስን የሚሰድብ ግን አይሰረይለትም።

verses.text_english: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምኵራቦችና ወደ መኳንንቶችም ወደ ገዢዎችም ሲጐትቱአችሁ፥ እንዴት ወይም ምን እንድትመልሱ ወይም እንድትናገሩ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.text_english: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስ ቅዱስ በዚያች ሰዓት ልትናገሩ የሚገባችሁን ያስተምራችኋልና።

verses.text_english: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝቡም አንድ ሰው። መምህር ሆይ፥ ርስቱን ከእኔ ጋር እንዲካፈል ለወንድሜ ንገረው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አንተ ሰው፥ ፈራጅና አካፋይ በላያችሁ አንድሆን ማን ሾመኝ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ሕይወት በገንዘቡ ብዛት አይደለምና ተጠንቀቁ፥ ከመጐምጀትም ሁሉ ተጠበቁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌም ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል። አንድ ባለ ጠጋ ሰው እርሻ እጅግ ፍሬያም ሆነችለት።

verses.text_english: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ፍሬዬን የማከማችበት ስፍራ አጥቻለሁና ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ አደርጋለሁ፤ ጐተራዬን አፍርሼ ሌላ የሚበልጥ እሠራለሁ፥ በዚያም ፍሬዬንና በረከቴን ሁሉ አከማቻለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, be merry.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴንም። አንቺ ነፍሴ፥ ለብዙ ዘመን የሚቀር ብዙ በረከት አለሽ፤ ዕረፊ፥ ብዪ፥ ጠጪ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ እላታለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: But God said unto him, fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን። አንተ ሰነፍ፥ በዚች ሌሊት ነፍስህን ከአንተ ሊወስዱአት ይፈልጓታል፤ ይህስ የሰበሰብኸው ለማን ይሆናል? አለው።

verses.text_english: So he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሱ ገንዘብ የሚያከማች፥ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድም ባለ ጠጋ ያልሆነ እንዲህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
verses.text_amharic: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ለነፍሳችሁ በምትበሉት ወይም ለሰውነታችሁ በምትለብሱት አትጨነቁ።

verses.text_english: The life is more than meat, and the body than raiment.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስ ከመብል ሰውነትም ከልብስ ይበልጣልና።
