verses.text_english: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verses.text_amharic: ቍራዎችን ተመልከቱ፤ አይዘሩም አያጭዱምም፥ ዕቃ ቤትም ወይም ጎተራ የላቸውም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ይመግባቸዋል፤ እናንተስ ከወፎች እንዴት ትበልጣላችሁ?

verses.text_english: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ተጨንቆ በቁመቱ ላይ አንድ ክንድ መጨመር የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ትንሹን ነገር ስንኳ የማትችሉ ከሆናችሁ፥ ስለ ምን በሌላ ትጨነቃላችሁ?

verses.text_english: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.text_amharic: አበቦችን እንዴት እንዲያድጉ ተመልከቱ፤ አይደክሙም አይፈትሉምም፤ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰሎሞንስ እንኳ በክብሩ ሁሉ ከእነዚህ እንደ አንዲቱ አለበሰም።

verses.text_english: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more you, O ye of little faith?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ ያለውን ነገም ወደ እቶን የሚጣለውን በሜዳ የሆነውን ሣር እንዲህ የሚያለብሰው ከሆነ፥ እናንተ እምነት የጐደላችሁ፥ እናንተንማ ይልቁን እንዴት?

verses.text_english: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም የምትበሉትን የምትጠጡትንም አትፈልጉ፥ አታወላውሉም፤

verses.text_english: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንስ ሁሉ በዓለም ያሉ አሕዛብ ይፈልጉታልና፤ የእናንተም አባት ይህ እንዲያስፈልጋችሁ ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን መንግሥቱን ፈልጉ ይህም ሁሉ ይጨመርላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ታናሽ መንጋ፥ መንግሥትን ሊሰጣችሁ የአባታችሁ በጎ ፈቃድ ነውና አትፍሩ።

verses.text_english: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
verses.text_amharic: ያላችሁን ሽጡ ምጽዋትም ስጡ፤ ሌባ በማይቀርብበት ብልም በማያጠፋበት በሰማያት የማያልቅ መዝገብ የሚሆኑትን የማያረጁትንም ኮረጆዎች ለራሳችሁ አድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.text_amharic: መዝገባችሁ ባለበት ልባችሁ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናልና።

verses.text_english: Let your loins be girded about, and lights burning;
verses.text_amharic: ወገባችሁ የታጠቀ መብራታችሁም የበራ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ጌታቸው መጥቶ ደጁን ሲያንኳኳ ወዲያው እንዲከፍቱለት ከሰርግ እስኪመለስ ድረስ የሚጠብቁ ሰዎችን ምሰሉ

verses.text_english: Blessed those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታቸው በመጣ ጊዜ ሲተጉ የሚያገኛቸው እነዚያ ባሪያዎች ብፁዓን ናቸው፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ታጥቆ በማዕድ ያስቀምጣቸዋል ቀርቦም ያገለግላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find so, blessed are those servants.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌሊቱም በሁለተኛው ወይም በሦስተኛው ክፍል መጥቶ እንዲሁ ቢያገኛቸው፥ እነዚያ ባሪያዎች ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ግን እወቁ ባለቤት በምን ሰዓት ሌባ እንዲመጣ ቢያውቅ ኖሮ፥ በነቃ፥ ቤቱም እንዲቆፈር ባልፈቀደም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደግሞ ተዘጋጅታችሁ ኑሩ፥ የሰው ልጅ በማታስቡበት ሰዓት ይመጣልና።

verses.text_english: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን ምሳሌ ለእኛ ወይስ ደግሞ ለሁሉ ትናገራለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom lord shall make ruler over his household, to give portion of meat in due season?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም አለ። እንኪያስ ምግባቸውን በጊዜው ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ጌታው በቤተ ሰዎቹ ላይ የሚሾመው ታማኝና ልባም መጋቢ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Blessed that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታው መጥቶ እንዲህ ሲያደርግ የሚያገኘው ያ ባሪያ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.text_english: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ባለው ሁሉ ላይ ይሾመዋል።

verses.text_english: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.text_amharic: ያ ባሪያ ግን። ጌታዬ እስኪመጣ ይዘገያል ብሎ በልቡ ቢያስብ ሎሌዎችንና ገረዶችንም ይመታ ይበላም ይጠጣም ይሰክርም ዘንድ ቢጀምር፥

verses.text_english: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for , and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያ ባሪያ ጌታ ባልጠበቃት ቀን ባላወቃትም ሰዓት ይመጣል፥ ከሁለትም ይሰነጥቀዋል እድሉንም ከማይታመኑ ጋር ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not , neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many .
verses.text_amharic: የጌታውንም ፈቃድ አውቆ ያልተዘጋጀ እንደ ፈቃዱም ያላደረገ ያ ባሪያ እጅግ ይገረፋል፤

verses.text_english: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few . For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verses.text_amharic: ያላወቀ ግን መገረፍ የሚገባውንም ያደረገ ጥቂት ይገረፋል። ብዙም ከተሰጠው ሰው ሁሉ ከእርሱ ብዙ ይፈለግበታል፥ ብዙ አደራም ከተሰጠው ከእርሱ አብዝተው ይሹበታል።

verses.text_english: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ እሳት ልጥል መጣሁ፥ አሁንም የነደደ ከሆነ ዘንድ ምን እፈልጋለሁ?

verses.text_english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የምጠመቃት ጥምቀት አለችኝ፥ እስክትፈጸምም ድረስ እንዴት እጨነቃለሁ?

verses.text_english: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ሰላምንም ለመስጠት የመጣሁ ይመስላችኋልን? እላችኋለሁ፥ አይደለም፥ መለያየትን እንጂ።

verses.text_english: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሁን ጀምሮ በአንዲት ቤት አምስት ሰዎች ይኖራሉና፤ ሦስቱም በሁለቱ ላይ ሁለቱም በሦስቱ ላይ ተነሥተው ይለያያሉ።

verses.text_english: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.text_amharic: አባት በልጁ ላይ ልጅም በአባቱ ላይ፥ እናት በልጅዋ ላይ ልጅዋም በእናትዋ ላይ፥ አማት በምራትዋ ላይ ምራትም በአማትዋ ላይ ተነሥተው ይለያያሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አለ። ደመና ከምዕራብ ሲወጣ ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ወዲያው። ዝናብ ይመጣል ትላላችሁ፥ እንዲሁም ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And when the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
verses.text_amharic: በአዜብም ነፋስ ሲነፍስ። ትኩሳት ይሆናል ትላላችሁ፥ ይሆንማል።

verses.text_english: hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
verses.text_amharic: እናንት ግብዞች፥ የምድሩንና የሰማዩን ፊት ልትመረምሩ ታውቃላችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ይህን ዘመን የማትመረምሩ እንዴት ነው?

verses.text_english: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.text_amharic: ራሳችሁ ደግሞ ጽድቅን የማትፈርዱ ስለ ምን ነው?

verses.text_english: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
verses.text_amharic: ከባላጋራህ ጋር ወደ ሹም ብትሄድ፥ ወደ ዳኛ እንዳይጐትትህ ዳኛውም ለሎሌው አሳልፎ እንዳይሰጥህ ሎሌውም በወኅኒ እንዳይጥልህ፥ ገና በመንገድ ሳለህ ከባላጋራህ እንድትታረቅ ትጋ።

verses.text_english: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
verses.text_amharic: እልሃለሁ፥ የመጨረሻዋን ግማሽ ሳንቲም እስክትከፍል ድረስ ከዚያ ከቶ አትወጣም።

verses.text_english: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰዎች መጥተው ጲላጦስ ደማቸውን ከመሥዋዕታቸው ጋር ስላደባለቀው ስለ ገሊላ ሰዎች አወሩለት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እነዚህ የገሊላ ሰዎች ይህ ስለ ደረሰባቸው ከገሊላ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ኃጢአተኞች የሆኑ ይመስሉአችኋልን?

verses.text_english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ንስሐ ባትገቡ ሁላችሁ እንዲሁ ትጠፋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ በሰሌሆም ግንቡ የወደቀባቸውና የገደላቸው እነዚያ አሥራ ስምንት ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌም ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ በደለኞች ይመስሉአችኋልን? አይደለም፥ እላችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ንስሐ ባትገቡ ሁላችሁ እንደዚሁ ትጠፋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: He spake also this parable; A certain had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ምሳሌ አለ። ለአንድ ሰው በወይኑ አትክልት የተተከለች በለስ ነበረችው፥ ፍሬም ሊፈልግባት መጥቶ ምንም አላገኘም።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
verses.text_amharic: የወይን አትክልት ሠራተኛውንም። እነሆ፥ ከዚህች በለስ ፍሬ ልፈልግ ሦስት ዓመት እየመጣሁ ምንም አላገኘሁም፤ ቍረጣት፤ ስለ ምን ደግሞ መሬቱን ታጐሳቍላለች? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung :
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ዙሪያዋን እስክኰተኵትላትና ፋንድያ እስካፈስላት ድረስ በዚች ዓመት ደግሞ ተዋት።

verses.text_english: And if it bear fruit, : and if not, after that thou shalt cut it down.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊትም ብታፈራ፥ ደኅና ነው፤ ያለዚያ ግን ትቈርጣታለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበትም በአንድ ምኵራብ ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up .
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከአሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ጀምሮ የድካም መንፈስ ያደረባት ሴት ነበረች፥ እርስዋም ጐባጣ ነበረች ቀንታም ልትቆም ከቶ አልተቻላትም።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus saw her, he called , and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ባያት ጊዜ ጠራትና። አንቺ ሴት፥ ከድካምሽ ተፈትተሻል አላት፥ እጁንም ጫነባት፤

verses.text_english: And he laid hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜም ቀጥ አለች፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመሰገነች።

verses.text_english: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: የምኵራብ አለቃ ግን ኢየሱስ በሰንበት ስለ ፈወሰ ተቈጥቶ መለሰና ሕዝቡን። ሊሠራባቸው የሚገባ ስድስት ቀኖች አሉ፤ እንግዲህ በእነርሱ መጥታችሁ ተፈወሱ እንጂ በሰንበት አይደለም አለ።

verses.text_english: The Lord then answered him, and said, hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or ass from the stall, and lead away to watering?
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም መልሶ። እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ በሰንበት በሬውን ወይስ አህያውን ከግርግሙ ፈትቶ ውኃ ሊያጠጣው ይወስደው የለምን?

verses.text_english: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
verses.text_amharic: ይህችም የአብርሃም ልጅ ሆና ከአሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ጀምሮ ሰይጣን ያሰራት በሰንበት ቀን ከዚህ እስራት ልትፈታ አይገባምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሲናገር ሳለ የተቃወሙት ሁሉ አፈሩ፤ ከእርሱም በተደረገው ድንቅ ሁሉ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ምን ትመስላለች፥ በምንስ አስመስላታለሁ?

verses.text_english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ወስዶ በአትክልቱ የጣላትን የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት ትመስላለች፤ አደገችም ታላቅ ዛፍም ሆነች፥ የሰማይ ወፎችም በቅርንጫፎችዋ ሰፈሩ አለ።

verses.text_english: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት በምን አስመስላታለሁ?

verses.text_english: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ወስዳ ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ በሦስት መስፈሪያ ዱቄት የሸሸገችውን እርሾ ትመስላለች አለ።

verses.text_english: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲሄድ ከተማዎችንና መንደሮችን እያስተማረ ያልፍ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የሚድኑ ጥቂቶች ናቸውን? አለው። እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.text_amharic: በጠበበው በር ለመግባት ተጋደሉ፤ እላችኋለሁና፥ ብዙዎች ሊገቡ ይፈልጋሉ አይችሉምም።

verses.text_english: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
verses.text_amharic: ባለቤቱ ተነሥቶ በሩን ከቈለፈ በኋላ፥ እናንተ በውጭ ቆማችሁ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክፈትልን እያላችሁ በሩን ልታንኳኩ ትጀምራላችሁ እርሱም መልሶ። ከወዴት እንደ ሆናችሁ አላውቃችሁም ይላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም። በፊትህ በላን ጠጣንም በአደባባያችንም አስተማርህ ልትሉ ትጀምራላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all workers of iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እላችኋለሁ፥ ከወዴት እንደ ሆናችሁ አላውቃችሁም፤ ሁላችሁ ዓመፀኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ ይላችኋል።

verses.text_english: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you thrust out.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃምንና ይስሐቅን ያዕቆብንም ነቢያትንም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ ግን ወደ ውጭ ተጥላችሁ ስትቀሩ፥ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And they shall come from the east, and the west, and from the north, and the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብም ከሰሜንና ከደቡብም ይመጣሉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት በማዕድ ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከኋለኞች ፊተኞች የሚሆኑ አሉ፥ ከፊተኞችም ኋለኞች የሚሆኑ አሉ።

verses.text_english: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ሰዓት ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዱ ቀርበው። ሄሮድስ ሊገድልህ ይወዳልና ከዚህ ውጣና ሂድ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third I shall be perfected.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ሄዳችሁ ለዚያች ቀበሮ። እነሆ፥ ዛሬና ነገ አጋንንትን አወጣለሁ በሽተኞችንም እፈውሳለሁ፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን እፈጸማለሁ በሉአት።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን ነቢይ ከኢየሩሳሌም ውጭ ይጠፋ ዘንድ አይገባውምና ዛሬና ነገ ከነገ በስቲያም ልሄድ ያስፈልገኛል።

verses.text_english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen her brood under wings, and ye would not!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም፥ ኢየሩሳሌም፥ ነቢያትን የምትገድል ወደ እርስዋ የተላኩትንም የምትወግር፥ ዶሮ ጫጩቶችዋን በክንፎችዋ በታች እንደምትሰበስብ ልጆችሽን እሰበስብ ዘንድ ስንት ጊዜ ወደድሁ፥ እናንተም አልወደዳችሁም።

verses.text_english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until come when ye shall say, Blessed he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ቤታችሁ የተፈታ ሆኖ ይቀርላችኋል። እላችኋለሁም፥ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው እስክትሉ ድረስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታዩኝም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበትም ከፈሪሳውያን አለቆች ወደ አንዱ ቤት እንጀራ ሊበላ በገባ ጊዜ እነርሱ ይጠባበቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሆዱ የተነፋ ሰው በፊቱ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። በሰንበት መፈወስ ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? ብሎ ለሕግ አዋቂዎችና ለፈሪሳውያን ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: And they held their peace. And he took , and healed him, and let him go;
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ዝም አሉ። ይዞም ፈወሰውና አሰናበተው።

verses.text_english: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ አህያው ወይስ በሬው በጕድጓድ ቢወድቅ በሰንበት ወዲያው የማያወጣው ማን ነው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they could not answer him again to these things.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ነገርም ሊመልሱለት አልተቻላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
verses.text_amharic: የታደሙትንም የከበሬታ ስፍራ እንደ መረጡ ተመልክቶ ምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.text_english: When thou art bidden of any to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ለሰርግ ቢጠራህ በከበሬታ ስፍራ አትቀመጥ፤ ምናልባት ከአንተ ይልቅ የከበረ ተጠርቶ ይሆናልና አንተን እርሱንም የጠራ መጥቶ።

verses.text_english: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህ ስፍራ ተውለት ይልሃል፥ በዚያን ጊዜም እያፈርህ በዝቅተኛው ስፍራ ልትሆን ትጀምራለህ።

verses.text_english: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በተጠራህ ጊዜ፥ የጠራህ መጥቶ። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ወደ ላይ ውጣ እንዲልህ፥ ሄደህ በዝቅተኛው ስፍራ ተቀመጥ፤ ያን ጊዜም ከአንተ ጋር በተቀመጡት ሁሉ ፊት ክብር ይሆንልሃል።

verses.text_english: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፥ ራሱንም የሚያዋርድ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
verses.text_amharic: የጠራውንም ደግሞ እንዲህ አለው። ምሳ ወይም እራት ባደረግህ ጊዜ፥ እነርሱ ደግሞ በተራቸው ምናልባት እንዳይጠሩህ ብድራትም እንዳይመልሱልህ፥ ወዳጆችህንና ወንድሞችህን ዘመዶችህንም ባለ ጠጎች ጎረቤቶችህንም አትጥራ።

verses.text_english: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ግብዣ ባደረግህ ጊዜ ድሆችንና ጕንድሾችን አንካሶችንም ዕውሮችንም ጥራ፤

verses.text_english: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
verses.text_amharic: የሚመልሱት ብድራት የላቸውምና ብፁዕ ትሆናለህ፤ በጻድቃን ትንሣኤ ይመለስልሃልና።

verses.text_english: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከተቀመጡትም አንዱ ይህን ሰምቶ። በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንጀራ የሚበላ ብፁዕ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አለው። አንድ ሰው ታላቅ እራት አድርጎ ብዙዎችን ጠራ፤

verses.text_english: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
verses.text_amharic: በእራትም ሰዓት የታደሙትን። አሁን ተዘጋጅቶአልና ኑ እንዲላቸው ባሪያውን ላከ።

verses.text_english: And they all with one began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት ያመካኙ ጀመር። የፊተኛው። መሬት ገዝቼአለሁ ወጥቼም ላየው በግድ ያስፈልገኛል፤ ይቅር እንድትለኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም። አምስት ጥምድ በሬዎች ገዝቼአለሁ ልፈትናቸውም እሄዳለሁ፤ ይቅር እንድትለኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም። ሚስት አግብቼአለሁ ስለዚህም ልመጣ አልችልም አለው።

verses.text_english: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያውም ደርሶ ይህን ለጌታው ነገረው። በዚያን ጊዜ ባለቤቱ ተቆጥቶ ባሪያውን። ወደ ከተማ ጎዳናና ወደ ስላች ፈጥነህ ውጣ ድሆችንና ጕንድሾችን አንካሶችንና ዕውሮችንም ወደዚህ አግባ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንዳዘዝኸኝ ተደርጎአል፥ ገናም ስፍራ አለ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም ባሪያውን። ቤቴ እንዲሞላ ወደ መንገድና ወደ ቅጥር ውጣና ይገቡ ዘንድ ግድ በላቸው፤

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና፥ ከታደሙት ከእነዚያ ሰዎች አንድ ስንኳ እራቴን አይቀምስም አለው።

verses.text_english: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
verses.text_amharic: ብዙም ሕዝብ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሄዱ ነበር፥ ዘወር ብሎም እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: If any come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ቢኖር አባቱንና እናቱን ሚስቱንም ልጆቹንም ወንድሞቹንም እኅቶቹንም የራሱን ሕይወት ስንኳ ሳይቀር ባይጠላ፥ ደቀ መዝሙሬ ሊሆን አይችልም።

verses.text_english: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም መስቀሉን ተሸክሞ በኋላዬ የማይመጣ፥ ደቀ መዝሙሬ ሊሆን አይችልም።

verses.text_english: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have to finish ?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ግንብ ሊሠራ የሚወድ ለመደምደሚያ የሚበቃ ያለው እንደ ሆነ አስቀድሞ ተቀምጦ ከሳራውን የማይቈጥር ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish , all that behold begin to mock him,
verses.text_amharic: ያለዚያ መሠረቱን ቢመሠርት፥ ሊደመድመውም ቢያቅተው፥ ያዩት ሁሉ።

verses.text_english: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሰው ሊሠራ ጀምሮ ሊደመድመው አቃተው ብለው ሊዘብቱበት ይጀምራሉ።

verses.text_english: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ሌላውን ንጉሥ በጦርነት ሊጋጠም የሚሄድ፥ ከሁለት እልፍ ጋር የሚመጣበትን በአንድ እልፍ ሊገናኝ የሚችል እንደ ሆነ አስቀድሞ ተቀምጦ የማያስብ ንጉሥ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
verses.text_amharic: ባይሆንስ ሌላው ገና ሩቅ ሳለ መልክተኞች ልኮ ዕርቅ ይለምናል።

verses.text_english: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደዚሁ ማንም ከእናንተ ያለውን ሁሉ የማይተው ደቀ መዝሙሬ ሊሆን አይችልም።

verses.text_english: Salt good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
verses.text_amharic: ጨው መልካም ነው፤ ጨው አልጫ ቢሆን ግን በምን ይጣፈጣል?

verses.text_english: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: ለምድር ቢሆን ለፍግ መቈለያም ቢሆን አይረባም፤ ወደ ውጭ ይጥሉታል። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.text_english: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
verses.text_amharic: ቀራጮችና ኃጢአተኞችም ሁሉ ሊሰሙት ወደ እርሱ ይቀርቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንና ጻፎችም። ይህስ ኃጢአተኞችን ይቀበላል ከእነርሱም ጋር ይበላል ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.text_english: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.text_english: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verses.text_amharic: መቶ በግ ያለው ከእነርሱም አንዱ ቢጠፋ፥ ዘጠና ዘጠኙን በበረሃ ትቶ የጠፋውን እስኪያገኘው ድረስ ሊፈልገው የማይሄድ ከእናንተ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: And when he hath found , he layeth on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.text_amharic: ባገኘውም ጊዜ ደስ ብሎት በጫንቃው ይሸከመዋል፤

verses.text_english: And when he cometh home, he calleth together friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤትም በመጣ ጊዜ ወዳጆቹንና ጐረቤቶቹን በአንድነት ጠርቶ። የጠፋውን በጌን አግኝቼዋለሁና ከእኔ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ እንዲሁ ንስሐ ከማያስፈልጋቸው ከዘጠና ዘጠኝ ጻድቃን ይልቅ ንስሐ በሚገባ በአንድ ኃጢአተኛ በሰማይ ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find ?
verses.text_amharic: ወይም አሥር ድሪም ያላት አንድ ድሪም ቢጠፋባት፥ መብራት አብርታ ቤትዋንም ጠርጋ እስክታገኘው ድረስ አጥብቃ የማትፈልግ ሴት ማን ናት?

verses.text_english: And when she hath found , she calleth friends and neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.text_amharic: ባገኘችውም ጊዜ ወዳጆችዋንና ጐረቤቶችዋን በአንድነት ጠርታ። የጠፋውን ድሪሜን አግኝቼዋለሁና ከእኔ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ትላቸዋለች።

verses.text_english: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ እንዲሁ ንስሐ በሚገባ በአንድ ኃጢአተኛ በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። አንድ ሰው ሁለት ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And the younger of them said to father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth . And he divided unto them living.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ታናሹ አባቱን። አባቴ ሆይ፥ ከገንዘብህ የሚደርሰኝን ክፍል ስጠኝ አለው። ገንዘቡንም አካፈላቸው።

verses.text_english: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ታናሹ ልጅ ገንዘቡን ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄደ፥ ከዚያም እያባከነ ገዘቡን በተነ።

verses.text_english: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም ከከሰረ በኋላ በዚያች አገር ጽኑ ራብ ሆነ፥ እርሱም ይጨነቅ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዶም ከዚያች አገር ሰዎች ከአንዱ ጋር ተዳበለ፥ እርሱም እሪያ ሊያሰማራ ወደ ሜዳ ሰደደው።

verses.text_english: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እሪያዎችም ከሚበሉት አሰር ሊጠግብ ይመኝ ነበር፥ የሚሰጠውም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ልቡም ተመልሶ እንዲህ አለ። እንጀራ የሚተርፋቸው የአባቴ ሞያተኞች ስንት ናቸው? እኔ ግን ከዚህ በራብ እጠፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቼም ወደ አባቴ እሄዳለሁና። አባቴ ሆይ፥ በሰማይና በፊትህ በደልሁ፥

verses.text_english: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊትም ልጅህ ልባል አይገባኝም፤ ከሞያተኞችህ እንደ አንዱ አድርገኝ እለዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.text_amharic: ተነሥቶም ወደ አባቱ መጣ። እርሱም ገና ሩቅ ሳለ አባቱ አየውና አዘነለት፥ ሮጦም አንገቱን አቀፈውና ሳመው።

verses.text_english: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
verses.text_amharic: ልጁም። አባቴ ሆይ፥ በሰማይና በፊትህ በደልሁ፥ ወደ ፊትም ልጅህ ልባል አይገባኝም አለው።

verses.text_english: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on feet:
verses.text_amharic: አባቱ ግን ባሪያዎቹን አለ። ፈጥናችሁ ከሁሉ የተሻለ ልብስ አምጡና አልብሱት፥ ለእጁ ቀለበት ለእግሩም ጫማ ስጡ፤

verses.text_english: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill ; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.text_amharic: የሰባውን ፊሪዳ አምጥታችሁ እረዱት፥ እንብላም ደስም ይበለን፤

verses.text_english: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ልጄ ሞቶ ነበርና ደግሞም ሕያው ሆኖአል፤ ጠፍቶም ነበር ተገኝቶአልም። ደስም ይላቸው ጀመር።

verses.text_english: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቁ ልጁ በእርሻ ነበረ፤ መጥቶም ወደ ቤት በቀረበ ጊዜ የመሰንቆና የዘፈን ድምፅ ሰማ፤

verses.text_english: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
verses.text_amharic: ከብላቴናዎችም አንዱን ጠርቶ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ወንድምህ መጥቶአልና በደኅና ስላገኘው አባትህ የሰባውን ፊሪዳ አረደለት አለው።

verses.text_english: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
verses.text_amharic: ተቈጣም ሊገባም አልወደደም፤ አባቱም ወጥቶ ለመነው።

verses.text_english: And he answering said to father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን መልሶ አባቱን። እነሆ፥ ይህን ያህል ዓመት እንደ ባሪያ ተገዝቼልሃለሁ ከትእዛዝህም ከቶ አልተላለፍሁም፤ ለእኔም ከወዳጆቼ ጋር ደስ እንዲለኝ አንድ ጥቦት ስንኳ አልሰጠኸኝም፤

verses.text_english: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ገንዘብህን ከጋለሞቶች ጋር በልቶ ይህ ልጅህ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ የሰባውን ፊሪዳ አረድህለት አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ ሁልጊዜ ከእኔ ጋር ነህ፥ ለእኔም የሆነ ሁሉ የአንተ ነው፤

verses.text_english: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን ይህ ወንድምህ ሞቶ ነበረ ሕያው ስለ ሆነ ጠፍቶም ነበር ስለ ተገኘ ደስ እንዲለን ፍሥሐም እንድናደርግ ይገባናል አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ አለ። መጋቢ የነበረው አንድ ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ነበረ፥ በእርሱ ዘንድ። ይህ ሰው ያለህን ይበትናል ብለው ከሰሱት።

verses.text_english: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
verses.text_amharic: ጠርቶም። ይህ የምሰማብህ ምንድር ነው? ወደ ፊት ለእኔ መጋቢ ልትሆን አትችልምና የመጋቢነትህን ሂሳብ አስረክበኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: መጋቢውም በልቡ። ጌታዬ መጋቢነቱን ከእኔ ይወስዳልና ምን ላድርግ? ለመቈፈር ኃይል የለኝም፥ መለመንም አፍራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
verses.text_amharic: ከመጋቢነቱ ብሻር በቤታቸው እንዲቀበሉኝ የማደርገውን አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: So he called every one of his lord's debtors , and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
verses.text_amharic: የጌታውንም ባለ ዕዳዎች እያንዳንዳቸውን ጠርቶ የፊተኛውን። ለጌታዬ ምን ያህል ዕዳ አለብህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። መቶ ማድጋ ዘይት አለ። ደብዳቤህን እንካ ፈጥነህም ተቀምጠህ አምሳ ብለህ ጻፍ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላም ሌላውን። አንተስ ስንት ዕዳ አለብህ? አለው። እርሱም። መቶ ጫን ስንዴ አለ። ደብዳቤህን እንካ ሰማንያ ብለህም ጻፍ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታውም ዓመፀኛውን መጋቢ በልባምነት ስላደረገ አመሰገነው የዚህ ዓለም ልጆች ለትውልዳቸው ከብርሃን ልጆች ይልቅ ልባሞች ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እላችኋለሁ፥ የዓመፃ ገንዘብ ሲያልቅ በዘላለም ቤቶች እንዲቀበሉአችሁ፥ በእርሱ ወዳጆችን ለራሳችሁ አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁሉ በሚያንስ የታመነ በብዙ ደግሞ የታመነ ነው፥ ከሁሉ በሚያንስም የሚያምፅ በብዙ ደግሞ ዓመፀኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true ?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ በዓመፃ ገንዘብ ካልታመናችሁ፥ እውነተኛውን ገንዘብ ማን አደራ ይሰጣችኋል?

verses.text_english: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
verses.text_amharic: በሌላ ሰው ገንዘብ ካልታመናችሁ፥ የእናንተን ማን ይሰጣችኋል?

verses.text_english: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.text_amharic: ለሁለት ጌቶች መገዛት የሚቻለው ባርያ ማንም የለም፤ ወይም አንዱን ይጠላልና ሁለተኛውንም ይወዳል፥ ወይም ወደ አንዱ ይጠጋል ሁለተኛውንም ይንቃል። ለእግዚአብሔርና ለገንዘብ መገዛት አትችሉም።

verses.text_english: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
verses.text_amharic: ገንዘብንም የሚወዱ ፈሪሳውያን ይህን ሁሉ ሰምተው ያፌዙበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ራሳችሁን በሰው ፊት የምታጸድቁ እናንተ ናችሁ፥ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ልባችሁን ያውቃል፤ በሰው ዘንድ የከበረ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርኵሰት ነውና።

verses.text_english: The law and the prophets until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግና ነቢያት እስከ ዮሐንስ ነበሩ፤ ከዚያ ጀምሮ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ይሰበካል፤ ሁሉም ወደ እርስዋ በኃይል ይገቡባታል።

verses.text_english: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከሕግ አንዲት ነጥብ ከምትወድቅ ሰማይና ምድር ሊያልፍ ይቀላል።

verses.text_english: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from husband committeth adultery.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቱንም የሚፈታ ሁሉ ሌላይቱንም የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል፥ ከባልዋም የተፈታችውን የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል።

verses.text_english: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
verses.text_amharic: ቀይ ልብስና ቀጭን የተልባ እግር የለበሰ አንድ ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ነበረ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም እየተመቸው በደስታ ይኖር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.text_amharic: አልዓዛርም የሚባል አንድ ድሀ በቍስል ተወርሶ በደጁ ተኝቶ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.text_amharic: ከባለ ጠጋውም ማዕድ ከሚወድቀው ፍርፋሪ ሊጠግብ ይመኝ ነበር፤ ውሾች እንኳ መጥተው ቍስሎቹን ይልሱ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
verses.text_amharic: ድሀውም ሞተ፥ መላእክትም ወደ አብርሃም እቅፍ ወሰዱት፤ ባለ ጠጋው ደግሞ ሞተና ተቀበረ።

verses.text_english: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.text_amharic: በሲኦልም በሥቃይ ሳለ አሻቅቦ አብርሃምን በሩቅ አየ አልዓዛርንም በእቅፉ።

verses.text_english: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እየጮኸ። አብርሃም አባት ሆይ፥ ማረኝ፥ በዚህ ነበልባል እሣቀያለሁና የጣቱን ጫፍ በውኃ ነክሮ መላሴን እንዲያበርድልኝ አልዓዛርን ስደድልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም ግን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ በሕይወትህ ሳለህ መልካም እንደ ተቀበልህ አስብ አልዓዛርም እንዲሁ ክፉ፤ አሁን ግን እርሱ በዚህ ይጽናናል አንተም ትሣቀያለህ።

verses.text_english: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that from thence.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር ከዚህ ወደ እናንተ ሊያልፉ የሚፈልጉ እንዳይችሉ፥ ወዲያ ያሉ ደግሞ ወደ እኛ እንዳይሻገሩ በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ታላቅ ገደል ተደርጎአል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እንኪያስ፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ወደ አባቴ ቤት እንድትሰደው እለምንሃለሁ፤ አምስት ወንድሞች አሉኝና፤

verses.text_english: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ደግሞ ወደዚህ ሥቃይ ስፍራ እንዳይመጡ ይመስክርላቸው አለ።

verses.text_english: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም ግን። ሙሴና ነቢያት አሉአቸው፤ እነርሱን ይስሙ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አይደለም፥ አብርሃም አባት ሆይ፥ ነገር ግን ከሙታን አንዱ ቢሄድላቸው ንስሐ ይገባሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንና ነቢያትንም የማይሰሙ ከሆነ፥ ከሙታንም እንኳ አንድ ቢነሣ አያምኑም አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe , through whom they come!
verses.text_amharic: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። መሰናክል ግድ ሳይመጣ አይቀርም፥ ነገር ግን መሰናክሉን ለሚያመጣው ወዮለት፤

verses.text_english: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾች አንዱን ከማሰናከል ይልቅ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ባሕር ቢጣል ይጠቅመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.text_amharic: ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ። ወንድምህ ቢበድልህ ገሥጸው፥ ቢጸጸትም ይቅር በለው።

verses.text_english: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.text_amharic: በቀንም ሰባት ጊዜ እንኳ ቢበድልህ በቀንም ሰባት ጊዜ። ተጸጸትሁ እያለ ወደ አንተ ቢመለስ፥ ይቅር በለው።

verses.text_english: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.text_amharic: ሐዋርያትም ጌታን። እምነት ጨምርልን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም አለ። የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት የሚያህል እምነት ቢኖራችሁ፥ ይህን ሾላ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተተከል ብትሉት፥ ይታዘዝላችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተም የሚያርስ ወይም ከብትን የሚጠብቅ ባሪያ ያለው፥ ከእርሻ ሲመለስ። ወዲያው ቅረብና በማዕድ ተቀመጥ የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.text_amharic: የምበላውን እራቴን አሰናዳልኝ፥ እስክበላና እስክጠጣ ድረስ ታጥቀህ አገልግለኝ፥ በኋላም አንተ ብላና ጠጣ የሚለው አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.text_amharic: ያንን ባሪያ ያዘዘውን ስላደረገ ያመሰግነዋልን?

verses.text_english: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ የታዘዛችሁትን ሁሉ ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ። የማንጠቅም ባሪያዎች ነን፥ ልናደርገው የሚገባንን አድርገናል በሉ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሲሄድ በገሊላና በሰማርያ መካከል አለፈ።

verses.text_english: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ አንዲት መንደርም ሲገባ በሩቅ የቆሙት አሥር ለምጻሞች ተገናኙት፤

verses.text_english: And they lifted up voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም እየጮኹ። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And when he saw , he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.text_amharic: አይቶም። ሂዱ፥ ራሳችሁን ለካህናት አሳዩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ሲሄዱ ነጹ። ከእነርሱም አንዱ እንደ ተፈወሰ ባየ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን እያከበረ ተመለሰ፥

verses.text_english: And fell down on face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
verses.text_amharic: እያመሰገነውም በእግሩ ፊት በግንባሩ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም ሳምራዊ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where the nine?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሥሩ አልነጹምን? ዘጠኙስ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.text_english: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ ከልዩ ወገን በቀር እግዚአብሔርን ሊያከብሩ የተመለሱ አልተገኙም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም። ተነሣና ሂድ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መቼ ትመጣለች ብለው ቢጠይቁት፥ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመጠባበቅ አትመጣም፤

verses.text_english: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። እንኋት በዚህ ወይም። እንኋት በዚያ አይሉአትም። እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመካከላችሁ ናትና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see .
verses.text_amharic: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። ከሰው ልጅ ቀኖች አንዱን ልታዩ የምትመኙበት ወራት ይመጣል አታዩትምም።

verses.text_english: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after , nor follow .
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እነሆ በዚህ፥ ወይም። እነሆ በዚያ ይሉአችኋል፤ አትሂዱ አትከተሉአቸውም።

verses.text_english: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one under heaven, shineth unto the other under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.text_amharic: መብረቅ በርቆ ከሰማይ በታች ካለ ከአንድ አገር ከሰማይ በታች ወዳለው ወደ ሌላ አገር እንደሚያበራ፥ የሰው ልጅ በቀኑ እንዲህ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞ ግን ብዙ መከራ እንዲቀበል ከዚህም ትውልድ እንዲጣል ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.text_amharic: በኖኅ ዘመንም እንደ ሆነ፥ በሰው ልጅ ዘመን ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ እስከ ገባበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ይበሉና ይጠጡ ያገቡና ይጋቡም ነበር፥ የጥፋት ውኃም መጣ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።

verses.text_english: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ በሎጥ ዘመን እንደ ሆነ፤ ይበሉ ይጠጡም ይገዙም ይሸጡም ይተክሉም ቤትም ይሠሩ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed all.
verses.text_amharic: ሎጥ ከሰዶም በወጣበት ቀን ግን ከሰማይ እሳትና ዲን ዘነበ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።

verses.text_english: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ በሚገለጥበት ቀን እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቀን በሰገነት ያለ በቤቱ ያለውን ዕቃ ሊወስድ አይውረድ፥ እንዲሁም በእርሻ ያለ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.text_english: Remember Lot's wife.
verses.text_amharic: የሎጥን ሚስት አስቡአት።

verses.text_english: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚፈልግ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ በሕይወት ይጠብቃታል።

verses.text_english: I tell you, in that night there shall be two in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያች ሌሊት ሁለት ሰዎች በአንድ አልጋ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።

verses.text_english: Two shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ሴቶች በአንድ ወፍጮ ይፈጫሉ፤ አንዲቱ ትወሰዳለች ሁለተኛይቱም ትቀራለች።

verses.text_english: Two shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ሰዎች በእርሻ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።

verses.text_english: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body , thither will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: መልሰውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። እርሱም። ሥጋ ወዳለበት በዚያ አሞራዎች ይሰበሰባሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he spake a parable unto them , that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
verses.text_amharic: ሳይታክቱም ዘወትር ሊጸልዩ እንዲገባቸው የሚል ምሳሌን ነገራቸው፥

verses.text_english: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ሲል። በአንዲት ከተማ እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈራ ሰውንም የማያፍር አንድ ዳኛ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ከተማ አንዲት መበለት ነበረች፥ ወደ እርሱም እየመጣች። ከባላጋራዬ ፍረድልኝ ትለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.text_amharic: አያሌ ቀንም አልወደደም፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ግን በልቡ። ምንም እግዚአብሔርን ባልፈራ ሰውንም ባላፍር፥

verses.text_english: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.text_amharic: ይህች መበለት ስለምታደክመኝ ሁልጊዜም እየመጣች እንዳታውከኝ እፈርድላታለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም አለ። ዓመፀኛው ዳኛ ያለውን ስሙ።

verses.text_english: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር እንኪያስ ቀንና ሌሊት ወደ እርሱ ለሚጮኹ ለሚታገሣቸውም ምርጦቹ አይፈርድላቸውምን?

verses.text_english: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ ፈጥኖ ይፈርድላቸዋል። ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ በመጣ ጊዜ በምድር እምነትን ያገኝ ይሆንን?

verses.text_english: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቃን እንደ ሆኑ በራሳቸው ለሚታመኑና ሌሎቹን ሁሉ በጣም ለሚንቁ ይህን ምሳሌ ነገራቸው፥

verses.text_english: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ሲል። ሁለት ሰዎች ሊጸልዩ ወደ መቅደስ ወጡ፥ አንዱ ፈሪሳዊ ሁለተኛውም ቀራጭ።

verses.text_english: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men , extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳዊም ቆሞ በልቡ ይህን ሲጸልይ። እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እንደ ሌላ ሰው ሁሉ፥ ቀማኞችና ዓመፀኞች አመንዝሮችም፥ ወይም እንደዚህ ቀራጭ ስላልሆንሁ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.text_amharic: በየሳምንቱ ሁለት ጊዜ እጦማለሁ፥ ከማገኘውም ሁሉ አሥራት አወጣለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.text_amharic: ቀራጩ ግን በሩቅ ቆሞ ዓይኖቹን ወደ ሰማይ ሊያነሣ እንኳ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኔን ኃጢአተኛውን ማረኝ እያለ ደረቱን ይደቃ ነበር።

verses.text_english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያ ይልቅ ይህ ጻድቅ ሆኖ ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ፤ ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፥ ራሱን ግን የሚያዋርድ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when disciples saw , they rebuked them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲዳስሳቸውም ሕፃናትን ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም አይተው ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.text_english: But Jesus called them , and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። ሕፃናት ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉአቸው አትከልክሉአቸውም፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ እነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም አለ።

verses.text_english: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.text_amharic: ከአለቆችም አንዱ። ቸር መምህር፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንድወርስ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none good, save one, , God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ስለ ምን ቸር ትለኛለህ? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ቸር ማንም የለም።

verses.text_english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዛቱን ታውቃለህ፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ይህን ሁሉ ከሕፃንናቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ። አንዲት ገና ቀርታሃለች፤ ያለህን ሁሉ ሽጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሰምቶ እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ነበርና ብዙ አዘነ።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ብዙ እንዳዘነ አይቶ። ገንዘብ ላላቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ባለ ጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ይልቅ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ሊገባ ይቀላል አለ።

verses.text_english: And they that heard said, Who then can be saved?
verses.text_amharic: የሰሙትም። እንግዲህ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። በሰው ዘንድ የማይቻል በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይቻላል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ቤትን ወይም ወላጆችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን የተወ፥

verses.text_english: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ዘመን ብዙ እጥፍ በሚመጣውም ዓለም የዘላለምን ሕይወት የማይቀበል ማንም የለም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then he took the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለቱንም ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ ስለ ሰው ልጅም በነቢያት የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸማል።

verses.text_english: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.text_amharic: ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታልና፥ ይዘብቱበትማል ያንገላቱትማል ይተፉበትማል፤

verses.text_english: And they shall scourge , and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.text_amharic: ከገረፉትም በኋላ ይገድሉታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል።

verses.text_english: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከዚህ ነገር ምንም አላስተዋሉም፥ ይህም ቃል ተሰውሮባቸው ነበር፥ የተናገረውንም አላወቁም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢያሪኮም በቀረበ ጊዜ አንድ ዕውር እየለመነ በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝብም ሲያልፍ ሰምቶ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ያልፋል ብለው አወሩለት።

verses.text_english: And he cried, saying, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.text_amharic: በስተ ፊት ይሄዱ የነበሩትም ዝም እንዲል ገሠጹት፤ እርሱ ግን። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ አብዝቶ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ወደ እርሱ እንዲያመጡት አዘዘ። በቀረበም ጊዜ። ምን ላደርግልህ ትወዳለህ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አይ ዘንድ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እይ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw , gave praise unto God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም አየ፥ እግዚአብሔንም እያከበረ ተከተለው። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.text_english: And entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢያሪኮም ገብቶ ያልፍ ነበር። እነሆም ዘኬዎስ የሚባል ሰው፥

verses.text_english: And, behold, a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የቀራጮች አለቃ ነበረ፥ ባለ ጠጋም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም የትኛው እንደ ሆነ ሊያይ ይፈልግ ነበር፤ ቁመቱም አጭር ነበረና ስለ ሕዝቡ ብዛት አቃተው።

verses.text_english: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም መንገድ ያልፍ ዘንድ አለውና ያየው ዘንድ ወደ ፊት ሮጦ በአንድ ሾላ ላይ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደዚያ ስፍራ በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ አሻቅቦ አየና። ዘኬዎስ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ በቤትህ እውል ዘንድ ይገባኛልና ፈጥነህ ውረድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.text_amharic: ፈጥኖም ወረደ በደስታም ተቀበለው።

verses.text_english: And when they saw , they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም አይተው። ከኃጢአተኛ ሰው ጋር ሊውል ገባ ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.text_english: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore fourfold.
verses.text_amharic: ዘኬዎስ ግን ቆሞ ጌታን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ካለኝ ሁሉ እኵሌታውን ለድሆች እሰጣለሁ፤ ማንንም በሐሰት ከስሼ እንደ ሆንሁ አራት እጥፍ እመልሳለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እርሱ ደግሞ የአብርሃም ልጅ ነውና ዛሬ ለዚህ ቤት መዳን ሆኖለታል፤

verses.text_english: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ሊፈልግና ሊያድን መጥቶአለና አለው።

verses.text_english: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መቅረቡ ስለ ሆነ የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ፈጥኖ ሊገለጥ እንዳለው ስለ መሰላቸው ምሳሌ ጭምር ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እንዲህ አላቸው። አንድ መኰንን ለራሱ መንግሥትን ይዞ ሊመለሰ ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
verses.text_amharic: አሥር ባሪያዎችንም ጠርቶ አሥር ምናን ሰጣቸውና። እስክመጣ ድረስ ነግዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this to reign over us.
verses.text_amharic: የአገሩ ሰዎች ግን ይጠሉት ነበርና። ይህ በላያችን ሊነግሥ አንወድም ብለው በኋላው መልክተኞችን ላኩ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.text_amharic: መንግሥትንም ይዞ በተመለሰ ጊዜ፥ ገንዘብ የሰጣቸውን እነዚህን ባሪያዎች ነግደው ምን ያህል እንዳተረፉ ያውቅ ዘንድ እንዲጠሩለት አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.text_amharic: የፊተኛውም ደርሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አሥር ምናን አተረፈ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ ባሪያ፥ በጥቂት የታመንህ ስለ ሆንህ በአሥር ከተማዎች ላይ ሥልጣን ይሁንልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አምስት ምናን አተረፈ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ደግሞ። አንተም በአምስት ከተማዎች ላይ ሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በጨርቅ ጠቅልዬ የጠበቅኋት ምናንህ እነሆ፤

verses.text_english: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.text_amharic: ፈርቼሃለሁና፥ ጨካኝ ሰው ስለ ሆንህ፤ ያላኖርኸውን ትወስዳለህ ያልዘራኸውንም ታጭዳለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ አፍህ በተናገረው እፈርድብሃለሁ። እኔ ያላኖርሁትን የምወስድና ያልዘራሁትን የማጭድ ጨካኝ ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ አወቅህ፤ ምን ነው ገንዘቤን ለለዋጮች አደራ ያልሰጠኸው?

verses.text_english: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
verses.text_amharic: እኔም መጥቼ ከትርፉ ጋር እወስደው ነበር አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ቆመው የነበሩትን። ምናኑን ውሰዱበት አሥሩ ምናን ላለውም ስጡት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሥር ምናን አለው አሉት።

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁ፥ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋል፥ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው ስንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.text_english: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay before me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እነዚያን በላያቸው ልነግሥ ያልወደዱትን ጠላቶቼን ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው በፊቴም እረዱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጣ ይቀድማቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: ደብረ ዘይትም በሚባል ተራራ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላከና።

verses.text_english: Saying, Go ye into the village over against ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring .
verses.text_amharic: በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፥ ፈትታችሁም አምጡት።

verses.text_english: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose ? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም። ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? ብሎ ቢጠይቃችሁ፥ እንዲሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.text_amharic: የተላኩትም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ።

verses.text_english: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ውርንጫውን ሲፈቱ ጌቶቹ። ውርንጫውን ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? አሉአቸውም

verses.text_english: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጡት፥ በውርንጫውም ላይ ልብሳቸውን ጭነው ኢየሱስን አስቀመጡት።

verses.text_english: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.text_amharic: ሲሄድም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ቍልቍለትም አሁን በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁላቸው ደስ እያላቸው ተአምራትን ሁሉ ስላዩ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ሊያመሰግኑ ጀምረው።

verses.text_english: Saying, Blessed the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው፤ በሰማይ ሰላም በአርያምም ክብር አሉ።

verses.text_english: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝብም መካከል ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ገሥጻቸው አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.text_amharic: መልሶም። እላችኋለሁ፥ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮች ይጮኻሉ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.text_amharic: ሲቀርብም ከተማይቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት፥

verses.text_english: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ እያለ። ለሰላምሽ የሚሆነውን በዚህ ቀን አንቺስ ስንኳ ብታውቂ፤ አሁን ግን ከዓይንሽ ተሰውሮአል።

verses.text_english: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.text_amharic: ወራት ይመጣብሻልና፥ ጠላቶችሽም ቅጥር ይቀጥሩብሻል ይከቡሻልም በየበኵሉም ያስጨንቁሻል፤

verses.text_english: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.text_amharic: አንቺንም በአንቺም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ልጆችሽን ወደ ታች ይጥላሉ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥም ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ አይተዉም፥ የመጐብኘትሽን ዘመን አላወቅሽምና።

verses.text_english: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በእርሱ የሚሸጡትን የሚገዙትንም ያወጣ ጀመር፤

verses.text_english: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፤ እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ አደረጋችሁት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.text_amharic: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፤ ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች የሕዝቡ ታላላቆችም ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያደርጉበትንም አጡ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙት ተንጠልጥለውበት ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon with the elders,
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ቀንም ሕዝቡን በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር ወንጌልንም ሲሰብክላቸው፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ከሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና።

verses.text_english: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.text_amharic: እስኪ ንገረን፤ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን ታደርጋለህ ወይስ ይህን ሥልጣን የሰጠህ ማን ነው? ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.text_english: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
verses.text_amharic: መልሶም። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም ንገሩኝ፤

verses.text_english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
verses.text_amharic: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከሰማይ ነበረችን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.text_english: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው ብንል ግን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይወግሩናል፤ ዮሐንስ ነቢይ እንደ ነበረ ሁሉ ያምኑ ነበርና አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they answered, that they could not tell whence .
verses.text_amharic: መልሰውም። ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አናውቅም አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ምሳሌ ለሕዝቡ ይላቸው ጀመር። አንድ ሰው የወይን አትክልት ተከለ ለገበሬዎችም አከራይቶ ለብዙ ዘመን ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent away empty.
verses.text_amharic: በጊዜውም ከወይኑ አትክልት ፍሬ እንዲሰጡት አንድ ባሪያ ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ፤ ገበሬዎቹ ግን ደበደቡት ባዶውንም ሰደዱት።

verses.text_english: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated shamefully, and sent away empty.
verses.text_amharic: ጨምሮም ሌላውን ባሪያ ላከ፤ እነርሱም ያን ደግሞ ደበደቡት አዋርደውም ባዶውን ሰደዱት።

verses.text_english: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast out.
verses.text_amharic: ጨምሮም ሦስተኛውን ላከ፤ እነርሱም ይህን ደግሞ አቍሰለው አወጡት።

verses.text_english: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence when they see him.
verses.text_amharic: የወይኑም አትክልት ጌታ። ምን ላድርግ? የምወደውን ልጄን እልካለሁ፤ ምናልባት እርሱን አይተው ያፍሩታል አለ።

verses.text_english: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
verses.text_amharic: ገበሬዎቹ ግን አይተውት እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ርስቱ ለእኛ እንዲሆን ኑ እንግደለው አሉ።

verses.text_english: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.text_amharic: ከወይኑም አትክልት ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ገደሉት። እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ ምን ያደርጋቸዋል?

verses.text_english: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard , they said, God forbid.
verses.text_amharic: ይመጣል እነዚህንም ገበሬዎች ያጠፋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ለሌሎች ይሰጣል። ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህስ አይሁን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ወደ እነርሱ ተመልክቶ። እንግዲህ። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ይህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ሁሉ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ግን ይፈጨዋል አለ።

verses.text_english: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም ይህን ምሳሌ በእነርሱ ላይ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀው በዚያች ሰዓት እጃቸውን ሊጭኑበት ፈለጉ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: And they watched , and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
verses.text_amharic: ሲጠባበቁም ወደ ገዢ ግዛትና ሥልጣን አሳልፈው እንዲሰጡት ጻድቃን መስለው በቃሉ የሚያጠምዱትን ሸማቂዎች ሰደዱበት።

verses.text_english: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person , but teachest the way of God truly:
verses.text_amharic: ጠይቀውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነትን እንድትናገርና እንድታስተምር ለሰው ፊትም እንዳታደላ እናውቃለን፥ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ታስተምራለህ እንጂ፤

verses.text_english: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
verses.text_amharic: ለቄሣር ግብር ልንሰጥ ተፈቅዶአልን? ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ተንኰላቸውንም ተመልክቶ። ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ? አንድ ዲናር አሳዩኝ፤

verses.text_english: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
verses.text_amharic: መልኩ ጽሕፈቱስ የማን ነው? አላቸው። መልሰውም። የቄሣር ነው አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝቡም ፊት በቃሉ ሊያጠምዱት አልቻሉም በመልሱም እየተደነቁ ዝም አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then came to certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
verses.text_amharic: ትንሣኤ ሙታንንም የሚክዱ ከሰዱቃውያን አንዳንዶቹ ቀርበው ጠየቁት፥

verses.text_english: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ሲሉ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ። ሚስት ያለችው የአንድ ሰው ወንድም ልጅ ሳይወልድ ቢሞት፥ ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ ብሎ ጻፈልን።

verses.text_english: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ ሰባት ወንድማማች ነበሩ፤ የፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሞተ፤

verses.text_english: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.text_english: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሰባቱ አግብተዋታልና ሴቲቱ በትንሣኤ ከእነርሱ ለማንኛቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.text_english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የዚህ ዓለም ልጆች ያገባሉ ይጋባሉም፥

verses.text_english: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.text_amharic: ያን ዓለምና ከሙታን ትንሣኤ ሊያገኙ የሚገባቸው እነዚያ ግን አያገቡም አይጋቡምም፥ እንደ መላእክት ናቸውና፥

verses.text_english: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.text_amharic: ሊሞቱም ወደ ፊት አይቻላቸውም፥ የትንሣኤም ልጆች ስለ ሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
verses.text_amharic: ሙታን እንዲነሡ ግን ሙሴ ደግሞ በቍጥቋጦው ዘንድ ጌታን የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ በማለቱ አስታወቀ፤

verses.text_english: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ለእርሱ ሕያዋን ስለ ሆኑ፥ የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ከጻፎችም አንዳንዶቹ መልሰው። መምህር ሆይ፥ መልካም ተናገርህ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊትም አንድ ነገር ስንኳ ሊጠይቁት አልደፈሩም።

verses.text_english: And after that they durst not ask him any .
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?

verses.text_english: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሲሰሙ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን።

verses.text_english: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
verses.text_amharic: ረጃጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዞር ከሚፈልጉ፥ በገበያም ሰላምታ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥ በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ ከሚወዱ ከጻፎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.text_english: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.text_amharic: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ፥ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ አለ።

verses.text_english: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ መባቸውን በመዝገብ የሚጥሉ ባለ ጠጎችን አየ።

verses.text_english: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.text_amharic: አንዲትም ድሀ መበለት ሁለት ሳንቲም በዚያ ስትጥል አየና።

verses.text_english: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህች ድሀ መበለት ከሁሉ ይልቅ አብልጣ ጣለች፤

verses.text_english: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መዝገብ ጥለዋልና፤ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አለ።

verses.text_english: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶቹም ስለ መቅደስ በመልካም ድንጋይና በተሰጠው ሽልማት እንዳጌጠ ሲነጋገሩ። ይህማ የምታዩት ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ የማይቀርበት ዘመን ይመጣል አለ።

verses.text_english: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign when these things shall come to pass?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? ይህስ ይሆን ዘንድ እንዳለው ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አለ። እንዳትስቱ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ብዙዎች። እኔ ነኝ፥ ዘመኑም ቀርቦአል እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፤ እነርሱን ተከትላችሁ አትሂዱ።

verses.text_english: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end not by and by.
verses.text_amharic: ጦርንና ሁከትንም በሰማችሁ ጊዜ አትደንግጡ፤ ይህ አስቀድሞ ይሆን ዘንድ ግድ ነውና፥ ነገር ግን መጨረሻው ወዲያው አይሆንም።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ፥ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣል፤

verses.text_english: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅም የምድር መናወጥና በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ ቸነፈር ራብም ይሆናል፤ የሚያስፈራም ነገር ከሰማይም ታላቅ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute , delivering up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሁሉ በፊት እጃቸውን በላያችሁ ይጭናሉ ያሳድዱአችሁማል፤ ስለ ስሜም ወደ ምኵራብና ወደ ወኅኒ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ወደ ነገሥታትና ወደ ገዥዎችም ይወስዱአችኋል፤

verses.text_english: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ለምስክርነት ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Settle therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.text_amharic: ሰለዚህ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ አስቀድማችሁ እንዳታስቡ በልባችሁ አኑሩት፤

verses.text_english: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.text_amharic: ወደረኞቻችሁ ሁሉ ሊቃወሙና ሊከራከሩ የማይችሉትን አፍና ጥበብ እሰጣችኋለሁና።

verses.text_english: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ወላጆችም ስንኳ ወንድሞችም ዘመዶችም ወዳጆችም አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ከእናንተም አንዳንዱን ይገድላሉ፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall be hated of all for my name's sake.
verses.text_amharic: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.text_amharic: ከራሳችሁም አንዲት ጠጉር ስንኳ አትጠፋም፤

verses.text_english: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.text_amharic: በመታገሣችሁም ነፍሳችሁን ታገኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሩሳሌም ግን በጭፍራ ተከባ ስታዩ በዚያን ጊዜ ጥፋትዋ እንደ ቀረበ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.text_amharic: የዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉ ወደ ተራራዎች ይሽሹ፥ በመካከልዋም ያሉ ከእርስዋ ፈቀቅ ይበሉ፥ በገጠር ያሉም ወደ እርስዋ አይግቡ፤

verses.text_english: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: የተጻፈው ሁሉ እንዲፈጸም ይህ የበቀል ጊዜ ነውና።

verses.text_english: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ወራት ለእርጕዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው፤ ታላቅ ችግር በምድር ላይ፥ በዚህም ሕዝብ ላይ ቍጣ ይሆናልና፤

verses.text_english: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: በሰይፍ ስለትም ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አሕዛብ ሁሉም ይማረካሉ፤ የአሕዛብም ዘመን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌም በአሕዛብ የተረገጠች ትሆናለች።

verses.text_english: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.text_amharic: በፀሐይና በጨረቃም በከዋክብትም ምልክት ይሆናል፤ በምድር ላይም አሕዛብ ከባሕሩና ከሞገዱም ድምፅ የተነሣ እያመነቱ ይጨነቃሉ፤

verses.text_english: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም ከፍርሃትና በዓለም የሚመጣበትን ከመጠበቅ የተነሣ ይደክማሉ፤ የሰማያት ኃይላት ይናወጣሉና።

verses.text_english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ በኃይልና በብዙ ክብር በደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል።
