verses.text_english: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሊሆን ሲጀምር ቤዛችሁ ቀርቦአልና አሻቅባችሁ ራሳችሁን አንሡ።

verses.text_english: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.text_amharic: ምሳሌንም ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል። በለስንና ዛፎችን ሁሉ እዩ፤

verses.text_english: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሲያቈጠቍጡ ተመልክታችሁ በጋ አሁን እንደ ቀረበ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ ይህ ሁሉ መሆኑን ስታዩ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ ቀረበች እወቁ።

verses.text_english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።

verses.text_english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.text_english: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day come upon you unawares.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ልባችሁ በመጠጥ ብዛትና በስካር ስለ ትዳርም በማሰብ እንዳይከብድ፥ ያ ቀንም በድንገት እንዳይመጣባችሁ ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.text_english: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ሁሉ ላይ በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ እንደ ወጥመድ ይደርስባቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሊመጣ ካለው ከዚህ ሁሉ ለማምለጥ፥ በሰው ልጅም ፊት ለመቆም እንድትችሉ ስትጸልዩ ሁል ጊዜ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called of Olives.
verses.text_amharic: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፥ ሌሊት ግን ደብረ ዘይት ወደምትባል ተራራ ወጥቶ ያድር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ይሰሙት ዘንድ ማልደው በመቅደስ ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.text_amharic: ፋሲካም የሚባለው የቂጣ በዓል ቀረበ።

verses.text_english: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም እንዴት እንዲያጠፉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ሰይጣንም ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ቍጥር አንዱ በነበረው የአስቆሮቱ በሚባለው በይሁዳ ገባ፤

verses.text_english: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ሄዶም እንዴት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከመቅደስ አዛዦች ጋር ተነጋገረ።

verses.text_english: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ደስ አላቸው፥ ገንዘብም ሊሰጡት ተዋዋሉ።

verses.text_english: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.text_amharic: እሺም አለ፥ ሕዝብም በሌለበት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ምቹ ጊዜ ይፈልግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.text_amharic: ፋሲካንም ሊያርዱበት የሚገባው የቂጣ በዓል ደረሰ፤

verses.text_english: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስንም። ፋሲካን እንድንበላ ሄዳችሁ አዘጋጁልን ብሎ ላካቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ወዴት እናዘጋጅ ዘንድ ትወዳለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ከተማ ስትገቡ ማድጋ ውኃ የተሸከመ ሰው ይገናኛችኋል፤ ወደ ሚገባበት ቤት ተከተሉት፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.text_amharic: ለባለቤቱም። መምህሩ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ፋሲካን የምበላበት የእንግዳ ቤት ክፍል ወዴት ነው? ይልሃል በሉት፤

verses.text_english: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.text_amharic: ያም በደርብ ላይ ያለውን የተነጠፈ ታላቅ አዳራሽ ያሳያችኋል፤ በዚያም አሰናዱልን።

verses.text_english: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.text_amharic: ሄደውም እንዳላቸው አገኙና ፋሲካን አሰናዱ።

verses.text_english: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዓቱም በደረሰ ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት ጋር በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከመከራዬ በፊት ከእናንተ ጋር ይህን ፋሲካ ልበላ እጅግ እመኝ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና፥ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ወደ ፊት ከዚህ አልበላም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide among yourselves:
verses.text_amharic: ጽዋንም ተቀበለ አመስግኖም። ይህን እንካችሁ በመካከላችሁም ተካፈሉት፤

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስክትመጣ ድረስ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ከወይኑ ፍሬ አልጠጣም አለ።

verses.text_english: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake , and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.text_amharic: እንጀራንም አንሥቶ አመሰገነ ቆርሶም ሰጣቸውና። ስለ እናንተ የሚሰጠው ሥጋዬ ይህ ነው፤ ይህን ለመታሰቢያዬ አድርጉት አለ።

verses.text_english: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ከእራት በኋላ ጽዋውን አንሥቶ እንዲህ አለ። ይህ ጽዋ ስለ እናንተ በሚፈሰው በደሜ የሚሆን አዲስ ኪዳን ነው።

verses.text_english: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me with me on the table.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ እጅ እነሆ በማዕድ ከእኔ ጋር ናት።

verses.text_english: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅስ እንደ ተወሰነው ይሄዳል፥ ነገር ግን አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።

verses.text_english: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ይህን ሊያደርግ ያለው ማን እንደ ሆነ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠያየቁ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ማናቸውም ታላቅ ሆኖ እንዲቈጠር በመካከላቸው ክርክር ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ይገዙአቸዋል፥ በላያቸውም የሚሠለጥኑት ቸርነት አድራጊዎች ይባላሉ።

verses.text_english: But ye not so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ አትሁኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ታላቅ የሆነ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ታናሽ፥ የሚገዛም እንደሚያገለግል ይሁን።

verses.text_english: For whether greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.text_amharic: በማዕድ የተቀመጠ ወይስ የሚያገለግል ማናቸው ታላቅ ነው? የተቀመጠው አይደለምን? እኔ ግን በመካከላችሁ እንደሚያገለግል ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እናንተ በፈተናዎቼ ከእኔ ጋር ጸንታችሁ የኖራችሁ ናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤

verses.text_english: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired you, that he may sift as wheat:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እምነትህ እንዳይጠፋ ስለ አንተ አማለድሁ፤ አንተም በተመለስህ ጊዜ ወንድሞችህን አጽና አለ።

verses.text_english: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ወኅኒም ወደ ሞትም ከአንተ ጋር ለመሄድ የተዘጋጀሁ ነኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ እንዳታውቀኝ ሦስት ጊዜ እስክትክደኝ ድረስ ዛሬ ዶሮ አይጮኽም አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። ያለ ኮረጆና ያለ ከረጢት ያለ ጫማም በላክኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ አንዳች ጐደለባችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አንዳች እንኳ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አሁን ግን ኮረጆ ያለው ከእርሱ ጋር ይውሰድ፥ ከረጢትም ያለው እንዲሁ፤ የሌለውም ልብሱን ሽጦ ሰይፍ ይግዛ።

verses.text_english: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take , and likewise scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.text_amharic: እላችኋለሁና፥ ይህ። ከዓመፀኞች ጋር ተቈጠረ ተብሎ የተጻፈው በእኔ ሊፈጸም ግድ ነው፤ አዎን፥ ስለ እኔ የሚሆነው አሁን ይፈጸማልና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ሁለት ሰይፎች አሉ አሉት። እርሱም። ይበቃል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, Lord, behold, here two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥቶም እንደ ልማዱ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ደግሞ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ስፍራውም ደርሶ። ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ጸልዩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም የድንጋይ ውርወራ የሚያህል ራቀ፥ ተንበርክኮም። አባት ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.text_amharic: ብትፈቅድ ይህችን ጽዋ ከእኔ ውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን የእኔ ፈቃድ አይሁን የአንተ እንጂ እያለ ይጸልይ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይም መጥቶ የሚያበረታ መልአክ ታየው።

verses.text_english: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.text_amharic: በፍርሃትም ሲጣጣር አጽንቶ ይጸልይ ነበር፤ ወዙም በምድር ላይ እንደሚወርድ እንደ ደም ነጠብጣብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ከጸሎትም ተነሥቶ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጣና ከኀዘን የተነሣ ተኝተው ሲያገኛቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምን ትተኛላችሁ? ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ተነሥታችሁ ጸልዩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.text_amharic: ገናም ሲናገር እነሆ፥ ሰዎች መጡ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱም ይሁዳ የሚባለው ይቀድማቸው ነበር፥ ሊስመውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረበ።

verses.text_english: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ በመሳም የሰውን ልጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.text_amharic: በዙሪያውም የነበሩት የሚሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በሰይፍ እንምታቸውን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዱ የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መትቶ ቀኝ ጆሮውን ቈረጠው።

verses.text_english: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። ይህንስ ፍቀዱ አለ፤ ጆሮውንም ዳስሶ ፈወሰው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ለመጡበት ለካህናት አለቆችና ለመቅደስ አዛዦች ለሽማግሌዎችም። ወንበዴን እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ወጣችሁን?

verses.text_english: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት ከእናንተ ጋር ስሆን እጆቻችሁን አልዘረጋችሁብኝም፤ ይህ ግን ጊዜያችሁና የጨለማው ሥልጣን ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ይዘውም ወሰዱት ወደ ሊቀ ካህናት ቤትም አገቡት፤ ጴጥሮስም ርቆ ይከተለው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then took they him, and led , and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
verses.text_amharic: በግቢ መካከልም እሳት አንድደው በአንድነት ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ጴጥሮስ በመካከላቸው ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.text_amharic: በብርሃኑም በኩል ተቀምጦ ሳለ አንዲት ገረድ አየችውና ትኵር ብላ። ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለች።

verses.text_english: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። አንቺ ሴት፥ አላውቀውም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.text_english: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂት ጊዜም በኋላ ሌላው አይቶት። አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ወገን ነህ አለው። ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ እኔ አይደለሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰዓትም የሚያህል ቆይቶ ሌላው አስረግጦ። እርሱ የገሊላ ሰው ነውና በእውነት ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለ።

verses.text_english: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ የምትለውን አላውቅም አለ። ያን ጊዜም ገና ሲናገር ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን ተመለከተው፤ ጴጥሮስም። ዛሬ ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ እንዳለው የጌታ ቃል ትዝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ ምርር ብሎ አለቀሰ።

verses.text_english: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም የያዙት ሰዎች ይዘብቱበትና ይደበድቡት ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote .
verses.text_amharic: ሸፍነውም ፊቱን ይመቱት ነበርና። በጥፊ የመታህ ማን ነው? ትንቢት ተናገር እያሉ ይጠይቁት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም ብዙ ነገር እየተሳደቡ በእርሱ ላይ ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ የሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችና የካህናት አለቆች ጻፎችም ተሰብስበው ወደ ሸንጎአቸው ወሰዱትና

verses.text_english: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.text_amharic: ክርስቶስ አንተ ነህን? ንገረን አሉት። እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ብነግራችሁ አታምኑም፤

verses.text_english: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.text_amharic: ብጠይቅም አትመልሱልኝም አትፈቱኝምም።

verses.text_english: And if I also ask , ye will not answer me, nor let go.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከአሁን ጀምሮ የሰው ልጅ በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ቀኝ ይቀመጣል።

verses.text_english: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላቸውም። እንግዲያስ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህን? አሉት። እርሱም። እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ እናንተ ትላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ራሳችን ከአፉ ሰምተናልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምን ምስክር ያስፈልገናል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም በሞላው ተነሥተው ወደ ጲላጦስ ወሰዱትና።

verses.text_english: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕዝባችንን ሲያጣምም ለቄሣርም ግብር እንዳይሰጥ ሲከለክል ደግሞም። እኔ ክርስቶስ ንጉሥ ነኝ ሲል አገኘነው ብለው ይከሱት ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest .
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። አንተ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም መልሶ። አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለሕዝቡ። በዚህ ሰው አንድ በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትም አለ።

verses.text_english: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን አጽንተው። ከገሊላ ጀምሮ እስከዚህ ድረስ በይሁዳ ሁሉ እያስተማረ ሕዝቡን ያውካል አሉ።

verses.text_english: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስ ግን። ገሊላ ሲሉ በሰማ ጊዜ። የገሊላ ሰው ነውን? ብሎ ጠየቀ፤

verses.text_english: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.text_amharic: ከሄሮድስም ግዛት እንደ ሆነ ባወቀ ጊዜ ወደ ሄሮድስ ሰደደው፤ እርሱ ደግሞ በዚያ ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long , because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስም ኢየሱስን ባየው ጊዜ እጅግ ደስ አለው፤ ስለ እርሱ ስለ ሰማ ከብዙ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ሊያየው ይመኝ ነበርና፥ ምልክትም ሲያደርግ ሊያይ ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.text_amharic: በብዙ ቃልም ጠየቀው፤ እርሱ ግን አንድ ስንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.text_english: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም አጽንተው ሲከሱት ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስም ከሠራዊቱ ጋር ናቀው ዘበተበትም፥ የጌጥ ልብስም አልብሶ ወደ ጲላጦስ መልሶ ሰደደው።

verses.text_english: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስና ጲላጦስም በዚያን ቀን እርስ በርሳቸው ወዳጆች ሆኑ፥ ቀድሞ በመካከላቸው ጥል ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም፥ የካህናትን አለቆችና መኳንንትን ሕዝቡንም በአንድነት ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡን ያጣምማል ብላችሁ ይህን ሰው ወደ እኔ አመጣችሁት፤ እነሆም፥ በፊታችሁ መርምሬ ከምትከሱበት ነገር አንድ በደል ስንኳ በዚህ ሰው አላገኘሁበትም።

verses.text_english: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ሄሮድስም ደግሞ ምንም አላገኘም፤ ወደ እኛ መልሶታልና፤ እነሆም፥ ለሞት የሚያደርሰው ምንም አላደረገም፤

verses.text_english: I will therefore chastise him, and release .
(For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.text_amharic: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤

verses.text_english: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this , and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሁከትን በከተማ አንሥቶ ሰውን ስለ ገደለ በወኅኒ ታስሮ ነበር።

verses.text_english: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ኢየሱስን ሊፈታ ወድዶ ዳግመኛ ተናገራቸው፤

verses.text_english: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እነርሱ። ስቀለው ስቀለው እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But they cried, saying, Crucify , crucify him.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛም። ምን ነው? ያደረገውስ ክፋት ምንድር ነው? ለሞት የሚያደርሰው በደል አላገኘሁበትም፤ ስለዚህ ቀጥቼ እፈታዋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let go.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን እንዲሰቀል በታላቅ ድምፅ አጽንተው ለመኑት። የእነርሱ ጩኸትና የካህናት አለቆችም ቃል በረታ።

verses.text_english: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ልመናቸው እንዲሆንላቸው ፈረደበት።

verses.text_english: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.text_amharic: ያንን የለመኑትንም፥ ስለ ሁከት ሰውንም ስለ መግደል በወኅኒ ታስሮ የነበረውን አስፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስን ግን ለፈቃዳቸው አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.text_amharic: በወሰዱትም ጊዜ ስምዖን የተባለ የቀሬናን ሰው ከገጠር ሲመጣ ይዘው ከኢየሱስ በኋላ መስቀሉን እንዲሸከም ጫኑበት።

verses.text_english: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear after Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ዋይ ዋይ ከሚሉና ሙሾ ከሚያወጡ ሴቶችና ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ብዙዎች ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤

verses.text_english: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.text_amharic: በእርጥብ እንጨት እንዲህ የሚያደርጉ ከሆኑ፥ በደረቀውስ እንዴት ይሆን?

verses.text_english: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችንም ሁለት ክፉ አድራጊዎች ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ይገድሉ ዘንድ ወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.text_amharic: ቀራንዮም ወደሚባል ስፍራ በደረሱ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ እርሱን ክፉ አድራጊዎቹንም አንዱን በቀኝ ሁለተኛውንም በግራ ሰቀሉ።

verses.text_english: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። አባት ሆይ፥ የሚያደርጉትን አያውቁምና ይቅር በላቸው አለ። ልብሱንም ተካፍለው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉበት።

verses.text_english: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ቆመው ይመለከቱ ነበር። መኳንንቱም ደግሞ። ሌሎችን አዳነ፤ እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር የተመረጠው ክርስቶስ ከሆነ፥ ራሱን ያድን እያሉ ያፌዙበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.text_amharic: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው ሆምጣጤም አምጥተው።

verses.text_english: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided , saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.text_amharic: አንተስ የአሁድ ንጉሥ ከሆንህ፥ ራስህን አድን እያሉ ይዘብቱበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነው ተብሎ በግሪክና በሮማይስጥ በዕብራይስጥም ፊደል የተጻፈ ጽሕፈት ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.text_amharic: ከተሰቀሉት ከክፉ አድራጊዎቹም አንዱ። አንተስ ክርስቶስ አይደለህምን? ራስህንም እኛንም አድን ብሎ ሰደበው።

verses.text_english: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛው ግን መልሶ። አንተ እንደዚህ ባለ ፍርድ ሳለህ እግዚአብሔርን ከቶ አትፈራውምን?

verses.text_english: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አደረግነውም የሚገባንን እንቀበላለንና በእኛስ እውነተኛ ፍርድ ነው፤ ይህ ግን ምንም ክፋት አላደረገም ብሎ ገሠጸው።

verses.text_english: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በመንግሥትህ በመጣህ ጊዜ አስበኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ዛሬ ከእኔ ጋር በገነት ትሆናለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስት ሰዓትም ያህል ነበረ፥ ጨለማም እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይም ጨለመ፥

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.text_amharic: የቤተ መቅደስም መጋረጃ ከመካከሉ ተቀደደ።

verses.text_english: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ። አባት ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን በእጅህ አደራ እሰጣለሁ አለ። ይህንም ብሎ ነፍሱን ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃውም የሆነውን ነገር ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ ሰው በእውነት ጻድቅ ነበረ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን አከበረ።

verses.text_english: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ለማየት ተከማችተው የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ደረታቸውን እየደቁ ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያውቁቱ ግን ሁሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ሴቶችም ይህን እያዩ በሩቅ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በጎና ጻድቅ ሰው የሸንጎ አማካሪም የሆነ ዮሴፍ የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በምክራቸውና በሥራቸው አልተባበረም ነበር፤ አርማትያስም ከምትባል ከአይሁድ ከተማ ሆኖ እርሱ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይጠባበቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And, behold, a man named Joseph, a counsellor; a good man, and a just:
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው፤

verses.text_english: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: አውርዶም በተልባ እግር ልብስ ከፈነው፥ ማንም ገና ባልተቀበረበት ከዓለትም በተወቀረ መቃብር አኖረው።

verses.text_english: This went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: የመዘጋጀት ቀንም ነበረ፤ ሰንበትም ሊጀምር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.text_amharic: ከገሊላም ከእርሱ ጋር የመጡት ሴቶች ተከትለው መቃብሩን ሥጋውንም እንዴት እንዳኖሩት አዩ።

verses.text_english: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሰውም ሽቱና ቅባት አዘጋጁ። በሰንበትም እንደ ትእዛዙ ዐረፉ።

verses.text_english: Now upon the first of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain with them.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከሳምንቱ በመጀመሪያው ቀን ያዘጋጁትን ሽቱ ይዘው ከእነርሱም ጋር አንዳንዶቹ ወደ መቃብሩ እጅግ ማልደው መጡ።

verses.text_english: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋዩንም ከመቃብሩ ተንከባሎ አገኙት፥

verses.text_english: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ገብተውም የጌታን የኢየሱስን ሥጋ አላገኙም።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በዚህ ሲያመነቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁለት ሰዎች የሚያንጸባርቅ ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ እነርሱ ቀረቡ፤

verses.text_english: And as they were afraid, and bowed down faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
verses.text_amharic: ፈርተውም ፊታቸውን ወደ ምድር አቀርቅረው ሳሉ፥ እንዲህ አሉአቸው። ሕያውን ከሙታን መካከል ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ተነሥቶአል እንጂ በዚህ የለም።

verses.text_english: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ሊሰጥና ሊሰቀል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ሊነሣ ግድ ነው እያለ ገና በገሊላ ሳለ ለእናንተ እንደ ተናገረ አስቡ።

verses.text_english: And they remembered his words,
And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሎቹንም አሰቡ፥ ከመቃብሩም ተመልሰው ይህን ሁሉ ለአሥራ አንዱና ለሌሎች ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary of James, and other with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ለሐዋርያት የነገሩአቸው መግደላዊት ማርያምና ዮሐና የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ከእነርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሌሎች ሴቶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ቃል ቅዠት መስሎ ታያቸውና አላመኑአቸውም።

verses.text_english: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ ግን ተነሥቶ ወደ መቃብር ሮጠ፤ በዚያም ዝቅ ብሎ ሲመለከት የተልባ እግር ልብስን ብቻ አየ፤ በሆነውም ነገር እየተደነቀ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem threescore furlongs.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ ከእነርሱ ሁለቱ በዚያ ቀን ከኢየሩሳሌም ስድሳ ምዕራፍ ያህል ወደሚርቅ ኤማሁስ ወደሚባል መንደር ይሄዱ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ስለ ሆነው ነገር ሁሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, while they communed and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
verses.text_amharic: ሲነጋገሩና ሲመራመሩም፥ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ቀርቦ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሄድ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንዳያውቁት ዓይናቸው ተይዞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What manner of communications these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እየጠወለጋችሁ ስትሄዱ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁ የምትነጋገሩአቸው እነዚህ ነገሮች ምንድር ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.text_amharic: ቀለዮጳ የሚባልም አንዱ መልሶ። አንተ በኢየሩሳሌም እንግዳ ሆነህ ለብቻህ ትኖራለህን? በእነዚህ ቀኖች በዚያ የሆነውን ነገር አታውቅምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ይህ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እንዲህ አሉት። በእግዚአብሔርና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት በሥራና በቃል ብርቱ ነቢይ ስለ ነበረው ስለ ናዝሬቱ ስለ ኢየሱስ፤

verses.text_english: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም የካህናት አለቆችና መኳንንቶቻችን ለሞት ፍርድ እንዴት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡትና እንደ ሰቀሉት ነው።

verses.text_english: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን እስራኤልን እንዲቤዥ ያለው እርሱ እንደ ሆነ ተስፋ አድርገን ነበር፤ ደግሞም ከዚህ ሁሉ ጋር ይህ ከሆነ ዛሬ ሦስተኛው ቀን ነው።

verses.text_english: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ከእኛ ውስጥ ማልደው ከመቃብሩ ዘንድ የነበሩት አንዳንድ ሴቶች አስገረሙን፤

verses.text_english: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋውንም ባጡ ጊዜ። ሕያው ነው የሚሉ የመላእክትን ራእይ ደግሞ አየን ሲሉ መጥተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኛም ጋር ከነበሩት ወደ መቃብር ሄደው ሴቶች እንደ ተናገሩት ሆኖ አገኙት፥ እርሱን ግን አላዩትም።

verses.text_english: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እናንተ የማታስተውሉ፥ ነቢያትም የተናገሩትን ሁሉ ልባችሁ ከማመን የዘገየ፤

verses.text_english: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.text_amharic: ክርስቶስ ይህን መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድና ወደ ክብሩ ይገባ ዘንድ ይገባው የለምን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.text_amharic: ከሙሴና ከነቢያት ሁሉ ጀምሮ ስለ እርሱ በመጻሕፍት ሁሉ የተጻፈውን ተረጐመላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.text_amharic: ወደሚሄዱበትም መንደር ቀረቡ፥ እርሱም ሩቅ የሚሄድ መሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ። ከእኛ ጋር እደር፥ ማታ ቀርቦአልና ቀኑም ሊመሽ ጀምሮአል ብለው ግድ አሉት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሊያድር ገባ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed , and brake, and gave to them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ እንጀራውን አንሥቶ ባረከው፥ ቈርሶም ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይናቸውም ተከፈተ፥ አወቁትም፤ እርሱም ከእነርሱ ተሰወረ።

verses.text_english: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም። በመንገድ ሲናገረን መጻሕፍትንም ሲከፍትልን ልባችን ይቃጠልብን አልነበረምን? ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በመንገድ የሆነውን እንጀራውንም በቈረሰ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they told what things in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሲነጋገሩ ኢየሱስ ራሱ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ደነገጡና ፈሩ መንፈስም ያዩ መሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ትደነግጣላችሁ? ስለ ምንስ አሳብ በልባችሁ ይነሣል?

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ራሴ እንደ ሆንሁ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን እዩ፤ በእኔ እንደምታዩት፥ መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት የለውምና እኔን ዳስሳችሁ እዩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them hands and feet.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከደስታ የተነሣ ገና ስላላመኑ ሲደነቁ ሳሉ። በዚህ አንዳች የሚበላ አላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከተጠበሰ ዓሣ አንድ ቁራጭ፥ ከማር ወለላም ሰጡት፤

verses.text_english: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀብሎም በፊታቸው በላ።

verses.text_english: And he took , and did eat before them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ በሙሴ ሕግና በነቢያት በመዝሙራትም ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይገባል ብዬ የነገርኋችሁ ቃሌ ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, These the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም መጻሕፍትን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ አእምሮአቸውን ከፈተላቸው፤

verses.text_english: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ መከራ ይቀበላል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ከሙታን ይነሣል፥

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.text_amharic: በስሙም ንስሐና የኃጢአት ስርየት ከኢየሩሳሌም ጀምሮ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበካል ተብሎ እንዲሁ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ለዚህ ምስክሮች ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ አባቴ የሰጠውን ተስፋ እኔ እልክላችኋለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ከላይ ኃይል እስክትለብሱ ድረስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከተማ ቆዩ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ ቢታንያም አወጣቸው እጆቹንም አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።

verses.text_english: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.text_amharic: ሲባርካቸውም ከእነርሱ ተለየ ወደ ሰማይም ዐረገ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም፤ ሰገዱለትና በብዙ ደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥

verses.text_english: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.text_amharic: ዘወትርም እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እየባረኩ በመቅደስ ኖሩ።

verses.text_english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.text_amharic: በመጀመሪያው ቃል ነበረ፥ ቃልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ፥ ቃልም እግዚአብሔር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ በመጀመሪያው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ከሆነውም አንዳች ስንኳ ያለ እርሱ አልሆነም።

verses.text_english: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ሕይወት ነበረች፥ ሕይወትም የሰው ብርሃን ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንም በጨለማ ይበራል፥ ጨለማም አላሸነፈውም።

verses.text_english: There was a man sent from God, whose name John.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር የተላከ ስሙ ዮሐንስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all through him might believe.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ በእርሱ በኩል እንዲያምኑ ይህ ስለ ብርሃን ይመሰክር ዘንድ ለምስክር መጣ።

verses.text_english: He was not that Light, but to bear witness of that Light.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ብርሃን ሊመሰክር መጣ እንጂ፥ እርሱ ብርሃን አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ሁሉ የሚያበራው እውነተኛው ብርሃን ወደ ዓለም ይመጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለም ነበረ፥ ዓለሙም በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ዓለሙም አላወቀውም።

verses.text_english: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.text_amharic: የእርሱ ወደ ሆነው መጣ፥ የገዛ ወገኖቹም አልተቀበሉትም።

verses.text_english: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, to them that believe on his name:
verses.text_amharic: ለተቀበሉት ሁሉ ግን፥ በስሙ ለሚያምኑት ለእነርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሥልጣንን ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከእግዚአብሔር ተወለዱ እንጂ ከደም ወይም ከሥጋ ፈቃድ ወይም ከወንድ ፈቃድ አልተወለዱም።

verses.text_english: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልም ሥጋ ሆነ፤ ጸጋንና እውነትንም ተመልቶ በእኛ አደረ፥ አንድ ልጅም ከአባቱ ዘንድ እንዳለው ክብር የሆነው ክብሩን አየን።

verses.text_english: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ ስለ እርሱ መሰከረ እንዲህም ብሎ ጮኸ። ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው እርሱ ከእኔ በፊት ነበረና ከእኔ ይልቅ የከበረ ሆኖአል፤ ስለ እርሱ ያልሁት ይህ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ሁላችን ከሙላቱ ተቀብለን በጸጋ ላይ ጸጋ ተሰጥቶናልና ሕግ በሙሴ ተሰጥቶ ነበርና፤

verses.text_english: For the law was given by Moses, grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ጸጋና እውነት ግን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared .
verses.text_amharic: መቼም ቢሆን እግዚአብሔርን ያየው አንድ ስንኳ የለም፤ በአባቱ እቅፍ ያለ አንድ ልጁ እርሱ ተረከው።

verses.text_english: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም። አንተ ማን ነህ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ዘንድ ከኢየሩሳሌም ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንን በላኩበት ጊዜ፥ የዮሐንስ ምስክርነት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.text_amharic: መሰከረም አልካደምም፤ እኔ ክርስቶስ አይደለሁም ብሎ መሰከረ።

verses.text_english: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.text_amharic: እንኪያስ ማን ነህ? ኤልያስ ነህን? ብለው ጠየቁት። አይደለሁም አለ። ነቢዩ ነህን? አይደለሁም ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.text_amharic: እንኪያስ። ማን ነህ? ለላኩን መልስ እንድንሰጥ፤ ስለራስህ ምን ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He said, I the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ እንዳለ። የጌታን መንገድ አቅኑ ብሎ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.text_amharic: የተላኩትም ከፈሪሳውያን ነበሩና። እንኪያስ አንተ ክርስቶስ ወይም ኤልያስ ወይም ነቢዩ ካይደለህ፥ ስለ ምን ታጠምቃለህ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔ በውኃ አጠምቃለሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት በመካከላችሁ ቆሞአል፤

verses.text_english: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የጫማውን ጠፍር ልፈታ የማይገባኝ፥ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ከእኔ ይልቅ የሚከብር ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ነገር ዮሐንስ ያጠምቅበት በነበረው በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በቢታንያ በቤተ ራባ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.text_amharic: በነገው ዮሐንስ ኢየሱስን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ እንዲህ አለ። እነሆ የዓለምን ኃጢአት የሚያስወግድ የእግዚአብሔር በግ።

verses.text_english: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ሰው ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል፥ ከእኔም በፊት ነበርና ከእኔ ይልቅ የከበረ ሆኖአል ብዬ ስለ እርሱ ያልሁት ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አላውቀውም ነበር፥ ዳሩ ግን ለእስራኤል ይገለጥ ዘንድ ስለዚህ በውኃ እያጠመቅሁ እኔ መጣሁ።

verses.text_english: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም እንዲህ ብሎ መሰከረ። መንፈስ ከሰማይ እንደ ርግብ ሆኖ ሲወርድ አየሁ፤ በእርሱ ላይም ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አላውቀውም ነበር፥ ዳሩ ግን በውኃ አጠምቅ ዘንድ የላከኝ እርሱ። መንፈስ ሲወርድበትና ሲኖርበት የምታየው፥ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የሚያጠምቅ እርሱ ነው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም አይቻለሁ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ መስክሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.text_amharic: በነገው ደግሞ ዮሐንስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሁለት ቆመው ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሲሄድ ተመልክቶ። እነሆ የእግዚአብሔር በግ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም ደቀ መዛሙርት ሲናገር ሰምተው ኢየሱስን ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ ሲከተሉትም አይቶ። ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ረቢ፥ ወዴት ትኖራለህ? አሉት፤ ትርጓሜው መምህር ሆይ ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: One of the two which heard John , and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
verses.text_amharic: መጥታችሁ እዩ አላቸው። መጥተው የሚኖርበትን አዩ፥ በዚያም ቀን በእርሱ ዘንድ ዋሉ፤ አሥር ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከዮሐንስ ዘንድ ሰምተው ከተከተሉት ከሁለቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ አስቀድሞ የራሱን ወንድም ስምዖንን አገኘውና። መሢሕን አግኝተናል አለው፤ ትርጓሜውም ክርስቶስ ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጣው። ኢየሱስም ተመልክቶ። አንተ የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ነህ፤ አንተ ኬፋ ትባላለህ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው ጴጥሮስ ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.text_amharic: በነገው ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ሊወጣ ወደደ፥ ፊልጶስንም አገኘና። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: ፊልጶስም ከእንድርያስና ከጴጥሮስ ከተማ ከቤተ ሳይዳ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.text_amharic: ፊልጶስ ናትናኤልን አግኝቶ። ሙሴ በሕግ ነቢያትም ስለ እርሱ የጻፉትን የዮሴፍን ልጅ የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን አግኝተነዋል አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.text_amharic: ናትናኤልም። ከናዝሬት መልካም ነገር ሊወጣ ይችላልን? አለው። ፊልጶስ። መጥተህ እይ አለው።

verses.text_english: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ናትናኤልን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ ስለ እርሱ። ተንኰል የሌለበት በእውነት የእስራኤል ሰው እነሆ አለ።

verses.text_english: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ናትናኤልም። ከወዴት ታውቀኛለህ? አለው። ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ፊልጶስ ሳይጠራህ፥ ከበለስ በታች ሳለህ፥ አየሁህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.text_amharic: ናትናኤልም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ፤ አንተ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከበለስ በታች አየሁህ ስላልሁህ አመንህን? ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ነገር ታያለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን በገሊላ ቃና ሰርግ ነበረ፥ የኢየሱስም እናት በዚያ ነበረች፤

verses.text_english: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ሰርጉ ታደሙ።

verses.text_english: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.text_amharic: የወይን ጠጅም ባለቀ ጊዜ የኢየሱስ እናት። የወይን ጠጅ እኮ የላቸውም አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ከአንቺ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ጊዜዬ ገና አልደረሰም አላት።

verses.text_english: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do .
verses.text_amharic: እናቱም ለአገልጋዮቹ። የሚላችሁን ሁሉ አድርጉ አለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም እንደሚያደርጉት የማንጻት ልማድ ስድስት የድንጋይ ጋኖች በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም ሁለት ወይም ሦስት እንስራ ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ጋኖቹን ውኃ ሙሉአቸው አላቸው። እስከ አፋቸውም ሙሉአቸው አላቸው። እስከ አፋቸውም ሞሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare .
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ቀድታችሁ ለአሳዳሪው ስጡት አላቸው፤ ሰጡትም።

verses.text_english: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.text_amharic: አሳዳሪውም የወይን ጠጅ የሆነውን ውሃ በቀመሰ ጊዜ ከወዴት እንደ መጣ አላወቀም፤ ውኃውን የቀዱት አገልጋዮች ግን ያውቁ ነበር፤ አሳዳሪው ሙሽራውን ጠርቶ።

verses.text_english: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሁሉ አስቀድሞ መልካሙን የወይን ጠጅ ያቀርባል፥ ከሰከሩም በኋላ መናኛውን፤ አንተስ መልካሙን የወይን ጠጅ እስከ አሁን አቆይተሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ይህን የምልክቶች መጀመሪያ በገሊላ ቃና አደረገ፤ ክብሩንም ገለጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.text_english: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ከእናቱና ከወንድሞቹ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ጋር ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ወረደ፥ በዚያም ጥቂት ቀን ኖሩ።

verses.text_english: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
verses.text_amharic: የአይሁድ ፋሲካም ቀርቦ ነበር፥ ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደስም በሬዎችንና በጎችን ርግቦችንም የሚሸጡትን ገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ተቀምጠው አገኘ፤

verses.text_english: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.text_amharic: የገመድም ጅራፍ አበጅቶ ሁሉን በጎችንም በሬዎችንም ከመቅደስ አወጣቸው፥ የለዋጮችንም ገንዘብ አፈሰሰ ገበታዎቻቸውንም ገለበጠ፥

verses.text_english: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.text_amharic: ርግብ ሻጪዎችንም። ይህን ከዚህ ውሰዱ፤ የአባቴን ቤት የንግድ ቤት አታድርጉት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። የቤትህ ቅናት ይበላኛል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ አሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አይሁድ መልሰው። ይህን ስለምታደርግ ምን ምልክት ታሳየናለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ይህን ቤተ መቅደስ አፍርሱት፥ በሦስት ቀንም አነሣዋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አይሁድ። ይህ ቤተ መቅደስ ከአርባ ስድስት ዓመት ጀምሮ ይሠራ ነበር፥ አንተስ በሦስት ቀን ታነሣዋለህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ስለ ሰውነቱ ቤተ መቅደስ ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከሙታን ከተነሣ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይህን እንደ ተናገረ አሰቡና መጽሐፍንና ኢየሱስ የተናገረውን ቃል አመኑ።

verses.text_english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast , many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.text_amharic: በፋሲካ በዓልም በኢየሩሳሌም ሳለ፥ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ ብዙ ሰዎች በስሙ አመኑ፤

verses.text_english: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all ,
There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያንም ወገን የአይሁድ አለቃ የሆነ ኒቆዲሞስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም በሌሊት ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥቶ።

verses.text_english: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.text_amharic: መምህር ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ከሆነ በቀር አንተ የምታደርጋቸውን እነዚህን ምልክቶች ሊያደርግ የሚችል የለምና መምህር ሆነህ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንደ መጣህ እናውቃለን አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሰው ዳግመኛ ካልተወለደ በቀር የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ሊያይ አይችልም አለው።

verses.text_english: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.text_amharic: ኒቆዲሞስም። ሰው ከሸመገለ በኋላ እንዴት ሊወለድ ይችላል? ሁለተኛ ወደ እናቱ ማኅፀን ገብቶ ይወለድ ዘንድ ይችላልን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሰው ከውኃና ከመንፈስ ካልተወለደ በቀር ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ሊገባ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ከሥጋ የተወለደ ሥጋ ነው፥ ከመንፈስም የተወለደ መንፈስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.text_amharic: ዳግመኛ ልትወለዱ ያስፈልጋችኋል ስላልሁህ አታድንቅ።

verses.text_english: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ነፋስ ወደሚወደው ይነፍሳል፥ ድምፁንም ትሰማለህ፥ ነገር ግን ከወዴት እንደ መጣ ወዴትም እንዲሄድ አታውቅም፤ ከመንፈስ የተወለደ ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.text_amharic: ኒቆዲሞስ መልሶ። ይህ እንዴት ሊሆን ይችላል? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አንተ የእስራኤል መምህር ስትሆን ይህን አታውቅምን?

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ የምናውቀውን እንናገራለን ያየነውንም እንመሰክራለን፥ ምስክራችንንም አትቀበሉትም።

verses.text_english: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምድራዊ ነገር በነገርኋችሁ ጊዜ ካላመናችሁ፥ ስለ ሰማያዊ ነገር ብነግራችሁ እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?

verses.text_english: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይም ከወረደ በቀር ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ ማንም የለም፥ እርሱም በሰማይ የሚኖረው የሰው ልጅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረው እንጂ እንዳይጠፋ እግዚአብሔር አንድያ ልጁን እስኪሰጥ ድረስ ዓለሙን እንዲሁ ወዶአልና።

verses.text_english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለም በልጁ እንዲድን ነው እንጂ፥ በዓለም እንዲፈርድ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ዓለም አልላከውምና።

verses.text_english: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ በሚያምን አይፈረድበትም፤ በማያምን ግን በአንዱ በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ስም ስላላመነ አሁን ተፈርዶበታል።

verses.text_english: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: ብርሃንም ወደ ዓለም ስለ መጣ ሰዎችም ሥራቸው ክፉ ነበርና ከብርሃን ይልቅ ጨለማን ስለ ወደዱ ፍርዱ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ብርሃንን ይጠላልና፥ ሥራውም እንዳይገለጥ ወደ ብርሃን አይመጣም፤

verses.text_english: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትን የሚያደርግ ግን ሥራው በእግዚአብሔር ተደርጎ እንደ ሆነ ይገለጥ ዘንድ ወደ ብርሃን ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ይሁዳ አገር መጣ፥ በዚያም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተቀምጦ ያጠምቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም ደግሞ በሳሌም አቅራቢያ በሄኖን በዚያ ብዙ ውኃ ነበርና ያጠምቅ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.text_amharic: እየመጡም ይጠመቁ ነበር ዮሐንስ ገና ወደ ወኅኒ አልተጨመረም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርትና በአይሁድ መካከል ስለ ማንጻት ክርክር ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Then there arose a question between of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዮሐንስም መጥተው። መምህር ሆይ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከአንተ ጋር የነበረው አንተም የመሰከርህለት፥ እነሆ፥ እርሱ ያጠምቃል ሁሉም ወደ እርሱ ይመጣሉ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all come to him.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ከሰማይ ካልተሰጠው ሰው እንዳች ሊቀበል አይችልም።

verses.text_english: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። እኔ ክርስቶስ አይደለሁም፥ ነገር ግን። ከእርሱ በፊት ተልኬአለሁ እንዳልሁ ራሳችሁ ትመሰክሩልኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሽራይቱ ያለችው እርሱ ሙሽራ ነው፤ ቆሞ የሚሰማው ሚዜው ግን በሙሽራው ድምጽ እጅግ ደስ ይለዋል። እንግዲህ ይህ ደስታዬ ተፈጸመ።

verses.text_english: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ሊልቅ እኔ ግን ላንስ ያስፈልጋል።

verses.text_english: He must increase, but I decrease.
verses.text_amharic: ከላይ የሚመጣው ከሁሉ በላይ ነው፤ ከምድር የሚሆነው የምድር ነው የምድሩንም ይናገራል። ከሰማይ የሚመጣው ከሁሉ በላይ ነው።

verses.text_english: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.text_amharic: ያየውንና የሰማውንም ይህን ይመሰክራል፥ ምስክሩንም የሚቀበለው የለም።

verses.text_english: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክሩን የተቀበለ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ አተመ።

verses.text_english: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የላከው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይናገራልና፤ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን ሰፍሮ አይሰጥምና።

verses.text_english: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure .
verses.text_amharic: አባት ልጁን ይወዳል ሁሉንም በእጁ ሰጥቶታል።

verses.text_english: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.text_amharic: በልጁ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፤ በልጁ የማያምን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእርሱ ላይ ይኖራል እንጂ ሕይወትን አያይም።

verses.text_english: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። ኢየሱስ ከዮሐንስ ይልቅ ደቀ መዛሙርት ያደርጋል ያጠምቅማል ማለትን ፈሪሳውያን እንደ ሰሙ ጌታ ባወቀ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳን ትቶ ወደ ገሊላ ደግሞ ሄደ፤ ዳሩ ግን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንጂ ኢየሱስ ራሱ አላጠመቀም።

verses.text_english: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማርያም ሊያልፍ ግድ ሆነበት።

verses.text_english: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ያዕቆብ ለልጁ ለዮሴፍ በሰጠው ስፍራ አጠገብ ወደምትሆን ሲካር ወደምትባል የሰማርያ ከተማ መጣ፤

verses.text_english: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with journey, sat thus on the well: it was about the sixth hour.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የያዕቆብ ጕድጓድ ነበረ። ኢየሱስም መንገድ ከመሄድ ደክሞ በጕድጓድ አጠገብ እንዲህ ተቀመጠ፤ ጊዜውም ስድስት ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማርያ አንዲት ሴት ውኃ ልትቀዳ መጣች። ኢየሱስም። ውኃ አጠጪኝ አላት፤

verses.text_english: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ምግብ ሊገዙ ወደ ከተማ ሄደው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሳምራዊቲቱ። አንተ የይሁዳ ሰው ስትሆን ሳምራዊት ሴት ከምሆን ከእኔ መጠጥ እንዴት ትለምናለህ? አለችው፤ አይሁድ ከሳምራውያን ጋር አይተባበሩም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታና። ውኃ አጠጪኝ የሚልሽ ማን መሆኑንስ ብታውቂ፥ አንቺ ትለምኚው ነበርሽ የሕይወትም ውኃ ይሰጥሽ ነበር አላት።

verses.text_english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መቅጃ የለህም ጕድጓዱም ጥልቅ ነው፤ እንግዲህ የሕይወት ውኃ ከወዴት ታገኛለህ?

verses.text_english: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.text_amharic: በእውኑ አንተ ይህን ጕድጓድ ከሰጠን ከአባታችን ከያዕቆብ ትበልጣለህን? ራሱም ልጆቹም ከብቶቹም ከዚህ ጠጥተዋል አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከዚህ ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሁሉ እንደ ገና ይጠማል፤

verses.text_english: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከምሰጠው ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሁሉ ግን ለዘላለም አይጠማም፥ እኔ የምሰጠው ውኃ በእርሱ ውስጥ ለዘላለም ሕይወት የሚፈልቅ የውኃ ምንጭ ይሆናል እንጂ አላት።

verses.text_english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንዳልጠማ ውኃም ልቀዳ ወደዚህ እንዳልመጣ ይህን ውኃ ስጠኝ አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሂጂና ባልሽን ጠርተሽ ወደዚህ ነዪ አላት።

verses.text_english: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱ መልሳ። ባል የለኝም አለችው። ኢየሱስ። ባል የለኝም በማለትሽ መልካም ተናገርሽ፤

verses.text_english: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.text_amharic: አምስት ባሎች ነበሩሽና፥ አሁን ከአንቺ ጋር ያለው ባልሽ አይደለም፤ በዚህስ እውነት ተናገርሽ አላት።

verses.text_english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ነቢይ እንደ ሆንህ አያለሁ።

verses.text_english: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችን በዚህ ተራራ ሰገዱ፤ እናንተም። ሰው ሊሰግድበት የሚገባው ስፍራ በኢየሩሳሌም ነው ትላላችሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላት። አንቺ ሴት፥ እመኚኝ፥ በዚህ ተራራ ወይም በኢየሩሳሌም ለአብ የማትሰግዱበት ጊዜ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተስ ለማታውቁት ትሰግዳላችሁ፤ እኛ መዳን ከአይሁድ ነውና ለምናውቀው እንሰግዳለን።

verses.text_english: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእውነት የሚሰግዱ ለአብ በመንፈስና በእውነት የሚሰግዱበት ጊዜ ይመጣል አሁንም ሆኖአል፤ አብ ሊሰግዱለት እንደ እነዚህ ያሉትን ይሻልና፤

verses.text_english: God a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and in truth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ነው፥ የሚሰግዱለትም በመንፈስና በእውነት ሊሰግዱለት ያስፈልጋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱ። ክርስቶስ የሚባል መሲሕ እንዲመጣ አውቃለሁ፤ እርሱ ሲመጣ ሁሉን ይነግረናል አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am .
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ። የምናገርሽ እኔ እርሱ ነኝ አላት።

verses.text_english: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጡና ከሴት ጋር በመነጋገሩ ተደነቁ፤ ነገር ግን። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? ወይም። ስለ ምን ትናገራታለህ? ያለ ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም እንስራዋን ትታ ወደ ከተማ ሄደች ለሰዎችም።

verses.text_english: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.text_amharic: ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ የነገረኝን ሰው ኑና እዩ፤ እንጃ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ይሆንን? አለች።

verses.text_english: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ከከተማ ወጥተው ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሲሆን ሳለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ብላ ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። እናንተ የማታውቁት የምበላው መብል ለእኔ አለኝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him to eat?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። የሚበላው አንዳች ሰው አምጥቶለት ይሆንን? ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። የእኔስ መብል የላከኝን ፈቃድ አደርግ ዘንድ ሥራውንም እፈጽም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ። ገና አራት ወር ቀርቶአል መከርም ይመጣል ትሉ የለምን? እነሆ እላችኋለሁ፥ ዓይናችሁን አንሡ አዝመራውም አሁን እንደ ነጣ እርሻውን ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያጭድ ደመወዝን ይቀበላል፥ የሚዘራና የሚያጭድም አብረው ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለም ሕይወት ፍሬን ይሰበስባል።

verses.text_english: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱ ይዘራል አንዱም ያጭዳል የሚለው ቃል በዚህ እውነት ሆኖአልና።

verses.text_english: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም እናንተ ያልደከማችሁበትን ታጭዱ ዘንድ ሰደድኋችሁ፤ ሌሎች ደከሙ እናንተም በድካማቸው ገባችሁ።

verses.text_english: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም። ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ ነገረኝ ብላ ስለ መሰከረችው ቃል ከዚያች ከተማ የሰማርያ ሰዎች ብዙ አመኑበት።

verses.text_english: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማርያ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ በመጡ ጊዜ በእነርሱ ዘንድ እንዲኖር ለመኑት፤ በዚያም ሁለት ቀን ያህል ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ቃሉ ከፊተኞች ይልቅ ብዙ ሰዎች አመኑ፤

verses.text_english: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱንም። አሁን የምናምን ስለ ቃልሽ አይደለም፥ እኛ ራሳችን ሰምተነዋልና፤ እርሱም በእውነት ክርስቶስ የዓለም መድኃኒት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን ይሉአት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለቱ ቀኖችም በኋላ ከዚያ ወጥቶ ወደ ገሊላ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.text_amharic: ነቢይ በገዛ አገሩ እንዳይከበር ኢየሱስ ራሱ መስክሮአልና።

verses.text_english: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ገሊላም በመጣ ጊዜ፥ የገሊላ ሰዎች ራሳቸው ደግሞ ለበዓል መጥተው ነበርና በበዓል በኢየሩሳሌም ያደረገውን ሁሉ ስላዩ ተቀበሉት።

verses.text_english: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ውኃውን የወይን ጠጅ ወዳደረገባት ወደ ገሊላ ቃና ዳግመኛ መጣ። በቅፍርናሆምም ልጁ የታመመበት ከንጉሥ ቤት አንድ ሹም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ኢየሱስ ከይሁዳ ወደ ገሊላ እንደ መጣ ሰምቶ ልጁ ሊሞት ስላለው ወደ እርሱ ሄደ ወርዶም እንዲፈውስለት ለመነው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ። ምልክትና ድንቅ ነገር ካላያችሁ ከቶ አታምኑም አለው።

verses.text_english: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.text_amharic: ሹሙም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብላቴናዬ ሳይሞት ውረድ አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሂድ፤ ልጅህ በሕይወት አለ አለው። ሰውዬውም ኢየሱስ የነገረውን ቃል አምኖ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told , saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሲወርድ ሳለ ባሮቹ ተገናኙትና። ብላቴናህ በሕይወት አለ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በጎ የሆነበትን ሰዓት ጠየቃቸው፤ እነርሱም። ትናንት በሰባት ሰዓት ንዳዱ ለቀቀው አሉት።

verses.text_english: So the father knew that at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.text_amharic: አባቱም ኢየሱስ። ልጅህ በሕይወት አለ ባለው በዚያ ሰዓት እንደ ሆነ አወቀ፤ እርሱም ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር አመነ።

verses.text_english: This again the second miracle Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ደግሞ ኢየሱስ ከይሁዳ ወደ ገሊላ መጥቶ ያደረገው ሁለተኛ ምልክት ነው።

verses.text_english: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ የአይሁድ በዓል ነበረ፥ ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም በበጎች በር አጠገብ በዕብራይስጥ ቤተ ሳይዳ የምትባል አንዲት መጠመቂያ ነበረች፤ አምስትም መመላለሻ ነበረባት።

verses.text_english: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህ ውስጥ የውኃውን መንቀሳቀስ እየጠበቁ በሽተኞችና ዕውሮች አንካሶችም ሰውነታቸውም የሰለለ ብዙ ሕዝብ ይተኙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንድ ጊዜ የጌታ መልአክ ወደ መጠመቂያይቱ ወርዶ ውኃውን ያናውጥ ነበርና፤ እንግዲህ ከውኃው መናወጥ በኋላ በመጀመሪያ የገባ ከማናቸው ካለበት ደዌ ጤናማ ይሆን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ከሠላሳ ስምንት ዓመት ጀምሮ የታመመ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time , he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ይህን ሰው ተኝቶ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እስከ አሁን ብዙ ዘመን እንዲሁ እንደ ነበረ አውቆ። ልትድን ትወዳለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.text_amharic: ድውዩም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ውኃው በተናወጠ ጊዜ በመጠመቂያይቱ ውስጥ የሚያኖረኝ ሰው የለኝም ነገር ግን እኔ ስመጣ ሳለሁ ሌላው ቀድሞኝ ይወርዳል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ። ተነሣና አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.text_english: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ሰውዬው ዳነ አልጋውንም ተሸክሞ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry bed.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ቀን ሰንበት ነበረ። ስለዚህ አይሁድ የተፈወሰውን ሰው። ሰንበት ነው አልጋህንም ልትሸከም አልተፈቀደልህም አሉት።

verses.text_english: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። ያዳነኝ ያ ሰው። አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ አለኝ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ ያለህ ሰው ማን ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in place.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን በዚያ ስፍራ ሕዝብ ሰለ ነበሩ ኢየሱስ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ነበርና የተፈወሰው ሰው ማን እንደ ሆነ አላወቀም።

verses.text_english: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ አገኘውና። እነሆ፥ ድነሃል፤ ከዚህ የሚብስ እንዳይደርስብህ ወደ ፊት ኃጢአት አትሥራ አለው።

verses.text_english: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዬው ሄዶ ያዳነው ኢየሱስ እንደ ሆነ ለአይሁድ ነገረ።

verses.text_english: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በሰንበት ይህን ስላደረገ አይሁድ ኢየሱስን ያሳድዱት ነበር ሊገድሉትም ይፈልጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን። አባቴ እስከ ዛሬ ይሠራል እኔም ደግሞ እሠራለሁ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሰንበትን ስለ ሻረ ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ደግሞ ራሱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አስተካክሎ። እግዚአብሔር አባቴ ነው ስላለ፥ ስለዚህ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት አብዝተው ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብ ሲያደርግ ያየውን ነው እንጂ ወልድ ከራሱ ሊያደርግ ምንም አይችልም፤ ያ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ ወልድ ደግሞ ይህን እንዲሁ ያደርጋልና።

verses.text_english: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.text_amharic: አብ ወልድን ይወዳልና፥ የሚያደርገውንም ሁሉ ያሳየዋል፤ እናንተም ትደነቁ ዘንድ ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ሥራ ያሳየዋል።

verses.text_english: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.text_amharic: አብ ሙታንን እንደሚያነሣ ሕይወትም እንደሚሰጣቸው፥ እንዲሁ ወልድ ደግሞ ለሚወዳቸው ሕይወትን ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
That all should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚሰማ የላከኝንም የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ ከሞትም ወደ ሕይወት ተሻገረ እንጂ ወደ ፍርድ አይመጣም።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሙታን የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ድምፅ የሚሰሙበት ሰዓት ይመጣል እርሱም አሁን ነው፤ የሚሰሙትም በሕይወት ይኖራሉ።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.text_amharic: አብ በራሱ ሕይወት እንዳለው እንዲሁ ደግሞ ለወልድ በራሱ ሕይወት እንዲኖረው ሰጥቶታልና።

verses.text_english: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ልጅም ስለ ሆነ ይፈርድ ዘንድ ሥልጣን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከራሴ አንዳች ላደርግ አይቻለኝም፤ እንደ ሰማሁ እፈርዳለሁ ፍርዴም ቅን ነው፥ የላከኝን ፈቃድ እንጂ ፈቃዴን አልሻምና።

verses.text_english: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ስለ እኔ ስለ ራሴ ብመሰክር ምስክሬ እውነት አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክር ሌላ ነው፥ እርሱም ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክረው ምስክር እውነት እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ወደ ዮሐንስ ልካችኋል እርሱም ለእውነት መስክሮአል።

verses.text_english: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ከሰው ምስክር አልቀበልም፥ እናንተ እንድትድኑ ይህን እላለሁ እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ የሚነድና የሚያበራ መብራት ነበረ፥ እናንተም ጥቂት ዘመን በብርሃኑ ደስ ሊላችሁ ወደዳችሁ።

verses.text_english: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ከዮሐንስ ምስክር የሚበልጥ ምስክር አለኝ፤ አብ ልፈጽመው የሰጠኝ ሥራ፥ ይህ የማደርገው ሥራ፥ አብ እንደ ላከኝ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.text_english: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.text_amharic: የላከኝ አብም እርሱ ስለ እኔ መስክሮአል። ድምፁን ከቶ አልሰማችሁም፥ መልኩንም አላያችሁም፤

verses.text_english: But I have greater witness than of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የላከውን እናንተ አታምኑምና በእናንተ ዘንድ የሚኖር ቃሉ የላችሁም።

verses.text_english: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በመጻሕፍት የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳላችሁ ይመስላችኋልና እነርሱን ትመረምራላችሁ፤ እነርሱም ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክሩ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሕይወት እንዲሆንላችሁ ወደ እኔ ልትመጡ አትወዱም።

verses.text_english: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በአባቴ ስም መጥቻለሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝምም፤ ሌላው በራሱ ስም ቢመጣ እርሱን ትቀበሉታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: I receive not honour from men.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ እርስ በርሳችሁ ክብር የምትቀባበሉ ከአንዱም ከእግዚአብሔር ያለውን ክብር የማትፈልጉ፥ እንዴት ልታምኑ ትችላላችሁ?

verses.text_english: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በአብ ዘንድ የምከሳችሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ የሚከሳችሁ አለ፤ እርሱም ተስፋ የምታደርጉት ሙሴ ነው።

verses.text_english: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴንስ ብታምኑት እኔን ባመናችሁ ነበር፤ እርሱ ስለ እኔ ጽፎአልና።

verses.text_english: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that from God only?
verses.text_amharic: መጻሕፍትን ካላመናችሁ ግን ቃሌን እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?
