verses.text_english: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is of Tiberias.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር ማዶ ተሻገረ፤ እርሱም የጥብርያዶስ ባሕር ነው።

verses.text_english: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.text_amharic: በበሽተኞችም ያደረገውን ምልክቶች ስላዩ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ ተራራ ወጣና በዚያ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
verses.text_amharic: የአይሁድ በዓልም ፋሲካ ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: When Jesus then lifted up eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ዓይኖቹን አንሥቶ ብዙ ሕዝብ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አየና ፊልጶስን። እነዚህ እንዲበሉ እንጀራ ከወዴት እንገዛለን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱ ሊያደርግ ያለውን ያውቅ ነበርና ሊፈትነው ይህን ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.text_amharic: ፊልጶስ። እያንዳንዳቸው ትንሽ ትንሽ እንኳ እንዲቀበሉ የሁለት መቶ ዲናር እንጀራ አይበቃቸውም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ።

verses.text_english: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.text_amharic: አምስት የገብስ እንጀራና ሁለት ዓሣ የያዘ ብላቴና በዚህ አለ፤ ነገር ግን እነዚህን ለሚያህሉ ሰዎች ይህ ምን ይሆናል? አለው።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ሰዎቹን እንዲቀመጡ አድርጉ አለ። በዚያም ስፍራ ብዙ ሣር ነበረበት። ወንዶችም ተቀመጡ ቍጥራቸውም አምስት ሺህ የሚያህል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንጀራውን ያዘ፥ አመስግኖም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለተቀመጡት ሰዎች ሰጡአቸው እንዲሁም ከዓሣው በፈለጉት መጠን።

verses.text_english: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.text_amharic: ከጠገቡም በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። አንድ ስንኳ እንዳይጠፋ የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አከማቹ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore they gathered together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.text_amharic: ሰለዚህ አከማቹ፥ ከበሉትም ከአምስቱ የገብስ እንጀራ የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሞሉ።

verses.text_english: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ የተነሣ ሰዎቹ ኢየሱስ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ። ይህ በእውነት ወደ ዓለም የሚመጣው ነቢይ ነው አሉ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ምክንያት ኢየሱስ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ሊመጡና ሊነጥቁት እንዳላቸው አውቆ ደግሞ ወደ ተራራ ብቻውን ፈቀቅ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when even was come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.text_amharic: በመሸም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ባሕር ወረዱ፥

verses.text_english: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
verses.text_amharic: በታንኳም ገብተው በባሕር ማዶ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ይመጡ ነበር። አሁንም ጨልሞ ነበር፤ ኢየሱስም ገና ወደ እነርሱ አልመጣም ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.text_amharic: ብርቱ ነፋስም ስለ ነፈሰ ባሕሩ ተናወጠ።

verses.text_english: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ አምስት ወይም ሠላሳ ምዕራፍ ከቀዘፉ በኋላም፥ ኢየሱስ በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ ታንኳይቱ ሲቀርብ አይተው ፈሩ።

verses.text_english: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን። እኔ ነኝ፤ አትፍሩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በታንኳይቱ ሊቀበሉት ወደዱ፤ ወዲያውም ታንኳይቱ ወደሚሄዱበት ምድር ደረሰች።

verses.text_english: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.text_amharic: በነገው በባሕር ማዶ ቆመው የነበሩ ሕዝቡ ከአንዲት ጀልባ በቀር በዚያ ሌላ ጀልባ እንዳልነበረች፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለብቻቸው እንደ ሄዱ እንጂ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳይቱ እንዳልገባ አዩ፤

verses.text_english: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን ሌሎች ጀልባዎች ጌታ የባረከውን እንጀራ ወደ በሉበት ስፍራ አጠገብ ከጥብርያዶስ መጡ።

verses.text_english: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ኢየሱስ ወይም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በዚያ እንዳልነበሩ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ራሳቸው በጀልባዎቹ ገብተው ኢየሱስን እየፈለጉ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.text_amharic: በባሕር ማዶም ሲያገኙት። መምህር ሆይ፥ ወደዚህ መቼ መጣህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የምትፈልጉኝ እንጀራን ስለ በላችሁና ስለ ጠገባችሁ ነው እንጂ ምልክቶችን ስላያችሁ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚጠፋ መብል አትሥሩ፤ ነገር ግን ለዘላለም ሕይወት ለሚኖር መብል የሰው ልጅ ለሚሰጣችሁ ሥሩ፤ እርሱን እግዚአብሔር አብ አትሞታልና።

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንድንሠራ ምን እናድርግ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ እርሱ በላከው እንድታምኑ ነው አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። እንኪያ አይተን እንድናምንህ አንተ ምን ምልክት ታደርጋለህ? ምንስ ትሠራለህ?

verses.text_english: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.text_amharic: ይበሉ ዘንድ ከሰማይ እንጀራ ሰጣቸው ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ አባቶቻችን በምድረ በዳ መና በሉ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እውነተኛ እንጀራ ከሰማይ የሚሰጣችሁ አባቴ ነው እንጂ ከሰማይ እንጀራ የሰጣችሁ ሙሴ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር እንጀራ ከሰማይ የሚወርድ ለዓለምም ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን እንጀራ ዘወትር ስጠን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። የሕይወት እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ፤ ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ከቶ አይራብም በእኔ የሚያምንም ሁልጊዜ ከቶ አይጠማም።

verses.text_english: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አይታችሁኝ እንዳላመናችሁ አልኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.text_amharic: አብ የሚሰጠኝ ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣል፥ ወደ እኔም የሚመጣውን ከቶ ወደ ውጭ አላወጣውም፤

verses.text_english: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ፈቃዴን ለማድረግ አይደለም እንጂ የላከኝን ፈቃድ ለማድረግ ከሰማይ ወርጃለሁና።

verses.text_english: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰጠኝም ሁሉ አንድን ስንኳ እንዳላጠፋ በመጨረሻው ቀን እንዳስነሣው እንጂ የላከኝ የአብ ፈቃድ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.text_amharic: ልጅንም አይቶ በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወትን እንዲያገኝ የአባቴ ፈቃድ ይህ ነው፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። ከሰማይ የወረደ እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ ስላለ ስለ እርሱ አንጐራጐሩና።

verses.text_english: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.text_amharic: አባቱንና እናቱን የምናውቃቸው ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ ኢየሱስ አይደለምን? እንግዲህ። ከሰማይ ወርጃለሁ እንዴት ይላል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። እርስ በርሳችሁ አታንጐራጕሩ።

verses.text_english: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.text_amharic: የላከኝ አብ ከሳበው በቀር ወደ እኔ ሊመጣ የሚችል የለም፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ ተብሎ በነቢያት ተጽፎአል፤ እንግዲህ ከአብ የሰማ የተማረም ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
verses.text_amharic: አብን ያየ ማንም የለም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከሆነ በቀር፥ እርሱ አብን አይቶአል።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ በእኔ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው።

verses.text_english: I am that bread of life.
verses.text_amharic: የሕይወት እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶቻችሁ በምድረ በዳ መና በሉ ሞቱም፤

verses.text_english: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ከእርሱ በልቶ እንዳይሞት ከሰማይ አሁን የወረደ እንጀራ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይ የወረደ ሕያው እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ፤ ሰው ከዚህ እንጀራ ቢበላ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ እኔም ስለ ዓለም ሕይወት የምሰጠው እንጀራ ሥጋዬ ነው።

verses.text_english: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us flesh to eat?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። ይህ ሰው ሥጋውን ልንበላ ይሰጠን ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል? ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተከራከሩ።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰውን ልጅ ሥጋ ካልበላችሁ ደሙንም ካልጠጣችሁ በራሳችሁ ሕይወት የላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋዬን የሚበላ ደሜንም የሚጠጣ የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋዬ እውነተኛ መብል ደሜም እውነተኛ መጠጥ ነውና።

verses.text_english: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋዬን የሚበላ ደሜንም የሚጠጣ በእኔ ይኖራል እኔም በእርሱ እኖራለሁ።

verses.text_english: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው አብ እንደ ላከኝ እኔም ከአብ የተነሣ ሕያው እንደምሆን፥ እንዲሁ የሚበላኝ ደግሞ ከእኔ የተነሣ ሕያው ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይ የወረደ እንጀራ ይህ ነው፤ አባቶቻችሁ መና በልተው እንደ ሞቱ አይደለም፤ ይህን እንጀራ የሚበላ ለዘላለም ይኖራል

verses.text_english: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.text_amharic: በቅፍርናሆም ሲያስተምር ይህን በምኵራብ አለ።

verses.text_english: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard , said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙዎች በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህ የሚያስጨንቅ ንግግር ነው፤ ማን ሊሰማው ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለዚህ እንዳንጐራጐሩ በልቡ አውቆ አላቸው። ይህ ያሰናክላችኋልን?

verses.text_english: and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የሰው ልጅ አስቀድሞ ወደ ነበረበት ሲወጣ ብታዩ እንዴት ይሆናል?

verses.text_english: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, are spirit, and are life.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ መንፈስ ነው፤ ሥጋ ምንም አይጠቅምም፤ እኔ የነገርኋችሁ ቃል መንፈስ ነው ሕይወትም ነው።

verses.text_english: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ የማያምኑ አሉ። ኢየሱስ የማያምኑት እነማን እንደ ሆኑ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም ማን እንደ ሆነ ከመጀመሪያ ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ። ስለዚህ አልኋችሁ፥ ከአብ የተሰጠው ካልሆነ ወደ እኔ ሊመጣ የሚችል የለም አለ።

verses.text_english: From that many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም የተነሣ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብዙዎች ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፤ ወደ ፊትም ከእርሱ ጋር አልሄዱም።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ። እናንተ ደግሞ ልትሄዱ ትወዳላችሁን? አለ።

verses.text_english: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ማን እንሄዳለን? አንተ የዘላለም ሕይወት ቃል አለህ፤

verses.text_english: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.text_amharic: እኛስ አንተ ክርስቶስ የሕያው የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆንህ አምነናል አውቀናልም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔ እናንተን አሥራ ሁለታችሁን የመረጥኋችሁ አይደለምን? ከእናንተም አንዱ ዲያብሎስ ነው ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: He spake of Judas Iscariot of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ስምዖንም ልጅ ስለ አስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ ተናገረ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ የሆነ እርሱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ አለውና።

verses.text_english: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢየሱስ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ስለ ነበር በይሁዳ ሊመላለስ አይወድም ነበርና በገሊላ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.text_amharic: የአይሁድም የዳስ በዓል ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ወንድሞቹ። ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ደግሞ የምታደርገውን ሥራ እንዲያዩ ከዚህ ተነሣና ወደ ይሁዳ ሂድ፤

verses.text_english: For no man doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱ ሊገለጥ እየፈለገ በስውር የሚሠራ የለምና። እነዚህን ብታደርግ ራስህን ለዓለም ግለጥ አሉት።

verses.text_english: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹ ስንኳ አላመኑበትም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ጊዜዬ ገና አልደረሰም፥ ጊዜያችሁ ግን ዘወትር የተመቸ ነው።

verses.text_english: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለም እናንተን ሊጠላ አይቻለውም፤ እኔ ግን ሥራው ክፉ መሆኑን እመሰክርበታለሁና እኔን ይጠላኛል።

verses.text_english: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ወደዚህ በዓል ውጡ፤ እኔስ ጊዜዬ ገና ስላልተፈጸመ ወደዚህ በዓል ገና አልወጣም።

verses.text_english: When he had said these words unto them, he abode in Galilee.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም አላቸውና በገሊላ ቀረ።

verses.text_english: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቹ ግን ወደ በዓሉ ከወጡ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በግልጥ ሳይሆን ተሰውሮ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም። እርሱ ወዴት ነው? እያሉ በበዓሉ ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝብም መካከል ስለ እርሱ ብዙ ማንጐራጐር ነበረ፤ አንዳንዱም። ደግ ሰው ነው፤ ሌሎች ግን። አይደለም፥ ሕዝቡን ግን ያስታል ይሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ማንም ስለ እርሱ በግልጥ አይናገርም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም በበዓሉ እኩሌታ ኢየሱስ ወደ መቅደስ ወጥቶ ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም። ይህ ሰው ሳይማር መጻሕፍትን እንዴት ያውቃል? ብለው ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። ትምህርቴስ ከላከኝ ነው እንጂ ከእኔ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or I speak of myself.
verses.text_amharic: ፈቃዱን ሊያደርግ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ እርሱ ይህ ትምህርት ከእግዚአብሔር ቢሆን ወይም እኔ ከራሴ የምናገር ብሆን ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.text_amharic: ከራሱ የሚናገር የራሱን ክብር ይፈልጋል፤ የላከውን ክብር የሚፈልግ ግን እርሱ እውነተኛ ነው በእርሱም ዓመፃ የለበትም።

verses.text_english: Did not Moses give you the law, and none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ ሕግን አልሰጣችሁምን? ከእናንተ ግን ሕግን የሚያደርግ አንድ ስንኳ የለም። ልትገድሉኝ ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ?

verses.text_english: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡ መለሱና። ጋኔን አለብህ፤ ማን ሊገድልህ ይፈልጋል? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። አንድ ሥራ አደረግሁ ሁላችሁም ታደንቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሙሴ መገረዝን ሰጣችሁ፤ ከአባቶችም ነው እንጂ ከሙሴ አይደለም፤ በሰንበትም ሰውን ትገርዛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴ ሕግ እንዳይሻር ሰው በሰንበት መገረዝን የሚቀበል ከሆነስ ሰውን ሁለንተናውን በሰንበት ጤናማ ስላደረግሁ ትቈጡኛላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ቅን ፍርድ ፍረዱ እንጂ በመልክ አትፍረዱ።

verses.text_english: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች አንዳንዶቹ እንዲህ አሉ። ሊገድሉት የሚፈልጉት ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በግልጥ ይናገራል አንዳችም አይሉትም። አለቆቹ ይህ ሰው በእውነት ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ በእውነት አወቁን?

verses.text_english: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አውቀናል፤ ክርስቶስ ሲመጣ ግን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ ማንም አያውቅም።

verses.text_english: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር። እኔንም ታውቁኛላችሁ ከወዴትም እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ እኔም በራሴ አልመጣሁም ነገር ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት የላከኝ እውነተኛ ነው፤

verses.text_english: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ከእርሱ ዘንድ ነኝ እርሱም ልኮኛልና አውቀዋለሁ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሊይዙት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ጊዜው ገና ስላልደረሰ ማንም እጁን አልጫነበትም።

verses.text_english: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this hath done?
verses.text_amharic: ከሕዝቡ ግን ብዙዎች አመኑበትና። ክርስቶስ በመጣ ጊዜ ይህ ካደረጋቸው ምልክቶች ይልቅ ያደርጋልን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም ሕዝቡ ሰለ እርሱ እንደዚህ ሲያንጐራጕሩ ሰሙ፤ የካህናት አለቆችም ፈሪሳውያም ሊይዙት ሎሌዎችን ላኩ።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and I go unto him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር እቆያለሁ ወደ ላከኝም እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find : and where I am, ye cannot come.
verses.text_amharic: ትፈልጉኛላችሁ አታገኙኝምም፤ እኔም ወዳለሁበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። እኛ እንዳናገኘው ይህ ወዴት ይሄድ ዘንድ አለው? በግሪክ ሰዎች መካከል ተበትነው ወደሚኖሩት ሊሄድና የግሪክን ሰዎች ሊያስተምር አለውን?

verses.text_english: What saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find : and where I am, ye cannot come?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ። ትፈልጉኛላችሁ አታገኙኝምም እኔም ወዳለሁበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም የሚለው ይህ ቃል ምንድር ነው? ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: In the last day, that great of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.text_amharic: ከበዓሉም በታላቁ በኋለኛው ቀን ኢየሱስ ቆሞ። ማንም የተጠማ ቢኖር ወደ እኔ ይምጣና ይጠጣ።

verses.text_english: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ የሚያምን መጽሐፍ እንዳለ፥ የሕይወት ውኃ ወንዝ ከሆዱ ይፈልቃል ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ግን በእርሱ የሚያምኑ ሊቀበሉት ስላላቸው ስለ መንፈስ ተናገረ፤ ኢየሱስ ገና ስላልከበረ መንፈስ ገና አልወረደም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከሕዝቡ አያሌ ሰዎች ይህን ቃል ሲሰሙ። ይህ በእውነት ነቢዩ ነው አሉ፤

verses.text_english: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎች። ይህ ክርስቶስ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች ግን። ክርስቶስ በእውኑ ከገሊላ ይመጣልን?

verses.text_english: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.text_amharic: ክርስቶስ ከዳዊት ዘር ዳዊትም ከነበረባት መንደር ከቤተ ልሔም እንዲመጣ መጽሐፍ አላለምን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከእርሱ የተነሣ በሕዝቡ መካከል መለያየት ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ሊይዙት ወደዱ ነገር ግን እጁን ማንም አልጫነበትም።

verses.text_english: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.text_amharic: ሎሌዎቹም ወደ ካህናት አለቆችና ወደ ፈሪሳውያን መጡ፤ እነዚያም። ያላመጣችሁት ስለ ምን ነው? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.text_amharic: ሎሌዎቹ። እንደዚህ ሰው ማንም እንዲሁ ከቶ አልተናገረም ብለው መለሱ።

verses.text_english: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ፈሪሳውያን። እናንተ ደግሞ ሳታችሁን?

verses.text_english: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.text_amharic: ከአለቆች ወይስ ከፈሪሳውያን በእርሱ ያመነ አለን?

verses.text_english: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሕግን የማያውቀው ይህ ሕዝብ ርጉም ነው ብለው መለሱላቸው።

verses.text_english: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ አንዱ በሌሊት ቀድሞ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ የነበረ ኒቆዲሞስ።

verses.text_english: Doth our law judge man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.text_amharic: ሕጋችን አስቀድሞ ከእርሱ ሳይሰማ ምንስ እንዳደረገ ሳያውቅ በሰው ይፈርዳልን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም መለሱና። አንተም ደግሞ ከገሊላ ነህን? ነቢይ ከገሊላ እንዳይነሣ መርምርና እይ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.text_amharic: ማለዳም ደግሞ ወደ መቅደስ ደረሰ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ። ተቀምጦም ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.text_amharic: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም በምንዝር የተያዘችን ሴት ወደ እርሱ አመጡ በመካከልም እርሱዋን አቁመው።

verses.text_english: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.text_amharic: መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህች ሴት ስታመነዝር ተገኝታ ተያዘች።

verses.text_english: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም እንደነዚህ ያሉት እንዲወገሩ በሕግ አዘዘን፤ አንተስ ስለ እርስዋ ምን ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with finger wrote on the ground, .
verses.text_amharic: የሚከሱበትንም እንዲያገኙ ሊፈትኑት ይህን አሉ። ኢየሱስ ግን ጐንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በምድር ላይ ጻፈ፤

verses.text_english: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.text_amharic: መላልሰው በጠየቁት ጊዜ ግን ቀና ብሎ። ከእናንተ ኃጢአት የሌለበት አስቀድሞ በድንጋይ ይውገራት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ጐንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በምድር ላይ ጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And they which heard , being convicted by conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ ሕሊናቸው ወቀሳቸውና ከሽማግሌዎች ጀምረው እስከ ኋለኞች አንድ አንድ እያሉ ወጡ፤ ኢየሱስም ብቻውን ቀረ ሴቲቱም በመካከል ቆማ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ቀና ብሎ ከሴቲቱ በቀር ማንንም ባላየ ጊዜ። አንቺ ሴት፥ እነዚያ ከሳሾችሽ ወዴት አሉ? የፈረደብሽ የለምን? አላት።

verses.text_english: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንድ ስንኳ አለች። ኢየሱስም። እኔም አልፈርድብሽም፤ ሂጂ ከአሁንም ጀምሮ ደግመሽ ኃጢአት አትሥሪ አላት።

verses.text_english: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ኢየሱስ። እኔ የዓለም ብርሃን ነኝ፤ የሚከተለኝ የሕይወት ብርሃን ይሆንለታል እንጂ በጨለማ አይመላለስም ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.text_english: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.text_amharic: ፈሪሳውያንም። አንተ ስለ ራስህ ትመሰክራለህ፤ ምስክርነትህ እውነት አይደለም አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። እኔ ስለ ራሴ ምንም እንኳ ብመሰክር ከወዴት እንደመጣሁ ወዴትም እንድሄድ አውቃለሁና ምስክርነቴ እውነት ነው፤ እናንተ ግን ከወዴት እንደ መጣሁ ወዴትም እንድሄድ አታውቁም።

verses.text_english: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሥጋዊ ፍርድን ትፈርዳላችሁ፤ እኔ በአንድ ሰው ስንኳ አልፈርድም።

verses.text_english: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: የላከኝ አብ ከእኔ ጋር ነው እንጂ ብቻዬን አይደለሁምና እኔ ብፈርድ ፍርዴ እውነት ነው።

verses.text_english: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.text_amharic: የሁለት ሰዎችም ምስክርነት እውነት እንደ ሆነ በሕጋችሁ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ራሴ የምመሰክር እኔ ነኝ፥ የላከኝም አብ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል።

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። አባትህ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። ኢየሱስ መልሶ። እኔንም ወይም አባቴንም አታውቁም፤ እኔንስ ብታውቁኝ አባቴን ደግሞ ባወቃችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.text_english: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር በግምጃ ቤት አጠገብ ይህን ነገር ተናገረ፤ ጊዜው ገና አልደረሰምና ማንም አልያዘውም።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ። እኔ እሄዳለሁ ትፈልጉኛላችሁም በኃጢአታችሁም ትሞታላችሁ እኔ ወደምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም። እኔ ወደ ምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም ማለቱ ራሱን ይገድላልን? እንጃ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ከታች ናችሁ፥ እኔ ከላይ ነኝ፤ እናንተ ከዚህ ዓለም ናችሁ፥ እኔ ከዚህ ዓለም አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am , ye shall die in your sins.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። በኃጢአታችሁ ትሞታላችሁ አልኋችሁ፤ እኔ እንደሆንሁ ባታምኑ በኃጢአታችሁ ትሞታላችሁና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። አንተ ማን ነህ? አሉት። ኢየሱስም። ከመጀመሪያ ለእናንተ የተናገርሁት ነኝ።

verses.text_english: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ የምናገረው የምፈርደውም ብዙ ነገር አለኝ፤ ዳሩ ግን የላከኝ እውነተኛ ነው እኔም ከእርሱ የሰማሁትን ይህን ለዓለም እናገራለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ አብ እንደ ነገራቸው አላስተዋሉም።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am , and I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ። የሰውን ልጅ ከፍ ከፍ ባደረጋችሁት ጊዜ እኔ እሆን ዘንድ አባቴም እንዳስተማረኝ እነዚህን እናገር ዘንድ እንጂ ከራሴ አንዳች እንዳላደርግ በዚያን ጊዜ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.text_amharic: የላከኝም ከእኔ ጋር ነው፤ እኔ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ዘወትር አደርጋለሁና አብ ብቻዬን አይተወኝም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሲናገር ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ያመኑትን አይሁድ። እናንተ በቃሌ ብትኖሩ በእውነት ደቀ መዛሙርቴ ናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትንም ታውቃላችሁ እውነትም አርነት ያወጣችኋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም መልሰው። የአብርሃም ዘር ነን ለአንድም ስንኳ ከቶ ባሪያዎች አልሆንም፤ አንተ። አርነት ትወጣላችሁ እንዴት ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ኃጢአት የሚያደርግ ሁሉ የኃጢአት ባርያ ነው።

verses.text_english: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: the Son abideth ever.
verses.text_amharic: ባርያም ለዘላለም በቤት አይኖርም፤ ልጁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ልጁ አርነት ቢያወጣችሁ በእውነት አርነት ትወጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.text_amharic: የአብርሃም ዘር መሆናችሁንስ አውቃለሁ ነገር ግን ቃሌ በእናንተ አይኖርምና ልትገድሉኝ ትፈልጋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በአባቴ ዘንድ ያየሁትን እናገራለሁ፤ እናንተም ደግሞ በአባታችሁ ዘንድ ያያችሁትን ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.text_english: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: መልሰውም። አባታችንስ አብርሃም ነው አሉት። ኢየሱስም። የአብሃም ልጆች ብትሆኑ የአብርሃምን ሥራ ባደረጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አሁን ከእግዚእብሔር የሰማሁትን እውነት የነገርኋችሁን ሰው ልትገድሉኝ ትፈልጋላችሁ፤ አብርሃም እንዲህ አላደረገም።

verses.text_english: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, God.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ የአባታችሁን ሥራ ታደርጋላችሁ አላቸው። እኛስ ከዝሙት አልተወለድንም አንድ አባት አለን እርሱም እግዚአብሔር ነው አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። እግዚአብሔርስ አባታችሁ ከሆነ በወደዳችሁኝ ነበር፤ እኔ ከእግዚአብሔር ወጥቼ መጥቻለሁና፤ እርሱ ላከኝ እንጂ ከራሴ አልመጣሁምና።

verses.text_english: Why do ye not understand my speech? because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.text_amharic: ንግግሬን የማታስተውሉ ስለ ምንድር ነው? ቃሌን ልትሰሙ ስለማትችሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: Ye are of father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ከአባታችሁ ከዲያብሎስ ናችሁ የአባታችሁንም ምኞት ልታደርጉ ትወዳላችሁ። እርሱ ከመጀመሪያ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነበረ፤ እውነትም በእርሱ ስለ ሌለ በእውነት አልቆመም። ሐሰትን ሲናገር ከራሱ ይናገራል፥ ሐሰተኛ የሐሰትም አባት ነውና።

verses.text_english: And because I tell the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እውነትን የምናገር ስለ ሆንሁ አታምኑኝም።

verses.text_english: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ስለ ኃጢአት የሚወቅሰኝ ማን ነው? እውነት የምናገር ከሆንሁ እናንተ ስለ ምን አታምኑኝም?

verses.text_english: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear not, because ye are not of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር የሆነ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይሰማል፤ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር አይደላችሁምና ስለዚህ አትሰሙም።

verses.text_english: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ መልሰው። ሳምራዊ እንደ ሆንህ ጋኔንም እንዳለብህ በማለታችን እኛ መልካም እንል የለምን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እኔስ ጋኔን የለብኝም ነገር ግን አባቴን አከብራለሁ እናንተም ታዋርዱኛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን የራሴን ክብር አልፈልግም፤ የሚፈልግ የሚፈርድም አለ።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚጠብቅ ቢኖር ለዘላለም ሞትን አያይም።

verses.text_english: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ። ጋኔን እንዳለብህ አሁን አወቅን። አብርሃም ስንኳ ሞተ ነቢያትም፤ አንተም። ቃሌን የሚጠብቅ ቢኖር ለዘላለም ሞትን አይቀምስም ትላለህ።

verses.text_english: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.text_amharic: በእውኑ አንተ ከሞተው ከአባታችን ከአብርሃም ትበልጣለህን? ነቢያትም ሞቱ፤ ራስህን ማንን ታደርጋለህ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰ አለም። እኔ ራሴን ባከብር ክብሬ ከንቱ ነው፤ የሚያከብረኝ እናንተ አምላካችን የምትሉት አባቴ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.text_amharic: አላወቃችሁትምም፥ እኔ ግን አውቀዋለሁ። አላውቀውም ብል እንደ እናንተ ሐሰተኛ በሆንሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን አውቀዋለሁ ቃሉንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw , and was glad.
verses.text_amharic: አባታችሁ አብርሃም ቀኔን ያይ ዘንድ ሐሤት አደረገ፥ አየም ደስም አለው።

verses.text_english: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም። ገና አምሳ ዓመት ያልሆነህ አብርሃምን አይተሃልን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብርሃም ሳይወለድ እኔ አለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሊወግሩት ድንጋይ አነሡ፤ ኢየሱስ ግን ተሰወራቸው ከመቅደስም ወጥቶ በመካከላቸው አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And as passed by, he saw a man which was blind from birth.
verses.text_amharic: ሲያልፍም ከመወለዱ ጀምሮ ዕውር የሆነውን ሰው አየ።

verses.text_english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህ ሰው ዕውር ሆኖ እንዲወለድ ኃጢአት የሠራ ማን ነው? እርሱ ወይስ ወላጆቹ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ በእርሱ እንዲገለጥ ነው እንጂ እርሱ ወይም ወላጆቹ ኃጢአት አልሠሩም።

verses.text_english: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.text_amharic: ቀን ሳለ የላከኝን ሥራ ላደርግ ይገባኛል፤ ማንም ሊሠራ የማይችልባት ሌሊት ትመጣለች።

verses.text_english: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለም ሳለሁ የዓለም ብርሃን ነኝ።

verses.text_english: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ብሎ ወደ መሬት እንትፍ አለ በምራቁም ጭቃ አድርጎ በጭቃው የዕውሩን ዓይኖች ቀባና።

verses.text_english: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.text_amharic: ሂድና በሰሊሆም መጠመቂያ ታጠብ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው የተላከ ነው። ስለዚህ ሄዶ ታጠበ እያየም መጣ።

verses.text_english: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.text_amharic: ጐረቤቶቹም ቀድሞም ሲለምን አይተውት የነበሩ። ይህ ተቀምጦ ይለምን የነበረ አይደለምን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: Some said, This is he: others , He is like him: he said, I am .
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎች። እርሱ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች። አይደለም እርሱን ይመስላል እንጂ አሉ፤ እርሱ። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.text_amharic: ታድያ። ዓይኖችህ እንዴት ተከፈቱ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ መልሶ። ኢየሱስ የሚባለው ሰው ጭቃ አድርጎ አይኖቼን ቀባና። ወደ ሰሊሆም መጠመቂያ ሄደህ ታጠብ አለኝ፤ ሄጄ ታጥቤም አየሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.text_amharic: ያ ሰው ወዴት ነው? አሉት። አላውቅም አለ።

verses.text_english: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.text_amharic: በፊት ዕውር የነበረውን ሰው ወደ ፈሪሳውያን ወሰዱት።

verses.text_english: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ጭቃ አድርጎ ዓይኖቹን የከፈተበት ቀን ሰንበት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን ደግሞ እንዴት እንዳየ እንደ ገና ጠየቁት። እርሱም። ጭቃ በዓይኖቼ አኖረ ታጠብሁም አያለሁም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያንም አንዳንዶቹ። ይህ ሰው ሰንበትን አያከብርምና ከእግዚአብሔር አይደለም አሉ። ሌሎች ግን። ኃጢአትኛ ሰው እንደነዚህ ያሉ ምልክቶች ሊያደርግ እንዴት ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.text_english: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም መለያየት ሆነ። ከዚህም የተነሣ ዕውሩን። አንተ ዓይኖችህን ስለ ከፈተ ስለ እርሱ ምን ትላለህ? ደግሞ አሉት። እርሱም። ነቢይ ነው አለ።

verses.text_english: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ የዚያን ያየውን ወላጆች እስኪጠሩ ድረስ ዕውር እንደ ነበረ እንዳየም ስለ እርሱ አላመኑም፥

verses.text_english: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱንም። እናንተ ዕውር ሆኖ ተወለደ የምትሉት ልጃችሁ ይህ ነውን? ታድያ አሁን እንዴት ያያል? ብለው ጠየቁአቸው።

verses.text_english: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.text_amharic: ወላጆቹም መልሰው። ይህ ልጃችን እንደ ሆነ ዕውርም ሆኖ እንደ ተወለደ አናውቃለን፤

verses.text_english: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን አሁን እንዴት እንዳየ አናውቅም፥ ወይም ዓይኖቹን ማን እንደ ከፈተ እኛ አናውቅም፤ ጠይቁት እርሱ ሙሉ ሰው ነው፤ እርሱ ስለ ራሱ ይናገራል አሉ።

verses.text_english: These spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.text_amharic: ወላጆቹ አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ይህን አሉ፤ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ነው ብሎ የሚመሰክር ቢኖር ከምኵራብ እንዲያወጡት አይሁድ ከዚህ በፊት ተስማምተው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወላጆቹ። ሙሉ ሰው ነው፥ ጠይቁት አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ዕውር የነበረውን ሰው ሁለተኛ ጠርተው። እግዚአብሔርን አክብር፤ ይህ ሰው ኃጢአተኛ መሆኑን እኛ እናውቃለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ኃጢአተኛ መሆኑን አላውቅም፤ ዕውር እንደ ነበርሁ አሁንም እንዳይ ይህን አንድ ነገር አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.text_amharic: ደግመውም። ምን አደረገልህ? እንዴትስ ዓይኖችህን ከፈተ? አሉት።

verses.text_english: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። አስቀድሜ ነገርኋችሁ አልሰማችሁምም፤ ስለ ምን ዳግመኛ ልትሰሙ ትወዳላችሁ? እናንተ ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ልትሆኑ ትወዳላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ተሳድበውም። አንተ የእርሱ ደቀ መዝሙር ነህ፥ እኛ ግን የሙሴ ደቀ መዛሙርት ነን፤

verses.text_english: We know that God spake unto Moses: this , we know not from whence he is.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንደ ተናገረው እኛ እናውቃለን፥ ይህ ሰው ግን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አናውቅም አሉት።

verses.text_english: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውዬው መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ እናንተ አለማወቃችሁ ይህ ድንቅ ነገር ነው፥ ዳሩ ግን ዓይኖቼን ከፈተ።

verses.text_english: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ፈቃዱንም የሚያደርግ ቢኖር ያንን እግዚአብሔር ይሰማዋል እንጂ ኃጢአተኞችን እንዳይሰማ እናውቃለን።

verses.text_english: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.text_amharic: ዕውር ሆኖ የተወለደውን ዓይኖች ማንም እንደ ከፈተ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ አልተሰማም፤

verses.text_english: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር ባይሆን ምንም ሊያደርግ ባልቻለም ነበር።

verses.text_english: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.text_amharic: መልሰው። አንተ ሁለንተናህ በኃጢአት ተወለድህ፥ አንተም እኛን ታስተምረናለህን? አሉት። ወደ ውጭም አወጡት።

verses.text_english: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ወደ ውጭ እንዳወጡት ሰማ ሲያገኘውም። አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ታምናለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በእርሱ አምን ዘንድ ማን ነው? አለ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። አይተኸዋልም ከአንተ ጋርም የሚናገረው እርሱ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አምናለሁ አለ፤ ሰገደለትም።

verses.text_english: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። የማያዩ እንዲያዩ የሚያዩም እንዲታወሩ እኔ ወደዚህ ዓለም ለፍርድ መጣሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያንም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ይህን ሰምተው። እኛ ደግሞ ዕውሮች ነንን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። ዕውሮችስ ብትሆኑ ኃጢአት ባልሆነባችሁም ነበር፤ አሁን ግን። እናያለን ትላላችሁ፤ ኃጢአታችሁ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ወደ በጎች በረት በበሩ የማይገባ በሌላ መንገድ ግን የሚወጣ እርሱ ሌባ ወንበዴም ነው፤

verses.text_english: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: በበሩ የሚገባ ግን የበጎች እረኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱ በረኛው ይከፍትለታል፤ በጎቹም ድምፁን ይሰሙታል፥ የራሱንም በጎች በየስማቸው ጠርቶ ይወስዳቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.text_amharic: የራሱንም ሁሉ ካወጣቸው በኋላ በፊታቸው ይሄዳል፥ በጎቹም ድምፁን ያውቃሉና ይከተሉታል፤

verses.text_english: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.text_amharic: ከሌላው ግን ይሸሻሉ እንጂ አይከተሉትም፥ የሌሎችን ድምፅ አያውቁምና።

verses.text_english: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ይህን ምሳሌ ነገራቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን የነገራቸው ምን እንደ ሆነ አላስተዋሉም።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እኔ የበጎች በር ነኝ።

verses.text_english: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ በፊት የመጡ ሁሉ ሌቦችና ወንበዴዎች ናቸው፤ ዳሩ ግን በጎቹ አልሰሙአቸውም።

verses.text_english: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.text_amharic: በሩ እኔ ነኝ፤ በእኔ የሚገባ ቢኖር ይድናል፥ ይገባልም ይወጣልም መሰማሪያም ያገኛል።

verses.text_english: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have more abundantly.
verses.text_amharic: ሌባው ሊሰርቅና ሊያርድ ሊያጠፋም እንጂ ስለ ሌላ አይመጣም፤ እኔ ሕይወት እንዲሆንላቸው እንዲበዛላቸውም መጣሁ።

verses.text_english: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም እረኛ እኔ ነኝ። መልካም እረኛ ነፍሱን ስለ በጎቹ ያኖራል።

verses.text_english: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: እረኛ ያልሆነው በጎቹም የእርሱ ያልሆኑ ሞያተኛ ግን ተኵላ ሲመጣ ባየ ጊዜ በጎቹን ትቶ ይሸሻል፤ ተኵላም ይነጥቃቸዋል በጎቹንም ይበትናቸዋል።

verses.text_english: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ሞያተኛ ስለ ሆነ ለበጎቹም ስለማይገደው ሞያተኛው ይሸሻል።

verses.text_english: I am the good shepherd, and know my , and am known of mine.
As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በረት ያልሆኑ ሌሎች በጎች አሉኝ፤ እነርሱን ደግሞ ላመጣ ይገባኛል ድምፄንም ይሰማሉ፥ አንድም መንጋ ይሆናሉ እረኛውም አንድ።

verses.text_english: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, one shepherd.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን ደግሞ አነሣት ዘንድ አኖራለሁና ስለዚህ አብ ይወደኛል።

verses.text_english: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በፈቃዴ አኖራታለሁ እንጂ ከእኔ ማንም አይወስዳትም። ላኖራት ሥልጣን አለኝ ደግሞም ላነሣት ሥልጣን አለኝ ይህችን ትእዛዝ ከአባቴ ተቀበልሁ።

verses.text_english: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከዚህ ቃል የተነሣ በአይሁድ መካከል እንደ ገና መለያየት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ብዙዎች። ጋኔን አለበት አብዶአልም፤ ስለ ምንስ ትሰሙታላችሁ? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችም። ይህ ጋኔን ያለበት ሰው ቃል አይደለም፤ ጋኔን የዕውሮችን ዓይኖች ሊከፍት ይችላልን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም የመቅደስ መታደስ በዓል ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.text_amharic: ክረምትም ነበረ። ኢየሱስም በመቅደስ በሰሎሞን ደጅ መመላለሻ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም እርሱን ከበው። እስከ መቼ ድረስ በጥርጣሪ ታቆየናለህ? አንተ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆንህ ገልጠህ ንገረን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰላቸው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ነገርኋችሁ አታምኑምም እኔ በአባቴ ስም የማደርገው ሥራ ይህ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል፤

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን እንደ ነገርኋችሁ ከበጎቼ ስላልሆናችሁ አታምኑም።

verses.text_english: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በጎቼ ድምፄን ይሰማሉ እኔም አውቃቸዋለሁ ይከተሉኝማል፤

verses.text_english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም የዘላለም ሕይወትን እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም አይጠፉም፥ ከእጄም ማንም አይነጥቃቸውም።

verses.text_english: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any pluck them out of my hand.
verses.text_amharic: የሰጠኝ አባቴ ከሁሉ ይበልጣል፥ ከአባቴም እጅ ሊነጥቃቸው ማንም አይችልም።

verses.text_english: My Father, which gave me, is greater than all; and no is able to pluck out of my Father's hand.
verses.text_amharic: እኔና አብ አንድ ነን።

verses.text_english: I and Father are one.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ሊወግሩት ደግመው ድንጋይ አነሡ።

verses.text_english: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ። ከአባቴ ብዙ መልካም ሥራ አሳየኋችሁ፤ ከእነርሱ ስለ ማናቸው ሥራ ትወግሩኛላችሁ? ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም። ስለ መልካም ሥራ አንወግርህም፤ ስለ ስድብ፤ አንተም ሰው ስትሆን ራስህን አምላክ ስለ ማድረግህ ነው እንጂ ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው። እኔ። አማልክት ናችሁ አልሁ ተብሎ በሕጋችሁ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፉ ሊሻር አይቻልምና እነዚያን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የመጣላቸውን አማልክት ካላቸው፥

verses.text_english: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነኝ ስላልሁ እናንተ አብ የቀደሰውን ወደ ዓለምም የላከውን። ትሳደባለህ ትሉታላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የአባቴን ሥራ ባላደርግ አትመኑኝ፤

verses.text_english: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.text_amharic: ባደርገው ግን፥ እኔን ስንኳ ባታምኑ አብ በእኔ እንደ ሆነ እኔም በአብ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቁና ታስተውሉ ዘንድ ሥራውን እመኑ።

verses.text_english: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father in me, and I in him.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ደግመው ሊይዙት ፈለጉ፤ ከእጃቸውም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም በመጀመሪያ ያጠምቅበት ወደ ነበረው ስፍራ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ እንደ ገና ሄደ በዚያም ኖረ።

verses.text_english: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው። ዮሐንስ አንድ ምልክት ስንኳ አላደረገም፥ ነገር ግን ዮሐንስ ስለዚህ ሰው የተናገረው ሁሉ እውነት ነበረ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.text_english: Now a certain was sick, Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.text_amharic: ከማርያምና ከእኅትዋ ከማርታ መንደር ከቢታንያ የሆነ አልዓዛር የሚባል አንድ ሰው ታሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: (It was Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም ጌታን ሽቱ የቀባችው እግሩንም በጠጕርዋ ያበሰችው ነበረች፤ ወንድምዋም አልዓዛር ታሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እኅቶቹ ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆ የምትወደው ታሞአል ብለው ወደ እርሱ ላኩ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus heard , he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ይህ ህመም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ በእርሱ ይከብር ዘንድ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ክብር ነው እንጂ ለሞት አይደለም አለ።

verses.text_english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ማርታንና እኅትዋን አልዓዛርንም ይወድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ታመመም በሰማ ጊዜ ያን ጊዜ በነበረበት ስፍራ ሁለት ቀን ዋለ፤

verses.text_english: Then after that saith he to disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ወደ ይሁዳ ደግሞ እንሂድ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አይሁድ ከጥቂት ጊዜ በፊት ሊወግሩህ ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ ደግሞም ወደዚያ ትሄዳለህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ቀኑ አሥራ ሁለት ሰዓት አይደለምን? በቀን የሚመላለስ ቢኖር የዚህን ዓለም ብርሃን ያያልና አይሰናከልም፤

verses.text_english: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊት የሚመላለስ ቢኖር ግን ብርሃን በእርሱ ስለ ሌለ ይሰናከላል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ተናገረ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ። ወዳጃችን አልዓዛር ተኝቶአል፤ ነገር ግን ከእንቅልፉ ላስነሣው እሄዳለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተኝቶስ እንደ ሆነ ይድናል አሉት።

verses.text_english: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስስ ስለ ሞቱ ተናግሮ ነበር፤ እነርሱ ግን ስለ እንቅልፍ መተኛት እንደ ተናገረ መሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በግልጥ። አልዓዛር ሞተ፤

verses.text_english: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እንድታምኑም በዚያ ባለመኖሬ ስለ እናንተ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ነገር ግን ወደ እርሱ እንሂድ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ዲዲሞስ የሚሉት ቶማስ ለባልንጀሮቹ ለደቀ መዛሙርት። ከእርሱ ጋር እንሞት ዘንድ እኛ ደግሞ እንሂድ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had in the grave four days already.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በመጣ ጊዜ በመቃብር እስከ አሁን አራት ቀን ሆኖት አገኘው።

verses.text_english: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.text_amharic: ቢታንያም አሥራ አምስት ምዕራፍ ያህል ለኢየሩሳሌም ቅርብ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.text_amharic: ከአይሁድም ብዙዎች ስለ ወንድማቸው ሊያጽናኑአቸው ወደ ማርታና ወደ ማርያም መጥተው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat in the house.
verses.text_amharic: ማርታም ኢየሱስ እንደ መጣ በሰማች ጊዜ ልትቀበለው ወጣች፤ ማርያም ግን በቤት ተቀምጣ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.text_amharic: ማርታም ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ በዚህ ኖረህ ብትሆን ወንድሜ ባልሞተም ነበር፤

verses.text_english: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give thee.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከእግዚአብሔር የምትለምነውን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰጥህ አውቃለሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ወንድምሽ ይነሣል አላት።

verses.text_english: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.text_amharic: ማርታም። በመጨረሻው ቀን በትንሣኤ እንዲነሣ አውቃለሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ትንሣኤና ሕይወት እኔ ነኝ፤ የሚያምንብኝ ቢሞት እንኳ ሕያው ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.text_amharic: ሕያው የሆነም የሚያምንብኝም ሁሉ ለዘላለም አይሞትም፤ ይህን ታምኚያለሽን? አላት።

verses.text_english: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፤ አንተ ወደ ዓለም የሚመጣው ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆንህ እኔ አምናለሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብላ ሄደች እኅትዋንም ማርያምን በስውር ጠርታ። መምህሩ መጥቶአል ይጠራሽማል አለቻት።

verses.text_english: As soon as she heard , she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም በሰማች ጊዜ ፈጥና ተነሣች ወደ እርሱም መጣች፤

verses.text_english: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ማርታ በተቀበለችበት ስፍራ ነበረ እንጂ ገና ወደ መንደሩ አልገባም ነበር።

verses.text_english: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.text_amharic: ሲያጽናኑአት ከእርስዋ ጋር በቤት የነበሩ አይሁድም ማርያም ፈጥና እንደ ተነሣችና እንደ ወጣች ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ወደ መቃብር ሄዳ በዚያ ልታለቅስ መስሎአቸው ተከተሉአት።

verses.text_english: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም ኢየሱስ ወዳለበት መጥታ ባየችው ጊዜ በእግሩ ላይ ወድቃ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ በዚህ ኖረህ ብትሆን ወንድሜ ባልሞተም ነበር አለችው።

verses.text_english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እርስዋ ስታለቅስ ከእርስዋም ጋር የመጡት አይሁድ ሲያለቅሱ አይቶ በመንፈሱ አዘነ በራሱም ታወከ፤

verses.text_english: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.text_amharic: ወዴት አኖራችሁት? አለም። እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መጥተህ እይ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus wept.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንባውን አፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አይሁድ። እንዴት ይወደው እንደ ነበረ እዩ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ ግን አንዳንዶቹ። ይህ የዕውሩን ዓይኖች የከፈተ ይህን ደግሞ እንዳይሞት ያደርግ ዘንድ ባልቻለም ነበርን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በራሱ አዝኖ ወደ መቃብሩ መጣ፤ እርሱም ዋሻ ነበረ፤ ድንጋይም ተገጥሞበት ነበር።

verses.text_english: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been four days.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ። ድንጋዩን አንሡ አለ። የሞተውም እኅት ማርታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ከሞተ አራት ቀን ሆኖታልና አሁን ይሸታል አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ። ብታምኚስ የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር እንድታዪ አልነገርሁሽምን? አላት።

verses.text_english: Then they took away the stone where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋዩንም አነሡት። ኢየሱስም ዓይኖቹን ወደ ላይ አንሥቶ። አባት ሆይ፥ ስለ ሰማኸኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said , that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜም እንድትሰማኝ አወቅሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንተ እንደ ላክኸኝ ያምኑ ዘንድ በዚህ ዙሪያ ስለ ቆሙት ሕዝብ ተናገርሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ። አልዓዛር ሆይ፥ ወደ ውጭ ና ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.text_amharic: የሞተውም እጆቹና እግሮቹ በመግነዝ እንደ ተገነዙ ወጣ፤ ፈቱም በጨርቅ እንደ ተጠመጠመ ነበር። ኢየሱስም። ፍቱትና ይሂድ ተዉት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወደ ማርያም ከመጡት፥ ኢየሱስም ያደረገውን ካዩት ከአይሁድ ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ፤

verses.text_english: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ወደ ፈሪሳውያን ሄደው ኢየሱስ ያደረገውን ነገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን ሸንጎ ሰብስበው። ምን እናድርግ? ይህ ሰው ብዙ ምልክቶች ያደርጋልና።

verses.text_english: If we let him thus alone, all will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ብንተወው ሁሉ በእርሱ ያምናሉ፤ የሮሜም ሰዎች መጥተው አገራችንን ወገናችንንም ይወስዳሉ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And one of them, Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያችም ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት የነበረ ቀያፋ የሚሉት ከእነርሱ አንዱ። እናንተ ምንም አታውቁም፤

verses.text_english: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከሚጠፋ አንድ ሰው ስለ ሕዝቡ ይሞት ዘንድ እንዲሻለን አታስቡም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም የተናገረ ከራሱ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን በዚያች ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት ነበረና ኢየሱስ ስለ ሕዝቡ ሊሞት እንዳለው ትንቢት ተናገረ፤

verses.text_english: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን የተበተኑትን የእግዚአብሔርን ልጆች ደግሞ በአንድነት እንዲሰበስባቸው ነው እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከዚያ ቀን ጀምረው ሊገድሉት ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወዲያም ኢየሱስ በአይሁድ መካከል ተገልጦ አልተመላለሰም፤ ነገር ግን ከዚያ በምድረ በዳ አጠገብ ወዳለች ምድር፥ ኤፍሬም ወደምትባል ከተማ ሄደ፤ በዚያም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.text_amharic: የአይሁድም ፋሲካ ቀርቦ ነበር። ብዙ ሰዎችም ራሳቸውን ያነጹ ዘንድ ከፋሲካ በፊት ከአገሩ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ።

verses.text_english: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም ይፈልጉት ነበር፤ በመቅደስም ቆመው እርስ በርሳቸው። ምን ይመስላችኋል? ወደ በዓሉ አይመጣም ይሆንን? ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew , that they might take him.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም ፈሪሳውያንም ይይዙት ዘንድ እርሱ ያለበትን ስፍራ የሚያውቀው ሰው ቢኖር እንዲያመለክታቸው አዘው ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ከፋሲካም በፊት በስድስተኛው ቀን ኢየሱስ ከሙታን ያስነሣው አልዓዛር ወደ ነበረበት ወደ ቢታንያ መጣ።

verses.text_english: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም እራት አደረጉለት፤ ማርታም ታገለግል ነበር፤ አልዓዛር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ከተቀመጡት አንዱ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.text_amharic: ማርያምም ዋጋው እጅግ የከበረ የጥሩ ናርዶስ ሽቱ ንጥር ወስዳ የኢየሱስን እግር ቀባች፤ በጠጕርዋም እግሩን አበሰች፤ ቤቱም ከናርዶስ ሽቱ ሞላ።

verses.text_english: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's , which should betray him,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ አሳልፎ ሊሰጠው ያለው የስምዖን ልጅ የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ።

verses.text_english: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሽቱ ለሦስት መቶ ዲናር ተሽጦ ለድሆች ያልተሰጠ ስለ ምን ነው? አለ።

verses.text_english: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም የተናገረ ሌባ ስለ ነበረ ነው እንጂ ለድሆች ተገድዶላቸው አይደለም፤ ከረጢትም ይዞ በውስጡ ከሚገባው ይወስድ ስለ ነበረ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ለምቀበርበት ቀን እንድትጠብቀው ተውአት፤

verses.text_english: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.text_amharic: ድሆችስ ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ይኖራሉና፥ እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር አልኖርም አለ።

verses.text_english: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ከአይሁድም ብዙ ሕዝብ በዚያ እንደ ነበረ አውቀው መጡ፥ ከሙታንም ያስነሣውን አልዓዛርን ደግሞ እንዲያዩ ነበረ እንጂ ስለ ኢየሱስ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.text_amharic: የካህናት አለቆችም አልዓዛርን ደግሞ ሊገድሉት ተማከሩ፥

verses.text_english: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ከአይሁድ ብዙዎች ከእርሱ የተነሣ ሄደው በኢየሱስ ያምኑ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱ ወደ በዓሉ መጥተው የነበሩ ብዙ ሕዝብ ኢየሱስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲመጣ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: የዘንባባ ዛፍ ዝንጣፊ ይዘው ሊቀበሉት ወጡና። ሆሣዕና፤ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን ነገር በመጀመሪያ አላስተዋሉም፤ ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ ከከበረ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ ይህ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይህንም እንዳደረጉለት ትዝ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and they had done these things unto him.
verses.text_amharic: አልዓዛርንም ከመቃብር ጠርቶ ከሙታን ሲያስነሣው ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ይመሰክሩለት ነበር።

verses.text_english: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ሕዝቡ ይህን ምልክት እንዳደረገ ስለ ሰሙ ሊቀበሉት ወጡ።

verses.text_english: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.text_amharic: ሰለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን እርስ በርሳቸው። አንድ ስንኳ ልታደርጉ እንዳይቻላችሁ ታያላችሁን? እነሆ፥ ዓለሙ በኋላው ተከትሎት ሄዶአል ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.text_amharic: በበዓሉም ሊሰግዱ ከወጡት አንዳንዶቹ የግሪክ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከገሊላ ቤተ ሳይዳ ወደሚሆን ወደ ፊልጶስ መጥተው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ኢየሱስን ልናይ እንወዳለን ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ፊልጶስም መጥቶ ለእንድርያስ ነገረው፤ እንድርያስና ፊልጶስ መጥተው ለኢየሱስ ነገሩት።

verses.text_english: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰላቸው፥ እንዲህ ሲል። የሰው ልጅ ይከብር ዘንድ ሰዓቱ ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የስንዴ ቅንጣት በምድር ወድቃ ካልሞተች ብቻዋን ትቀራለች፤ ብትሞት ግን ብዙ ፍሬ ታፈራለች።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን የሚወድ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም በዚህ ዓለም የሚጠላ ለዘላለም ሕይወት ይጠብቃታል።

verses.text_english: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያገለግለኝ ቢኖር ይከተለኝ፥ እኔም ባለሁበት አገልጋዬ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናል፤ የሚያገለግለኝም ቢኖር አብ ያከብረዋል።

verses.text_english: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will Father honour.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ነፍሴ ታውካለች ምንስ እላለሁ? አባት ሆይ፥ ከዚህ ሰዓት አድነኝ። ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ወደዚህ ሰዓት መጣሁ።

verses.text_english: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.text_amharic: አባት ሆይ፥ ስምህን አክብረው። ስለዚህም። አከበርሁት ደግሞም አከብረዋለሁ የሚል ድምፅ ከሰማይ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, , I have both glorified , and will glorify again.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ቆመው የነበሩትም ሕዝብ በሰሙ ጊዜ። ነጐድጓድ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች። መልአክ ተናገረው አሉ።

verses.text_english: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard , said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ይህ ድምፅ ስለ እናንተ መጥቶአል እጂ ስለ እኔ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን የዚህ ዓለም ፍርድ ደርሶአል፤ አሁን የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ወደ ውጭ ይጣላል፤

verses.text_english: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ከምድር ከፍ ከፍ ያልሁ እንደ ሆነ ሁሉን ወደ እኔ እስባለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all unto me.
verses.text_amharic: በምን ዓይነትም ሞት ይሞት ዘንድ እንዳለው ሲያመለክታቸው ይህን ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሕዝቡ። እኛስ ክርስቶስ ለዘላለም እንዲኖር ከሕጉ ሰምተናል፤ አንተስ የሰው ልጅ ከፍ ከፍ ይል ዘንድ እንዲያስፈልገው እንዴት ትላላህ? ይህ የሰው ልጅ ማን ነው? ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ብርሃን ከእናንተ ጋር ነው። ጨለማ እንዳይደርስባችሁ ብርሃን ሳለላችሁ ተመላለሱ፤ በጨለማም የሚመላለስ ወዴት እንዲሄድ አያውቅም።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.text_amharic: የብርሃን ልጆች እንድትሆኑ ብርሃን ሳለላችሁ በብርሃኑ እመኑ አላቸው። ኢየሱስም ይህን ተናግሮ ሄደና ተሰወረባቸው።

verses.text_english: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.text_amharic: ክብሩን ስለ አየ ኢሳይያስ ይህን አለ፥ ስለ እርሱም ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ጋር ከአለቆች ደግሞ ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከምኵራብ እንዳያስወጡአቸው በፈሪሳውያን ምክንያት አልመሰከሩለትም፤

verses.text_english: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with eyes, nor understand with heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ክብር ይልቅ የሰውን ክብር ወደዋልና።

verses.text_english: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ጮኸ፥ እንዲህም አለ። በእኔ የሚያምን በላከኝ ማመኑ ነው እንጂ በእኔ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess , lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.text_amharic: እኔንም የሚያይ የላከኝን ያያል።

verses.text_english: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ የሚያምን ሁሉ በጨለማ እንዳይኖር እኔ ብርሃን ሆኜ ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ።

verses.text_english: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለምን ላድን እንጂ በዓለም ልፈርድ አልመጣሁምና ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማይጠብቀው ቢኖር የምፈርድበት እኔ አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጥለኝ ቃሌንም የማይቀበለው እርሱ የሚፈርድበት አለው፤ እኔ የተናገርሁት ቃል እርሱ በመጨረሻው ቀን ይፈርድበታል።

verses.text_english: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከራሴ አልተናገርሁምና፤ ነገር ግን የላከኝ አብ እርሱ የምለውን የምናገረውንም ትእዛዝ ሰጠኝ።

verses.text_english: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዙም የዘላለም ሕይወት እንደ ሆነች አውቃለሁ። ስለዚህ እኔ የምናገረውን አብ እንደ ነገረኝ እንዲሁ እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ከፋሲካ በዓል በፊት፥ ከዚህ ዓለም ወደ አብ የሚሄድበት ሰዓት እንደ ደረሰ አውቆ፥ በዚህ ዓለም ያሉትን ወገኖቹን የወደዳቸውን እስከ መጨረሻ ወደዳቸው።

verses.text_english: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's , to betray him;
verses.text_amharic: እራትም ሲበሉ ዲያብሎስ በስምዖን ልጅ በአስቆሮቱ በይሁዳ ልብ አሳልፎ እንዲሰጠው አሳብ ካገባ በኋላ፥

verses.text_english: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ አብ ሁሉን በልጁ እንደ ሰጠው ከእግዚአብሔርም እንደ ወጣ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲሄድ አውቆ፥

verses.text_english: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.text_amharic: ከእራት ተነሣ ልብሱንም አኖረ፥ ማበሻም ጨርቅ ወስዶ ታጠቀ፤

verses.text_english: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላም በመታጠቢያው ውኃ ጨመረ፥ የደቀ መዛሙርቱንም እግር ሊያጥብና በታጠቀበትም ማበሻ ጨርቅ ሊያብስ ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም መጣ፤ እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ የእኔን እግር ታጥባለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ የማደርገውን አንተ አሁን አታውቅም፥ በኋላ ግን ታስተውለዋለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። የእኔን እግር ለዘላለም አታጥብም አለው። ኢየሱስም። ካላጠብሁህ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ዕድል የለህም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also hands and head.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እጄንና ራሴን ደግሞ እንጂ እግሬን ብቻ አይደለም አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። የታጠበ እግሩን ከመታጠብ በቀር ሌላ አያስፈልገውም፥ ሁለንተናው ግን ንጹሕ ነው፤ እናንተም ንጹሐን ናችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ሁላችሁ አይደላችሁም አለው።

verses.text_english: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.text_amharic: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውን ያውቅ ነበርና፤ ስለዚህ። ሁላችሁ ንጹሐን አይደላችሁም አለው።

verses.text_english: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.text_amharic: እግራቸውንም አጥቦ ልብሱንም አንሥቶ ዳግመኛ ተቀመጠ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። ያደረግሁላችሁን ታስተውላላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for I am.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ መምህርና ጌታ ትሉኛላችሁ፤ እንዲሁ ነኝና መልካም ትላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: If I then, Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እኔ ጌታና መምህር ስሆን እግራችሁን ካጠብሁ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ እርስ በርሳችሁ እግራችሁን ትተጣጠቡ ዘንድ ይገባችኋል።

verses.text_english: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ለእናንተ እንዳደረግሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ምሳሌ ሰጥቻችኋለሁና።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ባሪያ ከጌታው አይበልጥም። መልእክተኛም ከላከው አይበልጥም።

verses.text_english: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ብታውቁ፥ ብታደርጉትም ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሁላችሁ አልናገርም፤ እኔ የመረጥኋቸውን አውቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን መጽሐፍ። እንጀራዬን የሚበላ በእኔ ላይ ተረከዙን አነሣብኝ ያለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am .
verses.text_amharic: በሆነ ጊዜ እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ታምኑ ዘንድ፥ ከአሁን ጀምሬ አስቀድሞ ሳይሆን እነግራችኋለሁ።
