verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ማናቸውን የምልከውን የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፥ እኔንም የሚቀበል የላከኝን ይቀበላል።

verses.text_english: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ይህን ብሎ በመንፈሱ ታወከ መስክሮም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ አንዱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠኛል አለ።

verses.text_english: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለ ማን እንደ ተናገረ አመንትተው እርስ በርሳቸው ተያዩ።

verses.text_english: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይወደው የነበረ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ በኢየሱስ ደረት ላይ ተጠጋ፤

verses.text_english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ እርሱን ጠቅሶ። ስለማን እንደ ተናገረ ንገረን አለው።

verses.text_english: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በኢየሱስ ደረት እንዲህ ተጠግቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ማን ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped . And when he had dipped the sop, he gave to Judas Iscariot, of Simon.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔ ቍራሽ አጥቅሼ የምሰጠው እርሱ ነው ብሎ መለሰለት። ቍራሽም አጥቅሶ ለአስቆሮቱ ለስምዖን ልጅ ለይሁዳ ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.text_amharic: ቍራሽም ከተቀበለ በኋላ ያን ጊዜ ሰይጣን ገባበት። እንግዲህ ኢየሱስ። የምታደርገውን ቶሎ ብለህ አድርግ አለው።

verses.text_english: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከተቀመጡት ስለ ምን ይህን እንዳለው ማንም አላወቀም፤

verses.text_english: For some thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳ ከረጢቱን የያዘ ስለ ሆነ፥ ኢየሱስ። ለበዓሉ የሚያስፈልገንን ግዛ፥ ወይም ለድሆች ምጽዋት እንዲሰጥ ያለው ለአንዳንዱ መስሎአቸው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ቍራሹን ከተቀበለ በኋላ ወዲያው ወጣ፤ ሌሊትም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.text_amharic: ከወጣም በኋላ ኢየሱስ እንዲ አለ። አሁን የሰው ልጅ ከበረ እግዚአብሔርም ሰለ እርሱ ከበረ፤

verses.text_english: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እርሱ የከበረ ከሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር ደግሞ እርሱን ራሱን ያከብረዋል ወዲያውም ያከብረዋል።

verses.text_english: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ፤ ትፈልጉኛላችሁ፤ ለአይሁድም። እኔ ወደምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አይቻላችሁም እንዳልኋቸው፥ አሁን ለእናንተ ደግሞ እላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዋደዱ ዘንድ፥ እንደ ወደድኋችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዋደዱ ዘንድ አዲስ ትእዛዝ እሰጣችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: By this shall all know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁ ፍቅር ቢኖራችሁ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቴ እንደ ሆናችሁ ሰዎች ሁሉ በዚህ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? አለው። ኢየሱስም። ወደምሄድበት አሁን ልትከተለኝ አትችልም፥ ነገር ግን በኋላ ትከተለኛለህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሁን ልከተልህ አለመቻሌ ስለ ምንድር ነው? ነፍሴን ስንኳ ስለ አንተ እሰጣለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። ነፍስህን ስለ እኔ ትሰጣለህን? እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሦስት ጊዜ እስክትክደኝ ድረስ ዶሮ አይጮኽም።

verses.text_english: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.text_amharic: ልባችሁ አይታወክ፤ በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ፥ በእኔም ደግሞ እመኑ።

verses.text_english: In my Father's house are many mansions: if not , I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.text_amharic: በአባቴ ቤት ብዙ መኖሪያ አለ፤ እንዲህስ ባይሆን ባልኋችሁ ነበር፤ ስፍራ አዘጋጅላችሁ ዘንድ እሄዳለሁና፤

verses.text_english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, ye may be also.
verses.text_amharic: ሄጄም ስፍራ ባዘጋጅላችሁ፥ እኔ ባለሁበት እናንተ ደግሞ እንድትሆኑ ሁለተኛ እመጣለሁ ወደ እኔም እወስዳችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
verses.text_amharic: ወደምሄድበትም ታውቃላችሁ፥ መንገዱንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
verses.text_amharic: ቶማስም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደምትሄድበት አናውቅም፤ እንዴትስ መንገዱን እናውቃለን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እኔ መንገድና እውነት ሕይወትም ነኝ፤ በእኔ በቀር ወደ አብ የሚመጣ የለም።

verses.text_english: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔንስ ብታውቁኝ አባቴን ደግሞ ባወቃችሁ ነበር። ከአሁንም ጀምራችሁ ታውቁታላችሁ አይታችሁትማል አለው።

verses.text_english: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.text_amharic: ፊልጶስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አብን አሳየንና ይበቃናል አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou , Shew us the Father?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም አለው። አንተ ፊልጶስ፥ ይህን ያህል ዘመን ከእናንተ ጋር ስኖር አታውቀኝምን? እኔን ያየ አብን አይቶአል፤ እንዴትስ አንተ። አብን አሳየን ትላለህ?

verses.text_english: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በአብ እንዳለሁ አብም በእኔ እንዳለ አታምንምን? እኔ የምነግራችሁን ቃል ከራሴ አልናገረውም፤ ነገር ግን በእኔ የሚኖረው አብ እርሱ ሥራውን ይሠራል።

verses.text_english: Believe me that I in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በአብ እንዳለሁ አብም በእኔ እንዳለ እመኑኝ፤ ባይሆንስ ስለ ራሱ ስለ ሥራው እመኑኝ።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእኔ የሚያምን እኔ የማደርገውን ሥራ እርሱ ደግሞ ያደርጋል፤ ከዚህም የሚበልጥ ያደርጋል፥

verses.text_english: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ወደ አብ እሄዳለሁና፤ አብም ስለ ወልድ እንዲከበር በስሜ የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do .
verses.text_amharic: ማናቸውንም ነገር በስሜ ብትለምኑ እኔ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ዓለም የማያየውና የማያውቀው ስለ ሆነ ሊቀበለው የማይቻለው የእውነት መንፈስ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚኖር በውሥጣችሁም ስለሚሆን እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
verses.text_amharic: ወላጆች እንደ ሌላቸው ልጆች አልተዋችሁም፤ ወደ እናንተ እመጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.text_amharic: ገና ጥቂት ዘመን አለ ከዚህም በኋላ ዓለም አያየኝም፤ እናንተ ግን ታዩኛላችሁ፤ እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እናንተ ደግሞ ሕያዋን ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ በአባቴ እንዳለሁ እናንተም በእኔ እንዳላችሁ እኔም በእናንተ እንዳለሁ በዚያን ቀን ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: At that day ye shall know that I in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
verses.text_amharic: ትእዛዜ በእርሱ ዘንድ ያለችው የሚጠብቃትም የሚወደኝ እርሱ ነው፤ የሚወደኝንም አባቴ ይወደዋል እኔም እወደዋለሁ ራሴንም እገልጥለታለሁ።

verses.text_english: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.text_amharic: የአስቆሮቱ ያይደለ ይሁዳ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ለዓለም ሳይሆን ራስህን ለእኛ ልትገልጥ ያለህ እንዴት ነው? አለው።

verses.text_english: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መለሰ አለውም። የሚወደኝ ቢኖር ቃሌን ይጠብቃል፤ አባቴም ይወደዋል ወደ እርሱም እንመጣለን በእርሱም ዘንድ መኖሪያ እናደርጋለን።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.text_amharic: የማይወደኝ ቃሌን አይጠብቅም፤ የምትሰሙትም ቃል የላከኝ የአብ ነው እንጂ የእኔ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስኖር ይህን ነግሬአችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: These things have I spoken unto you, being present with you.
verses.text_amharic: አብ በስሜ የሚልከው ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስ የሆነው አጽናኝ እርሱ ሁሉን ያስተምራችኋል እኔም የነገርኋችሁን ሁሉ ያሳስባችኋል።

verses.text_english: But the Comforter, the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ሰላምን እተውላችኋለሁ፥ ሰላሜን እሰጣችኋለሁ፤ እኔ የምሰጣችሁ ዓለም እንደሚሰጥ አይደለም። ልባችሁ አይታወክ አይፍራም።

verses.text_english: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እሄዳለሁ ወደ እናንተም እመጣለሁ እንዳልኋችሁ ሰማችሁ። የምትወዱኝስ ብትሆኑ ከእኔ አብ ይበልጣልና ወደ አብ በመሄዴ ደስ ባላችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.text_amharic: ከሆነም በኋላ ታምኑ ዘንድ አሁን አስቀድሞ ሳይሆን። ነግሬአችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከእናንተ ጋር ብዙ አልናገርም፥ የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ይመጣልና፤ በእኔ ላይም አንዳች የለውም፤

verses.text_english: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አብን እንድወድ ዓለም ሊያውቅ፥ አብም እንዳዘዘኝ፥ እንዲሁ አደርጋለሁ። ተነሡ፤ ከዚህ እንሂድ።

verses.text_english: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.text_amharic: እውነተኛ የወይን ግንድ እኔ ነኝ፤ ገበሬውም አባቴ ነው።

verses.text_english: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬ የማያፈራውን በእኔ ያለውን ቅርንጫፍ ሁሉ ያስወግደዋል፤ ፍሬ የሚያፈራውንም ሁሉ አብዝቶ እንዲያፈራ ያጠራዋል።

verses.text_english: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ስለ ነገርኋችሁ ቃል አሁን ንጹሐን ናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ኑሩ እኔም በእናንተ። ቅርንጫፍ በወይኑ ግንድ ባይኖር ከራሱ ፍሬ ሊያፈራ እንዳይቻለው፥ እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ በእኔ ባትኖሩ አትችሉም።

verses.text_english: I am the vine, ye the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የወይን ግንድ ነኝ እናንተም ቅርንጫፎች ናችሁ። ያለ እኔ ምንም ልታደርጉ አትችሉምና በእኔ የሚኖር እኔም በእርሱ፥ እርሱ ብዙ ፍሬ ያፈራል።

verses.text_english: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ የማይኖር ቢሆን እንደ ቅርንጫፍ ወደ ውጭ ይጣላል ይደርቅማል፤ እነርሱንም ሰብስበው ወደ እሳት ይጥሉአቸዋል፥ ያቃጥሉአቸውማል።

verses.text_english: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ብትኖሩ ቃሎቼም በእናንተ ቢኖሩ የምትወዱትን ሁሉ ለምኑ ይሆንላችሁማል።

verses.text_english: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ፍሬ ብታፈሩና ደቀ መዛሙርቴ ብትሆኑ በዚህ አባቴ ይከበራል።

verses.text_english: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.text_amharic: አብ እንደ ወደደኝ እኔ ደግሞ ወደድኋችሁ፤ በፍቅሬ ኑሩ።

verses.text_english: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የአባቴን ትእዛዝ እንደ ጠበቅሁ በፍቅሩም እንደምኖር፥ ትእዛዜን ብትጠብቁ በፍቅሬ ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and your joy might be full.
verses.text_amharic: ደስታዬም በእናንተ እንዲሆን ደስታችሁም እንዲፈጸም ይህን ነግሬአችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እንደ ወደድኋችሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዋደዱ ዘንድ ትእዛዜ ይህች ናት።

verses.text_english: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሱን ስለ ወዳጆቹ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ፍቅር ለማንም የለውም።

verses.text_english: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ያዘዝኋችሁን ሁሉ ብታደርጉ እናንተ ወዳጆቼ ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ባሮች አልላችሁም፤ ባርያ ጌታው የሚያደርገውን አያውቅምና፤ ወዳጆች ግን ብያችኋለሁ፥ ከአባቴ የሰማሁትን ሁሉ ለእናንተ አስታውቄአችኋለሁና።

verses.text_english: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ መረጥኋችሁ እንጂ እናንተ አልመረጣችሁኝም፤ አብም በስሜ የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ እንዲሰጣችሁ፥ ልትሄዱና ፍሬ ልታፈሩ ፍሬአችሁም ሊኖር ሾምኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁ እንድትዋደዱ ይህን አዛችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before you.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለም ቢጠላችሁ ከእናንተ በፊት እኔን እንደ ጠላኝ እወቁ።

verses.text_english: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓለምስ ብትሆኑ ዓለም የራሱ የሆነውን ይወድ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እኔ ከዓለም መረጥኋችሁ እንጂ ከዓለም ስለ አይደላችሁ ስለዚህ ዓለም ይጠላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.text_amharic: ባርያ ከጌታው አይበልጥም ብዬ የነገርኋችሁን ቃል አስቡ። እኔን አሳደውኝ እንደ ሆኑ እናንተን ደግሞ ያሳድዱአችኋል፤ ቃሌን ጠብቀው እንደ ሆኑ ቃላችሁን ደግሞ ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.text_english: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን የላከኝን አያውቁምና ይህን ሁሉ ሰለ ስሜ ያደርጉባችኋል።

verses.text_english: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ መጥቼ ባልነገርኋቸውስ ኃጢአት ባልሆነባቸውም ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ለኃጢአታቸው ምክንያት የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.text_amharic: እኔን የሚጠላ አባቴን ደግሞ ይጠላል።

verses.text_english: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ ሰው ያላደረገውን ሥራ በመካከላቸው ባላደረግሁ፥ ኃጢአት ባልሆነባቸውም ነበር፤ አሁን ግን እኔንም አባቴንም አይተውማል ጠልተውማል።

verses.text_english: But , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በሕጋቸው። በከንቱ ጠሉኝ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን እኔ ከአብ ዘንድ የምልክላችሁ አጽናኝ እርሱም ከአብ የሚወጣ የእውነት መንፈስ በመጣ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል፤

verses.text_english: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ደግሞ ከመጀመሪያ ከእኔ ጋር ኖራችኋልና ትመሰክራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
verses.text_amharic: እንዳትሰናከሉ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
verses.text_amharic: ከምኵራባቸው ያወጡአችኋል፤ ከዚህ በላይ ደግሞ የሚገድላችሁ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እንደሚያገለግል የሚመስልበት ጊዜ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም የሚያደርጉባችሁ አብንና እኔን ስላላወቁ ነው።

verses.text_english: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጊዜው ሲደርስ እኔ እንደ ነገርኋችሁ ታስቡ ዘንድ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ። ከእንናንተም ጋር ስለ ነበርሁ በመጀመሪያ ይህን አልነገርኋችሁም።

verses.text_english: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን ወደ ላከኝ እሄዳለሁ ከእናንተም። ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? ብሎ የሚጠይቀኝ የለም።

verses.text_english: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህን ስለ ተናገርኋችሁ ኀዘን በልባችሁ ሞልቶአል።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን እውነት እነግራችኋለሁ፤ እኔ እንድሄድ ይሻላችኋል። እኔ ባልሄድ አጽናኙ ወደ እናንተ አይመጣምና፤ እኔ ብሄድ ግን እርሱን እልክላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም መጥቶ ስለ ኃጢአት ስለ ጽድቅም ስለ ፍርድም ዓለምን ይወቅሳል፤

verses.text_english: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ፍርድም፥ የዚህ ዓለም ገዥ ስለ ተፈረደበት ነው።

verses.text_english: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.text_amharic: የምነግራችሁ ገና ብዙ አለኝ፥ ነገር ግን አሁን ልትሸከሙት አትችሉም።

verses.text_english: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
verses.text_amharic: ግን እርሱ የእውነት መንፈስ በመጣ ጊዜ ወደ እውነት ሁሉ ይመራችኋል፤ የሚሰማውን ሁሉ ይናገራል እንጂ ከራሱ አይነግርምና፤ የሚመጣውንም ይነግራችኋል።

verses.text_english: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ያከብረኛል፥ ለእኔ ካለኝ ወስዶ ይነግራችኋልና።

verses.text_english: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ለአብ ያለው ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፤ ስለዚህ። ለእኔ ካለኝ ወስዶ ይነግራችኋል አልሁ።

verses.text_english: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ አታዩኝምም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ ታዩኛላችሁም፥ እኔ ወደ አብ እሄዳለሁና።

verses.text_english: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም አንዳንዶቹ እርስ በርሳቸው። ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ አታዩኝምም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ ታዩኛላችሁም፤ ደግሞ። ወደ አብ እሄዳለሁና የሚለን ይህ ምንድር ነው? ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: Then said of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። ጥቂት የሚለው ይህ ምንድር ነው? የሚናገረውን አናውቅም አሉ።

verses.text_english: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሊጠይቁት እንደ ወደዱ አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ አታዩኝምም፤ ደግሞም ጥቂት ጊዜ አለ፥ ታዩኛላችሁ ስላልሁ፥ ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትመራመራላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተ ታለቅሳለችሁ ሙሾም ታወጣላችሁ፥ ዓለም ግን ደስ ይለዋል፤ እናንተም ታዝናላችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ኀዘናችሁ ወደ ደስታ ይለወጣል።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት በምትወልድበት ጊዜ ወራትዋ ስለ ደረሰ ታዝናለች፤ ነገር ግን ሕፃን ከወለደች በኋላ፥ ሰው በዓለም ተወልዶአልና ስለ ደስታዋ መከራዋን ኋላ አታስበውም።

verses.text_english: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እናንተ ደግሞ አሁን ታዝናላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እንደ ገና አያችኋለሁ ልባችሁም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ደስታችሁንም የሚወስድባችሁ የለም።

verses.text_english: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀንም ከእኔ አንዳች አትለምኑም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብ በስሜ የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ ይሰጣችኋል።

verses.text_english: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give you.
verses.text_amharic: እስከ አሁን በስሜ ምንም አልለመናችሁም፤ ደስታችሁ ፍጹም እንዲሆን ለምኑ ትቀበሉማላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን በምሳሌ ነግሬአችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ስለ አብ ለእናንተ በግልጥ የምናገርበት እንጂ ከዚያ ወዲያ በምሳሌ የማልናገርበት ሰዓት ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀን በስሜ ትለምናላችሁ፤ እኔም ስለ እናንተ አብን እንድለምን የምላችሁ አይደለሁም፤

verses.text_english: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ስለ ወደዳችሁኝ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ እኔ እንደ ወጣሁ ስላመናችሁ አብ እርሱ ራሱ ይወዳችኋልና።

verses.text_english: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
verses.text_amharic: ከአብ ወጥቼ ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ፤ ደግሞ ዓለምን እተወዋለሁ ወደ አብም እሄዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እነሆ፥ አሁን በግልጥ ትናገራለህ በምሳሌም ምንም አትነግርም።

verses.text_english: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን እንድታውቅ ማንምም ሊጠይቅህ እንዳትፈልግ አሁን እናውቃለን፤ ስለዚህ ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ ወጣህ እናምናለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው። አሁን ታምናላችሁን?

verses.text_english: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁ ወደ ቤት የምትበታተኑበት እኔንም ለብቻዬ የምትተዉበት ሰዓት ይመጣል፥ አሁንም ደርሶአል፤ ነገር ግን አብ ከእኔ ጋር ስለ ሆነ ብቻዬን አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ሳላችሁ ሰላም እንዲሆንላችሁ ይህን ተናግሬአችኋለሁ። በዓለም ሳላችሁ መከራ አለባችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አይዞአችሁ፤ እኔ ዓለምን አሸንፌዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን ተናግሮ ወደ ሰማይ ዓይኖቹን አነሣና እንዲህ አለ። አባት ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዓቱ ደርሶአል፤ ልጅህ ያከብርህ ዘንድ፥ በሥጋም ሁሉ ላይ ሥልጣን እንደ ሰጠኸው፥ ለሰጠኸው ሁሉ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ልጅህን አክብረው።

verses.text_english: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
verses.text_amharic: እውነተኛ አምላክ ብቻ የሆንህ አንተን የላክኸውንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ያውቁ ዘንድ ይህች የዘላለም ሕይወት ናት።

verses.text_english: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ላደርገው የሰጠኸኝን ሥራ ፈጽሜ በምድር አከበርሁህ፤

verses.text_english: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር በአንተ ዘንድ በነበረኝ ክብር አንተ በራስህ ዘንድ አክብረኝ።

verses.text_english: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓለም ለሰጠኸኝ ሰዎች ስምህን ገለጥሁላቸው። የአንተ ነበሩ ለእኔም ሰጠሃቸው፤

verses.text_english: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
verses.text_amharic: ቃልህንም ጠብቀዋል። የሰጠኸኝ ሁሉ ከአንተ እንደ ሆነ አሁን ያውቃሉ፤

verses.text_english: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received , and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
verses.text_amharic: የሰጠኸኝን ቃል ሰጥቻቸዋለሁና፤ እነርሱም ተቀበሉት፥ ከአንተም ዘንድ እንደ ወጣሁ በእውነት አወቁ፥ አንተም እንደ ላክኸኝ አመኑ።

verses.text_english: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ስለ እነዚህ እለምናለሁ፤ ስለ ዓለም አልለምንም ስለ ሰጠኸኝ እንጂ፤ የአንተ ናቸውና፤

verses.text_english: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.text_amharic: የእኔም የሆነ ሁሉ የአንተ ነው የአንተውም የእኔ ነው፤ እኔም ስለ እነርሱ ከብሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we .
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ በዓለም አይደለሁም፥ እነርሱም በዓለም ናቸው፥ እኔም ወደ አንተ እመጣለሁ። ቅዱስ አባት ሆይ፥ እነዚህን የሰጠኸኝን እንደ እኛ አንድ እንዲሆኑ በስምህ ጠብቃቸው።

verses.text_english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ ጋር በዓለም ሳለሁ የሰጠኸኝን በስምህ እኔ እጠብቃቸው ነበር፤ ጠበቅኋቸውም መጽሐፉም እንዲፈጸም ከጥፋት ልጅ በቀር ከእነርሱ ማንም አልጠፋም።

verses.text_english: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ወደ አንተ እመጣለሁ፤ በእነርሱም ዘንድ ደስታዬ የተፈጸመ እንዲሆንላቸው ይህን በዓለም እናገራለሁ።

verses.text_english: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ቃልህን ሰጥቻቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም ከዓለም እንዳይደለሁ ከዓለም አይደሉምና ዓለም ጠላቸው።

verses.text_english: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ እንድትጠብቃቸው እንጂ ከዓለም እንድታወጣቸው አልለምንም።

verses.text_english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ከዓለም እንዳይደለሁ ከዓለም አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነትህ ቀድሳቸው፤ ቃልህ እውነት ነው።

verses.text_english: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዓለም እንደ ላክኸኝ እንዲሁ እኔ ወደ ዓለም ላክኋቸው፤

verses.text_english: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ደግሞ በእውነት የተቀደሱ እንዲሆኑ እኔ ራሴን ስለ እነርሱ እቀድሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
That they all may be one; as thou, Father, in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.text_amharic: አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም ሳይፈጠር ስለ ወደድኸኝ የሰጠኸኝን ክብሬን እንዲያዩ እኔ ባለሁበት የሰጠኸኝ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር ይሆኑ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ አባት ሆይ፥ ዓለም አላወቀህም፥ እኔ ግን አወቅሁህ እነዚህም አንተ እንደ ላክኸኝ አወቁ፤

verses.text_english: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.text_amharic: እኔንም የወደድህባት ፍቅር በእነርሱ እንድትሆን እኔም በእነርሱ፥ ስምህን አስታወቅኋቸው አስታውቃቸውማለሁ።

verses.text_english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ይህን ብሎ አትክልት ወዳለበት ስፍራ ወደ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ማዶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወጣ፤ እርሱም ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በዚያ ገቡ።

verses.text_english: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙ ጊዜ ወደዚያ ስለ ተሰበሰቡ አሳልፎ የሰጠው ይሁዳ ደግሞ ስፍራውን ያውቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Judas then, having received a band and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ይሁዳ ጭፍሮችንና ከካህናት አለቆች ከፈሪሳውያንም ሎሌዎችን ተቀብሎ በችቦና በፋና በጋሻ ጦርም ወደዚያ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም የሚመጣበትን ሁሉ አውቆ ወጣና። ማንን ትፈልጋላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am . And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.text_amharic: የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን ብለው መለሱለት። ኢየሱስ። እኔ ነኝ አላቸው። አሳልፎ የሰጠውም ይሁዳ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.text_english: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am , they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ። እኔ ነኝ ባላቸው ጊዜ ወደ ኋላ አፈግፍገው በምድር ወደቁ።

verses.text_english: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። ማንን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። እነርሱም። የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am : if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። እኔ ነኝ አልኋችሁ፤ እንግዲህ እኔን ትፈልጉ እንደ ሆናችሁ እነዚህ ይሂዱ ተዉአቸው አለ፤

verses.text_english: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም። ከእነዚህ ከሰጠኸኝ አንዱን ስንኳ አላጠፋሁም ያለው ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ሰይፍ ስለ ነበረው መዘዘው፥ የሊቀ ካህናቱንም ባርያ መትቶ ቀኝ ጆሮውን ቈረጠ፤ የባርያውም ስም ማልኮስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ጴጥሮስን። ሰይፍህን ወደ ሰገባው ክተተው፤ አብ የሰጠኝን ጽዋ አልጠጣትምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የሻለቃውና ጭፍሮቹ የአይሁድም ሎሌዎች ኢየሱስን ይዘው አሰሩት፥

verses.text_english: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድመውም ወደ ሐና ወሰዱት፤ በዚያች ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት ለነበረው ለቀያፋ አማቱ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.text_amharic: ቀያፋም። አንድ ሰው ስለ ሕዝብ ይሞት ዘንድ ይሻላል ብሎ ለአይሁድ የመከራቸው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ሌላውም ደቀ መዝሙር ኢየሱስን ተከተሉ። ያም ደቀ መዝሙር በሊቀ ካህናቱ ዘንድ የታወቀ ነበረ፥ ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱም ግቢ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ገባ፤

verses.text_english: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ ግን በውጭ በበሩ ቆሞ ነበር። እንግዲህ በሊቀ ካህናቱ ዘንድ የታወቀው ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር ወጣ ለበረኛይቱም ነግሮ ጴጥሮስን አስገባው።

verses.text_english: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
verses.text_amharic: በረኛ የነበረችይቱም ገረድ ጴጥሮስን። አንተ ደግሞ ከዚህ ሰው ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዱ አይደለህምን? አለችው። እርሱ። አይደለሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.text_amharic: ብርድ ነበረና ባሮችና ሎሌዎች የፍም እሳት አንድደው ቆሙ ይሞቁም ነበር፤ ጴጥሮስም ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቆሞ ይሞቅ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ኢየሱስን ስለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱና ስለ ትምህርቱ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየስስም መልሶ። እኔ በግልጥ ለዓለም ተናገርሁ፤ አይሁድ ሁሉ በሚሰበሰቡበት በምኵራብና በመቅደስ እኔ ሁልጊዜ አስተማርሁ፥ በስውርም ምንም አልተናገርሁም።

verses.text_english: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.text_amharic: ስለምን ትጠይቀኛለህ? ለእነርሱ የተናገርሁትን የሰሙትን ጠይቅ፤ እነሆ፥ እነዚህ እኔ የነገርሁትን ያውቃሉ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሲል በዚያ ቆሞ የነበረው ከሎሌዎች አንዱ። ለሊቀ ካህናቱ እንዲህ ትመልሳለህን? ብሎ ኢየሱስን በጥፊ መታው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ክፉ ተናግሬ እንደ ሆንሁ ስለ ክፉ መስክር፤ መልካም ተናግሬ እንደ ሆንሁ ግን ሰለ ምን ትመታኛለህ? አለው።

verses.text_english: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሐና እንደ ታሰረ ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወደ ቀያፋ ሰደደው።

verses.text_english: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also of his disciples? He denied , and said, I am not.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ቆሞ እሳት ይሞቅ ነበር። እንግዲህ። አንተ ደግሞ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አይደለህምን? አሉት። እርሱም። አይደለሁም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.text_english: One of the servants of the high priest, being kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ ጆሮውን የቈረጠው ዘመድ የሆነ ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ባሮች አንዱ። በአትክልቱ ከእርሱ ጋር እኔ አይቼህ አልነበረምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም እንደ ገና ካደ፥ ወዲያውም ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም ከቀያፋ ወደ ገዡ ግቢ ወሰዱት፤ ማለዳም ነበረ፤ እነርሱም የፋሲካ በግ ይበሉ ዘንድ እንጂ እንዳይረክሱ ወደ ገዡ ግቢ አልገቡም።

verses.text_english: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ ወደ ውጭ ወደ እነርሱ ወጥቶ። ይህን ሰው ስለ ምን ትከሱታላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም መልሰው። ይህስ ክፉ አድራጊ ባይሆን ወደ አንተ አሳልፈን ባልሰጠነውም ነበር አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። እናንተ ወስዳችሁ እንደ ሕጋችሁ ፍረዱበት አላቸው። አይሁድም። ለእኛስ ማንንም ልንገድል አልተፈቀደልንም አሉት፤

verses.text_english: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ በምን ዓይነት ሞት ሊሞት እንዳለው ሲያመለክት የተናገረው ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም እንደ ገና ወደ ገዡ ግቢ ገባና ኢየሱስን ጠርቶ። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ አንተ ነህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አንተ ይህን የምትለው ከራስህ ነውን ወይስ ሌሎች ስለ እኔ ነገሩህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስ መልሶ። እኔ አይሁዳዊ ነኝን? ወገኖችህና የካህናት አለቆች ለእኔ አሳልፈው ሰጡህ፤ ምን አድርገሃል? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። መንግሥቴ ከዚህ ዓለም አይደለችም፤ መንግሥቴስ ከዚህ ዓለም ብትሆን፥ ወደ አይሁድ እንዳልሰጥ ሎሌዎቼ ይዋጉልኝ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን መንግሥቴ ከዚህ አይደለችም አለው።

verses.text_english: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። እንግዲያ ንጉሥ ነህን? አለው። ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ ንጉሥ እንደ ሆንሁ አንተ ትላለህ። እኔ ለእውነት ልመሰክር ስለዚህ ተወልጃለሁ ስለዚህም ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ፤ ከእውነት የሆነ ሁሉ ድምፄን ይሰማል አለው።

verses.text_english: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault .
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስ። እውነት ምንድር ነው? አለው። ይህንም ብሎ ዳግመኛ ወደ አይሁድ ወጥቶ። እኔስ አንዲት በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትም።

verses.text_english: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በፋሲካ አንድ ልፈታላችሁ ልማድ አላችሁ፤ እንግዲህ የአይሁድን ንጉሥ ልፈታላችሁ ትወዳላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ደግመው። በርባንን እንጂ ይህን አይደለም እያሉ ጮኹ። በርባን ግን ወንበዴ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ጲላጦስ ኢየሱስን ይዞ ገረፈው።

verses.text_english: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.text_amharic: ወታደሮችም ከእሾህ አክሊል ጐንጕነው በራሱ ላይ አኖሩ ቀይ ልብስም አለበሱት፤

verses.text_english: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.text_amharic: እየቀረቡም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን ይሉት ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.text_amharic: በጥፊም ይመቱት ነበር። ጲላጦስም ደግሞ ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ። እነሆ፥ አንዲት በደል ስንኳ እንዳላገኘሁበት ታውቁ ዘንድ እርሱን ወደ ውጭ አወጣላችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And saith unto them, Behold the man!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም የእሾህ አክሊል ደፍቶ ቀይ ልብስም ለብሶ ወደ ውጭ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify , crucify . Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify : for I find no fault in him.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። እነሆ ሰውዬው አላቸው። የካህናት አለቆችና ሎሌዎች ባዩትም ጊዜ። ስቀለው ስቀለው እያሉ ጮኹ። ጲላጦስም። እኔስ አንዲት በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትምና እናንተ ወስዳችሁ ስቀሉት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም መልሰው። እኛ ሕግ አለን፥ እንደ ሕጋችንም ሊሞት ይገባዋል፥ ራሱን የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ አድርጎአልና አሉት።

verses.text_english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ ይህን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ እግጅ ፈራ፤

verses.text_english: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.text_amharic: ተመልሶም ወደ ገዡ ግቢ ገባና ኢየሱስን። አንተ ከወዴት ነህ? አለው። ኢየሱስ ግን አንድ እንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.text_english: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጲላጦስ። አትነግረኝምን? ልሰቅልህ ሥልጣን እንዳለኝ ወይም ልፈታህ ሥልጣን እንዳለኝ አታውቅምን? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከላይ ካልተሰጠህ በቀር በእኔ ላይ ምንም ሥልጣን ባልነበረህም፤ ስለዚህ ለአንተ አሳልፎ የሰጠኝ ኃጢአቱ የባሰ ነው አለው።

verses.text_english: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ጲላጦስ ሊፈታው ፈለገ፤ ነገር ግን አይሁድ። ይህንስ ብትፈታው የቄሣር ወዳጅ አይደለህም፤ ራሱን ንጉሥ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ የቄሣር ተቃዋሚ ነው እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ይህን ነገር ሰምቶ ኢየሱስን ወደ ውጭ አወጣው፥ በዕብራይስጥም ገበታ በተባለው ጸፍጸፍ በሚሉት ስፍራ በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
verses.text_amharic: ለፋሲካም የማዘጋጀት ቀን ነበረ፤ ስድስት ሰዓትም የሚያህል ነበረ፤ አይሁድንም። እነሆ ንጉሣችሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But they cried out, Away with , away with , crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን። አስወግደው፥ አስወግደው፥ ስቀለው እያሉ ጮኹ። ጲላጦስም። ንጉሣችሁን ልስቀለውን? አላቸው። የካህናት አለቆችም። ከቄሣር በቀር ሌላ ንጉሥ የለንም ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led away.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስንም ይዘው ወሰዱት፤ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ በዕብራይስጥ ጎልጎታ ወደ ተባለው የራስ ቅል ስፍራ ወደሚሉት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሰቀሉት፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎች ሁለት፥ አንዱን በዚህ አንዱን በዚያ ኢየሱስንም በመካከላቸው ሰቀሉ።

verses.text_english: And Pilate wrote a title, and put on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም ደግሞ ጽሕፈት ጽፎ በመስቀሉ ላይ አኖረው፤ ጽሕፈቱም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ የሚል ነበረ።

verses.text_english: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, Latin.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም የተሰቀለበት ስፍራ ለከተማ ቅርብ ነበረና ከአይሁድ ብዙዎች ይህን ጽሕፈት አነበቡት፤ በዕብራይስጥና በሮማይስጥ በግሪክም ተጽፎ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የአይሁድ ካህናት አለቆች ጲላጦስን። እርሱ። የአይሁድ ንጉስ ነኝ እንዳለ እንጂ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ብለህ አትጻፍ አሉት።

verses.text_english: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.text_amharic: ጲላጦስም። የጻፍሁትን ጽፌአለሁ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.text_english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.text_amharic: ጭፍሮችም ኢየሱስን በሰቀሉት ጊዜ ልብሶቹን ወስደው ለእያንዳንዱ ጭፍራ አንድ ክፍል ሆኖ በአራት ከፋፈሉት፤ እጀጠባቡን ደግሞ ወሰዱ። እጀ ጠባቡም ከላይ ጀምሮ ወጥ ሆኖ የተሠራ ነበረ እንጂ የተሰፋ አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳቸው። ለማን እንዲሆን በእርሱ ዕጣ እንጣጣልበት እንጂ አንቅደደው ተባባሉ። ይህም። ልብሴን እርስ በርሳቸው ተከፋፈሉ በእጀ ጠባቤም ዕጣ ተጣጣሉበት የሚለው የመጽሐፍ ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.text_amharic: ጭፍሮችም እንዲህ አደረጉ። ነገር ግን በኢየሱስ መስቀል አጠገብ እናቱ፥ የእናቱም እኅት፥ የቀለዮጳም ሚስት ማርያም፥ መግደላዊትም ማርያም ቆመው ነበር።

verses.text_english: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም እናቱን ይወደው የነበረውንም ደቀ መዝሙር በአጠገቡ ቆሞ ባየ ጊዜ እናቱን። አንቺ ሴት፥ እነሆ ልጅሽ አላት።

verses.text_english: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own .
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ደቀ መዝሙሩን። እናትህ እነኋት አለው። ከዚህም ሰዓት ጀምሮ ደቀ መዝሙሩ ወደ ቤቱ ወሰዳት።

verses.text_english: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ አሁን ሁሉ እንደተፈጸመ አውቆ የመጽሐፉ ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ። ተጠማሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put upon hyssop, and put to his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሆምጣጤ የሞላበት ዕቃ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ እነርሱም ሆምጣጤውን በሰፍነግ ሞልተው በሁሶፕም አድርገው ወደ አፉ አቀረቡለት።

verses.text_english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ሆምጣጤውን ከተቀበለ በኋላ። ተፈጸመ አለ፥ ራሱንም አዘንብሎ ነፍሱን አሳልፎ ሰጠ።

verses.text_english: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and they might be taken away.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም የማዘጋጀት ቀን ስለ ሆነ ያ ሰንበት ትልቅ ነበረና ሥጋቸው በሰንበት በመስቀል ላይ እንዳይኖር፥ ጭናቸውን ሰብረው እንዲያወርዱአቸው ጲላጦስን ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.text_amharic: ጭፍሮችም መጥተው የፊተኛውን ጭን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰቀለውን የሌላውን ጭን ሰበሩ፤

verses.text_english: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሱስ በመጡ ጊዜ ግን እርሱ ፈጽሞ እንደ ሞተ አይተው ጭኑን አልሰበሩም፤

verses.text_english: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከጭፍሮች አንዱ ጎኑን በጦር ወጋው፤ ወዲያውም ደምና ውኃ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And he that saw bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
verses.text_amharic: ያየውም መስክሮአል፤ ምስክሩም እውነት ነው፤ እናንተም ደግሞ ታምኑ ዘንድ እርሱ እውነት እንዲናገር ያውቃል።

verses.text_english: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የሆነ። ከእርሱ አጥንት አይሰበርም የሚል የመጽሐፉ ቃል እንዲፈጸም ነው።

verses.text_english: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም ሌላው መጽሐፍ። የወጉትን ያዩታል ይላል።

verses.text_english: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ አይሁድን ስለ ፈራ በስውር የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዝሙር የነበረ የአርማትያስ ዮሴፍ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ሊወስድ ጲላጦስን ለመነ፤ ጲላጦስም ፈቀደለት። ስለዚህም መጥቶ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ወሰደ።

verses.text_english: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound .
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም አስቀድሞ በሌሊት ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥቶ የነበረ ኒቆዲሞስ መቶ ንጥር የሚያህል የከርቤና የእሬት ቅልቅል ይዞ መጣ።

verses.text_english: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
verses.text_amharic: የኢየሱስንም ሥጋ ወስደው እንደ አይሁድ አገናነዝ ልማድ ከሽቱ ጋር በተልባ እግር ልብስ ከፈኑት።

verses.text_english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.text_amharic: በተሰቀለበትም ስፍራ አትክልት ነበረ፥ በአትክልቱም ማንም ገና ያልተቀበረበት አዲስ መቃብር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መቃብሩ ቅርብ ነበረና ስለ አይሁድ ማዘጋጀት ቀን ኢየሱስን በዚያ አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: The first of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳምንቱም በፊተኛው ቀን መግደላዊት ማርያም ገና ጨለማ ሳለ ማለዳ ወደ መቃብር መጣች ድንጋዩም ከመቃብሩ ተፈንቅሎ አየች።

verses.text_english: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.text_amharic: እየሮጠችም ወደ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስና ኢየሱስ ይወደው ወደ ነበረው ወደ ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር መጥታ። ጌታን ከመቃብር ወስደውታል ወዴትም እንዳኖሩት አናውቅም አለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ጴጥሮስና ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር ወጥተው ወደ መቃብሩ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለቱም አብረው ሮጡ፤ ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙርም ከጴጥሮስ ይልቅ ፈጥኖ ወደ ፊት ሮጠና አስቀድሞ ከመቃብሩ ደረሰ፤

verses.text_english: And he stooping down, , saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.text_amharic: ዝቅም ብሎ ቢመለከት የተልባ እግሩን ልብስ ተቀምጦ አየ፥ ነገር ግን አልገባም።

verses.text_english: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ተከትሎት መጣ ወደ መቃብሩም ገባ፤ የተልባ እግሩን ልብስ ተቀምጦ አየ፥

verses.text_english: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በራሱ የነበረውን ጨርቅ ለብቻው በአንድ ስፍራ ተጠምጥሞ እንደ ነበረ እንጂ ከተልባ እግሩ ልብስ ጋር ተቀምጦ እንዳልነበረ አየ።

verses.text_english: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አስቀድሞ ወደ መቃብር የመጣውም ሌላው ደቀ መዝሙር ደግሞ ገባ፥ አየም፥ አመነም፤

verses.text_english: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ከሙታን ይነሣ ዘንድ እንዲገባው የሚለውን የመጽሐፉን ቃል ገና አላወቁም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ቤታቸው ደግሞ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, into the sepulchre,
verses.text_amharic: ማርያም ግን እያለቀሰች ከመቃብሩ በስተ ውጭ ቆማ ነበር። ስታለቅስም ወደ መቃብር ዝቅ ብላ ተመለከተች፤

verses.text_english: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት መላእክትም ነጭ ልብስ ለብሰው የኢየሱስ ሥጋ ተኝቶበት በነበረው አንዱ በራስጌ ሌላውም በእግርጌ ተቀምጠው አየች።

verses.text_english: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ስለ ምን ታለቅሻለሽ? አሉአት። እርስዋም። ጌታዬን ወስደውታል ወዴትም እንዳኖሩት አላውቅም አለቻቸው።

verses.text_english: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብላ ወደ ኋላ ዘወር ስትል ኢየሱስን ቆሞ አየችው፤ ኢየሱስም እንደ ሆነ አላወቀችም።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ስለ ምን ታለቅሻለሽ? ማንንስ ትፈልጊያለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም የአትክልት ጠባቂ መስሎአት። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ወስደኸው እንደ ሆንህ ወዴት እንዳኖርኸው ንገረኝ እኔም እወስደዋለሁ አለችው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ማርያም አላት። እርስዋ ዘወር ብላ በዕብራይስጥ። ረቡኒ አለችው፤ ትርጓሜውም። መምህር ሆይ ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and my God, and your God.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ገና ወደ አባቴ አላረግሁምና አትንኪኝ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ወንድሞቼ ሄደሽ። እኔ ወደ አባቴና ወደ አባታችሁ ወደ አምላኬና ወደ አምላካችሁ ዓርጋለሁ ብለሽ ንገሪአቸው አላት።

verses.text_english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.text_amharic: መግደላዊት ማርያም መጥታ ጌታን እንዳየች ይህንም እንዳላት ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ነገረች።

verses.text_english: Then the same day at evening, being the first of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ቀን እርሱም ከሳምንቱ ፊተኛው በመሸ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተሰብስበው በነበሩበት፥ አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ደጆቹ ተዘግተው ሳሉ፥ ኢየሱስ መጣ፤ በመካከላቸውም ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንም ጎኑንም አሳያቸው። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ጌታን ባዩ ጊዜ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace unto you: as Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ዳግመኛ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን፤ አብ እንደ ላከኝ እኔ ደግሞ እልካችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had said this, he breathed on , and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ እፍ አለባቸውና። መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; whose soever ye retain, they are retained.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ያላችኋቸው ሁሉ ይቀርላቸዋል፤ የያዛችሁባቸው ተይዞባቸዋል አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ዲዲሞስ የሚሉት ቶማስ ኢየሱስ በመጣ ጊዜ ከእነርሱ ጋር አልነበረም።

verses.text_english: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎቹም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ጌታን አይተነዋል አሉት። እርሱ ግን። የችንካሩን ምልክት በእጆቹ ካላየሁ ጣቴንም በችንካሩ ምልክት ካላገባሁ እጄንም በጎኑ ካላገባሁ አላምንም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ከስምንት ቀን በኋላም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ደግመው በውስጥ ነበሩ፥ ቶማስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ። ደጆች ተዘግተው ሳሉ ኢየሱስ መጣ፤ በመካከላቸውም ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ ቶማስን። ጣትህን ወደዚህ አምጣና እጆቼን እይ፤ እጅህንም አምጣና በጎኔ አግባው፤ ያመንህ እንጂ ያላመንህ አትሁን አለው።

verses.text_english: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.text_amharic: ቶማስም። ጌታዬ አምላኬም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed they that have not seen, and have believed.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ስለ አየኸኝ አምነሃል፤ ሳያዩ የሚያምኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም በዚህ መጽሐፍ ያልተጻፈ ሌላ ብዙ ምልክት በደቀ መዛሙርቱ ፊት አደረገ፤

verses.text_english: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ ታምኑ ዘንድ፥ አምናችሁም በስሙ ሕይወት ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ ይህ ተጽፎአል።

verses.text_english: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he .
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ በጥብርያዶስ ባሕር አጠገብ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንደ ገና ተገለጠላቸው፤

verses.text_english: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ተገለጠ። ስምዖን ጴጥሮስና ዲዲሞስ የሚባለው ቶማስ ከገሊላ ቃና የሆነ ናትናኤልም የዘብዴዎስም ልጆች ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሌሎች ሁለት በአንድነት ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ። ዓሣ ላጠምድ እሄዳለሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም። እኛም ከአንተ ጋር እንመጣለን አሉት። ወጥተውም ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገቡ በዚያችም ሌሊት ምንም እላጠመዱም።

verses.text_english: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በባሕር ዳር ቆመ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ግን ኢየሱስ መሆኑን አላወቁም።

verses.text_english: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ልጆች ሆይ፥ አንዳች የሚበላ አላችሁን? አላቸው። የለንም ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። መረቡን በታንኳይቱ በስተ ቀኝ ጣሉት ታገኙማላችሁ አላቸው። ስለዚህ ጣሉት፤ በዚህም ጊዜ ከዓሣው ብዛት የተነሣ ሊጐትቱት አቃታቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt fisher's coat , (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ይወደው የነበረውም ደቀ መዝሙር ጴጥሮስን። ጌታ እኮ ነው አለው። ስለዚህ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ጌታ መሆኑን በሰማ ጊዜ ዕራቁቱን ነበረና ልብሱን ታጥቆ ወደ ባሕር ራሱን ጣለ።

verses.text_english: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎቹ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ከምድር ሁለት መቶ ክንድ ያህል እንጂ እጅግ አልራቁም ነበርና ዓሣ የሞላውን መረብ እየሳቡ በጀልባ መጡ።

verses.text_english: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምድርም በወጡ ጊዜ ፍምና ዓሣ በላዩ ተቀምጦ እንጀራም አዩ።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። አሁን ካጠመዳችሁት ዓሣ አምጡ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.text_amharic: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም ወደ ጀልባይቱ ገብቶ መቶ አምሳ ሦስት ታላላቅ ዓሦች ሞልቶ የነበረውን መረብ ወደ ምድር ጐተተ፤ ይህንም ያህል ብዙ ሲሆን መረቡ አልተቀደደም።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto them, Come dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። ኑ፥ ምሳ ብሉ አላቸው። ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንድ ስንኳ። አንተ ማን ነህ? ብሎ ሊመረምረው የደፈረ አልነበረም፤ ጌታ መሆኑን አውቀው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም መጣና እንጀራ አንሥቶ ሰጣቸው፥ እንዲሁም ዓሣውን።

verses.text_english: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ከሙታን ከተነሣ በኋላ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሲገለጥላቸው ይህ ሦስተኛው ጊዜ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.text_amharic: ምሳ ከበሉ በኋላም ኢየሱስ ስምዖን ጴጥሮስን። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ከእነዚህ ይልቅ ትወደኛለህን? አለው። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንድወድህ አንተ ታውቃለህ አለው። ግልገሎቼን አሰማራ አለው።

verses.text_english: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ሁለተኛ። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ትወደኛለህን? አለው። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንድወድህ አንተ ታውቃለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.text_amharic: ጠቦቶቼን ጠብቅ አለው። ሦስተኛ ጊዜ። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ትወደኛለህን? አለው። ሦስተኛ። ትወደኛለህን? ስላለው ጴጥሮስ አዘነና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ሁሉን ታውቃለህ፤ እንድወድህ አንተ ታውቃለህ አለው። ኢየሱስም። በጎቼን አሰማራ።

verses.text_english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry whither thou wouldest not.
verses.text_amharic: እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ አንተ ጐልማሳ ሳለህ ወገብህን በገዛ ራስህ ታጥቀህ ወደምትወደው ትሄድ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በሸመገልህ ጊዜ እጆችህን ትዘረጋለህ፥ ሌላውም ያስታጥቅሃል ወደማትወደውም ይወስድሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.text_amharic: በምን ዓይነት ሞት እግዚአብሔርን ያከብር ዘንድ እንዳለው ሲያመለክት ይህን አለ። ይህንም ብሎ። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ዘወር ብሎ ኢየሱስ ይወደው የነበረውን ደቀ መዝሙር ሲከተለው አየ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ በእራት ጊዜ በደረቱ ተጠግቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሳልፎ የሚሰጥህ ማን ነው? ያለው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what this man ?
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ይህን አይቶ ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህስ እንዴት ይሆናል? አለው።

verses.text_english: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what to thee? follow thou me.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም። እስክመጣ ድረስ ይኖር ዘንድ ብወድስ፥ ምን አግዶህ? አንተ ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what to thee?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ። ያ ደቀ መዝሙር አይሞትም የሚለው ይህ ነገር ወደ ወንድሞች ወጣ፤ ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ። እስክመጣ ድረስ ይኖር ዘንድ ብወድስ ምን አግዶህ? አለው እንጂ አይሞትም አላለውም።

verses.text_english: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እነዚህም የመሰከረ ይህንንም ጽፎ ያለ ይህ ደቀ መዝሙር ነው፥ ምስክሩም እውነት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን።

verses.text_english: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስም ያደረገው ብዙ ሌላ ነገር ደግሞ አለ፤ ሁሉ በእያንዳንዱ ቢጻፍ ለተጻፉት መጻሕፍት ዓለም ራሱ ባልበቃቸውም ይመስለኛል።

verses.text_english: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.text_amharic: ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥

verses.text_english: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ የመረጣቸውን ሐዋርያትን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ካዘዛቸው በኋላ እስከ ዐረገበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ያደርገውና ያስተምረው ዘንድ ስለ ጀመረው ሁሉ መጀመሪያውን ነገር ጻፍሁ፤

verses.text_english: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ አርባ ቀን እየታያቸው ስለ እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ነገር እየነገራቸው፥ በብዙ ማስረጃ ከሕማማቱ በኋላ ሕያው ሆኖ ለእነርሱ ራሱን አሳያቸው።

verses.text_english: And, being assembled together with , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, , ye have heard of me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ጋር አብሮ ሳለ ከኢየሩሳሌም እንዳይወጡ አዘዛቸው፥ ነገር ግን። ከእኔ የሰማችሁትን አብ የሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል ጠብቁ፤

verses.text_english: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስ በውኃ አጥምቆ ነበርና፥ እናንተ ግን ከጥቂት ቀን በኃላ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ትጠመቃላችሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ወራት ለእስራኤል መንግሥትን ትመልሳለህን? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አብ በገዛ ሥልጣኑ ያደረገውን ወራትንና ዘመናትን ታውቁ ዘንድ ለእናንተ አልተሰጣችሁም፤

verses.text_english: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስ በእናንተ ላይ በወረደ ጊዜ ኃይልን ትቀበላላችሁ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በይሁዳም ሁሉ በሰማርያም እስከ ምድር ዳርም ድረስ ምስክሮቼ ትሆናላችሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ እነርሱ እያዩት ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ ደመናም ከዓይናቸው ሰውራ ተቀበለችው።

verses.text_english: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሲሄድ ወደ ሰማይ ትኵር ብለው ሲመለከቱ ሳሉ፥ እነሆ፥ ነጫጭ ልብስ የለበሱ ሁለት ሰዎች በአጠገባቸው ቆሙ፤

verses.text_english: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም። የገሊላ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ወደስማይ እየተመለከታችሁ ስለ ምን ቆማችኋል? ይህ ከእናንተ ወደ ሰማይ የወጣው ኢየሱስ ወደ ሰማይ ሲሄድ እንዳያችሁት፥ እንዲሁ ይመጣል አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ደብረ ዘይት ከሚባለው ተራራ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ እርሱም ከኢየሩሳሌም የሰንበት መንገድ ያህል የራቀ ነው።

verses.text_english: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas of James.
verses.text_amharic: በገቡም ጊዜ ወደሚኖሩበት ሰገነት ወጡ፥ ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስም፥ ያዕቆብም፥ እንድርያስም፥ ፊልጶስም፥ ቶማስም፥ በርተሎሜዎስም፥ ማቴዎስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም፥ ቀናተኛ የሚባለው ስምዖንም፥ የያዕቆብ ልጅ ይሁዳም።

verses.text_english: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከሴቶችና ከኢየሱስ እናት ከማርያም ከወንድሞቹም ጋር በአንድ ልብ ሆነው ለጸሎት ይተጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ወራት ጴጥሮስ መቶ ሀያ በሚያህል በሰዎች ማኅበር አብረው በነበሩ በወንድሞቹ መካከል ተነሥቶ አለ።

verses.text_english: Men brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ኢየሱስን ለያዙት መሪ ስለሆናቸው ስለ ይሁዳ መንፈስ ቅዱስ አስቀድሞ በዳዊት አፍ የተናገረው የመጽሐፍ ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይገባ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኛ ጋር ተቈጥሮ ነበርና፥ ለዚህም አገልግሎት ታድሎ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሰው በዓመፅ ዋጋ መሬት ገዛ በግንባሩም ተደፍቶ ከመካከሉ ተሰነጠቀ አንጀቱም ሁሉ ተዘረገፈ፤

verses.text_english: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ሁሉ ታወቀ፤ ስለዚህም ያ መሬት በቋንቋቸው አኬልዳማ ተብሎ ተጠራ፥ እርሱም የደም መሬት ማለት ነው።

verses.text_english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
verses.text_amharic: በመዝሙር መጽሐፍ። መኖሪያው ምድረ በዳ ትሁን የሚኖርባትም አይኑር፤ ደግሞም። ሹመቱን ሌላ ይውሰዳት ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.text_amharic: ኢዮስጦስም የሚሉትን በርስያን የተባለውን ዮሴፍንና ማትያስን ሁለቱን አቆሙ።

verses.text_english: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
verses.text_amharic: ዕጣም ተጣጣሉላቸው፥ ዕጣውም ለማትያስ ወደቀና ከአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ጋር ተቈጠረ።

verses.text_english: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
verses.text_amharic: በዓለ ኀምሳ የተባለውም ቀን በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ ሁሉም በአንድ ልብ ሆነው አብረው ሳሉ፥

verses.text_english: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገት እንደሚነጥቅ ዓውሎ ነፋስ ከሰማይ ድምፅ መጣ፥ ተቀምጠው የነበሩበትንም ቤት ሁሉ ሞላው።

verses.text_english: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እሳትም የተከፋፈሉ ልሳኖች ታዩአቸው፤ በያንዳንዳቸውም ላይ ተቀመጡባቸው።

verses.text_english: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verses.text_amharic: በሁሉም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው፥ መንፈስም ይናገሩ ዘንድ እንደ ሰጣቸው በሌላ ልሳኖች ይናገሩ ጀመር።

verses.text_english: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይም በታች ካሉ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በጸሎት የተጉ አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌም ይኖሩ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ድምፅ በሆነ ጊዜ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፥ እያንዳንዱም በገዛ ቋንቋው ሲናገሩ ይሰማ ስለ ነበር የሚሉትን አጡ።

verses.text_english: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
verses.text_amharic: ተገርመውም ተደንቀውም እንዲህ አሉ። እነሆ፥ እነዚህ የሚናገሩት ሁሉ የገሊላ ሰዎች አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
verses.text_amharic: እኛም እያንዳንዳችን የተወለድንበትን የገዛ ቋንቋችንን እንዴት እንሰማለን?

verses.text_english: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
verses.text_amharic: የጳርቴና የሜድ የኢላሜጤም ሰዎች፥ በሁለት ወንዝም መካከል በይሁዳም በቀጰዶቅያም በጳንጦስም በእስያም፥

verses.text_english: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
verses.text_amharic: በፍርግያም በጵንፍልያም በግብፅም በቀሬናም በኩል ባሉት በሊቢያ ወረዳዎች የምንኖር፥ በሮሜም የምንቀመጥ፥ አይሁድም ወደ ይሁዲነትም የገባን፥

verses.text_english: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
verses.text_amharic: የቀርጤስና የዓረብ ሰዎች፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ታላቅ ሥራ በልሳኖቻችን ሲናገሩ እንሰማቸዋለን።

verses.text_english: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም ተገረሙና አመንትተው እርስ በርሳቸው። እንጃ ይህ ምን ይሆን? አሉ።

verses.text_english: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎች ግን እያፌዙባቸው። ጉሽ የወይን ጠጅ ጠግበዋል አሉ።

verses.text_english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጴጥሮስ ከአሥራ አንዱ ጋር ቆመ፥ ድምፁንም ከፍ አድርጎ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው። አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሁላችሁ፥ ይህ በእናንተ ዘንድ የታወቀ ይሁን፥ ቃሎቼንም አድምጡ።

verses.text_english: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is the third hour of the day.
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ እንደ መሰላችሁ እነዚህ የሰከሩ አይደሉም፥ ከቀኑ ሦስተኛ ሰዓት ነውና፤

verses.text_english: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህ በነቢዩ በኢዩኤል የተባለው ነው።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይላል። በመጨረሻው ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ሥጋ በለበሰ ሁሉ ላይ ከመንፈሴ አፈሳለሁ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ጎበዞቻችሁም ራእይ ያያሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም ሕልም ያልማሉ፤

verses.text_english: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በዚያች ወራት በወንዶችና በሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ ላይ ከመንፈሴ አፈሳለሁ ትንቢትም ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
verses.text_amharic: ድንቆችን በላይ በሰማይ፥ ምልክቶችንም በታች በምድር እሰጣለሁ፤ ደምም እሳትም የጢስ ጭጋግም ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅ የሆነ የተሰማም የጌታ ቀን ሳይመጣ ፀሐይ ወደ ጨለማ ጨረቃም ወደ ደም ይለወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And it shall come to pass, whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታን ስም የሚጠራም ሁሉ ይድናል።

verses.text_english: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
verses.text_amharic: የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ይህን ቃል ስሙ፤ ራሳችሁ እንደምታውቁ፥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችሁ በእርሱ በኩል ባደረገው ተአምራትና በድንቆች በምልክቶችም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ለእናንተ የተገለጠ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም በእግዚአብሔር በተወሰነው አሳቡና በቀደመው እውቀቱ ተሰጥቶ በዓመፀኞች እጅ ሰቅላችሁ ገደላችሁት።

verses.text_english: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን የሞትን ጣር አጥፍቶ አስነሣው፥ ሞት ይይዘው ዘንድ አልቻለምና።

verses.text_english: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊት ስለ እርሱ እንዲህ ይላልና። ጌታን ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አየሁት፥ እንዳልታወክ በቀኜ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ልቤን ደስ አለው፥ ልሳኔም ሐሤት አደረገ፥ ደግሞም ሥጋዬ በተስፋ ያድራል፤

verses.text_english: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍሴን በሲኦል አትተዋትምና፥ ቅዱስህንም መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትሰጠውም።

verses.text_english: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
verses.text_amharic: የሕይወትን መንገድ አስታወቅኸኝ፤ ከፊትህ ጋር ደስታን ትሞላብኛለህ።

verses.text_english: Men brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስለ አባቶች አለቃ ስለ ዳዊት እንደ ሞተም እንደ ተቀበረም ለእናንተ በግልጥ እናገር ዘንድ ፍቀዱልኝ፤ መቃብሩም እስከ ዛሬ በእኛ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
verses.text_amharic: ነቢይ ስለ ሆነ፥ ከወገቡም ፍሬ በዙፋኑ ያስቀምጥ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር መሐላ እንደ ማለለት ስለ አወቀ፥

verses.text_english: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ክርስቶስ ትንሣኤ አስቀድሞ አይቶ፥ ነፍሱ በሲኦል እንዳልቀረች ሥጋውም መበስበስን እንዳላየ ተናገረ።

verses.text_english: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ኢየሱስን እግዚአብሔር አስነሣው ለዚህም ነገር እኛ ሁላችን ምስክሮች ነን፤

verses.text_english: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎና የመንፈስ ቅዱስን የተስፋ ቃል ከአብ ተቀብሎ ይህን እናንተ አሁን የምታዩትንና የምትሰሙትን አፈሰሰው።

verses.text_english: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
verses.text_amharic: አለ። እንግዲህ ይህን እናንተ የሰቀላችሁትን ኢየሱስን እግዚአብሔር ጌታም ክርስቶስም እንዳደረገው የእስራኤል ወገን ሁሉ በእርግጥ ይወቅ።

verses.text_english: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ ልባቸው ተነካ፥ ጴጥሮስንና ሌሎችንም ሐዋርያት። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ምን እናድርግ? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Now when they heard , they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men brethren, what shall we do?
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም። ንስሐ ግቡ፥ ኃጢአታችሁም ይሰረይ ዘንድ እያንዳንዳችሁ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም ተጠመቁ፤ የመንፈስ ቅዱስንም ስጦታ ትቀበላላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: የተስፋው ቃል ለእናንተና ለልጆቻችሁ ጌታ አምላካችንም ወደ እርሱ ለሚጠራቸው በሩቅ ላሉ ሁሉ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, as many as the Lord our God shall call.
verses.text_amharic: በብዙ ሌላ ቃልም መሰከረና። ከዚህ ጠማማ ትውልድ ዳኑ ብሎ መከራቸው።

verses.text_english: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉንም የተቀበሉ ተጠመቁ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሦስት ሺህ የሚያህል ነፍስ ተጨመሩ፤

verses.text_english: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added about three thousand souls.
verses.text_amharic: በሐዋርያትም ትምህርትና በኅብረት እንጀራውንም በመቍረስ በየጸሎቱም ይተጉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በሰው ሁሉ ፍርሀት ሆነ፤ በሐዋርያትም እጅ ብዙ ድንቅና ምልክት ተደረገ።

verses.text_english: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
verses.text_amharic: ያመኑትም ሁሉ አብረው ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
verses.text_amharic: ያላቸውንም ሁሉ አንድነት አደረጉ። መሬታቸውንና ጥሪታቸውንም እየሸጡ፥ ማንኛውም እንደሚፈልግ ለሁሉ ያካፍሉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all , as every man had need.
verses.text_amharic: በየቀኑም በአንድ ልብ ሆነው በመቅደስ እየተጉ በቤታቸውም እንጀራ እየቈረሱ፥ በደስታና በጥሩ ልብ ምግባቸውን ይመገቡ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑ በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስ ነበራቸው። ጌታም የሚድኑትን ዕለት ዕለት በእነርሱ ላይ ይጨምር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth .
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስም በጸሎት ጊዜ በዘጠኝ ሰዓት ወደ መቅደስ ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቅደስም ከሚገቡት ምጽዋት ይለምን ዘንድ፥ ሰዎች ተሸክመው መልካም በሚሉአት በመቅደስ ደጅ በየቀኑ ያስቀምጡት የነበሩ ከእናቱ ማኅፀን ጀምሮ አንካሳ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ወደ መቅደስ ሊገቡ እንዳላቸው ባየ ጊዜ፥ ምጽዋትን ለመናቸው።

verses.text_english: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስም ከዮሐንስ ጋር ትኵር ብሎ ወደ እርሱ ተመልክቶ። ወደ እኛ ተመልከት አለው።

verses.text_english: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አንድ ነገር ከእነርሱ እንዲቀበል ሲጠብቅ ወደ እነርሱ ተመለከተ።

verses.text_english: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
verses.text_amharic: ጴጥሮስ ግን። ብርና ወርቅ የለኝም፤ ይህን ያለኝን ግን እሰጥሃለሁ፤ በናዝሬቱ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም ተነሣና ተመላለስ አለው።

verses.text_english: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.text_amharic: በቀኝ እጁም ይዞ አስነሣው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም እግሩና ቍርጭምጭምቱ ጸና፥

verses.text_english: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ላይ ዘሎም ቆመ፥ ይመላለስም ጀመር፤ እየተመላለሰም እየዘለለም እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገነ ከእነርሱ ጋር ወደ መቅደስ ገባ።
