verses.text_english: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's .
verses.text_amharic: ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ሰዎችም ጋር ተጣልቶ ነበር፤ በአንድ ልብ ሆነውም ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ የንጉሥንም ቢትወደድ ብላስጦስን እሺ አሰኝተው ዕርቅ ለመኑ፥ አገራቸው ከንጉሥ አገር ምግብ ያገኝ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በተቀጠረ ቀንም ሄሮድስ ልብሰ መንግሥቱን ለብሶ በዙፋን ተቀመጠ እነርሱንም ተናገራቸው፤

verses.text_english: And the people gave a shout, the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም። የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ነው የሰውም አይደለም ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ስላልሰጠ ያን ጊዜ የጌታ መልአክ መታው በትልም ተበልቶ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን ያድግና ይበዛ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.text_amharic: በርናባስና ሳውልም አገልግሎታቸውን ፈጽመው ከኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ ማርቆስ የተባለውን ዮሐንስንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይዘውት መጡ።

verses.text_english: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.text_amharic: በአንጾኪያም ባለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነቢያትና መምህራን ነበሩ፤ እነርሱም በርናባስ፥ ኔጌር የተባለው ስምዖንም፥ የቀሬናው ሉክዮስም፥ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ የሄሮድስም ባለምዋል ምናሔ፥ ሳውልም ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ጌታን ሲያመልኩና ሲጦሙ መንፈስ ቅዱስ። በርናባስንና ሳውልን ለጠራኋቸው ሥራ ለዩልኝ አለ።

verses.text_english: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid hands on them, they sent away.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ከጦሙ ከጸለዩም እጃቸውንም ከጫኑ በኋላ አሰናበቱአቸው።

verses.text_english: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተልከው ወደ ሴሌውቅያ ወረዱ፤ ከዚያም በመርከብ ወደ ቆጵሮስ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to minister.
verses.text_amharic: በስልማናም በነበሩ ጊዜ በአይሁድ ምኵራቦች የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰበኩ፤ አገልጋይም ዮሐንስ ነበራቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name Barjesus:
verses.text_amharic: ደሴቲቱንም ሁሉ እስከ ጳፉ በዞሩ ጊዜ፥ በርያሱስ የሚሉትን ጠንቋይና ሐሰተኛ ነቢይ የሆነውን አንድ አይሁዳዊ ሰው አገኙ፤

verses.text_english: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አስተዋይ ሰው ከሆነው ሰርግዮስ ጳውሎስ ከሚባለው አገረ ገዥ ጋር ነበረ። ይህም በርናባስንና ሳውልን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሊሰማ ፈለገ።

verses.text_english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.text_amharic: ጠንቋዩ ግን ኤልማስ፥ ስሙ እንዲሁ ይተረጐማልና፥ አገረ ገዡን ከማመን ሊያጣምም ፈልጎ ተቃወማቸው።

verses.text_english: Then Saul, (who also Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ የተባለው ሳውል ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተሞልቶ ትኵር ብሎ ሲመለከተው።

verses.text_english: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, child of the devil, enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ተንኰል ሁሉ ክፋትም ሁሉ የሞላብህ፥ የዲያብሎስ ልጅ፥ የጽድቅም ሁሉ ጠላት፥ የቀናውን የጌታን መንገድ ከማጣመም አታርፍምን?

verses.text_english: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ እጅ በአንተ ላይ ናት፥ ዕውርም ትሆናለህ እስከ ጊዜውም ፀሐይን አታይም አለው። ያን ጊዜም ጭጋግና ጨለማ ወደቀበት፥ በእጁም የሚመራውን እየዞረ ፈለገ።

verses.text_english: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ አገረ ገዡ የተደረገውን ባየ ጊዜ ከጌታ ትምህርት የተነሣ ተገርሞ አመነ።

verses.text_english: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ከጓደኞቹ ጋር ከጳፉ ተነሥቶ የጵንፍልያ ወደምትሆን ወደ ጴርጌን መጣ፤ ዮሐንስም ከእነርሱ ተለይቶ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሰ።

verses.text_english: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን ከጴርጌን አልፈው የጲስድያ ወደምትሆን ወደ አንጾኪያ ደረሱ፤ በሰንበትም ቀን ወደ ምኵራብ ገብተው ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, men brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግና ነቢያትም ከተነበቡ በኋላ የምኵራቡ አለቆች። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሕዝብን የሚመክር ቃል እንዳላችሁ ተናገሩ ብለው ላኩባቸው።

verses.text_english: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ተነሣና በእጁ ጠቅሶ እንዲህ አለ። የእስራኤል ሰዎችና እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥ ስሙ።

verses.text_english: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.text_amharic: የዚህ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ አምላክ አባቶቻችንን መርጦ በግብፅ አገር በእንግድነት ሳሉ ሕዝቡን ከፍ ከፍ አደረጋቸው፥ ከፍ ባለችውም ክንዱ ከዚያ አወጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.text_amharic: በበረሀም አርባ ዓመት ያህል መገባቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.text_amharic: በከነዓንም አገር ሰባት አሕዛብን አጥፍቶ ምድራቸውን አወረሳቸው።

verses.text_english: And after that he gave judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ እስከ ነቢዩ እስከ ሳሙኤል ድረስ አራት መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ያህል መሳፍንትን ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወዲያ ንጉሥን ያነግሥላቸው ዘንድ ለመኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከብንያም ወገን የሚሆን ሰው የቂስን ልጅ ሳኦልን አርባ ዓመት ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም ከሻረው በኋላ ዳዊትን በእነርሱ ላይ እንዲነግሥ አስነሣው፥ ሲመሰክርለትም። እንደ ልቤ የሆነ ሰው ፈቃዴንም ሁሉ የሚያደርግ የእሴይን ልጅ ዳዊትን አገኘሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Of this man's seed hath God according to promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሰው ዘር እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተስፋው ቃል ለእስራኤል መድኃኒትን እርሱም ኢየሱስን አመጣ።

verses.text_english: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: ከመምጣቱ በፊት ዮሐንስ አስቀድሞ ለእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ የንስሐን ጥምቀት ሰብኮ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not . But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሐንስም ሩጫውን ሲፈጽም ሳለ። እኔ ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ታስባላችሁ? እኔስ እርሱን አይደለሁም፤ ነገር ግን እነሆ፥ የእግሩን ጫማ እፈታ ዘንድ ከማይገባኝ ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: Men brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ወንድሞቻችን፥ የአብርሃም ዘር ልጆች ከእናንተ መካከልም እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሆይ፥ ለእናንተ የዚህ የመዳን ቃል ተላከ።

verses.text_english: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled in condemning .
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ ሰዎችና አለቆቻቸው እርሱንና በየሰንበቱ የሚነበቡትን የነቢያትን ድምፆች ስላላወቁ በፍርዳቸው ፈጽመዋልና፤

verses.text_english: And though they found no cause of death , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.text_amharic: ለሞትም የሚያደርስ ምክንያት አንድ ስንኳ ባያገኙበት፥ ይገድለው ዘንድ ጲላጦስን ለመኑት፤

verses.text_english: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took down from the tree, and laid in a sepulchre.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርሱም የተጻፈውን ሁሉ በፈጸሙ ጊዜ ከእንጨት አውርደው በመቃብር አኖሩት።

verses.text_english: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሙታን አስነሣው፤

verses.text_english: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.text_amharic: በሕዝብም ዘንድ ምስክሮቹ ለሆኑት ከእርሱ ጋር ከገሊላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለወጡት ብዙ ቀን ታያቸው።

verses.text_english: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.text_amharic: እኛም ለአባቶች የተሰጠውን ተስፋ የምስራቹን ለእናንተ እንሰብካለን፤

verses.text_english: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ተስፋ እግዚአብሔር በሁለተኛው መዝሙር ደግሞ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ እኔ ዛሬ ወለድሁህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ ኢየሱስን አስነሥቶ ለእኛ ለልጆቻቸው ፈጽሞአልና።

verses.text_english: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.text_amharic: እንደገናም ወደ መበስበስ እንዳይመለስ ከሙታን እንደ አስነሣው፥ እንዲህ። የታመነውን የዳዊትን ቅዱስ ተስፋ እሰጣችኋለሁ ብሎአል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore he saith also in another , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ በሌላ ስፍራ። ቅዱስህን መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትሰጠውም ይላልና።

verses.text_english: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.text_amharic: ዳዊትም በራሱ ዘመን የእግዚአብሔርን አሳብ ካገለገለ በኋላ አንቀላፋ፥ ከአባቶቹም ጋር ተጨምሮ መበስበስን አየ፤

verses.text_english: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ እግዚአብሔር ያስነሣው ግን መበስበስን አላየም።

verses.text_english: Be it known unto you therefore, men brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.text_amharic: በወጡም ጊዜ ይህን ነገር በሚመጣው ሰንበት ይነግሩአቸው ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ጉባኤውም ከተፈታ በኋላ ከአይሁድና ወደ ይሁዲነት ገብተው ከሚያመልኩ ብዙዎች ጳውሎስንና በርናባስን ተከተሉአቸው፥ እነርሱም ሲነግሩአቸው በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ጸንተው እንዲኖሩ አስረዱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ሰንበት ከጥቂቶቹ በቀር የከተማው ሰው ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይሰሙ ዘንድ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ብዙ ሕዝብ ባዩ ጊዜ ቅንዓት ሞላባቸው፥ እየተሳደቡም ጳውሎስ የተናገረውን ቃል ተቃወሙ።

verses.text_english: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስና በርናባስም ገልጠው። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል አስቀድሞ ለእናንተ ይነገር ዘንድ ያስፈልጋል፤ ከገፋችሁትና የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳይገባችሁ በራሳችሁ ከፈረዳችሁ ግን፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ አሕዛብ ዘወር እንላለን።

verses.text_english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ጌታ። እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ለማዳን ትሆን ዘንድ ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን አድርጌሃለሁ ብሎ አዞናልና አሉ።

verses.text_english: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም ሰምተው ደስ አላቸው የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል አከበሩ፥ ለዘላለም ሕይወትም የተዘጋጁ ሁሉ አመኑ፤

verses.text_english: For so hath the Lord commanded us, , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታም ቃል በአገሩ ሁሉ ተስፋፋ።

verses.text_english: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ግን የሚያመልኩትን የከበሩትንም ሴቶችና የከተማውን መኳንንት አወኩ፥ በጳውሎስና በበርናባስም ላይ ስደትን አስነሥተው ከአገራቸው አወጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ግን የእግራቸውን ትቢያ አራግፈውባቸው ወደ ኢቆንዮን መጡ።

verses.text_english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.text_amharic: በደቀ መዛሙርትም ደስታና መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባቸው።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.text_amharic: በኢቆንዮንም እንደ ቀድሞ ወደ አይሁድ ምኵራብ ገብተው ከአይሁድና ከግሪክ ሰዎች ብዙ እስኪያምኑ ድረስ ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ያላመኑት አይሁድ ግን የአሕዛብን ልብ በወንድሞች ላይ አነሣሡ አስከፉም።

verses.text_english: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.text_amharic: ምልክትና ድንቅ በእጃቸው ይደረግ ዘንድ እየሰጠ ለጸጋው ቃል ስለ መሰከረው ስለ ጌታ ገልጠው እየተናገሩ ረጅም ወራት ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማውም ሕዝብ ተከፍለው እኵሌቶቹ ከአይሁድ እኵሌቶቹም ከሐዋርያት ጋር ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብና አይሁድ ግን ከአለቆቻቸው ጋር ሊያንገላቱአቸውና ሊወግሩአቸው ባሰቡ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: They were ware of , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.text_amharic: አውቀው ልስጥራንና ደርቤን ወደሚባሉት ወደ ሊቃኦንያ ከተማዎች በእነርሱም ዙሪያ ወዳለው አገር ሸሹ፤

verses.text_english: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወንጌልን ይሰብኩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
verses.text_amharic: በልስጥራንም እግሩ የሰለለ፥ ከእናቱም ማኅፀን ጀምሮ አንካሳ የሆነ፥ ከቶም ሄዶ የማያውቅ አንድ ሰው ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.text_english: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ሰው ጳውሎስ ሲናገር ይሰማ ነበር፤ እርሱም ትኵር ብሎ ተመለከተውና ይድን ዘንድ እምነት እንዳለው ባየ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ድምፅ። ቀጥ ብለህ በእግርህ ቁም አለው። ብድግ ብሎም ተንሥቶ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ጳውሎስ ያደረገውን ባዩ ጊዜ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው በሊቃኦንያ ቋንቋ። አማልክት ሰዎችን መስለው ወደ እኛ ወርደዋል አሉ፤

verses.text_english: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.text_amharic: በርናባስንም ድያ አሉት፤ ጳውሎስንም እርሱ በመናገር ዋና ስለ ነበረ ሄርሜን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማውም ፊት ቤተ መቅደስ ያለው የድያ ካህን ኮርማዎችንና የአበባን አክሊሎች ወደ ደጃፍ አምጥቶ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ሆኖ ሊሠዋላቸው ወደደ።

verses.text_english: when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard , they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.text_amharic: ሐዋርያት በርናባስና ጳውሎስ ግን ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ልብሳቸውን ቀደው ወደ ሕዝቡ መካከል እየጮኹ ሮጡ፥

verses.text_english: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም አሉ። እናንተ ሰዎች፥ ይህን ስለ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? እኛ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ የምንሰማ ሰዎች ነን፥ ከዚህም ከንቱ ነገር ሰማይንና ምድርን ባሕርንም በእነርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ወደ ፈጠረ ወደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ዘወር ትሉ ዘንድ ወንጌልን እንሰብካለን።

verses.text_english: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ባለፉት ትውልዶች አሕዛብን ሁሉ በገዛ ራሳቸው ጐዳና ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተዋቸው።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር መልካም ሥራ እየሠራ፥ ከሰማይ ዝናብን ፍሬ የሚሆንበትንም ወራት ሲሰጠን፥ ልባችንንም በመብልና በደስታ ሲሞላው ራሱን ያለ ምስክር አልተወም።

verses.text_english: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብለው እንዳይሠዉላቸው ሕዝቡን በጭንቅ አስተዉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And there came thither Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ግን ከአንጾኪያና ከኢቆንዮን መጡ፤ ሕዝቡንም አባብለው ጳውሎስን ወገሩ የሞተም መስሎአቸው ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ ጐተቱት።

verses.text_english: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ከበውት ሳሉ፥ ተነስቶ ወደ ከተማ ገባ። በነገውም ከበርናባስ ጋር ወደ ደርቤን ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and Iconium, and Antioch,
Confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: በየቤተ ክርስቲያኑም ሽማግሌዎችን ከሾሙላቸው በኋላ ጦመውም ከጸለዩ በኋላ፥ ላመኑበት ለጌታ አደራ ሰጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.text_amharic: በጲስድያም አልፈው ወደ ጵንፍልያ መጡ፥

verses.text_english: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.text_amharic: በጴርጌንም ቃሉን ከተናገሩ በኋላ ወደ አጣልያ ወረዱ፥

verses.text_english: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ስለ ፈጸሙት ሥራ ለእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ አደራ ወደ ተሰጡበት ወደ አንጾኪያ በመርከብ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: በደረሱም ጊዜ ቤተ ክርስቲያኑን ሰብስበው እግዚአብሔር ከእነርሱ ጋር ያደረገውን ሁሉ ለአሕዛብም የሃይማኖትን ደጅ እንደ ከፈተላቸው ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ከደቀ መዛሙርትም ጋር አያሌ ቀን ተቀመጡ።

verses.text_english: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, , Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶችም ከይሁዳ ወረዱና። እንደ ሙሴ ሥርዓት ካልተገረዛችሁ ትድኑ ዘንድ አትችሉም ብለው ወንድሞችን ያስተምሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱና በጳውሎስ በበርናባስም መካከል ብዙ ጥልና ክርክር በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ስለዚህ ክርክር ጳውሎና በርናባስ ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶች ሌሎች ሰዎች ወደ ሐዋርያት ወደ ሽማግሌዎችም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይወጡ ዘንድ ተቈረጠ።

verses.text_english: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ቤተ ክርስቲያኑም በመንገድ እየረዳቸው እነርሱ የአሕዛብን መመለስ እየተረኩ በፊንቄና በሰማርያ አለፉ፥ ወንድሞችንም ሁሉ እጅግ ደስ አሰኙአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም በደረሱ ጊዜ ቤተ ክርስቲያንና ሐዋርያት ሽማግሌዎችም ተቀበሉአቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ያደረገውን ሁሉ አወሩ።

verses.text_english: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command to keep the law of Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ከፈሪሳውያን ወገን ግን ያመኑት አንዳንዶቹ ተነሥተው። ትገርዙአቸው ዘንድና የሙሴን ሕግ እንዲጠብቁ ታዙአቸው ዘንድ ይገባል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.text_amharic: ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎችም ስለዚህ ነገር ለመማከር ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.text_english: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ክርክርም በኋላ ጴጥሮስ ተነሥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ አሕዛብ ከአፌ የወንጌልን ቃል ሰምተው ያምኑ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር በመጀመሪያው ዘመን ከእናንተ እኔን እንደ መረጠኝ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as unto us;
verses.text_amharic: ልብንም የሚያውቅ አምላክ ለእኛ ደግሞ እንደ ሰጠን መንፈስ ቅዱስን በመስጠት መሰከረላቸው፤

verses.text_english: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸውንም በእምነት ሲያነጻ በእኛና በእነርሱ መካከል አንዳች አልለየም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አባቶቻችንና እኛ ልንሸከመው ያልቻልነውን ቀንበር በደቀ መዛሙርት ጫንቃ ላይ በመጫን እግዚአብሔርን አሁን ስለ ምን ትፈታተናላችሁ?

verses.text_english: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ እንደ እነርሱ ደግሞ እንድን ዘንድ እናምናለን።

verses.text_english: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዝም አሉ፥ በርናባስና ጳውሎስም እግዚአብሔር በእጃቸው በአሕዛብ መካከል ያደረገውን ምልክትና ድንቅ ሁሉ ሲተርኩላቸው ይሰሙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ዝም ካሉ በኋላ ያዕቆብ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ።

verses.text_english: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለስሙ የሚሆንን ወገን ከአሕዛብ ይወስድ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ እንዴት እንደ ጐበኘ ስምዖን ተርኮአል።

verses.text_english: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ጋር የነቢያት ቃል ይሰማማል፥ እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ሥራው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታወቀ ነው።

verses.text_english: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከአሕዛብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የዞሩትን እንዳናስቸግራቸው፥

verses.text_english: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከጣዖት ርኵሰትና ከዝሙት ከታነቀም ከደምም ይርቁ ዘንድ እንድንጽፍላቸው እቈርጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and fornication, and things strangled, and blood.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴስ ከቀደሙት ትውልድ ጀምሮ በሰንበት በሰንበት በምኵራቦቹ ሲያነቡ በየከተማው እርሱን የሚሰብኩ አሉት።

verses.text_english: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች ከቤተ ክርስቲያኑ ሁሉ ጋር ከእነርሱ የተመረጡትን ሰዎች ከጳውሎስና ከበርናባስ ጋር ወደ አንጾኪያ ይልኩ ዘንድ ፈቀዱ፤ እነርሱም በወንድሞች መካከል ዋናዎች ሆነው በርስያን የተባለው ይሁዳና ሲላስ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; , Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ጽፈው በእነርሱ እጅ ላኩ። ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች ወንድሞችም በአንጾኪያና በሶርያ በኪልቅያም ለሚኖሩ ከአሕዛብ ወገን ለሆኑ ወንድሞች ሰላምታ ያቀርባሉ።

verses.text_english: And they wrote by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
verses.text_amharic: ያላዘዝናቸው ሰዎች ከእኛ ወጥተው። ትገረዙ ዘንድና ሕግን ትጠብቁ ዘንድ ይገባችኋል ብለው ልባችሁን እያወኩ በቃል እንዳናወጡአችሁ ስለ ሰማን፥

verses.text_english: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no commandment:
It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.text_amharic: ራሳቸውም ደግሞ በቃላቸው ያንኑ ይነግሩአችሁ ዘንድ ይሁዳንና ሲላስን ልከናል።

verses.text_english: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell the same things by mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ተሰናብተው ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረዱ፥ ሕዝቡንም ሰብስበው ደብዳቤውን ሰጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.text_amharic: ባነበቡትም ጊዜ ከምክሩ የተነሣ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁዳና ሲላስም ደግሞ ነቢያት ነበሩና ወንድሞችን በብዙ ቃል መክረው አጸኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.text_amharic: አያሌ ቀንም ከተቀመጡ በኋላ ከወንድሞች በሰላም ተሰናብተው ወደ ሐዋርያት ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.text_amharic: ሲላስ ግን በዚያ ይኖር ዘንድ ፈቀደ።

verses.text_english: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed .
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስና በርናባስም ከሌሎች ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋር ደግሞ የጌታን ቃል እያስተማሩና ወንጌልን እየሰበኩ በአንጾኪያ ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And after they had tarried a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ጳውሎስ በርናባስን። ተመልሰን የጌታን ቃል በተናገርንበት በየከተማው ሁሉ ወንድሞችን እንጐብኛቸው፥ እንዴት እንዳሉም እንወቅ አለው።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.text_amharic: በርናባስም ማርቆስ የተባለውን ዮሐንስን ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይወስድ ዘንድ አሰበ፤

verses.text_english: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን ይህን ከእነርሱ ጋር ሊወስድ አልፈቀደም፥ ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ከጵንፍልያ ተለይቶ ነበርና፥ ወደ ሥራም ከእነርሱ ጋር አልመጣም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, how they do.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እርስ በርሳቸው እስኪለያዩ ድረስ መከፋፋት ሆነ፥ በርናባስም ማርቆስን ይዞ በመርከብ ወደ ቆጵሮስ ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን ሲላስን መረጠ፥ ወንድሞችም ለእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ አደራ ከሰጡት በኋላ ወጣ፤

verses.text_english: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.text_amharic: አብያተ ክርስትያናትንም እያጸና በሶርያና በኪልቅያ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father a Greek:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደርቤንና ወደ ልስጥራንም ደረሰ። እነሆም፥ በዚያ የአንዲት ያመነች አይሁዳዊት ልጅ ጢሞቴዎስ የሚባል አንድ ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረ፤ አባቱ ግን የግሪክ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም በልስጥራንና በኢቆንዮን ያሉ ወንድሞች መሰከሩለት።

verses.text_english: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ይህ ከእርሱ ጋር ይወጣ ዘንድ ወደደ፥ በእነዚያም ስፍራዎች ስለ ነበሩ አይሁድ ይዞ ገረዘው፤ አባቱ የግሪክ ሰው እንደ ሆነ ሁሉ ያውቁ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: በከተማዎችም ሲዞሩ በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩት ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች የቈረጡትን ሥርዓት ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ሰጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.text_amharic: አብያተ ክርስቲያናትም በሃያማኖት ይበረቱ ነበር፥ በቍጥርም ዕለት ዕለት ይበዙ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
verses.text_amharic: በእስያም ቃሉን እንዳይናገሩ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ስለ ከለከላቸው በፍርግያና በገላትያ አገር አለፉ፤

verses.text_english: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
verses.text_amharic: በሚስያም አንጻር በደረሱ ጊዜ ወደ ቢታንያ ይሄዱ ዘድን ሞከሩ፥ የኢየሱስ መንፈስም አልፈቀደላቸውም፤

verses.text_english: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
verses.text_amharic: በሚስያም አጠገብ አልፈው ወደ ጢሮአዳ ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.text_amharic: ራእይም ለጳውሎስ በሌሊት ታየው፤ አንድ የመቄዶንያ ሰው። ወደ መቄዶንያ ተሻገርና እርዳን እያለ ቆሞ ሲለምነው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ራእዩንም ካየ በኋላ ወዲያው ወደ መቄዶንያ ልንወጣ ፈለግን፥ ወንጌልን እንሰብክላቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጠራን መስሎናልና።

verses.text_english: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next to Neapolis;
verses.text_amharic: ከጢሮአዳም ተነሥተን በቀጥታ ወደ ሳሞትራቄ በነገውም ወደ ናጱሌ በመርከብ ሄድን፤

verses.text_english: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወደ ፊልጵስዩስ ደረስን፤ እርስዋም የመቄዶንያ ከተማ ሆና የወረዳ ዋና ከተማና ቅኝ አገር ናት፤ በዚህችም ከተማ አንዳንድ ቀን እንቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted .
verses.text_amharic: በሰንበት ቀንም ከከተማው በር ውጭ የጸሎት ስፍራ በዚያ መሆኑን ስላሰብን ወደ ወንዝ አጠገብ ወጣን፤ ተቀምጠንም ለተሰበሰቡት ሴቶች ተናገርን።

verses.text_english: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard : whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verses.text_amharic: ከትያጥሮን ከተማም የመጣች ቀይ ሐር ሻጭ እግዚአብሔርን የምታመልክ ልድያ የሚሉአት አንዲት ሴት ትሰማ ነበረች፤ ጳውሎስም የሚናገረውን ታዳምጥ ዘንድ ጌታ ልብዋን ከፈተላት።

verses.text_english: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought , saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide . And she constrained us.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ከቤተ ሰዎችዋ ጋር ከተጠመቀች በኋላ። በጌታ የማምን እንድሆን ከፈረዳችሁልኝ፥ ወደ ቤቴ ገብታችሁ ኑሩ ብላ ለመነችን፤ በግድም አለችን።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ጸሎት ስፍራም ስንሄድ፥ የምዋርተኝነት መንፈስ የነበረባት ለጌቶችዋም እየጠነቈለች ብዙ ትርፍ ታመጣ የነበረች አንዲት ገረድ አገኘችን።

verses.text_english: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ ጳውሎስንና እኛን እየተከተለች። የመዳንን መንገድ የሚነግሩአችሁ እነዚህ ሰዎች የልዑል አምላክ ባሪያዎች ናቸው ብላ ትጮኽ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም እጅግ ቀን አደረገች። ጳውሎስ ግን ተቸገረና ዘወር ብሎ መንፈሱን። ከእርስዋ እንድትወጣ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም አዝሃለሁ አለው፤ በዚያም ሰዓት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew into the marketplace unto the rulers,
verses.text_amharic: ጌቶችዋም የትርፋቸው ተስፋ እንደ ወጣ ባዩ ጊዜ ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን ይዘው ወደ ገበያ በሹማምት ፊት ጐተቱአቸው፤

verses.text_english: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ገዢዎችም አቅርበው። እነዚህ ሰዎች አይሁድ ሆነው ከተማችንን እጅግ ያናውጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም የሮሜ ሰዎች ሆነን እንቀበላቸውና እናደርጋቸው ዘንድ ያልተፈቀደልንን ልማዶች ይናገራሉ አሉ።

verses.text_english: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat .
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም አብረው ተነሡባቸው፥ ገዢዎቹም ልብሳቸውን ገፈው በበትር ይመቱአቸው ዘንድ አዘዙ፤

verses.text_english: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
verses.text_amharic: በብዙም ከደበደቡአቸው በኋላ ወደ ወኅኒ ጣሉአቸው፥ የወኅኒውንም ጠባቂ ተጠንቅቆ እንዲጠብቃቸው አዘዙት።

verses.text_english: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የዚህን ዓይነት ትእዛዝ ተቀብሎ ወደ ውስጠኛው ወኅኒ ጣላቸው፥ እግራቸውንም በግንድ አጣብቆ ጠረቃቸው።

verses.text_english: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈቀ ሌሊት ግን ጳውሎስና ሲላስ እየጸለዩ እግዚአብሔርን በዜማ ያመሰግኑ ነበር፥ እስረኞቹም ያደምጡአቸው ነበር

verses.text_english: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
verses.text_amharic: ድንገትም የወኅኒው መሠረት እስኪናወጥ ድረስ ታላቅ የምድር መንቀጥቀጥ ሆነ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ደጆቹ ሁሉ ተከፈቱ የሁሉም እስራት ተፈታ።

verses.text_english: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
verses.text_amharic: የወኅኒውም ጠባቂ ከእንቅልፉ ነቅቶ የወኅኒው ደጆች ተከፍተው ባየ ጊዜ፥ እስረኞቹ ያመለጡ መስሎት ራሱን ይገድል ዘንድ አስቦ ሰይፉን መዘዘ።

verses.text_english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን በታላቅ ድምፅ። ሁላችን ከዚህ አለንና በራስህ ክፉ ነገር አታድርግ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
verses.text_amharic: መብራትም ለምኖ ወደ ውስጥ ሮጠ፥ እየተንቀጠቀጠም ከጳውሎስና ከሲላስ ፊት ተደፋ፤

verses.text_english: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ውጭም አውጥቶ። ጌቶች ሆይ፥ እድን ዘንድ ምን ማድረግ ይገባኛል? ኣላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እመን አንተና ቤተ ሰዎችህ ትድናላችሁ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱና በቤቱም ላሉት ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
verses.text_amharic: በሌሊትም በዚያች ሰዓት ወስዶ ቍስላቸውን አጠበላቸው፥ ያን ጊዜውንም እርሱ ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ተጠመቀ፤

verses.text_english: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቱም አውጥቶ ማዕድ አቀረበላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስላመነ ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ሐሤት አደረገ።

verses.text_english: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ ገዢዎቹ። እነዚያን ሰዎች ፍታቸው ብለው ሎሌዎቻቸውን ላኩ።

verses.text_english: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
verses.text_amharic: የወኅኒውም ጠባቂ። ትፈቱ ዘንድ ገዢዎቹ ልከዋል፤ እንግዲህ አሁን ወጥታችሁ በሰላም ሂዱ ብሎ ይህን ቃል ለጳውሎስ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን። እኛ የሮሜ ሰዎች ስንሆን ያለ ፍርድ በሕዝብ ፊት ደብድበው በወኅኒ ጣሉን፤ አሁንም በስውር ይጥሉናልን? አይሆንም ራሳቸው ግን መጥተው ያውጡን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
verses.text_amharic: ሎሌዎቹም ይህን ነገር ለገዢዎች ነገሩ። የሮሜ ሰዎችም እንደ ሆኑ በሰሙ ጊዜ ፈሩ፤

verses.text_english: And they came and besought them, and brought out, and desired to depart out of the city.
verses.text_amharic: መጥተውም ማለዱአቸው፥ አውጥተውም ከከተማ ይወጡ ዘንድ ለመኑአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they went out of the prison, and entered into Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
verses.text_amharic: ከወኅኒውም ወጥተው ወደ ልድያ ቤት ገቡ፥ ወንድሞችንም ባዩ ጊዜ አጽናኑአቸውና ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
verses.text_amharic: በአንፊጶልና በአጶሎንያም ካለፉ በኋላ ወደ ተሰሎንቄ መጡ፥ በዚያም የአይሁድ ምኵራብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም እንደ ልማዱ ወደ እነርሱ ገባ፥ ሦስት ሰንበትም ያህል ከእነርሱ ጋር ከመጻሕፍት እየጠቀሰ ይነጋገር ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ሲተረጉምም ክርስቶስ መከራ እንዲቀበልና ከሙታን እንዲነሣ ይገባው ዘንድ እያስረዳ። ይህ እኔ የምሰብክላችሁ ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ነው ይል ነበር።

verses.text_english: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ተረድተው ከሚያመልኩም ከግሪክ ሰዎች ብዙ ከከበሩትም ሴቶች ጥቂቶች ያይደሉ፥ ከጳውሎስና ከሲላስ ጋር ተባበሩ።

verses.text_english: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ግን ቀንተው ከሥራ ፈቶች ክፉ ሰዎችን አመጡ ሕዝብንም ሰብስበው ከተማውን አወኩ፥ ወደ ሕዝብም ያወጡአቸው ዘንድ ፈልገው ወደ ኢያሶን ቤት ቀረቡ፤

verses.text_english: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.text_amharic: ባላገኙአቸውም ጊዜ ኢያሶንንና ከወንድሞች አንዳንዶችን ወደ ከተማው አለቆች ጎትተው። ዓለምን ያወኩ እነዚህ ወደዚህ ደግሞ መጥተዋል፥ ኢያሶንም ተቀብሎአቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሁሉ። ኢየሱስ የሚሉት ሌላ ንጉሥ አለ እያሉ የቄሣርን ትእዛዝ ይቃወማሉ ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡና የከተማውም አለቆች ይህን ነገር በሰሙ ጊዜ ታወኩ፥

verses.text_english: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
verses.text_amharic: ከኢያሶንና ከሌሎቹም ዋስ ተቀብለው ለቀቁአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያውም ወንድሞች ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን በሌሊት ወደ ቤርያ ሰደዱአቸው፥ በደረሱም ጊዜ ወደ አይሁድ ምኵራብ ገቡ፤

verses.text_english: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም በተሰሎንቄ ከሚኖሩት ይልቅ ልበ ሰፊዎች ነበሩና። ነገሩ እንደዚሁ ይሆንን? ብለው ዕለት ዕለት መጻሕፍትን እየመረመሩ ቃሉን በሙሉ ፈቃድ ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ከእነርሱ ብዙ፥ ከግሪኮችም የከበሩት ሴቶችና ወንዶች ጥቂት ያይደሉ፥ አመኑ።

verses.text_english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
verses.text_amharic: በተሰሎንቄ ያሉት አይሁድ ግን ጳውሎስ በቤርያ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ ሰበከ ባወቁ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚያው ደግሞ መጡና ሕዝቡን አወኩ።

verses.text_english: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ወንድሞቹ ወዲያው ጳውሎስን እስከ ባሕር ድረስ ይሄድ ዘንድ ሰደዱት፤ ሲላስና ጢሞቴዎስም በዚያው ቀሩ።

verses.text_english: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስን የሸኙት ግን እስከ አቴና አደረሱት፥ እንደሚቻላቸውም በፍጥነት ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ዘንድ ወደ ሲላስና ወደ ጢሞቴዎስ ትእዛዝ ተቀብለው ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም በአቴና ሲጠብቃቸው ሳለ፥ በከተማው ጣዖት መሙላቱን እየተመለከተ መንፈሱ ተበሳጨበት።

verses.text_english: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በምኵራብ ከአይሁድና እግዚአብሔርን ከሚያመልኩ ሰዎች ጋር በየቀኑም በገበያ ከሚያገኛቸው ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
verses.text_amharic: ከኤፊቆሮስ ወገንና ኢስጦኢኮችም ከተባሉት ፈላስፎች አንዳንዶቹ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገናኙ። አንዳንዶቹም። ይህ ለፍላፊ ምን ሊናገር ይወዳል? አሉ፤ ሌሎችም የኢየሱስንና የትንሣኤውን ወንጌል ስለ ሰበከላቸው። አዲሶችን አማልክት የሚያወራ ይመስላል አሉ።

verses.text_english: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, ?
For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.text_amharic: የአቴና ሰዎች ሁሉና በዚያ የኖሩ እንግዶች አዲስ ነገርን ከመናገርና ከመስማት በቀር በሌላ ጉዳይ አይውሉም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም በአርዮስፋጎስ መካከል ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። የአቴና ሰዎች ሆይ፥ እናንተ በሁሉ ነገር አማልክትን እጅግ እንደምትፈሩ እመለከታለሁ።

verses.text_english: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
verses.text_amharic: የምታመልኩትን እየተመለከትሁ ሳልፍ። ለማይታወቅ አምላክ የሚል ጽሕፈት ያለበትን መሠዊያ ደግሞ አግኝቼአለሁና። እንግዲህ ይህን ሳታውቁ የምታመልኩትን እኔ እነግራችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለሙንና በእርሱ ያለውን ሁሉ የፈጠረ አምላክ እርሱ የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ ነውና እጅ በሠራው መቅደስ አይኖርም፤

verses.text_english: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሕይወትንና እስትንፋስን ሁሉንም ለሁሉ ይሰጣልና አንዳች እንደሚጎድለው በሰው እጅ አይገለገልም።

verses.text_english: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ከባለ ቅኔዎች አንዳንዶች ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ዘመዶቹ ነንና ብለው እንደ ተናገሩ፥ በእርሱ ሕያዋን ነንና እንንቀሳቀሳለን እንኖርማለን።

verses.text_english: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔር ዘመዶች ከሆንን፥ አምላክ በሰው ብልሃትና አሳብ የተቀረጸውን ወርቅ ወይም ብር ወይም ድንጋይ እንዲመስል እናስብ ዘንድ አይገባንም።

verses.text_english: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር ያለማወቅን ወራት አሳልፎ አሁን በየቦታቸው ንስሐ ይገቡ ዘንድ ሰውን ሁሉ ያዛል፤

verses.text_english: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
verses.text_amharic: ቀን ቀጥሮአልና፥ በዚያም ቀን ባዘጋጀው ሰው እጅ በዓለሙ ላይ በጽድቅ ሊፈርድ አለው፤ ስለዚህም እርሱን ከሙታን በማስነሣቱ ሁሉን አረጋግጦአል።

verses.text_english: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verses.text_amharic: የሙታንንም ትንሣኤ በሰሙ ጊዜ እኵሌቶቹ አፌዙበት፥ እኵሌቶቹ ግን። ስለዚህ ነገር ሁለተኛ እንሰማሃለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by man whom he hath ordained; he hath given assurance unto all , in that he hath raised him from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ጳውሎስ ከመካከላቸው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this .
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶች ወንዶች ግን ተባብረው አመኑ፤ ከእነርሱ ደግሞ በአርዮስፋጎስ ያለው የፍርድ ቤት ፈራጅ ዲዮናስዮስ ደማሪስ የሚሉአትም አንዲት ሴት ሌሎችም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ጳውሎስ ከአቴና ወጥቶ ወደ ቆሮንቶስ መጣ።

verses.text_english: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
verses.text_amharic: በወገኑም የጳንጦስ ሰው የሚሆን አቂላ የሚሉትን አንድ አይሁዳዊ አገኘ፤ እርሱም ከጥቂት ጊዜ በፊት ከሚስቱ ከጵርስቅላ ጋር ከኢጣልያ መጥቶ ነበር፥ አይሁድ ከሮሜ ይወጡ ዘንድ ቀላውዴዎስ አዞ ነበርና፤ ወደ እነርሱ ቀረበ፥

verses.text_english: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራቸውም አንድ ስለ ነበረ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ተቀምጦ በአንድ ላይ ሠሩ፤ ሥራቸው ድንኳን መስፋት ነበረና።

verses.text_english: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
verses.text_amharic: በየሰንበቱም ሁሉ በምኵራብ ይነጋገር ነበር፥ አይሁድንና የግሪክንም ሰዎች ያስረዳ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ሲላስና ጢሞቴዎስም ከመቄዶንያ በወረዱ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስ ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ለአይሁድ እየመሰከረ ለቃሉ ይተጋ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook raiment, and said unto them, Your blood upon your own heads; I clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በተቃወሙትና በተሳደቡ ጊዜ፥ ልብሱን እያራገፈ። ደማችሁ በራሳችሁ ነው፤ እኔ ንጹሕ ነኝ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ወደ አሕዛብ እሄዳለሁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain house, named Justus, that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወጥቶ ኢዮስጦስ ወደሚባል እግዚአብሔርን ወደሚያመልክ ሰው ቤት ገባ ቤቱም በምኩራብ አጠገብ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
verses.text_amharic: የምኵራብ አለቃ ቀርስጶስም ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር በጌታ አመነ፥ ከቆሮንቶስ ሰዎችም ብዙ በሰሙ ጊዜ አምነው ተጠመቁ።

verses.text_english: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
verses.text_amharic: በመካከላቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እያስተማረ ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ተቀመጠ።

verses.text_english: And he continued a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.text_amharic: ጋልዮስም በአካይያ አገረ ገዥ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ አይሁድ በአንድ ልብ ሆነው በጳውሎስ ላይ ተነሡ፥ ወደ ፍርድ ወንበርም አምጥተው።

verses.text_english: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሕግን ተቃውሞ እግዚአብሔርን ያመልኩት ዘንድ ሰዎችን ያባብላል አሉ።

verses.text_english: Saying, This persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም አፉን ሊከፍት ባሰበ ጊዜ፥ ጋልዮስ አይሁድን። አይሁድ ሆይ፥ ዓመፅ ወይም ክፉ በደል በሆነ እንድታገሣችሁ በተገባኝ፤

verses.text_english: And when Paul was now about to open mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ቃልና ስለ ስሞች ስለ ሕጋችሁም የምትከራከሩ ከሆነ ግን፥ ራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ እኔ በዚህ ነገር ፈራጅ እሆን ዘንድ አልፈቅድምና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But if it be a question of words and names, and your law, look ye ; for I will be no judge of such .
verses.text_amharic: ከፍርድ ወንበርም ፊት አስወጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
verses.text_amharic: የግሪክ ሰዎችም ሁሉ የምኩራብ አለቃ ሶስቴንስን ይዘው በወንበሩ ፊት መቱት፤ በእነዚህም ነገሮች ጋልዮስ ግድ የለውም ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ ጳውሎስ እጅግ ቀን ተቀምጦ ወንድሞቹንም ተሰናብቶ በመርከብ ወደ ሶርያ ሄደ፤ ስለትም ነበረበትና ራሱን በክንክራኦስ ተላጨ፤ ጵርስቅላና አቂላም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And Paul tarried yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኤፌሶንም በደረሱ ጊዜ እነዚያን ከዚያ ተዋቸው፥ ራሱ ግን ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ ከአይሁድ ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ብዙ ጊዜ እንዲቀመጥላቸው ሲለምኑት እሺ አላለም፤

verses.text_english: When they desired to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሲሰናበታቸው። የሚመጣውን በዓል በኢየሩሳሌም አደርግ ዘንድ ይገባኛል እግዚአብሔር ቢፈቅድ ግን ወደ እናንተ ደግሞ እመለሳለሁ አላቸው። ከኤፌሶንም በመርከብ ተነሣ።

verses.text_english: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቂሣርያም በደረሰ ጊዜ ወጥቶ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ ከሰጠ በኋላ ወደ አንጾኪያ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
verses.text_amharic: ጥቂት ቀንም ቆይቶ ወጣ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትንም ሁሉ እያጸና በገላትያ አገርና በፍርግያ በተራ አለፈ።

verses.text_english: And after he had spent some time , he departed, and went over the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.text_amharic: በወገኑም የእስክንድርያ ሰው የሆነ ነገር አዋቂ የነበረ አጵሎስ የሚሉት አንድ አይሁዳዊ ሰው ወደ ኤፌሶን ወረደ፤ እርሱም በመጻሕፍት እውቀት የበረታ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ የጌታን መንገድ የተማረ ነበረ፥ የዮሐንስንም ጥምቀት ብቻ አውቆ በመንፈስ ሲቃጠል ስለ ኢየሱስ ይናገርና በትክክል ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.text_english: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በምኵራብ ገልጦ ይናገር ጀመር። ጵርስቅላና አቂላም በሰሙት ጊዜ፥ ወስደው የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ከፊት ይልቅ በትክክል ገለጡለት።

verses.text_english: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ወደ አካይያ ማለፍ በፈቀደ ጊዜ፥ ወንድሞቹ አጸናኑት፥ ይቀበሉትም ዘንድ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርት ጻፉለት፤ በደረሰም ጊዜ አምነው የነበሩትን በጸጋ እጅግ ይጠቅማቸው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ከመጻሕፍት እየገለጠ ለአይሁድ በሁሉ ፊት በጽኑ ያስረዳቸው ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
verses.text_amharic: አጵሎስም በቆሮንቶስ ሳለ ጳውሎስ በላይኛው አገር አልፎ ወደ ኤፌሶን መጣ፥

verses.text_english: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንድ ደቀ መዛሙርትንም አገኘ። ባመናችሁ ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበላችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አልተቀበልንም መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዳለ ስንኳ አልሰማንም አሉት።

verses.text_english: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
verses.text_amharic: እንኪያ በምን ተጠመቃችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም። ዮሐንስስ ከእርሱ በኋላ በሚመጣው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ያምኑ ዘንድ ለሕዝብ እየተናገረ በንስሐ ጥምቀት አጠመቀ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: When they heard , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም ተጠመቁ፤

verses.text_english: And when Paul had laid hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም እጁን በጫነባቸው ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ወረደባቸው በልሳኖችም ተናገሩ፥ ትንቢትም ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And all the men were about twelve.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎቹም ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት ያህሉ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምኵራብም ገብቶ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እየተነጋገረና እያስረዳቸው ሦስት ወር ያህል በግልጥ ይናገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶች ግን እልከኞች ሆነው በሕዝብ ፊት መንገዱን እየሰደቡ ባላመኑ ጊዜ፥ ከእነርሱ ርቆ ደቀ መዛሙርትን ለየ፥ ጢራኖስም በሚሉት በትምህርት ቤት ዕለት ዕለት ይነጋገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.text_amharic: በእስያም የኖሩት ሁሉ አይሁድም የግሪክ ሰዎችም የጌታን ቃል እስኪሰሙ ድረስ ሁለት ዓመት ያህል እንዲህ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም በጳውሎስ እጅ የሚያስገርም ተአምራት ያደርግ ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ከአካሉ ጨርቅ ወይም ልብስ ወደ ድውዮች ይወስዱ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verses.text_amharic: ደዌያቸውም ይለቃቸው ነበር ክፉዎች መናፍስትም ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
verses.text_amharic: አጋንንትንም እያወጡ ይዞሩ ከነበሩት አይሁድ አንዳንዶች። ጳውሎስ በሚሰብከው በኢየሱስ እናምላችኋለን እያሉ ክፉዎች መናፍስት ባሉባቸው ላይ የጌታን የኢየሱስን ስም ይጠሩባቸው ዘንድ ሞከሩ።

verses.text_english: And there were seven sons of Sceva, a Jew, chief of the priests, which did so.
verses.text_amharic: የካህናትም አለቃ ለሆነ አስቄዋ ለሚሉት ለአንድ አይሁዳዊ ይህን ያደረጉ ሰባት ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
verses.text_amharic: ክፉው መንፈስ ግን መልሶ። ኢየሱስንስ አውቀዋለሁ ጳውሎስንም አውቀዋለሁ፤ እናንተሳ እነማን ናችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.text_amharic: ክፉው መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው ዘለለባቸው ቆስለውም ከዚያ ቤት ዕራቁታቸውን እስኪሸሹ ድረስ በረታባቸው አሸነፋቸውም።

verses.text_english: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በኤፌሶን በሚኖሩት ሁሉ በአይሁድና በግሪክ ሰዎች ዘንድ የታወቀ ሆነ፥ በሁላቸውም ላይ ፍርሃት ወደቀባቸው፥ የጌታም የኢየሱስ ስም ተከበረ፤

verses.text_english: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
verses.text_amharic: አምነውም ከነበሩት እጅግ ሰዎች ያደረጉትን እየተናዘዙና እየተናገሩ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all : and they counted the price of them, and found fifty thousand of silver.
verses.text_amharic: ከአስማተኞችም ብዙዎቹ መጽሐፋቸውን ሰብስበው በሰው ሁሉ ፊት አቃጠሉት፤ ዋጋውም ቢታሰብ አምሳ ሺህ ብር ሆኖ ተገኘ።

verses.text_english: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም የጌታ ቃል በኃይል ያድግና ያሸንፍ ነበር።

verses.text_english: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ጳውሎስ። ወደዚያ ደርሼ ሮሜን ደግሞ አይ ዘንድ ይገባኛል ብሎ በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ አልፎ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲሄድ በመንፈስ አሰበ።

verses.text_english: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚያገለግሉትም ሁለቱን ጢሞቴዎስንና ኤርስጦንን ወደ መቄዶንያ ልኮ ራሱ በእስያ ጥቂት ቀን ቆየ።

verses.text_english: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ስለዚህ መንገድ ብዙ ሁከት ሆነ።

verses.text_english: For a certain named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
verses.text_amharic: ብር ሠሪ የሆነ ድሜጥሮስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው የአርጤምስን ቤተ መቅደስ ምስሎች በብር እየሠራ ለአንጥረኞች እጅግ ትርፍ ያገኝ ነበርና፤

verses.text_english: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም ይህንም የሚመስለውን ሥራ የሠሩትን ሰብስቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ትርፋችን በዚህ ሥራ እንደ ሆነ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ጳውሎስ። በእጅ የተሠሩቱ አማልክት አይደሉም ብሎ፥ በኤፌሶን ብቻ ሳይሆን ከጥቂት ክፍል በቀር በእስያ ሁሉ ብዙ ሕዝብን እንደ አስረዳና እንደ አሳተ አይታችኋል ሰምታችሁማል።

verses.text_english: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራችንም እንዲናቅ ብቻ አይደለም፥ እስያ ሁሉ ዓለሙም የሚያመልካት የታላቂቱ አምላክ የአርጤምስ መቅደስ ምናምን ሆኖ እንዲቆጠር እንጂ፥ ታላቅነትዋም ደግሞ እንዳይሻር ያስፈራል።

verses.text_english: And when they heard , they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ ቍጣ ሞላባቸው። የኤፌሶን አርጤምስ ታላቅ ናት እያሉም ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማውም በሙሉው ተደባለቀ፥ የመቄዶንያም ሰዎች የጳውሎስን ጓደኞች ጋይዮስንና አርስጥሮኮስን ከእነርሱ ጋር ነጥቀው በአንድ ልብ ሆነው ወደ ጨዋታ ስፍራ ሮጡ።

verses.text_english: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ወደ ሕዝቡ ይገባ ዘንድ በፈቀደ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርት ከለከሉት።

verses.text_english: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
verses.text_amharic: ከእስያም አለቆች ወዳጆቹ የሆኑት አንዳንዶች ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ልከው ወደ ጨዋታ ስፍራ ራሱን እንዳይሰጥ ለመኑት።

verses.text_english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያና ወዲህም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር፤ በጉባኤው ድብልቅልቅ ሆኖ የሚበልጡት ስንኳ ስለ ምን እንደተሰበሰቡ አላወቁም ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ሲያቀርቡት፥ እስክንድሮስን ከሕዝቡ መካከል ወደ ፊት ገፉት፤ እስክንድሮስም በእጁ ጠቅሶ በሕዝብ ፊት እንዲምዋገትላቸው ወደደ።

verses.text_english: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁዳዊ ግን እንደ ሆነ ባወቁ ጊዜ፥ ሁሉ በአንድ ድምፅ። የኤፌሶን አርጤምስ ታላቅ ናት እያሉ ሁለት ሰዓት ያህል ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the which fell down from Jupiter?
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱም ጸሐፊ ሕዝቡን ጸጥ አሰኝቶ እንዲህ አለ። የኤፌሶን ሰዎች ሆይ፥ የኤፌሶን ከተማ ለታላቂቱ አርጤምስ ከሰማይም ለወረደው ጣዖትዋ የመቅደስ ጠባቂ መሆንዋን የማያውቅ ሰው ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም የሚክደው ከሌለ፥ ጸጥ እንድትሉና አንዳች በችኮላ እንዳታደርጉ ይገባል።

verses.text_english: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.text_amharic: የመቅደስን ዕቃ ያልሰረቁ አምላካችንንም ያልሰደቡ እነዚህን ሰዎች አምጥታችኋቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
verses.text_amharic: ድሜጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉት አንጥረኞች ግን በሰው ላይ ነገር እንዳላቸው፥ የመጋቢያ ቀንና አገረ ገዢዎች አሉ፤ እርስ በርሳቸው ይምዋገቱ።

verses.text_english: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሌላ ነገር እንደ ሆነ ግን አንዳች ብትፈልጉ፥ በተደነገገው ጉባኤ ይፈታል።

verses.text_english: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ ስለ ተደረገው። ሁከት ነው ሲሉ እንዳይከሱን ያስፈራልና፤ ስለዚህም ስብሰባ ምላሽ መስጠት አንችልም፥ ምክንያት የለምና።

verses.text_english: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ ጉባኤውን ፈታው።

verses.text_english: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto the disciples, and embraced , and departed for to go into Macedonia.
verses.text_amharic: ሁከቱም ከቀረ በኋላ ጳውሎስ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አስመጥቶ መከራቸው፥ ተሰናብቶአቸውም ወደ መቄዶንያ ይሄድ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
verses.text_amharic: ያንም አገር እያለፈ በብዙ ቃል ከመከራቸው በኋላ ወደ ግሪክ አገር መጣ።

verses.text_english: And abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሦስት ወር ተቀምጦ ወደ ሶርያ በመርከብ ሊሄድ ባሰበ ጊዜ፥ አይሁድ ሴራ ስላደረጉበት በመቄዶንያ አልፎ ይመለስ ዘንድ ቆረጠ።

verses.text_english: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
verses.text_amharic: የሸኙትም የቤርያው ሱሲጳጥሮስ ከተሰሎንቄ ሰዎችም አርስጥሮኮስና ሲኮንዱስ የደርቤኑም ጋይዮስና ጢሞቴዎስ የእስያ ሰዎችም ቲኪቆስ ጥሮፊሞስም ነበሩ፤

verses.text_english: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ወደ ፊታችን አልፈው በጢሮአዳ ቆዩን።

verses.text_english: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን ከቂጣ በዓል ቀን በኋላ ከፊልጵስዩስ በመርከብ ተነሥተን በአምስት ቀን ወደ ጢሮአዳ ወደ እነርሱ ደረስንና በዚያ ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጥን።

verses.text_english: And upon the first of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳምንቱም በመጀመሪያ ቀን እንጀራ ለመቁረስ ተሰብስበን ሳለን፥ ጳውሎስ በነገው ሊሄድ ስላሰበ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይነጋገር ነበር፥ እስከ መንፈቀ ሌሊትም ነገሩን አስረዘመ።

verses.text_english: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
verses.text_amharic: ተሰብስበንም በነበርንበት ሰገነት እጅግ መብራት ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
verses.text_amharic: አውጤኪስ የሚሉትም አንድ ጎበዝ በመስኮት ተቀምጦ ታላቅ እንቅልፍ አንቀላፍቶ ነበር፤ ጳውሎስም ነገርን ባስረዘመ ጊዜ እንቅልፍ ከብዶት ከሦስተኛው ደርብ ወደ ታች ወደቀ፥ ሞቶም አነሡት።

verses.text_english: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ወርዶ በላዩ ወደቀ፥ አቅፎም። ነፍሱ አለችበትና አትንጫጩ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
verses.text_amharic: ወጥቶም እንጀራ ቆርሶም በላ፤ ብዙ ጊዜም እስኪነጋ ድረስ ተነጋገረ እንዲህም ሄደ።

verses.text_english: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
verses.text_amharic: ብላቴናውንም ደኅና ሆኖ ወሰዱት እጅግም ተጽናኑ።

verses.text_english: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን ጳውሎስን ከዚያ እንቀበለው ዘንድ ስላለን ወደ መርከብ ቀድመን ሄድንና ወደ አሶን ተነሣን፤ እርሱ በመሬት ይሄድ ዘንድ ስላሰበ እንደዚህ አዞ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
verses.text_amharic: በአሶንም ባገኘን ጊዜ ተቀብለነው ወደ ሚጢሊኒ መጣን፤

verses.text_english: And we sailed thence, and came the next over against Chios; and the next we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next we came to Miletus.
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱም ከዚያ በባሕር ተነሥተን በኪዩ ፊት ለፊት ደረስን፥ በነገውም ወደ ሳሞን ተሻገርን በትሮጊሊዮም አድረን በማግሥቱ ወደ ሚሊጢን መጣን።

verses.text_english: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ በእስያ እጅግ እንዳይቀመጥ ኤፌሶንን ይተው ዘንድ ቆርጦ ነበርና ቢቻለውም በዓለ ኀምሳን በኢየሩሳሌም ይውል ዘንድ ይቸኩል ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
verses.text_amharic: ከሚሊጢንም ወደ ኤፌሶን ልኮ የቤተክርስቲያንን ሽማግሌዎች አስጠራቸው፤

verses.text_english: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
how I kept back nothing that was profitable , but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በመንፈስ ታስሬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ፥ በዚያም የሚያገኘኝ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም፤

verses.text_english: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስ። እስራትና መከራ ይቆይሃል ብሎ በየከተማው ሁሉ ይመሰክርልኛል።

verses.text_english: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሩጫዬንና ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ የተቀበልሁትን አገልግሎት እርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ወንጌልን መመስከር እፈጽም ዘንድ ነፍሴን በእኔ ዘንድ እንደማትከብር እንደ ከንቱ ነገር እቆጥራለሁ።

verses.text_english: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እየሰበክሁ በመካከላችሁ የዞርሁ ሁላችሁ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ፊቴን እንዳትዩ አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እኔ ከሰው ሁሉ ደም ንጹሕ እንደ ሆንሁ ዛሬ በዚች ቀን እመሰክርላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ምክር ሁሉ ነግሬአችኋለሁና፥ ምንም አላስቀረሁባችሁም።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I pure from the blood of all .
verses.text_amharic: በገዛ ደሙ የዋጃትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ትጠብቁአት ዘንድ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እናንተን ጳጳሳት አድርጎ ለሾመባት ለመንጋው ሁሉና ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሦስት ዓመት ሌሊትና ቀን በእንባ እያንዳንዳችሁን ከመገሠጽ እንዳላቋረጥሁ እያሰባችሁ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ለእግዚአብሔርና ያንጻችሁ ዘንድ በቅዱሳንም ሁሉ መካከል ርስትን ይሰጣችሁ ዘንድ ለሚችል ለጸጋው ቃል አደራ ሰጥቻችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
verses.text_amharic: ከማንም ብር ወይም ወርቅ ወይም ልብስ አልተመኘሁም፤

verses.text_english: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ እጆቼ በሚያስፈልገኝ ነገር ለእኔና ከእኔ ጋር ላሉት እንዳገለገሉ እናንተ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ እየደከማችሁ ድውዮችን ልትረዱና እርሱ ራሱ። ከሚቀበል ይልቅ የሚሰጥ ብፁዕ ነው እንዳለ የጌታን የኢየሱስን ቃል ልታስቡ ይገባችሁ ዘንድ በሁሉ አሳየኋችሁ።

verses.text_english: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ ተንበርክኮ ከሁላቸው ጋር ጸለየ።

verses.text_english: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉም እጅግ አለቀሱ፥ ጳውሎስንም አንገቱን አቅፈው ይስሙት ነበር፤

verses.text_english: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ፊቴን አታዩም ስላላቸው ነገር እጅግ አዘኑ። እስከ መርከብም ድረስ ሸኙት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ተለይተን ተነሣን፤ በቀጥታም ሄደን ወደ ቆስ በነገውም ወደ ሩድ ከዚያም ወደ ጳጥራ መጣን፤

verses.text_english: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊንቄም የሚሻገር መርከብ አግኝተን ገባንና ተነሣን።

verses.text_english: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
verses.text_amharic: ቆጵሮስንም ባየናት ጊዜ በስተ ግራችን ተውናት ወደ ሶርያም ሄደን ወደ ጢሮስ ደረስን፥ መርከቡ ሸክሙን በዚያ የሚያራግፍ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ደቀ መዛሙርትንም ባገኘን ጊዜ በዚያ ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጥን፤ እነርሱም ጳውሎስን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዳይወጣ በመንፈስ አሉት።

verses.text_english: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
verses.text_amharic: ጊዜውንም በፈጸምን ጊዜ ወጥተን ሄድን፤ ሁላቸውም ከሚስቶቻቸውና ከልጆቻቸው ጋር እስከ ከተማው ውጭ ድረስ ሸኙን፥ በባሕሩም ዳር ተንበርክከን ጸለይን፤

verses.text_english: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችንም ተሰነባብተን ወደ መርከብ ወጣን፥ እነዚያም ወደ ቤታቸው ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: And when we had finished course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም የባሕሩን መንገድ ጨርሰን ከጢሮስ ወደ አካ ደረስን፥ ለወንድሞችም ሰላምታ ሰጥተን ከእነርሱ ዘንድ አንድ ቀን ተቀመጥን።

verses.text_english: And the next we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was of the seven; and abode with him.
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም ወጥተን ወደ ቂሣርያ መጣን፥ ከሰባቱም አንድ በሚሆን በወንጌላዊው ፊልጶስ ቤት ገብተን በእርሱ ዘንድ ተቀመጥን።

verses.text_english: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም ትንቢት የሚናገሩ አራት ደናግል ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.text_english: And as we tarried many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
verses.text_amharic: አያሌ ቀንም ተቀምጠን ሳለን ነቢይ የነበረ አጋቦስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ከይሁዳ ወረደ።

verses.text_english: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver into the hands of the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እኛም መጣና የጳውሎስን መታጠቂያ ወስዶ የገዛ እጁንና እግሩን አስሮ። እንዲሁ መንፈስ ቅዱስ። ይህ መታጠቂያ ያለውን ሰው አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌም እንደዚህ ያስሩታል በአሕዛብም እጅ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል ይላል አለ።

verses.text_english: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም በሰማን ጊዜ እኛም በዚያ የሚኖሩትም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዳይወጣ ለመንነው።

verses.text_english: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን መልሶ። እያለቀሳችሁ ልቤንም እየሰበራችሁ ምን ማድረጋችሁ ነው? እኔ ስለ ጌታ ስለ ኢየሱስ ስም በኢየሩሳሌም ለመሞት እንኳ ተሰናድቼአለሁ እንጂ ለእስራት ብቻ አይደለም አለ።

verses.text_english: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
verses.text_amharic: ምክርንም ሊቀበል እምቢ ባለ ጊዜ። የጌታ ፈቃድ ይሁን ብለን ዝም አልን።

verses.text_english: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ቀን በኋላ ተዘጋጅተን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣን።

verses.text_english: There went with us also of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
verses.text_amharic: በቂሣርያም ከነበሩ ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዳንዶች ደግሞ ከእኛ ጋር መጡ፥ እነርሱም ወደምናድርበት ወደ ቀደመው ደቀ መዝሙር ወደ ቆጵሮሱ ምናሶን ወደሚሉት ቤት መሩን።

verses.text_english: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በደረስን ጊዜ ወንድሞች በደስታ ተቀበሉን።

verses.text_english: And the following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም ጳውሎስ ከእኛ ጋር ወደ ያዕቆብ ዘንድ ገባ ሽማግሌዎችም ሁሉ መጡ።

verses.text_english: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
verses.text_amharic: ሰላምታም ካቀረበላቸው በኋላ በእርሱ ማገልገል እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ መካከል ያደረገውን በእያንዳንዱ ተረከላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they heard , they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም በሰሙ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ አሉትም። ወንድም ሆይ፥ በአይሁድ መካከል አምነው የነበሩት ስንት አእላፋት እንደ ሆኑ ታያለህ፤ ሁላቸውም ለሕግ የሚቀኑ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise children, neither to walk after the customs.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቻቸውንም እንዳይገርዙ በሥርዓትም እንዳይሄዱ ብለህ በአሕዛብ መካከል ያሉት አይሁድ ሁሉ ሙሴን ይክዱ ዘንድ እንድታስተምር ስለ አንተ ነግረዋቸዋል።

verses.text_english: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ምን ይሁን? የአንተን መምጣት ይሰማሉና ብዙዎች የግድ ሳይሰበሰቡ አይቀሩም።

verses.text_english: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ይህን የምንልህን አድርግ፤ ስለት ያለባቸው አራት ሰዎች በእኛ ዘንድ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህንም ይዘህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ንጻ፥ ራሳቸውንም እንዲላጩ ገንዘብ ክፈልላቸው፤ ሁሉም ስለ አንተ የተማሩት ከንቱ እንደ ሆነና አንተ ራስህ ደግሞ ሕጉን እየጠበቅህ በሥርዓት እንድትመላለስ ያውቃሉ።

verses.text_english: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
verses.text_amharic: አምነው ስለ ነበሩ አሕዛብ ግን ለጣዖት ከተሠዋ ከደምም ከታነቀም ከዝሙትም ነፍሳቸውን እንዲጠብቁ ፈርደን እኛ ጽፈንላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ ሰዎችን ይዞ በማግሥቱ ከእነርሱ ጋር እየነጻ፥ መንጻታቸውን የሚፈጽሙበትን ቀን አስታውቆ ወደ መቅደስ ገባ። በዚያም ቀን ስለ እያንዳንዳቸው መሥዋዕትን አቀረቡ።

verses.text_english: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
verses.text_amharic: በፊት የኤፌሶኑን ጥሮፊሞስን ከእርሱ ጋር በከተማ አይተውት ነበርና ጳውሎስም ወደ መቅደስ ያገባው መስሎአቸው ነው።

verses.text_english: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
verses.text_amharic: ከተማውም ሁሉ ታወከ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ ጳውሎስንም ይዘው ከመቅደስ ውጭ ጎተቱት፥ ወዲያውም ደጆች ተዘጉ።

verses.text_english: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
verses.text_amharic: ሊገድሉትም ሲፈልጉ። ኢየሩሳሌም ፈጽማ ታወከች የሚል ወሬ ወደ ጭፍራው ሻለቃ ወጣ፤

verses.text_english: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ያን ጊዜ ወታደሮችን ከመቶ አለቆች ጋር ይዞ እየሮጠ ወረደባቸው፤ እነርሱም የሻለቃውንና ወታደሮችን ባዩ ጊዜ ጳውሎስን መምታት ተዉ።

verses.text_english: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም የሻለቃው ቀርቦ ያዘውና በሁለት ሰንሰለት ይታሰር ዘንድ አዞ ማን እንደ ሆነና ምን እንዳደረገ ጠየቀ።

verses.text_english: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
verses.text_amharic: ሕዝቡም እኵሌቶቹ እንዲህ እኵሌቶቹም እንዲያ እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር፤ ስለ ጫጫታውም እርግጡን ማወቅ ባልተቻለ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ወታደሮች ሰፈር ይወስዱት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ደረጃውም በደረሰ ጊዜ ስለ ሕዝቡ ግፊያ ወታደሮች እንዲሸከሙት ሆነ፤

verses.text_english: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሕዝብ። አስወግደው እያሉና እየጮኹ ይከተሉ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰፈርም ሊያገቡት በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስ የሻለቃውን። አንድ ነገር ብነግርህ ትፈቅዳለህን? አለው። እርሱም። የግሪክ ቋንቋ ታውቃለህን?

verses.text_english: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ከዚህ ዘመን አስቀድሞ ከነፍሰ ገዳዮቹ አራቱን ሺህ ሰዎች አሸፍተህ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ያወጣህ የግብፅ ሰው አይደለህምን? አለ።

verses.text_english: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን። እኔስ አይሁዳዊ በኪልቅያ ያለው የጠርሴስ ሰው ሆኜ ስመ ጥር በሆነ ከተማ የምኖር ነኝ፤ ለሕዝቡ እናገር ዘንድ እንድትፈቅድልኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: But Paul said, I am a man a Jew of Tarsus, in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
verses.text_amharic: በፈቀደለትም ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በደረጃው ላይ ቆሞ በእጁ ወደ ሕዝቡ ጠቀሰ እጅግም ጸጥታ በሆነ ጊዜ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ እየተናገረ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.text_english: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence now unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ወንድሞች አባቶችም፥ አሁን ለእናንተ ነገሬን ስገልጥ ስሙኝ።

verses.text_english: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
