verses.text_amharic: በዕብራይስጥም ቋንቋ ሲናገር በሰሙ ጊዜ ከፊት ይልቅ ዝም አሉ። እርሱም አለ።

verses.text_english: I am verily a man a Jew, born in Tarsus, in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የኪልቅያ በምትሆን በጠርሴስ የተወለድሁ፥ በዚችም ከተማ በገማልያል እግር አጠገብ ያደግሁ፥ የአባቶችንም ሕግ ጠንቅቄ የተማርሁ፥ ዛሬውንም እናንተ ሁሉ እንድትሆኑ ለእግዚአብሔር ቀናተኛ የሆንሁ አይሁዳዊ ሰው ነኝ

verses.text_english: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
verses.text_amharic: ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም እያሰርሁ ወደ ወኅኒም አሳልፌ እየሰጠሁ ይህን መንገድ እስከ ሞት ድረስ አሳደድሁ።

verses.text_english: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ሊቀ ካህናቱ ደግሞ ሽማግሌዎቹም ሁሉ ይመሰክሩልኛል፤ ከእነርሱ ደግሞ መልእክትን ለወንድሞቻቸው ተቀብዬ፥ በደማስቆ ያሉትን ደግሞ ታስረው እንዲቀጡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ላመጣ ወደዚያ እሄድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
verses.text_amharic: ስሄድም ወደ ደማስቆ በቀረብሁ ጊዜ፥ ቀትር ሲሆን ድንገት ከሰማይ ታላቅ ብርሃን በዙሪያዬ አንጸባረቀ፤

verses.text_english: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ላይ ወድቄ። ሳውል ሳውል፥ ስለ ምን ታሳድደኛለህ? የሚለኝን ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም መልሼ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ማን ነህ? አልሁ። እርሱም። አንተ የምታሳድደኝ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ እኔ ነኝ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር የነበሩትም ብርሃኑን አይተው ፈሩ፥ የሚናገረኝን የእርሱን ድምፅ ግን አልሰሙም።

verses.text_english: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግ? አልሁት። ጌታም። ተነሥተህ ወደ ደማስቆ ሂድና ታደርገው ዘንድ ስለ ታዘዘው ሁሉን በዚያ ይነግሩሃል አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ብርሃንም ክብር የተነሣ ማየት ባይሆንልኝ ከእኔ ጋር የነበሩት ሰዎች እጄን ይዘው እየመሩኝ ወደ ደማስቆ ደረስሁ።

verses.text_english: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt ,
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የኖሩት አይሁድ ሁሉ የመሰከሩለት እንደ ሕጉም በጸሎት የተጋ ሐናንያ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ነበረ።

verses.text_english: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ወደ እኔ መጥቶ በአጠገቤም ቆሞ። ወንድሜ ሳውል ሆይ፥ እይ አለኝ። እኔም ያን ጊዜውን ወደ እርሱ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አለኝ። የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ፈቃዱን ታውቅ ዘንድና ጻድቁን ታይ ዘንድ ከአፉም ድምፅን ትሰማ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ መርጦሃል

verses.text_english: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
verses.text_amharic: ባየኸውና በሰማኸው በሰው ሁሉ ፊት ምስክር ትሆንለታለህና።

verses.text_english: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንስ ለምን ትዘገያለህ? ተነሣና ስሙን እየጠራህ ተጠመቅ ከኃጢአትህም ታጠብ።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ከተመለሱ በኋላ በመቅደስ ስጸልይ ተመስጦ መጣብኝ፥

verses.text_english: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ፍጠን ከኢየሩሳሌምም ቶሎ ውጣ፥ ስለ እኔ የምትመሰክረውን አይቀበሉህምና ሲለኝ አየሁት።

verses.text_english: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በአንተ የሚያምኑትን በምኵራብ ሁሉ እኔ በወኅኒ አገባና እደበድብ እንደ ነበርሁ እነርሱ ያውቃሉ፤

verses.text_english: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
verses.text_amharic: የሰማዕትህንም የእስጢፋኖስን ደም ባፈሰሱ ጊዜ፥ ራሴ ደግሞ በአጠገባቸው ስቆም ተስማምቼ የገዳዮችን ልብስ እጠብቅ ነበር አልሁ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ሂድ፥ እኔ ወደ አሕዛብ ከዚህ ወደ ሩቅ እልክሃለሁና አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And they gave him audience unto this word, and lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
verses.text_amharic: እስከዚህም ቃል ድረስ ይሰሙት ነበር፥ ድምፃቸውንም ከፍ አድርገው። እንደዚህ ያለውን ሰው ከምድር አስወግደው፥ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ አይገባውምና አሉ።

verses.text_english: And as they cried out, and cast off clothes, and threw dust into the air,
verses.text_amharic: ሲጮኹና ልብሳቸውን ሲወረውሩ ትቢያንም ወደ ላይ ሲበትኑ፥

verses.text_english: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
verses.text_amharic: የሻለቃው ወደ ሰፈሩ እንዲያገቡት አዘዘ፥ እንደዚህም የጮኹበትን ምክንያት ያውቅ ዘንድ። እየገረፋችሁ መርምሩት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
verses.text_amharic: በጠፍርም በገተሩት ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በአጠገቡ የቆመውን የመቶ አለቃ። የሮሜን ሰው ያለ ፍርድ ትገርፉ ዘንድ ተፈቅዶላችኋልን? አለው።

verses.text_english: When the centurion heard , he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃውም በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ሻለቃው ቀርቦ። ይህ ሰው ሮማዊ ነውና ታደርገው ዘንድ ካለህ ተጠበቅ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
verses.text_amharic: የሻለቃውም ቀርቦ። አንተ ሮማዊ ነህን? ንገረኝ አለው፤ እርሱም። አዎን አለ።

verses.text_english: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was born.
verses.text_amharic: የሻለቃውም መልሶ። እኔ ይህን ዜግነት በብዙ ገንዘብ አገኘሁት አለ። ጳውሎስም። እኔ ግን በእርስዋ ተወለድሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ሊመረምሩት ያሰቡት ከእርሱ ወዲያው ተለዩ፤ የሻለቃውም ደግሞ ሮማዊ መሆኑን ባወቀ ጊዜ ፈራ፥ አሳስሮት ነበርና።

verses.text_english: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
verses.text_amharic: በማግሥቱም አይሁድ የከሰሱት በምን ምክንያት እንደ ሆነ እርግጡን ያውቅ ዘንድ አስቦ ፈታው፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ሸንጎውም ሁሉ ይሰበሰቡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፥ ጳውሎስንም አውርዶ በፊታቸው አቆመው።

verses.text_english: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ሸንጎውን ትኵር ብሎ ተመልክቶ። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ እስከዚች ቀን ድረስ በመልካም ሕሊና ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኖሬአለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ሐናንያ አፉን ይመቱት ዘንድ በአጠገቡ ቆመው የነበሩትን አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ። አንተ በኖራ የተለሰነ ግድግዳ፥ እግዚአብሔር አንተን ይመታ ዘንድ አለው፤ አንተ በሕግ ልትፈርድብኝ ተቀምጠህ ሳለህ ያለ ሕግ እመታ ዘንድ ታዛለህን? አለው።

verses.text_english: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
verses.text_amharic: በአጠገቡ የቆሙትም። የእግዚአብሔርን ሊቀ ካህናት ትሳደባለህን? አሉት።

verses.text_english: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሊቀ ካህናት መሆኑን ባላውቅ ነው፤ በሕዝብህ አለቃ ላይ ክፉ ቃል አትናገር ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና አላቸው።

verses.text_english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን እኵሌቶቹ ሰዱቃውያን እኵሌቶቹም ፈሪሳውያን መሆናቸውን አይቶ። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ፈሪሳዊ የፈሪሳዊም ልጅ ነኝ፤ ስለ ተስፋና ስለ ሙታን መነሣት ይፈርዱብኛል ብሎ በሸንጎው ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ባለ ጊዜ በፈሪሳውያንና በሰዱቃውያን መካከል ጥል ሆነ ሸንጎውም ተለያየ።

verses.text_english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዱቃውያን። ትንሣኤም መልአክም መንፈስም የለም የሚሉ ናቸውና፤ ፈሪሳውያን ግን ሁለቱን ያምናሉ።

verses.text_english: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅ ጩኸትም ሆነ፥ ከፈሪሳውያንም ወገን የሆኑት ጻፎች ተነሥተው። በዚህ ሰው ላይ ምንም ክፉ ነገር አላገኘንበትም፤ መንፈስ ወይስ መልአክ ተናግሮት ይሆን? ብለው ተከራከሩ።

verses.text_english: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring into the castle.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጥልም በሆነ ጊዜ የሻለቃው ጳውሎስን እንዳይገነጣጥሉት ፈርቶ ጭፍሮቹ ወርደው ከመካከላቸው እንዲነጥቁት ወደ ሰፈሩም እንዲያገቡት አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛውም ሌሊት ጌታ በአጠገቡ ቆሞ። ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ስለ እኔ እንደ መሰከርህ እንዲሁ በሮሜም ትመሰክርልኝ ዘንድ ይገባሃልና አይዞህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
verses.text_amharic: በጠባም ጊዜ አይሁድ ጳውሎስን እስኪገድሉት ድረስ እንዳይበሉና እንዳይጠጡ በመሐላ ተስማሙ።

verses.text_english: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሴራ ያደረጉት ሰዎች ከአርባ ይበዙ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ወደ ካህናት አለቆችና ወደ ሽማግሌዎቹ መጥተው። ጳውሎስን እስክንገድል ድረስ ምንም እንዳንቀምስ ተረጋግመን ተማምለናል።

verses.text_english: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አሁን እናንተ ከሸንጎው ጋር ሆናችሁ ስለ እርሱ አጥብቃችሁ እንደምትመረምሩ መስላችሁ ወደ እናንተ እንዲያወርደው ለሻለቃው አመልክቱት፤ እኛም ሳይቀርብ እንድንገድለው የተዘጋጀን ነን አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
verses.text_amharic: የጳውሎስ የእኅቱ ልጅ ግን ደባቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ፥ መጥቶ ወደ ሰፈሩ ገባና ለጳውሎስ ነገረው።

verses.text_english: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto , and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ከመቶ አለቆች አንዱን ጠርቶ። ይህን ብላቴና ወደ ሻለቃው ውሰድ፥ የሚያወራለት ነገር አለውና አለው።

verses.text_english: So he took him, and brought to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ይዞት ወደ ሻለቃው ወሰደውና። ይህ ብላቴና የሚነግርህ ነገር ስላለው እስረኛው ጳውሎስ ጠርቶ ወደ አንተ እንድወስደው ለመነኝ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went aside privately, and asked , What is that thou hast to tell me?
verses.text_amharic: የሻለቃውም እጁን ይዞ ፈቀቅ አለና ለብቻው ሆኖ። የምታወራልኝ ነገር ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.text_english: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። አይሁድ ስለ ጳውሎስ ከፊት ይልቅ አጥብቀህ እንደምትመረምር መስለህ፥ ነገ ወደ ሸንጎ ታወርደው ዘንድ ሊለምኑህ ተስማምተዋል።

verses.text_english: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አንተ በጅ አትበላቸው፤ እስኪገድሉት ድረስ እንዳይበሉና እንዳይጠጡ ተማምለው ከእነርሱ ከአርባ የሚበዙ ሰዎች ያደቡበታልና፤ አሁንም የተዘጋጁ ናቸው የአንተንም ምላሽ ይጠብቃሉ አለው።

verses.text_english: So the chief captain let the young man depart, and charged tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
verses.text_amharic: የሻለቃውም። ይህን ነገር ለእኔ ማመልከትህን ለማንም እንዳትገልጥ ብሎ ካዘዘ በኋላ ብላቴናውን አሰናበተው።

verses.text_english: And he called unto two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
verses.text_amharic: ከመቶ አለቆቹም ሁለት ጠርቶ። ወደ ቂሣርያ ይሄዱ ዘንድ ሁለት መቶ ወታደሮችንና ሰባ ፈረሰኞችን ሁለት መቶም ባለ ጦር መሣሪያዎችን ከሌሊቱ በሦስተኛው ሰዓት አዘጋጁ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And provide beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring safe unto Felix the governor.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስንም ወደ አገረ ገዡ ወደ ፊልክስ በደኅና እንዲያደርሱት የሚያስቀምጡበትን ከብት ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
verses.text_amharic: ደብዳቤም ጻፈ እንዲህ የሚል።

verses.text_english: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix greeting.
verses.text_amharic: ከቀላውዴዎስ ሉስዮስ ወደ ክቡር አገረ ገዡ ወደ ፊልክስ፤ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ሰው አይሁድ ይዘው ሊገድሉት ባሰቡ ጊዜ ከጭፍሮቹ ጋር ደርሼ አዳንሁት፥ ሮማዊ እንደ ሆነ አውቄ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
verses.text_amharic: የሚከሰስበትንም ምክንያት አውቅ ዘንድ አስቤ ወደ ሸንጎአቸው አወረድሁት፤

verses.text_english: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
verses.text_amharic: በሕጋቸውም ስለ መከራከር እንደ ከሰሱት አገኘሁ እንጂ ለሞት ወይም ለእስራት የሚያደርስ ክስ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what against him. Farewell.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ሰው አይሁድ ሴራ እንዲያደርጉበት ባመለከቱኝ ጊዜ ያን ጊዜውን ወደ አንተ ሰደድሁት፥ ከሳሾቹንም ደግሞ በፊትህ ይከሱት ዘንድ አዘዝኋቸው። ደኅና ሁን።

verses.text_english: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought by night to Antipatris.
verses.text_amharic: ወታደሮቹም እንደ ታዘዙት ጳውሎስን ይዘው በሌሊት ወደ አንቲጳጥሪስ አደረሱት፤

verses.text_english: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም ከእርሱ ጋር ይሄዱ ዘንድ ፈረሰኞችን ትተው ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሱ።

verses.text_english: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ወደ ቂሣርያ ገብተው ደብዳቤውን ለአገረ ገዡ በሰጡ ጊዜ ጳውሎስን ደግሞ በፊቱ አቆሙት።

verses.text_english: And when the governor had read , he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that of Cilicia;
verses.text_amharic: ካነበበውም በኋላ የወዴት አውራጃ እንደ ሆነ ጠየቀው፤ የኪልቅያ ሰው መሆኑንም ባወቀ ጊዜ።

verses.text_english: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳሾችህ ደግሞ ሲመጡ እሰማሃለሁ አለው፤ በሄሮድስም ግቢ ውስጥ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and a certain orator Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
verses.text_amharic: ከአምስት ቀንም በኋላ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ሐናንያ ከሽማግሌዎችና ጠርጠሉስ ከሚሉት ከአንድ ጠበቃ ጋር ወረደ፤ እነርሱም ስለ ጳውሎስ ለአገረ ገዡ አመለከቱት።

verses.text_english: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse , saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
We accept always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.text_amharic: በተጠራም ጊዜ ጠርጠሉስ ይከሰው ዘንድ ጀመረ እንዲህ እያለ። ክቡር ፊልክስ ሆይ፥ በአንተ በኩል ብዙ ሰላም ስለምናገኝ ለዚህም ሕዝብ በአሳብህ በየነገሩ በየስፍራውም መልካም መሻሻል ስለሚሆንለት፥ በፍጹም ምስጋና እንቀበለዋለን።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እጅግ እንዳላቆይህ በቸርነትህ በአጭሩ ትሰማን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: For we have found this man pestilent , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ሰው በሽታ ሆኖ በዓለም ባሉት አይሁድ ሁሉ ሁከት ሲያስነሣ፥ የመናፍቃን የናዝራውያን ወገን መሪ ሆኖ አግኝተነዋልና፤

verses.text_english: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
verses.text_amharic: መቅደስንም ደግሞ ሊያረክስ ሲሞክር ያዝነው፥ እንደ ሕጋችንም እንፈርድበት ዘንድ ወደድን።

verses.text_english: But the chief captain Lysias came , and with great violence took away out of our hands,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሻለቃው ሉስዮስ መጥቶ በብዙ ኃይል ከእጃችን ወሰደው፥

verses.text_english: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
verses.text_amharic: ከሳሾቹንም ወደ አንተ ይመጡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ አንተም ራስህ እርሱን መርምረህ እኛ ስለምንከስበት ነገር ሁሉ ልታውቅ ትችላለህ።

verses.text_english: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድም ደግሞ። ይህ ነገር እንዲሁ ነው እያሉ ተስማሙ።

verses.text_english: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
verses.text_amharic: ገዡም በጠቀሰው ጊዜ ጳውሎስ መለሰ እንዲህ ሲል። ከብዙ ዘመን ጀምረህ ለዚህ ሕዝብ አንተ ፈራጅ እንደ ሆንህ አውቃለሁና ደስ እያለኝ ስለ እኔ ነገር እመልሳለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
verses.text_amharic: እሰግድ ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ከወጣሁ ከአሥራ ሁለት ቀን እንዳይበልጥ ልታውቀው ትችላለህ።

verses.text_english: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
verses.text_amharic: ከአንድም ስንኳ ስነጋገር ወይም ሕዝብን ስሰበስብ በመቅደስ ቢሆን በምኵራብም ቢሆን በከተማም ቢሆን አላገኙኝም።

verses.text_english: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ስለሚከሱኝ ያስረዱህ ዘንድ አይችሉም።

verses.text_english: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ይህን እመሰክርልሃለሁ፤ በሕጉ ያለውን በነቢያትም የተጻፉትን ሁሉ አምኜ የአባቶቼን አምላክ እነርሱ ኑፋቄ ብለው እንደሚጠሩት መንገድ አመልካለሁ፤

verses.text_english: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ራሳቸው ደግሞ የሚጠብቁት፥ ጻድቃንም ዓመፀኞችም ከሙታን ይነሡ ዘንድ እንዳላቸው ተስፋ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and men.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት ሁልጊዜ ነውር የሌለባት ሕሊና ትኖረኝ ዘንድ እተጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
verses.text_amharic: ከብዙ ዓመትም በኋላ ለሕዝቤ ምጽዋትና መሥዋዕት አደርግ ዘንድ መጣሁ፤

verses.text_english: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ሳደርግ ሳለሁ ሕዝብ ሳይሰበሰብ ሁከትም ሳይሆን በመቅደስ ስነጻ አገኙኝ።

verses.text_english: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእኔ ላይ ነገር ያላቸው እንደ ሆነ፥ በፊትህ መጥተው ይከሱኝ ዘንድ የሚገባቸው ከእስያ የመጡ አንዳንድ አይሁድ አሉ።

verses.text_english: Or else let these same say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
verses.text_amharic: ፊልክስ ግን የመንገዱን ነገር አጥብቆ አውቆአልና። የሻለቃው ሉስዮስ በወረደ ጊዜ ነገራችሁን እቆርጣለሁ ብሎ ወደ ፊት አዘገያቸው።

verses.text_english: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶውንም አለቃ ጳውሎስን ሲጠብቅ እንዲያደላለት፥ ከወዳጆቹም ማንም ሲያገለግለው ወይም ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ እንዳይከለክልበት አዘዘው።

verses.text_english: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ፊልክስ አይሁዳዊት ከነበረች ድሩሲላ ከሚሉአት ከሚስቱ ጋር መጥቶ ጳውሎስን አስመጣ፥ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ስለ ማመን የሚናገረውን ሰማው።

verses.text_english: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ስለ ጽድቅና ራስን ስለ መግዛት ስለሚመጣውም ኵነኔ ሲነጋገር ሳለ፥ ፊልክስ ፈርቶ። አሁንስ ሂድ፥ በተመቸኝም ጊዜ ልኬ አስጠራሃለሁ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜም ደግሞ እንዲፈታው ጳውሎስ ገንዘብ ይሰጠው ዘንድ ተስፋ አደረገ፤ ስለዚህ ደግሞ ብዙ ጊዜ እያስመጣ ያነጋግረው ነበር።

verses.text_english: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት ዓመትም ከሞላ በኋላ ጶርቅዮስ ፊስጦስ በፊልክስ ፈንታ ተተካ። ፊልክስም አይሁድን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ወዶ ጳውሎስን እንደ ታሰረ ተወው።

verses.text_english: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
verses.text_amharic: ፊስጦስም ወደ አውራጃው ገብቶ ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ከቂሣርያ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
verses.text_amharic: የካህናቱ አለቆችና የአይሁድም ታላላቆች በጳውሎስ ላይ አመለከቱ፥

verses.text_english: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስንም ሲቃወም እንዲያደላላቸው እየለመኑ፥ በመንገድ ሸምቀው ይገድሉት ዘንድ አስበው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲያስመጣው ማለዱት።

verses.text_english: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly .
verses.text_amharic: ፊስጦስ ግን ጳውሎስ በቂሳርያ እንዲጠበቅ እርሱም ራሱ ወደዚያ ፈጥኖ ይሄድ ዘንድ እንዳለው መለሰላቸው፤

verses.text_english: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with , and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በዚህ ሰው ክፋት ቢሆን ከእናንተ ዘንድ ያሉት ባለ ስልጣኖች ከእኔ ጋር ወርደው ይክሰሱት አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም ዘንድ ከስምንት ወይም ከአስር የማይበልጥ ቀን ተቀምጦ ወደ ቂሳርያ ወረደ፤ በነገውም በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀምጦ ጳውሎስን ያመጡት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.text_english: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
verses.text_amharic: በቀረበም ጊዜ ከኢየሩሳሌም የወረዱት አይሁድ ከበውት ቆሙ፥ ይረቱበትም ዘንድ የማይችሉትን ብዙና ከባድ ክስ አነሱበት፤

verses.text_english: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም ሲምዋገት። የአይሁድን ህግ ቢሆን መቅደስንም ቢሆን ቄሳርንም ቢሆን አንዳች ስንኳ አልበደልሁም አለ።

verses.text_english: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
verses.text_amharic: ፊስጦስ ግን አይሁድን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ወዶ ጳውሎስን። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጥተህ ስለዚህ ነገር ከዚያው በፊቴ ትፋረድ ዘንድ ትወዳለህን? ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን። እፋረድበት ዘንድ በሚገባኝ በቄሳር ፍርድ ወንበር ፊት ቆሜአለሁ። አንተው ደግሞ ፈጽመህ እንደምታውቅ አይሁድን ምንም አልበደልሁም።

verses.text_english: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በድዬ ወይም ሞት የሚገባውን ነገር አድርጌ እንደ ሆነ ከሞት ልዳን አልልም፤ እነዚህ የሚከሱኝ ክስ ከንቱ እንደሆነ ግን ለእነርሱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠኝ ዘንድ ማንም አይችልም፤ ወደ ቄሳር ይግባኝ ብዬአለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ፊስጦስ ከአማካሪዎቹ ጋር ተማክሮ። ወደ ቄሳር ይግባኝ ብለሃል፤ ወደ ቄሳር ትሄዳለህ ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.text_english: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
verses.text_amharic: ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ ንጉሡ አግሪጳ በርኒቄም ለፊስጦስ ሰላምታ እንዲያቀርቡ ወደ ቂሳርያ ወረዱ።

verses.text_english: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያውም ብዙ ቀን ስለተቀመጡ ፊስጦስ የጳውሎስን ነገር ለንጉሡ እንዲህ ብሎ ገለጠ። ፊልክስ አስሮ የተወው አንድ ሰው በዚህ አለ፤

verses.text_english: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed , desiring judgment against him.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሩሳሌምም ሳለሁ የካህናት አለቆችና የአይሁድ ሽማግሌዎች እፈርድበት ዘንድ እየለመኑ ስለ እርሱ አመለከቱኝ።

verses.text_english: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ተከሳሹ በከሳሾቹ ፊት ለፊት ሳይቆም ለተከሰሰበትም መልስ ይሰጥ ዘንድ ፈንታ ሳያገኝ፥ ማንንም ቢሆን አሳልፎ መስጠት የሮማውያን ሥርዓት አይደለም ብዬ መለስሁላቸው።

verses.text_english: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በዚህ በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ፥ ሳልዘገይ በማግሥቱ በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀምጬ ያንን ሰው ያመጡት ዘንድ አዘዝሁ።

verses.text_english: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
verses.text_amharic: ከሳሾቹም በቆሙ ጊዜ እኔ ያሰብሁትን ክፉ ነገር ክስ ምንም አላመጡበትም፤

verses.text_english: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ስለ ገዛ ሃይማኖታቸውና ጳውሎስ። ሕያው ነው ስለሚለው ስለ ሞተው ኢየሱስ ስለ ተባለው ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከሩ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ይህን ነገር እንዴት እንድመረምር አመንትቼ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄደህ በዚህ ነገር ከዚያ ልትፋረድ ትወዳለህን? አልሁት።

verses.text_english: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን አውግስጦስ ቄሣር እስኪቈርጥ ድረስ እንዲጠበቅ ይግባኝ ባለ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቄሣር እስክሰደው ድረስ ይጠበቅ ዘንድ አዘዝሁ።

verses.text_english: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
verses.text_amharic: አግሪጳም ፊስጦስን። ያንንስ ሰው እኔ ዳግም እኮ እሰማው ዘንድ እወድ ነበር አለው። እርሱም። ነገ ትሰማዋለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም አግሪጳና በርኒቄ በብዙ ግርማ መጥተው ከሻለቆችና ከከተማው ታላላቆች ጋር ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ገቡ፤ ፊስጦስም ባዘዘ ጊዜ ጳውሎስን አመጡት።

verses.text_english: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
verses.text_amharic: ፊስጦስም አለ። አግሪጳ ንጉሥ ሆይ እናንተም ከእኛ ጋር ያላችሁ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ እንዳይገባው እየጮኹ የአይሁድ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም በዚህም ስለ እርሱ የለመኑኝን ይህን ሰው ታዩታላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን ሞት የሚገባውን ነገር እንዳላደረገ አስተዋልሁ፥ እርሱም ወደ አውግስጦስ ይግባኝ ስላለ እሰደው ዘንድ ቈረጥሁ።

verses.text_english: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርሱም ወደ ጌታዬ የምጽፈው እርግጥ ነገር የለኝም፤ ስለዚህ ከተመረመረ በኋላ የምጽፈውን ነገር አገኝ ዘንድ በፊታችሁ ይልቁንም በፊትህ፥ ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ አመጣሁት፤

verses.text_english: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes against him.
verses.text_amharic: እስረኛ ሲላክ የተከሰሰበትን ምክንያት ደግሞ አለማመልከት ሞኝነት መስሎኛልና።

verses.text_english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:
verses.text_amharic: አግሪጳም ጳውሎስን። ስለ ራስህ ትናገር ዘንድ ተፈቅዶልሃል አለው። በዚያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ እጁን ዘርግቶ መለሰ እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.text_english: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:
Especially thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ የአይሁድን ሥርዓት ክርክርንም ሁሉ አጥብቀህ አውቀሃልና በአይሁድ በተከሰስሁበት ነገር ሁሉ ዛሬ በፊትህ ስለምመልስ ራሴን እጅግ እንደ ተመረቀ አድርጌ እቈጥረዋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ በትዕግሥት ትሰማኝ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
verses.text_amharic: ከመጀመሪያ አንሥቶ በሕዝቤ መካከል በኢየሩሳሌም የሆነውን፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሬ የኖርሁትን ኑሮዬን አይሁድ ሁሉ ያውቃሉ፤

verses.text_english: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
verses.text_amharic: ሊመሰክሩ ይወዱ እንደ ሆነ፥ በአምልኮአችን ከሁሉ ይልቅ ሕግን በመጠንቀቅ እንደሚተጋ ወገን ፈሪሳዊ ሆኜ እንደኖርሁ ከጥንት ጀምረው አውቀውኛልና።

verses.text_english: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን ስለ ተሰጠው ስለ ተስፋ ቃል አለኝታ ልፋረድ ቆሜአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Unto which our twelve tribes, instantly serving day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚህም ወደ ተስፋ ቃል አሥራ ሁለቱ ወገኖቻችን ሌሊትና ቀን በትጋት እያመለኩ ይደርሱ ዘንድ አለኝታ አላቸው፤ ስለዚህም አለኝታ፥ ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ከአይሁድ እከሰሳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ሙታንን የሚያስነሣ እንደ ሆነ ስለ ምን በእናንተ ዘንድ የማይታመን ነገር ሆኖ ይቈጠራል?

verses.text_english: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ራሴ የናዝሬቱን የኢየሱስን ስም የሚቃወም እጅግ ነገር አደርግ ዘንድ እንዲገባኝ ይመስለኝ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against .
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም አደረግሁት፤ ከካህናት አለቆችም ሥልጣን ተቀብዬ እኔ ከቅዱሳን ብዙዎችን በወኅኒ አሳሰርኋቸው፥ ሲገድሉአቸውም አብሬ ተቸሁ።

verses.text_english: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted even unto strange cities.
verses.text_amharic: በምኵራብም ሁሉ ብዙ ጊዜ እየቀጣሁ ይሰድቡት ዘንድ ግድ አልኋቸው፤ ያለ ልክ ስቈጣባቸውም እስከ ውጭ አገር ከተማዎች ድረስ እንኳ አሳድድ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ነገ ከካህናት አለቆች ሥልጣንና ትእዛዝ ተቀብዬ ወደ ደማስቆ ስሄድ፥

verses.text_english: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በመንገድ ሳለሁ እኩል ቀን ሲሆን በዙሪያዬና ከእኔ ጋር በሄዱት ዙሪያ ከፀሐይ ብሩህነት የበለጠ ብርሃን ከሰማይ ሲበራ አየሁ፤

verses.text_english: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችንም በምድር ላይ በወደቅን ጊዜ። ሳውል ሳውል፥ ስለ ምን ታሳድደኛለህ? የመውጊያውን ብረት ብትቃወም ለአንተ ይብስብሃል የሚል ድምፅ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ ሲናገረኝ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ማንነህ? አልሁ። እርሱም አለኝ። አንተ የምታሳድደኝ እኔ ኢየሱስ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ተነሣና በእግርህ ቁም፤ ስለዚህ እኔን ባየህበት ነገር ለአንተም በምታይበት ነገር አገልጋይና ምስክር ትሆን ዘንድ ልሾምህ ታይቼልሃለሁና።

verses.text_english: Delivering thee from the people, and the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
To open their eyes, to turn from darkness to light, and the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ከሰማይ የታየኝን ራእይ እምቢ አላልሁም።

verses.text_english: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አስቀድሜ በደማስቆ ላሉት በኢየሩሳሌምም በይሁዳም አገር ሁሉ ለአሕዛብም ንስሐ ይገቡ ዘንድና ለንስሐ የሚገባ ነገር እያደረጉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘወር ይሉ ዘንድ ተናገርሁ።

verses.text_english: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ አይሁድ በመቅደስ ያዙኝ ሊገድሉኝም ሞከሩ።

verses.text_english: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill .
Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህም ብሎ ስለ ራሱ ሲመልስ ፊስጦስ በታላቅ ድምፅ። ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ አብድሃል እኮ፤ ብዙ ትምህርትህ ወደ እብደት ያዞርሃል አለው።

verses.text_english: That Christ should suffer, that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን እንዲህ አለ። ክቡር ፊስጦስ ሆይ፥ የእውነትንና የአእምሮን ነገር እናገራለሁ እንጂ እብደትስ የለብኝም።

verses.text_english: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ፊት ደግሞ በግልጥ የምናገረው ንጉሥ ይህን ነገር ያውቃል፤ ከዚህ ነገር አንዳች እንዳይሰወርበት ተረድቼአለሁና፤ ይህ በስውር የተደረገ አይደለምና።

verses.text_english: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሥ አግሪጳ ሆይ፥ ነቢያትን ታምናለህን? እንድታምናቸው አውቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
verses.text_amharic: አግሪጳም ጳውሎስን። በጥቂት ክርስቲያን ልታደርገኝ ትወዳለህ አለው።

verses.text_english: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም። በጥቂት ቢሆን ወይም በብዙ አንተ ብቻ አይደለህም ነገር ግን ዛሬ የሚሰሙኝ ሁሉ ደግሞ ከዚህ እስራቴ በቀር እንደ እኔ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እለምናለሁ አለው።

verses.text_english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
verses.text_amharic: ንጉሡም አገረ ገዡም በርኒቄም ከእነርሱም ጋር ተቀምጠው የነበሩት ተነሡ፥

verses.text_english: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.
verses.text_amharic: ፈቀቅ ብለውም እርስ በርሳቸው። ይህ ሰው እንኳንስ ለሞት ለእስራትም የሚገባ ምንም አላደረገ ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
verses.text_amharic: አግሪጳም ፈስጦስን። ይህ ሰው እኮ ወደ ቄሣር ይግባኝ ባይል ይፈታ ዘንድ ይቻል ነበር አለው።

verses.text_english: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ኢጣሊያም በመርከብ እንሄድ ዘንድ በተቈረጠ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስንና ሌሎችን እስረኞች ከአውግስጦስ ጭፍራ ለነበረ ዩልዮስ ለሚሉት ለመቶ አለቃ አሳልፈው ሰጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
verses.text_amharic: በእስያም ዳርቻ ወዳሉ ስፍራዎች ይሄድ ዘንድ ባለው በአድራሚጢስ መርከብ ገብተን ተነሣን፤ የመቄዶንያም ሰው የሆነ የተሰሎንቄው አርስጥሮኮስ ከእኛ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the next we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
verses.text_amharic: በነገውም ወደ ሲዶና ስንደርስ ዩልዮስ ለጳውሎስ ቸርነት አድርጎ እርዳታቸውን ይቀበል ዘንድ ወደ ወዳጆቹ እንዲሄድ ፈቀደለት።

verses.text_english: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ተነሥተን ነፋሱ ፊት ለፊት ነበረና በቆጵሮስ ተተግነን ሄድን፤

verses.text_english: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, of Lycia.
verses.text_amharic: በኪልቅያና በጵንፍልያም አጠገብ ያለውን ባሕር ከተሻገርን በኋላ በሉቅያ ወዳለ ወደ ሙራ ደረስን።

verses.text_english: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃውም በዚያ ወደ ኢጣሊያ የሚሄድ የእስክንድርያውን መርከብ አግኝቶ ወደ እርሱ አገባን።

verses.text_english: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ቀንም እያዘገምን ሄደን በጭንቅ ወደ ቀኒዶስ አንጻር ደረስን፤ ነፋስም ስለ ከለከለን በቀርጤስ ተተግነን በሰልሙና አንጻር ሄድን፤

verses.text_english: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city Lasea.
verses.text_amharic: በጭንቅም ጥግ ጥጉን አልፈን ለላሲያ ከተማ ወደ ቀረበች መልካም ወደብ ወደሚሉአት ስፍራ መጣን።

verses.text_english: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished ,
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜም ካለፈ በኋላ፥ የጦም ወራት አሁን አልፎ ስለ ነበረ በመርከብ ለመሄድ አሁን የሚያስፈራ ነበርና ጳውሎስ።

verses.text_english: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ይህ ጕዞ በጥፋትና በብዙ ጕዳት እንዲሆን አያለሁ፤ ጥፋቱም በገዛ ሕይወታችን ነው እንጂ በጭነቱና በመርከቡ ብቻ አይደለም ብሎ መከራቸው።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃው ግን ጳውሎስ ከተናገረው ይልቅ የመርከብ መሪውንና የመርከቡን ባለቤት ያምን ነበር።

verses.text_english: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, to winter; an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
verses.text_amharic: ያም ወደብ ይከርሙበት ዘንድ የማይመች ስለ ሆነ፥ የሚበዙቱ ቢቻላቸው በሰሜንና በደቡብ ምዕራብ ትይዩ ወዳለው ፍንቄ ወደሚሉት ወደ ቀርጤስ ወደብ ደርሰው ይከርሙ ዘንድ ከዚያ እንዲነሡ መከሩ።

verses.text_english: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained purpose, loosing , they sailed close by Crete.
verses.text_amharic: ልከኛም የደቡብ ነፋስ በነፈሰ ጊዜ፥ እንዳሰቡት የሆነላቸው መስሎአቸው ተነሡ በቀርጤስም አጠገብ ጥግ ጥጉን አለፉ።

verses.text_english: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እጅግ ሳይዘገይ አውራቂስ የሚሉት ዓውሎ ነፋስ ከዚያ ወረደባቸው፤

verses.text_english: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let drive.
verses.text_amharic: መርከቡም ተነጥቆ ነፋሱን ሲቃወም መሄድ ስላልቻለ ለቀነው ተነዳን።

verses.text_english: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:
verses.text_amharic: ቄዳ በሚሉአትም ደሴት በተተገንን ጊዜ ታንኳይቱን ለመግዛት በጭንቅ ቻልን፤

verses.text_english: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ላይም ካወጡአት በኋላ መርከቡን በገመድ አስታጥቀው አጸኑ፤ ስርቲስም ወደሚሉት ወደ አሸዋ እንዳይወድቁ ፈርተው ሸራውን አውርደው እንዲሁ ተነዱ።

verses.text_english: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next they lightened the ship;
verses.text_amharic: ነፋሱም በርትቶ ሲያስጨንቀን በማንግሥቱ ከጭነቱ ወደ ባሕር ይጥሉ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And the third we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
verses.text_amharic: በሦስተኛውም ቀን የመርከቡን ዕቃ በእጃችን ወረወርን።

verses.text_english: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ቀንም ፀሐይን ከዋክብትንም ሳናይ ትልቅ ነፋስም ሲበረታብን ጊዜ፥ ወደ ፊት እንድናለን የማለት ተስፋ ሁሉ ተቈረጠ።

verses.text_english: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
verses.text_amharic: ሳይበሉም ብዙ ቀን ከቆዩ በኋላ፥ ያን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ሰምታችሁኝ በሆነ ኖሮ ከቀርጤስ እንዳትነሡ ይህንም ጥፋትና ጕዳት እንዳታገኙ ይገባችሁ ነበር።

verses.text_english: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of life among you, but of the ship.
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም። አይዞአችሁ ብዬ እመክራችኋለሁ፤ ይህ መርከብ እንጂ ከእናንተ አንድ ነፍስ እንኳ አይጠፋምና።

verses.text_english: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,
verses.text_amharic: የእርሱ የምሆንና ደግሞ የማመልከው የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በዚች ሌሊት በአጠገቤ ቆሞ ነበርና፥ እርሱም።

verses.text_english: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ በቄሣር ፊት ልትቆም ይገባሃል፤ እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር የሚሄዱትን ሁሉ ሰጥቶሃል አለኝ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እናንተ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ አይዞአችሁ፤ እንደ ተናገረኝ እንዲሁ እንዲሆን እግዚአብሔርን አምናለሁና።

verses.text_english: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወደ አንዲት ደሴት እንድንወድቅ ያስፈልገናል።

verses.text_english: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
verses.text_amharic: በአሥራ አራተኛውም ሌሊት በአድርያ ባሕር ወዲህና ወዲያ ስንነዳ፥ መርከበኞች በእኩለ ሌሊት ወደ አንድ ምድር የቀረቡ መሰላቸው።

verses.text_english: And sounded, and found twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found fifteen fathoms.
verses.text_amharic: መለኪያ ገመድም ቢጥሉ ሀያ በሰው ቁመት አገኙ ጥቂትም ቆይተው ሁለተኛ ቢጥሉ አሥራ አምስት በሰው ቁመት አገኙ፤

verses.text_english: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.
verses.text_amharic: ድንጋያማም ወደ ሆነ ስፍራ እንዳይወድቁ ፈርተው፥ ከመርከቡ በስተኋላ አራት መልሕቅ አወረዱ፥ ቀንም እንዲሆን ተመኙ።

verses.text_english: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
verses.text_amharic: መርከበኞቹም ከመርከቡ ይሸሹ ዘንድ ፈልገው ከመርከቡ በስተ ፊት መልሕቅ መጣል እንዳላቸው አመካኝተው ታንኳይቱን ወደ ባሕር ባወረዱ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ለመቶ አለቃውና ለወታደሮቹ። እነዚህ በመርከቡ ካልቆዩ እናንተ ትድኑ ዘንድ አትችሉም አላቸው።

verses.text_english: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
verses.text_amharic: ያን ጊዜ ወታደሮቹ የታንኳይቱን ገመድ ቈርጠው ትወድቅ ዘንድ ተዉአት።

verses.text_english: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንም ሲነጋ ጳውሎስ ምግብ ይበሉ ዘንድ ሁሉን ይለምን ነበር፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። እየጠበቃችሁ ምንም ሳትቀበሉ ጦማችሁን ከሰነበታችሁ ዛሬ አሥራ አራተኛ ቀናችሁ ነው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I pray you to take meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
verses.text_amharic: ሰለዚህ ምግብ ትበሉ ዘንድ እለምናችኋለሁ፤ ይህ ለደኅንነታችሁ ይሆናልና፤ ከእናንተ ከአንዱ የራስ ጠጕር እንኳ አትጠፋምና።

verses.text_english: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken , he began to eat.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ብሎ እንጀራን ይዞ በሁሉ ፊት እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ ቈርሶም ይበላ ዘንድ ጀመረ።

verses.text_english: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took meat.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለም ተጽናንተው ራሳቸው ደግሞ ምግብ ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
verses.text_amharic: በመርከቡም ያለን ሁላችን ሁለት መቶ ሰባ ስድስት ነፍስ ነበርን።

verses.text_english: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በልተውም በጠገቡ ጊዜ ስንዴውን ወደ ባሕር እየጣሉ መርከቡን አቃለሉት።

verses.text_english: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.
verses.text_amharic: በነጋም ጊዜ ምድሩን አላወቁትም፥ ነገር ግን የአሸዋ ዳር ያለውን የባሕር ስርጥ ተመለከቱ፥ ቢቻላቸውም መርከቡን ወደዚያ ይገፉ ዘንድ ቈረጡ።

verses.text_english: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
verses.text_amharic: መልሕቆቹንም ፈትተው በባሕር ተዉአቸው፥ ያን ጊዜም የመቅዘፊያውን ማሠሪያ ፈቱት፤ ታናሹንም ሸራ ለነፋስ ከፍ አድርገው ወደ ዳር አቅንተው ይሄዱ ዘንድ ጀመሩ።

verses.text_english: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሁለት ባሕር በተገናኙበት ስፍራ ወድቀው መርከቡን በዲብ ላይ ነዱ፤ በስተ ፊቱም ተተክሎ የማይነቃነቅ ሆነ፥ በስተ ኋላው ግን ከማዕበሉ ግፊያ የተነሣ ይሰበር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
verses.text_amharic: ወታደሮቹም ከእስረኞች አንድ ስንኳ ዋኝቶ እንዳያመልጥ ይገድሉአቸው ዘንድ ተማከሩ።

verses.text_english: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast first , and get to land:
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ አለቃው ግን ጳውሎስን ያድነው ዘንድ አስቦ ምክራቸውን ከለከለ፤ ዋና የሚያውቁትም ከመርከብ ራሳቸውን እየወረወሩ አስቀድመው ወደ ምድር ይወጡ ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: And the rest, some on boards, and some on of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም እኵሌቶቹ በሳንቃዎች ላይ እኵሌቶቹም በመርከቡ ስባሪ ይወጡ ዘንድ አዘዘ። እንዲሁም ሁሉ በደኅና ወደ ምድር ደረሱ።

verses.text_english: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
verses.text_amharic: በደኅና ከደረስን በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ ደሴቲቱ መላጥያ እንድትባል አወቅን።

verses.text_english: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.
verses.text_amharic: አረማውያንም የሚያስገርም ቸርነት አደረጉልን፤ ዝናብ ስለ ሆነም ስለ ብርዱም እሳት አንድደው ሁላችንን ተቀበሉን።

verses.text_english: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስ ግን ብዙ ጭራሮ አከማችቶ ወደ እሳት ሲጨምር እፉኝት ከሙቀት የተነሣ ወጥታ እጁን ነደፈችው።

verses.text_english: And when the barbarians saw the beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
verses.text_amharic: አረማውያንም እባብ በእጁ ተንጠልጥላ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ እርስ በርሳቸው። ይህ ሰው በእርግጥ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፥ ከባሕርም ስንኳ በደኅና ቢወጣ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ አልተወውም አሉ።

verses.text_english: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን እባቢቱን ወደ እሳት አራገፋት አንዳችም አልጐዳችውም፤

verses.text_english: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። ሊያብጥ ወይም ወዲያው ሞቶ ሊወድቅ ነው ብለው ይጠባበቁት ነበር ብዙ ጊዜ ግን ሲጠባበቁ በእርሱ ላይ የሚያስገርም ነገር ምንም ባላዩ ጊዜ። ይህስ አምላክ ነው ብለው አሳባቸውን ለወጡ።

verses.text_english: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ስፍራ አጠገብ ፑፕልዮስ የሚሉት የደሴት አለቃ መሬት ነበረ፥ እርሱም እንግድነት ተቀብሎን ሦስት ቀን በፍቅር አሳደረን።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
verses.text_amharic: የፑፕልዮስም አባት በንዳድና በተቅማጥ ታሞ ተኝቶ ነበር፤ ጳውሎስም ወደ እርሱ ገብቶ ጸለየለት እጁንም በላዩ ጭኖ ፈወሰው።

verses.text_english: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በሆነ ጊዜ የቀሩት ደግሞ በደሴቲቱ ደዌ የነበረባቸው እየመጡ ተፈወሱ፤

verses.text_english: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded with such things as were necessary.
verses.text_amharic: በብዙ ክብርም ደግሞ አከበሩን፥ በተነሣንም ጊዜ በመርከብ ላይ የሚያስፈልገንን ነገር አኖሩልን።

verses.text_english: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት ወርም በኋላ በደሴቲቱ ከርሞ በነበረው በእስክንድርያው መርከብ ተነሣን፥ በእርሱም የዲዮስቆሮስ አላማ ነበረበት።

verses.text_english: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried three days.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሰራኩስም በገባን ጊዜ ሦስት ቀን ተቀመጥን፤

verses.text_english: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም እየተዛወርን ወደ ሬጊዩም ደረስን። ከአንድ ቀን በኋላም የደቡብ ነፋስ በነፈሰ ጊዜ በሁለተኛው ቀን ወደ ፑቲዮሉስ መጣን።

verses.text_english: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወንድሞችን አግኝተን በእነርሱ ዘንድ ሰባት ቀን እንድንቀመጥ ለመኑን፤ እንዲሁም ወደ ሮሜ መጣን።

verses.text_english: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወንድሞች ስለ እኛ ሰምተው እስከ አፍዩስ ፋሩስና ሦስት ማደሪያ እስከሚባለው ሊቀበሉን ወጡ፥ ጳውሎስም ባያቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ ልቡም ተጽናና።

verses.text_english: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሮሜም በገባን ጊዜ ጳውሎስ ከሚጠብቀው ወታደር ጋር ለብቻው ይቀመጥ ዘንድ ተፈቀደለት።

verses.text_english: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ ጳውሎስ የአይሁድን ታላላቆች ወደ እርሱ ጠራ፤ በተሰበሰቡም ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ሕዝቡን ወይም የአባቶችን ሥርዓት የሚቃወም አንዳች ሳላደርግ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ታሰርሁ በሮማውያን እጅ አሳልፈው ሰጡኝ።

verses.text_english: Who, when they had examined me, would have let go, because there was no cause of death in me.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም መርምረው ለሞት የሚገባ ምክንያት ስላልነበረብኝ ሊፈቱኝ አሰቡ፤

verses.text_english: But when the Jews spake against , I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
verses.text_amharic: አይሁድ ግን በተቃወሙ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቄሣር ይግባኝ እንድል ግድ ሆነብኝ እንጂ ሕዝቤን የምከስበት ነገር ኖሮኝ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see , and to speak with : because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ምክንያት አያችሁና እነግራችሁ ዘንድ ጠራኋችሁ፤ ስለ እስራኤል ተስፋ ይህን ሰንሰለት ለብሻለሁና።

verses.text_english: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም። እኛ ከይሁዳ ስለ አንተ ደብዳቤ አልተቀበልንም፥ ከወንድሞችም አንድ ስንኳ መጥቶ ስለ አንተ ክፉ ነገር አላወራልንም ወይም አልተናገረብህም።

verses.text_english: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ስለዚህ ወገን በየስፍራው ሁሉ እንዲቃወሙ በእኛ ዘንድ ታውቆአልና የምታስበውን ከአንተ እንሰማ ዘንድ እንፈቅዳለን አሉት።

verses.text_english: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and the prophets, from morning till evening.
verses.text_amharic: ቀንም ቀጥረውለት ብዙ ሆነው ወደ መኖሪያው ወደ እርሱ መጡ፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትም እየመሰከረ ስለ ኢየሱስም ከሙሴ ሕግና ከነቢያት ጠቅሶ እያስረዳቸው፥ ከጥዋት ጀምሮ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ይገልጥላቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
verses.text_amharic: እኵሌቶቹም የተናገረውን አመኑ፥ እኵሌቶቹ ግን አላመኑም፤

verses.text_english: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳቸውም ባልተስማሙ ጊዜ፥ ጳውሎስ አንዲት ቃል ከተናገረ በኋላ ሄዱ፤ እንዲህም አለ። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ለአባቶቻችን።

verses.text_english: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
verses.text_amharic: ወደዚህ ሕዝብ ሂድና። መስማትን ትሰማላችሁና አታስተውሉም፥ ማየትንም ታያላችሁና አትመለከቱም፤

verses.text_english: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with eyes, and hear with ears, and understand with heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.text_amharic: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ በጆሮአቸው እንዳይሰሙ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ ተመልሰውም እንዳልፈውሳቸው፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ደንድኖአል ጆሮአቸውም ደንቁሮአል ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍነዋል በላቸው

verses.text_english: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and they will hear it.
verses.text_amharic: ሲል መልካም ተናገረ። እንግዲህ ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ደኅንነት ለአሕዛብ እንደ ተላከ በእናንተ ዘንድ የታወቀ ይሁን፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ይሰሙታል።

verses.text_english: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም በተናገረ ጊዜ አይሁድ እርስ በርሳቸው እጅግ እየተከራከሩ ሄዱ።

verses.text_english: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስም በተከራየው ቤት ሁለት ዓመት ሙሉ ተቀመጠ፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚመጡትን ሁሉ ይቀበል ነበር፤

verses.text_english: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሳይከለክለው የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እየሰበከ ስለ ጌታ ስለ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እጅግ ገልጦ ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.text_english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
verses.text_amharic: ሐዋርያ ሊሆን የተጠራ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያ ጳውሎስ በነቢያቱ አፍ በቅዱሳን

verses.text_english: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
verses.text_amharic: መጻሕፍት አስቀድሞ ተስፋ ለሰጠው ለእግዚአብሔር ወንጌል ተለየ።

verses.text_english: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
And declared the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ወንጌል በሥጋ ከዳዊት ዘር ስለ ተወለደ እንደ ቅድስና መንፈስ ግን ከሙታን መነሣት የተነሣ በኃይል የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ሆኖ ስለ ተገለጠ ስለ ልጁ ነው፤ እርሱም ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው።

verses.text_english: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ስለ ስሙ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ከእምነት የሚነሣ መታዘዝ እንዲገኝ ጸጋንና ሐዋርያነትን ተቀበልን፤

verses.text_english: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም መካከል የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ልትሆኑ የተጠራችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ናችሁ።

verses.text_english: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ለተወደዳችሁና ቅዱሳን ልትሆኑ ለተጠራችሁ በሮሜ ላላችሁት ሁሉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
verses.text_amharic: እምነታችሁ በዓለም ሁሉ ስለ ተሰማች አስቀድሜ ስለ ሁላችሁ አምላኬን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.text_english: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ትጸኑ ዘንድ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታ እንዳካፍላችሁ ላያችሁ እናፍቃለሁና፤

verses.text_english: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ማለቴ በመካከላችን ባለች በእናንተና በእኔ እምነት አብረን በእናንተ እንድንጽናና ነው።

verses.text_english: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በሌሎቹ አሕዛብ ደግሞ እንደ ሆነ በእናንተም ፍሬ አገኝ ዘንድ ብዙ ጊዜ ወደ እናንተ ልመጣ እንዳሰብሁ እስከ አሁን ግን እንደ ተከለከልሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ለግሪክ ሰዎችና ላልተማሩም፥ ለጥበበኞችና ለማያስተውሉም ዕዳ አለብኝ፤

verses.text_english: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በሚቻለኝ መጠን በሮሜ ላላችሁ ለእናንተ ደግሞ ወንጌልን ልሰብክ ተዘጋጅቼአለሁ።

verses.text_english: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
verses.text_amharic: በወንጌል አላፍርምና፤ አስቀድሞ ለአይሁዳዊ ደግሞም ለግሪክ ሰው፥ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ለማዳን ነውና።

verses.text_english: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ በእምነት ይኖራል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ከእምነት ወደ እምነት በእርሱ ይገለጣልና።

verses.text_english: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትን በዓመፃ በሚከለክሉ ሰዎች በኃጢአተኝነታቸውና በዓመፃቸው ሁሉ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ከሰማይ ይገለጣልና፤

verses.text_english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ገለጠላቸው፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሊታወቅ የሚቻለው በእነርሱ ዘንድ ግልጥ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed unto them.
For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
verses.text_amharic: ጥበበኞች ነን ሲሉ ደንቆሮ ሆኑ፥

verses.text_english: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
verses.text_amharic: የማይጠፋውንም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በሚጠፋ ሰውና በወፎች አራት እግር ባላቸውም በሚንቀሳቀሱትም መልክ መስለው ለወጡ።

verses.text_english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳቸው ሥጋቸውን ሊያዋርዱ እግዚአብሔር በልባቸው ፍትወት ወደ ርኵስነት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የእግዚአብሔርን እውነት በውሸት ስለ ለወጡ በፈጣሪም ፈንታ የተፈጠረውን ስላመለኩና ስላገለገሉ ነው፤ እርሱም ለዘላለም የተባረከ ነው፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ለሚያስነውር ምኞት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ ሴቶቻቸውም ለባሕርያቸው የሚገባውን ሥራ ለባሕርያቸው በማይገባው ለወጡ፤

verses.text_english: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ወንዶች ደግሞ ለባሕርያቸው የሚገባውን ሴቶችን መገናኘት ትተው እርስ በርሳቸው በፍትወታቸው ተቃጠሉ፤ ወንዶችም በወንዶች ነውር አድርገው በስሕተታቸው የሚገባውን ብድራት በራሳቸው ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን ለማወቅ ባልወደዱት መጠን እግዚአብሔር የማይገባውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ለማይረባ አእምሮ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤

verses.text_english: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃ ሁሉ፥ ግፍ፥ መመኘት፥ ክፋት ሞላባቸው፤ ቅናትን፥ ነፍስ መግደልን፥ ክርክርን፥ ተንኰልን፥ ክፉ ጠባይን ተሞሉ፤ የሚያሾከሹኩ፥

verses.text_english: And even as they did not like to retain God in knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
verses.text_amharic: ሐሜተኞች፥ አምላክን የሚጠሉ፥ የሚያንገላቱ፥ ትዕቢተኞች፥ ትምክህተኞች፥ ክፋትን የሚፈላለጉ፥ ለወላጆቻቸው የማይታዘዙ፥

verses.text_english: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
verses.text_amharic: የማያስተውሉ፥ ውል የሚያፈርሱ፥ ፍቅር የሌላቸው፥ ምሕረት ያጡ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.text_amharic: እንደነዚህ ለሚያደርጉት ሞት ይገባቸዋል የሚለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ እያወቁ እነዚህን ከሚያደርጉ ጋር ይስማማሉ እንጂ አድራጊዎች ብቻ አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ አንተ የምትፈርድ ሰው ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የምታመካኘው የለህም፤ በሌላው በምትፈርድበት ነገር ራስህን ትኰንናለህና፤ አንተው ፈራጁ እነዚያን ታደርጋለህና።

verses.text_english: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም በሚያደርጉት ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን።

verses.text_english: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.text_amharic: አንተም እንደዚህ በሚያደርጉ የምትፈርድ ያንም የምታደርግ ሰው ሆይ፥ አንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ የምታመልጥ ይመስልሃልን?

verses.text_english: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት ወደ ንስሐ እንዲመራህ ሳታውቅ የቸርነቱንና የመቻሉን የትዕግሥቱንም ባለጠግነት ትንቃለህን?

verses.text_english: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንደ ጥንካሬህና ንስሐ እንደማይገባ ልብህ የእግዚአብሔር ቅን ፍርድ በሚገለጥበት በቍጣ ቀን ቍጣን በራስህ ላይ ታከማቻለህ።

verses.text_english: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ሥራው ያስረክበዋል፤

verses.text_english: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
verses.text_amharic: በበጎ ሥራ በመጽናት ምስጋናንና ክብርን የማይጠፋንም ሕይወት ለሚፈልጉ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ይሰጣቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
verses.text_amharic: ለዓመፃ በሚታዘዙ እንጂ ለእውነት በማይታዘዙትና በአድመኞች ላይ ግን ቍጣና መቅሠፍት ይሆንባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
verses.text_amharic: ክፉውን በሚያደርግ ሰው ነፍስ ሁሉ መከራና ጭንቀት ይሆንበታል፥ አስቀድሞ በአይሁዳዊ ደግሞም በግሪክ ሰው፤

verses.text_english: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በጎ ሥራ ለሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ምስጋናና ክብር ሰላምም ይሆንላቸዋል፥ አስቀድሞ ለአይሁዳዊ ደግሞም ለግሪክ ሰው።

verses.text_english: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ፊት አያዳላምና።

verses.text_english: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.text_amharic: ያለ ሕግ ኃጢአት ያደረጉ ሁሉ ያለ ሕግ ደግሞ ይጠፋሉና፤ ሕግም ሳላቸው ኃጢአት ያደረጉ ሁሉ በሕግ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: (For not the hearers of the law just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሕግን የሚያደርጉት ይጸድቃሉ እንጂ ሕግን የሚሰሙ ጻድቃን አይደሉምና።

verses.text_english: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
verses.text_amharic: ሕግ የሌላቸው አሕዛብ ከባሕርያቸው የሕግን ትእዛዝ ሲያደርጉ፥ እነዚያ ሕግ ባይኖራቸው እንኳ ለራሳቸው ሕግ ናቸውና፤

verses.text_english: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሕሊናቸው ሲመሰክርላቸው፥ አሳባቸውም እርስ በርሳቸው ሲካሰስ ወይም ሲያመካኝ በልባቸው የተጻፈውን የሕግ ሥራ ያሳያሉ።

verses.text_english: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም እግዚአብሔር በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እኔ በወንጌል እንዳስተማርሁ በሰው ዘንድ የተሰወረውን በሚፈርድበት ቀን ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን አይሁዳዊ ብትባል በሕግም ብትደገፍ በእግዚአብሔርም ብትመካ፥

verses.text_english: And knowest will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
verses.text_amharic: ፈቃዱንም ብታውቅ ከሕግም ተምረህ የሚሻለውን ፈትነህ ብትወድ፤

verses.text_english: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አንተ ሌላውን የምታስተምር ራስህን አታስተምርምን? አትስረቅ ብለህ የምትሰብክ ትሰርቃለህን?

verses.text_english: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.text_amharic: አታመንዝር የምትል ታመነዝራለህን? ጣዖትን የምትጸየፍ ቤተ መቅደስን ትዘርፋለህን?

verses.text_english: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.text_amharic: በሕግ የምትመካ ሕግን በመተላለፍ እግዚአብሔርን ታሳፍራለህን?

verses.text_english: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተ ሰበብ የእግዚአብሔር ስም በአሕዛብ መካከል ይሰደባልና ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግን ብታደርግ መገረዝስ ይጠቅማል፤ ሕግን ተላላፊ ብትሆን ግን መገረዝህ አለ መገረዝ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ያልተገረዘ ሰው የሕግን ሥርዓት ቢጠብቅ አለመገረዙ እንደ መገረዝ ሆኖ አይቈጠርለትምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.text_amharic: ከፍጥረቱም ያልተገረዘ ሕግን የሚፈጽም ሰው የሕግ መጽሐፍና መገረዝ ሳለህ ሕግን በምትተላለፈው በአንተ ይፈርድብሃል።

verses.text_english: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.text_amharic: በግልጥ አይሁዳዊ የሆነ አይሁዳዊ አይደለምና፥ በግልጥ በሥጋ የሚደረግ መገረዝም መገረዝ አይደለምና፤

verses.text_english: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን በስውር አይሁዳዊ የሆነ አይሁዳዊ ነው፥ መገረዝም በመንፈስ የሚደረግ የልብ መገረዝ ነው እንጂ በመጽሐፍ አይደለም፤ የእርሱ ምስጋና ከእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ ከሰው አይደለም።

verses.text_english: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit of circumcision?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የአይሁዳዊ ብልጫው ምንድር ነው? ወይስ የመገረዝ ጥቅሙ ምንድር ነው? በሁሉ ነገር ብዙ ነው።

verses.text_english: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞ የእግዚአብሔር ቃላት አደራ ተሰጡአቸው። ታዲያ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.text_amharic: የማያምኑ ቢኖሩ አለማመናቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ታማኝነት ያስቀራልን?

verses.text_english: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ አይሁን፤ በቃልህ ትጸድቅ ዘንድ ወደ ፍርድ በገባህም ጊዜ ትረታ ዘንድ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ ሰው ሁሉ ውሸተኛ ከሆነ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዓመፃችን የእግዚአብሔርን ጽድቅ የሚያስረዳ ከሆነ ምን እንላለን? ቍጣን የሚያመጣ እግዚአብሔር ዓመፀኛ ነውን? እንደ ሰው ልማድ እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ አይሁን፤ እንዲህ ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር በዓለም እንዴት ይፈርዳል?

verses.text_english: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ውሸት ግን የእግዚአብሔር እውነት ለክብሩ ከላቀ ስለምን በእኔ ደግሞ እንደ ኃጢአተኛ ገና ይፈርድብኛል?

verses.text_english: And not , (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ምንስ መልካም እንዲመጣ ክፉ አናደርግም? እንዲሁ ይሰድቡናልና አንዳንዱም እንዲሁ እንድንል ይናገራሉና። የእነርሱም ፍርድ ቅን ነው።

verses.text_english: What then? are we better ? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ምን ይሁን? ከእነርሱ እንበልጣለንን? ከቶ አይደለም፤ አይሁድም የግሪክ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ከኃጢአት በታች እንደ ሆኑ አስቀድመን ከሰናቸዋልና፤

verses.text_english: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ የለም አንድ ስንኳ፤ አስተዋይም የለም፤ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ የለም፤ ሁሉ ተሳስተዋል፥

verses.text_english: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድነትም የማይጠቅሙ ሆነዋል፤ ቸርነት የሚያደርግ የለም፥ አንድ ስንኳ የለም።

verses.text_english: Their throat an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps under their lips:
verses.text_amharic: ጕሮሮአቸው እንደ ተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ በመላሳቸውም ሸንግለዋል፤ የእባብ መርዝ ከከንፈሮቻቸው በታች አለ፤

verses.text_english: Whose mouth full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.text_amharic: አፋቸውም እርግማንና መራርነት ሞልቶበታል፤

verses.text_english: Their feet swift to shed blood:
verses.text_amharic: እግሮቻቸው ደምን ለማፍሰስ ፈጣኖች ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: Destruction and misery in their ways:
verses.text_amharic: ጥፋትና ጉስቁልና በመንገዳቸው ይገኛል፥

verses.text_english: And the way of peace have they not known:
There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.text_amharic: አፍም ሁሉ ይዘጋ ዘንድ ዓለምም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በታች ይሆን ዘንድ ሕግ የሚናገረው ሁሉ ከሕግ በታች ላሉት እንዲናገር እናውቃለን፤

verses.text_english: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም የሕግን ሥራ በመሥራት ሥጋ የለበሰ ሁሉ በእርሱ ፊት ስለማይጸድቅ ነው፤ ኃጢአት በሕግ ይታወቃልና።

verses.text_english: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law the knowledge of sin.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በሕግና በነቢያት የተመሰከረለት የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ያለ ሕግ ተገልጦአል፥

verses.text_english: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም፥ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ የሆነ፥ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በማመን የሚገኘው የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ነው፤ ልዩነት የለምና፤

verses.text_english: Even the righteousness of God by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ኃጢአትን ሠርተዋልና የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ጎድሎአቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም በሆነው ቤዛነት በኩል እንዲያው በጸጋው ይጸድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱንም እግዚአብሔር በእምነት የሚገኝ በደሙም የሆነ ማስተስሪያ አድርጎ አቆመው፤ ይህም በፊት የተደረገውን ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ችሎታ ስለ መተው ጽድቁን ያሳይ ዘንድ ነው፥

verses.text_english: Whom God hath set forth a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.text_amharic: ራሱም ጻድቅ እንዲሆን በኢየሱስም የሚያምነውን እንዲያጸድቅ አሁን በዚህ ዘመን ጽድቁን ያሳይ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: To declare, , at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ትምክህት እንግዲህ ወዴት ነው? እርሱ ቀርቶአል። በየትኛው ሕግ ነው? በሥራ ሕግ ነውን? አይደለም፥ በእምነት ሕግ ነው እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Where boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ያለ ሕግ ሥራ በእምነት እንዲጸድቅ እንቆጥራለንና።

verses.text_english: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
the God of the Jews only? not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ሕግን በእምነት እንሽራለንን? አይደለም፤ ሕግን እናጸናለን እንጂ።

verses.text_english: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በሥጋ አባታችን የሆነ አብርሃም ምን አገኘ እንላለን?

verses.text_english: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath to glory; but not before God.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም በሥራ ጸድቆ ቢሆን የሚመካበት አለውና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፍስ ምን አለ? አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ ጽድቅም ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።

verses.text_english: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚሠራ ደመወዝ እንደ ዕዳ ነው እንጂ እንደ ጸጋ አይቈጠርለትም፤

verses.text_english: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለማይሠራ፥ ኃጢአተኛውንም በሚያደድቅ ለሚያምን ሰው እምነቱ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ይቆጠርለታል።

verses.text_english: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ዳዊት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ሥራ ጽድቅን ስለሚቆጥርለት ስለ ሰው ብፅዕና ይናገራል እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.text_english: , Blessed they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃቸው የተሰረየላቸው ኃጢአታቸውም የተከደነላቸው ብፁዓን ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: Blessed the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ኃጢአቱን የማይቆጥርበት ሰው ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.text_english: this blessedness then upon the circumcision , or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ይህ ብፅዕና ስለ መገረዝ ተነገረ? ወይስ ደግሞ ስለ አለመገረዝ? እምነቱ ለአብርሃም ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት እንላለንና።

verses.text_english: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.text_amharic: እንዴት ተቆጠረለት? ተገርዞ ሳለ ነውን? ወይስ ሳይገረዝ? ተገርዞስ አይደለም፥ ሳይገረዝ ነበር እንጂ።

verses.text_english: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.text_amharic: ሳይገረዝም በነበረው እምነት ያገኘው የጽድቅ ማኅተም የሆነ የመገረዝን ምልክት ተቀበለ፤ ይህም እነርሱ ደግሞ ጻድቃን ሆነው ይቆጠሩ ዘንድ ሳይገረዙ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ አባት እንዲሆን ነው፥

verses.text_english: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which being uncircumcised.
verses.text_amharic: ለተገረዙትም አባት እንዲሆን ነው፤ ይኸውም ለተገረዙት ብቻ አይደለም ነገር ግን አባታችን አብርሃም ሳይገረዝ የነበረውን የእምነቱን ፍለጋ ደግሞ ለሚከተሉ ነው።

verses.text_english: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.text_amharic: የዓለምም ወራሽ እንዲሆን ለአብርሃምና ለዘሩ የተሰጠው የተስፋ ቃል በእምነት ጽድቅ ነው እንጂ በሕግ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For if they which are of the law heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.text_amharic: ከሕግ የሆኑትስ ወራሾች ከሆኑ እምነት ከንቱ ሆኖአል የተስፋውም ቃል ተሽሮአል፤

verses.text_english: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, no transgression.
verses.text_amharic: ሕጉ መቅሠፍትን ያደርጋልና፤ ነገር ግን ሕግ በሌለበት መተላለፍ የለም።

verses.text_english: Therefore of faith, that by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
(As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.text_amharic: ዘርህ እንዲሁ ሊሆን ነው እንደ ተባለ፥ ተስፋ ባልሆነው ጊዜ የብዙ አሕዛብ አባት እንዲሆን ተስፋ ይዞ አመነ።

verses.text_english: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.text_amharic: የመቶ ዓመትም ሽማግሌ ስለ ሆነ እንደ ምውት የሆነውን የራሱን ሥጋና የሳራ ማኅፀን ምውት መሆኑን በእምነቱ ሳይደክም ተመለከተ፤

verses.text_english: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት።

verses.text_english: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን። ተቈጠረለት የሚለው ቃል ስለ እርሱ ብቻ የተጻፈ አይደለም፥ ስለ እኛም ነው እንጂ፤

verses.text_english: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በእምነት ከጸደቅን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምን እንያዝ፤

verses.text_english: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ደግሞ ወደ ቆምንበት ወደዚህ ጸጋ በእምነት መግባትን አግኝተናል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ክብርም ተስፋ እንመካለን።

verses.text_english: And not only , but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን መከራ ትዕግሥትን እንዲያደርግ፥ ትዕግሥትም ፈተናን ፈተናም ተስፋን እንዲያደርግ እያወቅን፥ በመከራችን ደግሞ እንመካለን፤

verses.text_english: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.text_amharic: በተሰጠንም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በልባችን ስለ ፈሰሰ ተስፋ አያሳፍርም።

verses.text_english: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.text_amharic: ገና ደካሞች ሳለን ክርስቶስ ዘመኑ ሲደርስ ስለ ኃጢአተኞች ሞቶአልና።

verses.text_english: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ጻድቅ የሚሞት በጭንቅ ይገኛልና፤ ስለ ቸር ሰው ግን ሊሞት እንኳ የሚደፍር ምናልባት ይገኝ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ገና ኃጢአተኞች ሳለን ክርስቶስ ስለ እኛ ሞቶአልና እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ ያለውን የራሱን ፍቅር ያስረዳል።

verses.text_english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንስ እንግዲህ አሁን በደሙ ከጸደቅን በእርሱ ከቍጣው እንድናለን።

verses.text_english: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶች ሳለን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር በልጁ ሞት ከታረቅን፥ ይልቁንም ከታረቅን በኋላ በሕይወቱ እንድናለን፤

verses.text_english: And not only , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን አሁን መታረቁን ባገኘንበት በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል በእግዚአብሔር ደግሞ እንመካለን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምክንያት ኃጢአት በአንድ ሰው ወደ ዓለም ገባ በኃጢአትም ሞት፥ እንደዚሁም ሁሉ ኃጢአትን ስላደረጉ ሞት ለሰው ሁሉ ደረሰ፤
