verses.text_english: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግ ሁሉ በአንድ ቃል ይፈጸማልና፥ እርሱም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ የሚል ነው።

verses.text_english: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እርስ በርሳችሁ ብትነካከሱ ብትበላሉ እርስ በርሳችሁ እንዳትጠፋፉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እላለሁ፥ በመንፈስ ተመላለሱ፥ የሥጋንም ምኞት ከቶ አትፈጽሙ።

verses.text_english: I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.text_amharic: ሥጋ በመንፈስ ላይ መንፈስም በሥጋ ላይ ይመኛልና፥ እነዚህም እርስ በርሳቸው ይቀዋወማሉ፤ ስለዚህም የምትወዱትን ልታደርጉ አትችሉም።

verses.text_english: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስ ብትመሩ ግን ከሕግ በታች አይደላችሁም።

verses.text_english: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.text_amharic: የሥጋ ሥራም የተገለጠ ነው እርሱም ዝሙት፥ ርኵሰት፥

verses.text_english: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are ; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.text_amharic: መዳራት፥ ጣዖትን ማምለክ፥ ምዋርት፥ ጥል፥ ክርክር፥ ቅንዓት፥ ቁጣ፥ አድመኛነት፥

verses.text_english: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.text_amharic: መለያየት፥ መናፍቅነት፥ ምቀኝነት፥ መግደል፥ ስካር፥ ዘፋኝነት፥ ይህንም የሚመስል ነው። አስቀድሜም እንዳልሁ፥ እንደዚህ ያሉትን የሚያደርጉ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት አይወርሱም።

verses.text_english: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.text_amharic: የመንፈስ ፍሬ ግን ፍቅር፥ ደስታ፥ ሰላም፥ ትዕግሥት፥ ቸርነት፥ በጎነት፥ እምነት፥ የውሃት፥ ራስን መግዛት ነው።

verses.text_english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ያሉትን የሚከለክል ሕግ የለም።

verses.text_english: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.text_amharic: የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም የሆኑቱ ሥጋን ከክፉ መሻቱና ከምኞቱ ጋር ሰቀሉ።

verses.text_english: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስ ብንኖር በመንፈስ ደግሞ እንመላለስ።

verses.text_english: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችን እየተነሣሣንና እየተቀናናን በከንቱ አንመካ።

verses.text_english: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሰው በማናቸውም በደል ስንኳ ቢገኝ፥ መንፈሳውያን የሆናችሁ እናንተ እንደዚህ ያለውን ሰው በየውሃት መንፈስ አቅኑት፤ አንተ ደግሞ እንዳትፈተን ራስህን ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ የአንዱን ሸክም ይሸከም እንዲሁም የክርስቶስን ሕግ ፈጽሙ።

verses.text_english: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.text_amharic: አንዱ ምንም ሳይሆን ምንም የሆነ ቢመስለው ራሱን ያታልላልና።

verses.text_english: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ራሱን ሥራ ይፈትን፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ስለ ሌላው ሰው ያልሆነ ስለ ራሱ ብቻ የሚመካበትን ያገኛል፤

verses.text_english: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ራሱን ሸክም ሊሸከም ነውና።

verses.text_english: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ቃሉን የሚማር ከሚያስተምረው ጋር መልካምን ነገር ሁሉ ይከፋፈል።

verses.text_english: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.text_amharic: አትሳቱ፤ እግዚአብሔር አይዘበትበትም። ሰው የሚዘራውን ሁሉ ያንኑ ደግሞ ያጭዳልና፤

verses.text_english: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.text_amharic: በገዛ ሥጋው የሚዘራ ከሥጋ መበስበስን ያጭዳልና፥ በመንፈስ ግን የሚዘራው ከመንፈስ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ያጭዳል።

verses.text_english: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.text_amharic: ባንዝልም በጊዜው እናጭዳለንና መልካም ሥራን ለመሥራት አንታክት።

verses.text_english: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all , especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ ጊዜ ካገኘን ዘንድ ለሰው ሁሉ ይልቁንም ለሃይማኖት ቤተ ሰዎች መልካም እናድርግ።

verses.text_english: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.text_amharic: እንዴት ባሉ ታላላቆች ፊደላት በእጄ እንደ ጻፍሁላችሁ እዩ።

verses.text_english: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.text_amharic: በሥጋ መልካም ሆነው ሊታዩ የሚወዱ ሁሉ እንድትገረዙ ግድ አሉአችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ስለ ክርስቶስ መስቀል እንዳይሰደዱ ብቻ ነው።

verses.text_english: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.text_amharic: በሥጋችሁ እንዲመኩ ልትገረዙ ይወዳሉ እንጂ የተገረዙቱ ራሳቸው እንኳ ሕግን አይጠብቁም።

verses.text_english: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ዓለም ለእኔ የተሰቀለበት እኔም ለዓለም የተሰቀልሁበት ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መስቀል በቀር ሌላ ትምክህት ከእኔ ይራቅ።

verses.text_english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ አዲስ ፍጥረት መሆን ይጠቅማል እንጂ መገረዝ ቢሆን ወይም አለመገረዝ አይጠቅምምና።

verses.text_english: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ሥርዓት በሚመላለሱ ሁሉ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር እስራኤልም ላይ ሰላምና ምሕረት ይሁን።

verses.text_english: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ የኢየሱስን ማኅተም በሥጋዬ ተሸክሜአለሁና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አንድ ስንኳ አያድክመኝ።

verses.text_english: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with your spirit. Amen. « Galatians written from Rome.»
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከመንፈሳችሁ ጋር ይሁን። አሜን።

verses.text_english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥ በኤፌሶን ላሉት ቅዱሳን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም ላሉት ምእመናን፤

verses.text_english: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Blessed the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly in Christ:
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ በሰማያዊ ስፍራ በመንፈሳዊ በረከት ሁሉ የባረከን የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክና አባት ይባረክ።

verses.text_english: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.text_amharic: ዓለም ሳይፈጠር፥ በፊቱ ቅዱሳንና ነውር የሌለን በፍቅር እንሆን ዘንድ በክርስቶስ መረጠን።

verses.text_english: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.text_amharic: በበጎ ፈቃዱ እንደ ወደደ፥ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሥራ ለእርሱ ልጆች ልንሆን አስቀድሞ ወሰነን።

verses.text_english: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.text_amharic: በውድ ልጁም እንዲያው የሰጠን የጸጋው ክብር ይመሰገን ዘንድ ይህን አደረገ።

verses.text_english: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.text_amharic: በውድ ልጁም፥ እንደ ጸጋው ባለ ጠግነት መጠን፥ በደሙ የተደረገ ቤዛነታችንን አገኘን እርሱም የበደላችን ስርየት።

verses.text_english: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.text_amharic: ጸጋውንም በጥበብና በአእምሮ ሁሉ አበዛልን።

verses.text_english: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ለማድረግ እንደ ወደደ እንደ አሳቡ፥ የፈቃዱን ምሥጢር አስታውቆናልና፤

verses.text_english: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; in him:
verses.text_amharic: በዘመን ፍጻሜ ይደረግ ዘንድ ያለው አሳቡም በሰማይና በምድር ያለውን ሁሉ በክርስቶስ ለመጠቅለል ነው።

verses.text_english: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ፈቃዱ ምክር ሁሉን የሚሠራ እንደ እርሱ አሳብ፥ አስቀድመን የተወሰንን በክርስቶስ ደግሞ ርስትን ተቀበልን።

verses.text_english: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም፥ በክርስቶስ አስቀድመን ተስፋ ያደረግን እኛ ለክብሩ ምስጋና እንሆን ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: In whom ye also , after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ደግሞ የእውነትን ቃል፥ ይኸውም የመዳናችሁን ወንጌል፥ ሰምታችሁ ደግሞም በክርስቶስ አምናችሁ፥ በተስፋው መንፈስ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ታተማችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የርስታችን መያዣ ነው፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እስኪዋጅ ድረስ፥ ይህም ለክብሩ ምስጋና ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚሆን በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስለ ማመንና ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ስለሚሆን መውደድ ሰምቼ፥

verses.text_english: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ እያመሰገንሁ ስጸልይ ስለ እናንተ ማሳሰብን አልተውም፤

verses.text_english: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
verses.text_amharic: የክብር አባት የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክ እርሱን በማወቅ የጥበብንና የመገለጥን መንፈስ እንዲሰጣችሁ እለምናለሁ።

verses.text_english: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
And what the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set at his own right hand in the heavenly ,
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ከሁሉ በላይም ራስ እንዲሆን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም አካሉና ሁሉን በሁሉ የሚሞላ የእርሱ ሙላቱ ናት።

verses.text_english: And you , who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.text_amharic: በበደላችሁና በኃጢአታችሁ ሙታን ነበራችሁ፤ በእነርሱም፥

verses.text_english: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ዓለም እንዳለው ኑሮ፥ በማይታዘዙትም ልጆች ላይ አሁን ለሚሠራው መንፈስ አለቃ እንደ ሆነው በአየር ላይ ሥልጣን እንዳለው አለቃ ፈቃድ፥ በፊት ተመላለሳችሁባቸው።

verses.text_english: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም ልጆች መካከል እኛ ሁላችን ደግሞ፥ የሥጋችንንና የልቡናችንን ፈቃድ እያደረግን፥ በሥጋችን ምኞት በፊት እንኖር ነበርን እንደ ሌሎቹም ደግሞ ከፍጥረታችን የቁጣ ልጆች ነበርን።

verses.text_english: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በምሕረቱ ባለ ጠጋ ስለ ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
verses.text_amharic: ከወደደን ከትልቅ ፍቅሩ የተነሣ በበደላችን ሙታን እንኳ በሆንን ጊዜ ከክርስቶስ ጋር ሕይወት ሰጠን፥ በጸጋ ድናችኋልና፥

verses.text_english: And hath raised up together, and made sit together in heavenly in Christ Jesus:
That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: በሚመጡ ዘመናትም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ለእኛ ባለው ቸርነት ከሁሉ የሚበልጠውን የጸጋውን ባለ ጠግነት ያሳይ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር አስነሣን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም በሰማያዊ ስፍራ ከእርሱ ጋር አስቀመጠን።

verses.text_english: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: the gift of God:
verses.text_amharic: ጸጋው በእምነት አድኖአችኋልና፤ ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ነው እንጂ ከእናንተ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም እንዳይመካ ከሥራ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ፍጥረቱ ነንና፤ እንመላለስበት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ ያዘጋጀውን መልካሙን ሥራ ለማድረግ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ተፈጠርን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore remember, that ye in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እናንተ አስቀድሞ በሥጋ አሕዛብ የነበራችሁ፥ በሥጋ በእጅ የተገረዙ በተባሉት ያልተገረዙ የተባላችሁ፥ ይህን አስቡ፤

verses.text_english: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያ ዘመን ከእስራኤል መንግሥት ርቃችሁ ለተስፋውም ቃል ኪዳን እንግዶች ሆናችሁ በዚህም ዓለም ተስፋን አጥታችሁ ከእግዚአብሔርም ተለይታችሁ ያለ ክርስቶስ ነበራችሁ።

verses.text_english: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን እናንተ በፊት ርቃችሁ የነበራችሁ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ሆናችሁ በክርስቶስ ደም ቀርባችኋል።

verses.text_english: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition ;
Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, the law of commandments in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, making peace;
verses.text_amharic: ጥልንም በመስቀሉ ገድሎ በእርሱ ሁለታቸውን በአንድ አካል ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ያስታርቅ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.text_amharic: መጥቶም ርቃችሁ ለነበራችሁ ለእናንተ ሰላምን፥ ቀርበው ለነበሩትም ሰላምን የምስራች ብሎ ሰበከ፤

verses.text_english: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ሥራ ሁላችን በአንድ መንፈስ ወደ አብ መግባት አለንና።

verses.text_english: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከቅዱሳን ጋር ባላገሮችና የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ ሰዎች ናችሁ እንጂ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች አይደላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.text_amharic: በሐዋርያትና በነቢያት መሠረት ላይ ታንጻችኋል፥ የማዕዘኑም ራስ ድንጋይ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ነው፤

verses.text_english: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner ;
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ሕንጻ ሁሉ እየተጋጠመ በጌታ ቅዱስ ቤተ መቅደስ እንዲሆን ያድጋል፤

verses.text_english: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም እናንተ ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር መኖሪያ ለመሆን በመንፈስ አብራችሁ ትሠራላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም አሕዛብ ስለ ሆናችሁ ስለ እናንተ የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እስር የሆንሁ እኔ ጳውሎስ ለእግዚአብሔር እንበረከካለሁ።

verses.text_english: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
verses.text_amharic: ለእናንተ ስለ ተሰጠኝ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጸጋ መጋቢነት በእርግጥ ሰምታችኋል፤

verses.text_english: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሜ በአጭሩ እንደ ጻፍሁ፥ ይህን ምሥጢር በመግለጥ አስታወቀኝ፤

verses.text_english: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ስታነቡ የክርስቶስን ምሥጢር እንዴት እንደማስተውል ልትመለከቱ ትችላላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም፥ አሕዛብ አብረው እንዲወርሱ፥ በአንድ አካልም አብረው እንዲሆኑ፥ በወንጌልም መስበክ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በሆነ የተስፋ ቃል አብረው እንዲካፈሉ፥ ለቅዱሳን ሐዋርያትና ለነቢያት በመንፈስ አሁን እንደ ተገለጠ በሌሎቹ ትውልዶች ዘንድ ለሰው ልጆች አልታወቀም።

verses.text_english: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ኃይሉ ሥራ እንደ ተሰጠኝም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስጦታ መጠንየወንጌል አገልጋይ ሆንሁለት።

verses.text_english: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
And to make all see what the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: ፍለጋ የሌለውን የክርስቶስን ባለ ጠግነት ለአሕዛብ እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ ሁሉንም በፈጠረው በእግዚአብሔር ከዘላለም የተሰወረው የምሥጢር ሥርዓት ምን እንደሆነ ለሁሉ እገልጥ ዘንድ ይህ ጸጋ ከቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይልቅ ለማንስ ለኔ ተሰጠ፤

verses.text_english: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ አሁን በቤተ ክርስቲያን በኩል በሰማያዊ ስፍራ ውስጥ ላሉት አለቆችና ሥልጣናት ትታወቅ ዘንድ፤

verses.text_english: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን የፈጸመው የዘላለም አሳብ ነበረ፥

verses.text_english: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱም ዘንድ ባለ እምነታችን በኩል በመታመን ድፍረትና መግባት በእርሱ አለን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ስለ እናንተ ስላለ መከራዬ እንዳትታክቱ እለምናችኋለሁ፥ ክብራችሁ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥

verses.text_english: May be able to comprehend with all saints what the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱ በቤተ ክርስቲያን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እስከ ትውልዶች ሁሉ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በጌታ እስር የሆንሁ እኔ በተጠራችሁበት መጠራታችሁ እንደሚገባ ትመላለሱ ዘንድ እለምናችኋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.text_amharic: በትሕትና ሁሉና በየዋህነት በትዕግሥትም፤ እርስ በርሳችሁ በፍቅር ታገሡ፤

verses.text_english: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.text_amharic: በሰላም ማሰሪያ የመንፈስን አንድነት ለመጠበቅ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.text_amharic: በመጠራታችሁ በአንድ ተስፋ እንደ ተጠራችሁ አንድ አካልና አንድ መንፈስ አለ፤

verses.text_english: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጌታ አንድ ሃይማኖት አንዲት ጥምቀት፤

verses.text_english: One God and Father of all, who above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁሉ በላይ የሚሆን በሁሉም የሚሠራ በሁሉም የሚኖር አንድ አምላክ የሁሉም አባት አለ።

verses.text_english: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንደ ክርስቶስ ስጦታ መጠን ለእያንዳንዳችን ጸጋ ተሰጠን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ። ወደ ላይ በወጣ ጊዜ ምርኮን ማረከ ለሰዎችም ስጦታን ሰጠ ይላል።

verses.text_english: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምድር ታችኛ ክፍል ደግሞ ወረደ ማለት ካልሆነ፥ ይህ ወጣ ማለትስ ምን ማለት ነው?

verses.text_english: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የወረደው ሁሉን ይሞላ ዘንድ ከሰማያት ሁሉ በላይ የወጣው ደግሞ ያው ነው።

verses.text_english: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ሐዋርያት፥ ሌሎቹም ነቢያት፥ ሌሎቹም ወንጌልን ሰባኪዎች፥ ሌሎቹም እረኞችና አስተማሪዎች እንዲሆኑ ሰጠ፤

verses.text_english: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ስሕተት ሽንገላ ባለ ተንኮል በሰዎችም ማታለል ምክንያት በትምህርት ነፋስ ሁሉ እየተፍገመገምን ወዲያና ወዲህም እየተንሳፈፍን ሕፃናት መሆን ወደ ፊት አይገባንም፥

verses.text_english: That we be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እውነትን በፍቅር እየያዝን በነገር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ራስ ወደሚሆን ወደ ክርስቶስ እንደግ፤

verses.text_english: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, Christ:
verses.text_amharic: ከእርሱም የተነሣ አካል ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ክፍል በልክ እንደሚሠራ፥ በተሰጠለት በጅማት ሁሉ እየተጋጠመና እየተያያዘ፥ ራሱን በፍቅር ለማነጽ አካሉን ያሳድጋል።

verses.text_english: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አሕዛብ ደግሞ በአእምሮአቸው ከንቱነት እንደሚመላለሱ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳትመላለሱ እላለሁ በጌታም ሆኜ እመሰክራለሁ።

verses.text_english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ ባለማወቃቸው ጠንቅ በልባቸውም ደንዳንነት ጠንቅ ልቡናቸው ጨለመ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ሕይወት ራቁ፤

verses.text_english: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
verses.text_amharic: ደንዝዘውም በመመኘት ርኵሰትን ሁሉ ለማድረግ ራሳቸውን ወደ ሴሰኝነት አሳልፈው ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ክርስቶስን እንደዚህ አልተማራችሁም፤

verses.text_english: But ye have not so learned Christ;
verses.text_amharic: በእርግጥ ሰምታችሁታልና፥ እውነትም በኢየሱስ እንዳለ በእርሱ ተምራችኋል፤

verses.text_english: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛ ኑሮአችሁን እያሰባችሁ እንደሚያታልል ምኞት የሚጠፋውን አሮጌውን ሰው አስወግዱ፥

verses.text_english: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.text_amharic: በአእምሮአችሁም መንፈስ ታደሱ፥

verses.text_english: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.text_amharic: ለእውነትም በሚሆኑ ጽድቅና ቅድስና እንደ እግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ የተፈጠረውን አዲሱን ሰው ልበሱ።

verses.text_english: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ውሸትን አስወግዳችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችን ብልቶች ሆነናልና እያንዳንዳችሁ ከባልንጀሮቻችሁ ጋር እውነትን ተነጋገሩ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.text_amharic: ተቆጡ ኃጢአትንም አታድርጉ፤

verses.text_english: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.text_amharic: በቁጣችሁ ላይ ፀሐይ አይግባ፥ ለዲያብሎስም ፈንታ አትስጡት።

verses.text_english: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.text_amharic: የሰረቀ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይስረቅ፥ ነገር ግን በዚያ ፈንታ ለጎደለው የሚያካፍለው እንዲኖርለት በገዛ እጆቹ መልካምን እየሠራ ይድከም።

verses.text_english: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
verses.text_amharic: ለሚሰሙት ጸጋን ይሰጥ ዘንድ፥ እንደሚያስፈልግ ለማነጽ የሚጠቅም ማናቸውም በጎ ቃል እንጂ ክፉ ቃል ከአፋችሁ ከቶ አይውጣ።

verses.text_english: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verses.text_amharic: ለቤዛም ቀን የታተማችሁበትን ቅዱሱን የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ አታሳዝኑ።

verses.text_english: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.text_amharic: መራርነትና ንዴት ቁጣም ጩኸትም መሳደብም ሁሉ ከክፋት ሁሉ ጋር ከእናንተ ዘንድ ይወገድ።

verses.text_english: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁም ቸሮችና ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ይቅር እንዳላችሁ ይቅር ተባባሉ።

verses.text_english: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደ ተወደዱ ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን የምትከተሉ ሁኑ፥

verses.text_english: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.text_amharic: ክርስቶስም ደግሞ እንደ ወደዳችሁ ለእግዚአብሔርም የመዓዛ ሽታ የሚሆንን መባንና መሥዋዕትን አድርጎ ስለ እናንተ ራሱን አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጠ በፍቅር ተመላለሱ።

verses.text_english: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.text_amharic: ለቅዱሳን እንደሚገባ ግን ዝሙትና ርኵሰት ሁሉ ወይም መመኘት በእናንተ ዘንድ ከቶ አይሰማ፤

verses.text_english: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያሳፍር ነገርም የስንፍና ንግግርም ወይም ዋዛ የማይገቡ ናቸውና አይሁኑ፥ ይልቁን ምስጋና እንጂ።

verses.text_english: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን እወቁ፤ አመንዝራም ቢሆን ወይም ርኵስ ወይም የሚመኝ እርሱም ጣዖትን የሚያመልክ በክርስቶስና በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ርስት የለውም።

verses.text_english: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ የተነሣ በማይታዘዙት ልጆች ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ ይመጣልና ማንም በከንቱ ንግግር አያታልላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተካፋዮች አትሁኑ፤

verses.text_english: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.text_amharic: ቀድሞ ጨለማ ነበራችሁና፥ አሁን ግን በጌታ ብርሃን ናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: (For the fruit of the Spirit in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ፍሬም ከሌለው ከጨለማ ሥራ ጋር አትተባበሩ፥ ይልቁን ግለጡት እንጂ፥

verses.text_english: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove .
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ በስውር ስለሚያደርጉት መናገር እንኳ ነውር ነውና፤

verses.text_english: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ግን በብርሃን ሲገለጥ ይታያል፤ የሚታየው ሁሉ ብርሃን ነውና።

verses.text_english: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ። አንተ የምትተኛ ንቃ ከሙታንም ተነሣ ክርስቶስም ያበራልሃል ይላል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደ ጥበበኞች እንጂ ጥበብ እንደሌላቸው ሳይሆን እንዴት እንድትመላለሱ በጥንቃቄ ተጠበቁ፤

verses.text_english: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.text_amharic: ቀኖቹ ክፉዎች ናቸውና ዘመኑን ዋጁ።

verses.text_english: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የጌታ ፈቃድ ምን እንደ ሆነ አስተውሉ እንጂ ሞኞች አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord .
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስ ይሙላባችሁ እንጂ በወይን ጠጅ አትስከሩ ይህ ማባከን ነውና፤

verses.text_english: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.text_amharic: በመዝሙርና በዝማሬ በመንፈሳዊም ቅኔ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተነጋገሩ፤ ለጌታ በልባችሁ ተቀኙና ዘምሩ፤

verses.text_english: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ስለ ሁሉ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም አምላካችንንና አባታችንን ስለ ሁሉ አመስግኑ።

verses.text_english: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዳችሁ በክርስቶስ ፍርሃት የተገዛችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቶች ሆይ፥ ለጌታ እንደምትገዙ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ፤

verses.text_english: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ክርስቶስ ደግሞ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ራስ እንደ ሆነ እርሱም አካሉን የሚያድን እንደ ሆነ ባል የሚስት ራስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለክርስቶስ እንደምትገዛ እንዲሁ ሚስቶች ደግሞ በሁሉ ለባሎቻቸው ይገዙ።

verses.text_english: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so the wives to their own husbands in every thing.
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.text_amharic: እድፈት ወይም የፊት መጨማደድ ወይም እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ሳይሆንባት ቅድስትና ያለ ነውር ትሆን ዘንድ ክብርት የሆነችን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለራሱ እንዲያቀርብ ፈለገ።

verses.text_english: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ባሎች ደግሞ እንደ ገዛ ሥጋቸው አድርገው የገዛ ሚስቶቻቸውን ሊወዱአቸው ይገባቸዋል። የገዛ ሚስቱን የሚወድ ራሱን ይወዳል፤

verses.text_english: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.text_english: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ምሥጢር ታላቅ ነው፥ እኔ ግን ይህን ስለ ክርስቶስና ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.text_amharic: ሆኖም ከእናንተ ደግሞ እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ሚስቱን እንዲህ እንደ ራሱ አድርጎ ይውደዳት፥ ሚስቱም ባልዋን ትፍራ።

verses.text_english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ለወላጆቻችሁ በጌታ ታዘዙ፥ ይህ የሚገባ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: መልካም እንዲሆንልህ ዕድሜህም በምድር ላይ እንዲረዝም አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እርስዋም የተስፋ ቃል ያላት ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ናት።

verses.text_english: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም አባቶች ሆይ፥ ልጆቻችሁን በጌታ ምክርና በተግሣጽ አሳድጉአቸው እንጂ አታስቆጡአቸው።

verses.text_english: Servants, be obedient to them that are masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ ለክርስቶስ እንደምትታዘዙ በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ በልባችሁ ቅንነት በሥጋ ጌቶቻችሁ ለሆኑ ታዘዙ፤

verses.text_english: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ እንደሚያደርጉ እንደ ክርስቶስ ባሪያዎች እንጂ ለሰው ደስ እንደምታሰኙ ለታይታ የምትገዙ አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምትገዙ በትጋትና በበጎ ፈቃድ ተገዙ፤

verses.text_english: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether bond or free.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያ ቢሆን ወይም ጨዋ ሰው፥ እያንዳንዱ የሚያደርገውን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ ከጌታ በብድራት እንዲቀበለው ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ጌቶች ሆይ፥ ዛቻውን ትታችሁ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፥ በእነርሱና በእናንተ ላይ የሚገዛው ጌታ በሰማይ እንዳለ ለሰው ፊትም እንዳያደላ ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.text_amharic: በቀረውስ በጌታና በኃይሉ ችሎት የበረታችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.text_amharic: የዲያብሎስን ሽንገላ ትቃወሙ ዘንድ እንዲቻላችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ዕቃ ጦር ሁሉ ልበሱ።

verses.text_english: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high .
verses.text_amharic: መጋደላችን ከደምና ከሥጋ ጋር አይደለምና፥ ከአለቆችና ከሥልጣናት ጋር ከዚህም ከጨለማ ዓለም ገዦች ጋር በሰማያዊም ስፍራ ካለ ከክፋት መንፈሳውያን ሠራዊት ጋር ነው እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በክፉው ቀን ለመቃወም፥ ሁሉንም ፈጽማችሁ ለመቆም እንድትችሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ዕቃ ጦር ሁሉ አንሡ።

verses.text_english: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.text_amharic: በሁሉም ላይ ጨምራችሁ የሚንበለበሉትን የክፉውን ፍላጻዎች ሁሉ ልታጠፉ የምትችሉበትን የእምነትን ጋሻ አንሡ፤

verses.text_english: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.text_amharic: የመዳንንም ራስ ቁር የመንፈስንም ሰይፍ ያዙ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።

verses.text_english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.text_amharic: በጸሎትና በልመናም ሁሉ ዘወትር በመንፈስ ጸልዩ፤ በዚህም አሳብ ስለ ቅዱሳን ሁሉ እየለመናችሁ በመጽናት ሁሉ ትጉ፤

verses.text_english: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ የወንጌልን ምሥጢር በግልጥ እንዳስታውቅ አፌን በመክፈት ቃል ይሰጠኝ ዘንድ ስለ እኔ ለምኑ፤

verses.text_english: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ወንጌልም በሰንሰለት መልእክተኛ የሆንሁ፥ መናገር እንደሚገባኝ ስለ እርሱ በግልጥ እናገር ዘንድ ለምኑ።

verses.text_english: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እናንተ ደግሞ እንዴት እንዳለሁ ኑሮዬን እንድታውቁ የተወደደ ወንድምና በጌታ የታመነ አገልጋይ ቲኪቆስ ሁሉን ያስታውቃችኋል፤

verses.text_english: But that ye also may know my affairs, how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.text_amharic: ወሬአችንን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያጽናና ወደ እናንተ የምልከው ስለዚህ ምክንያት ነው።

verses.text_english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and he might comfort your hearts.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምና ፍቅር ከእምነት ጋር ለወንድሞች ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Peace to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታችንን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ባለመጥፋት ከሚወዱ ሁሉ ጋር ጸጋ ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.text_amharic: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያዎች የሆኑ ጳውሎስና ጢሞቴዎስ በፊልጵስዩስ ለሚኖሩ ከኤጲስ ቆጶሳትና ከዲያቆናት ጋር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ላሉት ቅዱሳን ሁሉ፤

verses.text_english: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ በጸሎቴ ሁሉ ስለ እናንተ ሁሉ በደስታ እየጸለይሁ፥ ከፊተኛው ቀን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንጌልን በመስበክ አብራችሁ ስለ ሠራችሁ፥ ባሰብኋችሁ ጊዜ ሁሉ አምላኬን አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተ መልካምን ሥራ የጀመረው እስከ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ቀን ድረስ እንዲፈጽመው ይህን ተረድቼአለሁና፤

verses.text_english: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
verses.text_amharic: በእስራቴም ወንጌልንም መመከቻና መጽኛ በማድረግ ሁላችሁ ከእኔ ጋር በጸጋ ተካፋዮች ስለ ሆናችሁ፥ በልቤ ትኖራላችሁና ስለ ሁላችሁ ይህን ላስብ ይገባኛል።

verses.text_english: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፍቅር ሁላችሁን እንዴት እንድናፍቃችሁ እግዚአብሔር ምስክሬ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all judgment;
That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔርም ክብርና ምስጋና ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የሚገኝ የጽድቅ ፍሬ ሞልቶባችሁ፥ ለክርስቶስ ቀን ተዘጋጅታችሁ ቅኖችና አለ ነውር እንድትሆኑ የሚሻለውን ነገር ፈትናችሁ ትወዱ ዘንድ፥ ፍቅራችሁ በእውቀትና በማስተዋል ሁሉ ከፊት ይልቅ እያደገ እንዲበዛ ይህን እጸልያለሁ።

verses.text_english: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ይህ የደረሰብኝ በእውነት ወንጌልን ለማስፋት እንደ ሆነ ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other ;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም እስራቴ ስለ ክርስቶስ እንዲሆን በንጉሥ ዘበኞች ሁሉና በሌሎች ሁሉ ዘንድ ተገልጦአል፥

verses.text_english: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታም ካሉት ወንድሞች የሚበዙት ስለ እስራቴ ታምነው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንዲነግሩ ያለ ፍርሃት ከፊት ይልቅ ይደፍራሉ።

verses.text_english: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.text_amharic: አንዳንዶች ከቅንአትና ከክርክር እንኳ ሌሎች ግን ከበጎ ፈቃድ የተነሣ ክርስቶስን ይሰብኩታል፤

verses.text_english: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ወንጌልን መመከቻ ለማድረግ እንደ ተሾምሁ አውቀው በፍቅር ይሰብካሉ፥

verses.text_english: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያ ግን በእስራቴ ላይ መከራን ሊያመጡብኝ መስሎአቸው፥ ለወገናቸው የሚጠቅም ፈልገው በቅን አሳብ ሳይሆኑ ስለ ክርስቶስ ያወራሉ።

verses.text_english: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: ምን አለ? ቢሆንም በሁሉ ጎዳና፥ በማመካኘት ቢሆን ወይም በቅንነት ቢሆን፥ ክርስቶስ ይሰበካል ስለዚህም ደስ ብሎኛል።

verses.text_english: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊትም ደግሞ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ይህ በጸሎታችሁና በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መንፈስ መሰጠት ለመዳኔ እንዲሆንልኝ አውቃለሁና፥

verses.text_english: According to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ናፍቆቴ ተስፋዬም ነውና፤ በአንድ ነገር እንኳ አላፍርም ነገር ግን በህይወት ብኖር ወይም ብሞት፥ ክርስቶስ በግልጥነት ሁሉ እንደ ወትሮው አሁን ደግሞ በስጋዬ ይከብራል።

verses.text_english: For to me to live Christ, and to die gain.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔ ሕይወት ክርስቶስ፥ ሞትም ጥቅም ነውና።

verses.text_english: But if I live in the flesh, this the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በስጋ መኖር ለእኔ የሥራ ፍሬ ቢሆን፥ ምን እንድመርጥ ኣላስታውቅም።

verses.text_english: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም በሁለቱ እጨነቃለሁ፤ ልሄድ ከክርስቶስም ጋር ልኖር እናፍቃለሁ፥ ከሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ የሚሻል ነውና፤

verses.text_english: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh more needful for you.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በሥጋ መኖሬ ስለ እናንተ እጅግ የሚያስፈልግ ነው።

verses.text_english: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
verses.text_amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፥ መጥቼ ባያችሁ ወይም ብርቅ፥ በአንድ ልብ ስለ ወንጌል ሃይማኖት አብራችሁ እየተጋደላችሁ፥ በአንድ መንፈስ እንድትቆሙ ስለ ኑሮአችሁ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ለክርስቶስ ወንጌል እንደሚገባ ኑሩ።

verses.text_english: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.text_amharic: በአንድም ነገር እንኳ በተቃዋሚዎች አትደንግጡ፤ ይህም ለእነርሱ የጥፋት፥ ለእናንተ ግን የመዳን ምልክት ነው፥ ይህም ከእግዚአብሔር ነው፤

verses.text_english: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ስለ ክርስቶስ ተሰጥቶአችኋልና፤ ስለ እርሱ መከራ ደግሞ ልትቀበሉ እንጂ በእርሱ ልታምኑ ብቻ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ያያችሁት አሁንም በእኔ እንዳለ የምትሰሙት፥ ያው መጋደል ደርሶባችኋልና።

verses.text_english: If therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስም አንዳች ምክር ቢሆን፥ የፍቅር መጽናናት ቢሆን፥ የመንፈስ ኅብረት ቢሆን፥ ምሕረትና ርኅራኄ ቢሆኑ፥ ደስታዬን ፈጽሙልኝ፤

verses.text_english: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, of one accord, of one mind.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ አሳብ ተስማሙ፥ አንድ ፍቅር አንድም ልብ አንድም አሳብ ይሁንላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: nothing through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.text_amharic: ለወገኔ ይጠቅማል በማለት ወይም በከንቱ ውዳሴ ምክንያት አንድ እንኳ አታድርጉ፥ ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራው ከራሱ ይልቅ እንዲሻል በትሕትና ይቍጠር፤

verses.text_english: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱ ለራሱ የሚጠቅመውን አይመልከት፥ ለባልንጀራው ደግሞ እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የነበረ ይህ አሳብ በእናንተ ዘንድ ደግሞ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ሲኖር ሳለ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር መተካከልን መቀማት እንደሚገባ ነገር አልቈጠረውም፥

verses.text_english: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የባሪያን መልክ ይዞ በሰውም ምሳሌ ሆኖ ራሱን ባዶ አደረገ፥

verses.text_english: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verses.text_amharic: በምስሉም እንደ ሰው ተገኝቶ ራሱን አዋረደ፥ ለሞትም ይኸውም የመስቀል ሞት እንኳ የታዘዘ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ምክንያት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ልክ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው፥ ከስምም ሁሉ በላይ ያለውን ስም ሰጠው፤

verses.text_english: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of in heaven, and in earth, and under the earth;
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በሰማይና በምድር ከምድርም በታች ያሉት ሁሉ በኢየሱስ ስም ይንበረከኩ ዘንድ፥

verses.text_english: And every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.text_amharic: መላስም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር አብ ክብር ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጌታ እንደ ሆነ ይመሰክር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ሁልጊዜ እንደ ታዘዛችሁ፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ በመኖሬ ብቻ ሳይሆን ይልቁን አሁን ስርቅ፥ በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ የራሳችሁን መዳን ፈጽሙ፤

verses.text_english: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of good pleasure.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ በጎ ፈቃዱ መፈለግንም ማድረግንም በእናንተ የሚሠራ እግዚአብሔር ነውና።

verses.text_english: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም መካከል የሕይወትን ቃል እያቀረባችሁ በዓለም እንደ ብርሃን ትታያላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም በከንቱ እንዳልሮጥሁ በከንቱም እንዳልደከምሁ በክርስቶስ ቀን የምመካበት ይሆንልኛል።

verses.text_english: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእምነታችሁ መሥዋዕትና አገልግሎት ተጨምሬ ሕይወቴ እንኳ ቢፈስ፥ ደስ ብሎኛል፤ ከሁላችሁም ጋር አብሬ ደስ ብሎኛል፤

verses.text_english: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ደግሞ እንዲሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ ከእኔም ጋር አብራችሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ኑሮአችሁን ሳውቅ እኔ ደግሞ ደስ እንዲለኝ ፈጥኜ ጢሞቴዎስን ልልክላችሁ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.text_english: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ እርሱ ያለ፥ ስለ ኑሮአችሁ በቅንነት የሚጨነቅ፥ ማንም የለኝምና፤

verses.text_english: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ የራሳቸውን ይፈልጋሉና፥ የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ልጅ ለአባቱ እንደ ሚያገለግል ከእኔ ጋር ሆኖ ለወንጌል እንደ አገለገለ መፈተኑን ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንዴት እንደምሆን ባየሁ ጊዜ፥ እርሱን ቶሎ እንድልክ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.text_amharic: ራሴ ደግሞ ግን ፈጥኜ እንድመጣ በጌታ ታምኜአለሁ።

verses.text_english: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወንድሜንና ከእኔ ጋር አብሮ ሠራተኛ ወታደርም የሚሆነውን፥ የእናንተ ግን መልእክተኛ የሆነውና የሚያስፈልገኝን የሚያገለግለውን አፍሮዲጡን እንድልክላችሁ በግድ አስባለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችሁን ይናፍቃልና፥ እንደ ታመመም ስለ ሰማችሁ ይተክዛል።

verses.text_english: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ታሞ ለሞት እንኳ ቀርቦ ነበርና፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ማረው፥ ኀዘን በኀዘን ላይ እንዳይጨመርብኝ ለእኔ ደግሞ እንጂ ለእርሱ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደ ገና ስታዩት ደስ እንዲላችሁ ለእኔም ኀዘኔ እንዲቃለል በብዙ ፍጥነት እልከዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በሙሉ ደስታ በጌታ ተቀበሉት፥ እርሱን የሚመስሉትንም አክብሩአቸው፤

verses.text_english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
verses.text_amharic: በእኔ ዘንድ ካላችሁ አገልግሎት እናንተ ስለሌላችሁ የጎደለኝን እንዲፈጽም፥ በነፍሱ ተወራርዶ ከጌታ ሥራ የተነሣ እስከ ሞት ቀርቦአልና።

verses.text_english: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed not grievous, but for you safe.
verses.text_amharic: በቀረውስ፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ በጌታ ደስ ይበላችሁ። ስለ አንድ ነገር መልሼ ልጽፍላችሁ እኔን አይታክተኝም ለእናንተ ግን ደኅና ነው።

verses.text_english: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.text_amharic: ከውሾች ተጠበቁ፥ ከክፉዎችም ሠራተኞች ተጠበቁ፥ ከሐሰተኛም መገረዝ ተጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ በመንፈስ እግዚአብሔርን የምናመልክ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም የምንመካ በሥጋም የማንታመን እኛ የተገረዝን ነንና።

verses.text_english: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ግን በሥጋ ደግሞ የምታመንበት አለኝ። ሌላ ሰው ማንም ቢሆን በሥጋ የሚታመንበት እንዳለው ቢመስለው፥ እኔ እበልጠዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.text_amharic: በስምንተኛው ቀን የተገረዝሁ፥ ከእስራኤል ትውልድ፥ ከብንያም ወገን፥ ከዕብራውያን ዕብራዊ ነኝ፤ ስለ ሕግ ብትጠይቁ፥ ፈሪሳዊ ነበርሁ፤

verses.text_english: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ቅንዓት ብትጠይቁ፥ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን አሳዳጅ ነበርሁ፤ በሕግ ስለሚገኝ ጽድቅ ብትጠይቁ፥ ያለ ነቀፋ ነበርሁ።

verses.text_english: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለእኔ ረብ የነበረውን ሁሉ ስለ ክርስቶስ እንደ ጉዳት ቈጥሬዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Yea doubtless, and I count all things loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them dung, that I may win Christ,
And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
verses.text_amharic: አዎን፥ በእውነት ከሁሉ ይልቅ ስለሚበልጥ ስለ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ስለ ጌታዬ እውቀት ነገር ሁሉ ጉዳት እንዲሆን እቈጥራለሁ፤ ስለ እርሱ ሁሉን ተጐዳሁ፥ ክርስቶስንም አገኝ ዘንድ፥ በክርስቶስም በማመን ያለው ጽድቅ ማለት በእምነት ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያለው ጽድቅ እንጂ ከሕግ ለእኔ ያለው ጽድቅ ሳይሆንልኝ፥ በእርሱ እገኝ ዘንድ ሁሉን እንደ ጕድፍ እቈጥራለሁ፤

verses.text_english: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን እንዳገኘሁ ወይም አሁን ፍጹም እንደ ሆንሁ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ስለ እርሱ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የተያዝሁበትን ያን ደግሞ እይዛለሁ ብዬ እፈጥናለሁ።

verses.text_english: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ገና እንዳልያዝሁት እቈጥራለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንድ ነገር አደርጋለሁ፤ በኋላዬ ያለውን እየረሳሁ በፊቴ ያለውን ለመያዝ እዘረጋለሁ፥

verses.text_english: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but one thing , forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ከፍ ከፍ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን መጥራት ዋጋ እንዳገኝ ምልክትን እፈጥናለሁ።

verses.text_english: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ፍጹማን የሆንን ሁላችን ይህን እናስብ፤ በአንዳች ነገርም ልዩ አሳብ ቢኖራችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ደግሞ ይገልጥላችኋል፤

verses.text_english: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ሆኖም በደረስንበት በዚያ እንመላለስ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔን የምትመስሉ ሁኑ፥ እኛም እንደ ምሳሌ እንደምንሆንላችሁ፥ እንዲሁ የሚመላለሱትን ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙዎች ለክርስቶስ መስቀል ጠላቶቹ ሆነው ይመላለሳሉና፤ ብዙ ጊዜ ስለ እነርሱ አልኋችሁ፥ አሁንም እንኳ እያለቀስሁ እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.text_amharic: መጨረሻቸው ጥፋት ነው፥ ሆዳቸው አምላካቸው ነው፥ ክብራቸው በነውራቸው ነው፥ አሳባቸው ምድራዊ ነው።

verses.text_english: Whose end destruction, whose God belly, and glory in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.text_amharic: እኛ አገራችን በሰማይ ነውና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ የሚመጣ መድኃኒትን እርሱንም ጌታን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን እንጠባበቃለን፤

verses.text_english: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ሁሉን እንኳ ለራሱ ሊያስገዛ እንደሚችልበት አሠራር፥ ክቡር ሥጋውን እንዲመስል የተዋረደውን ሥጋችንን ይለውጣል።

verses.text_english: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, dearly beloved.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ የምወዳችሁና የምናፍቃችሁ፥ ደስታዬና አክሊሌ የምትሆኑ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እንዲሁ በጌታ ቁሙ፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ።

verses.text_english: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ አሳብ በጌታ እንዲስማሙ ኤዎድያንን እመክራለሁ ሲንጤኪንንም እመክራለሁ።

verses.text_english: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and other my fellowlabourers, whose names in the book of life.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ደግሞ በሥራዬ አብረህ የተጠመድህ እውነተኛ ሆይ፥ እንድታግዛቸው እለምንሃለሁ፤ ስሞቻቸው በሕይወት መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት ከቀሌምንጦስና ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር አብረው ከሠሩት ከሌሎቹ ጋር በወንጌል ከእኔ ጋር አብረው ተጋድለዋልና።

verses.text_english: Rejoice in the Lord alway: again I say, Rejoice.
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ በጌታ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ደግሜ እላለሁ፥ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ገርነታችሁ ለሰው ሁሉ ይታወቅ።

verses.text_english: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ቅርብ ነው። በነገር ሁሉ በጸሎትና በምልጃ ከምስጋና ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ልመናችሁን አስታውቁ እንጂ በአንዳች አትጨነቁ።

verses.text_english: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: አእምሮንም ሁሉ የሚያልፍ የእግዚአብሔር ሰላም ልባችሁንና አሳባችሁን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ይጠብቃል።

verses.text_english: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things honest, whatsoever things just, whatsoever things pure, whatsoever things lovely, whatsoever things of good report; if any virtue, and if any praise, think on these things.
verses.text_amharic: በቀረውስ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እውነተኛ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ጭምትነት ያለበትን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ጽድቅ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ንጹሕ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ፍቅር ያለበትን ነገር ሁሉ፥ መልካም ወሬ ያለበትን ነገር ሁሉ፥ በጎነት ቢሆን ምስጋናም ቢሆን፥ እነዚህን አስቡ፤

verses.text_english: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ የተማራችሁትንና የተቀበላችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ያያችሁትንም እነዚህን አድርጉ፤ የሰላምም አምላክ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አሁን ከጊዜ በኋላ ስለ እኔ እንደ ገና ልታስቡ ስለ ጀመራችሁ፥ በጌታ እጅግ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ጊዜ አጣችሁ እንጂ፥ ማሰብስ ታስቡ ነበር።

verses.text_english: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, to be content.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ስል ስለ ጉድለት አልልም፤ የምኖርበት ኑሮ ይበቃኛል ማለትን ተምሬአለሁና።

verses.text_english: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.text_amharic: መዋረድንም አውቃለሁ መብዛትንም አውቃለሁ፤ በእያንዳንዱ ነገር በነገርም ሁሉ መጥገብንና መራብንም መብዛትንና መጉደልን ተምሬአለሁ።

verses.text_english: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.text_amharic: ኃይልን በሚሰጠኝ በክርስቶስ ሁሉን እችላለሁ።

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
verses.text_amharic: ሆኖም በመከራዬ ከእኔ ጋር ስለ ተካፈላችሁ መልካም አደረጋችሁ።

verses.text_english: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
verses.text_amharic: የፊልጵስዩስ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ወንጌል በመጀመሪያ ሲሰበክ፥ ከመቄዶንያ በወጣሁ ጊዜ፥ ከእናንተ ብቻ በቀር ሌላ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በመስጠትና በመቀበል ስሌት ከእኔ ጋር እንዳልተካፈለች እናንተ ደግሞ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.text_amharic: በተሰሎንቄ እንኳ ሳለሁ፥ አንድ ጊዜና ሁለት ጊዜ ያስፈለገኝን ሰዳችሁልኝ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.text_amharic: በስሌታችሁ የሚበዛውን ፍሬ እንጂ ስጦታውን ፈላጊ አይደለሁም።

verses.text_english: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሁሉ አለኝ ይበዛልኝማል፤ የመዓዛ ሽታና የተወደደ መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ለእግዚአብሔርም ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ስጦታችሁን ከአፍሮዲጡ ተቀብዬ ተሞልቼአለሁ።

verses.text_english: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: አምላኬም እንደ ባለ ጠግነቱ መጠን በክብር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የሚያስፈልጋችሁን ሁሉ ይሞላባችኋል።

verses.text_english: Now unto God and our Father glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ለአምላካችንና ለአባታችንም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.text_amharic: ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ሰላምታ አቅርቡ። ከእኔ ጋር ያሉቱ ወንድሞች ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.text_english: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይልቁንም ከቄሣር ቤት የሆኑቱ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.text_english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with you all. Amen. « Philippians written from Rome, by Epaphroditus.»
verses.text_amharic: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከመንፈሳችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus brother,
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ ጢሞቴዎስም ወንድሙ፥

verses.text_english: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: በቈላስይስ ለሚኖሩ ቅዱሳንና በክርስቶስ ለታመኑ ወንድሞች፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love to all the saints,
For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ ስንጸልይ፥ በሰማይ ከተዘጋጀላችሁ ተስፋ የተነሣ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ስለ እምነታችሁ ለቅዱሳንም ሁሉ ስላላችሁ ፍቅር ሰምተን፥ የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አባት እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ እናመሰግናለን፤ ስለዚህም ተስፋ በወንጌል እውነት ቃል አስቀድማችሁ ሰማችሁ።

verses.text_english: Which is come unto you, as in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as also in you, since the day ye heard , and knew the grace of God in truth:
verses.text_amharic: ይህም በዓለም ሁሉ ደግሞ እንዳለ ወደ እናንተ ደርሶአል፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ጸጋ በእውነት ከሰማችሁበትና ካወቃችሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ፥ በእናንተ ደግሞ እንዳለ እንዲህ በዓለም ፍሬ ያፈራል ያድግማል።

verses.text_english: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
verses.text_amharic: ከተወደደ ከእኛም ጋር አብሮ ባሪያ ከሆነው ከኤጳፍራ እንዲህ ተማራችሁ፥ እርሱም ስለ እናንተ ታማኝ የክርስቶስ አገልጋይ ነው።

verses.text_english: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በመንፈስ ስለሚሆን ስለ ፍቅራችሁ አስታወቀን።

verses.text_english: For this cause we also, since the day we heard , do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚሁ እኛ ደግሞ ይህን ከሰማንበት ቀን ጀምረን የፈቃዱ እውቀት መንፈሳዊ ጥበብንና አእምሮን ሁሉ እንዲሞላባችሁ እየለመንን፥ ስለ እናንተ ጸሎትን አልተውንም።

verses.text_english: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.text_amharic: ከደስታም ጋር በሁሉ ለመጽናትና ለመታገሥ እንደ ክብሩ ጉልበት መጠን በኃይል ሁሉ እየበረታችሁ፥ በቅዱሳንም ርስት በብርሃን እንድንካፈል ያበቃንን አብን እያመሰገናችሁ፥ በነገር ሁሉ ደስ ልታሰኙ ለጌታ እንደሚገባ ትመላለሱ ዘንድ እንለምናለን።

verses.text_english: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated into the kingdom of his dear Son:
In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ከሁሉ በፊት ነው ሁሉም በእርሱ ተጋጥሞአል።

verses.text_english: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የአካሉ ማለት የቤተ ክርስቲያን ራስ ነው። እርሱም በሁሉ ፊተኛ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ መጀመሪያ ከሙታንም በኵር ነው።

verses.text_english: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all he might have the preeminence.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም፥ ተመሥርታችሁና ተደላድላችሁ ከሰማችሁትም ከወንጌል ተስፋ ሳትናወጡ፥ በሃይማኖት ጸንታችሁ ብትኖሩ ይሆናል። ያም ወንጌል ከሰማይ በታች ባለው ፍጥረት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተሰበከ ነው፥ እኔም ጳውሎስ የእርሱ አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: For it pleased that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.text_amharic: አሁን በመከራዬ ስለ እናንተ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ስለ አካሉም ማለት ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በሥጋዬ በክርስቶስ መከራ የጐደለውን እፈጽማለሁ።

verses.text_english: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, , whether things in earth, or things in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ እንደ ተሰጠኝ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢነት፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ፈጽሜ እንድሰብክ እኔ የቤተ ክርስቲያን አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.text_english: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ቃል ከዘላለምና ከትውልዶች ጀምሮ ተሰውሮ የነበረ ምሥጢር ነው፥ አሁን ግን ለቅዱሳኑ ተገልጦአል።

verses.text_english: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.text_amharic: ለእነርሱም እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ያለው የዚህ ምሥጢር ክብር ባለ ጠግነት ምን እንደ ሆነ ሊያስታውቅ ወደደ፥ ምሥጢሩም የክብር ተስፋ ያለው ክርስቶስ በእናንተ ዘንድ መሆኑ ነው።

verses.text_english: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.text_amharic: እኛም በክርስቶስ ፍጹም የሚሆን ሰውን ሁሉ እናቀርብ ዘንድ ሰውን ሁሉ እየገሠጽን ሰውንም ሁሉ በጥበብ ሁሉ እያስተማርን የምንሰብከው እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህም ነገር ደግሞ፥ በእኔ በኃይል እንደሚሠራ እንደ አሠራሩ እየተጋደልሁ፥ እደክማለሁ።

verses.text_english: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and them at Laodicea, and as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተና በሎዶቅያ ስላሉት ፊቴንም በሥጋ ስላላዩት ሁሉ እንዴት ያለ ትልቅ መጋደል እንዳለኝ ልታውቁ እወዳለሁና።

verses.text_english: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
verses.text_amharic: ልባቸው እንዲጸናና፥ በፍቅርም ተባብረው በማስተዋል ወደሚገኝበት ወደ መረዳት ባለ ጠግነት ሁሉ እንዲደርሱ የእግዚአብሔርንም ምሥጢር እርሱንም ክርስቶስን እንዲያውቁ እጋደላለሁ።

verses.text_english: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.text_amharic: የተሰወረ የጥበብና የእውቀት መዝገብ ሁሉ በእርሱ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም በሚያባብል ቃል እንዳያስታችሁ ይህን እላለሁ።

verses.text_english: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.text_amharic: በሥጋ ምንም እንኳ ብርቅ፥ በመንፈስ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና፥ ሥርዓታችሁንም በክርስቶስም ያለውን የእምነታችሁን ጽናት እያየሁ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.text_english: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk ye in him:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ጌታን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን እንደ ተቀበላችሁት በእርሱ ተመላለሱ።

verses.text_english: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.text_amharic: ሥር ሰዳችሁ በእርሱ ታነጹ፥ እንደ ተማራችሁም በሃይማኖት ጽኑ፥ ምስጋናም ይብዛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ክርስቶስ ትምህርት ሳይሆን፥ እንደ ሰው ወግና እንደ ዓለማዊ እንደ መጀመሪያ ትምህርት ባለ በፍልስፍና በከንቱም መታለል ማንም እንዳይማርካችሁ ተጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ የመለኮት ሙላት ሁሉ በሰውነት ተገልጦ ይኖራልና።

verses.text_english: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.text_amharic: ለአለቅነትና ለሥልጣንም ሁሉ ራስ በሆነ በእርሱ ሆናችሁ ተሞልታችኋል።

verses.text_english: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
verses.text_amharic: የሥጋንም ሰውነት በመገፈፍ፥ በክርስቶስ መገረዝ፥ በእጅ ባልተደረገ መገረዝ በእርሱ ሆናችሁ ደግሞ ተገረዛችሁ።

verses.text_english: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
verses.text_amharic: በጥምቀትም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀብራችሁ፥ በጥምቀት ደግሞ፥ ከሙታን ባስነሣው በእግዚአብሔር አሠራር በማመናችሁ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ተነሣችሁ።

verses.text_english: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም በበደላችሁና ሥጋችሁን ባለመገረዝ ሙታን በሆናችሁ ጊዜ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ሕይወትን ሰጣችሁ። በደላችሁን ሁሉ ይቅር አላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.text_amharic: በእኛ ላይ የነበረውን የሚቃወመንንም በትእዛዛት የተጻፈውን የዕዳ ጽሕፈት ደመሰሰው። እርሱንም በመስቀል ጠርቆ ከመንገድ አስወግዶታል።

verses.text_english: having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.text_amharic: አለቅነትንና ሥልጣናትን ገፎ፥ ድል በመንሣት በእርሱ እያዞራቸው በግልጥ አሳያቸው።

verses.text_english: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath :
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በመብል ወይም በመጠጥ ወይም ስለ በዓል ወይም ስለ ወር መባቻ ወይም ስለ ሰንበት ማንም አይፍረድባችሁ።

verses.text_english: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body of Christ.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሊመጡ ያሉት ነገሮች ጥላ ናቸውና፥ አካሉ ግን የክርስቶስ ነው።

verses.text_english: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.text_amharic: ትሕትናንና የመላእክትን አምልኮ እየወደደ፥ ባላየውም ያለ ፈቃድ እየገባ፥ በሥጋዊም አእምሮ በከንቱ እየታበየ ማንም አይፍረድባችሁ።

verses.text_english: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህ ያለ ሰው ራስ ወደሚሆነው አይጠጋም፥ ከእርሱም አካል ሁሉ በጅማትና በማሰሪያ ምግብን እየተቀበለ እየተጋጠመም፥ እግዚአብሔር በሚሰጠው ማደግ ያድጋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
(Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሰው ሥርዓትና ትምህርት። አትያዝ፥ አትቅመስ፥ አትንካ ለሚሉት ትእዛዛት በዓለም እንደምትኖሩ ስለ ምን ትገዛላችሁ? እነዚህ ሁሉ በመደረግ ሊጠፉ ተወስነዋልና።

verses.text_english: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.text_amharic: ይህ እንደ ገዛ ፈቃድህ በማምለክና በትሕትና ሥጋንም በመጨቆን ጥበብ ያለው ይመስላል፥ ነገር ግን ሥጋ ያለ ልክ እንዳይጠግብ ለመከልከል ምንም አይጠቅምም።

verses.text_english: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ከክርስቶስ ጋር ከተነሣችሁ፥ ክርስቶስ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ተቀምጦ ባለበት በላይ ያለውን እሹ።

verses.text_english: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በላይ ያለውን አስቡ እንጂ በምድር ያለውን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.text_amharic: ሞታችኋልና፥ ሕይወታችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ከክርስቶስ ጋር ተሰውሮአልና።

verses.text_english: When Christ, our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወታችሁ የሆነ ክርስቶስ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ እናንተ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር በክብር ትገለጣላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በምድር ያሉቱን ብልቶቻችሁን ግደሉ፥ እነዚህም ዝሙትና ርኵሰት ፍትወትም ክፉ ምኞትም ጣኦትንም ማምለክ የሆነ መጎምጀት ነው።

verses.text_english: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም ጠንቅ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በማይታዘዙ ልጆች ላይ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተም ደግሞ ትኖሩባቸው በነበራችሁ ጊዜ፥ በፊት በእነዚህ ተመላለሳችሁ።

verses.text_english: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን እናንተ ደግሞ ቍጣንና ንዴትን ክፋትንም፥ ከአፋችሁም ስድብን የሚያሳፍርንም ንግግር እነዚህን ሁሉ አስወግዱ።

verses.text_english: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁ ውሸት አትነጋገሩ፥ አሮጌውን ሰው ከሥራው ጋር ገፋችሁታልና፥

verses.text_english: And have put on the new , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.text_amharic: የፈጠረውንም ምሳሌ እንዲመስል እውቀትን ለማግኘት የሚታደሰውን አዲሱን ሰው ለብሳችሁታል።

verses.text_english: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond free: but Christ all, and in all.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም የግሪክ ሰው አይሁዳዊም የተገረዘም ያልተገረዘም አረማዊም እስኩቴስም ባሪያም ጨዋ ሰውም መሆን አልተቻለም፥ ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ሁሉ ነው፥ በሁሉም ነው።

verses.text_english: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ምርጦች ቅዱሳን ሆናችሁ የተወደዳችሁም ሆናችሁ፥ ምሕረትን፥ ርኅራኄን፥ ቸርነትን፥ ትህትናን፥ የዋህነትን፥ ትዕግሥትን ልበሱ።

verses.text_english: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also ye.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዕግሥትን አድርጉ፥ ማንም በባልንጀራው ላይ የሚነቅፈው ነገር ካለው፥ ይቅር ተባባሉ። ክርስቶስ ይቅር እንዳላችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: And above all these things charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም ሁሉ ላይ የፍጻሜ ማሰሪያ የሆነውን ፍቅርን ልበሱት።

verses.text_english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.text_amharic: በአንድ አካልም የተጠራችሁለት ደግሞ የክርስቶስ ሰላም በልባችሁ ይግዛ። የምታመሰግኑም ሁኑ።

verses.text_english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በሙላት ይኑርባችሁ። በጥበብ ሁሉ እርስ በርሳችሁ አስተምሩና ገሥጹ። በመዝሙርና በዝማሬ በመንፈሳዊም ቅኔ በጸጋው በልባችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አብን በእርሱ እያመሰገናችሁ፥ በቃል ቢሆን ወይም በሥራ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም አድርጉት።

verses.text_english: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ሚስቶች ሆይ፥ በጌታ እንደሚገባ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ።

verses.text_english: Husbands, love wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.text_amharic: ባሎች ሆይ፥ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ መራራም አትሁኑባቸው።

verses.text_english: Children, obey parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ይህ ለጌታ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና በሁሉ ለወላጆቻችሁ ታዘዙ።

verses.text_english: Fathers, provoke not your children , lest they be discouraged.
verses.text_amharic: አባቶች ሆይ፥ ልባቸው እንዳይዝል ልጆቻችሁን አታበሳጩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Servants, obey in all things masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ በቅን ልብ ጌታን እየፈራችሁ እንጂ፥ ለሰው ደስ እንደምታሰኙ ለታይታ የምትገዙ ሳትሆኑ፥ በሥጋ ጌቶቻችሁ ለሆኑ በሁሉ ታዘዙ።

verses.text_english: And whatsoever ye do, do heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምታደርጉ፥ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ በትጋት አድርጉት፥

verses.text_english: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከጌታ የርስትን ብድራት እንድትቀበሉ ታውቃላችሁና። የምታገለግሉት ጌታ ክርስቶስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.text_amharic: የሚበድልም የበደለውን በብድራት ይቀበላል፥ ለሰው ፊትም አድልዎ የለም።

verses.text_english: Masters, give unto servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ጌቶች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በሰማይ ጌታ እንዳላችሁ ታውቃላችሁና ለባሪያዎቻችሁ በጽድቅና በቅንነት አድርጉላቸው።

verses.text_english: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.text_amharic: ከማመስገን ጋር በጸሎት እየነቃችሁ ለእርሱ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜም ስለ እርሱ ደግሞ የታሰርሁበትን የክርስቶስን ምሥጢር እንድንነግር እግዚአብሔር የቃሉን ደጅ ይከፍትልን ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ደግሞ ጸልዩ።

verses.text_english: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.text_amharic: ልናገር እንደሚገባኝ ያህል እገልጠው ዘንድ ጸልዩልኝ።

verses.text_english: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.text_amharic: ዘመኑን እየዋጃችሁ፥ በውጭ ባሉቱ ዘንድ በጥበብ ተመላለሱ።

verses.text_english: Let your speech alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ እንደሚገባችሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ ንግግራችሁ ሁልጊዜ፥ በጨው እንደ ተቀመመ፥ በጸጋ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.text_amharic: የተወደደ ወንድምና የታመነ አገልጋይ በጌታም አብሮኝ ባሪያ የሆነ ቲኪቆስ ኑሮዬን ሁሉ ያስታውቃችኋል።

verses.text_english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is of you. They shall make known unto you all things which here.
verses.text_amharic: ወሬያችንን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያጽናና፥ ከእናንተ ከሆነውና ከታመነው ከተወደደውም ወንድም ከአናሲሞስ ጋር ወደ እናንተ የምልከው ስለዚህ ምክንያት ነው። የዚህን ስፍራ ወሬ ሁሉ ያስታውቁአችኋል።

verses.text_english: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ የሆነ የክርስቶስ ባሪያ ኤጳፍራ ሰላምታ ያቀርብላችኋል። በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሁሉ ተረድታችሁና ፍጹማን ሆናችሁ እንድትቆሙ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል።

verses.text_english: Epaphras, who is of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ በሎዶቅያም በኢያራ ከተማም ስላሉቱ እጅግ እንዲቀና እመሰክርለታለሁና።

verses.text_english: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.text_amharic: የተወደደው ባለ መድኃኒቱ ሉቃስ ዴማስም ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.text_amharic: በሎዶቅያ ላሉቱ ወንድሞችና ለንምፉን በቤቱም ላለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልን።

verses.text_english: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.text_amharic: ይህችም መልእክት በእናንተ ዘንድ ከተነበበች በኋላ፥ በሎዶቅያ ሰዎች ማኅበር ደግሞ እንድትነበብ አድርጉ። ከሎዶቅያም የምትገኘውን መልእክት እናንተ ደግሞ አንብቡ።

verses.text_english: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the from Laodicea.
verses.text_amharic: ለአክሪጳም። በጌታ የተቀበልኸውን አገልግሎት እንድትፈጽሙው ተጠንቀቅ በሉልኝ።

verses.text_english: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.text_amharic: በገዛ እጄ የተጻፈ የእኔ የጳውሎስ ሰላምታ ይህ ነው። እስራቴን አስቡ። ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስና ስልዋኖስ ጢሞቴዎስም፥ በእግዚአብሔር አብ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ወደምትሆን ወደ ተሰሎንቄ ሰዎች ቤተ ክርስቲያን፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ጸጋ ሰላምም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
verses.text_amharic: በጸሎታችን ጊዜ ስለ እናንተ ስናሳስብ፥ የእምነታችሁን ስራ የፍቅራችሁንም ድካም በጌታችንም በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ያለውን የተስፋችሁን መጽናት በአምላካችንና በአባታችን ፊት ሳናቋርጥ እያሰብን፥ እግዚአብሔርን ሁል ጊዜ በሁላችሁ ምክንያት እናመሰግናለን፤

verses.text_english: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር የምትወደዱ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንደ ተመረጣችሁ አውቀናልና።

verses.text_english: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.text_amharic: ወንጌላችን በኃይልና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በብዙ መረዳትም እንጂ በቃል ብቻ ወደ እናንተ አልመጣምና፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ስለ እናንተ እንዴት እንደ ነበርን ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ እናንተ ቃሉን በብዙ መከራ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ደስታ ጋር ተቀብላችሁ፥ እኛንና ጌታን የምትመስሉ ሆናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ ላሉት ምእመናን ሁሉ ምሳሌ ሆናችሁላቸው።

verses.text_english: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ወጥቶ የጌታ ቃል በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ ብቻ አልተሰማምና፥ ነገር ግን ምንም እንድንናገር እስከማያስፈልግ ድረስ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሚሆን እምነታችሁ በሁሉ ስፍራ ተወርቶአል።

verses.text_english: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ራሳችሁ ወደ እናንተ መግባታችን ከንቱ እንዳልሆነ ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንደምታውቁት በፊልጵስዩስ አስቀድመን መከራ ተቀብለን ተንገላትተንም፥ በብዙ ገድል የእግዚአብሔርን ወንጌል ለእናንተ እንናገር ዘንድ በአምላካችን ደፈርን።

verses.text_english: For our exhortation not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
verses.text_amharic: ልመናችን ከስሕተት ወይም ከርኵሰት ወይም ከተንኰል አልነበረምና፤

verses.text_english: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወንጌልን አደራ ይሰጠን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር የታመንን ሆነን እንዳገኘን መጠን፥ እንዲሁ እንናገራለን፥ ልባችንን የሚመረምር እግዚአብሔርን እንጂ ሰውን ደስ እንደምናሰኝ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God witness:
verses.text_amharic: እንደምታውቁ፥ እያቈላመጥን ከቶ አልተናገርንም፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደሚመሰክር እያመካኘን በመጐምጀት አልሠራንም፤

verses.text_english: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
verses.text_amharic: የክርስቶስም ሐዋርያት እንደ መሆናችን ልንከብድባችሁ ስንችል፥ ከእናንተ ቢሆን ወይም ከሌሎች ክብርን ከሰው አልፈለግንም።

verses.text_english: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሞግዚት የራስዋን ልጆች እንደምትከባከብ፥ በመካከላችሁ የዋሆች ሆንን፤

verses.text_english: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም እያፈቀርናችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንጌል ለማካፈል ብቻ ሳይሆን የገዛ ነፍሳችንን ደግሞ እናካፍላችሁ ዘንድ በጎ ፈቃዳችን ነበረ፥ ለእኛ የተወደዳችሁ ሆናችሁ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ድካማችንና ጥረታችን ትዝ ይላችኋልና፤ ከእናንተ በአንዱ ስንኳ እንዳንከብድበት ሌሊትና ቀን እየሠራን፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንጌል ለእናንተ ሰበክን።

verses.text_english: Ye witnesses, and God , how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተ በምታምኑ ዘንድ በእንዴት ያለ ቅድስናና ጽድቅ ነቀፋም በሌለበት ኑሮ እንደ ሄድን፥ እናንተና እግዚአብሔር ምስክሮች ናችሁ፤

verses.text_english: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father his children,
That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የመልእክትን ቃል እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከእኛ በተቀበላችሁ ጊዜ፥ በእውነት እንዳለ በእናንተ በምታምኑ ደግሞ እንደሚሠራ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እንጂ እንደ ሰው ቃል አድርጋችሁ ስላልተቀበላችሁት፥ እኛ ደግሞ እግዚአብሔርን ሳናቋርጥ እናመሰግናለን።
