verses.text_english: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received not the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በይሁዳ የሚኖሩትን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያሉትን የእግዚአብሔርን ማኅበሮች የምትመስሉ ሆናችኋልና፤ እነርሱ ከአይሁድ መከራ እንደ ተቀበሉ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ ያንን መከራ ከአገራችሁ ሰዎች ተቀብላችኋልና።

verses.text_english: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they of the Jews:
verses.text_amharic: እነዚያም ጌታን ኢየሱስን ደግሞ ገደሉ ነቢያትንም እኛንም አሳደዱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ደስ አያሰኙም፥ ሰዎችንም ሁሉ ይቃወማሉ፥

verses.text_english: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ኃጢአታቸውን ይፈጽሙ ዘንድ አሕዛብ እንዲድኑ እንዳንናገራቸው ይከለክሉናልና። ነገር ግን ቍጣው ወደ እነርሱ ፈጽሞ ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በልብ ያይደለ ፊት ለፊት ለጥቂት ጊዜ አጥተናችሁ፥ በብዙ ናፍቆት ፊታችሁን ለማየት እጅግ ሞከርን፤

verses.text_english: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እናንተ ልንመጣ ወደን ነበርና፥ እኔ ጳውሎስም አንድና ሁለት ጊዜ፥ ሰይጣን ግን አዘገየን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋችን ወይስ ደስታችን ወይስ የትምክህታችን አክሊል ማን ነው? በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ፊት በመምጣቱ እናንተ አይደላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: For what our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ክብራችን ደስታችንም ናችሁና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወደ ፊት እንታገሥ ዘንድ ባልተቻለን ጊዜ፥ በአቴና ብቻችንን ልንቀር በጎ ፈቃዳችን ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እምነታችሁም እንዲያጸናችሁና እንዲመክራችሁ ወንድማችንን የእግዚአብሔርንም አገልጋይ ከእኛ ጋርም አብሮ በክርስቶስ ወንጌል የሚሠራውን ጢሞቴዎስን ላክነው፤

verses.text_english: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ መከራ ማንም እንዳይናውጥ፥ ለዚህ እንደ ተመረጥን ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለን፥ መከራ እንቀበል ዘንድ እንዳለን አስቀድመን እንነግራችሁ ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ደግሞ ሆነ፥ ይህንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ ወደ ፊት እታገሥ ዘንድ ባልተቻለኝ ጊዜ። ፈታኝ ምናልባት ፈትኖአቸዋል ድካማችንም ከንቱ ሆኖአል ብዬ እምነታችሁን ለማወቅ ላክሁ።

verses.text_english: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also you:
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን ጢሞቴዎስ ከእናንተ ዘንድ ወደ እኛ መጥቶ ስለ እምነታችሁና ስለ ፍቅራችሁ የምስራች ብሎ በነገረን ጊዜ፥ እኛም እናያችሁ ዘንድ እንደምንናፍቅ ታዩን ዘንድ እየናፈቃችሁ ሁልጊዜ በመልካም እንደምታስቡን በነገረን ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በእምነታችሁ በኩል በችግራችንና በመከራችን ሁሉ ስለ እናንተ ተጽናናን፤

verses.text_english: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ በጌታ ጸንታችሁ ብትቆሙ፥ አሁን በሕይወት እንኖራለንና።

verses.text_english: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችንና አባታችን ራሱ ጌታችንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወደ እናንተ መንገዳችንን ያቅና፤

verses.text_english: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, ye would abound more and more.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በቀረውስ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ልትመላለሱ እግዚአብሔርንም ደስ ልታሰኙ እንዴት እንደሚገባችሁ ከእኛ ዘንድ እንደ ተቀበላችሁ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ እንደምትመላለሱ፥ ከፊት ይልቅ ትበዙ ዘንድ በጌታ በኢየሱስ እንለምናችኋለን እንመክራችሁማለን።

verses.text_english: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታ በኢየሱስ የትኛውን ትእዛዝ እንደ ሰጠናችሁ ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: For this is the will of God, your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
verses.text_amharic: ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ እርሱም መቀደሳችሁ ነውና፤

verses.text_english: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
verses.text_amharic: ከዝሙት እንድትርቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርን እንደማያውቁ አሕዛብ በፍትወት ምኞት አይደለም እንጂ፥ ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ የራሱን ዕቃ በቅድስናና በክብር ያገኝ ዘንድ እንዲያውቅ፤

verses.text_english: That no go beyond and defraud his brother in matter: because that the Lord the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድመን ደግሞ እንዳልናችሁና እንደ መሰከርንላችሁ፥ ጌታ ስለዚህ ነገር ሁሉ የሚበቀል ነውና ማንም በዚህ ነገር አይተላለፍ ወንድሙንም አያታልል።

verses.text_english: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
verses.text_amharic: ለርኵሰት ሳይሆን እግዚአብሔር በቅድስና ጠርቶናልና።

verses.text_english: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ የሚጥል ሰውን የጣለ አይደለም፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስን በእናንተ እንዲኖር የሰጠውን እግዚአብሔርን ነው እንጂ።

verses.text_english: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ራሳችሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ ልትዋደዱ በእግዚአብሔር ተምራችኋልና ስለ ወንድማማች መዋደድ ማንም ይጽፍላችሁ ዘንድ አያስፈልጋችሁም፤

verses.text_english: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and ye may have lack of nothing.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ በመቄዶንያ ሁሉ ላሉት ወንድሞች ሁሉ ታደርጋላችሁና። ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ከፊት ይልቅ ልትበዙ፥ በጸጥታም ትኖሩ ዘንድ ልትቀኑ፥ የራሳችሁንም ጉዳይ ልትጠነቀቁ፥ እንዳዘዝናችሁም፥ በውጭ ባሉት ዘንድ በአገባብ እንድትመላለሱ፥ አንዳችም እንዳያስፈልጋችሁ በእጃችሁ ልትሠሩ እንለምናችኋለን።

verses.text_english: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ተስፋ እንደሌላቸው እንደ ሌሎች ደግሞ እንዳታዝኑ፥ አንቀላፍተው ስላሉቱ ታውቁ ዘንድ እንወዳለን።

verses.text_english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ እንደ ሞተና እንደ ተነሣ ካመንን፥ እንዲሁም በኢየሱስ ያንቀላፉቱን እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ያመጣቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታ ቃል የምንላችሁ ይህ ነውና፤ እኛ ሕያዋን ሆነን ጌታ እስኪመጣ ድረስ የምንቀር ያንቀላፉቱን አንቀድምም፤

verses.text_english: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ራሱ በትእዛዝ በመላእክትም አለቃ ድምፅ በእግዚአብሔርም መለከት ከሰማይ ይወርዳልና፥ በክርስቶስም የሞቱ አስቀድመው ይነሣሉ፤

verses.text_english: Then we which are alive remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም በኋላ እኛ ሕያዋን ሆነን የምንቀረው፥ ጌታን በአየር ለመቀበል ከእነርሱ ጋር በደመና እንነጠቃለን፤ እንዲሁም ሁልጊዜ ከጌታ ጋር እንሆናለን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳችሁ በዚህ ቃል ተጽናኑ።

verses.text_english: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስለ ዘመናትና ስለ ወራት ምንም እንዲጻፍላችሁ አያስፈልጋችሁም፤

verses.text_english: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታ ቀን፥ ሌባ በሌሊት እንደሚመጣ፥ እንዲሁ ይመጣ ዘንድ ራሳችሁ አጥብቃችሁ አውቃችኋልና።

verses.text_english: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
verses.text_amharic: ሰላምና ደኅንነት ነው ሲሉ ያን ጊዜ ምጥ እርጕዝን እንደሚይዛት ጥፋት በድንገት ይመጣባቸዋል ከቶም አያመልጡም።

verses.text_english: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ቀኑ እንደ ሌባ ይደርስባችሁ ዘንድ በጨለማ አይደላችሁም፥

verses.text_english: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችሁ የብርሃን ልጆች የቀንም ልጆች ናችሁና። እኛ ከሌሊት ወይም ከጨለማ አይደለንም፤

verses.text_english: Therefore let us not sleep, as others; but let us watch and be sober.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ እንንቃ በመጠንም እንኑር እንጂ እንደ ሌሎች አናንቀላፋ።

verses.text_english: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያንቀላፉ በሌሊት ያንቀላፋሉና፥ የሚሰክሩም በሌሊት ይሰክራሉና፤

verses.text_english: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን ከቀን ስለ ሆንን፥ የእምነትንና የፍቅርን ጥሩር የመዳንንም ተስፋ እንደ ራስ ቁር እየለበስን በመጠን እንኑር፤

verses.text_english: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ለቍጣ አልመረጠንምና፥ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መዳንን ለማግኘት ነው እንጂ።

verses.text_english: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.text_amharic: የምንነቃም ብንሆን፥ የምናንቀላፋም ብንሆን፥ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረን በሕይወት እንኖር ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እናንተ ደግሞ እንደምታደርጉ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተመካከሩ አንዱም አንዱም ሌላውን ያንጸው።

verses.text_english: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. be at peace among yourselves.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንመክራችኋለን፤ ያለ ሥርዓት የሚሄዱትን ገሥጹአቸው፤ ድፍረት የሌላቸውን አጽኑአቸው፤ ለደካሞች ትጉላቸው፤ ሰውን ሁሉ ታገሡ።

verses.text_english: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all .
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ለሌላው በክፉ ፈንታ ክፉ እንዳይመልስ ተጠንቀቁ፥ ነገር ግን ሁልጊዜ እርስ በርሳችሁ ለሁሉም መልካሙን ለማድረግ ትጉ።

verses.text_english: See that none render evil for evil unto any ; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all .
verses.text_amharic: ሁልጊዜ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: Rejoice evermore.
Pray without ceasing.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስን አታጥፉ፤

verses.text_english: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Quench not the Spirit.
verses.text_amharic: ከማናቸውም ዓይነት ክፉ ነገር ራቁ።

verses.text_english: Despise not prophesyings.
verses.text_amharic: የሰላምም አምላክ ራሱ ሁለንተናችሁን ይቀድስ፤ መንፈሳችሁም ነፍሳችሁም ሥጋችሁም ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በመጣ ጊዜ ያለ ነቀፋ ፈጽመው ይጠበቁ።

verses.text_english: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.text_amharic: የሚጠራችሁ የታመነ ነው፥ እርሱም ደግሞ ያደርገዋል።

verses.text_english: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስለ እኛ ጸልዩ።

verses.text_english: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከወንድሞች ሁሉ ጋር በተቀደሰ አሳሳም ሰላምታ ተሰጣጡ።

verses.text_english: Faithful he that calleth you, who also will do .
verses.text_amharic: ይህ መልእክት ለቅዱሳን ወንድሞች ሁሉ እንዲነበብ በጌታ አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: ጳውሎስና ስልዋኖስ ጢሞቴዎስም፥ በእግዚአብሔር በአባታችን በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ወደምትሆን ወደ ተሰሎንቄ ሰዎች ቤተ ክርስቲያን፤

verses.text_english: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ጸጋ ሰላምም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እምነታችሁ እጅግ ስለሚያድግ የሁላችሁም የእያንዳንዳችሁ ፍቅር እርስ በርሳችሁ ስለሚበዛ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን እንደሚገባ ልናመሰግን ግድ አለብን፤

verses.text_english: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በምትታገሱበት በስደታችሁና በመከራችሁ ሁሉ ከመጽናታችሁና ከእምነታችሁ የተነሣ በእግዚአብሔር አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ስለ እናንተ ራሳችን እንመካለን።

verses.text_english: a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርሱ ደግሞ መከራ ለምትቀበሉለት ለእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የምትበቁ ሆናችሁ ትቈጠሩ ዘንድ፥ ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ቅን ፍርድ ምልክት ነው።

verses.text_english: Seeing a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ኢየሱስ ከሥልጣኑ መላእክት ጋር ከሰማይ በእሳት ነበልባል ሲገለጥ፥ መከራን ለሚያሳዩአችሁ መከራን፥ መከራንም ለምትቀበሉ ከእኛ ጋር ዕረፍትን ብድራት አድርጎ እንዲመልስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በእርግጥ ጽድቅ ነውና።

verses.text_english: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን የማያውቁትን፥ ለጌታችንም ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ወንጌል የማይታዘዙትን ይበቀላል፤

verses.text_english: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together unto him,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስለ ጌታችን ስለ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መምጣትና ወደ እርሱ ስለ መሰብሰባችን፥

verses.text_english: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስ ወይም በቃል ወይም ከእኛ እንደሚመጣ በመልእክት። የጌታ ቀን ደርሶአል ብላችሁ፥ ከአእምሮአችሁ ቶሎ እንዳትናወጡ እንዳትደነግጡም እንለምናችኋለን።

verses.text_english: Let no man deceive you by any means: for , except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.text_amharic: ማንም በማናቸውም መንገድ አያስታችሁ፤ ክህደቱ አስቀድሞ ሳይመጣና የዓመፅ ሰው እርሱም የጥፋት ልጅ ሳይገለጥ፥ አይደርስምና።

verses.text_english: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ ብሎ አዋጅ እየነገረ በእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ እስኪቀመጥ ድረስ፥ አምላክ ከተባለው ሁሉ፥ ሰዎችም ከሚያመልኩት ሁሉ በላይ ራሱን ከፍ ከፍ የሚያደርገው ተቃዋሚ እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.text_amharic: ገና ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ፥ ይህን እንዳልኋችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?

verses.text_english: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
verses.text_amharic: በገዛ ራሱ ጊዜም ይገለጥ ዘንድ፥ የሚከለክለውን አሁን ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.text_english: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth , until he be taken out of the way.
verses.text_amharic: የዓመፅ ምሥጢር አሁን ይሠራልና፤ ብቻ ከመንገድ እስኪወገድ ድረስ አሁን የሚከለክል አለ።

verses.text_english: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ጌታ ኢየሱስ በአፉ መንፈስ የሚያጠፋው፥ ሲመጣም በመገለጡ የሚሽረው ዓመፀኛ ይገለጣል፤

verses.text_english: , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን፥ በጌታ የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን ልናመሰግን ግድ አለብን፥ እግዚአብሔር በመንፈስ መቀደስ እውነትንም በማመን ለመዳን እንደ በኵራት መርጦአችኋልና፤

verses.text_english: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.text_amharic: ለዚህም የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ክብር ለማግኘት በወንጌላችን ጠራችሁ።

verses.text_english: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ጸንታችሁ ቁሙ፥ በቃላችንም ቢሆን ወይም በመልእክታችን የተማራችሁትን ወግ ያዙ።

verses.text_english: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have course, and be glorified, even as with you:
verses.text_amharic: በቀረውስ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የጌታ ቃል እንዲሮጥ በእናንተም ዘንድ ደግሞ እንደሚሆን እንዲከበር፥

verses.text_english: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all have not faith.
verses.text_amharic: እምነትም ለሁሉ ስለማይሆን ከዓመፀኞችና ከክፉዎች ሰዎች እንድንድን ስለ እኛ ጸልዩ።

verses.text_english: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep from evil.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የሚያጸናችሁ ከክፉውም የሚጠብቃችሁ ጌታ የታመነ ነው።

verses.text_english: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.text_amharic: የምናዛችሁንም አሁን እንድታደርጉ ወደ ፊትም ደግሞ እንድታደርጉ ስለ እናንተ በጌታ ታምነናል።

verses.text_english: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ወደ ክርስቶስም ትዕግሥት ልባችንን ያቅናው።

verses.text_english: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ከእኛ እንደ ተቀበለው ወግ ሳይሆን ያለ ሥርዓት ከሚሄድ ወንድም ሁሉ ትለዩ ዘንድ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም እናዛችኋለን።

verses.text_english: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.text_amharic: እኛን ልትመስሉ እንዴት እንደሚገባችሁ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁና፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ያለ ሥርዓት አልሄድንምና፤

verses.text_english: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ዘንድ በአንዱ ስንኳ እንዳንከብድበት፥ ሌሊትና ቀን በድካምና በጥረት እየሠራን እንኖር ነበር እንጂ፥ ከማንም እንጀራን እንዲያው አልበላንም።

verses.text_english: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም እኛን ልትመስሉ ራሳችንን እንደ ምሳሌ እንሰጣችሁ ዘንድ ነበር እንጂ፥ ያለ ሥልጣን ስለ ሆንን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞ ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለን። ሊሠራ የማይወድ አይብላ ብለን አዘናችሁ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራ ከቶ ሳይሠሩ፥ በሰው ነገር እየገቡ፥ ያለ ሥርዓት ከእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚሄዱ ስለ አንዳንዶች ሰምተናልና።

verses.text_english: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.text_amharic: እንደነዚህ ያሉትንም በጸጥታ እየሠሩ የገዛ እንጀራቸውን ይበሉ ዘንድ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እናዛቸዋለን እንመክራቸውማለን።

verses.text_english: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ መልካም ሥራን ለመሥራት አትታክቱ።

verses.text_english: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ መልእክት ለተላከ ቃላችን የማይታዘዝ ማንም ቢኖር፥ ይህን ተመልከቱት፥ ያፍርም ዘንድ ከእርሱ ጋር አትተባበሩ።

verses.text_english: Yet count not as an enemy, but admonish as a brother.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንደ ወንድም ገሥጹት እንጂ እንደ ጠላት አትቍጠሩት።

verses.text_english: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord with you all.
verses.text_amharic: የሰላምም ጌታ ራሱ በሁሉ መንገድ ዘወትር ሰላምን ይስጣችሁ። ጌታ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.text_amharic: በገዛ እጄ የተጻፈ የእኔ የጳውሎስ ሰላምታ ይህ ነው፤ የመልእክቴ ሁሉ ማስረጃ ይህ ነው፤ እንዲህ እጽፋለሁ።

verses.text_english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with you all. Amen. « to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.»
verses.text_amharic: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, our hope;
verses.text_amharic: መድኃኒታችን እግዚአብሔር ተስፋችንም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እንዳዘዘው ትእዛዝ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.text_english: Unto Timothy, own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.text_amharic: በእምነት እውነተኛ ልጄ ለሆነ ለጢሞቴዎስ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም ከጌታችን ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: .
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መቄዶንያ በሄድሁ ጊዜ፥ አንዳንዶች ልዩ ትምህርትን እንዳያስተምሩና ወደ ተረት መጨረሻም ወደሌለው ወደ ትውልዶች ታሪክ እንዳያደምጡ ልታዛቸው በኤፌሶን ትቀመጥ ዘንድ ለመንሁህ፤ እንደ እነዚህ ያሉ ነገሮች ክርክርን ያመጣሉና በእምነት ግን ላለ ለእግዚአብሔር መጋቢነት አይጠቅሙም።

verses.text_english: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and a good conscience, and faith unfeigned:
verses.text_amharic: የትእዛዝ ፍጻሜ ግን ከንጹሕ ልብና ከበጎ ሕሊና ግብዝነትም ከሌለበት እምነት የሚወጣ ፍቅር ነው፤

verses.text_english: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚህም አንዳንዶች ስተው፥ የሚሉትን ወይም ስለ እነርሱ አስረግጠው የሚናገሩትን ሳያስተውሉ፥ የሕግ አስተማሪዎች ሊሆኑ እየወደዱ፥ ወደ ከንቱ ንግግር ፈቀቅ ብለዋል።

verses.text_english: But we know that the law good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሰው እንደሚገባ ቢሰራበት ሕግ መልካም እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን፤

verses.text_english: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.text_amharic: ይኸውም፥ ለበደለኞችና ለማይታዘዙ፥ ለዓመጸኞችና ለኃጢአተኞች፥ ቅድስና ለሌላቸውና ለርኵሳን፥ አባትና እናትን ለሚገድሉ፥ ለነፍሰ ገዳዮችና ለሴሰኞች፥ ከወንድ ጋርም ለሚተኙ፥ በሰዎችም ለሚነግዱ፥ ለውሸተኞችም በውሸትም ለሚምሉ፥ የብሩክ እግዚአብሔርንም ክብር እንደሚገልጥ ለእኔ አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ ወንጌል የሆነውን ደኅና ትምህርት ለሚቃወም ለሌላ ነገር ሁሉ ሕግ እንደ ተሰራ እንጂ ለጻድቅ እንዳልተሰራ ሲያውቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.text_amharic: ለአገልግሎቱ ሾሞኝ ታማኝ አድርጎ ስለ ቈጠረኝ፥ ኃይል የሰጠኝን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን ጌታችንን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.text_amharic: አስቀድሞ ተሳዳቢና አሳዳጅ አንገላችም ምንም ብሆን፥ ይህን አደረገልኝ፤ ነገር ግን ሳላውቅ ባለማመን ስላደረግሁት ምህረትን አገኘሁ፥

verses.text_english: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታችንም ጸጋ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ካሉ ከእምነትና ከፍቅር ጋር አብልጦ በዛ።

verses.text_english: This a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኞችን ሊያድን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ወደ ዓለም መጣ የሚለው ቃል የታመነና ሁሉ እንዲቀበሉት የተገባ ነው፤ ከኃጢአተኞችም ዋና እኔ ነኝ፤

verses.text_english: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ግን፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ለማግኘት በእርሱ ያምኑ ዘንድ ላላቸው ሰዎች ምሳሌ እንድሆን፥ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ዋና በምሆን በእኔ ላይ ትዕግስቱን ሁሉ ያሳይ ዘንድ፥ ምህረትን አገኘሁ።

verses.text_english: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ብቻውን አምላክ ለሚሆን ለማይጠፋው ለማይታየውም ለዘመናት ንጉሥ ምስጋናና ክብር እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.text_amharic: ጢሞቴዎስ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሞ ስለ አንተ እንደ ተነገረው ትንቢት፥ በእርሱ መልካም ጦርነት ትዋጋ ዘንድ ይህችን ትእዛዝ አደራ እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.text_amharic: እምነትና በጎ ሕሊና ይኑርህ፥ አንዳንዶች ሕሊናን ጥለው፥ መርከብ አለ መሪ እንደሚጠፋ፥ በእምነት ነገር ጠፍተዋልና፤

verses.text_english: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነዚያም፥ እንዳይሳደቡ ይማሩ ዘንድ ለሰይጣን አሳልፌ የሰጠኋቸው፥ ሄሜኔዎስና እስክንድሮስ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔርን በመምሰልና በጭምትነት ሁሉ ጸጥና ዝግ ብለን እንድንኖር፥

verses.text_english: For kings, and all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.text_amharic: ልመናና ጸሎት ምልጃም ምስጋናም ስለ ሰዎች ሁሉ ስለ ነገሥታትና ስለ መኳንንትም ሁሉ እንዲደረጉ ከሁሉ በፊት እመክራለሁ።

verses.text_english: For this good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ሁሉ ሊድኑና እውነቱን ወደ ማወቅ ሊደርሱ በሚወድ በእግዚአብሔር በመድኃኒታችን ፊት መልካምና ደስ የሚያሰኝ ይህ ነው።

verses.text_english: For one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.text_amharic: አንድ እግዚአብሔር አለና፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰውም መካከል ያለው መካከለኛው ደግሞ አንድ አለ፥ እርሱም ሰው የሆነ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.text_amharic: ራሱንም ለሁሉ ቤዛ ሰጠ፥ ይህም በገዛ ዘመኑ ምስክርነቱ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም ለዚህ ነገር አዋጅ ነጋሪና ሐዋርያ በእምነትና በእውነትም የአሕዛብ አስተማሪ ለመሆን ተሾምሁ፤ እውነት እናገራለሁ፤ አልዋሽም።

verses.text_english: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ወንዶች በስፍራ ሁሉ አለ ቍጣና አለ ክፉ አሳብ የተቀደሱትን እጆች እያነሱ እንዲጸልዩ እፈቅዳለሁ።

verses.text_english: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት በነገር ሁሉ እየተገዛች በዝግታ ትማር፤

verses.text_english: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.text_amharic: ሴት ግን በዝግታ ትኑር እንጂ ልታስተምር ወይም በወንድ ላይ ልትሰለጥን አልፈቅድም።

verses.text_english: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.text_amharic: አዳም ቀድሞ ተፈጥሮአልና፥ በኋላም ሔዋን ተፈጠረች።

verses.text_english: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.text_amharic: የተታለለም አዳም አይደለም፥ ሴቲቱ ግን ተታልላ በመተላለፍ ወደቀች፤

verses.text_english: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእምነትና በፍቅር በቅድስናም ራሳቸውን እየገዙ ቢኖሩ በመውለድ ትድናለች።

verses.text_english: This a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ኤጲስ ቆጶስነትን ቢፈልግ መልካምን ሥራ ይመኛል የሚለው ቃል የታመነ ነው።

verses.text_english: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ እንዲህ ሊሆን ይገባዋል፤ የማይነቀፍ፥ የአንዲት ሚስት ባል፥ ልከኛ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ፥ እንደሚገባው የሚሰራ፥ እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ ለማስተማር የሚበቃ፥

verses.text_english: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.text_amharic: የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ ነገር ግን ገር የሆነ፥ የማይከራከር፥ ገንዘብን የማይወድ፥

verses.text_english: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.text_amharic: ልጆቹን በጭምትነት ሁሉ እየገዛ የራሱን ቤት በመልካም የሚያስተዳድር፤

verses.text_english: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ግን የራሱን ቤት እንዲያስተዳድር ባያውቅ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን እንዴት ይጠብቃታል?

verses.text_english: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.text_amharic: በትዕቢት ተነፍቶ በዲያቢሎስ ፍርድ እንዳይወድቅ፥ አዲስ ክርስቲያን አይሁን።

verses.text_english: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.text_amharic: በዲያቢሎስ ነቀፋና ወጥመድም እንዳይወድቅ፥ በውጭ ካሉት ሰዎች ደግሞ መልካም ምስክር ሊኖረው ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: Likewise the deacons grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ዲያቆናት ጭምቶች፥ በሁለት ቃል የማይናገሩ፥ ለብዙ ወይን ጠጅ የማይጎመጁ፥

verses.text_english: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.text_amharic: ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወዱ፥ በንጹሕ ሕሊና የሃይማኖትን ምሥጢር የሚይዙ ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being blameless.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ደግሞ አስቀድሞ ይፈተኑ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ያለ ነቀፋ ቢሆኑ በዲቁና ሥራ ያገልግሉ።

verses.text_english: Even so wives grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም ሴቶች ጭምቶች፥ የማያሙ፥ ልከኞች፥ በነገር ሁሉ የታመኑ ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.text_amharic: ዲያቆናት ልጆቻቸውንና የራሳቸውን ቤቶች በመልካም እየገዙ እያንዳንዳቸው የአንዲት ሴት ባሎች ይሁኑ።

verses.text_english: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: በዲቁና ሥራ በመልካም ያገለገሉ ለራሳቸው ትልቅ ማዕርግና በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለው እምነት ብዙ ድፍረት ያገኛሉ።

verses.text_english: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.text_amharic: ፈጥኜ ወደ አንተ እንድመጣ ተስፋ አድርጌ ይህን እጽፍልሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ብዘገይ ግን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ቤት መኖር እንዴት እንደሚገባ ታውቅ ዘንድ እጽፍልሃለሁ፤ ቤቱም የእውነት ዓምድና መሠረት፥ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነው።

verses.text_english: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም የመምሰል ምሥጢር ያለ ጥርጥር ታላቅ ነው፤ በሥጋ የተገለጠ፥ በመንፈስ የጸደቀ፥ ለመላእክት የታየ፥ በአሕዛብ የተሰበከ፥ በዓለም የታመነ፥ በክብር ያረገ።

verses.text_english: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስ ግን በግልጥ። በኋለኞች ዘመናት አንዳንዶች የሚያስቱ መናፍስትንና በውሸተኞች ግብዝነት

verses.text_english: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.text_amharic: የተሰጠውን የአጋንንትን ትምህርት እያደመጡ፥ ሃይማኖትን ይክዳሉ ይላል፤ በገዛ ሕሊናቸው እንደሚቃጠሉ ደንዝዘው፥

verses.text_english: Forbidding to marry, to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ውሸተኞች መጋባትን ይከለክላሉ፥ አምነውም እውነትን የሚያውቁ ከምስጋና ጋር ይቀበሉ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከፈጠረው መብል እንዲርቁ ያዝዛሉ።

verses.text_english: For every creature of God good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የፈጠረው ሁሉ መልካም ነውና፥ ከምስጋናም ጋር ቢቀበሉት የሚጣል ምንም የለም፤

verses.text_english: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ቃልና በጸሎት የተቀደሰ ነውና።

verses.text_english: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወንድሞችን ብታሳስብ፥ በእምነትና በተከተልኸው በመልካም ትምህርት ቃል የምትመገብ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መልካም አገልጋይ ትሆናለህ።

verses.text_english: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself unto godliness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለዚህ ዓለም ከሚመችና የአሮጊቶችን ሴቶች ጨዋታ ከሚመስለው ተረት ራቅ። እግዚአብሔርን ለመምሰል ግን ራስህን አስለምድ።

verses.text_english: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.text_amharic: ሰውነትን ለሥጋዊ ነገር ማስለመድ ለጥቂት ይጠቅማልና፤ እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ግን የአሁንና የሚመጣው ሕይወት ተስፋ ስላለው፥ ለነገር ሁሉ ይጠቅማል።

verses.text_english: This a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ቃል የታመነ ሁሉም እንዲቀበሉት የተገባ ነው፤

verses.text_english: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን ለማግኘት እንደክማለንና፥ ስለዚህም እንሰደባለን፤ ይህም ሰውን ሁሉ ይልቁንም የሚያምኑትን በሚያድን በሕያው አምላክ ተስፋ ስለምናደርግ ነው።

verses.text_english: These things command and teach.
Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.text_amharic: እስክመጣ ድረስ ለማንበብና ለመምከር ለማስተማርም ተጠንቀቅ።

verses.text_english: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: በትንቢት ከሽማግሌዎች እጅ መጫን ጋር የተሰጠህን፥ በአንተ ያለውን የጸጋ ስጦታ ቸል አትበል።

verses.text_english: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.text_amharic: ማደግህ በነገር ሁሉ እንዲገለጥ ይህን አስብ፥ ይህንም አዘውትር።

verses.text_english: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.text_amharic: ለራስህና ለትምህርትህ ተጠንቀቅ፥ በእነዚህም ጽና፤ ይህን ብታደርግ፥ ራስህንም የሚሰሙህንም ታድናለህና።

verses.text_english: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat as a father; the younger men as brethren;
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌ የሆነውን አትገሥጸው፥

verses.text_english: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱን ግን እንደ አባት፥ ጎበዞችን እንደ ወንድሞች፥ የሸመገሉትን ሴቶች እንደ እናቶች፥ ቆነጃጅቱን እንደ እኅቶች በፍጹም ንጽሕና ለምናቸው።

verses.text_english: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነት ባልቴቶች የሆኑትን ባልቴቶች አክብር።

verses.text_english: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ባልቴት ግን ልጆች ወይም የልጅ ልጆች ቢኖሩአት፥ እነርሱ አስቀድመው ለገዛ ቤተ ሰዎቻቸው እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ያሳዩ ዘንድ፥ ለወላጆቻቸውም ብድራትን ይመልሱላቸው ዘንድ ይማሩ፤ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና የተወደደ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.text_amharic: ብቻዋንም ኖራ በእውነት ባልቴት የምትሆን በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ታደርጋለች፥ ሌትና ቀንም በልመና በጸሎትም ጸንታ ትኖራለች፤

verses.text_english: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.text_amharic: ቅምጥሊቱ ግን በሕይወትዋ ሳለች የሞተች ናት።

verses.text_english: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ ነቀፋ እንዲሆኑ ይህን ደግሞ እዘዝ።

verses.text_english: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለእርሱ ስለ ሆኑት ይልቁንም ስለ ቤተ ሰዎቹ የማያስብ ማንም ቢሆን፥ ሃይማኖትን የካደ ከማያምንም ሰው ይልቅ የሚከፋ ነው።

verses.text_english: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.text_amharic: ባልቴት በመዝገብ ብትጻፍ ዕድሜዋ ከስድሳ ዓመት እንዳያንስ፥ የአንድም ባል ሚስት የነበረች እንድትሆን ያስፈልጋል፤

verses.text_english: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.text_amharic: ልጆችን በማሳደግ እንግዶችንም በመቀበል፥ የቅዱሳንንም እግሮች በማጠብ፥ የተጨነቁትንም በመርዳት በጎንም ሥራ ሁሉ በመከተል፥ ይህን መልካም ሥራ በማድረግ የተመሰከረላት ልትሆን ይገባል።

verses.text_english: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.text_amharic: ባል የሞተባቸውን ቆነጃጅት ግን አትቀበል፤ በክርስቶስ ላይ ተነሥተው ሲቀማጠሉ ሊያገቡ ይወዳሉና፤

verses.text_english: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.text_amharic: የፊተኛውንም እምነታቸውን ስለ ናቁ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: And withal they learn idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም ጋር ቤት ለቤት እየዞሩ ሥራን መፍታት ደግሞ ይማራሉ፥ የማይገባውንም እየተናገሩ ለፍላፊዎችና በነገር ገቢዎች ይሆናሉ እንጂ፥ ሥራ ፈቶች ብቻ አይደሉም።

verses.text_english: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ቆነጃጅት ሊያገቡ፥ ልጆችንም ሊወልዱ፥ ቤቶቻቸውንም ሊያስተዳድሩ፥ ተቃዋሚውም የሚሳደብበትን አንድን ምክንያት ስንኳ እንዳይሰጡ እፈቅዳለሁ፤

verses.text_english: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሁን በፊት አንዳንዶች ሰይጣንን እንዲከተሉ ፈቀቅ ብለዋልና።

verses.text_english: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.text_amharic: ባልቴቶች ያሉት የሚያምን ቢሆን ወይም የምታምን ብትሆን፥ ይርዱአቸው፥ ቤተ ክርስቲያንም እውነተኞችን ባልቴቶች እንድትረዳ አይክበዱባት።

verses.text_english: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: በመልካም የሚያስተዳድሩ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ይልቁንም በመስበክና በማስተማር የሚደክሙት፥ እጥፍ ክብር ይገባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer worthy of his reward.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፍ። የሚያበራየውን በሬ አፉን አትሰር፥ ደግሞ። ለሠራተኛ ደመወዙ ይገባዋል ይላልና።

verses.text_english: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለት ወይም ከሦስት ምስክር በቀር በሽማግሌ ላይ ክስ አትቀበል።

verses.text_english: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎቹ ደግሞ እንዲፈሩ፥ ኃጢአት የሚሰሩትን በሁሉ ፊት ገሥጻቸው።

verses.text_english: I charge before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.text_amharic: አንድን እንኳ በአድልዎ ሳታደርግ፥ እነዚህን ያለ መዘንበል እንድትጠብቅ በእግዚአብሔርና በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በተመረጡትም መላእክት ፊት እመክርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.text_amharic: በማንም ላይ ፈጥነህ እጆችህን አትጫን፥ በሌሎችም ኃጢአት አትተባበር፤ ራስህን በንጽህና ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሆድህና ስለ በሽታህ ብዛት ጥቂት የወይን ጠጅ ጠጣ እንጂ፥ ወደ ፊት ውኃ ብቻ አትጠጣ።

verses.text_english: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some they follow after.
verses.text_amharic: የአንዳንዶች ሰዎች ኃጢአት የተገለጠ ነው ፍርድንም ያመለክታል፥ ሌሎችን ግን ይከተላቸዋል፤

verses.text_english: Likewise also the good works are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ መልካም ሥራ ደግሞ የተገለጠ ነው፥ ያልተገለጠም ከሆነ ሊሰወር አይችልም።

verses.text_english: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ስምና ትምህርቱ አንዳይሰደብ፥ ከቀንበር በታች ያሉቱ ባሪያዎች ሁሉ ለገዙአቸው ጌቶች ክብር ሁሉ እንደ ተገባቸው ይቍጠሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise , because they are brethren; but rather do service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያምኑም ጌቶች ያሉአቸው፥ ወንድሞች ስለ ሆኑ አይናቁአቸው፥ ነገር ግን በመልካም ሥራቸው የሚጠቅሙ የሚያምኑና የተወደዱ ስለ ሆኑ፥ ከፊት ይልቅ ያገልግሉ።

verses.text_english: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን አስተምርና ምከር። ማንም ልዩ ትምህርት የሚያስተምር ከጌታችንም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በሆነው ጤናማ ቃልና እግዚአብሔርን ለመምሰል በሚስማማ ትምህርት የማይጠጋ ቢሆን፥

verses.text_english: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
verses.text_amharic: በትዕቢት ተነፍቶአል አንዳችም አያውቅም፥ ነገር ግን ምርመራን በቃልም መዋጋትን እንደ በሽተኛ ይናፍቃል፤ ከእነዚህም ቅንዓትና ክርክር ስድብም ክፉ አሳብም እርስ በርስ መናደድም ይወጣሉ፥ አእምሮአቸውም በጠፋባቸው እውነትንም በተቀሙ፥ እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ማትረፊያ የሚሆን በመሰላቸው ሰዎች ይገኛሉ። እንደነዚህ ካሉት ራቅ።

verses.text_english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.text_amharic: ኑሮዬ ይበቃኛል ለሚለው ግን እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እጅግ ማትረፊያ ነው፤

verses.text_english: For we brought nothing into world, certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዓለም ምንም እንኳ አላመጣንምና፥

verses.text_english: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.text_amharic: አንዳችንም ልንወስድ አይቻለንም፤ ምግብና ልብስ ከኖረን ግን፥ እርሱ ይበቃናል።

verses.text_english: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን ባለ ጠጎች ሊሆኑ የሚፈልጉ በጥፋትና በመፍረስ ሰዎችን በሚያሰጥምና በሚያሰንፍ በሚጎዳም በብዙ ምኞትና በፈተና በወጥመድም ይወድቃሉ።

verses.text_english: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.text_amharic: ገንዘብን መውደድ የክፋት ሁሉ ሥር ነውና፥ አንዳንዶች ይህን ሲመኙ፥ ከሃይማኖት ተሳስተው በብዙ ሥቃይ ራሳቸውን ወጉ።

verses.text_english: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ከዚህ ሽሽ፤ ጽድቅንና እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እምነትንም ፍቅርንም መጽናትንም የዋህነትንም ተከታተል።

verses.text_english: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙን የእምነት ገድል ተጋደል፥ የተጠራህለትንም በብዙም ምስክሮች ፊት በመልካም መታመን የታመንህለትን የዘላለምን ሕይወት ያዝ።

verses.text_english: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን በሕይወት በሚጠብቅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት፥ በጴንጤናዊውም በጲላጦስ ዘንድ መልካሙን መታመን በመሰከረ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፊት አዝሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: That thou keep commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስኪገለጥ ድረስ ያለ እድፍና ያለ ነቀፋ ሆነህ ትእዛዙን ጠብቅ፤

verses.text_english: Which in his times he shall shew, the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.text_amharic: ያንም መገለጡን በራሱ ጊዜ ብፁዕና ብቻውን የሆነ ገዥ፥ የነገሥታት ንጉሥና የጌቶች ጌታ፥ ያሳያል።

verses.text_english: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ብቻ የማይሞት ነው፤ ማንም ሊቀርበው በማይችል ብርሃን ይኖራል፤ አንድ ሰው እንኳ አላየውም ሊያይም አይቻለውም፤ ለእርሱ ክብርና የዘላለም ኃይል ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.text_amharic: በአሁኑ ዘመን ባለ ጠጎች የሆኑት የትዕቢትን ነገር እንዳያስቡ፥ ደስም እንዲለን ሁሉን አትርፎ በሚሰጠን በሕያው እግዚአብሔር እንጂ በሚያልፍ ባለ ጠግነት ተስፋ እንዳያደርጉ እዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.text_amharic: ጢሞቴዎስ ሆይ፥ በውሸት እውቀት ከተባለ ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍና መከራከር እየራቅህ፥ የተሰጠህን አደራ ጠብቅ፤

verses.text_english: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
verses.text_amharic: ይህ እውቀት አለን ብለው፥ አንዳንዶች ስለ እምነት ስተዋልና። ጸጋ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እንደሚሆን የሕይወት ተስፋ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.text_english: To Timothy, dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ለተወደደው ልጄ ለጢሞቴዎስ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከጌታችንም ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: I thank God, whom I serve from forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.text_amharic: ሌትና ቀን በልመናዬ ሳላቋርጥ ስለማስብህ እንደ አባቶቼ አድርጌ በንጹሕ ሕሊና የማመልከውን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.text_amharic: እንባህን እያሰብሁ በደስታ እሞላ ዘንድ ላይህ እናፍቃለሁ።

verses.text_english: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.text_amharic: በአንተ ያለውን ግብዝነት የሌለበትን እምነትህን አስባለሁ፤ ይህም እምነት ቀድሞ በአያትህ በሎይድ በእናትህም በኤውንቄ ነበረባቸው፥ በአንተም ደግሞ እንዳለ ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምክንያት፥ እሳት እንደሚያቀጣጥል ሰው፥ እጆቼን በመጫኔ በአንተ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታ እንድታነሣሣ አሳስብሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር የኃይልና የፍቅር ራስንም የመግዛት መንፈስ እንጂ የፍርሃት መንፈስ አልሰጠንምና።

verses.text_english: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በጌታችን ምስክርነት ወይም በእስረኛው በእኔ አትፈር፥ ነገር ግን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ኃይል መጠን ስለ ወንጌል አብረኸኝ መከራን ተቀበል፤

verses.text_english: Who hath saved us, and called with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.text_amharic: ያዳነን በቅዱስም አጠራር የጠራን እግዚአብሔር ነውና፥ ይህም እንደ ራሱ አሳብና ጸጋ መጠን ነው እንጂ እንደ ሥራችን መጠን አይደለም፤ ይህም ጸጋ ከዘላለም ዘመናት በፊት በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ተሰጠን፥

verses.text_english: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ይህን መከራ ደግሞ ተቀብዬአለሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላፍርበትም፤ ያመንሁትን አውቃለሁና፥ የሰጠሁትንም አደራ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ሊጠብቅ እንዲችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.text_english: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.text_amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለ እምነትና ፍቅር አድርገህ፥ ከእኔ የሰማኸውን ጤናማ ቃል ምሳሌ ያዝ፤

verses.text_english: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙን አደራ በእኛ በሚኖረው በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.text_amharic: በእስያ ያሉቱ ሁሉ ከእኔ ፈቀቅ እንዳሉ ታውቃለህ፥ ከእነርሱም ፊሎጎስና ሄርዋጌኔስ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ልሄኔሲፎሩ ቤተ ሰዎች ምሕረትን ይስጥ፥ ብዙ ጊዜ አሳርፎኛልና፤

verses.text_english: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.text_amharic: በሰንሰለቴም አላፈረበትም፥ ነገር ግን በሮሜ ባደረ ጊዜ ፈልጎ ፈልጎ አገኘኝ፤

verses.text_english: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found .
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ቀን ከጌታ ምሕረትን እንዲያገኝ ጌታ ይስጠው፤ በኤፌሶንም እንዴት እንዳገለገለኝ አንተ በደኅና ታውቃለህ።

verses.text_english: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለው ጸጋ በርታ።

verses.text_english: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች የመሰከሩለትን ከእኔም የሰማኸውን ሌሎችን ደግሞ ሊያስተምሩ ለሚችሉ ለታመኑ ሰዎች አደራ ስጥ።

verses.text_english: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በጎ ወታደር ሆነህ፥ አብረኸኝ መከራ ተቀበል።

verses.text_english: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.text_amharic: የሚዘምተው ሁሉ ለጦር ያስከተተውን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ትዳር በሚገኝበት ንግድ ራሱን አያጠላልፍም።

verses.text_english: And if a man also strive for masteries, is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.text_amharic: ደግሞም በጨዋታ የሚታገል ማንም ቢሆን፥ እንደሚገባ አድርጎ ባይታገል፥ የድሉን አክሊል አያገኝም።

verses.text_english: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.text_amharic: የሚደክመው ገበሬ ፍሬውን ከሚበሉት መጀመሪያ እንዲሆን ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.text_amharic: የምለውን ተመልከት፤ ጌታም በነገር ሁሉ ማስተዋልን ይስጥህ።

verses.text_english: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.text_amharic: በወንጌል እንደምሰብከው፥ ከሙታን የተነሣውን፥ ከዳዊት ዘርም የሆነውን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አስብ፤

verses.text_english: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም በመስበክ እንደ ክፉ አድራጊ እስክታሰር ድረስ መከራ እቀበላለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን አይታሰርም።

verses.text_english: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ እነርሱ ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያለውን መዳን ከዘላለም ክብር ጋር እንዲያገኙ ስለ ተመረጡት በነገር ሁሉ እጸናለሁ።

verses.text_english: a faithful saying: For if we be dead with , we shall also live with :
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉ የታመነ ነው እንዲህ የሚለው። ከእርሱ ጋር ከሞትን፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ በሕይወት እንኖራለን፤

verses.text_english: If we suffer, we shall also reign with : if we deny , he also will deny us:
verses.text_amharic: ብንጸና፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ እንነግሣለን፤ ብንክደው፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ይክደናል፤

verses.text_english: If we believe not, he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.text_amharic: ባናምነው፥ እርሱ የታመነ ሆኖ ይኖራል፤ ራሱን ሊክድ አይችልምና።

verses.text_english: Of these things put in remembrance, charging before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን አሳስባቸው፥ በቃልም እንዳይጣሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ምከራቸው፥ ይህ ምንም የማይረባ የሚሰሙትንም የሚያፈርስ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.text_amharic: የእውነትን ቃል በቅንነት የሚናገር የማያሳፍርም ሠራተኛ ሆነህ፥ የተፈተነውን ራስህን ለእግዚአብሔር ልታቀርብ ትጋ።

verses.text_english: But shun profane vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍ ራቅ፤ ኃጢአተኝነታቸውን ከፊት ይልቅ ይጨምራሉና፥ ቃላቸውም እንደ ጭንቁር ይባላል፤

verses.text_english: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱም ሄሜኔዎስና ፊሊጦስ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም። ትንሣኤ ከአሁን በፊት ሆኖአል እያሉ፥ ስለ እውነት ስተው፥ የአንዳንዶችን እምነት ይገለብጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.text_amharic: ሆኖም። ጌታ ለእርሱ የሆኑትን ያውቃል፥ ደግሞም። የጌታን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ከዓመፅ ይራቅ የሚለው ማኅተም ያለበት የተደላደለ የእግዚአብሔር መሠረት ቆሞአል።

verses.text_english: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.text_amharic: በትልቅም ቤት የእንጨትና የሸክላ ዕቃ ደግሞ አለ እንጂ የወርቅና የብር ዕቃ ብቻ አይደለም፥ እኵሌቶቹም ለክብር፥ እኵሌቶቹም ለውርደት ይሆናሉ፤

verses.text_english: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, prepared unto every good work.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ማንም ራሱን ከእነዚህ ቢያነጻ፥ ለክብር የሚሆን የተቀደሰም ለጌታውም የሚጠቅም ለበጎም ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ዕቃ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ የጎልማሳነት ምኞት ግን ሽሽ፥ በንጹሕም ልብ ጌታን ከሚጠሩ ጋር ጽድቅን እምነትን ፍቅርን ሰላምን አጥብቀህ ተከተል።

verses.text_english: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጠብን እንዲያመጣ አውቀህ ከሰነፎችና ካልተማሩ ምርመራ ራቅ፤

verses.text_english: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all , apt to teach, patient,
verses.text_amharic: የጌታም ባሪያ ለሰው ሁሉ ገር ለማስተማርም የሚበቃ ለትዕግሥትም የሚጸና ሊሆን እንጂ ሊጣላ አይገባውም።

verses.text_english: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በመጨረሻው ቀን የሚያስጨንቅ ዘመን እንዲመጣ ይህን እወቅ።

verses.text_english: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ራሳቸውን የሚወዱ ይሆናሉና፥ ገንዘብን የሚወዱ፥ ትምክህተኞች፥ ትዕቢተኞች፥ ተሳዳቢዎች፥ ለወላጆቻቸው የማይታዘዙ፥ የማያመሰግኑ፥

verses.text_english: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.text_amharic: ቅድስና የሌላቸው፥ ፍቅር የሌላቸው፥ ዕርቅን የማይሰሙ፥ ሐሜተኞች፥ ራሳቸውን የማይገዙ፥ ጨካኞች፥ መልካም የሆነውን የማይወዱ፥

verses.text_english: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.text_amharic: ከዳተኞች፥ ችኩሎች፥ በትዕቢት የተነፉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ ተድላን የሚወዱ ይሆናሉ፤

verses.text_english: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.text_amharic: የአምልኮት መልክ አላቸው ኃይሉን ግን ክደዋል፤ ከእነዚህ ደግሞ ራቅ።

verses.text_english: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ቤቶች ሾልከው እየገቡ፥ ኃጢአታቸው የተከመረባቸውን በልዩ ልዩ ምኞትንም የሚወሰዱትን ሁልጊዜም እየተማሩ እውነትን ወደ ማወቅ ሊደርሱ ከቶ የማይችሉትን ሞኞችን ሴቶች የሚማርኩ፥ ከእነዚህ ዘንድ ናቸውና።

verses.text_english: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያኔስና ኢያንበሬስም ሙሴን እንደ ተቃወሙት፥ እንዲሁ እነዚህ ደግሞ አእምሮአቸው የጠፋባቸው ስለ እምነትም የተጣሉ ሰዎች ሆነው፥ እውነትን ይቃወማሉ።

verses.text_english: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all , as theirs also was.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን የእነዚያ ሞኝነት ደግሞ ግልጥ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሞኝነታቸው ለሁሉ ይገለጣልና ከፊት ይልቅ አይቀናላቸውም።

verses.text_english: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ትምህርቴንና አካሄዴን አሳቤንም እምነቴንም ትዕግሥቴንም ፍቅሬንም መጽናቴንም ስደቴንም መከራዬንም ተከተልህ፤

verses.text_english: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of all the Lord delivered me.
verses.text_amharic: በአንጾኪያና በኢቆንዮን በልስጥራንም የሆነብኝን የታገሥሁትንም ስደት ታውቃለህ፤ ጌታም ከሁሉ አዳነኝ።

verses.text_english: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.text_amharic: በእውነትም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔርን እየመሰሉ ሊኖሩ የሚወዱ ሁሉ ይሰደዳሉ።

verses.text_english: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ክፉዎች ሰዎችና አታላዮች፥ እያሳቱና እየሳቱ፥ በክፋት እየባሱ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.text_english: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned ;
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን በተማርህበትና በተረዳህበት ነገር ጸንተህ ኑር፥ ከማን እንደ ተማርኸው ታውቃለህና፤

verses.text_english: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ከሕፃንነትህም ጀምረህ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን በማመን፥ መዳን የሚገኝበትን ጥበብ ሊሰጡህ የሚችሉትን ቅዱሳን መጻሕፍትን አውቀሃል።

verses.text_english: All scripture given by inspiration of God, and profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
I charge therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሕያዋንና በሙታንም ሊፈርድ ባለው በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ፊት፥ በመገለጡና በመንግሥቱም እመክርሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን ስበክ፥ በጊዜውም አለጊዜውም ጽና፥ ፈጽመህ እየታገሥህና እያስተማርህ፥ ዝለፍና ገሥጽ ምከርም።

verses.text_english: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወት የሚገኝበትን ትምህርት የማይታገሡበት ዘመን ይመጣልና፤ ነገር ግን ጆሮቻቸውን የሚያሳክክ ስለ ሆነ፥ እንደ ገዛ ምኞታቸው ለራሳቸው አስተማሪዎችን ያከማቻሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall turn away ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.text_amharic: እውነትንም ከመስማት ጆሮቻቸውን ይመልሳሉ፥ ወደ ተረትም ፈቀቅ ይላሉ።

verses.text_english: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ነገርን ሁሉ በልክ አድርግ፥ መከራን ተቀበል፥ የወንጌል ሰባኪነትን ሥራ አድርግ፥ አገልግሎትህን ፈጽም።

verses.text_english: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: በመሥዋዕት እንደሚደረግ፥ የእኔ ሕይወት ይሠዋልና፥ የምሄድበትም ጊዜ ደርሶአል።

verses.text_english: I have fought a good fight, I have finished course, I have kept the faith:
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙን ገድል ተጋድዬአለሁ፥ ሩጫውን ጨርሼአለሁ፥ ሃይማኖትን ጠብቄአለሁ፤

verses.text_english: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልኛል፥ ይህንም ጻድቅ ፈራጅ የሆነው ጌታ ያን ቀን ለእኔ ያስረክባል፥ ደግሞም መገለጡን ለሚወዱት ሁሉ እንጂ ለእኔ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.text_amharic: በቶሎ ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤

verses.text_english: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.text_amharic: ዴማስ የአሁኑን ዓለም ወዶ ትቶኛልና፥ ወደ ተሰሎንቄም ሄዶአል፤ ቄርቂስም ወደ ገላትያ ቲቶም ወደ ድልማጥያ ሄደዋል፤

verses.text_english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.text_amharic: ሉቃስ ብቻ ከእኔ ጋር አለ። ማርቆስ ለአገልግሎት ብዙ ይጠቅመኛልና ይዘኸው ከአንተ ጋር አምጣው።

verses.text_english: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.text_amharic: ቲኪቆስን ግን ወደ ኤፌሶን ላክሁት።

verses.text_english: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring , and the books, especially the parchments.
verses.text_amharic: ስትመጣ በጢሮአዳ ከአክርጳ ዘንድ የተውሁትን በርኖሱንና መጻሕፍቱን ይልቁንም በብራና የተጻፉትን አምጣልኝ።

verses.text_english: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.text_amharic: የናስ አንጥረኛው እስክንድሮስ እጅግ ከፋብኝ፤ ጌታ እንደ ሥራው ይመልስለታል።

verses.text_english: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.text_amharic: አንተም ደግሞ ከእርሱ ተጠበቅ፥ የምንናገረውን እጅግ ተቃውሞአልና።

verses.text_english: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all forsook me: that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.text_amharic: በፊተኛው ሙግቴ አንድ ስንኳ አልደረሰልኝም፥ ሁሉም ተዉኝ እንጂ፤ ይህንም አይቍጠርባቸው፤

verses.text_english: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን የስብከቱ ሥራ በእኔ እንዲፈጸም አሕዛብም ሁሉ እንዲሰሙት፥ ጌታ በእኔ አጠገብ ቆሞ አበረታኝ፥ ከአንበሳ አፍም ዳንሁ።

verses.text_english: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታም ከክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ያድነኛል ለሰማያዊውም መንግሥት ይጠብቀኛል፤ ለእርሱ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.text_amharic: ለጵርስቅላና ለአቂላ ለሄኔሲፎሩም ቤተ ሰዎች ሰላምታ አቅርብልኝ።

verses.text_english: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.text_amharic: ኤርስጦስ በቆሮንቶስ ቀረ፥ ጥሮፊሞስን ግን ታሞ በሚሊጢን ተውሁት።

verses.text_english: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.text_amharic: ከክረምት በፊት እንድትመጣ ትጋ። ኤውግሎስና ጱዴስ ሊኖስም ቅላውዲያም ወንድሞችም ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡልሃል።

verses.text_english: The Lord Jesus Christ with thy spirit. Grace with you. Amen. « unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.»
verses.text_amharic: ጌታ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከመንፈስህ ጋር ይሁን። ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያና የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.text_english: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔር ለተመረጡት እምነት እንዲሆንላቸው በዘላለምም ሕይወት ተስፋ እንደ አምልኮት ያለውን እውነት እንዲያውቁ የተላከ፤ ስለዚህም ሕይወት የማይዋሽ እግዚአብሔር ከዘላለም ዘመናት በፊት ተስፋ ሰጠ፥

verses.text_english: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.text_amharic: በዘመኑም ጊዜ፥ መድኃኒታችን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ፥ ለእኔ አደራ በተሰጠኝ ስብከት ቃሉን ገለጠ፤

verses.text_english: To Titus, own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.text_amharic: በሃይማኖት ኅብረት እውነተኛ ልጄ ለሚሆን ለቲቶ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከመድኃኒታችንም ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ምክንያት የቀረውን እንድታደራጅ በየከተማውም፥ እኔ አንተን እንዳዘዝሁ፥ ሽማግሌዎችን እንድትሾም በቀርጤስ ተውሁህ፤

verses.text_english: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.text_amharic: የማይነቀፍና የአንዲት ሚስት ባል የሚሆን፥ የሚያምኑም ልጆች ያሉት፥ ስለ መዳራትም ወይም ስለ አለመታዘዝ የማይከሰስ ማንም ቢኖር፥ ሹመው።

verses.text_english: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.text_amharic: ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢ፥ የማይነቀፍ ሊሆን ይገባዋልና፤ የማይኮራ፥ የማይቆጣ፥ የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ፥ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወድ፥

verses.text_english: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚወድ፥ ጠንቃቃ፥ ጻድቅ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወት በሚገኝበት ትምህርት ደግሞ ሊመክር ተቃዋሚዎቹንም ሊወቅስ ይችል ዘንድ፥ እንደተማረው በታመነ ቃል ይጽና።

verses.text_english: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.text_amharic: የማይታዘዙና ከንቱ የሚናገሩ የሚያታልሉ ይልቁንም ከተገረዙት ወገን የሚሆኑ ብዙ ናቸውና፤

verses.text_english: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ስለ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይገባውን እያስተማሩ ቤቶችን በሞላው ስለ ሚገለብጡ፥ አፋቸውን መዝጋት ይገባል።

verses.text_english: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.text_amharic: የገዛ ራሳቸው ነቢይ የሆነ ከእነርሱ አንዱ። የቀርጤስ ሰዎች ዘወትር ውሸተኞች፥ ክፉዎች አራዊት፥ በላተኞች፥ ሥራ ፈቶች ናቸው ብሎአል።

verses.text_english: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉ ለንጹሖች ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለርኵሳንና ለማያምኑ ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ምንም የለም፥ ነገር ግን አእምሮአቸውም ሕሊናቸውም ረክሶአል።

verses.text_english: Unto the pure all things pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያውቁ በግልጥ ይናገራሉ፥ ዳሩ ግን የሚያስጸይፉና የማይታዘዙ ለበጎ ሥራም ሁሉ የማይበቁ ስለ ሆኑ፥ በሥራቸው ይክዱታል።

verses.text_english: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ግን ሕይወት ለሚገኝበት ትምህርት የሚገባውን ተናገር።

verses.text_english: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.text_amharic: ሽማግሌዎች ልከኞች፥ ጭምቶች፥ ራሳቸውን የሚገዙ፥ በእምነትና በፍቅር በመጽናትም ጤናሞች እንዲሆኑ ምከራቸው፤

verses.text_english: The aged women likewise, that in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም አሮጊቶች ሴቶች አካሄዳቸው ለቅዱስ አገልግሎት የሚገባ፥ የማያሙ፥ ለብዙ ወይን ጠጅ የማይገዙ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚያስተምሩ ይሁኑ፤

verses.text_english: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.text_amharic: ቆነጃጅትም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዳይሰደብ፥ ባሎቻቸውን የሚወዱ፥ ልጆቻቸውን የሚወዱ፥ ራሳቸውን የሚገዙ፥ ንጹሖች፥ በቤት የሚሠሩ፥ በጎዎች፥ ለባሎቻቸው የሚታዘዙ እንዲሆኑ ይምከሩአቸው።

verses.text_english: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.text_amharic: ጎበዞችም እንዲሁ ራሳቸውን እንዲገዙ ምከራቸው።

verses.text_english: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.text_amharic: የሚቃወም ሰው ስለ እኛ የሚናገረውን መጥፎ ነገር ሲያጣ እንዲያፍር፥ በነገር ሁሉ መልካምን በማድረግህ ምሳሌ የሚሆን ራስህን አሳይ፤ በትምህርትህም ደኅንነትን፥ ጭምትነትን፥ ጤናማና የማይነቀፍ ንግግርን ግለጥ።

verses.text_english: servants to be obedient unto their own masters, to please well in all ; not answering again;
Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.text_amharic: ባሪያዎች ስለ መድኃኒታችን ስለ እግዚአብሔር የሚሆነውን ትምህርት በሁሉ ነገር ያስመሰግኑ ዘንድ፥ ለገዛ ጌቶቻቸው እንዲገዙ በሁሉም ደስ እንዲያሰኙ፥ ሳይቃወሙና ሳይሰርቁም በጎ ታማኝነትን ሁሉ እንዲያሳዩ ምከራቸው።

verses.text_english: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችን ሁሉ የሚያድን የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ተገልጦአልና፤

verses.text_english: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.text_amharic: መድኃኒታችንም ከዓመፅ ሁሉ እንዲቤዠን፥ መልካሙንም ለማድረግ የሚቀናውን ገንዘቡም የሚሆነውን ሕዝብ ለራሱ እንዲያነጻ፥ ስለ እኛ ነፍሱን ሰጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን በሙሉ ሥልጣን ተናገርና ምከር ገሥጽም፤ ማንም አይናቅህ።

verses.text_english: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.text_amharic: ለገዦችና ለባለ ሥልጣኖች የሚገዙና የሚታዘዙ፥ ለበጎ ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጁ፥ ማንንም የማይሰድቡ፥

verses.text_english: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.text_amharic: የማይከራከሩ፥ ገሮች፥ ለሰው ሁሉ የዋህነትን ሁሉ የሚያሳዩ እንዲሆኑ ኣሳስባቸው።

verses.text_english: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ደግሞ አስቀድመን የማናስተውል ነበርንና፤ የማንታዘዝ፥ የምንስት፥ ለምኞትና ለልዩ ልዩ ተድላ እንደ ባሪያዎች የምንገዛ፥ በክፋትና በምቀኝነት የምንኖር፥ የምንጣላ፥ እርስ በርሳችን የምንጠላላ ነበርን።

verses.text_english: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን የመድኃኒታችን የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነትና ሰውን መውደዱ በተገለጠ ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ምሕረቱ መጠን ለአዲስ ልደት በሚሆነው መታጠብና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በመታደስ አዳነን እንጂ፥ እኛ ስላደረግነው በጽድቅ ስለ ነበረው ሥራ አይደለም፤

verses.text_english: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.text_amharic: ያን መንፈስም፥ በጸጋው ጸድቀን በዘላለም ሕይወት ተስፋ ወራሾች እንድንሆን፥ በመድኃኒታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በእኛ ላይ አትርፎ አፈሰሰው።

verses.text_english: a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉ የታመነ ነው። እግዚአብሔርንም የሚያምኑት በመልካም ሥራ በጥንቃቄ እንዲጸኑ፥ እነዚህን አስረግጠህ እንድትናገር እፈቅዳለሁ። ይህ መልካምና ለሰዎች የሚጠቅም ነው፤

verses.text_english: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሞኝነት ካለው ምርመራና ከትውልዶች ታሪክ ከክርክርም ስለ ሕግም ከሚሆን ጠብ ራቅ፤ የማይጠቅሙና ከንቱዎች ናቸውና፤

verses.text_english: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.text_amharic: አርጢሞንን ወይም ቲኪቆስን ወደ አንተ ስልክ፥ ወደ ኒቆጵልዮን ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤ በዚያ ልከርም ቈርጬአለሁና።

verses.text_english: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግ አዋቂውን ዜማስንና አጵሎስን ምንም እንዳይጎድልባቸው በጉዞአቸው ተግተህ እርዳ።

verses.text_english: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.text_amharic: ከወገናችንም ያሉት ደግሞ ፍሬ ቢሶች ሆነው እንዳይቀሩ፥ የግድ ስለሚያስፈልገው ነገር በመልካም ሥራ እንዲጸኑ ይማሩ።

verses.text_english: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.text_amharic: ከእኔ ጋር ያሉት ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡልሃል። በእምነት ለሚወዱን ሰላምታ አቅርብልን። ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
verses.text_amharic: የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እስር ጳውሎስ ወንድሙም ጢሞቴዎስ፥ ለተወደደውና አብሮን ለሚሠራ ለፊልሞና፥

verses.text_english: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.text_amharic: ከጥንት ጀምሮ እግዚአብሔር በብዙ ዓይነትና በብዙ ጎዳና ለአባቶቻችን በነቢያት ተናግሮ፥

verses.text_english: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን ወራሽ ባደረገው ደግሞም ዓለማትን በፈጠረበት በልጁ በዚህ ዘመን መጨረሻ ለእኛ ተናገረን፤

verses.text_english: Who being the brightness of glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የክብሩ መንጸባረቅና የባሕርዩ ምሳሌ ሆኖ፥ ሁሉን በስልጣኑ ቃል እየደገፈ፥ ኃጢአታችንን በራሱ ካነጻ በኋላ በሰማያት በግርማው ቀኝ ተቀመጠ፤

verses.text_english: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.text_amharic: ከመላእክት ይልቅ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ስምን በወረሰ መጠን እንዲሁ ከእነርሱ አብዝቶ ይበልጣል።

verses.text_english: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.text_amharic: ከመላእክትስ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ፥ ደግሞም። እኔ አባት እሆነዋለሁ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል

verses.text_english: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
verses.text_amharic: ያለው ከቶ ለማን ነው? ደግሞም በኵርን ወደ ዓለም ሲያገባ። የእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ሁሉም ለእርሱ ይስገዱ ይላል።

verses.text_english: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ መላእክትም። መላእክቱን መናፍስት አገልጋዮቹንም የእሳት ነበልባል የሚያደርግ

verses.text_english: But unto the Son , Thy throne, O God, for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.text_amharic: ይላል፤ ስለ ልጁ ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ ዙፋንህ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ይኖራል፤ የመንግሥትህ በትር የቅንነት በትር ነው።

verses.text_english: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.text_amharic: ጽድቅን ወደድህ ዓመፅንም ጠላህ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ከጓደኞችህ ይልቅ በደስታ ዘይት ቀባህ

verses.text_english: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.text_amharic: ይላል። ደግሞ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ከጥንት ምድርን መሠረትህ፥ ሰማዮችም የእጆችህ ሥራ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ይጠፋሉ አንተ ግን ጸንተህ ትኖራለህ፤ ሁሉም እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ፥

verses.text_english: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ መጎናጸፊያም ትጠቀልላቸዋለህ ይለወጡማል፤ አንተ ግን አንተ ነህ፥ ዓመቶችህም ከቶ አያልቁም

verses.text_english: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.text_amharic: ይላል። ነገር ግን ከመላእክት። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ

verses.text_english: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.text_amharic: ከቶ ለማን ብሎአል? ሁሉ መዳንን ይወርሱ ዘንድ ስላላቸው ለማገዝ የሚላኩ የሚያገለግሉም መናፍስት አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let slip.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ከሰማነው ነገር ምናልባት እንዳንወሰድ፥ ለእርሱ አብልጠን ልንጠነቀቅ ያስፈልገናል።

verses.text_english: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.text_amharic: በመላእክት የተነገረው ቃል ጽኑ ከሆነ፥ መተላለፍና አለመታዘዝም ሁሉ የጽድቅን ብድራት ከተቀበለ፥ እኛስ እንዲህ ያለውን ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብንለው፥ እንዴት እናመልጣለን?

verses.text_english: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard ;
verses.text_amharic: ይህ በጌታ በመጀመሪያ የተነገረ ነበርና፥ የሰሙትም ለእኛ አጸኑት፥

verses.text_english: God also bearing witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም እርሱ ራሱ እንደ ፈቀደ በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር በልዩ ልዩ ተአምራትም፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስንም በማደል አብሮ መሰከረለት።

verses.text_english: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርሱ የምንናገርበትን የሚመጣውን ዓለም ለመላእክት ያስገዛው አይደለምና።

verses.text_english: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንዱ በአንድ ስፍራ። ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ወይስ ትጎበኘው ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.text_english: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.text_amharic: ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ የክብርና የምስጋና ዘውድ ጫንህለት፥ በእጆችህም ሥራ ላይ ሾምኸው፤

verses.text_english: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት ብሎ መሰከረ። ሁሉን ከእርሱ በታች ባስገዛ ጊዜ ያልተገዛለት ምንም አልተወምና። አሁን ግን ሁሉ እንደ ተገዛለት ገና አናይም፤

verses.text_english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስለ ሰው ሁሉ ሞትን ይቀምስ ዘንድ፥ ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አንሶ የነበረውን ኢየሱስን ከሞት መከራ የተነሣ የክብርና የምስጋናን ዘውድ ተጭኖ እናየዋለን።

verses.text_english: For it became him, for whom all things, and by whom all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ልጆችን ወደ ክብር ሲያመጣ የመዳናቸውን ራስ በመከራ ይፈጽም ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱ የተነሣ ሁሉ በእርሱም ሁሉ ለሆነ፥ ለእርሱ ተገብቶታልና።

verses.text_english: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ምክንያት። ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ በማኅበርም መካከል በዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እኔ በእርሱ እታመናለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እነሆኝ እኔን እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝንም ልጆች ሲል ወንድሞች ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም።

verses.text_english: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.text_amharic: የአብርሃምን ዘር ይዞአል እንጂ የያዘው የመላእክትን አይደለም።

verses.text_english: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የሕዝብን ኃጢአት ለማስተስረይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ የሚምርና የታመነ ሊቀ ካህናት እንዲሆን፥ በነገር ሁሉ ወንድሞቹን ሊመስል ተገባው።

verses.text_english: For verily he took not on angels; but he took on the seed of Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ራሱ ተፈትኖ መከራን ስለ ተቀበለ የሚፈተኑትን ሊረዳቸው ይችላልና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ ከሰማያዊው ጥሪ ተካፋዮች የሆናችሁ ቅዱሳን ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የሃይማኖታችንን ሐዋርያና ሊቀ ካህናት ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ተመልከቱ፤

verses.text_english: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses in all his house.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ ደግሞ በቤቱ ሁሉ የታመነ እንደሆነ፥ እርሱ ለሾመው የታመነ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: For this was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.text_amharic: ቤትን የሚያዘጋጀው ከቤቱ ይልቅ የሚበልጥ ክብር እንዳለው መጠን፥ እንዲሁ እርሱ ከሙሴ ይልቅ የሚበልጥ ክብር የተገባው ሆኖ ተቆጥሮአልና።

verses.text_english: For every house is builded by some ; but he that built all things God.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱ ቤት በአንድ ሰው ተዘጋጅቶአልና፥ ሁሉን ያዘጋጀ ግን እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.text_english: And Moses verily faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴስ በኋላ ስለሚነገረው ነገር ምስክር ሊሆን በቤቱ ሁሉ እንደ ሎሌ የታመነ ነበረ፥ ክርስቶስ ግን እንደ ልጅ በቤቱ ላይ የታመነ ነው፤

verses.text_english: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.text_amharic: እኛም የምንደፍርበትን የምንመካበትንም ተስፋ እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ ቤቱ ነን።

verses.text_english: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንደሚል።

verses.text_english: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙት፥ አባቶቻችሁ እኔን የፈተኑበት የመረመሩበትም አርባ ዓመትም ሥራዬን ያዩበት በምድረ በዳ በፈተና ቀን በማስመረር እንደ ሆነ፥ ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ።
