verses.text_english: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ያን ትውልድ ተቆጥቼ። ዘወትር በልባቸው ይስታሉ መንገዴን ግን አላወቁም አልሁ፤

verses.text_english: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም ብዬ በቍጣዬ ማልሁ።

verses.text_english: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ምናልባት ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን የሚያስክዳችሁ ክፉና የማያምን ልብ ከእናንተ በአንዳችሁ እንዳይኖር ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.text_english: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ማንም በኃጢአት መታለል እልከኛ እንዳይሆን፥ ዛሬ ተብሎ ሲጠራ ሳለ፥ በእያንዳንዱ ቀን እርስ በርሳችሁ ተመካከሩ፤

verses.text_english: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.text_amharic: የመጀመሪያ እምነታችንን እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ፥ የክርስቶስ ተካፋዮች ሆነናልና፤

verses.text_english: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.text_amharic: እየተባለ። ዛሬ ድምጹን ብትሰሙት፥ በማስመረር እንደሆነ ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ።

verses.text_english: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.text_amharic: ሰምተው ያስመረሩት እነማን ነበሩ? በሙሴ ተመርተው ከግብጽ የወጡ ሁሉ አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: But with whom was he grieved forty years? not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.text_amharic: አርባ አመትም የተቆጣባቸው እነማን ነበሩ? ሬሳቸው በምድረ በዳ የወደቀ፥ ኃጢአትን ያደረጉት እነርሱ አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.text_amharic: ካልታዘዙትም በቀር ወደ እረፍቱ እንዳይገቡ የማለባቸው እነማን ነበሩ?

verses.text_english: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.text_amharic: ባለማመናቸውም ጠንቅ ሊገቡ እንዳልተቻላቸው እናያለን።

verses.text_english: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ወደ ዕረፍቱ ለመግባት ተስፋ ገና ቀርቶልን ከሆነ፥ ምናልባት ከእናንተ ማንም የማይበቃ መስሎ እንዳይታይ እንፍራ።

verses.text_english: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard .
verses.text_amharic: ለእነዚያ ደግሞ እንደ ተነገረ ለእኛ የምስራች ተሰብኮልናልና፤ ዳሩ ግን የሰሙት ቃል ከሰሚዎቹ ጋር በእምነት ስላልተዋሐደ አልጠቀማቸውም።

verses.text_english: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ሥራው ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ምንም እንኳ ቢፈጸም። እንዲህ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም ብዬ በቁጣዬ ማልሁ እንዳለ፥ እኛስ ያመንን ወደ ዕረፍቱ እንገባለን።

verses.text_english: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ ሰባተኛው ቀን በአንድ ስፍራ። እግዚአብሔርም በሰባተኛው ቀን ከሥራው ሁሉ ዐረፈ ብሎአልና፤

verses.text_english: And in this again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ስፍራም ደግሞ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም።

verses.text_english: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ አንዳንዶች በዚያ እንዲገቡ ስለ ቀሩ፥ ቀድሞም የምስራች የተሰበከላቸው ባለመታዘዝ ጠንቅ ስላልገቡ።

verses.text_english: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.text_amharic: ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙት ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ በፊት እንደ ተባለ፥ ይህን ከሚያህል ዘመን በኋላ በዳዊት ሲናገር። ዛሬ ብሎ አንድ ቀን እንደ ገና ይቀጥራል።

verses.text_english: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.text_amharic: ኢያሱ አሳርፎአቸው ኖሮ ቢሆንስ፥ ከዚያ በኋላ ስለ ሌላ ቀን ባልተናገረ ነበር።

verses.text_english: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲያስ የሰንበት ዕረፍት ለእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ቀርቶላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God from his.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ዕረፍቱ የገባ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሥራው እንዳረፈ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ከሥራው አርፎአልና።

verses.text_english: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እንደዚያ እንደ አለመታዘዝ ምሳሌ ማንም እንዳይወድቅ ወደዚያ ዕረፍት ለመግባት እንትጋ።

verses.text_english: For the word of God quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሕያው ነውና፥ የሚሠራም፥ ሁለትም አፍ ካለው ሰይፍ ሁሉ ይልቅ የተሳለ ነው፥ ነፍስንና መንፈስንም ጅማትንና ቅልጥምንም እስኪለይ ድረስ ይወጋል፥ የልብንም ስሜትና አሳብ ይመረምራል፤

verses.text_english: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.text_amharic: እኛን በሚቆጣጠር በእርሱ ዓይኖቹ ፊት ሁሉ ነገር የተራቆተና የተገለጠ ነው እንጂ፥ በእርሱ ፊት የተሰወረ ፍጥረት የለም።

verses.text_english: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast profession.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያለፈ ትልቅ ሊቀ ካህናት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ስላለን፥ ጸንተን ሃይማኖታችንን እንጠብቅ።

verses.text_english: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as without sin.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአት በቀር በነገር ሁሉ እንደ እኛ የተፈተነ ነው እንጂ፥ በድካማችን ሊራራልን የማይችል ሊቀ ካህናት የለንም።

verses.text_english: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ምሕረትን እንድንቀበል በሚያስፈልገንም ጊዜ የሚረዳንን ጸጋ እንድናገኝ ወደ ጸጋው ዙፋን በእምነት እንቅረብ።

verses.text_english: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ ስለ ኃጢአት መባንና መስዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ ከሰው ተመርጦ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ስለ ሰው ይሾማልና፤

verses.text_english: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ራሱም ደግሞ ድካምን ስለሚለብስ፥ ላልተማሩትና ለሚስቱት ሊራራላቸው ይችላል፤

verses.text_english: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ምክንያት ስለ ሕዝብ እንደሚያቀርብ እንዲሁ ስለ ራሱ ደግሞ መስዋዕትን ስለ ኃጢአት ሊያቀርብ ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as Aaron.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ከተጠራ በቀር ማንም ክብሩን ለራሱ የሚወስድ የለም።

verses.text_english: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ ሊቀ ካህናት ሊሆን ራሱን አላከበረም ነገር ግን። አንተ ልጄ ነህ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ ያለው እርሱ ነው፤

verses.text_english: As he saith also in another , Thou a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህም በሌላ ስፍራ ደግሞ። አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም በስጋው ወራት ከሞት ሊያድነው ወደሚችል ከብርቱ ጩኸትና ከእንባ ጋር ጸሎትንና ምልጃን አቀረበ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ስለ መፍራቱ ተሰማለት፤

verses.text_english: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.text_amharic: ምንም ልጅ ቢሆን፥ ከተቀበለው መከራ መታዘዝን ተማረ፤

verses.text_english: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፥ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.text_amharic: ከጊዜው የተነሳ አስተማሪዎች ልትሆኑ ሲገባችሁ፥ አንድ ሰው ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃላት መጀመሪያ ያለውን የሕፃንነትን ትምህርት እንዲያስተምራችሁ እንደ ገና ያስፈልጋችኋልና፤ የሚያስፈልጋችሁም ወተት ነው እንጂ ጠንካራ ምግብ አይደለም።

verses.text_english: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.text_amharic: ወተት የሚጋት ሁሉ ሕፃን ስለ ሆነ የጽድቅን ቃል አያውቅምና፤

verses.text_english: For every one that useth milk unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.text_amharic: ጠንካራ ምግብ ግን መልካሙንና ክፉውን ለመለየት በስራቸው የለመደ ልቡና ላላቸው ለፍጹማን ሰዎች ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የክርስቶስን ነገር መጀመሪያ የሚናገረውን ቃል ትተን ወደ ፍጻሜ እንሂድ፤ መሠረትን ደግመን አንመሥርት፥

verses.text_english: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም ከሞተ ሥራ ንስሐና በእግዚአብሔር እምነት፥ ስለ ጥምቀቶችና እጆችንም ስለ መጫን ስለ ሙታንም ትንሣኤ ስለ ዘላለም ፍርድም ትምህርት ነው።

verses.text_english: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርም ቢፈቅድ ይህን እናደርጋለን።

verses.text_english: For impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጊዜ ብርሃን የበራላቸውን ሰማያዊውንም ስጦታ የቀመሱትን ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ተካፋዮች ሆነው የነበሩትን

verses.text_english: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.text_amharic: መልካሙንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃልና ሊመጣ ያለውን የዓለም ኃይል የቀመሱትን

verses.text_english: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put to an open shame.
verses.text_amharic: በኋላም የካዱትን እንደገና ለንስሐ እነርሱን ማደስ የማይቻል ነው፤ ለራሳቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ይሰቅሉታልና ያዋርዱትማልና።

verses.text_english: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
verses.text_amharic: ብዙ ጊዜ በእርስዋ ላይ የሚወርደውን ዝናብ የምትጠጣ መሬት፥ ለሚያርሱአትም ደግሞ የምትጠቅምን አትክልት የምታበቅል፥ ከእግዚአብሔር በረከትን ታገኛለችና፤

verses.text_english: But that which beareth thorns and briers rejected, and nigh unto cursing; whose end to be burned.
verses.text_amharic: እሾህና ኵርንችትን ግን ብታወጣ፥ የተጣለች ናት ለመረገምም ትቀርባለች፥ መጨረሻዋም መቃጠል ነው።

verses.text_english: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ምንም እንኳ እንዲሁ ብንናገር፥ አብልጦ የሚሻለውና ለመዳን የሚሆነው እንዲሆንላችሁ ተረድተናል።

verses.text_english: For God not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር፥ ቅዱሳንን ስላገለገላችሁ እስከ አሁንም ስለምታገለግሉአቸው፥ ያደረጋችሁትን ሥራ ለስሙም ያሳያችሁትን ፍቅር ይረሳ ዘንድ ዓመፀኛ አይደለምና።

verses.text_english: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎች ከእነርሱ በሚበልጠው ይምላሉና፥ ለማስረዳትም የሆነው መሐላ የሙግት ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation to them an end of all strife.
verses.text_amharic: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤

verses.text_english: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed by an oath:
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ኢየሱስ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ሊቀ ካህናት የሆነው፥ ስለ እኛ ቀዳሚ ሆኖ ገባ።

verses.text_english: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.text_amharic: የሳሌም ንጉሥና የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ካህን የሆነ ይህ መልከ ጼዴቅ አብርሃም ነገሥታትን ገድሎ ሲመለስ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገናኝቶ ባረከው፤

verses.text_english: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.text_amharic: ለእርሱም ደግሞ አብርሃም ከሁሉ አስራትን አካፈለው። የስሙም ትርጓሜ በመጀመሪያ የጽድቅ ንጉሥ ነው፥ ኋላም ደግሞ የሳሌም ንጉሥ ማለት የሰላም ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.text_english: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
verses.text_amharic: አባትና እናት የትውልድም ቍጥር የሉትም፥ ለዘመኑም ጥንት ለህይወቱም ፍጻሜ የለውም፥ ዳሩ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ተመስሎ ለዘላለም ካህን ሆኖ ይኖራል።

verses.text_english: Now consider how great this man , unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.text_amharic: የአባቶች አለቃ አብርሃም ከዘረፋው የሚሻለውን አስራት የሰጠው ይህ ሰው እንዴት ትልቅ እንደ ነበረ እስኪ ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.text_amharic: ከሌዊ ልጆችም ክህነትን የሚቀበሉት ከህዝቡ ማለት ከወንድሞቻቸው፥ እነርሱ ምንም ከአብርሃም ወገብ ቢወጡ፥ ከእነርሱ አሥራትን በሕግ እንዲያስወጡ ትእዛዝ አላቸው፤

verses.text_english: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.text_amharic: ትውልዱ ከእነርሱ የማይቈጠረው ግን ከአብርሃም አሥራትን አውጥቶአል፥ የተስፋ ቃል የነበረውንም ባርኮአል።

verses.text_english: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.text_amharic: ትንሹም በታላቁ እንዲባረክ ክርክር የሌለበት ነገር ነው።

verses.text_english: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህስ የሚሞቱ ሰዎች አሥራትን ያስወጣሉ፥ በዚያ ግን የሚያስወጣ በሕይወት እንዲኖር የተመሰከረለት እርሱ ነው።

verses.text_english: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ለማለት ሲፈቀድ፥ አሥራትን የሚያስወጣ ሌዊ እንኳ በአብርሃም እጅ አሥራትን ሰጥቶአል፤

verses.text_english: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.text_amharic: መልከ ጼዴቅ በተገናኘው ጊዜ ገና በአባቱ ወገብ ነበረና።

verses.text_english: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ህዝቡ በሌዊ ክህነት የተመሠረተን ሕግ ተቀብለዋልና በዚያ ክህነት ፍጹምነት የተገኘ ቢሆን፥ እንደ አሮን ሹመት የማይቈጠር፥ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ግን የሆነ ሌላ ካህን ሊነሳ ወደፊት ስለ ምን ያስፈልጋል?

verses.text_english: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.text_amharic: ክህነቱ ሲለወጥ፥ ሕጉ ደግሞ ሊለወጥ የግድ ነውና።

verses.text_english: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ነገር የተነገረለት እርሱ በሌላ ወገን ተካፍሎአልና፥ ከዚያም መሠዊያውን ያገለገለ ማንም የለም፤

verses.text_english: For evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.text_amharic: ጌታችን ከይሁዳ ነገድ እንደወጣ የተገለጠ ነውና፥ ስለዚህም ነገድ ሙሴ ምንም እንኳ ስለ ክህነት አልተናገረም።

verses.text_english: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.text_amharic: አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.text_english: For he testifieth, Thou a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope ; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: And inasmuch as not without an oath :
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም እንዳይኖሩ ሞት ስለ ከለከላቸው ካህናት የሆኑት ብዙ ናቸው፤

verses.text_english: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስለሆነ የማይለወጥ ክህነት አለው፤

verses.text_english: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ እነርሱም ሊያማልድ ዘወትር በሕይወት ይኖራልና ስለዚህ ደግሞ በእርሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚመጡትን ፈጽሞ ሊያድናቸው ይችላል።

verses.text_english: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱስና ያለ ተንኮል ነውርም የሌለበት ከኃጢአተኞችም የተለየ ከሰማያትም ከፍ ከፍ ያለ፥ እንደዚህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት ይገባልና፤

verses.text_english: But this , because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም እንደነዚያ ሊቃነ ካህናት አስቀድሞ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት በኋላም ስለ ሕዝቡ ኃጢአት ዕለት ዕለት መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ አያስፈልገውም፤ ራሱን ባቀረበ ጊዜ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ አድርጎአልና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.text_amharic: ሕጉ ድካም ያላቸውን ሰዎች ሊቀ ካህናት አድርጎ ይሾማልና፤ ከሕግ በኋላ የመጣ የመሐላው ቃል ግን ለዘላለም ፍጹም የሆነውን ልጅ ይሾማል።

verses.text_english: Now of the things which we have spoken the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.text_amharic: ከተናገርነውም ዋና ነገሩ ይህ ነው፤ በሰማያት በግርማው ዙፋን ቀኝ የተቀመጠ እንዲህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት አለን፤

verses.text_english: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም የመቅደስና የእውነተኛይቱ ድንኳን አገልጋይ ነው፥ እርስዋም በሰው ሳይሆን በጌታ የተተከለች ናት።

verses.text_english: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ መባንና መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ ይሾማልና፤ ስለዚህም ለዚህ ደግሞ የሚያቀርበው አንዳች ሊኖረው የግድ ነው።

verses.text_english: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በምድር ቢኖርስ፥ እንደ ሕግ መባን የሚያቀርቡት ስላሉ፥ ካህን እንኳ ባልሆነም፤

verses.text_english: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ሙሴ ድንኳኒቱን ሊሠራ ሳለ እንደ ተረዳ፥ ለሰማያዊ ነገር ምሳሌና ጥላ የሚሆነውን ያገለግላሉ። በተራራው እንደ ተገለጠልህ ምሳሌ ሁሉን ታደርግ ዘንድ ተጠንቀቅ ብሎት ነበርና።

verses.text_english: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በሚሻል ተስፋ ቃል በተመሠረተ በሚሻል ኪዳን ደግሞ መካከለኛ እንደሚሆን በዚያ ልክ እጅግ የሚሻል አገልግሎት አግኝቶአል።

verses.text_english: For if that first had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛው ኪዳን ነቀፋ ባይኖረው፥ ለሁለተኛው ስፍራ ባልተፈለገም ነበር።

verses.text_english: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱን እየነቀፈ ይላቸዋልና። እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ኪዳን የምገባበት ወራት ይመጣል ይላል ጌታ፤

verses.text_english: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
verses.text_amharic: ከግብፅ አገር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝሁበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንደገባሁት ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልጸኑምና፥ እኔም ቸል አልኋቸው ይላል ጌታ።

verses.text_english: For this the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ ወራት በኋላ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር የምገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነውና ይላል ጌታ፤ ሕጌን በልቡናቸው አኖራለሁ በልባቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆንላቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑልኛል።

verses.text_english: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.text_amharic: እያንዳንዱም ጐረቤቱን እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን። ጌታን እወቅ ብሎ አያስተምርም ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ያውቁኛልና።

verses.text_english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፃቸውን እምራቸዋለሁና፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም።

verses.text_english: In that he saith, A new , he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old ready to vanish away.
verses.text_amharic: አዲስ በማለቱ ፊተኛውን አስረጅቶአል፤ አሮጌና ውራጅ የሆነውስ ሊጠፋ ቀርቦአል።

verses.text_english: Then verily the first had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛይቱም ደግሞ የአገልግሎት ስርዓትና የዚህ ዓለም የሆነው መቅደስ ነበራት።

verses.text_english: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.text_amharic: የመጀመሪያይቱ ድንኳን ተዘጋጅታ ነበርና፥ በእርስዋም ቅድስት በምትባለው ውስጥ መቅረዙና ጠረጴዛው የመስዋዕቱም ኅብስት ነበረባት፤

verses.text_english: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.text_amharic: ከሁለተኛውም መጋረጃ ወዲያ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን የምትባለው ድንኳን ነበረች፥

verses.text_english: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ውስጥ የወርቅ ማዕጠንት ነበረ ሁለንተናዋም በወርቅ የተለበጠች የኪዳን ታቦት፤ በእርስዋም ውስጥ መና ያለባት የወርቅ መሶብና የበቀለች የአሮን በትር የኪዳኑም ጽላት ነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.text_amharic: በላይዋም ማስተስሪያውን የሚጋርዱ የክብር ኪሩቤል ነበሩ፤ ስለ እነዚህም ስለ እያንዳንዳቸው ልንናገር አሁን አንችልም።

verses.text_english: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service .
verses.text_amharic: ይህም እንደዚህ ተዘጋጅቶ ሳለ፥ ካህናት አገልግሎታቸውን እየፈጸሙ ዘወትር በፊተኛይቱ ድንኳን ይገቡባታል፤

verses.text_english: But into the second the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and the errors of the people:
verses.text_amharic: በሁለተኛይቱ ግን ሊቀ ካህናት ብቻውን በዓመት አንድ ጊዜ ይገባባታል፥ እርሱም ሰለ ራሱና ስለ ሕዝቡ ስሕተት የሚያቀርበውን ደም ሳይዝ አይገባም፤

verses.text_english: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛይቱም ድንኳን በዚህ ገና ቆማ ሳለች፥ ወደ ቅድስት የሚወስደው መንገድ ገና እንዳልተገለጠ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ያሳያል።

verses.text_english: Which a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed until the time of reformation.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥

verses.text_english: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.text_amharic: የዘላለምን ቤዛነት አግኝቶ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ወደ ቅድስት በገዛ ደሙ ገባ እንጂ በፍየሎችና በጥጆች ደም አይደለም።

verses.text_english: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption .
verses.text_amharic: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም በረከሱትም ላይ የተረጨ የጊደር አመድ ሥጋን ለማንጻት የሚቀድሱ ከሆኑ፥

verses.text_english: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.text_amharic: ነውር የሌለው ሆኖ በዘላለም መንፈስ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረበ የክርስቶስ ደም እንዴት ይልቅ ሕያውን እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ ከሞተ ሥራ ሕሊናችሁን ያነጻ ይሆን?

verses.text_english: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም የፊተኛው ኪዳን ሲጸና ሕግን የተላለፉትን የሚቤዥ ሞት ስለ ሆነ፥ የተጠሩት የዘላለምን ርስት የተስፋ ቃል እንዲቀበሉ እርሱ የአዲስ ኪዳን መካከለኛ ነው።

verses.text_english: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.text_amharic: ኑዛዜ ያለ እንደሆነ የተናዛዡን ሞት ማርዳት የግድ ነውና፤

verses.text_english: For where a testament , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው ሲሞት ኑዛዜው ይጸናልና፥ ተናዛዡ በሕይወት ሲኖር ግን ከቶ አይጠቅምም።

verses.text_english: For a testament of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህም ፊተኛው ኪዳን እንኳ ያለ ደም አልተመረቀም።

verses.text_english: Whereupon neither the first was dedicated without blood.

For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ።

verses.text_english: Saying, This the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ሕጉም ከጥቂቶች በቀር ነገር ሁሉ በደም ይነጻል፥ ደምም ሳይፈስ ስርየት የለም።

verses.text_english: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያሉትን የሚመስለው ነገር በዚህ ሊነጻ እንጂ በሰማያት ያሉቱ ራሳቸው ከእርሱ ይልቅ በሚበልጥ መስዋዕት ሊነጹ የግድ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.text_amharic: ክርስቶስ በእጅ ወደ ተሰራች፥ የእውነተኛይቱ ምሳሌ ወደ ምትሆን ቅድስት አልገባምና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ እኛ አሁን ይታይ ዘንድ ወደ እርስዋ ወደ ሰማይ ገባ።

verses.text_english: therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናትም በየዓመቱ የሌላውን ደም ይዞ ወደ ቅድስት እንደሚገባ፥ ራሱን ብዙ ጊዜ ሊያቀርብ አልገባም፤

verses.text_english: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ ቢሆንስ፥ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ መከራ ሊቀበል ባስፈለገው ነበር፤ አሁን ግን በዓለም ፍጻሜ ራሱን በመሠዋት ኃጢአትን ሊሽር አንድ ጊዜ ተገልጦአል።

verses.text_english: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.text_amharic: ለሰዎችም አንድ ጊዜ መሞት ከእርሱ በኋላም ፍርድ እንደ ተመደበባቸው፥

verses.text_english: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ፥ የብዙዎችን ኃጢአት ሊሸከም አንድ ጊዜ ከተሰዋ በኋላ፥ ያድናቸው ዘንድ ለሚጠባበቁት ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ያለ ኃጢአት ይታይላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.text_amharic: ሕጉ ሊመጣ ያለው የበጎ ነገር እውነተኛ አምሳል ሳይሆን የነገር ጥላ አለውና፥ ስለዚህም በየዓመቱ ዘወትር በሚያቀርቡት በዚያ መሥዋዕት የሚቀርቡትን ሊፈጽም ከቶ አይችልም።

verses.text_english: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚህማ ባይሆን፥ የሚያመልኩት አንድ ጊዜ ነጽተው ከዚያ በኋላ በሕሊናቸው ኃጢአትን ስላላወቁ ማቅረብን በተዉ አልነበረምን?

verses.text_english: But in those a remembrance again of sins every year.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በዚያ መሥዋዕት በየዓመቱ የኃጢአት መታሰቢያ አለ፤

verses.text_english: For not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.text_amharic: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም ኃጢአትን እንዲያስወግድ የማይቻል ነውና።

verses.text_english: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ወደ ዓለም ሲገባ። መሥዋዕትንና መባን አልወደድህም ሥጋን ግን አዘጋጀህልኝ፤

verses.text_english: In burnt offerings and for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.text_amharic: በሙሉ በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ሰለ ኃጢአት በሚሰዋ መሥዋዕት ደስ አላለህም።

verses.text_english: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ። እነሆ፥ በመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ስለ እኔ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ መጥቼአለሁ አልሁ

verses.text_english: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure ; which are offered by the law;
verses.text_amharic: ይላል። በዚህ ላይ። መሥዋዕትንና መባን በሙሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንም ስለ ኃጢአትም የሚሰዋ መሥዋዕትን አልወደድህም በእርሱም ደስ አላለህም ብሎ፥ እነዚህም እንደ ሕግ የሚቀርቡት ናቸው፥

verses.text_english: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.text_amharic: ቀጥሎ። እነሆ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ መጥቼአለሁ ብሎአል። ሁለተኛውንም ሊያቆም የፊተኛውን ይሽራል።

verses.text_english: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once .
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ሥጋ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ በማቅረብ ተቀድሰናል።

verses.text_english: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናትም ሁሉ ዕለት ዕለት እያገለገለ ኃጢአትን ሊያስወግዱ ከቶ የማይችሉትን እነዚያን መሥዋዕቶች ብዙ ጊዜ እያቀረበ ቆሞአል፤

verses.text_english: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ግን ስለ ኃጢአት አንድን መሥዋዕት ለዘላለም አቅርቦ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ተቀመጠ፥

verses.text_english: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.text_amharic: ጠላቶቹም የእግሩ መረገጫ እስኪደረጉ ድረስ ወደ ፊት ይጠብቃል።

verses.text_english: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.text_amharic: አንድ ጊዜ በማቅረብ የሚቀደሱትን የዘላለም ፍጹማን አድርጎአቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
This the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.text_amharic: ብሎ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንና ዓመጻቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም ይላል።

verses.text_english: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.text_amharic: የእነዚህም ስርየት ባለበት ዘንድ፥ ከዚህ ወዲህ ስለ ኃጢአት ማቅረብ የለም።

verses.text_english: Now where remission of these no more offering for sin.
Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላይ የሆነ ታላቅ ካህን ስላለን፥

verses.text_english: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.text_amharic: ከክፉ ሕሊና ለመንጻት ልባችንን ተረጭተን ሰውነታችንንም በጥሩ ውኃ ታጥበን በተረዳንበት እምነት በቅን ልብ እንቅረብ፤

verses.text_english: And an high priest over the house of God;
verses.text_amharic: የተስፋን ቃል የሰጠው የታመነ ነውና እንዳይነቃነቅ የተስፋችንን ምስክርነት እንጠብቅ፤

verses.text_english: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.text_amharic: ለፍቅርና ለመልካምም ሥራ እንድንነቃቃ እርስ በርሳችን እንተያይ፤

verses.text_english: Let us hold fast the profession of faith without wavering; (for he faithful that promised;)
verses.text_amharic: በአንዳንዶችም ዘንድ ልማድ እንደ ሆነው፥ መሰብሰባችንን አንተው እርስ በርሳችን እንመካከር እንጂ፤ ይልቁንም ቀኑ ሲቀርብ እያያችሁ አብልጣችሁ ይህን አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.text_amharic: የእውነትን እውቀት ከተቀበልን በኋላ ወደን ኃጢአት ብናደርግ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አይቀርልንምና፥

verses.text_english: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some ; but exhorting : and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.text_amharic: የሚያስፈራ ግን የፍርድ መጠበቅ ተቃዋሚዎችንም ሊበላ ያለው የእሳት ብርታት አለ።

verses.text_english: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.text_amharic: የሙሴን ሕግ የናቀ ሰው ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ቢመሰክሩበት ያለ ርኅራኄ ይሞታል፤

verses.text_english: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ የረገጠ ያንንም የተቀደሰበትን የኪዳኑን ደም እንደ ርኵስ ነገር የቆጠረ የጸጋውንም መንፈስ ያክፋፋ፥ እንዴት ይልቅ የሚብስ ቅጣት የሚገባው ይመስላችኋል?

verses.text_english: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.text_amharic: በቀል የእኔ ነው፥ እኔ ብድራትን እመልሳለሁ ያለውን እናውቃለንና፤ ደግሞም። ጌታ በሕዝቡ ይፈርዳል።

verses.text_english: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.text_amharic: በሕያው እግዚአብሔር እጅ መውደቅ የሚያስፈራ ነው።

verses.text_english: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.text_amharic: የሚበልጥና ለዘወትር የሚኖር ገንዘብ በሰማይ ራሳችሁ እንዳላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ በእስራቴ ራራችሁልኝ የገንዘባችሁንም ንጥቂያ በደስታ ተቀበላችሁ።

verses.text_english: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ታላቅ ብድራት ያለውን ድፍረታችሁን አትጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ አድርጋችሁ የተሰጣችሁን የተስፋ ቃል እንድታገኙ መጽናት ያስፈልጋችኋልና።

verses.text_english: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance. yourselves}
verses.text_amharic: ገና በጣም ጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሊመጣ ያለውም ይመጣል አይዘገይምም፤

verses.text_english: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቅ ግን በእምነት ይኖራል ወደ ኋላም ቢያፈገፍግ፥ ነፍሴ በእርሱ ደስ አይላትም።

verses.text_english: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ግን ነፍሳቸውን ሊያድኑ ከሚያምኑቱ ነን እንጂ ወደ ጥፋት ከሚያፈገፍጉ አይደለንም።

verses.text_english: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.text_amharic: እምነትም ተስፋ ስለምናደርገው ነገር የሚያስረግጥ፥ የማናየውንም ነገር የሚያስረዳ ነው።

verses.text_english: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.text_amharic: ለሽማግሌዎች የተመሰከረላቸው በዚህ ነውና።

verses.text_english: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለሞች በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ተዘጋጁ፥ ስለዚህም የሚታየው ነገር ከሚታዩት እንዳልሆነ በእምነት እናስተውላለን።

verses.text_english: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.text_amharic: አቤል ከቃየል ይልቅ የሚበልጥን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር በእምነት አቀረበ፥ በዚህም፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ስጦታው ሲመሰክር፥ እርሱ ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ተመሰከረለት፤ ሞቶም ሳለ በመሥዋዕቱ እስከ አሁን ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
verses.text_amharic: ሄኖክ ሞትን እንዳያይ በእምነት ተወሰደ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ወሰደው አልተገኘም። ሳይወሰድ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እንዳሰኘ ተመስክሮለታልና፤

verses.text_english: But without faith impossible to please : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.text_amharic: ያለ እምነትም ደስ ማሰኘት አይቻልም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚደርስ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለ ለሚፈልጉትም ዋጋ እንዲሰጥ ያምን ዘንድ ያስፈልገዋልና።

verses.text_english: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.text_amharic: ኖኅ ገና ስለማይታየው ነገር ተረድቶ እግዚአብሔርን እየፈራ ቤተ ስዎቹን ለማዳን መርከብን በእምነት አዘጋጀ፥ በዚህም ዓለምን ኰነነ፥ በእምነትም የሚገኘውን ጽድቅ ወራሽ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.text_amharic: አብርሃም የተባለው ርስት አድርጎ ሊቀበለው ወዳለው ስፍራ ለመውጣት በእምነት ታዘዘ፥ ወዴትም እንደሚሄድ ሳያውቅ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.text_amharic: ለእንግዶች እንደሚሆን በተስፋ ቃል በተሰጠው አገር በድንኳን ኖሮ፥ ያን የተስፋ ቃል አብረውት ከሚወርሱ ከይስሐቅና ከያዕቆብ ጋር፥ እንደ መጻተኛ በእምነት ተቀመጠ፤

verses.text_english: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker God.
verses.text_amharic: መሠረት ያላትን፥ እግዚአብሔር የሠራትንና የፈጠራትን ከተማ ይጠብቅ ነበርና።

verses.text_english: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.text_amharic: ተስፋ የሰጠው የታመነ እንደ ሆነ ስለ ቈጠረች፥ ሣራ ራስዋ ደግሞ ዕድሜዋ እንኳ ካለፈ በኋላ ዘርን ለመፅነስ ኃይልን በእምነት አገኘች።

verses.text_english: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ደግሞ በብዛታቸው እንደ ሰማይ ኮከብ እንደማይቈጠርም በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ የነበሩት የሞተን ሰው እንኳ ከመሰለው ከአንዱ ተወለዱ።

verses.text_english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of , and embraced , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ሁሉ አምነው ሞቱ፥ የተሰጣቸውን የተስፋ ቃል አላገኙምና፤ ዳሩ ግን ከሩቅ ሆነው አዩትና ተሳለሙት፥ በምድሪቱም እንግዶችና መጻተኞች እንዲሆኑ ታመኑ።

verses.text_english: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.text_amharic: እንዲህ የሚሉት ለእነርሱ የሚሆነውን አገር እንዲፈልጉ ያመለክታሉና።

verses.text_english: And truly, if they had been mindful of that from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.text_amharic: ያን የወጡበትን አገር አስበው ቢሆኑ፥ ሊመለሱ ጊዜ በሆነላቸው ነበር፤

verses.text_english: But now they desire a better , that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን የሚበልጠውን እርሱም ሰማያዊ አገር ይናፍቃሉ። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው ተብሎ ሊጠራ በእነርሱ አያፍርም፥ ከተማን አዘጋጅቶላቸዋልና።

verses.text_english: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten ,
Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን እንኳ ሊያስነሣው እንዲቻለው አስቦአልና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ በምሳሌ አገኘው።

verses.text_english: Accounting that God able to raise up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.text_amharic: ይስሐቅ ሊመጣ ስላለው ነገር ያዕቆብንና ዔሳውን በእምነት ባረካቸው።

verses.text_english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.text_amharic: ያዕቆብ ሲሞት በእምነት የዮሴፍን ልጆች እያንዳንዳቸው ባረካቸው፥ በዘንጉም ጫፍ ተጠግቶ ሰገደ።

verses.text_english: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, upon the top of his staff.
verses.text_amharic: ዮሴፍ ወደ ሞት ቀርቦ ሳለ በእምነት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች መውጣት አስታወሰ፥ ስለ አጥንቱም አዘዛቸው።

verses.text_english: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ ከተወለደ በኋላ ወላጆቹ ያማረ ሕፃን መሆኑን አይተው በእምነት ሦስት ወር ሸሸጉት የንጉሥንም አዋጅ አልፈሩም።

verses.text_english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴ ካደገ በኋላ የፈርዖን የልጅ ልጅ እንዳይባል በእምነት እምቢ አለ፤

verses.text_english: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.text_amharic: የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።

verses.text_english: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.text_amharic: አጥፊው የበኵሮችን ልጆች እንዳይነካ ፋሲካንና ደምን መርጨትን በእምነት አደረገ።

verses.text_english: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.text_amharic: በደረቅ ምድር እንደሚያልፉ በኤርትራ ባሕር በእምነት ተሻገሩ፥ የግብፅ ሰዎች ግን ሲሞክሩ ተዋጡ።

verses.text_english: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.text_amharic: የኢያሪኮ ቅጥር ሰባት ቀን ከዞሩበት በኋላ በእምነት ወደቀ።

verses.text_english: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry : which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.text_amharic: ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ ሰላዮችን በሰላም ስለ ተቀበለቻቸው ከማይታዘዙ ጋር በእምነት አልጠፋችም።

verses.text_english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ምን እላለሁ? ስለ ጌዴዎንና ስለ ባርቅ ስለ ሶምሶንም ስለ ዮፍታሔም ስለ ዳዊትና ስለ ሳሙኤልም ስለ ነቢያትም እንዳልተርክ ጊዜ ያጥርብኛልና።

verses.text_english: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ በእምነት መንግሥታትን ድል ነሡ፥ ጽድቅን አደረጉ፥ የተሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል አገኙ፥

verses.text_english: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and Barak, and Samson, and Jephthae; David also, and Samuel, and the prophets:
verses.text_amharic: የአንበሶችን አፍ ዘጉ፥ የእሳትን ኃይል አጠፉ፥ ከሰይፍ ስለት አመለጡ፥ ከድካማቸው በረቱ፥ በጦርነት ኃይለኞች ሆኑ፥ የባዕድ ጭፍሮችን አባረሩ።

verses.text_english: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.text_amharic: ሴቶች ሙታናቸውን በትንሣኤ ተቀበሉ፤ ሌሎችም መዳንን ሳይቀበሉ የሚበልጠውን ትንሣኤ እንዲያገኙ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ተደበደቡ፤

verses.text_english: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.text_amharic: ሌሎችም መዘበቻ በመሆንና በመገረፍ ከዚህም በላይ በእስራትና በወኅኒ ተፈተኑ፤

verses.text_english: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.text_amharic: በድንጋይ ተወግረው ሞቱ፥ ተፈተኑ፥ በመጋዝ ተሰነጠቁ፥ በሰይፍ ተገድለው ሞቱ፥ ሁሉን እያጡ መከራን እየተቀበሉ እየተጨነቁ የበግና የፍየል ሌጦ ለብሰው ዞሩ፤

verses.text_english: And others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.text_amharic: ዓለም አልተገባቸውምና በምድረ በዳና በተራራ፥ በዋሻና በምድር ጕድጓድ ተቅበዘበዙ።

verses.text_english: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ እነዚህን የሚያህሉ ምስክሮች እንደ ደመና በዙሪያችን ካሉልን፥

verses.text_english: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verses.text_amharic: እኛ ደግሞ ሸክምን ሁሉ ቶሎም የሚከበንን ኃጢአት አስወግደን፥ የእምነታችንንም ራስና ፈጻሚውን ኢየሱስን ተመልክተን፥ በፊታችን ያለውን ሩጫ በትዕግሥት እንሩጥ፤ እርሱ ነውርን ንቆ በፊቱም ስላለው ደስታ በመስቀል ታግሦ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ቀኝ ተቀምጦአልና።

verses.text_english: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.text_amharic: በነፍሳችሁ ዝላችሁ እንዳትደክሙ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች በደረሰበት እንዲህ ባለ መቃወም የጸናውን አስቡ።

verses.text_english: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.text_amharic: ከኃጢአት ጋር እየተጋደላችሁ ገና ደምን እስከ ማፍሰስ ድረስ አልተቃወማችሁም፤

verses.text_english: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ልጆችም ከእናንተ ጋር። ልጄ ሆይ፥ የጌታን ቅጣት አታቅልል፥ በሚገሥጽህም ጊዜ አትድከም፤ ጌታ የሚወደውን ይቀጣዋልና፥ የሚቀበለውንም ልጅ ሁሉ ይገርፈዋል ብሎ የሚነጋገረውን ምክር ረስታችኋል።

verses.text_english: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.text_amharic: ለመቀጣት ታገሡ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ልጆች ያደርግላችኋልና፤ አባቱ የማይቀጣው ልጅ ማን ነው?

verses.text_english: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ሁሉ የቅጣት ተካፋይ ሆኖአልና ያለ ቅጣት ብትኖሩ ዲቃላዎች እንጂ ልጆች አይደላችሁም።

verses.text_english: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected , and we gave reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በላይ የቀጡን የሥጋችን አባቶች ነበሩን እናፍራቸውም ነበር፤ እንዴትስ ይልቅ ለመናፍስት አባት አብልጠን ልንገዛና በሕይወት ልንኖር በተገባን?

verses.text_english: For they verily for a few days chastened after their own pleasure; but he for profit, that might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱ መልካም ሆኖ እንደ ታያቸው ለጥቂት ቀን ይቀጡን ነበርና፥ እርሱ ግን ከቅድስናው እንድንካፈል ለጥቅማችን ይቀጣናል።

verses.text_english: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጣት ሁሉ ለጊዜው የሚያሳዝን እንጂ ደስ የሚያሰኝ አይመስልም፥ ዳሩ ግን በኋላ ለለመዱት የሰላምን ፍሬ እርሱም ጽድቅን ያፈራላቸዋል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የላሉትን እጆች የሰለሉትንም ጉልበቶች አቅኑ፤

verses.text_english: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.text_amharic: ያነከሰውም እንዲፈወስ እንጂ እንዳይናጋ፥ ለእግራችሁ ቅን መንገድ አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: Follow peace with all , and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.text_amharic: ከሰው ሁሉ ጋር ሰላምን ተከታተሉ ትቀደሱም ዘንድ ፈልጉ፥ ያለ እርሱ ጌታን ሊያይ የሚችል የለምና።

verses.text_english: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble , and thereby many be defiled;
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ለማንም እንዳይጎድለው፥ ብዙዎቹም የሚረክሱበት አንድ መራራ ሥር ወደ ላይ በቅሎ እንዳያስጨንቅ፥ ሴሰኛም የሚሆን እንዳይገኝ፥

verses.text_english: Lest there any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.text_amharic: ወይም ስለ አንድ መብል በኵርነቱን እንደ ሸጠ እንደ ዔሳው ለዚህ ዓለም የሚመች ሰው እንዳይሆን ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.text_english: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ በኋላ እንኳ በረከቱን ሊወርስ በወደደ ጊዜ እንደ ተጣለ ታውቃላችሁና፤ በእንባ ተግቶ ምንም ቢፈልገው ለንስሐ ስፍራ አላገኘምና።

verses.text_english: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.text_amharic: ሊዳሰስ ወደሚችል ወደሚቃጠልም እሳት ወደ ጭጋግም ወደ ጨለማም ወደ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ወደ መለከት ድምፅም ወደ ቃሎችም ነገር አልደረሳችሁምና፤

verses.text_english: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.text_amharic: ያንም ነገር የሰሙት ሌላ ቃል እንዳይጨመርባቸው ለመኑ፤

verses.text_english: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.text_amharic: እንስሳ እንኳ ተራራውን ቢነካ ተወግሮ ይሙት የምትለውን ትእዛዝ ሊታገሡ አልቻሉምና፤

verses.text_english: And so terrible was the sight, Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.text_amharic: ሙሴም። እጅግ እፈራለሁ እንቀጠቀጥማለሁ እስኪል ድረስ የሚታየው እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ነበር፤

verses.text_english: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ወደ ጽዮን ተራራና ወደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ከተማ ደርሳችኋል፥ ወደ ሰማያዊቱም ኢየሩሳሌም፥ በደስታም ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ወደ አእላፋት መላእክት፥

verses.text_english: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.text_amharic: በሰማያትም ወደ ተጻፉ ወደ በኵራት ማኅበር፥ የሁሉም ዳኛ ወደሚሆን ወደ እግዚአብሔር፥ ፍጹማንም ወደ ሆኑት ወደ ጻድቃን መንፈሶች፥

verses.text_english: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than Abel.
verses.text_amharic: የአዲስም ኪዳን መካከለኛ ወደሚሆን ወደ ኢየሱስ፥ ከአቤልም ደም ይልቅ የሚሻለውን ወደሚናገር ወደ መርጨት ደም ደርሳችኋል።

verses.text_english: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more we , if we turn away from him that from heaven:
verses.text_amharic: ለሚናገረው እምቢ እንዳትሉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ እነዚያ በምድር ላስረዳቸው እምቢ ባሉ ጊዜ ካላመለጡ፥ ከሰማይ ከመጣው ፈቀቅ የምንል እኛስ እንዴት እናመልጣለን?

verses.text_english: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ጊዜ ድምፁ ምድርን አናወጠ፥ አሁን ግን። አንድ ጊዜ ደግሜ እኔ ሰማይን አናውጣለሁ እንጂ ምድርን ብቻ አይደለም ብሎ ተስፋ ሰጥቶአል።

verses.text_english: And this , Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን። አንድ ጊዜ ደግሜ የሚል ቃል፥ የማይናወጡት ጸንተው እንዲኖሩ፥ የሚናወጡት የተፈጠሩ እንደሚሆኑ ይለወጡ ዘንድ ያሳያል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ የማይናወጥን መንግሥት ስለምንቀበል በማክበርና በፍርሃት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እያሰኘን የምናመልክበትን ጸጋ እንያዝ፤

verses.text_english: For our God a consuming fire.
verses.text_amharic: አምላካችን በእውነት የሚያጠፋ እሳት ነውና።

verses.text_english: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድማማች መዋደድ ይኑር።

verses.text_english: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.text_amharic: የ እንግዶችን መቀበል አትርሱ፤ በዚህ አንዳንዶች ሳያውቁ መላእክትን እንግድነት ተቀብለዋልና።

verses.text_english: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.text_amharic: ከእነርሱ ጋር እንደ ታሰረ ሆናችሁ እስሮችን አስቡ፥ የተጨነቁትንም ራሳችሁ ደግሞ በሥጋ እንዳለ ሆናችሁ አስቡ።

verses.text_english: Marriage honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
verses.text_amharic: መጋባት በሁሉ ዘንድ ክቡር መኝታውም ንጹሕ ይሁን፤ ሴሰኞችንና አመንዝሮችን ግን እግዚአብሔር ይፈርድባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: conversation without covetousness; content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.text_amharic: አካሄዳችሁ ገንዘብን ያለ መውደድ ይሁን፥ ያላችሁም ይብቃችሁ፤ እርሱ ራሱ። አልለቅህም ከቶም አልተውህም ብሎአልና፤

verses.text_english: So that we may boldly say, The Lord my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በድፍረት። ጌታ ይረዳኛልና አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል? እንላለን።

verses.text_english: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of conversation.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የተናገሩአችሁን ዋኖቻችሁን አስቡ፥ የኑሮአቸውንም ፍሬ እየተመለከታችሁ በእምነታቸው ምሰሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትናንትና ዛሬ እስከ ለዘላለምም ያው ነው።

verses.text_english: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.text_amharic: ልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት በሆነ በእንግዳ ትምህርት አትወሰዱ፤ ልባችሁ በጸጋ ቢጸና መልካም ነው እንጂ በመብል አይደለም፤ በዚህ የሚሠሩባት አልተጠቀሙምና።

verses.text_english: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.text_amharic: መሠዊያ አለን፥ ከእርሱም ሊበሉ ድንኳኒቱን የሚያገለግሉ መብት የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.text_amharic: ሊቀ ካህናት ስለ ኃጢአት ወደ ቅድስት የእንስሶችን ደም ያቀርባልና፤ ሥጋቸው ግን ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ በገዛ ደሙ ሕዝቡን እንዲቀድስ ከበር ውጭ መከራን ተቀበለ።

verses.text_english: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ነቀፌታውን እየተሸከምን ወደ እርሱ ወደ ሰፈሩ ውጭ እንውጣ፤

verses.text_english: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ የምትኖር ከተማ የለችንምና፥ ነገር ግን ትመጣ ዘንድ ያላትን እንፈልጋለን።

verses.text_english: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ዘወትር ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት፥ ማለት ለስሙ የሚመሰክሩ የከንፈሮችን ፍሬ፥ በእርሱ እናቅርብለት።

verses.text_english: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መልካም ማድረግን ለሌሎችም ማካፈልን አትርሱ፤ እንዲህ ያለው መሥዋዕት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋልና።

verses.text_english: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that unprofitable for you.
verses.text_amharic: ለዋኖቻችሁ ታዘዙና ተገዙ፤ እነርሱ ስሌትን እንደሚሰጡ አድርገው፥ ይህንኑ በደስታ እንጂ በኃዘን እንዳያደርጉት፥ ይህ የማይጠቅማችሁ ነበርና፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ ይተጋሉ።

verses.text_english: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.text_amharic: ጸልዩልን፤ በነገር ሁሉ በመልካም እንድንኖር ወደን፥ መልካም ሕሊና እንዳለን ተረድተናልና።

verses.text_english: But I beseech the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.text_amharic: ይልቁንም ፈጥኜ እንድመለስላችሁ ይህን ታደርጉ ዘንድ አጥብቄ እለምናችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.text_amharic: በዘላለም ኪዳን ደም ለበጎች ትልቅ እረኛ የሆነውን ጌታችንን ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያወጣው የሰላም አምላክ፥

verses.text_english: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል በፊቱ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን በእናንተ እያደረገ፥ ፈቃዱን ታደርጉ ዘንድ በመልካም ሥራ ሁሉ ፍጹማን ያድርጋችሁ፤ ለእርሱ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የምክርን ቃል እንድትታገሡ እመክራችኋለሁ፥ በጥቂት ቃል ጽፌላችኋለሁና።

verses.text_english: Know ye that brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድማችን ጢሞቴዎስ እንደ ተፈታ እወቁ፥ ቶሎ ብሎም ቢመጣ ከእርሱ ጋር አያችኋለሁ።

verses.text_english: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.text_amharic: ለዋኖቻችሁ ሁሉና ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከኢጣልያ የሆኑቱ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Grace with you all. Amen. « »
verses.text_amharic: ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.text_english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርና የጌታ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያ ያዕቆብ ለተበተኑ ለአሥራ ሁለቱ ወገኖች፤ ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.text_english: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
Knowing , that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ የእምነታችሁ መፈተን ትዕግሥትን እንዲያደርግላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ ልዩ ልዩ ፈተና ሲደርስባችሁ እንደ ሙሉ ደስታ ቍጠሩት

verses.text_english: But let patience have perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.text_amharic: ትዕግሥትም ምንም የሚጎድላችሁ ሳይኖር ፍጹማንና ምሉዓን ትሆኑ ዘንድ ሥራውን ይፈጽም።

verses.text_english: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ግን ማንም ጥበብ ቢጎድለው፥ ሳይነቅፍ በልግስና ለሁሉ የሚሰጠውን እግዚአብሔርን ይለምን፥ ለእርሱም ይሰጠዋል።

verses.text_english: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን በምንም ሳይጠራጠር በእምነት ይለምን፤ የሚጠራጠር ሰው በነፋስ የተገፋና የተነቃነቀ የባሕርን ማዕበል ይመስላልና።

verses.text_english: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
A double minded man unstable in all his ways.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለት አሳብ ላለው በመንገዱም ሁሉ ለሚወላውል ለዚያ ሰው ከጌታ ዘንድ አንዳች እንዲያገኝ አይምሰለው።

verses.text_english: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.text_amharic: ፀሐይ ከትኵሳት ጋር ይወጣልና፥ ሣርንም ያጠወልጋልና፥ አበባውም ይረግፋልና፥ የመልኩም ውበት ይጠፋልና፤ እንዲሁ ደግሞ ባለ ጠጋው በመንገዱ ይዝላል።

verses.text_english: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.text_amharic: በፈተና የሚጸና ሰው የተባረከ ነው፤ ከተፈተነ በኋላ ለሚወዱት ተስፋ ስለ እርሱ የሰጣቸውን የሕይወትን አክሊል ይቀበላልና።

verses.text_english: Blessed the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.text_amharic: ማንም ሲፈተን። በእግዚአብሔር እፈተናለሁ አይበል፤ እግዚአብሔር በክፉ አይፈተንምና፤ እርሱ ራሱስ ማንንም አይፈትንም።

verses.text_english: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ በራሱ ምኞት ሲሳብና ሲታለል ይፈተናል።

verses.text_english: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ምኞት ፀንሳ ኃጢአትን ትወልዳለች፤ ኃጢአትም ካደገች በኋላ ሞትን ትወልዳለች።

verses.text_english: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.text_amharic: የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ አትሳቱ።

verses.text_english: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.text_amharic: በጎ ስጦታ ሁሉ ፍጹምም በረከት ሁሉ ከላይ ናቸው፥ መለወጥም በእርሱ ዘንድ ከሌለ በመዞርም የተደረገ ጥላ በእርሱ ዘንድ ከሌለ ከብርሃናት አባት ይወርዳሉ።

verses.text_english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.text_amharic: ለፍጥረቱ የበኵራት ዓይነት እንድንሆን በእውነት ቃል አስቦ ወለደን።

verses.text_english: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ሰው ሁሉ ለመስማት የፈጠነ ለመናገርም የዘገየ ለቍጣም የዘገየ ይሁን፤

verses.text_english: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.text_amharic: የሰው ቍጣ የእግዚአብሔርን ጽድቅ አይሠራምና።

verses.text_english: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ ርኵሰትን ሁሉ የክፋትንም ትርፍ አስወግዳችሁ፥ ነፍሳችሁን ማዳን የሚችለውን በውስጣችሁም የተተከለውን ቃል በየዋህነት ተቀበሉ።

verses.text_english: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን የምታደርጉ ሁኑ እንጂ ራሳችሁን እያሳታችሁ የምትሰሙ ብቻ አትሁኑ።

verses.text_english: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.text_amharic: ቃሉን የሚሰማ የማያደርገውም ቢኖር የተፈጥሮ ፊቱን በመስተዋት የሚያይን ሰው ይመስላል፤

verses.text_english: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.text_amharic: ራሱን አይቶ ይሄዳልና፥ ወዲያውም እንደ ምን እንደ ሆነ ይረሳል።

verses.text_english: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ነጻ የሚያወጣውን ፍጹሙን ሕግ ተመልክቶ የሚጸናበት፥ ሥራንም የሚሠራ እንጂ ሰምቶ የሚረሳ ያልሆነው፥ በሥራው የተባረከ ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth , he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.text_amharic: አንደበቱን ሳይገታ ልቡን እያሳተ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያመልክ የሚመስለው ማንም ቢኖር የእርሱ አምልኮ ከንቱ ነው።

verses.text_english: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion vain.
verses.text_amharic: ንጹሕ የሆነ ነውርም የሌለበት አምልኮ በእግዚአብሔር አብ ዘንድ ይህ ነው፤ ወላጆች የሌላቸውን ልጆች ባልቴቶችንም በመከራቸው መጠየቅ፥ በዓለምም ከሚገኝ እድፍ ሰውነቱን መጠበቅ ነው።

verses.text_english: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ በክብር ጌታ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ያለውን እምነት ለሰው ፊት በማድላት አትያዙ።

verses.text_english: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
verses.text_amharic: የወርቅ ቀለበት ያደረገና የጌጥ ልብስ የለበሰ ሰው ወደ ጉባኤአችሁ ቢገባ፥ እድፍ ልብስም የለበሰ ድሀ ሰው ደግሞ ቢገባ፥

verses.text_english: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
verses.text_amharic: የጌጥ ልብስም የለበሰውን ተመልክታችሁ። አንተስ በዚህ በመልካም ስፍራ ተቀመጥ ብትሉት፥ ድሀውንም። አንተስ ወደዚያ ቁም ወይም ከእግሬ መረገጫ በታች ተቀመጥ ብትሉት፥ ራሳችሁን መለያየታችሁ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.text_amharic: ክፉ አሳብ ያላቸውም ዳኞች መሆናችሁ አይደለምን?

verses.text_english: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
verses.text_amharic: የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር በእምነት ባለ ጠጎች እንዲሆኑ ለሚወዱትም ተስፋ ስለ እርሱ የሰጣቸውን መንግሥት እንዲወርሱ የዚህን ዓለም ድሆች አልመረጠምን?

verses.text_english: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ግን ድሆችን አዋረዳችሁ። ባለ ጠጎቹ የሚያስጨንቁአችሁ አይደሉምን? ወደ ፍርድ ቤትም የሚጎትቱአችሁ እነርሱ አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
verses.text_amharic: የተጠራችሁበትን መልካሙን ስም የሚሰድቡ እነርሱ አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መጽሐፍ። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ እንደሚል የንጉሥን ሕግ ብትፈጽሙ መልካም ታደርጋላችሁ፤

verses.text_english: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰው ፊት ግን ብታደሉ ኃጢአትን ትሠራላችሁ፥ ሕግም እንደ ተላላፊዎች ይወቅሳችኋል።

verses.text_english: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one , he is guilty of all.
verses.text_amharic: ሕግን ሁሉ የሚጠብቅ፥ ነገር ግን በአንዱ የሚሰናከል ማንም ቢኖር በሁሉ በደለኛ ይሆናል፤ አታመንዝር ያለው ደግሞ። አትግደል ብሎአልና፤

verses.text_english: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.text_amharic: ባታመነዝርም፥ ነገር ግን ብትገድል፥ ሕግን ተላላፊ ሆነሃል።

verses.text_english: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.text_amharic: በነጻነት ሕግ ፍርድን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ እንዳላቸው ሰዎች እንዲህ ተናገሩ፥ እንዲህም አድርጉ።

verses.text_english: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
verses.text_amharic: ምሕረትን ለማያደርግ ምሕረት የሌለበት ፍርድ ይሆናልና፤ ምሕረትም በፍርድ ላይ ይመካል።

verses.text_english: What profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እምነት አለኝ የሚል፥ ሥራ ግን የሌለው ሰው ቢኖር ምን ይጠቅመዋል? እምነቱስ ሊያድነው ይችላልን?

verses.text_english: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.text_amharic: ወንድም ወይም እኅት ራቁታቸውን ቢሆኑ የዕለት ምግብንም ቢያጡ፥

verses.text_english: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what profit?
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ አንዱም። በደኅና ሂዱ፥ እሳት ሙቁ፥ ጥገቡም ቢላቸው ለሰውነት ግን የሚያስፈልጉትን ባትሰጡአቸው ምን ይጠቅማቸዋል?

verses.text_english: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚሁም ሥራ የሌለው እምነት ቢኖር በራሱ የሞተ ነው።

verses.text_english: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንድ ሰው። አንተ እምነት አለህ እኔም ሥራ አለኝ፤ እምነትህን ከሥራህ ለይተህ አሳየኝ፥ እኔም እምነቴን በሥራዬ አሳይሃለሁ ይላል።

verses.text_english: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አንድ እንደ ሆነ አንተ ታምናለህ፤ መልካም ታደርጋለህ፤ አጋንንት ደግሞ ያምናሉ ይንቀጠቀጡማል።

verses.text_english: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.text_amharic: አንተ ከንቱ ሰው፥ እምነት ከሥራ ተለይቶ የሞተ መሆኑን ልታውቅ ትወዳለህን?

verses.text_english: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.text_amharic: አባታችን አብርሃም ልጁን ይስሐቅን በመሠዊያው ባቀረበ ጊዜ በሥራ የጸደቀ አልነበረምን?

verses.text_english: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
verses.text_amharic: እምነት ከሥራው ጋር አብሮ ያደርግ እንደ ነበረ፥ በሥራም እምነት እንደ ተፈጸመ ትመለከታለህን?

verses.text_english: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፍም። አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ ጽድቅም ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት ያለው ተፈጸመ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ወዳጅ ተባለ።

verses.text_english: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.text_amharic: ሰው በእምነት ብቻ ሳይሆን በሥራ እንዲጸድቅ ታያላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent out another way?
verses.text_amharic: እንደዚሁም ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ ደግሞ መልእክተኞቹን ተቀብላ በሌላ መንገድ በሰደደቻቸው ጊዜ በሥራ አልጸደቀችምን?

verses.text_english: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.text_amharic: ከነፍስ የተለየ ሥጋ የሞተ እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ ደግሞ ከሥራ የተለየ እምነት የሞተ ነው።

verses.text_english: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ከእናንተ ብዙዎቹ አስተማሪዎች አይሁኑ፥ የባሰውን ፍርድ እንድንቀበል ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.text_english: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same a perfect man, able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.text_amharic: ሁላችን በብዙ ነገር እንሰናከላለንና፤ በቃል የማይሰናከል ማንም ቢኖር እርሱ ሥጋውን ሁሉ ደግሞ ሊገታ የሚችል ፍጹም ሰው ነው።

verses.text_english: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ ፈረሶች ይታዘዙልን ዘንድ ልጓም በአፋቸው ውስጥ እናገባለን፥ ሥጋቸውንም ሁሉ እንመራለን።

verses.text_english: Behold also the ships, which though so great, and driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ መርከቦች ደግሞ ይህን ያህል ታላቅ ቢሆኑ በዐውሎ ነፋስም ቢነዱ፥ የመሪ ፈቃድ ወደሚወደው ስፍራ እጅግ ታናሽ በሆነ መቅዘፊያ ይመራሉ።

verses.text_english: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
verses.text_amharic: እንዲሁም አንደበት ደግሞ ትንሽ ብልት ሆኖ በታላላቅ ነገር ይመካል። እነሆ፥ ትንሽ እሳት እንዴት ያለ ትልቅ ጫካ ያቃጥላል።

verses.text_english: And the tongue a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
verses.text_amharic: አንደበትም እሳት ነው። አንደበት በብልቶቻችን መካከል ዓመፀኛ ዓለም ሆኖአል፤ ሥጋን ሁሉ ያሳድፋልና፥ የፍጥረትንም ሩጫ ያቃጥላል፥ በገሃነምም ይቃጠላል።

verses.text_english: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
verses.text_amharic: የአራዊትና የወፎች የተንቀሳቃሾችና በባሕር ያለ የፍጥረት ወገን ሁሉ በሰው ይገራል፥ ደግሞ ተገርቶአል፤

verses.text_english: But the tongue can no man tame; an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን አንደበትን ሊገራ ማንም ሰው አይችልም፤ የሚገድል መርዝ የሞላበት ወላዋይ ክፋት ነው።

verses.text_english: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
verses.text_amharic: በእርሱ ጌታንና አብን እንባርካለን፤ በእርሱም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ የተፈጠሩትን ሰዎች እንረግማለን፤

verses.text_english: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.text_amharic: ከአንድ አፍ በረከትና መርገም ይወጣሉ። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ይህ እንዲህ ሊሆን አይገባም።

verses.text_english: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet and bitter?
verses.text_amharic: ምንጭስ ከአንድ አፍ የሚጣፍጥንና የሚመርን ውኃ ያመነጫልን?

verses.text_english: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ በለስ ወይራን ወይስ ወይን በለስን ልታፈራ ትችላለችን? ከጨው ውኃም ጣፋጭ ውኃ አይወጣም።

verses.text_english: Who a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ ጥበበኛና አስተዋይ ማን ነው? በመልካም አንዋዋሩ ስራውን በጥበብ የዋህነት ያሳይ።

verses.text_english: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን መራራ ቅንዓትና አድመኛነት በልባችሁ ቢኖርባችሁ፥ አትመኩ በእውነትም ላይ አትዋሹ።

verses.text_english: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.text_amharic: ይህ ጥበብ ከላይ የሚወርድ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን የምድር ነው፥ የሥጋም ነው፥ የአጋንንትም ነው፤

verses.text_english: For where envying and strife , there confusion and every evil work.
verses.text_amharic: ቅንዓትና አድመኛነት ባሉበት ስፍራ በዚያ ሁከትና ክፉ ስራ ሁሉ አሉና።

verses.text_english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.text_amharic: ላይኛይቱ ጥበብ ግን በመጀመሪያ ንጽሕት ናት፥ በኋላም ታራቂ፥ ገር፥ እሺ ባይ ምሕረትና በጎ ፍሬ የሞላባት፥ ጥርጥርና ግብዝነት የሌለባት ናት።

verses.text_english: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.text_amharic: የጽድቅም ፍሬ ሰላምን ለሚያደርጉት ሰዎች በሰላም ይዘራል።

verses.text_english: From whence wars and fightings among you? not hence, of your lusts that war in your members?
verses.text_amharic: በእናንተ ዘንድ ጦርና ጠብ ከወዴት ይመጣሉ? በብልቶቻችሁ ውስጥ ከሚዋጉ ከእነዚህ ከምቾቶቻችሁ አይደሉምን?

verses.text_english: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.text_amharic: ትመኛላችሁ ለእናንተም አይሆንም፤ ትገድላላችሁ በብርቱም ትፈልጋላችሁ፥ ልታገኙም አትችሉም፤ ትጣላላችሁ ትዋጉማላችሁ ነገር ግን አትለምኑምና ለእናንተ አይሆንም፤

verses.text_english: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume upon your lusts.
verses.text_amharic: ትለምናላችሁ፥ በምቾቶቻችሁም ትከፍሉ ዘንድ በክፉ ትለምናላችሁና አትቀበሉም።

verses.text_english: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
verses.text_amharic: አመንዝሮች ሆይ፥ ዓለምን መውደድ ለእግዚአብሔር ጥል እንዲሆን አታውቁምን? እንግዲህ የዓለም ወዳጅ ሊሆን የሚፈቅድ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ጠላት ሆኖአል።

verses.text_english: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
verses.text_amharic: ወይስ መጽሐፍ። በእኛ ዘንድ ያሳደረው መንፈስ በቅንዓት ይመኛል ያለው በከንቱ እንደ ተናገረ ይመስላችኋልን?

verses.text_english: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
verses.text_amharic: ነገር ግን ጸጋን አብልጦ ይሰጣል፤ ስለዚህ። እግዚአብሔር ትዕቢተኞችን ይቃወማል፥ ለትሑታን ግን ጸጋን ይሰጣል ይላል።

verses.text_english: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፤ ዲያብሎስን ግን ተቃወሙ ከእናንተም ይሸሻል፤

verses.text_english: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse hands, sinners; and purify hearts, double minded.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቅረቡ ወደ እናንተም ይቀርባል። እናንተ ኃጢአተኞች፥ እጆቻችሁን አንጹ፤ ሁለት አሳብም ያላችሁ እናንተ፥ ልባችሁን አጥሩ።

verses.text_english: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and joy to heaviness.
verses.text_amharic: ተጨነቁና እዘኑ አልቅሱም፤ ሳቃችሁ ወደ ኀዘን ደስታችሁም ወደ ትካዜ ይለወጥ።

verses.text_english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.text_amharic: በጌታ ፊት ራሳችሁን አዋርዱ ከፍ ከፍም ያደርጋችኋል።

verses.text_english: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁ አትተማሙ። ወንድሙን የሚያማ በወንድሙም የሚፈርድ ሕግን ያማል በሕግም ይፈርዳል፤ በሕግም ብትፈርድ ፈራጅ ነህ እንጂ ሕግን አድራጊ አይደለህም።

verses.text_english: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
verses.text_amharic: ሕግን የሚሰጥና የሚፈርድ አንድ ነው፤ እርሱም ሊያድን ሊያጠፋም የሚችል ነው፤ በሌላው ግን የምትፈርድ አንተ ማን ነህ?

verses.text_english: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም። ዛሬ ወይም ነገ ወደዚህ ከተማ እንሄዳለን በዚያም ዓመት እንኖራለን እንነግድማለን እናተርፍማለን የምትሉ እናንተ፥ ተመልከቱ፥ ነገ የሚሆነውን አታውቁምና።

verses.text_english: Whereas ye know not what on the morrow. For what your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.text_amharic: ሕይወታችሁ ምንድር ነው? ጥቂት ጊዜ ታይቶ ኋላ እንደሚጠፋ እንፍዋለት ናችሁና።

verses.text_english: For that ye to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ ፈንታ። ጌታ ቢፈቅድ ብንኖርም ይህን ወይም ያን እናደርጋለን ማለት ይገባችኋል።

verses.text_english: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.text_amharic: አሁን ግን በትዕቢታችሁ ትመካላችሁ፤ እንደዚህ ያለ ትምክህት ሁሉ ክፉ ነው።

verses.text_english: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth not, to him it is sin.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ በጎ ለማድረግ አውቆ ለማይሠራው ኃጢአት ነው።

verses.text_english: Go to now, rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon .
verses.text_amharic: አሁንም እናንተ ባለ ጠጎች፥ ስለሚደርስባችሁ ጭንቅ ዋይ ዋይ እያላችሁ አልቅሱ።

verses.text_english: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.text_amharic: ሀብታችሁ ተበላሽቶአል፥ ልብሳችሁም በብል ተበልቶአል።

verses.text_english: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.text_amharic: ወርቃችሁም ብራችሁም ዝጎአል፥ ዝገቱም ምስክር ይሆንባችኋል ሥጋችሁንም እንደ እሳት ይበላል። ለኋለኛው ቀን መዝገብን አከማችታችኋል።

verses.text_english: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እርሻችሁን ያጨዱት የሠራተኞች ደመወዝ በእናንተ ተቀምቶ ይጮኻል፥ የአጫጆችም ድምፅ ወደ ጌታ ፀባዖት ጆሮ ገብቶአል።

verses.text_english: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.text_amharic: በምድር ላይ ተቀማጥላችኋል በሴሰኝነትም ኖራችኋል፤ ለእርድ ቀን እንደሚያወፍር ልባችሁን አወፍራችኋል።

verses.text_english: Ye have condemned killed the just; he doth not resist you.
verses.text_amharic: ጻድቁን ኰንናችሁታል ገድላችሁትማል፤ እናንተን አይቃወምም።

verses.text_english: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.text_amharic: እንግዲህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ጌታ እስኪመጣ ድረስ ታገሡ። እነሆ፥ ገበሬው የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን ዝናብ እስኪቀበል ድረስ እርሱን እየታገሠ የከበረውን የመሬት ፍሬ ይጠብቃል።

verses.text_english: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.text_amharic: እናንተ ደግሞ ታገሡ፥ ልባችሁንም አጽኑ፤ የጌታ መምጣት ቀርቦአልና።

verses.text_english: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንዳይፈረድባችሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ አታጉረምርሙ፤ እነሆ፥ ፈራጅ በደጅ ፊት ቆሞአል።

verses.text_english: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የመከራና የትዕግሥት ምሳሌ የሆኑትን በጌታ ስም የተናገሩትን ነቢያትን ተመልከቱ።

verses.text_english: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በትዕግሥት የጸኑትን ብፁዓን እንላቸዋለን፤ ኢዮብ እንደ ታገሠ ሰምታችኋል፥ ጌታም እንደ ፈጸመለት አይታችኋል፤ ጌታ እጅግ የሚምር የሚራራም ነውና።

verses.text_english: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.text_amharic: ከሁሉም በፊት፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ቢሆን በምድርም ቢሆን በሌላ መሐላም ቢሆን በምንም አትማሉ፤ ነገር ግን ከፍርድ በታች እንዳትወድቁ ነገራችሁ አዎን ቢሆን አዎን ይሁን፥ አይደለምም ቢሆን አይደለም ይሁን።

verses.text_english: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ መከራን የሚቀበል ማንም ቢኖር እርሱ ይጸልይ፤ ደስ የሚለውም ማንም ቢኖር እርሱ ይዘምር።

verses.text_english: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.text_amharic: ከእናንተ የታመመ ማንም ቢኖር የቤተ ክርስቲያንን ሽምግሌዎች ወደ እርሱ ይጥራ፤ በጌታም ስም እርሱን ዘይት ቀብተው ይጸልዩለት።

verses.text_english: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.text_amharic: የእምነትም ጸሎት ድውዩን ያድናል ጌታም ያስነሣዋል፤ ኃጢአትንም ሠርቶ እንደ ሆነ ይሰረይለታል።

verses.text_english: Confess faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.text_amharic: እርስ በርሳችሁ በኃጢአታችሁ ተናዘዙ። ትፈወሱም ዘንድ እያንዳንዱ ስለ ሌላው ይጸልይ፤ የጻድቅ ሰው ጸሎት በሥራዋ እጅግ ኃይል ታደርጋለች።

verses.text_english: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.text_amharic: ኤልያስ እንደ እኛ የሆነ ሰው ነበረ፥ ዝናብም እንዳይዘንብ አጥብቆ ጸለየ፥ በምድርም ላይ ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር አልዘነበም፤ ሁለተኛም ጸለየ፥

verses.text_english: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማዩም ዝናብን ሰጠ ምድሪቱም ፍሬዋን አበቀለች።

verses.text_english: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.text_amharic: ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ከእናንተ ማንም ከእውነት ቢስት አንዱም ቢመልሰው፥

verses.text_english: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአተኛን ከተሳሳተበት መንገድ የሚመልሰው ነፍሱን ከሞት እንዲያድን፥ የኃጢአትንም ብዛት እንዲሸፍን ይወቅ።

verses.text_english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.text_amharic: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ ጴጥሮስ፥

verses.text_english: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አብ አስቀድሞ እንዳወቃቸው በመንፈስም እንደሚቀደሱ፥ ይታዘዙና በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ደም ይረጩ ዘንድ ለተመረጡት በጳንጦስና በገላትያ በቀጰዶቅያም በእስያም በቢታንያም ለተበተኑ መጻተኞች፤ ጸጋና ሰላም ይብዛላችሁ።

verses.text_english: Blessed the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.text_amharic: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከሙታን በመነሣቱ ለሕያው ተስፋና ለማይጠፋ፥ እድፈትም ለሌለበት፥ ለማያልፍም ርስት እንደ ምሕረቱ ብዛት ሁለተኛ የወለደን የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክና አባት ይባረክ፤ ይህም ርስት በመጨረሻው ዘመን ይገለጥ ዘንድ ለተዘጋጀ መዳን በእምነት በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ለተጠበቃችሁ ለእናንተ በሰማይ ቀርቶላችኋል።

verses.text_english: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verses.text_amharic: በዚህም እጅግ ደስ ይላችኋል፥ ነገር ግን በእሳት ምንም ቢፈተን ከሚጠፋው ወርቅ ይልቅ አብልጦ የሚከብር የተፈተነ እምነታችሁ፥ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሲገለጥ፥ ለምስጋናና ለክብር ለውዳሴም ይገኝ ዘንድ አሁን ለጥቂት ጊዜ ቢያስፈልግ በልዩ ልዩ ፈተና አዝናችኋል።
