verses.text_amharic: እነሆ በደጅ ቆሜ አንኳኳለሁ፤ ማንም ድምፄን ቢሰማ ደጁንም ቢከፍትልኝ፥ ወደ እርሱ እገባለሁ ከእርሱም ጋር እራት እበላለሁ እርሱም ከእኔ ጋር ይበላል።

verses.text_english: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ደግሞ ድል እንደ ነሣሁ ከአባቴም ጋር በዙፋኑ ላይ እንደተቀመጥሁ፥ ድል ለነሣው ከእኔ ጋር በዙፋኔ ላይ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.text_english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈስ ለአብያተ ክርስቲያናት የሚለውን ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.text_english: After this I looked, and, behold, a door opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያ በኋላም አየሁ፥ እነሆም በሰማይ የተከፈተ ደጅ፥ እንደ መለከትም ሆኖ ሲናገረኝ የሰማሁት ፊተኛው ድምፅ። ወደዚህ ውጣና ከዚህ በኋላ ሊሆን የሚያስፈልገውን ነገር አሳይሃለሁ አለ።

verses.text_english: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and sat on the throne.
verses.text_amharic: ወዲያው በመንፈስ ነበርሁ፤ እነሆም፥ ዙፋን በሰማይ ቆሞአል በዙፋኑም ላይ ተቀማጭ ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
verses.text_amharic: ተቀምጦም የነበረው በመልኩ የኢያስጲድንና የሰርዲኖን ዕንቍ ይመስል ነበር። በመልኩም መረግድን የመሰለ ቀስተ ደመና በዙፋኑ ዙሪያ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And round about the throne four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑ ዙሪያም ሀያ አራት ዙፋኖች ነበሩ፥ በዙፋኖቹም ላይ ነጭ ልብስ ለብሰው በራሳቸውም የወርቅ አክሊል ደፍተው ሀያ አራት ሽማግሌዎች ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.text_amharic: ከዙፋኑም መብረቅና ድምፅ ነጐድጓድም ይወጣል፤ በዙፋኑም ፊት ሰባት የእሳት መብራቶች ይበሩ ነበር፥ እነርሱም ሰባቱ የእግዚአብሔር መናፍስት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And before the throne a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑም ፊት ብርሌ የሚመስል የብርጭቆ ባሕር ነበረ። በዙፋኑም መካከል በዙፋኑም ዙሪያ፥ በፊትና በኋላ ዓይኖች የሞሉአቸው አራት እንስሶች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And the first beast like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast like a flying eagle.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛውም እንስሳ አንበሳን ይመስላል፥ ሁለተኛውም እንስሳ ጥጃን ይመስላል፥ ሦስተኛውም እንስሳ እንደ ሰው ፊት ነበረው፥ አራተኛውም እንስሳ የሚበረውን ንስር ይመስላል።

verses.text_english: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about ; and full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verses.text_amharic: አራቱም እንስሶች እያንዳንዳቸው ስድስት ክንፎች አሉአቸው፥ በዙሪያቸውና በውስጣቸውም ዓይኖች ሞልተውባቸዋል፤ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ቅዱስ፥ የነበረውና ያለ የሚመጣውም ሁሉንም የሚገዛ ጌታ አምላክ እያሉ ቀንና ሌሊት አያርፉም።

verses.text_english: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
verses.text_amharic: እንስሶቹም በዙፋን ላይ ለተቀመጠው ከዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም በሕይወት ለሚኖረው ለእርሱ ክብርና ውዳሴ ምስጋናም በሰጡት ጊዜ፥

verses.text_english: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑ ላይም በተቀመጠው በቀኝ እጁ ላይ በውስጥና በኋላ የተጻፈበት በሰባትም ማኅተም የተዘጋ መጽሐፍን አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.text_amharic: ብርቱም መልአክ። መጽሐፉን ይዘረጋ ዘንድ ማኅተሞቹንም ይፈታ ዘንድ የሚገባው ማን ነው? ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ሲያውጅ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይም ቢሆን በምድርም ላይ ቢሆን ከምድርም በታች ቢሆን መጽሐፉን ሊዘረጋ ወይም ሊመለከተው ማንም አልተቻለውም።

verses.text_english: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፉን ሊዘረጋ ወይም ሊመለከተው የሚገባው ማንም ስላልተገኘ እጅግ አለቀስሁ።

verses.text_english: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከሽማግሌዎቹም አንዱ። አታልቅስ፤ እነሆ፥ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የሆነው አንበሳ እርሱም የዳዊት ሥር መጽሐፉን ይዘረጋ ዘንድ ሰባቱንም ማኅተም ይፈታ ዘንድ ድል ነሥቶአል አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑና በአራቱ እንስሶች መካከልም በሽማግሌዎችም መካከል እንደ ታረደ በግ ቆሞ አየሁ፥ ሰባትም ቀንዶችና ሰባት ዓይኖች ነበሩት እነርሱም ወደ ምድር ሁሉ የተላኩ የእግዚአብሔር መናፍስት ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.text_amharic: መጥቶም በዙፋን ላይ ከተቀመጠ ከዚያ ከቀኝ እጁ መጽሐፉን ወሰደው።

verses.text_english: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.text_amharic: መጽሐፉንም በወሰደ ጊዜ አራቱ እንስሶችና ሀያ አራቱ ሽማግሌዎች በበጉ ፊት ወደቁ፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም በገናንና የቅዱሳን ጸሎት የሆነ ዕጣን የሞላበትን የወርቅ ዕቃ ያዙ።

verses.text_english: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁም፥ በዙፋኑም በእንስሶቹም በሽማግሌዎቹም ዙሪያ የብዙ መላእክትን ድምፅ ሰማሁ፤ ቍጥራቸውም አእላፋት ጊዜ አእላፋትና ሺህ ጊዜ ሺህ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅም ድምፅ። የታረደው በግ ኃይልና ባለ ጠግነት ጥበብም ብርታትም ክብርም ምስጋናም በረከትም ሊቀበል ይገባዋል አሉ።

verses.text_english: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይና በምድርም ከምድርም በታች በባሕርም ላይ ያለ ፍጥረት ሁሉ በእነርሱም ውስጥ ያለ ሁሉ። በረከትና ክብር ምስጋናም ኃይልም ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በዙፋኑ ላይ ለተቀመጠው፥ ለበጉም ይሁን ሲሉ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: አራቱም እንስሶች። አሜን አሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹም ወድቀው ሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
verses.text_amharic: በጉም ከሰባቱ ማኅተም አንዱን በፈታ ጊዜ አየሁ፥ ከአራቱም እንስሶች አንዱ ነጐድጓድ በሚመስል ድምፅ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ አምባላይ ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠው ቀስት ነበረው፥ አክሊልም ተሰጠው፥ ድልም እየነሣ ወጣ ድል ለመንሣት።

verses.text_english: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ ሁለተኛው እንስሳ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And there went out another horse red: and was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም ዳማ ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ ለተቀመጠው ሰላምን ከምድር ይወስድ ዘንድ ሰዎችም እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲተራረዱ ሥልጣን ተሰጠው፥ ታላቅም ሰይፍ ተሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ ሦስተኛው እንስሳ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ። አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ ጕራቻ ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠው በእጁ ሚዛን ያዘ።

verses.text_english: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
verses.text_amharic: በአራቱም እንስሶች መካከል ድምፅ። አንድ እርቦ ስንዴ በዲናር ሦስት እርቦ ገብስም በዲናር፥ ዘይትንና ወይንንም አትጕዳ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ የአራተኛው እንስሳ ድምፅ። መጥተህ እይ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ ሐመር ፈረስ ወጣ፥ በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠው ስሙ ሞት ነበረ። ሲኦልም ተከተለው፤ በሰይፍና በራብም በሞትም በምድርም አራዊት ይገድሉ ዘንድ ከምድር በአራተኛዋ እጅ ላይ ሥልጣን ተሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃልና ስለ ጠበቁት ምስክር የታረዱትን የሰዎች ነፍሳት ከመሠዊያ በታች አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ድምፅም እየጮኹ። ቅዱስና እውነተኛ ጌታ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ አትፈርድም ደማችንንስ በምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ እስከ መቼ አትበቀልም? አሉ።

verses.text_english: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they , should be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: ለእያንዳንዳቸውም ነጭ ልብስ ተሰጣቸው፥ እንደ እነርሱም ደግሞ ይገደሉ ዘንድ ያላቸው የባሪያዎች ባልንጀራዎቻቸውና የወንድሞቻቸው ቍጥር እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ገና ጥቂት ዘመን እንዲያርፉ ተባለላቸው።

verses.text_english: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ አየሁ፥ ታላቅም የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይም እንደ ማቅ ጠጕር ጥቁር ሆነ፥ ጨረቃም በሞላው እንደ ደም ሆነ፥

verses.text_english: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
verses.text_amharic: በለስም በብርቱ ነፋስ ተናውጣ ቃርያዋን ፍሬ እንደምትጥል የሰማይ ከዋክብት ወደ ምድር ወደቁ፥

verses.text_english: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይም እንደ መጽሐፍ ተጠቅልሎ አለፈ፥ ተራራዎችና ደሴቶችም ሁሉ ከስፍራቸው ተወሰዱ።

verses.text_english: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
verses.text_amharic: የምድርም ነገሥታትና መኳንንት ሻለቃዎችም ባለ ጠጋዎችም ኃይለኛዎችም ባሪያዎችም ጌቶችም ሁሉ በዋሾችና በተራራዎች ዓለቶች ተሰወሩ፥

verses.text_english: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
verses.text_amharic: ተራራዎችንና ዓለቶችንም። በላያችን ውደቁ በዙፋንም ከተቀመጠው ፊት ከበጉም ቍጣ ሰውሩን፤

verses.text_english: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
verses.text_amharic: ታላቁ የቁጣው ቀን መጥቶአልና፥ ማንስ ሊቆም ይችላል? አሉአቸው።

verses.text_english: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ በአራቱ በምድር ማዕዘን ቆመው አራት መላእክት አየሁ፥ እነርሱም ነፋስ በምድር ቢሆን ወይም በባሕር ወይም በማንም ዛፍ እንዳይነፍስ አራቱን የምድር ነፋሳት ያዙ።

verses.text_english: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
verses.text_amharic: የሕያው አምላክ ማኅተም ያለውም ሌላ መልአክ ከፀሐይ መውጫ ሲወጣ አየሁ፥ ምድርንና ባሕርንም ሊጐዱ ለተሰጣቸው ለአራቱ መላእክት በታላቅ ድምፅ እየጮኸ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
verses.text_amharic: የአምላካችንን ባሪያዎች ግምባራቸውን እስክናትማቸው ድረስ ምድርን ቢሆን ወይም ባሕርን ወይም ዛፎችን አትጕዱ አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: sealed an hundred forty four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.text_amharic: የታተሙትንም ቍጥር ሰማሁ፤ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ነገድ ሁሉ የታተሙት መቶ አርባ አራት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Juda sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ከይሁዳ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ታተሙ፥ ከሮቤል ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከጋድ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Aser sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ከአሴር ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከንፍታሌም ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Simeon sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ከምናሴ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከስምዖን ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከሌዊ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከይሳኮር ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥

verses.text_english: Of the tribe of Zabulon sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text_amharic: ከዛብሎን ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከዮሴፍ ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከብንያም ነገድ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ ታተሙ።

verses.text_english: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ አንድ እንኳ ሊቆጥራቸው የማይችል ከሕዝብና ከነገድ ከወገንም ከቋንቋም ሁሉ እጅግ ብዙ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ነጭ ልብስም ለብሰው የዘንባባንም ዝንጣፊዎች በእጆቻቸው ይዘው በዙፋኑና በበጉ ፊት ቆሙ፤

verses.text_english: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅም ድምፅ እየጮሁ። በዙፋኑ ላይ ለተቀመጠው ለአምላካችንና ለበጉ ማዳን ነው አሉ።

verses.text_english: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.text_amharic: መላእክቱም ሁሉ በዙፋኑና በሽማግሌዎቹ በአራቱም እንስሶቹ ዙሪያ ቆመው ነበር፤ በዙፋኑም ፊት በግምባራቸው ተደፉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም እየሰገዱ።

verses.text_english: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: አሜን፥ በረከትና ክብር ጥበብም ምስጋናም ውዳሴም ኃይልም ብርታትም ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ለአምላካችን ይሁን፤ አሜን አሉ።

verses.text_english: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
verses.text_amharic: ከሽማግሌዎቹም አንዱ ተመልሶ። እነዚህ ነጩን ልብስ የለበሱ እነማን ናቸው? ከወዴትስ መጡ? አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.text_amharic: እኔም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ታውቃለህ አልሁት። አለኝም። እነዚህ ከታላቁ መከራ የመጡ ናቸው፥ ልብሳቸውንም አጥበው በበጉ ደም አነጹ።

verses.text_english: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ፊት አሉ፥ ሌሊትና ቀንም በመቅደሱ ያመልኩታል፥ በዙፋኑም ላይ የተቀመጠው በእነርሱ ላይ ያድርባቸዋል።

verses.text_english: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይራቡም፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አይጠሙም፥ ፀሐይም ትኵሳትም ሁሉ ከቶ አይወርድባቸውም፤

verses.text_english: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑ መካከል ያለው በጉ እረኛቸው ይሆናልና፥ ወደ ሕይወትም ውኃ ምንጭ ይመራቸዋልና፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንባዎችን ሁሉ ከዓይናቸው ያብሳል።

verses.text_english: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛውንም ማኅተም በፈታ ጊዜ እኵል ሰዓት የሚያህል ዝምታ በሰማይ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.text_amharic: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት የሚቆሙትን ሰባቱን መላእክት አየሁ፥ ሰባትም መለከት ተሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም መልአክ መጣና የወርቅ ጥና ይዞ በመሰዊያው አጠገብ ቆመ፤ በዙፋኑም ፊት ባለው በወርቅ መሰዊያ ላይ ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ጸሎት እንዲጨምረው ብዙ ዕጣን ተሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
verses.text_amharic: የዕጣኑም ጢስ ከቅዱሳን ጸሎት ጋር ከመልአኩ እጅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም ጥናውን ይዞ የመሰዊያውን እሳት ሞላበት ወደ ምድርም ጣለው፤ ነጐድጓድና ድምፅም መብረቅም መናወጥም ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱንም መለከት የያዙ ሰባቱ መላእክት ሊነፉ ተዘጋጁ።

verses.text_english: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ ደምም የተቀላቀለበት በረዶና እሳት ሆነ፥ ወደ ምድርም ተጣለ፤ የምድርም ሲሶው ተቃጠለ የዛፎችም ሲሶው ተቃጠለ የለመለመም ሣር ሁሉ ተቃጠለ።

verses.text_english: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ በእሳት የሚቃጠል ታላቅ ተራራን የሚመስል ነገር በባሕር ተጣለ፤ የባሕርም ሲሶው ደም ሆነ

verses.text_english: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
verses.text_amharic: በባሕርም ከሚኖሩ ሕይወት ካላቸው ፍጥረቶች ሲሶው ሞተ የመርከቦችም ሲሶው ጠፋ።

verses.text_english: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ እንደ ችቦም የሚቃጠል ታላቅ ኮከብ ከሰማይ ወደቀ፥ በወንዞችና በውኃም ምንጮች ሲሶ ላይ ወደቀ። የኮከቡም ስም እሬቶ ይባላል።

verses.text_english: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
verses.text_amharic: የውኃውም ሲሶ መራራ ሆነ መራራም ስለተደረገ በውኃው ጠንቅ ብዙ ሰዎች ሞቱ።

verses.text_english: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ የፀሐይ ሲሶና የጨረቃ ሲሶ የከዋክብትም ሲሶ ተመታ፥ የእነዚህ ሲሶ ይጨልም ዘንድ፥ የቀንም ሲሶው እንዳያበራ፥ እንዲሁም የሌሊት።

verses.text_english: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
verses.text_amharic: አየሁም፥ አንድም ንስር በሰማይ መካከል እየበረረ በታላቅ ድምፅ። ሊነፉ ያላቸው የሦስቱ መላእክት መለከት ስለሚቀረው ድምፅ በምድር ላይ ለሚኖሩት ወዮላቸው፥ ወዮላቸው፥ ወዮላቸው ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ ከሰማይም ወደ ምድር ወድቆ የነበረ ኮከብ አየሁ፥ የጥልቁም ጕድጓድ መክፈቻ ተሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
verses.text_amharic: የጥልቁንም ጕድጓድ ከፈተው፤ ጢስም ከታላቅ እቶን እንደሚወጣ ጢስ ሆኖ ከጕድጓዱ ወጣ ፀሐይና አየርም በጕድጓዱ ጢስ ጨለሙ።

verses.text_english: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.text_amharic: ከጢሱም አንበጣዎች ወደ ምድር ወጡ፥ የምድርም ጊንጦች ሥልጣን እንዳላቸው ሥልጣን ተሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርም ማኅተም በግምባራቸው ከሌለባቸው ሰዎች በቀር በምድር ያለውን ሣር ቢሆንም ወይም ማናቸውንም የለመለመ ነገር ወይም ማናቸውንም ዛፍ እንዳይጐዱ ተባለላቸው።

verses.text_english: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
verses.text_amharic: አምስትም ወር ሊሣቅዩአቸው ተሰጣቸው እንጂ ሊገድሉአቸው አይደለም፤ እነርሱም የሚሣቅዩት ሥቃይ ጊንጥ ሰውን ነድፎ እንደሚሣቅይ ነው።

verses.text_english: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ወራት ሰዎች ሞትን ይፈልጋሉ አያገኙትምም፥ ሊሞቱም ይመኛሉ ሞትም ከእነርሱ ይሸሻል።

verses.text_english: And the shapes of the locusts like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads as it were crowns like gold, and their faces as the faces of men.
verses.text_amharic: የአንበጣዎቹም መልክ ለጦርነት እንደ ተዘጋጁ ፈረሶች ነው፥ በራሳቸውም ላይ ወርቅ እንደሚመስሉ አክሊሎች ነበሩአቸው፥ ፊታቸውም እንደ ሰው ፊት ነበረ፤

verses.text_english: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as of lions.
verses.text_amharic: የሴቶችን ጠጕር የሚመስል ጠጕር ነበራቸው፥ ጥርሳቸውም እንደ አንበሳ ጥርስ ነበረ፥

verses.text_english: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
verses.text_amharic: የብረት ጥሩር የሚመስልም ጥሩር ነበራቸው፥ የክንፋቸውም ድምፅ ወደ ጦርነት እንደሚጋልቡ እንደ ብዙ ፈረሶች ሰረገላዎች ድምፅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power to hurt men five months.
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ጊንጥም ጅራት ያለ ጅራት አላቸው በጅራታቸውም መውጊያ አለ፥ ሰዎችንም አምስት ወር እንዲጐዱ ሥልጣን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And they had a king over them, the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath name Apollyon.
verses.text_amharic: በእነርሱም ላይ ንጉሥ አላቸው እርሱም የጥልቅ መልአክ ነው፥ ስሙም በዕብራይስጥ አብዶን በግሪክም አጶልዮን ይባላል።

verses.text_english: One woe is past; , behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛው ወዮ አልፎአል፤ እነሆ፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ገና ሁለት ወዮ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛውም መልአክ ነፋ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ካለ በወርቅ ከተሠራ መሠዊያ ቀንዶች አንድ ድምፅ ሰማሁ፥

verses.text_english: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
verses.text_amharic: መለከትም ያለውን ስድስተኛውን መልአክ። በታላቁ ወንዝ በኤፍራጥስ የታሰሩትን አራቱን መላእክት ፍታቸው አለው።

verses.text_english: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
verses.text_amharic: የሰዎችንም ሲሶ እንዲገድሉ ለሰዓቱና ለቀኑ ለወሩም ለዓመቱም ተዘጋጅተው የነበሩ አራቱ መላእክት ተፈቱ።

verses.text_english: And the number of the army of the horsemen two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
verses.text_amharic: የፈረሰኞችም ጭፍራ ቁጥር እልፍ ጊዜ እልፍ፥ እልፍ ጊዜ እልፍ ነበረ፤ ቁጥራቸውን ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.text_amharic: ፈረሶቹንና በእነርሱም ላይ የተቀመጡትን እንዲሁ በራእይ አየሁ፤ እሳትና ያክንት ዲንም የሚመስል ጥሩር ነበራቸው፤ የፈረሶቹም ራስ እንደ አንበሳ ራስ ነበረ፥ ከአፋቸውም እሳትና ጢስ ዲንም ወጣ።

verses.text_english: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
verses.text_amharic: ከአፋቸውም በወጡት በእሳቱና በጢሱ በዲኑም በእነዚህ ሦስት መቅሰፍቶች የሰዎቹ ሲሶ ተገደለ።

verses.text_english: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
verses.text_amharic: የፈረሶቹ ሥልጣን በአፋቸውና በጅራታቸው ነውና፤ ጅራታቸው እባብን ይመስላልና፥ ራስም አላቸው በእርሱም ይጐዳሉ።

verses.text_english: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
verses.text_amharic: በእነዚህም መቅሠፍቶች ያልተገደሉት የቀሩቱ ሰዎች ለአጋንንትና ያዩ ወይም ይሰሙ ወይም ይሄዱ ዘንድ ለማይችሉ ከወርቅና ከብር ከናስም ከድንጋይም ከእንጨትም ለተሠሩ ለጣዖቶች እንዳይሰግዱ ስለ እጃቸው ሥራ ንስሐ አልገቡም፤

verses.text_english: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
verses.text_amharic: ስለ መግደላቸውም ቢሆን ወይም ስለ አስማታቸው ወይም ስለ ዝሙታቸው ወይም ስለ ስርቆታቸው ንስሐ አልገቡም።

verses.text_english: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow upon his head, and his face as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም ብርቱ መልአክ ደመና ተጐናጽፎ ከሰማይ ሲወርድ አየሁ፤ በራሱም ላይ ቀስተ ደመና ነበረ፥ ፊቱም እንደ ፀሐይ እግሮቹም እንደ እሳት ዓምዶች ነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and left on the earth,
verses.text_amharic: የተከፈተችንም ታናሽ መጽሐፍ በእጁ ያዘ። ቀኝ እግሩንም በባሕር ላይ ግራውንም በምድር ላይ አኖረ፥ እንደሚያገሣም አንበሳ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And cried with a loud voice, as a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
verses.text_amharic: በጮኸም ጊዜ ሰባቱ ነጐድጓድ በየድምፃቸው ተናገሩ።

verses.text_english: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱ ነጐድጓድ በተናገሩ ጊዜ ልጽፍ አሰብሁ፤ ከሰማይም። ሰባቱ ነጐድጓድ የተናገሩትን ነገር በማኅተም ዝጋው አትጻፈውም የሚል ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
verses.text_amharic: በባሕርና በምድርም ላይ ሲቆም ያየሁት መልአክ ቀኝ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ ዘረጋ፥

verses.text_english: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይንና በእርሱም ያሉትን፥ ምድርንና በእርስዋም ያሉትን፥ ባሕርንና በእርሱም ያሉትን በፈጠረው፥ ከዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ሕያው ሆኖ በሚኖረው ምሎ።

verses.text_english: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ፊት አይዘገይም፥ ዳሩ ግን ሰባተኛው መልአክ ሊነፋ ባለው ጊዜ ድምፁም በሚሰማበት ዘመን፥ ለባሪያዎቹ ለነቢያት የምስራች እንደ ሰበከላቸው የእግዚአብሔር ምሥጢር ይፈጸማል አለ።

verses.text_english: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይም የሰማሁት ድምፅ እንደ ገና ሲናገረኝና። ሂድና በባሕርና በምድር ላይ ከሚቆመው መልአክ በእጁ ያለችውን የተከፈተችውን መጽሐፍ ውሰድ ሲል ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take , and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ መልአኩም ሄጄ። ታናሺቱን መጽሐፍ ስጠኝ አልሁት። እርሱም። ውሰድና ብላት፥ ሆድህንም መራራ ታደርገዋለች በአፍህ ግን እንደ ማር ትጣፍጣለች አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
verses.text_amharic: ከመልአኩም እጅ ታናሺቱን መጽሐፍ ወስጄ በላኋት በአፌም እንደ ማር ጣፋጭ ሆነች፤ ከበላኋት በኋላም ሆዴ መራራ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
verses.text_amharic: በብዙ ወገኖችና በአሕዛብም በቋንቋዎችም በነገሥታትም ላይ እንደ ገና ትንቢት ትናገር ዘንድ ይገባሃል ተባለልኝ።

verses.text_english: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
verses.text_amharic: በትር የሚመስል መለኪያ ለእኔ ተሰጠኝ፥ እንዲህም ተባለልኝ። ተነሥተህ የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስና መሠዊያውን በዚያም የሚሰግዱትን ለካ።

verses.text_english: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty two months.
verses.text_amharic: በመቅደሱም ውጭ ያለው እድሞ ለአሕዛብ ተሰጥቶአልና ተወው አትለካውም፤ እነርሱም አርባ ሁለት ወር የተቀደሰችውን ከተማ ይረግጡአታል።

verses.text_english: And I will give unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
verses.text_amharic: ለሁለቱም ምስክሮቼ ማቅ ለብሰው ሺህ ከሁለት መቶ ስድሳ ቀን ትንቢት ሊናገሩ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በምድር ጌታ ፊት የሚቆሙ ሁለቱ ወይራዎችና ሁለቱ መቅረዞች ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
verses.text_amharic: ማንምም ሊጐዳቸው ቢወድ እሳት ከአፋቸው ይወጣል ጠላቶቻቸውንም ይበላል፤ ማንም ሊጐዳቸው ቢወድም እንዲሁ ሊገደል ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ ትንቢት በሚናገሩበት ወራት ዝናብ እንዳይዘንብ ሰማይን ሊዘጉ ሥልጣን አላቸው፥ ውኃዎችንም ወደ ደም ሊለውጡ በሚፈልጉበትም ጊዜ ሁሉ በመቅሠፍት ሁሉ ምድርን ሊመቱ ሥልጣን አላቸው።

verses.text_english: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
verses.text_amharic: ምስክራቸውን ከፈጸሙ በኋላ ከጥልቁ የሚወጣው አውሬ ይዋጋቸዋል ያሸንፋቸውማል ይገድላቸውማል።

verses.text_english: And their dead bodies in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
verses.text_amharic: በድናቸውም በታላቂቱ ከተማ አደባባይ ይተኛል እርስዋም በመንፈሳዊ ምሳሌ ሰዶምና ግብጽ የተባለች ደግሞ ጌታቸው የተሰቀለባት ናት።

verses.text_english: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
verses.text_amharic: ከወገኖችና ከነገዶችም ከቋንቋዎችም ከአሕዛብም የሆኑ ሰዎች ሦስት ቀን ተኵል በድናቸውን ይመለከታሉ፥ በድናቸውም ወደ መቃብር ሊገባ አይፈቅዱም።

verses.text_english: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህም ሁለት ነቢያት በምድር የሚኖሩትን ስለ ሣቀዩ በምድር የሚኖሩት በእነርሱ ላይ ደስ ይላቸዋል በደስታም ይኖራሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም ስጦታ ይሰጣጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
verses.text_amharic: ከሦስቱ ቀን ተኵልም በኋላ ከእግዚአብሔር የወጣ የሕይወት መንፈስ ገባባቸው በእግሮቻቸውም ቆሙ፥ ታላቅም ፍርሃት በሚመለከቱት ላይ ወደቀባቸው።

verses.text_english: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይም። ወደዚህ ውጡ የሚላቸውን ታላቅ ድምፅ ሰሙ፤ ጠላቶቻቸውም እየተመለከቱአቸው ወደ ሰማይ በደመና ወጡ።

verses.text_english: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሰዓት ታላቅ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፥ ከከተማይቱም አሥረኛው እጅ ወደቀ፥ በመናወጥም ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ተገደሉ፥ የቀሩትንም ፍርሃት ያዛቸው፥ ለሰማዩም አምላክ ክብር ሰጡ።

verses.text_english: The second woe is past; , behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛው ወዮ አልፎአል፤ እነሆ፥ ሦስተኛው ወዮ በቶሎ ይመጣል።

verses.text_english: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛው መልአክ ነፋ፤ በሰማይም። የዓለም መንግሥት ለጌታችንና ለእርሱ ለክርስቶስ ሆነች፥ ለዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም ይነግሣል

verses.text_english: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.text_amharic: የሚሉ ታላላቅ ድምፆች ሆኑ። በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት በዙፋኖቻቸው የተቀመጡ ሀያ አራቱ ሽማግሌዎች በግምባራቸው ተደፍተው

verses.text_english: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
verses.text_amharic: ለእግዚአብሔር እየሰገዱ እንዲህ አሉ። ያለህና የነበርህ ሁሉን የምትገዛ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ትልቁን ኃይልህን ስለ ያዝህ ስለ ነገሥህም እናመሰግንሃለን፤

verses.text_english: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም ተቈጡ፥ ቍጣህም መጣ፥ በሙታንም ትፈርድ ዘንድ ዘመን መጣ፥ ለባሪያዎችህም ለነቢያትና ለቅዱሳን ስምህንም ለሚፈሩት ለታናናሾችና ለታላላቆችም ዋጋቸውን ትሰጥ ዘንድ፥ ምድርንም የሚያጠፉትን ታጠፋ ዘንድ ዘመን መጣ።

verses.text_english: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይም ያለው የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ተከፈተ፥ የኪዳኑም ታቦት በመቅደሱ ታየ፥ መብረቅና ድምፅም ነጐድጓድም የምድርም መናወጥ ታላቅም በረዶ ሆነ።

verses.text_english: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅ ምልክትም በሰማይ ታየ ፀሐይን ተጐናጽፋ ጨረቃ ከእግሮችዋ በታች ያላት በራስዋም ላይ የአሥራ ሁለት ከዋክብት አክሊል የሆነላት አንዲት ሴት ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋም ፀንሳ ነበር፥ ምጥም ተይዛ ልትወልድ ተጭንቃ ጮኸች።

verses.text_english: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም ምልክት በሰማይ ታየ፤ እነሆም ታላቅ ቀይ ዘንዶ፤ ሰባት ራሶችና አሥር ቀንዶችም ነበሩት በራሶቹም ላይ ሰባት ዘውዶች ነበሩ፥

verses.text_english: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
verses.text_amharic: ጅራቱም የሰማይን ከዋክብት ሲሶ እየሳበ ወደ ምድር ጣላቸው። ዘንዶውም ሴቲቱ በወለደች ጊዜ ሕፃንዋን እንዲበላ ልትወልድ ባላት ሴት ፊት ቆመ።

verses.text_english: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and his throne.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብንም ሁሉ በብረት በትር ይገዛቸው ዘንድ ያለውን ልጅ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች፤ ልጅዋም ወደ እግዚአብሔርና ወደ ዙፋኑ ተነጠቀ።

verses.text_english: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred threescore days.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም ሺህ ከሁለት መቶ ስድሳ ቀን በዚያ እንዲመግቡአት በእግዚአብሔር ተዘጋጅቶላት ወደ ነበረው ስፍራ ወደ በረሀ ሸሸች።

verses.text_english: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይም ሰልፍ ሆነ፤ ሚካኤልና መላእክቱ ዘንዶውን ተዋጉ። ዘንዶውም ከመላእክቱ ጋር ተዋጋ፥ አልቻላቸውምም፥

verses.text_english: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚያም ወዲያ በሰማይ ስፍራ አልተገኘላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
verses.text_amharic: ዓለሙንም ሁሉ የሚያስተው፥ ዲያብሎስና ሰይጣን የሚባለው ታላቁ ዘንዶ እርሱም የቀደመው እባብ ተጣለ፤ ወደ ምድር ተጣለ መላእክቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ተጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅም ድምፅ በሰማይ ሰማሁ እንዲህ ሲል። አሁን የአምላካችን ማዳንና ኃይል መንግሥትም የክርስቶስም ሥልጣን ሆነ፥ ቀንና ሌሊትም በአምላካችን ፊት የሚከሳቸው የወንድሞቻችን ከሳሽ ተጥሎአልና።

verses.text_english: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
verses.text_amharic: እነርሱም ከበጉ ደም የተነሣ ከምስክራቸውም ቃል የተነሣ ድል ነሡት፥ ነፍሳቸውንም እስከ ሞት ድረስ አልወደዱም።

verses.text_english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ፥ ሰማይና በውስጡ የምታድሩ ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ለምድርና ለባሕር ወዮላቸው፥ ዲያብሎስ ጥቂት ዘመን እንዳለው አውቆ በታላቅ ቍጣ ወደ እናንተ ወርዶአልና።

verses.text_english: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man .
verses.text_amharic: ዘንዶውም ወደ ምድር እንደ ተጣለ ባየ ጊዜ ወንድ ልጅ የወለደችውን ሴት አሳደዳት።

verses.text_english: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
verses.text_amharic: ከእባቡም ፊት ርቃ አንድ ዘመን፥ ዘመናትም፥ የዘመንም እኵሌታ ወደ ምትመገብበት ወደ ስፍራዋ ወደ በረሀ እንድትበር ለሴቲቱ ሁለት የታላቁ ንሥር ክንፎች ተሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
verses.text_amharic: እባቡም ሴቲቱ በወንዝ እንድትወሰድ ሊያደርግ ወንዝ የሚያህልን ውኃ ከአፉ በስተ ኋላዋ አፈሰሰ።

verses.text_english: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
verses.text_amharic: ምድሪቱም ሴቲቱን ረዳቻት፥ ምድሪቱም አፍዋን ከፍታ ዘንዶው ከአፉ ያፈሰሰውን ወንዝ ዋጠችው።

verses.text_english: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.text_amharic: ዘንዶውም በሴቲቱ ላይ ተቈጥቶ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዛት የሚጠብቁትን የኢየሱስም ምስክር ያላቸውን ከዘርዋ የቀሩትን ሊዋጋ ሄደ፤

verses.text_english: And saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
verses.text_amharic: አንድም አውሬ ከባሕር ሲወጣ አየሁ፤ አሥር ቀንዶችና ሰባት ራሶች ነበሩት፥ በቀንዶቹም ላይ አሥር ዘውዶች በራሶቹም ላይ የስድብ ስም ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
verses.text_amharic: ያየሁትም አውሬ ነብር ይመስል ነበር፥ እግሮቹም እንደ ድብ እግሮች፥ አፉም እንደ አንበሳ አፍ ነበሩ። ዘንዶውም ኃይሉንና ዙፋኑን ትልቅም ሥልጣን ሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
verses.text_amharic: ከራሶቹም ለሞት እንደ ታረደ ሆኖ አንዱን አየሁ፥ ለሞቱ የሆነውም ቍስል ተፈወሰ። ምድርም ሁሉ አውሬውን እየተከተለ ተደነቀ፥

verses.text_english: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
verses.text_amharic: ለዘንዶውም ሰገዱለት፥ ለአውሬው ሥልጣንን ሰጥቶታልና፤ ለአውሬውም። አውሬውን ማን ይመስለዋል፥ እርሱንስ ሊዋጋ ማን ይችላል? እያሉ ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty two months.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅንም ነገርና ስድብን የሚናገርበት አፍ ተሰጠው፥ በአርባ ሁለት ወርም እንዲሠራ ሥልጣን ተሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔርንም ለመሳደብ ስሙንና ማደሪያውንም በሰማይም የሚያድሩትን ሊሳደብ አፉን ከፈተ።

verses.text_english: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
verses.text_amharic: ቅዱሳንንም ይዋጋ ዘንድ ድልም ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ ተሰጠው፥ በነገድና በወገንም በቋንቋም በሕዝብም ሁሉ ላይ ሥልጣን ተሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
verses.text_amharic: ከዓለምም ፍጥረት ጀምሮ በታረደው በግ ሕይወት መጽሐፍ ስሞቻቸው ያልተጻፉ በምድር የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ይሰግዱለታል።

verses.text_english: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
verses.text_amharic: ጆሮ ያለው ቢኖር ይስማ።

verses.text_english: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
verses.text_amharic: ይማረክ ዘንድ ያለው ማንም ቢኖር ወደ ምርኮነት ይሄዳል፤ በሰይፍ የሚገድል ማንም ቢኖር ራሱ በሰይፍ እንዲገደል ይገባዋል። የቅዱሳን ትዕግሥትና እምነት በዚህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም አውሬ ከምድር ሲወጣ አየሁ፥ የበግ ቀንዶችን የሚመስሉ ሁለት ቀንዶችም ነበሩት እንደ ዘንዶም ይናገር ነበር።

verses.text_english: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
verses.text_amharic: በፊተኛውም አውሬ ሥልጣን በእርሱ ፊት ሁሉን ያደርጋል። ለሞቱ የሆነውም ቍስል ተፈወሰለት ለፊተኛው አውሬ ምድርና በእርሱ የሚኖሩት እንዲሰግዱለት ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
verses.text_amharic: እሳትንም እንኳ ከሰማይ ወደ ምድር በሰው ፊት እስኪያወርድ ድረስ ታላላቆችን ምልክቶች ያደርጋል።

verses.text_english: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
verses.text_amharic: በአውሬውም ፊት ያደርግ ዘንድ ከተሰጡት ምልክቶች የተነሣ በምድር የሚኖሩትን ያስታል፤ የሰይፍም ቍስል ለነበረውና በሕይወት ለኖረው ለአውሬው ምስልን እንዲያደርጉ በምድር የሚኖሩትን ይናገራል።

verses.text_english: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
verses.text_amharic: የአውሬው ምስል ሊናገር እንኳ ለአውሬውም ምስል የማይሰግዱለትን ሁሉ ሊያስገድላቸው፥ ለአውሬው ምስል ትንፋሽ እንዲሰጠው ተሰጠው።

verses.text_english: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
verses.text_amharic: ታናናሾችና ታላላቆችም ባለ ጠጋዎችና ድሆችም ጌታዎችና ባሪያዎችም ሁሉ በቀኝ እጃቸው ወይም በግምባራቸው ምልክትን እንዲቀበሉ፥

verses.text_english: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
verses.text_amharic: የአውሬውም ስም ወይም የስሙ ቍጥር ያለው ምልክት የሌለበት ማንም ሊገዛ ወይም ሊሸጥ እንዳይችል ያደርጋል። ጥበብ በዚህ አለ።

verses.text_english: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number Six hundred threescore six.
verses.text_amharic: አእምሮ ያለው የአውሬውን ቍጥር ይቍጠረው፤ ቍጥሩ የሰው ቍጥር ነውና፥ ቍጥሩም ስድስት መቶ ስድሳ ስድስት ነው።

verses.text_english: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁም፥ እነሆም፥ በጉ በጽዮን ተራራ ቆሞ ነበር፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ስሙና የአባቱ ስም በግምባራቸው የተጻፈላቸው መቶ አርባ አራት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
verses.text_amharic: እንደ ብዙ ውኃም ድምፅና እንደ ታላቅ ነጐድጓድ ድምፅ ያለ ከሰማይ ድምፅን ሰማሁ፥ ደርዳሪዎችም በገና እንደሚደረድሩ ያለ ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred forty four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋኑም ፊት በአራቱም እንስሶችና በሽማግሌዎቹ ፊት አዲስ ቅኔ ዘመሩ፤ ከምድርም ከተዋጁት ከመቶ አርባ አራት ሺህ በቀር ያን ቅኔ ሊማር ለማንም አልተቻለውም።

verses.text_english: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
verses.text_amharic: ከሴቶች ጋር ያልረከሱ እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ድንግሎች ናቸውና። በጉ ወደሚሄድበት የሚከተሉት እነዚህ ናቸው። ለእግዚአብሔርና ለበጉ በኵራት እንዲሆኑ ከሰዎች የተዋጁ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
verses.text_amharic: በአፋቸውም ውሸት አልተገኘም፤ ነውር የለባቸውም።

verses.text_english: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
verses.text_amharic: በምድርም ለሚኖሩ ለሕዝብም ለነገድም ለቋንቋም ለወገንም ሁሉ ይሰብክ ዘንድ የዘላለም ወንጌል ያለው ሌላ መልአክ ከሰማይ መካከል ሲበር አየሁ፤

verses.text_english: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
verses.text_amharic: በታላቅ ድምፅም። የፍርዱ ሰዓት ደርሶአልና እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩ ክብርንም ስጡት፤ ሰማይንና ምድርንም ባሕርንም የውኃንም ምንጮች ለሠራው ስገዱለት አለ።

verses.text_english: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም ሁለተኛ መልአክ። አሕዛብን ሁሉ የዝሙትዋን ቍጣ ወይን ጠጅ ያጠጣች ታላቂቱ ባቢሎን ወደቀች፥ ወደቀች እያለ ተከተለው።

verses.text_english: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛም መልአክ ተከተላቸው፥ በታላቅ ድምፅ እንዲህ እያለ። ለአውሬውና ለምስሉ የሚሰግድ በግምባሩም ወይም በእጁ ምልክቱን የሚቀበል ማንም ቢኖር፥

verses.text_english: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
verses.text_amharic: እርሱ ደግሞ በቍጣው ጽዋ ሳይቀላቅል ከተዘጋጀው ከእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ወይን ጠጅ ይጠጣል፥ በቅዱሳንም መላእክትና በበጉ ፊት በእሳትና በዲን ይሳቀያል።

verses.text_english: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
verses.text_amharic: የሥቃያቸውም ጢስ ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ይወጣል፥ ለአውሬውና ለምስሉም የሚሰግዱ የስሙንም ምልክት የሚቀበል ሁሉ ቀንና ሌሊት ዕረፍት የላቸውም።

verses.text_english: Here is the patience of the saints: here they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዛት የሚጠብቁት ኢየሱስንም በማመን የሚጸኑት ቅዱሳን ትዕግሥታቸው በዚህ ነው።

verses.text_english: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይም። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በጌታ የሚሞቱ ሙታን ብፁዓን ናቸው። መንፈስ። አዎን፥ ከድካማቸው ያርፉ ዘንድ፥ ሥራቸውም ይከተላቸዋል ይላል ብለህ ጻፍ የሚል ድምፅ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
verses.text_amharic: አየሁም፥ እነሆም ነጭ ደመና፥ በደመናውም ላይ የሰውን ልጅ የሚመስል ተቀምጦአል፥ በራሱም ላይ የወርቅ አክሊል በእጁም ስለታም ማጭድ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ መልአክም ከመቅደሱ ወጥቶ በደመናው ላይ ለተቀመጠው። የማጨድ ሰዓት ስለ ደረሰ ማጭድህን ስደድና እጨድ፥ የምድሪቱ መከር ጠውልጓልና ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
verses.text_amharic: በደመናውም ላይ የተቀመጠው ማጭዱን ወደ ምድር ጣለው ምድርም ታጨደች።

verses.text_english: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላ መልአክም በሰማይ ካለው መቅደስ ወጣ፥ እርሱም ደግሞ ስለታም ማጭድ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
verses.text_amharic: በእሳትም ላይ ሥልጣን ያለው ሌላ መልአክ ከመሠዊያው ወጥቶ ስለታም ማጭድ ያለውን። ዘለላዎቹ ፈጽመው በስለዋልና ስለታሙን ማጭድህን ስደድና በምድር ያለውን የወይን ዛፍ ዘለላዎች ቍረጥ ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጠራ።

verses.text_english: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም ማጭዱን ወደ ምድር ጣለው፥ በምድርም ካለው ከወይን ዛፍ ቈርጦ ወደ ታላቁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቍጣ መጥመቂያ ጣለ።

verses.text_english: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand six hundred furlongs.
verses.text_amharic: የወይኑም መጥመቂያ ከከተማ ውጭ ተረገጠ፥ እስከ ፈረሶች ልጓምም የሚደርስ ደም ርቀቱ ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ምዕራፍ ሆኖ ከመጥመቂያው ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
verses.text_amharic: ሌላም ታላቅና ድንቅ ምልክት በሰማይ አየሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእነርሱ ስለሚፈጸም ኋለኛዎቹን ሰባት መቅሠፍቶች የያዙ ሰባት መላእክት ታዩ።

verses.text_english: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
verses.text_amharic: በእሳትም የተቀላቀለውን የብርጭቆ ባሕር የሚመስለውን አየሁ፥ በአውሬውና በምስሉም በስሙም ቍጥር ላይ ድል ነሥተው የነበሩት የእግዚአብሔርን በገና ይዘው በብርጭቆ ባሕር ላይ ሲቆሙ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true thy ways, thou King of saints.
Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for only holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉን የምትገዛ ጌታ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ሥራህ ታላቅና ድንቅ ነው፤ የአሕዛብ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ መንገድህ ጻድቅና እውነተኛ ነው፤ ጌታ ሆይ፥ የማይፈራህና ስምህን የማያከብር ማን ነው? አንተ ብቻ ቅዱስ ነህና፥ የጽድቅም ሥራህ ስለ ተገለጠ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይመጣሉ በፊትህም ይሰግዳሉ እያሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ባሪያ የሙሴን ቅኔና የበጉን ቅኔ ይዘምራሉ።

verses.text_english: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህም በኋላ አየሁ፥ የምስክርም ድንኳን መቅደስ በሰማይ ተከፈተ፥

verses.text_english: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱንም መቅሠፍት የያዙ ሰባቱ መላእክት ከመቅደሱ ወጡ፤ ከተልባ እግርም የተሠራ ጥሩ የጌጥ ልብስ ለበሱ ደረታቸውንም በወርቅ መታጠቂያ ታጠቁ።

verses.text_english: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከአራቱም እንስሶች አንዱ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ የሚኖር የእግዚአሔር ቍጣ የሞላባቸውን ሰባት የወርቅ ጽዋዎች ለሰባቱ መላእክት ሰጣቸው።

verses.text_english: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: ከእግዚአብሔርም ክብርና ከኃይሉ ጢስ በመቅደሱ ሞላበት፥ የሰባቱ መላእክት ሰባቱ መቅሰፍት እስኪፈጸሙ ድረስ አንድ እንኳ ወደ መቅደሱ ይገባ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.text_english: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ለሰባቱም መላእክት። ሄዳችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ቁጣ ጽዋዎች በምድር ውስጥ አፍስሱ የሚል ታላቅ ድምፅ ከመቅደሱ ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and them which worshipped his image.
verses.text_amharic: ፊተኛውም ሄዶ ጽዋውን በምድር ውስጥ አፈሰሰ፤ የአውሬውም ምልክት ባለባቸው ለምስሉም በሚሰግዱ ሰዎች ክፉኛ የሚነዘንዝ ቍስል ሆነባቸው።

verses.text_english: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead : and every living soul died in the sea.
verses.text_amharic: ሁለተኛውም ጽዋውን በባሕር ውስጥ አፈሰሰ፤ እንደ ሞተም ሰው ደም ሆነ፥ በባሕርም ከሚኖሩት ሕይወት ያለበት ነፍስ ሁሉ ሞተ።

verses.text_english: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
verses.text_amharic: ሦስተኛውም ጽዋውን በወንዞችና በውኃ ምንጮች ውስጥ አፈሰሰ፤ እነርሱም ደም ሆኑ።

verses.text_english: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
verses.text_amharic: የውኃውም መልአክ። ያለህና የነበርህ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ቅዱስ ሆይ፥ እንዲህ ስለፈረድህ ጻድቅ ነህ፤

verses.text_english: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
verses.text_amharic: የቅዱሳንና የነቢያትን ደም ስላፈሰሱ ደምን ደግሞ አጠጥተሃቸዋል፥ የሚገባቸው ነውና ብሎ ሲናገር ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous thy judgments.
verses.text_amharic: ከመሰዊያውም። አዎን፥ ሁሉን የምትገዛ ጌታ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ፍርዶችህ እውነትና ጽድቅ ናቸው ብሎ ሲናገር ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
verses.text_amharic: አራተኛውም ጽዋውን በፀሐይ ላይ አፈሰሰ፤ ሰዎችንም በእሳት ልታቃጥል ተሰጣት።

verses.text_english: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
verses.text_amharic: ሰዎችም በታላቅ ትኵሳት ተቃጠሉ፥ በነዚህም መቅሠፍቶች ላይ ሥልጣን ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ተሳደቡ፥ ክብርንም እንዲሰጡት ንስሐ አልገቡም።

verses.text_english: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛውም ጽዋውን በአውሬው ዙፋን ላይ አፈሰሰ፤ መንግሥቱም ጨለማ ሆነች ከስቃይም የተነሳ መላሶቻቸውን ያኝኩ ነበር፥

verses.text_english: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
verses.text_amharic: ከስቃያቸውና ከቍስላቸውም የተነሳ የሰማይን አምላክ ተሳደቡ፥ ከስራቸውም ንስሐ አልገቡም።

verses.text_english: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
verses.text_amharic: ስድስተኛውም ጽዋውን በታላቁ ወንዝ በኤፍራጥስ ላይ አፈሰሰ፤ ከፀሐይም መውጫ ለሚመጡ ነገሥታት መንገድ እንዲሰናዳላቸው ውኃው ደረቀ።

verses.text_english: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.text_amharic: ከዘንዶውም አፍና ከአውሬው አፍ ከሐሰተኛውም ነቢይ አፍ ጓጕንቸሮች የሚመስሉ ሦስት ርኵሳን መናፍስት ሲወጡ አየሁ፤

verses.text_english: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
verses.text_amharic: ምልክት እያደረጉ የአጋንንት መናፍስት ናቸውና፥ በታላቁም ሁሉን በሚገዛ በእግዚአብሔር ቀን ወደ ሚሆነው ጦር እንዲያስከትቱአቸው ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ነገሥታት ይወጣሉ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ እንደ ሌባ ሆኜ እመጣለሁ፤ ራቁቱን እንዳይሄድ እፍረቱንም እንዳያዩ ነቅቶ ልብሱን የሚጠብቅ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.text_english: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
verses.text_amharic: በዕብራይስጥም አርማጌዶን ወደሚባል ስፍራ እስከተቱአቸው።

verses.text_english: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባተኛውም ጽዋውን በአየር ውስጥ አፈሰሰ፤ ከመቅደሱም ውስጥ። ተፈጽሞአል የሚል ታላቅ ድምጽ ከዙፋኑ ወጣ።

verses.text_english: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, so great.
verses.text_amharic: መብረቅና ድምጽም ነጎድጓድም ሆኑ፥ ትልቅም የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፤ ሰው በምድር ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ እንዲህ ያለ ታላቅ መናውጥ ከቶ አልነበረም፤ ከሁሉ በለጠ።

verses.text_english: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቂቱም ከተማ በሦስት ተከፋፈለች፥ የአሕዛብም ከተማዎች ወደቁ። ታላቂቱም ባቢሎን የብርቱ ቍጣው ወይን ጠጅ የሞላበትን ጽዋ እንዲሰጣት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ታሰበች።

verses.text_english: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
verses.text_amharic: ደሴቶችም ሁሉ ሸሹ ተራራዎችም አልተገኙም።

verses.text_english: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
verses.text_amharic: በሚዛንም አንድ ታላንት*ፍ1* የሚያህል ታላቅ በረዶ በሰዎች ላይ ከሰማይ ወረደባቸው፤ ሰዎቹም ከበረዶው መቅሰፍት የተነሳ እግዚአብሔርን ተሳደቡ፥ መቅሰፍቱ እጅግ ታላቅ ነውና።  ፍ1 አንድ ታላንት ሦስት ፈረሱላ የሚያህል ነው።

verses.text_english: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱንም ጽዋዎች ከያዙ ከሰባቱ መላእክት አንዱ መጥቶ። ና በብዙም ውኃዎች ላይ የተቀመጠችውን የታላቂቱን ጋለሞታ ፍርድ አሳይሃለሁ፤

verses.text_english: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
verses.text_amharic: የምድርም ነገሥታት ከእርስዋ ጋር ሴሰኑ በምድርም የሚኖሩ ከዝሙትዋ ወይን ጠጅ ሰከሩ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
verses.text_amharic: በመንፈስም ወደ በረሀ ወሰደኝ፤ የስድብም ስሞች በሞሉበት፥ ሰባት ራሶችና አሥር ቀንዶችም ባሉበት በቀይ አውሬ ላይ አንዲት ሴት ተቀምጣ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም በቀይና በሐምራዊ ልብስ ተጐናጽፋ በወርቅና በከበሩ ድንጋዮች በዕንቈችም ተሸልማ ነበር፥ በእጅዋም የሚያስጸይፍ ነገር የዝሙትዋም ርኵሰት የሞላባትን የወርቅ ጽዋ ያዘች፤

verses.text_english: And upon her forehead a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
verses.text_amharic: በግምባርዋም ምስጢር የሆነ ስም። ታላቂቱ ባቢሎን፥ የጋለሞታዎችና የምድር ርኵሰት እናት ተብሎ ተጻፈ።

verses.text_english: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
verses.text_amharic: ሴቲቱም በቅዱሳን ደምና በኢየሱስ ምስክሮች ደም ሰክራ አየኋት። ባየኋትም ጊዜ እጅግ ታላቅ ድንቅ አደነቅሁ።

verses.text_english: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
verses.text_amharic: መልአኩም አለኝ። የምትደነቅ ስለ ምንድር ነው? የሴቲቱን ምስጢርና የሚሸከማትን፥ ሰባት ራሶችና አስር ቀንዶች ያሉትን የአውሬውን ምስጢር እኔ እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.text_english: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
verses.text_amharic: ያየኸው አውሬ አስቀድሞ ነበረ፥ አሁንም የለም፥ ከጥልቁም ይወጣ ዘንድ አለው፥ ወደ ጥፋትም ይሄዳል፤ ስሞቻቸውም ከዓለም ፍጥረት ጀምሮ በሕይወት መጽሐፍ ያልተጻፉ በምድር የሚኖሩ አውሬው አስቀድሞ እንደነበረ አሁንም እንደሌለ፥ ነገር ግን እንዳለ ሲያዩ ያደንቃሉ።

verses.text_english: And here the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.
verses.text_amharic: ጥበብ ያለው አእምሮ በዚህ ነው። ሰባቱ ራሶች ሴቲቱ የተቀመጠችባቸው ሰባት ተራራዎች ናቸው፥

verses.text_english: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባት ነገሥታት ደግሞ ናቸው፤ አምስቱ ወድቀዋል አንዱም አለ፥ የቀረውም ገና አልመጣም፤ ሲመጣም፥ ጥቂት ጊዜ ሊቆይ ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
verses.text_amharic: የነበረውና የሌለውም አውሬ ራሱ ደግሞ ስምንተኛው ነው ከሰባቱም አንዱ ነው፥ ወደ ጥፋትም ይሄዳል።

verses.text_english: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
verses.text_amharic: ያየሃቸውም አስሩ ቀንዶች ገና መንግሥትን ያልተቀበሉ አስር ነገሥታት ናቸው፥ ዳሩ ግን ከአውሬው ጋር ለአንድ ሰዓት እንደ ነገሥታት ሥልጣንን ይቀበላሉ።

verses.text_english: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ አንድ አሳብ አላቸው፥ ኃይላቸውንና ሥልጣናቸውንም ለአውሬው ይሰጣሉ።

verses.text_english: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him called, and chosen, and faithful.
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህ በጉን ይወጋሉ፤ በጉም የጌቶች ጌታና የነገሥታት ንጉሥ ስለ ሆነ እነርሱን ድል ይነሣል፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉ የተጠሩና የተመረጡ የታመኑም ደግሞ ድል ይነሣሉ።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
verses.text_amharic: አለኝም። ጋለሞታይቱ የተቀመጠችባቸው ያየሃቸው ውኃዎች፥ ወገኖችና ብዙ ሰዎች አሕዛብም ቋንቋዎችም ናቸው።

verses.text_english: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
verses.text_amharic: ያየኃቸውም አስር ቀንዶችና አውሬው ጋለሞታይቱን ይጣላሉ፤ ባዶዋንና ራቁትዋንም ያደርጓታል፥ ሥጋዋንም ይበላሉ፥ በእሳትም ያቃጥሉአታል።

verses.text_english: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
verses.text_amharic: እግዚአብሔር አሳቡን እንዲያደርጉ አንድንም አሳብ እንዲያደርጉ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል እስኪፈጸም ድረስ መንግሥታቸውን ለአውሬው እንዲሰጡ በልባቸው አግብቶአልና።

verses.text_english: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
verses.text_amharic: ያየሃትም ሴት በምድር ነገሥታት ላይ የምትነግሥ ታላቂቱ ከተማ ናት።

verses.text_english: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ ታላቅ ስልጣን ያለው ሌላ መልአክ ከሰማይ ሲወርድ አየሁ፥ ከክብሩም የተነሣ ምድር በራች።

verses.text_english: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
verses.text_amharic: በብርቱም ድምፅ። ታላቂቱ ባቢሎን ወደቀች፥ ወደቀች፥ የአጋንንትም ማደሪያ ሆነች፥ የርኵሳንም መናፍስት ሁሉ መጠጊያ የርኵሳንና የተጠሉም ወፎች ሁሉ መጠጊያ ሆነች፤

verses.text_english: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብ ሁሉ ከዝሙትዋ ቍጣ ወይን ጠጅ የተነሳ ወድቀዋልና፥ የምድርም ነገሥታት ከእርስዋ ጋር ሴሰኑ የምድርም ነጋዴዎች ከቅምጥልነትዋ ኃይል የተነሳ ባለ ጠጋዎች ሆኑ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.text_english: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
verses.text_amharic: ከሰማይም ሌላ ድምፅ ሰማሁ እንዲህ ሲል። ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ በኃጢአትዋ እንዳትተባበሩ ከመቅሠፍትዋም እንዳትቀበሉ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ውጡ፤

verses.text_english: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
verses.text_amharic: ኃጢአትዋ እስከ ሰማይ ድረስ ደርሶአልና፥ እግዚአብሔርም ዓመፃዋን አሰበ።

verses.text_english: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
verses.text_amharic: እርስዋ እንደ ሰጠች መጠን ብድራት መልሱላት፥ እንደ ሥራዋም ሁለት እጥፍ ደርቡባት፤ በቀላቀለችው ጽዋ ሁለት እጥፍ አድርጋችሁ ቀላቅሉባት፤

verses.text_english: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
verses.text_amharic: ራስዋን እንደ አከበረችና እንደ ተቀማጠለች ልክ ሥቃይና ኀዘን ስጡአት። በልብዋ። ንግሥት ሆኜ እቀመጣለሁ ባልቴትም አልሆንም ኀዘንም ከቶ አላይም ስላለች፥

verses.text_english: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong the Lord God who judgeth her.
verses.text_amharic: ስለዚህ በአንድ ቀን ሞትና ኀዘን ራብም የሆኑ መቅሰፍቶችዋ ይመጣሉ፥ በእሳትም ትቃጠላለች፤ የሚፈርድባት እግዚአብሔር ብርቱ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
verses.text_amharic: ከእርስዋም ጋር የሴሰኑና የተቀማጠሉ የምድር ነገሥታት የመቃጠልዋን ጢስ ሲያዩ ስለ እርስዋ ዋይ ዋይ እያሉ ያለቅሳሉ፤

verses.text_english: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
verses.text_amharic: ሥቃይዋንም ከመፍራት የተነሣ በሩቅ ቆመው። አንቺ ታላቂቱ ከተማ፥ ብርቱይቱ ከተማ ባቢሎን፥ ወዮልሽ፥ ወዮልሽ፥ በአንድ ሰዓት ፍርድሽ ደርሶአልና እያሉ ይናገራሉ።

verses.text_english: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
verses.text_amharic: የመርከባቸውንም ጭነት ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሚገዛ የለምና የምድር ነጋዴዎች ያለቅሱላታል ያዝኑላትማል፤

verses.text_english: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
verses.text_amharic: ጭነትም ወርቅና ብር የከበረም ድንጋይ ዕንቁም፥ ቀጭንም ተልባ እግር ቀይም ሐርም ሐምራዊም ልብስ የሚሸትም እንጨት ሁሉ፥ ከዝሆን ጥርስም የተሰራ ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ እጅግም ከከበረ እንጨት ከናስም ከብረትም ከዕብነ በረድም የተሰራ ዕቃ ሁሉ፥

verses.text_english: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
verses.text_amharic: ቀረፋም ቅመምም የሚቃጠልም ሽቱ ቅባትም ዕጣንም የወይን ጠጅም ዘይትም የተሰለቀ ዱቄትም ስንዴም ከብትም በግም ፈረስም ሰረገላም ባሪያዎችም የሰዎችም ነፍሳት ነው።

verses.text_english: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
verses.text_amharic: ነፍስሽም የጎመጀችው ፍሬ ከአንቺ ዘንድ አልፎአል፥ የሚቀማጠልና የሚያጌጥም ነገር ሁሉ ጠፍቶብሻል፥ ሰዎችም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከቶ አያገኙአቸውም።

verses.text_english: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
verses.text_amharic: እነዚህን የነገዱ በእርስዋም ባለ ጠጋዎች የሆኑት እያለቀሱና እያዘኑ። በቀጭን ተልባ እግርና በቀይ ሐምራዊም ልብስ ለተጐናጸፈች በወርቅና በከበረ ድንጋይም በዕንቁም ለተሸለመች ለታላቂቱ ከተማ ወዮላት፥ ወዮላት፥ ይህን የሚያህል ታላቅ ባለ ጠግነት በአንድ ሰዓት ጠፍቶአልና እያሉ ስቃይዋን ከመፍራት የተነሣ በሩቅ ይቆማሉ። የመርከብም መሪ ሁሉ በመርከብም ወደ ማናቸውም ስፍራ የሚሄድ ሁሉ መርከበኞችም ከባሕርም የሚጠቀሙ ሁሉ በሩቅ ቆሙ፥

verses.text_english: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What like unto this great city!
verses.text_amharic: የመቃጠልዋንም ጢስ ባዩ ጊዜ። ታላቂቱን ከተማ የምትመስላት ምን ከተማ ነበረች? እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
verses.text_amharic: በራሳቸውም ላይ ትቢያ ነስንሰው እያለቀሱና እያዘኑ። በባሕር መርከቦች ያሉአቸውን ሁሉ ከባለ ጠግነትዋ የተነሣ ባለ ጠጋዎች ላደረገች ለታላቂቱ ከተማ ወዮላት፥ ወዮላት፥ በአንድ ሰዓት ጠፍታለችና እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.text_english: Rejoice over her, heaven, and holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይ ሆይ፥ ቅዱሳን ሐዋርያት ነቢያትም ሆይ፥ በእርስዋ ላይ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር ፈርዶላችኋልና።

verses.text_english: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
verses.text_amharic: አንድም ብርቱ መልአክ ትልቅን ወፍጮ የሚመስልን ድንጋይ አንስቶ ወደ ባሕር ወረወረው እንዲህ ሲል። ታላቂቱ ከተማ ባቢሎን እንዲህ ተገፍታ ትወድቃለች ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ከቶ አትገኝም።

verses.text_english: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft , shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
verses.text_amharic: በገና የሚመቱና የሚዘምሩም ድምፅ እንቢልታንና መለከትንም የሚነፉ ድምፅ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በአንቺ ውስጥ ከቶ አይሰማም፥ የእጅ ጥበብም ሁሉ አንድ ብልሃተኛ እንኳ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በአንቺ ውስጥ ከቶ አይገኝም፥ የወፍጮ ድምጽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በአንቺ ውስጥ ከቶ አይሰማም፥

verses.text_english: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
verses.text_amharic: የመብራትም ብርሃን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በአንቺ ውስጥ ከቶ አይበራም፥ የሙሽራና የሙሽራይቱም ድምጽ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በአንቺ ውስጥ ከቶ አይሰማም፤ ነጋዴዎችሽ የምድር መኳንንት ነበሩና፥ በአስማትሽም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስተዋልና።

verses.text_english: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
verses.text_amharic: በእርስዋም ውስጥ የነቢያትና የቅዱሳን ደም በምድርም የታረዱ ሁሉ ደም ተገኘባት።

verses.text_english: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
verses.text_amharic: ከዚህ በኋላ በሰማይ።

verses.text_english: For true and righteous his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
verses.text_amharic: ሃሌ ሉያ፤ በዝሙትዋ ምድርን ያጠፋችይቱን ታላቂቱን ጋለሞታ ስለ ፈረደባት፥ የባሪያዎቹንም ደም ከእጅዋ ስለ ተበቀለ፥ ፍርዶቹ እውነትና ጽድቅ ናቸውና ማዳንና ክብር ኃይልም የአምላካችን ነው ብሎ ሲናገር እንደ ብዙ ሕዝብ ታላቅ ድምፅ ያለ ድምፅን ሰማሁ።

verses.text_english: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ደግመውም። ሃሌ ሉያ አሉ፤ ጢስዋም ለዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ይወጣል።

verses.text_english: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
verses.text_amharic: ሀያ አራቱም ሽማግሌዎችና አራቱ እንስሶች በፊታቸው ተደፍተው በዙፋኑ ላይ ለተቀመጠው ለእግዚአብሔር። አሜን፥ ሃሌ ሉያ እያሉ ሰገዱለት።

verses.text_english: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
verses.text_amharic: ድምፅም። ባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ እርሱንም የምትፈሩት ታናናሾችና ታላላቆች ሆይ፥ አምላካችንን አመስግኑ

verses.text_english: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
verses.text_amharic: ሲል ከዙፋኑ ወጣ። እንደ ብዙ ሕዝብም ድምፅ፥ እንደ ብዙ ውኃዎችም ድምፅ፥ እንደ ብርቱም ነጐድጓድ ድምፅ ያለ ድምፅ ሰማሁ እንዲህ ሲል። ሃሌ ሉያ፤ ሁሉን የሚገዛ ጌታ አምላካችን ነግሦአልና።

verses.text_english: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
verses.text_amharic: የበጉ ሰርግ ስለ ደረሰ ሚስቱም ራስዋን ስላዘጋጀች ደስ ይበለን ሐሤትም እናድርግ ክብርንም ለእርሱ እናቅርብ።

verses.text_english: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
verses.text_amharic: ያጌጠና የተጣራ ቀጭን የተልባ እግር ልብስ እንድትጐናጸፍ ተሰጥቶአታል። ቀጭኑ የተልባ እግር የቅዱሳን ጽድቅ ሥራ ነውና።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። ወደ በጉ ሰርግ እራት የተጠሩ ብፁዓን ናቸው ብለህ ጻፍ አለኝ። ደግሞም። ይህ የእግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ ቃል ነው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
verses.text_amharic: ልሰግድለትም በእግሩ ፊት ተደፋሁ። እርሱም። እንዳታደርገው ተጠንቀቅ፤ ከአንተ ጋር የኢየሱስም ምስክር ካላቸው ከወንድሞችህ ጋር አብሬ ባሪያ ነኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገድ፤ የኢየሱስ ምስክር የትንቢት መንፈስ ነውና አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
verses.text_amharic: ሰማይም ተከፍቶ አየሁ፥ እነሆም አምባላይ ፈረስ፥ የተቀመጠበትም የታመነና እውነተኛ ይባላል፥ በጽድቅም ይፈርዳል ይዋጋልም።

verses.text_english: His eyes as a flame of fire, and on his head many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
verses.text_amharic: ዓይኖቹም እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ናቸው፥ በራሱ ላይም ብዙ ዘውዶች አሉ፥ ከእርሱም በቀር አንድ እንኳ የማያውቀው የተጻፈ ስም አለው፤

verses.text_english: And he clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
verses.text_amharic: በደምም የተረጨ ልብስ ተጐናጽፎአል፥ ስሙም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ተብሎአል።

verses.text_english: And the armies in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
verses.text_amharic: በሰማይም ያሉት ጭፍራዎች ነጭና ጥሩ ቀጭን የተልባ እግር ልብስ ለብሰው በአምባላዮች ፈረሶች ተቀምጠው ይከተሉት ነበር።

verses.text_english: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብንም ይመታበት ዘንድ ስለታም ሰይፍ ከአፉ ይወጣል፤ እርሱም በብረት በትር ይገዛቸዋል፤ እርሱም ሁሉን የሚገዛ የእግዚአብሔርን የብርቱ ቍጣውን ወይን መጥመቂያ ይረግጣል።

verses.text_english: And he hath on vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
verses.text_amharic: በልብሱና በጭኑም የተጻፈበት። የነገሥታት ንጉሥና የጌታዎች ጌታ የሚል ስም አለው።

verses.text_english: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all free and bond, both small and great.
verses.text_amharic: በፈረሱም የተቀመጠውን ጭፍራዎቹንም ይወጉ ዘንድ አውሬውና የምድር ነገሥታት ጭፍራዎቻቸውም ተከማችተው አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
verses.text_amharic: አውሬውም ተያዘ በእርሱም ፊት ተአምራትን እያደረገ የአውሬውን ምልክት የተቀበሉትን ለምስሉም የሰገዱትን ያሳተ ሐሰተኛው ነቢይ ከእርሱ ጋር ተያዘ፤ ሁለቱም በሕይወት ሳሉ በዲን ወደሚቃጠል ወደ እሳት ባሕር ተጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩትም በፈረስ ላይ ከተቀመጠው ከአፉ በሚወጣው ሰይፍ ተገደሉ፤ ወፎችም ሁሉ ከሥጋቸው ጠገቡ።

verses.text_english: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
verses.text_amharic: የጥልቁንም መክፈቻና ታላቁን ሰንሰለት በእጁ የያዘ መልአክ ከሰማይ ሲወርድ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
verses.text_amharic: የቀደመውንም እባብ ዘንዶውን እርሱም ዲያብሎስና ሰይጣን የተባለውን ያዘው፥

verses.text_english: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
verses.text_amharic: ሺህ ዓመትም አሰረው፥ ወደ ጥልቅም ጣለው አሕዛብንም ወደ ፊት እንዳያስት ሺህ ዓመት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ በእርሱ ላይ ዘግቶ ማኅተም አደረገበት፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ለጥቂት ጊዜ ይፈታ ዘንድ ይገባዋል።

verses.text_english: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
verses.text_amharic: ዙፋኖችንም አየሁ፥ በእነርሱም ላይ ለተቀመጡት ዳኝነት ተሰጣቸው፤ ስለ ኢየሱስም ምስክርና ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ራሶቻቸው የተቈረጡባቸውን ሰዎች ነፍሳት፥ ለአውሬውና ለምስሉም ያልሰገዱትን ምልክቱንም በግምባራቸው በእጆቻቸውም ላይ ያልተቀበሉትን አየሁ፤ ከክርስቶስም ጋር ሺህ ዓመት ኖሩና ነገሡ።

verses.text_english: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This the first resurrection.
verses.text_amharic: የቀሩቱ ሙታን ግን ይህ ሺህ ዓመት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ በሕይወት አልኖሩም። ይህ የፊተኛው ትንሣኤ ነው።

verses.text_english: Blessed and holy he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
verses.text_amharic: በፊተኛው ትንሣኤ ዕድል ያለው ብፁዕና ቅዱስ ነው፤ ሁለተኛው ሞት በእነርሱ ላይ ሥልጣን የለውም፥ ዳሩ ግን የእግዚአብሔርና የክርስቶስ ካህናት ይሆናሉ ከእርሱም ጋር ይህን ሺህ ዓመት ይነግሣሉ።

verses.text_english: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
verses.text_amharic: ሺሁም ዓመት ሲፈጸም ሰይጣን ከእስራቱ ይፈታል፥

verses.text_english: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom as the sand of the sea.
verses.text_amharic: በአራቱም በምድር ማዕዘን ያሉትን አሕዛብ፥ ጎግንና ማጎግን፥ እንዲያስታቸው ለሰልፍም እንዲያስከትታቸው ይወጣል፤ ቍጥራቸውም እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ የሚያህል ነው።

verses.text_english: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ምድርም ስፋት ወጡ የቅዱሳንንም ሰፈርና የተወደደችውን ከተማ ከበቡ፤ እሳትም ከሰማይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወርዳ በላቻቸው።

verses.text_english: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ያሳታቸውም ዲያብሎስ አውሬውና ሐሰተኛው ነቢይ ወዳሉበት ወደ እሳቱና ወደ ዲኑ ባሕር ተጣለ፥ ለዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም ቀንና ሌሊት ይሣቀያሉ።

verses.text_english: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅና ነጭ ዙፋንን በእርሱም ላይ የተቀመጠውን አየሁ፥ ምድርና ሰማይም ከፊቱ ሸሹ ስፍራም አልተገኘላቸውም።

verses.text_english: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
verses.text_amharic: ሙታንንም ታናናሾችንና ታላላቆችን በዙፋኑ ፊት ቆመው አየሁ፥ መጻሕፍትም ተከፈቱ፤ ሌላ መጽሐፍም ተከፈተ እርሱም የሕይወት መጽሐፍ ነው፤ ሙታንም በመጻሕፍት ተጽፎ እንደ ነበረ እንደ ሥራቸው መጠን ተከፈሉ።

verses.text_english: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
verses.text_amharic: ባሕርም በእርሱ ውስጥ ያሉትን ሙታን ሰጠ፥ ሞትና ሲኦልም በእነርሱ ዘንድ ያሉትን ሙታን ሰጡ፥ እያንዳንዱም እንደ ሥራው መጠን ተከፈለ።

verses.text_english: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
verses.text_amharic: ሞትና ሲኦልም በእሳት ባሕር ውስጥ ተጣሉ። ይህም የእሳት ባሕር ሁለተኛው ሞት ነው።

verses.text_english: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
verses.text_amharic: በሕይወትም መጽሐፍ ተጽፎ ያልተገኘው ማንኛውም በእሳት ባሕር ውስጥ ተጣለ።

verses.text_english: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
verses.text_amharic: አዲስ ሰማይንና አዲስ ምድርንም አየሁ፥ ፊተኛው ሰማይና ፊተኛይቱ ምድር አልፈዋልና፥ ባሕርም ወደ ፊት የለም።

verses.text_english: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.text_amharic: ቅድስቲቱም ከተማ አዲሲቱ ኢየሩሳሌም፥ ለባልዋ እንደ ተሸለመች ሙሽራ ተዘጋጅታ፥ ከሰማይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ስትወርድ አየሁ።

verses.text_english: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, their God.
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅም ድምፅ ከሰማይ። እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ድንኳን በሰዎች መካከል ነው ከእነርሱም ጋር ያድራል፥ እነርሱም ሕዝቡ ይሆናሉ እግዚአብሔርም እርሱ ራሱ ከእነርሱ ጋር ሆኖ አምላካቸው ይሆናል፤

verses.text_english: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
verses.text_amharic: እንባዎችንም ሁሉ ከዓይኖቻቸው ያብሳል፥ ሞትም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይሆንም፥ ኀዘንም ቢሆን ወይም ጩኸት ወይም ሥቃይ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይሆንም፥ የቀደመው ሥርዓት አልፎአልና ብሎ ሲናገር ሰማሁ።
