verses.text_english: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
verses.text_amharic: በዙፋንም የተቀመጠው። እነሆ፥ ሁሉን አዲስ አደርጋለሁ አለ። ለእኔም። እነዚህ ቃሎች የታመኑና እውነተኛዎች ናቸውና ጻፍ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
verses.text_amharic: አለኝም። ተፈጽሞአል። አልፋና ዖሜጋ፥ መጀመሪያውና መጨረሻው እኔ ነኝ። ለተጠማ ከሕይወት ውኃ ምንጭ እንዲያው እኔ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.text_english: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
verses.text_amharic: ድል የሚነሣ ይህን ይወርሳል አምላክም እሆነዋለሁ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል።

verses.text_english: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
verses.text_amharic: ዳሩ ግን የሚፈሩና የማያምኑ የርኵሳንም የነፍሰ ገዳዮችም የሴሰኛዎችም የአስማተኛዎችም ጣዖትንም የሚያመልኩ የሐሰተኛዎችም ሁሉ ዕድላቸው በዲንና በእሳት በሚቃጠል ባሕር ነው፤ ይኸውም ሁለተኛው ሞት ነው።

verses.text_english: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
verses.text_amharic: ሰባቱም ኋለኛዎች መቅሠፍቶች የሞሉባቸውን ሰባቱን ጽዋዎች ከያዙት ከሰባቱ መላእክት አንዱ መጥቶ። ወደዚህ ና፥ የበጉንም ሚስት ሙሽራይቱን አሳይሃለሁ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.text_english: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
Having the glory of God: and her light like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
verses.text_amharic: ታላቅና ረጅም ቅጥር ነበራት፥ አሥራ ሁለትም ደጆች ነበሩአት በደጆቹም አሥራ ሁለት መላእክት ቆሙ፥ የአሥራ ሁለቱም የእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች ስሞች ተጽፈውባቸው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And had a wall great and high, had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.text_amharic: በምሥራቅ ሦስት ደጆች፥ በሰሜንም ሦስት ደጆች፥ በደቡብም ሦስት ደጆች፥ በምዕራብም ሦስት ደጆች ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
verses.text_amharic: ለከተማይቱም ቅጥር አሥራ ሁለት መሠረቶች ነበሩአት፥ በእነርሱም ውስጥ የአሥራ ሁለቱ የበጉ ሐዋርያት ስሞች ተጽፈው ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.text_amharic: የተናገረኝም ከተማይቱንና ደጆችዋን ቅጥርዋንም ይለካ ዘንድ የወርቅ ዘንግ ነበረው።

verses.text_english: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
verses.text_amharic: ከተማይቱም አራት ማዕዘን ነበራት፥ ርዝመትዋም እንደ ስፋትዋ ልክ ነበረ። ከተማይቱንም በዘንግ ለካት አሥራ ሁለትም ሺህ ምዕራፍ ሆነች፤ ርዝመትዋና ስፋትዋ ከፍታዋም ትክክል ነው።

verses.text_english: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥርዋንም ለካ፥ መቶ አርባ አራት ክንድ በሰው ልክ፥ እርሱም በመልአክ ልክ።

verses.text_english: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred forty four cubits, the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
verses.text_amharic: ቅጥርዋም ከኢያሰጲድ የተሠራ ነበረ፥ ከተማይቱም ጥሩ ብርጭቆ የሚመስል ጥሩ ወርቅ ነበረች።

verses.text_english: And the building of the wall of it was jasper: and the city pure gold, like unto clear glass.
verses.text_amharic: የከተማይቱም ቅጥር መሠረት በከበረ ድንጋይ ሁሉ ተጌጦ ነበር፤ ፊተኛው መሠረት ኢያሰጲድ፥ ሁለተኛው ሰንፔር፥ ሦስተኛው ኬልቄዶን፥ አራተኛው መረግድ፥

verses.text_english: And the foundations of the wall of the city garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
verses.text_amharic: አምስተኛው ሰርዶንክስ፥ ስድስተኛው ሰርድዮን፥ ሰባተኛው ክርስቲሎቤ፥ ስምንተኛው ቢረሌ፥ ዘጠነኛው ወራውሬ፥ አሥረኛው ክርስጵራስስ፥ አሥራ አንደኛው ያክንት፥ አሥራ ሁለተኛው አሜቴስጢኖስ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
verses.text_amharic: አሥራ ሁለቱም ደጆች አሥራ ሁለት ዕንቆች ነበሩ፤ እየአንዳንዱ ደጅ ከአንድ ዕንቍ የተሠራ ነበረ። የከተማይቱም አደባባይ ጥሩ ብርጭቆ የሚመስል ጥሩ ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.text_english: And the twelve gates twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
verses.text_amharic: ሁሉንም የሚገዛ ጌታ አምላክና በጉ መቅደስዋ ናቸውና መቅደስ በእርስዋ ዘንድ አላየሁም።

verses.text_english: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
verses.text_amharic: ለከተማይቱም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ስለሚያበራላት መብራትዋም በጉ ስለ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይ ወይም ጨረቃ እንዲያበሩላት አያስፈልጓትም ነበር።

verses.text_english: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb the light thereof.
verses.text_amharic: አሕዛብም በብርሃንዋ ይመላለሳሉ፥ የምድርም ነገሥታት ክብራቸውን ወደ እርስዋ ያመጣሉ፤

verses.text_english: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
verses.text_amharic: በዚያም ሌሊት ስለሌለ ደጆችዋ በቀን ከቶ አይዘጉም፥

verses.text_english: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
verses.text_amharic: የአሕዛብንም ግርማና ክብር ወደ እርስዋ ያመጣሉ።

verses.text_english: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
verses.text_amharic: ለበጉም በሆነው በሕይወት መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት በቀር፥ ጸያፍ ነገር ሁሉ ርኵሰትና ውሸትም የሚያደርግ ወደ እርስዋ ከቶ አይገባም።

verses.text_english: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
verses.text_amharic: በአደባባይዋም መካከል ከእግዚአብሔርና ከበጉ ዙፋን የሚወጣውን እንደ ብርሌ የሚያንጸባርቀውን የሕይወትን ውኃ ወንዝ አሳየኝ።

verses.text_english: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, the tree of life, which bare twelve fruits, yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree for the healing of the nations.
verses.text_amharic: በወንዙም ወዲያና ወዲህ በየወሩ እያፈራ አሥራ ሁለት ፍሬ የሚሰጥ የሕይወት ዛፍ ነበረ፥ የዛፉም ቅጠሎች ለሕዝብ መፈወሻ ነበሩ።

verses.text_english: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ መርገም ከቶ አይሆንም። የእግዚአብሔርና የበጉም ዙፋን በእርስዋ ውስጥ ይሆናል፥ ባሪያዎቹም ያመልኩታል፥ ፊቱንም ያያሉ፥

verses.text_english: And they shall see his face; and his name in their foreheads.
verses.text_amharic: ስሙም በግምባሮቻቸው ይሆናል።

verses.text_english: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.text_amharic: ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ሌሊት አይሆንም፥ ጌታ አምላክም በእነርሱ ላይ ያበራላቸዋልና የመብራት ብርሃንና የፀሐይ ብርሃን አያስፈልጋቸውም፤ ለዘላለምም እስከ ዘላለም ይነግሣሉ።

verses.text_english: And he said unto me, These sayings faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እነዚህ ቃሎች የታመኑና እውነተኛዎች ናቸው፥ የነቢያትም መናፍስት ጌታ አምላክ በቶሎ ሊሆን የሚገባውን ነገር ለባሪያዎቹ እንዲያሳይ መልአኩን ሰደደ።

verses.text_english: Behold, I come quickly: blessed he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆም፥ በቶሎ እመጣለሁ። የዚህን መጽሐፍ ትንቢት ቃል የሚጠብቅ ብፁዕ ነው አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And I John saw these things, and heard . And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
verses.text_amharic: ይህንም ያየሁትና የሰማሁት እኔ ዮሐንስ ነኝ። በሰማሁትና ባየሁትም ጊዜ ይህን ባሳየኝ በመልአኩ እግር ፊት እሰግድ ዘንድ ተደፋሁ።

verses.text_english: Then saith he unto me, See not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
verses.text_amharic: እርሱም። እንዳታደርገው ተጠንቀቅ፤ ከአንተ ጋር ከወንድሞችህም ከነቢያት ጋር የዚህንም መጽሐፍ ቃል ከሚጠብቁ ጋር አብሬ ባሪያ ነኝ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገድ አለኝ።

verses.text_english: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
verses.text_amharic: ለእኔም። ዘመኑ ቀርቦአልና የዚህን መጽሐፍ ትንቢት ቃል በማኅተም አትዝጋው።

verses.text_english: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
verses.text_amharic: ዓመፀኛው ወደ ፊት ያምፅ፥ ርኵሱም ወደ ፊት ይርከስ፥ ጻድቁም ወደ ፊት ጽድቅ ያድርግ፥ ቅዱሱም ወደፊት ይቀደስ አለ።

verses.text_english: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verses.text_amharic: እነሆ፥ በቶሎ እመጣለሁ፥ ለእያንዳንዱም እንደ ሥራው መጠን እከፍል ዘንድ ዋጋዬ ከእኔ ጋር አለ።

verses.text_english: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
verses.text_amharic: አልፋና ዖሜጋ፥ ፊተኛውና ኋለኛው፥ መጀመሪያውና መጨረሻው እኔ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: Blessed they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
verses.text_amharic: ወደ ሕይወት ዛፍ ለመድረስ ሥልጣን እንዲኖራቸው በደጆችዋም ወደ ከተማይቱም እንዲገቡ ልብሳቸውን የሚያጥቡ ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.text_english: For without dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
verses.text_amharic: ውሻዎችና አስማተኞች ሴሰኛዎችም ነፍሰ ገዳዮችም ጣዖትንም የሚያመልኩት ውሸትንም የሚወዱና የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ በውጭ አሉ።

verses.text_english: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright and morning star.
verses.text_amharic: እኔ ኢየሱስ በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ዘንድ ይህን እንዲመሰክርላችሁ መልአኬን ላክሁ። እኔ የዳዊት ሥርና ዘር ነኝ፥ የሚያበራም የንጋት ኮከብ ነኝ።

verses.text_english: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.text_amharic: መንፈሱና ሙሽራይቱም። ና ይላሉ። የሚሰማም። ና ይበል። የተጠማም ይምጣ፥ የወደደም የሕይወትን ውኃ እንዲያው ይውሰድ።

verses.text_english: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
verses.text_amharic: በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን የትንቢት ቃል ለሚሰማ ሁሉ እኔ እመሰክራለሁ፤ ማንም በዚህ ላይ አንዳች ቢጨምር እግዚአብሔር በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፉትን መቅሠፍቶች ይጨምርበታል፤

verses.text_english: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and the things which are written in this book.
verses.text_amharic: ማንምም በዚህ በትንቢት መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት ቃሎች አንዳች ቢያጎድል፥ በዚህ መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት ከሕይወት ዛፍና ከቅድስቲቱ ከተማ እግዚአብሔር ዕድሉን ያጎድልበታል።

verses.text_english: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
verses.text_amharic: ይህን የሚመሰክር። አዎን፥ በቶሎ እመጣለሁ ይላል። አሜን፥ ጌታ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ና።

verses.text_english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ with you all. Amen.
verses.text_amharic: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
